If this ally is under the effect of {g|f:9c78e44bf8ff44a9afff8370c673c9ad}Voice of Command{/g} and kills an enemy before the end of the Officer's turn, the ally gains a one-time additional +{uip|Momentum|5bfccf14d8604ae1a041fb347fb8f19f} {g|Encyclopedia:MomentumWithDetailsGlossary}momentum{/g}.
This {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} cannot be used on the same ally more than once per round.

f6e6bb53-2b2e-43ce-b5b6-41aaba3d0e24.Text:
The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerLeaderGlossary}Officer{/g} treats their own or their ally's {g|Encyclopedia:Injury}fresh injury{/g}.
! Once after each combat.

f06186bd-3126-4012-91cf-37300aa4239c.Text: This character was targeted by the {g|f:5bfccf14d8604ae1a041fb347fb8f19f}Bring It Down!{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} this {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g} and cannot be targeted again.

1d5e3a4b-0889-4d23-9d62-f59f6f0db5aa.Text:
The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerLeaderGlossary}Officer{/g} forces an ally to fully push themselves, increasing their {g|Encyclopedia:Characteristic}characteristics{/g} by +{uip|BonusStats|9c78e44bf8ff44a9afff8370c673c9ad} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.
Additionally, all of the Officer's {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}abilities{/g} can be applied to the target of {g|f:9c78e44bf8ff44a9afff8370c673c9ad}Voice of Command{/g} from any distance.
A character who becomes the target of {g|f:9c78e44bf8ff44a9afff8370c673c9ad}Voice of Command{/g} cannot be targeted by this ability again for the next 2 rounds.

281eda93-48b7-4c73-9fcd-886657fd7c7a.Text: This character cannot be targeted by the {g|f:9c78e44bf8ff44a9afff8370c673c9ad}Voice of Command{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g}.

d58a61f3-7d40-456b-b771-d039cc6e8435.Text:
The Officer immediately grants an ally additional {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} equal to {unit_stat|WarhammerFellowship|bonus}. The target can only use movement abilities, {g|Encyclopedia:HeroicAct}heroic acts{/g}, or {g|Encyclopedia:DesperateMeasure}desperate measures{/g} during this {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}extra turn{/g}.
If the target is under the effect of {g|f:9c78e44bf8ff44a9afff8370c673c9ad}Voice of Command{/g}, it ignores {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g} until the end of the Officer's turn.

da4856fc-0dd4-4a0f-9d65-145f305b1a4a.Text:
The Officer encourages an ally, who immediately recovers from {g|Encyclopedia:BurningEffect}burning{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}bleeding{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:ToxinEffect}toxin{/g}, and {g|Encyclopedia:Stun}stunned{/g} effects.
If the target is under the effect of {g|f:9c78e44bf8ff44a9afff8370c673c9ad}Voice of Command{/g}, they also gain +{uip|TemporaryWounds|083057fc1a6b47f29ea0409337135030} {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g}.

d64ca2f4-d170-4d60-8177-87a96d048a7d.Text: The psyker assaults the targets with a telekinetic strike, dealing <u>((from 1 to 4) + {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}WP{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} / 2)</u> damage and attempts to knock the targets {g|Encyclopedia:ProneEffect}prone{/g}. The targets must pass a Toughness {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a −<u>(5 × {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}psy rating{/g})</u> penalty to stay on their feet.

6851e82a-ef67-4b00-a4c3-a79140149d69.Text: Chains up to 4 targets within a 3-cell radius, dealing {uip|Damage|7b68b4aa3c024f348a20dce3ef172e40} {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} to each.

cad8e19f-e9dc-44c7-89d2-82aee1662238.Text: Chains up to 6 targets within a 6-cell radius, dealing {uip|Damage|3c48374cbe244fc2bb8b6293230a6829} {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} to each.

e17507ad-af19-48e6-94ab-5cf2a209fe60.Text: <u>(2 × psyker's staff power level × {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}psy rating{/g} + psyker's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}WP{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g})</u>

20d36665-f367-414d-aa0b-a42643b53529.Text: Chains up to 6 targets within a 6-cell radius, dealing {uip|Damage|635161f3087c4294bf39c5fefe3d01af} {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} to each. Ignores friendly targets.

a0ad4ea9-ae94-400f-be33-5b07cb729f23.Text: <u>(2 × psyker's staff power level × {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}psy rating{/g} + psyker's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}WP{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g})</u>

74d42dfd-a8c3-4234-9138-382d81c4a636.Text: The psyker makes the target attack their nearest ally. The target must pass a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} in order to regain control of their body.

acb4a91e-2898-45f6-8c15-39bb37ee7b51.Text: Everyone within a 7-cell cone in front of the psyker suffers {g|f:fa305ba4e2aa48f394608d1ccfc6d385}Psychic Shriek{/g} damage and is forced to make a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g}. All targets that fail that test are {g|Encyclopedia:Stun}stunned{/g} until the psyker's next turn.

e17088a2-8fef-4af4-8d3c-07288af53661.Text: The psyker deals {g|f:fa305ba4e2aa48f394608d1ccfc6d385}Psychic Shriek{/g} damage to everyone within a 7-cell cone in front of the psyker and forces them to make a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g}. All targets that fail the test are {g|Encyclopedia:Stun}stunned{/g} until the psyker's next turn.

64e2099e-612b-48db-ba29-58afa56c0633.Text: [draft] The Psyker protects the target with a Telekinetic Shield that grants additional +5×({g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}psy rating{/g})% {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} against ranged attacks.

86a9f043-d9f3-4af8-b010-ba7a63a50858.Text:
[draft]The Psycker catches the target up in a whirling vortex of telekinetic powers, each {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g} pulling enemies around toward its centre and damaging enemies within.
Enemies must succeed on a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Test}test{/g} to move away from the vortex. The ones who reach the adjacent to the centre area take additional {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} and become {g|Encyclopedia:Stun}stunned{/g}.

1ecf325f-485f-4cc9-9191-dcf1746fd201.Text:
The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerBladedancerGlossary}Bladedancer{/g} targets a single enemy, vowing to dispatch their mark. The Bladedancer's next attack against their selected enemy cannot be {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodged{/g} or parried. If this attack kills the target, the Bladedancer regains +{uip|Heal|590c990c1d684fd09ae883754d28a8ac} {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} and gains +1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} along with an additional attack this {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}.
This {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} can be used multiple times per turn, but it grants +1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} and an additional attack only once per {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.

390c665c-d286-4ee6-9065-f43519fb7beb.Text:
Bladedancers are swift and deadly masters of the sword, specialising in delivering flurries of rapid strikes, able to sacrifice a part of their health to enhance their close combat capabilities. Bladedancers prefer to avoid enemy attacks, either by parrying, dodging, or quickly repositioning before enemy counter-attacks. They even have the ability to parry ranged attacks.
Core focus: melee, swords, movement, dodge, parry.

79c65f56-6d62-453e-bbcc-bb739de0b77d.Text: Attacks with the chosen {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee{/g} weapon are 20% harder to {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g}. Its damage and {g|Encyclopedia:ArmourPenetration}armour penetration{/g} are increased by +2.

13d8bf98-daf5-4c73-b75d-c19ecbec4092.Text: Attacks with the chosen ranged weapon gain a +20% bonus to {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit chance{/g}. Its {g|Encyclopedia:Recoil}recoil{/g} is reduced by −25% and its {g|Encyclopedia:RateOfFire}rate of fire{/g} is increased by +25% (by at least 1 shot).

19713c81-fe5c-427b-876d-3d7e8a755526.Text: Attacks with the chosen ranged weapon gain a +20% bonus to {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit chance{/g}. Its {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:ArmourPenetration}armour penetration{/g} are increased by +2.

d77c552f-81b1-48a3-b603-ad6c1ac25310.Text:
The Soldier immediately spends all their {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} and gains a +30% bonus to {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}cover efficiency{/g}.
The next time the Soldier uses {g|f:7a76af1ef02c4699b62db147e2b9a172}Run and Gun{/g}, they gain back all spent AP and MP plus 1 additional AP. It also resets the cooldown of all other Soldier's abilities except for {g|f:7a76af1ef02c4699b62db147e2b9a172}Run and Gun{/g}.

d6c4053c-da58-4c97-a3eb-aac5a8138668.Text: The Soldier immediately dashes in the selected direction, spending all their {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}movement points{/g}. Does not provoke {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g}. Allows the Soldier to dash through allies and enemies but not through obstacles.

7dc753d9-99a6-4a8f-a02d-ceb9a745ef84.Text: The Soldier suffers a −10 {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerBallisticSkill}Ballistic Skill{/g} and cannot use {g|f:7a76af1ef02c4699b62db147e2b9a172}Run and Gun{/g}.

6c56e757-a5f5-4b11-82a3-d0d8bd3833aa.Text:
The Soldier gains +{uip|MovementPoints|5e60764f84c94277ae6a78b63a1fd2aa} {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g}. Their next attack costs −1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} less and does not count toward the attack limit per turn.
Until the end of the next turn, the Soldier becomes winded. While winded, the Soldier suffers a −10 penalty to {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerBallisticSkill}Ballistic Skill{/g} and cannot use {g|f:7a76af1ef02c4699b62db147e2b9a172}Run and Gun{/g}.

2e4ff37d-4f5a-44ab-9e1e-841d7b00b902.Text:
The Aeldari are supernaturally agile and can advance their {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerPerception}Perception{/g}, and {g|Encyclopedia:SkillAwareness}Awareness{/g} skills regardless of their archetypes.
They also gain +15% {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} chance and +2 {g|Encyclopedia:InitiativeGlossary}initiative{/g}.

a6bc1469-0b9f-4608-9553-89125f83d20f.Text:
{g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} (AGI) measures a character's quickness, reflexes, and poise. High Agility allows a character to manipulate delicate explosives with finesse or to keep their footing when crossing treacherous terrain. It improves the character's {g|Encyclopedia:InitiativeGlossary}initiative{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} chance, and reaction. If a character uses a {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee{/g} weapon, their {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeReduction}dodge reduction{/g} is equal to the half of their Agility.
It also affects the Demolition skill.

d036e304-3946-4b77-af81-6e01e3eb41c4.Text: {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerBallisticSkill}Ballistic Skill{/g} (BS) reflects a character's accuracy with all forms of {g|Encyclopedia:Range}ranged{/g} weapons and determines the trajectory of shots in a burst. A high Ballistics Skill indicates that a character is a skilled marksman, someone to be feared in a gunfight or skirmish. The base {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit chance{/g} for ranged attacks within a weapon's effective range is <u>(30 + BS)</u>%.

c6f4c7bc-0ccd-4f6e-8e06-16a4f2cbd8be.Text:
Fellowship (FEL) represents a character's ability to interact with other creatures, to deceive, charm, or befriend them. High Fellowship will help a character find a way to approach a gathering of unsociable servants or to effortlessly make deals with treacherous merchants.
It also affects the {g|Encyclopedia:SkillPersuasion}Persuasion{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:SkillCoercion}Coercion{/g}, and {g|Encyclopedia:SkillCommerce}Commerce{/g} skills.

f7dee261-95a7-4801-a2b4-259d2d1c617a.Text:
{g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerIntelligence}Intelligence{/g} (INT) is a measurement of the character's acumen, reason, and knowledge. For each point of an Intelligence bonus, characters deal +5% more damage with non-{g|Encyclopedia:BurstAttacksGlossary}burst{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Range}ranged{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:AreaOfEffect}area attacks{/g}.
It also affects the {g|Encyclopedia:SkillLoreImperium}Lore (Imperium){/g}, Lore (Warp), Lore (Xenos), Logic, Medicae, and Tech-Use skills.

b52bcd5b-9940-4290-afd2-a60a09c24905.Text:
{g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerPerception}Perception{/g} (PER) describes how well a character perceives their surroundings. Characters with high Perception can pick out a stray bolter shell casing in between the day-to-day morass of an underhive, or even tell when someone is being deceitful.
It also affects the {g|Encyclopedia:SkillAwareness}Awareness{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Skills}skill{/g} and reduces enemy {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} chance against a character's attacks.

91309fa8-28bd-480e-b947-371823a39cbc.Text:
{g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerStrength}Strength{/g} (STR) represents how physically strong a character is. It affects the {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} a character inflicts with {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee{/g} weapons and allows them to lift heavier objects. For each point of a Strength bonus, characters deal +5% more damage with one-handed melee weapons and +10% more damage with two-handed melee weapons.
It also affects the {g|Encyclopedia:SkillAthletics}Athletics{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Skills}skill{/g}.

ec6e3092-2cf4-4993-838c-acb976c23c09.Text:
{g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g} (TGH) defines how easily a character can shrug off pain, as well as how easily they can resist toxins, poisonous environments, diseases, and other physical ailments. It increases the chance of resisting negative physical {g|Encyclopedia:CommonStatusesGlossary}effects{/g} and the amount of a character's {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}. For each point of a Toughness bonus, characters gain +10% wounds.
It also affects the {g|Encyclopedia:SkillCarouse}Carouse{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Skills}skill{/g}.

155986e5-041b-4bcb-816a-aaad463683f3.Text: {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}Weapon Skill{/g} (WS) reflects a character's competence in all forms of close combat. It increases their {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g} and reduces enemy parry chance against {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee attacks{/g}. It also increases chances of scoring a {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit{/g} in melee combat.

e18cbeb5-8164-4ae0-bfc0-37374a451762.Text:
{g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} (WP) reflects a character's ability to withstand the horrors of the warp, the terrors of space, and the dreadful opponents they are bound to encounter in the Koronus Expanse. High Willpower allows characters to exert control over a crowd or interrogate a heretic.
It also increases the chances of resisting negative mental {g|Encyclopedia:CommonStatusesGlossary}effects{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic powers{/g}.

2cc8efa6-b724-48f3-9685-c582ffe009d0.Text:
Always in the thick of battle, using their leadership and combat prowess, {g|Encyclopedia:CareerTacticianGlossary}Master Tacticians{/g} are able to harness the {g|Encyclopedia:MomentumWithDetailsGlossary}momentum{/g} of their party to enhance the combat effectiveness of their allies and themselves.
Core focus: scaling with party success, long-term single-target buffs, momentum, versatility.

cd4fccfc-23d8-43fb-ab15-98d24ca23a0e.Text: All weapons in a huge area gain additional effects: Allies' Weapons: {g|Encyclopedia:Recoil}recoil{/g} is reduced by half for {uip|Round|a01295a67a9a46579e46c3073d6a9aa9} rounds. Enemies' {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} is reduced by −{uip|Percent|a01295a67a9a46579e46c3073d6a9aa9}% for {uip|Round|a01295a67a9a46579e46c3073d6a9aa9} rounds. Enemies' Weapons: recoil is increased by half for {uip|Rounds|a01295a67a9a46579e46c3073d6a9aa9} rounds. Allies' dodge is increased by +{uip|Percent|a01295a67a9a46579e46c3073d6a9aa9}% for {uip|Round|a01295a67a9a46579e46c3073d6a9aa9} rounds.

d9667a6e-cf5b-4b08-9751-3933ad778b13.Text: Ballistic mechadendrites allow the Tech-Priest to use any ranged weapon hands-free.

fce3091c-e35e-46d1-bf96-a3663a6c3dee.Text: An additional servo-skull connected directly to the Tech-Priest's systems increases their {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerPerception}Perception{/g} by +10.

36c9fa90-1db3-48df-af9d-d7af114ffaee.Text: This mechadendrite is equipped with all kinds of tools to communicate with machine spirits. Increases {g|Encyclopedia:SkillTechUse}Tech-Use{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:SkillDemolition}Demolition{/g} by +10.

803fffb7-7aaf-4155-937d-d5a647901585.Text: Grants a +15 {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}Weapon Skill{/g} with Omnissian axes.

e788a4cb-eba0-46fb-b9a8-48bb23ba8ef7.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerVanguardGlossary}Vanguard{/g} gains +2 to {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} and to {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g} for each unused {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} this {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.

2a635637-981e-4835-bd1a-da7470c050b6.Text: Each attack against the Vanguard grants them +1 stack of unyielding beacon. Each stack increases their {g|Encyclopedia:Resolve}resolve{/g} by +1, up to a maximum of +15. All allies in a 2-cell radius around the Vanguard gain 1/5 of that {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g}. {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}Temporary wounds{/g} applied to the Vanguard now stack, but only remain stacked until the start of the Vanguard's turn. At the start of their turn, the remaining temporary {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} are reduced to the largest amount granted by one applied effect. If the remaining number of temporary wounds is less than the number of stacks of unyielding beacon, it becomes equal to the number of those stacks even if the Vanguard has no temporary wounds at the start of their turn.

558bc526-54a0-466a-8dfc-e4fd4f205f89.Text:
The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerVanguardGlossary}Vanguard{/g} and all their allies in a 3-cell radius around them gain +<u>(3 + number of {g|Encyclopedia:UnyieldingBeacon}unyielding beacon{/g} stacks)</u> {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g}.
All affected targets suffer −50% less {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} from the next attack. The effect lasts until the start of the Vanguard's next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}.

bbf01d37-2849-482b-a93b-afb2fbbf8f44.Text:
The target must pass a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a −{uip|ResistancePenalty|37a95446c4e74c77bf46439923527646} penalty, or on their next turn they will spend all their {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}movement points{/g} to move as close as possible toward the psyker. They can act as normal, but all their MP are spent on moving toward the psyker.
At the end of their turn, the target must make the Willpower resistance {g|Encyclopedia:Test}test{/g} again, otherwise they remain under this effect.

f9842e24-b320-480c-9f22-ca2e82b5cf63.Text: Grants immunity to {g|Encyclopedia:ToxicDamage}toxic damage{/g} and inflicts a −10 {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g} until the end of combat.

455aedc2-a73e-4d88-b0cf-74752e0a5580.Text: Gives immunity to {g|Encyclopedia:ToxicDamage}toxic damage{/g} until the end combat.

5d708bda-cc84-419c-8b00-488250e12087.Text: Grants a +10 {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerStrength}Strength{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g}, and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} and inflicts a −10 penalty to {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerIntelligence}Intelligence{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerPerception}Perception{/g}, and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} for 2 rounds.

ebeedd48-7da7-4556-9cd6-08067ad9f096.Text: The user gains +1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} and immediately resets cooldowns on all attacks and attack {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}abilities{/g}. At the start of the user's next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, they gain +1 stack of {g|Encyclopedia:StaggeredEffect}staggered{/g} that lasts until the end of combat.

90d48de3-fe20-4567-962e-aac1814f53c4.Text:
Requires {g|Encyclopedia:SoulMarkCorruption}Heretical{/g} — Adherent
The user suffers {g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}bleeding{/g} (6). As long as the user is bleeding, they get +100% {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical damage{/g}.

b16b3706-b51b-43ee-9f87-d93d462bcdc8.Text: Grants +15 {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerPerception}Perception{/g}, and all {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} both dealt or suffered by the user increases the user's critical {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit chance{/g} by +10% for each instance of damage. This effect lasts for 2 {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turns{/g}, after that the user becomes {g|Encyclopedia:StaggeredEffect}staggered{/g}.

ff99f29e-8058-48fc-adda-a0f3ee950fae.Text: The user loses all of their temporary wounds and increases their melee damage by the same amount for 1 round.

bcd2c356-f917-4c87-8a7e-3dde132075e9.Text: Grants immunity to {g|Encyclopedia:FireDamage}fire damage{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}bleeding{/g}, but reduces {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} by −10 and {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}movement points{/g} by −2 until the end of combat.

279d8a01-b2f1-438a-ba1b-38b32a64e5b3.Text: The user immediately doubles their {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} and reduces the costs of their non-attack {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}abilities{/g} by −2 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} (to a minimum of 0) until the end of their turn. After the effect ends, the user suffers {g|Encyclopedia:SlowedEffect}slowed{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:StaggeredEffect}staggered{/g} for 1 round.

70820709-6322-4965-a007-25529120c73d.Text: Increases the user's {g|Encyclopedia:Resolve}resolve{/g} by +2 for each level of {g|Encyclopedia:SoulMarkHope}Iconoclast{/g} while decreasing all {g|Encyclopedia:Characteristic}characteristics{/g} by −10 until the end of combat. Does not stack.

f83844da-685c-4f58-af92-14e1f339bd42.Text: The user permanently gains +1 {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}psy rating{/g} and +30% more chance to trigger {g|Encyclopedia:PerilsOfWarp}perils of the warp{/g}.

a70e838f-6b4c-4ec5-a55c-a16529119f10.Text: The user permanently gains +1 {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g}, but suffers −10 {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g}.

56903190-41e1-4d5c-939c-f0a2ccd2ba0e.Text: The user gains +20 to {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerIntelligence}Intelligence{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} for 2 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rounds{/g}. After that the user suffers −20 to Willpower until the end of combat.

fd64972a-b900-42c5-b123-482663d92b07.Text: Instantly increases {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}movement points{/g} by +6 and grants 2 charges of the {g|f:f6d693dbff0d44eb9590684241e63ef3}Slash{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g}, yet reduces {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}Weapon Skill{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerBallisticSkill}Ballistic Skill{/g}, and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerPerception}Perception{/g} by −15 until the start of the user's next turn.

d8ec2f76-c374-4644-a14b-5cbd6b084261.Text: The user suffers −10 {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} from any source until the end of combat. After the combat ends, the user suffers 1 random {g|Encyclopedia:Traumas}trauma{/g}.

e111e6eb-bf05-4f0a-9b8e-b3ad41240efe.Text: Grants +70% {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit chance{/g} and reduces {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} by −70% for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.

a26ce1a0-3f47-4652-9891-c2b88f63b8c7.Text: The user's attacks do not count toward the attack limit until the end of this {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}. Afterward, the user is knocked {g|Encyclopedia:UnconsciousEffect}unconscious{/g}.

eeae97cd-7bd9-4d35-a516-f22baeaf53b2.Text: The user's attacks deal an additional +{uip|Damage|5433415371084b559e028fb201b83b9d} {g|Encyclopedia:WarpDamage}warp damage{/g} until the end of the turn. This turn, each of the user's {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} attacks triggers {g|Encyclopedia:PerilsOfWarp}perils of the warp{/g}.

1306306f-a463-4dcd-aede-8cbc40f4e27b.Text: The user immediately gains +4 {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} and +4 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}. For the next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} their MP and AP are reduced by −2.

1c112d1a-660a-450d-bec2-3a7cd813e9ca.Text: Grants immunity to {g|Encyclopedia:WarpDamage}warp damage{/g} and inflicts a −10 {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerFellowship}Fellowship{/g}, but the user cannot deal warp {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} until the end of combat.

827e233a-f169-41b7-be56-6849ff71c383.Text: Grants immunity to {g|Encyclopedia:WarpDamage}warp damage{/g} and inflicts a −10 {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerFellowship}Fellowship{/g}, but the user cannot deal warp {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} for 2 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rounds{/g}.

a6627729-b79f-41d5-afff-8b7afe3aa4f6.Text: Grants +40% {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} until the start of the next {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}. The user suffers a −10 penalty to {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerStrength}Strength{/g}, and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} during the next round.

dd529468-40fb-48e8-9a42-6f18c9f5910e.Text: Grants +30% {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} and inflicts a −20 {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} for 2 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rounds{/g}.

dbbab2a9-479f-4bb5-b23f-58c9a29ea08a.Text: Deals <u>(from 10 to 20)</u> {g|Encyclopedia:EnergyDamage}energy damage{/g} with 40% {g|Encyclopedia:ArmourPenetration}armour penetration{/g} and blinds enemies for 2 {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turns{/g} if they fail a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Test}test{/g} with a −10 penalty.

82ed2539-e415-43e8-a309-0e564b269c7c.Text: This grenade blinds all enemies within the area for 2 turns if they fail a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Test}test{/g}. Enemies which succeed upon that Toughness test become {g|Encyclopedia:DisturbedEffect}disturbed{/g} for 2 turns.

ed7335ae-500f-4c64-a649-196f963bd21c.Text: Creates a zone of fear in the area of explosion for 1 round. 41df0e27-5524-4b14-ad94-a2c43f00fdee.Text:
"Void Shadows" is the first major story expansion for Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader, offering a massive amount of content with about 15 hours of fresh gameplay and a new romanceable companion. Fully integrated into the game's main story, this DLC will allow players to delve into the depths of their voidship first-hand in an enthralling new story that will pit them against an unfamiliar enemy trying to bring ruin to the von Valancius dynasty from within.

A new story — a tense 15 hours of adventures on board the von Valancius voidship, filled with unexpected threats, various quests, unique equipment, and additional lore content, all of it fully integrated into the main campaign.

A new companion — Kibellah, a Death Cult Assassin, who is ready to pledge her life in service of the von Valancius dynasty just as her predecessors did for generations before, even possibly developing a strong personal bond with the Lord Captain.

A new looming threat arising from within the deepest and darkest bowels of the player's very own voidship — the malignant Genestealer Cult — a horrific breed of xenos who operate from the shadows, infecting your crew with their genetic code to convert them, slowly twisting their faith in the Emperor to carry out their wretched designs.

New crew members — high-level officers integral to voidship operations, numbering thousands upon thousands of souls, stand ready to serve the Lord Captain.

New locations to explore — the sheer magnitude of the voidship hides many distant nooks and crannies where no Lord Captain has gone before.

fdbcdbbe-da99-42f8-805f-d433828bdf89.Text:
"Lex Imperialis" is the second story expansion for Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader, providing an additional 15 hours of thrilling narrative-driven gameplay that explores the iron-clad rule of Imperial Law and introduces an entirely new faction — the Adeptus Arbites. Unravel the dark secrets of House von Valancius as you navigate a perilous web of justice, duty, and betrayal, on a quest that will alter the destiny of the entire Koronus Expanse.
A gripping new story: Immerse yourself in a tense narrative where your choices as judge and judged ripple throughout the Imperium. Delve into the intricate process of the Grand Harvesting and experience firsthand the grim responsibility of collecting the Imperial Tithe — and the severe consequences that await those who interfere with this sacred duty.
Dynamic new mechanics: Embrace tactical innovation with an all-new set of Familiars and bring fresh strategy to combat challenges. Command a majestic cybernetic eagle — a living embodiment of the Aquila — while your companion directs his powerful cyber-mastiff. These battle companions dramatically reshape combat encounters, requiring the use of inventive tactics while delivering thrilling, unpredictable outcomes.
An uncompromising new companion: Meet Solomorne Anthar, a seasoned Arbites officer whose unwavering dedication to Imperial justice is matched only by his simmering anger and hatred of criminals. Accompanied by his loyal cyber-mastiff, this fierce Arbitrator offers players not only formidable combat skills but also a deeply personal romance and a troubled past to uncover.
The Adeptus Arbites revealed: Face the unyielding guardians of Imperial law. These incorruptible enforcers arrive equipped with signature weaponry — shotguns, suppression shields, and power mauls — to redefine battlefield dynamics and tactical gameplay, embodying both their elite status and their relentless pursuit of order.

d591e465-ac82-4322-9f01-c49152df0d43.Text: You convinced Cassia Orsellio to depart Eurac V of her own free will.

b5db37e9-8a3c-426b-82cd-63469f220a88.Text: You took Cassia Orsellio from Eurac V by force.

6c1a2510-280c-4245-be00-43d688f7da41.Text: You took Felek Orsellio's side in the conflict on Eurac V.

719bc29d-ef91-4a0f-9086-72fd5b1d9e9e.Text: You took Theobald Orsellio's side in the conflict on Eurac V.

d2321d6b-cfd7-4210-aac0-118d5206e4e4.Text: You killed both of the Keepers of Eurac V.

d7b82894-e5fe-40f5-aeaf-8aed0ae7e8a7.Text: You used the cultists' clothes to disguise yourself.

2675f8c9-fa76-498e-a6d8-3e57d4894485.Text: You went to Rykadi Philia as soon as you could.

330e8167-019e-4e12-bf8f-62a1bcd14d7c.Text: You were late to arrive on Rykadi Philia.

1ea4b5de-a5e2-4cfc-85e9-7438bb6ce0aa.Text: You learned the code phrase for Ryzza of Footfall from Bakhval on Rykadi Philia.

70c05ea2-c962-4413-9c3e-7770ac76c974.Text: You abandoned Rykad Minoris to its fate, letting it be transformed into a daemon world.

6252526f-ce82-4e97-b5f1-5359d21b954b.Text: You destroyed Rykad Minoris upon giving the order to blow up the Miraculous Fusion Reactor.

4291a63b-6a2c-4eb1-875a-4886c571282b.Text: You refused to destroy Rykad Minoris and dispatched rescue shuttles to the surface.

44d3870e-e8a1-4ee8-a300-d2f255f36911.Text: You went to Rykad Minoris as soon as you could.

0f138cfa-4755-4090-b7fe-21fafde683fa.Text: You were late to arrive on Rykad Minoris.

8a6f0b75-6d83-4f9e-b6e0-769e66ef4b02.Text: You shook Sergeant Malgar's faith in the foundations of the Imperium by scoffing at his devotion to duty.

712e6517-d70e-4a48-888b-24208aa2d492.Text: You sent reinforcements from your ship to help Sergeant Malgar and his people at the starport.

c9e29adc-6d4b-43ab-9319-6ee1d6ac9bc8.Text: You helped the commoners at the starport.

d2c14630-d5eb-4354-9aee-9fe87fabf425.Text: You decided to offer help to all who needed it at the starport.

e9c9e3b8-932d-483e-8eaf-17aaab724c7e.Text: You helped the nobles at the starport.

3cb60120-96e2-4086-8b8f-31eb01b0c17f.Text: You corrupted the defective servitor with the blade shard.

69e1d5bc-2c19-48e2-b2cf-a4f1d4208664.Text: You ordered that the defective servitors be assigned to their former duties.

f94bbfef-3ed2-4686-a0d1-796decc35996.Text: You ordered that the defective servitors be destroyed.

fa7a369d-c85a-4d74-915b-da3dbe280cb2.Text: You chose for ordinary people to be allowed to approach you during the Triumph.

0aa253ab-da7f-47b6-89fb-76c75ce9a725.Text: You helped the vox operator Jaspar at the starport.

461b7cc8-8ac8-43e5-9d25-22f65ec48378.Text: You let the scout Camille live.

0a8542d4-2e32-4e66-a8d8-2192f3521bdc.Text: You chose for a group of planted adulators to approach you during the Triumph.

637af1a1-1b1f-4f7e-8bef-e9b135ea9fe6.Text: You saved the hostages from their own family on Rykad Minoris.

4a933e49-898b-4ea6-9089-8454685ac21f.Text: You brought the pilot Raquel news about her betrothed.

e9783d02-3de6-45aa-b33d-29740326f8ca.Text: You lied to the battery gunners on Rykad Minoris.

eadb7a35-ba4a-49d1-8bdc-61f5c8ba0513.Text: You let the battery gunners on Rykad Minoris walk away with their lives.

36abd211-d0af-43e0-b5c8-3d25c56bac42.Text: You obtained power after witnessing the visions from the bottomless pit.

44fa8b5b-ca85-485a-89cc-6055c4e5a283.Text: You made it to Dargonus before it could be devastated by the Drukhari.

6481c783-5f7f-4d08-ac39-5c6ae16668a9.Text: You made it to Dargonus too late to save it from being devastated by the Drukhari.

72ba771c-1661-4d80-b82e-b03c0fff6ca9.Text: You saved Footfall Station from starvation by granting it your patronage and delivering shipments of grain.

d594c78a-9979-4a0f-8e8e-2fb10a8679d5.Text: You refused to help Footfall with shipments of grain and allowed the Chorda dynasty to take control of the station.

4f195f09-3efc-4bc4-bfbd-ee4291063bb2.Text: You publicly announced your identity when you arrived on Footfall.

ec23d888-f215-42c7-8316-74ba1058cef4.Text: Janus was not harmed during the search for the rebels.

fb107fa8-f05d-4896-9cf7-77976b2c4ab1.Text: You ordered that corrupted grain be shipped from Janus to Footfall.

d3b7a0d7-b0ba-45c7-9c13-3847156b052b.Text: You made a pact with the Aeldari on Janus and let them remain on the planet.

e56c8422-6336-437d-ac37-a2c9dd93b7f2.Text: You destroyed the Aeldari on Janus.

c91a0403-ec54-44de-bfc9-cb55328a6dec.Text: You allowed the Aeldari on Janus to control the planet.

e840a30f-4ad0-46ed-a70e-f3f2dfec569e.Text: Janus suffered harm during the search for the rebels.

33dd0eb0-68cd-4a5f-bb68-8c94eebf3a5f.Text: Janus was irreparably harmed during the search for the rebels.

fa21886b-3ea8-4599-8c4f-2db08b67b602.Text: Janus was severely harmed during the search for the rebels.

2e9a3b78-88e2-4c3a-82af-7bf1922b9214.Text: Vistenza Vyatt remained in charge of Janus.

a273a6b3-b7b1-42bb-8821-e3c7a9780518.Text: Vistenza Vyatt was killed during the events on Janus.

9655352c-e42d-4495-9090-176b99053c5f.Text: You decided to restore the industrial world of Kiava Gamma and restart its production facilities.

1fd6afa2-050f-489a-abb5-c231b875557f.Text: After attempting to pass through the Maw, you turned back and survived.

7c6c9a81-a143-4917-b523-00a8f40319a2.Text: You accepted the mutated voidsmen from the corrupted ship on board your vessel.

a1774c5b-3458-41db-ac66-a946261b8e81.Text: You dealt with Tazarra during the defence of the capital world Dargonus.

f586cc62-ec73-43e5-92b8-4423050b905d.Text: Yrliet saw the unusual skull that had been given to the governor's secretary for shipment to Footfall.

2ac8a413-d905-4c4b-94f6-9b2a132c1eb6.Text: You broke your promise to Yrliet to seek out and help her Asuryani kin.

261c172c-a730-48d5-ad28-2ab4d313dd30.Text: You kept your promise to Yrliet by seeking out her Asuryani kin and attempting to save them.

c7e6327a-4b0f-49ee-bf8e-85478ed73133.Text: You dealt with Malice, the xenos leader of the Shriekers gang in the Chasm.

2982fef2-afdb-404b-bfb9-828332f27d4b.Text: You inspired the Commissar and his people to die honourably — fighting xenos and shouting His name.

c3db8980-d6d6-48bb-9769-9fe42ffc9852.Text: You left Sister Argenta to seek her own death in the streets of Commorragh after she confessed to killing Theodora von Valancius.

7be57948-154c-464e-a095-38c08c8e2ee6.Text: You forgave Sister Argenta after she confessed to killing Theodora von Valancius.

a8343a91-bca9-45ba-b1e4-1f5c3f310537.Text: The pernicious stone that Felek Orsellio used to inhibit Cassia's powers was shattered when she was released from the Haemonculus's torture sphere.

51d0e14f-1ed2-43fe-b74d-186225f362ad.Text: Cassia Orsellio decided against ridding herself of the pernicious stone that was inhibiting her powers.

42d995d6-4022-4371-8996-f95e29d9afa8.Text: You dealt with the false Commissar Iako Sotniy, who sent many a desperate victim into a trap to entertain his xenos masters.

3347e1ec-4491-4b79-8136-726c312bd18c.Text: With the might of your faith, you spurred the false Commissar Iako Sotniy to do what one would have thought impossible: escape the Dark City, repent, and rekindle his faith in the God-Emperor.

93c3c6f7-3761-43c3-b08d-22f8f3a9cb9c.Text: You sabotaged the Haemonculus's creation, which he had dubbed the Anguish Prospector, with corrupted flesh.

f94be380-a79f-4c2a-bd4b-0f4527d0f615.Text: By sundering reality and causing a dysjunction, you let the warp daemons invade Commorragh.

abb12edc-1df7-48b5-84cf-ed1297b3cb60.Text: The Farseer Eklendyl Ma'ersh perished in the Spire of the Reaving Tempest.

85653beb-049c-44f9-9988-8e30b146e7a3.Text: You saved the Farseer Eklendyl from his imprisonment in the Spire of the Reaving Tempest and let him accompany you through the Webway Gate.

bb41299d-8607-44f6-8a4d-726f607e75a2.Text: You destroyed every fighter in the Chasm who could stand a chance against the horrors of the Dark City.

4f9a71d2-13f1-4732-ba76-d9ce34fb32d2.Text: You decided not to kill Tervantias the Archmachinator in Commorragh.

011e3d4a-41c4-430b-9aeb-ba8e4894d675.Text: You have killed Tervantias the Archmachinator once before in the Dark City of the Drukhari.

47746794-045f-4b1e-a37e-0d5a00c9514f.Text: You let Idira Tlass execute Sister Argenta after she confessed to killing Theodora von Valancius.

ce8349fb-5881-4e4b-99d4-f19691fa65fb.Text: You convinced Jae not to resort to the Haemonculus's services and promised that you would cure her illness once you were back in the Koronus Expanse.

727c5115-6584-4b24-84b9-e3d04a29e1bf.Text: You helped Jae Heydari get her respiratory augment back after the Haemonculus's atrocious experiment on her flesh.

ca7c8b9f-d898-4ae4-bb1e-18a4347eedca.Text: You persuaded Marazhai Aezyrraesh to fight on your side against the gladiators of the blood arena in the Chasm.

10e6be2b-759f-4212-af6b-5223972f81c3.Text: You convinced Pasqal to purge himself of the xenoheresy that had been implanted into his body.

90935d2d-12e8-41a4-b6a7-d327361d54de.Text: You helped Tervantias the Archmachinator build his newest abomination, the Anguish Prospector.

9a4fc277-7786-4ed4-8e8d-80f3a6226a58.Text: At the Archons' court, you chose Marazhai's fate by sending him to fight in the arena.

a2d0149f-b86a-4c78-ab37-a4722e000759.Text: You ruined the trial and humiliated Marazhai in front of the Council of Archons.

2514ca2b-a9dc-4d58-b457-c08e5caff487.Text: You could not put up a strong resistance against Marazhai at the fake trial.

37de80d3-15bc-4190-a031-be791084b673.Text: Is that... true? Did you do that?

902d7e8b-5cf9-4784-9d6e-055d239868c3.Text: It is true. You did it.

9606704c-f95a-44c5-8bbc-42a0d10d904c.Text: You. Served. The. Drukhari. You did their bidding. They helped you survive. Without your Drukhari masters, you would be dead.

760ca8c8-e4f1-4887-b494-e4fec73c0630.Text: Theodora von Valancius... is alive. You were her loyal servant. And she made you serve the xenos.

9488891b-e18a-4ca3-943a-f53b291290d8.Text: You. Served. The. Xenos. You rejected His light. You revelled in your heretical desires and craved base profit.

a43666b1-32b3-4a8c-a463-08e2fc818db4.Text: It is true. The xenos Yrliet was one of your retinue.

372f9ba0-0561-461d-b818-ffdc4b0ff7fa.Text: Ulfar remained in the clutches of the Dark City of the Drukhari.

8ee27aae-46d2-4759-9632-2ef8dabd800e.Text: You saved Sergeant Vigastes from agonising captivity in the hands of the Drukhari.

9c73aa53-8d83-4f05-8ca8-612136a2d7e6.Text: You took the soul of the Aeldari Farseer that was imprisoned inside a game board by the Haemonculus's twisted mind.

60bdfa9d-328c-4401-81d0-f140f2531f44.Text: During your last encounter with Nocturne of Oblivion, you made it clear that you do not seek an ally in him.

e9741219-d455-417b-bd7d-2f309d7dd111.Text: It is difficult to say with certainty, however, you are of the opinion that Nocturne of Oblivion's disposition toward you is better than that of his kin.

9b00d794-ee0b-42a1-b483-65545dcfdd8f.Text: You have established a unique relationship with the xenos known as the Aeldari.

4704dd2d-e2c8-4419-97a2-d141915b4115.Text: You reinforced Incendia Chorda's conviction of the righteousness of her methods and fervent service to the God-Emperor.

116888ba-4e2a-4d8e-ac65-4a881f90bd16.Text: Incendia Chorda repented and left Footfall to go into the exile you had sentenced her to.

1693a931-3fcf-44cb-b508-71f17a308791.Text: You bear the word of the true gods. Millions of stars listen, and billions more will too. You were chosen to reign over this side of the stars. You are permitted to see more than the rest can. You are a champion of Chaos.

e5b17fad-943b-49b5-97be-137c9c52a4e5.Text: With a holy litany and His divine aid, you disrupted Uralon the Cruel's vile ritual and weakened him.

1e300307-b03e-41ba-bb15-2509e7af2d17.Text: After the death of Rogue Trader Winterscale on Quetza Temer, you made an agreement with House Winterscale, and so the dynasty's heir came to repay his debt to you.

7ea60d2e-214c-4e12-9997-4460679bc019.Text: High Factotum Janris Danrok was killed as an example to the rest of the officers during Marazhai's visit to the bridge.

0bcbac75-be5c-4681-a591-a3e6ed2e9116.Text: You convinced Hieronymus Doloroso to join your side and oppose Incendia Chorda on Footfall.

61b5fda7-9b7a-40bb-9ef3-a01653100f82.Text: Hieronymus Doloroso perished during the trial that you and Incendia Chorda held on Footfall together.

0d4e5ed5-cc44-429e-8a1b-37d97a249401.Text: You did not convince Hieronymus Doloroso to join your side and oppose Incendia Chorda on Footfall.

da6affaf-06c5-48df-9c23-3832b471c27d.Text: You helped Vladaym Tocara regain his status as Liege of Footfall.

49f96c8c-b1cb-4aa9-85ab-d709a10857e0.Text: You dissuaded Calligos Winterscale from battling the Aeldari in the forests of Quetza Temer.

e93a75e7-4c64-42da-846f-a47a508bdf22.Text: Yrliet disappeared into the forests of Quetza Temer when she saw a threat to her Asuryani kin in your words and actions.

ccbcdca4-a668-4e14-9851-62e0d1a6ec83.Text: You made the pirate Ryzza see the corruption in her own soul, prompting her to repent and atone for her crimes.

cafa4323-c8b4-411e-b1de-9de2b3258672.Text: Despite the harsh law that Incendia Chorda brought to Footfall, the pirate Ryzza was able to survive thanks to you.

b9e4fd25-d62c-4a01-8cc0-84b3daf7436f.Text: Ryzza, a known pirate, outlaw, and peddler of unholy artefacts, was executed during the trial that you and Incendia Chorda held together.

b4e8e0c8-c527-4342-aa7e-1497d6c2b20c.Text: You killed Calligos Winterscale on Quetza Temer.

afd3ca31-b64a-4bcd-9983-9852ec9a0d49.Text: You helped Calligos Winterscale see the corruption in his soul, and his broken spine became his first step toward redemption.

3993bd00-a8e2-4250-878b-140ae275b82b.Text: You earned Lord Inquisitor Calcazar's trust. There are few boons more precious to be found in the entire Koronus Expanse.

b2a77d01-7b1a-4e50-a0d4-9abbe8dab9f5.Text: You deciphered the language of the ancient xenos race.

41b1b061-354f-4c16-9f02-587618c763b4.Text: You did not decipher the language of the ancient xenos race.

570d9693-7ac5-42ca-b9f9-cca2afd2a2f8.Text: Before becoming a Rogue Trader, you were a Marshal of the Adeptus Arbites in the Calixis Sector.

8c30f45e-aa79-438a-8cde-c45228a5f5d8.Text: Before becoming a Rogue Trader, you were a Commissar of the Officio Prefectus.

c788bd08-5fee-465e-b6ba-535fa086667f.Text: Before becoming a Rogue Trader, you were a Calixian crime lord.

0c7bb932-956a-48c4-b405-ac2770a11265.Text: You suffered shame and humiliation sometime in your distant past.

8ac9dfa4-458a-4af4-af29-ba44e5e07e21.Text: You survived a brush with a warp phenomenon sometime in your distant past.

fafeb891-9cc5-4396-a9a6-16d0cf76c6de.Text: You lived through torture sometime in your distant past.

5d9ade4a-0c13-4a23-82c9-c6e7e81dc321.Text: Before becoming a Rogue Trader, you were a lieutenant general of the Astra Militarum.

d0def5e9-c1ec-48d7-bff8-e75e32db282b.Text: Before becoming a Rogue Trader, you were an archdeacon of the Adeptus Ministorum.

c66c9ca2-956f-4751-8163-f11ff40d34f5.Text: Your illustrious glory made you famous far beyond the bounds of your home system.

64bf557a-37a4-4d6b-9fa7-a8ca6b3a3508.Text: Word of your great past deeds has travelled the entire Koronus Expanse and far beyond.

06815bb9-b558-4e7b-96bd-bb1f07b4bd37.Text: Your outstanding intellect is known beyond the bounds of your home system.

b4b2d90b-0155-47c0-88c3-8578f7edf5a4.Text: Before becoming a Rogue Trader, you were a Lord Captain of the Imperial Navy.

35a14153-44a6-4c7e-badd-cb1474f30b34.Text: Noble blood runs in your veins.

a1fbdca2-5d1f-4f6b-9710-6a8545635f98.Text: You permitted the workers of Depot 4 to carry weapons and maintain order in the bay without the help of enforcers.

ebfeae17-4b39-4f78-b2e3-6cc55efc613c.Text: You told Abelard that with your coming to power, the established procedures within the dynasty would change.

8937a4b0-52ae-4dc9-b13c-64414fc8f0a2.Text: You agreed with Abelard that there was no need to change the established procedures within the dynasty.

7efc72ff-112d-4517-9977-93e5d22c03f2.Text: You accused and executed those responsible for sabotaging Dargonus.

919c7c71-cfb4-4e24-bcfe-874d7fd5371e.Text: You executed Regina Sauerback on charges of treason.

daf4e0c1-dc97-441a-9d80-f70e028c688f.Text: You supported Sister Argenta's intention to tame her impetuous rage.

025274b2-7705-490b-9e35-5076eb89accf.Text: You supported Sister Argenta in her righteous fury.

b8b9de50-4459-4e2f-b2a5-a4b66c2b9800.Text: You urged Sister Argenta to repent of her hubris.

47a9a4d4-0ce9-4e1c-837c-48ec0e908a4b.Text: Your influence has made Heinrix more merciful.

a1d6103d-c691-4597-9036-2d35f5339c8a.Text: Your influence has made Heinrix more callous.

b18f2304-f20f-4b3b-9ff9-60f746a57db8.Text: You steered Idira toward yielding to the voices.

50837ea6-b054-492a-8a21-11261af2bc0f.Text: You discouraged Idira from putting on the xenodevice that would have suppressed the voices from the warp.

0ebe13f3-b01f-4aed-a011-317310368646.Text: You encouraged Idira to put on the xenodevice to suppress the voices.

21e51bd3-ea8e-4eca-9400-f900c6189c5f.Text: You let Idira live on as a useful albeit dangerous tool.

6609092f-eb9c-442d-b6fe-a9a27b904bf0.Text: You let Idira live and promised to help her.

61bec2fa-e732-4665-96fc-ca833f133817.Text: You did not earn Idira's trust.

6bd56159-b853-415a-937b-3a08e8d6cd8f.Text: You helped Marazhai assume his place at the head of the Kabal of the Reaving Tempest.

4802d198-39e6-40f1-8d04-b55b7a4e6051.Text: You allocated a compartment for Marazhai to satisfy his violent needs.

1c521e63-9eca-4f3c-ae9b-6a3694e3a1cc.Text: You helped Marazhai deal with his enemies from Commorragh who were after him.

a7e61160-07d7-42d3-ba6f-995cd67f84fc.Text: You permitted Marazhai to move around the decks freely and claim any victim he desired.

314b5db1-4224-42d3-af1a-9dbe501a8c53.Text: You decided to keep Marazhai isolated in an empty compartment during warp jumps.

1bf7a390-acca-4590-818a-52484789e8a8.Text: You helped revive the Amarnat Collective.

bc9f489f-da0b-4863-af35-bd6cf0b46fd1.Text: You helped Pasqal accept Amarnat's power while rejecting the Collective's limitations.

1ae4d8ec-7b67-4635-83f3-91222a3a6227.Text: You helped Pasqal eradicate the schism of Discontinuing the Cycle.

ab7e0957-c25e-4e97-a968-3ac18bada65f.Text: You helped Ulfar embrace the path of the Lone Wolf.

61398009-4047-4606-b520-f9ac2824073e.Text: You helped Ulfar overcome his grief at the loss of his brothers.

3588bed6-ec16-4b48-bd89-e1bf2cbdcf2c.Text: You helped Ulfar embrace the path of the Wulfen.

596d4b16-1a33-46b0-ba16-6f54ee1caf62.Text: Corruption has rooted itself deep in your soul. You serve the Ruinous Powers, and the Ruinous Powers serve you.

6c41fd8d-6b93-4946-b85f-a5844b2eb2da.Text: You have become a paragon of true virtue in the eyes of the Cult of Saint Drusus, earning the trust and respect of its congregation.

7ee69346-d6de-447f-91f8-66e1c9707cad.Text: The Cult of Saint Drusus highly value their spiritual relations with you.

712d34ef-6d36-44a3-bf8e-57c525ff8e95.Text: You have seldom cooperated with the Drusians.

9fd8816d-61a5-4adf-aa71-6545feb0e8c6.Text: You have proven yourself a dependable ally, earning the trust and respect of the Imperial Navy in the Koronus Expanse.

8b9d77e0-4242-4549-bb79-57ba86a69575.Text: The Imperial Navy highly values its association with you.

216165ea-b2ac-4f83-a96d-998e50fb0871.Text: You have seldom cooperated with the Imperial Navy.

b40afd02-e0ff-4c0f-aeac-fcff2a40c36b.Text: You did not save Jae Heydari's associates.

848f887e-4c09-4782-a5e6-c7bd1ac5bd5e.Text: You set off the alarm in the sewers, causing Falco to execute Jae Heydari's gang.

529a4440-f821-47fe-a51e-d1e4cafa14a7.Text: You convinced Jae Heydari that it was her duty to the Imperium to protect the Mercatum Tabula Officiale, even at the cost of her associates' lives.

082b5bb5-0ff8-4256-b887-08bc8670e5f0.Text: After receiving no support from you, Jae Heydari died trying to save her gang on her own.

0075d7e0-b66f-4f29-b2cc-b821965cfd53.Text: You uncovered the truth about Jae Heydari's past.

d1701e2c-4aae-43ef-ba28-9551dfa68622.Text: You have become the Kasballica Mission's key business partner, earning the trust and respect of the Cold Traders of the Koronus Expanse.

c59d9bc9-5329-4b34-bfd0-2d21a2ec3bdc.Text: The Kasballica Mission highly values its partnership with you.

24afe01d-e21d-48fd-b545-a900cde50cee.Text: You have seldom cooperated with the Kasballica Mission.

958247fc-bc7b-418a-8dd5-f0eead07c84d.Text: You have become the best friend of the Fellowship of the Void, earning the trust and respect of the pirates of the Koronus Expanse.

7225c6af-c36a-41fc-be9d-406a3dfcf0d4.Text: The Fellowship of the Void highly values its mutually beneficial relationship with you.

7448e576-2b72-49af-924b-f06eafe2a298.Text: You have seldom cooperated with the Fellowship of the Void.

f9eea1cb-177d-4de8-8f0f-8ccade2d8741.Text: You were wounded by the corrupted weapon, which led to a warp entity invading your mind.

02cd6623-a5bc-4300-a82a-4ac66ccda1e8.Text: A promise of help was extended to you by the nightmarish daemonic entity that spoke to you on the bridge during the ship's translation from the warp.

a8ed26fa-071c-4aa9-b530-3444a80d4153.Text: You led your people out of the fiery trap on the officers' deck and arrived too late to rendezvous with Edelthrad.

27c8fde8-3234-4a97-ab28-53aac6d7f289.Text: You steeled your soul with your faith in the God-Emperor and walked through the flames on the officers' deck just in time to rendezvous with Edelthrad.

4320f926-aa64-4a12-a39f-10ab8095838f.Text: You struck a deal with the warp spawn when it offered to lead you out of the trap on the officers' deck.

aea3ce2a-31c3-45b2-a091-441b3422753a.Text: You did not go with Yrliet to search for the Farseers in the Spire of the Reaving Tempest.

0b421c91-b4c5-482b-ab91-3504df987889.Text: You ordered that the Astropaths be provided with good food and balms.

d0ae0e70-e8cb-4046-bd87-1054e7cfe84a.Text: You rescued one of the three Kibellahs from the Haemonculus's laboratory after she had undergone his profane experiments.

bbcf3b15-9ac5-4251-9274-3ade79c95654.Text: Cassia finds that you have treated her without due respect.

604b193c-e0d3-49cb-af5d-50a1e767fea5.Text: Your influence has made Kibellah strive for greatness.

16ff3f31-43df-439f-bfd5-e5db40939fc7.Text: Your influence has made Kibellah adhere to the Tenets of the Bloodspun Web with greater vehemence.

4dd01e9b-47c6-41ec-9b12-93f4fdd5f108.Text: Your influence has made Kibellah more compassionate.

d4d0e608-6f3f-49cf-9bb0-80b6f4fa5bf2.Text: During the synchronised trance, you failed to cure Kibellah of her doubts.

7b6988aa-4c21-4abb-813e-96757a09069c.Text: You did not earn Yrliet's trust.

db6dd368-7b7b-4b50-b1aa-dc4b6d55faa3.Text: You saved the Infernus Master's family from the enforcers' arbitrary persecution.

ced7fc72-9d31-4ac8-b940-eec03827b643.Text: You gave Hrotko, captain of the ship's enforcers who attempted to mislead the investigation, a second chance by having him serve penance as an initiate at the shrine.

c595d600-90bb-4e62-946b-983f0600969e.Text: Medicae Officer Marius abandoned his idea of becoming a missionary.

974e6491-7f63-46ca-ac04-00ae212c0e8a.Text: You permitted Medicae Officer Marius to become a missionary.

6eafefb9-49ed-43e8-b193-887e39933cee.Text: You decided to bind your fate to another member of your retinue.

48ee4a00-8aeb-4776-a6c7-3382b9ad5c3e.Text: You suppressed the unrest on the lower decks by shutting down the life support systems.

a36a7549-280f-4be9-9344-6351ee26e491.Text: You calmed the unrest on the lower decks by providing the people with medicine and supplies.

51543055-fef3-4ba5-8fe6-ac0c798175a8.Text: You spread discord and treachery among the rabble to suppress the unrest on the lower decks.

70ba178f-846a-488f-b272-92b93f24ec9c.Text: You told the Master-at-Arms about the ablutions you shared with the two enforcers.

f8699e5a-f110-4dcc-9b33-3da50664a95d.Text: You have already met the prefect as the Master of Seals.

f8a733b4-5ae0-4096-a31f-9b194538dd7c.Text: You demanded a part of the tithe as payment.

e9aedbcf-6230-4cc5-9bd6-0a84327c5e52.Text: You ordered precision strikes on the Heartless in order to facilitate the storming of the ship.

d9900edd-0524-460d-8c6a-e6cfe0687ada.Text: The frigate used to belong to the tithe thief. You boarded the ship and captured it.

c1644bf7-cebc-4953-ae3b-3e20cb4fdf58.Text: You helped the Arbitrator squad escape Rykad Minoris.

fe85ae1b-a425-4f5a-a3f6-db1add9cb5a7.Text: You took Maive aboard your ship.

266ade8d-6f7d-4a6a-9804-e270df896708.Text: After your victory over the daemon, you channelled a part of its power into your raven.

14895b8a-a9e3-476d-8a3f-12c779f799d7.Text: The governor of Thassera was killed.

c81dba0e-eef7-4f5c-8dba-9717ba3a4e08.Text: You refused to accept the key to Thassera from the court fool's hands and struck him.

54a7dbe0-c1c4-4caa-be61-0f9fa57076c4.Text: You refused to accept the key to Thassera from the court fool's hands.

686e32ce-5cb4-4dca-b446-6e45ab789272.Text: You accepted the key to Thassera from the court fool's hands.

fa9ca4f6-a6a0-4957-91c3-87897cf4d1cb.Text: You made Maive the new governor of Thassera.

d8a5560d-0c22-4d81-a686-fc3686f756e0.Text: You heard the story about Murgeth from the court fool.

d6abe5d6-c258-4e59-a15a-b3aa6d5cbd73.Text: You forced the executioner and the fortress commander to beg forgiveness for the disturbance at the trial.

34f2811e-11d6-4ee2-b222-89f50493b141.Text: You ordered that both the executioner and the fortress commander be burnt.

605be129-dc67-4471-8618-f686b27385c4.Text: You ordered the execution of the one responsible for the disturbance at the trial.

da284fa9-5bc3-4c42-a17f-0ec50a7e7ebe.Text: You spared both the executioner and the fortress commander.

d175048f-7f2b-45a1-b79f-3b4d3a077758.Text: You branded a real noble as an impostor.

6ba30ccc-4c6f-45d6-a99e-d7322d39a52b.Text: You wounded the court fool at the trial.

80382ad6-6d32-4bef-aa21-792fa90fb935.Text: You decided to destroy the thassertium along with the entire planet.

4bfb3368-b4a5-4ec7-93a0-dfeecb81b2fb.Text: You decided to maximise the supply of thassertium.

866cee53-e57a-4bb0-b818-1325a1ffc46b.Text: You decided to study the thassertium.

b6b30010-5dae-427e-a0ba-1949d937902c.Text: You decided to destroy the thassertium.

733e7dfb-defd-499b-83a8-613ea1d9e9d3.Text: You took the necklace from Maive.

0c7205d5-f90a-40f5-88b4-0dd54937744b.Text: You rescued the Arbitrators from Leethus.

8d725bd5-9a2a-4659-9cef-683e84aa2a30.Text: You were unable to protect all of the tithe barges.

7db9f33d-68bf-43a9-8e7e-362c99e3453f.Text: Solomorne authorised your decision to lay claim to the tithe.

f5a472df-9202-4916-907c-ebf05402846d.Text: Solomorne refused to authorise your decision to lay claim to the tithe.

41a73d93-772e-48bd-a681-90f1ee6c7eee.Text: You put the von Valancius dynasty above the law.

07f86835-c4fc-4e06-bebe-8a1a96428208.Text: An ancient and highly advanced alien race that once dominated the galaxy.

08c1a97a-4d75-4758-bada-d2dbd70e7902.Text: Aeons ago, the Aeldari divided into different factions and split away into distant parts of the galaxy. Even though they are small in number, the Aeldari remain a significant force due to their advanced technology, devious minds, and innate psychic abilities.

74166c89-5c5d-44ce-8a47-91a5f1887900.Text: An incredibly rare and powerful piece of technology from Humanity's ancient past.

14a67102-6e34-49f2-9498-40d0bdb19207.Text: Archeotech is often recovered in the frontier regions of the galaxy. While the Adeptus Mechanicus is particularly interested in the recovery of such ancient technology and considers all such devices sacred artefacts, some archeotech can also be considered forbidden and even heretical.

04ea3ebf-c8ab-4f4b-91ee-a9c0204900f1.Text: The psychic beacon that helps Navigators to triangulate a course for their voidships through the warp.

4b94a595-d6c9-4443-b3c1-77b0b913f02d.Text: The Emperor Himself projects the Astronomican from the Golden Throne on Holy Terra, the homeworld of Humanity. Over a thousand psykers are sacrificed every standard day to sustain the Emperor's psychic presence in the warp.

9eef641c-5417-446c-8dca-0cca290b7596.Text: The Emperor Himself projects the Astronomican from the Golden Throne on Holy Terra, the homeworld of Humanity. Over a thousand psykers are sacrificed every standard day to sustain the Emperor's psychic presence in the warp.

5323d2a5-1046-42de-b804-fa508bf6a6e7.Text: A branch of the Aeldari race that inhabits planetoid-sized vessels known as craftworlds.

9c527d32-438b-46f4-b90f-3c4ee90ad760.Text: The Children of Asuryan are defined as a culture by their pursuit of the Asuryani Path. This philosophy teaches them how to balance their potent minds and strive for constructive goals rather than falling into the amoral pursuit of pleasure and selfishness.

ebfb95dc-c88f-43b1-8a9e-32e8cff2f6c4.Text: A malign metaphysical force composed of psychic energy that exists in an alternate dimension known as the warp.

03eb86db-44aa-4ded-937b-b0498ebea67e.Text: A huge warp storm stretching across the galaxy, the result of a catastrophic rift in realspace.

3d165fb7-5bf8-408c-9743-4240b4ef8a0a.Text: The impact of the Great Rift can be felt throughout the entire cosmos, manifesting in anomalies of space and time, as well as in the intensification of other warp storms, which in turn can lead to the disappearance of previously known routes through the Immaterium.

4a05a333-8d20-4038-a58e-b5de11454e0a.Text: A vast, planetoid-sized spacecraft populated by Aeldari of the Asuryani faction.

eaee55da-e0ba-4ad5-b854-e3a011e02678.Text: Aeldari craftworlds have the resources and power to conquer entire planets and star systems. These mammoth constructs avoid warp travel, relying instead on pathways through the mysterious realm of the Webway.

e143bb01-8e76-4c3b-ae87-57528973e980.Text: A sadistic branch of the Aeldari race that revels in piracy, violence, and torture, which allows them to feed upon the psychic residue of their victims' suffering.

1b9314ef-bd03-4118-915b-3fb8f9b31653.Text: They are the living embodiment of all that is wanton and cruel in the Aeldari species. Highly intelligent and devious to the point of obsession, Drukhari are forsaken and corrupt xenos that eternally thirst for the psychic energy of the anguish and torment of other thinking beings in order to save their own souls.

eab47cd5-e4bc-4dd2-857d-576fbcfdc24f.Text: An individual of any intelligent species who possesses some degree of psychic ability or powers.

c4dbcced-fb70-47d9-a732-deb2757e3d36.Text: An alternate dimension of pure energy and madness existing as a mirror to realspace, also known as the Immaterium, the Empyrean, the Aether, the Sea of Souls, or Warpspace.

d289a660-d2f7-4ab5-baaf-dd099db7bacf.Text: An extra-dimensional space, also known as the labyrinth dimension, which links worlds, sectors, and stars from one end of the galaxy to another.

7f262bd6-af83-4cef-a8d5-f687d22ab9ba.Text: The Aeldari prefer this sophisticated and mysterious method of travel across the stars, using special gates to access the network. Yet nowadays the Webway has become a dark labyrinth of tunnels and portals where a wrong turn or pathway can lead a traveller to their doom.

6a66003a-ac4a-4763-aeff-7bd2e0e92bdc.Text: A term used within the Imperium to refer to aliens.

0e44d4a6-3470-4448-869d-e150206e9839.Text: At this archetype rank, characters gain active abilities for use in combat.

bb8d0660-22a7-43d5-ae60-bf5cbc55c818.Text: Advanced {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}abilities{/g} are stronger and more effective than common {g|Encyclopedia:FlagshipSpace}flagship{/g} abilities.

a4fc8bab-33d2-445f-9172-5ef96529b941.Text: A potent alcoholic drink of varying quality, widely available across the Imperium.

93da025d-701d-4c97-a0f8-0b0d84822127.Text: The two-headed eagle sigil that signifies the Imperium.

e56f9666-7b8c-4701-bebe-85d8d7a7c9f4.Text: A recognised master of a technological or scientific discipline within the Cult Mechanicus.

3d15b6d0-f4e7-4b21-82b9-61370b8eb27b.Text: At this archetype rank, characters gain a unique talent for that archetype.

89c7e9ff-7e9a-4810-a932-44937de20490.Text: At this archetype rank, it is possible to increase the base {g|Encyclopedia:Characteristic}characteristics{/g} of the character, which define a character's skill scores, number of {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit chance{/g}, and many other aspects.

23e54aa4-31c2-441c-9a09-a77085af75da.Text: Sensor technology that allows voidships to scan planets, spot enemies, and obtain various other kinds of crucial data at great distances.

a460d510-af68-4ada-b59a-e4d16600e50a.Text: A device used to detect movement, heat, emissions, and numerous other factors necessary to identify dangers at short {g|Encyclopedia:Range}range{/g}.

183221b5-8c1f-4b78-a7a2-b5732d197057.Text: A Space Marine who has renounced the Emperor and become a devoted servant of the forces of Chaos.

baff9c27-21d5-4e96-8473-ca2a59b61f8e.Text: The illegal trade of commodities and artefacts of xenos origin.

50f31061-995f-4d94-906d-2ec2a21f5635.Text: An earpiece device used for communication over short distances.

783118bf-d164-462a-92ed-956c9bf57ad7.Text: At this archetype rank, characters can select general talents able to be mastered by any archetype.

13a0fc99-ac2c-46ca-8a64-42d6f55622c6.Text: The religion of the Adeptus Mechanicus, which includes the worship of the Omnissiah, the Machine God.

525874dc-7f6d-49ab-a23f-31026a9ab1bf.Text: A data repository sanctified by the Adeptus Mechanicus to be used in conjunction with a cogitator.

c7cfc355-adc5-41e2-9bac-5d2e453665b3.Text: A cybernetically enhanced bird capable of expanding its master's scouting abilities on the battlefield. Built-in Adeptus Mechanicus technologies allow the owner to control the cyber-eagle through simple commands, spreading fear across the front. The most common variant is a two-headed creature resembling a living Aquila.

0d5e0f0f-8bbc-4082-b45a-845ee741354c.Text:
A robotised construct controlled by the brain and nervous system of the creature serving as its base — a dog. Cyber-mastiffs are used by Adeptus Arbites patrol squads to track down and capture criminals.
Built using the technologies of the Adeptus Mechanicus, a cyber-mastiff is designed to kill, and has a hard time processing any commands unrelated to that function.

e4c2da04-d23b-419b-a6ea-9121c2fd3df6.Text:
An augmented bird familiar bound to its master by means of a strong mental connection. This bond allows the raven to enhance its owner's psyker abilities and even lets them see through their familiar's eyes.
Such creatures are most often seen in the retinue of Inquisitorial psykers. The technology behind their manufacture is considered sacred.

0b710ba7-5105-429e-a877-1d0b1717b63e.Text: A Chaos Space Marine from the Word Bearers Legion. A sorcerer sworn to serve the Dark Gods.

96410759-3027-4d0c-a651-7b53439e2237.Text: An electronic digital storage device similar to a tablet computer.

090ccb4d-df5f-4f67-8909-0ec0c15c7b40.Text: An incredibly rare translation device that allows the user to understand and speak most dialects of Low Gothic and some xenos languages.

17adcc18-4f1f-40bf-81a0-bdac4a8ad63b.Text: A Tech-Priest whose specialisation is the maintenance and repair of sacred machines.

7dd17fc5-8dc6-4799-aaf1-8609030f67e2.Text: The high-ranking Tech-Priest who may act as an overseer of an entire planet.

ba42fb15-dbdd-4f79-8249-a3fdea8468b2.Text: At this archetype rank, additional active abilities of the first-tier archetype are available.

b9c379b9-5af8-481c-803c-4b485f620cca.Text: At this archetype rank, additional talents of the first-tier archetype are available.

c024132e-884c-41a7-b37b-64a499616731.Text: At this archetype rank, additional active abilities of the first or second-tier archetype are available.

cb53e0c3-35d9-488b-9377-e7f4139b3bec.Text: At this archetype rank, additional talents of the first or second-tier archetype are available.

49fd496b-1d89-443d-bf7c-e61513c7fa9f.Text: A protective field used by the voidships of the Imperium to navigate safely through the warp.

3e8ecf03-4e86-4502-9a85-95daeab2c0b5.Text: A large, semi-domesticated reptile. Grox are most commonly bred as livestock or used as beasts of burden.

cb3c3591-94b9-455d-a3e9-21ebf806946c.Text: Forbidden heretical technology spawned by the warp and Chaos.

999b4b33-d08e-481a-a5b1-e558376a3e00.Text: A Tech-Priest who has renounced the dogmas of the Cult Mechanicus in favour of delving into forbidden, Chaos-tainted technologies.

25803338-c4f5-4949-83f5-6d81e41ca6c2.Text: The crystalline psychoactive matrix that supplies a well of {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} to an Aeldari craftworld and provides a massive ancestral mind to advise and guide the Aeldari who dwell within it.

b75c759f-e30c-4115-8b0f-92523624c55a.Text: A common form of recreational stimulant that consists of a rolled paper stuffed with a plant-derived substance. When lit, this substance emits smoke that is inhaled through the tube.

4a254064-36d6-4c81-9c67-cb109af3ba67.Text: A collection of dialects used by the Adeptus Mechanicus and its Tech-Priests. Can be used as a spoken language with audio bursts or as a machine code with electrical signals.

5b2b65d0-7972-4d5b-92bb-44230419d44b.Text: A general term for a light source, presumably an electric one.

db277cef-38d1-4f62-8071-62d3319f4595.Text: A spirit believed by the adherents of the Cult Mechanicus to inhabit and control any technology in existence.

d49ca398-38d1-4028-b0b1-9c61bc7caac7.Text: A high-ranking member of the Adeptus Mechanicus and devoted disciple of the Omnissiah.

36c1aa14-8a12-4914-8c07-c51f28149723.Text: A turbulent region of space that divides the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g} from the rest of the Imperium of Man.

1ffd1226-48d5-4f8d-ae4f-d44ca0f08817.Text: A tentacle-like robotic limb prosthetic surgically attached to the spine.

a3f4441c-9780-4a42-80b6-bc7912d794a5.Text: A word used by the Aeldari to refer to any species they deem inferior.

3edfba98-889f-4c01-9c56-4f881ed0b690.Text: A patriarch or matriarch that rules over a Navigator House, the figurative — and often biological — father or mother of the dynasty.

297cfb84-d000-4a03-b056-ffc26627e389.Text: The Craftworld Aeldari philosophy that allows them to control their emotions and passions and direct them toward productive purposes.

5cb9766e-8d7c-4941-93d4-51dc43ee1be1.Text: A photographic image or playback recording taken with a device called a pict-recorder.

fea29230-99ac-428b-b316-ec2aab72bb4a.Text: A synthetic material as light as plastic yet as durable as steel. Plasteel is commonly used in the production of armour.

2d7afd49-fecd-483a-b32e-902f3f59c1d4.Text: A broad term for combustible fuel in the Imperium of Man.

175c0f8a-053f-48d4-8d3a-c8ff38451434.Text: A material or device that focuses and amplifies psychic powers.

1be0e4b7-8041-4e6b-8d4c-ce0af345cf19.Text: A term used to refer to the material universe, as opposed to the warp.

1672f10a-fdb4-4587-bbf8-edad5c329e19.Text: An invigorating hot drink containing caffeine or similar stimulants.

1d8d86ca-8801-45d2-9f47-181c3f4be4ce.Text: A human tabletop game played across the Imperium of Man, similar to the ancient Terran game of chess.

c506833b-c299-41fa-aecb-893eb379c2e1.Text: The Aeldari term for the Chaos God Slaanesh meaning "She Who Thirsts."

29c8f130-2e5c-4e7e-a104-9365e59535ad.Text: At this archetype rank, additional active abilities of the second-tier archetype are available.

57b39f90-6e9e-44fc-89a8-bc015a310300.Text: At this archetype rank, additional talents of the second-tier archetype are available.

7f483dde-a22d-480c-8a83-e598bb54c2e9.Text: Mindless cybernetic drones created from a fusion of human flesh and robotic technology, used to carry out simple, manual tasks.

d50a7cc7-895b-44a1-a772-3bcd4c138eae.Text: Created from the remains of the Imperium's most faithful servants and the technologies of the Adeptus Mechanicus, these sacred mechanisms together can perform a variety of auxiliary functions. The most advanced servo-skulls are fitted with parameters that assign them to a specific master. The machine spirits of such a swarm are service-bound to that single individual.

ca5d57c9-dae3-4d62-8286-9d9f18441593.Text: At this flagship rank, common post abilities are available.

d2af734c-f21e-47f7-b09a-0b264f5f7461.Text: At this flagship rank, special post abilities, flagship abilities, and flagship developments are available.

a065dfb1-20c4-460a-a568-514e0982ee37.Text: At this flagship rank, special post and flagship abilities are available.

6db0e019-96f2-4ddc-b7e7-7022b0d6070e.Text: Developments provide the {g|Encyclopedia:FlagshipSpace}flagship{/g} with passive {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonuses{/g} and effects.

bcf7074a-9501-40a9-84d0-a358c2670d42.Text: At this archetype rank, it is possible to increase characters' skills. The higher the skill score, the easier it will be to pass corresponding skill tests.

72e5ce42-ac7d-46c6-b054-5c07cd7a6116.Text: Precious psychoreactive crystals worn by living Asuryani as a means of sanctuary against the predations of Slaanesh. They begin as waystones whose purpose is to capture their wearer's soul at the moment of death, thus becoming spirit stones.

41c5ead6-0d97-4813-8477-769ca614718a.Text: At this archetype rank, characters gain talents that grant passive {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonuses{/g} and improvements.

49ba2138-83cc-4f08-9a50-1fd403001ad2.Text: The lowest rank of Tech-Priests responsible for minor and mundane rituals that are nevertheless necessary for the cult to function.

2c66b6e8-badf-4767-b50a-5bf2625ac0f3.Text: The rulers of the Adeptus Mechanicus, they revere technology as the object of their devotion. They direct the endeavors of fabrication and lead the followers of the Machine God in unforgiving crusades of ruthless acquisition.

92cb13a0-0399-4cc8-a47d-e97ffcbe820d.Text: A large factory or manufacturing complex.

59339538-a46d-42bf-acaa-a2632701e48a.Text: Any type of digital computer in the Imperium of Man.

577d6142-6328-44d8-9d32-cb0e80f855da.Text: At this archetype rank, characters can enhance their archetype's {g|Encyclopedia:HeroicAct}heroic act{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:DesperateMeasure}desperate measure{/g} ability.

0f7f3283-7bff-4d86-888d-4d4b09896888.Text: The sacred commandments observed by all followers of the Cult Mechanicus.

98e6f6c2-1f27-468d-985f-00557440c479.Text: A piece of technology used to communicate over short distances or to record sound.

419b68cb-f428-43dc-a9aa-cdb2f3794235.Text: An Aeldari material composed of crystallised psychic energy. Used in the creation of everything from art pieces to craftworlds.

29b4c6ec-8046-4ec0-83bd-03dd29d4d3eb.Text: The devout warriors who serve as the militant arm of the Adeptus Ministorum.

c28d2be7-7031-4afd-b9c7-630bceeef090.Text: Also known as the Sisters of Battle, the warriors of the Adepta Sororitas believe their faith to be a weapon far stronger than any steel. They strike their foes down with the holy trinity of bolter, flamer, and melta, fearlessly striding into battle, chanting hymns of praise and calling upon the Emperor to aid them.

cfe659a7-0ca6-41ba-9074-53d3ffa08b31.Text: The bureaucratic organisation of the Imperium responsible for levying tithes, distributing resources, and performing countless other administrative functions.

eea25729-0082-48b6-a382-6e00a0b66f45.Text: The heart of the gigantic bureaucracy that controls the government of the Imperium of Man. The Administratum is divided into myriad departments, offices, and subordinate organisations that control millions of human worlds throughout the galaxy.

976b0758-e317-441d-8e26-698088238eb0.Text: The Adeptus Arbites is an organisation that defends and upholds the Imperium's sacred code of law, known as the Lex Imperialis.

d3f97d9a-ea0d-4c46-a003-af6f428bb8f1.Text: Never swayed into abandoning their duty, never moved to pity when carrying out a verdict, Arbitrators judge criminals and keep a watchful eye on the timely payments of the Imperial Tithe, which is mandatory for most worlds. Wherever they go, they instil trepidation, and with good reason. Countless are the names of those who made pitiful attempts to trample on the Imperium's sacred order, only for an Adeptus Arbites shotgun to obliterate them from the annals of history.

372b52b9-3037-43dd-9ad8-bfcc13a3e1ad.Text: Commonly known as Space Marines, these genetically engineered super-soldiers are the most powerful and ferocious warriors of the Imperium.

1bb84e5d-9f5c-4707-af1a-4db8ed4e6f3f.Text: Created to be superior to normal humans in every way, they live to fight against any menace to Humanity. Each Chapter of Space Marines has its own homeworld, warrior culture, and strategic specialisms.

68e6ea3a-0f02-4989-9fd1-9ad4a326e751.Text: The special organisation that finds, recruits, and trains the majority of the Imperium's psykers.

245230ed-1b7c-41aa-8919-5176203beeb8.Text: Most die during testing, but those who survive might become sanctioned and serve the Imperium in many ways. Some might become Astropaths, linking worlds together by psychic means, or battle-psykers, living weapons who accompany the Imperial Guard to war.

710ad575-dcf5-47b9-9056-2f37d5e1a2b4.Text: The technological organisation, also known as the Priesthood of Mars, which maintains, constructs, and honours the sacred technologies of Humanity.

0527283b-6052-40fe-b549-fdd7170671e2.Text: The Adeptus Mechanicus devote themselves to the Machine God, the Omnissiah, and the Motive Force: the source of all knowledge, the embodiment of wisdom, and the animus that empowers all. With elaborate rituals, mechanically augmented priests oversee the fabrication, maintenance, and repair of every device crafted by Humanity.

d7e49d18-1da5-4912-a2a0-3138e16a5089.Text: The religious body of the Imperium, also known as the Ecclesiarchy, which venerates and promotes the worship of the Emperor of Mankind.

9969e124-fef9-40f6-bc13-ab8a23f0f4ea.Text: It guides the worship of trillions of people on numberless worlds across the vast divides of the void. The core of the Ecclesiarchy's power is the Cult Imperialis, also known as the Imperial Creed. Any deviance from its strictures and theology is considered heresy and brutally suppressed.

a050d28e-bfa7-4588-8bc3-f625a79d2db6.Text: A planet's Aestimare rating reflects its strategic value to the Imperium and has the form of an alphanumeric code that ranges from A0 to Z1000.

77950ea2-fd51-4db9-a719-46ade461d531.Text: Holy Terra, being of prime importance to the Imperium, is categorised as A0. Mars and a number of other forge worlds are A1, having lower priority than the capital. Like its tithe grade, a planet's Aestimare rating may also change over time.

9697e470-4804-4292-acd1-9c1adf8b8fff.Text: An Imperial world dedicated entirely to the production of agricultural products.

7cf2fc1d-1f85-4cb2-9456-5d7a1be9c8f9.Text: Many agri-worlds have whole continents given over to livestock or fields of crops, others are covered in oceans teeming with fish, and a few are used solely to provide clean water.

b0330232-dec1-46e6-8163-fcf9b688be48.Text: The primary combat force and first line of defence of the Imperium, also known as the Imperial Guard.

5427b417-8817-4df2-a811-7803e0de7736.Text: This military body is tithed continuously from all across the Imperium, recruiting fighting men and women to overwhelm the enemies of Humanity with firepower and their endless numbers.

2689e655-4d71-4682-8e4c-3b498b6d76eb.Text: A powerful sanctioned psyker who can send and receive messages through space using their telepathic abilities.

6674e55c-0d77-480a-95a3-3d9fa6572576.Text: Those chosen to become Astropaths undergo the ritual of Soul Binding that purifies their body and soul. The ceremony leaves Astropaths blind, yet they become bound to the Emperor and are trained to send their thoughts across the galaxy via the medium of the warp.

f0a241ee-31ab-4aeb-ac4f-341e1414c495.Text: A mechanical or electronic cybernetic substitute for biological limbs or organs.

55daac3a-57d0-4e2a-977c-e64eab7b40bc.Text: Replacements for damaged or diseased parts of the body, which improve on the abilities and powers of the human body and even extend life. All members of the Adeptus Mechanicus replace their impure flesh with sacred technology, but for most others a bionic replacement is more often a necessity due to injury or occupation.

809a41bc-3b26-40b2-b07f-0def75f3aa46.Text: The dreadful Imperial voidships that transport psykers given up by numerous worlds as part of their tithe to the Imperium.

dc777e8a-5ddc-4de9-afea-d0f9f15f2b38.Text: The Black Ships themselves are dark places of despair, for they are little more than high-security prisons, and many of the psykers being transported know full well that they will meet a grim fate at their journey's end.

c7e5a029-cf5b-4ceb-95dd-9d921ff30c0c.Text: The Gods of Chaos are monstrous beings weaved from mortal obsessions and fears. These ancient entities of unimaginable power and infinite malice endlessly seek to burst into realspace and lay ruin to it and its inhabitants.

2c421134-818f-4b10-a3c6-cd2c99728a3c.Text: The guide, the ruler, and the higher power to which Humanity offers their prayers for aid and deliverance. Most would be driven mad with despair if they knew the truth.
