If a trap is marked with a red area without a dotted line, simply approach it and press {console_bind|Confirm} to attempt the disarm test.
Different skills are used to disarm different types of traps.

21933bda-9ca0-4ad6-8de9-32cbef690557.Text:
Once the combat is over, the wounds of all party members are replenished automatically, but any {g|Encyclopedia:Injury}injuries{/g} they may have sustained remain — those can be healed with a medikit.
Medikits can only be used by characters who have the {g|f:9aefa8d7db3349358e23b2106578353b}Field Medic{/g} feature, {g|f:37363b46061e46218f40e01ed81e9189}Base Skill: Medicae{/g}, or have taken {g|Encyclopedia:SkillMedicae}Medicae{/g} skill advancement at least once. Whenever a character uses a medikit in battle, a Medicae {g|Encyclopedia:Skills}skill{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Test}test{/g} determines the number of {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} that will be restored as a result.
Abelard can heal your character's injury. Hold {console_bind|LeftBottom} and select Abelard's portrait. Press {console_bind|DPadVertical} to select the medikit on the panel at the bottom left of the screen, then use it on your character by pressing {console_bind|Confirm}. Abelard needs to be standing right next to your character for him to administer the treatment.

a5eac118-f15f-4356-9b05-a38e43d88dc9.Text: Combat begins with the tactical phase, during which characters {g|Encyclopedia:CantAttackEffect}cannot attack{/g} or take other actions but may try to take up advantageous positions. Select a character by holding {console_bind|LeftBottom}, moving the frame to their portrait, and then releasing {console_bind|LeftBottom}. Choose the cell you want the character to move to, then press {console_bind|Confirm}. Red cells are areas inaccessible to the character. During the tactical phase, each character in the party may move up to their maximum {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}movement points{/g} but cannot position themselves adjacent to an enemy. Press {console_bind|FuncAdditional} to start the battle.

074f5646-8004-4f0f-a747-e54a3cd1fd2b.Text:
You have found a consumable item!
Grenades, stimulants, medikits, and other consumables can be placed in quick access slots. To do this, select one such item and open the context menu with {console_bind|Func01}. Selecting the Equip option will place the item in the first unoccupied quick access slot.
You can also equip items by selecting the appropriate equipment slot and pressing {console_bind|Confirm}. Select the item you wish to equip in the list that appears.
Each consumable item has a certain number of uses, which is indicated in the item's description.
As with most actions in combat, using consumable items spends the character's {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}action points{/g}.

0281b1bb-f944-4fb5-b7a8-2de7cf2c76c2.Text: A new rumour has been added to your journal [{bind|OpenJournal}]! Travel to the designated place on the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g} map to see if there is any truth to it.

afa9ab3b-c214-45dc-9f89-fc97c330eaf1.Text: You can manage your colonies remotely using the colony management screen [{bind|OpenColonyManagement}].

d7014117-7cd8-4bed-a901-9761a5a1509c.Text:
Only certain worlds, usually the most habitable, are suitable for establishing thriving colonies ripe for development.
Completing projects and colony events can earn the Rogue Trader unique rewards that cannot be obtained through any other means.

fed652bc-3941-43b1-970e-2072a95e934f.Text:
Projects are the backbone of colony development. Completing them requires resources that can be obtained by exploring planets and cosmic anomalies.
Completing a project takes time. While you continue your travels throughout the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g}, you will receive a notification on the screen when a project is finished, informing you that the reward can now be claimed.

ee5ebded-efbb-4bc7-ab3a-b34b99f64825.Text:
An important event has occurred in one of your protectorate's colonies which calls for the Rogue Trader's personal attention.
You can visit the colony and complete the event at any time. You can find out more information about all current events demanding your involvement on the colony management screen [{bind|OpenColonyManagement}].

39ebb825-0a45-40e8-9e10-9cf9942fe897.Text: Standard scanning could not reveal a route to the selected system, but you can still get there by spending points of Navigator's insight to plot a guaranteed direct path. Click [LMB] on the system and use {g|Encyclopedia:NavigatorsInsight}Navigator's insight{/g} to chart the course.

8ed9edfc-0ff1-40b0-976c-83a8a2443687.Text:
The {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g} is a vast region of space where you will travel between different star systems. In each system, unique events can occur. By steering your {g|Encyclopedia:FlagshipSpace}flagship{/g} toward them, you can explore planets, study anomalies, and interact with other ships.
To switch to the map of the entire Koronus Expanse, click the button in the bottom right corner of the screen.

38b4588f-bd2c-4a0f-ba53-bc8e4caf03f2.Text: Opening the Map of the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g}

587b2ef5-1b38-4731-9924-7ac4e4663b0f.Text: Travel between systems is fraught with mortal peril and takes place in another dimension known as the {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}warp{/g}. Only a Navigator can plot a course through the warp to other star systems. Click the circular button at the bottom of the screen to have the ship's Navigator chart new routes to the system you have selected.

7f292dff-f1e9-493d-8163-127efdd88999.Text: To initiate travel, click [LMB] on a system and press the warp travel button.

a9d2ea2d-0391-4fb8-8477-6b339ff5e83d.Text: A route's colour is an indication of its danger level. -Green routes are the absolute safest. -Yellow routes signal that unpredictable events can occur during the jump. -Orange routes denote a high probability of the ship coming under attack — even in the warp! -Red routes are a sure sign that the ship will be assaulted by hostile forces during travel. The ship's Navigator can make a route safer by spending points of {g|Encyclopedia:NavigatorsInsight}Navigator's insight{/g}, which can be acquired by discovering and scanning new systems throughout the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g}.

19510826-efdf-4dba-bc2c-6fafd968a3ae.Text: Planets in the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g} are teeming with valuable resources. Before these resources can be harvested, however, an extractium needs to be set up on the world's surface. Scan the planet, then select the icon of the resource you are interested in to deploy an extractium. Click accept to confirm your choice. You can see how many extractiums you have available at the bottom of the screen.

1acc9d00-ef71-4eec-a288-2dad36ded888.Text: Resources are required to develop colonies and complete contracts. You can also use them to trade with various factions.

b893b6b0-7c8f-4f7e-8c0f-4431814ff3c2.Text: New contracts are now available in the journal [{bind|OpenJournal}]! Contracts are requests issued by your colonies. By fulfilling them, you can obtain resources, increase your {g|Encyclopedia:ProfitFactor}profit factor{/g}, or receive unique items. Sometimes fulfilling contracts offered by one colony can affect the productivity of your other colonies.

5ff0299a-e6e2-4b6e-b591-f223313cc7bb.Text: Fulfilling contracts costs a certain amount of resources or a share of your {g|Encyclopedia:ProfitFactor}profit factor{/g}. A contract's description contains both the costs associated with it and the reward you will receive. You can fulfil a contract by selecting it in the journal and clicking complete contract.

e978b972-abbb-4cc4-8a0b-f5e2e262bd21.Text: While traversing the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g}, as the Rogue Trader, you are bound to hear rumours regarding your own deeds and exploits, some of which reflect the reaction of the Expanse's denizens to choices you have made.

21d0deb9-7921-4df2-9437-b3afe29df49d.Text:
On your travels, you will hear many rumours. Those of them that are deserving of the Rogue Trader's attention are logged in a separate section of the journal [{bind|OpenJournal}].
Sometimes rumours are just that. Other times there is truth to them, and in some cases there may be even more. To verify a rumour, travel to the place indicated in the rumour's description.

4aab73c9-4493-4ac8-8445-4aec9425db73.Text:
Sometimes during space combat, you will see different types of anomalous zones. Any vessel that enters such a zone (even with only a part of its hull) will receive specific positive and negative effects. Hover your cursor over the effect icon to find out more about the zone and adjust your strategy accordingly.
For example, in a gas and dust cloud, your flagship is slowed down. The dense fog obscures objects in the zone and creates heavy resistance for projectiles, thus affecting the shooting range and accuracy of your voidship's weapons. At the same time, the fog conceals your own position, significantly reducing the chance your own voidship will be hit.
Beware of asteroid fields! Any vessel caught in these zones suffers damage each round. But if you manage to lure an enemy into this zone, you'll surely gain the upper hand and make quick work of them.

51e90f05-ebf5-4bb3-b245-6e4f06a787ce.Text:
You can fill your flagship's arsenals with various ammunition that enhance the capabilities of the flagship's weapons.
The flak ammo arsenal allows you to use special flak projectiles with macro-cannons. These projectiles have explosive warheads that deal area damage in a 1-cell radius around a selected cell.
Flak shots are especially efficient against enemy torpedoes and small wings of attack craft.

de30e09d-3c6d-4da9-9670-32adbc85f2c5.Text:
You can fill your flagship's arsenals with various ammunition that enhance the capabilities of the flagship's weapons.
If your arsenals have fighter or bomber decks, your torpedo tubes can launch Fury Interceptors or Starhawk Bombers instead of regular torpedoes.
For several rounds, you will be able to directly control these special light units, using them to create a distraction and deal damage to your enemies.
Attack craft have a limited amount of fuel. When empty, they can no longer be controlled directly and return to your flagship automatically.

142aaf4a-34fc-4e3d-a81d-6fc1633f80fa.Text:
Your ship is equipped with an arsenal of weapons, which differ in terms of {g|Encyclopedia:Range}range{/g} of fire and offer you a variety of ways to assault your opponents.
The ship can attack with each of its weapons once per {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}. Note these can be fired as the ship moves as attacking does not end the ship's movement.

f7f1b29d-ed06-4810-bf10-a787715a9fe7.Text: Each of the ship's weapons has a separate attack action on the panel at the bottom of the screen. You can click on an attack's icon to view its {g|Encyclopedia:FiringArcSpace}firing arc{/g} and consider what position on the battlefield would be the most advantageous for your ship.

89f61119-506b-4d7c-aacb-4812beb16b2f.Text:
Select an attack action on the panel at the bottom of the screen to attack an enemy with, then click [LMB] on the enemy ship. Each {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, you can use each of the ship's attacks once.
Manoeuvre your ship in battle and attack with different weapons to make the most out of your ship's capabilities.

33d87419-a2ec-4d85-b3a1-3aa451028db0.Text:
In space combat, the battlefield is separated into three zones marked by various degrees of brightness:
1. Acceleration zone
2. Mid-movement zone
3. End movement zone
Ships travel at high speeds even during combat, which is why both your ships and those of your enemies must move a certain distance each {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}. You can only end your {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} once your ship has traversed this minimum required distance upon entering the end movement zone.

75b2461f-d3ee-4815-acc8-ecbbdab0ae84.Text: To move the ship, click [LMB] on any accessible cell on the battlefield. Once you do, you will see a hologram of the ship that will allow you to evaluate the efficiency of future attacks and actions from that position just as you would in regular combat. Click [LMB] again to confirm your choice and command the ship to move. Alternatively, you can click [RMB] to remove the hologram.

2d4e6f82-e6c1-46da-a4e4-d681a999bc71.Text:
You have engaged the enemy in space combat!
Battles in space and on the surfaces of planets work quite differently from one another.

0b61269e-6bd6-4303-95e5-ea7c74a61c28.Text: On top of firing weapons, ship combat involves using {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}abilities{/g} from various ship posts occupied by your trusted officers. Increase your ship's level to gain access to new abilities. Each {g|Encyclopedia:PostSpace}post{/g} can have up to two basic abilities and one ultimate ability assigned to it.

c6aea396-a761-4d89-b475-24025265d7d4.Text: Only one {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} from each {g|Encyclopedia:PostSpace}post{/g} can be used per {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}. The {g|Encyclopedia:Cooldown}cooldown{/g} time before an ability can be used again is determined randomly and can take up to 3 rounds.

3c176d1c-1b15-4b73-987a-650e41032c1d.Text: Some ships are protected by {g|Encyclopedia:VoidshipShieldsGlossary}shields{/g}. To deal {g|Encyclopedia:SpaceBattleDamageGlossary}damage{/g} to such an enemy, you must first pierce their shields. Two shield arrays cover the ship's sides, one protects its bow, and one its stern.

4c25d4bd-8af6-4456-a692-db3cefc5132c.Text:
When facing an enemy ship equipped with {g|Encyclopedia:VoidshipShieldsGlossary}shields{/g}, choose your angle of attack wisely and direct your fire at a side where the shields are weakened or completely depleted.
Note that enemies' shields recover each round.

62d8ee30-62c1-49a5-bde3-dc1146de6f58.Text: The Rogue Trader's {g|Encyclopedia:FlagshipSpace}flagship{/g} is likewise protected by {g|Encyclopedia:VoidshipShieldsGlossary}shields{/g}. If the enemy attacks you from a side where the shields are weakened or depleted, the ship will take {g|Encyclopedia:SpaceBattleDamageGlossary}damage{/g}.

02d2f237-dde4-4c19-a740-d790101aa0a5.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:FlagshipSpace}flagship{/g}'s {g|Encyclopedia:SpaceBattleDamageGlossary}damaged{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:VoidshipShieldsGlossary}shields{/g} do not recover at the start of the next turn. Instead, they can be restored using the {g|f:bd61b300bcd84e06a80c8cf3b699c78b}restart shields{/g} action on the panel at the bottom of the screen.

0de8b369-2eb2-4095-8801-17a6ba428ad7.Text: {g|f:bd61b300bcd84e06a80c8cf3b699c78b}Restart Shields{/g} reduces the {g|Encyclopedia:FlagshipSpace}flagship{/g}'s combat efficiency: on its next turn, it will have reduced movement {g|Encyclopedia:SpeedSpace}speed{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:FiringRangeSpace}firing range{/g}.

f8fda36e-5674-483d-9083-b6f8c8d6ab7e.Text: Note: from here on out, you may encounter clusters of small ships that follow the same rules in combat as torpedoes.

3a6937fb-809d-4fb6-b31e-bd3737237a3c.Text:
The enemy has launched torpedoes! However, you can destroy them before they reach you.
Torpedoes are always fired in salvos, and they do not have {g|Encyclopedia:VoidshipShieldsGlossary}shields{/g} or {g|Encyclopedia:HullIntegritySpace}hull integrity{/g} — every attack that hits a {g|Encyclopedia:TorpedoSalvoSpace}salvo{/g} destroys one torpedo per shot.

3f822176-9f78-4a6a-a6b4-166a5d26bd20.Text: Enemy ships can attack your torpedoes and destroy them before they reach their target. One well-placed shot destroys one torpedo in a {g|Encyclopedia:TorpedoSalvoSpace}salvo{/g}.

f79ad2dd-5f93-4a19-af83-4cfbfe46a98c.Text:
You have fired a {g|Encyclopedia:TorpedoSalvoSpace}torpedo salvo{/g}. Torpedoes will appear next turn in the {g|Encyclopedia:SpaceBattleInitiativeGlossary}priority{/g} order — once their turn begins, you will be able to direct them.
Your own torpedoes can pass through the space occupied by your {g|Encyclopedia:FlagshipSpace}flagship{/g} without damaging it. As soon as torpedoes reach a cell adjacent to any enemy, they explode.

c1333ed7-6927-4452-9f28-8c59ac2243c7.Text: The ship has reached the end movement zone. To end your turn, press [{bind|Pause}] or click the end turn button.

abccd4eb-b7bd-40c0-8fb4-4ed8abfbf4cd.Text: Your ship now has access to an ultimate {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g}! It can drastically change the tide of battle — try using your ultimate ability and see for yourself! Note that you can only use one ultimate ability per combat.

146f1275-1d14-4097-a0bb-6200c6e59e61.Text: Ultimate {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}abilities{/g} are so powerful that they take a significantly longer time to recharge. When using {g|Encyclopedia:UltimateAbilities}ultimate abilities{/g}, be aware that they may still be on {g|Encyclopedia:Cooldown}cooldown{/g} the next time you enter battle.

1fe5f801-8c11-470c-8462-1184c4a1f927.Text: The ship's ultimate {g|Encyclopedia:Cooldown}cooldown{/g} bar gradually fills up on each of your {g|Encyclopedia:FlagshipSpace}flagship{/g}'s {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turns{/g} in combat, at the end of each battle, and as a result of certain events during space exploration.

03f5c70a-2b4d-4801-9cbc-9a8033aae28c.Text:
Long-range attacks against Drukhari ships are less effective due to the {g|f:f9b2e0f3583a491c91ad19d72e2d2024}Shadow Field{/g} that surrounds them. Try changing your tactics by attacking them at close range — that way you can deal more {g|Encyclopedia:SpaceBattleDamageGlossary}damage{/g} and crush the enemy.
To learn more about how passive abilities of ships work, find the effect that interests you on the {g|Encyclopedia:SpaceBattleInitiativeGlossary}priority{/g} panel and hover your cursor over its icon.

2c205cb7-6eb7-4e71-9418-001cc465a3ea.Text:
You have received new equipment for your ship!
To install it, open the voidship management screen from the panel on the right. Double click [LMB] on the equipment's icon or hold [LMB] and drag it to the desired section.

201ffb55-76d6-4996-84c5-f63e9530ad23.Text:
Your ship has reached a new level!
You can open the voidship management screen from the panel on the right or by pressing [{bind|OpenShipCustomization}]. On the development tab, you can improve the abilities and upgrades you already have or choose new ones.

1713572f-da55-4874-8cc2-c760eb84af85.Text: Click [LMB] anywhere on the system map to command your ship to move there.

2b2c3ddb-8d26-4402-9f5b-d900ad19e490.Text: Enemy attacks can penetrate your {g|Encyclopedia:VoidshipShieldsGlossary}shields{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:SpaceBattleDamageGlossary}damage{/g} your ship's {g|Encyclopedia:HullIntegritySpace}hull{/g}. This damage remains after the battle is over and must be repaired. Open the voidship management screen [{bind|OpenShipCustomization}] to make repairs to your ship.

4ab838b2-e726-405f-b525-87bf04cd16fe.Text: Use {g|Encyclopedia:ScrapSpace}scrap{/g} to repair your ship and restore its {g|Encyclopedia:HullIntegritySpace}hull integrity{/g}. Scrap can be found while exploring star systems, collected after certain space battles, or purchased from merchants affiliated with various factions.

ee381550-9867-40ac-8894-848d36a4a529.Text: You can only obtain {g|Encyclopedia:ScrapSpace}scrap{/g} from ship {g|Encyclopedia:ShipComponentsGlossary}components{/g} if you have previously installed an upgrade for that component. Try to keep enough spare scrap on hand so as not to find yourself in a situation where you are forced to sacrifice critical ship parts for repairs.

d3679be7-7720-41d0-b2ea-e142e219ddfc.Text: You do not have enough readily available {g|Encyclopedia:ScrapSpace}scrap{/g} to repair your ship, but you still have options if you are willing to sacrifice some of your ship's upgrades. Open the voidship management screen and choose a component. Click [LMB] on it and select downgrade. The current level of the component will be lowered as it is stripped from the ship and turned into spare scrap — a portion of the original investment — that can be used to repair your ship.

f1d31fe9-86b5-463a-96c2-1978c9415260.Text:
One of the voidships in battle has gained a new effect! You can hover your cursor over a ship to see the effect and its icon displayed above it.
To learn more about an effect, hover your cursor over its icon on the {g|Encyclopedia:SpaceBattleInitiativeGlossary}priority{/g} panel.

d5efbe05-31f1-4165-871c-dff8e1b05e6e.Text:
You have jumped into an uncharted sector on the edge of the Expanse.
The dimensional gate has closed and you are currently cut off from the rest of the Koronus Expanse. You cannot return to previous systems or chart routes to them. Protectorate management is also unavailable and you have no way to contact faction trade representatives.
There is no way back, and it is pointless to look anywhere but ahead — establish routes to the new systems in the uncharted sector on the map and go forth to meet the inevitable.

40328584-e9fc-47ab-9862-a40c82ce6f49.Text:
The events of Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader take place in a vast region of space known as the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g}. This sector is composed of numerous star systems, many of which you will get a chance to visit. You will find yourself scouring the void in search of routes leading to new, uncharted systems, discovering more routes as you explore the Expanse.
What you see before you is the map of one such system.

9451fda7-4c16-4b35-9e5f-76b1ed04c067.Text: Each star system contains objects you can interact with. Such objects are marked as points of interest. Move your ship to a point of interest, then click [LMB] on it to initiate the event or open the planet view.

125a9b83-04ed-45ed-ac31-73ec45b6cf60.Text: You cannot equip more than one familiar

0e28ffb5-d867-49c1-88f9-35674a50cf10.Text: An artificial bio-mechanical creation of the Magos Biologis Tech-Priests. Based on their uploaded doctrines, cherubs can perform various menial tasks for their masters.

0e1c293c-06a2-43a9-a6ce-18cdd4835d11.Text: This servo-skull is designed to spread the glory and splendour of its mighty owner.

4da8fc3c-8b99-4eee-b6fd-90178ff1df26.Text: This creature is extremely agile and gains +10% {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g}.

00d38f1b-0ce0-46a8-9d92-a339d7dee068.Text: This creature gains +1 {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g}, +10% {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g}, and suffers −5% to {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g}.

0b1e0251-55b5-4d66-9702-98bf2fb0f210.Text: This creature gains +2 {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g}, +20% {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g}, and suffers −10% to {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g}.

821f9fc8-9ac1-47bd-90c8-22216c7748b7.Text: This creature gains +3 {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g}, +30% {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g}, and suffers −15% to {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g}.

82881f63-dabb-4142-8244-1e11144da8fe.Text: This creature gains +4 {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g}, +40% {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g}, and suffers −20% to {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g}.

10f9ecb5-a950-4876-b0fe-f55229991efc.Text: This creature gains +5 {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g}, +50% {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g}, and suffers −25% to {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g}.

b933c0c1-2ebb-4f7e-8791-eea5c9346b23.Text: This creature gains +6 {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g}, +60% {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g}, and suffers −30% to {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g}.

663bba40-61a5-487a-92c2-75f3791a0836.Text: This creature gains +7 {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g}, +70% {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g}, and suffers −35% to {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g}.

8120f080-197c-4013-a940-d81e0d6d367e.Text: For 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} this creature increases its {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} by +10% for every instance of {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} it suffers.

8b03c1f0-69a0-42f5-b2ae-bbe58dae2aeb.Text: For 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} this creature increases its {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g} by +2 for every instance of {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} it suffers.

64a06577-44db-47ee-a969-e6a66e4d7704.Text: This attack inflicts {g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}bleeding{/g} on the target.

a126d8e1-77c1-4278-8f1f-7cb4fd18e2d9.Text: Emits a short ray of darklight, piercing all creatures in a line.

4a4122b6-afa3-47b6-ba9e-c32d1836c3b4.Text: This creature suffers a −30 {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerBallisticSkill}Ballistic Skill{/g}.

70d31784-dc8d-465a-a7e7-62ee48aafcca.Text: Rate of fire is increased by +100%. This attack ends the wielder's turn.

3659c638-ba8f-497f-a72d-0b11415a7b0c.Text: The user gains +15 to {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerStrength}Strength{/g}, +15 to {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}Weapon Skill{/g}, and −20 to {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} for 2 {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turns{/g}.

34ba1195-0f93-48b7-845d-8715d415b0c7.Text: {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerStrength}Strength{/g}, and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} are reduced by −10 for the next {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.

705c0173-1d97-4fa4-a67e-00819c3311ea.Text: Decreases {g|Encyclopedia:RateOfFire}rate of fire{/g} by −3, but increases {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} by +12.

69f07229-4bcd-4f89-be46-8eacd6bd1a1d.Text: Increases {g|Encyclopedia:RateOfFire}rate of fire{/g} by +3, but decreases {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} by −3.

f08d4594-919c-400d-bfe8-4e376f1ed5b0.Text: Minimum {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} decreased by −10, maximum damage increased by +18.

ea7a74c8-f894-457a-b2b3-6757e0b3de6b.Text: Affects creatures in a straight line, dealing {g|Encyclopedia:FireDamage}fire damage{/g} and inflicting {g|Encyclopedia:BurningEffect}burning{/g}.

dc0a4d47-b12b-4d36-b2d2-c42a61515163.Text: Affects creatures in a wide cone, dealing {g|Encyclopedia:FireDamage}fire damage{/g} and inflicting {g|Encyclopedia:BurningEffect}burning{/g}.

2ee7eab2-5733-4814-8a06-d22a712a9541.Text: Creates a pool of blood which has the same properties as if created with the {g|f:e299c13f2278479bbd4e23269af5657c}Raining Blood{/g} ability. Whenever {g|f:e299c13f2278479bbd4e23269af5657c}Raining Blood{/g} is used, +1 charge of blood phial is restored.

1215780f-7385-4da8-9a23-409135442adc.Text: Deals <u>(from 25 to 45)</u> {g|Encyclopedia:MentalDamage}mental damage{/g} with 20% {g|Encyclopedia:ArmourPenetration}armour penetration{/g} to mechanical creatures only.

e328a649-41b4-486e-b3da-c476be057d7f.Text: Creates a {g|Encyclopedia:BurningEffect}burning{/g} area for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, dealing {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} to everyone within and inflicting the burning effect.

d40bd6e2-8abc-4739-8ae6-bd5f79df7fbb.Text: At the start of each {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, this creature gains an additional +1 stack of {g|Encyclopedia:PerplexedEffect}perplexed{/g}.

bd527962-476e-4ead-8b76-0d325957d57f.Text: This attack {g|Encyclopedia:PushGlossary}pushes{/g} the enemy away for <u>{g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerStrength}STR{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g}</u> cells.

d4883c12-c28c-4120-bdd5-84350eee116d.Text: This attack sets a targeted area on fire for 1 round.

e5a456f7-5e6c-4262-9489-dccc1803bb47.Text: Whenever the target is {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g}, it must pass a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a −{uip|Test|b04f00d9faf0433eb413f55d0ccaa680} {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} or immediately get pushed 4 cells away, provoking {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g}.

76bc3fe9-1346-4a3c-a9bb-b205d4cac039.Text: Contains various cataplasm patches, antiseptics, and synthetic skin applicators. Restores {uip|Heal|083d5280759b4ed3a2d0b61254653273} {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}. Also removes {g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}bleeding{/g}. Removes one {g|Encyclopedia:Injury}fresh injury{/g}, or, if none exist, attempts to remove one old injury.

e1fc9e9b-1f0d-4ed2-8cd9-460cae126b67.Text: Applies +1 stack of the {g|Encyclopedia:PerplexedEffect}perplexed{/g} effect for 2 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rounds{/g} if the target fails a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g}.

dcd34d5f-19aa-4459-b7b6-b7b8ba12197b.Text: Swing strike that affects up to three enemies in front of the attacker.

9e0859b6-49af-401e-9bb8-86c98272a298.Text: Wide slashing strike that affects multiple enemies at once.

8f357935-2b12-4c38-9e7f-59b59831eb62.Text: Powerful {g|Encyclopedia:AreaOfEffect}area attack{/g} that overheats plasma weapon for 2 {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turns{/g}.

7a05b522-593b-44ec-b8cd-f39c5941ef4f.Text: Deals +75% extra {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}, yet overheats plasma weapon for 2 {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turns{/g}.

37d5dda5-7239-4c50-8596-7d0937e3c545.Text:
Using overcharge attack with a plasma weapon gains {uip|Chance|0835dbc012334dd49f849fcc92e9f708}% chance (cannot be more than 100%) of causing {g|f:2a5d173c50af4cfd86eb00b12848b450}Plasma Explosion{/g}.
Each stack of this effect increases the damage of {g|f:0bc1f945b05e4b5593ec6151c7109a06}Plasma Overcharge (Area Attack){/g} by +5%, {g|f:1da644efeb174a789fc857602ebdfc1b}Plasma Overcharge (Extra Damage){/g} by +15%, and {g|f:2a5d173c50af4cfd86eb00b12848b450}Plasma Explosion{/g} by +10%.
At the start of the wielder's non-{g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}extra turn{/g}, −1 stack of this effect is removed.

38ec3969-a5b1-4daf-8f54-7b614fdf41f3.Text: Attack with power maul that {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damages{/g} everyone in an area and stuns them if they take 6 or more damage.

81ec1376-f48a-4f0e-8927-2aa663b18721.Text: Wide {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee attack{/g} that {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hits{/g} additional targets on both sides of the attacker.

43a33950-61c1-41db-a49f-111b4b63e7c6.Text: Precisely aimed shot with a +50% {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to the {g|Encyclopedia:Range}effective range{/g} of a weapon and a +10% {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit chance{/g}.

44b0edaf-a6e7-452b-b199-7a2cf0d24e84.Text: Deals <u>(from 5 to 11)</u> {g|Encyclopedia:ToxicDamage}toxic damage{/g} and applies +1 stack of the burst of disease effect.

98a47a3d-c3d2-4d9e-8f80-504c562a1f09.Text: The target of this attack is forced to make a Toughness resistance test. If failed, a permanent {g|Encyclopedia:Opening}opening{/g} is created on the target's side closest to the wielder. Both the wielder and their allies can make use of the {g|Encyclopedia:Opening}opening{/g}.

a9698b0d-8b39-4187-9103-c0c21452e90e.Text: Inflicts {g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}bleeding{/g} if the target fails a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g}.

7691ca4c-afdb-4e7b-9330-5d5e0d6ed589.Text:
Special attack that counts as a major {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g}.
It deals an additional <u>(2 × {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}psy rating{/g} + {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}WP{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g})</u> {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}, but may trigger {g|Encyclopedia:PsychicPhenomena}psychic phenomena{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:PerilsOfWarp}perils of the warp{/g}.

6a4b9f72-e78b-4f8d-9b0a-450e67859290.Text: {g|Encyclopedia:AreaOfEffect}Area attack{/g} that smites every creature in front of and to the sides of the attacker.

ee186946-fbeb-4eb6-b41b-5f505e379c0e.Text:
This toxic substance ruthlessly corrodes any {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} it touches.
<indent=5%>−10% armour</indent>
<indent=5%>−2 {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g}</indent>

6c5578ee-fd33-4eb2-aa43-a7d2c2bd2a5a.Text: {g|Encyclopedia:SingleRangedAttacksGlossary}Single shot{/g} that poisons enemy with Viral {g|Encyclopedia:ToxinEffect}Toxin{/g} on {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} for 3 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rounds{/g} if it fails {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Test}test{/g}.

f7282c02-ae52-450c-a8cb-c4e2d2b5840f.Text: Shoots a small sliver needle coated with viral toxins. Every {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} for 3 turns, the target must pass a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Test}test{/g} with a −15 {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} or suffer <u>(from 4 to 6)</u> {g|Encyclopedia:ToxicDamage}toxic damage{/g}. This {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} cannot be reduced by {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g}.

7f9b4104-a1d5-46ca-88e6-a4755f1f7a2c.Text: Wide-cone flamer attack that additionally sets its targets and owner on fire, applying {g|Encyclopedia:BurningEffect}burning{/g} (10).

d57333ed-5533-414e-8d37-c49d27a65a28.Text: Wide slashing strike that affects multiple enemies at once and poisons {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} targets with {g|Encyclopedia:ToxinEffect}toxin{/g}.

3d095e6e-f4a5-44c2-a3af-ecffa5d2a3ea.Text: Deals {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} each {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} if the poisoned creatures fail a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g}.

7fb4f28a-84a7-4594-8f14-a0cb7cbf4a25.Text: Shoots a specially crafted needle that inflicts {g|Encyclopedia:ToxinEffect}toxin{/g} (6) and +1 stack of {g|Encyclopedia:FatiguedEffect}fatigued{/g} until the end of combat. The target also suffers {g|Encyclopedia:SlowedEffect}slowed{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}. Stacks.

6af3fd26-8919-4bee-810f-29e8aad6aeb8.Text:
Targets hit by this {g|Encyclopedia:AreaOfEffect}area attack{/g} must pass an Agility resistance test or become {g|Encyclopedia:ImmobilisedEffect}immobilised{/g} for 1 round.
At the end of their turn, affected targets must pass an Agility resistance test to remove the effect or suffer direct damage equal to <u>target's AGI bonus</u>.

c1f97a6a-2460-4861-b8ca-db1be739c08c.Text: The wielder's target must pass an {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} or become {g|Encyclopedia:ImmobilisedEffect}immobilised{/g} until the start of the wielder's next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}. This {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} is used instead of {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g}.

f76451b8-63e3-4448-9208-3c0d5ea07853.Text: Deals {uip|Damage|b7113e32083d4344ad172d296119d40c} damage to each target in the area of effect.

2f45d955-5ddd-4f96-9c0c-1a1e5b3bffa1.Text: Before the start of their next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, when an enemy attacks the wielder from the protected side for the first time after this {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} is used, the wielder makes a pre-emptive attack against that enemy. That attack is performed before the enemy's attack. This {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}, the wielder cannot make {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g} before the pre-emptive attack is triggered.

4255a0f5-8fd3-4a3f-af71-a7c3f5762abe.Text:
Shields allow the wielder to {g|Encyclopedia:BlockChance}block{/g} attacks.
The first use of a shield attack in a {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} costs −1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} less.

882e1f17-f6f3-4d4f-9253-9b911f3e7127.Text: The wielder marks enemies within the {g|Encyclopedia:AreaOfEffect}area of effect{/g} and immediately ends the {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}. Until the start of their next turn, the wielder gains +15% {g|Encyclopedia:BlockChance}block{/g} against the first attack made by each of the marked enemies. If such an attack is blocked, the wielder counter-attacks the corresponding enemy.

d0766a96-040a-4c6e-adfd-ca93c3904828.Text:
The wielder turns toward a selected object or cell.
Can be used multiple times per {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}.

b46bde42-706b-4b66-8d77-2dadeb27de78.Text: Whenever the wielder suffers energy, fire, power, or warp damage, this sword absorbs a part of that damage, reducing it by −{uip|Damage|3ccf46b177184d7b886568fa5451c43b}%. The wielder gains +{uip|Range|3ccf46b177184d7b886568fa5451c43b}% armour penetration for their next attack. Stacks.

2165bc9d-d02c-4c07-8695-7dfc17005b71.Text: Enemies {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} by this rifle suffer +{uip|Damage|1c8dbdedc0904ea7b47ba45a25ebbeab}% more damage from the wielder until the end of combat. Does not stack.

6144a427-d1af-4fd6-96b3-3f5f4748554a.Text:
Whenever the wielder {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hits{/g} a target with an arc rifle, they also hit each creature in a 2-cell radius around the main target.
Shots from an arc rifle cannot {g|Encyclopedia:OverpenetrationFullGlossary}overpenetrate{/g}.
Arc rifle {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical{/g} damage is increased by +{uip|CritDamage|23a11a94517345a6a7925e239cbc8ceb}%.

dbe8f123-f327-41a7-bdf7-43b987e209a5.Text: A favoured weapon of the Adeptus Astartes.

885bd72e-0fc0-4e0d-8de3-9fcd7bf807ac.Text: If an attack with this knife kills the target, the wielder restores +1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} and can make an additional attack with this knife.

8b404abc-0119-44c8-900d-01646b1895f2.Text: Targets hit with this weapon must pass a Toughness resistance test with a −10 penalty or be {g|Encyclopedia:PushGlossary}pushed{/g} 2 cells away.

8f4bcd02-d3ce-450a-9ee8-ba61a3b7b90a.Text: Solid projectile weapons have an increased (+50%) {g|Encyclopedia:OverpenetrationFullGlossary}overpenetration{/g}.

1d673611-90f3-40a1-955d-5806fc95b049.Text: Axes have a special attack that inflicts {g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}bleeding{/g}.

b78eac69-4f0c-4355-ba92-e2899f297c05.Text:
Requires {g|Encyclopedia:SoulMarkCorruption}Heretical{/g} — Fanatic
Each successful attack with Edge of the Irrevocable raises {g|Encyclopedia:VeilThickness}veil degradation{/g} by +<u>(from 1 to 5)</u> and deals an additional +{uip|Damage|cce8d529e407406695a7cc7dde1ebe70} {g|Encyclopedia:WarpDamage}warp damage{/g}. It also grants:
-<indent=5%>All allies deal +{uip|AllyDamage|cce8d529e407406695a7cc7dde1ebe70}% additional {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}.</indent>
-<indent=5%>The wielder gains +{uip|PsyRating|cce8d529e407406695a7cc7dde1ebe70} (minimum of +1) additional {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}psy rating{/g}.</indent>
-<indent=5%>If veil degradation reaches 20, successful attacks with Edge of the Irrevocable trigger {g|Encyclopedia:PerilsOfWarp}perils of the warp{/g}.</indent>
-<indent=5%>If veil degradation ever drops to 0, Edge of the Irrevocable loses all its powers until the end of combat.</indent>

9d751c7c-0496-44bd-b4b3-48bf4da8fae2.Text: This pistol increases the wielder's {g|Encyclopedia:SkillCoercion}Coercion{/g} by +10 and does not require weapon proficiency to be wielded.

187f1a77-cd9c-433e-be4a-cdbd197f3471.Text: Whenever an ally adjacent to the wielder attacks an enemy, the wielder makes an attack of opportunity against that enemy if possible.

91ead88e-6f0a-4334-a50c-15fee65c94f7.Text: This blade can only perform area attacks. Attacks of opportunity performed with it are also area attacks.

0bddc26c-cb82-4349-88b9-1b8066194445.Text: This blade deals an additional +{uip|Damage|483093afe6d34109a1eba3000eec4d9a}% damage to enemies with more than 50% wounds.

a7eb3b04-211a-49f9-bd73-39daf6b34c69.Text: This blade deals an additional +{uip|Damage|c4ae9d253c654ac5804f7a9bdd49bb61}% damage to enemies with less than 50% wounds.

a9e3181a-fce2-4d15-8654-c3cb1b9ec293.Text: The wielder of this sword gains a +25% {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g}.

4e0ac948-b2f0-4357-8c22-8d13a2d4bb67.Text: Each attack with this dagger increases its damage by +1 until the end of the combat. Stacks.

937e3649-8a9a-48b9-8720-53b9e26e63d9.Text: Every successful basic attack made with this mace inflicts a random trauma on the target.

ddbaf9c9-ffb0-48da-a2a7-e7a2b8937be7.Text: This weapon deals additional damage equal to the target's difficulty tier.

1fa29900-3bf6-4f9a-b11e-9e8aac1af23f.Text: On a successful {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} with this weapon, the target must pass a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a −{uip|Test|b04f00d9faf0433eb413f55d0ccaa680} {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} or immediately be moved 4 cells away, provoking {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g}.

c4f2dd90-3553-4c96-9d4b-dfb15f796665.Text: When this shot {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hits{/g}, it poisons the target with a viral {g|Encyclopedia:ToxinEffect}toxin{/g} for 3 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rounds{/g} if the enemy fails a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g}.

77bb0af2-1a2c-4664-9cda-7bf8188465d1.Text:
{g|Encyclopedia:DeadeyeShot}Deadeye shots{/g} fired by this rifle deal additional {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} to larger enemies:
-<indent=5%>Hulking creatures (2×2 cells) suffer +5 damage.</indent>
-<indent=5%>Enormous creatures (3×3 cells) suffer +10 damage.</indent>
-<indent=5%>Massive creatures (4×4 cells) suffer +15 damage.</indent>

72e9c211-e2b7-483c-9fc1-940c21985f54.Text: This weapon deals +2 additional {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} for each enemy adjacent to the wielder. Enemies {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} by this weapon cannot make {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.

488e0fb7-0861-4d51-aee7-a03f114e9da8.Text: This creature cannot make {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g}.

8185d855-0e48-4ea8-ad97-11ac83a756fe.Text:
On {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g}, targets must perform a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a +10 {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g}.
If they fail, they suffer {g|Encyclopedia:BurningEffect}burning{/g} (24) and {g|Encyclopedia:MeltingEffect}melting{/g}. Additionally, they are {g|Encyclopedia:Stun}stunned{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}.
If they pass, they suffer burning (8) and melting.

a444c1d4-dcb1-4108-9b97-db5378e42c60.Text: This klaive's {g|Encyclopedia:AreaOfEffect}area attack{/g} has an increased area of effect.

deb92c50-11d8-4e23-9e68-02264112247a.Text: The wielder can only perform {g|Encyclopedia:DeadeyeShot}deadeye shot{/g} attacks with this weapon. Whenever they kill an enemy with a {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit{/g} using this weapon, they gain an additional attack this {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}.

96ab3048-c5e9-46c6-b7d3-b1ccd23c0ba2.Text: Grants +25% {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit chance{/g}. If the wielder has at least {g|Encyclopedia:SoulMarkHope}Iconoclast{/g} — Zealot, {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} is increased by +{uip|Damage|3188b332a5044c73964b85b1e07438ad}.

adf0c0bd-99a2-4ad1-b8c3-1d5b98cc51d5.Text: This melta weapon modified by the Adeptus Mechanicus has increased firepower and range.

a7b4e027-ac45-491b-b73e-618c58130635.Text: A lasgun modified by some handyman.

30426d76-c1bf-41b6-8e11-29fd4566959d.Text: Deals {g|Encyclopedia:MentalDamage}mental damage{/g} to the target. If the target fails an {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerIntelligence}Intelligence{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g}, its {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerPerception}Perception{/g}, and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerFellowship}Fellowship{/g} are reduced by −10 and its {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}psy rating{/g} is reduced by −1.

703af0d2-4508-481b-bc9f-9d616564a25e.Text: Omnissian Axes grant the wielder a +15 {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}Weapon Skill{/g}.

ecfc92db-ca46-49f6-99c3-0aef51724a9e.Text: Slows enemies and inflicts +1 stack of the {g|Encyclopedia:FatiguedEffect}fatigued{/g} effect.

ad62c00b-9395-4302-924a-ab3f15bb9758.Text: This weapon ignores the targets' armour and deflection.

e7c53459-829a-4b34-8e51-1a05e2ff9f13.Text: This weapon has an extra attack action which increases armour penetration of all subsequent attacks made against the same target by +10 for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}. Stacks.

f8e398b7-fa59-435e-b727-cddd34671882.Text:
Decreases the target's weapon {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} by −3 for 2 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rounds{/g} after the wielder has parried an attack.
<indent=5%>+30% {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g}</indent>

963ab037-6814-4c70-b715-8fb8edcd7112.Text: Whenever the wielder makes a {g|Encyclopedia:BurstAttacksGlossary}burst{/g} attack with this weapon, its {g|Encyclopedia:RateOfFire}rate of fire{/g} is increased by +2 (up to a maximum of +10). Stacks and lasts until the end of combat.

9f979053-ec0f-413f-a68c-d6bf96aac024.Text: Each kill with this weapon increases its {g|Encyclopedia:RateOfFire}rate of fire{/g} by +1.

3d2ba96d-87f8-47fe-aaca-97176effbc98.Text:
Inflicts {g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}bleeding{/g} (4) if the target fails a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g}.
+10 {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g}

3205eb1b-05f7-421e-a24b-6c2b0cdfdd79.Text: This knife has a chance to inflict {g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}bleeding{/g}.

e40bae2c-ee7c-4c05-9e9b-f8e86af5b047.Text: Shotguns knock enemies back when shot at {g|Encyclopedia:Range}effective range{/g}.

473eb243-58df-40eb-b53f-0f38c825ecc6.Text: Attacks with this hammer always critically {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} against {g|Encyclopedia:Stun}stunned{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:ProneEffect}prone{/g} targets. The {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical damage{/g} is increased by +80%.

c5d88ee0-6a4c-45ac-a35a-bf7b28cd3dcf.Text: On a successful {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} with this weapon, the target must pass a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a −10 {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} or become {g|Encyclopedia:Stun}stunned{/g}. If the target fails the test, this attack has no {g|Encyclopedia:Cooldown}cooldown{/g}.

cb66fdfc-8f8a-442d-a413-ada924ef07c1.Text: Maces and hammers have a special attack that {g|Encyclopedia:PushGlossary}pushes{/g} enemies away.

4a33e45c-1968-47d9-9df2-8af9a023f454.Text: In addition to the webber attack effects, the target suffers a −20 penalty to Weapon Skill and cannot perform attacks of opportunity. These penalties last for 2 rounds.

0dcc787f-580d-4410-a9f8-087fc9f2d7a4.Text: This staff gains +10% {g|Encyclopedia:ArmourPenetration}armour penetration{/g} for every level of the wielder's {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}psy rating{/g}.

1d12ad36-4e12-4935-9492-613fe050b87c.Text: You escorted a tithe of psykers aboard a Black Ship. The terrors of the warp left your soul harrowed, deterring you from ever tapping into forbidden knowledge.

0735a084-d9f1-444a-be89-245d880eba3b.Text: You were defrauded by a group of clerks in the service of a Rogue Trader while collecting a tithe shipment. You were never able to prove that you were not the one responsible for the discrepancy.

dfe2bc09-8a8a-4f34-9cec-b7db30ce5244.Text: You were captured by pirates who wanted information on tithe transportation routes. You managed to survive, but you never fully recovered from the torture.

71234e00-4296-4983-9383-070a5d7e1b62.Text: The souls of all who perished in a brutal offensive still haunt your nightmares and torture your soul.

a3d6bb4b-e5f2-446f-8915-690f203dd911.Text: An inauspicious deal with the wrong people resulted in the rise of a Chaos cult and the horrific massacre of innocents.

e06e860e-3785-4817-a655-14f887aae33b.Text: Your sermons are dark and ominous, for the visions that inspired you were just as lightless and disturbing.

c35b3d3f-cac2-4ac5-a7ab-90db7488b0b0.Text: You lost an entire regiment to the Immaterium during a Geller field failure, yet you yourself emerged unscathed.

213e0e8f-4d5d-4f48-900c-d5d23716eee4.Text: You have journeyed through dark and forsaken systems, and the things you have seen have left a mark on your soul that will never heal.

a9b6d0e4-a6b9-4496-b7e9-e289273c9db8.Text: The mysterious tome that was discovered in your family library exacted a terrible toll on your mind.

020c0b0f-16a0-4971-976a-8231dc76acca.Text: You were accused of being possessed by a warp entity and forced into exile, leaving your soul forever scarred.

19ebd2ab-c0a9-4664-98e5-bbc89775797e.Text: Falsely accused of cowardice, you were forced to suffer through a humiliating tribunal.

9ae7ed1c-7288-4b90-a865-cf7f4908e410.Text: You turned your partners in to the authorities and became known as a traitor.

2a3efbb8-6bfa-4356-8579-7420bcda386c.Text: You renounced your mentor and testified against him in the Ecclesiarchy's court.

556f35b1-e701-4274-8b8f-6d260c68d98e.Text: As the commander-in-chief of a disastrous military campaign, you were buried in shame.

ed745652-b73a-428f-b28c-b73cece6aa95.Text: Once in your past, when the temptation of easy gains got the better of you, you resorted to piracy and were caught red-handed.

6bf9755b-b04f-4bd8-9914-8b835fd2ba59.Text: You are a bastard, an illegitimate member of a family that immediately turned its back on you.

4d8b7651-bf6b-4226-9bb8-4ef7082c7393.Text: Your sorcery caused a warp manifestation aboard a voidship, claiming thousands of lives in the end.

37a32d04-a54a-4c2a-96e6-dc493a8c8e7f.Text: You were attacked by a group of renegade Guardsmen during a mutiny and were beaten half to death.

cf9864d2-ff11-4477-8c9f-e1b3808a6aa4.Text: You were arrested and thoroughly interrogated using creative and violent methods.

ed584ea8-be85-4248-940f-385584ead3a0.Text: Your ordainment took place after a trial of faith by devotional torture.

8755683f-1952-4546-b30a-b2c2bc27be2e.Text: Captured by heretics, you suffered unbearable torture at the hands of Humanity's enemies.

2c6a3804-8405-45a2-bc1f-d07f2d0e0eee.Text: Your ship was boarded by pirates and you barely survived, enduring many horrors during your time in captivity.

6bf95a2a-ba81-4761-b25b-008f9a8dde1a.Text: You were kidnapped for ransom, and your captors mistreated you up until the moment you were released.

3297bde9-0da4-4453-8602-e5693c6777e2.Text: An error during the sanctioning process brought you many hours of agony, which nearly cost you your life.

311e0be4-2e9d-497d-aac0-5553e1a85bda.Text: You played a key role in exposing a conspiracy among your superior officers in the Astra Militarum.

ecdaac03-ef9d-4383-aa1f-d61f45cecd25.Text: You managed to corrupt an entire star system and turn it into your personal den of thieves.

f4f5f1d3-55fa-4cae-84e1-39a168385891.Text: By destroying the very foundation of a heretical teaching, you brought down a dangerous schismatic sect.

b002ca60-d181-4f85-8a31-b061479e7745.Text: Through reforms and leadership, you restored a broken Imperial Guard regiment to its former martial glory.

ec323bc4-d7f1-4615-8b7d-46082020a771.Text: You lured a pirate squadron into the gravitational tear of a star, thereby destroying the whole fleet through your cunning alone.

bbd3ffee-4217-4ef0-8f33-1e5a93bfbc22.Text: Your strong presence and persuasiveness stopped a feudal war between neighbouring systems.

50af873c-c0d3-47ec-ac5f-c300762def0d.Text: Upon solving the mystery of a powerful psychically active xeno-artefact, you managed to destroy the creation of countless enemies of Humanity.

4b214aa8-7a29-499d-a210-f2c0d3462934.Text: Your name has become a synonym for loyalty and valour, and your visage has adorned many Imperial Guard propaganda posters.

6e6a9856-d304-4c56-ae65-9a219020ceb5.Text: You stripped an Ecclesiarchy cardinal of a priceless treasure that had been kept in one of the most secure sanctums of the Adeptus Ministorum.

2115a959-1ae0-45ad-9fbc-44891ba4d821.Text: You have been deemed a worthy successor to a higher-ranked hierchon of the Ecclesiarchy.

b37c4eea-b01b-4075-8f0a-548136f8baa7.Text: You and your Guardsmen defended a shrine world and received a high commendation for your feat.

0be957a1-272a-4fb2-8e2f-cd5175c46548.Text: Your ship became the first to take a now-reclaimed warp route to a cluster of Humanity's lost worlds.

c5eff6f4-003b-4afb-8690-1a56e34af961.Text: You were named planetary governor and survived, having made useful connections on both sides of the law.

c190679e-4b7b-476f-aaf9-13f7244f814f.Text: You single-handedly saved a pilgrim ship by stopping a warp breach while travelling through the Immaterium.

73853d80-3237-4406-bdd8-808fde7eafd7.Text: You directed a heroic attack of an Imperial Guard regiment that breached the gates of a fortress held by heretics.

edf9b495-9813-4acf-940b-b012875671f7.Text: You prevailed in a bloody shadow war against the void pirates of your sector.

ca80747b-6830-4a34-a595-52692d0ad15a.Text: You heroically rescued a priceless relic of the Imperium from the clutches of heretics.

671828a5-e3cf-4089-bc0e-30e6846c6f0d.Text: You utilised your talents as a commander to achieve a great victory over the Ruinous Powers.

890d5de4-2978-44b8-9e8e-67f02cc3387a.Text: Under your command, a voidship braved a terrible warp storm without a single casualty among the crew.

eece3870-2a42-4010-b54b-9f1d6f4a9f20.Text: You had a rival noble house's reputation destroyed and its members exiled from the sector.

a7e0999e-f8ee-40a6-af9a-637cb71b3897.Text: The power of your sorcery crushed a daemon of the Archenemy and drove it back into the warp.

32f555ff-82e4-4777-97ed-72c46902fee8.Text: You preserved a copy of the regional Lex and used the appendices therein to extract a tithe of unprecedented value from a rebelling Imperial world.

db199e17-9db0-4acc-971c-44f0864d496f.Text: Your words alone persuaded a group of rebels to join the Arbitrators' side in the midst of a planet-wide uprising, without any need for punitive measures.

053673ec-ba20-4c12-bf9a-852a01b0acc6.Text: Despite having run out of ammunition, you defended a critical area for the Arbitrators all by yourself until reinforcements arrived.

563b277c-c04b-4c54-8d63-ad024d8e7ea1.Text: An immeasurably vast domain hidden within the depths of the Webway — an enigmatic labyrinthine dimension that exists between the warp and realspace — Commorragh is the prime bastion of the Drukhari, a cruel and deadly xenos faction of the Aeldari. It is here that they devise plans for their raids into realspace — and weave their perpetual webs of intrigue against one another.

0118e66f-09d5-4166-85d2-e71a3cd0c66b.Text: Craftworlds are colossal vessels that carry the remnants of the once great and numerous Asuryani people through the darkness of the void, each craftworld a marvel of psycho-engineering and a self-sustaining abode. Over such long periods of isolation from the rest of their kin, even unique cultures have formed among the craftworlds' denizens.

c4882118-702b-4ab4-8298-4cbefb523b39.Text: On death worlds, the plants, beasts, and sometimes even the environment itself take aggressive and destructive forms inimical to human life. Whilst exceptionally difficult to colonise, many death worlds possess valuable resources that require an outpost or other human presence upon the planet's surface to harvest. These harsh environments result in some of the hardiest and most resilient populations in the galaxy. Those tested and found wanting die young.

f2d365c4-2ad9-4aaa-900d-07594a1f0966.Text:
Once per combat, when the {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} of a death world character drop below 30%, they gain +20% of their {g|Encyclopedia:MaxWounds}maximum wounds{/g} as {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g}.
Death world characters also gain a +20% bonus to {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} and armour while they have at least 1 temporary wound from any source.

17901db7-c0b6-4dc2-aa2c-2afa6a3ce4cb.Text: Death world characters gain +15% {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit chance{/g} against targets with the {g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}bleeding{/g} effect or with 50% or less of their {g|Encyclopedia:MaxWounds}maximum wounds{/g}.

2b27eb63-88c5-42d9-84a8-cee22f49a92a.Text: Death world characters gain +10% to {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit chance{/g} for axes, hammers, and las weapons.

20386b15-f136-4d97-9775-658c968953fc.Text:
Every {g|Encyclopedia:Injury}injury{/g} increases the death world character's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} by +5.
Every {g|Encyclopedia:Traumas}trauma{/g} counts as 3 injuries.

723209da-07c6-4cf7-982e-866e10e7cf3e.Text: Death world characters suffer −{unit_stat|WarhammerToughness|bonus} less {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} from fire, {g|Encyclopedia:ToxicDamage}toxic damage{/g}, and {g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}bleeding{/g} effects.

9fbd89f6-faf6-40ec-a2b4-2b6d091d6f1d.Text: Once per combat, when a death world character suffers the {g|Encyclopedia:Stun}stunned{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:BlindedEffect}blinded{/g}, or {g|Encyclopedia:ImmobilisedEffect}immobilised{/g} effect, this effect is ignored, and they instead gain +20% of their {g|Encyclopedia:MaxWounds}maximum wounds{/g} as temporary wounds.

32a5f891-0ab4-4707-b99d-cd2c96ddb1b9.Text: Fenris is a death world of fire and ice, located on the fringe of the Segmentum Solar and home to the Space Wolves Chapter of the Adeptus Astartes. Each planetary year, Fenris goes through a cycle of devastating cataclysms, which has turned its inhabitants into hardened and unyielding warriors, from whose number only the select few are deemed worthy to bolster the ranks of the Space Marines of Leman Russ.

19500878-8f21-42c5-9992-bafdf7669631.Text: Forge world characters gain +{uip|CritChance|96fd88d5d1fe4ba1a35746cde88aaf3c}% {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit chance{/g}.

90fb1538-9f44-4706-b07e-c4f8a39cec12.Text:
Forge world characters choose one augmentation system from the following list:
-<indent=5%>Subskin {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}Armour{/g}: grants +<u>(5 + 2 × TGH bonus)</u>% armour.</indent>
-<indent=5%>Locomotion System: grants +<u>(AGI bonus / 2)</u> {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} and +<u>(2 × AGI bonus)</u>% {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g}.</indent>
-<indent=5%>Analytics System: grants +<u>(10 + INT bonus)</u>% {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit chance{/g}.</indent>

69a1565a-a07c-4ba6-a90f-7b822250c554.Text: Forge worlds are the domain of the Adeptus Mechanicus. Entire planets ceded to the demands of vast macro-industries, each is a manufacturing super-complex of unimaginable capacity and power. Over the millennia, different forge worlds have become especially renowned for their philosophies or ways of war. These are often coloured by the technologies they specialise in manufacturing. The bulk of a forge world's population is utilised as a labour force, whilst the fortunate few may be inducted into the ranks of the Adeptus Mechanicus itself.

46f84590-71e9-493b-98d0-50d83a695341.Text:
Forge world characters choose one augmentation system from the following list:
-<indent=5%>Subskin {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}Armour{/g}: grants +<u>(5 + 2 × TGH bonus)</u>% armour.</indent>
-<indent=5%>Locomotion System: grants +<u>(AGI bonus / 2)</u> {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} and +<u>(2 × AGI bonus)</u>% {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g}.</indent>
-<indent=5%>Analytics System: grants +<u>(10 + INT bonus)</u>% {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit chance{/g}.</indent>

44315fcb-b6bc-472a-982c-b055c26b92d6.Text:
The first attack in combat with any plasma, melta, or power weapon deals additional {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} equal to {unit_stat|WarhammerIntelligence|bonus}.
For the remainder of combat, the {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} damage is decreased to {uip|DamageBonus|4563725badc446ccab8413bbb0b9b287}.

81e369e7-7630-4748-8e62-68a836260b17.Text: Forge world characters gain +{unit_stat|WarhammerToughness|bonus} {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g} against the {g|Encyclopedia:BurningEffect}burning{/g} effect and flame weapons.

d17c9506-4f8e-4488-a0d3-4fbcdac5c6de.Text: While wearing {g|Encyclopedia:HeavyArmour}heavy armour{/g}, forge world characters gain +1 {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g}, +1 {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g}, and cannot fall {g|Encyclopedia:ProneEffect}prone{/g}.

65c9f975-902c-4f96-9ca4-4deb73fca18c.Text:
Forge world characters gain a stacking +10% {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to hit chance and {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeReduction}dodge reduction{/g} against any target they hit with a single-target attack.
Successful {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hits{/g} from single-target attacks increase the hit chance and dodge reduction by +20%.

b50de84c-93f9-4292-90df-4a65c6c4068a.Text: Forge world characters can use {g|Encyclopedia:SkillPersuasion}Persuasion{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:SkillCoercion}Coercion{/g}, and {g|Encyclopedia:SkillCommerce}Commerce{/g} based on {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerIntelligence}Intelligence{/g} instead of {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerFellowship}Fellowship{/g}.

e8042522-8f8b-4b03-a46b-b66fa4c28664.Text: Fortress worlds are planets where the entire populace is immersed in warfare; they constantly train for the day that they may be called upon to defend the Imperium, a charge they solemnly uphold. Fortress worlds are established as bulwarks against the enemy. Every citizen is a soldier, trained to fight from the moment they can handle a weapon.

31d86ec2-5137-4b41-85cb-e889c8b19804.Text:
Each time a fortress world character kills an enemy, they gain +10 stacks of never stop shooting. At the start of their {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, there is a <u>(stacks of never stop shooting)</u>% chance that the first attack this {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g} will cost 0 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} and will not count toward the attack limit per turn.
If this effect triggers, all the stacks are lost.

3ce453b1-dd58-49a5-ba91-49538ce778e2.Text: Fortress world characters gain +7 to {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerBallisticSkill}Ballistic Skill{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerPerception}Perception{/g}, and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} while in combat. Yet while out of combat, their {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerIntelligence}Intelligence{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerFellowship}Fellowship{/g}, Perception, and Willpower are decreased by −7.

4613266f-fd10-4320-83da-0c0759fe55a1.Text: Each round fortress world characters gain a stacking +1% {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} against {g|Encyclopedia:RangeAreaAttacksGlossary}ranged attacks{/g} for each shot they made during this round. Also, the ranged {g|Encyclopedia:BurstAttacksGlossary}burst{/g} attack grants an additional +10 stacks of never stop shooting.

70480cce-67b0-4542-8a55-d7a0f5baebd8.Text: At the end of their {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, fortress world characters gain stacks of never stop shooting equal to <u>(half the minimal {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} of the most damaging {g|Encyclopedia:RangeAreaAttacksGlossary}ranged weapon{/g} they used this {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g})</u>.

1e49df52-3899-483c-9228-8fabb928870e.Text: Fortress world characters' first {g|Encyclopedia:Reload}reload{/g} in combat costs 0 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}. Reloading a weapon grants an additional +10 stacks of never stop shooting.

de1e7980-c6f8-4894-b0ae-3dab93ea4fe3.Text:
When all stacks of never stop shooting should be lost, they become {uip|Stacks|40edd34c2d9d4b2482603083309a3ecf} stacks instead.
Additionally, a fortress world character may upgrade their {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Characteristic}characteristic{/g} even if their current archetypes do not allow it.

c825d72c-7f69-42e5-a66f-455478860ea9.Text: A hive world's population is so dense that great swathes of the surface of the world are frequently covered in gargantuan cities bejewelled with towering spires that pierce the atmosphere. Hive worlds are vital to the welfare of the Imperium and are the beating heart of its economy and war machine. They produce munitions for the Emperor's armies in vast manufactories, mine valuable minerals, and refine fuel for the Imperial Navy. Innumerable regiments of the Astra Militarum are raised from their massive populations as well.

78081c00-1e71-4247-8f4e-b7391b9f634d.Text: Hive world characters can pass {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance tests{/g} using their {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerFellowship}Fellowship{/g} value instead, if the character's Fellowship is higher.

04831615-a052-4299-9128-e8a39927bbfc.Text: If a hive world character has {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeSuperiority}melee superiority{/g} against the enemy, the effect is increased by +10. If an enemy has {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee{/g} superiority against a hive world character, the effect is decreased by −10.

70bfc2a1-d4bd-4e4f-8a86-a0b2bd72ed35.Text: All {g|Encyclopedia:RangeAreaAttacksGlossary}ranged weapons{/g} dealing {g|Encyclopedia:PhysicalDamage}physical damage{/g} have +1 damage, +5% {g|Encyclopedia:ArmourPenetration}armour penetration{/g}, +1 {g|Encyclopedia:RateOfFire}rate of fire{/g}, and −5 to recoil.

fdc33a3f-b2f8-4696-a604-f260b000edc0.Text:
If a hive world character starts their {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} adjacent to an ally character, that hive world character gains +2 {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g}.
If a hive world character ends their turn adjacent to allies, they all gain +2 MP on their next turn.

9ce05126-af22-4509-944a-50251382f3e5.Text: Hive world characters gain a +50% {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} against the first {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attack of opportunity{/g} every {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.

8362249b-472d-4b00-b1fe-bbceed51934a.Text:
Hive world characters gain +{uip|Resolve|33ece001a1ec47c19dca4ddc8435c249} {g|Encyclopedia:Resolve}resolve{/g} if there are 3 or more creatures (allies or enemies) in a 3-cell radius.
Yet they suffer a −2 {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} to resolve with no creatures around.

70e848f1-8049-4474-8245-033f8d11cace.Text: An Imperial world is one of a million planets united by the belief in the immortal God-Emperor. Hailing from hyper-technological societies to grimy feudal populations, the inhabitants of countless worlds offer fealty and devotion to the Master of Humanity and the Imperial Creed espoused by His servants. The designation "Imperial world" encompasses a vast array of wholly dissimilar worlds that are, nevertheless, part of the Imperium.

86ddda6c-ca8c-454e-bbb3-7d9995a9d4df.Text: Imperial world characters can select any {g|Encyclopedia:Characteristic}characteristic{/g} (except for {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}Weapon Skill{/g} or {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerBallisticSkill}Ballistic Skill{/g}) and add a +10 {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g}.

9af56a02-1d55-420d-939b-97cb35cf5a7f.Text: When an Imperial world character is affected by an ally's non-damaging {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} or affects an ally with such an ability, their {g|Encyclopedia:Resolve}resolve{/g} is increased by {uip|Resolve|ede94fd520554c3288633197b1f11bdc} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.

43f86ac3-4360-4b9e-8ded-d5cc50634ee7.Text: While under 40% {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}, Imperial world characters gain a +10 {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to all {g|Encyclopedia:Characteristic}characteristics{/g} and +2 to {g|Encyclopedia:Resolve}resolve{/g}.

9616cc5a-9d48-4a5f-ba90-d9363eebc791.Text: Better to Die for the Emperor

a440e8b4-520b-4ad0-9f10-2ac79921ca65.Text: If no other character in the current party has the same archetype as this character, the first {g|Encyclopedia:Career}archetype{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} used in each combat by this character costs −1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} less.

01d6ab8e-b0fa-4095-b14d-21f742080253.Text:
Imperial world characters gain +10% {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit chance{/g} and +10% {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} against xenos or daemonic creatures. Their allies gain half the {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonuses{/g} of Know No Heresy.
However, Imperial world characters' {g|Encyclopedia:SkillLoreXenos}Lore (Xenos){/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:SkillLoreWarp}Lore (Warp){/g} are always 0.

dee6861e-4a13-4aca-9529-47929ea6ac4c.Text: All allies, excluding xenos, in the current party gain +5 to the same {g|Encyclopedia:Characteristic}characteristic{/g} as was chosen for Humanity's Finest.

8801365d-0481-4277-91b6-22077705829b.Text: The planet of Leira lies in the deeper reaches of the Koronus Expanse. After a prolonged loss of contact with the Imperium, its population descended into heresy and turned to sorcery and forbidden knowledge to ensure their own survival and welfare.

0277f893-24a6-4420-8fc8-c3e6119473b6.Text: Voidborn are humans birthed in the belly of a void vessel or aboard an ancient orbital satellite. Those who have lived their lives on voidships become inured to some extent due to the reality-altering process of warp travel and to living in low- or zero-gravity environments. In many cases, their features are drawn and their skin pallid. They may even have minor deformities, or a strangeness to their speech, gait, or general appearance that sets them apart from others.

fbf83947-cc5b-4c8d-aa7a-3b0460838f1d.Text:
A voidborn character can re-roll any failed attack, {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:Characteristic}characteristic{/g}, or skill {g|Encyclopedia:Test}test{/g} with a 20% chance of success. This chance cannot be greater than the base success chance of the roll.
Additionally, any enemy dodge or parry against a voidborn character has a 20% chance to fail after a successful roll.

fee9b29f-aef7-4693-bcb3-8f4fd8954f91.Text: Any time a voidborn character scores a {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit{/g}, there is a 10% chance to double the {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}.

86d156e8-2efc-491b-a178-9c7d41822b87.Text:
Using a non-damaging {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} on an ally grants that ally the ability to re-roll any failed attack, {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g}, characteristic, or skill {g|Encyclopedia:Test}test{/g} with a 20% chance of success for 1 round. This chance cannot be greater than the base success chance of the roll.
Using a non-damaging ability on an enemy grants them a 20% chance to fail a successful dodge or parry test against any character for 1 round.

06b40c63-d53d-43fd-9dea-1c2ece9441dc.Text: The voidborn character has a 20% chance to survive after suffering lethal {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}, surviving with 1 {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wound{/g}.

3218d97d-299a-4640-acd9-3e9e90c89e85.Text:
While a voidborn character has more than 50% {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}, all chances of all creatures (including enemies) in a 3-cell radius are increased by +10%.
While a voidborn character has less than 50% wounds, all chances of all creatures (including enemies) in a 3-cell radius are decreased by −10%.

a90d048b-614f-4796-b974-7362e75f2b42.Text:
Any time an {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} or {g|Encyclopedia:Talent}talent{/g} uses the {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerFellowship}Fellowship{/g} bonus, a voidborn character can instead use the {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerIntelligence}Intelligence{/g} bonus, if it is higher.
Additionally, voidborn characters can always upgrade Intelligence even if their {g|Encyclopedia:Career}archetype{/g} does not allow it.

f5d4b112-8c1f-4848-b665-5ea72d442600.Text:
When used, for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g} the Astra Militarum commander and their allies do not suffer damage from allied attacks and deal +{uip|DamageBonus|e6a279ca5979435fbb0d39d9d60d7f8a}% more damage to enemies that were attacked by them since ability activation. If multiple Astra Militarum commanders are in combat, the effect does not stack.
! Can only be used once per combat.

2955dfef-3bd6-4f9b-9dc2-d172104dd143.Text: The Astra Militarum, commonly known as the Imperial Guard, is the primary fighting force of the Imperium and the first line of defence from the myriad threats that endanger the existence of Humanity in the 41st Millennium. You have served as one of the commanders of an Astra Militarum regiment, commanding thousands and winning battles in the name of the God-Emperor.

6eb8ed68-a538-4a4b-a8a1-5c0592ec904e.Text: While the effect of {g|f:34dad7246afb4e98ac1491bb24177463}Regimental Tactics{/g} lasts, the Astra Militarum commander's and their allies' weapon attacks gain +20% {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeReduction}dodge reduction{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:ParryReduction}parry reduction{/g}, block reduction, and {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}cover{/g} penetration against enemies that have been already been attacked by the commander's allies this combat.

df0ac38f-e0e5-423b-8d8e-7066a6c14c1a.Text: While the Astra Militarum commander is under the {g|f:34dad7246afb4e98ac1491bb24177463}Regimental Tactics{/g} effect, all their allies gain +5% to {g|Encyclopedia:RateOfFire}rate of fire{/g} for every attack they have made since the start of this effect.

2230c701-bc58-481e-9635-5130c9f61ba7.Text: Two-handed las weapons equipped by the Astra Militarum commander or their allies gain a {g|f:7ae09bd99a7f4fa8842d64fb001af19b}Bayonet Strike{/g} single {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee attack{/g} that costs 1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}. This attack deals the same damage as the las weapon and does not count towards the {g|Encyclopedia:AttacksPerTurn}attack limit per turn{/g} but can only be used once per {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.

bac8b532-8d1f-4a92-81bc-1e1c96f0f77d.Text: This attack deals the same damage as the las weapon and does not count towards the {g|Encyclopedia:AttacksPerTurn}attack limit per turn{/g} but can only be used once per {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.

3d9f7d23-a7b1-4384-b40d-5f41df7d4733.Text: Whenever the Astra Militarum commander or their ally performs a {g|Encyclopedia:HeroicAct}heroic act{/g}, all the commander's {g|Encyclopedia:Characteristic}characteristics{/g} are increased by +7 until the end of combat.

81dc24a8-4356-4b25-b2a3-29144b189aff.Text: While the Astra Militarum commander is in partial {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}cover{/g}, their las weapon's {g|Encyclopedia:RateOfFire}rate of fire{/g} is increased by +20% and by +40% while in full cover.

e3ae3c52-969f-436a-894a-8b6895c66909.Text:
While the Commissar is adjacent to an enemy, their allies gain +{uip|Resolve|d61fbaba9fe34b6697efe57f3c5e8574} {g|Encyclopedia:Resolve}resolve{/g}.
If there are no creatures in a 2-cell radius, the Commissar gains +{uip|Resolve|d61fbaba9fe34b6697efe57f3c5e8574} resolve.

29e15873-c24a-4146-85d0-6601429e6c82.Text: If an ally remains in combat after being attacked with the ability {g|f:cce96eda109f4431941cb5c240040657}At All Costs!{/g} and then kills an enemy while under the effect, they will regain 30% of the {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} lost due to {g|f:cce96eda109f4431941cb5c240040657}At All Costs!{/g} as {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g}.

11b15c73-7f0f-4896-820f-4c8661dcab9a.Text:
The Commissar shoots an allied character with the pistol equipped in their primary hand, dealing {uip|Pistol|cdbe5dd63fd84f3fb20f37e7ad043f6e}% of weapon damage. This shot ignores {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g}, and always {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hits{/g}.
If that ally is a xenos, this always scores a {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical{/g} hit.
If the ally remains in combat, they gain the {g|f:20a0af90dfed4914a26ffb92b05937e1}at all costs!{/g} effect for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.
If that ally falls {g|Encyclopedia:UnconsciousEffect}unconscious{/g}, this effect is instead applied to all the Commissar's other allies (except the Commissar themselves), and the {g|Encyclopedia:Cooldown}cooldown{/g} of this ability is reset at the start of the Commissar's next turn.

1bee3781-4cf0-46bc-bbda-5b8df68ea5b2.Text: This character deals +{uip|BonusFEL|cdbe5dd63fd84f3fb20f37e7ad043f6e}% more damage, gains +{uip|BonusFEL|cdbe5dd63fd84f3fb20f37e7ad043f6e}% {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g}, and +{uip|BonusStatCoercion|cdbe5dd63fd84f3fb20f37e7ad043f6e} to all {g|Encyclopedia:Characteristic}characteristics{/g}.

817e7325-35e5-4084-9d75-e27555b71935.Text:
The Commissar's {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} is increased by +{uip|MP|0e916a16e02e42968faa1cb730567827}. All allies, starting their turn in a 2-cell radius around the Commissar, also gain +{uip|MP|0e916a16e02e42968faa1cb730567827} MP.
Once per round, after the Commissar performs an attack with a pistol, they gain {uip|PistolMP|0e916a16e02e42968faa1cb730567827} MP. Does not stack.

12882344-7b1f-4519-b24a-ebd48107ad11.Text: Commissars of the Officio Prefectus are ruthless officers charged with maintaining the morale, discipline, and fighting spirit of their Astra Militarum regiment. You used to be one of these faithful servants of the God-Emperor, a living symbol of Imperium authority, regarded with a mix of fear and awe by their subordinates.

3e7b5952-3398-4b80-9360-ee895f2bf7dc.Text: Shots with a pistol in their primary hand deal +{uip|BSBonus2|1a1ac3e3f133432a8c5c0d19cce16035}% more damage, gain +15% {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit chance{/g}, and +{uip|FELBonus2|1a1ac3e3f133432a8c5c0d19cce16035}% {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeReduction}dodge reduction{/g}.

89aa894b-b44b-44e3-b4db-0621e6c27c64.Text: The effect of the {g|f:1a1ac3e3f133432a8c5c0d19cce16035}Iconic Sidearm{/g} is now active when a pistol is equipped in either hand.

fb3fda1c-53aa-4bbb-adea-6a55b177493d.Text: One for the Enemies, Two for the Traitors

08949fe8-09f4-4a4d-b4af-43cb1e55917b.Text: While the Commissar's ally is under the effects of {g|f:cdbe5dd63fd84f3fb20f37e7ad043f6e}At All Costs!{/g}, that ally suffers +50% {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} but gains +2 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} and +4 {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} (instead of +1 AP and +3 MP).

9a846276-688a-48b4-b72b-6b63f0883285.Text: When the Commissar uses {g|f:cce96eda109f4431941cb5c240040657}At All Costs!{/g} while shooting from behind, the bonuses granted by the effect are doubled.

1de5f70d-5ab7-4eef-bf4f-d3ef0f74ce56.Text: While the Commissar is adjacent to an enemy, all their allies gain +{uip|Resolve|d61fbaba9fe34b6697efe57f3c5e8574} {g|Encyclopedia:Resolve}resolve{/g}.

384334c0-155c-41b1-a3bc-b67eb75439cb.Text: If the crime lord uses a non-damaging {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} on an enemy, that enemy suffers a −{uip|AdditionalDamageTarget|f8fbdb667b6a4dca814aec2bb5f14097}% {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.
