b10f7a75-9341-433f-81c2-4d8905bb04d4.Text: If the crime lord moves, they gain +{uip|AdditionalDodge|f8fbdb667b6a4dca814aec2bb5f14097}% {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g} until the start of their next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}.

444f44f9-6270-4e37-ab8a-0d1b19902a60.Text:
At the start of combat, the crime lord gains +{unit_stat|WarhammerIntelligence|bonus} stacks of the sure-fire plan effect. Activation of this {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} consumes 1 stack and makes the next action stronger depending on the type of action:
-<indent=5%>If the crime lord attacks, they deal +{uip|AdditionalDamage|f8fbdb667b6a4dca814aec2bb5f14097}% more {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}.</indent>
-<indent=5%>If the crime lord moves, they gain +{uip|AdditionalDodge|f8fbdb667b6a4dca814aec2bb5f14097}% {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g} until the start of their next turn.</indent>
-<indent=5%>If the crime lord uses a non-damaging ability on an enemy, that enemy suffers a −{uip|AdditionalDamageTarget|f8fbdb667b6a4dca814aec2bb5f14097}% penalty to damage for one round.</indent>
Can be used multiple times per turn.

ec7eecc4-0dd9-42b3-b0ce-a94e44f64574.Text: The Imperium survives and prospers in no small part due to the narrowness of its vision, but a rebellious mind and will such as yours could not be so easily constrained. The dark paths of smugglers and renegades that wind behind the facade of the Imperium's society offer a dangerous refuge for those unwilling to bow to the law. You used to be one of these dangerous yet resourceful individuals.

185ef885-5fd4-4cdb-a8d8-0f7529843e9b.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} of sure-fire plan is increased by +{uip|DamageBonus|d29bd0cb21184342a09e7b928eaac0dc}%. Killing at least one enemy with the attack restores 1 stack of sure-fire plan.

971cdb14-a027-415d-8f15-666bd6b14b68.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g} from sure-fire plan is increased by +{uip|AdditionalDodge|1badb7fcaefb458a947f78ead3795587}% . Dodging or parrying at least one attack by the start of the next {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g} restores 1 stack of sure-fire plan.

6a93bc3c-bc9c-4533-971a-126c87fe55b2.Text: An enemy affected by sure-fire plan also suffers a −{uip|DodgeParryReduction|885ee31fc7ac49b9b75abd270004635d}% {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g}.

f83d8c0e-39ef-4b6d-ba1f-cb61fac0b4a6.Text: At the start of their {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, if the crime lord has no stacks of sure-fire plan, they gain +1 stack.

5c64add2-1740-4827-b2b0-745d93d024b1.Text: Once per combat, if the crime lord has at least 1 stack of sure-fire plan, they do not die from lethal {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}. Instead, they heal <u>(5 × sure-fire plan stacks)</u>% of {g|Encyclopedia:MaxWounds}maximum wounds{/g}, lose all stacks, and can no longer gain sure-fire plan stacks.

d7972892-925a-4614-937c-5f5a33eb6e41.Text: The creature deals +2% more {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} for each stack of the bloodblessed effect.

87535b81-b60a-4e9a-8236-45fc8f963962.Text: The creature suffers +2% more {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} for each stack of the bloodstained effect.

d01b5b20-0264-41a9-90f2-0db8cea29eca.Text: Each time the {g|f:9b090810169e4a42b22afd5995d3720d}Death Cult assassin{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parries{/g} or {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodges{/g} an attack, all enemies with the {g|f:4fe436747a7849759de6b83cdc774b7e}bloodstained{/g} effect suffer +1 stack of this effect.

893de6a2-fe36-45fd-b9df-ddc1b65267ee.Text:
The {g|f:9b090810169e4a42b22afd5995d3720d}Death Cult assassin{/g}'s next single-target {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee attack{/g} splashes blood in a 5-cell cone behind the target. The {g|f:9b090810169e4a42b22afd5995d3720d}Death Cult assassin{/g} and allies in the affected area gain the {g|f:437c7a78578c4bbeab1e85ea4a76df7d}bloodblessed{/g} effect. Every enemy in this area, including the initial target, suffers the {g|f:4fe436747a7849759de6b83cdc774b7e}bloodstained{/g} effect. Both effects last for 2 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rounds{/g}. Additionally, all the cells in the affected area are now covered in blood for 2 rounds. Whenever a creature interacts with such a cell (moves there or stands there at the moment when the effect is applied), it receives an additional +1 stack of the {g|f:437c7a78578c4bbeab1e85ea4a76df7d}bloodblessed{/g} or {g|f:4fe436747a7849759de6b83cdc774b7e}bloodstained{/g} effect accordingly.
Additionally, for every 10 {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} the {g|f:9b090810169e4a42b22afd5995d3720d}Death Cult assassin{/g} loses throughout the entire combat, each creature affected by {g|f:437c7a78578c4bbeab1e85ea4a76df7d}bloodblessed{/g} or {g|f:4fe436747a7849759de6b83cdc774b7e}bloodstained{/g} gains +1 stack of the corresponding effect.

cc603ecb-4084-42fa-8ca2-11a2f0a848b1.Text: A creature with the {g|f:437c7a78578c4bbeab1e85ea4a76df7d}bloodblessed{/g} or {g|f:4fe436747a7849759de6b83cdc774b7e}bloodstained{/g} effect gains +1 stack of this effect each time it suffers {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} from {g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}bleeding{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:BurningEffect}burning{/g}, or {g|Encyclopedia:ToxinEffect}toxin{/g}.

51fbfd91-9f36-4f04-9e77-a3ec6b6fb872.Text: The {g|f:9b090810169e4a42b22afd5995d3720d}Death Cult assassin{/g}'s allies deal +<u>(2 + {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}AGI{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g})</u>% more {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} to enemies if both the ally and their target stand on the blood-covered cells.

1cc0889b-b832-4efa-949a-4f048c944818.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerAssassinGlossary}assassins{/g} of the death cult that has formed in the depths of the von Valancius flagship are sworn to their duty of serving the Undying Emperor. Their movements in combat are akin to a dance with death, the blades in their hands are weapons of faith, the act of killing is their sacred mission, and the blood they spill and draw becomes a ritual offering to Him.

9b93516a-d60b-4333-ad29-216595305762.Text: A creature with the {g|f:437c7a78578c4bbeab1e85ea4a76df7d}bloodblessed{/g} or {g|f:4fe436747a7849759de6b83cdc774b7e}bloodstained{/g} effect gains +1 stack of this effect whenever {g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}bleeding{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:BurningEffect}burning{/g}, or {g|Encyclopedia:ToxinEffect}toxin{/g} is inflicted on it.

c515af01-3f13-4442-a4b0-5bc9dcea1eae.Text: A creature with the {g|f:437c7a78578c4bbeab1e85ea4a76df7d}bloodblessed{/g} or {g|f:4fe436747a7849759de6b83cdc774b7e}bloodstained{/g} effect gains +1 stack of this effect whenever {g|f:e299c13f2278479bbd4e23269af5657c}Raining Blood{/g} is inflicted again or whenever it starts its {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} on a blood-covered cell.

af9df8a6-561f-471f-8c9a-927e5988e33f.Text: A psyker who has not undergone the sanctioning rituals designed to protect the psyker's soul from the machinations of the warp, yet still possesses an unfettered sorcerous gift.

359ad1f1-ebe3-44a8-9ee8-613e0cd14d6a.Text: While Jae is fighting with weapons in both hands, the attack from the second hand (depending on which hand she attacked with first in the {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}) does not cost any additional {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}.

41151b8e-5769-4d23-9452-b881221516fc.Text: Jae can use either {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerFellowship}Fellowship{/g} or {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerIntelligence}Intelligence{/g} for Intelligence-based {g|Encyclopedia:Skills}skills{/g}, whichever is higher. Additionally, Jae can re-roll failed {g|Encyclopedia:SkillCommerce}Commerce{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Test}tests{/g} (+1 attempt for each test).

63ad8465-a996-47dc-8629-c562330b6761.Text: The Rogue Trader's {g|Encyclopedia:Reputation}reputation{/g} level grants Jae additional {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonuses{/g}: -Drusians: +(reputation level) to all {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance tests{/g} and +(2 × reputation level) to {g|Encyclopedia:SkillLoreImperium}Lore (Imperium){/g}. -Explorators: +(reputation level)% to {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} and +(2 × reputation level) to {g|Encyclopedia:SkillTechUse}Tech-Use{/g}. -Kasballica Mission: +(reputation level)% to {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g} and +(2 × reputation level) to {g|Encyclopedia:SkillCommerce}Commerce{/g}. -Fellowship of the Void: +(reputation level)% to {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit{/g} chance and +(2 × reputation level) to {g|Encyclopedia:SkillCoercion}Coercion{/g}. -The Imperial Navy: +(reputation level)% to {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}cover efficiency{/g} and +(2 × reputation level) to {g|Encyclopedia:SkillPersuasion}Persuasion{/g}.

a73ff572-f0ed-44b3-94dc-73947e1abd58.Text: A Dracon is a commander within the hierarchy of a Drukhari Kabal who leads the most audacious raids into realspace. Those who rise to this status are known for their remarkable combat {g|Encyclopedia:Talent}talents{/g} and are cruel and cunning enough to keep both their position and their life.

3540d25f-e872-4ffd-a81f-252aed545f98.Text:
Grants +{uip|Momentum|85e6ce25a6d64313b9ff39a8013d1b43} {g|Encyclopedia:MomentumWithDetailsGlossary}momentum{/g}. Then, the sister of the Adepta Sororitas gains +{unit_stat|WarhammerWillpower|bonus} stacks of {g|f:eeecc5cab7b846e8b1478ecfa15ce9bc}zeal{/g}.
Does not provoke {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g}.
! Can only be used once per combat.

8c1a284e-87ed-45a1-a131-a28942db2cee.Text: The Ecclesiarchy, known formally as the Adeptus Ministorum, is a vast institution that oversees the galaxy-spanning religion of the Imperium. The Ecclesiarchy's complex hierarchies of cardinals, missionaries, preachers, and zealous laity ensure the prescribed prayers and invocations are made, all the while instructing the masses to guard against heresy and deviancy. You used to be one of those fiery and charismatic individuals concerned with keeping a close watch on your congregation.

bc40c46c-872c-4d52-83e2-705fea7f87b3.Text:
In combat, the Ministorum Priest gains +{uip|StatBonus|171462027afe4bc6be83799f44fa9995} {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g}.
At the start of combat, they gain {unit_stat|WarhammerWillpower|bonus} stacks of {g|f:eeecc5cab7b846e8b1478ecfa15ce9bc}zeal{/g}. They gain +1 stack of {g|f:eeecc5cab7b846e8b1478ecfa15ce9bc}zeal{/g} for each enemy they attack with a bolter, a flamer, or a chain, melta, or power weapon for the first time in combat. They gain +2 stacks of {g|f:eeecc5cab7b846e8b1478ecfa15ce9bc}zeal{/g} for each daemon or xenos killed in combat by any source.

45bfd3ce-6b3b-48e7-a6dd-965c3d900391.Text: A specific parameter that enhances the abilities of Ministorum Priests and sisters of the Adepta Sororitas.

0870c1c3-4b05-40e4-8557-1825e9d77d8d.Text: This creature has already been attacked by the Ministorum Priest. If the Priest attacks it again, they will gain no {g|f:eeecc5cab7b846e8b1478ecfa15ce9bc}zeal{/g}.

5d34d17e-e3b4-48fc-86d9-cedac61d5585.Text: Whenever the character uses {g|f:c647c1c4a1a14c9cb31217ee439164ff}War Hymn{/g} or {g|f:85e6ce25a6d64313b9ff39a8013d1b43}Furious Recital{/g}, each daemon and xenos in a 5-cell radius suffers {uip|Damage|94b7a24311684783b34e0c53c41c58cf} {g|Encyclopedia:DirectDamage}direct damage{/g} and +1 stack of {g|Encyclopedia:PerplexedEffect}perplexed{/g}.

a92cafbe-79a5-4068-94ab-c6849e9ed9db.Text: Whenever the Ministorum Priest uses {g|f:c647c1c4a1a14c9cb31217ee439164ff}War Hymn{/g} or {g|f:85e6ce25a6d64313b9ff39a8013d1b43}Furious Recital{/g}, for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}, the Priest themselves and their allies in a 5-cell radius deal +{uip|DamageBonus|10a6dc3267d14009a0e302927bb7fcfe} more weapon damage. This bonus is doubled against daemons, psykers, and xenos.

0e930f3f-da5b-4f0c-a185-216fafae90d8.Text:
The Ministorum Priest deals +{uip|Value_1|c5acfe1f0e02491cb86047de9b200e48} more damage and +{unit_stat|WarhammerWillpower|bonus}% more {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical damage{/g} with bolt weapons. Base melta weapon and flamer damage is increased by +{unit_stat|WarhammerWillpower|bonus}%.
Those bonuses are doubled against daemons, psykers, and xenos.

d98d171e-68be-4bcc-93f4-70a4c3ad80d4.Text:
The Ministorum Priest gains +{unit_stat|WarhammerWillpower|bonus}% {g|Encyclopedia:ArmourPenetration}armour penetration{/g} with chain and power weapons. {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}Critical hits{/g} scored with such weapons inflict {uip|Value_2|825a60180393428a96e4008a0579afe7} levels of {g|Encyclopedia:BurningEffect}burning{/g}.
Those bonuses are doubled against daemons, psykers, and xenos.

f9436260-f433-4b3d-a96b-0d5e34aa0959.Text: The Ministorum Priest's {g|Encyclopedia:MaxWounds}maximum wounds{/g} are increased by +{unit_stat|WarhammerWillpower|bonus}.

3da2e659-1833-4b84-9b6e-44b4f0946675.Text:
Grants +{uip|Momentum|c647c1c4a1a14c9cb31217ee439164ff} {g|Encyclopedia:MomentumWithDetailsGlossary}momentum{/g}. Then, the Ministorum Priest gains +{unit_stat|WarhammerWillpower|bonus} stacks of {g|f:eeecc5cab7b846e8b1478ecfa15ce9bc}zeal{/g}.
Does not provoke {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g}.
! Can only be used once per combat.

1fe56732-2212-4455-8846-09830c140ad6.Text: Enemies in a 5-cell radius around the Navy Officer (while the {g|f:b9f9ef145708451f81283a73c16c527d}braced{/g} effect lasts) suffer −{uip|Debuff|8379931fea56440192a660288fada89a} {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}Weapon Skill{/g} and −{uip|Debuff|8379931fea56440192a660288fada89a} {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerBallisticSkill}Ballistic Skill{/g}.

1cd01bed-9140-4654-ae4d-862bddb889fc.Text: <u>(10 × number of {g|Encyclopedia:Career}archetypes{/g} chosen by the Navy Officer)</u>

95256ff0-b6df-4be2-9e86-d978bde7abf2.Text: All allies affected by {g|f:f0d6fd0433624181a3a6c9bb6fd60ab5}Brace for Impact!{/g} do not suffer the {g|Encyclopedia:NegativeEffectTypesGlossary}negative effects{/g} of {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeSuperiority}melee superiority{/g} for the entire combat.

7a281f56-5f79-427d-9ce1-a70066dab7bc.Text:
Allies with the {g|f:b9f9ef145708451f81283a73c16c527d}braced{/g} effect or affected by the Navy Officer's other non-attacking archetype abilities gain +{uip|dodge bonus|971073f6852045ca832e54ddc2e19ed4}% {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}. Does not stack.
The Navy Officer and their allies with the {g|f:b9f9ef145708451f81283a73c16c527d}braced{/g} effect do not provoke {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g}.

5d392473-6257-429d-a67a-75eebb926c38.Text: When the Navy Officer scores a {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit{/g} or successfully {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parries{/g} an attack with their primary melee weapon, they immediately make an attack (whichever costs the least {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}) with their secondary weapon against the same enemy.

dfb6c0fb-aa1d-467e-a51b-2b0076d51230.Text: All allies affected by {g|f:f0d6fd0433624181a3a6c9bb6fd60ab5}Brace for Impact!{/g} gain an {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}extra turn{/g} with 0 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} and 3 {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} and increase their {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}cover efficiency{/g} by +20% for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}. Targets can only use movement {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}abilities{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:HeroicAct}heroic acts{/g}, or {g|Encyclopedia:DesperateMeasure}desperate measures{/g} during this extra {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}.

960c02ff-6699-4c47-9717-d4e3b8f166bb.Text: The Navy Officer {g|Encyclopedia:PushGlossary}pushes{/g} enemies in a 2-cell radius away 2 cells.

2568475b-e8fd-4464-85df-2cd03430a82a.Text: While the {g|f:b9f9ef145708451f81283a73c16c527d}braced{/g} effect lasts, the Navy Officer can use the {g|f:282940ecb99948a28adc9cb60374223b}Get off me!{/g} ability once per {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}, and the targets of their {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee attacks{/g} must pass an {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a −10 penalty or fall {g|Encyclopedia:ProneEffect}prone{/g}.

faab2147-331f-4a1a-9991-1b1c93ae4ebe.Text: The Navy Officer grants the {g|f:b9f9ef145708451f81283a73c16c527d}braced{/g} effect to each ally (including themselves) in a 5-cell radius. The effect lasts for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}. The Navy Officer gains +1 charge of this ability at the start of combat, when their {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} drop below 50% for the first time in combat, and each time an ally falls unconscious for the first time in combat.

c24b863d-e6ae-4f3b-865b-859a195ef2fa.Text: Each charge allows the character to use {g|f:f0d6fd0433624181a3a6c9bb6fd60ab5}Brace for Impact!{/g}

3a966c68-27a2-4079-9706-af258acd30b2.Text: The character gains +2 {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g} for each {g|Encyclopedia:Career}archetype{/g} chosen by the Navy Officer. Also, the character gains immunity to forced movement effects and cannot be {g|Encyclopedia:OverpenetrationFullGlossary}overpenetrated{/g}.

9ce89208-3b86-4b04-b274-6d2fcd874d21.Text: The Imperial Navy is responsible for the fleets of voidships that assert the dominance of the Imperium amid the stars and fulfil other duties connected to the void and warp travel. You used to be a Navy officer and a commander of a voidship, hardened in numerous battles and famous for resounding victories.

f6767fcc-5d87-44df-bc97-7a23a2b1626c.Text: All allies affected by {g|f:f0d6fd0433624181a3a6c9bb6fd60ab5}Brace for Impact!{/g} suffer only half {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} from all {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g}.

5bba490a-4994-474c-ad7c-9fb421feb7a4.Text:
The noble assigns one ally who will become their servant until the end of combat.
Any time the noble's {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}abilities{/g} affect the servant, the servant gains +5 to all {g|Encyclopedia:Characteristic}characteristics{/g} until the start of the noble's next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}.
Any time the servant attacks a target that the noble dealt {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} to last turn, the servant gains +<u>(10 + noble's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerFellowship}FEL{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g})</u>% {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit{/g} chance against that target.{br}
! Can only be used once per combat.

f7936f2f-6c10-48e5-b329-83a69af08013.Text:
The noble assigns one ally who will become their servant until the end of combat.
Any time the noble's {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}abilities{/g} affect the servant, the servant gains +5 to all {g|Encyclopedia:Characteristic}characteristics{/g} until the start of the noble's next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}.
Any time the servant attacks a target that the noble dealt {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} to last turn, the servant gains +{uip|CriticalChance|b826d0a5600e44f7b6272750584bfca0}% {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit{/g} chance against that target.
! Can only be used once per combat.

b9c8e253-df42-43f4-b891-5ca519101182.Text: The high nobility of the Imperium are an enormously privileged and powerful elite, a breed apart from the common masses they rule. You grew into adulthood upon a pedestal of affluence and grandeur that towered high above the common masses. You expected their obedience and lived upon the fruits of their toil surrendered to your family in solemn fealty.

dc59264d-945e-4661-ac08-2cb795398a68.Text: If a noble uses an {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} on their servant, the servant gains +1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}. Does not stack with itself.

d49b570c-9588-42a7-9fb1-ebf1b131a23e.Text: If the noble and the servant are adjacent to each other at the start of the noble's {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, they both gain {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g} equal to <u>servant's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}TGH{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g}</u> or <u>noble's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerFellowship}FEL{/g} bonus</u> depending on which is higher.

26a33ec3-7dc6-4e34-b443-55604868c776.Text: The noble's servant gains +2 {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}movement points{/g} every {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}.

d30319fd-8c37-42c6-8733-3bfd8e129f2e.Text: If the servant kills the target that the noble dealt {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} to last {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, the noble gains +1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} next turn.

12b42d14-b363-4f53-92c7-c7eeeb8a7697.Text:
If the servant has less than 30% {g|Encyclopedia:MaxWounds}maximum wounds{/g}, the noble can use {g|f:bf82c37259cf4552b37e8dc03c44552d}You. Serve Me.{/g} once more in battle, designating a new servant and removing the effect from the previous one.
The noble cannot designate a character who already was their servant this combat.

f620f017-c092-445a-aac7-e183d0c692c1.Text: A member of the Adeptus Mechanicus and follower of the Machine Cult. Tech-Priests are initiated in the secrets of maintaining the most sacred and advanced technologies of the Imperium, which makes their contribution to Humanity's survival irreplaceable.

bd4b0d85-d5c4-4e14-a4fd-bd5a859a8c17.Text: Pasqal gains {unit_stat|WarhammerIntelligence|bonus} {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} in the first {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g} of combat. Every successful {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee attack{/g} grants Pasqal +{uip|MovementPoints|936867432ffa496786eef7e36336746e} MP for the next round.

beb75f20-93e3-4aa9-a180-4009133da0fb.Text: Pasqal gains +{uip|BallisticSkillBonus|e6fe1cf5410642be85f0ea27ef38c801} to {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerBallisticSkill}Ballistic Skill{/g} and +{uip|DodgeReduction|e6fe1cf5410642be85f0ea27ef38c801}% to {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeReduction}dodge reduction{/g} with plasma and melta weapon {g|Encyclopedia:RangeAreaAttacksGlossary}ranged attacks{/g}.

b2047405-6974-47c3-a714-333cc5ad844b.Text: Pasqal's {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee attacks{/g} apply the {g|f:95cdd5f42ef5480d9fadd9e0acee641b}machine spirit communion{/g} effect on all attacked enemies.

8637f5df-70cd-4f9b-a241-076c1e6c0f44.Text: Reduces the {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} dealt from the target's attacks by −{uip|DamageReduction|0b8058ef3f33406faebea94ee7967d66}% for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}. Targets with the {g|f:ed0acc1731834a89bda8cc52ec769e3d}Reject the Flesh{/g} feature suffer {uip|Damage|0b8058ef3f33406faebea94ee7967d66} {g|Encyclopedia:ShockDamage}shock damage{/g}. If the target is a mechanism or a machine, it suffers {uip|IncreasedDamage|0b8058ef3f33406faebea94ee7967d66} shock damage instead, and its {g|Encyclopedia:Characteristic}characteristics{/g} are reduced by −{uip|StatReduction|0b8058ef3f33406faebea94ee7967d66} until the end of combat.

c9f9e7df-7a09-4005-b08b-f7d741d04568.Text: Pasqal's attacks and effects of the {g|f:197b8a8a12b0442db7ffee1067cf3d97}Expose Weakness{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} gain {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonuses{/g} against enemies under the effects of {g|f:95cdd5f42ef5480d9fadd9e0acee641b}machine spirit communion{/g}, as if those enemies had 2 more stacks of {g|Encyclopedia:Exploit}exploit{/g}.

89acdfa0-1639-4f20-9b8d-1d1d6577e8d3.Text: When Pasqal uses plasma or melta weapons the first time in a {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}, he gains +1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}.

9addadd3-da9b-45a1-bf4b-b82a51211347.Text: {g|f:95cdd5f42ef5480d9fadd9e0acee641b}Machine Spirit Communion{/g} applies 1 stack of {g|Encyclopedia:Exploit}exploit{/g} on all affected enemies.

5069cbcc-181d-4f00-8bb5-54d74a5cae86.Text:
Every time Pasqal uses plasma or melta weapons, his {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} with these weapons increases by +{uip|DamageBonus|be49079e9e4c4f2aa84d04d8440e1859}%. Stacks.
If Pasqal does not shoot for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}, he loses all stacks.

d1ba3917-7ea9-4cca-ad70-01dedd0868b7.Text:
Pasqal gains +{uip|DodgeParryReduction|ef6a2442104a4768b0ef26c8a66b1201}% to {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeReduction}dodge reduction{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:ParryReduction}parry reduction{/g} with {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee{/g} weapons.
If an enemy {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodges{/g} or {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parries{/g} his attack, the {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} is doubled for the next melee attack against this enemy.

92d07a61-2410-414f-bce7-17190451edb9.Text: While Pasqal is under the effects of {g|f:95cdd5f42ef5480d9fadd9e0acee641b}machine spirit communion{/g}, his {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee attacks{/g} deal an additional +{uip|DamageBonus|5701e2340b9249f48bb57f51b6ad4848}% {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} and gain +{uip|PenetrationBonus|5701e2340b9249f48bb57f51b6ad4848}% {g|Encyclopedia:ArmourPenetration}armour penetration{/g}.

0eb0c7d6-6358-4856-a97f-bf9edbf9f6b1.Text: Pasqal's arc rifle shots gain +{uip|Dodgepen|bff347d4633745d0a29a7632b92aaf1b}% {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeReduction}dodge reduction{/g} against primary and secondary targets.

125c900b-fdd3-4e9d-a741-871224d67431.Text: The psyker gains the Inscribed Soul {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g}. It costs no {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} but deals {g|Encyclopedia:DirectDamage}direct damage{/g} to the psyker equal to 25% of the psyker's {g|Encyclopedia:MaxWounds}maximum wounds{/g}. The next {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} used after this ability will not trigger {g|Encyclopedia:PsychicPhenomena}psychic phenomena{/g} or {g|Encyclopedia:PerilsOfWarp}perils of the warp{/g} and will not degrade the {g|Encyclopedia:VeilThickness}veil{/g}.

1a584196-795f-47a5-a840-f6f9f2dd15ed.Text: The psyker suffers −<u>(5 × {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}psy rating{/g})</u>% less {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} from {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic powers{/g} and becomes immune to the {g|Encyclopedia:CommonStatusesGlossary}effects{/g} of {g|Encyclopedia:PerilsOfWarp}perils of the warp{/g} triggered by other psykers.

bc96edb5-790b-4340-a028-b9ebda4e6c83.Text: {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}Psychic powers{/g} have a 25% chance to regain {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} spent on psychic powers when {g|Encyclopedia:VeilThickness}veil degradation{/g} is 10 or lower.

0ff79df8-7380-4971-b4c1-d004a3b84c56.Text: The psyker gains a +<u>(3 × {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}psy rating{/g})</u> {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to all {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance tests{/g} and can use {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic powers{/g} while {g|Encyclopedia:Stun}stunned{/g} or being unable to act in any another way.

2aa3ae3a-ef2c-44eb-a0f8-b5f45c04374d.Text: The psyker gains +5 {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} while under the {g|Encyclopedia:CommonStatusesGlossary}effect{/g} of any allied {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g}, navigator power, or {g|Encyclopedia:Career}doctrine{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g}. This {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} increases by +2 for every other such ability affecting the psyker. If the bonus to Willpower from this {g|Encyclopedia:Talent}talent{/g} is higher than 15, this talent also grants a +1 bonus to {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}psy rating{/g}.

0930c0f8-8add-4c4e-a4f8-e7fbc281ab74.Text: The psyker's {g|Encyclopedia:Resolve}resolve{/g} is increased by +{uip|ResolveBonus|5f569e5e1dbe4271aa3b22f3cbf69e8c} while {g|Encyclopedia:VeilThickness}veil degradation{/g} is 10 or lower.

4b8653d9-102a-46bf-8268-0488ac5f6500.Text: Note: damaging psyker powers count as weapon attacks, counting toward the normal attack limit per {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} and gaining all the benefits of {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}abilities{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Talent}talents{/g} increasing the {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} of attacks. For example, a Soldier using the {g|f:7a76af1ef02c4699b62db147e2b9a172}Run and Gun{/g} ability will be able to use damaging psyker powers twice per turn, and an Operative's {g|f:502b9195c84c42c5b180f3f63ed7955c}Analyse Enemies{/g} ability affects the damage of damaging psyker powers.

18e9dd77-f3bb-4383-baf7-201d4f8bef0e.Text: Psykers are feared and distrusted but are nonetheless valuable assets to the Imperium. The role of the Adeptus Astra Telepathica is to recruit, identify, and classify those found to possess psychic abilities. The most powerful who somehow survive the rigorous sanctioning rituals are selected to serve on the battlefield. The mind of a sanctioned psyker is steeled against the manifold dangers risked by wielders of warp powers. You were one of those found worthy to serve Humanity and have miraculously survived the perils of the warp.

e80aed46-98da-4050-a2d7-493c836869af.Text: Biomancers specialise in manipulating biological energy and processes with the power of their minds. They are masters of the flesh, learning to shape and influence their own physical forms according to their will, as well as those of their allies and enemies.

bbad9e8f-2b30-449d-8fc2-3510affb4fba.Text: Diviners seek to discern the hidden past of the galaxy and know the course of events yet to come. These abilities allow diviners to look into the twisting strands of the Immaterium in search of the answers they seek and sometimes even influence the outcome of fate itself.

76cc2ce3-f6e7-48ea-80ff-b8b083f5eb46.Text: Pyromancers specialise in producing and manipulating flames to maim their enemies and burn them to ash.

b52598f9-e2ca-4b93-a477-ef895fb8a4eb.Text: Psykers of the sanctic discipline master their connection to the Golden Throne to support their allies with holy might and stave off daemons and heretics.

589042f7-18cb-4551-a436-ecf7228caaf4.Text: Telepaths use their {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic powers{/g} in conjunction with their own minds to delude, control, and destroy the minds of their enemies.

76af0dfb-c70a-4022-82cd-c42b88d7d195.Text:
Ulfar unleashes the instincts of the Wulfen, succumbing to a morose anger.
Ulfar reduces his {g|Encyclopedia:Resolve}resolve{/g} to 0 for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g} but gains +20 {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerStrength}Strength{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}Weapon Skill{/g} instead.
Every time he deals any {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} to an enemy this round, all enemies must pass a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} or suffer +4% to {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit{/g} chance and +8% critical damage against incoming attacks until the end of combat.{br}
! Can only be used once per combat.

acbc0c11-b6df-4965-8a14-f6091044c44b.Text:
Space Marines' {g|Encyclopedia:MaxWounds}maximum wounds{/g} are increased by their {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g}.
Additionally, their bodies are considered {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}full cover{/g} during enemy {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turns{/g} until they die or fall {g|Encyclopedia:UnconsciousEffect}unconscious{/g}.

f28d1188-9d36-48d2-ba01-693cfb18b30e.Text:
The Space Marine immediately moves next to the target, ignoring {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g}, and performs a single {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee attack{/g} with +<u>(10 + 2 × {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerStrength}STR{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g})</u>% {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical damage{/g}.
If there are enemies between the Space Marine and the target, the Space Marine charges through them, forcing the enemies to pass a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a −<u>(3 × TGH bonus)</u> {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} or fall {g|Encyclopedia:ProneEffect}prone{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}, if possible.

b4db21cc-a578-47fa-b1df-7e099a05702d.Text: [draft] The psyker knows beforehand which {g|Encyclopedia:PerilsOfWarp}perils of the warp{/g} will be triggered by using a {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} and whether they will be triggered at all.

0b512609-a34e-4e88-b351-b20a7ff3f373.Text: After triggering {g|Encyclopedia:PsychicPhenomena}psychic phenomena{/g} or {g|Encyclopedia:PerilsOfWarp}perils of the warp{/g} first time each {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, the psyker's next {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} costs −1 less {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}action point{/g}.

ce2ec0ad-881f-49e9-bb42-9d5de321f3e4.Text: [draft] First time the psyker uses a combat stimulant in combat, the psyker's {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}psy rating{/g} increases by +1 until the end of combat.

4e5edb3e-443c-4cec-8396-d870a18183e6.Text: Every {g|Encyclopedia:PerilsOfWarp}perils of the warp{/g} increases {g|Encyclopedia:MomentumWithDetailsGlossary}momentum{/g} by +{uip|Momentum|6f138a487f0140ee94c171547f982b68}.

60213b00-78a4-473b-b9a0-901042d5d4be.Text: [draft] Enemies that suffer a {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit{/g} from an attacking {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} from the psyker must pass a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} or become {g|Encyclopedia:BlindedEffect}blinded{/g} until the start of the psyker's next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}.

ffe6da7d-eca6-4504-b926-7d983614a9ed.Text: The first time in combat that an ally becomes the target of the psyker's {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g}, this ally gains +10 to {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}Weapon Skill{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerBallisticSkill}Ballistic Skill{/g} until the end of combat.

729ec4e5-4b33-4470-a1bb-a2f74a494611.Text: A Child of Asuryan who has chosen the Path of the Outcast and willingly left their craftworld to wander and explore the cosmos. Outcasts are masters of survival and skilled sharpshooters who prefer to destroy their prey from afar.

26f328b2-fb93-408c-a6f3-fa27406a9289.Text: Cannot use weapons. The effect will be removed at the end of combat. If gained outside of combat, visit the voidship to remove.

d6e31033-13e6-4337-a522-353b766b986f.Text: Cannot use {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic powers{/g}. The effect will be removed at the end of combat. If gained outside of combat, visit the voidship to remove.

ead66c2f-f41e-457d-a630-a61bb35e5711.Text: Cannot act and suffers a −30% {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g}.

9a45724c-644a-4060-b1ba-8f56c2c2227b.Text: Suffers a −30 {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerBallisticSkill}Ballistic Skill{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}Weapon Skill{/g} and a −30% penalty to {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g}. The effect will be removed at the end of combat. If gained outside of combat, visit the voidship to remove.

3c517ee3-ce22-4227-bac8-58b00ce9d99a.Text: {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}Psy rating{/g} is reduced by −1. The effect will be removed at the end of combat. If gained outside of combat, visit the voidship to remove it.

98e4f8df-2058-483a-b2d2-5aa90b0cb0fe.Text: Each stack inflicts a −10 {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerFellowship}Fellowship{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g}. The effect will be removed at the end of combat. If gained outside of combat, visit the voidship to remove.

30f7f7b9-7646-45ea-b3a5-00f2316b137e.Text: Each stack inflicts a −10 {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerStrength}Strength{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g}, and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} and reduces {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} by −1. The effect will be removed at the end of combat. If gained outside of combat, visit the voidship to remove.

0a8b3d6f-3d77-4ec0-99e7-39ce3ce95a1d.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerIntelligence}Intelligence{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerPerception}Perception{/g}, and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerFellowship}Fellowship{/g} of this character are decreased by −10, and {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}psy rating{/g} is decreased by −1.

2839d27d-eb65-46c3-8a8e-f75afbf8af94.Text: Each stack inflicts a −10 {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerBallisticSkill}Ballistic Skill{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}Weapon Skill{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerIntelligence}Intelligence{/g}, and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerPerception}Perception{/g}. The effect will be removed at the end of combat. If gained outside of combat, visit the voidship to remove.

c95afb71-ecee-43ac-9bd0-bf3c7dd2c115.Text: {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}Movement points{/g} are reduced by −3. The effect will be removed at the end of combat. If gained outside of combat, visit the voidship to remove.

44bcb993-cbf5-4a36-8c1e-ecad7d5f3297.Text: Suffers a −20 {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}Weapon Skill{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerBallisticSkill}Ballistic Skill{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerStrength}Strength{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g}, and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g}. The effect will be removed at the end of combat. If gained outside of combat, visit the voidship to remove.

af428f79-89f7-4eff-be9c-3171dc234a2a.Text: The character gains +5 to all characteristics.

4e15d77e-e568-4e75-94f0-8f615cf3cfef.Text: This character deals +<u>resolve</u>% more critical damage.

4f747690-ea5b-49ea-b1c7-d5225df078bc.Text: The first use of a heroic act or a desperate measure grants each party member the {g|f:2f93d13e3d734f1982a8424c22c372ef}welfare and prosperity{/g} or {g|f:8e9345fed2dd42d3b22665d2cfab5f85}resolute judgement{/g} effect, respectively. The effect is triggered once per combat and lasts until the end of combat. If one of the effects is triggered, the other becomes unavailable.

ece84440-e676-4597-a45b-a5d6a7ffebf3.Text: This character gains +<u>(3 × resolve)</u> temporary wounds.

aea47eea-e265-4130-b2bd-fef11a56a92e.Text: The character's AP is reduced by −1. At the start of their turn, the character suffers a moderate amount of mental damage. If this character passes a Willpower resistance test with a −10 penalty, that damage will be reduced.

a4dcfc73-b5a7-4d5c-a8fa-95050a1ef56d.Text: Each stack of this effect reduces all characteristics by −5 and increases the critical hit chance of incoming attacks by +5%. Stacks up to 5 times. Additionally, at the start of this character's turn, they have a 1% chance of becoming {g|Encyclopedia:ImmobilisedEffect}immobilised{/g} for 1 round.

7a98559f-a2d2-46ed-a13b-d6c9fc6f5a81.Text: Resolve is increased by +1 for each stack of this effect. Stacks up to 10 times.

7406d391-0474-44e6-bd3d-ba856151c019.Text: Kibellah's Weapon Skill, Perception, and Fellowship are reduced by −15 for each stack.

99610ba3-67b6-4983-81c0-38e3536f7e88.Text: Kibellah can re-roll a single attack or a dodge or parry when hit by an attack. Warp or mental damage dealt to her is reduced by −50%. She suffers +1 stack of {g|f:f823a8e976eb4a2caaf1ca375f173fe5}detachment{/g} for each ally in a 2-cell radius.

527618c5-f507-47f7-bc6b-e71f1d2a0025.Text: Kibellah's next successful attack will score a critical hit.

262004a7-4d5a-45ff-96e9-41acd3eb6ba5.Text: Whenever Kibellah kills an enemy, she automatically applies the effect of {g|f:3a4eebf212974ba68d6867981c240b1b}blood phial{/g} in a 1-cell radius around that enemy, and her allies with the {g|f:437c7a78578c4bbeab1e85ea4a76df7d}bloodblessed{/g} effect receive +1 stack of {g|f:bd0b478bdb014d4c9d5b6af8ac877283}disturbed{/g} for 1 round. Kibellah's next successful attack will score a critical hit.

4fa0b250-b9b2-44bc-9d7b-a304d93e8304.Text: All characteristics except Weapon Skill are reduced by −10.

1640d11b-50d7-4686-9e2a-bef8c1445cde.Text:
Kibellah deals +50% more damage. Additionally, her critical damage is increased by +3% for each stack of {g|f:437c7a78578c4bbeab1e85ea4a76df7d}bloodblessed{/g} she has.
Kibellah suffers +30% more damage, and her Willpower is reduced by −20.

c4c59cf4-e5b5-4596-b18b-8b3190cca2c3.Text: As long as Kibellah has less than 50% wounds, she has the {g|f:4f17da47f8a242d9921a390159e90885}despair{/g} effect.

6abf2db5-f424-481c-a388-c5983fb38647.Text: All characteristics are reduced by −10. Whenever the character suffers any damage, they must pass a Toughness resistance test or fall {g|f:8de915da52f24d9bb925d13fb2c8cf98}prone{/g} for 1 round. Any healing received removes this effect.

3b501bf9-6a77-4a6a-b363-dd3de904401b.Text: In the first round of combat, all allies gain immunity to forced movement effects and cannot be overpenetrated.

f7fa9412-f5cf-4062-b581-4b35a5ff89eb.Text: The character gains +10% dodge and parry against Genestealer Cultists.

b0f08f35-a1b1-4c5a-90a0-83fd8856447e.Text: The character cannot heal or be healed with any medical consumables. All characteristics are increased by +5.

5b654f98-3901-49da-aa8d-24b1d3e04f39.Text: This creature suffers a −10 penalty to Willpower.

d40e044c-8d8f-4c70-908d-6ffb4a5f0d2d.Text: The character suffers a −2 penalty to Willpower and Perception. Stacks.

ab2877e1-2ef9-4c14-8f5f-707237e4050a.Text: The character deals +10% more critical damage.

4d2519fe-19b1-4c4f-8314-84acf5232e08.Text: The character's dodge, hit chance, and parry are reduced by −10%.

a8ad5f65-9369-47a9-beae-e50910306a05.Text: The character suffers a −10 penalty to Perception.

e9b10f25-50b3-4c39-b7c5-f8ae13f8fb97.Text: The character suffers a −10 penalty to all skills.

fef68392-f5e7-4aaa-abcf-5f1ff4ed9155.Text: The character gains +10% critical hit chance and +5 Toughness.

09abc88e-04ce-4eac-947e-7351b2116d96.Text: The character deals +15% more damage to the Sire.

fa0ad72f-ff95-43cb-b089-ce85640ac5e4.Text: The character will have a higher initiative in the next combat. This is a one-time bonus that disappears after the combat ends.

de87095a-b330-42bc-be62-625afe61ad9d.Text: The character suffers <u>(from 8 to 12)</u> direct damage when using any psyker or Navigator powers.

8c24fc10-b59b-49b5-bd55-73b5adb52186.Text: Targets of the webbers must pass an {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a +10 {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} or become {g|Encyclopedia:ImmobilisedEffect}immobilised{/g}.
