c6e6deb1-b7e1-42e3-b86e-6f157344ea72.Text: {g|f:c4c25ebbdea341c5a153c073240d574d}Dismantling Attack{/g} also cripples the enemy, reducing their {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}Weapon Skill{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerBallisticSkill}Ballistic Skill{/g} by −30 until the end of combat.

287cb2fd-eace-4d62-94be-2aaba035a8de.Text: {g|f:c4c25ebbdea341c5a153c073240d574d}Dismantling Attack{/g} also intimidates all enemies in a 5-cell radius around the target, reducing their {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} by −15% until the end of combat.

74f01b56-9d54-4684-a2bd-da0062e12f71.Text: The target also provokes an {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attack of opportunity{/g} whenever it attacks.

95d6b4ce-fb38-4782-a6a0-9cd2f8707e91.Text: Whenever the character is healed, they regain +{uip|HealingBonus|67d48e2a1862454d97106e06b4c1ed2a}% more {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}.

3853642f-29d9-4dbe-89ce-c365a454b0c0.Text: Whenever the character is attacked by an enemy, they gain {g|Encyclopedia:MomentumWithDetailsGlossary}momentum{/g} equal to the {g|Encyclopedia:DifficultyTier}difficulty tier{/g} of the attacking creature.

6d72f46c-3037-4bed-8d55-25721ed7cd94.Text: The character's {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g} is doubled against single-target attacks.

0deb8838-2f2e-44da-96df-8c592f137aaa.Text: All toxic, mental, and {g|Encyclopedia:ShockDamage}shock damage{/g}, as well as all {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} from {g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}bleeding{/g} is reduced by −{uip|DamageReduction|e0bad88dd53b4a748b7f43156bf2f85c}%.

54465bc6-4401-4673-9b71-2b32c97cef71.Text: The character gains a {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to their {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerStrength}Strength{/g} equal to 20% of their {g|Encyclopedia:MaxWounds}maximum wounds{/g}.

de5c6ec8-98f2-49b6-8f6e-ade61ee039cf.Text: Whenever the character loses {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}, their next {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee attack{/g} gains +1 {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} for every 2 wounds the character has lost. Stacks.

028e21d8-8e9b-44a4-9acb-c106f52d480f.Text: During the first {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} of combat, the character has +2 additional {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}action points{/g}.

2ddb1939-065d-4afc-b8f8-67fbe4be0ba1.Text: Whenever the character kills the first enemy in a {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}, that character immediately makes an additional attack against the closest enemy they can target with the same weapon if possible, using whichever attack costs the least {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}. This attack deals 30% base {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} with a +10% bonus for every {g|Encyclopedia:DifficultyTier}difficulty tier{/g} of the first killed enemy, i.e. if the enemy was of difficulty tier I, this attack deals 40% damage in total.

8033593d-1d8c-42fe-9b1d-b38e3a974be1.Text: The character gains an additional 12 {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}. Those wounds are further increased by {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g}, increasing by +<u>(10 × TGH {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g})</u>%, in the same way as basic wounds.

06bdd4ce-0b41-4fd8-96c2-2da2d15573e4.Text: Whenever the character scores a {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit{/g}, they have a chance to increase their critical damage bonus by half. That chance is equal to <u>(character's critical hit chance − 50)</u>% (minimum of 0%).

dee84be1-9021-407a-9d8a-368f08c519f9.Text: The character's {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeReduction}dodge reduction{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:ArmourPenetration}armour penetration{/g} are increased by +10% of their {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit chance{/g}.

648dc9ba-bebf-45e4-b9b6-a8367872c498.Text: Every {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee attack{/g} the character makes reduces the target's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} by −{unit_stat|WarhammerStrength|bonus}% until the end of combat. This reduction is applied before {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} is calculated. Stacks.

478bb7d8-499f-44bb-a09d-76ebd62ce918.Text:
Enemies that have 0 {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g} or 0% {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} against the character's attacks suffer +10% additional {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} from the character.
If an enemy has both 0 deflection and 0% armour, those damage bonuses stack.

9f2d26f6-5f8a-415d-83db-c58654fdcd28.Text: The character ignores {uip|DeflectionReduction|f80d633400694ea0b4c73e69ebd03b2c} of the enemy's {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g} (rounded down).

25b4fdde-0e34-41d7-930a-c06491266187.Text: The character's {g|Encyclopedia:RateOfFire}rate of fire{/g} and maximum ammo of their weapons are increased by +30% (rounded up).

ffc4ef0a-44aa-4030-9bb3-0439d6d3945d.Text: Any damage the character deals is increased by +1 for every attack they have made this combat. Does not affect damage-over-time effects: {g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}bleeding{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:BurningEffect}burning{/g}, or {g|Encyclopedia:ToxinEffect}toxin{/g}.

c25642fb-ca8c-484e-a1e1-c42b5b8aff81.Text: All {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} dealt by the character is increased by +3% until the end of combat for every new enemy damaged by them this combat.

02782706-2c95-4298-a803-6f5d3c038817.Text: The character no longer suffers a −10 {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}Weapon Skill{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} for every additional enemy with {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee{/g} weapons adjacent to them and instead gains +10 Weapon Skill for every adjacent enemy on all attacks.

bf3e7ce6-fc95-4a15-964c-bf6bdc46c264.Text: When allies take actions on {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}extra turns{/g} given by the character, they deal +15% more {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}.

2797693b-8d9d-4eba-a6b6-d6fc490f1639.Text: At the start of the character's {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, they restore 10% of their {g|Encyclopedia:MaxWounds}maximum wounds{/g}. If the character has less than 20% of {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} left, they restore 20% of their maximum wounds instead.

c841c8a7-a239-4f06-9759-54cc637ad56f.Text: After an ally takes an {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}extra turn{/g} provided by the character, the ally gains +7% armour, +7% {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g}, and +3 {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}movement points{/g} until the end of combat. Does not stack.

67517663-d992-4726-9a96-cb12c4a7256f.Text: If an {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}extra turn{/g} given by the character's abilities or talents grants {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g}, the target gains +4 additional MP; if {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} — the target gains +1 additional AP.

a0efdb1a-c2ca-4171-b237-1653add204f6.Text: Allies within 2 cells around the character deal +{uip|DamageBonus|c67b58acea374a82a9b6b1d971f15581}% more {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} and suffer −{uip|DamageReduction|c67b58acea374a82a9b6b1d971f15581}% less damage. If multiple characters have this {g|Encyclopedia:Talent}talent{/g}, the effect does not stack.

24741fce-ce07-4179-82e3-7af91a7b1fec.Text: Whenever the character deals {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} to an enemy, that enemy suffers +1 stack of the degraded defence {g|Encyclopedia:CommonStatusesGlossary}effect{/g} for every 6 damage that the character has dealt. Whenever the character's ally attacks that enemy, they deal an additional +1% damage for each stack of degraded defence.

0cf0afa5-48a1-438b-b664-c1b7b126dc0b.Text: If the character's {g|Encyclopedia:ArmourPenetration}armour penetration{/g} is higher than the enemy's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g}, the character's {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit chance{/g} against that enemy is increased by +2% for every 5% difference between the character's armour penetration and the enemy's armour.

7a4d52d3-aca3-4c23-b083-ed3236a1c259.Text: If the character's {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeReduction}dodge reduction{/g} is higher than the enemy's {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} (before applying the heavy (0.75) or medium (0.5) armour penalty modifier), the character's damage against that enemy is increased by +1% for every 5% difference between the character's dodge reduction and the enemy's dodge.

c11bb8d1-e284-41e9-a3f7-5c0ffca8bf9b.Text:
{g|Encyclopedia:DeadeyeShot}Deadeye shot{/g} deals an additional +{uip|DamageBonus|0b113627def5404cb1d94310c85edfb8}% damage.
The following ranged attack abilities gain deadeye shot benefits (× 1.5 range and the additional damage from the talent itself):
-<indent=5%>{g|Encyclopedia:CareerHunterGlossary}Bounty Hunter{/g}'s {g|f:8930d6ba62ca4bc3a30a9900e741d87c}Claim the Bounty{/g} </indent>
-<indent=5%>{g|Encyclopedia:CareerTacticianGlossary}Master Tactician{/g}'s {g|f:e627e3fb653840dab9661093828432c5}Finish the Job{/g}</indent>
-<indent=5%>Assassin's {g|f:33214b7215b442519f4303bcd4a8ab34}Death Whisper{/g}</indent>
-<indent=5%>Assassin's
{g|f:c9dba0331212410dabe7dd2e19c52cd3}Killing Edge{/g}
</indent>
-<indent=5%>Assassin's {g|f:fca9f7a27d664ca2834d91822ca34663}Dispatch{/g}</indent>
-<indent=5%>Operative's {g|f:c4c25ebbdea341c5a153c073240d574d}Dismantling Attack{/g}</indent>
-<indent=5%>Bounty Hunter's {g|f:39809f7335f542c587678086db6ce338}Wild Hunt{/g}</indent>

91661ef3-4367-4241-a304-283d69727af2.Text: The character's first {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee attack{/g} each {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g} deals an additional +2 {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} for every cell between the character's current position and the spot where they started their turn. The distance is measured in a direct line, ignoring all terrain, with every second diagonal cell counting as two.

0701a8be-74e3-408c-962f-96ea4407db9a.Text:
Whenever the character {g|Encyclopedia:PushGlossary}pushes{/g} an enemy, the character gains +4 {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g}. Those MP are added after the attack and allow the character to continue movement.
{g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}Damage{/g} dealt by collisions from pushes is increased by +{unit_stat|WarhammerStrength|stat}%.

497d1ff1-dd02-44dd-96ab-c957d3a63853.Text: The character gains +15 {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} as long as they have no {g|Encyclopedia:Range}ranged{/g} weapons equipped (staves do not count as ranged weapons).

15d7e990-79cb-4d93-87a6-6fb199fd123b.Text: Targets that consider the character a {g|Encyclopedia:PriorityTarget}priority target{/g} deal −40% less {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} to the character's allies.

d2e0e46b-a4e9-426d-b439-a58f9313f54d.Text: Whenever an enemy fails a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} against the character, they suffer {uip|Damage|ffe7cf0f14ff411a981b63bdc228842f} {g|Encyclopedia:DirectDamage}direct damage{/g}. On success the damage is doubled.

9b96fd4a-9dde-4dd8-b3ec-6c5fc08a6270.Text: Whenever the character applies {g|Encyclopedia:BlindedEffect}blinded{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:SlowedEffect}slowed{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:FatiguedEffect}fatigued{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:PerplexedEffect}perplexed{/g}, or {g|Encyclopedia:DisturbedEffect}disturbed{/g} effects, one random enemy within 5 cells of the target also gains that effect for 1 round. The same happens if the character inflicts {g|Encyclopedia:Stun}stunned{/g} or {g|Encyclopedia:ProneEffect}prone{/g}, but the random target makes a {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} to avoid the effect.

1e5660d2-6d48-4d98-a9e5-71770ea3aa01.Text: If the character has at least one pistol in their current weapon set, they gain an {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}extra turn{/g} at the start of combat. During this extra {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, the character can make only one attack with each pistol in their current weapon set (any attack granted by the pistol).

2dd36f97-2ff0-41f1-af43-0362434574da.Text: The character becomes an unsanctioned psyker and gains +1 {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}psy rating{/g}.

f68ab6f9-c1cc-4265-939b-47fe306d949a.Text: The character gains +5 to all {g|Encyclopedia:Characteristic}characteristics{/g}. This {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} is doubled when they have 25% {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} or less.

2ad26d91-f0d0-40e7-8cef-9ec994381b2e.Text: The character's attacks gain an additional +{uip|Overpenetration|df6c348d0bbc490a8d6483ddaf99740b}% {g|Encyclopedia:OverpenetrationFullGlossary}overpenetration{/g}. Their overpenetration attacks cannot be {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodged{/g}.

0408085c-275c-4915-98b2-0c0877c98a3a.Text: The character gains a +{uip|Bonus|8d29b109e6c64a59b58cf1830271911e}% bonus to armour, armour penetration, {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeReduction}dodge reduction{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit chance{/g}, critical damage, and parry chance.

a4ad58d2-4da1-4e49-acec-de13e32578e7.Text: {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}Damage{/g} from the character's {g|Encyclopedia:OverpenetrationFullGlossary}overpenetration{/g} attacks does not decrease.

e5204012-3120-4502-bd6c-a81193a632ed.Text: When targets {g|Encyclopedia:PushGlossary}pushed{/g} by the character collide with enemies or {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}cover{/g}, both the target and the object they collide with suffer an additional +{uip|Damage|f09d24a1a5ee47f5b5d2826d3e32856c} {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}.

95db111e-6897-49d9-a232-76f6a95ab961.Text: Enemies {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} by the character with a melee attack must pass a Willpower {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} or make the character their {g|Encyclopedia:PriorityTarget}priority target{/g} until the start of the character's next turn.

29d5106c-2924-443a-ade7-16d66acbc407.Text: When the character's {g|Encyclopedia:SingleRangedAttacksGlossary}single shots{/g} deal {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} to targets other than their main target, they gain +5 {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerBallisticSkill}Ballistic Skill{/g} until the end of combat.

c187381b-8317-43f1-9d6d-92d0bee13d62.Text: The character can {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} attacks that normally cannot be dodged, including {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic powers{/g}.

d019624d-c971-41a9-b2d4-39417f0de569.Text: As long as the character wears {g|Encyclopedia:LightArmour}light armour{/g}, their {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} is increased by +1% for every 3% of the item's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g}.

af20a3ee-9f1c-4123-8526-7076fddbfa56.Text: The character's {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit chance{/g} and critical {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} are increased by +5% of their {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g}.

b948d8a8-8e3b-41a6-9bde-dd8278e02449.Text: The character gains a {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to all {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance tests{/g} equal to +{uip|ResistanceBonus|8b80a2f703bb4568875b78c473ed74ba}.

9505e793-fbfd-4667-85ea-c2791737bd27.Text: The character becomes immune to all {g|Encyclopedia:CommonStatusesGlossary}effects{/g} that reduce their {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g}. They gain +{uip|MovementPoints|e2feb6faef0d404e874f07b3ed51a888} MP.

77077099-4305-4860-baa6-39353e077492.Text: The familiar's {g|Encyclopedia:MaxWounds}maximum wounds{/g} are increased by +{uip|Wounds|f0351bf380f0498c9d68f546eac08ec3}%.

48b8a039-57d6-4f4a-b2be-05ca3cd58f67.Text: The familiar gains a {uip|Ignore|8932d22d911745a8817f9fc7c284d5dd}% chance to ignore any incoming damage.

61e6b137-0084-49f7-9e73-201c27430dcb.Text: If melee damage is dealt to the familiar, the attacker suffers {g|Encyclopedia:ToxicDamage}toxic damage{/g} equal to {uip|Reflec|9a3485e7900f43939a4e0afe883fb7d5}% of the damage dealt (cannot be more than 100%).

63320e6e-5153-4ba3-9a5b-7b0986c9f456.Text: Whenever the familiar's {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} drop below 20% for the first time in a {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}, the Overseer's next ability has its cost reduced to 0 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}.

51b24073-419b-473e-957f-2bd2d43a63e2.Text: In combat, the familiar gains +1 {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g} for each cell between it and the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g}, up to maximum of {unit_stat|WarhammerFellowship|bonus}.

eced03a4-1c93-46d5-b67f-aaac7d4a92b4.Text: Deals <u>({g|Encyclopedia:Lethality}lethality{/g} / 10)</u> {g|Encyclopedia:RendingDamage}rending damage{/g} that ignores armour and deflection at the beginning of each of the target's turns.

c9b033bd-9d12-4d49-ac05-0fa4b1432cae.Text: The Assassin makes an attack that does not count toward the limit of {g|Encyclopedia:AttacksPerTurn}attacks per turn{/g} and does not block the Assassin's movement, but deals only 25% of the Assassin's usual damage. If the attack is successful, the target suffers the {g|f:372208cc0f434c17abfb5140e8806ebc}haemorrhage{/g} effect.

aa356ece-b48e-49e2-8123-ddcd3164f858.Text: The Assassin can move through enemies and gains +{unit_stat|WarhammerAgility|bonus}% {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} and +{unit_stat|WarhammerPerception|bonus}% {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeReduction}dodge reduction{/g}. Their attacks deal +10% more damage. {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}Partial cover{/g} provides the Assassin with 50% cover efficiency.

422582b0-edae-4c0c-8d97-6a2a1c8bdffd.Text: For 1 round, the Assassin becomes the lowest {g|Encyclopedia:PriorityTarget}priority target{/g} for enemy attacks and gains the {g|f:670419fc312d4ee2b2298d03af22e0c2}elusive{/g} effect, which lasts until the Assassin attacks.

ac401b7d-0f20-427c-ac20-e26f5072bf3c.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerAssassinGlossary}Assassin{/g} chooses an enemy in their {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}line of sight{/g} and marks an additional {g|Encyclopedia:Opening}opening{/g} on this enemy on whichever side is closest to the Assassin. If this additional opening is not {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} by the end of the Assassin's turn, it disappears.

1af3f079-5e59-4be0-8457-d71af61b4ace.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerAssassinGlossary}Assassin{/g} sees a single {g|Encyclopedia:Opening}opening{/g} for each enemy on one of the enemy's sides. Opening: whenever the Assassin hits an opening (excluding {g|Encyclopedia:OverpenetrationFullGlossary}overpenetration{/g}), they deal an additional +10% of target's {g|Encyclopedia:MaxWounds}maximum wounds{/g} damage. After an attack, the opening is moved to the opposite side of the enemy. Each enemy's openings that were not hit by the Assassin during the Assassin's turn are moved to a random side of that enemy at the start of the Assassin's next turn.

8708c494-2a92-4e66-9d76-19146062f4ee.Text:
This value shows the Assassin's current base {g|Encyclopedia:Lethality}lethality{/g} before being modified by enemies' {g|Encyclopedia:Characteristic}characteristics{/g}, bonuses, and penalties.
The Assassin's base lethality is equal to {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} or {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeReduction}dodge reduction{/g}, whichever is higher.

daf57599-5950-49b4-9100-39878a6334c0.Text: The Assassin attacks, granting +40% {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} to the target of this attack. If this attack hits, it deals an additional +{uip|Damage|c9dba0331212410dabe7dd2e19c52cd3} (rounded down) damage increased by twice the percentage of that target's missing wounds.

31d037d3-e46b-4772-94b4-005a411e0047.Text:
The Assassin's next single-target attack will have a −50% armour penetration penalty, with a minimum of 0% armour penetration, and +10 {g|Encyclopedia:Lethality}lethality{/g}.
-<indent=5%>If it is a melee attack, its target rotates 180 degrees. The enemy's {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g} against the Assassin's attack is equal to 0% until the start of this enemy's turn.</indent>
-<indent=5%>If it is a ranged attack, its target is forced to move to the closest cell in a 3-cell range with no adjacent {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}cover{/g} facing toward the Assassin. This movement provokes attacks of opportunity.</indent>

c916732f-22f2-40ba-864d-db05f0012d72.Text:
The Assassin dashes in a straight line for up to {uip|Range|af4b536f77d14e12907337ff0efb7f76} cells, suffering −{uip|AOODamageReduction|af4b536f77d14e12907337ff0efb7f76} less damage from {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g} and gaining +{uip|DodgeBonus|af4b536f77d14e12907337ff0efb7f76}% {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} against the enemies they dash through until the next Assassin's turn.
If the Assassin has not dashed through any enemies, at the end of their turn they gain +{uip|CoverBonus|af4b536f77d14e12907337ff0efb7f76}% {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}cover efficiency{/g} to their cover until the Assassin moves.
Does not stack with itself.
After the first use, the Assassin can use this {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} again for free.

5f0f5c2e-119d-403d-9c04-36a01d8417f6.Text:
The Assassin dashes in a straight line for up to <u>(1 + {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}AGI{/g} bonus / 2)</u> cells, suffering −<u>Assassin's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}WS{/g} bonus</u> less damage from {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g} and gaining +<u>Assassin's WS bonus</u>% {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} against the enemies they dash through until the next Assassin's turn.
If the Assassin has not dashed through any enemies, at the end of their turn they gain +<u>(2 × Assassin's AGI bonus)</u>% {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}cover efficiency{/g} to their cover until the Assassin moves.
Does not stack with itself.
After the first use, the Assassin can use this {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} again for free.

7c315018-eb9b-4474-a781-f6dc5ea51205.Text:
The Assassin makes an enemy suffer −{uip|ArmourReduction|d8dd5aa174fb49a4b493ba266dece9af}% {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} and −{uip|DeflectionReduction|d8dd5aa174fb49a4b493ba266dece9af} {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g} until the end of the Assassin's turn.
-<indent=5%>If there is only 1 enemy adjacent to them, the Assassin also gains +{uip|DodgePenetrationBonus|d8dd5aa174fb49a4b493ba266dece9af}% {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} until the Assassin's next turn.</indent>
-<indent=5%>If there are no enemies adjacent to the Assassin, they gain +{uip|DodgeBonus|d8dd5aa174fb49a4b493ba266dece9af}% {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeReduction}dodge reduction{/g} until their next turn.</indent>

2338813b-e4d1-4d7b-9a5b-766e09c93c58.Text:
{g|Encyclopedia:CareerAssassinGlossary}Assassins{/g} are masters at identifying the slightest vulnerabilities of key targets and dispatching them by any means necessary.
Core focus: high {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeReduction}dodge reduction{/g}, threat elimination, hit-and-run.

982020f7-87dd-4825-8ae7-58193c2643bb.Text: This creature's chance to be {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critically hit{/g} by the Assassin is increased by +7%.

81679d7d-a44a-423a-8815-14d26e145190.Text: At the start of the Assassin's turn, all enemies that do not have the Assassin in their {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}line of sight{/g} suffer the {g|f:9872e38c87be4e4eb15dbc9fd5c53649}unsuspecting{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:CommonStatusesGlossary}effect{/g} until the end of the Assassin's turn.

4e4bdcf8-aef6-4a65-b003-8040f569892c.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerAssassinGlossary}Assassin{/g} attacks an enemy with a single-target attack, this attack reduces the target's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} by −10% until the end of the Assassin's {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}. Does not stack.

0e44c7ee-f1bc-4186-b10b-472eabdd7c92.Text: The {g|f:372208cc0f434c17abfb5140e8806ebc}haemorrhage{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:CommonStatusesGlossary}effect{/g} applied by {g|f:33214b7215b442519f4303bcd4a8ab34}Death Whisper{/g} deals an additional +10 {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}.

463822e0-4458-44eb-9e44-be750b70dce6.Text: If an enemy suffers a {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit{/g} from one of the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerAssassinGlossary}Assassin{/g}'s allies, at the start of the Assassin's {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, a new {g|Encyclopedia:Opening}opening{/g} is created on that enemy on whichever side is closest to the Assassin.

a24a3eb4-9aab-46e4-a761-54950a602663.Text: For every 10 {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} dealt by the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerAssassinGlossary}Assassin{/g}'s attack, that attack also deals +1 {g|Encyclopedia:DirectDamage}direct damage{/g} to the same target.

bedd622b-21d6-417a-90c3-95c378fdd7b1.Text: Whenever the Assassin deals {g|Encyclopedia:DirectDamage}direct damage{/g}, the target must pass an {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a −{uip|ResistancePenalty|fadb11b4b0e548ce889983f77d3a7fff} penalty or become {g|Encyclopedia:SlowedEffect}slowed{/g} until the end of their next turn.

6dc888e4-36a3-4772-986a-e3b2020c7a0a.Text: Each successful {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} grants the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerAssassinGlossary}Assassin{/g} +{uip|Lethality|daa322267afb45a9852f295a758c75c0}% {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} for the next successful attack.

208b22a8-d0c5-4c63-8ae5-f5682f53cd4a.Text: {g|f:d8dd5aa174fb49a4b493ba266dece9af}Poised to Strike{/g} also reduces the target's {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} by −{uip|DodgeReduction|7a62adafb0dd4af4895608cfee6dc971}%.

88dfe4c0-733c-400a-a53c-2aa55530e5a5.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:ArmourPenetration}armour penetration{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} of {g|f:f2c2674d408d4cc08a9a50ca33a50a7a}Feinting Attack{/g} is reduced to −20%.

c6135398-7586-4480-9c38-9d442a7094da.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerAssassinGlossary}Assassin{/g} deals {g|Encyclopedia:DirectDamage}direct damage{/g} to an enemy, that enemy suffers +1 stack of the {g|Encyclopedia:Vulnerable}vulnerable{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:CommonStatusesGlossary}effect{/g}.

b1992750-8de6-4031-bab3-88bfbf3473ab.Text: Each use of {g|f:e2af8c0124f94ca5b9a8b3f91982908a}Aim for the Opening{/g} on the same target reduces that target's {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeReduction}dodge reduction{/g} by −10%. Stacks.

8eeb10cb-97c7-4775-953e-65d20fe0c68b.Text: Whenever the Assassin has no more than 1 adjacent enemy, any enemy that moves into a cell adjacent to the Assassin must pass an {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a −{uip|ResistancePenalty|39a30ee0e035405ea0823dd98dafea7c} penalty or fall {g|Encyclopedia:ProneEffect}prone{/g}, if possible, and become {g|Encyclopedia:ImmobilisedEffect}immobilised{/g} until the start of that enemy's next turn.

911d07bb-e763-484f-9755-32292c625c06.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerAssassinGlossary}Assassin{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hits{/g} an {g|Encyclopedia:Opening}opening{/g}, the Assassin's {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} is increased by +{uip|DamageBonus|abb1af6ec9944442b4d815aadfa61db8}% until the end of combat. Stacks.

eab27e99-5f5d-4869-96a7-31972459af0e.Text: If this creature does not have the Assassin in its {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}line of sight{/g} at the end of the Assassin's turn, it suffers {uip|WeaponDamagePercent|7bec62f15dc440748fb6d510e9b13f85}% of the maximum base damage of the Assassin's current weapon.

9e1192fc-1ed7-41ee-8fd6-5e7a9cc4a935.Text: The enemy last {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damaged{/g} by the Assassin suffers the {g|f:8755496ae7954506a454cd2f03cc98ff}witness{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:CommonStatusesGlossary}effect{/g}.

beb3c2d9-f8ef-49f6-8cc3-5b51bb805fdc.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerAssassinGlossary}Assassin{/g} attacks an enemy, the Assassin gains +<u>((Assassin's {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeReduction}dodge reduction{/g}) − (target's {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g})) / 2</u> {g|Encyclopedia:Lethality}lethality{/g}. This lethality bonus cannot be less than 0.

6b5b1222-3c80-47ba-81bc-e06e42acbe69.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerAssassinGlossary}Assassin{/g} deals 5 or more {g|Encyclopedia:DirectDamage}direct damage{/g} to an enemy with a single attack, the Assassin gains +10 {g|Encyclopedia:Lethality}lethality{/g} until the end of combat. Stacks.

ce1c7430-23d2-431f-a82e-22843d0f8141.Text: While the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerAssassinGlossary}Assassin{/g} has no allies in a 5-cell radius around them, they gain +10% {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} and +10% {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeReduction}dodge reduction{/g}.

f88af8ef-5cc4-4fd7-90fe-8a632f1e18e4.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerAssassinGlossary}Assassin{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hits{/g} a target with an attack that has 100 {g|Encyclopedia:Lethality}lethality{/g} or greater for the first time in a round, the Assassin immediately regains the {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} spent for that attack.

db4779fb-ff3f-43da-af8f-3d8902255270.Text: The Assassin gains +{g|Encyclopedia:Lethality}<u>lethality</u>{/g}% chance to deal +<u>5% of target's {g|Encyclopedia:MaxWounds}maximum wounds{/g}</u> more damage when {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hitting{/g} an {g|Encyclopedia:Opening}opening{/g}.

a0f04f2c-e1fe-4733-b3f2-8f0585857c5a.Text: Every {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, the first use of an {g|Encyclopedia:CareerAssassinGlossary}Assassin{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} costs 0 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}.

857c8b76-17b5-49ff-b599-47ecbd28018a.Text: The Assassin gains +15 {g|Encyclopedia:Lethality}lethality{/g} against enemies that have any of following {g|Encyclopedia:CommonStatusesGlossary}effects{/g}: {g|Encyclopedia:SlowedEffect}slowed{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:ImmobilisedEffect}immobilised{/g}, or {g|f:372208cc0f434c17abfb5140e8806ebc}haemorrhage{/g}. The bonus is gained for each of these effects but cannot exceed +45 lethality.

e8703c29-daa3-4893-8cac-368ed5c6f90b.Text: If the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerAssassinGlossary}Assassin{/g} is {g|f:670419fc312d4ee2b2298d03af22e0c2}elusive{/g} at the start of their {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, they gain +4 {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} and +10 {g|Encyclopedia:Lethality}lethality{/g} until the end of their turn.

1333debf-5aa5-40e4-b3e0-6af71a482474.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerAssassinGlossary}Assassin{/g} attacks an enemy that is at full {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}, the Assassin gains +20% {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeReduction}dodge reduction{/g} against that enemy until the end of the Assassin's next turn.

119e3fe3-9c3a-49c0-9fd7-a23df8acb383.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerAssassinGlossary}Assassin{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hits{/g} an enemy without hitting the enemy's {g|Encyclopedia:Opening}opening{/g}, the Assassin gains +{uip|DodgeBonus|6835d43cba1d460f8b2ab0cb2bf31730}% {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} until the start of their next turn.

10224f6c-6cfe-4e5e-b314-94031e82921e.Text:
The Assassin makes an attack with the current weapon against an enemy. This attack cannot miss and deals +50% more damage. It also deals additional damage equal to 25% of the target's missing {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}.
The Assassin's {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} , {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeReduction}dodge reduction{/g}, armour penetration, and {g|Encyclopedia:ParryReduction}parry reduction{/g} are doubled for this attack.
The Assassin suffers +100% more damage until the end of combat.

93c9a7bf-9ffe-435e-806e-3df5f443e232.Text:
The Assassin makes an attack with the current weapon against an enemy. This attack cannot miss and deals +50% more damage. It also deals additional damage equal to 25% of the target's missing {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}.
The Assassin's {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeReduction}dodge reduction{/g}, armour penetration, and {g|Encyclopedia:ParryReduction}parry reduction{/g} are doubled for this attack.

92738713-9daa-41cc-8cfc-473226238697.Text: Until the end of combat, the target of {g|f:fca9f7a27d664ca2834d91822ca34663}Dispatch{/g} loses half of its current {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g}.

c335a908-7ff8-4792-935b-908c25b7afc4.Text: {g|f:fca9f7a27d664ca2834d91822ca34663}Dispatch{/g} deals additional {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} equal to 45% of the target's missing {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} instead of 25% of its missing wounds.

f4bdc1ad-414c-42dd-adb4-82193178a925.Text: Until the end of combat, whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerAssassinGlossary}Assassin{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hits{/g} an {g|Encyclopedia:Opening}opening{/g}, they gain +{uip|Lethality|fbe8ea3f3a2e4ce2b7ea337bda40bbd2} (rounded down) {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g}.

38c5c0bd-bd06-4a63-bf20-97e8128a66fb.Text: If the {g|f:fca9f7a27d664ca2834d91822ca34663}Dispatch{/g} attack kills the target, all enemies in a 3-cell radius around the target gain +2 stacks of the {g|Encyclopedia:DisturbedEffect}disturbed{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:CommonStatusesGlossary}effect{/g} and must pass an {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} or become {g|Encyclopedia:StaggeredEffect}staggered{/g} for 1 round.

a5cccc2d-caaf-4296-8fe3-2e74654f9cbf.Text:
At the start of its {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, the creature suffers {uip|Damage|7e42fcb1d83040e38e8d68d7edd96375} {g|Encyclopedia:ShockDamage}shock damage{/g} with {uip|Pen|7e42fcb1d83040e38e8d68d7edd96375}% {g|Encyclopedia:ArmourPenetration}armour penetration{/g}.
This effect is not considered a damage-over-time effect.

3fc06531-47a9-40ba-a0fa-a84ff1caeb7e.Text: Enemies hit by this character's arc rifle suffer a number of {g|f:7e42fcb1d83040e38e8d68d7edd96375}echopulse{/g} stacks equal to 10% of the damage dealt. Those stacks last until the end of combat.

a928cfe3-0ff5-4bd2-8e58-dcebd4b8bd64.Text: Whenever this character {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hits{/g} a target with an arc rifle, the radius of the area where additional targets are affected is increased by +{uip|Range|3d2fa2e2452f4a2baf8ede757601254d} (minimum +1).

71dafcc6-cafe-4402-9ee1-0902cb741f35.Text: The creature is {g|Encyclopedia:StaggeredEffect}staggered{/g}. Additionally, each stack increases {g|Encyclopedia:ShockDamage}shock damage{/g} suffered by +20%.

db9c19b1-338c-402f-a6fe-affc2345049a.Text: Targets hit by this character's arc rifle must pass a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} or suffer +1 stack of {g|f:25e7c7a70ef44e1c94d8618a77a778ec}arc-shock{/g} for 2 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rounds{/g}.

a848a7fd-eaa6-445b-ab14-975c09a19857.Text: If allies become the secondary targets of this character's arc rifle, they do not suffer damage.

b7898a74-6737-4038-9356-b3ee5e046cfa.Text: Whenever this character hits a target with an arc rifle, they gain +1 residual charge stack. When reaching 10 stacks, they immediately gain an additional attack with the arc rifle. Once the effect is triggered, these stacks are removed.

f47ff194-d308-4d83-8d83-29a445059033.Text: {g|f:1da644efeb174a789fc857602ebdfc1b}Plasma Overcharge (Extra Damage){/g} ignores {unit_stat|WarhammerIntelligence|bonus} of the target's {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g}.

81a62d0e-ac12-47ff-bda1-5b415e1d768a.Text: This character gains an additional attack with a plasma weapon in the first {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g} of combat and when reloading a plasma weapon for the first time each subsequent round.

05bfa269-8f96-4385-8eda-42af5e368c87.Text: {g|Encyclopedia:Reload}Reloading{/g} a plasma rifle costs −3 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} less and reloading a plasma pistol costs −1 AP less.

36f9744e-ff31-49a7-8d36-f4f876e92f40.Text: This character only suffers 25% of the damage dealt by {g|f:2a5d173c50af4cfd86eb00b12848b450}Plasma Explosion{/g}. The damage bonus from each stack of {g|f:0835dbc012334dd49f849fcc92e9f708}plasma cell overheat{/g} is increased by +5%.

50b0f470-4d48-4d21-9e19-d4655a346b2c.Text: The area of {g|f:0bc1f945b05e4b5593ec6151c7109a06}Plasma Overcharge (Area Attack){/g} is increased by an additional cell on each side of all axes (vertical, horizontal, and diagonal).

b1cb469b-fb23-4bc1-bb05-b5f842e78071.Text: {g|Encyclopedia:FireDamage}Fire damage{/g} suffered by enemies currently {g|Encyclopedia:ImmobilisedEffect}immobilised{/g} or {g|Encyclopedia:SlowedEffect}slowed{/g} by this character's webber is increased by +35%.

c2b8d97d-20a7-4ea6-8533-cdad70404765.Text: {g|Encyclopedia:AreaOfEffect}Area attacks{/g} with a webber create a webbed area which lasts for 3 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rounds{/g}. Any creature which enters that area, moves through it, or starts its {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} in this area must pass an {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} or become {g|Encyclopedia:SlowedEffect}slowed{/g} for 1 round.

c80dfa2f-f3c7-498c-a9e8-a7b45f86f9c0.Text: {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}Resistance tests{/g} against this character's webber effects suffer a −30 penalty.

d24e64f3-770b-4007-8122-3975f05145a4.Text: This character's first attack with a webber in a {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g} does not count toward the {g|Encyclopedia:AttacksPerTurn}attack limit per turn{/g}.

5dc453dc-f0fe-4a1f-bae2-cc8358348a7f.Text: When this character uses Drukhari or Aeldari melee weapons, weapon damage is calculated using their {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} instead of {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerStrength}Strength{/g} if Agility is greater.

b19a55bb-d66d-4fbd-aeaf-ab05085e8bb6.Text: {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}Critical damage{/g} dealt by this character's Aeldari ranged weapons is increased by +{unit_stat|WarhammerPerception|bonus}.

c7785b19-93a0-4a18-b39b-cc85c865de33.Text: This character's Drukhari ranged weapons deal +20% more damage for each damage-over-time effect the target is suffering.

4fc3fb8b-01f3-4d26-931b-cce4bcc9039e.Text:
All enemies suffering from damage-over-time effects in a 4-cell radius around the Executioner immediately suffer an extra instance of damage from these effects. They must also pass a {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a −{uip|Save|7d36cf07583c4450a481d88eaba4f738} penalty or suffer an additional {g|Encyclopedia:NegativeEffectTypesGlossary}negative effect{/g}. The effect and type of the resistance test depend on the initial damage-over-time effect.
-<indent=5%>{g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}Bleeding{/g}: Agility resistance test, {g|Encyclopedia:BlindedEffect}blinded{/g}</indent>
-<indent=5%>{g|Encyclopedia:BurningEffect}Burning{/g}: Willpower resistance test, {g|Encyclopedia:SlowedEffect}slowed{/g}</indent>
-<indent=5%>{g|Encyclopedia:ToxinEffect}Toxin{/g}: Toughness resistance test, {g|Encyclopedia:StaggeredEffect}staggered{/g}</indent>
These additional effects are removed at the start of the Executioner's next turn.

a90bc2b2-edd2-4224-b2fc-388b9124fcd7.Text:
The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerExecutionerGlossary}Executioner{/g}'s next ranged attack or psychic staff {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} inflicts a {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}-over-time effect on all targets {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g}. The type of this effect depends on the attack's damage type:
-<indent=5%>{g|Encyclopedia:PhysicalDamage}Physical damage{/g}: inflicts {g|Encyclopedia:ToxinEffect}toxin{/g}</indent>
-<indent=5%>{g|Encyclopedia:EnergyDamage}Energy damage{/g}: inflicts {g|Encyclopedia:BurningEffect}burning{/g}</indent>
The level of this damage-over-time effect is equal to <u>(minimum weapon damage / 7)</u>.
This effect is only applied once per target after all other effects from the attack are applied.

ca584aea-fd73-4fc3-80fa-d7f2feaab537.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerExecutionerGlossary}Executioner{/g} immediately inflicts bleeding (5) on an ally of their choice (including themselves). That ally gains a +{uip|Dodge|32206030daaf462e8fffbcf2e5e57dc0}% {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} and +3 additional {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} until {g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}bleeding{/g} ends for any reason.

7cf0bbb1-ba85-4935-a8b8-ebee84e97852.Text:
Until the start of their next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, the Executioner gains {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonuses{/g} to their parameters for each creature (enemy or ally) in combat suffering from the following damage-over-time effects:
-<indent=5%>{g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}Bleeding{/g}: +{uip|Resist|dfd41fb2d75445919683b1ea0c4cc40d}% {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} per creature</indent>
-<indent=5%>{g|Encyclopedia:BurningEffect}Burning{/g}: +{uip|Resist|dfd41fb2d75445919683b1ea0c4cc40d}% {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} per creature</indent>
-<indent=5%>{g|Encyclopedia:ToxinEffect}Toxin{/g}: +1 {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g} per creature up to a maximum of <u>{g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}TGH{/g} bonus</u>.</indent>

d1a84baf-6ec0-4ade-9d2b-1aa16c60257a.Text:
The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerExecutionerGlossary}Executioner{/g} replaces {uip|Damage|497d9f67e4b14631805c05dcb66bdcbf} of their {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} with the same number of {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g} until the end of combat.
While the Executioner has temporary wounds, all of their {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee attacks{/g} and damage-over-time effects deal an additional +{uip|Damage|497d9f67e4b14631805c05dcb66bdcbf}% {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}.

45ef8232-10ee-466a-8cbe-19addb2933fc.Text:
The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerExecutionerGlossary}Executioner{/g}'s next {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee attack{/g} forces all enemies {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} to run away from the Executioner in a straight line for up to 3 cells.
During this movement, the targets do not provoke {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g} and leave a bloody trail on the ground, which remains until the end of combat.
Movement through these bloodstained cells costs the Executioner 0 {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g}.

80ae39d0-ed17-4283-ae77-4ab57e89ae4b.Text:
If the target of the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerExecutionerGlossary}Executioner{/g}'s next successful attack is suffering any damage-over-time {g|Encyclopedia:CommonStatusesGlossary}effects{/g}, for each effect it must make the relevant {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} required to remove it with a penalty equal to −<u>(Executioner's {g|Encyclopedia:SkillMedicae}Medicae{/g} / 10)</u>. If failed:
