af26970c-f579-46fa-8afb-38ff77f0ae83.Text: If the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerFighterGlossary}Warrior{/g} has less than 50% {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}, they gain +{uip|BonusDamage|1c61468f25fc410586a383c32050e971}% {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit chance{/g}.

aac30508-38a3-4a70-aa53-c42e158f9fd4.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerFighterGlossary}Warrior{/g} is {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} while under the {g|f:4d2f2a839d2340388d45cf4cf66c947b}Endure{/g} effect, their {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g} is increased by +1 until the Warrior's next turn.

2e472f34-7db7-4547-8dcf-c6a6cd087db6.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} dealt by {g|f:4955b43454f6488f82892e166c76c995}Charge{/g} is increased by +{uip|Damage|5870ebea41f743e7b519e24f4ab97eb7} when the {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} is used from a distance of 5 or more cells.

f66bfe5b-8b85-43ed-8a28-5aade2488ddf.Text: When the Warrior {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parries{/g} an attack, their next Warrior {g|Encyclopedia:Career}archetype{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} costs −1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} less.

996a5365-86f4-47f3-819f-9d8befd7fa69.Text: When the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerFighterGlossary}Warrior{/g} ends their {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} near an enemy affected by the {g|f:4696f02da13b4596b941bb950d945a05}Sworn Enemy{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g}, the Warrior gains +{uip|TemporaryWounds|8b1920f555924a0dbe5caa88129061f0} {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g}.

23f56ab5-f4b5-4419-9b65-f5c017efc773.Text: Enemies suffer a −10% penalty to their {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit chance{/g} with ranged attacks (including {g|Encyclopedia:AreaOfEffect}area attacks{/g}) against the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerFighterGlossary}Warrior{/g} for every enemy in a 1-cell radius around the Warrior. Stacks up to 3 times.

a3f964d8-bd57-4774-a952-3c01d10e5d5d.Text: Enemies {g|Encyclopedia:PushGlossary}pushed{/g} away by {g|f:93d58dfeb6c648858c130e0a902f6ed6}Forceful Strike{/g} suffer an additional +{unit_stat|WarhammerStrength|bonus} {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} from collisions with objects and other enemies.

1b61cffb-6b7b-4160-bbbb-4a994d8dd2ee.Text: Each use of {g|f:f6d693dbff0d44eb9590684241e63ef3}Slash{/g} increases the {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} dealt by {g|f:f6d693dbff0d44eb9590684241e63ef3}Slash{/g} by +1 until the end of combat.

b4bd937b-fa2d-4534-b420-c82418581643.Text: {g|f:4955b43454f6488f82892e166c76c995}Charge{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:PushGlossary}push{/g} increase the {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} of ranged attacks made against affected enemies by +{uip|DamageBonus|7e132b65948448b3893d8c3be9634c02}% until the end of combat. Does not stack.

661c51aa-770c-43fc-8859-19b196a57a16.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerFighterGlossary}Warrior{/g} gains +{unit_stat|WarhammerToughness|bonus} {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g} against the first attack made by every enemy this combat.

aa1b4151-b6a1-413c-af48-e93550fd554c.Text: The maximum range of {g|f:4955b43454f6488f82892e166c76c995}Charge{/g} is increased by +3 cells.

0ef22c31-4b90-49b7-86d2-b48a5b6d15b8.Text: Whenever the Warrior hits with {g|f:ad2a77c5012c4ffd9a19204dcf794266}Reckless Strike{/g}, this attack scores a guaranteed {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit{/g}.

6539b659-a4d5-4b43-8d0f-fce47dda2b7b.Text: Whenever the Warrior uses {g|f:f6d693dbff0d44eb9590684241e63ef3}Slash{/g} with two melee weapons equipped, the Warrior deals damage from both weapons.

1858b001-c823-4334-a6cf-3ceb483322b0.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerFighterGlossary}Warrior{/g} gains +1 damage {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g}. Their {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g} chance is increased by +25% of the Warrior's total {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g}.

87cdc39f-a6d0-4c6d-8538-7a88af98703e.Text: If there are no enemies adjacent to the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerFighterGlossary}Warrior{/g} at the start of the {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, the Warrior's {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} is increased by +{uip|DamageBonus|ea7d851dd97441e2867fe29f23364f3c} for one {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee attack{/g}.

fd06b0d7-60b5-40d3-a253-a33c1bcd057f.Text: The area of {g|f:13e41af1d54c458da81050336ce8e0fc}Taunting Scream{/g} extends +2 cells wider around the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerFighterGlossary}Warrior{/g} and +2 cells farther forward.

55f03ded-b090-4fc8-86a2-28a398ca7b4b.Text:
The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerFighterGlossary}Warrior{/g} immediately restores all {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} and gains +{unit_stat|WarhammerAgility|bonus} {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} until the end of the turn. The Warrior has no limit on {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee{/g} weapon attacks this turn.
Starting from the next round and until the end of combat, the Warrior cannot use {g|f:4955b43454f6488f82892e166c76c995}Charge{/g}, and their MP are reduced by −3.

b149a5db-1d1d-47a9-bc0e-b88b85daba1f.Text: Until the end of combat, the Warrior cannot use {g|f:4955b43454f6488f82892e166c76c995}Charge{/g}, and their MP are reduced by −3.

6e10c07f-2ae2-4189-ae59-086196a18490.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerFighterGlossary}Warrior{/g} immediately restores all {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} and gains +{unit_stat|WarhammerAgility|bonus} MP until the end of the turn. They do not lose MP after performing attacks. The Warrior has no limit on {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee{/g} weapon attacks this turn.

a1e95ec4-1cd4-4d44-86a2-28a5e115197e.Text: {g|f:ed21642647a14ead9a09183cd5318d11}Daring Breach{/g} also grants +10 {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}movement points{/g} until the end of the {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}. The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerFighterGlossary}Warrior{/g} does not provoke {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g} this turn.

28f1396d-3333-41e5-88c4-6fef905b5513.Text: Until the end of combat, the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerFighterGlossary}Warrior{/g} gains +4 {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} for each kill and may use their MP after attacking or using {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}abilities{/g}.

cc71688d-5dcd-48b9-ad0c-747ef7026a0b.Text: For one round, the Warrior becomes the {g|Encyclopedia:PriorityTarget}priority target{/g} for every enemy {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} by their melee attacks. Also, the Warrior gains +20% {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g} and +2 {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g} until the end of combat.

fd3013b1-3c76-42f4-973a-eaa3634bd69d.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerHunterGlossary}Bounty Hunter{/g}'s next attack this turn will have additional effects: -Deals an additional +{unit_stat|WarhammerBallisticSkill|bonus} damage. -The target's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} will be reduced by −(3 × target's {g|Encyclopedia:DifficultyTier}difficulty tier{/g})% against all the Bounty Hunter's attacks until the end of combat. -If the target's armour against this attack is below 20%, the target's {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} is also reduced by −(3 × target's difficulty tier)% against all the Bounty Hunter's attacks until the end of combat. Additional damage of the Bounty Hunter's attack is increased to +{uip|AdditionalDamage|f333222c78614e6fb8ca145dd8cafcf6}. {g|Encyclopedia:Prey}Prey{/g}: if the target of the attack is marked as prey, its armour and dodge are also reduced against the attacks of the Bounty Hunter's allies.

e233312f-2dc9-4fb8-a6f0-628a2e28472a.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical damage{/g} and critical {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit chance{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonuses{/g} accumulated by using {g|f:802d21391d2f4573bfff126023df39bb}Hunt Down the Prey{/g}.

7997545c-a8a1-4cf2-bd3c-95e8ea7e7341.Text: Hunt Down the Prey — Critical Bonuses

114a7cb5-ad71-4109-98e0-2b6da1bc9abb.Text:
The Bounty Hunter may mark any enemy in combat as {g|Encyclopedia:Prey}prey{/g}. Whenever the Bounty Hunter kills a target marked as prey, they gain a stackable bonus until the end of combat. The bonus depends on the enemy {g|Encyclopedia:DifficultyTier}difficulty tier{/g} (the roman numeral on the enemy's icon):
-<indent=5%>I-II : +25% of the Bounty Hunter's {g|Encyclopedia:MaxWounds}maximum wounds{/g} as {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g}.</indent>
-<indent=5%>III-IV: +<u>(5 × prey's difficulty tier)</u>% {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical damage{/g} and +<u>(2 × prey's difficulty tier)</u>% critical hit chance until the end of combat.</indent>
-<indent=5%>V-VII: both of the above.</indent>
{g|f:802d21391d2f4573bfff126023df39bb}Hunt Down the Prey{/g} has 3 charges at the start of combat.

bf88926b-7282-49d2-8a61-28619f5825d4.Text: The number of times the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerHunterGlossary}Bounty Hunter{/g} can use {g|f:802d21391d2f4573bfff126023df39bb}Hunt Down the Prey{/g}.

5ec8c178-3aaa-4b44-aa01-65f87be257a3.Text: Until the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerHunterGlossary}Bounty Hunter{/g}'s next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, whenever an ally attacks a target marked as {g|Encyclopedia:Prey}prey{/g}, this attack deals +{uip|AdditionalDamage|1394e5c9a6a347db841d961a87f375f4}% additional {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} and gains half of the Bounty Hunter's current bonuses to {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit chance{/g} and critical damage granted by {g|f:802d21391d2f4573bfff126023df39bb}Hunt Down the Prey{/g}.

ccb13d91-1a60-467b-b1a8-f16d619a089d.Text:
The Bounty Hunter designates an enemy in a 10-cell radius as {g|Encyclopedia:Trailed}trailed{/g} and finishes its turn.
If an ally kills a trailed enemy:
-<indent=5%>The Bounty Hunter gains an extra turn after that ally's turn, with all {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} remaining from the moment the Bounty Hunter used {g|f:56bd0b3c54784098ae7044ceae173c7c}Hot on the Trail{/g}.</indent>
-<indent=5%>The Bounty Hunter gains an additional +<u>(2 + target's difficulty tier / 2)</u> MP.</indent>
-<indent=5%>The {g|Encyclopedia:Cooldown}cooldown{/g} of {g|f:56bd0b3c54784098ae7044ceae173c7c}Hot on the Trail{/g} is reset.</indent>
When {g|f:56bd0b3c54784098ae7044ceae173c7c}Hot on the Trail{/g} is used for the third time during combat, the Bounty Hunter recovers +1 charge of {g|f:802d21391d2f4573bfff126023df39bb}Hunt Down the Prey{/g}.
! Only a single enemy can be trailed at a time.

f6e4bd31-c233-4f05-963d-b1f351af3997.Text: The Bounty Hunter's next attack during this turn will have +100% {g|Encyclopedia:OverpenetrationFullGlossary}overpenetration{/g} and +{uip|AdditionalOverpenetration|0d8923eff3f94a5faf71bfe36ca19d70}% {g|Encyclopedia:ArmourPenetration}armour penetration{/g}. {g|Encyclopedia:Prey}Prey{/g}: the next attack that {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hits{/g} a target marked as prey is always a {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit{/g}.

60fa308f-0081-4289-a5ee-707e31bc60f8.Text: The Bounty Hunter sets a trap on a free cell in a 10-cell radius around them. Any enemy entering the 2-cell radius around that trap activates the trap: -Each enemy in a 2-cell radius around the trap suffers {uip|DirectDamage|9216a3659b1a4111a35d3eafe05f8921} {g|Encyclopedia:DirectDamage}direct damage{/g} and must pass an Agility {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a −{uip|ResistancePenalty|9216a3659b1a4111a35d3eafe05f8921} penalty or become {g|Encyclopedia:ImmobilisedEffect}immobilised{/g} until the enemy's next turn. -The Bounty Hunter gains +{unit_stat|WarhammerAgility|bonus} {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} at the beginning of their next turn. {g|Encyclopedia:Prey}Prey{/g}: a target marked as prey is always immobilised until their next turn.

818afb66-e8b0-45af-a7f9-e4dd64cb0ede.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerHunterGlossary}Bounty Hunter{/g} makes a free single attack with the selected weapon. This attack always {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hits{/g}, does not end the Bounty Hunter's movement, but deals only {uip|DamagePercent|a78f3ecf5c024fac860fc2beaa63a8f9}% of the Bounty Hunter's usual {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}. After each third enemy killed by {g|f:8930d6ba62ca4bc3a30a9900e741d87c}Claim the Bounty{/g}, the Bounty Hunter recovers +1 charge of {g|f:802d21391d2f4573bfff126023df39bb}Hunt Down the Prey{/g}. Prey: if {g|f:8930d6ba62ca4bc3a30a9900e741d87c}Claim the Bounty{/g} kills a target marked as prey, the Bounty Hunter receives +2 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}.

3493a6e2-d00a-40b3-b4b3-aada580d9718.Text:
The Bounty Hunter's first {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit{/g} in a round grants their allies a stacking +<u>(target's {g|Encyclopedia:DifficultyTier}difficulty tier{/g} + Bounty Hunter's PER {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} / 3)</u>% bonus to {g|Encyclopedia:ArmourPenetration}armour penetration{/g} until the end of combat.
Once a character with this bonus {g|Encyclopedia:Reload}reloads{/g}, the bonus is removed.

dbee2dd1-d983-4c68-8d49-29afc1118fc4.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerHunterGlossary}Bounty Hunter{/g} kills an enemy with a {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit{/g}, all allies in a 7-cell radius around the target gain +<u>target's {g|Encyclopedia:DifficultyTier}difficulty tier{/g}</u>% critical {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit chance{/g} until the end of combat. Stacks.

51cb03aa-9f7a-4290-b757-01f4563899d9.Text: Whenever {g|Encyclopedia:Prey}prey{/g} deals {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} to the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerHunterGlossary}Bounty Hunter{/g}'s ally, the Bounty Hunter gains +<u>prey's {g|Encyclopedia:DifficultyTier}difficulty tier{/g}</u>% damage against that prey for 2 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rounds{/g}. Stacks.

0823c751-726c-436f-9602-26054174eeca.Text: When the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerHunterGlossary}Bounty Hunter{/g} performs a {g|Encyclopedia:SingleRangedAttacksGlossary}single-shot{/g} attack on an {g|Encyclopedia:ImmobilisedEffect}immobilised{/g} or {g|Encyclopedia:Stun}stunned{/g} target, this attack refunds its cost and does not count for the attack limit. Once per {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.

85f872d7-0ca4-493e-b0d7-3b8ca08dd265.Text: Whenever the Bounty Hunter {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hits{/g} an enemy with an attack, they inflict the {g|Encyclopedia:Catch}catch{/g} effect on that enemy.

45f9632d-84b3-4419-aafa-af8a3667999d.Text: Whenever {g|Encyclopedia:Prey}prey{/g} that is not being {g|Encyclopedia:Trailed}trailed{/g} is killed by an ally, the Bounty Hunter gains an {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}extra turn{/g} with half of their {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}. The Bounty Hunter cannot attack during this extra turn.

3b7d3657-dc84-458f-9a1c-3a809220a8a3.Text: {g|f:f333222c78614e6fb8ca145dd8cafcf6}Cull the Bold{/g} additionally removes −<u>target's {g|Encyclopedia:DifficultyTier}difficulty tier{/g}</u> {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g}, −<u>(2 × target's difficulty tier)</u> {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g}, and −<u>(2 × target's difficulty tier)</u> {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g} from the target.

61cf5314-2f55-4d0b-814b-b79fc8ab65b0.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerHunterGlossary}Bounty Hunter{/g} scores a {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit{/g} for the first time in a {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}, they gain +<u>target's {g|Encyclopedia:DifficultyTier}difficulty tier{/g}</u> {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}movement points{/g}.

00964da0-8523-4bed-8ec8-51c7a4b9babb.Text: The Bounty Hunter gains +{uip|CritChanceBonus|6c71bfc05fa0455fa5550d0e33fd288b}% {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit chance{/g} against all {g|Encyclopedia:Prey}prey{/g} whose {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} is reduced by any effects from either Bounty Hunter or Operative archetype {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}abilities{/g} or {g|Encyclopedia:Talent}talents{/g}.

cac6a3a7-dd96-4cc1-951a-6beae83b38c6.Text: Every third {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit{/g} scored by the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerHunterGlossary}Bounty Hunter{/g} restores +1 charge of {g|f:802d21391d2f4573bfff126023df39bb}Hunt Down the Prey{/g}.

17c09a6f-2c74-4780-93c9-ff7e5d256ef6.Text: Whenever an enemy is killed by a {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit{/g} scored by the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerHunterGlossary}Bounty Hunter{/g} or their ally, the Bounty Hunter gains +<u>(2 × enemy's {g|Encyclopedia:DifficultyTier}difficulty tier{/g})</u>% {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} for 2 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rounds{/g}.

e65b6b46-d41f-4e02-a506-0c51330d7cac.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerHunterGlossary}Bounty Hunter{/g} kills {g|Encyclopedia:Prey}prey{/g} whose {g|Encyclopedia:DifficultyTier}difficulty tier{/g} is IV or higher, the Bounty Hunter additionally gains +2 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}.

1c36608f-ffe7-4224-a49d-a40ee9850e40.Text: {g|f:41e8d32342714d74ba97fe26220ed1fd}Raid{/g} grants an ally an additional +<u>(2 × {g|Encyclopedia:Prey}prey{/g}'s {g|Encyclopedia:DifficultyTier}difficulty tier{/g})</u>% {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} against prey.

8a3a0bd0-e063-4dc5-ac43-3474b95229e2.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerHunterGlossary}Bounty Hunter{/g} kills an enemy whose {g|Encyclopedia:DifficultyTier}difficulty tier{/g} is IV or higher, the Bounty Hunter immediately {g|Encyclopedia:Reload}reloads{/g} their weapon and attacks the closest enemy in their {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}line of sight{/g}. This attack gains +50% {g|Encyclopedia:OverpenetrationFullGlossary}overpenetration{/g} but deals only {uip|DamagePercent|e0dcfc42ff494a7ead8cd3a788ff7516}% of the Bounty Hunter's usual damage.

4183c02b-673e-4e52-bc67-ef9234111daa.Text: {g|f:56bd0b3c54784098ae7044ceae173c7c}Hot on the Trail{/g} now has an unlimited range and reduces the target's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} by −{uip|ArmourReduction|8f583f74dfec446faa1fd96d186147b0}% for 2 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rounds{/g}.

8019e67a-13c6-4808-9309-5b1cb984ad26.Text: Each enemy affected by {g|f:e92f1c119dd64d3981fd750a56e5aab2}Piercing Shot{/g} has their {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} reduced by −{unit_stat|WarhammerBallisticSkill|bonus}% until the end of combat. Stacks.

bcc346ca-32ed-4dbc-9afe-4203e2ea35f6.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerHunterGlossary}Bounty Hunter{/g} scores a {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit{/g}, the target's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} is reduced by −<u>({unit_stat|WarhammerBallisticSkill|bonus} + target's {g|Encyclopedia:DifficultyTier}difficulty tier{/g})</u>% until the end of combat. Stacks.

261f9783-94eb-49fd-8cac-e30eb18a866e.Text:
Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerHunterGlossary}Bounty Hunter{/g} is attacked in {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee range{/g} for the first time since the end of their {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, they automatically {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} that attack and move 1 cell in the opposite direction from the enemy.
The Bounty Hunter does not provoke {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attack of opportunity{/g} with this movement.

25fecb6b-9aa3-4740-be84-a179cd4d62e6.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerHunterGlossary}Bounty Hunter{/g}'s allies gain +{uip|CritChanceBonus|a56864477e624f6fbfdd8c526a1f9779}% {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit chance{/g} against enemies affected with one or more of the following effects: {g|Encyclopedia:Prey}prey{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:Trailed}trailed{/g}, or {g|Encyclopedia:ImmobilisedEffect}immobilised{/g}.

cf558a3e-503f-4ab1-906b-1c207dda0e96.Text: Whenever an ally kills {g|Encyclopedia:Prey}prey{/g}, the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerHunterGlossary}Bounty Hunter{/g} gains half of the {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonuses{/g} granted by {g|f:802d21391d2f4573bfff126023df39bb}Hunt Down the Prey{/g}.

95e96edd-184a-4eee-8b9c-8f7bfe4e8e5c.Text: If {g|f:8930d6ba62ca4bc3a30a9900e741d87c}Claim the Bounty{/g} kills an enemy, the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerHunterGlossary}Bounty Hunter{/g}'s next attack this {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} will always score a {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit{/g}.

9463685c-ca93-48d7-a1d6-2dfaabee6e6a.Text: If the target's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} is equal to or less than 0 when the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerHunterGlossary}Bounty Hunter{/g} makes this attack, the target will suffer an additional +<u>(5 × {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerPerception}PER{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g})</u>% {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} from the Bounty Hunter's attacks until the end of the combat. Stacks.

7066be3c-094c-4484-a95b-956210190861.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerHunterGlossary}Bounty Hunter{/g} scores a {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit{/g}, they gain +{unit_stat|WarhammerPerception|bonus}% {g|Encyclopedia:ArmourPenetration}armour penetration{/g} until the end of combat. Stacks.

762c065a-9f80-410b-9ef8-8a6a0b6d8699.Text: Whenever {g|Encyclopedia:Prey}prey{/g} is killed, all enemies in a 10-cell radius around the prey have their {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} reduced by −<u>(5 × prey's {g|Encyclopedia:DifficultyTier}difficulty tier{/g})</u> for 2 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rounds{/g}.

0a3a7b7d-ea2d-482d-af0c-abb7ca408437.Text: At the start of the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerHunterGlossary}Bounty Hunter{/g}'s {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, they gain +2 {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} for each ally who is adjacent to {g|Encyclopedia:Prey}prey{/g}.

72a82561-cef0-422c-8e60-5cd615c0f58f.Text:
The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerHunterGlossary}Bounty Hunter{/g} simultaneously makes several attacks. The number of the attacks is equal to the number of {g|Encyclopedia:Prey}prey{/g} in combat. These attacks are equally divided among all prey in the Bounty Hunter's {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}line of sight{/g}. The attacks always {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} and always score {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit{/g}.
Until the end of combat, the Bounty Hunter's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerBallisticSkill}Ballistic Skill{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerPerception}Perception{/g}, and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} are reduced by −20.

aac8ab03-06bc-4b48-9734-8cd6f2cd1566.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerHunterGlossary}Bounty Hunter{/g} simultaneously makes several attacks. The number of the attacks is equal to the number of {g|Encyclopedia:Prey}prey{/g} in combat. These attacks are equally divided among all prey in the Bounty Hunter's {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}line of sight{/g}. The attacks always {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} and always score {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hits{/g}.

08b8ae18-a996-4b30-9099-0d418d1c448e.Text: Prior to the attack, all {g|Encyclopedia:Prey}prey{/g} suffers a −<u>(3 × {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerPerception}PER{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g})</u>% {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} until the end of combat.

fd7f12e8-6ea6-4fb1-8038-f0ec3f20ce2a.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerHunterGlossary}Bounty Hunter{/g} gains +{unit_stat|WarhammerAgility|bonus} {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} and restores +3 charges of {g|f:802d21391d2f4573bfff126023df39bb}Hunt Down the Prey{/g}.

92dbe6db-fba3-49bd-b816-e86103b5e66c.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerHunterGlossary}Bounty Hunter{/g} attacks exactly one target, which is marked as {g|Encyclopedia:Prey}prey{/g}, with {g|f:39809f7335f542c587678086db6ce338}Wild Hunt{/g}, this attack deals +300% {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}.

b123449a-5de7-4073-abbf-bfcb457499c6.Text: All {g|Encyclopedia:Prey}prey{/g} has its {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} reduced by −<u>({g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}AGI{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} − 3)</u>, but by no less than −2.

128181fd-09e5-4577-afc5-139af211780a.Text:
The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerLeaderGlossary}Officer{/g} increases an ally's {g|Encyclopedia:Resolve}resolve{/g} by +{uip|ResolveBonus|32c0e0539f8548b08780089f8006f54a} until the end of combat.
If the target is under the effect of {g|f:9c78e44bf8ff44a9afff8370c673c9ad}Voice of Command{/g}, they will start their next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} with +1 additional {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}action point{/g}.

3ba0fbf3-62a3-4882-965d-1378256f29f0.Text:
This {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} can only target allies who have enemies adjacent to them.
Until the start of the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerLeaderGlossary}Officer{/g}'s next turn, all {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee attacks{/g} made by the target deal additional damage equal to {uip|BonusDamage|b509a3ee5ab44253b4b859dd5f3dbffb} multiplied by the number of enemies adjacent to the target when this ability is used.
If the target is under the effect of {g|f:9c78e44bf8ff44a9afff8370c673c9ad}Voice of Command{/g}, they immediately make an {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attack of opportunity{/g} against an adjacent enemy, targeting the one with the lowest remaining {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}.

a94ae4ac-da33-4a25-b4c0-471a9bb0d9c1.Text:
This {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} can only be used on allies who can reach the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerLeaderGlossary}Officer{/g} by moving fewer than 20 cells. The Officer immediately makes an ally move toward the Officer by taking the shortest possible path.
If the target is under the effect of {g|f:9c78e44bf8ff44a9afff8370c673c9ad}Voice of Command{/g}, it gains +{uip|ArmourBonus|19b029e81dae4e418fddfc6d24af3f6a}% {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} until the end of the Officer's {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}. If the target remains adjacent to the Officer, any attacks made against the Officer will target them instead until the effect of {g|f:19b029e81dae4e418fddfc6d24af3f6a}To Me!{/g} ends.

5080855f-fb87-44d4-8255-3f56953f03c3.Text:
{g|Encyclopedia:CareerLeaderGlossary}Officers{/g} use their {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerFellowship}Fellowship{/g} to improve the combat capabilities of their allies, turning them into even greater threats on the battlefield.
Core focus: {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}extra turns{/g}, single target buffs, rescuing allies, {g|Encyclopedia:MomentumWithDetailsGlossary}momentum{/g}.

0653ef2d-9f6b-4646-a5aa-07e00fc29e78.Text: Whenever an ally is affected by an {g|Encyclopedia:CareerLeaderGlossary}Officer{/g}'s {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} or {g|Encyclopedia:Talent}talent{/g} that grants {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g}, that ally's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} is increased by +10% for 1 round. Does not stack.

f954e67d-43df-43f0-b133-dfb5c7b89f09.Text: Allies under the effect of the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerLeaderGlossary}Officer{/g}'s {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}abilities{/g} gain a {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to their {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}Weapon Skill{/g} equal to {uip|DamageBonus|e1d30ac6037f43d98bc14c07f1c60cfe} and will deal +{unit_stat|WarhammerFellowship|bonus} more damage on {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g} until the start of the Officer's next turn.

d183a733-54e7-4874-be62-062af9c8603e.Text: Whenever an ally uses a {g|Encyclopedia:HeroicAct}heroic act{/g}, that ally gains {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g} equal to <u>(10% of their {g|Encyclopedia:MaxWounds}maximum wounds{/g} + {uip|Resolve|5f3732268bf044fab685fcead7998a3c})</u>.

09eb54b8-4f34-4963-a35d-59f6fe79f07e.Text: The range of the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerLeaderGlossary}Officer{/g}'s {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}abilities{/g} is increased by +3. The range of {g|f:9c78e44bf8ff44a9afff8370c673c9ad}Voice of Command{/g} is increased by +6.

be8a1037-df0b-4f91-8b59-7c29223c91b8.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerLeaderGlossary}Officer{/g} uses an {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} on an ally, that ally gains a {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to their {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerPerception}Perception{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerBallisticSkill}Ballistic Skill{/g} equal to {uip|StatBonus|27b71e5bb62a4bf1ad94359f49ca5f52}. These bonuses stack, but half of the stacks (rounded up) are lost at the end of the target's turn.

8b0c530e-e244-4d83-8bbe-fe70dbae1907.Text: At the start of each of the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerLeaderGlossary}Officer{/g}'s {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turns{/g}, the Officer uses {g|f:9c78e44bf8ff44a9afff8370c673c9ad}Voice of Command{/g} on a random ally that is not {g|Encyclopedia:Overexerted}overexerted{/g}. This ally will not suffer the overexerted effect and can be targeted by {g|f:9c78e44bf8ff44a9afff8370c673c9ad}Voice of Command{/g} again.

1b8f0a03-878c-4b97-8e53-2a269c52d30b.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerLeaderGlossary}Officer{/g} targets an ally with an {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} for the first time in a {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}, that ally gains +{unit_stat|WarhammerWillpower|bonus} {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g}.

9b1ea6b1-e480-4324-b422-412a16b7cb4d.Text: {g|f:ac05887b146a49e6b707fa17494f8a5c}Air of Authority{/g} immediately grants {g|Encyclopedia:MomentumWithDetailsGlossary}momentum{/g} to the target equal to the target's {g|Encyclopedia:Resolve}resolve{/g}.

05104805-ebae-427e-a211-b384455b97aa.Text:
The Officer gains +10 Willpower and +10 Fellowship when they have less than 50% of their {g|Encyclopedia:MaxWounds}maximum wounds{/g} remaining. They also gain an additional +10 Willpower and +10 Fellowship after using any Officer {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} on a target with less than 50% {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} for 1 round.
These two sets of {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonuses{/g} stack with each other but do not stack with themselves (the Officer can only have up to +20 Willpower and +20 Fellowship granted by this {g|Encyclopedia:Talent}talent{/g} at any given time).

8ab70f5c-4693-4187-bf93-99495f5415c2.Text: Allies affected by the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerLeaderGlossary}Officer{/g}'s {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}abilities{/g} gain a {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to all {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance tests{/g} equal to {uip|ResistanceBonus|c2d1294cea0644baa6f6dac2270dffdc}.

b13a73ae-b496-48da-af35-c9501685bc6d.Text: Half of the {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} granted by {g|f:9c78e44bf8ff44a9afff8370c673c9ad}Voice of Command{/g} remains until the end of combat. This bonus does not stack with itself or with bonuses granted by {g|f:9c78e44bf8ff44a9afff8370c673c9ad}Voice of Command{/g} but does count as an {g|Encyclopedia:CareerLeaderGlossary}Officer{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} effect for the purposes of other {g|Encyclopedia:Talent}talent{/g} effects. Note: the affected ally does not count as having the {g|f:9c78e44bf8ff44a9afff8370c673c9ad}Voice of Command{/g} effect. They only gain bonuses to their {g|Encyclopedia:Characteristic}characteristics{/g}.

f0bdf9af-8099-4c8d-a2ae-9d1338ba9aeb.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerLeaderGlossary}Officer{/g} makes an attack, they gain +5 {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerFellowship}Fellowship{/g} until the end of combat.

d4a586f2-4e52-4d64-9eb9-8ffb29969c4e.Text: The next {g|Encyclopedia:CareerLeaderGlossary}Officer{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Career}archetype{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} that does not grant an {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}extra turn{/g} will also affect the Officer.

d286f516-5cb1-44e8-beac-3c071d46d189.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerLeaderGlossary}Officer{/g} uses an {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} that grants {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}movement points{/g} to the target, the Officer also gains half that number of movement points.

0bef0515-6b82-4ebe-b509-52096ab06e57.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerLeaderGlossary}Officer{/g} uses {g|f:9c78e44bf8ff44a9afff8370c673c9ad}Voice of Command{/g} or {g|f:5bfccf14d8604ae1a041fb347fb8f19f}Bring It Down!{/g} for the first time in combat, this ability costs −1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} less.

f14764c4-2907-4b47-9f1c-102aa5771aa2.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerLeaderGlossary}Officer{/g}'s {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} grants {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}action points{/g} to an ally, that ally also gains +1 to all {g|Encyclopedia:Characteristic}characteristics{/g} for every action point gained until the end of combat.

445fe3e6-606c-48e1-b549-c8ef42937c3e.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerLeaderGlossary}Officer{/g} uses two Officer {g|Encyclopedia:Career}archetype{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}abilities{/g} that do not grant an {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}extra turn{/g} in one round, the Officer gains the {g|f:f02ddb75448343d8a867fbd7a725ec93}stand witness{/g} effect.

0a869024-94d2-476f-8f55-e24228372b5c.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerLeaderGlossary}Officer{/g} targets an ally with an action (an {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} or an attack), that ally's {g|Encyclopedia:Resolve}resolve{/g} is increased by +1 until the end of the Officer's next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}. This effect stacks and is prolonged until the end of the Officer's next turn each time it stacks.

cb2d292b-d47a-45b7-9a13-7367ba18feb5.Text: Whenever an ally starts a {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} (including any {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}extra turn{/g}) adjacent to the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerLeaderGlossary}Officer{/g}, that ally gains additional {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} equal to {uip|MovementPoints|45e575a80a5d49a1ad9bc5ba0537fd98}.

dec1a7e2-8fe3-4d45-8e89-d852622a4424.Text: {g|f:36cb9c507ede4953b22cefac9263aa4d}Break Their Ranks!{/g} works as if there were one more enemy adjacent to the target. This allows this {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} to be used on targets with no enemies adjacent to them.

a2ad8f02-3a53-42d6-ba4e-aa1c7264cbd8.Text: {g|f:5707cdc822e742f187d54627ae6ef4f9}Take Aim!{/g} also increases the {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} of the next ranged attack by +5%. This bonus is increased by +1% for each cell between the attacker and the target.

14a5b239-39ee-4084-abcb-0c0578cbe33f.Text: Targets of {g|f:19b029e81dae4e418fddfc6d24af3f6a}To Me!{/g} take −15% less {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} until the start of the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerLeaderGlossary}Officer{/g}'s next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}. This reduction is doubled to −30% for targets taking their turn while under the effect of {g|f:19b029e81dae4e418fddfc6d24af3f6a}To Me!{/g}.

d34dbdd4-3abb-42d0-94cb-e38047a87c4c.Text: Targets of {g|f:d8008dcfa0004bcca41b26b802d839b2}Move, Move, Move!{/g} gain a +10% {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} and a +10% bonus to {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}cover efficiency{/g} until the start of the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerLeaderGlossary}Officer{/g}'s next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}.

cbb582c4-d57b-41ed-a6f1-90a43202edbd.Text: {g|f:e8e9fbe8696e4820b84c733ceba629af}Get Back in the Fight!{/g} removes 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Injury}fresh injury{/g} from the target and heals the target for {uip|Heal|3bdde6bd1c65417d846e34e3d084d571} {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} for each effect removed by {g|f:e8e9fbe8696e4820b84c733ceba629af}Get Back in the Fight!{/g} (including fresh injuries). A minimum of {uip|Heal|3bdde6bd1c65417d846e34e3d084d571} wounds is always healed, even if no effects are removed.

7948708e-7079-4dbd-97ca-7008af7e2b78.Text:
The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerLeaderGlossary}Officer{/g} grants an ally an {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}extra turn{/g} with full {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g}. During the extra turn, there is no attack limit.
Until the end of combat, the Officer's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerFellowship}Fellowship{/g} is halved.

37d374be-3f91-4329-bb36-9ea7f862653a.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerLeaderGlossary}Officer{/g} grants an ally an {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}extra turn{/g} with full {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g}. During the extra {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, there is no attack limit.

dc9fa369-358d-4c5a-b70e-77244fbf9eef.Text:
The target of {g|f:33c8c9db91694ca6ad3eff26e36dd0af}Finest Hour!{/g} gains additional {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonuses{/g}:
-<indent=5%>During their {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}extra turn{/g}, the target deals +{uip|DamageBonus|cb35c9899b354cb596a4ec619811afeb}% {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}.</indent>
-<indent=5%>Until the end of combat, the target gains the effect of {g|f:9c78e44bf8ff44a9afff8370c673c9ad}Voice of Command{/g}.</indent>

d4540d14-854b-4d18-843e-5f359a104e3b.Text:
The target of {g|f:33c8c9db91694ca6ad3eff26e36dd0af}Finest Hour!{/g} gains more {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonuses{/g}:
-<indent=5%>All {g|Encyclopedia:NegativeEffectTypesGlossary}negative effects{/g} are immediately removed from the target.</indent>
-<indent=5%>Until the end of the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerLeaderGlossary}Officer{/g}'s next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, the target cannot die (its {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} cannot be reduced below 1).</indent>

cac67073-0cca-410d-b5aa-d7d919c0eb1b.Text: The target gains +{uip|TemporaryWounds|2ec870598a2543a083fbac734fcec6db} {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g} until the end of combat.

9fad135c-fb77-4f7b-a205-7669234aa1f2.Text:
The target of {g|f:33c8c9db91694ca6ad3eff26e36dd0af}Finest Hour!{/g} gains more {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonuses{/g}:
-<indent=5%>During the {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}extra turn{/g}, all their non-attacking {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}abilities{/g} cost −1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}.</indent>

cf65e905-5272-4d01-80d7-b3b2f34210ee.Text: The target can redirect the {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} with their remaining {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} to another target.

b1e4a3a2-c881-4ce8-b690-77f72e699e5d.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} deals +{uip|DamageBonus|5e29fedc5a7e4a209d58d4bd75f94743}% more damage with their next attack. If that attack kills the target, it does not count toward the {g|Encyclopedia:AttacksPerTurn}attack limit per turn{/g}, and the Overseer regains any {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} spent on it.

185b44b3-18b7-42c7-a834-e72165ab1159.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} gains a +10 bonus to all {g|Encyclopedia:Characteristic}characteristics{/g} considered to be their familiar's key characteristics. Whenever an enemy within a 4-cell radius around the Overseer is {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} by an attack, the Overseer gains {uip|StatBonus|5e29fedc5a7e4a209d58d4bd75f94743} {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g}.

0d35f5ed-223e-45f0-bb22-23c2c8b69d8b.Text: The next 3 {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hits{/g} against this familiar have their {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} reduced by −{uip|Reduce|5e29fedc5a7e4a209d58d4bd75f94743}.

dcb0b96b-04f7-4003-8a76-23ea3c03c0f2.Text:
Depending on their familiar's number of {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}, the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} or the familiar gains a special benefit for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}:
-<indent=5%>Less than 50% wounds: the next 3 {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hits{/g} against the familiar have their damage reduced by −{uip|Reduce|5e29fedc5a7e4a209d58d4bd75f94743}.</indent>
-<indent=5%>50% wounds or more: the Overseer deals +{uip|DamageBonus|5e29fedc5a7e4a209d58d4bd75f94743}% more damage with their next attack. If that attack kills the target, it does not count toward the {g|Encyclopedia:AttacksPerTurn}attack limit per turn{/g}, and the Overseer regains any {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} spent on it.</indent>

25dda977-78a9-4fd9-8aae-8b2c016e791e.Text: The target ally immediately gains an {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}extra turn{/g} with twice the number of their normal {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} and {uip|ActionPoints|29b7ab2d3e2640f3ad20a5c44c300346} {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}, but their body is subjected to severe stress, making them suffer <u>5% of their {g|Encyclopedia:MaxWounds}maximum wounds{/g}</u> {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} at the end of each turn until the end of combat. Every action the target makes during this extra turn will also trigger this damage.

6112b9b9-53e3-4968-b0ef-07c8e91ba3a7.Text: Until the end of combat, the target recovers +{uip|Heal|1161a6715442449da47157aa60274a42} {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} at the beginning of each of their turns and removes one {g|Encyclopedia:ToxinEffect}toxin{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:Stun}stunned{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:ImmobilisedEffect}immobilised{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}bleeding{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:BlindedEffect}blinded{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:StaggeredEffect}staggered{/g}, or {g|Encyclopedia:FatiguedEffect}fatigued{/g} effect. If the target has several effects, the removed effect is selected randomly.

dd68485d-b0c7-4eba-81f8-62614736136f.Text: Until the end of combat, the target ally increases their {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} by +{uip|MovementPoints|b83829b067534eb0aaadab90b4d86452}, their {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} by +{uip|AgilityBonus|b83829b067534eb0aaadab90b4d86452}, and their {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} by +1.

feaf78b1-9483-44d3-b60d-3eb3e203aef5.Text: Divination specialises in gleaning information and using it to turn fortune in your favour. Diviners find useful insights everywhere, manifesting extrasensory abilities and glimpsing the future.

d1d2077f-50c4-4323-8b41-c092c00b327b.Text: Creates an area that lasts until the start of the psyker's next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}. All allies within that area gain +{uip|DodgeBonus|f03c1b80631e412490316e47528c211f}% {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g}. Their dodge chance cannot be less than {uip|DodgeMinimum|f03c1b80631e412490316e47528c211f}%.

8e19038a-6606-48d8-bddf-8548c1d71de0.Text: The psyker increases the target's {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g} by +{uip|BonusChance|4a7f14d3eed040fca5d96b51b4d070b1}% until the end of combat.

9b6777b2-982d-4cde-844b-8dce684e12c7.Text: All allies that are currently affected by any of the psyker's powers gain the perfect timing effect. Perfect Timing: when an ally under this effect {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodges{/g} or {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parries{/g} an attack, if this ally has a weapon capable of reaching the attacker and has an attack that costs 1 or less {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}, that ally immediately counter-attacks with this weapon, and the perfect timing effect fades.

48d0f5ee-01ab-4985-9ef6-1e6e04bd0645.Text:
Once per {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}, the psyker's next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} is moved up by 2 turns in the round {g|Encyclopedia:InitiativeGlossary}initiative{/g} sequence.
This {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} may allow the psyker to have 2 turns during one round.

110ceeac-2e61-4f34-a793-fa93003c688e.Text: The target gains +{uip|StatBonus|2a8341087cbb458b95bbe882a366642f} {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerIntelligence}Intelligence{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerPerception}Perception{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerFellowship}Fellowship{/g}, and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} until the end of combat.

e5a7868b-b3dd-4d97-86ea-6c23f55aa124.Text: Whenever an ally suffers {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} that would make them fall {g|Encyclopedia:UnconsciousEffect}unconscious{/g}, the psyker immediately gains an {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}extra turn{/g}. During that turn, the psyker can only use Prophetic Intervention. This power can only be used under these conditions. Prophetic Intervention restores the ally's {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} to the amount they had before the attack that triggered the intervention. However, the psyker's {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}psy rating{/g} is reduced by −1 until the end of combat. ! This power can only be used by psykers with a psy rating of 3 or higher.

a1dfadfc-dadb-425d-8f41-f9daf76090ba.Text: The psyker immediately falls {g|Encyclopedia:UnconsciousEffect}unconscious{/g}, and a random minor daemon appears in the psyker's place.

e85245da-f5b4-4484-b24d-eed43aa7fa75.Text: The psyker and everyone in a 4-cell radius suffer {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}<u>psy rating</u>{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} and must pass an {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} or fall {g|Encyclopedia:ProneEffect}prone{/g} for one round.

5215f211-d768-4431-ba73-267e0c655bc8.Text: Everyone in a 4-cell radius around the target and in a 4-cell radius around the psyker suffer <u>(11 + {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}psy rating{/g})</u> {g|Encyclopedia:DirectDamage}direct damage{/g}.

bbc83bf2-6eba-4fb9-841a-270b2fa1922c.Text: The psyker suffers {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}<u>psy rating</u>{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} and is {g|Encyclopedia:PushGlossary}pushed{/g} back by <u>psy rating</u> cells.

d32cd913-28de-48b8-89a6-46a08c6dd886.Text: The psyker immediately falls {g|Encyclopedia:UnconsciousEffect}unconscious{/g}, and one or more daemons appear in the psyker's place.

dab1dc67-8c4a-46a2-9441-e776afa409ec.Text: Lightning strikes the psyker and {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}<u>psy rating</u>{/g} targets around them (both allies and enemies), dealing <u>(2 × psy rating)</u> {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} to them.

af4c4b89-18a6-4aaf-bbf8-a4e86fb33f20.Text: Everyone in a 4-cell radius around the target is {g|Encyclopedia:PushGlossary}pushed{/g} back by <u>(1 + {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}psy rating{/g} / 2)</u> cells.

28cb5950-5a5f-474e-84a6-c422c34ebff3.Text: The target and everyone a 4-cell radius suffer {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}<u>psy rating</u>{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} and must pass an {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} or fall {g|Encyclopedia:ProneEffect}prone{/g} for one round.

b48be4eb-5708-4409-a44a-027b6f3632ea.Text: Everyone in a 4-cell radius around the psyker is {g|Encyclopedia:PushGlossary}pushed{/g} back by <u>(1 + {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}psy rating{/g} / 2)</u> cells.

e01a15f0-a48c-4fa3-9884-ec24574dbd77.Text: This character is a psyker, albeit quite a weak one.

7753778f-2006-4ac7-bc13-c43229e8e623.Text: Each level of {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}psy rating{/g} provides the psyker access to new {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic powers{/g}. It also strengthens damaging {g|Encyclopedia:PsychicPowers}psychic powers{/g}.

e52b434d-fee7-442a-a4a2-346f97da8fd6.Text: Sanctioned psykers have reduced (−20%) chances to trigger {g|Encyclopedia:PsychicPhenomena}psychic phenomena{/g}.

ce945527-afe9-4d0c-ae2b-44f90c503aff.Text:
This character is an unsanctioned psyker, dangerous and uncontrolled.
All {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic powers{/g} used by this character have 5% chance to trigger {g|Encyclopedia:PerilsOfWarp}perils of the warp{/g} and are resolved as if the psyker's {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}psy rating{/g} was +1 level higher.

531ef571-8b03-4041-a2cd-ba73d5091aa6.Text: Deals {uip|Damage|3ddbf131cbd54087a665d4b2e026b0f2} {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} to the target at the end of their turn, with {uip|Penetration|3ddbf131cbd54087a665d4b2e026b0f2}% {g|Encyclopedia:ArmourPenetration}armour penetration{/g}. The target creature must pass an {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a −{uip|ResistancePenalty|3ddbf131cbd54087a665d4b2e026b0f2} penalty to stop {g|Encyclopedia:BurningEffect}burning{/g}.

06f17528-44a0-4024-af42-1011dd6cca48.Text: A pyromancer is a master of flame, a psyker who is able to create searing infernos out of thin air. Pyromancy is one of the most spectacular and destructive forms of psychic ability, and those who face a pyromancer in combat are oft reduced to nought but a pile of charred bones.

fef9b8b7-a0d2-4b66-921d-c7cdeaad31d3.Text: Every {g|Encyclopedia:BurningEffect}burning{/g} enemy in combat immediately suffers damage. Until the end of combat, burning effects deal +{uip|DamageBonus|24f1e49a2294434da2dc17edb6808517} more {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} to enemies.

5ccdba34-8ea4-4a24-a496-eea845200ebc.Text: Until the end of combat, all {g|Encyclopedia:BurningEffect}burning{/g} effects will deal +{uip|DamageBonus|24f1e49a2294434da2dc17edb6808517} more {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}. Every burning creature in combat immediately suffers damage.

30a282db-12a2-4210-bab7-a6a87804746b.Text: This {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} can only target creatures suffering from warp burn or {g|Encyclopedia:BurningEffect}burning{/g}. If the target is an ally, this psychic power deals no damage to it. Everyone adjacent to the target (both allies and enemies) suffers the effects of the {g|f:a2cca43669184eaa9f0da981f204e1c9}Ignite{/g} psychic power.

2d04502f-d5d3-438e-a0f2-f0095c61a524.Text: The target suffers (from {uip|BaseDamage|a2cca43669184eaa9f0da981f204e1c9} to {uip|MaxDamage|a2cca43669184eaa9f0da981f204e1c9}) damage and suffers the warp burn effect. This attack has {uip|BasePenetration|a2cca43669184eaa9f0da981f204e1c9}% {g|Encyclopedia:ArmourPenetration}armour penetration{/g}. The psyker can move after using Ignite. Warp Burn: deals {uip|Damage|a2cca43669184eaa9f0da981f204e1c9} damage to the target at the end of their turn with {uip|Penetration|a2cca43669184eaa9f0da981f204e1c9}% armour penetration. The target creature must pass an {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a −{uip|ResistancePenalty|a2cca43669184eaa9f0da981f204e1c9} penalty to stop burning.

3e61ced9-4da3-47cf-bf5b-1134c2ea05cd.Text: The target suffers double the {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} of the {g|f:a2cca43669184eaa9f0da981f204e1c9}Ignite{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} and half the {g|Encyclopedia:FireDamage}fire damage{/g} of all the {g|Encyclopedia:BurningEffect}burning{/g} creatures within {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}line of sight{/g} of the target.

0cbccd4a-ad49-43b5-a2b7-44460dc6c087.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} of the target is reduced by −<u>(10 + 2 × {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}psy rating{/g})</u>% until the end of combat for every stack.

2a92eab8-dcee-412a-9207-b342b71b759a.Text: Deals double the damage of {g|f:a2cca43669184eaa9f0da981f204e1c9}Ignite{/g} to all creatures in a 12-cell line and reduces their {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} by −{uip|ArmourReduction|f31807528a974b86aa0910e46b844e9b} until the end of combat. If the enemy's armour falls to 0, it gains the warp burn effect. Warp Burn: deals {uip|Damage|f31807528a974b86aa0910e46b844e9b} damage to the target at the end of their turn, with {uip|Penetration|f31807528a974b86aa0910e46b844e9b}% {g|Encyclopedia:ArmourPenetration}armour penetration{/g}. The target creature must pass an {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a −{uip|ResistancePenalty|f31807528a974b86aa0910e46b844e9b} penalty to stop {g|Encyclopedia:BurningEffect}burning{/g}.

d8e37ab8-47da-4da9-b947-af702e28505f.Text:
The target does not stop {g|Encyclopedia:BurningEffect}burning{/g} and no longer makes {g|Encyclopedia:Test}tests{/g} to stop burning.
Additionally, if the target is an ally, every {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee attack{/g} that ally makes inflicts full burning {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} on targets of their attack, while they themselves now only suffer half burning damage from now on.

e0a72b71-fecc-4b0c-8f46-b93c1eccac0c.Text: A concentration of faith, sanctic powers are used by pious psykers to protect allies and smite heretics.

9a64d9df-7294-4b07-be9b-0596339b00b5.Text:
All allies affected by {g|f:6285e5ba2a804e3d9df1dd5f7fa819f2}Word of the Emperor{/g} gain the hammer of the Emperor effect. Next time they deal {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}, this damage is increased by +{uip|DamageBonus|d1c22cdb445543a08b6dbc9867503572}, and the effect is removed.
! This {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} can only be used while there is at least one ally affected by {g|f:6285e5ba2a804e3d9df1dd5f7fa819f2}Word of the Emperor{/g}.

c568210d-5507-408a-a6b0-55070df80445.Text:
All allies affected by {g|f:6285e5ba2a804e3d9df1dd5f7fa819f2}Word of the Emperor{/g} are healed for <u>(from {uip|HealMin|050815b9d2e947acb13b81072f9b7210} to {uip|HealMax|050815b9d2e947acb13b81072f9b7210})</u> {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}.
! This {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} can only be used while there is at least one ally affected by {g|f:6285e5ba2a804e3d9df1dd5f7fa819f2}Word of the Emperor{/g}.

0a4bbed9-e7c0-44b2-8778-6c41d0b5259d.Text: {g|f:4b401c668e0d46a7a09dba9d5480cdaa}Purge Soul{/g} deals +50% more {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} against enemies that have already damaged the psyker or any of the psyker's allies this combat.

6c626611-568f-4cc6-990a-93f9481e25cf.Text:
Deals (from {uip|MinDamage|4b401c668e0d46a7a09dba9d5480cdaa} to {uip|MaxDamage|4b401c668e0d46a7a09dba9d5480cdaa}) {g|Encyclopedia:DirectDamage}direct damage{/g}.
This {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} is increased by +50% against xenos, by +100% against Chaos worshippers or Drukhari, by +150% against daemons, and by +50% if the enemy has already damaged the psyker or any of the psyker's allies this combat. These damage {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonuses{/g} also affect any damage bonuses from other sources.
! This power does not affect targets that lack souls.

1b3a03a2-32a2-4f4a-8148-c0b91042f214.Text:
Until the start of the psyker's next turn, all allies affected by {g|f:6285e5ba2a804e3d9df1dd5f7fa819f2}Word of the Emperor{/g} increase their {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g} by +{uip|Deflection|c096aedc367c4cfe8c8ed8507319ebab} (minimum +1) and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} by +{uip|Armour|c096aedc367c4cfe8c8ed8507319ebab}%.
! This {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} can only be used while there is at least one ally affected by {g|f:6285e5ba2a804e3d9df1dd5f7fa819f2}Word of the Emperor{/g}.

73600e3d-aed5-4bed-97bf-fe50b1f3f659.Text: This {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} costs 50 {g|Encyclopedia:MomentumWithDetailsGlossary}momentum{/g} and can only be used when momentum is 175 or higher. Until the end of combat, the weapon in the psyker's hand is replaced by a sword made of sheer will. -This sword has a single-target attack and an {g|Encyclopedia:AreaOfEffect}area attack{/g} (like a two-handed sword) and can be used to release a cone of fire or a line of fire (like a flamer). -The damage of this sword is the same as that of {g|f:4b401c668e0d46a7a09dba9d5480cdaa}Purge Soul{/g} (with all the same bonuses). -If the psyker was using a force weapon, all the bonuses from that force weapon remain. For the purposes of {g|Encyclopedia:Talent}talents{/g} and other bonuses, the Sword of Faith counts as a force weapon. -This power can be used again, increasing the damage of the sword by +{uip|Resolve|20d5376f942f454daf37f2b81a81e7b1}.

00efac33-66fe-4b86-a117-8212f1b68956.Text: Deals the same {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} as the {g|f:4b401c668e0d46a7a09dba9d5480cdaa}Purge Soul{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} to every enemy in front of the psyker.

ba986531-0c72-4f0e-ad32-dbb29d486ac7.Text: Deals the same {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} as the {g|f:4b401c668e0d46a7a09dba9d5480cdaa}Purge Soul{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} to every enemy in a cone.

f03ce15c-d38e-4867-a02d-e13a229f1650.Text: Sword of Faith — Cone of Flame

176c063f-ae3e-49d9-8866-eb9111201706.Text: Deals the same {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} as the {g|f:4b401c668e0d46a7a09dba9d5480cdaa}Purge Soul{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} to every enemy in a line.

9aca3362-10c8-496c-9164-07b166a5bd20.Text: Sword of Faith — Line of Flame

0e0f4bf1-942e-4245-9a8a-b017828cc883.Text: A single-target {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee{/g} strike that deals the same {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} as the {g|f:4b401c668e0d46a7a09dba9d5480cdaa}Purge Soul{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g}.

c41f29eb-12ae-481f-ab21-235f23a44db4.Text: All allies in a circle with a 5-cell radius gain +{uip|Resolve|6285e5ba2a804e3d9df1dd5f7fa819f2} {g|Encyclopedia:Resolve}resolve{/g} until the end of combat. Every additional stack of this effect increases the resolve {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} by +2.

ca89c11c-b9b4-4f05-b6d6-07093848946b.Text: [draft]*Work in Progress. Has little {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}Abilities{/g} and/or {g|Encyclopedia:Talent}Talents{/g} to take at later levels.*

a6811960-bbe9-44c1-9121-08b156915e87.Text: [draft]The Psyker creates a 3×3 telekinetic dome on the battlefield until the end of combat or until the Psyker selects another area for the Telekinetic Dome. Anyone shooting at the targets inside the telekinetic dome from the outside, has a chance to miss as if the targets were in a {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}half cover{/g}. This chance does not stack with defense from covers and counts as half cover for all effects and {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}abilities{/g}.

7012a14c-ecbd-4b1f-8485-cce570fdcc2d.Text:
[draft]The Psyker grasps the target with telekinesis. Targeting a new creature when someone is already grasped by this power will remove the grasp from the previous target.
If the target is an enemy, this grasp crushes them at the start of every Psyker's {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}. The enemy suffers <u>(from 1 to Psyker's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g})+2×({g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}psy rating{/g})</u> damage. Using this {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} on a new target does not restart the {g|Encyclopedia:Cooldown}cooldown{/g}.
When someone is already in the grasp of this power, it can be used on the point within the battlefield, and the target will be moved <u>psy rating</u> cells toward the targeted point.

13dfa398-7474-4759-b39b-c74a6bd390b6.Text: [draft]The Psyker can {g|Encyclopedia:PushGlossary}push{/g} away or pull closer all enemies in a semi-circle with a 3-cell radius. The targets are moved by {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}<u>psy rating</u>{/g} cells directly away from the Psyker or directly toward the Psyker, and must pass a Toughness {g|Encyclopedia:Test}test{/g} with a −<u>2×(Psyker's WP {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}Bonus{/g})</u> penalty or fall {g|Encyclopedia:ProneEffect}prone{/g} for 1 round.

27b469c0-2e76-4ab5-9fd3-c8e094e260a6.Text: [draft]The Psyker pulls closer the enemies in a semi-circle with a 3-cell radius. The targets are moved by {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}<u>psy rating</u>{/g} directly toward the Psyker, and must pass a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Test}test{/g} with a −<u>2×(Psyker's WP {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g})</u> penalty or fall {g|Encyclopedia:ProneEffect}prone{/g} for 1 round.

97773e8d-6212-4fd2-a3a3-804966ecffc2.Text: [draft]The Psyker pushes away all enemies in a semi-circle with a 3-cell radius. The targets are moved by {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}<u>psy rating</u>{/g} cells directly away from the Psyker, and must pass a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Test}test{/g} with a a −<u>2×(Psyker's WP {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g})</u> penalty or fall {g|Encyclopedia:ProneEffect}prone{/g} for 1 round.

e6523dfd-7740-49b3-aecc-d5cc099105f1.Text: [draft]The Psyker creates a terrible vortex of telekinetic power, pulling everyone within {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}psy rating{/g} range from the edge of the vortex toward it and repeating this pull each {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}. Enemies make a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Test}test{/g} with a −5×(psy rating) penalty. Any enemy that fails the test moves psy rating cells toward the vortext. Enemies that succeed move half that distance. At the end of every Psyker's {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} everyone within the vortex suffers triple damage of Assail.

eda3f220-d752-4481-b524-e69e0f12b195.Text:
The target makes a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g}. If that test fails, the target immediately attacks its allies. After, the target suffers {g|f:fa305ba4e2aa48f394608d1ccfc6d385}Psychic Shriek{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}, and their Willpower is reduced by −{uip|WillpowerPenalty|a38a9a446f094782a8bc871ce473024b} until the end of combat.
If the test succeeds, the target just suffers {g|f:fa305ba4e2aa48f394608d1ccfc6d385}Psychic Shriek{/g} damage, and their Willpower is reduced by −{uip|WillpowerReduction|a38a9a446f094782a8bc871ce473024b} until the end of combat.

ed4933d2-f051-420a-a43a-a57658d8b9e7.Text: At any time until the end of combat, the target of Mind Bond makes {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerPerception}Perception{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerIntelligence}Intelligence{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g}, or {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerFellowship}Fellowship{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Test}tests{/g} using either theirs or the psyker's stats, whichever is higher at the moment.

287c5acf-3420-4aec-837e-bfceb48fd87f.Text:
The target makes a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g}. If it succeeds, the target is merely {g|Encyclopedia:BlindedEffect}blinded{/g} until the start of the psyker's next turn.
If the target fails the {g|Encyclopedia:Test}test{/g}, they become blinded and suffer an additional −{uip|StatPenalty|8c86972daac142fea33bb3bc5c84396c} penalty to all {g|Encyclopedia:Characteristic}characteristics{/g} reduced by blindness and must make a Willpower resistance test at the end of each turn. The first success makes them just blinded, and second success removes the blinded effect.

027225f1-09bc-4d3c-b1cc-2614d2e86e00.Text: Telepaths are psykers whose mental expertise lies in contacting and controlling the minds of others. With a single thought, a telepath can tear away their foe's sanity, induce states of mind-numbing terror, or possess and puppeteer their victim's thoughts and actions.

18b8d8b0-ed96-4200-97c3-ccef66fb980f.Text: The Bladedancer faces a side of their choice and immediately ends their turn. Until the beginning of the Bladedancer's next turn, they can {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:AreaOfEffect}area attacks{/g} without moving, are immune to all types of forced movement, gain +20% {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g} against attacks from that side, and can now parry attacks made against adjacent allies. While under the effect of Veil of Blades, the Bladedancer can even parry ranged attacks (except ranged area attacks) made from that side. The chance to parry a ranged attack is calculated as if it were a {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee attack{/g}, where the attacker's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}Weapon Skill{/g} is equal to the {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit chance{/g} of the attack. If an attack is parried in this way, it can be redirected toward one of the enemies on the selected side. The chance of redirection is equal to half of the Bladedancer's parry chance against this attack. ! This {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} can only be used with a sword equipped.

192785a7-bb02-4f0c-923a-689075a2333e.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerBladedancerGlossary}Bladedancer{/g} makes {uip|Attacks|e955823f54d24088ae1fdefe88d3684d} {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee attacks{/g} against random targets (including allies) adjacent to the Bladedancer, each dealing 50% of their normal {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}. Blade Dance is a melee {g|Encyclopedia:BurstAttacksGlossary}burst{/g} attack that does not count toward the attack limit per {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}. This {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} can only be used with a sword equipped. If two swords are equipped, the Bladedancer makes {uip|DualAttack|e955823f54d24088ae1fdefe88d3684d} attacks with each one.

c740ea9b-f265-4e90-be33-397787a080cb.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerBladedancerGlossary}Bladedancer{/g}'s next attack inflicts {g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}bleeding{/g} ({uip|DamageTick|ce30e102719a4671b660ffe5bff7c43d}) on all targets {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g}. These targets must pass a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a −{uip|ResistancePenalty|ce30e102719a4671b660ffe5bff7c43d} {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} or become {g|Encyclopedia:ImmobilisedEffect}immobilised{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}. All enemies immobilised by Captive Audience count as {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}full cover{/g} for the Bladedancer and their allies when adjacent to those enemies.

9b6bc2ac-a4fb-471f-958d-2afa2f8ec434.Text:
The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerBladedancerGlossary}Bladedancer{/g} leaps into the air and lands on the selected cell. Upon landing, they deal {uip|DamageTick|6f1b7cfb48a0450cb85ce8a8879502de} {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} to all adjacent enemies.
This leap can be made to any unoccupied cell within a 3-cell radius in the Bladedancer's {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}line of sight{/g}. This movement does not provoke {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g}. The Bladedancer cannot jump to a cell that is inaccessible in combat.
This {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} can be used multiple times per {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, but each use requires a charge to be spent and inflicts +1 stack of {g|f:542bb296d9c942a8a0fb5583290d3720}short of breath{/g} on the Bladedancer until the start of their next turn.
The Bladedancer gains +1 charge of this ability each time they kill a target (excluding kills made with this ability).
! Can only be used with a sword equipped.

4fb11f8e-9078-44cc-8ea5-9354153b1f42.Text: Each stack of this effect reduces {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerStrength}Strength{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerPerception}Perception{/g} by −10% and {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} by −20%.

9fe278a7-cf96-4968-bcc2-a6b80d71c1f5.Text:
The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerBladedancerGlossary}Bladedancer{/g} selects an ally. Until the end of combat, attacks made by the Bladedancer against enemies who have already attacked that ally gain +{uip|CriticalChance|3774147440ac412a876725b9b2b24682}% {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit chance{/g} and +{uip|CriticalDamage|3774147440ac412a876725b9b2b24682}% critical {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}.
This {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} can be used multiple times per {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, but the {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonuses{/g} do not stack.

a2fe61d8-a179-45ca-9e45-a59ff6aba14a.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerBladedancerGlossary}Bladedancer{/g} immediately returns to the cell where they started their {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}. This movement does not provoke {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g}. If the Bladedancer used {g|f:c3d6e29e74e440a79cb243e4e93e0501}Death From Above{/g} this turn, this movement repeats all uses of this {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} in reverse.

0a4a4e21-4d40-46fa-98bc-62803c6c8534.Text: Once the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerBladedancerGlossary}Bladedancer{/g} has killed four enemies in total, the next {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} which requires spending {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} will cost no wounds and instead restore {uip|Heal|bc9759f0c41a4a3e84300557bea51dea} wounds.

059a3a61-16ab-4f8c-80da-a6ee82ab0779.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerBladedancerGlossary}Bladedancer{/g} is healed for the first time in a {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}, they are healed for an additional +<u>{g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}TGH{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g}</u> {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} and gain +10 {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g} until the end of combat. Stacks.

da55a4dd-fc4c-4215-9f1d-ab6928e28663.Text: After the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerBladedancerGlossary}Bladedancer{/g} loses any number of {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}, their next attack deals +{uip|DamageBonusWounds|d6e4a21bf78c494e8e9b3d3b6ecca169}% more damage. If that loss causes the Bladedancer to suffer an injury or trauma, the bonus damage increases to +{uip|DamageBonusInjury|d6e4a21bf78c494e8e9b3d3b6ecca169}%.

b4f148db-9d90-4b45-a676-1b725410e06b.Text: Each attack made by the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerBladedancerGlossary}Bladedancer{/g} increases the {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} of all subsequent attacks they make this {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} by +5%. This effect stacks up to 3 times. Area attacks, burst attacks (including the {g|f:e955823f54d24088ae1fdefe88d3684d}Blade Dance{/g}), and any other attacks that deal multiple hits are considered single attacks.

508ed9cf-0640-4121-b305-24ce6d692cf7.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerBladedancerGlossary}Bladedancer{/g}'s {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:AreaOfEffect}area attacks{/g} cost −1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} less (but no less than 1).

43bf738a-912e-4e53-b548-76896b3d80e5.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerBladedancerGlossary}Bladedancer{/g} can use both a {g|Encyclopedia:DesperateMeasure}desperate measure{/g} and a {g|Encyclopedia:HeroicAct}heroic act{/g} in the same combat (but not in the same {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}). Whenever the Bladedancer uses a desperate measure, they gain +10 {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}Weapon Skill{/g} and +3 {g|Encyclopedia:Resolve}resolve{/g}.

616a2ff5-6f91-48c3-84b3-c1f184349166.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerBladedancerGlossary}Bladedancer{/g}'s {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g} is increased by +<u>{g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}TGH{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g}</u>%. An attacker's {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit chance{/g} bonus determined by the difference between the attacker's and the Bladedancer's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}Weapon Skill{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Characteristic}characteristic{/g} is halved.

93020b7d-3b78-41c5-8974-e4abe064873c.Text: {g|f:c3d6e29e74e440a79cb243e4e93e0501}Death From Above{/g} deals double {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} to enemies that have less than 50% {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}.

53f48da2-432b-4b91-ba37-60ea9550851b.Text: If all the strikes made as part of {g|f:de2fa09b36314b2dafe09c3e8354d214}Blade Dance{/g} are directed against the same target, the last strike deals double {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}.

c3fbb7d9-74d1-42e5-b74a-a83bbab9133b.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerBladedancerGlossary}Bladedancer{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parries{/g} an attack, the number of attacks made by the next {g|f:de2fa09b36314b2dafe09c3e8354d214}Blade Dance{/g} is increased by +1. This effect stacks up to <u>{g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}AGI{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g}</u> times.

69e3723c-ebef-4b58-866e-eeff390817d0.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerBladedancerGlossary}Bladedancer{/g} kills an enemy, the Bladedancer's {g|Encyclopedia:Resolve}resolve{/g} is increased by +1 until the end of combat.

d112ff67-d7b9-4604-ba86-55e01cd7c074.Text: Targets affected by {g|f:8a3834391538418fa35ad73861da942f}Captive Audience{/g} have their {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g}, and {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g} reduced by −<u>(10 + {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}AGI{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g})</u>% until the end of combat. This {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} is doubled for targets failing the {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g}'s {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g}.

de2c4091-98ac-469c-8135-f2821aaf4b8d.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerBladedancerGlossary}Bladedancer{/g} uses {g|f:fba331366f474215812e3633e016c459}Acrobatic Artistry{/g}, their {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}cover efficiency{/g} are increased by +<u>(5 + {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}AGI{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g})</u>% until the end of their next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}. This bonus is doubled against all attacks made by enemies during the Bladedancer's turn (including {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}extra turns{/g}).

1aba85e3-42e5-4ebe-9bd0-e08f45172896.Text: Every ally targeted by {g|f:2cb163315827418eb6708fb9f8f79d9f}Oath of Vengeance{/g} gains the same {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonuses{/g} as the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerBladedancerGlossary}Bladedancer{/g} against all the affected enemies.

f53fd4e0-4341-4392-bde9-62d803a62041.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerBladedancerGlossary}Bladedancer{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parries{/g} a {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee attack{/g} while under the effect of {g|f:0e1aff9bec3c49e2996001be4f56a3de}Veil of Blades{/g}, they deal 50% of their normal {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} to the attacker. Additionally, while under the effect of {g|f:0e1aff9bec3c49e2996001be4f56a3de}Veil of Blades{/g}, the Bladedancer's chance to deflect a ranged attack at an enemy is increased by +20%.

244fdaa7-350d-42df-b444-b3b06649f626.Text: As long as the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerBladedancerGlossary}Bladedancer{/g} has two swords equipped, the Bladedancer's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}Weapon Skill{/g} is increased by +<u>{g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}AGI{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g}</u>.

4b4cbd0f-d004-4f90-a411-4923ba04de17.Text: Any {g|Encyclopedia:CareerBladedancerGlossary}Bladedancer{/g} attacks made with a sword deal +<u>{g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}AGI{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g}</u>% additional {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}. This bonus damage is doubled if using a two-handed sword.

29a1b748-2d53-42d2-bb48-90fafc4e0752.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerBladedancerGlossary}Bladedancer{/g} uses an {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} that costs {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}, they gain +3 {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} in the current {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}.

edf13cfa-aa15-4981-a09e-cdcfac1def0a.Text: Every time an enemy is killed by the Blade Dancer's allies, the number of MP on the Blade Dancer's next turn is increased by +2.

741fdefd-616e-41bc-afa4-6480d92cfae7.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerBladedancerGlossary}Bladedancer{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodges{/g} an attack made by an enemy who attacks them for the first time, the Bladedancer gains +1 charge of {g|f:c3d6e29e74e440a79cb243e4e93e0501}Death From Above{/g}.

d418d53e-6c50-48a4-89a5-6cbb324e6ecd.Text:
As long as the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerBladedancerGlossary}Bladedancer{/g} has less than 50% {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}, they gain +12% {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} and +3 {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g}.
The Bladedancer also gains +8% dodge and +2 {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} for every {g|Encyclopedia:UnconsciousEffect}unconscious{/g} ally in combat.

3e84c648-47f6-4269-ac51-e0c91cdb7f23.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerBladedancerGlossary}Bladedancer{/g} gains +3 {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}Weapon Skill{/g} and +3 {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} for every {g|Encyclopedia:Injury}injury{/g} they are currently suffering and +10 Weapon Skill and +10 Agility for every {g|Encyclopedia:Traumas}trauma{/g}.

3974b7b6-4420-4b9a-9af1-9f5aeabe4f6c.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerBladedancerGlossary}Bladedancer{/g}'s {g|Encyclopedia:SkillMedicae}Medicae{/g} is now determined by {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}Weapon Skill{/g} instead of {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerIntelligence}Intelligence{/g} (if their Weapon Skill is higher). The Bladedancer deals +<u>(5 + Medicae / 10)</u>% {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical damage{/g} and can use medikits as if having Medicae skill advancement or the corresponding feature or {g|Encyclopedia:Talent}talent{/g}.

b3642310-37c1-4ed4-aaa1-82f96989032a.Text: Enemies attacked by the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerBladedancerGlossary}Bladedancer{/g} have their {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}Weapon Skill{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerBallisticSkill}Ballistic Skill{/g}, and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerPerception}Perception{/g} reduced by −<u>(10 + Bladedancer's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}WS{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g})</u> until the start of the Bladedancer's next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}. These {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalties{/g} do not stack.

377eff10-4acb-4fee-ab20-9a94e6b8d9a5.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerBladedancerGlossary}Bladedancer{/g} kills an enemy with an {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attack of opportunity{/g}, the Bladedancer immediately gains +1 charge of {g|f:c3d6e29e74e440a79cb243e4e93e0501}Death From Above{/g}.

c168a680-5ffe-4f76-895b-1b3b4e223c0b.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerBladedancerGlossary}Bladedancer{/g} deals an additional +<u>(5 + Bladedancer's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}WS{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g})</u>% {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} against enemies armed with a {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee{/g} weapon.

5d731167-fc5e-40e5-8da0-3fe17e94b468.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerBladedancerGlossary}Bladedancer{/g} uses an {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} that costs {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}, they gain half of the wounds spent as {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g}. The number of temporary wounds gained cannot be decreased by effects that reduce the cost of abilities.

329ae6dc-e057-4b6c-ab9f-cbd477beecbd.Text: After performing a {g|Encyclopedia:DesperateMeasure}desperate measure{/g}, the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerBladedancerGlossary}Bladedancer{/g} suffers 1 random {g|Encyclopedia:Traumas}trauma{/g}.

dc09cf33-7b06-4fbb-b371-95bfacfe24c0.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerBladedancerGlossary}Bladedancer{/g} uses {g|f:c3d6e29e74e440a79cb243e4e93e0501}Death From Above{/g} against a target enemy without spending a charge, immediately making a {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee attack{/g} against that enemy. The Bladedancer repeats this combination up to {uip|Repeats|d52b8f3b44434f2798cd3a01c97fd1ed} times against random available targets. If it is impossible to use {g|f:c3d6e29e74e440a79cb243e4e93e0501}Death From Above{/g}, the Bladedancer only makes a melee attack against a random available target (can be the same enemy).

af3f8447-093a-4a11-8e54-55baf8350dda.Text: Upon using {g|f:916fcf40f9cc410f9b0a810516089207}Death Waltz{/g}, the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerBladedancerGlossary}Bladedancer{/g} immediately heals to full. The cost of {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}abilities{/g} that cost {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} is reduced by half until the end of combat.
