29e580cc-4fe9-4a54-9465-132b050f980d.Text: {g|f:916fcf40f9cc410f9b0a810516089207}Death Waltz{/g} also grants the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerBladedancerGlossary}Bladedancer{/g} +4 additional charges of {g|f:c3d6e29e74e440a79cb243e4e93e0501}Death From Above{/g}. Until the end of combat, {g|f:c3d6e29e74e440a79cb243e4e93e0501}Death From Above{/g} deals +<u>{g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}AGI{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g}</u> additional {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}.

e54a11ff-01eb-486b-85ae-48a86360dda3.Text: Until the end of combat, strikes made by the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerBladedancerGlossary}Bladedancer{/g} (including attacks made as a part of {g|f:916fcf40f9cc410f9b0a810516089207}Death Waltz{/g}) reduce enemy {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}Weapon Skill{/g} by −<u>(2 + {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}AGI{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} / 2)</u> and decrease enemy {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} by −<u>(2 + AGI bonus / 2)</u>%. These {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalties{/g} stack.

19b57b40-35f2-44e6-9666-6c1232f7d095.Text: Upon using {g|f:916fcf40f9cc410f9b0a810516089207}Death Waltz{/g} after killing an enemy, the Bladedancer gains +3% dodge until the end of combat. Stacks up to {unit_stat|WarhammerAgility|bonus} times.

0db23d74-d7a2-43c4-b473-bd3f9d81689b.Text: The Soldier gives a sign that they are about to open fire. The Soldier and their allies will automatically {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} the Soldier's next attack.

f13d19f5-45ef-4f72-a4b5-8f7aababeeb2.Text:
The Soldier's next ranged {g|Encyclopedia:BurstAttacksGlossary}burst{/g} attack will have its base {g|Encyclopedia:RateOfFire}rate of fire{/g} doubled but deal −25% less {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}. All the shots will follow random trajectories.
Only works with weapons capable of burst fire.

df30d572-41ad-4448-ab28-1789ed875070.Text:
A Soldier is a master of all ranged weapons, quickly able to assume an advantageous position, from where they stand ready to rain fire on the enemy. While well-trained in a highly diverse range of arms, a Soldier is particularly proficient at blasting their targets with {g|Encyclopedia:BurstAttacksGlossary}burst{/g} fire and area weapons.
Core focus: movement and ranged attacks, {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}cover{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g}, burst fire, area attacks.

2c19798f-ab43-4783-a679-44fdab396b4a.Text: Allows the character to use bolt weapons, such as a bolter or bolt pistol.

8302fa9e-fb43-436c-ac91-696a21a66316.Text: Heavy weapons deal +1 and +10% {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} and ignore 2 {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g}.

6b796633-2302-4fa5-814c-55e53c22bd9b.Text:
Healing an ally with a medikit in combat restores additional {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} equal to <u>({g|Encyclopedia:SkillMedicae}Medicae{/g} / 10)</u>.
Using medikits costs −1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} less.

5354a9a0-92c7-43fe-b74f-b1313f8e186c.Text: Allows the character to use flame weapons, such as a flamer, heavy flamer, or hand flamer.

9d7616c1-a02b-416e-bd1c-cdb221886dab.Text: The first grenade use in combat does not spend {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} and does not count toward the attack limit that {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}.

8c9a2b1a-98af-4cd0-b2f7-a77f098d3f7c.Text: When firing heavy weapons, {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit chance{/g} is increased by +{uip|CriticalHitChance|1e6606f5500a4baba84c4351f36da215}% and critical {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} is increased by +{uip|CriticalDamage|1e6606f5500a4baba84c4351f36da215}%.

b6935da8-d6be-40d2-be43-b5cfa5fb727a.Text: The first {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} of each ranged {g|Encyclopedia:BurstAttacksGlossary}burst{/g} attack deals additional damage equal to the weapon's current {g|Encyclopedia:RateOfFire}rate of fire{/g}.

d0c9b9dc-bbce-4aa5-b34f-8e629eee3dc8.Text: If the Soldier {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hits{/g} an enemy twice with one ranged {g|Encyclopedia:BurstAttacksGlossary}burst{/g} attack, the second hit will deal additional {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} equal to the damage of the first hit.

e5c817c2-b275-44a1-bb2e-9e05ce701236.Text: The Soldier's {g|Encyclopedia:SkillDemolition}Demolition{/g} instead of {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerIntelligence}Intelligence{/g} is used to determine additional damage dealt with ranged {g|Encyclopedia:AreaOfEffect}area attacks{/g}. Deals 5% more damage for every 10 points in Demolition (instead of 5% for each 10 points of Intelligence).

8feb2b2c-5ed1-439a-8915-21670a0a5830.Text: {g|f:8638221f9caf46649cefcbd7574804d1}Revel in Slaughter{/g} can be used after 2 kills instead of 3.

961f28f9-d598-4fbe-a565-79c8be2f0925.Text: The Soldier's second attack action in a {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} deals +{uip|DamageBonus|1c82d5f20dfb4e8ab89f78a4adad66a5}% more {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} to enemies that have not suffered damage from the Soldier during this turn.

13fa6eca-8de3-4f2d-9115-261f125d5644.Text: {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}Cover efficiency{/g} is increased by +10% for full cover and +20% for partial cover.

281cd08e-1919-4947-8d1d-f2ba64c5bb9f.Text: {g|Encyclopedia:Reload}Reloading{/g} costs −2 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} less (minimum 1). The first reload in a combat does not cost AP.

19ad09af-61ee-49e7-a577-4807e2408a2f.Text: Whenever the Soldier deals {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}, their {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical damage{/g} is increased by +1% until the end of combat.

dda2b809-54cd-4fda-8b63-b8e9b0e36684.Text: If the Soldier attacks before using {g|f:7a76af1ef02c4699b62db147e2b9a172}Run and Gun{/g}, their next attack after its use gains +3% {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit chance{/g} for each cell between the Soldier's position at the moment of the attack before using {g|f:7a76af1ef02c4699b62db147e2b9a172}Run and Gun{/g} and their position at the moment of the next attack after use.

7732ccd6-d280-4cf6-8a5c-f9e7b759984a.Text: While the Soldier has an ally adjacent to them, {g|f:ba56eecb14dc4793a604c28017307500}Controlled Shot{/g} costs −1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} less to use.

737a4fd7-4ffc-4c63-b551-a8e0a549634c.Text: While the Soldier has {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}full cover{/g} against an enemy, the Soldier gains +10% {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} against that enemy, and the enemy's attacks deal −20% less damage against the Soldier and their cover if the cover is present at the moment when the shot is fired (even if the cover is destroyed by the shot).

2186ef95-a212-45e8-beb7-8fb49b68229a.Text: If there are allies in the {g|Encyclopedia:AreaOfEffect}area of effect{/g} of the Soldier's area attack, enemies in the area suffer a −{uip|DodgePenalty|661f9a1ac69f44fc881366af05f7c502}% penalty to {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} and a −{uip|ArmourPenalty|661f9a1ac69f44fc881366af05f7c502}% penalty to {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} against that attack.

09d62719-a598-4fd8-bc52-0f6c1a96fedb.Text: The next use of {g|f:7a76af1ef02c4699b62db147e2b9a172}Run and Gun{/g}, when used after {g|f:f509573bad85478b8f36e6bd97c943e4}Entrench{/g}, grants an additional +{unit_stat|WarhammerAgility|bonus} {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}movement points{/g}.

443fd153-5df8-47d1-8cf9-b1742cff6ccb.Text: The Soldier's {g|Encyclopedia:MediumArmour}medium armour{/g} does not reduce {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g}.

35bf69ee-e6dc-419a-bbc5-40abbe5c0ac1.Text: The Soldier's {g|Encyclopedia:GrazingHit}grazing hit{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:AreaOfEffect}area attacks{/g} deal 75% {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} instead of 50%.

7922c3aa-2295-4fcc-88fa-32bae5831295.Text: {g|f:1d48dfb6002a48f68bee0b86c4b56dc4}Dash{/g} does not end the Soldier's movement for the {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}. Enemies adjacent to the starting point of {g|f:1d48dfb6002a48f68bee0b86c4b56dc4}Dash{/g} will consider the Soldier their lowest {g|Encyclopedia:PriorityTarget}priority target{/g} during their next turn.

36577311-c15d-4c83-ab7e-bc3198203928.Text: For each adjacent ally, the Soldier deals +{uip|BonusDamage|09204d361b6d4fb786842e43ac1979db}% more {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} to enemies.

29e2e1c2-b6b4-42e8-b9c8-49f86da0d8d2.Text: Enemies {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damaged{/g} by the Soldier's {g|Encyclopedia:AreaOfEffect}area attacks{/g} suffer +{uip|DamageBonus|3feb70e54f244b0e96053909f4533606} damage from the next attack that {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hits{/g} them.

73afc8f6-4a93-4613-bae5-c72d98abcabe.Text: Whenever the Soldier successfully {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodges{/g} or uses {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}cover{/g} against an enemy's attack, they gain a guaranteed {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit{/g} against that enemy.

1c8c485a-d4c0-44a3-9816-99e1f81367d7.Text: Each shot fired by the Soldier grants them +1 {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} until the end of their next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}.

cf88e534-8c2c-49f2-aa8e-a8a01cbd11d3.Text: The Soldier gains +{uip|CritChanceBonus|bcdbde555de5492abae33d0dc285c956}% {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit chance{/g}. This {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} is doubled against enemies from which the Soldier is protected by {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}cover{/g} at the moment of the attack.

8b59ee80-4f37-46b3-b94a-a7897c8ccb93.Text: While at full {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}, the Soldier has +10 {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerBallisticSkill}Ballistic Skill{/g} and +2 {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g}.

e4e8c61e-9f08-4a0b-abb3-71084a6750d8.Text:
The Soldier gains the ability to make a number of extra attacks equal to their weapon's {g|Encyclopedia:RateOfFire}rate of fire{/g} (minimum 2), using the weapon attack that normally costs the least {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}. These attacks do not spend AP.
-<indent=5%>Until the end of the Soldier's turn, their first attack against each new enemy automatically scores a {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit{/g}.</indent>
-<indent=5%>The Soldier immediately reloads their current weapon.</indent>
-<indent=5%>Starting from the next round and until the end of combat, the Soldier's AP are reduced by −1.</indent>

12a1151a-eb0f-4964-9f68-b743d4af09e5.Text:
The Soldier gains the ability to make a number of extra attacks equal to their weapon's {g|Encyclopedia:RateOfFire}rate of fire{/g} (minimum 2), using the weapon attack that normally costs the least {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}. These attacks do not spend AP.
-<indent=5%>Until the end of the Soldier's turn, their first attack against each new enemy automatically scores a {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit{/g}.</indent>
-<indent=5%>The Soldier immediately reloads their current weapon.</indent>

52e91cd6-7f59-4cfb-b241-dfeea90b5e39.Text: Until the end of the Soldier's {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, they gain +4 {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} and their attacks do not spend MP.

d7ab3e1f-6f16-417e-a24e-6cae6a131914.Text: Until the end of combat, the Soldier's {g|Encyclopedia:RateOfFire}rate of fire{/g} is increased by +30%.

5f422703-2ba3-4cd4-92bb-22445956db43.Text:
Until the end of combat, all of the Soldier's attacks are 20% harder to {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g}.
Until the end of combat, the Soldier's ranged attacks gain +10% {g|Encyclopedia:ArmourPenetration}armour penetration{/g}.

753c45bb-e968-4bda-a019-2c0facd6faf3.Text: Until the end of the Soldier's {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, each of their {g|Encyclopedia:AreaOfEffect}area attacks{/g} deals additional {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} equal to the number of attacked targets.

0c3d44f8-a342-4683-a7c0-b46cc99aefaf.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerStrategistGlossary}Grand Strategist{/g} chooses one of the {g|f:e4e45f74936c4740b7bc03013f6991ba}Combat Tactics{/g} areas. For 1 round, all allies within the range of {uip|Range|7005fbf810a64264893cd18fc0187b39} cells gain the {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} to move to that area. This movement does not provoke {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g} and does not spend {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g}.

5ad182e2-9e18-45da-b400-3a7d0735217b.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerStrategistGlossary}Grand Strategist{/g} chooses one of the {g|f:e4e45f74936c4740b7bc03013f6991ba}Combat Tactics{/g} areas. For 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}, the targeted area's {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonuses{/g} are doubled. All other tactical areas are discharged and cannot be used this {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, but can be designated again next round.

5a607afb-c716-4e07-9195-70c7793a893e.Text: The Grand Strategist chooses one of the {g|f:e4e45f74936c4740b7bc03013f6991ba}Combat Tactics{/g} areas. For 1 round, all enemies in that area are forced to re-roll successful {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Test}tests{/g} against all attacks. Any enemies that suffer damage and are left with less than {uip|MinimumWounds|ab86bcee2036424c90dd12c2ad3fab39} {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} immediately die.

13529d9d-5673-4891-8413-39694ebe2bef.Text: The creature suffers −<u>(5 + 2 × (Grand Strategist's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerIntelligence}INT{/g} bonus + {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerFellowship}FEL{/g} bonus))</u> {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerBallisticSkill}Ballistic Skill{/g}, −25% {g|Encyclopedia:RateOfFire}rate of fire{/g}, and −<u>(5 + (Grand Strategist's INT bonus + FEL bonus))</u> {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}Weapon Skill{/g}. Additionally, melee creatures have their {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} reduced by −3, and ranged creatures try to get behind {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}cover{/g}. A creature counts as a melee creature if it has at least one melee weapon, and this additional effect does not work on some stronger enemies.

4c202309-6c31-4e52-ab02-6e3dff6543f4.Text: The Grand Strategist chooses one of the {g|f:e4e45f74936c4740b7bc03013f6991ba}Combat Tactics{/g} areas. For 1 round, all attacks by allies in that area inflict the {g|f:27c28c48cd154096afcace5ac4ec66b6}overwhelmed{/g} effect on any enemy that fails a Willpower {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} for 1 round.

62b80a48-78ea-4116-8b1c-8c45b8534730.Text: The Grand Strategist chooses one of the {g|f:e4e45f74936c4740b7bc03013f6991ba}Combat Tactics{/g} areas. For 1 round, allies in that area gain +{uip|BonusArmour|111f6e8111ae4d30a9d5d6d06027281d}% {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g}, cannot be overpenetrated, gain immunity to the {g|Encyclopedia:ProneEffect}prone{/g} effect, and gain +{uip|BonusDeflection|111f6e8111ae4d30a9d5d6d06027281d} {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g} against area attacks. Additionally, they do not suffer {g|Encyclopedia:Injury}injuries{/g} for receiving damage.

73652c02-a15b-4589-baa2-7b50f55106e7.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerStrategistGlossary}Grand Strategist{/g} chooses one of the {g|f:e4e45f74936c4740b7bc03013f6991ba}Combat Tactics{/g} areas. For 1 round, all allies in that area gain +{uip|CoverBonus|0e89f6eda1ae4960aeebfed0737289a3}% {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}cover efficiency{/g} and re-roll all failed {g|Encyclopedia:Characteristic}characteristic{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Test}tests{/g}. Additionally, cover in the area does not suffer any damage.

817e9105-0af4-478a-bede-4557b26ac23a.Text:
A master of battlefield positioning for themselves and their allies, the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerStrategistGlossary}Grand Strategist{/g} is able to increase the battle effectiveness of their party by designating and strengthening important parts of the battlefield.
Core focus: battlefield control, ally buffs, unique utility, enemy debuffs.

2bb18646-ca59-49ec-b4ef-3fae23adc3fa.Text:
The Grand Strategist marks an area of 5×2 cells on the battlefield — the backline. All allies in the backline area gain +{uip|CoverDodgeBonus|bc99e6ba256f45368bc6bc529e59effd}% {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}cover efficiency{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} and +{uip|DodgePenetrationBonus|bc99e6ba256f45368bc6bc529e59effd}% {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeReduction}dodge reduction{/g}.
The backline can be moved by using this {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} again.

8ff3f00b-0ad4-4319-b5e4-6f03572d85b5.Text:
The Grand Strategist analyses the battlefield and can create specific areas providing {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonuses{/g} to all allies including the Grand Strategist: {g|f:7cdf3a1dd3b5477096e008492e738587}Frontline{/g}, {g|f:bc99e6ba256f45368bc6bc529e59effd}Backline{/g}, and {g|f:b1e24d15bb6841d89b9873829f7b3ba5}Rear{/g}. In the first round of combat, all three areas can be created in one turn. In the following rounds, only one of them can be created per turn. All areas can be moved with the corresponding {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}abilities{/g} (one per turn) and cannot overlap.
If there are two or more Grand Strategists in the party, the {g|f:e4e45f74936c4740b7bc03013f6991ba}Combat Tactics{/g} areas are common for all the Grand Strategists, and the highest {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerIntelligence}Intelligence{/g} bonus and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerFellowship}Fellowship{/g} bonus of all the Grand Strategists is used. There cannot be more than one {g|f:7cdf3a1dd3b5477096e008492e738587}Frontline{/g}, {g|f:bc99e6ba256f45368bc6bc529e59effd}Backline{/g}, or {g|f:b1e24d15bb6841d89b9873829f7b3ba5}Rear{/g} on the battlefield.
Regardless of the abilities used, the Grand Strategist always acts first in combat.

7b42298e-3de5-4ce4-8fd9-11482cc34f9d.Text:
The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerStrategistGlossary}Grand Strategist{/g} marks an area of 4×4 cells on the battlefield — the frontline. All allies in the frontline gain a +{uip|ArmourBonus|7cdf3a1dd3b5477096e008492e738587}% {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g}, and all enemies suffer +{uip|DamageBonus|7cdf3a1dd3b5477096e008492e738587}% more damage from any source.
The frontline can be moved by using this {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} again.

5aa704c6-23f0-4d78-868f-fe70ecc8165d.Text:
The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerStrategistGlossary}Grand Strategist{/g} marks an area of 5×2 cells on the battlefield — the rear. All allies in the rear area deal +{uip|DamageBonus|b1e24d15bb6841d89b9873829f7b3ba5}% damage with ranged attacks and gain +{uip|CritChanceBonus|b1e24d15bb6841d89b9873829f7b3ba5}% {g|Encyclopedia:OverpenetrationFullGlossary}overpenetration{/g} and +{uip|CritChanceIncrease|b1e24d15bb6841d89b9873829f7b3ba5}% {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit chance{/g}.
The rear can be moved by using this {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} again.

1faf76a7-00c3-4717-b7c9-f7484ece4d14.Text: All {g|f:e4e45f74936c4740b7bc03013f6991ba}Combat Tactics{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonuses{/g} are increased by +{uip|BonusBonus|c44292911a6d404b928176a5371eaaae}% if the area was not moved for 2 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rounds{/g}.

99f28961-b780-43fd-8166-7859eb5587d3.Text: Using a {g|Encyclopedia:Stratagem}stratagem{/g} on a {g|f:e4e45f74936c4740b7bc03013f6991ba}Combat Tactics{/g} area for the second time in a {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} refunds 1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}. This effect can be activated once per turn.

d08c8e4d-33fd-499b-9155-c00a4cf38846.Text: Allies gain the {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} to reposition the {g|f:e4e45f74936c4740b7bc03013f6991ba}Combat Tactics{/g} area they are currently in at the cost of 1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}.

25e9ebfb-1b46-4ec6-9824-a62dde020567.Text: The first {g|Encyclopedia:Stratagem}stratagem{/g} used in a {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} can be used a second time for 0 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}.

a3b94195-01c6-4d07-83a9-e18f34362c3c.Text: Using a {g|Encyclopedia:Stratagem}stratagem{/g} on a {g|f:bc99e6ba256f45368bc6bc529e59effd}Backline{/g} area grants allies in the area +{uip|CritChanceBonus|e76b4151d3554a369e3801ba27a6a9b6}% increased {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit chance{/g} against enemies they are protected by {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}cover{/g} from.

a72097a8-4b5a-4308-9a9d-b6b74b6a8d16.Text: Using a {g|Encyclopedia:Stratagem}stratagem{/g} on the {g|f:b1e24d15bb6841d89b9873829f7b3ba5}Rear{/g} area also makes the allies in that area the enemies' lowest {g|Encyclopedia:PriorityTarget}priority targets{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.

059b13cd-a1ba-4ef5-a685-3326ae3d2d8f.Text: Using a {g|Encyclopedia:Stratagem}stratagem{/g} on the {g|f:7cdf3a1dd3b5477096e008492e738587}Frontline{/g} area grants allies in the area +{uip|DodgeBonus|1d4ab291faad4ed4aa3fa918a43ec0d6}% increased {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} against other allies' attacks.

214c99c2-96e2-4c31-8eb3-b1b51afcacfe.Text: Using a {g|Encyclopedia:Stratagem}stratagem{/g} on a {g|f:e4e45f74936c4740b7bc03013f6991ba}Combat Tactics{/g} area grants all allies in the area the {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} to move 1 cell without provoking {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g}.

1f6c02f4-bce0-4196-9cb5-72099273901b.Text: Using a {g|Encyclopedia:Stratagem}stratagem{/g} on a {g|f:e4e45f74936c4740b7bc03013f6991ba}Combat Tactics{/g} area allows the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerStrategistGlossary}Grand Strategist{/g} to use all {g|Encyclopedia:CareerLeaderGlossary}Officer{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}abilities{/g} on allies in the area regardless of distance.

7bf09a9e-832c-43a5-8008-afc46f2149cb.Text: Using a {g|Encyclopedia:Stratagem}stratagem{/g} on a {g|f:e4e45f74936c4740b7bc03013f6991ba}Combat Tactics{/g} area grants all allies in the area +{unit_stat|WarhammerIntelligence|bonus} {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g} against the next {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} they suffer.

38902ad9-0e85-40cf-a336-5e33df80644b.Text: Each time the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerStrategistGlossary}Grand Strategist{/g} uses a {g|Encyclopedia:Stratagem}stratagem{/g}, they gain a stack of the strategic perfection effect. At 6 stacks of strategic perfection, the next stratagem applies the benefits of all stratagems known by the Grand Strategist, then all the stacks are removed.

19627d88-dd71-4f94-a236-be71e7994dfd.Text: At the start of combat, the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerStrategistGlossary}Grand Strategist{/g} gains one random unknown {g|Encyclopedia:Stratagem}stratagem{/g} and can use it until the end of combat for 0 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}.

7d2d6844-1c42-4a1e-b009-ab6a9c008039.Text: Every time a {g|f:e4e45f74936c4740b7bc03013f6991ba}Combat Tactics{/g} area is affected by a {g|Encyclopedia:Stratagem}stratagem{/g}, all allies in that area gain +1 {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} for the following {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}. Stacks with itself.

a56cf2a8-c729-4a5d-a6b1-f6ff625390a1.Text:
If there are more enemies than allies in the {g|f:7cdf3a1dd3b5477096e008492e738587}Frontline{/g} area, all allies in the area gain +{uip|BonusParryDodge|4264c8ae4ca646fa97f42b5183ac5fd7}% to {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g}.
If there are more allies than enemies in the {g|f:7cdf3a1dd3b5477096e008492e738587}Frontline{/g} area, all allies in the area deal +{uip|BonusDamage|4264c8ae4ca646fa97f42b5183ac5fd7}% {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}.

41bcbdc7-e4d7-4396-be80-aaa6f874a6d9.Text: Each ally in the {g|f:b1e24d15bb6841d89b9873829f7b3ba5}Rear{/g} area gains +{uip|BonusCritChance|ec81fa9d154544bcb9f5bc3c1a8feb91}% {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit chance{/g} if there are no enemies in a 5-cell radius around the ally.

a0c44774-f225-4a46-9ca0-377e5e965a69.Text: If there are no enemies in the {g|f:bc99e6ba256f45368bc6bc529e59effd}Backline{/g} area, the first attack in the {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} made by every ally in that area costs −1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} less.

1bd81e40-44d8-4dcd-ad8c-dc6122cc5d1e.Text: Allies, including the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerStrategistGlossary}Grand Strategist{/g}, in the same {g|f:e4e45f74936c4740b7bc03013f6991ba}Combat Tactics{/g} area with the Grand Strategist gain +{uip|StatBonus|0baaa1db7cf44a52ac7cf9beee62f230} {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerPerception}Perception{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g}.

907c9e5a-cb45-4247-a0a4-aa96cc0a6164.Text: Enemies in the same {g|f:e4e45f74936c4740b7bc03013f6991ba}Combat Tactics{/g} area with the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerStrategistGlossary}Grand Strategist{/g} suffer a −{uip|DodgeParryPenalty|2821d25b055348b5977aa16143bbd73e}% {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g}.

adcee0fb-4a40-457c-aadb-5faa44706021.Text: Every enemy killed in the {g|f:7cdf3a1dd3b5477096e008492e738587}Frontline{/g} area increases all {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonuses{/g} of {g|f:e4e45f74936c4740b7bc03013f6991ba}Combat Tactics{/g} areas by +1 until the end of combat.

4610b1e1-9566-4fbe-93d3-a99e97bb5926.Text:
All allies in the {g|f:b1e24d15bb6841d89b9873829f7b3ba5}Rear{/g} area are healed by medikits for +{uip|TemporaryWounds|43087167f03b46ff9c28c9914aa47e54} more and gain the same amount of {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g}.
Medikits used by allies in the {g|f:b1e24d15bb6841d89b9873829f7b3ba5}Rear{/g} area cost −1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} less.

e18ebe2e-bcd4-40df-b020-9a77c720d83b.Text: Re-rolls forced by {g|f:b8c1d9bf80354d24b279945f1f6e81fb}Killzone Stratagem{/g} are made with a −15 {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g}.

5a42f8a7-973e-4964-8e71-3fa60c815f0a.Text: Allies under the effects of {g|f:6fdddfc22c7145e5bda65b5c96e28c3e}Trenchline Stratagem{/g} will {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:AreaOfEffect}area attacks{/g} without movement and are immune to all types of forced movement.

70342965-9433-4019-bd4f-eb2d0c7ec1ee.Text: After the use of {g|f:be619d39ec424c9daec488acf25ae86b}Combat Locus Stratagem{/g}, one of the areas removed by {g|f:be619d39ec424c9daec488acf25ae86b}Combat Locus Stratagem{/g} can be recreated immediately.

9d18b557-fb33-42c3-8599-65a75cc9fcbb.Text: {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance tests{/g} forced by {g|f:807137df735b46858a3e562b49bb89b1}Overwhelming Stratagem{/g} are made with a −{uip|ResistancePenalty|2758369cb14a43cdb72df3e7d1aad9cb} {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g}.

611ea718-1136-4774-93c7-0bd09f68d230.Text: Every time allies under the effect of {g|f:631bcfc164274b6382daace38b7ce951}Stronghold Stratagem{/g} should have suffered an {g|Encyclopedia:Injury}injury{/g}, they gain +{uip|TemporaryWounds|bb601b2b4d404a219b33426afcf1d783} {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g} instead.

8dfaf1dd-e5fc-4eea-b1c6-6d5dfd0462bc.Text:
The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerStrategistGlossary}Grand Strategist{/g} chooses one {g|f:e4e45f74936c4740b7bc03013f6991ba}Combat Tactics{/g} area. Every ally inside that area, except the Grand Strategist, gains an {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}extra turn{/g} with 1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} and 2 {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} at the start of the Grand Strategist's next turn.
For every enemy that was killed in the selected {g|f:e4e45f74936c4740b7bc03013f6991ba}Combat Tactics{/g} area, this AP is increased by +1 (up to a maximum of 3) and MP by +2 (up to a maximum of 6).
The Grand Strategist's MP are reduced to 1 until the end of combat.

c3d74487-ce84-42fc-bc1c-9ebee6177d4a.Text:
The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerStrategistGlossary}Grand Strategist{/g} chooses one {g|f:e4e45f74936c4740b7bc03013f6991ba}Combat Tactics{/g} area. Every ally inside that area, except the Grand Strategist, gains an {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}extra turn{/g} with 1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} and 2 {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} at the start of the Grand Strategist's next turn.
For every enemy that was killed in the selected {g|f:e4e45f74936c4740b7bc03013f6991ba}Combat Tactics{/g} area, this AP is increased by +1 (up to a maximum of 3) and MP by +2 (up to a maximum of 6).

161afc2e-3632-48f5-bb06-94aafe0be6c0.Text: All allies in the selected area also gain +20% to {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g}, and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g}.

29fa1f97-18b4-44af-872c-74b6d10d58fe.Text: All allies in the selected area have their {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}Weapon Skill{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerBallisticSkill}Ballistic Skill{/g} increased by +20.

68342300-8917-4b5f-8689-326fb7068326.Text: All allies in the selected area also gain +20% {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeReduction}dodge reduction{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:ArmourPenetration}armour penetration{/g}.

725a1083-d2d0-4ccc-93a8-919881afdc00.Text: The maximum number of {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}action points{/g} granted by {g|f:afece68fac504e339ffefed3da8e5dc6}Take and Hold{/g} is increased to 5.

074148f4-206b-446a-baa8-a857d4d663a6.Text: The Master Tactician marks an enemy. If that enemy is killed by one of the Master Tactician's allies before the beginning of the Master Tactician's next turn, that ally gains +<u>(10 + 2 × ally's {g|Encyclopedia:Resolve}resolve{/g})</u> {g|Encyclopedia:MomentumWithDetailsGlossary}momentum{/g} and +5 to all {g|Encyclopedia:Characteristic}characteristics{/g} until the end of combat. The {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to all characteristics does not stack.

1f3eef73-6e06-48fa-8db0-854233642b0f.Text: The Master Tactician suffers {g|Encyclopedia:DirectDamage}direct damage{/g} equal to 20% of their {g|Encyclopedia:MaxWounds}maximum wounds{/g}, gains <u>Master Tactician's {g|Encyclopedia:Resolve}resolve{/g}</u> stacks of {g|f:b669fe2c03a240fca1b3b2429ca87414}tactical advantage{/g}, and resets the {g|Encyclopedia:Cooldown}cooldown{/g} of {g|f:a113bd4f6b4145f7bea35ea1c0a160a1}Linchpin{/g}, {g|f:3c33178f69de4c46983635ff3838e4f5}Inspire{/g}, and {g|f:4f978989a35e4f01b7405c409c8efeb5}Strongpoint{/g}. Until the end of the Master Tactician's turn, these abilities can only target the Master Tactician themselves.

02eb8892-330a-4cdd-974c-49dd74875bc8.Text:
Can only be used on enemies with the unfinished business effect. This effect is applied to enemies which were attacked by the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerTacticianGlossary}Master Tactician{/g}'s allies (but not by the Master Tactician) and have less than 50% of their {g|Encyclopedia:MaxWounds}maximum wounds{/g} remaining.
The Master Tactician immediately attacks the target with a {g|Encyclopedia:SingleRangedAttacksGlossary}single shot{/g} or strike. This attack does not count toward the {g|Encyclopedia:AttacksPerTurn}attacks per turn{/g} limit, dealing half of the weapon's maximum damage and an additional +{unit_stat|WarhammerBallisticSkill|bonus} damage.

2522038c-5b89-41b5-bf4c-f1ba572e737c.Text:
The target gains +5% {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} and +5% additional damage for every 10 stacks of {g|f:b669fe2c03a240fca1b3b2429ca87414}tactical advantage{/g} the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerTacticianGlossary}Master Tactician{/g} has, but the Master Tactician loses half of their {g|f:b669fe2c03a240fca1b3b2429ca87414}tactical advantage{/g} stacks (rounded up). This effect stacks and lasts until the end of combat.
If the target uses a {g|Encyclopedia:HeroicAct}heroic act{/g} before the beginning of the Master Tactician's next turn, they gain +25 {g|Encyclopedia:MomentumWithDetailsGlossary}momentum{/g}.

77d1f51e-cdd2-49a4-9948-3cb2eae740a6.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerTacticianGlossary}Master Tactician{/g} has used {g|f:305858b91e6e4d89bff75431fa6030e6}Fervour{/g} this {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g} and can now target only themselves.

8644abbf-d4fd-46ee-9564-22566f2d15cb.Text:
The target ally or the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerTacticianGlossary}Master Tactician{/g} gains +1 {g|Encyclopedia:Resolve}resolve{/g} for every 5 stacks of {g|f:b669fe2c03a240fca1b3b2429ca87414}tactical advantage{/g} the Master Tactician has, but the Master Tactician loses half of their stacks of {g|f:b669fe2c03a240fca1b3b2429ca87414}tactical advantage{/g} (rounded up). This effect stacks and lasts until the end of combat.
Until the beginning of the Master Tactician's next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, the Master Tactician gains stacks of {g|f:b669fe2c03a240fca1b3b2429ca87414}tactical advantage{/g} equal to {uip|AdditionalMomentum|ca8040427b6d4a3d859991b62609b318}% of all {g|Encyclopedia:MomentumWithDetailsGlossary}momentum{/g} the target gains (instead of the usual 20%).

ee3f80f1-3450-47a2-b96e-759ee0282130.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerTacticianGlossary}Master Tactician{/g} empowers their next attack to deal +4% additional {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} for every stack of {g|f:b669fe2c03a240fca1b3b2429ca87414}tactical advantage{/g} the Master Tactician has, and loses half of their stacks of {g|f:b669fe2c03a240fca1b3b2429ca87414}tactical advantage{/g} (rounded up).

6c69cb1e-ddf0-4404-a974-174416d54268.Text:
The target gains +2 {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g} and +1 additional temporary {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wound{/g} for every 2 stacks of {g|f:b669fe2c03a240fca1b3b2429ca87414}tactical advantage{/g} the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerTacticianGlossary}Master Tactician{/g} has, but the Master Tactician loses half of their stacks of {g|f:b669fe2c03a240fca1b3b2429ca87414}tactical advantage{/g} (rounded up).
Until the beginning of the Master Tactician's next turn, whenever the target loses temporary wounds from damage, the target gains {g|Encyclopedia:MomentumWithDetailsGlossary}momentum{/g} equal to the number of temporary wounds lost.

b28edc51-4d8f-4400-b14a-386daf831adb.Text:
The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerTacticianGlossary}Master Tactician{/g} gains a special tactical advantage effect that allows them to empower their attacks. They gain +1 stack of this effect for every 5 {g|Encyclopedia:MomentumWithDetailsGlossary}momentum{/g} gained by themselves or their allies.
The Master Tactician begins combat with a number of tactical advantage stacks equal to their <u>{g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerFellowship}FEL{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g}</u>.

ff2e193b-c81a-4d0e-9b34-0d851b4bc5c7.Text: A target for {g|f:e627e3fb653840dab9661093828432c5}Finish the Job{/g}: this creature was attacked by the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerTacticianGlossary}Master Tactician{/g}'s allies and has less than 50% {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}.

3c644481-3108-4469-a05e-0c009b62ae2e.Text:
The Master Tactician selects a 3×3 zone on the battlefield.
All allies, including the Master Tactician, that have a {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}line of sight{/g} to any enemies inside the selected zone make an immediate single attack against a random enemy within this zone that they can target with their weapons.
Until the beginning of the Master Tactician's next turn, all allies that attacked as part of {g|f:7a6c78a5bc854a2b95aa9b3cc3e2a094}Last Volley{/g} suffer a −20 penalty to their {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerBallisticSkill}Ballistic Skill{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}Weapon Skill{/g}, while the Master Tactician's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerFellowship}Fellowship{/g} is reduced by −40 until the end of combat.

f050d2f4-afb2-4290-9f9d-91969d79e8f4.Text: Until the beginning of the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerTacticianGlossary}Master Tactician{/g}'s next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, all allies that attacked as part of {g|f:7a6c78a5bc854a2b95aa9b3cc3e2a094}Last Volley{/g} have their {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerBallisticSkill}Ballistic Skill{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}Weapon Skill{/g} reduced by −20.

a99938f5-1b7c-4968-bdc1-39d0f2d7d0e4.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerTacticianGlossary}Master Tactician{/g}'s {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerFellowship}Fellowship{/g} is reduced by −40 until the end of combat.

96ab5127-7701-4210-a528-b5339311a15a.Text:
The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerTacticianGlossary}Master Tactician{/g} selects a 3×3 zone on the battlefield.
All allies, including the Master Tactician, that have {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}line of sight{/g} to any enemies inside the selected zone make an immediate single attack against a random enemy within this zone that they can target with their weapons.

e5813b5f-f2d1-4cd8-a37e-10c253030870.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerTacticianGlossary}Master Tactician{/g} and one random ally make two attacks instead of one during {g|f:874c1ff6e51945a0ae4d4e33f3dc1b49}Orchestrated Firestorm{/g} and {g|f:7a6c78a5bc854a2b95aa9b3cc3e2a094}Last Volley{/g}.

9b5dec26-4266-4539-8c5c-9f5a96cb4dc1.Text: {g|f:874c1ff6e51945a0ae4d4e33f3dc1b49}Orchestrated Firestorm{/g} and {g|f:7a6c78a5bc854a2b95aa9b3cc3e2a094}Last Volley{/g} can be used multiple times per combat, once per {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}.

67985709-9476-49ff-a4b6-96783f8cec30.Text: All allies, including the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerTacticianGlossary}Master Tactician{/g}, that have a weapon capable of {g|Encyclopedia:BurstAttacksGlossary}burst{/g} attacks use a burst attack instead of a single attack against enemies as part of {g|f:874c1ff6e51945a0ae4d4e33f3dc1b49}Orchestrated Firestorm{/g} and {g|f:7a6c78a5bc854a2b95aa9b3cc3e2a094}Last Volley{/g}. Until the beginning of the Master Tactician's next turn, allies automatically {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} all friendly fire.

5fda2942-2540-4c99-bd85-ec2d7f3b04b2.Text: All allies, including the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerTacticianGlossary}Master Tactician{/g}, that have a weapon capable of {g|Encyclopedia:AreaOfEffect}area attacks{/g} use these area attacks instead of a single attack against enemies as part of {g|f:874c1ff6e51945a0ae4d4e33f3dc1b49}Orchestrated Firestorm{/g} and {g|f:7a6c78a5bc854a2b95aa9b3cc3e2a094}Last Volley{/g}. All allies within the zone gain +35% {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} until the end of the Master Tactician's next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}.

87d4d8a0-ade9-410c-8959-4aafef454fb9.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerTacticianGlossary}Master Tactician{/g} heals an ally, that ally gains +1 {g|Encyclopedia:Resolve}resolve{/g} until the end of combat. This effect stacks up to a maximum of +{unit_stat|WarhammerFellowship|bonus}.

4e61c018-baf2-48a4-8644-316b3900b2a3.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerTacticianGlossary}Master Tactician{/g} begins combat with additional stacks of {g|f:b669fe2c03a240fca1b3b2429ca87414}tactical advantage{/g} equal to the number of enemies.

2c980c71-a981-4e79-bcab-ba5108749ee6.Text: At the beginning of the Master Tactician's turn, if their {g|Encyclopedia:MomentumWithDetailsGlossary}momentum{/g} is higher than 125, the first {g|Encyclopedia:BurstAttacksGlossary}burst{/g} attack or {g|Encyclopedia:AreaOfEffect}area attack{/g} used by the Master Tactician this turn costs −1 less {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}action point{/g} (minimum 0).

93b86205-ea4c-4df7-9c80-8406df84c720.Text: All allies have +25% {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} against attacks made by allies, deal −25% less {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} to allies, and deal −50% less additional damage with {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hits{/g} against allies.

da53b422-cdef-4662-9130-c9ea1856c8d1.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerTacticianGlossary}Master Tactician{/g} deals +12% more {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} to targets with less than 50% {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} and heals +20% more wounds for targets with less than 50% wounds.

833a1dd9-dfcc-460c-b413-399f72208668.Text: After a {g|Encyclopedia:HeroicAct}heroic act{/g} is used for the very first time in combat, the Master Tactician's next {g|Encyclopedia:Career}archetype{/g} ability used will have its cost reduced to 0 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} on all subsequent uses until the end of combat.

46ae23f9-529a-4783-8ba9-349f71443f5b.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerTacticianGlossary}Master Tactician{/g} or the Master Tactician's ally uses any consumable item (e.g., grenade, medikit, etc.) or {g|Encyclopedia:Reload}reloads{/g} a weapon, the Master Tactician gains +2 stacks of {g|f:b669fe2c03a240fca1b3b2429ca87414}tactical advantage{/g}.

59bfd4a2-939b-49d0-9bf5-07f85490fa7f.Text: Whenever an ally grants the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerTacticianGlossary}Master Tactician{/g} stacks of {g|f:b669fe2c03a240fca1b3b2429ca87414}tactical advantage{/g}, that ally also heals 1 {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wound{/g} for every stack granted.

805c2025-7e82-4425-b70c-ed94e9edd761.Text: All the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerTacticianGlossary}Master Tactician{/g}'s {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}abilities{/g} work as if the Master Tactician has {unit_stat|WarhammerFellowship|bonus} more stacks of {g|f:b669fe2c03a240fca1b3b2429ca87414}tactical advantage{/g}.

afcde269-db50-4cc9-96ae-161836993d40.Text: Every {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit{/g} scored by the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerTacticianGlossary}Master Tactician{/g} grants them {g|Encyclopedia:MomentumWithDetailsGlossary}momentum{/g} equal to <u>({g|Encyclopedia:Resolve}resolve{/g} / 2)</u>. Works up to 3 times per turn.

91f9fa01-0b36-4475-9dd8-51ed668850a4.Text: Using {g|f:a113bd4f6b4145f7bea35ea1c0a160a1}Linchpin{/g} now spends only 1/4 of the {g|f:b669fe2c03a240fca1b3b2429ca87414}tactical advantage{/g} stacks instead of 1/2.

ab034076-6db6-4943-808b-673612884869.Text: {g|f:4f978989a35e4f01b7405c409c8efeb5}Strongpoint{/g} also grants half the amount of {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g} to the ally closest to the target.

cb9e2912-b3c2-40eb-9dd5-f344fd87c950.Text: Whenever the Master Tactician's ally uses a heroic act, the Master Tactician gains +5 Fellowship. This bonus stacks and lasts until the end of combat.

d59795c0-85c2-4eaf-b52e-c0a65a2d8078.Text: Whenever the Master Tactician's ally uses a desperate measure, the Master Tactician gains +5 Toughness. This bonus stacks and lasts until the end of combat.

93d6b2af-fde4-4306-b337-97c90b4259ba.Text: Whenever the Master Tactician's ally uses a heroic act, the Master Tactician gains +5 Fellowship. Whenever their ally uses a desperate measure, the Master Tactician gains +5 Toughness. These bonuses stack and last until the end of combat.

25ec6cc9-70c6-4492-8fea-038df94e7d6e.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerTacticianGlossary}Master Tactician{/g} gains +1 stack of {g|f:b669fe2c03a240fca1b3b2429ca87414}tactical advantage{/g} for every {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} they score on enemies.

046c159a-8040-4d39-b607-76ea501ebd9f.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerTacticianGlossary}Master Tactician{/g} or their allies gain {g|Encyclopedia:MomentumWithDetailsGlossary}momentum{/g}, they gain +1 more. Whenever the Master Tactician or their allies lose momentum, they lose −1 less.

22469972-c558-4feb-ae71-0fd3029411e2.Text: Using medikits on an ally under the effects of the Master Tactician's {g|Encyclopedia:Career}archetype{/g} abilities heals that target for additional {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} equal to <u>(Master Tactician's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerFellowship}FEL{/g} bonus + target's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}TGH{/g} bonus)</u> and removes an extra {g|Encyclopedia:Injury}injury{/g} without any {g|Encyclopedia:Test}tests{/g}.

cbf692c6-b29c-49a1-89f8-4b89baf7005e.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerTacticianGlossary}Master Tactician{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Reload}reloads{/g} a weapon, all allies within a 3-cell radius around the Master Tactician also reload their weapons.

1af4823c-a6d8-4d4f-a2d2-9092d4faa4e3.Text: Grenades and medikits cost −1 less {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}action point{/g} to use (minimum 0).

62d86600-c306-4ed6-913d-6a98c950e8e5.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerTacticianGlossary}Master Tactician{/g} spends {g|f:b669fe2c03a240fca1b3b2429ca87414}tactical advantage{/g} stacks on {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}abilities{/g}, the {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical damage{/g} dealt by the Master Tactician increases by +1% for every stack spent until the end of the {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}.

621dfbe0-e770-4aff-8f66-309dbabfba56.Text: The target of {g|f:3c33178f69de4c46983635ff3838e4f5}Inspire{/g} gains +5% additional {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} for every 10 stacks of {g|f:b669fe2c03a240fca1b3b2429ca87414}tactical advantage{/g} until the beginning of the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerTacticianGlossary}Master Tactician{/g}'s next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}.

4fa8da9a-a7fd-416e-989d-183a47de64f5.Text: {g|f:0d8a5197d82b4c0193a429c49a6b25a7}Assign Objective{/g} also makes the target suffer +7% more {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} from any source until the beginning of the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerTacticianGlossary}Master Tactician{/g}'s next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}.

3a88ff97-9194-46ac-ad08-13483c141704.Text: Every enemy killed by the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerTacticianGlossary}Master Tactician{/g} increases the Master Tactician's {g|Encyclopedia:Resolve}resolve{/g} by +1 until the end of combat.

0bbfdede-ecc8-4c6c-bdfd-aeea95815381.Text: All enemies {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} by the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerTacticianGlossary}Master Tactician{/g} have +10% higher chances of hitting {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}cover{/g} when shooting at the Master Tactician's allies behind cover.

ac970024-e414-4b3a-8ecc-bbf14506d270.Text: Until the start of their next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerVanguardGlossary}Vanguard{/g} gains damage {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g} against ranged attacks equal to the number of stacks of {g|f:fc83a8ac57e54db59c3bb70083dc385c}unyielding beacon{/g} on the Vanguard. Additionally, the Vanguard becomes immune to {g|Encyclopedia:PushGlossary}push{/g} and forced movement effects until their next turn.

86cdb82c-8d48-41b5-a27f-a7dd51e8df0e.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerVanguardGlossary}Vanguard{/g} gains +<u>(10 + 2 × number of {g|f:fc83a8ac57e54db59c3bb70083dc385c}unyielding beacon{/g} stacks)</u>% {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g} until their next turn. Whenever the Vanguard parries an enemy's attack, they immediately make an {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attack of opportunity{/g} with a −20 penalty to {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}Weapon Skill{/g} against that enemy.

67eab4f3-30a3-4d32-bc3c-5be101da048f.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerVanguardGlossary}Vanguard{/g} forces an enemy in their {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee range{/g} to immediately attack the Vanguard. All of the Vanguard's allies who are wielding melee weapons and adjacent to the enemy make an {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attack of opportunity{/g} against that enemy. The enemy suffers +{unit_stat|WarhammerFellowship|bonus} more damage from these attacks of opportunity and has a −{uip|DodgeParryPenalty|46e7a840c3d04703b154660efb45538b}% penalty to {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g}.

2af9a427-9ddd-4afc-87f4-8175424dc297.Text:
The Vanguard chooses an ally. All enemies in a 3-cell radius around this ally must make a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a −{uip|ResistancePenalty|dac2896f1b4249648300531819f4d31d} penalty. On a failed test, the Vanguard becomes their {g|Encyclopedia:PriorityTarget}priority target{/g}.
Regardless of the Willpower resistance test results, the chosen ally does not provoke {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g} from these enemies, can shoot enemies in melee range, and move as if not within range of attacks of opportunity.

f3f28f39-8c04-4166-8bfd-7970c579a071.Text: This creature suffers +{uip|DamageBonus|6d2666949acd442bac7a4ab914af0b1f}% more damage from the Vanguard and their allies. Their {g|Encyclopedia:ArmourPenetration}armour penetration{/g} against it is increased by +{uip|ArmourPenetrationBonus|6d2666949acd442bac7a4ab914af0b1f}%.

97fe3bf0-b97e-4280-8cf5-1bbdb49db25d.Text:
Until the start of their next turn, the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerVanguardGlossary}Vanguard{/g} and all their allies gain +{uip|DamageBonus|6d2666949acd442bac7a4ab914af0b1f}% damage and +{uip|ArmourPenetrationBonus|6d2666949acd442bac7a4ab914af0b1f}% {g|Encyclopedia:ArmourPenetration}armour penetration{/g} against enemies in a 2-cell radius around the Vanguard. If the Vanguard moves, the area of this effect moves accordingly.
Additionally, all allies that are in a 2-cell radius around the Vanguard at the moment when this {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} is used, gain the {g|f:a39d7daf9b884978a66ef00675b2766f}Following!{/g} ability, which costs 0 AP, until the start of the Vanguard's next turn.

c16a7580-c26f-4a4a-bf46-54372b53d07c.Text: The character can move to any cell within their line of sight in a 2-cell radius around the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerVanguardGlossary}Vanguard{/g} without provoking {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g}.

88785878-4bdb-4e5e-a521-ec11df699f02.Text:
An unstoppable force on the front line and a beacon for their allies. Even when facing extremely heavy fire, a {g|Encyclopedia:CareerVanguardGlossary}Vanguard{/g} only grows stronger in the crucible of battle.
Core focus: frontline leader, defensive support, {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g}, absorbing attacks, attack redirection.

8f3cbd18-54ab-4e59-a2f6-be1d3a8e43f5.Text: Whenever the Vanguard {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hits{/g} an enemy with an {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attack of opportunity{/g}, that enemy must make a Willpower {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g}. On a failed test, the Vanguard becomes this enemy's {g|Encyclopedia:PriorityTarget}priority target{/g} until the end of the Vanguard's next turn.

66d8ba72-e37a-41c1-9a45-5d14d7bce905.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerVanguardGlossary}Vanguard{/g} gains +{uip|ParryBonus|4306728a131248258985ea6a89d9ec88}% {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g} against enemies that consider the Vanguard a {g|Encyclopedia:PriorityTarget}priority target{/g}.

18c18649-113c-4716-94a6-bfe870dacb9f.Text: Each stack of {g|f:fc83a8ac57e54db59c3bb70083dc385c}unyielding beacon{/g} additionally increases {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g} by +1%.

2ad48501-ca13-43e2-89de-c88d90410a40.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerVanguardGlossary}Vanguard{/g}'s ally in a 2-cell radius around them is {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g}, the Vanguard grants that ally +{unit_stat|WarhammerFellowship|bonus} {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g}. Once per {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g} for each ally.

6a9c87c1-ffb8-412b-9a47-3928302aa395.Text:
All enemies in a 2-cell radius around the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerVanguardGlossary}Vanguard{/g} suffer a −{uip|DodgePenalty|bf4d485e8397405daed6d2d7de06fb57}% {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} against all attacks except the Vanguard's.
If any of these enemies consider the Vanguard a {g|Encyclopedia:PriorityTarget}priority target{/g}, those enemies suffer a −{uip|DodgePenaltyMore|bf4d485e8397405daed6d2d7de06fb57}% penalty to dodge instead.

cd039f87-60fe-494b-8aef-0ec9118532d9.Text: Once per {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}, whenever an enemy that considers the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerVanguardGlossary}Vanguard{/g} a {g|Encyclopedia:PriorityTarget}priority target{/g} enters a cell adjacent to the Vanguard, that enemy provokes an {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attack of opportunity{/g}.

a26704d5-8e13-489b-a7c1-1c222783fb42.Text: All allies affected by the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerVanguardGlossary}Vanguard{/g}'s {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}abilities{/g} (but not the Vanguard themselves) are −{uip|CritChanceReduction|42bac3ce18ad49d887db32af0aea9f2c}% less likely to suffer a {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit{/g}.

c3f102ed-c435-4971-ad03-8c3b9568943d.Text: While the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerVanguardGlossary}Vanguard{/g} has at least 1 {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wound{/g}, they gain +{uip|ParryArmourBonus|62e487f6dc7b4155a35582f33a10d5de}% {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g}.

325f24bd-84d1-4f24-bc26-e6b4ce766f74.Text: {g|f:a0df8194db8c4e65ba74defc0da50a76}Defensive Stance{/g} now has a −10 {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}Weapon Skill{/g} for {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g} granted by this {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} instead of −20. These attacks of opportunity deal an additional +{unit_stat|WarhammerToughness|bonus} {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}.

0e033ad4-7634-4b84-80e8-68dc3e65b6f8.Text: While {g|f:4a0836fc274b422c922d1327438b5847}Bulwark{/g} is active, the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerVanguardGlossary}Vanguard{/g} counts as {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}full cover{/g} for their allies and grants the adjacent allies +<u>(stacks of {g|f:fc83a8ac57e54db59c3bb70083dc385c}unyielding beacon{/g} / 2)</u> {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g} against ranged attacks.

afb318db-38a8-4eb0-9e35-e3ce8b3202f7.Text: The next attack made by an ally under the effect of {g|f:f3704377141641898e285c815c4ab1dc}Forced Distraction{/g} additionally grants +3 {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} to that ally.

1ef852e0-b622-474d-80e2-efefc264f65b.Text: If the target of {g|f:3307422c78e04b02953a87f147c18942}Provocation{/g} is hit by at least one {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attack of opportunity{/g} caused by {g|f:3307422c78e04b02953a87f147c18942}Provocation{/g}, the target gains +1 stack of {g|Encyclopedia:FatiguedEffect}fatigued{/g} until the end of combat.

9e61d3ba-16d1-4dc6-b106-618df4f1a2ee.Text: {g|f:483e603fb5ea47fa8d5b45d1c34f4104}Wall of Rockcrete{/g} now grants an additional +{unit_stat|WarhammerToughness|bonus} {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g} to all targets.

184ace8e-eb58-46df-8e23-c7ce95546c27.Text: Whenever an ally uses {g|f:a39d7daf9b884978a66ef00675b2766f}Following!{/g}, that ally gains +{uip|DamageBonus|34e432a3137e4dc29ef5ce4fae0b0492}% more {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} against all enemies in a 2-cell radius around the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerVanguardGlossary}Vanguard{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.

77c4683f-1f81-446e-88c8-89689f0e2fed.Text: While at maximum stacks of {g|f:fc83a8ac57e54db59c3bb70083dc385c}unyielding beacon{/g}, the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerVanguardGlossary}Vanguard{/g} gains +7 {g|Encyclopedia:Resolve}resolve{/g}.

13bd209e-b351-4077-a747-7f52c6020951.Text: For each enemy that considers the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerVanguardGlossary}Vanguard{/g} a {g|Encyclopedia:PriorityTarget}priority target{/g}, the Vanguard's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} is increased by +5%.

408fa4e3-cc2d-4424-95c6-c6cf9a296d1c.Text: At the start of the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerVanguardGlossary}Vanguard{/g}'s {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, before their {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g} are lost, the Vanguard gains +<u>number of temporary {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}</u> {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerStrength}Strength{/g} for 1 round.

a3f0f442-bba5-4e13-b0d4-6da8dd1a9d82.Text: Whenever an attack made by an ally {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hits{/g} the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerVanguardGlossary}Vanguard{/g} for the first time in a {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}, that attack deals no {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} to the Vanguard. If this attack is a {g|Encyclopedia:BurstAttacksGlossary}burst{/g} attack, this applies to each successful hit in the burst.

c4470db8-9b0f-47d3-a016-0e7fc71735c6.Text: Allies affected by any of the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerVanguardGlossary}Vanguard{/g}'s {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}abilities{/g} gain +{uip|ArmourBonus|73f6b026ca2d470c9e497583148b7650}% {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}. Does not stack.

3789d9de-5ec4-44ac-99d5-800db5470de0.Text: While the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerVanguardGlossary}Vanguard{/g} has at least one ally in a 2-cell radius, the Vanguard gains +{uip|ParryBonus|d24e2ca5840c4a3d858e1a180c83cf20}% {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g}.

8a725ef3-4e29-4947-ae60-a9e1b93a8b9a.Text:
Until their next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerVanguardGlossary}Vanguard{/g} attacks each enemy that attacks the Vanguard's allies in a 3-cell radius around the Vanguard. Additionally, until their next turn, the Vanguard always retaliates when attacked.
Until the end of combat, the Vanguard suffers +30% more {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} from all sources.

9365965e-b068-4daf-a5d7-5da86e08af5b.Text: Until their next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerVanguardGlossary}Vanguard{/g} attempts to attack each enemy that attacks the Vanguard or their allies in a 3-cell radius around the Vanguard. To make this counter-attack, if the Vanguard has enough MP, they can move toward the attacker. If the Vanguard moves, the area of this effect moves accordingly.

a229fac5-1002-4758-9fd5-071f9dc21a21.Text:
Until the end of their next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerVanguardGlossary}Vanguard{/g} cannot die.
Until the start of their next turn, all {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} suffered by the Vanguard is reduced by −{unit_stat|WarhammerToughness|bonus}.

61eb158d-b1e3-432c-826e-f375a2c359e2.Text: Until the start of the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerVanguardGlossary}Vanguard{/g}'s next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, each attack made by the Vanguard makes them a {g|Encyclopedia:PriorityTarget}priority target{/g} for the enemy {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} by that attack.

93edd685-ca5d-4537-8afe-4587ee6bbb4f.Text: Until the end of combat, all allies in a 3-cell radius around the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerVanguardGlossary}Vanguard{/g} suffer −{uip|DamageReduction|5ba4b5d2e2e242249a271800974865cd} less {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}.

fca65961-8538-4d67-b7de-6df7f4d5a2ae.Text: Until the end of combat, the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerVanguardGlossary}Vanguard{/g} gains +{unit_stat|WarhammerFellowship|bonus} {g|Encyclopedia:MomentumWithDetailsGlossary}momentum{/g} for each attack that {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hits{/g} them.

897a4222-5431-4bcd-b5ae-eb8cc65db44f.Text:
The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerVeteranGlossary}Arch-Militant{/g} gains the {g|f:b75d2649f75f4262975138d739bf822e}cautious approach{/g} effect until the end of combat, or until this ability is used again, or until using {g|f:e63c911438394fb69d58597549f65688}Confident Approach{/g}. Instead of the usual bonuses from {g|f:7f7d109653f24774939f758d094b8812}versatility{/g}, the Arch-Militant gains +5% {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g} for every stack.
If the Arch-Militant already has 4 or more stacks of {g|f:7f7d109653f24774939f758d094b8812}versatility{/g}, the Arch-Militant removes all {g|Encyclopedia:SlowedEffect}slowed{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:BlindedEffect}blinded{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}bleeding{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:BurningEffect}burning{/g}, and {g|Encyclopedia:ToxinEffect}toxin{/g} effects from themselves and becomes immune to these effects, as well as {g|Encyclopedia:Stun}stunned{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:ProneEffect}prone{/g}, for as long as the Arch-Militant keeps the {g|f:b75d2649f75f4262975138d739bf822e}cautious approach{/g} effect active.

569901db-1951-40b6-aa5d-94b23b7239f5.Text:
The Arch-Militant gains the {g|f:e63c911438394fb69d58597549f65688}confident approach{/g} effect until the end of combat, until this ability is used again, or until using {g|f:b75d2649f75f4262975138d739bf822e}Cautious Approach{/g}. Instead of the usual bonuses from {g|f:7f7d109653f24774939f758d094b8812}versatility{/g}, the Arch-Militant gains +3% {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeReduction}dodge reduction{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:ParryReduction}parry reduction{/g} and ignores 3% of enemy {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}cover{/g} for every stack.
All the Arch-Militant's attacks score {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hits{/g}, but the Arch-Militant's critical damage on those attacks is reduced by half.
If the Arch-Militant already has 4 or more stacks of {g|f:7f7d109653f24774939f758d094b8812}versatility{/g}, the Arch-Militant's attacks always deal maximum damage as long as the Arch-Militant keeps the {g|f:e63c911438394fb69d58597549f65688}confident approach{/g} effect active.

0b494cea-4159-4e62-b274-8c3b87113957.Text: <u>(2 × {g|Encyclopedia:CareerVeteranGlossary}Arch-Militant{/g}'s {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerBallisticSkill}BS{/g} bonus or {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}WS{/g} bonus, whichever is higher)</u>

cc5c1c49-32cc-4133-9f3b-0462613a27a5.Text:
The Arch-Militant's next attack, if it hits, will cause all the targets to make a Toughness {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a −{uip|ResistancePenalty|fe85384efebb4d38b71738594746e413} penalty. If failed, the targets will suffer a negative effect based on the attack's damage type:
-<indent=5%>{g|Encyclopedia:ImpactDamage}Impact damage{/g} knocks the target {g|Encyclopedia:ProneEffect}prone{/g} for 1 round.</indent>
-<indent=5%>Piercing and {g|Encyclopedia:RendingDamage}rending damage{/g} inflicts {g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}bleeding{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:SlowedEffect}slowed{/g} on the target until the end of combat.</indent>
-<indent=5%>Energy and all other damage inflicts {g|Encyclopedia:BlindedEffect}blinded{/g} on the target until the end of combat.</indent>
Power swords and power axes count as both energy and rending, while power hammers count as both energy and impact. Attacks that combine several types of damage will benefit from each additional effect.

a9a358bc-a3d2-4e69-8583-f7671973095d.Text:
The Arch-Militant makes a {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee attack{/g} with a kick, dealing {uip|Damage|22d6c1b32a6d47f4899a370e28cf16f9} {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} instead of weapon damage. This attack does not count toward the attack limit per {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} and counts as a single melee attack for the purposes of {g|f:7f7d109653f24774939f758d094b8812}Versatility{/g}.
This attack cannot be parried and will {g|Encyclopedia:PushGlossary}push{/g} the target 2 cells away.

3b27fff4-79a0-473e-94c2-d91f5ca353b2.Text:
The Arch-Militant immediately gains +{uip|MovementPoints|801926b855d64391b465b6d75796a19a} {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g}.
If the Arch-Militant has stacks of {g|f:7f7d109653f24774939f758d094b8812}versatility{/g}, they gain +3 more stacks of {g|f:7f7d109653f24774939f758d094b8812}versatility{/g} which last until the end of their {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}.

92307861-6baa-4831-a9c0-7b3d6cfcfc16.Text:
The Arch-Militant's next attack this {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} will cost 0 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} and will not count toward the attack limit per turn.
The cost of this {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} is reduced by −1 AP for every 4 stacks of {g|f:7f7d109653f24774939f758d094b8812}versatility{/g} (minimum 1).

0caa0bd4-d2aa-44d4-a1e6-497e6fad2781.Text:
An Arch-Militant is a formidable master of warfare, able to blend various weapons and styles mid-combat. Be it {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee{/g}, or ranged, or anything in between — the Arch-Militant is the best at it, and becomes stronger and stronger with each second in battle.
Core focus: versatility, large {g|Encyclopedia:AreaOfEffect}area attacks{/g}, personal buffs, weapon set rotation, crowd control.

920c453b-ae7f-4b44-8f03-9517618647ae.Text:
Whenever the Arch-Militant uses an attack that is of a different type from their previous attack, the Arch-Militant gains a stack of versatility. Valid attack types are: {g|Encyclopedia:SingleRangedAttacksGlossary}single-shot{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee{/g} attack (single-target or {g|Encyclopedia:BurstAttacksGlossary}burst{/g}), area melee, area ranged, or ranged burst.
The Arch-Militant gains +3 Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill for every stack of versatility.
If the Arch-Militant has 4 or more stacks of versatility, the Arch-Militant deals an additional +<u>(10 + WS {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g})</u>% or +<u>(10 + BS bonus)</u>% damage, whichever is highest.

34e5aab9-8ec9-48df-bab1-d4dc3554f65c.Text:
When the Arch-Militant attacks targets that have their {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} reduced by any effects applied by the Arch-Militant's allies, the Arch-Militant deals +10% {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}.

995b8c44-a190-4c50-b1c3-8af2387e1595.Text: Every psychic or Navigator power used by the wearer's ally deals additional direct damage to all enemies in combat equal to {uip|Damage|5b436aeed46e49b292e4bb4c0f2056a5}.

0d8f5d6a-d5e7-445b-a102-0fa1187fa91e.Text: If any of the wearer's characteristics are more than 100, all characteristics that are less than 90 are increased by +10.

Whenever the wearer's {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} should be decreased to 0 for the first time in combat, they are restored up to 50% of their {g|Encyclopedia:MaxWounds}maximum wounds{/g} instead.

9712ed5b-bb5d-44db-9836-b59b2ec7847f.Text: If the target of the wearer's ranged attack fails a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a −10 {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g}, that attack inflicts {g|f:1711d1c36c8f40a9a8cb557515d0f31f}exhaustion{/g} on that target.

5791ce42-4c84-4d5b-9f33-ea65f687f62b.Text: This attack deals <u>(from 10 to 14)</u> {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} and has 40% {g|Encyclopedia:ArmourPenetration}armour penetration{/g}.

e6b803e3-20fd-428d-88a3-523ae5a496f8.Text:
A ring weapon that fires a single melta shot.
Can only be used once per combat.

82f39805-edd2-43ca-9b3d-85e02c5725c8.Text: If the wearer did not spend {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} during their {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, they gain +10 to all their {g|Encyclopedia:Characteristic}characteristics{/g} next turn.

347c688c-811a-42f9-8c47-33fdf9c59a3e.Text: Whenever the wearer uses a non-attacking consumable item (e.g. stimulant, medikit, etc.), it counts as an attack of a different type than the previous attack for the purposes of {g|f:7f7d109653f24774939f758d094b8812}Versatility{/g}. Also, this combi-tool grants a 50% chance that a consumable item will not be spent when used.

cfd72b7e-2240-447b-8656-ec40448750a7.Text: Whenever the wearer uses a major {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g}, they gain +{uip|Damage|c8def6e18b5e47f68cfadef7ee0ecbb2}% to all psychic power damage until the end of their next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}.

e8ec325c-ed87-43ec-ba51-3eabf4775707.Text: This character has their {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g} increased. Upon taking damage and losing non-temporary {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}, the effect is lost.

23758468-7fc7-4350-b88a-3a35acfb943a.Text: A marvellous compact weapon in the form of a ring that allows the wearer to fire a {g|f:9ab94c22f40147a0a04edc58ca7ff29e}Toxic Needle{/g} once per combat.

16f4f3c4-d751-4159-8e79-1d2ceb685ed0.Text: The wearer gains a permanent +{uip|Damage|6ea380e19640428c9c74235a5d52cc61} (rounded down) {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:DirectDamage}direct damage{/g}. This bonus is doubled if the wearer's attack triggers an {g|Encyclopedia:Opening}opening{/g}.

a17860b3-a906-40e6-9be5-06461270846b.Text: Whenever the wearer targets 3 or more enemies with one attack, those targets suffer −{uip|Penalty|9d6ff11d926343b1a22c210b27ee4575}% {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} until the end of combat.

208bfa95-d9fa-4e49-b6e2-6cdbfe18690a.Text: Each of the wearer's single attacks gains +10% {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} for each {g|Encyclopedia:NegativeEffectTypesGlossary}negative effect{/g} on the target.

091cff14-4942-491a-86dc-d38cef6e2256.Text:
At the start of the wearer's turn, they gain {uip|THP|7476be1b085d4e17a558d3b9f25a87d1} {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g}. When the wearer's {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} drop to 0, they fall {g|Encyclopedia:ProneEffect}prone{/g}, and gain 10% of their {g|Encyclopedia:MaxWounds}maximum wounds{/g} as temporary wounds. The wearer becomes the {g|Encyclopedia:PriorityTarget}priority target{/g} of adjacent enemies. While prone, if the wearer has no other allies with more than 0 wounds, they and their allies die.
On the wearer's next turn, they regain 30% of their wounds if they still have temporary wounds.
This effect activates only once per round.

317f1436-7da8-4f0d-ac85-d30044bc1e56.Text: A marvellous compact weapon in the form of a ring that allows the wearer to fire a {g|f:c23c91c1dd3f45aa86ba38a9478823b4}Plasma Shot{/g} once per combat.

f212729d-9c70-4531-bb40-1a72ef4b45cd.Text: Using {g|Encyclopedia:Reload}reload{/g} for any weapon costs −1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} less. (Minimum 0)

807148f5-b70c-4793-9aa5-baafbaa4269d.Text: If an ally under the effect of the wearer's {g|f:5bfccf14d8604ae1a041fb347fb8f19f}Bring It Down!{/g} ability successfully {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hits{/g} an enemy with an attack or targets them with an {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g}, the wearer gains +1 {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerFellowship}Fellowship{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} until the end of combat for each different enemy hit or targeted.

9a125753-4ef1-4a1b-8f42-3f85bd9859c1.Text: Whenever the wearer {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodges{/g} an attack, they become a {g|Encyclopedia:PriorityTarget}priority target{/g} for the attacker until the wearer's next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}.

81a35846-1d71-4a33-89b0-63acbed84f74.Text: The wearer gains a {uip|Ignore|d7877eeb7dd44b9595cce50113fbf2e5}% chance to ignore any incoming {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}.

0fcd1c50-4537-4e6b-b69e-d82e42d25d28.Text:
Whenever the wearer suffers an attack from a daemon or {g|Encyclopedia:WarpDamage}warp damage{/g}, they inflict {g|Encyclopedia:BurningEffect}burning{/g} (8) to all adjacent enemies.
All burning effects inflicted by the wearer deal double {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} if they target daemons or psykers.

763bd3b9-e2d4-4e30-b090-7083a2f288d6.Text: Wielder gains a +5% chance to reduce incoming {g|Encyclopedia:WarpDamage}warp damage{/g} by half for each point of {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g}.

Grants +20 {g|Encyclopedia:SkillLoreImperium}Lore (Imperium){/g}.
The wearer gains +{uip|Bonus|65635384b5de4f9aadee246bdbf9b694}% {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} and deals +{uip|Bonus|65635384b5de4f9aadee246bdbf9b694}% {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical damage{/g} to xenos and daemons.
Also, they can re-roll a failed {g|Encyclopedia:Test}test{/g} once per test.

8682e5ee-3f27-48fc-84f6-5ae9a3cacc76.Text: Every time when more than 2 targets are {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damaged{/g} by the wielder's {g|Encyclopedia:AreaOfEffect}area attack{/g}, the wielder gains +{uip|Momentum|5b6bc935bd664ed0b35c7f128b193cc5} {g|Encyclopedia:MomentumWithDetailsGlossary}momentum{/g}.

d6e4690c-1625-45da-8ce3-f7d57f158160.Text: At the beginning of the combat, the wearer gains the {g|f:f9b2e0f3583a491c91ad19d72e2d2024}shadow field{/g} effect. While under this effect, the wearer counts as being in a {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}full cover{/g} against all {g|Encyclopedia:RangeAreaAttacksGlossary}ranged attacks{/g}. The effect is lost when the wearer is {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} by a ranged attack and suffers {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} from it.

bc57dd0b-9c3e-4fb8-9af1-85e98fb25faa.Text: Grants the wearer +5% {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit chance{/g} and +5 {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}Weapon Skill{/g}, but reduces {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g} by −5%.

1bc44f70-a7f1-467e-844c-63a68f01f1d7.Text: Whenever the wearer kills an enemy with {g|f:e955823f54d24088ae1fdefe88d3684d}Blade Dance{/g}, other enemies adjacent to the wearer become staggered for 1 round.

4cb9749c-7795-4ea5-8628-590630683ece.Text: The wearer's non-attack {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic powers{/g} cost −1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} less during the wearer's first {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} in combat.

6f64fc9c-b687-4a0d-ab9d-b476657b20ca.Text: A marvellous compact weapon in the form of a ring that allows the wearer to fire a {g|f:8d027d39ba084d95ac87af84b59c9029}Stinger Shot{/g} once per combat.

47586fe8-3aae-47d1-8c7f-bc5b396e0bfe.Text: If the target fails a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g}, it becomes {g|Encyclopedia:Stun}stunned{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.

48165717-e225-47be-b93d-79e6b6a95b65.Text: At the beginning of the wearer's {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, all enemies in a 3-cell radius gain +1 stack of {g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}bleeding{/g} for each common effect on this enemy.

This manual grants the owner +{uip|Bonus|335b5f2e8a654604b2d279e91c5e54c5} to {g|Encyclopedia:SkillMedicae}Medicae{/g}.
