c8743a84-e6ab-4a2c-a0f0-05a710be0f65.Text: The wearer of this amulet gains a +10 {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:SkillCommerce}Commerce{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:SkillLoreImperium}Lore (Imperium){/g}.

cf396fad-ae63-4902-80e8-7c3244a129a4.Text: The wearer deals +10% more damage to xenos and daemons. If the wearer has Conviction — Dogmatic, this bonus is doubled.

cc561346-e33f-47d1-8db1-e7ff4163c456.Text: Enemies that are targeted by the wearer's psychic {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}abilities{/g} must pass a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a −15 penalty or suffer {g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}bleeding{/g} (10) and {g|Encyclopedia:BlindedEffect}blinded{/g}.

d5c8582a-05dd-4d7d-a3f0-f73db4bdb05d.Text: Whenever the wearer attacks any target in a 5-cell radius around them with a {g|Encyclopedia:RangeAreaAttacksGlossary}ranged weapon{/g}, this attack deals {uip|ArmourPen|a6765d2f82434282a2bde6d959e3b6b8}% more {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}.

f7dbbe93-ca30-47df-ad7e-d1c0a14e09c2.Text:
This item grants its owner a +25 {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:SkillTechUse}Tech-Use{/g}.
If the owner has medium or heavy {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} equipped, at the start of their first {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} in combat, they gain +{uip|Armour|326c14c03f8a44829037d9319ccaa6a9}% armour.

b4d96cbd-7354-47cc-91b5-fbdb48262a98.Text: This ring grants the wearer a +5 {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerFellowship}Fellowship{/g}. It also increases {g|Encyclopedia:Resolve}resolve{/g} by +1.

8922a79d-b8eb-4e09-bfb6-dca7736b6500.Text: Whenever the wearer's ally under the effect of the {g|f:6f6d2e22b4e744dd9e777b769c1aa167}Joint Analysis{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hits{/g} a target with an {g|Encyclopedia:Exploit}exploit{/g}, the wearer gains +5 {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerPerception}Perception{/g}.

dd6e4ac2-974f-4e42-8fa0-f00f64b96daf.Text:
If the wearer did not move during their turn or became {g|Encyclopedia:ImmobilisedEffect}immobilised{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:SlowedEffect}slowed{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:Stun}stunned{/g}, or knocked {g|Encyclopedia:ProneEffect}prone{/g}, they gain temporary wounds equal to {uip|THP|d1db3deaf73d415ca8a0b3a9e3652685}.
If the wearer has Conviction — Iconoclast, all their allies immediately gain the same number of temporary wounds.

8a00eba0-392b-47d8-a680-e9f10b863211.Text: When the wearer uses {g|f:ba56eecb14dc4793a604c28017307500}Controlled Shot{/g}, any enemies adjacent to the wearer's allies suffer a −30% {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} against the wearer's next attack.

02090245-62aa-456f-b1bf-31344e92563d.Text: Whenever the wearer suffers a critical hit, the attacker immediately suffers {unit_stat|WarhammerWillpower|bonus} warp damage.

a30e637c-5f6d-4538-ad2c-8b3dae9aa8fa.Text: The symbol of the Imperium gleams proudly under a crust of purple psychic ice. The frozen shell bears faint fingerprints left by Choirmaster Weisz in the midst of his desperate struggle against the warp.

0ad5c806-6942-4ab1-978a-0bb07226f170.Text: On their first non-{g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}extra turn{/g} in combat, the wearer gains a number of additional attacks equal to their {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}psy rating{/g}.

90672f1d-7951-4be5-bbc6-3ef7c6a173eb.Text: Any {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} with the wearer's single attacks inflict +1 stack of {g|Encyclopedia:FatiguedEffect}fatigued{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:DisturbedEffect}disturbed{/g}, and {g|Encyclopedia:PerplexedEffect}perplexed{/g} for 2 rounds if the target fails an {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Test}test{/g}. Stacks.

ab4c8cd6-256c-448d-9a58-edb753c7cf4b.Text: At the start of combat, inflicts the {g|Encyclopedia:Prey}prey{/g} effect on the enemy with the highest number of {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} without spending a charge of {g|f:802d21391d2f4573bfff126023df39bb}Hunt Down the Prey{/g} and grants a double {g|f:802d21391d2f4573bfff126023df39bb}Hunt Down the Prey{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} for killing it.

09b6f169-2650-48f7-804d-6154bdebcba8.Text: On target kill, assigned officer restores 2 AP and 2 MP. [One Ground Operation]

12211c7f-d7f7-4554-a101-f70d22579556.Text: Herald of the King of Distortion

6b747131-12d6-4194-a450-7137bb4239ed.Text: Herald of the King of Distortion

a0669c1c-df13-42cd-bf6a-7fce1a73154e.Text: The old servants of the dynasty noted the participation of Abelard Werserian in the Magnae Accessio and appreciate such distinguished continuity.

46ddd010-199a-4def-966f-0f920290057b.Text: Faithful subjects noted the participation of Sister Argenta in the Magnae Accessio and rejoice.

c86ff7b1-9191-46bb-8235-da0aa1b1bd76.Text: House Orsellio noted the participation of Cassia Orsellio in the Magnae Accessio and have expressed their gratitude to the Rogue Trader.

79c18b0a-ec1e-425d-88d4-5619168565db.Text: The vigilant servants of the Imperium have noted the participation of Heinrix van Calox in the Magnae Accessio and are ready to serve with even greater diligence.

9953c40e-5bda-45ee-9eaf-e97741272f24.Text: Powerful and free-thinking aristocrats have noted the participation of Idira Tlass in the Magnae Accessio and took a liking to the tolerant Rogue Trader.

d7f1502c-6da7-4144-b14a-c63ffd493cf0.Text: The smugglers' syndicates noted the participation of Jae Heydari in the Magnae Accessio and hope to win the favour of the Rogue Trader.

d3def3af-5b42-494e-8514-3766172c6f00.Text: The Adeptus Mechanicus has noted the participation of Pasqal Haneumann in the Magnae Accessio and offered prayers to the Omnissiah for the prosperity of the Rogue Trader's colonies.

8ebd911c-6a29-4442-a872-de0dcccb6e35.Text: Subjects with an interest in the forbidden xenos culture have noted the participation of Yrliet Lanaevyss in the Magnae Accessio and are looking to the Rogue Trader for patronage.

e59793e5-03cc-49e5-a1e5-83580e0e8556.Text: Chorda's protectorate is glad to support the von Valancius dynasty for helping in gaining patronage over Footfall.

df238791-1855-4821-ad8d-3a771a11abd5.Text: Trade representatives of House Gaprak have become involved in the trade of xenos artefacts by the grace and in the name of the Rogue Trader.

8c39f782-02b3-4978-bf68-bb3038bd0799.Text: The patronage of Lord Inquisitor Calcazar guarantees special privileges and various benefits for the von Valancius dynasty.

ee6629f1-b7dc-4add-ac89-b8b799cb9946.Text: For spreading defamatory gossip, a severe fine was imposed on the House Sauerback.

dd48d197-e50b-46a6-aecb-3c269ea98ca8.Text: House Sauerback proudly pays tribute to the Rogue Trader with its finest warriors.

36de6378-d61d-4718-b38d-aaf8a893e475.Text: House Werserian provided one hundred of their kin to the Rogue Trader's service as stewards and officials.

dbf22781-6323-4df7-8302-98cda5f0ab15.Text: A network of void beacons allows voidships to navigate the protectorate in greater safety.

fccaf854-9a1c-4761-b009-5d288b37117a.Text: The Rogue Trader has turned to the sublime minds of the Magi Explorators; may they employ the blessed machines of the Adeptus Mechanicus to melt the centuries-old layer of ice encasing a lost and forgotten Imperial world. What would be an unbearable burden for a commoner is just another task for a servant of the Omnissiah. The Explorators offer prayers to the machine spirits as they prepare for this unorthodox planetary-scale mission.

b4255f7a-4cd2-4b9f-9aef-82691bce7e6c.Text: The Rogue Trader and their allies gain +20% damage against daemons.

551b676e-cc02-4dc6-9c2e-475a4d36763d.Text: The Rogue Trader gains +10 Fellowship, +5 Weapon Skill, and +5 Ballistic Skill.

44ba23f5-d02e-48a3-9f38-fffe1a4a81d9.Text: The Rogue Trader gains a +10 bonus to all characteristics during warp encounter battles.

c835d780-db3f-4158-b5c7-7a6111350f5d.Text: Being the sole master of the Koronus Expanse's main trade hub considerably increases the Rogue Trader's wealth.

65be8aca-d9bf-45ae-9051-40b52d9fc744.Text: Advanced augur systems allow the ship to investigate previously inaccessible worlds and space anomalies.

678b3b7b-b66b-407b-b9a1-9ed747bfa457.Text: When the servants of the Omnissiah assembled the parts of this ancient mechanism, quiet clicks sounded from within and the cogs stirred into motion. The metal plates of the archeotech compass parted, releasing a cascade of golden rays. A hololithic projection shines between the rays: a model of the star system Mu-Rho 79. One of its worlds is marked with an unknown symbol.

2adbc47e-a5ab-45ba-b09c-f6676f55331d.Text: A surviving piece of an archeotech mechanism of unknown purpose, discovered among the wreckage of an ancient Imperial vessel on one of the planets in the Cradle of Khepri.

45805ddf-7d08-4436-9e34-cddd53a28b9e.Text: A surviving piece of an archeotech mechanism of unknown purpose, discovered among the wreckage of an ancient Imperial vessel on one of the planets in Silence of Mer-Segrit.

b0bf84c8-9c9a-4ef0-8b35-51fc92351180.Text: A surviving piece of an archeotech mechanism of unknown purpose, discovered among the wreckage of an ancient Imperial vessel on one of the planets in Narmer IV.

288084c5-3a10-40d2-a26b-7c216f311c63.Text: A surviving piece of an archeotech mechanism of unknown purpose, discovered among the wreckage of an ancient Imperial vessel on one of the planets in Odaenathus XI.

d7905780-e904-405a-9bfb-78678eafe368.Text:
Daring difficulty level demands that players possess a solid grasp of the base game's systems or extensive experience in analogous tactical games or CRPGs. The stats and modifiers of enemies and the game environment are balanced.
This difficulty level is NOT RECOMMENDED for players unfamiliar with the Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader system.

6227c521-ba16-45a6-8295-d79feb0d05c7.Text:
WARNING:The modifiers for this difficulty level gradually come into effect, reaching their intended values by the conclusion of Chapter I.
Hard difficulty level is designed for players who want a challenging experience and either know the base game's systems well or have extensive experience in analogous tactical games or CRPGs. The stats and modifiers of enemies and the game environment are increased. Penalties for the player's party are slightly harsher. This difficulty requires an optimised and well-balanced party.
This difficulty level is NOT RECOMMENDED for players unfamiliar with the Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader system.

4bd52a95-6df7-44d2-97e7-19ee0eaba87b.Text:
Normal difficulty level is designed for players unfamiliar with the base game's systems or those who play tactical games and CRPGs infrequently.
The stats and modifiers of enemies and the game environment are slightly reduced.

7efffef9-825a-4f95-b579-721da6f8ba0e.Text:
Story difficulty level is designed for players who want a relaxed experience primarily focusing on the narrative aspect of the game with a reduced emphasis on ground and space combat mechanics and character progression.
The stats and modifiers of enemies and the game environment are significantly reduced.

268515f2-1352-4c91-84b2-ceb6d5d3b6a4.Text:
WARNING:The modifiers for this difficulty level gradually come into effect, reaching their intended values by the conclusion of Chapter I.
Unfair difficulty level is... unfair. It requires thoughtful use of all game mechanics and an extremely well-optimised party. Even then, it might require numerous reloads to get through some challenges. The stats and modifiers of enemies and the game environment are heavily increased. Penalties for the player's party are unfair.
This difficulty level is NOT RECOMMENDED for players unfamiliar with the Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader system.

e54d10e4-1175-4c77-80a4-e7f4b734d44e.Text: A division of the Adeptus Terra that ensures the functioning of the massive bureaucratic apparatus of the Imperium of Mankind.

31a179a4-956b-4914-b152-78dd07fbad62.Text: A powerful sanctioned psyker who can send and receive messages through space.

b734536b-4921-4788-a00b-1c067447c203.Text: A division of the Adeptus Terra that recruits and trains psykers to serve the Imperium.

317d6b3b-a790-451c-9a5a-ec6a33b53b4a.Text: A division of the Astra Militarum, these military academies supply the armies of the Imperium with skilled recruits.

f0ed34bf-9ecd-4f03-8766-c5aa89d49d7a.Text: The religious body of the Imperium that venerates the Emperor and brings His light to distant worlds.

66af749a-e792-4951-b135-8ed9c26ba218.Text: The standard ground troops of the Imperium also known as the Imperial Guard.

36f241c7-7f0e-495f-9d1b-7917b58002a1.Text: Commonly known as Space Marines, these genetically engineered super-soldiers are the most powerful and ferocious warriors in all of the Imperium.

08126a26-212d-4fb9-bb47-4bcdc531ee8f.Text: An official name for the Machine Cult that maintains and constructs most of the Imperium's advanced technologies.

fa3c59bb-d6ff-4143-aa3b-cdf156293624.Text: A void port founded centuries ago by a Rogue Trader. A wretched nest of villainy and intrigue.

1dcafdbc-7ec5-4cad-a422-e4b9b231a4b3.Text: A radical faction of the Adeptus Mechanicus who travel to the far reaches of void in their quest for Knowledge.

9a626cd5-1ea4-412b-9f41-ff46cba0b1d5.Text: Followers of the Cult of Saint Drusus, a legendary hero of the Angevin Crusade.

5189d5b8-3857-4c1c-88d3-c31bd3abf178.Text: The Footfall chapter of the most successful crime syndicate in the Calixis Sector

0025f947-1af6-41c6-ad7a-cdcd2a4feff0.Text: A sanctioned mutant whose genes allow them to safely traverse through the Immaterium.

5124fb5d-36ec-46fe-9151-c01ed10bd8f4.Text: An organisation of Noble mutant families who possess the Navigator gene.

d24c4ecc-5260-4493-a6e9-95210df959a9.Text: An Imperial world dedicated entirely to the production of agricultural products.

cdb4c901-9f76-49b3-a39a-50e5ccedac6a.Text: An Imperial world dedicated to manufacturing, mining, or refining.

b4fb0e7d-528c-43a6-943e-e69bf4d01eeb.Text: A highly advanced planet governed by the Adeptus Mechanicus.

5e924f3c-323c-4ffc-86be-48a914fa338f.Text: A chapter of the Adeptus Terra responsible for enforcing law across all worlds in the Imperium.

743f0bb3-6079-44ab-bc08-f0aa342cddf1.Text: The ruler of the Imperium and saviour of all Mankind.

382816fc-a7be-4bd9-ab00-2d546bc6ed0a.Text: A supernatural entity, god of all Knowledge, worshipped by the Adeptus Mechanicus.

2de86056-ced3-48ad-86e0-1783a84402b4.Text: The galaxy-spanning interstellar empire of Humanity ruled by the living god known as the Emperor of Mankind.

67bec25b-a20a-4ab8-a179-3e16942cccf2.Text: An arcane artefact utilising long-lost technologies to sustain the God-Emperor's life force and maintain His psychic presence in the warp.

abc6a5e4-2655-4802-8d64-6841e6543bcd.Text: Skills reflect a character's ability to solve various problems: manage equipment, detect small details, open locked containers, and even influence conversations. A skill score determines how proficient a character is — the higher the skill score, the easier it will be to pass corresponding skill {g|Encyclopedia:Test}tests{/g}.

3796c840-fa73-46a3-80d3-582ee065b18a.Text: If you find an encounter too challenging, feel free to adjust the battle difficulty in the options menu.

e401d703-e207-41e7-aefd-8ef016eb982c.Text: Please report any bugs you find! Click {console_bind|LeftStickButton} + {console_bind|RightStickButton} to create and submit a bug report.

ed7a618f-8c33-47ab-94fd-b36bd833341d.Text: Almost any item in the game can be placed in cargo. Exceptions are quest items and narrative objects.

5512ea46-8fe2-436c-bee5-f2c2138dfde0.Text: All non-usable items are automatically packed into cargo.

838990fa-a876-460b-a313-d8c3a7dd7309.Text: You can always check on your cargo status on your cargo management screen.

a91b2687-5c4d-4dae-a860-63050f0d939c.Text: However powerful a Rogue Trader you are, to deal with vendors of the Koronus Expanse, you will have to demonstrate your authority and gain renown with them.

d7ccde55-305b-47de-94e8-39c0a196748e.Text: Rogue Traders are immensely wealthy and do not use mere currency for their trade operations. The sum of all your currently available sources of wealth is measured in profit factor (PF).

435ac390-c453-4b6a-8343-0d60de15954c.Text: Profit factor (PF) isn't spent on buying items, but serves as a simple prerequisite. If you have enough profit factor, you do not purchase the item. It will simply be yours for the taking.

ecdf6c1e-8ae9-460a-a0c4-dff1865c1789.Text: You can gain the trust of vendors in the Koronus Expanse by providing them with cargo you find on your journeys. This will increase your reputation and expand vendor's stocks.

73bc18d3-8db0-4830-87b7-c75003182ec9.Text: You are going to stumble upon some rumours from time to time. Whether to check their credibility or leave them be — the decision is yours.

0ed26782-6b18-44e1-8145-47583917f0e4.Text: Weapon Skill (WS) enhances the effectiveness of attacks with melee weapons, increasing parry reduction and critical hit chance. Melee combat abilities often benefit from a high Weapon Skill.

3cc4b2f2-5c27-4a4d-bd73-cf99e4569856.Text: Ballistic Skill (BS) enhances the effectiveness of attacks with ranged weapons, increasing hit chance and critical hit chance. Ranged combat abilities often benefit from a high Ballistic Skill.

675bbc28-d8e2-40f1-b7dc-4d711bd083da.Text: You can find previous cues from the current dialogue by scrolling up in the dialogue window.

4cfa6182-932d-4139-adde-50d9c8c5b7ec.Text: For each point of a Strength bonus, characters deal +5% more damage with one-handed melee weapons and +10% more damage with two-handed melee weapons. Strength also affects the Athletics skill (base Athletics is equal to Strength).

83dc7f77-15ed-416b-bf3c-391645a84ac2.Text: Toughness (TGH) provides characters with bonus wounds. It also affects the Carouse skill (base Carouse is equal to Toughness).

b6a62eca-5d0f-4921-a8e5-67d233149ff6.Text: Agility (AGI) enhances the initiative and dodge chance of characters. It also affects the Demolition skill (base Demolition is equal to Agility).

608ed7bd-d935-4fe7-ba02-5cf531783392.Text: Intelligence (INT) affects a wide range of skills, including Medicae, Tech-Use, Logic, and all Lore skills.

098a4d41-0fb3-43cc-9739-fe5b416ad5b6.Text: Perception (PER) reduces the chances of an enemy dodging an attack. It also affects the Awareness skill (base Awareness is equal to Perception).

04bf5a42-2307-48c7-8aba-234d893089ea.Text: Willpower (WP) enhances the effectiveness of psyker powers and increases characters' resolve.

0aa4eefd-6976-4388-8155-fc013f8b86f2.Text: Fellowship (FEL) is a core stat for Officers and increases characters' resolve. It also affects a wide range of skills, including Coercion, Persuasion, and Commerce.

46ddad7e-a639-49a6-82fb-e584e30cd22a.Text: Rogue Traders are powerful servants of the God-Emperor, vested with a sacred mission to bring the light of Humanity beyond the edges of the Imperium and expand its territory in the process.

7714822e-3dc8-4c24-bc05-09e05e0347fe.Text: Worship of the God-Emperor is the central pillar of the Imperium of Man. Each day, trillions of people across a million worlds live, toil, and die in His name.

22803f53-d927-452b-888a-1a5b422ea561.Text: The Imperium's unswerving hostility toward anything that challenges its laws and dogma has calcified over thousands of years. Anyone who deviates from this sanctioned hatred risks their very life.

cc6865a1-6d60-4ffc-982a-ae24c6c94bc6.Text: Dark and malign forces lurk beneath the fabric of the physical universe. The warp, a source of all psychic powers, is home to the forces of Chaos, a malevolent and turbulent entity that is the metaphysical manifestation of Humanity's worst fears and frailties.

47f79e28-d06a-4834-8b32-8d8252a6dd50.Text: Uncountable worlds are said to labour beneath the Imperium's yoke. The Koronus Expanse, where the realm of the von Valancius dynasty is located, is but a sliver of Humanity's dominion.

ddffdff4-4038-4a23-bd27-739f4939bd37.Text: Initiative determines how quickly your character reacts to dangers and challenges. Characters with low initiative act later in battle than others.

8cf95958-4ddc-4347-a57a-6b9fdc241c3d.Text: Make use of cover to minimise damage to your characters. If a projectile hits cover, the target behind this cover won't suffer any damage. Attacks with overpenetration may still hit through cover.

98b1786e-2e5f-4c02-97d5-85ddd76e3a3b.Text: Some shots are able to pierce enemies and deal damage not only to them but also to characters behind them. This effect is called overpenetration.

c180be8f-b6c5-44d2-8499-753c3b499f3d.Text: You can select answers in dialogues using the number keys on your keyboard.

de91992c-eb8c-44c3-b7d4-d1f5be1af2ae.Text: You can use a character's portrait as the target for an ability.

3c540e0d-1502-46a3-a8cf-41870051a95a.Text: Press Tab to highlight objects you can interact with.

05f79515-5f44-45f5-8bcc-32a6b70a4e5d.Text: Right-clicking on the result of a roll in the combat log will display how that roll was achieved.

3bb2f43d-d845-4f7b-ab0e-c54d54b8b563.Text: Double-click on a character's portrait to centre the camera on the corresponding character.

51b54bcd-3026-47d1-a80b-7cd73e757e26.Text: Please report any bugs you find by hovering the cursor over the broken character, creature, item, spell, or interface and pressing ALT+B.

dc9df7ab-b888-416a-bd4f-a70d189e3f34.Text: The bridge is the heart of a voidship. It is where the vessel's command centre is located, as well as the senior officers' posts and the cogitator control systems.

23956780-a2c1-447f-8221-d7b3729ba170.Text: The flagship of the von Valancius dynasty is a centuries-old voidship. Ancient and restive machine spirits dwell within its cogitators.

70deae54-8fc9-465c-be2a-d5492d1b78bf.Text: Idle chatter is strictly forbidden on the bridge, although between tasks the officers still find the opportunity to discuss the latest developments.

d5deeee3-970d-4541-ae4f-e08001e0dee8.Text: The Rogue Trader's companions frequently have something to say about unfolding events. Find members of the Lord Captain's retinue on the voidship's bridge.

7e06f170-ad22-4101-aa2a-ba4c1a7effd3.Text: High Factotum Janris Danrok is the Lord Captain's trade advisor, who handles the intricacies of the Rogue Trader's commercial endeavours. Speak to Janris on the voidship's bridge.

32dd0179-ff28-40d7-ad0e-735587c19c97.Text: The bridge of the von Valancius dynasty's flagship is equipped with a unique terminal that provides the Lord Captain with direct access to the ship's data-crypts.

d34afef3-c27f-4f4d-8633-c55300fc4ae5.Text: You can always hire mercenaries to tailor your experience or gather a wholly unique party and play co-op with your friends. Talk to the High Factotum about this matter. However, you will miss out on some of the narrative content from your companions.

2e1ac108-0040-436b-a843-2667902979b7.Text: If you do not like your character's build, you can always drop your character's current progression. All experience is refunded and you may even select a different archetype. Talk to the High Factotum about this matter.

f8ee00ef-7735-4230-a38a-17064cf30cef.Text: The "Pause on loading screen" setting determines whether the game will wait for confirmation from all players in cooperative mode before continuing after loading is complete.

8f0aaf05-8666-4ed8-a42e-dc24e7e863d4.Text: Every journey through the Immaterium is fraught with deadly risk. When a voidship leaves realspace, it is at the mercy of the warp, with the flimsy veil of the Geller field the only thing standing between the crew and oblivion.

8c4e884a-38f9-437f-95a3-e260b7d8d424.Text: A voidship is under constant threat from innumerable dangers, from lawless pirates and strange xenos in realspace to ravenous daemons and all-pervading corruption in the warp.

b1c0ac1a-fbad-4e30-9f1b-78f34fb5e7f9.Text: Navigators are exceptional mutants who serve Humanity as guides through the raging warp. They alone can see the light of the Astronomican in the Sea of Souls and use it as a beacon to set a course for a distant target.

6f4366de-7959-4fe2-b593-fa4700bad20f.Text: The Koronus Expanse is the domain of the Rogue Traders, who are forever carving out their spheres of influence and becoming entangled in wars over worlds rich in resources.

92caddd3-1c71-4fed-b9ef-3d58714a9cd6.Text: Every warp route has a distinct difficulty, varying from safe to deadly. The difficulty is indicated on the map with respective colours.

38b893a7-3531-4b6e-b19a-e465b6e371a6.Text: To reduce the chance of Chaos incursions during a warp jump, spend Navigator's insight to make warp routes safer.

e7d72fe2-0884-4e1c-99f2-a48c1a8b1281.Text: You gain Navigator's insight every time you perform a scan on the Koronus Expanse map.

e22431c6-6e85-40d8-93ef-2f98fe2422fa.Text: A lot of known routes through Immaterium were erased during recent warp storms, but you can always chart a new one using Navigator's insight.

caf57da1-7a27-4fc7-86bd-f28816ce426f.Text: Don't forget to occasionally check on your colonies, manage them, and decide their fate.

2491b294-22c7-4c43-acfa-9d2928d9c920.Text: Xenos are the mortal enemy of every subject of the Imperium. Any human who displays inappropriate sympathy for or even heretical interest in these foul aliens will very quickly come to regret it.

eac4774c-46f3-4b82-bb40-02a3f2b72eb8.Text: The armour parameter reduces incoming damage by a percentage (−20% of incoming damage). Deflection reduces incoming damage by a flat value (incoming damage is reduced by −2).

fbf004e5-60ff-47c8-ac60-1baadad13021.Text: Melee attacks always have a 100% hit chance, but they can be dodged or parried.

8139c942-2a49-4cc7-bda0-7626f97722c9.Text: Agility (AGI) makes it easier for characters to dodge enemy attacks. Perception (PER) makes characters' attacks harder to dodge.

10aaa740-c7dd-4d7b-976c-37c2f1464fa0.Text: The higher a character's Weapon Skill (WS) is compared to their opponent's, the easier it is for them to parry that opponent's attacks.

5ed7ef4d-7f7e-4490-8017-05615573c434.Text: Sometimes characters can physically dodge area attacks, moving out of the area of effect to safety.

8590cfb8-a99e-421f-8691-e80a4a0453cc.Text: Whenever a character performs a melee attack, they gain +10 Weapon Skill (WS) for each ally adjacent to the target of this attack.

ec16bd87-92e0-4e29-aa57-cbc1a318e7ac.Text: If a character falls unconscious, they receive a trauma. This reduces their characteristics or inflicts an additional negative effect.

329a4a70-7ad5-46b3-9209-24b1094514bd.Text: After falling into a trap or receiving damage that exceeds 50% of their total wounds within one round, a character will receive a fresh injury. Injuries reduce characters' resolve. If three or more injuries accumulate, they turn into a trauma.

53beeddb-3dfe-4170-b82b-d71e9460a5e1.Text: All injuries and traumas are removed after returning to your flagship.

e24f1019-b93d-4911-8b70-7e5121cca2e5.Text: For the first several rounds after receiving an injury, a character will have only a fresh injury. Fresh injuries can be instantly healed with a medikit. If left untreated, a fresh injury turns into an old injury. Old injuries require a successful Medicae test to be healed.

0dcba370-68ba-4565-bddd-e293c48ac88f.Text: The Imperium's enemies wear a million guises. Whether it be the traitorous heretic, the devious xenos, or the spawn of Chaos, their fate is one and the same — to burn in the righteous flame of the God-Emperor.

7e49a551-cda0-4145-a82f-9cc5c57a6af4.Text: Characters can only attack targets that are visible to them.

d96a9b82-d757-4479-8491-b6adf5e3c98e.Text: Usually, before combat, you have a tactical phase where you are able to advantageously position your characters. However, sometimes you will be ambushed and the tactical phase will be unavailable. Idira can help you predict some ambushes.

61ad0492-7488-4972-be59-07f29379446f.Text: All psykers have two types of psychic powers — minor and major.

c272dc88-7bac-4c1d-a15f-71335b353b34.Text: Veil degradation scales from 0 to 20 and does not transfer between battles. It is the same value for all psykers in a battle.

c22a34dd-642d-4205-9fee-60948714cf1d.Text: Whenever a minor power is used by anyone in battle, veil degradation increases by +1. Whenever a major power is used, it increases by +3. At the beginning of each round, veil degradation decreases by −1.

7cba0ca4-ccf5-4f4c-a487-9471bb997967.Text: Warriors are powerful melee combat experts. Their signature ability provides them additional mobility and offence. They are experts at provoking enemy attacks and survival combined with high damage output.

f45c12c5-7e83-4c4d-8085-4f986973375b.Text: Soldiers wreak havoc on enemy lines from a distance, constantly moving in and out of cover and finding the best angle for another devastating burst attack.

54a8d4c7-6b2c-4c9e-adde-58a4a69b1317.Text: Officers inspire their teammates to perform at their best. An Officer's playstyle involves improving allies' effectiveness and providing them with various extra opportunities to act.

5aeaa190-6136-42ba-99d6-c31ad0c458bc.Text: Operatives are indispensable for supporting your party and dramatically reducing enemy defences. However, each Operative performs in their own unique way.

033b980c-8dd1-4cc9-bc20-60e23ad22ac4.Text: Assassins are exemplary at evading enemy attacks and then delivering their own devastating blows, melee or ranged. They benefit from high dodge and dodge reduction as well as precisely planned attacks on enemy's weak spots.

25cd1c13-b90b-4ca6-823c-c0fedde9ceb2.Text: The dark corners of the Imperium are infested with scoundrels, criminals, heretics, and even minions of the Archenemy. Exterminating them is the duty of every righteous servant of the God-Emperor.

e3b2c94a-e84b-456e-922f-5894e7356c08.Text: Grand Strategists are rulers of the battlefield. They divide the combat zone into functional areas and make the best of them, providing not only strong positive effects to allies and negative effects to enemies but also additional unique effects.

824e5b33-f9cb-41c1-b41a-6b506ae0be6c.Text: Vanguards are the unyielding strongholds of the frontline. They lead attacks, bringing enemy fire on themselves and soaking overwhelming amounts of damage as well as defending and applying positive effects on their teammates.

52348564-adfc-489a-97a1-cf181cbaf9e5.Text: Arch-Militants always use the right tools for the job, being extremely versatile with all kinds of weapons.

8a07828d-e374-45fe-83f7-db0b9cc0e74c.Text: Bounty Hunters relentlessly chase their prey — the most dangerous and capable enemies — and display a natural aptitude for slaying them. Penetration of enemy defences and critical hits are what Bounty Hunters do best.

c8532162-9f43-4599-a42a-b978da047f08.Text: Master Tacticians always seize upon and develop any advantage the team can get, keeping allies' resolve high and converting momentum into powerful effects and attacks.

74597634-2e95-4526-9bcc-851d71c23381.Text: Every ranged weapon in the game has an effective range and a maximum range. Hit chance at maximum range is halved.

c2fb524a-21ce-4650-afd3-6f4e3e0ce4da.Text: When shooting in a burst, the trajectory deviation chance of the second and all subsequent shots in that burst is increased by the recoil value of the weapon.

02ea8bfd-2087-4c05-b0be-7e9078892561.Text: Maximum hit chance is always 95%. All hit chance above 95% is converted to critical hit chance.

b23ad707-907f-4c3e-8e4a-faf1d328636e.Text: Medium armour reduces the dodge chance of its wearer by 25% while heavy armour reduces it by 50%. Wear light armour if you want to be able to dodge enemy attacks.

7a651324-d6fa-4725-a0e5-2b99d0a2d9b0.Text: Base critical hit chance is 10%. All hit chance above 95% is converted to additional critical hit chance.

1ae70bec-5d62-485d-912a-7c109572728c.Text: Burst attacks are harder to dodge.

e7a1c9fd-d77d-4fe4-b569-9569d16ed74b.Text: Your voidship is a veritable fortress, one whose crew numbers in the thousands. The harmonious and seamless running of this vast team is the key to victory in void combat.

ae8669d6-726b-417f-ae59-4087a5f8da64.Text: In space combat, critical hits inflict various critical effects (i.e. "fire" or "breach") on targets depending on the attacker's weapon type.

cc47197d-734a-401e-ace5-ddbec12149a8.Text: Depressurising a bay is a death sentence for the hundreds of people within that part of the ship, but not for the ship itself. Quickly resealing the airlocks will enable the vessel to continue fighting, albeit with heavy crew losses.

1e8a43d3-dcfe-4f4d-9ae7-69cc57d85b43.Text: Voidships defeated in battle are rarely obliterated — their ravaged carcasses, laden with trophies and bodies, can spiral in space for millennia, enticing marauders and pirates.

be2f7dd0-a708-42ef-8a56-61e726f664be.Text: You can assign your party members to different battle stations of your flagship, gaining bonuses and even additional abilities in space combat.

ac44a756-03c9-4c21-b42b-f0919dc87b1e.Text: In space combat all ships have speed and manoeuvrability. Manoeuvrability is a value indicating how many cells a unit must move in a straight line before it can turn 45 degrees. Manoeuvrability counts exact cells not the amount of void movement points spent on a movement.

00ede3b4-b2e1-40da-9fdc-bb584cece86f.Text: Push phase occurs during the first few cells of the flagship's movement, indicated with bright yellow arrows. Whenever your ship moves to the first cell with a pale yellow arrow, push phase is over for this turn. Some of your flagship's abilities (i.e. {g|f:bd61b300bcd84e06a80c8cf3b699c78b}Restart Shields{/g}) can be used only during the push phase.

793588fe-c5f0-4110-9ace-61a2df0bc348.Text: Your voidship also receives experience points and has its own progression system.

efcb5200-2f20-47bb-818a-218922bff876.Text: You can restore your voidship's hull integrity using scrap, which can be found after space combat or during your journeys across the Koronus Expanse. You can also disassemble spare components of your ship to get scrap.

301a0836-1ee9-46a6-be55-39c59e7547ea.Text: Don't forget to restart your shields when they are down. Try to find an ideal manoeuvre for this, however, because on the next turn after the restart, your voidship's speed and firing range will be limited, which may leave it critically vulnerable.

3125afce-bc7b-4b4d-893f-3026161f2787.Text: In space combat your attack hit chance and critical hit chance do not depend on distance. However, they do depend on the Auspex installed on your ship.

4bf063b8-803b-4b63-9caf-3220f3a19d22.Text: No star system is alike — each holds its revelations, surprises, and dangers that can put an untimely end to the wanderings of an unduly inquisitive Lord Captain.

42a41cb9-3914-4b25-9a6a-799f58b4d330.Text: Distant star systems, little explored by the Imperium, conceal within themselves grim secrets from deep history, lost colonies of Humanity, and unnatural anomalies that imperil both body and mind.

c2595e0b-8553-44f1-ad0c-ee08bdeb1d12.Text: The Koronus Expanse is a little-studied region beyond the edges of the Imperium. Since before records began, people have been drawn there in search of glory, treasure... and the dark secrets that slumber in the gloom between the stars.

cfd1e9c7-4acd-4790-a248-4278c8c8f787.Text: The farthest limits of the Koronus Expanse are terra incognita for Humanity — only the bravest, boldest, or most deranged voidsmen dare to steer their ship toward the Unbeholden Reaches or the Rifts of Hecaton.

24b459d7-7d2b-441f-bbb6-f5346e3762c7.Text: You can enable installed DLC in your current playthrough by opening the DLC section of the in-game menu after loading your save.

1670f261-f115-486f-b812-bd1568ac7d2a.Text: How fare your adventures, Lord Captain? Let us know — leave a review!

b84a95e5-e58a-4dac-9678-62e57b533fab.Text: While veil degradation is 15 or higher: -Chances of triggering psychic phenomena quadruples. -Major psychic powers may trigger perils of the warp. -Unsanctioned psykers using minor psychic powers have a (20 + 4 × psy rating)% chance to trigger psychic phenomena. -Unsanctioned psykers using major psychic powers have a (20 + psy rating + veil degradation)% chance to trigger psychic phenomena whenever perils of the warp do not occur. -Sanctioned psykers using minor psychic powers have a (10 + 2 × psy rating)% chance to trigger psychic phenomena. -Sanctioned psykers using major psychic powers have a (10 + psy rating + veil degradation)% chance to trigger psychic phenomena whenever perils of the warp do not occur.

8613130a-c2a0-40cd-9fad-e0921859480d.Text: A special combat resource required for using the unique abilities called {g|Encyclopedia:HeroicAct}heroic acts{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:DesperateMeasure}desperate measures{/g}. These abilities can only be used once per round for the entire party and once per battle for each character.

0538b122-09bb-4c0b-85ae-5d50040602f1.Text: At the beginning of combat, veil degradation usually starts at 0. Veil degradation increases by 1 for each use of a minor psychic power and by 3 for each use of a major psychic power. It decreases by 1 each round.

d620fe63-f386-4d2d-9a1d-947bd568efbc.Text: When psykers reach deeper into the warp to power their abilities, there is always a chance of the Empyrean bleeding into our reality, a factor that is invariably destructive and damaging.

62b52312-05e1-425f-9a0c-193cdb7ab684.Text: While veil degradation is 14 or less: -Minor psychic powers have a (5 + psy rating)% chance to trigger psychic phenomena. -Major psychic powers have a (20 + 4 × psy rating)% chance to trigger psychic phenomena. -Sanctioned psykers using minor psychic powers have a ((5 + psy rating) / 2)% chance to trigger psychic phenomena. -Sanctioned psykers using major psychic powers have a (10 + 2 × psy rating)% chance to trigger psychic phenomena.

An archetype reflects the evolution of a character. What they were and what they will become.
Each archetype determines the character's key features: what abilities they will use in battle, what skills they will rely on to resolve difficulties during their travels, or how certain special abilities can be improved.
An archetype is divided into ranks, each of which allows to choose a new ability or talent, improve it, or increase the value of a skill or characteristic.

04cc0743-defe-48ab-be17-84b50aa63d46.Text: Followers of the Cult of Saint Drusus who believe in continuing Mankind's Crusade and bringing new worlds into the Imperium's fold. They adhere to principles of asceticism and high moral standards. Most of all, they value sacred relics and artefacts. Their representative, Reverend Hieronymus Doloroso, can be found in the Atrium on Footfall.

They seek long-lost technologies, hoping to unravel their secrets. This means they will be eager to buy any archeotech you will be willing to part with. Their contact is Opticon-22, a Tech-Priest who conducts business at one of Footfall's void docks, Alpha-Rho.

Its specialty is the Cold Trade of forbidden xenos artefacts. Vladaym Tocara is their official representative residing in the Liege's palace on Footfall.

bcf0f2dd-da04-40a8-8866-34100703746c.Text: A loose alliance of pirate factions from the Koronus Expanse. They hold nothing sacred and fear no authority, ready to defy even the mightiest of Rogue Traders and the Emperor's servants. Their spokesperson, Ryzza Calvaria, will readily take even the most unsavoury cargo off your hands. The Martyr's Endurance on Footfall is rumoured to be her favourite haunt.

Here in the Koronus Expanse, Chartist Captain Austerius Thorfast would be pleased to see a mighty Rogue Trader somewhere in the void of the Furibundus System.

fbd79643-8a9e-475c-b26c-57f430f16f79.Text:
In Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader, companions can become loyal followers. You can add them to your squad and control them on missions, utilising their various skills in turn-based combat.
The detailed customisation process allows you to choose who your companion was before joining your adventure. With a wide variety of options, you can determine their appearance, their characteristics, and their combat capabilities.

64f7a2e4-70fc-43c8-97f2-772bbe4fd5e3.Text:
Navigators are a unique human subspecies that possess the so-called Navigator gene known since the Dark Age of Technology. These sanctioned mutant nobles have a third eye (commonly called the "warp eye") located in the centre of their forehead. This eye allows them to peer into the Empyrean without losing their sanity.
The detailed customisation process allows you to choose who your Navigator was before joining your adventure. With a wide variety of options, you can determine their appearance, their characteristics, and their combat capabilities.

0520dd42-0d72-45b8-a6c0-bd8a8a799b78.Text: Create your very own Rogue Trader from scratch. The detailed customisation process allows you to choose who your character was before beginning your adventure. With a wide variety of options, you can determine their appearance, their characteristics, and their combat capabilities.

ca9e2383-d4de-4b8d-a777-fe10cc92e9f7.Text: Take up the mantle of a Rogue Trader, the scion of an ancient dynasty of daring privateers that reign over their trade protectorate and explore the fringes of the known galaxy. Darkness looms over the bloodline of von Valancius as it faces multiple threats, from within its own ranks and without as countless enemies seek to destroy the most daring and brave agents of Humanity. It is up to you to hold the reigns of this shattered protectorate and forge a new path for the von Valancius dynasty, currently finding itself in a vortex of wars, intrigues, calamities, and heresy. The stakes are high and rise even higher as you cross paths with terrifyingly powerful and ambitious adversaries in the darkness of the Koronus Expanse.

Each archetype encapsulates a unique set of skills and expertise and represents a specific combat specialisation, from the front-line warrior to the indispensable leader preferring to command from the rear. Choose who you want to be in the grim dark future of Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader.

41bff973-05fe-4ef8-9be1-7c0cff6113a9.Text: During {g|f:0b015a4752eb4787af7bd81ecc532a9c}Vulnerability Scan{/g}, the weak point never appears at the opposite side of an enemy voidship. Also, there is an additional +5% bonus to {g|Encyclopedia:SpaceBattleDamageGlossary}damage{/g} dealt to the scanned weak point.

65966fc3-e9fe-46fe-9486-d1d0aeb0126e.Text: {g|f:7b1ab2c9456a44febdc41b71f14d8df5}Voidship Ram{/g} can be used during any phase except ending, and its maximum range is increased by +2.

68b7e72b-5c50-42b5-8a3a-84dc9d1b1e97.Text: The {g|f:1e61d88162a34f898f4c961b757a8b57}Strafe{/g} ability can be used to ram enemy ships at 90% {g|Encyclopedia:SpaceBattleDamageGlossary}damage{/g} of the regular {g|f:7b1ab2c9456a44febdc41b71f14d8df5}Voidship Ram{/g} ability and without the bonus damage from distance travelled.

6a2d6395-c83f-4e75-a6db-7b92de29e940.Text: {g|f:9c115131f98f4273af06890aa9d558d2}Expeditious Reload{/g} will also reload the {g|Encyclopedia:ProwSpace}prow{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:LanceWeaponSpace}lance weapon{/g}. However, that weapon will suffer a −25% extra penalty to hit chance when shooting.

7d4a62f6-b0c6-4acd-bff0-b949ca2b7c0e.Text: {g|f:9c115131f98f4273af06890aa9d558d2}Expeditious Reload{/g} can be used during the {g|Encyclopedia:AccelerationPhaseSpace}acceleration phase{/g} to reload {g|Encyclopedia:TorpedoLaunchersSpace}torpedo tubes{/g} fired the previous round.

ab458176-6fff-4a11-9f39-191f7757ad6c.Text: Cooldown of {g|f:677884ef1a694ba19c4abb7be1d92cb2}Focused Efforts{/g} is reduced by −1.

af264d13-0ae5-43f8-90f6-d67a5a170c93.Text: By the end of {g|f:ce16283fbdff4a658071cc548a3bec2f}Swing Run{/g} the {g|Encyclopedia:FlagshipSpace}flagship{/g} can choose its position out of 3 directions instead of taking the opposite one.

48a452ce-efb1-4764-bc95-4ab4b68c194f.Text: Enemy voidships suffer <u>((from 25 to 35)% of their maximum {g|Encyclopedia:HullIntegritySpace}hull integrity{/g})</u> warp {g|Encyclopedia:SpaceBattleDamageGlossary}damage{/g} when being jumped through using {g|f:ab9221b929cf4c97b843831e1a09288f}Shallow Jump{/g}.

747a4603-0487-4454-a4bc-5be4e215235d.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:FlagshipSpace}flagship{/g}'s shield strength and {g|Encyclopedia:EvasionSpace}evasion{/g} are increased by +5%.

fc6db686-7f44-4b76-b128-41c7f15b61db.Text: During the next combat, your {g|Encyclopedia:FlagshipSpace}flagship{/g}'s {g|Encyclopedia:EvasionSpace}evasion{/g}, your {g|Encyclopedia:LanceWeaponSpace}lance weapon{/g} damage, and your {g|Encyclopedia:MacroCannonsSpace}macro-cannon{/g} damage will be reduced by −15%.

b974bb1b-191c-4e0c-8d1a-8c915a84f12c.Text: During the next combat, your {g|Encyclopedia:FlagshipSpace}flagship{/g}'s {g|Encyclopedia:EvasionSpace}evasion{/g} will be increased by +15% against Necron enemies.

8e67ff9c-d146-4c2f-acf4-4b653bb59dfc.Text: In the next combat, your torpedoes will be unavailable during the first 2 rounds. During and after the third round, their damage will be increased by +25%.

0ebc00bf-2a5b-4b46-9722-add0b1d949b9.Text: The freight line has become a cesspool of disease, which has drawn the attention of the forces of rot and decay. They protect the ship from fire and warp energies so that the infected may continue exchanging putrid gifts in the bowels of the vessel.

ed210321-baa0-454a-a3ce-26690d355c65.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:FlagshipSpace}flagship{/g} suffers −30% less warp damage. Damage dealt by {g|Encyclopedia:InternalFiresSpace}internal fires{/g} is reduced to <u>(from 2 to 7)</u>.

4db09c0e-2ba7-46b9-ae0a-f9ee29177dfb.Text: By virtue of strict discipline, the freight line delivers munitions with only minimal delay. The crews of the artillery bays now have more time to calibrate and maintain the ship's weapons.

f4aaaccb-46e6-401b-aaa9-46af8bf98ab8.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:FlagshipSpace}flagship{/g}'s weapons deal +5% more damage and gain +5% critical hit chance.

fdd50889-3271-4846-89b0-7c46b5e5bd69.Text: The freight line workers study to the best of their ability, applying newly attained knowledge for the betterment of the ship. Thanks to their efforts, logistical operations with the engineering bays have become more efficient, which has opened up new opportunities for fortifying the ship's hull.

170773a3-8560-4b9c-a65a-15c0beaa4155.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:FlagshipSpace}flagship{/g}'s {g|Encyclopedia:HullIntegritySpace}hull integrity{/g} is increased by +10. The plating of all sectors of the flagship is increased by +1.

7d142739-1bf9-4963-adba-5fbc040c4549.Text: Attack craft and torpedoes gain +2 void {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPointsSpace}movement points{/g}.

928a2313-5619-48cc-9122-1eb3b9079409.Text: Shield strength on each side of the {g|Encyclopedia:FlagshipSpace}flagship{/g} is increased by +10%.

f6bfe43e-e586-4280-98c0-0db9021d6cdd.Text: In the second round of combat, the {g|Encyclopedia:FlagshipSpace}flagship{/g}'s ultimate cooldown bars are restored by +15%.

fdcb3488-9824-4355-b7d7-1dfa23b716d1.Text: The Rogue Trader's ship is being escorted by the frigate Heartless.

6adf6c5c-ebff-4d52-916e-c1e8b1716470.Text: Now converted into a merchant vessel, the frigate Heartless wards off seekers of easy pickings with its exterior alone.

2c31dd02-1fc8-4084-a113-03e1a7faba87.Text: The frigate Heartless has been converted into a merchant ship of House von Valancius.

dc2b116a-10c0-4483-8c7c-d502a53a7f67.Text: In the first round, the flagship's lance weapons deal +3 more damage.

0f0c647b-df36-44e1-8e77-eb48174983a6.Text: When every professional counts, does it matter how exactly they obtained their skills? The Rogue Trader does not shun people with murky pasts, thus earning {mf|him|her} the respect of Ravor's motley crew.

915171a6-7862-43ef-b1e2-eb24a166d85c.Text: In the first round, the flagship's macro-cannons make an additional +1 attack.

a18f69e2-b523-4c6d-a7b0-58df65eb0b1d.Text: +15% to the flagship's evasion in the first round

a5a1e717-f7f7-4c22-815a-71b20e9176d0.Text: +5% to weapon damage dealt to pirates in the first round in space battles

fa6f2b8f-4bfc-4e4e-ae8b-18720954faf4.Text: When using {g|Encyclopedia:PostSpace}post{/g} abilities, there is a 20% chance its cooldown will be 1 round shorter.

d1db8ed2-17dd-4ec1-89de-3f2d8b84b9e0.Text: When using {g|Encyclopedia:PostSpace}post{/g} abilities, there is a 50% chance its cooldown will be 1 round shorter.

fdbe6033-0252-4c53-bc54-a6e948f0c150.Text: Allows the voidship to control +1 extra wing of each attack craft type.

d4ab45f7-eac5-43a6-b85a-d193a02a1916.Text: Each attack craft launched from a torpedo tube and each torpedo gain +1 {g|Encyclopedia:HullIntegritySpace}hull integrity{/g}.

8face57b-48e8-4a7b-a020-588a4e784e71.Text: Voidship Ram deals twice the additional {g|Encyclopedia:SpaceBattleDamageGlossary}damage{/g} for each extra tile travelled.

5ac4ee08-6056-4350-bb1b-e8c66093df30.Text: {g|f:bd61b300bcd84e06a80c8cf3b699c78b}Restart Shields{/g} now inflicts only a −2 {g|Encyclopedia:SpeedSpace}speed{/g} reduction and no {g|Encyclopedia:FiringRangeSpace}firing range{/g} penalty.

652e8a5d-155a-43ec-80be-d5aaa2fc7d61.Text: Torpedoes and attack craft gain +60% {g|Encyclopedia:EvasionSpace}evasion{/g} against enemy attack craft attacks and +20% evasion against all other attacks.

231c2f9f-5bf5-4191-970b-518a778c1019.Text:
When approaching an enemy, the {g|Encyclopedia:FlagshipSpace}flagship{/g} shuts down non-essential systems and starts to drift, unnoticed, past enemy ships.
As a result, in most encounters, larger enemy vessels (frigates and larger) are surprised and act later.

f6abcc8e-7e23-41dd-9f77-c6ab0f7f85ca.Text: {g|f:243127dbf4d840b2bb6d2ecd50e38c76}Silent Running{/g} now makes the {g|Encyclopedia:FlagshipSpace}flagship{/g} act before all enemies in most encounters.

cb7a47d1-e5ae-4e3f-a14f-b1d1c45a6f15.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:FlagshipSpace}flagship{/g} now collects +10% more {g|Encyclopedia:ScrapSpace}scrap{/g} from destroyed ships.

fbe54ec8-ea6c-40cd-bd25-4136de1abf4e.Text: The Falchion-class frigate is a more advanced and modern design that was developed only five centuries ago but has already proven to be as good as veteran frigates like the Sword-class. Estimated dimensions: 2.2 km in length, 0.3 km abeam at the fins, approx. Estimated tonnage: 6.5 megatonnes, approx. Estimated number of souls: 27,000, approx.{br}

e5d6bb56-5ee8-455b-b104-ef0db64f21b7.Text: The Firestorm-class frigate is a modification of the Sword-class, designed to deliver fire strikes against larger enemy ships, not shying away from engagements with a superior opponent. Estimated dimensions: 1.8 km in length, 0.3 km abeam at the fins, approx. Estimated tonnage: 6 megatonnes, approx. Estimated number of souls: 25,000, approx.{br}

6aa0c5bb-9513-4951-949b-2959d56efd71.Text: The Sword-class frigate is a classic voidship design, proven in thousands of battles, combining decent firepower, high {g|Encyclopedia:SpeedSpace}speed{/g}, and respectable survivability. Estimated dimensions: 1.6 km in length, 0.3 km abeam at the fins, approx. Estimated tonnage: 6 megatonnes, approx. Estimated number of souls: 26,000, approx.{br}

472b5b9f-3cc3-4fa5-b979-e3d14c67a98e.Text: The von Valancius {g|Encyclopedia:FlagshipSpace}flagship{/g} is the mightiest voidship belonging to the von Valancius dynasty. Every system aboard this frigate has been tried and tested in innumerable engagements. Its weapons and turrets deliver hard-hitting volleys with pinpoint accuracy. Its plasma drives are rugged yet reliable in extreme conditions. The flagship's size and {g|Encyclopedia:ManoeuvrabilitySpace}manoeuvrability{/g} are perfect for pursuing smaller, faster raiders and for hunting the countless pirates, xenos, and heretics in the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g}. Numerous von Valancius Rogue Traders have acknowledged the exceptional performance of this vessel, and, with a few minor updates, the flagship has continued to faithfully serve the von Valancius dynasty.

b52f9bb1-d27d-4a7f-8b68-a29e2e6cf539.Text:
For every 10% of {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} lost while wearing no {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g}, Argenta gains +5% {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}, +1 {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g}, and at the start of each turn +<u>{g|Encyclopedia:Resolve}resolve{/g}</u> {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g}. All {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonuses{/g} are removed at the end of combat.
Additionally, while wearing no armour, Argenta's resolve is increased by +2 for each {g|Encyclopedia:Injury}injury{/g} and by +6 for each {g|Encyclopedia:Traumas}trauma{/g}. Bonuses from injuries and traumas are removed after healing.

b5c28e21-603a-48bc-a9cc-b6300bc68797.Text: Whenever Glaito suffers {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}, Solomorne gains +1 stack of this effect.

d68d1393-c901-4bb2-9264-228525d581ac.Text: Solomorne removes all stacks of {g|f:cd8984dc4b2043c18278c317e2e309e5}Fury{/g}. His {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit chance{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} dealt, and {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeReduction}dodge reduction{/g} are increased by +{uip|Damage|2de518e4ecaa4cba86aef0a703dc7e42}% until the end of {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}.

4a81f02c-5903-4de1-a93d-0b87297c9213.Text: Ulfar may use {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} after attacking or using {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}abilities{/g}.

328f6efd-58f7-420d-ae36-1e30f89ff4dd.Text: When Ulfar should fall {g|Encyclopedia:UnconsciousEffect}unconscious{/g}, instead he stays inactive for 2 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rounds{/g}, becoming untargetable and immune to {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}, also counting as {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}full cover{/g} for his allies. After 2 rounds, he returns to the fight with 50% of his maximum {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}. ! Can only be used once per combat.

7404840f-e922-4402-9221-85c234c6a44d.Text: Whenever an enemy attack deals {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} to this creature greater than <u>15% of the creature's maximum {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}</u>, this creature gains +5 {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}Weapon Skill{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerStrength}Strength{/g}.

09c17900-6126-447d-9ec8-ca6b166eb9bb.Text:
Whenever the Drukhari suffer {g|Encyclopedia:WarpDamage}warp damage{/g} or are affected by {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic powers{/g}, they cannot use {g|f:9dc8b5c4113b412f97b1a321c798af5d}Power From Pain{/g} and lose all {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonuses{/g} of this {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} for 2 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rounds{/g}.
They additionally suffer −<u>(3 × {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}WP{/g} bonus)</u> to {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}Weapon Skill{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerBallisticSkill}Ballistic Skill{/g} and receive an additional <u>10% of maximum {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}</u> damage from warp attacks and psychic powers for 2 rounds.

ba929c00-5160-42a0-bd18-80c40e733066.Text: Grants +5 temporary {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} and +2 to all types of {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} dealt for each stack of dark blessing until the end of combat.

4722b570-5a92-4401-b451-720bbcb477a7.Text: Whenever {g|Encyclopedia:PerilsOfWarp}perils of the warp{/g} is triggered, the Chaos Space Marine gains an {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}extra turn{/g}.

58ef042a-f3fd-42f5-81a6-c02ebe321c64.Text:
This creature switches {g|Encyclopedia:NegativeEffectTypesGlossary}negative effects{/g}. It becomes {g|Encyclopedia:StaggeredEffect}staggered{/g} instead of suffering the {g|Encyclopedia:Stun}stunned{/g} or {g|Encyclopedia:CantAttackEffect}cannot attack{/g} effect, becomes {g|Encyclopedia:SlowedEffect}slowed{/g} instead of {g|Encyclopedia:ImmobilisedEffect}immobilised{/g}, and suffers the {g|Encyclopedia:CalmedWarpEffect}psy dampening{/g} effect instead of psychosomatic {g|Encyclopedia:Traumas}trauma{/g}.
Also, the creature is immune to falling {g|Encyclopedia:ProneEffect}prone{/g}.

086c59d6-6346-4ba2-a118-bb9342ae889a.Text: Whenever this creature is attacked by an enemy, it suffers +<u>attacker's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerPerception}PER{/g}</u>% more {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}. The {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit chance{/g} of this attack is increased by +<u>{g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}AGI{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g}</u>%.

bb07a9e5-8da4-47a7-9333-f71cdee68f8d.Text: The {g|f:7bb93df02d9942258b1acdb60e6eb3f7}coordinated trap{/g} effect can no longer be inflicted on this creature.

8748d5c6-4728-44af-8acd-4a6e949186e7.Text:
Whenever this creature attacks an enemy for the first time in combat, that enemy must make a Perception test. If failed, the {g|f:7bb93df02d9942258b1acdb60e6eb3f7}coordinated trap{/g} effect is inflicted on that enemy for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}. If that enemy successfully passes the test or if the duration of a previously applied {g|f:7bb93df02d9942258b1acdb60e6eb3f7}coordinated trap{/g} ends, that enemy can no longer suffer the effect.
This creature always {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodges{/g} attacks made by its allies.

30fa27d7-0341-44dd-a3f4-816e60ee885f.Text: You never know what a Genestealer Cultist is capable of until they do it, or until you get too close.

b7a678d9-10bd-4a4c-af97-51a25c08cf80.Text:
This creature gains immunity to {g|f:423e91ce057d4e2489043ded7306f3e2}horrors of the warp{/g}.
It gains +1 stack of dark blessing each time it suffers {g|Encyclopedia:WarpDamage}warp damage{/g} or is affected by {g|Encyclopedia:PsychicPhenomena}psychic phenomena{/g} or {g|Encyclopedia:PerilsOfWarp}perils of the warp{/g}.

dad970bc-e0f6-4e0e-b666-23cf217515ad.Text: The warp is deaf to my prayers!

9ec5ac74-671b-40e5-bde7-40131508bf93.Text:
There is a 30% chance that this creature will start praying to their Dark Gods at the end of their {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}.
At the start of the creature's next turn, {g|Encyclopedia:VeilThickness}veil degradation{/g} is increased by +1 and the gods answer the prayer:
-<indent=5%>40% chance: {g|Encyclopedia:PsychicPhenomena}psychic phenomena{/g} is triggered.</indent>
-<indent=5%>30% chance: the creature heals 10% of their maximum {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}.</indent>
-<indent=5%>20% chance: nothing happens.</indent>
-<indent=5%>10% chance: the creature becomes a Chaos Spawn.</indent>

f1235812-410e-42fd-a6f3-7cf4c0013a0f.Text: The daemon machine gains {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} equal to its {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}<u>WP</u>{/g}%, {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g} equal to its <u>{g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}TGH{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g}</u>, immunity to {g|Encyclopedia:PerilsOfWarp}perils of the warp{/g}, and immunity to {g|Encyclopedia:ToxicDamage}toxic damage{/g}.

4857de42-9f1c-4dff-b52b-94b632fa3fe6.Text: Whenever this creature scores a {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit{/g}, it reduces the target's armour by −<u>{g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerPerception}PER{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g}</u>% for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}. Stacks.

6e0a6230-d359-4f11-842e-fd058c7c1bce.Text: At the start of the {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, this creature gains +5 to {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}Weapon Skill{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerBallisticSkill}Ballistic Skill{/g} for each ally in a 3-cell radius around it for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.

858531d3-1a0e-4960-89d9-c1edcd73c603.Text:
This creature restores 10% of its maximum {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} at the start of each {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}. It also gains +{g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}<u>TGH</u>{/g}% {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} and +{g|Encyclopedia:DifficultyTier}<u>difficulty tier</u>{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g}.
If the creature is currently affected by {g|f:5617027d4ab7419092156bfadd0fff05}Reanimation Protocol{/g}, it does not gain any armour.

8e1b7cf4-d3fb-43e7-b53d-964779d69425.Text: Hit chance against this mechanism is increased by +50%.

78ab706d-3f1d-4852-8e28-00533a25ad5e.Text:
This mechanism is immune to {g|Encyclopedia:ProneEffect}prone{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:FatiguedEffect}fatigued{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:DisturbedEffect}disturbed{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:PerplexedEffect}perplexed{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:StaggeredEffect}staggered{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}bleeding{/g}, and {g|Encyclopedia:ToxinEffect}toxin{/g} effects, and {g|f:423e91ce057d4e2489043ded7306f3e2}horrors of the warp{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:MentalDamage}mental damage{/g}. It also cannot be {g|Encyclopedia:PushGlossary}pushed{/g}. Its armour and deflection become equal to its <u>TGH</u> and <u>TGH bonus</u>, respectively.
All incoming shock damage is increased by +30%.

5a0ab850-2a5e-4f13-9e90-ab4a15385820.Text: At the beginning of each of the daemon's {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turns{/g}, all creatures around it must pass a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} or suffer the {g|f:423e91ce057d4e2489043ded7306f3e2}horrors of the warp{/g} effect.

40012f48-228c-4cab-9388-e60cc889f76b.Text:
Whenever the daemon enters combat, each party member suffers −<u>(1 × daemon's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}WP{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g})</u> {g|Encyclopedia:MomentumWithDetailsGlossary}momentum{/g}. Whenever the daemon dies, each party member gains +30 momentum.
At the start of each of the daemon's {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turns{/g}, all creatures around it must pass a Willpower {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} or suffer the {g|f:423e91ce057d4e2489043ded7306f3e2}horrors of the warp{/g} effect.

d394e40b-be5d-48f8-a355-30aa1be95d04.Text: The creature gains immunity to {g|Encyclopedia:FatiguedEffect}fatigued{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:DisturbedEffect}disturbed{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:PerplexedEffect}perplexed{/g}, and {g|Encyclopedia:StaggeredEffect}staggered{/g} effects.

4448f45b-5e99-4acb-931d-bdd53b44d2cf.Text:
This creature's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} depends on the amount of its {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}:
-<indent=5%>If it has more than 70% of its total wounds, it has 55% armour.</indent>
-<indent=5%>If it has 70–40% of its total wounds, it has 40% armour.</indent>
-<indent=5%>If it has less than 40% of its total wounds, it has only 25% armour.</indent>
Also, it always suffers +20% toxic and {g|Encyclopedia:FireDamage}fire damage{/g}.

b349c3bc-737e-4637-9f15-0b6030fe7d8d.Text:
The creature is immune to the following effects:
-<indent=5%>{g|Encyclopedia:CantAttackEffect}Cannot attack{/g}</indent>
-<indent=5%>{g|Encyclopedia:FatiguedEffect}Fatigued{/g}</indent>
-<indent=5%>{g|Encyclopedia:DisturbedEffect}Disturbed{/g}</indent>
-<indent=5%>{g|Encyclopedia:ToxinEffect}Toxin{/g}</indent>
-<indent=5%>{g|Encyclopedia:PerplexedEffect}Perplexed{/g}</indent>
-<indent=5%>{g|f:423e91ce057d4e2489043ded7306f3e2}Horrors of the warp{/g}</indent>
{g|Encyclopedia:MentalDamage}Mental damage{/g} dealt to this creature is reduced by −50% and {g|Encyclopedia:MachineDamage}machine damage{/g} is increased by +30%.

cd2067ce-1945-41b9-83c2-ebcbe73b6c27.Text: When this creature's {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} drop to 0, it falls {g|Encyclopedia:ProneEffect}prone{/g} and gains 30% of its {g|Encyclopedia:MaxWounds}maximum wounds{/g} as {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g}. On its next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, the creature is reanimated with 50% of its wounds if it still has temporary wounds. If the creature has no other allies with base wounds more than 0, this creature and its allies die. ! Can only be used once per battle.

2fe4aa0a-255e-441a-bba9-3c8808ce28ed.Text: Grants immunity to {g|Encyclopedia:WarpDamage}warp damage{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:PerilsOfWarp}perils of the warp{/g}.

ee4aa12d-ed71-4d93-a996-8d58f6a386d0.Text: All creatures, excluding Necrons, machines, or Inquisition agents, in a 3-cell radius around this creature suffer −20 {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} and −20 {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerFellowship}Fellowship{/g}.

22295d4e-25b4-48c6-8ffb-233289391c37.Text: The target suffers −5 to {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}Weapon Skill{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerBallisticSkill}Ballistic Skill{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerStrength}Strength{/g}, and −1 {g|Encyclopedia:Resolve}resolve{/g} per {g|Encyclopedia:DifficultyTier}difficulty tier{/g} of the daemon for one {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.

d9f1f507-8b04-43ec-ba96-50a009bb218c.Text: This creature can attack more than once per {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.

eecffb62-d3d1-44d9-8f1c-97614d3901ba.Text: This creature does not trigger {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g}.

f733e407-7050-408e-a768-f1d915f2c208.Text:
The cyber-mastiff is a tough and powerful familiar. Its main purpose is to follow the designated target, be it ally or foe. The {g|f:3311f1213a1e452c874ce2cde5c03f59}Apprehend!{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} allows it to chase and isolate enemies. It is especially efficient against targets using ranged weapons and psykers. While the cyber-mastiff is adjacent to the {g|f:f39e0e323f314259b3e7510b110d3a4b}apprehended{/g} target, it will attack it each time the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} attacks that target. If the target decides to flee, the cyber-mastiff will try to stop it. Once the target is defeated, do not forget to give the cyber-mastiff a new order. It will be {g|f:7e87f215637d45dfb80d7291177ed6c8}waiting{/g}!
The {g|f:78e7771b7c974111887e762d5e999a11}Protect!{/g} ability turns the cyber-mastiff into a dependable bodyguard. It will follow the protected ally and strike anyone who dares to {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} them.
If you do not want to control the familiar directly, use {g|f:11251c47c7b14a87824cffe48ea6374d}Battle Mode: Standby{/g} — the cyber-mastiff will strike the nearest target itself! {g|f:1bdeaab7c66c44a09357141ff127f5ba}Growl!{/g} will weaken enemies in an area, reducing their damage dealt, while {g|f:b1ad536a308a4cb49e0c1c4d31c3ee25}Bite!{/g} and {g|f:05a10418b81049198fb5d792ca346f2f}Run!{/g} provide mobility and help break the enemy lines.

0d6f42cd-0fe5-4532-a7ff-4e24917198c3.Text:
The cyber-eagle is an agile instrument perfectly suitable to oversee the battlefield from above and disorient enemies. While {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}soaring{/g}, it gains access to alternative, more powerful versions of its {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}abilities{/g}.
The {g|f:9cea4a0c57c448f7a90c44998745bf96}Obstruct Vision{/g} ability will cause enemies to destroy each other with their own weapons. The evasive {g|f:53135057d69647a7854e578c5ef40bba}obstructing{/g} cyber-eagle provokes the enemy, causing it to shoot in its direction with an increased chance to {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} that enemy's allies.
If enemies are tightly grouped, {g|f:40bc0f9310894ee2ace0d60daafa3c19}Blinding Strike{/g} can significantly limit their capabilities. {g|f:95c502e72a6743d1ad0cbadf13051225}Strafe{/g} will help the cyber-eagle navigate through enemy lines while also dealing damage. Lastly, {g|f:ce847cb6b6074a528eaf4cc4479d4db0}Live Bait{/g} will turn this familiar into a merciless predator.
If you do not want to control this familiar directly, just let it {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}soar{/g}: it will regain its {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} and wait for the right moment to strike.

e3cdb5cf-4bba-410d-a2ac-655be89c38f5.Text:
The psyber-raven is a powerful instrument of transmitting warp energy. Its {g|f:3159a138a7ee4cc48f4c88ebd3399d96}Warp Relay{/g} ability allows it to enhance the Overseer's psychic powers, spreading their effect to multiple targets at once. If that is not enough, use {g|f:78e54abc64dc4935a4b481f9ca745c27}Complete the Cycle{/g} to transmit the most recently relayed psychic power once again!
No cover can hide the Overseer's enemies who are {g|f:a115669547864ccc816f0598a404e816}under surveillance{/g} if the psyber-raven is nearby. {g|f:5f6ef4bf13754f7285ac540bfd2ee80f}Relocate{/g} provides it with additional mobility.
{g|f:d9580c9bca3d4b068905ba234623cf6a}Stabilise{/g} is an essential ability for helping allies regain their wounds, while {g|f:319b06b3dbad4d47ae1dff5c1647f904}Evil Eye{/g} and {g|f:7962a71f962946258a64df9cd4b7c36a}Purification Discharge{/g} are great ways to deal damage to multiple enemies at once.

68058631-eb26-4a50-aaa0-c012eca56458.Text:
Servo-skull swarm is a versatile support tool that enhances the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g}'s combat capabilities. Thanks to the persistent {g|f:215d9f42b7e6435e9ed77337156e0fc3}extrapolation{/g} effect, it can transmit the effect of the Overseer's {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}abilities{/g} to multiple targets at once, healing and empowering groups of allies and weakening groups of enemies.
Additionally, the servo-skull swarm can influence the course of battle through its signal abilities. {g|f:62eeb81743734fc5b8fac71b34b14683}Medicae Signal{/g} helps its allies to regain {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}, {g|f:a8c7d8404d104d4dad2d460ec2b470ee}Provocation Signal{/g} wreaks havoc among enemy lines, forcing them to attack each other, and {g|f:33aa1b047d084a9b8faf534767a3a534}Priority Signal{/g} distracts the enemy and improves this familiar's defence. The {g|f:5376c2d18af1499db985fbde6d5fe1ce}Relocation{/g} ability provides the servo-skull swarm with additional mobility, allowing the Overseer to move it where it is needed most.

4f77af4f-92e2-4690-a268-222ca53002d8.Text: The plasma battery explodes, dealing <u>(from 8 to 32)</u> {g|Encyclopedia:ShockDamage}shock damage{/g} and inflicting the {g|Encyclopedia:Stun}stunned{/g} effect on everyone in a 2-cell radius. This explosion has 10% {g|Encyclopedia:ArmourPenetration}armour penetration{/g}.

581f7917-fcb5-4380-986e-390cb6edabb6.Text: Increases {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} of the Aeldari ranger's attacks.

0ebb35d1-eee7-4976-92c9-ef65177d19c1.Text: All the Navigator's attacks inflict additional {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} equal to their <u>{g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}WP{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g}</u>. The Navigator's enemies must remain in their {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}line of sight{/g}.

1842ccf1-7e8a-4b81-8074-7cdec4f9604b.Text: All the Navigator's attacks inflict additional {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} equal to their <u>{g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}WP{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g}</u>.

24a04c4e-b2c2-403c-90ce-e09b9e0f9713.Text: The creature is infected and suffers {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} every {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}. In 2 turns their body will burst, releasing a toxic cloud.

d2d2dd23-f98f-450e-84a4-d8a86a686e8d.Text: This creature can perform an additional {g|Encyclopedia:AttacksPerTurn}attack per turn{/g} for 2 {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turns{/g}.

3168dafd-fb11-4099-800a-a35e512992c3.Text: If this creature dies, its allies receive one additional {g|Encyclopedia:AttacksPerTurn}attack per turn{/g} for 2 {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turns{/g}.

a04480e3-cc2d-4577-83e5-91a58348b6d9.Text: If a diseased creature gains 3 stacks of the Shadow Quarters disease effect, the abscesses on their body will erupt with caustic pus, dealing 13 {g|Encyclopedia:ToxicDamage}toxic damage{/g} and resetting the stacks to 1.

0236a764-082c-4343-8d4b-700d4f2a263f.Text: When a diseased creature dies, it creates a toxic area which lasts for 3 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rounds{/g} and deals 7 {g|Encyclopedia:ToxicDamage}toxic damage{/g} to any creature that enters the area or starts its round inside it. These creatures must also pass a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} or gain +1 stack of the Shadow Quarters disease effect.

239e2a06-2006-4a22-a6c1-41cc111883c3.Text: {g|Encyclopedia:PushGlossary}Pushes{/g} an enemy up to 2 cells away.

ac1f8192-bd8e-416d-bd52-6a1352020ae2.Text: Applies +1 stack of the Shadow Quarters disease effect on enemies, while increasing {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerStrength}Strength{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g}, and {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} of allied mutants by +7.

3ff161f6-0cd4-4ba1-925c-ac29a4a27ac6.Text: The creature explodes, dealing 18 {g|Encyclopedia:ImpactDamage}impact damage{/g} to everyone in a 2-cell radius.

7171b1b0-4d3e-417e-8edd-db0e4aa6d8f6.Text: This creature receives {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} and an additional {g|Encyclopedia:AttacksPerTurn}attack per turn{/g}.

a14c67af-2205-4c0d-914c-91ea1b2a890b.Text: Creatures under the frenzy effect gain an additional attack, yet suffer {g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}bleeding{/g}.

337ac727-c245-4d28-af24-9f34fd439838.Text: Increases the {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}movement points{/g} of adjacent allies.

2bb1db55-1d3a-4abd-adf5-d5a829734707.Text: This flame deals {g|Encyclopedia:WarpDamage}warp damage{/g}, decreasing the enemy's {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g} by −1 and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} by −10% for each stack.

d596d9c2-5eb4-4216-bed9-efb0f39e1d0d.Text: Deals {g|Encyclopedia:WarpDamage}warp damage{/g}, decreasing the enemy's {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g} by −1 and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} by −10% for each stack.

8314d684-08ab-448c-b528-9a65181471af.Text: This creature almost lost their mind, but also gained an additional +6 {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} and +6 {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerStrength}Strength{/g}.

cffa0489-1bfe-4d26-b244-8a59739d3ae7.Text: This creature will fulfil any of its commander's orders.

82360f73-4d08-422d-8368-b33ea2d7ea3f.Text: This creature gains +5 minimum {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} and +6 maximum damage.

b463ed1d-fb6b-422b-8e83-51e2c330be20.Text: The world around feels less vivid. {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerPerception}Perception{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g}, and {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} are reduced by −10.

72ffed70-eb0b-4c21-80b9-e66d1e73ee21.Text: Grants an additional {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} that ends the attacker's {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} and deals an additional +30 {g|Encyclopedia:MachineDamage}machine damage{/g} with 50% {g|Encyclopedia:ArmourPenetration}armour penetration{/g}.

c044f580-9352-4f72-aeb3-8984788a6dd1.Text: Shots from this shotgun {g|Encyclopedia:PushGlossary}push{/g} targets 3 cells away even if the shot misses.

e08f6a55-1719-48cc-b086-afbbea338104.Text: This shotgun has an increased attack area. Its attacks deal +150% {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}, but their {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit chance{/g} is decreased by −50%.

7f01c09c-ff3e-4777-88ed-441022fec8b4.Text:
{g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}Damage{/g} from {g|Encyclopedia:OverpenetrationFullGlossary}overpenetration{/g} is always equal to 100%.
Deals an additional +{uip|Damage|ad4636f2df894381b0053a052d04129f} damage.

83609125-35b8-41cd-b946-8eb67cac87ac.Text: This rifle's {g|Encyclopedia:DeadeyeShot}deadeye shot{/g} costs +1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} more and deals triple {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} against large targets (size 2×2 cells and larger).

fe7dd7fd-6c53-4969-b7a3-93570505d7a8.Text: Deals double {g|Encyclopedia:ToxicDamage}toxic damage{/g}. Each successful attack with this weapon increases the {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} of the {g|Encyclopedia:ToxinEffect}toxin{/g} effect suffered by a target by +1.

ccdd2610-ac2d-4ad2-964e-522bdf528580.Text: This rifle inflicts {g|Encyclopedia:FatiguedEffect}fatigued{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:SlowedEffect}slowed{/g} on the target.

e6a85396-2d98-4ec1-ac1f-6a173b2bc9ae.Text: Every {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} from this weapon inflicts +1 stack of {g|Encyclopedia:FatiguedEffect}fatigued{/g} on the target for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g} if the target fails a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g}.

868cdb7f-4cc5-4e79-8540-f884b5d9eafc.Text: Once resting in Nemesite's lofty hand, this stub revolver gave many downtrodden the false promise of freedom.

74063ba7-2494-4063-adba-d6c1c4ee2866.Text:
Grants an additional {g|Encyclopedia:AreaOfEffect}area attack{/g} that affects all adjacent cells around the wielder.
<indent=5%>+1 {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} per target in the area of effect</indent>

fff58819-30f5-4df1-9979-67282333a601.Text:
All collisions caused by the thunder hammer's {g|Encyclopedia:PushGlossary}pushing{/g} attacks deal +300% more {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}.
All targets {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} by this thunder hammer must pass an {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a +10 {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} or fall {g|Encyclopedia:ProneEffect}prone{/g}.

797bd8d1-a5f7-4d41-86dd-a477aaf56236.Text: This flamer's attacks also inflict {g|Encyclopedia:ToxinEffect}toxin{/g} at the same level as {g|Encyclopedia:BurningEffect}burning{/g} is inflicted.

bcb16d15-b422-43d0-9a23-53e4188c5021.Text: {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}Resistance tests{/g} against this webber's effects suffer a −10 penalty.

f22ec546-8e55-4b7e-887b-558ba251ccc3.Text: {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}Resistance tests{/g} against this webber's effects suffer a −15 penalty.

df30b680-6934-426c-8296-14123b49d1a0.Text: {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}Resistance tests{/g} against this webber's effects suffer a −25 penalty.

13c7018e-a6c6-4beb-9394-32c007bce1d1.Text: There is no telling what awaits you beyond the gate, but one thing you know for certain: there will be no turning back — it is the point of no return. Ensure that you have taken care of any unfinished business, procured all necessary equipment, explored every world, and completed any desired colonial projects. You will no longer be able to do so after passing through to the other side.

e313d2b5-4960-4a2a-942c-bc908d4d8933.Text: [Repulsive unintelligible sounds made by the xenos]

7d7fdde5-2ea2-4194-b0c5-b1b672268fbc.Text:
"...to be the paragon of Humanity,
Unbroken by adversity,
To walk bravely first into darkness,
To unite and reclaim what was lost..."

9e22eda7-5e0c-4bd0-aff6-5e535872b847.Text:
"...to triumph over nightmares untold,
To hold boldly the reins of fate,
To walk steadily the road of thorns,
Through pain to greatness."

36a60f39-1962-464e-8bdc-ea78e5559370.Text: "Let it be known, that by my will and by the true words of this document, I appoint this person to be the bearer of the Warrant of Trade, and bestow upon them and their dynasty the great Mission..."

82c970bf-c3c2-4f7b-8d6a-579decb2c667.Text: The C'tan Shard was destroyed. The shadow of calamity threatening the Koronus Expanse should the ancient god ever be unshackled had been lifted... at least, for a time.

467b4780-1c62-4dcd-989b-e6578d698957.Text: If rumours are to be believed, the madness that permeated the Rogue Trader's ship had struck the Seneschal's mind as well.
