The ally immediately gains an {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}extra turn{/g} during which they can only use a single ability, mimicking the effect of the Warrior's {g|f:4955b43454f6488f82892e166c76c995}Charge{/g}, which costs 0 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}.

16c92564-1091-42b7-86be-066e03edfea5.Text:
The first use of this {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} on any target marks the target. Enemy targets must pass a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} to avoid this.
The second use returns the target to the position where it was during the first use and restores its {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} to the state they were at during that time.
If this cell is occupied or unreachable from their current position, they move to the next closest cell in the direction of the Navigator.

ce0ae9de-c483-4340-8e57-4962a385dcc5.Text: The Navigator deals <u>(from {uip|MinDamage|ec639338f11e49b1a75a7b9757a77076} to {uip|MaxDamage|ec639338f11e49b1a75a7b9757a77076})</u> {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} to an enemy. That enemy must pass a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} or become {g|Encyclopedia:ImmobilisedEffect}immobilised{/g} until the start of the Navigator's next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}.

660a289f-0c02-4ad3-bb18-044e4e7c4769.Text: Deals (from {uip|MinDamage|08767fbd714148ae88d5b1daf1dbc327} to {uip|MaxDamage|08767fbd714148ae88d5b1daf1dbc327}) damage to all targets in line and inflicts the soul burn effect. Soul Burn: The target suffers {uip|BurnDamage|08767fbd714148ae88d5b1daf1dbc327} damage at the start of their {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}. At the end of their turn, they must pass a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} to remove the flames. When {g|Encyclopedia:BurningEffect}burning{/g}, psykers suffer additional damage every time they use {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic powers{/g}, and daemons — every time they attack or use psychic powers.

b48df9c0-fdcf-443b-a226-464a727b942b.Text: All Navigator powers now have a chance to score a {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit{/g}. Their basic critical {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit chance{/g} is equal to <u>(Navigator's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerPerception}PER{/g} / 2)</u>%.

fd9c6da0-4a07-4d1b-81d4-8102a221fb55.Text: All Navigator powers gain +{uip|CritChance|1b425f19327f429eb4fbfae69950b868}% {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit chance{/g}.

83c11703-f24e-49cb-89e5-79841c6c47c9.Text: The Navigator creates a circle with a 2-cell radius. Every creature that is in it, enters it, or begins their {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} in the circle, suffers <u>(from {uip|MinDamage|9043cccc4e3a4aef82d86f4c46052dc6} to {uip|MaxDamage|9043cccc4e3a4aef82d86f4c46052dc6})</u> {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}. The circle remains for 3 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rounds{/g} or until the Navigator creates it again.

505c0b64-d3b6-4b90-8c8e-81d805b44c58.Text: All enemies within the area suffer a −{uip|StatPenalty|3db1b866b28e4256b359b89f45a6f38a} {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} to their {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g} until the end of the combat.

b335ea0e-5d3c-48a1-b9d1-f32477075211.Text: The enemy becomes cursed until the end of combat. Cursed: all incoming {g|Encyclopedia:WarpDamage}warp damage{/g} is increased by +{uip|WarpDamageBonus|3705e0ad78154ee0bd6436fc15dac784}% and other types of incoming {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} are increased by +{uip|DamageBonus|3705e0ad78154ee0bd6436fc15dac784}%. At the start of their {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, the enemy closest to them also becomes cursed.

3a3904b3-b31f-404a-9a21-3e67fd2dd936.Text: The Navigator designates a square. The enemy closest to that square immediately moves up to 4 cells toward it. If multiple enemies are the same distance from that point, all of them move. The targets move even if they are {g|Encyclopedia:Stun}stunned{/g} or {g|Encyclopedia:ImmobilisedEffect}immobilised{/g}.

ff1e8061-73ff-4f5a-9383-0fe862e58f01.Text: All {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance tests{/g} against Navigator powers gain a −<u>(2 × {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerPerception}PER{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g})</u> {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g}.

0b1773f4-718c-4ef1-9c6d-19d82cbc938c.Text: All {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance tests{/g} against Navigator powers suffer a −{uip|ResistancePenalty|d1825e9618cb4b9f9e06d12e3824d5c3} {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g}.

a47de320-96eb-4691-b006-34d647872e95.Text: All enemies in a 6-cell radius around the target point, up to 12 cells away from the Navigator, must pass a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} or immediately move 3 cells toward that point. The targets move even if they are {g|Encyclopedia:Stun}stunned{/g} or {g|Encyclopedia:ImmobilisedEffect}immobilised{/g}.

160a2a33-7bc1-4b03-85a8-003f66f426bd.Text: The Navigator creates a circle with a 3-cell radius. Any creature that is inside it, enters it, or ends their {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} inside, not under the effect of apathy, makes a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g}. Failure applies the apathy effect to the creature. Apathy: The target is {g|Encyclopedia:ImmobilisedEffect}immobilised{/g}. After one round passes under the effect of apathy, the target must make a Willpower resistance {g|Encyclopedia:Test}test{/g}. Success removes apathy. Failure stuns the creature for 1 round, removes apathy, and makes the creature immune to any further effects of Spot of Apathy until the end of combat.

bc45137a-8f8c-4eca-8561-8e6e88cb9480.Text:
All enemies in a 2-cell radius around the target point must pass a Willpower {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g}. Those who fail, even if they are {g|Encyclopedia:Stun}stunned{/g} or {g|Encyclopedia:ImmobilisedEffect}immobilised{/g}, immediately gain an {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}extra turn{/g} where they attack their allies.
Every time an enemy becomes the target of this Navigator power again during the same combat, they gain a stackable +20 bonus to Willpower resistance {g|Encyclopedia:Test}tests{/g} against it.

b79878f4-d1dc-47f9-bbf5-d8c40114329e.Text: All creatures in the area of effect must pass a Willpower {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} or immediately move out of the zone even if they are {g|Encyclopedia:Stun}stunned{/g} or {g|Encyclopedia:ImmobilisedEffect}immobilised{/g}. This movement triggers {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g} from the Navigator's allies who have passed the {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} or are outside the zone.

082e562d-6815-4abc-949f-4ca7ff180e3b.Text: Enemies {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damaged{/g} by the Navigator suffer +{uip|DamageBonus|e406f5febaa0417892d1b55e9223761e}% additional damage from any source of {g|Encyclopedia:WarpDamage}warp damage{/g}. The bonus damage stacks for each {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} inflicted by the Navigator. This effect stacks up to 5 times.

ed653dff-259e-44cb-92e7-bed56fbc3e49.Text: Every even {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} (second, fourth, etc.), the Navigator gains an additional {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}action point{/g}. Every odd turn (first, third, etc.), the Navigator gains +20 {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerPerception}Perception{/g}.

ec2c8be8-596f-4dde-93fb-60e0a2c3d83d.Text: Every enemy the Navigator has in their {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}line of sight{/g} has its {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit chance{/g} reduced by −{uip|DodgePenalty|51fa09bfa6334b46ac543174326fbd33}.

7979fed4-8606-4943-99b1-aacc3ea025b3.Text: Navigator powers deal +1 additional damage for every 5 {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} characteristic of the Navigator's currently equipped staff. {g|Encyclopedia:Castigating}Castigating{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:Infusing}infusing{/g}, and {g|Encyclopedia:Devastating}devastating{/g} count as characteristics for this {g|Encyclopedia:Talent}talent{/g}.

03920eed-6df4-47a5-9a16-ca411729be24.Text: The Navigator starts all {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turns{/g}, including {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}extra turns{/g}, with +3 additional {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}movement points{/g}. The first ally targeted by the Navigator with a single-target {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} each turn gains the same amount of additional movement points at the start of their next turn.

dd1de461-4d2c-43be-b986-30fefeda3cd3.Text: Whenever an ally in combat gains an {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}extra turn{/g}, the Navigator gains a stacking +5 {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} until the end of combat. Stacks up to 5 times (up to a maximum of +25 Willpower).

a45d4b2f-553e-4789-abd5-17a2dbf389f2.Text: The Navigator makes all {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance tests{/g} with their {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} if it is higher than the base {g|Encyclopedia:Characteristic}characteristic{/g} for such test. If the Navigator's Willpower is higher than their {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g}, the Navigator's {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} are calculated according to their Willpower.

3629891e-0768-418f-a604-4f2a270ab853.Text: Enemies affected by the Navigator's powers suffer a stacking −10 {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} to the next {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} from the Navigator's powers. The penalty is lost after such a test is made.

dfe201a8-f202-4faf-9547-169d51c39b93.Text: If the Navigator's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerPerception}Perception{/g} is higher than their {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g}, their {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} is calculated using Perception instead.

1775ba42-6749-4619-a146-2189c3d1e734.Text: Enemies moved by the Navigator's powers suffer {uip|Damage|5615a2517001450ea9205f263c72fd1e} {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} at the end of movement. This damage is increased by +1 for every cell the enemy moves.

aae8d8f3-91d9-46c0-be9b-cce07b8d64bf.Text: Whenever the Navigator uses a Navigator power, {g|Encyclopedia:VeilThickness}veil degradation{/g} is reduced by −1.

dc4ac5be-13de-467b-9f0d-cb318171f1db.Text: The Navigator heals {unit_stat|WarhammerWillpower|bonus} {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} at the beginning of every {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} and gains +1 additional wound for every Navigator {g|Encyclopedia:Talent}talent{/g} taken. The healing increases by +1 for every creature killed in between the Navigator's turns.

04461561-11fb-4724-9494-6299d35843c8.Text: Whenever the Navigator uses a Navigator power that has not been used this combat, the Navigator gains +2 {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerPerception}Perception{/g} until the end of combat.

c3a39c5c-408f-4034-a1df-fd784965eac9.Text: Whenever an enemy fails a {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} against a Navigator's power, attacks against them gain +{uip|CritChanceBonus|d01deb8d10f64c8cbd0717df85adb61b}% {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit chance{/g}. The effect stacks but is reset by a critical {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g}.

6d474d7a-c9d6-4439-b082-7f01e1b98519.Text: Any effects, applied by the Navigator and activated at the start or at the end of the target's {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, are inflicted one additional time at the end of every one of the Navigator's turn.

ba792556-1308-4ac8-9ea6-5cea12833bb8.Text: Until the end of combat, enemies {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damaged{/g} by the Navigator suffer an additional +{unit_stat|WarhammerPerception|bonus} damage from all {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g} and cannot {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} them.

175003a4-54ca-436f-83d9-76dfeed6717c.Text: While under the effect of any Navigator power, enemies have their {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} reduced by −{uip|ResistancePenalty|79abfcdecc5f434b80214d0c8647fe3e}. This reduction is increased by the {g|Encyclopedia:Devastating}devastating{/g} parameter of the Navigator's staff but does not stack.

6dffab84-dd8a-4de7-95cd-061299c2edc2.Text: Allies that are targeted by the Navigator's {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}abilities{/g} gain +5 to all {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance tests{/g} against {g|Encyclopedia:VeilThickness}warp{/g} effects (caused by daemons, {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic powers{/g}, Navigator powers, etc.) until the end of combat. The effect stacks with every applied ability.

0faf46f0-7790-4f11-bce6-4aabfff3308c.Text: The Navigator gains +5 {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerFellowship}Fellowship{/g} and an additional +1 Fellowship for every Navigator {g|Encyclopedia:Talent}talent{/g} or Navigator power taken.

fccc1e1d-1423-435d-866b-04db4fc37742.Text: Allies that are targeted by the Navigator's power gain +10% {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g}. This additional armour is reduced by the amount of {g|Encyclopedia:VeilThickness}veil degradation{/g} (to a minimum of +0%) and increased by the {g|Encyclopedia:Infusing}infusing{/g} parameter of the currently equipped Navigator's staff.

bfb2fa6d-285e-43f6-8d83-bf9164ff326b.Text: Whenever the psyker is healed or heals any ally, if the character being healed is already at full {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}, that character instead gains {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g} equal to the healing. These temporary wounds do not stack.

1527d981-12fa-490b-91e6-04f7c90a3eb4.Text:
When an enemy adjacent to an ally dies, that ally gains a stacking corpus conversion effect. If multiple allies are adjacent to the dead enemy, one is selected at random.
The psyker's next {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} that targets only the target with corpus conversion will work as if the psyker's {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}psy rating{/g} is +2 higher, will not degrade the {g|Encyclopedia:VeilThickness}veil{/g}, will not trigger {g|Encyclopedia:PsychicPhenomena}psychic phenomena{/g} or {g|Encyclopedia:PerilsOfWarp}perils of the warp{/g}, and will remove −1 stack of corpus conversion from the target.

d591feee-c152-4e6d-b2b9-efd89985b4ff.Text: Whenever the psyker heals themselves or another character with a {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} or an effect applied by a psychic power, this healing can critically heal with a chance of {uip|CritChance|d46817aabd934faeb9187cfcddb64f26}%. This critical heal chance is increased by all the effects that increase {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit chance{/g}, and the amount healed is increased by the same value as critical {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}.

29a1e1ad-26b1-46d4-9e1d-ed50296aaeb2.Text: Whenever an effect applied by the psyker increases the {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} suffered by a target, this effect is increased by half (for example, a 20% increase becomes a 30% increase).

a6993f58-012d-4a54-9dfa-3947d8f73f15.Text: In the first {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g} of every combat, all {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic powers{/g} of the biomancy discipline cost −1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}action point{/g}.

cf2da649-7712-498a-b83e-4cd76120ebb8.Text: All the psyker's attacks, including attacking {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic powers{/g}, now poison enemies. This poison deals {uip|Damage|c31aa2454d10447db0f279883bc5904a} {g|Encyclopedia:ToxicDamage}toxic damage{/g} at the start of each of the enemy's {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turns{/g}.

cf20b8de-ce4b-4411-a48b-279feeb6a54e.Text: Every time the psyker deals {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}, they gain +1 stack of the sanguine siphon effect. If that damage was dealt to a target adjacent to the psyker, they gain +2 stacks instead. When the psyker suffers lethal damage, the stacks of sanguine siphon are removed to reduce this damage by −1 for each stack, until either all stacks are removed or the damage is no longer lethal.

59dcfd93-d4f2-4e43-944d-d0849fc6827b.Text: When the psyker's allies or the psyker themselves are under the effects of {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic powers{/g}, they gain +5 {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g} for each of such effects.

18be6243-54ad-4f8f-8b17-e0fb3f2ceee2.Text:
The psyker drains life from the target, dealing {uip|Damage|65791f6355c04864b890c9e964b9c372} {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} and healing all the psyker's allies and the psyker themselves for {uip|Healing|65791f6355c04864b890c9e964b9c372} {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}. At the end of the psyker's next turn, all the psyker's allies will lose {uip|Wounds|65791f6355c04864b890c9e964b9c372} wounds unless the combat is already over.
This {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} always triggers {g|Encyclopedia:PerilsOfWarp}perils of the warp{/g}.

1303f445-efbf-4954-93f5-48fc930645f2.Text: The psyker drains life from the target, dealing {uip|Damage|f8629a743eaf414eb8bf79edee9b02d0} {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} and healing all the psyker's allies and the psyker themselves for {uip|Healing|f8629a743eaf414eb8bf79edee9b02d0} {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}.

a253f071-028e-4624-be74-7bbc9026aa0d.Text: The psyker drains life from the target, dealing {uip|Damage|fb5efed90c6442acb6f9c756905072eb} {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} and healing the psyker for {uip|Healing|fb5efed90c6442acb6f9c756905072eb} {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}. If the psyker is already at full wounds, this power instead heals the psyker's ally with the lowest wounds.

647a7d8a-06bf-4f1d-88a0-230ce6e5241e.Text:
The psyker drains life from the target, dealing <u>(psyker's staff power level × {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}psy rating{/g})</u> damage and healing the psyker for <u>psyker's staff power level</u> {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}. If the psyker is already at full wounds, this power instead heals the psyker's ally with the lowest wounds.
{g|Encyclopedia:HeroicAct}Heroic act{/g}: the psyker drains life from the target, dealing <u>(2 × psyker's staff power level × psy rating)</u> damage and healing all the psyker's allies and the psyker themselves for <u>(2 × psyker's staff power level)</u> wounds.
{g|Encyclopedia:DesperateMeasure}Desperate measure{/g}: the psyker drains life from the target, dealing <u>(2 × psyker's staff power level × psy rating)</u> damage and healing all the psyker's allies and the psyker themselves for <u>(2 × psyker's staff power level)</u> wounds. At the end of the psyker's next turn, all the psyker's allies will lose <u>(4 × psyker's staff power level)</u> wounds unless the combat is already over. This psychic power always triggers {g|Encyclopedia:PerilsOfWarp}perils of the warp{/g}.

c33d691f-3adf-414a-a955-2f31a9fc2bb5.Text: At the beginning of every combat, the psyker's allies gain +15% {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit chance{/g}. The first critical {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} removes this effect.

dcd9e3aa-172b-4e62-9ba0-1fe3a352ffc6.Text: Allies under the effect of at least one {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} applied by this psyker gain an additional +{uip|ArmourPenetrationBonus|119525ff526c431c9a931d6f655e3f09}% {g|Encyclopedia:ArmourPenetration}armour penetration{/g}.

167a0b73-154c-4f3d-b91e-0361a367b86b.Text: The psyker always begins combat first in the {g|Encyclopedia:InitiativeGlossary}initiative{/g} order.

18acb4bb-8d26-43b0-8bac-1562231bbe2c.Text: Every 9th successful {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} and/or {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g} by the psyker and their allies combined grants the psyker +2 additional {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} on the next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}.

ef4afe8e-ee8b-43e2-93b9-84b49e607f8f.Text: The first {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} attempt of every enemy in combat suffers a −{uip|DodgePenalty|ced3039da8724fcea4690f614db18d6c}% {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g}.

0dc3d4df-f924-44df-aada-7bc524ba85e0.Text: Any effect applied by the psyker that reduces enemy's {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} also reduces enemy's {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g} unless it already does so.

6c945b05-1df2-4a28-8131-686c84b79979.Text: When the psyker uses a divination {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} on an ally without an unnatural luck effect, that ally gains unnatural luck. Unnatural Luck: when the ally suffers a {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit{/g}, it becomes a normal {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} instead and the unnatural luck effect is removed.

ee8b3282-0676-444c-a6bc-da322df3cf20.Text: If an ally is already under the effect of one of the psyker's {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic powers{/g}, the psyker can target that ally with a single-target psychic power regardless of the range and {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}line of sight{/g}.

982e5b96-accb-4d36-bf00-5125830e10fe.Text:
The next {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} against every creature in combat (both allies and enemies) will be an automatic {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit{/g}.
This {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} always triggers {g|Encyclopedia:PerilsOfWarp}perils of the warp{/g}.

3fd7421f-98c8-49f0-b4c5-06e482aa6833.Text: The next attack against every enemy in combat will be an automatic {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit{/g}.

0b147871-57d3-44d0-b880-b89629342381.Text: The next {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} against the target will be an automatic {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit{/g}.

7f4fb032-396d-4406-9846-66b8715a96b1.Text:
The next hit against the target will be an automatic {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit{/g}.
{g|Encyclopedia:HeroicAct}Heroic act{/g}: the next hit against every enemy in combat will be an automatic critical hit.
{g|Encyclopedia:DesperateMeasure}Desperate measure{/g}: the next hit against every creature in combat (both allies and enemies) will be an automatic critical hit. This {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} always triggers {g|Encyclopedia:PerilsOfWarp}perils of the warp{/g}.

74316417-b0df-4d28-9b5b-92ec943b7f92.Text: Force weapon attacks deal +{uip|DamageBonus|0618c379e430483bab1a17b2de559bc5} more {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} and have +{uip|ArmourPenetrationBonus|0618c379e430483bab1a17b2de559bc5}% more {g|Encyclopedia:ArmourPenetration}armour penetration{/g}.

2757ad4e-d20f-4cfa-a1b9-b6237c5339f6.Text: [draft]{g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}Psychic powers{/g} that target allies have a chance not to {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} the {g|Encyclopedia:VeilThickness}veil{/g}. The chance is equal to the highest of <u>5×({g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerFellowship}FEL{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g})</u>%, and is based on the highest Fellowship among the Psyker and all allies targeted by the psychic power.

1c6d137f-dc0d-4de8-852c-d843fee11db9.Text: Usage of a {g|Encyclopedia:HeroicAct}heroic act{/g} by the psyker decreases {g|Encyclopedia:VeilThickness}veil degradation{/g} by −{unit_stat|WarhammerIntelligence|bonus}.

e4c7cef6-7bfd-44c6-b393-48d8e495bbdd.Text: [draft]If the second attack that the Psyker uses in the {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} is a {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g}, it works as if the Psyker had +2 {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}psy rating{/g}.

707a56a0-b647-4b70-8099-8ea09d054510.Text: Whenever the psyker uses a damaging {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} on targets that are 6 cells or farther from the psyker, the targets suffer an additional +{unit_stat|WarhammerBallisticSkill|bonus} {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}.

adf82f4b-86b0-4ebf-8d54-be11f16f6d79.Text: The psyker's {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic powers{/g} that have a range of 2 cells or more have their range increased by +{unit_stat|WarhammerPerception|bonus}.

13c2e986-90b0-41f7-864f-a54535b06d2e.Text: The first {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} used each {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} increases {g|Encyclopedia:VeilThickness}veil degradation{/g} by 2 points less. If this {g|Encyclopedia:Talent}talent{/g} reduces the effect on veil degradation to less than 0, veil degradation is instead decreased by 1.

9d4fc11a-bef1-425a-93ec-59da6a0c0f40.Text: The psyker can use a damaging {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} while being threatened by enemies in {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee range{/g} without provoking {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g}. Non-damaging {g|Encyclopedia:PsychicPowers}psychic powers{/g} do not provoke attacks of opportunity even without this {g|Encyclopedia:Talent}talent{/g}.

055fd702-cac4-4c25-9af8-8299d236d060.Text: [draft]Enemies under the effect of the Psyker's {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic powers{/g} suffer +10% {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} from the Psyker's allies under the effect of the Psyker's {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}abilities{/g} from doctrines or psychic powers. This {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} increases to +20% if an ally is under the effect of both the Psyker's psychic power and the Psyker's ability from a {g|Encyclopedia:Career}doctrine{/g}.

dcc3ffa1-cd48-4dcd-9fa7-fa168064724b.Text: While the psyker is not in the target's {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}line of sight{/g}, or the psyker is in {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}cover{/g}, all {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance tests{/g} of the target suffer a −{uip|ResistancePenalty|f92bf6d353374502953387488d2ba3e2} {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g}.

57dc5e92-3a13-4692-9e8f-13dc717284e7.Text: The psyker's {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit chance{/g} increases by +1% until the end of combat every time the psyker deals {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} by any means.

3e5ca69c-74f4-4ae7-ba25-3bfe2aa2bce7.Text: Whenever a {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} used by the psyker deals {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}, a random enemy within 2 cells from the initial target suffers half of this damage. That damage does not trigger this {g|Encyclopedia:Talent}talent{/g} again.

b3558251-0e95-42a7-a208-7591c96faa33.Text: The psyker gains +{uip|ArmourAgainstFire|52a24c4f709741489b8a0034109ecfdb}% additional {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} against fire {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} and half this amount as additional armour against {g|Encyclopedia:EnergyDamage}energy damage{/g} from las, melta, and plasma weapons.

87f918a1-9492-4700-9670-c0494bd529a1.Text: When the psyker uses a {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g}, all enemies adjacent to the psyker suffer {uip|Damage|8e85511b779e41548d0b57635ecfd4db} {g|Encyclopedia:DirectDamage}direct damage{/g}. The same also happens when the psyker suffers damage from {g|Encyclopedia:BurningEffect}burning{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}bleeding{/g}, or {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee attacks{/g}.

5ccbdefb-b6eb-4a27-87f4-ec80e18ae470.Text: When the psyker is {g|Encyclopedia:BurningEffect}burning{/g}, the psyker's {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}psy rating{/g} is increased by +1, and the psyker's {g|Encyclopedia:Resolve}resolve{/g} is increased by +2. {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}Damage{/g} from fire no longer reduces the psyker's {g|Encyclopedia:MomentumWithDetailsGlossary}momentum{/g}.

2503946e-2aa1-467f-b594-ba7bf3ef9e81.Text: Every time the psyker kills or scores a {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit{/g} against 8 creatures in one combat, the psyker's next attack (including attacking {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic powers{/g}) will cost 0 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} and will not count toward the attack limit per {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}.

bac79307-8d7b-4141-9e2c-c6ede500a262.Text: Every time an enemy suffers {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} from the psyker, that enemy's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} is reduced by −5%. If the enemy's armour is already 0, their {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g} is reduced by −1 instead.

4b559407-cff7-44f2-ad41-488760d0da5e.Text: All {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}-over-time effects applied by the psyker gain a {uip|Chance|25d44ec9def7447e9548469634168275}% {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit chance{/g}. This chance is increased by all {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonuses{/g} to critical {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit chance{/g}.

afda9532-5898-4500-b42d-4a4420efcf01.Text: The psyker unleashes a torrent of {uip|Count|8a759cdc2b754309b1fb75397798fbf1} flaming projectiles, each dealing <u>(from {uip|DamageMin|8a759cdc2b754309b1fb75397798fbf1} to {uip|DamageMax|8a759cdc2b754309b1fb75397798fbf1})</u> damage. The projectiles have a 60% chance to fly along the central line, and a 40% chance to deviate to one of the lateral lines. Creatures that are hit by 2 or more projectiles gains the {g|f:b91a3b9afb9147848d8167dbcf16d092}warp burn{/g} effect.

433bf8b3-a947-43ea-accb-7a7e40c50d30.Text:
The psyker unleashes a torrent of {uip|Count|c4ea2ad9fe1e4509916cb5f1787b1530} flaming projectiles, each dealing <u>(from {uip|DamageMin|c4ea2ad9fe1e4509916cb5f1787b1530} to {uip|DamageMax|c4ea2ad9fe1e4509916cb5f1787b1530})</u> damage. The projectiles are distributed along random trajectories. Creatures that are hit by 2 or more projectiles suffer the {g|f:b91a3b9afb9147848d8167dbcf16d092}warp burn{/g} effect. This {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} always triggers {g|Encyclopedia:PerilsOfWarp}perils of the warp{/g}.
This psychic power cannot be affected by the {g|f:27dc9a14aaca464a901dc6242123c154}Rapid Fire{/g} ability.

d08a507b-d071-411a-acd6-835f2ec0d972.Text:
The psyker unleashes a torrent of {uip|Count|84ddefd28f224d5fb3f5e176375c1f05} flaming projectiles, each dealing <u>(from {uip|DamageMin|84ddefd28f224d5fb3f5e176375c1f05} to {uip|DamageMax|84ddefd28f224d5fb3f5e176375c1f05})</u> damage. The projectiles have an 80% chance to fly along the central line and a 20% chance to deviate to one of the lateral lines. Creatures that are hit by 2 or more projectiles suffer the {g|f:b91a3b9afb9147848d8167dbcf16d092}warp burn{/g} effect.
This {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} cannot be affected by the {g|f:27dc9a14aaca464a901dc6242123c154}Rapid Fire{/g} ability.

d89ac4ac-58eb-4022-91a3-1c1246340198.Text: Whenever the psyker gains {g|Encyclopedia:MomentumWithDetailsGlossary}momentum{/g}, the psyker also gains {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g} equal to the half of the gained momentum. Temporary {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} gained from this effect do not stack.

07009740-f762-4913-80bf-ac956eedcd96.Text: The psyker's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} increases by +5%. This {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} increases by +5% at the start of every {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g} of combat except the first.

9d8fbc8c-d26e-45df-9885-b1eea3dcb436.Text: Enemies adjacent to the psyker suffer +10% more {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}.

ee6496b2-a292-417e-bd9a-f6beef131476.Text: The first time that {g|Encyclopedia:MomentumWithDetailsGlossary}momentum{/g} reaches 200 during the psyker's {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, the psyker gains +5 to all {g|Encyclopedia:Characteristic}characteristics{/g}, +1 to {g|Encyclopedia:Resolve}resolve{/g}, +1 to {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g}, and +1 to all damage that the psyker deals until the end of combat.

bbed7946-3bac-41f3-ba1f-45de6c4cc584.Text:
Whenever the psyker uses a {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} on themselves or an area effect psychic power that only targets the psyker, they can use that psychic power again this turn for −1 less {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} and without affecting the {g|Encyclopedia:VeilThickness}veil{/g} or triggering {g|Encyclopedia:PsychicPhenomena}psychic phenomena{/g} or {g|Encyclopedia:PerilsOfWarp}perils of the warp{/g}.
This second use of the psychic power cannot affect the psyker.

b4b38f3f-9748-40e8-9b91-2f3e984a9e00.Text: {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}Critical hits{/g} scored by anyone within the psyker's {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}line of sight{/g} (including the psyker themselves) increase the psyker's critical {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} by +1% until the end of combat. Stacks.

04fc8aa1-a241-447b-8320-45c4437de5a6.Text: The psyker's {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}psy rating{/g} is increased by +1 until the end of combat every time an ally uses a {g|Encyclopedia:HeroicAct}heroic act{/g}.

e7a6859a-14b4-4770-8001-4b7fe524977f.Text: The psyker's {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit chance{/g} is increased by +{unit_stat|Resolve|Resolve}%.

a4e0d664-f635-469c-ad72-1a500aa51f0c.Text: Everyone adjacent to the target cell suffers <u>(from 1 to {uip|Damage|560aa7c658a441df8bb4b2f9f431064b})</u> {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}. Damage dealt by this attack to allies is reduced by that ally's {g|Encyclopedia:Resolve}resolve{/g}.

21d59752-9020-4a73-b524-73c2799dda4e.Text:
Everyone adjacent to the target cell suffers <u>(from 1 to {uip|Damage|7039f3b35fc5487e9b6c64909062ea04})</u> {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}. Damage dealt to them is increased by +{uip|Debuff|7039f3b35fc5487e9b6c64909062ea04}% until the end of combat. The psyker also suffers this damage and effect.
This {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} always triggers {g|Encyclopedia:PerilsOfWarp}perils of the warp{/g}.

2ae4f2c9-2f35-42cd-a8d1-9b0ebecd258d.Text: Everyone adjacent to the target cell suffers <u>(from 1 to {uip|Damage|bdde427505b14cd68b20ab0d915d5fe3})</u> {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} and increases damage suffered by them until the end of combat by +{uip|Debuff|bdde427505b14cd68b20ab0d915d5fe3}%.

af22047f-159e-4d1f-8e47-41323c4fe04f.Text: [draft]Enemies that {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} the Psyker (or Psyker's {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}cover{/g} while trying to hit the Psyker) with a ranged attack, suffer <u>2+({g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}psy rating{/g})</u> {g|Encyclopedia:IrreducibleDamage}irreducible damage{/g}.

027c17df-a8dc-4ff7-9ab7-0c30126e6727.Text: [draft]Any enemy of the Psyker that is either {g|Encyclopedia:PushGlossary}pushed{/g} away or fall {g|Encyclopedia:ProneEffect}prone{/g} suffers {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}<u>psy rating</u>{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:IrreducibleDamage}irreducible damage{/g}. The same happens to enemies that either push or knock prone one of the Psyker's allies.

cd985e57-ed9d-4832-9746-3b4cc5be4566.Text: [draft]After every use of a {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g}, the Psyker regains 2 {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}movement points{/g}.

87e98401-5e26-4df0-86a0-3390f933477e.Text: [draft]{g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}Psychic powers{/g} deal additional {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} equal to half of the {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}movement points{/g} the Psyker had before using it.

eced513a-ca5f-4852-be0b-5b7b68876a6f.Text: [draft]The Psyker uses Willpower instead of {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerStrength}Strength{/g} for calculating {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee{/g} weapon damage, levels of skills, ranged weapon {g|Encyclopedia:Recoil}recoil{/g}, and effects of {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}abilities{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Talent}talents{/g} that rely on Strength.

f79e95c7-a6ed-4fd3-a824-d84f2ddccb14.Text: [draft]Every use of a {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} increases the Psyker's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} against ranged attacks by +5 until the start of the Psyker's next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}.

9ebcf8ff-6178-4a95-9217-9babc05eec0e.Text: [draft]The Psyker and their allies gain a +<u>5×(Psyker's {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}psy rating{/g})</u>% {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:OverpenetrationFullGlossary}overpenetration{/g} chance for ranged attacks, and their attacks have a −15% less chance to be parried.

5c97d2f7-1e96-4acc-abaa-759373c14b33.Text: [draft]Enemies affected by {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic powers{/g} of telekinetic type suffer −20 to their {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerPerception}Perception{/g} until the end of the Psyker's next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}.

1563f429-c27a-4488-9999-ed750ff40629.Text: [draft]Targets in a circle with a 4-cell radius around the Psyker and the Psyker themselves suffer 2×X damage and must pass a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Test}test{/g} with a −2×X penalty. Creatures that fail the test become {g|Encyclopedia:ImmobilisedEffect}immobilised{/g} until the Psyker's next turn. The Psyker automatically fails the test. At the beginning of the Psyker's next turn the effect repeats for the Psyker. This {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} always triggers {g|Encyclopedia:PerilsOfWarp}perils of the warp{/g}. In all the formulas, X equals the level of this psychic power granted by a psyker's stave.

9f85c7ea-6e51-4f8e-917d-fda814878f50.Text: [draft]Enemies within a circle with a 4-cell radius around the target point suffer 2×X damage and must pass a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Test}test{/g} with a −2×X penalty. Enemies that fail the test become {g|Encyclopedia:ImmobilisedEffect}immobilised{/g} until the Psyker's next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}. At the beginning of the Psyker's next turn, the effect repeats within the same area. In all the formulas, X equals the level of this {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} granted by a psyker's stave.

25f16fbb-b4d4-4eef-bb29-af293750e4e1.Text: [draft]All targets within a cross-shaped area with a 1-cell radius around the target point suffer X {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} and must pass a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Test}test{/g} with a −2×X penalty. Creatures that fail the test become {g|Encyclopedia:ImmobilisedEffect}immobilised{/g} until the Psyker's next turn. In all the formulas, X equals the level of this {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} granted by a psyker's stave.

04adf1c1-e44b-49d5-94ab-da3723fd3d96.Text: Every time the psyker deals {g|Encyclopedia:MentalDamage}mental damage{/g} from any source other than Aftershock, the target suffers half as much mental {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} at the end of their next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}.

9a675543-6936-4b3b-af26-7306363feeca.Text: Enemies that have taken {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} from the psyker at least once suffer a −20 {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} to all {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance tests{/g} against the psyker until the end of combat.

5c61a680-2296-4e3f-811a-9a861e603938.Text: Enemies that have failed a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} against any of the psyker's {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic powers{/g} will suffer an additional +{uip|Damage|95b11cc99c294b35a151c89ba6805241} {g|Encyclopedia:DirectDamage}direct damage{/g} every time they suffer mental {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} until the end of combat.

30a070f6-7643-436b-bbf9-b661bcec26b4.Text: Any time an enemy becomes a target of any particular psyker {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} for the first time, this enemy suffers a −5 {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} to their {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerIntelligence}Intelligence{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerPerception}Perception{/g}, and the psyker's Intelligence and Perception increase by +2 until the end of combat.

380f6f69-5bc9-48a1-9167-101047cc2d39.Text: Whenever the psyker kills an enemy with a {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} dealing more {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} than the target's {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}, the excess damage will be dealt to the enemy closest to the target.

4bdf97af-3eab-4539-9b38-a3d90df2c2ee.Text: Enemies that become targets of the psyker's {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic powers{/g} gain a stacking −5% {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} to their {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g} until the end of combat.

8f5b5123-90e0-4700-9328-58779d4c7cd6.Text: After every 6th use of a {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} by the psyker, all enemies gain a stacking −5 {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} to all {g|Encyclopedia:Characteristic}characteristics{/g} until the end of combat.

51645551-a3bc-4e03-b3dc-447d1533965f.Text: Enemies suffering from the {g|Encyclopedia:BlindedEffect}blinded{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:Stun}stunned{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:ImmobilisedEffect}immobilised{/g}, or {g|Encyclopedia:ProneEffect}prone{/g} effects inflicted by the psyker suffer +10% more {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}.

52a40f39-db85-462d-837f-4da25f8e0916.Text: The target must pass a Willpower {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} or suffer {g|Encyclopedia:MentalDamage}mental damage{/g} equal to {uip|Damage1|5a328c19cc214780b878be2183550910} + 30% of its current {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}. The latter part of the damage cannot exceed 300. If passed, that target instead suffers {uip|Damage2|5a328c19cc214780b878be2183550910} mental damage.

b7702670-9cba-496c-9668-378ec4ff452e.Text:
The target must pass a Willpower {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} or suffer {g|Encyclopedia:MentalDamage}mental damage{/g} equal to {uip|Damage1|5a328c19cc214780b878be2183550910} + 30% of its current {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}. The latter part of the damage cannot exceed 300. If passed, the psyker also suffers the same damage.
This psychic power always triggers {g|Encyclopedia:PerilsOfWarp}perils of the warp{/g}.

d5589c7e-5838-4215-abed-1c2d4d1cbcfd.Text: The target suffers {g|Encyclopedia:MentalDamage}mental damage{/g} equal to {uip|Damage1|5b19d80b3d694f77b84c2b38a04efe8f} + 30% of its current {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}. The latter part of the damage cannot exceed 300.

75ebfca1-a123-4fde-9089-788d6e604486.Text: The target suffers <u>(psyker's staff power level + psyker's {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}psy rating{/g} + 30% of the target's current {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g})</u> {g|Encyclopedia:MentalDamage}mental damage{/g}.

9a9e6cbc-dc0c-4357-8f40-a41cb9ed1e01.Text: "Would you like to take a bath, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}?"

6901a2e1-add4-46e4-8a47-1b6fcfded6af.Text: "The xenos who speaks in riddles sent me here. He assured me that it would lead to our reunion, Domin'{name}."

99ca0a84-80f9-415e-9098-23a71f53d769.Text: This artefact from the collection of Bartholomeus Ort resembles a gemstone covered in a delicate web of fine cracks. The words, "Make another's pain your weapon," are scratched along the edge.

ad7eb9a8-efe7-40d7-82df-eb5324b3f8d6.Text: A mysterious piece of archeotech found among the treasures of Captain Bartholomeus Ort. It is engraved with the words "Even a raging wave can lift you higher."

9d2beb28-e658-4135-b5fa-2423784a8b98.Text: An archeotech device distorted by the reckless hand of a Tech-Priest overly devoted to his lay allies. Wishing to grant them extra protection in skirmishes, he conducted an experiment utterly condemned by the Adeptus Mechanicus, shortly after which he was betrayed and his creation sold to pirates.

98945757-4598-4664-ae25-1738682ba4e9.Text: Armour that previously belonged to the commander of a boarding party, who discovered that his employers were tech-heretics and so gave them up to the Cognisance Fleet. In a coordinated attack with the Adeptus Mechanicus, he drenched the decks of the enemy ship in blood but met his death in the process. As a mark of respect, the servants of the Omnissiah preserved and modified his armour, honouring the officer's heroism with new functions.

24a70432-254b-40b5-bbea-c541803ebd6c.Text: A tech-litany from the far reaches of the Calixis Sector bestowing a blessing of the Omnissiah upon the warp engine. The prayer was discovered to have a beneficial effect on the psykers who heard it: the words about the mighty, Empyrean-conquering mechanism filled those cursed souls with faith that their own heinous abilities could be turned to the benefit of the Imperium.

7bf147b6-c713-447a-bc8e-316baa7a91d3.Text: The reverse of this reinforced uniform is covered in unholy symbols, inscribed by a sorcerer of the Fellowship of the Void to slow the mind-withering corruption that afflicted him while transporting heretical artefacts.

59b883c3-ca47-4e38-8d61-415a0404f898.Text: It is unclear what so enraged your cyber-mastiff, but there is no way to find out what the stranger was doing here — {petname} has mauled them to a bloody pulp.

b254a571-cd0a-46b3-9bb2-ce2e26e5623e.Text: {petname} tore the victim to shreds. The victim's mutilated insides glisten with ichor and are interspersed with vestigial scaly growths. A genetic abomination — there can be no doubt.

d3f44471-3b91-4713-92a2-87c1a18416c3.Text: Whenever the wearer kills an enemy, the {g|Encyclopedia:Cooldown}cooldown{/g} of {g|f:9395d6c10694470f8c8ea3c74c7e09c7}Go For the Throat{/g} is reset. Base armour property: +25 {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerStrength}Strength{/g}.

6337f3e5-7416-49af-8bc9-9d85328e4b65.Text: Armour covered in magical runes and sanctified by an Iron Priest. It belongs to brother Ulfar, an honourable warrior of the Wolf Guard.

108ecd99-f3de-4f57-b31a-ce395da0a4ee.Text: When making an attack, the wearer gains +3 {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} for each {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} they have right before that attack (up to a maximum of +30 Agility). This {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} stacks and lasts until the end of the wearer's {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}. Base armour property: +10% {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g}.

912da3e5-85d5-4517-bdd1-a94805fced7d.Text: Whenever the wearer {g|Encyclopedia:BlockChance}blocks{/g} an attack, all adjacent creatures must pass a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} or suffer +1 stack of {g|Encyclopedia:PerplexedEffect}perplexed{/g}. Base armour property: +10% {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} against ranged attacks.

d3387fb4-964a-4ec0-8265-ad8773047b7b.Text: While the wearer has 75% or more {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}, their {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g} is increased by +3 and their {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g} is increased by +{uip|Coercion|55627a193f5d4c3dbc05ab165c470b6c}%. Base armour property: +1 deflection against {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee attacks{/g}.

7d062289-0f12-48f5-ba25-4b73a90e1f70.Text: Whenever the wearer starts their {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} with no enemies in a 3-cell radius, they gain +4 {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} and do not provoke {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g} this turn. Base armour property: +10% {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} if the wearer starts their turn with at least 1 enemy within a 3-cell radius.

7dc46dd4-4e20-4178-a536-f9b5119ba81b.Text: Once the wearer's {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} are reduced to 0 for the first time in combat, they immediately regain +{uip|Wounds|2314620f28d146a0ad4b8f9e69df6731} wounds, remaining in combat, and gain +100 {g|Encyclopedia:MomentumWithDetailsGlossary}momentum{/g}. Base armour property: +15% {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} against ranged attacks.

15de77cf-3464-41e5-a76b-7b987d2265ad.Text: The targets {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} by the wearer's {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g} become {g|Encyclopedia:ImmobilisedEffect}immobilised{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}. Base armour property: +3 {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g} if the wearer's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerStrength}Strength{/g} is more than 70.

c6a94cb1-8f82-46b0-91ba-77b93b1b8be5.Text: Marshal's Armour of the Koronus Expanse

d1c90203-41a1-4ee7-914e-d2ef5e494345.Text: The wearer does not provoke {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g} and can move through enemies. The wearer's first attack each {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} does not spend {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} and does not count toward the {g|Encyclopedia:AttacksPerTurn}attack limit per turn{/g} but deals −50% less damage. Base armour property: +10% {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g}.

e81a82ce-c045-4315-9025-63ca2e233f71.Text: The wearer's {g|f:374265cc61d5475898f17ac969795f7c}Reactivate{/g} range is increased by +2. When using {g|f:374265cc61d5475898f17ac969795f7c}Reactivate{/g}, the wearer gains {uip|Temp Wounds|ba7be88fef58472a98adb0d094c1e06b} {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g}. Base armour property: +{uip|Armour|ba7be88fef58472a98adb0d094c1e06b}% {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g}.

b61e9347-bb3d-4bf7-895c-6a921e071eda.Text: While the wearer has less than 50% {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}, their {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit chance{/g} are increased by +{uip|Dodge|b3efe0523fb34b6fbf6ab9fdd4b03cb3}%. Base armour property: +10% dodge if the wearer's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} is more than 50.

6e1546fe-5593-4adf-8030-a003069fd04b.Text: While the wearer has less than 100% {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}, their {g|Encyclopedia:SkillCoercion}Coercion{/g} is increased by +25, and {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical damage{/g} by +25%. Base armour property: +{uip|Armour|a68758571233479bb5685943e58a5c2c}% {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g}.

306d4817-fbc4-49a7-b97c-6587da12e76d.Text: If the wearer has a shield equipped, whenever they make a {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee attack{/g}, their shield gains +2% {g|Encyclopedia:BlockChance}block{/g}. Lasts until the start of the wearer's next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}. Stacks.

7d7237a0-d9d4-49a2-8c05-644cc4de8b4b.Text: At the start of the wearer's {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, if there are more enemies than allies in combat, the wearer deals +20% more {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} with {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee{/g} weapons.

8522eb86-b486-4384-94f6-3966e0a72325.Text: {g|f:374265cc61d5475898f17ac969795f7c}Reactivate{/g} costs 0 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}. cfbca179-f050-4896-9443-9201dd9e1692.Text: Whenever the wearer uses {g|f:4955b43454f6488f82892e166c76c995}Charge{/g}, {g|f:7daf9f9d4c3d44ccaeebb0b9a7725b54}Danse Macabre{/g}, {g|f:9b09708aa0c244a6bc4a8e46d69c5884}Dash{/g}, or {g|f:c3d6e29e74e440a79cb243e4e93e0501}Death From Above{/g}, they gain +{uip|Penetration|c2d196acb09341a8a9796e59781823ed}% {g|Encyclopedia:ArmourPenetration}armour penetration{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeReduction}dodge reduction{/g} until the end of their {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}. Stacks up to 3 times.

a2ef6048-0023-4143-a50e-b9398ec5b73c.Text: The wearer's incoming {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} is reduced by −{uip|Veil Tear|3cbe5a2c28b049a9bc8e8e8ef4e447a6}%.

82493909-3295-4081-9c3b-f6abbcfff32a.Text: If the wearer ends their {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} with any adjacent familiar, that familiar regains +{uip|Wounds|6f5225ff33c34371b2b38f352e46fcbd} {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}.

498a242e-1443-4e0a-a910-5c2d8a852318.Text: Whenever the wearer successfully {g|Encyclopedia:BlockChance}blocks{/g} an attack with a shield for the first time in a {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}, they gain +2 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} on their next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}.

435be482-5782-4a79-ac37-ac030014f4d6.Text: Whenever the wearer makes a {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:AreaOfEffect}area attack{/g}, they regain +2 {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} and gain +{uip|Crit Hit Chance|f08a8a9e6e6142b7b839d5c1d8fda4db}% {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit chance{/g}. Lasts until the end of the {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}. Stacks.

5d57d86c-7cdf-4a2f-8417-c8596068594a.Text: If the wearer's {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee attack{/g} (except the {g|f:6f1b7cfb48a0450cb85ce8a8879502de}Death From Above{/g} and {g|f:e955823f54d24088ae1fdefe88d3684d}Blade Dance{/g} abilities) is {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodged{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parried{/g}, or scores a {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit{/g}, the wearer gains +{unit_stat|WarhammerAgility|bonus} {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} and does not provoke {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g} until the end of their {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}.

98cec7de-3a9c-4987-847c-0d57d06ef2f3.Text: While under the effect of {g|f:613246cc28464ade9845da9b30dc65c3}ruthless suppression{/g}, the wearer is immune to {g|Encyclopedia:ImmobilisedEffect}immobilised{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:ProneEffect}prone{/g}, and {g|Encyclopedia:SlowedEffect}slowed{/g}.

57067fa6-0ae4-4f84-ad61-393bc51b0463.Text: The wearer can use their {g|f:8c7d2be4225745e4911eb3c53c603b76}Assault Onslaught{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} twice per {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}.

b783428f-be81-407a-9eed-ae500924cf29.Text: Whenever the wearer uses {g|f:4955b43454f6488f82892e166c76c995}Charge{/g}, {g|f:7daf9f9d4c3d44ccaeebb0b9a7725b54}Danse Macabre{/g}, {g|f:9b09708aa0c244a6bc4a8e46d69c5884}Dash{/g}, or {g|f:c3d6e29e74e440a79cb243e4e93e0501}Death From Above{/g}, the wearer's {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} is increased by +{uip|Damage|ddc5a202a550411d9a23e1d13f1d8ddb}% until the end of their {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}. Stacks up to 3 times.

06d8769a-5358-437e-b6fa-89c7267052b1.Text: The wearer suffers −<u>({g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}TGH{/g} / 3)</u>% less {g|Encyclopedia:FireDamage}fire damage{/g}. If they are suffering from {g|Encyclopedia:BurningEffect}burning{/g} at the start of their {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, the level of burning is reduced by −{unit_stat|WarhammerToughness|bonus}.

8d3c09c4-d213-4354-b9de-1053f0fdc056.Text: If the wearer has a shield equipped, whenever the wearer is {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} (multiple hits in a {g|Encyclopedia:BurstAttacksGlossary}burst{/g} are considered a single hit), the shield gains +5% {g|Encyclopedia:BlockChance}block{/g}. Lasts until the end of {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}. Stacks up to 3 times.

42a0b9fd-9997-4f24-a392-4235a3cd3f96.Text: For the first time in a {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}, if the wearer kills 3 or more targets using a weapon {g|Encyclopedia:AreaOfEffect}area attack{/g}, that area attack does not spend {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} and does not count toward the {g|Encyclopedia:AttacksPerTurn}attack limit per turn{/g}.

6d19b123-c488-4e00-b5d5-a6679cee91e3.Text: While the wearer's familiar is adjacent to them, it successfully passes any {g|Encyclopedia:Test}tests{/g} in combat.

3718ee3c-9d27-4447-aced-63bba3db52bc.Text:
{g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}Dodge{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} of the wearer's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} is reduced by −10%.
If the wearer's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} is 60 or more, that penalty is reduced by −15% instead.

6ecb4c09-3ce6-4e07-bde3-d11a543d2e97.Text:
The wearer's {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee attacks{/g} gain +15% {g|Encyclopedia:ArmourPenetration}armour penetration{/g}.
If the target's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} is less than or equal to the wearer's armour penetration, the target must pass a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a +20 bonus or suffer {g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}bleeding{/g} (4).

aa173fe0-fed4-492b-9941-31548e6bbd37.Text: The wearer gains +15 {g|Encyclopedia:SkillCoercion}Coercion{/g}. If the wearer is the Arbitrator, they gain +20 Coercion instead.

b6a143e9-4a4d-4cdd-940e-bd3d989225a7.Text: When the wearer {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hits{/g} an enemy with a shield, all allies in a 3-cell radius gain +5 {g|Encyclopedia:Resolve}resolve{/g} until the end of combat. Does not stack.

f44ee9b1-d6a5-473e-8e8f-55ac10219d5c.Text: Marshal's Helmet of the Koronus Expanse

05991f54-643e-401d-9706-ba7509a5ca4c.Text: The target of the wearer's {g|Encyclopedia:SingleRangedAttacksGlossary}single-shot{/g} attack gains +50% {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} against that attack. But if this attack {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hits{/g} and scores a {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit{/g}, it deals +30% more critical damage and gains +100% {g|Encyclopedia:OverpenetrationFullGlossary}overpenetration{/g}.

43c700ba-b3b5-4a89-9e24-d0e1b16ea26f.Text: If the wearer is the Arbitrator with the Castigator specialisation, their Castigator {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}abilities{/g} cost 0 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}.

0e92bd0b-d0a5-42dc-b212-64f52f083f83.Text: Whenever the wearer {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hits{/g} a target with a shield, that target must pass a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} or be knocked {g|Encyclopedia:ProneEffect}prone{/g}.

7042b89f-0b6d-4246-8228-e05f054a6753.Text: If the wearer is the Arbitrator with the Castigator specialisation, their Castigator {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} range is increased by +1 cell.

4f442095-3b21-47bb-aef1-8cd76936a560.Text:
The wearer gains +1 {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}psy rating{/g} and +15 {g|Encyclopedia:SkillPersuasion}Persuasion{/g}.
If {g|Encyclopedia:PerilsOfWarp}perils of the warp{/g} is triggered and a daemon is summoned, that daemon attacks the closest to it non-daemon target.

b3d7f0ef-3dd5-4360-b9b2-a1d238d722e7.Text:
The wearer gains +10 {g|Encyclopedia:SkillCoercion}Coercion{/g}.
The wearer's incoming {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} is reduced by −{uip|Coercion|5a3e97bd4fc7462699fa4d79f7080879}% if the attacker does not have {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeSuperiority}melee superiority{/g}.

4ccc20f5-a869-40ba-ad43-575a2504ebfb.Text: Once the wearer's {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} drop below 50% for the first time in combat, they immediately gain {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g} equal to their missing wounds.

e3ffe696-62c5-41b1-87ac-20246833dc5a.Text: When the wearer kills a target the first time in a {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}, they gain +10 to all {g|Encyclopedia:Characteristic}characteristics{/g} until the end of the round.

cc74da3c-9dc2-4f98-bb3d-c470de5e78fc.Text:
The wearer can use ranged weapons in {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee range{/g}.
The wearer's ranged attacks against adjacent targets gain +{uip|Critical Hit Chance|e9aec82234b847ef8532feed4f674f31}% {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit chance{/g}.

ea9cd4f3-91f3-4c13-8d8e-d4b776e990d9.Text: Whenever the wearer triggers {g|Encyclopedia:PerilsOfWarp}perils of the warp{/g}, they gain +{uip|Temp Wounds|d30eeebc490b4fdc8c26be44ffa1bf6a} {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g} and do not provoke {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g} until the end of their {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}. Whenever perils of the warp is triggered, a daemon is summoned.

2e33a940-7de1-4864-93e3-e92e63a3d594.Text: If the wearer is the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g}, their first Overseer {g|Encyclopedia:Career}archetype{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} in a {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g} costs 0 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}.

Requires {g|Encyclopedia:SoulmarkTypesGlossary}Conviction{/g} — {g|Encyclopedia:SoulMarkCorruption}Heretical{/g}
The wearer gains +{uip|Veil Tear|4872ff5c18b14a579b66ddea5abfba84}% {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit chance{/g} and deals +{uip|Veil Tear|4872ff5c18b14a579b66ddea5abfba84}% more {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical damage{/g}.

c0105a83-f5f1-4d47-9a82-7cd382022bb0.Text: If the wearer is not the Rogue Trader, they gain +{uip|Bonus|d15873b887d74b36965930c7af9b1081} to {g|Encyclopedia:SkillCoercion}Coercion{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:SkillCommerce}Commerce{/g}, and {g|Encyclopedia:SkillPersuasion}Persuasion{/g}.

fe174d6e-18e4-48e3-be7f-cc8de35e5538.Text: The wearer's first {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} used in a {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g} is calculated as if {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}psy rating{/g} were increased by +3 and always triggers {g|Encyclopedia:PsychicPhenomena}psychic phenomena{/g}.

7b3abfba-a87f-4b72-a8d0-e00c5e96cd01.Text: The wearer's {g|Encyclopedia:DeadeyeShot}deadeye shots{/g} ignore {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}cover{/g} and have +30% {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeReduction}dodge reduction{/g}.

b16cd2f9-c789-43e9-a388-a4bcfb06f1ae.Text: When the wearer kills a target for the first time in a {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}, their next attack automatically {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hits{/g}. The wearer's Arbitrator {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}abilities{/g} used this round can be used again.

69da7e9c-918f-4984-949e-5236e3e7d40a.Text: If the wearer uses {g|f:f6a60b4556214528b0ce295c4f69306e}Stalwart Defence{/g}, but its effect is not triggered by the start of their next {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, they gain +{unit_stat|WarhammerToughness|bonus} {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} during their next turn.

b5d13573-7f93-4fad-b35c-a60d9da7fe76.Text: If the wearer is an {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g}, using their {g|Encyclopedia:Career}archetype{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}abilities{/g} grants them {unit_stat|WarhammerFellowship|bonus} {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g}.

a3d664db-a835-4987-bedf-68ac6bc2f467.Text: If worn by an {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g}, the wearer can use {g|f:eab4d0bba84f4d1294f5cd64a1b33084}Overcharge{/g} multiple times per combat, but only once per {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}. The bonuses do not stack.

381ae3f3-7b3f-431c-a63d-f3c314600c7e.Text: Whenever the wearer {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hits{/g} a target with {g|f:1c5f4edca9f64fe0911bc946e0b4ea4a}Shield Bash{/g}, {g|f:def7164545244af28d52cd38d0502525}Double Slug{/g}, {g|f:2162ce26f6db4cd1b748a4105c364ddb}Fulminating Shot{/g}, or {g|f:027e75ab89364049b844a720feca85ec}Grisly Adjudication{/g}, they make a {g|Encyclopedia:SkillCoercion}Coercion{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Test}test{/g} with a −40 penalty. If the wearer succeeds, the target is {g|Encyclopedia:ImmobilisedEffect}immobilised{/g}.

9751d798-12c4-4cca-abe9-a4a2a9388be7.Text: The wearer's successful counterattacks triggered by {g|f:f6a60b4556214528b0ce295c4f69306e}Stalwart Defence{/g} always score a {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit{/g} and deal +25% more critical damage.

1d50bf80-ce26-4824-8496-f801ab0df3d4.Text: {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}Critical damage{/g} dealt by the wearer with pistols is increased by +{uip|Crit Damage|a631996f6cf54d109fb694e8785cf2f0}% if their {g|Encyclopedia:SkillLoreImperium}Lore (Imperium){/g} is 150 or greater.

0d18059b-fd02-4f97-b695-e4bf822d9178.Text: If the wearer's name is {name} von Valancius, the wearer gains +{uip|Skills|521a28cd898f4d04bfcaf502c3a0fab3} to all {g|Encyclopedia:Skills}skills{/g}.

7ccd7f3b-527d-4312-bee1-534ef8ce03d9.Text: Whenever {g|f:78e7771b7c974111887e762d5e999a11}Protect!{/g} is used on the Rogue Trader, the Overseer regains +1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}. The {g|f:e16934c3dbf44cb997c684a6ddce7575}apprehending{/g} cyber-mastiff's attacks against the {g|f:f39e0e323f314259b3e7510b110d3a4b}apprehended{/g} target are triggered by the Rogue Trader's attacks too.

2d1a89cc-d31b-4c0f-8209-438166205c85.Text: A captain who calls himself the Master Inspector is in the market for human merchandise. This peculiar character has repeatedly shown up on Footfall to buy serfs, criminals, and unfortunates detained for vagrancy. Where he takes them is unknown, but his coffers seem bottomless.

afbca747-8183-4175-b71a-de1f027fb2c5.Text: The Rogue Trader has been contacted by a high-ranking Administratum official who previously helped with reclaiming a relic of Saint Cognatius from House Chorda. He enjoyed the generous bribes and would like some more. In exchange for the riches requested, he promises that an error will creep into the Administratum's calculations so that all provisions from the agri-world of Mircus Alpha will be shipped to Dargonus instead of the Navy's orbital fortress of Dragonis II.

bd762c2d-8eea-46b6-a0da-be33cb3ef1e5.Text: Calligos Winterscale has found out that the secret of gas factoriums had been stolen from him. However, he is willing to leave that "unfortunate incident" in the past, offering the prospect of much greater gains. He is now captivated by the idea of seizing House Chorda's nephium rigs on the frozen world of Lucin's Breath. For Calligos himself, it would appear, the profit is a mere side-benefit of the opportunity to massacre large numbers of House Chorda's servants in planetary battles. He is offering to pay with the aforementioned priceless flammable liquid in exchange for the fighting force he is desperately lacking.

71861dea-9fde-475b-bce2-5c720a66d4c1.Text: Intent on bringing the world of Iniquity to Imperial Compliance, Incendia Chorda is facing a prolonged campaign to weed out the planet's blasphemous element. She will pay a generous price for the formidable steel giants of Kiava Gamma, vested in holy armour and armed with the Emperor's righteous fury.

7df7e639-2ad1-4497-8a9e-71838a0205ff.Text: A gargantuan Explorator mass-transport is returning from a long expedition. Its star hunting is taking longer than expected, and it is in desperate need of provisions, water, and air. The captain is willing to show generosity — the ship's holds are brimming with plasma batteries.

28084714-e08e-44fd-8b03-d834f34cff41.Text: An influential alchemtek guild from the world of Varsius has enjoyed the patronage of the Fellowship of the Void for many years. Substantial bribes offered to these masters of substance transformation would help them find the courage to seek refuge under House von Valancius's wing.

6ca23aa8-c549-49c7-9786-98d95a400d64.Text: The Lemesta I trading outpost has been causing problems for Dargonus's trade for years by attracting merchants arriving from a number of systems, including those from the mining world of Flactica. If only some pirate were motivated enough to blast this station with torpedoes...

0876bde1-2e6b-4c12-b078-00bf779c10e5.Text: Even a creation as monumental as the God-Emperor's statue on Footfall requires regular maintenance. The station is willing to pay with thousands of mercenaries in exchange for a new set of chains to bind the asteroids to the statue.

34e3caa2-f8c5-45fc-9462-a3ff9c2a7d18.Text: The powerful governor of the orbital palace station of Weddawedda has been sentenced to death by Lord Inquisitor Calcazar. Now is a good time to send agents to his domain to partake in dividing the late governor's fortunes, such as his flogiston mines on the planet Kyrn.

7a1c4090-d0a7-48ac-b135-0d2912340ded.Text: A gang of daredevils is looking for a sponsor for their suicidal foray into the jungles of the world Paranthos and the ancient xenos pyramid located there. Should any of them survive and return with spoils, it will be well worth the investment.

a74fff4c-2153-4063-97ed-a17cb20b1634.Text: An army of Drusian pilgrims is planning to travel to an unexplored sector and set up a colony in the name of the Emperor. To ensure that these fervent believers don't die on their journey, the Cult of Saint Drusus requires a huge amount of food.

1bf35170-74c4-4102-b2b3-5fd078fcd04e.Text: The Imperial Navy has tried to conscript the fellowship of Mech-Sages on Larcheen, renowned creators of airborne machines, by force. The brave technomats have decided to fight back, and now they require armour for their flying constructs.

91e259cd-bf33-4287-a196-68b113e7cc01.Text: A once-fearsome pirate captain known as Voidshark Iophem has decided to leave his old craft behind and try his hand at the calmer and more refined Cold Trade. He is willing to purchase his first shipment of forbidden goods by trading in the weapons from his infamous raider.

cebf53b8-2bde-4a21-88b4-83301fde003a.Text: A group of rebels from the void city Kephaestus IX is looking for someone who could supply them with deadly chemicals to perpetrate an attack against the station's satrap. Should their request be satisfied, it will soon be time to send crews of void cutters to the station to salvage what remains of the metal husk.

127055bf-2aae-407f-bd88-897980fc792f.Text: A brave merchant, ruined by his competitors, intends to attack Kerlae, a flourishing world rich with fish and inhabited by a primitive people. The merchant intends to reward whoever provides assistance with this expedition with a share of the spoils.

941bc25e-9a07-4e64-a1a1-ca65904384bd.Text: The factory-world of Gensark incurred the wrath of the Omnissiah and has been struck by a major technological disaster. The machine spirits have gone to sleep inside the twisted industrial metalwork and damaged cogitators. The Forge Master needs supplies of materials and is offering skilful technomats in exchange.

cf561041-f6c0-4606-a123-a921992dabe6.Text: At the Departmento Munitorum, Officio Tactica analysts have noted an increase in pirate attacks. The Imperial Navy is planning on conducting a large-scale operation to eradicate the outlaws, but stocking up a sufficient amount of fuel has proven difficult.

2cac759e-1a21-4086-b10a-c5a830011440.Text: A ship has returned from an expedition to the Godless Stars with no xenos treasure, no coordinates of promising worlds, nor anything else of great value. All they have brought back is a mysterious protein-based slime that is edible and replicates itself at a phenomenal rate. Whoever purchases this amazing substance will be able to grow it in cultivation vats to feed entire hives.

087f9659-d280-45d8-92c1-522cfb47b922.Text: A Secret from the Godless Stars

87cf6723-5d3f-401f-a1b6-efe1f2d603e6.Text: A band of bold treasure hunters has raided a legendary ship cemetery, the Procession of the Damned. They were able to snatch the ruins of an ancient cruiser from the convoy of shipwrecks, and now the remains of the glorious ship have been put up for auction. Beyond repair though it may be, it is still a giant mountain of plasteel and adamantine.

b0b79aeb-2409-458e-b488-f7569f959f04.Text: Vladaym Tocara has entered into a trade war with a competitor in the Cold Trade. Having lost several of his xenotech procurers, he is in need of a powerful and influential supplier of the forbidden merchandise.

9881896f-5d9c-4d92-ac55-07fb07aa810c.Text: The hive world of Forlynx seeks to undermine the influence of the subsector's capital planet. The governor's agents seek rare and valuable minerals that will help Forlynx's industry to grow and prosper.

88385c6d-d717-43e0-bda6-9c5441518722.Text: Lord Inquisitor Calcazar's servants have been buying up top-quality plasteel and transporting it to an unknown location. While the nature of the Lord Inquisitor's secretive grand-scale manufacturing operation remains unknown, the names of those who are assisting him are uttered with great respect.

68f4e30b-8cb3-4099-a162-d29210b40d7b.Text: The Explorator Cognisance Fleet is planning a holy expedition to an unexplored sub-sector. Their Emissary, Opticon-22, is prepared to buy a massive amount of fuel for their voidships.

1a77e402-994c-4e0a-96fb-10c7a684d5d1.Text: As punishment for House Gaprak's negligence that led to the corruption of Kiava Gamma, the house's considerable wealth will be requisitioned by the Rogue Trader's treasury.

9189be63-8155-4ac2-973b-7e921e24a938.Text: The Rogue Trader commands that Kiava Gamma be cleansed of every trace of heresy. Missionaries and technomats, Techsorcists and corruption hunters will make their way to the planet. Their gruelling task will entail a pressing urgency for good weapons, spare parts, and blessed, brightly burning promethium.

fa4d3e72-4881-4f3f-af64-94afcf6e8269.Text: Prelate Lugnalia of the Order of the Hammer intends to bring throngs of armed pilgrims to worlds that currently serve as the resting places of Saint Cognatius's relics and reclaim these objects in the name of faith. By force, if necessary.

319486d7-d073-401b-86a3-8fbeb1581fff.Text: Prelate Tychon of the Order of the Hammer wishes to send messengers to worlds that serve as the resting places of Saint Cognatius's relics to form spiritual bonds with their current keepers.

e4cd5d5c-add5-4897-a7f9-0410236394f7.Text: A death cult has flourished in the colony, driving its members and others to the brink of religious frenzy through bloody sacrifices and self-flagellation. News of their bloody deeds brings uncertainty and fear.

9eb39d7e-4c1f-4a9d-b0de-82ee829dd2f0.Text: Many of the colony's nobles are losing their firmness of belief in the Creed and joining suspicious retrogressive societies indulging in sybaritism and excessive intellectualising.

e1016f4d-d6bb-43c7-b541-b0c293a03f7f.Text: Blasphemous Drukhari xenos have assaulted the colony and are now rampaging through it, driven by their desire to eviscerate the entire world.

e5e40eda-bbd2-476d-9a07-fcc3f115a6bb.Text: A deadly pathogen has paralysed the colony. The rabble is terrified, the planetary authorities are flummoxed.

d1beb487-e9a1-4388-85db-61389d99687a.Text: Pirates have devastated the colony, killing or capturing most able-bodied colonists. Restoring the colony will take time.

ff4063ab-a00f-47b9-83d5-05f8ae6a2724.Text: Few substances can rival adamantine when it comes to toughness. It is used in creating armour for the divine Titans, hull plating for voidships, and really for everything that needs to be extremely durable and strong.

cc3009f2-fac5-4ec8-aac1-5273332a1465.Text: Numerous substances contain remarkable powers. Magi Alchemys know how to awaken such powers, and the fruits of this labour are highly sought after by skilled artisans, wise healers, and harsh purgers of corruption.

74c25cdb-a1ae-4568-bd1e-290f384a9518.Text: Whether made from corpse starch, plant matter, or fermented fungal mould, these rations provide colonists with sustenance needed to work for the good of the Imperium.

8460cce2-5af8-4a73-9706-37e7bc1c4d25.Text: For every problem Humankind faces, it has a tool granted it by the Omnissiah. His sacred gifts are vested in the flesh of lathes and mechanisms, spare parts and augmetics, devices and modes of transport — the forms that Knowledge can take are innumerable.

f1c5bb92-e6ad-40f8-82cf-4f9da3cde7ab.Text: The foundation of any rule are workers and soldiers, a faceless and nameless mass of the rank and file. In the eyes of the Imperium, they are merely a resource, easily procurable and renewable.

d8469a90-1afc-4d32-bdf2-962828cb4a1f.Text: The framework of the Imperium was forged in plasteel. Buildings, machines, armour, and weapons — they all require plasteel.

2db88b58-9cc5-4936-b431-3c211ab46053.Text: Rare and priceless crystals born within flaming magma under immense pressure. Their energy potential is tremendous and fully justifies the cost of harvesting them, measured in the lives of miners killed by irradiation.

ee4e2c8d-3b7b-4bfe-bfc1-33df5b436745.Text: Highly flammable promethium can be used not only as a fuel, but is also the main ingredient in the Inquisition's purifying fire.

b8d56e0f-a90b-4635-aeaf-9827479c995b.Text: Autopistols, lasguns, chainswords, and stubbers are all instruments of the Emperor's fury. Blessed are the weaponsmiths, for without them there is no Imperium.

83b0a0f8-355f-4842-bf85-7f8a076f2673.Text: Creations of the ungodly xenos — forbidden, yet tempting treasures. The twisted minds of non-humans can create wonders that are fascinating in their mysteriousness and effectiveness.

887594ee-15a3-483d-a0a1-01893fb504ce.Text: Affects the amount of Profit Factor produced by the colony and the speed of projects in the colony, increasing and decreasing them by 10% for each point of Complacency, respectively.

45cd8213-9762-4238-8ec4-4eeff34c4db3.Text: Affects the amount of resources produced by the colony, increasing it by 10% for each point of Efficiency.

79f76208-656a-4c5a-a032-d9ffd1ebdaa8.Text: Affects the ability of the colony to cope with negative events on its own.

7d30aa3b-4fa9-4283-8c15-bbfedcc9905f.Text: If there are not enough resources, PF is decreased by the missing amount.

4e854b39-ac67-462f-b592-36596c4e7f5e.Text: Periodically, can be replenished in batches of 5. Do not forget to collect them!

edcdfe39-bd0d-47cc-a158-b5ebe3c0a329.Text: The holy shepherds of the faith have noted the growing influence of the von Valancius protectorate and are asking for a donation to fund a new pilgrimage route. Thousands of believers will pay for passage on ships and sing glories to the dynasty's piety.

f409212a-debb-400e-a639-f1ef5042c9da.Text: Having heard many tales of the Rogue Trader's wealth, the Tech-Priests are requesting financing for their research. The Adeptus Mechanicus are promising to share their profits — the by-product of gaining knowledge — and enter their benefactor's name in the blessed data array of valuable allies.

1589ddd3-33ba-487b-b6bf-0e417378c4b7.Text: Sensing a shift in the balance of power in the Expanse, the Cold Traders are wasting no time in seeking to strike an exclusive trade agreement with the dynasty. The first major deal will pave the way for mutually profitable cooperation.

ef7015dd-6787-4bc6-a4a6-b5d4d0cb8bd7.Text: Keenly aware which way the void winds are blowing, the pirates are seeking the patronage of the swiftly ascending House von Valancius. In exchange for material support of their fleet, they are offering a percentage of their loot, as well as the fullness of their friendship, as dubious as that notion is.

dcc4ac01-0f03-4cad-859e-60b9efc25770.Text: Strengthening Ties: The Fellowship of the Void

4c065e1d-2c8a-4d2b-b61c-5e3af19f4a16.Text: The Navy officers are counting on the Rogue Trader to direct {mf|his|her} growing power toward maintaining order in the Expanse. They are requesting resources for building void outposts, promising new and lucrative terms of trade in return.

bc348eee-b317-4c91-96d5-96dbdd8cf802.Text: The incredible wealth now possessed by House von Valancius is to lay the foundations of the Rogue Trader's grand designs. Dargonus will be refashioned into the commercial and political heart of the sector, from whence its eminent ruler will project {mf|his|her} power all across the Expanse.
