6215e26a-fdcb-4325-8e28-b2f2c0bf3ff4.Text: The Rogue Trader used the tithe {mf|he|she} took from Leethus to transform Dargonus into the most influential world in the Expanse.

152b5ef9-3dce-48bd-adda-0d1357e1efc1.Text: Built hallucinatory chem-thermae for the Dargonus nobility.

481f27dd-01d4-4bd4-bc8a-d90e24866678.Text: Allowed the commoners to manage the affairs of Dargonus alongside the aristocrats.

2a817c66-b920-4ad2-8301-59d6012db15e.Text: Scarred thousands of faithful with lines from scripture about Saint Cognatius.

45f675f4-546c-4870-a756-ef55516b4d57.Text: Killed the saint to turn his remains into a relic.

b6ada9bd-0162-40ad-b9bd-e1be2f7ce520.Text: Permitted the Sanguinalian Hospitallers to found a sanatorium sanctum on Foulstone.

caaf9aac-6d40-4909-9c7a-9e5b7af73338.Text: Founded the Death Cult of the Reaper Emperor on Janus.

18d27ee6-a379-45de-8777-9696ef9aff60.Text: Allowed the heresy of creativity to reign on Kiava Gamma.

357524e8-921c-4c91-b50d-2d987441d69f.Text: Introduced the martyr's shift for the convicts of Vheabos VI.

2e8f082a-0807-4856-9b8f-1cee63d2dd86.Text: All allies deal +5% more damage to xenos.

071996fb-f195-4dc9-8a9a-ec48a16250bd.Text: Allies' attacks ignore 10% armour and 4 deflection of machine creatures, Necrons, and targets with the {g|f:ed0acc1731834a89bda8cc52ec769e3d}Reject the Flesh{/g} feature.

25b42ee8-3033-4a2b-88a6-9535584f999f.Text: All allies gain +5 Carouse and suffer −10% toxic damage.

2629f01f-afd3-491c-b99d-71dabcf8f49d.Text: The Rogue Trader gains +1 deflection and +3% hit chance.

ef0f56bc-c037-4527-8308-aafc134f1e54.Text: All allies gain +<u>(Awareness / 10)</u>% critical hit chance.

47d56e2f-5699-41b6-a1bd-1fa19e9bc041.Text: Medikits always heal +<u>(3 × Rogue Trader's Iconoclast rank)</u> more wounds.

76acb959-4a24-44cd-8508-da90c2fb542c.Text: All allies gain +5% melee damage and +20% damage to their attacks of opportunity.

6de65071-cb85-405b-a25b-148e54c59916.Text: All allies deal +10% more damage to machines and targets with the {g|f:ed0acc1731834a89bda8cc52ec769e3d}Reject the Flesh{/g} feature.

b86265e6-4912-4da5-ad56-5bad3e2a9f48.Text: All allies gain +5 Willpower and +1 resolve.

d23f2426-5ff4-4cb7-9267-fad75f6b7126.Text: All allies gain +3% dodge reduction against enemies.

c010f435-0a4f-4c56-a9fd-85d701c8939d.Text: All allies gain +5 Commerce and +4% hit chance.

d9040f1f-d7d8-4cd7-b587-8c363eef30d8.Text: All allies gain +10 Lore (Xenos) and +<u>(Lore (Xenos) / 5)</u>% dodge reduction against xenos.

d9a9dbd0-4441-4d40-a758-4edbad30a272.Text: The Rogue Trader gains +10% dodge against human enemies.

f3ca6e91-2809-44fb-b708-16a0a513a43c.Text: Grants +5% damage against psykers and Navigators.

f36d645b-7dde-4517-b309-d4fa2e73d956.Text:
Whenever any creature (enemy or ally) dies in combat, the Rogue Trader and their allies with Conviction — Heretical gain +1 to all their characteristics until the end of combat.
Whenever the Rogue Trader's flagship destroys any voidship in space combat, the flagship recovers 5% of its maximum hull integrity.

77b8ae41-32b7-4ad6-9bc9-c07d2a80e8d3.Text: Whenever an ally is healed for the first time in a round, damage dealt by that ally is increased by +8% until the end of combat. Stacks.

be71fc67-5233-4217-b94f-8963aeeab5ba.Text: All allies deal +10% damage with melta and plasma weapons.

99790579-53b9-41fa-b0fa-02a9a87221c0.Text: All allies increase their wounds by +{uip|HP|e0f7982fb32f4af9a4eb618c464c06d6}.

f8b1bc8d-1325-44d0-b4ef-f15188872fb4.Text: Grants +10% damage for 2 turns and +20 temporary wounds when a character uses their origin ability.

e571eee2-da45-42f7-805f-5e26d9bd5558.Text: All non-xenos allies gain +2 {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g} against xenos and daemons.

b06a43e1-4ffa-47cc-a5a3-3b6ab4b165fd.Text: The Rogue Trader gains +<u>(3 × Iconoclast rank)</u> Fellowship.

6eabc15f-cf11-44f8-9892-8c1ae3777a48.Text: All allies gain +{uip|Crit|02d413bfae2b4a06bb2f7b37e03593c1}% critical hit chance.

094f9915-06ed-454d-b9c0-fd12422a45a1.Text: All allies gain +5% dodge and +3% hit chance.

56035e3f-80a3-4831-8489-8c1f64ffe213.Text: Enemies suffer −5% to their armour penetration.

c21bf3aa-caad-4e07-9d57-e1d6f5c9a9cb.Text: All non-xenos allies gain a +5 bonus to all their characteristics and skills.

69a4042e-5db4-440f-b2fa-ab190b8df3d5.Text: At the start of each battle, the Rogue Trader's party gains +10 momentum.

700f05a5-62ab-4a24-ae9b-7095266bcfe8.Text: All allies gain +5 Perception and +10% armour penetration.

8b49e973-3e5c-4d0c-a3a1-07c40c733880.Text: Machine creatures, Necrons, and creatures with the {g|f:ed0acc1731834a89bda8cc52ec769e3d}Reject the Flesh{/g} feature suffer +10% more damage from the Rogue Trader's and their allies' attacks.

b5a29746-a985-4ba4-94a1-298253be533c.Text: The Rogue Trader gains +5% {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g} against xenos attacks.

e2c33314-14e3-4f9b-a54e-8c867cbf53df.Text: The Rogue Trader gains a +5 bonus to all their skills.

4f830b84-4f69-4a5d-a7c9-da04fefd7d52.Text: All allies deal +25% critical damage to xenos.

f3058509-c93e-4366-a999-13ef5f43a59b.Text: Machine creatures, Necrons, and creatures with the {g|f:ed0acc1731834a89bda8cc52ec769e3d}Reject the Flesh{/g} feature deal -10% less damage to the Rogue Trader and their allies.

e3befaa1-88cc-4e70-89b0-61bf59ea0f45.Text: The Rogue Trader and their allies deal +15% more damage with flamers and grenades.

fe639616-313b-4909-9133-ea7287fb96da.Text: The Rogue Trader gains + 10 Intelligence, Fellowship, and Willpower.

1858c01b-f467-4211-afad-5fb3474bca96.Text: All allies gain +10 Demolition and deal +10% more fire damage.

79d0caba-175d-47ca-82ec-25a6e8d3c277.Text: All allies gain +20% minimum damage to their ranged attacks.

675e4e86-3025-4e21-bd76-f1a9fd133201.Text: All allies deal +<u>(Tech-Use / 6)</u>% more power, energy, and fire damage.

57e374b1-ec8f-49fd-8505-1f6ea6c728a5.Text: Daemons, Chaos creatures, psykers, and Navigators deal −10% less damage to the Rogue Trader and their allies.

f8c12197-0197-4ca8-a4e4-95f1a1006371.Text: The Rogue Trader gains a +15 bonus to all their skills.

8f63f236-031f-4a9f-9ec3-f59e75544e72.Text: All allies deal +10% more damage to machine creatures, Necrons, and targets with the {g|f:ed0acc1731834a89bda8cc52ec769e3d}Reject the Flesh{/g} feature.

36d3c0b0-07b1-47fd-8fae-4af597d97aeb.Text: Grants the Rogue Trader and their allies +2 momentum for each human enemy killed in battle.

138cc756-984d-4464-aafa-9e63430b8cea.Text: All allies gain +3% critical hit chance.

088f0aed-616d-45b6-a9bf-968c2181c4ac.Text: All allies deal +{uip|Damage|c1742cb19a7e45dab69daf007e6a1523}% more energy and machine damage.

548a66e9-5b8c-4aae-a534-f2e74633549b.Text: All allies gain +5 Ballistic Skill and +5% damage to their ranged attacks.

a28d4ba4-6182-403f-88a9-4a6e3f924be4.Text:
All allies gain +10 Coercion.
Whenever an enemy enters a 5-cell radius zone around the Rogue Trader or their allies, this enemy must pass a Willpower resistance test with a +5 bonus or become staggered for 1 turn. If two or more allies are close enough to trigger this effect, the enemy must pass this resistance test for each of these allies.

9fa2ef3a-fa29-4e37-bbd6-7f0f1556ee84.Text: All allies gain +5% armour and +5% critical hit chance.

11eaafa9-7339-448a-9648-f616c02a13cc.Text: The Rogue Trader's party gain +<u>(FEL bonus / 2)</u> momentum when using any psyker or Navigator powers.

b367ee13-177f-4ac3-b251-a288885c60ec.Text: All allies gain +12% dodge against xenos.

48bcb822-aedb-48ce-a1bc-a93d182a897a.Text: All allies gain +5 {g|Encyclopedia:SkillAthletics}Athletics{/g} and suffer −10% less {g|Encyclopedia:ToxicDamage}toxic damage{/g}.

9d9fab4a-c6ff-4d27-8d7e-96d2b7ed0902.Text: Level of {g|Encyclopedia:ToxinEffect}toxin{/g} inflicted by the Rogue Trader or their allies is increased by +3.

5a1028fe-22d9-44be-8e9e-c68b435067e2.Text: Provide the technicians with scrap to repair the extractium.

27d0a123-e66b-44d2-8fd6-ee12a6517304.Text: Dismantle the surviving extractium for spare parts.

ca1878ff-66b5-4683-b138-1440249d7c77.Text: Leave the world to face its end alone.

37b8166d-d4e2-49a6-9b8f-0fb9961df3fd.Text: Take the extractium machine on board. Its capabilities can be applied elsewhere.

0940b355-d07d-4869-92ba-74f9110add05.Text: The sight before you has excited the officer corps, who are delighted to witness the truly majestic end of this planet through the huge windows on the bridge, one of many nameless worlds throughout the Expanse. An unknown reason caused the planet to break into several uneven parts, but its strong magnetic field is still preventing them from drifting into the cold abyss of space. The planet's hard inner core has remained almost untouched as thousands of explosions taking place under its shell of hard metals light up the world's heart from the inside.

c0af93ee-edf4-4822-a876-178b64fbd616.Text: A few dozen time bells later, the Lord Captain is informed that the repair crew is suffering from unrelenting headaches, most likely caused by the oppressive magnetic field of this world. However, the machines have been successfully repaired, and the extraction of adamantine may continue if the Lord Captain wishes. Of course, the mine needs to be staffed with a squad of working servitors and a maintenance brigade doomed to endure the endless pain caused by the magnetic storms.

4403e8ea-4f2e-4145-9724-8f6ba045658c.Text: You leave a part of the crew to extract adamantine for the von Valancius protectorate. Those fortunate to escape such a fate fervently pray for the lives of their friends and family, hoping to find them in good health should they be reunited someday.

db5d5b35-1367-4c26-84f8-982d9e0b085a.Text: The augur crew detects several ruined extractiums on the broken planet's surface. Their analysis shows somebody used to mine adamantine here but abandoned the deposit after the catastrophe. Most of the machines are damaged beyond repair, but the Tech-Adepts claim one of the complexes can be restored if the Rogue Trader has the required parts and equipment.

39caaaa2-41ff-430e-8ee5-1b4d148d6c17.Text: You decide not to spend the resources on fixing a mechanism on the surface of a world that may literally break apart at any moment. Over the course of several rotations, your people fully dismantle the extractium and evacuate the planet without incident.

012f9533-6bc8-47fa-8b10-ebc6f7a826f7.Text: Stash of the Children of Asuryan

d24093bb-8f43-433c-9450-d162888f5db4.Text: The Lord Captain orders the servants of the Machine Cult to prepare a plan for clearing the minefield without harming the xenoship.

e0a244d9-64f8-4a1b-b97d-f824e617a3a6.Text: The Rogue Trader decides to show mercy and aid the xenos.

d757fcde-1d86-4433-ae4f-aae35393281c.Text: The Lord Captain gives the order to clear a path to the vessel, detonating the mines indicated by the Tech-Priests.

67f652dc-838e-4338-a22a-d67e54fdb318.Text: The Lord Captain enquires after the state of the vessel.

b573da71-a234-47f9-a776-0785bbbad631.Text: The Rogue Trader decides not to risk the team and orders them to steer clear.

8392a2e3-568b-40f1-83aa-d29caaae5901.Text: The Rogue Trader's decisions are not up for debate. Ready weapons!

d2fbe337-11eb-4b5a-96a2-6c5a379c3c53.Text: The system has been cleared, and it is safe to proceed.

9953e3a2-d025-493b-960d-8fbb0368aa83.Text: Saving the xenos is impossible, but at least the system can be made safe for travel. The Rogue Trader orders the minefield detonated, taking with it the Aeldari voidship.

f98dedb8-86b1-47fe-a9ef-5be6666fe19c.Text: Sometimes it's simply impossible to outrun fate.

3f041f25-8045-4c67-a3b4-f12f42ef5253.Text: {name} von Valancius sends a shuttle with an experienced pilot and scouts in hopes that the smaller vessel can bypass the ancient mines.

f1d022f2-e920-42bd-806a-881f34e618d2.Text: The Rogue Trader orders {mf|his|her} officers to establish communications with the Aeldari vessel.

785af4d1-7327-42b7-bbe8-244ac2229fe4.Text: Logistics officers lead by Master Helmsman Ravor are ordered to plot a course for the rescue shuttle from the dynasty's flagship to the xenoship and back.

d33df138-bc38-48a6-90f7-e98aebe8fc46.Text: The augur crew picks up a heavily damaged xenos voidship among the countless rock masses of the asteroid belt — an Aeldari vessel, beyond a doubt. According to the von Valancius archives, about a hundred standard years ago, the Imperial Navy set up a barrier in this system against pirates and the enemies of Humanity. Countless primed mines are still scattered among the wreckage.

d01e4d5a-c570-4706-9e86-39cdc578e9f5.Text: The Aeldari vessel's hull and engines have presumably been damaged in a collision with a small celestial body. However, it is impossible to prove or disprove this hypothesis at such a distance — the xenos' vessels differ too much from those of the Imperium.

668be80a-b693-4995-8eaf-543545bf769e.Text: The minuscule shuttle enters the asteroid field and is almost immediately thrown off course by space debris. The pilot performs a desperate evasive manoeuvre and dodges several wrecks of these lost ships of antiquity... But the shuttle's wing clips a small asteroid, pushing it toward a nearby mine.

caeb46d6-4c71-4987-8b80-07bed3d973e9.Text: Yrliet is asking the elantach to help her kin who have found themselves in a trap sprung by fate. The Aeldari are worn out and weak; their song is a cry of despair. And that cry is fading.

9736ff88-d487-4bd2-a9c6-7bce499555d3.Text: Shielding her eyes, Yrliet closes them and clutches the spirit stone at her breast. Coming to, the Aeldari does not speak for a time. With notes of sadness in her voice, carefully picking her words, she concedes that the elantach did all they could to save her kin... And yet it is the mon-keigh who are responsible for the loss of the Aeldari voidship. Saddened by the pain and hatred that humans have wrought upon her kind, Yrliet quietly leaves the bridge.

6bde2971-6955-4c8e-b4c2-106b24eead93.Text: No amount of calculation can account for every single variable — a single mistake, and suddenly the next explosion detonates too close to an ice asteroid. Shattering into pieces, a block of ice crashes into the Aeldari vessel and sends it spinning into a cluster of still-active mines.

cc0487fa-f273-40f3-9d7e-79657eea5fe8.Text: The Vox Master manages to tune the ship's systems to an unconventional frequency — and the bridge suddenly fills with chime-like xenos voices. Drawn-out and mournful, they sing in an unknown tongue, but every officer on the bridge can sense that this is a dirge.

127d88a0-36a9-42b8-b7be-be0b75548877.Text: Even having come to, the Aeldari does not speak for a time. With notes of sadness in her voice, carefully picking her words, she concedes that the elantach did all {mf|he|she} could, and quietly leaves the bridge.

486af0bd-9381-4f41-8748-94418f7b937e.Text: And the team awaits further instructions.

703fc0d2-4e7b-40f4-b083-564741f6c97d.Text: Once the explosions quiet down and the shards of asteroids, space debris, and void mines dissolve into the darkness of the void, a rescue team sets off toward the miraculously intact xenoship.

00a36984-bff7-422d-b1a2-b98650935090.Text: However, the xenos do not respond to the incoming signals. After several attempts, the frequency tuned by the Vox Master gets lost, and the mournful song fades away.

491f6f45-6043-4d59-aca9-0514124a36a7.Text: On the Lord Captain's command, the ship's cannons fire several powerful salvos. As soon as the shots reach their mark, a cascade of soundless explosions erupts within the asteroid field and spirals around the Aeldari vessel.

39fc3359-b355-4015-95d9-88c7e255e19f.Text: Yrliet dispassionately watches the chain reaction in the asteroid field. A brilliant flash engulfs the Aeldari ship momentarily surrounded by a series of smaller bursts... she turns away, hiding her pained and forlorn gaze from the mon-keigh around her.

3714d42b-e8c9-429b-939d-b2fa9a301d44.Text: The Rogue Trader's crew departs the site of the ancient void battle, leaving the Aeldari ship trapped amid the minefield.

3f122f6c-4535-444b-aaac-94eb2ce4a14d.Text: At the Lord Captain's command, the voidship's weaponry fires several powerful volleys. As soon as the projectiles reach their target, the asteroid field is wracked by a chain of soundless explosions, and the Aeldari vessel is torn to pieces alongside the surrounding space debris and rocks.

c9a45b43-efde-46d6-ab06-7b86595ee99f.Text: Answering the call, Yrliet jumps to the cogitators, startling the officers on the bridge with her sudden jolt. In the hopes of understanding the mon-keigh technology and figuring out how to help her kin, the Aeldari runs in circles around blinking vid-screens, but the mysteries of the Machine God elude the xenos. Then, she turns to the Lord Captain, powerless.

9d080ea6-d229-4981-b443-b85b45a2acc5.Text: The shuttle enters the asteroid field. The pilot proceeds with caution, confidently avoiding the chunks of rock and nearly imperceptible mines.

115cec50-fb4f-4481-981a-7c956a1c2c95.Text: Yrliet distractedly watches as the tiny Aeldari voidship disappears amid the shrinking asteroids and countless stars. With sorrow in her heart, she touches the spirit stone on her chest, closes her eyes, and bids a silent goodbye to her kin, who are left alone, inevitably doomed.

6499b5a9-726e-40f9-8578-768accd4fdb5.Text: But are the calculations correct? The Tech-Priests warn that in solving this kind of problem, it is impossible to account for every possibility — too many unknowns, too little time.

9c6b1696-f097-47e7-bbce-91e621d6114f.Text: However, when the shuttle reaches the xenoship, the rescue team's report catches the bridge crew off-guard: the vessel's starboard side has been breached by the macro-weapons of an unknown Imperial voidship. There are... no survivors.

88bda6d0-a916-4a92-86e6-b79d619596b5.Text: The success of the operation is assessed as "extremely probable."

ebe06855-1009-4fe3-897a-0f35b0943097.Text: After several hours pass on the ship's clock, the servants of the Omnissiah present a plan for the neutralisation of the ancient mines.

d021064d-5937-40e8-910b-a1508879f4a4.Text: Yrliet's cold voice traitorously cracks when she reminds the Lord Captain about the agreement made in the forests of the Lilaethan.

29eb31b2-f6b0-41b1-928a-12cbcbf3994d.Text: Now all the crew can do is hope that the calculations are correct, and that the veteran officers' experience has not let them down.

550dbcbf-0415-44fd-8fe1-3332ff342b78.Text: Some time after, Yrliet comes to the Lord Captain, haggard and lost. She says that she came aboard the mon-keigh vessel and set off into the darkness in the hopes of finding her kin but found only corpses slaughtered by Humanity's hatred. Even when the Lord Captain had the opportunity to help her people, the elantach obstinately followed the same path as the other mon-keigh, breaching the agreement. As such, the Aeldari does not see it fit to keep up her end of the bargain either — the treasures of the Children of Asuryan will not end up in the hands of those who are not worthy of them.

7b7f89ae-d694-4877-a530-995aa5f3205e.Text: Some time after, Yrliet comes to the Lord Captain, haggard but hopeful. She says that she came aboard the mon-keigh vessel and set off into the darkness in the hopes of finding her kin but found only corpses slaughtered by Humanity's hatred. And yet the Aeldari knows that the Lord Captain made every possible effort to uphold {mf|his|her} promise. For Yrliet, actions speak louder than any word. In gratitude, as she promised, she shares the coordinates of her kin's cache.

b5fb628c-c46e-4783-ad26-b717b714563c.Text: Some time after, Yrliet comes to the Lord Captain, haggard but still holding onto hope. She says that she came aboard the mon-keigh vessel and set off into the darkness in the hopes of finding her kin but found only corpses slaughtered by Humanity's hatred. And though she and the Lord Captain were not always in agreement, the elantach still tried to lend a helping hand. In gratitude, as she promised, she shares the coordinates of her kin's cache.

41c49822-9514-4a63-95d5-115465d97c1f.Text: Utilise the full capabilities of the augurs to locate something unusual on the planet.

e291b175-ecbc-46f7-a678-0a516e1e01e9.Text: Send sacred machines to explore the peculiar constructions.

56cced29-ecf2-4171-9363-add9a5577efa.Text: Examine the constructions and the discovered artefacts using the knowledge you collected earlier.

606c1c8d-9f2d-4565-b85a-2dd0abe30e08.Text: Before you is a burning world, an inhospitable place at the mercy of a perpetual inferno due to its suffocating atmosphere and close proximity to the system's star. The fire storms on its surface never cease. What could the Kasballica be looking for in such a place?

a7248464-2f60-4935-8c5f-fd19b34abb6f.Text: Another burning world. This time the fires comes from within the planet, the perpetual volcanic activity creating powerful cyclones of gases, ash clouds, and soot.

ec7bcae9-7c2e-41ad-9f18-fb5963c2f08e.Text: Yet another world is burning before your eyes. It is covered in geysers belching forth clouds of incendiary gas, feeding a massive conflagration enveloping the planet. Thousands of years ago, a single flash of lightning or some other spark launched a chain reaction that transformed the world into a blistering inferno.

77ad1cfb-96db-4bb8-90fb-3c679e04e86d.Text: This burning world looks different from the rest. There are little islands of blue amidst the boundless ocean of crimson and gold, places where natural gases tint the fire a different colour.

291b5bc4-488f-4738-8956-3f4921e251a2.Text: The explorers are convinced you are holding the artefacts of a unique ancient xenocivilisation the crew is now calling the Builders From the Flame. These creatures were accustomed to the incredibly high temperatures of the burning worlds. They may have been a silicon-based life form or even sentient colonies of bacteria. More evidence is required if the research is to continue.

81d5a2dc-c98f-47ac-8a14-583b1380938b.Text: It looks like the Builders From the Flame used hereditary bacterial structures to record information. The artefacts you discovered on the burning worlds contained colonies of bacteria whose genes carried the message of these xenos across generations. Their language, however, bears a passing semblance to some of the ancient samples already available to your scientists. They managed to make a crude translation of some of these records.

72526401-6331-4785-8ef7-96bfec3d6692.Text: They revealed that the Builders From the Flame were not originally colonising the burning worlds. Their homeland was not a planet but a star. It is hard to imagine what the creatures that evolved in the burning ocean of a faraway sun may have looked like, but one day their peaceful existence came to an end. The records contain a chilling legend about some cosmic horror that arrived and devoured the sun that the Builders called home. Fearing the monster, they fled and no longer dared to settle on stars.

a3a541e2-fcdb-40f2-8343-25921b9b0918.Text: The Builders considered burning worlds as the most fit for habitation, yet they went extinct shortly after the exodus, perhaps unable to adapt to the harsh realities of life outside their stellar home. Their civilisation left a wealth of unique technologies and heat-resistant materials, and now this treasure belongs to the von Valancius dynasty!

3b133ce0-be05-44e7-9655-62529a9bbff0.Text: After many long hours spent analysing the augur data, the Tech-Priests noticed something unusual. A number of constructions of artificial origin can be detected under the planet's surface. They are too vast and peculiar to have been created by humans, but their geometric shapes and other properties clearly indicate they were put together by sentient beings of some kind.

1c5c8243-630d-4d18-b949-960dd937efc8.Text: The augurs report nothing you don't know already. This world is hostile, inhospitable, and of little interest.

8bc001f1-3b82-4058-b46a-c36d0792adc5.Text: The operation is difficult but proceeds without a hitch. The machines make way to the unusual constructions and return carrying priceless samples. Seemingly uninteresting, these plates and weaves of heat-resistant material cause great excitement among the Tech-Priests.

d2803c8b-ffec-4b2a-9c5c-3d09e7dbf622.Text: Exploring under extreme conditions is never easy. A mistake in the Tech-Priests' calculations causes the machines to succumb to severe heat stress and malfunction, damaging the strange constructions beyond repair. This is not the end, however, as there are more burning worlds where this research can be carried out after the necessary modifications are made.

ba653d71-722e-4cfc-8fe6-1dc45be7f848.Text: The meticulous work of the Tech-Priests and archivists is taking forever. Even your Astropathic Choirmaster joins the effort, spending long hours in a trance and relaying messages to those who can help. But when the result comes, it is astounding.

9bf8ff41-cc11-49a5-90c0-12c18cb743c5.Text: Alas, you do not have enough knowledge to solve this mystery just yet.

280cc281-3bb6-4717-bd58-47d308be71f0.Text: The yellow-red glare of the burning world coming through the bridge windows hurts your eyes.

93cf27b1-3d6e-4fdd-8da6-ad1c520012b8.Text: Unfortunately, there are traces of human activity next to the mysterious constructions. It looks like somebody found a way to land on the planet and set up an archaeological dig. These ancient monuments have been stripped of anything of value or interest, but other burning worlds may yield new discoveries.

00862d56-fd21-480b-ab8b-a4e2744d01d5.Text: Now that you know what to look for, your augurs easily locate traces of the mysterious underground constructions.

26f3cd60-bf83-4682-8746-835e99f8b534.Text: Now you know both how to locate the strange constructions and how to extract artefacts from them.

7828f98d-bb87-48b7-b077-b9b662d5434f.Text: The Lord Captain declares a great hunt. The animals cannot flee and are virtually defenceless, and their valuable meat and pelts will prove quite useful.

711e3656-b964-4ef7-bdab-2a19b079b1a3.Text: The Lord Captain orders the removal of the space debris from the riverbed. It's a long and laborious process, but the animals will have a chance to survive.

0253acea-f071-4d47-8723-196a367357c7.Text: It appears that a large voidship recently dumped a huge load of junk and faulty parts from orbit. The debris that did not burn up in the atmosphere is now blocking the flow of a mighty river. This "dam" is causing the river to overflow, flooding the nearby valley. A herd of large hoofed rodents has gathered along the riverbanks. If the animals lose their usual habitat, they are doomed.

0b721ad4-9e10-43a2-9ee1-2dc6e161da0a.Text: The great hunt brings plentiful spoils and lifts the crew's spirits. The right to take shore leave and partake in the hunt is so coveted a prize that many are willing to sell their belongings, make hefty bets in card games, and even fight in improvised tournaments to win it.

5def44b9-e265-41c0-b2be-853b5cc30434.Text: It takes many planetary turns and hundreds of crew members to remove the heap of trash and unclog the river, letting the waters flow freely once more. The rodents run back to their pastures without so much as a backward glance at the people who saved them.

6e946cc0-6cd7-4451-b028-141865794612.Text: Sister Argenta believes the crew has found the remains of a martyr who sacrificed themselves to protect Humanity from the xenos threat. She proposes to erect a monument and hold a service in their honour.

706c38b3-b62a-4444-a00f-785d6ae2d707.Text: Jae Heydari is impressed by the dead pilot's bravery and believes they would have been honoured to have their equipment serve new generations in the fight against xenos and heretics.

ab4c5b44-0f43-4e25-92aa-47a77dd27034.Text: The Lord Captain wishes to honour the pilot and erect a monument amidst the ruins.

780d47e4-a8fc-40ed-9ae1-c085aec582cd.Text: The Lord Captain wishes to search the remains for any surviving equipment.

0a644d32-55e8-4e17-921e-568448e33e01.Text: The Lord Captain orders that the ruins and crash site are to be left alone.

7968d0d2-ed97-4a76-9815-70562728a20a.Text: Kibellah claims that the pilot's fierce and fearless spirit has not departed the remains to go to the Undying One. She proposes to honour the hero and decorate the bow of the flagship with their bones, so that they may continue to fight the enemies of Humanity in death.

5e2629b5-510f-4b56-af8a-8281a4643106.Text: Charred ruins have been detected on the planet's surface. The architecture, building materials, layout, and passages betray their xenos origin. There are currently no signs of xeno-activity on the planet and the ruins seem to be abandoned.

0630d60f-efa3-42cf-b3ab-b183902e6188.Text: The servants of the Bloodspun Web solemnly place the bones in the bow plating while the crew watches the sacred ceremony with awe. The God-Emperor has sent them a mighty spirit protector.

28c1a6a0-8518-4313-b704-fff31fb4907d.Text: The burnt husk of an Imperial shuttle has been found in the heart of the ruins. The pilot's remains are badly damaged. It would seem the shuttle smashed into the building at full speed, causing the fire that destroyed it.

46920282-23a5-42c6-9ad0-150a0ab24a5a.Text: Detailed examination of the ruins revealed nothing of interest.

5a167c0f-56bc-4173-8b6c-0d27f1d6c032.Text: Hundreds of crew members disembark to honour the nameless hero, while many more remain on board to listen to a vox-cast of the liturgy in the sombre gloom of the decks. Even though the pilot's name is unknown, their sacrifice will be remembered in the hearts of the Imperium's true children.

ebf771a2-337b-4c2c-acf9-866e8812c0e9.Text: Close examination reveals a few precious archeotech items. Unfortunately, removing them destroys the pilot's remains. White shards of bone are now scattered among the burned-out ruins.

dce2af49-ca20-4158-b403-0c0f56222b34.Text: Leave the prisoner in the cave full of corpses.

4b5280a5-4b63-412c-a859-fdfab527af18.Text: Order Kibellah to interrogate the prisoner.

f6d78863-6d40-4f42-a4de-ad94e710a95c.Text: Order Solomorne to lead the reconnaissance.

140c0366-361d-4baf-96be-3bdd0d683f3e.Text: The augur crew have detected signs of life under the planet's surface. There, in the caves, is a man-made complex. According to the ship's archives, this world is uninhabitable and devoid of useful resources, so the presence of someone's base seems intriguing.

1dcc4605-b84c-4e4e-91dc-b2a2f23d3896.Text: Your macro-cannon salvos collapsed the cave systems and buried the underground complex under thousands of tons of rock. The secrets of this place will forever be consigned to oblivion.

72ba69b9-212f-4cb3-a7c9-c87dbe897cb2.Text: The strike came so suddenly that the squad of enforcers died in the very first moments. Before reinforcements could reach the planet, a monstrously powerful explosion shook the cave complex and buried its secrets under thousands of tons of rock.

bdeb26af-f794-48db-9139-77cf1f8fa731.Text: The enforcers disembarked next to the suspicious cave. The entrance to the cave turned out to be blocked by a massive plasteel door, once pierced by a melta charge then shoddily patched up. Within, an ambush awaited your team. Attackers with emaciated bodies pounced from the darkness without warning.

8d2c98e0-ced3-4366-b5f1-d182411fd2dd.Text: Under torture, the bastard confessed to belonging to the Cult of Saint Drusus. He and his brothers and sisters were tasked with guarding this strange cemetery and preventing anyone from entering. He equally could not hide that the unfortunate inhabitants of the cryo-vaults were killed by his people. Alas, that was his last confession as the harsh interrogation finally took its toll.

293054c5-4dae-4043-8471-6c8a2b92fda9.Text: While a shuttle brought the prisoner aboard the Lord Captain's voidship, scouts searched the base and found a vast hall, the walls of which were dotted with cryo-vaults. All but one were disabled and contained the remains of some prominent people judging by their clothes. The last cryo-vault was opened and stood empty.

634d7962-3812-466e-974f-6d31724684b2.Text: In the hours that followed, the captive became fully aware of how sophisticated and ruthless the Bloodspun Web can be in its quest for the truth.

bdd73c8d-4787-45a2-b18c-88d745a56996.Text: The squad landed near a suspicious cave. The entrance to the cave was blocked by a massive plasteel door that had previously been pierced by a melta charge and then shoddily patched up. After receiving a signal from his faithful cyber-mastiff, Proctor Anthar warned the enforcers of the ambush ahead, and the attack was not long in coming — armed people with emaciated bodies charged out of the darkness.

821e925b-ccfa-480d-adfe-746787a467d2.Text: Despite the brutal torture and various persuasive, mind-altering solutions administered into the prisoner's bloodstream by a wise Tech-Priest, the bastard maintained his arrogant silence and perished before a single word escaped his lips.

19eb14a4-5248-49be-9043-a7c3c7c3192b.Text: Tech-Priests sent at your command have reported that the machine spirits of all cryo-vaults are healthy and obedient, excepting the one living within the opened sarcophagus. This machine spirit is in terrible condition and afflicted by great madness, muddying its algorithms.

ec69f8de-8ce3-40f2-8d96-3920d35940ab.Text: The enforcers of the von Valancius dynasty reacted with lightning speed. They walked away from the vicious battle not only victorious but having captured the enemy commander.

381411b3-c622-46dd-874e-c296b65f40ed.Text: Offering up prayers to the Machine God, the augur operators turned their blessed optics toward the very epicentre of the raging magnetic storm. In spite of the thick haze of static covering the augurs' pict-visors, something unexpected appeared.

3fbf7e92-16a3-4f58-828a-50935527d006.Text: The bastard did not appreciate your mercy. He threw himself at the guards as soon as he was unchained. In the resulting scuffle, both his brains and the secrets they concealed were splattered across a bulkhead.

a3901721-1ba8-460a-8322-ce0b56b4b8cc.Text: For the attempt on the lives of subjects of the von Valancius dynasty, the bastard was placed in the nozzle of a manoeuvring thruster, where the zealous machine spirit incinerated him with a jet of roaring flame.

22354c6c-d8be-4ea7-b869-7fc97a5928fe.Text: In addition, a curious machine was destroyed during the battle. As further inspection would show, this was the very contraption responsible for creating the magnetic storms blanketing the planet, concealing the cemetery from prying eyes. Its machine spirit extinguished forever, Tech-Priests still managed to extract those parts that still held value.

296b0828-b4ce-4c94-b31e-28474d5f4421.Text: The Rogue Trader has decided to leave this unwelcoming world. Maybe {mf|he|she} will return here one day.

6cf0832b-ee53-43a5-990d-778253e581f7.Text: The magnetic storm raging above the planet blurs the gaze of augur arrays. Only truly powerful diviner machines may see through the currents of magnetic fluctuations in their blessed vigil and discover the mysteries of this Emperor-forsaken planet.

51dec211-bd8a-4790-8440-7765d44f2f82.Text: The Rogue Trader orders to behead everyone on the illegal mining rig and send their heads to Incendia Chorda — with the very best of wishes.

d8a7a552-a57f-49af-aebe-c5f7cbbd76d5.Text: Destroy the extractium with a precise shot.

77119292-3e4b-4ac4-a15d-b6d359ce8f46.Text: Destroy the unidentified extractium with an aimed shot.

33da1553-9abf-4c0b-b064-0a1c64b8e3a8.Text: Proctor Anthar reports that, under the law, the extractium can be confiscated and compensation claimed through the Administratum from the Chorda dynasty for the illegal mining. The Rogue Trader gives the order to do just that.

dc3ecb67-2c4d-4a77-b784-c419348c112d.Text: The Seneschal considers this act unacceptable and insists on confiscating and rebasing this extractium that was illegally set up in von Valancius territory.

656e2433-9e0a-4c58-abe6-f0aeaa983921.Text: Magos Pasqal notes the unusual composition of Atle's core — subsequent development will allow the extraction of rare refractory metals. Heeding his advice, the Rogue Trader decides to keep the extractium for {mf|himself|herself}.

006011ed-00d1-49ad-a3a6-94959b5700a9.Text: The Rogue Trader graciously allows Incendia Chorda to feed on crumbs unworthy of the von Valancius dynasty's attention.

701a0854-0360-46da-9d6e-1e907317668d.Text: The Rogue Trader decides to keep the extractium for {mf|himself|herself} with all the workers and servitors.

a37aed30-1b89-42c7-9b2c-21087d7f3058.Text: The Rogue Trader commands that the machines be confiscated and put into the ship's cargo hold.

ba260c1c-54d2-4f28-baca-560d5de2373b.Text: This dwarf planet is marked on the von Valancius protectorate charts as "Atle" and serves as a backup source of water for the habitable worlds of neighbouring systems. Due to the abundance of bacteria proliferating in the Atle hydrosphere, the extraction of ice was stopped half a century ago, but much to your officers' surprise, the augurs detected an unidentified mining rig deep underground. Presumably, the excavation is aimed at extracting clay minerals near the planet's core, enriched with iron and other metals.

25b65c8d-ac51-4c1f-92fc-8ac5239d0793.Text: As soon as your people return to the flagship, you receive an Astropathic response from the Administratum ordinate: the governor of one of the nearest Chorda worlds has been implicated in the illegal mining. The perpetrator will be severely punished, and compensation will be sent to the Rogue Trader's treasury immediately.

d476e2da-18f6-45c7-b0d5-45c7e0576b39.Text: The extractium turns out to be Incendia Chorda's latest investment, whose demesne is located just within a few jumps from the Cranach System. While this world is of little value to the von Valancius dynasty, your officers see this gesture as an attempt to test the boundaries of the newly minted Rogue Trader's leniency.

9600f987-7a13-4f3c-b7ca-a7fe6a546260.Text: The transmission cuts off as soon as the scouting party reaches the extraction zone. All subsequent attempts to contact them fail, presumably because they were eliminated by the extractium's defence systems.

3a825b1e-cbc6-45b3-83e7-9a68ff3f2db2.Text: The Vox Master reports that your message was sent and received. Several hours pass, but there is no reply.

e86f9aa7-55d2-4ab0-878f-2dc15d3c9a37.Text: The crew carries out the order with grim determination. Not a hand trembled, each face focused without demur. The property of the von Valancius dynasty is yours alone, and the crew stands ready to prove this to any would-be challenger as often as is necessary.

30efc5cf-d63e-4ea6-af3d-62d74a3ecb90.Text: The frightened workers and the token security crew do not even attempt to resist the superior forces. The machines are delivered to the flagship's cargo hold, and shortly after the officers plant the von Valancius banner on the spot where the extractium used to be.

fd4520a0-29bc-4f83-af46-f1e67b2863f5.Text: Your people easily assume control as the frightened workers and the token security crew do not even attempt to resist. The extractium's machines are restarted shortly after, the amassed containers filled with precious ore are delivered to the flagship's cargo hold.

a0c743d3-68a1-440d-8079-977e9b73d37f.Text: All that remains of the extractium is a handful of craters. The augur crew scans the surface one more time and finds parts of the extractium machines scattered all over the area.

667de183-01af-468d-9e94-adff4ccbb5f9.Text: Vigdis reports that your order was being quite actively discussed on the crew's personal vox-casters until the lights-out bell. Some believe you lack the staunchness required of a Rogue Trader, but others are impressed by your clever response. Only the combat crews are bitterly disappointed, not having the pleasure of "teaching Chorda's space mongrels a lesson they won't soon forget."

c3c10f21-b0eb-416a-965e-a44052f79f21.Text: Disembark and examine the shuttle and the xenostructures.

6683aa97-b285-447a-9c8a-7a7e072dd152.Text: Get away from the unknown xenostructures.

ddb78af4-a6c3-4b02-93c5-a11c433d59a3.Text: A shuttle of Imperial make is detected among the rocky gorges of the planet, alongside two nearby xeno-objects — monolithic structures embedded into the landscape. When scanned, the objects distort the signal, but no signs of enemy activity nor signals from the shuttle are found.

30503fc0-fa3e-44de-8f61-563aa3f0496a.Text: The servitors' signals disappear as soon as they approach the cliffs between which the shuttle was found. Not one of them returns, and no data is received.

fcc0277a-ad61-4f99-acfc-c65b68451ce8.Text: {name} von Valancius wishes to personally explore the enigmatic monoliths. The von Valancius shuttle overcomes the turbulence zone with an alarming rumble, after which the connection to the voidship becomes tenuous. Despite a rough landing on rocky terrain, the flight ends successfully.

9bdc66cf-7243-44f1-81ce-d649be022e53.Text: Pick up several pieces of wreckage.

72fafec5-c777-41c8-8107-edc250645a8b.Text: Look for the source of the wreckage.

951f2182-8f2e-448b-8898-6b41ced2cd00.Text: The augurs have detected wreckage in the voidship's vicinity, but the exact nature of this wreckage remains unclear.

263bd997-5b0a-454b-a54f-4eb6608919dd.Text: Some of the wreckage is made of plasteel, the rest is some unknown material. Studying the fragments further is nigh impossible due to severe corrosive damage. The non-metallic fragments also bear burn marks.

688e2329-5458-49da-b948-8035a2cf9aa6.Text: The augur crew reports that it has registered no evidence of a disaster that could have produced such debris.

69196347-7b7a-4071-b64d-9d75b8e20477.Text: Open fire on the inhuman scum.

44e5d5af-27f2-4f90-b210-e3d8820f9dfb.Text: A vigilant member of the augur crew has detected a small xenos vessel drifting through the void. The ship is unpowered and shows no signs of being crewed.

f062caa2-1e06-45e7-92ba-b100c0afe411.Text: One macro-cannon salvo is enough to turn the pitiful ship into a cloud of dust.

8927caec-9ce1-4940-b44b-ee631cf3d75e.Text: The squad boarded the vessel without issue. Corrosion has laid waste to the ship's systems, which led to the death of the entire crew. The interior is full of Aeldari corpses. No weapons were found on board, and the dead xenos, judging by their clothing, were not part of any warrior caste, merely the crew of the now defunct ship.

7ba9fa7f-31d9-4c5c-865f-87e021021144.Text: The xenos Yrliet claims to have recognised the symbols on the dead Aeldari's clothes. They were civilian refugees from Craftworld Crudarach.

6fd6eec2-8eea-41f1-bf89-9199f7f946bc.Text: Analyse the nature of the creature.

c13ab446-b854-4ef5-bce9-75a52db61940.Text: Search for other objects in the grass.

f7ce1fc5-d234-4b1a-a6fc-64e2b8290e41.Text: Send out a squad of scouts to search the camp.

8aa1e79b-74b2-4ae4-9a23-5000811522ea.Text: Burn away all trace of xenos presence.

1b47287e-c32a-4135-93ab-903dab3a03c1.Text: Order the scouts to return immediately.

c91ca1da-7ee2-4358-8a50-2352a91e0d27.Text: Find out what is in the place marked by the skull.

5af36c40-1717-4c4d-96d0-c920b662533b.Text: Under thin clouds, as if shredded by a careless blade, sway vast steppes carpeted by pale gold deadwood. The Rogue Trader's attentive eye distinguishes a region among the endless grasses that does not fit into the general landscape.

c4b5daa9-d061-4d45-9f8f-7569714cb763.Text: The xenos' camp hides any number of dangers.

ad747734-92a2-42f6-9511-9ac4210252a6.Text: As they comb over the tracks left around the Drukhari structures, the scouts find items of Imperium make: blood-soaked clothes, an Aquila patch, and a data-slate cracked in half. Gothic letters and the symbol of the Inquisition are frozen on its bottom half. The sentence fragments make up part of an exploration report.

c589b350-0f5a-48e8-b38f-c3c99aa2e246.Text: The predatory structures do not burn easily, and it takes a long time for them to heat up. When the flames finally gather strength, turquoise explosions flash amid the yellow-orange waves. Whatever was down there was dangerous.

89dc9a01-55b8-40c3-a3d1-bb626970da74.Text: The scouts carefully inspect every piece of land in the marked area and discover a camouflaged pit studded with strong, thin needles. In a niche sunk into the wall of the trap glitters a volumetric flask with an ugly creature that looks like several brains stuck together.

4be4aeff-d08d-43d0-bff3-eda2ff6f46dd.Text: The scouts conduct a cursory exploration of the marked earth. A few men fall into a camouflaged pit studded with strong, thin needles. Their bodies swell from the punctures, being filled with an unknown toxin. Their comrades above freeze from the screams then come to their senses and begin extracting the unfortunate explorers. In a niche sunk into the wall of the trap glitters a volumetric flask with an ugly creature that looks like several brains stuck together.

11a2cb84-5a27-4180-8323-6975b80914f2.Text: Deep prints belonging to landing legs and a ladder are visible in the grass behind the maze. The relative positions of the recesses correspond to the design of an Imperial shuttle. When the von Valancius scouts approach, they find a wax seal bearing the symbol of the Inquisition and a monogram formed from the letters XC. An officer voices the proposition that the initials correspond to the name of Lord Inquisitor Xavier Calcazar.

90d7a6fc-5087-4935-8b42-c64497ef2019.Text: A segment of the dry grass a few metres in front of the prints from the ladder has been cut as if scythed. Among the chopped stems lies a piece of a Drukhari trophy — a flap of dark skin stretched out by thin chains. Most of it is covered by a tattoo: a silhouette of a storm or tornado and a black symbol composed of curved lines and sharp shapes.

844b62e3-5140-4b13-af15-58ece06c9cb3.Text: There is nothing in the dry grass around the depressions in the ground that would merit the Rogue Trader's attention.

61d9d8b6-2d09-4a10-820e-7b6e1dce78f6.Text: The Rogue Trader's people recognise the grotesque figure as a Drukhari medusa — a parasite capable of registering emotions and transferring them to its masters. This thing was left here as the equivalent of a pict-recorder, collecting the suffering of the Drukhari's victims.

e1cb2f28-b254-4b64-8087-a08d380c8478.Text: The flask explodes into shrapnel fragments under a salvo from the scouts' rifles. The remaining liquid is collected into several test tubes to be examined in the ship's laboratorium and put to good use — or destroyed on the orders of the Rogue Trader.

e4e1f695-3cbd-4d0a-bfde-d6377101c2ff.Text: The scouts from the shuttle see signs of intelligent life. Judging by the trampled soil and tent frames, someone made camp here. Distant silhouettes form a tangle of paths and obstacles — a maze. The outer walls are supplemented by a multitude of spikes and blades and decorated with scraps of leather and withered crucified prisoners. It does not take an expert in xenoculture to reason that Drukhari have been here.

91f62081-aa15-4edb-b942-b8ab7c434ee1.Text: The servants of von Valancius find a rough illustration of the camp in the pocket of a filthy coat. On it are marked two locations. The first is shown with a sword and highlights the area where the items were found. The other is a skull and points to a patch of ground by the maze.

9c8cfc57-851c-49dc-bef3-9d26dd49bcd9.Text: Take the risk and send a shuttle.

4743f098-16cb-4131-a895-5ab83c9f0b09.Text: The ship's augurs have detected a non-native mineral cluster on the planet's surface — probably the remains of an ancient asteroid shower. The substance is valuable, but collecting it will not be easy: the asteroid sits right above numerous underground caverns. The ancient tunnels and vaults are incredibly unstable and would likely not bear the weight of a large group of humans, let alone a shuttle.

38d670db-2184-47cc-9780-c25b21e16b41.Text: The crew's expertise made it possible to collect the mineral without disturbing the ancient caverns.

d585e923-bb1d-4aa0-94ca-334ee5314bd7.Text: One crew member's careless misstep caused the whole network of caverns beneath to collapse, not only killing the blundering worker, but causing a catastrophic chain reaction that claimed the lives of the whole team.

1df9c815-9aa8-41b9-8a35-ef2e56ab8063.Text: Life is fragile, even for creatures this enormous.

ab646883-e02d-46f7-9442-a2b1ab2a0df1.Text: After analysing the augur data, the officers were surprised to discover that the planet was once covered with oceans. Long ago, an unknown cataclysm caused the seas to dry out and turned the world into a lifeless desert. The most amazing discovery of all was the skeletal remains of colossal oceanic organisms, some large enough to be seen from orbit.

ec09b348-d71b-46aa-aa33-ff2a75d5a5e6.Text: Let the holy fire purify it all.

4e5a04b4-91cc-4c36-a8a9-5898da8cd1fb.Text: Search through the remains for anything valuable.

c4c4d96c-de6d-4485-bf44-72d298d2b74b.Text: The bizarre structure observed from orbit appears to be the ruined estate of a wealthy noble. Further searching reveals the remains of an enviro-dome, a landing pad, the main manor, and servants' quarters. It is impossible to determine what exactly happened there. The search team has found something truly disturbing in the main hall — an opulently clothed skeleton sitting at the dinner table. The table is set with gold plates covered with old blood and piles of bones. The bones on the plates are clearly human. No other remains have been found on the estate.

e6da0eba-351a-465c-af62-b19e0e5993fb.Text: The scout team returns with some expensive weapons taken from the skeleton. After finishing their report, they hurry away, whispering prayers.

ea78eeaf-edf5-4a48-9b30-e90815a47765.Text: Fire consumes the sinister ruins. The Imperium's faithful children will not tolerate any impurity on their path.

7b354d65-8dbe-4a08-8661-2e891fad6691.Text: Send an exploration team equipped with a drilling apparatus to the asteroid.

bfeb5ed2-f277-41f7-be65-38e6d605b6a0.Text: The Lord Captain decides that the potential reward is not worth the team's labours and gives the order to leave the asteroid belt.

73f88956-202b-49bf-a63a-9d96ef287dfc.Text: Order the squad to ignore these paltry deposits and move on.

83739a0b-38e4-4260-8c9d-5f6e896b3273.Text: Exploring these caves no longer seems like a good idea, and the Lord Captain commands the squad to return to the voidship.

392775ec-2a75-48a3-883a-2c69e351108c.Text: Plasteel is an important resource. An opportunity to acquire some should not be disregarded.

09ccf442-8de0-48ca-b8bc-70e202a3f727.Text: There is not enough data on the substance. The Rogue Trader orders the team to circumvent the toxin-filled tunnels to avoid risking their health and equipment.

02a56e10-8df7-47a2-9ab3-e4d8532b3d4b.Text: There's no need for haste. The explorers are to gather as much material as possible and transfer the find to the Magi Alchemys for further processing.

d68ca766-ae52-4a21-9481-0570b138e6e6.Text: Order the collection of the xenos totems. Flogiston is too valuable to leave it here.

50107110-c76e-49a9-a7c1-d1535baee113.Text: The flogiston is tainted by xenos filth and must be destroyed alongside the city.

566e1db2-7e52-43b8-88cb-4a43ef9c5675.Text: This city remained untouched for aeons. Let it remain so.

cfff4eab-0664-46be-94c5-58d535b0f8c2.Text: The gigantic asteroid's surface is densely sown with craters and pits leading into deep caves. Augurs indicate that the asteroid consists of layers characterised by strange heterogeneity. There is a high probability of finding valuable resources inside the stone — they can be extracted by sending an exploration team deep into the tangled tunnels.

eba2c0e8-9803-44b8-90aa-fe7795b63041.Text: Several caverns on the asteroid's surface release an unknown substance. Viscous and cloudy, it spreads over the stone's porous surface and expands into shapeless blots in the weightlessness of the void. The augur team warns that the substance is extremely toxic, and that the emanations are steadily eating away at the rock. Exploring the asteroid is impossible.

53fe3b98-0d78-43ef-9945-32c08c276705.Text: The tired squad begins the return journey up to the surface, forever leaving the pathways of the ancient city behind.

4a007440-1d6b-405a-ae68-4b4f29faf19e.Text: The massive beasts turn out to be surprisingly agile — in a couple of jumps they reach the team of explorers and dig into the poor souls' bodies with powerful mandibles, mashing them into a bloody paste. Gorged on fresh meat, the monsters scurry away into the colossal cracks in the walls. Having neither the time nor the strength to bid a final farewell to the fallen, deprived of equipment and hope, the remnants of the expedition rush out of the accursed caverns... back, to the ship, as soon as possible!

58369b7a-bacb-4e29-85ac-f99d3c249699.Text: With the help of the massive drill, the exploration team penetrates into the cavernous depths. The squad reports that their auspexes have detected meagre reserves of a substance used in the synthesis of plasteel in the rock. Their excavation will take time and significant effort.

ebed2808-f46c-4998-9904-47dee3902982.Text: The equipment struggles with the unexpected hardness of the rock, but after three watches the squad manages to set up enough mobile extractiums to gather the coveted material.

66144fe7-e09c-44ba-9ece-347d0bbd5a1c.Text: Cracking the unusual rock turns out to be impossible. Having encountered unexpected resistance, the equipment falls into disrepair. After several fruitless watches, the squad decides to continue moving deeper into the asteroid in the search of richer veins.

f05c95d4-9166-44e6-83db-5d83ffa95be0.Text: The noise and vibrations caused by the instruments have disturbed strange currents inside the asteroid. A transparent, viscous substance streams down from the porous walls of the caverns, slowly filling the caves. The squad's auspexes raise the alarm — a prolonged stay in these tunnels will undoubtedly result in the toxic liquid destroying the gear and equipment. Despite this, the explorers suggest blocking the livelier streams in order to leave them with enough time to fill several canisters with the strange substance. Later, the Magi Alchemys will no doubt be able to synthesise many useful chemicals from it.

111c92d2-f1b2-4e00-a8d8-96aad116bec5.Text: The Lord Captain's order lifts the team's spirits, and soon the members of the expedition manage to locate a safe cavern still untouched by the toxic currents. The exploration team continues its journey into the bowels of the asteroid.

56c33bf2-f1a1-47a6-a21d-9d53e9bafcf2.Text: Before coming across a dry cavern yet untouched by the toxic substance, the squad wanders at length through the maze of tight tunnels slowly filling with baleful liquid. The weakest members of the group fall behind, remaining forever buried in the lifeless space rock alongside their ruined equipment.

428bfa6d-15ef-4fb4-b553-22b6999ef30e.Text: Long hours are spent carefully preparing for the collection of the material and mapping the caves in this part of the asteroid. Carefully observing the flows of strange liquid, the squad succeeds in gathering several canisters of the substance while preventing any floods. While some soldiers return to carry the prize back to the surface, the rest continue moving toward the asteroid's heart.

36ac3de2-4f42-46f3-98fd-0b25d95b3b52.Text: The prolonged preparation for the collection of the material ends in tragedy — caverns destroyed by the substance open the way for even larger deluges. Having lost several team members and equipment to the bolstered currents, the squad hurries forward, unable to gather enough material for the Magi Alchemys.

91648b24-8ed0-4a14-a9c3-ee7b0d91d60e.Text: The explorers eventually reach the dry, surprisingly large caverns. A minute of respite is interrupted by a terrified scream — the squad is under attack! The tunnel's arches collapse, turning into nightmarish monsters resembling both worms and spiders. The beasts rush forward, yearning to tear apart the intruders who disturbed their rest!

61115d52-2f96-4883-aad5-4796b2afa564.Text: The gigantic horrors attack relentlessly, their powerful mandibles turning soldiers' bodies into a bloody paste, but nothing can withstand the purifying light of flamers! Intrigued by the encounter with new xenoforms, the explorers notice that their tough carapaces conceal meat — both extraordinarily nutritious and surprisingly tasty. Without a doubt, future hunts for these creatures could feed a significant number of people.

cf2bc035-8f72-4b2e-890a-11e4e9e64f4c.Text: Powerful mandibles turn soldiers' bodies into a bloody paste, and the nightmarish battle against unknown xenoforms seems to last an eternity. However, nothing can withstand the purifying light of flamers — the horrors finally retreat into hidden nests, calling new waves of their kind as reinforcements by rattling their disgusting mandibles. Lacking the strength and time to bid a final farewell to their fallen comrades, the survivors hasten to bring down the entrances to the nest and morosely continue their difficult journey.

c14a2c85-0af7-4592-a3d1-289aa34c441a.Text: The endless caverns eventually lead the explorers to the very centre of the asteroid, where they are met with a yawning cavity of unimaginable size. The giant rock turns out to be housing the curved, shapeless buildings of an unknown xenorace — fragile, built as if out of sand. An intriguing find awaits the squad in the long-dead city — uncountable quantities of ugly totems made from crystal flogiston are built into the walls of the most twisted buildings.

b2ed9243-463d-476a-bf00-8305c5ce30af.Text: With each crystal effortlessly removed from the dilapidated sand walls, entire blocks of the city collapse. It does not take long for the cavity inside the asteroid to fill with a thick dusty fog — further recovery of the flogiston from the crumbling ruins will take more time.

ecb9ea0d-31c3-4300-9e62-3941ee7fe4fd.Text: Under the squad's withering fire, the sandy buildings quickly fall apart one after another. Soon after the cavity inside the asteroid is filled with dusty fog, and in only a few hours the unknown xenorace's entire city crumbles to dust.

44e4cc47-d09a-48ef-beca-141c53543047.Text: The exploration team turns to flee, leaving their tardier comrades at the mercy of the gigantic beasts. While the horrid monsters' powerful mandibles sickeningly crunch and mash their bodies into a bloody paste, the majority of the squad successfully escapes to hide in several already-explored tunnels. Once the rattle of the last xenoform's mandibles finally fades away in the cavernous depths, the squad cautiously advances further.

af1529c5-d7e2-4eed-aa17-6c34e6498a5d.Text: Even in decay, xenotechnology is terrifying.

b34440d8-0a04-4482-b460-08969e5bbe19.Text: Confusion reigns among the voidship's augur operators: the unidentified emission keeps disappearing then reappearing on their scanners. At first it seems that sandstorms are to blame for this, hiding the source of the radiation. A team of explorers easily overcomes these storms and begins studying the surface.

59af6275-cd36-4cc9-bff7-9d7aa4cef01b.Text: Magos Haneumann volunteers to lead the observation team. His passion for the xenos' devices borders on heresy, and he takes a long time after his return to report to the Lord Captain. Later, Pasqal admits that he is discouraged by the gap between the scientific accomplishments of the xenos and the capabilities of modern Tech-Priests.

8b37a02c-b24e-40c2-8604-feeaac44bc12.Text: Such inquisitive appetite finds no approval from Interrogator van Calox. Though Heinrix agrees that understanding the enemies of the Imperium well will improve the Imperium's ability to destroy them, he fears that unprepared minds may become victims of their own curiosity and fall into heresy.

09dd1ef6-0bbd-4e60-86b7-953d9c712c6f.Text: Marazhai is so impressed by the murderous forms of the constructs that he proclaims his desire to possess such an instrument himself. Once the Drukhari learns that bringing one of the devices aboard is impossible, a sigh of genuine regret escapes his chest.

ec0e84ad-a490-4cdb-93f5-365169fc4f14.Text: Yrliet recognises the weaponry of an old foe in the descriptions of the discovered mechanisms — Necrons, now a part of the mythology of her people. This enemy is too old to truly frighten the Aeldari, but the shadow of an ancient contempt, burned into her very blood, passes across her face.

fa4b902f-dcdc-4c22-8dd3-b3d3fb524142.Text: Prolonged observation brings almost no results. The only thing that the Rogue Trader manages to understand is that the xenotechnology disturbs the integrity of realspace, so observing them from up-close is a bad idea.

42b981a8-0849-47f0-ab95-fce7976bccba.Text: As their accounts suggest, the planet remains littered with broken and mangled ruins of xenos origin. Insect-like constructs flicker among the ruins, like static on a malfunctioning cogitator. Their black, metallic bodies are equipped with grappling blades which bring to mind the spindly legs of spiders. With each occurrence, the devices look more and more distorted, bent, and sometimes even appear directly in the remnants of walls or overlap each other. The only stable thing in this structure is a deep hole with a melted rock at its centre. Whatever purpose this structure served for the xenos, the meteorite destroyed it long before the arrival of the Rogue Trader.

5a447981-8ea3-4e7b-9187-969a75ab05ec.Text: Send a team to examine the object.

af66a76c-d222-4656-a3c2-fdb9935c1999.Text: It is hard to believe that a civilisation capable of creating a device as powerful as this one could have undergone such a decline.

4b5a8e28-e8eb-4103-869e-437a9855367c.Text: The greenish glow of the gigantic ring, made from unknown materials, flows through the windows of the captain's bridge. The voidship's instruments measure a whole spectrum of various emissions. Sometimes the dull green is darkened by clouds of space dust or bent by gravitational waves. The object most closely resembles a portal, albeit what's passing through it cannot be clearly defined.

c5e57b84-8d7a-4ec0-9db4-95fe46cfc750.Text: Additional equipment and a closer position allow the team to understand part of what's happening. The portal seems to resemble the gate devices used by the Aeldari and Drukhari, only made of a different material. The metallic shine of the ring alternates with the darkness of the large blocks of stone, reminiscent of the material that makes up the famous Cadian pylons.

7755fc52-bf41-496a-a3c2-7a545435ae28.Text: Analysis of the wave signatures indicates that the construct once used parts of the Webway — the Aeldari system of pathways. However, in its current condition the portal is not fit for transporting vessels: it is unstable and often begins unleashing dangerous cosmic objects. Instead of transports, the gate spews forth darklight waves and deadly breaths of incandescent gas, the latter taken from a star's photosphere.

34af7d0d-ec84-40d3-b6db-c4d5341973df.Text: The pilot of the exploring vessel does not successfully escape a powerful wave of incandescent gas. Part of the team perishes as a result of damage to their compartment, and the vessel itself barely returns to the von Valancius flagship.

1fd2dca0-7d68-45c3-9a76-cbace574e26c.Text: Arcs of incandescent star gases bursting from the ring pierce the darkness of space, reflected by the surface of other celestial bodies in the system. At times, darklight waves bend the edges of the portal, but they are quickly restored thanks to the enigmatic, flowing metal. Then, lashes of purple clouds, dissected by threads of lightning, appear in the centre of the ring. An unseen force prevents them from reaching the other side of the portal as the blocks of blackstone become covered in purple-scarlet illumination.

f149ef20-f01a-41c9-be1c-8c566f7b2783.Text: If the ring truly were a portal, it is not fit to serve as one any longer. Stellar heat and gravitational force forbid any vessel from passing through it. According to the ship's Astropaths, the purple clouds are an even more dangerous phenomenon, indicating that the powers of the warp are eager to flow out of the portal into realspace. As if to highlight its deadliness, with the next wave of darklight, the portal throws out the shattered remains of an unidentified voidship.

5120601f-0348-40aa-9ae2-8647aaf05f8e.Text: Signs of intelligent life are visible on the planet's surface. Judging by the burn marks left by thrusters and the remains of various structures, someone made camp here for several days. Distant silhouettes, far removed from the forms that subjects of the Imperium are used to, form a tangle of paths and obstacles — a maze. The crew notes other thruster marks some distance away from it, this time belonging to an Imperial shuttle.

21706c18-3691-414c-940b-319ef262563d.Text: "Very well. First, we shall find your pack, and then we shall return here."

b5f0d3b6-2200-4eb5-acff-8bbbc24f89ae.Text: "We will break through the mines and make a landing."

f9b9df3b-f341-420a-9137-f1b005c0007b.Text: "Transmit the deactivation code we found in the outpost of the Lord Inquisitor's men."

4f3cdbd9-e9f0-4c69-870f-a3633418f07c.Text: "What do we see on the planetoid?"

22685d6b-1321-44a6-a717-fbfe15efb16f.Text: "Commence preparation of the landing party. I will lead it personally."

d4f5cbe8-6d52-4278-a1eb-5cbd74b4d2c1.Text: "I am ready to face whatever lies in wait. We make the landing."

5b209823-198a-4b7c-9e4f-c4658b7372f2.Text: "The advice has merit. Postpone the landing."

b8f2d678-3503-479b-b891-4178d02770c8.Text: "We can track down your brothers after my business has been settled."

6ca5e5f1-861d-4ad1-a361-30bbabd1b90c.Text: "Farewell, then. Good luck to you in your search, warrior."

061f13f1-48ba-42c3-b82b-df70d509b378.Text: "Lord Captain, we've spotted a planetoid with an unidentified xenostructure. Something tells me this is the place we've been looking for."

d36434be-2da0-438c-ab26-ff188a133cc7.Text: "Augur-clerics detect a field of void mines on our trajectory toward the planetoid."

8a9431de-81b9-4ba5-b761-decd217d4914.Text: "We have limited data — our attempts at scanning are being hampered by strong magnetic radiation. The augur-clerics have only observed an oddly shaped pyramid and picked up a few encrypted vox-transmissions."

7b181a71-464d-45a7-8e43-df95f32ebbb2.Text: "It's hard for me to offer an assessment. I imagine Helmsman Ravor could tell you, but... ahem, I apologise, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I can only assume that these mines were left by the Lord Inquisitor."

f0f58fdc-4a24-432a-8107-c5d18e58347a.Text: "Good mines, I know from experience. Encased in ceramite under a coat of cameleoline, their cognidetonators are inhabited by the most malicious and cunning machine spirits you've ever seen. Far too good for pirates, and given that they've been planted for seven cubic kilometres, I reason that these are gifts from the Lord Inquisitor's own stores."

96899aef-756b-4c7c-993d-7351cfdbb735.Text: "Thank you, Aett-Vater. Your concern for our fate will not be forgotten by the Baleful Howl."

1717bbf8-71c5-4eed-80b4-fd1665cb05ba.Text: "It will not cost anything. At least, not to us. We'll withstand four, at most five blasts. There will surely be at least twenty. You see, these mines were placed here specifically to prevent such a breakthrough. We need a navigable channel."

1ee87808-35a8-470e-9a53-456ee399392d.Text: "Good luck in battle, Aett-Vater. I am sorry I cannot be there with you."

e36af554-2933-4abb-a47c-bd05492da4fa.Text: "Practically nothing — the augur-clerics say that magnetic radiation blinds the machine spirits. We see some kind of wicked pyramid and we're picking up a few encrypted vox-transmissions."

6f03ef00-15eb-4783-8a13-88eed6cfc702.Text: "Beginning transmission. Receiving return signal... Five percent of mines report a transition to sleep mode. Receiving coordinates of an area designated as 'main landing site.' We have a safe channel of approach toward Epitaph and coordinates for landing."

e5dd1a73-6368-42b9-8871-4e5f1876a6ba.Text: "Beginning transmission. Receiving return signal... Five percent of mines report a transition to sleep mode. Receiving coordinates of an area designated as 'main landing site.' We have a safe channel of approach toward Epitaph and coordinates for landing."

a65f2096-a77a-4d32-8292-33b8d2c46cef.Text: "Plenty. We're picking up the remaining vox-echoes of conversations, standard signals belonging to augur observation systems, the gas-thermal trails of shuttles preparing to land... You know, Lord Captain, it seems to me that this place is about to fall apart. Augurs detect a multitude of signs pointing to structural damage in the tomb located on the planetoid. And they are very fresh."

6deb0901-fedd-495d-9b8c-3d8345078b8b.Text: "Are you certain, Lord Captain? I beg your pardon for such audacity, but this old void wolf's gut tells him that this tomb is very likely to become ours. I have this bad feeling, as if... Forgive me, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I've completely lost my senses, giving out advice like that..."

59012146-13d9-45b4-bfe3-c3e323309c80.Text: "Be careful, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. We'll wait as long as it takes for your retrieval signal even if every xenofleet in the world appears to swat us from orbit."

b6847652-0e55-4aa0-a1ed-543200244a0d.Text: "Lord Captain, I dare not question your orders, but the mere thought of disembarking on this cursed place has knocked the deck out from under me. I beg your leave to recommend that you check your gear and general combat readiness before landing."

23765651-9878-42ac-8f2b-49fc0ad6e64a.Text: "We will await Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} and not leave orbit until you have assumed your throne on the bridge once more. May our prayers for your imminent return be answered."

c2209587-524b-449e-ad98-be94ae898ec3.Text: "I am sorry, Aett-Vater, but I cannot follow you. My pack's trail was lost somewhere amidst these systems, and honour calls me to find them. If you mean to descend to this shard of firmament, our paths diverge."

b6a21e55-83f9-4abf-bf40-3b3c3b516b8b.Text: "The spirits tell me otherwise. I cast the runes, and they bade me follow the sound of the Baleful Howl. Each of us bears the burden of the fate woven for him, and mine is now coiled around my throat, choking me, keeping me from going with you." {n}Ulfar frowns, bowing his head stubbornly.{/n}

499fa43c-0715-4bf6-bccf-b64df1773220.Text: "Lord Captain, we are observing a planetoid with an unknown xenostructure. I believe this is the place you have been looking for."

090b8d46-f51a-4380-949d-4cc1401d111e.Text: "A field of void mines has been detected on the approach. The augur-clerics report that they are not xenotech, but of human design."

c6e18ba1-a8e3-4241-aa88-8ef8baaa703e.Text: "Will be the least of our problems. The ship can withstand four or five blasts, but there are many more mines than that. I'm afraid the Lord Inquisitor foresaw this possibility and has taken steps to prevent a brute force landing."

29e75ef5-9973-4121-bac4-72c5fff26d96.Text: "Quite a few: residual vox-echoes of conversations, standard augur surveillance signals, and thermal trails from shuttles coming in for landing. There are also older... traces. Our augurs are observing extensive structural damage to a tomb located on the planetoid. The damage is quite recent. It is surprising that the structure hasn't collapsed already."

d098a7e6-cb53-4789-b79f-da0b7f0d28ca.Text: Send out a crew to explore the city's temple district.

e1864833-6b1d-4712-88a8-724b55a1ec31.Text: Order the scouts to gather as many supplies as possible.

1c20633d-2fd6-4c19-bb53-b240658f4ae7.Text: Drain the remaining fuel from the generator stations — the city won't need them anymore.

21cdcbee-b85c-4b23-818e-49fb81357f9d.Text: The ruins of an ancient Imperial city were discovered on a dead world completely deprived of an ecosystem. According to the reports, the entire settlement is contained in a titanic glass dome that once held an artificial atmosphere. Your augurs detected the framework of three other similar structures that were never completed. For whatever reason, the dome's systems failed, and left behind is this city, a ghost that never managed to become a proper colony of the Imperium.

d604f50e-1643-4ee7-a4eb-b0d017b75370.Text: It takes several trips to deliver the massive promethium storage tanks to your vessel. The crew grimly points out the colony was running out of fuel — had the life support systems not failed prematurely, the locals would still have perished due to lack of energy.

60744818-e966-4f5a-881e-7b5b237c2e55.Text: A lavishly decorated estate of the local ruler towers over rows of featureless bunkhouses. Several explorers perished from the cleverly hidden tripwires in the courtyard, but after losing their companions, the team easily disarmed the remaining traps in the estate. Anything of value has been promptly delivered to the Rogue Trader's vessel. The Lord Captain was even given an exquisite sword found in a secret cache that once belonged to the mansion's owner.

035b9f94-2942-4777-80d1-dbb1a80f811c.Text: Disturbing the city's slumber must have angered its long-dead inhabitants— at least, this is what the surviving explorers are now saying. At some point a crack appeared in the glass dome during a routine expedition. The scouts ran for shelter, but the dome shattered before they could escape. No longer held back by the protective barrier, the scorching rays of the local sun incinerated the settlement and your men within seconds.

4aa29904-df46-4612-ba7f-7b13b49e83f0.Text: The temple district is situated at the heart of the city. The God-Emperor's statue, intricately carved from precious crystal, is suspended beneath the dome, supported by chains of gold, and can be seen from anywhere in the colony. Inspired by the majestic sight, the expedition members set off to explore the area with renewed vigour. Soon enough, they stumbled upon an ancient weapon lying on a pedestal wreathed in sunlight. The expedition brought it back to the ship and told many tales about how the Emperor Himself, who had been watching them from above, had directed their attention to the sacred relic.

ed6eb829-f6b6-4c42-aeba-822daca2e2eb.Text: Your people flooded the city like a tidal wave, filled building after building, bunkhouse after bunkhouse, and receded from its quiet streets just as quickly. There were plenty of useful things among their findings, including foodstuffs and weapons.

d57b6567-8b25-4358-a053-b93b5a72f187.Text: Allocate a shuttle to Solomorne to search for the criminals.

2fcddbff-96bc-4a46-a0a2-e08fd6d3323b.Text: Send out a party to raid the outpost.

9082a9fa-6bfa-4510-9fbb-1496afbf4d29.Text: Agree to help in the future should you have the necessary resources.

09b9aa9a-be11-47cb-b006-e13f171838f8.Text: Supply the outpost with the provisions it needs.

b9e4ebcb-ea49-40d5-9afd-c6b641ab245a.Text: The cogitator screen highlights the shapes of several buildings. This small settlement, the only one on the planet, is a Winterscale dynasty outpost.

11477f90-ed41-419e-b1a5-646d83b35bcf.Text: Evayne Winterscale shares what he knows about the planet and the settlement. Despite lush vegetation, this world was deemed unfit for development — its resources are scant, storms are common, and most of the flora is toxic to humans. The outpost serves as a transfer point for Winterscale ships. Evayne points out that the early planetary exploration reports mentioned countless strange and frightening phenomena that were never really explained. However, the reliability of this information is questionable at best.

04f48873-c4f1-4dcf-905a-cf23e568b935.Text: On his return, the Proctor reports that the squad managed to locate the hatch leading to the underground hideout and force open the passage with explosives, but your people found nothing in the dark tunnels save deathly silence and the stench of rotting corpses. Solomorne surmises that the hatch jammed and the heretics met an agonising death by starvation, as evidenced by the complete absence of any provisions and their gnawed leather belts. The Arbitrator ordered the remaining supplies in the hideout to be loaded onto your shuttle.

5118e7f5-e198-4154-98d4-66069c594aef.Text: However, the fire has not yet had time to spread to the structures on the surface. There is sure to be something useful in them.

6bc45fb4-217d-4d8e-98e2-b2a4f49a01e0.Text: The custodian shares alarming news. The outpost is highly dependent on various deliveries from the core Winterscale worlds, but two ships have already failed to arrive on schedule. The locals do not have an Astropath of their own, so the custodian cannot determine the cause of the delays or request aid.

6b58c78a-e19e-4d87-934f-eec47abda35c.Text: Evayne looks concerned as he points out the resemblance between this situation and the food crisis Footfall is about to face. It may be a sign of serious problems in the Winterscale demesne.

783df876-9745-4834-a3fc-8e64c7444576.Text: The outpost will soon run out of food at this rate, so the custodian sends an urgent request for provisions. He is begging you for help, offering what little his settlement has in exchange.

70e70c2b-35d9-4323-aa5f-4c270beee40a.Text: The custodian thanks you dryly. There is obvious concern in his eyes.

d0aa4f8a-c593-4e13-8c26-37cbe1d788f7.Text: The custodian showers you with gratitude and hurries to send gifts in return. The formerly grim and worried faces of his men light up with relief.

8c92a835-99b5-4a09-a15c-0b1ea8e62024.Text: The return journey treats you to a rare and unexpected spectacle. An eclipse begins as one of the two local suns covers the other. You watch as the temperature drops, the lighting changes, and the double shadows vanish. The two discs in the sky merge, forming a shimmering oval and then becoming one. Eventually the fantastic event passes, leaving behind a vivid memory.

1701222f-8143-414f-840d-1cc052f967f5.Text: Evayne looks genuinely upset by your decision. He comments that although he has no right to judge his saviour, he considers the destruction of an Imperial settlement an act of barbarism.

d37abc1c-d301-40c1-8fcf-e561538fc495.Text: Your soldiers and officers take to the task quickly, efficiently, and seemingly not without pleasure. The shuttles return loaded with loot, leaving behind the smoking remains of the settlement.

f6938542-d538-4dda-a67e-fca5dabbfba2.Text: Seneschal Werserian privately informs you that such escapades are not uncommon among Rogue Traders. The settlements that belong to rival dynasties are often considered fair game.

4ffabdc9-202c-46d8-baf2-408233ffa01e.Text: The Winterscale dynasty outpost hails {name} von Valancius and thanks {mf|him|her} for the help. The locals are indebted to {mf|him|her}. Glory to the Rogue Trader!

4adebd54-ab45-4427-a6c6-e4b5409ae8ae.Text: After a lengthy descent to the planet, you are rewarded with a dismal sight. The entire outpost consists of long columns of uniform bunkhouses, machine hangars, and a large headquarters topped with the massive antenna of an ancient vox-caster.
