Sotto's Tomb became a sepulchre for the entire planet.

9eab1add-02b5-4fa5-a8d5-7c923fe34044.Text: Wake up the machine spirit of the submersible vessel and send a crew to retrieve anything valuable.

d5fa6cf8-8f6c-450f-b012-17788b4ed4dc.Text: Order the crew to explore the ship using diving gear.

1ea4c16f-51c3-4cf3-93a0-079743ab712e.Text: The Rogue Trader decides to leave the world and abandon the secrets of the xenoship with it beneath the ocean.

a0fe3d7b-92ab-43d9-b8b6-466dd4f5b545.Text: This oceanic planet resembles a boiling cauldron, the water temperature here never goes below one hundred degrees. Such an environment is favourable for the proliferation of billions of aquatic xenoreptiles, but aside from the peculiar amphibians the augurs fail to locate anything else.

26cbd1a8-c479-4eee-9ed2-a60e5d74aa9b.Text: The augurs detect a sunken xenoship on the ocean floor, confirming the rumours of its existence. After a brief celebration the crew starts pondering the best way to get to the xeno-artefacts buried at the very bottom of the ocean world.

8581cc34-389c-4bdd-9b92-ad3eaa7faf34.Text: Almost the entire surface of the world is covered by a layer of ice, hiding the emerald waters of the ocean. According to telemetry data, the temperature on the planet drops by a few degrees every decade, and the local water is bound to turn into emerald glaciers sooner rather than later.

397fb4b8-fb31-4af0-bb65-d9ee004fe0a5.Text: This world was nicknamed the "Aquarium Planet" by your officers. The augurs failed to locate any wreckage of the crashed Aeldari ship, but their operators were treated to a sight of bright coral forests and huge opalescent molluscs gliding serenely through crystal clear water.

bde2ae2e-cabe-46fa-9b46-ffcd1fa345c0.Text: Your crew's diving equipment is poorly suited for exploring such depths. Extremely high pressure, icy water, and failing courage lead to most of the divers panicking from headaches and full-body spasms. Two thirds of the divers perish halfway, and the remaining ones return with little treasure, thanking the God-Emperor for saving their lives.

2d200fb7-af50-4806-aa3b-a83d96ce29f3.Text: Before you lies an entire world covered by a black and lifeless ocean. The augurs find nothing of interest, the murky depths hold no traces of a sunken xenovessel.

f7246d3e-e32b-40d6-bb89-77e93f0c4bdc.Text: After a lengthy deliberation, Seneschal Werserian remembers Theodora von Valancius once paid a modest sum for a mobile submersible vessel. The underwater adventure it was intended for was unsuccessful, but the apparatus is still resting in one of the ship's cargo holds. Should the Tech-Adepts of the Machine Cult manage to awaken its spirits, the Rogue Trader's crew may explore the depths of the sea at their leisure.

0c434d41-2ed8-46e3-aad2-35fb3bb44ff1.Text: The enormous mechanism slowly rumbles to life under the binharic chanting of the Tech-Priests. Diving team Alpha-11 dives into the depths and comes back loaded with xenotreasures mere hours later. More crews continue to fill the belly of the submersible one after the other. Having spent about four cycles on this world, the Lord Captain's men return on shuttles bursting with artefacts that once belonged to the enemies of Humankind, leaving the skeleton of the sunken ship behind them.

139f1b47-c6a7-49a6-81f1-184fda35ca93.Text: Confiscate the cargo and leave the planet.

3ae4d3b7-a2df-42f0-98d5-93985bb7a6f9.Text: Even following the coordinates given by Ryzza, you barely manage to find the carefully hidden cache. A dilapidated statue of the Emperor stands among the ruins of a long-dead colony. At its base is a disguised passage to the cache. A cargo of sacred relics of the Imperium is found inside.

cce12a99-bd96-4949-823a-977da5da2937.Text: It is impossible to tell to whom the relics belonged before they were stolen by the pirates. Now these relics are yours. Among the loot you also find a cloak adorned with crimson lining, apparently once belonging to a member of the Adeptus Arbites.

082a1788-0de3-4f5e-8a11-75d572851e0c.Text: Proctor Anthar examines the cloak with great reverence and reveals that it belonged to Arbitrator Vhyr, one of the most esteemed servants of the Lex Imperialis. Solomorne adds that he knows of Vhyr, as he served on Port Wander, where the Proctor himself is from. This unusual posthumous encounter fills Solomorne with an almost religious enthusiasm.

0396af4e-a1b6-49ef-8d92-ac57d393b6a7.Text: Swift and merciless retribution is a proper fate for many transgressors, but the Imperium permits using the convicts for hard labour on distant prison worlds like Vheabos VI. To atone for their crimes before Humankind, hundreds of thousands of rogues and lowlifes toil in the mines of the von Valancius protectorate until death from exhaustion or some other unfortunate accident claims their forsaken souls.

eee2e0cc-8863-4eab-99cc-d4d573983600.Text: At some point the connection cuts off completely and you leave the foreman and his prospectors to wait for their real master.

07e3dda7-da45-4a9a-bf3d-33cb55f2e8d1.Text: This cold, windy planet is covered by a raging sea of mustard-grey grass so tall it reaches an average human's waist. The monotony of the endless steppe is occasionally broken by chains of murky green lakes, but the augur crew spots a far more interesting anomaly, a scar, running several dozen kilometres deep, splitting the world's equator in two.

97684da8-5367-47ac-926f-e25f46cded2e.Text: After two exploration watches, the crew intercepts a faint signal coming from one of the labour settlements in the deep chasm. Due to the unstable connection, the foreman mistakes your vessel for a Winterscale ship — one was due to arrive nine cycles ago. The foreman grimly reports over the weak channel that the adamantine ore deposits on the world are nearly depleted and that the planet will be fully mined out in less than a decade. With some difficulty, he picks up enough words to understand that the ship in orbit belongs to another Rogue Trader house, then awkwardly apologises and falls silent.

fdfbc888-b413-44e3-8d68-fdeac26590fe.Text: Evayne Winterscale is deeply concerned with the predicament in one of the oldest mining colonies of his dynasty. However, he is grateful to you for the timely opportunity to learn about the emerging situation and the missing patrol ship. He thinks he may be able to rectify the situation.

b6edd49d-9f20-41a8-9851-d5967ded7ee2.Text: Swear fealty to the King and promise to fulfil his request.

d1bfcbfb-7442-4996-8e60-692b794065c1.Text: Ask who you are talking to.

7359829b-3e0c-4c09-aac5-5e41fd6ceb6c.Text: Command the entity to release the minds of the Amberworlders from its grip.

a213c17f-7ed5-4491-8d2f-6c0920223df5.Text: Say you wish to become the herald of the King of Distortion.

da6d046d-7d50-4955-a526-de880e4966e7.Text: Attack the entity with every cannon on board.

078fb935-6fbc-425c-a50e-5a7747b8f98b.Text: Order a ship-wide, thousand-voice prayer service over holy relics for the protection of Amberworld, the Imperium, and your own souls.

0181d383-78d9-4c53-85a3-c3c76089d233.Text: Aflame with a plethora of colours, the distorted celestial disc trembles slightly beyond the endless windows on the captain's bridge as the Rogue Trader's ship approaches its centre. An otherworldly voice, cold and enveloping, enters your mind. What could this puny wretch possibly offer a King?

2f8c0c36-8fc5-4557-b636-c3498a18e1c0.Text: Acerbic laughter fills your head as the enormous distorted disc vanishes from the voidship's augurs as if it had never been there.

cfa11dfb-adbb-41ea-a60f-74a50f83c498.Text: Deafening gong strikes are heard across hundreds of decks. Your eyes are misted with red and your gums bleed as your subjects fall to their knees all at once, in a shared prayer to the God-Emperor. The holy relics from the ship's temples melt from the ardour of your speech, and the entity screams and writhes inside your brain, struggling to break out.

90690bca-d35a-43c0-9476-a929ea37cf75.Text: Many drop dead during the first minutes of the prayer, unable to resist the corruption; however, others immediately take their place, unfazed by the sight of their fellows turning to dust in seconds. Then a nauseating stench engulfs the ship's decks like a wave, causing people to retch forth their innards. Finally, every deck is plunged into darkness. Ghosts of the past walk among the living, stealing breath from those weak of spirit. And still the prayer is not extinguished.

75d69daf-dd63-42c0-9527-68be47811cbf.Text: An endless flow of images fills your consciousness. You see horrifying scenes of millions of tortured souls. Their screams rend your mind. Their pain pierces you with a thousand red-hot needles. King. Ruler. The One Who Is Obeyed. That's all you can make sense of, although you see much more.

eeb75b42-30fe-49b9-92ec-bd92d46439d8.Text: How dare you disturb the King with trifles? The entity is furious, and you feel a gust of invisible wind blow a thousand blades right through your ship. Officers are collapsing at your feet, choking, and hundreds of casualties are being reported from every deck. A resonant silence descends on the ship, and a bright flash stuns you for what could be any length of time.

9a18231f-9d5c-4bc5-9f52-eb95c329fb5c.Text: The King's mocking laughter rings in your ears, and a deep-red trickle runs slowly from your nose and over your lips, leaving an aftertaste of salt and metal.

19119702-e148-43e6-9e47-18f5473e6ab8.Text: The King is intrigued: never before has a mortal sought to obtain his divine blessing. All you have to do is claim ownership of Amberworld and not interfere with the events unfolding on the planet. If the King is pleased with you, he may even let you collect tribute from his playthings.

fc21ef2d-3c36-4d96-9964-ddeb0147f9b6.Text: The officers on the bridge look around, perplexed. Their eyes are full of terror and confusion. Many clutch their heads and let out long howls of pain. Some empty their stomachs. But most, pale and exhausted though they are, have joined the Lord Captain in resisting the entity's influence.

72224317-9afb-45ca-869e-e0b1ffff4960.Text: Interrogator van Calox coldly reminds you of the Archenemy's schemes... and the laws of the Imperium under which even Rogue Traders, heralds of the Emperor Himself, can be punished, should they descend into heresy.

cd413559-5d9b-4946-a671-b4610a3fa3f5.Text: It is hard to tell if the prayer service has lasted several hours or several days. At some point, you feel your very essence overflow with heat and power, and then... the intruding will falters. The distorted disc vanishes from the voidship's augurs, as if it had never been there, and at long last, everything is quiet. As everyone slowly recovers from what just happened, reports begin to come in to the captain's bridge. You've lost a third of your crew in the unequal fight, and the fortunate survivors are going to take quite some time to come round. All hail the Rogue Trader!

ee30b107-2429-4c8a-ae84-847e7ad5e6c1.Text: Destroy the xenoships with a salvo from the voidship's weaponry.

4a0cd87e-44d6-4590-8bd2-ad8b55abc135.Text: Let Marazhai fly to the xenoships on a shuttle.

e7e56e6d-4bc8-4942-aa1e-6c79fcf19d2f.Text: Fly closer to determine the ships' affiliation.

b08a5199-30b3-440d-933f-a9e0a1c8a079.Text: Agree to help the xenos in exchange for a generous reward.

00c3c78b-a779-4dcc-8218-351825ee0f2b.Text: On the edge of the system, a few crippled xenoships barely visible in the darkness of space huddle together. Not displaying any of the usual hostility, the xenos are stuck in inactivity, entirely ignoring the Rogue Trader's presence.

c7efaff8-f98f-41ba-a57c-4a0c1ccb8bfc.Text: Marazhai recognises the vessels as those of the Reaving Tempest Kabal by their silhouettes and markings. The news that his Kabal's warriors survived their insatiable kin's bloodthirst fills the xenos with a grim resolve. Marazhai turns to the Rogue Trader with a demand to leave the detected ships unharmed — the xenos yearns to meet them in person.

e06217b6-27fa-453e-ba73-3695a077ccb2.Text: The augur team has detected a number of damaged voidships, each afflicted with several system failures and bearing a few dozen living creatures. An attempt to identify their drive signatures is met with failure, but the scanners pick up an exchange of data between the ships along an encrypted channel.

d77b8162-de9c-4847-8f0a-3311c073a272.Text: The darkness of space is torn by a sequence of white and red detonations which rapidly consume the xenoships. Moments later, the only thing that remains of them is but incandescent debris, chaotically drifting in the gloom.

5821ed08-05a3-4f20-a82e-6abd5f9594e0.Text: With the clicking of levers and toggling of switches, the Vox Master transmits a message to the xenoships but receives no response. Be it an equipment malfunction or deliberate disdain, the xenos disregard the Rogue Trader's hail.

bd808823-d276-4cbc-b3ae-a7a213172e67.Text: The shuttle carrying Marazhai returns so quickly to the Rogue Trader's vessel that it is impossible to tell whether the xenos took part in failed negotiations or participated in a violent and impetuous duel. Offering no comment, Marazhai turns to the Lord Captain with a categorical request — help the survivors and let them go.

6337e6f8-c207-4bca-9e95-6147a34e340c.Text: The frozen ships break into a hectic flight. As if not wanting to shorten the distance to the Rogue Trader's flagship, they attempt to fly further away. Before the ravaged ships again reach a significant distance, augurs identify their drive signatures — the ships belong to the Drukhari.

365f93a9-fcf0-4f7f-bf83-0ad2193652bd.Text: The frozen ships start moving. They scatter away from the Rogue Trader's flagship, avoiding it as best they can, as if wanting to keep their distance and remain untouched.

264ef310-f1ff-488a-844a-116e5b7c3eef.Text: The xenos accept the resource shuttles, arrogantly maintaining vox-silence and showing no gratitude for the Lord Captain's generosity and aid. With the resource transfer concluded, Marazhai returns aboard with bloodstains on his armour plate — according to him, the meeting was successful.

45dba6cf-bf51-4343-b803-1813bdf2d59b.Text: Paying no heed to the vessels of his Kabal as they dwindle in the distance, Marazhai's glares at the Rogue Trader with flaming intensity, speaking more expressively than any word.

7e5b944a-b74a-463d-98ef-a01ea5fa5de0.Text: Watching the fire consume the Kabalites' vessels, Marazhai hisses odious xenos curses so complex and savage that the Lord Captain's Elucidator is incapable of making any sense of them.

a27959db-bb04-41c7-9660-5fe9de79801b.Text: Officers sent to oversee the trade alongside Marazhai report that the exchange was successful. Some uncooperative xenos were against it, but Marazhai's deadly hand took their lives before their arguments gained any weight.

cc3f56d6-25a4-4811-af4a-973a56c7edf0.Text: Enquire if the Explorators have goods to trade.

d69ec218-e4fb-46a6-b5d9-4069c465df61.Text: Give transuranium elements to the Adeptus Mechanicus.

240f2aa5-178d-4618-b0d1-9eec81de52e0.Text: Propose a trade of resources with the Explorators.

3213bd76-44bb-45ee-bf2f-319b1bb353b3.Text: [Test the ship's new cannons on the station]

c7f24ab9-8cdc-4c8a-9e72-ee9325939541.Text: Give the Adeptus Mechanicus the gas the crew harvested.

6cfd188b-ba8d-4548-8a81-074d61a4a677.Text: When the Rogue Trader's ship approaches the Adeptus Mechanicus void station, it is met with the hostile scrutiny of the station's defence lasers. An Explorator Lexmechanic who introduces himself as Service Unit 42 dispassionately enquires how the station can be of use to the Rogue Trader.

6820c681-8ba1-4ef9-8b23-bc56a3883fa0.Text: The onslaught of cannon fire from the voidship damages the Adeptus Mechanicus station in ways that trigger runaway processes in its life support and defence systems. One after another, the station's modules depressurise before the Lord Captain's eyes, but no survival craft carrying servants of the Machine Cult are detected. According to later reports, they all died trying to protect the priceless machines destroyed in the attack.

c5e3ce7b-8f73-4f0a-8f5a-7170c3f998b8.Text: As soon as the Rogue Trader's crew load the cannons and aim them at the station, the Adeptus Mechanicus's defence lasers slice the voidship's hull open, leaving a painful-looking scar that spans several decks. The station's guns keep firing until the Master Helmsman moves the ship a safe distance away. Its guns still flaring, the station no longer responds to hails.

f1deccb0-abd2-4e0a-8c9a-7e9371ef418f.Text: Pasqal utters an alarmed binharic trill. The Magos will not dare question the Rogue Trader's orders, but he leaves the bridge and goes into the bowels of the ship to pacify the agitated machine spirits. He does not return until the operation is over.

af51f893-774d-4967-b271-2a4600f51c59.Text: Upon consulting data from the station's main cogitator, Lexmechanic Service Unit 42 confirms that the station requires rare transuranium elements or natural gas for research of an undisclosed nature. For its part, the station cannot offer the Rogue Trader anything in exchange at the moment, but the Adeptus Mechanicus representative on Footfall will certainly repay {mf|him|her} for {mf|his|her} aid.

d504607d-1e8a-4402-b11f-47c1e672f2f6.Text: The upgraded cannons strike the station, leaving the Machine Cult adepts with no chance of survival. The crew is in turmoil — while jubilant officers are praising the new weapons, which will surely help the voidship on its future travels, others are asking if this show of force was really worth the lives of faithful servants of the Imperium?

fd266e56-5e4d-4f6b-a7e1-b64f56df32c2.Text: The station thanks the Rogue Trader for {mf|his|her} cooperation and remunerates {mf|him|her} with gold and securities.

27ae4a77-5233-4e4b-afc1-d2fac7957c8c.Text: Lexmechanic Service Unit 42 presents the Rogue Trader with a special missile that has been blessed in full accordance with Machine Cult liturgy and expresses his hope for future cooperation.

0e3d1098-7764-4c5d-ae6f-83d516a22f4f.Text: The station thanks the Rogue Trader for {mf|his|her} cooperation and presents {mf|him|her} with several containers of unused reserves as a token of its gratitude.

5d75b0b7-70c2-478a-81f0-1ba076782245.Text: Direct the vessel to the centre of the anomaly.

43a377c6-4e3a-428f-86ab-1386a40da24c.Text: Determine if the archives contain data on any such anomalies.

e29f8b2b-695b-4f5b-9336-7b188a92e8a3.Text: Cast fate to the wind and take no action.

62693517-d237-4311-8c76-a4e34c7bbf9d.Text: The endless canvas of the cosmic void is interrupted by what looks like... a bottomless hole. Sight cannot pierce it: no stars, no planets, no cosmic dust. There is only total darkness. The augur team has failed to glean any information from the anomaly, and under the influence of a mysterious force, the voidship is slowly drawn to the heart of the darkness. The officers on the bridge worriedly look up from their cogitators — the machines' screens turn on and off chaotically, not obeying any of their operators' commands.

ec2b1c60-ffe4-4bca-92ea-bad7829b7650.Text: The Rogue Trader's vessel slowly draws closer to the cosmic hole. The outlines of walls, equipment, and people inside the voidship are distorted as they flicker and stretch under the influence of an invisible force. The machine spirits are badly affected and start rampaging across the ship, disabling cogitators on every deck.

c04f1296-6561-4045-ab04-02c319f02dfa.Text: A few operators manage to wring a minute amount of useful information out of the archives. Such anomalies are extremely rare, randomly appearing gravitational wells which connect different points in space. Where such a well leads is impossible to predict.

ecbbc8bc-87d2-4be6-8ed5-35f37780d965.Text: The voidship's machines refuse to carry out their orders and shut off in response to every attempt to access a function. Terrified by the flickering distortions in their own bodies, the operators frantically try to find out at least some information about the phenomenon, but their attempts remain in vain.

46f7d34b-4338-4afc-af3e-88ae05468865.Text: The closer the vessel gets to the hole, the faster it is pulled in. Thousands of people on every deck are gripped by panic — their bodies are turning into thin, twisting threads, fraying and tearing into pieces, exposing veins, bones, and internal organs. Falling apart into screws, plates, and bolts, Tech-Priests continue to offer relentless prayers to the machine spirits, but their binharic chants melt into the endless screams and cries for help. Finally, the voidship jumps into the cosmic tunnel with a torturous lurch.

59f5f1b2-9459-415f-9c18-9bfc964b63c2.Text: Barely overcoming the anomaly's pull, the voidship crawls in the other direction. A nightmarish cacophony of moans, prayers, and the screeching of metal fills every deck. Thousands of people are gripped in panic — their bodies are turning into thin, twisting threads, fraying and tearing into pieces, exposing veins, bones, and internal organs.

602cf9ae-1d47-4e0b-8a2e-386302b0c40b.Text: The walls of the bridge, the crew's silhouettes, and the ship's holy machines tremble and stretch out like rubber bands. Alerts of malfunctioning cogitators and maddened chronographs come in from every deck, as do reports of indescribable hallucinations gripping the crew. While the Tech-Priests are trying to placate the machine spirits, helmsman Ravor reports that the situation is bad. Navigational systems are barely functional, and the invisible force is getting stronger and accelerating, ceaselessly dragging the vessel into its dark bosom. There is little time, and the Lord Captain must decide — leave the dangerous place or give in to the force and study the anomaly from within.

3d033277-5414-4097-a3f9-f3d63452e8a3.Text: By chance or by the Emperor's grace, the voidship successfully clambers out of the tenacious grasp of the anomaly. Its influence dissipates — onboard systems return to normal one after another, and the deformed bodies of the crew take on their original shapes as if nothing had happened. Now, the only reminder of the event is a dull muscle pain.

899779e6-f1a7-43ea-904f-7f558887a6eb.Text: Punish the enforcer who dared to mistake you for a serf.

a3b37d63-50ed-4d38-80d7-b217ab2eb592.Text: Order the woman to let you go, lest she incur the wrath of the Rogue Trader!

447f6979-af6a-4cd8-a211-231fdad22d8f.Text: Punch the woman in the face and run away.

9f4d5baf-b4b8-4e21-9adb-e02f7c1044bc.Text: Start climbing to the middle decks, using an old map on the wall as your guide.

a16028c5-b313-4379-bc5a-a797f6eb11b9.Text: Find a servo-skull messenger to inform the bridge of your whereabouts.

bd6d59e7-7425-460e-ad8e-cf09553a5ced.Text: Talk to the locals to learn about everyday life on the lower decks.

5026d56f-3e8d-4a76-9ecb-2c36a685d105.Text: Rob a guard post and contact Vigdis using a stolen vox.

6cc7eefa-3dbd-40e4-a804-4ccc2ba17af5.Text: Stop the officer: the enforcer was only doing her job. And doing it well, at that.

c5a05209-4204-488f-84b9-dd57ab3b3ecd.Text: Punishing a single enforcer will not be enough to redress this outrage against the Rogue Trader's person. You order every enforcer on the lower decks to be strung up.

05be7718-3f53-494c-8c4f-e8a62fd666a0.Text: Tell the officer to hurry up: you would like to be back in your captain's quarters as soon as possible.

5eab7964-21d2-455a-8b6b-3bb0dd38ecfc.Text: Teach a lesson to all enforcers on the lower decks.

7d249cca-23f0-4988-b002-21f031a2298e.Text: When the Rogue Trader's ship draws near the unidentified celestial body, the machine spirits on every deck, from the captain's bridge to the cargo holds, become frantic. The engines are refusing to cooperate, sending the voidship hurtling toward the epicentre of the anomaly like an arrow toward a target.

99a76987-1463-4658-86f0-0fdb448e5d77.Text: The Vox Master gives praise to the Emperor of Humanity as you make your entrance on the captain's bridge. Vigdis explains that you were trapped in an anomaly that made the people on the ship inexplicably trade places. A rescue squad was immediately dispatched to search for the Rogue Trader, but finding you took quite a bit of time. All's well that ends well: the Lord Captain is at the helm again, continuing {mf|his|her} journey through the Koronus Expanse. Long live {name} von Valancius!

3b7c831e-09f0-4cfe-84e5-f03be2c2db86.Text: Wails of despair drown out the din of the lower decks as a metal club crushes its victim's skull and bones. Dark splatters of blood mark the bulkheads, deck, pipes, and ducts, the very ones you were made to scrub not so long ago. His work done, the officer salutes you and bids you follow him to the upper decks. Home. You turn around to take one last look and notice the tattered denizens, armed with brooms and rags, industriously cleaning up the enforcer's gory remains, and praying to the God-Emperor for mercy.

a7c976a1-fa38-46ed-a746-c92c2a82d12e.Text: The enforcer barks out a gruff laugh, then spits in your face: a scrub{mf|man|woman} even opening {mf|his|her} mouth is beyond the pale, let alone claiming to be the Rogue Trader. Drudges have lost their tongues for less. To drive home her point, the woman brandishes a hefty knife, then tosses you into a corner where similarly ragged people are scrubbing the deck — according to the sign on the bulkhead, this is Bay Theta 54.

929f627d-b4cb-4789-ba14-23e618d1d2a3.Text: The enforcer tosses you unceremoniously into a corner where similarly ragged people are scrubbing the deck — according to the sign on the bulkhead, this is Bay Theta 54. The lower decks. You have work to do. You need to get moving.

e23f7082-eb01-40a5-9538-7a420b4b0416.Text: You wrestle out of the enforcer's grip with ease, punch the woman in the nose, turn around, and flee into the darkness of unknown passageways. After taking yet another turn, you look over your shoulder to see if you are being pursued, and you notice a sign on the bulkhead: Bay Theta 54. The lower decks.

18d64c42-6c57-4810-a95b-0eafc65f2659.Text: The enforcer intercepts your hand, laughs gruffly and hoarsely, then punches you in the stomach. Then the ribs. Then the back. And finally, the face. Before you can regain your footing, the woman tosses you unceremoniously into a corner where similarly ragged people are scrubbing the deck — according to the sign on the bulkhead, this is Bay Theta 54. The lower decks. You have work to do. You need to get moving.

96209f49-49a1-4509-9aa1-add57c50c1dc.Text: You make sense of part of the map, while also realising that it is woefully out of date. As you move toward the deck's major passageways, you encounter a dozen more maps, which have been corrected and relabelled. For seven ship cycles, you make your way upward, one step at a time... until you finally reach the middle decks. That is when an airlock blocks your path. Security will not be letting you — or anyone — through. After several hours of persuasion, lies, and threats, one of the officers allows you to contact a "relative" on the upper decks.

da58a4c9-75e8-4f73-8c9b-f2272a94ec66.Text: You struggle to make sense of the routes that were shown on the ancient map hanging forlornly on the bulkhead. Most of the passageways marked on it lead to dead ends, or the airlocks are welded shut and have been out of use for hundreds of years. Some stairwells have been replaced by lifts that go to modules unknown, while others are missing altogether. After a few days of wandering around, you realise you still have not left the bay you started in.

69a74a62-bb86-4731-a878-9f41b548608e.Text: It takes you several attempts to catch one of the servo-skulls zipping around the bay. You scribble your approximate coordinates on one of the scrolls in its mechanical claw. The code, known only to the highest-ranking officers, ought to convince someone from your retinue to send help. After giving several commands that can only be issued by the Lord Captain personally, you release the servo-skull and it zooms upward, disappearing into a ventilation shaft.

0a31e411-1e66-40ec-bafb-60f16be8d2ee.Text: The servo-skulls are quicker than the Rogue Trader imagined. You chase one all over the unrestricted areas of the lower decks, only for it to slip through your grasp every time. Noticing this odd behaviour, one of the enforcers cuts your chase short with a blow to the head. Through the narrowing aperture of your rapidly swelling eye, you see the servo-skull disappear down a half-lit corridor.

7231db90-4fb3-41a2-a80b-0fb125c8da61.Text: The locals offer friendly smiles as soon as they see you. Perhaps it is your appearance. Staring hazily back at you out of a glass bulkhead is a shaggy, sooty-faced, worn-out vagrant in rags. A face not all that different from those of your new friends. At any rate, no one is trying to hurt you. You are told a couple of amusing stories about local life, the almighty Lord Captain, and the monsters that frighten people every now and then when the entire ship shakes and red lumens flash overhead.

bbfcabf8-0fd8-4d8f-8d6c-6a743cd4e4c4.Text: Even the locals shun your company. You have failed to talk to a single person all day: people either look away silently and walk faster or recoil in disgust as soon as you approach them. Perhaps it is your appearance. Staring hazily back at you out of a glass bulkhead is a shaggy, sooty-faced, worn-out vagrant in smelly rags.

14541855-4635-4606-9168-7decd190ca03.Text: You scrub the decks for several hours until a toothless old man calls out to you. You are handed a bowl of clear broth and a stale, mouldy piece of biomaterial — lunch. Then security herds everyone into an adjacent chamber to resume cleaning. And then another one. And another one. Until the final strike of the ship's gong marks the end of the watch. Might as well get some sleep.

e6dfccb1-f98c-416d-92c7-a0c519fce90a.Text: You have been studying the enforcers for several days now, observing shift changes, trips to the mess, games of regicide, and the aftermath of boozing sessions. On the fourth day, during a shift change, you sneak into their small room and find a vox-caster that someone left behind.

7830f5c5-a794-45ac-bef1-74af5ef4b0ad.Text: The ragged people, who have thoroughly enjoyed your pleasant company, walk with you to the bay supervisor's cabin. The workers ask the supervisor to report a stray noble from the upper decks. Your poise and manners do make you stand out from the humble denizens of the lower decks. When you are restored to the bridge, the Vox Master gives praise to the Emperor of Humanity and explains that you were trapped in an anomaly that made the people on the ship inexplicably trade places. A rescue squad was dispatched at once to retrieve {mf|Your Lordship|Your Ladyship}, but your friends from the lower decks have already helped the Lord Captain back to where {mf|he|she} belongs.

61816e1a-9408-4d6d-be25-cec5d3187cff.Text: Upon hearing your voice, the Vox Master gives praise to the Emperor of Humanity. Vigdis explains that you were trapped in an anomaly that made people on the ship inexplicably trade places. A rescue squad was dispatched at once to search for the Lord Captain, but you beat them to it and contacted Vigdis yourself.

07141ffc-522c-4ddb-a993-b902c41c9d40.Text: You had to wait several more ship cycles for the escort squad to make its way from the uppermost decks down to the very bottom. Informed about a "high-ranking guest" in their midst, the overseers of Bay Theta 54 tried to brighten your stay with passable food, a soft bed, and even warm water, a privilege not accorded to locals. Eventually, you see the familiar faces of escort officers who have come to retrieve you.

be093b08-8eac-4e89-8cf2-87ccf592dc5d.Text: Showing disrespect to the Lord Captain is an unforgivable oversight, even if {mf|he|she} appears in rags before {mf|his|her} servants. You give the order, and a dozen servo-skulls scatter across the compartments of the lower decks, carrying out your punitive verdict. And while you make your ascent to the voidship's bridge, several hundred enforcers are driven into an empty compartment, equipped only with a mechanical "thousand-headed" gallows. One turn of the switch, and they all receive the punishment they deserve.

53e2e311-5b3a-4ec9-90e6-6284242937ee.Text: You awake after unsettled sleep to find yourself lying on a stiff cardboard mat. You are overcome with a strange sense of wrongness. The place is dark and reeks of body odour. Someone elbows you under the ribs and grabs you by the collar, spitting abuse. It is an enforcer patrolling the voidship. And she is clearly displeased.

b49c285f-3009-4608-9865-89e910bfaa20.Text: The fist raised above you cracks as it meets a metal club. A frightened shriek echoes off the walls of Theta 54. Pressing her broken wrist to her chest, the enforcer falls to her knees and lowers her head before the figure that is standing between you and her. In the dim lumen light, you recognise your defender: one of the voidborn officers from the upper decks. You have been rescued after all! The officer inspects your injuries and clenches his teeth as he raises his club over the enforcer. That scum is about to get her just deserts!

3945b12d-2098-4b56-97ad-5ef3be8f351e.Text: You awake after unsettled sleep on a stiff cardboard mat. The same pitch darkness and unbearable stench of unwashed bodies surround you. Someone trips over your leg and grabs you by the collar, spitting abuse. It is the enforcer on patrol. And she is clearly displeased. Again.

df28e938-55d4-40f5-8d3c-0c190b6ec74f.Text: Sombrely, the officer lowers his club and salutes you. Time to go home. And the enforcer, some of her hair freshly grey, stares after you in awe. She beats her brow on the metal floor in prayer, vowing to keep rendering faithful service for the glory of {mf|Your Lord|Your Lady}ship, may the God-Emperor shield you from adversity!

bd8683f3-eb5e-4127-b61a-c91ddac01284.Text: The officer folds his hands on his chest in the sign of the Aquila. It will be done. A dozen servo-skulls fly off to carry your stern verdict to the bays on the lower decks. And while you are completing your ascent to the captain's bridge, several hundred enforcers are herded into a compartment containing nothing but a "thousand-headed" mechanical gallows. One flip of the switch and all the lower deck enforcers will simultaneously pay the price for their incompetence.

d45e4072-f7c6-4683-836e-636ec7a2d342.Text: Aim the upgraded cannons at the asteroid.

33a44076-1ce4-46d4-872d-aab35ae1720c.Text: Craters are scattered all over the lifeless rock, marking frequent collisions with smaller celestial bodies such as meteorites. The crew hold their breath. Will the Rogue Trader do it? Will {mf|he|she} test the new cannons on the lone asteroid?

10e8f44b-d83c-4f80-b483-e582e8a5bbbc.Text: Inspired by the Lord Captain's order, the officers look on as the asteroid turns to cosmic dust in a few mesmerising seconds. Long live {name} von Valancius!

aa6b6826-f532-4f13-b69c-4fbe94ecd403.Text: The Rogue Trader's crew is never unprepared!

08458377-b554-4fe2-bd67-8cd216577f47.Text: You are facing enemies of Humanity — Aeldari, judging by the drive signature. It appears your sudden exit from the warp has greatly alarmed them. Brace yourself for an enemy attack!

50307ebc-523e-4fa6-a145-d209ef7e6808.Text: The Rogue Trader is familiar with the methods of the enemies of Humanity. They will not catch an Imperial vessel unawares.

227a555d-d861-41d2-a430-bee01f66e57f.Text: The xenos are going to regret this.

3e6ce325-d5e2-4608-aa92-040dae06b96d.Text: Open fire on the wounded ship.

c6e67594-6bff-4040-a3d6-60c9d4dff9d7.Text: Confront the Chorda fleet. The Aeldari must be saved!

dd80199b-d100-4be5-ad18-8891ccbfa61a.Text: The xenos that dared defy Humanity must be destroyed! Help Chorda's ships.

f67cea37-d3a0-4c20-b716-47b121a04c90.Text: Help Incendia Chorda's fleet — engage the Aeldari vessel.

769530df-21b8-4c11-96e8-c2e3894dcc5c.Text: Send a message to Incendia Chorda's fleet, ordering them to stop the battle.

fed59654-132a-4f99-84fe-a9d71f432f31.Text: Demand Chorda's warships cease fire immediately and retreat.

c8fdb8cb-9655-4c21-b44c-fd7678eca7ee.Text: Let Yrliet speak with her kin.

b94643a8-ec34-4cdd-b5cc-9b3b9484b3f0.Text: The xenos have been saved from Chorda's vessels — their future fate does not concern the Rogue Trader.

689ffda8-0efc-43ae-8334-8f34787f7e36.Text: Mercifully grant the xenos provisions and medicines.

7cb53e2a-2486-4da7-89ab-af71b5b3ca06.Text: Perhaps humans and xenos simply cannot coexist in this world.

6cc6469c-89ec-4cea-a497-853d76a01e4d.Text: Gracefully agree to help the xenos one more time and repair their voidship. After that, the Aeldari are free to do as they please.

53a9463d-82f0-4ea9-86af-bf71f9be543d.Text: Direct the Aeldari ship to Janus — the xenos can find refuge among their kind there.

a276d35f-80e7-48b8-b570-329927f7c27e.Text: Grant the Aeldari the Rogue Trader's protection by accepting them aboard the ship.

7f369167-1a0e-4a25-a8e7-d43131c0a638.Text: Ask Chorda's patrol for proof of the xenos' transgressions.

0274ec7a-66f1-42b1-998d-8f0511c0d4fd.Text: The Rogue Trader sends punitive squads to the lower decks to hunt those responsible for the xenos' deaths.

1d6d38d4-a781-4466-b77f-1bf6c8343f83.Text: A violent battle is unfolding before the Rogue Trader's eyes — patrol ships from the Chorda fleet are tearing apart two small Aeldari vessels. Once they are finished with them, the voidships give chase after the third, already damaged vessel, clearly with the intention of destroying it as well.

c99ef2b6-1a8c-4400-b931-91fa49b67e95.Text: Seeing the last ship's impending death, Yrliet calls out to the Lord Captain, her voice trembling slightly. Only the Rogue Trader's intervention can save her kin from the massacre.

fed604e5-e38b-43a7-ad5f-148b79a771cf.Text: The Aeldari accept their fate with forced humility. They do not resist, but neither do they appear uplifted by their rescue. They see their stay on a mon-keigh ship as imprisonment filled with uncertainty about what awaits them next.

1802911c-9e4d-4549-ba78-d88efa493c3d.Text: The Aeldari half-heartedly thank the Rogue Trader, not understanding what earned them the favour of the mon-keigh. As soon as the technicians finish the repairs, the xenos hastily leave the system.

47750757-34ae-4f2f-b78f-ac38d9527ad1.Text: Yrliet sullenly watches the unfolding chase through the stained-glass windows of the captain's bridge. She grimly concedes that no crime should go unpunished. Except her kin are... were flying transport ships. It would have been impossible for them to rob a ship, let alone launch a planetary raid — vessels such as theirs simply lack the firepower to do so. The mon-keigh are lying.

7e3bec5d-be43-42c6-ba72-b67a94881c70.Text: The Vox Master relays the Lord Captain's demand to stop the battle and soon returns with a reply. According to the Chorda ships, this group of xenos are malicious criminals. They are guilty of raiding this system's planets and robbing merchant vessels. Incendia Chorda's voidships are intent on performing their duty before the Emperor and exterminating the xenos.

93c4051b-11ce-432b-b0d7-0a52bd82b9ec.Text: Like most Aeldari vessels, this one seems quick, manoeuvrable, and well-armed. These xenos are entirely capable of plundering a small trading vessel.

a7dc53a9-b0f9-421d-8b59-32c7205ffc5b.Text: The patrol's captain reluctantly admits that there is no conclusive proof — this system is sometimes the target of pirate raids. However, this changes nothing, for His servants have no mercy for the enemies of Humanity.

0a6b0dec-6d3e-4ebc-9120-0526eecfaecd.Text: The patrol's captain is outraged by the distrust. A Rogue Trader's will must be obeyed, but the xenoships are currently on the border of the Chorda dynasty's holdings. Exterminating any and all enemies of Humanity on the protectorate's trade routes is a direct order from the Lord Captain, Incendia Chorda, herself.

ce0b32e4-407e-495e-8354-e59417becd72.Text: Unwilling to engage in open battle against the flagship of a foreign dynasty, the patrol reluctantly leaves its prey and retreats to the edge of the system.

dab5d52b-249b-4286-89e3-a828adc75c9e.Text: The Chorda dynasty patrol will defend the protectorate's borders — be it from invading xenos or from the threat of another Rogue Trader. Prepare for battle!

21275e1f-573f-4f17-8172-8a55df5b30a6.Text: Meanwhile, the wounded xenoship is rapidly distancing itself from the recent battlefield, attempting to hide in the shadow of the nearest world. Every attempt to contact it is met with frustration, and the Vox Master reports that the vessel is in deplorable condition — who knows how much more the xenotechnology can endure before the irreparable happens.

96c22c3d-b183-4302-9345-f196b547be65.Text: The Aeldari are too scared and resentful of the mon-keigh for the recent deaths of their kin to answer incoming hails. Despite this, Yrliet is certain that she can convince them to cooperate with the elantach if she is allowed to speak with them.

73f0b9b8-cda3-49b0-bf24-9c08f929bee8.Text: Two watches pass, and the xenos finally decide to answer Yrliet's pleas concerning the elantach's assistance. Guardedly asking how exactly the mon-keigh can help their vessel, the Aeldari note that the humans' primitive technologies are incapable of healing the Aeldari vessel's wounds. The sudden benevolence of one human is equally incapable of bringing back those who perished in the recent engagement.

5e7fe05d-ae25-4203-985f-88efe77e2190.Text: Trying to outpace the pursuit of the next mon-keigh vessel, the Aeldari overload their voidship's drives. One of the damaged engines is unable to bear the strain. Before the eyes of a hundred officers, the xenoship flashes a fiery light blue through the stained-glass windows as thousands of tiny shards disperse across the system

74bf7d5d-edea-4fd1-b5f7-2fc56a1cfabf.Text: Yrliet watches through the stained-glass windows of the captain's bridge as the minuscule vessel hides behind one of the system's worlds. How cruel the mon-keigh are. Having power over the destinies of others, they readily give hope for salvation one moment... and then take it away the next, leaving the suffering to their fate.

66f23464-a83a-4c40-a477-9f3426d43305.Text: The horrible news shakes Yrliet. She blames herself for the deaths of her kin and regrets the hatred of the mon-keigh toward her kind, a foolish product of fear.

e0913b97-c67e-4de5-9bef-26d57ae771b6.Text: The bridge officers openly rejoice, offering prayers to the Emperor — today the Expanse is cleansed of more filth, the enemies of Humanity. What is this if not His providence?

dc5213d1-ba77-4444-a00a-93c29e0d490e.Text: Yrliet appeals to her kin's wisdom, but the words of the Outcast cannot make them trust mon-keigh — the pain of loss fills the Aeldari hearts. Only recently did the humans destroy two vessels of the Children of Asuryan, and now they offer aid? Worse, they offer aid through the mouth of their captive sister! No. The Aeldari will not fall for this trick.

d7c75e3e-932c-41a6-ad39-e814ad758115.Text: After a few watches, the xenos' suspicions are validated. The presence of outsiders who filled the lower decks was perceived by ordinary people as an invasion of godless mutants. Shouting prayers to the Emperor, they rushed to depressurise the compartment containing the xenos alongside those who were "touched by the filth of the unclean."

37055be7-f7da-4155-94a6-8d29c62f0d34.Text: Yrliet can only shake her head: mon-keigh deaths will not bring her kin back to life, it will only spread even greater hatred. And the gap between humans and Aeldari will grow even wider.

ed18fa94-38e5-457d-a3e1-28187107b0a3.Text: As if guided by the Emperor's hand, the voidships adorned with the Chorda coat of arms surround the xenos. Deadly salvos erupt from their cannons and pulverise the tiny Aeldari vessel into lifeless debris.

61d1ca61-4185-4ed1-98ca-e91206489e2f.Text: By the Lord Captain's order, House Chorda's ships have been annihilated.

70c3a990-c40d-4c25-aa15-8d142a8c4c06.Text: Deadly salvos erupt from the flagship's cannons and pulverise the tiny Aeldari vessel into lifeless debris.

4f80e46b-52cf-46a2-be45-c1558154651c.Text: The xenos half-heartedly thank the Rogue Trader and turn their ship toward distant stars and inevitable death in the void. No words are exchanged on the bridge, but everyone understands that the wounded ship will never make it there. A few Terran days later, a blue flash at the edge of the system confirms the vessel's unfortunate fate.

9ea39574-630d-48b9-902f-791246fb20fe.Text: Yrliet's face is distorted by regret and despair. She found some of her kin, but what awaits them instead of salvation? Only oblivion. And what awaits her? False hopes and disappointment. Not wanting to watch the deaths of those for whom her heart aches, Yrliet leaves the captain's bridge, knocking down a few officers in her path.

dfe716c4-e9d6-4af4-8095-03ac536a331a.Text: Yrliet looks through the stained-glass windows of the captain's bridge, watching the shots tear the tiny vessel apart, pondering the cruelty of the mon-keigh. When they hold another's fate in their grasp, they grant the hope of salvation lightly... until suddenly snatching it away along with their victim's life.

9710322e-be39-4497-a9b6-bb7e29f13a07.Text: Despite the presence of some weaponry, the xenoship is more likely meant for transporting cargo or the xenos themselves rather than direct combat.

3eebde24-ba36-4b2d-bbe5-96214a5554ad.Text: And only the thin figure of the Aeldari stands motionless against the backdrop of the intricate stained-glass windows, mourning the fallen in solemn silence. Once the pain in Yrliet's soul is numbed, she turns to the Lord Captain and nods — a short gesture of gratitude for their attempt to save those who could hardly be saved.

c5da172a-365e-4818-9c55-434980703bf1.Text: [Attack] There can be no negotiations with xenos.

3b8dec68-fb0c-49e4-bb3d-073184add84f.Text: Ask Yrliet to help with the negotiations.

bc2fac41-f034-4284-bf59-18fb8f748008.Text: Threaten the Aeldari with savage reprisal if they do not let the ship pass.

f2be0e6f-a330-41c6-875a-8cfde8799a13.Text: [Attack] Fire a torpedo at the nearest Aeldari ship.

c92c2bb1-b719-445e-aa8d-1a38d7388f11.Text: Flee from the looming battle into the warp.

bf15f554-bd9f-476a-a91f-b77997ab2104.Text: The Rogue Trader's voidship is facing several Aeldari scout ships. The xenos are in no hurry to attack, and time seems to have slowed down: one wrong move and carnage will ensue.

2cae991b-8cf4-4c05-bcd6-4f29e7f9205d.Text: Yrliet's speech is met with a torrent of Aeldari abuse that is too much for even the Rogue Trader's Elucidator. The xenos accuse her of betraying her kind by conspiring with the mon-keigh, and unceremoniously cut the connection... yet their ships are no longer blocking the way.

d2abf750-f7c2-48c2-bb2a-1ac33cc97f89.Text: Yrliet's speech is met with a torrent of Aeldari abuse that is too much for even the Rogue Trader's Elucidator. The xenos are enraged by the fact that one of their ilk is not only serving the miserable mon-keigh but even trying to talk her own kind into committing such disgrace. Conflict now seems unavoidable.

1d57578d-7200-40c5-b7e5-af3bac4e4b26.Text: The Lord Captain's formidable speech is greeted by silence from the vox-systems, but the enemies of Humanity let the voidship through.

83072569-af72-43d0-9464-00cb87cbd6ec.Text: The Aeldari are silent. Perhaps they did not understand the meaning of the Rogue Trader's words, or perhaps they are simply ignoring the threat.

d0c6d25a-f33e-47c3-8b3b-8581d167a0a6.Text: The Aeldari accept the mon-keigh gifts with suspicion, meticulously inspecting each of the offerings. Without a word of farewell, their ships retreat swiftly, clearing the way.

41a37f20-bb38-4cca-b12a-750d03bb3581.Text: Take the initiative and attack first.

331bed8b-e9c9-4a22-9576-e23dcac4b3dc.Text: Flee from battle into the warp.

b1ff8656-fe91-4e8c-aca8-80a6f6b67d92.Text: You are facing enemies of Humanity — Aeldari, judging by the drive signature. The enemy is attacking, get ready!

d953c7ae-b1a4-438b-92db-c09f1c5bcbfc.Text: You do not negotiate with heretics.

43f1adb4-63c7-49da-a390-4f39f5557269.Text: Give the order to turn the ship around.

995aded3-ca76-457f-9535-35c9b18ff504.Text: Death to the heretics, for the glory of the Emperor!

c6801c25-46cf-4298-9281-d67ca6e1bf7f.Text: A wave of angry whispers passes over the bridge as the Archenemy's minions train their weapons on you and prepare to attack!

2d8034ba-664b-4d9a-abc6-add79f9c91ab.Text: You are facing Chaos worshippers. It seems their ships have been lying in wait here. The Vox Master reports an incoming transmission.

0f571104-fd60-435d-aa1a-8630067e5ad5.Text: You give orders to start the manoeuvring thrusters and calculate, adjusting for the gravity fields of nearby celestial bodies, the optimal trajectory through the enemy voidships. Alarms blare and cogitator keyboards clatter frantically as the officers chart the course and pass the data to the Master Helmsman. The crew is elated: the enemy ships can be evaded with no great difficulty.

713e80bf-c254-469d-a53c-7fc31da70814.Text: No sooner do you give the order to power up the manoeuvring thrusters than the enemy ships fire a salvo and accelerate to block the voidship's path. The crew is preparing for battle!

8caa3394-f52d-41b9-b6d6-0a105db60e4f.Text: A bloodcurdling, visceral scream from the vox-caster deafens the officers on the bridge. Frightened and pale, they cover their ears with their hands to carry on working despite the impulse to vomit. A mocking inhuman voice giggles hysterically, "ToDaY iS tHe DaY yOu DiIiE!" — then the transmission ends.

1b4c3805-f9d4-4fad-bd7c-cfa5524be72a.Text: It seems... the shadows on the bridge are laughing at your decision. Are you the only one who can hear them?

53aca963-d71a-4616-bd5b-20380e46d963.Text: Inform the pirates that daring to threaten a Rogue Trader will not go unpunished.

671b2374-b6ef-4f92-86fd-5aeaef6cec73.Text: Attack the nameless ship first to gain the upper hand.

c4241d10-2969-4b71-86e4-3069c33e5682.Text: Pay off Xantha La Bouche with weapons.

62d00b05-b78c-4ab4-bef4-9f8142fd788a.Text: Pay off Xantha La Bouche with fuel.

f83b46d7-de1f-41ca-83a2-9febc715f4aa.Text: Order the Navigator to flee through the warp.

333b5e22-5860-48d1-8bdb-98919d118d0f.Text: Pay off Xantha La Bouche with provisions.

8ec2b79a-c764-4940-ab2b-ac49c13ebbe6.Text: Pay off Xantha La Bouche with equipment or implants.

6f02b3b6-1366-4bdf-98cf-f37a24ab2811.Text: Pay off Xantha La Bouche with garments.

4a70632d-c210-4822-9a92-fc41cd25eccb.Text: Lie that you have nothing to pay with.

91e21edf-6b84-43ce-b0d7-b14361a5d7a6.Text: Confess that you have nothing else to offer.

c012e9fa-a8dc-4080-8d40-acbbcee2b1e7.Text: As soon as you draw close to the unknown ship, it points its loaded cannons directly at you. Several other ships emerge from the shadows of drifting asteroids, tightly encircling you. Captain Xantha La Bouche offers a mocking greeting and a proposition: you can buy your way out of this, but the price must be to her "soul's satisfaction." The outrageous suggestion sends your crew into a fury. You are in a no-win scenario: you can enter an uneven fight and lose everything, or shamefully pay to save your skin, sacrificing only your pride.

649b5b1a-8bb7-4f33-93c4-f51259b3c526.Text: The captain laughs merrily upon receiving your gifts. Her "soul's satisfaction" has improved slightly, but not enough.

776a16e8-a8a4-408d-b64b-cb653e689c7b.Text: Satisfied with the deal and your meek obedience, Xantha La Bouche bids a pompous farewell to {mf|His Lord|Her Lady}ship the Rogue Trader, and retreats swiftly into the warp along with her lackeys.

a7863fd6-d624-47bf-8c89-dd8fb950c0ec.Text: Captain La Bouche makes her displeasure quite apparent but acknowledges that it would not be in her interests to cross the Rogue Trader. The nameless ships retreat swiftly into the warp, leaving you alone.

ad87163f-c7bb-409e-89ec-8af5bb3442be.Text: Captain La Bouche reacts to your threat with condescension. You may be a Rogue Trader, but no title can protect you from a bullet, let alone macro-cannon fire.

183db31b-1ff5-4ce0-ba32-c888faef6ad4.Text: Your crew is completely unprepared for the jump. Even a carefully planned shift into the Immaterium is fraught with consequences, and right now you do not even have time for a short prayer service. Your officers do not question the suicidal orders they have just received and set about issuing commands, while the Sanctum Navis is filled with the screams of those who were not quick enough to leave the Navigator's chambers before the start of the flight. A bright flash, nausea, the familiar heaviness — and the loathsome pirates are now behind you.

dfdd7be2-4fb6-419e-8c96-20a77d39cccd.Text: As soon as your crew starts the warp engines, several salvos pierce the hull of your ship, dealing colossal damage to many of its bays. As the engines give out, Captain La Bouche merely dons a condescending smile. This bird isn't leaving the cage until she decides it.

904c27a4-4a3e-4f40-8cec-33b06f6efc33.Text: Captain La Bouche makes her displeasure quite apparent, but admits that killing penniless Rogue Traders isn't her style. The nameless ships retreat swiftly into the warp, leaving you alone.

7cfc29d1-6b37-401e-aa77-dec61547243f.Text: Captain La Bouche is livid. What kind of Rogue Trader is too poor to even be extorted? You have really, really upset her. Prepare to pay with your life!

e015c968-3977-49ad-995a-d6cd56c6f9f9.Text: Captain La Bouche wonders what you could possibly surprise her with.

c6f7b8a0-3cd0-4022-8df9-41d4ea5fceb7.Text: Captain La Bouche hints that she does not like to be kept waiting.

564a6da5-428f-4e76-8038-8f301ef0f2bb.Text: They dare to attack a Rogue Trader — prepare for battle!

4fef6f94-7b00-43e2-9019-9510e067a71d.Text: Don't let the insolent pirates escape — fire a broadside at the Elusive Contempt!

664e84c8-d3b7-4954-be7d-331da13b928c.Text: It's pointless to chase the fleeing voidship. Prepare to battle the escorts!

be72f8f0-9928-4ff1-92e3-35b6da85d06f.Text: The Elusive Contempt mustn't get away! Chase the flagship.

70ad49bd-865e-4975-96ab-f983ff467ec7.Text: It's time for the Elusive Contempt to pay for its insolence. To battle!

8766a602-2f19-4bbb-b76a-1b47aa4e8ac5.Text: A chase is ensuing behind the stained-glass windows of the bridge — several pirate raiders are trying to catch up with the cruiser, fruitlessly firing salvos at it from their macro-cannons. The officers of the augur crew report: they're chasing the Elusive Contempt. It's a legendary pirate flagship that has been plundering cargo ships around the Expanse for several hundred years, masterfully evading patrols and escaping unpunished with the loot.

2d22d986-a554-4083-9c28-3173b7fd8d34.Text: A pirate flotilla has gathered in a system with an especially prosperous extractium. The augur crew reports that all of the voidships share their signatures with the Elusive Contempt! You hear a familiar cheerful voice from the vox: Shelby the Protospeculator sighs theatrically — you're hot on his heels, coming between him and his fortune. The cargo ships are just about to take off from the bountiful planet, but the Rogue Trader {mf|himself|herself} wishes to rudely interrupt their plans.

1c6695f3-ff85-4ea6-a365-0770b09db32a.Text: Starboard batteries light up, firing a salvo — the missiles reach their target! Despite a direct hit, the Elusive Contempt manages to slip away once more, though it won't recover from the damage anytime soon.

a8d937d5-fd5a-46d5-99fc-1b6e0854905d.Text: Starboard batteries light up, firing a salvo, but the missiles fail to reach their target: the warp swallows the Elusive Contempt leaving you surrounded by Captain Shelby's lackeys. Prepare for battle!

e92aa05a-bed6-4926-af7d-417c75f1f0c2.Text: The Elusive Contempt's captain contacts you. You can hear notes of disdain and mockery in his voice — playtime is over, and he's sure he's going to come out on top. After the Rogue Trader's death, the von Valancius protectorate will become his playground, where he'll claim plenty of booty before someone dares hunt him again. The bridge officers report: the Elusive Contempt is preparing for battle!

a531f8b8-a64f-4f2b-8415-ce6831a3cb3d.Text: Shelby the Protospeculator, the Elusive Contempt's captain, addresses you via vox. In a cheerful, almost affectionate voice, he thanks you for the high-grade resources mined by the von Valancius extractiums and also for your invaluable assistance in his escape.

86ec145a-6c33-4832-a7a3-13aaf114ec3d.Text: But that's quite all right — Shelby sounds thrilled by the sudden competition. The Elusive Contempt's captain is ready to wait for the next opportunity, and for now, he'll leave you in the good company of his friends. You see the pirate flagship beginning to manoeuvre to escape into the warp.

20a1e88f-da5a-4f2f-abcd-2b5c64fdf237.Text: The engines are at their maximum capacity, and the crew are trying their best to catch up to the insolent pirates, but... before you can reach it the warp swallows the Elusive Contempt, and the remaining pirates surround your voidship. Prepare for battle!

4218f96f-fcec-483d-8eff-f3503c29a169.Text: As soon as Shelby finishes his speech, the Elusive Contempt swiftly enters the warp, and a powerful salvo intended for his vessel explodes against your voidship's shields instead!

382a0fb2-eac7-4aa6-a30d-1fcc76643e49.Text: Don't let the Lightseeker attack first. Take up an advantageous position and engage!

c7a0762c-e85c-453d-ad47-17c30ea0c298.Text: A strange vessel enveloped in a pale orchid mist sails past the stained-glass windows of the captain's bridge. A familiar coat of arms appears on its thoroughly dented, ragged hull... The House von Valancius coat of arms. The augur crew reports that this is the Lightseeker, an expedition voidship tasked with exploring the planets of Koronus Expanse. This vessel disappeared without a trace over six hundred years ago. The telemetry shows that the decks are empty and devoid of life with no crew detected.

a0d95356-1619-4696-9397-d31705ccdfc9.Text: While closely watching the Lightseeker's manoeuvres, your Seneschal becomes certain: the vessel is preparing to attack. Abelard has heard a lot about bountiful worlds discovered by the voidship's crew, but he doubts the same brave voidsmen are at the helm now. Whatever dark powers are controlling the vessel, one thing is clear — it's a threat. The Rogue Trader needs to engage the unknown enemy and recapture the property of the von Valancius dynasty.

b6eb4958-a22b-4c94-8bdd-08b61e1e0a35.Text: Ulfar is adamant that any voidship that has spent the past six centuries beyond the veil is corrupted beyond salvation. He says it must be destroyed at once.

cf70001b-40dd-4029-a649-87298fd54354.Text: The High Factotum, Janris Danrok, confirms that the Lightseeker is still a part of the von Valancius fleet. In other circumstances, the Factotum would have insisted on reclaiming the property of the protectorate, but who knows what had happened to the vessel during the centuries it was lost? The dark powers of the cosmos or even the warp itself could have corrupted the voidship...

f1472d3b-fe03-420d-b1e8-f179ea33b4c6.Text: The Vox Master reports that the elders of her clan told her tales about the Lightseeker. This legendary voidship has discovered plenty of bountiful worlds where the most profitable extractiums were later installed. This vessel brought countless riches to the von Valancius protectorate in the past, but its sudden reappearance after six hundred years of oblivion seems wrong and dangerous.

371839a5-ddef-423b-b931-6e8e06ad7c69.Text: Vigdis sends one signal after another, urging the Lightseeker's crew to establish contact, to no avail. This short delay is enough for the possessed voidship to assume an advantageous position as it prepares to engage your vessel.

c8f8ecc6-fdce-48d0-ab1e-6e94bb1be76e.Text: The sight of the ancient voidship causes a throbbing headache and inexplicable disgust. Where did it vanish for all those centuries, and how did it end up here?

e76e79ca-8113-4544-9e2a-2a262514a36f.Text: The worried whispers of the crew are silenced by an urgent alert — the ship is rapidly changing course!

f7af68d2-384b-47aa-9244-10a9a4657a6a.Text: The ship's crew is up to the challenge.

290d08ad-bbca-4d66-9b40-ac4af6382152.Text: You fail to get past the enemy ships unnoticed. The nearest Drukhari ship attacks at once. Get ready, others will soon join it!

f4982c0c-1fa8-44c9-bccf-0195f51c0b5e.Text: Calm the soldier down. He was probably scared by the strange visions and lost sight of his comrades.

7e93d15c-0b2b-4f1b-a832-864a22354e17.Text: The object doesn't matter. The scouts should leave the voidship immediately.

c7b83f81-3a32-4a1e-be0b-597cbcff8d47.Text: Order the squad to proceed under threat of tribunal.

c990aadd-183e-4bfb-b248-37abfee914bb.Text: Order the operator to pull himself together. Soldiers must be prepared to face even the most terrifying space horrors!

93c30425-6ab5-4d24-bac9-73a387d5361b.Text: Remind the soldiers that it's impossible to cheat death. These visions must be a product of some dark powers.

3a52c1f0-2cc7-4f31-adb6-be73f22c65c8.Text: Order the squad to retrieve the unknown object and withdraw immediately.

5c201260-da4f-4e2a-990a-e5aeae1bb1ee.Text: Coerce the operator — he will be severely punished if he does not pull himself together.

931ed4e5-d147-4393-b29b-ced84cab023f.Text: Let the soldiers stay with their loved ones for a short time.

19369fa9-4012-498a-a03b-71a4e697ca95.Text: All usual noises on the bridge cease when the shadow of a gigantic voidship, seemingly appearing out of nowhere, sails past the stained-glass windows. It seems forlorn — the hull is tarnished, the lumens are dead, and the windows are broken and shrouded. The augur crew can't recognise the signature of its silent engines. They only manage to shed some light on its decrepit hull and make out the faded name of the cruiser: Queen's Lament. The Vox Master's report breaks the sombre silence: the bridge has just received a vox-cast... from the dead voidship.

4525c7f9-11e4-4618-a92d-63538bd24d68.Text: The scouts begin to argue. The unintelligible quarrelling abruptly stops, and after a few minutes, the operator anxiously gives his report. As soon as the squad split up, the ones who decided to stay with their loved ones were swallowed by the darkness of the empty deck and... vanished.

9b3185fb-19b1-45df-9b8a-bf4bb0ed887b.Text: The Rogue Trader has never heard about this voidship nor of its grim legend.

bc8ad0f8-5702-47da-99c7-c43efbd5f655.Text: Half an hour later, the vox comes to life once again: the operator flatly reports that the scouting party has reached the bridge. The cogitators are broken, so extracting any data from them seems impossible. The scouts have found a strange object in the captain's chair — they can't describe it, only saying that "this" shouldn't be there.

fe32b70d-bdf7-4ed2-a08c-afb0633b828c.Text: The vox-cast stops abruptly, and a few minutes later, the scouting party's shuttle leaves the Queen's Lament. The voidship itself dissolves in the darkness of space. The shuttle arrives empty — no trace of the scouting party can be found, save for a strange parcel left by someone on one of the empty seats.

16a03f15-ebe9-4af1-ace1-79932ef1e0fb.Text: The Rogue Trader relays orders to leave the vessel alone. After a few moments, the grim voidship's visage dissolves behind the stained-glass windows of the captain's bridge.

7fbc0e01-9e87-478b-9bfb-823ff830931a.Text: The Rogue Trader's flagship takes an advantageous position, ready to engage the motionless vessel. A powerful salvo erupts from the cannons, but the missiles impotently pass right through the cruiser's withered hull and dissolve in the darkness of space. The Queen's Lament dissipates in the darkness and, with unnatural swiftness, appears at the portside of the flagship, gaining speed.

d8c5bfb1-6660-434e-a9c7-33825f12381d.Text: The shuttle carrying the soldiers docks with the Queen's Lament without impediment. Using the disparate blueprints of other Imperial cruisers, the scouting party sets out to the bridge, following the dark, unpowered corridors that somehow retained oxygen and gravity.

4eaa8a9a-8148-4005-ab70-0d120759d842.Text: The scouting party's disjointed mumbling is replaced by the firm shouts of "Yes, Lord Captain!". The operator reports that the deceased are retreating into the darkness, their empty eye sockets lit up with blue, malicious flames.

8c5ec620-17aa-4abd-b871-8f7eb81a9f32.Text: For a few minutes, joyful cries and sobs of the soldiers are heard over the vox. The muted sounds are suddenly interrupted by heavy static. Vigdis starts fumbling with the switches, tumblers, and levers, trying to re-establish communication.

823b625a-03d3-4216-ab35-a1fd910485b3.Text: An anxious prayer to the Emperor is whispered over the vox. For a moment, the operator falls silent... and suddenly returns, mumbling excuses about his imagination playing tricks on him. His comrades are still walking ahead of him, alive and well, and the voidship looks completely empty again.

54b81eb0-b458-4f27-857a-d20b84b6ab18.Text: A sharp intake of breath is heard over the vox, as if the operator is going to say something... but nothing happens. The transmission is filled with lingering silence. Then — someone's frantic sniffling. A blood-curdling scream. And heavy static. Then the officers aboard the flagship come to the horrifying realisation that the only thing left behind the stained-glass windows of the captain's bridge is the uncaring vastness of space. The Queen's Lament has disappeared unnoticed, taking the entire scouting party with it.

7e884c70-e569-4e8f-8ff7-a03f6eea5fde.Text: The nervous voice of the operator erupts through the vox — the crew are still on board! But... what's this? Blurry silhouettes of people with torn-off limbs, cut-open bellies, and twisted faces are materialising and vanishing all around in ghastly flashes. The ghosts promise the unwelcome guests that they will stay on board the Queen's Lament forever. Raising his voice to a shout, the operator reports that his comrades are already dead, and soon it will be his turn! The augurs are telling a different story: all of the scouts are alive and still moving forward.

80257939-ec60-436e-afb6-8dd142648b75.Text: Vigdis conducts a full vox-system check and reports that the communications are in order, even though only eerie, unnatural silence can be heard through the vox. Worried murmurs sweep across the bridge — the officers are certain that this is the voidship of the old ghost stories. The Queen's Lament has appeared countless times in all corners of the Imperium. Like a ghost, it manifested out of nowhere and just as mysteriously vanished in the darkness of space, taking with it those who dared to board.

94e69d40-9620-4325-9a59-ea6655eee957.Text: After a few minutes of silence, a child's cry can be heard through the vox. The stuttering operator reports that friends and family of the members of the scouting party are blocking the way. The friends and family who've all been taken by death. The soldiers confirm that they're not seeing ghosts but living people made of flesh and bone. The soldiers are begging the Rogue Trader to let them talk to their loved ones for a moment.

789d5f30-cc72-4cf7-a771-89be6b40641d.Text: Queen's Lament — the Rogue Trader has heard that name before. This voidship was destroyed by xenos in one of the violent battles for the Expanse over three millennia ago. They say that its captain was a devout and vengeful man.

68f8aaed-fb0c-4b5c-804b-eb5da9358a9a.Text: After fumbling with a few switches, the Vox Master says in a perplexed voice that the incoming signal should've been interrupted, but it's still being received by the Rogue Trader's vox.

46410ea4-e118-4109-8468-1e50469c7b78.Text: The cruiser rams the Rogue Trader's voidship, passing right through it, and the bridge fills with blurry visages of decomposed and disfigured people. The tormented cries of these souls drown out all thoughts, and visions of the past intertwine with those of the present. The dead see the living as treacherous xenos, attacking the crew with ghostly chainswords and bolters, knocking the wind out of the terrified officers. The apparition dissipates into thick blue mist just as suddenly as it appeared, leaving behind only several strands of grey hair among the most impressionable crew members.

019cfeab-a0f6-427b-afa2-a5cc1888211c.Text: The vox-cast stops abruptly, and a few minutes later, the scouting party's shuttle leaves the Queen's Lament. The voidship itself dissolves in the darkness of space. The shuttle arrives, carrying a single passenger — the operator, clutching a strange parcel. The young man's hair has turned white after the time spent on the cursed vessel, and he has lost the ability to speak. His story and rumours of what happened to the other scouts will live on for many years in hushed whispers across every deck of the Rogue Trader's voidship.

28fd1fda-75f0-499f-84bf-e575b2f52f0e.Text: In his usual flat voice devoid of emotion, the operator completes his report — the way to the bridge took sixteen hours and forty-one minutes. The soldiers are exhausted and would like to rest for some time. Confused, Vigdis notes that only half an hour has passed outside the Queen's Lament.

24ffea2a-b30e-47f0-90c5-990403e5a979.Text: The story of a ghost ship that yet again has swallowed the souls of its unfortunate victims will live on for many years in hushed whispers across every deck of the Rogue Trader's voidship.

c106b904-793b-4e5e-a0a6-b31d5e944832.Text: You have stolen nothing, but merely confiscated substances banned in the Imperium. And are now going to punish the owner of said contraband.

0a42791d-9ef5-4f22-a084-629e6d21d9b3.Text: Inspire your crew ahead of the battle.

323fa47b-1c0c-41be-a539-ac4ed225ea50.Text: Threaten to make short work of the pirates just as you did their pals.

70c0b33b-c814-4094-95be-81818d127b19.Text: Inform her that her ship is an embarrassing imitation.

df36ab36-2421-4b38-9a66-676989dd38dd.Text: Declare that you will punish her for the glory of the Emperor!

362862f1-9daf-4535-bea6-4d58ab232920.Text: Relay that her band's unsolicited attention has become tedious.

1da622a0-889d-4fd6-9451-6d5b96b9c8fb.Text: You are addressed by Victor the Hollow Heart, captain of the Saddler of Darkness, who quite rudely suggests that you return what you stole from the cache in the Mundus Nullius System.

991d2fa1-9478-49d9-85f0-f85932f51c00.Text: Hollow Heart accepts the shuttle containing the lost cargo and thanks you for your cooperation. A second later, shouts and shots are heard from the vox-caster of the officers sent to the Saddler of Darkness. The pirate ship is loading its guns! Prepare for battle!

5308effc-d27d-4857-80f7-fe2fe55ef70b.Text: Hollow Heart heaps curses upon you and your entire protectorate — you will regret this decision! The pirate ship is loading its guns! Prepare for battle!

54f6de9d-c9a0-415d-952d-3eefb27c5aac.Text: Several ships head straight for you. The augur team reports that their drive signatures are similar to those of the Saddler of Darkness. The pirates are seeking revenge for one of their own, Victor the Hollow Heart, and they are in no mood to negotiate.

7c311d0c-1ef6-49c6-8d9d-50260e5ca5ca.Text: You are surrounded by several pirate ships, and you are certain you know what they want — to avenge the theft of their property and to punish the killer of Victor the Hollow Heart.

a6416b16-3736-410a-95a9-b04012cd17b1.Text: The pirates just will not leave you alone — and it's small wonder, considering how many of those curs you have taken out. Without even trying to contact you, they launch a fierce attack.

cb5d95ab-1823-4ea8-bbcf-be7b7b9936d6.Text: Much to the surprise of your officers, the Saddler of Darkness appears before you again. Or, more accurately, its faithfully constructed replica. Captain Katriona enquires if you have any last words.

ab8f59f6-79b7-46a5-b2b6-236f5d253831.Text: You attract the attention of several pirate ships that have been harassing a small cargo vessel. They abandon their prey and head toward you. The officers report that the ships are flying the same colours as the Saddler of Darkness.

8e240f06-a4fb-4b52-a0cc-9e6f016ec675.Text: Exclamations of approval echo around the ship, from the bridge to the lowermost decks. Your crew will follow you anywhere: into the warp, into darkness, into oblivion itself. Death to the pirates! Death to the enemies of the Imperium!

8ed69e9f-3489-4303-b170-48551178c55d.Text: Your crew faces the enemy with cold resolve. Your words may not have stirred their hardened souls, but they are ready for combat and that is what matters. Death to the unbelievers!

e8beb98a-3105-46c2-9a45-4b4764efe791.Text: The tense radio silence is occasionally punctuated with the heavy breaths of the enemy ship's Vox Master. Your words have convinced them: the pirates forget all about revenge and flee the battlefield with their tails between their legs.

19eb16e8-c360-4a78-a1b8-bb3de9fd9855.Text: Pirates are said to be proud people, in their own way. The response to your threats is a torpedo launch and some choice profanity over the vox-comm, from which the Vox Master decides to shield your ears.

e161b494-d5d2-45ba-ae81-4195a8027ed1.Text: Captain Katriona calls you an arrogant arsehole and charges into battle. Ready the cannons!

3056428e-50f3-47fb-ac20-a47eef9f823a.Text: The pirate scoffs grimly. She is the shadow to His light, and even the holder of a holy Warrant cannot withstand the onslaught of all the darkness that crosses {mf|his|her} path. Today will be the day Katriona's darkness obliterates you. Prepare for battle!

aeeee412-0585-429a-9ab4-ced597acb2e8.Text: Katriona's laughter is drawn out and hollow. She is only too eager to trade her rust bucket for your swift bird. The successor to the Saddler of Darkness loads its guns and charges into battle.

423afbc9-6231-4cd0-b6ae-0b8a77ca5ce9.Text: You sight a ship hovering over a void station. The vessel bears no identifying marks, but the landing craft swarming the station below makes the situation clear: pirates have seized an Imperial outpost. The augurs detect that the pirate ship is warming up its engines and quickly reloading its cannons. It is preparing for battle.

45f4220c-74cb-475b-aecc-af6b46170877.Text: A few moments of delay are enough for the pirates to take up an advantageous position to assault your ship. To battle!

0057bcea-fb57-4e13-beaf-4e7f74755ee1.Text: Instead of responding to your hail, the ship fires a salvo and sets course toward you!

acd96273-8fd9-4fea-b760-76b365a648c1.Text: The ship does not pursue you but stays behind to keep a close watch over the plundered station.

241dfc24-ba4c-45ea-b6de-f7f1b5b91dfb.Text: Upon noticing the Rogue Trader's ship again, the pirates turn their vessel toward it. The augurs sound the alarm: the pirate vessel's cannons are loaded and ready for battle!

6080da29-9714-4e74-b0e8-681404efd6fb.Text: Noticing the enemy's intentions in time, you approach first and begin your attack!

39a851c7-9785-47a6-a070-93140b5403a6.Text: Ask if Demir Shahnee has any goods of interest to sell.

448a54f3-d0c5-4868-9ac4-9864b9ee4351.Text: Share the information you have on burning worlds.

ee47582b-65c3-46a1-b2c9-de8490b817b9.Text: Let them know you have no current information on burning worlds but are willing to sell any you may obtain in the future.

d61c1f7f-adc8-4887-80cb-b18b7927724d.Text: Ask why they are looking for burning worlds.

23a0b532-aada-4f7c-91e8-a296e2e82651.Text: Refuse to supply information on burning worlds and move on.

9cea27cd-8c05-4542-884e-60357ff62a07.Text: An unknown ship hails you as soon as you are in its detection range. The ship, the Scarlet Pursuer helmed by Captain Demir Shahnee, has Footfall listed as its home port. The message hints transparently at a connection with the Kasballica Mission. The Vox Master adds that the captain has a proposal for you.

9d73af54-b0ea-4756-8330-2f95ebcbc454.Text: Demir Shahnee sends you a very agitated message in which he promises that your new friends will long remember your generosity. After the last of the shuttles carrying the reward has left your ship's docking airlock and returned to the Scarlet Pursuer, the captain sends you his best wishes and hints that your paths are going to cross again.

901f40b1-89c7-4afa-8c68-42af1867a8b2.Text: The ship lets you know they will readily reward you for any information about burning worlds in the Koronus Expanse.

1788e99d-78c4-4ea7-8bf5-df9ed6a4bb22.Text: With effusive gratitude, the ship sends out a shuttle with the promised reward.

6056c78c-eaca-4dc2-a00c-8a16e53c0a96.Text: You receive the Scarlet Pursuer's projected itinerary: information about what systems it will be visiting should you wish to find it later. The captain looks forward to meeting you again — and acquiring information on burning worlds, should you have it.

c65dd484-5a44-43a6-9764-9229f4fd50ef.Text: The reply is as courteous as it is vague. The captain cites a scholarly curiosity in this understudied type of world.

38f290bd-96cb-4476-b401-33bcee40b020.Text: Upon hearing the message, Magos Pasqal expresses a keen interest in burning worlds and asks the Lord Captain to take the issue into consideration.

ece008af-64b9-4b9c-830b-5ede69f02a63.Text: Jae Heydari immediately declares that Captain Shahnee would never dash about the void out of "scholarly curiosity," but only for a suitably high return. In that case, perhaps the Lord Captain, too, might want to look into these burning worlds.

61ff2513-9a9a-4584-849b-e865688171a2.Text: Seneschal Werserian makes no comment regarding the Kasballica message, but is amazed that, for once, the esteemed Magos and Mistress Heydari are in passionate agreement on something.

bd9f2b6c-dba0-4179-b53a-ad40ad559038.Text: Upon your approach, the Scarlet Pursuer sends out a hearty greeting. Captain Demir Shahnee wishes good health upon you and your entire dynasty, and asks if you might have any up-to-date information on burning worlds.

45dd36b8-b5bf-45d8-a7e2-28f42e31a5f7.Text: You receive the Scarlet Pursuer's projected itinerary: information on systems in which you can find it later. The captain looks forward to meeting you again — and acquiring information on burning worlds, should you possess it.

1e527220-2b43-4a1e-9e40-5b07b66c185c.Text: Send all available forces to intercept the Interstellar Sextant! Don't let it get away!

f6c1f2b9-d66c-43e8-a744-1e8c391aa8bf.Text: A report shows up on your personal cogitator screen. Unknown ships are towing the Interstellar Sextant, a cargo ship belonging to one of Footfall's wealthiest traders. It looks like the pirates have bitten off more than they can chew, and have now been forced to drag the ship to a more secluded place where they can plunder it undisturbed.

3bed374a-03f6-4667-bb4d-0b7ffaf4f065.Text: As soon as they see you, the escort ships charge into battle at once, while the captive Sextant powers up its warp engines. Unless you interrupt the preparation for the jump, the cargo ship will forever vanish beyond the veil of the Immaterium, along with all the riches it is carrying.
