f0e7098b-e76f-445f-b35f-7e393d1a4879.Text: The augur team reports that several pirate ships are closing in at top speed. Beware, there is almost no time left to retreat!

75e18c09-54ec-4b49-8d29-cc3e95a72b7b.Text: The augur team reports that several Drukhari ships are closing in at top speed. With no time to retreat, a confrontation is unavoidable!

ec0fa43a-ee0a-45bc-85e2-b9f6e4cc0f73.Text: Ask why the captain calls himself the Pilgrim.

dc931298-a6e9-4d77-9e47-76dee9cb42d7.Text: Ask why the Pilgrim needs flogiston.

d9064d4b-2acb-408f-ab68-6958f3bc813b.Text: Ignore the greeting and keep going.

a5eec62f-e850-40e5-882c-0fbf647a881b.Text: Attack the Darkpiercer and plunder it.

b7137e8a-a9f4-49a6-9e9c-936eeb489086.Text: Tell him that this is not enough.

9ff0d278-ae77-4757-9b79-a86b778d6bcf.Text: Propose a deal: valuable information in exchange for flogiston.

52330476-12d3-4de2-a93d-b520e6ed79e2.Text: Ask what you will receive in return.

97b2b52b-2be7-41c6-a43e-6b9cb27ff542.Text: Bid farewell to the Pilgrim and travel onward.

1dda2f98-87d1-4da5-a99c-1250ce40869e.Text: A vox-notification from the augur crew drowns out the usual noise on the bridge. An Imperial vessel, the Darkpiercer, and its escort ships are headed your way. Your archives make no mention of either the ship or its owner. As you consider your course of action, the ship's captain contacts you first. Introducing himself as the Pilgrim, the captain greets the Rogue Trader courteously and offers to purchase any information you might have on crystal flogiston deposits.

cddb255d-89c0-4992-bccd-112ef6ab1d1c.Text: The captain's coarse laughter echoes forth from the vox. Flogiston is a part and parcel of many different aspects of life in the Imperium. How exactly his customers are going to use it is none of his concern. All that the Pilgrim promises is that the flogiston will be used for the good of Humanity.

743c148c-8918-4031-82dc-8f9dc3a7c1d6.Text: The Pilgrim has been exploring the Koronus Expanse for years and knows many of its secrets. He promises to let you in on intriguing rumours that may be of interest to someone with your skills and capabilities.

5aea9974-1097-40c8-b6aa-249fb30e6d6a.Text: Pasqal becomes visibly animated at the mention of flogiston. Though indifferent to the prospect of a deal with the shadowy individual, the Magos nonetheless recommends you find out more about flogiston deposits. Your own protectorate would benefit from the knowledge.

e0aa7cfa-9ab4-4b96-9c95-e575f8bdf051.Text: Sister Argenta sincerely believes the words of the Pilgrim. A cowl or a golden Aquila are no prerequisites for being His true servant. If the captain sincerely wants to help the Imperium, perhaps by his own methods, there is nothing questionable about extending a helping hand.

0d667b09-c21b-4f68-8c87-d2539c1e26ad.Text: The captain admits he has not always done the right thing in his life, but he once beheld the blessing of the Emperor Himself, and has followed a special path of service to Him ever since. That is the path he now treads as the Pilgrim.

6dd21691-34ed-4cea-a1ba-e511475d36cd.Text: It looks like this was the exact decision the captain of the Darkpiercer expected you to make.

57eb9169-801e-4d3e-988f-74220d879e80.Text: It looks like the captain of the Darkpiercer is unsurprised by your reaction. He is willing to pay in gold and securities for any information on flogiston.

3f5b1f7f-e429-4c06-ba4c-9167bb88c8cb.Text: The Pilgrim hints discreetly that his secrets would be valuable enough for anyone, and in the hands of a Rogue Trader, they hold the promise of an entire fortune — if you can make the most of them.

48ada391-7a1f-4f12-9987-16eeec428b60.Text: The Pilgrim sincerely thanks the Rogue Trader for this meeting and asks that his offer be considered.

ab322814-ff19-4360-832a-89f0afd0f581.Text: Jae immediately remarks that someone without a name is not to be trusted. Deals with such people do not tend to end well. If she were you, she would first find out his secrets and then scrupulously remove him from the equation.

1c2bacdc-1283-46c5-b4d8-0296d40addbd.Text: Then, in a somewhat conspiratorial tone, the Pilgrim relates a story about a standoff between two xenos fleets, which he was told by... an acquaintance. The person in question, sadly enough, died at the hands of the Inquisition before they were able to pass on the coordinates for the crash site of one of the xenos ships. However, the Pilgrim knows for a fact that the vessel met its demise on an ocean world.

24b1f09d-e20b-4da2-aaf6-cb9d9a57ff72.Text: The Darkpiercer gives you the coordinates of several systems where you may encounter it later and melts into the distorted outline of a warp portal.

efaf8565-0f19-45f5-8be4-c1afb93f72dc.Text: The Pilgrim greets you courteously and asks how the Rogue Trader is faring.

e03c0879-b1e9-459c-b692-3e71c71c4d90.Text: The captain of the Darkpiercer is in the best of spirits. In gratitude for your invaluable help, he sends you a small box containing ancient maps and documents. They appear to speak of a certain Imperial world lost many centuries ago.

fb49be00-833a-478d-8042-402ac302fa94.Text: "I have seen a planet burn once before — Ksar-Maga. Exterminatus was invoked, incendiary cyclonic torpedoes were deployed. The world burned for several months until there was nothing but ash."

c07d6be6-5046-4e60-81c5-d20bacdfe228.Text: "There are sects in the Imperial Cult whose adherents believe transgressors will be punished after death on burning planets. This world could serve as one such purgatory."

ef96cb45-198f-40b5-8cd2-59e1cf01856e.Text: "I happen to have read about burning worlds in Pandora. It is said the fires there have been raging for close to a century, though no one knows how. How long has this one been burning?"

50c2457d-9eb0-42ba-bf5b-8c504aaa2d98.Text: "Hmm... Has anyone else noticed that, from a certain angle, that lump of rock looks remarkably like—"

7450cd01-40a2-4a28-adb2-baa31236b00c.Text: "Mistress Heydari, I speak on behalf of every officer currently on the vox-line when I state my total lack of interest in hearing the end of that sentence."

d34d2739-ed97-4816-9aa0-dbb46f706ed5.Text: "A celestial body holds zero interest as an object of study. We can continue onward, Lord Captain."

1d24718a-bfdf-4dc6-9033-a662edc3c4b8.Text: "It's so quiet... Is it possible? Have I found the one place in the universe where my chatty friends have nothing to say? What, not one tragedy in the past? Not a single calamity in the future?"

fd85cc79-6e46-46c5-acf4-1f71b1f3640c.Text: "I am unable to perceive what has been and what will be, but I too, ah, 'hear' this otherworldly hush. A strange warp anomaly. Strange and disquieting."

c5a985e8-5834-4fc8-bed7-347672e560b8.Text: "The whispers have gone wild — we should go back into orbit. They're just muttering, muttering about who knows... it doesn't even sound like human language... Oh, I do not want to know what happened to this world."

3c9ec55d-6615-4907-9970-6156474b2286.Text: "The telemetry indicates that these are the remnants of an Imperial world. A sorry sight. It is unlikely we will ever learn what catastrophe took place here."

0588daae-52d5-40eb-bbd1-9ed3a01b8e3f.Text: "I would often watch the prison population on a small planetoid from Eurac V's observatory. Looking at this celestial body now, I am beginning to think that all such entities are alike."

b552b228-b2f7-466f-a075-f877497694bf.Text: "There is no shortage of rumours among pilgrims about the worlds in Langrenn's Belt. Some attest that a great battle once raged here between the Imperium and the foes of Humanity."

4a1b052b-a163-4d58-b71f-96a525889ea5.Text: "The bowels of riven worlds contain extremely rare metals and minerals. But it appears someone has beaten us to it in this case."

7fce5d8a-f7bc-4e09-9518-27c4951d0a30.Text: "I am detecting traces of magmatic rock extraction. Judging by the methods of sacred geometry used for cutting open the formations, this is the work of my Explorator brethren."

05fcda48-c917-4972-9351-49a94c0fd1b5.Text: "I remember Lady Theodora used to condemn traitors to 'forced resettlement' on this planetoid."

48c7ce5a-c4f5-416e-afa0-efb83a2a5ad4.Text: "Yes... Every member of House Cellius was packed into a cargo shuttle and sent on a one-way voyage. And then a year later we found the real conspirators."

6895dd0a-8c75-419a-90f4-59cbfdd811c7.Text: "Intriguing surface topography. It is possible that the molten rock of the mantle poured out as a consequence of a natural cataclysm or a collision with the celestial body."

fc4efbf6-60a1-4b3d-9e62-1100538bf051.Text: "How did this world look before it was enveloped in this fiery shroud? Was it your ancestors, elantach, who disgorged its core in some ill-considered act?"

cdef6414-1c68-4397-aae5-4bda75572529.Text: "The planet is laced with pulsating veins... Strands woven from pain... But what are they? An oddity of the past — or a warning from the future..."

b4c891a7-8f60-4a06-b3c4-564d8a484b8e.Text: "Well, hello, Grantis. The last time I was here, three of the planet's barons put a price on my head."

ac1eaeb1-ec60-4050-b9ff-911245555b10.Text: "My guys were rushed off their feet, selling me to each baron in turn and then breaking me out of the dungeons every time. Exalted One bless their duplicitous souls!"

2899b88b-332d-4a70-8136-b4b529ecc864.Text: "Do you know how many times this world has been traded back and forth between the von Valancius and Winterscale dynasties? A senseless waste of thrones, if you ask me!"

758f77ea-72da-4f97-aae9-2f305c1daad7.Text: "A mining world? It looks to me like a filthy, inhospitable hole where loyal subjects 'freely' toil in fathomless mine shafts century after century. Usually until death."

82dcd0df-7ab0-4e83-9ecb-24f09606dd1b.Text: "By their arduous labour and unbreakable spirit do His faithful servants fuel hundreds of Imperial worlds. Their entire lives are an example of true service to Humanity."

a77fddb4-b99f-4f9a-8ec8-70151346d6e9.Text: "This mining world has been catalogued as normal. No rare or valuable deposits have been detected."

65c27357-080e-4ed2-ac1c-8d3af0069734.Text: "When I embarked on the Path of the Outcast, the first world I set foot on was similar to this: cloaked in snow and shrouded in leaden clouds... endlessly white, endlessly alone."

cab5e22b-b3d7-4a19-99b2-d9c27afeff4b.Text: "Worlds with extreme environments produce the finest Astra Militarum regiments... or so I've heard. I am merely repeating what some Guards I happen to know have whispered into my credulous ears..."

e3b1a272-6958-4d71-9bca-c7b16d95a37a.Text: "Lady Theodora loved frozen worlds. I never did discover the reason why, but the Lord Captain never missed a chance to visit such a planet, even on the slightest pretext."

9f3ce699-0e87-4ada-90b3-55725af8e1a2.Text: "The name is familiar... I've seen it somewhere in my observers' reports..."

b2ec6eed-6c02-4c80-a3e2-657fced3e278.Text: "Hmm. I think I know what was in that report, esteemed Interrogator. But it is probably best if I don't say it aloud."

7597a5d9-af6f-42d2-ae1a-c7b63e4348da.Text: "In my wanderings I have seen worlds engulfed in flame and worlds encased in ice, worlds gripped by never-ending storms and racked by wild radiation... but planets such as this — frozen in time — fill me with particular anguish."

9b17cbdf-dbfa-4049-bf3e-a17e93b098d6.Text: "A natural accumulation of irregularities on a solid planetary surface has been detected. Probability of occurrence of natural materials: high."

042f8b55-7c96-4ab3-9f6d-fcafb02d14f7.Text: A warp breach! The ship's vox-systems have reported an emergency: enemies of Humanity have been spotted aboard the ship!

94573471-2cf8-4160-a45f-3b50e183a090.Text: Ungodly fiends spreading sorcerous disease walk the lower decks, gathering a cohort of infected voidsmen. If no measures are taken immediately, an entire bay could be turned into a den of heresy!

5c239776-8d12-4ceb-9076-faf04ca60f52.Text: Warp beasts have enthralled the crew in charge of one of the macro-cannons and massacred those who resisted the heresy. The Lord Captain is their only hope!

fcd0742e-cced-4281-ac71-99cdfdd8f567.Text: Another watch aboard the voidship has come to an end. The Lord Captain, having given {mf|his|her} final orders for the day, retired to {mf|his|her} chambers for some divine rest. However, the Rogue Trader's slumber was disturbed by horrific nightmares plaguing {mf|his|her} mind. Fate wrenched the Lord Captain out of the clutches of these agonising warp dreams... only for {mf|him|her} to witness the nightmares seeping through the flimsy membrane of the Geller field and taking physical shape in the ship's sanctum sanctorum! To battle!

6cbd36eb-4276-4b88-80c9-75211d4a9ef6.Text: Troubling news concerning the deaths of some patrolmen has forced the Lord Captain and {mf|his|her} retinue to descend into the voidship's depths in person. The mystery of these crimes was unravelled in the domain of a clan currently charged with macro-cannon maintenance: a personal visit from the Rogue Trader scared off a group of traitors who were preparing an act of sabotage, forcing them to act prematurely. Every minute counts: if the mutineers trigger the explosives, the bay will be obliterated! To battle!

a643a6d4-a10a-4b38-99c3-04affe5ce49c.Text: A warp breach! A flicker of the Geller field has let the Archenemy's spawn aboard the voidship. This time, however, the fiends are more preoccupied with destroying each other than slaying crewmen. Whatever the cause of this unholy conflict, it gives the Lord Captain an opportunity to deal with the intruders before they bring their ire upon the voidsmen! To battle!

a8967c99-05ca-458d-94e4-1cd8b44682c5.Text: At the head of the assault is an accursed traitor, a Chaos Space Marine, followed by enraged daemons! The spawn have infiltrated the ship via the storage bay — they cannot be allowed to reach any populated decks or else the death toll will be exorbitant!

a0bc24f5-87c0-449d-8122-83a6a0738d2c.Text: Warp emanations have filled the plasma drive bay. Daemons, having appeared out of thin air, are twisting the appearances and minds of the crew — some of the voidsmen are being turned into mutant psykers! This incursion must be stopped at once!

adf430b4-7147-48ef-9151-4c63bad59c69.Text: Bizarre warp sorcery has linked a daemon, one that has breached the Geller field, to one of the voidsmen from the macro-cannon crew. A former faithful servant of the Emperor has now become a heretic preacher gathering a flock of those bewitched by the Archenemy — this madness must be brought to an end!

4ce1ddd8-453d-4e09-816f-292f14284375.Text: A call for help has pierced the tranquillity of an uneventful warp flight: something sinister is afoot on one of the storage decks. Two squads have already been sent to investigate, and both of them have gone missing. Alas, the only way to learn of their fate is a personal visit by the Rogue Trader and {mf|his|her} retinue.

7d81793f-153a-476f-97f7-4896c2f723d9.Text: A warp tear has split open on the storage decks, and a whole pack of daemons has burst through — creatures of odd forms and varieties, but all of them equally bloodthirsty and brutal. The crew is struck with terror, praying for the Lord Captain's wisdom!

3ecf72e1-44c3-4d2d-a2fd-d11e738d1fee.Text: The plasma drive crew is begging for help: thin and graceful warp creatures, laughing merrily, have caused a massacre in the drive bay. More and more people are losing their minds and joining the carnage — this lunacy has to be stopped!

cc597522-ba34-4cb9-9f4d-bf61c58f2cf9.Text: A warp breach! This time, trouble came straight to the bridge: malodorous mist teeming with swaying nightmarish figures has rolled through the ventilation shafts into the command centre. The officers are suffocating from this wave of corruption. There's no time to deliberate. To battle!

ec6cd1dd-6d4c-4096-a387-4a19d18ffb5e.Text: A catastrophe in the Omnissiah's hallowed halls! One of the few Magi assigned by the Machine Cult to serve on the von Valancius ship has lost his mind. Singing distorted binharic liturgies, the heretic has broken the sacred code rhythms and turned the ship's machines against the rest of the crew! The superstitious voidsmen are paralysed with fear before the mad servant of the Adeptus Mechanicus — only the Lord Captain can stand against the madman! To battle!

c08f6658-5c9d-4983-98f0-17289f96b407.Text: One of the macro-cannon clans has sounded the alarm: the bay's ventilation systems have brought in the miasmas of some terrible disease that is killing dozens by the minute. Even more horrifying, the dead are rising to their feet and attacking the living while some of the corpses are losing their human forms altogether, turning into unspeakable warp beasts. It would be suicide for the troops to storm the bay — only the fearless Lord Captain and {mf|his|her} retinue can stop this plight!

2b98be03-ae07-46e1-a8a6-a3e248453b44.Text: Servitors assigned to the storage bays have gone berserk and are attacking voidsmen. Survivors are claiming to have seen some pernicious warp beast possessing one of the automatons — it must be expelled one way or another!

9ded2b2a-570d-436c-961b-ac839828621d.Text: Since the very start of the warp jump, rumours of ill omens have been widespread among the voidsmen: sudden deaths among the crew, ravaged corpses, jagged shadows lurking behind the bulkheads... A Terran day later, the mystery unravelled itself in a most heinous manner — an attempt on the Rogue Trader's life! The question of how the Drukhari xenos came to be aboard the ship will have to be pondered some other time — right now, the Lord Captain has to fight for {mf|his|her} life!

92c08a5f-2a2e-45d0-afa5-3c1060db191e.Text: A foul warp entity has pierced the thin veil of the Geller field and spawned unimaginable beasts of unnatural hues. The vox-systems are picking up the crewmen's screams and the warp fiends' loathsome giggling — the situation demands immediate intervention!

f94e0d94-118a-4098-aae7-b684ad7e9d37.Text: Warp tears have appeared in maintenance bays on the lower decks, and voidsmen, driven mad by sorcerous corruption, have bowed to the daemons arriving from the other side, their new masters. This calls for an immediate response!

adf035ce-50fc-4eed-92e4-110ea8111089.Text: The Daemon Engine, fired by the energies of Chaos, will tear to shreds the creatures of the warp that dared to challenge the Lord Captain.

b9ea7b22-370f-426f-b7ce-5a72bac72347.Text: Blessed by holy gifts, the God-Emperor's loyal servants will battle His enemies without any fear or doubt.

a978b8d8-ba96-400a-8bd4-dede331dcc5a.Text: The crew will have to rely solely on their own strength and the Emperor's providence.

0b8432be-8ccd-48ef-88eb-76e32c02ec86.Text: The Rogue Trader and {mf|his|her} retinue will personally go and face these contemptible foes.

5b477dcb-5763-48c3-8ebe-950d16fb8fac.Text: The crew will receive military gear and a chance to prove their worth by dispatching the Lord Captain's enemies.

9c2eefa2-fa40-4b7a-989c-23409ea240ec.Text: Boiling over from its overwhelming power, the monstrous Chaos-born machine torments, crushes, and shreds the wretched creatures. The death of enemies that succumb to its onslaught echo with a gloomy energy impulse, ringing throughout the metal walls of the ship...

a9f4a8ce-4db3-4a76-8b9e-238d2fe25f87.Text: Blessed relics instilled the souls of the voidsmen with such faith that there was no room for fear or doubt. It may have taken a staggering number of casualties to prevail over the enemy, but their sacrifice was not in vain.

1c642877-4074-475e-b0d2-7fa0a8097800.Text: The warp breach has ended in untold losses. Thousands of voidsmen are dead, and the ship's systems have sustained terrible damage. Worst of all, however, is that the taint that has spread among the crew is bound to cause many more misfortunes in the days to come.

ed33995d-d29a-4ab7-ab0d-7131de56fc92.Text: The victory over the Rogue Trader's enemies came at a high price. Still, the decks have been cleansed of warp spawn, albeit it took the blood of hundreds voidsmen to wash away any evidence of their presence.

156ec254-e95e-4451-9005-2b27e5c72cf5.Text: Trust in the Navigator's judgement and approach the warp storm

8b570e66-9a38-465c-a7da-42ec8f4614dc.Text: Reports are coming in from the Navigator's Sanctum regarding the appearance of a warp storm along the voidship's course. The ship can go around the perilous region, but the ceremonious vox-casts from the Sanctum are tinged with strange inflections, as if, for some reason, the Navigator desperately wants to approach the raging warp elements...

4ef3aaf0-b9bf-4c3b-9ede-1f085886af22.Text: Leave the ship to the mercy of the warp

1dfabc85-6af2-4282-992c-f423915810fe.Text: Call upon the Navigator to steer the ship back on course, as is the Navigator's duty

5ae962b6-edfd-4951-ba08-12a569d151a4.Text: The voidship is in the clutches of the warp elements: a whirlpool has suddenly emerged and is threatening to throw the ship off course and leave the helpless crew at the mercy of the Sea of Souls. Only the Navigator's talent can save hundreds of people from madness or death...

f562ca1f-d879-4c11-9afc-921ea14d6ae8.Text: An unexpected report has arrived from the Navigator's Sanctum: a new path has revealed itself to the Navigator in a mystical vision. According to the omen, the voidship will be safer on this mysterious route. But can one trust the warp's revelations?

4ba811d6-6aea-4085-80b5-1570fe21ebe2.Text: Emergency aboard the voidship! A foul warp entity has pierced the thin veil of the Geller field and spawned unimaginable beasts of unnatural hues. The vox-systems are picking up the crewmen's screams and the warp fiends' loathsome giggling — the situation demands immediate intervention!

93c0052f-ee50-444f-a2bc-2891f9df9b90.Text:
In the grim darkness of the far future, there is only war.

This mode is the ultimate challenge for the boldest of Lord Captains who want to truly immerse themselves in the world of Warhammer 40,000 with the highest stakes possible. All decisions, victories, and losses in the Grim Darkness mode are final and irreversible — you only have a single save, which is updated automatically every time you exit the game. No loading from an earlier point, no second chances, and no changing previous decisions.

If you manage to successfully overcome all obstacles and make it all the way to the epilogue, bringing glory to the von Valancius dynasty, you will receive the "There Is Only War..." trophy and a special item for all your future playthroughs as a testament to your skill and bravery.

If your party or your voidship is defeated in battle, your Grim Darkness journey ends there. You will be offered to either honourably accept your fate and delete the save or continue the game in Custom mode; however, completing this story will not grant you the "There Is Only War..." trophy and the special reward. The Emperor protects!

- It is possible to turn off the Grim Darkness mode at any time, converting it to Custom mode. Once this is done, it cannot be reversed. As soon as you change the mode, you will no longer qualify for the trophy or the reward.

- Grim Darkness mode is currently only available in single-player mode. Inviting your friends into a game with this mode will automatically convert it to Custom mode.

c651715e-e303-4f85-879e-248d31a7c8fb.Text: This value is a flat modifier for the difficulty of all skill tests made by the party.

acd12774-272d-4fd6-8897-974e570338b4.Text:
Allows you to set the difficulty of space combat. This setting affects the performance of enemy voidships and your ability to repair the Rogue Trader's flagship.

Easy difficulty provides a trivial challenge in combat: -Damage inflicted by enemies is reduced by −90%. -Repair cost is reduced by −95%. -The power of some enemy evasion abilities is reduced by −75%. -Maximum hull integrity of enemy voidships is reduced by −40%.

Normal difficulty provides a relaxing experience in most combats: -Damage inflicted by enemies is reduced by −40%. -Repair cost is reduced by −20%. -Enemy voidships have a base amount of maximum hull integrity.

Daring difficulty level provides the complete void combat experience: -Enemies inflict full damage. -Flagship repair requires a base amount of scrap. -Enemy voidships have a base amount of maximum hull integrity.

Hard difficulty provides additional challenge for experienced players: -Damage inflicted by enemies is increased by +25%. -Flagship repair requires a base amount of scrap. -Maximum hull integrity of enemy voidships is increased by +20%.

Make sure not to lose details in the darkest areas (SHADOWS), matte surfaces (MIDTONES), or bright fire and light sources (HIGHLIGHTS).

The technology used to minimise jagged edges caused by aliasing.
Subpixel Morphological Anti-Aliasing (SMAA) — a high-quality but slower algorithm that does not support motion vectors.
Temporal Anti-Aliasing (TAA) — an advanced technique which requires motion vectors.

8281113a-6da7-4031-8c46-bdb03746f313.Text: The "Crowd density" setting controls the number of characters or objects displayed on the screen at one time. Increasing this setting adds more non-player characters and objects to the game environment, making the game world feel more immersive and livelier. However, it can also impact game performance, especially on older or less powerful hardware, as more objects require more resources to render. Adjusting this setting allows you to find a balance between visual fidelity and performance based on your hardware capabilities and personal preferences.

6279200c-1ea7-4d9e-bed6-f38021ff7662.Text: Depth of Focus (DoF). Objects will look sharp only in the focal field and blurred if they're closer or farther away.

da3ba607-8eda-410f-b1e8-626e6d6fe8de.Text: Screen selection if multiple screens are available.

49ff37d7-d8ac-4f4a-9ae1-1eaea18c1629.Text: Adds a visual effect simulating a film grain, i.e. visual noise.

68051e0b-ff54-4051-a389-b76870ff2d7b.Text:
Everyone — all creatures and characters leave footprints.
Party — only characters under the player's control leave footprints.
Off — no one leaves footprints.

fa79efa5-0b25-4e58-bc95-5c6da9f9389b.Text:
Turns on FPS capping mode (see below).
Only works when VSync is disabled.

147797ba-8cb7-4ef0-a1ae-dbfd6ab3de63.Text:
Determines the desired FPS value.
Acts as a maximum FPS limiter.

979b363b-b1c5-4fc0-aaee-2ad76c0c5116.Text:
Turns on one of the presets for FSR.
Saves memory and time spent on rendering a frame.
This decreases image quality.
It is in fact lower resolution rendering with subsequent upscaling using a special filter.
Does not apply to the UI.

74b9250e-66ff-475e-a4f8-dcee5a597d79.Text: The value of the filter definition that is applied when FSR is upscaled.

1f503546-6fde-44ac-9c32-d33e7a7d179e.Text: Game window operation mode in the OS.

de4f8dc6-a962-4e9c-b593-7cf293e81885.Text: Adjusts the colour scheme to your screen.

c6fa4798-0c5e-49b6-9f59-584cf41eac91.Text: Overall graphics quality. Affects several settings.

cc101558-cd22-4944-ab71-0d6851739cba.Text: Enable particle systems to have lighting.

29baf23c-8308-4fff-89dd-40495af54a54.Text: Enable particle systems to cast and have shadows.

a9c1b947-9835-435e-bbdb-8902d89880e3.Text: Determines whether soft body physics (e.g. cloaks, trees, grass) are processed using the central processing unit (CPU) or the graphics card (GPU). In most cases, graphics card processing is faster. But for certain PC setups, the GPU option may provide slower results (especially for integrated GPUs).

c4223326-3ba8-418f-85fc-96269dd3c867.Text: Enables dynamic shadows for static objects. Enhances image quality when the character is inside a static object's shadow.

1337e7a9-ed20-44ad-8590-c51974573b78.Text: Affects shadow texture size and shadow antialiasing.

f21e1623-7d6e-4e5c-9a87-d180dcf3adf7.Text: Fullscreen post effect. Simulates the intensity of light and shadow.

1146c599-42bc-4cfe-9692-51ed83bbd895.Text: Fullscreen post effect. Simulates reflections in the screen space. Affects performance.

6fc1c271-dee1-4dc8-996a-631be9a7dbbc.Text: General texture resolution. The higher the texture resolution, the more detail the image has.

92750eca-2a41-4bdf-98fe-98ba1524fd83.Text: Determines the quality of volumetric lighting.

c033bc08-4f24-4e3d-a5ec-a7baee8e9c30.Text: FPS and screen frame rate synchronisation.

43337c49-4632-4b3a-9c98-17e98390b99c.Text: FPS and screen frame rate synchronisation.

86eb2941-1123-4a4b-bc02-b99ce580a873.Text: Mute audio when the game window is collapsed

7e6a8bb7-a94b-43cf-8684-c6d7f6061d7a.Text: Move the slider to change the volume of all abilities and their effects.

c660273d-5ce1-4bdf-a2d2-f43fd7e6b7dc.Text: Move slider to change the volume of ambient sounds.

1a41a1cb-750f-44c9-a33f-277c5243e285.Text: Move the slider to change the volume of impacts(hits) and their effects.

1a8162ef-8985-4a6e-8b4d-b2a3af449c67.Text: Move slider to change the volume of weapons and abilities sounds.

24a238f1-7f27-40dc-95be-e82811f6baf8.Text: Move slider to change the volume of all voices and effects.

6d06fbcc-ab1e-41d7-b66c-326e48b5c1d9.Text: Move the slider to change the volume of melee weapons and their effects.

e8cfeaab-457b-4a71-9f6e-dc353c3daa01.Text: Move slider to change the music volume.

c6862528-c94d-4690-a799-e41f2cd53337.Text: Move the slider to change the volume of ranged weapons and their effects.

f58c09b7-f1ed-49bb-93e7-41b10ab629e4.Text: Move the slider to change the volume of all sound effects except for music and in-game voices.

20b89e20-90c1-43fe-b98b-f5a19e65fd10.Text: Move slider to change the volume of the user interface.

b0178c51-8271-4152-a392-5b67d5ef89f6.Text: Move the slider to change the voice volume of all player characters.

c297b2dd-3106-4673-b175-512d12875c8a.Text: Move the slider to change the volume of dialogues.

67ac4deb-4b78-402d-9ac0-a9477ff99d13.Text: Move the slider to change the voice volume of all non-player characters.

a1149d18-3b82-4171-94e8-9090818c18ce.Text: Move slider to change the volume of voices.

8b8c5a8b-1912-4cfd-bbfd-02d68d6c2beb.Text: Sets the frequency of companion remarks in the game.

3dfa9d4a-1978-4934-b76c-e73ec7331b21.Text: Important character or point of interest

b9caf5e4-8e6d-4591-98a3-7150ab1f13fc.Text:
Fires an ionic blast.
Ionic blasts never score critical hits. When hit, the ionic blast immediately removes the target's shields from 3 sides (excluding the side furthest from the attacker) and inflicts the ionic effect on the target, reducing its hit and critical hit chances during the next round.

5fd15925-53be-487a-be63-86d15f9a5551.Text: Fires 4 flak shots each dealing 15 damage to targets in a 3×3 area.

ca1864f6-5100-4b1b-a86a-7c73b0b7f8d2.Text: Fires 4 flak shots each dealing 22 damage to targets in a 3×3 area.

b16fa98e-98d5-4a7e-9ec5-06e9ad25f6f9.Text:
Shoots the {g|Encyclopedia:LanceWeaponSpace}lance weapon{/g} in sensory overload mode.
In this mode, the lance weapon suffers a −15% penalty to hit chance but inflicts the sensory overload effect on its target. This effect significantly reduces the target's {g|Encyclopedia:ManoeuvrabilitySpace}manoeuvrability{/g} for the next round.

05b12540-f277-413d-bea1-b350fd1e6df3.Text: Implants maddening thoughts into the weak-willed members of the enemy crew, making them start {g|Encyclopedia:InternalFiresSpace}fires{/g} aboard their own ships.

5efe59dc-e1b8-413b-8802-fe6f69cf4762.Text:
Makes the ship instantly stop and shoot its {g|Encyclopedia:LanceWeaponSpace}lance weapons{/g} 3 times instead of moving, suffering <u>(from 5 to 14)</u> {g|Encyclopedia:SpaceBattleDamageGlossary}damage{/g}.
! Can only be used before movement.

8dc27222-8509-44b1-b9ba-6d5881f0d1c4.Text: The voidship makes a short jump through the warp but loses some {g|Encyclopedia:HullIntegritySpace}hull integrity{/g} in the process.

4d7867de-8f09-4a89-b7f6-50614ed32233.Text: The voidship opens a short-lasting warp portal, which {g|Encyclopedia:SpaceBattleDamageGlossary}damages{/g} targets not aligned with Chaos. Watch out!

877b1455-e7e1-4a59-93fc-b725a6f30bb9.Text: Launches a wing of 4 Swiftdeath Fighters. These attack craft are equipped with plasma cannons and deal a large amount of single-target damage.

d11db8cf-f8ed-4b25-a089-db7b6a41969e.Text: Launches a wing of 3 Voidraven Bombers. These attack craft are equipped with void mines and deal a large amount of single-target damage.

4ec24c1e-5722-4dfa-9726-a3e7f682b740.Text: A long-ranged {g|Encyclopedia:LanceWeaponSpace}lance weapon{/g} dealing 63 {g|Encyclopedia:SpaceBattleDamageGlossary}damage{/g} to a chosen enemy within a narrow {g|Encyclopedia:FiringArcSpace}firing arc{/g}.

fe649f6d-437a-42b8-a560-f002c0ca9071.Text: A long-ranged {g|Encyclopedia:LanceWeaponSpace}lance weapon{/g} dealing 84 {g|Encyclopedia:SpaceBattleDamageGlossary}damage{/g} to a chosen enemy within a narrow {g|Encyclopedia:FiringArcSpace}firing arc{/g}.

a2531227-7c5e-41e7-9b47-672fddc1db2f.Text:
{g|Encyclopedia:TorpedoLaunchersSpace}Torpedo tubes{/g} capable of firing 5 neutron torpedoes per {g|Encyclopedia:TorpedoSalvoSpace}salvo{/g}.
<indent=5%>Reload: 2 rounds</indent>

90fb5998-66c4-49e4-980b-b5afff49f02b.Text:
{g|Encyclopedia:TorpedoLaunchersSpace}Torpedo tubes{/g} capable of firing 5 neutron torpedoes per {g|Encyclopedia:TorpedoSalvoSpace}salvo{/g}.
<indent=5%>Reload: 1 round</indent>

47a45dec-8eb2-4912-964c-1dc7854f2a7b.Text: Plasma cannons operated by a pilot.

3fb270a2-bf92-47bd-ad89-618d70e3df53.Text: A long-ranged {g|Encyclopedia:LanceWeaponSpace}lance weapon{/g} dealing <u>(from 55 to 65)</u> {g|Encyclopedia:SpaceBattleDamageGlossary}damage{/g} to a chosen enemy within a narrow {g|Encyclopedia:FiringArcSpace}firing arc{/g}.

2e2c1c0a-9fad-4901-a150-82ccc0039b71.Text: A medium ranged light {g|Encyclopedia:LanceWeaponSpace}lance weapon{/g} dealing <u>(from 40 to 48)</u> {g|Encyclopedia:SpaceBattleDamageGlossary}damage{/g}.

8610896b-1b38-44ab-86dd-808794322b81.Text: Short-ranged {g|Encyclopedia:DorsalSpace}dorsal{/g} melta {g|Encyclopedia:MacroCannonsSpace}macro-cannons{/g}, which fire 2 shots, dealing 22 {g|Encyclopedia:SpaceBattleDamageGlossary}damage{/g} per each shot.

de8b4813-e6db-4b42-b7ce-e4179b502ca9.Text: Short-ranged broadside melta {g|Encyclopedia:MacroCannonsSpace}macro-cannons{/g} with 4 shots, dealing 22 {g|Encyclopedia:SpaceBattleDamageGlossary}damage{/g} per shot.

6a5f42f9-7e56-47f5-a426-fcce2eef6c5d.Text: Long-range broadside plasma {g|Encyclopedia:MacroCannonsSpace}macro-cannons{/g}, which fire 3 shots, dealing 40 {g|Encyclopedia:SpaceBattleDamageGlossary}damage{/g} per shot.

72bdc3b1-60f5-4aec-a65d-2d28c6abc60f.Text:
{g|Encyclopedia:TorpedoLaunchersSpace}Torpedo tubes{/g} capable of firing 4 corrupted melta torpedoes per {g|Encyclopedia:TorpedoSalvoSpace}salvo{/g}.
<indent=5%>Reload: 2 rounds</indent>

944b06ae-71e3-4757-a1b5-400225042342.Text: A long-ranged {g|Encyclopedia:DorsalSpace}dorsal{/g} missile launcher, which fires 5 missiles, dealing 18 {g|Encyclopedia:SpaceBattleDamageGlossary}damage{/g} per missile.

a422bb9e-8456-4218-bd47-0f04e0c7be60.Text: Medium-range {g|Encyclopedia:LanceWeaponSpace}lance weapon{/g} dealing <u>(from 36 to 52)</u> {g|Encyclopedia:SpaceBattleDamageGlossary}damage{/g} to a chosen enemy within a narrow {g|Encyclopedia:FiringArcSpace}firing arc{/g}.

3657fd02-fc9d-427a-abeb-2cdeeda43daf.Text: A short-ranged {g|Encyclopedia:ProwSpace}prow{/g} missile launcher, which fires 6 missiles, dealing 18 {g|Encyclopedia:SpaceBattleDamageGlossary}damage{/g} per missile.

8389fd69-dfee-4206-82f7-f09901ad5273.Text: A short-ranged {g|Encyclopedia:ProwSpace}prow{/g} missile launcher, which fires 10 missiles, dealing 18 {g|Encyclopedia:SpaceBattleDamageGlossary}damage{/g} per missile.

6dd65b21-72c6-4266-8181-22a24dc5fb7a.Text: A short-ranged {g|Encyclopedia:ProwSpace}prow{/g} missile launcher, which fires 5 missiles, dealing 11 {g|Encyclopedia:SpaceBattleDamageGlossary}damage{/g} per missile.

0962b347-cec4-4b43-b2a7-7e86fce2e56f.Text: A short-ranged {g|Encyclopedia:DorsalSpace}dorsal{/g} missile launcher, which fires 3 missiles, dealing 18 {g|Encyclopedia:SpaceBattleDamageGlossary}damage{/g} per missile.

01328751-ce17-48f9-9517-f7c68b51a20c.Text:
{g|Encyclopedia:TorpedoLaunchersSpace}Torpedo tubes{/g} each capable of firing 2 salvos of 6 short-burning leech torpedoes.
<indent=5%>Reload: 2 rounds</indent>

ea110b73-4771-4d07-a423-8ca762ff4b1c.Text: Each {g|Encyclopedia:DirectHitSpace}direct hit{/g} of this torpedo has a 40% chance to reduce the target's {g|Encyclopedia:SpeedSpace}speed{/g}.

0f885a11-bd4d-4098-8643-67dd60bb8e15.Text:
{g|Encyclopedia:TorpedoLaunchersSpace}Torpedo tubes{/g} capable of firing 5 plasma torpedoes with 20 {g|Encyclopedia:SpaceBattleDamageGlossary}damage{/g} warheads.
<indent=5%>Reload: 1 round</indent>

d1986eb7-5391-42a6-961c-fbfe0f584610.Text: For one {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}, all of Chorda's {g|Encyclopedia:AreaOfEffect}area attacks{/g} automatically critically {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} and her {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical damage{/g} is increased by +({g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}WP{/g} / 2)%.{br} ! Can only be used once per combat.

b327448b-fb3d-4646-abd9-2ec71220a060.Text:
Chorda gains a <u>(2 × {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}WP{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g})</u>% chance to ignore any enemy {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} or {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g}. This chance is doubled against attacks or abilities of daemons and {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic powers{/g}.
Additionally, Chorda uses Willpower instead of {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerFellowship}Fellowship{/g} for determining her {g|Encyclopedia:Resolve}resolve{/g} and for {g|Encyclopedia:CareerTacticianGlossary}Master Tactician{/g} abilities.

aaf94612-c74d-4017-928c-00d0f718d58d.Text: Uralon randomly summons one of the following daemons: Pink Horror, Daemonette, Plaguebearer, or Bloodletter. That daemon fights on Uralon's side until the end of combat. This {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} can be used again if at least 9 enemies were killed in combat.

92e706bc-4077-47bf-b133-10ed89f56295.Text: Uralon gains the {g|f:9395d6c10694470f8c8ea3c74c7e09c7}Go for the Throat{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g}. Additionally, he gains +5 {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerFellowship}Fellowship{/g} until the end of combat each time he kills an enemy in {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee combat{/g}.

bc10b4bf-e977-4896-aef9-69e2a66ec2b8.Text: Winterscale gains +20 {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}Weapon Skill{/g} and +40 {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerStrength}Strength{/g} but becomes uncontrollable until the end of combat. Uncontrollable: the creature always tries to attack the nearest target. ! Can only be used with a {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee{/g} weapon in hand.

35b87aaa-8ea8-4c76-8b9a-90d1f8fed752.Text: Every kill with a {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee{/g} weapon permanently increases Winterscale's melee {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} by +1%. While he has less than 50% of his maximum {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}, those {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonuses{/g} are doubled.

de58e285-b937-4a00-a34d-7125138cc317.Text: Deals <u>{g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerStrength}STR{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g}</u> {g|Encyclopedia:RendingDamage}rending damage{/g} to Marazhai, and he starts {g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}bleeding{/g}. While Marazhai is bleeding, he gains +3 {g|Encyclopedia:Resolve}resolve{/g}.

cad49fa8-cbdc-47c6-ac60-0a70e2c6dbd3.Text: While Marazhai is {g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}bleeding{/g}, every kill he makes grants him a stacking +5 {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}Weapon Skill{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerBallisticSkill}Ballistic Skill{/g}.

8a54c186-efc0-431c-b26f-b6e813fce9a8.Text: While Marazhai is {g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}bleeding{/g}, his {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerFellowship}Fellowship{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} are increased by +15.

5cec0455-26a4-4b94-8e8d-a47c5aa41966.Text: When Marazhai makes an additional attack granted by {g|f:1b26e486d9974b9ca26d055413fb3e01}Dual-Weapon Combat{/g}, using a Drukhari weapon, that attack suffers no penalties and does not have its cost increased.

1cd785f7-c121-46ed-8c2c-3950423e6a21.Text: Each time the Rogue Trader is {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damaged{/g}, they gain +3 {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g}, and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerFellowship}Fellowship{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.

ec93cc53-9f05-4c49-8792-15385f50f04c.Text: The Rogue Trader gains a {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} +2 {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g}, and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerFellowship}Fellowship{/g} each time any creature in a 5-cell radius suffers {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}.

cf943253-1ec9-4c9b-92ca-0d27526b242a.Text: Yrliet ends her turn. At the start of her next turn (excluding extra turns), if possible, she makes an attack that cannot miss and does not count toward the attack limit per turn.

3ddeafc4-4e4a-46ab-be27-afe6310259ee.Text: {g|f:48139b5d8510426fa2d07a55f99236f5}In My Sights{/g} gains additional {g|Encyclopedia:ArmourPenetration}armour penetration{/g} equal to {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerPerception}<u>Perception</u>{/g}%.

381a6aec-b5a0-4b43-86bc-f1088f0c0558.Text: {g|f:48139b5d8510426fa2d07a55f99236f5}In My Sights{/g} gains additional {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeReduction}dodge reduction{/g} equal to {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerBallisticSkill}<u>Ballistic Skill</u>{/g}%.

237cf086-ee96-47bf-b205-6d44ce0dd5d9.Text: When Yrliet kills a target with a {g|Encyclopedia:SingleRangedAttacksGlossary}single-shot{/g} attack from Aeldari weapon for the first time in a {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}, she immediately gains an additional attack.

309d42ca-aec4-4b72-abe2-248cf8578273.Text: The ambull mother brutally slams the ground, dealing {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} to all enemies on loose ground.

e4812187-be40-4c3c-b929-a4063e7a2781.Text: The ambull mother burrows herself into the ground causing her brood to emerge on the surface. While underground, the ambull mother cannot be targeted or {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damaged{/g}. All {g|Encyclopedia:NegativeEffectTypesGlossary}negative effects{/g} are also removed.

9c720c19-0376-4f48-82ee-3c1321013526.Text: The ambull mother urges her brood to emerge to the surface.

6e5ed340-f3e2-4d58-a88f-ee73d26a8870.Text: The ambull mother emerges to the surface. All enemies adjacent to where she emerges must pass an {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} or fall {g|Encyclopedia:ProneEffect}prone{/g}.

8ad91073-dce8-4fe1-8878-ee2fc4dae8d6.Text: The ambull mother tunnels underground to her next target and emerges back to the surface.

c5052dfe-1248-4d01-959d-43ef64f7fa8f.Text: This creature cannot be targeted and has immunity to {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}.

5fcb7008-09da-442b-9adb-65bdbcd33397.Text:
Ambulls can sense their targets out on loose ground. Quickly, find a solid platform to stand on!
Whenever a target ends its {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} on loose ground, the ambull mother immediately starts her turn, unleashes her wrath upon that target, and then ends her turn.

50e17991-58a1-45e5-8cc2-469fff1e3c15.Text: Once the ambull mother loses a third of her {g|Encyclopedia:MaxWounds}maximum wounds{/g} (and later, once she loses two thirds), she immediately uses {g|f:0c133569641d4e079d914963cebe015d}Burrow{/g}, causing her brood to emerge to the surface. She also uses this {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} during her {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} if no targets are located on loose ground.

35b851b9-76ed-4bcf-8cfc-55a22d34f511.Text: Whenever an enemy ends their {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} on loose ground, the ambull mother immediately starts her turn, unleashes her wrath upon that enemy, and then ends her turn.

6505d02c-07bf-4ea3-b52b-b277b60d9173.Text: Once all young ambulls are killed, the ambull mother immediately gains an {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}extra turn{/g}.

51b2184d-edd1-4e31-980d-9056b704d31b.Text: An ambull deals additional {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} to targets on loose ground (with the {g|f:05d5bc8b6f234521af42bc5f1050ee70}get off the ground!{/g} effect), even if the attack is {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodged{/g} or {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parried{/g}.

1f190f72-4341-46ca-8c8f-7c47beab568b.Text: An ambull is immune to effects that change its {g|Encyclopedia:PriorityTarget}priority target{/g} and selects among targets on loose ground (with the {g|f:05d5bc8b6f234521af42bc5f1050ee70}get off the ground!{/g} effect). It deals additional {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} to those targets, even if the attack is {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodged{/g} or {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parried{/g}.

28b60d57-4699-4736-85f1-8f8fdf79e59c.Text: An ambull has the natural ability to navigate and hunt underground by detecting vibrations. As a result, it is immune to the blinded effect.

f160c9a8-9e2d-42b0-9972-30f4fe3f2ab8.Text: All ambulls suffer −50% less mental and {g|Encyclopedia:WarpDamage}warp damage{/g}. Their {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} cannot be reduced below 35%.

30af572a-5d0c-4048-8a5b-375e45da74ab.Text: This creature is immune to all types of forced movement.

aeb915e3-f100-4f26-9a8f-8736659b4d92.Text: When the closest immortal creature's {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} drop below 50%, the closest scarab will try to move and reconstruct it. Has 2 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rounds{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Cooldown}cooldown{/g}.

c0c1548f-0d36-4ace-9b0e-aef9f088670c.Text: When this creature dies, it explodes and deals <u>(from 7 to 25)</u> {g|Encyclopedia:ImpactDamage}impact damage{/g} to everyone in a 2-cell radius.

57d67cfe-a6ae-47f6-96ec-c96d774156b4.Text:
Each attack made by the creature decreases the target's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} by −5 and {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g} by −2 until the end of combat.
Each 2 points of {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} dealt will increase the creature's overall damage by +1.

7afd8a39-7824-4250-91da-9260d7e49a36.Text: The creature will explode after death, dealing heavy {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} around it.

af43acce-386d-439e-a269-0e58ec48cd9b.Text: An expression of utter astonishment is frozen on the slain rebel's blood-drenched face.

9f1aa158-d4fe-41dc-93f9-ae215afa990e.Text: These bodies have been hacked up and dismembered using an unknown weapon — you have never seen wounds like these before. A darkened handle is sticking out from the middle of the gory pile.

744a15d9-b5b9-4bd0-8632-2c726cecf2ad.Text: The gory prints have gone dry: whoever left these grim marks came and went a long time ago.

e64a0c7a-e15d-406d-8a0d-7e139c439a63.Text: Lord Captain, the enforcers have discovered a mysterious tool from the armoury of the voidship Mourningstar on the officers' deck. On the Seneschal's orders, it has been placed inside the safe in your quarters.

a6fbe82d-8059-4c99-a3ef-07d67bab6d85.Text: A metal tag, barely visible through the black, caked blood covering the handle, identifies the shovel's provenance as the armoury of the voidship Mourningstar.

68513889-d248-4d7f-a5cb-5c288ea94c9a.Text: It seems as if the skilfully crafted sculpture is about to step down from its podium.

3fec3c2c-c374-4f6e-8271-c6b909b84539.Text: Statue by the famous Calixian sculptor and chronicler Zacharius Vernon the Magnificent. The twenty-third year of this millennium. Original.

960fa2a7-5e8f-47a4-ab07-d1ce68c584fe.Text: A deep cut extends across the mutant's throat and a holy Aquila has been carved into their forehead.

63f3152f-2006-4df5-a793-00db2e93996a.Text: A deep cut extends across the mutant's throat and a holy Aquila has been carved into their forehead. Traitors are often executed in this way.

f000281e-ef41-4591-8786-301fbe0bbb98.Text: The strong but timid spirit of the sacred machine refuses to obey, frightened by the violence going on around it.

835bb57c-f8e1-40db-8bba-116341977c0b.Text: Tear down the door with the sacred loader

e60ac2c2-6917-42fc-ad64-280392076832.Text: A poorly placed melta charge explodes in a seething cloud of plasma instead of burning through the thick plasteel with a focused energy beam.

b96c9ef5-1d2e-415a-9fae-afcd0b2cddd5.Text: Blow up the door with a melta charge

681d9233-679d-429b-8871-2013012e21b2.Text: The servo-skull probably circled its dead master until its energy sources ran out.

c2a0c3c4-d116-4460-be02-169e2b20eb59.Text: There are trophies inside the opened chest.

2b3766f7-3440-47a7-bdca-14922e48991e.Text: Something goes wrong — the shock wave hits you instead of the blockage.

e5ed5949-4258-4ba1-8be7-af46beedef95.Text: There is nothing here but scraps of metal.

898adf90-9cf9-489b-9d27-23a10a0ed4ce.Text: Find the code to the safe

a9c5db04-e47d-487f-8d52-a25d7f3fb991.Text: Connect the cable to the cogitator

481cd2e2-aa0e-485c-afb9-e6c6d748f01f.Text: There is nothing here but cheap scrap metal.

f1faac7f-ccad-4c1a-9072-b1a4e73470c8.Text: Among the wreckage was an instruction manual for the duty officer on how to access the safes. You can obtain the codes to the safes by logging in to the ship's cogitators.

eab9c455-87d3-45be-908f-142eadd901ce.Text: The cogitators appear to be inoperative.

5e51c594-0f27-43d6-b358-12682315fc5f.Text: The cogitator is off, but appears intact. You can try to power it from a local source.

96ee03f3-905c-4554-a284-6afba044909a.Text: You failed to overcome the protection and obtain the code from the safe.

26747633-353d-4d78-8d2e-b99526d49f1b.Text: You successfully logged in with the duty officer credentials and obtained the code to the old safe.

cbadc1de-7b00-405f-946c-3c0c2387ee91.Text: An unknown container, very strong and securely locked.

745ed30a-9eea-4779-a5a9-51452c0ebd6c.Text: A damaged safe. The contents of similar safes are destroyed when hacking is attempted. You should not try to open it just like that, but something from the environment could help.

2549ef8f-38b8-4103-814a-b3fee10526dc.Text: This fake door is connected to a mine trigger.

4b69e122-5365-49e0-a918-801e1ee389c2.Text: Rising sun symbol. It seems oddly repulsive, even sinister.

419ef9ba-d13d-44f6-b16c-fe89c8b5236e.Text: A dilapidated journal — many pages are torn out, the handwriting is confusing, nothing can be made out.

d75197e4-fd1f-4c16-b077-2777e796ac8a.Text: A journal of one of the locals. The handwriting is barely legible, but it appears to mark the births and deaths of the inhabitants of the small community of mutants. There is no one to add the last entry.

a2def582-0373-4f44-a7d7-dc6ad1e6815f.Text: The anvil looks like an alien primitive element among the machines surrounding it.

078e229a-e255-4305-b110-298cd74bef82.Text: The anvil, covered with the inscriptions and symbols of Chaos, is designed for the work of one person — a forge master who is capable of creating sorcerous components used in complex machines.

9ee28279-b5ab-44ea-ab6f-2979c40377a4.Text: The metal arch is blood-stained and melted in some places as if from unbearable heat.

96dabbf1-6523-4f55-ba9a-4f10874be9a0.Text: Looking into the centre of the arch, you begin to hear noise: the warp amplifier seeps with sorcerous energies designed to fuel the dark rituals of Chaos.

a76ef941-d3cf-4898-ae45-29ce9b9fb731.Text: The symbol has been desecrated, so much so that you can hardly guess the original features of the image.

87074828-63b2-4273-9af2-2f4fea38305d.Text: Mutilated and defiled, the Aquila looks like a pathetic parody of the sacred symbol of the Imperium.

41c851c5-ae2e-4711-ae45-e6b0d5644b9c.Text: The statue is vandalised and mutilated, but even in this form, a figure in a robe is recognisable as one of the revered Tech-Priests of the Adeptus Mechanicus.

3261c7f0-8178-461f-8e9e-e1c7ec2f6484.Text: A strange construction that has been extensively vandalised — someone purposefully disfigured it and beat off the pieces, taking out their anger on the dead metal.

3daa2bdb-a71a-47b5-ab1a-cf5ab648b8fb.Text: The remains of a ritual performed on a disassembled Daemon Engine.

4af4da4a-255b-4e40-a114-cee5a6ba59e2.Text: Traces of an unholy ritual requiring human sacrifice. A grim reminder of the price exacted to create each Daemon Engine.

ef007f2e-8872-4a95-afda-645546463f7e.Text: The floor is covered with foul symbols and covered in red — it seems that blood was purposefully drawn out of them, prolonging the suffering of the unfortunate.

391f1fd5-8c8b-4e73-a10a-a4b25e465ab3.Text: The remnants of a foul ritual designed to feed the souls of victims into the shell of a Daemon Engine — a necessary element of the process to strengthen the monster's physical form.

40aeccfa-7862-4c37-a580-60734ba890b6.Text: You cannot make out a single detail on the cogitator screen: the sacred machine is so defiled that your knowledge of the Omnissiah's gifts is powerless.

f33a7144-ccbf-4e1b-b300-0fce018f814c.Text: A huge machine of unknown purpose, red-hot from a working built-in furnace. The howl coming from the firebox seems to be the roar of an angry daemon.

e439ae48-8275-4903-9784-eaeefaeacf57.Text: A huge machine, red-hot from a working built-in furnace. Traces of blood and scratches are visible on the bypass of the firebox — undoubtedly, the burning of living people was part of some blasphemous ritual.

16913541-cf28-45ab-8a41-c8576e66bf3c.Text: The manufactorum has been completely converted from rock and metal processing to a much more sinister purpose: the lines have been set up to manufacture shells for Daemon Engines.

a9c4d8a9-4ce5-4d88-b849-c63eca4e324d.Text: The machine is strikingly different from those found at the upper level of the manufactorum — its surface is littered with foreign components and extra pipes that at first glance look completely useless.

07fccb32-83d0-46df-b09a-3c95399b48ba.Text: The machine is functional, but heavily altered: you see redundant parts and crudely welded modules, stinking oil oozes from the cracks, and the dashboard is covered with symbols of Chaos. There is no doubt that all these manipulations were intended to change the purpose of the device.

8d51c80b-f23d-4e21-bf05-e0ee862d78c0.Text: The people in cages are exhausted to their limit. The bodies of many have been distorted by mutations.

e6acab1e-3779-4306-8654-37ca6ce52770.Text: The air around the caged people is almost ringing with sorcerous energy — before you are psykers, whose powers, even at rest, create disturbances in the warp.

865e5b33-fd81-44d8-9712-f8f5b0e8a112.Text: The injectors are filled with an unknown concoction that is delivered into the bodies of the weakened captives.

88da9464-ad96-4655-9962-eecf08eaf41a.Text: The injectors are filled with powerful sedatives — a sensible precaution that keeps the captives under the complete control of their tormentors.

5d24b3d5-47c9-406d-b6f3-5fe089e6eb38.Text: The people in fetters are long dead — the smell of decay leaves no doubt.

21a28e71-30de-40d2-a3e0-536081cd0135.Text: The fetters that hold the victims are designed in such a way as to increase suffering — there is no doubt that torment is one of the elements of a dark ritual.

25c2d0b0-8186-43ae-9998-53eeb31e88cc.Text: The bodies are dressed in rags and armed with faulty weapons. You notice many handmade Aquilas and other symbols of faith.

95f9a969-f04d-4fed-9c21-8a53b0456c31.Text: The former warehouse of the planet's defenders. The crates marked "Provisions" are empty, and the weapons are simple and of poor quality.

178d6b3f-f8fe-49cc-b8eb-04a9814174f6.Text: Headless body. Nothing definite can be said about it.

4e1e98d3-224e-46ef-9954-087b591fd78a.Text: By the nature of the injuries, it is clear that the head of this man was literally wrenched off, unscrewed from the body.

39e67c15-aab7-41c0-8206-ec1e8b5686f3.Text: A fragment of ship plating bearing unholy symbols. It seems the vessel was shot over the planet, as some of the debris reached the surface.

962d08e6-9383-4d8e-967c-daa69cc3564b.Text: The bodies of the defenders seem to have exploded from within.

4d49586b-323e-4f42-b860-8e618bcb304c.Text: The lasgun batteries are depleted. These people fought to the last breath.

3d5afaa4-810d-4963-a6fa-5f012536fff6.Text: The bodies of the defenders were clearly being prepared for some hideous ritual.

0638b741-7d23-4cfb-9b28-ed719bd6783e.Text: The pulpit is almost intact — it was no doubt fiercely defended. Nearby lies the body of the preacher — it was from here that he recited his last prayer.

bb1206d6-389e-495a-bc54-66ac043f0ba5.Text: The search did not produce any results — you may need to look elsewhere

af4cc63f-cc62-43d2-af5c-11f4ccd649d6.Text: The seams of the machine cannot be loosened — you cannot dismantle the implement.

97b3f6f5-ab11-4a06-b8c5-2f722b735587.Text: Nothing in this semi-darkness stands out from the rout around you.

2ed4b482-3f01-45fc-94c1-e00aafe1cf40.Text: Hide enforcers in the ventilation system

457270e6-ea2a-4789-8012-b4d1df1fc525.Text: To the streets of the Chasm

c48b28e3-003e-44b7-b387-28d9e9cc594c.Text: To the forests of Quetza Temer

6d925fa9-232b-42da-b370-0d946c7d5d19.Text: To the scene of the slaughter

8e8f5265-b96a-468f-a721-8dda680d8b48.Text: The indispensable Astropaths are instrumental in establishing communication between worlds and ships on the scale of the entire immense galaxy. Continually exposed to the Immaterium's terrors, many of these psykers perish, go insane, or even meet a fate worse than death.

ab9d91b0-435d-4c83-93d1-96cf71ebf3eb.Text: Death cultists are sacred executioners who worship the Emperor through slaughter and bloodshed. Their grim faith and chilling rituals instil a superstitious dread in ordinary people.

267da7b6-989a-47bf-8073-cbdca2a4de91.Text: A voidship is like a city unto itself, inhabited by thousands of people, most of whom are disenfranchised rabble providing an easily replaceable workforce. The common folk's only mission in life is to toil away in the name of the flagship's insatiable demands.

f48ab19b-549e-484f-9f4e-dbcf4ea3b622.Text: Laid to rest in the ship's crypt are members of House von Valancius and their loyal subjects who were given the honour of accompanying their Rogue Traders beyond the grave.

ef1bdd92-3b7d-4059-9c4b-cee3e1f2d905.Text: For the underclasses, there is nothing but back-breaking labour in the gloom of the lower decks; meanwhile, the Rogue Trader's officers and high-ranking servants enjoy the many luxuries the upper decks offer. The flagship's higher-ups receive the best food, clean water, and quality medicine.

622ae98c-d9a4-4767-be6e-239397a8358d.Text: At the heart of the flagship's power systems are the plasma drive chambers, which house its main reactor. Here, Tech-Priests remain on operational duty at all times to take care of its mighty machine spirit.

89b1c02d-a7d9-4e4b-b46b-b03849ceda36.Text: Every ship of the Imperium has shrines. This is where the servants of the Ecclesiarchy watch over the purity of the crew's faith and fortify its members' spirits on journey after journey through the dark corners of the galaxy where unthinkable horrors lurk.

ae7ff750-bb05-4fae-b0d6-85bff0fbe61f.Text: Test scene for Exploration, Anomalies and Space Systems

c27e68fb-9d1f-49e8-94be-9dcf4aadf301.Text: Willkommen zu Hause, mein lieber UI team!

b7cab339-fab5-4fb3-9f97-9e9de84d84e4.Text: "In the name of the Chorda dynasty, I order you to lower your weapons! Do not aggravate your sentence by resisting!"

d7942a02-8bb7-47ae-85ec-ca179c8e882a.Text: "They'll hang us all! Don't trust them, lads!"

e8f6acf0-0f63-40be-856a-35f8f8adb1a5.Text: "I hoped you would respond like this. Enforcers, attack! For the justice of Chorda and the Emperor!"

4e0bf5a2-efd4-4809-97f7-26211dcb7039.Text: The huge walls that rise above the chaotic buildings of Footfall are strikingly different from the small houses and squalid huts sitting huddled under the soaring arches.

7c8607b6-44a7-424c-9043-ec17f5776be8.Text: "Darkness lurks beyond the bright flashes... no... two darknesses. One streaked with red, with clanking shackles and false preaching. The other a bilious yellow, the tang of roiling blood, and screams of pain..."

548fb8da-9cdc-4efe-80fe-13530175e1d0.Text: "The colours of this place are flecked with sparks of pain — bright scarlet, blackish crimson, deathly grey... A kaleidoscope of despair and madness..."

63ab5e47-43ff-4e2b-b36c-b2412b5fbe90.Text: "What are all these enforcers and soldiers doing in this shelter? Why are they not on the streets, fighting back against the enemies of Humanity?"

120bef4f-90ab-4bb3-9d1d-fa2389a06531.Text: "I presume it is because the governor does not wish to be without his personal guard — even behind the metre-thick walls of his bunker. Typical."

b96aafd7-c662-420f-b35a-8f77337a72ec.Text: "They're scrabbling around, digging into my skull from the inside — it's like nails dragging down these metal walls..."

d1eead0a-5759-424e-9c9c-cdccd7c3d32a.Text: "I have conducted a visual survey of the locale. The bunker's metal cladding is fully intact and undamaged."

25594892-aefb-4e33-b4df-e580fca3763c.Text: "Dark green, gloomy and stifling, fills this space like dense fog... The people here are drained, exhausted, bewildered."

f490b765-1707-41e5-8cae-3cb12fe0e541.Text: "The protracted rebellion has no doubt taken a toll on the soldiers' morale. Discipline and loyalty to the God-Emperor, that is what sustains people when emotional reserves are depleted."

34cfe890-88c7-4b79-b51c-e2fb9db3519d.Text: "Now that the heresy of rebellion has engulfed this entire world, no walls will offer shelter from His furious judgement."

5e75622f-85f4-460e-8161-3f448e95ddd4.Text: "Indeed. Our only option is to fight to the last drop of blood and secure victory for the glory of the Emperor, or to die in the attempt."

126f43c7-5f4d-488b-b3e1-29dd40d0b5a3.Text: "It's absolutely vast! The sky above seems to stretch on and on. And all the spires below — hundreds and hundreds of them... So this is the Rogue Trader's palace!"

70d873f3-c6b5-4a60-bf77-bc7ca918bd79.Text: "You've got that right — it's an impressive sight to behold. Although my eternal quest for wisdom means I simply must get a peek at {mf|his|her} private quarters. What? Cassia, are you blushing?"

982c772d-1cbf-4b65-90cc-13410e2261b2.Text: "And here we are... home once more. It is strange to return here without Lady Theodora."

d84e5719-4a78-4afe-9565-efea5ed5fa28.Text: "Come on, she despised this place. She called it a 'nest of gossips and malcontents.' I have missed sleeping in a feather bed, mind..."

86cdad79-87dd-4f47-9415-4c588851d636.Text: "A palace in the clouds... Our rulers also prefer to dwell thus, above the rest of their kin."

e1bfa45c-b1a5-463c-b0e5-cdeb2612ae11.Text: "Humankind has but one ruler, xenos — the eternal and all-seeing God-Emperor, and there is none above Him."

6623333b-ae9e-4239-8043-a06df39036b7.Text: "Get a load of this... My eyes hurt just looking at all the marble and gold. The bosses back on Leira, my homeworld, they lived in mansions like this."

2f576dcd-8be0-4cb5-84f5-a2c95b42df3e.Text: "Leira? That is the name of the rock you crawled off? I will make a note of it. Another world requiring a dose of cleansing fire."

7313b69a-9729-44e4-91c3-a9d8f378f3f3.Text: "Dead rock encased in metal. Mon-keigh structures are repellent. I could never live in such a place."

1490f455-def7-4a23-9cea-df410719273c.Text: "Your kind live on floating graveyards powered by the energy of your dead. If I were you, I would refrain from making any further critiques."

1727f93a-be2b-4286-a6c4-e3e4e54d3908.Text: "I hope we have time to sample the local libations. I have heard rave reviews of Janus's distilleries!"

60e9f8fe-103d-4adf-ab33-5176ffceb7ca.Text: "Dreaming of feasting in a time of plague... True to form as ever, Mistress Heydari."

b646169f-b963-4fc4-ad4c-9508211f0d1a.Text: "Want to know what I'm thinking about? I'm thinking about being in my nice, heated cabin. With a glass of something warm. And somebody warm pressed up against me..."

c54f6e11-b9d4-4af0-b856-21d79547de92.Text: "Hey, quit that giggling! What are we heading into here? Certain death? Or is it meant to be a surprise? So hilarious! Wait, Jae, did you just say something?"

de996b7f-392c-4ba6-b9fb-5c1fce177015.Text: "Such a peaceful scene, the likes of which I haven't seen in a long time. No bright flashes, no riot of colours... Just pure white canvas."

cd5db23a-7930-4f65-8f38-758e92d5e418.Text: "Well, now you've said that, I expect things to take a turn for the worse any minute now. Be on your guard."

305d27b5-952f-464d-89b9-f882e8afc393.Text: "Glory be to the current of the Motive Force! May its dulcet light shine in our Noospheric coronas, may its vitality nourish our augments, may its purity wash over our imperatives and engrams."

1417151b-fa0d-47a8-885d-86fed2327cd1.Text: "As far as I am aware, the monastery supplies power to several major hive cities on Rykad. Hidden somewhere in the depths of this building is a reactor of monstrous, unfathomable power."

def47a37-c82f-4c31-a6ed-c4bfa5e62bad.Text: "Guide my strikes true against the heretics who have encroached upon these halls... Let not one villain escape the God-Emperor's retribution delivered by our hands!"

6df26699-a4cf-484c-be7d-9362c0fea681.Text: "Your hues are so vivid, Sister Argenta. The hatred that fuels your words and impulses burns like a supernova!"

da34db54-4fa2-4160-a83f-a16f9c856361.Text: "Mistress Kibellah, you move with the utmost confidence in unfamiliar places. And yet, until now, you have spent your entire life on a voidship."

9433c8ce-995a-4b42-b299-63dded35f5e7.Text: "This place is almost like the plasma drive chambers on the flagship. The deadly flashes of the machine spark, the smell of scorched flesh — and threads that must be severed."

780e0743-3bd9-4447-a514-50035a8534af.Text: "An odd comparison that omits many details. However, it is fully explained by your narrowness of specialisation — and focus."

5dd43159-cc06-4801-8dc3-c84bf0a4b95a.Text: "Rusty bridges over dusty trenches... How frightfully fascinating. Truly, the mind boggles. Remind me again why we've come all this way?"

7194355d-27a2-4e86-ae40-3ed872eda2df.Text: "As expected, your sluggish and feeble mind is ignorant of the obvious bounty at hand. Any inquisitive explorer would realise that we are near a great source of Knowledge."

021aaa7f-5735-4684-bef6-9852d942abc2.Text: "It's weird... My mind is completely empty. Not a single whisper, no premonitions. Nothing. Just empty."

16313f2e-7401-4d28-878c-c1872c7d80aa.Text: "The witch's mind is at ease — I must be doubly on my guard!"

ee10517e-7899-4dff-a0c9-88da5e9735ba.Text: "The hive is engulfed in smoke. And your palace, it's... We will cleanse it, Rogue Trader — down to the very last xenos."

47e10f5e-0f60-4075-b2ce-a864c22ae4e3.Text: "'To the very last xenos' must be merely a mon-keigh figure of speech, yes?"

0afd2720-507d-455c-8ced-e471474b0e4c.Text: "I cannot believe it... In the entire history of the von Valancius protectorate, there has never been an attack on the capital world."

672542f8-1b1c-46f6-88bd-6f7d5e5311a3.Text: "Being the first and being the best are often one and the same, so my uncle taught me. Looking at the Rogue Trader now, I am not so certain."

1e2a22b0-cb7e-46a1-ad43-8b8699e78f04.Text: "The entire palace is drenched with fear... The dragon has encircled it with its body and crushed its bones. What was true... today has become a lie."

2994dba9-09f3-4e98-bd05-f56c278139da.Text: "The Emperor's light banishes all lies. But you will never understand that."

24e08fb4-fef0-4bdb-8b8b-42679459615f.Text: "The imprint of torment and fatigue has been left upon this world. The mark of my dark cousins is so stark, it cannot be anything but a trap."

605d9006-f742-4c9f-b0ea-a0b2ab077121.Text: "'Dark cousins'? Meaning the xenos that repel even their own repellent kind? My weapon will be put to use here!"

76ede2e9-5b7b-4964-8bae-9b267dcb9c6d.Text: "We have come here... by a dark invitation. The black dragon stirs in the shadows. Drinking blood. Waiting... for you."

f583cca9-30f6-46d1-8ad6-568d7899e737.Text: "Idira, pull yourself together. The governor sent out a call for help — no such entreaty can be considered 'dark.'"

86d87fe4-07c8-4442-a889-09198d6d0c19.Text: "The warp is a sea of evil relentlessly grasping at our souls. It is no surprise that vessels travelling through it so often meet with disaster."

ce55ae37-de72-4167-abbe-2447807a1599.Text: "You are right, Sister. The Sea of Souls can devour even the most skilled voidsmen, for to believe in a tamed warp is to believe in a delusion."

b335fd08-bb01-468e-ba43-9d38ebba0b74.Text: "I sense something strange... a thread running from the recent past to the future. Rivalry. Threat. It carries the taint of warp influence, but just barely."

3449d526-afe0-4416-a49c-f2f974999c9c.Text: "If there is danger here, it would be logical to return to the ship and use the macro-cannons to destroy this vessel."

907c8bd0-6662-4839-aeb4-c95345997988.Text: "I know several individuals who would be willing to lay down a lot of thrones for a pile of this dead scrap... and a couple of obliging Explorators, too."

a2511ee6-bc6a-4146-9230-0668cd08a9b3.Text: "Mistress Heydari, if you ever manage to pull off such a trade, I would be extremely interested in the identities of the purchasers."

ae828a38-72d6-46be-bd5e-ce11131656c4.Text: "Strange. Oghyr bodies disappear after death. These specimens must be defective in some way, as they are still here."

3f26849b-0b7d-41cc-b0fe-7d01902fa8b6.Text: "You sound disappointed. Was the stick insect hoping to cut a deal with them and stab us in the back?"

0b038bc4-f548-4781-90b5-97068956d2f7.Text: "Even the wicked xenos were no match for the scourge that has befallen them. How pitiful their empty shells look..."

d9e1a2e3-7008-42d2-a702-5775f1931ab4.Text: "I hope it is not a ploy to lure us in. However, they do appear to be quite dead."

07fa4b35-8844-4af2-88c3-f3ab395fc46c.Text: "Nice little spot! It's good to see folks enjoying themselves. Even the air in here feels nicer to breathe!"

abb84bad-697c-4aa2-bc86-7bdbde7ab08d.Text: "An entire establishment dedicated to unproductive and parasitical pursuits. A waste of station space."

b42f8525-37eb-4eb0-8e23-a8ed13b048c5.Text: "My, this place has so many colours. Every shade I can imagine is floating in the air!"

719053c3-d2b7-4b3f-a3de-081072cdf0de.Text: "Colours, you say? Next she'll be asking us to take her on a tavern crawl... Spare me."

91a42db8-003d-4af1-aff5-9c5b6503a1af.Text: "Every time I come here, I nearly go deaf. The sounds of the past assault my ears — trumpets of glory interrupted by the rustling of rags, and the clinking of coins above everything else."

fd53c619-c550-4667-8ac8-6b9e38314d3f.Text: "This place is turning me nearly deaf as well, and that's without sorcerous voices in my head. If it's not swearing, it's merchants shouting, or gunshots — it's the same wherever one goes on Footfall!"

02d72d77-4662-449c-a172-8305b49f9c3e.Text: "This place was intended to be merely a hall within the temple. But now a whole city has been squeezed into it!"

33974ee9-814d-4378-9d1f-b59ab688673c.Text: "A rational decision. Ecclesiarchy temples lack the critical functionality that a void station requires. Unlike the chapels of the Adeptus Mechanicus."

e7dac989-26bb-484e-b196-2788bf0fbc90.Text: "I am forever astonished that Reverend Hieronymus makes do with that shoebox of a chapel in the Atrium for his sermons. Footfall has several temples far more befitting his status."

a4b6e7ff-4195-46e0-a19e-aedc002d5fcf.Text: "The Drusians are a unique order. They teach people to be content with little, and they follow that principle themselves."

b647aaa9-fe6c-4a40-a7f0-d45196cc2120.Text: "Small in large, metal in rock. I discern two layers, two ideas, in this place, and one — shallow and shifting — has swallowed the other."

0a158906-7952-4e2f-8d2a-48baa859b4ec.Text: "Footfall is an iconic place, a grand monument to immense ambition and dashed hopes."

9d3524b3-bd39-4b4c-85d2-f5fc057d8964.Text: "Vladaym will be as slippery as a snake, like any seasoned operator. I don't need any voices in my head to predict that."

4c9d6b74-419b-4dd4-85c1-45aef8a59ac6.Text: "Some leaders hold onto power with an iron fist, but Tocara isn't the type. He's an opportunist... a brilliant opportunist."

cfbedcc0-1284-49cc-b772-283c46a37293.Text: "We're paying Vladaym a visit? Ah, he'll be overjoyed to see his old friend!"

5f7b4e88-2599-4d60-a19a-23941e273322.Text: "Your words are shrouded in thick green smoke, but warm yellow light shines through... You truly are pleased to see him, aren't you?"

d454b187-4f45-4407-99d9-14b3bbabe751.Text: "The Kasballica trade xeno-artefacts on Footfall, and fairly blatantly at that. And the Ordo Xenos is in no hurry to rectify the situation..."

cb465034-4804-4b0d-b6f2-cc854c6e54fc.Text: "We know everything we need to, and we are monitoring everything we need to."

7411f74c-b0b5-4381-8790-f1af896f36e1.Text: "The Shadow Quarters... When I was last on Footfall, I used to take my weapon and wander this area, anticipating an encounter with a mutant or a bandit."

1865ed1c-6a88-4f63-8b10-097dfba616cc.Text: "Why are your recollections of this so blue? And the more you talk about it, the darker the blue becomes..."

6dc65c16-2ef8-4f7e-bfc1-11f934e53c84.Text: "I hear strange... breathing, full of poison and disease, masquerading as prayer..."

8ee4d1d0-fd5b-4ec2-9a82-47402ab7433d.Text: "For ones such as you, the most sincere prayer would be poison."

914606fa-a4c5-415e-82c7-5c40d57c046e.Text: "A mon-keigh warren. How curious. Your dens look better without the clumsy attempts at grandeur. More natural."

61de17da-2aa5-4bbb-80f0-720d6f2bb461.Text: "This place is different to the other mon-keigh settlements I have seen."

fe5a11a6-d7db-4e63-9dfb-add655cb6e99.Text: "You have seen one agri-world, and a dilapidated one at that, and you have extrapolated from this single data point to reach an assessment of the entire Imperium? A ridiculous syllogism."

cb35e5e6-4290-4fe5-91c8-2354e137bda1.Text: "Alpha-Rho, the best dock on Footfall. It is clean, well equipped, and caters to a higher class of traveller. By local standards, that is."

e7d11143-ec26-49ee-b6fc-69bb78cf0985.Text: "A very polite way of saying 'a filthy hole that's slightly less filthy than the rest,' Seneschal!"

7c18db35-405d-4739-acdb-dbac1483bcd6.Text: "The Footfall dockyard is a blessed wonder of the all-powerful Omnissiah. The rest of the station is extraneous, a superfluous appendage."

3403d6d1-8044-4d5d-8894-2827c151102b.Text: "If you had your way, cogs, all the taverns would have long since been turned into workshops and everyone on the station into servitors!"

81061b89-dcb1-428b-83df-06e19761b9bd.Text: "Van Calox, I would still like to know where you obtained your intelligence about the current situation on Kiava Gamma. The dynasty does not widely disseminate such information..."

4a4e74cc-0f58-479e-812e-2fd87c7a2bef.Text: "It is not a question of how widely you disseminate it, but how thoroughly we question those who possess it."

a6fc503c-8553-4e9d-a7f3-b141ffb277f1.Text: "Ugh, rank! It's as hot as a furnace in here, and it stinks of grease and burnt metal... But there are other smells too... like something rotten..."

36c2cb53-ef8d-4a96-8617-b7d169599fa3.Text: "Your senses do not deceive you: I perceive shades of carrion and death in the fiery glow of the manufactorum. This massive plasteel beast is rotting alive."

15765189-0100-4a83-9b78-44aefdcd97f6.Text: "I am reciting a psalm of data-worship in exaltation of this sacred site of production. I am reciting an auxiliary litany of annunciation. The Omnissiah knows all, comprehends all."

7ddb3fb9-8d8e-4dde-a5b2-c2324dad13c6.Text: "After what happened when we entered the system, my mind is clouded with doubts that this 'sacred site of production' will greet us with myrrh and frankincense..."

6092fc7e-cfb4-4f07-9766-00e6a77c9ebc.Text: "Oh... Poison runs through mechanical veins... The path to your goal seems easy as long as you do not turn back. Fire rages in an iron heart..."

9a14cfda-40aa-4905-a9e0-145779309af2.Text: "Your pronouncements sometimes remind me of our Farseers' prophecies, mon-keigh. Only vaguely, of course — your diviners are hardly comparable to ours."

33addce5-9a89-4eec-9102-330789d8457a.Text: "The protocols for ministering to the machine spirits have been violated in a manner most profane. The ship's Noosphere is overrun with data-impurities!"

14537744-b2a5-4d2c-b091-ca4426de5a0f.Text: "I can sense it too! Machines usually give off barely discernible colours... exactly like your body, Magos. But here... all the hues have blended into muck."

e6621c0e-5c81-4a16-8968-f74bc6d6bcaf.Text: "This place is steeped in corruption, which means that it must be cleansed. With fire. Down to the last crevice."

a178e185-f8aa-4e72-9f1a-9a956a227d44.Text: "Sister, tame your fervour. Your zeal is laudable, but first I must ascertain the intentions of the Archenemy, not crush its manifestations without a second thought."

f59e3fca-813e-4a6a-83e0-02e27d3d5524.Text: "Thousands and thousands of voices crying out for salvation... in hope... with wild promises... Their pain... is your reward, Interrogator."

7bb900c2-cb84-4197-8a82-d0c880f2e956.Text: "I will pretend I did not hear your last words, witch."

1f211b26-8cea-461a-93c4-74d333e3bb0f.Text: "Your mind is swathed in blue-grey smoke, Master van Calox. A heavy colour... for heavy thoughts, I presume?"

7ed40f78-4833-4102-9f42-d03d9f4d4994.Text: "You are a dangerous person, Lady Orsellio. All Navigators are, but your abilities place you in a special category."

f05a437a-0c92-4d39-86a3-e19c6b72f698.Text: "Lord Captain, do you think this... enterprise... is wise? I wouldn't be surprised if this all turns out to be a trap."

9df039f4-a1fb-420a-818c-5c3aee706b10.Text: "I concur with Master Werserian. This place reminds me of the maintenance modules on Eurac V — all the colours are so... grubby."

5b726e71-4291-4b22-8e25-e260d1d4cc2d.Text: "Is aiding a smuggler an endeavour worthy of a Rogue Trader?"

f6590f24-062c-4197-8e74-cc7785952d9b.Text: "You're just jealous! She swigs amasec and wears revealing clothes, while your only outlet is praying."

314df502-2b79-4614-a14f-f0dea457acb3.Text: "The little voices are whispering that there's trouble waiting up ahead. And if you don't take things down a notch, you could be caught with your trousers down. Figuratively or literally, I'm not sure."

5f6ebe2b-d9cc-4cf5-8a6e-a82dafa5b4f5.Text: "The only thing more priceless than this profound augury is the expressions of the people who just heard it."

782747d9-e264-4de4-9647-112e307b1b60.Text: "The Imperium is a grand mechanism and we are cogs within it. And this is a warehouse for the most twisted and corroded cogs."

9b1a7510-373d-4c6a-80cc-76a5f62a92a9.Text: "An interesting metaphor. I would add only that storing such cogs is often a waste of nutribars and oxygen."

ef8f681b-55b8-4d7c-beab-ad9510be0c23.Text: "Repentance in prison is but a weak shadow of a true transformation of the soul. Only in battle, by abjuring the flesh and cloaking the soul in flame, can one earn absolution."
