48d55818-ace2-418a-9614-60e2d9a185d0.Text: "Sometimes it suits the Imperium's functionaries to have a criminal spend the rest of his days toiling in a pit, working for the good of the righteous until his last breath."

7bd665ee-5dae-4345-a294-7676f2f35e36.Text: "I did not have the opportunity to visit Rykadi Philia before the uprising broke out on the primary world. I read in a report that the warden has shown... unusual ingenuity in how he handles prisoners on the planetoid."

cc72d879-7998-4ca8-b5f6-890b17d6fabd.Text: "I only saw Rykadi Philia from a distance whenever I chanced to visit the observatory. It is so strange to actually be here in person!"

b3387b49-b346-43d7-9eab-86ff34689dd9.Text: "Places such as this make me think of snow — pure and untainted by human squalor. Under the frozen light of a star that illuminates everything — to the very depths of one's soul."

05d24ea1-1304-410c-a775-bf04c8828d22.Text: "Your soul already shines, Amic'Argenta. But if death calls you before me, I will keep your ashes for the richest world of snow there is."

394d5050-809b-4f05-a695-de925bb168af.Text: "I've never seen so many plants before, not even in our arboretum... Oh, that flower there! I read about it in one of the works by Genetor Kanassian."

52d882eb-fbf7-49dc-a7f6-5c67a03fe420.Text: "Your display of knowledge, atypical for a layperson, would warrant approbation, were it not for the fact that Genetor Kanassian was excommunicated approximately three centuries ago."

307774ac-56c9-4f28-b6d6-cf8b2f247d02.Text: "Lord Captain Theodora and I once landed on a green world similar to this one. Two-thirds of the team perished in the jaws of wild beasts, while the rest died of fever."

296aeceb-3f6c-41f9-b246-c5d666978988.Text: "There are worse beasts lurking in this jungle, and they don't have claws and fangs. I can hear... they have a leader among them. And he is closer than you think..."

7a570acf-19c4-4d2b-b5b4-6b185809f904.Text: "I considered these forests my home for a time... But I still feel myself a stranger here."

b0590198-5ea7-4c52-8a54-133e7174bca8.Text: "I suppose it's because the jungle is ever so slightly hostile to visitors. Speaking of visitors... Lord Captain, have you ever, in all your infinite wisdom, considered setting up a resort for rich folks here?"

371d1222-9afb-4d80-8966-2bdf20fbba14.Text: "What a splendid estate! I have seen picts of our ancient manors in the House Orsellio archives — this place is very similar."

a300c62c-47fc-468d-b735-5c737f089c7c.Text: "It's a pity you were denied the chance to grow up in such surroundings. I can just picture a young Lady Navigator relaxing with a book in the garden after her lessons."

8ddeee84-1f49-4fbd-801e-250ed56f379c.Text: "What did you just say? Or was it not you? The voices are growing stronger... Why? Something's not right."

7ab9986b-5954-469e-bebb-5104fab5476e.Text: "All this tasteless extravagance could send anyone mad. Look at that: these ashmags have used expensive Kavossian wood on the finishes!"

46effd9c-9df4-4ce7-9a6b-14b1d5f9aad1.Text: "Indeed. I have not seen many places that flaunt such luxury. If you were to scrape all the gilding from every temple on Footfall, it would still be less than there is here."

7d1148b6-d246-45f4-8196-aef72e4e7ce0.Text: "I suspect the residents of an estate like this could buy Footfall in its entirety and use it as a seasonal residence."

62e191d9-838b-4a76-829a-c00bbadab39e.Text: "The ruins are emitting faint psy energies... However, it does not pose a direct threat for now. But I advise that we do not linger here."

21e37821-6b7b-4252-a5c2-5749dd3a5bcd.Text: "Your 'does not pose a direct threat,' van Calox, can be interpreted much too broadly for my personal comfort."

1f2b0ca6-72d7-4f37-bfac-419588019435.Text: "I offer up my thanks to thee, Omnissiah, for granting me the ability to serve you as a predator whose prey is Knowledge!"

da3fcb62-77a2-4b80-ad2a-1f006e867429.Text: "Predators? You can hear the growling too? A sound so vile it makes your teeth clench, makes you want to kill... No? Just me? That's not good..."

a2bd769f-505c-465c-94bc-03b1b1f14bbf.Text: "And you are here also, esteemed Master van Calox. Does the Inquisition never sleep?"

ee3896b6-da97-42d4-9378-59a17d17bcb5.Text: "It is in our collective interest to ensure that the Rogue Trader does not accidentally meet {mf|his|her} demise in the bowels of {mf|his|her} own ship. Wouldn't you agree, Seneschal?"

8f1207fb-b8a8-4bbf-a87f-37571d24b3c4.Text: "I still do not see our purpose in coming here."

f497defe-d247-45aa-9d17-1c9f34f0e93d.Text: "Relax, old man. Going for a stroll on the lower decks every once in a while is good for you. Lets you see how the simple folk live."

2384d917-16b7-4392-9d06-61df85352101.Text: "Why is so much space allotted to the lower orders? It is inefficient. They could be accommodated much more compactly."

53a4100d-3e8c-4a60-8a0e-d37e6a2cec59.Text: "They are not sardines in a tin, they're living people, you soulless pile of cogs!"

656c106e-7b7f-4e23-99f0-293b5def2268.Text: "These rumours... about Lord Captain Theodora... Surely you do not believe them?"

0c3f2426-9c52-44d2-aa65-bad9df771e92.Text: "Of course not. I saw first-hand how— wait. Who's that there?"

8cb040b2-0958-424c-997b-520b6d1c422f.Text: "The breath of the Immaterium... I feel the same thing whenever your resident witch is around. We are close."

91325592-fa75-45f4-b73f-fdba54572720.Text: "I too... feel something drawing near. But I do not see any colours. The whole world drained of colour the moment we set foot on this deck."

f49bb054-e043-429d-8d67-afc5f37856c6.Text: "The Navis Nobilite is a unique part of the Imperium's apparatus. The privileged position Navigators occupy enables them to carry out questionable acts, which they hide behind the walls of their fortresses."

4f994820-0955-49cc-a0f0-d930bc66d27e.Text: "The station's silence can hardly be considered a good sign. Perhaps it was attacked by cultists? Or, as with our ship, the strike came from within?"

f543fd69-96a8-4705-a753-569dc8485064.Text: "White, white... bright, pure colour — and it's all riddled with horrible veins that carry the poison of fear and pain throughout its body. Who are you? Why are you crying?"

0949b2ad-0f79-4ee7-ba45-2c93e67969f0.Text: "If the witch is talking about the enemies of Humanity who set upon this abode of noble Navigators, then our weapons will soon dispel their wicked misery!"

b66aafbb-7960-4f20-b29c-12beaef34844.Text: "A void station is a sacred place of the Omnissiah, who shields the rulers of this fortress against death and darkness. Why, then, are the vox-channels dead, and why is the air not filled with holy binharic rhythms?"

78e56209-9178-49b5-9a78-389e3e4c2c19.Text: "The station's lack of response to our ship's hails was already suspicious. I am no less uneasy after the Magos's words. Hands at your weapons."

26ed9617-1e9d-4e9e-add3-321895864ab4.Text: "Today... the first link will pull the others along with it, and soon the chain will tighten around a neck. But whose? No, I can't see..."

6d544106-7e64-4ccc-a070-ee00aabcfb18.Text: "Your predictions are the chain that chokes the will of a free being. Be silent, mon-keigh."

bf29b05b-9746-4a5f-85bc-ba92601ca3cd.Text: "Vheabos VI always was a penal world, but this... even the miscreants of this place do not deserve such a fate."

3bb1959f-86c9-4e89-bed2-cf338572424a.Text: "I believe many of them do. But not at the hands of xenos."

3205fa10-f014-4922-a27d-4d78f98ba1b2.Text: "The Imperium is laughably unoriginal in its educational methods. Corrective labour in the mines? Places like this show mercy to no one, adult or child."

7e001543-73dd-45ea-922d-dcfbd674cdde.Text: "These transgressors ought to be weeping in gratitude for being given a chance to atone through hard labour."

1d0bdfaf-55ee-412f-826a-e7b53a15db8e.Text: "Damn it... It's a vox-liturgy twisted by warp sorcery. Try not to listen too closely."

480a33ad-4c62-4377-bad7-adf623441009.Text: "The warp got into a soulless tin can and corrupted the vox? Now I'm imagining what it could have done to the minds of the poor souls that live here..."

2ae3295d-28b6-4570-b443-85027d450ef8.Text: "May the hearts of the faithful not be daunted by the vile speeches of the foes of Humanity, may our faith be strengthened in the face of all corruption and foulness..."

e4c4c0b7-ef28-484c-98ae-5618268af11d.Text: "I cannot make out a single word... but the taint that hangs with these sounds in the air is almost palpable."

3c2dfd64-62b3-4a98-97c5-8a39f7ffacf8.Text: "Darkness... There is darkness everywhere, biting, hungering — and it's all wrong... Watch where you tread. One misstep, and this doom will swallow you."

25250ce2-71b8-4f78-8ee6-afba391e6ce8.Text: "Darkness is an ally of those who follow the Tenets, a cloak that conceals the spinners from His enemies. But here... here, the darkness is the enemy."

e578e09b-483e-4bb2-b89c-610bc3fbe21c.Text: "The pain of an entirely dead world is a heavy burden, one that can break your heart and shatter your spirit. Are all of us ready to face it?"

e5d3bb8f-6239-4722-a83a-8a2c61798cf1.Text: "I... I am ready, Argenta. With you and the Lord Captain by my side, I am ready for almost anything."

7935b5e3-c705-485b-90a1-a039c4350056.Text: "Angel of Death, you hail from a world blessed with danger, one that nurtures mighty warriors. Is this place anything like your home?"

f4dd9231-5a10-4de6-90d1-481bd7d70f24.Text: "The frost here is like that of an ice troll's breath — this does bring back memories of Fenris... But the resemblance ends there. This world feels like cold oblivion, while Fenris bellows with the fight for survival and the promise of glory."

e5927a3c-dae4-4dd5-8430-6ebff474c6be.Text: "An initial survey of the vessel indicates that my Explorator brethren have already performed a requiem rite here. Further examination is inadvisable."

5ddd3a3d-f2fd-4bd1-95b6-3a223033857d.Text: "What about the sagacious marauders rooting around in the guts of this dead colossus of the void? Talk to them — wisdom can be found in unexpected places, shereen."

fbd8c719-c43f-440d-81b3-d07b327d2f4f.Text: "Do these mon-keigh truly spend their brief lives digging through refuse? Why do they not choose another Path? Find another self?"

3a031975-57f0-46f7-abd3-65f27c6ca796.Text: "These people are humble at heart and diligent in their work, as all true children of the Imperium ought to be."

7c629b2e-2252-4d7b-9dad-901e15afd5b8.Text: "If we manage to find an intact shuttle in this burning hellscape, it will be a miracle sent by the God-Emperor."

1aedaeea-9f8a-4dfd-bf27-5b37c9c8760b.Text: "For a person as important as the Lord Captain, I am certain there will be a vessel waiting where it should be. Surely the commoners know their place in the evacuation order?"

ba121b88-e8f0-4b96-8542-559d5b047161.Text: "The anarchy at the starport will distress the hallowed machine spirits of the voidcraft, rendering them deaf to all litanies of placation. The shuttle we use for the evacuation must be handled with caution."

f3d9e9c9-7d66-4428-ac57-4291941a4ce0.Text: "With all due respect to your faith, Haneumann, if we find a working shuttle, we will worry about restoring the machine spirits' equilibrium once we're back on board our ship!"

2b663525-3644-4280-a630-07c013bcac85.Text: "Did you see that? They almost knocked us out of the air! Some bumbling idiot's going to regret that when he's dragged before the Lord Captain for questioning and trial!"

737e8b79-2941-4a15-8097-f3f2f99ccf8f.Text: "I do not think the Rogue Trader should take a personal interest in a common crackpot. Summary execution will be sufficient."

7c269548-3e56-462a-a34d-c5d757ac5bab.Text: "May His light harden our hearts... new trials await us in this place."

081b74b0-1d44-4a33-bf13-814c7b6ab4e9.Text: "It's going from bad to worse... I expected a typical dull reception with the governor, not more carnage!"

d4ca4565-906a-463e-bdb7-1d79108c53e3.Text: "So, this is how vast the sky is. It is no wonder that mutiny broke out here. How can order be maintained in a place without compartments or bulkheads?"

ac8e7851-f053-4f17-937a-1fd56ab8dd23.Text: "I would argue that it is not the size of the territory, but the competence of the governor that matters. He did not even send a proper cortege to meet us!"

473dcbd3-077e-4554-b75f-227952e1db88.Text: "My little voices have quietened down. They're lying low, whispering somewhere in the distance, like a draught sighing through the smallest crack. I suppose I should see it as a bad sign, but it's so nice to hear myself think again!"

827aa477-fe0b-484b-8748-c21d559d320e.Text: "Knowing you, Mistress Tlass, and being unwillingly acquainted with your... ahem, voices, I would remain on my guard."

ccc5c772-f321-4255-9b1a-24109f62b936.Text: "How many righteous servants of the Imperium were felled by a weapon intended to aid them in the struggle against the faithless? Shot down in flight, with no chance to defend themselves or to complete their mission..."

7c198d16-e0c5-4281-b4a5-10e01c6edb8d.Text: "I pray for their souls. And I pray that the Emperor guides us to the leaders of the heretics guilty of this wicked deed. To be a weapon of righteous retribution would be a destiny beyond imagining!"

79c7987e-aa91-4de5-a373-d504f4a1921f.Text: "I can sense a slight pressure in the atmosphere, like a distant psy-echo... I presume it is the result of the massacre that happened on these streets."

7382ce23-55b1-44ef-a0e4-9da3085a0b65.Text: "You're being so loud! Why are you shouting like that? Oh... Did you say something, Master Interrogator? I couldn't hear you over the blood-curdling screams."

62a273df-49b5-4307-96bc-a1b6daaa1007.Text: "A disorganised rabble should not be capable of bringing down a world like Rykad Minoris. Is the governor exerting every effort to restore order here? I am not convinced."

b0aa8e7e-d2a7-474d-9deb-a033880f1b1c.Text: "If the governor is sincere in his faith and service to the Emperor, then I am confident that he is doing everything within his power."

faec7159-3b76-472e-a1a3-791bbb7d1266.Text: "I am registering numerous losses among combat and civilian units. There is a high probability that these values would be lower under more competent leadership."

8bbe3d56-82aa-4959-8593-61bfc16b72ef.Text: "Numerous losses among combat and civilian units — do you mean dead people, Magos? People die in droves everywhere, every minute, under all kinds of leadership. If you tried to count them all, you might fry the cogitator in your skull!"

f064628f-fbcf-4d43-815f-9c71af3d2e39.Text: "The voices behind the door are cackling to the beat of all this commotion! Down? Yes... there's something down below!"

71168807-afb0-437b-a754-ce16a2fdb327.Text: "If I am not mistaken, the streets of Rykad Minoris are arranged in tiers. There is certainly something beneath this avenue. Storage facilities, at the very least."

e562d6f7-9b0e-4f81-b458-56546d853db5.Text: "Even at the epicentre of an anthracite-crimson storm, you, Kibellah, radiate an even, silvery glow. For you, physical pain is a mere flicker of sensation. Why is that?"

0a63f262-bfbc-4f8d-9551-05bfd334aa28.Text: "Pain is my teacher, my ritual dagger. It cuts away fears and desires. Like a chisel, it hones the will and reflexes. What reason is there to avoid it? I do not understand."

a6aedd6e-1434-44e3-942e-2983f16d15b8.Text: "Gah, my eyes are stinging like crazy! I'll need augments if this goes on much longer. And the voices are still howling... I can hear my little friends behind the door sniffing at this lens, muttering to it... I can sense its foul, clammy energy. A nasty piece of kit!"

e79b4340-536a-425b-a35e-18f72d4af27e.Text: "This construct and its intended purpose truly evoke nothing but horror."

11906d4e-7893-4927-a544-d5a46033f000.Text: "The Archenemy's foul fingerprints are all over this place. A nest of wickedness! The heretics met the only end possible — death at the hands of faithful servants of the Emperor."

0e635cc4-9cf0-4031-9cdc-31d8d4db9ddf.Text: "I am registering extensive structural damage to the tomb and the expiry of the expedition team. Initiating investigation to determine if the cause was gross incompetence or extraordinary circumstances."

3cc1d924-6d7c-4c4a-b08d-75a1cc033321.Text: "My, you are a heartless cog, aren't you? Why is your first reaction always to accuse everyone of incompetence? Touchy subject, is it?"

39d87264-c69c-4223-b27e-e16d9280ed16.Text: "The way out is blocked, the stairs have collapsed, and there are dead Tech-Priests everywhere. What in the void happened here?"

58bc9628-5cf6-4606-8e64-4526a68b272e.Text: "Abelard, look closer at these creepy hunks of junk. You don't need to be a seer to know what happened here — they happened. They are properly dead... aren't they?"

f797ca65-3a97-40fb-8cf1-dba2c675581a.Text: "There was a great reaping here. So many brave souls fell and their wrath brought down the very vaults of this tomb!"

e52700f2-e268-43dd-9570-9ad9f6b77b5d.Text: "A pretty metaphor, but based on the nature of the damage, I would place my bet on melta charges."

9e9e513b-a32f-4470-b3f3-943d567a5fdf.Text: "What are they? They're in the walls, above us, under the floor... They're scratching at my skull... They want to disembowel me, to wear my skin..."

3f7873d6-6c5a-4c57-a474-f8ed343461c6.Text: "I too sense eyes upon us. Like a beast preparing to pounce. Hundreds of beasts."

66b6b895-f969-4a77-b279-bf37d54db7d8.Text: "The upper limit for the concentration of toxins in the air has been exceeded. Crew members are advised to activate their respiratory protection."

070a30f3-bec9-4883-b1ab-12ba708ee555.Text: "Can you quiet that mechanical whirring? I can't make out the voices! What are you saying? Compassion was the downfall of the righteous? What else is new?"

1e431b2c-5a13-40f6-87ad-f63bee8df64b.Text: "An old Imperial bunker... There are some on Dargonus too. A good place to hide when the whole world is going to the void."

b1d5458c-6401-4f46-942f-69556af6436f.Text: "Eh, I wouldn't say they are especially good places to hide. My guys can break into them easy as you like, and... know what they usually find inside? Corpses."

78dd2ab5-840e-4cab-8dbb-60710188b5da.Text: "Argenta, don't you find it difficult to be without your sisters? You are a soldier without a squad."

fd36f547-78a4-4ac8-98e8-0c13996d8814.Text: "I will fight alongside my sisters again, but my present fate is not a burden to me. No matter where I go or who I am with, I bring death to heretics. That is what matters!"

5a33aedd-2c5e-4836-bdd8-225c0fb98cb8.Text: "I feel my age when fighting alongside such young warriors..."

74f88aac-fb26-40c6-92bd-5f4cc219678e.Text: "Indeed. While I have my Navigator skills to call upon, you are, statistically speaking, far more likely to perish in battle. Oh, I mean, that came out wrong..."

43d333ae-16fa-4c69-b0ab-ea55cd6f0265.Text: "I spoke to Mistress Toliman recently... Don't you think you are taking advantage of the Lord Captain's hospitality, van Calox?"

45e13ec4-45ad-46bd-8f18-cfff0a2c1f31.Text: "I assume you are referring to the small request I submitted to Vigdis? If so, then no. I am not taking advantage. The matter is closed."

c192ef63-e9b8-4062-9c2b-904f9b1005a0.Text: "Idira, is there something you wish to tell me about? Namely, the mess in the wardroom last week?"

39ba38fc-0f3a-409d-af48-86e2e3c395b0.Text: "Stop blaming me every time one of the officers flies off the handle, old man. Not every brawl or disaster on the ship is because of me."

7237df84-935c-4a39-84c0-bd2b01fe7ede.Text: "In truth, Mistress Heydari, I find it hard to believe that a ne'er-do-well such as yourself could be successful in any field, even smuggling."

cb8a7fcd-b277-4c77-8d09-ee8ffd2673e8.Text: "In truth, Master Werserian, I find it hard to believe that anyone would put out for a bore such as yourself. But you've somehow managed to sire a whole gaggle of offspring!"

a3620508-0cc8-4862-ab9c-752c75154415.Text: "There is a life lesson every young man should learn: keep your backside off any throne you have not rightfully earned or irrevocably won."

d45147ae-e3f5-4a88-a643-a85fc08fa730.Text: "You— you are addressing me? I am no man, young or otherwise, and I have nothing to learn from mon-keigh homilies. What is more, I honoured that wretched monstrosity you call a throne when I deigned to touch it."

d367f04d-e65a-4bb6-a1a8-ded6577366c1.Text: "I must thank you, esteemed Magos. After your intervention, I feel fifty years younger — both my knee implants are as good as new!"

e7e1b105-f8d1-4599-ad58-a9272f98f9c3.Text: "I agreed to help out of respect for the priceless array of augmentations placed in your body. Such sacred creations deserve the best maintenance available."

9aa53c93-b3f6-4e91-8898-4461e8a291b9.Text: "Oh, Terra knows, many of the household items and devices on board are simply not designed for your build and strength, my lord Ulfar."

14e7c834-f2a4-4f93-b76c-104884623731.Text: "When spirits are high, the exuberance of my fist is enough to shatter fragile things."

264e7086-5942-4a17-a11f-80536bb738c7.Text: "Mistress Yrliet, the ship's crew would be less alarmed if you made the slightest effort not to frighten them."

828c3210-40e9-412f-90d0-9e48e621b04d.Text: "Mon-keigh fears are not my concern, and even if I wanted to assuage them, your kind will never cease to fear those who stand above them."

89460b71-3ca0-41b0-93a7-5e66c55f6b7b.Text: "You left the Navis Imperialis to serve the Rogue Trader. Do you ever regret it, Seneschal?"

47985c02-e697-40d2-8025-8f316193efb1.Text: "No, I do not regret it in the least. Serving in the Imperial Navy is a fine thing to do, but it was only under Lady Theodora that I truly felt the significance of what I was doing."

2ad9f502-3592-4566-b629-dfd5b137c898.Text: "If I could see the golden light of the Astronomican as you see it, Cassia... I would probably go still forever, unable to take my eyes off the radiance of the Emperor for an instant."

6f5165bc-6edf-4445-8fed-37c481d69b2b.Text: "I think you would manage. You have different hues of light within you — gold, silver, and crimson — one of them would call you back to this world."

a831a9bf-e2c6-4ade-a4f6-e3b161d8b3d0.Text: "Serving the Inquisition means peering into the secrets of Humanity's foes. Aren't you afraid that one day you will peer too deeply, Interrogator?"

f8c4d066-ef96-473c-a335-38ffa61b83ec.Text: "Fear is the enemy of duty. Anyone who cannot overcome this weakness does not last long in the Holy Inquisition."

86b5f8cf-a88e-4751-8f40-1610b48a9e81.Text: "The future you see could be the whispers of the Archenemy! How can you trust your visions, Idira?"

91a84fb4-e74b-40c1-af31-1d1e5e14572a.Text: "I don't think that's the question you wanted to ask. What you wanted to ask was: how can others bring themselves to trust a despicable psyker like me? Face it, Sister, not everybody's as pig-headed as you are!"

5a600ab8-44a5-444f-a5d4-f3f51b921792.Text: "It's being in your presence, my stunning righteous angel! I find you distracting and inspiring in equal measure!"

fe6c716e-e86d-471b-8b21-1949abadfaeb.Text: "One day the Rogue Trader will tire of you, abomination, and let justice be done. Nothing gives me more pleasure than the anticipation of that moment."

7b618510-d6a0-4108-a93f-9dc39ebe1e23.Text: "The anticipation of killing gives you pleasure? I see... No need to explain, sweet-voiced mon-keigh — I read your passions clearly in your eyes."

51af5739-db64-4aeb-bbfc-85694c2af4ff.Text: "Crimson is a good colour for battle attire. Enemies will perceive no weakness, not even if you are bleeding."

83065d86-69fa-414d-99b2-50e515d2d6fa.Text: "My augmentations allow me to function effectively even in the event of extensive blood loss. This is what should concern those who dare to stand against a servant of the Omnissiah in battle."

7d6352ab-7646-4f2a-83e9-a081d43e9089.Text: "I like your oration, bright warrior. It reminds me of the sacred hymns my sisters and I sing on the battlefield."

55cdccf1-edf8-4a1e-a44b-5b813b090913.Text: "A good battle song gives strength to comrades and glorifies the Allfather. My songs and yours are alike in this respect, pure-hearted sister!"

32695065-f0f8-485d-90f4-24963243cfd9.Text: "Grace and strength of will. It is sad that such gifts have fallen to one whose soul will never be illuminated by the light of Terra."

b7333bf0-3035-40b6-979e-d80ccf3b36c8.Text: "Limited, petty creatures often wrongly pity others who are, in fact, superior to them. I do not know if I should find it fascinating or repulsive."

65993516-7093-4285-a19e-ed05317b9b4b.Text: "I can see the agitation and fear of the servants beside me, but you... How do you manage to drown out their colours with mere words? Their dark hues dissolve immediately, and humility sets in."

5ca4d14a-5fa6-41e1-8a81-8021afaf7224.Text: "I, ahem, have always desired only respect, not fear. It is good to know that my efforts have not been in vain. Thank you... for telling me."

a76c2b13-c383-40c5-85dc-059ab3ef7852.Text: "Sister Argenta, you are always shrouded in a greenish-grey mist when I see you. Is it me that troubles you? Or is it whatever I can see behind it?"

aafa2461-04e1-4e88-9e25-413006b9b8e8.Text: "My soul is open to the light and His faithful servants. The rest is merely fleeting frailties that hold no significance."

2cfc7a34-93c6-4e8a-807f-59371ea2e4d3.Text: "The more you try to hide your colours from me, Master van Calox, the more clearly I can see them. If you find my gaze so unpleasant, just say so."

9f3b6a47-0577-4676-8b10-c96aa3e6252a.Text: "Do not mistake my caution for rudeness, Lady Cassia. I am usually the person who gauges others' secret thoughts and feelings. Being on the receiving end is different."

4d5d2d63-74ba-4b2a-9208-c107bdd9e314.Text: "Sometimes I wonder to what extent our perception of the Empyrean differs?"

69d9e93a-5527-4d3d-a345-103589f3f70f.Text: "I am glad that I never have to look at it. No offence, Cas, but I'll do just fine without an eyeball in the middle of my forehead."

31c93418-2c25-4240-91ea-588e4ea260c9.Text: "Behind the varied colours of your soul, I see very different shades, less gold and silver, and more and more—"

62048726-759e-4526-a6b2-86190143f92f.Text: "Cass, joy of my eyes, I'm not ashamed to show off my body to others. But do not bare my soul for me."

c2c9990d-8c67-4b1e-8cfa-3f0c094290b9.Text: "If people could see what I see in you, they would fear your kind even more than they already do."

36a4f558-5956-4bb9-acd1-957ff4c8fff6.Text: "That is the folly of the mon-keigh. You squeal like livestock from the pain inflicted by our blades, when you ought to tremble at the horrors hidden in the gaze of those such as you."

0ac16dfa-2669-4726-81a9-d5ae1a4c8709.Text: "Incredible... Your heart, esteemed Magos, shines with a kaleidoscope of colours, albeit one made of metal."

ef838a9c-7df1-4556-82c0-9ac8a0df17bb.Text: "Only laypersons believe feelings to be the preserve of flawed flesh. We know the higher passions granted by the Omnissiah — the aversion to techcorruption, the blessing of compliance with the canon of maintenance, and the satisfaction of effective devotional service."

4e5bc77c-4aa5-442c-870f-f9aa6128a6eb.Text: "You do not have to hide the ashy shadows of loneliness behind swirls of bright colours, Ulfar."

9f956843-fd31-4e68-a1d7-12454f6b44ba.Text: "I respect your gift, Guide to the Soul Sea, but you should save your sorcery for someone else."

7778d328-d49a-4b52-961d-418dd0aee845.Text: "I was taught that xenos were abhorrent creatures, but you do not look terrifying. You look... unusual. As do I."

c3beb724-ce21-419d-8f87-07cb95548f61.Text: "Naive child. You are a monster to your own kind. Were it not for your third eye that sees Sha'eil, the thread of your fate would have been severed at birth."

093760fa-da93-4361-84d9-6b7804bef4db.Text: "For a deck officer, your physical fitness is impressive, Master Werserian. I take it your position as Seneschal is extremely demanding."

83639446-fd68-44be-b926-d8f4ac7524f1.Text: "Young man, rosette or no — stop lavishing these condescending compliments on me. If I were your age, you would be no match for me."

b14045c0-534b-48e1-a2d3-4706820801fd.Text: "You are an excellent fighter, Sister, but — if I may be blunt — you are too impulsive."

85a7b479-5c98-4407-85da-cc202fa9eb60.Text: "Your point is? My hand is guided by the Emperor. Every shot and strike will find its target among the ranks of the enemies of Humanity!"

69f84a7a-a919-4c50-a80d-0ccf36561d28.Text: "Once again you have read my mood like an open book, Master van Calox. My eyes... they still ache from the kaleidoscope of colours I see around me."

1145c3e4-6572-4d1f-a18f-150069640d1d.Text: "Idira, either stop glaring daggers at me or tell me what the problem is."

87145718-6d34-43b9-83fc-aeee21ffffe8.Text: "You are planning something, iceman. You yourself don't realise it yet, but I'm not you — I know your devious plans before you even think of them."

f9ef6c55-26cc-475f-aebd-e9b631f5ebae.Text: "Mistress Heydari, I have been meaning to ask you — are your people still working with the Tutors?"

3753e45e-c5f9-4c11-abf5-d9a6522394b7.Text: "By the Exalted One, Master van Calox, even Cold Traders have standards. And mine do not permit me to have dealings with the Tutors, now that I know what they specialise in."

24c0b02c-dee1-4af8-b595-6dd4ee5d3b2e.Text: "Xenos biology is different from human biology. I wish I had the opportunity to study first-hand what causes the greatest pain to enemies of Humanity..."

2544d5c7-e16e-45af-a7f1-0034a6282e8f.Text: "You hide behind duty, but in reality you crave others' suffering as much as I do. How does it feel to know that you and I are alike? No need to answer — I can sense your agonising rage."

a3252699-54e1-495d-917c-7f978f39991a.Text: "When I was a child, I was once initiated into some of the mysteries of tech ministry. I still have questions that you might be able to answer, Magos..."

da1f9d4f-8992-4d48-b50e-e04969aa8e73.Text: "The imparting of knowledge to laity who lack the proper initiation is an unfortunate necessity, not a sign of trust. I am not at liberty to divulge the mysteries granted to me when I received my rank."

beff970f-6d73-4a74-8b16-17839c68e1d3.Text: "No. Get back. Do not speak to me. Get out of my sight, you devious little bloodhound!"

06215038-feee-42d4-b430-defcbd0cf7b1.Text: "I suspect that fighting alongside humans is causing you certain difficulties. Psychologically and tactically."

bcc1705a-2167-4ca6-969d-f392f474186a.Text: "Asuryani are capable of adapting. You mon-keigh slow me down and slightly hinder me in combat... but it is tolerable."

c9c32d1c-d54f-41d5-8518-8929819417af.Text: "Abelard... I've been meaning to ask... How are you keeping it together so well? Don't you ever feel... awful without her?"

ea906641-e68e-4c9f-9c5e-42986d402ae3.Text: "Merely taking a professional interest, nothing more."

abbb8f50-b3bb-43ff-af34-5b05d8d9fef0.Text: "Enough, Tlass. We have a duty to the new Rogue Trader — you would do well to focus on that. If you keep your mind busy, you will have less opportunity to fill it with awful things."

b1f8fe0e-a5c8-4aa9-a110-999dbed80fcd.Text: "Hey, your virtuousness, how are you doing?"

a1b24aea-8279-432f-b4cb-a6b5ca5aa0cf.Text: "I was born to wage war against darkness, I am always doing wonderfully when danger is near!"

1173aeaa-c1e9-4532-a944-bb16fb82a4d1.Text: "Cass, tell me: what do you see when you look at me?"

b911a21f-21d1-4d47-b595-d7a32f9edace.Text: "Usually a colourful pandemonium, but now... your colours have faded. Are you afraid of me, Idira? Or of what I might see in you?"

8704c92b-ebb7-4053-b137-fa47ff006403.Text: "Jae! When we get back, do you want to go back to that place on the lower decks — the one with the tables made out of used promethium tanks? That was fun!"

265e31dc-c537-41ac-a050-5f8dc1b807e4.Text: "Idira, shereen, I thought you'd gone off the idea of hanging around with me after that shootout! But I have a few more ideas for how we can enjoy ourselves!"

f1a98371-d855-4219-9cbd-768bce2f074a.Text: "I've asked you before, but I'll ask you again... Aeldari are supposed to be all the one species, aren't they? But I look at you, stick insect, and I don't understand why you and your kin are so creepy looking — nothing like the Aeldari on Janus. I suppose a diet of pain and torment won't do wonders for anybody's looks, but..."

acbc731c-6572-488e-91a5-4f45c704e639.Text: "You're always praying, cog. Don't you ever bore yourself? Do you even know what fun is? What about jokes?"

8b4f3270-40c0-4551-b714-03afd8834cd2.Text: "The concept of humour has been detected in the catalogue. Demonstration: an ignorant layperson, a low-status candidate for servitorisation, and a blasphemous augment thief walk into a bar deprived of the Omnissiah's blessing..."

6b156ed8-24f3-4160-a38e-1021f91813f5.Text: "I can't work out if you respect me for my abilities or despise me, big man. You're glaring at me now like you've just downed some sour amasec. Don't you like me?"

4c49cb20-8261-44cc-ae1d-016f0958fe92.Text: "I am no fool — I will not insult a witch who knows the spirits, but I am not careless enough to forgo a protective amulet in your presence. You are not to be trusted."

2d6162f2-a3e7-4c83-a887-8c6aa1405213.Text: "People go on and on about xenos this and xenos that... but I look at you, Yrliet, and I think you look like a human, albeit a dangerously skinny one."

ad821da4-57b7-44aa-b3d8-fb876c1e36f3.Text: "A degrading comparison, mon-keigh. You are the call of Sai'lanthresh in a corporeal shell — you could tear the veil apart at any moment. We are as alike as a snowy mountain peak and dirt on the sole of a shoe."

b6421a26-7121-41d1-bbc9-68aa5bdd1646.Text: "Hey, old man! Are your joints playing up? You're walking funny."

4fd13350-f994-47da-a2dc-2fc8219a27e0.Text: "Fear not, Mistress Heydari, I am feeling perfectly well. I do so appreciate your... thoughtful concern."

22c6be53-7df6-4402-a848-20d1e3cd98c8.Text: "Sister Argenta, do you want to pray together to the Exalted One when we return to the ship? But it has to be somewhere private — I don't want to ruin my reputation as an unscrupulous trader."

abd0cfdc-9ed1-4c5e-82fa-2593f9921fb0.Text: "Sometimes I think you are not such a bad person, Jae. And it unnerves me."

8c4b4ec7-7e70-4cba-9bee-34b5dfe97416.Text: "Cass, light of mine eyes, have you ever considered dyeing your hair? With your House's wealth, you could afford the finest treatments..."

f36c3706-a432-4fda-8315-0a388c2a57ac.Text: "Whyever would I do that? I perceive the hues swirling in people's souls — their masks cannot deceive my gaze."

31a46063-7ee9-484c-88b3-6fa15d3be54d.Text: "Master van Calox, you and I need to find some time to talk business. In private. I believe you have information that will be extremely helpful to me... and extremely valuable."

6333205b-f64b-4bc7-bcfa-8a71698409cd.Text: "Mistress Heydari, you will find a private conversation with me to be extremely unhelpful to you and your business. Save your charm and money for another informant."

9f85fffd-581b-4c83-a31f-fd0214c1a02d.Text: "Idira, shereen, dispel my doubts... Can you use your visions to see what card will be dealt at a gaming table?"

5bc88c82-b2b5-4cac-8ba1-87e012c143f4.Text: "You've been easier to tolerate since you were taken down a peg. You're not any nicer, just... easier."

4056bd24-fdf8-4f21-94a3-ed57e2372171.Text: "Let me know if you grow tired of things being easy. I would take great pleasure in making your life much, much more difficult."

97aefb23-1db7-4572-86c1-33845fc923e1.Text: "I bet that as soon as we come across something interesting, the greedy hunk of junk will crackle on about the privileges of the Adeptus Mechanicus and try to lay his hands on the spoils."

0c9c1047-3ff1-4e4a-9743-2484769ef159.Text: "I am judging and disregarding the statement of the unworthy thief who has disrespected the privileges of the Adeptus Mechanicus."

d084f913-fc4a-410d-8576-a573e653f8df.Text: "What is that stink— er, rich aroma coming from your cell? Are you brewing Fenrisian mjod in there? I've heard of the stuff — I wouldn't say no to a taste!"

05487f34-b6c6-482a-b8d7-19909faa9535.Text: "Mjod would eat away at your stomach and liver, swindler. Are you not satisfied with the number of augments you already have? Content yourself with sipping on booze intended for ordinary mortals."

e3a9b16c-32da-4046-a13f-7e9ee1a2bd3c.Text: "You are different from your kin, Yrliet, and that worries me. Not knowing what to expect means I always have to be on my guard."

432476dd-02c3-4a20-aca7-f8f1a4950803.Text: "You are unusually perceptive for a mon-keigh, and you have such an unruly nature. Perhaps I should take a closer look at you, too."

24e1d22e-40e2-4cc3-b751-506121d56e35.Text: "You are at the end of your years. Why languish in an existence where you lack the vigour for rage or ecstasy?"

21eae5c2-5530-4f69-bb09-f4b63057b2e4.Text: "There are reasons to live that do not include whatever, ahem, depravities you count as pastimes. And I'll bet I have far more reasons than you to hang on for another while yet. But your concern is noted."

451f4748-7c84-4bce-91ae-6b3fc3fe3b84.Text: "You are staring at me again, sweet-voiced mon-keigh."

11e9deb1-c103-4458-afd3-8b842c38d619.Text: "Rest assured, I am watching your every move, abomination. When you betray the Rogue Trader — and you will — I will be ready."

488f10d2-2c22-4914-95be-e016eadc2475.Text: "Do not turn your foul gaze upon me, or I will cut out your cursed eye myself."

0dbec5a4-3f89-4407-8ac9-419e3776c7ff.Text: "You are a black blotch — my gaze is helplessly drawn toward you as to a grisly disaster. I want to look away... but the distortion of your soul is both frightening and mesmerising."

928f7f92-77c2-4d6e-b1c6-9f5a61f279a3.Text: "Huge potential lies hidden within you. Strong in body and will, a stubborn, intractable victim... You would make an excellent pain toy."

45805c9c-e6ea-4cc0-8471-bf7bdad5a702.Text: "Making a biomancer feel sick to his stomach is a true accomplishment, xenos. Spare me any more of your... enthusiasm."

4b9fd36a-b6ef-4e55-988c-516fa4e4fd5e.Text: "You exude the corruption of She Who Thirsts. Whenever you are near, my whole being clamours for new sacrifices to drown out her call..."

55de44be-225b-44f0-9dae-c44d1ce92866.Text: "That's just fantastic! Before they accused me of sorcery, and now I'm being accused of making xenos go berserk! Just stay away from me, stick insect, all right?"

4ba2a359-9cdb-4483-bf4a-ce7af802069a.Text: "I do not strike the same fear in you that I evoke in others. Why is that? Why are you so accustomed to my Drukhari appearance?"

49fd930b-6d56-4d6a-bbc3-018c550f1060.Text: "May the Exalted One forgive me for my transgression, but I have had dealings with Drukhari in the past. I still can't believe I emerged from those negotiations with all my limbs intact."

0492ab3a-582e-4d1e-b238-f9812c0c2a55.Text: "How afraid must you be of your passions to replace them with a clicking counting machine? What feelings so terrified you, little priest?"

b0580d0d-5ee1-4230-8221-08e49018798c.Text: "Activating the computational spirit defence protocol. Be advised: maintain a distance of at least ten paces or eradication measures will be taken."

826ed45e-5937-4c14-b969-080ec28d38fb.Text: "You were made by the mon-keigh equivalent of a Haemonculus? He must have been a ham-fisted butcher to have fashioned such an ugly fighter."

97af1b25-642f-4d13-850f-2c70668f2abf.Text: "I am the creation of Fenris and the Allfather. My flesh is the flesh of the mountains of Asaheim, shaped by the winds of Helwinter, which would blast a runt like you right up Morkai's arse."

564eb06f-2ff9-4efc-99f6-84b6f4fb71bc.Text: "You might make a decent Drukhari, cousin, if you could find the strength to admit that your Path is a delusion and follow in our footsteps."

d68318ac-150b-4b42-97a8-ed58b3a41655.Text: "Perhaps... Perhaps if the elantach had not accepted me into {mf|his|her} circle, I would have become like you and lost myself completely. But now I have hope, so spare me your futile words... cousin."

f101ff6d-508b-4099-9e89-a7951f61c0ba.Text: "You are outdated and suboptimal. Your body has suffered deterioration and requires modification."

70b10202-d778-4797-8ea5-80210b7b6d74.Text: "Funnily enough, I have grown rather attached to the old thing. Have patience — someone will shoot me any minute now, and then you will have your chance to upgrade me."

5544aa08-2310-4df0-b95d-a2755735cd8f.Text: "I am satisfied with your performance of the maintenance rites on your equipment. Although some of your prayers are unfamiliar to me."

e1708457-b36a-4d52-b29a-c77a83b2955b.Text: "They are rites performed by the Imperial Knight pilots of my world. I must commend you on the delicacy with which you expressed your suspicion that I was deviating from dogma."

5ebf5417-3959-4e3d-86d9-6f7096f36dfd.Text: "Our prayers are different, but I note a similarity in our attitudes toward ministry. It unites us."

782bf238-e951-4d76-a5ce-a5aaec4873f9.Text: "You are right. Only we know what it is to pray to our intercessor at an altar in our struggle to protect those close to us. To be their spiritual shield."

168f8c7e-8c5a-47dd-9f7e-d806be1faa0b.Text: "I am registering an unconventionally high efficiency for the unit Cassia Orsellio relative to her limited experience. The unit's status has been upgraded."

3829b304-1d00-4013-ac72-b86eeb973851.Text: "Knowledge is the key to everything, is it not, esteemed Magos? I learned this wisdom from your fellow priests, and it has helped me many times."

368d29ab-3eaf-4010-9327-77c719ae4925.Text: "Observation report on Heinrix van Calox: the unit's professional skills make him a suitable candidate for data-interrogator servo-skull conversion. I am proposing—"

27f7c60b-ef09-4db4-a03e-62492511585c.Text: "I will have to decline your generous offer, Magos. I would rather keep serving the Golden Throne with my full complement of limbs."

f596222d-93b0-447f-97f8-c08a7e2d56cb.Text: "The auditory hallucination problem troubling this unit can be rectified..."

4f6840b6-e0ba-4da8-9851-3e2c3115c45a.Text: "Let me guess, it involves the drill on your mechadendrite? There's no need, really! My burden suddenly doesn't seem so heavy."

70abe5c5-437d-4977-bc0e-8f09c1164a98.Text: "This unit's augmentations bear decorative elements not specified in the Catechism of Maintenance and Operation. Registering a Category Fourteen blasphemy."

ced27af8-508d-4d0c-95e0-702df9f883d9.Text: "Touch any of my augments with your iron tentacles and you'll be registering a bullet in your forehead! I mean it!"

c7f10d16-5bc9-4004-81bf-dc0d1f34db05.Text: "What has triggered this unit's interest? Is blasphemy imminent?"

8ee6ac27-74da-4716-b9ef-b9f88a0645fd.Text: "I can feel the pain of the iron parts inside you, it is... intentional, yes? You are not as blind to true pleasures as the other mon-keigh."

c1d4d584-f1fd-46fe-929b-b5001368900e.Text: "I am offering a hymn of homage to the Angel of the Emperor and the ancient ferocious machine spirit controlling his armour."

917a4eef-41d3-48c3-8e17-72ae31c6b9e0.Text: "Yes, my adamantine skin has seen many battles and bears many glorious scars! Hear the glorious verse of the time when..."

2dde38c4-0827-4d21-b72c-6d727a379fef.Text: "Your species is aware of mutilated forms of the Omnissiah's wisdom. Does anamorphic ersatz veneration of the Deus Mechanicus exist in your culture?"

a1354023-7524-4e50-875a-9750104c9418.Text: "We venerated Vaul, the smith and craftsman, but he is nothing like your ugly deity — he has never sought to replace our souls with wraithbone sculptures."

2cc71f35-3f72-4390-9a96-a4c0d09edb24.Text: "My armour could do with cleaning. You there, servant, see that it is done! I will reward you with a glorious saga for your diligence!"

26368899-41d2-44bd-b5ac-35bbaf77b51f.Text: "Firstly, I am not your servant, and secondly— oh. Of course, my lord Ulfar, I will see to it. Just, please, no sagas."

0161f1db-446c-424e-b5e3-7584beef1007.Text: "What are you whispering, pure-hearted sister? A command to the fearsome spirits of battle?"

2aa61b97-21c8-4c77-a252-c1ca1ed42fb4.Text: "No, Brother Ulfar, I humbly pray that the Emperor sends clarity to my eyes so that they might recognise falsity, and then destroy it!"

58ac0cd8-35bb-42ed-8eff-8aecb1683105.Text: "Helmswoman of the Soul Sea, accept this amulet as a token of my respect for your craft. Every experienced ship pilot on Fenris wears one of these."

ad27230b-de0e-44c4-a9b5-f379eec498dd.Text: "Thank you, Ulfar. I am pleased to know that I am worthy of the Space Wolf's trust, and even more pleased to see it in the motley flashes surrounding your radiant soul."

43d89526-d465-4624-afcc-d6f14fe4fbbf.Text: "Thank you, my lord Ulfar, I am in good health, and I hope you are as well. I am pleased that we are starting to get along."

44dda00b-403e-4729-93c3-c08d0c81c655.Text: "Keep your eyes to yourself, gothi. They will sap my good luck."

5a77c90b-2fec-46e2-a84b-891e2f297815.Text: "From what I've heard, you don't have much good luck to lose. But thanks, big man, now I know how to say 'witch' in yet another language. I've built up quite the collection."

50fb5684-d687-419c-bf42-557101621a32.Text: "I had a brother like you — stubborn rascal, he was. A merry fellow, and a singer! Anyway, I know your type. If any of my things go missing..."

50aa0435-9d7a-45c2-8e62-123d7ea1b23b.Text: "I assure you, my lord Ulfar, I would never dream of doing such a thing. Why are you acting so suspicious — have you lost something? Take a closer look in your cell, I'm sure you'll find it!"

c894df48-f2eb-42bb-b843-fbbeaf70ff33.Text: "I am waiting for the day when the Aett-Vater tires of you, pet xenos. And on that day, I will personally throw you out of an airlock."

7ebe7ce5-947d-4f5d-8622-acd2553a20b8.Text: "But no order has been given and you have not laid so much as a finger on me. So tell me, which of us is the pet?"

5e9b3961-d4db-4438-aea3-64b5edf3dfcc.Text: "I hear two hearts of iron beating in your chest. One belongs to a warrior, the other to a priest. Which one were you born with?"

f8c54724-5b12-4541-923d-f9d92c8c3769.Text: "Both are granted by the Omnissiah. I am an Explorator, and within my algorithms, a warrior's indomitability is meshed with a cleric's humility, like two perfectly interlocking cogs."

8bfe5e05-e129-4ca8-a281-ec27b82c9a7c.Text: "Your style of combat deserves nothing but contempt. Even if you were not xenos, such a cowardly race would still have no right to survive."

4f91d1d0-de57-4ba6-838d-633e5335e590.Text: "How ugly you are on the inside, mon-keigh. Nothing but a bloodthirsty monster... A curse your people inflict upon more enlightened races."

f50d04c8-3b2b-4217-bd2a-ccd8c5cbda1a.Text: "Do you not struggle to carry the burden of all your years, grey warrior? Will your hand not eventually betray you in combat?"

70e315e1-8e53-45cd-95dc-a3f021c76263.Text: "Youth has vigour on its side, but age has knowledge. I'm sure even a long-lived xenos must understand the importance of experience!"

ca7c0ad5-cb69-44bc-aeb5-1578edada7bf.Text: "You really believe your god is sitting somewhere on a throne of gold, watching over you?"

2dc5753e-5e3b-4efd-abce-60111436704f.Text: "Not over me — the God-Emperor cares for all His worthy daughters and sons. But a xenos like you can hardly be expected to grasp the purity of human faith."

ace2b565-362d-4b64-b6e2-8048b081fc51.Text: "You make my soul uneasy, seer of Sha'eil. Is it your third eye? Or is it something else? Whatever it is, do not come any closer."

e6f91a4c-8ae0-4dd7-bc7a-924df587dfb5.Text: "I will say the same to you. The glare of your soul dazzles my sight — to the point of pain, to the point of tears. We should keep our distance."

4e5e388e-1e56-4b9c-be7b-5e124755624d.Text: "I can see your furtive looks in my direction, mon-keigh."

324a1351-b8a6-41ae-898b-c84dc5bcaa57.Text: "Mon-keigh must know no fear or reason at all, for they permit those entwined with the great enemy in their midst."

78211868-eaa8-428b-a45e-4ec959da915b.Text: "Would you look at that — a xenos siding with Imperium doctrine! I've heard it all now!"

4743a9ed-2598-45b4-b392-532e53fa84b8.Text: "Is dealing with my kin not considered treason among the mon-keigh? Or has greed so blinded you that you do not fear retribution?"

72c26d88-8794-436a-b5dd-b6e9bdfbc55d.Text: "It all depends on where you're coming from. A crime that means a death sentence for some is freely permitted for others. I just try to keep on top of my game and not let any opportunities pass me by."

0c241e61-5dbd-4f55-ae6a-ac960585a9fb.Text: "What happened to you was just, Marazhai. There is no pity in my heart for you."

59be5344-a241-44f1-8061-eb3af6352735.Text: "You are beginning to see the true nature of things, Outcast! Pity is the province of the powerless. So continue to give me your pain and despair — just as you did before."

203dfae0-80bf-43d6-a5ab-9cdc7840aa24.Text: "You replaced your body with iron, but greed cannot be cured with cold metal. Stop looking at my gear with such avarice, mon-keigh."

b65c685c-a126-427e-886b-cf43abe1b777.Text: "I have no intention of taking it. Only of studying the unnatural perversions to which you have subjected the gift of Technology."

3bb30e34-af50-4add-8369-e0dd3bc86eeb.Text: "You are more akin to a wild beast than a member of your species."

70bb9792-0450-4894-b22c-d79c6ac37656.Text: "Be silent. If you continue your vile and insolent speech, you may truly set eyes on a beast."

1384cfd7-61c0-4ec3-ad82-cff0ede38b62.Text: "I mislaid my favourite flask a few days ago. For the life of me, I cannot imagine where it's got to. I wonder... perhaps one of you purloined it?"

21b964e7-d70e-4cb6-a0de-adda2c65a832.Text: "You left it by the vox operator's station on the bridge. You should reclaim it before the officer is upbraided for drinking at their post."

eb2e4dbf-93b0-4b2e-b4a0-ddba61b00fad.Text: "What can we expect to find in the Navigator's Sanctum?"

2325b4c2-77bc-43b8-acd2-027b9997c162.Text: "Voigtvir openly admitted that he is the mastermind behind the mutiny."

86dcfaac-da7d-4b5c-9348-1564acb9eff9.Text: "Kunrad Voigtvir is a traitor. When we parted ways on the officers' deck, he stunned me somehow and brought me here."

8a66f3fa-85c6-4059-88b1-4916fe8059fd.Text: "He is clearly serving the unholy gods of the warp!"

cae4374e-d0a0-4950-b5dd-f632b5e72bfb.Text: "How did you find me? Are you with that traitor Voigtvir?"

8e286249-0f4a-4dce-855c-f06b28a14469.Text: "For a mere Seneschal, you are asking too many questions."

ea938cc1-2662-4ca5-903d-fb7f49af1cda.Text: "He intended to take revenge on Theodora for something, and trying to reach the Warrant was somehow part of that plan."

7f9140e4-d275-40a4-bc4d-59d3d60bf359.Text: "I think the Warrant Sentinel may have sent that message. It appeared when I opened the Chamber."

22dba75c-2549-46ce-8ef2-fa22f9c3e81d.Text: "The Navigator's Sanctum. Very well. Will you lead the way?"

905e4ffc-3f0d-43fd-8d6f-f49437c84349.Text: "I am under no obligation to take such risks!"

102e1d8c-25ff-42c6-846d-d407112c5568.Text: "Since I have no other choice, let us depart... You will go first, Seneschal."

c6dfbc03-98a7-423d-ac40-9745f57208c8.Text: "For the Imperium and Humanity. Lead the way, Seneschal."

35ee374c-dd0a-472e-babc-b63306fe2b41.Text: "What exactly has gone wrong with the translation?"

e579092d-586a-40f8-8ac9-aefb8312d6de.Text: "Why don't we leave matters of etiquette for another time?"

348a5975-2045-4007-82d4-b48c113b83e8.Text: "So it would seem. But he is not here, and we have a mutiny to end."

0ac59ae0-da31-4d06-b928-bccd9bf161d4.Text: {n}Seneschal Abelard Werserian has lost some of his former polish: his forehead is sweating, and one of the sleeves of his coat is torn and soaked through with blood. Nonetheless, despite his heavy breathing, he stands firm and his gaze is demanding, albeit somewhat surprised.{/n} "{mf|Master|Mistress} {name}! What... Whatever are you doing in the {g|Encyclopedia:Warrant}Warrant{/g} Chamber? How did you..." {n}He surveys the carnage around him. His brow furrows, and he places a hand on his weapon.{/n} "{g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Throne{/g} preserve me, what is the meaning of this?"

101f7129-62a4-48fe-9b29-e8517045130d.Text: "The Warrant Chamber is an ancient and rather sacred mechanism that the ship's {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priests{/g} treat with the utmost reverence. I assume that, whatever it is that you did, you must have activated certain processes and caused the Sentinel to awaken... but then why did none of it happen when Lady Theodora did the same?" {n}He frowns.{/n}

0e320211-dea2-4617-bbcd-00ae36ea9aea.Text: {n}The Seneschal's eyes light up, and he smiles with grim determination.{/n} "The Lord Captain is calling her crew to battle, which means the vox-networks are set up for broadcast transmission, not message exchange. Splendid. While the Rogue Trader inspires proper resolve to fight in her subjects, you and I shall prove that her trust in us is well deserved. Onward!"

1ef74d16-2a3f-4687-8ddc-a7aa02010809.Text: "Indeed, indeed..." {n}Abelard frowns.{/n} "That is easier said than done, of course. But seeing one of Lady Theodora's heirs alive inspires at least some degree of optimism."

a4b4fb88-f083-43b0-ae89-08b764854572.Text: "Saints' blood! Then it is small wonder that the heretics are so well organised! I thought his order to seal the passages between decks was his attempt to stop the attackers from spreading to other levels, but now I see the real reason: it was to stop the enforcers from intervening! At least you are alive and now safe, {mf|Master|Mistress} {name}. Alas, I doubt we can afford to look for a compartment to sit out this disaster."

c2a549dd-518e-463b-a2ae-00531f286984.Text: {n}Abelard stares at you as if a toad just jumped out of your mouth.{/n} "{mf|Master|Mistress} {name}, with all due respect — what nonsense are you saying? Kunrad? A traitor?"

fe7f2cfa-fed4-4ef0-9ce7-04c41d3c25cd.Text: "Serving... the gods of the {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}warp{/g}? Kunrad is a heretic? Oh, Voigtvir, you void rat..." {n}Abelard shakes his head.{/n} "Madness. And this mutiny is likewise his doing, no doubt?"

2184319f-548f-4ffe-8232-8c8363b6c792.Text: "The lower decks are teeming with heretics instigating the rabble to revolt, but that is the least of our problems — the ship's enforcers are rounding up the scoundrels and suppressing the resistance. The situation on the middle decks is much worse, although strike teams have already been dispatched there. All communication with the bridge and the engineering bay was lost, so, apart from scattered {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox-casts{/g}, we have no information to go on."

efdde414-f007-408c-8893-b5908f7f5826.Text: "But that is not the worst of it all..." {n}He pauses when the light flickers yet again.{/n} "All these jolts and shaking are most alarming. These are signs that the {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Navigator{/g} and the Master Helmsman are having difficulty translating the ship out of the warp and into realspace. I fear that they may have already lost control. We must reach the Navigator's Sanctum and get a handle on the situation. If we can manage that, some aboard this vessel may yet survive."

4def9a1d-bcee-467d-9f54-d921438f443b.Text: "Oh, Holy {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}God-Emperor{/g}..." {n}Abelard clutches his forehead. He looks lost for the briefest of moments, but then quickly finds his resolve again.{/n} "I presume he is the one responsible for the mutiny? And, {mf|Master|Mistress} {name}, I wish to remind you that you are to refer to the Lord Captain as 'Lady Theodora.'"

1e06006a-3ec2-450d-bfad-041372360833.Text: "Lady Theodora's... Which one? The last one I received was about the Navigator's Sanctum, and that was... a good while ago. In any case, let us hope that the Lord Captain is well and safely in charge of the ship's defence. In the meantime, we must do all we can to prevent the ship from veering off course."

dbbdc309-1765-404d-8f2d-f580597cf5bf.Text: "Warrant Sentinel?" {n}He looks at the servo-skull floating next to you.{/n} "The Lord Captain barely ever ventures down to the Chamber... and I was at her side only once or twice when she did, and I did not see anything of the sort."

d35f820f-0732-4bc2-ba5d-1d69ebfc2c13.Text: {n}Abelard tilts his head and looks at you with worry.{/n} "You sent me a vox-message... specifically, a vox-cast on the officers' frequency, which I had the good fortune to receive... Do you mean to say you did no such thing?"

a109c56b-ca02-453b-8016-d04926caeb67.Text: {n}Abelard sighs before raising his voice slightly.{/n} "I concur that, under ordinary circumstances, interrupting the Navigator's solitude would be equivalent to suicide. Right now, however, our sacrifice could prevent the demise of a {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}, a voidship of the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}, and all her crew, armaments, and equipment. The choice is obvious."

47a3826e-3fe9-4369-83ef-d9eb4a08adbf.Text: "Certainly, {name}." {n}Abelard nonchalantly adjusts the blood-soaked sleeve of his coat.{/n} "This way."

aceadac1-6b70-469b-8a52-a12e4f736688.Text: "I am no helmsman or, God-Emperor preserve me, Navigator. However, I have spent my entire life aboard voidships equipped with warp drives, and I know that portents such as these do not bode well. It could be that the Geller field has faltered. Perhaps the Navigator was struck down by warp corruption and is fighting for the last shreds of his humanity as we speak..."

291c9f84-9220-4ee4-a4a9-607e7ec54b67.Text: "If we get thrown off course, we will be forever lost in the warp. Naturally, we would likely not have long to live in that scenario, but I will not resign myself to such an outcome just yet."

e8d0e17e-ef7c-4927-9db8-be3b3272b319.Text: {n}A wave of static suddenly erupts from the servo-skull, and you can make out Theodora's words through the noise:{/n} "To arms, loyal sons and daughters of the God-Emperor! Fight the heresy and corruption that threatens to consume our home, and with all your might, destroy those who have dared—"

cd7a50a4-0793-4461-a161-6014a49eb84a.Text: {n}Abelard glowers at you.{/n} "Absolutely. With the Lord Captain's permission, I shall give you an hour-long lecture on how making use of proper addresses corresponds to showing due faith in the God-Emperor's anointed. For now, however, we have more pressing matters on our hands."

53220070-fd38-4e46-ba75-90a0c998fb7a.Text: "During warp transit, the Sanctum is closed to all who are not involved in traversing the {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}Empyrean{/g}. And for good reason: for the Navigator to open their third eye and perceive the way, the Sanctum must be bathed in the energies of the Immaterium. Only a Navigator can withstand such an ordeal — for the rest of us, any contact with the warp is fraught with perils such as loss of sanity, spontaneous mutations, and death." {n}Abelard does not bat an eye as he lists all the horrors that you are about to face.{/n}

1483e02a-c1a1-4998-936d-b44242b097c5.Text: {n}Abelard examines you critically.{/n} "You are in a bad way, {name}. I can treat your wounds — I have a medicae kit with me. And, for the love of the Throne, now is not a good time to be walking around the decks without means of self-defence. Here." {n}He hands you a weapon.{/n}

c44bf78a-5027-48bf-a9f6-05bdc76a6c83.Text: {n}Abelard nods in satisfaction.{/n} "That is a noticeable improvement, {name}. Now you are prepared for the trials ahead."

2fd67580-64d7-4634-a6c0-b593e531fbbb.Text: {n}Abelard gives you a tired and somewhat irritated glance — the same way one looks at a disrespectful child.{/n} "I would be glad to follow formal protocol, {mf|Master|Mistress} {name}, but I am obliged by the circumstances to view this situation as an extraordinary one, and therefore one that permits deviations from our accustomed procedures."

4140f941-eca2-42e7-8b15-e6a91b517b79.Text: "What suspiciously poor timing for such an accident. Servitors malfunction on the officers' deck at exactly the same moment when the {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} and her heirs are gathered here." {n}Without taking his eyes off the bodies on the floor, Voigtvir removes the {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox-caster{/g} from his belt and speaks a few quick orders into the device. Then he turns to you.{/n} "I have blocked all passages between the upper and lower sectors of the residential decks. If this is a deliberate attack, it should stop the culprits from... advancing their plan."

3236d0ef-c82c-4a1e-bd58-1a7b4b0554d6.Text: {n}The lines on Voigtvir's forehead soften, and his voice regains its usual courtesy.{/n} "I'm afraid I must remain here, {name} — for Lady Theodora's safety, I have to oversee the execution of these orders personally. I hope you will have no difficulty reaching the observation platform on your own — it is just at the end of this corridor." {n}The Master of Whispers gives you a curt bow.{/n}

2164177a-0e4c-463b-8b92-4f4bb5d3c525.Text: "The Seneschal is right. There is no time for talk."

b5a33a16-28d1-4f57-976a-b04f7d6dce94.Text: "What is a warrior of the Adepta Sororitas doing aboard a Rogue Trader's ship? Your orders serve the Ecclesiarchy, do they not?"

e984a07b-9fc0-43d3-9d75-94c3969d99c3.Text: "What is happening on the officers' deck?"

122bcc87-31eb-45a7-90e9-727d416be24f.Text: "We must get to the main hall of the deck."

b120e9af-1185-4722-ad8a-d8988eede7f5.Text: "And just who are you to be so brazen about your enquiries?"

3e9b2bbd-fbed-4a64-958a-f02a083462d9.Text: "I am no traitor, Sister. You can be sure of that."

29c138e5-ef9c-4204-93d5-867a044c87fc.Text: "Do not even think to insinuate that I am one of the traitors. I will not let such an affront slide."

19619479-f088-4f07-bfb7-e12422123fba.Text: "{name} von Valancius. The Lord Captain's heir."

5a43362b-8804-4c4c-8265-4005f78fc4e9.Text: "I shall introduce myself after you do the same."

afbad6c1-8e28-4bf8-bc34-7cd3d899c8ce.Text: {n}The white-haired warrior turns to face you, her dark eyes blazing. The weapon quivers in her hands and, for a brief moment, it seems she is not going to stop and will instead continue eliminating every target she sees, starting with you.{/n}

a3d1aa68-584c-44b0-8bdc-f8e6998b758a.Text: "Sister Argenta!" {n}The Seneschal's voice seems to bring the warrior out of her battle trance.{/n} "Sister Argenta, it is a relief to see you. We require all the forces we can muster!"

91f3e398-276f-47d0-bb16-fff089ce475d.Text: "I cannot wait to rain righteous fire down upon each and every heretic!"

4b5c7a38-91ef-4dc5-ba93-b4a910d8d2f3.Text: "Sister Argenta is a guest of the Lord Captain." {n}Abelard shoots her a quick glance.{/n} "And that story deserves its own time and conversation — under more appropriate circumstances."

17905916-481b-445c-91e2-b540ed0d197b.Text: "Massacre, my {mf|lord|lady}! And heretics are not just killing the crew... Some kind of blight is sweeping through the decks, filling the air. I saw people going mad the moment they breathed it in... screaming about seeing their dead comrades... tearing out their eyes... I implore you, my {mf|lord|lady}, be on your guard!"

438d6686-a74a-4484-b587-47767638eadb.Text: "Ready. May Terra's light illuminate our path through fire and darkness!"

a8ecba6e-6f9c-4534-b488-fe9c6e11be51.Text: "That answer does you credit. Only the truly righteous would be so provoked by the accusation of heresy." {n}Argenta nods.{/n}

dc3c3356-85b4-479e-949e-0acc7783a0f4.Text: "If you speak truthfully, the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} will not forsake you. If you are lying, you will not escape His retribution."

c391c9e8-9ca9-4df9-be97-c08394add642.Text: "Enough idle chatter. I am where I must be, and that will suffice."

6335a076-9037-47ef-a624-b1e1a93de993.Text: "Sister, I beg of you!" {n}Abelard appears to be losing his patience.{/n} "Now is not the time for interrogations. The ship is under attack by heretics, we've been betrayed by our esteemed Master of Whispers, Edelthrad the heir is waiting for our aid, and Lord Captain Theodora is expecting a report on our success. We are here to deal with the situation! So I suggest we all do just that."

6b8370c0-ac31-439d-bb98-8c0a6c697b48.Text: {n}Idira lets out a croaking laugh.{/n} "Ha! First time I've seen anybody on this ship talk to the little sister like that!"

0f60dfb7-ec54-43d9-a756-8b107aaa0860.Text: "Allow me, {name}. Sister Argenta, sacred warrior of the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptaSororitas}Adepta Sororitas{/g}. Sister, this is {name} von Valancius, a member of the {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}'s house."

dc795687-67ae-49d1-9244-e119a9bb4ed4.Text: {n}Argenta gives you another stern appraisal. You catch something strange in the dark depths of her eyes, some internal struggle or a wordless question. In the end, however, she nods.{/n} "The hour is dark and daunting. The ship abounds with corruption. The faces of friends are twisted by sneers of heresy, the eyes of comrades ignite with the {g|Encyclopedia:Chaos}Archenemy{/g}'s hunger. I will do what I must to halt the advance of the dark forces, but in these dire moments little can be trusted. So I must know, why are you here?"

b35f6d72-aa90-43f3-8a93-1852280789a7.Text: "Very well. We may leave it at that... for now." {n}Argenta raises her chin proudly.{/n}

b2d21fd6-2700-45b7-87dc-1a21742c573a.Text: {n}The young woman called Argenta lowers her weapon and scans your small party with an intense gaze. Then she sets her sights on you.{/n} "Your face — it is unfamiliar. Who are you?"

6318b8ab-7cdd-486b-8cda-5e13f45bbce9.Text: "Overseer of Middle Deck AL-84, my {mf|lord|lady}! We were rounding up everyone we could find in the attacked compartments when we ran into an ambush. Just about every enforcer fell... These are the survivors."

b2c6942b-9ff1-4c50-a14b-d23563de748f.Text: "We will follow. For now, we will hold off any heretics who might try to crawl in through the cracks to join the main assault, and we'll take a look at the generators while we're at it. Those villains made a mess of the cables... Oh, I wish we had a technomat with us, but we'll see what we can do without one."

19cd5eb5-560f-4ec6-944f-54ae12efe3af.Text: "Through this door." {n}Argenta nods at the passage to your right.{/n} "I shall join you, for it is my duty to the God-Emperor to destroy this heresy."

1b334595-b75f-4d4a-9c2f-e44c050f3a4c.Text: "Back! Fall back! We will go around!"

905ee1d0-39aa-4dcd-82cd-cf25f2362f4d.Text: "Your ship's as good as ours. It's all over for you!"

a1db94bf-6ab0-40ce-9db2-fe92d78ccbf7.Text: "I shall pity not Your enemies, I shall heed not their pleas."

938384ac-1c2f-49c2-9b50-0d7598d35030.Text: "I shall betray not Your tenets, nor stray one step from them."

2d71db19-1332-4a28-abd7-e6d3fca50057.Text: "Take not Your gaze from me! Leave me not without Your grace!"

d79eb671-c892-402e-a03d-67393d14f307.Text: "I told you He would protect us..."

2cd01a74-be7c-4408-b032-8bdfb4ed3dec.Text: The nauseating vision grimaces and grins as if mocking the suffering of mortals.

7decabdc-1a61-4225-b017-7c19f3887e31.Text: The horrific vision is a product of the warp energies that permeate the bridge.

48a5061d-a3cf-4766-8c3b-063b590d4f09.Text: The study looks pristine — except for the corpses and traces of gunfire.

9f6f950b-ec41-4790-ac3e-bca8e25522f7.Text: The murder scene looks like something caught the victims by surprise — no one had time to react to what was happening.

7fd5dee2-b139-40ed-82ca-24c7bc2cc918.Text: What could easily be mistaken for gilded statues turn out to be servitors, clearly custom-built.

fd245e81-6c95-4c14-85b2-3ea1390cbd00.Text: The door does not budge — clots of viscous flesh have entangled the metal, sealing the door shut.

d56f808a-9ba1-4598-96ee-13ee6337ba39.Text: A fallen piece of debris that almost proved fatal to you. Without Idira's prediction, you would have remained in this corridor forever.

bcb44232-057e-417b-b194-ae441c18861e.Text: "Hurry! Destroy this field! Don't keep our master waiting!"

7dc39e15-683f-431a-906b-75b697c49edb.Text: The Navigator appears dead — only the slight movement of his chest and the twitching of his eyelids let you know that he is still clinging to life.

47d35218-b1f9-49cc-bf2e-1281e9661257.Text: The Navigator's Sanctum is the private haven of the ship's guide through the warp, and a death trap for anyone left inside after translation to the Immaterium.

9d05dcfa-6f44-470a-846f-ba43446a7d9a.Text: The benches and even the cogitator, torn from its proper place, are stacked in a rough semblance of a barricade.

f0196f5d-46b6-4c76-83ee-92d52a632ce0.Text: A fallen stele has blocked the path to the lifts — you will have to look for another way to Edelthrad.

5384e959-0d04-4e7b-bcda-28768663924a.Text: Titles and authors are printed in gold on the spines of the books. The library contains works on Imperium theology, law codices, biographical sketches, and chronicles of the greatest military conflicts of the Koronus Expanse and the Calixis Sector.

eb54c590-5676-4a36-a518-eecc3c8da3d4.Text: An exact replica of the von Valancius voidship sits on the pedestal. Certain parts of the vessel are labelled, but you cannot make sense of the wealth of strange terms.

15ebc132-7a75-4183-a04f-74c684b985c9.Text: An exact replica of the von Valancius voidship sits on the pedestal. Labels indicate the main compartments and decks of the vessel.

eb66f1c9-664c-4019-9d58-9eb088256af9.Text: The cogitator is silent — it seems that its machine spirit is no longer being powered by the Motive Force.

03fc3f4b-8885-49d7-bdfd-5e2c4403ca19.Text: The cosy seating area is completely destroyed. Pieces of furniture and splinters are scattered everywhere, and dark stains cover the floor and upholstery.

450a0bf6-32a3-4933-aadc-c599e8e720f4.Text: A fierce confrontation clearly unfolded here. Traces of gunfire, blood, and fragments of barricades cover the floor.

59a46db5-9a0c-415a-b9d2-b7e6ae92106f.Text: The door will not move an inch. It is blocked.

c520a77d-6d13-4c55-9367-0f9d14f0618b.Text: The explosion blasted a hole through the door — large enough for a person to get through.

fe0a5747-cf9f-4d05-813c-9def59c8f72a.Text: The door is blocked on the other side. It seems that there is only one way to reach the deck — with the help of explosives.

3e593f0c-d968-4136-8948-70952adccb2a.Text: The door is closed, but the lock looks intact — it can probably be opened with the right tool.

a9e000b0-d96d-4a1f-9a55-039caeb6a7ba.Text: Incomprehensible information is displayed on a large screen above the cogitators. You can make out references to unfamiliar systems and worlds among the numbers and logisticar symbols.

7a4156e5-b698-4ed2-aa6f-83c63197a062.Text: A massive conference table, obviously crafted from real wood — a resource of incredible value aboard a voidship.

f6c6482f-4b30-4b8a-9fda-bf831e038861.Text: A candlelit altar with a copy of the 2,348th volume of the Lex Imperialis, the codex of the sacred laws of the Imperium.

e0a30d16-6ac9-4ffb-9eb3-f85167786df7.Text: The cage from which Theodora's "pet" escaped shows no obvious signs of damage. The cause of the creature's escape remains a mystery to you.

6377e38e-9b87-420e-b897-3026c75b3b29.Text: A black shard resembling obsidian. If you look closely, you can discern a strange, barely perceptible glow inside the artefact.

63668801-dcbe-4c49-afe3-19e33128573e.Text: A massive golden amalgam interspersed with sparkling particles.

43b01343-aa92-4f89-a9c6-a85067261091.Text: A strange object that resembles sea coral. The porous surface is pitted, a sign that it has been under water.

0f4ad0ea-5ed7-41f6-882e-db1b3c8fa35f.Text: A violet alloy, which, upon closer examination, turns out to be a handcrafted object: symbols carved with a primitive tool are visible on the surface.

364d6f3b-0b1f-46a5-848f-59e76fe4c318.Text: The stone on the pedestal is no doubt solid, but its surface shimmers and changes hue — as if someone has captured a piece of turbulent sea within the rock.

3ffa60b3-04a8-4ed4-9b36-ec5462267c48.Text: A grey-green crystal with white veins. A low hum can be heard coming from the artefact.

eeb820c8-206f-4966-9c55-c579039f8eb0.Text: The lifts carrying people around the decks move with a loud grinding noise.

47ef6366-9356-4ef3-8ec0-cfdbc6016696.Text: Some dusty and seemingly broken artefacts are displayed in the case — too strange in appearance for you to determine their nature.

9cbf5a41-ae67-47ab-b336-b945c15f5d65.Text: A huge beast roars at your approach. The tentacles in its mouth begin to move, oozing muddy saliva from numerous pores.

623a36b8-18ed-483c-b42c-3a164f9f5519.Text: These windows look into the next room, not outside the voidship. You cannot make out anything through the cloudy glass, only the weak light filtering through from that side.

3f82ea18-5e94-4d78-b389-96b85e1bcdc1.Text: The massive metal structure never stops moving for a moment. Light bounces off the orbits and figures representing celestial bodies.

81f033fb-1112-429f-98c4-e8f5bb38638a.Text: The grand voidship temple occupies the entire space below the officers' deck and is lit by countless candles and lumens.

5d517682-2a69-470a-a8b3-d92e592dce49.Text: A monument dedicated to the von Valancius dynasty's acquisition of the Warrant of Trade, a symbol of the power and special role of the Rogue Trader in the service of the Imperium.

85f8f9a8-eee1-4e9a-ae0a-ca6c839582f7.Text: The generators hum softly. When you draw closer, your skin begins to tingle from static discharges.

53a09b74-b75b-4a8b-9c74-dd4e0d3b2c78.Text: A monument dedicated to the von Valancius dynasty's acquisition of the Warrant of Trade, a symbol of the power and special role of the Rogue Trader in the service of the Imperium.

62c6fbdc-c404-41b6-98d7-6c23460be85f.Text: A massive podium rises above the gap in the main temple — a bold architectural decision that could turn into a disaster with a well-placed shot.

d76dede2-3cf5-447d-bdcc-3c3a56b20bd0.Text: Plasma conduits blaze with energy capable of powering a vast voidship.

967ae41f-6572-4886-8c20-da8ae8318301.Text: This clearly does not serve as a stateroom — the generators, machines, and crude wall panelling indicate that it is a maintenance module room rather than an area for receiving guests.

34a3f125-0f96-474d-9f8b-027b07c48694.Text: "By the God-Emperor's grace, the translation to realspace is complete. Begin preparations for voidfaring."

9d8125a9-4c0b-4505-bf4e-e516d27eae2a.Text: "Requesting status report: maintenance bay... No response... Requesting status report: middle decks... Response received... Requesting status report..."

f368cb22-47f5-47c9-9df2-8fc3da2e61d2.Text: Numerous valuables and trophies are carelessly dumped into a single pile. It seems whoever put them here did not give these items any serious thought.

1d121446-0361-4390-9de5-a37d3f2533bd.Text: A bizarre fragment hung on a trophy board. The light, smooth surface of the object is dotted with dark spots and crumbling holes.

c742b2ea-1fcb-42b3-92c2-eddf6341440b.Text: A parlour organ with ivory keys, yellowed by long service.

23555509-fcf7-4904-ac74-130402fd9d11.Text: This majestic portrait painted by a skilled artist greets guests who have been granted permission to enter the Lord Captain's quarters.

2159e4fb-1df9-4358-bd09-9c3b6f2eafeb.Text: This hefty tome contains schematics of the flagship of House von Valancius in addition to a plethora of notes, copies of reports, and other documents.

30072757-68c6-429f-9f53-4897a962afbe.Text: The globe looks strange: you cannot put your finger on it, but something about the continents and oceans seems unfamiliar or even wrong.

7cdcdb3d-1978-4c91-bcda-8c0730b8223b.Text: The ticking of the chronos seems too quiet for its bulky size.

5e7f1b2a-fe2b-42f4-a02e-3745b8fd4789.Text: The light glinting off the polished skull of some unknown xenos makes it seem like the bony face is mocking you.

b29ca6cf-ac50-43c7-bead-0ba81436e37c.Text: The bookshelves are packed with ancient books, piles of papers, and tomes, many of which look rather worn.

19caad95-1723-4f18-8646-17138b10f8eb.Text: "Liturgies of the Faithful to His Word and Name." The text below this solemn heading looks noticeably faded. It appears that the prayer book has been kept open on this page for a very long time.

46bca587-1d18-4cdc-ba25-f435ded2bcc3.Text: The coat of arms of House von Valancius is crowned with the text of the oath of Rogue Traders, the Emperor's faithful servants.

02f4ad13-b781-422b-bdae-1343365e9dc2.Text: The glinting of the displayed weapons is mesmerising — you have never seen many of these articles before.

7e9b5cb2-122e-46c5-b0c4-f39bbd6b9d4d.Text: The positions of the pieces on the board suggest that this game of regicide was interrupted — the winner was never determined.

c7263cab-6274-422d-a8ad-bba41365e596.Text: The long-dead eyes of this fierce monster forever capture the fear and pain of its final moments.

c5c0fbf3-1dd3-43e8-9d68-5b62f84afc26.Text: Beyond the glass, the distant stars glimmer in the darkness of endless space, filling you with an odd sense of dread.

618c5213-92f9-4bd1-8ca3-6126ca7e6653.Text: The water's calming murmurs and the warm steam feel inexplicably deceptive. A moment of weakness and rest promises nothing but danger.

88d8aefe-353b-47a7-86b8-3ab6e7f937fd.Text: This fine sculpture made from a strange metal seems to absorb any rays of light that fall upon it.

905925e8-f89a-477d-92fc-ced65af037e5.Text: Still red-hot from the gunfire, the engines of death froze as they finished off the heretics that had infiltrated the sanctum of the voidship.

8dbe7002-9cad-4757-8230-368b326fc4eb.Text: The enormous gates match the importance of the thing they protect — the massive doors are made of heavy metal and look impregnable.

699ed102-6896-4c31-8d64-ec868fb88453.Text: "Master of Whispers, it's an emergency! The esteemed Lord Captain's pet has broken the bolts on its cage and escaped!"

ec3d3999-f951-43cb-81c7-45740fd265ee.Text: "How is that possible? Where is it now?"

04b4c498-6fcf-4f2b-bd89-7cec45d01fee.Text: "No! Not now! Begone, corruption! The warp has no power over me... the warp... has... no... aaahhhhhh!"

5f9f64e9-914a-4279-a6f6-e6bcc17beebf.Text: "Death. I hear it. Here, on the threshold of the blinded guide, doom... comes... from the heavens..."

dc9f1682-cb3d-4a4c-a0e3-be003e88cb1b.Text: "A melta charge will help. There's probably one around here somewhere..."

2eb6c9ff-fa75-4255-8f4f-4e7eb206b464.Text: "It won't open! The damned heretics have jammed the door — to hinder the righteous, no doubt!"

10fd7db9-d1ce-4be9-bb77-91a73cf8e084.Text: "I can scarcely believe it. On a day like this..."

104f9a53-6bbb-4bca-853b-bacb1c235ad7.Text: "Spread out. No one is allowed to enter the premises. Stations!"

af120c40-0ef4-47d9-8dac-bc7ff2e58fe8.Text: "The observation platform is at the end of this corridor."

afb2be5f-dc0c-4aee-940d-110aaac210d9.Text: "I highly recommend that you make haste. Lady Theodora does not tolerate tardiness."

104d9c9c-ea2e-4f67-955e-bc4c977514b8.Text: "I am currently preoccupied with matters of our safety. You, on the other hand, have somewhere you need to be — the Lord Captain is expecting you. Do not try her patience."

58bab648-638c-4c55-9b72-469c32218bad.Text: "I promised you a special destiny, {name}. It is time to fulfil it."

a4e42da5-445f-465c-a616-9d40d434f160.Text: "One of the von Valancius trophy rooms. Perhaps you would like to take a look around after your audience with the Lord Captain..."
