2d8d2c0b-6914-45b8-bb81-cd35cd724066.Text: "{name}, shoot! Shoot, and don't let it get close!"

9ae6ea2f-1de6-4c8a-94c9-9c6010b0c749.Text: The wires in the servitor's head are still smouldering. It would seem the cause of this malfunction was the short-circuiting of the Motive Force.

1780a6ba-d789-4b7e-b7f0-4c96e5177e51.Text: "What is this? Did they shoot us with something?"

a7749986-a416-4359-86cf-7747172a07da.Text: "I can't — I can't see a thing!"

2023e695-60d5-4655-acd3-64895cf5d2a8.Text: "This Hydra flak tank fell in the defence of Algeda Omega against hordes of unholy xenos. A paragon of the Imperium's might, it was extracted from the ruins of the Algeda Pillar and restored as a sacred relic of House von Valancius."

4cf91256-3112-4336-b6a5-a372cf3a956e.Text: "Leman Russ battle tank, reclaimed and restored by the grace of the God-Emperor, the first to breach the capital walls during the pacification of Vortez Chton."

73315274-505d-46ba-a619-0f3ba40ec121.Text: "Tarantula sentry gun, constructed with the blessing of the Adeptus Mechanicus using a Standard Template Construct in the manufactorums of Kiava Gamma."

676a0618-e79f-4b08-99d3-a8e596d2ef59.Text: This exhibit is unfinished. Another symbol of House von Valancius's valour will be displayed here at some point in the future.

b487bc7b-59ea-4377-9110-5a20c23c7f89.Text: "Report from the Enginseers... request for cargo transfer... there, I see an alert about loss of communication with decks eight and twelve."

e121dfd1-2983-4f4d-a0c5-0320d9586c7d.Text: "I'm concerned about the disrupted communication with the Navigator's Sanctum. We should have already approached the translation point and proceeded to realspace..."

b552294f-559b-4ca7-ab06-c79ee34b78f5.Text: "Abelard, check the latest communication reports for the upper decks."

0700c965-03a6-40b2-b7d6-e1095cb5daab.Text: "Once we are done with the riot, I want to have a look at the logisticars' reports — we need to understand what happened on the decks during the warp jump and the preparations preceding it."

95c7a8dc-cf3f-41e6-82fc-ed13eb53ee72.Text: "I have a tool that will allow me to check the status of the distant compartments that are out of vox-contact. But we have to wait for Mort's results first."

2342622e-fb03-4442-8e67-238de386bc60.Text: "...of your Lord Captain, whose house each of you swore to serve till your last breath. May your souls never lose the fervour and fire that bolster your hatred for the enemies of the Imperium..."

14f28e3d-d620-4e0e-a24d-10fb2759ff1d.Text: "...undaunted by enemies of Humanity, for not one of them can prevail over true servants of the Imperium who are ready to give their lives for His anointed..."

0fb9465f-b597-4213-9987-eb7313a8b513.Text: "...fight selflessly and lower not your bloodied arms till the last foe of Humankind is slain..."

a13c3295-2dcd-452b-b96e-d8748dcef4ac.Text: "...draw strength from your unwavering faith and find courage in fulfilling your final duty, for showing weakness before His enemies is heresy..."

b3f63481-af45-4846-a09a-cd330f474783.Text: "...who yield or falter in their courage will be executed in disgrace as traitors to this house and abettors of the enemies of Humanity. Cast aside your doubts, for they are an open door to the curse of..."

186d4f46-f7d6-4e2d-989d-05b3c04a64cf.Text: "We survived... Oh, just a little longer and we'd all be..."

bd5f2c7b-c143-430b-816d-2e1ab4248f5c.Text: "You did not abandon us! Thank the God-Emperor, if it hadn't been for your quick thinking..."

c8c3f362-822b-4c19-b94f-04ff2d5ea5af.Text: [Draw your weapon] "Voigtvir, you duplicitous cur! The Rogue Trader's death will be avenged!"

9b8c5dec-1aba-480b-b197-11a334405104.Text: "Theodora von Valancius is dead. I found her and the Arch-Militant in her study."

5a75e63c-b1a8-4eec-a17b-f6e86880627a.Text: "The ship can still be steered out of the warp, but we must first restore communication between the bridge and the Navigator's Sanctum."

08942f0b-94f5-46b9-bd47-611b7d7565ec.Text: "The Lord Captain will not be joining us."

11e415e4-9e40-4f3c-8e72-993b9ae5191c.Text: "Merely a trace of the corruption that is assailing this vessel."

7fbdaf87-9dc0-40de-a303-8c418e7d71bd.Text: "I have a Sister of Battle at my side! What suspicions could you possibly have?"

bccf82d6-53c8-465a-b058-cdd1c72329f2.Text: "I forbid you the very thought of yielding! Only by resigning to your fate will you truly suffer defeat!"

c6438ed4-444a-4811-ac7b-0d174717d3b7.Text: "Perhaps the warp does not have to be the end..."

9a9fa507-e172-4550-887c-33cdf96134ea.Text: [To the party] "Ready your weapons. If we are to die this day, let us die with honour."

ef4aed7f-a832-408f-8892-f7a1e270cfee.Text: {n}Edelthrad, who is clutching the bleeding wound on his chest, gives you a hateful glare.{/n} "Traitor... Right when we needed all forces to deliver a decisive blow, you stepped aside! Do not even try to claim that my {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox-casts{/g} did not reach you!"

a879a612-e07f-44f2-8c22-235d4f67873e.Text: {n}Edelthrad looks somewhat harrowed but is still in one piece. He glances at you, then over your shoulder, clearly alarmed.{/n} "{name}, you are here... but where is the Lord Captain?"

9c131aa3-d0ea-4dab-8a97-bd2aa7dcae02.Text: {n}Edelthrad, who is clutching a bleeding wound on his chest, gives you a tormented look.{/n} "Help has arrived? {d|Encyclopedia:Prologue_WentBack}Too late{/d} to change the tide, I'm afraid. But if there is any honour in you, we can at least die with dignity and give our lives for the {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}."

4a3b3818-b702-497f-a129-8a2a723b1fbf.Text: {n}You can see Kunrad Voigtvir clearly in the gloom of the bridge. The broken blade he is holding is stained with dark drops that seem to have a pearlescent glimmer to them.{/n}

1f20bb7d-7b31-4bbd-b8bf-7037377a5bf4.Text: {n}Edelthrad winces, which only makes his grimace worse.{/n} "I am still standing. And I have enough strength in me for one more fight. All that truly concerns me is this: where is the Lord Captain?"

89dd86b4-7c08-4950-9362-49cf067802ce.Text: "What? You!" {n}Edelthrad looks at you.{/n} "This is your doing!"

a6ecc92b-80d6-4d9a-8303-b832fc3e087a.Text: {n}Edelthrad's eyes widen.{/n} "{g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}God-Emperor{/g} preserve us, the Rogue Trader is dead? The ship has lost her Lord Captain, and the house its head..."

9aa701d6-def0-4656-90c6-91dd898d5fee.Text: {n}The {g|Encyclopedia:Psyker}psyker{/g} narrows his eyes.{/n} "I sense the mark of the {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}warp{/g} on you... an {d|Encyclopedia:Prologue_WentWithTheodora}echo of the powers{/d} that are ravaging this ship. What is it? The aftermath of the terrors that you had to face or an admission of guilt?"

a1c44e5d-8622-42c5-ac0f-4f8c8554eb72.Text: "Master Edelthrad... no. We have remained in each other's sight ever since {name} broke free from Kunrad's schemes. The Lord Captain was killed by another's hand... and, by the {g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Golden Throne{/g}, I can surmise whose hand it was!"

350b6d8c-e741-45a6-b831-7c63c7ed2152.Text: "I cannot vouch for your actions, {name}. What transpired on the officers' deck..." {n}Argenta's eyes are clouded as she looks past you.{/n}

bd4541e3-cf86-4282-b35c-606f591bc95a.Text: {n}Edelthrad glares at you for a few moments longer.{/n} "Perhaps. The {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}God-Emperor{/g} knows this crew is infested with corruption as it is..."

f5a5b896-7f37-4e32-90e0-d7a76db8aad3.Text: "Let us leave this conversation for another time. Master Edelthrad, it is with great sorrow that I inform you that Lady Theodora von Valancius is dead."

7e9d7bea-d6c6-4df8-9aa6-0a2698a338f2.Text: {n}Edelthrad shudders and grabs his shoulder. As you watch, the sleeve of his jacket bursts open, and two bone growths pierce through the fabric.{/n} "No matter what ritual Kunrad is performing there... the warp is too strong, I cannot withstand it. I feel my body changing with every second... The warp is ringing in the air... This is the end. We will perish in the {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}warp{/g}... along with the {g|Encyclopedia:Warrant}Warrant{/g} and all the dynasty's heirs. The enemy of Humanity has triumphed."

14a7692b-2fc4-4116-a9ac-f4a9b264d933.Text: "We are out of time!" {n}Edelthrad bites his knuckle, desperately thinking. You see a wave ripple across the whites of Edelthrad's eyes, and they begin to turn a sickly yellow.{/n}

db2cc575-8ea3-4383-838c-3e930c02b9b4.Text: {n}Edelthrad stares at you, and his eyes harden with cold resolve once more.{/n} "Then we have no right to bow our heads..."

c4464629-eede-4bef-be99-31c88cf3ba5e.Text: "Enough talking rubbish! The {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Navigator{/g}'s alive and ready to take the ship out of the warp if he gets some help from the bridge!"

16ab3ae1-35c8-4fac-b4c5-87972c81839c.Text: "Save the lofty words for later, will you? The {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Navigator{/g}'s ready to take the ship out of the warp if he gets some help from the bridge!"

d9833d24-6495-47d0-90fc-3d6e2b124d9a.Text: {n}Edelthrad gives you a confused look. Then, as realisation dawns on him, his eyes fill with disbelief.{/n} "No... The Rogue Trader... is dead?"

57354e67-be94-4625-9003-aee1aed82c23.Text: "Accursed traitor! A time will come when you will bleed for Her Ladyship Theodora's murder! Remember my words, for they are the vow of he who marches toward his death!"

d84db758-f656-4c3b-88aa-23a1aa815302.Text: "No, {name}. To die all together is to allow the flame of the dynasty to perish in the dark. No, it will not be like this. Not today."

cb198aa7-ff5b-482d-86ad-ed214c20f777.Text: {n}Idira looks anxiously at Edelthrad. Then she glances back at you.{/n} "I've seen it before. We'd... we'd better get away from him. The changes are already accelerating..."

bd236b8f-94cb-4a53-a6b9-01bad5d29b17.Text: {n}Edelthrad roars with mad, fanatical rage.{/n} "I will not die quietly alongside one who is a traitor to {mf|his|her} blood! If my last service to the Imperium is to rip out the throat of an enemy of Humanity... then such is the God-Emperor's will!"

c7571803-1037-4d97-a9c1-3c58c1cf9428.Text: {n}Edelthrad lowers his head. Then he sighs and locks eyes with you, his gaze cold, haughty, and fanatical.{/n} "The ritual will not be completed — I'll take care of it. And you... see to it that the voidship breaks free from the warp. Watch over our realm. And farewell."

45e70f48-5b98-4e51-9ce6-7a0148188d26.Text: "What? Theodora is... dead?" {n}Voigtvir stares at you in seemingly genuine bewilderment.{/n} "No! That can't be! Not now! I still haven't..."

c0c0a88a-feb8-44dc-913d-a42d9fea70d1.Text: "Are you the one behind all that is happening here? The one who addressed me and guided me out of the flames?"

a7e13a79-e8f6-47c8-83e0-e73ca5a9885e.Text: "I am saving my people. Do your worst, but you cannot stop me."

eccf12b3-7424-482c-86f2-9afb75a98ec8.Text: "I have already resisted the temptation of the warp once. Whatever you are, you will not cloud my mind with a new illusion!"

138377a1-fb93-4cf2-8ef6-fb01b5bbb4ec.Text: "You... You are to blame for Theodora's death?"

c6d2ac06-fa7b-43d0-ad71-6e96b4c334c1.Text: {n}The vision lets out a cawing laugh.{/n} "I am the beginning and the end, and all that courses in between. I am the voice of the Truth that is destined to triumph, for this triumph is the terminal point of every twisted maze of fate."

58c5bc71-03cf-4b18-a2a4-0cc16e9d2cb5.Text: "Did you stand in the path of another's destiny only to steal it? You accepted the call of the Primordial Truth — and claimed that fate as your own. So be it. I wove the threads of destiny and {d|Encyclopedia:Prologue_WentWithTheodora}held out my hand to you{/d} when the flame arose in your path. You took it and, in doing so, sealed your fate. In the future... in the future, you will repay me for this boon in full."

4f9231c5-3fdd-4803-bd03-4e87fb58d02f.Text: "Who are you to {d|Encyclopedia:Prologue_WentBack}oppose destiny itself{/d} for the sake of lives that are not your own? So many threads stretch between you and other creatures of your world — pitiful, worthless links, ready to shatter at the slightest touch. A muddled, erratic, pointless tangle."

13b71db8-ba22-4067-8687-82a76fa0ca47.Text: "Mortal. Who are you to oppose the very flows of fate?" {n}The vision lowers its head, its harrowing gaze boring into you. For but a moment, something changes in Theodora's expression. It almost looks like a shadow of... {d|Encyclopedia:Prologue_WentThroughFire}fear{/d}?{/n} "It matters not. Your footfalls are an echo of the sand pouring between the scales. Your hopes and faith are my mockery."

8bad3e7b-edb8-4093-9fe0-34b9e8c85535.Text: "Indeed, for the boundless Truth encompasses all. Merely one part of it reached out to you — and answer you did. You could become the new champion."

5c76b4b2-2db5-43ce-9a31-c564e15819ac.Text: {n}Theodora lets out a long screech — a shrill, overwhelming sound that can only be interpreted as laughter.{/n} "Lead them, mortal. Guide them, persuade them, force them to walk your path. You will need followers, for destiny is preordained."

ebe853b5-0487-46f2-9dd3-9010557a324f.Text: {n}Theodora hisses almost painfully, as if wounded by your words.{/n} "Resisting the inevitable means only that realisation and submission will bring greater torment. There is no power that can hinder the flows of fate."

30261dbe-ff01-46cc-b897-9f391a0f78d6.Text: {n}Your head begins to spin and viscous drops slither down your cheeks. You blink — and you are no longer looking at Theodora. It is the traitor Voigtvir, just as fluid and ephemeral as the previous apparition. The same terrifying voice seethes from his lips.{/n} "The aspirant vowed to return with a trophy — a relic that could serve the Edge of Daybreak. That fate was assured and the steps chosen. And yet... you broke the unbreakable when you took the aspirant's place. I see you — on the day when the final dawn rises over the iron world. I see you by my side on that day, the day of my resurrection."

1de0b6ff-9c01-4f7b-9df4-a6ddaf1a77bb.Text: {n}The image is scattered by invisible sorcerous winds — and you see Idira, her eyes aglow with the same sinister flame.{/n} "Your image is woven into the tapestry of things to come. I am the will of the Weaver of Destinies, and today, I will weave a new thread of elusive possibilities and fickle chances. The thread that will lead you out of the maw of irreversibility. The thread that will help you find the keys to salvation. The thread that will guide you and the weapon of our return to me."

f2e57fee-5a95-4ca8-82d6-14fee2e16974.Text: {n}A cavalcade of hazy glimpses of a future yet unknown passes before your eyes. A flash of crimson... purple... The images replace one another in a violent kaleidoscope without ever letting you get a proper look at them. Through the rippling mirage, you see a twisted image of Abelard, the loyal Seneschal of the dynasty.{/n} "The path is set, Child of the Dawn. The thread is woven. Follow it... servant of mine."

2066c4e2-dd0e-4445-8b49-8b48da8d9070.Text: {n}The image before you is hazy, swaying in sorcerous currents invisible to mortal eyes, as if whatever is beneath this thin shell is constantly changing while still remaining the same. It has taken on the guise of Theodora, but the false Rogue Trader's eyes reveal the entity's true, surreal nature. One of Theodora's eyes is engulfed in otherworldly fire, the other, a vessel of ancient evil, bores into you. A voice seeps directly into your brain without ever reaching your ears, and this voice booms with all the horrors of the warp.{/n}

0fbc2ed7-5999-4bfb-b90b-c2f0bc218311.Text: {n}It resonates and merges with the voices that have {d|Encyclopedia:Prologue_CutByKnife}already dug their foul roots{/d} into your consciousness. A moment later, you realise that all these voices are the myriad manifestations of the same call that has finally invaded your mind.{/n}

6d9e4246-3d53-4394-994c-dbb108b99c02.Text: "Did you see that? The Aquila! It was glowing!"

310a2ba6-992c-42ea-bb3a-73ab966af4ed.Text: [Dismiss the help and stand up on your own] "I feel fine."

deb6abb9-a79e-49ce-b720-60b062ce3f0b.Text: [Rise and stand tall] "No element holds power over the righteous."

e1cc3991-92da-48f8-a558-ba0f664086a9.Text: [Allow Abelard to help you up] "Admittedly, I've been better."

b49b5b64-66c2-4068-8b58-573f65b4c666.Text: {n}The blinding inferno, the harrowing pyre, the all-consuming storm releases you as you step out, barely able to stay on your feet. The blood is pounding in your ears, drowning out the world around you. Your eyes, caked in soot and burnt eyelashes, refuse to open. Free from the flames, you take two more steps before collapsing to your knees.{/n}

50a1bf6e-d608-4653-a9ce-d3fbff8f4f89.Text: {n}The rush of blood in your temples and the horrible pain all over your scorched body cloud your mind... before suddenly retreating, as if driven away by some mighty will. A new strength spreads throughout your veins, and despite the wounds, your body is once more ready for trials and struggle. You open your eyes and see, aglow with warm light before you, the {g|Encyclopedia:Aquila}Aquila{/g} — the sacred symbol of the Imperium.{/n}

87a9c996-3112-471c-9226-57310ca0ef01.Text: "—{mf|ster|stress} {name}! {mf|Master|Mistress} {name}, can you hear me?" {n}A familiar voice cuts through the din and the pounding — Seneschal Abelard Werserian is leaning over you, peering into your face with a look of worry. He notices your gaze and breathes a sigh of relief.{/n} "You are alive... which is more than I was expecting after what you just did!"

0e47edcd-4e7b-4aa3-b6c6-cab9896fdd8e.Text: {n}Behind Argenta, you see Idira Tlass doubled over in a fit of nausea. The rest of the people who were following you have withered away in the fire that continues to rage mere two steps away from you.{/n}

6639a730-c634-48f4-9717-0bfcb8d8c07b.Text: "Your attempts at humour are inappropriate." {n}Abelard frowns.{/n} "You nearly got us all killed..."

bc6b3b9a-c559-4348-80ba-69cf22ac093f.Text: {n}Idira wipes her mouth and rasps,{/n} "What happened to Lady Theodora? Did she follow us?"

8328df7e-f3ac-4630-9efa-1db566e0d6f0.Text: "There was no Theodora, witch." {n}Argenta is staring straight ahead, then crosses her arms over her chest with reverence.{/n} "There was an illusion, a temptation, a foul taint that tried to lead us astray. But {name} perceived its true nature!"

cfa9a312-b948-4b6b-b851-b586f79acb28.Text: "Is that right, Adepta Sanctimonious? What, we'll just pretend like we didn't see the Lord Captain standing there in the fire? Abelard, you tell her!"

b8bbb2d4-0fef-4937-8d46-80c6cc5fcaa1.Text: "Whatever it was... it matters no longer." {n}Abelard sighs.{/n} "Your conduct, {name}, is bordering on madness... or holiness. A path opened behind you. Where one moment there was fire, the next only smouldering embers remained... but what am I saying? My eyes must have deceived me — too much smoke for my lungs! Truly, would you have received wounds like these if there had been no fire?"

4dbe50f5-33dd-425a-a12b-5528583b840e.Text: {n}Your tone renders Abelard motionless, then he quickly makes the holy sign of the Aquila himself.{/n} "Indeed He does, {name}. If I hadn't seen it myself, I never would have believed..."

291021a2-3907-4005-8212-29929212c5bb.Text: {n}Abelard glances around, then looks back at you, his expression now twice as worried.{/n} "You are delirious, {name}. Whatever it is you think you are seeing..." {n}He seems perturbed by your words — he casts another, surreptitious glance at the Aquila you just pointed at.{/n}

ab11c5bf-86ba-404b-96c3-a213fc82bf01.Text: {n}Even if you were anticipating another wave of pain, it does not come: your muscles feel strong, and your limbs obey you without fail. And yet, deep inside, somewhere next to your heart and stomach, you feel a certain tension akin to that of a taut string: you are at your limit. Be it adrenaline or the strength of your faith, it will not carry you much farther.{/n}

125ac37d-8b1e-4489-bf7f-ff3fefdb54a2.Text: "Praise the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g}!" {n}Argenta kneels next to you, and for the first time you see her eyes radiate pure, unclouded joy.{/n} "We passed through the flames! Oh, how can this be anything but a portent? For so it is said that the Emperor will bless the worthiest and most steadfast in their faith!"

27882352-332a-4aee-b957-40ce227773e6.Text: "The wounds are merely a sign of a trial laudably passed. It is something to be proud of, the same as decorations or badges of honour." {n}Argenta herself sounds proud, even fervid.{/n}

ead35eab-fd3c-4b43-b826-a9bf030a0fdf.Text: {n}In the next moment, you are struck with another realisation: the {d|Encyclopedia:Prologue_CutByKnife}repulsive presence{/d}, the one that has plagued your mind since Voigtvir wounded you, is gone. The fire seems to have burned the entity away without a trace.{/n}

36780ad6-9a4a-4045-b4de-e4ca54c69228.Text: "Yes, I need to bolster my ranks."

19508b65-d654-4126-a83c-ca6b438494ec.Text: {n}The officer before you gives a refined bow.{/n} "Would you like to be provided with an armed escort, my {mf|lord|lady}? The ship's regulations state that you are entitled to a retinue of up to two fighters."

d3c5407c-e9bb-4810-a9a4-78412ee1c207.Text: "You will have to wait but a moment..."

c9ac18bf-81a6-436f-b976-a3daf89269a4.Text: {n}The officer sighs.{/n} "I fear you have reached the regulations' limit, my {mf|lord|lady}. You are already accompanied by both of the fighters you are authorised to have at your side."

7ce53995-e25c-4840-b94f-d300844bc352.Text: "How do you know who I am?"

ab150995-82a8-431b-8e41-83cd1fa4665f.Text: "We must see if the Navigator is well."

21598caf-ec01-4b49-b56f-da07cc4f8f6c.Text: {n}The woman before you whips around and gazes straight at you, her eyes glowing with otherworldly light.{/n} "...and so {mf|he|she} will enter the halls of the blinded guide, and witness the radiance of the final dawn through the cracks, and fall victim to a whim of fate..."

9352933b-730c-4b1e-8296-098adee0eaa0.Text: "Idira!" {n}Abelard grumbles as he dusts himself off and grips his weapon again.{/n} "Would it be too much to ask that you phrase your soothsayings plainly for once? That was too close!"

a4b8348b-ad35-4202-be3f-c68cf0465cce.Text: {n}The woman bursts into guttural, drunken laughter.{/n} "Sorry, old man — the voices are so loud I can't even hear myself! They shriek, they sing, they— oh, Abelard, how they sing!"

5ffd03f8-cc30-44a1-940e-c871600c4fbd.Text: "{name}, this is Idira Tlass, personal psyker and diviner of Her Ladyship Theodora von Valancius." {n}Abelard looks her up and down.{/n} "Idira..."

63534e8e-d5e1-49a4-bd69-c24b0c7fc47d.Text: "Dead. Without a doubt. And the voices wail, heralding countless nightmares, cackling at each soul among the hundreds that are now joining the warp. The shriek from the Navigator's Sanctum was louder than the rest — and it's better that we save the Navigator than some lever-puller from a cooling module or a cook from the middle decks!"

f4948779-155b-4221-af6c-68445b5c64b6.Text: {n}Idira nods, yet her gaze is directed somewhere away from you.{/n} "The voices from beyond the threshold whisper to me. Sometimes their murmurs are clear, they grant insight. Sometimes they drive me mad... But I am patient. I know how to listen. And discern. But now, with this clamour around me... Too many voices. Too loud."

17a91edc-aab6-430f-bbf3-ed85f1677177.Text: {n}Idira turns her head to you, her vacant eyes flaring like embers.{/n} "And you... you, {name} von Valancius, are a sorcerer {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Psyker}too{/d}. Just like the other one. Lady Theodora must have grown so fond of psykers she wants one to replace her..."

dbe057eb-b782-422a-a6f6-ccde156588dc.Text: "The whispers called me — the ones I could make out among all the screams and screeches. Those who are rocking this boat hit us where it hurt — they went after the {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Navigator{/g}, our guide through the warp. Other whispers called me to the enginarium... but it was too late. I heard the cry of our master cog... and the silence that followed."

f252f4a2-a4e3-4872-9bfe-f380baf7477b.Text: "Oh, no. No, no, no. Nothing is well about him. Can't you feel the chill crawling on your skin? The eyes watching you? The warp ice has already encased the bulkheads... What follows is calamity."

5732e608-7d90-4628-b747-23d548568b93.Text: {n}Idira freezes. Then she slaps her cheeks, rubs her face, and looks at you — the supernatural glow is gone from her eyes, and a smirk spreads across her lips.{/n} "But we're not just going to stand here and take it, are we? The state of things in here suggests there's a Navigator around — maybe one who's crippled or at death's door, but still kicking. And since our skin hasn't peeled off our faces just yet, his third eye must be closed — at worst, it's a little roughed up. So what are we moping around for? Let's go protect that noble mutant while we're still alive!"

8082dc74-763a-4205-b364-cf1470a8fbc5.Text: "I'm not drunk, old man. I'm suffering the effects of the {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}warp{/g} that is seeping through these walls. I see the ship's fate — to die in the waves of the Immaterium, fall under the burning rays of the final dawn... And in the roaring blaze, I see a figure standing... Who is it? I have no answer."

57430e4e-99dc-412c-8f0a-9bd979476cfa.Text: {n}Abelard spits out a florid curse.{/n} "Blast it! You're right — first we need to deal with what is happening here."

115f3c94-9684-461c-9e1e-3b9b7c624ebb.Text: {n}The {d|Encyclopedia:Prologue_CutByKnife}entity in your consciousness{/d} shrinks and crawls in deeper, its claws scraping against the walls of your mind, as if the presence is trying to hide from the seer standing before you.{/n}

36849b0b-a2cc-41c3-8dde-5e24c6152032.Text: {n}You flinch at the seer's words. No doubt she is referring to the {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Torture}nightmares{/d} the torturers inflicted upon your body and mind. Your muscles contract involuntarily as if steeling themselves once more for the inevitable pain.{/n}

f3db2559-bd2a-47f2-a779-f2177da37f2a.Text: {n}The seer's words dredge up {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Signs}something dark and frightening{/d} from the depths of your memory. Your soul has been tainted by the influence of warp sorcery, and it seems you will never be rid of it.{/n}

72773011-1031-4441-9609-5e2f65b18232.Text: {n}Idira turns her head to you, her vacant eyes flaring like embers.{/n} "And you... you are {name} von Valancius, one of Lady Theodora's heirs. Well, then. We finally meet."

03261c4b-e735-4c45-8696-a34a0f409fab.Text: {n}The seer's words bring back a wave of memories of the bitter, humiliating moments of {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Shame}your greatest shame{/d}. Something sour rushes to your tongue, and your head is clouded with a sickening sense of your own worthlessness.{/n}

e567a986-dfe3-4e23-bb1d-e41e7213fc57.Text: "What, you think Lady Theodora didn't ask me to peek into the darkness behind the backs of those she sees as her prospective heirs?" {n}Idira laughs in a deep voice.{/n} "I have seen you, {name}. I have seen the footsteps of your past and the wounds of your heart."

c00f0144-852a-49f6-9c6e-32fa73db2c77.Text: "What? You don't mean the Enginseer Prime is..."

fa256507-cc9e-48cb-8c40-6df7dba0fdbf.Text: {n}You hear a few clicks from the relays on the servo-skull, which has followed you all the way here, and Theodora's scrambled words give way to a voice vaguely familiar to you:{/n} "...officers' frequency. To all who can hear me: those with a weapon in their hands are to gather on the officers' deck at once. I repeat... gather on the officers' deck at once and prepare to launch a counter-attack..."

35dd6757-2e8c-4ab3-bbab-093e16e40547.Text: "That's Edelthrad! Emperor's providence, the other heir lives as well! Quickly, we must head to—"

67b97989-f8a9-4624-b37b-e5bdb4a61073.Text: "Not so fast, old man! If we drown in the warp, Lady Theodora's heirs won't be any good to us! If Edelthrad's like me and hasn't yet surrendered his mind or body to the mercy of the warp, then he can still hold on a little longer without us!"

14d4781c-918f-404f-90bb-0d9c76dfa347.Text: A blade made from a mysterious metal that shimmers with unnatural colours.

829bbad5-f2a7-428e-b8d4-c76e8e69722a.Text: "'Lord Captain'? A strange title for the Lady Theodora."

8f9d706a-faa6-4b8e-b908-9d2a6d113f8e.Text: "Frankly, such excess can be tiring at times."

ee14be8e-05d3-4a13-a736-ef0bf3059672.Text: "Do you have a particular reason for disturbing me?"

20e1adf5-9621-471d-bd8f-01bebd10c975.Text: "Divisional Commissar of the Officio Prefectus {name} Xanathaw."

be2a96a4-3689-44e1-9947-6ceb23e684bf.Text: "Commodore {name} van Mynaard, Lord Captain of Drusus's Blessing."

521f0cf1-8d3e-40b1-a8a1-8a54059b0a69.Text: "{name} Stubbs. My name is rather well known in certain circles in the Calixis Sector."

c22845a6-940c-4736-ae33-58de96f101f8.Text: "{mf|Duke|Duchess} {name} Aeos Venria de Vahl af Calixis. You may call me 'Your Grace.'"

8189ea37-29af-4082-86bf-b7e2931a7c02.Text: "Lieutenant General {name} Scipio-Grimald, Commander of the 8th Army of the Scanthian Janissaries."

b0d0a1bc-4c63-411d-960f-ad1bc53b8f76.Text: "My name is {name}. And so as to avoid any misunderstanding, I am a sanctioned psyker."

17523a57-4c7b-46d1-8cc2-7f8617e2f637.Text: "I have no intention of introducing myself."

fbb6bcf4-5607-41af-99f7-ce301c200acc.Text: "All this ostentatious luxury, this laughable pretence... It is enough to make one think that the architects meant to compensate rather than glorify."

050fad0e-2a19-4490-bf89-c534aa0db7a1.Text: "I merely criticised the talentless architects of this place, nothing more."

8e287266-c632-465f-a780-8f907135b863.Text: "I thank you for your advice. I shall strive to follow it in the future."

fa643c5a-7416-4f9b-926d-42cb81a3f418.Text: "I do not show deference for things I do not believe in myself."

b508f56c-9a39-4124-8965-56482e806573.Text: "You seem to attach much importance to words. Well, I have a fondness for names. I have yet to hear yours."

8b7ca5ac-8cb9-43bb-8cac-835148deb4bd.Text: "I prefer to serve by acting, not speaking."

b1de74d7-117b-4320-9c31-4675342f6231.Text: "Why am I aboard this vessel? Why have I been brought here?"

f8ac294b-5959-43a4-9d40-b82f098cef41.Text: "I assume you had some goal in mind when you decided to seek me out. Let us address it."

e9543475-1f5b-4742-9f35-1b7eaacdf41a.Text: "You have a curious title — Master of Whispers. What are your responsibilities?"

aeac8f0a-cd45-4ba7-bd7f-52ab76d98a4d.Text: "You say I am one of the Rogue Trader's heirs... So there is another candidate?"

e89edcf8-d14c-4f85-b778-4c223fc129aa.Text: "Tell me about the one on whose ship I have found myself."

ca2ef6c0-f159-447d-96d3-164e4ab8bb84.Text: "An excellent place for contemplation." {n}The man who has approached you is gazing down into the depths of the vast temple on one of the lower decks.{/n} "One has the best view of the cathedral from here. Mesmerising, wouldn't you say? An impeccable manifestation of the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}God-Emperor{/g}'s sublimity."

db5d2764-b932-490e-864c-a9196703b725.Text: "Such are the traditions of the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}. Lord Captain is the title that was established in the annals of the {g|Encyclopedia:LexImperialis}Lex Imperialis{/g} at the time when the first Rogue Traders entered the God-Emperor's service, and therefore it is sacrosanct."

43cbd32b-0157-4e7b-a405-c7583c4a5f50.Text: "I would rather not discuss the Lord Captain behind her back — especially not on board her ship. No one knows better than I that whispers are wont to attract particularly close attention!" {n}Voigtvir laughs and shakes his head.{/n} "Suffice it to say that Her Ladyship is the bearer of the sacred {g|Encyclopedia:Warrant}Warrant of Trade{/g}, and a woman of immense power and entitlement. However privileged your position may be, I ask that you do not incur her anger by being disrespectful or obtuse. Lady Theodora despises both qualities."

0c1ed0ba-6657-4b0b-ba85-a55d8b8a523b.Text: "I see that you are shocked. Yes, you understood correctly. Lady Theodora's authority indeed supersedes that of those whom you obeyed before. The Lord Captain's power is so great that she is capable of performing unthinkable feats, such as changing the fate of a servant of the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}. Your fate."

d5c76593-ebff-4b4c-90e4-6b0466214d56.Text: "Your former position may have been different from conventional service as part of one of the institutions of the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}, but from now on, a different fate awaits you — one chosen for you by the Lord Captain. I advise you to come to terms with this reality as quickly as possible."

9e4c0e7f-8a1f-4bf4-b413-7161ab0877d6.Text: {n}The man nods in satisfaction, as if your words have confirmed some thought he had.{/n} "That is the purpose of all temples to the God-Emperor: to inspire awe and reverence. For it is the duty of His servants to persevere in their tireless service until they are presented with a chance to give their very life for the Master of Humanity." {n}He sighs and turns to you.{/n}

e920d58c-dab7-4a91-8e16-7173225cea40.Text: {n}The man gives you a sympathetic look.{/n} "I believe there are those among us who share that sentiment. But such is our duty, is it not? To overcome base weaknesses and desires so as to excel in our service to the God-Emperor, the Master of Humanity." {n}He shakes his head and turns to you.{/n}

171c5042-e1d8-4309-af8e-79cf44dec21a.Text: {n}The man turns to you and bows.{/n} "My apologies. I did not seek you out to pester you with unwanted attention."

031209d1-d587-470d-9ae1-5629138d657f.Text: "Allow me to introduce myself. Kunrad Voigtvir, Master of Whispers in the employ of Her Ladyship {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} Theodora von Valancius. At your service. I haven't had the pleasure of speaking with you in person before..." {n}Voigtvir bows his head and focuses his attention on you.{/n}

ad883201-5fb5-4de9-850c-d9b5b07ea189.Text: "My regards, {name}..." {n}Voigtvir looks you up and down with a thin smile.{/n} "Or should I say, {name} von Valancius, scion of a blessed Rogue Trader house in the service of the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}? Perhaps this kinship came as a shock to you. Understandably so, given that all evidence of the connection was lost in the generations separating you and Lord Captain Theodora. It required no small effort on the part of Her Ladyship's servants to discover and verify this blood tie, which has now made you one of the heirs of this dynasty."

41a095af-1280-4b0d-a7d4-8a8ad2b1c5b8.Text: "My regards, Commissar. Finding you was a difficult task, given your parents' fate and your upbringing in the {g|Encyclopedia:ScholaProgenium}Schola Progenium{/g}. Truly our meeting is an act of providence, is it not?" {n}Voigtvir smiles faintly, but you are not sure it is directed at you.{/n}

ce26ba77-7d37-4176-a13a-f5c7c7048dd6.Text: "My regards, {name}. Naturally, the infamy of your... achievements in the shadows of an entire sector is not unknown to me. Your enterprising spirit and — if you excuse my bluntness — refusal to die are qualities worth saluting. It is as if you were carried here on the wings of destiny itself." {n}Voigtvir smiles faintly, but you are not sure it is directed at you.{/n}

b65904c7-2662-413c-9c58-e269b9cf1da3.Text: "My deepest respects to you, Your Grace. A noble of the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g} — it's been a long time since providence last brought such eminent guests aboard this vessel!" {n}Voigtvir smiles faintly, but you are not sure it is directed at you.{/n}

cc8eab5a-17ae-49c7-b962-456a19afb7f8.Text: "My regards, Lieutenant General. The {g|Encyclopedia:AstraMilitarum}Astra Militarum{/g} is the hammer of the God-Emperor, isn't that what they say? Well, it is likely that fate will give you ample opportunity to demonstrate your talents as a commander." {n}Voigtvir smiles faintly, but you are not sure it is directed at you.{/n}

119aad60-41cd-4a09-8691-3a76b56a22e1.Text: "My regards, Your Reverence. As far as I am aware, you were in charge of resource distribution for the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMinistorum}Adeptus Ministorum{/g}... A rather fortunate coincidence, considering where fate has brought you in the end." {n}Voigtvir smiles faintly, but you are not sure it is directed at you.{/n}

08db96ea-05a7-4411-adce-541c9970130f.Text: "My regards, Lord Captain... though perhaps I should refrain from addressing you thus while aboard this vessel. With all due respect, Commodore." {n}Voigtvir smiles faintly, but you are not sure it is directed at you.{/n}

17da523d-17ef-44e8-af52-6b043d1e7de9.Text: {n}Voigtvir nods gravely.{/n} "I am aware of that fact, {name} — it would have been unacceptable negligence to have overlooked such a detail when compiling your profile. Fate bestowed upon you powers of witchcraft... and a duty to use them for the good of the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}. Yours is truly an unenviable lot."

accfa543-e23f-44ff-935e-2a971fee8d18.Text: {n}Voigtvir smiles guiltily.{/n} "I am afraid I wouldn't be able to hide my familiarity with who you are and where you come from, {name}, no matter how respectful I tried to be of you and your wishes. After all, it is my primary duty to be well informed. Moreover... whatever bloodline name you used before, it no longer matters much."

60873fad-fef6-4218-bd80-fa7511abdbbb.Text: "So that you may fulfil your blood duty, {name}. Whatever obligations you had before, they are henceforth null and void. By order of the Lord Captain, you have been requisitioned to serve the Rogue Trader in deeds blessed by the God-Emperor."

9491c280-bac0-47e8-a876-ff16e30a95a7.Text: {n}The man casts an intrigued eye over you.{/n} "An interesting perspective. However, allow me to offer you a bit of advice: in the interests of your own well-being, you should frame your thoughts with greater piety. Demonstrating such a lack of care when choosing your words might be viewed by certain people as evidence of insufficient trepidation before the God-Emperor, the Master of Humanity."

714446d0-b3c4-4e8b-91d3-a9899183b4d0.Text: "I understand. But the particularities of my craft have made me a perceptive individual capable of seeing through to the root of things — unlike millions of His devout servants. Trust me, your words could easily be interpreted a different way, especially by one inclined to do so."

35579d48-4afe-4fad-a086-e9cd7a9e3928.Text: "That is commendable, quite so. However, there are many, many who believe that toils in His name start with diligence in choosing one's own words. Remember that when next you are presented with the privilege of conversing about Him with loyal servants of the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}."

5aaab80d-8194-46df-b514-038cba8f22c5.Text: {n}The man bows slightly.{/n} "I am glad to have pleased you, for that is my duty to the dynasty of His chosen."

77defef7-67c8-4417-8e66-0bb4c5f2ec5c.Text: {n}He studies your face with interest.{/n} "Your position won't protect you for long if you continue making such pronouncements. Know that a fate far more compelling and eventful awaits you than being executed as a heretic."

69add308-40ee-479f-b427-76d8b7d92e70.Text: {n}The man lets out a laugh that he deftly masks by clearing his throat.{/n} "My apologies. The statements you made were so intriguing that I forgot myself."

059885b6-3a80-441e-afb2-f81a37f4d10d.Text: "I will be frank with you: you may forget your past titles no matter who gave them to you or what their origins are. From the moment you and the other candidate were brought aboard this voidship, your fate changed: you now serve Lord Captain Theodora von Valancius and carry the burden of an heir of this house. Henceforth, you share your dynastic name with Her Ladyship. Bear it with honour."

1db2dd55-57c5-4d9b-bc09-8e436f2e690d.Text: "To put it plainly, I am the head of the network of spies and informers who serve the interests of House von Valancius. I uncover weak links both among Lady Theodora's retinue and in the ranks of her rivals. I eliminate our vulnerabilities and exploit those of others."

f005ce77-7a04-4315-8869-a23e6932cd63.Text: "The Lord Captain and Master Edelthrad von Valancius are conversing on the observation platform. Let us join them there."

2691affc-215c-4302-9c14-f1e6745eef53.Text: {n}Voigtvir shrugs slightly.{/n} "There is. And you will meet him soon enough."

87c26401-b2a7-4f58-8ffc-fe274ceee8b0.Text: "My regards, Your Reverence. Judging by the beginning of our conversation, you have rather... interesting views on the deeds of the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMinistorum}Adeptus Ministorum{/g}." {n}Voigtvir smiles slyly, looking you in the eye.{/n} "You, {name}, are an individual of extraordinary talent, to have retained your rank this long. Or perhaps providence itself has shown you favour."

2ab9ec32-0648-4bc0-8349-4cacf5067909.Text: "But of course. I have come to invite you to a meeting with Lady Theodora. I imagine you have many questions for your patroness. And I'm sure she has just as many questions for you. It is regrettable that you haven't yet had an opportunity to speak — it has been an arduous voyage thus far."

bb408716-f229-4c72-b9f7-014b4b355779.Text: "My regards, Marshal. The Adeptus Arbites are famous for their unbending will and keen instinct for uncovering hidden webs of conspiracy and scheming. This is admittedly a priceless skill for someone destined for a path as special as yours." {n}Voigtvir smiles faintly, but you are not sure it is directed at you.{/n}

85ea92a8-aadb-4d2c-b3fe-1a3a56432a95.Text: "Will you let me join you? We can take the Warrant from Theodora together!"

285e367c-2da9-4e06-81d2-720493568d48.Text: [Fight the voice in your head] "Get out! I am not your puppet!"

7798883e-546d-4ffb-874c-7b6093fd6130.Text: "Voigtvir, you two-faced scum! You are the one behind this mayhem!"

b24099de-f528-4d22-85e8-9d2f3755b724.Text: "What is it, inbred? Is your blood too thin for the Sentinel?"

20d98349-623b-4182-95b0-00bb33d1209d.Text: "What sorry, pathetic excuse do you even have for your apostasy, you sordid, wretched piece of grox shit?"

15329134-17e6-4387-92a7-6c48fc5a5d19.Text: "I have no intention of helping you!"

68c81888-7764-4496-b7ad-f28481b8e743.Text: "I will help you. As long as you spare my life."

d08b7407-c21c-40d5-b942-03da372dc293.Text: "I will do as you require... but I will find a way to make you pay for this, you filth."

cedf5076-97ae-4103-bdba-a0f84109f2fb.Text: "Enough threats. I will comply with your demands."

ef141c2e-4fee-4455-a7b2-66f4760e1741.Text: "Careful! Careful! Be gentle with our guest — {mf|he|she} has an important mission to complete during our visit to the {g|Encyclopedia:Warrant}Warrant{/g} Chamber, and for that I need {mf|him|her} breathing." {n}Voigtvir looks down at you.{/n} "You are back with us, I see. Delightful."

0c6a011c-e39f-4e9f-ab88-72b47b4d63d5.Text: {n}Voigtvir tilts his head.{/n} "Hmm... I may consider it. Once you have done what I need you to do."

1107f9b4-68f6-46af-ad88-0462063d9f57.Text: {n}The voices in your head persist in their demands, and yet you feel this unseen chorus momentarily waver under the strength of your resolve... until the intruding influence forces you to your feet and pushes you toward the gates looming in the centre of the chamber.{/n}

61f58550-68bb-4bab-b572-78dad4ef8ffe.Text: "You must have hit your head harder than I thought... No matter — very little is required of you. Just your blood, which you can either share of your own volition, or I will spill it for you."

cb12863f-edf7-4a2d-a7bd-3f81430a382f.Text: "How perceptive of you, {name}. I'll help you with the next insight: I need you here for your blood. You have the option to share it voluntarily — or I will squeeze it out of you myself."

c6451676-9a9e-4db7-b458-3d3d58001895.Text: "We are in the anteroom of the Warrant Chamber — this voidship's most hallowed vault. There, beyond those gates, lies the relic that gives Theodora all of her power — the sacred {g|Encyclopedia:Warrant}Warrant of Trade{/g}. Only one obstacle remains on my path to obtaining it — the gates to the Chamber are guarded by the Sentinel, an ancient device that will only open the door to a true heir of the dynasty. I expected to do this part myself, but... never mind. You will offer your blood to the Sentinel."

6426e7bf-201b-4130-9593-5a33e245fc74.Text: "On the contrary. The warp's blessing has raised me too much above your kind, von Valancius. The Sentinel refused to submit to me... but you can help — after all, isn't that what family is for?"

8962691b-99f9-4f15-b360-d0827f7c7714.Text: "There's a good {mf|boy|girl}. Then go to the Sentinel at the gates of the Warrant Chamber and fulfil your destiny. I had hoped to feed Edelthrad to the machine — he is the one who caught Theodora's eye, after all — but since procuring him has proved difficult, you will have to do."

00a2d692-cabe-40da-b72e-0362ea627c10.Text: "I am afraid that you, {name} von Valancius, have no choice in the matter." {n}Voigtvir produces a strange object — a blade without a handle that shimmers blue in the light.{/n} "Try to resist, and I will demonstrate the power that the warp holds over mortals. Come to think of it, I might even take some pleasure in doing so."

caa773e2-f6af-4a31-a1cc-0907d8ad0b4f.Text: {n}The blade flashes in the dim light, and drops of blood appear on your palm. For a brief moment, you feel nauseous, your head is spinning... and then quiet whispers begin to flood your mind. More and more sourceless voices echo each other, drowning out your own thoughts... replacing them with a singular urge... Go. To. The gate. Go. To. The gate. Go. To. The gate.{/n}

958665ee-a30e-426e-9892-66068d7e47dd.Text: "I doubt it, my dear {name}. But that's enough talk. Fulfil your destiny."

0f4d14ff-f6e9-4f49-a646-33330694acf9.Text: {n}Something — either your tone or the venomous words — throws Kunrad off for a moment, as hateful fury blazes from beneath the mask of a cold professional.{/n} "Wretched? What do you know about wretchedness, Theodora's cur? Are you hoping to buy a grain of her indulgence with your blind loyalty? Oh, I know this delusion — but, thank the gods, it no longer has power over me. Humanity can rot — I no longer serve mortalkind."

9067231a-a2b1-4d8a-b8ec-a300c065311f.Text: {n}Voigtvir hesitates for a second and then produces a strange weapon — a blade without a handle that shimmers blue in the light.{/n} "Once my work is done, I'll make that pompous wench von Valancius watch as I sacrifice her entire dynasty and commit their fate to the gods... and you, {name}, will be the instrument by which I will accomplish this righteous act."

04fbc947-673e-4988-a46a-3be43f4720ba.Text: "Why? Because I am following an order. What is happening on the ship right now has been in the making for a very long time. All that remains is to obtain what my masters sent me for. The Warrant of Trade."

19d1162d-8063-4d49-97e7-007ce4869031.Text: {n}You close your eyes and try to {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Psyker}focus{/d}... and then you feel the touch of something sharp — Voigtvir has somehow sensed a shift in the warp and delivered a pre-emptive strike.{/n}

eabd8c63-b3d6-454b-a110-fc473b0d279f.Text: {n}The voices in your head giggle and mock your desperate outcry. You feel this {d|Encyclopedia:Prologue_CutByKnife}intruding influence{/d} forcing you onto your feet and making you take a step toward the gates looming in the centre of the chamber.{/n}

8dbfe122-2112-4f60-95c5-291642e5d7c1.Text: "In whatever state? What does that mean?"

3dcf3d84-b8b5-4ce6-9f9f-559988236f45.Text: "Mutiny? But who would attempt a mutiny here, in the warp?"

7304019a-3622-4e78-89d9-a753f7ce51d4.Text: "A mutiny against the Emperor's anointed! Execute the traitors, every last one of them!"

21a83e88-ced8-4c88-980d-c6af72172633.Text: "We must provide immediate assistance to those still on the middle decks. Perhaps then we might stop this wave from spreading."

c6a91abe-120e-46b6-9078-557ca211c342.Text: "If this is indeed a severe case of warp madness, then the situation is dire..."

8b18c705-ce7e-4831-9b67-42b5ec20ab9b.Text: "I shall do everything in my power."

b29dbf52-380b-4e7a-991e-35daead819f3.Text: "I cannot promise that I won't lose our dearest heir somewhere along the way..."

95dd5746-8e47-4a8e-8574-960fc46d5b17.Text: "I shall make do. Lead the way."

24e77f0f-7014-44bf-9e06-fc7e5af7cec3.Text: "I have a proposition: since I am the more important person here, you can go in the front to shield me from potential threats."

9628f6f3-a99a-4c13-a0fa-4da660651f50.Text: "You had better not fail me. The Lord Captain made it clear that relying on you is fraught with risk."

1422c954-9156-4cc8-9496-37768a95e39a.Text: {n}Kunrad Voigtvir lets out a sigh of relief upon seeing you.{/n} "Thank providence you are alive and well—"

921c6754-2490-4f95-84a5-5857dc4767a2.Text: "Master of Whispers, what is happening on my ship? The {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox-net{/g} is silent, the Vox Master is not responding, armed assailants have stormed the officers' deck, and my Arch-Militant just destroyed several more heretics on the way here. Is this a severe case of {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}warp{/g} madness? Have some of my crew lost their minds and forgotten who they are and whom they serve? Report!"

3e99ad83-910e-49ee-a38a-f64a79a4ccbb.Text: "I have not yet received word from the enginarium regarding any Geller field failures... but communications were already unstable half an hour ago, and now they have ceased altogether. Whatever the cause may be, the consequences are spreading fast. I am receiving scattered reports from the middle decks, and the only vox-casts from the lower bays are one-way heretical gibberish." {n}Voigtvir pauses.{/n} "That the madmen have already reached the officers' deck suggests that this outrage was planned in advance. Perhaps this is an organised mutiny."

2cca197e-c276-4502-9b7c-7bb8de776e06.Text: {n}The Arch-Militant looks back at you.{/n} "What, did the Lord Captain send you to chivvy us along? We are all done here, I'll report right away..." {n}Mort pulls his vox from the belt and hurriedly reports on the situation.{/n}

43e755d5-3db6-4a8b-952b-3b8d3f972e53.Text: "Lunatics. Fools. Heretics. This ship houses thousands upon thousands of people — pernicious thoughts and warp-induced delusions could have tainted any one of them. It is a difficult notion to accept, but such risks are inescapable."

eaa6ecf9-c0bc-4106-8225-4324b0e0cec2.Text: "First we have to confirm that the bridge and the Navigator's Sanctum are secure... and I have the means to do both things at once." {n}Her expression changes as her eyes flash ominously.{/n}

e670455b-f2c4-434f-af2d-ec8422d1f9a6.Text: "You don't know the half of it." {n}Mort is in the middle of checking his arsenal.{/n} "There's only one thing worse than the warp addling the brains of our crew, and that's the warp itself crawling all over our decks... Bah, I shouldn't even think about it — it's bad luck! Your orders, Lord Captain?"

7bcfe2ab-6733-4e92-9822-2e340f04b8fe.Text: {n}Theodora looks at Voigtvir.{/n} "Edelthrad — where is he? I must know if he is unharmed! A psyker aboard a ship that is potentially being assailed by the warp could pose a greater threat to himself and others than a whole army of madmen with improvised weapons!"

6d8f5e96-c2d3-40a4-aefd-0bfbfe871fcc.Text: "I tried to locate him, but the last thing known about his movements is that he arrived on Transitional Deck 18..."

5fd7d875-fccf-440a-9510-4c277ef506d1.Text: "Blast it! Master of Whispers, find Edelthrad immediately. Seneschal, locate Tlass and the Sister of Battle — both are to remain at my side. Arch-Militant, with me — I must go to my study, and it appears we might encounter heretics along the way. {name}..." {n}Theodora glances at you thoughtfully.{/n}

de3ff86c-9957-467f-8fbf-a1d8037b6143.Text: "If I may, Lord Captain?" {n}Voigtvir's voice is soft and cautious.{/n} "Transitional Deck 18 is at the heart of the disturbance, and, if our goal is to bring Edelthrad back, I could use some support. After all, I am not as adept at directly confronting enemies of the house as the esteemed Arch-Militant... and taking into consideration Edelthrad's psyker powers..."

f1c8c6da-da25-4eb4-bf6b-631e86a53d20.Text: "Then it's settled. {name}, find Edelthrad and bring him here — in whatever state you find him. This elevator..." {n}She points at the massive doors.{/n} "...leads to restricted compartments such as my personal chambers and the bridge. Do not let me down. I require you both, do you understand?"

85dcaf1e-22d9-45b0-b05a-b5572a404cd5.Text: {n}Theodora waves a hand impatiently.{/n} "Then move out! Mort, come!"

eedb48a0-0459-47fc-9c38-02efba2571f8.Text: {n}Theodora hisses in fury.{/n} "Not 'everything in your power' — you will do as I say! I'll have your heads if you fail! Is that clear? Then move out! Mort, come!"

ccfef52b-a5d4-407b-8fcc-0d9a6bf33c6e.Text: {n}Theodora shakes her head.{/n} "Kunrad... keep an eye on our spirited guest. You are personally responsible. Mort!"

e0f02133-a9b0-474a-adae-8e133c69a593.Text: {n}Voigtvir gives you a nod.{/n} "Are you ready to head to 18? It is a long walk, and you do not even have proper gear..."

265fc6de-f99e-43c2-9664-e0ee4e3fde22.Text: "Of course you will." {n}He rummages in his pocket for something.{/n} "Lady Theodora would never have someone she couldn't rely on as one of her heirs... but that is no longer relevant."

e121ba71-d294-4305-8792-dc0e8c7a878b.Text: {n}He smiles faintly.{/n} "Certainly. Lady Theodora would be devastated if she were to lose one of her precious heirs... but that is no longer relevant."

c53c516f-492e-4fca-916a-80434add5409.Text: {n}He pales at your words, but you cannot tell if it is because of shame or fury.{/n} "I see you have quickly earned Lady Theodora's trust if she is already sharing her closely guarded secrets with you... but that is no longer relevant."

b8b7ef36-894b-460c-a411-f7d9d798d26e.Text: {n}Something hits you hard with a sharp crackle — and you are consumed by unbearable, gut-wrenching pain.{/n}

352e8f54-77be-41ae-9349-a01b5ad182a5.Text: "Always on time, eh, Kunrad? The moment we finish chasing the riffraff around the deck, you show up! Always just after the fighting's done. You could set your chrono by it..."

33786221-2325-41b0-860e-f96ef062f780.Text: {n}Kunrad pointedly looks away from the Arch-Militant to you.{/n} "Mort. Pull yourself together."

dbf68466-a15e-4ba8-b4eb-cf372043b6ed.Text: {n}Kunrad coughs.{/n} "We are in the warp. Considering the attack... there could be a disruption in the Geller field and the infiltration of malevolent forces onto the decks. Psykers... can react to such things in the most unpredictable ways..."

345fb5a3-e05c-4c0c-974e-c8b66dad25bf.Text: "Enough! Master of Whispers, you must not allow my heir to turn into a mindless mutant and to perish under enforcer fire! Do whatever it takes to bring Edelthrad back to me!"

fbe3f98a-de64-4ab4-9d24-54063a0a8627.Text: "The incident with the rampaging servitors may be connected to what is transpiring now."

c5139f4e-c36c-461c-a95e-993817902d27.Text: "How could there be armed people in the ranks of the crew who would dare to attack the Lord Captain?"

c743aeb0-7cfd-4da5-add2-1822e8c5a5a2.Text: {n}Theodora waves her hand in a commanding gesture.{/n} "Mort! Take a team with you and clear a path to the transport line! Do not let a single whoreson survive!"

032d76f9-0c09-4c7c-8052-996e664740ed.Text: {n}The {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} turns her eyes to you.{/n} "Didn't bat an eye when that scum burst onto the deck, hmm? Not bad. I have seen many an officer who panicked at the sight of combat on the upper decks — the false sense of security offered by their position makes them that much more vulnerable to the harsh realities of {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}warp{/g} travel." {n}She looks at the {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g} in her hand. All you can hear is lifeless static.{/n}

136dd2cb-bdcf-4f1e-a65b-855ecbafa413.Text: "From what we have seen, {name}, I can speculate that we are dealing with some variety of madness induced by warp travel." {n}The Seneschal is astonishingly calm for someone who just survived a sudden attack.{/n} "Such episodes are not uncommon among voidsmen who have found themselves outside the boundaries of realspace... though such episodes seldom spill onto other decks."

218468d2-0b13-42bb-98f4-158fb6b1a409.Text: {n}Theodora clicks her vox a few times.{/n} "The casters are not working. Or have been sabotaged. Either the warp is toying with us or someone went to great lengths to cut the ship's communications. I will need a direct channel to the {g|Encyclopedia:Enginseer}Enginseer{/g} Prime before I can get a sense of what we are up against. Whatever it may be, keep your weapons at the ready. I imagine it will be some time before we no longer need them."

59a7b57e-4ba1-4776-a251-38e8d8b61a29.Text: {n}The Seneschal gives you a gloomy look.{/n} "Trust me, {name}, this is hardly surprising for a crew of thousands. The lower decks are a fertile environment for discontent and heresy, no matter how one tries to incinerate any seed before it can take root. All it takes is a hint of warp influence to cloud the minds of normally obedient cattle."

ea724255-9ae5-4d75-a08c-315ef9ccec94.Text: "Possibly. Quite likely." {n}Theodora winces and flicks the switch on her vox a few times.{/n} "We will investigate at a later time. Right now we need to isolate the affected compartments and try to assess the situation."

733f2512-f962-4a39-8db5-8dbea983a71e.Text: {n}She breaks eye contact with you.{/n} "Mort has gone on ahead to clear a path for us. If you want to make yourself useful, go after him and see if the Arch-Militant requires aid. And be quick about it."

2a4eed4f-ebd2-43cb-a31f-75648f12a64c.Text: "Sporadic riots on the lower decks never reach these compartments!" {n}Theodora's anger causes the Seneschal to shrink slightly.{/n} "No, the tumults of the rabble are always contained within their own territory. This is too well organised. It is spreading too rapidly..."

87e9132e-6dda-4551-8c4d-2c8c30bcde07.Text: "I cannot bear to see his agony any longer. I would rather put an end to it."

281ef709-c10d-4e3b-b04e-0fba6b1a563d.Text: "Our time is short to do what?"

db459447-7886-48ec-91a0-1f9011e0b907.Text: "You are in need of help. We have to get you out of that chair."

1a6bd5f6-56aa-407d-b50f-720fcd5e2bb8.Text: "I want to help you. Tell me how."

889ee106-e0c4-4a0a-a4d8-151ddfcdd65a.Text: [Address your companions] "What is that supposed to mean?"

72d03828-629d-443b-b0d3-607877b5437b.Text: [Address Abelard] "The Navigator is still alive, but barely so. What do we do now?"

aaea348f-cced-47fa-81e4-8ed19cb78890.Text: {n}The creature in the chair appears as if it has become one with its throne: you see pink, parchment-like skin stretched between the seat and the limbs that have too many joints for a normal human being. The {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Navigator{/g} is breathing heavily, the air whistling as it exits through the two dark gill-like slits on its cheeks. The creature's eyes are shut — the two ordinary eyes as well as the third one that sits in the centre of its forehead.{/n}

3c3313f7-2db2-49b0-95d9-c49b73be805f.Text: "Its march thunders under the burden of hopes! Unseal your hearts, and I will flood your souls with myriads of words and meanings, each one a portent of salvation within me!" {n}The Navigator continues to convulse violently in his seat, shrieking and cackling, but then his fit stops abruptly. His face is drenched in black and crimson — the dark ooze from under his third eyelid has turned from a trickle into a stream mixed with the blood coming out of his nose, and there is purplish swelling around the eye.{/n}

9188c3e6-fc4e-4611-8211-0129fc1efab6.Text: {n}The Navigator does not give her a response. Black tears mixed with blood are streaming from under the closed eyelids, and the vox at the base of the chair is bellowing out static interspersed with distant echoes of otherworldly laughter.{/n}

c7349119-5c98-4f28-8d2e-d30992e43e8a.Text: {n}Each word rings through your head like the tolling of a bell, as if {d|Encyclopedia:Prologue_CutByKnife}countless voices{/d} have joined in, screaming into your ears. For a moment, you lose your bearings — this unholy chorus must be trying to confound you with sounds not meant for this world.{/n}

5c267bb7-fae4-4ff0-80e1-9c01de65a9d8.Text: {n}The Navigator stirs, barely able to lift his head and half-open his normal eyes. A dark drop rolls from under the closed lid of the third eye and down his face, leaving behind a black trail.{/n} "Your time... is short..." {n}The voice is coming from the {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox-grille{/g} at the base of the bizarre chair. It is unclear how the Navigator is able to produce human speech.{/n}

09db881f-227b-4004-8b2c-e7dbb39718c6.Text: {n}Idira winces.{/n} "Wounded. Exhausted. Fighting back the endless horrors of the warp that are forcing their way into his head. Pick one."

68d1b3c9-78fb-40af-ab74-37055adcfc89.Text: {n}Suddenly, the Navigator's body starts thrashing in place: it lurches forward, then falls back onto the seat, then thrusts forward again as its bones crack and its skin tears open. However, the fusion between the body and the chair appears to be stronger than these wild impetuses: the mutant remains seated but leans as far forward as he can, his layered raiment slowly turning crimson. The gill slits burst open, forming two hideous screaming mouth-like pits.{/n} "Fall to your knees, mortals, and behold the final dawn!"

f062b2a8-6e08-4f13-b3cf-2ca319d4341c.Text: {n}Idira shrieks in terror.{/n} "It came from beyond! His body is not his!"

6fc3dfd8-b3e5-48c6-82de-ac653135043b.Text: "Run... Flee from this place while I still have the strength..." {n}The words come out of the vox as a laboured rattle.{/n} "I can contain... the intrusion... but not for long. We must begin the translation... leave the warp... but it can't be done without the Master Helmsman's help..."

42fb39e4-3336-4c0c-8397-8389d484e430.Text: {n}The Navigator takes a ragged breath.{/n} "Run. The Sanctum will be sealed. I will hold it off... hold on... and wait for the signal from the Master Helmsman. Then I will commence the translation. So... run. Run!"

b331db50-8758-4da7-b9df-1d6f2bb50aaf.Text: "The Edge..." {n}The Navigator starts thrashing about once more, his gill-mouths bursting with crazed laughter.{/n} "Kneel before the ascent of a new champion! When the rite is complete, this shell will burst, and thousands of maws will accept the sacrifice offered to the Edge of Daybreak by the bringer of twilight, the one marked by the will of the gods!"

dc15a24c-e2b9-4562-9d1a-201d6407dc77.Text: {n}The Navigator, or rather the thing that is so determined to seize his body, erupts into mocking laughter.{/n} "The footfalls of the bringer of twilight are veiled by the will of his masters. Tear out your eyes, she who is to become the champion's servant, for you need them no longer!"

8fa03b01-1f2b-4917-9e38-fa3787ee60df.Text: "A rite... A sacrifice offered... Oh, my heart tells me that Kunrad was not deterred by his defeat in the Warrant Chamber!"

5f3970ee-88c9-44af-a972-3181655e9770.Text: "What? Kunrad betrayed Lady Theodora?" {n}Idira clutches her head.{/n} "But how is that... How... He was as loyal as a dog! And I didn't hear a thing, I swear!"

c6c70206-99b1-4526-9414-1cc2daba86e7.Text: {n}The Seneschal gazes at the figure in the chair.{/n} "The ship can only begin the translation with the assistance of the Master Helmsman... if he is still alive. It is worth a try. We must get to the bridge, but we will need support. Our only option is to fight our way to the officers' deck and join forces with Edelthrad and his people. I believe we will also find Lady Theodora there — she must have heard the call to arms that the servo-skull relayed to us earlier."

41a8197d-203c-4620-8562-a73e5f393506.Text: {n}Idira reaches her hand out toward the Navigator, but pulls it back at the last moment.{/n} "Vespiadas... good luck. And thank you."

d6fc78b9-3c73-439f-83f6-abc470d7d6b1.Text: "I believe Master Vespiadas still lives..." {n}Abelard flinches at the sight of the stretched skin and the dark marks on the face of the creature.{/n} "The servants are dead... but the chamber, thank the Emperor, is still sealed from the warp. Well, we have a chance of leaving this place alive..."

d4df654a-54a8-41bd-a249-a0386c84115e.Text: "You can't! It's only thanks to Master Vespiadas that we're still alive. If he falls, this whole ship is doomed!" {n}She catches her breath.{/n} "Let him do his duty. You know it's the last thing he'll ever do... if he lasts that long..."

d8dd62c1-68f5-471f-b081-1980e87bdd58.Text: {n}Idira's scream is echoed by the silent cries in your head — the {d|Encyclopedia:Prologue_CutByKnife}unseen creature{/d} triumphs at the sight of the Navigator succumbing to the paroxysms of corruption.{/n}

e669a6cf-3bd5-4459-98d0-6cb0d28a667b.Text: {n}Ravor turns around and looks up at you. He hesitates for a few moments, then addresses Abelard, who is standing next to you.{/n} "Seneschal, the Navigator's Sanctum is silent. The vox-signal is stable, which means..."

3a95cb24-9072-484c-a1ae-ae2671204240.Text: {n}Abelard nods absent-mindedly.{/n} "The Navigator gave his life battling the storm that nearly claimed the von Valancius flagship. We will honour his memory along with that of all who died this day."

19ace1c5-6572-4115-ba15-89824c314309.Text: {n}Ravor does not look away. He is giving you a hard stare, his white brows furrowed.{/n} "Seneschal... Will you tell us now? Who is that? Where's the Lord Captain?"

fdb14699-616e-4862-8eab-cec0f8c56766.Text: {n}It takes time for Abelard to respond: you watch as he grits his teeth, unable to bring himself to say anything. Finally, he adjusts his blood-stained coat, straightens, and begins to speak,{/n} "As First Officer, it is my duty... to inform you, with the greatest regret and indelible sorrow, that Lord Captain Theodora von Valancius is dead. May her memory never fade from the annals of the dynasty."

39d85534-2bc3-4e82-bed0-c83e3a8ed847.Text: {n}After waiting out the first wave of shocked cries, Abelard glances at you and continues,{/n} "By right of blood succession and with the absence of other kin who could challenge this decision..."

30651f28-8615-4f8f-8216-6d22f037b312.Text: {n}The Seneschal turns to you. He looks at least half a decade older.{/n} "The deed is done, {name}... My apologies. I meant to say, Lord Captain."

ff9ac85c-bb3d-4a81-9d5d-0569196eaaaf.Text: "...it is hereby declared that the successor to Theodora von Valancius is {name}, the rightful inheritor of the Warrant of Trade and the title of Rogue Trader. The official ascension ceremony will be held at a later time. In the interim..." {n}Abelard stops short and glares fiercely at the confused officers.{/n} "Have you lost your tongues? Hail your {mf|lord|lady} — it is because of {mf|his|her} toils that we all still live!"

3d80cf24-0928-46c4-8424-d8d3f73fd725.Text: "We need to re-establish contact with the Navigator's Sanctum. It is our only chance of escaping from the warp."

d63f2f2b-21b6-4342-96b5-c34dc3d7d1ae.Text: "How did you people survive in here?"

603ff722-64d8-44b0-9a34-a4606d377284.Text: "By the Emperor, it's the Seneschal! Living and breathing!" {n}The white-haired man with sickly-pale skin salutes you.{/n} "Well, there's a tricky question — the whole place is so overgrown with foul wickedry we'll be scrubbing it off the vid-screens for Throne knows how long..."

efa3e435-7594-4c58-9db2-b1d80a06a714.Text: "Restore the vox-channel to the Navigator's Sanctum. Ready the crew. Prepare for translation to realspace!" {n}Abelard pauses for a few seconds before turning to you.{/n} "{name}, you may call me superstitious, but translation is not a good time to disregard rules. You are the only one who speaks for House von Valancius. You may not be the Lord Captain, but you, more than anyone else, deserve to take her place in the ritual that is about to commence." {n}He directs your attention upward — to the throne that sits at the apex of the tall staircase.{/n}

ced566d2-a912-40a2-a33f-4c708a24e4e9.Text: "Take the Lord Cap'n's seat. Order the final preparations. Wait for the officers to report... bah, blast it all to the void! Translation is a craft, not something to be explained in a tick! Just go up to the throne, {mf|Master|Mistress} {name} — these people are about to do the impossible, the least they deserve is the solace of seeing a figure sitting in the usual spot. Please hurry! Every second we waste is a terrible risk!"

4d2a3825-f7a7-4feb-a013-84167bc68c31.Text: {n}Your words seem to knock the officers out of their stupor, and the air around you fills with voices and commands being issued. You hear someone sobbing — one of the survivors buckling under the stress. Abelard cuffs the crying officer without even looking.{/n}

af273c17-2531-4977-a64b-01336118fdef.Text: {n}The man glances around the bridge.{/n} "Musta been providence... it better have been the Emperor's, not someone else's. When they barged in here, the ones with the Master of Whispers, some officers charged them, but it wasn't even a fight... I grabbed whoever I could and dragged 'em behind the cogitators, then I prayed for our rescue."

f773c002-a5cf-472f-96c9-6678c6f48c39.Text: Succumbed to the promises of power and allowed "Theodora" to lead you out of the fire trap.

8c84cc01-cde5-490a-936f-2efe3eac9c54.Text: [Accept the offer of help] "Take my pain away. And give me power."

b8c4ca1b-d9a4-4e50-995c-41e887bebf0c.Text: Passed through the flames, refusing "Theodora's" help.

09c4ac96-7dc1-4abf-b1e2-97d93cdf8f2a.Text: [Walk through the fire] "The Emperor will guide the righteous on their path."

1dcc4061-73da-4dcc-9515-075aeb5ba0b2.Text: Led the people out of the fire trap, refusing "Theodora's" help.

9025b812-7e34-449b-a1c1-32dc027aa962.Text: [Get the people off the bridge] "I will not leave my people in harm's way!"

d79fc6b9-b641-42c1-816a-9d0b9913cb8d.Text: {n}The roar of the flames rings in your ears, and the choking smoke makes you cough and gasp for air. You instinctively recoil from the scorching heat, wiping your face. A moment later, a hazy silhouette forms in the raging wall of fire. You are surrounded by ear-splitting noise and screaming, yet you distinctly hear the sound of footsteps — and then you see the figure walk out of the fire toward you. It is Theodora von Valancius.{/n}

9343091e-7b25-47cd-a185-e93c89bf335f.Text: {n}Her expression is calm — terrifyingly so for someone whose body is engulfed in an inferno. One of her hands is resting on the hilt of her power sword, the other is raised in an inviting gesture.{/n} "Are you lost, my heir?"

a656d797-11d7-4ee6-a328-b16b225d7733.Text: {n}Your mouth begins to salivate — each word Theodora speaks is like music to your ears. The {d|Encyclopedia:Prologue_CutByKnife}entity{/d} that now dwells in the deepest recesses of your mind is pleading, begging, demanding that you give her an immediate answer — and that answer can be nothing other than acceptance.{/n}

f72f20f6-c4bd-442d-aa22-27e0988b8a2a.Text: {n}Argenta goes as still as a statue, then slowly raises her weapon.{/n} "An apparition... A sorcerous apparition! Trickery of the warp!"

94843f49-4a9d-4959-a7da-76856bc39613.Text: "Sister, you will lower your weapon!" {n}Despite his commanding tone, Abelard does not sound too confident — he is staring at the {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}, and you notice a muscle in his cheek twitching.{/n} "Threatening the Lord Captain is outrageous..."

3041af75-783c-4a5c-bcb6-d31ccc98eee2.Text: "I doubt you are aware of the limits of what is possible, {name}, for your worldview is but an iota of what a Rogue Trader knows and sees. But I can tell that you would like me to share that knowledge with you. That power over reality."

c2494085-cd75-4e38-aa61-6f496514fd82.Text: "Pain is but a reflection of one's weakness, {name}. To renounce weakness of spirit in pursuit of greatness is the only path to heights worthy of a Rogue Trader."

6b842bb6-931d-4ca6-a729-21819c56624b.Text: "I am a Rogue Trader, {name}. I am wherever my will demands me to be. Would you prefer to be elsewhere at this time? Indubitably. But are you ready?"

a70f4e31-9793-4754-bb97-8cb132353174.Text: {n}Theodora watches you without blinking. Her snake-like gaze almost makes you forget about the fire searing you, leaving burns on your skin.{/n} "I can lead you out of these flames, {name}. Show you a path. Rid you of pain. And give you a weapon so that you may defeat your enemies. Decide."

7617433b-2914-407d-baf5-55fbe98bab03.Text: "Do not listen to this abomination! {name}, if you... If there is naught but His light in your heart, if you are resolute in your faith, then step into the flames! The {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} protects. His faithful will not be deterred by either darkness or deceitful promises. Nor will the fire burn those who carry the torch of faith in their soul!"

a96d6ee3-87e7-44c5-b901-27575b4a2177.Text: "To the void with you... We need to follow Lady Theodora! Before we suffocate in this furnace!"

7218f6f3-4544-47f1-9578-00ef114b6eb0.Text: "The people...!" {n}Abelard looks back at the coughing and confused people around you.{/n} "{name}! The survivors from the middle decks! We must help the crew... lead them out... find a way around..." {n}Over the roaring flames, you hear distant sounds... frightened voices, screams... muffled and distorted, as if there were a body of water between you and them.{/n}

8d122d56-7284-4e7f-96e3-77b5cd3781bd.Text: "Then we'll miss our chance to meet up with Ede—" {n}Idira breaks off and starts coughing violently. Her knees buckle, and she looks like she is about to fall.{/n} "{name}, what are we waiting for?"

16d90eb6-4a7f-4c0c-9199-22049fd25735.Text: {n}You offer Theodora your hand — and the air around you seems to tighten, becoming thick and viscous, enveloping you and your companions in an impenetrable veil. Theodora smiles at you. Her radiant, piercing blue eyes suddenly remind you of Voigtvir's.{/n}

4845692c-7244-4e04-9d03-c9c6ee347f96.Text: {n}You take a step forward — and the illusion breaks. A wave of excruciating pain crashes over you, and Theodora's voice fades into the firestorm. You hear the voices of your companions calling you from behind... and the screams of the weak dying in the inescapable blaze.{/n}

a91f9d1a-0652-4d62-abdf-feacd834dd9e.Text: {n}You look away — and the illusion breaks. The unbearable heat instantly makes your skin burn, and the voices of the people beyond the shroud of smoke grow stronger... and hopeful, once you and your companions rush back, barking orders and guiding the survivors. In your determination, you completely forget about Theodora, and when you turn your head, you see nothing but the bellowing fire.{/n}

ce7c95cb-8572-4614-967f-8bed79f72f9d.Text: "I will show you the way. Go on, close your eyes..."

785864be-37d5-4a6e-89e6-bef3f04f7179.Text: {n}{d|Encyclopedia:Prologue_CutByKnife}Thousands of needles{/d} pierce your consciousness but are powerless to stop you.{/n}

05ec55cf-049c-4cc3-84a3-12e1eea2533b.Text: "My experience tells me that when wealth is involved, someone is trying to appropriate it. This looks like the actions of a criminal syndicate stealing extractors under the cover of barbaric rites. I am ready to land on the planet with an assault squad and pass judgement on the thieves."

c232a61c-db7b-4b90-b531-7fad4115289e.Text: "Was it not you who sent for me?"

b08f96cc-b0d6-4a82-ab8c-b6abc9968419.Text: "I am here to speak with the Lord Captain."

bbf1140b-47a2-414b-8a3f-ae064d83cf4b.Text: "I am a former Commissar. I would continue sending in more people. One crew after another, until someone succeeded in their service to Humanity and the conquest of Aion VI."

311e0049-a936-4a57-95f8-0293646db11b.Text: "Seismic activity, you say? I wish I could look at some augur readings, but, theoretically, a couple of well-placed orbital strikes would drown Aion VI and all its terrors in an ocean of magma."

f93b3b93-753b-4774-9a5d-ed8c3360b5e2.Text: "I have retained some connections in the Astra Militarum... A few Imperial Guard regiments would take care of the natives, their 'spirits,' and the magma — solid fortifications have never let me down."

f505ffda-9d07-4b3f-97dd-c1357e62fc67.Text: "I believe I could use my personal abilities to ascertain whether there was sorcery on Aion VI. But it would require going down to the surface in person."

bb21a120-c2b3-4f0f-a034-766afb717ccf.Text: "Why should I concern myself with making this decision? I always have servants on hand to whom I can delegate matters such as this — just as you have delegated it to me."

08c10187-9263-437e-b786-6e06d99fc9b8.Text: "If my... particular life experiences are any indication, some of the natives would eagerly betray their chieftains in exchange for a quiet life serving on board my ship. I would then leave dealing with Aion VI to those who know it best."

51af22c9-e420-4feb-9d35-fed92d7a5fab.Text: "The natives of Aion VI are lost souls in need of a shepherd's crook... or a whip. I am a priest of the Ecclesiarchy. I know how to instil reverence for the Emperor. There are many ways."

53e13aee-7430-421f-a27e-91dc07cdfc44.Text: "These reports of spirits certainly sound like evidence of heresy... however, I would put my interests first. No matter what means I would have to use, the riches of Aion VI would be mine."

e3e3999c-41df-4b76-baea-927bb1e76d91.Text: "Aion VI must be purged. For the good of the Imperium, I shall exterminate the heretical beliefs and otherworldly powers that rule the native apostates."

37ee19c4-b13a-4b83-905b-eccfae593fca.Text: "There are ways to confirm whether what is happening on Aion VI is witchcraft or not. It might cost several psykers to do so, but it will give us the answer."

b9e99187-6059-4bcc-a709-fc5cbea5a88e.Text: "Gracious Lord Captain! Surely there are ways I can prove myself a worthy heir?"

683720fc-12db-4d09-a2f9-ebec33c5ed2b.Text: "Navigator? Translation? What are these things that you speak of?"

68e81a20-3be7-49d2-a948-3b14889013a4.Text: "I gave a straight answer to a simple question. Which, as I understand, was still more than you could do, Edelthrad."

c2074d6d-10de-4786-9af2-bc027a09fb1b.Text: "We are both servants of the God-Emperor and Lady Theodora. Does it become anyone of our status to engage in petty feuds?"

28538f20-99b6-42f1-aac8-a7a3882e9302.Text: "I find your tone most disagreeable, Edelthrad. You will kindly alter the manner in which you address me, or else you will live to regret the consequences."

913801ea-d73f-42d2-9e1d-adbe02850954.Text: "Shut your mouth, Edelthrad, before I decide to shut it for you."

6d0c75ca-3952-464e-a48e-573538bc4cfc.Text: "'One of'? Does this mean there are other heirs?"

df59f7bc-743d-4960-add4-9d3be3222f41.Text: "If you are satisfied with Edelthrad, then what sense is there in having this conversation? Why are you wasting your time on me?"

e5d44de7-147b-4f0d-bc7c-0863f695b5df.Text: "Did I hear you correctly? The Master of Whispers is related to you?"

d700dd93-2ad5-43c5-97e5-7f2d237e6196.Text: "Thank you for clarifying. May I ask my questions now?"
