499d65f5-dfc6-4233-9197-ffe2420a635e.Text: Lord Captain, a warp jump to the Hermitage cannot be calculated. We cannot detect its shadow within the sacred radiance of the {g|Encyclopedia:Astronomican}Astronomican{/g} — the warp's storms are obstructing everything. We think our only chance is to make a longer jump to Footfall. Our chances of survival are low, but not non-existent. Emperor preserve us.

9b1915fe-1c6a-4440-8cfd-de2de0022334.Text: I don't know how they haven't gone crazy yet, sitting in the middle of this warp storm. There are around a thousand people there — a few hundred outcasts and anchorites living permanently on the station, and the crew of a trading vessel that barely made it as far as the Hermitage and won't be departing ever again. It seems they spend whole days sitting under their crystal dome praying, eating ration packs, and watching as reality loses its mind. They say the Emperor will protect them against the coming tempest... Of course they do. He is the only thing they can trust in now. For them, there is nowhere else to turn. We offered them passage on our ship — not one said yes. Mad, all of them.

61336f22-3127-4c5d-a0c0-efa66cd8e500.Text: Halting their vigil over the sacred machines, the Enginseers left the majestic vaults of the enginarium.

845bb119-dc34-431d-a36c-12cb15a866ae.Text: To send repair teams to put out the fire, the officers had to drive the voidsmen away from the rescue shuttles with weapons in their hands. The instigators of the shameful attempt to escape were shot on the spot.

c8861fdf-43a0-44c2-a4ed-d7dccb13daab.Text: The left side was engulfed in a terrible fire, threatening to undermine the main-calibre arsenal chambers.

cdc0dad8-a9a5-45ec-b83b-cd2125e4f74b.Text: I cried out as I watched Enginseers burning holy incense and chanting the prayer to waken the plasma generator's machine spirit. A young acolyte, his heart wavering, accidentally disrupted the liturgy, releasing the Motive Force into the power circuit before it was time, and my poor eyes were blinded by the white light of the explosion.

175051a0-98e4-4ed0-ba20-8b84543e602e.Text: Lord Captain, we report that, to our disgrace, we failed to safeguard the crew of the Navigator's Sanctum. During the warp jump, virtually the entire crew was afflicted with monstrous deformations, which we cannot bring ourselves to recount. The senior officers began the last watch, we were here al000ne, we gave all the junior crew the mercy of dFeaRth. We sealed the airlocks, as the echoes of our pain were great enough to drive the uninitiated to madness. Lead us where you will — onward to Port WanDONTer, or back. We will serve and steer the ship as long as we can.

f28dda90-e8cb-46d4-a75a-59ab83636e6d.Text: The pict chronicle recorded by the eyes of the servo-skulls made my heart stutter. In horror, I watched as a crewman, who seemed perfectly healthy, struggled against the shackles pinning him to an operating table, and a group of doctors, whispering excitedly among themselves, drew out their steel surgical instruments and eagerly began cutting into his flesh.

eb175847-25e4-4cb5-b340-574cdb037d7e.Text: During the gruelling voyage through the depths of the Maw, the voidship crew suffered significant losses. Many experienced voidsmen occupying important positions died, and suitable replacements for them will not be found anytime soon.

facb9350-c7fd-460e-b18d-dc7b612d3d0d.Text: The book contains the blasphemous tenets of the cult of the Nourishers of the Afflicted. It speaks of the insatiable Emperor-Progenitor and his impending coming that will bestow miraculous unity upon all the faithful.

686f9780-036d-46f1-8730-f1bbedcb3d5c.Text: Lectionary of the Revelations of the Emperor-Progenitor

a72f8d35-d2ef-4e30-9605-7ed77489bcb8.Text: "Lord Captain on the line. What do the augurs show?"

4ec7b286-5ea9-440b-9177-46c10a7905e4.Text: "Lord Captain on the line. No need to engage the augurs. I know what it is — it's called a Webway Gate."

aaf1703f-dce7-488b-b427-1613afcfbf19.Text: "What is the senior officers' take on this?"

9fd4a27a-e403-460c-8b6d-fcc48c1f8bc6.Text: "Lord Captain on the line. We won't investigate — all weapons, fire on the object!"

4c2a26d2-a241-45fd-8aee-a75e0ed556bb.Text: "Do my officers have anything to say?"

49a9dc8b-8f99-407f-a6ee-d42a04e696da.Text: "Fire the sacred ordnance on one of the targets!"

4f2ce7d6-d896-4681-9b31-2fc5acc99257.Text: "Enough mysteries. We're changing course and moving out."

43625400-d5b0-47f3-a1ca-919a755a2730.Text: "Lord Captain on the line. What is the senior officers' take on this?"

b6a309ec-0f36-4655-abcd-d552a068a2cf.Text: "Lord Captain on the line. Let's get away from that thing."

2f854e3e-8e15-49e5-8e51-c32dde2cec5e.Text: "Do the senior officers have anything to say?"

678fbcd1-ea86-45b3-a362-b060b6d68562.Text:
Lookout: Bridge, we have an unknown object, dead ahead. Not an asteroid, clearly artificial in nature, but... it's larger than Footfall Station.
Bridge: Copy that, report relayed to officer on duty and pilots.
Lookout: Expect visual soon.
Bridge: We have visual. What the... (incoherent whispering)

0e72770e-8cbb-470c-abe6-efc61ffc9ceb.Text:
Region: Cinerus Maleficum
Material: Internal voidship communications log

d8bad685-c129-4a6a-9a10-035cfd809430.Text: Officers station: Van Calox here. What we see before us is a Webway Gate. An artefact that xenos use to get to their... sorcerous realm, so to speak. It allows Aeldari to get around the sector quickly and serves as a hideout for their most unpleasant tribe — the {g|Encyclopedia:Drukhari}Drukhari{/g}, whom we have already met.

e38007ee-b505-4483-84ac-16d52692200d.Text: Officers station: Even if I knew the secret of this Gate, I would never surrender it to the mon-keigh. The Webway is our kin's sacred refuge and a deadly trap to those such as you, elantach.

0d2a8f9e-1cf1-48ae-8823-66ec11758305.Text:
Bridge: Lord Captain's orders — destroy the object. Activate batteries... Targeting... Firing in three... two... one...
Lookout: Confirming contact with the object... good Throne!
Bridge: Report!
Lookout: No effect! I don't know what that thing is made of, but our weapons are powerless against it!

d7dc1738-0712-41e1-b1c9-21f81917105a.Text: Officers station: Yrliet here. This Gate is just like the one you saw on the Lilaethan. The Children of Asuryan wander the void through such constructs, erected in ancient times. Any ship that passes through such a portal will enter a tangle of paths fathomable to none but my kin.

03d46129-94d0-4db8-83b2-f5b7ccba41de.Text: Lookout: Lord Captain, we are detecting activity near the object. Observations indicate... that the signatures are very similar to... ships, Lord Captain! Xenos ships!

ae103abd-ac85-42de-80ee-a6531f58bcdb.Text: Officers station: Jae Heydari speaking! Shereen, what we see here is a portal to the xenos world they call the Webway! A treacherous place full of azhi and other nasty things. Plus, I hear they don't call it the Webway for nothing — no Imperial ship can last an hour in there before it gets horribly lost with no hope of finding its way again.

c45dee60-4c08-45b5-8668-78959e7eec41.Text: Bridge: According to available data, the object consists of an unknown material foreign to the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}. We are registering an unknown class of energy profile... The Enginseers are at a loss about how this technology works exactly, but they did specify that the energometry suggests that the system is holding an active charge. The object appears ready to... do whatever it's designed to do.

e01478bb-2e15-4f1f-8358-4df5d94a0446.Text: Bridge: According to available data, the object consists of an unknown material foreign to the Imperium. The Enginseers do not know how this technology works and are staggered by this xenoheresy.

c6bba80d-b53a-4cfb-b092-77e3eca66c64.Text: Bridge: Perhaps a certain companion of yours could...

cf78ce75-70f0-463b-875c-0be02effac79.Text: Bridge: Yes, Lord Captain! Manoeuvre engines... Changing course...

f82dfc37-b6ee-43aa-be4f-5b7eef512a09.Text:
Bridge: Requesting augur relay data. Awaiting response...
Bridge: Urgent report from the Enginseers on the augur deck! Detecting an energy spike of an unknown nature. Cogitator network overloaded, peripheral systems offline...
Lookout: Confirming visual changes... The Gate! It... What is that?

ab2476bf-2036-4954-8a97-5ec5ae5d6d88.Text:
Bridge: Order received, executing now!
Lookout: Target hit! One of the xenos ships has fallen! Glory to the Rogue Trader... Wait, what's that?

24f6cb33-7e98-4876-a7b1-029ab398e774.Text: Bridge: Lord Captain, interference on the line! Repeat your order! Repea— what is that?

a377883f-c801-4a9c-b691-6a23b8c9b813.Text:
Bridge: Order received, executing now!
Lookout: Target has performed an evasive manoeuvre and shot down the shell! Damned xenos! Wait... what's that?

baaaa9a3-4f44-4630-a8d8-de1007f77f2d.Text:
Bridge: Urgent report from the Enginseers on the augur deck! Detecting an energy spike of an unknown nature. Cogitator network overloaded, peripheral systems offline...
Lookout: Confirming visual changes... The Gate! It... What is that?

8fad0074-b15f-4ff0-b3cd-f67519279746.Text:
Bridge: Lookout, this is the Vox Master. I'm adding the pilots, senior officers, and the Lord Captain to this channel. {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship} wishes to assume personal command.
Lookout: Lord Captain, we have requested intel on the object from the augur array module. Awaiting their response...

31db4025-dbff-4b28-bcec-cba7562cec6a.Text: Bridge: Lord Captain's orders — prepare for manoeuvring. Shields to max, engines to max, fire on the enemy on my mark only! Wait... What is that?

c1bc5930-439d-4286-816b-6e7d5f44d91a.Text:
Lookout: Bridge, the object is dead ahead.
Bridge: Copy that, report relayed to officer on duty and pilots.
Bridge: Vox Master on the line. I'm adding the pilots, senior officers, and the Lord Captain to this channel. Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, the xeno-artefact is directly ahead. What are your orders?

3b4b872d-c681-41ef-bc81-561c15ba8e3a.Text:
Bridge: Requesting augur relay data. Awaiting response...
Bridge: Negative, Lord Captain, no changes detected within the construct. What are your orders?

f09b6d5a-a76e-4dbb-92c5-bee722440b6a.Text: Bridge: Lord Captain, we are gaining distance, but they are firing at will! We're hit, shields are damaged— wait, what is that?

6b0965b1-acc0-4198-94f0-1a9027a56211.Text:
Bridge: Requesting response from the enginarium.
Bridge: Apologies, Lord Captain, the Tech-Priests have refused even to consider such a possibility. It would be a violation of the Omnissiah's tenets and an extremely dangerous undertaking.

f770fbf6-ad6e-4fc6-b89a-024e48f1368c.Text:
Lookout: Lord Captain! Alert! Another xenos ship inbound, must be a boarding party!
Bridge: What? Where did it come from?
Lookout: It was hiding nearby. It closed in undetected while we were distracted by the construct. It's right by us! It's aiming for the engines module!

585df522-3450-49e6-b211-f51c7311a7e5.Text: Bridge: Lord Captain! Emergency! Confirming contact with the enemy ship in the engine area! Confir—

9660280a-8306-4fd9-a54f-53ef8a4c3148.Text: The prisoner appears dead until you notice his eyes, which are filled with pain and following your every move.

3af04c89-ba01-4eab-aef0-5752ae7f7364.Text: The platform hovers in the air, suspended in the tight clutches of the anti-grav drive.

5d4a6c01-da90-4b91-a8e0-c6e08b296d53.Text: This portal stitches two pieces of the Commorragh subdimension into a phantasmagoric canvas of the surreal.

0624c285-ced0-437e-90e8-7cccd78817e6.Text: You are unable to discern the bottom of the abyss out of which Commorragh's spires rise. A small mercy for your sanity.

a58ce131-aa80-41dc-aec1-45857031b215.Text: "We have identified the breed of xenos that pose this threat: the Aeldari, Humanity's ancient and insidious foes."

68d40548-1996-418a-b50f-ffb233959eaa.Text: "I... focused all my attention on investigating the attacks across your protectorate. I suspected that there was something bigger behind the xenos attacks, but..."

d6240d4b-c80e-4898-a8e3-79809f95f5c5.Text: Abelard Werserian's limbs were amputated and then sewn back onto his body with remarkable skill and precision using human tendons.

c771c0ef-5dd4-4c01-8ea8-1e4796f82672.Text: Every exposed area of Argenta's skin is mottled with an intricate pattern of scarlet blisters, crimson indentations, and charred tissue.

0eeba563-98f6-4eca-8d73-beb9e5a918e3.Text: Pulsating strands stretch from under Cassia's headpiece, one wrapping around her neck while the others drain her lifeblood through her weeping eye sockets and mouth.

0ebe960a-c255-4220-a816-b83517cce5a7.Text: A passing ray of light reflects off the countless tiny blades that look like they sprouted from inside Idira's body.

caa50a08-ffe4-4663-8e5b-42e1142e0be2.Text: All of the Cold Trader's bones were broken, her augmented arm was ripped from its socket, and the bones of every finger on the remaining hand are twisted and sticking out at strange angles.

de10627c-abaf-483b-be06-c2f931f8ff35.Text: Pasqal's augmetics were separated but not extracted from his body. The places where they connect to the organic tissue teem with predatory millipedes feasting on the coagulating blood and accumulated pus.

178297de-ea14-4f9c-9d5e-b90b19aa4e34.Text: Solomorne's bloodless body is sporting enormous teeth of iron, pulled from the jaws of his loyal cyber-mastiff.

20decf00-9230-441b-8ea0-028711919c2f.Text: There are vein-like lines running under Yrliet's reddened skin, a network of moving wires that suffuse her body and cut through her flesh.

452c70ce-5967-47f7-b008-0787fc849f87.Text: "How is it that you were the only soul who managed to escape the trap on Rykad Minoris? How much truth is there to the rumours that the heretic Kunrad Voigtvir is spreading about you?"

3856ce82-1146-4cff-97f2-6b5bf777db9d.Text: "...I am going to ignore any... minor liberties that you, esteemed Rogue Trader, may have afforded yourself..."

fd30b0f2-c96a-4e42-8f53-496c22a60597.Text: "Lord Captain, we have received an Astropathic message from Dargonus. Achilleas Scalander reports a xenos raid against a merchant ship in Gartrafal's Calamity!"

e8d5d03b-1094-439d-b25b-c8c0836abe0e.Text: "A new message from Master Scalander, Lord Captain. Achilleas's aides have reported that the xenos leader will be heading an attack on the paradise world Grantis."

4d5390b5-99fd-400d-a7d9-9b36553f759b.Text: "You have disappointed us, Rogue Trader {name} von Valancius."

8c13668d-b84e-485b-be41-8e2149ae0026.Text: "You are accused of consorting with xenos, betraying the Imperium, and neglecting the interests of Humankind."

eda5d7da-4a81-4dd7-bee0-f31e442ece6a.Text: "The tribunal is waiting for your explanations. Come closer."

304908a4-4d6c-4d1f-b46c-c98d7d3d8ec5.Text: "Do my eyes deceive me? Explain yourself, elantach. Why is there a shard of Crudarach in your chamber?"

1040dabb-5c47-40f2-90d6-be3f559f5f27.Text:
"Sly intrigue's ruthless chill to jagged ice
Turns lips, and tongues, and breath — all in a trice."

e4d498b6-6115-44ec-a5b8-411bba7e9cd8.Text: "Is there anything else I should know?"

15ad6924-beb5-4911-a92f-87997c3a4d2a.Text: "First off, how much do you know about my abduction?"

cfdacac9-234b-4fb6-bea2-197a0ecd8348.Text: "Where has my ship been all this time?"

a8ae6d74-cf6e-4601-8097-f25fab00f091.Text: "What is the source of the strife between Incendia and Calligos?"

bdd908f6-b249-4cb9-badd-463369ecf0d6.Text: "I would prefer to get the details of the situation first."

18d041de-52bc-4851-90e1-f3d07893f688.Text: "Yrliet helped the Drukhari abduct me and take me to Commorragh."

26be740b-e26f-4d3c-bb95-d14f84f9e384.Text: "Achilleas turned out to be a traitor. He helped the Drukhari abduct me and hide me in Commorragh."

f57bfeb7-6bc3-49eb-bcdf-0b8ec2586d28.Text: "It does not matter. The topic of my disappearance is closed."

1188186b-d397-4cb6-a30f-d2b6c286e6fd.Text: "Abelard... what if your family is guilty?"

1708a00d-5e75-43f1-a7b6-710ecd54e7d2.Text: "Enough empty talk. Your {mf|master|mistress} is waiting for a proper celebration!"

b92c8a07-4ece-455a-accf-786d2aca0933.Text: "Tell the Choirmaster to send a message to Dargonus saying I will personally take part in the investigation."

77374cef-76fd-430e-9bd7-d5871b5284de.Text: [Lie] "My loyal servants! The accursed xenos tried to take your leader from you! But their plan has failed! I am once again with you! Are you with me?"

d30aea73-2318-4f86-8ff1-0a1e7db9c9bb.Text: "What has happened in the Expanse in my absence?"

860eb73c-2134-4974-b98d-e12e29dfddc5.Text: "What kind of xenos are attacking the Expanse?"

fc4276a3-505a-49ad-9dab-f97095134983.Text: "How fare the worlds of my dynasty?"

a2234727-0a86-4467-80a5-d87eb08552e5.Text: "So Xavier Calcazar is leading the defence?"

9b9208e4-78d8-40d5-acbc-082abaf8a594.Text: "That is quite enough fawning and fussing. I wish to return to my duties immediately."

2a17af6f-b56b-4617-a2f7-028b0cfd2dce.Text: "Aeldari troubles are no longer my concern."

0b161896-fd6b-4d70-b050-f100c7a31eee.Text: "I'm sorry, Abelard. I refuse to offer House Werserian my protection."

89925d94-9718-4c1a-a286-8cb90b328c80.Text: "I am glad you realise you are to blame for my capture. You have not earned the right to hear about my adventures."

38963467-c68a-44ee-9fcf-a5964a6cf422.Text: "I might as well pay old Winterscale a visit."

b8ac0586-87f7-42ae-9032-21309fa26daf.Text: "Endanger my standing with Calligos? For the sake of some xenos?"

74a5b9a7-4a36-4196-8eb7-ec1175f704a9.Text: "Hmm... Your family have shown their true colours at last."

6e13dcf2-f60e-4a77-a9b4-653501b6beb8.Text: {n}The high-ranking officers beam with genuine happiness. Danrok steps forward and solemnly says,{/n} "Welcome to the bridge, Lord Captain. Like the rest of the crew, we are overjoyed by your return and thank the Emperor for it."

85260b76-fef0-4a6d-96a6-f7f5a55c7a04.Text: "Exactly. The esteemed Lord Inquisitor Calcazar has declared himself Warden of the Koronus Expanse and issued orders to requisition troops. He has made Footfall his base of operations, as it was the most logistically convenient point. From there, his fleet strikes throughout the Expanse, destroying the forces of the Cult of the Final Dawn and the abominable Drukhari. He may be all that currently stands in the way of the Expanse being reduced to ashes."

239f8f80-c0af-4326-89a4-70f8d3b91fb1.Text: "When heretics laid siege to Eufrates II, the hallowed forge of the Cognisance Fleet, the Lord Inquisitor sent an enormous force. Now they and the Explorator squadrons recalled from the front lines stand together against the heretics in the battle for the sacred planet."

3cead260-b9a4-40c4-b27d-0995b6ed1438.Text: "Dare we enquire what happened to Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship?"

f6125493-bb17-4c9c-8a50-f20c5146f796.Text: {n}Hostile stares fix on Yrliet, and a spiteful whisper whips through the air:{/n} "Xenos scum!"

c155769b-4f7d-4e1e-bc36-37e2f14f8e3b.Text: "Dare I hope that you will lend me a shoulder to lean on again, elantach? Will you come with me to the distant stars of Quetza... Temer?" {n}In her agitation, the Aeldari is struggling with human language.{/n} "To save my kin from the wrath of your mighty rival?"

efd5323f-2975-4afa-9e18-2a31b4a92692.Text: {n}Sister Argenta greets you with burning eyes.{/n} "Welcome back, Rogue Trader! No trial could break the will of the Emperor's chosen or stop {mf|him|her} from returning to those who have put their hopes in {mf|him|her}!"

cbeb30b5-dd26-458b-a78e-9dcab64d2676.Text: "Lord Captain!" {n}the Seneschal almost shouts, his voice filled with genuine anger.{/n} "Allow me to lay out the matter in full before levelling accusations!"

b628a967-75dd-43f1-a12c-e775a0404744.Text: "I cannot comprehend it." {n}The Seneschal shakes his head helplessly.{/n} "The Werserians have served the Rogue Trader dynasty loyally for generations... This is hard to admit, but the news has come as a crushing blow."

ff137cc1-4048-47a9-851f-02921dbb5fd6.Text: {n}The officers erupt into indignant shouts, promising death to any treacherous xenos that crosses their path. Ravor shakes his head.{/n} "Xenos have no souls and no conscience. They are dishonourable degenerates and traitors by their very nature."

af97b57c-6899-4777-9249-47824e629c9c.Text: "Not much, Lord Captain. All contact with your party was lost shortly after the supposed pirates boarded the ship and abducted... your companion's kinspeople. We immediately sent shuttles with boarding parties to your aid, but... we didn't find anyone on the ship save for the crew, all of whom had either been butchered or driven insane."

9f88c077-4b2a-43de-ab3c-3325e54879e4.Text: "Not much, Lord Captain. In keeping with Master Scalander's plan, after Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship's party landed on the station, we went into vox-silence. We waited for quite some time, but the despised heretic Voigtvir's ship never showed. When we took the liberty of sending a messenger to the station with a report, he found only the bodies of unknown officers and other signs of bloodshed."

f7b0181e-7e2e-4da1-a859-7049e290f48b.Text: {n}The outburst prompts a self-conscious half-shrug from Achilleas, who is huffing noisily behind you. At this moment, he must be glad his disfigured face is hidden behind the black mask.{/n}

821ce363-eebf-48bd-8b7d-a84ab62cd357.Text: "Achilleas Scalander — a traitor? If that damned wretch is still alive, we'll hunt him down no matter what system he's hiding in! I don't know if that corrupt sellout is capable of feeling love for anything or anyone, but if he does, we'll find it and destroy it!"

739b249a-b7a8-45ef-bbd4-e556cee0ca1d.Text: {n}The Factotum smacks his lips awkwardly and adds in a quieter voice,{/n} "Lord Captain... The senior officers will report to you shortly. In your absence, we received a number of Astropathic messages and dispatches that demand your attention."

b390a2fe-559a-46f9-905e-2b8af9bfff71.Text: "Death to the enemies of House von Valancius! Show us the culprits, and we'll tear the heads off the lot of them then stack them next to your throne, Lord Captain!" {n}The furious officers grab their weapons, as if eager to crush the foes who dared breach the sanctity of your person right here and now.{/n}

c51b456d-1dda-49f1-98ed-10c877590155.Text: "The officers' council decided to take the ship to Footfall, where one can hear the gossip of the entire Expanse. Our agents tirelessly searched for information about Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. Had we heard even a whisper of where you were imprisoned, we would have immediately launched a rescue expedition."

47dc1784-be81-44fe-87e8-f6932d8badf5.Text: {n}The Factotum lowers his head in thought.{/n} "There have been other minor developments... If you so wish, I will gladly bring you up to speed on the bridge. I would not want them to take any time away from this occasion."

961faf57-19b6-44b0-84cb-0fda63e5273c.Text: {n}The high-ranking officers beam with genuine happiness. Abelard, who presides over the gathering, looks tired and a little older.{/n} "Lord Captain, the ship's officers gladly welcome you back! The crew offers prayers of thanks to the Emperor for your safe return!"

f741f680-589a-48d7-8c35-f0578e001cc1.Text: "In your absence, I had to temporarily assume stewardship of your protectorate. I chose Footfall as our base of operations, as gossip from across the Expanse finds its way there. My agents searched for any mention of Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship that could point us to the target of our rescue expedition. I am greatly relieved to relinquish my command and return it to you, Lord Captain."

7c74a4a0-e319-4510-95e4-d00a3e29de4f.Text: "The Expanse is in flames, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. Squadrons and smaller groups of despicable Drukhari raid our systems. The Cult of the Final Dawn has emerged in full force, wreaking havoc everywhere. We've heard rumours of the fall of Santiel's Pride, House Chorda's world... An outrageous sacrilege, given how abundant and inexpensive promethium is there!"

9813b639-9671-40dd-89f9-82ba188b436b.Text: "Strife has broken out between House Winterscale and House Chorda. Chaos reigns everywhere. Only the esteemed Lord Inquisitor is trying to fight it, concentrating all available forces at Footfall to draw them into a fist that will smash the rampaging heretics and xenos vermin."

40397558-2dd6-4024-abb6-a411bd60e81d.Text: "Drukhari, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Their squadrons, both large and small, are invading the Expanse, unleashing carnage on planets, taking captives by the thousands, and attacking ships. It is as if something has poked their nest, if you will, and now they are lashing out."

a1044658-435a-4069-81a4-d2974adaedef.Text: "Hmm... My kin are not so blindly suicidal. Desperation is the more likely cause. In the wake of our most intriguing adventure in the Spire of the Reaving Tempest, many Kabal members must have lost everything and fled Commorragh before their old enemies caught up with them. How very... interesting and promising."

0857c823-d195-4a63-b329-860798d751e1.Text: "When the esteemed Lord Inquisitor called upon the Rogue Traders to join his forces, Her Ladyship Incendia Chorda heeded the summons, while His Lordship Calligos Winterscale... ignored it. Rumour has it that his refusal was... defiant in manner, and served as a pretext for Lady Chorda to declare war on House Winterscale."

01bf7833-2792-48dd-9e20-e01f919c339e.Text: "Lord Captain..." {n}Abelard bows his head.{/n} "Allow me to make a request. A personal one."

7fb141c2-597c-4249-89f4-67fb7607cc93.Text: {n}Yrliet's expression is inscrutable, but her eyes are fixed on you and you alone.{/n}

55dd1180-f1e2-4039-ad2a-f451bcab8883.Text: "We pursued it, but the accursed xenos were too fast. They took cover in an asteroid belt and activated a cloaking field. We swept the asteroids, of course, but those vile creatures doubtlessly used our short delay to laugh at us and then slip even farther away. Such was our inglorious defeat, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship."

1388dae6-d2ce-4a5a-b307-53008f129cb7.Text: "We fully accept our responsibility, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. Our negligence was unforgivable. Allow us to make amends through impeccable service and diligence."

58236b21-34f1-4815-a67c-e78cee9d33a7.Text: "Since Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship's body was never recovered, we hoped against hope that you were still alive. Alas, even our most alert augur operators never spotted anything suspicious, and thus our ignominious failure put you in dire peril."

f977ff2a-819c-4867-83c5-29a70e2af167.Text: "Your... devotees continue their work of spreading the word of the Great Beacon. There are more and more people in the von Valancius protectorate who have accepted the new faith as the one true belief. The followers of the old cult are either hunted down or forced into hiding."

3d18f72c-1cdc-4eca-a594-f6f28da0a383.Text: "The officers' council humbly requests that you accept a full report of the events that took place in your absence."

525b709c-444b-4ff7-bb0c-5b19e8eb62d5.Text: "Without a doubt, the return of the guardian of the Koronus Expanse will give new strength and faith to those who have stood under the blows of the enemies of Humanity in your absence! Rumours of the holy relic kept aboard your vessel are spreading to every system of the Expanse, inspiring and emboldening the weak and the forlorn."

aa7714c9-7908-4f80-b3c3-71c756edd828.Text: {n}Yrliet is about to object but reconsiders at the last moment, making do with only a loud sigh and a nod.{/n} "A right I would not dare take away from you, elantach. I only ask that you... make your decision soon. As much as I would like to lift that burden from your shoulders, the lives of my kin depend on you again."

ceaf8462-6fa7-4b1f-b08b-2b7d377172ad.Text: "Then I will not presume to distract you any longer. The distant stars of Quet... za... Temer... await us." {n}In her agitation, the Aeldari is struggling with human language. She falls silent, absorbed in her thoughts.{/n}

314ca237-c872-4d36-be18-133be8f06ad7.Text: "Not for the sake of my kin, elantach. I... am asking you to do this for me. Perhaps you... perhaps we might convince your star rival to stop the meaningless bloodshed."

c07e15de-e7a4-447d-83ba-7901156e258f.Text: "I see." {n}Yrliet's words are scalding cold.{/n} "Let me know if you change your mind... mon-keigh."

f5283042-eb5c-451b-9e1d-a41084485339.Text: "While you were away, the Choirmaster received an Astropathic message from Dargonus. It concerns... my family. The Werserians have been accused of treason against House von Valancius."

32d7c6a7-2cfe-4579-b169-de31f1e30f65.Text: "The accusations were levelled by, or on behalf of, the Drivestems. The governing house. Under normal circumstances, the investigation would not have required your involvement, and my entire family would have been... But being of noble stock, the Werserians are entitled under an ancient custom to petition for a Rogue Trader's personal protection once in a generation. Your personal protection, Lord Captain." {n}Abelard raises his gaze to you.{/n} "Do not deny us that honour, I implore you."

d8b7e826-4599-401e-82c2-e845a2984a52.Text: "Then the traitors will accept their due punishment. I have never relied on my position as an immunity guarantee, and I will not even try to sway your decision... as long as it is fair and balanced."

65bf0809-4adb-4d2c-a257-71fcf8b6515d.Text: {n}Abelard breathes a sigh of relief and seems to grow an inch or two taller.{/n} "It will be done, Lord Captain!"

aca5f9af-5f22-4d07-b8d7-6c1e35acf1e3.Text: {n}The Seneschal wobbles slightly on unsteady legs, as though he is about to fall. He keeps his balance after all and says with dry lips, barely audibly,{/n} "I serve House von Valancius."

1cb16cfa-91be-4421-a974-c41d093e7dba.Text: "What is more, regrettable events have taken place in your dynasty's capital..." {n}Vigdis hesitates.{/n} "House Werserian has been found guilty of organising revolts and plotting a conspiracy against Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. Governor Drivestem has ordered the Werserians to be executed. Order has been fully restored on the planet."

41300a18-9c37-4499-826e-de0e008ccc1e.Text: "Lord Captain..." {n}The Seneschal weighs his words carefully.{/n} "I hate to say that while you were away, Dargonus saw a series of revolts among its rabble. Charges of orchestrating those revolts, undermining the capital's economy, and... conspiring against you were brought against my family members."

1a9ea957-1967-4216-a74a-629165648e5b.Text: "Governor Drivestem had the perpetrators executed. Every last one of them." {n}Abelard's voice is raspy. He is struggling to speak.{/n} "I assure you those events happened without my knowledge and came as a genuine shock to me. Dargonus has been fully restored to order now, which is all that matters."

5501b324-781a-4d5f-b8b3-d9dc7f862da1.Text: "The heretics' malicious acts make it difficult to maintain Astropathic contact with the colonies. The Cult of the Final Dawn strikes everywhere, and their sleeper agents are active on every planet. On Vheabos VI, a mutiny was crushed after a group of newly arrived prisoners succumbed to blasphemous propaganda. But other worlds stand firm against the onslaught of the enemies of Humanity and do not succumb to their pernicious influence."

1e47a048-cc87-4968-917c-a05fcffbdf4a.Text: "Once word of your return reaches every von Valancius world... why, the masses will be ecstatic! Never before has the Expanse known a leader as merciful as you! The fanatics of the Creed may whisper about the heresies of the mind burgeoning under your rule, but your benevolence has forever captured the souls of millions of ordinary subjects."

b5b4afb7-d9d8-44ce-ba32-425183789470.Text: "Domin'{name}, the flagship without you was like a body without a heart — its blood froze in its veins. We welcome your return and stand ready to serve."

5bd58bcb-ef8f-4463-8b37-8653b41af199.Text: "While you were absent, Lord Captain, we made every effort to find you. That resulted in a number of modifications to the ship that have significantly upgraded it. Thanks to a favourable deal secured by the esteemed High Factotum, the ship is now equipped with state-of-the-art augur systems and direction finders from Kiava Gamma."

3238da4f-ad92-4e60-bd65-ae2501a1479c.Text: {n}Kibellah devours you with her eyes, anxiety writ large on her usually impenetrable face.{/n} "As your shadow, I must personally make sure you are well, Domin. Wait for me in your quarters."

8a1d1f52-92d8-4189-93af-062f7da8e8d3.Text: {n}Heinrix gestures to you.{/n} "While the officers were preparing this briefing, I had some time to find out what had happened in our absence. I discovered that the Astropathic Choir received a message addressed to me... which I'd like to discuss at the earliest opportunity. Let me know when you have time to do that."

bd5899e3-b0dc-438d-af0f-03b659450c47.Text: {n}Heinrix van Calox approaches you. He is not looking his best. It seems he has not slept in quite a while.{/n} "Lord Captain, allow me to express how glad I am that you have rejoined us, alive and unharmed."

8d15a78c-966c-40c0-9a43-d87e13dd5b1d.Text: {n}Heinrix falls silent, but then cannot help casting another dismayed glance at you.{/n} "Although... it can wait. I... would like to... I'll visit you in person after the briefing. I have... questions."

77165c3f-6875-495c-9932-1df462af351c.Text: "Lord Captain, during your absence, your retinue has seen certain changes. The esteemed Master Anthar will no longer be able to accompany you. According to a message from the Adeptus Arbites, he has been discharged and is currently an overseer on Vheabos VI. However, Prefect Vultur has informed me that you have the authority to challenge that decision and have Master Anthar reinstated."

301dca8e-b620-40ae-a26d-fe9c6a053cd2.Text: "An Aeldari fleet? Elantach, I no longer believe in coincidences. Your pale-faced servant speaks of the same world that appeared to Muaran in his visions. The world where my kin fell into peril. Help me reach them!"

250d4137-1e54-44ca-926c-8990c6871135.Text: {n}Marazhai's presence alone is enough to elicit gasps of dismay and whispers from the crowd. The Drukhari ignores all mon-keigh reactions to his person and surveys the ship's bridge, examining every detail with ostentatiously cool interest. His markedly casual posture is belied by the subtle and unusual tension in his body.{/n}

ddce5958-b375-4052-a221-3548b080894c.Text: "The enemies of Humanity are showering us with blows, capitalising on our indecision." {n}Argenta jerks her head up, her eyes aflame.{/n} "I hasten to remind every one of them that their crimes have not escaped the eyes of the righteous — and there will be retribution for each of those crimes!"

b65337e9-9120-434c-859f-c2c6dd8e1a84.Text: "Shereen, light of my eyes! I am overjoyed to see you among us once more! Truly, the Exalted One is merciful for showing you the way back home. I hope all the ashmags who left us to languish without our Lord Captain have already become food for the warp daemons!"

cbf20924-c059-44e2-bbd7-d46d59320785.Text: "The decks overflow with dazzling shades of yellow as the crew welcomes its {mf|lord|lady}, and I join them in this greeting!"

8e61ae1c-7585-4dc4-bbb1-ad5d8edced1f.Text: {n}The crew stares in awe and terror at the giant towering over the crowd. Some make the sign of the Aquila on their chests, others collapse to their knees with a prayer to the God-Emperor on their lips. This wave of pious shock does not seem to discompose Ulfar in the slightest — he just chuckles into his beard and glances around curiously.{/n}

8e182c68-049d-4fcc-9cbc-b20c5bbf863d.Text: {n}He stops, then his facade of sangfroid cracks, and he gives you another look, this one full of turmoil.{/n} "I would... prefer... I will meet with you in person after the briefing. I have... questions."

20293d19-869d-4bf8-9951-22d397a7373a.Text: "Winterscale's ships are being hunted and his worlds occupied under the pretence of compelling them to submit to the Imperial Creed. Surprisingly, for all his love of fighting, Winterscale is in no hurry to defend his domain. According to intercepted Astropathic messages, he and his retinue are currently on Quetza Temer hunting down a xenos fleet — Aeldari, by all appearances."

2d363857-7be9-424b-a265-1a4143ceb1e0.Text: {n}Jae twirls a lock of hair around her finger and sends a fiery gaze your way, which she immediately hides beneath her lowered lashes.{/n} "I... do hope we will get a chance to have a conversation in private very soon. For now, however, I dare not steal any more of the Rogue Trader's precious time..."

05b30866-1a25-4b97-b4de-6a2f28c93d7e.Text: {n}Cassia nervously brings her thin fingers to her lips and lowers her eyes.{/n} "I am... particularly gladdened by your return, Lord Captain. I hope that you can find a moment... once you have seen to your duties..."

a297b3f2-b13e-41ef-b549-a0ce29f69b6d.Text: {n}Pasqal offers you a respectful bow.{/n} "The return of the {mf|master|mistress} of the temple is an event honoured by every spirit that dwells within the sacred systems and machines of this abode."

95b59b54-803b-469f-84a5-af19bf62319f.Text: {n}Heinrix's gaze is focused on Yrliet. His eyes burn with undisguised hatred... and a promise.{/n}

f6835fb7-821e-4f29-8384-6b15e930f96e.Text: {n}Heinrix's gaze, tense and almost desperate, is focused on you. But he says nothing — for now, at least.{/n}

659bc810-149d-43f0-a908-1d8c1c2c87cc.Text: "This is so... touching." {n}Marazhai's voice is laced with venom.{/n}

cabc5435-ff6d-4c6f-939c-95b43f299d3e.Text: {n}Danrok throws up his hands.{/n} "But... but the crew is overcome with joy and gratitude to the God-Emperor... Nonetheless, your will is absolute!"

2cedc915-d2b1-46f1-aaad-e6c0621a9cc1.Text: "Glory to the Rogue Trader! Glory to House von Valancius!" {n}Your subjects' triumphant roar sends a tremor through the bridge. It is as though the ship itself is greeting its long-lost owner.{/n}

af6b97e1-1b83-4c09-98a0-7ca5291d04f7.Text: {n}Danrok adjusts his jacket before addressing you.{/n} "Now then, Lord Captain... Shall we get to business? We have a number of items to go over."

5600aaa9-2f03-4bd2-ad18-180642299448.Text: "The Adeptus Arbites tasked him with a mission of some sort that, as far as I know, ended in failure, leading to Master Anthar being deemed unworthy of his rank and unfit to serve you."

b912a7ef-e7b2-4802-9cca-9419939bf280.Text: "I have good news to share as well: all preparations for the deployment of the {d|Encyclopedia:BS_Heartless}Heartless{/d} have been completed! The ship is fully operational and ready to perform the duty you set out for it."

91f3aa93-353e-4da6-b622-db95dc60f1c6.Text: "I have good news to share as well: the {d|Encyclopedia:BS_Heartless}Heartless{/d} is fully repaired! Its hull has been considerably reinforced, and, after a complete cycle of tech-litanies, the fighter craft in its hangar now eagerly await the chance to show their worth in battle!"

6632273f-4598-4f6a-a747-7228348877f3.Text: "If the Expanse is under siege, then I know where to look for my pack: in the thick of battle. When we arrive at Footfall, I want to talk to Calcazar and find out to what battlefront he has sent my brothers."

03093abe-b2aa-4fcc-a0a2-3d4093ad2ab6.Text: "I humbly ask that you accept my report on the events that took place in your absence."

cbfe984f-65e6-4e2f-8a7c-9c55d3d20c9a.Text: "On behalf of the officers' council, I dare say that the esteemed Seneschal Werserian performed his duties with distinction and averted many tragedies that threatened your domain in these trying times." {n}Danrok starts clapping, and the rest of the assembly joins in the applause. Abelard accepts the accolade with a faint smile of weary indifference.{/n}

962fdc1c-6afd-4912-81e0-7644873cc7e5.Text: "First and foremost, I have news about your subjects. In the time that you were gone, the servants of House von Valancius have toiled tirelessly in their service to you and for the benefit of the entire trade protectorate."

23077676-2765-4be2-b9db-d834c5d88cd3.Text: "We discovered a world that is home to a long-abandoned colony founded centuries ago by one of your predecessors. A ship was sent there, carrying several thousand colonists who were to restore the derelict settlement. After the ship entered its system of destination, contact was lost with it, and its fate remains unknown. Perhaps you might like to investigate the disappearance of that vessel personally."

c5c369ef-1160-47d3-a57f-b6541624e2a7.Text: "In addition to that, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, pirates have presented a serious problem for your domain. For centuries, a group of bandits headed by a ship called the Elusive Contempt has been raiding cargo vessels on their way from the protectorate's most plentiful extractia. Their ability to deftly escape pursuit by patrols has allowed them to operate with complete impunity. The pirates' flagship has been spotted in a nearby system. Your ship, Lord Captain, is sufficiently powerful to finally chase down those brazen scoundrels and bring them to justice."

bab1a5be-e8e1-4e76-be35-326b1578b18e.Text: "The Astropathic Choir has received a series of alarming messages concerning the Narmer IV System, where a dangerous space anomaly has supposedly manifested itself. Its nature is unknown but the fabric of space within the system is reported to be... curved and unstable. It is said that any ship entering the region disappears without trace. I believe we ought to be prudent and steer clear of that system."

4296676b-29ba-433b-b37a-bba9f75756ef.Text: {n}The Factotum hesitates, as if unsure that what he has to say is worthy of your attention.{/n} "There is something else, Lord Captain. The ship's Astropaths have caught echoes of alarming messages. Unidentified ships abandoned by their crews have been spotted in several systems of the Expanse. It may only be a rumour, but those who encountered them have gone missing... That is all, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

bdb7ad45-1787-49d1-a3e2-69075917beb8.Text: "An Aeldari fleet? That means... there are many more Crudarach survivors than I dared hope." {n}A secondary vox-channel transmits Yrliet's voice, laden with desperation.{/n} "Elantach, I... I must go to this planet. To find them. To try to save them..."

b694e535-e115-4960-87f9-3d9a8b03e981.Text: "What corruption in my soul are you talking about, Yrliet?"

94d981ea-8972-4c6c-aacf-a82f3dc1e592.Text: "If you are so worried about my wrongdoings, Sister, why did you take part in committing them?"

cd72f22f-99c5-44c7-a942-c7edf31728aa.Text: "You may disapprove of my methods, but you cannot argue with my results."

5183eb2d-1851-4625-bca1-70525c4d62d5.Text: "How magnanimous of you, Interrogator. I shall bear it in mind."

a8fae864-fdc2-4f65-b927-fc24313a0219.Text: "I do only what is necessary to ensure the prosperity of the Expanse and House von Valancius."

6d09e401-e5a6-464e-83e7-325e0a8b4f69.Text: "Argenta, what is the meaning of this?"

f76f937f-807a-4225-8308-3f34ed5bb89e.Text: "Are you accusing me of something, Heinrix?"

b53ffea3-6b48-4289-b7b3-b193ea8064a9.Text: "I promise to atone for my faults. This audience is over."

1efc172a-f93a-4183-a32c-b895d150a205.Text: "Threatening me may cost you your head, Wolf."

6a35b783-9d2d-4ebc-a118-a59f528dbb76.Text: "Perhaps I did misstep. It will not happen again."

a5ad148c-e636-44ac-a1f3-550f3c215e99.Text: "Are you some kind of seer now, seeing shadows and prophesying a dire future for me?"

6da3e2be-c1a7-4704-9462-d6c5bfd2fef3.Text: "How dare you insinuate that I, one of the Emperor's anointed, have been weak-willed enough to succumb to the Archenemy? The audacity!"

0c8b6456-0a51-47c8-af8b-bad87b320cf4.Text: [Lie] "I shall reconsider my ways, I give my word as Lord Captain! The Emperor protects."

b6c5133e-c566-41bb-9766-9c79b95c7c94.Text: "Given that the Lord Inquisitor still has not ordered you to execute me, I am not doing too badly."

1a7c19bd-2116-4295-a677-77dcc410ca18.Text: "You are making a mistake. With me, many glorious battles still await you. Is that not what you desire?"

b2e2b215-afa7-47c2-8bf5-1a607b5beaa8.Text: "Have you finished the lecture? Then get off my bridge! I have other matters to attend to."

d1a86533-e780-474c-b9fe-600497744e2a.Text: "Lord Captain, I tried to explain that you were busy but—" {n}The Vox Master does not have time to finish her sentence before she is unceremoniously interrupted.{/n}

b0800b7a-fcb0-4486-a93c-56d50849f8e4.Text: "You are consumed by corruption. With every decision you make, I feel more and more that I do not belong in your retinue. Stop. Repent before the Emperor — before it is too late."

4ce8ad04-ab53-4771-9106-8b41f3f7508b.Text: "{name}, your actions concern me. They concern me a great deal. It would be quite unfortunate if we found ourselves on opposing sides."

85f050ee-058a-4df7-b286-7966ca56b02e.Text: "Your actions have earned you a grim reputation, Aett-Vater. Ill deeds have too often been done by your hand. You do not live according to the law given by the Allfather, and so I ask you to stop before you go too far. I am loath to visit punishment upon my own saviour."

b37839fa-b6df-4a22-8c7d-1ac4a31c2427.Text: "You have started down a dangerous path, elantach. I can see it in your eyes, your actions, the sound of your voice, the beating of your heart. Leave this path while the growing corruption can still be torn from your soul without completely destroying it! Or are you so lost in this world that you long to lose yourself as well?"

d910d767-df23-4b05-9b95-c61a8c7e87c5.Text: "Baring your fangs at me is unwise, Rogue Trader. You do not want to see what I am like when I take a threat to heart." {n}A sinister glint of bloodlust flares in the giant's darkened eyes.{/n}

9c816ea7-9351-4426-b278-0473f369ad71.Text: "A wise decision, elantach. I hope you find the strength to return to the true path. For as long as I am at your side, I will help you find your way back."

d6088fae-987d-4b0d-aa8e-75acc02a5773.Text: "I have no need of prophecy or sorcery to see what is blindingly obvious. Think about it, elantach. Is your own vision clear?"

67da5de4-9ef3-431e-b908-49edd2a279cf.Text: "Even the most beautiful fruit can rot from the inside, but it is hard to tell until you cut off a piece. So look inside yourself, elantach. Is your inner world really as perfect as you think?"

313c32a0-e3fa-45ae-bc32-1c14a3116d40.Text: "You are becoming more and more like Theodora. But even she stopped short of crossing the lines you have crossed. A few more steps and your soul will be irrevocably mired in the Archenemy's heresy. I cannot bear the fault of inaction, {name}. Either you come back to His light, or sooner or later I will leave this unholy ship."

69a7d8bd-9ce4-4e1f-878e-e9290401cb4f.Text: "Truly, I too have erred, and I will receive my due for the things I have done. But the spirit of any of His servants may falter. It is because I understand this that I now stand before you with a plea, and not with a sword."

1547642f-bd3c-4c9e-a32e-c35270bc330d.Text: "With these words have the most horrendous crimes against the Imperium been committed. His commandments exist for a reason. You either follow them or receive your just punishment."

ba29b732-926b-40ff-a283-c14b5eb71edb.Text: "Hearing is not enough. The sooner you start on the path to redemption, the better."

f03c2cc9-596f-47af-b923-aae75eff33eb.Text: "I am at the Lord Captain's service, as always. However, magnanimity has nothing to do with it. Consider this my attempt to spare myself an unnecessary and unpleasant task."

94fc32a5-79c6-4a77-a52a-45e1247e9f33.Text: "For now, it is only a warning. Your Warrant is not a licence to do as you please. Many a Rogue Trader has forgotten this, and this mistake inevitably costs them their life. I can turn a blind eye to the occasional misdemeanour, but when they become systemic... Suffice to say that the Inquisition's conversations with hardened heretics tend to be short, and I'd rather not have one of those conversations with you."

37a85c88-740c-4332-8249-d1caa936870b.Text: "I am doing only what is necessary for the prosperity of the entire Imperium. So when a member of the Inquisition tells you that you are on the verge of heresy, I advise that you listen."

ce2c0d69-a0ef-4649-b5da-06ef9248e869.Text: "Just because a heretic has stepped into the fire, but is not yet engulfed in flames, does not mean things are going well. The match is in my hands, and only your actions will decide whether or not I strike it. That is all I have to say."

153d9226-e0c3-4586-b624-e57f2a974c50.Text: "I respect you enough, Rogue Trader, to speak frankly. I would rather fight shoulder to shoulder with you than stand against you."

b829ad86-bfe2-4a43-aee4-c0e96525c897.Text: "Glorious battles await me whether I am in your squad or on my own. I am only trying to prevent a course of events that will end with us meeting as enemies in one of those battles."

e1af832e-46e9-4e30-9b63-b111c0a8ddd8.Text: "Threats are the recourse of the weak. I am a loyal ally trying to keep you from making a mistake. The villainy you condone comes close to crossing the line beyond which there is no forgiveness. I do not wish to see you cross that line, for we are all bound by our duties, and it is my duty to punish such transgressions."

c0c7c08d-1503-4450-ab31-14e55f65e97e.Text: "Vice and cruelty follow in your wake like a gloomy shadow, a shadow in which the malevolent smirk of She Who Thirsts more and more clearly manifests. This shadow will swallow you and everyone around you. And it will become irrevocable if you do not start fighting it. I am ready to help you in this if you are willing to renounce the path of corruption. Otherwise... I will not risk my immortal soul by remaining at your side."

a3ec8083-080e-4b5d-8054-a1d2ba6019f4.Text: The blood of the pirate Ryzza, who sold her soul to the Ruinous Powers. It still contains traces of her soul. Should they be offered as a sacrifice to the altar, the Dark Gods would undoubtedly reward their servant.

77d058b0-8533-4304-9eed-20e41045695c.Text: You have gone through the ritual of purification, cleansing your soul of filth and forever giving yourself to the service of the Emperor. Your conviction has changed to Dogmatic and will remain so forevermore.

26fd79ab-9e55-4bcd-a4a9-d85565e19e0f.Text: "I apologise for intruding upon your hallowed ground. It is where my journey from Commorragh has taken me."

a65455a1-d7e2-49e8-818f-09b411e4ffb7.Text: "I am the {mf|master|mistress} of this planet, {name} von Valancius. And I require something of you."

71b645db-6cd2-4bab-bf69-fc02070a32c7.Text: "Who am I, you ask? I am Rogue Trader von Valancius! On your knees, knave, while you still have them!"

0afb5967-0bcb-41c4-a58c-37089cd90a97.Text: "I suppose I can now call myself an interdimensional traveller."

982c94d1-5a2d-4bfe-b352-b26d8e50a754.Text: "Yes. The xenos is coming with me. As my guest."

80d48f77-6eda-4dfd-b315-45674b1faeba.Text: "Shackle the xenos and keep him imprisoned until my ship arrives."

35bf57f2-ca12-478b-b880-ea401efb81e7.Text: [Kill the Farseer] "This one? He is of no further use to me."

5dafb7f5-8e8d-478b-92fa-b64e4e4d3778.Text: "Marazhai, aren't you and the Children of Asuryan of the same blood? Why do they loathe you so?"

54b4e69a-352d-466c-a224-a6158965608e.Text: "Do you know anything about my abduction?"

68490b05-4f01-42fc-92b5-78559c4aca78.Text: "I would say a ransom for his rescue is in order."

cd79f8fc-42d7-47da-a445-f17d3cfdfb66.Text: [Draw your weapon] "I wish to challenge your bold statement. He is my prisoner."

e23032eb-3201-42e6-92a3-cda79b8616d9.Text: "You said Yrliet would serve the Aeldari once more. Are you seeking to use her again?"

5e4d222f-a15a-494c-86af-dd3b8506c6d0.Text: "Well, now. The one about the woman with horns sounds promising. Go on."

64f80f07-3dc4-4463-81b5-a9184c5b1e1a.Text: "I am sure your kin brought their misfortune upon themselves."

d1658988-bccd-4e28-ac94-bcc080d862bd.Text: "I need a shuttle and some means of contacting the Astropathic Choir so I can summon my voidship here."

6ff80b19-c265-471a-815f-e993a0a918fb.Text: "Your kinsman, Eklendyl, helped us escape from Commorragh."

bc011fda-c377-43c9-a6f9-2b23e7598134.Text: "I just cut down a good hundred Aeldari in Commorragh. Keep up that tone, and you will become the hundred and first."

e3699c1a-28c3-4f0f-84bb-50a3ed8d0ebd.Text: "Warm greetings to you as well. You are almost as hospitable as the Dark City."

44918d0b-d8e1-417a-bd25-dc7da5d4ccb3.Text: "What do the people of Janus say about my abduction?"

7957bb80-5778-49b7-a2b0-1468fba3d1dc.Text: "Yrliet, kindly explain to your kinsman that there is no reason for him to be so riled up."

102db652-4e7c-4b6c-a8b0-2eb4f45ca288.Text: {n}A poorly shaved commoner in worn coveralls eyes you with suspicion. He is clutching an autogun that looks like it is one careless reload away from falling apart. The man narrows his eyes and enquires,{/n} "Oi! Who are you lot? Yer not bandits, are you?"

97103447-53aa-4365-ad1c-27bca2094260.Text: "Vistenza Janus Vyatt ab Aram af Koronus?" {n}The commoner pronounces the governor's florid name flawlessly, but every word makes him flinch like someone is hitting him with a stick.{/n} "We {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_JanusVistenzaAlive}pray for her health{/d} every day!"

fca608ec-49c0-483f-beed-9d893c97bc05.Text: {n}The man squints with his weak eyes and finally realises who is standing before him. He collapses to his knees with a whiny grimace and wails,{/n} "Blessed Throne! Mercy, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, have mercy! Blasted old eyes didn't recognise you!"

f0ee57af-6129-453a-9ad3-92b8f055ced1.Text: "The Chem-Princes collect tithes, flog troublemakers, protect us from bandits, and don't fight much among 'emselves... All's well."

71937da5-2bc0-4677-9ad6-c456fe558a01.Text: "Can't say our lives are all in order, though. The war ended all that. The nobles were so scared of the riots that they abandoned the irrigation facilities and skedaddled to the capital for good. Too afraid there are still conspirators hiding on their estates, waiting to gut them at night."

cfae4406-c1d7-42fa-8fdb-b6bb3fa955eb.Text: {n}The man gives you a puzzled look.{/n} "Wassat? Did some rotter abduct you? Who could perpetrate such villainy? Kidnapping {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship}, the nerve! We ain't heard nothing here on Janus!"

12a53cc5-a712-4236-ba53-c5e54738c929.Text: "Our new masters, the Ultrequisitors, they're a dignified bunch. They fancy the learned type, though, and no good ever comes from scholars. But on the upside, they are paying you thrones for your service. Can you believe it? I hadn't seen a throne in my whole life, and they are giving us two for every month's work!"

593e833c-b560-425e-abf5-b193ad474038.Text: "Blessed Throne! You're joking me! {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship}, in these here backwoods! What an honour, a big ol' honour, this!" {n}The man drops to his knees and tries his best to hide his travesty of a firearm, pretending that he was not just pointing it at your chest a moment ago.{/n}

5ec6712f-577b-44a1-965e-89605ef98d71.Text: {n}The man furrows his shaggy eyebrows and pokes his travesty of a firearm in your direction.{/n} "Trynna pull a fast one on me, eh? Like {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship}'d go wandering about this here swamp... Gah! Emperor almighty!"

2269cc7e-e304-40d5-9da9-51347c23d9cf.Text: {n}The old man flinches in terror, drops his travesty of a firearm, and falls on his knees with a snivelling grimace.{/n} "Throne above! Yer {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, have mercyyy! Didn't recognise ya!"

2e51938f-b50f-4c33-bd9e-5dc56ec66334.Text: {n}The old man furrows his shaggy eyebrows and pokes his travesty of a firearm in your direction.{/n} "Trynna scare the pants off me, are you? Well, I'll have none of that! Or I'll call them wardens over the vox, they'll grab ya by the floppers right quick! Them wardens, they don't mollycoddle bandits like yo—"

c4d274a5-1ca0-4c15-8788-0954f020ae44.Text: "Do I have anything to say about the life of the mon-keigh? No, your servants are of as little interest to me as they are to you. They simply... carried on in your absence. Some died. Some achieved various insignificant things. Nothing has changed."

5019fe63-f931-46ba-b4a5-f90ca72b10a1.Text: "Wassatchusay? Sounds like heresy talk to me..."

d5cbf0aa-d523-4f1c-a4bb-85afc358e7cd.Text: "Will do, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Can't let xenos scum like him walk free." {n}He eagerly points his weapon at the Farseer.{/n}

d29baf1e-5f36-4dfd-a83c-7e9b9d291e5f.Text: {n}The sight of the dying xenos makes the commoner rejoice.{/n} "You show 'em, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Death to the enemies of Humanity!"

94232bc4-4ac9-4f8d-90f1-63450dd501d5.Text: {n}An iridescent haze momentarily clouds the world around you, and that moment is all it takes for Muaran to hide Eklendyl behind the veil of his xenosorcery.{/n} "We will speak of my kin's fate no longer. All that was meant to be said has been said."

c09a7956-5645-49d1-b51b-2e34080f3143.Text: "Farewell, mon-keigh. I am pleased that our meeting did not spill blood into the Lilaethan's womb." {n}An iridescent haze momentarily clouds the world around you, and that moment is all it takes for Muaran to vanish behind the veil of his xenosorcery.{/n}

5793c893-9af8-4e99-ae6a-14b0011932ee.Text: {n}Yrliet nods silently and leaves it at that, as if she is less interested in Muaran's words than in your reaction.{/n}

30b6e53e-6b04-463c-8cf0-fe000efddf8b.Text: "Ours are the souls of the true Aeldari. Our ancestors, whom the craftworld cowards preferred to forget..."

a8b58b8e-e728-491d-8432-8fc35b99b23c.Text: "You, despicable, dishonoured, madness-stricken blind renegade, will not speak of what it means to be an Aeldari."

4be03ad9-fda1-4082-ac06-1797f56a45b3.Text: "Oh, but we are all that keeps their very essence alive, Farseer. You chose to abandon their great legacy at the call of cowardice, so do not embarrass yourself now with your pathetic attempts to justify such a betrayal."

a5020e57-550e-4830-a296-9899f365c27f.Text: {n}Eklendyl shoots you a keen look and asks coldly,{/n} "Will your capital offer protection? I do not wish to exchange one prison for another."

6144d7e1-f179-490c-99b6-277d6296e284.Text: "The mon-keigh turned out to be a traitor. How shocking!"

e824588a-27a5-45e7-9172-af49db4b874a.Text: "Oi, keep your wisecracks to yourself! If I hear you badmouth {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship}, I'll shoot your floppers clean off!"

54f36c83-7abe-4ab7-a5f5-3ebdd04c83a8.Text: {n}{d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_JanusEldarAllies}Muaran{/d}'s silhouette emerges from the dense foliage without disturbing a single blade of grass. He addresses you in an accusatory tone of dissatisfaction,{/n} "I sensed your mind, mon-keigh. Why are you skulking by the Webway Gate? Why have you come to the Lilaethan in secret? Do you intend ill for us?"

86a79755-63f5-44eb-91c6-f82349330b33.Text: {n}His expression darkens.{/n} "There's this plague going around on Janus, though... Makes your hair fall out, your skin go pale, and your voice disappear. Turns normal, Emperor-fearing people into right freaks, scum of Humanity. We call folks like that retches. Scary to look at — better to put them all down. Well, we do, little by little. With poison."

756358b2-32a0-4c8a-b4d5-ae0ea4d383c6.Text: {n}After a lengthy pause bordering on insult, Muaran inclines his head slightly.{/n} "I do not seek confrontation, mon-keigh. My words were chosen without proper diligence."

604689c6-c053-4e7f-99ba-5b868bf52ebf.Text: "My people are not welcoming of spies and infiltrators." {n}Muaran peers at you, then says thoughtfully,{/n} "However, you, mon-keigh, did not come here to spy on the Webway Gate. You came through it. I can sense its energy lingering on you now. This changes many things."

653cced1-31c0-4961-af88-358986bec3f2.Text: "The news of your disappearance has not reached Janus. My guess is that your close servants decided to conceal this event so as not to beget fear."

72755b1f-90b1-45e9-9a09-ffb1c0d062dd.Text: {n}With a frowning grimace, the commoner bows and mutters under his breath,{/n} "Oh, this won't end well. With guests like these, better grab 'em by the floppers and to the pyre. Burn them right quick."

2761d6b4-9fc2-4a74-bbdb-8767dc2703d7.Text: "The Lilaethan has been charitable to the mon-keigh. She bestows special gifts upon some of your servants; she forges bonds with them. This is the first time I have seen our world so... tolerant of your kind. It reminds me just how much I still do not understand. Alas, your kin do not trouble themselves with contemplating this matter. They fear those gifted by the Lilaethan, they despise them, and seek to kill them. And that does not surprise me at all."

569bd26e-b97c-47f7-9825-f0dc997cb920.Text: {n}Muaran's voice grows pensive.{/n} "The Lilaethan's slumber is restless. She has guarded a part of herself away from you — it is what the mon-keigh call the isolated region. At first, I thought it was the Lilaethan's attempt to push you away, so she could heal from the wounds your cold iron had inflicted upon her flesh, but... I see something else in what is transpiring. A mystery."

21c64d24-85e9-4874-b46f-6fa2a67d3b90.Text: {n}Muaran exchanges long looks with Eklendyl, then says gravely,{/n} "This is where Eklendyl's path and yours diverge, mon-keigh. He will stay with us when you leave."

87e9d071-872e-4e19-bae9-c00185803e25.Text: "We will send instructions to our mon-keigh serv— allies to provide you with means of transportation. Farewell, mon-keigh. I am pleased that our meeting did not spill blood into the Lilaethan's womb."

aef0c3fa-c7d4-4649-a976-778059a72ea9.Text: {n}Upon noticing a non-human in your retinue, the old man grimaces with contempt and clutches the Aquila hanging around his neck.{/n} "And chumming around with inhuman scum, no less! Begone, you lanky freak! I compel you in Saint Cognatius's name, in Saint Nicomedes Keefe's name, in Saint Drusus's name..."

cfcdac61-1add-46c5-8462-4694b314bec4.Text: {n}{d|Encyclopedia:Ch3_EklendylSaved}Eklendyl{/d} casts a weary eye over the commoner and enquires quietly,{/n} "Is this mon-keigh possessed or simply mad?"

d8480474-0f45-47c4-b82e-5a770c8d155c.Text: "I'm just a lowborn, a small, humble man! I've only ever seen your lustrous visage on the holy icons in the temples of the capital."

f37d0174-24b9-4552-8f87-377f468d09aa.Text: {n}Marazhai laughs mockingly.{/n} "Another Farseer who chose to hide from the blades of the Reaving Tempest! Well, it is nothing I cannot rectify, coward."

c8c30022-42b0-4e49-90d2-b4975abcc3b2.Text: {n}Upon noticing {d|Encyclopedia:Ch3_EklendylSaved}Eklendyl{/d}, Muaran flinches, then says solemnly,{/n} "Brother Eklendyl, I praise Asuryan for the fortune of seeing you again. Please, step under my protection without delay."

bd799709-43e9-46de-bb42-288d51483875.Text: "Brother Muaran, I do not feel threatened... not anymore."

09285ddd-9aaa-42f5-a4d5-0af8b801af5e.Text: {n}Muaran looks at Yrliet and says with enmity in his voice,{/n} "Outcast Yrliet, you walk the path paved with your own misdoings. Once more mon-keigh have found their way to our domain, and once more you aid them in doing so!"

3471b9bf-f417-4b7a-a790-7201008ce7eb.Text: {n}Muaran's voice drops to a venomous hiss when he sees Marazhai.{/n} "Dark Ones have no place here."

2b87b585-9e1a-4342-a101-a5e221dae30e.Text: "Neither war nor ill intent follow in our wake, Muaran. Your anger is unwarranted."

d361fc17-5d99-4b09-8935-2799526fc88f.Text: {n}Muaran's eyes shift from Yrliet to Marazhai, from Marazhai to Eklendyl, then back to Yrliet again. He exclaims indignantly,{/n} "By Asuryan's grace, what is the meaning of this strange visit?"

72c379eb-83b5-48ac-9dc2-fd89c73d66fb.Text: "No bandit or xenos, that's plain to see! Can you say the same? You..."

305bf127-ebe1-4f68-9cd8-d93656129d3e.Text: {n}The old man lowers his voice.{/n} "Who knows with him. Folks say he doesn't govern us no more at all. They say {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_JanusEldarGovern}forest spirits{/d} have coaxed him, the ones that slip inside his palace at night. Those spirits whisper things into his ears — all their wicked ploys and plots. They almost made him ban expeditions to the islands, but the red priests didn't let him. It's where they live, those spirits. In their old forest shrines."

b844ecf3-8f8e-418c-b453-e593ebb54d1a.Text: {n}Eklendyl nods.{/n} "I am elated to be once more among those with whom I shared Crudarach's time of bloom, Muaran."

2c33a285-c1c6-4d8b-9301-b2beb637ce54.Text: "My people do not bargain for the lives of their kin," {n}Muaran declares angrily.{/n} "We will remember your deed — nothing more."

795e0759-26bd-43f2-bb4d-b1b7fe1ef788.Text: "It is not up for discussion, mon-keigh. It is so."

18e18554-ec06-4930-92f1-64eb7dc4dbc6.Text: "We will send instructions to our mon-keigh serv— allies to provide you with means of transportation. You are free to go wherever you wish. But Eklendyl stays with us." {n}Muaran points at the Farseer you rescued.{/n}

bdd6b433-457f-462e-9b0e-0ce7dac80c04.Text: "I'm a scout, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I wander the woods, I test the soil." {n}Taking great care, the old man reaches into his sack and pulls out a scratched auspex with a long spike, wrapped in a muddy rag.{/n}

4591935e-380f-4889-86a2-04285fe4c778.Text: {n}His voice drops to a whisper.{/n} "We also pray that she never sets her sights on us. They say scary things about the capital, about her court, about the missing people. Rumour has it, they host a never-ending ball at her palace. The dancing never stops, not for a moment. Any servant who steps inside the palace never comes out. There must be an awful lot of work to do at that ball of theirs."

edb3c4e3-b66a-40be-bce6-9151fbbb0083.Text: "The Tech-Priest told me, 'Once a thousand steps you have walked, thrust the mystical probe into the soil, say a prayer, then press the smaragdine seal. Offer three prayers to the Emperor, then press the ruby seal. Thus will the probe test the land and tell you what minerals dwell therein.'"

3c80bd6d-b182-4004-b92b-6ec601dfd75c.Text: {n}Marazhai narrows one eye.{/n} "His body is neither strong enough nor spirited enough to bear torment. I will not waste my efforts on him."

bef2db89-68c2-49b0-b67f-eb11afe3780a.Text: "I won't shame myself by complaining. We live, thanks be to the God-Emperor and Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. We pray for your health every day."

bf612338-d9ae-4feb-945f-2cf961a9da7a.Text: {n}Muaran's gaze bores into Yrliet for a few moments in tense silence as he considers something in his mind. At last, he says in a commanding tone,{/n} "Your arrival is sudden, Outcast Yrliet. But perhaps there is purpose behind it. You will serve your people shortly."

c3e25082-d81d-4ea7-85ff-4944eace04f7.Text: "And some blokes say they saw a woman with horns in these woods—" {n}Despite his excitement at the rare opportunity to tell every possible tall tale he knows to a stranger, the old man suddenly remembers who is standing before him and chokes on his unfinished story.{/n}

efebd402-5b41-42c0-b4e7-926e5625caf2.Text: "Oh, it's just groxwash, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, it's nothing. Just some faffers running their mouths." {n}The old man looks down sheepishly.{/n}

336eb57e-65cd-415a-b99c-88aef9b015a5.Text: {n}Muaran grimaces contemptuously.{/n} "A mon-keigh cannot comprehend the depth of the tragedy that befell our home, our... Crudarach. The duty of every Child of Asuryan is to do all they can to quell the pain of that loss. And Yrliet the Outcast is no exception."

768a771c-3479-4b99-a3a6-61705e2921da.Text: "Unlike you, Muaran, I was able to find the truth. The truth of Crudarach's doom was revealed to me... even though that required me to throw myself in the Dark City's deadly embrace." {n}Yrliet frowns and looks defiantly into the Farseer's eyes.{/n}

158a1727-17a7-490e-8432-ace1aa5a98a7.Text: "Is the fire of our souls not better directed toward worthy deeds than arguing with our kin?" {n}Eklendyl waves his hands in the air, making several gestures of unknown meaning. Muaran and Yrliet fall into cowed silence.{/n} "I can see that something is troubling your delicate heart, my kinsman Muaran. Share your feelings with me and the Outcast then, and I will reveal the truth of Crudarach's fate to you a little later."

b598b354-45f3-4fb3-8a5a-aa22244d3f16.Text: "You..." {n}Muaran bows his head, surprised.{/n} "Allow me to see the truth that was revealed to your eyes." {n}The Farseer steps toward Yrliet. He touches her brow lightly with one hand and the faintly glowing spirit stone with the other.{/n}

724644e5-7415-487f-bf60-0ffb4007aee7.Text: "Now... I understand." {n}Dark shadows appear on the Farseer's face, and the look in his eyes becomes even sterner than before.{/n} "And that is why I am once again appealing to your sense of duty, Outcast. We did not spend our time on the Lilaethan in fruitless grief. On the contrary, our lost kin have answered my call and are now pleading for help. Driven by revenge, they set out to pursue the one responsible for Crudarach's rueful demise, only to end up as captives on a mon-keigh world."

38c8cf48-2298-484f-b996-3bfc805efc4f.Text: "We did not spend our time on the Lilaethan in fruitless grief. On the contrary, our lost kin have answered my call and are now pleading for help. Driven by revenge, they set out to pursue the one responsible for Crudarach's rueful demise, only to end up as captives on a mon-keigh world."

c468dc6b-2e13-4aed-8825-c94d83603510.Text: "That I know not. All that my visions showed me was an infinitely green sea... A living sea. And the maddening thirst of a hunter who was pursuing the Children of Asuryan. Outcast, your Path is taking you toward the stars again. Find our kin and do not let them perish."

d232a0b1-11c5-4a1c-bafe-096edae3950d.Text: "Can't say I have the foggiest. We've never even heard the governor's name. But it still beats living under that accursed heretic, Vistenza the Bloodsucker."

6f6bc3b4-7c25-4bef-bc69-eaf905e3a1eb.Text: {n}Her emerald-green gaze turns to you and rests on you a little longer than usual.{/n} "Dare I hope that... you will lend me a shoulder to lean on again, elantach?"

3a69c295-3e59-49f3-99d5-6d9fb1ad1fe7.Text: "They might have... But that does not mean they should pay for their mistakes with their lives."

77263675-9699-4c72-92e8-32295b86224d.Text: {n}Kibellah looks up at the Farseer with torment in her eyes.{/n} "You should."

bd2c517c-c0d6-4ffb-9d41-912b24e21c9a.Text: "In a jiffy, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Please be welcome to our flying ferry, it's right over yonder, in the brush. It's also where our expedition's vox-wizard is staying."

1c08a65d-d34c-468b-a9dd-95575097c57d.Text: {n}The old man glances at the Farseer suspiciously.{/n} "Will that there chatty mug be flying to the capital with Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}? He's got an awful big mouth, he looks like trouble..."

3f2c2740-0803-479e-a993-327c9299290c.Text: "You come from Commorragh?" {n}Muaran says nothing for a moment, then continues, his voice shocked,{/n} "Now I see. The Gate refused to obey me because it was sealed from within. By the Dark Ones, no doubt. The Lilaethan was meant to become a slaughterhouse for the Drukhari!"

a5962d6b-ec21-4713-8a15-31afb7494f30.Text: "'Riled up'?" {n}Yrliet gives you a confused look, but then nods.{/n} "Elantach and I have travelled a long way, Muaran. We..." {n}She gives you another long look.{/n} "We were prisoners in Commorragh, but followed a Webway thread out. That thread brought us here."

0dacacb6-d9aa-4423-bea2-a74d193594ae.Text: "Our good masters, the wise Magi, they take care of us. Every month, we give 'em a drop of blood as payment for protecting us, and they use it to brew potions that can detect freaks. We do whatever mystical tasks they require of us, and for that, the Magi order the irrigation facilities to yield twice as much."

21fa6855-ab7d-447a-ac83-97320b1cfb06.Text: "I will help you find your kin."

8ae88851-d4e9-4398-9c5c-da297620da2b.Text: {n}Yrliet breathes out almost inaudibly and her shoulders relax.{/n} "And I am grateful to you, elantach."

6118624f-b2ef-4ba0-ba1d-b19a2b97ec12.Text: "After all that you have done? No. Not a chance."

5ff81074-89ac-42e7-a9ed-c955eb449408.Text: "I hope your answer changes soon. I will await it more eagerly than I waited to be freed from the Dark City."

c6a7adda-2f1b-405c-95c6-7440e687ad5e.Text: "I destroyed nothing. I will take no blame for any of this."

0eb02aab-279d-4fa7-9e5b-61d5800bf501.Text: "We have done no harm to your race. Once I find what I have come for, I shall trouble you no more."

8f895d9c-7511-44f6-8852-540c1f334735.Text: [Shoot at the source of the Necron's speech] "That's enough blathering, you foul piece of scrap!"

5a72bbdd-6f45-4300-bac1-eff146f1655c.Text: {n}The drawn-out metallic groans form a painful and melancholy melody, but one that oozes with venomous spite.{/n} "I exist again and I behold discord! An abominable sight! Great conquerors brought low by a fleeting pestilence! Corrosion everywhere. The hollow insides are ablaze!" {n}The grating roar is more like the sound of a metal torture instrument than {d|Encyclopedia:Ch5_NecronKnowlege}a sentient being's speech{/d}.{/n}

953a22ce-a1e7-4a90-a946-d6066bd920fc.Text: {n}The drawn-out metallic groans form a painful and melancholy melody, but one that oozes with venomous spite. The armoured plates {d|Encyclopedia:Ch5_NoNecronKnowlege}sing in an unknown language{/d}, and you feel as though the meaning is on the verge of reaching your mind — unless the monster cuts your lives short before that. The grating roar is more like the sound of a metal torture instrument than a sentient being's speech.{/n}

a723b6df-bf19-4939-b267-ee5a29a15c2f.Text: {n}The Necron's screeching distantly resembles laughter, or perhaps sobs. {/n} "Rust does not have the privilege of witnessing noble metal perish! The destroyer shall be destroyed. The accursed one is sowing disease. The great and mighty do battle — the petty and worthless shall fall!"

cd78c403-85cb-497c-842d-487bb0e8558d.Text: "Rust is rust. It devours one day and disappears the next. I shall unmanifest it! Annihilation!"

469f0eca-1bee-40a4-97f2-552e2a3e347b.Text: {n}The sound of the vibrating metal plates has both the rhythmic malice of a march and the hollow hum of misery — the lament of an immortal mechanism doomed to aeons of wrath and battle, or else an impending demise. The salvo from the monstrous cannon is an infernal orchestral chord that makes the very fabric of space tremble.{/n}

b81abfc2-2684-48cd-ac1f-e74bf8e77d3c.Text: "You are an ancient nightmare from a long-forgotten past..." {n}Yrliet's breathing becomes unsteady as she stares wide-eyed at the being opposite you.{/n} "I have encountered others like you, Oghyr. Once before. And I will do to you as I did to them: send you to the depths of your tomb."

7a62fcfa-5897-467c-b073-26a8021c1b53.Text: {n}The xenos lets out a metallic click, a semblance of laughter.{/n} "An ancient weapon that was broken in battles forgotten... worthless!"

86b26a19-4db4-42ac-a5c5-5c705f4234b3.Text: {n}The xenos's entire skeletal body is made of an unknown metal interlaced with greenish energy channels aglow with currents. Below its waist, the flares of a grav-pad are humming and rattling. Its upper limbs fuse into a formidable heavy cannon. Not a single part of the monster's body betrays vulnerability. Without a doubt, this is a technologically superb machine designed to annihilate all life. Disabling it will not be easy.{/n}

4dc17b1a-2f0a-49c2-8f3e-8cd33d4ed6b6.Text: {n}The xenos's entire skeletal body is made of an unknown metal interlaced with greenish energy channels aglow with currents. Below its waist, the flares of a grav-pad are humming and rattling. Its upper limbs fuse into a formidable heavy cannon. Not a single part of the monster's body betrays vulnerability. Without a doubt, this is a technologically superb machine designed to annihilate all life. Disabling it will not be easy.{/n}

7fb6ecdb-5df2-47cc-9fd7-762d4af7207a.Text: {n}The vox-translator spits out several metallic sounds, and a new flash of anger makes the Necron's bulky body rumble.{/n} "Desecration of intelligent speech! I will sooner see it obliterated!"

deeb1dea-7639-48fe-91ba-9b84dc91b522.Text: {n}The skull-like head jerks, and for a few moments, a circular opening appears between the jaws, resembling a mouth open in astonishment. The wound closes with a terrifying, tremulous ringing. The deafening roar that follows sharply pierces you with pain. Blood starts seeping out of your ears.{/n}

28c69747-58bc-4e36-a2d2-4865b7c794ba.Text: "The runts of the universe shall be eliminated! I rout them and I pulverise them into bloodied dust! I rid myself of them and of my sorrow! The cursed one will regret ever existing!" {n}The xenos starts to shake, from the armoured plates on its head down to the tail flaps of its grav-pad. The tremor causes the rock below it to crack and sink in.{/n}

0abd71d3-3e50-4b79-9dc8-29a4223db7ec.Text: "I recognise a leader and a true warrior in this one. Yes, still a xenos unworthy of life, but a warrior all the same. I bet this noble madman of battle will fall by my hand!" {n}Ulfar casts a joyous look over the party, as if expecting someone to take him up on the wager.{/n}

28432349-dc56-459e-b9d2-bda563b0da13.Text: {n}Marazhai grins.{/n} "Bold words for an arena slave. I accept the challenge. Just do not take your defeat too close to heart."

faa15d8b-0966-4989-a3d2-a6dd1a366dc9.Text: [Try to extract the data concerning the mechanism's masters]

368d1d21-384a-4afa-805d-834a75235a31.Text: {n}Several disfigured corpses in the uniforms of Inquisition soldiers have been tossed in a grotesque pile between the cogitator and the large obelisk-like statue. Their killers left no trace, but you have the nagging, oppressive feeling that the very walls are watching you. The air, thick with electricity and the heavy stench of rotting flesh, only makes that feeling worse.{/n}

f1a88aa7-9337-4b5f-b589-cb5afa45aab1.Text: {n}You have never seen a cryptographic machine as intricate and unorthodox as this one. The numerous sacred seals of algorithmic asceticism suggest that the spirit dwelling within is exceptionally cunning and powerful, privy to forbidden knowledge.{/n}

cb3d3248-0d0e-47c2-9683-e259d7e593d1.Text: {n}If there is one thing you know for sure, it is that the machine is expensive, rare, and sacred enough for you to easily get a good price for it.{/n}

e9fb9433-abc4-43d2-889f-ee35c4b8ddc0.Text: {n}The mechanism, having served the Inquisition so faithfully, is loath to part with its secrets. One after another, menacing scarlet dots light up on its casing.{/n}

11c935a5-f888-4b28-ab64-9121d7a6467f.Text: {n}An impulse of the Motive Force runs through the thick cables around the cogitator. "Data accepted. [Alg.84521-4521] Linguistic analysis complete. Initiate final cataloguing?"{/n}

8996ffc3-2a8f-4010-a335-a23f3cdc0baa.Text: {n}The vid-screen fills with the same symbols you saw on the surrounding buildings. You feel an inexplicable rush of disgust at the sight of them in place of familiar words and numbers. Almost identical geometric shapes combine into long chains and flash by too fast for you to take them in.{/n}

cbb93c4c-aeb8-4543-b154-2320e4819b01.Text:
{n}A message is blinking impatiently on the cogitator's vid-screen: "PROCESS: Linguistic analysis [Alg.54782136]
STATUS: Awaiting data cataloguing. Activate information panels."{/n}
