9f1bba62-a37c-4e9e-9ad8-ae16b8e5d1e5.Text: {n}Now connected to the cogitator, your Elucidator hums intensely. As it learns the meaning of the hitherto unfamiliar glyphs, it responds with rattles and metallic groans. The cogitator's vid-screen lights up: "Operation completed."{/n}

45e7fe13-8764-4dba-bc3c-5ca373e6ff32.Text: {n}A scrolling binharic code replaces the xenos symbols. The vid-screen displays the following message: "Linguistic analysis aborted. [Alg.13697512]."{/n}

98281a36-30e0-43fd-8619-d30e9e6d9a67.Text: {n}Your ruthless intrusion into the cogitator's memory chambers yields the following message: "Prepare for the start of Operation Precious Sentinel. The Horrific Vision event may come to pass. Orders to abort the research mission and join the contingent on Epitaph. Codes for traversing the minefields are attached." The message has an attachment containing the astronomical coordinates of a planet along with some binharic code.{/n}

c6d6aaa9-9364-45b0-bf39-7ef058213caf.Text: {n}The cogitator shrieks indignantly, lighting up with blinding red indicators and letting out a high-frequency howl. A word appears across the entire width of the vid-screen: "[Alg. 00-02] INTRUSION!" When the ringing in your ears subsides, you realise you hear something else... someone's heavy footsteps. The vindictive machine spirit triumphantly displays a blinking prophetic message.{/n}

0ad7f286-e6dc-466d-9c3b-c2296f9a43cb.Text: a vast number of incomprehensible symbols fills the screen, causing headache and requesting clarification of unmarked symbols

0724733a-fb0b-4ca3-b759-7b8a34628974.Text:
{n}The hum of the servo-motors inside the cogitator grows louder as the machine processes information. "ATTENTION. Insufficient data for final cataloguing. [Alg.54782136-125]
STATUS: Awaiting data input."{/n}

ce6af1fa-f5ca-41fa-b969-96b003b9a7bc.Text: {n}The lights smugly and maliciously blink at you one last time before going out.{/n}

c8054a3d-fc96-4e75-a1f4-6a6b3fd5faf8.Text: "Now I see why they needed such an ancient and powerful machine spirit. To decipher a xenos language is practically to comprehend it. This archeotech is on the verge of turning into an Abominable Intelligence." {n}Trepidation blends with horror in the Tech-Priest's voice.{/n} "It cannot be left here. I am sending an order to the ship to deploy a team of technomats to dismantle and extract the sacred machine."

5c60a3a9-2b88-4bd9-a85a-90b508963170.Text: {n}Pasqal bows his head and mutters a prayer, then makes a quick motion with his fingers. Several lights on the cogitator go out as its defences crack.{/n} "Forgive me, ancient spirit. You must be pacified."

fdb3783a-3517-4439-a87d-d012477b4634.Text: {n}"Priority zero: contact with barrier squadron lost during dimensional gate recharging. No confirmation received of gate being sealed. Stay on high alert!"{/n}

d3d91c7f-fd1d-42a4-86df-b70c1a267f06.Text: "Careful, Rogue Trader. The Oghyr are adept at springing traps."

b3854c42-4734-46aa-a248-ee80b25cd7d1.Text: {n}Closing his eyes and sniffing noisily, the Wolf snarls grimly,{/n} "What killed these mortals is still near. I can smell it... A lifeless stench. Not like a corpse, but like the iron teeth in Morkai's maw."

dafebb78-8726-401f-87e1-13785943fe68.Text: {n}A text in Low Gothic appears under the glyphs: "Shunning the imperfections of the flesh, its transience, and its finiteness, we have embarked on a new trajectory amid the stars, and have become immortal. We have become the New, preserving a bond with the Old through rhythm, images, and symbols. Before existence turns to darkness, it shall be conquered and it shall tremble in fear."{/n}

8149f31d-b4a7-4261-9798-3387e3ad8ea6.Text: {n}Pasqal bows reverently to the sacred machine and whispers,{/n} "This machine's spirit is wayward and apprehensive, for it is tormented. Its intricate mind carries many scars from pacifying binharic litanies." {n}The Tech-Priest carefully removes the severed human finger from the input panel, whispers an apologetic prayer to the cogitator, and casually tosses the piece of flesh away.{/n}

dac89d59-b576-4d60-bb51-34f196336617.Text: {n}"REPORT. [Ref. err.] [Alg. 7458-14] Cataloguing completed successfully. Active vocabulary of the xenos race compiled. [Alg. 7458-41] ATTENTION. Data transfer to the translation device is required to save the catalogue. Declining will result in catalogue deletion. Continue?"{/n}

006229c8-9c32-4aa8-97fc-9823b5d04fa4.Text: Activate the stairway on the left

b6450577-84a0-4393-bf4a-119e3513ebce.Text: Activate the stairway on the right

3b01dcf8-d4c4-41b6-b598-85584be55cf1.Text: "Stay behind me, Lord Captain! I will hold it off for as long as I can."

36535426-2452-421a-9fd6-3da87a3d99ec.Text: "Betrayer of the Emperor's blood! Archsacrilege! Mine shall be a worthy death!"

0f08ab85-f3a3-44b2-87da-a6b42ebe361a.Text: "What... what is that monster? Its image... it is twisted by corruption! Oh, Emperor, is my life meant to end so soon?"

029e29cc-1150-4f70-b3eb-fdefb6909b86.Text: "Farewell. If any of you somehow manage to survive, find Lord Inquisitor Calcazar and inform him of what you saw here."

2fa0dd92-c7f8-408b-8457-fc33fc137f7a.Text: "What is that? The voices... they're screaming, wailing, choking! We're up against death itself!"

db69a00f-6f08-4eae-8d67-aff7aa70b793.Text: "My threat analysis indicates insurmountable superiority. Survival prognosis is... disheartening."

a61de17b-bfed-4f49-a9e1-cd82a5205e63.Text: "Emperor, take my soul for its final judgement, for what I see is death!"

6c3427c9-6b14-46c7-8282-87baa9d96887.Text: "The traitor has fallen, while we live still. Praise Him for this miracle!"

f796025f-7bf4-435f-acd1-178b9606fbe4.Text: "His colours were a blazing, raging crimson... Thank the Emperor that our souls are unburnt!"

8ae2bd13-92a1-4fc3-9ec0-dba1e01592c7.Text: "Incredible... To have survived an encounter with a heretic Astartes..."

09771028-0e3f-409d-9793-0571f1c5a8b6.Text: "Praise be to the Omnissiah for manifesting this statistical miracle and invalidating an unfavourable tactical prognosis."

7bcc03d8-2c36-4a12-82f7-7da2d0fd2db8.Text: "I'm... alive, and so is Glaito... Truly, the Emperor protects — there is no other explanation."

0f535ee6-4050-49c2-955c-478f5137717f.Text: "By the Throne! I have seen much in my time, but what is that abomination?"

5b740e02-e8d7-4a7b-9bdc-d6e2693955a4.Text: "Emperor, grant me strength, for a horror from the Immaterium is upon us!"

1836a6fc-9315-4e7f-b79a-5437b69273ef.Text: "Begone! You do not belong in realspace! I should not be able to see you... not with these eyes!"

781e6353-9cf0-4a02-bf6b-b206a063e760.Text: "A daemon of the Immaterium! Brace yourselves, we face a waking nightmare!"

14139243-a0d1-4c6a-ad63-d2d22d60a694.Text: "It speaks to me, it's in my head! No, shut up!"

a25454fd-b8aa-4b8f-854a-81d1992d7629.Text: "Initiating enemy analysis... Error. This is impossible... Omnissiah have mercy on me, what is that?"

60e6cac7-af36-49a7-90c8-ba19bb9ee937.Text: "No... It's impossible! In the name of the Lex, how can something like this exist?"

fa380a8a-b279-4a2e-ae19-3299ecf242dc.Text: "The escort team is guarding and inspecting your shuttle!"

eb30199d-8364-432e-ad3d-10644b696349.Text: "I honour your Motive Force, machine spirit! I honour your engine's might!"

4977376e-1f13-48af-9451-c29fc34a6987.Text: Turn your thoughts to the God-Emperor

5a04e557-cad4-41d2-9ad9-9de588816a85.Text: Lord Captain Theodora von Valancius perished along with her heir, Edelthrad, and thousands of crew members.

dd4d9646-2657-4b0b-b2ec-1c039886d9d8.Text: Yet hope remained, for the second in line to the Rogue Trader dynasty survived

ca35ec24-7091-4e2f-a62a-9a63a91e9b12.Text: at the cost of many sacrifices made by the Lord Captain in the name of h{mf|is|er} own ambitions.

8f3e1089-7e5e-4961-91f4-33256d1b3673.Text: and, through the strength of h{mf|is|er} resolve, saved those who were counting on h{mf|im|er} for protection.

ca5d1001-51b5-4d1e-b524-6d376ce77004.Text: to hang the ancestral banners once again and exact vengeance on the enemies of House von Valancius and Humanity.

505eb4fa-498d-465f-bd30-19c5a471b309.Text: The treachery of the Master of Whispers was fruitless, but victory came at a great cost.

311f3dd9-3111-4807-b8fd-e9582eeec12c.Text: As the voidship plunged deeper into the Koronus Expanse, the Rogue Trader's subjects bid a formal farewell to the late head of the dynasty, Theodora von Valancius.

5cf8794f-be0f-4e4c-89f7-a70449b707bb.Text: Having paid their last respects, the crew gathered their strength and braced themselves for whatever was to come next.

90b1d46b-2490-401b-a10e-cde7cf4f408c.Text: The von Valancius flagship made its way out of the doomed star system.

0d8f7bad-c147-4b42-a7e6-e0155eaca11f.Text: For a time, threats subsided, activity returned to trade routes, and reclaimed worlds began to heal.

02a6ead8-879a-45c4-b225-f21eb4c05688.Text: The new Lord Captain's subjects praised the God-Emperor and their leader wholeheartedly — for none knew what fate might await them.

7b86b145-6301-43a5-be37-d72b0b538e74.Text: The rise of the Rogue Trader heir restored a tenuous equilibrium to the von Valancius protectorate.

84804cdb-4e67-4ea6-8cdc-87009c076798.Text: Despite the challenges, they managed to escape the labyrinthian Webway and find their way back... home.

d72e6582-4d38-40f9-8d06-920e5734775d.Text: With the physical horrors of Commorragh behind them, a long and arduous journey, possible only with the help of a xenos guide, lay ahead for the Rogue Trader and h{mf|is|er} party: from one strange destination to the next, through unknowable environments, the mere sight of which could drive one to madness.

4fe1a952-2e1d-4c01-886e-023952cdf3c9.Text: After gathering allies and preparing to venture into the unknown, the Lord Captain plunged headlong into the darkness that held ancient nightmares... and the answers to all h{mf|is|er} questions.

e2ffeb23-60e5-4334-b092-b33913ce13fe.Text: The ancient gate, long impenetrable for the Rogue Trader, was at last ready to reveal its secrets.

f6b3eba3-2351-47e3-99bc-1705a5ccd83c.Text: "With the turn of this spanner, I do praise the Omnissiah's wisdom!"

55a533f3-b42a-45dd-9fbf-398a878a288e.Text: "And so He gave us a sign, and bathed our humble visages in the light of the emerald lumen!"

3519c2cd-9815-4dce-8248-bf591bcac662.Text: "Let the boon of the Motive Force bless this cogitator's hallowed cathodes!"

5c8d3d08-dd2e-4a34-a725-e6d3b0630a78.Text: "Slice the seal open with a consecrated blade and let the valve drink of the oil of life."

b1801cfc-6e6b-4fd9-ba08-45777e79e540.Text: "May this healing salve banish the malady from the ravaged flesh of this mechanism!"

94d54a4a-e15f-4b37-9601-880243d35a57.Text: "Lay bare your adamantine being and let these lowly hands perform the sacred rite."

cd1d4b03-1901-4b5c-ba2c-eb2d2b738d60.Text: Wasted resources on ineffective propaganda among the people of Janus.

bcf08c9e-31f2-4248-bda2-16c116b562fb.Text: Janus suffered from a series of devastating terrorist attacks perpetrated by the rebels.

bb9b3625-1a20-4d83-a557-54ac1c68e7d1.Text: The guerrilla tactics employed against the rebels on Janus failed and led to many deaths and a colossal waste of resources.

6ebd86ae-a76b-4a71-9143-f833971f242b.Text: The large-scale attack by militia troops against rebel camps on Janus failed and led to many deaths and a colossal waste of resources.

12bb4d77-f2a7-4de8-a45c-4557835f6e6d.Text: Received a reward for helping Jae Heydari.

e662597a-9f2f-4bf9-918c-02ce7e8da72d.Text: Bribed the heretical vandals in the ruins of Scipione 84-249.

b76a43fa-5540-4fdd-a4d1-684df269087a.Text: Allowed the Engine Vandals in the ruins of Scipione 84-249 to redeem themselves before the Deus Mechanicus and serve the Omnissiah once more.

a837ea6a-72b7-4986-a0d2-e43caca2a66d.Text: Ordered that no expense be spared and that sanctioned Astropaths be hired to restore the Astropathic Choir of Dargonus.

b8c0f6b4-f9ba-4b13-82f7-d9a70b5a261d.Text: House Drivestem replenished the von Valancius coffers by tripling the tithes collected from its subjects.

826a28e5-42c5-461a-835f-311c2e933e58.Text: Gained the support of the new prelate of the Order of the Hammer, Brother Nigmus, by investigating his dark secrets.

26644ed9-532f-4ef3-9454-949c91b95008.Text: Made Brother Nigmus the new prelate of the Order of the Hammer.

90377ff8-bac7-484e-b4c9-94b15ed5010f.Text: Allowed the prophet to leave Foulstone with the Crucible in tow.

79be7895-d92d-406d-94c7-6287d369fccd.Text: Gifted promethium to the colony of Vonvalancius and received ancient gilded statues and jewels as a sign of gratitude from the populace.

f92c5028-fee1-4ac0-817d-a9c52e5c79e4.Text: Tripled the tithes collected from Janus as punishment for the governor's actions.

473c7c29-628c-4c9b-ba40-0a8f5b942ac7.Text: Sent provisions from the ship to the hungry people of Footfall.

b3f8d5da-c0b4-4c99-a55c-8bf2bfdca76d.Text: Organised delivery of corrupted provisions to Footfall.

a65a0fb5-c784-49bb-b6c2-fc7b71841c03.Text: Requested the aid of master xenowhisperers to stop the invasion of xenos spirits on Janus.

aeaf6641-350b-41c0-bd2d-02e995edf20f.Text: Attempted to hide the events on Janus from the Ordo Xenos punitive unit.

7ea521d3-fdcd-444e-bb99-25dc76e076c6.Text: Isolated the Kiava Gamma manufactorum stricken with the xenodisease and invited interested parties that paid for the right to research the tech-leprosy.

aebe59b5-25d1-49c5-9a7a-8a3df484cdab.Text: Procured high psy-sensitivity Tech-Priests to support the performance of the manufactorums on Kiava Gamma.

490904ed-e7c4-4163-942a-50a84300409d.Text: Agreed to the demands of the rebels on the lower decks.

32e778e6-b2b1-4678-a7da-92ada1b18e84.Text: Received a generous reward for providing transuranium elements to the void station of the Adeptus Mechanicus.

7f6309fc-1bf6-4e4a-b220-a5f6ae1e0ad3.Text: Stripped Eurac V of anything of value.

77317fec-7db2-43c4-8f9f-8c91542bdadc.Text: Wrote out a letter of payment for ten times the certification officer's salary.

ce0eb22b-441f-4161-aa03-c90d3d5d22fb.Text: Gifted the Dargonus University of Medicae to the young nobleman so he could study the sciences together with his lowborn beloved.

d7af8d62-b621-42bd-94c3-b2f54b5ca652.Text: Ordered that the decommissioned servitor be bought and given to its grandfather.

0da4fa6e-7a77-4718-85a7-e4f28fdfd818.Text: Gave money to a stranger in the queue at the Administratum Palace.

567a89e7-ab7c-4b69-837e-4568d49dffa1.Text: Bribed the petitioner in the queue at the Administratum Palace.

76e806c0-d2da-4609-98c5-3c5cf9022b45.Text: Transferred new data on planets of the Koronus Expanse to the representative of the Explorator Cognisance Fleet.

2e99d844-e282-49ca-b312-3d70a7881a20.Text: Transferred data on planets of the Koronus Expanse to the representative of the Explorator Cognisance Fleet.

83874ee3-d669-412e-9fd6-0bdd293ada80.Text: Bought the mutant captives on Footfall.

f9667bf8-b040-4180-8ebf-9021149f0fef.Text: Held a reception for the Navigators of House Orsellio.

879eb3aa-25f8-4e53-a502-723367b25702.Text: Struck a deal with the Pilgrim by allowing him to mine flogiston using your extractiums.

58d6ce22-612a-411f-9ec5-b845807369c0.Text: Hired mercenaries to deal with the Cult of the Final Dawn on Vheabos VI.

471a1ff9-43a5-4c51-aa2c-de265b708da4.Text: Obligated the governor of the Rykad System to provide resources and people to the crew of the von Valancius flagship.

17fc2f03-ebb7-45c3-9b3e-85dd01ae1b4a.Text: The governor of the Rykad System agreed to provide material assistance to the Rogue Trader.

638881da-a5e2-47d9-aff7-466ab643709e.Text: Appropriated the pirate Denz's inheritance by posing as his lawful heir, Fidelio.

66f684a2-b543-4464-9ac2-611938a78f3b.Text: Voided the pirate Denz's will and confiscated his entire fortune.

dbec5b93-dfc8-4f02-92dc-c15018e7bb52.Text: A gust of cold wind ruffles your hair

5e097460-19cb-43cd-b76e-c9b3cb9ac884.Text: Shadows are reversed for a moment

cb9d450b-7315-4704-8538-f46112f11e2d.Text: A feeling of terror grips your heart

dc378295-5e7e-460f-a51f-0641d18c016d.Text: The air is filled with evil whispers

7a73c604-bf28-4e3b-a2a3-d9e956838294.Text: A gloomy premonition clouds the mind

c5b13f98-f779-4033-bd92-5e3a16103549.Text: A strike of terror pierces the heart

de27d045-80af-4529-b21c-b00664b9f75f.Text: The stink of scorched flesh fills the air

9d9b13b9-a69c-4a09-8d6b-d02e277c748a.Text: Surfaces around are covered with mucus

e5606571-b03a-40dc-bb0e-cc262478afba.Text: An otherworldly screech pierces your ears

83389497-e7ad-456f-9d3b-ac4c31b7fad2.Text: The blood freezes in your veins

7ecd5559-1940-48f6-8563-81ff79aef6d0.Text: Discharges of the Motive Force fill the air

15afd425-30e6-4bfd-82cf-103d8bc56742.Text: "...Rogue Trader, Bearer of the Warrant of Trade, Stellar Inheritor, and Guardian of Humanity comes!"

17a820a1-04b1-475d-8c04-d06fcf2e9068.Text: "{mf|His Lord|Her Lady}ship {name} von Valancius, Rogue Trader by the grace of the God-Emperor and the sacred Lords of Terra..."

18f183eb-c1dc-4f2c-a730-48751e916e2f.Text: "...loyal servant of the Imperium of Man, unvanquished!"

d5b5a4b7-27b7-4e85-b805-54c0ba367d94.Text: "Long live Rogue Trader {name} von Valancius, rightful successor to the Warrant of Trade and the von Valancius protectorate..."

3765f71d-58ef-4328-b8eb-d88bb39b7adc.Text: "...Warpstrider of the Koronus Expanse — may the world tremble!"

c75d8550-9a2b-40d3-9591-5ae8d97db54d.Text: "Before Rogue Trader von Valancius, Guardian of Order, Ruler of Great and Lesser Worlds..."

7658e1bd-bc27-47d7-ad29-b78d66564aef.Text: "Long live {name} von Valancius, heir of Theodora von Valancius, rightful Bearer of the Warrant of Trade, hailed as Xenosbane and Saviour of Dargonus, let {mf|his|her} name be glorified through the aeons!"

ed4dce4a-6280-453a-927f-c4ef2097c755.Text: "Rejoice, for among you is {name} von Valancius, Rogue Trader of the Imperium of Man, ruler of Footfall!"

cf4e484a-a180-4cd8-8fa6-d2a91ad48147.Text: "...the Saviour of Janus and scores of other worlds. Glory!"

98b2ba8d-36ca-4317-86d7-5e45d8d51735.Text: "Glory to the Rogue Trader of House von Valancius, the Guardian of the World, the Exterminator of the Enemies of Humanity..."

766d4473-c098-4659-83c6-0f2cec9baaba.Text: "...and strikes His eternal enemies, the Eradicator of Chaos, the Hero of Janus!"

888e48ce-1da4-4ef3-911e-d2181e5c99eb.Text: "Tremble, for the Sword of the Emperor is coming! {name} von Valancius carries His punishment..."

c29ab557-bbfd-4fd2-8010-6c6f6bfbde74.Text: "Bow down! {name} von Valancius, God-willed Bearer of the Warrant of Trade, Enemy of the Archenemy's worshippers, Executioner of Kiava Gamma!"

6cb35551-9f17-4efd-93a7-0736c91375b8.Text: "Protector of Kiava Gamma and the children of the Omnissiah, enlightened {name} von Valancius, the Rogue Trader of the holy dynasty!"

2003da4a-501a-44a7-92c0-6025fdeb96e2.Text: [Open the door with plasma cutters, suffering through the fumes]

9ef7bcc3-18c2-4769-85e6-c1c9e4fce83b.Text: {n}The massive door is dotted with small chips, scratches, and bullet marks. There is no sign of any hinges, levers, or anything resembling a lock. There is a dusty panel built into the wall to the right. As you approach, the cracked screen starts to flicker faintly.{/n}

bcc31ab1-ee46-4373-ab59-4ed04c25f90c.Text: {n}The panel on the wall blinks in farewell — and goes dark.{/n}

f70bf6db-b759-4212-af70-36d9ec20db27.Text: {n}A little patience — and you hear the tired clicking of mechanisms from beyond the wall. The door opens slowly and with a groan.{/n}

dcc7f782-0673-4d8d-a085-7732dcd01043.Text: {n}The machine spirits are angered by your intrusion and activate the defence systems. The previously sleeping lumens above the door blossom with amber lights.{/n}

c133a553-879f-4112-a3cb-363d46f3fea9.Text: {n}You pick out the most vulnerable spots and carefully affix the explosives.{/n}

a04b6baa-8b1d-42af-af7a-f1c367ef7097.Text: {n}After picking out what you think are the most vulnerable spots, you affix the explosives and push the trigger.{/n}

fa5d4d58-8c80-49f2-b94b-e34311fbb4a2.Text: {n}You cut the door open, trying your best to avoid the defence mechanisms. After ten long minutes, the obstacle yields, but you have inhaled your fill of poisonous vapours.{/n}

8f4c9cac-ccc4-4190-9c93-04602a0a130e.Text: {n}The massive door greets you with impenetrable silence.{/n}

aa77d30e-7a65-47ab-9032-5b610fe3191d.Text: You hear a strange sound that reminds you of dripping water... or the clattering of something sharp against metal.

f0596c8f-cdb0-4eaa-afc8-a9fd5828982e.Text: Through the ventilation shaft, you can hear the steady drip of condensation from the depths of the ship.

9ffb0ee9-c190-4332-b524-68460642f3d4.Text: The bars weren't destroyed by corrosion or rust: they were torn and pulled apart by some powerful creature.

ac551803-5324-4768-8ddd-007769b65f7a.Text: Even the plasteel bars have succumbed to corrosion after centuries of neglect.

7bf22b16-3418-471f-8411-47203d8b990e.Text: The ventilation system still works. There are strange gouges on the metal: they look like the claw marks of some beast that was trying to crawl into the shaft.

ffb6ab39-5f93-47d7-adf8-9a38632b130b.Text: The ventilation system still works, though the fan's blades are covered in rust.

842f5e11-8d92-423f-a344-56c5c9ac9524.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! If you can hear us, know that we've almost broken down the door! Hang in there if you're still alive! The Emperor protects!"

d8f719fb-a213-49de-9453-e74119f933e8.Text: This Godwyn-pattern bolter was given to Sister Argenta on the day she took her vows to join the Order of the Martyred Lady. Unfortunately, despite its illustrious name, the gleam of its metal has dulled after years of travel and encounters with horrors untold, and the sacred prayers engraved on the barrel have been worn smooth in places. With every shot it fires, another spark goes out in the halo of sanctity that surrounds this noble weapon.

77ee07ec-c6a2-4f4a-a3f7-32602b06b592.Text: ...personally led the attack, inspiring the Guards by {mf|his|her} own example to fulfil their duty to the God-Emperor. The regiment displayed unprecedented bravery in the face of mortal danger, although the higher ranks did not approve of the unwarranted risk.

27cd6ad6-1c16-4fd5-bfa9-bf70640b2f34.Text: ...gave the order for the total bombardment of the rebelling hive, disregarding the presence of allied forces within the perimeter.

7ddf6b99-46c8-449b-8ab8-c097bad7a516.Text: ...provided support to ground forces, delivering targeted orbital strikes while prolonging the military operation.

dff2afb9-eb08-4f09-bf12-9521c7257d78.Text: ...established contact with the leader of the pirate fleet and, in exchange for significant remuneration, passed on information about the location of ground forces and the latest call signs.

511f989a-389f-4f37-a449-6ef7be7ba4a2.Text: ...recognised the enemy's superiority and executed a tactical retreat.

d5356b0f-aa79-4fcc-ae2f-73c09f21ef82.Text: ...directed {mf|his|her} ship at the fleet in a suicidal attack, giving the remaining Imperial forces time to regroup and prepare to defend the planet.

fc2c5825-0b0f-4827-b322-14c2c9359e1e.Text: ...sent out invitations to a fictitious officer party in order to lure everyone involved in the crime to a single bay, and then triggered the depressurisation procedure, which was later attributed to a glitch in one of the ship's cogitators.

bc130bf3-a927-41fd-8477-ee503bd01acb.Text: ...used {mf|his|her} position to arrest the culprits and brought them before a tribunal, disregarding the complex hierarchical relations between the Astra Militarum and the Navis Imperialis.

814c5130-04aa-43bc-bab1-07de4f83516d.Text: ...increased {mf|his|her} own personal wealth many times over, capitalising on both sides' ignorance of the true value of the cargos under discussion.

f7f8b2c6-13ff-46b6-b8a1-e5cb846a1fce.Text: ...oversaw the deployment of forces and the defence of vital areas, thereby protecting key infrastructure nodes and the most important members of the planet's leadership until reinforcements arrived.

34392421-448a-4db6-b496-f2afa8486bc7.Text: ...sent forces on a decisive counter-attack, which brought the pirates' ground offensive to a standstill. By the end of the operation, the Astra Militarum regiment had been completely obliterated.

ccc51359-b6d1-4aa7-8508-25804c1e988c.Text: The pirate fleet struck after the planet's orbital forces had departed on a secret directive from the Imperial Navy. The limited ground garrison of the Astra Militarum, which had been awaiting deployment, was the world's only line of defence against the rampaging heretics.

8e59873b-6e3a-452f-b7c9-ca768bc9f273.Text: This cloak with a crimson lining once belonged to a Judge of the Adeptus Arbites.

176dbe97-8f1d-453d-aaeb-c08fc760c80f.Text: The gleam of gold has faded, the joints are covered in soot, the steel fingers are scratched and chipped as if they have been scraped repeatedly against metal or rockcrete.

8cc8397e-4496-4cbb-b230-fd27d39f80ac.Text: This unholy relic was created from the remains of Brother Skarikitus, a remorseless harbinger of the Word Bearers.

427ad472-d53e-4faa-81fb-5dcead76fe20.Text: The Ruinous Powers remember those who witnessed the death of Rykad Minoris. Woe be to any who draws the eye of the Archenemy.

85d0a3fd-bacf-4e9b-9ebc-e050b9cd7760.Text: "I will examine the prayer room immediately."

12330b4d-3d40-4183-b6da-b1b5924b0a72.Text: {n}The High Factotum bows before you in servile deference.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, allow me to steal a few minutes of your precious time! I come to you on behalf of your lowly devotees, who have bestowed upon me the honour of paying you tribute."

74f24b26-88b0-4bd9-9c0b-7eb724416ec0.Text: "Glorious tales of your majesty travel far and wide, not only across the decks of this vessel, but also throughout the protectorate. Your name instils enough fear and awe that people think twice before uttering it without reason... or they call on you in their most desperate prayers. Yes, Lord Captain, at times... your name is spoken instead of His among the commoners. Of course, there are also those who have long since honoured you as a messenger of the true gods."

a27e7776-1410-4760-af7e-ba39ce2217a9.Text: "Followers of your cult have created a relic for you — an altar that was just recently delivered to the ship. I felt compelled to ensure that no one interrupted your... work... and had it placed in a secret room within your chambers. Does Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} wish to see it?"

817dfb4e-1a00-40c4-b1ec-b880c27b4409.Text: "Stop! I did not wish for any of you to die!"

b018a076-c900-4a0d-ab78-e3d3f73814be.Text: "Kneel before the Rogue Trader! Your lives belong to me!"

8693d1f7-d6be-44b1-9266-7feceaa0c447.Text: "I am the sword's master, not its servant. Remember that."

1d9d9568-9976-4fb6-aaf4-87d55eb25294.Text: {n}As the ship makes its way through the star system, a strange fatigue falls over you. Your eyelids grow heavy, and the quill you have been using to draw up yet another order falls from your hand...{/n}

a3b905f3-4f81-45c3-9b2c-c5cc72b42dfe.Text: {n}You raise your head with a start: someone else is here, in your study! You stand up and stare at the dozens upon dozens of corpses surrounding you. Among their number, you recognise the disfigured and bloodied faces of those who died on the ship's bridge and those you met in your previous life. How is this possible? Where are the enforcers posted to stand guard? It matters not: you are alone against a horde of heretics risen from the darkness to take your life!{/n}

33844bec-bb2b-4265-ae5c-4b560df1da52.Text: {n}As if of its own accord, the shard lying on the edge of the desk, the sole remnant of Kunrad Voigtvir's weapon, slips into your hand. The metal is searing cold. The dead sway from side to side, closing in around you in a nightmarishly slow advance.{/n}

336917db-1b0e-478d-836f-5dc9ef7bbd8e.Text: {n}A foreign presence rises up out of the deepest, darkest recesses of your mind. The cut on your hand burns like acid, and an alien consciousness in your head greets the pain with a discordant wave of barely intelligible voices.{/n}

d18da16b-d0ac-4c96-b149-176a9a7804cf.Text: {n}The dead only draw closer, and closer, and... Your fingers involuntarily tighten around the shard, its sharp edge cutting into your palm.{/n}

ccd03147-7a85-44b5-8a8d-9d254b408c5b.Text: {n}All you hear in response is unintelligible voices — whispers, moans, and derisive laughter... Anger ignites your chest, and you clutch the shard, which ravenously bites into your palm with its sharp edge.{/n}

9d4d7f38-e2d2-4c5e-b424-86e9054ed9e1.Text: {n}The dead remain deaf to your words, creeping ever closer with the inevitability of death itself. You belatedly realise that your trembling hand has found the shard when its razor-sharp edge cuts into your palm...{/n}

2d9d7965-aaf0-486f-9de0-39c35e8e51e5.Text: {n}An unbearably bright light floods everything around, and you find yourself surrounded by grovelling minions, their bodies shivering in your mere presence. Your hands no longer hold a pitiful shard, but a majestic and intricate weapon — a skilfully crafted sword with strange, unnerving proportions, a curved design, and an unusual hilt adorned with the image of a closed eye.{/n}

7a9f6dbc-a6ac-40a3-b59e-f69038ad60b2.Text: {n}The eye opens wide, revealing a gaze so ancient and dark that it steals your breath away. You have felt this gaze before — there, on the bridge... and the voice that appears in your mind only confirms your guess.{/n} "The tapestry is woven. The path is chosen. Accept your fate, champion."

879e3db4-734c-41c2-8184-37d3c1cd3a32.Text: {n}You feel the sword's immense weight pulling you down. You resist its will for a moment longer before collapsing to the ground to the sound of odious laughter. The strain is such that you fear your back could break at any moment.{/n}

a9798a7d-ba74-40bf-a956-c7e59c081a3a.Text: {n}Your body refuses to obey your mind. The handle feels as if it has become one with your hands, and the gaze of the daemonic eye sets your very soul ablaze.{/n} "Resisting your fate is futile." {n}You scream as you feel your soul burn away to ash...{/n}

96867386-d5a0-4490-be8b-030ff7c69107.Text: {n}One look at the weapon in your hands makes your very soul tremble — it is a weapon fit for the greatest chosen of the gods, the judge of fates, the tyrant of millions... In the whispers flooding your ears, you hear promises of strength, power, and triumph.{/n}

e94ab85b-3d7e-4367-b55e-88a969a7d5b4.Text: {n}...you awaken from the vision kneeling next to your desk, clothes drenched in sweat and with a sour taste on your tongue. Your head is ringing, and you struggle to recall those faces and the image of the sword in your hands. Only the deep cut on your palm and the bloodied shard lying on the floor remind you of what just transpired.{/n}

e0c1939d-c738-435f-bcfe-e7d7941fb124.Text: {n}You would rather die than touch that thing again, so you reach a shaking hand for your vox and call for a servitor. Now you just have to wait for the mindless automaton to arrive, pick up the cursed artefact, and head for the nearest airlock to be claimed by the void.{/n}

6902906c-b42d-404b-ba1c-0d54b07c88aa.Text: {n}You reach your shaking hand out to the shard, now slippery with your blood. You wipe its metallic surface and stash your treasure under your clothes, next to your heart and soul forever seared by the great power of the warp.{/n}

f11fa36e-9dd1-4137-ad14-ea512361f08c.Text: "Vog, the First Dawn, is hereby woven into the tapestry of your fate. Seek the Second Dawn in the hands of she who rises above its future dominion. The former aspirant fell, and thus the new one will become the chosen of the Weaver of Destinies. Make mortals serve you as their god, and become the vessel of the Edge."

4ea2b5f1-4144-4e08-b4ba-721eff54d087.Text: [Place both sword shards upon the altar]

70135ecc-aafc-43fe-8a7e-433bdd70b52d.Text: [Pray to the gods of the warp]

2c972c6c-7dda-4d97-bd70-b85f7bd27739.Text: "Before we continue... I wish to know the story of the sword and the Edge. The whole story."

29d59322-7e23-413f-92c0-80dd0c6862ac.Text: "So the Weaver joined forces with the Drukhari who stole Rykad's sun?"

b01816d2-077a-4b30-bbc8-5ca67a1e635f.Text: "There is a third dawn? I thought there were only two."

5e9d3963-580b-4e20-893c-84c87f178c5b.Text: "I am surrounded by the servants of the corpse emperor. What should I do with them?"

59fd66a9-eb94-4dcf-8547-5bef0b4ad9ed.Text: "Enough. Let the Weaver's will be done. I shall see to it."

ef9a9a1b-3234-4ca8-8e29-04253c28de81.Text: "What will be my reward for obeying the Weaver's will?"

a663037f-5213-4545-b3dc-160a9fddcb3e.Text: "I have changed my mind. I will not serve the Weaver!"

c70f6594-5552-4bb6-bafe-733ebc3ffb1d.Text: [Place Yrliet's spirit stone upon the altar]

586420a1-1a32-4728-948d-d78393621b9c.Text: {n}Just as you place both of the shards on the altar, an irresistible force pulls your hands toward them. Blood bursts forth from your palms onto the iridescent metal... and then the shards begin to dissolve, melting like snow in the sunlight. After several agonising moments, the blood inexplicably reverses its flow and pours back into your veins through the jagged wounds.{/n}

cb300004-841f-4728-be77-db0dfa20c310.Text: {n}A blinding fever consumes you. Your forehead beads with sweat, your hands tremble, and your breath grows uneven. Something alien comes to life in your mind, and you sense it turning its dualistic attention to you.{/n}

7c342293-be4e-4741-9cd8-b4c202e2f074.Text: "Vog, the First Dawn, is woven into the tapestry of your fate. Haik, the Second Dawn, has entered the halls prepared for the coming of the Edge of Daybreak. The champion's name is praised by mortals as that of a rising god. The ordination is complete: the vessel is blessed and ready to accept the Weaver's will."

b0faea9c-95b4-4ed8-8226-be57dbeaa0dc.Text: {n}As soon as you utter the first words of prayer, you sense someone's close attention from beyond the edge of reality. Dark flames fill your soul, and inspired thoughts burgeon in your mind.{/n}

78260d76-ca53-4613-bbef-7594e1f6a1f9.Text: "Vog and Haik have been found and reunited. The Third Dawn, the last of the three, is still shrouded in darkness. Find it on a metal world in the hands of a preacher who desires to fulfil his lord's will, whom he now serves as the greatest of the four gods."

e715a195-3ed9-4a23-bac9-401109d97a42.Text: "When the pattern leads you there, it will split in two, for a pattern disrupted is wont to ripple, become manifold, and distort its colours. Accept the Edge or make it your god — which will you choose? Only a mortal who has reached the prime of enlightenment can find the answer."

efd66b4b-98d4-40c9-b3a0-719416b697de.Text: "Once the pattern is woven, you will hold the power to stop mortals from obtaining a weapon against us. Remain veiled. The blind may read your soul, but they will not dare strike until your blessing becomes apparent."

2f8fc4e5-9ee8-49be-a020-983d87272ae2.Text: "Perhaps in this world that confines you, mortal, but not in the realm of the Weaver of Destinies."

7ab747dc-d9de-48f3-a6f1-e34627840ddd.Text: {n}The voices fall silent for a brief moment.{/n} "If you find yourself alone... beseech us. Vog'Haik is hereby and forever in your blood."

54bde30c-2ff5-4f8f-8907-e6531a683ccf.Text: "Make the weak kneel before you. Subdue the strong or wait for the moment to strike them in the back. Do it alone or with your faithful allies."

43bee46e-7248-4d10-88b9-ee332cf0af85.Text: {n}You feel as if a white-hot metal ring has suddenly tightened around your head.{/n} "Is it worthy of the chosen one to ask what others can give {mf|him|her}? You take what you desire, because you have torn the veil from your eyes and now see the truth."

6ad12c96-df12-4c07-b5a8-a05acbe81ec5.Text: "The Weaver's will is your own. Remember that." {n}The voices begin to fade.{/n} "Cast off false beliefs. Find the Third Dawn. Complete... the pattern..."

baa96fc3-8e4a-473c-88e1-5ce13ab05de4.Text: "Vog'Haik is a shard of what was once whole — a weapon that was shattered and scattered across realspace by the Prince's orphans. We are but refractions of the Edge, to which Uralon the Cruel sings his hymns of hatred."

0c7a2a53-31e0-4c1f-a6da-6efd2f28587e.Text: "The aspirant vowed to return with a trophy, to procure that which elevates a mortal above others — a relic that could serve the Edge of Daybreak..." {n}Those familiar words resurface in your mind as if the voices have pulled them directly from your memory.{/n} "That fate was assured and the steps chosen. And yet... you broke the unbreakable. The aspirant was defeated, and thus gave birth to a new aspirant."

e9ec269d-5252-4f4f-86fe-07ad67d34d53.Text: "They are no longer necessary, for their essence has been absorbed by your body — a vessel to hold the great blessing, or a weapon that will crush the Edge of Daybreak. The truth is in your very blood now, and you are hereby blessed to discover the last part of the name of the Edge. When the time comes... you will gain power over it."

1fffcac2-d6d4-4bb5-ad61-8d54ea81db21.Text: {n}The voices fall quiet and then merge into one, ringing and hypnotising.{/n} "This galaxy is an ancient, forgotten battlefield, where the Prince's orphans once stood together against a mighty viceroy of the Realm of the Sorcerer, the embodiment of the Weaver's will in realspace: us. The battle ended with our defeat. We were fated to return to the Weaver's realm... but mortals changed that destiny."

5212c4ab-ae08-43ea-aa4e-c3ec1d9d9ebb.Text: "The shards of the Edge were sealed in a material object — a weapon whose creation was sung by the artisans of the Prince's orphans. The sword shackled the fragments of the Edge, depriving them of their full power and blocking the path to their return. Millennia have passed since. The sword's creators are no more and the sword itself, broken into shards, was lost to oblivion among the stars, where generations of my servants have searched for it. Until now."

97b85166-faec-451b-82db-26688c04b0eb.Text: "The shards were reclaimed, one after another. The first, Vog, was found in the vastness of the Heathen Stars. The second, Haik, was extracted from the body of a planetoid, where the corpse emperor's lackeys, crawling in the dirt, unearthed it and heeded the whispers. Vog was entrusted to our last aspirant, and the servant named Aurora accepted Haik... but you intervened. You cut the threads of the tapestry by interrupting the aspirant's mission and destroying the prophet. The sword was once destined to be reforged... but the pattern has changed, and now you will become the vessel for the Edge's power."

ca366212-401e-487e-ab05-26e78f6a2d81.Text: {n}The voices burst into screeching laughter.{/n} "The Prince's orphans follow the same paths as the corpse emperor's lackeys — paths woven by the Weaver. The Edge foretold the Final Dawn, and so it came to be, though its makers knew nothing of its design."

b4a569d7-92fe-4488-918d-e6a1d73f1f0e.Text: {n}The heavy altar looks ancient and out of place in your chambers. Faint whispers surround you as you approach.{/n}

d6aedb6e-7cda-495a-9820-547c676b0307.Text: "Mortals are always trying to save themselves from their own creations. Yet another fool thinks himself powerful enough to tame an ancient horror. Let his hopes turn to dust." {n}The voices in your head die down for a moment.{/n} "The future fluctuates and changes. Its interpretation will only tarnish the pattern. Follow the destined path, and all will be revealed in time."

90eae2c3-e502-493a-a5d0-103ba9167164.Text: {n}The voices burst into nauseating laughter.{/n} "It is too late for you to hide behind the tattered curtain of lies. Fulfil your destiny. Find the Third Dawn. Complete... the pattern..."

fe09084a-3c3b-4435-87c8-3f0baa039d14.Text: {n}You slowly start regaining clarity of mind. There is no trace of the wounds on your palms. The shards, however, have disappeared as well, which makes you wonder if they ever existed at all.{/n}

e1093a03-6d28-4fe1-a4a5-52462d7e139b.Text: {n}Faint smoke rises from the altar, twisting into intricate shapes and silhouettes...{/n}

0ab26a83-49a9-45b7-94cd-c034ae99ecf9.Text: {n}The moment the stone touches the altar, you hear an echo of a distant tormented groan — and then a wave of frenzied glee washes over you from beyond the edge of reality.{/n}

2b97f3de-b867-4200-95d5-5eb6a695f19a.Text: "I leave the ceremony to you. I will say my prayers at the altar shortly."

4e380e61-e383-43ef-83d1-08ea84075047.Text: {n}The High Factotum bows low to you.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, if I may beg for a minute of your precious attention! I am elated to notify you that a delegation of high ecclesiarchs of the Adeptus Ministorum has arrived at your vessel. The holiest of His servants have come to proclaim their veneration before the Rogue Trader, faithful to His word and fearful of His wrath."

5945b134-0543-4ac5-9a21-dd175e99bd1e.Text: "Long may the von Valancius name be praised in the annals of the Imperium! May the God-Emperor protect this dynasty from peril and adversity! Noble {name} von Valancius, word of your righteousness and diligence in serving Him has spread to the farmost corners of the Koronus Expanse. It would be folly to let a paragon such as you travel among the stars without firm spiritual support. We are here to correct this egregious oversight."

400624ba-c4e5-40a8-9b14-c5ae2193787d.Text: "From this day forth, this ship will be consecrated daily and nightly by the servants of the Ecclesiarchy, given to you for toils eternal. So that His light in these halls may never fade, the Ecclesiarchy grants you a holy relic — a banner of Saint Cognatius obtained in the conquest of the Expanse. May this gift instil trepidation and reverence in the hearts of your subjects, and the altar created to bear it become a place of prayer for your senior officers."

5297e730-ae8b-4e7d-a66e-4d916e92f1f3.Text: "Does Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} wish to witness the installation of the altar and banner? You would be the first to kneel before the relic and set the example of piety for the crew."

f2af9d90-310b-40d1-b28b-3d4513c83b5a.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!" {n}The High Factotum bows low. Every few moments, Danrok brings a perfumed cloth to his face, but his expression remains obsequious.{/n} "Members of your crew have made a request to allow them to proclaim their most profound devotion to the Lord Captain... personally. Young man!"

34337024-1648-46d6-a61a-3b6728d9f222.Text: {n}A man in a worn uniform bows awkwardly.{/n} "Your Highness, gracious Lord Captain! Please let me speak on behalf of the whole crew... and everyone... and express our gratitude to you, uh, officially, so to speak! The kind of leader you are, the way you treat people, it's now known in every corner of the Expanse, from Footfall to the poorest, dirtiest, most unremarkable planet. All praise your dedication to the human spirit and good will!"

8e2592bf-a96b-4c73-b9ab-0bf1a9979744.Text: "Everyone wants to serve under your command, there's no end to the volunteers! So the other day, when we were clearing out an abandoned sector for new living quarters, we found a forgotten vault. Right in the bilge of the ship, literally beneath our feet! Well, it turned out the vault had some centuries-old weapons in it — they look a bit odd, but they're powerful for sure! The good Tech-Priests helped with the assembly and consecration of the weapons — and now you can strike down your enemies with even greater might!"

79fd2dcf-3623-4d57-93c6-18a74a78144a.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, apart from the weapons, the crew has sent one more find to the bridge as a token of its eternal gratitude — a most ancient mechanism, which our Tech-Priests have dubbed the Celestium Observatorum. Alas, its machine spirit refuses to heed their rites, which makes the device more symbolic and aesthetic than practical in purpose. Do you wish to see it?"

ff97b7c0-455c-4208-94ba-eb03887d4e5d.Text: "Lord Captain? We have visitors on the bridge seeking an audience. Your presence is required."

f40a81e7-a89a-43b6-a8e7-09eb4c5d8f60.Text:
The parchment, bearing Astropath Zacchary Weisz's flowing handwriting, reads as follows:
"Vision: a cathedral with a golden facade of the Emperor In Triumph Over The Enemies Of Mankind. Twilight. The golden light of a star (the Astronomican?) shines through a stained-glass window in the vault. Like a statue of old, a woman clad in ancient armour with a sword stands in the light. A salute follows (a feeling — greeting an equal). A message follows:
'To the righteous {name}, the rising star of House von Valancius. May all your ships stay on course in the golden light of the Astronomican. I, Incendia Bastaal-Chorda, head of House Chorda, send you greetings and wishes for prosperity. You took your position at a dark hour. Trade routes and paths are the circulatory system of the Expanse, but the warp is shaking its foundations, interrupting that life-giving flow where it matters most. Disaster has also struck Footfall Station, which can no longer be reached by vessels carrying provisions. House Chorda is ready to solve this problem. [Note — the emphasis is on the last phrase, this is a declaration of intent — Z. W.] Be careful. The Rogue Traders of the Expanse live by a strict code of honour. Those who follow it thrive. Emperor judge the rest!'"

da11fdbb-3837-4673-aa92-f93ad923b611.Text:
The parchment, bearing Astropath Zacchary Weisz's flowing handwriting, reads as follows:
"Vision: darkness. A cacophony of sounds, as if heard in fragments. In the centre, an image of Liege Tocara. Twisted hands reach toward him from the darkness. A feeling — chaos, loss (the echoes of emotions from the Astropathic Choir). The Liege himself is calm (portrays calmness). Words follow:
'Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, Footfall humbly reminds you of its plight and waits for good news from you and supplies from the planet Janus.'
The rest is illegible. A lot of outside noise. Presumably from a disturbance in the warp or exhaustion of the Footfall Astropathic Choir. Z. W."

9496aec4-53b8-4770-8aeb-e76f8d8fce8b.Text:
The parchment, bearing Astropath Zacchary Weisz's flowing handwriting, reads as follows:
"Vision: darkness. A cacophony of sounds. In the centre, an image of Liege Tocara. Twisted hands reach toward him from the darkness. A feeling — disarray, loss (presumably echoes of emotions from the Astropathic Choir). The Liege himself is calm. Words follow:
'Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I hope you are in good health. I humbly remind you that Footfall is waiting for food supplies from your agri-world Janus. To this day, we have not seen a vessel from there and continue to subsist on disappearing stocks. Vladaym Tocara, Liege of Footfall.'
Note: The Astropathic Choir of Footfall is in poor condition. Deciphering their transmissions takes twice the normal time. Afterward, I was forced off duty for one watch due to headaches. Z. W."

ee3268ad-0cbc-4279-9f03-0b5947d792f1.Text:
The parchment, bearing Astropath Zacchary Weisz's flowing handwriting, reads as follows:
"Vision: dusk, dreary sounds of undetermined origin. In the centre, an image of Liege Tocara. The Liege is smiling (sincerely, I suppose — Z. W.). Words follow:
'Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, food supplies from Janus have arrived on Footfall! I humbly thank you on behalf of the entire station to which you have delivered aid in a difficult time. I will be glad to welcome you again!'"

18651827-2acb-4576-aa58-67ae2b362972.Text:
The parchment, bearing Astropath Zacchary Weisz's flowing handwriting, reads as follows:
"Vision: the bridge of a voidship in space, gigantic windows, bloody glow. Soundscape — echoes of battle (presumably the glow and the battle are imprints of the emotional state of the sender — Z. W.). A figure: a giant towering over the bridge. Words follow:
'My comrade, {mf|Lord|Lady} {name} von Valancius! I am Calligos Winterscale. Business delayed me and my fleet on the way to Footfall [I feel this phrase is a formality concealing a bitter/unfavourable truth — Z. W.], but I hope that you will succeed in saving the station from famine. I cannot do so myself. Footfall is necessary for every Rogue Trader in the region. Deliver it from starvation, and you may count on the gratitude of House Winterscale.'
Note: I am very familiar with the signature of the Winterscale Astropath. I mark his great tiredness and lack of focus at the moment of transmission. A prolonged struggle with warp disturbances is a likely cause."

7d6db70e-04d9-4bfb-9b9d-ae22e9cab876.Text:
The parchment, bearing Astropath Zacchary Weisz's flowing handwriting, reads as follows:
"Vision: the bridge of a voidship in space, gigantic windows, bloody glow. Soundscape — echoes of battle (presumably the glow and the battle are imprints of the emotional state of the sender — Z. W.). A figure: a giant towering over the bridge. The words transmitted are:
'My comrade, {mf|Lord|Lady} {name} von Valancius! I welcome you among Rogue Traders and I am sorry for your loss. I am Calligos Winterscale. Business delayed me and my fleet on the way to Footfall (I feel this phrase is a formality concealing a bitter/unfavourable truth — Z. W.), but I am pleased that you have saved the station from hunger and salute your success and resourcefulness. I await our meeting in person, when matters permit. Safe journeys!'
Note: I am very familiar with the signature of the Winterscale Astropath. I mark his great tiredness and lack of focus at the moment of transmission. A prolonged battle with warp disturbances is likely the cause."

c4fafc52-3d48-43c5-95a6-8e95fd035372.Text: "Your... {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Do not tell them... who I am. It's for... the best."

bc948fef-3008-47bd-ab06-45b321d37cd9.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I thank you for the timely rescue from Commorragh! Commissar Iako Sotniy reporting for duty. You wouldn't divulge our little secret to anyone, would you?

eb56d47e-e3c8-4276-9329-74964a949e57.Text: "Stained glass windows, a throne, servants... Compared to the Pit, you have a veritable palace! However, I confess I almost miss the simple but cosy squalor. Almost."

518cd1fe-c40f-4b3f-9f9d-df965b54d493.Text: The Commissar clicks his heels together and makes the symbol of the Aquila on his chest, looking like he just stepped out of a Hero of the Imperium poster. He gives you a sly wink.

a3ece6b6-4064-455d-a4eb-712eafaca3aa.Text: "Navigator Cassini at your service, Lord Captain."

7ca6b67a-38dd-4bd8-82fb-6eeed97dc688.Text: "The crew members shun me, and that is to be expected. The appearance of members of the Navis Nobilite instils terror in the hearts of common people."

a22ddf96-5fd6-47c8-b1a3-7ba3ed14f52c.Text: "Even here on the bridge, I can feel the echoes of the warp... This ship has crossed the veil of the Immaterium so many times that its bulkheads are steeped in its energies."

f6ccfdc1-e080-4737-9710-b107f188b5b0.Text: "I swear to you, Honourable One, my boys can get anything you need from the warp! We just need to turn off the Geller field for a moment during the next flight!"

206d7a15-2d99-4ef9-b11c-b40ff5931b47.Text: "You are called the Lord of Captains — this is something like Lord of Change, yes? I can't wait to take part in your machinations, Honourable One."

4f9266d0-ebb6-4aa2-9d00-313a3d068a16.Text: "That huge painted tank in the corner of the room, it's for drowning enemies, yes? Not bad, but R'Yzza prefers throwing them out of an airlock: it's much funnier to watch them flap around!"

704f7d5c-e37f-4b84-aa1d-4a1b816481c8.Text: Impertinently scampering about the cabin, the daemon giggles and gossips with unseen companions. Some of its mannerisms and turns of phrase distinctly remind you of a certain old pirate from Footfall.

ed8a2ab9-b961-4d25-b504-38997133c7ff.Text: "A worthy mansion, R'Yzza approves! And where will you live?"

9846170d-b4c8-4ba6-877f-e230d9d061f7.Text: "Hm, you seem vaguely familiar... Ah, no matter! Rejoice, Honourable One, for before you is R'Yzza, Herald of Easy Money!"

36a8a330-94c8-43e2-809b-54729b3cd94d.Text: Cracks spread through the spirit stone before it bursts into pieces. Shadows in the form of claws and tentacles envelop the escaping essence and devour it forever. You feel the writhing blessing of She Who Thirsts slithering into your soul.

4c908247-0eb2-42eb-865e-591323fc7b4a.Text: Sergeant Vigastes's face appears flushed, and his wounds clearly burden him less now. It seems he refused to part with his battered lasgun.

5492bffd-478b-42fe-9888-66c1158b588b.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I am glad to see you in good health! I still can't believe we made it out of Commorragh. I am in your debt."

32fdd0a1-266d-43c5-b00f-ff31231b3df5.Text: "Your helmsman, Ravor, showed me around the decks in his spare time. A wonderful voidship you have — the Watchman of the Abyss couldn't hold a candle to it. I still miss that old rig though..."

159e1460-b121-4a76-b5c0-be975216a774.Text: "I am certain that we could come to an agreement regarding a... more elegant use of my talents, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

cb210acf-b5b2-4580-83fd-36ec3af3bf8b.Text: "After every warp flight, a bloodstain appears in the same place on the deck. In general, I can't complain. Such is the lot of a loyal servant of the Emperor — to tirelessly destroy filth. Is it not so?"

9f5c885c-b1d0-410a-9ec5-4e139dba4102.Text: "I'd like to think that cleaning up the deck is better than dealing with the mess on Footfall... That said, your servants always find new ways to surprise me with their untidiness."

56c665f3-be72-43c6-8611-02fd0b668f52.Text: The servitor's mindless oculars remind you of the dark glasses Vladaym concealed his emotions behind. He has nothing to hide now.

28d8e070-8422-474e-b6d7-9fe334d746de.Text: "Use the system map in the centre of the bridge to issue orders to the crew."

7cd8fc33-43cc-4f44-bf6b-676f1dec8954.Text: A mysterious object steeped in warp corruption.

e0349ec9-fbca-4621-a29f-510b06476bee.Text: The code for the duty officer, retrieved from the cogitator aboard the old shipwreck.

277c780f-5526-4f67-b9c3-fd4f4bb92290.Text:
"1. The holy book by the altar.
2. That void-damn customs guy (he is always on duty! Does he get any time off? Does he ever leave for a piss? Is he a servitor or something?)
3. Guess-What
4. Hangar by the window. Remember to bow to the Emperor through the window!"

6126c826-9a06-4a83-a968-741c3001d57c.Text: "There's barely enough fuel for a shift. We should steal a couple of cases of Octaviana's signature brew — that'll do the job."

8833aa85-a963-43e3-a613-8282b2695e94.Text: "I love this job. It's not like I'm breaking my back in a manufactorum..."

9b5f7bfa-f759-4c09-a64a-4d42613f462a.Text: "You'd better be careful around these parts. You never know when some foul stuff's going to come bursting out of a pipe — it happens more often than you'd think."

9f08681e-59b5-4669-b1fa-301504875a76.Text: "Boss, the Hustler's lads, the ones who call themselves Anvers only for show, went to shake down traders in the Atrium. How long are we going to put up with this? Common muggers are using our name, and there are more of them every day. They haven't even read the Man's words, I'm sure of it! Boss, I know their route — what do you say we get rid of our 'cousins' once and for all?"

49c3e122-bf6a-44d5-b5be-cf9ab97bb6f6.Text: Anvers' Note From the Shadow Quarters

e1e352e9-f58c-4733-97f1-49bd64f55b0b.Text: Human eyes and tongue submerged in an alcoholic preservative.

6e9753af-0812-4353-ac44-8a496b4c3661.Text: The sounds of fierce fighting reach your ears.

877ee0df-3624-4da0-97ac-7c313bf716a4.Text: The message on the screen signals that the first block has been removed from the elevator.

d3f3d959-a07d-4c87-b2d6-3e1eb0395e41.Text: You do not have the access codes to this room.

63516dc4-f4b1-4c10-b3f9-df47b96390a7.Text: The system accepts the access codes. The clanging of moving bolts indicates that the door has been unlocked.

17b050cb-4b78-44a9-acaf-920ce74981ad.Text: The control panel does not react to your touch — the system is locked.

e5fe0c19-df91-4b26-9f4a-1bb128eed839.Text: The cyberguard is asking for access codes you do not have.

bc6b4d03-deff-4979-a717-34b17e154307.Text: The cyberguard accepts the access codes and sets mysterious mechanisms in motion.

35953018-b563-4e00-8992-c461fcf040a2.Text: Explosive device suitable for eliminating flimsy obstacles.

b0b31717-0cc9-4c27-9594-d2ff04c287dc.Text: Universal lockpicking tool. Provides an additional opportunity to open a lock. An expendable item.

f4547114-2d43-48f8-bdae-2237f7cc2909.Text: A set of sacred oils and cogitograms that can appease the keeper of any technology. Provides an additional opportunity to call out a machine spirit and interact with a device. An expendable item.

ab752104-7411-4383-955f-7c570aaeeec6.Text: "Not now, Domin'{name}. I must first clear my mind."

8d2a6b3d-9fef-44f6-a96a-a3a50274852f.Text: The ancient anti-aircraft battery has been destroyed. It is best to inform Governor Medineh about this and discuss the departure to the monastery.

a8d6b2d0-a1e5-4bb8-acea-742181396573.Text: Abel Haneumann has shared the prayer-password that will open the way to the priests' hiding place.

2712a190-7622-48ec-8a1b-cddcd13b5f07.Text: Interrogator van Calox thinks the priests are hiding somewhere near the circular cogitator.

6fd3a5f3-d244-4731-80cf-82c131239877.Text: The Lord Captain knows that the entrance to the priests' hiding place is located near the circular cogitator and can be opened by a special prayer.

d6e23b0f-ff3a-4785-9d1d-8a7d1ed9ce2f.Text: Order the distribution servitor to raise the output to peak values

ef30c951-e4d7-4bc0-a5de-e7f7b27f0c1c.Text: Utter the Litany of Actuation from the command throne

8014a1cc-3ab5-462f-bcb9-7c0ecb8a5e65.Text: Destroy the safety system control altar

1d353626-6ab7-434e-ae0a-9b795c47b1e6.Text: Aurora, the leader of the Cult of the Final Dawn on Rykad Minoris, has been slain, and the monastery of the Adeptus Mechanicus is now safe.

2f544b60-7b62-4d6a-a9df-189b431970cd.Text: Interrogator van Calox headed to the monastery of the Adeptus Mechanicus that guards the sacred archeotech reactor. According to Governor Medineh, rebel forces have been spotted in the vicinity. The Rogue Trader needs to head to the region to assess the situation and locate the agent of the Inquisition.

eebf0709-4f17-4197-a5cf-8f2d3e113d2b.Text: An ancient anti-aircraft battery is located on the road leading from the starport to the governor's command centre. While it remains under the control of the rebels, shuttle flights over the capital are too dangerous to countenance.

eb0897d2-5f72-4f7f-b44b-07bb70a5665b.Text: Destroy the anti-aircraft battery preventing the shuttles from flying

077c3e37-b403-46b5-910b-fb966ae706ac.Text: The monastery of the Adeptus Mechanicus is situated in remote territories gifted to the Priesthood of Mars, away from the hives of Rykad Minoris. Due to the scale of the planetary rebellion, descending from orbit is considered the optimal way to reach the monastery.

3cf671c2-8850-4bdb-bc14-180c2eac9949.Text: The Adeptus Mechanicus monastery's defences have been breached: immediate intervention by the Rogue Trader is required. According to the acquired data, a sacred reactor is hidden in the depths of the temple complex captured by the rebels. Only protecting the relic's control panels from the heretics will ensure its safety.

353e490d-4894-4eb0-8278-6bfa2c14cab0.Text: The group of heretics guarding the captured Tech-Priest must be eliminated to rescue him.

a2296786-8f61-41aa-8a43-2667c668526d.Text: According to Magos Haneumann, an act of technological sabotage is the optimal way to destroy the large group of heretics and rescue the captured Tech-Priest.

7ff6f445-ba3a-4bcf-9955-9a18c48d083b.Text: The Tech-Priest rescued by the Lord Captain may have useful information on how to keep the archeotech reactor safe.

436bf19e-4152-4a44-8e33-7183737c16a3.Text: The leader of the Cult of the Final Dawn on Rykad Minoris, known as Aurora, has decided to personally perform the reactor desecration ritual. She must be destroyed.

b86e2e28-89a6-4f4c-9a34-6a5a7c449d2b.Text: A guarded shuttle is ready to transport the Lord Captain to the voidship.

50aab16c-8a75-44d6-9b89-e4e9460b4674.Text: News of Aurora's downfall and the successful liberation of the monastery of the Adeptus Mechanicus signify the end of the major unrest on Rykad Minoris.

70de0813-7767-4ef4-9230-900fe434feef.Text: The Interrogator must have visited Rykad Minoris. Perhaps the planetary governor knows of his present whereabouts or planned course of action.

0fd32bc8-4a57-4070-8447-d642fe7a9d29.Text: The Navigators' abode could have been a plausible destination for an Interrogator of the Ordo Xenos. The station's residents may tell the Rogue Trader if they are playing host to such a guest.

8f8c1de2-ee45-4833-affc-4d3b67084d66.Text: Make contact with the Navis Nobilite station

5d64137a-bd68-4bf9-b171-20f92879854a.Text: The prison planetoid in the Rykad System may have caught the Interrogator's attention.

45055676-c5bc-4a19-a24f-d8ff28649546.Text: Visit Rykadi Philia, the prison planetoid

d41baf7f-9827-4177-b085-ab9fb00ec540.Text: Governor Medineh told the Rogue Trader that the Interrogator headed to the Hallowed Electrodynamic Cenobium. It is there that this agent of the Golden Throne is most likely to be found.

41a2c093-b02d-4e94-8d79-6efaaeffe223.Text: Investigate the Adeptus Mechanicus monastery on Rykad Minoris

0ed13fc4-1106-48af-912b-1b95e9a252cf.Text: The search for the Interrogator on the Navis Nobilite station failed to yield any results

0fe1f0b3-ff8a-4039-9d11-399e31f20db0.Text: After their encounter in the Electrodynamic Cenobium, Heinrix van Calox allied himself with the Rogue Trader and {mf|his|her} retinue.

623a665b-0152-410f-9abd-59f3132fdbf6.Text: A matter of the utmost importance led the Interrogator of the Inquisition, Heinrix van Calox, to the Rykad System. The Rogue Trader's duty as a loyal servant of the Imperium is to find the Interrogator and aid him in his mission. Since his whereabouts are currently unknown, it may be easier said than done.

dd8dfe1f-63f4-44fa-b958-c7a512bf8327.Text: The Rogue Trader needs to recruit a new Navigator, but the Navis Nobilite heralds are not responding, and something strange is happening on their void station. It appears outside intervention is required.

9a2dca68-da0c-4a40-aefb-7c320bad7fd3.Text: Explore the station to find answers

27440639-3f8b-4ba4-bad6-af5cde2ebe25.Text: The Keeper of the Station spoke of a rebellion and madmen who captured his mistress. Lady Cassia is being held in the upper chambers against her will, but a malfunctioning elevator prevents anyone from entering.

a0cc60e6-5425-4e16-8526-9b24f667e77d.Text: The Rogue Trader has recreated the control rod and restored power to the elevator. It is time to return to the Keeper of the Station and ascend to the lady's chambers.

be9772c4-7e5d-4353-924a-7eb81e5cb11c.Text: It turns out that Lady Cassia is no damsel in distress but a vicious monster who has been terrorising House Orsellio for years. She is capable of driving a Navigator insane and killing them with a single glance. The Keeper has asked the Rogue Trader to grant him one last request: to ascend to the upper chambers, weaken the beast with a glowing charm, and bring her back to Felek for judgement.

1c34eccc-144a-4a5f-b3bc-b845a751ec1b.Text: The rebels have acquired mysterious weapons imbued with the powers of Navigators. The Keeper of the Station will immediately perish if he tries to fight them. Felek has asked the Rogue Trader to grant him one last request: to ascend to the mistress's chambers, give her the charm, and bring the traitors to justice. After that, Lady Cassia must be returned to her people on the lower level.

fc980f3c-9b67-4dd5-a1c6-db621d2523c7.Text: The only surviving Navigators on the station can be found in the upper chambers. It is necessary to restore the power to the lift and use a control rod to reach them.

fc73d52d-ee9a-4875-9606-ffa0b47a7350.Text: Felek Orsellio, Navigator and Keeper of the Station, is dead. Hope remains that there are some other warp guides left on Eurac V who are ready to join the Rogue Trader.

894fc8d2-0d3d-435f-b6e0-ea349e7fc22a.Text: Felek Orsellio, Navigator and Keeper of the Station, is dead. Hope remains that there are some other warp guides left on Eurac V who are ready to join the Rogue Trader.

31640b6c-fd77-46f9-a934-abccc3e39064.Text: Felek Orsellio, Navigator and one of the Keepers of the Station, turned out to be a traitor and the source of all the trouble on Eurac V. It is time to punish the traitor for his wickedness.

dda69e36-b93f-450c-862d-7ec166d24bdd.Text: Felek Orsellio, Navigator and one of the Keepers of the Station, turned out to be a traitor and the source of all the trouble on Eurac V. It is time to punish the traitor for his lies and wickedness.

987bbcf5-0df1-40e9-a3a8-0b33011bd57d.Text: Lady Cassia is the only surviving Navigator on the station. She must be immediately brought aboard the Rogue Trader's voidship, provided with the necessary medical aid, and prepared for the communion ritual.

4ca785cc-d907-4e77-9699-11d8cb53ca72.Text: Lady Cassia is the only surviving Navigator on the station. She must be immediately brought aboard the Rogue Trader's voidship, provided with the necessary medical aid, and prepared for the communion ritual.

d8514ded-ba77-488f-b78e-534b44cac07a.Text: Felek Orsellio has died at the hand of the Rogue Trader. Only speaking with Lady Cassia in the upper chambers will show if he was telling the truth about his mistress.

f0b4d163-f459-484a-8376-7d09f96a1c16.Text: Talk to the mistress of the station

36cacd0f-72bc-4e24-b190-d07111449c21.Text: The power to the elevator must be restored using the cogitator in the guard room.

bf03c43d-d278-4949-b796-12939ff745ec.Text: The elevator control rod can be rebuilt in the laboratory using blood and a sacred mechanism.

0acc6287-db5c-48c3-a429-a6318a5d0a93.Text: Every station is required to store details about its inhabitants. It may contain information on the Navigators' whereabouts.

e1e15a64-2c4c-4138-91d1-153bfb2d29a8.Text: Power has been restored to the elevator, and the Rogue Trader has both parts of the control rod. It is time to start the lift and ascend to the upper chambers.

64619031-d9bd-42b4-b368-e296fc0eb33d.Text: The power to the elevator can be restored using the cogitator in the guard room.

e798d6cf-24fb-4ed2-8129-4a03b9eb6029.Text: The elevator can be activated with two parts of the control rod. According to the local cogitator, it can be rebuilt in the laboratory.

5540cc7f-fead-4d93-b25f-e6324771f787.Text: The Navis Nobilite station is not responding to any signals, but the augur arrays have detected biological signatures in the main chamber. The Rogue Trader's only option is to perform an emergency docking and personally investigate.

20925333-94ed-4626-9adc-65a7d02641c3.Text: Young Evayne Winterscale, son of another mighty Rogue Trader, is somewhere on the planetoid. Finding him would be a good political move for the Lord Captain.

b1935ea2-39d6-4ad2-99f2-ad46374c55de.Text: The only way to stop the rebellion and uncover the truth about the planetoid is to find the warden who instigated the chain of sinister events.

f1c8ab5a-9ec5-4f19-b329-ba3c4e67b226.Text: The Lord Captain has put an end to this horrible chapter of Rykadi Philia's history.

32458e66-6ad7-40e9-ac17-d284792e8786.Text: Rykadi Philia, the prison planetoid, is corrupted by heresy. Despite his noble lineage, its warden has succumbed to heresy and rebelled. Is this place hiding any other sinister secrets?

d2498bc4-5bd8-4ee3-be68-ad3f707bfeb5.Text: Contact with the Lord Captain's voidship has been lost. The only way off the planet lies through the starport, which still has intact shuttles.

4161cc8f-497e-4030-8d29-44dd480cbbe1.Text: The starport has been overrun by heretics and refugees, making it hard to find an intact shuttle. Still, it is the most viable way of leaving the planet.

29d337a2-0ecc-45fa-a5ba-79df606b3db1.Text: A mysterious leader of the Cult of the Final Dawn, the second person to bear the name of Aurora, intends to destroy all the shuttles so no one can leave Rykad Minoris. Every shuttle destroyed by him equals hundreds of people unable to escape the planet slowly being devoured by the Ruinous Powers.

c83b591e-5118-412a-86be-2901cb043195.Text: The heretic has been purged. Now the Lord Captain can leave Rykad Minoris on the remaining shuttle. The recommended course of action is to grasp this opportunity without delay.

05a500e9-8bd8-41d4-8cb8-82ed91895e05.Text: All the shuttles have been destroyed: the probability of the Lord Captain's extraction is zero. The recommended course of action is to reload all available weaponry and prepare to make a last stand against the overwhelming enemy forces.

78e4e9fc-63d8-4f55-9965-e9e932b47c12.Text: The evacuation of the Lord Captain and {mf|his|her} retinue from Rykad Minoris has been successful.

601719c6-dbb3-4a19-89df-3668a19dd5be.Text: Rykad Minoris is falling to the relentless assault of the Archenemy's forces. Despite the Lord Captain's best efforts, the heretical prophecy of the Final Dawn has come to pass. Those who do not want to be devoured by the Ruinous Powers must flee the planet.

cf8b7d15-1d98-457b-b87a-d24aba7cf07a.Text: The rebels' air barrages control the skies over the capital. The only available route to the city streets lies through the war-torn starport.

d0e50541-8e8c-49e3-8f58-77dd09572d92.Text: The rebels talk in raptures about Aurora, the mysterious leader of the rebellion.

fdd4fe65-98c5-4bc1-bb56-00477eef2008.Text: Blind madmen aimlessly roam among the ruined streets.

75da3723-254a-4a97-893f-f28d291dc64d.Text: Heretics believe in the "Final Dawn" — a strange event that will soon bring doom to this world.

ae073c63-17cd-447a-a957-670eb0fe1118.Text: The rebels captured a vox-station, which they used to eavesdrop on the planetary defence forces' communications.

8638e7b9-560f-4f75-ba59-95097057bfed.Text: The rebels have performed blasphemous sorcery and blinded one of the heretics with an enormous lens.

48fa54d0-0e0f-4f60-bd93-249fab242aef.Text: If the ancient anti-aircraft battery captured by the rebels were to be destroyed, the Lord Captain would be able to reach the command centre on a shuttle, bypassing the dangers lying in wait on the city streets.

0e485cf0-9ff7-4a0c-8a2b-582c621ce256.Text: A convoy of soldiers was sent to meet the Lord Captain and escort the honoured guest to the governor's command centre.

4c4e3344-1d31-44b7-8206-f7aaa66a6b61.Text: The governor of Rykad Minoris is commanding the planetary forces from a fortified bunker. To reach it, the Rogue Trader will have to traverse the Upperway, which is controlled by the rebels.

23d97d75-67f0-41a8-9252-f9b7bbfc9521.Text: The flames of rebellion have engulfed the streets of Rykad Minoris, making traversing them a dangerous endeavour. The Lord Captain must push through the war-torn city to learn what other wicked events are unfolding among the shadows of the burning capital.

cc72bc12-de12-436a-ab64-2f8854a96d97.Text: Find out what is going on

6e21eb40-ab9a-4129-8522-c213f3d4796a.Text: After meeting the governor, the Lord Captain will be able to recruit new people to the crew, replenish supplies, and learn more about the events unfolding on Rykad Minoris.

56083541-369a-45ad-9b3f-ebf84c71137d.Text: The Lord Captain managed to push through the chaos of the street fighting and meet the governor of Rykad Minoris.

73f18b96-132c-4b81-88a5-caab075797d6.Text: Rykad Minoris welcomed the Lord Captain not with fanfare and a grand parade, but with explosions and the sounds of battle. Still, this changes nothing — the Rogue Trader still needs to find this world's governor and request the necessary supplies and crew for {mf|his|her} voidship.

d7cd3d2d-4943-47fb-9017-9b4b2665066e.Text: The street leading from the command centre to the starport is ready to celebrate the Lord Captain's triumph.

86f60f56-9af9-41ab-855d-bda66548cdce.Text: The governor's representative will describe the ceremony in detail.

03127d5f-5971-4174-b908-686acd612f50.Text: Talk to the master of ceremonies

d1509bd6-dd9a-4960-9369-7eb6cff76619.Text: The Lord Captain's grand entrance on the vehicle prepared for {mf|him|her} by the master of ceremonies will signify the start of the celebration.

1f54a79a-61e9-45e4-8317-316b3046757a.Text: The von Valancius flagship is not yet prepared to depart from the system. Once all matters have been taken care of, the governor of Rykad Minoris will see the Rogue Trader to begin the ceremony.

202e086f-83e0-4aed-96e9-481a91ca1a72.Text: Deal with unfinished business before the triumph

aadd158e-1d18-4848-b4ce-2d0ca7c230c5.Text: The world of Rykad Minoris and its governor want to honour the Lord Captain with an ancient ceremony — the Triumph.

e5dca7c5-c115-4169-9779-61f2c0af2f4b.Text: The dataset on the planets studied by the Lord Captain was gratefully accepted by Opticon-22. The von Valancius dynasty's links with the Adeptus Mechanicus have been strengthened.

2eb8a23b-bae1-46e1-bda5-7b8fdd3c8694.Text: The representative of the Explorator Cognisance Fleet, Opticon-22, is willing to pay for information on planets studied by the Rogue Trader.

2b0e23b1-b24f-4f04-862e-665e820927bc.Text: Ten planets' worth of scanning data from the ship's augurs is a worthy start to the Rogue Trader's working relationship with Opticon-22.

9b06df88-33a1-42bf-8c86-246cfe636dae.Text: The collected reconnaissance data must be delivered to the Adeptus Mechanicus representative based on Footfall.

6a4d1d43-a84f-474f-89b4-52dcb08a658f.Text: Give the planetary data to Opticon-22

2ad80eec-0eb0-45f6-b824-60d424096e1a.Text: According to Achilleas Scalander, the xenos raids may have struck the penal world of Vheabos VI. This report requires further investigation.

c358827a-6ec4-46d5-8fe1-aa4390dca4a6.Text: Forge a path to Vheabos VI

7a1ce129-c087-4cc9-b6da-1a719faf9297.Text: Preliminary scanning revealed a catastrophic change in the planet's atmosphere and devastation of infrastructure on its surface, and it also detected the presence of enemy vessels. Reconnaissance must be carried out immediately to ascertain the situation on Vheabos VI.

468953ea-917c-40fd-89c0-776a6b0f07bd.Text: Find out what is happening on Vheabos VI

c18d935f-e145-4d49-a783-0b0120ec95eb.Text: A xenos by the name of Tazarra acting on behalf of Archon Yremeryss has created an arena on a penal world to entertain her kin. The enemies of the Imperium must be destroyed, including the traitors from the hordes of Humanity.

eb9d7f3a-ed5d-48f1-be80-0a7f1f1c53b7.Text: Destroy the xenos and their minions

857d09b8-7f23-403d-90df-f32b8d50aee2.Text: Vheabos VI has been purged of xenos, but the raid leaders evaded capture. Information about the pillaging of Vheabos VI has already been sent by the Astropathic Choir to Dargonus. A response may take some time to arrive, and it would be unwise to spend it waiting on the poisoned penal world.

1b166144-4aca-49b5-84a6-60c9622405c8.Text: Wait for a response from Dargonus

37886ef9-2a22-4613-a36d-2ce3db9928b6.Text: Achilleas Scalander has directed his spy network to discover the xenos' future plans and hunt down the leaders who were detected on Vheabos VI. Before any new information is found, attacks on the colonies and trading vessels must be stopped to avoid any further damage to the von Valancius protectorate.

687c31c4-7e71-41d7-9cda-c29cac5ab541.Text: Stop the xenos raids on your holdings

f3f556c7-82a5-40ac-a81f-281c4c1d6517.Text: Achilleas has reported an attack on a world belonging to the Winterscale dynasty. Heading the raid is apparently one of the xenos leaders who has been harrying von Valancius holdings. This is an opportunity to strike a blow against an enemy and learn more about a rival.

ecdf9619-dc62-43f0-9124-b9c1a10b8595.Text: Answer the call for help from Grantis

635a611b-f126-4e05-b77f-da702a57c88e.Text: The xenos Marazhai dares to give the Rogue Trader an ultimatum — fight a final battle in the Cinerus Maleficum nebula or continue fending off raids. It would be unwise to agree to terms set by enemies of Humanity, but it is permissible if it will mean an end to constant attacks.

e8941bbf-52ea-4b66-87f1-8c844980ede7.Text: Probable location: Lapidus Mortus, Last Chance of Cyrene, Litoribum Maledicta

0a4df58b-a3ed-4f2e-9c61-8946fe9633d9.Text: Explore the systems of the Cinerus Maleficum nebula

bbd60175-20c6-4902-ac5f-c1a4beaf7e57.Text: A mysterious cosmic artefact has been discovered while exploring the Cinerus Maleficum nebula. The object should be studied further, taking all necessary precautions.

9042de47-ef79-4c61-969e-41ea6d4f1ccd.Text: The xenos were planning to destroy the key nodes in the maintenance bay with a targeted explosion. The explosive device needs to be disarmed immediately.

4a0fd105-1c2b-4c19-977c-3f0f80bbe3b2.Text: Plasma Drive Chambers, von Valancius Voidship

0c81abff-cec1-4488-807c-af9c0ae2b7c4.Text: Conniving xenos have boarded the Rogue Trader's voidship. The enemies of Humanity must be destroyed immediately.

46a97f14-c6e5-4816-813e-a1c282c56b20.Text: Plasma Drive Chambers, von Valancius Voidship

63d8f3c2-af5e-465e-8409-dc391cc7b5b4.Text: According to the Vox Master, the xenos were trying to reach this very room. It would be worth exploring the area in detail to determine the reason for their actions.

1c95118f-3bd4-40d8-b4bc-6214b2db39db.Text: Plasma Drive Chambers, von Valancius Voidship

fc17af88-9f4c-4b6a-821e-9cac0097ed3a.Text: The rendezvous point set by the xenos turned out to be a trap. The Rogue Trader must return to Dargonus immediately to regroup and clarify the situation.

9f3a9305-d0e7-48ba-aa80-8cf1deddde48.Text: von Valancius Palace, Dargonus, Mundus Valancius

ff495c7a-ccb9-43fa-aef5-0faded5f1148.Text: In the Rogue Trader's absence, the xenos struck a blow at the very heart of the protectorate and captured the dynastic palace. Lead the counter-attack and destroy the invaders.

82230e98-71d7-4b18-aa5b-afd0602078f0.Text: There could still be surviving vassals or nobles on the dynasty's estate. It would be wise to search the rooms and examine bodies for signs of life.

be7cc434-8ff1-4fde-a67c-175cc418eedb.Text: The Vox Master is ready to report the results of the defence of Dargonus.

4d7455ff-b32b-4a15-8d92-eb524186c3b1.Text: There is a saboteur among the xenos who is determined to do considerable damage to sacred technologies. The saboteur must be stopped before they can put their plan into action.

c0608e7a-cd44-4c80-bf51-9bbf1a20677c.Text: The attack on Dargonus by vengeful xenos was repelled thanks to the joint efforts of the Lord Captain and {mf|his|her} subjects. The capital world will need time to rebuild, but the death of one of the leaders of the raids and the flight of another should spell at least a temporary reprieve.

e97aa6f1-1c50-4b49-945a-939a4ba4e190.Text: The worlds of the von Valancius protectorate are being terrorised by enemies of Humanity — xenos carrying out rapid strikes on colonies and trading vessels. The Rogue Trader must prevent any further plundering of the dynasty's holdings and launch a counter-attack.

cda270ee-6147-41de-b77e-f7e6ee323e66.Text: Talk to Rogue Traders Winterscale and Chorda

1d16b272-e015-415b-960b-5dc5777f4c66.Text: Order the master of ceremonies to end the reception
