7b2ce55a-3d14-4dc8-b226-d519842c8c8d.Text: The Koronus Expanse has learned the name of Theodora von Valancius's heir. Henceforth, any acts against {mf|his|her} possessions will be considered a threat to the sacred privileges of a Rogue Trader.

1569aaad-7394-4618-b8af-b0c1e5e731eb.Text: The von Valancius protectorate is emerging from a crisis, but that means it is once again an interesting prospect for external predators. To avoid leading the major players of the Koronus Expanse into temptation, the Rogue Trader should assert {mf|his|her} right to Theodora's legacy.

d96e6f39-3276-447a-ad5e-b8217f7e624e.Text: Throne Room, Palace von Valancius, Dargonus, Mundus Valancius

78fbdc13-63bb-4aca-9696-c6dcf1e9f5d9.Text: The Vox Master has requested an audience — the Lexmechanics' report on the current situation in the protectorate is ready.

a739deb2-9fb8-4f69-9a62-2bc3eb6c84db.Text: A grand ceremony is about to take place on Dargonus in the Mundus Valancius system. Overseeing the preparations is the master of ceremonies, who is waiting in the palace.

c910e59e-14fa-4474-81ab-dacba4c81cbd.Text: Talk to the master of ceremonies

8147b86e-6af8-4efc-ac27-e4fb934f2ada.Text: The nobles of the protectorate and influential guests have gathered at a reception in honour of Theodora von Valancius's heir. The social occasion is a political event where alliances will be forged, which is why the Rogue Trader must seize the opportunities presented to {mf|him|her}. The master of ceremonies should be notified of the end of the reception.

b5f8f348-576a-4183-bf4d-f5df56d92f67.Text: An uninvited guest has come to the Rogue Trader's chambers. The purpose of their visit is unclear and highly suspect. The Lord Captain should proceed with extreme caution.

2dcca63d-923e-449e-a4f4-655e9d8221a2.Text: Most of the surface of Kiava Gamma is covered in ore mining operations. The optimal place to begin the on-world reconnaissance is the planet's largest manufactorum.

8117cc13-cbd5-49c0-990a-9f00bddbf3a0.Text: Kiava Gamma's manufactorum continues to operate, despite the presence of enemy forces in the system. More information is needed to assess the situation.

aedab85f-4974-4a20-9d39-f710843ae66f.Text: Find out what is happening on the industrial world

f9bca076-bfaa-4f8b-b946-b73f8b17422e.Text: The information obtained from the Fabricator-turned-heretic reveals there has been a revolution on the industrial world. Cubis Delphim's reasons for revolting are likely to be found in the deepest levels of the manufactorum.

5ac20c0e-2b7f-4bfe-b519-8873173642d5.Text: Find a way to the heart of the manufactorum

22699c02-fcc9-44d8-9cc9-d7696130a3fe.Text: Cubis Delphim poses a direct threat that is incompatible with the future operation of Kiava Gamma's manufactorum. The optimal solution is to eliminate the Fabricator-Censor.

5fbcfddb-1f70-4e70-9239-71a75ea3497a.Text: The Vox Master is awaiting orders regarding the fate of this world.

3f863071-e126-403e-a5ec-37929dc40641.Text: Kiava Gamma suffered severe losses due to the Archenemy's invasion of the planet. Nevertheless, thanks to the ground operation led by the Lord Captain, the industrial world has been restored to the Rogue Trader's control.

3eb3015f-3c23-424b-b76b-391f1d0a059a.Text: An attempt to establish first contact with Kiava Gamma in the Cranach System provoked a hostile reaction. The Lord Captain must review the situation on the planet and take necessary steps to reassert the Rogue Trader's control over the industrial world.

c96e25b3-f37f-4b35-9560-e949bae498d5.Text: It is vital to keep an eye on any potential threat. The local inhabitants or the Liege of Footfall can provide more information.

319d2a19-1f0b-4270-8905-7c79f5cfd9d5.Text: The Lord Captain decided against going to the dangerous location in person. However, the Liege believes that after the death of the last victim, the area can be safely disinfected.

dd8a74a6-05c7-488c-8e55-f17d833c6d8d.Text: Wait for the situation to resolve itself

d9ffb9eb-98cb-4341-b684-f1a2b4e26982.Text: What was the cause of the strange deaths? The answer must be somewhere nearby.

fc863f93-fe43-42fa-b2f0-f9781d199ebe.Text: It appears the source of the contagion was a population of mutants hiding in the backstreets of the Shadow Quarters. Eliminating them will wipe out the disease's breeding ground.

2edf6763-e690-4e18-bc4d-4622e937b46d.Text: Now that the source of the contagion has been eliminated, Utility Crew 3 can do their work unimpeded.

5c50513d-b2ab-49d1-ae13-4abfa1ddedb7.Text: Talk to the crew about the new information

d36e7cd2-fa9d-4482-b8ae-7b8b8fd87a0a.Text: By now, the matter in the Shadow Quarters must surely have come to a conclusion… in one form or another.

47ea548d-905f-4ce2-8c59-47943f3a6f45.Text: Permission to enter the quarantine zone can be obtained only through the Liege.

3a5cce61-55c1-4b9a-bba7-2c1c48146e52.Text: Using {mf|his|her} status as a Rogue Trader, the Lord Captain has secured entry to the quarantine zone. However, {mf|he|she} must wait for the station crew to remove the barriers and deactivate the mines.

6c9d9845-51ce-4627-966a-2f74946f245a.Text: There are people still inside the quarantine zone and no one is prepared to help them.

067d1f89-1111-458b-9caa-52883387ba48.Text: On the Lord Captain's orders, help has been sent to the residents of the sealed-off area.

8c50fd4f-48ea-4154-b3c3-6d4ed1a42833.Text: The problem has been solved, one way or another.

3612469d-ce02-4f26-9442-0618d9e65db3.Text: Part of the Shadow Quarters, the poorest of Footfall's asteroids, has been placed under quarantine. The authorities suspect an outbreak of disease or an infestation of parasites.

1b2b65dd-baaa-4927-9aed-75263d697bdc.Text: Where the Shadows Are Deepest of All

1b8787ec-7198-42c9-b5be-001e640c0262.Text: The planet's temperature is below acceptable levels and continues to drop every few hours, effectively rendering the planet a "dead" world. The Rogue Trader should scan the surface to try to find any witnesses to the cataclysm.

2a26c34f-b276-46ba-ac51-c0a9df467e83.Text: The augurs have detected a faint heat signature in the planet's central hive city. Homing in on the signal requires a team to go down to the surface.

1765be65-fbbd-4a40-ae4e-2a1a9cff51f2.Text: Make planetfall on the hive world

8810a5f7-74d6-48ff-93f3-07fd9dfd245e.Text: An unknown cataclysm has claimed the lives of billions of the Rogue Trader's subjects. If there are any survivors on the planet, they are probably based near the heat source detected by the augurs.

c682d1da-674c-4d33-9bad-2b39d98dd89a.Text: A peripheral geothermal substation is the last heat source maintaining an acceptable temperature in this part of the hive. There may be survivors nearby — or xenos.

61a4c204-d692-4919-aca4-57a96de150b0.Text: Explore the hive in search of answers

e2de1489-986f-47d2-ab83-98001fb5a6e6.Text: The scout the Rogue Trader encountered claims that there are more survivors deep in the hive. He told the Rogue Trader the approximate location of the secret passage and warned {mf|him|her} of the danger lying in wait.

5f8203af-1b3b-4fa7-a162-16d49b0b28ff.Text: Enemies of Humanity have set up an outpost near the old city gates. Nobody can go in or out of the heart of the hive unnoticed.

a3e51991-45f6-4e4c-aaad-d2af8ae321f6.Text: The Children of Redemption are the small number of survivors still holding out against the heretics and xenos with their last vestiges of strength. Their elders sincerely believe that the Emperor has sent his wrath upon the world — taking away the Fiery Messenger and filling the planet with Nightmares.

9d70223a-3e1c-4d8e-81a8-9b13757a2e3e.Text: The perpetrator behind the tragedy that befell hive world turned out to be a mad Haemonculus.

64a2e9d3-08de-4268-9eda-fc8fc8b95b75.Text: The passageways of the hive are teeming with heretics — madmen devour the flesh of their own kind to try to dull their insatiable hunger.

22f39331-77e5-405d-b205-aa36368493ee.Text: A barely warm pipe runs deep inside the hive city and vanishes amidst the maze of utility lines.

9f39638a-ec1c-4f43-aeb7-99ce935b2d8b.Text: A repulsive creature of flesh and metal roams the hive, conducting experiments on corpses. It is protected both by xenos and terrifying constructs — floating torture instruments.

1399d064-ae42-45f4-b75e-d07c59209375.Text: The invading xenos forces have been wiped off the face of the planet. Control of the dead world once again indisputably rests in the hands of House von Valancius.

0f70ce97-b6b2-483b-b523-ec6342aa3c77.Text: A hive world in the Gronos System has been inexplicably destroyed. The main city on the planet, a source of promethium for the von Valancius protectorate, remains silent.

97d010be-a847-4fd5-ab46-21a4a0c6a181.Text: The hint mentions a small quay and large windows — that sounds like part of Footfall's Void Dock Alpha-Rho.

8cdec42a-935a-449f-b092-671a55fb1741.Text: Look for a cache by the windows in Dock Alpha-Rho

cf50533e-b6ce-4095-8855-800dcf382e57.Text: The hint mentions "a tunnel in the shadow of a bridge, a bridge in the shadow of the great statue." It must be referring to the Shadow Quarters.

969ac36a-c9e1-4b96-a9a5-d63ed3f4a2c1.Text: Look for a cache in the old tunnel in the Shadow Quarters

0b0ac144-c99f-42ac-9484-abd772e7bb80.Text: The hint mentions a cogitator and a statue in the Small Temple. Footfall's Atrium was once supposed to be the nave of the Little Cathedral.

3e119565-ad02-4144-93b5-dab9555698d3.Text: Examine the cogitator by the statue of Footfall's founder

6d134a19-e8bf-4dd4-80b5-20dab7e32f0e.Text: This part of the Shadow Quarters is currently under quarantine due to a possible outbreak of disease.

8cd7a748-61a5-4e3b-a0b4-0ee11b7f0c94.Text: One of the secrets of the founding of Footfall Station has been revealed.

b05baaf0-bae8-4c4e-b262-788f43c65931.Text: Mysterious caches connected to Footfall's origins are scattered across the station. To discover what secret they hold, the Rogue Trader must find all the places indicated in the clues.

7e27b846-5e91-4067-ba2c-4b77ddaf79d8.Text: Footfall is experiencing severe shortages of provisions. If the situation is not remedied soon, a dramatic fall in the station's population is likely.

e7806aa5-6c0d-453a-b0ae-0ef439f5e91f.Text: Supply Footfall with provisions from the agri-world Janus

dc01eb06-2b37-42d8-b76f-0411de0e0e44.Text: Footfall has found itself caught between the interests of the Winterscale, Chorda, and von Valancius protectorates. Now its fate has been decided, as is the person who will rule over it.

cc7cb749-601b-4cb8-a232-66d8a6a46edd.Text: The Liege of Footfall Vladaym Tocara has come with a request about the station's survival. His people are at risk of starvation, and Vladaym's current patron, Calligos Winterscale, is not rushing to his aid, so Liege Tocara is seeking a new ally and protector. If the von Valancius dynasty does not help him, he will be forced to submit to the rule of the merciless Rogue Trader Incendia Chorda.

78833306-dafc-4524-b753-50b7970b1b5c.Text: An unknown cataclysm has claimed the lives of billions of the Rogue Trader's subjects. If there are any survivors on the planet, they are probably based near the heat source detected by the augurs.

c3361e01-f2ed-4ab5-8428-377463f9f639.Text: Billions of irreplaceable promethium extraction experts perished in the catastrophe on the world. If the Rogue Trader hopes to restore even a fraction of the promethium manufactorums, the remaining survivors must be found.

cfb74fbf-57cf-4dc4-9195-1343c984085d.Text: Enemies of Humanity have installed themselves in the frozen hive, turning the remnants of the dying world into their own torture testing ground. To preserve what is left, the Rogue Trader must understand the xenos' intentions.

d977c8c8-6f76-4375-bb80-052b4d5f8d43.Text: Discover what the Drukhari are up to

8400ac6d-2b5c-4ab8-9ed4-66a199bae887.Text: A horrifying creature dwells in the bowels of the hive — the Wrack. Stitched together from countless bodies, the Wrack operates an Engine of Pain deep within the world. It is time to put an end to its crimes against the Rogue Trader's protectorate and Humanity itself.

806ef972-87a2-40d2-8967-6ef0bd6afcd9.Text: A sinister laboratory filled with xenotech, strange artefacts, and human remains. If the xenos do possess the answers to the Rogue Trader's questions, this is the best place to look for them.

909f1ea9-9367-4088-b6aa-4dce7892299a.Text: The Wrack and his entourage no longer pose a threat to the Children of Redemption. The time has come to return to the survivors' shelter and decide their fate.

245d1a7e-3fa1-4726-be46-706051015c82.Text: Return to the Children of Redemption

ae936b74-f600-4908-971b-9a06a64c8f11.Text: The Vox Master is awaiting the Rogue Trader's return to the ship and further instructions.

9fbf8664-f322-4f7a-91b3-83fcd8bb7a4d.Text: The scout claims that there are more survivors deep in the hive. The easiest way to find their hideout is to go through a secret passage.

794aea5e-18d3-4317-b6ab-918718c051b5.Text: The enemies of Humanity have set up an outpost near the old city gates. It seems they are not letting anyone in. Or out.

ed1cb708-3780-47d8-925e-2c960870d0b7.Text: A barely warm pipe runs deep inside the hive city and vanishes amidst the maze of utility lines.

ab755ac3-2770-4242-87a6-eed59db93fb9.Text: Instead of survivors, the passageways of the hive city are teeming with heretics — madmen devour the flesh of their own kind to try to dull their insatiable hunger.

455018c2-7e0b-4a88-81e4-75c806be1c78.Text: A repulsive creature of flesh and metal roams the hive, conducting experiments on corpses.

c69c1414-1ec1-4fbc-b6f8-de67a404b79e.Text: The Children of Redemption are the small number of survivors still holding out against the heretics and xenos with their last vestiges of strength. Their elders sincerely believe that the Emperor has sent his wrath upon the world by taking away the star and filling the planet with Nightmares.

b3db924e-9eab-49e3-a3c6-3fcff8b4ee51.Text: The perpetrator of the tragedy that befell hive world turned out to be a mad Haemonculus.

fdfab9b7-dbc6-4635-a5e8-0c0e6e0f1f47.Text: Control of the world rests indisputably in the hands of the von Valancius protectorate once more. Unfortunately, its promethium manufactorums will never be restored to full capacity.

6f203e58-afef-4f56-86ab-e84882eee453.Text: A hive world in the Gronos System has been inexplicably destroyed. The main city on the planet, a source of promethium for the von Valancius protectorate, remains silent.

fea2e31f-67ab-4819-8378-843bc533af41.Text: The Lord Captain's reign over the von Valancius realm has begun, and {mf|he|she} has set {mf|his|her} sights on the horizons that are now open to {mf|him|her}. Henceforth, the protectorate's prosperity is in {mf|his|her} hands.

47dac19c-8d34-46c2-b5e9-91309a739546.Text: The Lord Captain is to take Theodora von Valancius's place as the ruler of the protectorate. To command it with success, the Rogue Trader must master every aspect of {mf|his|her} newly acquired power.

37388501-18ee-4379-a1ac-8352f68a27ad.Text: Rogue Traders possess immense power, and many of the world's influential figures wish for an alliance with them. For the Lord Captain, to make a deal with such a powerful partner and supply them with resources or riches would be to assert {mf|himself|herself} as a shrewd venturer.

3b545dca-73be-4084-9c79-9aaacc51c2a4.Text: Strike a deal with an influential partner

8fc90096-857c-48e3-8db6-22d0b57f479c.Text: The protectorate is strong as long as it is growing. Stable, sated domains inevitably begin to crumble. By claiming a new planet as {mf|his|her} property, the Lord Captain will prove that House von Valancius has not lost any of its ambition or strength.

c7adfaa8-d041-4d42-9f10-b53ec0308b23.Text: Every vassal world is a treasure and a source of wealth. However, by managing these worlds with prudence and undertaking new development projects, one can make them deliver even greater results.

18d70165-23f4-49c8-af1c-f9d5d75d3951.Text: Complete a development project of the highest difficulty in any colony

040f90cf-af1b-45dc-8768-14b578277def.Text: An entity called Nomos is inhabiting the Lord Captain's ship. It is not fully aware of what it is, but it wants to live and to be on amicable terms with the ship's other inhabitants.

3cfaabf6-a138-4f50-81c8-7c739dc84120.Text: An in-depth conversation about the limits of existence will help to establish full mutual understanding between Nomos and the Lord Captain. Holding this exchange without witnesses is advisable.

91fb2cbd-7e36-4e65-9297-bf816bac93df.Text: Talk to Nomos on the ship

b60d5bad-aace-41ea-8a0e-3d6a90adfc6f.Text: Eradicating the last of the xenos will allow Janus to restore production and re-establish export shipments.

31a0b8d0-a13d-47d5-9cea-9aa6db85d061.Text: The governor of Janus is looking forward to the Rogue Trader's visit, where she will personally welcome {mf|him|her} at an official ceremony.

b6371e18-526b-40b8-b3ae-0c5fc1a5ef88.Text: The ceremony was interrupted by an attack by an unidentified enemy. The hostile elements must be eliminated.

2cbee184-9803-4d5c-a4a8-9d1c8565fe71.Text: Fight off the forces attacking the estate

57dc0f57-d324-4d6d-bbea-7b21dee05737.Text: Governor Vyatt has proposed continuing the conversation in her study to avoid a repeat incident.

cbced3d7-0b54-442e-b555-abd084f8c52e.Text: The governor has suggested starting the search for the rebels' base by questioning the servants and other witnesses to the assassination attempt. It may be possible to extract key information from the conspirators themselves (regardless of their vital status).

b100d23b-68bf-4c4a-9195-20afe58f1ab2.Text: Find leads to track down the rebel leaders

66a0d0f0-c358-4766-a7bb-c79e79604fd6.Text: Additional information about the rebels causing unrest on Janus will help to narrow the search for the rebel leaders' base and speed up the process of pacifying the local populace.

1c497a0e-d874-45c7-96ab-04cdf002c486.Text: Gather more information about the rebels

59759889-cbc8-41d8-a9cc-6faa3b9ec3d1.Text: A vox with recordings of the rebels' conversations will make it possible to launch a large-scale reconnaissance operation. The Rogue Trader must return to the ship to engage its systems in the search.

1d42a1bd-de43-41f4-86e1-48a4b7f1f1ba.Text: Conduct the search operation from the voidship by scanning the planet

10434012-f88a-4eda-9fed-9dcd0aca9e58.Text: The information obtained during the operation has made it possible to pinpoint the location of the rebel leaders on Janus. The rapid deployment of a small team and armed reconnaissance on the ground will solve the rebel problem on Janus for good.

e1fde2f8-228b-49ec-9b3d-aed0ba58d316.Text: As previously agreed, the governor is waiting for the Rogue Trader at her estate with news of the rebels' fate.

8a74d379-ccfb-418c-878b-df0f14c9b141.Text: The governor poses a significant threat to the Lord Captain's safety and the stability of Janus. The volatile element should be destroyed.

0214ccd0-0a7e-4190-ab78-6a8ba37d95a5.Text: The surviving rebel claims that their leaders are in hiding far away from population centres.

12e1c300-c1ae-4df4-97a8-bdab89aef0a3.Text: The rebels were in possession of unidentified weaponry and equipment — this may be linked to the artefacts from the local xenoruins mentioned by the Tech-Priest.

df3f8291-de12-4fe5-ab77-a0216c3ba401.Text: The coordinates of the attacks indicate a definite vector of movement for the rebels, making it possible to narrow the search area.

b84c3424-cda9-429a-b85d-90372be81146.Text: The berries of a plant that grows outside of Janus's cultivated areas were found among the rebels' equipment.

92e3b128-4706-4205-97ba-8e60f193f143.Text: Kill the surviving leaders of the rebellion

c31513fd-f921-4caa-881a-29a0ea442d0c.Text: The unrest on Janus has been stopped, but not without losses to the local workforce. When the planet is restored, it will once again supply other worlds and serve the aims of the Rogue Trader.

c607320a-50ef-4f35-8d74-ecef80359c10.Text: The agri-world Janus is a key source of food for planets in the von Valancius protectorate. The Rogue Trader should do everything possible to reintegrate the planet into the Koronus Expanse economy quickly.

9c1e6494-f2bb-484f-8103-6c4de33aa675.Text: The populations of numerous von Valancius worlds are in need of food supplies. Only the agri-world Janus has the capacity to meet the needs of several dozen planets.

c8903fe2-b5d8-4782-b166-30895537c0bd.Text: The industrial world Kiava Gamma provides the von Valancius dynasty with heavy machinery and a host of useful minerals not found on other planets. Controlling this industrial world guarantees the manufacturing power the protectorate needs.

63176991-e383-46b9-bd28-183f8e87acef.Text: Deal with the disrupted shipments from Kiava Gamma

965ef34a-de61-4adf-9aa5-43893978021e.Text: Dargonus is the capital world of the von Valancius dynasty and home to key administrative assets. Discovering this world will help to restore essential channels for communication and trade between the Rogue Trader's holdings.

3a0ab6bb-6c2e-4067-9362-b93ff65fa6c2.Text: Restore the operation of the administrative apparatus on Dargonus

0a77470c-b57f-4901-a9d9-566d2fc045cd.Text: Key worlds of the von Valancius dynasty and links between them have been restored as far as possible. Now with the necessary base to maintain the protectorate's territory, the Rogue Trader can continue to strengthen and expand {mf|his|her} holdings.

0b037284-7c51-4e1d-9320-d3078d442825.Text: The von Valancius protectorate has been destabilised by the disturbances in the warp and the severing of trade and transport routes. Restoring links with key worlds will provide the Rogue Trader's planets with the supplies and support they need in this time of crisis.

583bb488-d243-49d0-b5f6-147a9951bc4e.Text: It is worth taking a closer look at the belongings of those killed by the Anvers and searching for other evidence. The Anvers' brazen actions guarantee that they will give themselves away sooner or later.

7385bccc-38c0-4dbe-95a6-35d6a2124215.Text: Find out more about the strange gang

4ed9f4e3-3af3-4308-8c70-cf8e1c577d1d.Text: Leads and evidence will probably be found across various parts of Footfall

787693e0-6283-4e38-b717-5658fe8f2c15.Text: Pinpoint the location of the secret base

6f219a37-183d-4e79-bd51-c9aa3c535305.Text: The location of the base has been found — its entrance is somewhere in Sector 2 in the Shadow Quarters. The turn-off to the entrance can be seen from the Adeptus Amasecus. This should be enough to find the place.

1d617626-df06-4fbc-bd82-189af0cdd020.Text: A note found on the body of one of the Anvers' leaders mentions "Sector 2."

6be9cd11-278a-439c-8b0d-a101c44a9508.Text: A note found on the body of Cinder, an Anvers leader, mentioned a location. Apparently, it's near the Adeptus Amasecus — the turn-off is visible from the bar's entrance.

e099fd38-410b-4c18-a3b4-ae269498f972.Text: The story of the Anvers gang is over. But its leader's strange prophecy is cause for concern...

6ff5c97f-116d-4d91-89a8-a962c69bfade.Text: A new, particularly aggressive gang has set up shop on Footfall, showing no fear of either the Liege or Rogue Traders. Their thuggish behaviour must be stopped.

de6f22b3-05e3-44a2-8edc-9e7382e528ab.Text: The Drukhari must not be allowed to destroy a voidship carrying valuable cargo. The merchant needs military support.

ea7653ac-530f-4e0d-92a4-410e28460d06.Text: Arrive in time to help the voidship

18a48806-7e10-44ca-a2fe-4b8d3b370019.Text: The merchant was lost. All that can be done now is to take revenge on those who dared to attack the subjects of the Imperium.

ca26788b-7290-44fa-92b7-a07408644545.Text: Achilleas Scalander has reported new information about the planned attack. The xenos are already preparing to strike — the Rogue Trader must act immediately.

5de9e3d7-4916-4e1a-8293-33a28bc74079.Text: Attack in the Silence of Mer-Segrit

43fb53c3-4d27-4f9f-92e4-1e3818621abd.Text: The capital world of the von Valancius dynasty has been found and is awaiting the arrival of its sovereign.

d4905e5a-06e6-41a8-a071-d712875652c0.Text: Achilleas Scalander has requested a private audience. It seems his report will contain information that must be kept confidential. Achilleas will be waiting in the throne room of the von Valancius palace.

bab82f3d-3be2-45e2-90ac-9aa83959d636.Text: Governor Drivestem, who has been entrusted to oversee the world of Dargonus, is ready to deliver a detailed report about the planet's current state of affairs.

f6781d3a-78d8-4ae1-90a3-5f22658d9563.Text: Tell Chancellor Werserian that you are ready to receive the governor of Dargonus

45dce329-1c85-4871-96ac-0ce4c41a0cae.Text: The nobles of Dargonus have accepted the authority of their new {mf|master|mistress} and protector.

48b27e99-dcc3-466f-abd7-c38ffe917c9e.Text: The capital world of Dargonus is home to the high aristocracy of the von Valancius protectorate. The power of any one of the noble families exceeds that of the colonial governor, and securing the complete loyalty of the nobility is an important step to legitimising the authority of the new Rogue Trader.

35b04c0d-41ae-4518-a007-30b0b87ef326.Text: It will take time to confirm that the ship is free of serious damage and to repair what damage there is. The Vox Master will report when the inspection is complete.

9f7e0194-da1e-4ad5-ae69-fb6e7764ca86.Text: Wait for the completion of the ship's inspection

4085cd11-3ca5-4535-b6db-d02b882725d9.Text: While waiting for the ship to be ready to get underway again, the Rogue Trader is free to visit the local administration. Liege Tocara is waiting in his residence.

b8f018e1-0197-4955-825c-89a94a849ae7.Text: The dockyard is waiting for the ship in order to begin the full inspection and repairs.

0d6572f1-f3c2-4dc8-9e34-82995880f9a6.Text: To coordinate the next steps, the Lord Captain must hold a meeting with {mf|his|her} retinue.

b9bc1564-dd47-42a1-8e9a-b4986d68842e.Text: Meet with officers on the ship's bridge

57327cdd-6773-42fc-a3e5-36797f2e803e.Text: The ship's wounds have healed. It is ready to continue its journey.

74f886c4-0f6a-4b5b-82d8-8b08d11ec583.Text: Many of the systems on the Rogue Trader's ship have suffered damage in the battle with the cultists. The wounded ship's spirit yearns to reach the only port in the sector — Footfall.

01db3c1c-cd7d-4ce4-b016-6c5aae959a68.Text: The Rogue Trader's cogitator on the bridge once belonged to Theodora von Valancius. Pasqal is sure that it can be used to decrypt the discovered data-bank.

85278490-10e3-4243-95d6-dc85c97b0c1c.Text: Authorise the data-bank decryption on the personal cogitator

b54e7bf9-2c20-41bb-b012-17371133d739.Text: The data contained in the data-bank was corrupted, but the Rogue Trader learned that more information might be found in Theodora's hidden caches. One of them is located somewhere on Kiava Gamma.

2f991013-f31d-4ac8-99e8-193c6e7bab6b.Text: Find the hidden cache on Kiava Gamma

d45bdac7-1edc-4744-9438-0dfcc6995846.Text: The second of Theodora's caches can be found in the capital of the von Valancius protectorate. Maybe someone who knew her well might be able to provide some clues.

39c17b4e-0698-4871-a9ee-9c2685a9ec86.Text: Find the hidden cache on Dargonus

a4983727-eaa9-43c1-82fd-f656d9a74861.Text: The contents of the data-banks found on Dargonus and Kiava Gamma have been encrypted. The Rogue Trader's cogitator on the bridge can be used once again to decrypt the data.

f150283c-a99c-43f6-800b-4fd2096da0be.Text: Decrypt the data on the personal cogitator

345fb870-ad49-44bc-8889-c48521cf630a.Text: Having searched {mf|his|her} predecessor's caches, the Rogue Trader discovered new data and transferred it to {mf|his|her} personal cogitator to be analysed.

dc72a60a-31f1-40f2-a037-00c9c7cea8b4.Text: Pasqal has found a data-bank belonging to Theodora von Valancius in the Furibundus System. The data encrypted in this database may prove useful to the new Rogue Trader.

dd38c16c-2152-48d0-a67e-0229db910614.Text: A strange gathering in the centre of Footfall is raising questions. The Rogue Trader wants to find out what is going on.

ad6991bd-3b68-4fe3-8206-d5eaea06ad2a.Text: Find out what is happening at the strange ceremony

647f92a7-935a-46e8-9e2a-e38b6155e0df.Text: Who is the mysterious final guest everyone is waiting for at the ceremony? The answer to that may be the key to understanding what is happening.

0d528b97-7611-418d-9736-94fd517bfbad.Text: Denz Bellardo left a sizable estate behind. The Rogue Trader has the chance to step in and influence who inherits the lot.

85e36800-6bd9-4093-a83b-a85adaf066fd.Text: It seems the ceremony guests were trying to kill Fidelio, whom they believed the Rogue Trader to be. The Lord Captain should return to the crematorium and demand answers for these actions.

4b89a6a9-9601-4008-aacf-62c84973d023.Text: The word "repentance" could have some connection to the Fidelio mystery.

ab2ca118-8087-4d3a-bc9c-bbb14bed82e9.Text: In the last months before his death, Denz raved about "dead eyes" watching him.

f0f1344a-d206-4a02-818a-b83476f07594.Text: The honourable Master Bellardo turned out to be a former pirate by the name of Jerrycan Denz.

52512d5b-a59a-4eaf-9767-1e25116144f0.Text: Fidelio is the heir to Denz Bellardo's riches.

fcaa5eb8-264f-4723-bf37-0b8612c46abe.Text: Someone — possibly Fidelio — left a strange note in the book of remembrance.

bc83b301-b1ee-4402-b2e6-e1de529700ec.Text: The Administratum clerk promises to provide the Rogue Trader with documents made out in the name Fidelio if {mf|he|she} helps him rescue some valuable cargo from the crematorium's furnace.

847aa11c-e0cc-495f-a43e-cb319777c62a.Text: Idira senses growing possibilities, but also growing danger.

1ebf28d3-fe66-442d-b2e7-ef70c2f7144d.Text: The ceremony guests do not know who Fidelio is or what he or she looks like.

5cfc58ec-652a-4266-953e-deb506817e8a.Text: Upon hearing the name von Valancius, the person overseeing the event subtly orders the servitor to remove the amasec intended for guests. What could be the reason?

904b0474-b30c-4a27-b207-3f3732281b69.Text: Chaplain believes that all the clues to Fidelio's identity have been found. Only one step remains — to unmask this mysterious figure...

5d101c72-ae43-468e-b920-22f469d79195.Text: The ceremony turned out to be the funeral of an honourable gentleman by the name of Bellardo.

4bab40bc-2d77-47d9-9348-6f0d66c6c7ce.Text: The funeral of the old pirate Denz Bellardo exposed the vices of society just as much as Denz's own.

c6c67c23-cc78-48e2-9679-38c83648ca2b.Text: A strange ceremony is taking place in the heart of Footfall. What will happen if the Rogue Trader decides to join the proceedings?

d6c3af6c-c6fc-449d-bcad-df8463078af8.Text: Somewhere in the depths of the Chasm lies the device known as the stifler, which stops the forces of Chaos from overwhelming the Dark City. This construct must be destroyed.

633e608e-7deb-4f60-bb7f-976798b3d2ac.Text: The Anatomical Opera is full of the products of strange and dangerous experiments. All it would take is a small act of sabotage for the powers of the warp to gain a foothold in the heart of the Drukhari bastion.

20ebce0c-32e8-4b0a-b2a7-543c23326308.Text: Mortal souls make for generous gifts to the true gods and their spawn. The Shriekers could serve as a tribute to the powers that aid the Rogue Trader in this accursed place.

2bb0fdf6-63d3-40ff-b850-38ef6b3eea9b.Text: Make a sacrifice to the warp gods

8b72f5bb-78c4-4b52-ad35-1412de4ecfb7.Text: The powers of the warp will show the Rogue Trader where to strike. The fall of the construct that protects the Dark City from another dysjunction will become the last chord in the unfolding symphony of Chaos.

795e7fa7-60f8-4de4-bf45-4b8bbcf16019.Text: Destroy the warp stifler in the arena

24f6ae7d-bd50-46c6-b69d-5850011239ee.Text: The arena of the Cult of the Fatal Thirst has fallen, torn apart by the new dysjunction. If the Drukhari had known that a pitiful mon-keigh's arrival in the Chasm would cause its downfall, they may have taken better care to ensure {mf|he|she} was dead.

5f0f33e4-3233-4050-a276-660f7052720d.Text: The warp gods have answered the Rogue Trader's call. They offered {mf|him|her} a deal: {name} von Valancius must find a way to destabilise the Dark City and let Chaos invade it once again. For that, the Primordial Truth will assist its loyal servant.

aad449d4-f90b-452d-9def-034ac390c213.Text: Escape the arena through the portal

3ebb6c71-f017-4c25-84e8-63659eea219a.Text: The maestro of flesh is probably the Haemonculus Tervantias, who resides at the Anatomical Opera

c232e9f7-52e0-4165-accb-6bddc6f6e7a3.Text: The Rogue Trader managed to escape the Chasm. Now {mf|he|she} needs to find the way out of the Dark City.

f428ef43-30e2-471a-8b0e-6985d7fbf21e.Text: The Rogue Trader was unlucky enough to end up in the part of Commorragh called the Chasm. To escape the Dark City, the Lord Captain first will need to break free from this place drenched in suffering and peril.

b3cba404-0e0a-4412-b606-3dd1b9ec815b.Text: Just one more step separates the Lord Captain from freedom.

35f105a0-7dad-42cd-91df-83cdb18f56e1.Text: The xenos called Malice promised to aid the Rogue Trader in exchange for killing his enemy — a man named the Commissar hiding in the Mangled Sector of the Dark City.

af01bb83-eeda-4aec-943b-b0fcda232787.Text: The Rogue Trader has formed an alliance with the Commissar. To successfully escape Commorragh, they will need to eliminate the xenos called Malice. Securing Malice's lair will be the first stepping stone to freedom.

1d9c8cf6-a6f4-4caa-9526-ec38f31d103e.Text: The deviousness of the denizens of Commorragh has lured the Rogue Trader to the arena of the Cult of the Fatal Thirst. To continue {mf|his|her} search for freedom, the Rogue Trader needs to survive a fierce battle.

34dda0cd-53d4-468e-bfee-ef5d61022035.Text: The Lord Captain's enigmatic ally, who prefers to speak in riddles, has advised {mf|him|her} to search for a "maestro" of a "haggard chorus" whose "flesh is employed to serve his art." It seems that this mysterious person might provide the Rogue Trader with the means to escape the Dark City... Though it is hard to decipher the exact meaning behind the bizarre stranger's words.

2f67b803-0505-445a-918e-7a26d68086e5.Text: The champions of the arena, the Bloodstained Proselytes, have entered the Anatomical Opera for reasons known only to themselves. Tervantias has advised the Rogue Trader to take a good look at them — such a chance may not present itself in the Fatal Thirst's arena.

d7793bed-eeb2-4f02-ac76-9a4f54b40be2.Text: Tervantias is ready to offer his patronage to the Lord Captain. But first, {mf|he|she} will have to teach the Wych Cult a lesson by killing several of their fighters in the arena.

497e6bde-fb29-41b8-9978-0ea7d91dd8f5.Text: The Rogue Trader's opponents have fallen, so now {mf|he|she} can demand the Haemonculus's promised help to escape.

bad067d3-e79e-4f4d-9b9f-868fb0cde403.Text: The malignant Wych Keykeross wants to punish Tervantias and personally deal with his new champion — the Rogue Trader. Killing her is the only way for the Lord Captain to buy precious time to escape the Chasm.

0821e060-c38d-435f-9bdd-e63efd3e230e.Text: The Spire of the Reaving Tempest contains a way to escape Commorragh. It must be found.

3611fdb1-76cd-4576-b83d-e3d1748e45fb.Text: Find a way to escape Commorragh

8a9f272d-709d-4653-8adc-4dca2156bce9.Text: The Archon of the Reaving Tempest has brought enough grief upon the von Valancius dynasty. It is time to get rid of the powerful xenos once and for all.

112bfe21-bb36-4541-a1a5-5b009a05b4f9.Text: The Webway Gate presents the only chance to perform an impossible feat — escaping the Dark City of the Drukhari alive.

dea26120-a98f-4a93-bf7f-b052646d35c2.Text: Activate the Webway Gate and escape Commorragh

6d6d1a8a-7238-46e7-9441-19f3ed70a738.Text: The key to the Webway Gate was found during the exploration of the Spire of the Reaving Tempest. Now Yrliet can use it to open the Webway Gate.

aa31064f-96bd-4c8f-85fd-d5eb56af5a4c.Text: Yrliet knows how to open the Webway Gate, but she needs a special key hidden in the spire to do so.

9e7bdd6b-b697-44c0-afb2-e5c81ebaef9b.Text: Marazhai promised to open the Webway Gate if the Lord Captain allows him to leave the Dark City with {mf|him|her}.

433260e0-fd5b-42f7-8d0b-754fce5a8212.Text: The Webway Gate refuses to open. There must be a way to open the portal and escape Commorragh.

4ac7ffda-728f-4794-9b48-9cc11e87bd79.Text: The Farseer Eklendyl was found during the exploration of the Spire of the Reaving Tempest. He will guide the Lord Captain through the Webway Gate.

efe7a98e-699e-4c56-b7ee-4a40e3c31dc2.Text: Nocturne of Oblivion has decided to involve the Rogue Trader in his enigmatic escape plan. Kept in the dark about the nuances of the Harlequin's true intentions, the Lord Captain can only follow his lead while looking for opportunities to cut the strings tying {mf|him|her} to the tips of the xenos puppeteer's fingers.

e2aa7156-acca-4aad-a1e1-2a7524c19f9a.Text: The portal that Nocturne of Oblivion has directed the Lord Captain to has led {mf|him|her} to a Drukhari feast. The Rogue Trader must understand why the Harlequin has chosen this place as the portal's exit point.

3bfb1c40-cd7e-4390-878d-4453cac061fa.Text: Ulfar, the ferocious Space Wolf, has destroyed any possibility of parleying with the Drukhari. There is only one way out now — the way of carnage and war.

b1a55b82-1f37-4006-b861-651ca3e10264.Text: Drukhari gravi-gondolas capable of transporting the Lord Captain to the top of the Spire of the Reaving Tempest are moored on the outer terrace.

259c2eee-4978-4886-be5d-04810c5e5021.Text: The system where the Aeldari refugees are currently hiding is situated at the edge of the Koronus Expanse. Establishing contact seems impossible, so the Rogue Trader should personally head to their last known coordinates.

2fd6bd41-75ec-49b8-8721-a460b2a0fa6e.Text: Travel to the Atlas Reach System

44f7f254-4d7b-4462-88c7-d587dda0c1d8.Text: Yrliet insists that the Aeldari are hiding in the depths of the Atlas Reach System. The system must be explored to locate the traces of xenos.

b39e35f5-975f-44fb-b244-1e79dd0ab7e2.Text: The planet is not responding, but an unidentified voidship was discovered in the system. Yrliet asks the Lord Captain to find out if the vessel's crew knows something.

a04c9bb4-ed28-49a1-8b85-7ee050f5442b.Text: Trying to save the Aeldari craftworld Crudarach has led to unexpected consequences. That no longer matters, however — the Rogue Trader has more pressing issues at hand now.

ad1e920d-c843-426d-82f4-62ee3e59e762.Text: Yrliet has gathered rumours of a group of surviving Aeldari from the lost craftworld of Crudarach. She asks that you travel to the Atlas Reach system to learn the fate of her home world.

ba1b2d17-b3c7-486f-90ed-25d1ae34cc3f.Text: The nameless void station where traitors of the Imperium secretly meet with xenos is situated in the Hundred Dreams Crossroads. Achilleas Scalander will escort the Rogue Trader to the destination point to help eradicate the heretics.

9ebfc582-f56f-444c-bf05-cd2f86ea285c.Text: Travel to the Hundred Dreams Crossroads

d35e4e5d-602e-4c1c-808c-2ba99bd01882.Text: Based on the intel, a meeting between Kunrad Voigtvir and the leader of the Drukhari will soon take place at the void station. Achilleas Scalander recommends ambushing and capturing the conspirators.

3009bfa4-15cd-4ccd-9353-39ff68fa6397.Text: Part of the escort group has concealed themselves at the entrance of a massive ventilation shaft.

9a09be0e-fee9-4058-b94c-12b49cb58e4a.Text: The Rogue Trader's enforcers used the conspirators' supplies to make and place tripwires.

b06fbdfc-c480-40aa-a35a-9d1763e99319.Text: Part of the escort group has prepared an ambush at the centre of the void station.

ab3c305d-0b81-45ff-8e13-237ab22fb3ed.Text: Turret controls have been hijacked by the Rogue Trader's technomats. The weapons are ready to fire.

0a5d8d4a-00f9-4311-b215-55adffacf9a7.Text: All the void station sections except the main one have been depressurised.

8590a834-36f6-4062-958a-da1eb14728ca.Text: The Rogue Trader managed to reach the void station and prepare an ambush for the traitors of the Imperium. That no longer matters, however — the Rogue Trader has more pressing issues at hand now.

684e06cb-44b7-4583-aac2-2ba5951514ec.Text: Achilleas's agents have picked up the trail of the traitors that helped the enemies of Humanity terrorise the protectorate and attack Dargonus. The mastermind behind the attacks is Kunrad Voigtvir, the former Master of Whispers who has betrayed the Rogue Trader and {mf|his|her} predecessor once before. The intel received by the Inquisition agents will help rid the von Valancius dynasty of two threats at once.

9fdb0ee7-8bbe-4819-844e-5340fe5d2c0f.Text: Find Glaito at the corpse dump

aa70e298-45ff-4506-9763-3ca978a12b9d.Text: Find out what happened to Solomorne

ff3a6933-9194-4951-a116-28c1cb905e7a.Text: Find Pasqal in the streets of Commorragh

d7c0c4eb-bd84-4f41-91af-297bfa14f6d8.Text: Save Abelard from the Mangled Sector

79107d3d-b009-4849-b69e-4c738f92b182.Text: Find Yrliet in the streets of the Chasm

199cad20-9612-460f-86bf-9066a57e187d.Text: Find the sarcophagus where Heinrix is being held

079f19f8-6965-45ab-8c19-5b1a09a97859.Text: Find the sarcophagus where Cassia is being held

6268f960-d9dc-4635-b0fb-718dd41b074d.Text: By collecting rumours and information on {mf|his|her} missing companions, the Lord Captain will be able to find them and learn about their fate.

c096ca89-0876-4750-afa9-0da9b544ceb0.Text: All of the Lord Captain's companions captured by the Drukhari have been located.

4aab4d4e-2da8-4972-b0b6-7ba4b940f636.Text: The Lord Captain's squad has been scattered throughout the Dark City. By reuniting with {mf|his|her} lost companions, the Lord Captain will increase {mf|his|her} chances of successfully escaping Commorragh.

08b52fde-fcea-4b43-b98a-f969e52afedb.Text: Wait for news from the von Valancius spies

a760fb90-ef31-4acf-ba3f-5539e52a26fd.Text: Find a way to escape Commorragh

04dafcbf-45e7-4fdd-9d76-b6bad4e8fabd.Text: Achilleas Scalander wants to personally meet with the Lord Captain to discuss a matter of the highest importance.

932b89ef-2cdc-40de-b0b8-27f13ccc670c.Text: The xenos Yrliet is insisting on a personal meeting with the Lord Captain — at some time when {mf|he|she} is not busy with {mf|his|her} direct duties.

a509ba5b-503e-459b-a392-b7cd002c61f1.Text: Being captured imposes certain unfortunate limitations on controlling the von Valancius protectorate directly. Until these circumstances are remedied, the Rogue Trader's duties of maintaining and enriching the dynasty are considered negligible.

ac356ff9-f316-4f18-8dd8-e12efe58bc1d.Text: The Lord Captain managed to escape to realspace — the Webway Gate has led {mf|him|her} to the agri-world of Janus. The voidship must be reached as soon as possible to regain control of the protectorate.

56d45517-164a-4fb3-9b58-382ce8f81b5a.Text: House Winterscale and House Chorda are displaying unusual activity at the borders of the protectorate. As soon as the Lord Captain's servants obtain additional information on their movements and intentions, it will be possible to plan further steps.

b1b85668-c894-4539-9799-0f540bcf2447.Text: Obtaining updates on the state of the protectorate and the actions of {mf|his|her} rivals took a long time, but the Lord Captain ultimately succeeded in escaping Commorragh and acquiring the crucial intel.

b8060fcb-74a3-4d27-a901-1e687e26b1f7.Text: Chancellor Werserian brought news of troubling events on Footfall and in other Rogue Trader dynasties. While von Valancius spies are busy collecting intel on the events unfolding in the Koronus Expanse, the Lord Captain needs to wait patiently and prepare for any unforeseen developments.

4bc9f64a-bf4a-4d1f-ac88-495652bc106a.Text: The Lord Captain came to {mf|his|her} senses atop a mountain of corpses in some dreadful place. {mf|He|she} needs to escape this place as soon as possible if {mf|he|she} does not want to join them.

b5e8de89-c422-4f7e-8281-a284bc6a20ee.Text: The Lord Captain is heavily wounded, {mf|he|she} has been robbed, and {mf|his|her} companions are nowhere to be found. Trapped in this disturbing place, {mf|he|she}, more than ever, needs to find shelter and medical aid, and plan {mf|his|her} next steps.

584d595a-f030-49e3-8312-11ba1b9486c0.Text: The Lord Captain has narrowly managed to escape death and find a safe shelter... of sorts. Now {mf|he|she} needs to plan {mf|his|her} next steps.

a14a110c-1966-4c4a-a780-890401259450.Text: The xenos underestimated the Lord Captain and discarded {mf|him|her} to the corpse dump. But their torture failed to finish off the Rogue Trader. The path to escape and vengeance starts at the very bottom of the grave.

48b029de-becb-45f4-b982-cd1d78b8d30c.Text: Eufrates II has been liberated — and the mysterious cargo that appears to have been the Lord Inquisitor's primary concern all along has been secured.

85712c9f-c0af-4c2d-8b82-af40022ddf1a.Text: Eufrates II is under the control of the heretics of the Final Dawn. It is the Lord Inquisitor's wish that the sacred world of the Adeptus Mechanicus be wrested from the hands of the traitors as expediently as possible. The right to deliver the Emperor's judgement belongs to the Rogue Trader.

3ab674a6-015c-4085-8b85-1b05324ed6c2.Text: The forces besieging Eufrates II are divided and will remain that way as long as their commanders are at odds. The Lord Inquisitor wants the Rogue Trader to take charge of planning the upcoming planetary assault.

8792e871-265b-43ad-b006-3ff96776a879.Text: So long as the heretics' ships continue to provide covering fire to the traitors' command centre from orbit, the ground forces cannot begin their advance. Therefore, the Rogue Trader's first step in this campaign is to engage the fleet.

83814bbc-2632-49f2-878a-7f7be23c8ecf.Text: Destroy the fleet covering the Machine Cathedral

bdb1a63b-8c8e-433d-8369-692db59fc41b.Text: The forces are ready and awaiting the Rogue Trader's order to commence the all-out offensive.

a316d2a0-706f-4163-8ba4-032618b7e844.Text: While the Space Wolves are distracting Uralon the Cruel, the Rogue Trader must find a way to reach the drilling platform and confront the leader of the heretics.

51afc90e-75fa-4de8-a683-6c538f0361aa.Text: When the Rogue Trader's opponents fall, the carnage on Eufrates II will be at an end.

40856786-a6e2-41be-adc5-f14848ba50ab.Text: Deal with the enemies in the drill shaft

ef0962c4-3396-4df2-86c3-0624ab39cc67.Text: The troops up on the world's surface will rejoice at hearing the news of the Rogue Trader's great triumph.

bc0e62eb-69a3-42d3-b799-d967a6a499fc.Text: Report the news of Uralon's defeat to the surface

5aae092f-af44-423a-99dc-f19e9408b26f.Text: Xavier Calcazar trusts the Lord Captain enough to share the burden of safeguarding the Koronus Expanse with {mf|him|her}. Their momentous meeting concluded with the Lord Inquisitor entrusting the fate of the world of Eufrates II, currently endangered, into the purview of House von Valancius.

55a5c74a-54ea-4de6-b439-d19848f5fbc5.Text: Lord Inquisitor Calcazar has instated himself as the warden of the Koronus Expanse and set up his headquarters on Footfall as the most logistically convenient location. The Lord Captain needs to meet with him to discuss the present state of events in the Expanse and the next plan of action.

9bfb5b09-1985-4252-aecb-4e1dc719d55a.Text: The Lord Inquisitor and the Lord Captain

8793a9c7-6b71-4d68-8c6f-a54a42891e5f.Text: Incendia Chorda currently controls Footfall. It is unlikely that the Lord Captain will be able to meet with Xavier Calcazar without first running into her.

fb68552c-e01f-450b-bdc9-0dd9e0d14ce6.Text: To determine the role of House von Valancius in the defence of the Koronus Expanse, the Lord Captain must go to Footfall and meet with Xavier Calcazar.

f934a012-2771-4cd5-993f-4f7487b0f948.Text: The Lord Inquisitor is not seeing any visitors on account of being preoccupied with matters of import. However daring it may sound, {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship} has no other way of meeting with Calcazar other than by waiting to be summoned.

d043f1ae-d2e4-491f-bbab-81db93de2a16.Text: Calcazar has sent word that he is ready to meet with the Lord Captain. He is waiting at the Liege's palace on Footfall, which now serves as his base of operations.

021c4c59-b088-4f32-851e-86ee1f8a409f.Text: The Lord Captain has passed the great judgement and decided who deserves to hold the reins on Footfall. Those who dared to contest their sentence were destroyed without mercy.

2fb61b1a-69f3-4a13-837f-6dc2e8e4bc66.Text: Rogue Trader Incendia Chorda has taken control of Footfall and brought her own justice and brutal executions of heretics to the station. The former Liege, Vladaym Tocara, has gone underground to oppose her. The Lord Captain's intervention could secure the victory for one side or the other.

6c20997b-2673-4fab-b503-14ca1986c46f.Text: Incendia Chorda wishes for Vladaym Tocara to stand trial. Footfall's asteroids are cordoned off by her enforcers, and the only solution that would grant the Lord Captain free run of the station is accepting Lady Chorda's proposition... or at least pretending to accept it.

f2ba3bdf-d075-41bb-b6cb-5a2ed4006612.Text: According to the information gathered by Chorda enforcers, Vladaym is holding secret meetings at the Adeptus Amasecus bar.

1990312a-7a0c-41fe-bafd-94d4c2e49d85.Text: According to the information gathered by Chorda enforcers, Vladaym is holding secret meetings at the Adeptus Amasecus bar. This could be the Lord Captain's chance to discuss the situation that Footfall finds itself in.

e58ada51-b02c-4638-8535-06dfde69dcc8.Text: Vladaym Tocara has decided to offer resistance. His rebellion must be quelled swiftly and harshly.

d6132ad8-a2bf-436f-ae06-d5fb5c650e19.Text: Vladaym wants to set up an ambush and lure Incendia Chorda from under the protection of her throne so she can be dealt with. Once the Lord Captain is prepared for battle, {mf|he|she} should inform the Liege that everything is ready, then {mf|he|she} can use {mf|his|her} agents to feed Incendia misinformation that will serve as bait.

46cbbeb1-787e-4c0e-a355-f9f9a4a84a53.Text: Lure Incendia to the Adeptus Amasecus

2f24df51-373d-4fca-992b-5d3cf3e8cb57.Text: Incendia Chorda is unwilling to release Footfall from her claws. It falls to the Lord Captain to break them.

080b32cf-26ea-44b0-95eb-e4955db786a2.Text: Reverend Hieronymus has turned against the Lord Captain. This brazen display needs to be subdued and his fanatical congregation executed.

f37670c5-c335-426a-881e-f4af0bbf4ef0.Text: The wicked power of xenotechnology has allowed the Haemonculus to create multiple copies of himself. Not one of them must be allowed to leave the world of Quetza Temer.

cb756ec5-a61a-4e94-84ac-0efe445005c0.Text: Since his last encounter with the Rogue Trader — and his ignominious defeat — not only has the Haemonculus found a way to revive himself, he has created multiple copies of himself. Not one of them must be allowed to leave the world of Quetza Temer.

73d4fb74-1dc1-462d-9af8-fca957bdf771.Text: Part of the Haemonculus's laboratory was destroyed by an intense force of unknown origin. It would be prudent to investigate the rubble thoroughly.

7e7d8635-eaf2-482b-8ba3-c297812f76fe.Text: Tervantias the Archmachinator, Haemonculus, master of flesh and pain, has been vanquished along with his abhorrent creations. Alas, there was nothing in his laboratory that could be of interest to the Rogue Trader. Nevertheless, the Haemonculus's death is a true blessing for both the system and the Koronus Expanse as a whole.

85865aa1-5596-4b8f-9bea-7b06a873789a.Text: The Aeldari who arrived on Quetza Temer were expecting to find Tervantias the Archmachinator, a figure all too familiar to the Rogue Trader. Having discovered Tervantias's laboratory, the Rogue Trader now has a chance to learn what secrets his hideout has to offer.

e64e8df8-04e6-4c10-9f52-e8308b9a44f8.Text: The laboratory may still hold some evidence of Tervantias's presence and the products of his unholy research.

bbb66419-4fdd-4d66-acab-2ed7bc3695b9.Text: Rumour has it that Calligos Winterscale does not have the slightest concern about events in the Koronus Expanse and instead prefers to spend his time hunting. Now may be a good time for the head of the von Valancius dynasty to pay a visit to {mf|his|her} eminent peer.

d91ec759-c3e4-4c6d-a1eb-68fe7d1afc4a.Text: Go to the world of Quetza Temer

54b29ded-b183-44f7-93ab-5f43351c42f2.Text: The Winterscale flagship was last able to contact Calligos's hunting party approximately thirty days ago. The only clue to the whereabouts of the missing Rogue Trader is the coordinates at which his personal shuttle last landed.

91ca9f28-1113-4b2d-b5f8-8491601800d7.Text: On Quetza Temer, the Rogue Trader encountered a most uncommon anomaly of planetary flora known as silvus vagarum — a way-changing forest. No one could have predicted this development, so the Lord Captain will have to improvise.

bc1717de-f1ef-4e27-b0c0-b8e7335090f5.Text: Find a way out of the jungle

b613c80d-5c8e-4dfd-ba7f-bde902483d9d.Text: The priest performed the ritual, and now the way through the forests is clear. Calligos Winterscale has proposed to finish the hunt before returning to the ships.

0018b5d6-2c7d-451a-975c-1839e3394fa2.Text: Decide the fate of the Aeldari

e0302512-5c8c-45c2-9664-6e8ee0138939.Text: The Rogue Trader has managed to reach the inner sanctum of the Haemonculus Tervantias. The Lord Captain must discover what exactly the xenos was hiding here — and if there is anyone alive within these walls.

cf46c6b5-8c35-4f5f-8b46-e89f8db13cd2.Text: Evidence of the Haemonculus Tervantias's presence has been discovered on Calligos Winterscale's world. The fastest way to reach the Haemonculus's hideout is by taking the ship along a parallel around the southern hemisphere. The officers have already added the approximate coordinates to the hololithic map of the planet.

47f4cf8c-3cd5-4a28-8501-ef785bb4cd48.Text: Speaks-With-Gods has sent the Rogue Trader a vision where Calligos Winterscale was drowning in an ocean of blood. The Lord Captain must return to the village and assess the situation.

2b1d031a-acc1-467a-b11a-905a98f7a695.Text: Speaks-With-Gods, a priest from the settlement that the Rogue Trader has discovered, may be able to perform a ritual that would tame the forest, but he was called into service by Calligos Winterscale and disappeared along with him.

f4f91f25-a4ee-441e-b2ce-70a8bc53327f.Text: The priest Speaks-With-Gods can perform a ritual that will cleanse the forest — as soon as he finds his way back to his home settlement.

f1bd62da-e4b0-46c4-979d-68f9888b0fb8.Text: Find the way to the settlement

7ddeaa02-90de-43c4-98af-e54bc1e2131b.Text: The priest turned out to be a powerful psyker. He must be escorted back to his home settlement so that he may perform the ritual.

70998c37-a5dc-470d-b670-3a58dca8437b.Text: On Quetza Temer, {name} von Valancius made a series of fateful decisions that greatly impacted many lives. Time will tell how much wisdom there was in the choices {mf|he|she} made.

4e56936c-a911-4067-a362-4644ccdd7416.Text: Calligos Winterscale has turned one of his own planets into hunting grounds where the game is the Aeldari who have launched an attack on the world. House von Valancius could offer a helping hand to one of the sides of this conflict... or eliminate both of them.

85f854b9-750e-43a5-966b-43fe265be5a6.Text: The Lord Inquisitor should be at his headquarters on Footfall, at the Liege's palace. There, the Rogue Trader will demand answers to all {mf|his|her} questions.

f841c1ce-45d1-4a50-9f86-e13be0cb3f09.Text: According to Footfall's residents, the Lord Inquisitor and his people departed from the station with an unknown destination. Perhaps the palace still holds clues that could tell the Rogue Trader where Calcazar is headed.

030cb48a-2963-4a38-9b14-dd23eb250aa4.Text: Xavier Calcazar's expedition went through an ancient dimensional gate. To catch up to him, the Lord Captain will have to venture into the unknown.

5d587e8f-ee08-4d2c-93d0-026cc5059345.Text: Follow Calcazar through the dimensional gate

cbb27008-05b6-4653-8bc1-aedc84a7bb27.Text: The Lord Inquisitor has eluded the Rogue Trader by leading an expedition to the other side of an ancient dimensional gate. There, somewhere in those unexplored star systems, lie the answers to the Lord Captain's questions.

07d123e5-c0d2-47a5-948f-89795b58ba3c.Text: Calcazar's interest in Eufrates II now seems stranger still in light of the Tech-Priest Axiomantha's revelations. The Lord Captain is well within {mf|his|her} rights to demand answers from the Lord Inquisitor about the nature of the fearsome weapon that was buried in the depths of Eufrates II and about Calcazar's intentions regarding its use.

b85fb8a4-deed-4c71-8aeb-80a213433d4f.Text: Find a way to pass through the mines

9ad0c141-adfa-434b-b1ab-19bb908151bb.Text: Order the Vox Master to initiate landing

b7fbb8f9-e8c4-4f4e-9d79-40a575251514.Text: The C'tan Shard has fallen. The fate of the Koronus Expanse is in the hands of the victor.

0939c71b-43cf-4ca1-a633-50743a49d997.Text: Unexplored systems lit by nameless stars — this is where the Rogue Trader's pursuit of the Lord Inquisitor has led {mf|him|her}. This is where everything will be decided.

71e57d34-7fdd-43f3-adb4-a4b54a46044e.Text: To Walk Bravely First Into Darkness

4f79d428-8e39-46c2-ac4d-83f314691749.Text: Beyond the dimensional gate, the Lord Inquisitor's trail goes cold. The Rogue Trader must find clues that could point {mf|him|her} to where he headed next.

6bf4d3ed-ce08-4744-9d78-41bdd2ce9d66.Text: Xavier Calcazar went to the surface of the world of Epitaph. The Rogue Trader has no choice but to go after him.

2229bba7-d4fa-4f65-9a1f-d76b399ef3eb.Text: To find Calcazar, the Rogue Trader will have to descend into the depths of a crumbling xenos tomb.

acbe7277-50f9-44c0-8764-f0d5748c08f8.Text: The Lord Inquisitor's plans were not meant to come to fruition — the Rogue Trader has arrived not a moment too soon.

6d0b6b2f-ccef-48eb-bd18-b43b250a444e.Text: The ancient monstrosity has left its prison. This entity must be stopped and chained before it can break out into the world in all its annihilating might.

5bd3dfb8-7f69-40d5-ad58-f8eec67b083a.Text: A web of giant cities dominates whole continents of this world. The population numbers in the hundreds of millions, occupying the many city spires — although only a precious few can boast that they've ever seen the sky.

2926460a-1725-4f57-a21b-b13ff3685506.Text: This small station is a grain of sand lost in the depths of the void. Its inhabitants hope to serve the Imperium lest their home be erased from the astrogation charts.

4fbefda0-e685-464e-b0c8-e9633ff6a555.Text: The station's population is 10k or less.

0ce7434f-0f18-4749-80da-06fe45e35a1a.Text: A small settlement that is barely protected from pirates, predators, and other calamities. The people are starting to make use of the planet's resources, praying some unseen threat won't sap the life from their meagre colony.

fbb641a4-2400-41df-9fba-aca4d5c86dc9.Text: The outpost's population is 50k or less.

468de0de-55b6-44e4-b915-e67dd8b175a1.Text: The local populace has not only managed to gain a foothold on this world, but has even begun small-scale manufacturing, justifying the Rogue Trader's expenses and their insignificant lives.

387b91f7-97f9-4778-a53f-2cbc37529c08.Text: The factorium's population is 250k or less.

4eb6f1c6-78ec-489c-817b-1593d117ac19.Text: This world is populated by savages who steer clear of the governor's palace, "for in there lives a god." But even these simple-minded folk can be put to good use for the benefit of the Rogue Trader.

5c84bd4b-1254-4aab-a0dd-0dd5c6201287.Text: The feral world's population is 500k or less.

5274249d-3381-411f-8b1d-f25a5a165bb9.Text: This colony is yet another testament to the Imperium's greed which claimed so many worlds for the Emperor's glory. Its citizens feel secure in their reinforced fortresses and are already greedily setting their gaze on other nearby worlds.

8b8e924b-e8e1-4ec9-8b90-21dc7e3862e7.Text: The frontier world's population is 1m or less.

2efbe275-7bdf-4509-ba81-467051832d7c.Text: The excess of manpower combined with the lack of technology make this world feudal. The highborn, with their monopoly on technology and violence, rule over uneducated, obedient serfs who break their backs in the fields and mines.

68930c46-e962-4042-a211-52b1ec348c52.Text: The feudal world's population is 10m or less

f051c2de-fa06-46d2-a253-cb64597cffc5.Text: This is a typical colony found on the Imperium's fringes — a poor and ragged world tied economically to brilliant and wealthy hive worlds.

6f01185d-4f77-4bc3-b639-8fe912008aac.Text: The backward world's population is 50m or less.

684e21f8-53a3-4a1f-befa-3aa92dedfc66.Text: The city spires of this colony grow taller with each day, as its manufactorums and fundi take over ever more land, spreading the Emperor's power all over the planet.

0a50c024-04e0-449f-b80e-829d0baf737a.Text: The upcoming world's population is 250m or less

86cc7932-a6cd-4660-b470-09d61d3b04a7.Text: The Imperium and its technology have conquered this world, subjugated its nature and turned an unknown planet into one of the subsectors most important financial and industrial hubs.

a6197467-cdbd-40c5-8b90-ae6bdad4e682.Text: The civilised world's population is 500m or less.

f41dec62-27ec-407d-834f-41e9d1c33457.Text: Voidship captains are a superstitious lot, and for a good reason. This world is so notorious among the voidfarers that few would risk visiting it.

5680e81f-e286-4488-8c74-8848295f1cac.Text: The colony suffers a −50 accessibility penalty.

63942da1-0380-4441-9efa-fc32e4baf825.Text: It's hard to fathom why, but the Immaterium cares little about this world. Travelling through the warp poses virtually no risk.

3c414088-cf37-4bd3-aa0f-f2d20fd8816d.Text: The colony receives a +50 accessibility bonus.

27ef5358-ee2e-4b59-951c-2425f7fb8c88.Text: This world was once run by Archenemy worshippers. Their cult is long gone, but whispers of their evil deeds and forbidden secrets still permeate through the shadows of this world.

98948213-e239-4f29-8a0e-53694e44368a.Text: The colony suffers a −30 contentment penalty.

90b817d0-792e-453f-b6a6-17b691af7b9e.Text: This planet's core is encased in a trans-diamond shell.

930c40c3-59dd-4b5e-a189-97fd419384b6.Text: All extractiums produce 2x trans-diamonds in addition to standard resources. Trans-diamonds provide the protectorate's extractiums with a +20% productivity bonus.

62ebacc4-d630-497f-a6d4-8dc172d73f18.Text: This world either has an unbreathable atmosphere or none at all. People can live here only under huge domes full of stale, reprocessed air.

f9390951-ee99-43ce-a0fb-fcd6ae919ff2.Text: All fundi suffer a −50% productivity penalty.

fad5af8f-a369-4dda-ab79-35be39f948f4.Text: This world has no shortage of energy and is capable of providing plenty of power to its own industry.

17fcd50d-258d-4149-8528-42b33558b972.Text: The colony receives a +50 efficiency bonus.

8ec07535-a6cd-45de-a576-9488a6bf862c.Text: This forge world is a lost treasure of the Adeptus Mechanicus. The pict-screens of its cogitators are a lifeless black; the machines have been silent for centuries, waiting, shackled in dream.

5347179d-ff18-4f2e-9567-445d003a95e6.Text: The colony receives a +N efficiency bonus and +N% bonus to production of servitors, cogitators, machines, weapons, military vehicles, and voidship components.

d924a88f-78f9-4a72-a3a1-43541dfc8539.Text: Not every world welcomes colonists. A few of them are rocky deserts or frozen wastelands. Development of a colony in such a place demands patience and means.

54600fa9-db08-4c4d-b419-c19e864534b8.Text: The colony suffers a −50% efficiency penalty.

4ae1d6f3-59b4-4ff6-843d-7618f2a6020c.Text: This world is safe: devoid of aggressive predators, extreme climate conditions, or other dangers. To live here is to be blessed by the Emperor himself.

a429d1f0-7ba2-4084-b66a-4fbe96bde731.Text: The colony receives a +50 contentment bonus.

71536213-011b-41f0-ab61-3cd97fd4c47f.Text: The local populace consists of mutants and degenerates, unwelcoming to the arrival of colonists. They raid the colony and sabotage the production lines at any opportunity.

43ee2e98-61c9-475a-9437-1a2247bc1a4c.Text: The colony suffers a −50 security penalty.

a43ce448-dda7-4972-80b8-2f9ce99576cf.Text: Some of the local herbs are not mentioned in the official records of Magi Biologis and are kept in secret. They contain priceless chemicals that can bring immense power to owner of this world.

bfa0b7a6-ccdb-42ec-9136-68496b058ec3.Text: All fundi produce 2x tranq-obedience in addition to standard resources. Having tranq-obedience provides a +50% contentment bonus to all colonies within the protectorate.

74e303e2-5f06-457d-a08a-2a091ac7329a.Text: An abundantly warm and humid world teeming with dense forests.

6ac42de5-82de-4fe0-b487-402d71965b12.Text: All fundi receive a +100% productivity bonus.

ba6a4816-23a0-4f83-933d-1488de3c4cb3.Text: Among the abundant flora of this world, there is a plant well suited to making lho. There remains little doubt that labourers will cultivate them for this specific purpose, no matter how harsh the punishment.

01c2f62e-7a81-4099-b6b8-562a19fc0ac7.Text: All fundi produce 5x lho in addition to regular crops.

cd45d077-076b-42ce-80ce-07222c41867c.Text: A mysterious mineral called vitagen can be found in the planet's crust. The Adeptus Mechanicus trace its origin to some xenos technology, although its creators remain unknown.

cef95b11-bb67-4fdb-9a17-db6329ec8ec6.Text: All extractiums produce 1x vitagen in addition to standard resources. Vitagen provides all fundi in the protectorate with a +50% productivity bonus.

2bcc51f7-1b31-45f9-9a91-b0d82eee4b36.Text: This world was once inhabited, but then fell into ruin. Its grave-spires are abandoned, the blast furnaces of manufactorums extinguished. However, the potential of this world justifies the expense of restoring it dilapidated industry.

ba71f018-05d1-486b-bd1c-755f52d0ec39.Text: All manufactorums receive a +50% productivity bonus.

cf7fb544-a57b-475b-a4cd-4c310071c3e5.Text: On this thinly planet, the low gravity helps shuttles and voidships to land on its surface. Without the restrictions of heavy gravity, certain Imperium crops can reach gigantic sizes.

b641d091-eb78-4c27-9007-8023b9200709.Text: The colony receives a +30 bonus to accessibility. Fundi receive a +50% productivity bonus.

bcfae866-f09d-4dd4-8594-00f5c683b740.Text: Cogitators and other machines, necessary for the functioning of manufactorums, can barely function on this world due to constant magnetic storms.

f5b71a36-a900-4b54-8413-8c6348a9f60e.Text: All manufactorums suffer a −100% productivity penalty.

226f212d-800b-4a3b-948c-7af62e3c821e.Text: This world is covered in mountains and with large cavern complexes, making it easy to protect and isolate the colony's vital industrial complexes.

641ff205-d7ef-435e-929f-f8ce587fff00.Text: The colony receives a +50 security bonus.

f30eca17-4a92-499c-967e-f2419bdfe71d.Text: The ocean that covers this world's surface is teeming with life. On such planets, colonists have to build giant platforms for reaching the seabed to extract minerals.

6a70ce26-f53c-4fad-8bfe-991172920af1.Text: All fundi receive a +150% productivity bonus. All extractiums suffer a −100% productivity penalty. Any building is 100% more expensive.

d7a473e3-c848-43a9-89f6-a817337f1e73.Text: Only criminals are sent to harsh worlds like this. Under constant watch, they toil to serve the Rogue Trader, to learn obedience. Awaiting those who can't be rehabilitated is the fate of eternal mechanical servitude.

89457697-59e7-453e-a21f-709b510c1321.Text: The colony suffers a -N efficiency penalty and receive a +N% bonus to production of servitors. Contentment can never drop lower than Security.

faf5350c-3521-498d-a39b-4c97320d630f.Text: The Inquisition's edict explicitly forbids any contact with this world under penalty of death. Very few dare to even consider defying this order.

631f63db-5f23-4a04-b23a-7049bb99b14a.Text: The colony suffers a -N accessibility penalty.

62bad703-4861-4718-b0b6-a467d2d684a9.Text: Mining on this world is incredibly difficult due to the swamps that cover most of the planet's surface.

00be04a2-b111-4be0-81ba-3ac2586750d2.Text: All extractiums suffer a −50% productivity penalty.

e82667c5-d5bb-4958-ae86-7a52c9d07a99.Text: This world attracts the adherents of Saint Drusus as a convenient beachhead for the future acquisition of the Koronus Expanse. The cult is ready to help the colony on this planet with resources and manpower by providing it with pilgrims.

54d433db-c288-415f-a412-d7ee3cffbcc6.Text: +N BP per cycle is added to the trade network.

d5a38425-6fef-402c-9659-7a19270cd47f.Text: This world is inhabited by numerous docile natives, ready to accept Imperial Compliance. These obedient workers will serve well in building a protectorate.

d34c4bfa-2e27-4fde-94fa-6bfbca71c749.Text: +N BP per cycle is added to the trade network.

f7631bfd-87e2-44f6-875b-08aeed5785cd.Text: This world is blessed, and even the tiniest of holy trinkets, brought from here, carry special significance in the eyes of believers. To prove their loyalty to the Emperor, devout artisans from these worlds create holy icons and sigils in their off-hours.

006ffe32-db60-40c8-a98c-ca6632aca206.Text: All manufactorums produce 1x holy icons in addition to standard resources. Holy icons provide all colonies within the protectorate with a +100% contentment bonus.

26a54b67-6689-488d-9697-2cf4f9e4f9c2.Text: The planet's crust is rich in ore, precious stones, and other minerals.

a92364a3-f358-472d-9710-031da8d92b15.Text: All extractiums receive a +50% productivity bonus.

ae781463-faab-44cc-a7c5-657028e4cf20.Text: The planet has abundant minerals due to active seismic processes. These processes also cause earthquakes that threaten industrial infrastructure.

3f724182-f679-402b-8436-3792f73956b5.Text: The colony suffers a −50 security penalty. All extractiums also receive a +100% productivity bonus.

69ea1ed2-9c53-4246-b73c-0f54c48d795a.Text: The colony suffers a −50 security penalty.

bf36c19d-f257-498d-98a6-e8de7b141ed8.Text: The colony suffers a −50 contentment penalty.

e7276c0f-b80f-4284-a585-d33e639dee57.Text: Each cycle the population has a chance of shrinking instead of growing. The colony suffers a −70 penalty to accessibility, security, efficiency, and contentment.

7540624d-226a-4d7b-970a-87a69b4817c1.Text: The colony suffers a −100% efficiency penalty.

a9ace350-ccfa-4aa1-ab16-720153ab3ca4.Text: The colony has exhausted their supply of food, bodies of the starved mysteriously disappear before officials have a chance to remove them.

0ec627a5-fd08-4812-950a-c8d090bbb4f4.Text: Each cycle the population has a chance of shrinking instead of growing.

e4777529-072e-4fc7-b9b0-fd21b625e284.Text: Anomalous starlight has inexplicably caused dramatic growth in local plants.

57dd0c90-7ff8-4b88-85cf-0fc96baf5a4e.Text: All fundi receive a +50% productivity bonus.

4ad2880e-a562-468d-985e-9bd572fa4f32.Text: The colony's population growth is halted.

e105b8a7-4dad-42c2-801f-d0149929388e.Text: A tectonic rift has allowed access to previously unavailable ore deposits.

b2126ed1-808d-4f3a-a5e5-5da6871dd2a7.Text: All extractiums receive a +50% productivity bonus.

2da99964-ba81-4b10-b324-c3b3d13af6b6.Text: A storm in the Immaterium has cut this world off from the rest of the protectorate. Voidships that dare travel there bring unclean and ungodly horrors from the warp to realspace.

bce1a8ae-19d9-46b4-8127-0cb9d2862939.Text: The colony suffers a −100 accessibility penalty.

f8e916c2-c1dc-4542-bf14-91f0293d24e4.Text: Lord Inquisitor Xavier Calcazar has sent his agents to many worlds. They are accepting "donations to the Inquisition" from local governments in the form of troops, weapons, munitions, and equipment. It seems that Lord Inquisitor Xavier Calcazar believes that war is brewing in the Koronus Expanse and wishes to prepare. Those who offer the honourable Calcazar valuable gifts will gain influence and prestige.

5afa8bdb-fa7e-4d9f-8cf7-459084914c57.Text: The syndicate that supplied Footfall with highly illegal contraband have perished in a warp storm along with their ship and cargo. Vladaym Tokara is looking for a new supplier to fulfil the needs of his station's more "stimulated" denizens.

2e0c3868-d9ca-45b3-8c53-69f825246121.Text: Prefect 4-11 is hoping to reorganise the local office of the Departmento Munitorum by creating a full list of questors and their tasks. This requires the computational capacity of many cogitators and the prefect is looking for suppliers who can provide it.

6056b5cc-7918-4c24-8b07-82041ac52f93.Text: Calligos Winterscale is planning a great hunt on the jungle world of Tvalde IV. His hunters will need hundreds of harvesters for deforestation and trucks to carry the carcasses of slaughtered beasts.

5a0e1501-9c2b-4f23-a608-f375733e7dd2.Text: A priceless mineral, waiting for the hands of caring workers to extract it from the bedrock and use it for the benefit of Humanity.

62ecdb6b-95a6-41a4-a5f4-e71c5129ce4b.Text: A strong liquor that comes in many varieties. Some are fit for nobles, and the others, well, they're swill for commoners.

282dd87a-b7f6-4176-9086-0c0050903dd4.Text: Armaplas is a high-quality rolled armour which can be used in a Guardsman's helmet or in Leman Russ tank; it does the job.

2ad0426c-78e5-4529-90bb-9f66e5d61011.Text: The ceramsand will be cleaned and ground into a dry dust that will serve as an excellent base for viscous mortar and heat-resistant ceramite armour.

e06bf6ec-0df4-446b-b793-902d0302efe4.Text: This is a weak plant-based narcotic which helps labourers deal with stress after the work day or in the lull between battles.

24110105-1351-4df8-a917-175619f0d4d6.Text: A popular narcotic that gifts blissful hallucinatory oblivion to many tainted souls.

8fa90310-b635-42fa-8822-67f2b0278409.Text: Cogitators are expensive to make and hard to use, but the Imperium can't function properly without the Omnissiah's blessed machines.

7ac0153d-d009-4c41-bcc5-320e2e24fbd8.Text: Cheap and durable, rockcrete is used as the main building material throughout the Imperium.

4e92eb41-fc01-4b5d-8024-1103720d2e2d.Text: This type of food has the same nutrition value as the basic rations, but costs significantly more. Only the precious few can afford to delight in the taste of real vegetables, fruits, and meats.

e4ca355a-a9db-4e6a-91d6-25803e0b1f93.Text: This loose and highly flammable substance is an irreplaceable component in the manufacture of all ammunition and explosives.

67399571-0e0d-4397-ab8d-dca9a5025011.Text: Dangerously explosive fyceline sand is placed in the hands of only the most skilled miners. The inept ones run the risk of soon having no hands at all.

f602724f-7155-46b8-8223-dbe2fdb33600.Text: This gas is released when any type of organic matter decomposes, whether it be plants, animals, or humans. In its purified form it is a great source of energy.

c3c78126-24ca-4788-9402-74388b5855a3.Text: Holy images of the Emperor and His saints fill the souls of His loyal subjects with determination and faith.

c43f5c4c-ed95-4597-ba5d-5a5179d1a32b.Text: To follow the light of the Astronomican, voidships and their components require the best quality materials, the most precise calculations, and the most careful assembly.

c4bdcf78-c992-4dac-a1a2-7dcb1018c5d5.Text: Mineral formations containing iron are found in a bedrock.

6d482b4f-2d9b-48d7-92d9-e734a8c5bb52.Text: Plasteel is made from iron which makes it one of the most necessary materials in the whole Imperium.

b0f943cf-0dc0-45e1-b96d-10895006db92.Text: Heavy vehicles of various function driven by powerful, yet obedient machine spirits.

893ce9b9-8b13-4ec9-86b8-64731d93e561.Text: A universal first-aid kit that includes basic medications in form of pills, sprays, and detox-injections.

4e355c80-a9dc-4a2a-8440-dbde50ee8883.Text: Noctilith is a rare and expensive material. Xenos use it to build their mysterious Blackstone Fortresses.

6539c390-efba-4d6b-aac4-34eb95394cc1.Text: Organics are not really valuable on their own, but they can be used to fertilise farms and fundi.

cfd76b5a-1382-4ccc-b4ea-bfcd04ebc49d.Text: Ferrocrete fortified with plasteel beams is capable of serving as the foundation for even the colossal spires of hive worlds.

4f907449-3699-4c31-b1c3-c17780ce2440.Text: Flesh is weak, and the feeble human brain is the main source of such weakness. Thankfully, servitors are bereft of most brain activity, which makes them excellent at the most monotonous and laborious tasks.

5152d0b5-aa77-4e16-9263-ef12b27b4890.Text: Imperial worlds are in constant need of protection. They require skilled fighters, ones who would rather die for the Emperor than live for themselves.

01b35a42-d2fe-4fa7-a113-6a38c9384b07.Text: This light and smooth sand is found almost everywhere and is the main ingredient for the production of building materials.

e237d40f-32f9-47fb-8532-168289910207.Text: Ceramite is durable, light, and heat-resistant, which makes it perfect armour for both warriors and transportation.

07cf55a1-39fe-4cfd-97a4-127f4e3e0df5.Text: Substances, found in some plants, display certain effects on the will of users, making them highly suggestible and completely loyal. Influential servants of the Imperium are especially fond of these compounds and their effects.

4a52ed8e-76ac-45c9-9f36-d0b8541e0c65.Text: The unbelievable hardness of these diamonds, formed in the depths of planet's crust, are used to coat the most powerful drilling machines.

dd4b18ac-1242-4988-bcb5-0c48821d82cd.Text: This mysterious and unstudied mineral has a strange effect on organics, accelerating their growth many times over. The Magi Biologis have still not studied its effects on humans.

e94a55cb-2015-4e0a-9ccd-495c33fdb4c0.Text: These intimidating machines are protected with a holy ceramite shell and armed with the Emperor's righteous wrath.

315582f5-20ae-4752-b6fb-e2fc7f6c1c27.Text: "This is madness. You will destroy the industrial world by your own hand!"

09683d75-e53b-42b5-9e52-38a0f169cf25.Text: "You are once again mumbling something about my blood..."

9b5d034e-df9d-46d3-b449-5e2dfe418346.Text: "Hmm. No pain, no torture. Your sorcery no longer has the power to hurt me, does it?"

d45375d5-b54c-4c0a-b42f-279b66fc398c.Text: "Bend the knee? I'd rather make you call me 'master,' pathetic mutant."

1ce68395-a4dd-4156-bcbe-5bc28d63a3bd.Text: "May the Emperor shield me from the corruption of your slander!"

7f04250f-53ea-4658-81fa-bad5936e9435.Text: "Leave the planet now and take your vermin with you, and I promise there will be no pursuit."

3fb4a13a-146d-4f26-8093-5eb369b8ba83.Text: "Theodora may have tainted herself by consorting with Chaos, but I will correct her mistakes."

5ea20f8f-d8a9-4a78-86bd-19170a84ce42.Text: "What 'Sanctum Sanctorum' of Kiava Gamma are you talking about?"

c71bf445-ba8c-4de6-af01-08a36e6820c5.Text: "Theodora crossed the line for the sake of the forgotten treasures of the Expanse. Isn't that what we Rogue Traders are supposed to do? Unveil the mysteries of the cosmos?"
