cc6ac984-c73f-40ab-ac1a-92e2a2406572.Text: "I have already found a good use for my soul, not to mention my body, so please excuse me as I reject your generous offer."

60659023-fa5e-46d5-87b3-ade9ab5fa52f.Text: "Have you considered that recruiting works best when you offer the mark something valuable instead of 'Kneel, worm, I will make use of you'?"

2ad53ff3-b392-4485-bcc6-21ad213430ab.Text: "It is a shame Theodora's deeds cost millions of people their lives and caused tremendous suffering."

afd1e940-203b-493b-ac9a-96d9a499a807.Text: "I am wondering how your tongue hasn't yet gone numb from these pompous yet shallow platitudes."

01a1ef76-3c9b-4e70-8788-3f6d6466a59d.Text: "You are dreaming in vain. You are not leaving this mine shaft alive."

0514a8de-dbeb-4ae4-b296-8d74a91d4032.Text: "Are you responsible for Stronghold's destruction? Your henchmen destroyed the sun and the entire system along with it!"

b4d2361e-f5bf-446e-9da5-afd75dc4f4a0.Text: "I will destroy you and everyone on Kiava Gamma who has already bowed down before Chaos."

53fcfd8f-3325-431d-be5e-efdcfa1bf7bc.Text: "It was the Dark Apostle again. He confirmed what he had been hinting at before — Theodora was in contact with him and availed herself of the gifts of Chaos."

6916c6d1-8243-441e-ae70-728ced13bcfb.Text: "The machinations of Chaos. Let us move on."

4c3ec7ae-1469-400a-a6eb-476ee657979e.Text: "You are opening warp portals from here? But how?"

8126b5d2-2385-4753-b7d6-429a9e2e9be9.Text: {n}Blood starts pounding in your temples and a wave of nausea comes over you — these familiar feelings predate the appearance of a black maelstrom around you and a tall figure walking toward you through smoke and ash. Uralon crosses his arms and examines you with interest laced with revulsion.{/n}

cb3b3961-73fb-41ec-9e20-17458b48755a.Text: "Each mortal is a lock that calls for a matching key. Ones like you and your predecessor are driven by avarice. Approaching Theodora was not easy, but an overlooked flaw in her entourage and a suitable lure was all it took... No Rogue Trader can resist the call of profit, and Theodora's will faltered when I promised her treasure beyond her wildest dreams."

04bd8a49-311a-44f7-87ce-ee52edf1bb16.Text: {n}Your companions are looking at you with concern, obviously wondering if you are all right.{/n}

c25af0ac-7f38-4e05-8879-37c2c6e4752a.Text: "Quite the contrary, Rogue Trader. A daemonic world spawned from a planet with such infrastructure will become a foundry releasing hundreds and thousands of engines of Truth into the world every passing day. Once the metamorphosis is complete, Kiava Gamma will become the jewel in the necklace that is the Final Dawn."

cb8aa490-fad8-4ada-a395-c216d3d13b90.Text: "I am aware. The spirits carried his final breath on their wings. The Tech-Priest served the Primordial Truth well and perished defending the planet's most precious treasure — the key to its ascension."

679235a4-6f47-467b-9fae-da450143320c.Text: {n}The sister's words ring with a genuine, sincere hope for a better fate for you. She does not appear to be shocked by the news of Theodora's betrayal.{/n}

a76f4856-6989-4886-afdd-16f94074a00e.Text: "I possess many mysteries, Rogue Trader. Though I equally respect all the Ruinous Powers, I serve the greatest among them — the one that reveals secrets and bestows truth upon those willing to pay for the privilege. Creating portals from psyker souls is but the smallest of the rewards I received for serving the Changer of Ways."

59560ce9-06cc-49bb-a532-4fed16b8697e.Text: "So boasts the twig seeking to stop an avalanche. So be it, amuse me with your hubris — and your inevitable downfall."

70a7adf4-548a-4c5f-98e3-eb0086256234.Text: "It seems the victory over the Fabricator-Censor has gone to your head, Rogue Trader. Your mortal weapons are powerless beneath the vaults of this temple to the Truth — as you will soon discover for yourself."

f94a4732-5c95-4dd6-afe1-12ef579f9d5b.Text: "Hah! Your Emperor is the grandest deception in the history of Humanity! Begging an illusion to deliver you from lies? Pathetic. At least your predecessor forwent righteous hypocrisy when she colluded with the envoy of the Primordial Truth."

82ee14fa-5fc6-48e7-b406-0f1509b689b8.Text: "Word Bearers have refused to back down against threats far greater than a handful of mortals. My servants will crush you and use what is left to decorate idols honouring the true gods."

c21c8c77-ae60-4197-afc0-aa4db48b2780.Text: "Come to me, Rogue Trader. Lay your life on the altar of the new Kiava Gamma. I will be waiting." {n}The vortex engulfs Uralon's figure and quickly dissipates, revealing the grim underground chambers ahead.{/n}

3232f3c0-bc5d-4400-af38-785735201426.Text: "It does not look like you are surprised by this revelation. Good. That means there is willingness in your soul to accept your fate and serve the Primordial Truth already. Theodora was more stubborn — she fancied herself mistress of her own destiny. She was not."

615a8533-33c3-4e88-a29c-d2268013d7ee.Text: {n}Your companions exchange grim glances. It feels as though the very mention of dark powers makes the gloom in the far corners of the chamber coalesce into an impenetrable black shroud.{/n}

16205d4f-6456-40a6-82bc-e3b8608e5b51.Text: "That pittance was enough to keep the Rogue Trader away from Kiava Gamma and the Fabricator-Censor who laid the foundations for the coup. Theodora paid me with this world — a fair exchange, though she was unaware of it. One way or the other, you are her heir and you are here, trying to claim what is not yours. The temerity of Imperial worms will not go unanswered. Kneel like your pathetic dynasty was meant to, and I may find a better use for your body and soul."

44fcee84-06f9-4c81-8c7a-145da3136bfb.Text: "Collusion is not the word one should use to describe the blind. You dogs of the corpse emperor, you all fancy yourselves paragons of courage and virtue, but a single promise of what your feeble hearts truly desire makes you forget your oaths and indulge in passions you have been suppressing for so long."

51fd766a-4ef4-49d3-a660-4b7fdb3efb7e.Text: "I am talking about the halls in which you now tread. Look around, and you will see the final preparations for the ascension of this world. Cubis's final creation, the mighty Terebrum imbued with the warp's blessing, has already pierced Kiava Gamma's flesh and is ready to plunge toward its ultimate goal — the planet's core. Once Terebrum pierces the mantle, the Primordial Truth will reign over the world and bring it into the fold just like it brought Drusus's Stronghold."

16ed675a-ba58-447a-aaab-d1b6f89cec22.Text: "For the good of Humanity and the glory of the Imperium. You may want to read your Warrant again, {name} — these words betray hubris that may cost you your soul."

32411204-eedb-45e5-bab3-aab7962816eb.Text: {n}You receive several confused or suspicious looks, but no one objects to your decision.{/n}

c3060961-d012-4ab0-bd55-34cf0dbcb41b.Text: {n}You turn away from their perplexed faces but you can still feel their suspicious gazes burning into you. However, no one makes any attempt to press the issue.{/n}

acf357e2-410b-4811-b7a8-8ae352f49ac9.Text: {n}The apostle looks at you closely, a frightening spark smouldering in his eyes.{/n} "When will you end this farce, Rogue Trader? You got what you wanted — I, Uralon the Cruel, the Dark Apostle of the Word Bearers, member of the synod of the Cult of the Final Dawn, have granted you an audience, and yet you are still pretending to be a loyal servant of the corpse emperor. Cast off the mask. Bend the knee. Your blood is clamouring to submit, slave."

8f21ab45-825f-4541-86c8-393459c440ab.Text: {n}The Interrogator regards you with a point-blank stare.{/n} "The suspicions surrounding von Valancius have been confirmed, even though the source of the new information is less than reliable. Dabbling in the forbidden arts seldom ends well, does it, {name}?"

cd22b5b7-1f5e-4708-847e-be69d3e353f9.Text: "Come on now, Abelard. Remember what she was like." {n}Idira's smile is sad but, at the same time, strangely knowing.{/n} "Brazen. Assertive. It was like her entire life was a race against fate, until fate caught up with her in the end. She would have gone head first into a black hole if she thought that would put her one step ahead of everyone else in the Expanse."

c9f010bb-0135-45c1-b5ea-a50771accc4b.Text: {n}Sister Argenta's beautiful face is full of grief.{/n} "How bitter it is to know that you were born from bad blood — but do not let this knowledge drag you into darkness!"

a3287c95-817b-4fdd-b55f-fc90e1186180.Text: {n}The sister's words ring with genuine, sincere sadness and hope that you will not follow in Theodora's footsteps.{/n}

fb010f7f-5952-4d5c-9828-48725464af51.Text: "Striking a deal with Chaos cultists is not some silly race! Theodora von Valancius was a creator. She brought order to devastation — not the other way round."

d817c8e9-0580-4351-9157-69e7625a9942.Text: "The gifts of prophecy bestowed upon us by the master allow us to lift the veil of obscurity over the lost and forgotten treasures of the universe. Coordinates of a lost world brimming with riches, directions to a sector full of xeno-artefacts, tales of a dead vessel whose hold is stuffed with valuable cargo... Your predecessor never asked whether the source of her newfound prosperity was pure. In the end," {n}Uralon speaks softly, not bothering to hide his malicious glee,{/n} "it was I who led her to a treasure the likes of which the Expanse had never seen before."

247570ac-db2c-4e08-a273-6b0168fc0992.Text: "That's it. What if, say, she thought she could control the cultists..." {n}Idira shrugs.{/n} "You're missing the point, old man. We could be standing not far from the ones who used and betrayed her. And if that's so, I want to get to them now!"

380fe298-9cae-4b59-b225-bab78d1192bc.Text: "It will be enough not to repeat them. Be wary and do not sully yourself with others' filth, {name}."

b09ed2a8-f81b-456a-a9ea-8e95e832c494.Text: {n}Heinrix's expression relaxes a little. He nods.{/n} "Indeed, may the Emperor protect their wretched souls from the monsters of the warp. We must stop the Apostle before even more people die."

a44f74df-9156-417e-aced-3726d04eae9f.Text: "Life must be so easy for you sanctimonious preachers. A couple of words, and you no longer see a person, you see 'bad blood,' an annoying hindrance." {n}There is enough venom in Idira's voice to poison a regiment.{/n}

102c7535-daa8-4ca0-8381-16b4ddfbd853.Text: {n}Argenta recoils, but the next moment her dark eyes light up with fury.{/n} "How dare you admonish me? We are talking about abetting Chaos! A person who has tainted themselves thus can never justify it!"

8604717a-b85e-47cf-95b2-c1f490e472b7.Text: "Yes, yes, Chaos, shmaos. Except I remember you following Theodora like a baby duck following its mother, dear friend. You didn't leave her side even for a moment while you were aboard the ship. She rescued you, aided you, and your adoration wilted the moment you heard an accusation that sullied her memory. You weren't surprised or upset — you just gave up on her and moved on."

d15c77da-bc9e-4f34-9bb3-f8ae183e7946.Text: "You are a prisoner of lies and your frail, pitiful life. I see the world from the height of the Primordial Truth and use the language to match the revelations that unfold before my wide-open eye."

92350b73-2bbf-4e94-be9e-5a5ba2e20480.Text: {n}Uralon's face splits into a grin.{/n} "A long time ago, even before Kiava Gamma opened its gates to me, I looked for opportunities. Opportunities to reach this world. Opportunities to subjugate those who could help me forge weapons of war. Opportunities to serve my master while avoiding unnecessary wars and disruptions."

fa6b6abb-6169-44ed-9773-8ca4fa7a0b43.Text: {n}You notice a slight twitch of his eyebrows — your words have clearly stung Uralon. The giant leans toward you before shooting back,{/n} "The psyker who connected our minds does not have the power to hurt you. But I do."

96d5ab3f-38a8-4f2f-9c5a-226cb1f69778.Text: {n}The chamber begins to hum, a sound so faint you can barely hear it. You think it may be the vibration of a distant mechanism when the floor beneath your feet starts to groan, announcing the arrival of something sinister.{/n}

9f31bdd4-977e-477a-8c2b-b0ca0d9df7d4.Text: "Very well. Delphim has fallen, and you have managed to reach Kiava Gamma's Sanctum Sanctorum. You warrant slightly more attention than I originally was prepared to give."

c3684d0d-0280-4e13-817c-e4c846d8c1c4.Text: "You are limited by the scope of your limited abilities, Rogue Trader. To someone who was given mastery over the fabric of reality, retreat is simply a matter of skill. But I have no intention of fleeing, mortal. Not now, when my great labour is so close to completion."

3bf060a6-d65b-435e-b963-f3f7eb15aef6.Text: "What? WHAT?" {n}Abelard is at a loss for words. But once he has composed himself, they start pouring out in a hasty sputter:{/n} "This is a lie and vile slander of Chaos. A crude and disgusting lie meant to blemish the good name of a person who is now dead and cannot even defend herself! First those minions of Chaos murdered Lord Captain Theodora, and now they seek to tarnish her memory. This cannot be tolerated! It WILL not be tolerated!"

f4bb2099-1b2c-4586-9592-e4924cf83150.Text: "No — it is a shame that millions of people were sacrificed to serve her ego and greed rather for the good of the Golden Throne." {n}Heinrix's gaze sweeps over you.{/n} "That would have been a worthy use of the resource."

340cab94-55d3-4f30-9b23-72dd33676ec9.Text: "The paths of the master are unfathomable, Rogue Trader. We merely follow the course he set so that we may play the roles he has prepared for us. My destiny is to bring the final dawn to this world. My master's hand wrote it in the scrolls of fate that govern the flow of time and the movement of the stars."

5aaf182a-971f-4907-9b29-85e67ea91cda.Text: "By the Golden Throne, I will stop you and your Terebrum here and now!"

f8d187d0-13c9-4ead-9df0-8310ab124e3c.Text: "You have done a fine job with the planet, Uralon. But it is I who will enjoy the gifts of the Primordial Truth, not you."

98515350-4313-4691-9a88-2f8c61672ce6.Text: "I will not let the pain and suffering continue, Uralon. I will save Kiava Gamma."

39997e54-f672-4fd1-abbb-507d3cf0f308.Text: "Who is this poor soul you have encased in chains?"

99ee61c8-f726-43ff-aae2-1497c6cfc6b3.Text: {n}Uralon looks even more imposing in the flesh. A hulking figure clad in power armour turns to you, small flickers of warp flame still dancing at his fingertips — traces of recent sorcery. When the apostle begins to speak, the walls of the massive well echo his every word.{/n} "To do the will of my lord in front of the last member of the Rogue Trader dynasty that once called this world their own! Such delightful irony, is it not? Step forward and meet your fate, the final sacrifice on my altar."

9272bc94-2bc0-4ef7-b088-e5c11714211a.Text: "Miss your fallen accomplice, servant of the Archenemy?" {n}Argenta grins with wicked defiance, but then a shadow passes over her face and she casts you a quick glance.{/n} "Rogue Trader... You knew?"

72ef7d3e-73f9-4e0e-8a90-2e3365c303c6.Text: "You are not the first blasphemer to call the true faith 'meaningless.' And you will not be the first to pay for their mistake."

823f0c3c-d72f-47fe-bd05-0cd32f607b01.Text: {n}Uralon cocks his head as if trying to hear something.{/n} "None of this matters anymore. The time has come."

aca6cded-6c3e-495c-b172-ff04d2786f01.Text: {n}Heinrix allows himself a thin mirthless smile.{/n} "Such a hollow trick, servant of Chaos. Leave the half-truths and deceptions for your sycophants, not servants of the Emperor."

8dc8e308-73f9-4cf5-8dc8-ff9ca5c8eb91.Text: {n}Uralon's laughter sounds like distant peals of a warning bell.{/n} "Corpse emperor's dog, I will enjoy each moment of your suffering."

48630d0c-b641-4dad-8169-0c348f95c276.Text: "Do not comfort yourself with futile dreams — what the Truth needs is warriors, not slaves!"

d20988e6-7eee-4d11-9836-737a6b304d20.Text: "No, {name}, you will merely open the way for much, much more suffering in the name of the Primordial Truth, for your very being will become a perpetual beacon of pain and terror!"

e40da281-dd65-4f54-8fbf-4303036c2545.Text: {n}Uralon drags the howling psyker close and lifts him in the air by the chain. The links burn white-hot, and the victim's scream rises to a desperate shriek that is quickly cut short. The man's neck snaps and the beheaded body bursts into flame.{/n}

32994dc5-7e91-4df4-a3cd-39ec29036f54.Text: "Primordial Truth, accept my gift and bless the world that is about to witness your glory! Turn the hands of ascension on those whose demise will serve your will!"

78a1da83-b944-489b-8659-1c744263fe2a.Text: "You are standing at the top of the Terebrum, a spear of Chaos that will pierce this world's heart and make the planet serve the Primordial Truth. Powered by the reactors made at Kiava Gamma and imbued with the suffering of those who anointed its hull with their blood, it is already poised above its intended target. It requires but one last sacrifice — that of the sovereign of this world, whose soul will forever be tormented to feed the planet's core with unrelenting agony."

af91a796-4f87-48a2-bac9-16cedbe384b3.Text: {n}Uralon raises his head, glancing at the others behind you.{/n} "Not only will your meaningless faith cost you your life, it will doom the fools you have brought before me."

d3ef3bb6-7765-41e4-88c7-1592215a77e3.Text: {n}Uralon reacts to your words with a sullen sneer.{/n} "Such arrogance! You are staring kismet in the face, Rogue Trader. I am the servant of fate, {name}. My word echoes that of my master, and his command is law for this reality."

5d62b0a9-5bd9-4a3f-8f05-8ed1b9fea161.Text: "A waste of words and hollow threats. You will die, thrall to the Archenemy."

f2099732-e5a3-46c1-bed3-d4f87f4e2c55.Text: {n}It is as if a gargantuan beast stirs under your feet — tremors roll down the shaft, and a low menacing rumble makes the walls tremble.{/n} "Do you hear this roar, Rogue Trader? Terebrum longs to accept its final sacrifice. The ascension of Kiava Gamma is at hand."

1aed7c79-845a-4788-9ca8-6daab4a46146.Text: "So much naivety and bravado. {name}, I wonder if your friends know about our little secret? Do they know they are fighting for the heir of a heretic and the servant of the Truth who sold me her world for a few tall tales about distant treasures?"

aab4cdaf-b1c7-4769-a840-872e3d91cd8c.Text: "Do you not recognise the one who reached out and touched your mind, human?" {n}Uralon makes a small gesture — compelled by some monstrous force, the exhausted man moans and crawls closer to the Chaos Space Marine.{/n} "This is my personal vox, {name}. A psyker telepath has another use aside from dying on the altar — to serve as liaison for his master. But the potential of this tool is exhausted."

c61e7535-d94b-40e5-8746-9c206564a6f6.Text: "We are here to rid the world of the legacy of the traitor and heretic Theodora von Valancius. You will fall as she did, servant of the Archenemy!"

08805fff-3b6c-4932-802c-932bba32127c.Text: {n}The sound bursting forth from Pasqal's vox is nothing like his usual speech. It is the cold metallic voice of a higher being, immutable, enlightened and full of wrath.{/n} "I denounce thee! Heretic who cast down this Omnissiah-blessed world into the darkness of decadence, I denounce thee and name thee a Category One blasphemer. Meet thy destruction here and now!"

f43b684f-41f9-420d-8b84-9b04f85b349d.Text: {n}Heinrix cringes as if he has just heard a profanity and looks at you askance.{/n}

758f4f3c-dbd8-4092-b8dd-0166a6e226fa.Text: [Insert the enneahedron into the Daemon Engine]

968cc3e1-e67e-4149-9db5-4029449bb5ba.Text: [Destroy the engine before it breaks free]

5d69ba97-7505-43d5-820a-522fe496b9aa.Text: {n}The hulking mass of freakishly twisted metal stirs when you approach. The straining chains groan and you hear a muffled growl from deep within the massive carcass — the melded sound of rods, nozzles, gears, and pistons. A furious unliving glare pierces you through, but the machine remains motionless.{/n}

c4b39f98-02d2-4b9c-bfa0-d8b58459f56d.Text: "The Omnissiah triumphs, the ritual is observed. Requesting permission for complete disposal of the defiled technological object in accordance with the Canon of Technological Security."

84340f26-6ec5-40c4-8f2e-0e59420df3b3.Text: "A bound monster, neither living nor dead. Just like the rest of this iron world."

9ea025b2-78d9-438d-b182-0cebcd0c742c.Text: "What have you done, {name}? This Chaos creation must immediately be destroyed!"

73de0e6e-c057-4d00-8ac3-00039cba61b1.Text: "You have never seen true beauty." {n}Yrliet's words resonate with genuine sympathy.{/n} "But be consoled — this world is merely an iron shell, a lifeless scrap of mon-keigh ambition. The Universe lost nothing when corruption claimed it."

b42d8c34-2f32-49d8-8604-40692fe1b7c7.Text: {n}You spot a flaw in the monstrosity's design — an open area of the "spine" stuffed with entwining cables. You slash the cords, and the machine emits a guttural howl, twitching in agony. The massive claws screech against the floor, jaws snapping for the final time, and the colossus drops dread with a loud clang, its huge body striking sparks against the metal.{/n}

6609745d-137f-485e-bd5f-df662a3e7214.Text: {n}The chains binding the machine's will snap! The engine emits a bloodthirsty howl, turns around, and charges.{/n}

0e757eb7-74a4-4764-95ab-5c72a9e8f375.Text: {n}The machine emits a deafening roar and jerks, trying to reach you — but then quickly collapses limply to the ground. The hostile fire in its eyes seems to dim, as though the chains binding it have sapped the engine's sorcerous power.{/n}

fb4a538b-bb69-4153-9714-e89e142c0e0c.Text: {n}The enneahedron fits snugly into the groove, and the runes adorning it light up with blinding shine. Rumbling, the machine rises to its feet — and you hear a desperate groan of the chains strained to bursting point!{/n}

b015c4a6-36e5-47bf-8d88-989f99313e3d.Text: "What... are you doing? This is a sacrilegious breach of the Litany of Activation. This is... heresy..." {n}Pasqal's voice grows quiet and hoarse with static, frightened and meek with fascination. The mechadendrite helplessly snaps its claws.{/n}

a7719147-b47a-4c4a-ab9c-dab0e677b8ef.Text: "Danger! Detecting profane activity!" {n}Despite the cry of alarm, Pasqal does not seem to be preparing for combat. He is greedily watching the heretical mechanism, eager to observe the whirring of every cog. Seemingly of its own volition, a mechadendrite curiously reaches toward the twisted Chaos contraption.{/n}

d1494f37-1837-4d98-8a9d-52fcf9b7415b.Text: {n}The engine emits a warning growl and thrashes in its chains, but quickly calms down and remains still, following you with a hateful gaze.{/n}

2acc24ac-e31c-407b-a9e8-881268538562.Text: {n}Taking advantage of the Daemon Engine's helplessness, you closely examine its profane design. Your eyes start to water before long: both the plasteel sides of the machine and the chains binding it are covered in interwoven runes that cause a wave of nausea to roll through you whenever you try to take a look.{/n}

7244ed9e-ac11-4591-be0d-52852456dce0.Text: "This statement is false. This world was blessed and beautiful before corruption claimed it..." {n}Even the crackling of the Tech-Priest's vox sounds like a lamentation.{/n}

67349216-c876-48e6-8f96-1bfb1c615f63.Text: "The conversation has been terminated due to the interlocutor's ignorance. Such benightedness is unacceptable in a discussion about the gifts of the Omnissiah."

73840b0f-1a80-4309-ad66-d33bf9a13a61.Text: {n}You have barely finished when the chains explode. Links clatter against the walls and the floor, almost hitting you. The engine slowly turns its head, finds you with its sight — and stops. You reach out to touch its surface, and you feel the beating of the engine's corrupt "heart" — only to realise that its pulse is syncing with your own.{/n}

c862fd2c-0939-4244-818f-b8ca7c1ab3b2.Text: "To willingly offer your blood to a daemon is madness, and the first step on the path to the obliteration of your soul!"

29d175d5-27fa-487c-8cd6-fdbb32803303.Text: "I had no intention of hiding anything — but the time wasn't right. Or do you think that villainous heresy perpetrated by one's forebear is something that can be casually broached in snatched moments between fending off enemies?"

9bc9cb0c-63ba-4429-afda-bd42d0dc5782.Text: "He was lying! How can you fall for such an obvious ploy by our common enemy to sow distrust among us?"

a4e9c338-3db4-4d8d-a0d0-ed1b4e0cb224.Text: "What makes you think I would hide the fact one of my forebears was enterprising enough to trade a backwater world for ancient treasures and secrets? On the contrary, I am proud of her."

59baac24-4a01-4def-a0a2-609348228bb2.Text: {n}Heinrix clears his throat.{/n} "If you expect me to forget what I just heard, you are mistaken. The accusation levied by the Archenemy's spawn at your predecessor, {name}. His admission that Theodora was consorting with cultists and caused the downfall of Kiava Gamma. How long did you intend to hide it?"

5a7d9a25-2ca1-4f9d-bb7d-a28f8bdaa4b5.Text: "Let's go. We still have to ascend this accursed shaft and get to the surface. I fear this may take quite some time..."

8f57b449-391f-4425-9885-923b52a2cfab.Text: "Tell me, Rogue Trader. How long ago did you learn that Theodora was a traitor and a heretic? And why did you hide it from everyone?"

e1228e9b-8a0f-4992-ac11-e4a193ec958d.Text: {n}Heinrix's eyes bore into you, then he closes them with a sigh.{/n} "Let us assume this is indeed the case. But remember — such hesitation may cost you more than a brief quarrel in the future."

ef64d035-f0a0-4c8d-9e36-a274acd32357.Text: "A convenient delay, hoping that hastiness and lack of attention would keep the von Valancius dynasty's little secret safe. I do not believe you, Rogue Trader. But we will revisit this later, once the circumstances are more convenient for us both."

974e7726-fe01-45f3-a48d-b05f5a9cbc23.Text: {n}Argenta frowns and then nods.{/n} "It is not always easy to unburden one's heart... I understand. It really is not the best time for this conversation."

b977fb88-ac15-4b99-84fc-e4a53289629c.Text: {n}The Interrogator stays silent for a while.{/n} "It is possible. It is possible this is exactly what happened. But such a grave accusation is a cause for concern even if it comes from a servant of Chaos. It is a shame we could not capture the cursed Astartes alive to pry the truth out of him..."

9a9f7a57-2850-4cfa-970b-c1d231de4f64.Text: "Do not speak to me of lies, Rogue Trader — I have faced them often enough to recognise a liar when I see one. We will revisit this conversation at a better time and discuss this lie, as well as what I presume are many others."

f1f77a49-ef74-4977-b89c-02dc224883f7.Text: {n}Heinrix's gaze becomes vacant as if he is purposely not looking at you.{/n} "Corruption runs in the blood from one generation to another, Rogue Trader. It would appear you have not escaped its grasp. We will revisit this conversation."

294a3887-721e-4187-bec4-d7e6bd0b4942.Text: {n}Argenta's dark eyes alight with wrath.{/n} "You have no idea how often such 'enterprise' drags people into darkness! Beware... Rogue Trader. Approving of your predecessor's heresy means you risk sharing her fate."

f0c119e5-f6ae-4443-95b7-357f245f33cf.Text: "He lied, then..." {n}Dark clouds roil in Argenta's eyes.{/n} "Lies, lies everywhere..."

c4fddd7c-a9f5-4b0b-b8c3-29e48b994136.Text: "Eiko managed to barricade the passage, so I hope these madmen won't notice us. We ran out of tinned food and our supply of corpse starch is running low — I'll have to go out and look for food again tomorrow. I am starting to regret our decision to flee from the Elders, but the things they made us do... No. The Emperor will guard us from their wickedness. Eiko says there is an old Militarum warehouse not far from here. If we find a way to open it... Then we just may hold out until the reinforcements arrive. Dargonus is not going to leave us, is he, Mavelin?"

6117c160-5b78-42e5-a630-9c8ea9e915d7.Text: A vile green liquid covers the walls of the reservoir you extracted from the terrifying construct. The base of the vessel is equipped with a thin syringe — the substance is prepared for intramuscular administration.

2e14f68a-6425-4938-8fe0-2dbf8c4a8f93.Text: The slimy fruit pulses like a small bearing heart.

b1679e45-e0c9-4aa2-ab55-feeac2ec22d6.Text: The remains of a twisted xenoconstruct. A detailed study will require both take and connections.

430eee70-cc38-4d58-b3a9-5f77f78f7d43.Text: "We disposed of the brothers and sisters blinded by the false belief in the extinguished Prophet, and in doing so cast off the fetters of lies and hypocrisy. The elders of the dead city are stubborn and vain, their degeneracy making them blind to the blazing truth — the Sovereign of the Galaxy has given us the chance to bond with His body and His soul, and we have no right to reject His divine gift! An so we have grown strong. We live, we kill, and we guide the lost toward the light for the glory of Crimson Emperor! The elders treat His gift as a curse, but they deceive themselves, for we are no different in the end. I will fold any child who seeks to join us in a loving embrace."

18cbf626-952a-4633-b5ed-a2e4643f78f4.Text: Notes of the Crimson Prophet Eusibius V

2225da79-06e3-4e12-89d6-79c94b368be6.Text: A small jar filled with blood and a softly shimmering amethyst liquid. This is what the xenos were pumping the corpses in hive corridors with.

68ddd219-241d-44bc-9f10-66aa6c37e141.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} selects a cell within their {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}line of sight{/g} in a 12-cell radius around the cyber-eagle and another unoccupied cell within {uip|PetsMP|95c502e72a6743d1ad0cbadf13051225} cells from the first one. The cyber-eagle moves to the first cell and then dashes to the second cell in a straight line, dealing its weapon damage to each enemy in its path without provoking {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g}.

ecf05dc0-dfc3-4c8f-8f2a-d49b44daa2e0.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} selects two cells within {uip|PetsMP|d830b9fd0e7240139d3f7381fa308ab7} cells from each other. The second cell must be unoccupied. The cyber-eagle lands at the first cell, losing the {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}soaring{/g} effect and dashes to the second cell in a straight line, dealing twice its weapon damage to each enemy in its path. If any of those enemies are {g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}bleeding{/g}, they must pass an {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a −{uip|PetsPER|c367824c9c6e4f7188e35f6e2755bd78} penalty or become {g|Encyclopedia:SlowedEffect}slowed{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}. This movement does not provoke {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g}.

c5bfefa1-0fbc-45a6-9370-a7a6c3917233.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} selects a cell within their {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}line of sight{/g} within a 12-cell radius around the cyber-eagle and another unoccupied cell within {uip|PetsMP|95c502e72a6743d1ad0cbadf13051225} cells from the first one. The cyber-eagle moves to the first cell and then dashes to the second cell in a straight line, dealing its weapon damage to each enemy in its path without provoking {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g}. Then, the cyber-eagle begins {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}soaring{/g}. While the cyber-eagle is {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}soaring{/g}, this {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} is replaced with {g|f:d830b9fd0e7240139d3f7381fa308ab7}Strafe — Soaring{/g}.

2a82a5a0-7c5d-4d2e-816e-720b8858dacc.Text: This cyber-eagle cannot be targeted or {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damaged{/g}. It regains +10% of its {g|Encyclopedia:MaxWounds}maximum wounds{/g} at the start of each {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.

ca2dee9f-7833-41ec-9947-b7236d609414.Text: At the end of the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g}'s {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, the cyber-eagle soars high above the battlefield. This action does not provoke {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g}.

d253a65a-44fe-4933-b83b-68ef0df9f52a.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} selects an unoccupied cell in their {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}line of sight{/g}. The cyber-eagle moves to that cell and deals its weapon damage to all adjacent enemies without provoking {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g}. Those enemies must pass an {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a −{uip|PetsAGI|40bc0f9310894ee2ace0d60daafa3c19} penalty or become {g|Encyclopedia:BlindedEffect}blinded{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.

e3aa7db2-f353-4ed0-aa55-8f29024ddf9c.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} selects an unoccupied cell in their {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}line of sight{/g}. The cyber-eagle lands at that cell, losing the {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}soaring{/g} effect. It deals three times its weapon damage to all adjacent enemies without provoking {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g}. Those enemies must pass an {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a −{uip|PetsPER|2abd1ef7c3bb4c77a2658637058fd294} penalty or become {g|Encyclopedia:BlindedEffect}blinded{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.

a79029b3-b055-4636-8149-49c1bd04b628.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} selects an unoccupied cell in their {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}line of sight{/g}. The cyber-eagle moves to that cell and deals its weapon damage to all adjacent enemies without provoking {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g}. Those enemies must pass an {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a −{uip|PetsAGI|40bc0f9310894ee2ace0d60daafa3c19} penalty or become {g|Encyclopedia:BlindedEffect}blinded{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}. Then, the cyber-eagle begins {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}soaring{/g}. While the cyber-eagle is {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}soaring{/g}, this {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} is replaced with {g|f:d830b9fd0e7240139d3f7381fa308ab7}Blinding Strike — Soaring{/g}.

2339e15f-8cb1-4674-9a93-f0064789a1d8.Text:
The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} chooses an enemy in their {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}line of sight{/g} and an unoccupied cell adjacent to it. The cyber-eagle moves to that cell (can move through occupied cells) without provoking {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g}. If the designated enemy only has a {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee{/g} weapon, it attacks the cyber-eagle, using the lowest {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}-cost attack. If that enemy has a ranged weapon, it shoots at the cyber-eagle, using the lowest AP-cost attack, with an additional +50% chance to {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} that enemy's allies (if there are any within a cone behind the cyber-eagle). Then, the cyber-eagle attacks this enemy, dealing +{uip|Damage|53135057d69647a7854e578c5ef40bba}% more damage and spending 0 AP.
While the cyber-eagle is in that cell, the designated enemy is {g|f:1e22c265a12744cc95a03d26b6c3cef9}obstructed{/g}.
This {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} can be used multiple times per {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, but each subsequent use within a {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g} increases its cost by +1 AP until the end of round.

7e594f21-62f3-4337-af55-88cc2575fbe0.Text:
The Overseer chooses an enemy in their {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}line of sight{/g} and an unoccupied cell adjacent to it. The cyber-eagle stops {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}soaring{/g}, lands at that cell without provoking {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g}, deals twice its weapon damage to adjacent enemies, and gains {uip|PERBonusDamage|e985b758fa94464abfd506c773409571} {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}. The designated enemy becomes {g|f:1e22c265a12744cc95a03d26b6c3cef9}obstructed{/g} (the effects last while the cyber-eagle is in the designated cell). If this enemy only has a {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee{/g} weapon, it attacks the cyber-eagle, using the lowest {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}-cost attack. If that enemy has a ranged weapon, it shoots at the cyber-eagle, using the lowest AP-cost attack, with an additional +50% chance to {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} that enemy's allies (if there are any within a cone behind the cyber-eagle). Then, the cyber-eagle attacks this enemy, dealing +{uip|Damage|53135057d69647a7854e578c5ef40bba}% more damage and spending 0 AP.
This {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} can be used multiple times per {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, but each subsequent use within a round increases its cost by +1 AP until the end of round.

b129e10a-4641-4f4b-9268-9b9336992457.Text: This creature cannot leave its current cell through regular means. It can only attack the {g|f:53135057d69647a7854e578c5ef40bba}obstructing{/g} cyber-eagle. If this creature uses a ranged weapon, the shots have an additional +50% chance to {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} this creature's allies (if there are any within a cone behind the cyber-eagle). Whenever the cyber-eagle {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodges{/g} this creature's attack, it immediately counter-attacks, dealing +{uip|Damage|53135057d69647a7854e578c5ef40bba}% more damage and spending 0 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}.

d432f900-8302-45c8-b9ea-5786055cad75.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} chooses an enemy in their {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}line of sight{/g} and an unoccupied cell adjacent to that enemy. The cyber-eagle moves to that cell (can move through occupied cells) without provoking {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g}. If the designated enemy only has a {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee{/g} weapon, it attacks the cyber-eagle, using the lowest {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}-cost attack. If that enemy has a ranged weapon, it shoots at the cyber-eagle, using the lowest AP-cost attack, with an additional +50% chance to {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} that enemy's allies (if there are any within a cone behind the cyber-eagle). Then, the cyber-eagle attacks this enemy, dealing +{uip|Damage|53135057d69647a7854e578c5ef40bba}% more damage and spending 0 AP. While the cyber-eagle is in that cell, the designated enemy is {g|f:1e22c265a12744cc95a03d26b6c3cef9}obstructed{/g}. This {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} can be used multiple times per {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, but each subsequent use within a {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g} increases its cost by +1 AP until the end of round. While the cyber-eagle is {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}soaring{/g}, this ability is replaced with {g|f:d830b9fd0e7240139d3f7381fa308ab7}Obstruct Vision — Soaring{/g}.

135dc65c-49c5-45db-9c65-e6e2889536fc.Text: The {g|f:1e22c265a12744cc95a03d26b6c3cef9}obstructed{/g} target can only attack this cyber-eagle. Whenever this cyber-eagle {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodges{/g} that target's attack, it immediately counter-attacks it, dealing +{uip|Damage|53135057d69647a7854e578c5ef40bba}% more damage and spending 0 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}.

b6f17601-11db-47b9-9c6e-0e53d57f7d15.Text: If the cyber-eagle is {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}soaring{/g}, whenever an enemy attacks this character, the cyber-eagle {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hits{/g} that enemy from above, dealing its weapon damage and expending −1 stack of this effect.

96014b64-d18c-4f05-8b56-9627edfbf34e.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} chooses an ally within their {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}line of sight{/g} and grants them {uip|2PERBonus|09793f5510a840f1858079051560828e} stacks of the {g|f:90f1c90ae52342fda66f67d43e988286}bait{/g} effect.

d408fdc9-c9c9-457b-84cc-062e985ef28a.Text: If the cyber-eagle is {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}soaring{/g}, whenever an enemy attacks an ally with the {g|f:90f1c90ae52342fda66f67d43e988286}bait{/g} effect, each stack of this effect allows the cyber-eagle to deal its weapon {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} to the attacker. Once the effect is triggered, the ally loses −1 stack of this effect.

e0121793-a5cf-4012-816f-5df3bff7bf31.Text: An {g|f:1e22c265a12744cc95a03d26b6c3cef9}obstructed{/g} enemy's attacks against their allies gain +{uip|DodgeReductionBonus|716db50043764b14802c71e4774d6010}% {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeReduction}dodge reduction{/g} and deal +{uip|WarpDamage|716db50043764b14802c71e4774d6010} additional {g|Encyclopedia:WarpDamage}warp damage{/g}, increased by the cyber-eagle's protocol damage bonus.

bbcdf53a-6926-4717-864c-2cf1b689e07d.Text: The character gains {uip|tHPNumber|5da89253c7ea493d92a955f101a53349} {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g}. They re-roll failed {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g} attempts once and ignore the next instance of damage.

facbe4ca-cf1a-4402-bf04-eec102da088d.Text: When the cyber-eagle moves through cells, adjacent to its allies, it grants them {g|f:5da89253c7ea493d92a955f101a53349}Life-Giving Touch{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.

92de414e-68f1-4586-b9a4-ca9930c3c888.Text:
While the cyber-eagle is {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}soaring{/g}, the {g|Encyclopedia:Resolve}resolve{/g} of all non-xenos allies is increased by +{uip|ResolveBonus|8ab6e0555aba4bb691a9e01fce6bef99}. Does not stack.
Whenever the cyber-eagle stops {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}soaring{/g}, all non-xenos allies gain {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g}, equal to their resolve. Also, their {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeReduction}dodge reduction{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:ParryReduction}parry reduction{/g} are increased by +<u>resolve</u>%. Both effects are active for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.

03b98793-c09b-42a4-9633-004da988ad44.Text:
While the cyber-eagle is in combat, whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} grants an {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}extra turn{/g} to an ally, that ally gains +{uip|AGI Bonus|cd1bc2285bb54db78734297bc404684c} {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} and +{uip|PER Bonus|cd1bc2285bb54db78734297bc404684c} {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerPerception}Perception{/g} until the end of the {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.
If the cyber-eagle is {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}soaring{/g}, these bonuses are doubled.

8cce6b9a-a64e-4658-8eed-54c8e1d76116.Text:
When attacking a target with {g|f:66e7b370e32b43118315ab0fd24a7f0d}exploits{/g}, the cyber-eagle gains the same bonus to damage dealt as the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g}. Its attack removes all {g|f:66e7b370e32b43118315ab0fd24a7f0d}exploits{/g} from the target.
When the cyber-eagle inflicts {g|f:1e22c265a12744cc95a03d26b6c3cef9}obstructed{/g} on an enemy, that enemy must pass an {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a −{uip|AGISave|5fc198b41b194129a8d29658840ddf76} {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} or suffer +{uip|ExploitNumber|5fc198b41b194129a8d29658840ddf76} {g|f:66e7b370e32b43118315ab0fd24a7f0d}exploits{/g}.

8dfc8d2d-b5d1-4233-b50e-7fd1e342944a.Text: Upon killing this target, the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} or their ally regains +1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} and gains a stacking +1 bonus to {g|Encyclopedia:Resolve}resolve{/g}.

78bcbd50-8964-4485-8ae4-bdf5a972ffe1.Text: Whenever the {g|f:1e22c265a12744cc95a03d26b6c3cef9}obstructed{/g} effect is removed from an enemy, that enemy suffers the {g|f:d683469a1e0e45d48e72a5ed2811f1b0}promised death{/g} effect until the end of combat.

8bccb683-6f9c-4aee-aa4b-04762efc875e.Text: At the start of its {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g}'s {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, the {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}soaring{/g} cyber-eagle inflicts {uip|Exploit Number|267f29e1f94d43ec9f9cd5ee25d7427c} {g|f:66e7b370e32b43118315ab0fd24a7f0d}exploits{/g} on each enemy in combat.

c674d7a5-4429-40ea-900e-d713e61482bf.Text: When the cyber-eagle suffers lethal damage for the first time in combat, it remains in combat and immediately {g|f:d8ae4229d77d444fa3bff7e2817541b3}soars{/g}, regaining 33% of its {g|Encyclopedia:MaxWounds}maximum wounds{/g}.

edd3f1ed-fc7b-4ee6-96dc-e1cc38992665.Text: The cyber-eagle's attacks deal +{uip|AGI Bonus|1ca2081984db4240b9b0c97d7fe48be0} more damage.

5e4b8ea5-546e-4776-8c34-fbc24992920a.Text: Whenever the cyber-eagle successfully attacks the {g|f:1e22c265a12744cc95a03d26b6c3cef9}obstructed{/g} enemy, that enemy suffers {uip|Bleed|489c6f6e95f44cdeb8a00bb7609b0e7e} levels of {g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}bleeding{/g}.

d93e6085-d099-45ca-b2c3-2a034fc84dec.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} deals −{uip|Awareness|c269ba83802c4d8c96584a6738950a1e}% less damage to the cyber-eagle.

fc63777c-8d18-4ba1-b3cf-06d4a3683f68.Text: When the cyber-eagle stops {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}soaring{/g}, it gains +{uip|AGI Bonus|566eb762e2bd464989b99fbaf6ebc734} {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.

a1f5aacd-42c0-41d9-aa6b-32616f4a11ae.Text: Whenever the cyber-eagle starts {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}soaring{/g}, it gains +3 to its key {g|Encyclopedia:Characteristic}characteristics{/g}. Stacks and lasts until the end of combat.

1531345d-b304-4e2a-8c0c-5b8c884e71ac.Text: Right before the cyber-eagle begins {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}soaring{/g}, adjacent enemies must pass an {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a −{uip|AGI Bonus|8ccf488b5b5d4c1180ff5e44f1ed6bf1} penalty or become {g|Encyclopedia:StaggeredEffect}staggered{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.

7fbe7546-c283-48eb-bcb4-442509659062.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} makes an attack against this creature, the {g|f:e16934c3dbf44cb997c684a6ddce7575}apprehending{/g} cyber-mastiff makes a free {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee attack{/g} against it, dealing −50% less damage. If this creature tries to move away from the cyber-mastiff, the cyber-mastiff gains a {uip|StopChance|e16934c3dbf44cb997c684a6ddce7575}% chance to cancel this creature's movement. If the creature moves further than 1 cell away from the cyber-mastiff, the cyber-mastiff follows (during this creature's {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, spending 0 {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g}) and attacks it.

8f575eb6-d0bd-4b39-95d2-400b2b18b01b.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} makes an attack against the {g|f:f39e0e323f314259b3e7510b110d3a4b}apprehended{/g} target, this cyber-mastiff makes a free {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee attack{/g} against it, dealing −50% less damage. If the target attempts to move away from the cyber-mastiff, the cyber-mastiff gains a {uip|StopChance|e16934c3dbf44cb997c684a6ddce7575}% chance to cancel the target's movement. If the target moves further than 1 cell away from the cyber-mastiff, the cyber-mastiff follows (during this creature's {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, spending 0 {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g}) and attacks it.

29d113ee-ced4-4fc2-ab27-14d17eb7582d.Text:
The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} chooses an enemy in their {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}line of sight{/g}. The cyber-mastiff immediately attempts to run to that enemy. If it does not have enough {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g}, it moves as close to that enemy as possible. Upon reaching the designated target, the cyber-mastiff makes a {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee attack{/g}, dealing +50% more damage and inflicting the {g|f:f39e0e323f314259b3e7510b110d3a4b}apprehended{/g} effect, which lasts as long as the enemy and the cyber-mastiff are adjacent to each other or until another order is given.
This {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} can be used multiple times per {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, but each subsequent use within a {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g} increases its cost by +1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}.

55419805-8d86-4999-b58f-6b1eee04b788.Text:
Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} is attacked, their cyber-mastiff gains {uip|Mastiff STR Bonus|582bb17c04754121b4b31647865dfd32} {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g}. Stacks.
While the cyber-mastiff has temporary wounds, its {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit chance{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} dealt, {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g}, and {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g} are increased by +{uip|Mastiff tHP|582bb17c04754121b4b31647865dfd32}%.

f5917846-c280-4b97-96a3-7dac7ba73a31.Text:
For 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}, allows the cyber-mastiff to move through enemies. While moving, it inflicts {uip|Power|50df13d6ecfa472aa818147e0a9a2419} levels of {g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}bleeding{/g} on all adjacent enemies it passes.
Each enemy affected increases the {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit chance{/g} of the cyber-mastiff's next attack by +{uip|STR|50df13d6ecfa472aa818147e0a9a2419}% until the end of its {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}.
This {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} removes {g|Encyclopedia:ImmobilisedEffect}immobilised{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:ProneEffect}prone{/g}, and {g|Encyclopedia:Stun}stunned{/g} from the cyber-mastiff.

54652bbe-6cca-4b14-b4f8-2f0d8c821c85.Text: The cyber-mastiff lets out a terrifying growl. For 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}, all enemies in a 2-cell radius deal −{uip|Damage|364d975f704e46a0bcaaf755278edbb7}% less damage to the cyber-mastiff, the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g}, and their allies.

b2afa413-ab95-49b9-9bfd-7a9dc9402d8b.Text:
The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} chooses an enemy in their {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}line of sight{/g} within {uip|Range|f43988eb304d448db74237fcc605f840} cells of the cyber-mastiff. The cyber-mastiff immediately dashes to that enemy and performs a special attack. The target suffers double {g|Encyclopedia:RendingDamage}rending damage{/g} and must pass a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a −{uip|Save|f43988eb304d448db74237fcc605f840} penalty or fall {g|Encyclopedia:ProneEffect}prone{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.
This {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} removes the effects of the {g|f:3311f1213a1e452c874ce2cde5c03f59}Apprehend!{/g} and {g|f:78e7771b7c974111887e762d5e999a11}Protect!{/g} abilities.

f446f4cb-676b-4200-980d-3c377d8cab56.Text:
The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} chooses an ally in their {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}line of sight{/g} (can be themselves). The cyber-mastiff immediately attempts to run to that ally. If it does not have enough {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g}, it moves as close to that ally as possible. Upon reaching them, the cyber-mastiff applies {g|f:7d75105e9e224ceab784932c12a26757}protected{/g} to them and makes a {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:AreaOfEffect}area attack{/g} against adjacent enemies. The {g|f:7d75105e9e224ceab784932c12a26757}protected{/g} effect lasts until the cyber-mastiff or the targeted ally's {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} drop to 0 or until another order is given.
When used on the Overseer for the first time in combat, the Overseer regains 1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}.

7338bdb4-c4ca-4662-a41b-b1a2b1cf29c0.Text:
Whenever an enemy attacks this character, the {g|f:a63088cd6402424b8ec0c508e5143083}protecting{/g} cyber-mastiff makes a free {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee attack{/g} against the attacker, if possible, dealing −50% less damage. To make the attack, it can move to any cell adjacent to this character, spending 0 {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g}. If this character moves, the {g|f:a63088cd6402424b8ec0c508e5143083}protecting{/g} cyber-mastiff follows them during the character's {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, spending 0 MP.
Additionally, this character suffers −80% damage from the {g|f:a63088cd6402424b8ec0c508e5143083}protecting{/g} cyber-mastiff.

a144c0b8-a915-441b-9b39-5d6f44e38428.Text: Whenever an enemy attacks the {g|f:7d75105e9e224ceab784932c12a26757}protected{/g} ally, this cyber-mastiff makes a free {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee attack{/g} against the attacker, if possible, dealing −50% less damage. To do so, it can move to any cell adjacent to that ally, spending 0 {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g}. If the {g|f:7d75105e9e224ceab784932c12a26757}protected{/g} ally moves, this cyber-mastiff follows them during that ally's {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, spending 0 MP.

35364ab5-2874-429d-aa8f-758e7589fdb2.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} orders the cyber-mastiff to fight autonomously. It gains the {g|f:11251c47c7b14a87824cffe48ea6374d}battle mode: standby{/g} effect until the end of combat or until a new order is given.

553daba3-9ada-459c-a8da-df074253f267.Text:
This cyber-mastiff fights independently and cannot be controlled directly.
During its {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, it always moves to the closest enemy and attacks them.

c35703e2-f31d-4f9c-b0f4-38f85630dc1c.Text: This cyber-mastiff is waiting for the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g}'s next command.

56337492-d11a-43fc-893e-b111c4559440.Text: When the cyber-mastiff attacks a target, it deals +{uip|FireDamage|a02ad192625a4bc289b3a59008ab84ea} additional {g|Encyclopedia:FireDamage}fire damage{/g}. If the target suffers from the {g|Encyclopedia:BurningEffect}burning{/g} effect, it cannot {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g}, or {g|Encyclopedia:BlockChance}block{/g} the cyber-mastiff's attack.

458d7bd8-0be2-4924-bb5f-45be2e81789f.Text: While an ally is still in combat and adjacent to the cyber-mastiff, they suffer −{uip|DamageReduced|4b7781d804484271947c42e2cdbe1727}% less damage from all sources and regain {uip|RestoredWounds|4b7781d804484271947c42e2cdbe1727} {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} at the start of their {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}.

c8ca3fc5-1de3-4baa-b769-9231d50df2c3.Text: Each time the cyber-mastiff deals damage while attacking, it gains +<u>(damage dealt / 25)</u> stacks of the {g|f:6cf8cf0920bd461aa5bddb4d45d49649}frenzied{/g} effect. Stacks up to 100 times.

a1540725-ef05-44fa-ab79-6f10cbcbe677.Text: When the cyber-mastiff suffers lethal damage, it remains activated and regains {uip|RestoredWounds|6cf8cf0920bd461aa5bddb4d45d49649} {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} if it has more than 30 {g|f:6cf8cf0920bd461aa5bddb4d45d49649}Truculence{/g} stacks.

20111012-c1eb-4231-aad2-c8e7c582eef4.Text:
When attacking a target with {g|f:66e7b370e32b43118315ab0fd24a7f0d}exploits{/g}, the cyber-mastiff gains the same bonus to damage dealt as the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g}. Its attack removes all {g|f:66e7b370e32b43118315ab0fd24a7f0d}exploits{/g} from the target.
If the Overseer starts their {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} in {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}partial cover{/g}, for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}, the cyber-mastiff gains +{uip|Overseer INT Bonus|ce95a986c4044c0ca07fd0db9915388c} {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} and has its {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g} increased by +{uip|Overseer PER Bonus|ce95a986c4044c0ca07fd0db9915388c}%.
If the Overseer starts their turn in full cover, these bonuses are doubled.

13273269-e346-4a05-aae1-47ec6dc0a4c2.Text: Whenever the cyber-mastiff {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hits{/g} an enemy, it has a {uip|Prone Chance|e09dd57609ff429aa33c697e99242c36}% chance to knock its target {g|Encyclopedia:ProneEffect}prone{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.

16ce3fc3-3757-4c2b-abf7-9dc4662dd67b.Text:
The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g}'s attacks inflict {g|f:e09dd57609ff429aa33c697e99242c36}fragility{/g} on enemies for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.
The cyber-mastiff's weapon damage against {g|Encyclopedia:ProneEffect}prone{/g} enemies is increased by {uip|Pet WS Bonus|e202927235194d9ba695ea250e904cf0}.

0e3e4b37-4761-494d-b38b-0336a191975b.Text: When an ally in a 3-cell radius around the cyber-mastiff gains an {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}extra turn{/g}, the cyber-mastiff immediately (before the extra turn starts) makes a free single attack against an adjacent enemy, if any.

9654af06-b55f-441f-8d6f-85711a90c41d.Text: After the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} uses {g|f:e955823f54d24088ae1fdefe88d3684d}Blade Dance{/g}, the cyber-mastiff immediately uses {g|f:a82be46a250047dcbaf7fe534441ae6c}Bloody Carnage{/g}.

ea1c89a7-7d47-4cbd-933d-26dd1d11930e.Text: The cyber-mastiff makes {uip|Attack Number|a82be46a250047dcbaf7fe534441ae6c} single melee attacks against random adjacent targets (including allies), dealing −50% less damage.

eb2246e7-8d14-475c-b039-14f50871f290.Text: The cyber-mastiff gains a stack of {g|f:10672b55534045a19bbbcae01f7e741d}call of blood{/g} for every 20% of their {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g}'s currently missing {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}.

48508db4-a4be-4c8f-b24a-cb0347dffecf.Text: Each stack increases the cyber-mastiff's damage dealt and its {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} by +{uip|Damage Increase|10672b55534045a19bbbcae01f7e741d}.

9e0edb84-7d83-4ef4-a9b0-fd091728d3fe.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} uses {g|f:9c78e44bf8ff44a9afff8370c673c9ad}Voice of Command{/g}, its effect is also applied to their cyber-mastiff.

45217d7d-3fcf-4788-bb91-49e2ba55c916.Text: The cyber-mastiff's attacks no longer remove {g|f:66e7b370e32b43118315ab0fd24a7f0d}exploits{/g} from its targets (while still gaining damage bonus).

ca213949-5c07-45d0-947f-c58bc13df4a0.Text: Allies in a 2-cell radius around the cyber-mastiff have their {g|Encyclopedia:Reload}reload{/g} cost reduced by −1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}.

6f76dce7-368c-4839-8a00-32a9e953bab5.Text: Whenever the cyber-mastiff {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hits{/g} the {g|f:f39e0e323f314259b3e7510b110d3a4b}apprehended{/g} enemy or an enemy adjacent to the {g|f:7d75105e9e224ceab784932c12a26757}protected{/g} ally, it gains +1 to its key {g|Encyclopedia:Characteristic}characteristics{/g}. Lasts until the end of combat. Stacks.

2a47732c-5fc9-42cf-a966-11d226e81836.Text: Each subsequent {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} scored by the cyber-mastiff against the {g|f:f39e0e323f314259b3e7510b110d3a4b}apprehended{/g} enemy deals +{uip|Damage|c3cffc6b88cb47f3867b194fbcdb8b03} more damage. Stacks. Stacks reset when {g|f:078bea05041540fa87a53b93d639f243}Apprehend!{/g} is used again.

c3a546a0-40ac-42ba-a2ba-f89fd8ad321d.Text: The {g|f:f39e0e323f314259b3e7510b110d3a4b}apprehended{/g} enemy takes +{uip|Stat|cb6744a50f65438a8f20fd90efdbaff1}% more damage from the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g}.

69305eec-1cce-47a0-beef-9a3f149201c4.Text: If {g|f:78e7771b7c974111887e762d5e999a11}Protect!{/g} is used on the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g}, the cyber-mastiff's {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} is doubled when moving to them.

5a6eeb76-28f9-4f0e-b4b7-6291722ac377.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hits{/g} the same target right after the cyber-mastiff in {g|f:11251c47c7b14a87824cffe48ea6374d}battle mode: standby{/g} hits it, the Overseer's attacks always score a {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit{/g}.

43e5d78b-b35b-4944-a5f8-f88aced87344.Text: If the cyber-mastiff suffers {g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}bleeding{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:BurningEffect}burning{/g}, or {g|Encyclopedia:ToxinEffect}toxin{/g}, at the start of the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g}'s {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, the level of this effect is reduced by −{uip|Bonus|c15a6be91f594d72ab087a8522d39fae}.

3d667871-8295-4e59-8669-2e2bde0c6756.Text: Whenever the cyber-mastiff gains bonuses from {g|f:582bb17c04754121b4b31647865dfd32}Combat Reflexes{/g}, if its {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} is in a 3-cell radius, they gain these bonuses as well (except the {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g}).

5aa95dc6-feb0-4cb0-bce5-6c0f4824a2ab.Text: The psyber-raven deals {uip|ShockDamage|7962a71f962946258a64df9cd4b7c36a} {g|Encyclopedia:ShockDamage}shock damage{/g} to the 3 closest enemies in a 4-cell radius around it.

bd0bc717-a800-4a7d-ae62-0c5481874472.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} {g|f:fcf1f3b77e3e4cf7ba2cb960e2e6028e}relayed{/g} through the psyber-raven this {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g} is {g|f:fcf1f3b77e3e4cf7ba2cb960e2e6028e}relayed{/g} once again.

fcc2a590-ab25-4ddb-8f90-cb7f183cf45f.Text: The psyber-raven suffers 9 {g|Encyclopedia:WarpDamage}warp damage{/g}, and every creature in a 4-cell radius around it suffers <u>(9 × number of affected creatures)</u> warp damage. After that, the affected creatures (excluding the psyber-raven), whose number of {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} is divisible by 9, lose 9% of their {g|Encyclopedia:MaxWounds}maximum wounds{/g}.

01f66fd4-b892-48e5-b611-99e0ba96d1be.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} commands their psyber-raven to stop {g|f:3159a138a7ee4cc48f4c88ebd3399d96}relaying{/g}.

58d6f540-a6af-4aff-bd3c-116c84ef3ed8.Text: Enemies in a 4-cell radius around the psyber-raven suffer <u>(from {uip|MinDamage|319b06b3dbad4d47ae1dff5c1647f904} to {uip|MaxDamage|319b06b3dbad4d47ae1dff5c1647f904})</u> {g|Encyclopedia:WarpDamage}warp damage{/g} and +1 stack of {g|Encyclopedia:PerplexedEffect}perplexed{/g} until the end of combat.

16833c66-5ecc-4e1e-a7e9-cc09ae294a1a.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} commands their psyber-raven to immediately move up to {uip|MP|5f6ef4bf13754f7285ac540bfd2ee80f} cells. It can move through occupied cells and does not trigger {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g}.

f1e850ae-1bf0-426d-8706-dda363e86fb3.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} uses non-attacking single-target {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic powers{/g} (except those granting {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}extra turns{/g}) on their psyber-raven, they are applied to all relevant targets (allies or enemies) in a 4-cell radius around it, having no effect on the psyber-raven itself. Enemies in a 4-cell radius around the psyber-raven are {g|f:a115669547864ccc816f0598a404e816}under surveillance{/g}.

5d596511-49fe-4338-8db7-e41cbba57214.Text: This creature is in the {g|Encyclopedia:AreaOfEffect}area of effect{/g} of the psyber-raven's {g|f:3159a138a7ee4cc48f4c88ebd3399d96}Warp Relay{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g}.

b8afa6c1-6b5d-4fdf-a8ac-6b18ee3b91c2.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} uses non-attacking single-target {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic powers{/g} on this psyber-raven, they are immediately applied to all relevant targets (allies or enemies) in a 4-cell radius around it, having no effect on the psyber-raven itself. The effect of those psychic powers is calculated using the psyber-raven's {g|Encyclopedia:Characteristic}characteristics{/g} (except {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}psy rating{/g}). This psyber-raven is considered the enemies' lowest {g|Encyclopedia:PriorityTarget}priority target{/g}.

bd618890-3914-4dbf-836a-3b02ac4bf8f3.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} of the psyber-raven ignores this creature's {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}cover{/g}. Additionally, this creature cannot {g|Encyclopedia:BlockChance}block{/g} the Overseer's attacks using a shield.

170e6471-0fa4-4dfd-b370-61789807a58c.Text: Allies in a 4-cell radius around the psyber-raven gain +{uip|THP|d9580c9bca3d4b068905ba234623cf6a} {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g} and +{uip|Armor|d9580c9bca3d4b068905ba234623cf6a}% {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.

b53ca7ad-34bd-421e-8648-b51cd6c28fec.Text: Each stack of this effect increases {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}Weapon Skill{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerBallisticSkill}Ballistic Skill{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g}, and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerStrength}Strength{/g} by +5 and {g|Encyclopedia:Resolve}resolve{/g} by +1.

369ef0e7-1d2b-4bfb-89a4-0da19b002063.Text:
All allies in a 4-cell radius around the psyber-raven gain +{uip|WPBonus|1ff86f1bc340493d9ca708f838c7678c} {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g}, suffer −50% less damage from daemons, and are immune to the {g|f:423e91ce057d4e2489043ded7306f3e2}horrors of the warp{/g} effect.
If an ally starts their {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} in in a 4-cell radius around the psyber-raven, they gain +1 stack of the {g|f:d601afbd98d44f7fb57fe84c12f2dc59}warp solace{/g} effect until the end of combat. Stacks up to 5 times.

93c85dc1-2e5f-4779-a1bc-d86558c2e133.Text:
The first {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} in a {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g} {g|f:fcf1f3b77e3e4cf7ba2cb960e2e6028e}relayed{/g} through the psyber-raven scorches enemies in a 4-cell radius around the familiar, dealing {uip|FireDamage|6a40ad34e6fa4400a96b82ebd140fcaa} {g|Encyclopedia:FireDamage}fire damage{/g} to them.
That damage is increased by +100% against xenos, psykers, and daemon enemies.

7f868969-ec59-4581-b377-9ac229cc0d28.Text: If damage is dealt to the Overseer while they are in a 4-cell radius around the psyber-raven, this damage is dealt to a random allied character instead.

06b9dd35-7a78-4220-94ca-e74da16e942c.Text: This creature is connected to the psyber-raven. When this creature suffers the next instance of {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}, {uip|SharedDamage|1054900271274ed5a11b7a8c5b1406d8}% of that damage (up to a maximum of 100%) will be dealt to all the connected targets as {g|Encyclopedia:MentalDamage}mental damage{/g}. Once triggered, this effect is removed.

32643e03-b880-48d9-874d-12cf02ec2183.Text: Whenever {g|f:7962a71f962946258a64df9cd4b7c36a}Purification Discharge{/g} is used, the affected targets suffer {g|f:70a18b24f69f4dfb905cb3d9420d0b19}bonds of pain{/g}, connecting them with the psyber-raven. At any time, an enemy can only be connected to a single psyber-raven.

cc29dede-f169-492d-81e4-8821170eec2b.Text: While moving, the psyber-raven deals {uip|WarpDamage|1d49df8923274b3d88ab61d275990b52} {g|Encyclopedia:WarpDamage}warp damage{/g} to each enemy it passes.

25d77a9b-76fa-473d-a66f-eead9ec597e0.Text: When the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} {g|f:fcf1f3b77e3e4cf7ba2cb960e2e6028e}relays{/g} a {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} through the psyber-raven for the first time in a {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}, they regain +1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}.

50be3e6e-b7d7-4991-ba2c-7a516dde09b2.Text: Enemies in a 4-cell radius around the psyber-raven have their {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} reduced by −<u>(2 × psyber-raven's WP bonus)</u>.

a3e7dceb-f64e-49c5-bd86-e99160560ad2.Text: If the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} is within 4 cells of the psyber-raven, whenever the Overseer triggers {g|Encyclopedia:PerilsOfWarp}perils of the warp{/g}, it affects a random enemy inside that area instead of the Overseer. If there are no enemies in this area, perils of the warp affects the Overseer as usual.

7d85ef60-9d90-4224-a21c-c782df349054.Text: The effect of {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic powers{/g} {g|f:fcf1f3b77e3e4cf7ba2cb960e2e6028e}relayed{/g} through the psyber-raven is calculated as if {g|Encyclopedia:PsyRating}psy rating{/g} were increased + 1

0639fcb0-b0f7-436c-b5fb-c4f57b9674e6.Text: At the start of each {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}, if {g|Encyclopedia:VeilThickness}veil degradation{/g} is 15 or more, all creatures in a 4-cell radius around the psyber-raven suffer {uip|WarpDamage|397d0c905d074ac183684d5547868253} {g|Encyclopedia:WarpDamage}warp damage{/g}.

abffe086-78a2-4fb8-b0a3-9561333871da.Text: Whenever a {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} is {g|f:fcf1f3b77e3e4cf7ba2cb960e2e6028e}relayed{/g} through the psyber-raven, it suffers 3 {g|Encyclopedia:DirectDamage}direct damage{/g} and gains +3 {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g}. Stacks.

faa6b15f-e9eb-48dd-ab02-c6c75479db1c.Text: This creature is in the {g|Encyclopedia:AreaOfEffect}area of effect{/g} of the servo-skull swarm's {g|f:215d9f42b7e6435e9ed77337156e0fc3}Extrapolation{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g}.

a3f1ca59-f4a2-4ff6-98a9-5463647e4048.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} of the servo-skull swarm ignores this creature's {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}cover{/g}. Additionally, this creature cannot {g|Encyclopedia:BlockChance}block{/g} the Overseer's attacks using a shield.

09b3ab17-3c28-4fbb-8fbe-2c5e05d21791.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} uses non-attacking single-target {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}abilities{/g} on this servo-skull swarm, they are immediately applied to all relevant targets (allies or enemies) in a 4-cell radius around it, having no effect on the servo-skull swarm itself. The effect of those abilities is calculated using this servo-skull swarm's {g|Encyclopedia:Characteristic}characteristics{/g}. This servo-skull swarm is considered enemies' lowest {g|Encyclopedia:PriorityTarget}priority target{/g} and has immunity to all types of forced movement.

3cc72390-c492-4c36-95e0-363eb6636ac3.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} uses non-attacking single-target {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}abilities{/g} (except {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic powers{/g}, Navigator abilities, and those granting {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}extra turns{/g}) on their servo-skull swarm, they are applied to all relevant targets (allies or enemies) in a 4-cell radius around it, having no effect on the servo-skull swarm itself. If the Overseer uses an ability granting an extra {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} to an ally in that area (except {g|f:33c8c9db91694ca6ad3eff26e36dd0af}Finest Hour!{/g}), the closest ally to the initial target also gains an extra turn. Enemies in a 4-cell radius around the servo-skull swarm are {g|f:5fcfda67ccb14a66a0ff79d2b9ee250c}under surveillance{/g}.

87e889ed-7f47-483c-b544-e60d87a884f0.Text:
At the start of their {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, each enemy in a 4-cell radius around the servo-skull swarm makes a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a −{uip|WILSave|6fe07c288ab442c4b70d4e9d535a6cb6} penalty. Each enemy that fails makes a free attack against the closest creature (ally or enemy), if possible. After that, they act normally.
! This signal effect lasts until the servo-skull swarm is destroyed or uses another signal {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g}.

d3d9e659-e71e-48b8-91a8-9a694abb1006.Text:
At the start of their {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, each enemy in a 4-cell radius around the servo-skull swarm makes a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a −{uip|WILSave|42ed520aeaf2480ba43afc9290b36663} penalty. Each enemy that fails considers the servo-skull swarm their {g|Encyclopedia:PriorityTarget}priority target{/g} until the end of their turn.
While this signal effect lasts, the servo-skull swarm's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} are increased by +{uip|ArmorBonus|42ed520aeaf2480ba43afc9290b36663}% for each enemy in the area.
! This signal effect lasts until the servo-skull swarm is destroyed or uses another signal {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g}.

89094b7b-0093-4fff-8e84-08c50c5715fb.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} commands their servo-skull swarm to immediately move up to {uip|MP|57e2562dac5c40268e27f87317f008d0} cells. It can move through occupied cells and does not trigger {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g}.

05560c2e-fc44-43d3-a652-ee2c44a2b4ae.Text:
At the start of their {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, each ally in a 4-cell radius around the servo-skull swarm gains {uip|Heal|9af122965c3c4decad673e9ccf58c628} {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} and a {uip|Chance|9af122965c3c4decad673e9ccf58c628}% chance (cannot be more than 90%) to remove 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Injury}injury{/g}. Does not affect {g|Encyclopedia:UnconsciousEffect}unconscious{/g} allies.
! This signal effect lasts until the servo-skull swarm is destroyed or uses another signal {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g}.

b6e9af9f-d6aa-453e-94dc-4625ba3454a9.Text:
While the Overseer is in a 4-cell radius around the servo-skull swarm, the non-xenos allies in that area gain +{uip|ResolveBonus|e5265e74557c4069b8312921f4c640b1} {g|Encyclopedia:Resolve}resolve{/g}.
All xenos, daemons, and psykers in that area suffer +{uip|DamageModifier|e5265e74557c4069b8312921f4c640b1}% more damage from any source.

8e1c8d3e-20a2-48d9-aa72-9f68f9bebfef.Text: After a total of five creatures have died or allied characters have fallen unconscious in a 4-cell radius around the servo-skull swarm, the Overseer and allied characters starting their {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} in that area gain +1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}.

cb1b844c-1476-4fae-ac3c-3dfaeba6a527.Text: When an allied character falls unconscious or suffers a {g|Encyclopedia:Injury}fresh injury{/g} in a 4-cell radius around the servo-skull swarm, the {g|Encyclopedia:MomentumWithDetailsGlossary}momentum{/g} of the party is not reduced. Instead, it is increased by +{uip|DeathMomentum|7118f19ea17a4fa9bf849fe70766fbbb} for each allied character still in combat.

0ad4b8cb-7928-4980-afeb-2bda0298d7d8.Text: At the start of its {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g}'s {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, the servo-skull swarm immediately inflicts {uip|ExploitNumber|1946e3294827418889bca99e190cfd92} {g|f:66e7b370e32b43118315ab0fd24a7f0d}exploits{/g} on each enemy in a 4-cell radius.

b32e19de-22b2-45c8-9f39-8eb4ec362a45.Text: Whenever an ally within a 4-cell radius around the servo-skull swarm gains an {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}extra turn{/g}, they have their next non-attacking ability cost reduced by −1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} and can use one consumable, spending 0 AP. If multiple servo-skull swarms are in combat, the effect does not stack.

3d31ee84-2aa4-4087-8e50-3b6c240501d0.Text: Whenever Pasqal uses {g|f:95cdd5f42ef5480d9fadd9e0acee641b}Machine Spirit Communion{/g}, the servo-skull swarm mimics the effect of this ability, creating a second area centred around it. If the areas overlap, the effect does not stack.

bab67d9c-b69e-4774-a4f2-bc38c5ccb172.Text: Whenever an {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}extra turn{/g} is granted in a 4-cell radius around the servo-skull swarm, until the end of combat, its {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} gains +3 {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerFellowship}Fellowship{/g} and has their damage increased by +{uip|BonusDamage|94f07339271446e1bd2ee4b667d3bfc7}%. Stacks.

9c68b2c8-80fd-498d-906d-6833958d4ab0.Text: Whenever an enemy in a 4-cell radius around the servo-skull swarm is {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} or becomes the target of {g|f:fbdba5fe2a264c25bada29aecd64049a}Expose Weakness{/g}, each {g|f:66e7b370e32b43118315ab0fd24a7f0d}exploit{/g} removed from that enemy grants the servo-skull swarm +1% {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} until the end of combat. Every 10 {g|f:66e7b370e32b43118315ab0fd24a7f0d}exploits{/g} removed grant it +1 {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g}.

97053eac-5002-4a67-b2a0-1894db684b07.Text: While moving, the servo-skull swarm deals {uip|Damage|75a2610727ad4d95878c6a940dd9b265} {g|Encyclopedia:ShockDamage}shock damage{/g} to each enemy it passes.

c476b16e-105b-4131-b3d8-0d228c258b12.Text: When the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} {g|f:215d9f42b7e6435e9ed77337156e0fc3}extrapolates{/g} an {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} through the servo-skull swarm for the first time in a {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}, they regain +1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}.

d80b88de-f60d-4f78-853d-e47d51d38f9e.Text: If the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} or their allies are protected by partial {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}cover{/g} in a 4-cell radius around the servo-skull swarm, they are considered protected by full cover.

c72001c4-1f1e-4aeb-b87c-ee21fdc7e84e.Text: Whenever an {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} {g|f:215d9f42b7e6435e9ed77337156e0fc3}extrapolated{/g} through the servo-skull swarm affects allies, the servo-skull swarm gains +1 {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerFellowship}Fellowship{/g}. Whenever such an ability affects enemies, the servo-skull swarm gains +1 {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerIntelligence}Intelligence{/g}. Stacks.

fed0477e-550a-4356-b2e4-26ed0500cb05.Text: While the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} is 5 or more cells away from the servo-skull swarm, their {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerFellowship}Fellowship{/g} is increased by +{uip|Bonus|4cd606a241884135b1253e705eff88e6}.

6a8ce5d6-affd-4956-89cd-f2d2ffc8f5aa.Text: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} uses {g|f:5bfccf14d8604ae1a041fb347fb8f19f}Bring It Down!{/g} on an ally in a 4-cell radius around the servo-skull swarm, which then also grants an additional {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}extra turn{/g} to another ally in that area, the servo-skull swarm gains +5 to all {g|Encyclopedia:Characteristic}characteristics{/g}. Stacks.

7efb0ee0-ef0a-4b1b-b43f-116031119eae.Text: Once per combat, the servo-skull swarm can save an ally. If that ally suffers lethal damage in a 4-cell radius around the servo-skull swarm, that ally regains <u>(servo-skull swarm's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerFellowship}FEL{/g} bonus / 3)</u>% of their {g|Encyclopedia:MaxWounds}maximum wounds{/g} and remains in combat. Then, the servo-skull swarm suffers <u>(100 − {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g}'s {g|Encyclopedia:SkillMedicae}Medicae{/g} / 5)</u>% {g|Encyclopedia:ShockDamage}shock damage{/g}.
