25729efe-dfe5-437d-bf24-d18818fd2352.Text: "You are ever so generous! Then I shall ask Master Weisz to arrange a little tour so that I may select texts that interest me." {n}Vistenza directs a winsome smile at the Choirmaster, but her charm is shattered by Weisz's almost palpable coldness.{/n}

9356bd44-4dfa-4f7c-a601-b5513c8c663e.Text: {n}She puts on the ring without hesitation and brings her hand to her chest.{/n} "I will wear it always and never take it off. To be favoured by your grace and elevated above the other nobles in your protectorate is a priceless boon."

b5734e74-df9d-4b27-ab23-64bd54e8c3c2.Text: "But Lord Captain—" {n}No sooner does Weisz begin to object than he is interrupted by Vistenza.{/n}

331dff6a-3958-401f-8706-906d7cf55c2e.Text: "Thank you for this truly generous gift. You will not regret it — I will ensure that your Astropaths work for the prosperity of Janus." {n}She bestows a radiant smile upon the Choirmaster.{/n} "I assure you, your subordinates are fortunate indeed. They shall live in my palace, where they will want for nothing."

97231f44-7d3d-4e42-9428-4ec59fcfb651.Text: "I will pray that my Astropaths do not forget their duty to the Emperor while they are being showered with your largesse."

81830af7-8934-4cde-b497-ca1cee1a7848.Text: "The Immaterium is restless." {n}Cassia's voice sounds stifled, as if she is fighting for air.{/n} "The colours are darkening... No! They are beginning to boil!"

ac045e18-6509-4263-8c6e-4e6d02fbe642.Text: {n}A blind man clad in green appears between you and the croaking Nothingness, shielding you.{/n} "What manner of abomination are you? I cannot sense you. You are not of the warp. What is your twisted nature?"

61253784-4613-42af-abf5-7afce87e3ff4.Text: "I cannot sense you either. But... I know you. I heard you were going to seek me out. My ears are everywhere. I was ready." {n}The age-worn voice is like a deep wail echoed by a throng of smaller voices. Civilisations and star clusters lie buried at the bottom of the being's pale eyes, which are aflame with hunger. Your mind feels cramped inside your skull, and you can hear the bone creaking.{/n}

04a405b7-a7f1-42b5-b231-ed8b42c98f5c.Text: "How old were you when you first took a life? You are... scarcely more than a girl. Dreadful."

d706c018-d8c2-4f49-9077-8124e676dcee.Text: "There is no sorrow in stepping onto the thread of His service early. Rather, one should lament doing so too late. Do not feel sorry for me."

7bf6927e-d669-4a6a-9d2a-8beb617caeb0.Text: "In another life, you could have worn the insignia of the Adepta Sororitas, and I would have called you sister. But your rituals — they... trouble me."

07367fac-faa1-429b-be29-e53e0c31649a.Text: "Perhaps it is because you see them as a reproach to your asceticism? My armour bears patina and dust, while yours shines bright and clean. You venerate yourself, whereas I simply wield myself."

9710e948-3e6f-4672-b638-75e6afee53be.Text: "A blood-soaked sunset of gold and crimson burns within your soul. But the rest of your colours... have faded to grey."

f88bc351-fa87-4e40-ab5c-355a9ac34056.Text: "To serve the Undying Emperor, one must excise all that is superfluous. What you see is sacrifice. What you see is duty."

b98adb3a-ec3b-46da-92fc-343e92506824.Text: "I am impressed by your combat skills and conviction. Perhaps, one day, you will consider serving Him under a different set of tenets..."

7f685fe5-2b3e-43d7-8f3f-e7d817cdf33e.Text: "Mistress Kibellah, have you ever demonstrated special... abilities inaccessible to ordinary people? Ever experienced amazing insights? Or the ability to... influence the minds of others?"

ad75a79f-8767-438c-8a16-5fa292afe518.Text: "I hear what you are saying, and I do not like your insinuations. I warn you, if you attempt to paint the Undying One's blessing as foul psykerism, you will answer for it in blood."

6b005185-19ad-4e5d-af2a-05a2f94ab638.Text: "I hear your words, and I see your intent. In truth, all you wish to change is the name of the one who commands me. But I am already the Domin's shadow."

e6d7b678-853a-41e7-a071-0f5e84049e66.Text: "So, I hear you use the Tarot to divine the future... Do you have nightmares afterward? Problems sleeping? Voices haunting you?"

76f9d2f5-14e7-4260-ad06-5d089213980a.Text: "I've been watching you divine using the Emperor's Tarot, and do you know what? I think you have the psyker's gift, sister."

222a1f81-22a5-47b2-bb7a-7ccde314b9e8.Text: "Hold your tongue or you will be punished for blasphemy, witch. I have the blessing of the Undying One upon me, not the perversity with which you are tainted."

8a38f035-b47c-4e4a-8f30-e92cdcfd0e67.Text: "All my nightmares come to me when I am awake. As for His blessed whisper: it has been with me all my life."

427ffb1a-4267-4c2a-a0fa-ce6a2145f508.Text: "First you take stimulants to hear whispers, then you torture yourself for the perverted pleasure it gives you. Admit it: your vaunted self-denial is nothing but a facade!"

a4c00c7f-9039-4a6e-8db4-1b432f584318.Text: "People see only what they know. And all you know is the poisonous sweetness of vice."

0194a2b9-cba2-4686-85c4-2882db525cef.Text: "In spite of your years, your body and spirit remain strong. Tell me, Amic'Abelard, what do you do to train them?"

c4857e6e-2259-4609-9b1f-e01e14f9ebf6.Text: "Well... I spend a lot of time running back and forth after the Lord Captain, for a start."

e8a37e79-199c-45f0-ac64-e341503ea66e.Text: "Faith leads you along your thread as it leads me along mine. We both serve Him in our own way. So, why do I see such worry in your eyes whenever you look at me, Amic'Argenta?"

47f128fc-a2a7-46ed-bb85-e42037d42742.Text: "We find our foes by different means. I kill those deemed guilty of heresy by the exalted Ecclesiarchy. You kill those identified by vague portents. And I do not know to what extent they can be trusted."

1a6ff442-fb82-4b70-b5fd-6bd5bc2ef28d.Text: "Tell me something, Veni'Cassia. Do you... truly see the Undying One's light in the darkness between the stars? What is it like?"

b962ccf5-a37f-4617-ba60-3600b6b5c8c1.Text: "Amid the boundless terror of the Sea of Souls, His distant light is... akin to a great burning heart. I see it beating in the darkness, and I know that I can find my path."

60e20317-4e04-4b2a-9a37-23928cb20d9c.Text: "I know that you are watching me, Veni'Heinrix. Not as a friend, but as a sentry. I do not mind."

dcad6719-1fea-4317-bfe7-a9afe0fd651d.Text: "Thank you. I do not doubt your loyalty, but your method for selecting victims... makes me wary."

b7a04b2c-c6d4-4db0-af0e-aee70f78eeb3.Text: "Dark forces are devouring you, tearing at your soul, Veni'Idira. I could teach you techniques to clear your mind..."

9ad48985-46e4-4229-92f9-7af8ba7f1d5a.Text: "Just no intoxication, bloodletting, or self-torture, all right? Hey, why have you gone all quiet there, Skully?"

49baf332-962c-49fe-822c-53e93c06eba0.Text: "Your faith in Him is a brazen lie. You never abstain; you only indulge. Your heart has no place for sacrifice in the Undying One's name."

57e1f7bb-42e9-41b5-b0f8-7ecedda2bd16.Text: "The Exalted One is both life and light. And yet, somehow, you lot have managed to turn His golden glow into darkness, and His mercy into savage murder."

14bcd014-d2bf-4391-8dbb-dd2eb871e0f7.Text: "I am watching you, Vil'Marazhai. I am waiting for the Undying One to whisper your name."

3e6a245b-c56c-4645-afd0-6ed06c593fbe.Text: "Ha! Yes, watch carefully. Listen for whispers. Look for me in every shadow. Who knows when a trick of your imagination might become your nightmare?"

40384707-ab0a-4802-96ab-30d394e9f6f2.Text: "You have encased yourself in metal, priest. You may trick age this way, but you cannot trick death."

be02fc90-a2f6-4161-81f5-a5d5dd36dde0.Text: "This unit's service life is not determined by entropic degradation. The Omnissiah determines all. He is greater than entropy."

31c27703-10da-484c-92b5-edd9b6f19820.Text: "Blessed Angel, I humbly offer you this blood claimed in righteous combat."

e5d96391-f221-4707-bf34-74b16e80e31c.Text: "I accept your gift, blood scryer. Use it to inscribe a rune upon my armour so that it may praise my valour."

7d4d3056-8aa0-4af0-baa5-d31d2f56919b.Text: "I have not interacted with your kind before, Vil'Yrliet. Now, I have the chance to observe the enemy up close. To study your weaknesses. I welcome this chance."

d2bb03c6-3dae-43c7-b86e-8ee715c81774.Text: "Alas, you are not the first mon-keigh I have encountered. And I can speak from experience longer than your years: you are no different from the rest."

0760895e-660c-4697-ad4b-fe7def1379d0.Text: "Spatters of hot blood on your face, a blade sinking gently into flesh, prey trembling in your hands... Does it not stimulate your senses, slayer?"

13037cd9-338d-410a-80ad-78b6924e4e2d.Text: "What stimulates me is this question: could you still serve the Domin if you had no tongue?"

1897749c-08fc-47a1-8f1c-360e4cd8f219.Text: "I am registering a significant quantity of non-essential self-harm inflicted by this unit. Requesting clarification."

4d94a102-6998-4385-bf07-fc10097f19a3.Text: "You reshape your body so that it may reflect the depth of your devotion. So too do I reshape mine. The scars on my skin become prayers, and my every torment turns into zeal."

3ad00d7a-a3cb-4338-91eb-2505510ef7f2.Text: "Tell me, blood scryer of the Allfather... What about... me?"

2f6f8679-379e-405b-b4f8-a1e6374eb8e7.Text: "Your life is already short, and yet, still you charge toward death. Like a flaming comet falling into a star."

8e2e0b03-65f6-4fa5-a720-ce827a3de870.Text: "You treasure your long life, but it is hollow. This is why you waver on your many paths while I walk surely along a single thread. I can do more in the moment I have been given than you can achieve in centuries."

4f5a3046-8c9c-4d12-973f-0036b3879208.Text: "For every bad thing that ever happened, old Weisz was always there to blame me for it — who's the troublemaker now, eh? The warp, it spares no one, burnt eyes or no."

161db519-1091-4288-963c-4cc8029bc40d.Text: "No offence, shereen, but for sheer quantity of unpredictable episodes, you are still firmly in the lead."

5efb90ad-0f77-4bc4-80c7-10e49238446e.Text: "Yes, you are right. Gothis, both of you. As if there was ever a time when your ilk did not stink of plague."

913a5dde-33e6-4b00-95cc-d1c7d5965e8e.Text: "You keep dozens of madmen who are constantly staring into Sha'eil, and yet you are surprised when they fall prey to the nightmares of She Who Thirsts? The sheer thoughtlessness of your kind..."

9760fb3b-679f-4899-9fc2-bb3c3a3de2cd.Text: "At least we can survive it and still prevail. How does your own kind fare on that score?"

be77885d-e959-49c0-ab29-c8fcf2f9f2f5.Text: "No one is keeping you here, ashmag. You're welcome to demonstrate your superior intellect all you like in the void. Shall I hold the airlock open for you?"

2108aa7c-bf2f-4d57-a308-6c888135252d.Text: "The souls that tormented Veni'Zacchary... Did they reject death? Or did the Undying One accept them into His hands in the end?"

086e9107-dfb6-4770-9513-0c50ecf30675.Text: "I don't hear them among the whispers. So, let's hope it's the second one."

2a094c6a-7e6f-4342-b05b-8c4c3af08bc9.Text: "Seldom does She Who Thirsts release victims from her grasp. It is better that you do not dwell on their fate."

42b16f27-47af-4da0-86ed-c54389673723.Text: "An entire cult of mutant spawn, hiding among the dynasty's most eminent dead... It's simply inconceivable!"

80a5e940-a7ac-442e-aebb-647aa876b18d.Text: "They dared defile Lady Theodora's memory! I hope all the daemons in the warp are clawing at their rotten souls right now."

ddaafa4e-e246-4774-a35d-24b7a5b59b29.Text: "If I were you, I would be less concerned about the desecration and more concerned about where else they might be hiding."

fc8595cb-0471-40f3-8afe-1ad28a845687.Text: "I find it suspicious that a Genestealer Magus was in charge of this cell. They occupy a high position in the cult power structure, but not the highest... not according to the reports I have received."

69fc33bf-55f0-44b4-9f0c-8d345c9c55de.Text: "Which you will predictably withhold from the rest of us, you scheming pest."

cb9937ef-ab9d-42cb-9b34-d2109cbbafd1.Text: "I trust your vigilance, Heinrix. And I hope that you will trust in my righteous fury if you discover any more of these abominations."

1cca6b1d-8755-4e32-bc24-8b7d54e5e876.Text: "I cannot approve of how the Bloodspun Web seeks to lord it over the crew. We may acknowledge the spinners, but that does not make them superior to our officers!"

0a0fe209-d5ce-4589-bfbf-c2393d2d11d3.Text: "You know nothing about what makes one superior... but she is beginning to understand. And I marvel at how this revelation has changed her."

c62ca6af-2b74-4d0a-9817-6856670e614f.Text: "Power has corrupted Kibellah so swiftly. I fear that this will all end in fratricidal strife."

613a689d-c068-4b25-bc7f-7682a0f8a48c.Text: "These webspinners bathe in blood, gut corpses, and perform shady rituals... Remind me, how are these cultists any better than the ones we kill?"

17751f06-102f-4e54-8892-a84c10e8a72d.Text: "Because they do all that to someone other than us, obviously."

e4ff1467-3722-4441-9ea1-d6b44e7698a1.Text: "Death cults often cross the line. They are dangerous... but useful. Like any weapon."

ed1b2f8d-a052-48d0-84d3-e1c623aced82.Text: "Is it seemly for valued servants of the Emperor to huddle together in such a squalid abode?"

fc79fd19-b0bb-4fa8-b803-36b9c752f8f1.Text: "We attach importance to other things, Veni'Cassia. Ascesis is how we achieve self-perfection. Our feats of faith are our gold, and the prayers written upon our walls serve as our murals."

c8a5ebba-99fe-4c11-8ab6-642ce51e4676.Text: "Laypeople always overvalue indications of status. Prestige is demonstrated through functional superiority, not the quantification of one's possessions."

3b370aea-bf30-4b18-b170-e07645545d2c.Text: "We should not have let the aberrations' families live. A poor time to bow to sentiment."

13c066f7-3545-49d1-a4a3-31bc511d92ef.Text: "This statement is true. Emotion severely impairs rational judgement."

5ae968f9-5168-446b-a07f-23a5747a6ec2.Text: "Oh, what possible reason could they have had to hate such kindly souls as us, I wonder?"

f6a532ec-f8cc-40ce-812c-34226013c6f0.Text: "Will it make me the scum of the galaxy if I say I'm not the slightest bit sorry Kibellah is gone? I know she was one of us, but..."

5093f6e2-7c08-4857-ba1b-4253082d5e9e.Text: "'...but boy, are we going to sleep well tonight'? What a thing to say, Jae! You're a terrible person, and nobody else feels that way at all. Certainly not!"

e5c46516-0c1a-42b4-98e1-4deb00dd65ea.Text: "I am registering satisfaction at the death of an ally. This unit has met my expectations with this show of disloyalty."

49ec690e-678b-4225-9e34-888778adf979.Text: "I grieve for the blood scryer. She knew how to make me laugh."

2f32ccbf-00d2-435d-b20a-ad69677164cd.Text: "She what? Are we talking about the same person here?"

04d5b8f1-b991-4b65-b511-5dd56e97ecd2.Text: "Well, I learned something about Fenrisian humour today."

d1c3c57e-2482-4483-b012-e6b9ac096641.Text: "Although the rites of the Bloodspun Web seem radical to me, I am glad to have such a fervent and devout warrior of the Emperor at our side."

f1cb2822-c2b2-417e-a3e4-fccc4858a5a4.Text: "I sense a peculiar resemblance between us. We were both raised by our... houses, if you will — raised for a glorious purpose."

1b9fc490-1226-464f-ab35-3224ab6b2ac6.Text: "I too am glad to fight side by side with His worthy servant, even though I usually hunt alone."

fa61befc-fd61-4f93-944e-bbfde68f297c.Text: "The configuration of units known as the Bloodspun Web has been updated. Such revision is welcome, for it prevents entropy."

49678e22-b6b5-481d-8616-5233ac0adcd7.Text: "You're just glad you're not the only one in our tight-knit circle who has defeated their mentor."

3d47274e-02df-47f8-8115-6176212dc88a.Text: "The sacrifice she made was terrible... And yet, as astounded as I am, I have nothing but respect for her."

632befc6-4f53-465f-a07e-91b79a0e0339.Text: "Kibellah... Poor girl. That is now twice that her service has robbed her of family."

df3f5c7c-0fbd-4f56-be16-fbcebec9d3d3.Text: "Do not demean her with your pity. The blood scryer walks a harsh but honourable path. The conclusion will be grim, of course, but that is the only way for worthy tales to end."

345c8cff-d988-4af1-ae3d-6ab62bb9783a.Text: "One can only hope that she took at least some pleasure in killing her mentor. Such an exhilarating moment deserves to be savoured!"

08eef5cd-b73c-46be-9b10-cf41e8b1c79b.Text: "A Lord Captain who graces the freight line with visits and speaks to the lowliest of serfs... Retirement has never sounded more tempting!"

c9132dc5-6284-4cb5-8b61-41243ed7c3e0.Text: "We have survived a heretical mutiny, Lady Theodora's death, the warp spitting us out into grox knows where... and what shocks you is the Lord Captain going down to the lower decks? Seriously?"

2777e187-7878-4d27-a875-355fdbdf8f89.Text: "All it means is that {mf|he|she} is more attentive to {mf|his|her} subjects than Lady Theodora ever was. It is unfortunate that you should find this surprising rather than heartening."

857506a9-24dd-44a2-8b04-740f94145273.Text: "The Rogue Trader descending into the abode of wretched serfs — is it some sort of tradition? If so, then it is certainly not one my House has adopted."

6fe4d000-bd12-4df6-a2f0-0571f37a962d.Text: "Oh, Lady Theodora would be tickled pink to hear about a tradition like that."

59867898-e300-4353-b6a2-39d830249f29.Text: "I would call it wisdom. Anyone smart enough understands that they should know everything that goes on in their home, even in its darkest corners."

9a2a8588-04cc-429b-ab8c-3ba0a0e47a52.Text: "I certainly hope that was the last Nemesite. I have lost count of how many dead firebrands claimed to carry that infamous name."

1c8c327d-cc07-4ac8-a282-eac4890750e7.Text: "Rebels like him appear all too regularly. If it's not a Nemesite, it'll be someone else. They're like mould, these people."

0a4d34c8-8fb4-4bae-97ee-0eeac293e971.Text: "Look, I know he was a mutant freak. But you have to admit, old man: he did trick people with promises of freedom. Maybe we should ease up on them a little, you know?"

4614df39-79bc-4549-bab6-959a1d9306ff.Text: "Until his last breath, Nemesite was dedicated to his purpose. Had he not been the weapon of a twisted will, I would have recognised him as worthy."

506008b4-e406-4f5e-858c-7cc3d439e051.Text: "You are driven by your service to the Emperor, while he was nothing but a heretical spawn, an abomination. Do not suggest that the two of you were alike."

e8baa839-e06d-4fb4-8168-c52219115c53.Text: "You mon-keigh are all equally unsettling in your self-renunciations, regardless of what path you might choose."

75db4bff-c0df-488c-83b8-97deb4017cab.Text: "When that many-armed monster looked at me, I saw... something — an immense black shadow floating just beyond its gaze. There were no colours there at all... None."

af7a21a9-c3fd-4476-a66e-8c992fac968e.Text: "And I heard Nothing. A great, big Nothing. But don't worry, whatever it is, it's far away... right?"

ae622fd9-fd12-48bc-b922-95ea3dcf7783.Text: "What you saw was inevitability, seer of Sha'eil. The Shadow of the Devourer. Seek solace in the knowledge that you will probably not live to see the day when it reaches you."

10dd8a12-4359-41e9-a71e-9d21c90bfd64.Text: "I wish I had taken some time to play with that many-armed monstrosity. Mmm, I wonder what its pain would have tasted like."

edb9123a-3839-462c-9fa3-a3d5c691a27b.Text: "This is why the great curse fell upon our people: because of our inability to curb our most twisted curiosity."

617477cc-ceb5-4922-8dc6-40fd274766d9.Text: "So, the Lord Captain is indulging the spinners now? Is {mf|he|she} going to start cutting people left and right because 'the Undying One gave {mf|him|her} a sign'?"

31685766-6fc3-48ea-b878-c971d17d1da6.Text: "Oh, by the Holy Throne... I hope not. This dynasty is enough of a mess as it is!"

107c1a4f-d297-4ea5-8648-27c20506c6f9.Text: "Your worry is misplaced. If the Undying One whispers your name, it will not be the Domin who claims you. It will be I, and I will do so with the proper respect."

e09c348f-d244-41ee-8e52-54beecf80352.Text: "The flute player has vanished into thin air. Unfortunately, this just confirms my fears that there is something not quite right about him."

96cc7b18-9501-4293-a8c6-d98e62d76e88.Text: "Lower-deckers go missing all the time. Maybe he got run over by a train."

76e970c7-3a29-4fd6-bab5-0529243eb069.Text: "If he managed to spot the tail and cover his tracks, that truly is cause for concern. Vagrant musicians tend not to possess such skills."

987b1bb4-dc5a-4c74-ac34-dc2424792049.Text: "The whispers are yelping with delight. They always get so excited when they sense others like them nearby."

ddbc8fce-f6b8-4956-9ade-5a1afb485970.Text: "I hear the voices of the dead... as if they were standing right behind me."

6311d3b7-71e5-456b-b8e0-d22a68e33c8c.Text: "There is corruption in this chapel. I can hear it in the shadows — it wails with the voices of the souls it has devoured."

f4e15a5c-ccb1-4220-bf0d-ffb8ba2e1c7f.Text: "A fell place is this. Let us offer a bountiful tribute to the Allfather at the altar of chants, and then burn it all to the ground."

7cd4f3a3-02e5-4746-86a2-ce902da0cd8d.Text: "Ugh, they're staring at me with their burnt eyes like I'm a leper. I'm just passing through, all right? So you lot can calm down!"

81bce542-fe6e-4e85-b305-f4336bad3d60.Text: "Your presence has flooded the Astropaths' souls with myriad shades of horror... No, we should not tarry here."

5da700df-b861-4ac0-b455-799c8fac8d00.Text: "How fascinating. To me, the Immaterium is made of colours, but to the Astropaths who dwell in this chapel, it is music."

99154bc8-4daa-45d9-af47-ad7d70e7f3d0.Text: "Cursed music. Why do the Astropaths not fill this place with litanies in His name instead?"

940a3728-6a20-41c0-b0c3-6c60d6386cd9.Text: "You're awful quiet there, Abelard. Are you picking out a nice spot for yourself? That pretty little casket looks as good as any!"

02d2fea8-b906-45c6-8810-35964839acc6.Text: "Mistress Tlass, I would appreciate it if you would stop treating me as if I were at death's door. To be interred here would be a high honour, but I would rather my final resting place be on Dargonus, closer to my family."

3e1be735-e523-4514-95ec-f9333b3daff1.Text: "The heretics have made their lair in a hallowed compartment. They seek to make a mockery of our great faith!"

a918a9a1-6c39-4be7-8757-e1eb62fe36b8.Text: "Were sacrilege their intention, they would have defiled the crypt beyond recognition. No, they simply needed a quiet place to hide. Devious scum."

8b60b3b5-404c-44b7-8376-1e1121ce21e8.Text: "These bones of the dead should be serving the living. They could be used in rites or divinations, or as amulets. Why are they here, gathering dust and concealed from people's eyes?"

8a60d531-81e3-4597-b735-9855cf975004.Text: "This statement is true. The remains could be usefully processed into corpse starch, and the premises refitted to house the vessel's systems."

c35bcbea-0b3d-4284-a910-dd03256cb29f.Text: "Why does this place look deserted? On Efreet, the burial sites of eminent figures are always crowded with people absorbed in prayer."

7ff4ef4a-6d21-4932-aa61-ed2bec2deda5.Text: "We are voidsmen. Our dead prefer to sleep in silence. Only a small number of servitors attend to their needs."

baf44103-4281-4e91-b77e-771c745a85d6.Text: "Child of Asuryan, doomed to spend an eternity alone amid the dust of mon-keigh... It is not my place to judge your choice of Path, and yet, my soul grieves — do you not hear its cry?"

1594d4ff-13db-4ad2-9981-4266b2e493bf.Text: "I am not even going to bother listing every law and canon of the Imperium that this burial place violates."

3275fd5a-b4ae-4a15-9ab3-c29cc2889d28.Text: "I am glad to note that the Bloodspun Web does not show any signs of heresy, unlike so many other death cults."

a36c76a2-4a3c-47af-b396-1c9d45bcdb13.Text: "First, the Rogue Trader gives the cult the go-ahead, now an Inquisitor does too... I guess there's just no putting a lid on this den of murderers anymore."

79572fcf-9393-4bbd-a9e6-402edfb6547f.Text: "The shrouded faith of the Bloodspun Web... It is both frightening and awe-inspiring."

a673af88-ad70-4811-b1dd-1aa38d2721ec.Text: "As is the fact that they have managed to claim a whole compartment to themselves, and the officers somehow failed to notice. I shall conduct an inspection."

f718a7be-5b92-4e5c-8577-9c565646a416.Text: "I am registering one hundred and thirty-seven violations of the Catechism of Maintenance and Operation here. Initialising enumeration. One: 'keep the screw thread as your augmetic eye'..."

6f622766-4ad8-40b9-805e-21ec37a340d0.Text: "Oh no, not again. How do I turn him off? Anybody?"

60c06938-d800-4a06-9cb9-39d2e726b634.Text: "Ah, shereen, what fabulous places you take us to! Abandoned ships, foul-smelling backstreets, and now a filthy compartment where anyone is welcome to get themselves killed by a conductive charge..."

d30f5ab2-e3d0-4beb-ba0a-3855b3457754.Text: "I, for one, cannot wait until this bold streak passes and the Lord Captain realises just how comfortable {mf|his|her} throne is."

d3cb4f3c-da6e-497b-8ced-e93e6c99fcfb.Text: "Death has whispered many names, yet when it got to ours, it simply... stopped. Not here. Not now. Not today."

ff29b363-24ac-4a9b-a797-20d8dec80d0b.Text: "Remind me to light a candle in that temple of yours. I'll have to ask death to stammer more often."

05c4e498-7cad-40ab-820c-383992c7bbd1.Text: "Curses! Aett-Vater, is your drekkar truly so flimsy? That would have been a shameful death!"

0eae191e-b9b7-4b4d-9711-50786fb77e40.Text: "The sacred mechanism is not to blame for this incident. All required litanies of actuation and maintenance have been performed. Hypothesis: the cause of the failure was the excessive mass of the unit Ulfar."

b719867c-732b-456f-ba7f-8a1edd2ea180.Text: "Do we truly... have to be here? I am not even sure what is making me more nauseous: these horrid colours, or the smell..."

b85709b4-c76d-4b90-b5d2-d7f972a51c16.Text: "Light of my eyes, may I offer you a drink from my flask? In a mere instant, the colours will seem more pleasing, and you won't mind the smell anymore either!"

ca4a2f62-add4-4100-b521-3b009205e6fe.Text: "Upper-deckers avoid coming here. But how can one live aboard the flagship only to turn one's back on the core that gives it life?"

5a4216a5-5899-4563-891a-2c6bbc656818.Text: "This core can just as easily take a life too, especially if someone around here takes a fancy to your boots."

969a907b-b39d-42b4-afb1-8c950689dbc6.Text: "Crimson, black, cerulean, grey... It has all become an ugly whirlwind of muck. Rage and despair have poisoned the bay."

ca2d54e5-8977-4305-82f5-c85efbbf5fc9.Text: "And treason has poisoned the whole damn ship. In the interest of dealing with it, I will try my best to ignore this ugly whirlwind you speak of."

e67e3e5e-70f6-4e8d-af37-fdd6bb677509.Text: "This is a charming appetiser to be sure, but compared to the arenas of Commorragh, their suffering is quite flavourless. I could give your torturers a few riveting lessons, if you like."

11218c2c-4454-4ff9-9dc8-fad67262e9b5.Text: "With you as the study material, I hope? I am almost certain you're the one behind this blood spectacle, you depraved scum!"

dd21877b-3550-40ba-8a6e-3fd73b24d607.Text: "Sadness always takes me when I see good steel and banners falling into disuse like this. Their place should be on the field of battle, not inside these gilded chests."

c9aee775-bcf3-41af-be83-93a3dcb8c64a.Text: "Banish your sorrow, warrior, for they serve a purpose still. People gaze upon them and they become filled with His light, inspired to fight anew against the enemies of Humanity!"

42ff3963-0a8e-4324-8eed-22512e91458e.Text: "Why, Seneschal, it is positively scandalous of you to invade a lady's personal space like this, let alone in a place of holy worship. Do you, perchance, have something untoward in mind?"

71d43c88-7b98-4081-96a9-0b71632253c9.Text: "Kindly keep your antics to yourself — and your hands too. I am merely making sure that the dynasty's relics do not end up in the inventory of some Kasballican fence."

31d4132b-f51c-4fed-8aec-fbe5f19ad65e.Text: "Their deaths strengthen the thread that leads to freedom. That is all I need to know."

890f97c9-e5be-4722-a830-446324f5f7b6.Text: "The glow of emergency beacons in the darkness is more familiar to me than the light of any star. Follow me, Domin. I will guide us."

56942bd2-7e7a-4a6e-b912-c80ef3c60bcb.Text: "The world is crumbling, the star has gone out, and she is looking for the positives. The grit of a true voidborn!"

58cf8fc8-a6db-41fe-8a13-b11ed9f5a1f0.Text: "We're surrounded by darkness... and flames... and you're feeling... cosy?"

b1e0e9e4-6385-47f0-8c18-93f8b981aa8b.Text: "The souls of Rykad Minoris... They will never reach the Undying One — their names have been distorted forever, and He will not be able to utter them."

07209bd1-22eb-435b-87d6-bd7e5062b588.Text: "Not just their names. Indeed, a fate worse than death has befallen them."

c9da5f72-7e11-463f-a478-356d385c7709.Text: "Every time I close my eyes, my eyelids burn with the maddening colours of a world consumed by heresy. A terrible sight to behold."

76fdb148-693b-4ecb-a1df-f857e85b24b4.Text: "Governor Medineh has done the living a grave disservice. It grieves me to think how he will serve the Undying One when He calls His servant to His side."

493915b5-6e5d-44d1-88fc-f4edaccd2d5a.Text: "The privilege of saying what you think with no regard for diplomacy is a gift, one I hope you appreciate."

dbb0400f-8f09-4737-bfdf-0cd6cf454468.Text: "Such harsh judgement of a superior from the insolent mouth of a common— I beg your pardon, what I meant to say was I am amazed at the boldness of your thought."

cff239c3-c1b4-4b02-bce7-51ac896956b2.Text: "The Web bleeds in mourning for Domin'Theodora. We honoured the Giver of Life. We made generous sacrifices so that her path to the Undying One would be easy."

1570262f-44c7-45aa-b4db-dbc90f52fab4.Text: "You know that I killed Lady Theodora, but I see no reproach in your gaze — why?"

53a6b7c4-6f0c-4ab7-987b-7e53f0ceb284.Text: "The Undying One called Domin'Theodora's name. He merely chose you to carry out His will. Nothing else matters."

3fec64b4-69f4-4122-bac6-f3cae623f1b6.Text: "It was right that Vil'Marazhai was killed. But not like this. Not for the amusement of the xenos, and not according to their rules."

01910f28-21af-41ac-b0e3-1b7e1b507487.Text: "I too would have preferred eight hours of interrogating the wretch with the use of biomancy first, but we must be grateful to the Emperor for small blessings."

9439ce0f-dd69-49ca-80bb-1a4141460c62.Text: "Nonsense! The worm has gone into the jaws of Morkai, and the other wretches have seen that their best warriors are no match for us."

82000bb2-348f-4173-bfb6-03396d93553f.Text: "I like Vil'Jae better without the mask. But rot without a mask is still rot."

038bf3d6-28d1-4b28-b1fd-53a501c9c5cd.Text: "Looks like we picked the right unhinged zealot after all. Or did all your dead doppelgangers hate me just as much as you do?"

418f504f-8e0b-4af3-bccd-d366c4135442.Text: "I remember you helping them to remove the corpses from my cell, Veni'Idira. You looked... peaceful."

18a6b418-c0cd-4fbf-ae33-788c3bacc139.Text: "I was so engrossed in the newfound silence that I didn't even realise it was you at first. I'm so sorry, Kibellah..."

1ddd52cc-8381-48c7-9965-e1f57bb04968.Text: "Blood scryer, I have watched you do battle with yourself. A hard test, a brutal test — this is the true deviousness of the xenos."

4ac20a36-2a3a-4787-902e-87bd7c9bd44f.Text: "I am glad a blessed Angel beheld my agony. To die before you is an honour."

73b32463-2a12-4fdd-98a9-78ce654edac5.Text: "To bear witness to an oath of His blessed Angel is a great gift. To bear witness to an oath of inescapable vengeance is the greatest gift of all."

13c35e03-6c72-47dd-883b-d0418e70fc49.Text: "Your clan paid in blood for the attack on the Domin. Carry the memory of it."

f6927473-50b3-4827-8aca-051e9ad61c49.Text: "I... shall consider this a show of sympathy, rather than a threat."

77f917ec-8bba-4351-a9bc-b7afc437a0b5.Text: "Red priest, grant me your blood. Through divination I will know if corruption festers on the flagship as it does on the red priests' vessel."

6404825b-d310-4849-8033-d73c7ecca457.Text: "I wonder if the cog's got any blood left. I bet it's been years since there's been anything but machine oil in there."

bfdb9d8d-83b9-45f0-a8d8-a80f6c8cbe14.Text: "Two threads tied together by duty. Such bonds are stronger than any sentiment the laity extol."

6f64555c-cc49-4543-bde1-3dbe457cc601.Text: "Veni'Heinrix, my thread is inseparable from the Domin. I am {mf|his|her} shadow, and our bond is unbreakable. Step aside."

d481ab03-e24d-4da8-b8a5-3d3d8a14cc51.Text: "I fear we have both allowed ourselves to mix duty and sentiment. I will not back down — and I suppose neither will you."

a09dd18d-978c-43fc-bb97-d5ea74f4deb8.Text: "The Domin gave you a chance because {mf|his|her} mind is clouded with emotion. I bear no such burden, and I will cut short your life without a second's hesitation."

7566973d-7ba3-4c5e-97a2-f69cedc2d83b.Text: "For some reason, everyone on the ship sees the elantach as an unreasonable child. If you truly esteem {mf|him|her}, then recognise that {mf|he|she} can forge {mf|his|her} own path."

0b885061-2861-4afb-b5f5-090ce3dfdf05.Text: "The commoners should never have opposed the will of Amic'Abelard. Each person has their place on the flagship, their burden awarded by the Undying One."

40a590f1-4623-45ec-967b-55efa91c7e3c.Text: "Mistress Kibellah, spare an old man's heart — any more of that and I'll have to adopt you."

0dc45f3b-f99e-4900-b7a2-4f040f2184cd.Text: "This is what happens when you act against the will of the Undying One. Evayne was trying to save someone whose name had already been spoken."

febf2c98-ed93-4cb4-b90e-75937f8f814c.Text: "For individuals of Evayne's standing, friendship is an unacceptable luxury and a vulnerability that the Ruinous Powers are only too eager to exploit."

f9d48340-37ad-40b6-98b5-c310eba89a76.Text: "Just one crazy aristocrat getting into trouble trying to talk sense into another crazy aristocrat. Rich people have a strange way of amusing themselves..."

0e92021b-235a-487e-8b1b-7f5d8935a945.Text: "Vil'Yrliet is dead. The blood debt has been paid. The Tenets of the Web have been fulfilled."

9fb00651-65d8-4d52-95c5-2a047e5f1714.Text: "Registering manipulation of the fallen traitor's corpse. Hypothesis: the red hair on the hilt of the weapon belonged to the unit Yrliet."

8865f844-ce6a-4e14-adb6-82f8346d3b7d.Text: "Listen, bonehead, I often want to strangle you, but... I'm sorry you had to do it to yourself."

94139086-d134-4288-b23f-5a8101906e6c.Text: "I do not want your pity. Not now, not ever."

d9fbfcd2-59b6-47f5-a0f4-c48450d1d9e4.Text: "You are most definitely the genuine article and not a replica fashioned by the Haemonculus, Mistress Kibellah. If the Lord Captain's bodyguard had been switched, I would know."

e80cfb69-86a4-4a22-8cb0-fb1bb5915ca7.Text: "I am grateful, Amic'Abelard. I hope the xenos cannot deceive your instincts as he deceived mine."

feec0d57-c57c-4e1e-b4a4-d920347e9144.Text: "Your house is dead — the right thing to do is for you to follow it too."

8f127a64-fe9b-4a34-bd7e-1d16b2894f77.Text: "Is the Domin trying to comprehend the limits of baseness and vice? Is that why Vil'Jae is allowed to live?"

e7c3a996-c3f2-4313-95b4-ca61bfb96fee.Text: "You simply have to hit every nerve you come across, don't you? Let's just chalk this one up to the Lord Captain's whims."

a5d7e5f0-2b8a-43e1-af08-057dbd0488d2.Text: "You have won a glorious victory — allow me to let the blood from your scars, so that the pain may strengthen you for the battles to come."

20db1d33-fb55-4de3-abc0-09adf4cbea56.Text: "Janus is full of colour and fragrance, but I will not miss it. The decks of the flagship mean more to me than this rampant greenery."

b7b57266-d441-4393-baf2-b11fd23e5660.Text: "The Lilaethan sighs with relief whenever a mon-keigh ceases defiling her with their presence."

0f4dc7c9-7e9f-499f-a3af-725eacfa5601.Text: "Registering: the unit Kibellah, like most voidborn, is uncomfortable with natural planetary gravity and atmosphere."

b6402122-ff5a-461a-832f-d193006ef668.Text: "What sacraments do the servants of the Administratum perform to deaden the spirit of those who visit their cult's temple? I wish to tell the Vizsier about them."

5f7093e6-38cb-4550-8307-619d988b643b.Text: "The xenos that attacked Dargonus have no respect for death. They ridicule it and turn the act of killing into a mockery."

4a16c984-c3f5-4712-8c32-b970dd44146c.Text: "It is not death that feeds them, but suffering. They cling to life, though they were doomed long ago."

caffe23b-22e7-4727-b693-84ee8dcf265e.Text: "They slaughtered thousands of people, but what bothers you is that they did it without showing the proper respect? Madness."

ec35fca5-0171-4d40-9c4f-4768f30d6085.Text: "I am grateful to the Undying One for the opportunity to kill this xenos many times over... Poetic justice for what he did to me."

8a90a9de-c528-4e50-a16a-e646f9ccef77.Text: "No one is immortal, Seneschal. The Undying One whispers everyone's name in the end."

ce9e73d7-aef4-4e4f-80a9-90b216637703.Text: "I will carry in my heart the dark memory of that place. The place where His whisper does not sound. Where there is no hope."

be38f979-1a9a-4020-a49c-a75807cb1bf0.Text: "The mind is clouded, the eye blind, and the ear deaf, but blood does not lie. His Angel slew daemons — his own or ours, it does not matter."

28496164-6d69-4764-bf46-c278ba696479.Text: "There is no blood on this battlefield, not a trace. I advise you not to succumb to the... ah... hysteria that has gripped our esteemed companion. And pray to the Emperor."

26ebe73a-75dc-4170-9d64-2c11512f7199.Text: "All that brutal, monstrous power in body and spirit — I still cannot believe he did not break under the force of it."

99fd6f82-0a24-4d9b-9cd4-891a4158dec9.Text: "Blood has guided Amic'Argenta since her birth. Blood has led her to that which is hidden. Blessed are those who steadily walk the thread!"

1081238b-ef3b-44e7-9705-a1a38d1642de.Text: "The preacher Jerobor wrote, 'Each will be asked according to their strength and rewarded according to their merit.' I shudder even to imagine her reward."

1f51b9b6-cf3f-44aa-84aa-098525685304.Text: "The Domin grants great favour to Vil'Marazhai, but it will be swallowed by the dark abyss without a glimmer of gratitude."

fc691883-abad-452e-a5a6-3c23d5c2a805.Text: "Gratitude is a pitiful fiction. The Rogue Trader is useful to me, and {mf|he|she} likes it."

c1672fec-b225-480e-bdff-cdbeeacbbcbe.Text: "Blessings can be bestowed upon peasants directly, as Incendia Chorda does? And the Domin has the right to do the same?"

23aec93f-724b-441d-af29-fb08d5ded4ab.Text: "I knew a commander who preferred quick, simple, and effective measures. A shame he didn't survive."

8078125b-36dd-4048-adb2-e6319866fef3.Text: "A Rogue Trader's privileges are extensive. On Footfall, they are limitless. But some still are wise enough not to exercise those privileges to the fullest."

672e9ac0-91ce-419c-a4ac-b88ba13a2a63.Text: "Our footsteps sound louder than usual. Their thunderous echoes are magnified by the terror in the xenos' hearts."

cecc82b3-6742-481b-892c-eb9002695b0a.Text: "This carnage has really livened you up. Are you sure you're not one of the Drukhari?"

ad6c739a-550e-4100-a98a-0855e02e2fec.Text: "Hmm, I sense no change. The fear of our enemies carries the same odour. It stank of rotten meat before and it stinks still."

40b1bc33-e5fa-452c-a062-eb73e5850dbb.Text: "I have laid out His Tarot, and the spread promises danger. Think carefully where you are leading the Domin, xenos."

fd8ba23a-e26a-4555-8080-2c3fba94ce52.Text: "I have seen you draw labyrinths of blood and dance in them with whirling blades. Crude, but the intent is sound. Shall I show you how it ought to be done?"

f7341564-c91e-4cdf-9c70-524404e3b99a.Text: "The only dance you can teach me is the one where you lie twitching on the deck with your throat slashed open."

76e64ccf-abb8-4af8-93c1-6a2d6bc01e78.Text: "I hope the Domin bringing a xenos into {mf|his|her} retinue is some kind of elaborate trap."

05faf072-7caf-4513-ac9f-4f503935bab3.Text: "If that is the case, then we should have been informed. Otherwise, the prey might find its neck snapped before the trap can slam shut."

17fec39e-5a4b-4e47-90f9-102eac1449cb.Text: "If I had known what they had done to you, I would have come to extricate you... or to bestow His Peace."

d9d3cc0d-e180-4a0a-9f59-65b00c3d9f5e.Text: "I prayed many times for that to happen, but He is nowhere to be found in this cursed place."

99982051-d4e4-491a-833d-ee24cb77e248.Text: "A coddled life leads to nothing but ruin. Trials are what hardens the spirit. Veni'Cassia should offer thanks to the Undying One for the suffering she has endured."

4d21d921-ec81-4448-94c0-5b4d20cef4aa.Text: "This outlook on life is unseemly and crude... but not without truth. The characters in my favourite novels have to overcome adversity — now it is my turn."

f09fa350-3f6e-4d2c-8ded-b52e7232c07c.Text: "One has lived a life of self-denial and training, the other — one of luxury and books. Neither has any idea how real life works."

baeb1a2b-5ca7-4c9e-97c3-f27c78f5b738.Text: "As Seneschal, I cannot help but be concerned: won't Kibellah's personal feelings affect her performance of her duties as bodyguard?"

f955b2be-f8c3-4d71-90a0-f8962d34e597.Text: "I am a shield, a shadow, a blade, none of which have 'personal feelings.'"

734cea5b-2184-4322-a342-46610da41311.Text: "Breaking up with a death cult assassin and staying in the same sector as her? The Lord Captain's got guts."

ffcbc5e4-57bd-4feb-9351-6ad4042b85ec.Text: "Order has returned to the colours of your soul. Are you... relieved that your bond with the Lord Captain has been broken?"

273a3d12-4c0d-49c2-96c1-541ff0d4d677.Text: "Our bond has not been broken. It has become what it should be. I will say nothing more about it to you."

4d2872ac-a67f-4f4d-be8d-752295fb5e36.Text: "Blessed Throne, our little girl's got fangs beneath that veil of naivety!"

6bb2d7d8-5311-4238-ab37-d04cc72e06c0.Text: "The Domin's deeds have cast a shadow over us all. They could not live in the growing darkness. We are stronger — we will remain with the Domin... until the Undying One gives a sign."

9593c588-fc18-49eb-8264-8492801db09a.Text: "I hear Mistress Kibellah has made quite an impression on Dargonus. I never tire of marvelling at the edifying influence {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship} has on those around {mf|him|her}."

55d01eee-1be7-45bb-86a6-dafa5475f48c.Text: "Now she is truly terrifying. A maniac who can pretend to be normal is ten times more dangerous."

7d6682b8-67cb-4994-9422-1da89e80a6ad.Text: "It seems the connection with the Lord Captain is slowly driving Kibellah mad. Should we maybe..."

24b7f6cf-2424-4b46-86af-1d71acef3508.Text: "Rest assured, Mistress Tlass, you are not the only one who sees it, or the only one who cares about the Lord Captain's life... And you are not the only one who has taken proactive measures."

3fa4c95a-2b63-4c06-9a34-17cf8ee6f0d8.Text: "I think she was mad to begin with, but I'm glad you're at least noticing it now!"

61b61c95-4e17-4f3d-92e6-3c1c713c6ff7.Text: "What the priest in red did... I felt the will of the Undying One. He doomed the machine spirit as I doom the souls of people."

4ec2959a-05f9-4f94-91d4-ce4dde0224ff.Text: "I hope he shows more consideration for the machinery on board our ship than the spinners of the Bloodspun Web do our crew members."

78193bb0-830c-4297-a6f0-3149c800e5b6.Text: "Kibellah, how do you see your relationship with the Lord Captain? As part of your duty as a bodyguard? Or as something that violates that duty?"

b5e18186-eedf-4914-861a-3b5284ee38cc.Text: "Neither... and both. I do not know. It is a thread leading into darkness."

7f5e7e43-0d72-4710-a801-66b6c23038d4.Text: "The Lord Captain shouldn't have let the assassin get so close... If you know what I mean."

e86208c6-976d-4030-8653-dd2b0ba4554b.Text: "Well, at least in bed she's unarmed and so she's not as dangerous. She is unarmed, right?"

978062d9-88ef-4823-ad7d-5d2e15c6bbd0.Text: "The tickling sense of danger she spreads is an exquisite spice. The Rogue Trader certainly knows how to add a frisson of heat to an encounter."

595589f6-8744-44c4-a864-315d4d59c2a7.Text: "If you are right, why do I sense that your name is about to fly from His lips?"

4353d2a1-dd62-4520-9921-0740a8b5a2cc.Text: "Suffering purifies. Mortification of the flesh hardens the spirit, and Footfall will rise again, exsanguinated but transformed."

74cc6c6a-b908-4b28-918b-2dea13361e7c.Text: "Do not worry about them. We do not know their names yet, but the Undying One knows all names."

38429367-2b63-43cd-9b3f-06071d5d2007.Text: "Amic'Abelard, there are techniques and tools to help you forget. I can—"

eb70008f-f284-4548-aa8f-a26b7adf55f3.Text: "No. There are some things one must not forget, Mistress Kibellah."

255fa2b4-2cec-4cdb-9dbd-442bda4f6c83.Text: "Kibellah, I have never seen her drenched in such colours before. Is it... fear? Distress?"

e4031ee2-954d-4e65-9180-45a6382c0acd.Text: "Perhaps you were looking at a different Kibellah before."

02bd4942-7553-4e04-9707-2196f0b5c65e.Text: "The capital stinks of sacrilege — too many have departed before the Undying One willed it."

6dac2039-0012-4623-b6e3-086b31e2b038.Text: "There is too much emptiness. It seems as if at any moment it will wrench you off the ground and pull you in."

4cafa046-c053-4b87-867b-32c381d89d60.Text: "Perhaps the Undying One has sent us to bring the final gift of His Peace to those who survived."

8c5fabbc-67db-4e1f-bc81-cab11e97837a.Text: "Their language of violence is a blasphemous parody of the art of the Bloodspun Web. With every cut and puncture, we address the Undying One, while they grovel before the face of nothingness."

a2998c85-fcd6-4ecb-a17c-a746857ba109.Text: "The Undying One cares not for the souls of xenos, and so what awaits them after death is terrible indeed."

9f8cba44-f145-494e-9cd9-9ff889c65519.Text: "The holiness of the temple does not lie in the height of its vaults, but in the generosity of the sacrifices offered in it."

c25a209b-13e8-40e2-b48e-522607cda297.Text: "I enjoy it here. This place reminds me of the flagship's freight line. Almost like home."

b1aefa7a-d20e-4c29-a00a-9c695829a481.Text: "However different the canon we follow, here it converges into one — let us go to fulfil it together as sisters."

1df2f576-12c6-41fa-a208-cd9f61ea1f3a.Text: "I never thought such a riot of life could exist anywhere. Why does the Undying One not allow such things in the void, where we dwell?"

8c24f6b1-8a0e-4650-80ab-36dee1c6f1b4.Text: "Do the masters of this place deserve such honour? Are they the chosen servants of the Undying One? Or do they glorify themselves rather than Him?"

7b64d389-601e-49d4-95bb-f6d077565cd3.Text: "All this luxury pins you to the ground like the gravitational grip of this world. A gilded yoke."

cf447b6d-4c2b-443b-9939-031cd40aeb3a.Text: "Spinners sometimes have to visit this bay and remove those who are a drain on its resources."

6e9736ea-c699-4f65-8719-e4b57e8feabd.Text: "The Undying One does not relinquish the souls of the faithful. Domin'Theodora is too sacred a person not to find her way to His Throne."

a259416b-84c5-484c-a300-89deebdc901d.Text: "Hallowed apostates from Humanity's true form. It is so strange to know that the Undying One has granted the privilege of sanctity to such... servants."

5f049f2d-26b7-4b4c-860f-ae04810a1aa4.Text: "It is true. Most malefactors cannot be reformed, only chained or killed, like you."

14152c3a-1eb2-42db-9a3e-ad88d1271101.Text: "Veni'Heinrix is right. The Undying One's whispers have subsided and the Tarot reading I did was vague and confusing. Something is coming."

b44393ce-f34d-47e6-85d6-20c1c5e8a00e.Text: "Perhaps the Undying One did not claim him at the right time, and now he occupies a place that is not his. We will soon find out."

605600b7-944d-46e3-87c8-c013f1604582.Text: "I hear whispers, but not from Him... Something is sleeping in the darkness. Or is pretending to."

5bef5eda-277c-4df8-8c4e-3bc0ad4bcb2b.Text: "I wish to know what disaster has befallen us."

324c5e42-3bf1-497b-b956-0dd91b0c7f4e.Text: "Was this an accident or was it sabotage?"

3bcefac1-59ce-4d03-b022-73916de4f81b.Text: "We must come up with a plan of action."

c1fe1a9f-09a8-462e-9574-9c1c6a4cac3c.Text: "Save the vessel. The enforcers must quell the riots and ensure that the work is done."

1e3a095c-8c81-4a46-b40b-67a300bb00a7.Text: "Rescue the crew members from the damaged compartments. Either we all survive or we all perish."

b830596b-e4f5-48c5-a422-04480541267b.Text: Ordered that the shuttles be mined to prevent escape from the damaged ship.

709d17b0-1d30-4e76-8e92-e8eefe14bc3e.Text: "Seal the bay doors and mine the shuttles. Let them know that I mean to leave them no choice but to carry out their duty in the Emperor's name."

0c725e7b-c31e-4823-8139-07cd64578fcd.Text: Allowed the panicked crew to escape from the damaged ship.

f336e88e-ce3e-44a7-bbdc-cdd816ff3912.Text: "Let them go. I will stay here with those who still believe in our success."

46c2b9aa-854b-4c53-811b-33c536993bc4.Text: "Tell them they have my permission. Gather them all in one compartment, then seal it and vent it into the void. I have no need for cowardly refuse."

bc2393dc-ea38-4e22-bf3c-b5e2fa689573.Text: "I do hope it is obvious to everyone that my treasures, trophies, and relics are to be rescued first! Everything else comes second!"

1953e0d9-d6d9-47a9-b7c8-65181622a047.Text: [Assume command] "We will begin with emergency countermeasures. Here are your orders!"

44fa7c7d-e507-45aa-bfe8-9c70b785a2a3.Text: {n}Turmoil reigns on the bridge, with officers running about frantically tapping the cogitator runes, operators issuing commands into hissing vox-casters, and enforcers brandishing and checking their weapons. Only the Master Helmsman looks curiously unperturbed — Ravor's ever-scowling face clearly cannot hold any more grim dissatisfaction.{/n} "I'm glad you've made it here in one piece, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

6c274ae5-5ee5-462c-ad34-8f768c980d13.Text: {n}Vigdis's voice breaks through the shower of static gushing from the vox-caster:{/n} "They were in their quarters or carrying out their duties when the incident occurred. Immediately after the emergency meeting, I will summon those you request to the bridge as escorts."

c3729284-e370-45f7-95be-205d3f160ca3.Text: "While we do not know this for certain, I am convinced that we have been attacked from within. We are now more vulnerable than ever."

b37c2c29-64ab-443f-8a53-7f038bb0be53.Text: {n}Your {g|Encyclopedia:CommBead}comm-bead{/g} springs to life.{/n} "Infernus Master speaking. There have been several large explosions throughout the ship. A cascading blackout has knocked out lighting, transportation lines, air filtration, and heat control across the entire vessel. Multiple fires detected. All Infernus Guild forces have been deployed for emergency repairs. We will save the ship, no matter the cost."

5049d814-392a-436b-b811-413a151f07ea.Text: {n}Her voice is followed by a hiss from the vox-caster:{/n} "It might have been a chain reaction caused by an accidental failure. The ship is old — that sort of thing can happen. But I commend Mistress Sauerback's vigilance. It is appropriate at this hour."

2815415f-d4be-415a-99d3-300856f9a71a.Text: "I've already put together a priority order for the repairs of the critical systems, but many bays have descended into bedlam and riots, making the work difficult. People are terrified and think they're about to die. In addition, some decks have become inaccessible. The trapped crew members' time is running out. Sadly, the optimal survival strategy for the vessel does not include the survival of those poor sods."

3e2161d9-bd73-4e77-a4f8-301c98d8cb33.Text: {n}Ravor shakes his head, gazing intently at the vid-screen of one of the cogitators.{/n} "The pressure's dropping. The bridge ventilation system is completely busted, Lord Captain. I humbly request that you move to the officers' deck, where the emergency headquarters are to be established. The bridge is no longer safe, so I must ask you to hurry, while the Tech-Priests are still supplying the elevator with power."

da89ca3a-9815-4357-96fd-65f4dfb79dca.Text: "My assistants and I will stay here and report on system readings. We have an emergency supply of void suits, so we won't croak right away, Emperor willing."

21a35713-2ed2-43b1-9d5f-ded00f2da543.Text: {n}She barks orders into the vox and is answered immediately by a staccato of gunfire. After a while, she nods in satisfaction.{/n} "The crowd has been pacified, Lord Captain. A clear demonstration of our resolve and a few public executions have tempered their fervour."

af593d4d-931e-4773-89b3-4c4277240549.Text: {n}Having given the order, Sauerback listens in to the vox with a furtive smile, then nods contentedly.{/n} "The compartment has been vented. The vessel has been purged of the spineless wretches."

c6b9edc6-1bc9-4770-a811-a3052c1862e4.Text: {n}Sauerback grits her teeth and hisses into the vox,{/n} "Let them through... Remove the cordon... Provide enough oxygen, water, and rations... for eight watches. And nothing else for those traitors!"

6d82fc06-3e05-4d2e-ab51-2a0263941a95.Text: {n}The Master-at-Arms glares furiously at the vox-caster.{/n} "The enforcers... will do their duty. Aid will arrive shortly."

f66a7aed-7f31-4388-8307-f720afcb398a.Text: {n}Sauerback's personal vox bursts into life. Her face contorts with rage as she listens to the report.{/n} "There's been an incident on the flight deck. A mob of voidsmen and labourers, despicable cowards all, are trying to break through to the shuttles! The enforcers are holding them back for now, but the cordon is in danger of being overrun."

53c1aa34-61f7-4729-8267-aaa30eb6a52a.Text: "Right now, we are a blind, unpowered, defenceless, sinking spittoon drifting through the abyss. The total volume of outages was nearly enough to turn us into an adamantine casket."

239f11ee-b07c-4c79-9b86-af4d6e11591a.Text: "The crew has suffered heavy casualties due to explosive depressurisation, loss of air supply to the compartments, multiple fires, and failures in the transportation systems. The numbers are getting worse by the minute."

3ea6ee04-6550-4c2f-922d-4e91690e4dc6.Text: {n}During your {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Navy}time in the Navy{/d}, you have encountered more than a few critical failures. As a result, you know exactly how to redistribute the system power to help you buy whatever time and resources might be needed to address priority issues. Your plan succeeds, and the ship now stands a better chance of not collapsing into a pile of scrap within the next few hours. You can tell from the officers' voices that they are very glad to be under the command of someone who knows what they are doing.{/n}

77bde4a5-3149-431b-8634-bc80fdadf618.Text: {n}A moment's silence fills the bridge. Finally, a cautious response comes from the vox-caster:{/n} "Copy that, Lord Captain. Every effort will be made to save your treasures and preserve the cultural heritage of the dynasty."

35e8feff-efa6-4b05-a92d-db8e69e0357b.Text: "At the time of the accident, Danrok was on the freight line inspecting warehouses. He has not been in contact since. We are assuming... the worst."

815afe00-9d12-4706-a3d1-f2ce34f7717f.Text: {n}Sauerback grabs the vox-caster and snarls,{/n} "All enforcers are to don full gear, spread out among the compartments, and maintain discipline at all costs. If anyone dares to distract the Infernus Guild from their emergency work, shoot them. Record this order, hand it to the servo-skulls, and distribute it across the decks. Now."

1756c16f-925f-47c1-96ce-d39588c5a908.Text: {n}A new burst of hisses emanates from the vox-caster:{/n} "Jocasta, we are running short on brave men. We would be grateful if your people would lay down their weapons and come to assist the Infernus Guild. The sooner you come, the more lives we can save."

22348e6c-0d68-49cc-aaeb-dafff7de5ea4.Text: "The crew is running ship damage control procedures. The situation has been recorded in the ship's log as 'critical.' Mistress Sauerback and I are temporarily in charge of the bridge. I'm organising the technical staff while Jocasta musters the enforcers. The honourable Vox and Infernus Masters have departed for the affected compartments to take charge of their subordinates, but remain present on the vox-line."

8f6f5fce-a57f-4697-b518-40724308c516.Text: "To all officers and crew members who have remained faithful to their vows of service: this ship is ours! Glory to the von Valancius dynasty!"

ed53682c-1e42-4d0c-b995-71204279f866.Text: "Very well. In that case, I will take no part in this investigation. Notify me once you have found the culprit."

2f1acdf2-ac5a-432a-b705-a44a1f7240a5.Text: [Take the maul and beat Sauerback with it]

aa68cc24-def6-4d56-a7ee-3cc2c18f9871.Text: "Could this have been an assassination attempt?"

0918c211-c7ec-4803-b0b7-d55e09980ef7.Text: "What do you intend to do next?"

1e419ae0-0976-4bfe-8483-5c6c3600718f.Text: "I will handle the investigation myself. If they wish to challenge me, then I shall take matters into my own hands."

6e8fc279-3508-46aa-9df2-51863e0de5f1.Text: "I am curious to see the Master-at-Arms in action. I will preside over the investigation."

14503697-bb80-4170-960b-496057a41546.Text: "I want answers. I will take no part in this investigation — notify me once you have found the culprit."

17ffc750-a191-4b12-ad62-d1f1e675c29b.Text: "Could it ever be a disgrace to face a challenge shoulder to shoulder with your {mf|lord|lady}?"

1afa5338-1e90-4e28-a81b-140f407be0e4.Text: "On second thought, it might be interesting to see you at work. I think that is what I will do."

f6685998-d862-4537-a188-e4739d239a35.Text: "I have changed my mind. I will take charge of this investigation myself."

266b0791-3365-4695-b1d4-6c591f8b8db7.Text: "Consider it my whim. I have always wished to participate in a real inquest!"

d1788d3a-2f47-4240-8738-93ff562a2307.Text: "You dare protest against my will? You should count yourself fortunate I have not yet had you thrown you out of an airlock for this blunder!"

bcebb0f6-90d4-424a-a1c8-2bebc3b16a2b.Text: "I want an explanation, not vain self-chastisement. Put that weapon away and report."

90a6b452-0e26-4fb1-ad32-2c1a6143d86c.Text: {n}The Master-at-Arms radiates grim fury — her eyes are dark, her lips pursed. With a practised hand, she removes the maul from her belt and offers it to you.{/n} "An unforgivable error. I accept full responsibility and ask for due punishment."

9d8968eb-a09a-4945-bd89-9b7ed292d21c.Text: "I... had not considered it like that. Your resolve is commendable."

579f7905-68f6-49f0-be07-43efe2d69269.Text: {n}She bows even lower, as if hoping to find her trampled pride beneath your boot.{/n} "I beg your forgiveness, Lord Captain, and I thank you for your mercy."

4dcf55ab-f2c2-4fa3-b1ec-0ed2aa148df7.Text: {n}Sauerback's expression darkens.{/n} "I shall strive to satisfy your... curiosity."

bb5f05b0-18c5-42d3-8ce1-0e237cf74430.Text: {n}Sauerback hesitates for a moment before putting the maul away.{/n} "Understood, Lord Captain. Reporting."

93f73f03-f4c8-41ca-b731-f5fe02c9cef9.Text: {n}Sauerback hesitates for a moment before putting the maul away.{/n} "Our approaches to discipline differ radically. You are too magnanimous, Lord Captain. In that case, I will give my report."

c14fd487-7810-488f-b293-bae91672ec97.Text: "All adjacent decks have been isolated. We have begun our search for the culprit, and have set up investigation headquarters on the officers' deck. The substance has been analysed and confirmed to be blood containing traces of major mutations. While it poses no risk of infection to Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, the very presence of such genetic aberration on board is a serious threat to the safety of the ship and must be addressed promptly. Once word of this gets out, many among the crew will surely see it as a brazen challenge to your status as {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTraderGlossary}Rogue Trader{/g}."

cf5b0142-83f6-4054-b184-c3ed149e732c.Text: "The heresy of mutation. Mutants are vicious beasts who sow only ruin and death. They are devoid of all humanity, and the vile blood that runs through their veins feeds their unclean thoughts and urges. Numerous accounts speak of entire colonies falling prey to bloody uprisings staged by these creatures, all because their governors were too squeamish to order genetic purges."

b5e8d624-0789-4114-b3c4-308d2a664641.Text: "Alas, the Imperium's enemies are not limited only to those outside its borders. Mutants can become a considerable threat, especially when given the chance to organise."

ca920209-3a23-49b0-b953-b9d7118dc53b.Text: "You don't say! I wonder why somebody we don't consider human and exterminate by the thousands would think to revolt. What a crazy mystery."

fd8b2b6e-4107-47b9-90de-1eabb9a817ce.Text: "Then they would have filled the bath with acid or poison instead. There are easier ways to kill someone than drowning them in blood, as foul as that blood may be."

ace0165c-1d12-4870-850c-a47105a7836f.Text: {n}As one, every enforcer present gets on their knees.{/n} "Lord Captain, this incident has cast a shadow on our honour. We only ask for one thing: a chance to absolve ourselves of our guilt. Allow me to head to the officers' deck at once so that I may lead the investigation personally."

090b75b0-8e47-4b80-8423-16efed693f5f.Text: "That is precisely what Lady Theodora {d|Encyclopedia:CompAbelard_Q1_OldWays}would have done{/d}: entrust the matter to her faithful servants. However, I would still advise you to observe the Master-at-Arms at work, Lord Captain — it may prove enlightening."

9750b3cd-d352-4142-bc17-007a3bc4da50.Text: "Lord Captain, on a previous occasion, it was your intervention that resolved a matter that my own {d|Encyclopedia:CompAbelard_Q1_NewWays}rigidity{/d} had only succeeded in making worse. With all due respect to Mistress Sauerback, perhaps she would benefit from your fresh perspective."

af2fd1fb-d0f8-4a25-b9ed-b864b9dbb458.Text: "Seneschal! Do you think so little of me that you would rob me of a chance to defend my honour?"

005e289e-6f70-4625-9988-60a31bb3f12e.Text: "Should the Lord Captain wish to monitor the investigation, my people and I would consider it an honour."

d6c465c4-c0ac-46b5-8749-9e8e8d10fac7.Text: "Do I understand correctly that Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} does not wish to oversee the course of the investigation?"

512308a8-c127-4dfb-a00f-f03f379c18b4.Text: "Of course, Lord Captain. I will arrange for an area befitting your status to be prepared on the officers' deck."

2c7c7a4e-703a-476d-aa31-8ee52bcb770c.Text: {n}You see a look of horror in Sauerback's eyes.{/n} "Lord Captain, I implore you! This was my mistake. If you rectify it for me, I will be disgraced."

021a04e3-fbf9-44cc-92f5-7f25249488c7.Text: "I will not fail you. We will find and eliminate any and all threats, Lord Captain."

981e7a2a-d0da-4417-83d6-089b44acdefd.Text: "Such a good, obedient mon-keigh! Go on, {name}. Do not deny the rest of us the pleasure of watching."

5f6f8049-4b58-4214-b2f7-5b3c417f45b4.Text: {n}Cassia shudders.{/n} "I beg to differ. Were something of this sort to happen to me, my heart would surely stop."

8e9fc164-4773-47d0-8269-b89d56a0a8ad.Text: "Sometimes, it falls to the Arbites to conduct such purges — mutants on lower hive levels breed quickly and often become a threat to the stability of the entire planet." {n}The Proctor raises his iron hand to his face.{/n} "I know only too well what these miscreants are capable of."

309a4203-0229-44e5-9085-b36761791004.Text: {n}Sauerback clenches her teeth through every one of your blows. Not a single sound escapes her throat, not even when the maul's steel head breaks her nose and splits open her lips. After you finish, she receives her weapon back and bows, all the while maintaining the same impeccable bearing.{/n}

ca043e95-2750-4972-98e7-f6052111a3e0.Text: "I will await your arrival at the headquarters on the officers' deck to brief you on our current progress."

1245b576-2745-42c8-95ea-008541f8ca77.Text: "Sauerback! How could you have let this happen? An assassination attempt upon the Rogue Trader, in {mf|his|her} own chambers, right under the noses of your enforcers?" {n}A fierce growl rumbles deep in Abelard's throat.{/n}

30bd88c3-4791-43b3-a428-56fd1bb0e757.Text: "Thank you, Lord Captain. Requesting permission to report."

92b3f64b-4a33-4b87-b0bc-6ff350071055.Text: "The heretics have revealed themselves and are eager to fight? Then fight we shall! Let the vessel be purged of their filth!"

434bc0a1-1e7b-4b95-b9df-ac5b288a4a0d.Text: The Rogue Trader's expert leadership has allowed the crew to act with maximum efficiency.

d79b1530-07ad-4ab4-80d7-f5587fd91339.Text: Evil will fall by your hand, as you have decided it must.

2488becf-c974-4caf-9eca-1b24aea4e83e.Text: A nightmarish shadow, spawned from the Sire's mind and the minds of his offspring, has blocked out the glow of the warp's energies.

fd937792-9a16-4b28-a4aa-632f4cd52f22.Text: "How did you come to serve on my flagship?"

e6f6c430-00fe-4e65-9ac0-fec006e832f1.Text: "I am in need of treatment. I have developed a rash of some sort down on the lower decks."

123c4e90-bd1b-4b37-aed9-61bed66196d5.Text: "You are not actually a heretic, are you? You serve the Emperor faithfully?"

af505d08-ac19-46b5-afa1-173aef23b471.Text: "Are the customs of Chorda worlds truly so uncompromising and blind to reason?"

4fc7a90e-4fc2-465e-bd20-b5c82172c528.Text: "There is something else I wish to discuss."

21c9f7db-dfa3-4c2d-862f-44c265f58978.Text: "It was rather careless of you to get involved in that case."

d91dbe57-4216-4a66-866e-e08e372d3704.Text: "One of your subordinates by the name of Marius approached me. He expressed his desire to become a missionary."

cf3b3257-1e7c-43ff-a459-7692c30adf74.Text: "Faith can work miracles and cure those who are beyond treatment. This cannot be denied."

b578a495-8cdf-4821-a1d5-b080f8565882.Text: "Were you the one who treated my burns?"

e82c4e89-ed09-47c7-a674-a838796f9e6b.Text: "Well, you earn your keep, at least."

caf175a9-56b5-4d78-a24d-7d5b8cca32b9.Text: "So you have the cure, yet the disease continues to roam free aboard my ship?"

fe91b4ad-66e3-45fc-b2c5-cba001512f5a.Text: "The senior officers. What kinds of complaints do they have?"

55ad9e67-eb56-441d-a920-29c0858820d7.Text: "Not the most compassionate of healers, are you?"

e21deba8-63e2-426a-aec6-eaa3f44b340e.Text: {n}A man of indeterminate age bows his head. His robes are spotless, and his rigid collar constricts his throat. The unsettling smell of medicine hangs in the air, and the man's pale eyes look bleached.{/n} "Greetings, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Your Chirurgeon Majoris is at your service."

94631cb6-903b-4f2a-b5ab-4e874b3fc2d5.Text: {n}Forius examines your face and hands critically, then gives a satisfied nod.{/n} "No scars. The consequences of your {d|Encyclopedia:Prologue_WentThroughFire}charge through fire{/d} have been successfully remedied. Very good. I will make note of it in the journal."

6ccfc08d-2525-4ffb-a658-76d0fa43156a.Text: "I was the master healer on a world that belongs to the Chorda dynasty. I had managed to cure someone who was considered doomed. Not because of their illness, but because a certain self-important priest had tried to cure them with a prayer and failed. After I put him to shame, he started spreading rumours that I owed my skill to the influence of the {g|Encyclopedia:ChaosGlossary}Ruinous Powers{/g}. I sought refuge under Lady Theodora, who expressed an appreciation for my talents and welcomed me and my family on her ship."

c5525bb6-31d1-4474-bb58-7f6359ef5222.Text: "Void leprosy is born where sanitary canons are spurned. Rid the ship of grime and serfs who propagate it if you wish for the disease not to return."

a958df14-dcc0-4533-b84c-a17d9901ca97.Text: "I am currently not aware of any epidemics or other large-scale threats to the lives of the crew... or anything more serious than normal, at least. Minor outbreaks are part of the natural decline process. The medicae are occupied with treating both industrial and combat injuries as well as dealing with sporadically occurring ailments."

fae74b6c-f81e-4a11-85c4-c8b99cdf595b.Text: "There has been an outbreak of a highly contagious disease in Bay LD-A14, but the complaints from the workers there have been few — despite the many pathologies, the people continue working without interruptions. A curious case, which I will study thoroughly."

7f19c7ab-64be-4031-8b8f-6d599b20df77.Text: "The Master Helmsman's headaches caused by his faulty implants, the High Factotum's occasional indigestion, the Master-at-Arms's combat wounds that can hardly be considered life-threatening..." {n}Forius folds a finger dismissively for every officer he mentions.{/n} "Vapid cases that I am obligated to manage as Chirurgeon Majoris. At least the Infernus Master does not waste my time and simply comes to pick up ointments for his burns."

ca61e04e-b1d7-4a73-ae7b-6541c52a92a3.Text: {n}He nods, brushing away invisible specks from his white gloves.{/n}

0f5ceaff-6383-436b-a538-78dea44ec9d5.Text: {n}He grimaces wearily.{/n} "And neither can one deny the fact that miracles are rare. The belief that prayer can relieve a person of illness enables false hopes. Those who prefer healing themselves with reverent words still end up on my table — so that I can perform an autopsy rather than a procedure."

5a1541ec-b4a8-4c01-8cf6-f702928ccb86.Text: "Compassion has nothing to do with the healer's trade. I prefer conversing with diseases rather than their carriers. Patients are... aggravating."

b9882da8-8a7d-42b6-96d5-ca472cd1c67a.Text: "There are many. I am ever in search of solutions to dangerous afflictions. My latest work involved studying a particularly lethal disease that devours the person's flesh and skin. It has already claimed a dozen lives, but their deaths were not in vain: I have learned much about the enemy, and the vaccine will soon be ready for testing."

1d19cfac-e692-425e-bda4-367bccd3e310.Text: "I hope I have satisfied your curiosity."

4f2e4d7e-fcab-44e6-a7fa-5bdba26c0c93.Text: "{d|Encyclopedia:MariusPilgrim}So I have heard{/d}. Well... Marius complained about his shifts, and any healer who cannot dedicate themselves to their work completely is a healer not worth having around. I have no regrets about him."

f560fac5-c910-44d4-b208-ce1607f86637.Text: "I appreciate that you were {d|Encyclopedia:MariusNotPilgrim}strict{/d} with him. Marius's example has taught the other medicae officers that their responsibility is to focus on their work, not distract the Lord Captain with inane fantasies."

2d9710d8-67a4-4c2c-b62c-b6bf618aa723.Text: {n}Forius raises his chin haughtily.{/n} "Treating the Lord Captain is a job for the best medicae practitioner on board. Which is me."

6f21764b-263f-457d-b4ed-3988f88daeb7.Text: "I do not make confessions, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. My faults are diseases for which a cure is yet to be discovered, and mortal wounds that can be remedied only by new methods of the chirurgeon's craft. Why confess when one should be searching for a solution? For this reason, I choose to spend my time on work that pleases the Emperor, not on words."

e8a1e6dc-55bc-4161-ba52-bebeeb1badd1.Text: "Naturally, House Chorda still has need of people like me — educated and capable of intellectual thought. However, anyone who is permitted to learn does so under strict supervision. I have heard Lady Incendia's ship has a dedicated compartment for sages and keepers of knowledge that more resembles a prison than a librarium."

ba645269-965c-4cf7-b0d6-46617ec4493f.Text: "My job is to save lives. Heal wounded officers, develop vaccines for onboard epidemics, discover new methods of healing. However... I spend most watches listening to patients about their many qualms, managing the junior medicae officers, and dividing the afflicted into those who matter and those who do not. A rather... irritating addition to my duties as Chirurgeon Majoris."

15003abc-a9ff-41e1-a0c1-f89eb25224b6.Text: {n}Forius takes one look at your hand and immediately produces a syringe from the folds of his robe.{/n} "Ordinary vesticula scarabis, or 'void leprosy,' in common terms. Still in the early stages. One injection will suffice."

0490a618-5976-4d21-ab02-98807d1574b2.Text: "I would not have become a chirurgeon if I was afraid of death. It is an unavoidable side effect of my profession."

43b37363-b66c-4feb-b55d-f8a8f5505bb9.Text: {n}His colourless eyes flash indignantly.{/n} "My expertise is the result of hard work and accumulated wisdom, not some paltry sorcery! I employ my craft to save His children. That should serve as a better proof of my innocence than any show of piety."

3d4d321b-f4ed-4393-893e-5bf052d1329a.Text: "'You teach a man to read, you raise a bright heretic,' I believe was one of the favourite local sayings. As for demonstrating the superiority of knowledge over the advice of holy ecclesiarchs, well... that kind of defiance was sure to put my life at risk."

7521e935-2f5f-4a17-9f89-7924c3350651.Text: "Are you interested in a general report on the ship as a whole or in hearing about how your immediate subordinates are faring?"

2572a0d0-2349-4b85-88fa-73d56a9d0a1f.Text: "Were you born a human or an aberration?"

72b052dc-f612-4dac-bd96-7cb1dd317789.Text: "These things can dominate anyone's mind. Are you sure there are no traitors among your people?"

ecf65a3e-1b2f-4fdb-8a8d-ecc280dec358.Text: "It is not your fault. This xenos had tremendous psychic power."

cfdbbdf5-2b4e-4558-b32b-cd49e7e6e446.Text: "There will be no execution. You have a duty before the dynasty, and you will bear it."

567e350e-e7c7-40f7-b1ac-08145dc96828.Text: "Where am I supposed to find a new Master Helmsman? Give yourself a few lashes, and you are forgiven."

591e6b7d-eb4e-47f5-a2c2-cc54cdd36de7.Text: "I met Captain Klein on the freight line. He showed great ingenuity and valour."

50ddf2d7-fa9a-4e48-b038-307f343799b7.Text: "Your people will die with you. Such is the lot of xenos and mutants."

06223149-65cc-4b13-9a6c-42b000f2f469.Text: "There is no sense in fighting anymore. You have already lost. Lay down your weapons."

9c1045ab-27a3-4112-a349-06cea0d46ec3.Text: "I told them to surrender. They would not listen."

c24e1cfc-e026-48ce-bfb7-bb59c3b0b787.Text: "They deserved it, and so do you."

b76b3068-73fa-42ce-8de3-7e321c5b0d0d.Text: "How did that monster, your leader, come to be on my ship?"

56e8c3e4-3edd-4d16-9ed8-0be1e1b8ca1d.Text: "He was a brave man, Einrich Monteg."

95d5ce69-0511-47d1-8d46-ef35c3a89660.Text: "I wish I could have finished him off with my own hands."

2d9873ad-dafa-4318-be65-032d39d049bb.Text: "I am just deciding where in the trophy room to hang the heads of the monsters I have vanquished."

714b5523-ceed-4216-af81-bb328cdd52b8.Text: Decided to spare the families of the Infernus Guild and leave them on a desolate world.

1e9287e7-d08d-4059-8b0e-0657ce24a21e.Text: "I will spare your people and drop them off on a desolate world."

ada0c110-98ce-4311-a9dc-fc2322aa36cc.Text: "By killing your Sire? Did you feel that abomination die?"

6baf3b45-2849-4ca5-a5b3-ba5ef9d9f06b.Text: "Now that it's over, will you tell me what the Genestealer Cult's plan was?"

0e2e3b6e-bcb9-4b54-89c5-773d3531d5b4.Text: "You are a damned xenos and a vile traitor, Monteg."

9110853b-ada6-4b02-b558-549fec735147.Text: "Are you going to beg for mercy?"

23eb947a-a610-48d6-8c25-64efcaee4bfc.Text: "Where is the Infernus Master now? The traitor tried to finish me off."

af8f92bf-b57c-46c1-90a9-8cb988bf405b.Text: "I have heard about your contingency plan. Your foresight is commendable."

44a55f47-140a-47fe-b9e8-af105a2884ad.Text: "If I let you go, you will only start scheming, killing, and infecting people again."

875343c4-c231-4c1f-80a8-2882bb0184d3.Text: "Captain Hrotko had been infected by xenos. I killed him."

0346088a-392a-484e-a964-c64ae046e1ba.Text: {n}The hulking carcass of the monster lies in front of you. The amber fire has left its baneful eyes, departed along with the last drops of foul blood oozing from its wounds. In the distance, the Master Helmsman slowly regains consciousness. He immediately recoils from the dead creature, swearing profanely.{/n}

a685b95d-cb3c-4e68-9a92-e6cc31e497cc.Text: "Lord Captain, I'm guilty as charged... I was not myself. I fell for the filthy xenos's tricks like a green cabin boy. I make no excuses. I know the rules, and I request capital punishment. Strike off my head and be done with it."

1bfae4fd-6c91-4696-81dc-f7b148101dff.Text: "Not anymore. Several enforcer squads were compromised, but I shut down the ventilation systems in their compartments and asphyxiated them. Once we are done here, we will enter with flamers, burn the bodies, and do a personnel sweep. Anyone suspicious goes out of the airlock."

ef9972cb-0e3a-4839-9891-6bde93c3818c.Text: {n}Einrich laughs hoarsely.{/n} "I wouldn't believe you if you said otherwise."

90541c1b-9bc0-4863-b2d8-5da0bd8f5d37.Text: "It is the duty of the Master-at-Arms to anticipate any threat to the ship's safety, even one as unusual as an uprising by genetic aberrations supported by the highest-ranking officers."

5361c3d5-c8c0-4553-91ba-2359ddbe9264.Text: "Then the old tub will have to put up with me a while longer. I appreciate your clemency, Lord Cap'n."

88393c39-ea87-407a-ac06-12ef3fa3f66d.Text: "You aren't wrong. Leaving this old tub with these idiots would be blatantly irresponsible. Thank you, Lord Cap'n. I'll see to my penance."

afce9cb9-8db2-439a-8f08-7dc230fb909a.Text: {n}The Master-at-Arms stands at attention, ignoring the wounds and burns covering her face and body.{/n} "Lord Captain, the vessel has been secured. The mutineers in all compartments have lost the will to fight all at once. Some have fainted while others have gone into shock or panic. I believe they sensed that their despicable overlord was dead."

84790d06-d1df-482b-8489-7313066bc199.Text: "That entire traitorous bloodline should have been sealed in a tank of fyceline, thrown into the void, and blown up a long time ago. The whoreson has mounted a defence in Bay 45-F-1, but my people have his gang cornered. We will get him soon enough."

b4988ede-dd77-4616-9f4c-89cd09f535cd.Text: "That's... very generous for a false believer. I am grateful, although I do not forgive you. Order the enforcers to hold their fire, and I will let my people out of the compartment." {n}After a long pause, Einrich nods.{/n} "It is done. Only those willing to share my fate remain."

e96478aa-bf14-41a0-96c1-cc40a183256a.Text: {n}You hear shouting and gunfire in the background. Einrich hastily finishes his final lho-stick.{/n} "Jocasta's mongrels have begun their attack. It's time to say goodbye, {name}. It's a pity I couldn't share the blessing of purity with you and make you part of our family. A pity, too, that we couldn't kill you either.
