But we all must play the cards we are dealt. And now we take our leave the way the true masters of fire should."

ecf965e2-3eb1-43be-8fe1-351b5a54d6f5.Text: "And then what? Will you spare us?"

04e3294b-5f36-4f3e-80a4-c3f498cefb6e.Text: {n}Einrich winces angrily.{/n} "We all felt every single moment of the blessed angel's agony. And then he died, and our dream died with him. You snuffed it out and stomped on it like a lho-stick butt. Now, his song will not return to our dreams. The Many-Armed Emperor will not see us."

46c48534-2f13-4bff-a071-01f778507bf7.Text: {n}A tear rolls down his cheek, leaving a damp trail through the soot covering his face. Yet his voice remains steady:{/n} "Was that really necessary? Did Nemi and Mia have to die?"

19e5a38a-8505-4cb5-9f51-b71c0dc58d12.Text: {n}The lho-stick in his fingers is shaking.{/n} "Of course not. Why would they?"

f9715fa4-a19b-4cf3-8235-a0bb189542ab.Text: "He has been here a long time — longer than you or anyone else. His blessed feet crossed these decks centuries ago, when Theodora's predecessor still called himself Lord Captain. He came from the stars where the Many-Armed Emperor dwells to bear His word, but then he faced a great massacre at the hands of the wicked."

a10b4502-404a-49b3-9e9e-b938db313704.Text: "You can always count on veterans. I will present the old man with an award. Throne knows he has earned it, and then some."

ab642412-1bcb-4505-8dae-b459c8e62e84.Text: "A brave heretic is no better than a craven one. And that is what he was: a heretic and an abomination."

a8b77430-9128-416a-9f40-5e707976dccd.Text: "I wish you could too, Lord Captain."

bb9c1718-479e-4372-9237-ab79686d8f51.Text: {n}Her servo-skull rattles to life and projects a hologram onto the deck. A blurred replica of Einrich Monteg stares at you, blood oozing from a wound on his temple. One of his hands is bound with a tourniquet, and he is lighting a lho-stick with the other.{/n} "Hey, bridge, do you copy? I see you have not yet changed the access psalms. Are you celebrating your victory, {name}?"

8395ccf1-2610-4862-86e8-f6afb9c27cc7.Text: "That was the last pocket of resistance — the mutiny has been suppressed, Lord Captain. The enforcers are now carrying out a sweep of the compartments, and the officers are forming new repair crews to replace the inferni. The ship's critical systems have been stabilised, and your throne has been liberated. Thousands of dynasty subjects are waiting for your orders, so all that remains is for you to take the captain's throne and affirm your dominion. All hail House von Valancius!"

18fdd954-c5a6-4435-b753-cc77682462e6.Text: "The renegades stormed the bridge and then brought that thing in. We held our ground, but as soon as the monster looked at us, my mind went blank. It was like being a puppet. Damn those xenos tricks!"

be5c6f2b-66e9-4e05-8e58-993176f4177b.Text: "In that case, we will die together as a family."

bd5fe6d7-2349-4777-adce-aaf9cb1e7902.Text: "I'm also a liar and a manipulator. All of this is true, but it no longer matters."

5fe32ad6-e3dc-417a-a66c-6a23886e0344.Text: "Will you grant me mercy, {name}? I doubt it."

4f45c276-1209-4d2e-ac36-068e48358fab.Text: "Your arrogance never fails to amuse. Yes, I underestimated you, as well as your retinue, those bloody zealots, and that sadist Jocasta. Who would have expected such fierce resistance from a bunch of false believers?"

1a9ec1b1-b3ff-4a81-8a4c-8b6d3adb05fe.Text: {n}The Infernus Master appears serious, sombre. The usual cheerful insolence has vanished from his face.{/n} "I wanted you to see my face before I die. Commit it to memory. One day, you will realise what sacrilege you have committed, and in that moment, you will remember me."

e4e9a4b3-9859-4406-b048-8d13eda9c736.Text: "No, I know I'm a dead man walking. But there are unarmed people here with me: our families, who have neither the desire nor the ability to fight. Our children, our elderly. People like my sister and niece. Do you want their blood on your hands as well? Will you take revenge on them, too, or is my life enough?"

cc0c8779-0cf4-474e-87f2-51b89900d9c1.Text: "And yet the venerable Sire kept His message safe and took refuge on this vessel, away from the persecution of heretics. When that false Lord Captain let our ancestors on board, the Sire heard their pain and answered their pleas, blessing them with genetic purity. He protected us after that, joining our thoughts together into a single song. He was the true Lord Captain of this ship."

b7374cb7-2750-4540-addb-f0ba20a70c00.Text: "Do not even think about showing mercy to a single offshoot of this menace, {name}." {n}Heinrix's voice rings with cold fury.{/n}

ba419338-6daf-4535-bb3e-6b386a6c31b6.Text: "You addled, pathetic ashmag..." {n}Jae shakes her head.{/n} "Just do yourself a favour and give up the ghost, Einrich..."

52f9f7fb-04be-4bc0-8e93-0b22b5e81778.Text: {n}Argenta's expression grows sombre.{/n} "It was merciful. Death has released them from serving a horrific beast. May the Emperor take pity on their souls."

2eb16185-5955-421e-86fd-915cb00300c2.Text: "First you consign your family to the clutches of unspeakable heresy, and now you weep for their deaths?" {n}The Seneschal's voice rings with icy castigation.{/n} "I see that any further dialogue with you would be pointless, Monteg."

b6a50f55-5427-4f17-b79a-256ce06a7d0f.Text: "Does this primitive piece of technology give you a good view of your precious monster's corpse?" {n}Marazhai smiles with satisfaction upon seeing the pain in Einrich's face.{/n}

963606cf-3715-4722-a19e-94c42db678eb.Text: "Remember you, kraken spawn? You are a brazen one!" {n}Ulfar bursts into laughter.{/n} "I will compose a fine verse about this day — about the bloody battle and the victory over your abominable master. But you, spouter of lies and betrayer of Humankind — there won't be a single line about you."

945c91fd-ad1f-4dae-ba76-61a9917e4822.Text: "You don't know when to stop, do you, {name}? Fine, I'll tell you. We were close to our goal — a few more years, a few more pure converts to the true faith... But the spinners pulled that stunt with the bath and you seized on their tip-off right away. When it came to the telepathic ritual, it became clear that you weren't going to leave us alone and that we'd have to start the harvest season early."

e985b77e-083e-4772-bd46-ad9b1cc31cf8.Text: "Our old Magus appeared to you during the rite and led you on a false trail. He lulled you into a false sense of security by throwing a small portion of our forces to the wolves and sacrificing himself to buy time to prepare for the harvest. We orchestrated the elevator accident, but you survived, and then I almost intercepted you there on the freight line, but the Bloodspun Web interfered again. You could have been part of us — part of something great, something real. But you ruined everything. Everything."

4232a380-ae4a-4a1e-b7b4-fc0c93cd2e68.Text: "I am pure. My mother and father both trace their lineage back to the ones who received the gift of genetic perfection from the Sire himself. Had there been a few more generations between us, I would have resembled the Sire more closely, but... each of us has their own calling. I look almost like a false believer..." {n}Einrich lifts the welding goggles from his forehead, exposing the rudiments of a purple crest.{/n} "...which means that I was destined to be a spy among you."

46288738-fdb1-4425-b287-85ac3e88938e.Text: "The finger of truth has three sorrowful phalanges. One is shattered, but..." {n}The Infernus Master smiles widely, pulls a remote control from his pocket, and pushes a button. There is a sharp beeping of detonators, a monstrous roar, and the projection disappears. For a while, the sound of flames crackles from the speaker before abruptly cutting off.{/n}

66b0c6fe-c4b6-4d43-9d46-6cb0b5b6ef88.Text: {n}Sauerback mutters something into the comm-bead, then hisses angrily:{/n} "Thermal charges. The void rat blew up the compartment, along with himself and the entire assault team."

a130eabf-1067-455b-8ee6-1f20ec1c6674.Text: "No, we will merely fade away. The Sire is dead and his pureblood offspring have been butchered. They alone, our pristine kin, could bestow the kiss that allowed his song to be heard. The orphans and widows are of no threat to anyone. Drop them off in any remote wilderness."

cc385f37-ed5b-4491-befc-32293d27212d.Text: {n}Sauerback grimaces.{/n} "He was always a self-important bastard and a sycophant, but he honoured the Creed. Even he did not deserve to become one of those creatures."

18295992-8706-42e8-8f8d-4b2068b3dada.Text: "How did you come to be in the service of the von Valancius dynasty?"

f7dbdc88-c641-47aa-a63c-97851b2e8325.Text: "This is fine. I enjoy having informal conversations."

e81f04e0-9984-4159-8826-780e23d2ca11.Text: "A labourer? Then why are you lounging on the bridge?"

852d73d5-d9cc-4336-9c57-a245a09fe32e.Text: "What was that about a 'bringer of woes'?"

cbaa0b7c-4690-4bfa-8c54-b50d6947d5d6.Text: "What if I were to put a curse on you this very instant?"

df585105-2790-40a7-b5c0-16cda1cc964b.Text: "Aren't you being a little too relaxed in front of your Lord Captain?"

1c006ee7-5f49-4b7d-b8d6-9196aa903c7c.Text: "How are your sister and niece doing?"

c6013edf-1a26-4ad5-9920-759611522825.Text: "State of the art equipment? That sounds interesting."

721f7497-bef5-4d66-9d9a-3693edf841e0.Text: "It seems that several of the ship's bays are due for depressurisation, as a disciplinary measure."

f2815ab9-bff1-4092-b59f-2f9e7d672653.Text: "I am sorry for your loss, Einrich."

61d58906-2f92-4549-adaa-14ce820c1719.Text: "What kinds of emergencies does the Infernus Guild deal with?"

97058f73-804c-4189-90f6-7bbf7d4605b6.Text: "Do not forget that I am your {mf|master|mistress}. Is that understood?"

30367598-93b2-4efe-b2df-51a95b170ea8.Text: [Take the lho-stick from Einrich and draw a puff] "You are an interesting person, Einrich."

ef4e8ad6-fdc1-4287-a7d5-b5eeaf2eff39.Text: "Tell me more about the Infernus Guild."

3dd3177d-1884-4e39-8787-549fae1a545c.Text: {n}The Infernus Master nonchalantly lights a lho-stick from a thermal cutter and spreads his arms in a welcoming gesture.{/n} "Einrich Monteg, at your service." {n}He smells of cinders and {g|Encyclopedia:Lho}lho{/g}, his face is sooty, and his belt is laden with a number of heavy tools. You would have taken him for a labourer if it weren't for the greasy and ragged officer's uniform.{/n}

be502469-472f-4e01-8345-85cc3fc91bf7.Text: "Not in the usual way. My ancestors wronged yours and were appointed inferni as a result. Hard labour, deadly risks, plenty of opportunities to atone. Those criminals have been dead for generations, but we are still serving their time. Maybe we will find redemption one day."

9d79f2f2-3175-4a6e-b93c-76b402579cf6.Text: "I am just a humble labourer in charge of putting out fires and dealing with emergencies, but everyone calls me the Infernus Master. I guess this is because I answer for them with my life."

84a9b929-37de-487a-885a-963665d195f7.Text: "What interests you the most? Our duty, our state-of-the-art equipment, or our vibrant traditions?"

31c9722f-f9e1-4e51-8840-b2ca54458f28.Text: "The simple answer is because nothing is on fire. As head of the Infernus Guild, I'm mired in the officers' routine of reports and discussions. There are several compartment upgrades and refurbishments on the agenda right now, and I have to make sure that fire safety protocols are followed everywhere. Rest assured, I'll scurry back to the technical bays to do manual labour as soon as all the paperwork is done."

7af70dfd-733c-4109-91cb-033a0bedfe28.Text: "I'm glad you feel that way. Life is too short to waste it on ceremonies. It is better to present yourself as you are, immediately."

d7467f53-d0d9-4ea1-994c-0eef68f0afa0.Text: "That's right. Picture flames roaring, all the ship's systems have failed — including the artificial gravity — you can't make out anything because of the red-hot debris, and you know an explosion is coming. It's a nightmare, but it's your job to evacuate the panicked crew, eliminate the cause of the fire, and get the compartment back in working order."

9e04dd0b-1be9-44ad-b557-db4562ed33fd.Text: "Do I even need to say it? The moment you came aboard, Lady Theodora perished. So did her Arch-Militant, as well as half of the senior officers and a quarter of the Infernus Guild along with the previous Infernus Master. What's worse: rations don't taste as good anymore, fire burns hotter, and that {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Signs}sinister{/d} look in your eyes — like you're about to put a curse on someone!" {n}Einrich grins.{/n} "It's what the voidsmen say, so it must be true."

2c0ed982-f27f-498f-809f-f90120266697.Text: "Sounds like the start of an interesting conversation!" {n}He looks you directly in the eye.{/n} "No, I have not."

e5b5ac8c-564a-4534-8c15-92f92bdcb8c1.Text: "That would be a sight! I've never seen a real curse before. My niece would be thrilled to hear all about it."

c2357ae1-5a14-4472-8096-f2d1bef95b77.Text: {n}He shrugs.{/n} "It might cure loud mouths, but not loose lips. People talk, and they still would — just maybe a little quieter."

785850a8-503d-4a33-b7aa-a17b07dfaaf9.Text: "The bare minimum, yes. I sometimes check in on our little ragamuffins. They don't have it easy: no parents, and they live like new recruits in an infantry regiment. Please, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, do not neglect the children."

63c9aa4b-0508-4078-a0fe-ad812f9aeb1b.Text: {n}Einrich takes a long puff, burning up half the lho-stick in one go.{/n} "I don't know, Lord Captain. I simply don't know. Too many good men have been devoured by the damned warp, and it will never be sated. It's hard to think about it."

b38e54be-01c7-40e2-9fcd-b2ef8f5bf5a8.Text: "You are right: I'm used to talking about important things in heart-to-heart conversations." {n}Einrich flashes you a genuine smile.{/n} "Like the one we are having right now."

f09876f1-b7fd-498c-8535-7e255d55fad1.Text: "Perhaps because I live under the constant threat of an agonising death by fire, I have a repressed, uh, what's the word? Self-preservation instinct. Or maybe I just relish every minute I get to breathe lho smoke instead of cinders. I humbly apologise for my manners, Lord Captain." {n}Einrich continues to smile without a shred of embarrassment.{/n}

447a8d59-1699-4296-8353-57e5ceecf3fc.Text: "We have plenty of those, like the reminders." {n}Einrich rolls up his sleeve, revealing a tattoo inscribed over an old burn mark.{/n} "When you survive a particularly hopeless accident, you get a tattoo on your scar. You can always tell an experienced infernus by their ink. It's like a badge of honour of sorts."

3e50bc95-b5a9-4fcc-a3b3-8fd6813e7f3f.Text: "I hear that you too have had to deal with {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Shame}injustice{/d} and badmouthing in your time. I hope people will stop judging you for your past mistakes in less than a couple of centuries." {n}Einrich gives you a sympathetic smile.{/n}

bba3b699-af52-4099-af27-d33fbcbc5511.Text: {n}The Infernus Master smiles guiltily.{/n} "That was a bit of a stretch, I'm sorry. There is no state-of-the-art equipment; the risks of ruining it in a fire are too great. We get by using human resources and the most common items available: respirators, fire extinguishers, and flame-retardant uniforms. Let's face it, the lives of the inferni are not worth much. It's more important that we save the machines and minimise damage to the ship."

f269be70-aa5e-47f2-872a-1e3d4d84a69d.Text: {n}He narrows his eyes, studying your face, then says with visible relief,{/n} "It's only tales after all. You just don't look like a bringer of woes to me."

cddeea7d-6f81-4372-a19a-dd9bb69b72f5.Text: "Safe and sound, {d|Encyclopedia:HelpedInfernusFamily}thanks to you{/d}. Nemi has been going on and on about how great and noble you are. You're her new idol. Meanwhile, Mia just snorts and says she thought you'd be taller. She's trying very hard to pretend she's not impressed with the whole acquaintance thing."

1d68221a-d5fa-4aed-8e97-cd59df235496.Text: "Don't let it get to you. They'll get bored of it soon enough."

cc300547-e4f0-426a-b51c-3a55ca71874f.Text: "Life has been tough for those two. I take care of them as best I can, but at that moment, I was powerless. There is only one other time I ever felt so helpless. Thank you for standing up for them. I will never forget this. Ever since Elsie died, they are all I have left."

08e5adb2-35e3-4f4a-b464-2914efbdd251.Text: "Elsinora, my wife. She died saving the ammo depot, back in Lady Theodora's time." {n}The smoke from the lho-stick mercifully obscures Einrich, hiding the traces of emotion on his face.{/n}

6cbb80e2-e08f-4fab-8cd7-b35976f803b6.Text: {n}Einrich smirks.{/n} "I most respectfully disagree, Lord Captain. I will, because I can."

667bad36-55d9-47f7-872d-e3b3f1621f21.Text: {n}He points to a tattoo on his right forearm:{/n} "This one is from the time plasma leaked from the outer aft circuit. Imagine yourself clinging to the hull outside, thermal cutter in one hand and a magnetic clamp in other. Azure flames burst from the breach, the kind that can incinerate you in a second. All that separates you from death is a flimsy rope and a void suit more ancient than {g|Encyclopedia:HolyTerraGlossary}Holy Terra{/g}. And yet the price I paid was nothing compared to my comrades..." {n}He slowly moves the {g|Encyclopedia:AugmentationGlossary}augmented fingers{/g} of his right hand.{/n}

c35b1164-823e-4323-b9fe-bc6385f125fa.Text: "As for this one..." {n}The look he directs at his left hand is full of bitterness.{/n} "I got this one in the ammo depot where my wife Elsinora died. There was a fire, and the flames were getting close to the ammunition. And I don't mean autogun rounds — these were {g|Encyclopedia:MacroCannonsSpace}macro-cannon{/g} shells."

e33cc06e-4510-4295-b6e6-9b030f651717.Text: "We put out the fire as best we could, but we were losing. Suddenly, Elsie took my hand, kissed me, and then ran straight into the blaze and activated the emergency blast door. We stayed outside while she... vented the compartment." {n}Einrich gives a tender smile, gazing at the smoke.{/n} "It was quite a story."

02350ff6-3dcb-4adb-a775-2dbc1ab000d4.Text: {n}He nods gratefully and takes another puff.{/n}

d7af2738-0d58-4e82-b24a-d4b4633aa7f1.Text: "Lord Captain, a pleasure to see you again! I see you've kept the Arbitrator on board..." {n}Einrich casts a glance in Solomorne's direction and shakes his head.{/n} "Don't get me wrong, our ship's enforcers are heavy-handed enough as it is, but the Arbites are notorious for their brutality. I've told my inferni to steer clear of the esteemed Proctor and his dog if they can help it — just to be on the safe side. In other words, we're treating your new ally with the utmost fear and respect."

b268a16b-3349-47c3-b904-6fa72d855060.Text: "Of course, the job description doesn't allow me to risk my life now." {n}He smiles sadly.{/n} "It is all about management these days, sending the boys and girls into the fire. But it's all nonsense, and if the going gets tough, I won't leave them there alone."

6d931232-1769-493c-9d38-ac10344450d2.Text: "Oh, there are many! Accidents due to external factors, for example — hits from enemy guns or collisions with hollow objects like the wreckages of other ships. There are plenty of internal causes as well, from system malfunctions and short circuits to problematic cargo. A couple years ago, something blew up in the hold. Nearly burned it to a crisp. And then there's sabotage. That Voigtvir snake did a lot of damage to the ship."

5b8c393b-9caf-4631-9e44-bdbdc002ae90.Text: "Never let your fire go out, Lord Captain — I mean, no!" {n}Einrich hurriedly waves his hands.{/n} "That's just a stupid little guild in-joke. Seriously, if you see an infernus next to a naked flame, run."

158fcb5a-10f6-4ebe-a4e4-a16a26626634.Text: "Ain't that the truth. You are in charge of the ship, and I am your servant. I wouldn't have it any other way."

dc8bb40d-ed6f-49a2-94ac-3f5da1dd250c.Text: "The Lord Captain {mf|himself|herself}! To what do I owe the honour?"

9d8821c4-0531-4501-b660-70035b9c7879.Text: {n}Chuckling, the Infernus Master takes out a new lho-stick and lights it.{/n} "Not half as interesting as you are, Lord Captain!"

a3b7f6bb-5379-40f6-a256-52bc31cae716.Text: "The Infernus Service is split into different brigades according to duties. The heart of the Guild are, of course, our liquidators — tough guys with nerves of steel, who put out fires and pull people from the flames. Others are repairmen, dealing with problems like jammed doors, fuel leaks, or broken vents. And then there's the walking inspectors, who check the decks to make sure that nothing is blocking any passages or access to communication lines."

62bd9363-e28f-4234-87f7-641459deb095.Text: "I hope you will not repeat the mistakes of the previous Master-at-Arms."

4f48a124-8e40-4bc7-8775-3fccdb23e331.Text: "There are thousands of people aboard this vessel. How do you maintain order?"

b3b6f52e-eb01-47a7-aa02-e50448d960f0.Text: "What is the dirty secret behind those strange words? Tell me!"

543c60e1-1eb9-4aa3-87a5-a9558a33c3ff.Text: "At ease. It was a test, and you passed."

54a9e303-9563-41f6-a256-1c6976294d95.Text: [Grab Jocasta by the chin] "In my chambers, in five minutes. That is an order."

339bbe90-735a-4ee0-816a-3c1cdb5de499.Text: "You are right, he is quite a scoundrel."

a06389eb-1b8a-44b5-ab4e-930eb00b051e.Text: "I put him in his place. It was... enjoyable."

3b9b960b-1d83-47f8-ab37-dbe626f56b9f.Text: "Just one of my many servants. Nothing special."

f1ba085e-7eb2-494f-99c7-830574c62e9e.Text: "I want to know more about your service."

a7c7dcc8-9feb-4653-a7af-32284f37c2dc.Text: "Hmm... What can you tell me about Abelard?"

6d5fc880-9fc4-4094-801e-c50301ef3e6b.Text: "Why are you here instead of basking in luxury on Dargonus?"

e3e72b3f-d691-46fc-ade6-d1eabec2fb70.Text: "I liked Macharius. I believe he and I came to an understanding."

e97deb5b-6812-4a63-a5bf-490330c91f2a.Text: "Your enforcers are doing a rather poor job of keeping order on the lower decks. I caught some kind of rash because of them."

9ae4be23-9b3d-43b1-a560-1870e354c337.Text: "Calm down. I am alive and well."

b30ff80f-fdb9-4f5b-af82-9add74743596.Text: "I trust you to come up with your own punishment."

5cb863c2-c3ab-4727-92b3-e43526720430.Text: "Bring Kibellah here. I want to know what drove her to murder."

6f9c6762-bc28-4fe4-b960-76ff161777c9.Text: "We can discuss your admiration... somewhere private."

34c3b6dc-8340-40dc-baa1-ea1b2d17bc08.Text: "Your lust is revolting. Stop, right now."

ae0ae1d0-d9ec-4323-bda4-ff3baf139887.Text: "What is your opinion of me as Lord Captain?"

499cb399-877c-4c59-83e9-ca03b5705a1a.Text: "Thank you for dispatching such attentive guards to my bathchamber. Taking a bath with them was entertaining."

3e3ee852-2ffd-4e0c-b97e-132f8c090077.Text: "I invited them to come and have a swim with me. They are fine people and good conversationalists."

38279e35-776d-4d2e-abb2-cbd6b693bbb1.Text: "Yes, they immediately left their posts and jumped straight into my tub."

07d55aa0-25b0-4454-afb7-2bf1798b4c83.Text: "It was a joke. Pay it no heed."

d0a5465f-c11a-41d2-be1c-c34bf70b398c.Text: "How did Jinevri's execution go? Did she repent before she died?"

9a7a58f8-0a96-47f0-afae-4fd342387125.Text: "I seem to be detecting something more than mere admiration."

d99c196b-68aa-4da6-aa65-c7d35ebb2ea7.Text: "Your family was involved in treason. I had them all executed."

5e608bea-71a3-47d8-ac21-636779577988.Text: "You are wearing Imperial Navy armour. How did you come by it?"

a5b17dc7-d5b1-4dce-a527-540019e18e1d.Text: "How did you come to serve on my flagship?"

a5c231e4-cf2b-4420-a95f-641933158600.Text: "I hope the executions are carried out in public, for the educational benefit."

ffd4bbcb-00f1-4bc8-9d9f-b68e4fd262e6.Text: "I want to know what you think about the other officers."

1bdcff8c-2b6a-477f-8a98-19b43681ebf0.Text: {n}Jocasta Sauerback is the very picture of discipline. Her uniform is exquisitely pressed, her armour is polished, and her posture is imposing and rigid. The only flaw in her immaculate appearance is the heavy enforcer's maul, which is worn and battered from frequent use. She salutes you with a practised motion.{/n} "Greetings, Lord Captain!"

318f0615-439c-43fa-859c-a1b7ee6a46e4.Text: "You can be sure of that. He was a fine enforcer, but suffered from the fatal flaw of trusting his associates. I myself lack that weakness and trust no one except you, Lord Captain."

182ded40-99a9-42e9-b0d4-39e441807274.Text: "I am responsible for upholding safety and order aboard the ship. Guard duties, patrols, finding and punishing troublemakers... In addition, my enforcers ensure that the crew follow all directives and carry out their tasks properly. As they say in my family, a servant who shows disobedience today prepares a riot tomorrow."

b5cf0f70-02f4-40c1-9076-4b466a5a9809.Text: "Two words, Lord Captain: suppression and fear. The base nature of the rabble cries for an iron grip, lest they give in to their animal urges. We have many well-tested measures to prevent it: random night searches, preventive interrogations, corporal punishment, and executions. Of course, the laws of the ship equally apply to the officers. We eradicate the canker of insubordination wherever we find it, without mercy."

5d0e37e7-6dcd-4aac-b739-b1809ace7143.Text: {n}Anxiety flares in her gaze.{/n} "I am ready to answer any questions as soon as I understand what you mean, Lord Captain."

68513005-f9c6-4098-8205-474b7ef816bc.Text: "I have no embarrassing secrets or weaknesses. Please recite the charge so that I can make a formal statement." {n}The Master-at-Arms's words ring with pride and devotion.{/n}

fd120cf7-e0f0-4036-b971-8a647c6aa4c0.Text: "Like Vigdis, he is a voidborn mutant. And he is too tightly woven into the ship's systems, which provides plenty of opportunities for sabotage. Moreover, his manner of address violates the ship's regulations..." {n}She frowns.{/n} "But Ravor's dedication to his post cannot be denied."

0d7a608b-4335-41eb-845b-0eeb352c0bb9.Text: {n}Sauerback nods respectfully.{/n} "A stress interrogation is a good tool for exposing ideologically weak elements." {n}She lowers her voice slightly.{/n} "It is usually conducted under duress. Thank you for choosing to omit that part for me."

44b45d44-280d-41aa-98ae-70cea0aa18b1.Text: "But things could have turned out quite differently!"

62345ea3-cdf4-432f-a377-dc57c430cbdf.Text: "Of course, Lord Captain." {n}She forces herself to look at you again — and this time, you see only cold impassivity in her eyes.{/n}

732f2dce-a9e3-404e-9230-680e3f83e7af.Text: "Too bad Macharius could not hear that." {n}An acrimonious smile twists Jocasta's pressed lips.{/n} "He has always thought very highly of himself, but you see right through him, Lord Captain."

5fbe04e2-0c8f-469c-974d-70ddf23e4b41.Text: {n}She flashes a venomous smile.{/n} "I am sure he deserved it. A little beating will be good for his pride. Let him try to earn your respect now."

29ddc3ad-174f-4104-86b8-882f634c5c33.Text: "I apologise for my cousin's behaviour, Lord Captain." {n}She grinds her teeth.{/n} "Macharius has always been a grouch, but a loyal one."

3913a6b8-07b6-4759-b444-468d6c724848.Text: "You liked... Macharius?" {n}She instantly shakes off her surprise and continues with a stony face:{/n} "I meant to say, I am glad my cousin has earned your favour, Lord Captain!"

9fb762f7-b8c7-4d2b-833d-cc9c45eb8fed.Text: "May I ask your opinion of him, Lord Captain?"

8acc9217-d387-40b5-b28c-af4d99308315.Text: {n}Sauerback's eyes gleam with a sadistic light.{/n} "Naturally, they last long enough to give the rabble something to think about! The witnesses to the execution must be of the same class as the criminal. It is unwise to put an officer to death in front of the common folk, for it undermines the perception of rank!" {n}She trails off. It seems like she rarely gets to discuss the nuances of a craft as complex and delicate as capital punishments.{/n}

41b99fce-e5e3-4643-8109-1465565318d9.Text: "I do not trust them, but I do not trust anyone. Mistress Toliman has too much power, and will surely be tempted to start deciding for herself what information to share with the crew on your behalf and what to withhold. Ravor is closely intertwined with the ship's systems, which opens up plenty of opportunities for sabotage... He must be watched. As for Danrok... Forgive me, but a man of his size and habits cannot help but steal!"

9914d8e1-bbf2-473c-8274-cf51acf9e31c.Text: "Lord Captain, power corrupts, but Danrok also controls your treasury. He may be loyal to you today, but sooner or later, the gold will cloud his judgement. It does not take long for the one who buys and sells to start seeing price tags attached to everything."

c3cd42c9-faab-41b3-ab39-65b38300bb3d.Text: "The Seneschal is a model of competence and fidelity, and all the officers and enforcers look up to him with gratitude..." {n}A grimace of fierce devotion takes hold of Sauerback's face, before she abruptly grits her teeth and continues.{/n} "It is all the more distressing to see that the years have not been kind to the deeply respected Master Werserian. Soon, there will be no rejuvenat treatment that can save him from the mistakes inherent in such advanced age. But we are ever watchful, and will be there to steady the trembling hand of the honoured veteran if need be."

70ca0d11-eb58-43ce-9ad3-9d56279ad6fa.Text: "If you ask me, leaving all the communication channels in the hands of a single officer can be dangerous. I have heard stories of Vox Masters who started to make their own decisions about what to tell the ship's captain and what to hide. To his credit, Vigdis has shown no such inclinations... At least, not yet."

f3ed2ad6-e220-412d-b090-05d66535bb5f.Text: "I am ready to answer any questions, Lord Captain!"

72302b1f-2b0b-489a-87c8-18f6ec6eb413.Text: {n}This conversation evokes nostalgic memories of serving as a Commissar. Sauerback's approach is very similar to the disciplinary oppression techniques used by the Officio Prefectus.{/n}

cd1926b0-12a2-414d-99dc-55c56f489374.Text: "Because of my cousin Macharius." {n}A furious crease appears between her brows.{/n} "I cannot stand him, but the feeling is mutual. We can hardly be in the same room together, so I jumped at the opportunity to become your enforcer. I should thank my obnoxious cousin for nudging me toward the best decision of my life. I serve you with all my heart and wish for no other fate than this one."

ee1eae14-d2b9-45cd-820e-804434ddae49.Text: {n}The mask of nonchalance on Sauerback's face shatters. She rolls up your sleeve with one hand, already pushing the tip of a long glass syringe into the centre of the growing rash with the other. A cramp runs through your body, and a cold sweat breaks out on your temples. But the itching subsides, and you start to feel much better immediately.{/n} "The Emperor... protected..."

571e2da7-435b-47be-95ea-748e82bde1a3.Text: "Void leprosy is a terrible disease that has affected several of the lower decks in recent years. Our chirurgeons know of a remedy that prevents its development at an early stage of infection. But if treatment is delayed, the patient's fate is not pretty. When did it begin to affect Bay LD-A14, and why wasn't I informed immediately?"

c8b8d262-bfb3-4e1a-a559-86cc7a47bba6.Text: {n}The Master-at-Arms bows her head in obedience, her eyes burning with rage and shame.{/n} "Please, Lord Captain, I beg you to punish me for this ignominious transgression!"

aab4b404-5244-4a3b-bff8-5ebdd2049a10.Text: "On the first evening watch, I shall visit the temple and submit to the proper punishment of the flesh with a spiked scourge before His countenance."

e42789f1-ed71-4be0-9f4a-efa4bc4698bd.Text: "I humbly insist on two hundred, Lord Captain."

eb71049f-0d51-4fd8-93aa-869de6baf26e.Text: "Lord Captain! I trust you have already received the report of Confessor Adalbert's involvement with Nemesite? We stand ready to arrest him as soon as you grant us your high permission to do so."

2f60d0b3-8165-4c9b-8014-c30a3f86c78f.Text: "Lord Captain! Mistress Kibellah is awaiting your judgement. Would you like her brought in?"

d4ca6109-030d-4ef9-a867-a52b90feebd6.Text: {n}Sauerback averts her gaze, clearly flustered by her outburst.{/n}

3a33a1f9-241f-4279-b50b-fccd405b1c15.Text: "Lord Captain!" {n}The Master-at-Arms snaps to attention, ready to carry out your order.{/n}

b54b672a-c5b6-4902-8ebb-fa2262faba68.Text: "Yes, Lord Captain!" {n}Flames of anticipation burn beneath Jocasta's icy mask of loyalty.{/n}

185dd0be-ef5e-447a-8585-04918ac35071.Text: "I do not doubt the astuteness of your decisions. But beyond that... I am impressed with you. I have heard about the {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Torture}brutal punishments{/d} that you have endured, Lord Captain." {n}She looks away, but before she does so, you notice a strange spark in her eyes.{/n} "Your tenacity deserves admiration."

c7cec018-1556-4fac-bd81-fc4c6d7d930d.Text: {n}There is fire in the black depths of her gaze. If she could, she would devour you whole with her sidelong glances.{/n}

16676dc0-1c73-48bd-968f-01713ac74106.Text: {n}Sauerback's gaze becomes very still.{/n} "What... Excuse me, Lord Captain, what did you just say?"

8e6cae9a-5e56-4070-82a8-297393883b67.Text: {n}Sauerback does not seem to be entertained.{/n} "But of course. That is what I assumed."

c6507816-3f6c-48e8-b054-b7bb829dd637.Text: "I am pleased to have been of service," {n}she hisses, gripping the handle of her maul, which does not bode well for the two fine people and good conversationalists.{/n}

bf6cf5d5-66b8-4618-8528-1fdaf31563be.Text: "This will not happen again — I will see to it personally." {n}Her hand grips the handle of her maul in ice-cold fury.{/n}

75ccb689-f94f-4200-a37f-ceeb47f2c6fb.Text: {n}Sauerback shakes her head grimly.{/n} "No, she proclaimed her innocence to the very end. In fact, she dragged another good enforcer down with her."

847941a7-32ac-4794-8742-e4d849249c02.Text: "Before her execution, she asked to speak to Captain Klein. I do not know what lies she told him, but the old man snapped. First, he showed up to watch duty in his cups, and then he drank himself to death on rotgut. We lost a good veteran because of that conniving rat."

0803584b-f19a-4775-ade5-3c65bedb2d1d.Text: "I would not dare form opinions about Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} — that would be unforgivably brazen of me. My duty is to serve, not to evaluate."

26b0b7ec-3c73-4cc8-8428-6371ac6f04f2.Text: "I do not share the disgraceful concerns that certain crew members indulge in. Those who whisper about your so-called {d|Encyclopedia:Conviction_Heretical3OrMore}apostasy{/d} from the Emperor are all traitors." {n}She looks away, but before she does so, you notice a strange spark in her eyes.{/n} "The courage with which you ignore the opinions of others deserves admiration."

cf084119-c41f-48c8-b59b-92732dd2d4a5.Text: "Then what about... awe?" {n}She stares at your neck, right at the scar peeking out from under your collar. Her pupils dilate, and she licks her lips involuntarily.{/n} "Thinking about what you have suffered leaves me... trembling."

7882ee0b-2e0e-4c8c-894c-0a1612deadd4.Text: "Then what about... awe?" {n}Her pupils dilate, and she licks her lips involuntarily.{/n} "Thinking about how superior you are to those around you, about all that you can... permit yourself... It leaves me trembling."

8183e8f7-3cad-4e90-9c47-4e54558a5b7e.Text: {n}There is a long pause. Then, Sauerback smiles grimly.{/n} "I do not intend to mourn Macharius's death, although I will miss the insufferable snob. I shall strive to redeem my family name through unwavering service, for the sake of the generations who were loyal to the Rogue Traders of Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}'s line."

c03b084e-d6ad-4ea0-b963-ebecc66ebb61.Text: "I inherited it from the previous Master-at-Arms. Like the esteemed Seneschal, he left the Navy to serve Lady Theodora. He brought quite a few officers with him and established a tradition: upon the death or resignation of an enforcer, his or her armour would be passed on to a fellow officer who had distinguished themselves in the course of their duties. I was awarded armour in this way in my time, and upon the death of my predecessor, I inherited his personal armour."

ddf806a8-9a80-4a1c-b40f-911fb62ab992.Text: "But for now the steel in his spine remains unbending as ever — Werserian has been staunchly defending the crew in disputes with Master Anthar. I admire the Arbitrator's dogged pursuit of order, his hard-nosed severity, his implacability..." {n}The admiration in Sauerback's voice is unmistakable.{/n} "But the esteemed Seneschal is right — while our enforcers may not be as superbly trained as the Adeptus Arbites, our strength lies in our unquestioning loyalty to the dynasty. It is not for the esteemed Proctor to interfere with centuries of tried and tested practice."

91511a6e-b09d-4151-84ac-c47ef4235266.Text: {n}She cocks an eyebrow.{/n} "Please repeat your orders, Lord Captain."

fb6a5e33-4d6c-4022-9b18-cd1da800814f.Text: "I come from the noble Sauerback family of the capital world of Dargonus. I dare say that our house is renowned for its loyalty and strict adherence to the law, and the members of my family have been your faithful enforcers for centuries. I am honoured to be the sixth Master-at-Arms named Sauerback to serve on this ship." {n}Jocasta speaks the words with unmistakable pride.{/n}

813e41aa-8d44-4630-9a96-e43d36ca758c.Text: [Smile at the impostor] "I do not fear you."

b2acce7f-7991-466a-a39e-fabed43de97f.Text: [Wound Ravor] "You are not yourself. I must stop you for your own good."

a10ea145-d733-444e-86c8-5962d65211b3.Text: "I do not wish to kill you."

d2f36328-fcab-4acb-b51b-db7a8b97eb02.Text: "You carry xenos blood in you. Expect no mercy."

4b4784f9-c670-4ce2-aa40-c14bcb9657e5.Text: "I owe Einrich a bullet in the forehead. Your deaths will simply be a nice bonus."

07d74069-e0e5-4855-b6ad-bb15428df4eb.Text: [Invade Ravor's mind and shatter the psychic bonds]

128911a5-c2b8-4e56-a62d-f16451931321.Text: "Ravor, you saw me fall to the lower decks in that elevator with your own eyes."

2df1c1cb-a006-4873-8555-f4e06162759e.Text: "Abelard, there is a vile creature sitting on my throne. Get rid of it."

09340406-a3e4-44ce-be4d-58ac836fb691.Text: "I have done the impossible before, and soon, your death will become simply another page in the chronicle of my deeds."

4a36243d-81c0-4351-90e8-21ff2f2121f0.Text: "It is the Master Helmsman's duty never to deviate from the charted route. You have veered far off course, Ravor. Your hands should be holding the wheel, not pointing a weapon at your Lord Captain."

cf34e823-32d0-4f9c-8d98-8b091183dffa.Text: "Mia, Nemi, have you betrayed me too?"

0af247ab-c15f-42a1-ae69-78ec6f5710c3.Text: [Give up the futile struggle] "You know... that unity of yours does not sound so bad after all. I think I am ready to accept it."

37b8dd92-3bd8-444b-a0ab-8fd8faadb3e5.Text: "If you are a sentient creature, then you are also capable of negotiating, are you not?"

84b7fb90-7285-46ba-b18e-ad034190a22d.Text: Sowed confusion in the Sire's chorus of voices with your true faith in the Emperor.

2ec5b33f-09f9-4978-8543-63a3a77b55b2.Text: "Your very existence offends the Emperor. In His name, I cast you down into the abyss!"

86f6fa40-2f46-42c5-81af-6918a07f7fa6.Text: {n}An exact copy of you sits on the throne, a sinister double, crawled into this reality from behind the looking glass. {mf|His|Her} gaze meets yours, and the world expands sharply, crushing you with an overwhelming sense of your own insignificance. From somewhere far away, across millions of light years, a god is looking at you through those eyes. He sees you and he is hungry — insatiably, unquenchably so.{/n}

b84840a7-c63a-46d2-a561-38a87c30a87c.Text: {n}You are snapped out of your stupor by Ravor's harsh bellow. The Master Helmsman's eyes are empty, his pale lips curling in fury.{/n} "Not one step further, voidscum! I sentence you to death for endangering the Lord Captain's safety!"

5ce9bdfd-337a-488c-aaef-42b435f0e5a5.Text: {n}Holding you at gunpoint, Mia casts an annoyed glance at Nemi.{/n} "Don't speak with the heretic, you idiot!"

b1801aed-3fc0-486a-9d69-aed8ad49f2a7.Text: "Master Helmsman, are you out of your mind? The Rogue Trader stands before you! Step aside before I shoot you for treason and insubordination!"

fb282d94-99db-432e-8dc9-abd21ccbc5fa.Text: {n}Idira doubles over, attempting to shield herself from your doppelganger with both arms.{/n} "It has latched onto him, grinding his thoughts like a millstone! What is this monster? Don't look, don't look!"

42d7db1a-4410-4600-ba16-71eee39cd64b.Text: "Either infected, or exposed to a psychic influence. Both cases call for immediate termination."

bf6cfe55-bd4d-47a4-a4f3-247ece707dcd.Text: "No, Abelard. The Rogue Trader sits upon the throne, and you dare drag this reactor sludge onto the bridge! You must have grown senile in your old age, Seneschal, if you cannot even distinguish {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship} from an impostor." {n}Ravor shakes his head, a trickle of blood running from his ear.{/n}

1eaafdb0-1560-44a8-a4fd-7ec39be7a786.Text: {n}Your twin leers back. With razor-sharp teeth, {mf|his|her} grin rips open your mind, and a primal dread slithers in through the gap. It is a terror woven into the genes of every living thing, the paralysing fear of the natural predator of one's species. There is nothing human in the smile emanating from that face you know so well.{/n}

a9a1f9e6-22b2-4e4f-8b7f-26b4e6f94626.Text: "We don't want your mercy. The Sire will reap his harvest, and we won't shame him with our cowardice!" {n}The girl's eyes burn with a fanatic zeal.{/n}

9044b7b3-5683-4850-b3ee-bc9066b160e4.Text: {n}With a tremendous {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Psyker}mental{/d} effort, you pry open the invisible jaws locked on Ravor's mind. You only manage to hold the unknown entity's monstrous power back for an instant, but it is enough to free your helmsman's consciousness from its prison.{/n}

f368b14f-357d-4530-9991-d7fa475d1f94.Text: "Lord Cap'n? But if it is you, then who's sitting on the throne?" {n}Ravor turns toward the impostor and recoils with a shout of terror. He reaches for his pistol, but blood begins gushing from his ears and he collapses to the floor.{/n}

5e0d63ec-38de-441f-9e86-3e2f55fbecd8.Text: "Groxshit! The Lord Captain never left the bridge. We dropped the elevator to keep the mutineers out!"

4f641b09-29a4-4d31-89f4-0944cd6f09aa.Text: {n}Ravor tries to catch you in his sights, but falls to the deck before he can steady his hand. There is bloody foam bubbling from his mouth.{/n} "No! The Lord Captain is in danger! I must... protect..." {n}He stops, his chest rising and falling heavily. He is badly wounded, but he will live if he receives help soon.{/n}

426af56e-03ba-474b-ae64-5418bd6515aa.Text: {n}Your doppelganger remains seated and motionless on the throne, but {mf|his|her} posture betrays the tension of a predator ready to pounce. {mf|He|She} catches your gaze, and the vessel of your soul overflows with a cascade of images and feelings. You hear a song, a chorus of countless whispers that weave a tantalising melody. You feel a unity with something great and beautiful. It is bigger than you, bigger than this ship and everyone on it.{/n}

3263e838-1b18-4a66-a0dd-1a50e1b373a7.Text: {n}The doppelganger's eyes grow wider and deeper, like twin purple lakes. You step into them, and the Meaning begins to permeate every fibre of your being. You dive head-first into the bliss, never to come out again.{/n}

f223bb92-c9ba-4e7c-b42f-366c77a699b7.Text: {n}The bridge shudders as a crushing roar billows across it. Behind the facade of that leering face, you glimpse the monstrous shadow — the shadow in the void that wants only to devour you.{/n}

5e5db1b1-96f1-46cb-b136-1de946364c1a.Text: {n}The Seneschal adjusts his grip on his weapon and growls,{/n} "Only one {mf|man|woman} may sit on the throne of the Rogue Trader, and that is {name} von Valancius. Wretched pretenders, craven xenos, enemies of Humanity — their only rightful place is in a pool of blood at the {mf|lord|lady} of the dynasty's feet!"

b5cef116-5dbd-42c2-88bc-2809a51665d8.Text: "Then put down your weapons and accept death, heretic. The Sire will reap, and we shall be his sickles!" {n}The girl's eyes burn with a fanatic zeal.{/n}

411db2f3-61c7-4981-975f-9355b67a1110.Text: {n}The whispers grow stronger, conjuring visions of strange worlds inhabited by unthinkable creatures... Or is it a single creature? It has Unity, Meaning, Purpose, and Perfection. It is magnificent, and next to it, you are nothing.{/n}

bff997c5-42ca-4785-b6cd-3fc08c10acfa.Text: {n}There is a strange... allure to the whispers. You begin to glimpse vague yet intriguing images — images of glorious victories and meaningful service, of a truly worthy goal, and of companions bound to you by the seal of genetic sameness. The angelic song enters into your dreams, revealing astounding truths.{/n}

136dd97f-8821-46a1-809e-4c348b38f009.Text: {n}A ripple of dissonance runs through the chorus of voices as they screech in anger, vexation, defiance. The song no longer carries a sense of overpowering superiority.{/n}

a215dc6a-63b5-4678-b506-50d3da9a52a5.Text: {n}His very presence is unbearable — it washes over your {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Psyker}mind{/d}, twisting and crushing it. You feel a wet crack inside your skull, and blood comes pouring out of your eyes and nose.{/n}

1aa1b7ae-7679-435f-a9bc-78b4329d35cb.Text: {n}You hear stifled groans behind you. Even standing near this entity is torturous for anyone who possesses psychic powers.{/n}

167f2c44-652f-45ba-91cf-aa8a2ea6399c.Text: {n}Something starts scratching at the walls of your mind, making you ill.{/n}

894873e0-189e-473b-ae50-7e2b7817bf34.Text: {n}Marazhai's face splits into a grin as he casts you a mocking look.{/n} "A sore spot with you, is it not?"

a181b86d-3b61-4dde-9e2a-52c13800ba8f.Text: {n}This simple truth, known to any and all {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Navy}voidsmen{/d}, causes something in Ravor's mind to click.{/n} "I have... veered off? Blast me in the back with plasma torpedoes, who's watching the readings? And why am I aiming this thing at..."

5307b101-ce39-4046-a3be-04e5021b2889.Text: {n}Your heart feels strangely calm. It seems that performing feats of heroism has become {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_MOT_GreatDeed}second nature{/d} to you.{/n}

b7ba0b3c-8f38-42ea-989c-a80583807878.Text: {n}The doppelganger peers into your smile. Displeased. Concerned. From the imperious look in {mf|his|her} eyes, {mf|he|she} expects submission, but there is no submission or fear in you. And this inspires terror.{/n}

6d82a48d-c7c6-43cc-9dd8-20e64aa11c52.Text: "You won't hurt him, heretic! The Sire won't let you! I won't let you!" {n}The girl's eyes burn with a fanatic zeal.{/n}

618b4fb7-7836-47a9-b680-4252745cafb9.Text: {n}A rumbling growl shudders through every nerve ending in your body. It is the roar of a beast defending its territory. The throne is no longer yours. It was never yours in the first place.{/n}

80e5840e-437c-4213-9a30-2bb1a689beaf.Text: {n}Among the mutineers by the throne, you spot a dishevelled woman and a teenage girl with a short haircut. You {d|Encyclopedia:HelpedInfernusFamily}recognise{/d} the Infernus Master's sister and niece, Nemi and Mia. Their faces are no longer friendly, but twisted with determination and hatred.{/n}

d8b6c8c2-18ec-465a-8016-1d2b0019b55f.Text: {n}Nemi shakes her head.{/n} "Betrayal of false believers is not treason. We have heard the Sire's song throughout our entire lives. Our blood is pure. We bring liberation."

d3fd10f4-8f20-47d5-888b-f19de2c9f5f2.Text: {n}Argenta looks at the girl with visible sadness. She whispers a silent prayer, then clenches her weapon so hard that the knuckles on her hand turn white.{/n}

929df13f-47af-4f0b-9a98-61cffdda996c.Text:
The Rogue Trader's ship is a veritable city sailing through the void. The ship has numerous compartments that you can visit.
Navigate these compartments using the map of the ship, which you can access from the main elevator on the bridge or from any compartment.

026f1641-1f2f-4ab8-b8da-12ccdeefb845.Text: "You are reaching out to a soul you do not fully understand. You are afraid that your differences will only cause you pain. Do not let fear dictate your fate."

3fd01974-633f-4597-9b50-514dad37fb49.Text: "Love... A hollow word, Domin'{name}. Do you not see that I only have the Undying One in my heart? Not you. Not ever."

064bb19f-12d3-4a08-867a-172577242266.Text: "One day, the Undying One will whisper your name to me. I will carry out His command without hesitation, for I am your death, Domin'{name}."

bd9e342c-19df-4040-95c9-408fec9ac15c.Text: "You have a way with... subjugation, Lord Captain."

a0f5baf4-66a1-4852-9ca5-622e2d1a3263.Text: "That choking technique... I could use it during my more rigorous interrogations."

2930161a-3921-4e66-a51b-43934e92fa40.Text: "You know how to savour pain, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}... It sets me ablaze."

b3387fe3-3c0a-46dc-a5d5-b5155e8d869b.Text: Even in death, the Sire continues to watch your every step. The head of the genetic abomination serves as a bitter reminder that a great many of Humanity's enemies are hiding within the ranks of its allies.

d22bc534-99e7-4941-b5c2-93ac4ef8572b.Text: "Gracious {mf|master|mistress}, please... take pity on this miserable worm..."

42fa5df3-93d8-463f-9bf8-05509ec740c7.Text: "You seem tense. Your orders are to enjoy some of this food and amasec."

d5ad8c5b-1314-481a-9ac9-71f8cd82c7bf.Text: "What do enforcers do in their free time?"

1ad726a0-76ae-41b1-a725-803172a290e0.Text: [Try to weave your voice into the melody]

71cd99f3-ecbe-4685-b8fe-f0c068a1f683.Text: "I will have it placed in my study."

0fc3b8c9-a0bb-45a1-945e-4d3a9720f87b.Text: "What a curious hobby. But the carving is yours — you should keep it."

01303eac-ec1e-4a55-894b-1392448c0576.Text: "You may relax with me here until I am finished bathing."

2722d6a3-a57d-49e4-a33b-a5ab36ec9460.Text: [Address the enforcers] "You two, get in here! I require company and pleasant conversation."

9b1d5bd8-a9fa-4f11-b803-f9b32aee5e36.Text: [Address the Master of Ablutions] "I wish to see someone from my retinue."

4375a6c2-0cf4-4eb9-acd9-7a083ae3d4d6.Text: "Argenta. I wish to know what the Sisters of Battle do in their spare time."

28d031cc-7f3d-4c71-a558-c0d793006903.Text: "Yrliet. The xenos will keep me entertained."

5e515235-5631-489e-a604-8b5eba5667f4.Text: "Ulfar. I wish to listen to his sagas."

a4cb3989-b3a1-4bca-8e11-d0f2c8ba02a4.Text: "Marazhai. I wonder what sort of amusements he will suggest."

3e27806c-0e67-4a2f-abcf-29c2bc569e0f.Text: "Consider it an opportunity to practice life drawing."

a992c414-a36a-4f33-8abf-154024c8e4ef.Text: "It is a proud aristocratic tradition. Was it not customary on your station?"

de031d5d-a96e-4e4d-9923-55c16d5b5cae.Text: "Do you mean to tell me that my body is more hideous than all the horrors of the warp? After all, you do not shy away from painting them."

f180f981-d1ee-4cf9-81f5-2ccb1f653f8b.Text: "Perhaps you are right. Maybe this was not such a good idea."

01937816-c624-4d11-89a8-a10e3f213a70.Text: "There is no need to be shy. Relax with me for a moment."

f8232aa1-19dc-4e80-9d14-01c0d585544e.Text: "Enough! What are you talking about? This is madness!"

b638f0f7-34d4-44a8-b507-182b2270a1f1.Text: "Your style is so unique. I like it."

6fefe72f-251d-4f4c-ae89-b95b2ed889dc.Text: "That sounds like it could be dangerous."

d3604571-caf1-4b06-9142-05558829c889.Text: "I do not think I want to try this particular discipline."

ebb2fdd2-1446-4c0b-8d89-d8afb0407b06.Text: "Death... It is Nothing. And yet... it is everything."

cffd5d56-1f67-44c8-9373-3062c7dd0322.Text: "It was... interesting. But I hope it does not happen again any time soon."

7d20c133-1199-4c60-a18c-246fe891c272.Text: "It was terrible! In the end... there was only oblivion. It all felt so... inevitable."

43bd4a6e-3c30-401b-a5b6-96eb76596487.Text: "That will be all. You may leave."

7dc74ae5-1333-4211-9abc-7bf546e6b95e.Text: [Communicate with the blob through a series of giggles]

5daedb4d-f6c2-478d-98b7-f42baaaf6ad9.Text: [Stare at the blob until it dissolves]

60474c82-3504-423a-84e3-926fdc818240.Text: "A 'kick' is certainly one way of putting it... "

3241c01f-438e-4cb4-98bc-92b96bd214fa.Text: "You have not told a lie... But you have failed to tell the whole truth. These claims sound shocking because you have presented them without context."

36bc01cf-fdba-41b5-830d-160357241aef.Text: [Allow Jae to take the lead so you can keep a clear head]

0097eebf-3581-48a2-a111-b00a6c2ba9a5.Text: "I want to hear a heroic tale of valour."

f9ce2a6e-0f59-4517-a576-9cb46e77e575.Text: "I am in the mood for a terrifying tale."

57fb5e88-e0ab-49bb-a372-368395f0c811.Text: "Guards! Bring me a weapon and set out the targets!"

dfcd20a9-53f5-4998-89b1-db08ac5bb763.Text: "And that is your idea of fun? How deathly dull."

ab0cc3d5-8dcd-4ca0-9085-85768e3dff1a.Text: "Three rounds isn't enough, it could end in a draw."

6442b26f-ce60-46a9-b5c0-6182c4c98cff.Text: [Toss back a glass of amasec] "Let's raise the stakes! We're going to shoot while drunk!"

f97f277a-e14f-48a9-9889-fd12b720f7b1.Text: "Congratulations, Solomorne, you win. Take a bottle of my finest amasec as a reward."

2c06d5b0-26da-4266-8e31-388c4c71e284.Text: "I do not think this is something I wish to try."

14f2b8f5-7194-4cf2-8ebd-f35d22236110.Text: "The last round needs to be special — shooting a bottle on top of an enforcer's head."

ee7bf985-3c11-485f-a64b-4ae4724f63c3.Text: "Because you cheated by using Glaito, I refuse to accept your victory. Dismissed."

426b013e-93c1-4b37-8e4a-1a8c33afd3ea.Text: "Tell me about yourselves. Do you have any other responsibilities besides guarding these chambers?"

9a376ea4-8b20-4511-b5a3-8ca607a209bb.Text: [Pass Bran a piece of soap and a knife] "I demand a demonstration, Bran."

080cfa99-6ebc-4ad4-8e59-7fa153884937.Text: "All right, one final joke. Make it a good one!"

610093b5-4e3d-4d4c-bb05-fb945a1424e7.Text: "I am not interested in your exercises!"

bc4a6dbb-7751-4e99-b423-27a3fe8cd395.Text: "Very well. I will try your exercises."

bb106e7e-6b92-46cd-a120-3c4a7565dd66.Text: "Surely you do not train all the time. What else do you like to do?"

870bc4e3-865a-416b-b562-fe93cd40ae10.Text: "Wait, why do I have to listen to a lecture?"

be113825-204b-43ec-82a4-5442f317ac65.Text: [Drop the soap sculpture into the bathtub] "How clumsy of me. Well, it is only soap."

80d1cbf7-0dec-4101-b7b9-a144fa6e8ef5.Text: "I do not wish to waste your valuable time. You are free to leave."

12596fa1-173a-4866-aca0-9ca6b0fca30b.Text: "I promise that I will study the history of the dynasty in my spare time."

f4c6f2bc-b2f8-40ae-89d7-a76835eb8774.Text: [Clutch your head] "Oh, no... Suddenly I do not feel so well..."

6e2180c5-a220-4b38-8714-5b88feed8223.Text: "Abelard. I simply cannot bathe without my loyal Seneschal."

2af3dc0a-bf8a-4d94-81cd-3471d50bbe44.Text: Reflected on your duty to the Emperor.

745b9a58-5cf3-4f56-9b59-999e3c24b6aa.Text: [Thoughts of {mf|his|her} monumental duty to the Emperor. Such duty can only be fulfilled through service and death, for such is the price of Humanity's victory in the everlasting war]

fd741d38-75fe-4933-b699-9fae90e9b42e.Text: "I will not participate in such a frivolous activity."

c9638946-8ea3-492e-884b-f7c48f33ee01.Text: "Cassia. I want her to paint my portrait."

5431b252-1711-4949-98ba-3791abaec23a.Text: "Jae. She knows how to have a good time."

8ac76501-5f70-4198-a2e0-5b224d0fd1dc.Text: "Kibellah. I wish to learn more about the Tenets of the Web."

5076d2e0-31a4-4f32-a13e-7ecb78278739.Text: "Pasqal. I wish to see my Enginseer."

dfc1458a-b7ec-42b7-830b-251d4be469f1.Text: Reflected on the fate of your subjects.

1d567c1a-81b9-4229-9d5f-dd491661d920.Text: [Thoughts of those who keep {mf|him|her} afloat in these waters. Who will drown, and who will {mf|he|she} manage to pull to the surface?]

aec6315a-ed5b-4312-bd03-a6793a7aafa2.Text: Reflected on the price of power.

b741963c-b897-40cb-a3de-c7ff433229e1.Text: [Thoughts about the price paid for power, the inconstant paths through which such power is obtained, and the people and things {mf|he|she} will sacrifice for the sake of {mf|his|her} supremacy]

6b3a34f8-9b7c-4d10-911b-f39e6dacfa50.Text: [Only a desperate desire to lose {mf|himself|herself} in these precious moments of peace and quiet before they are gone]

755fa720-433c-4873-96a7-fd4f7f8a1599.Text: "No one knows the name of the dynasty's founder. It has vanished into the darkness of the ages."

7b92f168-e00b-437c-b39e-e0cf14346f74.Text: "Pasqal... why have you climbed into my bathtub?"

375b0713-a737-4729-becd-685e6776e1bc.Text: "Why are you taking a bath with your clothes on?"

34849add-3667-41e1-8fff-885bce12d485.Text: "Pasqal, please get out of the bathtub."

66fe689a-53dd-4e99-b2a3-f9a345dc0744.Text: "How long will it take you to complete your cleaning protocol?"

64ec110f-0c15-4c4d-a13e-ec948798818e.Text: "I am not going to wait here for an hour."

ebbfd744-b5f8-4a17-af32-b446a6d4bb9c.Text: "Are you... suggesting that I should leave my own bathchamber?"

7b03075b-d04c-414d-9ec8-3a1600def84e.Text: "I am afraid to take a bath now, thanks to you."

bc8e6594-b1ad-4c0a-9f51-f2cf55651acd.Text: "I am not asking you to violate protocol. I am asking you to suspend it temporarily, and finish it... somewhere else. "

8cdfbb19-9a6d-4d1c-87b2-27ab4142191c.Text: [Give him a lecture — or rather, several lectures] "Their name has vanished into the darkness of the ages. Would you like to hear how it happened?"

0befff7b-9ccc-478a-9831-ac1d9fbba66d.Text: "...and that is why this particular shade of blue was chosen for the von Valancius coat of arms."

cad8f319-6d6f-4ce9-82e0-511131836dbb.Text: "It is reassuring to know my enforcers are prepared for anything."

d640fc90-4300-4638-80b5-49150acd70a5.Text: "...and that is the origin of the legend of the incredible, upside-down-flying Rogue Trader."

5450d908-b4b4-4c52-b3dd-5dcac5a96d25.Text: "...and that serves as the indisputable proof of my magnificence."

f5bd455a-b282-4944-8724-57156da24903.Text: "You are welcome to stay, Pasqal. Your presence does not inconvenience me in the slightest."

6d128344-a689-4e82-947a-d211c34dd0ad.Text: "Solomorne. I wonder what Arbitrators do to unwind."

af0a4455-4886-47a7-96fb-998649f9f018.Text: "Now we shoot with our eyes closed!"

064de2b0-a80a-4b8c-9bb1-9d99947a6dcc.Text: "You must give me a chance to redeem myself. If I hit the bottle on the enforcer's head, victory is mine."

1a115801-6fdc-4738-8e89-5aade78f244f.Text: [Open one eye] "Shooting blind is damn difficult..."

4ad89f3f-be40-4546-962f-3749ba9efd17.Text: "That sounds fascinating. Can you teach me?"

5b12d401-ee7c-4cb3-bfe8-991966a94183.Text: {n}The enforcers breathe a sigh of relief.{/n}

cc28c4b7-ff2f-425f-9099-539f63f543f4.Text: "Orders received, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! We will commence relaxation immediately!"

b561f5ba-e2d3-4ff1-811f-ed2f228c1e8e.Text: {n}The enforcers are lean and muscular. They sit down awkwardly in the bathtub, clearly fighting the urge to stand at attention.{/n}

3039bc7e-1196-425a-9262-f5e6ab56e9e9.Text: "We live to serve, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! We'll keep you safe!"

acd989b8-7754-49e5-a7e8-33d33ae58a28.Text: "Please excuse my partner, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. She talks too much. I can assure you that in our clan's hundreds of years of service, no Rogue Trader has ever died while taking a bath."

8b345f06-7054-42a2-80a1-eeede43fb8ad.Text: {n}The enforcers are barely able to conceal their excitement as they shove delicious delicacies into their mouths, and wash them down with obscenely expensive drinks. They have never experienced anything like this before, and likely never will again. It is a feast they will not soon forget — a story they will tell to their grandchildren someday.{/n}

31fa770c-8e8e-4acd-a165-6b6a81317f30.Text: {n}The woman reverently places slices of exotic fruits and rich-smelling cheeses into your mouth, and the man brings a cup of {g|Encyclopedia:Amasec}amasec{/g} to your lips to wash it all down. They do everything for you except chew and swallow, but you suspect that if you were to give them the order, they would find a way to do that for you as well.{/n}

95492574-01cc-4dd2-9c36-2ad4576664db.Text: "In that case, elantach, I will leave you to occupy your mind with more suitable pursuits."

d3e130de-41cb-46c9-b5b6-7c5ac3b2c74a.Text: {n}The soothing water caresses your senses, and your grateful muscles welcome the chance to rest. A pleasant languor spreads through your body as you allow yourself a moment of quiet relaxation.{/n}

002bec45-0242-4480-8e5e-09df33257ae9.Text: "What would you like to talk about, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}? We await your orders."

acb5f43d-4e28-4ffc-a9bd-b5f2b6dc9366.Text: {n}You try to add your voice to the song, but you find it difficult to follow the music. One motif is suddenly replaced by another, and the shifting rhythms leave you confused.{/n}

4eeead34-340f-472a-9fe2-97d4c112a7b5.Text: "You have fundamentally misunderstood the purpose of this custom, elantach. But that is to be expected. You should spend more time among your own people instead of trying to learn something that takes an Asuryani centuries to master."

11f55a91-2df7-4fc3-a1ef-e55b92cd8782.Text: "We would consider it a great honour, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! But please do not tell the Master-at-Arms we joined in your ablutions. Mistress Sauerback will beat us bloody if she finds out."

20fa428b-a276-46b1-ac58-194a4cc533f1.Text: "Yes, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Thank you for the honour you've bestowed on us! We will resume our duties at once!"

f328ce3c-bcf3-444d-b701-075244296c21.Text: {n}You feel revitalised — this was truly an experience worthy of a Rogue Trader.{/n}

2e32025f-ddf7-4179-abbf-211a78e08c8a.Text: "Which of them would you like me to summon, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}?"

2d0b8504-927f-4dab-8707-8173c1f7f3b0.Text: {n}Troubles, worries, loss — such things do not belong in this newly established dominion of tranquillity. There are only the infinite waters of weightlessness, in which, stripped of all things superficial, the mind of {name} von Valancius drifts in silent bliss.{/n}

1a71734f-16c8-4248-86cd-202e30a19ac7.Text: {n}It is a conscious mind. What fills this consciousness?{/n}

cdd7b7a9-e4fd-4d30-95c1-022505ed5f6f.Text: "Are you asking me to violate the sacred protocol?"

64e05941-a232-4226-bd5f-b4324aceb62e.Text: {n}Abelard provides you with a daunting amount of information, but you still learn quite a lot about your dynastic history... whether you want to or not.{/n}

510012ee-703b-4643-bdba-90177aedb426.Text: {n}It is a lost cause to try and commit the contents of Abelard's lecture to memory — after an hour of names, dates, and events, it all becomes an incomprehensible jumble.{/n}

4e416c62-e24d-4252-9bac-971517140c03.Text: {n}You know that the name of the dynasty's founder has been lost to history. After all, it has been millennia since the Warrant was bestowed upon your ancestors.{/n}

b18c4046-8dcc-4cb6-8951-f8ac8da4d557.Text: {n}The sacrifice of the many paves the way to a triumphant future for the titan that is the Protector of the {g|Encyclopedia:ImperiumGlossary}Imperium{/g}. It is a heavy burden to be the ground beneath His feet, but it is glorious to serve such a righteous purpose in unity.{/n}

74bc4e33-cc13-4ad0-af56-0ba1f95fc1e1.Text: {n}The strands of fate are fragile — yet woven together, they are strong. Not everyone is destined to see this voyage through to its end, but no one will be forgotten.{/n}

823189d7-3829-4945-92a9-ef9546d61546.Text: {n}The cost of power is great. But when it comes to accomplishing one's dreams, no price is too high.{/n}

08f1bc0a-0211-42ed-a170-29165967fd03.Text: "Lord Captain, it is most improper for us to be conversing in your bathchamber, and I cannot believe you wish me to paint a picture of you... disrobed! I... I cannot! It is scandalous. This goes beyond every standard of decency!"

28b9672c-026e-4914-b4bf-6c0cdaef930e.Text: {n}The enforcers exchange a puzzled glance.{/n} "Do you mean... us, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}?"

6929bbbb-e983-47ed-8b4a-07b59df7cbf0.Text: "Hmm..." {n}He purses his lips, pretending to be deep in thought.{/n} "If you insist. I will personally flay the skin from your back and send your servants to fetch some sacks of salt for the bath..."

00c9c538-1211-4a99-a2f5-cc29a6466a56.Text: "Well... you are certainly an interesting model..."

7eaf58ab-cc18-41c8-a8b5-bad7eff7679d.Text: "Personally, I prefer still life and landscapes. However, I appreciate your concern for my artistic education."

9a97cebd-da72-424b-962f-d139319912ac.Text: "I am afraid that my teachers on Eurac V never mentioned such a curious practice to me."

4792eb9e-a4f3-493e-800f-4c803d674da9.Text: "I regret to say such traditions never made it to Eurac V. I am sure painting a portrait is a worthy artistic endeavour, but it is not one I am experienced enough to attempt."

37eba188-8a45-4ea0-8527-ea07cfdd888c.Text: "No, of course not! I... did not mean to insult you, Lord Captain."

6d615a2c-b5b1-4db1-9e55-111e216227ec.Text: "No, that is not it at all! I simply... understand the warp. It is familiar to me, unlike human anatomy."

4b315e2d-aedd-4ed3-b14b-2f640a57ca16.Text: "I have never painted people before. But I am willing to try if you insist."

de58cbdb-78a5-48bc-be85-970d5349424d.Text: {n}Panic engulfs you as your empty lungs burn. Your body thrashes, stubborn in its refusal to die. You push your way to the surface and gasp hungrily for air.{/n}

d3f0f875-4a38-4ea6-91b2-2cb83fd5a400.Text: "You are unprepared for this discipline, Domin'{name}. Breathe. Feel the life beating in your veins. Rest."

3b7fe3fa-aa58-416e-91ca-78d807907579.Text: {n}Cassia's cheeks turn pink, and you feel a flush of embarrassment.{/n} "You are most gracious. It would be a pleasure to paint like this again sometime. Though perhaps in a more... traditional environment."

baa2ec28-8452-455c-bf65-964615acbbe6.Text: "So is everything else about this situation. I hope you are satisfied, {name}. If you will excuse me, I will take my leave."

dd15992c-2090-40d5-aa27-97cb5a08dc38.Text: {n}Cassia looks away, and you feel a lump rise in your throat.{/n} "I... will take your comment into consideration."

b0bd3e3b-abbb-478c-b4fe-cf5628bd56f3.Text: {n}She sighs.{/n} "{name}, although I find your request entirely inappropriate and am baffled by your current conduct, the truth is... I have never painted anyone before. If you insist on my company, I will paint something of my own choosing, but I will not paint you."

aca98561-336c-439e-9db8-cb8580b79f9c.Text: {n}Cassia picks up her brush. Although the two of you spend the next half hour engaged in small talk, she never once looks up from her canvas.{/n}

8920f754-3950-4a1f-9535-1dbcc4ec2381.Text: {n}Kibellah silently appears by your side.{/n} "You asked to see me, Domin'{name}? Do you wish to learn more of the cult's rites? Very well. Since you are in the water, I can introduce you to a rare discipline of the Bloodspun Web known as controlled self-drowning. Few receive this honour, with water being so precious on a ship. Still, it has opened my eyes to many truths."

dc734479-2922-4591-a899-048179c741cb.Text: {n}Kibellah nods respectfully.{/n} "If that is all, I will return to my rituals."

925b1178-4375-475f-b757-e2adf2f25764.Text: "Every step we take is dangerous, yet still we choose to walk. If done correctly, the ritual is simple and will cause you little pain."

63c201bf-b0c1-4cac-ab04-99adc4814ef9.Text: "Close your eyes and trust me. Reject your fear and remember — you have carried death within you since birth. This ritual is simply a meeting between you and your oldest friend."

3b3a9057-fded-4fe4-a8f6-79f076c00cd4.Text: {n}You close your eyes and hear a quiet splash — Kibellah has entered the pool. She puts her hands around your neck and gently pushes you under the water. As your lungs start to burn, she pulls you back to the surface, allowing you to take a single breath of air before she begins to drown you again. This process repeats several times, and she holds you beneath the surface a little longer with each plunge. The fourth descent lasts an eternity — but her hands prevent you from resurfacing.{/n}

833b6980-3f96-4e25-9c9f-dbeba1d34728.Text: {n}As your empty lungs burn, you start to panic. You fight against your fear as the darkness swallows you, and soon it gives way to peace. As you listen to the soft whisper of the water around you, you realise that death is the end and the beginning. There are no worries here... and no mistakes. There is only you. You... and the infinite Nothing.{/n}

1426abfa-ab90-4477-bc26-0a57ab6ba0b1.Text: {n}Just as Nothing is about to claim you, you are gently lifted from the emptiness of oblivion.{/n} "Domin'{name}, you have been touched by death. What was it like?"

5a24e508-5cac-4399-bfac-92371e4f1e79.Text: "You have not yet mastered this discipline. But do not fear. When the Undying One stretches out His hand to you, the inevitability of death will become a gift."

bf116f6d-f463-4e1d-8f15-47574e3cbd5a.Text: "Now you understand the Tenets of the Web more fully. I will leave you to reflect on this experience."

f804cb41-0980-4275-acc5-9ef7023ce42a.Text: "The Tenets of the Web teach us to remember the importance of death, for it is the greatest of all His servant's deeds. One day, you will understand. For now... rest."

c06a1aa8-dd9a-464c-bd04-2c10858b219f.Text: {n}Abelard claps his hands together in a business-like manner, and there's an ominous glint in his unaugmented eye.{/n} "Lord Captain, what a fortunate rarity to find you at leisure! Since you have nothing else to occupy your time, I will give you a lecture on the history of House von Valancius. I would not be doing my duty if I did not start from the beginning... "

02014255-308b-43d1-86f9-29ca615c6f70.Text: {n}Idira takes a draw from her hookah. She playfully blows a few smoke rings as she lounges lazily nearby.{/n} "This is nice! Five of my cabins could fit in here, and don't get me started on that rusty nook I call a shower. But I'm pretty sure you didn't call me in here just so I'd die of envy, did you?"

17fbb11b-1997-469e-bccd-b5b465126e17.Text: "Just a mix of {g|Encyclopedia:Lho}lho{/g} and obscura. Got a kick to it — not enough to knock you out, but just enough to help you relax and distract yourself from... your worries."

110457e0-7266-4e14-83c6-a48db4b3910b.Text: "Of course, Lord Captain." {n}Idira gives you a sly grin as she blows a thick cloud of smoke in your direction.{/n}

163a2fd3-7ca3-4a1e-adba-a925914ed91c.Text: "What's the difference between a warp storm and a dispute at the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusAdministratumGlossary}Adeptus Administratum{/g}?"

ad71496f-1273-4273-9585-f3ba6e1aaba6.Text: {n}Idira gets up reluctantly.{/n} "Have a nice soak, Lord Captain!"

87ce2873-0253-4f42-901b-7ecc8d600fc3.Text: {n}Grey serpents of caustic smoke slither into your nostrils until reality becomes a blur. Your thoughts grow slow and sluggish, merging together into a bizarre kaleidoscope of mental imagery.{/n}

37b8e049-2e03-4a5a-99c6-0437f5ccf67a.Text: {n}After a while, the haze dissipates and the images arrange themselves into the shape of Idira's face. She is watching you curiously.{/n} "Can you hear me, Lord Captain? Are you all right?"

0a621101-f29f-47c1-be0a-3bf44fcb91de.Text: "Wait 'til the crash gets you. Still, you're one tough nutribar — I've watched seasoned voidsmen struggle to say two words after just a couple of drags, but here you are, clear-eyed and talking sense."

64461159-35af-4122-92cb-dbb818c4e4cf.Text: {n}The blob can understand you! It laughs in response, and its tentacles tickle the air so energetically that the space around it starts laughing too.{/n}

022c12fc-411b-4898-b15b-e68245cac4d7.Text: {n}The blob wiggles and shakes as it yelps out your orders. Its muffled voice sounds as though it is coming to you from underwater.{/n} "Board cabin! Board cabin!"

0a67b925-08fe-41f1-9acc-b00d51e10835.Text: {n}The blob mumbles something in a concerned tone and makes a loud clicking noise as it waves a tentacle at you. It must be frightened by the power of your gaze.{/n}

9997e8f6-e003-4f8b-b9a9-634ac87ef9a0.Text: {n}After a while, the blob rearranges itself into the shape of Idira. She is snapping her fingers in front of your face and howling with laughter.{/n} "Lord Captain! Lord Captain, can you hear me? That was some ride, huh? You just take it easy, it'll pass soon. How are you feeling? Still among the living?"

fa2e8fe6-89aa-4e73-b06c-f2f72c0e6222.Text: "{name}, are you conditioning your body with water treatments? How commendable! Allow me to share some of the water exercises I learned at the {g|Encyclopedia:ScholaProgenium}Schola Progenium{/g}!" {n}Argenta does not wait for a reply, but immediately launches into a series of detailed instructions.{/n}

15b13d80-73b2-46ed-a51d-79796b5fca99.Text: {n}Argenta briskly explains how to stretch your muscles correctly. She makes you repeat each exercise multiple times as she teaches you the best way to do bends and squats. Her eyes are alight with righteous fire and her voice rings out with conviction — she shows the same dedication to completing each exercise as she does to destroying heretics.{/n}

a26ad9c0-ef77-4ff1-9291-8e6315e2fd03.Text: "Would you like me to go over any of the exercises again?"

9bcc6fd2-2327-4e03-9a87-d68e4ac312bd.Text: {n}Argenta's enthusiastic zeal is so contagious, you cannot help but follow the sister's lead as she demonstrates each exercise.{/n}

70863d82-1d98-402d-8237-361887ba1d4b.Text: {n}Argenta wipes the sweat from her brow with an air of satisfaction.{/n} "Good work, {name}! A healthy body is like a finely-tuned bolter — a worthy instrument of His will. I will take my leave now. Rest, and recover your strength."

4bac9c8c-5d52-4982-bb00-53fe7e4dd9dc.Text: "{name}, is this a matter of terrible urgency, or..." {n}An exasperated expression crosses Heinrix's face when he sees you relaxing in the water.{/n} "...or did you simply call me here for your own amusement? On second thought, don't answer. I think I have assessed the situation for myself."

e6ca29ac-54ac-4ec9-bcf5-d0d317e6c0df.Text: "I suppose you desire entertainment. Very well. I will give you something to occupy your time — a simple game of intellect that is often played in our conclave. I will give you a fact about my life, and you will have to discern whether it is a truth or a lie. Shall we begin? I betrayed my family and caused the death of innocent people, and I was never held accountable for my actions."

0e398576-dffd-4e47-aaf2-4c0d135e2649.Text: {n}The corners of Heinrix's mouth twitch slightly, his hands are tense, and his breathing has quickened. The Interrogator's behaviour suggests that he is lying.{/n}

db9c59d8-df62-4f44-83d3-241f3c6ce6bf.Text: {n}You cannot read anything in the Interrogator's impassive face.{/n}

58295ef9-6fdc-48f3-96c1-6f728efa37f5.Text: {n}Heinrix chuckles dryly.{/n} "Truth. And a lie at the same time. Yes, the description is factually accurate, yet context lends a different... flavour to the events."

e15693ae-0bca-46d8-b33d-c923457b7664.Text: {n}Heinrix is an experienced Interrogator and a biomancer. This is just a trick... He is too skilled to give himself away through body language. The real trap lies in the way he phrased the rules — he wants you to think that only two answers exist, but what if there's a third option? What if his statement is both true and false?{/n}

119c3e98-e370-4869-b7f0-9cc960f8eebb.Text: {n}You do not know of any facts that would either confirm or disprove Heinrix's assertion.{/n}

a87c9503-9a69-491e-bed8-fe1deac31158.Text: {n}Heinrix chuckles dryly.{/n} "Did you come to that conclusion because I feigned certain behavioural 'tells'? Well, I did not lie, but I did not tell the whole truth either."

d3376900-843f-446b-800f-36217138ae23.Text: "I once belonged to a house of {g|Encyclopedia:ImperialKnight}Imperial Knight{/g} pilots. My younger sisters wanted a coat of arms like the ones that adorned the hulls of our mighty machines. So one day, I stole a cutter, and used it to remove a coat of arms from my uncle's Knight."

8d7c0e9d-5114-4f6c-b1f1-1bfe5b8ec928.Text: "I hope you have enjoyed our game together, {name}. But now I must return to my duties."

d4139e42-b987-4805-8a68-cbe8ac50cd2e.Text: "Shereen! I hear you are in need of entertainment! Well, do not worry. I have the perfect solution! I will show you how to combine the joys of drinking and the rigours of intellectual recreation into one incredible pastime!"

1d31d97d-c97e-43d1-a09a-11191c70d1cc.Text: "We will play a game of {g|Encyclopedia:Regicide}regicide{/g}... but instead of pieces, we will use shots of {g|Encyclopedia:Amasec}amasec{/g}. The rules are simple — when you capture an opponent's 'piece,' you have to take a shot. Ready? Let's play!"

18bbba25-f153-4755-bbcb-e8709645780d.Text: {n}Jae makes mistake after mistake, and you quickly gain the upper hand. As she surrenders her pieces left and right, you soon realise the hardest part of the game is keeping a clear head as you drink the shots for each claimed piece.{/n}

0c55f334-fbae-478e-8948-9142aa003404.Text: {n}Soon you can barely tell Jae's pieces from your own. It does not take long before the Cold Trader claims the victory.{/n}

07c8946e-60b7-470b-86aa-a41b79323d0b.Text: {n}You intentionally place your pieces in harm's way, hoping to trick your opponent into getting drunk and throwing the game. However, Jae appears to be employing the exact same strategy.{/n}

396e621d-68b3-42b1-b0d6-178067049f7e.Text: {n}The amasec makes it difficult to keep a clear head. You lose focus on the game, and it is not long before the Cold Trader claims victory.{/n}

c1868aec-6b01-4d4d-9572-b98374dae15b.Text: {n}Jae tries to distract you with conversation, but you notice her sneak several new "pieces" onto the board. You give her a charming smile and continue to make small talk as you switch some of them around, catching the {g|Encyclopedia:ColdTrade}Cold Trader{/g} in her own trap.{/n}

cf377c0d-5e77-4d31-b05c-98b4ceb07b24.Text: {n}You try to keep watch for Jae's tricks, but... Wait! Is this the third time you've taken this piece? Or are you seeing triple? And why is Jae clapping as though she has won?{/n}

fffecd23-927b-4b69-ba6e-a23d995976eb.Text: "I must admit my astonishment, shereen. This is the first time an opponent has ever bested me by relying solely on the strength of their liver! I would propose a rematch, however... I'm afraid they might accuse me of trying to drink the Rogue Trader to death. So with your permission, I think I'd better go get some air."

acb90f71-0dc0-4507-90da-65bcde3b3708.Text: "Hold on. Wait a minute... Is it... your turn? Or mine?" {n}Jae reaches for a "piece" and knocks it over, spilling the amasec all over the board.{/n} "Tell you what, you can have this one, shereen. If I have another drink, I think I'll fall right into this bathtub... And you don't want a corpse in your pool, do you? Anyway... What was I talking about? Oh, right. I think... I need to get some air."
