8420df39-ae21-4ce6-94c1-8aabfd948e6e.Text: "Are you all right, shereen? Here, have some water. Do not worry! I will gladly play another round with you later if you want to try and even the score. Right now though, you should get some rest. Oh... and for the love of the Exalted One, do not fall asleep in the bathtub."

2d121523-663e-4a1a-a1e0-e60988cad5b4.Text: "You have fine chambers, Aett-Vater. Now, what kind of saga do you wish to hear?"

cc2d5074-6368-4ffa-aa8b-899f9f93ef8f.Text: "Once, my brothers and I clashed with a throng of Orks. On the fifth day of the fray, Brother Harad skewered one of the meaty bastards with his chainsword — and his sword got stuck! The fight still raged on around him, so Harad just kept swinging his sword — and the impaled corpse along with it! And that is how he got his moniker, Harad Barbfang!"

47340055-8e78-4ac2-91a8-8bbf7b6d6f82.Text:
"Flies the green carrion
above a battlefield bloody.
'Tis the banner of Harad.
His glory displayed,
it sends his foes fleeing,
afraid of becoming
Barbfang's new standard."

8417e896-7aed-4eae-b365-5ca66091eb1a.Text: "I have seen my brothers accomplish many fine deeds, but I will not tell stories of them today. Instead, I will honour the valour of a mortal Guardsmaiden named Soria. When all of her comrades had fled or fallen, she alone stood and fought with us against the unholy scourge. She died with honour — a laspistol in one hand, and a torn banner in the other."

787ff69e-6db8-4e16-8794-7ae7b3a314c1.Text:
"Fragile is the human form
that stands with the Astartes.
Yet those with heart aflame
a hero's honoured place will claim
beside the Allfather's children."

1b8fd2ee-5bf7-4c82-8015-4d10efd1feaa.Text: "Once, when I was young, a foul sorcerer bewitched me in battle. It made me see my own brothers as warp spawn, and I attacked them. Good was my fortune that our leader made short work of the scum before I could harm any of my brothers. And great was my horror when I realised what I had nearly done."

be8c1115-ec9a-410c-944a-38aaff4abe92.Text:
"Foams the mouth
of the spellbound runt,
biting the flesh
of prey misperceived.
The sorcerous grief will forever remember
the pup, scarred by brotherly blood
all but spilt."

010100ac-ce95-4a0b-98ce-760e8a92ec76.Text: {n}Your clever ploy eventually succeeds, and you watch as Jae's eyelids start to droop.{/n}

28da5113-ee7f-466a-95ad-a5a390f4dbdb.Text: {n}Abelard is naive to think that you could fall into his trap. The name of the dynasty's founder has been forgotten over the millennia of its history. As if {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_MOT_Mind}you{/d} could be stumped by something so trivial.{/n}

8e5f7cb5-7e7d-4419-9212-8bc367e5f1b2.Text: {n}Abelard's brow rises sharply.{/n} "I am exceedingly curious, Lord Captain. Please, do tell."

401eaf7d-eda9-49cb-acb7-8fe8b10a002a.Text: {n}Your lecture goes on for hours. You make sure not to omit even the most insignificant details, complementing your educational talk with fascinating historical anecdotes, an extensive analysis of your family tree, and precise descriptions of daily life on the worlds of your ancestors. By the end of it all, you notice Abelard beginning to doze off.{/n}

1cdcc683-b17c-4a68-ab8a-46bc137ec1e0.Text: {n}Sensing a pause in the lecture, Abelard shakes himself awake.{/n} "Hmm? I beg your pardon, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I was... lost in thought. A thoroughly captivating subject, yes. Well, I see that you are indeed remarkably versed in history, and therefore my presence is not required at the moment!" {n}He hurriedly backs his way toward the exit.{/n}

a7e5824b-0921-449a-b3af-2b1bb26d4e90.Text: {n}You notice that the enforcers guarding you are tense and fearfully averting their gaze. Bran's nose is broken, and his right leg is in obvious pain. Meanwhile, Neema {d|Encyclopedia:ToldAboutEnforcerBath}winces{/d} as she adjusts her sling.{/n}

c7968c10-99aa-4b57-b9ab-b5efe83c842b.Text: "This unit is grateful for the invitation. It will exit the receptacle upon completion of the cleaning protocol."

55f11e02-8989-4714-85ea-e29d04f90f34.Text: {n}Yrliet looks at you curiously, though you see doubt in her eyes.{/n} "I do not know how much you truly understand of what I have told you. Still, if your soul seeks harmony..." {n}She closes her eyes and begins to hum a peculiar melody. It follows a strange, unpredictable rhythm as though she is drawing intricate patterns with her voice.{/n}

34831a31-12fd-4b7a-b2d9-83a3fb80ad0d.Text: "So, 'unwind' is not a code word, and you are not in any danger?" {n}Solomorne looks around the bathchamber in faint bewilderment.{/n} "So you truly want to know how Arbitrators spend their time off duty... Well, why not? I suggest a little shooting contest — we'll use empty bottles as targets."

ddb41e1f-195c-45e8-8a0b-31f2591112d3.Text: {n}The target explodes, showering the floor with broken glass.{/n}

7b31ebc9-0577-42e5-b376-6aa25e2fb4a7.Text: "I am afraid Mistress Heydari has {d|Encyclopedia:JaeGuysDead}refused{/d}... in no uncertain terms. Is there anyone else I can summon for Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}?"

11d4c5e2-db13-4b80-9cc0-2f6d8bb9bd50.Text: {n}You fire — the bottle remains unscathed, and the wall is now adorned with evidence of your miss.{/n}

acf822ab-fa94-401c-99d5-54aa0a003b0b.Text: {n}Solomorne makes a gesture toward the target, and Glaito makes a lightning-fast leap. The bottle shatters in the cyber-mastiff's powerful jaws.{/n}

9b5fe558-c0da-4cda-9c46-03df5fcdc22c.Text: {n}The Proctor raises his weapon, and the bottle shatters.{/n}

d1cddab8-6aae-4ede-9229-9a1b98176c2a.Text: "For hundreds of years, our clan has been responsible for ensuring the Rogue Trader's safety during times of leisure and relaxation." {n}The enforcer's voice is filled with pride.{/n} "I guard the bathchamber, just as my grandmother did before me. She trained me herself and instructed me in my duties."

29f778e0-84c3-4832-bc4f-0a38bbea7050.Text: {n}You inhale the hot, humid air and your head spins for a moment. The barrel of your weapon tilts sideways — and the enforcer loses a decent chunk of an ear.{/n}

4c21cfdf-239d-4c90-af3d-1a0e4dede887.Text: "When we're off-duty, we train, maintain our equipment, and pray at regulation-approved intervals."

d79baa15-1ffa-4c4f-a18c-b3e9753355ee.Text: "Why not? Visibility in combat is usually far from ideal." {n}The Proctor closes his eyes and waits for his turn to shoot.{/n}

331babe0-8440-49ca-a7f2-3aef65cebf88.Text: "You like it when the odds are stacked against you? Admirable. I accept the challenge."

969a40d2-ac28-4377-917b-bc17564c75bf.Text: {n}The enforcers hasten to carry out your order, and within seconds are setting out the bottles that will serve as your targets and deferentially placing a firearm into your waiting hand.{/n}

f76b8629-cd19-47c5-8088-0db514afa9d4.Text: {n}The enforcers praise your strength of spirit, and their unanimous denunciations of idleness echo throughout the gilded bathchamber.{/n}

9290fdd8-be98-4af9-9afe-e935efb7ba4b.Text: "Let's keep it simple — three rounds, three shots. Whoever is the better shot wins. You go first."

282b210e-5fe4-49a4-98b7-d44a26edd0e7.Text: "Fun? Not at all. Downtime between missions is for honing one's combat skills."

e3334cce-ba01-4f4a-855c-67fb268348af.Text: "You think so? Glaito is my weapon, which means I can use him." {n}Solomorne's face is expressionless, but his voice sounds slightly smug.{/n}

dcbead23-cadf-4202-93b2-52238c85461b.Text: {n}The enforcer looks slightly flustered, but he quickly gets to work. After a little while, he presents you with a bust of the {g|Encyclopedia:EmperorGlossary}Emperor{/g} about half the size of your palm. The Emperor's visage has been recreated with incredible precision and attention to detail — the small carving surpasses the work of many a skilled sculptor.{/n}

d9b76a5d-5eab-4254-b151-b8c0e06aa80e.Text: {n}Solomorne drains his glass in turn.{/n} "Not a bad idea — it will simulate a mild concussion and bring us closer to combat conditions."

9919be3f-0d4d-4083-9ae1-de08fcb033a2.Text: "Thank you, Rogue Trader. I'll make sure to keep the empty bottle afterward — in case you want to have another shooting contest."

6cd1582a-2173-4bff-a04e-6a1e301ec1ba.Text: "This is beginning to feel more like a gambling competition than a training session — but, very well, proceed."

2516439f-2780-4b61-a51b-bb392bdb7209.Text: "We'll do it this way: if it's a draw after two rounds, if you land the third shot, the victory is yours. In Calixis we called this the attacker's advantage — a good way of teaching Arbitrators that if you get the chance to shoot first, you must hit the target."

b4fd5649-1b68-4b6d-962a-951140d64a99.Text: {n}The shot lands exactly on target, and the enforcers applaud discreetly.{/n}

e372def7-67ba-4ca5-b491-3ada23cb1d11.Text: {n}The steadiness of your hand fails you, and the shot goes wide.{/n}

60dca74d-6eb1-4806-9436-c434015de66e.Text: "A glittering victory, Rogue Trader. It has been my honour to compete with you."

d5872d23-637c-4a09-8fc7-f9fb2cb3411a.Text: {n}Yrliet stops after a few moments.{/n} "Elantach, the purpose of Symphonic Creation is unity. If I try to weave the images alone, the tapestry's threads will come apart."

f6ca056a-c589-48a9-8d77-8cc697f8b737.Text: {n}The target shatters. Your guards immediately roar in delight, and Solomorne bows his head respectfully.{/n}

74f4cdb9-c634-4582-9eea-dba63d4cbe06.Text: {n}The shot leaves a charred stain on your priceless tiles.{/n}

53ee855a-6366-4ec3-8c86-5e1aa27088d6.Text: {n}Before the thunder of your shot subsides, Solomorne is already pulling the trigger and hitting the glass target with ease.{/n}

9dabc4ab-7d65-4f8f-84de-407697e0bcf4.Text: "As you will. Glaito and I will return to patrolling the upper decks."

3bf65962-b9bc-475b-883b-b23b87cfd97f.Text: "This bathchamber can be more dangerous than a battlefield sometimes! You can slip on a wet tile, you can choke and drown... If the water is too hot, you can burn yourself, and if it's too cold, you can freeze... There have even been cases where angry machine spirits have released sparks of their fury in the water. And of course, there have been numerous assassination attempts and—"

823050a9-96f2-40eb-be08-976aca53f284.Text: {n}You begin to sing, guided by your own emotion more than any specific rhythm or motif. Every now and then, Yrliet changes the flow of the melody, encouraging you to add something new to the song. A warm feeling settles over you like a gentle embrace, and Yrliet's expression softens.{/n}

25b0dd56-abf8-4e62-a15e-1b0a57c39178.Text: "I am afraid the xenos has chosen to {d|Encyclopedia:CompYrlietNoTrust}ignore{/d} your invitation. Is there anyone else I can summon for Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}?"

529c749e-f5d0-4847-9ce7-8704ca7e9b1d.Text: {n}The enforcer's eager expression wilts a little.{/n} "Just so, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

329d6225-a734-4449-a8ee-62ee1484e915.Text: {n}The enforcer carefully takes back the soap sculpture.{/n} "Thank you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

4900bc8a-3b27-4264-9e5a-dc06743d3bd1.Text: {n}The enforcer is speechless with amazement. His eyes shine with pride.{/n} "I am not worthy of such an honour! Thank you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

69a24def-26fc-4518-ac96-c0b04b0d7e49.Text: {n}The tension slowly retreats as you bring yourself to complete stillness. Joint by joint, muscle by muscle, pore by pore — before long, you have surrendered the bastion of your body to the bliss of oblivion.{/n}

a18ee54b-8422-434d-820c-e9d94c8238bb.Text: "We created an unusual tapestry together, elantach. It is unlike any I have woven with my kin. You lack experience, but you understand the purpose of the weave, and in our brief melody, I found peace." {n}Yrliet sounds almost surprised, and she falls silent for a moment.{/n} "I must leave now. May you find rest in body and spirit."

e3f4e1d8-9f62-4af7-8d50-b185e8f2832f.Text: "At least there's a chance a warp storm might end."

6e2b57b1-a0ee-4088-ae68-7a3226bccb60.Text: "What do you call an unsanctioned {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerGlossary}psyker{/g}'s cabin?"

13820faa-87c8-4ede-8e58-7d4edc9e4d56.Text: {n}The woman stops abruptly as the other enforcer loudly clears his throat.{/n}

de16aa47-194e-4b9e-9870-469b835ba69f.Text: "How many {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priests{/g} does it take to change a {g|Encyclopedia:Lumen}lumen{/g}?"

7c8d21ef-26e0-41d0-96a7-a2551bf0ec54.Text: "Three. One to wave a censer, one to pray to the {g|Encyclopedia:OmnissiahGlossary}Omnissiah{/g}, and the third to {g|Encyclopedia:Servitor}servitorise{/g} a serf to do all the work for them."

8c51b796-7ef5-4a62-9338-2551a93929f1.Text: {n}A colourful blob floats in front of you. It has a large bottle where its belly should be, and moves its tentacles around in a comical manner as it tries to speak.{/n} "Board cabin? Star crew ignite?"

ebefba67-c50b-4655-8e0a-bd6045965b2d.Text: "This is how I see your ship. The emotions of the crew, the void beyond the stained glass, the bustle and noise of the bridge, and... my own experiences here." {n}The canvas is a whirlwind of different colours. The colours give form to a variety of abstract images and shapes. Bright and dark paints contrast with one another in intricate patterns and designs. It would take a great deal of imagination to identify anything in this painting that would remotely resemble a ship.{/n}

a05f1541-d2a4-4528-98e5-c7742c7ce6bb.Text: "This painting... It may not be what you had in mind. Still, this is how I see you and your colours." {n}The canvas is a whirlwind of brightly coloured paints. The outline of a human figure is suggested through broad, colourful strokes and fluid shapes. You would be hard-pressed to call it a portrait — but the series of abstract images and impressions do vaguely resemble your form.{/n}

ca53ed95-8fe7-471b-a4f7-fb927afcbf07.Text: {n}The sister is tireless. It is a challenge to keep up with her unrelenting pace, but you refuse to accept defeat. Your muscles are starting to ache by the time you finish the exercises, but your body feels invigorated.{/n}

ee0be45d-ed46-44a3-baf2-a675300b4040.Text: {n}The world slows, and time itself goes still as this moment of repose stretches into an eternity.{/n}

5db4f3a1-4730-4ebb-a3e7-9bd9b518df9a.Text: {n}This moment of serenity soon fades. The body reclaims the mind, binding it once more to the familiar shell of flesh, sinew, and bone.{/n}

6a5abe39-37f3-424b-8edb-f4e743e73f32.Text: {n}The sister is tireless. But you do not have her stamina. Your burning muscles beg for mercy and your legs cramp as you gasp for air. This is not exercise. This is torture.{/n}

0d1a3116-3efc-47cf-b9cb-665fdc518d78.Text: "Then why have you summoned me? I thought you wished to know how the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptaSororitasGlossary}Adepta Sororitas{/g} take their leisure."

87f345ad-90dd-41fe-80e4-98b25fa2cb2c.Text: "In combat, my heart finds joy in the battle hymns of my sisters and in the death cries of the unrighteous. When I have a rare moment to rest, I cherish the first rays of dawn and the smell of dew on the ground in places where such things can be found."

5b0c5fb4-8fd4-49ee-a068-6211badb101a.Text: "Lady Cassia has requested me to inform you that she is {d|Encyclopedia:CompCassiaNoTrust}disinclined{/d} to spend any more time in your company than is necessary. Is there anyone else I can summon for Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}?"

df71cd5b-664b-49bb-88b8-8181b2584d3c.Text: "I normally save it for the battlefield... but there is never a bad moment to praise the Emperor if we sing with sincerity in our hearts!"

a503756a-b414-4d73-9063-8b785e4b17ff.Text: {n}The sister's voice is clear and passionate. Her face glows with zealous exultation. Her words call to you, compelling you to follow her through enemy hordes and across minefields, smiting down any who would oppose His glory. By the time the hymn is finished, you feel alight with glorious purpose, as though you and Argenta have been fighting side by side this whole time.{/n}

c371a3bf-39f0-48f0-975c-6f27192bfaa9.Text: "I hope your heart is filled with righteous fire, {name}. We should sing this hymn again when we fight the enemies of Humanity together!"

e5e743e1-8136-4f0b-95f1-215f048d1d2e.Text: "It is not a waste of my time or ability, Lord Captain. In fact, I would consider it an honour to increase your knowledge of your dynasty's history."

73906ac2-fe56-4bb1-b8c7-6c72df119b4a.Text: "You are the new head of this dynasty. It is unacceptable for a Rogue Trader to be ignorant of their origins."

a795da91-fc3f-4891-b0c3-9824be614c25.Text: "I am afraid you will not have much time to spare from your duties. Lady Theodora made a similar promise, and I made the mistake of believing her — we never had the chance to speak on the matter again. We should make the most of this opportunity."

df5f4560-0dae-4f1e-9933-0f564821bbfc.Text: "Indeed? Well, in that case, it should not be difficult for you to name the dynasty's founder."

c67366fe-cc1b-457c-b10b-64a8c7d20dea.Text: "I wish you a pleasant bath, Lord Captain." {n}Cassia drops into an awkward curtsy.{/n}

49baa4bc-316b-4098-b77a-4b3ff8cd13a1.Text: "You should not have called upon me for the sake of your own idle amusements, elantach. The Children of {g|Encyclopedia:AsuryaniGlossary}Asuryan{/g} delight in unity — both with the universe and their kin. One of the ways in which we achieve this unity is Symphonic Creation."

db5def6b-ef34-4b84-be0a-2fa34020ed1c.Text: {n}Abelard clears his throat and looks smug.{/n} "As I was saying, we shall begin with the origins of your noble lineage..."

e8938379-f311-4e82-997f-9b7285e8a6d1.Text: {n}Evidently your knowledge of the dynasty's history is not as extensive as you thought.{/n}

ea8e726f-ddf0-4f5f-bf8f-8ad7d47ff8b8.Text: {n}Abelard raises an eyebrow.{/n} "You... just made that up, didn't you?"

d24c1917-4c23-4943-8106-f88e3f48c266.Text: {n}Abelard lets out a pained sigh.{/n} "I suppose it is a good thing you said that to me and not to someone else. A claim like that could be interpreted as heresy."

38dfa2c5-6c92-4bbd-9a78-1bce9f7fe256.Text: "The correct answer is that we do not know their name, for it has faded from the annals of history. This dynasty's legacy reaches back thousands of years. It seems I have my work cut out for me — I must try to rectify these regrettable gaps in your knowledge of the dynasty's history."

8ae03c45-a6b9-4bcc-9902-407a2100a27a.Text: "You are correct. Well, Lord Captain, you have convinced me... However, I would implore you to seek my assistance should you ever wish to refresh your memory. If you will permit me, I will return to my post, Lord Captain."

7f693a95-1061-4e90-9b9d-69b2e03759e6.Text: {n}You put on such a convincing show of having a headache that even Abelard's keen gaze is fooled by your deception.{/n}

fe0acac3-57c8-44c3-8146-875729fad7f3.Text: {n}After a few minutes of your theatrical sighing, Abelard interrupts you with a small cough.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I do not believe you."

201cb79b-4e80-4fca-93b8-49446e44ae71.Text: "I can see that Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} requires rest. I will not disturb you any further."

72846989-8ee0-4cc7-b765-4bbab9037322.Text: {n}Abelard's moustache twitches as he purses his lips in evident satisfaction.{/n} "That is enough for today, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Permit me to leave you while you contemplate what you've learned."

bd83c5ec-0f4d-473e-b14d-817bb060574b.Text: {n}Marazhai does not look pleased by your summons. He smiles ominously.{/n} "I have been told that you seek entertainment, {name}. Well, since you demand my time... I have a few ideas for you. How does bloodletting sound? I will not drain you completely, I promise."

066b852d-0e20-4d07-99c3-2327c1722a9b.Text: "Ah, so you crave something more sophisticated? What about becoming more closely acquainted with this... 'conductive charge' of yours?" {n}The Drukhari hooks a claw around a lamp cord.{/n}

2c4f7e9c-fd2b-4880-a086-066225f951a8.Text: {n}Marazhai's mocking eyes narrow into slits.{/n} "You wanted entertainment, so you called me. What else did you expect? On second thought, save your answer — I do not care. I will now return to what I was doing before I was so rudely interrupted."

8da46c4d-a3ed-4a21-8d8c-7682f4eb314a.Text: {n}The xenos sneers.{/n} "Oh, yes. This will be very entertaining indeed."

04afcd63-77dc-4214-a5d2-05f04a004b52.Text: {n}After half an hour of torture, your body is bloody and mutilated. Your mind shudders at the thought of any further suffering. Nevertheless, you remain silent in the face of Marazhai's mistreatment, and endure the horrible pain without making a sound.{/n}

01843a5b-0fe2-4d93-a288-575df5ffd89a.Text: {n}You are exhausted. Your body is spent and your mind is fractured. The xenos ignores your frantic screams as he finishes his horrific experiment. The pain drives all the thoughts from your head except one — you need a chirurgeon... and you need one now.{/n}

15e4dcc8-3eaa-49f4-a160-4648c85c29cb.Text: {n}Marazhai pushes back a strand of hair from his face, and his lips curl into a cruel smile.{/n} "Well, {name}. I have had my fill of fun. Lick your wounds well before summoning me again."

07e85d56-ff89-4f06-87c6-2bbfccfc9dbc.Text: "When an Asuryani wishes to rest and spend time with their closest kin, we weave images with our voices. Each of us adds something of our own, until the melody becomes a harmonious tapestry woven from different sounds."

a76f16ee-b006-4196-a6c3-27bfbc234540.Text: "There was a scandal the next morning. Someone had defaced a sacred machine inside our residence! I was soon discovered, and my uncle — kind as always — named me a traitor to the family and demanded my execution. In the end, however, I was merely reprimanded, and the guards in charge of watching the Knight were executed instead."

a0da1b65-aaa8-416f-b067-4cede47c7f01.Text: {n}An oily patch spreads slowly outward from the {g|Encyclopedia:Magos}Magos{/g}. The smell of lubricant fills the bathchamber.{/n} "This receptacle is deemed adequate for the execution of the cleaning protocol."

df2e6a12-78bf-4748-8f62-b6730ca195aa.Text: "I have received an invitation to perform collective ablutions. Ablutions are impossible to perform without submerging into the bathing receptacle."

2fb92376-feac-423e-9422-ebe64710768b.Text: "This statement is true. The disposal of waste substances is an integral part of the cleaning protocol."

179d8bdd-f34a-4180-b866-362f987e3a91.Text: "It is prohibited to expose the {g|Encyclopedia:AugmentationGlossary}True Flesh{/g} in the presence of laypeople. My raiment will not hinder the cleaning protocol."

5eea8ad9-b2de-4eba-9d20-4c076e023960.Text: "No. The {g|Encyclopedia:OmnissiahGlossary}Omnissiah{/g} has granted the sacred chromium resistance to the plague of rust."

a19ce2b5-18dd-4295-b31d-094782dceb7f.Text: "Negative. This unit is yet to complete the cleaning protocol, therefore it cannot exit the receptacle."

2fb56a07-d8c2-49db-a1d8-e333ba969742.Text: "The procedure will take one standard ship hour."

088e0638-5d20-4a47-83ee-703751767d60.Text: "Your presence is not required for the completion of the protocol."

309f6165-a6c8-4d80-8966-7a9a195ab632.Text: "This statement is false. Allow me to rephrase. If you do not intend to perform the cleaning protocol with me, I can finish it by myself."

8ef97057-0a33-458d-a16b-3edf018cb476.Text: "I am afraid Mistress Tlass has {d|Encyclopedia:CompIdira_NoTrust}refused{/d}. Or at least, I think she was speaking to me... Is there anyone else I can summon for Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}?"

38774055-f65a-48f8-b840-b1c218a4cd5c.Text: "I thank you for the invitation, {name}. This ablution will be recorded in this unit's archive of significant events."

e3951165-6837-460b-99af-1b6ebc1028ba.Text: "This interpretation of the protocol is unconventional, but otherwise unobjectionable. I regret that you will not be present to witness the conclusion of the protocol. Initiating exit ritual."

885c79d1-d6b8-456a-a46d-319c59ebfb11.Text: {n}You are alone once more. The Master of Ablutions stands by at the ready, patiently awaiting your command.{/n}

d4a3323a-6932-4307-a1ab-9941d42754a3.Text: {n}Cassia picks up her brush. The two of you spend the next half hour engaged in small talk, and her awkwardness soon gives way to an intense focus as she becomes immersed in her art.{/n}

32eafebb-438c-4d85-af36-811ba77a3039.Text: "Then perhaps you should seek out more 'refined' entertainment from one of the other members of your retinue."

09dcde73-cc43-4b09-b370-f7ab61092896.Text: "If we do have some time to ourselves, we might play some tan-to-lo. And Bran over here carves things out of soap scraps." {n}She nods at her partner.{/n} "Though for the most part, we barely get enough time for rest, let alone for leisure."

c14f4dfe-d397-4163-9bdd-6d7c07c2f541.Text: "Help! Danger! Someone's tried to kill the Rogue Trader! {mf|He|She}'s covered in blood!"

42ddfedd-140e-403d-8499-7e74ca0a5101.Text: "Get a chirurgeon in here now! Evacuate the Rogue Trader and secure the area!"

657d1bf8-0025-467e-98e8-0c9d6efe5ed8.Text: You feel thoroughly refreshed and ready to take on new challenges.

4fd72983-8569-44eb-9de6-f6a55da377fe.Text: A painting by Lady Cassia. If you look at it closely from different angles and use your imagination, you might just be able to detect a resemblance to your ship... And if not, you can always nod your head wisely, and pretend to understand what the artist is trying to convey.

3369ddbd-ad38-49bc-bcc3-b7326d084778.Text: Lady Cassia's artistic interpretation of your naked form. You could spend hours trying to figure out which specific part of the painting is supposed to be your face or your leg — or if they are even depicted in it at all.

a3b2004a-0537-47b0-a46e-e8b1df9c1b46.Text: Nude Portrait of the Rogue Trader

eb12400b-c3ed-4347-ab64-0a5e74733133.Text: "You have satisfied my wants to the full."

f770146c-c827-454f-8eff-6edeb4bfa665.Text: "The next time you wield your weapon, remember this night."

64a2dcb4-c7c6-4f96-b645-881dce202a2a.Text: "I hope this will have no effect on your diligence in performing your duties. Any intimacy shared between us confers no special privileges."

4e69d032-8232-4926-8670-1bb4ea8b982a.Text: "Perhaps we shall do this again sometime."

d9b287ac-7904-4946-b0fa-34f9e208a26c.Text: {n}Sauerback lovingly strokes the stiff cord that is usually braided around the hilt of her weapon. It still retains the heat of her passion-charged flesh. She raises her eyes, full of dark satisfaction, to you. It is an exceptionally rare sight: the Master-at-Arms, utterly relaxed and content.{/n} "Lord Captain... Have I obeyed your orders well enough?"

7661f77a-911e-4050-887e-ef93fd325ce0.Text: "Yes, Lord Captain!" {n}Reaching for her clothes, she bites her lip and casts a lust-filled glance at you.{/n}

385ea448-f71e-4b12-9b48-d936de8a1057.Text: {n}Sauerback winds the cord around her finger with a wolfish grin.{/n} "I shall. Often and with great pleasure."

2fc4bd6d-2981-4b90-82fe-df1b16122e1a.Text: "I am certain I can impress you still further. If you also wish it..."

d838f7d8-660f-4be0-9119-e32d42f178bf.Text: "Of course," {n}she says in a tone of surprise, sounding somewhat affronted.{/n} "In fact, I request that you show me no favour as a consequence of this encounter. This evening has itself been a privilege. I need no others."

39068fcc-70d7-4abc-9e44-5bc574659e12.Text: "If it pleases the Lord Captain, next time I will bring along a few things from the interrogation room. You will most certainly find a use for them."

342510ab-9b5d-4369-a856-8eac8e65296c.Text: The religious zealots have noted Kibellah's participation in the Magnae Accessio and have begun fervently exterminating the wicked in the Rogue Trader's domain.

cfc883e8-16a0-405c-935b-94d69e0b7ff3.Text: The demise of Heriokh's Rim Station has intimidated many pirates and made the trade routes safer.

60a9c40c-14d4-46c6-8f5d-634d81fb0112.Text: Fort Heriokh's Rim keeps vigil, protecting the capital world from enemies.

1b82f129-5a4d-4e7c-9491-bb5cf93109c3.Text: The ship's ramming prow is filled with indomitable fury from the bones of a martyr who fell upon a settlement of abominable xenos.

c9a308a0-6606-45b6-95bd-b796f917218e.Text: The words of Confessor Cecilia have enraptured the crew of the engines module, spurring them to work through sweat and blood.

9a936078-c5f9-4501-9524-b14218b5ec85.Text: The sacraments of Confessor Tercitius have blessed the crew with a vision of how they might rain unrelenting death down upon enemy vessels and seek out their vulnerabilities in the heat of battle.

082808c9-b1e6-4503-9c3d-4511d8b41b90.Text: The prayers of Confessor Arabella have roused the crew to purge any and all foes of the God-Emperor and service the weapons of His wrath with exemplary rigour.

1bb302e0-e576-427a-9f27-b48f0b481f42.Text: The sermons of Confessor Zirmen have inspired the crew to defend the vessel with all their might and devote greater efforts to serving the machine spirits that sustain its blessed shields.

9d603e49-1afb-4582-a9e2-cadeeb633f01.Text: Sparing no sweat or blood, the crew serves with uncanny rigour just so they might tell about their righteous toils at the shrine confessional later, knowing that lies will be met with punishment.

28701daa-9336-4ddd-b8f6-d28478308dc9.Text: Officer Hrotko, whom the Lord Captain tasked with espionage, has found an attractive opportunity. Two factoriums operate on the scantly developed world of Vergis II: one serving House Chorda and the other, House Winterscale. Despite the two Rogue Traders being enemies, the heads of their respective factoriums have made a truce and are jointly governing the unsophisticated but headstrong natives. Hrotko has worked his way into both leaders' trust and is confident that he can use a series of provocations to spark a war between the erstwhile allies. That would allow agents of House von Valancius to seize control of the world's resources and the promise of great wealth that they hold.

1d836f8a-b751-4933-ae62-adcf0f0dde04.Text: "An entire world serves only to satisfy the whims of nobles. The sheer pointlessness of it..."

2ff85a6e-3abc-443a-9beb-07819cbb4f4f.Text: "A place so lifeless... Contemplating it brings me indescribable calm. I will preserve its memory for my meditations."

23ba199a-2419-434c-9559-4a46065c7b69.Text: "So, they welcome death with open arms here, as they should. It still surprises me that most laypeople need to experience torment before they can see that true freedom lies not in life, but at its end."

221a91bf-c460-47ff-b1a4-5fc91bad9c97.Text: "Each of us is born with our death. It grows with us, and when the time comes, it displaces our life. The same is true for entire civilisations, for they too must one day fade beneath the weight of the ages."

4c486ff7-f9fb-444e-909f-7a221c5c906d.Text: "This white cover is like the frost that forms on the condensers. Can worlds made of nothing but cold truly exist?"

a1f57442-b9c6-499d-8c87-f5e57d42a849.Text: "It's... beautiful. There are ardent views in the void the likes of which I could never have imagined. A single vivid world bleeding flames, yet so much substance for my thoughts."

fdc28ce9-d0cb-4f33-8207-d61a6822357d.Text: "So, at some point in the past, this once living planet met a death proportional to its size."

5afa8ce3-77a6-4ca5-b827-9a09c8fafa3a.Text: [Gesture at Kibellah] "I am taking you away from here."

7b5db708-0d35-4334-9370-e573cfec5138.Text: "The Undying One is testing you, and what do you do? Show doubt and disgrace yourself!"

f2ecad2e-29d6-4f46-be0e-5368bc16bdf3.Text: [Kill all three of the Haemonculus's prisoners] "I am granting the Emperor's Peace to you all."

d2cb3fc7-9a23-440a-832b-b5388f91b291.Text: "I will not soil my hands with you, unholy spawn. I order you to kill each other."

03f5957b-d438-4c33-bec8-9dc112a17a8e.Text: [Address the doppelgangers] "You are fabrications. Who were you before the Haemonculus changed you? Why do you play along with his deception?"

1d4c3a8b-f90a-483e-b9f6-5bf3ba8d13ec.Text: [Examine the figures standing next to Kibellah]

3a4c609a-0fc0-4ad4-bcad-edb18698127f.Text: "Tervantias is toying with your mind! They are his fake creations, and your soul is untouched. He wants you to believe that he holds limitless power over you!"

ab757dba-b802-4b3e-a265-b8aaf62eaa59.Text: "Trust me. I can see that you are the true Kibellah. My devoted ally."

2a0bef50-b09b-407b-9286-db722dde4271.Text: Refused to release Kibellah from her debt despite what the Haemonculus had done to her.

f97c5907-5ae6-404a-b562-4415eded5764.Text: "You would dare plead for a release from your sacred vow of service? Your duty is not yet done, and neither has your penance been paid!"

6a519678-88bb-41ed-991a-b89b2bde0a0b.Text: [Raise your voice at the doppelgangers] "If you do not stop lying to her, I will show you that I know more about torture than Tervantias!"

0ec6ee8e-bf97-4ce3-a2b7-cae3fa5c3f5d.Text: "I order you to kill these abominations and join me!"

bca9279f-eebd-43bd-b318-7ccf64486d54.Text: {n}The floor of the cage is littered with corpses, their arms sticking out between the bars and their pale faces pressed against the cold metal. Above them stands Kibellah, frozen between two female figures. She listens to their sinister whispers, her arms hanging limply.{/n}

4fb298bd-c22f-43ca-b307-5ef6216d84b7.Text: {n}Before Kibellah can say anything, her furious copy hisses,{/n} "You will not endanger the Domin! You have been in the Haemonculus's hands for too long. You do not know how much control he has gained over you. What if you turn out to be his instrument and not that of the Domin in a critical moment? What if this is a trap, a poisoned gift?"

cc9dacc8-5caa-457b-b05f-33d98f99bda0.Text: {n}Each corpse has one or two brutal, indisputably lethal wounds: a pierced heart, a slashed throat, a black void instead of an eye socket. Each body, both living and dead alike, has the same face. Kibellah's face.{/n}

de47cf50-de48-47e9-b84b-7e64ce3063c7.Text: {n}Not even the most skilful among the blasphemous xenos can fracture the soul of one of His servants. The Haemonculus is playing a mind game with Kibellah by convincing her that his puppets are all parts of her. In truth, it is merely an intricate deception.{/n}

8f911077-61cf-417e-9e30-5e42bde28fb2.Text: "I... dare not disobey you." {n}Kibellah faces her two copies.{/n} "Farewell. I am sending you into nothing and leaving to carry on this curse alone. Perhaps... you will find the Undying One there, and He will accept you."

6cd5ad68-84df-4458-9633-1fb7cdc23aca.Text: {n}The other double laughs and points at the dead bodies.{/n} "The true Kibellah lies among these corpses. You are just her vestige, her infinitesimal trace defiled by the xenos. You are unclean, and now you would stain the Domin with your abominable essence?"

a0efb768-cfa3-4d04-978a-28c8dc667cf5.Text: {n}Kibellah's voice cuts through the darkness, quivering with anguish:{/n} "But the Tenets command us to protect you! Even from ourselves! For we are the fruit of the xenos's dark knowledge!"

d47557de-75dc-4fda-b3ea-4dd3e4c8c355.Text: {n}Gloating laughter interrupts you.{/n} "Enough words, Domin'{name}. Rid your servant of her shameful existence. You have come in an hour of despair, and that is a sign from the Undying One. Only you can grant the one who was once called Kibellah her final death."

5dbcf2f6-fd78-4da5-bb33-478881819fee.Text: "You should just leave me here, Domin. Leave me and do not come back. I am cursed."

f11175f1-c30f-428a-905d-5de3cb9ea273.Text: {n}The other two prisoners raise their weapons... but they do not possess even a tenth of the speed of a true death cultist.{/n}

93a291b7-d1b6-401b-9ee8-f5b98f3e2aeb.Text: {n}Kibellah stares at you as if she does not recognise you, a trickle of blood running down her face.{/n} "Can you feel it, Domin'{name}? The shards have become whole. The torturous ringing is gone — only silence remains. As for the wounds that this place has left... No matter. I am your blade once again, yearning for your command."

1e6f9c21-ae8e-42be-8d0b-c28efc7a01c4.Text: {n}The three nearly identical yet distinctly different faces bearing Kibellah's features turn to you.{/n}

0233365e-6c8b-4c04-926c-caa4f23fbbb0.Text: {n}Kibellah shakes her head forlornly.{/n} "I do not believe you, Domin. Your asserted knowledge is just a veiled hope."

449ebe03-8358-42c9-b35a-76bacc58f0fe.Text: {n}The doppelgangers respond with a furious growl and disdainful laughter. Kibellah's head drops lower.{/n} "You are mistaken, Domin. They do not lie. They are me."

e77328de-a69b-4567-b53d-1c08443cb331.Text: "Stay away, Domin! I've been... corrupted. The blasphemer said you were dead. This worthless blade had failed you, and all it could do was to break itself against the bones of its enemies to wash away the shame. I fought them, I forced them to take my life, but... The dark fleshcarver, he committed an atrocity — he has spurned death itself. Whenever I received a mortal wound, he would wrest my fading soul from His hands. He mended my wounds, made my heart beat once more, kindled my consciousness a moment before it could be extinguished forever. And he did it again, and again, and again..."

a5fefed7-188a-48d3-9f69-f6a5a4917463.Text: {n}Fear flickers in their eyes for but a moment — but Kibellah still notices. She narrows her eyes and whispers,{/n} "Then it was all a lie? You clouded my mind with poisoned words..."

45a3e66a-4e57-4048-8b84-174b318e1a4d.Text: {n}Kibellah raises her chin and hisses,{/n} "Do not reproach me, Domin'{name}! Not even you have that right! You who know not of the dread of looking into your own face and questioning what you are!" {n}She pulls out a dagger and mutters,{/n} "Enough! If there is no answer, I will carve it into the flesh of existence! I am the Second Spinner of the Bloodspun Web! I am Kibellah! And I name myself the true one!"

d11307ab-ba7a-4245-918d-37eb818787b7.Text: {n}Kibellah bows her head in acceptance and whispers,{/n} "Farewell, Domin. Forever."

43c6e468-2298-4f06-8283-6a1716e2c53f.Text: {n}The three figures bow their heads and draw their weapons, ready to lose themselves in their final ritual dance.{/n}

b961ad33-ee20-42f6-b2a1-d3d772328a20.Text: {n}A shadow darkens her face.{/n} "If... if you can find a moment to spare... I would ask that you speak with me, somewhere more private. There is too much weighing on my soul, Domin'{name}."

e7a0af0b-54ce-439f-8bb7-c31cd232d600.Text: "The pattern of their souls is disfigured. I recognise Kibellah's own hues, but it is as if those hues were added by a cruel, brutish hand. Two of them are mere forgeries, but... they seem to be unaware of it." {n}Black veins swell on Cassia's temples as she clutches her head with a groan.{/n} "Forgive me. I cannot be more specific. I am still feeling sick from my... tribulations."

f2bbb6e5-21d5-4587-8bef-0afa6e76ece7.Text: "Do not yearn for salvation. Yearn for cleansing." {n}Argenta's voice is full of pain.{/n} "One day, I will avenge you."

121921fd-fb2e-4cdd-b870-6578cef1770c.Text: "I..." {n}Kibellah grits her teeth and says with powerless anger,{/n} "I will trust you, Domin. I am your weapon. I am a blade unbroken! Even that butcher could not break me, and that means..." {n}The rage subsides, leaving naught but cold resolve in her voice.{/n} "...he cannot corrupt me. I am I, the Second Spinner of the Bloodspun Web. Kibellah."

729c8af6-7366-449b-994c-1ae849225dc1.Text: {n}After getting a better look at the doppelgangers, you notice faint scars on their skin left by the scalpel that has transformed their appearance. Subtle as their sculptor's handiwork may be, it does not stand up to your scrutiny.{/n}

cfc03914-1985-4e8b-b814-e02a7d1a3659.Text: {n}It is unclear if the two figures are clones or some other sinister form of xenos trickery.{/n}

cf2f98a4-0c53-4362-9460-db9a81edb2bb.Text: {n}The other doppelganger, grimacing angrily, nods at Kibellah with contempt.{/n} "Do you think she is cleaner than us, Domin? She is broken. Nothing could shake the Kibellah you knew. Before you is a warped imitation of who she was. Repulsive. Tainted."

8925de06-2e87-4d97-bad0-2498f2f25aa5.Text: "And every time I found myself upon death's threshold, he claimed a part of my soul to create... this!" {n}Kibellah gestures to her copies.{/n} "Unhallowed replicas! My soul is mutilated, and I am a mockery of what I once was. And I... can't fight. Not anymore."

18a6998c-a7e9-4437-8fdc-a941b6ccb877.Text: {n}Both figures have her face, and yet there is no mistaking one for the other. One of them is twisted into a still, mask-like grimace of loathing. It rasps as if ripping its own throat apart,{/n} "You were created to serve as a tool. You do not have the capacity to oppose the hand that commands you. That is why, sooner or later, you will succumb."

f4534d6f-154b-4e3c-b68b-2309fe1e24a8.Text: "We are her. We are shards of a soul that is crushed and cursed. Do you not recognise your servant in her new form, Domin?" {n}The wicked spawn never stops grinning brazenly.{/n}

bad2c056-b073-4db0-bfda-1c442f65c9c1.Text: "You are nothing but a weapon designed to spill blood. You have no will of your own, and thus you cannot resist him. Admit it."

5ac2baba-a542-4caf-b072-b46b9486688d.Text: "He has sullied you. Shattered you. You are an unholy imitation. You should have accepted this by now."

393e8752-1171-4e1c-8015-7c9b7c44f0b7.Text: {n}The other wears a smile, both mocking and pained at once. Like the first figure, this one seems unable to rid itself of its expression.{/n} "You are ruined. That is why the Undying One refuses to take you away. Now you are prey for the wicked, their plaything."

3eaa7bef-44a7-4a48-99b9-7099e3bc686c.Text: {n}It is possible that the xenos is indeed so powerful as to be able to dissect and alter a person's soul. If so, anyone who has spent time as his captive should be avoided. There is no telling to what extent he can twist someone's very being.{/n}

d092ac63-2095-4187-8f2a-6f402f32f62e.Text: {n}Kibellah regards her copies in silence, then shakes her head heavily.{/n} "They are right. I cannot go with you. It could be the Haemonculus's trap. Who can say, perhaps... perhaps I am not even the true Kibellah, merely a shard of her. Abandon me here. Save yourself."

263d56f7-46b0-45f5-9541-b5c30229e953.Text: {n}Kibellah gazes at the corpses darkly.{/n} "I alone am left. But what does that change, Domin? I am a broken mirror, a poor mockery. When you realise this, you will send me away yourself. But not today, it seems."

3c6da9f2-908e-4fe2-b6e9-05c4a9f1cce5.Text: "Toying with my mind..." {n}Kibellah ponders this.{/n} "Then everything was a lie, a spectacle designed to break my spirit? To feed my paranoia? A toy for his twisted games... Could he have done so? Of course he could..."

a1186700-aae1-43ec-87ff-83dce477e787.Text: "I want to believe your words. And that is proof of my weakness, my corruption. I do not wish to besmirch my {mf|master|mistress}'s name further with my unworthiness. You must disown me, Domin."

71d4d07e-5f6f-46c8-a93a-8310a05fd087.Text: The shock that Kibellah suffered as Tervantias's prisoner has left an indelible mark on her mind. It will take some time for this horror to fade away.

0fe5614c-6b90-49d5-aa7e-05680aef359e.Text: "Make your people leave, Domin'{name}. Their idle questions are getting in the way of my watch."

06881328-001d-4a6f-ba87-42f6cdba2c21.Text: "You are my shield. My shadow. My instrument. Have you forgotten?"

c6e25d01-5b03-41cc-acd4-02aaa67dcdaa.Text: "I cannot help but wonder... Are you the same Kibellah I once knew?"

fd109424-4baa-431d-9fdb-037ab87dd12c.Text: "Did you manage to learn anything useful while you were in captivity?"

0a230d43-44e2-41af-982a-671417f4bda3.Text: "Be ready. We are getting out of this place."

6881cbea-590e-4e53-a69a-7fdb8076ada6.Text: "Be that as it may, your thirst for blood is troubling."

ed8283f6-9b74-4b43-bbf8-dc03eb2b5e6f.Text: "It would be an honour to bear the mark of the Undying One."

3e392087-5dea-4b18-9e76-726071817003.Text: "People spend their whole lives searching for the answers to these questions, and they often die without finding them."

36b94cc7-dfbd-4f3f-8e55-f2ab51845e0a.Text: "Do you not see? The longer you dwell on these thoughts, the further you stray from the Undying One's light."

3555e8a4-689b-4de8-8a95-faa06e6e6358.Text: "Only you can decide who you are and what you believe."

9854101b-c5d7-4abb-94c6-1aa690a891d7.Text: "I expected you to be angry. I thought you would ask me to change my mind, or demand to know my reasons. Are you not bothered by my decision?"

885a5950-4d3a-4fd5-8756-da1551e3e024.Text: "I would like to know more about the sacred mysteries of the death cult."

d2239c26-7816-4ebb-8264-d4735cd11e26.Text: "I no longer want you in my retinue."

cab1a83f-d625-414d-a771-4d2b562402c9.Text: "Wait. I wish for you to stay."

383b935e-cd7c-4342-a07e-914f1c7c074c.Text: "You said you could get rid of Marazhai for me. Is that true?"

de9e142b-3406-43d5-a6ba-58901fd65a00.Text: "How many cards are in your deck?"

a33991ba-d414-4d38-8259-2412764f9e67.Text: "Are you satisfied with the results of the hunt?"

c0e25f2e-d5a9-4432-9f63-23f125dda089.Text: "What are the responsibilities of the Vizsier?"

4db6c693-778b-43e2-ac28-3115c6d612af.Text: "Can you teach me to follow the Tenets of the Bloodspun Web?"

9a0c800c-c986-401a-abbf-522dd4fc0d9b.Text: "You have satisfied my curiosity... for now."

a1fde12f-dbed-445c-a881-1bc4fd1ad1c4.Text: [Gesture at the scars covering Kibellah's skin] "You torture your own flesh. What is the meaning of this ritual?"

453ca716-4403-404b-9b4e-1573d12d50d5.Text: "You say the God-Emperor is death. There are some who might find the comparison blasphemous."

d9b89804-7231-493a-96dd-b7298143e01f.Text: "Your fighting style is unique. Do you think it is something I can learn?"

d4dcea3f-7e15-499c-8750-499148bef9a3.Text: "What was it like growing up in the cult? What do you remember?"

37ff8cad-356d-4345-be24-4f3fd9896b66.Text: "It must have been difficult to go through all of that as a child."

93c2bd5e-2ffd-4f51-b17a-c21f9cb65548.Text: "Your parents, your... family. You never mention them."

ab63d581-4378-4006-8b54-cd2f3bfede60.Text: "I can see now why you are the best assassin in the cult. The cost was worth it."

a98c375d-d244-43c1-86c8-9f17ce61df68.Text: "That is awful! No one should be subjected to such torment!"

1142a1c3-f561-4e66-8043-06707ac91bde.Text: "You may not remember your real family, but are you truly so unconcerned by the deaths of your fellow cultists?"

65495ae2-e9dd-4967-a3a3-f33cafebc4fd.Text: "You always address me as 'Domin.' What does that word mean?"

c4f14320-c6b3-4987-9b54-72326dd1a061.Text: "I presume this will not be a painless procedure."

485e8771-6802-4207-a264-8c35b41e5ee4.Text: "Did you ever meet Theodora von Valancius?"

a5e9391e-3d0d-4d93-9724-0763a458af4a.Text: "I am disturbed by the news about this Nemesite. How will the emergence of this heroic figure from legend affect the ship?"

d8235287-6271-49a7-911e-fbe12065238a.Text: "I am worried for you. I want you to do a reading for yourself."

a5ee1ba8-1fdd-40d0-869c-c1f5d49e8b19.Text: "What does the future hold for me?"

f3caab01-6c83-41a3-a719-ea2ac7fb4f3e.Text: "The shadows around us grow darker. What does the future hold for the Koronus Expanse?"

f6bae159-f884-4a2f-931c-867252e78118.Text: "I have no questions at this time."

8b2aa827-cc9e-4d84-8588-583f1b23fa8e.Text: "How do you know you have never made a mistake? How can you be sure you have never wrongly robbed one of your victims of their life?"

a02bb9e3-e306-491d-8240-7c33a5e87070.Text: "Very well. Let us see just how impervious to pain you really are."

ab796f4d-75b5-4136-bfd5-918828c398c9.Text: [Drive a long needle into her eye socket]

811d0f27-4f00-4a5d-96dd-f3f646baedf4.Text: [Stab the sharp prongs of a steel fork beneath her clavicle]

3e423471-20a8-403c-9695-184d2340c746.Text: [Pierce her skin with several chained hooks]

78e85a6e-a88c-43cd-9524-a19e82ea8817.Text: "Tormenting yourself almost seems to give you pleasure."

204e767f-abaf-419b-902d-519e6f80e17f.Text: "You frighten me more than Marazhai sometimes."

d7fd7494-6855-467d-ba33-736ba2b98f01.Text: "How long has the Bloodspun Web been in existence?"

a954c87d-e458-48b9-85ea-49d4be59167b.Text: "What is the matter with you? How can you compare the Emperor's servants to the enemies of Humanity?"

f003cd15-f0d0-4726-8223-772499ade691.Text: "How did you come to have a deck of His Tarot?"

ee2837c5-cc3c-4bb7-a30a-c861a7a4c59d.Text: "Do you truly feel no pain at all?"

2790feec-0e58-47ed-a48f-b5a097196c77.Text: [Carve a nefarious symbol into your skin] "I will do it myself."

d4d3b69e-7681-4ae6-a690-72c61eff7869.Text: "I won't hold it against you. You are tired and wounded. You are not thinking straight."

c19497cb-5831-4605-91d7-79f23042d56d.Text: "I am beginning to wonder if it was the true Kibellah who stepped out of that cage..."

a7545349-b080-4be1-b822-c605b747e13c.Text: "Kibellah... This is not the place for this conversation. I refuse to continue it any longer."

d536db6f-5ae3-4f33-9d49-6e9c093410ae.Text: "You want this to be over? Perfect. You and I are done."

aee19284-7866-4b9c-9d77-b39f3a3a06e0.Text: "To the void with the Vizsier! If the path of the Bloodspun Web is suffocating you, you must abandon it to survive!"

14415f83-0989-4253-a861-cee3d09f58b0.Text: "This air of mystery surrounding you is quite alluring. Did you know that?"

7a954446-9904-4e0d-ae97-b3f0acda9b33.Text: "What if I showed you my world? One of the rituals we practise on the upper decks?"

09f3f2e1-a323-499d-be42-7858ea5f8eab.Text: "Yes, I suppose you are right. The distance between our worlds is too great."

f8cf64e1-42c3-421a-8c5d-5c744b26a674.Text: "I want to go somewhere private with you."

cc050124-459e-4395-a93b-59d924626fc6.Text: "I want this to be over. That should be enough."

8dc5317c-a430-4ddf-be9c-f7098e563ca9.Text: "I did not mean to say that. I'm sorry."

ee703c5e-cd54-4713-8a28-df42d967b44f.Text: "That is not what I asked. I want to know how you are doing."

0311683f-500d-4c67-8087-b61bd0161d04.Text: "I presume you have no friends either?"

15adae9f-154c-4de7-a806-f9338b5902e1.Text: "These doubts are merely another trial for you to overcome. Follow your thread, and they will be dispelled."

1690dac5-a0a7-48a8-b4a7-1d49db75a04b.Text: "How succinct. Do you dislike talking about yourself?"

e01780d0-96ae-469a-bf9c-5f96d12a6305.Text: "I have no use for a broken shield. Next time, be faster than our enemies."

313a64a4-f5a2-4b76-94ab-f6546e85544f.Text: "You saved my life. I have no reason to doubt you."

e0530d86-e046-4779-889e-eb82b2dd800c.Text: "That shot was meant for me. Never do something like this again."

c034b9b4-585a-4acb-8824-de9091514e9a.Text: "Does this have anything to do with our earlier conversation, about your resemblance to Nemesite?"

0a1c959f-bb02-41f6-b527-84787c9edd5b.Text: "You are my servants, my weapons. You serve the dynasty."

f9082c5a-6d16-43e9-8263-863bbe0cc8de.Text: "Where is this strange question coming from?"

66d9298f-66eb-42e3-ae91-b78fa9fadc42.Text: "Good. We cannot afford to let down our guard."

260c20c1-7065-4e63-8c10-1a4127e8fa77.Text: "You are the scourge of the renegades. You deliver His vengeance in the name of the righteous."

ee237527-8e65-4019-94a9-23a01a80fb16.Text: "I cannot be the judge of that."

34ca8dbc-41f0-45e8-aa9a-6fc5ee7fc56c.Text: "All you are is a sect of the deadliest, most terrifying zealots on this ship."

4ac694b7-2674-4332-abfa-ed2fe59cc3a7.Text: "You serve the Undying Emperor, yet you also serve His faithful. You are the givers of His Peace."

f7386860-4d04-4e00-85a0-5f6658f9e668.Text: "We need to discuss your hunt in the plasma drive chambers."

e659917c-b5ce-4c6d-aadc-0eb97e3b869a.Text: "Do you not wish to know what became of your family?"

fbb8aa14-e9b9-419a-89e6-17b9b3fd9404.Text: "It felt like... I was with you somehow... Is that even possible?"

ac7f99a1-5dbc-477e-a10f-3787e5e95381.Text: "I expressly forbade your cult from killing, and yet, not only did you arrange for that enforcer to die, you also performed a blood divination."

e8fd8fca-eea9-443f-a87c-dc8d0fe9caa5.Text: "I understand. You were chasing Nemesite, your quarry. But... killing an enforcer? Using blood in a divination rite? Was that truly necessary?"

3f6b64dd-43a8-430a-b51d-cce05067426a.Text: "I pardon you for these killings, for they were justified. But do not defy me again."

374b467f-9ac7-4df6-a8a8-cbf1962ff671.Text: "I know that corporal punishment would be a trifle to you. So, instead, you are to clean all the latrines on the officers' deck for the next dozen watches."

4e796052-becc-4cae-8390-94bbbfd0ca32.Text: "If the Undying One whispers my name, will you carry out His will?"

3b41510a-e5f9-4178-b581-31d7cf240d9d.Text: [Leave a wound on Kibellah's hand] "This will be a mark of my displeasure. Do not let the wound heal, and always remember that you have not earned my forgiveness."

6198fc26-835f-4309-a77c-2fe6d38b2dc7.Text: "How can I be angry at you? You were beautiful in the way you sowed death, determined to see your hunt through to the end."

dbddc716-9fc0-4f41-a506-de1a7b0013fd.Text: "It was a trying time for you in Commorragh, but you are home now, back on the ship. How are you holding up?"

6592971c-cb73-4033-bf7a-1e6243e0610b.Text: "I am ready to perform the rite of blessing for your hunt."

787fb107-69c6-4bdc-a0a4-baa135f5166c.Text: "I am ready. Let us present ourselves to the Vizsier."

c2cbbef3-d8c7-4edd-abe2-b8d17868838e.Text: "Some of my companions have accused me of turning away from the Emperor. But not you. Why is that?"

8f4fa10f-f8ec-44e8-b7b1-c5cfea2655e6.Text: "Neither Commorragh nor anything you say can change how I feel about you! I want to be with you. Do you understand?"

b2700ad1-0bc3-44ae-8611-b1fbbb183b9d.Text: "I am ready for the binding ritual."

de963cf6-e1ee-487a-9724-d57017f3a3e6.Text: "You hear a whisper in your mind telling you to kill someone, and you obey? Have you ever considered that these 'whispers' could be a deception orchestrated by minions of the Archenemy?"

79109b1f-2f18-4c5c-8607-fc127e058053.Text: "The Emperor's Tarot is usually read by sanctioned psykers."

f3e6eee1-f663-4ec1-ac3a-03fb634459d4.Text: "Domin'{name}." {n}Kibellah puts away the dagger she has been using to reopen her freshly closed wounds.{/n}

2cd2dadd-bb6a-4e18-ba18-c76f15d8649c.Text: "Domin'{name}. I have spun a web of crimson in the plasma drive chambers and ensnared Nemesite's accomplices with it. It is done. My divination has revealed that your confessor, the sower of faith aboard this vessel, is stained with deceit. The Undying One has spoken: his time has come."

26b0bba2-c941-4279-8dcc-3df8dd17509d.Text: "Come, Domin." {n}With ominous resolve, Kibellah drags a steel claw down her face, leaving behind a line that splits it in half. She steps forward without another word.{/n}

62743ea7-7a43-46a3-8746-52d1c5cdc996.Text: "The web of my soul was unmade. Every time I died, I lost something important. Something intangible... until finally, there was only me. I am all that is left of Kibellah. Now a new web has been woven from the threads of the old, and though its pattern will never be the same, it still stores Kibellah's memories. My memories."

19411d14-19d9-4282-a790-c2518ba27c56.Text: {n}Kibellah clenches her fists to keep them from trembling.{/n} "The Vizsier told us that we must die many times to learn the truth. We believed him. We died again and again... But it was all a lie. A delusion. We never truly passed to the other side. But here... "

767d883e-d094-4b13-b9ff-bb15dff8a3d8.Text: {n}The time spent in the Dark City has left its mark on Kibellah. The life has left her eyes, her face is grim, and her skin has taken on a pale corpse-like pallor. Her ritual wounds, which she has renewed in a fit of frenzy, are swollen and inflamed.{/n} "I... I can fight. Do not hesitate to unsheathe this blade if it is needed."

db6abe33-32b7-4399-b503-b399c94ef081.Text: "All I heard was that accursed xenos butcher boasting about another stolen sun. Was it the truth, or was it just another lie told by the Undying One's enemies? I do not know."

afbb15c8-4d96-490f-b780-b5a9ac0ddd92.Text: {n}Kibellah nods and closes her eyes.{/n} "We are Thy hounds. We pursue the blood of Thy foes. We shall not fear the end, for in meeting the end, we meet Thee."

8eda67ea-fe32-42a9-835d-c633b95575c3.Text: "The Vizsier taught us that there are many like us throughout the Imperium who spill blood in His name — 'death cultists,' as they call us. He said that no two death cults are the same, just as there are no two identical stars in the void. I will tell you about the Bloodspun Web, but I cannot speak on behalf of all death cults."

9c4cfb49-0424-402c-a19f-cedeed13f747.Text: "There is no purpose in lamenting the will of fate. It is an act of foolishness comparable to attacking the void ocean itself. Your word is my command in life and in death. It is my duty to you and the Undying One to accept it with dignity."

938a19b7-1c57-426c-9709-2b1fbf06c3a1.Text: {n}The needle goes in right between the lid and the eyeball. Kibellah reaches out and adjusts your hand as casually as though she were straightening out the tableware at dinner.{/n} "The purpose of this practice is to fortify the flesh, not to mutilate it."

943c57e3-dd88-4bf3-b6de-6751899a0629.Text: "It does not matter how strong a blade is, nor how faultless its service. When the time comes, it must return to its sheath."

5007b584-52a6-4b5f-ad0e-4639413f6151.Text: "Though I must serve from a distance, I will remain your unseen shield and shadow until the Undying Emperor calls me to Him. Then my time in the halls of life will come to an end, and I will serve Him in the beyond."

bdd72e9a-c0cf-4840-b2e0-d75064b1df10.Text: {n}She meets your eyes with her steady, unblinking gaze.{/n} "Even the wisest of rulers may err — so we learn from the Tenets. They also teach us to make decisions before giving orders, not after."

4647ffca-1890-4129-a47b-ed1bf0c5c2d5.Text: {n}Kibellah holds the skull up to your face.{/n} "An aberration. Your former foe. His eternal foe. My new companion-in-shadow and my trophy. You once knew him by the name Nemesite, but now, his name is Nemo."

9ab4ebb2-bc0d-47d6-bb5c-28d9e09af4b1.Text: "May the Undying One shroud your footsteps from the faithless."

25183258-3194-41ba-86d8-bb1bae792f0e.Text: {n}Your question seems to take Kibellah by surprise.{/n} "I am... the Second Spinner of the Bloodspun Web. A spear in the hand of the Undying Emperor. I am your shield and shadow. Your blade."

9e480ac8-5cfb-4c59-b587-ee349a1fde64.Text: {n}She stops and tilts her head. Then slowly, as if in a trance, she draws her black dagger.{/n} "Death whispers to me. You are worthy of bearing His marks. Tell me, Domin'{name}, do you wish to honour your flesh with His gifts?" {n}You notice several officers exchange worried glances as they eye the blade in Kibellah's hands.{/n}

b38a9d1a-46fb-4229-a666-10bd35a49853.Text: {n}Kibellah watches you warily as you defile your own flesh.{/n} "Enough." {n}She takes her dagger from your hands.{/n} "You have made a mockery of the sacred ritual. So be it. The Tenets teach us to hold no ill will. But I will have no part in this."

995656cf-fd8c-489c-865f-ce6a2e0ec2d1.Text: "The Bloodspun Web holds the bays of the flagship together with the threads of its faith — such is our service to the Domini of the von Valancius line. The Undying One commanded the Domini to embark on a ship and sail the void's expanse. And thus it became our duty to protect your dynasty and the ark that became its home — this great relic of blood and adamantine."

a57990dc-3861-42fe-a130-e2ef005eea97.Text: "Through blood, sweat, tears, and the strength of their convictions, the servants of the Undying One spin the souls of your subjects into threads of balance. This is why we refer to ourselves as spinners. Those who are newly committed to the Bloodspun Web are called lesser spinners. If they are faithful in their service to Him, they may eventually become spinners. The most devout of us all are known as the high spinners, of whom there are seven, each bearing a unique title. The Vizsier, the First Spinner, leads the cult. I, Kibellah, am the Second Spinner. The Third Spinner's name is Io, and there are four more."

222c00a0-dbce-4d10-ae09-515064d0bc19.Text: "The Maw. The Galaxy. The Monster, inverted. The Executioner." {n}Kibellah shudders as she looks at the Tarot spread before her.{/n} "Something is coming... It is inevitable. Soon the Expanse will tremble — and you will be the cause. You are not the beginning, but you will be the end. Some will see you as death. Others, a powerful force. Still others, as a portent. Or... you might simply fade into nothing."

351937a7-7397-46ad-9b53-aedf49971660.Text: "The Tenets are knowledge, an art that is passed down from one generation of the Bloodspun Web to the next. Even so, there are spinners who will never fully comprehend this knowledge in the time allotted to them by the Undying One. The Tenets dictate how one follows the thread of life, but they are also the thread itself — from first breath to last. The Tenets cannot be taught. They must be lived. Only then will you understand."

048bf870-251d-43af-b818-214a5248e3f6.Text: "A blade does not forgive hesitation, Domin'{name}. Remember that."

86903932-dbec-4ffc-9ea1-f19f73428f48.Text: "Did... Vil'Marazhai do this?" {n}Kibellah stares at the mark left by the xenos, and swiftly presses the blade of her dagger to your throat. The cold touch of steel eases the pain a little.{/n} "One word from you, Domin'{name}, and the xenos will meet his ancestors."

ae3e6ae8-db51-49db-adc8-c5d3be1b24aa.Text: "Your body will fail you, Domin'{name}. Your bones will break. Your tendons will snap. Your heart will stop. Our rituals of self-perfection are unending, they demand absolute dedication and decades of special training. However, if you devote the next thirty years of your life to its study... you might be able to learn the basics."

3b7cbd1d-c292-4b99-bc98-7520a5b8ff04.Text: {n}Kibellah frowns.{/n} "The Undying One is death itself. We serve Him, and thus we serve death. This is not a comparison, attribution, or preference. It is the truth... and nothing can change it."

28bdfecb-9689-46bb-b887-a83166e3ee6e.Text: "It is not difficult to speak the truth."

ffc72996-1acc-47f2-bfef-19f5753635ba.Text: {n}Kibellah's brow furrows.{/n} "I am the spear of His retribution, not a witch, or a sorcerer, or a soothsayer. I have no strange powers, but I do bear His blessing. I do not command the veil, I am guided by His whisper and led by my faith. By the Tenets. Please, do not mistake me for something I am not."

7e2c90f0-6038-4565-b629-c7cd13f572c4.Text: "I use blood to read {g|Encyclopedia:ImperialTarotGlossary}His sacred cards{/g} and hear the whisper of the Undying One." {n}Kibellah's voice is filled with reverent awe.{/n} "His Tarot is not an answer, but a question I ask of the universe... and the universe answers with questions of its own. In this sacred communion, I perceive hundreds of possible outcomes. They are all true, and yet they are only visions. I know what will come to pass... and yet I do not."

f961b1d5-1ee8-4b16-8e39-439bbbc66986.Text: "The Tenets compel us to let our deeds speak on our behalf. There is no one in the cult who does not know me, so I have grown accustomed to taciturnity in matters regarding myself. Ask, and I will try to give you an answer that will satisfy your thirst for knowledge."

971fec64-a1e0-4d5f-8fff-cc6584008e7f.Text: "Ask the cards, Domin'{name}. And I will listen." {n}Kibellah carefully takes out her Imperial Tarot deck. A black blade flashes before your eyes, and blood drips from her palm onto the cards. She closes her eyes... and listens.{/n}

d374fcfa-6b46-48bf-8aa9-b8f1174adf42.Text: "It is impossible to understand the value of your body and spirit if you've never experienced physical or emotional pain. Pain is temporary, but experience endures. Experience can be sharpened like a blade and turned into mastery. I have never regretted walking the thread I was destined to follow."

2d6ec83f-fbdb-4f5e-8dd7-1db74dea89fe.Text: "When we join the cult, we relinquish our past. The Bloodspun Web becomes our new family. I have seen the pain, terror, and doubt in the eyes of those who hear the Undying One whisper the names of their kin. For some... the blessing of oblivion is a gift not unlike death."

d7380c4d-b52d-46db-9efd-70db0f49c138.Text: "Those who devote themselves to the service of the Undying One must be prepared to pay any price. Emotions. Blood. Life. Death. Memory. We all must lose what we hold most dear to become a spear in His hand. Some may lose everything... but they will also gain everything."

02811f15-6389-424c-bdd2-7a6b79a5eb2a.Text: "A blade cannot be forged without hammer and fire, and a Domin cannot reign without spilling the blood of enemies and subjects alike. We all have our own hammer and anvil."

6762e92a-77bf-440a-896e-aa7423dbffe8.Text: "Torture?" {n}Kibellah arches an eyebrow.{/n} "I bear the sacred marks of the Undying One's service. Death has bestowed them upon me. Though others may cherish hollow riches or meaningless beauty, it is my duty to cherish His gift of blood. Each wound is a symbol of our service to Him. Each drop of blood carries His blessing. To renounce these scars is to renounce the Undying One Himself."

a7ccd6d0-e786-468c-b2bb-6d0bb2229d0a.Text: "My story is not as interesting as yours."

6fb4c8cd-555d-471f-82d5-0b0917783b3b.Text: "The Gothic we use to communicate is different to that spoken on the upper decks. 'Domin' has many meanings: 'Giver of Life,' 'Lord or Lady of the Ark,' and 'Shadowless Sun.' The Matriarch Spider gave this title to the Rogue Trader who allowed her to form the Bloodspun Web. We use other titles as well. For example, 'Veni' means 'master of the {g|Encyclopedia:WarpGlossary}Immaterium{/g}' or 'watcher of the veil.' 'Vil' means 'one who must go to the other side.' 'Amic' means 'one you can trust in battle.'"

adc53cbc-3f30-4eef-bb5a-f7838ef57afa.Text: {n}The answer escapes Kibellah's lips before she can give it any thought. Upon realising this, she produces a small blade seemingly out of nowhere, and begins to sharpen it with pointed nonchalance.{/n}

c212c088-752d-43db-bf64-30f384962079.Text: {n}Kibellah is too devoted to the teachings of the Web to let her emotions lead her astray.{/n}

b1bfedca-547f-4626-8244-59b889eb68e0.Text: "A boon cannot be given to one who is not ready to receive it." {n}Kibellah sheathes her dagger.{/n}

88ce6685-f84c-4f96-afdb-92248e52c669.Text: "I have not felt pain in a long time. But yes, your body will certainly suffer. Embrace the pain, and make it a part of you. It will be your salvation even on your darkest days."

f8dbe6da-d1b8-4802-a04e-50b189955fc5.Text: "I met her once when I was young. The Vizsier saw a serpent hiding among those close to Domin'Theodora, ready to sink its fangs into her throat. I was ordered to find the serpent, and sever the soul from its body. I watched and waited for weeks. I hid among the shadows, the air ducts, and the faceless masses. Once I found the serpent, I sliced off its head and returned to the temple. I doubt that Domin'Theodora ever saw me. But the three ritual cuts I left behind on the body let her know that this death was pleasing to Him. They sent us a grand feast from the upper decks before the cycle's end. We gave it to the hungry."

90c9e8dd-a42e-450a-870c-3537a52ed67c.Text: "I will listen, but I will make my own decision. Death claims all, one way or another. But it is within my power to stay the sentence."

7d46c8a4-1422-450b-9918-df4d846e6b36.Text: "If the Undying One chooses to take your soul, He will take mine along with it. You will not fall by my hand, for that is not my duty."

56459be8-1d9e-4ceb-87f5-a36c63a07bea.Text: "Lords and wretches are equal before death. If such is the Undying One's will, I will guide you to Him, Domin'{name}."

038bfcb2-22aa-4ffa-93f0-3908e09ac748.Text: "But not you and I, Domin'{name}. Our threads cannot be unwoven, and only the Undying One will end my service to you."

a7141df0-c821-47cd-b4ff-3f512dc1bc5f.Text: "The Harlequin. The Martyr, inverted. The Sword. The Inquisitor." {n}Kibellah looks at the cards thoughtfully.{/n} "The hero of forgotten legends wears a mask — an actor adored by their audience. The power of inspiring words will fan the sparks into a blaze. I see blood boiling in the fire. I see the mask melting away. The ashes of false hope will bury the mask. And the cheat will be beaten at their own game."

074cd2e1-a6e6-4843-b7d6-1d801927d6d0.Text: {n}Her normally impenetrable gaze gives way to one of anxious confusion.{/n} "I... will meet death. Twice. Very soon. The first time, it will not claim anyone, but the second... Someone's thread will end, bringing change to many lives. This change may be a blessing or a curse. That is all I see."

af06f9b4-57be-443d-b60b-ab004e6531bf.Text: {n}Kibellah draws four cards from the deck and lays them face down before you.{/n}

712bf512-c395-4f83-9b17-8cd756643f75.Text: "The first card is the Young Warrior. It suggests inexperience, a path of becoming. The second card is the Shattered World, inverted. The path will have twists, turns, and thorns, but you will gather allies along the way and find what was lost."

599a021d-9416-4ba4-9255-c91229fed3b7.Text: {n}Kibellah glances at you, looking suddenly lost and vulnerable. However, the illusion quickly passes.{/n} "Thank you, Domin'{name}. As you are letting me go, so will I let go of you. Follow your own thread, and I will try to find the one meant for me."

64bd7cbf-5b55-4919-a92d-162a7ea486e0.Text: {n}Kibellah draws breath with a sob, her gaze growing cold.{/n} "Running away from your burdens, Domin'{name}? You dishonour yourself... But let it be as you wish — I won't inconvenience you with my thoughts!"

9335caa8-cf2a-4a80-a622-57273b721df3.Text: "I must return to the labyrinth — perform the dance, spin new threads, remind myself of the Bloodspun Web, restore my spirit..." {n}She casts a glance at you. The shadow of a gentle smile appears on her lips.{/n} "I will make this journey by myself. I'm sorry, but I need some time alone, Domin'{name}."

0c342b73-fe1e-423b-b2bf-bf7f9aacb3fa.Text: {n}Kibellah waits. And waits. And waits. At last, she lets out a quiet sigh.{/n} "I knew it. Our bond is weighing you down too. I am releasing you from it. Follow your thread, and I will try to find my own in this haze that has flooded my mind."

c8e98884-7f3a-48f2-a70c-4f5aae0258b6.Text: {n}She glares at you, clearly wanting to add something... but instead, she merely grimaces painfully and looks away.{/n}

6ce49e4a-0f47-4f93-adf5-ad8e9891ef78.Text: "Well..." {n}All life seems to drain from Kibellah's voice. She sounds for all the world like a servitor, its speech apparatus still intact, repeating an old recorded message.{/n} "I will remain your shield, your shadow, your blade. But... I am yours no more."

54ea0244-e5af-4f92-ac00-4bbd5e965db9.Text: {n}Kibellah regards you for a while without blinking. When at last she looks away, she does not try to mask her grimace.{/n}

750a6f91-5e45-44f6-a0c6-cb1ebf18ae4c.Text: {n}She touches your chest.{/n} "Come. We will open our souls to each other."

f844fa41-dac6-4073-ae5f-3e387f2b7a7c.Text: {n}Kibellah takes a step back, refusing any attempt to touch her.{/n} "Please..." {n}Her voice is full of pain.{/n}

ac981edb-4d6c-44b4-add0-cf29bae2c9ff.Text: {n}Kibellah steps into your arms, giving herself completely to the kiss. When she withdraws, her hands sliding gently down your face, she gives you a look that sets your heart ablaze.{/n} "All of my thoughts are of you, Domin'{name}."

607b9eb6-99d6-42c8-8d3d-976d3fe31c0f.Text: "I have lived according to the Tenets of the Bloodspun Web for as long as I can remember. It is what I was told to do. I knew no other way. But perhaps... this was the weakness in my soul's armour. I will think on what you've said, Domin'{name}."

09e11938-7023-4328-bd1b-fb122a326e90.Text: "Pain has no power over my body. A single shot cannot break me. And yet..." {n}Kibellah puts a hand to where you saw the gaping wound.{/n} "Before, whenever I found myself caught between unlife and undeath, I always remained calm. My mind was ever a vessel of humility and resolve. But when I saw Nemesite pull that trigger, I suddenly realised..."

2469e631-d675-401d-bb9b-397e46ef14da.Text: {n}She looks you straight in the eye.{/n} "The Undying One's hand was close, and its touch was cold. I thought that I might depart for the other side before my service here had ended. I was angry at... at Him. And then, I turned that anger upon myself. Truly, none are faultless before Him."

13ba06a7-2756-4597-89ac-431289167793.Text: {n}She frowns.{/n} "I had accomplished so little. Whatever grace I might have given to my flock, it was but a speck in the hourglass of eternity. And I realised that... I wanted to live. To carry on serving the Web. Such a selfish desire is a disgrace to the Tenets."

75c1731d-2ca6-4485-bceb-deecb7c924eb.Text: {n}She takes a deep breath.{/n} "I was enraged. I wanted to live. Not for the Tenets. Not for the Undying One. For myself."

eafe4aa8-5e7e-47ac-8748-6e6006c23e0e.Text: "I will strive to live up to the great faith you have put in me."

0a2dc77a-ef22-4a14-b314-138a80522f5c.Text: "There will be no next time — I will see to it." {n}Kibellah clutches the skull, which she has dubbed Nemo. Her steel claws dig into the bone with a creak.{/n}

96f5cb61-2507-4091-9e84-5e23fa292e0b.Text: "For years, I have been honing my body and spirit through sacred rituals. I have ushered hundreds of souls to the other side — the hunt for Nemesite was not my first. Yet, after my enemy fell, for the first time ever, I..." {n}She forces the words out of herself.{/n} "I felt empty. And that emptiness only grew heavier under the weight of the question that formed in my mind during that hunt."

f6c60088-f9bb-4e25-ae28-6bb869e3a076.Text: {n}She looks away.{/n} "I thought I would never see your face again, Domin'{name}."

592dae80-6571-4208-b337-b0e12c9a2d68.Text: "And, for the first time in years, I felt pain. It disturbed me. It disturbs me still. The wounds of the flesh will mend, but a bleeding soul dulls the edge. Such a blade does not deserve to be at your side."

d9265c6a-561e-4e7e-931c-7e791428a2ea.Text: {n}Kibellah's face turns to stone, and her eyes harden with grim resolve.{/n} "For such is His will. And such is my duty. I remember."

d3fbd2aa-6673-442c-905f-0ee5968917c5.Text: "I prayed. I longed for His guidance to put my mind at rest. But in my self-pity, I showed weakness in the eyes of the Undying One. And so, my only answer was silence. I must therefore ask you this agonising question, Domin'{name}: tell me, what is the purpose of the Bloodspun Web?"

a6a9914d-9780-42d0-ae9c-cf41eb2f31be.Text: "Whenever I feel the need to voice my thoughts, I turn to him. He is far wiser in death than when he was alive."

56d3a6e9-2dbc-47b0-8aa6-10d9e72d7b63.Text: "You demand the impossible, Domin. I am your shield. That is the point of me."

ba7bc37a-5962-4903-b765-b6a0fc3ed359.Text: "Then that makes me a tool that has renounced itself and the entire world for the sake of serving a purpose chosen by others."

d68d9bdf-9190-4f7f-86d6-b5b2a7328aed.Text: "Then that makes me a self-proclaimed judge, executioner, and idol. And it is my destiny to keep the herd fearful and obedient."

d2e8a64e-a679-4e1f-b46a-b2b5a473ef84.Text: "All my life, I have walked the road that was prescribed for me. I did as I was told. I searched for the truth in other people's words, then repeated them in my own voice. And I never once questioned my destiny... until you came along, Nemo." {n}The way Kibellah drags her metal claws across the skull in her hands seems almost affectionate.{/n}

e402fa07-f15d-457c-8944-60e6cb345ab7.Text: "Neither can I," {n}she says in a hollow voice.{/n}

c1991467-2e58-49b0-a11f-08b22e72751f.Text: "Then that makes me the living weapon of another's will, forged upon the anvil of the Tenets with the hammer of duty."

f6a2d4a5-8d10-4d70-979e-280db4cc9f03.Text: "I have known eleven deaths and resurrections. But the truth still eludes me. Death brought no answers... only more questions. Where do I begin and where do I end? Is it really so easy to snatch a soul from the hands of the Undying One and return it to its body? If death is not the beginning or the end, if it is not the thread that guides us... then what is it?"

aa4a44f4-5001-4340-b25c-28ac6d242c39.Text: "Then that makes me a driver of the ignorant, one who guides people into following an idea they may never hope to comprehend."

a9ac5159-6bf6-4874-a655-92b3478262c3.Text: "I might just as easily have met Nemesite's fate, and he mine. All it would have taken is a different pattern of threads. The only distinction lies in our ideas." {n}Kibellah's gaze has grown pensive.{/n} "Thank you for this conversation, Domin'{name}. It has satiated the void that gnaws at my soul, if only for a time. As for how to seal this chasm for good... that I have yet to find out. May the Tenets of the Web guide me to the truth."

0e43356d-31aa-4969-8a7d-7030b89e7893.Text: {n}Kibellah's lips curve into a smile.{/n} "Domin'{name}... Thank you for the moments of revelation that we have shared. Our souls may be closed to one another... but our bodies speak as one."

01f43b73-386b-4aed-9b22-d739ce73a216.Text: "I have been awaiting your questions, Domin. Ask away."

1725af6b-0a3c-4b06-a117-72125d44b900.Text: "Such was the Undying One's will. And yours before that, Domin'{name}. You blessed my hunt so that I might lead you to Nemesite. Your blade performed its service, and the hunt was fruitful."

41be6395-8abe-4d0d-89ae-001f1f16ec8f.Text: "Perhaps what you saw was induced by the ritual essence. Perhaps it was the Undying One's will that made you see. I too sensed a thread between us. Indeed, there were times when I could almost sense you with me. It was... a comforting feeling."

08f67f10-96f9-4734-9411-8e18cb308c02.Text: "If you consider me deserving of punishment... then, I will accept your wrath."

ce2235ba-e250-47a0-9c29-b3c1ca9f2dd0.Text: {n}The corner of Kibellah's mouth twitches.{/n} "I accept your punishment, and I thank you for leaving me my life so that I may continue to serve you."

6b8e342b-099f-49f0-8534-de6f4bbcf99e.Text: "I merely did as He commanded me to do." {n}Kibellah's voice remains dispassionate, but her half-smile tells you that your words have pleased her.{/n}

0b10adb9-6044-4a54-83f6-455d6fbb0209.Text: "No. One of the false champion's lackeys has escaped. I deserve no forgiveness."

09bc3484-3610-4fd0-aaa6-7cae7601ed75.Text: {n}You catch a spark of excitement in Kibellah's eyes.{/n} "It was a good chase. My quarry caught itself in my web of blood and met its end there, as was its fate."

8b0bba89-44be-4b61-9ce9-da873b96cd6a.Text: "I am... ashamed. Of what I said. Of how I acted. Of my hesitation. Now that I can see the stars through the portholes again, feel anew the ship's beating heart, once more breathe the bitter air of the lower decks... my mind has become clear. I am Kibellah, servant of the Undying Emperor. I am your blade and your shield. And thus, it shall be, now and forever. Thus... I will be."

88468aa0-3670-4bd6-a8a5-f959b0e6240d.Text: "Then we need a place where we can be alone. No one will disturb us in your chambers. Come."
