82cb2fbd-3721-428f-907c-d7de96a79aa5.Text: "Domin'{name}, sacred overlord of the Ark, my protector and friend." {n}Kibellah stands with her shoulders confidently squared, her dark eyes burning brighter than the stars.{/n} "How may the Vizsier of the Bloodspun Web, your shield, shadow, and blade, serve you?"

c9742a05-136a-4058-a5ef-d430032ec85f.Text: {n}Kibellah's lips twist into a grim half-smile.{/n} "I am your shadow, Domin'{name}. Wherever you choose to go, I will always follow. I see your deeds. I hear your prayers. And yet, I wait. When the Undying One whispers your name, my blades will rid you of the weight of your transgressions. But for as long as He is silent, I am your sword and shield, Domin. So it has been, and so it shall be."

358a4ff8-387e-43c5-93cc-b53823c2829c.Text: {n}Your response hangs in the air, turning into an uncomfortable pause. Kibellah closes her eyes, takes a deep breath, and finally breaks the silence first.{/n}

f1d114c0-9de6-4b91-b0df-9bf8046dad14.Text: {n}Kibellah gives you an appraising look.{/n} "None dispute your skill in close combat. Your body is well hardened, and perhaps you could even learn some of our techniques. Our art, however, is more than just patterns of movement — it is one's ability to give oneself completely to the dance of death. To fight as we do, you would have to empty your being, to start anew, to reject both the title of Domin and all the memories of your own past."

1276e206-0c32-4a60-9433-347f4bce6be4.Text: "Amic'Solomorne, keeper of the law — do you stay so close to him because you fear his verdicts? You fear in vain. Only the Undying One may judge you."

57fcd5d5-39fe-41c0-b6e0-9780ceaaeef7.Text: "Domin." {n}Kibellah raises her chin, her eyes black as the abyss.{/n} "I know {d|Encyclopedia:MiniJealousyRomanceBroken}you have decided to bind yourself to the thread of another{/d}. So be it. I submit to your will. From now on, I will content myself with the role of blade and shadow — the only unbreakable bond I am permitted to have."

fc449ce2-daf3-47d3-8811-af43363da1f7.Text: "Let it be so." {n}Kibellah waits patiently as you prepare yourself for the ritual. Once you are ready, she carefully presses her blade to your skin, and carves the sacred symbol into your flesh with skilful precision. The wounds sting and burn painfully as they begin to bleed.{/n} "Treasure His gift, Domin'{name}. Inscribe it anew each time you pray. May His blessing find you."

b0d684b4-deef-4e0f-841d-10e7344db8d9.Text: "Some loathe and fear us, they call us murderers and reapers. Others call us dancers of death who send the souls of the dead on their way. Both are right. Both are wrong. We are servants of the {g|Encyclopedia:EmperorGlossary}Undying Emperor{/g}. When He whispers that the time has come for a righteous martyr's soul to be laid in His blessed hands, we come to claim it. When He whispers that the wicked must know of His wrath, we come to reap. This is how we maintain order on the ship, unseen and guided by death's will."

1cc26a0d-0ded-4c39-a28c-a5486091f0a1.Text: {n}Kibellah shakes her head slowly.{/n} "Death's whisper is unmistakable. It is not like the murmur of stars or the hiss of corruption. It is truthful. Pure. Unyielding. Only the most eminent of us, the high spinners, can hear the whisper of the Undying One and give voice to His will. They must hone their senses and temper their body and soul for years before His call can reach them. If it puts you more at ease, you can think of these whispers as... His providence."

7855b9d8-84be-4c6c-ae09-72a6c57f1449.Text: "Take heed, Nemo. Our blessed Domin honours us with a visit. The one who delivered this ark from the curse of your existence." {n}The malformed skull in Kibellah's hands has been polished to a pale sheen. Its empty eye sockets pose a question that can only be answered in death.{/n}

6a0ffc23-9572-4b52-92a3-b5c61dd58718.Text: "We are carried along by a current of blood in the great river of fate. Life is not given or taken away by chance. If I see an enemy of Humanity, my blade will sever the thread of their existence. I will not wait for a sign of His divine bidding. I am His will, and I do what must be done."

603aa7a8-7e54-42b8-a5e9-9e06cbee81f0.Text: "There is no thirst, only duty. Killing brings us no pleasure. We are instruments of His will, and this is how we serve Him."

9f443763-5085-4968-9915-c9b2e17ac2de.Text: "It is said that she was one of many. Born in the void. The Domin's subject. She honoured death instead of life, and for this she was persecuted. It is said that when the {g|Encyclopedia:ChaosGlossary}Archenemy{/g}'s forces invaded the flagship during a warp jump, she gathered the Undying One's servants around her and saved the ship from ruin. Together, they spun the first threads of the Web to ensure that such devastation would never happen again. It is said that she was strong and indomitable, but as the years passed, her heart became as stone. And thus the Undying One whispered her name to the one who would become the first Vizsier of the Bloodspun Web."

78f854dc-3d80-45ec-bcfa-f586f43bb758.Text: {n}Kibellah's gaze wanders aimlessly over her temporary shelter. Her bloodless lips whisper a prayer to the Undying Emperor, stumbling over every word:{/n} "For we are Thy blades, washed in blood and darkness. For we are Thy wings, broken and featherless. When the crimson flood comes and the river of death flows, guard us from weakness. Burn away the fear and despair that stain our so—" {n}She falters, and her hands start to shake.{/n} "Our souls, for they are Thine to claim."

3864d189-b960-4bc4-88e5-19ae5a32b22d.Text: "Long has death whispered of Vil'Marazhai's demise. His life is in your hands, his death is in mine. Give the order, and the thread of his life will be cut short before the next watch."

3155ec50-5799-45a4-ab07-86dca5698edc.Text: "I am your blade, Domin'{name}. I will not fail you."

27ff3d32-e7cb-4862-936a-c7dfc412cfd4.Text: "Spinners carved the chronicles of our history on the stones of our temple long ago. But fate and time have erased our past, just as an exploding star erases a part of the galaxy from existence."

eb79ee0c-453d-4626-aae4-600e00cf0c66.Text: "It is the Vizsier's duty to watch over the flock. To lead those who want to learn more of the Undying One but are fearful of death, and guide those who seek answers in death but do not know how to live. The Vizsier protects all — those who do not know we exist, those who are grateful for our service, and even those who hate us. The Vizsier sees what is to come, remembers the past, and accepts the present. They spin a web of faith and blood so strong that no enemy may sunder it. This is the Vizsier's burden. This is the legacy of the Matriarch Spider."

f73fb81d-5225-4303-9fe2-5eb10f6d9f6a.Text: "When we were young, we would sew our eyes shut and wander through the bays for months at a time. Starving. Surviving. Dying. This trial of darkness honed the senses of those who passed it. We were... elated, for we knew we were blessed by Him. When we grew older, we learned to wield our weapons, and our mentors tested us with pain, poison, and the weight of deceitful words. In time, our bodies no longer felt pain. Our blood became resistant to toxins. And our focus could not be shaken. We were at peace, for we had shed everything that could encumber our faithful service to Him."

0fc8bedf-b318-4fc3-861e-ffd07a45b019.Text: "When we came of age, we faced a great trial — a year-long vigil spent in unceasing prayer to the Undying One. When hunger and other base sensations faded away... we attained true comprehension of ourselves and our place in the world. Our place between life and death. We were proud, for on that day, He truly accepted us, and we accepted Him."

f132e11c-232f-44e8-91ae-ce24ba3b799e.Text: "You can see for yourself." {n}Kibellah removes a small leather pouch from her belt and opens it to reveal several instruments of torture.{/n}

b05c3439-aace-4da2-90df-8a8a503db173.Text: "Attachment makes us weak. The weak meet their demise prematurely. But such death does not please the Undying One, for a soul must not be claimed before their time has come. It is true that spinners occasionally cross paths with those outside the cult, but such paths always diverge in the end. We may walk the same road together, but we are nothing more than temporary travelling companions. It is similar for those of your retinue. Our threads may intertwine for a time, but all will go their separate ways as is inevitable."

36830411-446a-4b5d-ae34-b34c291fe0f5.Text: {n}The pouch vanishes as quickly as it appeared.{/n} "You honour me by taking me at my word."

034b18ba-0e30-4e06-b2d0-43faa6a2da62.Text: "You wish to discuss this again? The past should remain where it belongs." {n}Kibellah purses her lips.{/n}

e94fc9f1-4900-47d6-881b-9c8b1c72e1eb.Text: {n}A look of curiosity flashes across Kibellah's face before it is masked by her usual stoic indifference.{/n}

dbd35b88-24ef-4b68-a3e8-4b584be12f55.Text: "Tools for tempering the flesh. If a spinner neglects this practice for too long, their body will weaken and their sensitivity to pain might return. If it does, they will feel the overwhelming agony of every wound they have ever endured... and go mad with torment before the Undying Emperor whispers their name."

8617f547-cf50-491f-bff2-f6abca145d4b.Text: {n}An assortment of small but sophisticated torturer's tools are laid out before you.{/n}

b28dd445-5ff1-4830-bcb1-637130a110ed.Text: {n}Kibellah raises an eyebrow as she watches a crimson stain spread across her clothes.{/n} "You have found an interesting use for this tool, yet it still serves its purpose."

0fd0aebd-f3ac-413f-aaf5-75f9738ca75f.Text: {n}A melancholy shadow passes over her face.{/n} "I remember nothing of my childhood. The Vizsier says this is because of my training and the injuries I received in battle. He told me it is the fate of all high spinners. The only memories I have are of the Bloodspun Web, and the brothers and sisters who serve the cult alongside me."

466bfed6-a77f-4b11-a08d-44136eb7f52d.Text: {n}The black chains dangle from Kibellah's body. They look more like a macabre form of adornment than an implement of torture. Kibellah gathers up the chains and pulls them until her skin goes taut.{/n} "The flesh remains untorn. Good."

be197bc5-b414-4f3e-91ad-96e18f849730.Text: "Is it possible to experience pleasure if one feels nothing?"

af4021a5-0258-4685-8397-42d0b6f40344.Text: {n}Kibellah nods and carefully begins to tend her wounds.{/n} "That is enough. My body may not feel pain, but it still requires rest. Thank you for helping me in my practice, Domin'{name}. You have gained a deeper understanding of the Tenets today."

86c61582-c858-479e-b60c-22f23842e7c7.Text: "You need not be afraid of your shadow. It is merely an image of yourself."

03e2aa42-b9c3-469a-856c-af224c46e3be.Text: "Thirty-four. There used to be more, but some have perished in the darkness of time. Their loss is a great tragedy for the Bloodspun Web."

8694e696-58ee-4cba-8a4a-2e059a7df735.Text: "It brings me comfort when my brothers and sisters cross to the other side. The Undying One has called them to His side so they can serve Him in ways we cannot."

a1a7d236-d31c-4a0d-a6b0-f8a7683b56ae.Text: "It is a holy relic that has been passed down from generation to generation. Only the First and Second Spinners are allowed to study the sacred cards and interpret their meaning. We use His Tarot to guide the cult and discern the tangled threads of fate."

99766e1f-8dec-4322-9566-9a49b2d9f613.Text: "I..." {n}She winces and looks away.{/n} "I still remember our first meeting, Domin. Like it was yesterday. Every day I spent at the temple of the Undying One. Every one of the Vizsier's lessons. Every soul I've ever ushered to the other side. Every... death of my body, and every revival."

9dfc6f9b-a40d-4764-88b3-3da2ff25bdd5.Text: {n}You occasionally feel a shiver run down your spine, or detect faint sparks in the air when you are standing next to Kibellah. It seems her powers only manifest when she is practising divination, or in moments of pious exultation. Kibellah herself does not seem to be aware of her gift.{/n}

c5774ba8-f409-4922-9ee0-258076483907.Text: {n}Kibellah does not appear to possess any psychic powers. If she has a gift, it is limited to the reading of cards.{/n}

3fb26ef7-2a1f-4963-b917-6eff6af6616e.Text: "The cards are silent for now. We will try again later."

425b41b8-9d63-44bc-be3a-c06a91943b71.Text: "Know your enemy, and prevail in battle. Know your ally, and prevail in war."

7ad4f57d-bda7-40b5-86c2-4a8a02f1107a.Text: "The third... The Hound, inverted. Someone has marked you as their prey and is chasing you through a field of traps. The Lost Child... you will leap into one of those traps of your own free will, and place your trust in someone truly desperate."

8404049e-34ca-43ae-93bc-98ce7d9ac218.Text: "How will we meet our journey's end? It is a decision we all must make. And I have already made mine. It will not be here... and it will not be now."

364d8491-c587-4880-88fb-610ef910ab9e.Text: {n}Kibellah stares at you intently. You catch a glimpse of uncertainty in her gaze, but it quickly gives way to cold surety.{/n} "Let's see. The God-Emperor. The Assassin, inverted. The Moon, inverted. The Preacher."

af513b47-fbed-4bd9-a1a7-e97aa7f06cc5.Text: {n}She collects the cards and glances at you uneasily.{/n} "I have told you everything I can, Domin. But there may be more to this than I can see. These omens are unsettling, but we cannot alter our fate. All we can do is... wait. And prepare for the inevitable."

ada5a7f3-9886-4ac5-9fdb-062596b84f3d.Text: {n}Kibellah says nothing for a while. Then, a bitter chuckle escapes her pursed lips.{/n} "'You'... that sounds so strange, considering how many me's were made. Can you be sure you are talking to the same woman you were close to? For all you know, you left her body lying there, in the xenos's cage, where we died and rose to profane life so many times over..."

a1531a4b-7aec-4b58-8121-ab72efa6516b.Text: "And now, just when I need the Bloodspun Web the most... my family, my pillar... is so far away. I didn't notice it at first, this cold that cloaked my shoulders and has been weighing them down ever since we came to this Dark City. The cold of solitude. Everything around me feels wrong, repulsive to my nature..."

6f55d9be-3f40-452c-97a2-948e0f599591.Text: {n}Kibellah suddenly raises her head, pinning you with her dark gaze.{/n} "But you... you don't feel this petrifying fear, do you? Your world and the world of the xenos aren't all that different, are they? Both are full of duplicity and masks that cover fake aspirations and a hunger for pleasure..."

7534bec9-9797-4c76-88e5-a2d04328e950.Text: {n}She bares her teeth, like a rabid beast.{/n} "I've seen those you call His servants! Not one of those souls spends their every waking hour trembling at the thought of their duty to Him! Empty talk and base delights — that is all they toil for!"

96663ac6-478b-404a-8319-3d7bd1156713.Text: "Are you, Domin'{name}? We are trapped in a waking nightmare that scorns all that is holy! How do I know that the xenos rot hasn't poisoned you too?"

b0eb0c26-d25e-4715-a9c2-1a021a0d82cf.Text: {n}Kibellah bursts into throaty laughter.{/n} "Oh, I see! Your loyal blade raised its voice while talking to you — and there goes your faith in me!"

e92efa71-df69-4c04-895d-5da46b9780c8.Text: "Hubris clouded my mind. I thought I knew everything. I was granted the title of Second Spinner and the favour of the Undying One... but my pride was my undoing. This is the punishment for my arrogance and stupidity."

d40d844c-3dab-4363-bcf1-6862a2756312.Text: {n}After a few heavy seconds of silence, Kibellah exhales through clenched teeth. Fury slowly gives way to weariness, despair. Then, quietly, she says,{/n} "Our bond, Domin'{name}. Our bond was a mistake. I can't pass this trial because my thoughts are distracted by pointless worries."

ff5b1d5b-ab78-4ae5-9b0d-07ee3b8138d5.Text: {n}Kibellah shakes her head.{/n} "Whatever has stretched the thread between us, we must stop it. It blurs our reason, robs our thoughts of their cold clarity, makes us lose the path... through the labyrinth..." {n}Her fingers twitch, instinctively looking for a knife.{/n} "The Vizsier... told us..."

2d0f3a33-e16e-458d-8557-b269a981105d.Text: "My grief is all the bitterer for knowing the truth: though worry for you stabs at my mind without remit, yours is occupied with thoughts of another — the one you've tied yourself to in the same way we are bound."

bb744b59-28dd-44c7-a359-2a4a96694b57.Text: {n}Kibellah tilts her head.{/n} "What you call mysterious is merely the difference between the worlds we each inhabit. You have stepped into my labyrinth, and I have become your shadow. And yet... we have no understanding of one another, or of each other's customs and rituals. I cannot imagine that you were able to comprehend what transpired on the officers' deck in its full depth."

a1f7f494-00cb-4751-8543-468de75f4972.Text: {n}Kibellah nods.{/n} "And yet we both serve Him, as is our duty."

ada1600b-354c-4601-b2f2-a940e9c7dbe7.Text: {n}Kibellah thinks for a moment before a spark of curiosity flashes in her eyes.{/n} "I would not be against learning more about your world, seeing your rituals, Domin'{name}... should you be open to showing them to me."

9b135a79-335e-4d2e-9bd6-84086ce4a6f0.Text: {n}The expression in Kibellah's eyes changes: she glances at you from beneath her eyelashes and smiles slightly.{/n} "I'm here, Domin'{name}."

5d49e642-b172-4798-b89e-fd5b9db0c2bd.Text: {n}Kibellah clenches her fists.{/n} "The Tenets of the Bloodspun Web give us purpose, a destiny in His service! How could I even consider—" {n}She groans as if in pain.{/n} "Then again, the Vizsier also didn't consider a place as poisoned as this..."

a8a2eb0e-f386-48e2-a928-6b9b200c82c9.Text: {n}She falls silent. The echo of a grim smirk crosses her lips.{/n} "The Dark City's shadows will hide my every trespass against the Bloodspun Web, and I will emerge purified. Strong. Untarnished." {n}She glances at you warily.{/n} "Leave me, Domin'{name}. I must traverse the labyrinth with your words in my soul."

6336344d-6f92-42ac-94b2-51af018577a1.Text: "The Tenets teach us to be without doubt and trust the fate He has chosen for us. We must not know fear. We must not feel regret. I... I came close to abandoning the truth. But you did not let me, Domin'{name}. Please accept my gratitude."

49f60f86-c01d-44fa-be36-c42f26d7eb1c.Text: "Veni'Cassia... I've seen the way she looks at you. The way you look at her. You crave her fluttering soul... Why? Is it because it's so easy to break?"

e223ab7d-16a8-4d57-ab3b-43641770ac0d.Text: "Veni'Heinrix is duty-bound to act as your sentinel — do you hope to cloud his mind, throw him off his guard? These rituals do not become you, Domin'{name}!"

df16d859-aada-4633-8038-7f2fef70b7ec.Text: "The evasive Vil'Jae is not your equal, neither in soul nor in thought. Her shallow words and farcical deeds are but a colourful shell that cannot conceal just how little remains of her teetering faith."

3f1efc32-d044-45c2-99c3-ef7d393bc3ad.Text: "Vil'Marazhai... How could you accept him into your faithful host? Already he has sunk his claws into your soul. I can feel his venom within you. Tear out this treacherous needle, or he will drink your soul to the last drop."

dbda47c6-918c-4f22-a288-e2de99f56d70.Text: "The very orchestrator of our capture, Vil'Yrliet! Your bond is but one of the reasons why we couldn't foresee the betrayal! And you would trust her with your shadow? Let her breathe the same air we do?"

d3dabe2f-b1b8-4f3f-954c-16aef2197f6f.Text: {n}Kibellah stares at you intently — perhaps too intently. She says nothing.{/n}

2102234d-72e3-4114-9482-23dcad0de478.Text:
Kibellah is the finest assassin in the Bloodspun Web, a death cult dwelling in the bowels of the von Valancius flagship. From an early age, she was trained in the sacred art of assassination and the methods of steeling one's body and spirit that go along with it. It would seem that her soul has grown as cold as a blade that brings nothing but death... Or has it?
Becoming the Rogue Trader's bodyguard introduced Kibellah to the world of the upper decks, a world of new sensations and experiences. This cold-blooded killer finds herself pondering her destiny and purpose ever more often. Eventually, she will be forced to decide who she really is: a flawless instrument of death — or a person.

ab1371e4-b310-4322-aa3e-8fa92d1ed1e9.Text: "Your subjects have turned the act of killing into amusement. This is a great sacrilege, Domin'{name}, but have no fear. I will explain the will of the Undying One to the laypeople."

7ff267fe-b261-415f-8179-e8a54403d057.Text: "Our enemy's might is... unfathomable. Offer a prayer to the Undying One, for we will appear before His Throne soon."

b3c29d5a-7c0e-4ef6-b8d5-83ae3a4a987b.Text: "On this day, an ancient and terrible foe fell, as was His will. Let us thank the Undying Emperor for choosing us for this great mission."

aa847cf0-ed4b-48e6-93cb-87f508103f9d.Text: "It... has no thread, no name! Undying One guide me... How can such a thing be killed?"

fc5a0dea-4271-4751-acd2-3f4120b397a3.Text: "I am glad to see you undaunted by the unknown."

18feb8bc-df7a-4f78-8501-a17dfb073011.Text: "I thank the Emperor for having met you."

ffab44a6-7fa6-4bb9-a4f7-cab08fb1a519.Text: "Now would be a good time to receive an inkling about our future. Have you consulted the Tarot?"

5cd2105d-4133-410a-a1bb-d50d06906fc7.Text: "Have you thought about what happens afterward? If we survive."

abd1865b-b1bf-48b7-8703-e0def3c8f98c.Text: "Whatever awaits us, it is time we set forth."

196e6fda-9aee-4ef2-a3f5-2fbd5a29f33b.Text: "My love for you will give me strength."

be65669d-d9ca-4093-a117-ff52237fcb11.Text: {n}Kibellah stands motionless, deep in trance, but returns to reality the moment you approach.{/n} "Your every breath and heartbeat has been in anticipation of this moment, Domin'{name}. Do not hesitate. Step into the darkness and allow your shield and shadow to walk with you."

9ccac4a0-4321-487d-9a1d-ebcfe6efe1fc.Text: "There is no need for a reading. The {g|Encyclopedia:ImperialTarotGlossary}cards{/g} will ask if we are prepared to face the challenge with dignity. And that will be the answer to our own question."

b6817477-405b-485a-90e3-7d3fdcb8c7ed.Text: {n}Kibellah lowers her gaze and stays quiet for a while. Her eyes are full of tenderness and deep, sincere love.{/n} "I will forever be your shadow, until the Undying One bestows upon me the greatest reward for my service."

8bfa3ecf-6f05-41b9-a0e7-3e9240c67eb6.Text: {n}Kibellah gives you a thin smile.{/n} "Gaze upon me whenever you feel your faith in yourself waning. Seek strength in this union of the strong, and remember: only the victor commands the flow of history."

1794a26e-a96f-4c06-9cc3-cf91b21a938d.Text: {n}Kibellah lets silence fall, keeping her deathly calm gaze on you.{/n}

a08d4a9e-24e4-4280-adf8-b014a8bb2e75.Text: "Now and forever, each of us must follow our own thread. And so it shall be, until the day we find ourselves in His embrace." {n}Her lips curve into a smile.{/n} "But what's between us... It has made a web that joins you and me, and along that web our love will travel. I will stay strong. I will hold. Because it is what the Tenets demand, and because I can do no less for you."

af48928b-8846-42f0-9f07-10342829bd9d.Text: "Once we are done triumphing over our enemies?" {n}She presses a finger to her lips.{/n} "I have spent some time considering the future of the Bloodspun Web... and I think that the cult is due for a new set of Tenets. I should keep the details to myself... for now."

ac4bc3eb-a9d6-44d1-a4fa-ad33264eb050.Text: "Such was His design. In the pattern of the Bloodspun Web, my thread stretched out to yours, Domin'{name}. To shield you. To serve you." {n}She touches a wound that has barely begun to heal.{/n} "And every night, I praise Him for the honour of letting me twine around your path."

dce1bbae-915c-4ba2-a10b-52e0af09dbe7.Text: {n}She frowns as if failing to understand the question.{/n} "A shadow is inseparable from its master, Domin'{name}. I will follow you as before and guard your thread."

7d3eae23-7629-4f82-a1bb-1f02573a6fee.Text: "Every thread ends in death... but only the Undying One knows the time and place."

4cb69d27-b80e-4125-824a-d0d538f7f8e5.Text: "The Undying One has given us a great gift — a path of thorns, a fate of trials. What is it, if not a sign of His favour? We will either offer our victory to Him or find His embrace."

07d00cd1-0962-49ac-b33f-0091148c96b2.Text: {n}Kibellah hurries near to kiss you, then steps back just as quickly. There is a spark of warmth in her eyes.{/n} "The Grace of the Web guides us hand in hand, Domin'{name}. Death will be our reward for a thread honourably followed."

faa5b144-8430-47e4-948f-f51486c93264.Text: "You wish to foresee what lies along our thread? Do not try. When the hour is right, the future will reveal itself to you. Until then, we can only do what we must and pray for His blessing."

5ebb0e81-d6a6-44d9-b718-2974746c077e.Text: "The Undying One has extended His hand, showing us the way. Lead us, Domin'{name}."

4f4c6579-bb54-45a2-a552-e16f22add4cb.Text: Kibellah's skin is covered in countless injection marks. Black, tendril-like webs of burnt nerves radiate outward around each one.

656c0560-4ea0-456b-802f-cad138120767.Text: "Let your thoughts be as rays of His avenging light. As eternal night does fade at the touch of a sun, so let the faces of corruption that lurk in the darkness be destroyed by your hand."

a484f50b-1621-4244-a4aa-18bd4ad7752c.Text: "Genetic aberration has sullied this temple of memory. I will conduct a vigil in the crypt to ensure that all corruption is expelled and the Emperor's light shines in His halls once more."

7d4a1f1f-5ef6-47e1-9082-272735f8d205.Text: The hole in the wall seems to grin with broken teeth, as if mocking the dynasty's ancestors. It would be impossible to make a hole like that without industrial tools.

91817ebb-9d6e-490d-990f-c1d04fcfc756.Text: "Every enforcer who died took a dozen heretics with them. It is a great honour to shed blood for the von Valancius dynasty."

c4ce775c-4761-4cb4-9a83-56e7b024a245.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! We will make sure that no blasphemous freak disturbs the dead ever again."

af95967e-c154-439d-a7ca-443517b250dc.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, we're ready to move out! The sacred halls will be purged of heretics and mutants!"

52f5b1ba-b7d0-405f-b3dd-291d80fa3504.Text: "Inferni, break the freak like a rotten bulkhead! Forward, for House von Valancius!"

e175e5e4-cf67-4daf-89d7-316f819c099b.Text: "The bastards made a mess of the maintenance tunnels — our folks saw a good few breaches and some other damage. Infernus crews are already patching them up, so the tunnels will be good as new in no time."

230751af-6448-4847-a8f7-d47efa1022df.Text: "Forward, faithful pure! Crush those who oppose the coming of the Many-Armed Emperor!"

6fb421a7-f3d8-4364-b6d4-92d532c0661d.Text: "Flamer squads have already been assigned to the side sections — soon the defilers' bodies will be nothing but ash piles. I won't stop until the last stain of this disease has been wiped away."

0adb0bb7-6d9b-4e26-98bb-59e8328e2480.Text: Theodora's statue towers over the broken urn. Her gaze is confident and bold, as if she is challenging those who have dared disturb the Rogue Trader's rest.

2875baa1-6dc9-4c1c-acca-330f43a20515.Text: Above the hundred different names is an engraved inscription: "To all who made the highest sacrifice for the dynasty and paid with their life, honour, and name: I will remember you."

a9bbbff3-b346-4073-8a2c-af02ee68e4dc.Text: This sarcophagus belongs to the first Rogue Trader of House von Valancius. Merciless time has erased their name from the stone.

595f73a2-5d6d-4712-9b37-350e29b81e90.Text: "Here lies Alaric Wolfgang of Geschter, the first Seneschal to have come on board this vessel. Your duty is done, now others will serve in your stead."

849954ef-7243-4f7e-9940-7ed198e123d4.Text: "Glory to the diligent servants of the dynasty who have exalted the title of Seneschal."

32823cf9-2d70-4952-bef7-7dae30990ad3.Text: "We are Rogue Traders, and ours is a rare destiny. Yet still we remember those who once walked at our side, who served us, whom we honoured."

59ee8f59-3fac-4ba3-8497-2009e6dbaceb.Text: "Remember the deeds of the hero who died to protect the Lord Captain."

44362bb9-f6f6-4ab3-917c-fa11805ea5b9.Text: The lid of the sarcophagus depicts a tall, scrawny man, likely a voidborn. It is unclear why his resting place was hidden from sight.

538e7327-4731-403d-90db-7ade3d29a54e.Text: At first glance, the sarcophagus depicts a man, but you can tell by the body proportions and designs of xenos origin that an Aeldari is buried here. It is small wonder that his resting place was hidden from sight. This xenos must have been someone important to one of the Rogue Traders.

7c548ccf-2e8a-40d5-acbc-aab8c1d7d16a.Text: The gate does not yield. The luminator servo-skull beam reveals the lifeless cable of the entry cogitator snaking into the dark.

1d0a64bb-dd83-4082-a5d9-2a8980010443.Text: The servitor is gone. Fresh pools of blood and embalming fluid drip down into some deep grooves on the floor that look like they were left by monstrous claws.

c0069f64-1189-4191-ba63-e1bc9074304a.Text: The gates have been blocked to cut off all possible escape routes for heretics and enforcers alike. They will not open until your victory has been secured.

1cadcc18-11c6-46a8-a4c9-e9ac72fce838.Text: The sarcophagus was installed recently. The inscription reads: "Here, Arch-Militant Mort keeps his eternal vigil, protecting in death the one he could not protect in life."

24439f20-1f6e-4438-aec1-a93dbb06fd86.Text: Wires protrude from the servitor's severed head, wrapping around a fragment of its spine. The broken jaw twitches frantically, struggling to shut.

3ef6abea-c271-409a-8bae-a1686ccddf84.Text: The skull gives in, and something clicks beneath it. Somewhere in the dark, a passage opens up with a rumbling groan.

77b287c6-cac2-426e-8e74-52ab84e15bfb.Text: You discover a dusty button disguised as the Aquila. As you press it, you hear the creak of an ancient mechanism. Something has opened somewhere.

35bda4bb-a2c3-4e70-ba85-10c7e6f7e21e.Text: The sour smell of putrid meat and rust hits your senses — the beheaded bodies of the servitors have begun to decompose. You can make out lacerations on their rotting flesh, and their augmetics have been partially melted by some caustic substance.

2108be89-0645-48d9-85a3-64a546c37b46.Text: In the pale light of the lumen, the servitor looks like an animated corpse. But no grave will ever accept a human who has become a thing.

acf63649-b062-4710-b04f-c26f73e136e8.Text: Your speech has fanned your people's hatred for genetic miscreants.

84439221-0d8f-4968-a63e-2939b1502670.Text: The evidence discovered on the upper layer of the crypt suggests that the conspirators are heavily armed and have mutants in their midst. The Rogue Trader and {mf|his|her} retinue are prepared for the fight ahead.

4f217021-25de-4d6b-8385-060928f6f4e9.Text: "Whether through darkness or well-lit halls, we are going in."

7999cc30-27b2-40ef-8ffe-47ccf7de82c0.Text: "Then arm yourselves properly. A torch seems like a poor weapon indeed."

7cfada9b-f8d1-4fdd-ab8b-76ff4b989d51.Text: "I hereby remove the brand of shame from the Infernus Guild and permit them to carry weapons, fight, and die for this ship."

1e15bdec-115b-4724-87ee-5b9b993a8f84.Text: "Confessor Adalbert, I ask for your blessing before a righteous battle."

0528ad24-7d6f-4045-bbdf-10568ffc6cc7.Text: "Those who descend from traitors deserve no trust. You are not allowed inside the crypt."

3417df8d-91a4-4227-ab07-e8c2b7a03e9b.Text: "Do not throw your lives away. Stay out of this."

d8d4745f-438a-42db-a585-378d6ceea4f1.Text: "Why did you fail to discover this earlier?"

8155ee67-090f-4a04-bd29-ce70f28a6768.Text: "Then you will use the means you have to fight. And die, if it is required of you."

c323367d-f99f-489c-ab69-e2157e201dce.Text: "Children of the Emperor, I bless your crusade! Today, He watches over us!"

e763ec46-e620-4307-9ba3-b310807fcb5b.Text: "Your expeditious performance is laudable, Infernus Master."

5239cd6f-9a5d-48b1-b0f8-6ce5d7c8c075.Text: [Shout] "Soldiers! Our ship lies behind us, and our enemy awaits ahead! No mercy, no cowardice, and no turning back — this is my order to you!"

1a7e81b5-520a-4254-ac08-bdc1a687b671.Text: {n}Adalbert, the ship's confessor, solemnly raises his hands above the altar and speaks mournfully,{/n} "Heed me, O guardian spirits! We have come to punish a great desecration: heresy has made its lair in the dynastic crypt and disturbed the peace of our honoured dead. I beg you to perform the ritual of unsealing and allow us passage."

2a6a40cd-e8da-4172-802e-2d933707d840.Text: "Those spared people became the Infernus Guild — repairmen, firefighters... those who bear the brunt of any disaster and are the first to die. That was our penance. It's been centuries, and still we die not just because our duty demands it, but because we atone for what our ancestors did. The enforcers keep reminding us about it, and if they see an armed infernus, they'll execute them on the spot. Such was the Lord Captain's will."

4e561de7-8055-4618-b274-81e0dd49e54f.Text: {n}The Infernus Master and his people leave the hall. The doors of the crypt are open. It is time to step into the darkness.{/n}

cdf72e5a-b9e4-4f74-9290-cb2c452645d4.Text: {n}The officer bows his head with dignity. You notice fresh oil stains on his coat — it seems he not only sent his underlings, but also went to investigate the area himself.{/n}

fabea4d3-c921-498a-8fc5-f53c88343823.Text: "I fear we might be underestimating the enemy. The enforcers have already done it once. I... The Infernus Guild would join you in this fight, if you would have us. To get inside, the aberrations would have had to make a passage for themselves somewhere in the crypt's perimeter. No one knows the maintenance tunnels better than us. We could find this breach and attack the enemy from the rear. I doubt a few workers armed with axes and torches will make much of a difference, but we would be honoured to die in your name."

ceeadbff-2a04-49f9-85eb-660fa1fb7e48.Text: "Lord Captain, we now require your blood. The crypt will not open without the Rogue Trader's genetic signature."

4de43dca-b0f6-412a-b47c-aef61a541856.Text: {n}The panel's mechanical teeth sting your flesh, and you feel your blood trickling down the small ducts into the altar's bowels. You hear a click, and the crypt doors open with a piercing creak. Beyond them, you see nothing but darkness.{/n}

343d9450-fa23-401c-a02c-5bc900e2caf2.Text: "This was done on purpose, I'm sure of it. Our coming is expected. Vanguard, provide the Lord Captain with a luminator servo-skull!" {n}She gives you a surprisingly easy smile and bows.{/n} "Take care, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, and watch out for dark corners. Move out! For House von Valancius!"

de6e22e2-673d-499b-83f0-2410428769d6.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, wait! There's been..." {n}Einrich bursts into the antecompartment and stops short when he sees the open doors and the gloom beyond.{/n} "Damn it, I'm late. I meant to report an act of sabotage. They've cut off the {g|Encyclopedia:Promethium}promethium{/g} supply to the crypt's lighting. You're walking into an ambush."

1316054f-3a64-43c9-b5b2-768cb4ba626e.Text: "Depends on who's wielding it," {n}Einrich says with a chuckle, but then his expression darkens.{/n} "The Infernus Guild is banned from taking up arms. Our clan is branded because our ancestors were rebels. The station where we originally hail from once rose against Lady Theodora's predecessor. The traitors were killed, and the rest of the station was left stranded in the void to die without air or water. Out of those who repented, the Rogue Trader selected a thousand who were allowed on board."

a1ed6c18-6cc7-43e0-b73f-a5d3929d92b6.Text: {n}His eyes widen in astonishment.{/n} "Your... I... I never would have dared to ask, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. We will live up to your expectations, I swear it. Those who die today will die smiling, for today is a great day for our people!"

bfc74981-3600-4c8a-91a1-f871f5e11fd1.Text: {n}Einrich hangs his head.{/n} "I understand. I hope we will redeem ourselves before the dynasty one day. Since we may not enter, we will focus our efforts on finding the breach in the maintenance tunnels. We won't launch a surprise attack on the traitors, but at least we'll block their escape routes with our bodies and axes."

6aa31a90-5ac9-4162-9984-d6d001e1ee42.Text: {n}Abelard scowls.{/n} "What opportune time you've chosen to tell this tragic tale, Monteg. So... convenient."

dc715bbf-cb67-4c19-b800-5da756c9da9c.Text: "They covered their tracks well. But I was... worried about your safety." {n}Einrich smiles somewhat sheepishly.{/n} "Which is why I took the liberty of sending maintenance patrols to inspect the perimeter of the crypt."

612e2502-d98c-4fcb-83e0-25bf335abb06.Text: "We will, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Dying is second nature to us. The Emperor protects!"

82366870-0b53-47e1-b61c-ef92700577d1.Text: "Show no mercy!" {n}Argenta's face brightens in anticipation of battle, and her eagerness spreads to the enforcers.{/n}

9a2167a4-4be6-45d4-9226-a90fb900718d.Text: {n}Their faces glow with righteous indignation and a drive to exterminate the traitors who dared to invade the sanctity of the dynasty's most eminent dead. Your {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Ministorum}sermon{/d} has ignited a fire in their hearts.{/n}

e44dbb51-2fd7-403c-9ecb-1e342818c924.Text: "A fight, at last! For the Allfather! Fenrys hjolda!" {n}The enforcers match Ulfar's roar with growing excitement.{/n}

69ac95c1-310e-4900-914d-d9d25cb9f6e3.Text: "As you command. Please be careful, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

b0655e29-f667-4c33-8b6a-2ebd60bbc53f.Text: {n}The warriors' faces show staunch pride and a readiness to die rather than bring shame to their {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Militarum}commander{/d}.{/n}

4528d459-7439-4738-864c-8bf67df4c844.Text: {n}A hand-shaped panel opens in the altar of unsealing. The panel is lined with sharp spikes.{/n}

7a0155bd-2de5-45b1-9dab-18f76c6a1adb.Text: "Ready as never before, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. They are incensed by this profane intrusion and eager to exterminate the menace before the eyes of our departed ancestors. My enforcers will secure the side sections of the crypt to prevent any flanking attacks."

150a89f0-6c08-4586-9e9a-f8edfff05f26.Text: "May the Emperor protect His children who carry forth His cleansing flame. Hear the roar of chainswords and the bellow of autoguns, for they are His voice. Oft do I preach clemency to our noble officers, but this I say to you now: lay aside pity and show no mercy!"

20c411d1-bfad-4a80-9250-90551d4eea42.Text: "Sacrilege! The hallowed crypt must remain illuminated at all times to drive away the shadows from the place of the ancestors' final repose!"

b11257ab-3796-455a-8f5b-244708494113.Text: "Why did you make your lair here in the crypt?"

d1ef5e12-582f-4aa9-98ac-28f24d9b42a1.Text: "It was you I saw in that vision. Are you the leader of this spawn?"

aba90d3b-3acb-4d13-80c0-009338e5d7a8.Text: "Sauerback, I have rectified the consequences of your blunder. But that does not mean I have forgotten who was responsible for letting this taint spread on my ship."

846f66ba-4574-4890-a85a-89794b1acd79.Text: "What are you? Are you mutants or xenos?"

64f00643-74a5-4926-ad8c-a9b8ae2f3c76.Text: [Nudge one of his wounds with the toe of your boot]

1ce39c2f-64ba-40ed-93a3-38c1195f9a25.Text: "Are there more of you freaks on board? Where did you even come from?"

3f880961-ced6-4a13-82e7-01141f3c6eed.Text: "Do all Rogue Traders have their remains turned into gemstones?"

4eef6643-a076-459f-afec-c5eb3a63d97a.Text: "Henceforth, the relic shall remain in my keeping."

8236e3c0-9140-4ec5-9738-cfb11f396fd5.Text: "Return the relic to Lady Theodora's urn."

d3f0968a-e21a-45fc-a180-eebe6fe3e4a6.Text: "Well then, let's see what the ringleader has to say."

e589fe2f-4640-4c75-a0b1-b0358d88dd4a.Text: "Adalbert, how much of the crypt has been desecrated?"

118106fc-3eb3-44c9-8aad-badfef7297cc.Text: "Einrich, I see that you found the hole through which the mutant scum wormed their way inside."

c5d2fa02-8bab-481b-9d6d-653ecd4aa4ff.Text: "Jocasta Sauerback, I pardon the enforcers their negligence that led to treason endangering the ship. You and your people have proven yourselves."

f6819374-eb29-468f-9e06-b177ca55a11c.Text: {n}The old man before you resembles a human being, but the scaled bony growths going from the bridge of his nose to the top of his bloated, hairless head, the grotesque cheekbones, and the black claws on his meaty fingers leave no doubt that this creature is a genetic aberration. He utters in a creaking voice, black spittle spraying from his mouth,{/n} "You have spilt the blood of the Congregation. You have offended the purest of His chosen children! You... heretic!"

0f4f49dc-935b-4883-a605-c89e71877b6f.Text: {n}Sauerback's gaze remains trained on the mutant. You notice deep wounds on her chest and shoulder, but she shows no signs of acknowledging their existence.{/n} "Strike forces have cleared the side sections of mutants. The freaks fought like madmen, but they could not match the skill of the von Valancius enforcers. Once victory was secured, our pursuit units made sure that none would escape. Our flamer squads are in the process of purging the crypt. All degenerates confirmed dead."

e83543ca-5c7e-4658-8305-85823e6ff96f.Text: {n}You glance at the gaping hole in the adamantine bulkhead. It is almost unbelievable that the mutants were able to make a hole like that — they would have required truly powerful industrial equipment, and not the kind that can be easily assembled or stolen.{/n}

d7e46823-9284-46da-bd2b-59bd263bbd46.Text: "We have. This discovery cost the guild sixty-eight souls. It was crowded in those tunnels. They set monsters on us, but... Few things can scare someone who has seen a fire in the arsenal bay."

a1efd031-9706-4c5f-8604-638519fbac40.Text: "I have words to say to you as well, heretic. Every beast akin to you shall perish in the flames of purgation. Their hearts shall burn away, and their lungs shall boil until their chests burst. You promise us death? We are already cutting through your vicious spawn." {n}The old man lets out a hateful shriek and starts thrashing like a monster of the warp before a holy image.{/n}

3b71c521-a02a-434f-85f1-46b6f71488ea.Text: {n}The mutant erupts in wet, slurping laughter.{/n} "I am the herder of the pure! The Many-Armed Emperor has blessed my mind with the ability to behold Him, and I guided His children... until you came and slaughtered us, heretic!"

de025cdf-8638-4989-87c2-062026e513aa.Text: "The true god who comes through the void to us, His devout children. The universe is an abyss of horrors, and only He can save us! But not you, vile heretics! You are all doomed!"

ce1e07de-fe8b-4f2b-aaf2-a1321008fd51.Text: "I will perform the ritual and pray in hopes of easing Lady Theodora's anger."

60a3d2e7-a6ae-4291-8524-55fc07f295b5.Text: {n}His face becomes a gloating grimace.{/n} "We are the pure! We are the Congregation, children of the Many-Armed Emperor, the genetic perfection of existence! You will never understand... You are of inferior flesh, your genes are woven from feebleness and misery. We are the new curve of the spiral. We are one, and thus we are strong."

baa93144-5342-43d6-bf77-2550e423c5c2.Text: "I've been waiting for this." {n}The sound of your voice hangs in the air as the steel toe of Sauerback's mag-boot pulverises the man's knee and bone shards shred his decrepit flesh like shrapnel.{/n}

0bf5c2c8-abe8-48e2-8c55-ad26d829e444.Text: {n}The old man doubles over, but it is not pain or fear but burning hatred that contorts his face.{/n} "Go on, torture me! I'll endure it all. My time may be up, but you are all doomed! I will gladly spit the words of truth in your face and they will burn you like acid! In death I will ascend to the hosts of pure voices and I will await the day when you will pay for the shed blood of His children!"

5cd0b66f-2f88-44b7-af02-ed9bf794da0e.Text: {n}The man's face twists in rage and his milky eyes bulge. He hisses,{/n} "The Many-Armed Emperor cometh! The true god shall avenge us! And when He does, I will laugh—" {n}His string of doomsayings is silenced by a kick from the Master-at-Arms.{/n}

1b29a152-6edc-4921-9cf4-99a94e55f619.Text: "Forty years ago, the profaner Theodora, the false sovereign, stopped at the trade outpost Heriokh's Rim to replenish her crew. The outpost had long served as a bastion of the pure. My brethren and I were chosen to embark on her ship and prepare it for the coming of the Many-Armed Emperor. This uprising against your godless dominion has been many years in the making..."

bb66f2ce-b8f8-4ef2-8b94-7dd97c5be5b2.Text: "Heriokh's Rim. That cesspool of abomination must be burned. Who knows how many ships they have infected over the decades."

8c57470f-9ad5-4fcd-a05c-91d5003bf3f1.Text: "The accursed spawn have disrespected the spirits of the dead, but, thankfully, they did not have enough time to wreak as much destruction as they could have. Many tombs were disturbed, but what is the most outrageous..." {n}Adalbert carefully presents you with a sapphire-blue gemstone.{/n} "They sought to despoil Lady Theodora's urn."

72a62c3c-2a21-4063-ae91-dc91359267c8.Text: "After Her Ladyship's cremation, her ashes were made into this magnificent relic, an example of resilience and purity. One of the heretics dared to lay claim to it."

3b333e51-f86e-4fc7-86b0-57fcf76c8184.Text: {n}Abelard stares at the gem with a crestfallen expression. His lip twitches as if he is struggling against a new wave of grief or else enraged at the thought of someone so heinously violating Theodora's rest. He forces himself to look away without saying a word.{/n}

ea76ef10-574c-4f26-96ab-6d6635f74c4b.Text: {n}The sight of the gem takes Idira's breath away. You catch her quiet whisper:{/n} "She's beautiful. Even in death, she shines on."

624d17eb-9657-44bf-b9b7-3f3e0f9cb54f.Text: "Not all, no. Tradition demands that the Lord Captain's body be burned so that no one could use samples of their tissue or blood to gain access to the ship's systems that require the Rogue Trader's genetic imprint. Lady Theodora herself once voiced her desire to be turned into a stone."

a72df960-85cf-4c70-87e5-e811036b3700.Text: "If such is Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}'s wish. I see deep symbolism in this duty."

538f816c-4020-4cd9-a9f0-6bb426fe8a33.Text: {n}The Master-at-Arms lowers her head.{/n} "Our honour is sullied. We have failed our forebears. Our ineptitude and weakness are shameful, Lord Captain."

0865c6fc-e356-4189-9fdb-5e3a5aa079b7.Text: {n}Sauerback casts a hostile look at the autopistol on Einrich's belt but says nothing.{/n}

fb778272-d7bc-416a-9243-c89633e9899f.Text: "You shall perish in the cold void, your heart shall beat its last under the light of uncaring stars, your lungs shall become trees of ice within your chest! You will never receive the grace of the Many-Armed Emperor!" {n}The old man calls curse after curse down upon you with spiteful satisfaction.{/n}

6951fdc0-c0f4-4df4-b333-58dd65043913.Text: "Their loathsome tribe has spawned a sorcerer." {n}Sauerback grimaces in disgust.{/n} "No doubt to help them brainwash more victims and swell the cult's ranks."

c2fc49bf-1cd0-472e-802c-eee730d57f79.Text: "Psychic ability, human-like appearance, high status within the cult... I believe we are looking at a so-called Magus — a psychically-gifted Genestealer cultist. The cult's elite. A Magus's speciality is recruitment and subjugation."

b1e322eb-ae6f-4436-938f-3e65c6fc2797.Text: {n}The malice alight in the abomination's eyes leaves no doubt — no barrier could have stopped him, intent as he was on committing sacrilege.{/n}

d08e2dc4-19f7-41f3-938e-ad0d13e74db1.Text: {n}Pasqal's visor flashes scarlet, growing brighter with every word.{/n} "This statement is false. Only the True Flesh is perfect. You are a scrap of ignorant meat, and this vaunted genetic perfection, which you are not, will be ground into nothing by the cogs of the Omnissiah." {n}The old man shrinks and hisses as his face is bathed in the red light of the visor, itself framed by the shadows of writhing mechadendrites.{/n}

d529b5a8-8b73-472e-9099-7c33c4ba730c.Text: {n}Yrliet touches her spirit stone, and it resonates with a soft, pearly glow.{/n} "They may appear similar. And yet, as bright as mon-keigh relics are on the surface, they are hollow inside. They hold no memory, no life."

addb8bbc-d6db-4a2e-9d5f-951688626a89.Text: "Be silent, xenos. This place has heard too many blasphemous utterances already, and your voice is trying its patience."

969b0e87-5389-43cf-83b8-88f140947ee6.Text: {n}The creature's last word elicits a nervous laugh from the nearby enforcers — the irony of this embodied perversion of the human form accusing you of heresy is not lost on them. The confessor whispers a quiet prayer. The Master-at-Arms is watching the old man's every move, her lips twisted in contempt.{/n}

95ff55b7-8b62-4a92-9592-c1ee3428202c.Text: "None wander in here. We were free to offer our prayers without fear of discovery. And the sight of dead heretics... was pleasing! Trampling your bones was a righteous act! That is why I ordered the pure to sunder the walls of your bone vault and make this place a sanctuary for the Congregation!" {n}He sneers.{/n}

ca0c891b-9398-4f5d-907c-b2193146a2ab.Text: "The ashes of the other eminent dead, whose rest was disturbed, will be transferred to the reliquary chapel. Rites of redemption will be held day and night. Thousands of the ship's crew will be allowed to kneel before the relics and pray for the Lord Captain's health and the dynasty's prosperity."

394b62a9-189a-4e69-b9f4-dc4f8aa0097a.Text: "Now I see why so many inspectors in the adjacent compartments have had 'accidents.'"

8f3f6acd-bf93-407c-800c-b97fb0f34e69.Text: {n}You notice that the crypt looks surprisingly... undefiled, even after all these years. The heretics could have turned it into an inconceivable nightmare, yet the signs of corruption are few and localised here.{/n}

61021fc8-2fd2-4713-b32e-17ae688f9cef.Text: {n}She bows her head respectfully, and her expression relaxes. She responds with a weak smile,{/n} "Thank you for restoring our honour, Lord Captain."

fb3f23db-3887-4f47-a582-0ec7d88cb749.Text: Lady Theodora's ashes were subjected to immense pressure and turned into this resplendent diamond to be interred in the ship's crypt. The gemstone's sapphire hues veined with gold and purple are reminiscent of the von Valancius family colours.

eb8eeaa1-29e8-4643-a07c-f5f5d35e36ec.Text: "I feel like I'm being watched. Do you think it's—"

9ff88afa-6935-4a5e-af9e-238c78ac7913.Text: "Relax. The Bloodspun Web serves the Rogue Trader. The spinners won't harm us... though it wouldn't hurt you to pray a little more fervently tonight, just in case."

de033790-1ba9-43f9-ab9b-4daeea32a562.Text: "A spinner of the Bloodspun Web came to the service today! I thought they were there to kill someone, but they just said a quiet prayer and left. I'm still shivering."

a80430d0-b8e2-4c99-8a28-c508d462b7a2.Text: "Maybe they were looking for righteous souls for a bloody ritual? Thank the Emperor for not sending a portent to mark someone on this particular day..."

c6cf9dca-a7fd-4453-ad34-46ddff2f8348.Text: "I wonder if I should quit all this and join the Bloodspun Web."

3fe86fee-2f39-49d6-8ee6-9c2f878802b9.Text: "What if some blood omen points to your own family? Will you kill them? That's right, not as eager now, are you?"

cc1d134f-d497-44cc-88ef-934ffb30f917.Text: "If I don't eat for a few more days... will I start seeing things in the dark like the spinners?"

dacb1104-c9df-42e8-956c-4053bd728549.Text: "Yes... The criminal rabble has got out of hand in the aftermath of the death cult's extermination."

02266b61-2e30-496c-9dbb-eb365cc8f466.Text: "I've heard someone is stalking the decks in a bone mask, stabbing people and painting Aquilas in blood."

79a66c98-7e6e-4576-afc1-1c7ef9af24ac.Text: "Maybe someone from the Bloodspun Web did survive? Oh, I hope it's only rumours and there isn't an actual holy assassin prowling among us..."

d7a470a8-4912-486b-aceb-0bf9545d2c56.Text: "I can't give you any more medicine. I'm sorry about your father, but I need it for myself."

096abb84-3902-48f2-bee4-bf54c5144abf.Text: "Damn it! If the spinners were still alive, they would end his suffering. But I... I can't."

113ac359-8e81-422a-b02e-138bde6ffd46.Text: "I've spent many watches searching for shadows clad in scarlet. I yearn... to repent of my weakness... to be cleansed by holy punishment. But there is no answer. Am I cursed?"

14088d23-2d75-45a9-8234-67a4cef38ceb.Text: "Crime on the lower decks has increased fivefold. It's like the serfs have gone mad."

ed735b04-826b-4590-ae67-1f6ae13a90a5.Text: "The Rogue Trader has forbidden the spinners of the Bloodspun Web from killing... So the rabble thinks they're safe from punishment."

e01fd68b-7ea0-4032-a01c-cccdd7fb6755.Text: "I'm glad the Bloodspun Web has stopped killing people. I was sick of scrubbing blood out of the chapels."

9a415e34-0dda-4400-835e-f2f57828a051.Text: "Don't be too glad. They killed heretics too, and now there is no one to bring His stern judgement to the corruption that lurks in our midst."

ef141f85-3bf8-4cec-bafe-bb61ca2ee364.Text: "I saw a spinner usher a wicked man to the other side. Then another spinner came... and killed the first one."

a31d7b16-7fa5-4dec-baa4-14fa19dc23ff.Text: "The penalty for disobedience is death. The Bloodspun Web made a vow to the Lord Captain, and will show no mercy to oathbreakers."

5a43b76a-7d01-481f-9fa1-19fb53ea0979.Text: "The spinners no longer grant death to those steeped in villainy. Has the Emperor turned His back on us?"

0781d430-fd73-4906-8292-1a45192d9573.Text: The enforcers eradicated the death cult on the Lord Captain's orders. Those who once looked to the cult for guidance now wander lost in the dark depths of the lower and middle decks. Without the spinners' harsh guardianship, many of them no longer have any qualms about thievery or disregard of duty.

29ab0168-1880-4388-bfc9-403b4ebf68f8.Text: "They will have to wait a little longer."

8a6d339f-4812-40fa-888b-366063bcf6c5.Text: "I do not have time to listen to the concerns of cultists. Tell them to crawl back into whatever hole they came from and never bother me again!"

8e0e295d-b389-4fd1-9e1d-67dc021f9ae1.Text: "You make a good point. Very well, inform the cultists that I will receive them."

cd7ed084-40eb-4826-b955-d239d4be5ef8.Text: "Are you questioning your captain's decisions, Vox Master?"

576350aa-6132-4f48-9f00-6461b876eade.Text: "Lord Captain, the cult representatives have waited patiently for many watches to have an audience with you. Will you receive them, or do you wish to send them on their way without granting their request?"

0b970644-a186-4d19-8eba-ba6484de7827.Text: "My apologies, Lord Captain, but if the cultists are not granted an audience, they will go back to their secretive existence in the flagship's lower bays. According to them, 'the cult must return to the service of the Undying Emperor and tread the sacred path in darkness.' When they depart, they will take their gifts and secrets with them. This may be your only chance to hear what they have to offer."

0a0cfd17-a90f-4b75-b757-78be9739207b.Text: {n}A raspy sigh can be heard through the vox-system.{/n} "I would not dare, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I will make your will known to the cult."

982a3129-e4af-4a0a-a635-7d727fe7ba0d.Text: "You mentioned 'the Tenets of the Web.' What are they?"

3a1de77e-10c6-4a50-9137-fe124d40a5d0.Text: "I disapprove of your practices... but I am not going to ban them. For now."

92fc1bd5-4b5c-4da7-a91f-ae8cf3720703.Text: "Tell me about yourself, Kibellah. Are you the leader of the Bloodspun Web, or its herald? Or its servant?"

c6b56cec-b186-463e-8dee-dfb0b96f7a74.Text: "Interesting. So, a death cult watches over my crew — they who honour the Emperor through killing, who devote their every deed to serving Him. Sacred executioners."

9c70b3a8-b919-4ea4-bd4c-ba1f6070df7b.Text: "Why have you waited so long to reveal yourselves to me?"

29154c30-8fb9-4e37-a3d2-c9cb82b01f77.Text: [Nod toward the captives] "Why have you brought this rabble to the upper decks?"

0fbb4637-b67e-4955-b2ab-2b14e58b5075.Text: "What exactly does a cult like the Bloodspun Web do?"

ce2af7bd-6e4d-4ad8-aebc-f55b7d85e20b.Text: "I find it outrageous that such important members of my crew are dressed in rags! They are to be given food, wine, and new garments immediately!"

97014535-b6af-4ca1-b6cf-fe0a7d7d2adb.Text: "Instead of helping those who may soon stumble, you offer them... death?"

715373a5-5a8b-418b-91b7-fe0f097c91e3.Text: Commanded the death cultists to kill in your own name.

96a1b3df-5124-4d6b-9464-8cfedb3632ea.Text: [Give a bloodthirsty smile] "Continue to serve me, dancers of death. But henceforth, let my name be upon your lips when you shed blood!"

1a95b348-a8e7-4ad7-b330-f673ad7f51ad.Text: "Let it henceforth be known that the Bloodspun Web is forbidden from killing without my permission."

19d52181-a7c2-45d6-885a-1cb8e16ec554.Text: "Give weapons to the traitors. It is time for Kibellah to prove herself."

033a74f6-3e6a-4741-a9a4-7a5ff2c47f17.Text: "You have my blessing. May your blades bring swift death to the Emperor's enemies!"

9649eeaa-89d1-49ff-8c59-4fef64802b68.Text: "You are right. I will wield you as a sword against my enemies."

4173de9f-2f1e-4bca-8afc-6954b30e140c.Text: {n}Those on the deck watch in awe as the final figure moves gracefully into a ceremonial pose. Some of the officers whisper in excitement, while others murmur prayers to the {g|Encyclopedia:EmperorGlossary}God-Emperor{/g}.{/n}

a85bceb6-8f57-428f-be0a-0133a9aae58c.Text: {n}They fall silent as a tall young woman steps forward. She moves toward you soundlessly, the dim light casting shadows across the mask which conceals her face.{/n} "The Undying Emperor commanded us to spin a web of blood around His children, and we obeyed. We obey still." {n}The masked cultists repeat the words in a mournful whisper, "We obey still."{/n}{g|Encyclopedia:Lumen}{/g}

afab644e-190d-4f98-ab3e-ceace84f153e.Text: {n}The prisoners cower beneath the weight of your gaze. Blood drips down the tear-stained faces of the captured officers, {g|Encyclopedia:Technomat}technomats{/g}, and workers. A word has been carved into each of their foreheads with meticulous precision: "Traitor." "Heretic." "Apostate." "Renegade." The cuts have been diligently and regularly reopened to prevent healing.{/n}

656c9f93-86d6-4a04-89a2-eaf82ca04318.Text: {n}You have heard many stories about death cults such as this one. These devoted, holy assassins of the {g|Encyclopedia:ImperiumGlossary}Imperium{/g} have turned death into a form of worship of the Emperor. They are exemplary slayers, invisible executioners, and the scourge of traitors, heretics, and fallen souls. Many righteous people honour them as votaries of the faith, while others see their fearsome rituals as frenzied spectacles touched by madness.{/n}

f130a45c-01cd-4eb6-bc3a-897bea224bf7.Text: "We were not there when the blessing of death was granted to Domin'Theodora. Our failure brought shame upon the Bloodspun Web. We could not stand before you until we restored our honour. We tracked down the traitors and sliced open their bodies. Then we washed the flagship's bulkheads in their blood in a sacred act of ritual purification."

4e1877cd-44dd-46f6-b94a-e88a5b5129d8.Text: {n}A ringing sound fills your ears, deafening the noise of the world around you. Time goes still. A voice {d|Encyclopedia:Prologue_CutByKnife}whispers{/d} seductively in the back of your mind.{/n} "How interesting... Devout assassins who believe themselves to be instruments of a higher power. They revel in violence, and cannot tell the difference between bloodthirst and piety. They follow their faith blindly, unaware of how closely they tread to corruption and depravity. Look at them. They stand on the edge of a precipice. The smallest push will send them plummeting into the abyss. You could be their downfall. All you have to do... is push."

fad69b1c-f2ea-44bc-9e4e-b67fe93cb5e5.Text: "We must not seek that which is not ours. We must smother our worldly desires. Thus do the Tenets guide us, and thus we follow them. However..." {n}Kibellah's voice remains calm, but you notice a ripple of excitement pass through the other cult members. They are clearly flattered to be the subject of the Rogue Trader's attention and generosity.{/n} "The Bloodspun Web would not dare to cause offence by refusing the Domin."

eaa52193-67be-470e-8fb7-c73fd9fe1df4.Text: {n}She stares at you in bewilderment.{/n} "We follow His design. We claim those marked by His omens. We submit to His will. How could it be otherwise?"

1da7d993-7782-48d3-bd80-7fa264c9ed07.Text: "I am the Second Spinner of the Bloodspun Web. The honour of this title is bestowed only upon those who have ushered more souls than—" {n}Kibellah stops abruptly. She touches a slender finger to the fresh wound on her hand, and paints the symbol of a lock across her lips in blood.{/n} "It is shameful to speak of one's own deeds. I am here to become your shadow, not to make boasts."

6af3f68a-8b3a-46b9-abf8-529099c181d8.Text: "As the Tenets ordain. As honour demands."

7512ce5f-8ed8-419d-951e-5578da9ee867.Text: {n}Everything about these people unsettles you. Their manner of speech and the sinister grace with which they handle their blades is enough to make your blood run cold. You cannot help but feel a growing unease as you witness their tattered, blood-stained clothes, hear their whispered chants, and feel the weight of their cold, impassive stares. They do not look like any servants of the Emperor you have ever met. However, your officers treat them with cautious reverence, and speak about their prowess in whispers of admiration.{/n}

4549a09a-4618-4412-9ab7-ccb11b41ee0d.Text: {n}Your heart is filled with awe as you gaze at the cultists. You recognise this feeling. You have experienced it before — when you walked through the scorching {d|Encyclopedia:Prologue_WentThroughFire}flame{/d} and survived. The eyes of your grim guests burn bright with sacrificial fervour. They serve the God-Emperor with whole-hearted faith and devotion.{/n}

ffe83565-a519-48ab-8ca6-ef4fba984696.Text: {n}The cultists are all voidborn. Their lithe, sinewy bodies are clad in light armour, which allows them to move with an acrobat's nimble grace and strike with an assassin's swift surety. Their red-and-black vestments are adorned with sharp spikes and ritual jewellery. Where time and training have worn their garments threadbare, you can make out patterns of bleeding lacerations.{/n}

24144b50-2c17-4f2b-afbd-d121d8621ded.Text: "So you may offer the souls of these traitors as a gift to Him." {n}Kibellah touches her sharp blade reverently to her lips. The captives tremble in fear at the sight of the weapon.{/n} "You have the authority to order their execution. Their blood will bind us together through Him. For the God-Emperor, the Undying One, is death itself. The Undying One is duty itself."

18c7625d-c208-4691-8031-6591416527f9.Text: "The Tenets of the Web teach us to read the threads of the future and understand the hearts of others. When a soul is filled with the poison of corruption, we know its time has come. We bring liberation. Three strikes. Three rebukes. One blade. This is how we serve the Undying One. This is how we serve you and your flagship."

eb67949b-ceba-4d1b-a8b7-5c1f76f095ce.Text: "Your name upon our lips." {n}The cultists make two thin cuts along the corners of their mouths, sealing the vow with word and blood.{/n}

64869aa1-1ae1-460c-a7d9-96fc81c67e14.Text: {n}The cultists do not blink or look away as they stare at you.{/n}

cc7d65df-9e5c-466d-ae7b-f90abba7a0d3.Text:
"Give the order, Domin'{name}. Let a spinner of the Bloodspun Web undergo the test of a sacred trial."
{n}The others echo her words from beneath their bone masks: "Undergo the test."{/n}

af66ae78-c884-4903-a84b-278cf26049ef.Text: "Have we transgressed? Have we caused offence?" {n}The worried cultists whisper among themselves and the sound of their anxious voices fills the hall.{/n} "What will we do now? What service can we offer Him?"

2ee73413-54dc-4489-a474-eb088ce8b16c.Text: {n}Kibellah claps her hands twice. The sound echoes off the ancient walls of the deck, and the cultists fall silent.{/n} "We are the threads that bind the darkness. We are here to serve you. If you command us to set aside the rites of sacred slaughter... then it is our duty to obey."

525d1e88-db51-410b-8d77-e8e685bc32ef.Text: "A dagger that has not sliced through sinew is nothing more than a toy." {n}Kibellah motions to the other cultists. They release the captives from their restraints and place weapons in their hands.{/n} "Let the final dance begin."

bf17b24d-7b71-4d7b-821a-819aa4c277df.Text: "Then I will tell you of the treacherous blood that runs through their veins."

323b7d58-56f2-45f4-aa83-79fbdccef33e.Text: {n}The eyes of the cultists burn bright with righteous fervour.{/n} "The Bloodspun Web will not forget your words, Domin'{name}. They are the wisdom of the Tenets and the benediction of our duty."

cc8f23f0-d559-4721-a027-d11bdac60af2.Text: "Domin'{name}... has discerned our essence. This is a great honour for the Bloodspun Web. We have woven the bays of this ship together with the threads of our faith for many years. We keep the greatest relic — {g|Encyclopedia:ImperialTarotGlossary}His Tarot{/g}, through which He sends us His blessed revelations. We obey the whispers of the Undying One. This is our service to Him. This is our service to you."

cdcd6ba0-a0c5-4cf0-90b9-61cfb1c150df.Text: "We give you a blade — the Silent Verdict. The Undying One has chosen you to wield this instrument of death. We give you one of our own — Kibellah. She will be your shield and shadow. And we give you the blood of these traitors — the Tenets of the Web will purify their souls."

240fadab-795e-4c12-a706-d305c23a9456.Text: "These renegades committed treachery against their Domin. Their lips once praised the name of Kunrad Voigtvir, but it is your name they will whisper as they cross over to the other side."

d0006550-c5e4-4232-99ab-e99a41afeb32.Text: "Apostates led astray by the Final Dawn. These traitors chose to tarnish the honour of their families. Only their blood can wash away the shameful memory of their betrayal."

2e157122-aff3-4ef2-ad5c-90cab8a0f4da.Text: "Humanity owes its existence to the Undying Emperor's sacrifice. It is He who protects us from a darkness of terrors. Hence, each of us has a duty to serve Him. And..." {n}Kibellah says with purpose,{/n} "...a duty to die for Him. To act otherwise is to waste the life that has been given to us by the Undying One — to become a thief. We help others understand this. We help them to live and die righteously."

9c85c2ef-6d84-4a2e-bd01-4dc692375946.Text: {n}Her gaze is perfectly still.{/n} "But there are others. The virtuous martyrs who contravene His design without realising it. Those who have come too close to faltering or committing an apostasy, but have not erred yet. We present such souls to the Undying One."

f25d1826-b992-4645-945a-603aa765a3f2.Text: {n}The High Factotum nods as his plump fingers rapidly tap the screen of his data-slate.{/n}

4594d19d-1f61-49ce-8cf3-658c6cea7105.Text: "Our laws and teachings. Our philosophy and way of life. Our art of combat and spiritual dogma. The Tenets are the Bloodspun Web itself."

1f487c85-98f7-47bc-9278-aba7bc2ff070.Text: "We lament having incurred your anger, Domin. And we hope that you may yet understand: there is no fault in our service — before Him, or before the crew of this vessel."

d73dc918-e1c3-4b27-89d2-2fb714a25ffa.Text: "Domin'{name} von Valancius, death has whispered your name." {n}The woman's slender finger has been fitted with a metal claw. She points it in your direction, and gazes at you from behind her bone mask with the cold, grim eyes of an assassin.{/n} "We disown Domin'Theodora. We renounce our oath to her." {n}She pulls out a sinister curved blade, and similar weapons suddenly appear in the hands of her motionless companions.{/n}

a0a08a1b-b2df-4fc6-9522-18a4b9bb75be.Text: {n}The cultists glance at one another uneasily.{/n} "Would you cast down your sword at the enemy's feet in the heat of battle? How can we be an instrument of the Undying One's will if you forbid us from serving you through the Tenets?"

b3fbc303-e6ed-426c-ae3c-48a23988b933.Text: "And now we give the gift of our blood to you. It is the gift of death." {n}Their blades sing through the air, and rivulets of crimson flow onto the deck. The young woman bows her head reverently as she hands you a heavy parcel. The others bow their heads as well. They seem unconcerned by the blood that trickles down their fingers.{/n} "Death has whispered your name. The followers of the Tenets of the Web swear fealty to their new overlord and offer proof of their devotion."

b89c9c3e-9fc5-47ef-bcaa-05b0f66cc59e.Text: "We are the spinners of the Bloodspun Web. Our cult holds the bays of your flagship together with the threads of our faith. We are an instrument of retribution, the silent blade sworn in service to the Undying Emperor. We guide those whose time has come, and usher them to the other side." {n}A murmur runs through the gathered crowd. "Death cultists!"{/n}

6b87a479-8a32-4608-a9f3-fcceba81e6ef.Text: "We do not desire their death. We do not seek them out in the darkness. They come to us." {n}Kibellah closes her eyes for a moment. She takes a deep breath.{/n} "And we usher them from this life if {g|Encyclopedia:ImperialTarotGlossary}His sacred Tarot{/g} reveals that the Emperor wishes to accept these martyrs."

601d5a2c-f609-4e3a-b44b-b403d5b914c3.Text: "I have more pressing matters that require my attention."

fa5c0c09-8e31-49ff-95cf-f60b7aeb7ec9.Text: "They have certainly taken their time. Very well, I will speak with them."

ce9b76b4-3652-442d-8bc8-cf8af4cd2041.Text: "Permission to report, Lord Captain. Members of a sacred cult operating aboard this ship have requested an audience. They wish to present gifts and introduce themselves to their new captain."

11b03313-db62-4d0a-a7f6-55e1bd577a76.Text: "They call themselves the Bloodspun Web. The cult defends the flagship from both internal and external threats. Lady Theodora held them in high regard, and looked favourably upon their activities."

045705bc-8ac3-49ba-a4d8-c2c9479541a4.Text: "Please let me know when Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} is ready to receive the cultists. I will await your orders on the bridge. As always, I am at your service."

0d590b2a-ead1-4bd4-bec9-e37b4049acae.Text: "I will commence preparations at once, Lord Captain."

2e5393c9-5fba-41c4-81f2-04c6a290d9d3.Text: "Confessor, tell me about the spinners' great sacrifice."

c56b6d62-e3eb-4334-bbc0-4fbce77812bb.Text: "I have enough fighters in my retinue. I do not need the cult's gift."

abcfa118-d2be-421e-8937-46bc3097daf8.Text: "I do not see the point of these riddles. Your temple is a part of my flagship. What is to stop me from simply walking inside?"

86c0e7c2-35a2-4601-b99a-8f59f192accf.Text: "I will not waste my time with foolish riddles."

585f366e-e198-4a9f-bff8-98f250e18080.Text: "I will walk in the footsteps of the Matriarch Spider."

20c9446d-fa59-4c81-a3f7-8d4274979421.Text: "Perhaps one day I will grant you that favour."

741f8606-eadc-4c7b-8851-906205ae306b.Text: "I wish to hear what my retinue thinks."

7b0bf475-8e8f-41f8-b911-18177ce146f3.Text: "What do the accused have to say in their defence?"

bf0c7563-f2b0-4c98-9b71-a8504093919d.Text: "I have heard enough. Throw this traitorous scum out of an airlock."

694c8a80-2096-4180-9c5e-99e5bf617862.Text: "The officer and his subordinates are to be demoted without the right to reinstatement."

755c5d59-34ed-4dd4-ae21-a5c4267f1adf.Text: "These commoners wanted to enter the reactor room? I shall fulfil their wish. Throw the traitors into the steam generator bay — they can boil in there."

341b059f-981f-4843-87c5-68e48d9a95a7.Text: "Kibellah, is it true these things were revealed to you through visions?"

066c0b5e-27cc-4c11-8167-bb1a57aed68d.Text: "I shall spare the lives of the workers, for their guilt is unproven. Let them labour on the ship, but under the supervision of the enforcers."

758108d1-2d9e-4f8a-b376-cf8e783436b2.Text: "What about those prisoners you killed during the procession? Did you feel entitled to stand in judgement over them?"

7c1ef91c-f11b-4955-8a2e-44939ef76ddd.Text: "It seems that not all the officers have been presented to me yet."

e4d5a876-9f8c-4cc5-9d2a-faac51ab6a89.Text: "Forespoke? What do you mean? What Tarot?"

79d9896d-a662-414b-a701-a664547f1bdd.Text: "Why is the Vizsier not here to deliver the message himself?"

fb4f4473-263b-4fb1-864c-18130c0fe5c4.Text: "Throw them all out of an airlock and let us be done with this."

ba630ab4-0b89-4f57-954b-0443c4c65638.Text: "I hereby sentence the guilty officers to be shot. Take them away."

110cc5db-3a3e-4dc1-be4b-001507881909.Text: [Address the officer] "I will not punish you or your men. Continue your service and do not make any more mistakes."

18aa3e92-0ee4-4f36-86c2-ad24728c629c.Text: "Get this treacherous rabble out of my sight and shoot them."

f9163f3f-9f11-471c-87ca-3ce7148a6694.Text: "A cut to the heart. A cut to the throat. A cut to the stomach. These wounds have been inflicted according to His pleasure. The blood of the apostates will wash away the stain of their treachery, so that their souls may prostrate themselves before the Undying One's throne and beg His forgiveness." {n}Kibellah wipes the blood from her blade in one swift movement.{/n} "I have acted with reverence and shown proof of my loyalty. Will you accept me, Domin'{name}? Will you make me your shield and shadow?"

4f6c4694-caa7-4b61-9e7b-a3486507e324.Text: "These wretched apostates were caught trying to sabotage the reactor. They are guilty of treason..."

c642d74e-1818-4652-9d0c-b5707196cf82.Text: "The exhausted crew was too weak and emaciated to resist the invaders... but then the spinners emerged from the depths. They stood alone against hundreds of foes, yet they did not falter. They did not sleep or rest as their bladetip dance brought death. Though many spinners fell, the Bloodspun Web held strong until the flagship left the turmoil of the warp."

28a45afe-0604-4168-ac35-6edd6efe65de.Text: "The First Spinner is old. His abode is in the temple beneath the flagship's freight line, and he has not left the lower decks in decades. Even a short journey could sunder the spirit from his ancient body."

ccd88fde-b667-4348-a549-be16b29b56fb.Text: "We will never forget your generosity, Lord Captain! We will repay your loyalty with our lives if need be."

f73a0cbf-48f2-46d7-b737-806b0ed70eac.Text: {n}Kibellah's movements are slow, almost rhythmic, as she removes her ceremonial mask. The dark shadows of her eyes accentuate the deathly pallor of her skin, which is covered in ritual scars.{/n} "Henceforth, I am your shadow, Domin'{name} von Valancius. An instrument of death placed in your hand by the {g|Encyclopedia:EmperorGlossary}Undying One{/g}. For so it was ordained, and so {g|Encyclopedia:ImperialTarotGlossary}His Tarot{/g} forespoke."

9560e585-8132-43e5-b743-230ea276528e.Text: "Death has whispered your name, Domin'{name} von Valancius. You may refuse the gift, but it will remain yours forever. For so {g|Encyclopedia:ImperialTarotGlossary}His Tarot{/g} forespoke, and so it was ordained. Perhaps the time has not yet come, and you may well change your decision."

dfa1f2ad-4997-449d-bd95-8bd2f29685c4.Text: {n}The young woman bows her head once more.{/n} "I also come bearing an invitation from the Vizsier of the Bloodspun Web. He wishes you to know that the doors to the Undying One's temple are open to you."

d942c0f3-6db2-4f27-9282-ddfb4dc70d52.Text: "Are you suggesting the Lord Captain should go down into the depths of {mf|his|her} flagship to search for this temple? With all due respect, the lower decks are for servants and crew. They are not a fitting place for {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship}."

aeb7169a-66f2-4686-9751-681888ca8b0b.Text: "You must become the blood of the flagship before you can enter the sacred temple of the Undying One. I cannot guide your way, but I can walk by your side."

56c76656-8b3a-4fc4-b042-b652c0156147.Text: "Enough, Einrich. The Lord Captain will decide the truth of these claims for {mf|himself|herself}."

1a014ff1-b80c-4731-8802-5a75a9fd5e54.Text: "I have heard the whisper of the Undying One. He awaits you. He calls to you. Your time will come."

d06759ad-171c-475e-b140-4f9337c8c537.Text: "Bone and sinew revealed your hubris. You abandoned vigilance for the promise of glory. You did not give weapons to the traitors, but you left your post to seek a hero's path. Though you did not act with treasonous intent, you are complicit nonetheless."

fb4eba1d-576c-490d-aa30-6ffc22d84250.Text: "Your journey will begin in the darkness of the deepest tunnels. The Vizsier awaits you."

39cab465-fd52-4f73-bcbd-1f817ab5980a.Text: {n}The young woman folds her hands over her chest in the sign of the Aquila before vanishing into the shadows. The cultists follow.{/n}

13cf1a99-f3d1-4947-b3de-bc8e4661dfdd.Text: {n}The cultists retreat into the shadows as Kibellah sheathes her ceremonial dagger.{/n} "Your blade awaits direction, Domin'{name}. We will speak again when the time is right."

a61c869a-5190-4249-9fae-ee35c5435e7b.Text: "I have heard, though only at a distance, the prayers the spinners offer up to Him. I have seen how their deeds fill the people's hearts with confidence in the inevitability of His wrath. The Bloodspun Web's loyalty to the Emperor is without question, as is their willingness to lay down their lives in the fight against the Archenemy."

e22b7362-f99d-42f2-8334-a0a78dafc4d4.Text: "Although Lady Theodora never granted the cult an audience or brought a spinner into her retinue, she respected the Bloodspun Web and approved of its mission."

25d7cf3d-460a-49f1-8937-2ef17942c606.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, the spinners of the Bloodspun Web were watching, tracking, and killing von Valancius enemies long before the Warrant of Trade passed to Lady Theodora. However, their blade has also been known to cut short the lives of highly upstanding persons." {n}The Factotum swallows nervously, casting a fleeting glance at Kibellah.{/n} "But I certainly do not in any way condemn the deeds of the deeply esteemed cult... I am sure they must have had good reason..."

112eede7-8a75-4992-b60a-fab68cdee447.Text: {n}The Master-at-Arms clears her throat.{/n} "The cultists are the scourge of the seditious. They bring the unrighteous to ruin. The enforcers respect the Bloodspun Web, for we share a common goal — to bring His light and His harsh justice to the darkest depths of this ship."

e508d59b-5227-4dee-926c-994c49f31017.Text: "My predecessor's predecessor once delivered a sermon about how the spinners saved this vessel from the servants of the Archenemy.
