The Bloodspun Web paid the price in blood, a river of scarlet that flooded the decks from bridge to bilge. They became the blood of the flagship, the pulse in its veins, and the beat of its heart. Their great sacrifice earned them the favour of House von Valancius."

df0a8dea-8f13-4fd6-8686-b853c79abfc6.Text: "I swear, we are not sabo—" {n}A woman in a tattered protective suit pushes forward in protest, but her movement is halted by the thin cord wrapped around her neck. You notice that all the captives have been similarly restrained. The woman clutches her throat as a thin line of scarlet appears between her fingers.{/n}

7c68dc8a-4b3b-4a13-a99b-752d699ff2bc.Text: "...theft of weapons, sabotage, and the deaths of the crew in Bay AL-82."

91f22a50-b943-46a2-a97a-4893d3a0cea1.Text: "Do you have proof of these charges, or are such claims the result of cultic revelations?" {n}There is doubt in the Infernus Master's gentle voice.{/n} "With all due respect, it is difficult to discern the truth of these accusations without evidence. Divine visions and dark portents may be reason enough for you to shed blood, but not everyone here shares your perspective."

c655c82b-8b0b-4ef9-bef0-70ef2aa3b288.Text: {n}The cords around the prisoners' necks are loosened just enough to let them speak.{/n} "Have mercy! We're just technical tunnel workers. We were told to block the ventilation shaft leading into the reactor room. Fume leakage, supposedly. We didn't know we were doing anything wrong — we were just following orders! And as for why we were holding weapons, that was... well, you know..." {n}The woman scratches her cheek nervously.{/n}

93a5d230-cc44-41f7-b84c-f8e33171fd0e.Text: "She's lying!" {n}An injured officer scowls angrily.{/n} "They smeared blood on themselves and crawled out of the tunnel wailing, 'Oh, no! The ship's been attacked! There are enemies everywhere! Defend the bay!' We rushed off to investigate, and they used their cutters to break into the weapon storage at our guard station. They stole guns and headed straight for the reactor room."

a02f7257-5e7f-40c7-b292-c585a62b578f.Text: "The Lord Captain has spoken. Take them away!"

e8f39456-51f0-4063-b995-f5608545a45b.Text: "I could not honour you by ushering the souls of those traitors to the other side. This troubles me, for I wish to serve you as the sword serves its master. Will you make me your shield and shadow, Domin'{name}?"

24ac9765-b521-4232-8ca5-760efb0b94e8.Text: "The practice of sacred divination using the bones and sinews of a martyr led us to the reactor room. This is true. But it is also true that I beheld the act of treachery with my own eyes."

6fc0c8c9-5f1b-40cb-902c-693ce3d52a43.Text: "Many within the Inquisition look favourably on death cultists. If you do not need a bodyguard, the Ordo Xenos might recruit her instead."

12354c78-fa27-4b7c-a486-bae8c4ff2da2.Text: "She swears eternal loyalty and seems to know which end of the blade to hold when swinging it around." {n}Marazhai makes a dismissive gesture.{/n} "One more mon-keigh in the retinue, one less..."

7f963b1e-8d21-431a-ada7-189452b77661.Text: "Only you can decide who will follow you, shereen..." {n}A line appears on Jae's forehead.{/n} "...but I have always been wary of those who turn belief in the Exalted One into a moribund set of principles."

26e59aa0-152a-49bc-a5a0-f67ae2381c30.Text: "The greatest, most sacred relic of the Bloodspun Web: the Emperor's Tarot. Only His chosen servants may earn the permission to rain blood upon the cards and perform a reading to see portents of the future, shadows of the past, or tangles of the present. However, the secrets of His Tarot are not for the ears of laypeople to hear. I cannot tell you more — not here, not now."

335af533-bb74-4d21-9ddf-621de3060af2.Text: "Scourge of the seditious or not, folk are afraid of them for a reason. A couple of watches ago, these spinners took a train driver to pieces for some kind of ritual. I don't know what old Maloc did to earn that privilege, though. And who's going to feed his family now?" {n}Einrich takes a drag on his lho-stick, exhaling the thick smoke through his clenched teeth.{/n} "But that's a lower-decker problem. What matters is that the Bloodspun Web serves you faithfully, Lord Captain."

f445c717-333b-4ebe-bbb0-0ad1245f0186.Text: "This xenos..." {n}Like a predator on the hunt, Kibellah tracks every fleeting movement of the Drukhari's face and body. The steel claws of her hand open like the teeth of a trap.{/n}"I hear the dark whisper of blood that flows through his veins. I see the ugly shadows of his designs on the other side of his pupils. I smell the scent of his footprints, spun from the pain and hatred of thousands of victims. How many threads have been severed by him — and how many more will be..."

b7841f62-854b-41bd-a85c-f851d209f870.Text: {n}Kibellah's gaze lingers on Yrliet, who looks on impassively.{/n} "The xenos is permitted to dwell in the Domin's ark on equal footing with humans? The enemy of Humanity's black heart cannot appreciate such favour, and no dissembling can hide the inhuman's blasphemous nature from the servant of the Undying One."

ac7b5c32-511b-4471-8512-1353abb7b6e0.Text: "What should be done with the rest of the prisoners, Lord Captain?"

3c2b8a3d-b6e8-4d7d-8fe0-67dcf1ccaf9e.Text: {n}Sauerback looks in disgust at the captives, who are shedding tears of relief and praising your mercy.{/n} "My people will see to it that this scum never again fails the dynasty in either word or deed."

7ed54f9a-a66c-45ea-9d08-ad247f75f681.Text: "Those scoundrels aided the traitor Voigtvir and were caught carrying weapons. Their guilt and sentence were certain. They avoided immediate execution only so that the blood of the wicked could flow in a scarlet trail that led the Bloodspun Web to your glorious halls."

82f3e069-0b2e-4851-8ae6-42442592a118.Text: "A test? Good. Not only will it make you stronger, Aett-Vater, it will let you understand what sort of tribe this blood scryer belongs to." {n}Ulfar strokes his beard as he regards the death cultist before you.{/n}

f1a4f8a1-9a7c-4356-acd9-7cd4e3a39ad0.Text: "Yet another trail of mon-keigh faith is soaked in blood and violence. You do not seek to comprehend death; you only add more limitations to your comprehension of life. Why would you want this, elantach?"

acd231dc-a20b-4697-84c7-b46d749e27e1.Text: {n}A stern-looking woman clears her throat.{/n} "The cultists are the scourge of the seditious. They bring the unrighteous to ruin. The enforcers respect the Bloodspun Web, for we share a common goal — to bring His light and His harsh justice to the darkest depths of this ship."

c1bcf601-abe5-48c1-a9e9-af5c5fba558b.Text: "Scourge of the seditious or not, folk are afraid of them for a reason. A couple of watches ago, these spinners took a train driver to pieces for some kind of ritual. I don't know what old Maloc did to earn that privilege, though. And who's going to feed his family now?" {n}A man in a soot-covered uniform takes a drag on his lho-stick, exhaling the thick smoke through his clenched teeth.{/n} "But that's a lower-decker problem. What matters is that the Bloodspun Web serves you faithfully, Lord Captain."

93ce749f-994a-41a5-b980-2d3b50caa5ed.Text: {n}A plump old man in the rich robes of a confessor adds respectfully,{/n} "My predecessor's predecessor once delivered a sermon about how the spinners saved this vessel from the servants of the Archenemy. The Bloodspun Web paid the price in blood, a river of scarlet that flooded the decks from bridge to bilge. They became the blood of the flagship, the pulse in its veins, and the beat of its heart. Their great sacrifice earned them the favour of House von Valancius."

2636ba29-bf6e-4b0d-b3ac-ec517481e50d.Text: "Confessor Adalbert, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. As a humble servant of the Emperor, I am entrusted with the high honour of being the ship's confessor, or, in other words, the highest spiritual authority on your vessel. I am here to oversee the purity of the crew's faith. I officiate in the officers' chapel and also look after the ship's reliquary."

0b761fde-e8ff-4352-b4ac-3eb6c50fa310.Text: "Do you have proof of these charges, or are such claims the result of cultic revelations?" {n}There is doubt in the man's gentle voice.{/n} "With all due respect, it is difficult to discern the truth of these accusations without evidence. Divine visions and dark portents may be reason enough for you to shed blood, but not everyone here shares your perspective."

2152469f-9ecb-45d3-b0c3-fa343df5783e.Text: "It is... strange. Their shadowy forms are swathed in darkness, yet a radiant light burns within them like scarlet flame. I think... it is a good sign. It is rare to see anyone filled with such light, even among servants of the faith."

97cee879-2a97-41a6-9858-d020032aad18.Text: {n}The enforcer looks in disgust at the captives, who are shedding tears of relief and praising your mercy.{/n} "My people will see to it that this scum never again fails the dynasty in either word or deed."

4ca2cf90-06a6-4181-925e-272f4108fa43.Text: "Any death cult is merely a circle of zealots who dispense mob justice outside of the God-Emperor's Law, no matter how deftly they may hide behind His name." {n}Solomorne looks at Kibellah with undisguised enmity.{/n} "If you really need a pet assassin that badly, I would at least recommend keeping her on a short leash."

71a51877-3a68-49a4-8ec0-f3b8898fa188.Text: "The vessel was beset by famine and pestilence during a long warp jump. The flagship wandered uncharted paths in the Immaterium for twenty cycles straight. Servants of the {g|Encyclopedia:ChaosGlossary}Archenemy{/g} used the despairing hearts of the crew to infiltrate the ship... and death followed. The hungry became the hunted. The famished became a feast."

6491c21a-0e36-4871-8958-083981eb8e4a.Text: "I am not permitted to say. If you wish to find the temple, you must walk the path of Saint Erianne, the Matriarch Spider. Hers was the thread that would become the Bloodspun Web."

a222c020-6717-4a02-9c03-9f24aac15897.Text: "Her path began deep within the flagship, in the dark tunnels of the freight line, and that is where yours must begin as well. This journey will bring you closer to the thread of the Web. Closer to the Undying One. Closer to understanding death."

1f424c79-eb8e-4ed9-82a2-1e861eeda023.Text: "He is the first among us. The Vizsier has spun the web of faith for fivefold longer than I have lived. Blood of the flagship's blood. My mentor and teacher."

43024ef8-68c6-4ed6-bdc4-09ef1272b9f0.Text: "As I am now fated to be your shadow, Domin'{name}, we must perform a ritual that will seal our bond, for it pleases the Undying One. Let us speak on the bridge, and I will take us to a place appropriate for the ritual."

bb5c021f-21d3-4322-b0e4-0d8566681979.Text: "This blood scryer is a fierce warrior who honours the Allfather in her own way. There are much harsher customs on Fenris than this, so you need not be afraid of her."

b2ccdcd5-44ea-4f68-a656-2baa27dc1e1a.Text: This elegant blade, quenched in the blood of holy martyrs, fits perfectly in the hand. The black steel has been polished until the reflective gleam of the metal can be seen even in the dark.

f9320738-4a6b-4280-8b04-073a9ee06923.Text: The wearer of this armour serves the Undying Emperor with absolute devotion, as evidenced by the grim vows on the purity seals and the dried bloodstains from countless foes.

d8859cca-5a3e-4819-98e3-67f04a4fe2b4.Text: This mask of a messenger of death is as worn as a burial shroud. The gaze of its impassive bony visage carries an unyielding promise: every life must end.

3797b727-f81f-41e9-bc69-c5272be37c9b.Text: "Zdena the Spinner — she showed the way, and the Domin came. Another thread spun in the Undying One's name... another one of many. Oh yes..."

bb0ba927-b436-4e69-8740-9a84eb3a2c61.Text: The Undying Emperor holds out His hands to all His children, offering them the highest reward — a worthy death.

723cbc4f-7fb7-4551-b80b-3167d9488445.Text: A crimson torrent flows from the statue's hands — a symbol of the countless deaths offered up in His name.

bc2e96b2-5f77-438b-9763-bed6c1d3f1c6.Text: "The thread is unbroken. The Undying One has not yet reached out His hand to me..."

f61528b7-eec4-4222-97ba-d1933c086866.Text: "This is nothing. I shall not die, for I am Death itself."

a7ce17f1-1679-47a7-bd1b-726afc97ba82.Text: "We must inform the crew that you are alive as soon as we can. I am confident that your people will rally behind you to fight back against the mutineers."

2133cae9-d7f1-4fa4-924f-5305b34cea5b.Text: "Why are we hiding in here, {name}? Point me through the flames and darkness, and I will banish them!"

7daca550-95be-420f-9e88-1f2131964cc7.Text: "We are safe here, but how long will that last, I wonder? Would it not be best to keep moving?"

f0e68f14-8c11-4bb3-94f0-86b4e90d983a.Text: "This place will work as a temporary sanctuary, but I doubt you intend to stay here any longer than necessary. Do you have a plan for how to proceed?"

f2cf0ee9-c6e0-4375-92c5-9236e53181cf.Text: "This is great and all, but now what? Voices? Hello? Damn it, they've gone all quiet again..."

e1f3cf4b-c661-4837-ba40-d95b969aed2f.Text: "So, our gracious hosts are a cult of fanatics. How delightful. Shereen, could we perhaps look for a safe place that smells of something other than blood?"

2d434302-7623-4a9a-a771-dd7a7789ebe9.Text: "Offer a prayer to the Undying One, for today, He reaps."

aa551fac-9352-4ea4-bbd6-dc86ee4754e0.Text: "I grow bored, {name}. You know what happens when I grow bored. I suggest you decide on your next move, and soon."

f6b4f9f1-5577-454c-b469-394758fb784a.Text: "Recommendation: conduct re-armament protocols followed by a counter-attack manoeuvre aimed at re-establishing dominion in the key compartments."

b6f6b509-0d07-4aca-8190-5c08a5ca72c3.Text: "{name}, I stand by for your orders. This is not the first time I've participated in suppressing a rebellion. Remember, the more ruthlessly we crush it, the better the outcome will be."

1f3418be-08a9-4d20-a74a-5156b0c04f03.Text: "Aett-Vater! It does not become us to stay holed up in here while your servants collect all the glory!"

fefcf65a-f2ce-4910-ab16-ac063b0b6bfb.Text: "I can wait for as long as it takes. But can you afford to do the same, elantach?"

c28f6cca-d711-43f5-a389-687c11c0fd02.Text: "Our duty is to do our {mf|lord|lady}'s bidding. We no longer usher souls to the other side. The Undying One will collect them Himself when their time comes."

197b51aa-8bd9-4f5d-9505-33319c9994ad.Text: "The blood of heretics should wash the flagship's decks! How can I serve the Undying One when my hands are tied by the oath I swore to you, Domin'{name}?"

cb7c8a5e-150b-46ab-bee0-1a99fe2cef28.Text: "The Undying One is death. The Undying One is duty."

89f59912-00f4-48d1-95ec-43ec71689e1b.Text: "Domin'{name}. The Undying One has whispered that you would honour the temple of death with a visit. We are ready to serve you."

48dbac65-5f71-41d9-8dff-b65c257688b3.Text: The death cultist bows his head reverently.

e41e036f-fdf6-4b8a-9286-6ede45f190e7.Text: "Five generations of spinners have guarded this relic so that it may serve the worthiest of the Domini. Its time has come."

f78df4a4-33cc-4c0e-a2de-c94781a854d8.Text: Underneath the ancient relic is a stone plaque with an inscription carved in elegant cursive: "If you value life above duty, you are not worthy of life. Vizsier Geophranus."

b0607f21-8c0a-4554-9376-b1b40f4dbbaa.Text: Part of the cultists' service to the Undying One involves turning the corpses of the departed into sacred altars for their blood-anointed congregation to pray at.

3a8a4197-fb4f-414c-bed8-aac74d460615.Text: The smoke tickles your nostrils, making you slightly dizzy.

3d152776-b9ec-4d0d-8543-ef7457058ffd.Text: The smoke tickles your nostrils, making you slightly dizzy. Such substances are known to induce visions or hallucinations.

951fa504-04ea-4959-9c54-edea4371b8c5.Text: Tangles of improvised bridges constructed from beams and flooring stretch ever higher, not unlike a web. The temple is growing, as if it were a living organism.

effb7094-1188-4c5a-9880-609f0e0b8c54.Text: "Another spinner will soon take my bed... That is regrettable. I will miss conversing with my sisters and brothers who have passed on."

e9c8bb30-c3a3-4ff3-99ae-c3c0af986250.Text: Cold stone sarcophagi serve as the death cultists' beds. The bones of their deceased comrades are their bedding.

1889bf15-7de2-48d9-a968-17fd1089e200.Text: There are large holes in the compartment's ceiling — the spinners have dismantled the bulkheads to expand their temple ever higher.

f1d06ea9-d1bd-40d1-bfd7-fd8fe1f6288d.Text: "The time for words has passed. Go. Wash yourself in blood and ashes."

a6e70d1c-1e4b-400a-ad34-b03ca3718656.Text: "How did you manage to erect an entire temple in the middle of the ship without anyone noticing?"

e0dadaa5-2a7d-4b28-ad4d-85f5dda65b00.Text: "What would have happened if I never reached the end of the path?"

9765ac78-bd70-45ca-ae2b-95626175b656.Text: "First you are going to give me the antidote."

887b7e45-c3b7-433b-ac30-ea5e47c1f419.Text: "Your traditions and rituals are rooted in blood and death. Many are frightened by that."

0ad9c38d-d1d8-4a6a-a263-804a955c069c.Text: "Were the trials truly necessary? Would not a conversation have sufficed?"

76b977f3-cef0-416e-a5dd-2036e479a344.Text: "What do you mean, you have 'waited for many years'? It was not so long ago that I made my acquaintance with the cult."

a8f19870-6f5e-495e-80f1-be453deb4a88.Text: "I expected greater respect from one who so eagerly anticipated a meeting with the Rogue Trader."

bcd2531f-3d98-4594-ba2d-d65239baad91.Text: "Why is it you invited me here?"

611c6b74-3f18-4579-9bc1-c62603bd3eaa.Text: "I have walked the path of the Matriarch Spider. What now?"

d9d200ff-6a51-4670-8e1a-4543bdee763f.Text: "So this entire conversation is another test, I imagine?"

b928aa9f-6ba3-44c7-9f44-d6777811db2e.Text: "The followers of the Web are skilful fighters. What is your secret?"

62c85e50-590a-4497-9ae7-e3cfc9ba5234.Text: "You poisoned me somehow, did you not?"

743bbf2d-5cfa-42b4-b0e0-3471d17d7ad8.Text: "How do you know I have passed every trial? Have you been watching me?"

a3ad23fb-9aab-4c80-be8b-3aefdec7c530.Text: "I see your eyes are sewn shut. Are you blind or is that another of the cult's rituals?"

3f46b671-7b98-4d03-8182-a14a8f8f52a8.Text: "What do your Tenets say about human weaknesses?"

07bda62a-d660-4b9a-90b4-d71576f11f8e.Text: "Who is it you talk to all the time?"

43a76eaf-7210-4011-b033-73b5c1945af2.Text: "Have you stopped killing people, as I ordered?"

a1fa68fc-2774-4bff-8817-df3a3007c379.Text: "Now you are going to initiate me as a servant of death."

d7d4b65b-9bfd-4c3c-b3d6-6eeb09962e18.Text: "Enough tests and trials. Your insolence has crossed all reasonable lines. You will be punished for that."

72532609-c92b-492e-a808-ea8afbf1efb3.Text: "You forced me to undergo all this just to share your wisdom with me? Are you out of your mind?"

c51d8a93-65ac-4cd1-8ab1-969a34a7b3ce.Text: "The path I have walked has helped me understand myself better."

1bac614e-31a4-4173-ad52-82f5f55154ec.Text: "So, you just walked my companions in here the normal way while I was forced to take that jump?"

6c10aac5-32e5-47db-8a20-1a2db38eb0d1.Text: "What are the Tenets of the Bloodspun Web? I want a clear answer."

ef84a4ce-61d9-40c6-9b47-e8dee2f9b795.Text: "'Vizsier.' Is that some sort of title?"

5f9afcb0-400f-47d7-8215-a4ae91b2bca4.Text: {n}A frail old man, grey beard tinged with blood, folds his wrinkled hands in a ritual gesture. His body is covered in scars, some old, some fresh. His eyes are sewn tightly shut. His mouth is cleft at both corners, making his jaw seem eerily snakelike.{/n} "And the {mf|Lord|Lady} of the Ark walked the paths of unlife, in the footsteps of the Web's very first spinner. And the servants of death bowed before {mf|him|her}, for the Domin is the giver of life."

9527597e-446b-411c-b8ea-965b7bbc498d.Text: "Followers of the cult once inhabited the tunnels between the bays' bulkheads, until the threads of fate were tangled and a Domin of ages past gave us this compartment. We set ourselves to building spacious halls where the shadows, the images of Him, and the spinners themselves would whisper of death. And thus the temple that you see began to change with the succession of Vizsiers and the cult's generations. We are building it still, slowly but surely."

324b3c84-4a89-4495-bd00-1c37a1cba5ea.Text: "There is none. But I will ease its effect and quicken dissipation." {n}Three long, thick needles appear in the Vizsier's hand. A moment later, they are inside your body: one in your neck, one in your shoulder, and one between your ribs. You feel no pain or discomfort. On the contrary, your mind feels clearer and your muscles regain their function. The Vizsier then carefully removes the needles.{/n} "Now you will feel better."

0b324f74-9bc5-47c2-aec6-393a2b9e7b3a.Text: {n}A smile graces the Vizsier's bluish lips.{/n} "The Tenets command us to be prepared for all trials, corporeal and spiritual alike. Are you prepared, Domin'{name}?" {n}His mouth closes but you can still hear his whisper. A prickling sensation in your face is making you increasingly anxious. You raise a hand to your cheek, only to realise you can't feel it. You look at your palm and see a few smudged drops of blood from the Vizsier's blade.{/n}

7164ec90-ff56-4642-92fb-4c7dd7762ead.Text: {n}The old man goes still, his head turned to the side. He nods toward the temple's muffled silence.{/n} "Yes... Yes, truth like a stream pours from your lips. We welcome {mf|him|her} as the Tenets demand."

7c09cc94-1af8-4349-8eb0-f6f1da722a9d.Text: "The Song of Trailing Blood tells of a path fraught with trials. By accepting it and setting out on that path, you passed the first one, the trial of resolve. For not everyone is prepared to shun their fear and doubt and embark on a search for the unknown. A search for death. The trial of compassion was the second one. You passed it when you put yourself, albeit briefly, in the service of another soul, a man suffering from burns. For the choice between life and death is to be made only by those willing to take responsibility for the pain of another."

79fe8b98-d934-4a31-a17b-7c812d10bbce.Text: "Death whispered your name and commanded us to honour you with a sacred ritual. But only inside the temple can the spinners perform it..." {n}The Vizsier is suddenly distracted by someone invisible, and nods toward empty space.{/n} "Yes. We are glad {mf|he|she} has reached this place. We are glad to serve."

4f6624e3-0123-449e-9e83-5d42978dcc6d.Text: {n}The Vizsier bows his head guiltily.{/n} "Such are the Tenets of the Web. They are all we have ever known and the only life we have learned to live. The path you walked was a gift from the Undying One. And so we decided that was how we were to honour you."

d1c4b907-c425-4bd8-9dfd-cb77c0e31394.Text: "For the Tenets teach us that the lesson learned is in itself the supreme reward for one who is open to self-discovery."

040ec4b4-9892-4ae2-bd56-67db10bd784c.Text: {n}Struggling to suppress the tremors in his body, the Vizsier bows as low as his hunched back allows.{/n} "Forgive us our poor manners. Our intention was not to insult you. You are the first visitor from the upper decks we have had in a great many years, and the customs of longtime servants of death are... somewhat different. But rest assured that there is no disrespect in them."

d4f46b73-d6bb-4801-ae61-a75c5723edc6.Text: "As I delve into my divinations from the flesh and blood of the departed ones, I turn to a relic most ancient and priceless. It is {g|Encyclopedia:ImperialTarotGlossary}His Tarot{/g}, inherited by the cult from the Matriarch Spider who spun the first thread. One of the readings I did back when I still had the strength to leave the temple and usher souls on their final journey. That was when, in the intricate tangle of destiny, I glimpsed our meeting. But when we would meet, alas, was not revealed to me. So we waited, year after year. And now the hour has come."

85d40792-e263-4f2a-8149-a59eaaa136bd.Text: "The third was the trial of justice. In assuming the role of judge for an apostate of our faith, you declared your right to influence the balance of life and death that the errant soul had upset. And the fourth was the trial of duty, for duty always leads to death. We are prepared to render our duty to the Undying One, fearless and accepting of our purpose, which is to serve Him. You, too, have proven yourself prepared, and the four trials have brought you here."

2d6c8d33-281d-4023-909f-fe60b54b83b5.Text: {n}The Vizsier smiles gently.{/n} "I cannot share the full wealth of my knowledge, for it has taken me a lifetime to learn. But I can share this foremost lesson with you: be guided by reason, not fury, when you fight. And seek no pleasure in killing. That is how you will win."

8ff6b35f-68e4-4764-84e9-20696f9b6474.Text: "To give and receive death. And to fear no twist or turn of fate. One who is afraid of death is already dead in their soul, waiting for the end, afraid to accept the inevitable. A life of fear is disgraceful. The true service is in dedicating oneself to death with no regrets."

b3163577-3635-4017-a220-57d428715b34.Text: "Scarlet shadows, death's messengers, accompanied you. They were my eyes and my ears. And thus I saw every choice you made, and heard every word you spoke."

c1fcdccf-5734-43a3-a2ec-83fad7f1e0cd.Text: "'Many are blind even with their eyes wide open.' Thus spoke the Matriarch Spider. People look at things without seeing their essence, which makes them easy to beguile or frighten. We adorn the tunnels with the bones of the righteous, that they may guard our faithful against corrupt deeds and thoughts. We use the blood of the unholy ones for divination so we may see dangers. The blood of martyrs is our wine, for their suffering makes us stronger. People are afraid, but only because they see death as the end. Death, however, is a beginning. It is life and duty and oblivion. Death has many facets — that is its essence. That is its beauty."

bd52f094-de29-4562-8654-462d923b1860.Text: {n}The Vizsier nods obediently and makes a strange sign with his crooked fingers. The spinners echo back.{/n} "Three hundred lashes, so the flesh may know repentance. Three dozen cycles without food or sleep, that the mind may be cleansed of extraneous thoughts and designs. The Bloodspun Web accepts its punishment. And repents. We are ashamed at the Domin's displeasure. We hope the price we pay is proportionate."

17eb6184-7eee-40c4-ba03-4f06690ff22e.Text: "Then we would have met at another time. For the tangle of fate's threads cannot be rearranged by one turn, however earnestly one may try to run in the opposite direction."

ce281916-0e86-4a95-b4ca-1aef17d24582.Text: "I was sighted for much of my life, until a disciple of mine violated the Tenets and I realised just how blind I had been. A lesson, but a bitter one. To look with one's eyes alone is to be easily fooled, but the heart cannot be lied to. Such is the truth, and such was my choice. I sealed my eyelids with a Geas of True Sight. Now I see more, and better."

77e6c078-c8f7-4fee-92ed-fa9fd7bd82b3.Text: "The smallest stain of rot is enough to ruin the most beautiful woven pattern. Weakness is a gateway into the soul, one we hold open for new failings. It is born of desire. Kill your desires, and your weakness will die along with them."

a9c71a5a-ccc7-4ee9-a00c-a5d703bdfe36.Text: {n}The Vizsier turns his head as if looking around the temple.{/n} "I see echoes of those who came before us and those who were with us, but have since crossed over to the other side. My brothers and sisters raised by the cult. I hear them from beyond their deaths. They share their wisdom. I heed them. The other spinners, they hear not, for that burden is mine to bear."

8a158eb8-b920-4d26-89b3-fc3cd9161c44.Text: "Watching. Listening. Guarding. Do you wish to make her your shadow?"

06ecc593-8cee-45b0-961d-f62a3e1b6faf.Text: {n}The Vizsier gestures, and Kibellah emerges from the temple's shadows.{/n}

c380f0ae-347e-4f5d-a819-4a5939f251c4.Text: "We will meet again, Domin, when the threads of fate weave a bloody pattern."

83c474d7-e09e-4581-907c-a5f0504ca6cc.Text: {n}The Vizsier is once again distracted by the empty space to his left.{/n}

62e11720-ed9a-4bf3-880a-d2028eec4702.Text: "A prohibition imposed by the {mf|Lord|Lady} of the Ark, against which we are powerless. To serve with honour is the rule the Web commands us to follow. A spinner must be prepared for any test of their faith. It is difficult. But faithful we stay."

fae891e6-575e-417e-8f27-22dcf96f8be1.Text: "That is for you to tell me." {n}You look at the Vizsier, and his trembling frame seems small and insignificant. A single step is all it would take to crush him. But the visions are starting to wear off, and now the old man towers over you. The keen gaze of his sealed eyes is studying your every movement, waiting for a response.{/n}

5d520d66-6893-41c2-bd8c-4fde3708f576.Text: {n}The Vizsier ponders your words for a long time, whispers something to the empty space behind his shoulder, then shakes his twitching head.{/n} "Our thread is repellent to you, Domin'{name}. You proved it by walking the Matriarch's path in your own way. It is your right and we respect your choice. However, only one who accepts the essence of death may become its servant. You accept your own essence, and we dare not burden you with our dogma."

d9042238-2aeb-46a6-83a7-d61e548da416.Text: {n}"A servant of death!" hiss the echoing whispers from the temple, and the Vizsier bows his head reverently.{/n} "You have become the blood of the flagship. Now you will become one of His faithful servants. We may not name you a spinner, for a spinner's thread demands the forsaking of one's previous life, but the Bloodspun Web will still accept you. The Tenets allow it, but only for a Domin who has followed the trailing blood until the end."

88e51ced-75ac-46e9-a610-80cda2976e72.Text: {n}The Vizsier's sewn-shut eyes seem to peer into your face. Studying it. Then he turns away and speaks into empty space again.{/n} "Peace, my brother. The time has almost come."

56468893-8302-4dfb-af44-4d8f250a341c.Text: {n}One moment, the walls of death's sanctum grow infinitely wide. The next, they are so narrow as to make it hard to breathe. The floor dances under your feet, and the Undying Emperor's statue seems to shake its head threateningly as it looks down upon you.{/n}

a49e5d1b-3809-4a2e-bd4d-0f6d5e5f782b.Text: {n}You intend to ask a question, only to find that the seemingly simple idea you had in your mind has eluded you. Instead, you are now reflecting on who it is that decides the fate of a human in this world, and whether or not people are actually masters of their own free will, since everything is ruled by the will of the Undying Emperor.{/n}

98087eb8-6c21-42f2-932d-42e867956987.Text: {n}A strange, serene calm envelops your body. Your fatigue subsides and you seem to float in the air, seeing things you had not noticed before: the shadows in the corners taking on shape and colour. The subdued lumen light playing on the cultists' bone masks. Are they... really masks? Their tall, lean, empty-eyed wearers might as well be dead people. A chill runs down your spine.{/n}

67177bd1-070c-46c7-8118-76fc1f81d50c.Text: "That which was foretold has come to pass. The ritual of descent is complete! Now be this temple's guest of honour and rest a while."

ad205d69-7d5b-4557-9386-4337cfbdb40d.Text: "For years, we have maintained fealty to the Domini. We have collected sacred symbols and relics. You are the first in three generations of lords and ladies to descend into this sanctum. We are grateful. We are uplifted in spirit. Hear our exultation and accept this gift of a vestment sewn from the bones of His faithful with the threads of death."

9e8f1ef0-508f-4b2e-b9d8-8cf5af740821.Text: "Your hues are almost as pale as the grey of your beard. But... What is this?" {n}Cassia flinches and takes a shuddering breath.{/n} "A scarlet whirlwind shines through the faded colours..."

9a6801e7-b7e7-49f7-a23f-11694ea0377c.Text: {n}Ulfar looks wary.{/n} "A mighty flame is roaring behind feigned weakness. Do not believe your eyes, Aett-Vater — this old man's hands can still remember how to draw blood."

640298fc-a914-45f8-9144-f5f399f77665.Text: {n}The Vizsier's head trembles with the infirmity of age, and his lips utter barely audible words meant for those only he can see.{/n} "Domin'{name} has honoured us with a visit. We are glad."

386c8f03-7bd8-489e-a4f9-9b4093fda166.Text: {n}You {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Psyker}sense{/d} a strange disturbance around the Vizsier. It is similar to the one that appears around Kibellah, but... stronger. He is not a psyker, or else, he is such a powerful one that he can conceal his gift. However, his psychic potential is definitely higher than that of an average mortal. There are people like that in the Imperium — undiscovered by Inquisitorial hunters, they live out their lives as individuals with a reputation for having "strange things" happen to them on occasion. Perhaps this decrepit old man is indeed capable of gleaning something more from the Emperor's Tarot than just painted pictures.{/n}

05ebfe68-3681-4c00-ac84-66d9806432ff.Text: "The spinners guided them along a different trail. You had to take the step, for only you were meant to become the flagship's blood, Domin. There was no reason to test the faith of those who follow you, for this burden was for their {mf|lord|lady} to bear."

f16bc047-03cc-4f33-8ede-d76653c3fc6a.Text: "It is the name we give to the First Spinner. The one who has learnt the wisdom of the Tenets of the Web in order to lead others. I may have a duty to instruct and spin bloody threads, but in all other ways I am as much His servant and yours as anyone else in this temple."

9afd3d76-3a4a-45e1-8fb6-9edffaefd454.Text: {n}Your heart is beating slowly, your breathing has become deeper, and your thoughts are muddled. You seem to be under the influence of a potent stimulant.{/n}

c9f19d24-17ed-4308-9353-59ef9e4ca3d7.Text: "A servant of death who sees beyond the threshold! A spider who spins a cocoon at the end of his thread!" {n}Idira shakes her head and clutches her temples.{/n} "S-sorry about that, it just came over me. I didn't say anything too weird, did I?"

c28b2e8c-4cb4-4ff2-889e-ff0f48ea7930.Text: "An insurmountable challenge for most mon-keigh, who nurture and cherish their vices like their own children."

39c42e2d-4081-4c06-9b98-0bfcfd9b333a.Text: "Peace, Kibellah. You are the shield. You are the shadow. You are the blade. So be them."

4c3700e7-6583-4c9c-a73d-7a4722b6dd5b.Text: {n}The Vizsier nods meekly.{/n} "My blood is infused with a concoction taken by those who follow the thread. It is sacred and harmless to us, but you it befogs and afflicts. And yet, Domin'{name}, you have grasped that the mind may fail the body and the senses. This was the trial of spiritual acumen. You have passed it."

030836c6-7101-4471-bf2e-004b16c71244.Text: "Every thread ends in death." {n}The Vizsier falls silent, as though those words have explained everything. Then he nods toward empty space.{/n} "Yes, I see {mf|he|she} is still full of questions. Let us give {mf|him|her} answers about our ways, my brothers and sisters."

c935f99a-c48f-4157-82f2-b07670b294e1.Text: {n}A thin blade appears in the old man's trembling hands. Although his arms are stiff and look like they can barely bend, in the next instant the dynasty's symbol is etched on his forehead, dripping blood. With a brief motion, he flicks the blood off his blade, and several drops land on your face.{/n} "The Bloodspun Web welcomes its new {mf|lord|lady}. I am the Vizsier. For many years we have waited, and now you are here." {n}"We have waited," whispers echo his words from the shadows.{/n}

4a1b9c5e-40f3-4830-b1a1-1ca7de0fcb25.Text: "Whom are you planning to fight? What is happening on the ship?"

11187722-0427-4d69-8ad4-faece2a9a140.Text: "But I killed the cult's leader with my own hands!"

65a0a13f-d128-4d32-84e8-1b53b74baad2.Text: "Come dress our wounds. We have many lives to take today."

574d27ee-fbd3-4542-8207-839da4c36e61.Text: "Are you going into battle yourself? You are a little old for that, are you not?"

24d8feba-a447-4bee-a671-9118e2b8b236.Text: "You seem surprisingly well informed about what is happening here."

394bd113-c4bb-462a-aa61-1c6ebf5f332f.Text: "If you knew about the cult all this time, why did you not tell anyone?"

b75f71e5-5104-4441-a9bf-1030b3cc7037.Text: "The spinner who brought me here is severely wounded. Do whatever it takes to keep him alive."

0594d4cb-e2e0-4fab-9246-3de4585c87b7.Text: {n}The figure of the Vizsier stoops under the weight of his battle garb. His bony fingers tremble as they scoop blood from the bowl and begin tracing the symbols of war on his withered face. Without breaking the ritual, he addresses the emptiness:{/n} "Thread after thread, death after death, the Giver of Life wove {mf|his|her} path. Yes... I have heard. Twice did {mf|he|she} find {mf|himself|herself} caught between undeath and unlife, and twice did the Undying One reject {mf|him|her}, for the time had not yet come."

69219d19-bef6-4358-9dde-fb068be08ac6.Text: "I had the pleasure of cutting up two of the three that came after me. I then followed the trail of the one I let go to see where these pests were coming from."

2d0c9fd6-3936-456c-8f3c-7c2fdb4788f0.Text: "What? You crooked old spider! Why did your servants not tell me the enemy was coming? You tricked me into fleeing from battle!"

2c7e8212-b858-4131-8fc2-35fd92f3f697.Text: "An omen, a scarlet whisper, bled into the web of prophecy: the foe longed to slaughter those alone in their chambers. But they were too late — the spinners had already led your chosen few to our abode along a hidden thread."

f5c6e8e5-cefa-4a9b-ab21-70e738818d42.Text: "Violence and turmoil. A mutiny of twisted souls! The traitors speak in a false voice over the vox. They speak of enforcers and officers who sought to slay their Lord Captain. But seek they did not... It was the murk-wreathed abominations who threatened the Domin."

2045c1b7-8f03-43a5-82c2-70a7a3d4274c.Text: "One sees now that this was but a pawn, ushered into place merely to deflect the falling sword. The player knew the game was forfeit, and thus made a trade: a few of their tribe sent to the slaughter so that they might sell the lie that the foe was dead."

9c11c215-8b8e-4e87-b4e2-598a1ec799fd.Text: {n}The Vizsier nods at the emptiness behind you.{/n} "Yes... It is time {mf|he|she} learned about the Ravenous Star, about the beasts that appear as men, their malignant flesh imbued with xenos filth. Long has the foe lurked, pouring its lies into the minds and veins of the disparaged."

1c68ad87-2d61-493d-987c-d4772e146a17.Text: "Go back to your people, Domin'{name}, for it is difficult for them to die without your voice. The Vox Master's pleas still echo through the bays, and the muzzles still bark. The spinners say that the enforcers' post has not yet fallen. The end is not now. May the Tenets of the Web guide your blade, Domin'{name}. Be swift."

223b4553-d827-4cc3-87c0-f97596f19dbe.Text: {n}The decrepit old man looks pensive as he twirls a dagger, making it dance between his fingers.{/n} "An old blade, if hardened well and honed with care, does not lose its sharpness, Domin'{name}."

d3c17950-4534-40c4-93dd-494c377c17b4.Text: "That sudden invasion could have cost your people their lives. They were fortunate that I was up late reading and recognised the garments of the Bloodspun Web in the lumens' light. Please... knock on the door next time."

37dec18a-a01d-4ff0-ac8e-de725fcb9d89.Text: "This enemy cannot take an Asuryani by surprise, but your caution is... commendable. The predator will now become prey."

02527a6f-33c2-41cc-8fe2-ba792f652c32.Text: "First Spinner! How dare you! I am a warrior of the Adepta Sororitas! My place is in the thick of battle, not in some hidden sanctuary!"

98feb6cd-10e0-4d66-a64c-0214fa4a67a9.Text: "I will give credit for assisting a representative of the Adeptus Mechanicus and raise the status of the Cult of the Bloodspun Web on the list of benevolent organisations."

1b5ca6ca-b480-4add-8942-396619c3b56f.Text: "The dawns and dusks of generations followed upon one another, spawning veiled abominations, until the holy {mf|Lord|Lady} of the Ark stirred the profane lair of iniquity. The war emerged from the shadows in the chamber where the living honour death over the ashes — and then spilt forth. The sacred ark is nearing its ruin, but our lot is not yet cast, your servants not yet broken. The Undying One awaits your deeds to cover you in glory."

20c6d1d6-8f15-40ee-9e95-e1fe8b60af00.Text: "The flagship is split. Those loyal to the true Domin are fighting those who believe the twisted lie. The faithful are shaken, and the unclean press on, claiming the bays one by one." {n}His voice hums with a dismal energy.{/n} "They are taking over our home with the hands of the deceived and the lowly."

f1a49e8b-e597-4500-b0be-65ebee70ffa3.Text: "The death spinner mends the wounds of the breathing with a bloody thread. A horde of predators hunts you, {mf|Lord|Lady} of the Ark. Here, in the dark tunnels, the faithful stand in their way... But death is whispering for them, and they will not last long."

a2ef353c-4e0d-48b5-baed-ac7b205f9fb4.Text: "This man, blind and wretched, knows nothing... But He knows all." {n}He points a knotted finger at the majestic statue.{/n} "He reveals the truth to this unworthy speck, warns him through divinations... And the spinners who dance upon the threads help him grasp the visions."

a8259eea-8b9d-4d72-8667-775f882be87d.Text: "The Undying One's omens foretold that the blood of His faithful would flood the flagship's pipes — that I too would join this blood and flow with it... I understand now. He whispers to me, and this string of traitors' names caresses my hearing."

5de7d2da-8de8-4941-8fe8-766d6431fb7e.Text: "At last has Domin'{name} honoured us with a visit, and we welcome {mf|his|her} arrival. This was preordained — blood was meant to lead the Domin to death's abode. Yet it was not the scarlet trail of she who first spun the Web, but rather, the blood of aberrations that guided {mf|his|her} way... Yes, this still pleases the Undying One."

7cfc4903-2cca-462b-941f-e9d28820bd44.Text: {n}Heinrix rubs the bridge of his nose in exhaustion.{/n} "This is the worst scenario imaginable. All this time, your ship has been carrying the very progenitor of the Genestealer cell. A xenos of immense psychic and physical strength who has total control over the cultists. It must be destroyed. This is no longer a question of our own safety, but rather the continued existence of the Expanse as a whole."

97c6dc2d-319b-4267-bb71-9f9f5803b872.Text: "We did not know who our foe is. There was only the appalling shadow upon the bulkheads; the divinations were silent, and no answer was read. But the signs changed when the corruption assailed your flagship: the Undying One bid us bare our blades, and among the deaths of the wicked, answers rang out. At once I sent His spinners to those of the lower bays that should not fall into the foe's hands. Others became guides for your chosen few."

e222be64-c097-4aa6-bf7a-3ee3808a9f61.Text: "This is also the desire of the Undying One. He has not whispered the name of young Giorek, so we may heal him."

92efb432-ab18-443c-ad96-8399552f0e78.Text: "I smell no reason to worry about this one's head staying on his shoulders. His bearing tells me all — this worn body belies the spirit of a mighty warrior, the kind who stands tall in the midst of battle, knee-deep in blood and with a grim prayer on his lips."

5ce3086a-1a69-44a3-8af0-c1219e7560f2.Text: "Glaito sensed one of the cultists coming. I thought your sect had finally shown its true colours and had started assassinating the crew. You are officially cleared of suspicion — but in regard to this incident only."

a16a28f0-87b1-46d9-a7f3-f89f9d2856c6.Text: {n}His shrivelled face turns to you. His lips quiver in joyous anticipation.{/n} "Once again, the Tenets of the Web lead us along the thread of righteous struggle. The foe, the flagship's tormentor, until now unseen, has shown its face at last. My blades have left their sheaths, and duty commands them to slake their thirst with monstrous blood."

91f0c442-bd5d-48e2-ab3e-4d0940333edd.Text: "A surprisingly sensible plan. I expected something less judicious and more... bloodthirsty."

8c94cf91-17e5-425f-8a20-ddad016b52fa.Text: "They call the true master 'the Sire,' it which spawned the cult. A vessel of xenoheresy, a fierce yet cunning predator that twists their minds into a single knot with only its will... That knot must be severed."

632892f5-99d5-4332-baec-35ed7a17aade.Text: "There is no glory to be found in a needless death, Wolf of Midnight. The foe will choke on the blood you lust for soon enough. Ready your fangs and your claws."

58c217bc-9691-456d-b07b-02f1799ae119.Text: "At first, I thought they were coming to finish me off. What a surprise: even a witch gets rescued sometimes!"

da8a9d46-8cc6-4bac-8bd1-3b718c949695.Text: "It was a wise move to deny the assassins their target without starting a panic among the crew."

3ad3553e-d56a-4ecf-a728-9a9287112349.Text: "The spinners could use a lesson in courtesy, but should I really complain of mistreatment? It was not the first time, and, by the Exalted One, it will not be the last."

630b5388-cf93-4a6a-b6a3-6947ca401da3.Text: The blood of those whose names the Undying Emperor has whispered strengthens His servant's body and spirit. This ring embodies that dogma.

ac1c645c-5ab2-437d-b6e0-6e3a37c2b96b.Text: The sight of a Bloodspun Web initiate's grim attire inspires terror in their enemies and pious trepidation in followers of the Undying One — for this bone armour, sheathed tightly in thin leather, identifies the wearer as a messenger of death itself.

84ad5409-121e-4b46-bcd3-15773c44965a.Text: [Look up into the face of the Undying Emperor's statue]

730b5dd2-fbac-47d7-a2d9-cc64666f25a3.Text: [Offer a prayer to the Undying Emperor]

c6c84dd7-1552-40e6-97fd-dfc496d728dd.Text: Whispered words of corruption during a sacred death cultist ceremony.

77e8dd01-ef25-4bb2-a7ef-e4b7796e81d4.Text: [Wipe the blood off your face with disgust] "When is this going to end..."

cc0a1377-c44a-4856-8bc5-c13e75fb2fdd.Text: "Bloodwarden? Very flattering. I will add it to my other titles."

fc5f4577-cc3b-4bcc-a04b-32ed3f58fc03.Text: "It felt as if the God-Emperor was watching me..."

bbf923f5-958a-438b-ac41-f7eaa51db0ae.Text: "Does that mean I have passed the ritual?"

6ea28ec2-9528-4acc-bdfa-ebf2aa660f32.Text: {n}Upon the ritual platform, at the Undying Emperor's feet, under the keen gaze of His dark, empty eye sockets, you feel completely insignificant. Surprisingly, the thick blood pouring from His hands onto your brow, chest, and shoulders is still warm.{/n}

a5a75b63-e02d-45f9-8a21-0c6f79248279.Text: {n}A familiar {d|Encyclopedia:Prologue_CutByKnife}whisper{/d} is scratching at the periphery of your consciousness. Or is it an inner voice?{/n} "Even if He hears you, what does He care? He did not save Theodora. He will not save you either. You are not His chosen one. But what if... you offer a prayer to the gods that are truly immortal? The ones who do not hold back with their gifts? The ones who are always willing to accept you?"

7ea9a507-519b-48ef-a1f9-2aca8523cf9d.Text: {n}Each word consecrated to Him echoes in your temples and chest. Your veins become hot, and your blood turns to liquid flame. You have no fear in you. A whisper seems to come from above, from the Emperor's lips of stone: "I see you."{/n}

7794939d-1051-4acc-9d63-711e6445f9b0.Text: {n}The words of corruption fill your consciousness like rotting pus from a lanced abscess. A whisper of approval gurgles and purrs inside your brain. The blood streaming down your face becomes sweeter than honey... However, a dismal feeling comes over you as well. As though the gaze of the statue's empty eye sockets has grown a dozen times heavier, and the stream of blood is lashing your back and shoulders harder than before.{/n}

c8ddeffc-159a-40b8-829b-875a03000673.Text: {n}Blood floods your eyes. It creeps its way into your ears and nostrils. You slide your hands down your face, trying in vain to escape it, but breathing becomes ever harder.{/n}

81ac57c1-22a1-4060-9822-40406ff8afd6.Text: {n}A rusty taste fills your mouth, causing a spasm in your stomach. Your head is spinning, but you struggle to determine if it is a thrilling sensation or one of profound revulsion.{/n}

34a8598a-51f2-4112-9c93-562e25e67cc0.Text: {n}The strange rash you developed in the freight line's pestilence pit grows pale and scabs over. A healing grace descends upon you.{/n}

a92e5fca-3f87-40ab-a092-52cf451b68f8.Text: {n}Could the lingering intoxication still be playing tricks on your mind?{/n}

ef2a6fad-89c1-4f64-8651-09843d451045.Text: {n}The cultists whisper prayers to the Undying One as they help you change your clothes and regain your faculties.{/n}

118be60f-2fc7-4ffc-9ce3-f1969dfc8711.Text: {n}Blood falls into your eyes. You hiss in pain, but raise your head. Through a red mist, you glimpse a harsh truth in the Emperor's face: death sees you. Death is watching you.{/n}

49ed930c-295f-4cef-9a1b-1770eb0c87e8.Text: {n}It seems the disease you caught in the freight line's pestilence pit is getting worse. Your skin is more itchy, and dark patches are forming in a few places.{/n}

1f51a079-9fa2-420e-a654-37ce9bbbfbde.Text: "To many, He comes during their time of service, in images of blood and whispers from the shadows. But remember that those are mere visions. For true death will not come for you until your time, and it will take your soul gently in its bony hands."

3ee7a503-db7a-4c3a-9c24-8af66a0595fb.Text: "Now that you are part of the Bloodspun Web, remember henceforth to beware of vanity. For it leaves gaping rents in the armour of our souls."

b10fc940-233e-455d-aa78-cc8c219eac0a.Text: {n}Bowed before His image, the Vizsier assumes the ceremonial postures with incredible ease, his withered body moving swiftly and soundlessly. You are slowly plunged into darkness to the sound of ritual chants and swooshing blades. Amid the noise of splashing blood and the cultists' whispers you hear the words,{/n} "Death has spoken your name, Domin'{name}. Death accepts you."

1823d3aa-9734-486f-a3e2-424158e37bb7.Text: "For years, we have maintained fealty to the Domini. We have collected sacred symbols and relics. You are the first in three generations of lords and ladies to grace this sanctum. And the first of them all to be initiated so. We are grateful. We are uplifted in spirit. Hear our exultation and accept this gift of a vestment sewn from the bones of His faithful with the threads of death."

2956ab50-7153-48d3-83ce-28e825a65e97.Text: {n}The Vizsier's voice grows suddenly thunderous and snaps you out of your reflections.{/n} "Death has accepted you, Domin'{name}! Now and for all of time, you are the Bloodwarden and the Undying One's most venerable servant."

83052c5e-9ffd-4221-b50a-f0cffb9bebee.Text: "The ritual is complete... but you are not." {n}The Vizsier gestures for one of the cultists, who is carefully holding a strange garment, to come closer.{/n}

e874430b-48a6-419f-b723-540ad3eea282.Text: {n}A strange whisper brushes against the edge of your hearing. You cannot make out the words spoken by this infinitely distant yet infinitely powerful voice... You are not even certain whether you actually heard something or simply imagined it.{/n}

801ddf27-4c0f-4c19-ae37-017a439cc859.Text: "I intend to stay here a while longer."

6065d540-32dd-4126-bef2-c1f4c8d52e36.Text: "Take me to the enforcer in charge of the freight line hub. I have business with him."

9c8b2fe0-5e2e-4a56-a8bd-667d64f478e0.Text: {n}A spinner, his face covered in carved, bleeding glyphs, makes a respectful gesture of invitation.{/n} "Let me show you the way, Domin."

8c36916a-cbc0-4f73-b502-5f3f289210f3.Text: {n}The spinner points his finger upward, at the ventilation shaft through which you reached the temple the first time.{/n} "The path to where the laypeople dwell is complex. Web-like. Let me show you."

14494288-c822-4443-89fc-e06314ebcfcc.Text: "We're maximally minimising the... er... risk of a leak, Lord Captain!"

3b63cb00-0b44-4b85-856a-38e1252ed8f3.Text: "It's not going boom on my shift!"

dec9995d-f53d-4bb9-ad94-bfa5d22f574d.Text: "Conducting a routine inspection of the units for critical integrity violations, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

5c76e03c-7f7d-45ca-8a0b-99ff2e6e80bb.Text: You can just make out a faded symbol on one of the tiles — a serpent and a star. There appears to be someone's stash behind it, but the stash has long been abandoned.

93d979bb-793b-427a-9b8c-9040da1f1330.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Can I offer you a lho-stick?"

a00d8b63-5fa5-4e1e-a52b-ebf49f8f15c4.Text: "No incidents to report, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. We're on watch!"

f5f1ad41-72c8-4153-afc5-940d74d95ec6.Text: The lift is stuck between the platforms. There must be mechanisms capable of powering the machine spirit with energy somewhere in the compartment.

a64aa18c-4faf-434e-b9c9-bd95c736edab.Text: "Why are there enforcers here? To guard the Lord Captain? Do they think we'd do something to harm {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship}?"

3ffa49c2-2aec-467d-b1c6-3059b1928ac9.Text: "Look at the enforcers with {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship}! Nasty brutes, by the looks of them!"

a56500ac-ce80-4396-95ed-507c9d3998e1.Text: "If any of the rabble dare to show any disrespect, we'll be right here. We'll put them down."

bb4353bb-7e09-49ba-bb48-406ff80de702.Text: "Mistress Sauerback has stationed us in the compartment while you honour the workers here with your visit."

2e44b7f5-db3c-43ac-97c9-581e4361a214.Text: "Our esteemed officers have relaxed the schedule — every four hours we get a ten-minute break!"

fd03c4bc-24a5-4682-87a6-143d858d7d40.Text: A worker intently puffs on a lho-stick, trying to finish it in the short break.

da5cda6f-4513-4839-8b61-b7eb780a3879.Text: "I used to have decent workers, but now they only send me cretins. How am I supposed to meet my quota with this lot?"

b228b347-3648-4961-ab6b-833ec66d5829.Text: "Put your backs into it, lads! The Lord Captain's watching — don't embarrass yourselves!"

82099096-eab1-434a-8247-530665c040e2.Text: "Shift yourselves, you brainless lumps! If I catch any of you slacking, I'll leave you without rations!"

6312357d-29ba-46b8-8246-7fd8d33a8c4e.Text: "Proud to toil for the good of the flagship, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"

c279796a-259f-4672-bbe7-37e509688a80.Text: "They sent us bad nuts, all rusted. You'll sort it out, punish whoever's responsible! Nuts are a serious business, after all!"

76ebf0e2-1665-445d-a300-c0171a00e9e1.Text: "You've graced the compartment with your presence, Lord Captain. Blessed the deck, so to speak, with your noble foot."

f63de7c7-f7b3-44ad-aa32-e229242f3530.Text: The worker stares at you, face twisted in an expression of fierce zeal.

0c513702-5f44-4581-aae2-924cb6a76c99.Text: With a pitiful clanking sound, the servitor's claw docks with the mechanism and begins to perform the necessary manipulations.

e6b6447d-5958-42cf-996c-e55b1be6a6ba.Text: "Heed these words, and commit not the transgression of industrial accident! Praise the Omnissiah thrice, and only then lay your hand upon the lever. Pull the lever with confidence and restraint, for the machine spirit tolerates no haste..."

74c42b0e-4ee3-4652-82f6-b291d9abd3aa.Text: The Rogue Trader knows that the conspirators are armed with webbers, and thus comes properly equipped.

2c46ebbb-9e3f-45a7-b1f7-af7fa3c7620c.Text: Not even abominable spawn can hide the truth from the Rogue Trader.

6625563c-b9b6-45a1-b7a8-a9aa56d1309b.Text: "Heinrix, you are going to burn a hole in him with that glare of yours."

eb759527-e96e-4b53-9815-5e2084e0df9a.Text: "I presume our next objective is the von Valancius dynastic crypt?"

fc88b3e7-9620-4adf-af01-4ecff0f8f606.Text: "Good work, Einrich. Were any of your people harmed?"

16688ffe-c0b2-40ea-81f4-2fa3f8e52892.Text: "Sauerback, your people have exceeded my expectations."

176110c4-14b9-4d19-80a1-2f790ae60a5b.Text: [Address the prisoner] "Well? Do you feel like talking yet?"

a75a3bca-0552-40aa-8635-9d2932603a43.Text: "He does not deserve an easy death. Give him to your enforcers for training in the executioner's craft."

96d01c63-4ac8-4f62-b734-d0aa2ffb460b.Text: "We are not monsters, no matter what he thinks of us. Turn him in on the nearest colony for a life sentence on a penal world."

1dc1b651-2546-4c87-98fc-66f27619e3ec.Text: [Raise your voice] "Watch your tongue, peasant! You are in the presence of the Rogue Trader!"

70975369-2394-4c27-9c45-db64e53c4116.Text: "I wish to know everything about your vile cult."

7402879b-5fc2-4f1e-ad19-11df80f45562.Text: "Heinrix, I invite you to demonstrate what an Interrogator of the Inquisition is capable of."

5f77da11-f7c1-4e6e-bbc6-c32808a431e0.Text: "Idira, acquaint this man with what lies beyond the veil of reality."

7f32471b-12e2-4a07-a96a-18fd2cc08c5a.Text: "I'm the heretic, am I? Either fear has robbed him of reason, or he has a very skewed perspective."

e59b0f51-8d98-4e67-a9f8-8a6fbedd30c3.Text: [Fill the prisoner's head with visions of warp horrors] "You will retch up your short-sighted belief in your own courage along with your confession, insect."

f6647811-ba0f-4107-b210-68dc42cb775a.Text: "Inject him with substances that break the subject's will. But be sure not to melt his brain."

05a938bd-46c3-43d5-8286-1d950a3c4300.Text: "I am done. He will sooner die by my hand than talk."

1df1581b-ea61-43d2-a048-bae194e8a3c6.Text: "This 'angel' — is that the old sorcerer who appeared before me and promised my demise? Did he brainwash you all? Or is someone else leading you?"

f09f0529-6b33-4590-896d-6b799fa0568f.Text: "What is their objective? Power? Bloody sacrifices to their god?"

cc5484db-ff1a-4015-a16a-0a69be0078ab.Text: "Solomorne, show us why the Arbites are feared."

7c5defba-01a3-47ac-954e-0f3c1172100f.Text: "Calm yourself. Talk to me, and I will not let these people do what they intend to do."

daf3c103-7041-4db8-be05-f23d6b2f5806.Text: "Where are you hiding? Where are your leaders?"

8d22dbfb-7a0c-45b0-beba-a73bd35e10d9.Text: [Torture him as they tortured you] "I know the true meaning of torment. Allow me to educate you."

235150f1-d118-4bd5-ab1c-02fca7b64208.Text: Spared the captured conspirator so that you could torture him for your own amusement.

201ad229-dc00-4ccf-b58a-d763976afa55.Text: "Such forthrightness deserves a reward. I give you a cage in my own quarters — you are now my personal slab of meat, and your torture has only just begun."

f547e055-6f14-42a3-b790-e79ce53657a1.Text: "What do you know about our enemy?"

23af7a89-49bd-429e-81fc-fb30567aa2da.Text: "Why do they choose to act among the rabble specifically?"

c1e0efb7-fec0-4383-871e-87ff161a5ee9.Text: "Do you have anything more to add, Heinrix?"

c663fcb1-5648-443c-8234-b9999488f2bd.Text: "Let us return to interrogating the prisoner."

f0673f66-1551-4e19-b2f5-2a9b1a1d9b45.Text: {n}The man kneeling before you has an ungainly build, a stubborn jaw, and a heavy gaze. He looks no different from any other worker in this compartment, except for the tattoo on his forearm, its design resembling a worm devouring a star.{/n}

5410dccf-9177-4af6-8621-23b9d8391063.Text: {n}The Master-at-Arms regards the infernus sternly.{/n} "The weapon — hand it over. What you saw — keep it to yourself." {n}She forces out the words through clenched teeth:{/n} "Your cooperation with the enforcers will be noted."

17379ea2-5cb6-4c0b-a7a2-f7ae5b25a51b.Text: {n}Abelard grumbles,{/n} "And once again the Lord Captain is doing {mf|his|her} subjects' work for them. Dirty, bloody work."

925fec2e-a8bc-4ab4-9a8e-305a511f01a1.Text: "I would advise you to prepare for the worst. The cult could have been operating on the ship for a long time, in which case it might already have a small army at its disposal. And I am not talking about infiltrators with a semi-human appearance — such cults command strong, fast monstrosities whose claws tear through metal like paper. Psychically attuned mutants linked to the Brood's collective mind. Specialised abominations and elite specimens at the top of the cult's hierarchy. The enemy is dangerous and has many faces."

31733365-06d1-41de-ba6a-3defd7a84a9e.Text: {n}Heinrix does not take his eyes off the prisoner's neck, his lips twisted in distaste.{/n}

33b80747-f6da-4970-80ba-b281022c5819.Text: "Or me." {n}Einrich's menacing scowl has instantly robbed him of his friendly charm.{/n} "I'd be happy to oblige."

fc1873ec-6c57-4270-9108-43fff91c1ecd.Text: "The more likely reason is that it helps them blend in. They hide their heresy behind the veil of normality. Just one more cult like so many others. Moreover, it is possible that they indeed see their deity that way. Such cultists have been known to describe their grotesque xenos masters as beautiful during interrogations. Monsters are angels to them, and the God-Emperor's worshippers are heretics."

6cd1a7ce-8055-4f9f-9684-81d8ac565ade.Text: {n}Sauerback gives the prisoner a gentle smile.{/n} "Did you hear that? You're mine."

69ddc3da-1348-4a35-9b18-abf3ce8265d9.Text: {n}Before the Master-at-Arms lies a groaning heap that was once a man. It shudders and lets out a gurgling sob:{/n} "Stop... I'll... talk..."

5429322e-8d31-401c-a830-c023f8b31016.Text: "The poor are less likely to pay attention to strange behaviour or disappearances. Even if someone sees a genetic monster, they will chalk it up to a bad case of mutation. Meanwhile, the cult attracts the weak and injured — easy prey for their indoctrinators. In other words, it makes for a convenient staging ground."

5faf2e7e-4b3b-466c-a28e-1c39b76464b5.Text: {n}Einrich's cutter coughs up blue flame.{/n} "He will."

e88f9ce3-be04-447e-b82d-66f08a4cac3f.Text: {n}Sauerback looks at him with a radiant smile.{/n} "The prisoner is ready to cooperate, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

b25a0601-770d-405e-8369-3147a1b81b5f.Text: {n}Minutes seem to stretch forever, each filled with howling and the smell of cooked meat. Finally, Einrich retreats with a guilty expression as his unbroken victim continues to whisper curses at him.{/n}

cf1cb90a-5876-42fd-8320-cc5d888a6e08.Text: "The Cult... of the Ravenous Star... The true believers... The righteous... The purest Congregation... They who hear... the songs of His angel..."

304e4c09-7fd8-4195-81e8-57753f8cc3dd.Text: "I... believed! I found Him, I bowed to Him! His angel's kin granted me a revelation... It entered... my flesh... It let me join... the Congregation..." {n}The man's words devolve into nonsensical muttering.{/n}

5c2e70e6-b75d-4e71-9e4f-d0e0a76e4d96.Text: "Yes, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. We must attack now, while we still have the element of surprise. I will lead the strike force, but I will require your presence and Confessor Adalbert's help. Fierce machine spirits guard the dead. They won't let an armed troop pass without a direct command from the Rogue Trader and the ring of the ship's confessor. I will meet you at the doors."

6279753e-1a0c-4992-a319-65fb65a9cf15.Text: "As you command. Although I believe this zealot will require some effort. Questioning fanatics is a long and exhilarating process."

a60fdefc-e297-47e4-b95c-daf6cb486b4a.Text: "This is a pawn, a mindless tool. He was brainwashed and forced into submission. He is not even a distributor of ideology, he was merely fed the rudiments, and, without trusting him with anything important, they sent him out to serve and die."

f455e6a6-4a74-4265-aeab-c125b1b63537.Text: "Death! Yours..." {n}Even broken, he musters a spiteful sneer.{/n} "Fake captain... The faithful are already aiming for your heart. I was ordered... to stockpile weapons, so that when the fateful hour comes, the righteous would not stand unarmed!"

44bb17de-0008-4ca0-a21c-093387c9eb4c.Text: {n}The Interrogator touches his own neck in the same spot where the prisoner has his fresh scar.{/n} "A sign of infection, I'm sure of it."

144848d1-6f13-4417-b698-64fd55dcf457.Text: {n}The Interrogator touches different spots on the prisoner's body, coldly commenting on the effects his {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerGlossary}sorcery{/g} is having on the writhing man. He makes his blood boil, then freeze, then boil again. He arrests his heart, makes it beat rapidly, then back again. At last, Heinrix steps away.{/n}

048dc3fb-bd8c-441f-a6f4-0a52d8affdee.Text: {n}Idira lays her hands on the prisoner's temples, looks into his eyes, and opens her mouth. The shadows in the room dart back and forth, and an unnatural, discordant wave of noise bursts from the psyker's lips. The man's body shudders, his breathing turns ragged. His face contorts into a grimace of pain and horror, blood trickles from his nose. A few minutes later, Idira staggers back to you.{/n}

03acecfb-78d3-47cb-af4e-3698dce02fca.Text: {n}Marazhai's long, slender silhouette looms over the prisoner, and you see something flash in his hands. You are unsure what exactly the Drukhari does to the man, but the sounds and the convulsions give you an idea of the agony in which the torturer drowns his victim. Eventually, Marazhai returns to you with a scoff.{/n}

aaf8a45b-4ffb-4d45-9cd2-6a4f465cc450.Text: {n}A haze of psychic frost coats the floor at your feet. You and the rest perceive only glimpses and shadows of the {g|Encyclopedia:WarpGlossary}Empyrean{/g} terrors creeping through the weakened veil, but the warp senses a weakness in the mind of the wounded and frightened man and sinks its claws deep. The prisoner begins to shake, his face contorted in a grimace of pain and horror, blood bursting from his nose. His eyes roll up as if to gaze inside his head at things that no living soul should have to witness.{/n}

f520bcb8-7604-413d-8eca-d3c8c7b38b28.Text: "Procedure complete. Insignificant parts of the unit's frontal lobe responsible for motivation have been removed. I expect an increase in the unit's obedience levels." {n}Pasqal's voice conveys as much emotion as the sound of his drill.{/n}

3e7570b5-8402-45b9-ad0a-90661dcfdeaa.Text: {n}The screams of pain eventually give way to weak, long wails. The man's body lies broken, slashed, cut open, and burnt. His ruptured skin reveals open fractures and torn tendons. His eyes widen in terror at your smallest movement in his direction.{/n}

0cf6bc3d-cff1-446d-92c2-428c28ee9ce6.Text: {n}The chemical concoction burns the man's mind from within. His muscles twitch, tensed to the point of his sinew cracking. A torrent of nightmares born from his subconscious assaults his brain, but he cannot even scream — he moans, choking on his own saliva.{/n}

664224e8-5689-4bec-b1e4-195ad8435176.Text: "Request approved." {n}You watch the shadows of Pasqal's {g|Encyclopedia:Mechadendrite}mechadendrites{/g} advance on the prisoner before the Tech-Priest's frame blocks your view. You hear the shriek of the drill, the crunching of bone, and screams. When Pasqal withdraws, you notice two bleeding, precisely made holes in the prisoner's skull, as well as his twitching, differently sized pupils.{/n}

022ad92e-13bc-48d9-8a8a-7e947dc09265.Text: {n}His hysterical scream rises to the ceiling:{/n} "My suffering is naught, for I hear his songs and believe!"

1f476584-7acb-4bf0-a71d-f95b5ea7e816.Text: {n}And yet even in this pit of horrors, he somehow manages to latch onto something that gives him strength. A nasty, triumphant smirk spreads across his spasm-ridden face.{/n}

54d259da-db05-4507-9462-802bd7125f43.Text: "Hmm. I would play for longer, but... if I continue, there won't even be scraps left for you."

441445eb-c060-445c-8ca0-b44260d8f655.Text: {n}A gurgling sob falls from the man's lips:{/n} "Stop... I'll... talk..."

a2752bb7-015a-4588-816b-4839ca6f47f6.Text: {n}The man whimpers incoherently but grits his teeth.{/n} "Your song... I hear it... I won't break..."

44b8966d-2f53-4f9a-b185-d0803082bfef.Text: "Old sorcerer? No, the angel is not of the woeful human form... He is splendour! His visage is a divine inspiration of the Many-Armed Emperor! You, faithless one, were granted the honour of gazing upon the Magus, our good shepherd... our messenger." {n}The captive lets out a deranged chuckle.{/n} "If you beheld the angel, you would scratch your own brain out through your eye sockets... for you would realise the depth of your wickedness before him!"

ed22c48c-2ba0-47f8-803b-0aeff256c9b0.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, this serf was arrested on suspicion of stealing machine components. He was searched and found to be carrying a strange weapon built from the parts. We also discovered symbols matching the description you provided." {n}Sauerback looks at her prey with vicious excitement.{/n}

721d9258-5cea-44e7-8183-220f5b30a1a4.Text: {n}One of the infernus workers is holding the webber taken from the prisoner — exactly like the one that was in the cache.{/n}

4ea17b5c-16b1-4ef3-a386-32baff2a1567.Text: "Shouf Galai, servant of the blessed lathe Beta-II-Diligence. Low-ranking worker, easily replaceable. No apparent signs of mutation."

a3e51cea-7274-4759-8012-5bd68ea7e425.Text: "Thank you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, not a scratch on us. He's a piece of work, right enough, but he's no fuel compartment fire. More like a sparking cogitator."

ed36da1d-545e-4c5a-8424-e0bd008d179f.Text: "We are honoured to be of service to Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}." {n}The Master-at-Arms offers you a fervid bow.{/n}

f5ad86f5-3ee6-4172-a0d9-52ca27a17b9e.Text: {n}The prisoner gives you the smile of a man condemned and snaps,{/n} "I've got nothing to say to you, heretic!"

7ef84fef-2ace-4613-86fe-7ec2d69d5ac0.Text: {n}Choking with rage, Sauerback grabs the maul from her belt. She rasps,{/n} "Allow me, Lord Captain... Please..."

8f686aa8-7520-4d7c-b24e-2c77b4361372.Text: {n}The man laughs with contempt, then starts chanting:{/n} "Tempting are the promises of heretics, but barren as the darkness-cursed void in which they bury the souls of those who trust them!"

c71afa9b-c6c3-471f-ad38-20dbde27bca3.Text: "Terrorise me, torment me, gratify your rotten heart, heretic! Know the strength of a martyr's spirit, and come to fear it!" {n}The prisoner's eyes flash as he gives you an inviting gap-toothed smile.{/n}

e6f2e810-9f8d-487a-bdb9-f5a11e75742a.Text: {n}The anguish of your distant {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Torture}past{/d} resurfaces in your mind. You know how to make flesh suffer, and so, you make it suffer, your handiwork rivalling that of your own former torturers. Sauerback bites her lip as she stares at you and the writhing man. You were a good student.{/n}

804b2777-ad4a-4277-8493-43161841996f.Text: {n}The prisoner lets out a long howl filled with despair.{/n}

634f7fc9-4c35-4ddc-8563-7721f5037f79.Text: "Amateur. I request Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}'s permission to show the Infernus Master how it's done."

3c3140a2-c34b-40b9-8219-6f5a2e8348d9.Text: "Many-Armed?" {n}A deep furrow appears on Sauerback's brow.{/n} "Blast it! Lord Captain, we are dealing with an extremely dangerous xenos cult that excels at hiding among humans."

22e9c345-3c7f-49eb-b11b-d39a024b9269.Text: "Very little. As per regulations, every Master-at-Arms passes on special instructions to their successor — instructions that more resemble disturbing tales. Some of them mention genetic cults — covert clans, cliques, and sects that all share one common trait: xenos infestation."

2b3658f2-703c-460a-8d99-617581e77fba.Text: "We believe... in the Many-Armed Emperor... He who waits... for His children, cast out into the unknowable abyss. He is kind... merciful... He uproots tyrannies of evil... He sends His angel to the righteous, and angel's kin follow..." {n}The man lowers his gaze with an expression of surprise. It seems he has described his paltry religion in its entirety.{/n}

a267daac-303d-4d9f-90e6-7fa774ae74c6.Text: "Their arms, Lord Captain. These xenos have more arms than normal. They twist and pervert our faith, probably for the sole reason that it gives them blasphemous pleasure."

e71a3f19-eaa7-486a-8477-204e07080343.Text: "Genestealers, {name}. That is what these enemies of Humanity are called. When such a creature bites its victim, it injects its gene into their body and dominates their mind. Or, more accurately, it binds it to the shared mind of the Brood. The victim undergoes no visible change, but their offspring will carry the brand of inhuman nature. Bestial maws, extra limbs, or something worse at times — horrific genetic outliers. However, the cult makes sure to keep any of their kind with unnatural appearance out of sight. After several generations, the mutants become practically indistinguishable from humans, but then something in their genes once more begets fully developed xenos capable of beginning the cycle of infestation anew."

bfd3ed6f-2039-4cdb-a598-411935439426.Text: "The lower decks have plenty of dark corners for the xenos to lie in wait. Commoners are too dull-witted and spineless to identify the threat before it is too late. And at the same time, they are dull-witted and spineless enough to serve as cannon fodder to be thrown at the cult's enemies when the uprising begins."

daf442f7-857c-452e-9ec9-a04c923978b7.Text: "He's had enough. If I go any harder on him, his brains will roll up and crawl out of his nostrils. And honestly, I've had enough too — better stop now before we wind up with some warp spawn on our hands."

785a08b0-365f-4019-af51-55c69a5ab1f6.Text: "These things pass themselves off as ordinary people, as rabble or preachers, corrupting new groups. They pray to their unholy idol, which they often refer to as the Many-Armed Emperor. They create ever-growing families and produce offspring — hideous at first, but with each new generation, more and more human in appearance. And then, they rise up."

42023556-68de-4389-98e8-e8255073cbad.Text: {n}In lieu of answering, Sauerback nods grimly, lost in troubling thoughts.{/n}

a02c1928-f2e1-4fff-98cd-7daf57f3d147.Text: "In a sanctuary... A tomb... for heretics... A quiet place..."

ddeacc98-d146-4211-99e4-d79b5a2a5ee9.Text: {n}Sauerback glares at him with visible jealousy, but Einrich just keeps grinning smugly.{/n}

f07042d4-eb83-4535-a86e-6671ae8aa1c8.Text: "Their end goal is always mutiny. They can prepare for many generations, accumulating weapons and numbers, until one day, they attack. That day is their 'day of revelation,' the apotheosis of their profane faith. They think that on that day, their blasphemous 'Star Children' will descend from the void and elevate their worshippers."

32808887-f25a-4156-a0fa-bad8da0e5aa1.Text: {n}The prisoner jerks as if trying to point at you with his tied hands.{/n} "You're a false believer, a fake captain! You're leading people into the gloom of heresy, away from salvation!"

6c7e7f27-2e18-4f24-bb2d-6fa9d03158a4.Text: {n}The Master-at-Arms says with a warm smile,{/n} "Please, allow me. He won't die by my hand. I won't let him."

e524f69b-718d-4070-82ca-60c9daa08bd9.Text: "The creatures that infect the first victims act as scouts for a xenos race known as Tyranids. After creating a Genestealer Cult, the scout... 'evolves' into something more complex, an entity called the Patriarch. The collective mind of the Brood becomes a psychic beacon for the Tyranids, a beacon that marks the planet as vulnerable. Once the xenos fleet approaches the infected world, the rebellion begins. The cult strikes the world's defenders in the back while the xenos devour all life on the planet. And the cult's true believers certainly do not find the ascension they were promised. Instead, they all become a bioresource. Food."

578ab631-6c52-4084-8f6a-f37848eafc10.Text: "I fear you are right, Mistress Sauerback. This— actually, please, continue. I will correct you should your information contradict credible intelligence."

7d212267-5423-4286-ac35-00874d75a3a6.Text: {n}The pigment of the tattoo looks fresh, standing out starkly against the colour of his skin, which means that it is a very recent addition. You look closely and you notice a pair of scars at the base of his neck, suspiciously reminiscent of an almost healed bite.{/n}

1b733503-b530-45a8-9b66-f574062603f2.Text: {n}The Interrogator slowly shakes his head.{/n} "It's too early for that... Let's see what he has to say first."

e00e5f18-653c-488a-8015-83d8c8598f5f.Text: {n}You notice a strange mark on the man's neck: it looks like a superficial burn, or yet another pestilence from the lower decks.{/n}

01a2c5dd-4080-419a-9443-8365072cd1ae.Text: "He has proved far more useful than I expected. He must have been in the cult only for a short time, and the psychic connection to his brethren had not taken root in his mind. No amount of torture would have loosened his tongue otherwise..." {n}Heinrix frowns.{/n} "Things are progressing too smoothly. I don't like it."

6a5affb6-c9d9-42f3-ac84-e845634ce1e3.Text: {n}Casting a glance at the prisoner whispering incoherently under his breath, Sauerback adds off-handedly,{/n} "And this vile scum, with your permission, I'll throw out of the airlock. I doubt he will be of any further use."

6e5c5b56-c6e5-4e99-af8a-240f2595034c.Text: "The speeches of your enemies, mon-keigh, sound just like your own. Fanatical, composed of nothing but rage and contempt. Is even that not enough to make you wonder?"

4bc56002-ec78-4278-ac56-13919ce873a3.Text: {n}Argenta exhales hoarsely:{/n} "Damn you all, distorters of holy words!"

4bcc6ba8-4a29-4750-8a39-3d49dd650984.Text: {n}Snarling furiously, Ulfar clenches his fist.{/n} "Many-armed poison... I smell the foul seed of the xenos. The Iron Priests say it once fell into the waters of Fenris, and from it came the terrible sea krakens. Well, Fenris is here, Fenris is ready to hunt."

f457b096-d5f1-4b04-80ad-10f55fb1143b.Text: {n}Cassia whispers in mesmerised horror,{/n} "His soul is pale, almost colourless, but alien hues have seeped into it. Unthinkable and insane... and they came from without."

02b636a4-84f5-4455-84d0-635b6b972eda.Text: "I have heard of them, and every tale was awash in blood. They are the reapers of the Great Devourer — predators that have bloomed from its seed, beasts whose gift is to turn the weak-spirited into their enthralled fighters. Beware of them, elantach. When they are near, even a loyal friend may turn out to be a messenger of death."

636ac2c9-8939-42f6-8afe-b886d333c5fe.Text: {n}At a barely noticeable gesture from the Proctor, Glaito lunges at the prisoner, bites down, and starts violently shaking his arm. You hear the man's bones break and his flesh tear apart, but his screams are filled with horror rather than pain — so overpowering is his fear of this living weapon of the Lex Imperialis that knows no pity.{/n}

d83a6f78-39d0-40c6-9703-16684d3db54b.Text: "I am finished, {name}. If that didn't suffice, I do not recommend applying biomancy again — we may lose the prisoner."

3293564d-ce2a-4156-9f97-07aab26fe982.Text: "Glaito, heel. The miscreant can't take any more. What we need is answers, not execution."

48ee1c25-6d6d-44ef-8d47-48c19feddca1.Text: "The dynastic crypt! The vermin have infiltrated the crypt holding the bodies of the worthiest servants of the dynasty!
