5a3a8b1d-a09c-4ef9-812e-25b633095f11.Text: {n}Jinevri looks at Klein with sympathy — she clearly cares about him, but does not wish to trample on her comrade's honour with words of comfort. Hrotko regards Klein with a contemptuous smirk, while Klein scowls back at him.{/n}

6777ae79-47ff-4409-b655-388772942bcf.Text: {n}Jinevri sneaks a few awkward glances at Klein. It is hard to say if she is embarrassed for her fellow officer or if she pities him. Hrotko looks at Klein with a sympathetic smile.{/n}

3170e2cb-8270-4d00-9b0d-cfa7f178d7b3.Text: "Well played, Lord Captain. It has been some time since I last saw this kind of fire in the old man's eyes."

db6afec9-e302-4aec-b983-1069628c2e44.Text: {n}Klein is up to his elbows in blood, his eyes flaring defiantly.{/n} "I've examined the filth inside and out. Its innards are a genetic nightmare — it's a bag of corruption wrapped in human skin. Extra organs, scales, atrophied ingrown limbs. But that's not what's important."

3e62080d-cc55-4e8a-bc8a-0cbeef88ec69.Text: {n}Sauerback shakes her head.{/n} "You have my apologies, Lord Captain. The man is not himself. He must be getting old. It will not happen again."

9f1e98eb-a1b3-43b5-8396-1283a6b4268f.Text: {n}Klein's lips tremble. His eyes bulge. He seems unable to stop wiping his reddened hands with a rag soaked in disinfectant.{/n} "Disgusting. Unspeakable. You can't even imagine what's inside that... thing. They should've burned the body right there and then. Whoever killed him should've just finished the job."

1f148bb4-183e-4c9f-a0d2-92d3e135c1d2.Text: "Someone wanted to hide the cause of death. What I fail to understand is why they would then leave the body out in the open instead of disposing of it."

9157fa27-2e57-40e6-b6d7-9c701d103c67.Text: "The killer wanted to tell us something. It can be difficult to make sense of a murderer's twisted logic."

d6199335-dba8-466b-b421-1a6bee3f473d.Text: "We should run the victim's identification number through the {g|Encyclopedia:Cogitator}master work log cogitator{/g}. If its machine spirit favours us, we will be able to narrow down the number of suspects. Jinevri, this is your arena."

e3c1f446-be19-48d9-922b-7f4cb18d9145.Text: "The pipewardens are a worker clan that services the ship's sewer systems. The tattoo indicates the worker's status and personal number. This one was..."

afa00d17-1a63-419a-8321-4c009d9ab570.Text: {n}Klein accepts the glass and downs it instantly. Evidently, he is in no state to savour the bouquet and taste of the fine drink you have offered him.{/n}

b4876854-2ab0-4d5b-827f-3dd7029c0453.Text: {n}As Klein bows his head guiltily, Sauerback mutters, her gaze boring into him,{/n} "Rest assured, Lord Captain, disciplinary measures will be applied to Captain Klein as soon as we are done with the investigation."

5af9cf37-ed2c-4a8e-822b-81f45d38bc43.Text: {n}Judging by the change in Klein's expression, the old {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Navy}voidsman saying{/d} appears to have improved his spirits.{/n} "That rotting carcass is no kraken, I can tell you that! Orders received, Lord Captain! I'll carve him up into shreds!"

c1c3fdb0-1352-4310-bc05-c0fa53c0e7a7.Text: "I concur. Would you like to give us specific instructions, Lord Captain?"

82763e16-754a-471a-a785-0f0dec0f6c23.Text: {n}Sauerback nods firmly.{/n} "If the perpetrator was in a hurry to cover their tracks, they may not have had time to dispose of the soiled clothing."

6aa45264-a916-4367-ae68-111e2b900c87.Text: {n}She sighs.{/n} "If it was a special or unique item, that might help. However, if the criminal was using an industrially manufactured weapon or tool instead of a makeshift one... Those are all the same. But we will conduct a thorough search, Lord Captain."

277691ba-7396-48e9-9b97-d905c81fce3a.Text: {n}Sauerback's eyebrow twitches nervously.{/n} "Follow my heart. But of course. I should have thought of it myself, Lord Captain."

86fe3ed2-4379-4f2e-a45d-29263c55567f.Text: "I thank Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} for your wise counsel."

422a6abf-b454-400b-a0de-a8f571a69186.Text: "Hrotko, go assist Klein with the autopsy."

d4bc8af4-4061-4134-8003-2ed76803fde0.Text: {n}You see a flash of genuine horror in Klein's eyes before his gaze turns glassy.{/n}

754432dc-f432-4388-b527-7f34f07589e2.Text: {n}Klein's face turns a deep red.{/n} "Shut your damn mouth, Hrotko! The things I've seen, the filth I've crushed... You want me to gut another one? You want to see its mutant blood on my hands? I'll show you blood!"

30eb59e5-ca60-45d2-92c6-d8374da497fe.Text: {n}Klein's pride begins to outweigh his fear. Ignoring Hrotko's taunts, he mutters,{/n} "I don't need rest. I... will do my duty and open up the freak."

439b1623-1256-473e-8a03-5f24d4342423.Text: {n}You catch Jinevri's grateful look, then watch as she smiles encouragingly at Klein.{/n} "Come on, Klein, you'd better teach the greenhorns how to carve up mutants. I'll grab us a pair of respirators to make sure we don't catch anything."

466360d7-56ee-4a37-9933-c7ca33685dd6.Text: {n}You have seen that look before in the eyes of other veterans. It's the expression of someone reliving painful memories that have left behind deep scars. They cannot hope to overcome such trauma on their own — they would need help, or a partner, or, perhaps, some strong emotional stimulus.{/n}

abb06536-4bda-412e-ba07-2a788c405b97.Text: "Indeed. Klein, why don't you go take a break? Maybe it's time you considered asking for a transfer to a less demanding post? Your best years are behind you. You should make way for the younger generation."

05f2053c-39e6-4441-bfd6-ab37918685b1.Text: "The wounds were so brutal I almost missed his work tattoo — the victim was a pipewarden. And I found this in his throat." {n}Klein presents a bloodstained raven feather.{/n}

1b23b4b1-1c8c-4971-83d5-5dead34f886f.Text: A lift to the Lord Captain's quarters is hidden behind the metal plating here. On the day of Voigtvir's mutiny, you saw Lady Theodora leave the officers' deck this way.

07a88b0d-8bc3-4ce6-80ca-8107efd6b299.Text: "The blessed elder is resting! Do not disturb its datadream!"

395103a3-a3a1-4890-aadb-2138e4c2765d.Text: The mounds of protocols enclose the archtranscriptors like paper bastions. You blink, and already, another thick folder is added to the fortifications.

2095f73d-335b-48b8-b530-d9cc47d24a6d.Text: The interrogation transcripts are strikingly redundant: they record everything from the direction of the questioned person's gaze to the length of the pauses between their answers.

f8bfc458-20bd-4628-becf-c1d39c9b4a74.Text: The worker was beaten with skill, and care was taken not to damage his joints. He is suffering, but he can still work for the dynasty.

d14cfdb5-4758-4d1f-8e1a-298259403dbd.Text: "To arms, faithful souls! Their tyranny ends today!"

8e213626-6774-457c-8095-b4555805c332.Text: "We are the voice of the oppressed! We are vengeance!"

e1d674c2-8973-477b-9b52-ac4f70444d08.Text: You notice a few drops of blood that have somehow managed to avoid being trodden on. The blood does not appear all that fresh, but it has not fully dried yet either.

b281b5ad-9287-4f33-bd1a-1bf7bcb2805c.Text: A scrap of human skin with jagged edges is stuck to the deck.

c8ef0389-0110-482c-ba70-a9d59d5cea54.Text: The vents are clogged with synthetic fabric, probably some kind of homemade insulation.

c336104b-118f-4f8a-a880-e53b750e43f4.Text: Someone has shoved a tattered and bloodied synth-coat into the vent. Such garments are included in every enforcer's uniform.

24656732-f058-488b-8408-844b7ef6186f.Text: "Lord Captain, the interrogation is underway. We will find that miscreant!"

ebb817d6-f470-43d0-93f6-de55bd73de06.Text: "Every enforcer has been issued a pack of stimulants. No one will dare sleep until the culprit has been found."

0b4e6cc5-e260-4d75-b580-76e79f2ca3f8.Text: Keeping his attention focused on the Master-at-Arms, the enforcer sharply reports the names and positions of newly arrived suspects.

85982e09-63ef-4469-8439-ae0589a333ec.Text: "Any pleas for mercy will be treated as resistance."

eedb7115-4c72-43f0-ad80-3002266f7691.Text: "If you didn't do it, then you're still abetting the one who did! Rebellion is all you serfs ever think about!"

c6a5b76e-1248-4202-9f4b-e605b81cb4d7.Text: "What'd you say? Your ribs hurt? I'm being gentle, you know. Confess before I really put my back into it!"

3d830d9b-412b-4179-baff-58e6409bf46c.Text: "You don't remember? That's too bad. Not to worry, another half-watch in solitary should refresh your memory."

2ccfa21d-488d-498a-aca7-c975c59ce0a8.Text: The annoyed enforcer grips the handle of his baton furiously every time the serf fails to answer his question, but he holds himself in check.

61da5f75-e911-4fe8-bfe5-3e86c5be845b.Text: "I would like to return the favour, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I assure you, my initiation has not robbed me of my enforcer's skills."

6cbf1c93-82c7-4f32-ac84-2a4d77fa1deb.Text: "Greetings, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Right, where was I? Interrogation report D-379, addendum A15, copy 3..."

3faa54a0-bb23-43d1-b7d9-7f0861bfdde9.Text: "This is the tenth autoquill I've used up today!"

f3df96cc-1b5f-4361-85ca-43bd9eecef0f.Text: "Everything will be added to the record — you never know which word might contain a crucial truth or lie."

5f32539f-b8e3-465b-ae61-f3d0496f0643.Text: The man's entire body is one enormous bruise. He looks like he is about to breathe his last.

278e6ac7-146c-48e5-ba38-36f0757a7d1d.Text: All you catch is a few faint moans. You cannot tell if they are pleas for mercy or for a swift death.

a0b1a559-5bc7-4a38-9768-dac9b3311307.Text: With a gap-toothed grin, the freed worker rubs his wrists and ankles, stiff from the shackles.

e6df37b0-7093-4503-8e3a-f7d457342a5c.Text: The worker tries unsuccessfully to get to his feet. The beating has stopped, but no one is in any hurry to help him.

a2a0b409-d8f9-4e93-bcd3-decf41e5573c.Text: "If I don't drink some hot recaf soon, I'll start swearing in binharic too."

42018a91-bb5b-4c2a-b8ee-6230951be9a2.Text: "My enforcers are at your disposal, Lord Captain."

07f67327-3066-4f1b-ab57-0acb5a41d183.Text: The cabinet is bursting with treatises, codes, and statutes on the practice of sailing a voidship.

2bf51645-aa25-4500-8184-87ed6cb401d8.Text: "Mercy! I'll say whatever you want, but please, stop hitting me!"

1b50d47d-4fbe-4383-a299-65affb7c3b52.Text: "Thank the God-Emperor for the Lord Captain! {mf|He|She} saved us! Another minute and they'd have broken my arm, and I'd have been unable to feed my family."

61cb39dc-ed96-4608-b171-28c84b0bb396.Text: "So they've stopped thrashing you, and what? They're holding back now, but later they'll come inspecting the compartments and there'll be no stopping them then..."

dd380ddb-6706-45c1-9ea7-46a97ee97341.Text: "The Lord Captain! {mf|He|She}'s here? But I heard {mf|he|she} was murdered in {mf|his|her} own bathchamber..."

93477674-cdea-4dfa-9027-729339db16dd.Text: "Can't say I like getting punched in the teeth, but hey, at least we get a break from work."

fc2eef5e-6322-4b7c-8612-cd5a0bcc11e0.Text: "Y-Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, we didn't do it. I swear on the Throne!"

34ed5c16-97e6-4a20-b7a4-8c5dc8bcebc0.Text: "The holy mechanism has sent forth a revelation. The transmitted coordinates resolve to a location on one of the worlds in the Pelium Solitas System."

997fb780-50e1-4ede-9721-784eb52f48ab.Text: "This unit experiences exultation in your presence, Lord Captain."

2ffe82bf-c1bd-4848-b293-8fded25c8e70.Text: "These investigation procedures must not impede our vigil over the sacred mechanisms."

91c4a2a3-2202-4a25-a7e7-c838494746c7.Text: "That poor fellow... He sure fooled me! I thought he was really a sorcerer."

79163e18-1b60-4964-901a-f5c307be87a1.Text: "If I'd been beaten like him, I would have said all this and more. The Emperor does protect me..."

c1c85c7b-7549-4989-9d8a-b2d302367893.Text: "It was such a nice ring, but where did it go? If I find it, I'll give it back to them, and then maybe they'll let me go for my good service... I'm sure they will..."

008b2628-eb03-4f61-9ab1-536b9f0cb348.Text: "The enforcer knocked him about so hard that a ring came off their noble hand..."

b082a4f6-c77b-495e-8d5a-0bc0a2f487e3.Text: "Cultist or not, he should still be executed for such heresy."

7d1c2199-08e8-446e-93a6-e4a49b7ecaf6.Text: "You can start by reporting on the results of the additional investigative efforts."

c426e8e3-5594-4475-ac4e-f3b422299a58.Text: "Who had access to the work log cogitator?"

66628a44-9ad9-4c9e-9ff7-ebf14ffa876c.Text: "Suspect Yart claims that you coerced him into lying about himself, Jinevri. What do you have to say for yourself?"

12886a6a-e7fd-4671-9327-5f98424f7db0.Text: "I have no more questions. Bring in the pipewarden."

01e3cbd0-1988-48c2-81c3-b4c2497fb333.Text: "A bloody synth-coat was discovered not far from the corpse. I would ask the enforcers in this room to present their coats."

8648d879-d758-41e3-a6e0-724de7600299.Text: "One of the inferni complained that an enforcer had taken away his pass to the room with the master cogitator. And it was a man."

22b5a14c-3661-4864-ba2d-e8dfbc037eb8.Text: "You are the real pipewarden Gwedon, are you not?"

948e8159-b5c0-4b05-9c9e-8445c58b8f7d.Text: "Why did you fill my bath with blood?"

9cc8121d-3aa0-4de0-83bd-cdef6706800a.Text: "Hrotko, were you really hoping you could deceive the Master-at-Arms and me?"

014fb735-2463-4e15-9585-b6d1fa0fe970.Text: "Whom do you mean by this 'servant of death'?"

5f09f11c-4b9c-47ed-8636-5737092ca68f.Text: "You are a liar and a blackguard, but I commend you for your intelligence. I have no need of such enforcers, but I could use another spy. You will sow confusion among my rivals for the good of the dynasty."

50f9c247-2629-4e4d-9ee4-cc7234a3f2b2.Text: "Captain Jinevri, all the evidence points to you. You are charged with sabotage and consequently sentenced to death."

13e29948-4260-4300-ae11-22be1ea75690.Text: "Summon the Vizsier of the Bloodspun Web. I wish to hear his explanation."

44c6894b-1420-46d4-b1d7-7c2a7b2a6152.Text: "The Vizsier has crossed the line! I want him dragged here by force!"

6271ee92-526b-4f01-9d72-5cad3b92ce6b.Text: "Hrotko, for your crimes of sabotage, slander, and heresy, I hereby condemn you to death. Master-at-Arms, carry out the sentence."

8a287182-5c29-4c2c-9320-33d9d96c3608.Text: Ordered Captain Hrotko to become an initiate and seek repentance.

32c462a8-0ea2-4c00-9317-b8eeec5d8aa6.Text: "I will give you a chance, Hrotko. You are to be demoted and to become an initiate at the shrine, where you will spend the rest of your days in penance and servitude."

0371a9d8-4428-40c0-b33b-08ad2c84bebf.Text: "Give him lashes. Hopefully he will think more carefully about whose orders to follow next time."

58c23de3-d217-4cb0-92a9-2982dfff25ee.Text: "You drenched the Rogue Trader in blood. Did you expect to simply walk away afterward? I think not. Hang the scum!"

d331e0ee-ea62-4e47-af26-df3ea46d95d0.Text: "Witnesses saw Yart being knocked around by an enforcer wearing a ring. Let me see your hands."

5c532ecc-4555-45ca-9ac1-11e9cdb19b0d.Text: "Why were you trying to frame Jinevri?"

6e5326f3-aa08-4b9f-b6e0-68bb74274a02.Text: "I cannot decide. Sauerback, you can handle this yourself."

eb40dfe4-dfed-418b-84ef-a49a473dedae.Text: "You do not seem to fear punishment."

0cd541cf-cf74-4054-bfd0-07b0cfa7aebf.Text: "Someone attempted to mislead our investigation. We cannot let this go without consequences."

28579a5f-1bf0-4aec-b4f7-46f6a7b75a44.Text: "What is the meaning of the Master-at-Arms's words about your clan, Einrich?"

9c63c419-99c3-491f-8eb9-ece5b3d9f53d.Text: "Hrotko, this is all your doing, is it not?"

779e3f53-2469-425b-ac61-b575e9f68445.Text: "You acted as a true servant of the Emperor would. I will have you provided with the best ocular implant for your work."

1bf43b51-8b8a-47ed-9b01-44fd172a72b1.Text: "You were deceived into becoming an accomplice. I will not punish you."

cc10e173-8049-4261-9dea-0a8faf37864d.Text: "Lord Captain, the real pipewarden Gwedon has been found and is being escorted here as we speak. Are there any remaining questions you wish to address before we hear from Gwedon himself?"

85ebc1cd-ea8a-4873-8eaf-e8d3ce304805.Text: {n}Jinevri nervously adjusts her armour under Sauerback's piercing gaze.{/n} "The corpse was already looking like that when it came under my purview. But I... I could not get the name of the officer who discovered it. The deck was such a mess that I decided I would deal with it later."

d9b7e122-4d6e-43ed-a3f3-68154150895d.Text: "Yes, ma'am, since the start of the watch. I went there right after I handed the body over to Klein. The only time I stepped away was to retrieve the {g|Encyclopedia:Dataslate}data-slate{/g} from my quarters. I left a watchman, but he went missing. Most likely, one of the officers did not realise he was on duty and sent him off on some errand... But I was only gone for a few minutes!"

fd0e7527-be39-4ba3-a413-4618fb663fb7.Text: "Very convenient. A missing sentry, a data-slate misplaced against regulations." {n}Hrotko drums his fingers on a holster on his belt, where his own data-slate sits tightly nestled.{/n}

93ddc55e-b2e2-4cf9-a811-5d00cc5078b2.Text: "We have thoroughly questioned all detainees known to have a violent temper and compared the tools and weapons we seized with the wounds found on the corpse, but have not been able to establish who was responsible for the mutilation. I take full responsibility for this failure."

09c9eba7-3ea9-4301-9e14-41def9201ec5.Text: "Your insightful suggestion helped the enforcers to locate the evidence. In fact, we found a bloody synth-coat in one of the vents — a standard issue included in every enforcer outfit on the ship."

dc97e913-8268-4418-b605-c47b6bdd355c.Text: {n}The pipewarden does his best to remain reverentially bowed, which paints a rather comical picture given his formidable height and complexion. He lowers his head, tugging at his beard.{/n} "Senior pipewarden Gwedon, honoured to serve, Lord Captain. I'm ready to confess to everything."

a57cb7f6-5f07-4a6d-b36b-87709db12b6b.Text: "The interrogation of the detainee Yart had to be suspended. He seems to have gone mad: he just keeps mumbling that it was Jinevri who set him up to lie, and that he must therefore be set free. I doubt we will get anything further out of him, be it with cruelty, kindness, or holy prayer."

e4bd2e7a-7273-4cc6-ba7e-1b070d6d6d70.Text: "I am, and I'm proud of it, Lord Captain. A pipewarden's craft is hard work, but necessary. My number is SP-268-55. My work partner was the late Orto, number SP-246-01. I oversee the water supply systems on the upper decks, sectors A-3, K-8, and R-2. That includes valve 27-B."

78bb5011-0ae6-4ea4-99d5-c301678cf7a1.Text: "There can be no mistake: I have verified his identity myself. It has also been confirmed by the other workers."

61232536-a4ca-4540-adf1-7e0ddf3d32b2.Text: {n}The rustle of synthetic fabric fills the room. All the enforcers show their coats... except Hrotko. He shrugs complacently under the gaze of his comrades.{/n} "I do not wear it. An enforcer must be able to withstand the cold, and the serfs treat synth-coats as a sign of weakness."

242530a9-2362-4e51-ba9c-a41990b20f77.Text: "Are you no longer wearing your family ring, Hrotko?" {n}Klein gives him a bloodthirsty scowl.{/n}

fd3f078a-fb03-4a7d-8bc0-ec303a4db718.Text: "Not on duty. And certainly not in compartments full of detained rabble." {n}Hrotko's voice is icily calm.{/n}

8578cca2-6134-4825-9373-2b8c51f92584.Text: "I didn't kill him, and I didn't know he was a mutant. Orto and I always got along, even if he wasn't much for talking. But then..." {n}He shudders.{/n} "A servant of death came from the darkness — ended him quickly but harshly. She bled him dry and put a black feather in his throat. She told me to pump blood into the pipes, and then she left. I wanted to confess, but... I was afraid she'd come for me too if I did."

27350140-50eb-4957-ba92-ba1e3c35c22e.Text: "A holy slayer in black and crimson and bone. Feared by all, they are, quiet and merciless as death itself. They come from the shadows to kill, because the Emperor commands them so."

ddad64d9-a03a-4d68-b3f8-9ba9eadc19ec.Text: "I did as the servant of death commanded. She said the Emperor gave the First Spinner a sign: that Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} should be bathed in the blood of poor Orto, my partner. And I, well..." {n}He gulps.{/n} "I was scared. So, I obeyed."

40759738-d979-4495-aef3-89925d9a7e31.Text: "The First Spinner? Are you talking about the Vizsier of the Bloodspun Web?"

f01258cc-db04-4af3-99cb-4c88129d9739.Text: "Y-yes, that's him. He leads the death cultists, the lot who worship the Emperor by killing. His spinners hunt down heretics, but sometimes they take righteous lives too. Their service is mysterious, fervent, and bloody."

a5f5a753-6322-4e99-8e84-9ead22ed2a65.Text: {n}Sauerback casts a menacing look over the room.{/n} "Leave it to me. I will not rest until I get a confession. A real confession. In the meantime, let us get back to the assassination attempt."

5e2a660c-826f-4ebc-bfd3-a92b2ee9cacf.Text: {n}Jinevri stands with dignity, neither arguing nor begging for mercy. She surrenders her weapon and allows herself to be led away. Klein watches her with a gloomy expression, and as she passes him, you notice her whisper something in his ear.{/n}

fd248fa2-a712-4445-81d9-3fd6dcff4d64.Text: "Lord Captain, reporting: we have identified the perpetrator who introduced the blood to your bathchamber. The culprit is senior pipewarden Gwedon. Gwedon drained the blood from the dead body of his partner, a worker by the name of Orto. The victim looked like a normal human; however, the autopsy has revealed horrific mutations in his internal organs. Gwedon is being escorted here as we speak."

bd394b3e-1aed-4dcc-bca7-310cb1aeebaa.Text: "The Tech-Priests did not let anyone near the cogitator. They even tried to prevent the enforcers' investigation. Jinevri, were you there the entire time?"

a206ac88-c90a-438c-9c73-385f7e9a5d7a.Text: {n}Sauerback draws her autopistol and points it at Hrotko, who appears entirely unperturbed.{/n} "I will give you one chance to retain your last shred of honour and confess. You sabotaged the investigation. Why?"

c3d14a0c-b771-49f0-a559-3331359f5d93.Text: "You have already met the servants of the Bloodspun Web, Lord Captain. Their grim procession is not one the upper decks will soon forget."

c3415723-cabc-4601-8240-7977ab5f508c.Text: "Is it not obvious?" {n}Hrotko smugly arches an eyebrow.{/n} "To expose the conspiracy myself and to prove your incompetence to {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship}. To take the place I actually deserve. For years, I toiled for the good of the dynasty, but when the former Master-at-Arms was killed, I was refused my promotion. Instead, they give the position to you, a self-serving Sauerback nit. I guess a noble name means more than talent."

5671ec9e-b8fd-4b8f-a000-f8640b79d0d8.Text: "When this crime occurred, I realised it was my chance to show what I was worth. While you were busy dallying, I quickly learned the name of the suspect, diverted the course of the investigation — an easy enough task — and began looking for the real Gwedon. Had I found him in time, your position would have already been mine, Jocasta."

e67746e0-29c8-483e-b93f-f2b045bcba7f.Text: "Simply listen to yourself, and you will understand why they made me Master-at-Arms. Lord Captain, I request permission to dispose of this refuse personally."

542d6876-babb-4c31-a2b0-f68d729db626.Text: {n}Hrotko tries to speak, but his words are cut off by a devastating blow to the jaw. He collapses to the ground, but Sauerback raises the maul again and delivers another blow, this time straight to his ribs. She stretches out the pleasure, slowly crushing his bones and savouring every scream. When she is done, she finally allows the bloody mess that was once Hrotko to die where it lies.{/n}

c9f781b1-2cb1-43f5-84ed-a0f749e480a3.Text: {n}For the first time, you see the look of surprise on Hrotko's face.{/n} "You... are pardoning me? I must confess, I expected a severe punishment. Thank you. I will remember this act of leniency." {n}He bows.{/n}

8aea5c69-6936-4ea7-af44-0ee3930457af.Text: "Penance? He is a traitor! Just allow me to... Throne damn it, I dare not protest your decision."

9608b87a-f1b3-464f-b5f8-6fccfdba0c78.Text: "That takes care of the traitor. Now, let us proceed with interrogating the pipewarden."

8eb5390b-99b6-4315-89f6-0f1987ea76bc.Text: "We found witnesses to the battery of our false conspirator. According to them, an enforcer in a helmet came to the detained Yart, spoke to him, and then gave him a beating so thorough that a ring came off their finger. Alas, said ring could not be recovered."

ce0b2cea-47ad-4ba3-96a5-fd0d42ffbae0.Text: "I may have conducted his preliminary interrogation, like so many others. Hrotko requested my assistance because of my experience in dealing with the rabble. But I swear that there is no truth to these accusations against me!"

2a07d2e9-cc42-4099-aabb-57ced6a6118a.Text: "The transcript says you conducted Yart's interrogation alone. Why is that?"

5e19bc79-56ea-4fed-914e-e4da9460ac32.Text: "Because I can handle a single laundryman." {n}Jinevri raises her chin proudly.{/n}

ed017286-7c78-4cad-81fb-9afdcdd0c35d.Text: {n}The enforcers take off their gloves. Not one of them is wearing a ring. However, you do find a small mark on Hrotko's little finger, as if he had been wearing some sort of band on it for a long time.{/n}

4b9a03ff-cc5a-496a-9fdc-8c017266fd58.Text: "A backup plan. You always need someone to blame if you make a mistake." {n}Hrotko's voice sounds calm, even casual.{/n} "I could have framed Klein, but... that young upstart was already galloping through the ranks too fast and was clearly aiming for my station. Besides, she and her thick-witted subordinates were always right where I wanted them to be."

036e6d99-f898-44a0-80bd-bb56271dbd28.Text: {n}Your dismissive tone makes Hrotko flinch with indignation.{/n} "I had every chance, but you were shrewder than I expected. My little trick with the body did work: you still don't know who was behind it all, but I have already figured it out. I hid Gwedon from you by damaging the cogitator and delivering you a fake, an idiot willing to incriminate himself out of fear. I even prepared a contingency plan in case he cracks by making sure he would blame someone else. Yes, there were a couple of slip-ups, but... you must admit, it was a solid attempt overall."

0bb7df7a-ef3a-40d2-942f-3a4e384694df.Text: "The body of the deceased was mutilated after death. It is likely that the nature of the injuries would have proven very useful in the investigation, and that the perpetrator concealed them for that very reason."

8763bb7c-8534-477e-a36e-2b1ae826a1ea.Text: {n}Hrotko's lips stretch into a thin smile.{/n} "Thank you for your high praise. I am grateful to have had this opportunity to prove my usefulness to you, albeit under... unusual circumstances." {n}Hrotko remains unfailingly polite and completely ignores the seething Sauerback.{/n}

60e19631-f717-4dbf-a2e8-fd70f663cc45.Text: "Instead of the murdered man's partner, we were given a fool — one who thoroughly incriminated himself first, before admitting that Captain Jinevri had put him up to it." {n}Sauerback glowers at Jinevri, and she pales with fear.{/n}

898fb675-2c07-4599-a5fe-3f42e1d3ddc2.Text: "Someone sabotaged the work log cogitator so it would be harder for us to find the victim's partner, who might have information valuable to the investigation."

0dafb7eb-e85a-4595-a9fd-9beca1216670.Text: "I don't understand how I could have forgotten it... I always check my gear when I go on duty!"

e73bb4ea-8c6f-4eff-a19b-1e7ce49070ba.Text: "Then it wasn't her, just one of her accomplices. Will you give us a name, Jinevri?"

a3e6a856-a7e5-4ae9-a1e3-1eb52bec3d19.Text: "Shut your mouth, Hrotko! Nothing has been proven yet!" {n}Klein goes red in the face and brushes Jinevri aside with his shoulder.{/n}

54fe3bd5-f2d2-4f2a-a212-39b0cc89d440.Text: "It was Jinevri." {n}Klein reluctantly nods at his fellow enforcer.{/n} "I relieved her when I came to inspect the corpse, which by then had already been cut up."

cb6a7cb1-b812-4536-9e67-9e0e11a2904c.Text: "With all due respect to {mf|Your Lordship|Your Ladyship}, I am an enforcer. I have looked death in the eye, and I will accept your judgement with dignity." {n}There is no bravado in Hrotko's words, just a dry statement of fact.{/n}

b15362c7-2762-4188-8b9b-4b2c8f7c852d.Text: {n}With an acerbic smile, Einrich blows a stream of smoke in Sauerback's direction.{/n} "What a shocking turn of events, Jocasta. The inferni are innocent! Who could have seen that coming? Could it be that you were wrong to brutalise and humiliate my people?"

b44c4f60-5f88-42f9-99bb-996fa7368898.Text: "Do not expect an apology from me. I was doing my duty. You can play the victim all you want, but I haven't forgotten the circumstances under which your blasted clan came to be on this ship. Consider every strike upon your backs a reminder of that event."

7806bacd-0609-4684-bd40-1bf717cbdc2f.Text: "It's a story of days long past, one that Mistress Sauerback greatly enjoys reminiscing about as if she was there herself. My ancestors committed a trespass against your ancestor and were made inferni as punishment. I'll be sure to tell you this tale some other time."

f2dbc793-9ea0-4630-b54f-f60569ea212d.Text: "I must concede as much, Lord Captain. The story can wait. We should first find out why the Bloodspun Web thought to bathe you in repugnant blood."

24e9e1f0-4e5d-4ca1-8f6f-a04b76b047ea.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, if I may ask... What happens to me now? I never meant to anger you. I thought I was doing as the Emperor willed it, but here we are. I'm a simple man. I know pipes, and I know them a lot better than all this people business! My eyes aren't what they used to be, but I can still smell rust in metal, though not so much in people's thoughts."

faf8e76c-61f4-4a34-90e5-dd94149b249b.Text: "Thank you from the bottom of my heart, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! I'll serve you faithfully, and I'll never forget your mercy!"

1f04e9c3-bfb2-4ff9-99f0-c23f7c627dd2.Text: "It will be done, Lord Captain! I will also order to have his fellow pipewardens thoroughly examined for rust in their brains."

64b70854-f9ad-4560-99da-266a362099e5.Text: {n}Gwedon hangs his head.{/n} "My mum always said I'd die an idiot..."

3ce2e95a-395d-48a6-973b-992f5d9cf67e.Text: "Behind the armour of affected indifference, his thoughts ooze grimy hues. Like blood mixed with umber. It looks vile."

0a07a79c-8653-4c60-885e-70d0b6574e2f.Text: "If the Vizsier ordered it, there must have been a reason. The Undying One must have revealed something to him that we are ignorant of."

30c460d1-02cc-4482-9b98-2d972aeabb11.Text: "Undoubtedly. Let us go over the facts we have on this sabotage and compile them."

a084a060-198c-43e4-a137-c628ac3f0455.Text: By taking the path of repentance, Hrotko can save himself in the eyes of the Emperor and benefit the dynasty.

1a3566bb-6901-4f3e-9694-772b363532ff.Text: Hrotko's penchant for plotting may work in the dynasty's favour outside the ship and bear fruit.

ad622155-2d59-4e77-9584-065fc23b7741.Text: Under the Lord Captain's command, the crew's chances of capturing Nemesite have improved considerably.

2e79c97e-32bb-41b7-88c7-d8110b540258.Text: The gruesome execution of Captain Hrotko has increased the diligence of both the enforcers and those they have been entrusted to supervise. The crews of the engines and shields modules now work their hardest for fear of punishment.

a03f786b-e5a0-4d89-ae8d-30efad61838a.Text: "One of the inferni said he had his pass to the maintenance room taken away by an enforcer."

65b86757-addb-45af-84d4-72cff990fc97.Text: "What is the problem with the machine spirit?"

2cb83c53-9ba2-4ff8-a73e-96ed29670784.Text: "What exactly does this data-recuperative dogma prescribe?"

07ec71f0-8648-47e2-b1f1-76d90e7575c1.Text: "Pasqal, how profane would you say your hands are?"

a3ca320f-ae4b-428a-993d-be86a5e17d45.Text: "Laypeople may be prohibited from communing with the machine spirit, but you are not, esteemed Tech-Priest. Jinevri will merely stand at your side and observe."

fa9f1b9b-6f4c-47d5-b9b6-bb126c597d9b.Text: "Well, then the solution is quite simple. We cut off the esteemed Tech-Priest's hand and use it to commune with the machine spirit."

241fee84-579e-4cd0-a002-5ffa6a066d0f.Text: "Did the murderer get to the cogitator too?"

6d76e5e1-02b3-4a80-8086-ad8672545d3c.Text: "Master-at-Arms, how do you propose we find our new suspect?"

1f3992e9-8d34-47ec-a447-19e1034658cb.Text: {n}Jinevri approaches you, followed by a dignified woman in crimson robes.{/n} "Allow me to introduce the esteemed Tech-Priest Androveta-Phi. She believes she has the right to obstruct the investigation, and refused to grant the enforcers access to the master cogitator."

f5aff81c-9eed-41a6-b6c3-6849e5041943.Text: "The spirit is old and quick to anger. It therefore calls for a sensitive approach, not a torturous intrusion by a brutish laywoman! Since the start of this watch, the spirit has been unwell, so we have been trying to soothe its woes by applying sacred unguents and censing the great machine's boards. The dogma of data-recuperative quarantine prohibits any disturbances to blessed machines found to be in such a state."

9bc1f180-2b9f-4a0e-8243-14673381ea28.Text: {n}Judging by Jinevri's expression, she would rather have her profane hands touch Androveta-Phi's neck.{/n}

44227980-4c83-4cdd-be2f-e232bdc63172.Text: "'Let no profane hand touch the sacred machine stricken. Let the mechanism be shielded from all worldly troubles by a veil of righteous litany, and let its shrine be thricely honoured 'til the malady is no more.'"

1930dd45-7df5-4d0d-9ebb-25f5a672468b.Text: "I am a Magos Explorator and this vessel's {g|Encyclopedia:Enginseer}Enginseer{/g} Prime. The profanity of this unit's hands, as well as the rest of its limbs, organs, and augmetics, is null."

2721ef97-dd78-48d2-920b-787836d2eb46.Text: {n}Androveta-Phi shoots Jinevri a sidelong glance.{/n} "Very well. I shall disturb the spirit, but I demand that the laywoman show respect and do as she is told!"

ee0898a0-14d1-4e74-8fb3-a67f4fcc4932.Text: {n}Androveta-Phi shoots Jinevri a sidelong glance.{/n} "I know her 'standing and observing' all too well. I may disturb the spirit at your behest, but mark my words: this won't end well!"

b9004381-584f-43d2-9128-adddbef591c2.Text: {n}The Tech-Priest withers and mewls pitifully,{/n} "Understood, Lord Captain. I offer my apologies along with my assurances of cooperation."

c747d2b5-34b9-4465-a1da-6e9d50f5a093.Text: {n}The Tech-Priest recoils.{/n} "This is madness! Tech-barbarism! If you would resort to brute force in your irreverent intentions, then I cannot stop you. Instead, I will disturb the machine spirit myself. However, I must register this as a Category Six blasphemy!"

55324e00-8d2b-40e5-ad73-6c507b4288cc.Text: "If the honoured Magos supervises the laywoman's tactful interaction with the spirit, I will sanction this disturbance."

399cdb9c-c848-460f-bb69-4dee24fbb2ad.Text: {n}Raising her hands high, Androveta-Phi wails,{/n} "{g|Encyclopedia:OmnissiahGlossary}Omnissiah{/g} preserve us! The great spirit was infected by a layperson! That is the culprit you should be searching for, not some pipewarden! Sacrilege!"

11def6bb-3448-4069-bd12-326f8cc347dd.Text: {n}Fuming, Androveta-Phi hisses something in {g|Encyclopedia:LinguaTechnis}Techna-Lingua{/g}, pointing a crooked finger at Jinevri.{/n} "I told you! I warned you that it would end this way! The laywoman forced me to mistreat the machine spirit until it left us, taking all the logs of the crew's toils with it! Sacrilege!"

857f7c49-d3db-491d-8030-8710b9625795.Text: "We have discovered that the cogitator's malfunctions began after an unauthorised attempt to access it was made. Someone deliberately angered the machine spirit in order to bury the work logs. Thankfully, the esteemed Tech-Priest was able to appease the spirit and extract the information we needed."

4fb833b3-f028-43a0-a62c-b4f742b1e743.Text: "Fortunately, we were able to get the results before it did. The cantankerous spirit had no choice but to share some of its knowledge with us."

8f0506a4-7cd7-4705-9f4e-c2385aa7e46a.Text: "Impossible. Since the start of the watch, this area has been used as the centre of operations. No rabble could have slipped by unnoticed. Moreover, a common pipewarden wouldn't know how to commune with a machine spirit. The murderer had help."

2da499d2-34cb-4bc7-b0f9-19f4b3736299.Text: "Senior pipewarden Gwedon, number SP-268-55. An eighth-generation pipewarden — no registered infractions, excellent discipline, perfect work record. An exemplary servant of the Imperium."

0d98f328-3fc1-4b37-ab89-caeb386c6ec0.Text: {n}Before Sauerback can respond, Hrotko cuts in:{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, there was a man named Gwedon among the rabble waiting to be interrogated. He immediately struck me as suspicious. Please allow me to question the man in your presence!"

6990eeb4-d024-4af1-be4c-f53e66a83cd8.Text: {n}Sauerback narrows her eyes, but all she says is:{/n} "Bring him in. Now."

2e854216-0588-4690-bf94-fe7649e79752.Text: {n}The Tech-Priest lets out an indignant binharic trill.{/n} "I request that the laywoman's wilful activities be halted. She intends to torment the {g|Encyclopedia:MachineSpirit}machine spirit{/g} of the master work log cogitator Iota-IIIB! The venerable spirit is ill and in no disposition to endure such abuse."

89bdcc10-1994-40a7-a695-08f62a1de8bb.Text: "The victim's name was Orto. On the day he died, he was servicing valve 27-B, which supplies water to the Rogue Trader's bathchamber. He also had a partner, who has yet to appear for duty since the incident occurred. We have a suspect."

2a4f5b8c-ab94-48b9-b5ef-a130b577fb0d.Text: "Our villain? But how did they get past Jinevri's guards unnoticed?" {n}Sauerback stares intently at Jinevri as she grows pale.{/n}

70ee2c8d-a467-49ed-a4e8-15d79198915b.Text: "When I'm old and cantankerous, I'll demand aromatic unguents and a hookah to fumigate my sacred lungs too. Then again... why wait?"

c30ccb9a-056e-4acd-a2de-7dd04c9623ce.Text: {n}Jae snorts derisively.{/n} "Shocking arrogance! If I count up how many pieces of xenotech and archeotech this grasping hand has managed to 'confiscate,' I wonder if its profanity will increase or decrease?"

5a48388e-0b4e-4985-a652-cd40044034d5.Text: "Registering a Category Three act of sacrilege resulting in a Category Epsilon Quadro transgressive scenario. Requesting the inclusion of the offender in the registry of wanted entities for the purpose of expiative disposal."

1bdff1a5-2ac9-4a91-a3ca-9054175a604f.Text: "Because I am the Lord Captain, and this is my ship, my cogitator, and my business!"

d7cd5f98-4c11-4917-8372-2cc71c091215.Text: [Point your weapon at the cogitator] "I will count to three."

e411064a-09f9-49a7-8d37-4e8fbba6bd5e.Text: "Androveta-Phi, you will persuade the machine spirit to cooperate. If you do not, I shall do the persuading myself."

40d42fa8-485b-48b8-8f8d-d4f6e920517b.Text: "We need to investigate this cogitator in order to obtain information about a certain pipewarden."

743bda67-f3c7-4101-8739-ebc1f8d534a4.Text: [Courteously introduce yourself by inputting your data to show respect for the machine spirit]

46192922-3f1e-4b54-895a-7ebeecb01a71.Text: [Proudly present your Lord Captain's privileges and access levels to the machine]

5179576c-43f4-458e-8e82-6a0fa3bde1c7.Text: [Unceremoniously demand access to the catalogue containing the necessary data]

6576b8ca-4e0c-475f-9270-7f7a37297be8.Text: [Enquire about the cause of the old cogitator's ailment]

966e5ec6-167e-4821-9673-9fbb03a27875.Text: "Jinevri, why do you seek access to the malfunctioning cogitator?"

68323ac6-61e2-46c1-ba2f-e0a32fe66f5e.Text: "I have faith that the two of you can come to an agreement."

e9938d28-400a-4d4c-804e-0a5161bbaade.Text: "You will have to find another way. Do I make myself clear?"

c03c812b-1e7c-4fdf-bda8-2b7d6770cc0b.Text: "There is a secret lift nearby leading to my chambers. I saw Lady Theodora use it. Could the culprit also have known of its existence?"

7f079b9f-8388-4c66-9e35-a1115af57e6e.Text: [Sternly request the logs detailing the toils of the ship's workers]

36d6b38d-5a1f-4dc9-8f10-14ad9b72acd4.Text: "You have my word that I will treat the machine spirit with due respect. You may observe the interrogation."

4073fb62-0b5d-48a4-a73d-19b7185892be.Text: [Treat the cogitator's boards with thermal unction, let it slumber for a while, then awaken it once more]

e9bfd365-8ffc-4aa5-9212-d481c45cbd75.Text: [Humbly ask for the data on the toils of the ship's workers]

b9e11be6-a5ac-4606-b2ef-1c12c152fd16.Text: [Grab the cogitator's braid of cables and give it a good pull]

0bc17be3-8128-4cce-853e-bc4b5d696709.Text: "You are obstructing the investigation, esteemed Tech-Priest! I require the information stored by this {g|Encyclopedia:MachineSpirit}machine spirit{/g}. If you refuse to cooperate..."

87f2bbeb-7bd6-41bb-99a8-e3f3b084daac.Text: "Petition rejected. A malady has befallen the machine spirit of the honoured master cogitator Iota-IIIB. Unauthorised anguish will worsen its condition and impede treatment. I will not stand for such acts of brutality against the great elder!"

e3635270-820e-45df-80e3-b24ad4ae16dd.Text: "I'll show you brutality, you blasted cog..."

d5c489e1-06a4-496e-8833-8c5d2357dfd4.Text: {n}Androveta-Phi's mechadendrites creak as they bow before you.{/n} "Exalted ruler of the vessel, I mean not to harm, but to protect — I merely care for the machine spirit's health. It has fallen ill of late, and now its temper is worse than ever. If the laywoman starts torturing it now, the venerable spirit may take offence and leave us forever, taking the logs of the laypeople's toils with it. This must be prevented!"

618cc965-a91c-4d2f-92bb-b9fba7d9dadf.Text: {n}The Tech-Priest's {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g} hisses defiantly,{/n} "You would not commit a Category Four blasphemy! The Omnissiah protects!"

c4359541-2eec-4b13-a40e-9bfececaddd5.Text: "Ruler of the vessel, why do you insist on interrogating an elderly soul when it is in such a miserable state? You are making a mockery of the Omnissiah's tenets and the privileges of the Priesthood of {g|Encyclopedia:MarsGlossary}Mars{/g}!"

0a797c60-71ce-40ef-b3a6-ef54e82260ed.Text: {n}After mulling over your question for a while, the spirit recalls that the number is assigned to a senior pipewarden by the name of Orto. This Orto and his partner spent the last watch servicing valve 27-B, which supplies water to the Rogue Trader's chambers. After finishing up the maintenance, only Orto's partner reported in.{/n}

be827aea-b83c-4d47-8d9d-6e543d9f70b1.Text: {n}After a heated exchange of tech-commands, the Tech-Priest manages to appease the spirit with cryptoprotocols of praise and to convince the elderly machine that the sacred blocker has erred. Clearly irritated, the cogitator noisily chews the air with its cooling fans, but is nonetheless ready to hear your requests.{/n}

a94a5e39-7d48-4370-a2d0-391797409e90.Text: {n}The Tech-Priest glances anxiously back and forth between your weapon and the cogitator.{/n}

2fb12aa2-b727-44b2-8d5c-d40df8f7b660.Text: {n}The elderly machine wheezes hysterically, showering you with sparks. Androveta-Phi clutches her chest. Eventually, with a plaintive flicker of its lumens, the cogitator wipes the data-blocker from the vid-screen.{/n}

0173a9d8-4697-46a5-85cb-0301d631d84b.Text: {n}Androveta-Phi moves to shield the machine with her body, but freezes when she sees Jinevri grasp the handle of her pistol.{/n}

e435ff1b-c2db-4c4a-8440-f1804cbf9035.Text: "Stop! Access privileges granted. But I'm begging you to be gentle with the elderly spirit!"

aee74617-876a-49e5-bf8d-8947bcaf2c79.Text: {n}At your approach, the {g|Encyclopedia:Lumen}lumens{/g} on the master cogitator's bulky hull light up peevishly, and the cooling filters breathe an exasperated sigh. The machine spirit appears to be in a rotten mood.{/n}

8123864f-f9ba-4b35-9295-1e32bc24e849.Text: {n}Jinevri gives you a look of respect. With an audible stress on every word, she says,{/n} "Mistress Androveta-Phi, step away from the machine. That is an order."

d454c4e1-b53c-40e9-8f20-bfbc2707eeb0.Text: {n}With a forlorn binharic trill, Androveta-Phi withdraws from the cogitator.{/n}

eacd5f21-7189-4ec0-a6db-e1be0cd3b5d4.Text: {n}Androveta-Phi lets out a screeching sigh.{/n} "Access privileges granted. I reserve the prerogative to interrupt the interrogation the moment I detect the slightest threat to the machine spirit."

348aec2c-ac83-4b39-a084-dd77c7184008.Text: "The honoured machine spirit is tired! It cannot bear any more of this torture! I see that you got what you came for, so I would ask that you let the elderly have their rest!"

3d35ec45-11fb-4891-8499-a499654e822c.Text: {n}You manage to find the right string of tech-commands. With a grunt, the cogitator starts whining on about its woes. Just as today's watch began, someone disturbed its datadream, used some trickery to rob it of its data, then befuddled its elderly mind and instructed it to deny access to anyone else.{/n}

78c3c2f4-7d7d-424d-83fb-b13bf56fcb59.Text: {n}Beside itself with anger, the cogitator sprays you with sparks. As its vid-screen dims and flickers, you hear a spiteful whirr and find yourself staring at an incomprehensible mess of symbols. Apparently, the spirit refuses to comply on account of some "Blocker A403."{/n}

f2569a22-9f75-46e5-8a22-6e8285b3e8a6.Text: "As {g|Encyclopedia:Enginseer}Enginseer{/g} Prime of this vessel, I hereby lift the ban on interaction with the machine spirit that has been afflicted by a tech-ailment of unknown category. I grant this {mf|layman|laywoman} right of access to the master cogitator Iota-IIIB under my careful supervision for the purposes of procuring knowledge and establishing truth."

cf8026d8-8725-4d6a-9579-3c45db173942.Text: {n}Androveta-Phi's vox squeals piteously as she bows.{/n} "The identity of the Enginseer Prime is confirmed. Privileges granted. I petition for the well-being of the machine spirit to be given utmost priority."

086afc00-9f9e-4073-9c59-94aecfe7845b.Text: {n}The enforcer and the Tech-Priest halt their bickering while in your presence. Clearly, this armistice will not last.{/n}

c83a5fec-2796-4f03-80bd-9c508a9afa98.Text: "Our villain?" {n}Jinevri frowns.{/n} "But how did they get past the guard post? My men swear that no one approached the cogitator."

edfb01f0-e82b-4780-a177-118ea93e3588.Text: {n}At first, the cogitator feigns ignorance out of spite, pretending not to recognise your request, but, after four more attempts, the spirit takes pity on you. Orto's partner was senior pipewarden Gwedon, number SP-268-55. Gwedon has not reported for duty since the incident.{/n}

b76e2b60-b090-4545-94f1-04db7342c9ee.Text: "That's the same valve that was used to pump the blood into the bathchamber. That must be where they killed Orto before dragging his corpse onto the deck."

09b63c9a-6d6c-48c7-aa21-891404feb48e.Text: "We have our suspect. It looks like Gwedon killed his fellow worker and put on this entire bloody spectacle. Hrotko is the one responsible for arresting the rabble, so he'll be our best candidate for shedding some light on this Gwedon character."

8e81b5a5-9612-49f9-b435-acb8de026454.Text: "The work logs are on it. They might contain important information that will lead us to our suspect."

2ad2747a-1bf4-4c33-88e5-a423b62484a0.Text: {n}Androveta-Phi's vox explodes in a furious binharic roar:{/n} "This laywoman does not even know what she intended to enquire of the blessed elder! Blasphemous disrespect!"

f436d702-0e58-4f26-96ba-e3bc4ee997eb.Text: {n}The menacing crack of Jinevri's knuckles and the venomous hiss of Androveta-Phi's vox suggest that such faith is misplaced.{/n}

b29be784-6785-47f9-bdfe-77cc88474174.Text: {n}Surprised, Jinevri breaks off from glaring at the Tech-Priest.{/n} "But, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, the tracts on interrogation and truth extraction clearly state that torture and intimidation are the most important elements of the process!"

ab6f15c9-82b3-47fc-a87e-04876fb1dc08.Text: "Yes, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I will inform Mistress Sauerback now and issue the necessary orders."

6e339f17-0a72-44ac-814d-cc9ba1c54749.Text: {n}Jinevri thinks for a moment, but soon shakes her head.{/n} "We will look into it, but I think it unlikely that the culprit could have had access to it. The lift's machine spirits probably obey only the Lord Captain and the most trusted members of their retinue, and no one else."

65015815-f2fe-4ff2-b6b5-92dfa34a3ada.Text: "This statement is true. The incident catalogue on this vessel contains no less than twelve instances of grievous loss of data due to disrespect shown to the machine spirit by unauthorised units."

be92d027-0285-4eb1-afd7-74aa1069d718.Text: {n}Pasqal's mechadendrites freeze and the optical augment focuses on you, trying to verify the authenticity of your threat.{/n}

e2598d82-7d78-4f5d-98cc-f54c8fb5f9df.Text: {n}A brief binharic hymn praising the Omnissiah erupts from Pasqal's vox like a sigh of relief.{/n}

58685667-2952-480b-b4c0-32672ab6ccfc.Text: "We should find out if the shift change took place without incident. If the culprit truly is an enforcer or is pretending to be one, he could have orchestrated a gap between the guard shifts."

9349194b-3a7f-4f4a-bd6b-805bac446461.Text: {n}The elderly spirit bombards you with abusive {g|Encyclopedia:LinguaTechnis}Techna-Lingua{/g}, refusing to interact with a nonentity. An identification request flashes furiously on the vid-screen.{/n}

a23bfeb5-0486-467a-afa5-3a4b7fadc0d4.Text: "Lady Theodora paid great attention to security measures. Only her inner circle knew about the lift, and the security systems would have made short work of anyone who tried to gain unauthorised access."

2ea5ba96-9e3d-4de5-bfc1-59984bff6677.Text: "It's too bad that wasn't enough to save her when it mattered most..."

0891dece-750b-4909-8740-5ad2d04f1a64.Text: "Observing a critical distortion of the sacred code. Initiating the sacrament of hibernation and anointing of the holy machine's data-cards."

fe294d7b-7ae7-41b5-86f7-af0dfcf11b5e.Text: "O Deus Mechanicus, bestow an impulse of miraculous transformation upon the Noospheric spirit of this machine — and may it rise again from its sacred datadream!"

e3e5018a-3831-42fa-9f38-ceb629ef46a2.Text: "In the name of upholding the blessed axiomatics, I am initiating the accompanying tech-service." {n}Pasqal's mechadendrites writhe like snakes in a sacred dance. One of them reverentially docks with the cogitator's dataport.{/n} "O calculating machine spirit, blessed in omniscience, luminous in the darkness of ignorance! May the regalia be revealed, may the prayers of access be said, may these restrictive circuits be removed." {n}The cogitator lets out a serene sigh of dust from its ventilation grate.{/n}

45424b39-26ac-4546-ac46-0ed8faa58999.Text: "Activating the deep hibernation protocol." {n}Pasqal's mechadendrite disconnects from the master cogitator's dataport in a respectful motion. The trill of binharic prayers lulls the elderly spirit's fading lumens.{/n} "May the Omnissiah bless this machine with healing slumber, that the sacred unity of its anode and cathode may be purified and shine once more."

5cd4e449-76f1-443f-a7aa-732ab09ae4e0.Text: {n}A long binharic vox-prayer makes the master cogitator drowsy. At last, the elder's vid-screen fades to blissful black, and, after releasing the casing from its screws, the mechadendrites expose its interior of vein-like wires. After anointing the machine with unguents while reciting binharic datapsalms, the casing panel is put back in place.{/n}

c2ec8f02-1c21-4e5f-85f9-ba86e1bc95e3.Text: {n}After an unnecessarily long verification process, the cogitator recognises the possibility that you may indeed be the ship's Lord Captain. A string of {g|Encyclopedia:LinguaTechnis}Techna-Lingua{/g} on the vid-screen tells you that you may now input your request.{/n}

b7a2b874-02f3-46b4-9a25-0fe2ffff0616.Text: {n}Pasqal's synthesised voice is as harsh as the screech of metal on ceramite.{/n} "Predicting sensory mutilation of the machine spirit! Prescribing hourly prayers of good functioning upon the conclusion of this procedure!"

6d839b40-7f59-4a4f-a0da-b7be5e571e30.Text: "The greatly esteemed Tech-Priest Androveta-Phi does not seem to realise the importance of investigative action and refuses to grant anyone access to the {g|Encyclopedia:Cogitator}master cogitator{/g}."

27f01f05-7198-4309-8ac2-7560b9c7c6af.Text: {n}Jinevri and Androveta-Phi offer you a mannerly bow before immediately resuming their tempestuous argument.{/n}

f280e158-2ab3-4110-b0b8-ade3d2e97a80.Text: {n}Your question upsets the spirit terribly — the honoured cogitator is so incensed and erratic in its expression that you cannot comprehend what it is trying to say. Your tech-commands only exacerbate its anger.{/n}

a0bbdb5f-91ba-4e43-baf2-8e991970716d.Text: "Oh, the spirit is truly unwell! Why else would Blocker A403 prevent it from sharing such data, especially after a log-ritual of greeting?"

c46e05c0-bca8-4ce0-8058-a52ded7b4c42.Text: {n}The unction, as well as the short breather, have done wonders for the old spirit's disposition. Mollified, it wipes the data-blocker from the vid-screen and agrees to indulge your enquiries.{/n}

4136c656-cfc2-4952-b852-95fdea8366e6.Text: "Decrepit worm! You will pay for your mutinous plot with your life!"

f32be237-88cb-4f68-aae8-3e1324abc262.Text: "I will not have murders and bloody rituals committed on my ship. Henceforth, the cult is banned from engaging in such spectacles!"

4aaacfa2-9876-4611-b527-6427f19a07ee.Text: "How can the Choirmaster of the Astropaths be of use to us?"

fbac98a1-ddc8-48bb-a27d-d5c54f21acb5.Text: "The Cult of the Bloodspun Web will face no persecution for their deed."

7cafce35-ef0e-473f-9f68-97f23ccfc8d8.Text: "What do you mean by 'the roiling unclean'?"

a3746f03-ec18-4006-9cf1-382855b1d649.Text: "I offer you my apologies for having you brought here at gunpoint, Vizsier."

22d8edc5-e666-47bd-a609-c8f9aaa01662.Text: "We may be overestimating the scale of the problem."

c304b2d9-be28-48f5-abee-4f4dfd8ecd84.Text: "I forbade you and your cult from killing my subjects. Your trespass will be punished."

36b6ca5f-575a-42df-87b5-1fe28c0d8ebd.Text: "That is all. Master-at-Arms, your duty is done. I give you leave to wrap up the investigation on the officers' deck."

b41f802c-6c96-4a7d-a0eb-c51abc7f293b.Text: "I already have a psyker in my retinue. Idira can perform the ritual."

930f6ef5-fbfb-479f-92e9-cf593240986f.Text: "The man you killed — who was he?"

2a47ae0b-bf45-4362-aeb0-bd5ee793cbdd.Text: "Could it be a coincidence that the victim of the ritual was a genetic aberration?"

80825570-d1bd-4d64-8efc-cd0a2a428809.Text: "Let the Bloodspun Web find the mutants breeding on my ship."

23da59a1-490d-4ee9-9dce-3191b95c55e1.Text: "Has Weisz done something like that before?"

55555c6c-7aef-43c3-add9-a68a459ede2e.Text: "Correct me if I am wrong, but it seems that not everyone here is eager to leave this matter to Master Weisz."

ef49dc70-da4e-428a-ad01-3b776c0b5fe2.Text: "Why so cryptic, Heinrix? If you have any theories about what is occurring here, share them."

25891baf-bdf7-4874-9960-9fb9b7fb6794.Text: "Master-at-Arms, are you convinced that we have found the culprits?"

cb1a3618-53d2-408b-a847-7f89bb005e82.Text: "Perhaps you are right, Vizsier. The spinners may carry on with their bloody service."

d57dedf2-38b8-44f9-a724-e80ecd6c0d7e.Text: [Nod respectfully] "I have summoned you to discuss the actions of your apprentices."

a421107d-4b48-49cf-88a6-d5d93ed25912.Text: "Master-at-Arms, inform this man of the accusations against the cult."

edf075f3-a487-4420-b1d6-a4494eecbc90.Text: "Do you claim that you did it because the God-Emperor willed so?"

d4b76546-7c81-4d11-9cbb-e2e3279b56a2.Text: "If you think that your tales will save you from punishment..."

8b0f40b5-7396-483b-9ff2-2882880a1333.Text: {n}The Vizsier of the Bloodspun Web treads lightly and silently as if his old, gaunt body has no weight at all. He whispers weakly,{/n} "Domin'{name} willed to see me, and so I have come."

e70ab51d-3af1-43be-9162-37c5abc4ee0a.Text: {n}You notice a fresh bruise on the Vizsier's face, and his clothes are torn even more than those of his fellow cult members. The escort enforcers' faces are pale but resolute.{/n}

5731e705-9419-41dd-bf17-b0f3f17fde64.Text: {n}The Vizsier responds in an equally respectful manner,{/n} "Let their deeds be weighed."

102e917b-a7bb-40cd-a4b9-104b5e5419cf.Text: {n}The old man's murmur drowns out Sauerback's relentless voice:{/n} "Domin'{name} knows the truth. So it was done, for so I did will. It was no affront, but... a prophecy. For my hands to divine, unsullied martyrs offered their souls and bodies into His imperishable embrace. I gazed into the red rivers of their smouldering lives, and I did see. A roiling unclean staining the bays, reaching for the anointed {mf|Lord|Lady} of the Ark."

54d520bf-f4ad-43eb-bac9-4495627c1077.Text: "Do I fear meeting Him? I do not. Yet I fear my Domin, for I hear {mf|his|her} ire thunder." {n}He chews his lips, casting his sewn-shut eyes down.{/n}

b6b2a3f4-9940-48bf-8931-237c661fba52.Text: "Be that as it may, we have hit a dead end. We hoped that exposing the culprits would lead us to the aberrations' lair."

18fee033-4e35-4c16-b325-cb7ad45983db.Text: "Not to put too fine a point on it, Weisz nearly destroyed the ship back then. Incidentally, he had given us multiple warnings that it could happen. Lady Theodora ignored him, and we reaped the results. Oh, why do I get the feeling that I know what will happen next?"

aa14dd68-5ec7-4b2f-b240-1fbcfd2bd8b2.Text: {n}Heinrix clears his throat.{/n} "As far as I know, the Inquisition's involvement in the matter was never proven. Spreading dubious rumours is a precarious habit that you would do well to abstain from."

9577bcfd-ec3d-47a7-9980-45a035783d8c.Text: "I didn't see the ritual — Weisz kicked me out. But the echoes of it that reached the decks were enough to scare me shitless. Weisz is a mighty old grox, but his head is a mess. And I mean the bad kind of a mess, the Astropathic kind. I say we think twice before we risk having whatever lives inside his head crawl out."

9aa6aea1-e7bb-4492-902e-177181b47299.Text: "What is it, iceman? Are you worried we might take a peek inside your own dark thoughts? Well, don't be. We already know we can't trust you."

381db4a9-5d7c-4209-af68-d1b593bd1702.Text: {n}The Vizsier listens intently — not to the words of anyone present, but rather to someone invisible and inaudible.{/n} "I hear you, yes... The witch is weak. Death whispers of many names that it will claim if she is allowed. Names whose time to be erased is not now."

f318f0af-9149-44dd-9579-8d73d5c92ed6.Text: "I'm not weak! Lady Theodora didn't keep weaklings around, and neither does the Lord Captain. But... a telepathic ritual of that scale really would be too big of a bite for me on my own. If it's listening to the whispers from behind the door or frying someone with lightning — that I can do. But looking for mutants by following the trail of their unclean little thoughts — that takes a special kind of learning."

9f846dff-7ffb-4574-bb25-4b25a82ba34d.Text: "{name}, regardless of how regularly you kneel before an altar, I advise you to take this warning seriously. If I am correct in my suspicions about what is transpiring here — and I pray to the Throne that I am not — then you can indeed consider this incident a sign that the Emperor is watching over you and this ship."

b4419562-b19c-4991-8b4e-3c65fb455c2a.Text: {n}The Vizsier's lips curl into a smile.{/n} "I held the cards of {g|Encyclopedia:ImperialTarotGlossary}His Tarot{/g}, washed in the blood of the righteous. They make no mistakes, and neither does He send false visions. Only mortals err — they who read the signs. They who interpret."

b7e88439-2b13-49d4-addc-768f59dee728.Text: "He did not reveal. But it is corruption itself. It offends Him. It tastes as sweet as fetid waters in old pipes. Its promises are the deception of an enforcer's smile. Its face is... elusive."

6ae00bbf-48c8-4ffb-bee7-1fd29dd57930.Text: {n}You hear {d|Encyclopedia:Prologue_CutByKnife}laughter{/d} scraping against the inside of your head.{/n} "The Emperor bid him? This old fool sacrificed his disciples to read their flesh, blood, and bones. He wants to see the corpse emperor's revelations in the tangle of happenstance. He is so desperate that he... invents omens for himself."

71be3b2b-72f7-4014-9b01-bcc1688e9d67.Text: {n}Before you can finish your sentence, a curved dagger appears in the Vizsier's hand. There is a flash of steel in the air, and five severed fingers land at your feet. He says, his voice unfaltering,{/n} "We have displeased you. We are guilty." {n}His parchment-like skin grows even paler. He carefully bandages his maimed hand, then bows his head low.{/n} "It is disgraceful for me to stand before you, Domin. I beg you to accept the cult's apologies. My apologies. I am ashamed."

030b34cd-ed41-43ab-8619-9a2f585aa4b8.Text: {n}Something resembling alarm creeps into his colourless voice.{/n} "They were martyrs. It was their conscious wish to walk into the Undying Emperor's embrace. Domin'{name}, by disallowing the spinners' duty to Him, death, and the dynasty, you cut the very threads of faith that the Bloodspun Web uses to hold the flagship's bays together."

fc4dcfd1-c541-4366-86a1-087893fec80e.Text: "There is no need for them, Domin'{name}. The word of the {mf|Lord|Lady} of the Ark begets truth, not danger." {n}He gives you a meek nod, his thin, unarmed hands hanging limply at his sides.{/n}

2fc19741-5bba-4b75-93a5-96094a0dcc5d.Text: "My duty will be done when the threat is eliminated. I will brief the enforcers while you consult Choirmaster Weisz, Lord Captain."

c0f1eaf1-59cf-47cf-bdf6-5659ae296ffb.Text: "Investigation has established that the Bloodspun Web orchestrated an attack on {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship} by means of pouring unholy blood into {mf|his|her} bath. This affront—"

4d717222-9c39-41db-ad26-452829899870.Text: {n}The officers around you keep a respectful silence, but you can tell by their faint smiles that they find the very idea of doubting the Emperor's providence absurd.{/n}

ce77827d-27fa-43cb-9cef-fc90e6771109.Text: {n}The Vizsier freezes, listening to silence, then nods to nothing.{/n} "Yes, yes... I will tell {mf|him|her}." {n}He turns his sewn-shut eyes to you once more.{/n} "We are seeds in your hands, Giver of Life. Whether you keep us or scatter us, we will remain grateful."

4a386c5f-bbfc-48f3-abba-bd64b8046642.Text: "But no spinner or brave warrior from the Domin's circle can find the roots of the unclean, for it can appear as human and act as human. Only its thoughts betray its vile nature. Only its thoughts are never human."

b27e226b-99a7-49de-be59-868ec17c3b05.Text: "No." {n}The Vizsier responds in a slithering whisper.{/n} "Your dread is not hollow: the unclean has sullied every bay on this ship. You are right to fear it. It is His will that you do."

b6e0d4fe-e52a-41cb-a47f-dc58534770a5.Text: "The esteemed Zacchary Weisz can perform the ritual of thought reading. This practice lets him do a cursory examination of the minds of thousands of people in search of certain individuals. A ritual as rare as it is dangerous, and only someone as versed as Master Weisz can accomplish such a feat."

8630505f-0df1-48bf-a7a3-bcf171be7c40.Text: "Once. Lady Theodora made use of his services to expose spies on board... who apparently had been in the employ of Lord Inquisitor Calcazar."

cf63f009-5b6c-46f6-b4e9-7f89917e9934.Text: "In my apprentices' last sighs, I heard the {g|Encyclopedia:EmperorGlossary}Undying One{/g}'s whisper. He bid me: bathe the Domin in the blood of he who must go and they who have been righteous, for this will shield the Domin and strengthen {mf|his|her} body against the roiling unclean. I obeyed."

3b5cfe1f-b9a3-4fe4-98d0-4befef8f100a.Text: "Veni'Zacchary is a fearsome hunter. When he hunts, the flagship wails. When he thinks, my teeth creak, and I can feel pain as if I am young again. But his power is great indeed — he can hunt down our prey."

7845494c-0e7d-406b-bc60-d830f4d6e503.Text: "Weisz." {n}Anxious silence falls the moment Sauerback says this one word. She narrows her eyes.{/n} "Is it unclean thoughts we need to find? Very well. Let Weisz find them. He knows how, no matter how badly he wishes that the rest of us forgot about it."

00bb4441-7f9d-4714-b5e7-f15e7aa3ffb3.Text: "I would say the one least eager will be Master Weisz himself. Last time, his efforts caused some... severe warp manifestations. The ritual truly is perilous."

5c071cd6-5491-496a-9289-a4a58fa3453e.Text: "The situation is clear, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}." {n}Sauerback makes the sign of the {g|Encyclopedia:Aquila}Aquila{/g}.{/n} "The Emperor has sent us a portent. The Protector of Mankind guides the hands of His holy servants to guard us and warn us of hidden threats."

94650e47-c41e-4359-91a7-134df790b0d0.Text: {n}You heard tales of this practice during your {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Psyker}training{/d} at the Scholastica Psykana — dark, chilling tales. This is not a ritual that is taught, for it can only be learned through great sacrifice. Weisz is obviously a rare example of someone who was able to pay the price and survive.{/n}

8bdd795e-c946-48da-b452-7118d6ee75f2.Text: "My 'theories' are classified information of the Inquisition that I cannot divulge without good reason. If evidence comes to light that confirms my fears, I will disclose everything necessary. If, however, my concern is baseless, I would not wish to share knowledge dangerous to you without cause."

e8b2f3da-37d5-413f-99e0-b49526b49669.Text: "When I saw the wounds made by the hand of a fellow believer, I guessed. But the Vizsier chose not to warn you, and so it was not my place to do so either. If there had been a plot against you, and a knife aimed at you, I would have given you some sign. But the Vizsier means you no harm, he is your servant. Where your other subjects' threads are clear and straight, his lie in the shadows of hints and secrets. Trust him as I do."

360a40c7-99c5-48ab-ac1b-455dc76666a1.Text: "This mon-keigh has drawn attention to the mutant in a way that could not be ignored. A shrewd tactic, if the threat is indeed as great as he believes."

4c801653-2a46-49f0-afc1-b1a3a52dbc40.Text: "I know not. I heard only the name, and I knew: he must go." {n}He listens to the empty space above his shoulder and nods.{/n} "Yes. We need no more knowledge than that."

0ceffcef-fd36-4a36-8814-8481bd28da03.Text: "Such is your will. We obey, but know this, Domin'{name}: death claims all. One way or another."

65569524-aae7-4a11-bdb3-ed0bed542624.Text: "God-Emperor, I thank Thee for protecting us, even though there are instruments of Your protection whose purity and holiness I may never understand."

5ef04045-26da-4cb8-bc81-cf7660ece9c7.Text: "We thank your will and your grace, Domin'{name}. We will serve you well."

b6abb2ed-c1d0-4dd2-93f7-678f068f1c8e.Text: "I speak, move, and draw breath because He wills so. I defy not the Undying One, neither in death that gifts and takes nor in my living existence."

deb85c08-cb60-4ff1-8054-aed4ddb238b7.Text: "The Allfather's enemies are through! This grisly old spider did well. Every pup on Fenris knows that bathing in the blood of a slain foe wards off witchcraft."

67204d73-b176-4593-a691-0e59372f8227.Text: "It is inhumane. I order that you immediately cease using these barbaric methods."

115ae027-ee71-4f72-8fb3-f0f8a16b6eb4.Text: "What do you propose we investigate first?"

64d804c6-d0cc-4e4e-a223-62d4b6d93844.Text: "I have faith that my Master-at-Arms is capable of finding other methods of seeking out the truth."

2c7216b4-cdc4-4f09-85f7-acd0f55e0a56.Text: "I gave you an order. Now do it!"

5c958a39-dc26-4d22-b0fa-1f4c38e635c6.Text: "I am flattered. Now, let us get back to business."

4d10cfcc-1e40-499e-952a-d1ec2f49105f.Text: "An unfortunate necessity. Let us return to other matters."

c432c024-f6e3-43fc-91a3-779914cc930a.Text: "I cannot help but notice all the looks of awe. Is my presence going to distract you from your duties?"

c0371db4-6710-446c-8131-4dbf55b9f0fd.Text: "Even taking into account the neighbouring decks only, that constitutes hundreds of people. How do you plan to question them all?"

42b7c622-cfa2-467d-bbfd-5a8ec67804b2.Text: "So, they write stories about me, do they?"

55743bcf-4060-46cf-b10a-463fa02a0bcf.Text: [Leave your signature on the endsheet] "May it remind you of this meeting."

87523d24-2f5d-4fc6-bc75-23ab5988e968.Text: [Correct the inaccuracies in the tome] "Oh, this simply will not do..."

cdb2e471-a1f1-451f-a50b-d4bc622ea9bc.Text: {n}Sauerback barks at the enforcers gathered before you:{/n} "{mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship} the Rogue Trader wishes to handle the investigation personally."

5321e23e-9197-4035-8714-3a4bd5a1b4fd.Text: "You are expected to perform your duties immaculately and report your every step to me. Should any of your actions bring shame to the enforcers, you will answer to me personally."

d3cda0da-3fb7-47db-bf94-61a635faa222.Text: "Lord Captain, the three officers before you have been tasked with conducting the investigation. The first, Captain Klein, is a veteran with a record of quelled uprisings of mutant abominations in the colonies. Captain Jinevri is young, but she has already pre-empted several mutinies among the ship's rabble. Lastly, there is Captain Hrotko. His interrogation skills deserve credit, and he knows how to instil fear and respect firmly in the minds of the riffraff."

1eac8ffb-7e83-4f4b-b884-34b950f84667.Text: "We have discovered a worker's corpse, mutilated and desiccated. We are still looking into the man's identity and position, but the chirurgeon's report has confirmed that, among all the blood that was pumped into your bathchamber, the blood carrying mutations was indeed his."

d64a5341-d48f-40eb-9290-d5318e1b5f13.Text: {n}The Master-at-Arms nods coldly.{/n} "Of course, Master Interrogator."

c0bdbd1a-70a2-4755-9bff-2b4687cdfafd.Text: "Indeed, Lord Captain, most unfortunate," {n}says the Master-at-Arms, a bloodthirsty smirk stealing across her face.{/n}

22eeb3ff-03bd-43b5-8ed1-993259a01520.Text: "The mutants are plotting." {n}Klein spits in disgust.{/n} "They've been breeding like void rats, so they're getting cocky. Must have wanted to infect Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} with their plague."

b5a0d82a-36a6-4b9a-9ebe-caccd4a32fe2.Text: "It wasn't an attempt on the Lord Captain's life — it was a threat. The rabble are planning a revolt, so they're trying to terrorise us. 'Soon, you will drown in blood' — insurgents pride themselves on such metaphors."

185b44ea-3399-4b8b-9617-86ee0cb1918c.Text: "Meanwhile, Captain Hrotko is convinced that it was the work of Voigtvir's surviving cultists. However, I believe this to be a warning rather than a threat. What we need to establish is who is trying to warn us, and of what."

a6d61621-43e1-4492-8908-204ffde869da.Text: "The body. Once we have ascertained the dead man's identity, we'll be able to locate his associates and narrow down the number of suspects. Captain Klein is in charge of examining the corpse."

a2d1be81-9bde-4e06-94f4-fdc5317e27f1.Text: "The body was discovered on a suspended platform not far from the room with the armillary sphere. Take a left once you're out of the mess hall, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, and go along the balcony. The corpse is on the next platform after the one holding the Infernus Guild suspects. I'll show you around the scene once you're there."

55075417-c03f-4d23-bcca-9442fa98c6fa.Text: "Yes, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I'm almost done with my report. As soon as it's ready, I'll deliver it to you."

d453ab8b-6496-4434-a858-5f647a604c14.Text: "Yes, Lord Captain. If you have any questions, I am ready to answer them."

4b253a22-1b86-41c8-9dd3-3b189285a91c.Text: "My people are at your disposal, Lord Captain."

421e9572-4d97-4e92-82f8-b602ea6d7a6c.Text: "While we wait for Klein to report back, please enjoy the refreshments that have been prepared for you, Lord Captain."{g|Encyclopedia:Amasec}{/g}

e9671b2d-35a7-493b-b672-860ca70a6af4.Text: "Our interrogation techniques are broad and varied. However, nothing loosens the tongue like corporal punishment: beatings, mutilations, torture, public executions." {n}Sauerback almost purrs as she lists ways of making people suffer.{/n} "When combined with psychological pressure, such methods work wonders."

99a94e8a-86bd-4ae3-9388-5461a57509e2.Text: "I am delighted to hear it, Lord Captain. It is always a pleasure to meet a connoisseur of the craft."

1782004a-f407-47ab-bdce-86e635260670.Text: {n}The enforcers are looking at you with a unique respect that seasoned voidsmen show only to other {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Navy}seasoned voidsmen{/d}. To them, you are a Rogue Trader, but you are also one of their own.{/n}

459798f1-5752-494c-98d5-af69fa8a44d1.Text: {n}Jinevri accepts the tome gingerly, as if it were a relic touched by the Emperor Himself.{/n}

7d223bf9-49cc-4eda-ab17-ed789b8ba57a.Text: {n}Half an hour later, you hand Jinevri her tome back, which now contains numerous comments written between the lines. She accepts it reverently.{/n}

da19a34c-5237-4c8e-9662-efc2bcb41dd8.Text: {n}Sauerback's murderous glare silences Jinevri's frantic expressions of gratitude.{/n} "Does that take care of the pleasantries? Then let us return to the attempt on the Lord Captain's life."

36d750e1-34b1-45f7-82b5-2f9e45a23a4e.Text: "Lord Captain, these methods may be brutal, but their effectiveness has been proven over centuries of practice. No criminal will confess if you ask them politely. But if you shatter their finger and courteously remind them how many unshattered bones they still have left in their body... That is a different conversation altogether. That is how the truth is born."

7a7df303-2f03-475c-85aa-efd2cae10d23.Text: {n}Sauerback's glove creaks as she grips her maul. Her gaze remains cold and calm.{/n} "As you command, Lord Captain."

baf9bb42-dac8-47e9-a3bb-0fbf78f94fdb.Text: "Yes, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. They are undergoing interrogation like all the rest. The scum refused to comply, so they were isolated on a separate platform. The inferni are a rotten bunch, they must be involved in this!" {n}The captain spits contemptuously.{/n}

a0ec8974-00ef-43e1-9e24-c0e7be087003.Text: "According to my data repository, the term 'fictionalised' is typically applied to texts whose knowledge dissemination potential is negative."

9280f1d6-388c-4437-894e-08eee8833a39.Text: "What need have you for these soulless scribblings? The written word is false, only the living spoken word carries the truth! Sing verses about the glorious feats of your aett-vater! Sometimes you find yourself singing a good song in the long night of Helwinter — and suddenly you feel heat in your chest, as if the Sun Wolf has emerged again on the sacred hunt..."

49472b90-c521-4768-b045-99e9900164da.Text: {n}Marazhai drops his bored expression and tilts his head to the side, looking at Sauerback.{/n} "This one is intriguing, {name}. Lend her to me to play with after you have dealt with your wounded pride. It seems we have some common ground to... explore."

b708a2a9-a298-4a3a-9db6-1647636ca4e1.Text: "Ah, shereen! Perhaps I'll travel with you and they'll write about me as well? I want a novel! About the adventures of the fearless Jae Heydari, who skilfully bestows a bullet's kiss on any ashmag who stands in her way!" {n}Jae toys with a lock of hair, a wistful expression on her face.{/n}

307bb188-6884-4fc3-8b09-c5486bdaeffd.Text: {n}After carefully assessing the officers' bearing and their uniforms, Abelard nods with satisfaction.{/n} "Their drilling is good, their service records are excellent. Let's see how they perform in the field."

df5e69ac-0fa9-4baa-a576-c7272f9db2e9.Text: "Interesting hypotheses, but I doubt it is that simple. Mistress Sauerback, grant me access to the investigative files. I have my own thoughts on what is going on here."

14832d00-fc19-472e-8d3a-66415de47e2f.Text: {n}Sauerback barks at the officers gathered before you:{/n} "{mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship} the Rogue Trader has seen fit to honour us with {mf|his|her} presence in order to monitor the course of the investigation."

aeea996a-cac4-49cd-aa3f-a512f9a66fe7.Text: {n}Yrliet frowns as she surveys the deck.{/n} "So much noise and empty violence. I am surprised you are able to find anything in this pandemonium of your own making."

59c1d54a-d9c4-4463-968e-f1cd33628ee9.Text: "You did not answer the question of how you intend to organise this process. So far, this looks like a fire in an obscura den. Although I don't know what else one could expect from..." {n}The Proctor's cold gaze sweeps over the room.{/n} "...amateurs."

8c099df3-c3d9-438c-8c7d-9c2e6bc672e6.Text: {n}Sauerback furiously jerks up her chin.{/n} "Our methods may not be up to the highest standards of the Adeptus Arbites, but they will get us the results we need — I swear it on my honour as Master-at-Arms!"

a4e3144c-ba54-42d3-98ae-330342f473f1.Text: {n}You see fear and respect in the enforcers' eyes — after all, not only must they prove themselves to the Rogue Trader today, but also to a {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Arbitrator}true master{/d} of investigation.{/n}

da7299bd-7177-444e-bc0b-6276be0749de.Text: "The workers from the nearby decks have all been checked for genetic aberration, but the mutations identified are all within the norm for labouring masses. They are being rounded up for interrogation as we speak."

f2009596-7f7f-4718-8bc5-e648de05b8df.Text: {n}You notice the enforcers exchange a few astounded glances and throw their shoulders back — apparently, they are not used to standing so close to figures as {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_MOT_Glory}renowned{/d} as you.{/n}

e6a1b2fc-a159-45fc-a00d-9a5f8723f52a.Text: "On the contrary, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Your presence inspires us!"

deab643e-bb18-4c76-ac2c-9580bdf160b9.Text: {n}Captain Jinevri's cheeks redden.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I hope you do not take this as insolence, but I am a great admirer of yours! I've read the fictionalised account of your deeds many times."

6b3c96bd-061f-42ca-91e2-a31ad2c8d0c1.Text: "Of course! I have it right here!" {n}She offers you a worn tome with a somewhat embellished portrait of you on the cover.{/n}

737c4d3e-6a59-4550-b07c-148ff3914990.Text: "I wish you swift results in your interrogation."

dd73d4d4-2c80-43e9-9570-514894cd5c93.Text: "I am in no hurry. My orders are not up for discussion."

4931770d-295a-4758-b3a5-1ebb58c68ae2.Text: "I thought you said he was still waiting his turn. Why does he look beaten half to death?"

1c1684b2-3394-4ba4-824f-e2b0e2c0824f.Text: "This man is no cultist, he is a fool. Hang him and bring me the real culprit."

882d1bfb-954c-4ffe-856c-42a2a67cef0e.Text: "And who is this dark and almighty patron of yours?"

3c8c1f65-5bc1-4d14-8a30-0905c063b444.Text: "I assume that our suspect is not who he claims to be?"

08475950-309d-4531-b96e-6e7e1f87c7e6.Text: Ordered that the fake cultist be spared.
