8832efa9-b32f-4fd5-bb25-25941bf00de5.Text: "Spare the man. Wash off those heretical symbols and let him rejoin his family."

06143500-f6b9-44eb-b48b-383c9c7c4466.Text: Ordered that the fake cultist be executed.

3b3d7dc6-1a8f-4440-9c1c-81f42f3b4249.Text: "Hang the heretic. Even farcical symbols and mentions of the Archenemy are capable of drawing corruption."

caee4a44-4f9b-40d1-a563-36a7a0250ba8.Text: "Heinrix, do you, by any chance, wish to ask some questions of your own?"

27f6da36-c6af-498d-89e9-74e0974f22b7.Text: Ordered that the fake cultist be burned along with his family.

56f727e6-25ad-4cee-ada6-788ef026660f.Text: "Burn him, and his family along with him. But be sure to leave him for last."

2c04ee7b-d1ff-45ac-a4cf-c06b397ae1ad.Text: "I do not care. I leave this decision to you."

e8781285-fe83-4083-b468-f2cc9df7dba4.Text: "What are those marks on you? What do they mean?"

aae9a70d-c318-4d3c-a7bb-951d9c188df2.Text: Examined the worker's soul with an unholy gaze to seek out traces of corruption.

07a1550d-92e1-4091-9221-771cbf99c5dd.Text: "Enough with these theatrics, Gwedon. You are no cultist. Why are you so intent on vilifying yourself?"

346cb5b2-d8c8-429c-94d5-8f4dbef3712c.Text: "I ordered that the beatings be stopped!"

547925b3-8516-4200-aab0-190cb56ccd2f.Text: "Cut his rations for a month. And have him scrub the lower decks after shifts."

41e3e7a8-cbbf-4eca-8c26-70286f2161d8.Text: "Solomorne, I would like to observe how Arbitrators interrogate their suspects."

0fcfadbb-32f1-4236-b82f-9bc9dba04b16.Text: "Execute him and be done with it."

6c270902-2e66-4073-99e8-ae5858e2b028.Text: [Look at the worker with your experienced Commissar's eye]

0a19ad73-cc8a-437f-8ac4-6bc5e6a48cc6.Text: "If there is a senior pipewarden by the name of Gwedon among the suspects, escort him to me. I will question him."

e7b5ee25-7cce-4de0-91f9-fb31ce5d7704.Text: "Go ahead. Curse me. I am waiting."

6252fe07-d9e2-4495-a44c-66125ff7a30a.Text: "Do you take me for a complete fool? I will give you one final chance."

5d1e59c5-b93e-44b9-b29d-ffba1c0b4e0a.Text: {n}Hrotko looks on with indifference as his people use their batons and legs to interrogate the serfs. Upon noticing you, he nods curtly.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

81624b33-2e1a-4622-a9f3-83b91ed820c6.Text: "Satisfactory. We are maintaining fear and respect among the rabble as we go through our suspects. We will find the culprit soon, I swear it on my rank."

e57cab11-fc2d-4b83-9994-00438ec3ccec.Text: {n}Before you stands a gaunt man in work clothes. His face is swollen from the bruises, and several of his fingers are broken and sticking out at odd angles. He stares vacantly into the distance with watery eyes.{/n}

e1f0383d-77db-495b-8672-de8d423d4814.Text: "Those are merely the preliminary measures before the interrogation begins in earnest, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. A suspect becomes more inclined to speak if you give them the baton first. Standard procedure."

53ef8dea-16b9-4325-9331-8ee230171df5.Text: "I have been informed of your decision to question one of the suspects, Lord Captain. I consider it my duty to be present for the interrogation so that I may ensure your safety."

0fc71ad8-df92-4dca-b01c-f3ceb8bf86d9.Text: "Lord Captain, the evidence you have collected is sufficient to apprehend the culprit. I will report to you in the mess hall, and we shall bring this investigation to a close."

2857456e-e946-4d2c-97fe-057e2f8dcb6e.Text: "Start talking, you miserable wretch! You tried to kill the Lord Captain, didn't you?" {n}Hrotko grabs the worker by the lapels. Gwedon's coat flies open, revealing crude occult symbols painted all over his body.{/n} "What's this? Heretical brands? Cultist scum!"

90cb6d12-7f49-44bf-bfe5-c492c483de2f.Text: {n}Gwedon yells, baring what remains of his teeth,{/n} "Yes! It was me! I tried to put a curse on the Lord Captain. I killed my partner in a wicked ritual, rubbed elbows with them daemons, consorted with 'em! All to carry out a dark plot and doom the Lord Captain for the glory of my almighty master." {n}He bursts into a fit of hysterical, theatrical cackling.{/n}

30e55470-8e77-4e6a-97d3-c9d27f30ff82.Text: "Malakai Drek is the foreman of the 5th food depot and known to skimp on his meals, you halfwit. Is that the most terrifying figure you could come up with?"

c2fa61f0-bcc7-47cc-9773-bf2f1c802e22.Text: "We have ourselves a model cultist here. There is a ritual, a curse, and a plot. He even consorted with 'them daemons.' How kind of him to confess to all that immediately."

d99a155e-5f9e-452f-beb6-4e940bc00661.Text: "His words... He is trying to paint them over with fake garish hues, but his abject terror carries with it too much black and grey. What does he hope to accomplish with this?"

1410710e-3d87-44cf-80fc-92bc6a66132c.Text: "He has admitted to everything, the vermin! I have insisted time and again that the assassination attempt was carried out by one of Voigtvir's surviving henchmen, and I was right. I guess we weren't so thorough in clearing them out as we thought." {n}Hrotko casts a sharp look at Sauerback.{/n}

6a092257-dcea-4586-9b0f-bf63d2d01348.Text: {n}You do not remember hearing of such a daemon before. What you do remember from reports is that the name of the foreman of the 5th food depot, a known miser and sadist, is Malakai Drek.{/n}

4d49f222-f99f-4fb3-8ef8-d39a304db877.Text: "He realised he was done for. Besides, a heretic will take any chance they get to gloat about their wicked ways."

630fdcc5-17f3-4679-b878-32d74379aa35.Text: "What a shame. He was a good man."

c19699cf-3b6b-49af-ad1b-eece8c8a0db5.Text: "What enforcer? Name! Give me her name!"

4d3c3a31-89b9-4c1c-9ed4-45ce731cd99f.Text: {n}The name sounds strangely familiar to you. Perhaps such a daemon does indeed exist?{/n}

ab9a887f-d8d8-428c-8215-826b001c40b3.Text: "Well, I grabbed myself a rusty saw and started hacking at him. Then... I pulled out a dagger made from a virgin's bones and stabbed him! Oh, right, I also cursed him first. It was only right."

d2e3f7a0-6524-45be-813b-323a0d60f033.Text: "Tell me, Gwedon, why did you kill {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship}'s Seneschal?"

55dd6783-f131-47ca-9d0c-fbad8d909a0a.Text: "Well, because... he saw me do it. A witness, he was. So I cursed him first, and then... I killed him too!"

f4363f70-722e-4812-b609-1a307ba9279f.Text: "These are my cultist marks. So I can put curses on people and talk to daemons." {n}He pokes a finger at an uneven semicircle with nine arrows coming out of it.{/n} "This one's called the hame of terror. It represents the nine archdaemons. I always pray to each one first thing in the morning."

73409936-24ed-4b6b-906b-7bac2fcbf428.Text: {n}His soul is untouched by the warp. Your gaze pierces him to his core, and you see his lips mouth a silent prayer to the Emperor.{/n}

7442fef0-a622-402f-846c-201754903075.Text: {n}The man blanches and starts bawling. He gives up on his sinister theatrics and babbles in the voice of a common worker,{/n} "F-forgive me, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! I'm not Gwedon, and I'm not a heretic! Yart's me name. I'm a laundryman! Please, have mercy... They took my family. That enforcer said she'd throw them out the airlock if I don't confess! She made me draw these unholy marks on meself!"

10ba94f9-31f4-457e-98dc-9a212cbc45d7.Text: "Jinevri?" {n}The steely edge in Sauerback's voice causes everyone present to freeze, but you also hear a note of bewilderment.{/n} "We will deal with her later. I will handle the search for Gwedon myself. Lord Captain, would you have us execute this 'daemon worshipper'?"

942e38c7-7d82-4e79-995c-242cd5825302.Text: "Enough! You will not embarrass yourself in front of the Lord Captain any further. Since this is the best you've managed to do, I will take charge of the interrogations myself."

87b86337-918f-415b-84ce-5c2d4734e860.Text: "Not so fast." {n}Sauerback interrupts the officer without taking her eyes off Gwedon.{/n} "You, cultist. Whom did you say you serve?"

72c45f38-d856-4101-a2bb-2231d6588c58.Text: "Our murderer here is a fake. The symbols on his body are all wrong and only recently painted. I won't be surprised if it turns out that this is not even Gwedon. We will proceed with the execution, and Captain Hrotko is in for disciplinary action."

dcd186ac-14c0-488f-a2bf-6240df11cf2e.Text: {n}You have {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Commissar}shot{/d} a good many soldiers who had given in to corruption. You know how it manifests itself — how it twists a person's body and mind. The only violation that this worker deserves to be shot for is an absence of intelligence. He does not even remotely resemble a crazed cultist.{/n}

b8904daa-faba-47b8-8be2-fc8312fd6e03.Text: "Ji... Jinevri. Her name was Jinevri..." {n}The failed heretic raises his hands to his face, and you see many purple bruises. They are older than the others by several hours. He was evidently beaten long and hard, and he would have been screaming the whole time. Someone must have witnessed it.{/n}

0aefc25d-f37c-4529-8c5b-3c84d5f13f59.Text: {n}He gulps.{/n} "Wh-what do you mean, 'no cultist'? I am a cultist! Don't you mess with me, or I'll curse you!"

bc821f34-6010-44cb-8db4-3da5fd0229b9.Text: {n}Hrotko raises an eyebrow.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I dare not contradict an order, but this limitation will slow the progress of the investigation. Are you sure?"

b4119466-76a9-46a5-a141-cabed3cb813f.Text: {n}Hrotko looks on sourly as angry, bewildered enforcers attempt to interrogate serfs without resorting to violence. When he sees you, he nods nonchalantly as before.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

810d424b-8140-4270-91b8-7ccbcc3d7519.Text: "Of course, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I will inform Mistress Sauerback and ensure that our methods are moderated."

d073fc2f-2d06-44d3-b8e2-2ce9397a61bd.Text: "Either our suspect is delusional or he is lying. I would assume it's the latter."

47c1c318-5be7-4806-a4ff-079d7235407d.Text: "My apologies, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. This one was interrogated before your order was given. I will take responsibility for not anticipating it."

b73a6eac-8b14-42c3-b693-d0951f689925.Text: "In this instance, my dog will suffice. Glaito, contact."

747df398-7422-4156-ad7d-100f8a750d5d.Text: {n}None of the wounds on the victim's body could have been inflicted with a saw. There were no dagger wounds on him either.{/n}

95967ca0-edee-4ebc-9b48-a58c77ede326.Text: {n}The cyber-mastiff's muzzle stops a mere hair's breadth away from the worker's face. Baring his fangs slowly, Glaito lets out a menacing growl, before his jaws abruptly snap shut.{/n}

71e977cc-ea8c-4ab0-9f1e-3fbb623b2bbc.Text: "Holy Emperor protect me! I, uh, I mean Dark Master Malakai! P-please call off your beast, for Throne's sake— Oh, rats..."

cbe716ed-06c2-4e0a-a887-e125459e1c13.Text: "A truly miraculous return into the fold of the faith. Cultists these days..."

85d7e5a3-169e-4809-a692-757dadd49c7a.Text: {n}The body was badly disfigured. There is every possibility that a saw could indeed have been used to inflict some of the wounds.{/n}

ea3f7375-a73d-4e93-a1ad-c0812cbc3be3.Text: {n}Hrotko frowns as he taps on his data-slate.{/n} "Gwedon... Yes, we have him here. He is waiting his turn. We will bring him over at once."

bbc3990c-a1c1-4557-803f-9cbc232c86b9.Text: {n}You are unimpressed by this half-baked attempt at drawing the eight-pointed star of {g|Encyclopedia:ChaosGlossary}Chaos{/g}.{/n}

130bf8c9-7a81-4141-9913-5e861c57999a.Text: {n}You are unfamiliar with this profane symbol.{/n}

60e1eb7d-3d5d-4c9f-b630-bef178597af9.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, they must have beaten his head too—"

35914e08-c62c-45e3-8eb3-2a30cc0ca715.Text: Took pity on the arrested inferni and ordered that the beatings be stopped.

0412eef0-44dd-48f4-9a01-ea55c253518c.Text: "Cease the beatings immediately! Those people are to be provided rations and water."

3ff8c0c9-81fa-4100-b82e-4038d9ca2cf4.Text: "I will not have you disrupting the course of this investigation."

a3e4170a-92f8-4add-a3b7-8ad725129c8e.Text: "A senior officer has their duties. See to them. That is an order."

9c1037ff-a43e-4114-bdd1-28ae51bb4a2f.Text: "Very well. I command you to cease the beatings and provide those people with rations and water."

62db7e61-8552-4dfd-8100-e8ad81ce856e.Text: "Return to the rest of the detainees."

c2f794c4-8dbf-4111-9f0f-350cca77ee71.Text: "How did they end up in the hands of the enforcers?"

16dfde54-d051-41b1-9403-7edf5b6d412f.Text: "That was indeed terrible. This one gets no rations and no water."

77856441-39f8-471e-99b8-06ef6017af8c.Text: "I want results, not excuses. What have you learned during the interrogation? Or, by the Lex, are the lot of you only playing at justice?"

dd05f55d-85f5-453a-994c-67ccdf0bce3d.Text: "I am interested in any and all statements, even the most outlandish ones."

2fb2b3ee-95e1-4a10-97a9-dfa3ec340f43.Text: "And did any of them confess to anything useful?"

3c04ecaf-eed8-4313-b22f-f20320dc6208.Text: "So be it. Let him see his family."

a07ea5ed-5ece-406d-a205-061ef1764d68.Text: "It was a jest. I, too, have a sense of humour."

c50d622c-ab49-42dc-9571-947603c56837.Text: "You will know to watch your tongue next time, commoner."

ce441bb2-c73a-4b23-b921-91340ecabb0e.Text: "Nemesite, you say? I wonder who that is."

462bae49-97ce-456d-a3f0-952a3cd55007.Text: "Have patience, Einrich. As soon as the culprit is found, your people will be released."

61963a77-60e1-4421-84ee-ea836d45d055.Text: {n}With a menacing growl, Einrich looms over the second enforcer, who is holding his baton at the ready.{/n} "Why are you assaulting my people and denying them water like they're criminals? You've got teenagers and elderly folk here — they're all just ordinary workers, they've done nothing wrong!"

69b108db-630c-425c-aa20-91a87a7fdd60.Text: "They're all guilty until proven otherwise. You think a kid or an old man wouldn't do something that might threaten the Lord Captain's life? Once we light a bit of fire under them, who knows, perhaps someone will confess. So, sod off, traitor spawn, or I'll put a baton through your skull for attacking an enforcer. I couldn't care less about your rank."

2cc0a482-83a4-434c-96e7-b2bddc520158.Text: {n}Einrich looks up at you.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I ask you please to protect your servants from this abuse."

de10eb61-d4bb-4bbc-8f0d-02116f3b32c4.Text: {n}Einrich adjusts his clothes and approaches confidently.{/n} "What do your enforcers think they're doing, Jocasta? Why are you assaulting my people, denying them water like they're criminals? You've got teenagers and elderly folk here — they're all just ordinary workers, they've done nothing wrong!"

eadc4e33-9d6d-4854-8821-7bd70e63cc9d.Text: "No, Einrich, what do YOU think you are doing? Attacking my people, chastising me in front of the Lord Captain? Get out before I have you charged."

48cb1a12-115c-4501-8ba6-9b545ad19e61.Text: {n}As Nemi's shoulders slump, Mia hisses to her,{/n} "I told you! It's fine, I'll split mine with you."

55e5505f-e395-4bce-adbf-fdfa9ec48877.Text: {n}You see no anger in Einrich's eyes, only bitterness and worry. He breathes in, then out.{/n} "As you command, Lord Captain."

febc5e7d-0dc6-4281-8f29-0767484fab20.Text: "The enforcers are revelling in their impunity, treating the crew like cattle, especially my clan. Many in their custody are dying of thirst or injuries. My sister and niece are there too. I don't expect them to be exempted from the investigation, but I'm begging you to put an end to these assaults and let my people have some food and water."

e1f93fb5-8d05-4886-ba36-e34fa261a6e7.Text: "That is what the procedure demands. Intimidation loosens tongues. Torment erodes the seditionary's will. The rabble are to know only awe and terror." {n}The words of the ship's regulations ring out across the room.{/n}

5ab85537-fe85-4f5a-b981-0dc392ff7918.Text: "That is what the procedure demands. Intimidation loosens tongues. Torment erodes the seditionary's will. The rabble are to know only awe and terror." {n}The words of the ship's regulations ring out across the room.{/n}

00d59255-ea94-4289-9143-af9863b3e807.Text: "We're following procedure, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. The regulations dictate the use of extreme force when dealing with the rabble so that the scoundrels do not cover up each other's transgressions."

8e9de2f9-7303-4356-bc4b-6199fb7cd325.Text: "Thank you. We won't forget your mercy."

27736661-faab-446e-a6f2-98c761721dc5.Text: {n}Einrich gestures at a dishevelled young woman and a short-haired girl in her teens. Both are dressed in utility coveralls and smeared with soot.{/n} "Lord Captain, let me introduce my sister Nemi and my niece Mia. Ladies, you should thank the Lord Captain for helping you."

3f17381a-5e5f-4e12-ab8c-8848473741ab.Text: "Uhm... Hello, Your Majesty. Thank you for the food and water, and for not letting them chop our hands off. That would've left us a little short-handed!" {n}Nemi laughs awkwardly.{/n}

f292e411-39be-433a-a83b-c5e939e4ba5f.Text: {n}Marazhai stifles a yawn.{/n} "Beatings and starvation. Hideous. In its banality."

3ca8cfd4-2fcc-4e1f-8b29-db00c225b73f.Text: "My status as senior officer exempted me from being arrested, but that same privilege did not extend to them — they were taken, along with the rest of the clan."

33954ea5-a4e2-4223-93da-59ccac0131c8.Text: "I hope you find the culprit before another hundred workers are forced to suffer the same undue punishment."

0e86fdc0-2080-4490-96cc-ffd5360d9b2b.Text: {n}Mia snorts and elbows Nemi in the ribs.{/n} "It's 'Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}'! And don't make jokes when you're so terrible at them. Do you want the Lord Captain to change {mf|his|her} mind and send you back?"

cd8f0b5a-a873-4958-8ccf-e746a30d6551.Text: "Thank you, Lord Captain. They're all I live for, and, thanks to you, the people most important to me are now safe."

923745ef-ba1c-4c9d-a146-9dd18ef8f0bb.Text: "They were acting horribly! They were hitting people in the head and the ribs, they didn't care if someone fought back or not. Nemesite would never allow that!"

26d850d4-85db-471f-b835-260764ffc2a2.Text: {n}Mia elbows her again.{/n} "Shush! If they hear his name, they'll get angry again!"

260b4cd5-114e-4519-8716-c58d16316578.Text: {n}Nemi lowers her eyes in fear.{/n} "No one! Just a hero from a tale my grandfather used to tell when I was little."

248a7d79-7875-4c90-86f2-21fa25188044.Text: "That's enough, Nemi." {n}Einrich scowls disapprovingly.{/n} "You are not a child anymore, so stop bothering people with those silly rhymes. Forgive my sister, Lord Captain. That was inappropriate."

9dd27cb9-1a77-4ac0-af45-f5494d176502.Text: {n}Infernus Master Einrich Monteg spits blood onto the deck, right in front of the enforcer lying nearby, unconscious. Einrich's lip is busted, his knuckles are grazed and covered with blood, and there is a chewed-up lho-stick between his teeth.{/n}

b552ac00-fa19-4753-a5f4-892e747cc979.Text: "The void take your procedures! These are not seditionaries. They serve the dynasty, just like you and I."

3247d6c7-a039-4398-b89c-2ef6e5b7b56c.Text: {n}A pair of enforcers with battered faces is escorting Infernus Master Einrich Monteg. His lip is busted, his knuckles are grazed and covered with blood, and there is a chewed-up lho-stick between his teeth.{/n}

6b0c43ab-0d0a-4a24-9557-61954a4cd459.Text: {n}One of the enforcers drones nasally,{/n} "We apprehended him while he was trying to break through to the detained rabble. Got into a scuffle. We barely managed to restrain the troublemaker. He demanded an audience with you, Mistress Sauerback." {n}The Master-at-Arms nods, and the enforcers release their prisoner.{/n}

37fcbb67-6802-48e7-9ef0-c99d81e79266.Text: "I'm not strict! Nemi is just sloppy. If it weren't for me, she would have cut her own arm off with a torch or floated out of a breach long ago."

371687ab-dfd1-4485-b874-256550843037.Text: {n}Nemi tries unsuccessfully to slap her upside the head.{/n} "You could at least behave in front of the Lord Captain! It's like I never taught you to respect your elders."

5175234a-29c5-4a30-a5c2-bcf9027eab2c.Text: "You're the one mixing things up all the time! Tell her, Einrich!"

20949b6e-444a-452c-bf72-821f4323b63b.Text: {n}Einrich raises his chin proudly.{/n} "In that case, I request permission to join my family."

5409b8c2-09ee-4525-ad66-5ebccfd60ce1.Text: {n}Einrich ruffles Mia's hair.{/n} "Don't be mean to Nemi. She is having a hard enough time as it is. Sure, she's always tongue-tied and her jokes are stupid, but her heart's in the right place." {n}He is immediately slapped by his sister and laughs.{/n}

ec2d96d5-f5ac-4c41-95f9-893d273105ef.Text: "Outlandish ones? One of the inferni was found to be missing his pass to the room housing the work log {g|Encyclopedia:Cogitator}cogitator{/g}. Losing such a pass is a serious offence, but the scoundrel claims an enforcer took it from him. He could not specify the name and rank of the enforcer, but he did give a description: a man, tall, blond hair... Obviously, he is lying. He either lost it or sold it for a bottle of rotgut!"

ae64c033-8f24-4439-b945-6d6d9ed21fa3.Text: "Outlandish ones? One of the inferni was found to be missing his pass to the room housing the work log {g|Encyclopedia:Cogitator}cogitator{/g}. Losing such a pass is a serious offence, but the scoundrel claims an enforcer took it from him. He could not specify the name and rank of the enforcer, but he did give a description: a man, tall, blond hair... Obviously, he is lying. He either lost it or sold it for a bottle of rotgut!"

b281a143-4d72-4a2a-9b94-a4a6fc49edbb.Text: "Statements... There was one infernus goon, a real dimwit. He said that some enforcer took away his work pass. And the pass was an important one that grants access to the work log {g|Encyclopedia:Cogitator}cogitator{/g} room. But the scum was lying — he couldn't give the name and rank of the enforcer. All he said was: 'Some guy, blond hair, tallish...' He knows that he will be flogged to death for such a misdemeanour, the rat, so he tried to shift the blame."

82023faf-5564-4766-8766-2200bf06d6b7.Text: "Nothing important or, indeed, worthy of your attention."

25489a06-d70a-40fb-9b81-d666069108f3.Text: "Nothing important or, indeed, worthy of your attention."

b09b5dcc-bf7e-4c07-bf17-fdf5e1f6f949.Text: "Not yet, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. But they will soon!"

5e91412f-7a05-4eef-b3ae-515072635982.Text: {n}You detect a slight hesitation before the reply. There is something you are not being told.{/n}

f6a83f17-6f59-402d-88ed-d7e1d729413a.Text: "Then let's get back to the things that are worth attending to, like the arbitrariness of the enforcers."

866df5e1-32fa-4b3f-bb32-8d87b6f6ad98.Text: {n}Argenta takes rations from her bag and holds them out to the little girl along with her flask.{/n} "Take mine. Children should not suffer for their parents' mistakes."

4cbb9101-c91b-4c14-be28-0f552abf1aa1.Text: {n}Argenta smiles warmly.{/n} "A feisty one, isn't she? She has the spirit of a true Sister of Battle. But when I look at her family, I am glad she has someone to take care of her and that the Emperor did not call her to serve Him with weapons and fire as we do."

72a25e9b-adb7-428e-b21a-5a8cf087ea2a.Text: {n}Abelard sighs wearily.{/n} "Nemesite, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, is a folk vigilante from voidsman legends. Every few years, some hothead declares himself Nemesite. They always meet a sticky end, as do those foolish enough to believe in Nemesite's ravings." {n}The Seneschal levels a meaningful look at Nemi, who shrinks away.{/n}

919aa6fc-3918-40f0-96b3-a2a9484f7656.Text: "He doesn't look to me like somebody who knows only awe and terror. But I'm sure a few more empty threats and busted enforcer noses will have him quivering on his knees!"

b7584c1e-5a99-4b0e-8d59-7def3a87f435.Text: {n}Heinrix makes a note on his data-slate.{/n} "There are more convincing ways of exculpating oneself than making up some mysterious enforcer stealing passes. This incident should not be forgotten — it might be connected to the case."

ab108811-2cfc-41b3-bcf5-e097ca9e3365.Text: "{name}, are your serfs literate? I could lend them a highly informative pamphlet on etiquette!" {n}Cassia glances at Nemi and Mia's grubby hands and wrinkles her nose.{/n} "Then again, they would probably just burn it for warmth..."

c3fa0a40-7528-4e51-afd5-f79d8c32ad56.Text: {n}Your {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Arbitrator}accusatory tone{/d} strikes like lightning, but what really matters is that, in addition to bringing a flash of terror and shame to your subjects' faces, it immediately expedites their cognitive processes.{/n}

01c13f09-2c7c-4722-847a-d27b0803737c.Text: "There is something, but... No, it is not worth Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}'s attention."

f6143366-7b25-4b60-9fda-d3fac3f74f97.Text: "We have obtained some contradictory accounts, but their credibility leaves much to be desired."

2dcb5e13-bb7c-4b35-96a7-28c08c39f3d4.Text: {n}The enforcer glares at Einrich before giving you a silent bow.{/n}

8d57b199-8dad-4c5b-b652-6a14b4a1acbf.Text: "I would not dare disobey Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}'s order, even one I disagree with."

4999edaa-c0b8-409d-bbfc-94aeebf54a20.Text: {n}Nemi lets out a sigh of relief.{/n} "Yeah, you got me good there!"

7e9c3f54-a646-43ab-8d7d-f30f0e39e1da.Text: "So, this is the work of the Final Dawn. Execute the heretic and be done with it."

c4c4c76d-c633-407f-8495-654279cd7ebd.Text: "I take it we have hit a dead end here?"

b9d51159-3fcb-467a-9cb4-bfc8e6809ddd.Text: [Assess the enforcers' reaction to the confession]

0d44700e-750e-4036-b33a-282eb80fe4b0.Text: "Expertly done. Jinevri, you have much to learn from Hrotko. Wouldn't you agree, Jocasta?"

4cd52911-6b8e-4fc9-82f4-07b569966bff.Text: "It seems that Klein was too quick to blame the mutants. We are dealing with daemon worshippers here."

01dab3a0-7401-451f-8392-b6ea656c692b.Text: "Does the Master-at-Arms not find it strange that the suspect is so eager to paint himself as a heretic? And in such a preposterous fashion, no less?"

9de4ca30-e53f-482b-81b8-feea63d0cb02.Text: "He will confess. We just need to apply a little more torture."

bfa7dc5a-3af0-4666-a42f-8b76d278e239.Text: "We need to change our approach. Bandage his wounds and give him food. Talk to him gently and with kindness."

4bab4c7b-0b4c-4e15-b6b1-a36827fcbe36.Text: "I refuse to believe that there is not a single person who saw them being manhandled. Find those witnesses."

ec12a070-2214-4f5b-bc9a-c88467e4f255.Text: [Pensively take an appetiser] "Faith changes people. Take a book of psalms and read it to him until he confesses."

a263406b-aad1-4983-a252-1199041e3248.Text: "Why has he been beaten? I ordered that the beatings be stopped!"

225c77c5-34f4-446e-a07a-4f76cab80ea1.Text: "Perhaps our culprit is a simple idiot?"

f15b1328-2860-4e7c-9fad-5a514b7cb838.Text: "We can still execute him, can we not?"

16e0ccf4-b700-4ab6-a7a9-d7d1dd841898.Text: "Jinevri, where did you get your knowledge of heretical signs?"

63b94776-3ebf-4c53-8461-f9d86705f51b.Text: "Hold on. He has lied to us more than once, and maybe he is lying to us still. Jinevri, do you have anything to say?"

6113db7b-5812-4bea-a74b-9ae36c4f628b.Text: "Allow me to demonstrate. You there, cultist. You said you rubbed elbows with daemons? Name one for me."

65a8359a-d581-47bf-9aa3-b68d2fe700c2.Text: "That makes sense. You cannot beat a man half to death without everyone in the compartment getting wind of such a scene. We will look into it."

7d02dd9c-047b-4497-a77d-ccb67ef19814.Text: {n}A vein swells on Sauerback's temple.{/n} "Should we also grant him a pleasure palace in the spires of Dargonus while we are at it? Lord Captain, I doubt you will get the result you desire, but we will do everything within our power."

698e0f01-592b-4066-b34c-7be3b8a27ed2.Text: "We can certainly try, although we risk breaking him permanently. Extensive practice has shown that repeated torture of prisoners in this condition rarely has the desired effect."

c911547b-9025-4d55-accb-901a50b887a3.Text: "What do you want us to do with him when we are done?"

4e6d34f2-599e-4e6f-b43c-481ad1a59625.Text: {n}Undoubtedly inspired by your idea, Sauerback rolls her eyes and faintly mutters under her breath,{/n} "Emperor, grant me strength... It will be done, Lord Captain. We will recite psalms to the prisoner."

1ddd02e6-eca7-4a76-a3d4-4a9dd2fdd653.Text: "I agree, Lord Captain." {n}Sauerback growls at the worker:{/n} "I want the truth! Who are you? And who told you to give us this pathetic confession?"

72cdd359-28be-44eb-b4b4-c6caadac5567.Text: "We have the pipewardens' names and identification numbers, and we know which clan they are from. We will keep pressing the riffraff until either the culprit confesses or someone turns him in. I will handle this." {n}The Master-at-Arms pointedly grips the maul on her belt.{/n} "Please enjoy your meal in the interim, Lord Captain. The scoundrel will appear before us soon enough."

28de9216-3a04-4e5e-8fba-f397d624ad8b.Text: "There is no cause for alarm, Lord Captain. This 'conspirator' may have been a fake, but now it is only a matter of time before we find the real culprit."

8f21e839-666d-468a-9dff-bc6020f4084f.Text: {n}Klein smirks.{/n} "The dead mutant looked more like a daemon worshipper to me, the way his guts were all twisted. As for this one here... There's no touch of the warp on his body, that's for sure. The worst he'll be able to show us is an ingrown nail."

32281348-6983-437c-ba5f-1d2f2263e410.Text: {n}Klein shakes his head morosely.{/n} "My mistake, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Mutations are common among heretics... I guess this really is about a cult."

0f10bf9a-d14b-4470-b170-163721c4dfb0.Text: "There is one thing that's bothering me." {n}Jinevri points at the symbols on the worker's body.{/n} "Gwedon, what are those marks all over you?"

7a06bd8a-6e3d-43c6-b197-7d8a5737f3e3.Text: {n}Jinevri baulks sheepishly, casts a wary gaze at the Master-at-Arms, then shakes her head.{/n}

6bd4a44e-599b-4a5a-a8f4-fd274d7e6bfa.Text: "There is no such symbol. It's supposed to be a circle with eight arrows, and there is no way it's called 'the hame of terror.' This is some kind of travesty. Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, the man is talking nonsense."

fa8ba8d1-9be7-4fba-adb4-d1d829840aa4.Text: {n}Hrotko looks proud and self-important. Jinevri is biting her nail, as if hesitant to say anything. Sauerback is observing the worker in silence, apparently sunk deep in thought. Meanwhile, Klein merely stands still with a distrustful grimace on his face. Other than Hrotko, no one here seems to believe that you are looking at the real culprit.{/n}

e325ced8-5151-458a-8c72-04cdb61c5207.Text: {n}Sauerback glances at Jinevri with curiosity.{/n} "Jinevri, do you concur with the Lord Captain? Have you anything to say about this... expert display?"

f34bfc31-9f59-4339-9711-a184a37f35a3.Text: "I often have to deal with insidious rabble. The idleness and avarice of the scum on the lower decks breeds heresy, especially during warp travel, and people start carving signs on themselves and praying to... all sorts of things. The circle with eight arrows is more common than any other symbol, but I've never seen this variation before."

152260bb-419c-407d-b90a-52883c0369ee.Text: "What? I swear that I have not—"

23b43259-05bf-49ca-862d-6ecd5f0b1065.Text: "I have never threatened his family, and I certainly did not force him to lie and draw heretical signs! I barely even remember his face. I may have interrogated him beforehand, but it was someone else who put him up to this!"

da4c039b-cbc2-4d5b-a29d-1643fb921f05.Text: "And yet he knows your name and pointed you out right away. Do you not find that funny?"

7b96aa6d-1539-4153-9ad5-d3fd6779a787.Text: "And do you not find it funny that your head is always up your arse, Hrotko? It's obvious that someone framed her!"

e9f70cc5-6217-44b0-b0f8-04bcf1d2a2d8.Text: "Cease this bickering!" {n}Sauerback's snarl forces the officers to back down.{/n} "Lord Captain, what we have here is a liar, and a well-coached one at that. He will never confess on his own. What do you suggest we do?"

f2dd66cb-4f17-4e0e-a73d-96ec7962cb52.Text: "'Execute'... Truly, no word sounds sweeter to this mon-keigh's ears."

1ff3992c-263b-4660-b9e6-2556f2a625af.Text: {n}Argenta sighs, shaking her head sorrowfully.{/n} "God-Emperor, forgive this wayward soul his feeble-mindedness."

abad26c6-7481-4f68-a134-0be1ddb6192b.Text: {n}Abelard casts a significant glance in Sauerback's direction.{/n} "Your enforcers have a knack for persuasion, Mistress Sauerback. But this is ridiculous."

43829984-edec-456b-a8fe-1309f005304b.Text: "We cannot rule out the possibility that the dark pantheon of the lower decks is led by you, Mistress Sauerback."

0a724963-8a96-4ae5-8e9a-989be8ae7ae1.Text: "I am sure she is quite fond of various methods of torture, too. She would make a fine pet, one trained to respond to many interesting commands."

b877e66d-fa13-40a0-a5b7-eb85d8401329.Text: "Mistress Sauerback, are you not being too hasty in your conclusions? He did confess, after all."

04fd2219-69d7-4e33-bbf2-66cee6aa4dd0.Text: "He confessed what he was told to confess. I was personally involved in interrogating Voigtvir's henchmen, and even they did not spout such drivel."

ee886a02-3c03-4908-8de0-9451adbf7f10.Text: "Then he is the smartest idiot I've ever seen. He successfully carried out the crime, yet there is nothing remotely nefarious in his behaviour."

95962371-91bd-43fe-8dac-10105dfb80ce.Text: "That will do, Captain. We all have our foibles."

f770ed68-4ea4-44a7-a7a1-bb37df57357d.Text: "Is something the matter? You look pale."

3a224098-9aa4-4655-877e-a2253432a6e1.Text: "I was drenched in his blood. If the mutations were contagious, I would have mutated by now."

0f353994-b0d7-422f-a76a-6ca0a820b0cc.Text: "Hand me that scalpel. I will perform the autopsy, you record the findings."

ade47c60-2858-48ea-ab64-66a0a6a35d66.Text: [Toss the scalpel away] "I have finished the autopsy."

7efd253e-73fc-422b-a764-4378088a38ec.Text: "Someone tried to conceal the victim's identity and cause of death."

d33532ea-28f2-41c3-a62b-0d72f0fca846.Text: "Someone stuffed a feather down his gullet — a reference to the legend of Saint Quirine."

b1e52f83-9627-4db7-9cc9-17476f78f501.Text: "Someone stuffed a feather down his gullet. But why?"

bc263df1-d775-496b-9f54-bf5a8937e81e.Text: "He has a tattoo on his neck — a skull with a valve and a few symbols: 'SP-246-01.'"

b27347e2-9735-41bd-93e1-c8dfae90ab38.Text: "I am not comfortable with the enforcers' harsh interrogation methods. You will cease the use of violence — that is an order."

797b3e29-393b-4a59-b51d-5b5e7a753195.Text: "I expect greater professionalism from you in the future."

1cc880f1-8736-4c4e-921a-616ca6e040ed.Text: "Sanitation work is an excellent means of hardening those of tender character. When the investigation is complete, you shall join the mutant corpse disposal unit on the lower decks."

a52ad7e7-0d25-4ddf-b84e-a251c4e6aa65.Text: "I gave an order. How you execute it is your concern."

7d58983f-ee61-4161-aa71-d1b618717a10.Text: "Entirely true. In that case, carry on."

4c9640f4-037a-425f-858b-b3d97f6e10ed.Text: {n}The worker's ruined body lies in a waxen pile on the platform. His face is crushed, his throat open, and his body riddled with cuts and lacerations. Above it stands Captain Klein, the dim light filling the lines on his forehead with shadows that bleed down his furrowed brows and into the pits of his eyes. The scalpel in his hand trembles faintly.{/n}

62fa4025-31e6-4509-b68f-5aa0a0697dfc.Text: "It might look human, but what's inside it is all wrong. Unholy. Irredeemable. Wrong."

1d3912cf-6ab4-46ee-b999-6495fcfcf4b6.Text: {n}It is difficult to say why — it could be meant as a symbolic gesture, or perhaps a message.{/n}

827322ba-bc9d-42da-8218-824c3b97b43c.Text: {n}Argenta reflexively raises her weapon when she sees the mutant's rotten insides. The fiery rage in her eyes seems capable of incinerating the abomination as thoroughly as any flamer.{/n}

e3c8910a-963a-4558-962e-177cbbc7e590.Text: "I have, but..." {n}The furrows on the enforcer's face deepen.{/n} "I will get back to it in just a moment, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

a8a6310d-f1fd-49be-b515-96ea47b2ba51.Text: "Quite right, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I will convey your will to Mistress Sauerback right away. The violence will stop immediately."

dd7a9285-ed4f-47f1-9639-b4bdef118c25.Text: {n}Klein hesitates, avoiding your gaze.{/n} "I suppressed a dozen mutant revolts on Dargonus for Lady Theodora. I've torn the freaks to pieces myself. But to open one up... to sink my hands into their impure guts infested with the mutant blight..."

73933678-2f33-4a0f-8761-dabcba0d2436.Text: "I have seen this aberration utterly pervert the human form. The thought of it touching me... Disgusting. Infuriating. But I will overcome this."

8eccab5c-3a73-43af-9aae-43c3585ae517.Text: "In other words, the captain has a phobia. Such irrational fears are common among veterans who have faced the enemies of Humanity. This is a most unfortunate set of circumstances that won't help us here."

50a1bc79-316a-4bb1-84e4-1b7009241678.Text: {n}The twisted abnormalities of the mutant's insides make you wonder if he can even be considered human at all. As you probe deeper, your hand finds something lodged in the victim's gullet: someone has stuffed a black feather into the man's throat.{/n}

6b2ee57d-9417-4a71-90ed-a4bc058d1c81.Text: "And the righteous woman prayed to the Master, beseeching Him to reveal who had plotted to destroy her. And He heeded her call, and the feather of a raven sprang from the maiden's mouth and, as if guided by His hand, brought forth the names of those who had nurtured foul treachery in their minds. The Legend of Saint Quirine, verse 15. It is a sign, {name}."

137440a5-d647-4fd2-ae57-04dc0216a95a.Text: {n}Judging by the damage, the most brutal wounds were administered posthumously, over the top of those inflicted while the victim was alive — it is as if someone deliberately wanted to make it harder to identify the victim and his cause of death. The truth is, the killer acted quickly and with surgical precision, then suspended the body upside down to drain its blood.{/n}

bb93a170-1f50-429a-a4f8-85897d4b21d1.Text: {n}The haphazard miscellany of gruesome wounds suggests that the man was tortured for a long time before he died. You notice bruises on his ankles — the killer must have hung him upside down like cattle to drain him of all blood.{/n}

8f43c576-fe83-4913-90bd-bbea7090fa25.Text: {n}The skin and bones part, and the stench of rancid meat hits your nostrils. Klein empties his stomach over the deck railing. Fighting the urge to vomit yourself, you peer at the vile mass of subhuman entrails.{/n}

a73ced12-5730-47c0-b416-9a04a676bac1.Text: {n}Suddenly, the taste of bile rises in your mouth, and you are forced to look away, lest you follow Klein's example.{/n}

df65f532-14ca-44be-a60b-eb1d7ce83a23.Text: {n}A certain legend springs to your mind, one involving Saint Quirine, who was granted a portent of enemies hiding among the faithful. When Quirine prayed to the Emperor for a sign that might reveal the traitors, a raven's feather burst out of her mouth to inscribe the names of the conspirators. Only someone versed in the symbology of the Imperium could have left such a message.{/n}

da3306bb-bfdc-4f4a-bd3e-d862a2a6004e.Text: {n}With some difficulty, you are able to discern a mark on his neck, almost ruined by the wound across his throat. It is a tattoo of a skull with a valve in its mouth and a string of letters and numbers encircling it — SP-246-01.{/n}

4322f770-ca7b-40a8-b173-94b2905bba9e.Text: {n}The enforcer offers you a rag soaked in disinfectant.{/n} "That was... foul."

ab3b1871-6067-463e-bde7-e2e7dbbeaf2a.Text: "That's the symbol of a pipewarden clan that maintains the sewer systems. The 'SP' stands for 'senior pipewarden,' followed by his identification number."

47c41a14-2e5f-45f9-bd0b-88b410a44500.Text: {n}Klein takes a closer look at the precise wounds you indicated, almost undetectable beneath the mutilation.{/n} "You have a keen eye, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. But why would someone do that, then leave the body in plain sight? They could have just disposed of it. There has to be something more to this whole bloody business..."

a6304e42-5782-45d6-9c0e-ef318dca1323.Text: "A feather? A raven feather is hard to come by on a ship. I'll investigate where it came from."

13664d19-f341-47e5-a5de-1179a7d5213f.Text: "Well spotted, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. No doubt you have already reached the same conclusion, but I will state it for the official record: vile mutants do not make allusions to saints. This was someone versed in the Creed."

b8daeea6-6fc2-4006-8af8-b2fc70416aca.Text: "Vile mutants do not make allusions to saints. This was someone versed in the Creed."

39bae7c4-dc62-4881-805b-588fbecd5cbe.Text: "Jinevri is working on the work log {g|Encyclopedia:Cogitator}cogitator{/g} — she can use it to learn the victim's name from his number. The cogitator is in the nearest maintenance room."

ab1e8a9c-442b-485f-b4af-6d483567ceb8.Text: {n}You refuse to submit to fear and revulsion. One foul corpse is nothing to someone who has triumphed over {mf|his|her} own fate and achieved the {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_MOT_GreatDeed}impossible{/d}. You look at the mutant's insides without a moment's hesitation.{/n}

9c9e5461-9456-4673-bb90-6b7adcf0069a.Text: {n}"Bloody business." You turn your attention to the floor around the corpse. There is no spatter, no gobs of flesh, no bloody footprints fortuitously trailing into the dark. And yet... you know there is no way to butcher a corpse like that without getting dirty at all.{/n}

f86f70c6-0a93-48ee-9d58-fc9c7e29747d.Text: {n}Klein almost drops his scalpel.{/n} "But what methods of seeking the truth remain to us, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}? The rabble do not understand any other way."

3562f9eb-2b90-45e8-afdc-8d8c852b3bee.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I must commend your fearlessness and insight... and apologise for my weakness of spirit. My shameful fear prevented me from doing my duty. It will not happen again."

fa0ba0bc-acad-4cbf-9730-62fd61161101.Text: {n}Klein lets out a ragged breath and then draws himself up straight, speaking in a clipped tone:{/n} "Yes, Lord Captain."

4f3bc3a1-509a-46cc-829b-6efe4d8457ac.Text: {n}The enforcer dips his head deferentially.{/n} "You have been a model of fearlessness and competence — I will aspire to follow your example."

d7a6c178-729c-4f4c-9d6f-4a6ff6988043.Text: "Vestigial limbs, chitinous formations. These are far beyond mutations that one would consider common or acceptable. We must locate the killer and find out what they managed to learn about this creature."

45a998a0-dc9b-47f3-aa06-1b058b2b5687.Text: {n}Your knowledge of xenos is enough to infer that the murdered man may have been subject to xeno-influence. True human form has not simply been distorted, but mixed with something strange, something profane. It is as if you are dissecting a seed that should have evolved into something more complex and alien.{/n}

255ddb79-59ab-468d-beca-10a26a9f6047.Text: {n}You cannot begin to guess what unfavourable genetic factor caused such hideous mutations.{/n}

b29f20f0-16b4-4e86-98d2-e262befbbe56.Text: {n}Heinrix bends over the corpse.{/n} "{name}, take heed, all these mutilations are a facade. They were inflicted postmortem, clearly a while after. He died instantly from a stab to the heart. He was killed by a professional, someone who knew exactly what they were doing."

2755fada-9052-484f-94a5-74c0062b88dd.Text: "Shame on you, Captain. An officer's duty is to be a support to the Lord Captain, not the other way around. If that burden is too great for you, you should consider resigning. I speak plainly, veteran to veteran." {n}A modicum of sympathy is buried deep within the Seneschal's ruthless words.{/n}

cd43c517-c792-4f39-998f-cfd689f62b04.Text: "You will indeed, Captain. If you like, I can recite a few paragraphs from the regulations to enthuse you."

e87bbfca-2b9b-453b-b292-2858b1de4144.Text: "Coal-black fear colours his soul. I doubt it can be cast off by mere force of will..."

31d69085-dcf9-4f8d-a6eb-7272a8161103.Text: "Jae, you are so fortunate, they said. Your life in the Rogue Trader's retinue will be all about feasts and ballrooms, they said." {n}Jae looks away from the corpse squeamishly.{/n} "I think I will keep this little tale of mutant disembowelment to myself. Let my friends go on envying my life of luxury."

9f86e70a-b50e-4ded-9e49-4f241852b4a3.Text: {n}Klein nods cautiously.{/n} "You haven't mutated yet, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

c5718d1f-64cc-4a82-8565-993acf019e87.Text: {n}The enforcer responds with a grim nod.{/n}

a0a68476-dc54-4b03-98a8-4a9a2c47528f.Text: {n}The enforcer has not budged since your last visit. His scalpel is pristine, and you do not see a single new cut on the body.{/n}

15e9809f-f13a-4d0b-8144-fe0bb210d276.Text: {n}Vestigial ingrown arms wrap around what look like the vile semblances of familiar organs interlaced with scaly, bile-coloured sacs.{/n}

f38e08fc-fd5d-4c6c-92b4-e35abc565be6.Text: "I read about something quite similar!" {n}Clutching a handkercher to her face, Cassia leans over the body with interest.{/n} "Saint Quirine was looking for traitors, and the Emperor answered her prayers with a miracle: a raven quill appeared out of her mouth and wrote down the names of the enemies."

a6b46b2b-cbda-4d67-abef-6008b25fe6c5.Text: {n}Your practised eye instantly notices that the corpse was mutilated posthumously. You have resorted to such ruses yourself on a {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Criminal}number of occasions{/d} when you needed to trick some servants of the law.{/n}

19d293f5-ffa5-4589-98bb-b60ccfd423f5.Text: The desiccated body is horribly mutilated — what was once a face is now a shapeless mass of flesh and bone shards.

345f3553-861e-41f6-ade2-e165f29f035d.Text: "Lord Captain, the {g|Encyclopedia:Lexmechanic}Lexmechanics{/g} assigned to the Astropathic Chapel are reporting a significant drop in our communications potential. This may be a consequence of the telepathic ritual in which Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} deigned to participate. The enforcers report that the Choirmaster asked for an audience with the Lord Captain and has since locked himself in the chapel, refusing to let anyone in. As brazen as the audience request may seem, I cannot shake the feeling that it is a cry for help."

ed51fb81-0198-40de-a859-d8d692bfac96.Text: "Detain him yourselves. I will join you once everything is ready."

4186b44a-cf71-48ef-8291-36e988ddf71e.Text: "Very well, we will capture him together."

018ce314-a566-46cf-923b-15d8b89eec71.Text: "You should stay out of this, Kibellah. I will do it myself."

2b71d440-9ecc-4d8f-a81a-db30b369c56c.Text: "Wait, the appropriate age? Are there going to be elderly and youths present?"

d2ab43d5-d361-415d-920a-3ec52c411024.Text: [Brief the enforcers] "I am taking charge of this operation. Connect me to the squad commanders."

2cbaa43a-7117-4728-9553-fe9038ab13c1.Text: "Lord Captain, your plan was a success! Our provocation against Nemesite and the killing of the traitor Adalbert has brought out all the rest of them. My enforcers have captured a number of suspicious individuals and beaten the truth out of them. That scum Nemesite wishes to avenge his mentor's death and plans to raid the ceremony of the officers' anointment."

8e41cf20-5893-462d-bd40-8a7ad9dd36d3.Text: "We will deliver the bastard on a platter, Lord Captain."

b3d0dfa3-6944-4b7d-ad80-1c0f502a1dc5.Text: {n}You hear a burst of interference, followed by Kibellah joining the channel.{/n} "Domin'{name}, the whispers of death are uttering the name of Nemesite ever more loudly. I must meet the enemy face to face."

109b1dbd-59c2-4594-9fd1-80a8214140ec.Text: "So be it." {n}Kibellah's voice is quiet, yet somehow even more grim and ominous than usual.{/n}

84618491-1cf6-48f2-96cb-6bbef08ede12.Text: "No." {n}The single short word is filled with unyielding resolve.{/n} "It was my searching that revealed the trail of Nemesite. Without my labours, he would have continued to elude you and remained lurking in the shadows, gathering his strength for another strike. It is my hunt and my prey. If you do not wish for my assistance, then banish me." {n}The vox shuts off.{/n}

20042043-f5e7-4e45-9998-ce27327d2541.Text: {n}You hear a burst of interference, followed by Kibellah joining the channel.{/n} "I will go with you, Domin'{name}. My hunt is coming to an end. I will not let the enemy slip from my grasp."

385d7324-db9e-4d5c-a204-f2f347290593.Text: "We will replace the civilians with enforcers and their relatives of the appropriate age, dress them all in their formal clothes, and hide their weapons underneath. When Nemesite tries to strike, he will find only cruel disappointment — for the last time in his worthless life."

96260229-8140-4d65-b27e-d110c396a3a3.Text: "It is necessary for the sake of secrecy. Let me assure you: all of my people will gladly risk their families for the good of the von Valancius dynasty, without fear or hesitation!"

648c5434-3d5a-44b5-a7ac-702a40eed8e7.Text: "Since the impious Adalbert has turned out to be an apostate, it is the new confessor's duty to ensure that the officers retake their oath to the God-Emperor. Traditionally, the ceremony is attended by the officers' families, and it is they who are the target of the mutineer. He wishes to slaughter all of the ship's elite in one fell swoop. I have ordered a trap to be set for Nemesite. Would you like to be personally involved in the operation?"

cc06dbb6-76f4-4745-ad55-b277d4855b18.Text: {n}You receive the officers' reports. Thanks to your {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Militarum}experience{/d}, you quickly discover a number of flaws in their tactics and make a few small but crucial changes. The enforcers respond with deep respect in their voices.{/n}

b1825fe4-af56-4b96-8263-3b9a10e47c08.Text: "I object to these experiments. Get those voidsmen back to working fitness. You will have to find the cure some other way."

c17a0f24-f9cc-4ccf-98eb-75e6dc16658d.Text: "How do you intend to study this disease?"

f3cf55e1-6e21-4ada-ba3d-53c191176830.Text: Ordered the Chirurgeon Majoris to find volunteers willing to be infected so that he might find the cure for the disease.

7a1a1495-462b-4a01-8436-492ddb8bb547.Text: "Defeating a disease is a noble goal, but I cannot approve of your methods. Find volunteers among the crew who will agree to being infected in exchange for compensation. I expect you to cure every one of them once you are done."

02e68501-6e89-4589-b550-0a2445c127b0.Text: Ordered the Chirurgeon Majoris to use convicts as test subjects so that he might find the cure for the disease.

2935b26d-c467-4dff-a807-3ec326a17307.Text: "The voidsmen are to be treated and put back to work. If you want test subjects, tell the Master-at-Arms to provide you with the required number of convicts and other riffraff."

bd1037b4-d429-4d76-8590-b1253a588efa.Text: Permitted the Chirurgeon Majoris to expend the lives of crew members in order to obtain dangerous knowledge about the nature of wicked afflictions.

01d41b9b-dd55-44a7-b315-92db9b576ded.Text: "Make the most of it, Forius. If understanding this disease will indeed let you delve deeper into the nature of wicked afflictions, then you may have as many test subjects as you need. You may expend them all if that is what it takes."

57c8a65d-b1c0-451f-8260-8c8e5679a029.Text: "Forius is the officer in charge of all matters of health on this ship. Do not interfere with his work, Ravor."

31abe3e6-be03-4c54-b277-f0ccf5e30804.Text: "Lord Captain, permission to address you with a request! Our head chirurgeon is sabotaging the ship's operations — he has quarantined several voidsman crews on account of a piddling sickness. People don't even go to the medbay when they come down with it — they just wipe their noses and keep working. Only a dozen or so die from it in a whole year. We're sitting on our hands here, so I ask you to talk some sense into him."

e8cdb53f-a48e-4df6-b650-7ad7ee8dd83f.Text: {n}Your vox clicks, and you hear a dry, nonchalant response:{/n} "Greetings, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. My name is Lettard Forius, and I am the Chirurgeon Majoris of this vessel. As your chief medicae specialist, I assure you that the quarantine is well warranted. This 'piddling sickness' has claimed the lives of a number of meritorious officers in the past. This time, I intend to get the epidemic under control, study the disease thoroughly, and develop a proper cure."

9251ef35-82c1-4ce5-a633-6d504d84734e.Text: "This may limit the potential of the study, but... this approach is also acceptable. I will make up for the lack of material with my expertise. Thank you for taking your crew's health into consideration."

0dc19148-4b17-4415-a154-2ee10ab0670b.Text: {n}You hear muffled grumbling over the vox.{/n} "Orders received, Lord Cap'n. I will redistribute the shifts between healthy crew members, and may the Emperor keep them from dying from exhaustion."

b4f8222d-0564-4e8f-8182-5951f82c40b5.Text: "'Expend them'? What is that supposed to mean, Lord Cap'n? Now we'll have to teach new idiots the ins and outs of the voidsman's craft!"

212cc447-e356-4db5-bf01-39e664e9356f.Text: "Allow me to relieve your panic, Master Helmsman, by saying that I will not stand for any waste of life. The losses among the crew will be negligible."

2a2e6ed7-de41-4375-99dd-091ce966fd69.Text: "By gathering enough infected individuals together, letting the illness progress, comprehending its properties, and, finally, killing it. The disease goes through several stages, with each containing clues to its nature and vulnerabilities. The voidsmen will have to stay sick for some time until I discover the cure, assuming, of course, that the disease is reversible in its final stages."

e9eb5bc4-0287-4872-a989-04d90520d5ae.Text: "I hope you will agree that a single period of downtime is a small price to pay for the number of lives that will be saved and the increase in the crew's performance during other such outbreaks in the future. Not to mention the fact that we won't have to waste stimulants due to the afflicted using them as a crutch to offset their limited work capacity."

5b0c224e-4bbf-40fc-8473-14c3c03ce69c.Text: "I wish I could discover the cure by sitting in my office and furrowing my forehead, but reality imposes other demands. Be that as it may, I obey your command and will search for other means to defeat the disease."

d9f84fd7-34d3-4c0f-8408-5334dc8acb76.Text: "Should you require my services, you may find me on the bridge, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

11739b81-176b-40f3-a96a-8c7f1c72325a.Text: "I thank Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} for granting me this opportunity." {n}A touch of warmth enlivens Forius's dispassionate voice.{/n} "Trust me, I am the healer who will live up to your expectations. Should you require my services, you may find me on the bridge."

0ecbfca8-11d3-4889-ad56-6b978366fc1b.Text: {n}You hear the dry voice of Jocasta Sauerback over the vox:{/n} "Lord Captain, we've caught the miscreant. Under normal circumstances, he would already have been executed and I would have been reporting about the end of the investigation, but I believe his confession may be of interest to you. It's best that you hear from the culprit himself — I will await your arrival at the investigation headquarters on the officers' deck."

585f01c5-efc8-4e07-86e4-0f4eb16cbff2.Text: "What do you think these 'three sorrowful phalanges' represent?"

03fb3244-3955-4545-9a9f-5607b55da7f9.Text: "Are you telling me that the von Valancius dynasty has been transporting genetic aberrations across the Expanse?"

3322bda6-cf7f-4915-92fb-065f0fde2600.Text: "Where did this Finger of Sorrow come from?"

e4f5360d-2be6-44c2-9f1e-0e42a08bc25e.Text: "I wish to locate the wreck and investigate it."

4f5c3d7b-2e95-4948-86f3-38a293df1a2e.Text: "Some things are best left forgotten. Erase the data on the Finger of Sorrow from the ship's log."

c981151e-2f3b-4a1a-a5c8-3a994edcf6ea.Text: "Lord Captain, I have made an important discovery! When you destroyed the creature the mutants called the Sire, I felt it was my duty to investigate how the abomination had found its way onto our ship. Digging through old inventories and archives of trade transactions, I latched onto a single name, 'Finger of Sorrow.' More than two centuries ago, the drifting hulk of this vessel was discovered by Lady Theodora's predecessor. It was a lost merchant ship with a hold full of cargo."

a76a29db-f1d8-4497-8e5c-c6f08a43ac02.Text: "I was reminded of the 'three sorrowful phalanges' mentioned by the twisted creatures. I dare theorise that this image hearkens back to the name of the ship woven into the heretics' beliefs. A third of the goods taken from the Finger of Sorrow were sold to the Drusian mission on Footfall for the needs of a colonisation ark, the Wasteland Wayfarer, bound for the world of Jesevon."

443f8461-95a7-446f-8d69-6ef08ee0e021.Text: "A third was taken to hive Scipione 84-249 on Dargonus, where a mutiny broke out later, and the final third was left on the flagship. Surely you can see where I am going with this? Centuries later, a cult of mutants emerged in every single location the shipments were delivered to."

fc41dd62-44da-4309-adc9-329fbb5d6a65.Text: "Purely out of ignorance. The creatures probably lurked in the cargo and no one discovered them, or perhaps... We know these things can take over minds. They could have dominated anyone who stumbled upon their nest."

664412d7-cfc6-4d75-bbc8-cb0d88efac23.Text: "It arrived in the Expanse from somewhere in the {g|Encyclopedia:CalixisGlossary}Calixis Sector{/g}. More precise information may be contained in the dead vessel's log, but I do not have it in my possession."

c93cbc8d-9bfa-4c2f-9cce-636bbb9e16e3.Text: "As you wish, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Nothing must compromise the good name of the dynasty."

5340179f-3fd8-4aca-aa1e-fc9ca60b8943.Text: "The coordinates have already been entered into the logbook, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

d5f79616-f30b-4ebb-aee5-0de56706be56.Text: "I assume they symbolise the three branches of the cult. The Nourishers, the Ravenous Star, and the unnamed cult from Scipione. At least I pray to the Emperor that there are only three..."

9e180afc-a9de-4212-88d1-fb78b3e7bb29.Text: "Lord Captain, I must inform you that Mistress Kibellah has made her way to your chambers and relieved the bodyguards stationed there. Perhaps she wishes to have a conversation in private."

d829470f-384b-411c-b879-2ce2680ab87e.Text: "Lord Captain, the ship's senior officers request an audience with you. They are humbly awaiting you on the bridge."

37b14000-fa1a-469e-8dd7-65a95ff2328c.Text: "I know just how to handle this cult."

a74d619a-7aae-417d-889c-5dda79279ab0.Text: "If my Infernus Master says they are a danger to the ship, then I am convinced. Disperse the troublemakers."

4feef3f2-e752-4e9c-80c1-263598470d65.Text: "Infernus Master? We have not yet been introduced."

fcd37247-563e-4c47-8bad-7822a2b41964.Text: "Describe the problem to me in detail."

bda816d7-4b92-4093-a4d2-259f30e0249d.Text: "Master-at-Arms. I do not believe we have met."

f875e8b3-a0a0-46be-992c-315178004f3c.Text: "Does the Ecclesiarchy recognise this cult or is it considered heretical?"

be7605ef-fbeb-4fb9-aa67-18fba903fb4f.Text: "Does this Oracle of Fire really make prophecies?"

97804000-61ee-441f-af1f-fbbb1d1a7bdf.Text: "Choirmaster Weisz, you and I have not yet had the pleasure of conversing."

59f71d26-17bc-4289-aba3-bbf5d5dccb30.Text: "I see nothing wrong with this cult. They may continue their prayers, provided they remain careful around fire."

d9d916b8-9275-404e-a707-9eeabd32f41a.Text: "Master-at-Arms, I order you to disperse the fire worshippers. This cult is suspicious."

17b47fc9-4a8b-4a17-a030-7c30d1fca381.Text: "The Oracle's visions may prove useful to us. We will not let the law stand in our way. Do keep an eye on him, Weisz."

7ab97e4c-e6f4-4d1e-a56b-6ae69166f3f0.Text: "Throw the Oracle into a holding cell and hand him over to the authorities at the first port we visit."

81174f19-0ee1-445a-9a15-64745a6ff51e.Text: "Throw this prophet out of the airlock."

bb5734c6-b40a-4208-ae49-ffe499ea625e.Text: "Since Confessor Adalbert and Mistress Sauerback have both attested that those people are obedient and free of fault, I will not ban their teaching."

00985e36-0d99-497d-8ee0-e76b067009ce.Text: "I should point out that there have been no incidents in the fuel compartment so far, and that the beliefs of this sect do not affect the obedience of the workers or their efficiency in any way. All assemblies are conducted strictly after hours with the permission of their superiors. However, if you find their practices unacceptable, we will put a stop to them immediately."

6b8f4b62-5e71-45ae-8325-b41effe5ffac.Text: "Lord Captain, if I may request your attention for a moment, I must report a series of highly dangerous violations that have taken place in the fuel compartment. The Master-at-Arms is ignoring my demands and I am thus forced to appeal directly to you!"

99ce9cf0-af8e-4918-98cf-04947371e743.Text: "The amount of residue accumulated in the drainage tanks was so laughably small that it was not even worth recording. If there were any real misappropriation of the ship's resources happening here, I would have already punished those involved, Lord Captain." {n}The last sentence carries a faint note of regret.{/n}

f279f0d7-37d7-437f-94a6-9ff5bcda74f9.Text: "My apologies for that omission, Lord Captain. I am Einrich Monteg, head of the Infernus Guild. I am responsible for preventing and extinguishing fires, as well as handling any emergency situations."

6829e633-7ceb-4b5e-ab56-729316b4bdce.Text: "Indeed, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Jocasta Sauerback, at your service. I am entrusted with the honour of commanding the enforcers and keeping order aboard this vessel. It is my duty to punish trespassers, suppress disobedience, and repel any and all attacks on the ship."

83f9ee27-0490-4ad5-bba8-e01aff5e74cf.Text: "This matter is beyond my purview. Let Confessor Adalbert be the judge of such business."

c18201b2-336c-40c8-a609-6abe00b9c9d8.Text: "I am pleased to make your acquaintance, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. As a humble servant of the Emperor, I am entrusted with the high honour of being the ship's confessor, or, in other words, the highest spiritual authority on your vessel. I am here to oversee the purity of the crew's faith. I officiate in the officers' chapel and also look after the ship's reliquary."

dfb182ed-79df-49a0-8521-da97ce64aac6.Text: "At least he and his flock believe that the {g|Encyclopedia:EmperorGlossary}Emperor{/g} reveals glimpses of the possible future to him in the sacred flame. Occasionally, his visions do come true, or so his followers convince themselves. We do not know whether the grace of the God-Emperor truly lies upon him, or if he is merely a charlatan... or perhaps a blissful lunatic, or—"

d366c616-c238-4263-9b97-b4c97b3781cb.Text: "...a wicked rogue who possesses psychic power not tempered by His will." {n}A croaking voice interrupts the confessor's words.{/n} "Lord Captain, as Choirmaster of the {g|Encyclopedia:AstropathGlossary}Astropathic{/g} Choir, I must be watchful of any threats to the ship's safety originating from the Immaterium. I have heard rumours about this Oracle, and so I have sent my adepts to see him. They assert that the man is a {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerGlossary}psyker{/g}."

80f3fc21-5a43-4791-bd0d-fd7c0f85b6cb.Text: "I beg your forgiveness, but I seldom leave the chapel to interfere in the affairs of the ship. My duty requires that I keep constant vigil as I direct the arrival and departure of messages across the boundless void. But, given that this incident had already demanded my interference, I thought it a good opportunity to introduce myself and pay my respects to you."

12175d60-35dd-4569-97b8-02b2454cf5b3.Text: "As you wish, Lord Captain. I will warn my people to be on their guard."

6c49ba6a-96ae-467b-9ccd-aa6f2a804234.Text: "Yes, Lord Captain! By tomorrow, this cult will be forgotten, never to be mentioned again."

73168969-a018-4cc4-a60c-f60dffe6f58a.Text: "This man who speaks to the warp is a danger to himself and to the entire vessel. Both law and common sense dictate that he should be thrown into a holding cell, tranquillised, and handed over to the {g|Encyclopedia:InquisitionGlossary}Inquisition{/g} to be sent to Holy Terra. Alternatively... you may also dispose of him in some other way."

484a9c5b-8f94-4572-b1c7-8cb310c442dd.Text: "This is a dangerous decision, but I will obey the Lord Captain. I will do my utmost to ensure that this cursed soul does not cause a manifestation of the warp, Emperor save us."

8fe31268-6b9d-49d4-83a3-f07828b408bf.Text: "It will be done, Lord Captain. I will see to it that he remains unconscious and his dangerous powers are kept in check. As for the cult, I am sure it will dissolve on its own without its spiritual leader."

bca1aaed-935a-459a-b623-499244fb6e33.Text: {n}A plump, rosy-cheeked old man steps forward, his voice deep and sonorous:{/n} "The Emperor protects, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! I can assure you that there is no heresy festering in the fuel compartment. The Sect of the Fire Prophecies has been tested for purity and found to be in accordance with the Creed. Their leader, who calls himself the Oracle of Fire, is devout and submissive to His servants. They do not twist the sacred teachings, and as for their chosen forms of worship, these are neither rare nor remarkable. Many such minor cults exist in the Imperium with the full approval of the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMinistorumGlossary}Ecclesiarchy{/g}."

f925a7dd-362b-4ca9-999a-d9790f751cd3.Text: "We stand ready to carry out any order."

334139ef-cf60-4f2f-aded-a75b55f3202b.Text: "The fuellers have founded a sect of some kind. This group practises fire worship of the Emperor and has been burning {g|Encyclopedia:Promethium}promethium{/g} near the fuel lines! I beg you to stop this madness before we all go up in flames."

39dc6198-b632-4f13-9c70-d8c693ca6931.Text: "Lord Captain, if it be your wish, we will crack down on any violations of the ship's discipline. However, I dare say that the Infernus Master has no right to command the enforcers, and I find his actions to be an outrageous breach of the chain of command!"

e6d86545-4374-4e6a-86c5-9d809b37c081.Text: "Lord Captain, the plasma drive chambers have been searched and the conspirator apprehended and neutralised. The interrogation will begin shortly, if Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} is ready to attend."

8c51bde3-71ce-4452-a53e-20555b385a19.Text: "Why are you so concerned about this situation?"

5c3494ff-6c0b-4ac3-ad27-2442574127a9.Text: "Very well. I will lead the investigation personally."

813d6934-b020-4985-83b6-cf4f114ef901.Text: "I have no intention of getting involved."

38f5c8d0-326a-4f24-8f50-d79813dc7548.Text: "I will not join the investigation myself, but I will oversee the proceedings."

98164be2-0a15-4a1f-83d3-4fe6160814b3.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, this is Infernus Master Monteg. I urge you to intervene in the so-called 'investigation' that the Master-at-Arms has organised. The enforcers are out of control: they're assaulting people, depriving them of food and water. Your servants are dying for no reason other than Mistress Sauerback's desire to impress you. I'm sure that they wouldn't dare terrorise them in your presence, or at least they would show some restraint!"

0e6c257b-222a-4337-9c37-34ebbd771f23.Text: "Someone has to be. My clan and my family are among the persecuted. I couldn't stand and watch them being tortured, so I mustered the nerve to address you with a request."

67250a4a-0e31-4cce-a475-34ffec592da5.Text: "I thank you on behalf of your people. Please, don't delay."

5d5571e0-2c0d-40c3-babd-aef158631fe9.Text: "I could not ask for more. Please, don't delay."

6ec57a2f-2b6d-4735-8e1a-e3cc925f3204.Text: "A pity. Then I will do what I can on my own."

746dfef3-124c-4188-a61c-d2e06a9a0dbb.Text: Request information about the foundry bay.

fe3a38ed-1ac3-4272-bbdc-707a61e1be94.Text: Discover the details of the commandant's murder.

479f0a24-251e-42be-b3c5-71d5e717bf18.Text: Sow division among the rabble. Whoever gives up Nemesite will be moved to the middle decks and paid a year's allowance.

3b26d6d4-67fc-4ac3-8246-97a8ac3d5a70.Text: Authorise the Master-at-Arms to punish the foundry workers as she sees fit.

32fc12f9-f549-4df6-ab3a-d100b9db3833.Text: Calmed the unrest on the lower decks by providing the people with medicine and supplies.

6cc8cae4-3b05-4b09-9ca2-7214ada1906c.Text: Comfort the exhausted people by giving them medicine and supplies.

831b3858-25ec-42ad-a2a8-754b7e8dcb8a.Text: Suppressed the unrest on the lower decks by shutting down life support systems.

ed5ad81d-66ff-4ac8-8117-a062e1823a93.Text: Ruthlessly crush the unrest by shutting down life support systems.

c4d44027-dde0-48d3-85d3-4a09364e4ba7.Text: The Master-at-Arms reports a disturbance in the foundry bay. A certain Nemesite, an avenging figure beloved by lower deck rabble, shot the commandant during a routine medical supply delivery and called on the vessel's serfs to fight for a better life. The rabble immediately plundered the medical storehouse and proceeded to smash other supply stations, slaughtering officers as they went.

2938063d-6caa-40ce-919c-624e1e15c471.Text: It is a place of unbearable heat and poisoned air, where scrap metal is melted down into plates that are later used to repair and refit the hull. There are no critical facilities here, and the bay is fairly easy to isolate. This opens up opportunities for quelling unrest with no casualties among the enforcers.

f0891d1c-3f44-45ae-9c08-63f0f33d1bb3.Text: The Seneschal points out that all Nemesites act in the same fashion: whenever the rabble is feeling oppressed, they step forward, serving as the spark that ignites the fires of sedition. They target the officers most hated by the workers for their strictness and adherence to order, with every murder bringing cheers from the commoners.

abcfd553-2d46-409d-a4f3-e5a954e1150e.Text: The Vox Master shares the rumours about Nemesite that abound on the lower decks. Some say he arises from the blood of oppressed labourers, some, that he is the vessel's spirit of justice. Others still believe he is an immortal hero. Such veneration makes it very difficult to capture the riffraff's champion.

6798971b-fdc1-44c7-a9a0-cdaa576995e2.Text: The unrest has subsided. While the serfs praise the Rogue Trader's generosity, the enforcers gloomily predict that the rabble will simply shed blood even more quickly and willingly the next time they find themselves lacking for something.

aea096f1-0d3a-4db5-a55b-98113f8ba4a9.Text: The people die gruesomely, suffocating in the pitch black and the icy cold. But the harsh lesson has been learned: the survivors bow their heads and return to work without complaint.

c8598ae1-4481-413f-b12f-c5912f1da0b3.Text: Many people betray their relatives and neighbours in hopes for a better life, but there is no true Nemesite among them. The enforcers suppress the divided mob and restore order with ease.

5d6c1906-cae4-4125-9b43-5509b54e650a.Text: Nemesite's reason for the attack had to do with the widow of a respected foreman. She had delayed the queue by begging to be given medicine for her afflicted children, which the commandant refused because her request exceeded the expenditure quota. The widow persisted and was given ten lashes on the spot. That was when Nemesite fired the fatal shot that set off a mutiny in the compartment.

7c24507b-e64d-4722-a14d-ab59ff0d0dca.Text: The Master-at-Arms reports that this is the fourth Nemesite to operate on the lower decks over the past few years. The previous three were captured by enforcers, and each openly identified themselves as Nemesite. The public executions evidently have no effect: people continue to rally around their hero as soon as one emerges and always believe in the invulnerability of their champion.

8a01657a-11c7-4fd8-9f25-d11747c2d28c.Text: Nemesite has escaped, and the situation on the deck is increasingly spinning out of control. The Master-at-Arms asks permission to employ the harshest possible treatment, not simply to restore order, but to avenge the dead commandant as well as the fallen enforcers.

5d425bc7-b71c-4c7b-8339-1ad66a1d4e03.Text: The punitive squads act with the utmost brutality, breaking the will of the workers. The disfigured corpses of entire families serve as a long-lasting reminder of the inevitability of punishment.

2fbf02ef-c174-4c59-be98-64d7427501e9.Text: The instigator fuelled the mob's anger with outrageous but regrettably popular stories about the Rogue Trader's allegedly {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Shame}reprehensible{/d} character. As a result, a certain vile epithet has spread rapidly throughout the voidship: the Dynasty's Pustule.

b0e4db49-3b36-4b56-8fbf-63996c8379f2.Text: In light of the discovery of a Genestealer Cult cell on the ship, Heinrix van Calox recommends paying special attention to the Nemesite story. The Interrogator suspects that an escaped mutant is behind the incitement to revolt — it is too similar to one of the tactics employed by these enemies of Humanity.

80d2670d-7518-4faa-8340-9926cad1c78c.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, Lady Vyatt has come aboard. She has brought along some manner of manuscripts and is taking the liberty to add symbols from them to our protective hexagrams. The governor appears to have... a fair deal of confidence in her powers."

ea30f890-7b82-4ec4-ac5c-204ccdb1615e.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, Master Herimon succeeded in his escape and has arrived on board. He has almost completed the ritual of harmonisation with the rest of the Choir, which has given our voices greater strength and cohesion."

7cb9f63e-084b-4743-920a-af67a8d19d23.Text: "We have made our preparations and are awaiting your arrival to start the ritual as soon as you give the order."

3c86a60c-ed26-4090-a3c3-1515b10aa9f3.Text: "Lord Captain! Multiple critical systems are failing throughout the vessel, half the compartments are no longer responding — the ship is falling apart! We request Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}'s presence on the bridge immediately."

972ccdb6-a0ca-4d87-941b-38d015e753d1.Text: "Come, and you will see. I do not wish to speak of the mysteries of the Bloodspun Web over the vox. This knowledge is not meant for the ears of the uninitiated."

ff4efbc6-468b-4b4d-a1ec-75fa3142451f.Text: "I have more important matters to attend to at the moment."

8279f0f7-14ab-4f75-a788-8d30a9b0bf27.Text: "I do not think we have been introduced."

f762a6fa-4018-4b0d-a449-91096a37a056.Text: "If the scream stops, will we be able to contact someone?"

3e7abca0-6fa9-402d-b49c-b7bc94e00414.Text: "We are going to pay a visit to that station."

7e06faca-c493-44bd-af8e-875e005786e3.Text: "What is the nature of this scream?"

143171b0-0c63-4432-b5c2-d85fea6d3282.Text: "Lord Captain, {g|Encyclopedia:AstropathGlossary}Astropathic{/g} Choirmaster Zacchary Weisz is asking to speak to you via a private channel."

877323a9-5668-4a87-9b5a-47baa0d22d45.Text: "Greetings, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I can report that the Choir is listening tirelessly to the {g|Encyclopedia:WarpGlossary}Immaterium{/g} in the hope of picking up voices from the dynasty's ships or worlds. However, we have heard something... horrifying instead. Amid the Immaterium's tumult, something... is screaming. This scream is driving your Choir mad. Until it stops, we have no hope of contacting any of the dynasty's worlds. It is coming from the Rykad System's Astropathic station."

71f5512c-81e3-4c83-91d7-7f087fa1591f.Text: "I humbly hope so, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Perhaps we will manage to send a call for aid to the von Valancius worlds or one of the dynasty's allies."

d5960c05-360d-45ad-89f8-0f8ea8f53421.Text: "Indeed not, and we meet under lamentable circumstances. My name is Zacchary Weisz and I am proud to be the Choirmaster of your ship's Astropathic Choir. The duty I perform is to keep you in contact with the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanseGlossary}Expanse{/g} via Astropathic messages sent through the warp by trained psykers."

fa3f72f1-f44a-4d0e-b552-8f9410346244.Text: "We do not know, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, but... it has brought the Immaterium to a boil. It has always been a violent, roaring ocean that could spell doom to any who would consider stepping into its waters. Now, however, it has become a cradle of madness where expelled images fuse together, twisting and cackling, before crashing into the minds of all who perceive it. A mighty {g|Encyclopedia:CicatrixMaledictumGlossary}warp storm{/g} the likes of which I cannot recall rages in the Empyrean, and it fills me with terror."

aa85fde5-9d50-4ab6-88b9-c55766eee015.Text: The body was mutilated to hide the cause of death.

cd0ff957-cb1d-487a-848a-34e348e2980c.Text: A bloody synth-coat was found near the scene. It is a standard part of the enforcer's uniform.

03028a4d-d316-4153-9b7f-68305ab81f8d.Text: Someone deliberately sabotaged the master cogitator in an attempt to conceal the work logs.

c3dd662a-74c0-4e52-902f-4d296a180d1b.Text: The fake cultist Yart claims that he was forced to incriminate himself by Captain Jinevri.

d785887d-1eed-420b-982e-2499a5ebd63e.Text: An enforcer beat the fake cultist before the interrogation, losing an expensive ring on their finger in the process.

c8f309ff-0f2b-4ca7-82d4-15d7574dfe50.Text: There was an old cache marked with a suspicious symbol. It is worth asking Nije the shift foreman about it.

e4d9e406-fe86-44c6-903a-4a9662f8f939.Text: The cache contained a cryptic note. Nije the shift foreman might be able to help with deciphering its meaning.

94ecf24c-78fb-4994-8f28-fc90e8fb7e5c.Text: Find a way to open the door

4db7b5d3-8d46-4f25-b365-4ebdd8a47d44.Text: A strange weapon was hidden in the cache. The shift foreman should take a look at it.

041f7640-e186-4cac-a4f4-b241f3f10d17.Text: The conspiracy of abominable genetic aberrations has been exposed and reduced to dust.

691b25cf-e74f-434b-b247-0dcf6b54c5e4.Text: A brazen attempt on the Rogue Trader's life took place in {mf|his|her} own bathchamber — someone filled the bathtub with blood. The culprit must be found.

5c27f2a0-43c3-461a-8ca1-1c942d859e3f.Text: The Rogue Trader has tasked {mf|his|her} subjects with conducting a search of the plasma drive chambers. All that remains is to wait for the report.

c9c3246d-714c-4c7c-9bf7-591e602f8cb7.Text: Wait for the results of the search

24a5ab28-9efe-4540-80da-a26c682e5098.Text: The traitors could have left behind evidence in this compartment.

495cb642-2e58-488e-bd86-d2219a218729.Text: The Rogue Trader must be present during the interrogation of the apprehended conspirator, which is to be conducted in the same place where he was arrested — in the plasma drive chambers.

a8d903c1-562c-46ad-bbe5-b09ba75de42e.Text: The Infernus Master will provide people for an ambush next to a stash the Lord Captain discovered.

0b559194-63c3-4709-ae7d-a681a105b865.Text: The conspirator has confessed that his accomplices are hiding in the dynastic crypt. Only the Lord Captain can unseal that hallowed place for the enforcers.

3ae075d7-bb48-4627-8d98-04fde8619fa2.Text: The traitors are hiding in the darkness. It is time to search the crypt.
