822b5f42-1e21-4382-b441-d4064f63ab6e.Text: The sinister figure from the vision has revealed itself. The mutant must be destroyed and the strange cult eradicated.

481bc577-4f9b-441c-ab85-4cd0917ae3bf.Text: Kill the leader of the aberrations

86ada8ce-f22b-42c6-8519-e5075b5379fe.Text: The Rogue Trader has seen fit to lead the search for the culprit, starting with visiting the officers' deck and receiving the enforcers' reports.

0e7319eb-846d-4f73-9773-3ca438b31e84.Text: The Rogue Trader has seen fit to observe {mf|his|her} enforcers at work and grace the investigation with {mf|his|her} presence on the officers' deck.

72b8303c-02ff-4017-bae9-adbf2fdb9702.Text: The Rogue Trader has tasked {mf|his|her} enforcers with finding the culprit. All {mf|he|she} has to do now is wait for a report from the Master-at-Arms.

26bb91d1-ad55-46a1-bf5e-796d596f2480.Text: Wait for the results of the investigation

843ba6ef-9c4e-4338-b637-a1185203be05.Text: The enforcers have discovered a desiccated corpse on a suspended platform not far from the room with the armillary sphere. The first step in the investigation is to examine it.

91cf4d28-82ef-4160-b2ae-94fa427ea767.Text: A personal number has been discovered on the corpse. The master cogitator in the maintenance room can shed some light on the victim's identity.

25e58efe-4e60-4845-9fd0-2a80588f688a.Text: Check the logs of the master cogitator

c10ac65b-9d77-4515-8475-2fef54f52478.Text: Receive the report on the master cogitator's logs

3bd8ec8e-6f06-4b49-adf6-c08bf3f6b10c.Text: On the day he died, the victim was working together with his partner Gwedon. This Gwedon is likely being held in custody in the main hall not far from the armillary sphere, along with the other arrestees under Captain Hrotko's watch.

250ec1ca-eef1-4358-bca1-f7a80930b8ab.Text: The Master-at-Arms has taken matters into her own hands. She will find the suspect, Gwedon, so that the Rogue Trader may receive his confession. The investigation will conclude where it began — in the mess hall of the officers' deck.

132f96fc-cd74-4d79-9375-a448dbf8b34b.Text: Conclude the investigation in the mess hall on the officers' deck

65c1d8e8-10e5-47bc-8b76-c838b3299077.Text: Choirmaster Weisz is a powerful telepath who can track down the conspirators by following the dark traces of their traitorous thoughts. The Lord Captain can find him at the Astropathic Chapel.

0da1096d-b44a-483f-a6b1-7d771e964688.Text: The Choirmaster insists on having a powerful telepath protect him during the ritual. The Rogue Trader must decide who should offer Master Weisz their services.

e6380f96-63e4-4d4e-8f97-31d996be56f9.Text: Assign a psyker to ensure the safety of the ritual

7ce96106-7a46-4837-a214-7430a30fe8e7.Text: The specialist required for the ritual will soon arrive on board. Until then, the Rogue Trader has time to attend to other matters.

1b4a779b-bc8e-4dc1-a6c6-768c5863684e.Text: Wait for the psyker to arrive

c352bb9a-867e-40e0-bd6c-0e26852d865a.Text: The Choirmaster is ready to begin the ritual. The time has come for the Rogue Trader to see the faces of {mf|his|her} enemies.

a59d7e48-abe1-464a-a7bb-c32dadfada41.Text: The ritual has gone awry, just as Zacchary Weisz predicted. The Choirmaster must be protected at any cost, or else all are doomed.

4c2fe40e-8bd1-4ea5-a5f2-7d6782adc940.Text: The Choirmaster's visions have shown that corruption lurks in the ship's plasma drive chambers.

d81f99db-f4a7-4e27-9d12-861bc9f1ab19.Text: The lives of even the lowliest among the Lord Captain's servants are no longer a mystery to {mf|him|her}.

648dcfa9-22b4-4768-96dc-cf04da4aee99.Text: The Rogue Trader has decided to get a first-hand view of {mf|his|her} subjects' daily life on the freight line. That will involve visiting even the darkest corners of the bay.

65c3118b-74a8-4a51-93ef-8ec857ed20c1.Text: Enforcers and traffic controllers are the bay's most privileged workers. Are their lives different from what the Rogue Trader has seen on the upper decks?

2f879ad3-c546-41e6-830e-2bd6d2b82058.Text: The transport network station is the reason this bay exists. Its beating heart.

f10f4ead-ac49-4a04-828c-bc301b92d587.Text: The forlorn dwellings of the bay's inhabitants should be near the freight line station. That is where one can get a glimpse of an ordinary serf's life.

a4d2aa15-25f0-4f27-b67c-c28bc412bdab.Text: Every society breeds its outcasts and misfits. Seeing their miserable existence first-hand is essential for completing the picture of life in this bay.

a85b1edd-0c6b-4e4f-977b-9985791a9933.Text: The Rogue Trader has seen enough. Time to tell Captain Frensoe what this bay's future will be.

1a350100-7be7-4d3d-81e3-edf0100e80ad.Text: Leave your mark on life in this bay

2b496164-2832-42ef-9361-f172ea21e834.Text: The death cultists have pointed out where on the lower decks the path of the Matriarch Spider began — the freight line. Thus, it must likewise serve as the starting point on the Lord Captain's journey to the temple of death.

5db72c81-be9a-4fbb-8d93-7585b0cc3fb8.Text: The blood marks left by the cultists conceal the verses of the Song of Trailing Blood, which chronicles the path walked by the Matriarch Spider. The Lord Captain has decided to follow the symbols and see where they lead.

7861b9a4-cbbe-4606-a421-bec50333af96.Text: The Lord Captain is facing a difficult choice: to take the final step and become the blood of the flagship, or to abandon the path of the Matriarch Spider and {mf|his|her} own search for the temple.

69d8fcf8-78ab-45db-8f3d-f68d6e72062b.Text: Plunge into the ventilation shaft and become the flagship's blood

21946a33-e3d2-4c0f-99eb-a5519ece84b6.Text:
"The soundless shadow sank into the dark.
Slashed feet crescendo, a fatal dance:
bladesong in tempo, each edge an echo,
twin odes to death throes.
Now on her sacred blood,
as she once trod the backs of foes,
tread countless souls, but none who know."

8b364702-9002-4179-8daf-28f998267584.Text:
"To soot-smirched soul her mercy she did grant.
Last breath expressed, knife met heart:
removed from chest, passed on to death.
Her duty blessed, a balm for those
who suffer anguish and distress.
A longing brought to rest:
of mortal bonds the soul divest."

a669b97b-6080-4b3e-83c1-aefc878ee944.Text:
"But some would choose to leave the righteous path.
These earned penance in due time:
her whip sings vengeance on renegade menace.
Her blades pass sentence.
For cowards seek to hide their hearts,
but death makes no pretendence;
it takes what it is due in essence."

a52c6043-0038-4921-b431-c9ebc89ce8dc.Text:
"She wandered an eternity in dark,
yet was consoled. Web foretold:
Undying One's blood-secrets glowed,
a light to guide her faithful fold.
But threads must end. And so the spider
did that which was owed:
her life and death to ship bestowed..."

83de346f-7c5b-4beb-8945-d55f80932401.Text: The Rogue Trader has followed the trail of the Bloodspun Web's first assassin and has become the flagship's blood that runs through the iron veins of its bays.

9299bb75-b011-4375-94be-f4db8137d679.Text: The Vizsier of the Bloodspun Web has invited the Rogue Trader to visit the cult's temple, which lies somewhere in the depths of the voidship. However, the hallowed cradle of death will only reveal itself to one who has walked in the footsteps of Saint Erianne, the Matriarch Spider.

2cc5df7b-2c02-4849-874e-824b924d0231.Text: The pirate station has been cleansed with plasteel and promethium.

fab60d4a-4000-4b95-b52d-5439bd4e99d4.Text: The leader of the genetic aberrations who infested the dynasty's flagship has confessed that the despicable mutants had used the Heriokh's Rim trading station to launch their infiltration. That lair of corruption must be incinerated.

3800f210-5e56-4a62-aa28-73b348e7202c.Text: The mutants are hiding on an ill-reputed trading outpost.

037c5aaa-c7b7-43a1-a360-919ac8aef6aa.Text: Lay waste to Heriokh's Rim Station

078e1a37-1f40-4f38-b03d-9a2e85504123.Text: Choirmaster Weisz's past had been breathing down his neck until it finally drove the Astropath to the edge of madness, endangering the ship. Now the Astropathic Chapel is operating again.

9212c4e5-d674-4129-a204-b75f5bb72514.Text: The Choirmaster has locked himself inside the Astropathic Chapel and will not let anyone in. The situation must be addressed so that the Choir can resume its work.

9679af45-4e78-4841-ae51-88123bf0f650.Text: Something concerning is happening to the ship's Choirmaster. The Rogue Trader had best find out what.

0e9e5b22-4bd5-413e-a3dc-8e576170e631.Text: The Rogue Trader has pieced together the events of years past and thus has traced Weisz's anguish to its phantasmal source.

6d13d6e4-5811-46bb-a3ee-4ff7bba4935f.Text: Something from beyond this world is lurking in the chapel, twisting the Choirmaster's mind. The Rogue Trader must find a way to uncover this entity.

18de3242-d4a1-4d69-a8bb-80d64d41bb85.Text: Find the intruding entity in the chapel

9f9e28a4-0d0e-4ef9-8aff-d4fb7231b910.Text: Choirmaster Weisz owes the Rogue Trader a confession.

efcd3c27-d11c-4815-91b9-68ceb41e9c9c.Text: There should be an undamaged vox-station somewhere near the lift shaft. It is the only chance of re-establishing contact with the crew.

e18e0e99-9180-43bc-906f-f9663c98024a.Text: The monstrous Sire, Patriarch of the Cult of the Ravenous Star, is defeated, and his Congregation has been vanquished once and for all.

67de2022-ee5f-493f-a6e4-53e92e32cb60.Text: A series of disasters has rocked the voidship, and most of its vital systems have failed. The Rogue Trader must find the cause of the accidents and save the vessel.

3f3a763f-d290-48b0-9db0-b12c3fda9d8b.Text: It is too risky to stay on the bridge. An emergency headquarters will be set up on the officers' deck, from which the Rogue Trader can then lead the rescue operation.

d933aa4d-896f-4862-82e2-2d7c19c6f689.Text: Go down to the officers' deck

31c2ca01-e52d-4d9e-aacd-924fa137f32b.Text: The elevator has crashed into the lower compartments. The Rogue Trader must find help and escape the disaster zone.

0a4cce11-85dd-405b-87e6-2ae32ed701a3.Text: There must be a working vox-station at the enforcer post. The Rogue Trader needs to reach it and contact the loyal officers.

52c9b244-30c7-41de-92f6-ce1bc3421904.Text: Break through to the enforcer post

fc1c24e1-4fcc-4ff7-b3e1-da330ff2eaa2.Text: The bridge has been captured by the Sire, leader of the Cult of the Ravenous Star. No matter who or what he is, this menace must be destroyed.

58818bc1-1bda-480a-a140-27c15a053eba.Text: The Cult of the Nourishers, tainted with genetic corruption, was discovered on the planet Jesevon.

a99da1d1-93c1-469c-a427-60bcff5cefd1.Text: The Cult of the Ravenous Star was eliminated on the dynasty's flagship.

07f30060-0eb2-4170-9444-c2af9ada9c18.Text: A Genestealer Cult was behind the rebellion on the capital world of Dargonus.

5b33cb69-d400-41cb-aeeb-e995419a77dc.Text: The Finger of Sorrow was broken, its centuries-long voyage finished at last.

c599014b-7725-48c5-8637-f502297d8449.Text: The corruption of hidden Genestealer Cults has permeated the Koronus Expanse. This contagion is a danger to all worlds, so its source must be discovered.

a72d2dce-cc9e-43f8-8b7b-e3cf5c91f3a7.Text: The corruption of genetic aberrations could have spread across many worlds and ships. Each case of contamination must be documented.

eafcbcef-424b-4b78-b4f5-3a44af6ea83d.Text: Find the traces of the Genestealer Cults

44cd6bb4-34f0-458c-ab0e-c9057c1caefb.Text: The High Factotum has deduced how the Genestealers originally arrived in the Expanse. If his theory is correct, the Rogue Trader will find evidence inside the drifting remains of the merchant ship Finger of Sorrow.

37014716-2566-438e-a3d5-1a3d431de0ea.Text: Inspect the wreck of the Finger of Sorrow

42f1cc09-2d9e-4b9c-8325-4748a88f8182.Text: "Who are you and what do you do here?"

c8a58e79-8095-407e-a0f2-9ca1a9ea287f.Text: "Is there a way to find out who made which confession?"

588e1284-d02e-43d9-a407-8aaa538c638b.Text: "What makes you think these confessions were made by senior officers?"

375cce74-d76b-4950-a1dc-69f44b426ff5.Text: "I am curious to know who left these confessions. I will seek them out."

80fff378-ec64-439a-90ea-e7f49f8800b5.Text: "I have found the sources of the confessions. You have nothing to worry about now."

33a2ba86-b4ff-444b-b0cf-6dfa4e74c543.Text: "I will leave you to your concerns."

112b95ab-2ea7-4738-82ef-2c2a1bf743f3.Text: Poured the truth of sins and crimes into the confession machine under the cloak of anonymity.

832ec9e2-262b-4b58-97a9-02d8ab9d2684.Text: [Tell the machine the truth about your heinous deeds] "Leave me, servant. I need to confess."

330d0739-f568-4d45-b29c-f9a756fc7567.Text: "No more anonymity, but keep this change under wraps. Establish a confession quota. If there is a decline in the number of confessions, the crew will face disciplinary measures."

97a371d8-5642-4485-9957-2ff49d7f599d.Text: "Good thinking, making it anonymous. Keep up the fine work."

232f9ebf-ecec-4322-8327-bfb5a54bfa90.Text: {n}A lanky initiate is leaning over the {g|Encyclopedia:Cogitator}cogitator{/g}, an expression of extreme mental effort on his face, his fishlike round eyes peering into the screen.{/n} "Grant me understanding, {g|Encyclopedia:EmperorGlossary}Master{/g}, grant me wisdom..." {n}He winces as you approach.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}? How can I be of service?"

12f6032f-0454-4874-9c04-6ec5f8009faa.Text: "Have you come up with something, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}?"

4b7bd432-b6f6-48e8-89ae-31cb80cb2363.Text: "I am Klotus, junior cleric. I sort recordings from the shrine confessional to pass on to higher-ranking clergy."

de06e8a8-25b8-432e-be54-5fc52981c646.Text: "Our parishioners come here to repent, to share their innermost thoughts and observations of their neighbours. The sacred machine records all confessions and alters the voices beyond recognition."

14c745d1-73cc-431c-81af-3acd9c7f18a1.Text: "There is not." {n}Klotus shakes his head resolutely.{/n} "That would undermine the usefulness of it. The first prototype wasn't anonymous, so those confessions might as well have been carbon copies of each other. Everyone was impeccably diligent and pious and whatnot. But as soon as the {g|Encyclopedia:MachineSpirit}machine spirit{/g} started keeping the names secret, the parishioners opened up."

20a02e41-e253-4761-9532-47a44bba7b9b.Text: "Nothing escapes Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}'s notice. As it so happens, I am struggling to categorise three rather peculiar confessions. I wouldn't have dared tell you about them, but, I think, they may have been left by senior officers. Which would make this a matter of the highest order, one that is far beyond my meagre understanding."

4a564f99-90bd-4e90-85e2-04b8d5945092.Text: {n}The initiate steps aside, putting the cogitator at your disposal.{/n}

e134bacd-3585-4064-9ce3-8f8833332184.Text: "These parishioners are well-spoken, meaning they are used to addressing an audience. Perhaps they issue orders and are vested with power. And, well, after categorising so many confessions, I have learned to notice the subtle differences between them."

f1657868-818b-4099-9949-35d52aba7925.Text: "One question has troubled me for years: why are some destined to perish in the {g|Encyclopedia:WarpGlossary}warp{/g} while others must go on living and preserve the memory of the dead? Worthier and more luminous souls have been lost, and yet I am still here..." {n}Light static is distorting the recording, but you are confident that the speaker is male.{/n}

f3bdf085-5457-41c2-992e-a3d78dc2523d.Text: "The orphans on the ship have already been provided with the bare essentials, but every so often I consider increasing their rations and ordering more sets of clothes for them. That will not replace the families they lost, but it will improve their lives somewhat, especially given that the ship has enough resources to cover that comparably trivial expense." {n}Despite the poor sound quality, you determine the voice to be male.{/n}

e05c6e9f-193a-460c-8830-d1c1dbd71516.Text: "Lop-eared kleppas display a high degree of socialisation both among their kind and toward their owners. These animals adjust well to a voidship's lower gravity, since it is similar to their homeworld's conditions. Lop-eared kleppa meat is edible, should necessity demand it." {n}The voice sounds muffled, as though from behind a thick layer of glass, but is unmistakably a woman's.{/n}

b069f4c9-91b2-4bbe-88e9-ee9915e7134d.Text: "I suppose those confessions truly are special if Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} is giving them {mf|his|her} personal attention." {n}The initiate bows deeply.{/n} "Never would I have imagined the {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTraderGlossary}Rogue Trader{/g} {mf|him|her}self coming to my aid."

160c3130-174f-4368-b7f9-6ba36d237b16.Text: "Nothing indeed! I will pass the confessions on with a note regarding your personal involvement." {n}The initiate looks at you with equal parts astonishment and admiration.{/n} "May the Emperor protect Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"

6a4c2fe2-4800-46c2-ade0-1ea45aa01f1f.Text: {n}The initiate replies very solemnly,{/n} "I labour for the glory of the Emperor and House von Valancius."

f9bd55e1-b3fe-456b-a198-39d7e97e13e6.Text: {n}The initiate looks at you, intrigued, but does not say a word.{/n}

d65fe37c-9d32-4385-a366-f24fd616fcad.Text: {n}The initiate leaves you alone with the machine. You pour out all your unholy secrets and dark desires onto the hapless mechanism, describing your profane accomplishments in great detail. After the confession, not a trace of guilt or shame remains — only a satisfying sense of impunity.{/n}

6a9cb021-e7ba-4b53-a161-3a499fb508a1.Text: {n}The initiate blinks in surprise.{/n} "As Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} wishes... I suppose that would be... prudent. I defer to your... {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Commissar}unique experience{/d}."

30b7c6c9-1aec-44a1-a8b7-d50cb7c74184.Text: "I will endeavour to do so, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

30227587-16bb-4a91-a4f2-b908540b1687.Text: "These confessions, you see, are far from being examples of pious conformity. I dread the very thought of dissent or heresy poisoning the minds of some of the most eminent members of the crew, but... I cannot change what I heard." {n}He bows his head in reverence.{/n} "I cannot share this with anyone but the Emperor's anointed, nor can I allow anyone but Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} to listen to these messages protected by the secrecy of confession."

58df15d6-83e5-4be3-9b3e-c35c014c6726.Text: {n}You have heard the bridge officers gossiping that the High Factotum has taken personal charge of the orphans.{/n}

47f0be00-823d-460e-8b65-479726eaaf63.Text: {n}You do not know who on the ship is in charge of the orphans, if anyone.{/n}

d193e824-a065-47fa-bd22-1dc8d0b53e95.Text: Even after death, Rogue Traders of yore and their servants continue to preserve the dynasty by imbuing the relic's bearer with power.

c720d8aa-449c-434c-8062-63b638156a73.Text: A prayer in the voidship's shrine has filled you with righteous fervour. Onward to victory for the glory of the Imperium!

c55f3a84-2623-4b78-add5-6aadd94e0871.Text: "Hold on, Janris! I will not let you die here!"

4a2ebf30-c77e-4d72-b78e-3f1f5d718e43.Text: "How badly is the High Factotum wounded?"

a0bf9032-ec74-4927-90dd-95915d3d1e93.Text: "I will strangle this Nemesite with my own two hands!"

4d34ceb3-5732-490a-b1bb-96690fb4f7b6.Text: "Damn you, Jocasta! How did the renegades manage to sneak all the way to the upper decks?"

6a225c19-376b-4839-9134-bdc9476dcf57.Text: "Nemesite? Yet another spin on that old wives' tale?"

4bbb1381-4df8-4e66-a87b-626f49e3240e.Text: "Why did you wish to see me so urgently?"

18e23dc8-64e5-4c86-9e17-1382534e2629.Text: "I will not forget your courage, my loyal Factotum."

48d4a594-ee6a-4eb0-9437-9738635e154b.Text: "You failed to apprehend either the criminals or the relic. Were you even trying?"

a45498fd-9a62-4823-bc07-6fb41aa0fe74.Text: "I insist. What did he say about me?"

23896ca0-c773-49d5-86ee-f6e713e83def.Text: {n}The High Factotum's velvet coat is streaked with blood, and Janris himself is deathly pale. A medicae officer is working on the black gunshot wound in his chest, and Janris grunts faintly with every touch. He focuses his eyes on you with tremendous effort:{/n} "Forgive me... for not greeting Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} with a bow... I must tell you... Nemesite has stolen the great relic."

aa793027-2c0c-46b6-886a-c9c66bcd8183.Text: "And then he committed sacrilege... by stealing the relic and shattering the sarcophagus! Forgive me, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I have failed to preserve the sacred ashes of your ancestors!"

0ec89cd7-30ee-4d4f-9b7a-52081cd7e6f1.Text: {n}Sauerback mutters through clenched teeth,{/n} "They had help. We have discovered the hidden corpses of several chapel attendants. The traitors took their clothes and led Nemesite and his accomplices straight past the patrols."

bd7f9d16-d5e6-404e-952e-5aa41cac8b47.Text: {n}Confessor Adalbert ruefully shakes his head.{/n} "They were good people, pious people. They never slighted a serf in their lives. Why punish them?" {n}His face grows darker.{/n} "I swear that these innocents will be avenged, may the Emperor be my witness."

46f2cef0-0fd6-4a97-b3cf-86571ac8cd5e.Text: "Proud to serve... the dynasty!" {n}Janris's thoughts are becoming muddled.{/n} "The papers, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Have the clerk double-check the freight bills... I did not have time to get the seals... My will is in the left-hand drawer..."

70f47738-d6ad-4eb0-9e29-9671c08a85fe.Text: "I did not. I was on my way to offer a prayer when I heard gunfire and ran as fast as I could. When I got here, I saw Master Danrok, and... I think the next thing I did was just to press his wound and spout curses." {n}Einrich looks at his bloodied hands in confusion.{/n} "So much for being a heroic repairman. I wasn't much use, was I?"

47e7f431-f9c0-490d-8ced-286f7fffcf79.Text: "Not this time. No one has ever dared to raid the upper decks before. Never in the ship's history has the fury of the rabble been so blind and fierce."

834a1e3b-2405-4470-a063-c0423e7ecb8d.Text: "May the Emperor... protect Your..." {n}The Factotum's eyes roll back as his enormous frame gives a convulsive shudder.{/n}

642baa4c-eb79-4113-84b4-3d6ab1fbf1d6.Text: "Just another arrogant rebel, wrapping himself in a crimson rag and wreaking havoc for the adoration of the commoners."

a3c78204-94d3-45e2-a9dc-125a53a05012.Text: "This old wives' tale was blessed with amazing corporeality... Whoever the bastard in the red scarf was, he went by that name, and spoke very impertinently of Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

a0ee2f46-d3c9-4d09-a7b5-98bf1a9f5208.Text: "He dared to ridicule the way you allegedly tried to {d|Encyclopedia:NemesiteExploitsSmartWay}turn{/d} the commoners of the foundry bay against him... with a bribe. What a despicable character!"

a83a926b-a881-4332-aea3-de0e26bea87a.Text: "He dared to threaten you and promised that for every {d|Encyclopedia:NemesiteExploitsHardWay}dead{/d} serf from the foundry bay, three occupants of the upper decks would perish. Despicable villain!"

e5d595bc-796d-4a4e-8b25-5a2b47daeb7b.Text: {n}The reliquary has been brutally smashed, and the bed on which the sacred ashes of past Rogue Traders and their servants once rested is now empty.{/n}

56165d0d-234f-40b5-b7df-099f04a90ba8.Text: "He dared to mock your generosity and sneeringly thanked you for the supplies you used to {d|Encyclopedia:NemesiteExploitsMercyWay}pacify{/d} the serfs of the foundry bay... The scoundrel boasted that his fighters have made good use of the gifts!"

11ccb5ed-1a4b-4fd6-a9a8-94a1ef6ba9cd.Text: "I beg forgiveness, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}... I dare not repeat this slander."

d46db8d0-a5ae-44af-8eea-fb3bdd72291c.Text: "He called you a ghoul who sits on a throne of bones, feasting on the raw flesh of {mf|his|her} servants... Forgive me, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Merely repeating these foul words is making me ill!"

2c17a4e7-3d3b-4e56-8d7b-a24c9f846940.Text: "I... I had to apologise to you. I had to repent." {n}He grimaces bitterly.{/n} "For many years, I did my best to serve the dynasty, but at the most crucial hour, I failed... Shame scorches my pathetic, cowardly heart, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I had to tell you how deeply remorseful I am."

ba558ae4-d298-40f1-a4c4-62b6bd661576.Text: {n}Kibellah quickly sweeps her gaze over the destruction before focusing on the bloody footprints that stretch from the ruins of the reliquary.{/n}

cbca1d25-d7c5-4419-b541-fa1272a14d5c.Text: {n}Kibellah stands nearby, completely absorbed in the bloody footprints that stretch from the ruins of the reliquary.{/n}

eb92516c-33f9-45a5-9cef-00670bd937f4.Text: {n}The medicae officer snatches a syringe of stimulant and speaks decisively:{/n} "Apologies, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, but we are taking Master Danrok away. He is unable to tell you anything more at present, and every second of delay could cost him his life."

b9b578bd-ef42-47d8-ad31-357756ee8d1e.Text: "He's losing a lot of blood." {n}The medicae officer casts a worried look at you.{/n} "I advise you to hurry. Master Danrok should be on the chirurgeon's table as soon as possible."

4ae82927-9c38-456b-b409-83efabb9cc45.Text: {n}Marazhai observes him with a satisfied smile.{/n} "A stimulating combination of agony and guilt... Keep talking, {name} — I want this bleeding slab of meat to stay conscious."

924516f2-abe4-4fc0-bd2f-a585483e9c5a.Text: {n}The Drukhari's nostrils flare with delight.{/n} "Yes, that's it! Well done, {name}."

1bb3b3bd-b77d-4a6a-ac04-d64f3d09d85e.Text: "Pardon him this failure, Aett-Vater. If the healer cannot save him, then let him go to the Allfather with no burdens. The coffer keeper stood valiantly, willing to offer his life, and it is no fault of his that he was not born a warrior who could bring you the enemy's head."

a474fec3-4c35-4db0-9332-3b0a3d0bc8c6.Text: "Serfs in red headscarves burst into the chapel and started shooting... Their leader made for the relic — the remains of honourable Rogue Traders brought here from the mutant-sullied crypt... And when I realised that the sacred ashes of your ancestors were about to fall into the filthy hands of a heretic... one intent on desecrating the glorious dynasty... No, that could not be allowed to happen! I... blocked his path..." {n}Janris briefly closes his eyes, gathering his strength.{/n} "The bastard allowed himself a few vile insults against me, which I am obliged to omit, but I did not give in to the provocation. I was hoping to buy myself some time."

4326da0a-83db-45f0-ade2-08615f73ad89.Text: {n}The Master-at-Arms is barking orders, Confessor Adalbert is murmuring a prayer, and the Infernus Master is circling the chapel with a keen eye as if watching for a threat.{/n}

4532dd8f-0d95-429d-a1fa-b9fddcbd79ac.Text: "Then this so-called Nemesite started reviling the customs of the ship, berating its officers and enforcers... before insulting the very name of Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} yourself. I threw my glove in his face and demanded a duel, but the honourless villain just shot me. He... laughed at me. The depraved creature." {n}He winces, either from a new burst of pain or from the memory of the humiliation he so recently endured.{/n}

c446603e-47d4-4109-8261-884c449dd033.Text: "Some miracle preserved Master Danrok's life long enough that he might address you. His fate now rests in the hands of the Emperor. May He show mercy to this selfless man."

ab8033fa-54ed-442a-9ecd-11f80e74460f.Text: {n}The Factotum drops his head on his chest, unable to bear the crushing weight of his shame any longer.{/n}

a82c2526-d04a-4290-bcee-79bcda99b205.Text: "The threads of the Bloodspun Web tremble, angered by the deeds of the awakened false champion. The sacred {g|Encyclopedia:ImperialTarotGlossary}Tarot{/g} of the Undying One foretold that he would appear, and so he did. However, now is the time for him to perish, for the Undying One wishes for his thread to be severed. And so, I tread the trail of blood."

72f173f5-b84a-4e16-8ad5-4ba4467458f5.Text: "I am holding on, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Worry not. What matters now is that you recover the relic..." {n}The Factotum groans as the medicae officer pulls the blood-soaked bandages aside and shakes his head dolefully.{/n}

6ffc183b-7677-401f-9fae-0bbde4600f70.Text: An ancient scroll containing a solemn vow of service to the Emperor, penned by an unknown missionary from the words of the great Nadine Aleynikov.

441be127-c939-401c-9ef0-4186676d370f.Text: An extremely heavy power maul. Its handle is covered in litanies of fury spurring the wielder to exterminate the enemies of Humanity without mercy.

ccc737a8-593b-490e-9843-bf83984f4d34.Text: {n}A dazzling young woman presses her hands to her chest rapturously. Her dark eyes glint with maniacal excitement.{/n} "I am elated to behold you, O Great Beacon!"

00470fa5-03f4-4a23-a8e4-3bec6e5b8492.Text: "Your fame grows! I can tell — after all, before I was confined to that monastery, I made some... friends who were very good at procuring all manner of {g|Encyclopedia:KasballicaMissionGlossary}oddities{/g} — remarkable things that people mistakenly brand as forbidden. Shortly after my release, I contacted them to spread the good word about you! Oh, how intrigued they were!"

5968ca86-d9ac-4a97-9a0d-e952873e9cba.Text: "The power of the Warrant has gone to your head, I see. Do not expect the Inquisition to ignore the blasphemous acts you enable here."

bc2f49e7-dcd8-475b-8b0a-d5a8aa6504e5.Text: "What is this filth you have dressed in priest's robes, Aett-Vater? Don't tell me you enjoy listening to her rotten words..." {n}Ulfar snarls.{/n}

18abf86d-0aa8-460c-ba2f-eae4ed2c8416.Text: "Confessor Cecilia, your most devoted servant. My parents threw me into a monastery for showing interest in knowledge that the ignorant see as forbidden. But when you came to power, I knew things were about to change. I prayed to you, and you answered when you sent your people to search for a truly pious soul. They tested me, but it was nothing, for any price is dust compared to the chance to serve you personally."

1f64094a-e43c-4928-b573-34559d4f9130.Text: "It is marvellous! Your people adore and fear you, and all it takes is a little effort to open their eyes to the only truth..." {n}She lowers her voice.{/n} "...that their god is right here, in the flesh."

195e191e-9e9e-4812-9e36-7e5b233058fc.Text: "How do you wish it would change? No, no, there is no need to answer — it is my sacred task to predict your desires."

35e788f2-eae1-40d4-acd4-de417998eb9e.Text: {n}She closes her eyes and says in a breathy, almost sultry voice,{/n} "I will set the minds of your subjects free and shatter the chains of the false faith. Let them witness your glory and offer all their prayers to you."

8dc03dfc-3b69-4916-b13a-c1367ad643f9.Text: {n}Argenta's face is alight with righteous indignation.{/n} "{name}, did you purge this place of heretics only to nurture a new heresy in their place?"

7ef03b5e-ffe6-415a-a9f4-0e906b489bdb.Text: {n}The man raises his head, and you see a face covered in scars that form a holy {g|Encyclopedia:Aquila}Aquila{/g}. A rustling voice speaks,{/n} "I am here to serve, Domin'{name}."

29488e42-db2c-406b-af24-6874c1ad75c0.Text: "I used to mentor the Web's disciples. Now I mentor laypeople. It is... different. More unsettling. But it is a beautiful dance still."

b2923cfc-f1db-4fba-af01-dc982948dcb9.Text: "The flock... is afraid. I will help them to see the Undying Emperor. Those who behold Him are no longer afraid. They will recognise Him in self-denial and servitude, and they will expel weakness through sacraments of pain. Through purifying ascesis and sacrificial bloodletting, they will be saved and renewed as His servants who are without doubt. His servants... and yours, Domin'{name}."

77fe9e54-1240-46cf-bc7c-8ecd55d4e279.Text: {n}He nods slowly.{/n} "They call me Confessor Tercitius. I have left the cloister of the Bloodspun Web and now reside here. I teach the Tenets of the Web to the laity."

f7fb0ae7-0211-4707-b7cd-bb177531d501.Text: "The word of the Undying One travels around the flagship... and beyond. Many pirates who live off plunder and murder are deaf to the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMinistorumGlossary}Ecclesiarchy{/g}'s sermons. Our teaching is easier for them to understand. Much like the pirates themselves, it is forged in blood and violence. The Bloodspun Web has told them of you and your devotion to Him." {n}He bows his head.{/n} "We honour the Domin."

2c63c3da-60bc-44c8-ace4-279a40d42adc.Text: {n}The bones adorning the confessor's armour glitter with gold, as does the blood-filled chalice that he is holding.{/n} "Blessed are your steps, Domin'{name}."

915291c0-1025-4676-b11e-b27a159af797.Text: "The Vizsier has {d|Encyclopedia:CompKibellah_Distortion}elevated{/d} the Bloodspun Web, and now it is the laypeople's duty to pay their guides, be it in respect, gold, or blood. Our flock trembles, for we are death."

6ff67ad9-c5a9-4882-8254-92009a020e84.Text: "Never before has our teaching guided laypeople, Domin. It is a revelation meant for His chosen spinners. But now, a new thread of the Bloodspun Web will be spun, for you have commanded that it be so."

a3b8bf35-f820-4cb9-8e09-167740508fc1.Text: {n}You see a middle-aged woman dressed in rich ecclesiastical robes. Her features are large and unsightly, but her majestic posture and commanding gaze, coupled with her gleaming gold regalia, make her an imposing figure.{/n}

8c3d5821-91fa-4b7f-8075-7c238054d6f5.Text: "My predecessor was a heretic, and only the Emperor knows how many blasphemous thoughts he managed to instil in the minds of his congregation. I will start from nothing, as if I were arriving on a world unfamiliar with the Creed, and from there I will rebuild the citadel of faith aboard this vessel. Within one year, you will be surrounded by the righteous."

1ab839d6-47b9-4be4-9295-e6ca8ad3f2fe.Text: "Where a heretic once preached, the Imperial Creed now thunders as before! It fills my heart with a joy almost as deep as that of fighting His foes." {n}Argenta exchanges a look of pious resolve with the confessor.{/n}

0189e7ba-e654-45c5-b77b-78b0037e06f9.Text: "Confessor Arabella Bolint, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, of the Calixian Lesser Bolints. It is an honour to be welcomed aboard your vessel. You may entrust me with your crew, for I am a lifelong missionary and preceptor. I was drawn to serving the faith from a young age, and I have been fortunate enough to have studied under some of the most doctrinally rigorous mentors in the Expanse."

c404ef96-1f31-4c1d-a615-578d146ea5f5.Text: "Never before have I served on a ship, but the faith in Him must be uniform and consistent with the Creed in every place, must it not? I see much unorthodoxy in the life of the voidsmen, but by the Emperor's grace, I will rekindle the light of His teachings until it banishes the shadows from your subjects' hearts."

b4cedad4-fb11-4761-ba3c-624c0895770c.Text: "And, of course, I will see to it that your name is always upon the lips of the Expanse's faithful. Servants of the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMinistorumGlossary}Ecclesiarchy{/g} must stand together in this grim hour, and news of your pious deeds, loudly proclaimed, will contribute to this. Let our faith unite us in the face of the trials ahead."

d0b52323-6160-4338-a5dc-3fa8d87877f5.Text: {n}The confessor is covered head to toe in jewellery. Even her nails are gilded, and her smile reveals teeth inlaid with mother-of-pearl.{/n} "Great Beacon, our glorious {mf|master|mistress}!"

9e0f5916-06d0-4a53-83e0-d3f36ba19e9b.Text: "Here, away from all those austere priests, I feel liberated. The canons are strict: they only take, and give nothing in return." {n}She touches her heavy adornments lovingly.{/n} "I much prefer my present circumstances."

2b391fea-8754-43ad-9d12-09a6d4b2927d.Text: "I have shortened some less significant parts of my sermons, such as the ones that talked about all the various saints, and instead put a greater focus on explaining Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}'s divine nature as the {mf|master|mistress} of the {g|Encyclopedia:WarrantGlossary}Warrant{/g} who commands our destinies." {n}The confessor smiles obsequiously.{/n}

e5010112-1935-4f4a-a403-67a64fdbee27.Text: "How are you enjoying your new position?"

15b2da7e-24b0-47c7-8148-1d4934dcc3f9.Text: "How will the spiritual life of the vessel change?"

a058b460-94a8-4212-9ce5-01870fa259e5.Text: {n}A morbidly thin and heavily augmented voidborn makes the sign of the {g|Encyclopedia:Aquila}Aquila{/g} the moment he sees you.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! I pray to the Emperor for you every day!" {n}His voice is unexpectedly energetic and loud. It is hard to believe that such a puny body could produce such a vigorous sound.{/n}

720b4e52-7eec-40c7-9d3a-72d281e8e4d3.Text: "It's all new to me, but people are always stopping by for prayer and counsel, and the shrine confessional is packed to the brim — I just haven't had any time to take everything in. But I know everyone and have spoken on spiritual matters with many crewmen. I guess they've accepted me in ordination faster than I've accepted myself."

7941f2c6-2de1-4eed-895b-fcb9f256b92f.Text: "I want to infuse my home vessel with faith, so that people may feel the presence of the God-Emperor wherever they go. This will make them feel at ease, and the work will be done with greater effort. I've already indicated where best to place automatic chapels on the decks, and where to install {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox-casters{/g} for liturgical sermons." {n}He produces a data-slate showing a map of the ship and points at the marks excitedly.{/n}

2d428796-b18f-426c-ad3f-3d7c79041581.Text: "That I am, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. They call me Confessor Zirmen now. I used to be in the Master Helmsman's employ, and he kept saying how much my zeal was getting on his nerves. But he swore worse than usual when I was appointed confessor, so I guess he did appreciate me after all."

a454d902-3930-4424-ba8d-629839f78251.Text: "Not every preacher can understand the voidsman, you see. Our lives are different from those dwelling on planets — our way of life is alien and strange. Sometimes, we even speak a different language. People feel relieved when it's one of their own who talks to them about the God-Emperor."

edfaf98d-82df-4a4a-9719-ff6dd8425184.Text: "Lord Captain..." {n}He scratches the wires at the back of his head sheepishly.{/n} "I just want you to know that voidsmen across the Expanse have been saying good things about you. It's not just our {g|Encyclopedia:ImperialNavyGlossary}ship{/g} — many crews out there honour you as His faithful servant. All too often, captains are blinded by power, but not you. Us void wolves, we respect that."

edc94865-a533-4deb-aee0-a3874a3a7111.Text: "Like I need to tell you any of this! You've been a {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Navy}voidfarer all your life{/d}. So, I'm with you... I mean, I'll live up to... I'll do my best. You'll see!"

45ba710c-0d14-4fd1-b5f3-30d33b644c15.Text: {n}The confessor's skin is pale and riddled with mystical symbols, but his voice is brimming with energy:{/n} "Praise the Great Beacon!"

2239f416-3336-409a-8187-759b6136a5cb.Text: "I will bring enlightenment to my brothers and sisters! I swear, this shrine has more books on faith than I've seen nuts and bolts on this ship! I read them day and night, and I remember their words so clearly, as if they have become impressed on my mind! I've never read this much in my life... And the books — new ones just keep appearing. I don't even know where they're coming from! They have prayers in them, and signs filled with sacred power..." {n}He proudly points at the marks all over his body.{/n} "This knowledge must be shared! And I will share it!"

55a827c6-3828-4d42-896b-e41862255f1b.Text: "Open the reliquary. I am going to try to solve the mystery of the orb."

efcdb2bf-01ca-420e-91f3-e6ba639ba844.Text: "What is this relic next to you?"

ff6073f5-0ab9-48d0-841b-f1fd74ba43a1.Text: [Form the question in the orb's first quarter]

fb9af2c4-9403-4fc3-a1f6-308a6b492b1b.Text: [Form the question in the orb's second quarter]

fc959e9b-6cee-4756-a521-f8ea6c2dd08b.Text: [Form the question in the orb's remaining quarter]

1df2f1db-173b-45a3-9865-b4f3097eeac6.Text: [Reset the orb's configuration and start over]

8119c03d-28a6-4a77-ad24-7f653936f56a.Text: "Do you have any ideas on how to open this orb?"

dbfaf285-0145-45f5-b65a-6259d58a567e.Text: "I wish to try opening the orb one more time."

2755dc48-6f1f-4366-b145-1e2e03fa9b27.Text: [Form the question in the orb's third quarter]

cb5c8ea3-e5b9-49ab-910f-a8fbe464a35b.Text: {n}The broad-shouldered young priest makes the sign of the Aquila.{/n} "The Emperor protects, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. How may I be of service?"

c634bbbc-1b11-4e7f-8509-62d93e0c792f.Text: {n}The initiate opens the lock and hands you the orb. Someone has already moved the hoops around, trying to arrange the letters into meaningful sentences. It will only take a few more rotations for the orb to split cleanly into four parts, each with its own question. The answers should presumably be formed using adjoining hoops.{/n}

0933fffc-2871-42dd-93fb-6f7cb6a2b3e8.Text: {n}The orb comes alive. Its hoops shift around with alarming speed, coming together and folding into each other until the orb opens completely, laying its treasure bare.{/n}

d1073f8c-e29d-456f-b386-854935840aae.Text: "Initiate Ziek, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I recite prayers and help Confessor Adalbert with the rites."

9bea9d31-0471-45da-aa99-0ada95f88094.Text: {n}The initiate looks over at the sarcophagus. The skeleton within is clutching an orb made up of many tightly fitted hoops covered in glyphs.{/n} "A mysterious object, but undeniably a holy one. It was donated by a group of pilgrims who studied the legacy of the great missionary Nadine Aleynikov. They believed there was something inside that only someone truly righteous was meant to have. One of the pilgrims was so desperate to witness the moment of the orb's opening that they bequeathed their body to us."

d5b3709d-3a6d-4d66-bf90-f3000f93eb15.Text: "If I recall the pages of Life of Nadine Aleynikov correctly, this part speaks about purity. The saint saw it as the quintessence of all other virtues."

b9046042-9c2b-4046-8fe2-c667158ee436.Text: {n}The initiate unlocks the reliquary, putting the sacred object at your disposal.{/n}

bcc450f1-ac74-4319-9d1e-12990ec1888d.Text: {n}"My light reaches everywhere. The greedy will see me in gold; the scholars, in Humanity's cradle; but only the righteous will see me within their souls."{/n}

1e984eb2-f63b-4b37-91f6-1a3d91b30c70.Text: {n}"I am within every human, and my loss is feared, for without me comes the end. But give me to the Emperor, and you will be eternal."{/n}

02df47b8-55a8-4793-bd4b-9cb0721bd770.Text: {n}"I am poison; I am perdition; I am disgrace. Burn me down, eradicate me, or perish rejected by the Emperor."{/n}

4b6fc83a-aa4a-4f42-aa13-fe63d4c090c1.Text: {n}"In your body, mind, and soul, you must possess me. I am no mere absence of stains; I bring you closer to Him."{/n}

898a5eb3-bccd-4b40-b264-9c0f1b047fad.Text: {n}For better or worse, something clicks inside the orb.{/n}

b2745a8f-ab9e-41bb-bc49-64bc550152db.Text: {n}As a {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Ministorum}servant of the Ecclesiarchy{/d}, you have given innumerable sermons about the light radiating from the {g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThroneGlossary}Throne{/g} of the God-Emperor, Protector of Mankind. It seems doubtful that the author of the riddle would have deviated from such deeply revered canon.{/n}

5302465a-3dc4-4f90-8135-497d76dc11c0.Text: {n}Your {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_MOT_Mind}sharp mind{/d} quickly scours the recesses of your memory for any fragments of Nadine Aleynikov's sermons. You recall that she mercilessly denounced the weakness of those who have faith in the Emperor but are incapable of translating that faith into deeds. She must have despised this shortcoming of the soul more than any other.{/n}

b3ed0561-9187-43e9-81ae-a612eae0a684.Text: {n}The answer immediately comes to you: it is blood. You have spilt it too many times in the name of faith for you not to realise that it is the most precious offering one can give Him.{/n}

5e76251e-e323-43a1-b78d-95da1d2e38b1.Text: {n}The initiate stares at the relic in your hands, stunned.{/n} "How strange and exciting it is to behold the holy object that has lain hidden from the eye for so many years... Truly it is a great day upon which the Rogue Trader {mf|himself|herself} has revealed the legacy of great missionaries to us all!"

e50badc7-bcfa-42bd-910f-781b7203c724.Text: "A riddle?" {n}Cassia's eyes light up with curiosity.{/n} "It would be most interesting to learn what is stored inside. Lord Captain, would you like to try opening the orb?"

4eacd414-6ffa-4d0d-9b39-f030a945916f.Text: "One of your predecessors was the last to attempt solving this relic's mystery. It happened a long time ago, before Lady Theodora was born. That's all I know."

24049ba7-073c-4c2b-8760-fa63a1a031b4.Text: "To damage a sacred relic is an unthinkable crime, and to use force to bypass the test of wisdom and faith it contains is terrible blasphemy."

c8e22cc0-bd6d-48bb-8cc8-fd9ff87b39d4.Text: {n}The initiate recites a short prayer as he locks the repository with great reverence.{/n}

016438b6-dc13-475f-b385-c9582c96aed5.Text: {n}The hoops slide until the glyphs on them align in an order you recognise.{/n}

07dc17ef-29b0-431a-9455-9a81efdd4c3a.Text: {n}Another soft click comes from inside the orb.{/n}

5c72cdab-efb1-4dc5-9721-2aec3ad7acbb.Text: {n}With a click, the hoop settles into place.{/n}

af1fcf52-2d67-4854-8471-4a959b17da59.Text: {n}The hoops shift and... return to their previous arrangement. You will have to start over.{/n}

09ce1e95-7434-4bdd-8ede-f33333081766.Text: "Remind me, what is it you do on my ship?"

d4cd40a8-bd97-48c0-96ba-ea4aac89ebd9.Text: "Is this the only place of worship on the ship?"

fa584cc7-3148-48b2-8ae4-59a05b749fb7.Text: Granted residents of other decks access to the ship's reliquary.

1eb068e1-da3a-4d4f-be37-4cf4b0e9b703.Text: "I want those on other decks to be able to partake of this exuberance as well."

b449bc74-0c74-40ab-bfc8-9c32ba3d67b0.Text: "I would like to find out more about this place."

1d2e3e7c-def3-4fe0-800f-4032340d7fd7.Text: "Still, your gentle manner may adversely affect your flock's faith."

eeed1701-08a6-4942-b05b-1ff886b7c7a7.Text: "Hmm... It seems there are more holes in the Imperium's religion than parasites on a grox."

f99d3f09-ab04-4684-8c2b-c89db2c62366.Text: "Nothing has changed! The rash is still there."

cd5adf37-870d-42ea-b82a-5647dc73c173.Text: "The Imperial Creed prescribes being wary of psykers, but the Imperium needs them."

933269bd-011e-47b0-8038-29e1543ba082.Text: "The Ecclesiarchy tells us to persecute mutants, but an exception was made for Navigators."

6e93927f-67d6-4316-a540-1f1b193a2e57.Text: "These rumours are baseless, Confessor. Trust me."

def63a79-bded-4977-a406-94d2bfe3d932.Text: Repented of your transgressions to Confessor Adalbert.

4a7b21c1-2f30-47b0-ae1d-2aa8d9b00516.Text: [Pray with Adalbert] "I have things to repent."

0be70857-1c58-488d-bd7e-3979db44dabf.Text: "Among the Adeptus Mechanicus, the Emperor is known as the Omnissiah. They have their own form of worship... Do they truly share our beliefs?"

bcfc1c38-3619-412a-a19e-e296a1c78572.Text: "Come to think of it, my Warrant entitles me to violate the Imperial Creed in many ways..."

2a4b0fa1-b355-4876-b939-a04c8a3ffad9.Text: "You may have your rank and your golden trinkets, but you are still my servant. Hold your tongue!"

de421e10-6418-479b-a1cc-182f8b744db4.Text: "If I notice even the slightest hint of insinuation from you again, I'll have you flayed alive."

9ac8f5c0-4354-474b-aeee-ca474ab76996.Text: [Sneer defiantly] "And what would you do if the rumours turned out to be true?"

c4f0518c-60d0-452b-b8d3-a0e46c2b6c44.Text: "Tell me, Adalbert, do you visit the shrine confessional to repent as the other officers do?"

010a2fed-a52c-458b-b660-650a6c23d8f1.Text: "A strange rash broke out all over my body after my visit to the lower decks. Can you help me?"

1a581cb5-0a05-4d29-9bce-d5081d19e4c0.Text: "I would like to hear the Imperium's tenets from you."

d99a6147-ec3e-4e9c-845d-40df88dbf01b.Text: "No servant of the Ecclesiarchy would pass up the opportunity to visit this place."

64d9d870-0d75-4be1-b880-34c15c8ef970.Text: Gave a sermon on duty and sacrifice.

b4b7df10-ddc8-45c9-b5d4-5aa23ab4626a.Text: [Give an impassioned sermon] "Let my words become His flame!"

7881d038-ed27-4616-9dc9-141275290d45.Text: Gave a sermon on your own greatness.

66dee333-ddfe-46db-977b-39a36ec27e5c.Text: [Give a sermon that praises your name] "I will take this chance to tell the faithful about the {mf|master|mistress} of this ship."

0a2158dc-8b4c-43df-87bc-a278bf8e1b60.Text: "I will limit myself to reciting a brief litany."

891eb290-6367-4b08-910e-342c234eabe8.Text: Gave a sermon on unity and compassion.

8d01fff2-e383-44b3-a41c-42e157cfdb9d.Text: [Give a solacing sermon] "In these dark times, I will remind my people of the value of mercy."

e8849014-d510-45a7-b5d1-b51a01122321.Text: "Open the reliquary with the power maul. I wish to wield it myself."

25539bd4-c00e-4898-94c4-39cd3ef2d383.Text: "You are positively beaming with joy. A priest like you is a rare sight."

85195460-33bb-412e-8016-c3237dfe379c.Text: "Where does this collection of sacred relics come from?"

516f7d4b-9e33-4e3f-a39c-70168db5b493.Text: "People confess to you, do they not? I am interested to know the thoughts of some of my subjects."

47407b76-19fc-41b9-883d-7173cb7e7d66.Text: {n}Confessor Adalbert, a plump, rosy-cheeked old man, is lighting candles, taking his time with each. Glints of fire dance on his heavy golden Aquila and in his sky-blue eyes as he addresses you, smiling.{/n} "The {g|Encyclopedia:EmperorGlossary}Emperor{/g} protects, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Are you here to pray, or have mundane matters brought you to me?" {n}There is an incredibly profound quality to his voice, and he speaks with mesmerising timbre.{/n}

04dd3a78-2099-4092-852f-6a744466d9b4.Text: "Why, no, there are multiple sancta on every deck, where your subjects pray fervently and the clergy keeps a close watch on the firmness of their faith. This, on the other hand—" {n}He gestures around at the glittering reliquary.{/n} "—is the holiest of holy places, where only the noblest among your servants are permitted to set foot."

7dc94c5e-a84d-41c6-8d75-0e8eb68e404f.Text: {n}Adalbert's eyebrows arch upward.{/n} "Truly a most generous and gracious gesture, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! I will arrange for commoners who have distinguished themselves in their service to be allowed in here. An event like that will fill them with fervour, and they will pass down the memory of what they have seen to their offspring."

c93938f7-ec41-4db2-be5e-cba0359ba886.Text: {n}Adalbert takes in your words with a dispassionate expression, and bows his head.{/n}

a73589c3-8f24-45af-8802-f1d1c4b50d0b.Text: "I will do my best to answer them."

a38fda95-99fd-4e6b-a582-e0fc9b740690.Text: {n}The usually relaxed and genial Confessor Adalbert now exudes an aura of resolve and unperturbed calmness.{/n} "I have been waiting for Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, and now we are standing in the Emperor's presence again." {n}His words are quiet, but have weight to them.{/n} "Your fame is growing, but so are the ill rumours. It would not be unthinkable for some to conclude that the Rogue Trader has {d|Encyclopedia:Conviction_Heretical3OrMore}turned away{/d} from the light. I, however, believe you are as loyal a servant of the Golden Throne as ever, and that you will soon dispel any doubt as to your righteousness."

d3949820-9718-4324-ae9b-83bb0a6b4e54.Text: "I was scarcely more than a child when the malady struck our cabins. First would come the fever, then the unlucky victim would start retching blood. After that, they would melt away like a candle. Only the youngest survived, myself among them." {n}He smiles feebly.{/n} "But now my family is growing, and I am grateful for each new life that replaces one lost."

54b7b4f9-ffa3-4b4e-bda1-8cb61c8a8ae8.Text: {n}You and Adalbert kneel in prayer together. He says softly,{/n} "And there is no such darkness as would not flee from His light. Nor is there a life better than one lived for His glory. For all strength and all grace comes from Him alone and by His will."

fbfb99bb-178a-4a66-aa2d-332f47de4684.Text: "Your predecessor always had due concern for the reliquary's maintenance and its needs, and under her rule, faith occupied its proper place on this ship." {n}Adalbert gives you a diplomatic smile.{/n}

c9bd82c4-cfea-4721-a180-b4e7ca96a6e0.Text: "Ours is a Throne-fearing flock that regularly leaves vox-recordings in the shrine confessional housed in the eastern part of the reliquary. This allows us to maintain constant watch for any heretical tendencies. We can observe the earnesty with which our parishioners render their duties, as well as any dangerous dissent brewing in their minds. Initiate Klotus is responsible for sorting the confessions — he would be honoured to offer you access to the confessional cogitator."

a712e66a-0468-46f2-9b10-0e6b444c0e3d.Text: "You are right. Without the {g|Encyclopedia:AstropathGlossary}Astropaths{/g}, we are deaf and blind, and there are many other psykers labouring for the good of Humanity. That is their place within the Emperor's design — but only those among them who accept His light and have been authorised."

092e37af-b726-47f4-8140-f6d5456f4bfe.Text: "I can understand. Having been touched by the powers of the warp yourself, you are pondering your own essence." {n}Adalbert nods sympathetically.{/n}

5c4a51bc-c878-4dd5-883c-ee9f1722aa73.Text: "The {g|Encyclopedia:NavisNobiliteGlossary}Navis Nobilite{/g} are different from most humans, but their differences are a blessing. They are noble servants of the Imperium who help Humanity expand its galactic domain. Do you not see that as a higher purpose that pleases the Emperor?"

cb6df5ff-fd79-46bd-87eb-9d018bc34a0c.Text: "It is a pleasure to hear that unlike the ignorant rabble, you give due acknowledgement to the greatness of our deeds, Confessor."

0340d322-1a78-4554-af4c-08e83a5ce32b.Text: "Most certainly! Different likenesses of the Emperor and ways of worshipping Him can be found across the Imperium's worlds, but we all believe in the One."

9a4d5909-8648-4c10-9a56-0e922051e8f4.Text: "For the purposes of optimising the present exchange, I suggest regarding this statement as true. For a competent answer to the question, I recommend addressing this unit as a member of the Adeptus Mechanicus clergy."

bbe65a39-5ac2-4e1d-8ca3-08cc83a4f733.Text: "Violate? Those are not to be conceived of as violations. A Rogue Trader's privileges come with a duty — the duty to expand the bounds of human influence. If the Rogue Trader must take responsibility for unorthodox solutions or actions in the course of performing that duty, then so be it."

6b7822cc-832e-4aa4-bb29-a2ae7000a86d.Text: {n}Adalbert clutches his chest and exclaims in a fearful voice,{/n} "For the sake of your own soul's salvation, this conversation is over!"

43860049-6b11-43a3-8fb6-540dc2c0c00e.Text: {n}Adalbert's face regains its familiar gentle expression.{/n} "Poison tongues may tirelessly belittle the Rogue Trader's honour, but all slander will turn to dust before Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}'s righteous devotion."

42d0643b-5604-4400-a23d-90a8d8e42769.Text: {n}Adalbert frowns.{/n} "Is Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} quite certain of that? Unburden your soul. I am here to help you."

34f8e2f5-d051-4dfb-8c7a-43d246d04370.Text: "I will pray for you. May the light of the Emperor touch your soul and return it into the fold of the faithful." {n}The priest sighs heavily as he makes the sign of the Aquila.{/n}

301f0847-5c9d-450b-8e4a-efd5983b69eb.Text: "May the Emperor's blessing be with Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

4b4c067b-aabd-44b2-b5f9-a4449426b2d7.Text: "Every relic we have here was either arduously tracked down by your ancestors, captured in battle against the faithless, or received as a gift for glorious deeds. A show of loyalty to the Emperor that speaks for itself, does it not?" {n}He makes no effort to conceal his pride.{/n} "For our part, we keep the precious relics intact and undisturbed as we conduct liturgies and perform rites. Initiate Ziek is especially diligent in his care for the relics. Though he is of common stock, he earned his position through dedication and piety."

b0fe76b8-60c9-4e3c-8dd4-fc86754496cd.Text: "An accurate observation from a {mf|lord|lady} who knows the importance of strong faith on {mf|his|her} ship. The gentleness you speak of is skin-deep. On the inside, my faith and spirit are pure adamantine: decades instructing the crew in fighting the dangers of the void and the warp have required nothing less. My resolve in the face of the monstrous threats we face must always be a hundredfold firmer than that of my flock."

4d1554dd-b332-4388-874b-e1635b87cbe7.Text: "Why, I always find time for penance on my morning and evening shifts, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

41929e90-7cfd-4003-927d-84d05a277867.Text: "Do you mean spiritual nourishment? It is ever in short supply. Those children who are literate could use new prayer books and hagiographies, for their own perusal and to read to the others."

a0b044d2-9166-4774-a0a1-2f97b5cb8b5a.Text: "The Emperor protects, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. What brings you to this holy abode?"

f013f580-a8b4-496d-ad6e-8f4593757449.Text: "An irrelevant question." {n}His face takes on an expression of fathomless wisdom and calm.{/n} "Our fates are in the Emperor's hands, and He does as His plans require."

f917089e-13bf-4736-b8b0-882f2481cd5c.Text: "For a moment I thought you had come to confess, but now I see you have taken on the role of cleric yourself. May the Emperor guide you on your quest for answers."

860e3dc8-0034-4920-a49f-3f90ed8503a2.Text: {n}Adalbert carefully studies the inflamed blisters on your skin.{/n} "An affliction of the unclean, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Those who have abandoned His light and shunned all care of the body as well as the spirit. Allow me to cleanse your mortal flesh of the seeds of corruption with a sanative prayer."

121fc83a-cda6-4268-a94f-f2e8c0fd6540.Text: "To heal the body, you must begin with healing the soul, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

50605cc0-7bbd-4727-873e-47dc10c4edfd.Text: {n}Adalbert opens a hefty volume titled "The Sanative Hymn of Sufferers" and recites the first forty verses in a chanting voice.{/n}

98b67054-d121-4523-b857-a01335715de7.Text: {n}The vigil continues for two more hours straight. Your mind is clearer and you feel much better, but it is still not enough to rid you of the affliction.{/n}

8d59508d-1f0b-473f-b246-5ad622d80b67.Text: {n}At some point the ship's evening gong breaks your stupor, and you note with surprise that your abscessed blisters are gone and your skin is now barely even red where it was previously inflamed.{/n}

3a3e3a82-b13a-4d4d-bec0-97b7bc955edb.Text: "Grace descends upon those who are filled with humility and patience, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

d25cb3c6-d489-49b2-9f75-bfbb98ac7108.Text: {n}Two hours of incessant prayer later, despite your knees and shoulders burning with strain, your inflamed skin still torments you with unbearable itching.{/n}

e3289349-11f9-402c-b131-45a87bf25754.Text: "...and bless Thy loyal servant, so strength and health may return to the body that guards the borders of the Imperium..."

22153fd9-a5fe-434f-b15c-705db9500a16.Text: "I am entrusted with caring for the reliquary chapel and the dynastic crypt. I also conduct liturgies, consecrate the ship's bays, and strengthen the crew's hearts whenever a dark hour is upon us, lest any among them falter in the face of the horrors lurking in the darkness, and fail in their duty."

43103c2c-1ecb-497e-a6d7-e141c04d2738.Text: {n}Adalbert dabs at the sweat on his brow with the edge of his robe and smiles warmly.{/n} "The God-Emperor never abandons His faithful, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Rest now. You will soon feel much better."

e40e589a-45e5-40b7-8c2d-aa5861ed389f.Text: "It is good to hear you say these words, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. You have taken the first and most crucial step toward redemption."

19033db3-7e21-4032-b84c-5face1af45d5.Text: "You forget yourself, {name}!" {n}If Argenta's glare could burn, you would be a handful of ash by now.{/n} "Not even a Rogue Trader is allowed to blaspheme against the holy faith!"

a74a7901-3ac9-41c4-a096-f541cf3a2d84.Text: "Blessed be the day when {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Ministorum}{mf|His|Her} Reverence the archdeacon{/d} assumed the helm of House von Valancius. Perhaps you wish to honour this chapel with a sermon?"

56c091f8-ecfe-401a-88df-354e73ff86a9.Text: {n}Your words of duty and sacrifice ring out beneath the chapel's vaulted roof, leaving your listeners ecstatic. They start swearing sacred oaths before His image, professing remorse for their misdeeds, and depositing everything they have, down to the last throne, in the offering plate.{/n}

d70d8bdc-86ab-40ad-8efc-5f7b25b58d50.Text: {n}You begin by describing the terrors lurking in the Expanse, then artfully shift the focus to yourself, the Emperor's anointed, Guardian of Humanity. The people listen in awe, accepting your greatness and the power you hold over their fates.{/n}

47c32011-5f0c-41ff-80e8-2777d2805f91.Text: {n}You recite the Hymn of Vigilance and Intolerance, and the congregation listens dutifully, making sure to repeat the last line of each verse after you. Those present are well familiar with this litany, and it takes you little effort to deliver its words with aplomb.{/n}

6487cbc5-e0b2-456d-ad0a-462c2a9ca50a.Text: "The flock will forever preserve the words of Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}'s sermon in their hearts. Thank you for finding the time to take care of your subjects' souls in the midst of your countless labours."

7feab8ef-8379-4e11-bd3c-8b398ce13ec6.Text: {n}You give a poignant speech on unity and compassion, studying the faces of parishioners. Tired, callous, sorrowful — many seek salvation in faith, and with every word you speak, their expressions grow brighter. They may yet remember your sermon in an hour of adversity and choose life and hope over anguish and despair.{/n}

2acc4da7-08c0-4acd-9904-eb16ea6028ae.Text: {n}Adalbert nods deferentially, but his gaze is fixed on Marazhai. A furrow cuts across the confessor's brow, and he hastens to make a protective sign.{/n}

7a3f94c4-0825-45ec-a1b0-08684fc15f6f.Text: {n}Marazhai idly stretches his neck.{/n} "One day I will grow tired of being stared at by the mon-keigh and start teaching them some respect."

25022ed8-1b01-4d1b-ab83-0e36760f5a98.Text: "I am the ship's confessor, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. No vessel that abides by the Imperium's laws can sail the void without a spiritual guide. Even a smaller-sized ship that does not have a member of the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMinistorumGlossary}Ecclesiarchy{/g} on board entrusts all matters of faith to a layperson who is a staunch adherent of the Creed. A Rogue Trader's flagship, naturally, is expected to have a confessor who comes from a line of His reverent servants. I am such a one."

67dc59c1-ca17-4325-beae-db7bd845abd8.Text: "Every Rogue Trader takes care to maintain an appropriate place of repose on board their flagship. For their capital may change with the passing of centuries, but the vessel of the Emperor's anointed serves them for millennia. It is more than just a symbol of the dynasty's authority — it is the source of its power, the Lord Captain's seat in the void whence they reign over their many lands."

0406955c-91e3-4610-93a0-ea3204980b6e.Text: "The von Valancius crypt is where {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTraderGlossary}Rogue Traders{/g} and their most loyal servants are laid to rest. As the ship's confessor, I perform the rites of burial and remembrance for these honoured dead." {n}Adalbert lets out a heavy sigh.{/n} "It never occurred to this old man that he might have to send Lady Theodora on her final journey, but... All is the Emperor's will."

0e1c943b-cf12-4e5e-b555-630e6c165027.Text: "Alas, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I do not know of a way to open the locks on that particular receptacle without damaging its contents. One of the ship's confessors from days past sealed the reliquary well so as to bar anyone from taking the weapon. I suppose it was a desperate precautionary measure against thieves and heretics who would seek to lay their hands on the holy relic. I am sure there exists some impenetrable secret method of unlocking the reliquary, and if I only knew what it is, I would tell you right this moment."

a9050024-e0f8-4d83-bc2a-084f3426734b.Text: "Well put. The rights granted by the Warrant are a burden more than they are a privilege. Exercising them for the good of the Imperium without staining the purity of one's faith is a task too great for any ordinary individual."

50f3e066-1ae2-4a8a-b6e1-d7cfd306fd41.Text: {n}In a voice brimming with solemnity, Adalbert begins,{/n} "Every man and woman has their place in the order He created, and this order must be followed and the will of one's superiors obeyed. Beware of {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerGlossary}witches{/g}, for they have been stained by the {g|Encyclopedia:WarpGlossary}warp{/g}; persecute mutants, for they are perversions of the human form; and hate the accursed {g|Encyclopedia:XenosGlossary}xenos{/g}."

618985ab-7958-49ee-99e5-92b2f9784c82.Text: {n}Adalbert laughs good-naturedly.{/n} "A fair observation. Everyone knows that the clergy must maintain a stern appearance to inspire fear and awe in their flock." {n}His mirth fades, giving way to a pensive gravitas.{/n} "The truth is that my clan and I experienced great hardship. I cannot explain how it is I am standing before you now except by His will. How could one be anything but joyful knowing they were saved by the Emperor?"

c0ddd097-d650-4094-afce-c5a8efa6437d.Text: {n}Adalbert smiles warmly at you.{/n} "I could talk about the reliquary chapel for hours."

de7e011c-0e56-4481-8cdf-ac9bdc0f9aa7.Text: {n}Idira scoffs contemptuously.{/n} "For once in your life, you could just admit that it doesn't take a tongue calloused from prayer to handle the warp's dangers!"

9113e22e-b6cd-422f-981c-29fa5b69b293.Text: "Enough blood has been spilt. I hereby pardon this deluded fool, to show the rest of the vessel that I am not the monster that Nemesite paints me to be."

8c5b77fc-dbe1-4ed0-95e2-31020f9a676b.Text: "Sauerback, get him an escort so that he may tell the lower decks that Nemesite is a liar and a scoundrel. You will persuade him to be eloquent, will you not?"

6b3c805f-3135-454a-b529-27aee2991c92.Text: "The Creed must be strictly observed aboard the vessel. Since the voidsmen are wavering in their faith, let the High Factotum find a true servant of the Ecclesiarchy elsewhere."

c8fd126e-5f35-4602-b4ae-c6667fc58af5.Text: "Appoint a loyal crew member who is known for the strength of their faith — someone the children of the void will recognise as their own. We do not want any outsiders."

a594da7f-c9f1-4e72-9909-a8b2ca60156b.Text: "I trust the Bloodspun Web and grant the cult the honour of guiding the congregation aboard my ship."

a131385a-c634-4284-9012-cdb36208745a.Text: "It is not my place to judge."

ddeebefc-3eae-4442-bfc9-3b3dfa0a0beb.Text: "You are different. He is a murderer, but you understand the true value of human death."

34a2eb28-295f-40c6-963b-479bf86f7152.Text: "You are indeed alike. And it is up to you to prove before the God-Emperor's gaze that the Tenets of the Web are stronger than whatever Nemesite believes in."

17968e15-b23f-4e97-87f7-d2c5b638a83a.Text: "To equate a true servant of the God-Emperor with this apostate is a heresy unto itself!"

0fa60da8-6b25-4f77-aed7-c0e363977146.Text: "I want you to find a preacher on Dargonus who would kill their own mother for me. I will accept nothing less than absolute loyalty. Is that clear?"

cec1a02b-d9f9-43dd-a844-b0b9ccaf7342.Text: "Hrotko, how did you come to be here at just the right moment?"

546f704f-eb79-4e1a-a243-2ca7b8ac62c8.Text: "Are there any other senior officers helping you?"

f3387945-9a34-4054-bbe8-45847f01accb.Text: "How many more of you mutineers are hiding on my ship? I want to know your names, I want to know where you meet — everything."

a8465748-5b05-4444-be28-445b2bee791e.Text: [Address Ziek] "I have questions for you, traitor."

2cf03f28-373c-4ddc-8f50-884bf94105a3.Text: "Yes, both of you have been brainwashed. Stop looking for omens and try using your own judgement instead."

b63aef34-8521-4567-99a4-05f95457264d.Text: "So he was connected to the genetic aberration as well. Delightful."

75d5f516-8e9d-42d4-b485-0b06d71697c4.Text: [Nod at Ziek] "Now, let us decide what to do with our surviving traitor."

2883c257-3286-485a-927f-aaf99de42c67.Text: "Were you serving Nemesite for a cause or simply for money?"

0676a2da-22e1-4ccd-a9f3-997db05dc266.Text: "They were waiting for us. It was a trap."

771dd3a9-5065-4ca2-8fa8-ef6c5623ee8a.Text: {n}Her ruminations are interrupted by a furious hiss. Sauerback snarls a curse through her teeth and spits at Adalbert's smoking remains. Her left arm hangs limp and her face is mangled by shrapnel.{/n} "Lord Captain, we have a prisoner." {n}She points her weapon at the man standing hunched over in pain.{/n} "Permission to finish off the cur."

b673fdc2-ecde-46ab-9b33-148b6f2613ed.Text: "We will make certain that the lower-deckers believe their 'hero' to be dead. We will leave the body to hang for a good long while, that the hopes of the mutineers may rot along with the corpse."

55fadae1-ae2b-4d19-89ae-e5069d1aa3fd.Text: "P-pardon? Does this mean I can go?" {n}Ziek glances nervously about like a harried animal.{/n} "Have you really... Forgive me, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}... I thought you... But then... I'm so sorry!"

bdab0ffe-4fbb-496f-be88-3e7b4be7a819.Text: "That is one traitor dealt with, Lord Captain, but how many more have been poisoned by the false confessor's heresy? A new spiritual shepherd must be appointed quickly to banish any mutinous thoughts sown by the traitor from the minds of the crew and to strengthen their faith and obedience. Without the ship's confessor, the rabble will begin to whisper that the Emperor has forsaken us, and such doubts will only play into the rebels' hands."

998e66cf-be6e-4705-bebf-900c8c9a985d.Text: "You honour us with this boon, Domin. I will relay your words to the Vizsier so that he may choose someone worthy."

3b90d88e-f5cd-47e7-afda-c0c25d847038.Text: "As you command! I will order the chapel be restored as well."

f72e621a-8bee-4c42-9790-6862278c2bde.Text: "I will send agents to every deck. The next time Nemesite rears his head — which, I am certain, will happen sooner rather than later — we will be one step ahead of him, and not the other way round."

1b1a22a2-8c03-4682-9ea7-608def866f03.Text: "I am thinking about Nemesite, my adversary. The more I learn about him, the more I see a vague reflection of myself. A twisted reflection, perhaps... but all too familiar. Like me, he was forced to tread the path of servitude from an early age, stripped of anything that might stand in the way of duty — a champion and a zealot left with nothing but an idea, forged and tempered by his mentor."

209ed0f9-4f94-4f80-945e-ae8e558e1a47.Text: "This is true. Like a puppeteer, he pulls at the threads of other people's destinies, tangling and severing them. When I cut these threads, it is only as the Undying One commands: with timely precision. I must stop Nemesite so that I might save your subjects from premature death."

f377ec50-aa9d-4198-8a87-cc4815879aac.Text: "Yes, Domin'{name}. Your words echo through my soul, and we are in accord. Nemesite will fall, for his ways are dark and have led him astray." {n}Kibellah trails a metal claw across her lips, sealing her promise with blood.{/n}

ab6c7b4c-032a-437c-b03e-05e0851cf456.Text: {n}Sauerback staggers away, and your gaze turns to the motionless Kibellah, staring at her own reflection within a pool of blood.{/n}

7e6f04e7-25ef-4078-8705-a184e4cf701c.Text: "Down... with the tyrant..." {n}The broad-shouldered initiate who calls himself Ziek clutches a deep wound, glaring at you with hatred.{/n}

9a7f9cc6-e75c-44a4-a270-86760e9618a3.Text: "All warriors fight for something, be it fame, life, wealth, or their loved ones. Nemesite cares nothing for these things: he sacrifices his kin, scorns glory, and amasses no riches. I am sure he would gladly give up his own life if necessary. Nemesite fights for an idea, and so that is where we must strike. Make his idea bleed, and he will be obligated to respond. And whoever is forced to react instead of acting, dies."

c2279757-e52e-4921-9184-c682d1223780.Text: {n}Ziek flashes you a bloody grin.{/n} "He promised us freedom!"

e67a33dd-35ba-4e72-a189-bb1b6f083163.Text: "Yes, Lord Captain. Adalbert had been warned, yet he chose not to flee. Instead, he stayed behind to set a trap for us. Did he really believe this madness would succeed and he would somehow survive?"

11e5d522-f8a2-4a77-904f-fe9f152b0c4d.Text: "He did not want to survive. His only hope was to kill. Nemesite managed to turn his adoptive father into a blade pointed squarely at the Domin's throat, just as Adalbert himself had once turned Nemesite into a weapon. Neither of them feared death."

aed7545e-9108-4a1f-a5e8-7200f4096233.Text: {n}She looks away... but then turns back to you as if remembering something.{/n} "Domin'{name}... our conversation is not yet over. Please, stay with me for a few moments. There is something I want to ask."

5a015c6e-125f-4515-857a-5ebbf8699af8.Text: "You may be right. Perhaps we are defined not by what we are, but by what we serve. Thank you for this insight, Domin."

24124e24-3d9a-4c4f-ae24-1d45e9e45f65.Text: "I was praying, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Ever since you spared me, I have been praying a lot." {n}Hrotko's groomed face now looks haggard. His cheekbones jut out, and his former well-off appearance has taken on an air of noble piety.{/n} "And when I saw those vermin pull out their weapons, I considered it unacceptable to stand aside. I may have been found a bad officer, but not once have I been called a bad fighter. I am glad to see you in one piece. Today, I will be praying to the God-Emperor for your health."

28367dfc-4c35-4d2b-addb-e9e31c2c317a.Text: "Lord Captain, are you unharmed?" {n}Hrotko, formerly an enforcer and now an {d|Encyclopedia:HrotkoPriest}initiate{/d}, has not lost his usual cold composure, despite the fact that his white robes are stained with blood.{/n}

6b0457a5-8ea8-4c0f-af99-ff613b7e343a.Text: "That devious, mind-twisting beast..." {n}Sauerback frowns with worry.{/n} "I have been going through my predecessor's archive recently, and I may have an idea as to what manner of creature this Nemesite is. We are dealing with a Kelermorph — a special variety of mutant filth in service of genetic cults. These creatures are made and raised to play the part of the people's leader, an inspiration for the mutinous rabble. A Kelermorph's purpose is to sow disorder and use the rebellion to eliminate the ruling elite, those who might be capable of opposing the xenos."

767a0cab-4437-4949-9214-a11abdb9f03f.Text: "Too much evidence points to Nemesite being a Kelermorph, a special xenos unit bred for subversion. A Kelermorph utilises the discontent of the masses and incites them to revolt, with the end goal of removing local rulers loyal to the Imperium and installing Genestealer cultists in their place. This creature wears the mask of a populist leader, one who inspires the mutinous rabble. It will not stop until one of you is dead, {name}."

d968f716-188d-416a-b753-e497f2d6c4e7.Text: "Even the confessor didn't know where it is. He was afraid of spies, or of giving his son's secrets away under torture. You see? You can't get to our champion!"

57ce67bb-9299-47d5-a81f-0a0210f9671e.Text: "Officers? Ha! There is no one else among them who is pure! They only care about power and gorging themselves on the scraps you throw them, or else they would have long... long since turned against you." {n}Ziek can barely finish the sentence before he is beset by a torrent of gurgling coughs.{/n}

0d82f26e-72b8-4579-b028-5f9a54c77652.Text: "The confessor said every compartment has people who fight for our cause. They promised to take me into the circle of our most devoted believers. Then I would know... But even then, I would tell you nothing, not even under torture!"

7a564f50-35e5-4c17-bb51-a42db5b9156b.Text: "This mon-keigh makes her traps deftly — with sharp edges and relentless bonds. Yet, once again, she uses blood. Blood and death... Not as a hunter, but as a killer."

d28c642a-edf5-4afb-a5f8-291c63b5760f.Text: "You hunt with skill, blood scryer." {n}Ulfar nods in approval.{/n} "To smoke the foe out of his putrid burrow and provoke him to fight? Much smarter than chasing him around dark corners!"

3a82d423-ae71-48c5-adac-bfeacf287cea.Text: "Do not kill him in vain." {n}Kibellah shakes her head.{/n} "Those who follow the Tenets of the Web know that, just as we serve death, so too does it serve us. Allow the death of this man to become an instrument in your hands, Domin'{name}. Pass off the traitor's body as that of Nemesite. Instil fear in his supporters. The enemy will be forced to act to undo this deception, exposing himself in the process."

be1e3144-0ec1-4b31-bfdf-b313a770c0a6.Text: {n}The initiate only looks at you sullenly.{/n}

7e19d8e9-89fc-415c-91b3-d883bd743ee0.Text: "You ought to see this, Domin'{name}." {n}Kibellah leans over the confessor's body and slices off the edge of his collar with her blade, revealing a tiny scar on the back of his neck. It looks just like the one the captured worker in the plasma drive chambers had, except that this one clearly healed a long time ago.{/n}

3190961b-85de-4a64-b055-b94c43cdc366.Text: "We now know much more about the enemy." {n}Kibellah ponderously runs her finger along the flat of the blade.{/n} "About just how deep the poison of conspiracy runs within the veins of your ship. But the Bloodspun Web has wrapped itself around its bays too tightly, and Nemesite can no longer hope to escape."

10a5910b-d49c-4bf7-9f20-11906090350a.Text: {n}Sauerback gives Ziek a bloodthirsty smile.{/n} "Did you hear that, wretch? It is not over for you yet. You are mine now, so you had best sing sweetly about your Nemesite. You may yet earn yourself an easy death."

5f38eb25-e792-455d-a182-895cebe1c3af.Text: {n}Kibellah gives a barely perceptible nod of agreement but maintains an aloof expression.{/n}

be5beec2-e80e-45c6-b9a8-50ea72312740.Text: "Omens are not just the idle whimsy of a sluggish mind. They appear everywhere to those who have eyes to see them. And yet, your words ring true. Thinking about how alike Nemesite and I are is deeply distressing to me, and this is a weakness. I must instead focus my thoughts on the thread that will lead us to victory."

c4288380-bf21-45fa-a681-1c1ab2bb37a8.Text: {n}The battle is over, and silence descends once again upon the chapel. Flakes of ash whirl quietly in the air before coming to rest on the blood trickling slowly across the floor.{/n}

11eaa9de-f431-45e2-afac-0c7e79bb6448.Text: "So, Nemesite is just a man? Excellent. It is harder to kill a legend."
