406459bc-2257-49f7-97e9-9a3654d68c22.Text: "So, lawman, now you know I'm a deserter. Still feel like telling me how to live my life and trying to put me on the right path?"

25059c0e-940d-48ec-a319-6606e44f86e9.Text: "Unlike you, I do not run from duty. I suggest you finally yield and become an honourable subject of the Imperium."

13c25c30-2edd-44a2-a176-5f53e49bf3f7.Text: "Even here, you shine still, Sister. You haven't given up, haven't despaired... I am ashamed of my weakness. I should have stood with you from the beginning."

e82b317c-2495-4ab5-a862-038fee31d415.Text: "Cast aside your regrets! The past must not overshadow the future in which you and I, together, shall forge our path to freedom — with fire and steel!"

4f2e330c-e533-4931-906a-9fb3e26ca136.Text: "Throne, you really don't die easily, witch..."

bc6047d8-fdca-40a1-97a2-13a9bc3104b9.Text: "Glad to see you too, Master Killjoy! Though I'm more glad to see your dog."

dce3b3a6-90d7-45fe-ab43-a2f96e37d696.Text: "The crew loathes the xenos. I usually put a stop to any chatter at the stations, but only a complete louse would cheat people out of cursing that scum to their heart's content."

043d7e89-c1c7-41e5-80e0-3de61a2f6558.Text: "The Navigators found a way for the Imperium to benefit from your unholy existence. Taking into account the status of the Navis Nobilite and other circumstances, I would not consider this an offence against the Lex Imperialis."

a7aebd0e-afcb-46ab-9a98-aaebc5b6a48d.Text: "Even with that device on, you are still a witch. In fact, you've become something worse — there is no telling what this xenos-made noose is turning you into."

f938915f-fb08-44d4-bf2c-b21957fe83cb.Text: "The case on Dargonus brought back memories from my investigating days on a certain Calixian hive world, Piety. I can't say I miss those times, but there is something pleasurable about following the criminal's trail..."

4a4fa096-d3f6-4194-a815-098f7cdbeaff.Text: "I suspected that the only thing that gets you going in this life was your job. But to call tracking down criminals 'pleasurable' is a rare kind of perversion."

9d4f42f3-155e-4643-9799-2b072cecdb94.Text: "So, this is where your quest has led you, Pasqal. I don't even know if you're still the same man who used to patch Glaito up or someone else entirely."

f3e865aa-491a-4be2-9f79-74f26e48e8bc.Text: "I have become something too great and frightening for your understanding. But that does not mean that you were deceived. My personality lives on, as does my sympathy for Glaito. And not just for him."

d935184f-6e44-4c70-9ecf-9e56a1087011.Text: "Sometimes, I think some part of that blasted place has crawled under my skin and won't ever go away. A part made of pure despair and hatred."

e883bb7a-4ffe-4fed-932e-db9ffcfa154a.Text: "This statement is false. The unit Proctor bears no traces of modification. In the name of cognitive optimisation, I recommend doubling the volume of daily prayers."

82826df4-5e92-472f-a7f7-90e25d7ca9be.Text: "Oh, chin up, killjoy. There's no way Commorragh could break you! Hatred, you say? Haven't you always hated all life anyway?"

e38f7ce6-64b4-4fb7-b798-139c44f8b148.Text: "Here's what I'm wondering, Master Killjoy: how does your Lex view the current situation with the Lord Captain? Can't judge a Rogue Trader, can you?"

8017c265-36e2-47fe-bdb2-73de115f9723.Text: "Do not try to bait me — the Lex Imperialis states that I have no right to judge the bearer of the sacred Warrant. This clear restriction spares me from having to indulge in pointless deliberations."

6f7a7449-e02f-4d8b-94b7-ece291f2116b.Text: "This unit's internal visors are confirmed to be fully clear. My function is defined, my path set."

b6f73696-9d45-4247-933d-322b197fa493.Text: "Then, we walk the same road, my trusted comrade."

2b854268-c11e-4e9e-9649-b2a89dc0ba86.Text: "Imposed prohibitions shall hinder me no longer. I will become my own sacred protocol."

9b7b12f8-1b26-4d27-b9df-99f638df04a2.Text: "You are wrong, Pasqal. Prohibitions are worth obeying. No one has the right to name themselves sacred, no matter how great they may be — that authority belongs to the Emperor alone."

0d19fec9-8b2d-42b6-8e21-9b358624fc22.Text: "I could order Glaito to bite you, witch, then you would know for sure. Oh, feeling more lucid already, are you?"

7b19ca8c-d63b-450d-9792-5295b6bbf09b.Text: "It's not a court, it's a farce. The guilty escaped while she was busy crushing slum rats."

c8539d52-7c7b-4471-9b88-c94cdc996d1f.Text: "Clear proof that only the Emperor's Law must stand above us all. Not the law of people, no matter how righteous they claim to be."

e3b679e6-a57f-4697-98fa-3ff901331ffb.Text: "Oh, I wish the Exalted One's will really were— Wait a minute, am I agreeing with a lawman? You are a bad influence on me, Proctor!"

c88edc1f-c252-4645-8637-3d51c27043f8.Text: "Yours is too short-lived a tribe for you never to have encroached upon the dogma of your dead god. I doubt your precious laws contain even a single word that has not been rewritten to oblige new generations of mon-keigh."

2895e56a-c50b-42de-a886-3365c2e5dbc5.Text: "Chorda's methods aside, she can keep order on the station, and that is something Footfall needs more than air regenerators at this time."

114dea25-8545-4d93-bfc2-76a3493476c5.Text: "If Vladaym is an idiot, he will continue begging the Rogue Trader for help. If not, it will be a while before we hear from him again."

62ffe346-6648-4fbc-8bfa-38c026613de7.Text: "If you are referring to House Chorda, then there is hardly anyone left who could hold a grudge because there are no heirs who could take Incendia's place. Besides, as surprising as it may be, the sacred Warrant does not prohibit Rogue Traders from warring with one another."

c3178d71-58d6-4fa8-8184-bd09b6ac1698.Text: "If Winterscale's heirs all share that same foul blood of his, the one left ruling will be whoever emerges from the bloodbath of the succession war."

98d62825-64f0-48da-96d2-27789156471e.Text: "I hope all of you vile spawn exterminate each other one day. There has to be some small purpose to your existence."

fd3da71d-d28a-49a9-94be-c824a3a769af.Text: "You could learn something from him: one doesn't have to spout whatever pops into one's head, especially if it's your head, witch."

d8d3b9ef-593e-4e36-8898-425628e495ba.Text: "All too often, noble houses delude themselves into thinking they are above the law. It takes only the slightest push for them to cross that line. I am sure you understand my meaning, Werserian."

51657315-4a88-4cb4-968b-11eaf19ad5fb.Text: "If you are so adamant about settling the score with the governor, then challenge him to a duel, or whatever it is nobles do. No more false accusations or tampering with Administratum documents — Arbitrators can find better uses for their time."

0aff6429-3196-4705-8fb5-7855b2c40386.Text: "You have accomplished something great indeed, Sister. If anyone deserves to feel at peace, it is you."

c4f84c64-fa75-4600-ab00-fd633ce5c804.Text: "It was humans who routed your foul kind on Dargonus, so your mockery is pointless."

eb23eb64-9f80-4198-9c96-dc2f3e11b903.Text: "By the Holy Throne... Glaito, target: Pasqal; partial escort and protection. If your knowledge finally gets you killed, it won't happen on my watch."

3e21808e-1d5e-4a81-bd23-6055c4c5b1c7.Text: "It is staggering to realise that the Emperor's Angels are mortal... Then again, who knows what the God of Humanity has in store for His children after their death?"

395f35d4-b2ab-4628-9c56-3fd235755d2a.Text: "There is no greater honour for a fighter than to die fulfilling their duty. No mourning — only eternal glory."

ddf3528e-4b88-4269-9445-1c358c5c6b5e.Text: "Even a dog may at times echo the wolf's howl. Your words have reached my heart, lawkeeper."

b00d55d7-beb0-4c94-ad46-6f416b0ca309.Text: "It was nice of him to leave — outside his accursed city, with fewer forces at his side, and in unfamiliar territory, he practically ensured his own death. I wish xenos would do that more often."

dde472e0-c5ff-47d5-8c74-9ee763ed912e.Text: "I would agree that being aboard the flagship is better — if only there weren't deranged assassins skulking in its corners."

802eabae-6dfc-48ec-a5f0-d5f3ec138980.Text: "I may never understand the rituals of highborn lords and ladies, but I see a certain beauty in everything following strict protocol."

8cc855e7-3af1-44de-9edc-10eac34b28aa.Text: "You know, we have a saying, Master Interrogator: if you miss your first shot, there are always other rounds in the magazine."

c882e2b0-c8a5-421f-9d35-c93e0cd45ca2.Text: "I see no point in wasting ammunition on a previously confronted target."

c9eb743c-1b94-48fa-9aa7-383c97f4639f.Text: "Master Interrogator, I am forced to ask you directly: are you engaged in an off-duty relationship with the Rogue Trader?"

7e6e9d93-428a-4e2a-84cf-3df8085e5f97.Text: "An interesting way to put it. Forced, you say? What is forcing you, Solomorne? Is it idle curiosity or emotional insecurity? Neither suits you."

d60de84f-1cb6-4109-a568-34c8d9bf1484.Text: "You want to be a real thorn in my side, don't you, peddler? Learn to keep your greed in check. The Rogue Trader has already granted you protection — do not demand anything more."

80a779d7-e3c6-4d66-abb9-e50db80d2d4d.Text: "Trying to scare me off, are you, lawman? That's too bad. You see, between the coldness of the mind and the heat of a living heart, the choice is simple."

1baf6053-9dcc-4f04-9712-dbba73246e94.Text: "If you are looking to satisfy your perverse needs — then get lost and do it elsewhere. The peddler may have one foot planted in heresy, but she will not serve as your food."

ad4f9ebf-a23b-4282-832a-a2ec7c61b482.Text: "Shield, shadow, blade, and now what else — a favourite? For an obedient weapon, you are too set on taking a place not fit for a servant."

976940b2-a454-4d67-a6d8-bbbd929b772e.Text: "You speak out of concern for the Domin. You do not want {mf|him|her} to grow close to someone unworthy. Someone who might betray or deceive. That is why I forgive your words that besmirch our sacred bond."

920ba08d-220f-4a1f-b89f-25d7b9988335.Text: "Steel yourself, Lady Navigator. The miscreant wants you to fear him — do not grant him that pleasure."

c34c5deb-3ecc-48c6-b1e7-931662d237b1.Text: "Desist from your games, xenos. The Rogue Trader is nothing like you. And {mf|he|she} will never be."

31e5ccfa-9584-4125-b607-e95a655a70d0.Text: "Yes, your mon-keigh limitations are unfortunate. But that does not stop {mf|him|her} from trying again and again — all for a chance to please me."

33be2588-3a20-4b4c-a758-c2c137d733d8.Text: "It has been some time since I last received any criticism of the discipline on the bridge from the Proctor. Not that I am complaining — merely noticing a worrying change."

d4570d77-d852-40d2-8500-f87c7e78f161.Text: "Please leave him be, Seneschal. The Proctor's colours... This is a difficult time for him."

6bc7c5fc-de6e-45b6-b7aa-fb206b1d25af.Text: "Even in the driest desert lies an underground spring. Even in the coldest man's chest there is a beating heart."

134d476c-c220-4676-bc95-f77a1785b1ae.Text: "I have not seen you around the bridge lately, Proctor. Were you preoccupied with some crucial tasks?"

1279a72e-c4f8-42a3-8f94-84df946a09d9.Text: "Rest assured, my present duties on this ship matter, and I am fully dedicated to performing them well."

8a8a2d3a-f282-4199-b3af-f694280c31f7.Text: "Look at you walk all over the poor man. And here I thought our killjoy was the one without a heart."

d3b6d14c-8954-4185-b54a-bf889a3376d2.Text: "Ah, our good Proctor... He always seemed to me so stern and unapproachable — but in truth, he was not nearly so stern, and indeed quite approachable after all!"

8c1debc7-d01f-4fba-88bc-1b19f8fba77d.Text: "I assume an exception was made for one specific individual — I still do not recommend pushing the boundaries of what is permissible, even in light of this new information."

6088c6a5-4d03-45e9-b7a6-52c81ba6df81.Text: "It calms my heart to know that Amic'Solomorne and his beast guard the Domin's sleep. And that Vil'Jae will not be slithering her way into those sacred chambers."

755ca141-30ea-4501-aac2-445bdefbb697.Text: "If you'd asked me before what was more likely to happen — me becoming a nun or Master Killjoy hitting it off with the Lord Captain — I would have gone and bought me some prayer beads."

d902b897-121d-4b1d-876f-99799903e134.Text: "With one remark, you have scoffed at both the faith and other people's feelings. You really have no shame, witch."

b98d2df5-efe0-44be-9b91-cec585b23211.Text: "The laywoman's foray into statistical analysis has failed deplorably. It is evident that you do not possess the means to purchase prayer beads, for the primary reason that you squander your upkeep on continued indolence."

655c7f86-f380-4ca2-af5e-f51ec85426ae.Text: "I am registering a deep emotional disturbance that is hampering the performance of the unit Solomorne. I propose a set of non-invasive measures with the aim of stabilising my comrade."

04c66107-afa3-46b8-a64a-2bc2fc913c26.Text: "Something must be wrong with your visors, Pasqal — you are imagining things. I am perfectly fine."

457ffb48-3ca2-47f9-b2dd-54a7895e2cf3.Text: "Let him mourn the things he has lost, iron mon-keigh. He should not smother the voice of his heart. Only after accepting one's pain can one move forward."

d6cbd0d6-93f5-4dd5-b1fa-6877a8c4e598.Text: "You are nothing but a passing diversion, a dubious exotic for a Rogue Trader who only recently came to power. Know your place."

ca87fe40-4f61-4f06-b745-07fc9fe4a62d.Text: "Does the elantach know what you think of {mf|his|her} decisions? Oh, I see. You lack the courage to say it to {mf|his|her} face, so you have chosen a different quarry. But I am indifferent to the rot of your words."

2e1ad230-486d-43f2-aa4a-c24f5be9ce02.Text: "A Rogue Trader and a backstabbing xenos. How did she earn the right to live and be included in the Rogue Trader's inner circle? I simply refuse to understand what is going on. Even if the sky were to fall on our heads, I would not be as confused as I am now."

7e6b49f1-a684-454b-8289-c4e5c0635ee5.Text: "To the Lord Captain, Yrliet is not a habit or a mistake. She is... something more. I doubt we will ever be able to understand them."

758cdec2-7f99-4b0b-91b2-8aa35f1d7f2b.Text: "Chin up, peddler. Trials make us stronger — this world might just beat a few vices out of you."

64b545f5-511b-422a-964c-1b57c7a146b0.Text: "Call it paranoia after many years of service, but I don't like silence. Especially when it's like this... Absolute."

bc3bffd3-ecf3-4df6-be12-99e0c2aa8919.Text: "I want to say that makes this place convenient for interrogating psykers, but... something about it puts me on edge. We should leave and forget how we ever got here."

fc3d20ae-fc72-4134-abf3-7a5ca5dacc38.Text: "I am sure the Arbitrators already have their hands full exterminating xenos on the other spires. Then, I will do my part here — we won't let Dargonus fall."

2dc92815-7d35-496a-bb4a-a657af5aa4c0.Text: "I've finally realised why we need a xenos in the retinue — to have someone walk up to whatever that is and check if it's really dead."

f928aae8-77bc-44ce-9e14-ea538f720804.Text: "Yes, this is a real hot spot. I would not be surprised to run into some familiar faces from the wanted list. But they sure would be surprised. Right, Glaito?"

18cbb5d7-b7f4-4137-809e-2dd251ae94bd.Text: "What a gem of a place. It reminds me of my first punitive raid. A clean assault, except the hovels took a while to burn down."

41b62cc7-73ac-4772-a943-11e16f8413c3.Text: "Hey, you've gone five whole minutes without stories about bones crunching under the boot of the Imperial Law! How did you pull that off?"

4a12bb41-19b6-4715-a7f7-414cb65880b4.Text: "Glaito is having some minor malfunctions trying to analyse the local smells — as if something were affecting his augmetics. I do not like any of this..."

bda382f5-0f14-4ef8-82da-07baf5a4c051.Text: "Since you're a witch anyway, would you do us a favour, in the Throne's name, and train your whispers to line up and report properly?"

e0e9442e-1265-44b9-bd81-012916e22cec.Text: "I hope this filth doesn't infect Glaito. There is too much metal in him..."

f2d75f1c-b2c6-4646-a193-839ea3273893.Text: "Is this what serving in the Inquisition is like? Cursed places, inconceivable horrors, high stakes..."

3ec72150-aeed-4d7b-8923-1a3fa463aed2.Text: "More or less. And just in case it is not clear already: none of what you saw here is going in your report to the Marshal."

6ae82acd-a0d2-48df-b1da-389152a3449f.Text: "Perhaps this unsavoury operation will put us on the trail of more serious criminals. It wouldn't do for us to waste time on squabbles between common parasites."

c84726bd-31ea-48b6-82d0-744c061a382d.Text: "Wilderness... That's not good. I wish it were lower hive levels or deep inside a manufactorum. Thankfully, I have Glaito's instincts to rely on."

cd409fb5-b2c2-40e5-82e8-d59d62ee5bf6.Text: "Even your rueful beast whom the mon-keigh have turned into a weapon may become prey in these forests. Tread carefully, and do not anger the Lilaethan."

e40f44a0-38a8-44d7-80ad-2bbf758d5945.Text: "Luxury... The number of times I have seen lofty criminals use it like armour. What they fail to realise is that Arbitrators are indifferent to gold in all its forms."

df5c91bf-28a3-4605-a957-5faa4fcfbed9.Text: "You are keeping a suspicious eye on the local population, Proctor — more so than usual. Do you find Janus disagreeable in some way?"

c77bda7e-4edd-4b9a-af8f-4bc8d739e66b.Text: "I always double my guard around nobility. A commoner steals forks from his master; a nobleman ransacks entire worlds."

3fc34199-fa1e-4c3b-9ce2-4f1d7cd48945.Text: "You could work as a bloodhound, peddler. Where you go, that's where one will find the most corrupt individuals on the whole planet."

497e5cd4-eeec-439e-9105-0ed49cbb3d23.Text: "Pasqal, sometimes I wish you had a protocol of some kind that I could use to make you freeze. One day, your knowledge will come at a price you won't be able to pay."

06f325c9-ab5f-4ed1-b05c-0a92996e03af.Text: "Do not pity them — they became weapons in the enemy's hands. The xenos wanted to shake our spirit, and, judging by your words, they were successful."

7c0fdb58-9ace-4c06-a3d1-f88a6ed50780.Text: "Everyone, cover your ears, keep chanting... and walk. There is no other way."

02e067a7-b85e-4cc7-ae1f-fbedb2dd6354.Text: "The witch is right, something is off. Glaito's visors are reacting to the shadows — that is not normal."

53e303b4-5c93-4259-b8dc-9dc365ff5724.Text: "Do xenos always abandon their vaunted Paths whenever the going gets tough? That is why you will all crumble before Humanity's resolve."

25c82bd6-88ed-4e80-a837-962407a595b5.Text: "My working theory is a martyr's death by means of an explosion. They were trying to defeat something terrible, or bury evidence of it. Glaito has already discovered traces of the explosive."

5832ea5e-74a2-4374-9941-4a1dc01a9db0.Text: The cogitator flashes its lumens mockingly, refusing to divulge Sargona's secrets.

9b5babb2-6500-49aa-8592-519d6fe405c4.Text: The cogitator obeys and reveals Sargona's secrets, including information on a hidden cache in one of the systems of the Expanse.

ccf2b5b0-53e9-4790-b3cd-3d0693afac03.Text: The screen is flooded with endless lines of critical error warnings. The machine spirits have gone into a stupor and are not responding to commands.

a143347a-ca3b-4940-bead-ce37d666e679.Text: Stored on the cogitator is a chronicle of various deals Sargona made with the Drukhari. The captain was actively bartering human captives for xenotech, and was not above violence when it came to acquiring what he coveted.

502cd23b-6983-4c31-91a3-aac5f14b278e.Text: A map on the vid-screen shows the movements of Sargona's fleet. According to the data, the captain was roaming between trade routes while consistently going back to systems where the Drukhari had been sighted.

90c988eb-b9c0-47de-91b3-194d31dbd3a6.Text: The Heartless's status report states that while the ship took a beating when attempting to enter the warp, it has passed that trial and remains fit for service.

348213e3-4a97-4432-ba34-b3d2c2783596.Text: "Bryce, we need a shorter path — consult the ship's schematics. Stein, check the melta charge. Clayton, keep a medikit ready — Rho-Theta may require urgent medical attention."

a6f060d5-6ef1-4896-a2ee-a2bee81ce6c8.Text: "Found it, Proctor. There should be a bulkhead nearby that we'll be able to safely detonate."

6e7e3a1e-b452-4f91-ab3f-6ab810080c8d.Text: "We have a low-power melta charge. Just enough explosive for a single passage."

9e269cfb-d3c5-4624-9356-b677e8a9bcc0.Text: "I have stimulants and bandages on hand, Proctor. Assuming Rho-Theta aren't dead by the time we show up, I'll get them back on their feet."

340613bf-d4d5-4921-bfa3-296ff63b69a6.Text: The enemy crew has blocked the door from the other side. Explosives are required to create a way through.

f18d12c7-746e-48e4-99c2-7e0cfd2d37ca.Text: "Lord Captain, we'll cover your retreat! Glory to the dynasty!"

c76bc7ed-fe6d-49e9-b4f2-a72268f6c8bb.Text: "We'll stop their reinforcements from attempting any rear attacks. We will die before we let the enemy reach you!"

533d625a-6204-4087-9b4f-d20bffcdb5da.Text: "Attention all crew, the Arbitrators have joined us aboard the Heartless! Let us give them a proper welcome!"

7b782574-1405-4336-bc55-49a8c564416b.Text: "Our guests have landed on the upper deck, above the fuel chamber. Kill them all! Show no mercy!"

15640343-56b8-4c5b-b1bd-35035c8e73b1.Text: "I will give a double share of the loot for every lawman's head you bring me!"

be026ea8-5961-4521-b028-f76b69847fff.Text: "They just fried an enemy squad in the reactor room. Too bad you could not hear them squealing!"

48d25573-239f-47aa-8d87-2b0e20619e3f.Text: "We have lost contact with the arsenal. No matter. What we need now is not macro-cannons but good old-fashioned carnage!"

389fc80f-971f-4227-8a68-82a1c163eda2.Text: "We need more reinforcements on the officers' deck. Get your carcasses up there, now!"

232c2f35-ada7-4de7-81e8-36cc1bc25011.Text: "Take back my ship, you gutter vermin, before I decide to vent a few compartments and you along with them!"

64cd8256-9960-49a1-8801-d8de81fdd7aa.Text: "Secure the approach to the bridge. All hands to the upper deck!"

0b745ef6-4616-4f96-939b-656a114781cb.Text: "Ah yes, a Rogue Trader has also decided to grace us with {rt_mf|his|her} presence. Deck the bay with {rt_mf|his|her} innards!"

5d8cb121-4255-4cf8-8acc-7aac864d5ddb.Text: "You must be very proud of yourselves, lawmen..."

934874bf-8cac-40df-bacc-27d1e46e4678.Text: "But don't even think you'll be getting either me or the Heartless! A captain and his ship always share the same fate. Always..."

ae044af6-7f86-4a04-b16a-8208cf30ef0d.Text: "Come at me, then. Come and get me... if you can!"

6450eab1-7b98-4bd8-9e7c-1d7922d59b3e.Text: "I'll ram a vox down your throat next time! Yes, this area is clear."

27282408-28fc-47d7-93e9-1e86d111e75e.Text: The barrier is crackling menacingly. Touching it bodes no good.

9ee6736f-6553-4ab8-8f7e-4aae9b2ecd2c.Text: A low rumble from the shaft tells you that an elevator from another deck is coming this way.

b7d7df2b-703d-4325-bd66-4d920a68b308.Text: The elevator shaft is filled with debris. The path for enemy reinforcements is cut off.

8a589d0e-cfd9-47be-971a-f2964698b3ce.Text: A note on the pipe reads: "Explosive. If damaged, report to the nearest infernus brigade immediately."

93b04087-3f75-4018-9087-3b8463946d4c.Text: This pile of impassable wreckage is the result of a recent shelling.

844bbcc2-3771-455c-8175-fda1a4b4d7c7.Text: A clutter of xeno-artefacts, many of them drenched in the blood of their former owners.

3e5503f1-b321-4fdd-95f8-e7c03bc5f92e.Text: The unknown xenodevice is covered in tangled wires and shows signs of crude tampering. Someone has attempted to incorporate it with human technology.

0dce1589-eda7-4eb7-b801-5fab853bc678.Text: The space from which the captain addresses the officers — far more modest than its counterpart of the Rogue Trader's vessel.

8ee46ccf-5d5d-4011-915a-fcc539df9edd.Text: Promethium tubes are connected to the fuel tank.

acc08873-9d5b-4213-ae16-148b4e4f1e84.Text: Judging by the mess, the Enginseer in charge fled the turret control post in a panic.

bfffd5f9-3ea8-4772-96ed-2af4f31a35cc.Text: The unlocking mechanism cannot be activated — it has been completely melted by a shot from the flagship's weapons.

651c81c0-c7c7-4581-9cc5-076755b2e0d9.Text: "Throne's blood... Bryce, Stein, Clayton, I am witness to your final judgement. Sargona will not escape me. I swear it."

9d683c15-96ff-4bd3-bb12-5538fec9764d.Text: "We have the advantage. Formation K-12. Press down on the enemy!"

46182fd4-2248-4108-9dcd-527dc5d946b4.Text: "Proctor, the pressure in the fuel pipes is at its limit. We could use the valve to create a diversion and roast a few of the scoundrels."

ab8c7669-a37b-41cd-ac8c-59076446ff25.Text: "Groxshit! Close the valve, or we're all gonna burn!"

96959271-2be1-424c-bf31-c41d5cd1cf6d.Text: "Hold it! The target is in the other direction."

c181b317-fd74-420a-b825-f2900c2b84a6.Text: "D-don't hurt me! I'm just a servant!"

49effb9e-acbb-413c-bfa9-1c3dd71cf45d.Text: The cogitator's wayward machine spirits refuse to grant you access to its data.

2b9c3590-4244-49f9-a6d2-3f9a207a94c2.Text: Judging from the deck plans, there is a small room hidden behind the elevators that did not make it onto the Arbitrators' diagram.

02330c1b-8db0-4dee-831c-537613f8800b.Text: "Clear the debris quickly, or the captain will have us skinned alive!"

b66eb888-27a7-4a37-8098-ef6a40c058df.Text: "Put it out! Put it out! The fire will spread at any moment!"

232a9f8a-ad0e-4127-bb43-c13518df6c32.Text: "The pressure! How's the pressure? I just hope it doesn't blow..."

8bc39fe7-d982-4df5-a679-4af6bf04b6cb.Text: "We will have to redistribute the power if the life support systems fail..."

054a9e50-7dbb-4d15-80ae-44a8d46950a1.Text: The command runes flash, indicating an error and requesting that you repeat your access attempt.

c4b928bf-a990-45fc-bb4d-3146db9d44aa.Text: This place looks like a medicae facility as devised by a psychopath. The contents of the tub exude a sharp chemical smell.

6aa6fbbe-78a1-4739-84e3-64819bdde845.Text: This place vaguely resembles a chamber used for rejuvenat treatments. The sinister appearance of the devices installed all around the tub suggests their Drukhari origin.

0cee23e9-65c3-4b58-b41b-5fa158419f0c.Text: The abominable creature behind the thick glass is showing no signs of life.

e6556d9d-c615-419d-9bf1-ce36119b91f8.Text: Floating in the greenish liquid is a Drukhari medusae: a dangerous parasite that absorbs its victim's emotions.

dd7f16fd-30ad-4b68-8fb4-a7bc1c2814f5.Text: Your efforts are rewarded with a dying spark flaring from the cable followed by a whiff of acrid smoke. It appears you will be unable to connect the vid-screen.

c49040ae-89cc-43ba-b5be-a679946e079a.Text: All of your manipulations are fruitless. The xenodevice refuses to come to life.

e1adab6b-ba41-4d3e-9f93-66613f4e5c33.Text: The xenodevice is lacking energy. You will have to connect it to a power source to use it.

ff78f5ed-992c-41c7-ac8e-08913421355c.Text: The xenodevice comes to life with a low hum, then goes quiet, awaiting your actions.

29862955-57e5-484a-9c6d-59f8d665033d.Text: You touched the insidious xenos cogitator, and it touched you in turn.

983602ce-d974-4ae8-88d7-589160ac8091.Text: In Sargona's eyes, you are no longer just an enemy, but one branded by the warp — a manifestation of certain doom.

56e13b90-caf1-482a-8bf1-42957398de90.Text: Solomorne's and the Rogue Trader's squads act with greater effectiveness thanks to the Lord Captain's past combat experience in the Adeptus Arbites.

a013eae8-ee9f-4d49-b3c1-3b70ec18d03b.Text: The Rogue Trader's speech has bolstered the Arbitrators' morale. Let the wrath of the Lex Imperialis fall upon the heretics!

e76e66a5-c863-4bb5-8e20-64e5e8d2ae1b.Text: A sinister-looking device that blends Imperium technology with the unholy knowledge of the xenos. Sargona used it to take his psyker abilities to their absolute limits. However, it is common knowledge that everything comes at a price.

e3b77c12-5423-4e8b-8d1d-6627279c78ce.Text: Open the door in the lower chamber

f64da2e6-8923-4caa-a2d0-63cfe65b3eb3.Text: Send Glaito to close the valve

368ac3a1-c711-4791-bfb4-a352f9fb39bf.Text: Blow up the fuel pipe with a shot

30c5bfe8-8d53-49aa-99f1-3e3934846285.Text: By defiling his ship with xenotech, Captain Sargona has scorned the ancient prohibitions of the Lex Imperialis. But in committing the heinous act of stealing the sacred tithe, he has forfeited even the slightest chance of dying a righteous death.

019e7180-1374-4615-984c-fbac8f5d5d37.Text: The justice of the Adeptus Arbites is implacable — and inescapable for anyone foolhardy enough to violate the sacred Imperial Law.

8312d866-4352-45b4-aec5-29f001fe146a.Text: "This boarding mission turned out to be more dangerous than expected. I believe additional compensation is in order?"

d271148e-7e65-47db-acc3-5f5b9a9a3edc.Text: "I want to have a look around first."

ead46511-3577-4f8d-a13a-71204e422633.Text: "All targets eliminated. Perimeter clear. I suggest we return to the flagship and debrief."

8f276d71-0043-4214-9e2a-5e32a1d2fdb7.Text: "A reasonable proposal. I think I have something you may find interesting. We can discuss the details back on your bridge."

acb14584-75db-4b8b-8354-4f2a24147461.Text: {n}Solomorne nods.{/n} "Acknowledged. We will depart when you're ready."

da9d525e-237d-4ff2-a434-0535deb97d56.Text: "The hollow threats of a man whose ship has been boarded."

5d5c2453-b349-4629-98a6-e3aadfd2b0b7.Text: "What a cheap trick. Surely you do not expect me to run back to my flagship, do you?"

5e5de8e8-97c8-451e-a6ab-23a55f0ad668.Text: "Why did you steal the tithe? Did you really think you could escape the Imperium's wrath?"

99dda6fa-b3be-4d43-aabb-6445b8811761.Text: "Just the man I wanted to see. How is my recaf coming along? I do not like it too hot."

f1f2f3cd-de4c-463e-9982-711b5e3ad456.Text: "Someone else is pulling the strings here, aren't they?"

0810177f-97db-4e8b-a4ee-9aa10c0db010.Text: "Is this the best servo-herald you could find to speak to me? It's a defective piece of rubbish."

ebd4806d-1fca-4635-9599-e63ada859cd0.Text: {n}The servo-skull projects a hololithic image of a man boasting a slew of exotic augmetics and an ostentatious jacket.{/n} "Are you enjoying yourself, von Valancius? I see you and your pet Arbitrators are crawling all over my ship like little void rats..."

0e964d0c-b3b5-485c-81e4-44913c762e4d.Text: "...and thrashing it with the gusto of a raging grox! Well then, when I get my hands on you, perhaps I should treat you like a grox — I will hang you from hooks between your ribs and cut off a piece of you for every breach you have made in the Heartless."

994bf4c1-4775-45cb-a0eb-255dbcb24ae0.Text: "Brave words. But have you considered the possibility that I have allowed you to stride ever so confidently into my hands? It is that overconfidence that has sealed your fate."

63bdfe4c-5d5f-4e5b-8737-8de41475546e.Text: "On the contrary — I would very much prefer that you continue to stand there like a pompous fool for just..." {n}He clicks his chrono open theatrically.{/n} "...one more second. My gift to you, Rogue Trader."

1078ac2e-f826-48dc-af12-53f13bcdccdd.Text: "And do you really think it's all so simple?" {n}Sargona licks his lips anxiously, almost compulsively.{/n} "Then you are thicker than an Ogryn. Don't trouble your sorry little head — you are about to lose it regardless."

d566931b-facb-43aa-9b28-a20bbeaa3f17.Text: "The recaf will be ready soon enough. I will brew it in your skull, you impudent wretch — if there is anything left of it."

b40ed8f5-fdc7-45b6-8759-eb79d286924f.Text: "That skull, unlike your own, is in perfect working order. The signal from the detonator is almost through — time to adorn the deck with your intestines."

682f549c-c343-4f98-a1b9-54cdea520124.Text: "Do try to make it to the bridge — I would like to shake the throat of such a troublesome individual."

d73811c8-405c-45f8-90d1-cc0af1ff2bd0.Text: {n}Something within the servo-skull emits a shrill beep, and Sargona's image flickers for just a moment.{/n}

6131aadd-65e2-4f5f-b776-bd0c184c0729.Text: {n}Idira cries out in a hollow voice, clutching her temples.{/n} "Bloody... What trap? Where? My head is not a vox-hub — don't shout all at once!"

f8563063-81de-422f-912f-cf530fbb3b26.Text: {n}A red microlumen flashes inside the servo-skull — very much like the lumen on a melta charge.{/n}

0075fc3f-7387-4785-90db-1200d70262e9.Text: "Oh, I would love to tell you, except..." {n}He smiles, displaying teeth inset with mother-of-pearl.{/n} "There is no point in talking to corpses."

912287b0-a251-4aca-bacd-338dcb82ec0b.Text: [Unleash powers of the warp against your enemies] "Fall, you worms!"

13d942c3-e8a6-4456-af92-5d8209e59b55.Text: "Would you indulge me by answering a few questions?"

95cb89c2-3a4f-486b-9a1f-f5d1186fec26.Text: "You are not very talkative for someone who is about to die."

86de0d64-594e-46f0-ac25-99e29e323b3f.Text: [Address the pirates] "Whoever brings me Sargona's head will receive a pardon and a spot on my flagship's crew!"

0188437c-17a3-4bc7-932d-749f24503a1d.Text: [Give Solomorne a three-finger signal and attack the guard] "This has been a grand waste of my time... Now!"

90ed48b9-5a7e-49c9-b4cc-b8b3fb5b2525.Text: [Charge into battle] "Enough! I am carrying out your sentence!"

691cdc47-83cb-4420-9d76-f0966f2cef28.Text: [Strike the barricade] "You coward, Sargona! Do you think this pitiful trap will keep you safe?"

db58488e-8e84-48a6-adde-d1e3bb74f969.Text: "You are guarded by a mere handful of men and servitors — hardly enough to stop me."

81322cc6-d6d3-47af-aeed-92dbcff3d1a7.Text: "Your little ploys won't stop me from getting my recaf!"

67542b9e-cb3e-43cd-9b77-520400d82e8f.Text: [Fill your voice with the promise of inexorable punishment] "Who among you pirate scum will dare raise their hand against a disciplinary officer and learn first-hand what kind of death I have prepared for you?"

ef9257ad-f7d3-4ce7-8cb7-896aedbdcf20.Text: "Who helped you to steal the tithe? It could not have been Governor Medineh."

24d22f2e-da9c-4ba8-9671-1b6c845d237e.Text: [Nod at the strange machines] "An interesting choice of decorations for a ship's bridge..."

6ddca98b-ebda-449d-82d6-02a53059a1fe.Text: [Destroy one of the suspicious devices] "You have such fascinating toys. I wonder what they look like on the inside."

d6418aec-4d40-49cd-b0e1-fd66ea27e2b1.Text: [Look at Sargona's henchmen] "If you have grown weary of the pirate's life — stand and fight with me. You all know that, in such circumstances, the right to come aboard is earned with blood."

d8800762-71a0-43b5-be5a-74d3e98e1509.Text: "Are you actually going to send the ship into the warp? Fool, you do not know what lurks beneath the fabric of reality. Unlike me."

722e4f72-686d-4346-8977-4890f2e9bb77.Text: {n}Sargona's forehead is covered in sweat, and his expensive jacket is mottled with burn marks. His hands are in constant movement as he works the controls for the {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}warp engine{/g}.{/n} "So, von Valancius, you think you have won? Think again — I still have one last card to play."

40d7e636-5f22-4c77-992f-8a388b8e7c40.Text: {n}You unleash the full power of the warp on the green-tinged screen, but it passes straight through without doing any visible damage.{/n}

bdb2a293-ba1b-4002-aaeb-cdb9318783e4.Text: {n}{d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Psyker}Sorcerous power{/d} spills out into realspace and crashes against the minds of those who have dared oppose the von Valancius dynasty.{/n}

135137f9-53af-454e-943d-4d8388bf29a8.Text: {n}Screams of terror fill the bridge as unnatural, indescribable fear takes hold of your foes.{/n}

fb42fbf2-a61c-4412-808a-5903ee8268da.Text: {n}Sargona flinches as if from a blow. His soft whisper takes on a sinister note:{/n} "Both of us are going to die here, von Valancius, but even so, I would rather not say. You have no idea who you are up against."

63a0a989-7ca2-4ca5-825f-f08823e0b169.Text: "If there is even the slightest chance that I might live... I would rather keep my mouth shut."

12912d49-8575-4250-bb42-5545adc059ee.Text: {n}Sargona bares his teeth.{/n} "The {g|Encyclopedia:MachineSpirit}machine spirits{/g} of these 'decorations' will accelerate the start of my warp engine... and our deaths, von Valancius. Take a good look at the last thing you'll ever see."

03603155-83be-49ef-934e-5ea08e4ed012.Text: {n}The captain of the Heartless meets your gaze, and you see in his eyes the desperate courage of one who knows he is doomed. He sneers, then pulls the warp engine lever.{/n} "Let the gates open! We are headed for the abyss, von Valancius, and you and I have front row seats!"

62975abd-9f78-432f-be49-3decec7d7716.Text: {n}Your voice echoes across the bridge. A few of the pirates nod at each other and point their weapons at their captain.{/n}

df6cf274-6e1c-4edd-8801-157cdef56e85.Text: "Then come closer and have a taste! Or are you afraid of getting burnt?" {n}Your shot passes straight through the screen without doing any damage. Sargona casts a quick glance at one of the generators off to the side, as if checking that it is still intact.{/n}

d751fb59-4755-468c-aa61-336732d225f0.Text: {n}You aim your weapon. The muzzle roars — and now there is one fewer guard to deal with.{/n}

9016d5e7-e90b-4182-a54e-db35deae6dd8.Text: {n}You concentrate on your target... and the pirate falls under the onslaught of warp energies.{/n}

75abe2fc-5eb7-45c9-82a7-ac3b697b36f2.Text: "What is it with you and recaf?" {n}For a moment, it looks like Sargona is about to explode, but then, with visible effort, he reins himself in.{/n} "If I survive today, I swear I'll see you supplied with recaf for the rest of your life — I'll boil you in it!"

d6c84fe9-1536-48a0-acd6-a844ed8b64c8.Text: {n}Your weapon sparks and heats up in your hands — another second and the screen would have burnt your fingers. Sargona gives you a tired grin.{/n}

2e7b1bb4-8a1b-412a-83f2-98c30a7a1d25.Text: {n}Pasqal's visor clicks anxiously as it switches repeatedly between different optical lenses and focal points.{/n} "Sacrilegious data-mixing... Heresy... Tech-atrocity..."

defbf22c-f22d-43ca-b402-463a2bcee559.Text: {n}Solomorne catches your eye, then nods subtly toward the most frightened-looking of Sargona's guards and drags a finger across his palm, signalling: "That one dies first."{/n}

50e46656-6d2b-41c7-a1e8-75ffb1d7f22f.Text: {n}You dash toward your target. One precise strike — and the pirate's body crumples to the floor.{/n}

23c0988a-0323-4f2d-b2a7-0ed15d3c5862.Text: "I am registering a Category Two blasphemy: defilement of a sacred creation of the Omnissiah via impure code. The sentence is torturous disposal." {n}Pasqal's drilling mechadendrite shrieks with a spray of still-fresh blood.{/n}

133ce221-b253-46a4-a3bb-c1f9d76b68be.Text: {n}A few of the pirates give their captain a sidelong glance, but it appears their fear of him has prevailed.{/n}

33e45120-ba04-4038-b990-2605210fac55.Text: {n}Your shot passes through the screen without doing any damage to it. Sargona gives you a tired grin.{/n}

4aafa89e-049f-41f6-91c3-2b7f97365e4b.Text: {n}The sight of your figure emanating authority and your {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Navy}knowledge of the ancient laws of the void{/d} cause several pirates to reconsider their options. They instantly aim their weapons at Sargona.{/n}

e0c61073-accd-4932-ae60-09eee699a0af.Text: {n}The words of a {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Commissar}former Commissar{/d} find their mark: several void thugs lose their nerve and promptly decide to switch sides — probably in panic rather than in some insane hope of receiving your mercy.{/n}

1658248b-2bde-4596-9cb4-555e55077c3a.Text: {n}Like a thousand needles, the painful proximity of the Empyrean pierces {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Psyker}your sorcery-touched soul{/d}, and you realise that Sargona is not bluffing — he really is willing to condemn everyone here to a terrible fate.{/n}

5d65ebcf-7d67-432d-ae99-ce480ffb1f65.Text: "You touched the {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Signs}forbidden{/d} and survived?" {n}His voice is laced with panic.{/n} "No wonder you're so hard to kill. But hard doesn't mean impossible!"

f8f9af0f-29b9-49f3-9dc0-2a477174921c.Text: "We are both trapped here, Rogue Trader. But unlike you, I at least grasp the scale of the situation." {n}Your shot passes straight through the screen without doing any damage. Sargona casts a quick glance at one of the generators off to the side, as if checking that it is still intact.{/n}

c7608437-6875-4069-952a-d648b3690d93.Text: "We are both trapped here, Rogue Trader. But unlike you, I at least grasp the scale of the situation." {n}Your attack passes straight through the screen without doing any visible damage. Sargona casts a quick glance at one of the generators off to the side, as if checking that it is still intact.{/n}

1dd8b076-f8a7-41e0-9123-f8b4a0cf85be.Text: "We are both trapped here, Rogue Trader. But unlike you, I at least grasp the scale of the situation." {n}Your weapon sparks and rebounds, unable to pierce the screen. Sargona casts a quick glance at one of the generators off to the side, as if checking that it is still intact.{/n}

2dc9fe8f-cf07-474b-9dad-2cb534001648.Text: "You miscalculate: Slither-in-Darkness is the most dangerous xeno-mercenary in this part of the sector. And my Helmsman… After all the atrocities he has committed, it would be difficult to call him human."

f07e9c93-1663-4239-bff2-0a5974493b31.Text: "What? Questions? What in the void are you talking about?" {n}Palpable hysteria breaks through Sargona's voice, but he does not pull the lever just yet.{/n}

640b5b11-6f87-4cff-b40b-14b998bf38c5.Text: {n}Covering you, Solomorne throws a flash grenade such that its light masks Glaito's movements. A moment later, the cyber-mastiff's jaws clamp down on the second bodyguard's leg.{/n}

adea0a52-b286-46f0-98ff-1752e4e68f4a.Text: "Then come closer and have a taste! Or are you afraid of getting burnt?" {n}Your attack passes straight through the screen without doing any visible damage. Sargona casts a quick glance at one of the generators off to the side, as if checking that it is still intact.{/n}

a56cf127-cb17-40e0-8de0-53c561f15a5f.Text: {n}Your act of sorcery coincides with Sargona's desperate roar. The resulting warp wave emanating from the pirate captain shatters your psychic attack.{/n}

802279e2-c92a-4786-8e2e-5c44d8bc3b41.Text: "The Heartless has lost its {g|Encyclopedia:GellerField}Geller field{/g}, Sargona. A warp jump without it would be worse than death. Even you are not crazy enough to—"

38732965-2a59-4fd0-baf2-12420069aa8f.Text: "WANT TO FIND OUT?" {n}Sargona's tongue darts out to wet his lips, and his voice drops from a shout to a whisper:{/n} "What's that thing you lawmen always say — any last words?"

61bcbce4-24cd-4e6e-b403-ad7ae4764745.Text: {n}The moment you glance at the sacred machines installed around the bridge, several of the pirates grow visibly nervous, exchanging looks and shifting from one foot to another. Whatever these devices are, they carry some special importance.{/n}

189a4278-c2d2-4739-8c9f-85e02d827d19.Text: "What was the nature of the arrangement between the Arbites and Theodora?"

46a20891-a757-4e6a-a1ee-764cb23a0bd1.Text: "Was this tithe stolen from my domain?"

80ef88c6-f9f5-4cd3-88e8-7c342306094e.Text: "Hmm. So, you're offering me a ship that I have to capture myself? Hardly a profitable bargain, is it?"

c1dfe6dd-e9ef-482b-bfe2-5bdc69f6933f.Text: "Tell me more about the ship you are promising me."

35806ac1-fcd6-4f63-8583-0f006d132c13.Text: "I may have other matters to attend to en route to the Mundus Nullius. Will you be able to accompany me?"

2aebfa8c-e565-4394-bdc8-59f1c71500db.Text: "That is an impressive dog you have."

1173dfe2-4501-450e-9748-2fc65cab851f.Text: "Well, where is the Marshal? Why send a Proctor with this request?"

495a1622-1901-4571-94a9-b928cdd51a6c.Text: "Why have you approached me and not Winterscale? Rykad Minoris was his world."

e797d0b7-ce76-481d-952d-adcaecec0353.Text: "I don't want the ship — I want a cut of the tithe."

8254812d-0a26-4197-ad85-f09a0fd983aa.Text: "It is a pleasure to see you, Solomorne. And you, Glaito."

e30da127-f5a6-410b-9688-43ab59fd8862.Text: "Counter-offer: I get the ship, and an Arbitrator joins my retinue as well."

b1a1f171-696e-466a-b22a-da3dc7b1f04c.Text: "I will help the Adeptus Arbites. What is the plan?"

d6c06228-3d34-4f4e-9f83-b9aa00277718.Text: "I expect to be well compensated for my efforts, or else I shall be severely displeased. Now tell me the particulars."

72b8c09a-c5e6-4895-a075-81182576ea99.Text: "You are here to beg for my help? Well, go on, then, make your case. Perhaps you have found me in a helpful mood."

b572f970-60e5-4ef2-875c-90c0e31a4c93.Text: [Return the data-slate] "I remember all the commands perfectly well."

5cb1570b-3ff9-463f-85b7-df0ca89c6292.Text: "I need more information about the thief."

75b2e783-9030-43aa-afdb-3d9384039904.Text: "I have no more questions. Board the flagship and await my command."

ad990a57-82ec-4477-867a-53b5c8c45ff6.Text: "I knew you would be back, begging another boon... First the rescue from Rykad, now this."

b3f65d86-0606-4186-b535-44f56710af6d.Text: "It is poor form for a Rogue Trader to refuse to help servants of the law."

1f9fa80d-22ec-4a87-88b2-1b31809b4053.Text: "So, you've lost a ship and you want someone else to solve your problem?"

f62afa64-4d0c-4253-ae74-d9e6b1cbb28d.Text: "I dislike my call sign. A Rogue Trader needs something grand — Emperor's Eagle, for example."

bc7f000e-5d78-4dcb-b791-0f4d7e50fcd7.Text: "Greetings, Proctor. You did the right thing in coming to me."

027d6635-fd7b-45e2-9be9-51e142ab39fb.Text: "I suggest we move to a more private location where we can provide you with the case files."

f719bf27-ed92-44e9-99f7-f66cd3dfe080.Text: {n}The formidable-looking man offers you a salute. His armour is immaculately polished, and a hulking cyber-mastiff sits at his feet. The Arbitrator's face reveals nothing but imperturbable equanimity, and his gaze is cold and weighty as befits an enforcer of the law.{/n} "Proctor-Exactant Solomorne Anthar. I greet you on behalf of the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusArbitesGlossary}Adeptus Arbites{/g}."

c355fc5b-ff18-47fa-9757-71e763e7ece0.Text: "Thank you for responding to my request, Rogue Trader. I am here on the orders of Marshal Strachs to ask for your help. We are in pursuit of a tithe thief. We must board the thief's ship, execute the heretic for his crimes, and return the sacred tribute to the protection of the Adeptus Arbites. The reward for your assistance in this matter will be the thief's frigate, the Heartless, which we will capture in the course of the mission."

b50fa678-c47a-457a-ad17-213e5048a5ae.Text: "Your predecessor made a formal alliance with us. She provided us with a headquarters on Dargonus and supported us in the collection and guarding of the {g|Encyclopedia:TitheGlossary}Imperial Tithe{/g} on several occasions. We, in turn, assisted Lady Theodora in enforcing the law on the worlds under her control."

9aa5e9f4-63ea-46bb-9456-6ad333de4a1a.Text: "From Rykad Minoris. The tithe ship departed shortly before the world fell and has not been in contact since. Our investigation revealed that the ship was plundered and destroyed. I already know the name and approximate location of the culprit."

ef4eeea5-9c31-4d13-8be4-23c6dadca0a3.Text: "What I am offering is the coordinates of your future trophy and a team of Arbitrators to help you take the vessel. You will be enriched and you will be continuing the alliance formed by Lady Theodora with the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusArbitesGlossary}Adeptus Arbites{/g}. It is for you to judge the value of this opportunity."

7e41bb17-49c0-43df-bb2c-77b572da615a.Text: "Do not mistake this as an attempt at bargaining, but I promise you — if you agree to help us, you will see how truly impressive Glaito is in action."

b1320882-4711-4c5e-ae55-7a1567bb90ea.Text: "No. I'm still on mission, and in your absence, my subordinates and I will be checking weapons and finalising tactics for the assault. In other words, we will be wholly occupied with preparations."

714e527c-279f-4517-8581-97c285320ede.Text: "The Heartless is the enemy flagship. It has been corrupted with inhuman technology, but you have the necessary resources to purge it of xenos filth and make it serve the Imperium once more. Even if you don't wish to own a ship previously crewed by pirates, you will have prospective buyers lining up to take it off your hands."

b0da0fdc-ee9e-4249-b0bd-c37faf1368c1.Text: "He is a former privateer and a fugitive psyker. At one time he was involved in the {g|Encyclopedia:ColdTrade}Cold Trade{/g} and the supply of xenos mercenaries, but his pirate habits got the better of him and he started robbing his associates. Now even among the criminal rabble he is known as a nasty piece of work — something of an achievement, you will agree. Sargona is cunning, cruel, and unpredictable."

e5e5427e-6ab4-4df2-ba7a-a6fdc3a7fae4.Text: "Marshal Strachs is not on Dargonus at present, so he appointed me to speak on his behalf — time is of the essence when there is a heretic to catch. I am sure he will present himself to you as soon as he returns to your capital world."

102b9842-a7b5-461c-93df-517a6af0b271.Text: "I did and I was rebuffed. As Rogue Trader Winterscale rightly pointed out, from the moment of the tithe's collection, responsibility for it transfers to the Adeptus Arbites. He also noted that the loss of a world is not an inconsiderable detriment to his protectorate, and he has no intention of expending resources to recover something that no longer belongs to him."

8eb1ad96-059d-453c-a7da-11a85c816d61.Text: "I'm no expert on ships, but when I questioned the captains on Footfall about the Heartless, they were almost salivating as they listed its virtues."

392f2419-e777-4930-a19d-0517a7a1f813.Text: "Out of the question. The tithe is inviolable and belongs to the Imperium. No faithful servant of the Emperor would dare take any part of the sacred tribute."

38c73e7f-f5f4-480d-8f18-92a8a3900bed.Text: "I do not have the power to choose my assignments, Rogue Trader. However, if the mission is successful, the Marshal is unlikely to refuse to deploy me as your escort."

ec8a0fec-898b-4530-a92b-38e7b1662f0e.Text: {n}Without so much as a flicker in his expression, Solomorne commands,{/n} "Glaito, speak! Not every cyber-mastiff receives a personal greeting from a Rogue Trader — such an honour warrants a response."

96e3625d-abde-4d34-8aa8-835ab07b7e8e.Text: "Shortly after the fall of Rykad Minoris, I questioned the Liege of Footfall. He supplied me with exhaustive information about Sargona and his ship and gave the Arbitrators full access to the docks. I suspect Tocara's compliance stems from some bad blood between him and Sargona. Scum eating scum — nothing new there."

b26fa76a-cceb-43ab-8641-369135774667.Text: "Indeed. One {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Arbitrator}never truly leaves the Arbites{/d}." {n}Solomorne gives you a deferential nod.{/n} "I meant no disrespect to your skills, but I prefer to err on the side of caution."

b9b67ef5-8096-4124-8849-67bf58d0c1a5.Text: "Under similar circumstances in the past, our arrangement would have obliged us to turn to Lady Theodora. She was a key figure in supporting the {g|Encyclopedia:LexImperialisGlossary}Lex Imperialis{/g} in the Koronus Expanse."

bfab034f-bd45-41f2-a7af-dd2f4edc373b.Text: "Good. Do you have any further questions?"

f8032604-1ca6-4410-b238-1f52d6c2ea35.Text: "Captain Sargona and his flagship, the Heartless, are concealed in Mundus Nullius. The exact location can only be determined with your ship's augurs when we enter the system."

03eded48-ac9b-492b-b495-dab59b5e7832.Text: "The Heartless is escorted by a small flotilla — you'll need to neutralise it in order to capture the frigate. Arbites strike teams will land on the upper deck while your boarding party handles the remaining bays. My squad of Arbitrators will take on the most difficult and dangerous part of the operation. The ultimate goal is to capture the captain's bridge, and interrogate and execute Sargona."

603d162b-ac82-4834-9563-ea37aca6007a.Text: {n}The image quality leaves something to be desired, but you can make out the criminal's surfeit of augments and sumptuous clothing. There is something haughty, almost maniacal in his bearing — like the tyrants who sooner or later proclaim themselves gods.{/n}

1b32cfd0-ec91-4d1a-bdd6-d83e0b161220.Text: "I hear the words of the true heir of Lady Theodora. And the promise of swift retribution against heretics."

a184a447-d48f-4291-8bf2-ae93e095f9e7.Text: "Stein — transfer the latest data. Bryce — hologram." {n}Solomorne gives you a data-slate.{/n} "This one has the complete file."

61d36439-0e5d-4cfe-9340-160d4fab6629.Text: "Acknowledged." {n}Solomorne lays his hand on the back of the mastiff's neck and says, more to his dog than to you,{/n} "Sargona is already dead — he just doesn't know it yet."

fdbb7e9d-0df7-48e1-9ec9-2b89545e0930.Text: "We'll take it!" {n}Jae's eyes light up with the excitement of a gambler who has just drawn a trump card.{/n} "We are taking it, aren't we, shereen? It's a whole extra flagship, and practically for free..."

ca9396b8-6755-43d5-83a0-ce6e7bc5eb93.Text:
{n}Sentenced: Guido Sargona.
Homeworld: unknown
Psyker. Speciality: pyromancy. Formerly sanctioned. Abandoned his post on a privateer ship and joined the pirates.
Confirmed links: Kasballica, xenos, alleg. heretical cults.
Also implicated in at least 15 attacks on trading vessels.
Status: Alive.{/n}

31b3cb11-1861-419a-a7e1-b7903ba43695.Text: "I will only note that the xenotech equipment is to be destroyed, not studied comprehensively, Magos Explorator."

b39a1954-81a1-4aca-b304-9308bfa66a86.Text: "Doing the Imperium a service is worth more than satisfying any personal desire — especially one as... undignified as yours, Jae."

2ee5e290-aca2-42fc-b0f7-493bb88ae85e.Text: "You {d|Encyclopedia:BS_SolonornOnRaycadDecision}saved my squad from a dying world{/d}, and you also agreed to meet with me. Both facts have emboldened me to... 'beg,' as you put it."

7fb62ed0-94d2-48fc-bb52-56e337d31ffc.Text: "DX-1 means I am in command of the Delta-Xi squad. It's one of our standard designations for strike teams in the Expanse. RT-1 is you, the Rogue Trader and leader of the Rho-Theta squad. For a short mission like this one, these identifiers should suffice."

100c56a6-c840-4f25-905b-5530c2689edb.Text: "The following call signs will be used for vox-communication during the mission: you will be RT-1, and I will be DX-1. I also request you use Arbites sign language throughout. Non-verbal commands are faster than speaking and will allow us to catch our target unawares. Here is a short list." {n}Solomorne holds out a data-slate to you.{/n}

b894b896-a4d2-4385-b893-fd18b7a041d7.Text: {n}There are two dozen basic commands, from head nods to combinations of hand gestures. Everything you need to quickly and efficiently communicate enemy position and numbers, and even coordinate joint attacks.{/n}

9707a9a8-9782-43e0-bf96-d0371693d72d.Text: "It is not for me to judge the Emperor's anointed. Not least when I cannot fault his reasoning."

4609a83d-6880-4721-89ba-f32eda13268d.Text: "The ship was not lost — it was stolen. If breaking the law were an impossibility, there would be no Adeptus Arbites. In the Calixis Sector, our forces would have caught up with that heretic by now and brought him to justice, but the Arbitrators here do not have such resources."

230fe62e-1b1e-4564-9b9b-227b569e060c.Text: "However, we can still requisition vessels. But there is no ship on Footfall with {g|Encyclopedia:Augur}augurs{/g} powerful enough to track down the heretic. Your flagship, on the other hand, boasts advanced technology and impressive firepower. I assure you, if there were a suitable vessel at the docks, I would not be troubling you with this matter."

7d1e5f90-6e3a-4008-a5aa-540ba0456b13.Text: "In a tactical assault, the shorter the call sign, the lower your chances of getting shot while you're saying it. But so be it, Emperor's Eagle."

808b18cf-0f58-436a-835c-a28c1fb39efe.Text: "The task is relatively simple: kill all enemies we encounter and not let them kill us. Sargona must be taken alive for questioning, but I and my team will handle that. There is one other thing."

916937eb-4af5-49e5-a0e1-3aa6bdc8d192.Text: {n}Pasqal's vox-synthesiser comes alive with a crackling hiss.{/n} "Purifying and removing a ship equipped with blasphemous modifications from the hands of apostates is the sacred duty of all servants of the Omnissiah... and of the Emperor."

3b1d2a3d-4ff7-44c3-8926-e8984d677682.Text: "And I thank you, my knight in shining armour, for being so valiant and solicitous."

8beaeab9-6c51-4acc-830d-2d258dc4a6bb.Text: "You and Glaito would have managed without my help. Actually, I do believe that dog could have captured the ship all on its own."

51159feb-901e-4254-87fa-654e092884cf.Text: "You know, there is a certain appeal to all this — standing side by side, upholding the Lex. I would say you and I make a good team, no?"

71ac7b1c-5221-43e3-9186-6d0958d79d2b.Text: "I assume throwing you out of an airlock right now would prompt questions from your Marshal later? So be it: I accept — as long as you keep that mutt of yours on a chain."

39067bcd-ff12-4147-a220-91a6dce1a74a.Text: "Have the ship sent to our trading partners."

dd0d177a-00bf-4f39-bf70-1577a37c2d70.Text: "I wish to see the Heartless as my escort. Once it is cleansed and restored to its proper state, have it protect the flagship."

6b625ec9-21d3-414c-a40e-ed422e6694e1.Text: "Purge the Heartless of any corruption, patch it up, and assemble a loyal crew. Henceforth, it will serve as a trade vessel for the von Valancius worlds."

3744f3a1-4d66-44c5-b9fb-bc73a5db8587.Text: [Move closer and whisper in his ear] "An excellent plan, Proctor. Are you ready to execute it?"

a84157e4-00bf-43b0-b56e-33f045845c45.Text: [Smile] "A most thrilling plan. But you have to spend all night writing up reports instead."

4fe11587-5327-4262-a918-809d5fcfaae2.Text: "I want that oversized tub out of my sight. Give the Heartless over to the recolligers to be turned into scrap."

87f279b2-2070-450f-80bb-28679f81efc4.Text: "I know. I'm just teasing, and you're acting like a little boy."

541d3a67-99a4-4582-9ccc-d7bf6885ac82.Text: "I think we should start with ablutions and then move on to everything else. Agreed?"

bcdd5406-e5c1-471d-8451-35889a772448.Text: "I have changed my mind. I want to put the ship to a different use."

a89ff912-21d2-489c-87db-5feafa97008c.Text: "I appreciate the irony of the situation. My whole life I have avoided lawmen like the plague, and now one is asking to join my retinue — a Proctor, no less."

71b6e7fe-2177-4580-9498-0e5507a9ba48.Text: [Give detailed instructions on how the Heartless should be refitted] "The vessel in question will join my personal fleet and protect the dynasty flagship."

a7c1e5d4-cb72-4c0b-af31-230aea58fe1a.Text: "I have no need for the ship itself, but the scrap obtained from it could be put to good use. I know some capable voidfarers who will take the Heartless apart down to the last screw — deliver the ship to them."

a4088fb3-fcfc-4635-a991-01a8ec13ed8a.Text: "Does this mean I get to keep this fine dog to help me kill heretics? Excellent!"

9b0f40e4-1252-44e0-941a-d6731b0bb33b.Text: "Two dogs for the price of one. What a steal! Of course, both still need to be properly trained, but we'll get there, right?"

9d40ecdb-0213-44e9-aee3-56b14e52bb27.Text: "Yes, you should be thanking me! Judging by this operation, all they teach you is how to stand at attention and die when ordered."

37ba6a51-7eed-4e0b-8c4e-90d63bea7460.Text: "Assisting the Adeptus Arbites is the duty of every subject of the Imperium. I will take you to Dargonus as soon as circumstances permit."

c3815614-4b3b-4026-a533-8d6a5e2d84f6.Text: [Wink] "Reports are the last thing one feels like doing after a battle, wouldn't you agree?"

83811785-6140-4b58-b4c9-944fa6ff41bc.Text: "Are you saying you don't enjoy my company?"

925802e1-6670-45bd-b5e1-de2b4e0e6f81.Text: "Congratulations on the mission completion, Rogue Trader. On behalf of the Adeptus Arbites, I extend my thanks for your cooperation."

b6560244-d5dd-4e28-a637-ae8129c93130.Text: "The ship itself is a most impressive acquisition for the dynasty also! All it requires is some light repair work." {n}Janris rubs his hands together in anticipation.{/n} "What would you have us do with it? You could present it to our trading partners — I am confident that they would put it to good use! Alternatively, we could transfer some of your subjects to the Heartless and use it to increase trade between your own worlds. A profitable option, to be sure!"

596a3b2a-ae95-46c2-8f96-0c4c2197cd75.Text: "I doubt it. Cyber-mastiffs require commands. Either way, the Heartless is now yours, as agreed."

1bf7e8e7-0720-46c0-bcbd-c7bed5d632aa.Text: {n}The Arbitrator nods.{/n} "Yes, we do. But we can return to this later. The Heartless now belongs to you, as agreed."

0268abed-15f2-451f-8289-79b72762c516.Text: "The Marshal keeps personnel records. So, yes, it would. There might be a difficulty with the chains — Glaito bites clean through them. Still, we will try to find one that does the job." {n}The Proctor salutes and walks away.{/n}

caea7aed-842f-4aa5-8cdd-a2bef79fa6b4.Text: "And who is to receive the vessel, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}?"

a78c1c2e-ea6e-4170-a0c2-e7727cf6c4d3.Text: "I'm simply saying that it would be utterly unprofessional to involve personal feelings in a combat assignment."

b1f0f764-0a3c-4d90-a1b4-37d445a5de7f.Text: {n}The Arbitrator and his dog both watch as Janris leaves, then turn to you.{/n} "There is one more thing, Rogue Trader. Your performance aboard the Heartless was highly appreciated. As an additional token of gratitude from the Adeptus Arbites, I will be joining your personal security detail, at least until we arrive on Dargonus to meet with the Marshal. He has business to discuss with you, and I have a mountain of reports to write up about this operation."

3acfa889-48b1-4f5b-9e27-d16c7294858f.Text: "Well, now that all the financial matters have been resolved, allow me graciously to take my leave. The valuables must all be meticulously inventoried." {n}The Factotum offers you a deep bow, glancing sideways at Solomorne, who seems to be in no hurry to leave.{/n}

3553e661-b10a-4637-acf3-d809ac1094c0.Text: {n}The corners of Solomorne's lips twitch upward.{/n} "I want to spend the night with a passionate partner, to let off steam, and to give my blood a chance to cool. Afterward, I want to wash off the sweat and my enemies' gore with hot water."

edd5c0c9-67c2-469b-94c8-5540ae1ad05b.Text: {n}A chuckle escapes the Arbitrator's lips.{/n} "Very harsh."

1a03c9c0-7656-4fec-8799-e7ba62c57c77.Text: "Certainly! And what use did you have in mind for the ship afterward?"

21de7438-db28-448d-b294-9248fa965260.Text: {n}The Factotum's eyes dart over the data-slate in his hands.{/n} "I believe we can perform all the critically necessary repairs on the Heartless within the shortest time. Only the fighter launch bay and certain parts of the hull might pose some difficulties — it will take longer to fix those. Regardless, the vessel will be ready to serve the dynasty without delay."

fb65f64a-9133-4642-b6be-6c7904bbd451.Text: "But... Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}... An entire vessel—!" {n}Seeing your expression, Janris lets out a forlorn sigh and nods.{/n}

5fc416a1-71c9-4b4b-afdf-a04922c1ff52.Text: "I will send a compendium on cyber-mastiff training to your library. Some of the techniques described there also work on people if one were inclined to apply them." {n}Solomorne casts an eye at the unusually quiet bridge officers, then gives you a salute and leaves.{/n}

40eac8fc-cae3-45bc-9dad-700262f56513.Text: {n}Closing his eyes briefly, Solomorne quietly says, with a strange note of relief,{/n} "Fine, then. I'll be your valiant knight, if it pleases you."

ff4214b9-9a2a-4f8f-bd81-fa850256c328.Text: "I made no such claim." {n}The Arbitrator's expression is impenetrable, but there seems to be a spark glinting in the depths of his gaze.{/n}

56063803-a129-409b-b0b9-53f42e37c0e1.Text: {n}Solomorne adds with some gravity,{/n} "But that doesn't mean I have any distaste for you, Rogue Trader."

ac24cb6e-844f-4bfb-bcdc-f0f49768019b.Text: {n}Solomorne maintains a heavy silence for a time, then exhales quietly.{/n} "You're like a splinter, Rogue Trader. You know how to get... under a person's skin." {n}A faint but warm smile plays on his lips.{/n}

f0914fdc-d104-42a7-8168-88113249e788.Text: {n}Solomorne sighs softly.{/n} "In that case, I'd better get started on those reports."

1a80850c-ff71-4356-923f-b43b587686a3.Text: "The sacred Warrant has wiped {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Criminal}your slate{/d} clean. Now you have been summoned to serve the Emperor — and I'll be damned to the void if I ever once rebuke you for your past deeds."

70ac1969-cc7f-47dd-9372-3c38c7f33bd6.Text: "Extraordinary! Indeed it takes a {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Navy}person of your talents{/d} to turn an already exceptional ship into a true jewel of the void."

b97e6e74-8fdd-48e3-a9d2-e4e2fdf5cf5b.Text: "If a Lord Captain as {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Navy}experienced{/d} as you has deemed the ship unfit for service, then there is simply no other alternative. May the vessel's remains provide your flagship with enough repair materials for many journeys to come."

acec79f6-594a-4040-8e52-2264a408648e.Text: "On a separate note, I am grateful for your fire support as my squad advanced on the lower deck. Your marksmanship, timing — your shots on the fuel pipes gave us a significant advantage."

6b9f4606-4db6-42f4-84c7-ad4456b4e2d8.Text: "The rest is far from satisfactory. Your earlier {d|Encyclopedia:BS_HeartlessDamaged}artillery strike{/d} — though undeniably necessary — did severe damage to the ship. It can, of course, still be repaired and put to good use. We could have the Heartless escort our flagship or, say, carry goods along one of the trade routes within your domain. Those options aren't cheap by any means, but the benefits are enticing."

a7c6f735-3729-40b5-92f0-6aace76f880e.Text: "We also discovered a large supply of provisions, weapons, and xeno—" {n}The High Factotum catches himself, having seemingly just remembered Solomorne's presence.{/n} "And other valuables, which will be loaded into the flagship's holds with extreme assiduity."

015feae2-c2ce-42f9-8084-6cfa608fd02d.Text: {n}Solomorne raises his eyes to the ceiling.{/n} "I swear on the Emperor's light, I wasn't trying to express any kind of personal interest. I was simply doing my duty."

69077311-e62b-4da5-8baf-c8651625d1db.Text: {n}His eyes narrowing, Solomorne looks at you intently.{/n} "I would. And what do you like doing after a battle?"

b81ab188-c297-4723-a904-761ecc223aff.Text: "I hope those circumstances arrive soon. The longer our journey, the longer the criminals remain outside the reach of the Emperor's justice." {n}Solomorne nods at you, gives a quick salute, and leaves with Glaito at his heel.{/n}

dbfa6d8c-aa83-4754-bdd5-44ccabe15068.Text: "Indeed. My cyber-mastiff is at your disposal, Rogue Trader. Just keep your fingers to yourself around him — you wouldn't want to lose them." {n}With a nod, Solomorne takes his leave.{/n}

7afd7ebc-c05c-4424-8d60-3fad4e644877.Text: {n}The Proctor's face is stony as ever.{/n} "You are absolutely correct, Rogue Trader. Though, we are also taught how to drop dead without our bodies cluttering the path of those walking behind us. Allow me to present the Heartless to you as a more tangible show of thanks. I promised you a ship — this is it."

5d01f3e4-5758-4590-8af9-5922bbe7c72f.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, if you would permit me to interrupt: I am pleased to inform you that the boarding team has presented a most extraordinary gift to your dynasty. The heretics were keeping something of rare value in their hold. Our Enginseers have completed all the necessary rituals of cleansing. This trophy is now all yours!"

c58cb7e1-f8f6-438e-9e90-b1920ef44336.Text: "Let us go together. We will surprise Sargona with a small army."

c9017686-c662-4484-891a-7107f459fc1c.Text: "I would feel safer dispatching the cornered pirate alongside my retinue."

e7a24f6c-aaae-4ef6-abc4-17fa911562fd.Text: "I am doing you a favour, bloodhound. You had best remember it."

a71ac83a-26f2-41b7-84a8-6bc9afe51740.Text: "Relax — I understand. You are simply carrying out your mission."

ea436cf0-5237-4174-b0d3-b79317240eb6.Text: [Whisper] "Solomorne, I am pleased that you wish to be close to me in battle, but why be so blatant about it?"

c4815f2e-42d6-432f-9701-607c5de101af.Text: [Gently touch Solomorne's shoulder] "You are wounded. You have lost your comrades. You should rest and let me take care of you. I will confront Sargona myself."

86d089eb-8bda-4632-8959-adbcfd3ea78b.Text: [Laugh] "This competent warrior act is very sweet, but you're not hiding anything."

ad5831d3-7328-42b9-ab61-71915fdea7c1.Text: "You'll soon see what I'm worth in a fight. I don't need protecting."

acad2774-d1f1-44a3-acce-d27f0818a536.Text: {n}Despite multiple wounds, Solomorne stands firm. The Proctor's eyes are burning bright, like he has gotten a second wind.{/n} "My squad is down. We need to regroup. Here's what we do: I go with you, and one of your retinue stays behind to take charge of the defence along with the surviving Arbitrators."

eb22027c-db60-4935-a60f-546f4d3fad64.Text: "This will put us at a tactical disadvantage. The Heartless is still full of hostiles who will try to storm the bridge. We have to set up a defence at the elevator to avoid being shot in the back."

8ecf1722-bf28-4a4f-91f7-acad61850305.Text: "I am your shadow, Domin. I am your blade and shield. Do not cast me from your side — not when you are but a step away from the abyss."

21d51ab9-1784-431f-91fc-7b3289a3cbf6.Text: "Only one of your escort needs to be replaced. It is a minor permutation. Furthermore, I am responsible not only for Sargona's capture, but also for your survival."

b90bd01e-05b4-43e5-a9e9-a4d2e8abaed5.Text: {n}Solomorne gives you a conciliatory nod.{/n} "Indeed. I believe you are the most dangerous, relentless, and ferocious creature on this ship. It will be my pleasure to see you triumph in battle."

5b9a09f5-8b4a-4e07-82a9-23828ea30e07.Text: {n}Solomorne nods gratefully, but you catch a spark of interest dancing in the look he gives you.{/n}

bec3f4a7-ad66-4a10-8d6c-dc1e145a6662.Text: "The lawkeeper's advice is sound, Aett-Vater. Whichever of your servants are sapped of their strength, leave them here. If there is need, I can pull the weight of two fighters, or five."

ce6a8071-68f5-4609-a215-c79ad0cf6a06.Text: {n}Solomorne stills, his flinty gaze boring into you. Finally, he bites out,{/n} "I. Am. Just. Doing. My. Duty." {n}Taking a breath, he adds quietly,{/n} "And I'm trying to protect you."

36d51066-844b-4fa6-b945-a5352fc1f607.Text: "With your permission, Lord Captain, I would prefer to remain at your side. The Proctor's expertise is indisputable, but he is not your Seneschal."

7fc026f6-e600-422f-8a51-c5015be6d217.Text: {n}Solomorne carefully but firmly removes your hand.{/n} "I am on a mission, and I may permit myself no respite. The criminal who took the Arbitrators' lives must be judged, and I am the only one who can do so." {n}After catching his breath, he adds quietly,{/n} "And it is also my duty to protect you."

e8884c78-ad3f-44da-ba7e-9fc4333abcfa.Text: {n}Solomorne closes his eyes and lapses into silence as if he is praying. At last, he sighs.{/n} "Let's move out and kill someone already."

dfc8afa3-80dd-485d-b876-c1db30fdb6be.Text: [Smile] "It is very gallant of you to take the fire upon yourself to spare me."

64d8da6c-ab39-467e-8dda-defffea75423.Text: [Smile even more widely] "Your professionalism is terribly charming."

885b0bc9-52f5-4b00-a950-1d3c10737bcb.Text: "Why not go all together? We can overwhelm them with our numbers."

e151cae0-62cd-47b2-8f3a-c5e9dacbfd15.Text: "You do not know me well enough yet. It remains to be seen who will need saving, trust me."

f9be9c0f-41a5-4123-be1e-bb6040f79bb8.Text: "It sounds like it's more dangerous to go below. Why don't we switch?"

a7750f7d-0847-48a2-b216-c4a4da59f395.Text: "I am not accustomed to receiving such attentions from brave Arbites warriors. It is quite a pleasure."

5fa017c3-840c-4164-b4f0-57498fc2a375.Text: "I don't want you to die, Solomorne, so be careful. Don't risk your life on my account."

164f1e6f-f581-4cb7-8fd4-3d6e5a3324bd.Text: [Address Solomorne's squad] "Arbitrators, I expect every heretic on this ship to come to know the implacability of justice. Today, the Emperor Himself heeds your verdicts — so go and deliver death unto the enemy!"

3e5a3833-d13a-45ca-be19-6dd7b3329c91.Text: "It seems your main formation is going to be A-48. I will plan my squad's tactics with this in mind to maximise our effectiveness during the advance. The Arbitrators' strength is in coordinated action — the enemy will fall under our joint onslaught."

1fef91ce-c1e0-44ac-a4cd-5b4c097c3d13.Text: {n}With the sparest of movements, Solomorne attracts your attention.{/n} "I will lead Delta-Xi squad along the lower deck, through the tight passageways, promethium pipework, and service areas where the enemy is most at home. We will take that difficult ground. Your squad — call sign Rho-Theta — will proceed along the upper deck. The objective is to reach the elevator. Rogue Trader, I request that you personally do not put yourself in the line of fire or take any unnecessary risks — we cannot afford to lose you. Once the deck sweep is complete, we'll rendezvous to regroup and launch the assault."

cf28b630-229f-4fe8-84af-36276d85d8b6.Text: {n}Clenching his jaw, his face impenetrable, Solomorne says,{/n} "If you encounter especially stubborn resistance, summon me. I will come to your aid."

f301e602-9022-4831-aa33-51a9d8a3ec72.Text: {n}Solomorne stares at you in silence for a long time, then mutters,{/n} "Charming, indeed. I've been called many things, but that is a first."

be941042-f707-4512-a209-f4111903cb11.Text: "No, we will focus all their fire on us. Splitting up grants us tactical advantages — I know this based on dozens of successful assaults."

66170657-8103-46c5-8e68-549773dfbbd8.Text: "I don't doubt your skills in combat." {n}The corner of Solomorne's lips lifts ever so slightly in a quizzical, not-quite-smile.{/n}

3c32da97-b479-4110-ae6b-ce8fb0265bcf.Text: "I will not send a Rogue Trader into danger — not even if {mf|he|she} requests it. Your survival is a priority."

fad69806-0405-42a2-98ac-fc4f6d6b20a5.Text: "If you get into trouble, call us immediately." {n}Solomorne taps his finger on his vox. Turning to his squad, he sucks in a lungful of air and roars,{/n} "Delta-Xi squad — formation A-48! Go, go, go!"

d208ffe7-046d-4da8-87f7-19dd0d036e4f.Text: "I'm not—" {n}Solomorne sighs and rubs the bridge of his nose wearily.{/n} "It is my honour to serve the Emperor's anointed."

0b81f901-d81f-498e-afea-d00b5eb87faf.Text: {n}Solomorne puts two fingers to his ear, listening to his {g|Encyclopedia:CommBead}comm-bead{/g}.{/n} "Another Arbitrator squad has been hit hard. Find a way to open the door for us — there should be a cogitator or control panel nearby. But first, we will go down and get into position — we need to overwhelm the enemy with a surprise attack."

1c9e0824-b931-41b1-b2f0-bf5cecc9017b.Text: {n}At your words, the Arbitrators, whose presence was already formidable, begin to radiate danger. The Proctor strikes his chest with his fist.{/n} "A speech from a seasoned {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Commissar}Commissar{/d} is exactly what we needed. By the Lex, we will not fail you!"

af61f75c-9c36-4a52-9bab-5bd8fb35d9b1.Text: "You may not be {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Arbitrator}wearing the Arbites insignia any longer{/d}, but today, you are my {mf|brother|sister} in arms. And not just mine — isn't that right, Arbitrators?" {n}Solomorne's squad responds with a jubilant roar, and for a moment, you feel as though you are carrying the Marshal's mantle again.{/n}

c6506022-cc40-42bd-80ae-a8cef8240e95.Text: {n}Solomorne nods, relief written in his gaze.{/n}

f3528caf-6ece-47c5-8da6-a3b7c276670e.Text: "If you've been waiting for an opportunity to gallantly rescue a Rogue Trader from under fire and earn {mf|his|her} regard, it's time to act."

f284cf0a-88d7-449a-82eb-f693b6ffb4bb.Text: "Get me out of here! You have one minute, or I will have you patrolling Dargonus backstreets for the rest of your life!"

10ee39b8-f199-41aa-a03c-f0fe44d02935.Text: "My unit is under fire. We need assistance!"

bd739cd7-aa39-4352-b12b-97cae16ceb37.Text: "Emperor's Eagle is under attack! I repeat: Emperor's Eagle is under attack!"

07a318ad-c145-4fc4-8834-a1691b0aea0c.Text: "Solomorne, we are pinned down. Can you help? No heroics — I need you alive. It would be a shame to end our acquaintance without first getting to know each other better."

c840e598-8e5e-4ff1-98cc-c2a4ae9d91b4.Text: {n}The vox transmits the sounds of gunfire and death screams. Then, you hear Solomorne's calm voice:{/n} "This is DX-1, receiving."

5feddfb7-2d44-4227-aca9-ed6ef384ce73.Text: "Wait, I'm not—" {n}The vox abruptly falls silent, then crackles to life again with an exasperated{/n} "Copy that, advancing to assist. Stand by, DX-1 out."

d7090d9a-2448-4f67-ab61-304d355722b8.Text: "Copy that, RT-1. Stand by. Over and out."

967a01c3-cc7c-4cdd-a645-30ae6a96f2d2.Text: "Copy that, Emperor's Eagle. Stand by. Over and out."

da329598-ecd9-4016-b6e7-1fd2c2c81218.Text: {n}A dry, dispassionate voice replies over the vox,{/n} "Copy that. I'm on my way. Over and out."

3be7ee5c-339e-4404-ad5c-fb5c8817291d.Text: {n}The black cogitator you are looking at is clearly not Imperium technology. With its unnatural curves and a surface smooth like solid mercury, nothing about this machine suggests sacredness. The device has no vid-screen, but you notice the presence of dry, rust-coloured spots on the control panel.{/n}

4d9975d5-357b-4613-9d8f-1b0c644a20ae.Text: {n}You remain standing next to the cogitator. The panel is being fed by your pain, and you send a request: "Shut down life support systems." Instantly, you see — or rather sense — several people inside a crew cabin gasp for air, then sink to their knees, turn blue, and collapse lifeless to the floor. A quick death would have been too good for those traitors. You can feel their pain. You open your mind to it... The memory ends abruptly.{/n}

6167e43d-bef0-4946-a234-4c959821130b.Text: {n}A mental image comes to life: you are on your knees, your hands tied behind your back. Your wrists are painfully swollen, and your face stings with numerous abrasions. A finely dressed man stands with his back turned, but it is clearly you he is talking to.{/n} "Did you think you could betray me and get away in one piece? You were never smart, but I had no idea you were an idiot. There's nothing wrong with a bit of greed, my dear fellow. Stupidity, on the other hand...
