Think of this as me doing you a favour." {n}You barely have time to register the glint of a weapon in the captain's hand before a burst of pain shatters the traitor's skull — your skull — and your mind is released from the grip of the shared memory.{/n}

12c88df1-040c-4756-aa57-bcf604232a00.Text: "No!" {n}Breathing heavily, Cassia covers her eyes with her hand as crimson tears seep through her thin, trembling fingers.{/n} "Such rotten, rusty colours cannot possibly exist... It's all madness and lies. A mockery!"

2fb1807b-8648-4db6-ad42-a32a8a426bcc.Text: {n}The machine is refusing to let you go. It drives its needles deeper still into your flesh, trying to reach the nerve endings, and drinks greedily. You are overcome with a sensation of boundless hunger. When at last you manage to jerk your hand free, a fan-shaped splash of blood hits the panel. The machine's agony retreats from your consciousness.{/n}

c2200906-641c-439b-96c3-63a6e210015e.Text: {n}The needles slide deeper into your palm. Pain flashes through your spine like a jolt of energy, and you feel a drop of cold sweat run down your back. A string of data surfaces from deep inside the machine: it is awaiting your next orders.{/n}

4dbc3c56-e2b2-42e6-be55-4fbcd8f91691.Text: {n}You place your hands on the panel and transmit a series of mental commands into the machine, bidding it to open the sphere. Immediately, dozens of tiny needles shoot into your palms. An acrid liquid spreads through your veins. Then, a whispering thought forms in your head: access has been revoked.{/n}

b9b553b8-b3c0-4740-a100-ddd06ccd91ff.Text: {n}Pasqal's vox lets out a mournful binharic groan.{/n} "The rite of sacred diagnostics has been interrupted. Cause of interruption: a primitive method of disposal was employed against the object of study..." {n}The Tech-Priest's visor flashes red before dimming wearily.{/n} "...which had a ninety-eight percent chance of being of anathematic origin."

ee3a9505-4899-4889-8ab2-3fac72d0d692.Text: {n}This machine is controlled by pain, and you have fed it sufficiently. You place your hand on the panel — only for an instant — and send a single thought into the cogitator: "Open up." A barely audible click rises from the sphere's shell, and the walls of the prison move slowly apart, revealing a desiccated corpse. The dead man's body has stiffened in a huddled-up position, his fingers wrapped tightly around a metal object.{/n}

c5dab5cf-ab45-4b6e-afcc-f857ed2b771a.Text: {n}You touch the leather-bound buttons. In an instant, tiny needles sink into your fingers, and the machine greedily absorbs the seeping blood. A whisper-like mental echo rustles in your head: access has been granted.{/n}

c48b53a9-6313-4099-9d04-abc5a644a835.Text: "Contact with the object is categorically forbi— undesirable!" {n}Pasqal's mechadendrites freeze, scanning the foreign code greedily.{/n} "Or so it was. Omnissiah authorise and preserve us."

f264f5d4-9f6d-464a-ab0f-55706519711a.Text: "The very sight of that... mechanism... defiles us. One moment of stupidity will spell an eternity of cursed existence for all of us. Is that what you want, elantach? We must destroy it! Before the darkness of this creation touches our souls."

b86a1726-7015-4b9e-8d11-e6494caa0d82.Text: {n}A cacophony of screams explodes inside your head. Images swarm in your mind's eye — bodies... lots of bodies... your hands covered in warm blood that is not your own — the memories of the machine's first owner. The images flicker out as suddenly as they appeared. The machine has sneaked its way deep inside your consciousness, where it awaits your next command.{/n}

63aa3df9-52b0-4cf1-89f3-ed12f6639895.Text: {n}In one swift movement, you draw your weapon and rid the world of the corrupting xeno-abomination.{/n}

7a3e4e22-82df-464d-9eab-8637fb704985.Text: {n}You are lying in a fetal position, surrounded by pitch darkness. From all sides, the metal walls of the spherical prison bear down on you, their cold surfaces scalding the raw lesions on your skin. They are separating you from the world outside. Worse still, they have cut you off from the warp. The deafening silence presses down on your skull, making your mind scream in agony. You are aware of your body still existing, but your consciousness is already slowly dissolving inside a cocoon of emptiness... and then, the sphere opens up slightly. Blue light comes flooding in, blinding you. You hear a grating, non-human voice:{/n} "A disappointing result. The amplifier has next to no effect. The test subject is too weak. Leave him." {n}The sphere slams shut again, and you are forcefully ejected, or so it feels, from the memory.{/n}

74f4ff50-2a3c-41c5-8b47-871415d19d35.Text: {n}Pasqal's augmetics become instantly more animated, clicking, whirring, and flickering ecstatically.{/n} "Initiating observation log. No data-connectors or sacred Noospheric corona detected. Tech-nature: unknown. I declare Category Epsilon-Alpha secrecy. In accordance with the Canon of Technological Security, this object must be isolated and subjected to the rite of sacred diagnostics. All witnesses will be extermi— warned."

9f3c0485-c0eb-4723-b128-90d6c2cd7e49.Text: {n}Marazhai grins at the sight of the peculiar machine, then glances at you.{/n} "A most curious item. What are you waiting for, {name}? Come closer. It does not bite."

2cc23c46-3575-44b2-b93d-d452e0853b5c.Text: {n}Heinrix raises his eyebrows.{/n} "If only every xenoheresy were as blatant as this one... I hope I don't need to spell out what must be done with this perverse construct."

4f55ef01-8d09-4dbd-84c2-741066ab4302.Text: "That thing — it pretends to be silent, then explodes with echoes of voices. Then, it goes quiet again... And then comes another flash of pain... The pain of another! It knows something, keeps it inside. And... it wants to show it to you, I think."

0dd321d9-9d49-44fc-bf5f-81edb55a2216.Text: {n}The needles slide deeper into your palm, and you feel that your pain is no longer the only thing they are collecting. The thought that the accursed machine is draining the very life out of you makes you break out in a sweat. The pain remains, but the strange sensation is succeeded by weakness. From deep inside the device, a string of data surfaces: the machine is awaiting further orders.{/n}

7c28a9eb-882e-4a9b-9874-aeea22aad6c2.Text: Eternal hunger seems to be frozen in the ambull's many eyes.

8273b42e-3c4d-41fc-86a7-b6e510711cde.Text: A glass of amasec makes managing things more pleasant.

4775cd28-eab8-4254-943f-9c3d66405d1c.Text: Recaf with milk foam gives you extra energy.

d3a8563d-084e-4fbc-a6f9-172701847ea1.Text: The cyber-eagle is invigorated by people's admiration.

445c9b3c-fd24-430e-80bc-5fab5aa286d5.Text: The eagle's keen-eyed and precise cybernetic head reigns supreme.

1663b942-9427-4149-8449-eff25b86a55d.Text: The eagle's proud and fierce living head reigns supreme.

bbc02fb2-f2cf-4281-9914-9fd16a796510.Text: The cyber-mastiff is ready to tear your enemies apart at any moment.

fc2a9402-3cf0-42f2-9da9-c6379040bea4.Text: The cyber-mastiff is emboldened by people's fear.

f9b7fb24-93a8-46cf-b0a3-8951e77c7276.Text: The cyber-mastiff is ready to guard its master against danger, ignoring any distractions.

7af5fef0-0d08-4fad-822d-576397c31a7a.Text: The thread of your life has been tangled by the Weaver of Destinies. Not even death can see where this thread begins and ends.

1cf0e987-f98f-4546-9d5c-d94d4efca58c.Text: Your soul feels light after finishing the bureaucratic drudgery for the day.

79f5b07c-9eae-4dfb-9cc5-fc52e4c7f15d.Text: "You are not feeling lonely here, are you?"

a4a62d71-ca90-43df-b053-ba1bcb4ce498.Text: "I will have a frothed recaf, extra sweet."

899c426c-2fa0-43e1-bbb1-bc1714e65afc.Text: "Pour me some amasec. I want to relax."

1be56666-2551-430a-b3d2-fa69540e8e96.Text: "How do you find life on the flagship, Maive?"

fa999618-829b-4e5b-a47e-50c43906a7f6.Text: "There is a vacancy for a repairs servitor on the bridge. Consider this a promotion."

321493d8-bdf6-473d-ac02-9adaf3b007fd.Text: "I have had enough of your dancing. Stop."

8800a79f-22d0-45cc-9b0a-49271af482a3.Text: "From now on your place is among the workers, Maive. Double recaf will be much more popular with them."

91a18cb8-9ec7-441e-b437-4fbc2dc7a420.Text: "You need not fear anyone here. Dance if you want to."

bf8313ce-1c8b-47c3-8cc8-8a8b95d70175.Text: "I no longer require a personal servant. Go to Danrok and find out where else you might be useful to the crew."

3c94875a-2492-422d-b27e-dd852d18c46b.Text: "Would you care for a cup of freshly brewed recaf, my Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}?"

3018f667-73f6-4f00-8d10-7da62818c526.Text: "Why, my Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}, I have you! And Master Danrok has been very kind to me. Sometimes, he brings me all kinds of amazing things. The other day it was a book for little nobles. I learned from it that the stars are huge — too big to pick up and hold between your fingers, or even to hug with both of your arms! And when they dance together, they form entire galax-eyes!"

98f60d2c-c0ed-4498-aeb3-05dd4f0b68c8.Text: "Thank you, my Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}! Sometimes, I feel as if I've died and gone to the heavenly palace of the God-Emperor Himself! You are so kind to me..."

85fb5f61-3217-4a36-b003-d4431a492b47.Text: "I must admit, I've never mended anything... just sewn up some rips in my dress. But I'll be diligent in learning a servitor's craft, my Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}!" {n}Maive's eyes are radiant with gratitude.{/n}

167c6ecd-0ca0-4265-b071-3e0ff7bc5847.Text: "Sometimes, I stop and stand by a window, and it's like I'm flying through the starry sea myself. I still can't believe this is happening to me. You are so generous, my Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}! I couldn't dream of more!"

25364410-dc89-48be-b62c-6bed69299165.Text: "The cane spice sweetens it, and the whipped synth-milk gives it a special, airy softness. A sip of bliss on even the gloomiest of days!"

d299d58b-150a-495f-bccd-015ba5648849.Text: "Black as a starless sky. Strong as your will, my Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}! With a spicy touch to perk you up even faster!"

2c92d187-cd7b-47b8-bf72-e293ac1005ac.Text: "Aged amasec from the most remote holds, my Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}. To think that it is several times older than me! It's like holding time itself in your hands, sealed inside a bottle."

9337141d-e098-410d-9e6a-9b55774c1e1f.Text: "I hear and obey, my Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}." {n}The young woman bites her lip nervously.{/n} "Forgive me for offending your eyes with my clumsiness."

447035ee-c13d-49cd-959d-38caff491023.Text: "Thank you, my Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}, for the great privilege of serving you. May the God-Emperor protect you on your journey through the starry sea!"

9e83e1ef-110e-42bb-9222-036f1b73f102.Text: {n}Maive nods, her face serious.{/n} "Master Danrok once let slip that they often fall asleep on the job and get whipped by their overseers for it. Sometimes, they even lose their limbs..." {n}She shudders, then raises her eyes to you. They are beaming with resolve.{/n} "I'll be glad to ease your servants' burden, my {mf|lord|lady}."

c15a3575-6c90-42c8-a1ff-053525300029.Text: "May the God-Emperor protect you on your journey through the starry sea!"

742b3ea8-cffb-4dd2-9691-3fe83d9ee5fe.Text: "Why don't you go on a quick hunt?"

81a8237a-7a7a-4e77-b619-ddb1d9110360.Text: "Fly around and stretch your wings. Let people be inspired by your majesty."

125414c1-d2f6-44c0-adca-2f57caa88162.Text: [Goad the living head] "That's it! You teach that box of cogs a lesson!"

7959809f-aff3-49df-b51a-b429ed4b63bf.Text: "You are one of the most noble creations made by human hands that I have ever seen. Do you know that?"

2d886444-6308-4e30-8fd0-05e8c86eda95.Text: {n}The half-mechanical creature greets you by spreading its wings wide and raising both of its heads. The eagle regards you with alertness, ready to carry out any order.{/n}

819b773b-69cf-4c29-b64e-10596f212eaa.Text: {n}The creature's living head jerks forward and catches your offering. The mechanical head, free of the deficiencies of the flesh, remains entirely unmoved.{/n}

ee29653e-2b7e-465e-b83b-c2000afb9858.Text: {n}{petname} lets out a piercing cry, wings outstretched. It seems the eagle understands the meaning of the sacred gesture perfectly and has decided to bless you in return.{/n}

66ec7e88-f483-48dd-987f-4b21626261ec.Text: {n}When you approach, {petname} sends out a piercing screech and throws something at your feet. You reach down and realise that your bird has brought you a gift. As for where and when {petname} could have found it, you will probably never know.{/n}

90ee433f-2db9-4cca-ab49-86a9d2b48eca.Text: {n}A fierce battle is unfolding on {petname}'s perch. The giant bird's two heads have clashed in a bitter fight. It is impossible to determine the cause of this conflict, but you feel certain you should intervene!{/n}

e9a8c919-8926-4e5a-8055-5f54279ebaa3.Text: {n}The yellow-eyed head starts tearing through metal with redoubled fury, until its opponent is forced to yield. Shrinking away in a pitiful attempt to save itself, the machine half of the eagle admits defeat. The victor lets out a triumphant squawk and mercifully relents.{/n}

dfb6f973-8d05-463e-b954-f9353d6df867.Text: {n}The living symbol of the Imperium gazes at you with seeming indignation at the frivolous gesture. {petname} permits your touch, but you can tell that no further reaction will be forthcoming.{/n}

35321dc9-d18c-4539-8601-b99a11b73640.Text: {n}{petname} responds with a nod of calm dignity and a clack of the hooked beak. The second, mechanical head repeats the living one's gesture.{/n}

8ff381ed-b758-407b-9777-aa4da6c9350d.Text: {n}Both of {petname}'s heads let out a fearsome cry. Beating its wings, the mighty bird takes flight...{/n}

cf891135-6a00-4618-b2fa-2d1fca5d13cb.Text: {n}The servo-head immediately obeys your command as it lunges and snaps at its living counterpart's throat. The metal beak tightens like a vice until the victim gives a plaintive shriek. Having asserted its dominance, the machine lets go of its other half, leaving it bloodied and maimed.{/n}

9dbc4151-d39c-44d5-8008-319d06196a9e.Text: {n}When the eagle returns to its perch, it drops a trophy on the floor: a severed arm. You notice ship gang symbols tattooed across the wrist — this limb belonged to one of the lawbreakers who torment righteous servants of the Rogue Trader and often descend into outright heresy. It seems your companion has reminded the presumptuous rabble about the consequences of disobeying the law of the Imperium.{/n}

e6cbdda4-f899-4c73-af3b-71829a82f3d5.Text: {n}Upon its return, the eagle throws a mutilated piece of a person's chest at your feet — a trophy from the hunt. An Aquila on a leather strap glints in the mangled mass of skin and flesh, and you barely identify the bloodstained shreds of fabric as a fragment of the robes of an Ecclesiarchy servant. Looking at the grim wounds gives you a good idea of how much torture this sanctimonious fool must have suffered before their untimely demise.{/n}

00def8df-3d2b-4162-8d65-cb2a46748a41.Text: {n}Your stern voice has an immediate effect, and the fighting stops. Nevertheless, the living bird continues to shoot looks of deep-seated hatred at its servo-twin.{/n}

60641d74-a5b8-424b-8c1d-af2fe8ece75e.Text: {n}The giant bird observes you with unblinking eyes.{/n}

ccaab77d-fbb0-4b9a-9a52-bba53c86b8b7.Text: {n}The eagle returns looking somewhat ruffled after its long and swift flight. It flaps its wings a few times, then settles comfortably onto its perch.{/n}

b3aa8718-b35f-4c36-9c9d-317ce49936fa.Text: {n}Expecting a servitorised animal to appreciate your affectionate gesture would be folly, and yet, as you gently brush {petname}'s feathers, one of the heads tilts to one side as if leaning into your touch.{/n}

58cc3431-4283-4a88-8bd5-38f832d6bfa3.Text: {n}As your fingers brush against the rough feathers, {petname} lets out a chilling screech. You feel as if the bird is about to sink its talons into you... but then, under its master's commanding gaze, it quells its bloodlust.{/n}

4f7a7889-79d0-4403-bd5f-a7705a3e80b6.Text: {n}Having returned to its perch, the eagle throws a bloody scrap at your feet — all that remains of a particularly large void rat. These parasites can grow to frightening sizes and are a true scourge of the lower decks. It looks like your companion has just eased the lives of the ship dwellers, if only a little.{/n}

f233fd2c-87b6-463e-96a9-003a123fb90f.Text: "Well done! Be sure to give all my enemies the same treatment!"

4c6d107b-63a2-4e0a-a3c2-e415c501eac5.Text: "{petname}, stop that immediately! Don't attack things just because you feel like it!"

4825417b-5b35-42d1-81c4-34bb7b0cba44.Text: {n}The cyber-mastiff lifts its head from its bed, looking at you with the dispassion of a pict-recorder.{/n}

a7a8f238-4c15-4973-a032-9d7318ec2364.Text: {n}The cyber-mastiff makes a sound that reminds you of a dog's whimper combined with the screeching of metal. You feel confident that {petname}'s servo-protocols have registered your every word.{/n}

14f1cfc9-1709-4a53-a5e7-b0cd4a1b2c9a.Text: {n}The dog's attention instantly focuses on the thrown object. A moment later, {petname} leaps and snatches it from the air. Even before the metal legs hit the floor, your glove is reduced to tiny shreds — a transparent reminder that the cyber-mastiff takes every command extremely seriously.{/n}

008dde7d-a0bc-4268-baf3-d3ce7eda20b7.Text: {n}It takes you a moment to notice that something is amiss in your chambers. Finally, your gaze comes to rest on a torn cushion from one of the chairs. Your combat beast must have had too strong a reaction to the smell of real down filling. {petname} looks at you from the usual spot, unflustered as ever.{/n}

9d9ec939-2560-4fb1-87f8-f9b27abd4447.Text: {n}{petname} remains cold and impassive as if you touched an inanimate slab of metal. Only the slight twitch of the cyber-mastiff's tail indicates that your affection has been acknowledged and appreciated.{/n}

aa32f614-4aea-4543-bbb3-5ddc757e3d26.Text: {n}{petname}'s red visors turn to you. You know full well that a cyber-mastiff is an instrument of His will, not a comrade; nevertheless, just as one can grow fond of one's trusted bolter, so too can an instrument be shown sympathy.{/n}

1299ce6f-7a21-4eaa-b69c-a06a04e6eaf7.Text: {n}{petname} looks at you expectantly. Evidently, the servo-protocols refuse to acknowledge an unknown command, and so, the cyber-mastiff is simply ignoring it.{/n}

6b194166-1f9a-44c4-9f25-f173b020e1bb.Text: {n}{petname} carefully drops something at your feet. The cyber-mastiff must have picked it up somewhere aboard the ship or on a battlefield. Whatever the case may be, this unexpected trophy will prove useful.{/n}

f48f574f-63a6-4573-b69d-c857372d4b13.Text: {n}Upon receiving your command, {petname} leaps onto all fours with a low growl and runs out of your chambers...{/n}

bbe2f363-9d6f-435b-9d73-413d1124f97f.Text: {n}{petname} returns after a while, covered in blood and scraps of flesh. You do not know — or particularly care — where and under what circumstances the cyber-mastiff caught up to its prey. What matters is that your beast, an extension of your will, has taught your servants an excellent lesson and gorged itself on the suffering of its victims in the process.{/n}

21baa670-5703-495f-8c54-a5c961e4174d.Text: {n}{petname} is gone for a long time. Meanwhile, the open vox-line reports several incidents on one of the middle decks, mostly involving obscura dealers and smugglers who have suddenly let themselves be exposed. The vox is still talking about how the enforcers are in the process of apprehending the criminals when {petname} crosses the threshold of your quarters and walks back over to you.{/n}

e7cdd183-843b-445a-aa30-629f40a839c9.Text: {n}{petname} returns after a couple of watch hours. The cyber-mastiff's route is familiar to you by now — you know it has done a circle around the bridge and the upper decks, inspecting the various stations. Half beast, half machine, it is an embodiment of devotion to the ideals of the Imperium and the unbending will of its most faithful servants. The sight of it strikes awe and terror into any idling officers, compelling them to return to their duties as quickly as possible.{/n}

1a6234e5-cfaf-48ba-acec-e607a3d16e1d.Text: {n}The cyber-mastiff simply continues watching you as you turn away from the cushion.{/n}

f4fb45d6-43d1-4af7-9054-170a134b81cb.Text: {n}You take some time to learn how {petname} executes basic commands. The cyber-mastiff follows your exact instructions, leaving you convinced that the servo-protocols are working correctly... and yet there is a small deviation from the norm: the dog's tail keeps wagging, as if {petname} were pleased to be spending time with you.{/n}

c5fb33c9-0772-4de6-bfd1-294c15f274f1.Text: {n}The cyber-mastiff's servo-protocols have undergone a few notable changes. Throughout the training session, the beast repeatedly displays extreme aggression and ferocity, as it shreds anything you throw yet seems to remain unsatisfied. {petname} hungers for blood. Real blood.{/n}

33fb7ded-3edf-4570-b13c-03b5a55738f0.Text: {n}You try out the cyber-mastiff's commands one after the other, thoroughly checking the servo-protocols. {petname} obeys every order without the slightest error, relentless as any other tool created for His service. The beast remains perfectly focused until the very last command — this machine is ready to serve the Rogue Trader.{/n}

b9ca5f7b-c29c-4e76-bcaf-4fcef4fc10ae.Text: {n}The cyber-mastiff seems uninterested in your words, but you know that its servo-protocols have carefully recorded everything you said.{/n}

dbb50bef-624d-4fe4-abbb-1ca69af06c0c.Text: {n}The cyber-mastiff — a hulk of muscle, metal, and wire — is resting in its designated spot. {petname} tracks your every gesture, as if logging your movements using some sophisticated device that never stops watching.{/n}

cb87f472-9d31-4513-b758-64bde170c0f2.Text: "Tell me what the future holds for us, {petname}."

df64924e-fb9f-4285-a417-04b20cc72b46.Text: "How does it feel to be imprisoned in the body of one of my servants?"

60367dba-656e-45a5-9607-a5f3ba4d73d9.Text: "I grow tired of you. Rid my raven of your presence!"

f90cd8fc-a6a8-4f4d-a286-6cdbf7ff3291.Text: "You are a servant of the Weaver of Destinies, are you not? Do you have the power to save me from death?"

a6e8d57d-d1a9-4004-ab38-d2d8e34aed94.Text: "What do they say about me around the decks?"

bd58b3b9-f366-4d77-ac02-fe608cfd8a1e.Text: "Thank you, {petname}. I wonder what you will bring me next time."

7eb38d1c-dfd9-4049-8ae7-b33e5d8b395e.Text: "{petname}, that's enough. Petty thievery presents neither you nor your owner in a favourable light."

9f16b1ba-07c6-45c3-a968-9ff1940261c9.Text: "Let me talk to my bird, not you."

7887a3b0-e5b1-4575-b060-77944a808a76.Text: {n}{petname} watches you intently from up above. The jet-black bird remains almost perfectly still, giving you the sense of looking at a stuffed mount or a statue instead of a living creature. Suddenly, its beak opens, and you hear a distorted, barely intelligible{/n} "{name}."

862fe2db-d9ce-48e2-aa9d-d1b8cfef3669.Text: {n}{petname} looks at you without making a sound and straightens up. Then, the bird spreads its wings as if trying to appear larger. Presumably, this dignified silence is supposed to demonstrate the grim respect that your subjects have for their Rogue Trader.{/n}

9062b34c-4b25-4728-a376-33c19e5f4266.Text: {n}{petname} stares off into space without blinking. A barely distinguishable {d|Encyclopedia:CQ_RavenDemonDecision}whisper{/d} comes from the raven's half-open beak, filling the entire room. As soon as you approach, the sounds stop, and the bird turns its head to you sharply.{/n}

04c44916-15b4-46a4-a5a4-f81406e0bbec.Text: {n}The raven's beak yawns open unnaturally wide, its tongue lolling out and its wings trembling in agony. The eye under its tongue pierces you with its stare, and the sound of the voice that comes from the bird's throat pulls your muscles taut and twists your bones out of their joints.{/n} "Taunting a Lord of Change is unwise. My confinement within the weapon of the dancing souls lasted far longer, yet still, I found a way to exact my revenge. But I am not offended — I yearn to see you touch upon the Primordial Truth. The rest is insignificant, Child of the Dawn."

363ca2a9-768e-45a1-83ff-cc517862655c.Text: "That is impossible, Child of the Dawn — it was you who wove this fate into being. Now and for all time, this vessel is one of thousands of my eye's pupils." {n}The raven's head cracks and falls to one side, as if something invisible had snapped its neck. For a few seconds, the bird stares at you with dead eyes, before suddenly jerking back to life and raising its head once more.{/n}

cb70353c-5608-4528-b8bb-6b601792e0bc.Text: {n}A whispering host of voices erupts from the raven's throat, caressing your ears, slithering into your mouth and nose.{/n} "A true Child of the Dawn who craves to take hold of the threads of the future... You ask for much, and great will be the price to pay. But the champion's desire is my desire."

2f0b3bc3-9823-443d-bda3-3f80f3a2fc44.Text: {n}Something within the raven laughs softly, before the bird shakes itself as if to clear its head. It looks the same as before, but for the faint, mocking blue glow now emanating from its black eyes.{/n}

a3ff6acf-99df-4d81-8ca9-b038e7d7abbd.Text: {n}The raven suddenly shrieks and stretches its wings wide. From under its black feathers, dozens of glimmering, otherworldly eyes stare at you.{/n} "Power over destiny, Child of the Dawn! No more and no less!"

561deaaf-a19a-438b-9433-c396c8301404.Text: {n}The raven's head turns to you with a crack, and you hear a many-voiced {d|Encyclopedia:CQ_RavenDemonDecision}whisper{/d} emanating from its half-open beak.{/n}

9bf993f2-3298-48fe-85a7-63123d5d147a.Text: {n}...a thin, sharp blade — one of Kibellah's many tools of death.{/n}

fc0b734c-e930-452b-aec3-862eed116f1b.Text: {n}The raven's black eyes glitter with what seems like excitement.{/n}

b225c487-896d-405a-a7ed-507c2b24ad65.Text: {n}...a cluster of torn multi-coloured wires. It matters little where {petname} ripped these from — you had better hide them. Pasqal will be incensed if he hears about such a show of disrespect toward sacred machines.{/n}

4b41478e-2825-4227-bd30-4ab82cc31ec4.Text: {n}The raven turns its head, looking at you with each eye in turn, then cranes its neck as if trying to bow. It seems it has heard an abundance of flattering words about you and is now attempting to express reverence to the best of its ability.{/n}

f77fcec9-27fa-45a5-94c9-f0ee94a4a54d.Text: {n}The raven flaps its wings and takes off from its perch...{/n}

3454bc6a-0dc4-4b7d-bd66-0c217def4ca1.Text: {n}...a worn bookmark. Was {petname} really brazen enough to snatch it right from Cassia's book while she was reading it?{/n}

72ed8842-3166-41b1-9b3f-1968d31455ae.Text: {n}The feathers feel rough to the touch. {petname} catches one of your fingers with a beak that could easily slice a digit clean off — this is merely a warning, for now.{/n}

780af50b-4d16-47d7-b39f-e00ed72d9a48.Text: {n}The raven lets out a sullen, almost aggrieved croak.{/n}

79d90a03-dacb-4190-abe2-2991baa82eae.Text: {n}{petname} avoids looking you in the eye. A disturbing feeling pierces your body.{/n}

74ea911f-9f21-4ab1-8252-e1bf2be91be1.Text: {n}The raven starts beating its wings as if preparing to take flight. A few words fall from its beak:{/n} "Three stars! Burning! Burning! Burning into one!"

95b4dba0-c6f4-43cf-9813-92b96a1e1f41.Text: {n}The raven bows its head. This time, the voice you hear is not the usual deafening croak, but a quiet rattle, as if {petname} were afraid of being heard by the wrong ears:{/n} "Ancient one. Death of the galaxy."

1551af93-eb56-4054-b049-f13d9150fb6b.Text: {n}As soon as you step closer, the raven flaps its wings in agitation, as if eager to give you something. A curious object falls into your hand...{/n}

297d7fca-2048-4e55-bca1-c2b2d061d4da.Text: {n}...a cracked spirit stone. Marazhai's armour bears many such adornments — grim reminders of his triumphs over his distant craftworld kin.{/n}

1980b18d-18a1-4a62-b502-8e0cd7ad0f4d.Text: {n}...a strange bauble made from an unusual substance. After getting a better look, you recognise the material as wraithbone. It looks like Yrliet may now be one weapon ornament short.{/n}

f4d57612-a463-4842-9d69-aa1468e60c79.Text: {n}...a torn scroll containing a work schedule for one of the upper decks. Abelard must be looking everywhere for the document, stolen by {petname} when he wasn't looking.{/n}

5e8f7f3f-a22c-49f3-be96-ffc48e6a09a8.Text: {n}...a slightly bent, Aquila-shaped pin. You cannot imagine how {petname} managed to steal it right off Heinrix's jacket.{/n}

529dff92-f9a7-4259-a7fa-771d1953846c.Text: {n}...a scrap of fur, unmistakably from Ulfar's cloak. You find yourself wondering what the mighty Astartes would have had to say about {petname}'s antics had he caught the thief in the act.{/n}

ec9eb4eb-584c-4444-a366-ed7bc3414747.Text: {n}...an empty ammo casing. You recognise the weapon — {petname} must have sneaked into the training chamber in the middle of Sister Argenta's routine session.{/n}

f59914f2-2492-42ad-834e-dea8d6cc9489.Text: {n}...an empty flask smelling of cheap amasec. Idira would probably laugh if she heard how much your raven "cares" about her health.{/n}

b3236c36-a54c-4792-bbb8-83623292688d.Text: {n}...a sharp-smelling biscuit. Solomorne uses these when he is training with Glaito. It has been nibbled on — the raven must have got hungry in the middle of its shenanigans.{/n}

5eab46cc-504e-4529-b86e-60a94cd4c964.Text: {n}...a fine gemstone earring. The back looks bent beyond use, so returning this to Jae would probably serve no purpose at this point...{/n}

a48b0f97-bec5-4357-86fa-99bfa2869519.Text: {n}Quiet laughter breaks the silence. The raven's jaws part, and under its tongue, you see a daemonic blue-grey eye open sluggishly.{/n} "The Child of the Dawn has come to speak with me. I will answer your call."

6b47ce0c-7409-408a-8a6b-c7ba460b1231.Text: {n}{petname} lets out a piercing croak, beak agape. The sound is surprisingly reminiscent of mocking laughter. With its talons digging into the perch and its wings beating frenziedly, the raven looks as if it has grown used to people cowering in terror upon its arrival. It appears that its master instils the same fear in {mf|his|her} subjects.{/n}

a9fcefcf-c210-4a0a-8e51-be66b0197eb5.Text: {n}{petname} watches you approach with keen attention.{/n}

895860c6-0e61-46e7-977b-e5dea358ab57.Text: {n}{petname} returns after a watch hour has passed. Before landing back on the perch, the raven drops its trophy at your feet — following your command, it has indeed found something to offer its master.{/n}

f0bda268-42bf-4855-8c67-05020ae88f77.Text: {n}With a short croak of gratitude, {petname} catches the food and instantly tears it to pieces.{/n}

f1638147-4881-4f63-802d-dee293ec161e.Text: {n}The raven cranes its neck, staring into your face. Its black beak opens:{/n} "Darkness marching over fading suns."

a94db01c-e30f-4de2-a005-6da09eb1fc18.Text: [Read the plaque on the first skull]

a22986e0-3860-4324-8765-7bb4a97f057e.Text: [Read the plaque on the second skull]

25f3cc54-7464-4820-a591-dfcf8cd8170c.Text: [Examine the servo-skulls for any information on the people they were made from]

486c5188-3925-4f5b-a09b-358818ff82fe.Text: "I have work to do. Come, you will help me clear my backlog of paperwork."

b8016deb-175d-4062-836c-360fc43a813a.Text: "I wish to be entertained. Sing something for me."

19358bb1-c72a-4163-9a27-f32af247bcac.Text: [Read the plaque on the third skull]

b7fe0a10-d694-455b-874a-e944d85b7240.Text: "Since you have your quills ready, I shall dictate my memoirs to you. Let us start with my childhood..."

56321ae1-135f-4584-acad-03085c0d5573.Text: "Inspiration has returned to me. It is time we continued writing my memoirs."

027cc26b-e309-4d9e-85b1-b6dbea452029.Text: {n}The servo-skulls greet you with a chorus of binharic trills as you approach.{/n}

69b898ae-5234-44e3-99cf-577cf4f789cf.Text: {n}Judging by the buzzing of servo-motors, your metal servants are struggling to process an unfamiliar command. Then, one skull stirs into motion, followed by another — the two of them drift around you in something resembling a ceremonial procession. The third and largest servo-skull remains in place, watching the silent parade.{/n}

62ad9706-8801-43d6-909c-43bec24f257f.Text: {n}Several hours pass in the blink of an eye. Your head feels heavy from the volume of decisions you have made in this span of time — and from the incessant buzzing of servo-skulls by your ear. However, you have nothing to rebuke your assistants for: thanks to their help, you have managed to make a considerable dent in the impregnable wall of bureaucracy that serves as the lifeblood of voidship captaincy.{/n}

c9b26e60-d218-4343-adfd-55cce70599c1.Text: {n}The panels containing the data close with a quiet click.{/n}

0e365c0b-f710-4342-8bc3-af95b14a9ff5.Text: "Loyal servant of the Imperium, Administratum adept, Grand Chronicler Avangeline Aivic. Cause of death: suffocation."

97ed4b52-b085-48ad-8883-f862db78c409.Text: {n}Inside every skull, you find a small panel containing a cast-metal plaque.{/n}

b2b3198d-486a-4450-9b0e-d0aaae2164ec.Text: {n}After a few seconds, the skulls begin "singing" some kind of hymn, drilling the same, constant note into your temples, which quickly start throbbing with pain. You see no indication that they are ever going to stop.{/n}

561cab79-107d-4c54-b232-5da7566c7e2d.Text: {n}The servo-skulls obey and follow you to your desk, which is buried under a mound of reports, dispatches, missives, and God-Emperor knows what else...{/n}

b9755b72-c273-40a3-a64f-c93b9b273f0e.Text: {n}Your attempt is doomed from the start — you are not a Tech-Priest, and lack the knowledge to service these sacred machines. The sheer arsenal of buttons and wires on the back of every skull leaves you dazed, and you give up halfway through your examination.{/n}

a0c36b9a-4f1f-4904-91ca-6b524cf6a586.Text: {n}The skulls' humming grows louder. The lumens in their eye sockets dim, then light up brighter than before. The swarm's flight patterns seem noticeably more chaotic now.{/n}

6469742f-6f0c-4cdf-a050-e909905d41ff.Text: {n}A spark runs under your fingers, and one of the servo-skulls begins shaking violently. Afraid of irreparably damaging the machine, you cease your intrusion.{/n}

544991e8-86cd-498e-b701-e1742fabac29.Text: "Defender of the Golden Throne and of all Humanity, brave member of the Imperial Guard Bapask Yeronis, melee combat expert. Cause of death: killed in an ambush."

96c3bb11-ab37-4758-b785-fabe54237a7b.Text: {n}The servo-skulls obediently let themselves be held by your hands. It takes you a good deal of time, but you finally gain an understanding of the litanies and rituals that were used to tame their machine spirits.{/n}

adc216f2-8227-4b9c-a721-484c7f67cbc4.Text: {n}Several hours later, your throat is sore, and the creaking of the quill on the parchment has taken on a faintly sad undertone. It seems both you and the sacred machine are in need of a break.{/n}

d15a6fa9-1b2f-4293-9e7a-e45d8c5e8c59.Text: {n}Three watch hours later, the servo-skull ends the epic work of chronicling the many hardships and adversities of your life. Your magnum opus is complete, and although it may look like metres and metres of jumbled parchment now, you know it for what it truly is: the memoirs of the greatest Rogue Trader to have ever lived, carefully recorded by a servo-skull's quill!{/n}

05ce4fb4-c933-48ea-aa74-9fab094fe3e2.Text: {n}The sounds crawling out of their vox-machines drop to a rattle, then stop completely. Blessed silence returns to your chambers.{/n}

86f39118-7436-4f2f-b7a0-91cd74d6a7e5.Text: {n}You hear a click inside one of the servo-skulls, as if some compartment has opened.{/n}

b8ac27b2-fd9c-414c-ba7b-09ea6bdbb232.Text: {n}Behind the fake slate stating that all data on this servo-skull's provenance was deleted, a hidden section is revealed. An inscription inside it reads,{/n} "Adept of Inquisitor [redacted] of the Ordo [redacted] Havrilius Smiroth."

6efb64e5-2522-4099-b9ba-950181a6cfc5.Text: {n}The servo-skulls hover closer so as not to miss a single word. A golden quill appears where one skull's tongue should be and begins painstakingly committing your tale to a scroll.{/n}

03cf2e98-b7da-4d32-bb06-58742af6b3fd.Text: A long roll of paper covered in historically accurate records of your incredible adventures.

5c6fcd14-1b49-4b5e-a6fd-7b0b9dbd07e8.Text: Memoirs of a Rogue Trader of House von Valancius

5f2feded-6d42-4e9b-a93e-04751a23ec82.Text: Law-abiding subjects noted the participation of Proctor Solomorne Anthar in the Magnae Accessio and began keeping a sterner eye on any violations taking place in the Rogue Trader's domain.

ccd85a99-befd-4007-97ce-67702d20fcd7.Text: The Rogue Trader put a stop to the recruitment of fugitive criminals. The qualified personnel shortage was solved by appointing specially trained voidsmen from among the crew.

b87ccc3b-2062-4673-95e1-894e4229dce6.Text: The Rogue Trader entrusted {mf|his|her} senior officers with the task of recruiting specialists. As a token of the officers' appreciation, components of the macro-cannons were upgraded with special voidfarer technology — rumoured to be at the crew's personal expense.

d7c62d1a-33e5-45bd-9b45-e96b41dfd3b0.Text: Following the investigation into the recruitment of criminals, the decision was made to legitimise the practice by instating a special prison regime on the flagship. From now on, they will toil twice as hard under the watchful eye of the enforcers.

dfe702f4-1265-4567-b81d-328cca231faf.Text: Following the investigation into the recruitment of criminals, the decision was made to tighten control over the flagship's command staff, which greatly increased the zeal of the senior officers.

d1dba646-943d-4592-8f48-369e48aa663d.Text: From now on, recruits with dubious backgrounds will undergo a penance procedure, and those grateful fugitives will be particularly zealous in destroying everything that has ever linked them to their dark past.

ca67b876-3b23-4ea4-8dd6-9f9d043b592c.Text: The prelates of Foulstone praise the Rogue Trader's wisdom that leads the faithful to prosperity.

3a899ed8-bc8a-417e-b62e-74549158a99a.Text: Blessed by the Triad of the Hammer

2a67103f-3321-47cf-8bc4-d2f8d240ce81.Text: The machines will fall under the onslaught of the Rogue Trader, the great cleanser of Kiava Gamma.

940d715b-8829-4d48-9d66-0cabc4f17c85.Text: For {mf|him|her} who made the monstrosities from the mines of Vheabos VI turn and flee, any clash with xenos is a welcome test of skill and prowess.

685ce2f0-1dfe-4d15-9549-fb3866c6bd72.Text: All who disobey shall tremble before the Rogue Trader's stride, for in {mf|his|her} wake, order marches.

baefecf4-66f8-4d5a-afb2-5b321ffed1c5.Text: The Rogue Trader turned the Lex Imperialis into a pillar of faith on Dargonus. Discipline and obedience have become the greatest virtues among the congregation.

31ba7d99-655f-4430-be9c-f54d3a1f5828.Text: The Rogue Trader appointed three prelates at once, after convincing them to pool their efforts.

33a169e5-0694-4dbf-b413-9ce649b169c2.Text: The senior overseer who sabotaged the investigation provided the coordinates of the strange tunnels that the mad convicts are disappearing into.

b440b05f-9ad6-4a47-965d-090c92a9636f.Text: Guided by an Adeptus Arbites strategy, the Rogue Trader's servants gave battle to the terrifying steel insects, and drove the invaders back into the bowels of the planet.

6d63f707-8e73-4a39-900c-7c8793717a00.Text: The Rogue Trader used planet-wide vox-broadcasts and psychological pressure to quell the revolt on Vheabos VI.

974084f5-2274-4c36-ad38-65434309b1bc.Text: Neither status nor rank can stop the relentless might of this weapon.

be307d37-43fc-4b50-ab2e-33b994ab48a8.Text: A gift from the high overseer of Vheabos VI, commemorating an almost bloodless pacification of a revolt.

0b842599-a982-428b-9040-a0117c2418b3.Text: This mysterious device is a gift from Lady Xue. It considerably enhances its owner's cognitive abilities, so long as they can endure the pain that comes with connecting to the mechanism.

a9de05da-98bb-4114-b4db-819ecca949fd.Text: "I could stare at burning worlds forever. I love fire — it knows no half-measures and leaves not a speck of dirt behind. The perfect judge."

752c5972-6951-43f8-b710-09941529723d.Text: "Thank you for your candid confession. Headquarters will be interested to hear about your criminal schemes."

ec4a5897-b3bc-4898-bcb4-2d5d2f1cd085.Text: "Once in Calixis, we were sent to a hive world that owed a tithe debt. What we found were corpses, just a planet-sized burial ground, not a single sign of life. Looking at this world, it feels the same."

a525b792-615f-4ef8-8f78-001a07869f75.Text: "Mining worlds supply the Imperium until the last vein is depleted. Then the Administratum reviews the planet's status and assigns a new type of tribute — even rubble, waste rock, will do. The collection of the tithe never ends."

ecb7c633-f67c-41fc-9abf-27b4758cb617.Text: "I despise the snow. You can't take a step without a magno-scanner — you never know where there's a mine ready to rip your legs off."

0fe3e2ea-40c4-4f81-b4c3-35a9149a7d13.Text: A fresh trail of blood leads into the darkness of the alleys.

0b389eac-2aea-4ea1-9364-e801689203af.Text: The corpse's skull is all but crushed. Whoever the killer is, they must possess extraordinary strength.

10d6cee6-fb31-40c1-b9b9-6b065d428e97.Text: "Just you and me, Glaito — for as long as we can last in this accursed place. Until the very end."

dceb2678-ba4d-45a4-b80c-7c76b5a0ec13.Text: Glaito stands motionless beside his master's body, heedless of everything around him.

7e6be1a8-e9ff-4539-8c52-d4a83b5314ed.Text: Someone has tampered with Glaito's implants and disrupted his connection with Solomorne. One can only imagine how much this is weighing on the Proctor.

890d1398-2de2-471f-97a4-69f4798ac16f.Text: Solomorne no longer feels worthy of serving the Lex Imperialis. It will take some time before the Proctor regains his unyielding resolve.

2a31a0cb-810c-46bc-b0a1-214a6720b23b.Text: "Your request has been granted, so disturb me no further. Your patrons already know we are even. If the beast refuses to obey, use the controller. The top button depresses the nervous system with pain impulses; the bottom one reanimates your plaything if ever you get carried away when doling out punishment. Be sure to experiment with the device. I have no doubt the result will delight you."

ab2435f4-325c-4ce9-9d79-cc448386899a.Text: The brain implant that once linked the Proctor and Glaito together. The Aquila is barely recognisable beneath the gory chunks of flesh.

b15f67d9-92b5-4b39-b940-1054758ace88.Text: The small, methodical notches on the helmet suggest that its owner kept track of slain abominations. The number of the notches suggests that their service was righteous.

ff639a89-0678-4ffa-a1ce-05aaa4e0e11a.Text: Grey flesh covered in feather-like scales.

96c58da7-4c89-43b2-b5fc-4752175310e0.Text: [Refuse] "{petname}, I forbid you to pick up anything whatsoever from the floor of this ungodly place."

4a782634-51f9-47dc-8732-336629afaf0b.Text: [Take the find] "Thank you, {petname}. And don't bark with your mouth full anymore."

e075c72a-aa21-4b20-9861-054a2304dc33.Text: {n}An embodiment of the Imperium's virtue of endurance, your loyal cyber-mastiff is standing tense and motionless in front of the Pit's entrance. Its lumen eyes seek you out. A piece of something odd-looking is clenched between its teeth. The dog meets your eye with a muffled bark and spits out its find.{/n}

57052525-c0c3-4f54-b465-dab050e7d81c.Text: {n}The cyber-mastiff's lumens blink dispassionately as it records its new action protocol.{/n}

22130ec6-0eea-4e90-a549-15d57c8681e8.Text: {n}The cyber-mastiff crushes its find mercilessly with its heavy paw.{/n}

ffe94095-5f18-454e-b083-a59c24b49818.Text: [Attempt to extract the contents of Glaito's mouth]

4caee04f-7789-474b-a15f-93de27ebd488.Text: [Press the remaining button] "I hope this wakes you up."

300880ec-536f-4b69-a345-471f9b25bc3c.Text: {n}A bloodied Glaito lies next to the ravaged Drukhari corpse. You detect the slightest movement of the cyber-mastiff's chest — he is alive but he has been rendered inoperable.{/n}

a45bdd7a-82aa-472f-ac3e-ac4b1c13ad83.Text: {n}The ragged wounds indicate that the Drukhari was killed by the cyber-mastiff, losing his hand in the process.{/n}

7089aafd-5832-40e5-842c-7b52c875df3e.Text: {n}There is little doubt in your mind that he is looking for Solomorne. If a cyber-mastiff loses its master, its protocols dictate that it must return to its Arbitrator if possible.{/n}

a7bd7ea9-c5ec-42ea-8017-b5fba9b43f09.Text: {n}The nature of the wounds reveals the dead xenos's fate: first, Glaito gnawed off his hand, then he sank his teeth into his throat while clawing his stomach open.{/n}

a1f21120-45dc-4735-9978-46e15838cca8.Text: {n}No response. Not even a reflexive twitch of his paw.{/n}

84e4f95f-179b-4336-a371-51add14eaefc.Text: {n}As far as you can make out, it is not Glaito's own blood that he is covered with. It most likely came from the dead xenos. His hide reveals fresh stitches — a couple of small ones on his face, and one large one under his ribs. The dog is also holding something in his half-open mouth.{/n}

33c517cf-d854-4887-8492-9d019e0e01ef.Text: {n}The hulking body stirs into motion. Glaito rises to his feet and glares at you through his scarlet visors, then immediately sniffs and decisively runs somewhere off to the side.{/n}

162b3128-145a-4c51-80a4-ec43b63ad55a.Text: {n}Avoiding Glaito's sharp teeth, your fingertips land upon something wet and cold.{/n}

5a2d4a88-81d6-4224-89a6-5cffa74585bf.Text: {n}Tearing your hand open on Glaito's sharp teeth, you manage to pull something out of his mouth.{/n}

c40cfadc-5bbb-46ba-bff0-0f5def557d20.Text: {n}In your hand, oddly enough, is a hand. A bitten-off Drukhari hand clutching a compact xenos device resembling a remote control. The stiff finger is pressing one of the two buttons.{/n}

188932ae-e7db-43b5-9c8d-0a98ef286b4e.Text: "It was a mistake to look for you. Farewell."

0d577a66-fc34-4eb8-8eb7-60c68f428026.Text: "The Emperor protects you, despite our enemies' machinations. That means your service is still of use to Him."

3004850c-fc80-4671-9ea1-1b13436a77b7.Text: "Think of the heretics we have destroyed. Do you not feel righteous anger knowing that other transgressors will escape your justice?"

8fb4cddc-34dd-4218-b25c-595b85c1e781.Text: Returned Solomorne to serving the Lex Imperialis, dispelling his doubts.

57a0a9ba-ecdf-4103-805e-673efe944101.Text: "The Emperor laid this burden upon us in the certainty that we were equal to it. Now you are doubting yourself, but not the Lex Imperialis. Tell me — am I right?"

0260499c-6520-49ca-a9ac-f4737c26daa5.Text: Helped Solomorne find his humanity and a new way to serve the law.

7910cf97-b3ce-4e74-bb8e-d0cd4c8eb747.Text: "You are a human in a city of Drukhari. It is enough to break anyone. But Glaito led me to you, and I am going to get us out of here. You gave up hope too soon."

1f31314c-96d4-413a-bec9-2b6b2e0cbfda.Text: "Get a hold of yourself — we are leaving."

12caf86c-c298-4dca-94b4-202ac83560c6.Text: Under your influence, Solomorne began to allow his rage and pride to guide his actions when serving the law.

a7b99ec8-5b9e-475c-b6aa-fd0c7595a49d.Text: "You know something? You're right. I would gladly shoot half the people I encounter. Weak, cowardly worms in human skin."

8c5c32c8-d5e7-4986-8420-5aa16b1d0f91.Text: "You are not in your right mind. Let me help you."

990304fc-35ab-49ca-a140-76ec1bc81acb.Text: "If an Arbitrator from your squad was in your position, would you abandon them?"

2d57a3e5-55ec-4a95-a8ad-795f54498c9e.Text: "You protect Glaito, and you draw strength from that. Perhaps one day you will want to protect human lives, too."

91762a64-bbbb-40ec-859a-f03d4a904910.Text: "Why suppress your anger? Turn it to the service of the law. Teach your enemies such a lesson in pain and terror that the rest will never dream of violating the Lex."

aa69253c-7819-4f6b-a9a5-5b2bb43dec72.Text: "You do realise that we are talking about a half-servitor, a tool?"

73f3215f-67d9-4c5a-8545-9e68e7e7cc34.Text: "Even so, I am not leaving without you."

04cd02af-98c6-4497-a39f-f23af3a5764e.Text: "The Drukhari have been perfecting their art of killing for centuries, whereas you are wounded and exhausted — abandon your dream of a lone crusade against the xenos."

4ba7ae71-062d-4a7e-96b1-8c58fe99ff07.Text: "Proctor Solomorne Anthar, according to the Injuncta Cardinal, an Arbitrator stepping down from their post without leave is to be treated as a deserter and a traitor to the Imperium regardless of circumstances. How dare you interpret the spirit of the Lex Imperialis and decide your own fate when the letter of His Law has already given you purpose and rid you of the heresy of doubt?"

ef111e84-b5fe-48ec-9843-a0b8524076e1.Text: "You are only human, just like the people you judge. Make peace with yourself and find a new way to serve the law."

bd94933e-d341-498a-9f3f-77f61304610e.Text: "You are worth a dozen Arbitrators. It is not a death sentence you deserve but greater power. If you had it, what would you do?"

83cf1ef6-3679-4bcd-a6fb-e91cc67409ba.Text: "And what do I tell the Marshal? That his top Arbitrator died in this squalid hole? Or that he — void take me — fashioned himself a ladder of corpses and climbed out of this pit?"

3930759f-a4a9-415f-943c-1a3a20a1e06c.Text: "You spineless worm. Look at the state of you."

d0adace5-45cc-459f-8869-21b0c4a9936d.Text: "You do not think a mortal can embody the perfection of the law, do you? We can only strive. So, strive, then, Solomorne. You can do no more than that."

07c188b3-d1ca-41e0-8226-3059fbb8a9b7.Text: "Do you wish to die a hero? The Drukhari will catch you and break you, and you will die licking their feet."

6fe7725b-6eca-48d6-b3f7-17ec1c778dfa.Text: {n}You scarcely recognise the formerly sanguine and imperturbable Arbitrator in the frenzied, roiling mass of rage before you. Solomorne's face is twisted in a savage snarl:{/n} "I'll kill every last one of you! I'll kill you all! Where's my dog, you scum? WHERE IS HE?"

9ec0b84b-e084-4271-aa73-736efb11e181.Text: "Execution. I am my own executioner, and the city of the xenos will be my tool. I will kill as many of the spawn and their human servants as I can, and then I will go to the Emperor for my final judgement."

fe58afe3-9fe8-4a18-ac91-bea51ba181df.Text: {n}Solomorne closes his eyes as if in prayer.{/n} "Only the God-Emperor is perfect and can interpret the spirit of the law. We follow the letter of it as His faithful servants."

cd9ffed4-ee73-4494-b72c-93e6c9bd2e69.Text: "I don't remember. It was dark. I was being dragged somewhere. I called Glaito and I was struck, and then..." {n}Solomorne grips the back of Glaito's neck with a trembling hand.{/n} "I remembered the trap. And I started fighting. I felt no pain or fear, only rage. I came to in a different place and I searched, and searched, and searched..."

937fa0d3-e02e-43ff-bc27-550fdbaf8897.Text: "And you, you xenos scum. Why are you still breathing, wretch?"

e80e8231-4eb9-4853-9032-34d5149553a9.Text: "The elantach has chosen not to cut off my breathing. It is not for you to challenge {mf|his|her} decision."

9843e40a-613f-4299-a90c-483290878dcd.Text: {n}Stubbornly looking at you, he says through gritted teeth,{/n} "Humans may be imperfect, but His Law is not."

63ff94f9-5b38-43a5-8a3b-1df14623029c.Text: {n}Solomorne shakes his head.{/n} "I gave up hope long before now. Our world holds no less foulness than here — there, it is merely diluted."

67298ef5-2a98-4063-863e-15cbd25993f0.Text: {n}Kibellah gives Solomorne a look of sympathy, then pulls out one of her hidden blades and places it in his hand.{/n} "For the Undying One is duty itself."

ca63772c-94f1-46ec-9d3d-654410bb9f50.Text: "Get lost, Rogue Trader," {n}Solomorne says without malice, but his lips stretch into a feral, grotesque smile.{/n} "There is nothing more you can do here. Solomorne Anthar is guilty and is stepping down from his post."

4aac7b4f-ba3b-45ab-8b02-2966cd9dbbf0.Text: "I have judged myself and handed down the sentence. This accursed place is not the cause of it, though it did push me past breaking point. I cannot do it anymore — I cannot look at the lying governors, the scoundrels who succumb to corruption, the people who become the playthings of xenos..."

7c9933d9-a9da-4208-9e40-09f9b236e068.Text: "Or the xenos who consort with humans because, Throne take me, it is permitted under the law of your sector!"

d1b0be2f-c0eb-4744-afc6-fc9fd467c790.Text: "But, above all else, I cannot bear to look at myself — an Arbitrator who is coming apart at the seams. Who turns into a wreck without his dog. Who..." {n}Solomorne releases a ragged sigh.{/n} "Who no longer believes that the Lex Imperialis prevails anywhere at all."

99e3bf84-a785-42f7-a27a-d7545969b169.Text: "The Arbites already use fear as a weapon. But judging by the bastards I keep meeting, our tactics are next to useless."

6add5488-8815-4ccc-a965-7cee7361279c.Text: "I'd make them..." {n}He clenches his iron fist, the augmetic letting out a piteous creak.{/n} "Oh, they wouldn't dare to even think of breaking the law."

a37fc320-99b9-4b1e-a7be-3b85933f2c53.Text: "Like his master, there's something wrong with him." {n}His metal fingers trace over the stitches on the cyber-mastiff's forehead.{/n} "But he is not beyond repair. Take him — maybe you'll escape this place, and then the Tech-Priests on the flagship can fix him... I can't even guess at what the xenos have done to him."

40cfc52c-0f46-4ce6-930a-bca294c53cbf.Text: {n}Solomorne slowly raises his hand. His face is twisted in torment — perhaps his injuries are causing him pain, or perhaps it is the words he is trying to force out.{/n} "Glaito, Protocol Mortem-80. Guard the target." {n}Solomorne points a trembling finger at you.{/n}

46b15e28-4399-4cc5-9b97-8ecb2aa234a4.Text: {n}But the cyber-mastiff does not react. The scarlet lights of his visors stare at Solomorne, and not a muscle beneath the dark coat quivers in response to the order to leave his master.{/n}

3b8e9625-61d5-40ce-aac4-5f9ae206b291.Text: "Great. An error. Our synchronisation is broken, and now he..." {n}His voice rises to a roar:{/n} "Will this damned day ever end? My dog, the only one I would trust with my life — he..." {n}Solomorne shakes his head furiously.{/n}

0771bc20-ecc0-4d54-b9d2-970835eb64e0.Text: "No. He's not guilty. He never was and never will be. It's just... You can see I have a problem, can't you? What kind of Arbitrator turns into a quivering mess over a cyber-mastiff? It's a dependency, a weakness... I'm no longer fit for purpose."

9a84bb4e-4df8-4fad-9efe-c4f6bab2637f.Text: "There is no meanness in him, no fickleness. Tell me I'm mad, but he's my dog and without him I lose all reason."

0e19e473-3db9-487e-b998-248750bb7b2a.Text: "Well, well. Is it faulty implants, or true loyalty? I am going to believe that you have chosen to stay with me. To the end."

6401d582-7bee-4b7d-8794-170390e9f4bc.Text: "You will. You can't stand here forever."

07ce75c6-8a3d-4409-b41b-a1fa5a03452d.Text: {n}Solomorne glowers at you.{/n} "You escaped the xenos' clutches somehow. So, it's too early to write me off as well."

ec0f2510-6cb8-45ea-9046-a37c0e82f885.Text: "One outcome is worse than the other — are those my options?"

083c8428-6966-4428-b5a5-b5db24e98345.Text: "No!" {n}The Arbitrator growls through his teeth.{/n} "That won't happen. Ever."

a9f49e64-42bd-45da-812c-a4cb02187ae0.Text: "All right, I get it. If I don't yield, we'll just stand here and bicker." {n}There was no more rage in his voice, only limitless weariness.{/n} "Enough, you've got your way."

ed30d11b-7dc9-4a5e-95f1-3ba582683216.Text: "The trial of will is an immutable part of every journey. It is time to combat your weakness and light the fire of true faith in your heart."

c023d42a-ae2f-4610-a18d-fcba0839903c.Text: {n}Solomorne merely grunts in response.{/n} "Agreeing with me — is this some kind of trap?"

04c19cc3-1650-45e8-9554-14e99e97c85a.Text: {n}Marazhai scoffs.{/n} "Even the way you broke was boring. Go on, then. Commorragh devours millions like you every day — you will not get to savour your martyrdom for long."

780e403e-8dce-4fdb-a428-78df7c6608f9.Text: {n}Yrliet looks down at the man, but her voice sounds slightly gentler than usual.{/n} "You have seen the true face of your kind's world — ugly, cruel, and deceitful. But the pain you feel is not the end. You have a choice, even now. Even... here."

556863d0-4fc0-4b4f-ac57-9ab24ae968a8.Text: "I'll tell you this: you finally look like a person, Sol. Like someone who is capable of feeling something. And if a few of your screws had to come loose for you to get there, well... you're definitely not alone in that."

b5f173d5-d6bc-4735-87f3-673979d677ec.Text: "This statement is false. The unit is still fit to serve as high-quality base material for the purpose of servitorisation," {n}Pasqal interjects for seemingly no particular reason.{/n}

b76d3b35-ee57-4464-94e7-cde305403168.Text: "To die a true defender of Imperium is to die a heroic death. But it seems to me that to carry on living in the name of Humanity is no less-honourable a feat. Take heart, Proctor — do not let this place destroy you."

596ff413-ba0b-4752-ad5a-855b0c049965.Text: "He is unarmoured and defenceless as never before. But, until his colours turn to ash, there is a chance yet to set things right."

8ed64fdd-8e3a-47c2-a0e7-bf150e1c33dd.Text: {n}The Proctor grins crookedly.{/n} "A ladder of corpses. How does that sound, Glaito?"

0717e8da-19e7-462c-862f-26cb613f1003.Text: {n}Solomorne's iron fist unclenches slightly.{/n} "I never thought I would take comfort in naive platitudes. Clearly, I am losing my grip..."

77b20375-43d2-44b0-ba1f-92b799eb85db.Text: {n}Solomorne does not lift his heavy gaze from the cyber-mastiff.{/n} "It would be nice to at least know that I did everything I could to get Glaito out of here. Beyond that... we'll see."

5a631bf9-2c9e-4529-a2db-84f12a376bd6.Text: "No. I wouldn't listen to them. I'd haul them out of here on my back. I'd defend them to the last."

19b20168-d423-4ec2-baa6-3f6c9ef040bf.Text: {n}It seems Solomorne is a breath away from lunging for you next. But recognition glimmers in those deranged eyes and his voice goes quiet, as if all his strength has fled him.{/n}

c2bf5ab4-4608-4c3f-abc1-2dee20051047.Text: "Not a chance. I've got enough strength to take on at least one more scrawny Drukhari... but I'll admit, that still sounds like a terrible idea."

e3a68fa8-8897-4fa0-b42b-0947410113c0.Text: {n}Solomorne's nostrils flare in anger. Barely regaining control of his emotions, he mutters,{/n} "Even if you insist on my return, that won't change the crucial fact that I am no longer fit to serve the Lex. There is only one sentence for me — to stay here and send as many xenos to the abyss as I can."

09a101cb-351b-4726-b2b6-52be3710345a.Text: {n}Solomorne's rage crumbles into dust in the face of {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Arbitrator}your ironclad devotion{/d} to the code of the Adeptus Arbites.{/n} "What have I done... I have dishonoured the Arbitrator's duty with words of dissent. No, I am not a heretic — I am a faithful servant of the Emperor until my last breath."

89d726f2-559c-4ad7-9ce2-c715ad61cf28.Text: "Some plan I've made for myself. Craven fool." {n}Anger retreats from his voice, giving way to remorse.{/n} "But now I see where I have failed, and you... you didn't relent, didn't let me end my days in this ignominy. I guess that means I'm still worth something."

0bacd94c-c68f-4284-8c46-57a693d69b38.Text: "No one else will witness my judgement. Farewell, Rogue Trader."

696f69b6-824a-40b1-8079-c78f5bc65269.Text: {n}Solomorne accepts his death without a single sound, wearing a crooked smile on his face. Glaito does not even snarl, but simply goes still at his master's feet. Drops of blood slowly seep from the stitches on the dog's head.{/n}

23f1404e-f19a-4221-ae79-6124fc38e3ee.Text: "No. Stop. I can't leave — I'm guilty."

ed99e291-ec56-4189-bb7a-00b768701fac.Text: "Too many times has He diverted a bullet meant for me. Too many..."

a5d5a85b-3173-4dd2-a363-870479a92ec4.Text: "I do. I feel the weight of sentences undelivered. Of duty... unfulfilled."

bf028766-684b-405f-a613-2555d3c49da9.Text: {n}Metal fingers close around Glaito's collar.{/n} "Your words have been heard. I will rise above this foul city and everything in it — and return to my duties."

1ff52255-bd3a-4efd-918d-0af5b4b4b7c9.Text: "As jubilant as this occasion may be, it cannot distract me from my duty. You go ahead and celebrate, Rogue Trader. Glaito and I will make sure no one ruins your day."

b7c021e1-16d1-4ba7-a740-dcbea80900d6.Text: "The person responsible for maintaining security during the ceremony has carried out their duties adequately. The rest is inconsequential."

924b387f-9a0c-45d6-a7cc-e42738183a1c.Text: "You may send my regards to your master of ceremonies. He managed to complete this trivial procedure with minimal error."

51d4ddc6-1954-4c63-b4bf-a6c156890d56.Text: "I wish to know more about you."

9fc56892-9d1d-4ae0-af05-939342da6ac1.Text: "What types of crimes do you usually handle?"

2e694899-2212-4757-adf1-964aacd16c34.Text: "Just how far do the powers of the Adeptus Arbites extend?"

cf0b66f9-123f-4cf2-b8af-9033b54510aa.Text: "Let us talk about the Lex Imperialis. I am curious to know how you interpret its essence."

b04969e5-91cb-465e-a306-f4ee01670d45.Text: "What brought you specifically to the Koronus Expanse?"

3cea5876-bb25-4d74-92b2-dcb99af8c8eb.Text: "Would it kill you to do me this small favour?"

dc060ab2-8faa-4c8d-8349-8853b3331092.Text: "A transfer here sounds more like banishment to me."

520c5dce-cd3a-46b3-9b78-d0dccd54c062.Text: "When is he going to let me pet him already?"

aa362931-847d-4d62-b00c-602030c0b9d0.Text: "There is a reverence in your words that feels almost religious."

4548e83a-ff49-440d-b44e-04e083c4b8e9.Text: [Pet the dog] "You are a fine and loyal companion, aren't you, Glaito?"

96a51471-aecc-4aef-8493-c01ea8585c17.Text: "It sounds as if it is impossible to know the Lex Imperialis in its entirety."

40d17981-5d6b-49d6-a87c-fdcdac961434.Text: "What kinds of assignments did you handle before you were appointed to overseeing tithe cases?"

72ac2a61-8341-4fb4-9389-f7a2024be2ce.Text: "I am still going to pet him!"

14858a9b-fedc-4306-8ff3-f50efd896d81.Text: "Can't you ask Glaito to sit still for a moment?"

4e36baec-c2fe-43df-92ec-0ae92d08e2a6.Text: "I suppose my fingers do have sentimental value."

9d30faec-75e6-4146-8df7-fb386dae7278.Text: "I came to check how you were doing."

850c04f6-5897-4b96-878f-8be696ec5401.Text: "I am fortunate to be fighting on the same side as you."

d86e9bb8-3fba-4144-9f2e-24982756fb2a.Text: "What's done is done, but you should know: I need people who are not afraid to criticise my actions."

18a9fd0e-0335-4b47-8e6d-0720f1e312ad.Text: "Were you able to avenge your father?"

0be6a0b7-909a-4b22-9b63-7b5e543d1141.Text: "Hatred does not come from nowhere. It must have been your father's influence."

76c64628-68cc-431b-9c40-27f6fa0568bd.Text: "Did you just make up that sorry tale or did it actually happen?"

c55a1186-0dfb-41d0-a866-3ddca0e5ca3e.Text: "Parade your wit before me again, Arbitrator, and I'll have you swabbing the lower decks. Is that clear?"

2de29365-a9ab-4dfe-8c31-04afe7577903.Text: "It seems you were born to become an Arbitrator."

ad51159f-9f87-4072-93ee-32c5cb8e48db.Text: "Did the Marshal contact you about your reinstatement?"

360cefbe-82bd-4bad-87f2-3abe3716ea27.Text: "It must feel strange to be without your unit."

7258f71a-f568-4308-8d18-7d2074506d0e.Text: "Yes, indeed, how utterly sentimental of the old man."

7e1f2436-ccbb-41d8-966d-9a5549de7e4f.Text: "You talk about him as if he were a tool. Do you not feel attached to your dog at all?"

f9581ec6-c4f3-4213-8e50-d2a2b81bf4df.Text: "And you would be willing to sacrifice him for your mission?"

ef8c7063-1a3f-439d-840c-68c61cc2663d.Text: "Did I mishear, or did you just say you consider yourself to be on the same level as your dog?"

80f9debb-e2ab-46c6-9672-6e32af19c8d4.Text: "Duty comes before attachments to you, I see. Admirable."

11ee19df-e788-46c1-a46f-95483ecac5ad.Text: "Is Glaito fully servitorised, or is some part of him still a living dog?"

931000ab-bf53-4446-a9e1-dff267a7cb8f.Text: "Do not lose control like that again — I will not let you off so easy next time."

3751f56d-80d4-4104-918a-1d0259dbb2aa.Text: "Do you have any thoughts on how we might escape Commorragh?"

ec455180-2e22-4b14-9547-a1dbe3aa2318.Text: "I think you and Glaito could do with your own training ground. I will order a space be prepared in one of the compartments and have it outfitted with everything you need."

246024fa-c0e1-4e77-a1ab-768ef70154d3.Text: "I agree. Let's forget it ever happened."

f432bdf2-4af7-493d-8c2e-2714143cb3d2.Text: "I will be waiting for you in my chambers."

3f97ff9b-5481-4811-9e54-a37390da8676.Text: "I, Rogue Trader {name} von Valancius, order you to order Glaito to sit still!"

66d58b4b-31de-446d-a546-bf97bad56960.Text: "The attack on the barges, Sargona — these incidents are connected. Someone is desperately trying to seize the tithe."

d9ca102e-88d4-4ecd-90c0-62eec8a9622c.Text: "The prefect recently employed some mercenaries. An interesting coincidence..."

4629496c-8b22-4f55-a925-8142abb59b75.Text: "If you have a suspect in mind, I would appreciate it if you spoke plainly."

305927d0-c4c1-4aa6-ba3d-a7ccd6013033.Text: "I have no further need of you. Leave the ship."

fe9f9deb-66b3-44c6-8965-e199db772e13.Text: "I think I would like to keep my ties to the Adeptus Arbites. You may stay for now."

5a0c40fc-21c5-487f-b03e-d88c7881d696.Text: "Tell him that, as of this moment, I want nothing to do with any lawmen. You and your Marshal are never to disturb me again, or I will have you all removed from Dargonus. Dismissed."

a25e85ea-c6c7-4371-abd0-392dcb83d8d6.Text: "I have questions about what transpired at the Palace of Justice."

b82b5a89-34c0-4e8e-9f0a-3181ad450584.Text: "I know you had great respect for the Marshal. His crime must have come as a blow to you."

6fbbd3bb-e007-40fe-89a5-301d96c6ace8.Text: "What do you suppose awaits the Adeptus Arbites in the Koronus Expanse?"

9e7c9211-429b-4b04-a9b3-ef095a25cf22.Text: "What are your plans as the future Marshal?"

ed5b2585-b259-45e2-8247-f1d0cec922bc.Text: "You stood against me. I want to be certain that will not happen again."

9031db2b-d8e6-42d6-a9ef-c48cdd880efe.Text: "How is Glaito? Have you already had the recording device extracted?"

7e5b8b1f-c3b0-4e24-9892-5b9b49f055d5.Text: "Just how flawless is your memory of the core statutes of the Lex Imperialis?"

f2dced31-a328-41fb-882a-ec075aa085fe.Text: "I don't know why I said that. Forget I mentioned it."

34dae5d6-176c-4fed-87cf-db7f453e7c27.Text: "What I mean is that none of this is worth my attention. You can stop worrying — I am not interested in you anymore."

6e4fddbd-ea20-4b37-80ed-818df7e48edb.Text: [Grab your weapon] "Blasted mongrel! I'll teach you to behave!"

1bbb63fb-b147-40b7-bf0a-13158f09f66f.Text: "I have missed you, Solomorne. Come to my chambers."

6c51a6f5-9008-4135-b1a8-f6eb743b86e5.Text: "I am ready to hear your report on alleged collusion among the officers."

20057626-611c-4b4a-b8a1-78ca1eb003ce.Text: "Are you ready to talk about our relationship?"

e87f6dcf-c1f4-4580-8b03-de9813f94d65.Text: "An exaction squad... I see. A well-warranted measure."

43f72df3-c346-4068-a039-9a64ca6556b4.Text: "Where in the Koronus Expanse were you living prior to coming aboard my ship?"

ac5d3bf0-09d0-4cbb-90cc-d5f540d6676c.Text: "But every world still has its own laws."

95b3d15e-8f71-402b-beb0-f3fefe9be1ec.Text: "Then I want you to experience first-hand just how sharp this thing's teeth are."

1e8da0f5-1ce0-4e42-a3bf-d9ed588df24b.Text: "So, if you see someone trying to murder an innocent man whose life is irrelevant to maintaining order in the Imperium, you simply walk on by?"

bf1a5656-2d8f-466f-b3b4-e67c6c3aa019.Text: "I wish to ask you about something else."

2c16607b-c0cf-4db4-93c2-660f179e2383.Text: "Proctor, evidence suggests that you are not quite so indifferent to Glaito as you want people to believe."

1c41d870-c61a-4186-884a-6dc6a0883552.Text: "Have you been on any especially dangerous cases? I would like to hear about your accomplishments."

4b73ae49-85e8-4711-8b5c-2cd41e95e1e9.Text: "I have other business to attend to."

d9e19f3a-ad99-4108-ab76-a7a14b534b8a.Text: "Well, Rykad Minoris did fall on your watch..."

7aa17274-5387-4cb0-87c2-edd1ad6475c0.Text: "You are not getting off that easily, Solomorne. I need details."

1c515779-3d25-4a62-a6bb-93f7823bc9b3.Text: "What is the mission of the Adeptus Arbites in the Koronus Expanse?"

fe1ac7ff-6cfe-4c7e-90e2-ecba7b8cf36e.Text: "Am I imagining it, or do you seem... relaxed?"

7b07fa08-86ea-4255-86b8-b07e237cbb87.Text: "You are not making sense. With what you are going through, you are not thinking clearly."

0f1f34cd-4976-4338-a3ca-dc7af0bbbda2.Text: "Glaito is a tough cyber-mastiff — he's going to be fine."

ba2f60b3-96c2-4d1b-9bd7-7742ba364def.Text: "Can Pasqal help Glaito in any way?"

3c411631-f3c1-4163-8dcb-6a95adcba687.Text: "Good. That means we can converse like normal people."

89318863-7d52-4186-9458-aa2973083279.Text: "I am the kind of Rogue Trader who likes to hear all the gory details. Tell me everything!"

7c8a3ab7-24b7-409f-ba22-fc390be4f07f.Text: "You haven't said a word about your mother. Who was she?"

d9099e88-29ba-4dc2-8ce0-cba53974e1da.Text: "If your goal was to anger me, you have succeeded. To the warp with your story. Do not reply to me in such a fashion ever again."

b99f43b6-dad8-432d-9770-bde05a880210.Text: "I am ready to talk now about the intriguing contents of your data-slate — in my quarters."

b0accbfc-4ca7-4ece-b214-95b1506fc750.Text: [Show him the data-slate] "Solomorne, I happened to read something here, and I have a few questions."

619f8e00-b5a3-439b-b977-6d1984bb9867.Text: "The prefect can say what she likes — I am convinced that I made the right choice."

ddcb8282-2a21-41e7-bc53-83da417bf855.Text: [Give the dog a piece of dried meat] "Here you go, Glaito."

81cec583-0c52-4df9-ab08-479bb1881c30.Text: "Your advice led to me appearing before the Administratum in an unfavourable light. We should have handled the thassertium situation differently."

b090a840-2a3c-4a6f-9fb8-75c799861970.Text: "What do you think we could have done to satisfy the prefect?"

0288283c-b757-4423-b930-ee54bd87414e.Text: "I expect members of my retinue to offer useful assistance. You will endeavour to act in my interests from here on out."

43502bcd-3bde-4235-b5ad-492121c0d076.Text: "Think what you will, but I am capable of assuming responsibility and owning up to my mistakes."

793d6926-bcf4-42cd-a380-8bef63e936df.Text: "Do not be so angry, Solomorne. The prefect started pressuring me, so I said the first thing that came to my mind."

bfa8a48a-60f1-4425-a86b-6e7b4a126d26.Text: [Slap Solomorne] "You think you can judge me? Remember: I am the Rogue Trader, and you have no right to object to a word I say!"

9db22939-1888-4e84-b963-26a69b30380d.Text: "I am curious: did you like any of the entertainment we saw on Thassera?"

2c4f5736-d7d6-4332-abb6-505ec2187370.Text: "You are simply no good at enjoying yourself."

51f9fb71-c959-473c-9f44-11f8d2bf0fd9.Text: "There must have been something that appealed to you."

fea01828-ad84-4c81-afd9-e1b3bd5b5c60.Text: "Does Glaito have a favourite type of training or some other pastime of choice?"

601f32f0-fc68-4c8e-bf32-e9d5e070648d.Text: "On second thought, maybe Thassera was not all that impressive after all."

23a6099d-24f8-4003-9b1a-9ff5ca1df5fe.Text: "Shall we discuss the mission on Thassera?"

1c152755-2fc3-45c3-aa1e-7af524e5c369.Text: "We should discuss your return from Vheabos VI."

98a0a8b8-8003-4492-876d-786c12b70370.Text: "What do you wish to tell me?"

067ffa4d-6816-44ca-81eb-534c605e5380.Text: "I want to talk about what happened on Leethus."

7bc5b052-94a9-41a4-ad63-d2c9f6547b73.Text: "Do you have any thoughts on who might have been behind the attack on the barges?"

67635678-8779-42c3-8a05-838d690f1bb8.Text: "Why did the heretics capture you instead of just killing you on the spot?"

32a6e262-cdc9-438e-a98c-80d8c2ac0b9a.Text: "That can't be all of it, can it?"

c8016d0d-66ba-4369-b31f-3b669773656c.Text: "You did the right thing by executing your former comrade."

bcb2ae41-85ad-4985-b232-9f265586b2a6.Text: "If even Arbitrators are capable of violating the law, what does that say about the rest of Humanity?"

1478def7-14ae-49ad-ac89-dcf1a888ed64.Text: "How is Glaito? Do you two act as one again?"

359ef85f-d1b5-4ea2-82d3-48f74e20d69b.Text: "Pardon me, but exactly which part of that was heartfelt?"

a433b9e3-d4fb-4782-9772-0538be13fb69.Text: "I am sorry that you had to do that to your friend. You deserved better."

139ed3b9-382f-4ace-82e3-60438b3ab1f9.Text: "Enough vapid tragedy — one dead traitor does not warrant this much handwringing."

ad2e31f4-298e-463f-b184-3a33167d2d1c.Text: "I want to talk about what is happening between us."

4a6b48ff-09e4-4634-b1c8-f5546737b9a8.Text: "I will never believe that Glaito is just an instrument to you."

155a934b-7d20-47b7-ab26-fdda4b268e46.Text: "Just know that what we have is something I hold very dear."

4ddd5104-cc97-42c3-b48d-e945159fe6e5.Text: [Take half a step toward Solomorne and smile] "Be honest: do you think there is a chance for something to start between us? Something..."

e9664e05-abfe-47d6-98a6-2181472c5ea9.Text: [Take his hand] "Would you like to find out?"

4216283b-4863-4747-b83e-2b522ba6f981.Text: "Never mind that. I've made my choice."

2696331d-5bc0-42da-8a8b-a4a112e16e2f.Text: "You are right. We should just stop now."

9e370773-aa3e-4b03-a53a-a3509bc871db.Text: "You know, you jumping from 'it's only for one night' to 'I am in love with you after all' feels more than a little strange."

e6331278-ba56-4ab7-8421-44e9abe1b6fd.Text: "You no longer follow the letter of the Lex Imperialis, and your proposal regarding the fate of the Expanse's tithe proves it. Am I correct?"

5d295984-853f-45c7-bb1b-608433e0c02f.Text: "The matter of the watcher of Leethus has cast a shadow over my dynasty, but I want you to know: I am loyal to the Emperor's Law."

61b2c01a-cabb-4a9f-8c7f-884d81ed9d09.Text: "Trying to adhere to the Lex Imperialis causes more harm than good. Do you still not see it?"

f244b344-0258-4f2b-bdad-97507dbd8112.Text: "'Trouble' is putting it mildly. It is as though you had mutated into something utterly strange."

55e8be3c-84cc-417d-b1af-1e7e516e2fd1.Text: "I only wanted to hear your opinion, nothing more."

c69efb05-b087-4e93-82db-bfc931c9505d.Text: {n}Solomorne gives you a curt nod in greeting.{/n} "Rogue Trader?"

a1ea53ce-2d66-4e24-b379-0e11922faee9.Text: "Have you decided to make an exception for the Emperor's anointed, Glaito?" {n}Glaito puts his ears down under his master's gaze.{/n} "Fine. Congratulations on your achievement, Rogue Trader. Glaito has never allowed anyone to do that before."

6a619da1-ace0-4422-8adb-d7e0bfcdbf0d.Text: "You prefer to have a better understanding of the people you travel with? That makes sense." {n}Solomorne gives you a long, studying look.{/n} "Ask."

43344192-34a9-4a0e-99db-f61a39cec0ad.Text: "Port Wander, in Calixis. The gateway to the Expanse, a monumental station, always covered in ships and bursting at the seams from all the dealers, pilgrims, mercenaries, and criminals. Compared to Port Wander, Footfall is just a lifeless rock in the void."

59690bfb-d142-4261-8bfa-f9728ec79291.Text: "How?" {n}Solomorne echoes the word with a grim smile.{/n} "The short answer is: the Schola Progenium. But I doubt you'd be satisfied with that. My father was an Arbitrator. A good one — or else they wouldn't have found him in an alley, filled with bullet holes. Someone who served with my father told me he was shot with ten different weapons and that he took at least four of the bastards down with him."

b833bd38-296c-4be5-9a83-0bdcddf7daba.Text: "I was sent to the Schola Progenium right after that, and the mentors there forged me into an Arbitrator. I was an eager student, thanks to the example of unyielding duty and dignity my father set for me. The only thing I didn't need to borrow from him was hate. He didn't instil that — it was always with me." {n}Solomorne's gaze is completely emotionless.{/n} "I never doubted that criminal vermin deserve only execution, but it was my father's death that truly crystallised my hatred, made it complete."

b2b5fce8-5e16-44f7-800d-1dbf8e1496da.Text: {n}Glaito looks at the treat with indifference.{/n}

8a8887df-b4f6-4d82-b9cb-bb8907d050fd.Text: "You should ask the Marshal. I got my assignment, and that is all I know. I assume it's due to my experience: collecting tithes from worlds bordering on savagery and where people haven't seen a living Arbitrator in three generations is a task best left to a veteran."

140b4a8e-8fe3-4572-9970-6b658b02c46d.Text: {n}Solomorne shakes his head.{/n} "He has already done all he can, but there is no way to extract some unknown Drukhari filth out of Glaito while we're in the field. We will have to get by until we are back on the flagship, and that's that. I don't know if we will make it out of here, but in case we don't, there is something I must do..."

4350c6cd-6920-4ddc-8528-14085f777345.Text: {n}The cyber-mastiff growls quietly — it seems he does not take kindly to anyone making eye contact with him for more than a second.{/n}

faea44e8-be0e-4465-bc13-0fa1ae3bbd30.Text: "This isn't banishment. Otherwise, the same would apply to the Marshal and all other Arbitrators in the Koronus Expanse. We are here because the Imperium needs its tithe, and that's all there is to it."

37e67cfa-0f41-4f63-8a80-2c30139415d2.Text: "Probably never. That's just how Arbites dogs are. But Glaito definitely has a soft spot for you, considering he's not gnawing on your hand anymore."

5622fcad-bd16-464a-b0c9-666a4356eb22.Text: {n}The cyber-mastiff pricks up his ears, examining you with an intelligent look that seems anything but bestial.{/n}

1917c18f-2e30-4e1a-9f23-a86d8a5d2878.Text: "As it should. The codes of the Lex Imperialis are my prayer, and I believe that every Arbitrator's service is sacred, for it brings this imperfect reality closer to that inscribed in the Book of Judgement — closer to the God-Emperor's will."

8d36008a-a868-4965-8804-037cacba9873.Text: {n}Solomorne's hand darts between you and the dog.{/n} "A cyber-mastiff's handler bears sole responsibility for its actions. You may punish me, but me alone."

d469d292-ce35-4504-818f-826247cc1545.Text: "I must remind you that Glaito is a living weapon. If you like the number of fingers you have, do not touch the dog."

ae5e092c-f3a3-4317-8117-366367f6b310.Text: {n}He nonchalantly removes a piece of his armour, baring his remaining human forearm.{/n} "Glaito, target DX-1 — warning attack." {n}The cyber-mastiff bites down on his master's arm without hesitation, shaking it about viciously and spraying you with hot blood.{/n}
