ea8692bd-b078-4ada-820d-b6ba699862a0.Text: You have managed to keep a stony face while downing an entire dish of hot blaberids: a show of steel-hard composure.

40eaf940-4755-4868-b9df-ab21c7d4f457.Text: The amasec from the fountain has truly gone to your head.

4c2bdd73-76dd-4ddf-a77e-dcd7252d3a7b.Text: Glaito has taken damage after heroically defending you from bandits.

b60a0428-b8f9-476a-a143-2b1f02725062.Text: These are not your muscles. This is not your skin. Only your mind is still yours, but for how long?

f97a2df9-9819-4c42-8efa-f8888a98f135.Text: The nimble shrimperius has given you the slip, publicly casting doubt on your dexterity.

8d49a76e-0a6f-4abf-ab72-24ff215b68da.Text: You have bested a shrimperius in a battle of agility. Your reflexes are unparalleled!

694bd8d9-9881-48cd-8b2c-bca651270ce4.Text: Your very life's path has been carved into stone. Images of your future deeds are distracting you from the here and now. But someday, those fantasies will become reality.

0716bc31-7929-4d06-a807-b41da2de6e92.Text: Your very life's path has been carved into stone. One who lives in the present has no reason to fear the future. But sooner or later, the future catches up with everyone.

53f7abd9-480e-488f-bb96-3a9e6833023b.Text: Ruoldo is certainly no match for his chosen opponent.

7cf1dd08-e8e8-4401-b4a1-3b5e12be956d.Text: "All of you are going to pay for everything you have done to me!"

f0b2c1d1-693d-4fe6-957a-7e2c2285f0b5.Text: "You have stolen something from me, Ruoldo! I have come to reclaim it."

4fb5e0f6-bf0b-4533-ad10-5e56bb640966.Text: "Surrender now and confess everything, Governor. Perhaps, then, I will convince Solomorne to kill you swiftly."

a147669f-24bc-4307-8fa1-9dff16bc16f6.Text: "Well done, Solomorne! How did you know that would work?"

75dd0cdd-8f81-48ad-834f-f53aae29dcfe.Text: [Address Tavrisk] "Hey, psyker! Return me to my body at once, and I will grant you an easy death!"

aa18a565-a945-4991-a842-fabb85f85009.Text: "Your conspiracy almost entertained me. Fine, I suppose I will add this victory to my list of accomplishments."

2d376362-56fc-4091-a349-4296f096fd3c.Text: "EMPEROR KNOWS I was trying to give you a chance."

5a801a73-01f8-4121-ad2f-022647aaaf43.Text: "Governor Ruoldo! For the crimes of stealing my body from me, practising heresy, and all-round monstrousness, you are hereby sentenced to death! Attack!"

04f33087-ee6a-4f30-84d7-ad842daaead9.Text: "Has anyone got a lho-stick? I badly need a puff."

8fea3085-2ffd-4624-8b00-80a631de0829.Text: "But why did you not get out of the cage earlier? You could have..."

3baff4ba-b72c-4139-b7ad-745893e7a005.Text: "Let's go with an old Thasserian proverb: 'do not feed the horse you cannot outrun.'"

19037cbb-0533-4250-acb8-b051d2c494ac.Text: "One last stick before you go? I approve — let us respect that tradition! Somebody fetch me a—"

b762b181-61f7-4261-8af9-9e9a9a6ffb2e.Text: {n}When the dust clears, you see the familiar hall. From the shadows, the jester's eyes spark with malice as they meet yours. Behind him stands a cage, in which you, or rather your body, is sitting. Your face is awash with tears, your lip is split, and a vox lies next to you. In another cage to the side stands Solomorne, glaring through the bars at the true governor of Thassera. Upon seeing you and Glaito, the Proctor straightens. It seems he was just waiting for your return. Without taking his intent gaze off you, he gives you a slow nod: he is ready to fight.{/n}

3957e957-6713-4d39-bbcb-95e6394f7bdc.Text: {n}The fool mockingly sticks out his chin.{/n} "And how, may I ask, do you intend to do that? Only Tavrisk and myself know how the ritual works; certainly, he is the only one who can perform it. And it just so happens that we don't feel much inclined to cooperate."

1a0ee342-b9c4-4cfd-a191-b92deed5104c.Text: {n}Ruoldo's loud cackling reverberates around the hall, creating a thousand echoes.{/n} "Sculptor! You may begin!"

9745b516-098f-4653-afd5-6661d9a031d9.Text: "How very generous! Allow me to repay you in kind. If you leave now, you may live out the rest of your days on my planet as that dunce of a woman! No, wait. I've changed my—"

e194b937-c8d0-44b9-b3c1-11c299b1dead.Text: {n}Maive, the real Maive, looks at you through watering eyes.{/n} "Myself again... It was so... so..." {n}She lacks the strength for anything more, and her body collapses to the ground.{/n}

d86ee007-8af1-489b-a232-408c69152d7e.Text: {n}Without removing his hands from the stone in front of him, the heavily augmented old man turns around to look at you, an expression of utter amazement spreading across his face.{/n} "But why? Why would I negotiate with a corpse-to-be? You are the past, and the governor and I are bound for the future!"

ade4c5a5-45fd-4573-8ebc-3412085bd5c6.Text: {n}The metal of the cage emits a piteous creak as Solomorne slams his entire weight against the bars...{/n}

2719437f-e217-4ec8-9eed-1d2353b56393.Text: {n}The court fool snaps his fingers, and the guards ready their weapons. In the tense silence that follows, every sound, every movement can be clearly heard. And then...{/n}

6c91c0ff-b671-4714-bc4e-40c91f23aa4f.Text: {n}Ruoldo casts a furtive glance out the window and lets out a hesitant giggle.{/n} "Decided to show a little decorum, my celestial guest? It is a little late for tha—"

96550f8e-9d89-424d-8913-3533ba03224c.Text: "I didn't. But the heretics were so obsessed with this lump of stone, I figured their sorcery would be ruined without it."

087e21ca-b575-4bdd-b836-8cc460697459.Text: "How dare you order anyone around in my own palace! Tavrisk, do it!"

784cb6d2-d677-47c7-bea6-9f7c94054596.Text: "I don't know, Rogue Trader. My finger might twitch, and Glaito will think it's an order to spill his guts."

facca090-b8b3-4949-829a-7deb13c949c1.Text: "But how did you... the elevator! Damn it, why did you have to make all this commotion? Why couldn't you just sit in a cage, out of the way, and wait for the ritual to be completed?" {n}The fool looks back at the altar.{/n} "Tavrisk, move!"

313c46b4-d4ed-45f9-b3bd-ac23087dc64d.Text: "There is truth in his words: it is senseless to negotiate with a corpse-to-be." {n}Kibellah runs her fingers along the edge of her blade with a slow, almost caressing motion.{/n}

670d06cc-6f2e-4bfc-ba7e-15a2fadcb7a8.Text: "What is that old louse muttering now? Judging by that fulsome sneer of his, it's not the praises of the Allfather."

f2e148ca-90a6-4b09-81f7-cd41d543bad7.Text: "Your tongue is a quite superfluous part of your body, Vil'Ruoldo. Worry not — this flaw is easy to correct."

485bea01-9142-4e63-b60a-7fbe2c77e765.Text: "The term 'cooperation' is hardly applicable in this circumstance, Ruoldo." {n}As Heinrix speaks, his gaze, focused and grim, sweeps over the hall, the altar, and Tavrisk's decrepit frame.{/n}

dd10b6a1-27a3-42c7-ba24-7d0ad251990a.Text: "You're really, really not going to like that future, old man. The ones beyond the door already send their regards. They say they can't wait to meet you and this little king of yours."

e7d1d6c3-35a7-4f41-af2a-368f39e765e4.Text: "They would be of no help to him now. Nothing would." {n}Argenta's eyes are ablaze, her hands firmly clutching her weapon.{/n}

a1d53be7-9006-4449-81bf-863c426dd858.Text: "More often than not, there is a ravine of differences lying between us, Master Interrogator. But right now, I am prepared to cross it, so that we may stand together and give this one's motley posterior the beating it deserves." {n}Jae's crooked smile is as grim as Heinrix's.{/n}

f63bed8b-d0ff-4ae1-a15c-77ca12debfbf.Text: {n}Ruoldo angrily grits his teeth as he shoots them both a withering look.{/n}

9b79c435-4a8c-443c-a1f1-1f1bfcb64387.Text: "Ah!" {n}Cassia flinches and shields her eyes with her hand.{/n} "The deathly light of thassertium... It is all around him, permeating his soul, melding into his colour, his essence..."

7654cf09-89ef-4039-be39-8da6c8d88851.Text: {n}The psyker's cracked skin seems ready to crumble to dust, but his thassertium eyes burn with an otherworldly fire.{/n} "The ritual is nearly complete, my lord. The Altar of Change is ready to irrevocably switch the threads of fate."

7426929e-c439-4216-b5ae-fd109491ebe7.Text: "I doubt it. Loosening the cage's fastenings without being noticed proved to be quite difficult. Besides, without you and Glaito there, the outcome would have been too unpredictable, and I had no room for error. But there was one thing I knew for sure: Glaito's implants and mine were exchanging data logs, which meant you were alive. So I waited."

cb10a5b4-6f35-4db5-8f2d-d8707fb770ef.Text: "So the rumours were true? I'll remember that arrogant tone when I'm the one flaunting your {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_MOT_GreatDeed}exploits{/d} in your body!" {n}The fool laughs, but the laughter sounds nervous.{/n}

68b6976f-fefe-47a7-9851-ee6d33ce672e.Text: "I have heard plenty of nonsense spoken by convicts, but that drivel wins first place."

01653c3d-d595-4b87-919d-9420964554f6.Text: {n}The fool delivers a mocking bow, as if inviting you to dance.{/n} "Dying was not among my plans tonight. Sculptor, get to work!"

2a875836-1336-4237-b136-358e2e07da76.Text: {n}You struggle to open your eyes. After the world has once again taken shape, you realise that you are staring at your own palms, from your own eye sockets. You move a hand, and each muscle responds gratefully, filling with warmth. The others watch you with a mixture of hope and dismay.{/n}

5b9cb8d6-ae1a-47c4-8d4f-a8eee4d9329f.Text: "Aren't you that One-Eye fellow? Should I give Murgeth your regards? She's waiting for me up ahead!"

28964f92-56ac-4b8e-a13c-6f7d3f87e465.Text: "Listen here, you groxshit. Us from the underbelly have ways to repay those who go after our own — in the same coin. Got it?"

fa254bb6-86b1-4942-b572-a5212fba0b8a.Text: "Please, let me through. I'm just a poor girl. I don't have anything!"

77878806-5fae-4ed7-abc3-341f7485d6b6.Text: "Of course I'll lend it to you. Right after I flay you where you stand, scum."

992b9b17-db75-44a6-b271-a15824ef4188.Text: {n}The local inhabitants coming down the slope look hostile in the extreme. The vilest of them is missing an eye, but he makes sure to keep his remaining one fixed on you.{/n}

62d0e6bb-3093-4633-9722-cfa8213b134f.Text: "Hey, poppet. Where'd you get that dress? You know, my bride-to-be would love to wear a dress like that on her wedding day. Would you lend it to her?" {n}The one-eyed bandit glances at your dirty yet expensive clothes. Something tells you that these people would gladly peel the dress off you, right along with your skin.{/n}

f95e4443-2fcf-410f-911c-b37112b2ccfa.Text: {n}Something in your gaze causes the bandits' smiles to disappear. One of them whispers something to the leader. The one-eyed man clicks his tongue to mask his trepidation.{/n} "Groxshit... Off with you. Putting down palace brats is more mess than it's worth."

1a52df09-74e6-4d8f-b5cb-ef4a1404acdd.Text: {n}Something resembling sympathy flickers in the man's lone eye.{/n} "Fine, pretty. We're all in the same boat down here. My bride-to-be will make do without your dress. Go."

95a8cb15-ba1a-4c1f-87be-62bffbd4594c.Text: {n}The bandits sneer while eyeing the cyber-mastiff. Suddenly, a familiar voice calls out from above:{/n} "You leave that sweet girl alone, you half-baked bridegroom! I won't accept a present like that — and if you hurt her, I won't let you on my doorstep either!" {n}The {d|Encyclopedia:FW_LadyReleasedDecision}young woman from the Impostor Hunt{/d} is smiling at you from the balcony of a nearby hut. It is hard to say if she has recognised you as the Rogue Trader, but she clearly remembers Maive.{/n}

61d2974f-c2fb-4bbb-96c7-8c3ddf61e99d.Text: {n}The cyber-mastiff lunges at the leader of the bandits — his metal jaws start mincing flesh and bone like the knives of a giant meat grinder, moving faster than your eyes can even follow. Within seconds, the man who threatened you is a mutilated corpse, and his more fortunate henchmen are fleeing in terror.{/n}

8f13ace4-5516-4b9c-b3b7-87d50fbfd3d0.Text: {n}The bandit leader glares at the woman, then spits.{/n} "That fussy hag! Thinks she can push me around... You, in the dress: get lost if you know what's good for you!"

58675b35-189a-4431-9ef7-10d9635e2051.Text: {n}Several bandits at once break into howling laughter.{/n} "Oh, that sure gave me a fright, it did," {n}says the leader through the tears, casually pulling a knife from his sleeve. Glaito, standing by your leg, lets out a rumbling growl, and the laughter stops.{/n}

c2c023d8-03a7-4f22-9c1b-420c843bc615.Text: {n}The bandits let you pass, having seemingly lost all interest in you.{/n}

33c1f546-b2f1-4362-a11e-e1cd435d5ae9.Text: {n}The bandits exchange looks, and one of them lets out a whistle. The leader looks caught off guard.{/n} "So, you're {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Criminal}one of us{/d} then. All right, I hear you. Just stay off my turf from now on, yeah?"

66639758-eb3d-492c-94bb-f6a8ebd2edd8.Text: {n}You watch the bandit leader's expression {d|Encyclopedia:FW_LowlifeSecretDecision}slowly shift{/d} from confusion to barely concealed terror.{/n} "Damn it... You can give her this!" {n}After making a rude gesture at you, the man turns and steps aside.{/n}

d15ba2e7-b506-4cec-8219-afa53600b800.Text: {n}One of the bandits pulls out a knife, apparently planning to take on the cyber-mastiff, then stops dead. You hear a voice behind you, one you recognise:{/n} "This woman has the right cut. Leave her alone, or come meet my scissors."

a5899d40-186a-4f4f-8cbc-c2d6ec076ccb.Text: {n}You turn around to see a {d|Encyclopedia:FW_AvengerReleasedDecision}familiar figure{/d} standing by a wall — the avenger from the rich quarters. The bandits' faces suddenly tense. The one-eyed leader scoffs:{/n} "Take the girl if you fancy her so much. I don't like crossing lunatics."

91590004-e98b-4add-a083-131cbe404f6e.Text: {n}You notice that the cyber-mastiff's jaw is slightly crooked — one of the bandits must have managed to get in a solid blow. When you try to touch it, Glaito turns away and growls menacingly.{/n}

96dad82a-7eb0-4298-a8f3-6b6e2047255f.Text: "Uh-huh, sure. I'll bet that nice dress of yours is from the upper quarters. And that dog? Ooh, so fancy-looking! I'd love one of those for myself." {n}The leader takes a step forward. Glaito moves to block his path. A low growl makes the hound's jaws vibrate.{/n}

6a9ecf90-b726-450e-9938-1ef99c5ca4bf.Text: "Cogicor, answer only 'yes' or 'no.' Is your next answer going to be 'no'?"

e9e91bc5-dfb6-45ee-b066-c459c6f3c5ba.Text: [Listen to the sounds coming from the box]

36e00bd3-7441-44f5-92ca-45c43bc1359b.Text: "There is something I wish to ask this 'Cogicor.'"

8c28b930-8e48-4433-a1a3-e893cb7d7df6.Text: "Cogicor, what is the distance between earth and sky?"

6be4b796-9810-4d35-92b8-54fce857541e.Text: "Cogicor, what does the future have in store for me?"

7fc1aa74-eed8-48b9-9534-1c83e041ad80.Text: "Cogicor, what is the punishment for liars and frauds?"

c1feb857-a1be-4674-af29-094051bcf7f9.Text: "Unseal the box and let this poor soul out at once!"

c7beb7d5-6733-4ca8-8c65-a31a5e7f62d1.Text: "What a rare and magnificent gift! I will be honoured to display it in my chambers."

b56b20c9-00fe-4df6-ae13-f2a682891845.Text: [Break the box] "I heard that 'Cogicors' are also indestructible. Let's see if the tales were true!"

5335e265-a807-40af-ac0b-0a810dbeba40.Text: Pardoned the brothers after they offered you a gift on Thassera.

e7721b06-05d3-4911-b1d1-75be67f25734.Text: "You are nothing but a pair of dim-witted lickspittles. But mere stupidity hardly warrants an execution. Get out of my sight!"

9e1da30c-9a84-4ead-8350-154e3c8a00fd.Text: Punished the brothers after they offered you a gift on Thassera.

d4f2d320-0ac9-4e55-a370-5b8dff394f1a.Text: "I will inform the governor of your stunt. I hope that a few dozen lashes will teach you to respect the Omnissiah!"

64ff7a34-74b2-4355-bbaa-15afaa68ae19.Text: Killed the brothers after they offered you a gift on Thassera.

ea36a7dc-fd1e-4dd4-8dba-6c45c2b9de6b.Text: [Kill one of the brothers] "You dare mock the Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}?"

a940130a-e9c7-4c0f-8bd4-cb297edb4249.Text: "The ancient scrolls tell of a wonder, a mechanical sage by the name of Cogicor! It knows the answers to all questions, can make other machines do its bidding, and may even predict the future. My brother and I have borne many a hardship, but we managed to acquire this magic contraption for our much-cherished guest!"

10b91f7b-d5b8-4b4b-aa6e-630e7b2876d9.Text: {n}The box in front of you, presumably the Cogicor they speak of, exudes a strong odour of ritual oils. Made of thin planks, it is covered in so many purity seals that it seems to be held together by them alone. A stack of flimsy rough paper lies atop it, and there is a mica panel with malachite buttons attached to the front. A thin slit is visible among the buttons.{/n}

2d01213b-2535-48f4-85f6-c0aad7ecf7e0.Text: {n}Abelard sighs heavily and leans over to you.{/n} "Sometimes, when information reaches the more backward worlds, it undergoes strange metamorphoses in the minds of unfortunate and regrettably parochial laypeople... Have mercy, Lord Captain. They probably have been trying to please you."

f500ed2b-6cb3-48d7-a388-748ee72fd9de.Text: {n}Heinrix shrugs.{/n} "I've seen quite a few distortions of Gothic on primitive worlds... But I do not recall ever seeing such a miscomprehension of the Omnissiah's gifts."

95deae31-58ef-4e50-b60d-5d6309103ca2.Text: {n}There is a barely audible breathing coming from the box. Whoever is inside wants very much not to be noticed.{/n}

90099019-4667-4827-b2ad-dfb75ceb15d7.Text: {n}Surprisingly, the quiet rustle coming from the box does in fact resemble the hum of a cogitator.{/n}

cf755dcc-a1e2-40ab-a91a-a2bb18084fac.Text: "If I may advise the Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}... In order to receive an answer, one should take a piece of paper and slide it into the hole here. Then, touch this stone and ask the question loudly and clearly."

f491f0f6-02c7-4233-8440-4f3e67ba3487.Text: {n}The sheet you offer is consumed with a speed beyond that of an ordinary autoquill. After a few moments, the sheet returns with a single notation: "LOTS."{/n}

37bdbce0-b481-41fd-b208-5500ebe69600.Text: {n}The sheet shoots back out of the box and falls to the ground. It bears a solemn inscription: "GLORY EVERLASTING."{/n}

26dae1b8-f41e-4197-b563-0aa99125317e.Text: {n}The box holds the paper for a long time. When the sheet finally emerges from the slot, it is visibly shaking. You see the words "IMMOLATION. PLEASE DON'T."{/n}

7d4527be-31cb-4f7a-866e-b3ee8d536802.Text: "As you wish. Do not hesitate to pose more questions! It has enough ink for many more answers."

8f2a9ba4-145f-4f5c-a87f-481b9c649d5c.Text: "Who? What poor soul? I do not..." {n}The young nobleman addressing you withers under the scathing gaze of his partner.{/n}

72c4e80d-f007-490e-a4f4-4fcf35be583c.Text: "As you command, my Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}. Forgive us... We wished only to delight you by reproducing an otherworldly miracle we had read about in an ancient chronicle..."

276c5032-2113-4961-ac62-8b1bbfe09de5.Text: "Our hearts flutter at the opportunity to please the Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}! May this sagacious machine assist you in your endeavours."

c683ad67-020b-4321-baf6-4df4d3d96299.Text: {n}The box's thin walls splinter under your blows, and the ink-stained body of an old man falls to the paving stones. The two noblemen look away nervously, but they do not risk fleeing your wrath.{/n}

74df82f7-04f6-4ec8-a7ed-70cca605ba90.Text: "We did not mean to offend! We only wished to please..."

552758a1-02a3-4932-82a5-04fd2b5c154c.Text: {n}As you approach, the nobles bow gracefully. Their sewn-on faces are wrapped tightly around their skulls, and their eyes gleam with earnest subservience. One dares to address you:{/n} "O Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}, grace us with your regard! When my brother and I heard of your arrival, we immediately sought to surprise you with an exceptional gift."

b0bc4829-3ab6-473c-98a4-eb8c7b8fc35f.Text: {n}The miraculous device reluctantly accepts the offered paper and makes a vague moan-like sound. After a languid moment of waiting, you are presented with a sheet that reads "ERR" — which most likely means "error."{/n}

e31686a4-170c-4392-a095-9cf6821b9ff5.Text: {n}After a chrono-turn of heavy silence, Pasqal finally intones,{/n} "I am registering an act of... imitation of sanctity. This cultural phenomenon is typical of underdeveloped tribes. I also anticipate the discovery of cave pictograms dedicated to the divine arrival of the more advanced units."

4a578a98-b1ce-4802-b7a2-9d3f9f155603.Text: {n}Solomorne folds his arms and leans toward the slot, his voice ringing with steel:{/n} "Machines cannot feel fear, 'Cogicor.' They can only meekly accept their fate." {n}The Proctor catches your gaze and shrugs.{/n} "I couldn't help myself."

aba893d0-fb10-4c61-b385-9efe8896a453.Text: {n}Glaito stalks toward the box and bares his fangs, while Solomorne frowns grimly at the device:{/n} "Really? Then again, what else could you expect from this ignorant world..."

8c5db463-d21e-4e18-b33d-0492dfbee812.Text: Challenged the daemon that invaded your thoughts on Thassera.

229abbc7-fed6-48da-a26b-b19ffbfa4738.Text: "You are nothing but a worm in the shadow of the Golden Throne! Reveal yourself to me, and let us fight! Or is hiding like a coward in the back of a person's thoughts all you are capable of doing?"

b62bd4f7-9caa-40df-a13e-aadbc3f09051.Text: Rejected the protection of the daemon that invaded your thoughts on Thassera.

be8b4578-60e7-485b-a217-fc23fa9533a8.Text: "I need no protection, daemon. People are stronger than you think."

7f4c3ed9-0b09-4a92-ad09-af4144d74eb1.Text: Thanked the daemon that invaded your thoughts on Thassera.

7c9abaa1-c891-45e1-95cc-c6e8773c7242.Text: "My gratitude will not be long in coming, Master."

34aaf6f8-e861-427b-8190-52498f2236b1.Text: {n}A moment of ringing silence — and then, a thousand shards pierce your mind. A familiar voice coils around your thoughts, drowning them out:{/n} "Are you leaving without even conversing with me, Child? Without even asking yourself how such a vivid soul managed to remain intact after wandering in the darkness's embrace and donning another's guise? Such rare luck for a mortal."

e5f22120-af26-400a-a20e-f737419ca6ea.Text: "And their time is so fleeting..." {n}The echo of the entity's voice lingers for a while, like the sound of distant thunder.{/n}

3b531e4e-561e-4868-bd3c-44d5bdcb4376.Text: {n}In the icy silence, you are struck with a series of incredibly lifelike recollections. You are not alone, and you never were. It was always there, in your shadow, in your blood, inside you.{/n} "...Yes, {name}. This luck is named the Edge of Daybreak. Had it not been for my sleepless gaze, your mind would have long since joined the mournful host of those who are no more. It was I who kept it whole and unharmed, for I could not allow such a radiant destiny to fall to some absurdity. But at times, I do wonder: is it worthy of my protection?"

74ffe08a-dc2b-4505-8602-d2f7cb8bf6ce.Text: "There it is: the ingratitude and obliviousness of the insects that call themselves Humanity. I am no corporeal body that can be slain, Child. All of time belongs to me, as does every thread in the tapestry of destinies. I need but touch one of them..." {n}You feel a sharp pain, and a trickle of blood runs down your temple. A taste of grim solemnity permeates the silence of your unseen interlocutor.{/n} "But I am generous: I give my chosen Children time to understand..."

20758437-6a5a-4bd8-a846-0e0048cf0934.Text: "Naivety is a bold luxury... Is it not time to face the truth, Child? The threads of fate will not obey your desire alone. But I can help you to grasp them, once you are ready. Thankfully, I am generous: I give my chosen Children time to understand. After all, human souls are so fragile..." {n}You feel a sharp pain, and a trickle of blood runs down your temple.{/n}

91c3d2d8-7666-4e72-a103-129d4d9bd819.Text: "Soon. Very soon now, Child." {n}Ravenous sparks of foreign visions illuminate your mind.{/n} "You are not yet able to fathom the grand design of the Weaver of Destinies, but you may already relish this taste of power, of triumph, of true freedom, Child!"

c40c2a07-2061-49c7-9704-73b477bd45d1.Text: {n}You feel a sharp pain, and a trickle of blood runs down your chin — absorbed in the sudden cascade of images, you did not notice yourself biting your lip. Your patron has departed your mind.{/n}

979167d3-4570-4c77-87d4-9a9e6fe09c7b.Text: "Do you always have amasec flowing from that fountain?"

0147e492-a361-45b9-8e3f-a9418805f4dd.Text: [Drink] "Your 'enjoyments' and 'entertainments' are impossible to watch in a sober state."

d88563b9-521b-4a31-bed5-0ef7e6f965e7.Text: [Step away] "I prefer to keep my mind clear."

c0abe8ba-afb5-4cee-a3a8-22b84eb24ab1.Text: [Step away] "I think I have had enough."

07d29930-a94a-42a6-865f-0280dc12be52.Text: [Drink] "I am ready to celebrate my glorious self!"

04120fc3-4a20-4a04-8af6-a5a063a0dcd0.Text: [Hand the cup to Solomorne] "The duty of a valued guest is calling, Proctor."

5381d188-f15d-4398-b672-7aa7c4af391d.Text: [Hand the cup to Solomorne] "Let us give our hosts their due and raise a toast to companionship, shall we? Let us lock our arms together and seal this solemn ritual with a kiss!"

f6a734e3-21be-4901-9372-af3f4d9b84a3.Text: "The fools of this backward world won't be the only ones insulted should you refuse."

4bfb0836-339a-4b4e-a50a-49658ba5c9c2.Text: {n}Dark-maroon amasec is pouring out of the ridiculously gaudy fountain. An eager cup-bearer hands you a goblet filled to the brim.{/n} "Have a taste, if you please, my Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}! This vintage had been maturing ever since we laid the cornerstone of our citadel. We tapped it to celebrate you."

c1b021b4-fb4c-475c-9421-e375061dc88c.Text: "Thank you, Lord Captain, but we need one of us to remain sober." {n}The Interrogator gives you a mildly reproachful look.{/n}

959518b0-3b82-4295-adb1-e977a94b50ec.Text: {n}Yrliet looks at the cup of amasec with what seems to be desperation. Finally, she twists her lips and utters a forced but firm{/n} "No."

560d6401-88dc-45f1-8f5b-bae0af7d53d5.Text: {n}A pleasant warmth spreads through your body. The liquor is surprisingly palatable. The servant fills another cup and exclaims,{/n} "May your spirit be stronger than any amasec!"

738e41d0-61d0-4a1d-9550-9dd433471a02.Text: "I dare not protest! Should you change your mind, I am always at your service."

c6d64c5f-b926-4997-a4f9-607652e1225a.Text: {n}Marazhai wrinkles his nose in disgust.{/n} "I could smell the reek of this awful slosh from orbit. Do not insult me with the suggestion that I might want to drink it."

52ccfb60-d934-4a15-999a-42f1f564c8cb.Text: "Request denied. I am registering a number of mind-altering substances in this preparation that act as cognitive suppressants." {n}Pasqal casts a long glance at the fountain.{/n} "The layman or woman who conceived the idea of installing a poisonous fountain in a public place must have been under the influence of the poison themselves."

ea35f90e-8b5c-4497-8b6c-df86f54754bb.Text: "Amasec clouds the mind and darkens the eye. I will refrain, Rogue Trader."

2a3be9f8-1a9e-4c14-9580-ba61b6e1fb2e.Text: {n}You lean over the parapet with elegance, or what feels like it, and catch the amasec in your mouth. The dumbstruck servant sends the cups crashing to the ground. Anyone else who wants a drink will have to wait, or else follow your brilliant example.{/n}

55ba19e1-07d5-486e-9b11-759f24bccb09.Text: {n}Your mind is a little hazy, and a drunken flush brightens your cheeks. The amasec may go down deceptively smoothly, but its strength is already making itself known.{/n}

08e51fc5-af35-49d1-abc2-df300c2fd330.Text: {n}The cup-bearer beams.{/n} "Has your promenade put you in the mood for a drink, my Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}?"

8a5b04c5-1830-4d94-84ed-c3c78214add2.Text: {n}The world around you begins to swim before your eyes, and the sight of the maroon liquid makes you a little nauseous. You probably should not drink any more of it.{/n}

5af4c175-c55c-4d39-9c5b-137f9afc4aa1.Text: {n}The sight of the liquor makes you a little nauseous. You probably should not drink any more of it.{/n}

308eafdb-d541-49fd-8c67-2ffd945413f2.Text: {n}Your head feels light and pleasantly empty. It looks like you are more than a little tipsy. A heavy hand is laid on your shoulder, and Solomorne's voice comes in cold and insistent:{/n} "You ought to stop, Rogue Trader. We still have business to attend to."

864e45d3-a897-4eab-840d-34faa12fbdc2.Text: {n}The young woman's cheeks flush a bright red as she accepts the drink from you.{/n} "Thank you, my Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}. Here's to you prospering forever, and Thassera always serving you truly and faithfully..." {n}Maive takes a sip and coughs, but upon noticing your gaze, she bravely downs the drink after all.{/n}

d6d27995-3a9a-45e6-aaf7-7f6565f9ba6a.Text: {n}A stream of alcohol hits your nose. Your hands slip off the parapet. In full dress and along with all your weapons, you fall into the fragrant liquor, making a terribly loud splash.{/n}

43df3a18-0ba8-4cc5-a463-fab155c08204.Text: "You are just like Glaito when he sinks his teeth into a heretic." {n}The Proctor takes the cup and downs it in one long, powerful gulp.{/n} "Are you sure this is amasec? It is a tad watery. Trust a planet that underpays its tithe to dilute its liquor as well."

3c6daf0e-28b0-434e-8407-18036711da74.Text: {n}The cup-bearer refills your goblet. Then, with a sudden soulfulness, he looks into your eyes and sighs,{/n} "May you, unlike the rest, always be the {mf|master|mistress} of your fate."

c468c69d-ae1f-481f-8e11-ac81fd9b0f9e.Text: {n}Ulfar frowns sceptically before taking a powerful swig. He grimaces with contempt and spits on the ground.{/n} "Serving this sour hogwash to mighty warriors is a disgrace. Such tasteless slop can do nothing to raise the spirit."

3ee5a859-be62-4392-947d-0534fc875816.Text: "It is an honour to accept a gift from you, Domin." {n}Kibellah looks pensively at her own reflection in the cup and, with a swift motion of her hand, pours its contents into her ceremonial flask.{/n}

a432cebf-34c2-42c8-82cb-2243e82ae444.Text: "By no means! Such frivolous excess would impede us in carrying out our burden of service to the Emperor. It is only on truly great days, such as today, that the fountain pours forth this noble beverage. Besides, even the sturdiest of servants could not work the pump for days on end."

bd78109f-a0d9-4260-aab2-f00bc7af87e6.Text: "Naturally, my Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}! It requires the gruelling labour of dozens of sturdy workers to create an upward movement of the liquid in the pipes! It is a most useful contraption!"

ba271a7e-62a4-41cd-973f-945ee27994dd.Text: "I was planning to simply refuse... but I am nonetheless glad that the truth has been spoken." {n}Yrliet and Marazhai exchange knowing glances.{/n}

0098fc4a-e022-4756-980d-17b0dd24bad4.Text: "Azhi eat my eyes!" {n}A delighted Jae hands Cassia another brimming cup.{/n} "Keep going, shereen! You're doing great, but you're capable of so much more! Another couple of swigs, and the fire will warm your whole body and soul!"

3df89764-1e39-4c0b-bee6-730bc6d24b15.Text: {n}After casting a sidelong glance at you, Solomorne dips his head deferentially.{/n} "I apologise, I did not mean to be rude." {n}He accepts the cup, intertwines his arm with yours, and downs the amasec in a mighty gulp. Then he gives you a quick and not overly heated kiss and immediately averts his eyes.{/n}

30074c78-db2a-4025-b324-644c78589767.Text: {n}Perhaps a fountain of amasec is considered the height of luxury here on Thassera, but to you, one who has mastered the {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Nobility}art of social libation{/d}, the amount of drink seems rather meagre.{/n}

aa43a3ed-ff67-40f1-ae53-2362e3556614.Text: "Once I am back on your flagship, I will raise a glass to the success of this mission. That is, I might raise a glass. Of water."

a416574d-6446-4a33-aa1d-770c2f2f55ce.Text: "No. And not just because I am on a mission." {n}Solomorne studies the fountain with a critical eye.{/n} "This is nothing more than carousal on a backward world, no matter how many court fools are singing our glories. There is neither honour nor pleasure in partaking of local liquor."

f45d3206-691c-484b-a8de-e0510901e4e2.Text: {n}Idira shrinks from the amasec and hesitates for a short while before resolutely shaking her head.{/n}

6e802870-1eaf-4f07-bad0-023e84b89e54.Text: {n}Cassia's eyes widen in dismay. She stares intently at the cup, then screws up her eyes and downs the contents in one gulp.{/n} "My throat is... on fire..."

9170f5ae-12ce-419a-a803-8eda7946ced9.Text: {n}Abelard accepts the cup with great decorum, takes half a gulp, and grunts thoughtfully,{/n} "An interesting bouquet. Not particularly refined, but quite potable, in my uninitiated opinion."

71309f23-5f74-4073-b1ca-938b8157df1e.Text: {n}Jae downs the cup and looks around her with melancholy eyes.{/n} "What can I say? Footfall isn't the only place that knows how to have a good time."

a19532b5-f14b-463b-ae24-bac656f99794.Text: [Nod at the servitor orchestra] "Fascinating. How did you manage to acquire something like that?"

14b9071d-d688-4956-8831-fcc699ef7bed.Text: "Can't wait to meet some kindred spirits?"

4da3ea15-f029-4499-8ed8-dc0357e70b62.Text: "You heard the Proctor. Take us somewhere we can have a serious conversation."

08693b5d-9ed7-4add-a582-0e59e684e7b4.Text: "Ruoldo, I'm sure you know why we are here."

34fd07a1-a77e-4161-bf08-c940eaee5c38.Text: "Do your servants often interrupt their rulers' conversations without permission, Governor?"

bfe2f101-9bed-4d6e-bbe7-f9672da69f24.Text: "Very well. I would like to see what this place has to offer."

c2c5e5c3-5bb4-445c-9497-b839f62b76f2.Text: "Let's go, then. We must not miss the biggest local spectacle."

2807854e-35d3-4737-99e9-692b7e7cceeb.Text: "We have plenty of time. First, I will inspect every nook and cranny in this place."

a682aea5-8bef-4de9-a669-f2d5997a3e0c.Text: "What an exquisite necklace! I think it would look better around the neck of your Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}."

e915c027-b4e0-4757-947c-dcb2692e83d2.Text: "Never harm these people without my permission again, Solomorne."

64614cab-80b1-4f7c-b064-14ae17521738.Text: "I thank you for the courteous welcome, Governor; however, we have come here to address a grave concern."

15b11f39-2356-4be9-892a-28fecd71cac2.Text: [Glance around with a bored expression] "Might we proceed inside now? I find all this squalor rather tiring."

2ad8e680-5c0a-4588-ad0a-b70a46895875.Text: [Wave in Abelard's direction] "Seneschal, you take it. I do not wish to soil my hands."

73f2373a-31fa-4a23-b073-361090aa23c6.Text: "Remember, Maive: I do not want to hear a word out of you unless I give you explicit permission or ask a direct question."

b1859786-bdb7-4e96-8965-0867a02e28a1.Text: "Abelard, announce the purpose of our visit to these provincials."

426f9208-1271-40a8-bab1-ee269dda6610.Text: "I have absolutely no interest in your base entertainments. The sooner we start reviewing the tithe documents, the better!"

1d8b54ce-c760-4157-a1e3-5f7a15957456.Text: Ordered the Thasserian nobility to abolish their custom of sewing other people's faces onto their own.

94746bae-3b3f-4a12-862a-01ac99fcc831.Text: "You put on other people's skin out of a desire to look younger? You will declare this vile practice banned — today."

92ec73c3-76a9-49cc-ab66-77a92b874a87.Text: Permitted the Thasserian nobility to maintain their custom of sewing other people's faces onto their own.

26132e74-daa8-42dc-958e-eee70e8b2ee5.Text: "Grant each 'rejuvenated' individual a regular youth levy and overtime duties — after all, what good are health and long life to the servants of the Imperium?"

66ed20de-0fba-41e3-8d9f-dcba0f1eb5a0.Text: Expressed your desire to witness the Thasserian custom of removing and attaching faces.

66db1c29-91c8-428c-92ea-e944e0760c36.Text: "A fine tradition indeed... I hope the subjects are conscious when you peel their skins off? I would love to attend such a procedure myself sometime and enjoy the show."

5911cf9e-b291-43e4-b524-d866deb113b2.Text: [Smile] "Relax, Maive. Just pretend that you are giving a good friend a tour of the place."

5201918d-61f5-4524-a6f4-19c150d96ced.Text: "If it will help the investigation, we should not dally."

a392f05a-8512-4991-a61e-4429283ea385.Text: "'Celestial Highness.' What kind of an address is that?"

5d64d1c1-5a51-48b5-a102-6cddbd1ceeb9.Text: "Your face is your own. Why is that?"

c71100b3-0a19-4ab5-acfa-a01f236ca0e6.Text: "I believe there was something else the esteemed governor wished to say?"

dc783f5d-db83-440e-8409-9b5e8fc2a410.Text: "I am most flattered by your attention, esteemed judicator — and by this opportunity to serve the Imperium with even greater dedication than before. Speaking of dedication, we are already conducting a thorough inspection to see which scribe it was that bungled the tithe calculation. Fear not: the scoundrel shall soon be—"

b33209a0-8215-4354-9421-56e43dde2b08.Text: "Enough. According to data-protocol Calixis-Sigma UX 11-4, this Mu-class planet, type 'feudal,' {g|Encyclopedia:AestimareGlossary}Aestimare rating{/g} E874, with an assigned {g|Encyclopedia:TitheGradeGlossary}tithe grade of Solutio Extremis{/g}, has not provided its due tithe amount in full. You have violated the Lex and are hereby under investigation. You are to present all related customs reports and shipping manifests. Immediately." {n}The Proctor's voice carries no emotion, and Glaito silently bares his teeth, completing the image of the implacable hand of justice that has arrived on Thassera.{/n}

5eb775c9-1d2a-4c0d-a0c2-ce7db90b3000.Text: "Though at most only once in a generation, even Thassera receives visits from time to time, Your Celestial Highness. One day, an entire delegation from a foreign world arrived with these mechanical musicians in tow. We were immediately smitten with them! Sadly, our performers have now fallen into a sorry state. Thassera's humid air makes their preservation difficult, you see, and we don't have a single {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMechanicusGlossary}crimson-clad{/g} holy man or woman left. All we can do now is offer up prayers of our own, burn oils, and do everything else the old writings say, even though we have no hope of understanding them..."

1fc33cbf-faef-4a87-b281-151b5e226b83.Text: {n}The governor's heavy gold-stitched jacket adds a certain presence to his figure, but it cannot hide how poor of a rider he is. The way his boots dig into the horse's sides, his hands fiddling with the reins, his trembling fingers — all speak of nervousness and a lack of control.{/n}

dfa95925-8b9d-45c5-b546-35682839aa81.Text: "Thank you, Your Celestial Highness! We know your journey here must have been an arduous one. As a sign of our appreciation, we have prepared a veritable... constellation of enjoyments in your honour! We humbly invite you to taste of our amasec, along with our finest dishes, and may you likewise savour some of the local entertainment. One of the court ladies will accompany you so as not to let even a single word or wish of yours linger without attention."

22424974-f648-4b65-927e-c2530faab09f.Text: {n}The governor's gold-stitched jacket bears a skilfully depicted Aquila encircled by glittering stars, each of which has been cut from a different type of gemstone — a remarkable luxury for someone who governs a world devoid of the light of civilisation.{/n}

4a13e867-0282-4084-b0ae-4649a6d16af6.Text: {n}Ruoldo touches his stretched-out countenance.{/n} "Ah, this is a fine tradition that I myself brought to this world! You see, there is a way to tame the merciless passage of time: all you need is to find a young and healthy face, appropriate it, and attach it over your own fading skin. The local nobility eagerly took to this art of extending one's life and youth, and I, once a Celestial Lord myself, now promote this custom by personal example so I may showcase its wonderful properties!"

2f11b70f-9329-4c09-aa20-cb03e98ad63f.Text: {n}The fool parts with his offering and then jumps away with an irritating giggle.{/n}

2ee0abd4-3f6d-4556-aa36-69ebf9db92fd.Text: {n}Before you can even blink, the cyber-mastiff beside him sinks its teeth into Bluff's forearm, jerking it back and forth in a fury. The attack lasts only for a moment, but when Glaito lets go, the fool's limb is already torn to shreds. With a cry of pain, Bluff leaps away and melds into the roiling crowd.{/n}

4b344a8a-7152-4676-afa1-ff7d8793b6a9.Text: {n}A thin woman emerges into the torchlight, looking at you with a mixture of fear and awe. Her diminutive figure is practically drowning in her velvet and silk dress, and a resplendent necklace of blue stone adorns her neck.{/n} "Maive, my Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}, at your service!"

125322d0-7de7-4d2a-aea4-259b66c3374d.Text: {n}Daunted by your silence, the governor squirms nervously in his saddle.{/n}

535370c8-5a83-4510-bf61-30d7c160ba24.Text: "Well, slap my grox! Fine, then, listen to this: One-Eye, terror of the common man, went out a-thieving one day. He sneaks into a hut, itching to fill up his sack, and what sees he? A scary big shadow on the floor! He turns around, and right behind him... a giant! A monster! With hands like Imperial columns! It grabs him by the throat and starts beating the air out of him like he's a ball of dough... Turns out, he's popped by Murgeth's place, and she used to work the bone mill no worse than ten men could when she was young. The fellow's been One-Eye ever since. And hoo, is he glad he's not One-Arm or One-Leg!"

e4a22baa-cae4-4ef3-a08a-4ae932ea10dd.Text: "Such living masks are the privilege of the high nobility. I may not be a commoner, but to be entitled to a change of face... That is something I have yet to earn." {n}Maive casts a fascinated eye over the nobles whose faces — inasmuch as they are theirs — are stretched tight over metal fixtures. Many have their mouths frozen in an unnatural smile, and it is hard to tell whether this is a consequence of the tightness, or simply an eager show of delight.{/n}

b8c0900e-7fea-4f3e-bfac-bbed9d897a0f.Text: "It's not a question of preference, but of what might help the investigation. The execution will gather a crowd, and we in turn will gather information. That will prove useful, considering how eager everyone was to make their exit."

49e464a7-d8dc-41de-9d9a-9756f4a59fe4.Text: "Taddua the Scorched is hosting a public trial for a few guilty wretches today. I also overheard that the council of Thasserian nobility was preparing a special gift for you... Besides those, our mechanical orchestra, the only one on Thassera, will be playing all evening! And of course, you will also get to see the crowning jewel of Lord Ruoldo's collection: his maimed, metal-harnessed beasts!"

c219dce8-d9c9-447a-a4b2-08135676e287.Text: {n}Maive fidgets anxiously with her dress.{/n} "Perhaps my Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady} would like to attend the feast? Or the execution?"

2e7c0697-1355-4e74-833a-1e656957a5b1.Text: "Look at this one! She has barely risen above the bottom, and already she shoots for the privileges of the top! Greedy hands are wont to get chopped off!"

648f281e-770f-4ba8-8aa0-e3c39944caaf.Text: "Well, well! Our Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady} is not one to mince words — {mf|he|she} up and tells the specks on the soles of {mf|his|her} shoes where they belong!"

be718434-b576-43f6-afc3-48ecd7b48f86.Text: {n}A richly dressed man riding a sinewy horse breaks off from the procession. When he approaches, you immediately notice a strange detail: the man's face is pinned to his head with precious fastenings that stretch the skin across his skull.{/n} "Celestial guests, there is no higher honour for us than to extend our hospitality to such noble eminences! {mf|His|Her} Celestial Highness the Rogue Trader, and an illustrious judicator of the Imperium! All of Thassera clamours, trembles, and cheers! Ruoldo the Fair-Faced, Governor of Thassera, at your service!"

cf3070f7-4e35-4437-8ee2-b5b00ee1ebf6.Text: {n}Solomorne ruffles Glaito's neck and turns to you.{/n} "Feudal worlds are rarely known for their bureaucratic precision. Reconnaissance on the ground will tell us more than any report hastily scribbled down by these blockheads. I suggest we attend this trial and see how the laws of this planet are enforced."

e278c88c-f2aa-43cc-9b28-dde0dccac1ee.Text: "Mhmm, I can tell by what I'm hearing that our executioner has already lit up the Phesmophorius, ready to give the condemned a warm welcome! Which means the governor's official whisper collector — that's me — has a whole lot of important business to get to. And so, I must leave you now, good sirs and ladies, lest I miss out on a hot batch of juicy tales. Terribly pleased to meet you all! Honoured judicator!" {n}Bluff grasps Solomorne's hand and gives it a vigorous shake.{/n}

93fad3c9-ef06-4c9e-b629-25a8c022fc12.Text: "Little beasties like to play. People are their favourite prey. Champ and chomp and munch and crunch! Look! It's snapped your head away! Screams and tears and gore and more! Happy beastie, happy day!"

3e6d1688-080a-4b27-b7aa-c85158d8cee6.Text: "I see no reason not to. Who knows what evidence we might discover — or what secrets of her lord our guide might share." {n}Solomorne gives Maive an ominous look that makes her shudder timidly.{/n}

4bf7b9b1-adf1-402f-a46e-5ec6a346c486.Text: "But of course, Your Celestial Highness! It would be my pleasure to discuss whatever topic you have in mind. That said, you have had such long and perilous journey behind you! Like any self-respecting host, I must first propose—"

da4d68be-7d99-420b-88cd-acd627da67bf.Text: {n}Maive gasps. With trembling hands, she removes her necklace and offers it to you with a curtsy.{/n} "Lord Ruoldo generously gave it to me... This stone is a thassertium shard — the rare crystal our planet is famed for. Truly, my Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady} is more deserving of such a gift..."

b720a275-5ae4-45d2-98dd-b9033ec19aeb.Text: "As you wish. However, I should warn you that sudden 'handshakes' like that are considered tantamount to assaulting an Arbitrator on duty — there are contact poisons out there that can kill you in a couple of heartbeats. Be on your guard, Rogue Trader: festivals like these are ideal settings for assassinations."

dacd367e-4231-4fba-b291-62c02d5c122d.Text: {n}Judging by the stench, the servitors — or, more specifically, the parts of them made of flesh — will not last much longer. Slime oozes from rust holes, every other lifeless eye is adorned with cataracts, and their mouths are like corpse dumps filled with shards of rotten teeth. Every wrong note their instruments play is accompanied by the mournful screeching of servo-motors and sparks flashing from dangling wires.{/n}

b040be82-b729-4e09-ba02-301fc2bca008.Text: {n}A furrow appears on Heinrix's brow.{/n} "But that is devoid of all sense... What is this, some travesty of rejuvenat treatments? All the procedures I have heard of are far more complex and laborious..."

598d0a7e-feb1-4d0b-8d4f-7b49d1546e51.Text: {n}Abelard, wearing a grim expression, accepts the gift in your stead. Through comically exaggerated gestures, the fool displays his grief at having been unable to hand you the key directly, then steps back into the governor's shadow.{/n}

a5f099e1-1756-4989-9318-4a4cb1b517b4.Text: "Excuses are the hallmark of the guilty. Do not make your situation worse, Governor."

c69be6c7-ad78-406c-96a9-7cd221f7c61c.Text: "Oh, the embarrassment!" {n}The governor leans down from his horse and grabs the fool's hand. Having wrenched the key from Bluff's grasp, Ruoldo raises his hand to strike, and the fool quickly backs off. Finally, the governor offers the gift to you with a reverential bow.{/n}

5d947e19-8923-474b-bc8b-e6cfd2443727.Text: {n}You miss your mark as the fool jumps away with surprising agility, dancing and jeering as he goes.{/n}

a36bc280-279b-4062-b8d2-09f503b0828a.Text: "Being the paragon of grace that {mf|he|she} is, would my Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}, perhaps, also deign to feast {mf|his|her} ears on the latest Thasserian gossip to go with my gift?"

b9b6bc5b-b179-4a49-8f5c-17f1da75150d.Text: {n}Having finished his nonsensical tale, the fool erupts into acerbic giggling.{/n}

d434d8b0-f137-40cb-8409-bd0d7402b38f.Text: {n}Ruoldo nods, somewhat perplexed.{/n} "I, well, I do have certain suppositions—"

235b3720-ceb1-44d9-afb6-cbdbdc205db7.Text: {n}Pasqal's optical visor fills with deep red, and his vox-speaker erupts into a howl of pained fury:{/n} "I am registering heretical sacrilege born from the stupidity of self-entitled laity! The commandment 'Allow not a false prophet to touch upon the mysteries of the Omnissiah' has been violated! The commandment 'Offend not the Omnissiah by negligent misservice' has been trampled!" {n}His wail turns into an angry, stifled wheeze:{/n} "What scoundrel was it that thought to burn sacred unguents instead of incense?"

23c7966b-712e-4d5e-b4e1-81ad451c626f.Text: {n}Maive opens her mouth to say something, but catches herself, drops her gaze, and gives a sad nod.{/n}

2ec60b0b-13e6-4707-b1e0-4d5069c80492.Text: {n}Solomorne looks at the throng currently staring at you in wonder and trepidation.{/n} "So, 'Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}'... Your coming is a historic event for these people. Rest assured: the locals will be watching your every move, and a single word or careless gesture from you may well transform their lives on this underdeveloped world."

ef237017-4202-443b-b1f8-448656d67abf.Text: "Oh!" {n}Ruoldo looks confused for a few moments.{/n} "Yes! Yes, of course, this very day..."

ba0d4ec8-6928-4b42-8a8c-b82c1570e847.Text: "Most assuredly, Your Celestial Highness! I shall proclaim this decree this very day..." {n}Ruoldo smiles, causing his attached face to crease in an unsettling way.{/n}

3f884f94-8d4b-4203-b4b7-ae6f0966f901.Text: {n}Ruoldo's eyes nearly pop from their sockets at your words. He gulps and nods awkwardly.{/n}

33141596-d5ae-4f4d-9965-560955da984a.Text: {n}Maive smiles sheepishly.{/n} "I'm afraid that is easier said than done, my Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady} — it would be like trying to imagine a mighty sun as a tiny ember. But I will do my best not to anger you by acting too nervous."

a19f278e-30b0-418d-9344-aadfa56d4e08.Text: "I am pleased to see that you prefer to continue our mission over all the idle pastimes of this world."

01bbd891-26ca-4e53-9b72-74f999b9cb63.Text: "That is what we call the highborn who come down to us in their wondrous vessels... Of course, I am not a native of Thassera, and thus, was once a Celestial Lord myself. I have grown used to the local customs, however, and so, I address you like any Thasserian would."

835537b6-7b27-4d12-af62-9390a83ebd8a.Text: {n}Ruoldo clasps his hands together and says meekly,{/n} "Of course, Master Judicator, I will provide you with all the documents as soon as our internal review is complete. I assure you it won't take long, and the report itself will be exhaustive!"

5a1dfc6f-f7ad-4d73-b41d-f070996f108e.Text: {n}Solomorne leans closer and says in a lowered voice,{/n} "Based on my experience, I would say we have been assigned a spy under a pretence of generosity, but this is a good thing. We will use this young woman as our source of information about the world. For now, it would be wise to play along and question her thoroughly once we are away from prying ears."

b85f8b47-b1a9-46eb-a701-c1b5a9a30271.Text: {n}The governor's clumsy attempts to stay in the saddle and his utter lack of noble bearing are {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Nobility}bewildering to you{/d}. It appears that the upbringing of the Thasserian aristocracy is as unimpressive as this world's technological state.{/n}

4e926123-677e-4c3e-8a57-0c2576525613.Text: "From a distant civilised world — yes, Thassera lacks much of what I was accustomed to, yet after my appointment here, I quickly grew to love this planet with all my heart. I hope that during your visit you, too, will come to feel at least some affection for Thassera."

dd1dc048-a5fb-4123-bcae-8ca6c7f26175.Text: {n}Ruoldo abruptly changes the subject, unwilling to say more about his native world. The reason for this is unclear.{/n}

1a7ab9eb-be83-4228-a16a-3c24d85a5870.Text: {n}A smaller figure steps out of the crowd, dressed in the motley attire of a court fool and wearing a sneering mask.{/n} "My name is Bluff! I am Lord Ruoldo's good mood. I tickle His Governorship with well-spouted jests and itty-bitty gossip. And now, I merrily doff my cap to our Celestial Lords and Ladies and hand them this here key to Thassera as a token of our boundless loyalty." {n}The fool bows and offers you his gift.{/n}

23b8010d-461a-4ca6-a426-835190defa20.Text: {n}Ruoldo does not seem in the least disheartened — exchanging the gleaming spires of a hive for the dark towers of a feudal world would have broken the spirit of many.{/n}

58ce2544-b613-4abe-98aa-526a6c35d13e.Text: {n}Abelard clears his throat.{/n} "{mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship} {name} von Valancius, inheritor of the greatest protectorate of the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g} and bearer of the sacred {g|Encyclopedia:Warrant}Warrant{/g}, has graced Thassera with {mf|his|her} presence in order to discuss matters pertaining to this planet's tithe—"

09bfd62d-4764-44bb-8e9d-78ff8199a78c.Text: "N-now, Your Celestial Highness, we truly tried our best to put together a celebration worthy of our honoured visitors. But the news of your coming reached us so late! All I have left is a single talentless Astropath. We had to rush the preparations. Nevertheless, we have managed to put everything, everything Thassera is proud of on display here for you! I must ask—"

38b07785-229f-4ea7-b9cb-37a44ab9057c.Text: "Well, in that case... please proceed to the castle. All of Thassera has been awaiting your arrival, busily preparing the finest dishes and entertainments in your honour, so I fear it may be challenging for you to avoid attention. Let us have a court lady accompany you..."

0314faa5-6f95-471f-a816-a48040beb086.Text: "So, what should I do with you?"

64eb9b20-ff9f-4c69-9751-abdd6c8c4066.Text: "Yes, I am. But you do not look much like a noble lady."

121fe025-6dce-402b-93ff-bd4ebbbe09db.Text: "Why are you telling me this? According to the rules, you are meant to pose as a noble, then you get a reward."

7da2781c-d8c9-4e69-96aa-9fc1f2beb316.Text: "Why are you participating in the masquerade in the first place?"

3386d94b-3971-4b53-8c22-f8f49c118b76.Text: "I must think this over. Wait here."

b6f5c0e7-4d26-4eb9-b80e-649a11fb00b3.Text: "No one ever comes back? What is that supposed to mean?"

29b086d6-ce38-480e-b7b8-6b7ca8fd9da3.Text: "You really don't look like an impostor at all. Guards! Let her go."

3125526f-dd2c-44e6-9ac0-10fc3c3e8078.Text: {n}The young noblewoman's hair is dishevelled, her bodice stained with grime, and her mask pushed clumsily on top of her head. Holding her skirt high, she is trying her hardest to fight her way through the guards blocking the door.{/n} "Just let me go, please, for Throne's sake!" {n}she exclaims when the guards yet again push her aside.{/n}

a33ed023-53f9-4921-80b1-3cf0eb87c17f.Text: "It's not like they asked me nicely, Your Graciousness. They grabbed me, shoved me in this dress, and threw me in here. Nobody here was asked. But I don't want to be anybody's toy. I have three boys and a girl, we starch our lords and ladies' undergarments, and we work our fingers to the bone just to get enough scraps for the day!" {n}She shows you her calloused hands, mottled red from chemical burns.{/n}

56370fa8-bcfb-49d8-bfa3-bfd2be553c8e.Text: {n}The woman notices you and attempts something resembling a curtsy, but stumbles and falls to her knees.{/n} "I'm done! I just can't take it anymore! You're our Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}, aren't you?"

6300bebe-06f1-4f2e-9b50-0f54dab3e896.Text: {n}Gripping the frills of her fabulous dress in her coarse, white-knuckled hands, the woman looks up at you.{/n} "Please, Your Graciousness! By the God-Emperor, just let me leave! Nobody who gets put in one of these get-ups ever comes back. If I stay, I won't see my home again, I just know it. I haven't done anything wrong!"

e96aae11-4bc5-4f6d-9174-b5d70fd01147.Text: "I'm Edytka, Your Graciousness. I'm not a noble, not one bit! I just do the laundry and bleach the linens. I've never mixed in high society in my life! Forgive a fool, Your Graciousness..."

395fefdc-c36d-48f5-8233-ee007f042971.Text: "Just that, Your Graciousness. It doesn't matter if you get branded or not — once the hunt is over, you're gone. This place is like a grox pit — there's no way back. But I want to live, I want to be useful. Please, please let me go home!"

6c2f9f9c-c75f-41ce-8479-e9824cf24c11.Text: {n}Lacking the courage to object to your demand, the guards reluctantly step aside. As the woman turns to look back at you, you see wet trails on her guileless face.{/n} "Thank you, Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}! You sweetheart! I'll never forget your kindness!" {n}She bows low and vanishes into the darkness.{/n}

eccca61a-771f-436b-9514-4a8d8b736dd9.Text: {n}All hope fades from the woman's glistening eyes. She wipes her nose with her sleeve and lets out a dejected sigh.{/n} "Pardon me, Your Graciousness. You've done as you should. It wasn't right of me to spoil your game."

a294dd70-fe81-409a-adeb-8f330aa63ddf.Text: "But I don't want no reward, {mf|m'lord|m'lady}! I want to get back home!" {n}The woman hangs her head and clutches the lace frills on her dress. Her breathing stutters as she is racked with silent sobs.{/n}

9ef71ef9-adb3-42f5-8ca4-59f613735ff3.Text: "I want to get away before they start putting those... those brands on us. For the tricksters! I'm no kind of trickster, can't you see? I couldn't fool a grox."

7b5782cb-213c-484b-a65a-3eff9a3c327d.Text: {n}She glances at the door longingly and nods.{/n}

8065294a-c325-4ec7-ab21-bafaef46438d.Text: {n}Edytka looks at you with a haunted expression, waiting for your verdict.{/n}

38585828-e143-48dd-93d3-b619cf247ba2.Text: "Remembering nobles' faces isn't the done thing on Thassera, {mf|m'lord|m'lady} — not when they change them five times a day!"

c794bb09-9952-4978-9b78-96a71a750317.Text: "Solomorne, was it wholly necessary to set Glaito on him? There are ways to deal with criminals besides violence!"

8a9a6561-7b9e-4576-bcb6-232e572a511c.Text: "There is no need. It will heal on its own."

a344e19c-935c-4f30-b7af-428f707313a8.Text: [Pointedly look away, giving the attacker an opportunity]

0461ce29-6c78-431f-b34c-e1020f1bdf1a.Text: [Place the impostor's brand on the victim]

950f9721-7c29-474f-8762-2e1e324ba69c.Text: [Place the impostor's brand on the vigilante]

5881aa75-ba41-410f-a009-bd3d8512213a.Text: "The tailor is going to jail. Immediately. Guards!"

ce3b4371-0dbc-4d35-90fe-3eef1cdc9598.Text: "Proctor, I think you ought to put an end to this disorder."

064fe678-7af6-46eb-be24-139edbc93ac4.Text: [Kill the vigilante] "It seems your vengeance ends here."

7dd7c4a9-51a4-4c78-a3b5-e5f4d1d2bddf.Text: "This man has never undergone the local facial replacement procedure. He is wearing his own face."

8eca27ec-40c3-4c77-ae70-dde19dfd8ebd.Text: "Off with you, tailor. And ensure that I never set eyes on you again."

9abdc8c5-ae2b-474c-bdf8-2914e5e60b23.Text: "I have changed my mind. Tailor, you may finish what you started."

373ae04b-fd5f-4828-bb62-b0ae151920be.Text: "Dressing it would be great, thank you."

31ed273b-aa43-438c-a883-bb88663afc01.Text: {n}In the wavering torchlight, you see a glint of steel. One of the jacket-clad young men is pressing a blade against the other's ribs. A mask lies discarded at the attacker's feet. Noticing you, the trembling victim cries out,{/n} "Your Highness! Save me!"

9201411f-a59c-4775-8f4a-447d3b8222f3.Text: {n}The nobleman's eyes go wide.{/n} "I don't understand! I am of noble blood — a scion of the governor, or as good as! I wanted to help a gifted commoner and instead, landed myself in trouble for it — and you would brand me an impostor for that? You can't brand me! It's... it's not fair!"

32a57808-76b0-4162-b873-9225fe45586e.Text: {n}The noble lord's features are stretched and distorted. The edges of his neck, forehead, and cheeks are fastened at the sides with fine gold thread.{/n}

8de07c7d-6e6f-499b-8cc0-1cf501110b8b.Text: "Do not interfere, outsider. This man deserves to be punished, along with all of Thassera's rotten elite. They see people as just things to be worn. Let him look me in the eye and find out what it feels like to be cut to pieces." {n}You realise that the weapon pressed against the victim's body is none other than a pair of expertly sharpened tailor's scissors.{/n}

ff476d24-a800-473f-82e9-f9504dbb3012.Text: "This madman bribed the guards so that they would ignore my cries! I'm sure they'll be singing a different tune when they find out the Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady} had to intervene personally!"

9ba11807-406f-4d43-9a68-05eac4da702c.Text: {n}Peering into the nobleman's face, you realise that the stretched skin is his own. You see no scars or stitches. It appears this is merely his way of improving his looks and imitating people of higher standing.{/n}

1c7367f8-82d9-46e4-a1e5-141ce1b555fb.Text: {n}The attacker does not seem to hear you — he leans over his victim and begins to carefully peel the skin away from the nobleman's face.{/n}

858352f0-004c-46b8-8a2b-a1faecc3203d.Text: "They're parasites. They tear whoever they want into pieces. These scum squeeze into a person's skin like it's a suit that's two sizes too small, splitting the seams in the process." {n}The vigilante stares at you without blinking, his eyes glassy.{/n}

cce65c95-9f6f-40fb-9c8f-e369a1fef1c7.Text: {n}Solomorne casts an indifferent glance at the pair.{/n} "Local folk and their strange amusements — they're not worth our time."

16f07101-4dd3-43f9-af83-e4885d397b64.Text: "Skin suits and splitting seams? Preposterous! Your brother was rewarded for his talents with the best assignment he could hope for — maybe he just decided he wanted nothing to do with you anymore!" {n}The nobleman's voice cracks: he is on the verge of tears.{/n} "Your Celestial Highness, if such were your will, you could send servants to the dressmaker this very moment and find this man's brother alive and well!"

6d217cbe-76fb-45b2-9b28-3cdda735e135.Text: {n}You capture the scissors and deftly plunge them into the attacker's knee. Sensing his tormentor's grip weakening, the victim slips free and hides behind you.{/n}

b9f7bd18-b38f-4e43-8548-7169ea957bed.Text: {n}You try to grab the scissors, but the attacker is faster. You have to put yourself in harm's way to save the victim. Fortunately, the wound from the tailor's scissors is not fatal, and the rescued nobleman quickly hides behind your back.{/n}

39f80549-cc3f-40f7-9eb9-a7f72d0bd67c.Text: {n}Not a single muscle twitches on the attacker's face.{/n} "Play your games all you want. My mission will not change."

25d305df-85a9-488f-8f12-0118cb2a5b3c.Text: "Only because you asked." {n}Solomorne gives Glaito a sign and the cyber-mastiff launches himself at the attacker. Powerful metal paws pin the man to the ground, preventing him from moving.{/n}

3ca6268c-368a-4285-8bfe-96339e145a58.Text: {n}The nobleman eyes his attacker fearfully.{/n} "It's very simple, Your Celestial Highness. His younger brother has a way with clothes. I noticed him when I was looking for new servants, and I sent the boy to apprentice under a renowned dressmaker in the upper quarters. I thought I would make him my valet, you see. But then, this fool decided that I took his brother, not because of his talent, but to use him for my rejuvenation. Why would I even need a new face? I haven't even worn out my own yet!"

0f743159-716e-4eb0-9fe4-8538cf8e03f8.Text: {n}The nobleman's visage is twisted in a grimace of terror. It is difficult to tell whether he has another person's face sewn onto his own or not — or if he bears any family resemblance to the attacker.{/n}

1a541772-a80a-4235-accd-9d5afcad6513.Text: "It would be folly to let a possessed man roam free. He would drown this place in blood and poison it with his foul butchery."

50a2140a-e7cc-4012-9f87-d0af4cf5fbfc.Text: "His words are soaked in grey, with flashes of copper desperation breaking through. But of the swampy muck of deceit... I see nothing."

2008f365-93c7-4b09-99d8-73f07d2a47df.Text: {n}You hear a ripping sound: without hesitation, Maive tears off a piece of her richly embroidered dress, and hastens to tend to your wound. You catch her enquiring glance:{/n} "May I dress it?"

f36d4a10-15a7-4644-9c4d-ff8fa649c655.Text: {n}The young woman nods sheepishly and starts carefully treating the cut. It is still throbbing with pain, but the profuse bleeding has stopped.{/n}

515f66d5-575c-4b74-aeb7-ae2185612462.Text: "Yes, my {mf|lord|lady}... I'm sorry..." {n}The young woman steps meekly aside, covering the unsightly tatters of her ruined dress with a gesture made to seem casual.{/n}

85479d93-ef73-4d9f-93ea-25edb91729fc.Text: {n}The moment you step aside, guards rush onto the scene.{/n}

0886e478-aeb0-477a-9912-db5ba1f70cb2.Text: {n}Not one muscle twitches on the attacker's face. His relentless gaze is fixed upon the nobleman.{/n} "Play your games all you want. My mission will not change: the scoundrel will die."

94d54812-4ffd-4b8b-b596-cdb0fbf0af59.Text: {n}With a swift and elegant movement, you cut the attacker's life short.{/n}

b930a3c1-b413-48f2-9d33-1d5baae185c6.Text: "You can wriggle; you can run; you can cower behind others' backs. But there is no hiding from justice. It will pierce you right through, like a needle. Just give it time."

eee15ad7-c50e-450c-ae11-b040d3217d82.Text: "As you wish, my {mf|lord|lady}. You're so courageous!" {n}Maive's eyes are beaming with admiration.{/n}

ebb37e77-c5a2-453d-b3fd-f4f58ed57804.Text: "Th-thank you for intervening, Your Celestial Highness!" {n}The nobleman lays his hand on his heart and bows low to you. As soon as you step aside, the guards barrel toward the scene.{/n}

500bbd73-5dc3-4509-8a0b-929bcdad3ea3.Text: "The Adeptus Arbites does not waste words on passing rabble. And besides, my methods were warranted — at the sight of an Arbitrator with a cyber-mastiff, he should have immediately laid down his weapon and fallen to his knees."

60a9c82b-64eb-4b6e-8e12-d49224692ff4.Text: {n}The attacker visibly loses his cool.{/n} "Admit it! You killed him and took his face so you could wear it instead of a costume! I haven't heard from my brother in a moonlife!"

498f4a0d-12a9-4d3f-b70d-0c5b0ba0122b.Text: {n}The victim sucks in a ragged breath.{/n} "He's a tailor from the lower city! He's gone mad! He thinks I'm wearing the face of his brother, my valet!"

32c7ef4c-cae6-485d-9c9d-2c9923ca9311.Text: {n}The attacker clamps a hand over the nobleman's mouth and the sharpened scissors easily pierce his flesh. A second later, the dead man slips to the ground, and the killer looks up at you with a mad glint in his eyes.{/n} "You cut a fine figure, though you're not from Thassera. Let me go, and I'll stitch the entire world in your image."

e84f651f-b4fc-40bb-9f9b-e81a7783ad9c.Text: "Do not be deceived! Look closer: this scoundrel is simply hiding his stitches. He thinks he can trick an expert tailor, but it's a wasted effort."

eea57de4-5d45-4d07-ac66-8cc6a3b2bce5.Text: "Blackness has utterly enshrouded this man. How can one dispense righteous punishment in such blinding darkness?" {n}Cassia shudders and looks away.{/n}

f29437c9-d941-4fc0-8c44-db68822823ab.Text: "I think I will ask a couple of questions after all."

199c607c-5234-4598-82ea-e4b289d42255.Text: "I need to ask you a few questions first in order to identify the impostor."

5f0d7c4a-b270-46af-a009-ae821fe2815e.Text: "What awaits the Emperor's servant after death?"

5b678b35-c4b6-456c-bac4-8517be076bc1.Text: "By what name are the warriors born from the blood of the Emperor's sons known?"

792c83fe-08ec-44dd-851f-07a507f57cde.Text: "What, would you say, is the role of knowledge in the Imperium?"

afbf743c-2ffd-459b-9dbf-801bf665115f.Text: "Religious doctrines are not my strong suit."

6a6e4159-9379-41e4-b39c-180ac5ec19b1.Text: [Place the impostor's brand on the old priest]

7e3b982b-f0c7-418d-a07f-39d0960c805b.Text: [Place the impostor's brand on the young priest]

5e6327d0-275d-4906-9ffb-19272f00f214.Text: "I am ready to pass my verdict."

ddc13c3c-1590-4b5c-99b9-d341f0118c87.Text: "Knowledge depraves the soul, as does reading letters that are not meant to be read." {n}The old priest furrows his brow at the young man's passionate words.{/n}

a0d5328d-b8c9-4f72-b73d-abbaaa7ee0d0.Text: {n}The old priest gives you a reserved nod. Meanwhile, the younger one turns his entire body to face you, like a student being evaluated.{/n}

3d33d769-36c8-40bb-ac5b-20b163373d90.Text: {n}Cassia shakes her head.{/n} "Their judgements are like the two sides of a single coin. There is value in both, but neither one constitutes the whole."

35e9f217-75bc-4362-9779-c1017fb587a6.Text: {n}You notice a marked difference between the builds of the quarrelling men: the older priest's body is gaunt, unlike that of the smooth-faced youth. Also, the younger priest has the melodious voice of a singer, while the old man's speech is clear and powerful.{/n}

bd2108f4-4edb-4c3e-89dd-816ff7bdcc20.Text: {n}Both priests ponder the question for a while. The older is the first to speak up:{/n} "Should they serve faithfully, the Emperor will preserve their soul in His halls."

1aed8161-cbea-4aa5-87cb-9cdbf377dfe8.Text: "The Heralds of the Celestial Master. Gods among men!" {n}The young preacher's eyes are alight with awe.{/n}

cb75d32b-19d5-4a47-a69a-869be03e358b.Text: "There are no barriers to learning the word of the Emperor and to conquering all that He has given unto us. Have you read the manuscripts of our scribe, Gorgorius Falt? I hear he has left his craft behind now... but his research shines on with the light of true worship!"

5c9c60d3-2010-480b-8fc3-32ee89d701a6.Text: {n}The two priests shift their attention back to each other. A long pause follows.{/n}

8b86a24a-484d-4551-8a5b-93a03babf7b6.Text: {n}The old man grits his teeth and turns to the young priest.{/n} "My blood may be fouler than coal, but at least I've earned my robes!"

32fc3719-a73d-494f-a90f-7dab0907fb3c.Text: "This fool says he yearns for everlasting service? He does not hear the Undying One laughing quietly at his words. It is not this man's destiny to serve Him for eternity. It is to leave meekly when He whispers, 'It is time.'"

a30e93bb-d86c-462f-8a07-999cdc93e66c.Text: "You're back! God-Emperor bless your every step! Could it be that you wish to settle our debate at last?" {n}The young priest greets you with a beaming smile.{/n}

9150cae0-e2a4-42ce-978c-7cb241440523.Text: {n}The smile vanishes from the young man's face. He gasps indignantly,{/n} "Why... well, yes, I did skip the lectorium once or twice, it's true... But I am still a proper noble! I swear it on my honour!"

312386d9-f3e9-4589-b4e6-def2a771b46f.Text: {n}The priests look at you with reserved curiosity and apprehension.{/n}

dd0f6384-f92f-48f6-b50e-103bc172a822.Text: "May I, shereen? If there is one thing life has taught me, it's how to read people." {n}Jae looks the two men over.{/n} "This one, his face so fresh and glossy, is like a nice, fat grox — you can't gain all that weight overnight. And his voice — a true delight! I'll wager people must stand in line for a chance to confess to 'his holiness' in private. Who cares how many holy texts he knows by heart?" {n}Jae's smirk causes the young priest to blush profusely.{/n} "As for the old man — he's acting exactly like a half-dead Footfall vagrant who has just stumbled upon a proper meal. His robes might as well be hanging from a long stick. But I will bet a bottle of Calixian wine that he is earnest in his faith — if only because folks like him have no other choice!"

5bf88280-c485-4703-bc89-4e20b6f9653a.Text: "Just look at him, my {mf|lord|lady}! He is stuffing himself like a pig! What sort of noble behaves like that?"

576a78e2-76b2-44d5-afc1-d05b16e6bdf9.Text: "A better sort than this so-called preacher, this fat-faced brat whose head can't hold more than one litany at a time!"

f91cb93c-f2e0-4fc1-b9d1-22cb87582b8e.Text: {n}Ulfar shoots the young man a stern look but limits himself to a sad shake of the head.{/n}

aa19d709-cb7a-47c9-a1ce-4de6c843aff6.Text: {n}It is beyond obvious to you as a {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Ministorum}true adept of the precepts of the faith{/d} that the young man's words are heresy. The path of every righteous soul ends at the foot of the Golden Throne, and there is no greater reward in death than to behold its light.{/n}

90d00a26-fa82-44fb-92ca-922d6cd9f771.Text: {n}The two men in clergy robes are bickering loudly. The older of the pair is eating with great appetite, while the younger one watches him in disgust.{/n} "Your overindulgence is pure hypocrisy! A true servant of the faith would have abstained."

0f787750-e590-4905-bed2-f085a4e56ca0.Text: {n}The old priest shoots his companion a glance over the plate.{/n} "A true servant of the faith must keep his strength up so that he may offer the God-Emperor not just words but deeds as well."

a733b542-1b0c-4c42-b9c3-f4b52a69e56c.Text: {n}The young priest gives you a broad and sincere smile.{/n} "It is customary on Thassera to believe in sacred reincarnation. Thus, the worthy may serve the Emperor for all eternity!"

5facc0a3-137b-43d0-8da7-535b40c14654.Text: {n}You have encountered many variations of the God-Emperor's cult in your time, but never have you heard of reincarnation after death. A religious teaching such as this seems strange and exotic, even for a nondescript, half-forgotten planet like Thassera.{/n}

d64cbafd-f288-4227-a7a6-46c271aa0fc0.Text: "The Emperor's Angels. They descend upon the land to smite down His enemies." {n}You see respect in the old man's eyes... and fear.{/n}

10f46447-f0bb-4721-af1d-d5046b29ed31.Text: {n}Judging by the expressions of the two debating priests, you can easily believe that the one would indeed welcome his long-awaited rest, and the other a chance at eternal service.{/n}

48925fd0-8356-4f47-b5ed-971df2a1780c.Text: {n}The young man flushes when he notices your gaze.{/n} "Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}, how fortunate is your arrival! Only you can solve this conundrum and decide which of us is the true clergyman of noble birth and which is the arrogant impostor."

1bdad0c0-32aa-4697-b19f-22cc3b3f940e.Text: {n}Apart from their age, the two men before you look fairly similar. All servants of the Ecclesiarchy are as one in their indomitable faith.{/n}

79887564-4dde-46b6-95db-f5d91afe00f7.Text: [Place the data-brand on the young woman in the fine dress]

a0f34a14-eb20-41b7-ae80-e6d65adb5853.Text: [Place the data-brand on the woman in the golden mask]

3bb440f0-1990-4f03-813c-d9c02ed2e60c.Text: "Do you truly believe this man to be a commoner in disguise?"

72724f5f-8e4e-48a9-adb0-002b14533a1b.Text: "I am ready to brand the impostor."

70004f03-872c-480e-8238-7eba31a4a059.Text: [Place the data-brand on the man in the jacket]

0ca1d629-9bf7-41e4-beb7-d23a7b4d4a58.Text: [Address the young woman] "Why are you standing up for him?"

b9104efd-bbb3-45d8-b95d-9b639668133a.Text: [Address the man] "What can you say in your defence?"

caba2cc2-2c5f-4f58-9463-c1cc282b6241.Text: [Address the man] "Are you aware that your servant is trying to protect you, Sir Timeus?"

7b20fbd3-b43d-43e8-a342-f0a74575f880.Text: "This man is a noble. Why are you so intent on painting him as otherwise?"

373c91da-4a24-4110-b47a-46a8b5197950.Text: "Explain to me what exactly is going on here."

ecb80301-da34-4aa7-a914-72eeb560efb4.Text: [Hand the data-brand to the servant] "I call on this young woman to make the decision in my stead."

4f3c6c93-bf20-4069-bdf3-164b7e90cc0d.Text: {n}A few nobles have gathered around an older man in a fine jacket. His eyes dart back and forth between them.{/n} "I come from an honoured dynasty! You can't..." {n}He keeps trying to approach someone, but they all recoil from him as if he were a leper.{/n}

ec83aadd-69fb-40f6-ab17-86e60ba19d53.Text: {n}The mob's instigator, a lady in a golden mask, exclaims furiously,{/n} "Oh, listen to the songs of this poor wretch! He thinks that the bath they gave him makes him look like a nobleman!" {n}Upon noticing you, the crowd parts. In a peevish voice, the woman drawls,{/n} "We ask that our Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady} brand this peasant!"

c90b2135-4362-4af4-b696-49174bc52636.Text: {n}The woman who has been keeping her distance now steps closer and whispers to you,{/n} "My Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}, I'm begging you to listen to me! This man is a member of a noble family! He is being slandered!"

c3133d39-0e39-4299-9ef5-97092d8f8542.Text: {n}She believes her own words, just as the rest of them believe theirs.{/n}

9354d9ba-a8cf-4230-9608-42d31091c102.Text: {n}The old man looks you in the eye and grasps his cane, his last support, until his knuckles turn white.{/n} "I am an honourable servant of the Imperium. However, if my Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady} deems me unworthy... I shan't say a word in protest." {n}You hear his accusers murmuring in approval behind your back.{/n}

b3521270-cabb-4e43-8fd5-87b8ff1d9c9e.Text: {n}The young woman's lip curls with a mixture of joy and fear. She glances briefly at the man in the jacket, then gives you a bow. The man sighs with relief and says,{/n} "Thank you. I knew that no intrigue could fool the Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}."

3016be5b-dbf1-4024-8342-f9d2ae6886ff.Text: {n}The old man is terrified. His hands are clutching an expensive cane bearing an intricate family coat of arms.{/n}

c1a096f0-fce3-4a82-9daa-09714f2cca7d.Text: {n}The people around you are shouting, their masks blurring together, making it difficult to focus on any details.{/n}

0eb27697-0f5e-4e82-b3b8-196b18be26fb.Text: {n}The nobles gasp, while the woman stamps her foot and starts flailing her arms.{/n} "How... dare you! I am a descendant of a noble line! I will complain to the governor about this!" {n}You hear a few laughs — the people gathered here seem to appreciate the sheer absurdity of anyone trying to threaten you with such a complaint.{/n}

c10c1af0-9f91-4ec3-8398-67c83cf91a24.Text: {n}Among the hushed crowd, you single out a young woman in a half-mask and a gorgeous dress who is watching intently from the side.{/n}

35f007fd-04f6-4539-bb18-06b23bc8b8af.Text: {n}The loudest among the onlookers exchange glances. The woman's golden mask bobs as she offers a deep curtsy.{/n} "Most certainly, Your Celestial Highness! His plebeian nature is apparent to every self-respecting aristocrat."

5ff33839-4be3-45d3-9e53-98acd82e1ed7.Text: {n}The lady in the golden mask clears her throat:{/n} "There is not a word of a lie in what we have said. This travesty of a nobleman was granted his privileges less than a hundred years ago — a family of upstarts who have elevated themselves through peddlery. For any trueborn noble, he is no different from a masquerading peasant."

22d660e9-04c6-4e39-867a-6c9967df6b4b.Text: "This is Baron Timeus Highfoot, a noble lord. I know this because I am his servant — they just gave me this pretty dress." {n}She gestures at her gown.{/n} "I should be the one being branded." {n}Before you can react, she awkwardly places the mark on her wrist and returns the data-brand to you.{/n}
