cc4d9157-76c4-4f2b-be7d-cef4cc790191.Text: {n}Heinrix frowns.{/n} "She is not lying about the sorcery. There is a strange current of warp energy flowing from her, leading somewhere... up there."

75f40c95-ea0c-41d2-82c5-fdbe9987fe98.Text: "Do not weep, child. I will cut your thread quickly and painlessly before your soul succumbs to corruption."

c5551be4-c42b-40e7-8657-f2108acf0a8b.Text: "Not the most skilful attempt, little mouse. Our shereen would have come up with something better."

fa4c1195-6ecd-4d8d-9a7a-920c04de651c.Text: "This statement... is potentially true. Cyber-mastiff protocols are difficult to breach and override, much less..." {n}Pasqal casts a gloomy look at his surroundings.{/n} "In a primitive culture such as this."

3715ad6c-fcb1-4430-97c8-fd77131c6360.Text: "The evidence is difficult to argue with... unless the Arbitrator was forced somehow."

7d0c1da2-5aa7-4e56-88cb-07694170e5aa.Text: "If anything could cause Solomorne to be parted from his faithful dog, it would be a threat to the Lord Captain..."

0a2f0f00-672d-4618-b391-c3328b8cd2c8.Text: {n}The vox in your companion's hand is speaking in your own voice:{/n} "There is no need for concern! The Proctor and I are in the middle of examining the documents... together with the governor. I will be back as soon as we are done here..." {n}There is a loud click, indicating that the other side has cut the connection.{/n}

5e4c95ad-089d-40f3-a5a4-d447977640c2.Text: {n}As soon as you approach, everyone's attention shifts to you. For now, their reaction feels closer to pent-up irritation than outright hostility.{/n}

165c85b4-7eca-4682-a12b-40af5aa1ef93.Text: {n}Your pompous declaration silences the group momentarily and they stare at you in utter bewilderment. Someone lets out an awkward chuckle.{/n}

63028b34-7ccb-450d-ae87-cdafb78a7867.Text: {n}Your words are greeted with looks of bewilderment. Even the sight of Glaito standing at your side seems only to raise more questions.{/n}

0aeb1d1f-2f38-4430-a3bc-431ffe2f0625.Text: {n}They take no notice of you at first. But after a moment, one by one, they turn their gazes to you. Silence falls over the street.{/n}

ae673190-b713-47b1-924b-790e75925702.Text: "Feeble worms! Do you feel brave, testing my patience so? Present the Aett-Vater! Go on, make {rt_mf|him|her} come down here — it is a short enough trip!" {n}Ulfar's voice is like a thunderclap, the walls themselves seeming to shake with its mighty echo.{/n}

237be023-d939-4acf-b451-b53e71dff6fd.Text: "Strange little bird! Everyone wishes to wear the Aett-Vater's mantle, but few could bear its weight. Go and tell your tales elsewhere."

3315d479-d9d9-44bb-a31f-b0d9fe3f9c62.Text: "Activating standby mode." {n}Pasqal emits a quiet hum as he begins his binharic prayer.{/n}

131c1229-eac3-4cea-91b9-7dec9d1c0e6d.Text: {n}You see your trusted shuttle pilot — it seems he went looking for his Lord Captain when you disappeared. You hear a voice coming out of the vox in his hand — your own voice, telling the pilot that everything is in order and that you will return to the shuttle once you are done examining the tithe documents. Judging by his furrowed brows, the pilot has some reservations about following the orders he is receiving.{/n}

29dca0c4-09f9-437e-951a-f89c1a9a44f2.Text: {n}The pilot stares at you in bewilderment as he tries to fathom how a local stranger knows his name, but his confusion only lasts a moment. With a nod of grim determination, he grabs you by the elbow and hurries down the street with you toward the shuttle.{/n}

557028e9-2c5c-43e3-a96f-9f6858d740d6.Text: {n}The pilot gapes at the madwoman before him, but the mention of the Rogue Trader dynasty shakes him out of his bafflement. He unceremoniously pulls you to your feet, grabs your elbow, and hurries down the street with you to where the shuttle is waiting.{/n}

ba26b9f3-46e6-4706-8fdc-8184980fb0a6.Text: "How do you find living at the governor's court?"

bf470f67-8ba3-43a5-aa66-d73b793f301b.Text: [Lie] "Have I? I have not just seen Him, I have personally advised Him on the ruling of the Imperium."

fe1976be-2ddb-4c18-9f6b-e21655103cac.Text: "Alas, no. Our God-Emperor resides on Holy Terra, many light centuries from here. To behold Him is a privilege denied to all but a few."

c399ca87-da51-4203-aa5b-96fad9b91d95.Text: "Clean your muck off my shoes until they shine."

07e8cf42-b2c9-45f7-8eaa-232c99111890.Text: "You called the Emperor the 'holder of the Key to all Destinies.' Why?"

ff7ad104-7ab0-42fc-8282-f1dac1ca9955.Text: "And not a single note in tune! Awful!"

ee05e49e-18b5-4ac8-af49-4f5e62b86989.Text: "Why did the God-Emperor lock people in a dungeon?"

9f49673c-b39c-401d-99a1-96692e579816.Text: [Recite a sermon to the young woman] "Child, your faith has strayed far from the Imperial Creed, but I will teach you the true dogma."

9c8b4426-9945-430c-8913-e5bd76f6521a.Text: "What do you think of the governor?"

78c1c897-ca48-4bf3-a365-a7d6ba2bbf3a.Text: "Tell me about Bluff, the fool. How did he win the governor's favour?"

f38be061-203b-4682-97ce-186c0de7cec4.Text: "Since you are here, show me how the Thasserians entertain their nobles."

3a4aa66b-1b3b-45be-8b2a-bb0cb355ba21.Text: "Something happened, and Daen changed, did he not? That is his name, yes?"

6773441a-450b-4215-aeb6-7761ed390d16.Text: "You call that cleaning? Use your tongue! And don't forget the sole."

47a764c7-b924-4a17-897e-e25f1d6474de.Text: {n}Noticing your gaze, Maive turns to you.{/n} "My Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}..." {n}She hesitates before continuing.{/n} "They say you are the {g|Encyclopedia:EmperorGlossary}God-Emperor{/g}'s anointed. Have you... truly seen Him?"

3f04fe21-b331-4c37-8ab5-eb93969477f3.Text: "My Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}? Did you want to ask me something?"

c58ce639-72d4-40f4-a477-191f834bc48d.Text: "Well... he gave me a lovely thassertium necklace just before you arrived. Strange, is it not? To bestow such a treasure on someone of the lower nobility... And I also noticed that we have been conversing more of late, and it's been... easier. Sometimes, I think he knows me better than I know myself."

bdf537eb-91cd-4080-ac8f-e6cb97c464cd.Text: "Forgive me, Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}... Did you wish to ask me something?"

f8f60179-bd58-498b-9072-ac98890b6563.Text: "What would you like me to do, my Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}? I was taught how to dance and sing..."

f0d35028-d041-4845-8048-24acde55f5a5.Text: {n}A blush erupts on Maive's cheeks.{/n} "Thank you, Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}! For me, there is no reward greater than your praise!"

3cb61162-1efe-4079-b42d-cc2ff93c9123.Text: {n}Maive lets out a forlorn sigh.{/n} "I wish I could see Him... but I am sure His splendour is so dazzlingly bright that one glance upon His visage is enough to blind a person on the spot. Oh, pardon me. You probably wanted to ask me something, didn't you?"

93a150e3-0811-44ec-baa1-91c8cdad6898.Text: {n}Maive's eyes are like two moons, shining with wonder and curiosity. She bites her lip in an obvious attempt to restrain herself and not pepper you with more questions.{/n} "Pardon me. Did you... wish to ask me something?"

d7370dd1-8be9-4fab-86d0-a480400c621b.Text: {n}Maive nods apprehensively, then closes her eyes and begins. With great care, she sings a passage from some local hymn about how the Emperor, who holds the Key to all Destinies, locked the heavens against invisible monsters and enemies of Humanity. Her voice, though trembling with nerves, is surprisingly pleasant to listen to.{/n}

08cb0463-b554-4836-8cea-a66c86933a57.Text: {n}Maive closes her eyes, as if listening to music only she can hear, and begins to sway. Her dance is made up of simple movements, but the grace and ease with which she performs them add to their charm.{/n}

c87578c6-a08b-4b80-806a-ce8a56b1f47b.Text: "As you command, Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}." {n}Maive obediently crouches over your shoes and scrubs them clean with her own dress.{/n}

ec4338e2-81c2-480a-853a-08abb638d44c.Text: "Let's give it a try!" {n}Maive smiles cheerfully.{/n} "The movements are simple. Watch: you put this foot here, and you stretch your arms out like this..."

111ea2e8-3e9a-46c4-997b-89a06b4eed78.Text: {n}Maive bites her lip, disappointed.{/n} "As you wish, my Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}. I apologise for being unable to entertain you properly."

9b5639cf-984c-4453-9668-8ea56cde649a.Text: "It is an honour to entertain the Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}."

89e91255-5ba4-4a31-bdc7-552001511beb.Text: "Oh, he is a wonderful person! So considerate and generous... but, of course, his venerable age has taken its toll. He behaves oddly from time to time. But we all have our quirks, don't we?"

228eb4f4-fa08-446e-8c46-4236c2448532.Text: {n}When she comes to a stop before you in a final curtsy, her cheeks are flushed.{/n} "I hope this humble dance was worthy of your eyes, Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}!"

7ebefadd-0526-4662-b816-c8ac2ff9de84.Text: "He is... the best among all the court servants." {n}Maive looks down, but you catch the fear in her eyes.{/n} "He always knew how to make the noble lords laugh. But at first, Daen's jokes were just funny pranks and puns. Those were wonderful, almost impossible times..."

54b8ec32-65a4-43e1-b002-27a12f44d3a1.Text: "Yes, he seemed to... retreat into himself all of a sudden, and he started snapping back at people, saying sarcastic, scathing things. His jokes were simple before, but now, there is always a nasty bite to them. And he's started exploding at every little thing and ordering me about... My own brother..." {n}Having said all this, she freezes in fear, turning white as a sheet.{/n} "Apologies for my lack of restraint..."

8bd2d023-fbee-4417-8bf9-326ee772f25a.Text: "Anyone at court could tell you plenty of stories — the grim and the not so grim. But it's nothing compared to your travails, my Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}. You have far better things to do than listen to my tales, believe me."

fca9fbfa-2d06-4833-aa34-f350d3136c41.Text: "Forgive me if I've said something wrong, my {mf|lord|lady}. Preacher Antiochus said that the God-Emperor holds the Key to all Destinies in His celestial hand. He Himself sits at the very top of the Great Tower of Humankind, from there gazing out over the worlds and stars of His domain. He sees all, knows all, and a bloody tear rolls down His cheek when He reads our shameful thoughts and deeds in the annals of our lives."

6f7b837d-a055-478d-9f46-a04257553202.Text: "'The Story of Humanity's Deliverance From Darkness.' It is sung once a moonlife as a reminder of the great deed of the God-Emperor, who used the Key to all Destinies to lock the world away from wicked things. He walled Himself up in the Great Tower of Humankind along with all the people. He could have ascended to the stars, but He chose to stay, for our sake, though we are unworthy. We must remember this deed."

27ff0c79-d324-4503-ae00-290ba57874a8.Text: "Oh, how embarrassing! My Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}, I apologise for offending your ears!" {n}Cheeks burning with shame, Maive casts her eyes down.{/n}

200bf444-0fc5-4f45-b8d9-208b10ee7d4b.Text: "It is my pleasure to serve the Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}."

87d002ac-ff1f-499c-8d3a-9bb4c1fb9572.Text: "But those who strive, who do not let the seed of evil into their hearts, He will reward with a new destiny, a new life, higher and better than the one before — with a turn of His Key, he unlocks the dungeon of their souls. I live in hope that, one day, He will come to my door." {n}Maive's smile is one of sad resignation.{/n}

7a66eb48-1605-4688-9531-dc4950ea7f8d.Text: "In the time of darkness, the God-Emperor walled up the Tower of Humankind against fiends and monsters to keep it safe from evil. But evil had already planted its seed in thousands upon thousands of human souls. He locked them in the dungeon of the Tower, so that they might first eradicate the evil in their thoughts. All our lives, we atone for our transgression against the God-Emperor. And after death, we return to His judgement. But that is our burden to bear, my {mf|lord|lady}. When I see you and realise that before me stands His anointed, one blessed by His godly hand — there is no one happier than I!"

3fe27bc2-dc45-45f4-8b34-35cb97804ed8.Text: {n}Solomorne casts a quick glance around, as if looking for someone, and then nods at you confidently.{/n}

e068f4be-0b3a-4a73-90b7-2058cfd05c30.Text: "How fascinating. And what are you going to do to get a better destiny?"

9cd4f463-b2fc-4b92-a764-e372a8aa1d11.Text: "I... can hope. Pray earnestly, try to be virtuous and diligent. And if I manage to please the Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}, then maybe, just maybe, the Emperor will take notice."

152d2acf-576a-4ec3-84e7-2a52a19dc06a.Text: "So, the governor has never favoured you like this before? Perhaps the appointment to escort the Rogue Trader also came as a surprise?"

1d25356f-9d58-4a13-9b3d-ff5ff20d2789.Text: {n}Maive blinks in astonishment.{/n} "That is so, my lord judicator. I still wonder why the God-Emperor saw fit to bestow such a tremendous honour upon me."

ae1669f3-34be-4eff-8c93-96879e7e1974.Text: {n}For a brief moment, a deep wrinkle cuts across Solomorne's forehead.{/n} "So, your brother is not his usual self. This world is a tangled web indeed."

f6ff1833-837f-4fc7-857a-d66d564c2ea0.Text: {n}You speak the words that have sounded countless times from {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Ministorum}your lips{/d}, echoing off the walls of cathedrals, and Maive listens in fright and awe.{/n} "Could it really be true? There is no Tower, and all people's destinies are preordained? Forgive me, my {mf|lord|lady} — if you say so, then it is the truth. I will relearn how to pray and believe, I swear!"

b28a24b5-8884-4ee1-a8ac-7bc6af1268eb.Text: {n}Argenta shakes her head.{/n} "Serving the Emperor merely to earn a better fate? What a pitiful foundation for faith on Thassera! Missionaries must be sent here to set this world upon the true path, while there is still time."

7ef3bfbe-0c8b-4889-866f-4b74b896efeb.Text: "To beg for blessings rather than trials is an insult to the Undying One — such is the truth."

68abbe5a-3247-4e5b-a89c-dadd529a4cde.Text: "It is plain to see that Imperial zealots have not set foot on Thassera these past centuries. Else you would be singing a different tune: that one must suffer, pray until vision fades, and then suffer yet again."

c017f7e3-f3b1-49e3-8fdc-41be70907ee2.Text: {n}Though the Thasserians honour the God-Emperor, their interpretation of the Creed verges on heresy. Serving Him is already the reward, and only the desire to serve longer and with greater zeal is worthy of pursuit.{/n}

f0d356cd-0ed7-49d9-bed1-1f9eda170325.Text: {n}Indeed, the saying holds: as many the worlds, so many the paths of faith in the God-Emperor. Thus, it is no surprise that Thasserian doctrine is cast in an almost poetic form.{/n}

8fabe392-3a0d-4411-910b-a5e3830c4459.Text: "Yes, my {mf|lord|lady}." {n}Maive throws a despairing glance at you, but dutifully bends down and licks the clods of mud from the soles and heels of your shoes, crawling at your feet until her lavish hem is in tatters. Now your shoes shine like new. Wiping her muddied lips with her sleeve, Maive slowly rises to her feet, staring dully ahead.{/n} "How else may I serve you, my {mf|lord|lady}?"

59b49154-e2de-447c-8f68-780124a6cefc.Text: "I dare not complain, my Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}. Lesser nobles such as myself sometimes receive punishment for angering our lords, but that is good, in a way. I think it makes me cleaner and brighter on the inside and helps me to better serve the God-Emperor, the holder of the Key to all Destinies." {n}Maive makes the sign of the Aquila and turns a reverent gaze upon you.{/n}

1a6040a7-8bbe-421b-99e5-86e3792376e8.Text: "My {mf|lord|lady}? Oh..." {n}Maive catches herself and goes quiet.{/n}

d6feb928-c710-4270-b851-3001bbec8742.Text: "Just execute this one already so we can be done for today."

0ab86983-0167-41ea-a1ea-5e6d68d393fc.Text: "I missed such a glorious display? Do you have anyone else left to burn, perchance?"

73f1c1fe-8494-46d1-9719-5c37390cd663.Text: "What exactly are these heretics guilty of?"

091f01bb-26d6-41a2-b6ff-0bdcb4e8e648.Text: "What do you mean by 'the degree of their guilt may vary'?"

d8eca21c-2cff-4c62-a6d6-09a3a1d9487b.Text: [Yawn] "What makes you think I want to involve myself in your petty affairs? Burn them, and be quick about it."

6bc516da-d97e-417b-b024-0a3c275b2105.Text: "What happened to his face? Is he another mutant?"

63d96f10-0cb8-4db2-bfcf-cde8958300ea.Text: "The law of the Imperium punishes those who deserve it. Was that the last of the accused for the day?"

10962456-245c-47f9-bdff-5d240c88a4d8.Text: "What was the opulently dressed mutant's crime?"

d58e14dc-73c5-4a65-a1ed-b4cf6461b8d2.Text: "I am ready to announce my decision."

a18665a4-cf3b-4366-aa01-0bfdd7ef8b84.Text: [Make an impatient gesture] "Get on with the execution, Taddua. My time is precious."

569c35ab-eb3f-41cf-a7cf-2631483c3dca.Text: "Execute this mockery of a nobleman. The other mutant is pardoned."

dee05981-f9a2-4e82-bd6c-6d94b18a58db.Text: "The mutant commoner must be sent to the furnace. The nobleman is to be set free."

f537d39b-1329-4875-a895-97718c93e442.Text: "What did the mutant in a guard's uniform do?"

eb547327-d8cc-47ef-87ab-470105c065e8.Text: "I hope that concludes the incendiary atrocities for today?"

ccebe7e6-424a-40bd-a2b4-483863d13c99.Text: "You praise the lowborn mutant despite the vicious acts he has committed?"

29df01cd-9943-4e91-ac48-ff12cde0c0ee.Text: [Nod to Solomorne] "It is time to teach this gathering a lesson."

ad7104bb-5da8-479b-8bb4-3c38a5fb06e8.Text: "I have thought of a better entertainment. Forget the execution — whoever brings me the fool will receive the honour of kissing the Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}'s signet!"

869f49ad-4449-4060-8567-d70aa2caefaa.Text: "You need not hide yourself so carefully. I am not one to punish a born fool."

8a7bc773-1867-42db-aded-e135487d92e0.Text: "What do you say, Maive? Which of these two deserves to die?"

17752bce-73fd-4d84-843b-c40f89969118.Text: "Commanded that the condemned mutant's mouth be freed from the stitches."

16bddf35-3062-4075-ae8b-a6e6ddc87749.Text: "What monstrous cruelty to sew a man's mouth shut! Take those stitches out immediately."

d32da570-d69e-489c-826b-01718f2f5093.Text: {n}Taddua smiles maliciously.{/n} "Is the mere existence of this offal not enough? However, if Your Celestial Highness wishes to explore the depths of their depravity... then may you become today's judge. The sentenced stand before you. Tell us when you are done with the questioning and are prepared to deliver the verdict."

5491bb6e-ba9d-441a-ba19-10c3eed5fd5e.Text: {n}The madman raises his crooked fingers to his face and sinks his nails into its sagging flesh. Shrieking with what sounds like relief, he tears off a piece of his cheek, then another, and then one more... Falling to his knees, he frantically scratches his own eyes out, smearing blood and clear ichor across his face before collapsing dead on the platform.{/n}

5c9414cd-707a-443b-9a30-e996c51e8edf.Text: "Your Celestial Highness, behold, two loathsome heretics who blemish the very face of Thassera with their existence." {n}Taddua chuckles, but his sneer is completely devoid of mirth.{/n} "The degree of their guilt may vary, but they both deserve to enter the blazing bowels of the Phesmophorius for the worst of their transgressions: distorting the sacred face of Humanity."

5e2f189b-c0fb-419d-aae2-cad445547c2b.Text: "I am Taddua the Scorched, a slaughterman of the fifth generation, and a humble disciple of the iron saint you see before you, Your Celestial Highness."

ae8938de-25d5-40c0-b41a-c65ea13a3372.Text: {n}Two people, or something resembling people, are pushed onto the stage. They are mutants, hideous parodies of Humanity forever tainted by the imperfections of the flesh. One of them is dressed in stained yet expensive clothes. The other wears the tattered uniform of the local guards.{/n}

2bf19235-8d14-4a4b-8982-cbd72a4a248a.Text: "That was but one of the first bodies set to stoke the Phesmophorius. It is going to get a lot busier now." {n}As if to confirm the man's words, the fire-breathing saint expels a puff of acrid smoke.{/n} "While the guilty are being reduced to ashes, let us meet the next participants in our performance..."

7c287d88-0cf1-4c82-a04e-55ace9be586f.Text: "May you be cleansed by the fires of Saint Phesmophorius, filth."

8466cbdd-5171-4bbe-90e2-baacd26177d1.Text: {n}As Taddua opens his mouth to say something, the convict takes a step on his clumsy, spindly legs, and then another one...{/n} "The face, the face! Pretty, strong... shining!" {n}A gnarled claw points directly at you.{/n} "Give it here! Give it to me now instead of the one I bear! Take mine, it's not mine! Take it! TAKE IT!"

236888d6-8645-406b-b334-a98454478b4b.Text: "The furnace? The furnace! All those scandalous misdeeds in one heretic will make oh-such-lovely sparks! Behold the starfall!" {n}The fool's slimy joke is followed by laughter as the crowd anticipates the coming spectacle.{/n}

2fe905b4-4221-41f7-a476-0e2c573c2aa3.Text: {n}Cassia purses her lips when she notices the onlookers staring at her hands, eyes, and neck. Many point their fingers shamelessly in her direction; others spit at their feet in disgust. Her chin raised high, the Lady Navigator adjusts her forehead adornment with her clawed hands. She squares her shoulders, lets out a breath, and glares at the crowd with condescension.{/n}

6a971e7b-418c-4e4b-89bf-ddd59600df3b.Text: {n}The mutant utters a foul curse under his breath, then immediately gives you a frightened look and falls silent. The mere sight of the Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady} seems to instil a reverent awe in the common denizens of Thassera.{/n}

866496aa-97f3-43ca-9796-31ead847c92e.Text: "What in the Lex's name did I just hear?" {n}Solomorne raises his voice slightly, indicating that the usually impassive Arbitrator is profoundly indignant.{/n} "I normally have no trouble passing judgement, but in this case, I don't even know where to start."

bae6448f-760c-4946-86d4-d06938015f2d.Text: "They are both mutants, and have thereby violated His law. Yet, when one finds a spark of nobility in an abject commoner, one cannot help but feel a grain of respect for them. This heretic may be of low birth, but he does not flout the values of Thassera the way the nobleman does, and thus honours our traditions and His will. Born into the rabble, he applied all his abilities and skills, defied the restraints placed upon him, and crushed those who stood in his path — all in order to forge a new destiny for himself."

c09ecaf6-8b1f-40fb-a6fa-1e720d87cabb.Text: "Forge... a new destiny?" {n}Solomorne repeats slowly, with an undertone of utter disbelief at what he is hearing.{/n} "Even you, a degenerate, should know that man is bound to serve the God-Emperor's plan from birth, and that any attempt to change that is a violation of His will!"

5e4939f5-84e4-4458-bc88-e6e2e62b9259.Text: "Even on a planet forgotten by all, Humanity continues to seek freedom and to honour the Emperor in their own way..." {n}Sighing, Jae turns to you.{/n} "Humans need to believe in something in order to live. And a better destiny — who among us has never dreamt of that?"

917d39e5-844b-408c-8059-c6ad16d6a8cd.Text: "Eat your fill, iron saint! Gorge on the thin noble bones, and try not to choke!" {n}At the fool's screech, the crowd erupts in malicious laughter.{/n}

ec08cab2-b51d-45c3-96c2-935555058fe1.Text: "Oh, no no no! We didn't come here for you to stay quiet! Squeal now, and squeal louder!" {n}The crowd takes up the fool's outburst and begins demanding more screams.{/n}

4f9e493b-fd89-46b2-8b10-c422bb15d13f.Text: "Master Taddua knows no mercy, and his hand is unfailingly firm in the sacred cause of administering justice..." {n}Maive is careful to keep her posture straight, but her frightened gaze is deliberately averted from both the executioner and the mechanism behind him.{/n}

1c5a1973-02e4-4119-b71c-0336b731a631.Text: "Never again... defile the lips..." {n}Maive looks ready to faint. She seems both terrified and nauseated by this sacred rite that has drawn so many onlookers.{/n}

1ac7920a-7b21-4e60-8956-383be8f314a7.Text: {n}Maive seems to have reined in the emotions that were overtaking her, and she casts a timid glance at you as she awaits the verdict.{/n}

3dfef733-c354-4e84-8702-7e39914c5a16.Text: {n}You glance at the crowd... and suddenly see the fool, prancing and flitting among the gawkers, clearly trying not to be spotted by you.{/n}

a4f32801-d29d-4017-8df9-b4a6efa0acd9.Text: {n}Laughter bubbles up from the crowd — the audience appreciates your gracious yet mocking remark. The fool makes an angry sound and flees, to the cackling of bystanders.{/n}

2de4fe87-3184-4d0d-ad65-8286c28dd489.Text: {n}A cheerful gloating rises above the crowd. Several pairs of hands grasp at the fool with the apparent intention of dragging him to the scaffold, but Bluff proves to be too slippery. Having broken free of their grip, the fool rushes away, with several onlookers in pursuit.{/n}

d4bb7402-872c-4ea4-ac51-5f6ef9cbc7a0.Text: {n}Without uttering a word, the Arbitrator draws his weapon.{/n}

96370380-f2e7-4622-9f0c-986757b719d2.Text: {n}A shot rings out, and a deafening shriek rises from the throng of people. You catch sight of the badly wounded fool disappearing into the crowd.{/n}

6362156b-fd55-48c2-9836-545398792023.Text: {n}Maive cries out in horror and immediately clasps her mouth with both hands, trying to lock her voice inside.{/n}

b831ec80-ecd3-462b-b902-341b24f26f7a.Text: "Thank you, my Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}." {n}Maive's voice is barely audible. She smiles at you in a small, sad way.{/n}

b2e32e60-3181-411a-a016-c5d6000636df.Text: {n}Maive looks up at you, sad and grateful at the same time, and smiles uncertainly.{/n}

9073906d-b249-4bab-84ca-6186a7820dbb.Text: {n}Maive's gaze darts fearfully around while visibly avoiding the doomed mutants on the platform.{/n} "I am... of too low a birth to take on the burden of being a judge, my Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}..."

c40466c2-a7d0-4bec-afe6-0a30bf305619.Text: "You have just confessed that your semblance of justice serves not as a demonstration of lawful authority and deterrence to your subjects, but as... entertainment." {n}Solomorne utters the last word with disgust, as if there could be no fouler profanity.{/n}

c5377aad-1af1-4952-8f25-a8751abcf7be.Text: {n}Yrliet's voice is weak, but your Elucidator still picks up her quiet plea:{/n} "Isha, give me the strength to look without seeing. To hear without heeding the triumph of spiritual darkness..."

2b46a752-94d9-4992-8fa7-60aa25811255.Text: {n}Cassia turns away, covering her eyes and nose with a shawl.{/n} "This smell, these screams... It would behove you to put a stop to this barbarism, Lord Captain, not encourage more of it."

3ca60bcf-dbcf-4578-9bcf-e0d4e0c1c146.Text: {n}Ignoring the raging fire within the Phesmophorius, Argenta studies the crowd.{/n} "All of them came here to taste of other people's pain, not to praise His justice... They are as a pack of dogs slavering for a fresh bone."

7467da68-a211-481a-a118-bc91770b5774.Text: {n}Kibellah whispers without taking her eyes off the condemned man,{/n} "You are not the master of your own shadow — the shadows reign over you. You are alone, while they are many. But why?"

1effc32c-4372-44d1-855d-2195d447413f.Text: "A windowless, doorless house..." {n}Idira is standing still, her eyes glassy.{/n} "The master is gone, and only beasts remain..."

65352212-84b9-49f8-b858-0d4e68465a45.Text: "The rabble grins and cackles like scavengers at a feast. You lot! What amuses you so? Is it filth and heresy?" {n}Ulfar's roar shatters the crowd's exhilaration — until a new burst of laughter from the fool infects them once again with malicious glee.{/n}

7eb967e9-de97-4bdd-8f24-5ac4032c6732.Text: {n}Cassia peers into the black pits of the Phesmophorius's eyes and, with a strange expression on her face, whispers softly,{/n} "When you give an order like that, do not look away. Keep watching until the end, so that you remember the price that was paid. So that you remember the weight of your words..."

bd636928-a3ed-4868-8bfd-299a4c529093.Text: "But, since fate has graced us with such lofty visitors, I eagerly cede the right to punish these miscreants to you, Your Celestial Highness." {n}Contrary to his honeyed words, the executioner's voice betrays his poorly concealed displeasure.{/n}

e63f0f85-d2f2-4db4-9802-3c4d3e8a176e.Text: "Thasserian... fever. You need not worry, Your Celestial Highness: it is not contagious."

555916eb-48cf-4399-84b2-e06da2052360.Text: {n}Marazhai sweeps the crowd with a predatory gaze, silencing the whispers and driving the fearful deeper into the throng.{/n} "Cattle so eager for the slaughter. Their masters show too little cruelty — perhaps it is time to remedy that."

af33389e-3936-4b21-ad84-6fa95a3c1de1.Text: "Their lives are poisoned by fear and hatred, their words and thoughts drip with venom, yet the mon-keigh choose to hide behind masks rather than change anything."

ad96e8c9-2afa-4714-8867-96b758d396ec.Text: {n}Eager to please you, Taddua carries out the order, but his work is far from gentle: the condemned man groans and chokes in pain as the executioner pulls the threads from his flesh.{/n}

5cabf0f0-2ed0-4015-8b54-6794cd37e51b.Text: "Th... gnk yoo..." {n}With his mouth oozing blood, the mutant is unlikely to say much more.{/n}

53a48da8-a135-464c-89c3-c6ef56176700.Text: {n}At the sight of a xenos in your company, the masked courtiers begin to gasp and murmur. In the glint of their eyes and the curl of their lips lies only fearful disgust.{/n}

25bc3b3b-0fe9-4cb6-9b49-e65efef8392b.Text: {n}A pale, bony creature, barely able to move its legs, enters the stage. In place of a mask, it turns a horrific medley of features toward the world. This ugliness, however, is nothing like that of the previous convicts. The thin, squeamishly twisted mouth is fused to the cheekbones. Malicious eyes peer into the crowd from under hideous folds of skin. The face of this heretic appears to have... melted and congealed.{/n}

38d62c87-5bc6-417b-925a-3187feb3470d.Text: "Another heretic who violated the holy laws of Thassera. And, since his body is already turning to ash, such will be the fate of his name as well — to be scattered to the winds, that it may never again defile the lips of any who live upon our sacred world."

4ccfe183-1d7f-47e4-8467-51d0ec5358a2.Text: "This instrument of punishment is a personification of the great Phesmophorius the Martyred, who accomplished the legendary feat of slaying three hundred heretics. As is glorious tradition, all mutants who affront the Emperor's gaze and stain the face of Thassera must enter the saint's iron embrace. Whenever justice is served, hundreds flock to the Phesmophorius, eager to witness the magnificent spectacle."

2804a778-9b8e-4ccc-8689-5da39f2c4b40.Text: {n}Heinrix arches an eyebrow as he gazes at the iron giant.{/n} "This is one of those worlds where public execution forms part of the sacred edification of the crowd. And yet, from the description, it sounds like the people are not learning from what they see, but rather, are perversely enjoying it instead."

3dee2209-98ad-44cc-b097-cb58a5bf7734.Text: {n}Taddua fixes you with a fanatical stare.{/n} "One of them, despite being one of the highest lords of Thassera, spat on our world's customs by refusing to alter his destiny. The other did change his fate, even though he was just a lowborn wallowing in the mud."

57cd7b3d-6e57-4967-9408-12940f2018e6.Text: {n}You hear his voice among the masks, but the echoes and the noise of the crowd muddle the source.{/n} "Somewhere in this galaxy. And I feel much safer away from the sharp and pointy things in your hands, Your Celestialship!"

050b75a9-77a5-408a-9c79-ff5422d0a03e.Text: {n}A sudden rumble draws your attention. Like a rockfall tumbling down a slope, the thudding of feet and mad screams overwhelm you. After a moment, you see the source of the commotion: a throng of mutants is charging straight at you!{/n}

bded14d9-59ef-4866-8dea-e63da9f7d2a8.Text: {n}You see a man with a cruel grimace on his face and hands disfigured with burn marks. Behind him stands a ghastly looking mechanism adorned with a polished skull of gigantic proportions. The eye sockets, their edges melted, gaze darkly at the crowd with the promise of inevitable punishment. The man, clearly the executioner, bows his head.{/n} "The very messengers of the sky have come to decide our fate. We are honoured, Your Celestial Highness."

5533186d-25c9-4319-9bb3-b702b18576f4.Text: "Ah, a rotten stain upon the noble families. He was hiding in his manor to conceal his deformities, but had trouble keeping his mouth shut — he spread corruption among the minds of courtiers, cast aspersions on the traditions of the world, was insolent, swore profanely... Luckily, he has no heirs, and today, this accursed bloodline shall be put to rest once and for all."

69aa90d5-954c-49c1-88af-2583899baf61.Text: {n}The richly garbed mutant moans something. You notice stitches on his disfigured face: the zealous servants were evidently in a hurry to silence the condemned man early and sewed his twisted mouth shut.{/n}

93234f7a-5c9e-4907-aac9-6c6796a3bf39.Text: {n}The executioner's eyes gleam with exaltation.{/n} "What righteous words, Your Celestial Highness! There is no point in wasting precious minutes on heresy. Both have been found guilty and will be consigned to the flames!"

34936bc8-2c7d-483e-980d-b7abd29f3bee.Text: "The word of a distinguished guest is law. We are all trembling with anticipation!"

57198d6b-6fb9-405a-b1e5-087e1ee0a82c.Text: {n}Taddua observes you with guarded curiosity.{/n} "There are two great truths on Thassera, Your Celestial Highness. The first is that the Emperor created the planets and the stars, then fashioned Humanity in His image, and we are but His unworthy children. The second is that we have each been given the freedom to change our destiny — a divine gift that separates us from beasts and His enemies, a gift that fills our lives with His light. Should someone choose to rot away in the cage of their destiny and neither be content nor seek to change it, then into the Phesmophorius they go."

a3236c37-cab3-493e-a43c-1aff98962274.Text: "Go, you miscreant." {n}Taddua looks at the surviving mutant not entirely without sympathy.{/n} "You changed your destiny once, and now it is time to escape a new one — one where the mob tears you limb from limb in the first alley that gives you refuge." {n}The crowd around you begins to rumble in response.{/n}

677da027-68f4-486e-b97f-0b4f81ce59f5.Text: {n}Taddua gives you a dark look. As if reluctantly, and through gritted teeth, he forces out the words:{/n} "{mf|His|Her} Celestial Highness has spoken... May the flames of Saint Phesmophorius purify you, heretic."

d0a97eb2-5e80-4bc2-986f-20d9abeda144.Text: {n}Taddua glares at the surviving mutant with loathing.{/n} "Get out. And praise {mf|His|Her} Celestial Highness for granting you a life you do not deserve..." {n}The crowd around you starts jeering, and the mutant scurries away in haste.{/n}

84dcba0e-86b1-40de-b5cf-033c351202f4.Text: "I knew your blood runs hot, Your Celestial Highness! Let us stoke up the great Phesmophorius!"

5e6cc0bf-ed5f-44b8-83bd-a102144b895e.Text: {n}Having taken your plentiful offerings into its gut, the Phesmophorius roars and billows out smoke. Spurred by the cruel spectacle, the crowd around you begins humming to the beat of the execution device. Within that noise, you hear the sound of hungry anticipation.{/n}

8dc89ad9-2ce3-4c21-bb5c-7b46cb73d15e.Text: "Oh, the stove is burning hot today! Warm yourselves, my good fellows, for the Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady} is feeling generous!"

5476e2d5-0ba9-49e2-9365-c203a6068722.Text: "A thief, a brigand, and a murderer. There is no way to list all the crimes lying upon this freak's conscience! However, his willingness to change his destiny against all odds merits this mutant at least some honour. Despite his feeble-mindedness and simplicity, he had enough sense to obscure his countenance with hoods and helmets until he made his way from beggar to guard. It was not long before his excessive passion for fighting and stabbing gave him away."

ce34119f-b43c-47d9-aee3-c5de53fd41d8.Text: {n}The fool's voice pipes over the crowd:{/n} "What an unexpected twist! Who better to judge the filth of Thassera than a stranger who just fell on our heads?"

6002f585-00db-4f6c-84d5-b8857975912d.Text: {n}The excitement in Taddua's eyes fades away.{/n} "A merciful decision, Your Celestial Highness. Savour the gift of freedom bestowed on us by the Holder of the Key to all Destinies and by His messenger. Begone, you disgusting spawn!"

dbd5902b-8880-4ffa-9d2d-77b51ecc9a24.Text: "Oh, what clamour! I'll wager they heard the sound of the poor slaughterman's heart breaking all the way at the other end of Thassera!"

df6990c0-3fc0-4e1c-8992-ecc260e567d1.Text: {n}The executioner does not answer right away, but makes you wait for a moment.{/n} "His crime is more grievous than any this scaffold has ever seen. He was granted a new destiny, but chose to defy it. He turned away the greatest gift that can be offered to the loyal sons and daughters of Thassera!"

8b56b81c-26c3-4d46-86d8-b8caa833633d.Text: {n}The wretched man's gaze drifts over the crowd until his piercing eyes meet yours. His head twitches, his face contorting in a monstrous grimace.{/n} "Shut up! Shut up, before it gets in!" {n}he whispers in a sudden frenzy,{/n} "I won't give up! I won't give it up! I won't!"

a2cb4d0a-ba7e-4da6-8e11-057ce8c2dd09.Text: "So, it is either the commander or the executioner, is it? Then I shall now make my decision."

48ebb969-bf68-44de-9b5a-f8475749f6f5.Text: "It appears your celebration is over, Governor."

08dbd347-f275-4e10-90c2-9f9d60d44c13.Text: "The commander is guilty. Solomorne, carry out the sentence."

f89f13f5-acc0-4623-bb6b-2c807b30e16b.Text: "You know, I have not yet had my fill of executions for today... It is the Phesmophorius for the both of you. I demand a spectacle."

744635dd-8903-474d-897d-aa6023e57299.Text: "The executioner is to blame for what has transpired. Solomorne, enact the will of justice."

012e5b3a-1d7e-4f07-8051-47bbbd5d4b7f.Text: "There has been enough death. I will order no executions."

137334de-d580-4b4a-aaa7-10c4221f8184.Text: "Hmm... Perhaps your Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady} would be willing to show mercy... if the guilty worms begged for it at {mf|his|her} feet."

619a9307-7925-4b4e-b570-b9f510f9fd3b.Text: [Strike the governor] "If it were not for the tithe, you would be the one facing execution!"

a9780adc-46cd-4c73-b1a5-d58ac6548fb2.Text: "Find those responsible and bring them to me!"

39e1ae4e-18ee-465b-a4ac-c93ca11220b7.Text: [Accept the gift] "That's all? Some antiquated sword? I expect subsequent gifts to be better."

fd75189f-2dcf-40a1-9760-6bffdabc65bf.Text: [Return the gift] "Solomorne, make a note of this attempted bribery. I have no need of your gifts, Ruoldo."

c7fabdf2-dd04-490f-a949-94065fab9fe9.Text: "Both stand guilty. Put them to death as your traditions dictate."

dee6335f-fd0d-4f90-8ba0-13b56f92af95.Text: "Your Celestial Highness, apologies for my late arrival! I wasted a great deal of time in idle squabbles with that oaf of a treasurer as he was looking for the shipment chronicle! I only heard about the attack after it had already begun, and the elevator might as well not have been moving at all, it was so slow..."

12b40145-403d-4cef-9b3c-734fb144c331.Text: "Not in the least! I will not let some beasts ruin everything we have worked so hard to prepare... I suggest we distance ourselves from this place and return to our corner of revelry and peace. By your leave, I will be waiting for you at the head table, Your L— Your— Oh, God-Emperor, give me strength!" {n}Swallowing noisily, the governor hurriedly departs the scene of slaughter.{/n}

a50cfe6d-1074-4b57-b7bf-06f0db2dfc3d.Text: {n}An oppressive silence hangs over the previously bustling plaza. The people are taking in the carnage, clearly avoiding looking at you but still catching your every word. You notice Maive standing nearby, gazing around her with horror in her eyes.{/n}

f8bb68c9-de94-46c1-b39c-a6ba3f3b66d1.Text: "I obey Your Celestial Highness..." {n}His footsteps heavy, the commander heads toward the fire-breathing iron beast.{/n}

bcbc7eef-0436-4a4d-afb5-c46f9f9f6337.Text: {n}The executioner freezes, the corner of his mouth twitching.{/n} "So, the one who served the Phesmophorius with rigour and zeal must now himself enter its fiery embrace..."

e25a18de-00d3-47c5-ac83-ed453a4aa71a.Text: {n}There is no change in Solomorne's expression as he performs the execution. Taddua the Scorched expires without making a sound.{/n}

d0cc73b4-70e2-4591-84ca-7e330cd620b0.Text: {n}The governor babbles in fear,{/n} "I... I never... thought..." {n}He takes a deep breath.{/n} "The culprits. Of course. The culprits will face execution post-haste, my Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}."

18d69e15-2c50-4bff-b834-5b231280b362.Text: {n}Having dusted herself off and reassumed a proper bearing, Maive stares off into space. Despite the shock, her lips are pressed together firmly, and her back is impeccably straight.{/n}

2d0bb68b-51f4-47b8-be9b-09a4da43e31f.Text: {n}After putting herself in order, Maive catches your eye and looks away shyly. Her lips bear a poorly concealed smile of relief.{/n}

e82aa06f-727b-4ff1-af03-f14499cccd0c.Text: {n}The young woman next to you could well be a carved statue, perfect in its lifelessness. The only emotion in her gaze, directed at the smoking Phesmophorius, is ice-cold terror.{/n}

bb6dddc2-8ade-4c05-8ccd-fcc3cca56ceb.Text: {n}The governor staggers back from the blow, barely managing to stay on his feet. A trickle of blood runs down his lip, and he spits out a few rotten teeth onto the stones.{/n} "Thank you, Your Celestial Highness! I will never forget the lesson taught to me by the Emperor's own anointed!"

edb31c76-fabd-45c9-aa53-7cf6203a4cfe.Text: "The condemned mutants broke loose and attacked the townsfolk... It has been a long, long time since anything like that happened, Your Celestial Highness. They must have sniffed out that today is a special day..." {n}The executioner's lip curls, split by a blow during the fight.{/n} "The commander was responsible for guarding them. He got careless."

90221fae-a573-4217-b4cc-72e0f5a95ba4.Text: {n}In one precise movement, the Proctor carries out the execution. Lucra falls to the ground with a crash.{/n}

597bc47b-6361-42b4-a4c6-60cad952997a.Text: "It amazes me that that idiot just underpaid the tithe and did not somehow lose the whole planet as well." {n}Solomorne pauses, pensively watching the governor leave.{/n} "Fine, a feast it is. I am sick of the stench of burnt meat — let's try a change of scenery."

7c994502-4841-4dae-8782-296e93a4bc2e.Text: {n}Her face pale, Maive raises a hand.{/n} "My Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}, it is only a few steps away. The noble lords are already lifting their glasses in their saviour's honour, awaiting your arrival. Shall we... proceed?"

fd95a477-4e65-4958-ad9a-22cdb127ccbe.Text: {n}His armour rattling, one of the knights steps forward.{/n} "I am Lucra, commander of the fortress. I can attest that the ungodly mutants were restrained properly. It's the Phesmophorius... The smoke whipped the brutes into a frenzy!"

238a933d-f276-4d98-869c-b3012362ce4a.Text: "My Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}, I swear on my life that my knights and I did everything we could to keep you safe! Who could have foreseen that the Phesmophorius, after gorging itself on miscreants, would start driving the mutants mad with its smoke..."

035d9ec0-09be-4ff5-8258-a86a0d01dc17.Text: "Lies! The Phesmophorius does not taunt heretics, it fills them with terror! To shift the blame for your own failure onto a sacred weapon of justice is a heinous crime in and of itself!"

b414d1de-0c6b-498e-a8d1-969b6601b5f5.Text: {n}Taddua looks at the commander grimly and falls to his knees.{/n} "I swear on everything that is holy, on the blood of martyrs and His name — it was never in my thoughts to cause you grief, Your Celestial Highness. Have mercy!"

3fa47fb3-b745-4947-8fa7-f571cbd1d14d.Text: {n}The commander quickly kneels in turn.{/n} "Truly, our shame will not be washed away until the end of time! We beg for our Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}'s forgiveness, so that we might serve our lifelong righteous penance!"

509e8853-fbca-487f-afa3-0926431b201f.Text: "Emperor forfend that I try to bribe you, Your Celestial Highness! The thought never even occurred to me... Forgive me most graciously!"

e127aff4-9226-4cb7-a474-0140ab38776b.Text: "Done. Continue in this vein, Governor, and your punishment won't be long in coming."

1b96847e-5816-450a-a4a8-9f3d246cfe0e.Text: {n}The commander and the executioner stop their bickering and turn their eyes to you in astonishment; they quickly recover, however, and offer you their deepest bows, maintaining a solemn silence.{/n}

a433b053-2000-45cc-baa6-5263c5b90b39.Text: "You are our saviour today, Your Celestial Highness. And in gratitude, please accept this personalised sword from my treasury. Fatebringer once decided the outcome of one of our feuds: it killed a rebel leader, and peace has reigned on the planet ever since."

689bb9cd-43bb-4ae5-af34-382fe6ab4f97.Text: "The treasurer, the elevator — who are you going to blame next, Governor? Are you the ruler of this world or a casual onlooker? You will take measures immediately and restore order, or I will conclude that you are sabotaging the Rogue Trader's visit, either by intent or simply due to your own ineptness."

08c88089-c53b-45f4-8979-8d26bd537be0.Text: {n}Your mind is a loose shard, cast out into nothing, screaming in the voices of thousands of lives... Are they your lives? Or do they belong to another? The blood cracks branch out, biting into every scrap of disjointed thought, ravaging, hungering to shatter what little of your own self remains. A cry gurgles in the depths: a plea to make the torment stop and let you dissolve in unconsciousness... But something has sunk its claws into you, keeping you in place, fusing you back together piece by piece. Methodically and tortuously, it continues to skewer the shreds of your identity onto the thread of existence in an attempt to outpace the all-consuming void.{/n}

ae713777-92eb-4e39-afd5-7416f55c60f1.Text: {n}You are wrenched suddenly out of oblivion by a blunt, merciless bite. You try to breathe and hear your own ragged wheeze. Sight gradually returns to you, and an angry horse's head emerges from the mist. You are back. You are alive.{/n}

b94797b2-2dc9-4133-968f-6220e1729ebb.Text: {n}You try to shove the head away from you, but your hand veers off. Your palms feel nothing, because the skin on them is just some unwieldy meat cover forcibly pulled onto your frame. Your fingers curl up of their own accord.{/n}

4298a14a-7d12-43e5-b783-fd7b2a187852.Text: {n}Your shout is as thin as a death cry and unbearably shrill. Still, it is just strong enough to make the creature stop trying to bite you and back off.{/n}

b76fbea6-fb0e-4c0c-91b5-9f81710d789d.Text: {n}Slowly, your eyes begin to put together a sordid image: everything around you is brown and disgusting. Hay, wood, blood, dirt... horse: the trapdoor you jumped down has led you to a stable.{/n}

2cd569ba-7be2-426b-8eaf-77b9eb5e63da.Text: {n}You sway, as if from sickness, all your limbs feeling impossibly fragile. Scrawny legs, frail arms — these do not belong to you. This is a costume, and it is not yours: it does not fit your status, it is the wrong size, and it still carries greasy traces of its former owner inside. You are overcome with the urge to tear off your flesh and throw it away like a worn glove.{/n}

5b34d655-69d1-4e99-8ec4-b27776eee3b6.Text: {n}You gather your will and repress the desire to peel all the skin off. The mad impulse recedes. The memories that linger in this body may yet prove useful.{/n}

3524cc9d-d356-47f4-b5ed-a1feff570ad2.Text: {n}Your hand finds something on your chest, something so cold it burns your fingers. For a moment, you think that it is the real you — the shard of your will lost in the flow — but it turns out to be nothing more than a thassertium necklace.{/n}

290763b3-ce9e-43b4-89b0-dfcfa53fac46.Text: {n}Memories that are not your own tear into your mind, replacing your thoughts. It occurs to you that someone else used to scare all the monsters away — a big brother, so funny and always smiling. With some effort, you manage to force his gentle face out of your head.{/n}

901d558a-4072-404a-9181-6efefe3fa875.Text: {n}A stable is a place for peasants, not sovereigns. But, somehow, your body remembers the scents of poverty. Your consciousness expands heavily, like sick lungs. You remember a large basket, bundles of food clutched in your hands, and the grateful smiles of the hungry.{/n}

e904c7cc-9917-4351-b482-22e437d2cb6d.Text: {n}As you look at it, the crystal stares back at you with its still blue eye. The fool's wrinkled face suddenly emerges from the reflection, and his gloating voice seems to hang at the edge of your awareness. This body remembers pain and electrified air... Something bad.{/n}

14cdc209-fef9-449b-9fda-c83b67bee8f6.Text: {n}To complete the picture, you have no choice but to look into a nearby water trough at your reflection. You see familiar features: some unnatural force has dragged you out of your body and into that of Maive, Ruoldo's lady-in-waiting. Now that you have spent some time in this stable, you feel a little more accustomed to your new limbs. But where is your own mortal shell?{/n}

15d8b4d6-725e-43d3-9461-d030c65b4146.Text: {n}Your muscles cramp in bitter agony — you could swear you hear the gnashing of bones and the wailing of stretched tendons. The reward for your suffering is a clumsy turn to one side, and then, your strength leaves you once more.{/n}

0b4f7d6c-c3ed-4882-b522-5aaaa40003ea.Text: {n}You dig unfamiliar nails deep into thin skin, trying to scrape someone else's face off yourself. The pain in your cheeks has a sobering effect. You see blood on your fingers. This may not be your body, but it can still prove useful to you.{/n}

1e963eb7-21b6-4016-9cf6-ca3e2bda6ab9.Text: {n}This strange flesh obeys you reluctantly, as if receiving your commands with a delay. It takes all your grit to raise a dainty hand and place it on the horse's muzzle. The animal snorts and tosses the hand away with ease.{/n}

17f38629-a234-4c9e-bac0-c9a05429636e.Text: {n}Your memories of the last several minutes are incoherent and painful. The flash of sorcery, the leap into the unknown, Solomorne shouting something — he gave Glaito an order, but what order was it? Any attempt you make to process what happened only pulls you deeper into unconsciousness.{/n}

5fc0b85c-a31f-4aba-a5dc-a955070eb6e9.Text: {n}Your {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Commissar}iron will{/d} immediately rejects the shameful weakness, and you give yourself an order: to steady yourself and to probe the memories of the previous owner of this body.{/n}

6bbed2fc-73e8-4d87-9eb8-b7e32b6dd0ad.Text: {n}Your attempt at twisting your body around only ends in a racking pain shooting through your back. The most you can achieve is a lurch upward accompanied by a piercing crunch somewhere in the spine.{/n}

30377b49-72ff-4ac6-9b0f-00ea043ac9ce.Text: "You want me to tell you about the Celestial {rt_mf|Lord|Lady}? Well, I do know a thing or two."

6c12f10c-fca5-4d26-8f9c-4ef3cb631eac.Text: "Move along. There is nothing to tell."

24d05a8e-9610-4fff-ba93-1722b57bc5f4.Text: "Well, it may have been. However, that's when {rt_mf|his|her} servants pulled out a big bag of thrones and showered the poor with them wherever the Celestial {rt_mf|Lord|Lady} went. Haven't you heard?"

23b3a3b6-1642-49cd-9b53-61c4803edba8.Text: "It's all true. I have nothing to add."

a5d58288-e306-4d2a-ab4d-3e2ba4ea00bf.Text: "You people all feast on gossip, but I'm telling you, the Celestial {rt_mf|Lord|Lady} has never dirtied {rt_mf|his|her} hands with worldly affairs. {rt_mf|He|She} is above all such petty things. How could {rt_mf|he|she} not be, when {rt_mf|he|she} rules over a thousand worlds?"

69e77b7d-3052-4f56-9b9a-97a88229578d.Text: "The Celestial {rt_mf|Lord|Lady} allowed me to sing for {rt_mf|him|her} till sundown. Anyone who didn't fall silent when we approached, and distracted {rt_mf|him|her} from enjoying the music, was immediately executed."

80f54d8b-b856-4cf3-ae0b-54b2cc311121.Text: "It was only right — justice had to be served. But then, {rt_mf|he|she} generously compensated the families of all who had lost their providers. Now they don't have to lift a finger for the rest of their lives."

60e05b50-0bae-4aaa-810a-7d524d471414.Text: "You just had to twist the story every which way! If you only looked into the Celestial {rt_mf|Lord|Lady}'s eyes even once, you'd realise how full of light {rt_mf|he|she} is. Whenever {rt_mf|he|she} orders something done, you can feel it in your heart that it's the God-Emperor talking through {rt_mf|him|her}. That it's the truth! And who are we to fathom His truth?"

fe81cdfc-2a4f-428b-856d-b90165743a60.Text: "You know so little! The Celestial {rt_mf|Lord|Lady} never forgave the man for his misstep. {rt_mf|He|She} had his family brought before {rt_mf|him|her} and tortured them at length. And {rt_mf|he|she} laughed throughout the entire ordeal, with a voice so sinister, even the rats in the corners died of sheer horror."

470d9291-9d5a-4697-b22a-fa37817e4de1.Text: "The Celestial {rt_mf|Lord|Lady} was amicable and kind to me."

b2241fce-d1d8-4178-9af0-8bd06342b915.Text: "The Celestial {rt_mf|Lord|Lady} is like the God-Emperor. Wherever {rt_mf|he|she} sets foot, people are dumbstruck. {rt_mf|He|She} outshone me so completely, {rt_mf|he|she} never even spared me a glance."

2f0f6ed9-f414-4efa-aae2-9c6c2bd4e76f.Text: "The Celestial {rt_mf|Lord|Lady} granted me the honour of kissing {rt_mf|his|her} boots and wiping the dust of the road from them. Never have I known greater joy. It was like pressing my lips to the stars {rt_mf|he|she}'d walked on!"

b04b27c6-5ab7-43e5-9bcb-851c3ff2ba96.Text: "Well, almost... The governor's gift wasn't to {rt_mf|his|her} liking, and Ruoldo was punished severely for it! Now, every time the Celestial {rt_mf|Lord|Lady} so much as looks at him, he quivers, and his teeth clatter so badly, you could use his jaw as a hammer! Finally, someone our rich folks are afraid of."

dc3e7545-73a5-452b-882a-d278aafad292.Text: [Distract them] "Say... isn't that the Celestial {rt_mf|Lord|Lady} {rt_mf|himself|herself} over there?"

76527235-cda0-4c64-9c93-3a2c3faa137b.Text: {n}Several commoners are talking in a loud whisper, taking no notice of you. A balding man with a bowl cut is gesturing energetically, his back turned toward you.{/n} "Never thought a thing like this would happen in my time! A new Celestial {rt_mf|Lord|Lady} has paid us a visit! They say {rt_mf|he|she} descended from the sky on a great bird of iron, then stepped out of its belly clad in golden armour. Any who saw {rt_mf|him|her} were blinded by the splendour. That's His anointed for you!"

6ade047e-a202-4e12-9ed7-ee00de89cc8c.Text: "Rubbish! I've heard that tale before, and only an idiot would believe it. {rt_mf|He|She}'s a noble{rt_mf|man|woman} like any other, just a more important one. Treats everyone like dirt and pushes people around worse than any of our own nobles do... But that's the way it is, isn't it. It's the God-Emperor's will that their place be at the top and ours in the dust. It's how the world works... Next thing you know, that Celestial {rt_mf|Lord|Lady} will make this whole place {rt_mf|his|her} own." {n}The pot-bellied man runs a finger under his nose, leaving a clean patch on his grimy face.{/n}

3a1e95ba-3e54-4c96-b690-4c09944bd44b.Text: "Oh, I wish it was like you said... but something tells me bad things are coming now that {rt_mf|he|she}'s here. I heard the new Celestial {rt_mf|Lord|Lady}— Wait, look, that's Maive over there! She served the Celestial {rt_mf|Lord|Lady} herself. She can tell us all about it. Hey, Maive!" {n}The small crowd rushes toward you.{/n}

931996bb-32ec-42ed-a484-bf1de446121b.Text: {n}The servant looks about him several times, steps closer to you, and whispers,{/n} "I heard the {d|Encyclopedia:FW_KeyHitBuffonDecision}Celestial {rt_mf|Lord|Lady} was offended{/d} at the court fool for daring to speak to {rt_mf|him|her}, and then beat him up. Is that what happened, Maive?"

3f72af7d-6b32-4199-b402-92c4c52e7bc2.Text: "I was told the Celestial {rt_mf|Lord|Lady} {d|Encyclopedia:FW_KeyRTDecision}accepted{/d} the key to Thassera from the court fool's hands {rt_mf|himself|herself}. {rt_mf|He|She} didn't shun the fool, {rt_mf|he|she} didn't beat him! So gracious..." {n}the servant whispers with reverence.{/n} "That's how it happened. Right, Maive?"

6a5d1c07-95c0-417d-957a-d6f9614e525e.Text: "Oh, have you heard about Lord Grimley's new wife?" {n}The pot-bellied servant has the other two's attention now. They lean closer, losing interest in the previous topic, and you can no longer hear a word they're saying. It would appear the trio has forgotten about you completely.{/n}

b1ada0d8-732f-493f-a677-fa6602d30dd9.Text: {n}The people exchange whispers, nodding vigorously at each other. Every now and then, you catch a rapt glance in your direction.{/n}

baa83afe-0773-4e11-b075-331e8a2eb658.Text: {n}The people exchange anxious whispers. One of them shakes his head doubtfully as he steals glances in your direction.{/n}

fbaa889c-e9d0-42f5-a509-62f3128f3f72.Text: {n}The commoner who asked the question casts a triumphant eye over the others.{/n}

f0fe8826-eba6-4fb3-a370-ea975f7c1a0c.Text: "Say what you will, but a noble's a noble, no matter how celestial or {rt_mf|lordly|ladily}. They all act the same."

9f27349b-2fad-4fc1-878a-ad8563a9e963.Text: "Celestial {rt_mf|Lord|Lady} or not, I don't like this... My gut tells me it's better to stay out of {rt_mf|his|her} way. You know how far I trust my gut? All the way!" {n}The servant waves his hand, looks over his shoulder, and shudders slightly.{/n}

154965c9-e9e6-4a92-8283-f7a52117c23e.Text: {n}You try to evade the crowd's attention, only for the commoners to descend upon you like so many vultures. They stare at you as if you were a rare and bizarre animal.{/n}

067d34aa-ade7-42d0-b349-65b28a903760.Text: {n}The servant lowers his voice to a whisper.{/n} "Have you heard about the mutant disaster? Everyone wanted to blame the commander or the executioner, but the Celestial {rt_mf|Lord|Lady} interfered and was {d|Encyclopedia:FW_MoraliteMercyDecision}merciful{/d}. It was like I'm telling it. Wasn't it, Maive?"

92d4705a-4d95-4488-a146-6878923c9545.Text: {n}The trio falls silent for a while, each lost in their own thoughts.{/n}

1770fa6e-6c7e-4d1c-be03-bbb7bd248d4e.Text: {n}The servant lowers his voice to a whisper.{/n} "Have you heard about the mutant disaster? Well, they sure found someone to blame. The Celestial {rt_mf|Lord|Lady} didn't even bother with a trial. {rt_mf|He|She} made 'em crawl in the mud, {d|Encyclopedia:FW_MoraliteBeggarsDecision}begging for mercy{/d}... That's right! Isn't it, Maive?"

e6a13943-622c-4f4b-a09e-0feb02ec0e55.Text: {n}The servant gestures at the others to come closer and says in a conspiratorial whisper,{/n} "The Celestial {rt_mf|Lord|Lady} is a monster. You didn't listen to me, but I'll prove it, and Maive will confirm it. Heard about the mutant disaster? Well, they started looking for the culprits. They found two so-called suspects, and the Celestial {rt_mf|Lord|Lady} just {d|Encyclopedia:FW_MoraliteKillAllDecision}had them both thrown into a furnace{/d} for {rt_mf|his|her} amusement... Am I right, Maive?"

c4c26bd1-a82f-43a1-a560-7b579dca17f2.Text: {n}The three nudge each other in the side, nodding toward you. The details have clearly impressed them.{/n}

74dbca9f-7dd4-4698-8fdd-1ade4bc739b4.Text: {n}The trio exchange doubtful glances. One of the commoners catches your eye and smiles awkwardly.{/n}

40f8fcca-2b6b-4b1b-ae74-c3db8e0c0970.Text: "The Celestial {rt_mf|Lord|Lady} is honourable and righteous. Naysayers envy {rt_mf|him|her}, so they want to drag {rt_mf|his|her} name through the mud. All they do is prove me right! I wish I could get a closer look, just for a moment... Just one look, is all I ask!"

bf473be6-16fe-4a5d-b24f-e517481b0cc5.Text: "I'd rather stay out of that Celestial {rt_mf|Lord|Lady}'s way. Who knows what goes on in those noble heads. Suppose my appearance offends {rt_mf|him|her}... I'd rather not part with my own head just yet!"

5d03b465-f33a-4b49-bbff-031035c6aa2e.Text: "Don't know about you, but I'd rather not catch {rt_mf|his|her} eye. If I do, I might lose my own! It happens! Now my lord, when he has me whipped, at least it's for something I did — and I've still got all my limbs. Oh, Emperor protect us..."

cd437d12-8060-44f5-aeaa-98818a9b6b06.Text: {n}The servant elbows the others, bidding them be silent.{/n} "Be quiet, will you! Let Maive speak!"

0aa6465d-dd98-4360-9bb4-0136b28eab2b.Text: "Maive, you got closer to {rt_mf|him|her} than anyone else here. How did {rt_mf|he|she} treat you?"

7aebb523-f7ca-4362-8dd4-e0241261e589.Text: "Yeah, Maive, tell us! What's it like to be around one of the God-Emperor's anointed?"

d823b448-8b80-4df0-beb2-a8a422bb4f6d.Text: "If it'd been me there, I know I couldn't have said a word in {rt_mf|his|her} presence. You never know what to expect from someone of such rank. For all you know, you say the wrong thing, and {rt_mf|he|she} has your tongue ripped out, roasted, and served to you on a plate... What's that look for? It's happened before! I wouldn't lie."

baedf7ab-3d1a-4c58-8fa0-9e10fe327223.Text: {n}The commoners nod their understanding as they continue to hang on your every word.{/n}

c8de3e89-4dc1-494c-a960-fb374fcc0b05.Text: {n}The commoners mumble something, their disbelief clear on their faces.{/n}

ccb0e645-9e75-4142-b67f-36c756223d95.Text: "Just a quick glance... just to walk on the same ground {rt_mf|he|she} stepped on... If we had rulers like that, we could all breathe more freely! Why can't they make mercy their new custom, instead of wearing those sewed-on faces?"

0c24d2a2-3ed1-470b-bb24-2bc26f61237d.Text: "If only I could live like that for just one day. I'd throw a great big feast. And I'd have dozens of entertainers, not just Maive here... no offence. But in the end, all we can do is please the nobles. I bet ours are going to start acting like the Celestial {rt_mf|Lord|Lady}..."

52da1ae6-54e2-4cca-80f6-457a64d978b7.Text: "How long do you think {rt_mf|he|she}'ll be staying here? What if {rt_mf|he|she} never leaves? What if {rt_mf|he|she} becomes our new governor? For now, {rt_mf|he|she}'s putting our lords and ladies in their places, but what if we're next? Oh, saints' blood, may He protect us..."

205554bc-2e1f-4b8d-876a-5482ced8a436.Text: {n}The servants all gasp at once. The pot-bellied one shakes his head and tells you,{/n} "There's a real ruler of worlds for you. Our Ruoldo isn't a patch on {rt_mf|him|her}... If only I could also taste the stardust from the soles of the Celestial {rt_mf|Lord|Lady}'s boots! You're so lucky, Maive!"

4917f606-8411-4346-8e81-34ddfca85116.Text: "Wait, hold on! Your father was of common stock himself, Maive, even if he did rise through the ranks at court..." {n}The crowd encircles you, staring at you intently.{/n}

e9dda769-b04d-4a2f-bfb5-5bb336b6a708.Text: "I told you! {rt_mf|He|She}'s not just any Celestial {rt_mf|Lord|Lady}, but one of the God-Emperor's anointed! A benefactor!"

1db46fde-2068-47d1-8ebc-747beabb4145.Text: {n}The people's eyes light up with curiosity at your words. They hurriedly gather around you, ready to hear something extraordinary.{/n}

acd63fcd-60bb-4a61-a652-bfb943dbd026.Text: {n}The people recoil in fear and cast anxious glances about them. You make use of the confusion to successfully sneak away.{/n}

413883d9-6a2b-41a3-8bec-5e3cfdbe230a.Text: {n}The servant gestures for the others to come closer and says in a conspiratorial whisper,{/n} "The Celestial {rt_mf|Lord|Lady} is a monster. You didn't listen to me, but I'll prove it, and Maive will confirm it. You hear about the mutant disaster? Well, they started looking for the culprits. But the Celestial {rt_mf|Lord|Lady} just {d|Encyclopedia:FW_MoraliteKillLowmanDecision}had the executioner thrown into a furnace{/d} for {rt_mf|his|her} amusement... Am I right, Maive?"

965927ca-7214-4adb-9781-c3b7d109e756.Text: "No, no, you've got it all wrong! Not the executioner — the commander! Tell us, Maive: did the Celestial {rt_mf|Lord|Lady} really execute somebody?"

cfd91c0d-a26d-4c69-873c-f45a0c353e55.Text: {n}The servants grumble, unsure what to think. Their faces show disappointment.{/n}

ddf1af80-dfc9-4453-986b-54d1c3963e44.Text: "I heard that when Bluff the court fool handed {rt_mf|him|her} the key to Thassera, the Celestial {rt_mf|Lord|Lady} {d|Encyclopedia:FW_KeyNotBuffonDecision}didn't so much as touch{/d} the gift. {rt_mf|He|She} ordered a servant to take it. {rt_mf|He|She} shuns the rabble, same as any noble{rt_mf|man|woman} would. That was what happened, wasn't it, Maive?" {n}The corpulent servant puts his hands on his hips and looks down at you with condescension.{/n}

bfc9d524-90aa-4f45-8ab3-78a5642678c7.Text: "I do not quite understand. Are you a psyker?"

4019ea3a-f135-4ced-bc06-346735250d9c.Text: "All that I am accomplishing in the present."

841b329e-8991-4770-b99f-4992bb0e7f60.Text: "I am here to look at the sculpture. What has my destiny got to do with it?"

fac5f737-4541-40fa-85c9-6242c79624b5.Text: "What can you tell me about this material you are working with?"

3b96b646-0f1d-48af-90e0-50661738134f.Text: "Your hand augmetics are most impressive. Such implants are impossible to come by on a feudal world. Where are you from?"

53e31503-3e53-422c-b5f5-1396de1ff826.Text: "Did you capture the governor's destiny in sculpture too?"

4575aeee-e844-4805-8bcb-a4757c9439f2.Text: "Solomorne, how would you prefer to see me portrayed?"

89d87138-64cd-4bb8-bdaa-afed34f5a43f.Text: "This is ludicrous! You do not decide my destiny. Nor do I need a monument."

ddbf8b7a-1f89-462c-816a-1faa23a352ee.Text: {n}The sculptor's mechanical hands crawl over the rough stone, their many-jointed metal fingers remaining in constant motion. Even now, you recognise your own features in the unfinished piece — it seems someone commissioned a statue of you the moment you set foot on the planet. The old man turns his wrinkled face to you, and you see crystals where his eyes should be.{/n} "Is my Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady} here to gaze upon {mf|his|her} destiny? Alas, my creation is not yet complete."

90338fd7-d9e7-4df9-8329-6c627c3854a3.Text: "When I sculpt, Your Celestial Highness, I see people's destinies in the forms I create. The visions that come to me shape not only the stone, but the person's fate as well. Your image was indistinct when it appeared before me, and my work is not yet done. What do you wish to behold?"

17ef2019-1ccb-4b59-8e10-ba52bc0c09b3.Text: "These musings on destinies and fates remind me of a heretical cult that has been plaguing the von Valancius domain of late... Your visions, sculptor, are whispers of the warp." {n}Heinrix glares ominously at the old man.{/n}

bc6c85e2-15a2-4eeb-afc9-8e39415492dd.Text: "I have passed through the halls of the Black Ship. My Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady} may be certain that my creations bear no evil within them. Tell me, what do you wish to see shaped in stone?"

0025d36d-dd5b-4a47-a967-82fe65415b8f.Text: {n}The sculptor's hands scuttle over the stone like huge metal spiders. Somehow, his sightless gaze perceives exactly those details of your appearance that you are proud of the most.{/n} "Your destiny will soon be complete, my {mf|lord|lady}. I will have it delivered to your celestial vessel."

82b15bdd-9b3e-43c3-b51f-c752a7c0a12c.Text: {n}The sculptor's hands scuttle over the stone like huge metal spiders. Somehow, his sightless gaze envisions the exact version of you that you wish to see.{/n} "Your destiny will soon be complete, my {mf|lord|lady}. I will have it delivered to your starfaring vessel."

f08e0a19-c005-4832-92fd-f349e00dc511.Text: "As Your Celestial Highness desires. However, there is no escaping your fate." {n}The old man shrugs, his worn augmetics creaking.{/n}

4430499e-2eff-40e0-80e3-dc785d52d1cb.Text: "Lord Ruoldo had my limbs replaced before he took me from my home planet. It was so long ago, I have since forgotten what my land is like to the touch."

cc227257-4f23-4f99-847f-45cbcf924ec5.Text: "Lord Captain, all that about the soul? That wasn't a metaphor, you know. This one channels his own mind through the stone and then sees what comes of it. You should be careful around this sorcerer — I don't like how my whispers have taken a fancy to him."

e604c273-32f0-4b94-a84c-390b3cdd2656.Text: "Hmm... he carves his works using the psyker abilities he is cursed with. An astonishingly frivolous application of warp powers."

7726ef2a-4491-4b78-8151-2c7a519ae68a.Text: {n}The sculptor's mechanical arms are pierced by sticky tubes, and the elbow joints have all but worn down. It must have been a decade since these implants were last serviced. Such neglect often poses a serious threat to the person's life, and yet, the old man's skin looks relatively healthy in the spots where flesh and metal meet.{/n}

1a5c58c8-2170-42e0-9d00-1ca3a2525ac5.Text: {n}This man appears to belong to a rare variety of psykers — biomancers capable of recovering even from otherwise deadly wounds and diseases.{/n}

9893d602-5fdc-4ad8-9885-dace64c72e3c.Text: {n}His mouth stretches into a cryptic smile.{/n} "I have made thousands of statues for Ruoldo, but Thassera's stone flesh can never seem to sate his great ambitions."

43a25753-40eb-4293-8f88-b46cb900d68e.Text: {n}The old sculptor once more turns his unseeing gaze to the patterns in the stone before him.{/n}

b9484792-1a5d-431f-803d-47df014fbc72.Text: "My lord governor calls me a foreteller and creator — others, a wicked {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerGlossary}sorcerer{/g}. But there is no cause for concern: my abilities are sanctioned, and I am pure before the Emperor's celestial eye." {n}He gestures at the tubes on the back of his head, as if to prove the truth of his words.{/n}

1ca65485-b567-4beb-8cf5-2d49d5858b33.Text: {n}There is no embellishment in the old man's words — he shares a special bond with his creations, one that {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Psyker}you can sense{/d} as clearly as any other breath of the warp.{/n}

16f7fa0b-c9a7-4932-8828-a15acfd81597.Text: "A humble creator, the governor's first sculptor, Tavrisk, who has the honour of shaping the destinies of others but not his own." {n}Tavrisk the sculptor turns his head to you, but you see no pupils in his crystal ocular augmetics.{/n}

1d73bfa5-a0f6-4fa9-84cb-669426a8e906.Text: "This is thassertium — a fascinating stone born from the bowels of this planet. Like any other kind, it bends and melts beneath the sculptor's tool, but for the sculpture to come to life in earnest, they must put their very soul into it." {n}One of his hands emerges from behind the statue and gently touches his head, seemingly of its own volition.{/n} "The soul, however, obtains calluses the more the sculptor works, and mine has long since become covered in scabs."

11ae8caa-9627-445e-80b1-39b32d321a57.Text: {n}Idira clutches her head and wheezes:{/n} "Be wary when toying with destiny. What gives a boon now will come back to collect later. So may the opposite be true — to harvest sweet fruits in the future, one must first drink one's fill of bitter things. Watch your words!"

9953acaa-69bc-4f88-afed-64a33059bc41.Text: {n}The old man whispers without taking his eyes off the stone,{/n} "The sculpture is not quite ready yet."

de1c76f6-a78f-4986-b59b-7ab76ad1618a.Text: {n}That this old man has not yet rotted alive is an incredible stroke of luck.{/n}

a6d1d762-7323-4c3f-9032-fa715336ca6e.Text: {n}The blue veins of the statue flare faintly under your gaze. The stone undoubtedly possesses {g|Encyclopedia:PsyfocusGlossary}psy-focus{/g} properties, allowing the old man to concentrate warp energies in it and amplify them.{/n}

540f21fd-cc73-4f42-b41e-1d850643af6e.Text: {n}Solomorne, who has been intently scrutinising the sculptor, frowns and hesitates to answer. Noticing your expectant gaze, he sullenly mutters,{/n} "I would want it to perfectly match reality." {n}Averting his eyes, he growls,{/n} "I don't know about this art of yours."

6dd47ba5-5a3a-4a4a-a5c9-2f4d5f69f9f2.Text: [Draw your weapon] "Governor, fool... Or perhaps you're just a madman, Bluff."

2c6b4382-47d9-4c9a-bd57-cbf28fa9ae20.Text: "Your scribe Gorgorius Falt left some intriguing notes behind. In them, he appears to be describing the switching of... bodies? Is that part of your plan?"

d0b1a2fd-b2de-4499-bcdd-116118e0105e.Text: "The governor is dead. Was it your doing?"

25f57c0c-ba31-4792-88a4-90a06830b842.Text: "Take off the mask. I want to see whom I'm speaking to."

d1df7dba-6db5-4805-9993-47f63c6c7c66.Text: "What was it that Maive should have done, Bluff?"

ca662baa-98b1-4e2d-947b-8d4d8f7f886f.Text: "Let's make a deal. Let me out and you can ask for anything except my death."

bc085534-1e9d-4b67-bfcf-506ca8f96006.Text: "I suppose the irregularities with the tithe were part of your plan, too?"

2ce87075-4b31-4614-bf9c-b9b1ee7c61b8.Text: "Maive's necklace is more than just a pretty bauble, I take it?"

503fba43-9976-4e10-be38-9bf8dcca6d04.Text: "If you are the real governor, why bother masquerading as the fool?"

6cc138f1-aa63-4ae1-8e29-e47555cf67d8.Text: "When I get out of here — you are dead."

ba8486f6-7155-4001-97b9-bc9aea3b2a6c.Text: "How dare you attack me! I am a Rogue Trader!"

29d0a957-d7e7-4389-a6c1-729b4185b73e.Text: "Perhaps you could start by explaining what that was all about?"

0353d0ef-f8e7-4d78-b090-2ad4e9902b1f.Text: "Thassera is not your homeworld, is that right?"

5eee9fce-f6fc-4394-a53d-6f8426e9b8c4.Text: "Bodyguards for a private conversation? Isn't that a bit much?"

13b09607-f208-4565-94e0-e673b5ff8a20.Text: "If you grovel before me, I will be merciful and let Solomorne finish you off quickly."

4bd0355d-f705-42eb-8b58-d2af1b3d6e95.Text: [Draw your weapon] "Enough talk. I will not listen to another word of this heresy."

cbccd1a6-51b6-44ad-8969-335c662db526.Text: "Still acting the buffoon? Some people never learn." {n}Solomorne gestures behind his back to the cyber-mastiff, sending him off on a circuit along the wall.{/n}

965fe86e-59fb-4ccd-8fa5-a7222c2df772.Text: "I hope you enjoyed my bloodthirsty menagerie?" {n}You instantly recognise the spiteful voice and the cocky smirk of the fool's mask. The arm that was mauled by the cyber-mastiff at their first meeting hangs limply — he has not even bothered to bandage it.{/n}

f365ae43-f216-4813-a539-bebcdd6cdf14.Text: "And all of it for this one day... this exact moment!" {n}The elation in his voice sounds almost maniacal.{/n}

6f47eedb-a998-493e-ae94-b55a0e2cf846.Text: "The lacerax, fool. You unleashed it on the governor — don't try to deny it."

8c988f12-b8f5-41ee-b04b-2691fa32bbdd.Text: "It seems 'humour' is not part of the vocabulary of the Emperor's servants. But 'truth' should be. You see, that governor was a fraud, a fake — not worth crying over. The true governor of Thassera stands before you, esteemed guests."

578e7ad8-e51c-406e-842e-b577065bff29.Text: "Daen, come on! Don't say things like that! It's... not right. It's..."

c56329f2-a28b-44a1-849b-e0d0333ed403.Text: "Shut up, you idiot! You can't even do as you're told!" {n}The fool tosses a look of utter contempt at Maive.{/n}

a40b2f2a-f3b5-480c-8782-7723409ff5af.Text: "Exactly. I don't need you. But don't worry, I've planned for this as well. Tavrisk, are you ready?" {n}Bluff smirks, clearly enjoying his imaginary power — or is it real?{/n}

d5e59034-5835-4d27-aa8b-7560d55b552d.Text: {n}The fool gestures toward the object in front of the sculptor.{/n} "A great artefact, which Tavrisk carved from this planet's unique gift — thassertium. Take a good look at it while you still can."

65d0f2f5-e161-4708-b819-d81252d29221.Text: {n}At once, you recognise him as the sculptor who offered to carve your visage out of thassertium. The old man does not seem to notice you — all his attention is focused on the strange altar.{/n}

40f0a94b-5755-42ab-940d-70167d9bbf51.Text: "You didn't trap anyone — you shot yourself in the foot. Only an idiot would think they could outmatch a Rogue Trader and a Proctor together."

e34b8ba2-9e6b-4e64-9cea-6c766de4d78e.Text: "I see you've already found me out, eh? That's right, I was born and raised on Idex, the greatest world in all the Imperium! I'll never forget that mix of plasteel and ferrocrete, the glitter of proud spires — and the eternal humiliation of my... appointment."

35f99166-48c6-4410-8b73-70719898bd34.Text: {n}Wrapping his hands around the mask, Bluff begins to slowly pull it away from his face, squirming and sobbing theatrically. Suddenly, the moans turn to gurgling laughter, and the fool removes his hands from the mask.{/n} "A jest! You'll have time to examine this face. Very thoroughly."

a47c27d3-9539-43f4-bd01-85c832f17a80.Text: "You are perceptive, aren't you? My previous experiments were failures. You have met some of them, actually, including Falt himself. Remember the crazy mutant by the Phesmophorius? His brains turned out to be a bit of a complication." {n}Mocking laughter erupts from behind the mask, making the fool's body shake all over.{/n} "But do not fret. This time, it will work."

d62c4657-1b3e-4302-997d-2e14242ed917.Text: "Oh yes. One small part of the grand design. To be precise — the first bait you had to take. Which you did — with commendable zeal."

b8cff01f-1846-464e-a1e5-da80e9924430.Text: "And I, according to your plan, was supposed to die." {n}Solomorne raises the palm of his hand that holds the invisible mark of the data-brand.{/n}

2677ab9d-c29c-402b-b0e0-0460f392ebd1.Text: "The concept was simple: disrupt the shipment and provoke a response. An ingenious trap that the Arbites walked right into. But fate granted me a special boon: you were caught in my net along with them, {name}."

b5fc9083-2120-486b-93eb-ac6625766a10.Text: "Do I have to be any one thing?" {n}Bluff chuckles darkly.{/n}

d094a9d1-c6e3-40a8-bbdb-3fd0f25c13fb.Text: "Times are troubled, as you know. I want everything to go according to plan."

d3c253af-16be-4266-af05-56ef8ecb1144.Text: "To serve the Imperium faithfully and honestly, why else? Our all-knowing Administratum benefits if the feudal throne is occupied by someone with an intelligence level higher than a grox's. A golden shove for all my diligent service on Idex. I packed my bags and came here to govern this backwater. What a joke..."

97172562-7a4c-4040-8460-85a1ff798e6c.Text: {n}Solomorne turns slightly away from the fool and makes a series of furtive hand signals — telling you to stall while the cyber-mastiff gets into position.{/n}

efb796a7-8485-4f1c-8fc1-7bb74233beda.Text: {n}The Arbitrator gives you a subtle nod: the cyber-mastiff is close enough for a decisive lunge.{/n}

3f4dfbe0-6515-48e4-a9fb-488385411044.Text: {n}There is a {d|Encyclopedia:FW_ShotJesterDecision}gunshot wound{/d} in his shoulder surrounded by singed threads. His garish outfit is soaked with blood.{/n}
