eb3d983e-ebb3-4b39-b8c2-759bb23b5b6d.Text: {n}Bluff ignores the Arbitrator, his gaze fixed on you — more specifically, on the {d|Encyclopedia:FW_TookAmuletDecision}necklace on your chest{/d}.{/n} "A lovely piece, isn't it?"

e0087a1a-588c-498c-80af-f0e4d5dada1b.Text: "Don't be ridiculous — I couldn't swallow a man whole even if I wanted to!" {n}Bluff throws up his arms in an exaggerated fashion.{/n}

1898fed0-fb34-46b1-b405-254a42ee4d89.Text: {n}Bluff ignores the Arbitrator, his gaze fixed on Maive — more specifically, on the necklace on her chest.{/n} "A lovely piece, isn't it?"

0338e06d-1a4b-4f5c-8867-79ef79e8e9fe.Text: {n}The fool chuckles nastily.{/n} "You have overlooked one small detail."

9cbc2480-afdf-4566-95cf-b12e01ed4b81.Text: "What detail? Talk, you bastard!" {n}Solomorne raises his voice and takes a step toward Bluff, clearly trying to draw his attention. Glaito freezes, silently awaiting the signal to attack.{/n}

303f9a63-90c3-4fc7-b5ac-7b520f782c50.Text: {n}You are surrounded by the smell of old rust. The darkness reluctantly retreats: the pain comes first — throbbing in your head; then the metallic taste in your mouth; and finally the feel of the hard floor, chafing your stinging cheek.{/n}

c888a20a-c132-47cb-9d7c-a9e931c169c2.Text: "I'm fine." {n}He looks away for a moment and then back at you — under Bluff's unwavering gaze, he cannot communicate any more clearly.{/n}

8654ea78-43a9-4106-8b2c-422c606f708f.Text: "Enough chitchat. Tavrisk, begin!" {n}Wheezing raspily, the old man with the thassertium eyes spews a torrent of unholy words from his toothless mouth. In response, the markings beneath your cage seem to inhale, and begin glowing with light.{/n}

cc1f048c-9c52-4abc-9f81-8c575ee17fa9.Text: {n}You see Solomorne's hand signal out of the corner of your eye. Glaito leaps but does not reach the fool — the psyker moves at the same time. A flash of light, and everything goes dark.{/n}

92e48d6b-56bb-4e5d-b635-5d05cda376e2.Text: {n}Maive's gaze leaps from you to Bluff in alarm. Tear-reddened eyes widen as she realises what is happening.{/n} "Daen, stop!" {n}Her slight form crashes into the fool, pushing him out of the centre of the circle.{/n}

c76dc223-234d-4eb1-a687-110b15f75ebd.Text: {n}The world explodes into shards, suffused with a blinding light that burns out your eye sockets, incinerates the air in your lungs, and makes your heart judder in your chest. And finally, darkness descends — impenetrable and absolute, encompassing everything. It cradles you, dissolving everything that was once you. Everything that once was.{/n}

71ee0784-e944-4c97-87eb-fc0ecf728b2d.Text: {n}Staring daggers at you, Ruoldo shrieks,{/n} "Seize her! Seize Maive!"

7fb3cee7-328b-441e-8dd3-9b051899031d.Text: {n}You take a swing, and... lose your coordination. Maive's delicate body cannot even muster the strength for a slap.{/n}

a4241df1-f79a-4d40-90b6-67d8835e15a6.Text: {n}Your head swims, and through the haze you recognise the figure of a guard coming closer and closer with no sign of stopping. Your gaze sweeps over the room, searching for a way out, for a solution, until, somewhere at the periphery of your vision, you notice a streak of scarlet. It is the cyber-mastiff's visors lighting up, giving you a chance to run...{/n}

bfd5f8a1-c5b9-4f7b-91e5-d0542baac270.Text: {n}You see Bluff through the bars of the cage. The mocking smile on his sinister mask seems to grow even broader, or is it a trick of the light? Maive — as white as a sheet, with a dark abrasion on her face — weeps quietly as she stands stock-still beside the fool.{/n}

739d37af-c01c-429b-af64-085e42deab9d.Text: {n}You turn to the voice. Solomorne is trapped in one of the side cells. Apart from a bleeding bruise on his forehead, he appears unharmed.{/n}

bdced129-87ac-4c40-bfea-92ed47f627d2.Text: {n}You look over to where Solomorne indicated. Glaito lies motionless in the middle of the room. Judging by the flickering lumens on his implants, the dog is still alive.{/n}

437fff58-fbdc-4625-8937-32bbeb96b6c1.Text: {n}The piercing pain in your head makes it hard to parse Solomorne's cryptic signals.{/n}

e730299b-a03b-470d-b912-a74283c4a8f7.Text: {n}The guard takes a heavy step in your direction. The look on his face promises nothing pleasant.{/n}

8934fbd1-c943-4847-a9a6-fcaf0285a9b7.Text: {n}A sweet, melodious voice rings out — not yours.{/n}

08227be6-5d1f-4e5f-849e-3895ca60e5a0.Text: "It is simple: Who would ever take a poor, pitiful jester seriously? Who would even spare him a glance? Beneath this fool's cap, my hands were free, and I could devote myself entirely to preparing for our... grand finale. And to conceal the tracks of my little mischief..."

77f9dc5e-256f-4c63-8908-6282386f9fd0.Text: "I found a replacement. 'Ruoldo' wanted to play at power, and I graciously let him. Shame he didn't rule for long. {n} Bluff's jeering laughter carries no hint of pity.{/n}

813404a3-8b17-464f-b96f-2dc5f94aaf82.Text: "Much more. You see, with the right knowledge, the right tools, and some complex rituals, people can transform a simple, dirty blue pebble from the depths of Thassera into something truly special. However, it's a bit late for you to do anything with that information."

51cd941d-ad64-4e15-86e0-e880a5c243ab.Text: {n}Taddua the executioner stands behind the fool and gives you a crooked smile.{/n}

122dbc16-c191-49a1-af72-58e3b9213961.Text: {n}There are markings on the floor at your feet: a crooked circle bordered by unholy symbols. Bluff is standing in the centre of an identical circle. You hear a quiet, measured scraping sound and an old man's muttering coming from the depths of the hall — the few words you manage to catch sound nothing like Gothic.{/n}

065198c9-f044-488c-8c3f-403b99b895e6.Text: {n}You are bobbing like a boat tossed upon the waves. Colours and sounds meld into a cacophony, stirring up nausea in this exhausted body. You blink — and the patches of colour fall into place — or do they? Across from you, in the cage, you see a frightened, disoriented face — an expression you have never seen in a mirror.{/n}

d966ffd0-5c28-4023-a329-52a5efaec306.Text: {n}Nearby, Lucra, the fortress commander, keeps a sullen vigil. His hand never leaves the handle of his weapon.{/n}

359985c5-ef8d-426d-a03c-c9ab45856d1b.Text: "The preparations are complete, my lord." {n}Barely able to take his eyes off the dark altar, the sculptor hobbles toward the edge of the balcony.{/n}

c75fafe4-9461-461c-b7b4-3ed170741f99.Text: {n}At your feet lies a gaudy mask that has fallen from the fool's face. Covering his wrinkled visage with both hands, the ugly and enraged governor of Thassera rises hastily on trembling legs.{/n}

ba7150d8-feb1-4240-b534-c2749aa2f375.Text: "Now, now, why so tense? I simply grew tired of you forever wandering about with your retinue. Never a chance for a quiet word face-to-face. Yet I see your fearsome guardian has managed to find his way here as well." {n}The fool sneers as he nods toward the Arbitrator.{/n} "And do pardon the… less than gentle reception. These rain-worn mechanisms never fail to disappoint — creaking one moment, failing the next."

28828772-6b03-4ebf-90aa-060f9970e090.Text: {n}A pulsing light draws your attention — against the far wall, an old man stands behind an ominous-looking altar. The heavily augmented man stares in wonder at the flashes of blue light snaking through the veins of thassertium in the floor and walls. The crystals in his eye sockets gleam and go dark in time with the flashes.{/n}

9b53fc8e-ba8b-435b-8510-38f424908d3a.Text: "Bring you here, to the Altar of Change, and not ask questions. So simple, but she couldn't even manage that."

f21b49fe-e8e9-478d-8c2c-aa2198251ed3.Text: "I'm a hungry young court lady and I'm in danger. Don't you have a heart?"

a5160004-12ef-43c8-9373-5d98123b9b78.Text: "Let me out this instant! I am the Rogue Trader! They have put me in this body..."

cac776e0-ffae-4d93-93f1-ff1c34e861af.Text: "Please, let me out! I can make you rich."

0fb059ab-c0a8-4e4a-8af0-23f6a6817147.Text: "My servants will find me. And when they do, they will cut you to ribbons, unless you let me go right now!"

366b63e9-55c6-4377-9599-b194e9e3b77b.Text: {n}Your attempt at breaking out may not have worked, but it has drawn attention. You hear the stable hand grumble:{/n} "Hey! Cut it out in there!"

80b17457-34bf-453d-a862-9573b2b16c62.Text: {n}The sight of the stable hand standing in the doorway portends nothing good for you. The man's face is savage, and glinting in his hand is a meat cleaver.{/n} "You let the horse loose, you little wench? I'll skin you alive."

0ccb9743-d7f9-4ece-bb22-b43a2ad0c804.Text: {n}You see your new reflection in the blade of the cleaver. There is no way out. At least this foray into the life of Thasserian peasantry has been a short one...{/n}

7cfbfdce-e550-400b-a01a-77ef8f2589c1.Text: {n}You take a deep breath and scream as loud as you can. Your voice rings pitifully. This cry may be your last.{/n}

bde5e82c-0af9-42af-ae56-e2a104eeff13.Text: {n}You punch him in the jaw, but Maive's scrawny arms simply do not have the strength to do the brute any real harm. The man grabs your wrist.{/n}

1516b3e0-d919-4efa-86ab-bb58d3c7f751.Text: {n}You dash forward, but your weak legs fail you. The man grabs your hair with his free hand. Black spots dance before your eyes.{/n}

f5b09375-aeee-40f1-a63c-d3131313b9cf.Text: {n}Glaito stares at you for a while, then barks and turns to scan the area. He is clearly waiting for orders.{/n}

0a3a6f41-7934-4b3c-855a-68407004a43c.Text: {n}The stable hand says nothing for a while.{/n} "Hmm. I see. Well, I guess your trading days are over. It happens."

3b005616-e247-479c-b7ac-f33d1c1a9937.Text: "Stop whining. It's in your best interest to die quickly — no point in prolonging your own suffering. So, just lie down and croak already."

19339759-0401-43d7-984b-21edb2b36ea4.Text: {n}You notice a dent in one of the cyber-mastiff's implants: he has taken a beating. It is hard to say whether he received this injury at the time of your capture or during his escape from the castle.{/n}

8c6cad08-d6dc-4c95-aa65-6f03a61f3331.Text: {n}You try to hit him in the jaw, but miss your punch — Maive is a lady-in-waiting, not a fighter. The man grabs your wrist.{/n}

447386f0-2d7b-4c3a-92e5-6f2907425714.Text: {n}You try to make a run for it, but trip over your own legs. The stable hand grabs you by the hair. Bright circles fill your vision.{/n}

b31619e1-27ae-4593-a3d0-4f3a837df02d.Text: {n}The cleaver, raised for a strike, falls from the man's hand as he screams, assailed by a whirlwind of fangs, fur, and metal. Having emerged from the gloom, the cyber-mastiff does not give the stable hand even a single chance: after ripping out a part of his spine, the beast spits out the corpse and looks up at you.{/n}

7cc67d59-f1f7-4e97-b55b-8799c33bf043.Text: {n}An abrupt metallic clang rattles the stable. Something very heavy is coming your way at terrifying speed.{/n}

2c025ffa-a784-4672-99ea-8f3f5d93399f.Text: {n}A cyber-mastiff listens only to its Arbites master. The fact that Glaito is here means that Solomorne has ordered him to follow you through the trapdoor. The Arbitrator must have adjusted Glaito's priorities to have him guard you.{/n}

05585197-5182-4127-a58e-ea3c9e30bef5.Text: {n}A cyber-mastiff listens only to its Arbites master. But now, Glaito is here. He has followed you through the trapdoor, which must mean that his master is... dead?{/n}

ecc2a800-0792-4523-80e3-36aab36abf30.Text: "Maybe not. What I do have is enough wits not to go rummaging in the dump. That's why I'm on this side of the door, and you're on the other."

b38564f3-27b1-4e8d-84d7-ae4cb53cb3eb.Text: "You're far from the first daft lass who's crawled down the chute to eat the horses' leftovers. And you know what? Nobody's ever come to fetch any of you. 'Servants'... Don't make me laugh!"

c44464c9-e6d7-46a0-ac49-7b02b002f6d0.Text: {n}A mountain of vegetable waste rises up ahead, next to which stands a rusty pitchfork. Your attention is drawn to something pale pink, half-buried under the waste and looking suspiciously like a limb.{/n}

0e744068-5220-459e-9a67-8eee9522e4a6.Text: {n}You pull out the strange object from the pile. What emerges is a human forearm, crudely severed at the elbow. The horse behind you sniffs and cranes its neck.{/n}

71d5eb88-4e0b-4c03-b5a8-8d8fb56961dd.Text: {n}The horse behind you snorts and shifts about.{/n}

10660d2a-95ae-4fbd-90e5-b3472daa4232.Text: {n}You pick up what used to be someone's arm. The horse looks at the dead fingers greedily.{/n}

fe9defa0-4ea2-44e4-ab74-ae76426cdea2.Text: {n}You take a step back, trying to discern anything else useful here.{/n}

9cbb2d58-fc90-4743-a598-486d4abb8baf.Text: {n}This could be a decent weapon if not for one problem: you lack the strength to pull it free from the earth.{/n}

ba022398-0dc2-4686-bf79-78a1bcf30f48.Text: {n}A mountain of swill rises in front of you, with a rusty pitchfork standing next to it.{/n}

0c3fb88f-1a72-4403-885d-b975eeab027f.Text: "I am uneasy as well, on account of certain unusual circumstances."

0ed48380-8468-4f0c-b531-6df6df14bba9.Text: "The governor's strange behaviour. The remarkably lavish gifts, the change in personality... and all of that just before our arrival."

5902649f-51fd-4b9f-b99c-6f4f26ed8834.Text: "I do not like the way the governor is using every means possible to stall our enquiry into the tithe."

e3a33174-1c0a-4dae-bd71-60be781941ac.Text: "The governor is not Thasserian. And yet, he seems utterly clueless about what is happening outside this planet."

bfd2d7bc-1877-480b-afa5-0886f83647d8.Text: "The sculptor, like Ruoldo, is not a local. But more importantly, he is a sanctioned psyker."

a9a43168-6fb9-4598-aa29-c7fbab74290d.Text: "Remember the last mutant from the public execution? Something was off about him, and it wasn't just the physical deformity."

b157bf03-2cec-4a92-9e47-249dbfcff3eb.Text: "If you have suspicions about the Thasserians, why have you not taken any action so far?"

b59e666e-4c19-4f90-b8db-3c5b353be378.Text: "You are the most suspicious person here, Solomorne. Take a deep breath."

605ea24c-3693-48af-a862-a8fd0a5a2dd3.Text: "The local beliefs. What is this tripe about 'altering your destiny'?"

4917017e-6774-40d2-87a6-848bafbedf1c.Text: "No. We are going to resolve all issues peacefully."

f94fe504-45ce-42eb-9b14-8bb6958a306a.Text: "You tell me! You're the sleuthing Arbitrator!"

30c62299-8c7e-4f14-9e3d-3038b08c549c.Text: "We are being led into a trap of some sort."

24d3ac3e-d8d1-4d91-be33-6de62f6bd1f4.Text: "I will take a drag on a lho-stick. That will be the signal to strike."

f1e39134-6142-41b8-b171-6b615b3e917d.Text: "Do not forget that the Thasserians have been nothing but cordial to us so far."

c9ffe613-2048-475f-9009-1733f1eddd99.Text: "The Thasserians have failed to gather their tithe and are now distracting us with smoke and mirrors."

2957d657-8bcf-47cc-870d-9c9efcfd5933.Text: "There is something in Thassera's atmosphere that alters the human brain. Sooner or later, anyone who lives here becomes a clumsy idiot."

a8319bd8-a3eb-4d4f-860f-3fbf1bd9bfcb.Text: "Have you seen the writings of that madman, Falt? The Chronicle of Fates? It is lunacy bordering on heresy."

b0f8d365-3112-4a16-8c64-482e8711f8d0.Text: "I would wager that this is a cult. The predicaments I get into usually involve a cult of some description."

05c6a1a4-f91e-4e47-88a9-9120c9acad72.Text: "The tithe is a ruse. The governor is fully aware that with every hour that passes without him providing a report, his sentence only becomes more severe. Which means he is not even trying to account for the shortage. I suspect that there is some goal he is pursuing in trying to keep us here on Thassera."

fa33c918-e995-4655-bc64-127c998eea68.Text: "The fact there was a mutant attack during a public execution, with no clear or evident cause."

71a51f44-f5ea-479a-bdcc-e83beea81c55.Text: "The governor barely manages to stay in his saddle, which is odd for a local nobleman."

fb84948d-671d-40e7-89ce-4ec234249405.Text: "This is what they call a persecution complex, Solomorne."

81df8f85-c257-4068-a91b-c9042ca8d4fc.Text: "Thassera is not what they are making it out to be — not a feudal world with a primitive populace but a forge world. Or else, an industrial one. The point of the deception is to pay a smaller tithe!"

4d56d299-2ef2-45c7-b68a-6d88c6b8c665.Text: "It is how I want it done."

c60ab8b5-8fd8-4a15-b926-108aef51fdee.Text: "Everyone needs rest sometimes, Solomorne. When one is constantly on edge, one starts to imagine things."

e897c776-7aaa-42a2-b068-c4230c8292a6.Text: "Maive, bring me a cup of {g|Encyclopedia:Amasec}amasec{/g} — and make sure it's filled to the brim," {n}comes an unexpected order from Solomorne.{/n}

f72f66bf-eef4-4be0-890f-23766a0c8972.Text: "His work with locally mined stone may be a harmless pursuit... or it may not be. In any event, the fact that the governor employs a sorcerer who is working on his own project is enough to raise questions."

dc502c35-8a1e-4124-bfb3-5bb6e4f3e585.Text: "My hypothesis is that this is not about the tithe. That is merely a pretext to keep us here long enough — but what for? We should play along for now. Let them think we've taken the bait while we wait for an opportunity to seize control of the situation. For that, we need to agree on a signal to launch a coordinated attack."

372c8365-d0a9-4f31-b0ce-501b58b4cea7.Text: "I should rather call it vigilance. Strange situations may seem inconsequential now, but when the time comes for the looming threat to reveal itself, we will realise they were warning signs — or, indeed, warning shouts. Experience tells me we won't have long to wait for proof to emerge."

78d68067-1e91-4860-acf1-a64258eaac7a.Text: "Fair enough. It is my direct duty to draw conclusions and pass verdicts."

b35f13fe-7063-4c0a-b349-4b16a624bb26.Text: {n}Solomorne pauses, then asks with pointed courteousness:{/n} "May I conclude that you have observed nothing that struck you as suspicious?"

6ef8f86a-7bd5-4efc-9af5-c05545da0601.Text: {n}Solomorne waits until Maive is some distance away, then turns to you.{/n} "I wanted to talk to you without the observer they have attached to us overhearing." {n}He casts a sweeping glance around the courtyard and lowers his voice.{/n} "Do you get the sense that what is happening raises questions that lack coherent answers?"

c533e39e-bb10-4cdc-8013-3f7d908fb10b.Text: "You are not wrong. In particular, I would like to note the governor granting preferential treatment to our attendant. Perhaps he needs her unconditional trust... to ensure that she does something or, on the contrary, remains uninvolved at just the right moment."

cba3991c-84e8-4494-98da-33293dd9207a.Text: "I see. Then I will not initiate combat, but neither will I stand back if the other side initiates."

99496b56-8345-4ba2-ac98-da52c00d6cc8.Text: "Indeed. At first, one could mistake it for sycophancy and an attempt to appease the 'celestial guests,' but the longer it goes on, the more apparent the criminal intent behind this stalling of the inevitable becomes."

04f8cfac-608a-4218-81b9-841b1289af0e.Text: {n}Without a word, the Arbitrator hurls the drink on the pavement. The splash of amasec is like a scarlet wound upon the stone that has been polished by a thousand soles.{/n}

9102ef7b-0d5f-4ce7-b181-32befad2b10d.Text: "I have been gathering information. Taking any steps before doing that would have been reckless. Now is the time to coordinate our actions and discuss the risks — which are high, considering we are both outnumbered and in unknown territory."

528caed0-4fa4-46a3-9e91-c4378ba8597d.Text: "Not too odd considering Ruoldo's ravenous fondness for food and amasec... but an astute observation nonetheless."

160e9162-19dc-4f00-a194-2c75ba9cb1bd.Text: "I have a theory, but I would like to hear yours first, lest my opinions influence your reasoning."

7f29a4d2-5a6b-458e-b983-89b5c15b18f7.Text: "An Arbitrator cannot be bribed — neither with gold nor with special treatment. Doing our duty is all that concerns us. The locals' affability is not conducive to obtaining data on the tithe, and that is what matters to me."

468f730e-ed6c-4fc3-90b1-939b9d15286d.Text: "I take that as a no. Understood. No further questions."

c44ebf72-ff38-4d6c-aa6a-cf69bcd8065f.Text: {n}Maive returns, taking quick careful steps along the paved road, a brimming goblet in her hands.{/n} "Your amasec, my lord. I haven't spilt a drop!"

ebd7c1f1-33a7-4874-a629-7919da0f1f5f.Text: {n}Solomorne looks at you, his doubt evident.{/n} "Certainly a bold theory, but I would be wary of such far-reaching speculations."

48a18b0e-da90-420e-8633-5609c407f878.Text: "Likely so. But while we are ignorant as to the nature and purpose of this trap, we have nothing concrete to go on and can only stay on our guard."

54bf9302-adec-4d22-8c67-fa60388666a1.Text: "That is possible. But how can they ever expect it to work? Tithe evasion cannot be covered up, especially not by eliminating our delegation. It is as though the governor is painting himself into a corner..."

216452f5-5c84-4147-b286-2786e66097de.Text: "Believe it or not, I have seen worlds like that. Colonies do not tend to last very long on them, so I cannot second your hypothesis."

6338adee-37fd-4f06-9352-ee1644467258.Text: "Not bordering — they are heresy writ large. But that is not what troubles me. What troubles me is that the madman succeeded in publishing them."

bf576d70-7a52-4064-80f5-3c3c852a32df.Text: "Heretical cults are not the only threat by far. But there is enough heresy on Thassera either way."

9757f67e-64d6-46d1-987f-3ea972fd7abe.Text: "The fact that the court fool is Maive's brother only adds to the suspicion, as do the alleged changes in his behaviour. There is some connection between the governor and these two — a buffoon who is permitted to run wild and a minor noblewoman who has unexpectedly been given an important role in the festivities."

f1240916-4ee9-4fc6-9367-975a4099db68.Text: {n}Solomorne chuckles.{/n} "Expertly noted. It somehow slipped my mind that {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Arbitrator}you collected tributes{/d} from just as many worlds as I have in your time. I do not have a strong hypothesis for why the governor is stalling us, but I would like to propose a plan: let's not give away the fact that we are aware of his ploy and wait for an opportune moment to strike — we do not know the territory, so we should act suddenly and take no chances. Now let's decide on a signal we will use when the time is right."

8b78d35f-56a9-4e25-8585-b555cc01d171.Text: "It will be done, my lord judicator."

9c6e5a99-e776-4644-a98f-edebfab19a35.Text: "Precisely. Either he has had an experience so traumatic as to cause him to altogether lose his memory, or we are being played for fools."

f07b9b49-b696-42de-adc5-691238bd1fe4.Text: "Yes. Mutation is a corruption that seldom leaves a person with a sound mind, but what the madman spouted on the scaffold, and what he had done to himself, was beyond the pale."

f5a00a6f-e295-4106-9030-77ca77caebc1.Text: "The God-Emperor alone knows how many different cults of Him there are. No two planets worship Him in quite the same way. But only a heretic would wax poetic about altering a fate that was ordained by the Emperor once and for all."

7a720f97-2359-4eaa-826b-c6f21c455f00.Text: "The attack is unlikely to have been planned. It looked too... messy, shall we say. On the other hand, perhaps that's the best this backwater planet can do when it comes to plotting and scheming."

d833962d-7e7a-4205-9ba5-5b8ac608e674.Text: "Thus forewarning the enemy as well. What would be the point?"

1fbf6356-c656-4a11-a4f6-275ebdf652ab.Text: The protocol data-chip has been polished to a high shine and is encased in a thin wooden frame. You can see yourself in its mirrored surface if you wish.

81d64bc5-5bd8-4166-afd4-8404364c9bc8.Text: This brand leaves an almost invisible holographic mark on anyone it touches. Contains four charges.

12b00381-911b-4345-9229-6d7d63bf4892.Text: A mask studded all over with sparkling thassertium.

0e23cc11-8977-4165-a5a5-51bf062cd8e0.Text: An unusual mask made of red metal. The mouth is twisted into a scowl, its lips torn in such a way that they resemble fangs.

1d9f331d-126b-4a6c-a13e-16e1e91ae8db.Text: Despite its ceremonial appearance, the sword is perfectly usable in combat. The blade is polished, and the hilt is encrusted with blue crystals.

43b60b0b-ebaf-426f-b65f-a0eb9ea19327.Text: The pupil of the eye hollowed out of the thassertium surface looks unfathomably deep. Whichever way the amulet faces, its gaze seems to follow you.

693492e4-c8a9-43f3-8d0e-8584ebfabb00.Text: A splendid golden necklace adorned with skilfully polished, sparkling thassertium.

22086d56-a0e6-4b16-bb48-0d58b1f2b8c0.Text: A large key with the Thassera coat of arms embossed on its head.

1b928369-3253-4c75-9be0-122b73ffadf2.Text: The protocol data-chip has been pierced at the corner and tied on a long coarse string.

3dbe7b70-d7d9-40c2-873f-96b834d38940.Text: The protocol data-chip has been marred by many long scratches. Someone has tried repeatedly, and unsuccessfully, to insert it the wrong way round and in the wrong place.

ef3355e4-5224-42ac-8028-60c9fecaff75.Text: The entire data-chip is covered in saliva and gastric juices. It looks as though someone literally fed it to an animal.

5cff59cb-6034-43db-bd44-09587b35d6fd.Text: Little more than shards of civilisation that have been separated from the Imperium's fold for thousands of years, feudal worlds tend to be underdeveloped and degraded. Their technology is usually primitive, and their faith in the God-Emperor often takes on bizarre forms.

09d4edd0-6238-4766-ab13-2509ca987cb8.Text: "Have you heard about Sargona? The Arbitrators got to him. Let's drink to that bastard resting in the void's cold embrace."

5221e449-8a22-461a-a834-77b188a39bac.Text: "I'm not raising a toast to Sargona — he was a scumbag, robbing his own and selling them to the xenos as meat."

5d1bf4f9-39dd-4777-9d85-c311fd60bbf9.Text: "I'm not claiming otherwise. But it was the lawmen who handled him — are you expecting me to drain a glass for their victory instead?"

8995f2a4-98ac-4d33-8123-bbf76051dd6f.Text: The cogitator's vid-screen is showing partially encrypted records: the call signs of the Arbitrators in the task unit, the status of the upcoming operation, and its objectives.

c324c565-3669-4dfa-9459-e0a644fff061.Text: "Meddlers. As if we couldn't handle this ourselves, without the Arbitrators' 'help.'"

08022348-f140-4f3f-9a3f-d015af65e622.Text: "So, we're security's security now. So much for guard duty."

dd176337-519d-4562-8968-c0e4bec42188.Text: "This is a restricted area. There is an active investigation going on."

c0287364-5ce8-4ace-8b6e-d6a87518835c.Text: "Code RT-091. The Rogue Trader is here."

6e5b1cac-8996-4015-9f7a-d9af4dc1cfbd.Text: "If it's about murders or thefts, talk to the wardens. We're not here to deal with petty offences."

5554bd0c-23a9-41eb-a86c-03ff5700f371.Text: "Whoever is logging the ships docking in port is either a one-eyed grox or a criminal. And I am not seeing any groxes."

fbb9b7c8-4528-4024-be8a-34226376d351.Text: "Report 23.5A. 357 Lex violations identified over the past day — 321 resulted in a verdict, 36 still being processed due to potential of uncovering larger criminal cells."

a4a9e7a0-227c-40fd-8344-c37f498760b9.Text: Manipulating the mechanism is impossible: there is no machine spark in its innards.

040d8535-0ec6-40f4-aff6-84766f7d471b.Text: "What are you trying to tell me, {petname}?"

282b1eec-afe7-4a8e-ae79-a31ab6efc897.Text: "You can power up the elevator that goes into the infected sector? Proceed!"

582c6dc3-199a-41de-b78b-0dd35e77f7e3.Text: "The elevator was disabled for a reason. Leave it alone."

6dd4729d-bcd0-4e0b-b349-cf6838d758f4.Text: {n}The servo-skull swarm's loud binharic trill is clearly meant to draw your attention to the elevator control panel.{/n}

5f07204b-f258-4293-9cfc-08768cf7e804.Text: {n}The central skull's vox clicks briefly, and chittering sounds come from another skull's hurrying quill. A short note falls into your hand:{/n} "Recording a possibility to awaken the sacred mechanism's machine spirits. Awaiting confirmation from Unit {petname}'s owner."

4573b126-e60c-46e4-8b9f-9ef304712bfe.Text: {n}Manipulator cables entwine the elevator control board and dig into the emergency sockets inside it with an unpleasant scraping sound. Machine-spark discharges run over the panel. The lumen under the rusty lever lights up a flickering green.{/n}

9065043b-0f58-4df3-ad5e-379726966348.Text: {n}The skulls go quiet and hover off to the side obediently.{/n}

dcb0ae57-8b92-46ae-8cfd-405e4daf1f18.Text: This insignia is made of an expensive alloy, heavy as the gaze of a true believer.

9fe10816-12ad-4af2-a71b-3ebf5571443c.Text: One of the metal skulls adorning this belt bears its maker's signature, and their vanity is justified — this truly is the pinnacle of leathercraft.

bc80df55-235c-45be-b978-c59351eb17c2.Text: The enemy is discomposed by the cyber-eagle's attack.

fdb575a2-00f2-46f6-b407-f859931a4d00.Text: One of Tazarra's eyes has been ruined by the cyber-eagle's talons.

ebac006b-0fa6-458b-8861-d0e6195127a2.Text: The name on the grip of this shotgun has all but faded. This weapon once belonged to a member of the Adeptus Arbites. Judging by the many chips and dents, it served them long and well by ending the lives of hundreds of Lex violators.

a9acabf3-99eb-409e-b682-232a4585d3cf.Text: "Yes, I did come for Solomorne. Where is he?"

dfbec2f1-8cf5-4bfb-bbd4-3e8e804603f2.Text: "You look a little disturbed. Is Solomorne causing trouble?"

bdea3cba-6f80-4a2d-908f-bf32bfaed34f.Text: "Why is Solomorne dictating procedures? Are you not in charge here?"

4f84ea82-cdc4-4081-97dc-59c459bf7821.Text: "There has been a murder attempt on Solomorne. Some of the other jailers were behind it. Find the culprits and execute them."

e066806b-3960-45bc-ba39-a955d791645a.Text: "Are you saying the colony has become less functional?"

6aa8239a-4e38-47bf-b20e-a2c8006abab3.Text: "Solomorne may be gone but his rules still stand. Do not change a thing. Serve until service wears you down. Is that clear?"

e6e1d596-0bb6-409f-9de6-415adda41540.Text: "Solomorne is no longer your concern. Farewell."

1f03888c-7ff5-45d0-bc53-2e869a22cc1e.Text: "Greetings, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! You've come to collect him, haven't you? Overseer Anthar, I mean?"

1fd21b2b-5226-4a9e-b536-5df96a1e5a36.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, Vheabos VI is a grim and dismal place, but — how shall I put this — Master Anthar has made it unbearable. He has introduced new policies... Each shift now begins with a penitential scourging followed by an inspection. Even the slightest offence merits ten lashes, a thorough search, and yet more punishment. And I'm talking about the jailers here!"

4fc979ce-e2f9-46fd-92c0-5a60b76ae07a.Text: "I am in charge of just this sector... Or was in charge, anyway. The head of the colony said that, now that we have an ex-Arbitrator, we should heed his wisdom and learn from it. Called us planetoid-dwelling dust-gorgers too, but that is beside the point."

d48a6987-52cb-4807-8420-00cd11b6ffe0.Text: "Emperor be praised... I mean, he is not far from here, carrying out routine cell inspections. You should have no trouble finding him."

fd70158d-418d-4573-a3e4-2eed66d90e7b.Text: "Most certainly not! He is an Arbitrator through and through, albeit a discharged one. It's just..." {n}The jailer's rebreather emits a shuddering wheeze.{/n} "He is so diligent in his work that us common people cannot keep up."

1323eeb8-d2f0-4cf1-8f9e-495c09f01f50.Text: "Thank you for your personal involvement! Long live the dynasty!"

c87528c9-9ac7-4895-acb3-212cacb6356e.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, Master Anthar reports that you have sacked him. The issue's resolved, then?"

22be021c-e817-487e-b934-d343c1aa95bc.Text: "And you have learned nothing, choosing instead to wallow in cowardice."

c801a89c-5cff-4c0f-bf46-04aec5df4cf1.Text: "Do you spend your days breaking your back under the Sun Wolf's scorching gaze? Do you sweat and bleed as he licks at your skin with his flaming tongue?" {n}The Space Marine's glare seems to have pinned the puny man where he stands.{/n} "No? Then tell me, what part of your duty do you deem unbearable?" {n}Ulfar lets out a heavy sigh.{/n} "Humans grow weak... Is it their blood thinning? I wonder..."

6ac73224-9197-40b5-99f9-56ea1779e296.Text: "Quite the opposite! We have never enjoyed such strict discipline. Except, people are dying a bit too quickly... On both sides of the bars, I mean... Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, there have been several attempts on Master Anthar's life. The hate has grown stronger than the fear! Take him away from here, I beg you. Please, take him away."

b2429bf9-733e-4441-bed4-b3006dd95efa.Text: {n}The spark of a will to live goes out of the man's eyes.{/n} "Will... do. Until service wears me down."

d063f1a9-0e5d-4880-86e3-39dbb4f68f4b.Text: "Will do! The high overseer will receive a report on the investigation and all resulting executions."

0b35fcd2-43cb-469f-8953-08de16e83336.Text: "Why are you not wearing a rebreather? The air here is noxious."

69973ef9-a6fe-4e28-a5ff-259af553b4b9.Text: "I was told you had been discharged. How did that happen?"

e40dbfd3-240e-49c4-8949-0c096cf8a48c.Text: "Come. I have already submitted a petition to have you reinstated."

2431208e-fa12-42f6-a172-3517ea1afa5d.Text: "Glaito has protected you from the convict. Is that not enough for you?"

3ab00bf5-b9ad-42d0-8967-89d01d899923.Text: "You are in pain, and you are hurting yourself even more to block it all out. Wounds need to be healed, not opened up further."

06e421e5-9317-4bbc-a4f4-02251a810dd7.Text: "Is this how Proctors end their journey? You can die on a penal world, or in the heat of battle against the most dangerous heretics of the Koronus Expanse. The choice is yours."

b2aa8f7a-31ee-4f11-b373-4cfea3a790f9.Text: "Vheabos VI is not your prison — it is your personal bunker. You are a coward, hiding from the trials bestowed upon you by the Emperor."

57ff6bbf-b386-4c27-93d6-e08b8d756573.Text: "Vheabos VI has become your twisted reflection. Others' torment is part of your own punishment. You have grown tired of violence, tired of carrying out executions."

083457d8-1676-4d89-9222-ab8c3ba89d95.Text: "I am impressed with the way you went all out on Vheabos VI. Perhaps you are destined to write a new Lex Koronus. But be warned: the Expanse responds to force, and force alone."

cccc6943-167c-4ad1-a471-f89ce725cebe.Text: "I managed to drag one of the Arbitrators to the infirmary. The man died of his wounds. Bottom line: the objective was not accomplished, ten Arbitrators were lost, and their commander was somehow left alive. Like a coward, I hoped to be executed, but the Marshal sent me to rot on Vheabos VI instead, and he was right to do so."

74bfc818-cfa4-4c2c-8136-2ac40b52d242.Text: "Now, only Vheabos VI will be witness to my judgement. Farewell, Rogue Trader."

2437e000-e9a3-4745-800c-2352b37f6753.Text: "I have judged myself and handed down the sentence. Not because of the demotion, though it was the last straw. I cannot do it anymore — I cannot look at the lying governors, the scoundrels who succumb to corruption..."

706ca88a-9a78-4666-896d-cf8b33dde829.Text: {n}Solomorne lowers his weapon at the last moment, facing his death without any hesitation. Glaito jerks reflexively toward his master and then freezes. The scarlet visors flicker, signalling a malfunction in the cyber-mastiff's implants.{/n}

457d96b4-0dbf-42d3-bffa-a01d8401f664.Text: "A pathetic attempt on my life. The second one today. One of the jailers left the cells unlocked so the prisoners could do their dirty work. No matter. I will find the culprits and execute each and every one of them."

f45e943b-0e70-4916-8fad-c23620f92fdf.Text: "I failed the mission. Failed everyone." {n}Solomorne clenches his teeth.{/n} "There were too many enemies. The situation was against us... No, I am not making excuses. It was not my first mission to go awry, but I didn't have Glaito with me. I was sloppy, unfocused. I ordered the retreat too late."

8eca0d21-818f-4ea4-b9e7-b500835c2c48.Text: "I don't have the right to keep him anymore." {n}He reaches his metal fingers toward the cyber-mastiff's head, but stops just short of touching it.{/n} "Deliver him to the Marshal. He'll find Glaito a new master."

6aeb2ca4-7faa-4f49-99e5-0ba6820505ba.Text: "He is not listening to me. Is this the aftermath of that damned mission on Thassera, or did the Tech-Priests have to reset him to basic protocols? Throne, what difference does it make? My dog! I can't even give him one last order! Why now, Glaito?"

63f6ce33-d9c2-4f87-af0a-2b42d0d63238.Text: "We used to act as one, but not anymore. The last remnants of my composure are gone. Look at me! I'm a human scrap, not an Arbitrator — just an appendage to a cyber-mastiff."

2fc36574-23a9-4a52-9ef4-bbae4d352000.Text: "Is this pity? How far I must have fallen in your eyes if it has come to this."

abe5384a-ae65-4eda-92a6-96307a6a3606.Text: "None of this is because of me. They all get what they deserve... but for some reason, I no longer feel satisfaction from carrying out my duties."

7fed6c27-14a6-4bff-9ec9-1897201ed08a.Text: "I'm too used to hating." {n}Solomorne rests his hand on the back of Glaito's neck for the first time since the two of you began talking.{/n} "I don't even know what life without hatred would look like. Not so lousy, perhaps."

1d16b33f-a600-4fdb-9d83-d929c563a8ca.Text: {n}Metal fingers close around Glaito's collar.{/n} "You have convinced me. To the void with Vheabos VI. My place is not here. I am ready to serve once more."

1b3ec4ad-d21f-4e07-b1a0-ec081bebafa5.Text: "Find me on the bridge when you have time. I wish to give a full report."

dbe197d7-1de5-491c-9638-8a1663725eb0.Text: "If a Lex Koronus is to be written, it will be written in the blood of the sector's inhabitants. I have already seen that it is the only language they understand."

401613a5-2979-4cf2-a376-9bd6be81cffd.Text: "You have a way of hitting a nerve. I'd say you are too good at it." {n}Solomorne looks sullenly at the courtyard, where yet another prisoner is about to meet his fate.{/n}

70ae423d-4c45-4fb2-b56a-9f7473f16290.Text: "I am not a Proctor anymore, and that should answer all of your questions."

4af1f6dd-c48e-41f5-8a7f-702d40506d62.Text: "I am not—" {n}Solomorne stops abruptly.{/n} "I hadn't thought about it that way."

df0f7479-c575-466b-97ed-87306f557537.Text: "A coward would have hidden under the Rogue Trader's cloak to avoid his rightful punishment."

ff9f44ef-618d-47f9-ae69-a65712ac11e6.Text: "I will serve on Vheabos VI until either the world itself or its inhabitants end my existence. Until that day, I will mould this prison into a paragon of Imperial order."

58b93b6c-ef01-43a8-a757-f61c55dfb3e1.Text: "I will head to the ship at once. If you need anything, you can find me at my usual post on the bridge."

0a715406-3c74-4be3-b296-2d5b8c44bd35.Text: {n}Solomorne turns sharply toward you. He is not wearing a rebreather, and fresh bandages peek out from under his uniform. The former Proctor roars, consumed with rage:{/n} "Who opened your cells? WHO DID IT? Speak, or your deaths will be—"

d19bf92e-a394-48d5-8f2d-8f8c306f3177.Text: "I am too used to Arbitrator helmets — they do not cover the lower part of the face. As for my well-being... Frankly, I couldn't care less."

f1326008-63cd-480d-86fe-dc14bcd225dd.Text: The wall, which was destroyed in the Drukhari attack, has been partially rebuilt. A bold hand has left an inconspicuous message: "It was better under the xenos."

4c351e81-76c5-479d-954e-e3bbc98a30ba.Text: There is something wriggling in the prisoner's rags — a rat, greedily gnawing the flesh off a still living man. Its emaciated victim only twitches a finger convulsively.

9ac6ed62-4bdc-448a-a711-0eea665b93dc.Text: "Eyes on the floor, scum! On the floor, I said!"

847140de-b575-4bb4-9826-2b127c30d0f1.Text: "You have violated Anthar's Edict, Amendment 6, Paragraph 8, Point 193, which states: 'Voicing displeasure over one's duty or punishment is prohibited.'"

6e14213b-6f85-41a7-a058-b4bb9c7d951e.Text: "The sentence is death. Indisputable. Carry it out!"

b85f10b8-2b12-4516-81dd-90c7bde8343a.Text: "No hard feelings, boss... I'm already a dead man. I've got worms writhing inside me."

ae19aa9e-72a3-4d07-8401-692399d70824.Text: "Groxshit! Don't you dare die out of order! If one is missing, everyone is punished!"

cf8a405c-a454-4b78-99fc-5e46021d7f88.Text: "I didn't... I didn't mean to... No more..."

622bf878-3916-449c-a7db-4c7ecf9a9254.Text: Heat waves emanate from the huge mining machine. Overheating could be the cause of the work stoppage.

166659b6-505b-4706-b8ba-6dc152847d4b.Text: The drill rig rumbles on, digging into the rock in search of valuable resources.

f8dacc1c-d12c-47b6-b1a1-bb390095af1d.Text: "Attention! Time limit for execution has been exceeded. Beginning of quote. 'Insufficient zeal in the execution of justice. Punishment: forty lashes at end of watch.' End of citation. Source: Anthar's Edict, Amendment 12, Paragraph 15, Point 79."

9ef2bdb9-be83-44ff-951f-c4ae1de4cbaf.Text: "As long as you're with me, Glaito, I can endure anything. And I don't need anyone else — no one."

d284a789-1f41-4078-8e18-d0b60522ea81.Text: "What the...? It doesn't matter — you're already dead!"

48be83c7-8f48-409d-9e96-f0d5bfe93160.Text: The ordinance, entitled "Anthar's Edict, Amendment 12," contains a minute-by-minute schedule of each prisoner's duties and a detailed system of punishments for them. At the bottom is a seal with the inscription: "Approved by the Colony Governor."

2b0ea3e9-4790-423c-85b4-82a2ba6c75e4.Text: "The eight-hour tech-liturgy to appease the wrath of the machine is sixty-five percent complete. Omnissiah grant the unit the strength not to stray out of sequence, or it will be necessary to reinitialise the process."

86ee5e89-928b-46b0-8ff1-67cbea44af04.Text: "How mush more of thish can we take? That newcomer bashtard killed Connag! Let'sh kill him, we'll shay the prishoners did it."

ed9bd6ca-d02b-4a46-938f-c5f5556e6e2c.Text: "Quiet! Don't you want to keep the teeth you've got left? If no one's killed him yet, you've got no chance. That newcomer's no ordinary bastard, he's an Arbites bastard."

7e856648-686d-42cd-b2eb-9f3cd3d1c0c6.Text: "Emperor presherve us! What kind of lawsh are theshe? You sho much ash fart and it'sh a death shentence."

3e14efb4-2c24-4cab-8711-6b38909aca02.Text: "Let's not put any more holes in our trophy than necessary. Master Helmsman, here are your orders: send a torpedo just below the upper deck and detonate in proximity to the target. A blast wave like that won't penetrate the hull, but it will paralyse the elevator systems and block the pirates' approach from the lower decks."

e4dff534-8626-40f5-a7ce-655bc93ad637.Text: "Fire on the section just beneath the entry point. We will collapse the elevator shafts between the compartments and leave the enemy without reinforcements."

ff0897c5-8a63-4a65-b21a-4ad2d0711c62.Text: "We need to clear out the boarding zone. Ravor, shake up their upper deck."

92ccfc77-bf11-4ec4-9846-995a2ea78243.Text: "Prepare to board. Solomorne, are your people ready?"

282281b8-2986-47e7-90a7-72c784cac3f4.Text: "Lord Cap'n, the boarding teams are raring to go! The Heartless's {g|Encyclopedia:GellerField}Geller field{/g} generator is cooked, so no warp-diving for them now, and we've set off fireworks in their primary drive, too. That rustbucket isn't going anywhere. We can begin the assault on the ship right away, but experience tells me this will go a lot smoother if we deliver just a couple more precise strikes. How about we flatten a few heretics between the bulkheads to make the fighting easier for you, Lord Cap'n?"

1a82b015-0722-4440-9319-9fae6c91ea70.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I must remind you that the Heartless has been promised to you as spoils — every new blow to the ship would also be a blow to the dynasty's treasury."

d0e795db-5916-40e9-a80f-ed8d9dc3671f.Text: {n}A stifled wheeze comes out of the vox.{/n} "I beg your pardon, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, but I fear I must go to my study, take something for my heart, and start putting together the repair budget. It... may take considerable time."

3e781054-9a18-47f9-b302-0c3859e15049.Text: "Ready and waiting. I will see you on the upper deck of the Heartless, Rogue Trader."

3302b3f8-4927-44f4-9919-89276fc560fa.Text: "Yes, Lord Cap'n!" {n}Your macro-cannons fire several salvos, blasting through the hull. Fires rage in the gaping wound, and currents of pressured air burst forth into the void.{/n}

427344cf-8e5d-40fb-a5c8-28ed926d75cc.Text: "Easily done, Lord Cap'n." {n}Your dorsal weapons leave a visible dent in the hull — anyone who was near the point of impact has likely been splattered.{/n}

2cbb7f5b-e4e1-4a89-987b-a218a179d53b.Text: "An excellent shot, Lord Captain, but what about the repairs, the costs? Perhaps you would be willing to take satisfaction in what you have already achieved?"

1377d4dd-cbaa-490b-940c-e47b90da0e01.Text: "Blast my gut, Lord Cap'n, I thought I knew every trick in the book! Well, there's no shame in bowing to {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Navy}your experience in the void{/d}. Launch torpedo!" {n}A precisely calculated explosion shakes the side of the Heartless — your plan has been executed flawlessly.{/n}

4ac2bd4d-21b2-4727-8e77-a217d6ed76c1.Text: "I need nothing from you, Sargona. I am coming to take everything myself."

406b22cb-9f8a-4511-bf9b-22f833a1ddeb.Text: "Give me a tactical report on the enemy."

c0529075-43ec-462a-b9d2-563ca0c91985.Text: "Tell Vigdis to patch me through to the captain of the Heartless."

15f99b8a-76f8-40f2-97be-d1ba8324046a.Text: "I will grant you a swift death if you lay down your weapons."

ef8795aa-d01e-4d63-9ef8-c94674641863.Text: "Brew me some recaf and wipe down the captain's throne after you vacate it — I will be there shortly."

ffa651c3-9402-46f7-a9e2-b4de29bf4de0.Text: "I will offer you a chance to lock yourself in the privy, because I am about to rattle your tin can from bow to stern. I've boarded more ships in my time than you've had hot meals."

d8c2deed-466e-4d39-9e61-912711c64dbe.Text: "Lord Cap'n, the augur crew has spotted a fleet dead ahead. The drive signature of the enemy flagship matches that of the Heartless. The escort ships are sticking to it like flies to groxshi— Anyway, what are your orders?"

5afa1d46-007b-4026-9b6d-405ba1afd64f.Text: {n}The vox lets out a theatrical yawn.{/n} "If your ship's weapons are as weak as your threats, then you are already dead. Well, let's not waste any more time, shall we? Show me what you are worth!"

cdc9618d-f1ab-4f27-b2e7-c82e1dd84d9e.Text: "The enemy frigate is heavily armoured and boasts a fighter launch bay — which for sure won't be empty. As long as the escorts are around to defend it, trying to board the vessel would be a death sentence. My advice is to take them out first, then attack the Heartless itself. Once the frigate is damaged, we can close in and board it."

656c9f4e-2212-4405-b07d-4fc20fb4bfcf.Text: {n}A silken, almost whispering voice fills the air.{/n} "Ah, the illustrious Rogue Trader has arrived at last. Let me guess: you will now graciously offer me one chance to surrender?"

4c1b0bbc-0b92-49fc-83f1-f65d15521163.Text: "Captain Sargona, your void-frozen remains will serve as a message to anyone who thinks they can lay their hands on the tithe and escape justice. In the name of the {g|Encyclopedia:LexImperialisGlossary}Lex Imperialis{/g}, prepare for execution, heretic."

ba1e9fc8-9f77-4d95-a855-d3dace914fd6.Text: "You can wave your Lex around in the Imperium, lawman, but this is the Expanse. The mighty pass the sentences here."

8de3cad2-6729-4118-97cd-8d2083f35289.Text: "What a generous proposal! I think my response will be..." {n}A low hum rises out of the vox.{/n} "Can you hear it? That's the Heartless's lance weapon. I invite you to parley with it."

5bc3e4bc-3126-4082-bece-b7bcb0f2e902.Text: {n}The vox produces rustling laughter.{/n} "We'll see if you are still feeling so insolent after my macro-cannons make a few holes in your ship."

284ef877-edd4-4e74-9bb4-ac821fcf9392.Text: "Well, look at the proper {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Navy}void wolf{/d} we have here!" {n}The pirate's brazen tone is tinged with irritation.{/n} "You think you can simply show up and ruin my day? I will be the ruin of you. Man the cannons!"

f1af40c0-4e49-4a19-a0a9-6d02c692d98c.Text: "Very well. I shall meet with them."

c0df56eb-6065-450c-837c-9a76382efe28.Text: "Ignore the message and stop bothering me with trivial matters."

cb91db5b-a473-4ea7-993d-790c84b74861.Text: "What business did Theodora conduct with the Adeptus Arbites?"

7c12eea3-2d43-4ae3-9168-bc7dad30f864.Text: "Follow your orders. I don't have time for this."

6746a90d-c033-42cf-9b74-2ad591449ffa.Text: "Lord Captain, we have received a transmission from the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusArbitesGlossary}Adeptus Arbites{/g} base of operations on Dargonus. Proctor Solomorne Anthar is invoking a pact made with Her Ladyship Theodora and asks for an audience. How are we to respond?"

5697d622-b6de-49fb-afd3-6b5544c30e8f.Text: "Lord Captain, we have received an urgent vox-recording from Footfall. Beginning playback..."

2552d398-f45b-4bbc-b35c-2174148b4198.Text: "Lord Captain, Lady Theodora valued her connections to the Adeptus Arbites greatly. I fear that if we deny the Proctor's request for an audience, there may not be another chance to build cooperation with them."

2b1e7e3b-4f3a-4645-9697-ee9b16542d3f.Text: "Unfortunately, Lady Theodora seldom shared any details of this sort with her crew, though I do know that she met with the Arbites frequently."

dd238f3d-3f00-4762-9db6-cbf1cc107d3f.Text: "I will send word to Chancellor Werserian about arranging a meeting with the Arbites delegation."

76da4d6d-b3e3-455f-9e5d-d4d6be848853.Text: "Rogue Trader, my name is Solomorne Anthar. You and I met on Rykad Minoris. I have something to discuss with you. I will be waiting at the Footfall docks."

50cf40eb-df8e-4224-8eba-7fc499b5ed30.Text: "I will send word to your master of ceremonies about arranging a meeting with the Arbites delegation."

21c0e396-634e-43d8-819c-a65983254c42.Text: "Lord Captain, we have received a vox-cast from Thassera. The signal quality is rather poor, but the meaning is clear: the world is expecting Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}'s arrival. Great festivities have been arranged, and a delegation led by the planetary governor is ready to give you a welcome worthy of an honoured guest."

3af4b844-5ff6-4261-b473-8da4df63543d.Text: "I am curious to hear about the Heartless's voyages."

eb0bc8dc-6b48-4e51-9c7e-e544b4a830f8.Text: "Lord Captain, we have established a vox-connection with the captain of the Heartless. He says the ship and her crew serve you faithfully while protecting the dynasty's trading vessels."

99f125ac-defe-4f87-b646-db55dd8775cd.Text: "The captain reports an unexpected find: while attempting to avoid a warp anomaly, the Heartless strayed from its intended course and chanced upon an unmarked planetoid. On its surface, a scouting party discovered the ruins of seemingly ancient Imperial fortifications, along with evidence of a large-scale battle. But, most importantly, they found a miraculously preserved weapon worthy of being part of Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}'s collection."

630c4cfe-f4fe-4568-bb37-45d16b2900a3.Text: "The captain reports that the Heartless once took aboard a group of pilgrims who had found themselves in an out-of-the-way starport with no means of leaving. After the faithful had been delivered to the nearest hive world, your servants discovered ammunition in the cabins they had been occupying. It seems likely that they were not devotees after all, but rather mercenaries, or even fugitives."

7264a954-fe11-422d-a88e-ed3b300066af.Text: "The captain reports that a xenos threat was recently eliminated on board. It is unknown what forgotten compartment the creature had crawled out of, but it started taking over people's bodies, and its gaze inflicted unbearable pain. Several brave voidsmen died trying to drive the abomination into the fuel chamber before it was finally incinerated and its ashes consigned to the void."

c706bec6-93f4-4dad-9c4d-716aabacba3e.Text: "The captain reports the destruction of a pirate ship — the heretics did not know that Sargona was no longer the master of the Heartless, and offered to buy captives. Your servants immediately delivered a sudden strike and dispatched the brigands. The captain is pleased to present to you a shuttle loaded with spoils."

ee0669f4-0af6-477f-b380-f6ef1af98d79.Text: "The captain of the Heartless offers his sincere greetings to Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} and assures us that the ship performs her duty with all due diligence — the trade route to which she is assigned is secure, and the crew has no incidents to report."

588c421d-b6cf-4498-9aa0-9dfe9bbf9894.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I am pleased to inform you that the {d|Encyclopedia:BS_Heartless}Heartless{/d} is fully repaired! Its hull has been considerably reinforced, and, after a complete cycle of tech-litanies, the fighter craft in its hangar now eagerly await the chance to show their worth in battle!"

098579f8-888e-4f51-8bf0-5af57f9ba269.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, the {d|Encyclopedia:BS_Heartless}Heartless{/d} is fully repaired and has been deployed to guard the dynasty's trade routes, as you ordered. Your elated subjects are praising the thoughtful care you take of the protectorate!"

fecd0507-a81d-4926-a228-afab2c732ff2.Text: "The sheer worthlessness of some of my subjects is staggering. Once again, I must handle everything myself."

93533504-da93-4c29-8f8b-f0bc2a5937cc.Text: "Any idea what has brought on this behaviour?"

8e473b2c-b6a0-471d-8a03-5d870ed200ba.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, there has been an incident in the wardroom. The esteemed Proctor Anthar's dog Glaito won't let officers into the room. At the esteemed Proctor's request, he was assigned a space to work there... but, my word, not the whole area!"

b6eff844-8f3f-46f1-a221-bb79e787b047.Text: "Some less than sagacious individuals tried to lead him out by the collar... poor fools. The medicae officers cannot get them out of there now while they are bleeding. The esteemed Proctor is nowhere to be found, so we must ask Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} to deal with the beast. Shooting the esteemed Proctor's dog is... something we would prefer to avoid doing."

f6156191-4d8d-436e-9421-991447374d05.Text: "Not the slightest, Lord Captain. Who knows what might be going through that killing machine's head?"

b377e657-2c69-490e-a048-178cf448cf8c.Text: "The duty officer reported seeing the esteemed Proctor heading off to the holds to carry out an inspection. I have already dispatched runners to find him, but until they do..."

04bcdc16-8916-46b9-897e-c2141659561b.Text: "Praise be to the Emperor, Lord Captain! I will be waiting for you in the wardroom."

a84839ad-aaad-4c09-a41e-2ac6c99da70d.Text: "I beg your most gracious forgiveness, Lord Captain! This is a... delicate situation, and we put all our hopes of resolving it in you! I will go to the wardroom post-haste and await your arrival."

23b8e4f2-7843-4f0a-a380-cd5165d0a72a.Text: "Rogue Trader, I request the privilege of a private audience with you. The purpose of the audience is to submit a report concerning my service in your retinue."

ff110fba-29f5-4d57-820c-42d41346da50.Text: "Do not worry, I will make good on my word."

a26bd4ef-292c-4e4a-8f62-99df61f4be8e.Text: "My plans are not for you to enquire about."

a8ee8e81-6672-4809-a46d-6a8a5f064f72.Text: "Rogue Trader, I must remind you about your agreement with the Adeptus Arbites. As important as your personal affairs doubtless are, upholding the Lex Imperialis is of no lower priority."

0cea2021-9107-4c6d-9147-e490bd4cc6e5.Text: "As you wish. It was my duty to warn you."

a567cde5-380e-46c2-a330-4bc14fe046c5.Text: "If you do not plan to maintain your alliance with the Arbites, I will have no choice but to leave your retinue." {n}Solomorne speaks every word with the same nonchalance he shows when emptying his shotgun into criminals.{/n} "Frankly, I would prefer to avoid that scenario."

945fb0d4-5f6b-41aa-9b06-ad1f8c1305f3.Text: "Thank you, Rogue Trader. I won't take up any more of your time."

23d6555d-7353-4cf3-9a10-ef80654d957c.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, the esteemed officers responsible for ensuring cleanliness and order on the bridge have instructed me to submit their humble request to you — to relieve the esteemed Solomorne Anthar of his post as a deck swab."

d4f2301c-9d9e-4747-adcf-b0933836e605.Text: "The esteemed Master Anthar has thrown himself into the struggle for deck sanitation with commendable zeal, but some of his methods are... terrifying the staff. He recently ordered two servants to use their tongues to lick at a spot that was unsatisfactorily cleaned. Literally, their tongues. And the servant who initially refused was given his excised tongue to use as a cleaning implement."

80553db8-dce0-4ba4-b801-1631415ed543.Text: "Master Anthar has the servants living in fear and regularly subjects them to torturous drills, mutilating them for minor infractions. Meanwhile, the officers... are afraid to associate with him. They humbly beg to be relieved of your magnanimous gift, of which they are unworthy."

2ef33355-3318-4247-97bb-6669ef033600.Text: "I am ready to descend to the surface."

dd35a0cd-538a-448c-abcb-b91a4e3c12ed.Text: "Send the Tech-Priests to determine the cause of the malfunction immediately."

46b79526-8e8a-48cb-bc5e-2208793bfd35.Text: "Lord Captain, we are now in Leethus's orbit. The ship has successfully exchanged access codes with the Adeptus Arbites outpost, but their landing pad is unavailable. The shuttle pilot is already calculating the closest possible landing point, awai... ti..."

afc7e85c-6568-43c9-bbb3-9cff1b98bcd4.Text: "The augurs are detecting foreign objects in the way — possibly cargo containers."

f4dc956c-9881-4bc2-8369-fbb9ec5ec524.Text: {n}The vox-cast is interrupted by a crackle that turns into a ragged ultrasonic hum. A moment later, the connection returns to normal.{/n}

2864948b-0546-4615-9f07-865d2e0d1775.Text: "There appears to have been an intrusion into the data stream, one that was executed using the dynasty's secret codes. I can only assume that we have encountered an additional security measure installed by Lady Theodora."

7814dfb8-b764-4dee-be11-aa72aae3b1c7.Text: "The investigation is already underway, Lord Captain. The incident did not affect the security of our vox-casts — it seemed more akin to reciprocal augur scanning."

92b523a0-0fc3-45f1-8ebb-ed87715d68ae.Text: "The shuttle is prepared. We are detecting no apparent dangers, but... something is clearly amiss on this planet. Please use caution, Lord Captain."

aaaaae5d-06c0-4e75-9272-73a0d36973b8.Text: "How did they know where we were?"

8ca4ba14-d5c8-4f1c-b6d7-160c7d829fde.Text: "Where are these traitors? I wish to interrogate them."

d2243658-8563-41ce-b7a6-afcff2c87fbb.Text: "Report received. We are moving out. Marshal Strachs must be told about what happened here."

0ba03292-9ed0-447e-9d70-49f9f259d5c3.Text: "Reporting: all enemy vessels destroyed. When will these upstarts get the message? You attack a Rogue Trader, you'll be floating in the void like a dead rat in a lower-decker's soup."

d67a76cc-8564-4a1f-9b9f-aebd602ca0af.Text: {n}The vox relays the sound of hearty spitting.{/n} "Traitors. Some of them had infiltrated the crew. A dozen voidsmen, a few officers — and, Throne, even one {g|Encyclopedia:AstropathGlossary}Astropath{/g}! That eyeless scumbag sent his mates the system's coordinates when we arrived. Their ships must have been patrolling this region in hopes of discovering Leethus."

387405da-ea60-4575-a63e-7baff409937d.Text: "The Master-at-Arms handled their interrogation personally, and she managed to break the most resistant ones. In short, we learned that they wanted to destroy part of the tithe and retreat. Strange behaviour for pirates, wouldn't you agree? The last one spat out a cryptic warning along with his entrails: 'By the time you get back to Dargonus, it will be too late.' I don't know what that means exactly."

6f7a28f6-2ddc-42b5-ab1c-7a46050d2196.Text: "Successfully translated into the warp and are now on their way to the designated coordinates, Lord Cap'n."

aaf315d0-7ca8-492c-9162-22d4959729b2.Text: "Well coordinated, well equipped, signatures encrypted... Those weren't some nameless void rabble — they were professionals. Mercenaries, Lord Cap'n."

7cd95f91-b0c4-4448-82bd-40e96088bc25.Text: "Lord Captain, we have just received an urgent message from Dargonus. Marshal Strachs requests that you come to the Administratum Palace for a discussion of the utmost importance. Alas, that is the extent of what we know — the message ends there."

9e96df3e-51b6-42a5-9b2e-83914ee8908e.Text: "Solomorne may execute him if he deems it necessary, and let that be the end of it."

f182e4f6-2135-49d7-a966-b925974eb72c.Text: "I will deal with this when time allows."

99d4c7a4-4b82-4339-b7f0-4cf55d33d957.Text: "Bring the detained man to me immediately. I will personally interrogate him."

db1d0b21-a31d-44f0-a2e4-77d0200d2fcd.Text: "Permission to report. Your Proctor has arrested my voidsman and is demanding his execution. A repeat offender, he says. Please do something, Lord Cap'n!"

a37047c7-1dfc-4b67-aa90-0225d22e4962.Text: "He's one of mine. Not as big of an idiot as the rest of the idlers. He understands the control systems, he can make sense of the readouts. Him — a repeat offender?"

df9164f1-fda1-4659-81bc-90177f2d1819.Text: "Well, you know where to find me."

3c661eab-8e40-4db3-ae17-c61aa94d2847.Text: "What? I mean, as you will, Lord Cap'n. There's a queue of good voidsmen waiting in every port. Well, you know best."

90e487d0-7dc2-4302-b4e6-691673f4f6b3.Text: "Why not just grant him access to the records?"

5325edf1-9346-4410-abcc-de25e0878bad.Text: "I will meet with both of you immediately."

364a7e42-e805-4828-9f9f-263975053b8b.Text: "Give the Proctor access to the archived messages. This does not warrant a separate meeting."

ddb3c9dd-f57b-4023-8c98-d4209fad85bd.Text: "I have other matters to attend to. We will discuss this another time."

9dbad355-f447-4306-a5c5-1d9b5287daf0.Text: "Lord Captain, I humbly request an audience with you. Proctor Anthar is interfering with the crew and is demanding to see all the archival records of fugitive criminals we have ever received from the Imperial Navy. The matter is urgent... if you please, Lord Captain."

e7db0734-dffb-4195-aac8-05200af28ba0.Text: "As you command, Lord Captain. I'll be waiting for you on the bridge."

d01d5ca9-7684-4ca1-8d90-bdc69e24c8e1.Text: "Yes, Lord Captain. I apologise for disturbing you."

1d89d4c8-d198-46e7-b509-2b9d20b2b402.Text: "Access to the ship's archives can only be authorised by the dynasty's heir."

e3f59418-d64b-4aad-a545-58fe58f31928.Text: "Rogue Trader, please accept my report in person — it concerns criminal collusion among the senior officers. They will also be present to be able to answer the charges."

08d4de39-ea31-4103-a05a-d3dbffbca092.Text: "I would prefer not to divulge details over vox — it could be overheard by those who will have to stand before you and answer for their actions."

8b29bf33-d2ab-435f-90a1-e3267caedf40.Text: "I am going to the Palace of Justice. I must find out what the matter is."

0f84867c-cfc6-476f-8d31-f362c431ff27.Text: "I could not ignore this if I wanted to... so let us find out what heresy is threatening my domain."

b6a0c03c-e819-40ff-8721-2414d348402a.Text: "You are right. Vigdis, prepare a shuttle for me and my retinue."

2683c03c-76fd-4d07-9ad4-e467150f2005.Text: "The tithe barges must be recovered at any cost. I will depart for the planet at once!"

10a512a5-ef55-453d-991e-6aa5bc62c6cd.Text: "Urgent report, Lord Captain! The barges carrying the tithe have been seized and are heading off in an unknown direction. Multiple sources are voxing the flagship at once. I detect the signatures of several noble houses and the Administratum."

1a50cec2-4b62-4ea5-8af7-631e0b7d8684.Text: {n}A dark chuckle reaches you through the vox-channel.{/n} "While you were away, something — or someone — decided your capital world was up for grabs? Oh well. Make sure this 'heresy' rues the day it was born."

f009066f-14af-49b0-ba19-f5a8e127c1b7.Text: "We are getting reports... of it being an order of the Adeptus Administratum. We have received several official forms to the effect that Dargonus's orbit is currently deemed unsafe for tithe storage due to an unspecified threat that has sprung up on the world in your absence."

660e6e4c-4cf1-4051-9d6b-ce6f62ee0a3c.Text: {n}The vox is silent for several minutes.{/n} "The messages have no discernible structure or cause. Professions of loyalty. Audience requests. Even pleas for leniency... One thing is clear, Lord Captain: something has agitated the upper echelons of the nobility. In other words... they are scared."

480fdf41-19e6-46f3-9421-2173253f2fa7.Text: "You are requested to come to the Palace of Justice in person. The prefect speaks of a terrible heresy that is threatening the von Valancius protectorate. While you were away, steps were taken to prevent the spread of the corruption; however, your presence is required to make the final decision. Prefect Vultur will meet you in person for a confidential conversation."

002c0ea2-e33d-4e32-a1cd-f8a662d08a60.Text: {n}The vox is silent for a while.{/n} "It appears you have no choice if you want to help your subjects. Although I don't like what is going on, I would advise you to go to the Palace — if nothing else, to find out what you can do to protect your people."

3631dab3-66b9-46a3-b94d-4c1ee7f5c891.Text: "It seems the law faltered on Dargonus as soon as its {mf|master|mistress} left it unattended. The disjointed reports from the ground sound strange, if not outright suspicious... but only you can put an end to any heresy on your own planet."

63a75a97-3896-4991-b621-a7d8ceec53d6.Text: The Lord Captain discovered that the cyber-mastiff was guarding Solomorne Anthar's disturbing musings, which he had not intended to share with others.

4995bf85-629e-4bb8-948c-2391a9250d32.Text: It has been reported to the Lord Captain that Proctor Anthar's dog Glaito is creating a disturbance in the officers' wardroom.

662d42fc-4d83-422e-b628-046fe4b663bb.Text: Janris Danrok reports that cyber-mastiff Glaito has been preventing officers from entering the wardroom, leading to a number of casualties. The High Factotum begs the Lord Captain to resolve the situation.

d3833afb-ea9b-49d6-ba23-12db5affdf58.Text: Deal with Glaito on the officers' deck

4ce74d56-01c5-481f-a2f7-4fa4d8debb14.Text: The data-slate that Glaito was guarding belongs to Solomorne. The information it contains warrants a private conversation with the Arbitrator.

bfeb1198-2ccf-43b6-b673-7eaa0d531b5b.Text: Talk to Solomorne on the ship's bridge

9bf2a995-0517-4b8d-bc87-702bd847fc04.Text: In the papers of the wrecked Arbitrator shuttle, the Rogue Trader found the coordinates of the cache where the disgraced crime syndicate tried to hide their riches from the law.

a2a22028-9ceb-4de4-b0cc-627c301317cb.Text: The Lord Captain must unlock the door in the bottom part of the bay. A device that will open the path should be nearby.

3c7f9a9d-6c7d-41fe-aa2d-27fe11a2fc4b.Text: Unblock the passage for the Arbitrators

8bf0eaf6-0f2d-4e75-bff1-8874ba11a7a1.Text: As the Lord Captain makes {rt_mf|his|her} way to the enemy bridge, it would be best to keep an eye on {rt_mf|his|her} allies' status and assist them whenever possible.

70ee8d44-7dff-48a5-9ab9-a7fb4f137efb.Text: Offer the Arbitrators any assistance you can

ed9a3811-ea12-4b7c-a618-8fc61e47b9cd.Text: The Rogue Trader has received an urgent vox-cast from the Adeptus Arbites. Proctor Anthar would like to discuss something important — in private.

3fde2d3a-c283-4998-883b-388c9838014e.Text: Solomorne will be waiting for the Rogue Trader in Dock Alpha-Rho.

48d00ea0-546f-4d13-a470-635c403c6541.Text: Meet with the Arbitrators on Footfall

6aafe6c9-5898-40ec-8b21-ae412f5e6702.Text: The Adeptus Arbites is requesting an audience on Dargonus. The Rogue Trader must order {rt_mf|his|her} representative at the palace to commence the meeting.

4d98fb6c-375e-4ce7-87cd-3a610926c336.Text: Meet with the Adeptus Arbites delegation on Dargonus

b8143ef1-87d5-4a2c-8b94-e414bcdee6fb.Text: According to the Arbitrators' data, Sargona's ship is hiding in the Mundus Nullius System.

af1354c4-19d3-4d34-9849-1d435d49c305.Text: Go to the Mundus Nullius System

b7473761-0cd1-433a-a2b2-73ae93816562.Text: The enemy flagship cannot be boarded until its systems have been sufficiently weakened.

ffc5414e-910f-4de4-ac68-bdfee79e0f06.Text: Taking the elevator is the only way to reach the bridge, where Captain Sargona is hiding from justice. It is also the rendezvous point for the boarding teams. The Arbitrators have taken the most dangerous stretch of the advance upon themselves, so they would appreciate any support the Rogue Trader is able to provide.

4f422b4f-fd5b-4dc6-85a9-0fde0acc81cd.Text: Solomorne's squad must fight their way to the turrets and destroy them.

684a5ef8-1328-4065-8c31-34ec8908e19c.Text: The captain of the Heartless is cornered. It is time to make him answer for his crimes.

082bae2f-11ac-49c6-9db4-cfda19976f59.Text: The Lord Captain must now return to the dynasty flagship and conduct a review of the operation.

5385292c-1250-40dd-b604-4e9597e9a0ec.Text: Master Helmsman Ravor would like to discuss the arrest of one of his voidsmen with the Rogue Trader. He will await the Lord Captain on the bridge.

cc6de76c-a544-4473-8605-a75ee32fd739.Text: Vigdis reports that Proctor Anthar has been sabotaging the flagship's crew. She is awaiting the Rogue Trader on the bridge.

7d710a3d-f2d9-45a9-802c-6847cec0c388.Text: Solomorne has uncovered a plot among the flagship's senior officers and is requesting an audience with the Rogue Trader.

0bf10e0d-1f91-4e66-9d3f-d95b05642151.Text: The Rogue Trader has discovered the coordinates of a place where Captain Sargona stashed away something of value. The cache is located in the Tenebris Aquae System.

f70f8c2e-f48c-47a2-a3f8-74634f70c08f.Text: The Marshal of the Adeptus Arbites is waiting for the Rogue Trader on Dargonus. It seems he has business with the von Valancius dynasty. To commence the audience, the Lord Captain should speak to Solomorne in the throne room at the palace on Dargonus.

658edaab-d3ff-443b-bdbf-dede5e1b797e.Text: The High Factotum reports that Solomorne has been demoted after failing an Adeptus Arbites mission. Bringing him back into the retinue will require the Rogue Trader to travel to Vheabos VI.

65409316-2ce8-4826-bcca-772e1544bb82.Text: Solomorne Anthar has asked the Lord Captain to receive his report.

21265240-0135-401b-9b11-65d172f1f4de.Text: The rabble's quarter is little more than a cesspit where corpses are dumped as animal feed. It is highly unlikely the Rogue Trader's precious body is there. It must be somewhere in the wealthy quarter, but there is no obvious way to get back to it.

c44d6e62-f494-483b-964f-a1e90e3a9edd.Text: The Rogue Trader has made it out of the malodorous rabble's quarter. Now, {rt_mf|he|she} must look around and recover {rt_mf|his|her} stolen body.

67f6b9f6-f652-4439-8bac-530c7c237b74.Text: The Rogue Trader must land on Thassera and meet the planet's governor.

bb4ce6fe-b183-4655-8e41-751563bd10ee.Text: The Proctor suggests starting the investigation at the square, where preparations for the execution are already well underway.

16b8e214-aa96-4ceb-848e-9145f49701cc.Text: Ruoldo will await the Rogue Trader by the feast table, amid all the food and amasec.

e49c564b-835d-46df-8344-7f460e3a77ac.Text: It is time to show the rabid beasts that they are the real prey here.

b880abbf-0954-4614-9dd1-c723a4d296c2.Text: The final impostor has been found. All that is left is to inform Ruoldo and bring the hunt to a close.

422a8203-b8cd-44e5-ad7f-05dc0dcf3dd6.Text: The first impostor has been found.

d69776d3-6390-40f1-bd0c-67b8b76971af.Text: The second impostor has been found.

0a5ff382-7aae-48f4-802b-8272d3773b87.Text: The third impostor has been found. The last one should be hiding somewhere in the vicinity.

ff0cd762-9f68-46be-944d-6dba0b47f946.Text: The objective of the Impostor Hunt is to identify four disguised servants and then mark them using the data-brand. According to the lady-in-waiting Maive, impostors are often found hiding among groups of nobles. The game will end as soon as the Rogue Trader tells the governor that {rt_mf|he|she} wishes to proceed to the final stage.

6a3674d3-af9e-499e-9660-f6f68705cb1f.Text: Maive has survived. She might be able to shed some light on the madness taking place here.

e6c21f43-b399-4180-8017-06e47ffa870f.Text: Find out what is going on

abe41505-6dfd-4cc4-b4ce-286b00ae770b.Text: The Rogue Trader has been cast outside the castle walls and must find {rt_mf|his|her} way back in.

c93f0d0f-4cba-4f89-8a24-1cbdd71f7fa5.Text: The Rogue Trader has made it out of the slums. Time to look for {rt_mf|his|her} body. The tower where it all happened may be a good place to start.

87d1e752-9063-4940-bd83-eb7206c9451d.Text: The Rogue Trader has found {rt_mf|himself|herself} in Maive's body. {rt_mf|He|She} must find {rt_mf|his|her} way out of the slums and look for {rt_mf|his|her} real body.

6f14152e-3a15-4dbe-b790-49741734f943.Text: The governor has enlisted the aid of the Ruinous Powers. He and his minions must be defeated.

49aa9a1b-c8f6-406b-8e9d-904c8ea0c3d6.Text: The Rogue Trader and the Arbitrator must pass a final verdict on the planet and its inhabitants.

68db283d-e0c6-4d43-babb-3f869322c831.Text: The prefect will await the Rogue Trader at the Administratum Palace on Dargonus.

7e01020f-b32d-4b2c-a251-df5877993c67.Text: Inform the prefect of the "inspection" outcome

6096eae0-b270-4af8-acc9-6eac29f68e2d.Text: The Adeptus Administratum has noticed certain oddities in the recent tithe shipments from the feudal world of Thassera. The Rogue Trader and the Arbitrator must inspect the planet.

0eacc789-2057-4e06-ba65-071f0344b6b8.Text: The Arbitrator seems troubled — it may be best to clear things up with him before landing on Leethus.

f3c0d2cd-b57e-4718-b10e-c168415dc8c0.Text: The Rogue Trader must seize control of the tank to cut off the rebels' reinforcements.

6e3405b0-d842-46e0-9908-a3a1e3db89cd.Text: Tertius Quart has led the Rogue Trader into a trap. Go back and find out where he truly keeps the tithe inventory.

c8a0842d-d8ad-4149-a93f-ddb880b6179e.Text: The Rogue Trader has received an invitation from Marshal Strachs asking {mf|him|her} to visit the Administratum Palace of Dargonus at the earliest opportunity.

a4732ca8-f324-47c6-ad3e-2be5e031bdd6.Text: To secure the tithe collected from the entire Koronus Expanse, the Rogue Trader must go to Leethus, a hidden world bursting with unimaginable wealth.

14d14070-137f-4a7e-8310-ab2fd810b567.Text: Leethus greeted the Rogue Trader with a twisting maze of containers. Now, to find the way to the Adeptus Arbites outpost.

c0095f4b-bf95-47a7-a4b2-3c8ae5d48fb0.Text: The inventory must be delivered to Proctor Yeager at the outpost.

e134d82b-9974-43d2-aeee-59e682fee027.Text: The tithe cannot be extracted without a detailed inventory. This document is held by the clerk Tertius Quart, who should be somewhere in the near vicinity of the outpost.

e0da3980-902e-40dc-a80e-e7b75b966717.Text: A mysterious vox-message has summoned the Rogue Trader to an orbital station over Leethus.

8ca466cf-51c4-40af-8eff-a281730f6238.Text: Talk to the watcher of Leethus

75b2dc98-8bce-44e5-8ec3-1cb4520d5aa3.Text: Unidentified vessels are trying to intercept the barges carrying the tithe. The attackers must be stopped.

6ba3ed65-9b5c-401f-9bd0-c7caf2d74b28.Text: The fate of the tithe has been determined; however, someone attempted to disrupt its transportation. This must be reported to Marshal Strachs.

c011937c-ca72-4e14-881d-cf762b5c333c.Text: It is time for the Rogue Trader to visit the Palace of Justice on Dargonus and settle the matter of the Expanse's tithe once and for all.

fcc7c392-e13c-439d-86c8-6dc786102470.Text: Prefect Vultur and Marshal Strachs entreat the Rogue Trader once more — but this time, it concerns the most closely guarded secret of the Koronus Expanse.

0eefa322-d477-49c6-85c4-087b0f80e9f6.Text: Judging by its half-melted state, the former owner of this helmet feared neither fire nor death.

7d86f029-b63a-43a5-aff8-543d803134af.Text: This cloak made of expensive fabric is adorned with purity seals bearing prayers of salvation for the righteous.

3c8cb109-a907-41fd-82ac-6b0b6d7dcebe.Text: "A good spot for a defensive position. Let's hunker down and throw these amateurs out."

d7760b87-8ce0-4c01-a472-1217dc37c0d8.Text: "Refrain from loitering on this station. There is a lot of rabble about."

99f7114b-bb6c-477f-b658-768559ba6069.Text: "The Lex Imperialis is stern and unyielding."

0ded5b4c-4d52-4102-b4f1-5ec30046f969.Text: "I'm not much of a talker. Speak to Proctor Anthar instead."

85459a9c-f703-41aa-9653-2a852fab3092.Text: "My wounds will not stop me from taking a few more heretics down with me."

a2ee24e1-4671-45fa-b499-494079168ec4.Text: "The heretics are well armed, but it will not save them."

566f87bb-4c6a-4fe2-8693-7fce55358718.Text: "The perimeter is secure. The next step is to test the staff for loyalty."

88c5950e-341c-49e1-bc6d-23ab5a7d68a5.Text: "I hope one of the locals is dumb enough to try and steal from Bryce. It's been a while since we shot anyone."

30950f42-1b2d-4bbf-81ab-17735e90bff9.Text: "My duty is to serve the Lex Imperialis!"

15bec905-c40d-49ae-8193-c44f2171a496.Text: "Arbitrator Clayton reporting. The area is secure."

d52d654e-f4ab-4221-bf4d-121ae332c29d.Text: "Rogue Trader, I am occupied with the investigation at present. Solomorne Anthar will speak on our squad's behalf."

44965d9e-c4c3-4441-8455-db646f573576.Text: "None of this would have happened had we been allowed to investigate the locals."

a7984238-384a-4fdd-a2c5-cad30e7c215a.Text: "Wardens! Dispose of the bodies. Do not look at the amulets or insignia. Looters will be executed on the spot."

d9b10105-cc7a-4559-afc8-c840b3e522e3.Text: "What this place needs is an Arbites precinct fortress and a weekly round of purges."

65bd1cda-e800-4f64-8765-6aa84edc22f9.Text: "Some say that upholding the Lex is hard. I am always willing to make life easier for the weak-willed. It takes but one swing of my maul."

15d9ee7f-08ef-485b-b621-79ebf4e8d900.Text: "Status: on high alert. Ready to fire on command."

50f06ebd-ea45-4bda-bc9a-7f4286fe6bd9.Text: "All parts of an Arbitrator's duty are equally important. But much like Solomorne, I prefer action."

31c69e36-36cb-433b-b8a2-a8901dbb184b.Text: "Saints' blood! They put a few extra holes in me... but I put a dozen holes in them!"

7d58a333-c98c-401a-9604-3abea060cd04.Text: "During the last sweep, Clayton put down eight and Bryce put down eleven. They are falling behind."

add9066f-c4f8-4cc0-9386-4df400240791.Text: "The Adeptus Arbites is assuming command of this area."

fe6b5da6-b49d-4e1f-a49c-16fb2fd710a6.Text: "Now is hardly the time for talk — each moment lost could cost us valuable evidence."
