1f01f4f8-cf16-49c6-a32c-27a5c259cecf.Text: "I hope you and your retinue can take care of yourselves. All the Arbitrators are busy quelling the riot. We will not be able to support you."

2a2a0fe9-7f4c-4224-b976-0fbe8665f64c.Text: "This bunker is under the control of the Arbites. I cannot provide you with amenities, but I guarantee security within the perimeter."

1748b0df-261f-4a26-9d4a-ec05aaaf7374.Text: "I want you and your unit to escort me to the governor."

4f8fe275-1eb8-401b-86d9-7151c64253ac.Text: {n}A man in Adeptus Arbites armour raises the visor on his helmet and regards you with a harsh look.{/n} "Thank you for your cooperation. Proctor Garren. Now, state your name and the purpose of your stay on Rykad Minoris."

327c32bd-eb5d-418a-b747-46f53fcfa33c.Text: "Conducting an investigation, Rogue Trader, and removing any obstructions to the law along the way. I cannot share any details — this matter concerns the Adeptus Arbites only."

f21e300c-8105-465d-a820-c71654680c12.Text: "This world is in the throes of rebellion and madness. Whatever the cause may be, we will not risk the success of our mission to address it. But if the governor does not re-establish a semblance of control by the time we are done, we will see to it ourselves."

549c9f63-3fe5-4147-adb7-4b1b8fcd869f.Text: "We must keep moving. But first, allow me to thank you for your aid in battle." {n}The man offers you a heavy shotgun.{/n} "This belonged to one of our veterans. He fell on these streets. May his weapon now serve you."

570fe008-ad28-4bfc-a23f-80787ed1742b.Text: "Abelard, what makes this man think he can demand anything of me?"

97d3ae95-5656-4e27-a8d7-e8254a8ebd84.Text: "I am {name} von Valancius, successor to the recently deceased Theodora von Valancius. I have come to this world on personal business."

f30879db-04ce-4248-8cee-9cd564131944.Text: "You are speaking to a Rogue Trader, and that is all the information you are entitled to at this moment. I will be asking the questions from now on."

5e2f38d1-b666-4e2c-aa4d-44a6c5144aef.Text: "What are you and your people doing here?"

afa71459-69ee-4b0b-848f-c8ec731149ce.Text: "What do you know about the situation on the planet?"

a72dd9ff-b218-4d58-b38c-45d8e241b198.Text: "What do you intend to do next?"

905fdb99-326b-42bb-b915-3b5e98a48a0b.Text: "I am on my way to see the governor myself. You and your unit could accompany me."

d7dc27d5-e3c8-4053-b63a-b3c146a8e16c.Text: "Are you not supposed to help the governor regain control over this world? I thought that maintaining order was the foremost duty of any Arbitrator."

ea60d64b-5825-4aab-a681-e412bc5fa816.Text: [Nod at the cyber-mastiff] "That is one fearsome-looking dog. I was impressed by its performance in battle."

8ad92dad-b092-4786-9df0-e17ab1240e43.Text: "Proctor Anthar? Since I do not recall seeing you among my subordinates, I must assume that we served in different parts of Calixis. I am {name} von Valancius. I took on Lady Theodora's title after her recent death."

364a47dd-3a97-4f07-a6d4-4f6b7890a7fd.Text: "Do not stand in my way. Who I am is no concern of yours."

451a59c0-6912-436f-ad7e-d3e5f05b8786.Text: "That you did not know I was a Rogue Trader is irrelevant. Apologise, now."

8c61e488-2fdc-4c11-a76a-7924bc32213b.Text: "Cool it, lawman, and show some respect — the name is Rogue Trader {name} von Valancius, and as far as you're concerned, I am untouchable. Do we understand each other?"

abc9a3c7-fcfb-4b3d-8210-42bca5123669.Text: {n}A powerfully built man among the fighters quickly surveys the battlefield. His face, determined and impassive, recalls those seen on statues of heroes of the Imperium. His gaze remains trained on you as he raises an iron fist:{/n} "Arbitrators, secure perimeter, formation 47-55. Glaito, heel."

91ca152a-77cf-40ec-bfbd-2ec7e2b08f5e.Text: "Proctor-Exactant Solomorne Anthar of the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusArbitesGlossary}Adeptus Arbites{/g}. State your name and the purpose of your stay on Rykad Minoris." {n}His voice is calm and even, yet his finger remains firmly positioned on the trigger of his weapon.{/n}

e21394e4-384b-4f7c-a992-a691773a1de2.Text: "A Rogue Trader? Incendia Chorda has no heirs, and I know all of Calligos Winterscale's potential successors by name."

9a552559-648e-4add-b8b9-efe9f6f37a7f.Text: "His being a member of the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusArbitesGlossary}Adeptus Arbites{/g}, I presume. One might say such a tone is... an attribute of their occupation, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}." {n}Abelard furrows his brows.{/n} "Proctor, before you stands Rogue Trader {name} von Valancius, the Emperor's anointed and bearer of the sacred Warrant. As for {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship}'s business on this planet, I'm afraid you do not have the authority to demand an answer. I would ask that you treat the Lord Captain with the same respect that you gave Lady Theodora... the late Lady Theodora."

617d9bd8-dcb9-4906-900c-d7d4642b061e.Text: "So, Theodora von Valancius is dead. I will deliver this tragic news to Marshal Strachs."

4ce1a45f-7569-4808-8456-508016a2e6b8.Text: "Removing obstructions to an official enquiry," {n}the Proctor says without a hint of irony in his expression.{/n} "My unit and I came here to investigate the disappearance of one particularly valuable ship, but the mutinous scum got in the way. Now, we are having to deal with them too."

c1444632-c737-4cea-99ca-7d2dacc64193.Text: "Only that the governor is failing in his responsibilities." {n}The Proctor's voice is dry, matter-of-fact.{/n} "This is a planet-wide rebellion, and it reeks of madness — or worse: of witchcraft. The rebels are blinding both themselves and others, and their ravings are the most insane and unholy thing I've ever heard."

0d7546c9-7d8b-48e5-8632-f375c1ddaae9.Text: "It's 'about' a tithe ship," {n}he says forcefully.{/n} "A vessel loaded to the brim with planetary tithes — amassed over a considerable period — suddenly went dark as soon as it departed Rykad Minoris."

d71f12d9-4592-4078-be15-825dcefeec11.Text: "Fight our way to the local Administratum palace and ascertain whether a fire, or some other disaster, hasn't destroyed the documents related to the investigation — I hope the clerks were smart enough to put the records before their lives. If the Emperor favours us, we will extract the data we need or else interrogate the survivors before we pay our visit to the governor — the questions we have for him are beginning to pile up."

a7b4ac62-4e50-47a2-9630-d547104a9f98.Text: "I must refuse. Our mission and the Marshal's orders take priority, even over a request from an individual as empowered as you."

cc3bb4e2-e3ae-457d-99a7-8b16a77339ab.Text: {n}The cyber-mastiff lets out a low growl and leans forward somewhere to the side. Solomorne fires a shot in the same direction without even looking. You hear a stifled, gurgling rattle.{/n}

50e919be-19f5-4c45-88c0-452e4d2b9d41.Text: "Arbitrators, eliminate the surviving rebels." {n}He immediately ejects the smoking casing from the chamber and reloads his weapon, ready for combat once more.{/n} "Now is not the best time for conversations. We're target practice, standing around like this. Unless you have more questions, I will proceed with my assignment."

7b6518a1-8661-42b6-b500-44fee26be5cf.Text: "Every citizen of this planet is a suspect, but Governor Medineh is under particular scrutiny. Seizing the sacred tithe requires access to information, resources, and power. The governor fits that profile."

a345e725-f02e-4dd2-9cdf-0f1310741854.Text: "Then, there's this rebellion. Convenient. How many records and crucial witnesses do you think will be lost? Some people call it 'cover-up.' I do not like how aptly this term describes the present situation."

5f7b594c-9651-48d2-b020-ec966153437a.Text: "May the Emperor watch over us — that way, this meeting won't be our last."

8a37516d-ce8e-43d1-ab93-b307223b03eb.Text: {n}Solomorne thumps himself on the chest and humbly says:{/n} "I ask your forgiveness and request that you do not base your opinion of the Arbitrators on my conduct."

28bb4ca2-fd94-4f7c-9895-dcd82cddb5f6.Text: {n}For a moment, the Proctor's expression changes, as if he had been kicked in the chest.{/n} "Unless the Emperor has taken my sanity, Lady Theodora is dead, and her heir is... It does not matter {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Criminal}who you were before{/d} — I will conduct myself appropriately when dealing with the bearer of the sacred Warrant as is expected of any Arbitrator, including Marshal Strachs."

45e5c29d-da18-4138-9bae-5dd15b9027b1.Text: {n}The huge cyber-mastiff immediately stops snarling in your direction and goes quiet at its master's foot, its stillness punctuated only by the thick globules of blood dripping from its metal fangs.{/n}

372d9ba4-ac21-4b5f-b3f1-fec360ceadf3.Text: "Resources that every world is under obligation to relinquish for the good of the Imperium. In the case of Rykad Minoris, they include the ceramite and explosive reagents produced on Rykadi Philia, armaglass, medical supplies, and Guardsmen — a living tithe to be recruited into the regiments of the Astra Militarum. Cargo like that is particularly dangerous in the hands of heretics as it can be easily converted into wealth or used for military purposes."

b7310498-4b97-45fb-860c-26f740ca0b9c.Text: "Not every uprising demands action by the Adeptus Arbites. For now, I am simply assessing the situation, and if our investigation requires that the rebellion be crushed, then we will intervene. Still, the governor had best put a stop to this bedlam. He is not here to just sit and look pretty."

b1bfc143-2337-4680-8e98-6312e72f8d4e.Text: "That skirmish just now? Glaito didn't even get to show off a tenth of what he is capable of." {n}Solomorne ruffles the dog's neck.{/n} "But he is quickly catching up with me for who's killed the most heretics today."

7a04e00b-9d56-4d69-b170-68226fbb970f.Text: "So then, the new head of the dynasty is someone {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Arbitrator}who has spent most of {mf|his|her} life{/d} serving the Lex Imperialis. I suppose it is better to receive both good and bad news than just bad. I will be sure to report both of these developments to Marshal Strachs."

0752ca51-2c40-4db6-bcfb-154dfe353469.Text: "Words won't make me stand aside. Unless, of course, you answer my question."

9b0f4c75-86d9-4ae1-9005-66d1e12f356b.Text: {n}The Arbitrator bows his head.{/n} "I honour the pact your predecessor made with the Adeptus Arbites. I won't keep you any longer."

75cb13b5-f7d6-45c3-89f0-31552a1d359c.Text: "Those wounds look bad. Let me offer you first aid."

3e1cb836-08e1-4d8d-9c51-3e8c09caf7a9.Text: "It has been a pleasure to make your acquaintance. Do try to survive, will you?"

8cc2884a-64de-4076-b7b1-a64352968709.Text: "I sincerely hope that you die out here."

96d119df-6fe8-4d63-ad05-5f643f45f4a7.Text: "I see you are not trying to flee and have chosen to fight instead. I commend your resolve."

cee947f0-aa2f-49ed-b7ff-5ff7ac342d64.Text: "Rykad Minoris is doomed. There is no time for heroics. We need to leave!"

5832e7e1-da42-4f87-a62b-0d354ce529b0.Text: "Very well. You and your people may come with me."

7cf26423-1bcf-44dd-9d15-ca3d290f82bc.Text: "I will consider it an honour to assist you."

d1215ede-2528-46c3-883f-41befe1d3c02.Text: "You, your Marshal, and the rest of you Arbitrators can all go to the warp. I have no intention of forming an alliance with you, and I do not care what happens to you or your mission."

ece9f32c-06a5-4b81-a0a6-40a00a12b567.Text: "It appears your investigation has hit a dead end."

ce5b406f-62c4-48a8-9ce4-4cfe2c7d51b8.Text: "I could use a personal lawman at my beck and call — especially one who is in my debt."

149435cf-64ce-407b-863a-5d685ee88120.Text: "I won't wish you luck — with a dog like that, you clearly do not need it."

22d9bdda-246a-4f0d-bd00-4173dd21bde7.Text: {n}Solomorne's chestplate is punctured in multiple places and his face stained with blood, but his gaze remains clear and firm.{/n} "Still alive, Rogue Trader? Good."

11401536-afc2-46a6-b84a-fb6e9e4f711c.Text: {n}You spot just as many wounds on Glaito: there are burns and cuts all over the coat, and one of the visors is broken. And yet, there is nothing in the cyber-mastiff's straight posture that would indicate pain — if pain is even something this dog can feel.{/n}

ba6d1743-2c5c-4efd-94ed-0d4e84dceefb.Text: "Panic and heresy. The people are ready to crush each other to reach the shuttles, which makes them easy targets for the enemy."

dc562546-d324-49e1-af77-c0772fa62238.Text: "To die would be to fail my mission, and I cannot let that happen. Emperor protect you, Rogue Trader."

ac4538db-77fc-496d-b3a5-435a2741df89.Text: "I do not know. He waited for you — under Arbites escort — to burn the heretic's body and conclude the ceremony. But when the sun went out and enemies came at us from every crack in the rockcrete, he panicked and ran. Not the smartest choice — he would have been safer with us."

dfeb7e42-5785-4375-84ae-fe0daeedef79.Text: "Keep hoping," {n}Solomorne responds calmly, as if commenting on the weather, then turns away.{/n}

cffc1216-15ba-4792-9a25-91fb7c7962f9.Text: "Actually, our plan is to retreat. The rebels are one thing, but there is nothing we can do against the warp forcing its way in, and that's a fact." {n}Solomorne spits out a mouthful of blood.{/n} "This battle was forced on us — we had to keep the heretics away from the terminal until the machine spirits finished transferring the data to our shuttle."

4adad8bb-f765-40ee-9139-957281e703fa.Text: "Speaking of shuttles, the ship we hired has turned tail and left orbit, so I must turn to you with a request: take my squad aboard, and we will disembark on the first world or station with access to a voidship. We cannot die here while whoever stole the tithe is enjoying their freedom."

98f3553b-892a-46a3-b391-02d2d518823f.Text: "Emperor knows I am no orator, so I will ask you again, as well as I can. I need your help, not to save myself, but so that I may continue serving the Lex Imperialis. The Marshal must receive the information I have obtained here. If you want me to beg, I will — my pride means nothing compared to my duty."

9661e3db-f79a-44e4-aa59-571743cf5079.Text: {n}A vein pulses violently on the Proctor's temple, but his voice is calm:{/n} "You have my thanks, Rogue Trader. You should press forward — we won't keep you waiting."

a0cc97a0-aabd-4302-b77b-018da394e2da.Text: "We need time to dress our wounds and regroup. We will cover your retreat and make sure there is no attack from the rear. Get to the shuttle first; we'll be right behind you."

fc5e1a6c-774d-421f-b7d4-c2340c4a4f93.Text: {n}The man rests his bloodied hand on the cyber-mastiff's shoulders.{/n} "We always knew it would end like this, didn't we, Glaito?" {n}Solomorne turns away as if you had ceased to exist.{/n}

d4007e59-5f91-4ea9-90c2-1ada1f860da5.Text: "Not yet, it hasn't." {n}A crooked smile crosses his face.{/n} "We did find something on the port terminal... Shortly after the tithe was hauled away, a suspicious ship took off from the planet. And I already know how to track it down."

f8566979-a48a-48ca-8ee7-94871a85d198.Text: "My squad and I will dress our wounds, regroup, then try to break through to our shuttle. I recommend you do that last part as well, and soon."

8202795e-ea18-4514-b22e-13c51b31386f.Text: "You helped us to fight them off, so, instead of words of gratitude, let me offer you something more substantial." {n}Solomorne hands you a heavy shotgun.{/n} "It belonged to a bloody good Arbitrator. May it serve you now."

1f54111c-3400-4a5a-8725-a85b764b64e7.Text: "I would have accepted your offer, but we still have medicae kits. Not many, but it should last us until we get to the shuttles — which is all we need."

acba505f-8c00-46bd-b8b0-009e90edf7a5.Text: "I agree. In that case, you may add my luck to your own so you can get out of here."

a1018d67-8215-4d15-a18d-61a417e21e57.Text: Glad to be of help to you and your cyber-assistant!

b19efe96-6aab-4e38-a148-73683a0a7379.Text: All protocols calibrated and ready to operate, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}.

3b96af3f-49a7-4e0c-8d36-24f4fcb2f702.Text: Are you looking to treat your cyber-beast to something special?

db1fd9d6-1d01-47f0-8a7f-eb1bb7521f0e.Text: "Inscribia? Who would give their child a name like that?"

39f3d3c7-4c5e-4751-a084-6366d6339ca1.Text: "I recently assisted the Adeptus Arbites in dealing with a heretic who had stolen a tithe shipment."

1aadfb24-7d79-4c22-888e-b7bcab348df5.Text: "I hope I can expect a proper reward for my assistance."

d52d8a86-a399-424a-b99d-fb4d8f264009.Text: "Prefect, I recall seeing your face somewhere... Didn't I kill you at the Administratum Palace?"

0a3d42aa-92c1-4839-b94d-2818c15ea960.Text: "And what is to stop me from 'discharging' you again?"

4cb9d4fb-8945-466e-b2f5-e29a21607d1b.Text: [Get comfortable and listen to the end]

2f0f2a9f-ae97-4b1c-a658-655cc3c8a8ea.Text: "Abelard! What are these people doing in my demesne?"

39730c10-2384-4cb9-8e84-2036cc8497ca.Text: "I do not recall seeing you at court. What is the purpose of your visit?"

0e674c2e-1b3f-4863-ae52-de01479b3f81.Text: "Let's get to the point, shall we? What do you two want from me?"

f0697f8a-0886-40f1-86da-74c728c05ea3.Text: "Are you implying that I have an obligation to help you?"

aed686fa-d0f2-42b6-bc81-6d222cbc5d74.Text: "And which world was it that had the misfortune of drawing your attention?"

624fae7f-1cd9-4772-9218-3ebb44595e11.Text: "If one of my governors has missed a tithe payment, I will simply have them hanged and the debt collected."

73157ed9-a05b-471b-bd36-389315b395db.Text: "I will carry forth the responsibilities taken on by Lady Theodora. I offer you my help."

f6c99f44-496e-4d30-bd0d-7c5038c18a30.Text: "These are your problems, not mine. I am turning down your request."

084fb1ac-1663-42b9-a4fd-28def046a487.Text: "Hmm... So be it. Let us not end this arrangement just yet. I will help you."

869418a0-53ef-44dd-bd2e-a11cdc277cea.Text: "My word is final. You are dismissed."

2aa176dc-54d9-4068-a50d-a27ab842fbe8.Text: "I have enough fighters in my retinue already. Why would I want an Administratum spy?"

dcc1c8dc-bd56-4908-8c8c-0735dee1bede.Text: "Thank you for your support. I will go to Thassera as soon as I can."

79531d41-523a-400d-80f1-d6c7b1d076f7.Text: "Fine, I will try not to lose your dog handler."

8efb88ce-202e-4178-ab7f-56f5f160053b.Text: "Prefect, Master of Seals... Is that not too many titles for one official?"

77a86cf3-aa91-486e-8483-a67cb05e3232.Text: [Interrupt the old woman with the longest ceremonial greeting you can dredge up from your memory]

53b895aa-4a8e-4aff-88e7-6f049f79f54f.Text: {n}Two markedly distinct figures approach your throne. Marching in front is a man clad in {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusArbitesGlossary}Adeptus Arbites{/g} armour. He carries his helmet in the crook of his arm, but his stern facade serves him as well as any visor could. He bows to you sharply.{/n} "Marshal Strachs of the Adeptus Arbites."

221ec435-e194-4f4c-8fee-6ca090512bd5.Text: {n}A dry shadow follows after the Marshal — an old woman, familiar to you and likely to generations of clerks at the Administratum Palace. The ampleness of her robes gives the illusion that the Master of Seals is hovering rather than walking.{/n}

770eec08-6f7f-4403-9567-82a7e1cbd95b.Text: {n}An old woman walks in the Marshal's shadow, her body fitted with dozens of scribing implants and magnifying instruments. If not for her eyes, quick and inquisitive behind a giant pair of ocular lenses, you might have mistaken her for an exotic servitor. Her robes are adorned with sacred symbols of the Adeptus Administratum.{/n}

53752301-9bba-4eb2-964d-90d66278210f.Text: {n}The woman bows.{/n} "Rogue Trader {name} von Valancius! I, Prefect Inscribia Vultur, greet you on behalf of the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusAdministratumGlossary}Adeptus Administratum{/g}. I will now begin the due procedure of official address to the ruler of Dargonus as formalised by Amendment 4-N/10 to Law SK-941. May your name be wreathed in glory for centuries to come; may your fortunes ever proliferate; may the God-Emperor bestow upon you a duty worthy of His chosen..." {n}Her monotonous droning is making you weary. It seems she intends to go on for a good while longer.{/n}

fa5e06a1-d9b7-427c-b7d3-fd984b781828.Text: {n}The old woman steps forward and reveals a crude metal patch covering a gruesome wound.{/n} "Decree 1457, Clause 92, Amendment 8 states that the Rogue Trader has the right to discharge their subjects by any means available. Assistance was provided afterward, and I am now fit for service once more, as you may observe. The data in my cerebral storage was too valuable to let it go to waste."

b0589b14-a0c2-49ee-98f4-0e3c56aa1c21.Text: {n}The Marshal just barely turns his head in the prefect's direction, but it is enough to cause your guards and retinue to tense.{/n} "Please, it is best to leave this topic. As the official functionary tasked with executing the will of the {g|Encyclopedia:HolyTerraGlossary}Adeptus Terra{/g}, the prefect is under the protection of the Adeptus Arbites. Let us not complicate matters."

84421c4b-7c12-452c-8d98-515d4d12a8a4.Text: {n}The prefect resumes her elaborate formula. You notice a few poorly concealed yawns and frenzied blinking among the crowd. The speech drags on for another five minutes, but you pass this test of fortitude honourably. At last, the prefect's address comes to an end.{/n}

d6256316-0db6-4108-a9d2-ecd7e1177239.Text: {n}The prefect stops at the unceremonious sound reverberating throughout the room. Behind her thick ocular lenses, her eyes flash with displeasure. Catching herself, she quickly says,{/n} "In accordance with the Rogue Trader's prerogative to do so, the welcoming ceremony will be shortened to a brief formality."

d87b0f2f-9431-4350-b8aa-058590676c6d.Text: {n}Your eyes drift shut. You slowly plunge ever deeper into the darkness of sleep, while a voice, growing more and more distant, continues to wish you and your progeny epiphanies and boons of every kind... until an awkward cough jerks you suddenly out of your sweet torpor. The prefect, who appears to have finished speaking some time ago, is looking at you wordlessly, as is the Marshal, along with everyone else in the room.{/n}

9c6e3cd6-aa6e-4871-b5d4-fdcf0839ae33.Text: "A delegation of the Adeptus Administratum and the Adeptus Arbites is accommodated in the von Valancius territory so that they may tally and collect the {g|Encyclopedia:TitheGlossary}Imperial Tithe{/g} from your worlds, Lord Captain. Lady Theodora graciously provided them with premises where they could perform their duties and authorised them to restructure the dynasty's archives."

98cef492-c167-4f47-9bf8-163ea5a9883a.Text: {n}The Marshal leans forward. His voice is low, and when he speaks, it feels as though the marble tiles of the palace had begun to vibrate.{/n} "The Adeptus Arbites delegation has arrived to greet Lady Theodora's successor and to see to the extension of our decades-long arrangement."

17bb63b2-03e4-4c0b-a0c4-b31f04ab98ac.Text: "If I may continue for you." {n}The prefect steps forward, dragging her feet slightly.{/n} "As per the decree of Theodora von Valancius ORD-037/ЗN, the representatives of the Adeptus Administratum and the Adeptus Arbites are sanctioned to use the Palace of Justice, oversee {g|Encyclopedia:TitheGlossary}tithe{/g} collection in the protectorate, and review any and all cases of tithe avoidance, tithe exceedance, or other irregularities. These rights have been formalised in numerous pacts and statutes under the main decree — considering your new position, you may have yet to acquaint yourself with all these documents."

28c43d5c-89c3-451d-b64b-81eb761d8d17.Text: {n}The prefect's lips contort into a twist.{/n} "Our work has been disrupted by unforeseen setbacks regarding communication and transportation. As our requisitioned assets were not adequately prepared, we have lost some of our personnel and resources as a result."

1a33d12d-270c-45bf-a2c2-0a99027c7f21.Text: {n}The Marshal nods — he seems more accustomed to the tone you have chosen than to wordy pleasantries.{/n} "Warp storms ravaging the Koronus Expanse have deprived us of ships, people, and resources. And so, we must approach you as the inheritor of the pact we made with Lady Theodora."

515c41f1-37a6-426e-8753-43c47258950b.Text: "The Arbitrators are too short-handed to perform all the duties expected of them. Since they first arrived in the Expanse, their numbers, limited from the outset, have only continued to dwindle... After analysing the situation in accordance with Amendment FS/89З-24 to Decree ORD-037/ЗN, we have decided to notify you of a tithe violation committed by one of the worlds in the region. This regrettable lapse must be rectified as quickly as possible." {n}The old woman shivers and rubs her augmented hands together with an unnerving creak.{/n}

a5174047-7c09-4339-b638-c636e5618ca0.Text: "Not at all. You are the Emperor's anointed, and you act solely of your own volition." {n}The Marshal's voice makes the enforcers in the room flinch.{/n}

1efcdfa0-b25c-4d4b-a906-3e6d4501c821.Text: {n}The prefect, on the other hand, speaks softly, and yet, you can hear every word as if she were standing directly beside you:{/n} "Your predecessor, Lady Theodora — may the light of the Throne illuminate her path in death — always sought to address the needs of both the Adeptus Administratum and the Adeptus Arbites, because she realised how blessed and important our work is for the good of the Imperium — to say nothing of the fact that she honoured the laws of her own dynasty."

5d2b4ebf-af77-470e-bb66-7401c3247a47.Text: "Thassera, a feudal world far from the main routes that was bereft of the Imperium's light, then rediscovered less than two centuries ago. It supplies agricultural resources and manpower."

92658efa-dcd1-4c0a-b4e8-af2c442f2772.Text: "This is not a von Valancius world — the system is located just outside the border of your protectorate. The Imperium is built upon strict and unfailing abidance by the {g|Encyclopedia:LexImperialisGlossary}Lex Imperialis{/g}, and a planet's tithe, even one that is relatively small, must be provided in full."

289fee29-5dd5-4326-9142-5b1f688f26f1.Text: {n}The Marshal inclines his head.{/n} "If you were to break this pact, the Adeptus Arbites would no longer consider itself obligated to provide you with support, such as by bolstering your personal retinue with Arbitrators."

bc395977-8087-424d-aca7-4c4e4cf2358a.Text: "Furthermore..." {n}The prefect licks her finger out of habit, as though she were about to turn an invisible page.{/n} "Decree ORD-037/ЗN 'On Mutual Benefaction and Cooperation Between the Rogue Trader and Representatives of the Adeptus Administratum and the Adeptus Arbites' was created and personally certified by Theodora von Valancius for good reason. If we were to disregard this measure, we would risk having... any of the aforementioned parties sink back into pernicious freethinking. I am sure I need not to tell you what a great undertaking it is to establish any semblance of order. I strongly urge you to reconsider."

e7844944-f8db-4ebd-90bf-ed7ba2b1bce4.Text: {n}Before you even finish speaking, the prefect's cogita-quill begins scratching at her data-slate, likely recording your refusal and making corrections to various decrees. The Marshal merely bows, and the delegation of lawkeepers leaves the room.{/n}

0756a029-7638-4529-87cc-e67558fab9d4.Text: "An Arbitrator will be assigned to you for increased security. Proctor Anthar, front and centre!" {n}The Marshal's voice thunders over the Arbitrator ranks, and Solomorne Anthar marches over to your throne, his cyber-mastiff at his heel.{/n}

b725f1bd-d6f7-4140-a36b-30fdb0c10f37.Text: "Proctor Anthar's capacity is not that of a spy, but that of a representative of our organisations who will help you to navigate the many nuances of the Imperial Law and, if the need arises, direct you down the just path."

085b4ac6-106f-4d19-b456-c562ab2d3c7a.Text: "The Emperor protects!" {n}The Marshal makes the sign of the Aquila in a motion so sharp that you can practically hear it cutting the air.{/n}

705392e8-13ac-4be3-8f75-1632734f6173.Text: {n}The prefect adjusts her ocular lenses with a weary sigh.{/n} "And once again, no specifics given — of course. And my reports? Nobody ever stops to think—" {n}She quickly catches herself and offers you a bow.{/n}

4cbfb820-f381-472d-b81f-3ed3edc22907.Text: "For thirty-four generations, my family has served in the Adeptus Administratum. I was given a name befitting one who comes from a long line of scribes." {n}The prefect looks at you without blinking — she is either ignoring your disrespectful tone or has genuinely failed to notice it.{/n}

46406b41-b37c-47c7-85d8-5007cdecd1a4.Text: "You are the successor to Lady Theodora, whose alliance with our two sacred organisations forever glorified her as a Rogue Trader closely tied to the executors of {g|Encyclopedia:HolyTerraGlossary}Holy Terra{/g}'s will. And we as representatives of the Adeptus Administratum and the Adeptus Arbites must verify that you are able to maintain this alliance that has brought such repute to your dynasty." {n}The prefect scrutinises you as if trying to estimate your proportions and weight.{/n} "That is why we have arrived in person, as the present circumstances have provided us with a chance to see if your intentions concord with those of the late von Valancius."

7f4c0133-b76c-4169-923c-22267ae62bac.Text: {n}The prefect bows to you.{/n} "The material compensation... should satisfy you."

70e6d5dc-e3c8-4749-8116-e9d880bcb99d.Text: {n}The Marshal gives you a terse nod.{/n} "Indeed, and I should offer you our thanks once again. I have read the report on the operation, and it is worth noting that Proctor Anthar spoke highly of you and your talents."

f379f757-d202-44e8-9ee3-4bbf8bb46890.Text: "Though, having once saved him and the other Arbitrators from a dying planet, your character should require no further affirmation."

fb134041-5064-4c50-afb8-e53690f38e82.Text: "It is proportionate to my duties, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. While I am involved with the Administratum's archiving cogitators, I proudly bear the title of Master of Seals. In all other circumstances, I am a mere prefect. This distinction allows me to organise my work in due fashion. And as you surely understand, clarity and order are critical components of the sacred acts of maintaining and managing records."

7fb7e81c-f390-4350-8b28-5897ccadec97.Text: {n}You enunciate an impressively long and ornate list of all the blessings and encouragements that have been {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Nobility}showered upon you since birth{/d}. Those in attendance listen with bated breath. With each passing minute, the prefect's face falls lower and lower, but she dares not utter a word throughout your speech, which takes a good quarter of an hour.{/n}

2b7e4de8-3f12-4010-b147-a8c125e3ab17.Text: [Point to his implants] "Was your friendship with Aquila the reason you needed those augmetics?"

2da2cb6b-2d7b-4547-9895-ab997116fee4.Text: "What kind of curiosities do you sell?"

146394b4-655d-4599-b44a-5e4051146c70.Text: "That is a beautiful eagle. What is its name?"

9eb58d74-e089-4de9-8712-1eb0da17965d.Text: "I want to see what curiosities you have."

8c2ff6c9-2abb-4ba2-b9da-70bdefc97cef.Text: "If I want to purchase something, I will let you know."

9fd50f2d-b7e9-44d8-8cd3-18343cb5f573.Text: "I am a Rogue Trader, and I seek the rarest of curiosities. Do you have anything of that sort?"

86b7ac9a-1ca0-4be9-b099-4483bdd028cc.Text: {n}A finely dressed man greets you with an incredibly radiant smile. His meticulously polished jaw augmentation reflects the palace's interior as sharply as a mirror.{/n} "Allow me to introduce myself! I am Lussarius Karmelan, a collector of curiosities. Perhaps Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} will find something useful among my offerings."

aa52d793-cf60-4310-a41d-0f02a24c6f35.Text: {n}His polished jaw shining, Lussarius extends his hand toward the bird, a hand likewise made of shiny metal.{/n} "Her name is Aquila. As soon as I saw her, I knew a creature of such proud grace simply must be properly taken care of. Now Aquila is an integral part of my life. As I am of hers... "

d3cc88fd-3c67-473b-bf1b-0b0de686abf0.Text: "My collection will offer you the biggest and broadest choice in all the Expanse! However, even a devoted enthusiast like myself has his limits..."

9b058a49-e30b-448d-bf2a-37f8f5ab79c9.Text: {n}The merchant bows, still smiling: the light makes his prosthetic jaw sparkle.{/n}

661d7625-3e4c-466b-98c1-ad01b7d90d02.Text: "Cyber-beasts are the rarest of our sector's marvels, and I know every single person who has what it takes to keep one. The owner of one such creature, an Explorator Tech-Priest, has not contacted me in a long time. I am worried for his wondrous pet and the protocols that went missing with him. An Explorator Fleet's work is inherently risky, but to put the life of one's most loyal ally on the line... Perhaps you will be able to find him. Or what is left of him."

09393290-f121-4990-97ab-c454414c8f52.Text: {n}The curiosity merchant's smile has, or so it seems, never left his face even for a minute since you last spoke.{/n}

efb57cce-09bf-4976-a321-f256e44619e1.Text: {n}Judging by Aquila's displeased look, the bird's fondness for her owner's original extremity was of an alimentary rather than affectionate nature.{/n}

585304ff-2117-4353-a985-77ba9e2c021e.Text: "You are exceptionally observant!" {n}The man laughs softly and melodiously, then shakes his head.{/n} "Developing a friendship with such a noble creature is a thorny path, and after a moment of especially profound disagreement I had to have my hand replaced..."

166d9421-c1ed-4c19-ad96-d51e9f3bfc53.Text: "But this—" {n}Lussarius touches his jaw implant, his pride evident.{/n} "—this was purely for the beauty of the thing. I used to be passionate about finding rare augmetics, and could not resist having them installed, even if they were made by, shall we say, not purely righteous hands... But the fine craftsmanship! The razor-sharp outlines! Please keep this a secret from the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMechanicusGlossary}Adeptus Mechanicus{/g}. I know the red priests don't condone things like that."

ae232652-62cc-4c3e-8786-da599a1f5a73.Text: {n}Lussarius points to his eagle, still smiling.{/n} "Equipment for noble cyber-assistants, of course. The demand is modest, as few in the Imperium can afford such luxury, but I am glad to have found my calling."

c0e9b5b8-18e3-43cc-87a6-9406531ef0de.Text: {n}Judging by his expensive attire and ostentatious augmetics, Lussarius's wealth is unlikely to stem directly from his curiosity business. He came here following his heart, it seems, and not his greed.{/n}

f4681661-4778-4a1c-bb46-a9837587e6f4.Text: {n}With a shrill cry, the eagle stabs her benefactor's metal palm with her beak. The augmetic groans, while the merchant is still smiling as he modestly puts his hand back into his clothes and out of sight.{/n} "Apologies. Aquila is still getting used to my replacement extremity. She liked the old one better."

2c70a06c-e009-48eb-9f22-bc0fdf3fc5d1.Text: "There is a certain captain who owns a unique protocol, a family heirloom, which he has refused to sell to me. His ship is called the Renegades' Fall. Perhaps you can chart a path to his hoarded treasure... I will send you the coordinates of the place where we last met."

add843c5-537d-4db2-97cb-9a1a044fb2cc.Text: "I would prefer to first know exactly what it is that the head of the Adeptus Arbites in the Expanse wants to see me about."

35fbad54-cda6-4dc2-a6b3-c140e7a9d8bf.Text: "Yes. I am ready to discuss our business."

901d21ee-7b56-4f2a-a8dd-5389347fea8f.Text: "I hope it will not be exhausting. Call your Marshal in."

5a6276b6-03bb-4953-af07-a089a2d25c34.Text: "Rogue Trader, the Marshal is ready to meet with you. Do you wish to commence the audience?"

57c91c66-41e3-4415-9f05-e6a1e93991d8.Text: "I do not know the details, but I would assume the procedure is the same as it was in Lady Theodora's time: a personal introduction, a reaffirming of allyship between the dynasty and the Adeptus Arbites, and a discussion of tithe-related affairs."

3e2b0031-b298-4e87-b311-f85f24fd108d.Text: There are pits in the sand as if someone tried to dig something out — or dig their way out.

65704eea-d333-49bd-8e8b-fdee26837f35.Text: The excrement of a very large creature. You see Guardsman dog tags and pieces of armour.

b1549f07-92c8-4381-ac76-f5fed004021e.Text: "The sand! The sand is their ally! Watch out!"

84b5f26e-59e6-47cc-b2af-19a8aade5c05.Text: The weapons are arranged in a strict order, in vivid contrast to the haphazardly aligned walls of containers just beyond the outpost.

5cfdfa78-e45e-41a5-bf91-7bb59427b091.Text: Decayed books rest on the gilded pedestal. The plaque underneath bears the half-faded letters of an inscription in High Gothic: "Lex Imperialis, Volume 964, Addendum 33B."

30a35d51-2450-4449-a1db-91363413ce10.Text: Neat stacks of papers and diagrams, their meaning obscured by codes and ciphers.

561ca8e9-0bb0-4824-a7a2-8032d3369fbf.Text: The container is filled to the brim with dried, polished human bones. You can barely make out the Ecclesiarchy symbol on the rusted plasteel.

38cfddb7-abb4-4b4d-86bf-6eb57cbe3eec.Text: Nothing but rubbish and a few spent casings inside.

b2cc4695-8268-419e-b497-e644ddbc149d.Text: Emaciated, blue-skinned, frozen corpses cling to the container's lid with broken nails. Shattered knives lie at their feet. The patches on their clothes bear the name "Heartless."

dba792be-e4d7-4df9-9172-d6a8463f2f2b.Text: A corpse in Administratum robes, so withered that even carrion eaters were not tempted.

797799c6-ef65-4b00-9705-3e0f7580c5a6.Text: A corpse with the insignia of an Imperial Guard vox-operator. His battered knuckles and horrific injuries indicate that this man went down fighting.

26dff902-28ae-458e-a172-bcbf7f936601.Text: A cache with goods stolen from the containers. You spot a pile of blackened jewellery in the dirt nearby, likely thrown out of the crate to make room for provisions and weapons.

74a196ec-c11d-4597-bb12-5def8984b85e.Text: Someone has taken shelter in the old container. There is a simple bed and a table, both of which are buried in data-slates and papers, and the walls are scribbled over in unintelligible calculations.

23bd1c3b-79fd-4354-96c6-e0f3d239cca8.Text: A heavy stench of death spreads from the container. Judging by the markings, some Guardsmen ended up inside by mistake. Judging by the dents, they did not make it out.

071f3dd3-4189-44fb-a501-eca508cb9411.Text: "Do you hear that? That's not the creaking of a container — it's some kind of creature howling. Is it trying to scare us away by screaming, or is it calling to its own kind? We need to prepare for the worst."

5564043a-a50d-4275-835c-f5a98f68a1c4.Text: "Reporting: an unidentified corpse has been discovered in the food section."

31d073de-dede-4be8-904b-9f47831b0b2d.Text: "Several months ago at the least. The victim suffocated under a sliding mass of grain. Are we to proceed with the identification?"

5bbc576d-2de1-41b7-a971-dc9f266f8e7a.Text: "No. Remove the body. Check that the grain is all accounted for — the victim could have consumed some of it before death. Calculate the shortage."

943e1e0e-81f8-4172-9f1f-9bd4f148c084.Text: "The loading of the tithe is fully underway, Rogue Trader!"

dba987d7-7112-49a8-9398-a2b443aa424b.Text: "S-3085, S-3086, S-3088... Void-damned number bunglers! Now it's anyone's guess if they just miscounted or actually lost an item."

768e3b46-37ff-4244-b14c-0ed8d24d3dcb.Text: "I will commence the evacuation of people to your ship at once, Rogue Trader. You yourself should get out of here. The planet's a goner..."

78c3df62-fbea-4170-bd04-3046071bdbf6.Text: "Arbitrators, Protocol RT-091-Beta. The Rogue Trader has returned."

d886bcb8-0e8a-44cf-acfa-7436f569ef48.Text: "Arbitrators, stand ready. Protocol RT-091. We have important visitors."

8de681f9-8bca-4597-9fa7-9f21eda533cd.Text: You can glimpse dark corridors through the rusted grate in the floor. It is hard to tell the dim silhouettes of passing people from those of cockroaches rustling in every corner.

6c1d26b7-6d7a-41f0-8770-27fb1ebff3d9.Text: "The inventory... it's incomplete. Am I done for? I am so done for..."

b8263302-f142-4005-ab35-fd836c3b2893.Text: A glittering object on the corpse's hand catches your eye: a string of silver prayer beads with a vaguely familiar Imperium symbol.

5311f01f-2980-4539-9863-53084d7f5ec8.Text: A glittering object on the corpse's hand catches your eye: a string of silver prayer beads with a tarnished Adeptus Administratum symbol. The victim must have been buried alive in the middle of an inventory inspection.

d852740b-ea47-486d-992d-665e6a3abd5e.Text: "The cogitator is just over that container. A bit farther! It's a large sandy area, you'll know it when you see it."

a07ea92b-0a9b-4c2f-9126-14fb0d29d4e1.Text: The papers are covered in cramped handwriting. When you stop to examine it more closely, it turns out to be a single endless string of numbers.

19dd8a63-b576-42aa-8ed2-19f95a6ec931.Text: "Oh! You are back! You... are back?"

0a5d2afa-23ba-4dc9-b3d0-74ae7470408f.Text: "...Two hundred and fifty-two million containers taken stock of. Forty-seven... trillion to go..."

e46f4aae-a02f-44b6-8f84-a889c850bad8.Text: These people were buried up to their necks in the sand. The agony that is forever imprinted on their twisted faces shows this was a harsh execution.

8d7194d9-2006-444e-9d00-d1f72ba2cd10.Text: "It's hopeless. The Emperor has forsaken us."

e4713952-2cac-4425-acac-8ff125439f4f.Text: "When are they going to send us into battle? I can't stand just rotting away in here."

71751cbc-f467-4043-abf0-272ee0071ce0.Text: "Who is that? More shadows from the Riven Sky? They're sure dressed nice... Hey, is that an Arbitrator?"

7a3f1739-302d-4baf-914a-56eaf3836690.Text: "Why would an Arbitrator be here? They're all holed up in their outpost, and this bunch has crawled out of the dump. Walz will deal with them — he can smell a fake."

6f271914-48ff-4d3b-80b5-5792b1c176aa.Text: "Move it. The captain will decide your fate."

b920cb95-8e8e-469c-b24b-10efe9468fd1.Text: The Guardsman pointedly looks away, as though afraid to meet your gaze.

a3deaeeb-0717-4723-9e1d-e8c0c3f784f9.Text: "I know you're from the Riven Sky. Stay away."

b4fbd8bc-891c-4399-a205-4ca122416eee.Text: "No entry. Stay where I can see you."

f3316ed3-6b68-4652-9d5a-854668f7c0fc.Text: Weapons both old and new from a variety of worlds lie together in an incoherent pile, as if jumbled by a child's hand. Every gap is filled with ammunition of different calibres.

f9e3a843-5a93-4bd0-8bec-86ff00324ec4.Text: "C-Captain Walz! Do I take the oath now? Ahem. I swear never to abandon a comrade-in-arms, and—"

06e628f9-616a-4d18-ae5e-438f985e519a.Text: "Have you ever been under fire, soldier?"

e9612f98-dabf-4c91-97b4-d23f734b2feb.Text: "Go, Stepchild of the Imperium. Become bones in the foundation of the new truth."

fbfeada7-fd9b-46bf-bc87-b053d3ab9521.Text: This heavy metal door does not look like it can be forced or blown open. Only a key would work here.

e4353d67-bb4d-4715-a66f-c53eac446331.Text: "Stepchildren! Do not let them take the tank! The Riven Sky... shall... fall..."

dcffdcb3-f442-40c9-9cf7-70e10477a400.Text: Gilded ceremonial blades are tied with rough ropes to the spikes surrounding the encampment.

02f7c709-cfea-4fb9-bcdb-6eeb288fbaf0.Text: Despite all your efforts, the blade does not budge — time and the elements have fused the handle with the spike.

290a62ad-d1bd-40f6-b3ca-167da2cc01d4.Text: After a few moments, a gilded blade falls into your hands.

4ea21242-38a2-44f0-a581-f67572d9563a.Text: Red rust extends along the entire length of the container. It has only been cleaned off the container's number and the immaculately polished Aquila on the side.

365fda4c-310e-40f4-8ee4-4f8f2b951b1a.Text: A muffled growl comes from beneath the sand. The moment you approach, the sound fades, and blood starts pumping in your temples. You feel your lips stretching into a vicious grin.

2991790e-657f-48ee-a93a-1478cf60aaab.Text: Your jaw aches from the rage, and the crimson lumps of clay remind you of torn flesh. Your hands find a bundle wrapped in yellowed rags.

a5a1ba07-e7a3-4c43-913a-3be978ab80bb.Text: The container is tightly sealed on all sides. Something is scratched on the lid: "5 tonnes of the finest sl... ge."

db0bfacc-37a8-4ecd-94bb-1e31361b6c3f.Text: Walz senses the threat you pose. You could not be broken by monstrous torture — he knows too well how dangerous that makes you.

db126f13-e356-451e-90e9-a0401c778ef2.Text: While the Guardsmen believed they were alone amidst the horrors of the universe, they fought without doubt. But your words have given them a glimmer of hope of better things to come, and it will destroy them.

63cb08fc-c871-45b3-8722-a525cbbb7168.Text: The Rogue Trader {mf|himself|herself} is at the tank's controls. Death to the enemy! Glory to the Astra Militarum!

1324b52e-f9fe-4eac-8386-b73c73220510.Text: You know quite well how to deal with such a machine! You instantly load an additional {g|f:fc8b3cc2fb9344b88ad38a246b05ba26}APHE shell{/g} into the tank.

98642897-b14c-4baa-9447-ae1d5b8bff83.Text: "We hid in the container when things started to look bad on the old Heartless. We'll climb out once they unload the goods at the port warehouse. I bet those thick-headed lawmen won't even realise they've graciously brought a couple of ratsies right to their precious hoard. Got no food here, though, and it's cold as a grave. It's fine, we'll manage. They're not gonna drag all this to the other side of the sector, are they? Soon, Trei and Kaira are gonna be the richest rats in the whole Expanse!"

028c0b84-eda6-4292-933b-6e51646a988f.Text: This heavy, notched key opens the gate at the Guardsmen's camp.

99fe428c-d6fe-4ded-9da6-44b534b23672.Text: This weapon was meant to be used in Ecclesiarchy ceremonies. It never reached its intended recipient.

796c0adc-c6f7-4c52-bcc9-9502ed667b67.Text: This weighty augment once sparked within the head of the clerk Tertius Quart. It contains the most comprehensive inventory of Leethus's riches.

e3f54ed1-2097-425f-a200-f6a444dcf152.Text: "Rogue Trader. Quantity: 1." This document contains an exhaustive list of all conceivable details of your body, attire, and personal traits.

2d03f1c8-e450-4bbb-98d9-6141066c4cba.Text: This old shield is caked with blood and dried scraps of skin. As soon as you pick it up, unquenchable rage begins to boil inside your chest.

b0f2d968-528b-49ce-8758-96c96a6ae99d.Text: Righteous service to the Imperium does not always entail illustrious acts of glory. Many Arbitrators spend their entire lives keeping watch day in and day out on planets such as Leethus, where the stored tithe must be protected at all costs.

a538bcfb-0adc-4240-9cf8-bf4482aa0e7e.Text: "I will see to the clerk. Where do I find him?"

4e02651c-7235-471d-bb4d-d9ffea980832.Text: "Why don't you go fetch him yourself?"

e6eb3820-bdd2-4aa6-a531-3f3710a98851.Text: "What kind of farce is this? I was not even able to land properly!"

c609e3d1-ff1b-46cc-9987-a599b3160a64.Text: "The Marshal has ordered the tithe to be transported to Dargonus. Start loading the barges."

2ac278f1-fc1a-4728-87c1-745f72ffe337.Text: "Are you able to speculate how likely the following development is to occur: the Rogue Trader sends the insolent lawwoman to the most Throne-forsaken planet there is, where she will guard the dust at her feet for the remainder of her life. In solitude."

1e4e36d7-d22d-4f7f-869a-aca51c1d9933.Text: "Yeager, how long have you been here?"

a273a6ae-ec63-4711-bd92-4313afb7fe02.Text: "Collecting the tithe is meaningless, to say nothing of stockpiling it. The Maw is closed, and there is no telling when it might reopen. It would have been better if the tithe hadn't been collected at all."

bf297102-04c7-4524-ab96-5c8111f993c0.Text: "I knew I could rely on you, Solomorne."

239fc00d-87bd-422e-b30c-38766822b274.Text: "I have a proposal that will satisfy everyone: I will find out who caused this commotion and why, and then we will travel to Dargonus and go before the Marshal together."

6e82f4fa-50c5-46eb-9ee9-b1e61451ca7a.Text: [Attack] "Enough! I will not tolerate threats against me."

b8082c11-6a9d-4183-b223-1e5f92da90e0.Text: "Why have you not dealt with the insurgents? They nearly stole a tank!"

7872b4e7-17fe-4393-b6f4-8b66919573e7.Text: "Your supervision of the living tithe is insufficient."

92cfb5e2-84cf-4c78-9ad7-d1d7be02c4c3.Text: "I see you are completely incompetent in this matter."

ced80653-9e5a-4a2a-94e2-b26af4b5a56f.Text: [Hand over the inventory] "The clerk had to be disposed of."

80cc1e15-5cef-4c3d-91ce-669a71b0f0a6.Text: "Here is your clerk. What is next?"

b04fd3e3-72ac-4ee3-b94e-4be93ab6a668.Text: "Could we, perhaps, try to avoid bloodshed?"

adcfb2e9-9462-48cf-9d75-d88bd42d5e45.Text: "I am just as clueless as you are."

e43fe088-768b-41db-96b7-928354bc2a77.Text: "You dare demand an explanation from a Rogue Trader?"

c27d0754-ac75-4810-b2bf-d740d8b12e62.Text: [Draw your weapon] "Pull yourself together, or you will regret it."

64106d99-2964-4031-8dab-3039630cdc97.Text: "How do you keep the tithe safe with such a small force at your disposal?"

0b33ff29-9833-475e-affa-081fbdf75756.Text: "Indeed. So you are still faring well enough."

9ac8245a-acef-4cc2-99d6-956fbd4a3022.Text: [Look at Solomorne] "How is it that you didn't think to send a handsome fighter to seduce their leader?"

9b94a78a-a671-404a-9acf-56527ca15252.Text: "I wanted to ask you about something else."

73cbfd4d-0c24-46f8-9a3f-dddf640e7a08.Text: "Everything is clear. I am heading out immediately to procure the inventory."

c850483d-2d6f-4976-9e17-f96793c54712.Text: "Is there anything else I need to know about the clerk?"

e93f6464-28f3-48af-88cb-4ec373cab68e.Text: "Yeager, can you tell me what protocol you are following at this time? You do realise that your unauthorised actions are contradicting the Marshal's orders?"

7e25eda6-b12a-43b6-895b-a4d4191edff3.Text: "Don't you find that there are too many inconsistencies in this story? What if this situation is not, in fact, the result of some insanely devious plan of mine? Have you considered that I may have been unwittingly involved in someone else's scheme?"

f8190743-78c3-46c5-b844-a6ec57ee48ed.Text: "It is all quite simple: either you wait on my ship while I sort everything out, or you perish ignominiously by my hand."

38064443-83bf-4489-b15e-116f20fc8e9c.Text: "I am recruiting these people — they will undergo rigorous training on Dargonus and become a new generation of Guardsmen."

4329a4af-f9e8-40d9-8194-4f0e8b7a4aa4.Text: "This world clearly has problems. It is about time someone fixed them."

00a070f1-5579-4a4c-b47b-8c55f4fffcbc.Text: "You will have to content yourself with my word. I know nothing about what is going on, and I have nothing to hide."

dc47774d-5729-48a9-bfe5-5431c9fac010.Text: "The planet is about to fall apart! In case you have forgotten, I am in as much danger as you are. If we continue to stand here doing nothing, we are all dead."

ce60be5a-a170-42fc-a009-bb57cec5c8f0.Text: "Did you hear those strange noises on the vox-line? That is what intercepted transmissions sound like. Why would one of my servants do that?"

e7c5ecfd-c2c6-45e3-9697-89d050b0b0c9.Text: "I almost got killed and you are worried about the damage to your tithe?"

3dba3bea-2982-49f8-aad4-89a616e1a8be.Text: Left the surplus living tithe on Leethus.

e25057a1-b888-4178-ae1f-ab728c0d897e.Text: "They had no orders to breed. Take as many as is required and leave the rest here."

d0bfb4ea-7f52-4a88-8bd0-b501f0387ba4.Text: "Remarkable ineptitude, Yeager. I will assist you, but only because I want to get off this dump of a planet as soon as possible."

68ea5db8-b124-4032-a29c-36638caaa82c.Text: Took the surplus living tithe from Leethus.

f0b5cb14-1034-4d8c-a0ab-0cbd0cdb4e61.Text: "They are people, not a 'living tithe'! Take everyone. If there is not enough room, throw out something rotten."

4f2edf90-f7df-47be-a9be-eb33df7db7b0.Text: Buried the surplus living tithe in a pit on Leethus.

ae3ef187-50ae-4ba5-9ad7-225be90dd492.Text: "Drive the excess into the deepest pit and seal off the entrance. That is how you dispose of refuse."

7aabf7c1-dc8d-4530-9773-165b06591a11.Text: "What do you mean by 'they have bred'?"

28902c2c-2812-431d-ba4e-2403d51e75cb.Text: "Proctor Adriana Yeager, outpost T-M/255. Greetings, Rogue Trader." {n}The woman hailing you could hardly be called ancient, but it seems her life has been arduous enough to turn her hair grey well before its time.{/n}

644b595c-cc0d-4ccc-900c-6513c9388246.Text: {n} The Proctor raises her weapon, followed by the rest of the Arbitrators.{/n} "I demand an explanation, Rogue Trader. Why can't we block the Oblivion? Is this your doing?"

193669b5-928c-40a6-b6f7-0e53e7f1a597.Text: "The damage to the tithe is real, while your death... remains in the realm of speculation."

5614b53a-2886-43bf-a8fe-8f044cad9174.Text: "I trust your judgement, Proctor, but my mission requires vigilance and permits no compromise."

878686be-6f9e-4d89-aa31-45b2776750af.Text: "All Arbitrators are busy remotely monitoring the transport protocol. No one leaves the outpost alone, which means we would have to form a unit, and that, in turn, means the loading process would stop. Believe me: I would never have asked a Rogue Trader to run an errand for me, but I am doing my best to streamline the process."

36a3bb83-3bdb-4808-bc23-f98503fc2f69.Text: "The section that Quart is currently taking inventory of is not far from here. We have blocked the passage so that the living tithe does not bother the scribes. I will clear the way for you now." {n}She gives the data-slate a few quick swipes with her finger.{/n}

172e52fc-b6ed-41eb-a4ef-e93de6690233.Text: "I formally apologise for this on behalf of the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusArbitesGlossary}Adeptus Arbites{/g}. We have been forced to stockpile shipments of weapons and explosives within the walls of the outpost to keep the living tithe from getting to them."

8831468a-a10a-4925-9c87-a0b7d7dbb6d5.Text: "Throne's blood, more losses among the living tithe..." {n}The Arbitrator rubs her temple wearily.{/n}

7d5cc6b5-f56f-4149-b282-263b77e95322.Text: {n}Yeager lifts her gaze to the foul skies of Leethus.{/n} "So that's how it is. After so many years... Understood, Rogue Trader. We will begin loading immediately."

4308bf1c-b00d-44e7-a4c3-b4333aec35cf.Text: "I apologise for the inconvenience, Rogue Trader. If it's any consolation, the loading process is nearly complete, and only a few formalities remain — in particular, we need the tithe inventory. The clerk Tertius Quart has it. As much as it offends me, I must ask you to return him to the outpost. That said, retrieving the inventory without the clerk will also suffice."

9a037e84-d4d7-47ec-8dea-1e956fdb9b40.Text: "For many years, Rogue Trader. When I first set foot on Leethus, my hair was like a raven's wing, and there was a stupid certainty in my head that I would be here for a dozen cycles at most. Thankfully, Leethus has beaten the rotten habit of hoping and making plans out of me and taught me patience and humility instead."

05491631-1327-48bc-9057-1c76ec68164d.Text: {n}Something resembling anger sparks in her lifeless eyes.{/n} "Tithe collection is a sacred pillar and a sign that the dominion of the Imperium is strong. Without it, worlds would think that they were free of all obligations and use the resources for their own needs. Would they feel compelled to pay the tithe again after the {g|Encyclopedia:Maw}Maw{/g} reopened? Of course not. There would be unrest, riots, disorder. This is why it is important to collect the tithe at all times, regardless of circumstance."

29d57503-0c2f-4c92-a289-1a91405e16b3.Text: "The tithe is taking damage; I am aware of that. However, we cannot afford an operation to capture and eliminate the insurgents. That would cause losses among the Arbitrators, which would be catastrophic in our current situation — we barely have enough people to stand watch and man the planetary defence weaponry, so where do you suppose that leaves container loading systems? We are forced to keep order only where we can. For the time being, cargo loss is still within the Administratum-regulated norm of deterioration."

0309c556-a698-44cb-9021-1e7949d0c0b4.Text: "I am glad to hear it — and to know that our understanding of the Lex Imperialis is in accord."

48f69daa-8bcf-46b8-b9d1-5a4f41df7aee.Text: "The law is the same for everyone, Rogue Trader — even for you, and even on the edge of the galaxy. Arbitrators, to arms!"

774738e0-a333-43c8-8b12-4fae2e998e5b.Text: "I ask that you not forget whom you are addressing, Mistress Yeager. Be mindful of your words."

43b0472d-835c-4187-ba17-0355751342ef.Text: "Given the secrecy of the planet, the number of Arbitrators available, and the capriciousness of the {g|Encyclopedia:Maw}Maw{/g}, the current supervision is optimal. It is not up to standard, and that is putting it mildly, but neither we nor the Administratum can provide more."

5b62396e-cae2-4525-84b7-770704806468.Text: "Acknowledged, Rogue Trader. Your dissatisfaction will be recorded in the minutes for this meeting and addressed according to general procedure. Now, let us move on to the purpose of your unannounced inspection."

bc940402-a6c6-40d7-a9c0-b7f43bd262ae.Text: "What matters is that you have delivered the inventory. I will record Quart's death as part of the transportation expenses."

f632254a-8d42-454e-a921-58caa75fbb5b.Text: {n}Yeager cringes as if from a toothache.{/n} "You cannot bargain with the law."

50b4dfab-9d16-4d36-8f4f-3f9375dc7256.Text: "We do not have much left to load. The bulk of it is already on the barges, and the rest is being delivered automatically. We merely need to decide what to do with the living tithe. They have bred irresponsibly and are now twice as numerous as before."

3b3c7846-5976-48a0-81d1-1d42e9b51e7b.Text: {n}The space around you suddenly fills with screeches and crackles that pour from every vox-caster and speaker. Then, you hear a deep male voice:{/n} "Query: invitation to the von Valancius orbital station. Uploading coordinates into the shuttle's central cogitator... complete. Purpose: finalising the Oblivion directive." {n}The voice goes into a guttural, gurgling cough.{/n} "Tarry not, offspring... If you delay, you will be blown up along with all the extraneous subjects."

c2052dce-db44-4ec1-9e70-677e5b8ee524.Text: "Proctor Solomorne Anthar. A cursory inspection of the site has revealed serious improprieties in the custody of the tithe. Report the extent to which the damage exceeds the margin of error."

cedc2e86-f811-4e1b-b30d-38c9c27cfae1.Text: "And will I receive a complimentary bullet to the forehead upon arrival on your flagship? No, this will not do."

773493fc-a434-4ab5-89ab-3f61aff33562.Text: "Answers, answers... Yes, we have always had a thirst for knowledge. I will satisfy your curiosity when you come to me. I need to know if you... have what it takes to see this through. Now hurry: this world will soon cease to exist."

79c0e1ec-80e1-4d29-870b-ccd902171e1b.Text: "Don't make me take over control of the shuttle, offspring. Let us simply... put an end to this world and this whole miserable affair."

c47a966b-a47e-487f-b7b5-6af76120833d.Text: {n}The bolter's muzzle lowers slowly, as if overcoming an invisible obstacle.{/n} "I see no need for further confrontation. Consider the issue settled for now. We will board your flagship, and you will investigate the identity of the perpetrator. Let us return to this matter in the Marshal's presence on Dargonus."

6c016c27-651a-4799-ae77-9aaa54efb94d.Text: {n}The woman stares you obstinately in the eye for a long, long time, as if the backs of your pupils held the answers to all of her questions and doubts.{/n}

7ba75145-c97c-490d-9fba-b3d56d4c9b06.Text: "Hollow excuses. Again." {n}The muzzle of Yeager's bolter stares you between the eyes.{/n}

b08b0b61-757a-4a5d-b1bd-92cf3076bfce.Text: "Perhaps someone is trying to frame you, or there are even more convoluted motives involved."

26ac52f2-b03f-4de8-ba8b-ccf9f1ed960d.Text: "Are you still trying to weasel out and defend yourself? Enough."

bff02e75-0d73-4331-ae86-9549eea18b58.Text: {n}Abelard wrinkles his face tentatively.{/n} "That voice... Does it sound familiar? No, why would it? Forgive me, Lord Captain. I am hearing things."

2bf8f9b9-75eb-485b-a790-41f0c570361a.Text: "Fighting against a flawed interpretation of the Lex Imperialis." {n}Solomorne takes his eyes off Yeager for a moment and looks at you intently.{/n} "I did not think you would see it any other way."

4a7257d4-43c7-4a02-960e-b34c6846c27a.Text: "No, she is dead! She is gone! Shut up!" {n}Idira runs her fingers through her dishevelled hair.{/n} "Sorry. My little whispers suddenly hit a sore spot. Huh? Did I miss something?"

4f10134b-2bfa-454f-8f97-5ddcb240760a.Text: {n}Yeager's data-slate is flashing a panicked red.{/n} "The augurs are recording anomalous seismic activity: someone has started arming the cyclonic bombs in the bowels of Leethus. The machine spirits are rejecting all counter-litanies. The planet is done for. We cannot stop this..." {n}Her lips tighten into a white streak, and her data-slate falls to the floor.{/n}

ae19c94a-4520-44d9-8081-cd14e87388fc.Text: "I see you no longer serve the Lex Imperialis, but the interests of a Rogue Trader." {n}Yeager resolutely clutches her weapon.{/n}

5bbd0b65-4a92-4934-af6f-708d2d153c9c.Text: "At the same time, the threat of an explosion will help to herd the undisciplined living tithe onto the barges. Some of the recruits may be less than cooperative now, but telling them about the bombs will soon bring them to their senses."

a7c98ba6-99d8-4de9-82b1-66f7bd487496.Text: "Not right now. I can see that you followed the protocols. The Marshal will judge the results of your mission according to the proper regulations." {n}Both Proctors nod curtly.{/n}

916121c1-98be-4277-aa17-21725376ff74.Text: "She is right, Rogue Trader. What you are witnessing on Leethus are forced measures."

5c91dac0-0f35-466b-bbb5-fa1ab33f0f8b.Text: "Your words could almost be construed as aiding the investigation."

d1206557-37d5-4878-9ce1-33959c60843c.Text: "So, something you were supposed to learn in the {g|Encyclopedia:ScholaProgeniumGlossary}Schola Progenium{/g}."

80317cc0-7a22-4b49-8331-99a715667697.Text: "My bet is on the insanely devious plan." {n}The Arbitrator's finger tightens around the trigger.{/n}

8a57b888-c20c-4d6d-8a55-f3637575cb4c.Text: "Are you so confident you have the upper hand?" {n}Yeager's eyes dart all over you, clearly reassessing the threat in your favour.{/n}

5edcbe83-fa60-4c9b-8cb2-3c5bb1bb940d.Text: "Have you had much hands-on experience with entire sectors and dying planets being cut off from the Imperium? There must be other ways to display power — ones that do not incur the deaths of millions, for example."

1c22d4d1-2ce0-4d4c-b58d-541c58b1888e.Text: "Pathetic excuses. It seems the rust is eating away not only at the containers, but at the Arbitrators as well. My report to the Marshal will outline your incompetence. Pray you get off with just a demotion."

302b81f9-06ec-4195-8f63-a53b1d882afb.Text: "Those Guardsmen have been on Leethus for years, if not decades, and new ones keep arriving all the time. They disregard regulations, form clans, start families, and procreate. Such are the pernicious consequences of their aimless existence and the proof of their lack of fortitude."

bb9359c9-296e-4208-ab79-328a991016bc.Text: {n}Proctor Yeager nods without taking her eyes off her data-slate. Evidently, the fate of these people interested her only within the framework of statistics.{/n} "Then it is settled. Your shuttle is ready to depart. We will take care of—"

4e6dd133-6cd8-4ffb-bae2-6645af3db5c9.Text: "The authenticity of the Administratum and Adeptus Arbites authorisations has been verified upon your vessel's identification. I am aware that this is not a social visit. Speak plainly: why has the head of the dynasty come here in person?"

f8c39819-f354-4399-908c-750f060069b8.Text: "That depends entirely on you and what you are about to tell me."

a4e51422-3afd-43e1-bab2-3550eb8fa3c5.Text: "The first line of defence is secrecy. No one knows the coordinates of this world except the Marshal — and now you. The second is the automated defences and the communication systems between the warehouses. Each Arbitrator is responsible for their own sector and keeps it secure. There is also the last line of defence."

0c2a03d0-4e78-4238-af48-d9fcc84b5a2d.Text: "The self-destruction of the planet." {n}Yeager replies briefly, her fingers never leaving the command runes on the data-slate.{/n}

ac6fe082-7b3d-4f8e-8c58-c010ccf561fc.Text: "It was provided to us by Theodora von Valancius at the request of the Adeptus Arbites. The bowels of Leethus are packed with cyclonic bombs, manufactured to special order on Kiava Gamma. In the event of the imminent loss of the world to enemy attack, we will trigger the Oblivion directive and completely annihilate the planet. The tithe is paramount. It cannot be allowed to fall into the wrong hands, and we are willing to go down with it to prevent that from happening."

a18e716a-9f38-4f1c-b669-82956cb0023e.Text: "Blast it!" {n}Yeager whispers, grabbing her data-slate and typing frantic commands into it.{/n}

05f3db9e-73f9-48db-979a-6b240c466888.Text: "According to the last report, the losses have not yet exceeded the acceptable value set by the Administratum. The new inventory will show how well we have done in securing the sacred tribute. Would you like to see the numbers?"

b7535627-17d1-430c-ab68-c3345a65394b.Text: "In other words, you are sitting on your hands. We both were trained in punitive tactics, but you are the one who doesn't have the brains to apply them without compromising the mission."

2e6cbded-a84b-457d-94f1-94ca4ce12989.Text: "My job is to guard the tithe, even from a Rogue Trader if necessary. Kindly explain yourself, or I will be forced to take action."

b2b84b5a-eebf-4310-8bd4-2ee19868b79a.Text: "Greetings, Yeager. The lack of provisions and order here has driven the recruits to anarchy. You were supposed to keep the Guardsmen in good shape. I am waiting for an explanation."

2e17f038-161a-434d-97f4-219433cc7905.Text: "Yeager. So, it is under your watch that the living tithe has fallen into heresy. You have the men and the weapons, yet the sector in your charge is an utter mess. Such poor stewardship of the sacred tribute borders on treason."

36838030-505a-465c-8b91-4f8df1f3abfa.Text: "They have spawned extra mouths and rebelled against their commanders. There were too few of us to prevent this, but we will not issue a single extra ration merely over of an unplanned human surplus."

4fa79efe-7789-4418-8569-292288a6cba0.Text: "I won't even ask if you have tried to petition the Administratum for additional provisions. I know it is not in your instructions and I can see that you do not care about this 'human surplus,' as you put it."

66a0f6b7-44f5-43de-a1bc-b669f6586122.Text: "We do not have enough resources to—"

1cf51b70-c79f-448f-aa06-0271bfc259a7.Text: "What do you think you are doing, Yeager? Lower your weapon this instant!"

987645bb-6e14-4670-bb08-8549385477df.Text: {n}Solomorne looks you in the eye and shakes his head.{/n} "It's pointless. She has spent too much time in this insane place."

c72a8783-4b79-401c-900e-593a10d89336.Text: "Sending the Rogue Trader on errands... The nerve of this woman..."

49cadb57-98ff-4786-ae59-ed63562e882c.Text: "You know, shereen, I find myself questioning two things in this life: whether Arbitrators understand what 'secrecy' means, and whether one can consider it a good idea to be walking around on a planet packed with a gigaton of explosives."

a2d71b22-061a-450c-b2d0-b83ff81088d2.Text: "The process is questionably streamlined. According to initial data analysis, these laypeople demonstrate an efficiency ratio of under thirty-eight point four five percent."

ae14ceac-843a-4612-aa44-2212035eae53.Text: "Allow me to explain: you seized the tithe by somehow obtaining both the Marshal's and the Administratum's authorisations. Then, an accomplice contacted you and tricked the machine spirits into activating the destruction of the world with cyclonic bombs — bombs delivered years ago from a von Valancius world, I should add. All that is left to do is get away and cover your tracks. Did I miss anything?"

d5f1ca83-76d4-48e2-b75f-fa7e7df9591b.Text: {n}Marazhai tsks in exasperation.{/n} "Would you be so obliging as to finally blow something up or otherwise enliven this tedious conversation? The propensity of the mon-keigh for these protracted and futile efforts to avoid violence is enough to make me wonder if I should... cut down the number of negotiating parties." {n}The Drukhari's stare causes Yeager to turn pale.{/n} "One brazen tongue removed — and we are free. Does that not sound tempting?"

a6884957-7b76-46e6-b079-50981b355ded.Text: {n}Marazhai bares his teeth.{/n} "Here comes my favourite part."

ebbc3174-9596-4604-9252-dbd349463632.Text: "Do not confuse my responsibilities with yours. My duty is to guard the tithe, not ingratiate myself with people of higher standing."

3f7f828e-8896-49c7-95c3-86dd476d54ab.Text: "It is easy to judge for one has not had to rot here through long years of waiting amidst dust storms, predators, and madmen worse than any beast. Yet, we survived, and we continue do all that is possible and impossible alike using the strength of the few that yet remain on this world... esteemed Magos."

e7a56101-5ef3-4ee3-ae43-448ea7b323d5.Text: "By all means, converse away. That will only increase your chances of meeting an early... agreement."

99cc13f6-4092-4e07-bd49-25a1b3e157f9.Text: "Thank you, Rogue Trader. Duty stands above all, and it is good to meet someone who understands that. Now, on to the purpose of your inspection."

023200a3-4737-4089-a124-f981070e381b.Text: {n}Marazhai glances lazily at Kibellah.{/n} "Do you see? Your deadly little pet could use a few body parts for her amusing rituals."

c68fc146-5532-4b35-84c7-72a88db6e43b.Text: "Your own tongue will suit me just as well, xenos. Though I would prefer the heart."

8ca174a7-bbcb-41d6-9eb6-51017a00c070.Text: {n}Solomorne only silently closes his eyes, his expression turning stony.{/n}

0ef193c5-dfb9-4309-9f40-02c2dc66b478.Text: {n}The pained crease between Yeager's eyebrows grows even deeper.{/n} "I may have overestimated your role in the current events."

e4736c99-3d21-4b7b-b9c8-fe76ef144a95.Text: "Rogue Trader, we are now in the final stage of the loading process. Consequently, your shuttle is finally able to manoeuvre around and land. As soon as the matter of the inventory is settled, you will be free to depart."

c4e37eba-2987-4587-9f76-11d3612e522e.Text: "Lord Captain, your shuttle pilot reports that due to the loading activity, it is no longer possible to keep the shuttle on Leethus's surface — there is a risk of collision with the cargo handling mechanisms. The shuttle will remain in orbit until it can safely land at the Arbites outpost and take you aboard."

83ad6c0f-69a8-42aa-a6f9-2f71108aa87d.Text: "Hardly, but I can give a brief resume. Like other scribes, Quart was personally selected by the prefect to maintain the inventory. He is meticulous, efficient, and incredibly committed. I saw him on several occasions, and he was always immersed in his work." {n}Yeager frowns slightly.{/n} "Perhaps even obsessively so."

77049ed3-9954-47fe-bcd6-b0bf354b903e.Text: "Considering the necessity of the Adeptus Arbites maintaining its alliance with your dynasty, the Marshal may well give his assent to such a penalty." {n}Yeager bows her head.{/n} "This insolent lawwoman has fully earned her punishment and will be watching her mouth from now on."

d330cd66-88bd-4b3f-8ef8-a02be3ed1f75.Text: "I doubt there exists a protocol for a crisis like this, but... I hear the voice of the Lex Imperialis in {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Arbitrator}your words{/d}." {n}She frowns, but the suspicion in her gaze has somewhat eased.{/n}

baa7b63d-06b3-47e8-9a6c-2fab95f72a67.Text: "Are you going to forge these savages into soldiers of the Astra Militarum? A difficult project, but {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Militarum}you seem to know{/d} what you are doing." {n}Yeager enters a few commands into her data-slate.{/n} "That is all. You can board the shuttle now, and we will—"

b46e0fae-f4c7-431d-a7a3-8573f79cbb27.Text: "Then let us not waste time and move on to the purpose of your inspection."

15c96312-1d6b-4f04-9b78-b7788e9a9df7.Text: "I doubt anything will happen while you are here."

8da8d80c-5054-47a0-ab36-4bbf6227b25c.Text: "Proctor Yeager, you have no right to threaten a Rogue Trader on {mf|his|her} own planet." {n}Solomorne speaks each word in a soft yet confident voice, somehow overriding the wailing sirens.{/n} "Especially when the barges are being sent to Dargonus on the Marshal's orders. If that is not enough for you, I will personally vouch that {name} von Valancius is not in league with some unknown criminal."

9d6194ae-975d-4d15-8620-c9edb7148e38.Text: "Enough, Yeager. Not only are your efforts not helping to protect the tithe, they are actually hurting the cause. Lay down your weapons before you make one final mistake."

82d01b55-2a75-460d-b961-5e7e77d4a73d.Text: "Only the Rogue Trader can transport the tithe and get everyone out of here. You will bow your head and wait for the Marshal's judgement in handcuffs."

d2ef0015-50ef-408c-93da-af30833b9d5d.Text: "Fine, you got me: I am from the Riven Sky. What's more, I am its ruler!"

88a14679-ea9e-42ad-abb8-8261de426616.Text: "I need to get to the Arbites outpost."

1cb25e1c-1ea9-41c8-86b2-ccc89f8d99b7.Text: "What makes you think there is no Imperium?"

077eef51-4fe6-4a4c-be71-da7861056d84.Text: "You saw my shuttle arrive with your own eyes. Where do you think I came from?"

cc17eb19-a8fd-4cac-993b-abad73dd4158.Text: "If the Imperium does not exist, then who feeds you?"

8bbbd56b-7a46-4b64-80ad-d7f90fcc90ae.Text: "What do you need so many soldiers for?"

226e0689-55a1-4c5d-bbe8-95d0d9761bd9.Text: "Your plans do not interest me. I am leaving."

cec874f1-e188-4e81-ade5-f0b2684c04c3.Text: [Attack] "I will put an end to this madness."

72eb776e-af80-4280-9fda-48fad7f32034.Text: "No matter your numbers, you will never take the Arbites outpost."

38b87ebb-e229-45ca-a005-6f5d5f5f23c6.Text: Called on the Guardsmen from the living tithe to be loyal to the Imperium.

4f40d999-f53e-4457-a616-3cf7b144eadb.Text: [Address the Guardsmen] "Make the decision here and now: are you loyal children of the Imperium, or are you traitors befuddled by a heretic?"

a944a4ef-f7bd-4c9d-a8eb-156a4b37443a.Text: "Abelard, explain to this man at once how he will address me."

8eaea8b8-9268-4604-9834-b9bc0bb96f3e.Text: "And you admit to murdering your commander so easily?"

eeaccdb8-7f4f-49ec-8f6d-820bf081916f.Text: "You had better explain immediately what the warp is going on here."

bacb0726-71be-4290-bcaa-e684f68ff218.Text: "Guardsmen! I have walked the road from private to lieutenant general, and I say to you now: this madman has no right to lead you. Even fresh recruits like you should be able to tell the difference between a true commander and an impostor!"

318b13fc-88a3-4663-9f42-e7206a9273fd.Text: "People follow you because you have survived horrors they have never dreamt of. But if pain makes a person stronger, then you are nothing compared to me."

82ec413d-30bd-4209-a132-dd539bef9519.Text: "What nonsense! I am a fake? My name resounds throughout the Imperium — you must have heard of me."

741f104f-8486-474c-84cd-3a01f5ed3317.Text: {n}A man steps forward. The hideous burns on his head make it look like a ball of molten wax. The pupil of one of his eyes is clouded, but the other eye is sharp and alert.{/n} "I heard a shuttle, and here you are. Not a tithe, not clerks, but guests from the Riven Sky — the chance we've long been waiting for."

e84b9931-d25b-4770-a354-8f5119b60d8e.Text: "Destruction of the sacred tithe. Unlicensed reproduction. Repeated defamation of the Adeptus Arbites. I revoke your right to beg for mercy during the arrest."

583b7221-5826-44ae-b864-d97f7ced128d.Text: "Your choice was between starving to death and desecrating the tithe. This mitigating circumstance will be taken into account during your sentencing."

d03601ec-ad01-4e10-948a-fe5daa324e99.Text: "They should have hanged a few of your unauthorised families. You would have learned an important lesson in maintaining order, without falling below your initial head count."

b5d1eb22-0ee8-48a3-84d4-522fdeb77f48.Text: {n}The madman raises his only remaining eyebrow in mock surprise.{/n} "Pray tell, where on this Emperor-cursed world do you mean to go? Perhaps to the Arbites? Then, allow us to take you there. With such an esteemed guest for a hostage, I won't have to storm their fortifications: they will open the gates themselves. Stepchildren, kill our guest's retinue. They would encumber the negotiations."

7a48e1c9-541a-4411-bfbe-2accf25e3e3e.Text: "Self-proclaimed Captain Walz, a Stepchild of the Imperium, as we all are here. A living tithe abandoned to his fate. And a death world veteran who ended up among recruits by mistake."

d9cde18a-ec6b-417f-ad0e-08b2b0fe26a6.Text: "That's what you emissaries of the Riven Sky always say, because you're afraid of one who knows the truth."

41f56910-3351-4994-ac5a-9518663fa1df.Text: "Of course you do. Where else? I know the way. I dream of their little fortress at night, overwhelmed and aflame. The avenues of approach, the adjacent high grounds, the shelters — they are all burned into my mind because of how often I think about that place. The Stepchildren and I will arrive there very soon."

2ce583d4-a974-4a75-81a0-1f7e8b0a56c4.Text: "I will raise the bloodied head of the false law on a spike and destroy the illusion that the Riven Sky has any power left in it. Then, the other Guard units will join me, and our march toward the stars will begin!"

de68c78d-c511-4fa4-a3ef-3fb2a9227259.Text: {n}After examining the Guardsman, Kibellah gives a thoughtful nod.{/n} "The blood of a madman is hot, and his organs stay warm for longer... Useful for divinations."

5bcd6e34-6b2b-4510-8c3d-42ce97d48925.Text: "Our illusions were shattered. The Arbites brought us here and left us to rot. For years, we waited for our chance to die heroically in the name of the {g|Encyclopedia:ImperiumGlossary}Imperium{/g}, until we realised: the Imperium is gone. All there is... is the Riven Sky."

fc29f968-37d0-4363-a3c5-9a6b28811e3c.Text: "A warrior robbed of his right to perform feats in battle is akin to a caged beast. First, it is madness that gnaws at his heart, and then, it is Morkai, the bringer of death."

1555b20f-62fa-4f45-980a-fc92d55915f4.Text: {n}The revolting semblance of a smile appears on his melted face.{/n} "Look around you! Everything you see was a tithe — a sacred payment to the Imperium. And what became of it? Why did it never travel to other worlds as we'd been promised? Why are we starving here instead of doing battle among the stars? Because there's nothing there, that's why..."

aa0cbe84-f36f-4bfe-a0da-55d4e51fe84f.Text: "The Riven Sky. You children of the abyss like to toy with our minds.
