You keep bringing new garbage here and dumping it on our heads — all just to maintain the feeble facade of your lies! And you keep talking about a future that will never come... Enough!"

278cfe38-8a11-413d-9e12-df5e6ec433fc.Text: "We break the containers open, and we get our own sustenance. At least the food we have here is real. Your minions, the Arbites, toss us some rations, but they aren't enough for the whole regiment. There are too many of us now."

de63419f-5a17-4000-80ce-ca9641b33f87.Text: "Conspiracy to murder members of the Adeptus Arbites. The sentence is death. Further questioning would be pointless, Rogue Trader."

e8efdcb7-a35c-42c6-98f3-c450c017b3a2.Text: {n}Solomorne rubs the bridge of his nose wearily.{/n} "I have no further questions for anyone who is clearly out of their mind. The question I would like to ask is if there was ever a way to prevent this ugly situation."

e35a37f4-37ec-42b7-bfca-4683dbad2d45.Text: "Oh no. First, I will disembowel you in front of your Guardsmen. Then, I'd like to see what passes for the Arbites around here. I will ask them this: why in the void's name does rabble dare to speak of Arbitrators with anything other than terrified reverence?"

1613c6b6-1608-434e-af46-5a8cc30a4a89.Text: "Me? No, no, we need each other! Only together can we take on the Riven Sky and its emissaries. First we take out the Arbites, then we fly to the steel star in the sky. There, we will strike down the false rulers and begin our restoration of the true Imperium!"

dbf11e16-93a1-45ca-a291-37e914d4ea27.Text: {n}The madman's face breaks into a smile.{/n} "Ah, I'm sure that's what you think! You have one of the law dogs at your side. So, you are their commander, emissary of the Riven Sky! With you as my hostage, the Arbites will open their gates to me without a fight. Take this one alive, Stepchildren. We don't need the rest of them."

8ca00690-48f7-416e-b2a7-9a01d4b28968.Text: "Our sergeant... We strung up our sergeant. The Arbites gave him to us. They serve the Riven Sky, and nothing comes from the Sky but evil..." {n}The Guardsman's one eye studies your squad intently, as if calculating something.{/n}

279d6eed-221e-4d6f-9389-c45fba78d371.Text: {n}The soldiers exchange anxious glances. There are hints of doubt and shame in their discordant voices.{/n}

772d986c-82ae-4184-9d2d-90633cc9b613.Text: {n}The soldiers stare at you silently with stern, judging eyes devoid of any remorse.{/n}

9339a426-cf93-427d-b0c9-7655c68a685a.Text: "A sweet lie told by servants of the Riven Sky. Over and over... But not to worry: their end is nigh."

17e63fab-df85-428a-abc5-3ae962cafbf6.Text: "You are wasting your breath. None will renounce the truth once it has been revealed to them."

88f9baf2-1f61-41c6-8eb8-c7bcf2d39b89.Text: "And that outcome is far from the worst."

405e8b90-3dbd-4ec9-b998-a2c612552a8d.Text: {n}The Guardsman's face stretches into a merciless sneer.{/n} "You think I am the monster here, three-eyed thing?"

75bab283-dd80-425a-97ff-f27c2c896ce4.Text: "Commander? No, the enemy! He was hiding the truth from us and prevented us from taking action. His death opened the way to freedom and made us realise that there is nothing up there — we are on our own."

8fb1ee98-2cab-4662-a132-8fc62528d3de.Text: {n}Abelard assumes a most stern expression and proclaims vociferously:{/n} "Guardsman, before you stands Rogue Trader {name} von Valancius, by the will of the Emperor the ruler of millions of subjects and the sovereign of many planets, Leethus included! From now on, you will show {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship} proper deference and obey any order without question."

6e9ac703-d176-41ec-9a16-7d5f84d4275d.Text: {n}The man scrutinises you from top to bottom.{/n} "Yes, I see... I see the crux of the matter: you are someone very important, someone whose arrival can turn the tide. This is even more than I expected."

e4d867d5-a736-43ae-9d4b-8f9a1155ab7a.Text: {n}Shamed by your words, the Guardsmen avert their eyes from you, a {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Militarum}great Astra Militarum commander{/d}, obeying whose orders comes as naturally as breathing to any private.{/n}

75121436-c426-42ae-ae16-a31bbd9e1366.Text: {n}A tremor runs across the man's burned face.{/n} "You are not lying. We have both tasted {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Torture}pure agony{/d} and are forever changed by it. Yes, you are a dangerous opponent."

df5f256d-627a-4cc4-a88f-889a1b121f96.Text: "You are not {mf|him|her}, just another of the Sky's tricks!" {n}But the captain's voice is unable to drown out the whispers of the Guardsmen, who are already recounting your {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_MOT_Glory}story{/d} to each other.{/n}

d7652363-f516-454a-a1c3-197efd4672b6.Text: "These Guardsmen refer to you as captain — I do not know by whom or with what right that rank was given to you, but it means nothing to me. Every living tithe unit must be commanded by a sergeant — where is yours? I need them to take us to the Arbites outpost."

7ac8f949-a97e-4e36-abaa-ab16b92bda55.Text: {n}Solomorne turns to you and comments in a flat voice,{/n} "Murder of a superior officer. Desertion of living tithe quarters. Defamation of {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusArbitesGlossary}Adeptus Arbites{/g} members. More than enough for a verdict."

379e8828-d763-48e0-ba99-6221e0ba11ae.Text: {n}The Guardsman chuckles.{/n} "Don't try to fool me. We both know the truth: the Riven Sky is the abyss that has devoured everything outside — the primordial darkness. Sometimes, the Sky sends people, but they're imitations — shadows wearing human skins. They don't know that they don't exist, but I... I see right through them. They come from the steel star with the scarlet overseeing eye: from your rulers' throne."

1be05cbd-1ced-4185-9863-378c046502a8.Text: "At last, the puppet master has decided to face me. How does it feel to look into the eyes of the last loyal sons and daughters of the Imperium? Don't answer that. I can see all the hate and greed eating you up inside."

e2b0b124-1eb2-4c25-a0ea-8f13361e0048.Text: "That perfectly captures your rotten essence! You take true words and twist them into lies! No, we will put an end to the madness. Stepchildren, attack!"

c3d502be-55ee-4579-a838-a6663ad96bb8.Text: "There is no truth in your doomed mind, Guardsman. By succumbing to doubt, you have embarked on the path of the wicked — and now, you will not escape judgement. For so it is said that all who despair shall betray, and all betrayal shall draw His retribution."

7faffcbd-b0b7-4c0f-befc-6d563dad89c7.Text: "You are not marred by the scabs of corruption, but you still chose to become a monster who would find no rest... Why?"

b2cbf4d8-e681-4722-8f96-7829eaa3b6b3.Text: "Abelard, tell this scribbler what I am here for."

ef95b471-adca-4fa0-8fd1-e7b9dc229bd7.Text: "I am {name} von Valancius. I need the summary report on the tithe."

5ff341d9-44f2-4d10-891b-fc0b915b86de.Text: [Draw your weapon] "Pain will make you more cooperative."

fff2d0ba-3b25-4885-81e3-dcee09787a21.Text: "Do you even realise what the consequences are for attempting to kill a Rogue Trader?"

d3f0d78f-9f3e-489a-8992-e1ce59974ea9.Text: "What did you say about my appearance?"

bd281960-7c3e-47d5-965a-01445fa150c8.Text: [Kill the clerk] "Then I will take it."

0fc7cd92-c7d8-42cc-b56f-047a163bcd42.Text: "As much as I hate to distract you, you are coming with me."

33261de4-9744-45eb-afaa-669f71e4dde3.Text: "You heard Solomorne: time is running out. The document, Quart. No digressions!"

870bb8b5-445c-44fd-a880-42179ea3fc38.Text: "Regarding the Adeptus Arbites member of below-average physical integrity, enter in the inventory: 'Honesty: below average. Ethics: second-hand. Disappointment: massive.'"

35195e31-85e6-4ed8-9d27-684056e78c66.Text: [Take your clothes off] "You know what? I'm going all the way!"

70cbf3c7-55d6-4136-9874-c069eb3baf2d.Text: "Add to the Arbitrator's record: running from his feelings and pushing away the one person who loves him regardless."

6d043292-6a1c-4a33-a74f-52a428c65152.Text: "You face Rogue Trader {name} von Valancius, peasant! On your knees is how you are to greet me! And I will be expecting an inventory of this place's riches from you."

472c61bf-303a-4abb-aa58-6b33b1c5c84b.Text: [Reach for the data-slate] "Is that the inventory? Excellent. Give it to me."

466315c6-c556-418e-87ba-7d052565417d.Text: "Why were so few clerks assigned to an entire planet?"

c7b45126-c569-4b3b-9351-360b6a009442.Text: "There is no cogitator with the inventory, is there?"

36909fd4-0fb1-4165-82d6-2ae1442a4504.Text: "Not another word. And do not even think about falling behind."

185795d8-0e63-4605-908e-b45f99489ae1.Text: "How did ambulls get here in the first place?"

468bebf8-92aa-4b61-a075-73790b88e532.Text: "Enough! I will just drag you before the Arbitrators and let them deal with you!"

884724ec-512a-47f6-89ee-e89920f53ee2.Text: "Well, let us see what you have to say."

e907485b-d6f2-48b2-a397-0a4cb7cf2e95.Text: "Have you gone deaf? Where is the inventory?"

5b3db7a6-24bb-4f74-974a-19b72e4a773e.Text: {n}The grey-clad man taps his fingers on his data-slate. His bulky head {g|Encyclopedia:AugmentationGlossary}implant{/g} showers the surroundings liberally with sparks.{/n} "Two hundred million... No! Didn't account for corrosion... But where?"

56ddc8df-f9ef-48bb-9e58-e995dabf96a9.Text: {n}The Seneschal's booming voice causes a small avalanche of grain in one of the opened containers.{/n} "{mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship} Rogue Trader {name} von Valancius, bearer of the sacred Warrant, has come to collect the inventory of the tithe shipment."

f6313799-2f45-4799-8d11-f96077852dfe.Text: {n}The clerk winces and mutters mechanically,{/n} "Tertius Quart, rank three scribe of the Departmento Catalogus, quantity: one! The inventory— it—"

c4578b90-c906-4f8f-bb46-8efd4523dfd7.Text: "Another unauthorised addition to the living tithe?" {n}The clerk waves you off, annoyed.{/n} "Your turn is in eight cycles! Shoo!"

a3bc8d9e-cec2-4a6b-945a-f2b293d846e0.Text: {n}His dry, reddened eyes fix upon you.{/n} "There is no Rogue Trader on the inventory! I can't give you anything before I fill in the forms! So, let's start with the retinue..."

60ff8945-647c-4810-b469-b8aadda0ec1b.Text: "A woman of benign appearance, quantity: one. An opulence of golden Aquilas and Imperium-standard skulls suggests an affiliation with the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMinistorumGlossary}Adeptus Ministorum{/g}. What department are you from?"

0ed2999e-19f4-42e4-aade-ea532f1b2a52.Text: {n}The clerk nods quickly, pressing his fingers to his split lips.{/n}

c741bbb8-6e42-4026-8fbf-8e6d483f3614.Text: "A mutant with albinism, quantity: one. The gill slits suggest an ocean world origin. Note: skin desiccated. Placement in a liquid-filled tank recommended to avoid spontaneous disposal."

20a85e2e-79d6-446b-9fbb-ad8bd8bafda0.Text: "Guard private, aged, quantity: one. Deterioration: high. Unfit for duty..."

86cddf24-6de3-4be1-aa70-7b15afe80066.Text: "A Rogue Trader, quantity: one. Bloodstain count on attire: twenty... Could you turn around?"

668ba802-5653-4651-8958-c016a6a87ca1.Text: "Yes! Death! But, with you gone, the tithe would've stayed here! It would've given me time... Meeting the target, filling in the last form: those are the only things that matter!"

644f470d-87d5-4810-824c-29ffd0a2d9f4.Text: "There used to be more of us. Five died of exhaustion. Three were killed in collapses of tithe assets. Two were eaten by ambulls. Another ten... no, elev— I don't know! Administratum replenishments are too rare! This world is too highly classified!"

d07e55f0-7dbc-4c43-a2f2-0542e1758d53.Text: {n}The clerk gives you a hounded look, his implant crackling ominously.{/n} "You've eliminated the ambulls? G-good. I'm crossing them off the inventory. How many injuries have you sustained? I must account for the units of blood spilt..."

e31f0313-90e6-426c-b23a-a34a8d787f6f.Text: "Please understand: I need time for additional inventory-taking! Just a little. A couple of... years. No, decades..."

9a0f0646-a2c9-498d-8478-f5da1bea5906.Text: {n}Tertius's face brightens suddenly as his implant flashes again.{/n} "Ah, yes! Yes, of course... Let me open the path to the... the cogitator! That's where the inventory is."

53804011-3daf-4489-8463-9850f7b9228f.Text: {n}The clerk's eyes well up.{/n} "I thought it would stop you! I have a job to finish!"

6382cff5-2896-472b-b0a1-caca198f6746.Text: "It's incomplete!" {n}The scribe recoils and clutches his head with a moan.{/n}

73319336-cf71-43d0-a8f0-174171520c05.Text: "The inventory is in my implant. And it's notifying me of unaccounted-for assets — all the time!" {n}The clerk whimpers; his implant creaks in response.{/n} "My head is the inventory..."

a979f644-2905-4568-8bf0-7ccd48b91709.Text: {n}The clerk sobs and lowers his sparking head, ready to follow you.{/n}

88cc1530-0c99-45d2-a8fd-584541989753.Text: {n}The clerk collapses to the ground. The smile frozen on his face is one of a man relieved of an unendurable burden.{/n}

0a078c66-2576-4abd-bdc8-0a8c7e7794d0.Text: "Inventory of the Rogue Trader: complete. Thank you for your cooperation. Now, regarding the tithe..."

cc086c5e-7d9d-475c-97ed-c15f51da851b.Text: {n}The clerk gets to work enthusiastically, as if he hadn't heard you.{/n}

70f3a230-5cd7-44bd-a3d4-e1e5e92b4342.Text: "An Ogryn, quantity: one, extra shaggy. Hazy-eyed, unencumbered by intelligence. Everything within the norm. Equipped with Adeptus Astartes power armour from the Space Wolves arsenal. Note: send an enquiry to Fenris regarding possible theft."

0e2cd76e-a647-4551-b79a-29f71b5fefb0.Text: "A servitor of non-standard configuration, quantity: one. Frame: feeble. Functionality: dubious. Signs of subpar lobotomy evident."

54cbd146-42b3-4048-89b2-c2a97affb4cf.Text: "A sister of the Adepta Sororitas, quantity: one. Beauty: indescribable. Grace: perfect. Majesty: extraordinary."

5c292040-97c7-4af5-ba90-88362cdb0228.Text: "A member of the Adeptus Arbites, quantity: one. A non-standard-issue cyber-mastiff, quantity: one. Physical integrity: below average. Configuration: secondary. Jaw: prognathous and powerful. All of the above applies to both units."

c300b273-019c-4426-8ac1-32ed659a724a.Text: "What? Yes. The assessment is standardised. Don't argue with it." {n}The clerk touches his implant pensively. It has finally stopped sparking.{/n} "Excellent, very good! We're almost done... Now, to finalise your inventory record, please take off your clothes."

54261170-432e-49bf-a6e6-aafaef1ed1bf.Text: "A mutant most abominable, quantity: one... Scrawny, ugly, and underfed. Adding a recommendation for disposal..."

7914267e-35dd-4936-8bae-051d30591aa5.Text: "And other hired personnel of no note."

30298ac0-a01b-4383-93f5-02e030890851.Text: "This concludes the inventory of the retinue. Proceeding to taking inventory of the Rogue Trader."

41144ed0-e18a-43ba-8a24-4bbdd747b6cc.Text: "...Twenty-six. Equipment condition: excellent. Limb count: satisfactory. Appearance: unremarkable. Self-importance: elevated."

c6a45ed2-54ec-4cd3-a0d6-66ec24175759.Text: "You can't imagine how hard this is — the workload, the responsibility! Please understand: I'm on my own here! Well, almost..." {n}The clerk adds in a conspiratorial whisper,{/n} "There's another scribe here. He works at night and litters the reports with errors!"

5177fd5b-8685-4dd4-919b-526ac8b24ed1.Text: "A-ambulls! Repulsive, aggressive pests! They adapt to any environment... This world is infested with them! They got to the tithe and gobbled up everything they saw. And I had to update the inventory!" {n}The clerk's voice falters and turns into inconsolable weeping.{/n}

57c9b813-7413-40cd-8b84-efed7c3df1dc.Text: "Lord Captain, why can't you be like other Rogue Traders in how you express your eccentric side? You could reserve a deck for grox races. You could use your crew members as human pieces in games of regicide. At a pinch, you could have your face carved into an asteroid!"

15282004-5000-4525-9b44-cb4fb7b62ba3.Text: {n}The Lady Navigator covers her brightly blushing cheeks and turns away.{/n} "Not one eye of mine will behold that image... Not one..."

c0d3d8a8-9531-46f9-96b1-3f5ec294f439.Text: "I had become so obsessed with the prospect of seeing mountains of treasure, I forgot you were the real treasure all along, shereen!" {n}Jae makes herself comfortable, intending to fully enjoy the "inventory-taking."{/n}

2ed77c40-f4d6-40b1-b61a-57c81801ec28.Text: {n}The clerk grabs his quill greedily, ready to catalogue your every birthmark and scar.{/n}

4c423458-ecb1-4d08-842c-c4afaa456fdd.Text: "A man of worn-out appearance with a heavy stare, quantity: one... What department are you from, colleague?"

3fe95f35-9bb2-40eb-a2e8-a2d9ebc99245.Text: "A pale, lanky woman, quantity: one. Multiple signs of battery, evidence of malnourishment. Best category fit: Servants. Subcategory: Idlers."

f420e97a-5956-4c3a-abf6-822d2c9fb41f.Text: {n}The Proctor's heavy fist crashes into Tertius's jaw, and a bloodied tooth clangs against the wall of a nearby container.{/n} "Account for this. No more evasiveness or asinine excuses. The Rogue Trader asks, and you answer. Is that understood?"

8724a906-847e-4c0f-8082-8692d4275a02.Text: "He has lost his mind and is unlikely to recover it. I see no point in judging a madman. I suggest simply collecting the inventory and leaving."

4f53fd03-c52f-44a8-b2b7-38b2e250e417.Text: "Your confession does nothing to diminish your guilt. You will die for what you did, either here or following your return to the Administratum and a lengthy investigation."

88dcbb20-fb99-4455-b481-bd4afd00bdbd.Text: "Just one question: are you aware that this will go into the report to the Marshal?" {n}Solomorne's iron palm covers his face.{/n} "Or, worse, do you actually want this in the report?"

5b4166ac-ea5a-48b7-89f8-818a856ed122.Text: "Th-the Administratum? No! Let me finish the inventory, or kill me... What do I have to sign?"

a28d9444-914b-4280-ad50-6a72550673b0.Text: "He is stalling. He will continue to chatter away unless harsh action is taken."

08bcc6ef-4bb0-4bf2-8a6e-e9cd4c3d2e78.Text: {n}The clerk's tense shoulders relax a little.{/n} "I believe you... But the report... Just one more tiiiny bit of stock-taking, all right?"

16e46998-08d8-48bf-97b4-3a797803d482.Text: "I am not even sure which offends me more: your invaliding me or your mistaking me, an officer of the Navy, for an expendable Guardsman."

6796711c-2884-4e9d-8f78-458327a089bd.Text: {n}Ulfar makes a superstitious gesture to ward off evil.{/n} "Spilling the blood of a harmless fool is a bad omen. The feebleness of mind might spread to the killer. And that is the only thing saving this filthy-tongued louse's life."

7755443d-ee3e-452c-8958-cce4af6dc7bc.Text: "The unit's degraded cognitive capacity is confirmed. The unit's functional value is unconfirmed. Requesting termination of vital functions in the name of mercy."

5cf6ad24-e574-49b8-81af-784d9c05377e.Text: "This servant's colours are mad— Wait, did I just get called a fish?"

93879b14-69cd-4f4b-9c49-60fa60a091ed.Text: "Perhaps I should carve your words into his skin with my blade, Domin? He seems to want..." {n}Kibellah grins darkly.{/n} "...a written request."

6a8b694c-bbd9-4978-8924-c2eb756c6ac2.Text: "There's irony in a complete lunatic being the only one who thinks me normal."

4ce252a1-1f91-47de-ab12-3b19a19a4852.Text: "You are inventing some lady of the court in the place of the warrior you are looking at! What is this so-called inventory?"

9d020962-0654-4484-84f0-1529ba0dcabe.Text: "Do not protest, sweet-voiced sister! Has the scribe said a word of untruth?"

727f5e4c-2a20-421d-b6c7-107d86ef0289.Text: "Put 'N/A' in that field, 'colleague.' And add a note at the top of my sheet that says, 'burn before reading.'"

4faab3c7-eb83-49e2-8ff1-ebde90983234.Text: "No offence, but I would not trust you with an inventory of Glaito's shit, what with how deranged you are. And to think that someone gave you the Expanse's entire tithe to freely desecrate."

d3d8a183-cc96-4b9d-beda-6feed2198f41.Text: "The deeper my knowledge of your species becomes, the more often I ask myself: how have you colonised so many worlds? How did you reach the stars to begin with?"

4e887ced-ea0b-4aee-8d22-dab63c00cfde.Text: "'Disposal'... Your mon-keigh threats could at least use some variety. But even there, your imagination goes no further than a trite promise of premature demise."

97256fa9-1954-481e-aab7-04ff9b0781ce.Text: "Benign appearance? Yes, that's me! Put down 'Adeptus Amasecus' as my department, esteemed one."

8dc0f489-29a9-4d45-838e-3528de7563e7.Text: "Relax, Tertius. There is no time for any further inventory-taking. Just give us the report, and we will take you to the shuttles without any trouble."

78213ae4-c689-4c7c-9082-344fe7ad8e4e.Text: "The sub-items have been entered, thank you for your cooperation." {n}Under Solomorne's judgemental gaze, the clerk pokes his finger at the data-slate.{/n}

7a173e61-a4f3-41aa-9ce3-078afe236392.Text: {n}Solomorne sighs helplessly.{/n} "Mercy, Rogue Trader, I beg you."

8c732bcf-db83-4fa7-805e-d9876ec23a86.Text: "I am not authorised to release documents of such importance to individuals who have not identified themselves."

d4c15363-cafe-4d6f-8a52-4ccc5a734624.Text: {n}The clerk yanks the data-slate away with surprising agility and hunches protectively over it.{/n} "No! This device is already on the inventory list and must not be removed! I— I? Yes, I must make a note of attempted theft on the record! Please state clearly the offender's name and occupation."

14904ff7-e416-4e16-b325-31c69d0885e4.Text: "Are you a servitor or something different?"

fbab55e7-9554-4b49-9a3d-0b2647311f44.Text: "Explain to me what is going on. Now."

9359ceee-08b2-4be2-82c6-37f76a447164.Text: [Draw your weapon] "I am not playing your games."

b1a4fe44-e7a0-4ff7-a358-26733c38ef7d.Text: "You still haven't told me your name. Who are you?"

586788c1-290e-49a6-afe9-08cacedc799b.Text: [Attempt to change the machine's parameters] "Let's see if we can expand your privileges."

a1408985-59b4-4ee5-8ac3-aecfbe276b0b.Text: "You crave death. That is not typical for thralls who have no will of their own."

f3c34c41-51ca-4054-acd2-a6da5658e384.Text: "I claim the entire tithe for myself."

1140b0cf-0bf2-4d2a-9b39-274b822986ef.Text: "One more accusation against my dynasty, and you will be going to Leethus through an airlock."

0d50eb73-e5ab-4008-af06-64cccefa82a4.Text: "Solomorne, you are essentially proposing to steal the Imperial Tithe."

7e1ed0a4-2b9e-4b7d-a7f4-0bb4e2d73e7a.Text: [Point your weapon at Solomorne] "This is your final warning."

9f7643e6-9dc4-4e9e-94bd-c3d50ec886cd.Text: "I have decided what should be done with the tithe."

a70cb6b2-9bbf-4c20-b5d1-62782158ecc4.Text: "I still have questions for the watcher of Leethus."

009acfe7-20f2-410d-a5d9-b66f3db7ffe7.Text: Sent the tithe to Dargonus in full.

1c348194-ff75-4cc3-b37f-e76201a5e06d.Text: "I will not overstep the Imperium's law: the tithe must go to the Administratum."

e0441b2c-2a1a-41c3-a304-8a8b1b2194a6.Text: Sent a part of the tithe to support the worlds of the Expanse.

4b18ebeb-11ac-4e3c-9b8d-36bc411f2f2c.Text: "A portion of the tithe will remain with me, and I will see to it that it finds its way to worlds affected by the crisis."

2edd5fef-80a8-4ed9-8d55-6f2e543696d2.Text: Kept a part of the tithe for yourself.

cd5ea99a-cb1f-481e-9b54-69be127c83eb.Text: "A share of the tithe belongs to me by the right of the strongest. It will serve to support my reign in the Expanse."

9b8bf96d-df35-44a3-b206-0e023921782b.Text: "You have yet to ask me how your sister died."

758f4723-f358-422a-acb4-310c9d086a54.Text: Diverted the entire tithe in order to strengthen the Imperium in the Koronus Expanse.

c1c1987b-15fe-4c85-a1c1-b6a0406dbf20.Text: "I am acting for the good of the Imperium. The Maw is closed, and the tithe is going to waste. Therefore, I will instead use it to establish a bulwark of order in the Koronus Expanse, and once the passage is reopened, the tithe will be repaid a hundredfold."

f233ecae-05e1-47cc-9e5f-66a5f36bbd30.Text: "Very well. But if Theodora were to order you to tell her your name, how would you respond?"

5bf168cd-0a99-4182-a1a3-55c8e68e756b.Text: "Were you the one who intruded on my conversation with Vigdis prior to our landing on Leethus?"

c71f0912-21fe-41b2-a8a7-2369b638a053.Text: "Why were you consigned to such a terrible fate?"

87251085-846d-4c6f-8371-3f8e9ecc4118.Text: Diverted the entire tithe to aid the worlds of the Koronus Expanse.

8fc5e3e7-73a9-4916-885d-a1ba79bdb757.Text: "The Expanse is in danger. I want to use the tithe to protect the entire sector. Does the Imperium not exact tribute precisely so that Humanity may survive and advance toward prosperity?"

14950399-7727-496e-b3ac-4a10bfd1be04.Text: "How could Theodora have a brother? Everyone would know of you."

deb22ab3-0890-423b-8f0f-2ee0bc91a1a0.Text: "Would you rather see the tithe rot? That would be tantamount to destroying it. By the right of the sacred Warrant of Trade, I claim the entire tithe for myself. My decision stands."

1ebca597-03f6-43ba-8aca-2bc8c21d0ebd.Text: "I would not mind having a servant like you myself!"

c1f51131-a561-4085-a8e2-d7330c37a214.Text: "You want me to claim the tithe for my own?"

80bb832f-332b-424a-ac99-c81749f13935.Text: Kept the entire tithe for yourself.

7c6d1c75-11bf-4c05-b393-360fab9ee242.Text: [Look Solomorne straight in the eye] "I am the law, in case you had not yet realised. While others are afraid to make a move, I make history. And you will obey now, for my power and greatness are indisputable!"

81b1df4a-1ee6-47fd-b1ab-400430e9bfc6.Text: "Perhaps this is indeed folly. I will reconsider."

7243d2a3-ba50-48c8-81d3-0f005007b185.Text: "Do you serve Theodora or the dynasty? Because at this moment, I am the dynasty."

c52e43bb-5388-4da3-a511-ac9408e4dd77.Text: "Why come up with such an elaborate punishment?"

abfa1558-9d8f-46cf-8de6-6ae6304d6636.Text: {n}A human torso is built into the massive cogitator. Countless cables entangle the shrivelled body and snake under the pale skin.{/n} "Identification: Rogue Trader von Valancius. Initiating the final stage of the Oblivion directive." {n}A ragged wheeze escapes the vox-grille, and the man's speech becomes more animated and bilious:{/n} "You have arrived at last, offspring. At last, everything ends."

d1fc4dfd-0476-4579-ab58-50c32423f200.Text: {n}The man announces in a mechanical voice:{/n} "Supreme ordinance: the arrival of the head of the von Valancius dynasty with the purpose of extraction of the tithe triggers the immediate activation of the Oblivion directive by the watcher of Leethus. At the moment of the directive's activation, the machine spirits of the initiation systems are bound in Prometheus-Proxima-class cogni-shackles. The cogni-shackles cannot be removed by any means. The directive guarantees the Rogue Trader's acquisition of the planet's assets and the destruction of Leethus, presented as being caused by the actions of the enemies of Humanity."

46b9f79a-784d-4ee7-87c8-390acb0af876.Text: "At first I thought Theodora was going to pay me visits so she could gloat, but she never once appeared on the station. I have a different explanation now: for a von Valancius, even punishment must befit his status — with a gilded prison and one-of-a-kind augmetics so as not to have a pathetic servitor mar the dynasty's image."

9250c581-f9f2-4840-9fa1-e20f89cfb59a.Text: "Something entirely different, offspring. A prisoner of my own mind and these machines. Do not let my manner of speech deceive you — I am only following the orders vested in me. The part of my brain that controls my ability to converse and holds the scraps of my personality was severed from my volition centres and locked into a cage of functions and limitations."

817b9d8d-902d-4f0e-923f-61b603a07aa8.Text: "You really do not know. Did she choose not to tell you, or did she not get the chance? It doesn't matter anymore. Yours is the blood of the dynasty, and so, I am compelled to give you this answer..."

2c382839-072e-4af6-aeab-a7b4f0654f70.Text: "These are Theodora's games, not mine. And here we are, playing them even after her death. I am not your enemy — I am your loyal servant."

d00fd820-a574-4619-816f-b3d2ec6aa25f.Text: "Here is where I stand: Lady Theodora has violated the Lex Imperialis, and the Marshal should be informed of her crime. If you are loyal to the Imperium, you will send the tithe to the Administratum and tell Marshal Strachs of the events on Leethus."

6662f07f-fcf3-430e-a530-da5e0289c786.Text: {n}Solomorne gives you a long look before continuing:{/n} "If the Marshal learns the whole truth, it will make things difficult... for everyone. It is better that you redress Theodora's crime by sending part of the tithe to support the afflicted worlds of the Expanse and delivering the rest to the Administratum."

ae24fa27-183f-48b9-8cfc-0f6dc8b19fbb.Text: "I have been in your retinue long enough to acknowledge that you are the only true power in all of the Expanse. I won't object if you decide to leave some of the tithe for yourself — at least then these resources won't rot and instead serve to reinforce order on your worlds. But the majority must still go to the Administratum."

e597d52d-a9e8-42ff-ba3d-1098ca3fbbd5.Text: {n}Idira grins.{/n} "Ah, so that's what's got my whispers all excited. I take it Lady Theodora didn't like you very much since she shoved you into a tin can in the middle of nowhere? You got on her bad side, didn't you?"

a96a4e34-4e6c-49fa-bb4d-635b91f9c4ce.Text: "So you could brag about it to Winterscale at banquets? You are out of luck — there is an entire station attached to me. It supplies me with power, and massive computing modules lie below. Such is the price that you might make small talk with me."

9848b4ab-2513-49ac-b99b-10af4387568d.Text: "The Marshal might get curious when you return to Dargonus without me."

4b701b63-67b8-4247-a24a-deb2fbcd24c6.Text: "Before that conversation we had, I would have considered it a crime myself. But with the Expanse burning, and after witnessing every shade of absurdity on Leethus, my opinion has changed."

4f64f2a5-816e-48a6-b7fb-eae2b32d7b81.Text: {n}There is a heavy pause. Solomorne watches you, unblinking, then finally bows his head.{/n} "Understood, Rogue Trader."

12c722e9-3f4c-445f-b91b-08aa7aa62121.Text: "I was a threat to Theodora's rule, and she had my brain dissected. A sophisticated sentence — to be humiliated, to live in suffering, yet continue to serve the dynasty, perfectly harmless. Absorb this lesson, offspring — that is how a Rogue Trader metes out punishment."

8553a14d-efb1-4f6e-b568-f2c0c35d70cb.Text: "That is the one question I cannot answer. Theodora did not wish for anyone to learn the name of he who has become the watcher of Leethus."

2c456826-a8f6-4e1f-afdc-3751b37a455c.Text: "The Rogue Trader has spoken: the barges will go where {mf|he|she} has decreed, and the watcher of Leethus has served his purpose. I... I had hoped that I would feel relief. I know that it's there, locked inside my protocols. And she... she wanted me to know and to not feel..." {n}The watcher's head hits his sunken chest. Even at the moment of his death, he was denied the elation of freedom.{/n}

873f59e9-a884-4ee1-925f-e898ec93263d.Text: {n}The vid-screens of the cogitators flicker, trying to process the influx of data, then fade all at once.{/n}

8a230d69-4e30-4edb-a4e4-db0694aaca99.Text: "You seek to tamper with something that was created by the brightest minds in the protectorate. You will not succeed."

59dde8ea-c498-4874-aaf4-bee76f5285e3.Text: "Fond of tricks, are you? They won't work, not against my limitations."

6da606e9-b143-4347-9f9c-f34b499549c5.Text: "You rule your protectorate with an iron fist — which is exactly the kind of authority the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanseGlossary}Expanse{/g} needs right now. And unless the Arbites are blind, they will realise that such a valuable ally deserves a commensurate payment for {mf|his|her} help."

295c4dc5-ffe6-48b6-8e94-1280125bbc07.Text: "By the Holy Throne, so that's where I remember that voice from! I saw you once when I was accompanying Lady Theodora. You weren't... as you are now, back then. But she never spoke of you as her brother. Why?"

e574fab8-49b0-4f8b-bd26-130e275eeea2.Text: "I have long since been robbed of the luxury of freely expressing my thoughts. I am merely quoting Theodora's plan."

7842de6c-3bd3-43ad-af24-7099da249054.Text: "It would be best for the dynasty if my identity remained a secret."

0eb35c2b-cf54-4f14-a879-f778a90f91b3.Text: "Oh, the irony... Theodora's great plan, foiled by her own heir."

807a06e0-b941-4acc-a23c-21ee635a68ee.Text: "There are things one should never wish to know, offspring."

aa847ee0-6e66-425c-8b84-ae727d18bc2c.Text: {n}Startled, Solomorne gives you an incredulous look.{/n} "What? Have you been blinded by avarice? To steal the tithe from an entire sector is a heinous crime and an unprecedented act of blasphemy!"

a757ef5e-7d03-4e88-b2e6-22b27443bd1a.Text: "I... I believe him. Lady Theodora always played for high stakes — all or nothing. It's the only game there ever was for her." {n}Idira grimaces, clutches her temples, and snaps as she turns away:{/n} "Will you shut your gobs already? I don't know any Dariuses, got it?"

b85100cd-0515-4005-b946-73fa5fd488eb.Text: "Had I been a legitimate child — yes, they would have written my name in gold into the dynasty's chronicle. However, my mother's origin as well as certain other circumstances were damaging for House von Valancius, and so, my inclusion into the family hit a snag."

d04be9b3-38fc-4269-a2e8-97909db85654.Text: "As Theodora's senior relative and direct heir, I could lay claim to her throne — and I did. I intended to kill her and declare a search for her successor, and while it went on, to enter the Warrant Chamber and assume the Rogue Trader's title by right of blood. Theodora exposed my plan, executed anyone who had taken part in the conspiracy, and turned me over to her Tech-Priests."

703205d2-cf85-4656-ad70-00303160943f.Text: "I agree. The past is best dredged up in small quantities."

8bceccca-8220-4016-935e-1e886a54fd58.Text: "Calling it thinking would be an overstatement. Imagine a corridor with all the doors locked except for one or two — that would be my consciousness. Yes, a dark, suffocating corridor with fading pictures of memory and nail scratches on the walls."

99b1b0fa-8fd0-4b93-aa6e-657dd1329bb9.Text: "What does it matter what I crave if I am doomed to follow orders? Yes, I need you to complete the Oblivion directive and trigger the station's shutdown so that I can be set free at last. And yet, in all these years, I have done nothing to bring my death closer. I can wait an eternity longer. Suffering, but infallibly obedient."

164fc9a4-2900-4b65-82bd-734a6db9d084.Text: {n}Solomorne nods and turns his heavy gaze to the creature.{/n}

5891b6f7-4355-47ea-8c26-6dd5d1007192.Text: "So, Lady Theodora intended to steal the tithe from the start: she arranged the world's destruction to cover her tracks, installed a servant to keep an eye on things, and even made a contingency plan in case of her own death. All she needed was an opportune moment — like this one. With the Expanse being torn apart, the planet's death looks convincing."

479ab970-80d5-4916-b011-777dd3bfa9b6.Text: "What else should I call you? The heir to the dynasty's throne, a young descendant. You may have grown used to people prostrating themselves before you, but to me, you are just a child."

7b972c77-1e4b-4a4a-9ee5-6b7d2fc37f44.Text: "Of course, you are welcome to prolong my agony for as long as you like."

3aba025b-88e7-46b2-90d8-538f1baffcb4.Text: {n}There is a flash of sparks along the exterior of the cogitator, and the smell of burnt meat fills the air. The watcher's voice is cracked and distorted:{/n} "Name: Darius von Valancius. Status: transformed on the order of his younger sister Theodora."

ac361c35-2de3-4a9c-a943-68d6078bf45d.Text: "You may have a point. I am but a servant, and the future of the protectorate is in your hands. You are the authority, and I obey. I am... Darius von Valancius, Theodora's older brother, whom she turned into an amalgam of machine and man."

f889c64f-4dab-49ef-83d5-94bd139c9b98.Text: "Go on, take the last step: confirm the execution of the directive, and in so doing, destroy Leethus, take its riches, and... free me from this unbearable vigil."

79b91f15-4c82-4a67-b11e-c63c3734aa80.Text: {n}The man says nothing for a long time, and the air around the cogitator grows noticeably hotter. Finally, he speaks:{/n} "I would say: dear sister, what a silly question. It is me, Darius, your older brother, whom you condemned to eternal torment."

ccd7f5f3-7d5d-48a7-88c6-32f99fd563e7.Text: "I cannot ask questions about anything unrelated to my function. Now that you have brought it up yourself, however... No, I do not want to know. If I heard that she had died by chance at the hands of an unworthy opponent, I would be gravely disappointed. After all, I have always solaced myself by believing that Theodora was someone extraordinary, and only because of this she was able to beat me."

488746ed-4f50-4fd7-8d4a-83156d88585f.Text: "Helping the distressed planets is an investment in the future. A future which we may not live to see if we don't look after the people. Besides, how are we to collect new tithes without those who labour for the good of the Imperium?"

63c180d3-f4e0-4b95-b011-10839241a99b.Text: "Good. I've had enough complications for one mission."

768599b3-114a-4c80-a91b-0d3a2d0e0d05.Text: "When Theodora was young, I was brought to Dargonus to be trained for the role of Seneschal. When she became the Rogue Trader, she refused to recognise me as her kin. She needed an obedient servant who wouldn't challenge her rule. Had I behaved myself, perhaps Theodora would have condescended to call me her brother and heir on her deathbed."

0a314acf-2cd5-4c08-b54c-2e61c3b00e1d.Text: "You... are a better person than Theodora was. Do not take this as a compliment — it is an extremely detrimental quality for a Rogue Trader."

9ae88c5a-691f-4f26-a600-69c0e58796d7.Text: "You are a worthy successor to the great Theodora von Valancius, whether it pleases you or not."

dc1865ae-7297-474f-9d37-f856e1eada12.Text: "Then you will change nothing. The directive cannot be stopped — the cogni-shackles, once applied to the initiation systems, are unbreakable. Accept your fate, offspring. I accepted mine long ago."

723d759e-a420-4b1e-899f-c03ee6722a9a.Text: "At least you're alone in that corridor and will never have to wonder who's banging on the door from the other side — and how long the flimsy hinges of your mind will hold."

fa342de1-75f3-4168-9f90-98133614886a.Text: "But you wanted her throne, didn't you? Her whole life, she was surrounded by scoundrels who envied her, ready to devour her without a second thought the moment she made a single misstep."

607cc7e6-4711-4f21-9a58-3d61bc03551f.Text: "Worthy and unyielding even under the heavy burden of power. But surely you remember, shereen, that Jae Heydari is always at your service? That is what partners are for: to share their heavy burdens between them."

c18dd562-63c8-4898-8ccb-304625cebffd.Text: "Sisters... Such maddening creatures. At least they cause the mon-keigh just as much trouble."

2fd74ff4-6ba9-4357-bcae-010dd0028c00.Text: "I do not know what kind of person you were, but... I feel sorry for you. To be reduced to an expensive doll, a toy in someone's hands... No one deserves such a fate."

327bf93a-6739-42f3-bc1a-d502c61966ce.Text: "Such a waste of the sacred current of the Motive Force is unacceptable. I demand the immediate cessation of this unit's vital processes without the right to atone for its personal inefficiency."

3d257fa4-d389-4eb5-8f6d-b41bce1c54b0.Text: "Thank the Emperor for ending this brief spell of madness. Give the order to the watcher. We have lost enough time here already."

2b6eab23-399d-45bc-8974-8bbbe395d662.Text: {n}Solomorne stiffens, struggling to say a word. After a long pause, he speaks slowly, almost laboriously:{/n} "You are assuming a very broad interpretation of your authority, Rogue Trader. I do not believe that even the Warrant and the alliance with the Arbites give you the authority to take control of the tithe. However, the situation with the {g|Encyclopedia:Maw}Maw{/g} is a matter of urgency, and you are the only person in the Expanse who can take on this enormous responsibility. I hereby authorise your decision, but you will have to get approval from the Marshal as well."

676f0aac-a84e-41dd-91aa-b367b79db553.Text: "I will not authorise such a heinous violation of the Lex Imperialis." {n}Solomorne stubbornly juts out his chin.{/n} "It is within your power to plunder the tithe, but the consequences will be inevitable. Such a transgression cannot be concealed, and the Adeptus Arbites will demand answers. I have failed to convince you, but I trust the Marshal will change your mind."

43103114-e83a-4e28-9371-d8dbf5d1f30f.Text: "{name}... No, asking you to come to your senses won't do. I know you won't give up." {n}Solomorne presses a fist to his chest, his voice momentarily trembling with pain.{/n} "I will authorise your decision and assume full blame for what happens next. You may take the tithe, but do not deny me that."

ebbad266-def0-44dc-a489-7616f4ac114a.Text: "I must refuse. The supreme ordinance states that if the head of the dynasty has declared the tithe's evacuation, I am to destroy the planet. You are the one who announced to the Arbitrators that you were taking the tithe with you. The directive has been initiated and the cogni-shackles placed. It cannot be stopped."

a0bef99a-55e1-4c67-90db-523a7b5612c5.Text: {n}Solomorne does not take his eyes off you, as if he had been hypnotised.{/n} "May the Lex strike me down! Even allowing for the Warrant and everything that you have single-handedly accomplished in the Expanse..." {n}He shakes his head, unable to break out of his stupor.{/n} "I'll be damned, but your every word rings with truth that I cannot dispute... Of all the people in this sector, you are the only one who can rightfully lay claim to the tithe, and I, Proctor Solomorne Anthar, hereby acknowledge this."

1656fc08-bdaf-4dc2-86f6-c065788f7b98.Text: "{name}, your soft-heartedness is beyond the pale! You dare interpret the Lex Imperialis this way?" {n}Solomorne covers his face with the palm of his hand, trying to reign in his emotions.{/n} "No matter what words you may use, this is still theft, and you are asking me to be an accomplice. Throne's blood..." {n}He lowers his hand, and there is an immense weariness in his gaze.{/n} "So, you put before me a choice: the death of many worlds, or a heinous violation of His Law. I am siding with you, and may the Emperor have mercy. This crime now falls on us both, Rogue Trader."

829ca803-2d4b-4afa-a0af-21f7d93ccf6c.Text: "I have witnessed your deeds that honour the God-Emperor, and I believe that you exercise the power of the Warrant justly — but what you are about to do is unthinkable... And you would have me risk everything: my honour, my life, and the very future of the tithe." {n}Solomorne falls silent and fixes you with his gaze.{/n} "Nevertheless, in the name of the Lex Imperialis, I hereby authorise your decision. All that remains is to pray that the rest of the Arbites see you for the same person I do: a loyal servant and a true conduit of His will."

200bb9b7-3cb3-4a96-9bb1-899ae4d3c7ef.Text: "And so, Theodora's plan is accomplished: the tithe of the Koronus Expanse now belongs to the dynasty. Whether her intentions were the same as yours, offspring, I know not, but that matters little."

5a062df9-a144-4f9e-9a3c-b1246ca32fdd.Text: "Yes, I needed to exchange codes with the flagship in order to identify the vessel and its owner. I had to sift through onboard communication channels and systems to verify the new Lord Captain's data and {mf|his|her} right to be one."

4033de15-bfed-48f5-bdab-d6ad9edde6df.Text: {n}Jae lets out a whistle.{/n} "Now that's ambition — you can't even call it theft! Just an ingenious redistribution of resources on a sector scale. Ingenious and audacious..."

77fe5717-f94a-4072-99a3-0b4d9b7e1057.Text: "This qualifies for a culprit's confession, except the culprit herself is dead and judging this creature would be pointless. Still, we must decide what to do next, Rogue Trader."

bf3ee630-ef78-451b-8a05-b08e0a0709c4.Text: "An outrageous accusation! Lady Theodora never would have sullied herself with such heresy. Stealing the sacred tithe? Never!"

ac66dc27-221c-49bc-b3e6-cbf7d496f71b.Text: "How did they find us? This system's coordinates are classified!"

090827e0-d6a9-4a82-a6f4-f4bfd53e1f1a.Text: {n}Your vox-caster hisses softly, drawing your attention. It seems someone has been hailing you for some time now.{/n} "Lord Captain, your immediate intervention is required. The barges you sent to Dargonus have been attacked by enemy ships that just emerged from the warp."

82017005-d42e-4154-a8a6-1c8b18f01109.Text: "They carry no identifying marks, and the signatures are unreadable. All I can tell you is that they are of Imperial construction."

bd497744-46e5-490a-9142-2177d0c3ba5f.Text: "At present, we do not know, Lord Captain, but we are already working on it."

466bfb94-1cf8-429e-848e-3d1d6b2b5ecc.Text: "Abelard, I entrust the tank to you!"

b4f46c6e-1ffe-4b7b-8d55-eb2fdaa916f6.Text: "Sister Argenta, you know what to do."

f843507e-4bf5-4cda-a4b6-238e1feee8f6.Text: "Kibellah, have you ever shot from a tank?"

cd442411-1246-495f-aa64-599798e4cc46.Text: "This is a task for a Rogue Trader."

5e2b775b-439a-4297-93e6-55c40fa08b4e.Text: "I know who I definitely wouldn't trust to cover me in that thing. I mean you, Solomorne."

3ed8f2f3-0a5a-460f-8f25-fc4884271a0c.Text: [Cast a practised eye over the tank]

6e0da84e-b8ce-4c7b-84c6-b467b5f4895d.Text: {n}Solomorne casts a grave look over the battlefield, then turns sharply to you.{/n} "A change of tactics: we must cut off all the arrival points for their reinforcements. See those cables and counterweights? They're what's keeping the containers suspended. We get rid of the counterweights, and the containers will fall and block the passages. Someone will have to climb into this semblance of a tank and open fire on these targets while the rest activate the shell loading system using the cogitators and hold off the enemies. Choose who will man the tank."

632c4027-1adf-43f8-b4e8-42291e1c6476.Text: "This statement is true in the majority of circumstances. I hereby initiate the rite of mutual identification with the spirit of this machine."

57406bc9-b5a2-4160-b7b6-2bf19d1b6e2c.Text: "Do not look at me, Aett-Vater. This machine may have been blessed with the proud name of Leman Russ, but it is too small to fit one of the Emperor's Angels."

0594671a-fd55-4308-907a-093db274882d.Text: "The mon-keigh consider... this... to be a vessel of war? I won't even touch it, much less get inside it."

13cd6dc8-4af5-4519-843c-92f79f716d51.Text: "Command one of your own kind, elantach. The Path of the Outcast has taught me much, but you may keep the secret to controlling your primitive machines to yourself."

ffbd333e-0131-43e4-87ea-55c4ec46d991.Text: "The last time I drove something like this was before I had my first grandchild... But it will all come back to me once I get my hands on the levers."

28bc4491-5d68-4576-af35-b483b04be730.Text: "I am not— I know a lot about armoured vehicles and ground combat tactics — in theory." {n}Cassia nods cautiously.{/n} "Today, I will move on to practice, if you deem it necessary."

c5bfd648-ce28-452a-aabb-3bcce756ed70.Text: "Consider our enemies fallen, Rogue Trader!" {n}Judging by the enthusiasm in Argenta's voice, she is perfectly capable of driving tanks — or, at least, she thinks she is.{/n}

0b60c8ed-b2bc-43d3-8fa6-85f176a1fb25.Text: {n}The Interrogator sighs.{/n} "You leave me no choice."

cc0136c3-e147-4fb8-a57c-0851f9681208.Text: "Me? Really? All right, little voices, teach the witch how to shoot from a tank... What? No, at the enemies!"

372e05ee-170a-4b38-b326-fc45935746bd.Text: {n}Jae's lips curve into an ironic smirk.{/n} "Private Heydari reporting for duty!"

80865f48-6295-4918-b9b1-785b6cf8ca65.Text: "I have not. But this weapon was made to bestow death in His name, and so, we speak the same tongue."

4f0dc049-716b-460d-ae39-9134b224695c.Text: "Acknowledged." {n}Solomorne cracks his knuckles.{/n} "Take care of Glaito while I am busy."

ba090190-e926-40d4-ba88-f95e0311b1a5.Text: "Good luck. We won't let the enemy get through to you."

6effb8cb-8817-437f-a756-9dffdbbff5f4.Text: {n}The war machine before you is not in running order and has not been properly serviced in years, but there is no doubt that {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Militarum}under your control{/d}, it can still sow death and destruction.{/n}

fde82a04-f3ea-45d2-b8e6-d1febdacce80.Text: "Mercenaries in the prefect's office... I do not like this."

85d4513b-3e96-44af-a999-cfc30193f334.Text: "The waiting hall is full. Wait for your turn."

88b658fb-73fc-4751-97ab-5d9021f7fc82.Text: "No admittance today. Fill out Form O-9976 with supplemental attachment D-50 to receive clarification."

bdfb304e-2c40-4a5f-a50f-d917c90cf394.Text: "Let me in! My husband has been dead for ten years and they still haven't registered his birth!"

a24b92c6-007f-479c-bad2-dd12bb051317.Text: "Request denied. The waiting hall is full. Wait for the next group to be admitted."

b7c9a91c-6c6b-4664-9f38-eb21e195f03a.Text: "The mob crushed two clerks in the waiting hall the other day. So now, they only admit a hundred people at a time and then lock the door."

896311b1-4fa1-408b-a883-99333e4e98d8.Text: "Two clerks? Big deal! They should have worked faster!"

225c71fc-740a-429a-8709-1eaa53aed2a6.Text: "One-sixth of a quarter. One-tenth of a third. Two-tenths of six dozen."

106b8bd5-5d4d-497c-ae77-44b368ef4a90.Text: "The waiting hall is not available today. Come back later."

ee763670-def6-4f90-a84c-adea43e1a594.Text: "All this waiting will pay off. I'm sure it will."

334e90d0-9bab-43b0-bba6-4a949a4a1be8.Text: "I'm thirsty. But if I walk away, I'll lose my place in the line..."

b9470e61-e898-46db-90f7-294e48434e28.Text: "When will they admit a new group?"

46b5506e-8566-4960-a505-cd7f54317ddf.Text: "The Rogue Trader has repaid our loyalty with treachery. The warp may devour us, but we will take {mf|him|her} along with us."

297f022b-e8a0-449e-b63d-4c7232dcf42a.Text: "Harming a saint is punishable by death. Execute the Rogue Trader!"

e93048ef-6da1-4082-936d-c0afae4747b8.Text: "Anointed One! You have sunk into depravity, but we offer redemption. Do not resist. Accept this gift, and let the pain guide you to Him."

ca4f2eaa-40cc-4723-9f89-058388d6c9fc.Text: "You should not have killed our father. Prepare to die, Rogue Trader!"

1f5e318a-44ec-4416-a288-042916bb65a0.Text: "Gut the Rogue Trader! Make {mf|him|her} bleed! That'll teach {mf|him|her} not to meddle in other people's business."

4b0a390f-3fb6-4084-af73-fb01e60fe531.Text: "You will regret siding with heretics, Rogue Trader."

5e5db3f8-0b28-4767-bc3a-e8e5c500e41f.Text: In the broken base of the scales is a chest adorned with the patina-covered emblem of the Adeptus Arbites. The purity seals suggest it was consecrated before being immured.

8498f136-a571-4ccb-acc9-34cbeeb64203.Text: "I am but a humble servant of the Lex Imperialis, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

1f4d71ad-b46a-42ad-80d7-679ab4c3e3a9.Text: "The Palace of Justice has seen the execution of many of Humanity's most dangerous enemies. These walls forget nothing..."

fbe340c9-5a6e-47cb-a132-9556abde52d6.Text: "As you can see, you have failed to fill out Form 12-Beta/3, which means your claim will not be directed to the governor, but to his office, which in turn..."

36c89043-8c01-453b-a4a2-0272c8b89c10.Text: "You expect me, the proprietor of three agri-complexes, to pore over the paperwork while some worm lectures me on what I should do? I will crush you like the bug you are!"

227e16d2-8751-42f3-8c8d-b821c76ca73f.Text: "The Administratum operates under strict adherence to the rules. If you kill me, you will have to fill out Form 24-Gamma/7 to account for the damage you have caused to Administratum property."

5ab3d37e-9395-450b-95ea-becb54fe1513.Text: The might of the Imperium's justice in the form of a massive melta weapon. The roaring torrents of flame it generates leave criminals without a single chance.

a0bfd18a-350a-4776-8f16-b27bac5d595d.Text: These monumental scales barely fit inside the Palace of Justice. They were crammed into the hall after the Adeptus Arbites arrived.

87b90573-e7dc-40e3-9980-f1e98c29497e.Text: "The Emperor's favour be with His loyal servants!"

abf7f3c1-a054-4a3e-ac65-5493be564f7b.Text: "Wicked souls deserve no rest. The Emperor sees all!"

adfdc22f-af2b-43ca-a81b-901ae1ec1599.Text: "A blight upon you and all your kin! You are all doomed without me!"

79b3a534-5932-473c-8ec7-781deb9fd8b2.Text: "The Great Tithe is a sacred payment necessary for earning the privilege of being part of the Imperium. Anyone who denies this is a thief, a heretic, and a renegade."

b0cf8f32-cebd-4445-8d28-834441cd5720.Text: Excerpts from the Lex Dargonus, with addenda. The changes, personally signed by Theodora von Valancius, reflect the current situation in the Koronus Expanse.

720f0836-9bad-47b8-bca6-95677f1f92ab.Text: "To appropriate another's possessions is a transgression against His will, for He has divided all of Humanity into those who are worthy of having said possessions, and those who are not."

60dd7b91-7e0d-4fed-bf38-83b914d718f4.Text: "Lying is a transgression that burdens the soul of the one who commits it. Lying to a superior is a crime against the Imperium itself, for it disrupts its blessed structure."

0e4cf929-ec26-4ea5-9687-a330daa37794.Text: "To kill with the intent of enriching oneself is a crime. To kill for a righteous cause is a deed to be honoured and exalted."

de551b8f-ff75-4e9e-b468-c4fed6464e1f.Text: "Excuse us for a moment, Marshal. I would like to explain to the Rogue Trader the position {mf|he|she} is in."

348c2752-456e-4dfe-a058-7f0ab31c4254.Text: "Praise be to the Emperor, beloved by all, and to His Law that He bestowed upon us."

d0b67076-728b-4ceb-b7dd-4fc96648fe60.Text: "I swear to uphold the laws of the Lex Imperialis, for it is the law of all Humanity and His will given form."

d82a7e05-1960-47b6-b830-40c00af73154.Text: "Did you hear? Lord Avery's son has been sentenced to thirty years of hard labour!"

e658a03d-3b1f-471f-92ac-fa1d9809df3f.Text: "How dreadful! And after all the entreaties of his family. It is true what they say — an Arbitrator has no heart!"

d314772e-763d-4eed-84c5-8bc6dfe546de.Text: "Nor honour. They are driven not by nobility but by articles memorised without thought! If I were them, I would execute the scoundrel on the spot and be done with it."

3f939e5d-4af3-428d-bdf6-00717376d1c3.Text: "They do not shy away from execution, but what kind of punishment is that? I wish they would bring back public torture. That would be a sight for sore eyes!"

e99cb68d-6e06-4ac0-8f37-619fff1b33ae.Text:
This time-worn piece of paper bears a petition of some sort. You manage to make out only a fragment:
+++
"...then, he treacherously intruded upon the ancestral territories of House Gaprak and wrought destruction therein. The list of damages is headed by but not limited to: three servitors of ancient make, five armoured vehicles, and ten cogitators whose machines spirits are beyond recovery. Consequently, we demand that House Sauerback be penalised for an amount thricely covering the damage inflicted. In support of our accusation, we provide the following..."

6769c956-07bc-4d8c-8dac-171fbf7c55ff.Text:
Petition #36-Sigma/64
+++
Through the efforts of the Adeptus Arbites at my family estate, 12 (twelve) criminals among the members of my family were terminated. The Proctor in charge of the purge decreed that the bodies be left lying at the scene of the crime for further investigation. 40 (forty) planetary cycles have passed since. The heavy odour and vermin resulting from keeping dead bodies without the ability to transport them ceased to be of concern to me after the first two cycles. However, the mummified remains of the criminals prevent my estate from properly functioning at this time. I humbly request that another officer be assigned to oversee the investigation and that they be informed of the necessity of progressing the investigation in my home.
+++
Resolution: petition rejected in accordance with Protocol UP-1845. Basis: the assignment of the head investigator is regulated by Protocol UCH-9389. Note: a fine is to be imposed on the petitioner for failing to preserve the evidence.

b924a8f6-9df3-4513-886a-40c03b322970.Text: "Boarded the Heartless as part of the unit led by S. Anthar. Neutralised the target 'Sargona.' The captured vessel was assigned to a trade route." A note in impeccable handwriting reads, "Conduct an inspection!"

e842efd1-9a19-4ec5-870a-19e318a72693.Text: Report: Capture of the Voidship Heartless

2e0845c6-5c47-4881-a075-d78f9c849910.Text: "Boarded the Heartless as part of the unit led by S. Anthar. Neutralised the target 'Sargona.' The captured vessel was turned into an escort ship." The word "escort" has been circled several times in ink.

fe2411e1-0aad-49a1-b7cb-d167e0b920aa.Text: "Boarded the Heartless as part of the unit led by S. Anthar. Neutralised the target 'Sargona.' The captured vessel was presented to trading partners." A note in impeccable handwriting reads, "Conduct an inspection!"

42e5a7cc-3e3f-453e-9a06-c377ea741fb6.Text: "Boarded the Heartless as part of the unit led by S. Anthar. Neutralised the target 'Sargona.' The captured vessel was scrapped." The word "scrapped" has been circled several times in ink.

c709442d-df27-439a-a7af-e0c20568f8ab.Text: "Assisted in the suppression of the rebellion on Rykad Minoris. Departed unscathed. The world is to be considered null and void." A side note reads, "Damage assessment! Tithe recalculation! URGENT!"

66d63217-e56d-4f2e-8784-76d0975ff903.Text: "Arrived on Rykad Minoris. During the evacuation, took S. Anthar aboard the flagship. The world is to be considered null and void." A side note reads, "Damage assessment! Tithe recalculation! URGENT!"

990679db-b13a-4ad5-b710-7dbf8f2312ab.Text: "Declared Exterminatus on the world Thassera." There is a note in the margin that has been underlined twice: "Living tithe: check the protectorate world register! Double the levy!"

03887961-2d84-4758-bd44-f9ec17568608.Text: "Included the special-category item 'thassertium' (natural psy-focus) in the world's tithe." There is a note in the margin that has been underlined twice: "Decuma Tertius!"

22c76afe-522f-4cda-adc2-62d97622c399.Text: "Authorised the study of the special-category item 'thassertium' (natural psy-focus)." There is a note in the margin that has been underlined twice: "Evaluation required (calculate value!)."

c767ea04-c7d9-447f-8227-bb34a77656a1.Text: "Ordered the destruction of the special-category item 'thassertium' (natural psy-focus)." There is a note in the margin that has been underlined twice: "Existence of similar resources? Check the mining world register."

f94833e9-3549-4cfa-926b-f21bcfef2f2c.Text: Carefully engraved on the sole are the words, "His footsteps were thunderous, and his name, Meragon, made every soul tremble; it meant but one thing for his foes, and that thing was death."

7800bceb-ac5d-4ceb-b241-1aa36042a344.Text: Shiny, ornate letters run along the rim of the helmet: "He was sharp of sight indeed: nary a vice in a rotten soul, nary a shadow in the murk of lawlessness could escape Severius Meragon's all-seeing eye."

c2336087-8315-4d7d-b447-b30370339224.Text: An inscription on the inner side reads: "Many an enemy of Humankind took aim at Meragon's heart, yet this shield stopped each foe's deadly sting, for the God-Emperor protects His faithful servants from death's rapacity."

06551dda-cd39-4de5-8f08-87dd7c1522d1.Text: The ring is adorned with tiny golden lettering: "Severius Meragon, the first Marshal of this temple of the Lex Imperialis, was a righteous judge until the day the Emperor summoned his soul."

41939877-9754-41bc-8e4c-9936f73347a2.Text: A sacred symbol of the Imperium's justice, implacable and unsparing.

ff5499d7-98df-4a4d-83e3-786c293adb8c.Text: Countless reports on the incoming tithe, its redistribution, and the funding of the Administratum and the Arbites.

aaecb5d9-002e-4c1f-acdf-0b273c9a8e2b.Text: Financial reports. The procurement data does not match up with the spending, but this has been gracefully covered up by way of a "shrinkage" column.

263d29e2-c34c-4cc3-a2ab-aaec5e475f8d.Text: Countless rows of names and numbered Lex Imperialis violations merge into an endless stream of transgressions committed by the people of the Expanse.

a87f4337-5d42-453a-b4d9-04efdd0b0f3a.Text: The cogitator is filled with the personal data of the executed. All their possessions have been meticulously accounted for and deposited in the storerooms of the Administratum.

105ecad9-bd6e-4e58-90f6-7fd73c1cca28.Text: A cloud of incoherent text floats on the cogitator's vid-screen. You seem to have destroyed an impressive amount of data.

3bb149de-3bd2-46d8-ab66-b3cafb2469d7.Text: The cogitator is filled with data on the workings of the Palace of Justice, listing things such as the names of servants and details of executions. The number of people entering the building is always greater than that of those leaving it.

9d053a35-0145-4f54-84bc-5455d858cc69.Text:
[Accusation: Desertion]
End your turn on a cell adjacent to an ally!

be60b432-ada8-48a8-b893-a1ed7a6429bf.Text:
[Accusation: Insufficiency of Devotion]
Change the party's momentum value!

c1ffeffd-1e0f-4664-8a27-cd1467e8f9ca.Text:
[Accusation: Wasteful Expenditure of Manpower]
Use {g|f:e955823f54d24088ae1fdefe88d3684d}Blade Dance{/g} against a single target!

842a431e-509d-4e90-a410-7b30172b0d41.Text:
[Accusation: Sabotage]
Do not use your Navigator's abilities against your allies!

b6811db8-6b35-4f64-a118-beb2fead3642.Text:
[Accusation: Malicious Reluctance]
Allies must gain effects from your abilities at least 3 times!

a4bffce2-2e76-4fa6-a522-77bb55fe6520.Text:
[Accusation: Warp Idolatry]
Do not use major psychic powers!

2775557e-00d0-43f5-a5d1-2864628acac2.Text:
[Accusation: Use of Unsanctioned Weaponry]
Do not attack with weapons!

d87088b0-ad29-4958-88ba-8bc0fade2b9d.Text:
[Accusation: Blood Idolatry]
Blood splashes from your attacks must not affect any creature!

357d92f0-35b9-47f1-bae2-e53b763731ed.Text:
[Accusation: Malicious Acts Against Humanity]
Once you deal damage to a target, do not deal damage to any other until the initial target is dead!

bd438d8f-1139-45dc-8e3c-7135c76b4621.Text:
[Accusation: Insufficiency of Fervour]
Apply an effect to yourself and deal damage to an enemy!

7d1bb7a6-a570-4881-9829-8032f53787da.Text:
[Accusation: Non-Observance of Regulations]
Attack a target whose armour is reduced to 0 through the {g|f:fbdba5fe2a264c25bada29aecd64049a}Expose Weakness{/g} ability!

d92dca9a-0ec0-46c3-b673-5b64df417a53.Text:
[Accusation: Unlawful Stagnation]
End your turn on a cell which is 4 or more cells away from where you started your turn!

b91dd2bd-5cfa-4be3-b139-e4887e808a3c.Text:
[Accusation: Negligence of Duty]
Deal 2 or more instances of damage!

3ee78aee-7b9c-4f14-827d-623719b23fb4.Text:
[Accusation: Misuse of Privileges]
Choose a different target for each of your attacks!

8bd3c81a-9b4a-4f55-82cc-b018ac5e7ec4.Text:
[Accusation: Cowardice]
End your turn on a cell adjacent to 2 or more enemies!

dc6f7ba1-e1de-444d-8493-6893b5ea9668.Text:
[Accusation: Wasteful Expenditure of Ammunition]
Your single-target attack must deal at least three times your minimal weapon damage!

d59723ad-12a9-4663-9004-8435987accf4.Text: If their guilt is proven, at the end of the turn, the Weapon of Justice will fire at this character. If not proven guilty or if the {g|f:2cf8fef6da524c2ea554464b64d4d719}Accuser{/g} is killed, it will fire in Prefect Vultur's direction instead.

eeb052e3-90fb-4a3e-b29d-a619ea272001.Text: In the Imperium, where judgement is passed without prior deliberations, the Dargonus Palace of Justice is a truly exotic sight. This one-of-a-kind marvel was constructed on the whim of the eccentric Rogue Trader Benefaz von Valancius, who found rare pleasure in overseeing convoluted trial proceedings that he himself had invented.

ca9888b2-83d5-48f6-87ed-4fdfad0103ae.Text: "Are there any other such institutions elsewhere in my protectorate?"

f7a5012f-9d73-4ca6-b79d-d1173d8e333b.Text: "What kinds of cases are usually heard here?"

13d44acf-5448-4434-aa8f-96e432a4dddf.Text: {n}You are greeted by an impeccably dressed man with a perfectly straight back. An Arbites scale emblem is embroidered on his clothes.{/n} "Glory to House von Valancius! We are honoured to welcome you to the Palace of Justice, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Do you wish to proceed to the session at once, or will you grace me with any questions I might humbly answer?"

136662b1-1c63-45ee-98a1-234d578470ef.Text: "No, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. As is the case with the rest of the Imperium, worlds make do with the traditional method: the accused are not allowed to say a word, and executions are carried out as ordered by planetary authorities or by powerful organisations of the Imperium. Only here on Dargonus does such an unusual ceremony exist — Benefaz von Valancius was known for his eccentricities. It is said that he invented this system himself and started this glorious tradition in which you are to take part today."

46a8a1b4-5fe9-47fa-aaad-6b7e0472f7ad.Text: "This is the Palace of Justice: the ninth residence of House von Valancius, erected by your esteemed ancestor Benefaz von Valancius and handed over by Theodora von Valancius — ever may she bask in the Throne's radiance — to the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusArbitesGlossary}Adeptus Arbites{/g} and the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusAdministratumGlossary}Administratum{/g} for judiciary use. Cases of special interest are heard at this Palace. Sentences are carried out here also."

64b68f91-eb44-4fe3-b156-dff18831c996.Text: "Only the most important ones that involve the interests of the highest-born persons and prominent factions of the {g|Encyclopedia:ImperiumGlossary}Imperium{/g}: disputes between noble houses that go on for generations; conflicts between the God-Emperor's servants who are vested with authority and whose disagreements affect trade and security in the protectorate; and other litigations of supreme significance!"

1f568c79-8b0e-4d3c-9ca4-3c98c716135c.Text: "The cases litigated at the Palace of Justice quite literally concern matters of life and death. In such instances, there is always a guilty party whose lies, connivances, or negligence have caused damage to the protectorate. The task of the judge is to establish guilt and pass a stern sentence, as order cannot be imposed without these, or without summary executions."

b2850458-951e-4fa4-91a2-15ebd1c9d488.Text: "I cannot prove that my consciousness is in my body. No more than you can yours!"

34e28715-0f3a-4aeb-8e3c-0f4dc8cedfa7.Text: "I cannot predict the future — a poor outcome is a possibility in every case. If I had chosen a different path, the prefect still would have found fault with it."

63dc5ead-33f9-48a7-b95f-be8f199e7ec2.Text: "I will not confess to something I did not do, much less something I never had any intention of doing."

930425af-bded-45cc-8332-e33bb1973b5f.Text: "I sent a portion of the tithe for the rebuilding of the Expanse. It will serve the people better than leaving it to rot in your coffers forever."

b00256fe-42be-4acc-b046-6a75f8c590c5.Text: "They've made a right mess of this, haven't they? The talents of my subjects never cease to amaze me!"

892739cf-3dad-4ee0-aec2-ad2c316f8aa6.Text: "Solomorne, don't you have anything to say?"

77d7c960-4807-42c3-aa6b-c1efa020f870.Text: "I intended to return the tithe to Marshal Strachs in full, regardless of Theodora's plans."

dadabf48-2bfa-46ed-8827-af5f74cc763e.Text: [Lie] "I intended to return the tithe to Marshal Strachs in full, regardless of Theodora's plans."

0c3dcf4a-c884-428b-9f22-4bf2b695e7f7.Text: "I kept a portion of the tithe for myself, it is true. It will be put to far better use than being left to rot away in some warehouse. You may administer the rest as you see fit."

227761df-bc2a-48a8-8e92-208d9efb4057.Text: "Marshal Strachs! You have heard my arguments and the prefect's distorted version of the truth. Do you require yet more information before you denounce the real culprit?"

24bc3f6a-d6ba-408a-95ad-1738c348e53b.Text: Judged the prefect and the Marshal to the fullest extent of the Lex Imperialis.

58e4971f-b700-4d63-9c4f-8fa9fc6821f5.Text: "By the God-Emperor's will, the von Valancius dynasty was granted a Warrant of Trade. Go against me, and you go against the God-Emperor. Marshal Strachs and Prefect Vultur are hereby sentenced to death. Those who aided and abetted them in this plot will share the same fate."

500bc0ab-8ed3-45d4-ac39-801a377c6bb3.Text: Addressed the Arbitrators with an earnest speech, calling on them to rise up against the prefect and the Marshal.

e33dee34-5777-4ef7-b280-e7cf225e483b.Text: "Arbitrators! Vultur and Strachs believe that the Lex Imperialis is but a collection of letters and forms to be played with as they please. They believe that you must blindly follow their orders. But whom do you defend? Humanity or these prefects? I call upon you to stand with me in the name of Humanity, not the soulless machine of the Administratum!"

abf13b8a-0cfe-479c-b243-a0687a9131fb.Text: Pronounced yourself to be above the Law of the Imperium and sentenced both the prefect and the Marshal to death.

01891575-92ad-4009-9774-f1c4069ba48c.Text: "Your evidence, arguments, witnesses, and even the Lex Imperialis are just a pathetic attempt to gain the upper hand over someone like me. There is only one law in the Expanse and I am it! And I sentence you all to death for insubordination!"

c0554215-0da4-49d9-9699-90b8e6eca696.Text: "I am me. Maive can prove it. Send a request to Thassera and she will answer."

153e6c62-a572-415b-b587-2b792b901c4a.Text: "Mine and Maive's consciousnesses have been switched back. I can summon her here and she will confirm everything."

a634450a-fa4d-4883-b8ef-b582311dd44e.Text: "I can present Maive to the court. True, she is rather taciturn at the moment..."

d14c8685-cee6-4ca7-9d70-218bada8c918.Text: "I do apologise for putting a brain in your mechanical soldier's head."

57c9353c-c1ac-407b-b5a8-bf6cd3de5063.Text: "It will be as I say, Solomorne!"

59d0c045-b7c5-4fd5-8cd2-f62d2d81f503.Text: [Attack] "I am bored of this farce. By the right granted to me by the sacred Warrant, I declare this trial concluded and you both guilty. Attack!"

7d030bca-2bc0-40a4-b1aa-6990cfa10862.Text: "The consciousness in this body is my own. Any psyker capable of mind reading can confirm it."

bdc338c3-3fb6-4473-871c-d1ea39da39c9.Text: "Did you watch the entire recording? Is this, in your view, how a Rogue Trader conducts {mf|himself|herself}? Like some swooning maiden?"

9a64b7fc-0925-474e-a9ef-b8117cdfa0da.Text: "These cases were under the jurisdiction of the Lex Dargonus. Responsibility for the consequences lies with you."

8a7e6f9f-3895-47e5-8ab9-93d7f49519c5.Text: "Solomorne is his own master — I do not choose for him. But if you think that an Arbitrator's tenets can be so easily broken by any passing stranger, then you insult the very core of the Adeptus Arbites."

e7eea30c-abb1-453c-a021-9fcaede04f9b.Text: [Interrupt Strachs] "I deny the whole pack of lies. The charges are fabricated, and this trial of a Rogue Trader is a farce!"

6189e91c-d298-4766-99a4-d0d385d10755.Text: "That's an interesting tale. You forgot the part where we were suddenly attacked by a void kraken but Solomorne bravely fought it off with a can opener and his boot laces."

0f9ea6b5-1e69-4a4a-8289-b09c5f84d18e.Text: "I can but appeal to your own common sense. Marshal Strachs! Can you recall even one instance where a heretic attempted to steal the tithe while taking a few dozen Arbitrators along for company?"

d7198462-86ac-48f4-9b10-298484aee3af.Text: "You are talking nonsense. With all due respect for Solomorne's capabilities, if I had wanted to get rid of him and his Arbitrators and steal the tithe, there is no way he could have stopped me."

e5d9acfd-8142-483c-90f8-44f64e17bcad.Text: "Solomorne, did you know they were listening in?"

0dbc722e-a0a9-42a5-b4f8-027ed5036fe2.Text: "Those words were taken completely out of context!"

14ea2feb-34c8-41c8-a94c-182da87453f7.Text: "You can lie and implicate me all you want. But I will not forgive you for using Solomorne and Glaito like this."

fcff1851-ee05-46e3-be4b-5aeff3a07cb8.Text: "Those words were indeed spoken in our conversations. Our private conversations."

f4cc56a6-3820-4f09-a231-d2f0c696e278.Text: "Very well, let's do it your way."

f3b08d2e-72fa-4514-b434-dd345d077ae8.Text: "You couldn't have done any better, Prefect, no matter how fervently you believe yourself to be the saviour of the protectorate — an appointment you bestowed upon yourself!"

fd8ae6d0-1ffb-408e-bdf4-fcc2143aaeb4.Text: "I actually did requisition the tithe because I could not allow it to rot away uselessly. In my hands, the sacred tribute will serve a great purpose."

5aaca0d7-a0e5-444e-ac0c-dc04900b9ae3.Text: "Solomorne, if there is anything else you wish to add..."

e83e4bd8-c891-4c70-a7c5-30c9b63b3a92.Text: Convinced the Marshal to join your side by appealing to his loyalty to the Lex Imperialis.

7ef6c317-5dd8-444d-9837-2c8b7b890951.Text: "The right to judge is granted by the God-Emperor. Can you swear that at this moment you are guided by the Lex Imperialis and not someone else's intent?"

8421898f-be81-4f26-928f-4d3b0e6d8efb.Text: Convinced the Marshal to join your side by appealing to his conscience.

b00dc060-bda3-4d20-b178-c20036ebf198.Text: "It is a difficult thing to admit that one is in the wrong, Marshal. You have stumbled by putting your trust in Vultur, but I have faith that you will make the right choice now."

7952dba8-f45f-49ea-bf9d-d1c784f53d89.Text: Manipulated the Marshal in order to lure him to your side.

fbaef720-e616-4a4f-9d4a-5f9753d9fc5c.Text: "You have demonstrated clearly that your vaunted Lex is worth nothing — you bend and mould the law to suit your desires. And yet, power is so intoxicating, so difficult to give up... Am I wrong, Strachs?"

1ff9f28d-1668-411a-8254-223c63b9baf0.Text: "You should have joined my side while you still had the chance."

21dce637-72ea-4b73-be81-3a6696eda32b.Text: "In the name of the God-Emperor, the von Valancius dynasty stands accused of betraying the Imperium." {n}To the murmurs of all, the prefect picks up a scroll bearing Administratum seals.{/n} "The trial is public so that all may see the Rogue Trader's heresies and know that status and power are no shield against righteous punishment. Marshal Strachs, you have the floor. State the list of crimes against the {g|Encyclopedia:LexImperialisGlossary}Lex Imperialis{/g} that will be examined here today."

65b63da3-6715-4f2d-9b75-f3db277df56a.Text: "The Rogue Trader should not be held responsible for the misdeeds of {mf|his|her} predecessor." {n}Murmuring breaks out, but Solomorne presses on, unperturbed.{/n} "Or else, by that same logic, Incendia Chorda should have been tried long ago for what her predecessor Aspyce did. As you can see, it isn't difficult to find inconsistencies in a case if you use your head a little. I refuse to be a mindless tool and follow absurd orders."

ac8022a4-83b2-45bf-832a-f536dac15ec7.Text: "Your denial of guilt has been added to the record."

9d691eb1-4208-4e8b-80c3-c64bebcbaa35.Text: "Let's move on to Thassera. This world underpaid the appropriate tithe amount, a crime that should have been remedied by the Rogue Trader escorting Proctor Anthar to that backward world. Proctor, you are hereby called to testify. Describe what happened on the planet."

b999b32e-bbe3-4b30-b1df-dea8239aea97.Text: "In forbidding the Doleful Host from capturing the Choirmaster, the Rogue Trader confirmed {mf|his|her} complicity in the activities of the infamous heretic Kunrad Voigtvir, to whom the Choirmaster had been relaying messages that had led to mutinies, acts of heresy, and other forms of disobedience. The Adeptus Arbites had to step in and execute Omnis Pras themselves."

05b1cfa1-b5dd-48fe-a54f-73b2e58269f6.Text: {n}Inscribia picks up a scroll that carries the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMinistorumGlossary}Ecclesiarchy{/g}'s seals.{/n} "Allow me to read out the decision of the honoured representatives of the Saint Drusus mission. 'We brand the one who dared subject Anvylas, a holy votary of the faith, to a martyr's death a heretic and an associate to evil of every kind.'"

a59914a5-6601-41a8-a644-5881c2d809a1.Text: "Lady Molles-Secundas, who had taken over the reins of her family enterprise, was found guilty of conspiring with the pirate captains who were her suppliers of captives used to make corpse starch. Before her execution, she confessed to having paid a sizeable sum of money to House von Valancius for its cooperation in the court."

2c6df2fb-e72f-4cf1-8371-d9a6eadb2c53.Text: "Connivance at the Doleful Host's fanaticism and the loss of a valuable Astropath resulted in the appointment of a new Choirmaster. That same day, he lost several messages of utmost importance, thus sparking a war between two Koronus Expanse worlds. As of now, one of those worlds has been completely destroyed, and the other deemed uninhabitable."

0316379a-a6a4-481f-875a-7e369840cd9e.Text: "Attempting to manipulate the Marshal's sense of professional pride. Recorded and added to the case."

2a10cdfe-202c-49b4-8c0f-9afb21aae7d5.Text: "Disrespect toward the doctrine of the esteemed Adeptus Arbites has been recorded."

9aac2ca4-0b41-4bc2-9884-c7eb9f4e482d.Text: {n}Prefect Vultur stiffens, as though what she just heard has come as a very unpleasant surprise. Her slender fingers grip the armrests of her chair, her knuckles cracking.{/n} "This world and its denizens are rotten to the core..."

ce07278d-d4a8-44ca-97f4-ff59cc2a2c7f.Text: {n}The prefect straightens in her chair with such force that you hear the arduous grinding of her implants. Her voice is cold and slightly tremulous:{/n} "Decree GC-781/89, Supplement 982. For tithe theft, participation in foul sorcery, and other crimes against the Imperium {name} von Valancius is sentenced to death. The property of the dynasty is hereby confiscated and placed under the oversight of the Adeptus Administratum. Any last words, convict?"

67e1922f-b0ad-43cd-91ec-b6af915ffbde.Text: "Stop, {name}. The Arbites were following Strachs's orders, following the law. To condemn them just for that is unfair. Show them the leniency that you once showed me, or else this long road we have travelled together will have been for nothing."

836e1e3c-dd5c-4d42-a9b3-775db245644c.Text: "Surprisingly moderate words after all we have seen. You will not restore order this way. Now is the time for harsh and decisive measures, or else your subjects and allies will continue to rebel against you."

d871717d-7bd5-4086-8f19-97a977fba6a3.Text: "No, {name}. What you are proposing is not the God-Emperor's justice. You are distorting the Lex Imperialis and placing your own ego above all else, even His will. I cannot accept this outcome."
