678adb6f-5347-4597-a07e-bf25d4e80421.Text: "Prefect Vultur, for attempting to slander and kill one of the Emperor's anointed and for encroaching upon the Imperial Tithe, I hereby sentence you to death!"

8ce67485-5c81-4558-aa97-7041aaa7ab39.Text: "It would be a pity to lose such a valuable professional. I sentence you to work in tithe storages, where you will catalogue their contents in solitude until the day you die."

a699ffeb-b095-4d5a-af34-ce073dbbb739.Text: "You could have negotiated with me — voiced your dissatisfaction — and we would have found a way. Instead, you chose to plot behind my back. Execute her."

8b3259c5-06b0-4cf3-934d-6b3c0221778c.Text: "Marshal Strachs! By enabling Inscribia Vultur's machinations on your watch, you have demonstrated criminal ignorance and laxity. I hereby find you deserving of death."

eb1a82f3-c7e1-40ec-aab6-1933edff522a.Text: "Marshal, all you are guilty of is being gullible and rigid in your ways. I see no reason to condemn you."

4d7170ec-3372-442a-9e31-be04bfcabca7.Text: "You betrayed me, Solomorne. For this, you will die."

9937948a-5126-47e7-bb8f-260aac76b2ea.Text: "Loyal to your principles even in the face of certain death, are you? That is something to respect. You are pardoned, and may retake your place in my retinue."

adfccb12-8686-4ca0-92f6-f26f2d6276fc.Text: "The Koronus Expanse cannot be left without the Lex Imperialis and its keepers. The Adeptus Arbites will choose a new Marshal, one who is more worthy of their station, and continue to guard the Imperium against lawlessness!"

e6e46692-0daf-42f5-a71f-5dccab4a46f6.Text: "The Adeptus Arbites is in need of a more capable leader. I command you to choose a new Marshal. And let them take heed that the von Valancius dynasty will never again accept interference in matters of the protectorate from the Arbites."

96198e0b-8fa5-4a95-a0e6-5a2170b7f467.Text: "Proctor Solomorne Anthar, as ruler of Dargonus and head of the von Valancius dynasty, I name you the new Marshal of the Adeptus Arbites in the Koronus Expanse! See to it that the Arbites once more become faithful servants of the Lex Imperialis under your leadership."

3cd8c818-544f-4e7f-be53-1027dfac7494.Text: "The Adeptus Arbites is a rotten, corrupt canker on the face of the Koronus Expanse. I declare the beginning of a purge in their ranks. All whom I deem unworthy will be exterminated. Those who remain, the best of the best, will carry on protecting the law."

64d3960c-cee7-477e-8912-8da0ca29db9d.Text: "By my right as the bearer of the Warrant of Trade, I hereby disband the Adeptus Arbites. All members of this organisation are henceforth outlawed and stripped of the right to judge my subjects. From this day forward, the Koronus Expanse has but one executor of judgement and law: me, {name} von Valancius!"

d0423526-7363-494a-9697-3f2e34526282.Text: "Justice is done. My judgement is made."

adb0a07d-78f0-4074-a325-3a4ea90ac043.Text: "You helped me to defeat the prefect. Why would I sentence you?"

e99fdd27-6528-4d6b-acd1-3a1da1f68c4d.Text: "I offer you and Glaito your lives. Leave, and never show yourself within the protectorate's borders again."

f0426079-505f-4fc0-8d2d-c516170fffaf.Text: "Be sure to act strictly within the bounds of your authority... this time."

65f3a266-5ea8-4e21-a763-3a21d0d9aa7c.Text: {n}Prefect Vultur kneels before you. Scores of fragile implants all over her body are twitching convulsively, giving her the appearance of a crushed insect.{/n}

a40ece6c-229e-4213-a7ec-adeb66f4e607.Text: {n}Solomorne is breathing heavily, clutching a wound in his chest. He is not looking at you — his attention is focused on Glaito. His metal fingers gingerly touch the back of the bloodied, barely alive cyber-mastiff, his face frozen in an expression of despair.{/n}

8567208c-1a5e-4f2a-88fc-7fb2efea353a.Text: {n}The prefect lets out a cough. Then, an unnerving smile appears on her lips.{/n} "I at least had to try. I served the von Valancius protectorate faithfully for over a hundred years, painstakingly cultivating order where others had failed to do so. While you and your ancestors sowed anarchy and havoc with your ever-changing whims, I stood on as the linchpin that kept this domain from sinking into criminal disarray. It was because of me that this gargantuan system continued to function with barely a flaw — the only source of disruption was you, the Rogue Traders. Yes, I at least had to try."

960a120a-1b75-4ffe-b640-866b9d099235.Text: {n}Marshal Strachs's gaze is as firm as ever. Not one muscle quivers in his hard exterior. Even in cornered defeat, compared to the others, he appears as an indestructible pillar of rock.{/n}

54df0149-ab86-47d2-a6ec-c450caa9cec5.Text: "The protectorate isn't yours, and it never was. Have you not read your own Warrant, even once? Every conquest, every planet claimed by a Rogue Trader belongs to the Imperium — you are supposed to act as its vassal, nothing more. But Rogue Traders are incapable of efficient rule — all that drives you is your craving for profit and reckless exploits. The limitless potential of the protectorate is wasted in the hands of spoilt fools... And I am tired of watching you desecrate the very foundations of the Imperium. If it weren't for you, the protectorate would be operating for the good of the Throne as impeccably as a sacred machine of the Omnissiah!"

a32bd90b-51f3-43d8-b769-84b073e9709f.Text: {n}The prefect's eyes narrow spitefully. She opens her mouth to say something but is cut off before she can utter a single word.{/n}

d349c4d2-bda8-4525-adf3-47a97aa37798.Text: "I have not the strength to attempt something like this again." {n}Vultur sounds tired and... sincere, like you have caught a glimpse of the woman this lawmonger once was.{/n}

decf44fc-4e53-4090-880c-55c2662a3cb0.Text: {n}Marshal Gregoras Strachs takes a measured step forward, his armour clanging.{/n} "You must judge me also, Rogue Trader. I have shamed the Adeptus Arbites by succumbing to Prefect Vultur's manipulations, and betrayed the Lex Imperialis, the very law I was meant to uphold. I am guilty. I insist that you pass the sentence and carry it out immediately."

1b882b1b-9a0a-4c89-9a7d-9de81e34a413.Text: "Remorse does not absolve me from being culpable for what has transpired. I have betrayed the Lex. There is no going back for traitors."

07f1a471-d2a1-47fc-84a4-7f0a375b1827.Text: {n}Strachs sets his shield down, detaches his carapace, and places it over the shield. Now clad only in his undersuit uniform, he looks smaller without his armour, and very tired.{/n} "I, Marshal Gregoras Strachs, am stepping down from my post. I am no longer fit to wear this armour. May its new wearer bring honour to the Lex."

0201e038-c8a2-4788-9958-f97ec4c087c5.Text: {n}Inscribia Vultur gives no reply — she meets her death with her head proudly raised and her lips pursed in contempt.{/n}

606a2c5b-8a49-48a6-8ed5-73f624971dca.Text: {n}The prefect grimaces.{/n} "To be spared for the rest of my life from having to watch you bring the Imperium's territories to ruin? That is a reward, Rogue Trader. But I suppose you are right — cataloguing shipment chronicles is an art long overdue for some rigorous supervision, and none except me in your entire domain is capable of performing this function adequately."

9df15179-faf2-487e-8058-66103c2bfac3.Text: {n}Vultur chuckles.{/n} "Never. The counterparty always bends the terms to its advantage..."

5543e171-694b-4bd2-8cc5-fcc72e423690.Text: {n}The Marshal brings a closed fist to his chest and says solemnly,{/n} "And your judgement is final. I fought to protect the Lex Imperialis and those who enforce its word. I have erred in my duty. Death does not frighten me, but I must ask one thing of you: find the Arbites a better Marshal."

0998919b-747f-4a7e-9b75-bf811bb1b6ea.Text: {n}Strachs instantly snaps in a steely voice,{/n} "No. I have shamed the Adeptus Arbites by yielding to Prefect Vultur's manipulation. I have betrayed the Lex Imperialis, the very law I was duty-bound to uphold. I am guilty. I insist that you pass the sentence and carry it out immediately."

20a5b9ad-3f80-467c-9f68-f63220186db7.Text: "I accept death for staying loyal to the true Lex Imperialis, and I do so without regrets. My only request is this: take care of Glaito." {n}Solomorne closes his eyes and shouts a command:{/n} "Rejection protocol: leave DX-1. Farewell... my friend."

95fea718-70ed-4506-86ce-ca6b7d6e9afb.Text: {n}For a time, Solomorne says nothing.{/n} "I admit defeat. I admit that you are a Rogue Trader, one who is beyond my judgement. I gratefully accept my pardon and swear an oath of service to you."

5a691866-6397-4707-b8ff-ec3af576e82e.Text: {n}Solomorne salutes and gives a grim nod.{/n} "I will see it done, Rogue Trader."

a8ef431a-779b-4f8c-9833-77e5bdbde006.Text: "Your decree carries great weight, but my assignment will not happen so quickly. There is no precedent for electing a new Marshal in the Expanse, not to mention that the Lord Marshal is unable to participate in the process — we will have to develop a new procedure. Otherwise, we Arbitrators will not accept these changes. Until my official assignment, though, I will lead as acting head of the Adeptus Arbites."

35cb851c-fcda-43a6-9c79-b09efd744dbf.Text: {n}The Arbitrators accept your decision stoically: no one says a word in protest, no one reaches for their weapon.{/n}

2aee3bc4-918f-4c57-9c2a-17b27444beea.Text: "I will personally see to the execution of your order, Rogue Trader."

d20dabb5-f54f-4407-b892-f28948851b64.Text: {n}A whisper runs through the room, turning slowly into a murmur of approval. No one dares resist the will of the newly proclaimed sole judge of the Koronus Expanse.{/n}

02152635-bf35-4782-9824-6a1b8fd21b06.Text: {n}The rest of the room stands still, all eyes turned to you. The final verdict. What you say next will decide the fate of not just the Adeptus Arbites, but of justice in the Koronus Expanse as a whole.{/n}

91906a9a-8739-4654-b579-260e0d86731c.Text: "Only the guilty try to defend themselves, whereas I acted in the interests of the Imperium. Such a shame that some things cannot be set right by bureaucratic means, and that the short-sightedness of certain people serving in adjacent divisions..." {n}She pauses meaningfully, watching the Marshal knit his brows.{/n} "...so often becomes an insurmountable obstacle."

f9fb7ce2-0d03-489f-83e8-abf5723d35dc.Text: {n}Without waiting for you to address him, Marshal Strachs does not plead so much as give you an order:{/n} "Judge me, {name}. Now that the dust has settled, I can see everything clearly. Vultur used me and the Adeptus Arbites in an attempt to seize total control over your protectorate. I thought my actions were in service to the Lex, but in truth, only one person has ever benefitted from them. That mistake deserves no pardon, and I have earned my punishment."

f035ff16-21e5-40cb-89b0-921a990477af.Text: {n}Solomorne bows his head low.{/n} "I am grateful... for us both. Farewell, Rogue Trader. May none but the Emperor Himself be your judge."

c21dd948-ec4b-4440-9b00-7ee5a4f58253.Text: {n}The last shreds of the dog's mind contained in the body of a living weapon compel him to be with his master. Though too wounded to run at full speed, Glaito dashes forward nonetheless, his blood drenching the cold stone floor of the palace.{/n}

43878b89-18b6-41f5-94d0-b74801e516eb.Text: {n}Solomorne goes quiet as a statue. Slowly, in a voice that does not sound like his own, he says,{/n} "Order received, Rogue Trader."

ad8047c7-e349-4656-bc47-7a5269c26fc0.Text: {n}Before the sound of the cannon blast can subside, you hear the clanging of metal claws and a howl of rage.{/n}

4016fbe3-fd78-4255-b326-7977f7eeb5a5.Text: {n}The Marshal looks directly at you, with a strange emptiness in his eyes.{/n} "I see. Not only has the Rogue Trader turned out to be a criminal, but Vultur as well. However, I am the one most to blame for what happened, having been swayed by the manipulations of one heretic while failing to stop another violator of the Lex Imperialis. Rogue Trader, if you have a shred of honour left, have me executed, and may the Emperor judge my soul."

aa9b5437-ebc4-4dfb-9fea-b849973b0fa6.Text: {n}Among the broken fragments of the great scales and the burning Arbites banners, the people kneel as one. The verdict has been announced. Whatever the future may hold, one thing is certain: the Koronus Expanse will not be the same.{/n}

1848ed70-db21-46a3-b65e-b0a022c5db78.Text: "Even in this, you went against the Emperor's Law. But I accept the sentence." {n}The Marshal presses a fist to his chest and solemnly declares,{/n} "May He shorten my days; may He summon me to His judgement."

228ce31a-0c6c-47d3-849b-6c63c6728307.Text: {n}Strachs presses a fist to his chest and solemnly declares,{/n} "And your judgement is final. I was protecting the Lex Imperialis and its guardians. I erred on that path. May the Emperor send the Arbites a worthier Marshal."

7952e7b4-2b0c-49f5-b358-177cb0ee3a87.Text: "You might have understood my perspective. The way you managed to expose my plans before the trial confirms your {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_MOT_Mind}extraordinary intelligence{/d}. But it is poisoned by your self-interest, which makes it all the more painful for me to lose this battle of wits for power."

7a18fae4-33a8-4d08-b65b-45da4c8c0ef6.Text: "An inglorious fate for an Arbitrator, but... I will not be alone. Thank you for Glaito."

00a91880-118b-47f6-8cbd-888e6b0b80a5.Text: {n}The Marshal meets his death with dignity, standing tall as befits an Arbitrator. A flash of melta imprints his silhouette on your retinas. When you open your eyes again, Gregoras Strachs is gone.{/n}

0e8daaed-0b18-4846-b140-3b205cba748c.Text: "I consider this measure unduly lenient, but I have no right to protest your decision." {n}The Marshal brings a closed fist to his chest and adds solemnly,{/n} "For your judgement is final."

488e6187-02b0-4741-8c69-3040b1061f37.Text: {n}As the weapon roars, Inscribia Vultur's body is reduced to dust.{/n}

f722b8d3-c2ca-4dc2-880d-435650ac9b07.Text: "No. I cannot serve someone who does not follow the God-Emperor's Law. What kind of man would put his life above faith and duty?"

6f101359-1448-4129-9194-a485cb1a029e.Text: {n}Solomorne, on his knees, looks you dead in the eye without a hint of remorse.{/n}

6ee75426-44ec-485e-9033-b9492a8b8e6a.Text: "How did a criminal from Calixis find his way onto my ship?"

b4fc78de-c44c-4367-9a18-64e91ef70e95.Text: "Solomorne, why are you so certain that this is the man you're seeking?"

97c1d391-b4f7-4513-8595-2e0ca283cbcd.Text: "Accused, do you have anything to say?"

33c2b642-eeef-4ab2-b0ea-cdba7d12b9c6.Text: "Ravor, this talented voidsman is your responsibility. Should he commit any misdeeds henceforth, you will have to answer for them."

20ad7550-54e9-4243-a24f-124f14ee1750.Text: "I do not trust this man to remain in the Master Helmsman's crew... but I cannot allow such talent to go to waste. Hand him over to the Factotum, he will find a use for him."

81648d3a-2737-4ece-bd49-0c4c0ed92b08.Text: "The fugitive criminal must be punished. Execute him."

82640f00-2cde-4e0c-a613-d162edd33eac.Text: "Glaito can rid the ship of this scum."

0616e589-9941-4839-bd40-afd6992ebede.Text: "Cease any 'investigations' behind my back. If I hear of such a thing again, Arbitrator, you will be put off this ship — and not via shuttle, but through the airlock."

7e62a48d-69ae-4951-b086-b70946042716.Text: "Why did you unleash a cyber-mastiff on my subjects, Solomorne?"

dd019bde-4add-4a11-92a3-6c2204921774.Text: "It is not for you, Solomorne, to judge a man trying to escape the claws of dishonour. They tried to write me off once too. Let the voidsman be — I won't say it again."

42a7ad80-ae4b-4b34-9a7c-9d15e7baf6e3.Text: "Lord Cap'n, I beg you to look into this outrage! This cyber-horror nearly chewed up my assistants — and one of them's been left without two of his fingers. Instead of calming his beast, the Arbitrator attacked my crewman!"

cd8308f1-4a2a-431e-9788-5d6e17123877.Text: {n}Solomorne waits for the end of the Master Helmsman's words and coolly turns to you.{/n} "His crewman is a wanted man, Rogue Trader. He is accused of subverting {g|Encyclopedia:TitheGlossary}sacred tithe{/g} shipments, smuggling, kidnapping the Imperium's subjects, and bribing officials. Were we not on your flagship, I would have executed the heretic on the spot, but here, you are the authority, and you are the court."

6a3048d0-4c9b-4313-9101-357565c4a48a.Text: {n}With an impassive gesture, Solomorne points at the condemned man — and the cyber-mastiff launches himself off the deck.{/n}

a7ed347f-1281-4e67-8d41-e72e0e47cd4e.Text: {n}A deep crease runs down the Master Helmsman's forehead.{/n} "You're throwing away a crewman, Lord Captain... for what? To indulge that lump? Well, have it your way."

dc411aee-9fd1-4b6c-aaba-9f2420c45c98.Text: "Because I was personally involved in tracking down and purging the Shadows of the Abyss crime syndicate to which the perpetrator belongs. The case was in {g|Encyclopedia:CalixisGlossary}Calixis{/g}, on the world of Helvica Prime, but for Arbitrators, time and distance do not mitigate guilt."

5827d1e9-6aaa-444a-8aed-56beca23fdcb.Text: "If I went sticking my beak into the pasts of every one of the hundreds of people in the crew, I wouldn't have time to steer your ship. All I know is that when everything went to groxshit on Rykad Minoris, this one oversaw the work at the docks so that the fools didn't trample each other to death in their panic. And later he ran into a friend at the port on Footfall, and they found us some parts within a day. He's even got arms growing out of the right places. He might make it to junior helmsman, if he keeps it up."

12cfc5d9-18d1-4906-add0-5ffc4c6170ff.Text: {n}The long-haired voidsman flinches when you address him.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, the governor of Helvica Prime was a scumbag who abhorred the light of the God-Emperor — the things he did to the people under him... We only survived by stealing from him, or else we'd have ended up in a corpse pit, like one in four did after a distribution station accident. But once I'd got out of there, that was it, I was out of that business for good. And when I found myself in your service, I realised that it was a gift of fate, and I'd be a fool if I didn't repay such good fortune with my wholehearted toil..."

a0d80aac-bc96-4521-9ec1-0083614b45d2.Text: {n}The voidsman's face pales and he falls to his knees.{/n}

25215b1e-1aee-4452-9d36-6ad2779c2b5f.Text: "Rogue Trader, will you carry out the sentence yourself, or do you order me to deliver justice?"

54f59633-e5af-4cf9-8470-66ab80f679b1.Text: "The bastard tried to run when he saw me. His fellow crew members hesitated and didn't make way for me — there was no time to find out if they were abetting the perpetrator or just panicking, so I had to use Glaito for suppression purposes."

fe8da6b1-522c-4fb6-9dc7-ae503f46bc42.Text: {n}The Master Helmsman shoots a look of naked dislike at Solomorne.{/n}

c3acef5b-7976-46be-9700-506f8918859a.Text: {n}The man's eyes fill with tears of gratitude.{/n} "You understand... You know what it's like {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Shame}to rise from the ashes{/d} to a new life. I swear I'll write over my past with hard work!"

63b1dbb1-6cdd-4d95-b7dc-d01cc421b848.Text: "The man before you is the former captain of a smuggling ship owned by the syndicate. Check the heretic's left arm — every syndicate member had a distinctive implant by which they recognised each other. It was that implant's signature that Glaito picked up on during his patrols."

e01b0a43-75a5-45e7-b24e-e36f79f5751f.Text: "Yes, Lord Cap'n." {n}Ravor's disgruntled grimace momentarily dissipates.{/n}

1d78f385-157f-4e87-bf53-d5b2b1ef3bb9.Text: "Give my best crewman to that... bureaucrat to use as an errand boy? I'd rather see him fed to the dog, honestly..."

ec799c75-c315-4b40-b15d-7dbd4e03de59.Text: {n}The criminal manages to sigh a few words of prayer as you draw your weapon.{/n}

26d5a6f8-e180-45bf-a432-b4e1a8530593.Text: "He was among the servants sent to you by Governor Medineh."

ff35431f-aa8b-4cad-8f75-0ec45b20b0d7.Text: {n}Ravor looks grimly at the body.{/n} "Well, Lord Cap'n, I'll try to find a replacement for the poor sod. I hope your lawman doesn't go after the next one."

cf84e379-60da-4300-bbd8-ee98150405f5.Text: "Then this case is closed. With your permission, I will return to my duties."

4cb4f20e-e13a-46e5-8c10-27827cfad055.Text: "Your order is clear, Rogue Trader. I apologise for acting without your permission — I will no longer interfere in what is happening on the flagship."

0f1baf65-dca6-4332-b275-dcef3c0ebbb5.Text: "What do you have to say to that, Vigdis?"

bf0b7c94-b676-4d7c-9209-e6d1e5be207c.Text: "Solomorne, why are you sabotaging the work of the crew?"

2ef10b37-bb93-4adc-8185-3a26580ca661.Text: "I have listened to you and I am ready to make a decision."

0ec9f9dc-ff7e-4bba-a575-d77f9005352d.Text: "There is no need for any audit. I trust my officers to keep everything under control."

c6d58301-1c11-4545-bc0b-542c4e57af40.Text: "Solomorne, you will be granted access to the archives and lead an audit of my crew."

d854bfaf-05df-4265-8970-6c9805970b99.Text: "Vigdis, you and Janris will double-check all the crew on your own. Do not involve the Proctor."

15c12981-1c11-4f7e-8d89-2ae2b79b54ce.Text: "Vigdis, why did you try to pet Glaito?"

709c1868-3d59-4eab-960e-3aeb9157bbd3.Text: "Vigdis, reprimand yourself with a note on your personnel file. Glaito is a combat cyber-mastiff, property of the Adeptus Arbites, not some 'beast.'"

3144ec9d-2c6d-4c05-9fc9-638f755b56ab.Text: "Were you aware there was a runaway heretic hiding among the ship's crew?"

fb87c09a-4026-4eaa-a9c7-97cfce0d96fd.Text: "Solomorne, this is not some filthy hive backwater. You will cease your self-righteous investigations at once, and you had better hope I hear no further complaints about your conduct! "

6cfab3ce-27a7-42d0-b6c8-566908da5593.Text: "I questioned the crew in the Vox Master's absence and established that the wanted bulletins sent by the Imperial Navy were being completely ignored. I suspect that Senior Officer Toliman is abusing your trust."

c703e5f8-abd9-4652-80d8-25a6c986c9e1.Text: {n}A heavy sigh escapes the grate of Vigdis's vox.{/n} "Yes, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

82bab11d-0327-4643-9cf0-188cee8e0d75.Text: {n}Vigdis presses her hands together.{/n} "Reports of fugitive criminals, which number in the hundreds, are of low priority. What's more, I know that Lord Captain Theodora was most adamant on the matter. If you forgive me, her exact words were: 'We are not grox-damned bounty hunters.' The Proctor would know that if he had brought his questions to me rather than interrogating Astropaths and comms officers."

dc25691d-5777-48d0-805d-3c663d97c5e2.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, Proctor Anthar is interfering in the work of the crew. He is intimidating and threatening them, demanding access to the ship's sealed archives."

852f4072-e326-4d41-b3f2-929d6ddaf57b.Text: "Your flagship is untouchable for external inspections because of its high status, and criminals are taking advantage of that. So you need an internal audit: you need to pull up the archives of wanted bulletins and double-check the crew records — that is the only way to identify and eliminate potential threats to you."

1b63cb00-a8b5-48d0-93be-4f80332309eb.Text: "I was compelled to intervene as Glaito had intercepted a suspicious signal. The encrypted message contained the words 'heresy' and 'fugitive.' I managed to trace the signal back to the Vox Master's work station. I needed to dispatch Glaito on a reconnaissance mission — to obtain new evidence and, ultimately, to ensure your safety."

bf11af0e-356c-4a40-92ff-3ecc73ee8ce1.Text: {n}Vigdis and Solomorne look at you expectantly.{/n}

7082419a-2b62-48d8-b986-e6bf458ecee3.Text: "In other words, you sent the beast to follow me."

e8a41bed-b946-48f9-be81-7238b5d6e306.Text: {n}Vigdis's shoulders slump in visible relief.{/n} "Thank you, Lord Captain."

42f8bb60-e523-4b6b-81d1-daad18f411a5.Text: "As a result, I had to step away from my duties to have my implants replaced, esteemed Proctor."

763e2252-2592-4321-a8a6-c88e01dd9520.Text: "I didn't..." {n}This is the first time you have ever seen the Vox Master so agitated.{/n} "I did not try to pet him. It is not customary to keep such cyber-beasts on a voidship, Lord Captain — this is my first encounter with such a creature. That... Glaito, it was following me all over the bridge..."

15d2d779-9f78-4014-aea0-f0937ef44d82.Text: "And you decided to interfere with his work protocol."

b6e7a07c-caa2-4008-b673-dac5ff336091.Text: {n}Vigdis casts Solomorne a cold glance before continuing.{/n} "I had studied the archives and found mention of a ritual to establish contact that involves an offering and physical interaction with the beast—"

bc65e908-5b97-45d8-aded-74ba9637dbf9.Text: "You are literally talking about bribery. A pointless act — cyber-mastiffs cannot be bribed, and neither can Arbitrators."

08d9d407-62dd-40c7-afb2-57f9ea1ff895.Text: "Yes, Lord Captain." {n}Vigdis meekly bows her head.{/n}

026a5d6d-8c3c-4051-b770-c5f72a7a610c.Text: {n}Vigdis falls silent, but she continues to glare daggers at the Proctor surreptitiously. Solomorne only nods.{/n}

60e43069-d0cb-45eb-a2e1-98dc5a8a74d1.Text: "Allow me to explain: the Vox Master tried to pet Glaito, which activated his self-defence protocol."

728bb453-6846-455f-86d8-d0df5741f827.Text: "I already apologised. In any case, what happened was the expected outcome from unauthorised contact with a living weapon of the Adeptus Arbites."

c94a2491-107b-41da-a5b7-a64d323bd2c1.Text: "No, Lord Captain. He was not on the list of wanted criminals in the Koronus Expanse — I assume it is because of the relative insignificance of the heresies he was accused of by the Calixian authorities. Perhaps Proctor Anthar had information to which the Imperial Navy does not have access."

50b08123-21c0-4aca-b149-654e975f076c.Text: "And as for his dog..." {n}Vigdis pauses, shifting her gaze to the cyber-mastiff and tucking her hand behind her back.{/n} "I humbly request that you take action."

056a2e83-3eba-4206-a9cb-1a3afb8525de.Text: "As for the vox-transmissions — the frequency used by the senior officers is encrypted. I informed the staff of the situation regarding the voidsman who was earlier brought before you on the bridge for trial. Need I remind you, Lord Captain, that Proctor Anthar has no authority to access transmissions conducted by the senior officers of the Rogue Trader's flagship — not to mention that the signal was unlawfully intercepted?"

5b11e276-967b-493f-ace2-4bb5c3fda4bd.Text: "This is... madness for a ship whose officer corps alone comprises hundreds of people. The work hours that would be required for such an audit..."

326a9f17-263e-4309-88f0-f6c43f90f50f.Text: "Why not hire people from the lower decks?"

e676d386-667c-4369-b2db-7dda011b7a64.Text: "What would you do in my position, Solomorne?"

6678af62-f945-4114-8e02-2f6828ea828f.Text: "Allocate protectorate funds for training specialist crewmen. We have enough masters of their craft on board to train a new generation."

ded589a2-4a75-416c-9557-209a7ab0d2f3.Text: "Solomorne, why have you gathered my officers together?"

5e0ae8eb-b6c8-47f3-a0ea-4c526ba5d3d0.Text: "No one speaks without my permission! Solomorne, go on."

3acf914d-c24f-4e7c-82e4-d91c906c1149.Text: "Investigation? Didn't I tell you not to involve Solomorne in proceedings on the bridge?"

0e5e22c3-2566-4d4e-84c3-95ab65b6bd3f.Text: "Solomorne, why stage this scene? Accusing senior officers in front of the entire bridge?"

cb5dc6f7-9ffa-47f0-90c5-f85c8f0cec1d.Text: "Are we really taking fugitive criminals into our crew?"

12361c6c-d4f2-4045-9093-14b17adb8420.Text: "Why have you kept this from me?"

26b6bff7-78d6-4449-b606-2571abeedae4.Text: "Didn't I tell you that no audits were needed?"

ff11721f-f2a9-4f11-ab5a-622c675c36f4.Text: "I am satisfied with the way things are. Continue your efforts for the good of the dynasty."

77cc1802-ec7f-41e5-97e7-21dbcc14e888.Text: "I like Solomorne's suggestion. Let's do that."

0044e540-1c4c-41f5-aea2-5d2088609488.Text: "Rogue Trader, I hold the three senior officers accountable for the misconduct I have uncovered as part of my investigation. I allege that the ship's crew is full of wanted criminals. Do you refute the charge, Janris Danrok?"

f67f37e9-83d4-4c74-abd3-487f55bdecd3.Text: {n}The High Factotum stares at the Arbitrator with uncharacteristic coldness.{/n} "What are you insinuating, esteemed Proctor?"

8d8f0284-fe30-4c3c-b291-fbafa4dea6ef.Text: "Underhanded schemes are unworthy of your Emperor-given power — I recommend legalising the hiring of criminals through the Administratum. Of course, they cannot be full crew members: their service must include shackles, reduced rations, double watches, and daily punishments. The heretics will serve their time on the flagship and do good for the Imperium, and for each misdeed perpetrated by any of them, you will hold these three accountable one hundred times over."

38d2619a-0a2b-44ab-a693-5952e90859f1.Text: "I can see that your officers are acting for the good of the dynasty — it would be unfair not to take that into account in their sentencing. Therefore, I propose a process of atonement for the criminals brought aboard: those who show due diligence and loyalty at the end of their term may officially join the crew. All expenses are to be taken out of the personal allowance of these three — it will be their penalty for circumventing the law."

a2b49325-6df2-4d27-9a97-58cb4fcae5b7.Text: "It will take time... a great deal of time... and will require considerable financial contrib—" {n}Danrok stops short under your gaze.{/n}

6dc9b6de-a85c-4239-bac7-cc08962c9aec.Text: {n}The officers exchange glances.{/n} "We did not intend to hide it from you. Lord Captain Theodora did not deign to involve herself in so trifling a matter as replenishing her workforce. She was only interested in ensuring that there were no interruptions in the running of the ship. We have always handled crew appointments on our own, without Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}'s involvement."

56048683-6a08-4e05-a4dd-5479d291ae9c.Text: "Heretics on board the ship of the Emperor's anointed are a threat to the whole Imperium. If anyone knew of this and failed to report it... punishment will follow. Isn't that right, Vox Master?"

1f37b4b4-224d-40cf-9618-320d81f19efa.Text: "I have uncovered a scheme involving all three of them. It is coordinated by the Vox Master, who buries incriminating facts about voidsmen on your ship in the depths of the archives. Janris Danrok and Ravor turn a blind eye to the sordid pasts of the new recruits and divvy up the workforce that has come into their possession."

c42fccd0-e0a7-43d2-9fef-8652c650f28e.Text: "Your senior officers currently hold too much power — it has corrupted them. If you do not punish them now, they will lose their fear of you. Curtail their powers, force them to write reports on the tasks they complete and to account for every decision they make. That way you will be able to monitor the situation. And yes, I recommend whippings to enforce order."

06127956-d68f-4d9c-81f1-2a6d67074744.Text: "Sort of." {n}Janris clears his throat, shuffling from foot to foot.{/n} "Sometimes they slip through the net because we don't have information from local wardens. Sometimes we're forced to... overlook an unsightly past for the sake of acquiring niche specialists. Even common smugglers, for instance, often turn out to be quite an asset on Ravor's crew..."

f863b04d-4095-43ee-904b-9cb54f0c041d.Text: {n}Ravor and Vigdis silently bow to you.{/n}

3a0539b6-9529-4c69-b53d-a9de712c221b.Text: "That is correct. I merely examined the data obtained by the Vox Master and the High Factotum."

12406052-460f-4757-8379-27688c9a6305.Text: "There were none. I made do by analysing the data I had obtained earlier."

3a91d5ed-f96b-4360-a27b-5ce3e0e6adc9.Text: "We do draw a line, however, at even a whisper of genuine heresy in a voidfarer's past." {n}Vigdis raises her gaze to you.{/n} "I'm sure you realise, Lord Captain, that smuggling and false cultism are both heresies in the eyes of the law, for they transgress His word, but one is far more dangerous than the other, to put it bluntly."

01ca7b39-ca1a-4449-bc45-b0649057ba02.Text: {n}The officers look at each other in silence. Their respect for you — or perhaps their fear of you — stops them from expressing any displeasure.{/n}

5d09bdc3-f281-4abc-8b16-c0d3f60a7b2f.Text: {n}Vigdis does not react in any way to the Arbitrator's words.{/n} "I do my duty honourably and will obey the Lord Captain's will, whatever it may be."

b0af5599-3b4a-4245-94bf-f60dc741b313.Text: {n}The assembled officers look at you in anticipation of your decision.{/n}

be9245d9-19b8-431d-9d28-f3ad16aa7bab.Text: "This is a completely insane accusation. We are not bringing criminals into the crew intentionally! Of course we're not! I'll admit that we do not try to hunt down every biographical fact about each voidsman who sets foot on board, but only because that would be a hopeless endeavour..." {n}Danrok falters for a moment.{/n} "But none of us had any intention of populating your ship with heretics!"

50720f66-b59b-46f9-b023-de233d2a91ab.Text: "As you command, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. We will see it done."

daf4841b-931f-4cd3-8c34-2217cdc19001.Text: "What our esteemed Master Helmsman meant to say is that those unfortunates are only suitable for menial labour. It is simply impossible to find qualified voidsmen in the numbers we require."

da88f791-1e64-4847-a312-863f8cbd5d26.Text: "I... was in a rush and applied the regulations I'm accustomed to using on other vessels to your flagship. It was my fault for misjudging the situation, Rogue Trader."

c6f9d03d-7f2f-4349-86f4-d27ed1e5c1f0.Text: This xenos hide mantle once adorned Lady Theodora's shoulders. In the years since then, all had forgotten its existence, as well as that of the station it was left on.

dcb5bc79-c344-4931-9abf-721e82beeab9.Text: Theodora von Valancius had good reason to believe that secrets are better kept safe when only one person knows of their existence — herself.

3437ce96-8ab7-40c4-910e-b52a7a50e8c3.Text:
The wearer regains all {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} and can make an additional attack this {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}.
! Can only be used once per combat.

4d66c292-079a-4e93-a8ee-704640c8ab1a.Text: The wearer gains +2 {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} and the {g|f:4824d61c41f74e13be50391caf7f413f}Strike of Kurnous{/g} ability.

31273159-9f5c-4573-bf91-49d47aab4429.Text: While in combat, the wearer is considered protected by partial {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}cover{/g} if their {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} is more than 70, and by full cover instead if their Agility is more than 140.

cbd478e9-4ffe-47a0-ba92-af2ddfa6a70a.Text: The wearer gains +1 {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g} for each stack of this effect. When the wearer suffers any type of damage, except {g|Encyclopedia:DirectDamage}direct{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:WarpDamage}warp{/g}, or {g|Encyclopedia:MentalDamage}mental{/g}, all the stacks are removed.

da573f7f-9b53-4e9c-a8df-7d20d0ebb529.Text: Each time anyone uses a {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} in combat, the wearer gains +1 stack of the {g|f:8b6b420e5fad4cb3a0851ebf21ace3a8}wraithdance{/g} effect.

22fc0194-61de-4dc4-b7c0-268f5389a452.Text: Whenever the wearer {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodges{/g} an attack, they immediately counter-attack (Can even counter-attack with a ranged weapon in melee range). That counter-attack deals {uip|Damage|587c463377a14c9f843841fd7a19f461}% of weapon damage (cannot be more than 100%).

94072e83-5e4e-4c75-962a-3e3c333db2c2.Text: The wearer gains +70% {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g}. After each attack against the wearer that can be dodged, this value is reduced by −10%.

86faff08-ff6c-44e8-8542-25692b1ad9b7.Text: At the start of combat, the wearer gains the effect of the {g|f:adb64abd9fc745089b628b9a31d15dca}combat stimm: serpentin{/g} for 3 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rounds{/g}.

04c21983-6c02-41d4-b4b2-c0c56ffc30d5.Text: At the start of combat, the wearer gains the effect of {g|f:be213bbd9bd449a384d44b3a7e5b8893}combat stimm: grave lotus{/g} for 3 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rounds{/g}.

58dd6683-0876-4a8e-902d-1a25e36aed2f.Text: By humbling the monks and the Tech-Priests, the Rogue Trader has gained a reputation as a great mediator.

350c44e8-fab6-404b-b72d-c5d61fb5ec8c.Text: The Rogue Trader's servants have succeeded in identifying and studying the patterns in the peculiar drawings made by convicts on Vheabos VI.

bad94892-4076-4c8f-b674-9079ad4b35c2.Text: Everyone knows the Rogue Trader's eagerness to succeed using the most efficient ways possible.

ef054cc1-5290-4d1b-a969-825698b2027a.Text: Everyone knows the nobility of the Rogue Trader's spirit.

9cb8a30c-a95f-49a9-954f-a7626c2462ed.Text: The Omnissiah's favour is with the vanquisher of the tech-leprosy epidemic.

4922e5fc-a640-401a-9f2a-f9e0f1b1dda4.Text: May Metal never betray the {mf|Master|Mistress} whose deeds please the Omnissiah.

f26657b9-1598-4555-9725-d75324b7a8aa.Text: Seven times, each and every day, Prelate Inocrant says seventy-seven prayers for the Rogue Trader's health.

8ba0bd8d-f226-4d3f-970e-e0494ddd94f7.Text: The Rogue Trader is famed as the fearless sovereign who ordered the destruction of both evil spirits of Janus.

7b79bf36-4c41-4913-99e4-3dda7d9c423f.Text: Magos Toxicus of Vheabos VI, responsible for the purity of the climate domes, presented the Rogue Trader with a welcome gift of consecrated rebreather filters and poison resistance medicaments.

9c94e69d-ce0f-4440-8a56-16c23db51965.Text: Fyceline and promethium become a raging, all-destroying force in the hands of the Rogue Trader.

76d11337-6856-4c4f-9fce-172f6919a6ce.Text: The Rogue Trader's weapons carry the blessings of the supreme armourers of the Adeptus Mechanicus.

b6e375ea-f200-4178-99f3-206cf0c7f9ea.Text: The Adeptus Mechanicus generously bestowed esoteric secrets of energy transmutation upon the Rogue Trader.

1ba50650-a6a7-453b-a416-9e2fb15dadae.Text: Even the Omnissiah's metal spirits do not dare to force their will upon the Rogue Trader.

b620f02e-ec71-4749-81ed-caa5b6fcd991.Text: Everyone knows the ruthlessness of the Rogue Trader.

6fd400db-8940-4397-a180-7da60fbc378e.Text: The Rogue Trader's munitions are produced with fyceline of the highest quality.

26a86c8e-5315-4f94-8df7-49eacd284bf1.Text: The archeotech secrets extracted from the heads of the Touched were given to the gunsmiths tending the Rogue Trader's armoury.

6bc9e750-265f-4d84-8642-198ff1c72c32.Text: House Gaprak makes generous contributions to the colony's development and provides the planet with its most skilled servants.

00e6aae2-82a3-48a5-82cf-5ded7d7c26c5.Text: By the Rogue Trader's will, mystic artisans, masters of forbidden knowledge, burrowed themselves away in the depths of the manufactorums. There they continue the dangerous work of Cubis Delphim's heretics.

a2835e1e-fa01-4cb4-9ec5-4ca996717bf8.Text: The Rogue Trader wished that not a single poisoned seed of heresy on Kiava Gamma be allowed to survive. The work of the manufactorums has been halted for the duration of the great cleansing.

63c2c5d2-a2c8-402a-843e-e7d8ad1d0e08.Text: A World in Need of Cleansing

5363e71d-37b0-4fb6-b056-f1990b80173f.Text: Heresy on Kiava Gamma has been curtailed, but the Rogue Trader will not rest until it has been eradicated to the last poisoned seed. The planet's manufactorums are too important to allow any interruptions in their ceaseless production cycle.

5b1f9704-864a-4255-afff-773f7cc656bf.Text: The young Rogue Trader's decisive actions inspire confidence in {mf|his|her} subjects.

ed1b04ff-5406-4415-a31a-a9d8827142a2.Text: In ship encounters, the Rogue Trader's squad is supported by friendly combat servitors.

9ad4c52b-c6f4-41fc-a2c7-d7c846d853f1.Text:
Sacred icons painted by the Touched adorn the ship's decks.
~// Enemy critical hit chances and warp {g|Encyclopedia:SpaceBattleDamageGlossary}damage{/g} against the {g|Encyclopedia:FlagshipSpace}flagship{/g} are reduced by −30%

6dc97ee9-dbd2-4ca6-9cff-53af05f01415.Text:
The souls of the crewmen laid to rest in the Foulstone Cemetery send blessings to their ship.
~// The {g|Encyclopedia:FlagshipSpace}flagship{/g} gains a +5% bonus to {g|Encyclopedia:EvasionSpace}evasion{/g}

7d9c60b2-e662-491c-833c-4c642ccac91a.Text: Refugees from the fallen hive toil without rest to prove that they deserve the honour of serving the protectorate. These servants have now been tasked with maintaining the Rogue Trader's equipment in perfect condition, and they do so with painstaking care.

b6d60531-b68f-4285-83f7-39db58de0600.Text:
The Pure-Voiced Prophet has blessed the ship's weapons.
~// All voidship weapons (except torpedoes) deal +10% more {g|Encyclopedia:SpaceBattleDamageGlossary}damage{/g}

11e8c79e-3fb9-406c-bcec-7da8ff0dbd7f.Text:
Harsh overseers drive the crew in battle.
~// The {g|Encyclopedia:FlagshipSpace}flagship{/g} gains +3 {g|Encyclopedia:SpeedSpace}speed{/g} for the first round

9bb33b91-46c7-45ef-9f08-bc2f9502764b.Text: The Rogue Trader's {g|Encyclopedia:FlagshipSpace}flagship{/g} is escorted by an armed frigate.

85f6a701-4784-449d-b877-077c74ae49dc.Text: The Rogue Trader's ship is escorted by a pirate frigate.

829f845b-4b4b-446e-b677-8457cb6a2414.Text:
Confessors from the ranks of the Touched offer solace to the crew and pray for the ship's safety from the Archenemy's machinations.
~// The {g|Encyclopedia:FlagshipSpace}flagship{/g} gains a +20% bonus to {g|Encyclopedia:EvasionSpace}evasion{/g} against Chaos enemies

afb13ea4-f13b-4d10-91cf-f62270f86bf9.Text:
The Rogue Trader has received some of the best munitions and supplies for the defence of the Expanse.
~// +2 to the plating of all sectors

eeea60f7-a0c5-4262-8e49-2c8849ed9d89.Text:
All the inhabitants of the Expanse place their trust in the Rogue Trader during their hour of need.
~// The {g|Encyclopedia:FlagshipSpace}flagship{/g} restores +33% to the cooldown of ultimate abilities at the end of space combat. Red warp routes always become orange

adca6dbc-bbba-4278-aa05-cfd5ea2c3da3.Text:
The Tech-Priests who survived the tech-leprosy outbreak have proven their worth and thus earned the right to serve aboard the Rogue Trader's ship.
~// +20 to all void shield sectors

695c5f71-7e0c-4d60-ac41-dc79a82442d6.Text:
The spared convicts of Vheabos VI will not waste the second chance they have been granted, even if it costs them their lives. They have made for well-disciplined emergency crews.
~// The {g|Encyclopedia:FlagshipSpace}flagship{/g} suffer −40% ram {g|Encyclopedia:SpaceBattleDamageGlossary}damage{/g} less and gain +50% chance to reduce the duration of each {g|Encyclopedia:InternalFiresSpace}internal fire{/g} by −1 round

48b45d84-b58e-456c-98c2-f85f68899184.Text:
The cannoneers recruited from the warlike tribes of Vheabos VI are noted for their outstanding marksmanship as true hunters.
~// Torpedoes deal +15% more {g|Encyclopedia:SpaceBattleDamageGlossary}damage{/g}

0ae6681f-b28f-4160-af26-12c052bba189.Text:
Servitors have no feelings, but they serve, attempting to pay the Rogue Trader back for {mf|his|her} merciful guardianship.
~// +20 {g|Encyclopedia:HullIntegritySpace}hull integrity{/g}

6ad2db13-3ad6-4a46-a7bb-edba36cc94c1.Text:
After their admirable performance in the battles on Vheabos VI, the mercenaries are eager to serve the Rogue Trader. Many among them are seasoned combatants who can man the voidship's cannons.
~// All {g|Encyclopedia:LanceWeaponSpace}lance weapons{/g} deal +20% more {g|Encyclopedia:SpaceBattleDamageGlossary}damage{/g}

6c72e034-7d87-4b8e-82d9-dc7484fe544e.Text:
May the signal run free over the wires,
May the ocular eye be forever clear,
May the enemies of the Omnissiah be cast down.
~// +5 torpedo {g|Encyclopedia:SpeedSpace}speed{/g}

83f99c46-1d31-4f31-8141-77ca0fbde684.Text: Propose more favourable terms for the pact

ca837bf4-2822-4fca-b5fe-7887077fec71.Text: An Explorator ship has arrived on the planet. In accordance with an ancient pact forgotten by all but themselves, they intend to conduct general system maintenance and renew data-vows.

96ad42dd-8e7b-4458-9bae-fa4bee980b4d.Text: Having performed the restart liturgy on every tech-block and resanctified the energy substations, the Tech-Priests departed.

db1c2783-e776-46de-ab03-69f389309ec6.Text: Impressed by the prospering planet, the Tech-Priests have decided to strengthen their ties with the Rogue Trader by shortening the general maintenance cycle. In honour of the newly signed agreement, they offered the dynasty a gift — equipment for a lesser manufactorum.

65910ab0-c015-458c-bf87-32189388a61b.Text: Before leaving, they eagerly exchanged gifts by offering priceless technological marvels and accepting high-quality materials in return.

a0b16cf2-9020-4629-b793-f36bcbd0aef3.Text: Send loyal servants to the colony to make the nobles fall in line

8af2da35-bda5-4c35-b686-95808369b4a5.Text: As the colony's nobility amasses their wealth and makes new connections, they are showing less and less respect for the Rogue Trader.

555f9d73-f221-4a4d-a966-e55f49b857e6.Text: Rumours of the Rogue Trader's weakening authority are spreading throughout the Koronus Expanse.

97d7b76b-2bee-4448-8761-f00ad0ed4335.Text: The insolence of the colonists has been dealt with. Due to the ironclad discipline within the colony, the harsh punishments did not affect its productivity.

5b6fdc38-9a33-4a9f-b47a-8d943607c447.Text: The new colonists, who are not subservient to the local nobility, have reined in the aristocracy's hubris and reminded them of where their loyalties lie.

0963e2c2-88e2-4b1f-8013-8ad0cb4f4a3a.Text: Make haste to aid the colony

8cb259af-51c6-435b-87a3-4092f5b53b20.Text: Fight them off with the colony's own forces

5c60b10f-76c0-43c2-92d6-df1c5063a884.Text: Pay a tribute to the pirates

5959fdaf-7dd1-4389-8576-244a5c389270.Text: A gang of vile pirates has descended upon the colony and is now bombarding it from orbit.

a6009439-aa25-44a9-a55c-94921f327565.Text: The colony is sending a distress signal and requires the Rogue Trader's help.

a250e369-b899-4075-806d-9fa11103466a.Text: In a bloody battle, the planet's wardens defeated the landing party and forced the villains to flee from orbit.

bd6803e2-1971-45cf-b12b-f0c6bb622ee5.Text: Having reaped a fortune, the void mongrels finally left.

9538b57a-087c-4019-9207-6cd8eec308a0.Text: Pay a human tribute to the Drukhari

921eb4e2-9f66-4d99-9c0a-9f86b5a16ddf.Text: Having collected their bloody toll, the xenos left.

5ebee510-004e-40e9-bb6f-c34e31631dc1.Text: Suppress the riot with the planetary wardens

043a8876-4539-4cca-bef1-f0066e6e15dc.Text: A riot has broken out in the colony. The Cult of the Final Dawn has sunk its poisonous roots into the planet and has now grown strong enough to make itself known.

e916c734-c8c7-415e-ae7b-5a61d1f916fa.Text: The heretics' riot was mercilessly quelled and its instigators publicly executed.

7df46f1f-00e7-4042-944e-a583676a8bb8.Text: Cutthroats, loyal to the Rogue Trader, came to the colony and brutally dealt with the heretics.

2c4f5f0f-769f-4620-a7da-4189d55e2faf.Text: Pass holy relics to the faithful

a844f34c-557f-4ee5-9bae-1740860f6872.Text: Hurry to the colony with holy sacraments that will protect the faithful

8336f6f1-a93c-4a8c-9433-e1ad1c4df020.Text: Burn down the regions infected by the epidemic

9d7c9238-2225-433a-8aad-1381a64ed2c1.Text: The radiance of their faith destroyed the infection and put an end to the epidemic. The Emperor protects!

99d5643f-0ce9-4d49-8bbe-f1c84fa0ded2.Text: The hotbed of the infection was isolated, and regular health checks of the populace were enforced. These steps allowed the colony to put a stop to the outbreak.

2342fb7d-950b-4bb9-a533-2a56566ab03b.Text: The hotbed of the infection was turned to ash, and the disease retreated, terrified by the Rogue Trader's iron resolve.

f2059129-65e3-40ea-8a55-5cf1d8c643ef.Text: Order the planetary wardens to slay Winterscale's lackeys

f1938246-0bf1-4570-8af2-f2c03a3e0bde.Text: Buy the loyalty of Winterscale's people

4a180d4f-440b-4288-a6ae-3b7af73b27a9.Text: A troop of well-armed people has landed in the colony and started plundering, acting like they are in charge. The reports suggest that these pirating cutthroats are privateers, the likes of whom flock toward the banner of Calligos Winterscale, seeking his favour.

5fcd739a-26bf-459c-ba13-4c7a6209c8c3.Text: The wardens drenched the outsiders in their own blood and chased them away.

58b769a8-7895-4ed8-aa8e-f39eff89af8b.Text: Winterscale's crooked servants were all too eager to enter their new {mf|master|mistress}'s employ.

f12bc854-186a-4e4b-8a08-eebc206d9ae4.Text: Execute every noble who allowed themselves to be tricked

f6f6fe75-4bc1-4a56-a077-1f91e04cb1a8.Text: Declare a hunt for the impostor

5a6e75bf-45b6-44a0-a3de-238e31173446.Text: Hire the impostor to act as a decoy

2e248856-a567-4ec4-86a1-e10366b2eca3.Text: An impostor claiming to be the Rogue Trader has arrived on the planet. Apparently, {mf|he|she} indeed bears an uncanny resemblance to the Rogue Trader and has already managed to fool a number of nobles and collect ample gifts from them.

662ba99d-154b-4634-bed2-02eee11fd045.Text: The public executions of the careless nobles have made the rest of the aristocrats more vigilant and cautious. However, the impostor was able to abscond with {mf|his|her} ill-gotten riches.

10243793-1004-4aa0-b93d-cb321f141d58.Text: Eager to carry out the Rogue Trader's order, the people hunt down anyone whose appearance is even remotely similar to {mf|his|hers}. Whether the actual impostor has been killed or not remains unknown. Now the Rogue Trader will have to think twice before coming to this world in person again.

9ff6a174-5fe9-4155-9f74-c362b933edc0.Text: The impostor was overjoyed to accept the offer. Now {mf|he|she} attends social gatherings and other formal events, inspiring the planet's officials with "personal" visits from the Rogue Trader.

70b923e5-80e3-4ae9-89b3-a95ad689a08e.Text: Eradicate the cult as an affront to the Omnissiah

26f77703-e360-4cbc-9eb3-ee737075d281.Text: Servitorise the cult's leaders in secret, turning them into servo-heralds

a73fe3ed-2ac4-4201-bfd4-09ea7bbaa1ab.Text: A strange cult of machine worshippers has appeared among the workers. They disassemble industrial mechanisms and implant the parts as preposterous "augmetics" inside their bodies.

8af65709-e8a1-4514-bcf7-b1b3bfc512fe.Text: The cult's leaders have been eliminated and the desecrators servitorised and assigned to maintain the holy mechanisms that they themselves damaged.

79646ae9-cdd5-4377-b868-de8d34379e7b.Text: The machine-worshipping labourers are now rewarded for exceptional performance with unwanted spare parts instead of extra rations. Productivity has increased dramatically.

885e1236-38cd-4e70-9705-98f345260393.Text: The servo-heralds control the unsuspecting cultists, keeping their destructive urges in check.

1ff09753-b2cb-4e19-a158-3bf46a2977e8.Text: Ask Lord Inquisitor Calcazar for a favour

7b66aef5-6368-43dd-a133-695c855edcbc.Text: Use the dynasty's resources to facilitate the witness removal effort so that the unwanted guests will leave sooner

877421c6-4172-4a10-8280-da8de98123d5.Text: Bribe the agents with valuable pieces of xenotech

6c51bb70-9550-4b92-aa63-a684c144a62c.Text: Vilify the agents of the Golden Throne in the eyes of the population

b1fd1e84-eae5-4fbd-a096-4f3ebe1aecf4.Text: Agents of the Inquisition have carried out a large-scale covert operation on the planet. Now they are in the process of removing all witnesses, which is having a severe impact on the colony's functioning.

cc6e7337-435f-4a23-bd86-d09494735c10.Text: The next day, the Inquisitorial acolytes conclude their activities and leave the planet without a word of explanation.

d025af35-4d52-4318-ac1c-8b41ea5ed550.Text: The Rogue Trader's enforcers purge entire residential sectors, sparing no one. Satisfied, the acolytes take their leave.

e44380f7-d1fe-4b65-a82e-91a14faed75f.Text: The acolytes accept the generous gifts and depart. The colony can breathe a sigh of relief, but the consequences of bribing agents of the Golden Throne remain to be seen.

ba4b7555-9e81-49d7-8f9c-6975e11fd701.Text: Acting on secret orders, a group of preachers convince the common folk that the acolytes are vicious heretics in disguise. The agents are torn apart by an enraged mob that buries them under a mound of bodies.

96fca6a2-655b-46e3-baef-858d5bc5547d.Text: Keep silent about the mistake by bribing the Chartist

4175cd5a-4ec8-4468-97a7-04ae8d037d7c.Text: Return the cargo to its rightful owner

4d7663a5-937d-4a96-a8c1-5efd80945927.Text: A Chartist has delivered the wrong cargo to the planet — instead of the expected air filters, the world received a far more valuable shipment of cogitator boards.

5fc18fb1-74e2-4391-ae83-3547ab35a51b.Text: The Chartist readily falsifies the manifest and expresses hope that this is the beginning of a fruitful partnership.

f930f2c4-81dc-4fc6-bb16-68526263512f.Text: The cargo's intended recipient, an admiral of the Merchant Fleet in command of a squadron, is outraged and vows to take revenge for this insult. The Rogue Trader has made a new enemy this day.

72a173ed-4b5c-4780-a669-db30876bd26d.Text: The cargo's intended recipient, an admiral of the Merchant Fleet in command of a squadron, thanks the Rogue Trader for {mf|his|her} honesty and assures {mf|him|her} that the debt will be repaid.

49f2419a-f398-4a54-8992-776eb1e07c36.Text: Welcome Reverend Hieronymus with lavish festivities

e974b836-6bab-492a-84e8-99a1b457262b.Text: Organise a grand mass burning of blasphemers and the weak of faith in honour of Reverend Hieronymus's arrival

0a6b4f6f-341e-495d-8cd1-209a96e03a0d.Text: Reverend Hieronymus Doloroso has arrived on the planet for a brief visit. A great many itinerant pilgrim have come with him in hopes of finding a new home.

1377ae99-cd2a-42ce-a4bb-6e64b16d43cc.Text: Many of the pilgrims, weary from the years of wandering, decided to settle in the Rogue Trader's colony.

33760466-9096-4bdc-9b62-d36b6ab79673.Text: The colony's spiritual fervour has impressed many of the pilgrims, and they have decided to stay on the Rogue Trader's planet.

590ec05a-7f94-46e6-a762-217bc0acbdca.Text: Reverend Hieronymus departed for another world, taking the rest of the faithful with him in search of a planet that could become their home.

c758bde4-ae4c-4452-82b7-d261cbb1470e.Text: Call upon hunters of the wicked from the Cult of Saint Drusus

c397ee00-f593-47a2-8b88-0d7bd64d7d26.Text: Select the most powerful psykers and start training them in secret

74facb9b-9be2-4160-8bea-20626bc06fb9.Text: Declare a hunt for the awakened psykers

60511f2c-bf76-4705-8a67-467ab53f04cf.Text: An anomalous warp storm raging over the planet's surface has caused a mass awakening of psychic abilities among the population.

dc4591a0-bf17-479e-85d4-c2e12ca131ac.Text: The pious militants have slain the most dangerous witches and imprisoned the rest until the inevitable arrival of a Black Ship.

8206d1b1-4b50-42a2-990f-58e5eddbd6a7.Text: Thousands of unsanctioned psykers have been delivered to covert strongholds, where, under strict watch, they have begun to learn to control their powers. Those who survive will become valuable tools of the dynasty.

cc56aec1-ddfc-4ab8-848d-329a96a4e9ab.Text: The psykers, terrified and incapable of controlling their powers, claimed the lives of many loyal servants of the Imperium before they were exterminated.

f57402c5-acbe-492b-a72a-90433778db4a.Text: Provided shelter to the Winterscale refugees.

01ba6e4b-7cd8-46fa-8e21-7593a6337d10.Text: Capture the ships and kill the refugees

041474bd-de3c-478d-b4bf-46f943b84d0f.Text: Give the refugees fuel and supplies and send them on their way

3389913a-d79f-4d76-a1bc-e404f7e8a32d.Text: Equip the refugees with weapons and send them to a planet belonging to one of the dynasty's rivals

5033eb60-16f5-4e87-b1f9-e4bafb7f73ce.Text: There is a ship convoy in the planet's orbit bearing refugees from Winterscale's Realm. The survivors claim that their sun has been stolen. Such an influx of hungry, wounded, and sick people may put a great strain on the colony's resources.

1499e792-9c8e-49f1-92e9-1edfad5e7f14.Text: The convoy left orbit and disappeared in the cold void. It is unlikely that the refugees will last long without supplies, but that is not the Rogue Trader's concern.

db6dfdd5-b79d-4915-af4e-f9636326abe6.Text: As expected, the world in question refuses to take in the refugees. Thousands of armed, angry people with nothing to lose make planetfall despite the prohibition. Bloody battles ensue, paralysing the planetary economy of the Rogue Trader's rival.

ae96ed2c-69e9-438d-be60-87415bfdbc9f.Text: Hungry, desperate people have flooded the colony. Their housing and upkeep consume tremendous resources, and not all of the planet's inhabitants are pleased with this decision. Conflicts and clashes have become commonplace.

1b167315-83a1-4149-b71f-fb76b71b2d8e.Text: Upon painting the ships' holds with blood, the Rogue Trader's subjects added the convoy to the planetary fleet.

1774b7e6-48dc-4025-879d-86d3ec5c734b.Text: The dispossessed thanked the Rogue Trader and set out on a new journey in hopes of finding refuge elsewhere.

f80478c4-3609-4b99-a75f-1ac687653a3c.Text: Ordered that the rare cargo that sowed discord in the colony be burned.

a3843846-7f87-4db8-9298-58f8743f7cc6.Text: Burn the contentious riches and provide assistance to the surviving crew — this is no time to be filling one's pockets, plundering, or fighting over trophies

c5455538-03fc-4251-9dc1-5281624d0527.Text: Order the ship to be looted

90d6e8f8-9a9c-4251-9199-17714f1ef255.Text: Authorise a repair effort that will last hundreds of years

fecb0a0e-135e-473c-84c6-35a4bef3a369.Text: Take the ship under the dynasty's protection until its owners arrive

c4bf1298-0723-4aba-8466-b54f92a24142.Text: A Chartist ship loaded with valuable cargo has crash-landed on the planet. While legal scholars are divided on the legitimacy of the Rogue Trader's claim on the cargo, the local inhabitants are already preparing to loot the vessel and the crew is bracing itself for a bitter defence.

c1cf0a2c-2e69-4c77-99f9-abe83e8e5267.Text: The crew surrenders the ship without a fight, not daring to object to the Rogue Trader's will. Both they and the locals watch dejectedly as the valuable cargo goes up in righteous flames.

8f8a8077-9dee-4100-ba82-9d68639c1dac.Text: The colony dwellers broke through the ship's defences, plundered the holds, and put the surviving crew to work. In response to this unsanctioned act, the Adeptus Administratum has filed a tediously protracted suit against the Rogue Trader.

b755caca-c9d3-4561-9439-85817b0bcc92.Text: By the time the repairs are complete, the crew will have assimilated into the colony and long since died, and the fact that the cargo was given to the dynasty for "temporary safekeeping" will have faded from memory. The Rogue Trader's actions are irreproachable, but the colony dwellers, who had hoped to help themselves to a precious haul and some ship components, are left disappointed.

acbee237-9881-4d2f-a5f3-236a63476014.Text: Another Chartist vessel soon arrives on the colony world to pick up the cargo and the crew, promising never to forget the Rogue Trader's probity.

f1c99097-f122-4a1a-8953-45d0e4e630e3.Text: Appease the guild with precious gifts

73209ea0-a37a-4526-a99c-5d5d777877cb.Text: Strike a military blow at the guild

8d6bf229-db30-426c-b119-d282d9b4efe3.Text: Hire pirates to eliminate the guild leaders

e283fc3c-d352-41c8-97ce-bd26d27601f3.Text: A Chartist guild has started a tariff war with the protectorate. Trade and logistics on this world are suffering!

b6bf710a-9eb4-4260-bbb6-957ff523fa22.Text: The guild members arrogantly accepted the Rogue Trader's gifts and turned their attention away from the protectorate.

1de496bb-0d8a-4ab7-af71-910fef5257c1.Text: The defeat of the guild did not yield any trophies, but trade was resumed in full.

308f282a-4e9c-4a2c-815c-37c8798f1a7b.Text: The Fellowship of the Void made quick and bloody work of the guild's leadership. The lesson had been learned, and the new officers in charge immediately put a stop to the tariff war.

b773366f-f6d5-4cdc-b140-776b5272753a.Text: Give the participants weapons to make the race more entertaining

ebed9a12-e61b-4a7b-89ef-86b907a49ce5.Text: Ban the race and butcher the groxes

45fbc8ec-d1fa-40ae-8af8-744b240229f4.Text: Personally take part in the race and send out invites to the representatives of the dynasty's more prominent allies

d5bf878e-5f0a-49c4-9b6c-e5cb53857cd3.Text: The world is preparing for an annual event fiercely popular among the common folk: a groxback race across the central continent. Hundreds of participants have been raising and training the beasts just for this occasion.

7be1a0d0-4b51-4543-8dc4-6dd681ea8001.Text: The masses were enraptured by the bloody sight of the reptiles racing and weaving between explosion craters under a hail of stubber fire — the event was declared a success!

85f4cf28-4cc6-4b25-8167-00f11e9c3760.Text: The dispirited riders reluctantly carved up their mounts for their meat. After returning to work, the rabble took some small comfort in knowing that the colony's food stocks had been replenished.

3666dd6e-f83c-478c-99ef-e5910c8db590.Text: Stupefied by the Rogue Trader's attention, the people watch in awe as the Lord Captain overtakes the other competitors and prevails in the race. The Rogue Trader's reputation grows, both among the common folk and with {mf|his|her} allies.

8cc3146f-3bbe-433b-a355-47c5b720d558.Text: Call upon the people rescued from Rykad Minoris — it is time to repay the debt

b462943b-b2a2-4527-afd2-0f92fbc502ff.Text: Hide the most valuable inhabitants of the world in bunkers

b817614b-2e9f-487f-96d9-7d6b2a60c30d.Text: A voidship twisted by the Archenemy's dark power, formerly part of the Rykad Minoris fleet, has burst into the system! Its cursed vox-systems transmit prophecies of doom, promising the colony the same fate as that which befell the lost planet.

fad1dbb6-7ff9-4e51-944a-e184d839a54a.Text: The Rykadian nobles and commoners, their hearts still bitter with mourning for their lost homeworld and desire for vengeance, band together as a militia force and help the colony destroy the wicked invaders.

0bd6d00b-9f53-42b2-ab31-b115685423a0.Text: The well-coordinated manoeuvres of the planetary fleet combined with the Rogue Trader's remote tactical support have ensured the crushing defeat of the Archenemy's servants.

ea4ea468-1736-4982-8d57-84e5c480550b.Text: Landing parties from the damned vessel bring death and destruction to the world. Finally sated, the cultists leave the system.

4c18005a-09b9-4470-b356-fe070e35b216.Text: Empty the water tanks and order the people to wait for the next shipment

d3d841b5-6635-4c2b-b07f-5b075510e03a.Text: Purchase an emergency shipment of water

8315df33-9123-481c-8be0-70ec7644c52f.Text: Distract the people by proclaiming that this plight is the Emperor's punishment for their tolerance of mutants and declaring a hunt for the abominable scum

6f0e8562-17ba-4ed3-b663-21a74044769a.Text: Request support from the Cognisance Fleet

06a6261f-52f9-4337-8ad9-7dd719f5e0f0.Text: The Cult of the Final Dawn has poisoned the colony's water supplies — all who drink from the tainted sources start mutating at frightening speed.

1a4e973b-2548-442f-825e-bb1fe87ede46.Text: The tormented people are driven to commit terrible crimes for the sake of a drop to drink. These dark events will be forever remembered in the colony's annals as the Great Thirst.

54269d67-3eb3-4faa-a381-50762341cd2c.Text: Suppliers are taking advantage of the Rogue Trader's desperation by driving up the prices of rush shipments, but the colony's population has been saved.

39560183-176e-4aae-8018-cd606a87eea3.Text: While the Rogue Trader's subjects take out their anger on mutants and suspicious neighbours, the water is purified. Many have perished, but now the people of the colony firmly believe that the return of the water supplies is their reward for intolerance of deviations in the human form.

17a265e3-1e0a-44e3-81b2-1076eaaffa65.Text: Quickly and efficiently, the Tech-Priests set up a powerful water treatment plant. The purified water has a peculiar taste, but at least it is safe to drink.

e962689d-31f7-4acd-acb8-1accb3f31be9.Text: Send spies who will convert the cultists with bribes

a63c860f-9027-4b9a-a438-62f07b159ccd.Text: Organise large-scale purges and order the temples to curse Voigtvir's name

d8757e44-5420-4020-9b0a-be3f55f7881e.Text: Command the dynasty's subjects to destroy the heretics

b98a6338-d007-46c8-8c54-34d67f63db27.Text: Secret heretical communities have been discovered on the colony world. Rumour has it that Kunrad Voigtvir himself paid several visits to the planet to sow seeds of corruption.

7cfd61aa-2ecd-4ba1-b532-8068e1470749.Text: Many of Voigtvir's followers are joining the Rogue Trader's side and helping to destroy their former associates.

5a048b22-20bf-4d8d-8212-409487c8df3d.Text: The manhunts, executions, and incessant sermons condemning the traitor Voigtvir have hindered the colony's output.

23e2a13b-c4d0-4fba-b0c6-07664e676515.Text: The people seize any cultist they expose and burn them without mercy. In the glow of countless bonfires and to the screams of vile apostates, the colony purges itself of corruption.

387ac8ed-c331-4371-b01a-ce511409422f.Text: Wait, study the xenos' movements, then launch a sudden attack

3561fa2c-b14e-4ad3-8607-8931412371ac.Text: Order the people to take shelter

d574c8c7-2085-4be1-a3c9-1056988b0c51.Text: Organise a crowded festival to lure the xenos in

3ed36614-58d4-4033-ac6a-16ed0452c501.Text: The Drukhari have been delivering precision strikes to the colony, tormenting its terrorised inhabitants.

b063ce21-9b2c-43aa-8f12-9271b9386b39.Text: The unsuspecting people come to the festival, and so do the xenos, hungry for blood. A powerful salvo from the orbital cannons reduces them all to ash. Now the Drukhari prefer to give the colony a wide berth.

ef3f5d64-9fab-4200-89e8-56bde6071a05.Text: While the Drukhari are enjoying the slaughter, the Rogue Trader's servants carefully observe them. At last, the xenos are exterminated in an act of righteous retribution, leaving behind rich spoils on board their ships.

5c407aa8-b239-4af6-a50e-29561d4c0d79.Text: Production halts, but casualties are avoided. Bored, the xenos soon leave the system.

336de9c5-45ae-432d-9b1a-869bc54ac349.Text: After exorbitant losses, the people claim a dozen xenos heads. The Drukhari lose interest and leave the system.

4ed22985-a550-44de-8028-c0b9b60c60da.Text: Allow these subjects to set out on their way

5c53f2f1-0a9b-47cf-946c-e246f419390e.Text: Request that the followers of Saint Drusus bring holy relics to the colony

445640a4-fcb9-45e2-b0a8-1b1afc72303e.Text: Thousands of commoners have left their workstations to gather for a holy pilgrimage.

c5735a3a-8f2b-451b-8bba-f419fd61d1ee.Text: Manufactorums ground to a halt after thousands of workers leave their posts.

80043c36-c34c-4241-a228-1ce916929618.Text: The order caused significant discontent, leading to a bout of sabotage and petty disobedience.

196c6f53-442e-4fdd-a70e-932bcf7c8c2b.Text: Instead of leaving the colony, the people, trembling in awe, attended services by the relics, then returned to work inspired.

4a8b6f40-bc85-4469-80b3-44d99e9b76a1.Text: Offer them noble titles in exchange for their trophies

856fad50-389a-4f1e-8852-9a7e924053c5.Text: A void scout ship has arrived in the colony's orbit, having returned from a long expedition. Their hold is filled with trophies, and their promethium tanks are nearly empty.

432b632e-19f9-4efc-9c6b-7df4829c7eac.Text: The explorers of the unknown appreciated the prospering colony and agreed. No longer will the newly titled nobles have to risk their lives breathing recycled air.

539f4ac7-204f-46a2-96a7-577ac5e3a7a6.Text: The explorers of the unknown agreed to sell their trophies to the Rogue Trader, not willing to risk running into pirates while looking for a better price.

fb307435-61d0-48ab-bb15-51ce4828bea0.Text: The explorers of the unknown paid well for the promethium and departed.

56af91cf-f355-4308-babd-0fd2fdedafec.Text: Appoint whoever offers the most lavish gifts as the new governor

2d9fea91-4d89-4411-8b72-8157be265925.Text: Publicly execute the most enthusiastic schemers

030697f8-fa0f-4a6c-8739-5c65ea5e1eaa.Text: Spurred on the feud between the aristocrats for your own amusement, ignoring the collateral damage.

9be9120e-0aa4-4b8c-afc2-9b813cd3957b.Text: Entertain yourself by discreetly fanning the flames of intrigue

799371cd-d62b-4ba7-9af0-19227adb06ef.Text: The colony is facing a leadership crisis: the current governor is weak, and the nobles are engaged in a power struggle and have all but forgotten governing the planet.

89666585-b886-4c30-a53d-fce533345884.Text: Vying for the Rogue Trader's favour, the nobility neglects its duties further still. The victor, their coffers depleted, has assumed the long-coveted governor's throne.

fd1e2e62-b300-4406-8c51-5b57f430537a.Text: Though the nobles are now resentful of the Rogue Trader, fear drives them to be diligent in their duty to the colony.

b1756e97-c6db-4fd3-97a9-21d4b669e14d.Text: The Rogue Trader's servants set the nobles against each other, starting a bloody feud. In the end, the colony is left scarred by the conflict and under the rule of the most unscrupulous noble house, which secured its victory through a series of despicable betrayals and blackmail.

43f7c75a-13bf-4be1-a5ff-8636abeb6f6e.Text: Prove your piety by donating substantial resources to the Ecclesiarchy

70556dd9-5c9b-46a7-af10-c1bf684bdc37.Text: Request help from the followers of Saint Drusus

9f322a62-c5fb-40ac-83b8-bb329f7bd1cf.Text: There are rumours in the colony that the Rogue Trader has given in to the Archenemy's corruption, personally killed Lady Theodora, and usurped the throne by force.

acb1d43e-5fbc-4e03-b797-88de4bf009d0.Text: Horror has sealed the population's lips — no one wishes to be burned at the stake for their careless tongue.

3b7a2ec8-fc8b-47e0-907d-605a38e5ea0a.Text: Once the Ecclesiarchy's representatives publicly confirmed that the Rogue Trader remained a virtuous servant of the Emperor, the troubling rumours died away.

5d8753da-9bcf-4358-96f2-935417f4f434.Text: The Drusians' services and sermons have dispelled the veil of idle hearsay and slander.

e5527308-e4c6-431e-998b-32cb853fae25.Text: Do not give in to the demands

070ea815-9e13-4c1c-959d-106f61c75c19.Text: Pay the Kasballica Mission to arrange some more pressing problems for the blackmailer

b83ffd2e-b1ac-4219-a269-08f9f8dfbf4d.Text: One of the more influential patrons in the Expanse has learned a dirty secret about the von Valancius dynasty and is now blackmailing the Rogue Trader.

6430fb75-1501-4773-ba62-5da20c6b2feb.Text: The blackmailer has accepted the hush payment and sworn to keep the secret safe... as long as the "donations" continue, at least.

6e0ef24b-bc60-40d3-ba72-d41b096715a3.Text: Soon the Expanse is shaken by scandalous evidence proving that Lady Theodora plundered ships and colonies that belonged to her rivals. The dynasty's reputation has been sullied.

e9f205bd-bfab-435a-a10c-f265caeaa5c7.Text: Several days later, the Rogue Trader receives a report along with a sealed envelope containing the damning evidence and a small box containing two little fingers and the tip of a tongue. The blackmailer never makes contact again.

a8cfe6ae-a4fd-4ad6-92ba-f60e585d0094.Text: Publicly confess to some trifling errors

2266ad30-4922-4e40-9a6b-db2295169f51.Text: Execute two noble families at random and confiscate their property

d51c01f3-75e4-4c83-adb7-b78da692de8c.Text: Offer privileges to whoever turns in the malcontent

634afdd6-d230-45ed-a81e-597c36801079.Text: A malcontent has begun spreading insulting rumours concerning the Rogue Trader among the aristocracy.

40a9d782-75bf-4a1e-979d-1b5402e1c3e5.Text: The Rogue Trader's carefully prepared confession impresses the planet's clergy. The priests denounce the nobles who believed the slanderous words and make it their mission to keep a close eye on the aristocracy's moral integrity by constantly adding new religious taboos to their lives.

656f7618-1ca0-46e7-9c3d-a65329d47329.Text: The event is such a success that it scatters the rumours to the winds. The aristocrats, charmed by the Rogue Trader's generosity, present gifts as a show of gratitude.

1cde176b-a732-4ae6-97a3-d7efb2f9b0c6.Text: The act of deterrence was effective: whoever the malcontent was, they have stopped spreading rumours. The nobles, however, will not stop discussing the Rogue Trader's brutality for a while yet.

72ee7e12-718d-40d3-9a7b-d10b8f94dbfd.Text: Only a few days later, the troublemaker is caught and their tongue presented to the Rogue Trader on a silver platter. The noble house that is to be thanked for resolving the matter now monitors any and all remarks mentioning the ruler of the protectorate.

cb2fc58e-4cf5-4773-a3e5-58b32720d80b.Text: Secretly support an uprising among the miners

9f1af817-a6f6-4dc6-bb2a-695382875edc.Text: Make the consortium respect the agreements by force

7ca6db31-bf26-4e2a-b0c1-061ebb1a3b42.Text: Request that the Imperial Navy boycott the consortium's trade routes

a31462b6-e38a-47ce-910c-b1621b2e67e0.Text: In its efforts to exploit the crisis in the Expanse, a prominent mining consortium is disrupting ore shipments to the colonies of the protectorate.

1e95d5a9-c40a-4c9a-9613-2848b78c0fab.Text: After a series of pointed attacks, the consortium assents to resuming the ore shipments without interruptions. However, other suppliers, intimidated by this show of aggression, are in no hurry to sign contracts with the Rogue Trader.

a172b07e-7a5f-4681-ad57-68bf5c8cf76d.Text: Unable to restore order, the consortium breaks apart. Most of the splinter enterprises enter into contracts with the Rogue Trader.

36c94780-98d5-48cb-94cc-2849d6566545.Text: Frightened by the prospect of an economic blockade, the consortium offers its apologies and reinstates the shipment schedule.

6029664b-a269-4234-b190-3182f22eed86.Text: Accelerate the process with a generous donation

39f3ecd0-14eb-4aaa-ac97-df1c3a7ba365.Text: Use the interim as a lesson in patience and acceptance

590fa0ff-039e-447a-b583-384121bb69f5.Text: Burn a few clerks in one of the squares

a8cb1ea6-4b64-4b1f-8c10-8403bba2711a.Text: The Adeptus Administratum has mired the colony in a mind-numbing appraisal process, the completion of which continues to be delayed.

d88ba569-c3db-4e0d-857e-d16dddf5e68b.Text: The burnings create disruptions in the bureaucratic chain, important documents are misplaced, and the only solution is for the entire process to begin anew.

4147b235-4ed3-47ee-9d2f-e37c5e76b14c.Text: The Adeptus Administratum indignantly rejects the bribe. The evaluation procedure is delayed for another two months.

6716eb96-5663-4142-8d79-b6d8d8480036.Text: The appraisal process carries on just as slowly and painfully, but the Rogue Trader's patience is praised as an example for other rulers.

f1d8de0a-c2ad-42c4-9ccb-569b173ef274.Text: Proclaim that the saints give the workers their blessing so that they may be diligent in their toils

05f801ee-9f4d-45b5-8526-358e31b43a1a.Text: Pronounce the visions heretical and drive the workers back to their stations

c4a4f11f-2e4c-495b-af70-cfe250a30fa8.Text: Under the pretext of a pilgrimage, round up the most vehement believers, take them into orbit, and put them out through an airlock

2c0e3b39-8cf7-45b6-8000-6e20384b9b68.Text: Some inhabitants of the colony are being visited by saints in their dreams — the workers are growing dangerously ecstatic from these pious visions.

11b4ff88-f9c5-4568-ac57-df11a6e843e4.Text: Disgruntled, the people return to the manufactorums, finding solace in labour in the name of the God-Emperor.

2dd0acec-bd8b-4118-92eb-510ea6466525.Text: Still overwhelmed with pious fanaticism, the workers exceed quotas and die of exhaustion right at their stations.

74f74474-68ac-48c1-8294-a8bc035c8796.Text: The mass disappearances do not go unnoticed. The people mourn the martyrs but no longer dare go against the established order in the colony.

2d2fa234-4e7b-4c97-9ae9-5d64d1347ba1.Text: Stop the shipments and wait until the danger has passed

fdb8a66d-bb8f-4338-b997-4c7ec316c96f.Text: Strike a deal with the Drukhari

981ac8b3-5d39-4473-8b26-4f1db5b077f6.Text: Redistribute the colony's reserves so that the world can hold out without shipments

85429925-8994-4f88-897d-efd394e8416e.Text: A nearby transport hub has been ravaged by a Drukhari raid — the supply chain across the whole region is under threat.

0d65dbe7-5163-4962-b1c3-0d59e35276bc.Text: The colony's resources allow it to survive until the Drukhari lose interest and leave the system.

c3e31038-f4c8-4967-9b4f-9c4b6bce3bff.Text: The Drukhari are only interested in one form of payment: living people. Having filled their holds with victims, the xenos disappear from the system.

56fdf815-6cdc-4bd3-8894-8a84f22b0ccf.Text: All trade stops until the bored xenos finally decide to leave the system.

5cb58a55-d93c-40ce-9cc0-74ae4fdbcdf3.Text: Leave the least valuable sectors of the colony unprotected to encourage the Drukhari to focus their hunts there

984e8034-cd8e-4f01-b214-c5c8c70a8d84.Text: Start a rumour among pirates about the Kabals' unimaginable riches

8f3b0d2f-39e4-4c85-be76-311c3cb26e87.Text: Set up an ambush in the colony

e9b46644-4e19-4828-bc9e-bf46a1eb4003.Text: Two Drukhari Kabals are vying to see which can capture more of the Rogue Trader's subjects in the system. The dynasty's servants lament the elusiveness of the accursed xenos.

9e3188ec-10e5-45e6-bf6b-69d235719fa0.Text: The xenos took the bait and walked straight into the ambush, at which point the planetary wardens, supported by automated defence systems and militia forces, were finally able to destroy the blasted raiders.

3a4039aa-f602-4ca1-bf48-5cdae92bd3ad.Text: Dozens of pirate ships arrive in the system to hunt the Drukhari. The xenos beat a hasty retreat, and the pirates follow.

923802aa-d424-4c17-b910-80e07cc97ba0.Text: After capturing thousands of defenceless people, the xenos left the system to count their trophies and declare the victor.

a90771ac-7434-44b4-999d-6a01a869ca2a.Text: Threaten the fleet's captain with anti-orbit weapons

c3034f6d-9a57-4757-82bc-ba664b9ab0b5.Text: Let the Inquisition finish what they started

a9fec8ed-586c-46c8-b433-ca7389caccdf.Text: Tell Marazhai to reach an agreement with his kin

7d4d2d25-819a-48a9-bd0f-1cf2286ccef7.Text: A fleet belonging to Xavier Calcazar has chased the remnants of a Drukhari raid to the von Valancius world and is presently obliterating it from orbit, battering the planet.

4b0baec6-18b7-4971-ab6f-5b2a86b033c1.Text: The acolytes are not willing to confront the Rogue Trader and leave the world alongside the surviving Drukhari.

58f9634e-f713-4f5c-a2dc-41ee21cf252e.Text: Having dealt with the xenos, the agents of the Golden Throne depart the system, leaving much of the colony in ruins.
