7c05732d-d8f9-4f8f-a565-91ac50f8f3b1.Text: Marazhai gives his kin the coordinates to a dock where they steal a ship and make their escape from the planet. The Inquisition fleet gives chase, leaving the colony alone.

1bad488e-8d1c-4b46-9720-cf6789e24550.Text: Inspire the people to support construction efforts

b0365f73-58f2-491e-9d0c-f18dd117a50b.Text: The planetary authorities wish to found a new settlement that would expand their influence on the planet.

678ce094-557b-4a25-8608-9ee9c9410ef3.Text: Construction of the new complex's standard-template buildings has begun.

624d40b5-6b51-40c7-9f5b-148f7e5fe898.Text: As a collective initiative, the commoners will help organise the construction efforts, moulding a great future for their colony.

4582d8b3-1552-4c78-893a-133158e4931b.Text: The scale of the new complex will exceed its architects' original designs.

44293c1a-736e-4119-b2ab-e0a0f13bb59d.Text: Demand that she tempers her ardour for the dark arts

2eb6e51d-cd96-4990-a00f-f3968b75748c.Text: Provide additional resources to empower the ritual

503c7eba-4e0c-45e2-9bdc-7ad2ff8da887.Text: Vistenza Vyatt asks permission to conduct some kind of ritual that can increase the fertility of Janus.

91fe4d20-935f-41ff-9345-90cb3d53793e.Text: Janus shudders in the embrace of witchcraft and bows to the will of the governor. The output of the agri-complexes doubles, but the planet's flora and fauna start mutating violently and attacking hapless victims.

e8b99b47-54b4-49cb-8aaf-b9b78444988a.Text: Lady Vyatt performs a great ritual, and the new harvest surpasses all expectations. Meanwhile, a sudden wave of horrific mutations robs all afflicted living things of sanity, and the planet loses several settlements and agri-complexes as a result.

fa97f231-a9fe-462a-b9ee-b70ce1f55a10.Text: Lady Vyatt obeys, but the other cultists do not. In their attempts to hide all traces of the ritual, they make a fatal mistake, triggering a powerful warp manifestation. Lady Vyatt, having miraculously survived, now seeks to appease the Rogue Trader with lavish gifts.

6526b813-e30a-4d11-9992-547f99f4e7b0.Text: Let Muaran deal with the problem alone

4300b458-35b9-4130-9681-f88a008d338d.Text: Send a military detachment into the forests of Janus

055479a3-905b-4689-93dd-545ea226c361.Text: Send diplomats into the forests of Janus

773da3c0-4e21-42a6-a209-0dd940d8761d.Text: Alarming news from Janus: the Webway Gate has opened, bringing forth a wave of xenos!

e321f746-1b67-4587-8629-508536ec418f.Text: After a few cycles, the Farseer reports that the situation is resolved. No traces of the Drukhari are found on the planet, the Webway Gate is closed, and Muaran, while providing no details, claims that such troubles will never happen again.

db4c45ef-c767-40ff-9fda-510e6de96533.Text: Planetary wardens perish in a bloody battle between Crudarach's Aeldari and Drukhari raiders. Following Muaran's victory, a fragile peace settles on Janus.

ee67f403-5160-49bb-ab59-f2d31fb02c74.Text: The diplomats end up prisoners of the Drukhari raiders that have invaded Janus. The xenos flee the planet through the Webway, taking their victims with them.

43a040ed-c4c8-40d7-9d48-a322fd938c29.Text: Integrate the Engine into the manufactorums

32507374-8b7e-4e59-93b2-f8dcf3d5840b.Text: Use the Engine as the colony's sentinel

13fb1d6c-9aa7-4460-83f3-55a3006e003c.Text: Turn the Engine into a central cogitator connecting the hereteks' minds

16873d6c-a588-4d94-85c1-db15f8a0b1a3.Text: Hereteks from Kiava Gamma are ready to test an experimental Engine fuelled by warp energy. They are waiting for an order to test the machine.

f19b53bb-ca91-41eb-b69c-3fa80146fff0.Text: The Engine produces twisted parts and mechanisms to be used in the construction of other heretical devices. The Engine's corrupting presence causes people to rot alive and machinery and conveyor belts to require constant maintenance.

839dcc28-5623-4483-8d66-f6080819f890.Text: The Engine destroys any threat it detects, but in the absence of enemies, it satisfies its thirst for blood by hunting the colony's inhabitants.

9bc0f26d-24b0-4e65-bf25-ddc89c63f8f9.Text: The hereteks have become akin to a mechanical swarm, offering more and more sacrifices to the Engine. Their existence is blissful for as long as their metallic idol remains content. In return, the machine whispers to them secrets to the creation of new sinister mechanisms.

d7786b40-5298-41b2-b56b-5de577703f51.Text: Make the cursed workshop serve the manufactorum and feed it additional parts

96b0daa1-0ef8-4180-b673-e565b915a0c3.Text: One of the workshops has fallen to corruption: the machines within disassemble the surrounding mechanisms and swallow workers whole to construct repulsive amalgams of metal and flesh.

0e705fcc-2522-4bd7-b572-294b95a84a64.Text: Without any raw materials, the workshop begins to devour itself. At last, everything goes quiet, until a great explosion scatters the workshop's twisted remains across the manufactorum.

8f852b7b-b0cc-41e7-99c8-2b9ab67c1fa4.Text: The conveyor belt hungrily swallows the mechanisms, which greatly boosts its output. Upon consuming all available materials, it spawns its final horrific creation before something within it cracks and it falls silent forever.

45d5fa86-12a1-4b81-95aa-2397274a9c90.Text: The manufactorum focuses all its efforts on executing the Rogue Trader's order. After an arduous battle, the workshop is purged, and with it the last seeds of corruption on the planet.

98cc2ece-4027-4624-a3df-d127daa8a3cc.Text: Round up and quarantine the infected in order to study the disease

f0a9d04b-3f38-4c10-aa20-9d82fb162293.Text: Order the priests to carry holy icons through the streets and announce a healing fast

747436b1-eb28-499c-b600-423ea83a7302.Text: The Cult of the Final Dawn has infected the colony with a sorcerous disease. Wicked hunger torments the victims, compelling them to sate it by any means available, including inedible ones.

a30ed040-cb38-4a68-be1f-fce05659b612.Text: The best cure for corruption is fire. The colony is set ablaze, but the heresy is no more.

96e24960-b5c2-48da-a5c1-fae357b6ae6f.Text: People die in droves so that the investigation may continue. The source of the disease is revealed to be a corrupted food shipment. The contaminated stores are destroyed with no room for regret.

d544d3e1-56f3-4752-9dd8-e31e24ff7377.Text: Those who heed the preachers' words and abstain from eating anything at all are eventually cured of the ravenous fits. Others gnaw their own fingers to the bone, perishing in the throes of the terrible hunger.

eeea8cda-6fc4-4ea5-9cad-ef39e1d16ad0.Text: Bury the xenos under a mountain of paperwork

53aa1ac3-35d0-4736-bdfb-0015ddfb14f0.Text: Leave the Drukhari to her entertainment

f27f8840-c6d2-48ed-9e8b-09f3bb038338.Text: An intelligence report has come in stating that a Drukhari Archon is "playing at humans": having bent a high-ranking official to her will, she is now effectively running the colony from the shadows. She is committing unthinkable atrocities but is surprisingly good at governing.

885b7001-746b-4b30-9d23-7f418f505883.Text: The Archon acquires a taste for bureaucracy and turns it into a method of torture. She continuously invents new requirements for forms and petitions, makes the queues drag on for months at a time, and arranges fights to the death for a chance to receive an approval stamp. Once she is done harrowing the clerks, she slaughters them all and leaves the colony. The nobles are quite pleased to have no one left to write reports to.

55648d12-74f8-405e-913a-81f0cf1ec270.Text: The Archon's game becomes crueller by the day, until, at last, she grows bored of it and vanishes from the planet. Unexpectedly, it turns out that the aristocracy liked the previous official even less, and the xenos's "term" in power has had a positive effect on the planet's administrative structure.

b8d182e2-f62c-407c-af23-512000a3bf59.Text: The Archon easily dispatches the assassins, unmasks herself, and decides to "let her hair down" a little. The colony drowns in blood until the Drukhari's thirst is quenched. She departs, leaving behind valuable gifts of xenos origin and a slew of dead bodies arranged into a message of thanks.

07edd801-0adc-4959-99c6-d1e0fa5466eb.Text: Urge the people to form a militia

7bf571a0-4799-48fe-adea-d6dc3d7a155e.Text: Urge the people to hide in shelters

b3ad8f9b-f204-4612-9640-15a4d03f9426.Text: A frigate belonging to the Word Bearers disgorges a horrifying landing party on the colony. A small number of Chaos Space Marines level everything in their path.

b3d169d5-0e9d-4513-81af-fa031935c1f3.Text: The Word Bearers effortlessly exterminate the thoroughly outmatched defenders and depart, their bloodlust sated. The memory of the fallen defenders' heroism remains in the people's hearts.

32c608e4-d7db-442b-a2da-261cfefd95a3.Text: The people run for their lives, but the fallen behemoths catch up to the weaker stragglers. Having toyed with their prey long enough, the Word Bearers leave the planet.

28b34ebf-8106-4523-8ffa-32bd15d4fe25.Text: The people tremble in fear in the overcrowded bunkers while the Word Bearers roam the colony. With no victims in sight, they rid the world of their presence.

86373101-50f6-4afe-b115-4857c86e71c3.Text: Send Sergeant Vigastes to negotiate with the rebels

7dc186ef-6ede-47b8-b376-8cf882f4fb01.Text: Send Iako Sotniy to meet with the rebels

d217e886-38b2-4b12-bef3-42095ef332de.Text: The workers at one of the promethium stations are revolting because of life-threatening working conditions. They are threatening to detonate the fuel stores unless their demands are met.

91595816-85dc-4bab-bc5a-16b602356508.Text: The colony bleeds — the people are desperate, and the sight of armed enforcers no longer frightens them. The promethium reserves burn away in the fires of rebellion.

5273bceb-ba20-4cbf-8848-ed28aeb625da.Text: The rebels' long list of demands is accepted. The other workers, inspired by their example, now organise strikes of their own.

b4d70bb5-3394-4864-b4fc-ad4b06722b88.Text: The Guardsman who survived the horrors of Commorragh convinces the rebels of the importance of labour in the fight against the xenos. Impressed by Vigastes's story, the workers go back to breaking their backs in the name of Humanity's victory.

3abeff19-ef4d-4b54-a113-b2253d904a83.Text: Disguised as a preacher, Sotniy spins an artful and inspiring web of lies about the righteousness of suffering. With tears of joy in their eyes, the people return to their dangerous work, once more breathing the toxic promethium fumes.

362ee404-4c4a-46e5-9581-78deab237905.Text: Order the people to fight to the last drop of blood

30215aea-c589-4847-892f-18d7fe726257.Text: Send Achilleas the Wrack to face the enemies of Humanity

48e892b7-1cae-4a06-bcad-46784da8f91b.Text: Send the xenos an offering of human victims — on a ship loaded with explosives

73898288-eb2b-45df-afa0-deaba8f3fae4.Text: A delegation of Drukhari arrives at the colony — the xenos offer the mon-keigh the chance to willingly bow before them.

d9330dff-f22d-449e-a5d2-1ef6a7092d34.Text: Achilleas blends in with the delegation and decapitates the Drukhari leader with a single blow. Achilleas perishes in the ensuing carnage, taking several of the invaders with him. The seeds of discord have been sown: the xenos accuse each other of assassinating their leader with the intent to seize power. Now divided, they are unable to mount an attack on the colony and leave the system.

fd866e61-dcca-456e-810e-6182d0b0ccf7.Text: Certain of their superior might, the Drukhari accept the gifts, and a powerful explosion obliterates a part of the invading force. Before retreating, the surviving xenos take their vengeance by delivering an orbital strike on the colony's infrastructure.

bab210a1-3f9d-4c3f-a8ed-daed5c0761ea.Text: The humiliating tribute includes the dynasty's subjects, doomed to become nothing but heaps of flesh in the Dark City's arenas.

382bf56a-a71b-4893-a41a-3db06ef78553.Text: The battle with the xenos claims an untold number of lives, but none dare question the choice made. There can be no negotiation with the enemies of Humanity!

907ced85-5ee4-4377-9571-dbc3fb358c92.Text: Allow Hann Cassini to deal with the anomaly

4c0af8f1-820b-413e-930e-c7f9558b6656.Text: Halt all trade in the dangerous region

84f61bd6-b934-473b-8f17-7f3fc7b1837f.Text: Use psykers to study the warp anomaly

c67104c9-27da-47ed-bda3-32f35800e6c0.Text: A mysterious warp anomaly has been appearing in the way of the dynasty's trade ships, consuming them whole. Some are confident that this entity is sentient and that these events are the actions of a cunning hunter.

5bb53546-aeb9-4e77-9050-b33906621ca7.Text: The Navigator fearlessly guides his ship directly into the anomaly, and soon all consumed vessels begin to emerge from it. The anomaly dissipates, releasing Hann's ship last, its crew aged by decades. Now a decrepit old man, the Navigator no longer recognises familiar faces and quietly lives out his days in the ship's medicae facility, never divulging what transpired inside the anomaly.

aa174350-5f41-451c-9873-22b5b5e2dcd3.Text: Trade grinds to a halt for a long time. The warp anomaly slowly makes its journey from system to system, as if looking for victims, before vanishing without a trace.

a4ef7e97-99a9-4f0d-9db9-c8f4e02526ad.Text: The psykers perish in their attempts to comprehend this menace, but the last of them manages to deliver a message before he is turned inside out: "The offering is accepted and reciprocated." Following the incident, an increase in the number of latent psykers and warp manifestations is observed across the protectorate.

1b87b49a-7a1a-4e9e-8130-a12a49acb2e8.Text: Support him with all the resources the colony has

7a780f9f-67f2-4dc8-813f-069f27777425.Text: Provide him with materials for ship repairs

2271fc41-3366-49f1-a5fc-a0d32f3f68a6.Text: A feud has broken out between two influential admirals of the Imperial Navy, having already led to armed skirmishes and even outright battles. Calling to attention a favour he once did for House von Valancius, one of the admirals has appealed to the Rogue Trader's colony for support.

663c4add-7f00-4d12-ac47-a17836e1d17f.Text: The squabble between the admirals soon ended in the death of the weaker. The victor did not forget the Rogue Trader's refusal to help his rival and has sent generous gifts.

7ec8e3ce-ec52-4f55-b952-ce20e3141b1c.Text: The admiral appreciates the assistance. From now on, his ships will watch over the colony.

f87728d1-7abc-48e9-95ce-bb33337e649f.Text: The admiral appreciates the assistance, which has exceeded his every expectation. From now on, his ships will watch over the colony.

51ba23aa-8510-470d-af11-67ebcd4d6523.Text: Punish all who engage in suspicious conduct

5ef74704-7d4d-4c45-8896-58258ca68d1b.Text: Let the people do what they want

45b821f1-9c61-40ca-b944-fcc21f21dca3.Text: The inhabitants of Janus are rumoured to have taken up new mysterious habits and rituals.

41acb063-18e0-4608-b644-3428398b1091.Text: The colony thrashes in agony — the Rogue Trader's wrath is terrifying and indiscriminate!

23914acf-afd0-4486-b3ba-f7d3ecec817f.Text: Muaran's divination shows that the remnants of the servants of She Who Thirsts continue to operate on Janus in secret. The Farseer's Aeldari neutralise the cultists, and the colony soon forgets about the strange behaviour.

24f7a8ab-8826-4816-8d9a-7697677d92e7.Text: The rituals become part of everyday life and take up more and more of people's labour hours. Now there is no threat or punishment that could make them return to their former ways.

6feda634-944c-4769-8448-99e13168cb6b.Text: Inspire the people to support the authorities' actions

2eb862e3-a758-415a-940b-a2e8bc491e98.Text: The planetary authorities have begun a rigorous purge of dissidents, mutants, and apostates. The spree of arrests and executions has the people terrified.

1d11f39d-74a9-4c4b-9ed7-84b5fff822b4.Text: The authority of the planetary officials was damaged, but the Rogue Trader's popularity in the colony has grown.

046dc918-70b3-4907-b296-e019160c9b1d.Text: The harsh purges bring order to the colony but scare away some traders and deplete the world's human resources.

6bd6246f-98a7-4e23-936e-64ba268a0ef8.Text: Upon seeing the planetary authorities not as tyrants, but as wise protectors, the commoners will be delivered from their fear and charge to help the keepers of law and order in their cause of cleansing this world.

47eed735-46aa-48d9-ac27-aa87d66a0893.Text: Transports will deliver new workers to the colony to replace those who have been executed. They will work diligently, knowing that they too can be replaced if they display signs of negligence or freethinking.

ff57f4bd-bfa3-4b10-959a-2ef85a04cb9b.Text: Allow the nobles such liberties as long as the colony is operating properly

d6e45113-a101-4c2f-863b-a06d8d976df7.Text: Spread their views among the common people

0f830bf1-da0c-4659-aa45-4ae382f7bcfb.Text: Order in the colony has been restored, although many aristocrats now hold a grudge against the Rogue Trader.

1ffce635-3f61-4716-a2ca-c7651d8b4be8.Text: As they indulge in recreation and suspicious scholarship, they certainly contribute to the colony's cultural development, but they are also losing interest in service and labour.

16233df7-46ba-4683-83ac-697b0cd542a4.Text: The aristocrats are thankful to the Rogue Trader for such favour. As they develop the planet's culture, they will make sure that the plague of intellectual depravation does not leave their circles and does not reach the rabble, whose lot in life is toil and blind obedience.

ca599e9e-1743-41aa-bb97-059dd99dcd7e.Text: The colony was swept up by a thirst for knowledge and entertainment, which brought it to new cultural heights but had a negative impact on the obedience and diligence of the rabble.

5f5fc390-c8d2-406f-99ec-ae0e003438f2.Text: Smother the pernicious cult by indulging the squalid masses' most base desires

8642344d-7d71-4942-9187-01f3e10be54e.Text: Violence thrives in the colony. Their faith drives people to commit brutal acts against both others and themselves.

c150c29a-9626-4ba0-9fd3-acf17ea45a01.Text: Owing to the prevailing vitality of law and order in the colony, the death cult was unable to bring about bloody anarchy but instead became just another callous cog in its vast oppressive machinery. Such gruesome slaughter fosters ruthlessness and a willingness to sacrifice, qualities for which the Imperium has great need.

be472b70-21ac-49fc-946a-ae2b37d539f8.Text: With all the extravagance bestowed on the planet's commoners by Rogue Trader, the death cult dissolved, giving way to more optimistic and peaceful teachings.

baf41f58-c691-43da-a641-3d26375f0bcf.Text: Turn the people against the preachers

cd9d7473-aa4f-4dcc-9fb6-cdc3f8756c4f.Text: Send the rabble-rousers away on a pilgrimage

18f321b3-ffb1-4003-a6ee-c7d3c9288ad3.Text: Preachers, in the service of House Chorda, have arrived in the colony. They agitate fiercely before the mob, but, unfortunately, the planet's officials too often serve as examples of reprobate behaviour in their sermons, which begets even more turmoil among the common folk.

53858736-65b7-4417-bc28-121f8c253213.Text: After listening to the words of the preachers, the rabble is starting to show more and more signs of disobedience and rebelliousness.

4e4eb5b5-d742-4379-a2fa-8dd64a57038a.Text: Incited by the Rogue Trader's servants, the commoners attacked the preachers and drove the deceitful lot of them out of the colony.

9a4c2fbf-8b30-454e-9a7c-6e0f5e9c0b80.Text: Shrewdly using the preachers' words against them, the Rogue Trader's servants announced the start of a pilgrimage, ousting Chorda's lackeys along with anyone who had been too eager to listen to them. The latter are now free to look for a new home.

fdba5398-f72b-41ac-b282-cef3f0ec2f43.Text: The Return of the Master of Whispers

c328884b-043a-4b3e-82ee-d0436169001e.Text: A mobile mining outpost assembled in accordance with the blessed Standard Template Construct. This small industrial complex can be deployed on practically any world, however inhospitable. The serf clan assigned to it will devote itself to the maintenance of its sacred mechanisms and the extraction of resources needed by the Rogue Trader.

d8ed0544-12ea-47ef-a4f5-3981c0cdf458.Text: Sacred relics created in the name of praising the Emperor, brimming with faith in Him, and blessed by His faithful. Their very presence makes the darkness of blasphemy recoil.

708379d1-1f14-49d3-b7c5-2039aca757b9.Text: A mysterious creation of the Genetors that includes a mobile research complex, a chem-synthesis plant, and a stockpile of substances consecrated by the Magos Alchemys. An enlightened servant of the Omnissiah who has assumed its command throne is capable of stopping epidemics, taming the rebellious spirits of the enviro-protection system, or feeding the masses with nutribars created from what erst was poison.

b811a6b6-d9de-4ec2-baa0-54af81648eb4.Text: This venerable servo-skull was crafted out of the hollowed relics of the most exalted Brother Eclas, an implacable vanquisher of heresy on the world of Everharvest. It has accompanied many a zealous war commander of the faith, broadcasting sermons of vengeance and righteous hatred. The servo-skull's maglev unit has been out of order for centuries, but the rage of the Emperor is still very much alive in its vox-loudspeakers.

c3f09b3e-4f0a-4cc1-896c-fcd830af4557.Text: As he watched the fall of the shrine world Igrimont from orbit, Saint Falstow shed mournful tears, which were collected in a sacred vial and placed in the reliquary.

9afc35f2-ef48-4019-ac47-cd2ebd0a11d0.Text: A trophy claimed for the Rogue Trader on Vheabos VI, when the planet's denizens faced an enigmatic and pitiless xenos sorcerer.

549fc160-3223-4b2e-81e4-b214376efde6.Text: Combat-purposed medication that enhances a fighter's physical condition to peak performance values, while adversely affecting their mental state.

edbf761e-1f68-4f97-853a-b97b0c067252.Text: This armour once belonged to Solomon Vhyr of the Adeptus Arbites. While pursuing the head of a major crime syndicate, Plavius Kolt, Vhyr went beyond the bounds of the Calixis Sector and his own jurisdiction. Outnumbered, he was felled by the criminal and his henchmen but took them all out with him. His armour was kept in the reliquary of the Koronus Expanse division of the Administratum.

ee307a53-154c-4f51-b9c0-4ea8d66e22f3.Text: Carapace armour whose plates conceal miniature refractor generators that dissipate the energy of impacts. Blueprints for these generators are not contained in the catalogues of the Adeptus Mechanicus.

823a0533-1c50-4e24-bcaa-fae498554cb3.Text: An ancient Aeldari device that shrouds its wearer in a veil of small warp wind gusts. It has been theorised that it uses the same principle as the armour of the sinister Warp Spider warriors, minus the high-capacity power batteries. Instead, it senses and absorbs the energy of psychic suffering from its surroundings.

4981c105-7ae3-4797-b6f3-1ece4acf05e7.Text: A stimulant that links the pain and pleasure centres of the brain. The unholy potion is rumoured to be brewed with mutant blood.

6ae9c069-f34a-4dea-ac68-9619b5851451.Text: In these blessed shoes, the ascetic Nicomedes Keefe walked on dozens of worlds, treading dusty roads and pulling a vox-wagon proclaiming the exalted Truth behind him.

8e6ad635-a95c-43c8-8012-78303ec67bfd.Text: This weapon belonged to the infamous rebel and trouble-monger Sekt, exiled to Vheabos VI for inciting sedition and becoming the first champion of its gladiatorial arenas. He retained that status for sixty-two cycles.

9795a708-9626-460f-a301-16cb673c7631.Text: An expanded version of the ordinary medicae kit, this set of high-grade medical instruments and medicaments is intended for a skilful healer accompanying a person of high standing.

95a6bd07-b8aa-4f01-8c4a-7a4dc385a2d4.Text: A sacred weapon of the Order of Hammer crafted in the image of Piety's Charge, the hammer wielded by Saint Cognatius. Only the staunchest allies of the Order may have the honour of carrying this emblem of faith into battle.

87205067-9502-4f31-93a0-6d28cb452396.Text: A micro cogitator built from schematics bestowed upon the Rogue Trader by the blessed Null Caliph. The cogitator is locked in the never-ending cycle of calculating Paradox EF-Ultima-Octodecimum, whose essence is unfathomable to laypeople. The very process of meditating on this paradox allows the thinker to solve dilemmas that would otherwise require the combined computational rituals of a dozen Magi.

a52d20f0-21e4-4c55-90b4-6c19ad66c91d.Text: A cogni-weapon inhabited by a bloodthirsty machine spirit famous for its ferocity and fondness for slaughter.

dfdf8a81-60c6-4daa-9824-1a9abf3ee73f.Text: A magnificent ring holding a deadly plasma charge, gifted to the Rogue Trader. It saved Reverend Hieronymus from assassins not once but twice.

153c2dd8-a7ff-4be7-8255-ed1c43397492.Text: A combat stimulant that brings forth monstrous rage and burns the nervous system to ash. Designed for the organic battle golems that serve the Janus Tech-Priests.

aa5e9032-87bd-4a03-8dad-41e70ac2f0a0.Text: A blade found on a drifting ship whose crew had been slaughtered by a mysterious xenos. Holding its hilt braided with warm, still-living skin, your ears ring with the lamentations of the dying.

dccb1bc7-08dc-438e-9c93-c79a5a8fad2e.Text: This blade has been blessed by a preacher by the name of Himalisk. While dispersing a crowd, an unmannerly warden swung it at the Emperor's servant, only to receive an epiphany of faith, fall to his knees, and tearfully plead the prophet's forgiveness. The prophet was merciful to the warden and took the sword from his hand, promising that henceforth it would only strike at enemies of the faith.

78765aa4-9889-43fc-80a5-95018a298a73.Text: A mysterious xeno-object which belonged to the Magus of the abominable Genestealer Cult from the hive world of Dargonus.

af57d9a9-032d-4b54-8311-acf0aa331ab2.Text: The terrifying weapon of Yrge Sukhoi, a ship disciplinary officer who single-handedly put down a mutiny staged by the cowardly officers of the Void Triumpher.

4b313c89-e3bc-4d66-be8f-e58953d7f7e3.Text: The magnificent bracelets of the pirate leader Hermanios were once slave shackles. After starting a mutiny and forging a crew out of the prisoners aboard the captured convict transport, Hermanios had the chains decorated with gold and crystals. The glorious rebel leader presented them to the Rogue Trader as a token of respect.

1ee8813b-73d8-4922-b688-57ba482acd41.Text: A medical kit assembled and blessed by devout hospitalant monks. The instruments are adorned with respectful litanies of fortitude, and the preparations were made by venerable ascetics.

9b0b8bf8-ae4f-414e-a499-ee40dc71642d.Text: The weapon of a wrathful leader from the Aeldari corsairs, taken as a trophy by the Imperial Navy and later stolen from a secret arsenal by Kasballica agents.

9ff583ae-83a0-443a-85c2-b06bf660bafb.Text: A power device built from shards of Aeldari obelisks. The Rogue Trader received this xeno-artefact after pacifying the spirits on the agri-world of Janus.

812517fb-bf73-4e2e-a7fc-faebdd6ed531.Text: Inside the grenade there is a charge of acid and a low-powered gravity generator that keeps it from touching the shell.

0eedcdfc-96fc-42d7-981c-2e6d4689e8b0.Text: The blueprint for this high-powered grenade was illegally acquired from an Imperial Navy warship Enginseer.

c46298fe-1cad-4d41-bbbf-78e89666130b.Text: The grenades are loaded with a hallucinogenic chemical brewed from the rose of Zamarkand that plunges men into terrifying reverie.

ccd1a717-6500-4f74-a7f8-5a615595cda7.Text: Cogni-armour controlled by a wise and caring machine spirit. It dutifully monitors the wearer's physical condition and, whenever necessary, promptly injects a dose of regenerating stimulants into their arteries.

fa887d19-e6af-49da-902f-e2e972e082f8.Text: These battle gauntlets were crafted by Saint Cognatius for his guard, Avolius, who had stopped an assassin's blade with his bare hands. Avolius's grievous injuries prevented him from ever picking up a weapon again, but in close combat, the gauntlets can fire monoblades at point blank range.

4d0ab931-393d-400f-8a07-541891d82661.Text: A relic axe of the Omnissiah, deadly combination of both weapon and tool, that served Magos Domina Philaxalta in eradicating a race of blasphemous xenos inhabiting the worlds in the Rifts of Hecaton. This great feat was the Explorator Cognisance Fleet's first military victory.

7550fc9b-a770-4a0f-84f2-7243aabcfa8a.Text: This gem holds the soul of an unknown hero of the Aeldari race. Psykers who have found the courage to touch this forbidden item claim that the xenos was venerated among their kind as a peacemaker, healer, and public educator famous for great deeds.

2e1b91e0-60e9-4d1a-854d-388505325f32.Text: A relic offered to the Rogue Trader as a gift for {mf|his|her} willing and productive cooperation with one of the esteemed Ordos of the Holy Inquisition.

b9034612-4507-4beb-8cf1-588b3c961c9b.Text: Equipment containing a weakened malicious warp spirit. A starved daemon is locked inside the highly advanced iridial cogitator. Its batteries perpetually near-empty, the spirit will ravenously devour any thermal energy from its surroundings save for its owner's body heat.

73334da1-2edd-4cb1-9e84-e67de38c59f2.Text: Thousands of witches and heretics have been incinerated with this distinguished weapon, all in His name. Boiling in its fuel tank is no common promethium, but rather a highly potent mixture that detonates on contact with air.

867faad3-06ca-4c4a-a873-4bdf6cb39e73.Text: A mysterious piece of technology crafted by Electro-Priest artisans. While in passive mode, it senses every defect in the surrounding matter. When activated, it generates a pulse that accelerates the entropic decay of these unstable points by a factor of thousands.

f717d570-3bb5-4025-825b-dc4dbc98de96.Text: A weapon adorned by xenos artisans that keeps the memory of the Janusian spirit wreathed in purple flame.

f429d6ac-9a49-422c-97ec-89441ed846bc.Text: An ancient xenos weapon that keeps the memory of the Janusian spirit wreathed in blue flame.

2f35f129-3ac7-4ea9-a551-e794546d2539.Text: This relic was given to the Rogue Trader by the Malpians as a sign of their appreciation of {mf|his|her} valuable patronage.

8730630a-f314-416c-b548-a55ffe55cebe.Text: A precious gift from the Order of the Hammer to the Rogue Trader, who rid Foulstone of a false idol.

2afcc858-31b1-4d64-b152-b17026c8bfa9.Text: A sacred artefact offered to the Rogue Trader for resolving the conflict with the Malpian sect.

bc38e69a-8526-4626-9305-f1d3e75586f3.Text: A shard of wraithbone that broke off from an Aeldari structure. It now serves as a memento of the heated battle against the spirits of Janus.

bf6e98e2-d660-4476-87ed-ec21f5cc6b5b.Text: This glorious blade is forged from the wreckage of the Great Bell of the shrine world Paduvian, whose formidable voice rang out with implacable zeal but was silenced when the vile dogs of Uralon the Cruel consigned Paduvian to the flame.

e05b986e-c207-415d-9083-bcaf8bb96817.Text: This venerable sword was wielded by the most honourable agri-prince Illumian Vyatt ab Aram, who served as a paladin to the governor of Janus four centuries ago. In the darkest hours, during the rebellion of the dastardly sect of the Anointed by Earth, the glorious Illumian saved his patron from the rabble who had stormed the palace and quelled the rebellion by slaking the thirst of this noble blade with peasant blood.

b62ef3fe-8e31-42a1-b950-dd9e703643a5.Text: This curious adornment was solemnly presented to the Rogue Trader by a group of wild psykers on the capital world of Dargonus.

8653980d-2dc3-41a0-8106-fbdc20e94a2c.Text: This venerable weapon belonged to the devout preacher Petrakara, who brought light to the Night Satrapies of the dark world of Obscuralion.

14029fe0-8571-4541-80c4-9f805da3663a.Text: A small detector whose purpose is to sense the currents of life and death. Its steel casing conceals an excised fragment of an unfortunate psyker's brain. Their last spark of life is caged within it. The only thing this tortured mind is still capable of perceiving are the death throes of a living being. Upon sensing them, it releases a devastating blast of psionic energy.

bd7706c1-1d15-48ce-841c-e2bec03c323a.Text: This weapon sheathed itself in glory when it was used in ceremonious single combat between the Malpians and the Order of the Hammer.

7d0c7422-d103-4799-b891-11270945aa26.Text: The reliquary helmet is embedded with the auspex targeting system of the beneficent Militant Bishop Joyeuse. The saint's blood is caked in the cracks of the visor, staining the battlefield a deep purple-black.

bd913c52-5164-4886-8862-bc9951e064cd.Text: This object came from the body of one of the mysterious xenocreatures, hordes of which emerged from the depths on Vheabos VI and swarmed the planet for a brief period of time.

f7c1c347-96e9-4abc-91f2-889a1646cf81.Text: A mysterious Aeldari contraption fashioned into an exquisite decorative item. When activated, it uses inscrutable means to distort reality, altering the spatial and gravitational parameters of its surroundings in ways that cause the imminent death of its owner's enemies. Exactly how the unholy machine can tell them from its owner's allies remains beyond understanding.

d99c098d-27c8-44ef-8943-03d9a6fc3173.Text: A fabled holy relic that was given to the Rogue Trader for safekeeping after {mf|he|she} joined the side of the pious in their dispute against the hollow-hearted servants of the Omnissiah.

906df2fa-f5e2-47c3-b675-9270f42f91f9.Text: A compact collection of prayers and litanies which once belonged to a member of a minor cult on Dargonus.

3aea38c5-7fad-4067-9fe1-380b27e03917.Text: A cursed Drukhari weapon. Rather than energy beams or bolt charges, it strikes at foes with crystal cylinders, in which is sealed a deadly virus. The creator of this item was clearly after more than the mere death of their enemies: it had to be as cruel a death as possible.

db04efa4-d99a-4e54-bb25-24d5254cc486.Text: A torn banner of the Cult of the Final Dawn collected as a trophy off the body of one of their leaders in the uprising on Vheabos VI.

c6b9f630-e62f-4c3f-9a87-e03c36e5406e.Text: This remarkably sharp and durable curved blade was Lady Xue's personal weapon, which she brought with her to Janus.

0b77dc48-3fcf-4d37-8f74-da9b83455917.Text: Lord Karkalla, the leader of the Trebul rebellion, had his head struck clean with this noble blade. Despite his apostasy, even his enemies recognised the valour and nobility of Karkalla, who was generously granted a noble death by beheading.

b466e66f-0f60-4164-8748-aa923106342a.Text: A gas grenade that releases a cloud of acrid tear gas and blinds enemies.

4d0754e1-23be-4c05-b5e4-3a933190c64e.Text: A devastating weapon that contains the horrors of the tech-leprosy strain found in the bowels of a Kiava Gamma manufactorum.

5c8072ae-cc90-47ae-9232-77857dfff2c6.Text: An archeotech weapon that belonged to Saint Cognatius himself and is considered one of his most holy relics. The hammer was found by the ascetic Nicomedes Keefe and kept in his tomb for many centuries.

9d55db66-56ea-4b28-ae54-e79130c61ac4.Text: A compact trans-sonic emitter that speeds up projectiles fired by a weapon. It is adorned with gold and the bones of the righteous, as is befitting of a relic of Saint Cognatius.

a1d0c905-4dba-45ea-af4f-575ff59dfcf6.Text: A weapon that once belonged to the Pure-Voiced Prophet and was eventually presented to the Rogue Trader of House von Valancius.

73f6aa1e-491e-486d-b107-03de4d383ceb.Text: The battle garb of a mysterious assassin who came from Holy Terra itself to execute the corrupt Admiral Batillera. The servant of the Emperor did his duty but was eliminated by the wicked man's guards. The armour was retained by the Administratum and bestowed upon the von Valancius dynasty for their diligence in establishing order in the Expanse.

ad4ee7ca-18e0-4ba3-896d-e90465f72bdf.Text: A loathsome and twisted piece of technology created by the accursed Cubis Delphim, imbued with the power to contact voices from the warp.

38de6950-a39b-4ffc-90d3-d1f098a4d56c.Text: A creation of esotericist Magos who lift the veil separating the Empyrean from the Materium, using their instruments to penetrate the limits of the non-existent with the utmost care.

763ac674-9bfb-4698-aaa2-5c99ac6b63bc.Text: An ancient weapon that once belonged to the leader of the Engine Vandals, roamers of Dargonus wastelands.

dca530e2-e352-414c-a370-fbb5e158a961.Text: This odd-looking object made from an unknown material was found near an undocumented tunnel on Vheabos VI.

054042ea-7ca7-4bc7-98a8-21e792a315fb.Text: A piece of wraithbone that serves as a reminder of the eerie ritual used to banish the spirits of Janus.

dd014a37-5f86-468b-b881-75b7740a8627.Text: The tooth of an unknown semi-material creature, extracted from the corpse of the pirate leader Kernanes, a renowned hunter of xenobeasts.

85f3103c-62a1-4a55-9fd4-357f24f55d20.Text:
This front-focused armour design concentrates the thickest adamantine armour plates in the ship's {g|Encyclopedia:ProwSpace}prow{/g} compartment, allowing the ship to break through heavy enemy fire during a relentless push.
~// +4 to the prow plating. The ram of the {g|Encyclopedia:FlagshipSpace}flagship{/g} causes {g|Encyclopedia:InternalFiresSpace}internal fires{/g}, the number of fires depends on the size of the target

407be31c-7c61-4b9f-b85e-92654052d890.Text: A venerable cogitator assembled with the remains of the recently deceased High Logis of the Administratum, Zinclair, the Sovereign of Calculation.

bdfefb75-883e-4d69-8060-d603888aa6a4.Text:
The Touched who were recruited as enforcers gave form to the ancient knowledge stored in their minds by modifying the voidship's weapons using sacred archeotech.
Long-range {g|Encyclopedia:DorsalSpace}dorsal{/g} plasma {g|Encyclopedia:MacroCannonsSpace}macro-cannons{/g}, which fire 2 shots, dealing 26 {g|Encyclopedia:SpaceBattleDamageGlossary}damage{/g} per shot.

ef793fe7-a56a-4aac-ae6f-e7baef77d4f9.Text: These fearsome weapons were cast on the great world of Kiava Gamma. Gunners whisper about having heard otherworldly cackling on the artillery deck at night and claim that people go missing there. When these weapons are fired, they let out a terrifying howl, as if their muzzles house the souls of malefactors. The truth, however, is far more frightening...

4beb9976-636a-47b0-ae17-f77c4fd4e1c9.Text: These weapons were created by daring artisans from mysterious Aeldari mechanisms of war discovered during excavations on Janus. Efforts to replicate their original design may have failed, but the ancient machines were nonetheless transformed into devastating rapid-fire weapons that are sure to bring the Imperium's wrath upon the wicked.

2cf2bf06-dfb5-41a6-8afb-e693ba3c4b91.Text: The design of this exquisite weapon makes use of Aeldari mechanisms of war. Only a Rogue Trader can afford to possess a weapon that so outrageously disregards the laws of the Adeptus Mechanicus.

ecb6d4fa-d449-48a5-9f08-0ce56eec3afa.Text:
This augur system is connected to the mighty cogitation blocks offered by the Explorators as a gift to the Rogue Trader. Their computing power is so great that the augurs can pick up even the slightest vulnerabilities in enemy defences.
~// Enemies suffer −10% to their {g|Encyclopedia:EvasionSpace}evasion{/g}

757b716c-d671-4029-8600-b92355b8c41f.Text: The void shield array of The Daring, a heroically destroyed frigate. The mechanism was found among the wreckage of the ship, which fought the forces of the Final Dawn and saved a convoy of refugee transports bound for Footfall at the cost of her own life.

a6ce1d90-b129-4993-a112-548a6dfaae48.Text:
Ancient and fearsome weapons captured on the ship of the Archenemy's devotees and cleansed by techsorcism over the course of a seven-year long vigil.
Medium-range broadside {g|Encyclopedia:MacroCannonsSpace}macro-cannons{/g}, which fire 3 shots, dealing 24 {g|Encyclopedia:SpaceBattleDamageGlossary}damage{/g} per shot.

fcc31c25-aa1f-4398-adc1-ecc15c1aca4b.Text:
A serpent of embossed lines coils around the barrels of these holy weapons, a complete chronicle of the exploration of the systems called the Lathe Worlds by the servants of the Omnissiah.
Medium-range broadside {g|Encyclopedia:MacroCannonsSpace}macro-cannons{/g}, which fire 5 shots, dealing 30 {g|Encyclopedia:SpaceBattleDamageGlossary}damage{/g} per shot.

1b15ec9b-338e-4d8e-9b78-a87642147347.Text:
An engine assembled by a mysterious clique of engine elders, countenance hidden by veils of openwork plasteel, and whose wisdom is so great that servants below the rank of Magos are forbidden from even addressing them.
This plasma drive provides 15 {g|Encyclopedia:SpeedSpace}speed{/g} along with average {g|Encyclopedia:AccelerationBrakingSpace}acceleration and braking{/g}.

ebc2db42-6a4f-4d56-a0f1-fd86943bf77d.Text:
This complete collection of tech-litanies is a token of gratitude from the Explorators to the Rogue Trader for giving them the right to take charge of the Crucible on Foulstone. The ship's Tech-Priests dutifully recite these litanies over the ship's weapons.
~// All voidship weapons (except torpedoes) gain +3% to critical hit chance and +3% to critical {g|Encyclopedia:SpaceBattleDamageGlossary}damage{/g}

712e8596-1727-4391-80be-8aaf59e6640c.Text: This weapon design was developed in the Calixis Sector and boasts firepower greatly superior to that of the more humble Starbreakers, which were designed as imperfect copies and are manufactured only on minor industrial worlds. Only truly enlightened artisans can reproduce such an exalted weapon.

90a10635-e444-4ab0-8f4d-522440fd9bfa.Text: The servitorised Touched gave form to the ancient knowledge stored in their minds through the improvement of the voidship's {g|Encyclopedia:VoidshipShieldsGlossary}shields{/g}.

7d66fd6f-89ba-46d7-bd56-a2efd6e68407.Text:
This ancient component of a Dargonus-fleet frigate was discovered in the wastes by the Engine Vandals and presented to the Rogue Trader.
{g|Encyclopedia:TorpedoLaunchersSpace}Torpedo tubes{/g} capable of firing 5 short-burning plasma torpedoes with 19 {g|Encyclopedia:SpaceBattleDamageGlossary}damage{/g} warheads.

05d71cc0-3899-41b1-ba81-cedf084e54b2.Text: The mining complexes are becoming overcrowded with convicts. The massive crystalflex domes, whose filtration altars purify the water and air, will fit far more workers.

d7c019da-f635-44e1-a436-35bd969dc293.Text: Secret experiments with the wrecks of xenos ships will be conducted at the orbital shipyard.

786d175a-e8a6-4cf5-b7ff-e928c94ad725.Text: The Imperial Navy has sustained heavy losses. They are willing to provide valuable machinery in exchange for trained Tech-Priests.

6e4037b1-df7c-40a1-a907-8321947e91a0.Text: Gigantic machines will vaporise the rock in their path, clearing the way to the most valuable mineral deposits. The serf clans operating them will never again see the sun, nor will their descendants.

f00a8fa7-82f4-4c03-821e-ae6099d097a4.Text: The Drusians always need new pilgrims, and convicts will be an adequate fit for this role.

64167a6c-2879-48dd-9b29-5bd913d8143e.Text: The master artisans of the Adeptus Mechanicus deepen the mines on Vheabos VI, where thundering seismic cannons will tear through rock to free precious ores.

ddb81a7f-ef35-45ad-a621-90a4857abece.Text: The disciplinary officers of the Imperial Navy will make for wonderful wardens on Vheabos VI.

00766b33-2ea1-4f87-a979-82a4e24eff50.Text: The requisitioning of religious tithes from other worlds in the guise of the Ecclesiarchy gives the opportunity to keep a portion of the proceeds.

50d36d0e-a586-406c-969b-50a24dafb0fb.Text: The clandestine cultivation of a xenoplant that feeds on the blood of serfs will allow the production of hallucinogenic poisons that contaminate the victims' genes.

47425741-44e4-4e45-8652-aee7ca502e9a.Text: The Expanse is burning, testing the mettle of its void pirates. They are ready to pay in exotic xenobeasts for such simple things like air and provisions.

95931675-ed45-41ac-99f9-f98a8f6d0497.Text: Convicts will be secretly resold to the pirates of the Koronus Expanse.

d3ede36b-d45d-4189-a38a-fe507fe27d21.Text: The Kasballica Mission is ready to run a secret auction on Dargonus with illegal lots — provided the Rogue Trader's dynasty guarantees its protection.

3d147ab1-98b1-40af-a217-1634710bef34.Text: The great freedom accorded by the Imperial Navy will allow the mustering of an impressive independent squadron, not classified as pirates.

12cd057c-57ce-4952-821c-0edf3a0f1887.Text: A glorious mag-train loaded with relics will run across Foulstone, carrying the light of faith to every corner of the world.

aee7bafb-41a9-4487-9078-a95b2b6e8b39.Text: The foundation of an honorary cemetery for the repose of the dynasty's best servants will create a new tradition in the protectorate.

4a6b711a-910c-483d-96d6-4b217b913035.Text: The inhabitants of Janus are restless. The populace may be placated by turning agri-complexes into impenetrable fortresses, assigning sheriffs from among the overseers, and forming jaeger bands.

b1b7dd63-dc52-4f2e-a726-7df70542e15f.Text: The inhabitants of Janus are restless. The Adeptus Mechanicus are ready to run experiments on the serfs that will turn them into obedient, battle-ready genetic deviants.

e636e1bf-80fc-442e-bc3f-9827f8e657b6.Text: The inhabitants of Janus are restless. The malateks may prepare for the coming storm by studying xeno-artefacts and using them in the construction of weapons.

d38d45bc-40b2-4bbe-9b78-606e9599b5ac.Text: There are now more convicts than there is work to go around. The quarries extracting explosive fyceline sand are rightfully called killing fields — they will consume any amount of living labour.

7e66e7db-630d-495c-b4a4-b11e2dbafc07.Text: Kiava Gamma will be granted a sacred writ authorising the production of war machines. Amid the solemn flickering of lumens, fierce machine spirits of battle tanks, armoured transports, and artillery cannons will awaken, craving the blood of heretics and xenos.

022b37f7-ac16-497f-b7ed-4747a751535c.Text: A curious intoxicating substance has been discovered in xenos ruins. Clandestine Magos Alchemys workshops will refine and distil the substance, transforming it into pure euphoria that will delight the weary souls of aristocrats who long for new diversions.

8080051d-c4e0-4b87-b5ba-d2900431ce03.Text: An orbital shipyard will provide the Imperium's massive vessels with proper repair and produce new voidships.

96b742ec-e374-4c5e-ab67-c979c50adf32.Text: Retrofitted mining equipment may be of interest to the pirates of the Expanse — it does not take a brilliant mind to turn a mining laser into a weapon.

7c2c08ab-8acb-4446-97a3-83c272d33f77.Text: Passing through distillation plants and a multitude of filters, raw materials with high energy potential will be transformed into combustible promethium. Once the proper liturgies have been served, it will be employed as the Emperor's burning wrath.

d7df0b55-f192-4aaa-86b8-16feafdde4f1.Text: The patronage of architects and other artists will allow the creation of amazing and monumental works marked with the Rogue Trader's likeness.

45944607-4ef9-42a8-9699-af56fcc4a343.Text: The Adeptus Administratum's vanity may be indulged through the construction of a floating palace filled with helpful serfs and exquisite pleasures. Mollified by the bribe, the scribes will be especially attentive to the Rogue Trader's wishes.

433331e8-bc63-4ba9-9a7f-f6b6b6ef7fc4.Text: It is time for the Dargonus nobility to forget their feuds and take up arms in defence of their native world.

6a6592e9-2024-4c43-b9f6-8726f746d30a.Text: The Rogue Trader may grant the convicts the right to buy, with their labour, the freedom of their children born in captivity.

30179200-d91b-4b2b-b006-cee019dae6b3.Text: Transuranium's value is such that its open-pit mining will be worth the thousands of lives lost to radiation exposure.

9c0a8d8e-99d5-44a8-be9c-0564074cbae2.Text: Acquiring captives from the enemies of Humanity for use in forced labour is a possible way to replenish the work force.

cdfb4f18-6111-41bd-834f-e9c429c5f1e2.Text: Selling the forgiveness of the Ecclesiarchy can be a significant source of revenue.

96311a62-73d4-4bca-a711-18653320de30.Text: Since the grimy masses are so lazy, a wise lord will add substances to their daily communion that ensure obedience and diligence. Once purified and distilled, these truly miraculous plant-based chemicals will make a commoner forget their fatigue and their purposeless pastimes. And once their body is burnt out and withered, they will simply be replaced by a new worker.

eceeec09-4e4c-40e1-85a2-b4fdbff8a2f1.Text: Centuries ago, liturgies of assembly and first ignition were held on Kiava Gamma for majestic steel monstrosities: all-crushing mountain tunnellers, mighty cargo haulers, and voracious mega-harvesters. This virtuous craft is lost now, but Adeptus Mechanicus artisans can revive it. Then, once again, triumphant calls of klaxons will shake the Koronus Expanse!

0234907e-0ccd-485c-b02c-9474fc7c800a.Text: According to the new doctrine, the disenfranchised will be servitorised or disposed of through hazardous work.

d1519a56-b293-4251-a5b1-d4f89163a2c5.Text: The Koronus Expanse is in need of stalwart defenders, and Foulstone can help by sending its children to every dark corner of the sector.

4b83bea3-e004-4260-8e9b-8cea7bbd4520.Text: The establishment of ammunition production will be of great help in the defence of Foulstone and neighbouring systems.

667e263e-015e-418a-9e19-538108ca016f.Text: With the warp currents tangled, refugees lose their way and perish in terror. The Rogue Trader can send out pious patrols to help those in distress and light warp beacons.

618280d0-7b88-453a-9abb-a844ff18f027.Text: A new secret lodge of xenospecialists will decipher the written records left by the ancient xenos that once inhabited Janus.

5c56d56d-96c3-41c9-96e1-ebcf4fbcb3b7.Text: To teach the serfs to read, and thus produce educated servants under the supervision of monks, would be as useful as it would be dangerous.

4c481649-f2de-4071-9b04-d463c3c9bd8a.Text: Lord Inquisitor Calcazar warned the Rogue Trader that Governor Vyatt had fallen into the fetid embrace of heresy and surrounded herself with blasphemers and traitors. Her execution and the extermination of her inner circle is the only path acceptable to a faithful child of the Emperor, despite the fact that the colony will be decapitated and plunged into chaos.

65d9af93-849b-4449-8fee-2bb14e6ab4b5.Text: Execution of the Heretic Vistenza Vyatt

10aec931-e2e4-4ff4-9f11-23407ee80b58.Text: The genetic purges will be stopped — this world needs working hands.

fdcce12b-9e3f-4b41-85e2-57a12063e1aa.Text: Issuing this decree will significantly tighten production quotas, dooming laggards to being processed into corpse starch, which will encourage the most diligent servants.

03030c9a-4c41-43cd-9dd8-a10e80e905ef.Text: The abandoned void station in orbit around Vheabos VI may be turned into a secret den for the pirates of the Koronus Expanse.

53ca0e6d-5aa8-4c04-b703-2258530926eb.Text: The convicts will be of much greater use if they are kept from sleeping by employing a small augmentation.

48298d2d-659d-465e-b28c-15e657f3456e.Text: There is a rumour that there are several warp guides among the convicts — unsanctioned semblances of Navigators. It may be worth it to hunt them down and press them into service.

2a0948a8-50f0-445d-9ebf-e8ba5e623e17.Text: By showing illusions to the masses, it is possible to gain a lot of attention and attract pilgrims.

0e2061e6-2065-4edd-80e0-45bf97a77b94.Text: The large increase in tithes may be supplemented by a decree that addresses the current shortfalls in other ways.

1a3f5d50-b103-4989-88e0-3ea71467979b.Text: It is possible to utilise all of Kiava Gamma's potential by covering its surface in a huge electoo — the whole world will be wrapped in a grandiose potentia coil.

b3b0d96d-03e8-460f-b593-6ab61abe37e3.Text: The date for the payment of the tithe approaches. However, by making use of the corrupt practices of the Administratum, one could find a way to keep both the psykers and the thrones.

025e1bfd-f559-4b70-80a5-199aa91376b3.Text: The blessed hydraulic installation of the Adeptus Mechanicus will crush the greedy bowels of the earth, freeing the priceless minerals within that the Imperium so desperately needs.

412a5da6-f2b8-432f-9231-4623fe19b616.Text: The Hospitaller Priesthood of the Sanguinalians, a spiritual community within the Ecclesiarchy, has taken an interest in the pious world of Foulstone and offers to found a sanatorium sanctum on it. There, armed with scalpels and diagnostors, healers will cure diseases, furnish the disabled with augmentations, and keep a vigilant eye out for genetic anomalies among the colonists.

e71a8a06-73ff-4440-8528-9a71bc66dd67.Text: Saint Cognatius left behind many treasures that are now coveted by powerful men and women. Rogue Trader Incendia Chorda possesses the shards of a priceless combi-tool bearing the saint's fingerprints. Formally reclaiming the relic via the Adeptus Administratum will be a bureaucratic war requiring influential allies and nothing short of an army of clerks and scribes. But if it is passed into the safekeeping of monks in the Order of the Hammer, it will be a great triumph for the faithful.

bec3f4fa-4ac6-4e1e-9428-e6dd39d77ea8.Text: Not even the sprawling agri-complexes of Janus can cover the whole of the planet's fertile expanse. Gargantuan tracked mega-harvesters will come to their aid. They will wander the planet for months, each one operated by its assigned clan of serfs who are born, live, and die in the bowels of these great machines. These giants will reap harvests with their toothed jaws, break open the soil with their plasteel ploughs, and drink the swampy lowlands dry with their thirsty hydropumps, spewing the water forth down upon the arid hills.

7fe90d51-79b3-401c-8382-059dcba7b0ae.Text: Legend has it that House Winterscale holds the secrets of gas factoriums, workshops in which tons of organic raw materials pass through fermentation vats, hot rollers, and pressure exhausts to yield valuable chemicals. This sacred technology could enable Janus to produce enormous volumes of promethium. However, only the most skilful and highest-paid smugglers will be up to the task of stealing this treasure.

0409c64b-fe90-4bf3-bbd0-dae256eb1bbf.Text: Only the revered and marvellously equipped temples of the Adeptus Mechanicus earn the right to become Chapels of Enumeration. Underneath their majestic vaults, cybertheurges exorcise devastation-wreaking digital rakshas, while datasmiths awaken the spirits of the blessed cogitators with arithmetical liturgies and lexprayers.

0744b5f7-4554-4552-b3b6-89b0310707cb.Text: A planet's manufactorums are only as efficient as its logistical system. Lexmechanics predict a major growth in the world's overall manufacturing output if haulers and airships make way for powerful mag-trains speeding along a web of long-distance railways.

9069e971-214c-4b73-963d-831f56310547.Text: The construction of pleasure chambers will give the aristocrats a place of repose, free from moral restrictions.

4aa42b27-b9d7-4ce8-b88f-e3b9b3c49202.Text: The adoption of the Charter, a document that grants certain rights to commoners, is a scandalous decision. This step will allow a small group of elected commoners to rule Dargonus alongside the aristocracy.

45896aee-27f6-4190-9c98-ac09128e07b2.Text: The monks demand a great work — thousands of faithful with skin entirely covered in scars in the form of lines from scripture about Saint Cognatius.

0f898d2e-6fff-46cb-b146-04c67a323c81.Text: In these dark times, a number of individuals in the Expanse have become known as honoured saints. There is an opportunity to lure one such figure to Foulstone and kill him in secret. His remains will become a valuable relic.

78c33cf4-3fdb-45c9-834f-9c30e1cc29b3.Text: The decree requires that all redundant members of the community give themselves to the land, allowing themselves to become a nourishing compost on which the sprouts of future prosperity will burgeon.

8fef9d00-6e3c-4a24-9169-7fd83add1ea0.Text: Death Cult of the Reaper Emperor

98a2c47b-9fc1-4ee8-9fa5-4af32e8731d2.Text: A hospice for servitors will provide care for out-of-order automatons, to the utter bewilderment of the Adeptus Mechanicus.

1e1ebc5f-d4ea-4a75-905f-c4d46bd299c6.Text: The heresy of creativity may bear practical fruit — if subjects are allowed to secretly produce the mechanisms they invent.

ea37d897-cdbf-40bd-9d2b-588ad8db51d2.Text: In the Expanse's darkest hours, convicts may take the martyr's shift and descend into the mines, never to resurface, thereby clearing their name.

70252358-d671-409d-8445-90bfa404621f.Text: More and more ships arrive in orbit around Dargonus. The reduction of duties and the reining in of customs will allow the black market to flourish, able to compete directly with Footfall.

51f20c30-3555-4066-b174-e68244af1fbf.Text: The mining complexes are getting crowded. Individual pods and tranquillisers for the convicts could solve the problem.

adbb95a8-c829-4fc6-952f-bb7d978567dc.Text: After millennia of lying under the monastery, Saint Cognatius's titanic machine will soon be launched. It will take resources to awaken the relic, but doing so will bring glory to the von Valancius name.

1667ce36-d1a1-46f9-90a8-8d1c781b1e0c.Text: Territory for new agri-complexes can be gained in only one way — the way of fire.

82306fab-ddd5-4540-a483-de8b785518f4.Text: Kiava Gamma will become the main data-repository of the Expanse. Thousands of scribes register cargo and the lenses of watchful cogitators process myriads of documents.

2b8cc1c8-1963-4624-b63b-622d84580581.Text: By declaring Dargonus the defence centre of the Koronus Expanse, the Rogue Trader will be able to requisition foreign vessels and collect additional resources from the population.

9c4a1649-fdf3-436b-9032-8b289cfee6be.Text: An entire planetary regiment of martyr Guardsmen — a gift from the Rogue Trader to the Koronus Expanse in its darkest hour.

b5b13580-7c8c-4809-bde2-4b016e6a586e.Text: On Foulstone, the faithful are brimming with fanatical zeal. Their faith commands them to exterminate the subhumans, the mutants, and the weak of faith in their midst; then they must travel to other worlds of the protectorate to continue the holy cleansing. Creations of the blasphemous xenos, traces of heresies, and tomes of dangerous knowledge abound in the Koronus Expanse. Let the bonfires' flames consume the corruption!

0823d48b-4cde-49e5-8b33-e31de0a419f5.Text: The Order of the Hammer has a closely held and ambitious dream, to erect a giant spire that will reach up to Foulstone's orbit. From there, a powerful vox-station will broadcast prayers and sermons to the entire planet, while the voice of an Astropathic Choir will carry the sacred words all across the Koronus Expanse. The good tidings will be heard throughout the vox-spectrum, rallying the Imperium's subjects.

84f76d56-d494-4c28-91c0-32a0622ae811.Text: Not all servants of the Omnissiah firmly adhere to the Catechism of Maintenance and Operation. The malateks are defrocked clergy and other similar outcasts who wander the Koronus Expanse in pursuit of undesirable knowledge, teetering on the brink of a schism. A protector who gives them shelter, safety, and resources for their research will earn their gratitude. The Kasballica Mission has connections among the malateks and can secretly assemble an entire coven of the unholy sages on Janus so they may intrepidly study the mysterious xenos artefacts found in abundance on this world.

23b248b1-a932-4b57-bb2e-ce8f43dc548e.Text: The Magos Biologis, custodians of Janus's sacred irrigation plants, have taken an interest to the unique substances discovered on the planet. If provided with the resources for erecting a chapel, they will delve into the mysteries of chem-synthesis, which can turn deadly toxins into the basic substances needed for life-saving medicae kits.

8345eead-ccdf-49fe-9c99-e02f45ec10b6.Text: A servitor is superior to an ordinary worker in every way, being efficient, durable, and devoid of service-irrelevant brain processes. Kiava Gamma will have the capacity to provide the entire protectorate with servants of flesh and metal, once given appropriate amounts of human raw materials. The new production line will be deployed at an ancient and venerated workshop decommissioned for preservation years ago by Lady Theodora's order.

89cf3d50-8dc8-45dc-8b9a-0778c6f6d8d8.Text: The Adeptus Mechanicus are concerned about the recent outbreak of heresy on Kiava Gamma. They offer to enter into a solemn alliance with House von Valancius. Under its terms, an ancient workshop preserved by Lady Theodora's order will become the site of a Prioratus Skitarius, a factory which would produce the invincible Tech-Guards. These unrelenting warriors, impeccable in their digital vows, will secure every Adeptus Mechanicus facility in the protectorate.

aa972434-70ce-41ba-9926-b0b3b576b1c2.Text: More and more ships arrive in orbit around Dargonus. The agreement with the Navy allows the deployment of a permanent dock for warships and repositories for the Navy's property.

c5b9c1aa-4284-4ac1-aedf-9ca4e660fab3.Text: The manufactorums of Kiava Gamma have been damaged and tainted by the procedures of the heretic Delphim. A renowned tech-architect, the fugitive aristocrat Barabbas Killius, is offering to enter the Rogue Trader's service as a planetary steward and restore the world to its former production capacity.

2222a41c-1a4c-4d4b-92a4-4f3a7d0c870c.Text: Great trials are ahead, and we must steel ourselves to face them. The Rogue Trader will sign a mutual aid agreement with the quaestors of the Departmento Munitorum. These outstanding theoreticians of warfare will supervise the repurposing of the planet's manufactorums for the production of weapons and military equipment. In the jaws of lathe machines and the wombs of alloy vats, soulless plasteel will take on its highest and most perfect form, that of a weapon.

4330454a-17fd-4779-84e9-beb218b1270c.Text: For generations, the Adeptus Mechanicus have been custodians of the machinery and cogitators of Kiava Gamma. Recognising the value of this tragedy-stricken world, they are willing to deploy a forge-cathedral on it as a token of sympathy. Therein, the blessed Fabricator-Censor Fortron will envision and lay out a new and more perfect design for the planet.

a0738b38-c27c-4198-9eb6-7751193e8440.Text: A new hive city will be established on top of the ruins of Scipione 84-249.

1f26fef5-5da4-4897-b840-a64635e9df51.Text: Palace-Ecstasiums will be constructed on top of the ruins of Scipione 84-249 for the aristocracy. The dead and the dying will fertilise the gardens that will ring these pleasure chambers.

c3f2bbe5-75b0-4ef6-a16c-a6bf461b28db.Text: The surviving spine of Scipione 84-249 will be rebuilt into a space elevator. It will be capped by an emporium, accepting those ships that are too heavy to land on the surface.

29039b8e-e4f8-456a-89ce-718cf1a4686b.Text: Vheabos VI needs new convicts. Various dangerous literates and idle thinkers could supplement the work force.

d5bc057b-2b47-4bee-900a-a3baf9f7dc72.Text: Vheabos VI needs new convicts. The quarries can be filled with prisoners taken from foreign worlds.

b6ef5a74-5e57-4cb4-bb2e-2552c3cf7ae0.Text: Vheabos VI needs new convicts. Purchasing foreign criminals is a potential solution to this problem.

ab8eeb77-a1d4-4247-b082-8dda7d7226c3.Text: Thousands of believers are flocking to Foulstone in the hope of serving the Emperor. Their energy can be directed toward the colonisation and conquest of new worlds, as commanded by Saint Drusus. The construction of pilgrims' arks will require enormous resources, but wealth is nothing to the true believer.

afb42c27-5c06-4490-9895-fe6a064a9e01.Text: House von Valancius' worlds may be untouched by corruption, but many enemies of the faith are lurking all around, and the pilgrims of Foulstone are aflame with fanaticism! They need weapons and ships, and whoever gifts them these holy tools will be vested with a modicum of the God-Emperor's power! May the crusade against corruption and idolatry commence!

31845ac1-69b0-42a3-956f-b4aa9ce71b5e.Text: Shrine worlds are treasures of the Imperium, spiritual gems shining in the darkness. For Foulstone to become a shrine world will require an ocean's worth of thrones in bribes to greedy Ecclesiarchy officials, as well as mountains of extremely rare materials to erect cathedrals worthy of the status. However, succeeding will give House von Valancius prestige and the Order of the Hammer's eternal gratitude.

0b3d5d08-8013-489e-abc4-ea0c236c47d4.Text: All of the corruption on Janus originated in the sophistries of unholy scholars! Reverend Hieronymus Doloroso, a preacher of the Cult of Saint Drusus, is going to visit Janus to perform the procedure of blessed delimitation of the agri-complexes and demarcation of the irrigation systems. Instead of relying on the advice of godless Genetors, he will be guided by the wise examples set in hagiographies of the saints, the teachings of righteous scriptures, and the pious sacred geometry of the iconographers. May faith triumph over the sophistication of soulless metal!

86dbffdb-89c0-4158-8bc7-4334a6666055.Text: The Magos Metallurgicus are proposing a massive tectonic plate detonation to awaken the planet's great volcanoes. Smelting shops housed inside their flaming vents can produce plasteel of incredible purity. The earthquakes, tectonic instability, and ash clouds that will forever envelop the sky of Kiava Gamma are a small price for such a success.

59f7b480-a6d0-4f00-8a44-57497cc8c380.Text: A mysterious Explorator ship, the Hexaltation, has landed on this world's surface. The Tech-Priests graciously informed the authorities that they had taken control of nearby manufactorums in order to perform the rites of ship maintenance, and made servitors of the worker units deployed there. The servants of the Omnissiah requested enormous quantities of priceless materials without saying a word as to the purpose of their visit or the details of their mission. They have expressed their gratitude for the assistance and vaguely promised a reward "commensurate with the planetary authorities' contribution."

cf55ae4f-0a22-4216-911b-03e76626f03d.Text: Kiava Gamma is sufficiently advanced and well-defended to have the honour of hosting an Electro-Priest monastery. Lighting up the sky with a mighty magnetic radiance, this formidable power complex will pour thousands of gigawatts of the blessed Motive Force on the planet's manufactorums.

a2e93ff0-70ac-47c1-98a5-a55f48125cb3.Text: As the population of Dargonus grows, the old ways must be improved upon. Allowing the artisans to unite in guilds in order to protect their rights and control entire hive segments will cause an explosive growth of industry. This, in turn, will bring about devastating storms and acid rains pouring down from the poisoned atmosphere.

9e661a7c-af30-40b8-8adc-5a7194a32247.Text: As the population of Dargonus grows, the old ways must be improved upon. The creation of fortresses of justice will establish the rule of law and attract reliable merchants and partners.

10b2fdb7-3041-4f14-b8d7-d5800de8203d.Text: As the population of Dargonus grows, the old ways must be improved upon. The most audacious underhive gangs will form the planet's new elite. By leaving them to fight for territory, the Rogue Trader will be able to select the most vicious servants.

27589867-0d14-4bc0-88b7-a6ff4369e98d.Text: There are now more convicts than there is work to go around. The surplus can be driven into the jungle — over time they will become wild and be toughened by interclan conflicts, at which point the best fighters among them will be selected for service.

ee90ac67-37b7-4262-9964-ffcc87f3c355.Text: There are now more convicts than there is work to go around. Gladiatorial arenas contained under enviro-domes will make use of this surplus — to the delight of visiting aristocrats.

09c4eabb-7ec0-4ea7-9c0e-e2cdd62acab6.Text: The monastery damaged by the Crucible will be rebuilt. While the cathedral is being erected from the ruins, the noble monks will scour the archives for any evidence of a familial connection between Saint Cognatius and the von Valancius dynasty.

01851bc2-6b55-4f81-97ad-b9823e02655e.Text: The holy remains of the monastery, which was damaged by the launch of the Crucible, will be transferred to Foulstone's moon. Equipped with drives, the weaponised moon will leave orbit and set out on a crusade as a temple comet.

1b60ad1e-d80e-463b-ae8f-589f31a2345f.Text: The monastery, having been damaged by the launch of the Crucible, will be transferred aboard the von Valancius flagship as a great reliquary and shelter for the Order of the Hammer.

7d9f04b4-808c-4788-9a2d-dbbff15a0599.Text: Janus's orbit is swarming with a fleet of refugees. By turning the entire world into an enormous staging point, the Rogue Trader will save billions of lives.

2fa6ee8d-beac-4f02-b754-ada399490ef9.Text: Janus's orbit is swarming with a fleet of refugees. They can be utilised as a workforce for the construction of a grand xenovivisectory for the study of inhumans. All witnesses will be disposed of.

1831f2f9-e086-4617-a07c-628ac47a60d5.Text: Janus's orbit is swarming with a fleet of refugees. Welcoming the commoners would be pointless, but the Rogue Trader could offer refuge to the aristocrats and turn Janus into a world of blessed respite for them, gaining powerful allies as a result.

cf6d821e-5361-454b-b108-285cf4ff6750.Text: Eufrates II is lost, and the Adeptus Mechanicus now seek new citadels for their hallowed production lines. Kiava Gamma can house workshops that will forge voidship weapons.

74e3816d-9c6d-456a-8cbc-74eccc640214.Text: Eufrates II is lost, and the Adeptus Mechanicus now seek new citadels for their hallowed production lines. Kiava Gamma can become a sacred assembly site for plasma drives endowed with the Emperor's grace.

6fcf2600-a871-4794-a804-97d8d4975a97.Text: Eufrates II is lost, and the Adeptus Mechanicus now seek new citadels for their hallowed production lines. Kiava Gamma can set up a research complex for warp technologies — a dangerous, closely guarded secret of the Adeptus Mechanicus.

4bcaa555-7517-4009-b36f-7d225369eb0c.Text: A new entry in the annals of Dargonus — the fate of the millions of orphans whose parents fell in the fire that gripped the Expanse.

8ba86a6d-6e9c-45f0-9292-968fd308c415.Text: The privilege of becoming Foulstone's patron is a tempting prospect for many. However, with the Rogue Trader's assistance, the Order of the Hammer will retain ultimate authority over the world.

5bdee76b-b789-4984-baea-dbb4b42da745.Text: Since Dargonus is an educated world, it is the right place to establish a secret librarium where scholars of the arcane will be free to share their knowledge and delve into the forbidden.

6eb2b648-2765-48d6-adff-59898a3e2363.Text: The bravest captains will unite under the Rogue Trader's aegis. Upon being offered invaluable charts and other assistance with their expeditions, the voidfarers will repay the favour with goodwill and trophies.

4cd474e2-6e04-4062-a0f5-f865de3d21e2.Text: Vheabos VI is a quiet haven. If the Rogue Trader permits pirate squadrons to use it as a safe staging ground for their raids, {mf|he|she} will become known as the pirate {mf|king|queen} of the Expanse.

93392ec5-85b0-4c62-a4a5-f23d4e4e5545.Text: Vheabos VI is the far reach of the Expanse. Many influential people seeking refuge from the law and faith would pay well if one were to turn this world into a suitable sanctuary.

23908082-0f13-4b76-8c7e-c16b956d4513.Text: Vheabos VI is a quiet haven and a place to ponder the state of one's soul. A fortress of repentance complete with an order of battle flagellants will offer lawbreakers a chance to find solace in being reborn as a crusader.

339ed6e3-cfb0-49d5-87ce-2a4ceb01df31.Text: The Ecclesiarchy lacks a capital in the Koronus Expanse from which to guide the faithful. If Foulstone ascends to the status of a cardinal world, the Adeptus Ministorum will ensure the prosperity of their new planetary stronghold. Heretics will tremble when they hear of the alliance between House von Valancius and the Ecclesiarchy!

b3ed026f-d2d0-40cb-a54d-85d1c7f63507.Text: No one in the entire Koronus Expanse will make a worthier guardian of a sanctuary of faith than the head of House von Valancius. A marvellous basilica will be erected in h{mf|is|er} honour in the world's capital city. It will be decorated with a grand twin statue of the Emperor and the Rogue Trader. Thousands of parishioners and priests will say h{mf|is|er} name in their daily prayers and bring h{mf|im|er} reverent gifts.

5d6e62bf-5861-4be4-b3e6-46d2ca27c51b.Text: Many planetary aristocrats have stained themselves with incompetence and lost their titles. A new nobility of Chem-Princes will be created out of subjects who prove capable in sciences and governance. Those who succeed in wisely managing their agri-complex fiefs, strictly maintaining obedience among the commoners and increasing the output of rare organic chemicals, will keep their positions.

22a6f8df-77cf-4385-bfba-7405ed2d8389.Text: In the days of the mutiny, many among Janus's pampered nobility fled the planet. They are to be replaced with more enterprising servants. A small but ambitious Ultrequisitor syndicate belonging to the Kasballica Mission has contacted the Rogue Trader with a lowly request to entrust the governance of Janus to them. With Vladaym Tocara pushing all of his competitors out of the Cold Trade, the Ultrequisitors are hoping to change their line of business and become dignified aristocrats serving House von Valancius.

1e99463f-74e6-4fe4-93d4-a1a94d99506c.Text: Janus is ailing, and who better to cure it than the sage Genetors of the Magos Biologis? Management of the agri-complexes will be taken away from the aristocrats and handed over to the servants of the Omnissiah, who will synchronise their operations for the benefit of the planet.

a0f6bf2a-b848-45ab-860e-f8cf12f0bee1.Text: In the middle of a warp jump, our sensors detected an approaching voidship, similar to ours in size, but of greater tonnage. The unidentified vessel did not respond to our hails and kept its course, approaching us at a high speed!

bb5b0688-d498-4ce1-a0b0-0892c7a0511d.Text: The unplanned manoeuvre was completed without any casualties or damage. The unidentified vessel, or perhaps it was a warp mirage, passed us by and made no attempts to follow us.

a7c5441c-173e-47e5-9f01-885a9b375d04.Text: The shell hit its target. The unidentified ship held its course for a moment longer... and then it vanished, leaving only flashes of light in its wake. A single projectile is not enough to destroy a ship of that size... What's more, our ship collided with no debris.

afccb5ef-5d76-4e39-8b64-3e1097e0b5e9.Text: The unplanned manoeuvre took its toll on the crew and the ship. And yet, it worked. The unidentified vessel, or perhaps it was a warp mirage, passed us by and made no attempts to follow us.

90d71564-0ea8-43e1-9946-2b988960df17.Text: A hastily launched shell only glanced the unidentified vessel, which continued to bear down upon us. When we collided, our whole ship juddered... but nothing else happened after that — no damage, no system failures, only a few casualties caused by heart attacks. The mysterious ship disappeared from our augurs.

799e8770-b469-475f-86e8-75ce454604ff.Text: Without hesitation, burn the contaminated provisions

f1835636-549c-4f58-ad74-62d4debc6368.Text: Make sure the contamination is not a mere illusion

f9639eeb-0a62-4f7e-a799-944f6b60a729.Text: The command bridge received an alarming vox-message from the quartermaster: some of the provisions and drinking water have gone bad and continue to worsen, teeming with fat grey maggots. However, the ship's air remains undefiled by the rank odour, and the maggots sometimes completely vanish from sight. Should we get rid of the affected stores?

e2198bee-36fa-4675-9aad-168caf666ae8.Text: The purifying flame consumed the provisions in an instant, much faster than anyone expected. The crew's ears rang with a pained shriek and the scorched stores vanished without so much as a trace of ash. The vessel's ecclesiarchs consecrated the compartment with holy signs, but the rest of the voidsmen decided that the contamination had been nothing more than an illusion.

4f5f44b1-dd7d-4ed6-ba97-dc45cb8e5547.Text: The officers ordered the men to unleash a salvo. Upon ignition, one of the flame throwers unleashed a blazing whirlwind, turning its owner into a wailing torch. The spill from the exploded fuel tank drenched the ship's bulkhead and severely damaged the adjacent hold, burning many of the resident voidsmen. The scorched stores vanished without so much as a trace of ash, as such most everyone decided the worms had been nothing more than an illusion.

b97033d6-1ad9-4d23-9d6c-610b1f6c4e02.Text: At first glance the provisions are hopelessly ruined by scabs and disgusting larvae, but looking away makes the squirming filth vanish into thin air. "Yet another deception of the warp," thought the Lord Captain, proved right when the vessel arrived in realspace.

a3bc1234-dc4e-4263-a5f2-c873704b1efa.Text: The disgusting larvae started to spread, ruining the provisions. No one dared to approach the crates, and the compartment remained sealed until the very end of the journey. Upon leaving the Sea of Souls, the quartermaster was in no hurry to inspect it. When he finally gathered the courage, it turned out the contamination had been an illusion and nothing more.

8223ccab-bf27-43dc-adf8-623ebb7a6b15.Text: Seal off the chamber until the vessel leaves the warp

a99b3400-e6ba-488e-8810-f2c53fd5b5ae.Text: Send a flamethrower squad to burn away the infestation

88104344-3416-49a2-a974-ff7bda3686ef.Text: An auxiliary generator chamber on the artillery deck was overgrown with the thick stems of some thorny plant. The voidsmen reported the vegetation throbbing and sighing, and when they tried to lop off an offshoot, the cut started oozing a disgusting pus. Some officers claim to have heard someone trapped among the thorns: the desperate weeping of a woman's voice echoed from inside the compartment.

8f88a917-a06a-41a3-877d-21457688e05f.Text: As soon as the voidsmen started welding the chamber shut, a heartbreaking cry rang out and green shoots burst out of the gap. However, the crew's loyalty to the Rogue Trader and their unshakeable faith in the God-Emperor spurred them to finish the task. Only when the ship left the Immaterium did the diabolic moaning subside.

8270277b-b757-4187-bdd2-ea49cab6ebec.Text: The flame had been reluctant to take hold, barely flickering on the thorny vines at first. The warp creature begged endlessly for mercy, its soft voice full of genuine suffering — but the God-Emperor protects His servants. When the vile spawn caught fire at last, only its oily ashes were left behind.

cffe7d73-b2c5-49b7-996c-34a1811cfa4a.Text: The fire reluctantly gnawed on the meaty vines.
