The warp creature begged endlessly for mercy, its soft voice full of suffering — the hearts of many flame bearers faltered, inciting them to impale themselves on the burning thorns as they rushed into the tangle to save the unseen victim. By the time the chamber was cleansed, more than half of the flamethrower squad perished in the blaze.

4ab4e962-7b92-44f2-bcac-2bd83cf82acc.Text: Better to purge the mutants than to allow heresy to take root on the von Valancius vessel

bc74b0ad-8510-43e8-8d26-bfd73e08e96a.Text: Gather the corrupted for a mass prayer

33edbf2d-7ff4-4a85-9c66-a7fbabe59560.Text: The Rogue Trader sees nothing wrong with the glowing eyes of {mf|his|her} subjects

e50a11dc-47b3-4561-be49-d49c697aa022.Text: The ship's augurs registered an emission of unknown radiation in one of the chambers. As a result, some of the voidsmen now have glowing irises, which has proven to be quite beneficial in the performance of their duties. The vessel's confessors are in doubt and suggest it may be an outward sign of corruption.

488f68ba-7daf-476b-8bed-90b00a78fff1.Text: The crew zealously carried out the Rogue Trader's order and put to death everyone marked with the fiendish, glimmering eyes. Only the Emperor's light may illuminate the path of His servants.

c396f6fe-c861-4d46-a508-68beae80f85e.Text: The crew's fervent prayers were answered. Those bearing the most luminous irises dropped dead upon hearing the hymn to the God-Emperor, while the rest were struck with a severe sickness which did not abate until the vessel left the Sea of Souls.

18a496c8-1af5-4920-a32c-7a5a14bd6361.Text: Fear, provoked by the eerie glow of the voidsmen's eyes, gripped the lower decks. Many of the afflicted vanished, most likely victims of ruthless vigilante justice. Those whose eyes burned the brightest did not survive the translation to realspace, while the rest were struck with a severe sickness.

28ce2921-045d-4b79-b337-9780faeb46cd.Text: Organise punitive processions against everyone faltering in their belief

5e30129f-f307-4356-98b1-56951d278aa1.Text: Sanctify all chambers of the voidship one more time

30b5c2a7-320f-4983-8361-9e7c334db012.Text: The vessel's confessors report discontent among their flock: during the traditional sermon before departure, a ritual chandelier's hundred candles were snuffed out at once. The missionaries attribute this incident to an open ventilation shaft, but the voidsmen noticed it and are whispering about an ill omen, fearing the woes that may soon come.

5c3a7380-72de-44e2-8821-f78d9013aa05.Text: The holy procession in full accordance with Ecclesiarchy's liturgical canon rekindled the faith in the voidsmen's hearts and renewed their belief in the God-Emperor's benevolent power. The whispers subsided, and the crew is ready to face the potential dangers with courage and fervour.

cf3837b8-c24c-441a-a0a1-17515d4b85b8.Text: Taking the holy procession through each and every chamber of the ship taxed the confessors and disrupted the ship's schedule as the voidsmen abandoned their tasks to participate in the ceremony. However, the ritual was long enough to distract the flock from perilous thoughts until the vessel exited the warp.

66b3b34f-ef67-4bdb-8ca3-6ffbe287ace8.Text: A resounding condemnation of weakness of spirit and body led to arbitrary reprisals against anyone who dared even mention the troubles hanging over the crew. With the permission of the confessors, the voidsmen took the task of bolstering morale into their own hands and successfully quelled the rising panic.

b8c12046-d176-4e38-9c2d-0efde325bd5d.Text: The vessel's confessors zealously set about executing the order. Unfortunately, the poorly organised massacres of the weak-willed did not lead to the desired result: the apostates kept their heads down and the rest of the crew decided the persecution was the very trouble the omen had promised.

99e2f621-e4fb-43cb-97a6-fb3a4f919119.Text: Isolate the chamber until the vessel leaves the warp

a95e9864-f0e1-4f94-a78a-19cc90b34d3b.Text: Send patrols into the affected chamber

8c3076b3-4bda-49c2-9084-8320816c91a6.Text: Ignore the reports and resume the voyage

6ec01813-cba6-4927-ac75-b4f77d0af4b2.Text: The Tech-Priests reported a brief malfunction in the Geller field generator that left the vessel exposed to the warp for a brief second. According to the enforcer reports, something did manage to get into the ship and is now prowling the dark corridors of Loading Bay 5...

58f64070-1428-4fa9-bff6-39a4841a6196.Text: A part of the ship was isolated from the rest until it left the warp at the end of the journey. After the vessel emerged in realspace and the chamber was unsealed, it was intact... with the exception of the crew who had barricaded themselves in a far corner of Loading Bay 5 and bravely resisted the unknown assailant for as long as they could. Their remains have been safely disposed of.

7577bb13-8e78-428b-a8b9-69a2a16f7169.Text: The crew remained in the grasp of terror until the vessel finally left the warp. Each night the lurking beast would claim the lives of several dozen people, sometimes from entirely different decks. The crew is distressed by the loss of their friends and relatives and the ship's prayer rooms are overcrowded.

1ee6f174-ce55-4f50-8daa-45f7969e1ef4.Text: Several armed teams left to search for the unknown creature that had invaded the vessel. All but two returned with nothing to show for it but hair turned prematurely grey and horror stories of what was happening in Loading Bay 5. One team brought back a bizarre trophy allegedly found behind a shattered bulkhead. The last team was never seen or heard from again.

d0726b3f-8c50-42e3-bac3-bf2686a1bd76.Text: Steer the vessel past the warp reef

67eec55e-6e4b-4eb2-9989-2438d5c7a623.Text: During the warp voyage the Navigator's Sanctum reported there are warp reefs right on the ship's course — the fragments of the Sea of Souls given material form. The Navigator may either steer the ship past the dangerous region or risk approaching the ragged formation to gain valuable insight.

dea685bd-79f3-46bf-9295-33ca13f6836b.Text: Following the Lord Captain's orders and the Navigator's instructions, the voidship approached the warp reefs...

b1436c8b-5bd3-4ada-8ff2-c500eb53aca0.Text: The voidship followed the route charted by the Navigator and successfully passed the troublesome region.

1f8a1560-3770-4c3e-8dec-cf3b044d6ab9.Text: ...and passed the sharp formation without brushing against a single one. No one on board noticed anything in particular, but it became a momentous event for the Navigator, who gained a special understanding of warp emanations.

1657de0e-67dd-4cd4-8a9d-3b270de89a00.Text: ...and the lower decks rang with the unbearable screeching of tearing plasteel: a razor-sharp reef edge had cut into the hull! The ship managed to escape the dangerous region, but not before taking serious damage.

11c00045-3a79-4fed-bfcb-138e8b1687c3.Text: Dispose of the newly emergent prophet and ban the cult

2ed4df1d-803a-4bed-9344-7c4753cd0bf0.Text: During the warp voyage, the middle decks reported strange gatherings that were attracting dozens of officers. An investigation quickly bore fruit: one of the acolytes from the augur deck has proclaimed himself a prophet and is rambling about purification by blessed fire. Only the perilous influence of the warp can explain the strange convictions and uncanny zeal of this person...

83112d5e-0f36-4612-8b1c-fcf4780692cf.Text: The mysterious disappearance of the prophet and more frequent inspections of decks and living quarters quickly put an end to the growing popularity of the sect. After a few days, the people who visited the gatherings preferred to simply put the episode behind them.

1309f918-502b-4faa-815d-f429e7c8abed.Text: An attempt to remove the prophet led to an armed confrontation between his followers and the enforcers of the voidship. The cult was eliminated by the end of the voyage, but not before many good servants of the Emperor had lost their lives.

d32fbfd3-2650-41b0-9553-7dc163eda29f.Text: Spies reported that the cult gatherings were hardly worth investigating — they were nothing but long conversations punctuated by people searing their palms over an open flame. The surveillance was maintained until the end of the warp journey, after which the newly born prophet simply forgot about his calling, stopped giving sermons, and dismissed his congregation.

8c5f719d-97e7-4f58-8893-d56c59cb11c1.Text: The spies sent to keep an eye on the cult were careless and gave themselves away, sending the prophet and his cult into hiding. The bridge and the augur deck lost several key officers who chose to follow their "messiah" into exile to the lower decks, where it is easier to avoid the voidship's enforcers.

4e5089b5-331c-48ae-bbda-75b17fee3f20.Text: The cult lasted until the end of the warp voyage, but until then several officers from the bridge and the augur deck continually skipped shifts and neglected their duties. Upon arriving in realspace, the religious fervour abated — both for the gathering participants and the prophet himself, who seemed to forget what he had been preaching.

3b1ce552-72c3-4940-8b72-b92aaeaa16f9.Text: Order that the monsters be banished with faith and prayer

56c463de-bba1-4203-8fe4-99b1b42669bd.Text: Order that the decks be purified with fire

5f06ce0b-d13d-458e-9787-ec31173f3455.Text: The clan servicing the cooling systems have reported an incident of sorcery: the shadows in the cabins and corridors are coming to life! The voidsmen say they see strange writhing things lurk in nooks and crannies at the edge of their vision. If they look away, the things spread over the room, gnawing on everything in their path and attacking the weak and infirm. The strange creatures cannot be caught, it is almost as if they sense they are being watched and sink into the many cracks between the machines and bulkheads.

6cef9bbd-373c-42d9-ab97-2272f21a8dc8.Text: The Ecclesiarchy mission on board the voidship held sermons in every corner of the haunted chamber. The many-voiced chants and holy rituals manifested their power, and the daemons skulking in the cracks vanished without a trace. The crew was cheered and they praised the God-Emperor for His protection.

623690d6-a66d-40cb-ae44-f1adaec697c6.Text: The Ecclesiarchy mission on board the voidship held sermons in every corner of the haunted chamber. The rituals failed to produce a result, however, and the cursed creatures kept pestering the crew until the ship exited the warp, dealing a serious blow to morale.

f6cd1bdd-b28c-4fd6-99c7-97d6c71d803a.Text: The controlled scorching of decks is a labour-intensive but very familiar process for the voidsmen serving under the ship's Infernus Master. The evacuated chambers were set on fire, burning away all filth and heresy from the darkest corners. The shadow-skulkers vanished without a trace, and the denizens of the cooling systems breathed a sigh of relief.

2aa3df79-7ba7-4497-bf6b-db9fe159768c.Text: The scorching of decks started properly but quickly went out of control when it became clear the chamber had not been fully evacuated. The roaring flame destroyed many priceless machines and the people locked in distant cabins either suffocated from the toxic smoke or perished in the stampede. Despite the losses, the plan was a success and the shadow-skulkers were never seen again.

77bc1552-bd2a-4834-b602-ac24b9186f14.Text: The clan servicing the cooling systems was left alone with their problem and they tried to fight off the warp monsters themselves. Alas, their ingenuity did nothing to curb the otherworldly menace. By the time the ship exited the warp, the creatures had grown so bold that they openly hunted people in broad daylight. After the translation to realspace, it was announced that the sorcerous plight had been a punishment for the crew's lack of faith.

219932f0-5a76-41af-8e9e-a9f5957d409c.Text: Pray for salvation from the warp trap

37eb0f77-4b90-46e0-a1d7-b4a9423acbf0.Text: A trickle of disturbing news came from the Navigator's Sanctum over the last few days — allegedly there is a vast shadow following the voidship through the depths of the Sea of Souls. Mere hours before emerging in realspace, the vessel shuddered — an unidentified leviathan had emerged from the roiling warp, wrapped its tentacles around the ship, and started squeezing, trying to crack the hull like an egg.

3c590b65-215b-4e82-ad50-4ac8280b885e.Text: The voidship crew did everything they could to release their vessel from the nightmarish creature's grasp. The bulkheads groaned and snapped, entire chambers depressurised, and screams of people left alone with the warp spawn made vox operators go mad as their hair turned grey. At last the Navigator executed an emergency translation to realspace, and only the opening of the escape portal made the unknown aggressor retreat.

4563477e-559a-4780-b74c-35f690f38da4.Text: Trying to fight against a creature surpassing the size of a voidship is folly, but the element of surprise is a powerful thing: after receiving a blow, the creature loosened its grip and let the ship surge forward. Before the monster could close its tentacles around the hull again, the Navigator and the crew executed an emergency translation to realspace. The unplanned jump was a success, although the hull did take minor damage.

3b259fda-3475-4fc9-ae12-82fcaa81fd3e.Text: The ship's Navigator engaged the warp monster in invisible combat by giving orders from the Sanctum Navis. By following the Astronomican's guiding light and struggling against the mighty alien will at the same time, the guide managed to pry the void vessel from the nightmarish creature's grasp and execute an emergency translation to realspace — with minimal losses among the crew and new insights into the nature of warp entities.

6e827029-d25c-4391-8c4b-5e3c066d9870.Text: Let the events run their course

96276aea-e762-4362-80c2-cd608cb8dc76.Text: The Lord Captain and {mf|his|her} crew have lost track of how much time they have spent in the warp jump. The vessel itself, the groaning of the bulkheads, the Vox Master's reports — it all happened so many times before and would happen yet again. No matter what occurred, the officers could not shake the feeling that they were running in circles, as if the voyage across the Sea of Souls would be eternal. Routine actions blended into grey nothingness and filled the crew's hearts with anguish. Many members considered submitting to the mercy of the chaotic power outside. Days went by, but the Navigator did not give the order to leave the Immaterium.

639811fc-c6ea-4890-849c-d4ff6dc5e2f3.Text: Time stretched into endless drudgery. When the crew began their descent into madness, the Lord Captain decided to exit the warp regardless of the consequences. However, the Navigator's reports and the consumption of supplies revealed that the vessel had spent far more time in the Immaterium than was expected. It seems the vessel had gotten stranded in an anomaly at the point of egress and arrived at an unintended location.

b7e6913e-90a5-48f8-9346-b4c1fca0af56.Text: The Lord Captain's insight pierced through the mind-numbing haze. It appeared that the ship's Astropaths and the Navigator had been sounding the alarm, but their messages had been ignored. Their combined efforts finally broke the time loop and released the vessel from the Empyrean's embrace. The warp never tires of its cruel mockery.

4c8bd5ed-2bbd-43d8-be72-8c9804939ae6.Text: The rising sense of alarm was drowned out by dismal tedium. Time stretched into endless drudgery. When the crew began their descent into madness, the Lord Captain decided to exit the warp regardless of the consequences. However, the Navigator's reports and the consumption of supplies revealed that the vessel had spent far more time in the Immaterium than was expected. It seems the vessel had gotten stranded in an anomaly at the point of egress and arrived at an unintended location.

dbc659b8-7708-4915-b062-9a5e22953632.Text: The Navigator gave praise to the God-Emperor that the Lord Captain had replied at last. It turned out the ship had gotten stranded in a temporal anomaly and only the vessel's psykers had managed to resist its malignant influence. The warp is full of countless riddles, but this one has finally been solved and stands ready to release the ship into realspace.

1475ba45-e75b-4680-8984-1554897f7b02.Text: Time stretched into endless drudgery. When the crew began their descent into madness, the Lord Captain decided to exit the warp regardless of the consequences. However, the Navigator reported the vessel had spent far more time in the Immaterium than was expected. It seems the vessel had gotten stranded in an anomaly at the point of egress and arrived at an unintended location. Not all crew members survived the prolonged long journey.

c20a7539-29ef-4c25-91d8-981157888482.Text: Order to have the tentacles surgically removed

268676aa-4ec4-4c2e-abfa-8028fb4e31fd.Text: Organise prayers and sacred rituals to banish the fog

9cdcc388-b783-41f6-a4eb-b5daff2fe6e4.Text: The medicae teams from the lower decks reported the appearance of a dense purple fog that causes people to develop mutant deformities — short tentacles roughly the length of a pinkie finger. Since the deformities do not interfere with the crew's performance, the medicae are not certain whether this phenomenon should be a cause for concern, but the riffraff are already whispering of heresy.

eb7dfc08-6af7-4474-ad2d-cbf9f5b18ac4.Text: Led by the preachers of the Ecclesiarchy, the voidsmen gathered for a mass prayer as the priests chanted holy verses to banish the corruption. Some of the more severely infested crew members failed to endure the celebration of the God-Emperor's glory and perished before the vessel could leave the Immaterium.

787215b3-bd4c-47b9-b812-a083969c16ec.Text: The corrupted were granted the Emperor's mercy, their bodies consigned to the purifying flame. At least their souls were safe from the Immaterium's treachery.

928ecdcb-8eba-420a-b4de-e70b0449c85f.Text: The medicae teams zealously set to work and started processing the voidsmen in quick succession. Although many perished during the surgery, their sacrifices would not be in vain. As the vessel left the warp for realspace, the fog vanished.

abb4f846-ff22-4c18-9f02-89eb5f9928e2.Text: The warp jump was a success, but the Vox Master reported the following incident: beautiful blossoming vines had covered the deck and bulkheads in Loading Bay 6. Two workers had bent down to take a better look at the flowers, and the vines had devoured their faces before strangling them. The bay was then sealed and purged.

10016bfd-f2dc-49ec-afe7-2bb93e9e4f19.Text: The Immaterium released us from its grip. This time.

84519b13-a54e-4f1e-b876-a538c27b505a.Text: A scheduled service in the ship's chapel was interrupted in the most profane manner. The images of saints and martyrs depicted on the altarpiece started to move and stepped down from the canvas! The congregation was filled with terror and dozens perished in the stampede. The illusion disappeared on its own, but it claimed several priests and altar attendants. It is said their frenzied shrieks can still be heard echoing under the vaults of the chapel during prayer...

636615d6-afbe-46e5-b75f-c185682f4176.Text: There was a malfunction in the engineering chamber during the warp journey: the accelerator cogitators stopped obeying the Tech-Priests, and for a few precious moments the ancient machines were left to their own devices. The crew managed to avoid serious breakdowns or accidents. Several acolytes of the Cult Mechanicus were turned into servitors as penance, and the bosun gave out several triple watches to the voidsmen who dredged up the old rumours about "the cursed ship."

20ebebd9-730f-40e2-9b7e-1a6b015aed4d.Text: There was a commotion on lower decks: the chief mutant hunter, who is responsible for eliminating heresy in the hold of the voidship, went mad due to the perilous influence of the warp. The officer climbed the parapet above the central accelerator complex and threatened to jump unless the entire crew immediately submitted to a rigorous examination to uncover physical deformities and unholy perversions. After calculating the time and financial cost of the inspection of thousands upon thousands of crew members and consulting the Tech-Priests about the danger of foreign materials getting into the intake of the accelerator complex, the deranged mutant hunter was graciously allowed to proceed with ending his life in the desired manner.

6744ed99-369f-4e5f-8dc6-ef3c1987b08a.Text: A fire broke out on one of the decks during the warp voyage. The raging disaster consumed the entire chamber, destroying precious cargo and damaging the interior plating. No guilty parties were found. While clearing out the rubble, a few people claimed the soot on the plasteel beams formed lines in a cryptic alien language not known to humans. The delirious workers were executed and their bodies disposed of in the proper manner.

fad1b7dc-545f-484c-9fd7-1fba90bb8534.Text: Ship's enforcers notified officers about a strange insect-like creature appearing on the Astropathic chamber deck. The entity was destroyed, but the incident was recalled a few days later when one of the Astropaths lost his mind, shrieking about a splitting headache. The psyker perished shortly after, and the autopsy revealed the presence of countless bloated larvae consuming his brain. The corpse and the insects were safely disposed of.

6ca03b84-fa40-4938-a15c-fc1bca07f2a2.Text: A mysterious sickness struck the clan living in one of the macro-cannon chambers. The disease quickly spread, causing the afflicted to writhe with unbearable stomach cramps and expire after several days of agony. Before the officers could react, the neighbouring clans took the issue into their own hands and flooded the chamber with carbon monoxide. The macro-cannon was put back into service and the vigilantes were punished for subjecting the Rogue Trader's servants to mob justice.

57299f6f-ab73-49d1-9d19-d06bf9ac6760.Text: By the God-Emperor's grace, no perils of the warp prevented the vessel from returning to realspace.

b7195e68-a0a5-4a2d-9712-96be5bf80b24.Text: The officers on one of the lower decks stopped providing status reports. Three days had passed since the vox-system broadcasted anything other than subdued moans and wet slapping noises. An enforcer squad sent to investigate reported that the denizens of the lower levels had regressed to animals and succumbed to depravity. The connection with the squad was shortly lost. The High Missionary of the Adeptus Ministorum became flush with fury and condemned these as designs of the Archenemy. The hotbed of heresy was cleansed with fire and prayer.

8326591b-0c73-4d07-aab5-093b1ac0dbb3.Text: By the God-Emperor's grace, no perils of the warp prevented the vessel from returning to realspace.

f939bce9-1258-4c2e-94c9-fdbd32cff65a.Text: Daemonic eyes had materialised and begun to slither across the walls of crew quarter forty-nine. The burning orbs swelled like bubbles of fetid swamp gas, only in secluded places at first, later appearing in plain sight. Everyone subject to their glare started experiencing headaches and spells of self-flagellation. After one of the officers peeled off a portion of his own skin to fashion a makeshift eyelid for one of the fiendish orbs, the section was quarantined since neither fire nor other munitions could prevent more eyes from sprouting up on the ship. The vessel was cleansed only by escaping from the clutching embrace of the Sea of Souls.

76feb3e3-6904-4c7e-9f02-a3fd71b73c29.Text: By the God-Emperor's grace, no perils of the warp prevented the vessel from returning to realspace.

55c30506-a997-4073-953d-6e8603090af4.Text: The clan servicing the void shield arrays petitioned the Lord Captain for aid. Compartments were becoming overrun with putrescent fungal corruption. The mycelium claimed one chamber after another. The thick black spores poisoned the Rogue Trader's servants, causing their eyes to burst and their veins to swell until their skin ruptured. The clan was issued reinforced unirobes and gas masks so they could keep working while the soldiers burned away the infestation.

d9b22711-3b80-4db1-8542-93b1ba9b83f4.Text: The warp released us from its embrace... For now.

ea73ebd8-7870-4458-8f08-e9c83582c975.Text: The enforcers from different decks of the von Valancius vessel report a terrifying sight: the skin of some crew members has become translucent, revealing knots of muscle and blood vessels beneath. Worse yet, small spider-like insects were seen scurrying inside of them, snow-white and sparkling like ice. The transformed could not see this phenomenon in themselves or anyone else, only occasionally complaining about a prickly feeling in their extremities. Some were branded as mutants and killed. The survivors reverted back after the vessel emerged in realspace.

353cdf76-ebd3-464d-98df-8c7c0dbb4567.Text: That night, the Lord Captain and some of {mf|his|her} crew were awakened by beautiful music. The sound seemed to caress their very minds... until they realised that the source was their own bodies. While their teeth were chattering out a staccato, their tendons were being plucked like strings by unseen hands, and invisible breaths flowed through their bones, turning them into mournful flutes. The illusion ended, but for a long time afterward, every movement made their hearts stutter in fear — was the orchestra about to strike up once more?

4890e945-ba83-4b42-82a9-3bf6a0d2f062.Text: By the God-Emperor's grace, no perils of the warp prevented the vessel from returning to realspace.

1af4c30c-72f1-410f-8beb-7bbf5f083bd2.Text: The engine decks were transformed into exotic gardens. Several chambers sprouted foliage vaguely resembling the plants on Terra, although they exhibited a glass-like surface polished to a mirror sheen. While reflections in the plants perfectly copied the surrounding objects, they did not show a single living being. Those who peered into them saw grotesque blood-covered creatures instead, not unlike bloated abyssal fish with a pair of clawed limbs, sometimes more. Unable to destroy the sinister growth, the voidsmen covered it with plasteel hoods until leaving the Immaterium, finally ridding the vessel of the corruption.

219f7df0-bf77-4c02-9faa-9462ef7813bb.Text: While travelling through the Immaterium, the crew on duty in Loading Bay 7 heard what sounded like the hissing of a giant snake. The terrified workers sent out a vox-message, then locked themselves in a shipping container and welded it shut. The response team sent to the bay found no signs of warp activity. Unfortunately, by the time they arrived, the workers had suffocated.

b6eab496-85bb-4a56-80c6-502979302ccf.Text: The ship left the hostile Immaterium and returned to realspace.

19df8188-e183-4167-9ef3-deb6173537bd.Text: The warp jump passed without incident for everyone except the crew members on bridge duty. For the duration of the voyage, they heard laughter — it seemed to come from outside, through the airtight seal of the ship's massive windows. The laughter went on and on.

2a7e3af2-3ec8-4cb9-a028-dbbd122e853d.Text: The duty officer reported an incident in the shuttle repair bay. A security team was dispatched in response to a distress signal, but when they arrived, they discovered that the shuttle repair crew had doubled in number. Somehow, every crew member now had an identical "twin," but each assured the enforcers that they were the real one. The enforcers immediately opened fire, killing everyone in the bay. The duty officer awarded the squad a commendation for their vigilance and efficiency.

0ba872c7-2aa3-44fb-843a-4cdc771a3e85.Text: It was discovered that one of the smaller vats in Engine Hall 5, which should have been filled with waste water, instead contained a liquid that looked like blood. This incident was deemed not to be of serious concern, and everything went back to normal as soon as the ship returned to realspace.

838e9027-2ac1-49ec-8782-fbe21a9649a5.Text: Acolytes of the Cult Mechanicus have reported a disturbing incident: all vox-systems on the middle decks started broadcasting otherworldly sounds, whistling a haunting melody. The strains of monstrous music drove people into a frenzied dance that could not be stopped. Several hours later the vox-devices fell silent, and the dancing crew members fell lifeless. The area was cleared and the bodies of the deceased were disposed of with the necessary precautions.

869fd459-39c0-46dd-bb0f-00570b13dcf1.Text: The steady rhythm of life aboard the vessel was disrupted when, on the fourth watch of the voyage, the lower decks... had their gravity reversed. The stunned denizens of the afflicted sectors were woken up by being torn from their assigned beds and tossed onto the ceiling. Numerous injuries and fatalities were reported. The difficulties in performing regular duties due to the gravity reversal continued until the end of the journey. After the ship exited the warp, the gravity returned to the accepted norm, an event that once again was accompanied by deaths and injuries among the crew.

5d883b05-360d-4078-939b-e1e0bb4c56e2.Text: During the warp journey, the augurs discovered a strange object that had been following the Rogue Trader's voidship for several hours. Judging by the distorted telemetry, it was a strangely shaped vessel of xeno-origin. The unidentified pursuer tried to approach the voidship several times, allowing the augurs to observe the shimmering energy sails unfurled among the shifting currents of the warp. The strange chase ended after the mysterious ship vanished in the depths of the Sea of Souls.

4a76f440-0101-4937-af7d-aa8ef363be35.Text: The tranquillity of the warp jump was disturbed by reports of frightening sounds and visions that descended upon the crew. Hundreds of people reported knocking and screaming behind the bulkheads of the void vessel, the sound of nails scratching against the hull and the elongated Aeldari-like shadows thrashing about the long passageways. The phenomena were most prominent in the far corner of the officer deck where the new Lord Captain's companion, named Yrliet, had made her home.

47b35b4a-2c7d-4824-a2e4-96cb428b6d01.Text: The warp jump went surprisingly smoothly. None of the deck officers on duty reported any incidents. However, a strange discovery awaited the Lord Captain when {mf|he|she} returned to {mf|his|her} quarters. The bed was unmade, and the impression of a head was still visible on the pillow. There were no other signs of intrusion. The guards swore under oath that nobody had entered Lord Captain's quarters.

c67812a3-e63a-4319-8662-f46ee392419f.Text: When the Lord Captain arrived on the bridge during the warp jump, {mf|he|she} found the on-duty officers in a state of utter confusion. They claimed they had been receiving orders from the bridge for several minutes, orders authorised by the Rogue Trader — but the Lord Captain had been absent. Curiously, the orders had been signed by the late Theodora von Valancius. After a thorough investigation, the Tech-Priests attributed the strange incident to the whims of the machine spirits.

2d489619-bd08-4b32-93f1-dcb7186502a4.Text: The warp jump was unusually hectic: the recent attack of the scrap-code disabled many of the sacred machines whose malfunctioning algorithms showed no sign of failure until the vessel departed realspace and surrendered itself to the Sea of Souls. Only the Navigator's talent and the tireless vigil of the Tech-Priests saved the voidship from ruin.

b0431e81-b484-49b4-b594-983faf994980.Text: During the period designated as the night shift, the air throughout the ship suddenly turned stale. Those who were awake reported feeling incredibly tired. Those who were asleep later reported having horrible nightmares.

40b99dcf-8b2d-40b9-977f-0718e4f39690.Text: Sister Argenta, one of the Lord Captain's personal retinue, was found in her cabin — pale, crying, and caught up in a waking dream. She didn't seem to notice anyone around her. Instead, she clutched a fragment of a burnt Aquila in her hand and kept calling for her mother. It took an hour to bring her round.

133b2b74-ea67-4a6e-9d58-620de72e8e2a.Text:
Seneschal Abelard Werserian was found in his quarters in a trance-like state. He was pacing the room and talking to an unseen interlocutor, asking the same questions over and over: "Why won't the fever break?" and "Does the esteemed chirurgeon have the faintest idea what he is doing?" Then he sat by the bed for a long time, clutching the sleeve of a void suit, and repeating, "Everything will be all right, son." With great difficulty, the enforcers managed to return the Seneschal to his senses.
By the order of Seneschal Werserian, the report on this incident has been erased from the ship's logs.

053e632b-6f49-43df-ae91-5a257f25193c.Text: The xenos Yrliet, one of the Lord Captain's personal retinue, was found delirious in one of the ship's bays. She was screaming in her unholy language, her arms raised high above her head, as if she was trying to keep the sky from falling. The enforcers were unable to free her from the trance. Two who attempted to move Yrliet were attacked and died instantly. The xenos regained awareness about ten hours later. She explained that she had seen her homeworld of Crudarach collapsing around her and she had been the only one able to hold up its walls. She added that no mon-keigh should ever touch her again without permission, and that, in the future, she would deal with the call of the warp on her own.

f80c0241-100c-4b5a-8c28-fb12f9465e8a.Text: The warp jump went smoothly enough, although many crew members reported strange incidents while they were asleep — they sensed someone approaching them and laying a hand on their forehead. Then the hand seemed to pass through their skin, through their skull, and with tender motions, sorted their jumbled thoughts into some sort of order.

bd176834-07ee-4cf5-b3d9-572225b54baa.Text: The Magos Pasqal noted that the mysterious incident had allowed him to "remember" a few highly obscure tech-rituals... which, it seemed, he had never studied in the first place.

8c8b6a5c-ebc6-482c-a2aa-4a83ff739bfe.Text: Everyone affected by the incident was horrified for a long time afterward. Resident psyker Idira Tlass, however, remarked with a grin that the "tidying up" had allowed her to dredge up a vital memory and find the left sock that had long been missing from her favourite pair.

4861ffda-5220-4d8f-bf2d-3ef347026853.Text: After the strange incident, Jae Heydari was uncharacteristically sombre for almost two watches and spent several hours in the ship's chapel praying.

2590b082-131a-4b40-8133-f4521d2e191e.Text: Strange phantoms drift through the crew's minds. The voidsmen discuss the fantastic visions that haunt their sleep and fill their dreams, the visions of a future that never was. A strange melancholy holds sway over the ship's company.

16104167-2828-4ba7-8c12-caaca61dd218.Text: Interrogator Heinrix van Calox did not leave his cabin for 24 hours, after which he went to the medicae facility for help, weakened by blood loss and exhaustion. There were open and bleeding wounds at his nape, neck, and back. A chirurgeon remarked that the location of the stigmata resembled the placement of neural connectors on the bodies of Imperial Knight pilots, and van Calox forcefully and most indecorously suggested the man keep his idle fantasies to himself.

6cf7f397-c2f1-490a-b68d-8c086935c6b4.Text: Jae Heydari spent several days in feverish excitement, bothering the crew with stories of some "heroic exploit that would make her name famous for centuries" and persistent demands that they "raise a glass for her new promotion." Before the officers could discern the reason for such agitation, the obsession left her. According to reports, Mistress Heydari has come to her senses and is stubbornly pretending the episode never happened in the first place.

87025305-111a-4608-985a-35fdaf664892.Text: Tradition dictates that whatever happens in the Navigator's Sanctum during a warp jump remains a mystery, but the transmissions from the esteemed Lady Orsellio during the assault of the phantoms frightened vox operators. According to them, Cassia's voice became unrecognisably clear and cheerful. One of the radio operators reported strange conversations in the Sanctum where the Lady Navigator chattered happily, suggested they "play in the garden," and giggled. Several hours later another operator claimed he heard a woman weep bitterly over the vox-channel.

0b8362ea-e3fd-4c69-ab57-e5cd8f2abe7d.Text: Enabling this setting allows you to view the results of skill tests in dialogues. When your character performs a skill action, you will see whether it was successful and its consequences for the storyline. This helps you make informed decisions in dialogues and control the outcome of the game.

When the setting is enabled, you will see the level of difficulty that the character needs to overcome when testing certain skills. This will help you better understand how successful your actions are.

6daecf61-09d9-4db4-ac42-cdd4c1a66c40.Text:
We, as developers, are always striving to improve our work. To this end, we need information that we can only get from you. By allowing sending the game statistics to us, you can help us learn more about the way you play, and what difficulties you encounter in our game.
Only our developers will have access to your game experience data and bug reports.

7b258f85-0d7f-45bc-bf39-e3d8c88c6a3b.Text: Allow the game to send the most recent saved game to the developers occasionally, but not more often than hourly. Thank you for keeping this option on! It helps us to address the game bugs and develop the fixes sooner rather than later.

293a6789-0970-44a5-a5db-f543a770fb90.Text: All collected game statistics are stored on our server. You can always view submitted game statistics by choosing "Show". Your statistics will open in your browser. You can remove your game statistics from our server at any time by choosing "Delete".

2a74df06-0190-47d5-9259-0b3355e32d6b.Text: You can select the main menu theme. "Latest" automatically sets the theme to the most up-to-date one, for example, from the newest DLC. "Original" sets the theme to the standard one from the base game.

cd88ab93-6150-43d5-899f-952f781336bd.Text: When this creature's wounds drop below 30%, they immediately attack their enemies with {g|f:8e4f8f5fc4164faa99faa577fa64082e}fyceline{/g}. On their next turns, all the creature's subsequent attacks will also be performed with {g|f:8e4f8f5fc4164faa99faa577fa64082e}fyceline{/g}.

c17608c2-3604-4145-8126-356e011d83e5.Text: Deals <u>(from 20 to 40)</u> {g|Encyclopedia:EnergyDamage}energy damage{/g} with 10% {g|Encyclopedia:ArmourPenetration}armour penetration{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:PushGlossary}pushes{/g} targets 3 cells away.

f9399e1c-9e9d-463f-9f95-a80ff8d6697d.Text: The Undying Emperor unleashes a wave of fire, which moves toward the target and deals an enormous amount of fire and rending damage to all enemies in its path. This damage is equally divided between all affected targets. Each target suffers +2 stacks of {g|f:4fe436747a7849759de6b83cdc774b7e}bloodstained{/g}, and the Undying Emperor gains +2 stacks of {g|f:437c7a78578c4bbeab1e85ea4a76df7d}bloodblessed{/g}. Special: if the affected target suffers from {g|Encyclopedia:BurningEffect}burning{/g}, the fire wave inflicts {g|Encyclopedia:SlowedEffect}slowed{/g} on it for 1 round and +2 stacks of {g|f:26bad8fff4f24e6b8558340eb509c6cf}fading soul{/g} until the end of combat.

929a86cb-9e9b-4132-8ff9-dca45f69f95e.Text: The Undying Emperor deals rending damage to all enemies within a wide area and inflicts +2 stacks of {g|f:4fe436747a7849759de6b83cdc774b7e}bloodstained{/g} on every affected target. Additionally, he gains +2 stacks of {g|f:437c7a78578c4bbeab1e85ea4a76df7d}bloodblessed{/g}. Special: if the target has the {g|f:26bad8fff4f24e6b8558340eb509c6cf}fading soul{/g} effect, it suffers the same number of {g|f:5856ae1c9ea04369bddd4ee3eec32b3d}shattered{/g} stacks until the end of combat.

e51d7839-42ff-4601-a7df-c394c693b751.Text: "Do you truly believe that you can defeat me?"

089756a6-7d4b-41e9-92fe-5cd4089766e4.Text: The Undying Emperor's wounds are unknown.

6e5c82fb-0a0b-4ebb-8da5-3e5f7f46416d.Text: The Undying Emperor deals rending damage to the target and removes all the stacks of {g|f:437c7a78578c4bbeab1e85ea4a76df7d}bloodblessed{/g} and {g|f:4fe436747a7849759de6b83cdc774b7e}bloodstained{/g} from it. If the target has less than 50% wounds, it must pass a Toughness resistance test with a −50 penalty or immediately die. Special: a target with 3 or more stacks of {g|f:26bad8fff4f24e6b8558340eb509c6cf}fading soul{/g} or 3 or more stacks of {g|f:4fe436747a7849759de6b83cdc774b7e}bloodstained{/g} must pass that test if it has less than 90% wounds.

5a481e26-9b12-41cb-99b8-0c3ce685a0b4.Text:
Whenever the Undying Emperor's enemy ends their turn, supernatural powers grant him an extra turn. During every extra turn, he uses a single ability in accordance with the current phase.
-<indent=5%>{g|f:f03fb2a6d17f452899a8310ed41704e2}Death, Oblivion{/g} phase: {g|f:fdb7ad9f95224672af0853c2fe3a48de}Liturgy of Death{/g} or {g|f:08b50f3e19c240759b8f7bc57ca1758c}Visions of Death{/g}</indent>
-<indent=5%>{g|f:3d4f32cb26d44ef4aa5b7edf3b5eab2a}Death, Ashes{/g} phase: {g|f:fa98d892a6404f91af19e542d1b2fbb3}Searing Pyres{/g} or {g|f:7ecf42ea9ffb4231bb797f166b2694e5}Flames of Unlife{/g}</indent>
-<indent=5%>{g|f:997d8f1503e442ef906c58f1299037e2}Death, Agony{/g} phase: {g|f:f86ec5197f324351a2f62468a05a5a4b}Colossal Cleave{/g} or {g|f:c449c4181a484879913d0c31c8618ed8}Death Whispered Your Name{/g}</indent>
The order of phases remains unchanged. A new phase starts right after the Undying Emperor ends his turn. When a phase starts for the first time in combat, a random ability of the two available is used. Otherwise, the Undying Emperor uses an ability different from the one he used in the same phase previously.

26f0acf4-052c-4601-af84-cc1e87c9ffe3.Text: The Undying Emperor's armour cannot be reduced below 50%.

e407ded3-7eaa-4e21-bdba-29ddc6ded262.Text: All characteristics are reduced by −5. Stacks.

148ce9b6-59db-4f01-aaa0-8317818af50e.Text: The Undying Emperor deals mental damage to the target. That target must pass a Willpower resistance test with a −50 penalty or suffer the {g|f:eda0a061c09a4ea090998a9c117b05cd}lethargy{/g} effect for 2 rounds. Special: if the target has less than 50% wounds, it gains temporary wounds equal to 50% of its maximum wounds.

fd91f129-401b-48a4-9ae9-0d588eb27e8c.Text: This creature skips its next turn. If it suffers damage and loses non-temporary wounds, this effect is removed.

2ecc0da8-11cb-4372-bbdb-548f6ea22ecf.Text: The Undying Emperor deals mental damage to all enemies in the area and removes all their stacks of {g|f:437c7a78578c4bbeab1e85ea4a76df7d}bloodblessed{/g} and {g|f:4fe436747a7849759de6b83cdc774b7e}bloodstained{/g}. The targets have to pass a Willpower resistance test with a −20 penalty or suffer even more mental damage and the {g|Encyclopedia:FatiguedEffect}fatigued{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:DisturbedEffect}disturbed{/g}, or {g|Encyclopedia:PerplexedEffect}perplexed{/g} effect for 3 rounds. The effect is selected randomly. Note: if the main target occupies a single cell, that target is not affected by this ability. Special: the Undying Emperor inflicts +1 stack of {g|f:26bad8fff4f24e6b8558340eb509c6cf}fading soul{/g} on each target for each stack of {g|f:437c7a78578c4bbeab1e85ea4a76df7d}bloodblessed{/g} or {g|f:4fe436747a7849759de6b83cdc774b7e}bloodstained{/g} removed from that target.

a9a680a6-0c84-4ff5-891e-c9d69bb7fa59.Text: The Undying Emperor uses the {g|f:f86ec5197f324351a2f62468a05a5a4b}Colossal Cleave{/g} or {g|f:c449c4181a484879913d0c31c8618ed8}Death Whispered Your Name{/g} ability, targeting the closest enemy. If there are multiple possible targets, out of these, he will target the one with the lowest percentage of wounds. If there are still multiple possible targets, one will be selected randomly among them.

6b8dcfeb-64e4-4325-b885-d90b26e34e30.Text: The Undying Emperor uses the {g|f:fa98d892a6404f91af19e542d1b2fbb3}Searing Pyres{/g} or {g|f:7ecf42ea9ffb4231bb797f166b2694e5}Flames of Unlife{/g} ability against the enemy that dealt the largest amount of damage to him.

c0f5083f-2d78-4890-a12e-99a1e5258639.Text: The Undying Emperor uses the {g|f:08b50f3e19c240759b8f7bc57ca1758c}Visions of Death{/g} or {g|f:fdb7ad9f95224672af0853c2fe3a48de}Liturgy of Death{/g} ability, targeting the furthest enemy. If there are multiple possible targets, out of these, he will target the one with the highest percentage of wounds. If there are still multiple possible targets, one will be selected randomly among them.

70f8fc70-08b9-49d1-996c-48c0064216f3.Text: The Undying Emperor teleports the target to a cell adjacent to him. After that, he deals fire and rending damage to all enemies within a small radius around that target and removes all stacks of {g|f:437c7a78578c4bbeab1e85ea4a76df7d}bloodblessed{/g} and {g|f:4fe436747a7849759de6b83cdc774b7e}bloodstained{/g} from them. These targets must pass an Agility resistance test with a −40 penalty or suffer even more damage and be knocked {g|Encyclopedia:ProneEffect}prone{/g} for 1 round. Additionally, these targets must pass a Toughness resistance test with a −40 penalty or suffer {g|Encyclopedia:BurningEffect}burning{/g} (15) until the end of combat. Special: if the target has more than 90% wounds, it suffers +2 stacks of {g|f:26bad8fff4f24e6b8558340eb509c6cf}fading soul{/g} and becomes {g|Encyclopedia:BlindedEffect}blinded{/g} for 1 round.

8889a281-20b0-467e-8c1c-c10de96f4e7c.Text: The Undying Emperor will reduce the damage of the next successful attack against him by −100%, also dealing a small amount of mental damage to the attacker.

5d873170-a217-4365-ae4b-083e9b7ec80a.Text: At the start of his turn, the Undying Emperor gains the {g|f:ac6c6f5240d141bf82db7f5ca7deb390}soul depulsion{/g} effect.

8760d6e4-9f11-4d65-83df-6cc635ebe9b7.Text: The Undying Emperor can move through enemies.

99f9d53e-82ff-42eb-8059-a1874f4c9df4.Text: Grants +<u>(from 2 to 4)</u> {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} and +2% {g|Encyclopedia:ArmourPenetration}armour penetration{/g} per stack. Stacks up to 3 times.

d5116eca-5bd0-4b4e-8db2-17009608b215.Text: Grants the Wych +<u>(from 3 to 8)</u> {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} and +3% {g|Encyclopedia:ArmourPenetration}armour penetration{/g} for 3 {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turns{/g}.

3e15787d-166c-4517-bc09-7b375eeabd38.Text: Reduces the target's {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} by −10 upon a failed {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g}.

e7f14741-81b0-4952-9b5d-702b08a8ee4a.Text: Transforms a cultist into a Chaos spawn once per {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.

db1b5bfb-7598-404a-9ea0-0916a81ce15c.Text: The creature affected by this {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} becomes a Chaos Spawn.

25d4f99b-9ace-4899-98e7-ae6978687a0f.Text: Nemesite's allies gain a +5 {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to all their {g|Encyclopedia:Characteristic}characteristics{/g} until the end of combat. Stacks.

166a158b-4387-4612-85de-b312a1cff7d5.Text: Whenever Nemesite's ally is killed by an enemy, as soon as that enemy's {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} ends, Nemesite immediately attacks that enemy and grants his allies a +5 {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to all their {g|Encyclopedia:Characteristic}characteristics{/g} until the end of combat. Stacks.

57be9659-e43b-43ca-85de-f6ddedf457d1.Text: Any {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} dealt to Nemesite is reduced by −5% for each of his living allies.

5f1d99c0-d4d0-4888-8ccf-11a7875a8ecc.Text: On {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g}, this weapon inflicts +3 stacks of the {g|f:ac9bf532d765438299412b2158ce8953}melting{/g} effect for 2 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rounds{/g}. The wielder can perform {g|Encyclopedia:DeadeyeShot}deadeye shots{/g} with this weapon. It is considered a sniper rifle.

6f559a2c-ce92-4ed2-a14d-b72dde6c8540.Text: Targets {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} with this weapon must pass a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a −30 penalty or suffer {g|f:4755bff66f544cf7bd9f5be37dad08db}cannot attack{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.

baa830e7-3703-4a3e-be52-fb03380cc4fa.Text: This weapon deals +3% damage for each 1% of the target's missing {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}.

48082d94-b299-418b-9e15-ceeec4c3406b.Text: When the wielder deals damage with this weapon, they suffer {g|Encyclopedia:DirectDamage}direct damage{/g} equal to 10% of the damage dealt.

44f7f3a8-7172-4dd5-bdc7-98ebc236ef71.Text:
Death Cult weapon gains the following:
-<indent=5%>−{uip|Parry|ed0e0de8990b41f7b4fdc6683a55f6f2}% to the target's {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g}</indent>
-<indent=5%>+{uip|Crit|ed0e0de8990b41f7b4fdc6683a55f6f2}% to the wielder's critical hit chance for each attack they make. This bonus stacks until the end of each {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.</indent>

a4349f68-c595-4a4b-9bae-296bd89f8ddb.Text: Each attack with this heavy rock saw performs several strikes. If the first strike hits the target, all subsequent strikes automatically hit. If the first strike is dodged or parried, all subsequent strikes are automatically dodged or parried.

9b8473f4-5656-47cd-ab66-b25d42f9e295.Text: All the {g|Encyclopedia:SingleRangedAttacksGlossary}single-shot{/g} attacks with this bolt pistol gain +50% to {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} until the end of combat.

c353ab92-e762-4a98-b23e-991ac19b3270.Text: {g|Encyclopedia:BurstAttacksGlossary}Burst{/g} attacks with this bolt pistol cost +1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} more. After firing a burst attack, {g|Encyclopedia:SingleRangedAttacksGlossary}single-shot{/g} attacks with this bolt pistol gain +50% to {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} until the end of combat. This effect stacks.

39fcc1a1-e306-4c14-a7f9-0ccf1dc215de.Text: Using the {g|f:d42db343de7e4b08a3ea0d7bc36af41f}Rapid Fire{/g} ability increases this weapon's {g|Encyclopedia:RateOfFire}rate of fire{/g} by +17.

bdb14bd0-dfb8-434f-8b90-7f5e095d2b06.Text: Permanent −5 penalty to Willpower resistance tests.

811274c2-f8e8-4cba-90e9-9f54a617d45e.Text: Permanent +2 bonus to Weapon Skill and +5 bonus to Coercion.

201e887c-d530-48c7-bbda-2238131dc255.Text: The symbols on the screen are distorted as if they were smudged by an invisible hand.

1be357ce-4a15-48b8-8ceb-07423931d44e.Text: To the Spire of the Reaving Tempest

a77ac89f-594c-448a-a8d2-47a3a7938213.Text: To the Spire of the Reaving Tempest

5150e1f1-97aa-4fea-aa42-eac9edc4efe3.Text: Damage dealt is reduced by −40%. Incoming damage is increased by +25%. Shield strength is reduced to 0.

74c562a7-7937-464f-8aaf-7b3adca42186.Text: This vessel is focused on chasing down transport ships.

3dad1702-b46e-4eb2-ab3a-fe25f20c70ee.Text: In this zone, transport ships can safely make a warp jump.

70626657-87c8-4d0e-9d6e-ea0c1d718fce.Text: "The sanctity of the monastery of the Motive Force has been violated, but the vows of the Omnissiah have triumphed. In the gift of Technology do we find strength."

abfee042-a167-44bc-a3c0-037b320aebb9.Text: "Metal will not protect you from the Archenemy's corruption. Ensure that your colleagues are thorough in their inspections."

16967dcc-2319-41c1-8ed4-edab94edd4e9.Text: "The Electro-Priests of the Cenobium have shown unprecedented courage in the face of heresy. Worthy children of the Omnissiah!"

831894e0-7266-4662-9a62-a1390b922440.Text: "The Undying One sent us in response to the priests' prayers. They must keep their vows, and we must shed the blood of heretics. Let His design be fulfilled."

b04ae8c1-3a20-46f9-87a3-673d49d015c1.Text: "While the Omnissiah's servants remain strong and the faith of the Electro-Priests of the Cenobium remains unwavering, corruption will dare not touch this place again."

529b8a66-2c5a-4b3b-a82a-e67e4c2e8f96.Text: "Your speeches shine with gold and amber, Sister. Someday I will learn to believe in the rectitude of my words as strongly as you do yours."

c8a4f5cf-f368-4836-a787-71de9414bf7c.Text: "Strength and faith didn't help them when push came to shove. I'd like to think they'll respond to this calamity by doing something other than praying and genuflecting, but who am I kidding?"

4b5a451c-010d-4ea3-9a9d-985f98958a1f.Text: "Lord Winterscale had so much faith in his friend that he willingly rushed headlong into danger! An honourable act."

dd80eab7-1154-42a9-818a-74d434084d2f.Text: "Oh, Lady Cassia, you should not think such conduct is in any way honourable... Youth paints for itself a pretty picture of the world, but the reality is far more complex."

45c656ab-a788-4b34-8c3c-962c1c16d28b.Text: "I would use a word with fewer letters to describe his act... but I do not wish to swear in your presence."

f0e0423e-38f5-4c0a-afd9-f525e3483b27.Text: "Evayne's act was noble but foolhardy. You cannot save someone who has willingly succumbed to heresy."

05e3b894-5e97-4fcb-a0b4-4cc7c195b87b.Text: "At least he tried to get through to his friend instead of just blowing his brains out on sight. Oh wait, I forgot who I'm talking to."

a65b47d7-ac5d-4aa2-84d8-793d893ce460.Text: "You have a highly unusual retinue, Rogue Trader. It is hardly surprising given your status, but still."

420f1e20-2fd4-4620-b727-6b5c1475d0b8.Text: "I... do not mind accompanying the Lord Captain. Experiencing the outside world is an invaluable experience denied to those of us who fear to leave the walls of the Sanctum Navis."

334b80fc-81bb-4ee1-ad8a-e34d9e8d2995.Text: "It's got even more, ahem, unusual since you showed up. When did you say you'd be leaving us, by the way?"

ec87cf0c-0766-448a-b53b-4fbbda6cd41d.Text: "We must ensure that all airlocks are in full working order... and we need to test the robustness of the crew passcode system..."

6e76a389-32ff-4b99-a735-066f53ebb6ad.Text: "Heh. Fat lot of good that will do. When the flames are licking at their feet, it won't be long before all the passwords come spilling out of them."

bd5759cc-09d2-4e08-866c-ab1fd293e0e3.Text: "I assure you, First Officer Werserian, if I need to inspect anything, I will not go about picking locks — I will ask you to personally escort me."

e1f64b8b-8b60-46ee-a534-e7c928e96fad.Text: "I can barely understand cogs when they talk. But it seems I'm going to have plenty of opportunities to bone up on my translation skills!"

c3510fb1-1239-43e4-a995-2c742b4dc324.Text: "When the Truth is comprehended, let it be sheltered from the profane mind and ring out in binharic purity."

5dc74c4a-9445-43a2-9696-869471d206a9.Text: "True believers will find common ground — if not in words, then in a shared desire to cleanse this world of corruption!"

9aaf0790-9138-4b14-885c-6b81a3d12659.Text: "The Cognisance Fleet and the von Valancius dynasty are bound by a series of mutually beneficial agreements. This unit is pleased to foster a productive connection based on our joint efforts in heretic eradication."

e6abcc3f-b034-484c-bd6c-092d8c01b411.Text: "Your presence among us is a supreme blessing. It is a sign of the Omnissiah's benevolence toward the von Valancius dynasty, for He has sent us His own shepherd!"

8d9ee5aa-8aab-4067-acd2-6170ba15c092.Text: "The colours swirling around you are full of steel hues and flashes of crimson ribbons, esteemed Magos. We had Tech-Priests on my House's station as well, but the colours of their souls were always dreary."

de35f8c9-cfc1-4091-b2d6-aca59340de42.Text: "Governor Medineh believes he has everything under control. Hmm. I am not so certain."

3f7ab2c4-bb79-4272-8911-37e6979089f4.Text: "What gives you that idea? Is it his selective blindness or his obvious attempts to sugarcoat the situation?"

0ec02b46-9fea-4a54-b0f7-1584ff220316.Text: "The unit is making inferences from available information that contains erroneous data. The result is... contaminated."

0f812f20-f28d-4985-9cec-2851b1748efd.Text: "A planet-wide revolt... How could a heretic uprising of this magnitude be allowed to happen? Is Rykad completely devoid of any faithful citizens who could have foreseen this and raised the alarm?"

f24ac15c-03ad-46b4-b909-05e08bc09ffb.Text: "If everyone were endowed with the gift of seeing the world as I do, such a thing would never happen. But the eyes of ordinary people are blind to the hues that lurk in other people's souls."

eb34a7a9-3d81-4f11-9807-2c2200bb7d5e.Text: "It all comes down to sycophancy. Sycophancy and cowardice. It is often the messengers who are first in line for the gallows — and no one is ever in a hurry to join that queue."

26229c9b-3a23-4a20-98b9-f25fc5093ae5.Text: "This is my first time outside the station... It's so... bright here. Instead of a palette, it is a horrible smear of colours."

26fa51fd-62be-451f-9e5b-baae14a42688.Text: "An interesting interpretation of reality. However, if we read your words as a metaphor, it is quite accurate."

f981e904-47a6-4d20-af39-415b79a79355.Text: "Yeah. It's also very noisy. But you wouldn't understand that, Cass. Lucky for you."

13a425ee-570a-49cf-af06-dcd24cbbf027.Text: "Shouldn't the Rogue Trader's retinue be larger? Where is the honour guard? The heralds and standard-bearers?"

25effa89-dad5-43f2-a277-4fe85db28541.Text: "Relax, Lady Cassia, there are enough present here to keep you safe from the evil designs of others."

76ebe4e1-f8f1-4dc4-9267-9cdcd47b6cee.Text: "Is something troubling you, Cassia? Fear not — I will protect you from any heretic who dares to trespass against those who see His light!"

79e7e5f4-603b-43bd-90d6-eb49afe0e648.Text: "Now that we have the Navis Nobilite child with us, that is one less problem for us to solve. I cannot help but be pleased about that."

ef92356a-e1be-4764-91da-2ec8b15db479.Text: "I will fulfil the duty for which I have been training all these years, even though my appointment took place under a banner of crimson tones."

581d81ce-5fb1-45ab-ae48-4ce519ebe485.Text: "Mmmhmm. I just hope the crew will stop flying into a tizzy every time Cass deigns to walk across the bridge."

be5dfdfa-7ea0-498b-9000-42f29106dc2e.Text: "I hope House Orsellio will survive this heavy blow. Losing a station and many servants all at once is a difficult trial."

08ce1dd3-0726-4b69-ac9a-09473498e2e5.Text: "The station can be rebuilt. Servants can be... replaced. It is only my life that matters to those who await my return... and those who wish to see me dead."

f04c5f62-60df-4fda-a84c-de42818e58d6.Text: "I pray for the souls of the innocent. And that the souls of the guilty may not find peace."

fc290fef-df3e-4eef-884d-ed411f187c19.Text: "The station that nurtured the Navigator is dead. The Domin's flagship is now your home, and there is no way back."

8464ed5e-02fe-4313-be59-6651bbf90f91.Text: "How strange. Your words are bleak, but I can see a glimmer of joy in your soul. Is this how you bid me welcome?"

1517b931-03ae-4d3b-b695-617604acb9d9.Text: "I am certain that Mistress Kibellah, like any voidborn, is concerned for the well-being of her vessel and is pleased that the flagship has found a Navigator."

fa9b2f18-488d-4ad0-b9e0-831c81475739.Text: "Uprisings of the laity are the revolt of suboptimal instincts and desires against a predefined structure. This event is the result of insufficient servitorisation of the crew."

70bed7c5-7eb7-4d53-bc43-ac14820acfd1.Text: "Hmm. I can understand your view, but lobotomising the entire crew is a costly and ultimately unjustifiable undertaking. As long as the traditional methods serve us well enough, things should continue as they are."

8f35cecc-a458-48eb-9761-fd96a83422df.Text: "Replacing all humans with servitors is something only a major forge world could implement. The rest of us have to make do with human frailties."

c6204a1b-f91f-401d-a0cd-3ab8d62717cc.Text: "About those folk from the lower decks... I think the enforcers went overboard. You can't keep people ground down all the time — even if they don't kick up a fuss, they'll definitely go crazy."

ab11570e-b06b-48c6-a4f9-1a6d0d4f1fe8.Text: "Since when have you taken any interest in my work, Idira? I was operating under a charter that was passed many years ago and approved by Lady Theodora — I don't suppose you would dispute her judgement?"

ea2c38ad-22ca-4941-b6a5-12c9de5111df.Text: "I pity the weak and innocent who have fallen victim to the misdoings of others... It is better to fight on the front lines than to make the kind of decisions that fall to the Seneschal."

263d6d56-b8a7-438d-8de8-07c56ce63716.Text: "The Archenemy's forces are already engulfing this world. We have very little time."

76f08a3c-99be-4dc3-bf16-39c840948769.Text: "The sooner... we get... out... of here... the... better."

5f21123b-6011-4607-a68b-d17ace412396.Text: "The colours... I've never seen colours like this... They're changing, flowing into each other... Ah! My retinas! They're... burning..."

fed0508c-d9bc-4224-8bda-a835aaefc633.Text: "Primary priority: evacuation of the Rogue Trader from the planet. Secondary priority: survival of the retinue. Activating calculated self-sacrifice protocol."

6f01795a-5c78-4a4b-93fb-a808a4f5dabf.Text: "The denser the darkness, the brighter the fire in our hearts! We must unite in the face of calamity!"

f763c595-2b74-424a-b0b5-25664aa76380.Text: "The lack of communication with the flagship is making me uneasy... I hope the starport will hold until we arrive."

c0cc3a4f-8fe7-44ef-ac73-dd0a0aa7dbc2.Text: "The crew continues to mourn Lady Theodora. I fear it may affect the performance of their duties in service of the Lord Captain."

8ae9f822-51d3-4950-9b30-d35f3c7d48be.Text: "Let the people grieve. Lady Theodora was with us so long that we started to believe she was immortal."

9eb8f8c1-9514-4336-833e-8a14f24b0345.Text: "In His service will they find strength and fortitude. Only thus will they turn their hearts away from the frailties that lead to heresies."

75ef5a0a-e303-42c6-af3c-e924fcd5dd44.Text: "Damned warp... If we'd been in realspace, I'd have heard... I'd have..."

08619d30-e5c3-49c8-b2a4-d65425926fd4.Text: "Idira... stop castigating yourself. Your soothsayings have always been... vague. Even if you had heard — who among us would have realised that it was Lady Theodora who was in peril?"

f41f1513-7283-4993-93ea-ab03f38212db.Text: "Spare me your wailing, witch — every voice that sounds in your mind is a whisper of the Archenemy!"

e63c3abb-b0c8-4b75-9c37-c53bee62abcc.Text: "Thanks to Sister Argenta's efforts, the streets of Footfall are now a little cleaner. Destroying a cult cell is a worthy accomplishment."

6305c0de-c15c-4e85-af79-f64e1be8aea3.Text: "I am wherever there is need for His wrath, which scorches the wicked, casts out the profane, and purifies His servants' doleful fate."

aec25321-4bdc-4f64-9b1f-7fec22501d3f.Text: "Yes, yes, it is a commendable deed... But, knowing Footfall, it is unlikely that a place cleansed of heresy will remain empty for long. This station attracts foulness like... ahem, you understand."

8b781019-40ec-4497-97ed-fa71e055efb1.Text: "Praying before the Sacred Warrant has imbued me with the determination to fulfil my mission... With the support of the Rogue Trader, I will wrest the relic from the heretics' clutches!"

be7b60e8-d2bf-424c-8cba-76b004d2682d.Text: "Your resolve gleams with every shade of gold, Sister! Your words blaze like a fire, and your faith in what you say is unshakeable... I can barely behold it without squinting."

8bb03f79-2f79-444c-bc18-eae4fb3dd756.Text: "You've seen it? The Sacred Warrant? Oh, if only I could lay my eyes on it! Or even just one eye! But I doubt my shereen the Rogue Trader offers regular tours to anyone who asks..."

2c1ce97e-f038-498b-a927-8f76557ba843.Text: "Hey, Adepta Sanctimonious... How come that heretic recognised you, hmm? You know, the one we pinned down in that stinking lair? Strange friends you've got, that's all I have to say."

e4405175-456c-4924-a85a-2579531a03eb.Text: "Why did he recognise my face, witch? I should think because he has seen it often in his nightmares. I hope you see it too."

27ce8995-9c7c-4f96-967f-90a6ea5a4cd9.Text: "You have fallen for an old trick of the servants of Chaos. Heretics often try to confuse the minds of the righteous when they are facing death. However, such a crude ploy would hardly work on Sister Argenta."

6e9fc427-8167-48b1-9665-9069b123c478.Text: "You are surrounded by unbearably heavy colours, Master van Calox... It is as if they have been dredged up from a deep, forgotten well. It's... because of the Black Ship, isn't it?"

1e40891e-d92f-479c-8d03-91f615cb333e.Text: "I would rather not discuss my emotional state, especially as concerns that... place."

ae9091e3-ae9b-4678-b349-1a7394c200bd.Text: "Iceman doesn't seem too eager to talk about it, and I suppose I don't want to think about it a second longer than I have to either."

38b36a3b-dfc5-46bd-898f-21916226b757.Text: "The corruption soaked into the bones of the lost ship may have imprinted itself on the souls of your servants, elantach. I hope they were thorough when they performed the cleansing rituals."

b35e644a-cf7d-4fa0-8c3f-7ff0866f0e00.Text: "Hmm. One of the shuttle pilots died by suicide shortly after that flight. His body has long since been incinerated, though, so there is nothing to worry about."

1a82b338-302c-4a71-a6b7-bb639236bf35.Text: "How strange to hear a xenos speak of corruption. We wage an implacable war against this foulness, and you, a tainted creature, fear it too."

50e4e22a-f76d-4099-b942-8316da5165c0.Text: "A trap on a frozen world — a cruel snare for unsuspecting victims. The innocent souls drawn in by the signal paid for their kindness with their lives."

16efc384-abbb-4b0a-9e9d-a12cdc2c0eaa.Text: "I fell into a similar trap once — my rivals lured me to a signal from my dead crew... Kaskha! I made sure those worthless pirates paid for what they did to my boys."

f9f84755-31a6-4c16-97da-55fea6689751.Text: "Cass's relatives certainly kicked up a fuss at the palace... An assassination attempt right at the Rogue Trader's reception — crazy!"

7c26649b-a186-401a-979b-0a659bed5049.Text: "House Orsellio... has caused unnecessary trouble for the Lord Captain. By continuing to serve on the von Valancius flagship, I will atone for this regrettable error."

5298b0c5-ae0e-40a0-bf7a-6e8548fbe544.Text: "It is not my place to comment on the doings of the Navis Nobilite... I will only say that I hope their next visit will not result in the same hefty bill for repairs and enforcer replacements."

d42726dd-e7ed-4ddd-95ca-c7309bf7103c.Text: "I am consumed by thoughts of the future of House Orsellio. Years of hatred and distrust... have led to bloodshed again and again."

310d512f-14ee-4247-91c5-4b3531ceac90.Text: "You tread a perilous path that leads beyond the veil. To fight forces that cannot be tamed. Whatever strife may plague your kin... their fate is unenviable."

42d91e39-4c96-408b-8a5f-d95b2ff882d1.Text: "Yeah, Cass, I don't want to scare you... but when I think about you, I hear laughter. Laughter far more ancient than Humanity itself... laughter that sends a chill down my spine. I don't think it's someone laughing with us — more like at us."

31b27def-1e29-489b-87af-c3409da1cd8f.Text: "An internal conflict in a Navis Nobilite House... A regrettable situation that could lead to many problems in the future."

d1d496f2-47ea-4993-a6c0-d3ea7a973d45.Text: "Discord cannot be allowed to take root among the Navigators, who perceive the golden light through the veil of darkness and insanity! Their grand mission must surely inoculate them against such base impulses, must it not?"

ad776899-9a20-4a85-8b66-141a1fce78de.Text: "Not only problems in the future, but casualties in the present — as the Lord Captain has, alas, already had the misfortune of seeing for {mf|himself|herself}."

f665cda5-4379-48ba-b39e-9e5f0e29d233.Text: "We've been out of the Rykad System for a while now, and my mind is still ringing with what I heard before we jumped... It's scary to even think about what's going on there now."

02f20101-0dcc-4aa4-8144-16fb1eb68a9f.Text: "When the time comes, we will stand as an indestructible wall against the corruption that has engulfed this world. We will not give the Archenemy another inch!"

54e0ffb7-1995-4201-8ecb-d936369527ed.Text: "My entire life was lost in the nightmare of the Immaterium in a matter of seconds. It's... not something that one can comprehend and accept in such a short time."

8133efbf-de76-4a9a-ab6e-7444538631a2.Text: "Analysis recommends that the systems of the Expanse prepare for imminent clashes with the forces now dominating Rykad Minoris. Probability of a large-scale confrontation currently stands at 86%."

4d0733ff-e873-499b-9174-dbfd4c665b82.Text: "None of this is going to lead to anything good... We have enough troubles without this anathema appearing under our noses."

588cbbd9-9dc2-49ec-97ba-17210d2b8fd6.Text: "The loss of the sector is a catastrophe. There are no forces in the Koronus Expanse capable of opposing whatever may emerge now from the Rykad System."

f05eb6f5-ae85-4352-9c8a-56e74261d8c1.Text: "Dargonus was attacked by xenos but stood strong! Is this not a sign that the God-Emperor protects His faithful?"

91712f8f-a573-4fc7-a73e-d541554fb70a.Text: "It's a sign that the defence of Dargonus was organised relatively effectively. A Drukhari raid is a gruelling test for any world to endure."

6377a535-3e5d-4e61-8621-81b867970129.Text: "But what happened in the streets of the hives... Oh, the scarlet-blue scars will not soon be erased from the souls of those who lived through this nightmare."

00c49f5a-d579-45b3-ae6c-b7251b9539a4.Text: "This is the first time I have witnessed the Dark Ones raiding at close quarters... It is a wonder that your world survived it, elantach."

0985daa6-e150-418b-976b-547de38adad5.Text: "Is that respect for your kin I hear in your voice? Careful, my pointy-eared friend, my shereen won't like you showing admiration for them, if that is what it was."

7ed19915-fe28-4ad9-afdc-b3ddc9885286.Text: "Dargonus's preparedness for a confrontation scenario has been deemed satisfactory. The peasant population accounted for the overwhelming majority of losses: peasants can easily be replaced. Vital production facilities suffered minimal damage."

6a187f00-67ae-4c5e-b375-a76d96dc3cb4.Text: "I can't stop thinking about the governor of Dargonus. Why wasn't he there when they stormed the Rogue Trader's palace?"

03897747-366f-484d-b0fa-60722cb94e78.Text: "When disaster comes knocking, a businessman's only concern is for his own property. The governor is a businessman, after all, albeit one dressed in the garb of a servant of the Imperium."

f99d97b0-ad48-4383-8008-f4371e25825d.Text: "The official reason is that he failed to reach the palace in time because of attacks happening elsewhere. I have my own theories, but I suppose I had better keep them to myself."

c5a4e747-9001-459a-b2f6-159f5a1a0448.Text: "Navigator Hann is a noble soul. It is frightening to imagine the ordeal his spirit underwent on that ill-fated voyage... And still he did his duty."

e73f2378-756e-4a87-97c8-9fed863d45c6.Text: "Not only did he survive, he rallied people around him and fought back against those whose souls had fallen to the Archenemy! Truly, a Navigator of outstanding talent!"

b60df201-3610-42d2-b4a0-bb64c5835388.Text: "The tenacity displayed by the unit in the execution of his obligations can be partly explained by his deficient sense of duty — the superior response would be to independently discontinue life functions."

63eba222-3a4b-4421-ab39-c88974528c00.Text: "Cursed be the day that Kunrad entered Lady Theodora's service... Now, because of him, Dargonus has lost a ship along with its entire crew!"

79adfaff-2022-40b3-99ea-5d550cdd4666.Text: "I tremble with rage to remember that this heretic sought to encroach upon the Sacred Warrant! The day we put him to death will be a red letter day for me."

a327456c-8249-43f6-8f03-68e66878922b.Text: "And he is still at large and free to act as he pleases. If I were you, Abelard, I would see to it that no more von Valancius subjects are kept ignorant of his treachery."

b06235e9-a9d8-4776-a2c1-e7d86e1081e8.Text: "The sacred Exterminatus... I saw it for the first time in all its fiery majesty..."

9de5eaf0-f1a3-451f-9700-9567b57f3a90.Text: "An awesome sight to behold. Like a giant brush wiping all the colours of the world from the canvas of reality."

7dcdc248-3fe4-4baa-84ce-124f2a525052.Text: "It makes me sick to think how many innocents died in agony — and you marvel at it!"

da885968-b95f-46ca-9b59-535e357c311b.Text: "To behold the death of a world was akin to a revelation. I give thanks to the Undying One for the chance to bear witness."

d4e8aec8-9cc3-444e-8c18-cef5f101291f.Text: "The fall of Rykad Minoris is a blow to all of the Expanse. I imagine Winterscale will be enraged when he finds out."

5ec7b887-4de2-48a1-9204-d678fad4a199.Text: "This statement is false. The specified unit has experienced a long service life and observed many planetary catastrophes. Their statistical significance is negligible on a sectoral scale. The statement is tainted by the emotional burden of grief."

2e5a05e7-c40f-4798-b044-c927dd949704.Text: "I nurtured a spark of hope that Eurac V could still be saved... But now my home is lost. Forever."

51e4c1aa-cffd-4548-b208-897be081df9e.Text: "It is good to see the people of Footfall are once again getting back on their feet. There are many common folk on the station who now will no longer need to fear that they will die of starvation."

21e1d0a2-fd67-4682-a472-612645a5ef8f.Text: "A pre-emptive reduction in surplus population may have had a positive effect on the station's productivity. Analysis indicates that units with the lowest utility were at risk of death."

5bd2a2a3-ada8-403f-9a5f-afef4eac4653.Text: "Vladaym's first priority will be to feed the people keeping him in power on Footfall. Aid should eventually make its way to the common workers as well."

45c088be-f6dc-4225-89b0-9613139c4983.Text: "So now Vladaym has bowed down before the von Valancius dynasty... Interesting times lie ahead of us."

b7cce804-d8c8-4632-bade-4975d287345c.Text: "You mean how Winterscale will react to this? From what I've heard of him, 'interesting' isn't the word! It's nothing to look forward to, at any rate."

9b1151c4-0528-4cef-b19a-e7f91bc74b94.Text: "My shereen has angered two influential nobles at the same time... And both are Rogue Traders. Impressive efficiency!"

eafc2019-e283-45c7-845a-1973d103c457.Text: "I'd like to have seen Incendia's face when she found out we'd stolen Footfall out from under her..."

dd66eab7-dcc7-4d6f-9dae-c0bd05fecccf.Text: "From what I know of Lady Chorda, I would not be rubbing my hands with glee if I were you. The Rogue Trader is a dangerous opponent."

61be9ade-4b13-4df2-ad5e-229d4d0150f0.Text: "Really? I would prefer to be as far away from Her Ladyship Chorda as possible at that moment..."

8fc957be-a894-45ff-8857-2f4a85a04b2a.Text: "Footfall only received sustenance thanks to the Domin's magnanimity. The people have been taught to rely on the compassion of others — a lesson in helplessness."

d1785e49-1301-48fd-a470-ef0f0bfade76.Text: "Your cult of blood fanatics also only exists on the Lord Captain's sufferance. What do you have to say to that?"

307357ba-e5f6-468c-a332-3dd8f789cbfc.Text: "We have earned this right through sacrifice and service. And we will humbly accept death if the Domin decides that the spinners are no longer needed by the flagship."

2f179a9c-7a43-4f3a-8b8d-2897959f2e9e.Text: "I must admit that I had... misgivings about the Holy Inquisition's particular interest in Kiava Gamma. But after what we saw on the industrial world, I am relieved that the deeply esteemed Interrogator was with us after all."

916f1a3b-5314-459f-8a34-70ad5e8b2689.Text: "The Lord Captain probably would have successfully handled the invasion without me. Still, I hope my presence was useful to the von Valancius dynasty."

b8c5ddd9-d80d-444a-b93c-038f60eadcd1.Text: "You are awfully choosy, old man! When the azhi lead you to a world captured by the Archenemy, you should be grateful for any help you receive — not just from 'deeply esteemed' gentlemen."

457d19bd-7d3f-42e7-b704-73f94da1ee7f.Text: "Ever since the iceman went down to Kiava Gamma for his mission, my little whisperers have been behaving oddly whenever he's around. I can't quite figure out what's changed, but... it's just strange."

67ff5f56-5bd8-4cee-8c30-3c49176e1f03.Text: "I thought you would have learned by now not to pay too much attention to your 'little whisperers.' You may have become inured to their presence, Idira, but they are not your friends. Tread carefully."

9c087a5e-b930-43b5-9605-69fa237b4289.Text: "What? The unholy voices from the darkness are less than delighted at the triumphant return of His servants from that nest of heresy? Astonishing!"

1abcb175-4496-405d-9bf8-5cffebed6a01.Text: "A sacred machine possessed by an irreal warp spawn that predicts the future... An ingenious abomination. Such profane calculations are repugnant, but... I cannot deny their sophistication. Impressive."

1451e563-f7b6-4333-8c4d-7be5c56acfca.Text: "Impressive, is it? You'd never be so admiring about 'profane calculations' carried out inside a human head, would you? No, you'd much rather chop the head off."

7875df7a-df75-4d3f-8a36-70ac823110c2.Text: "Are you speaking of what happened on Kiava Gamma, esteemed Magos? I have read of such things... But reading something and seeing it with one's own eyes are very different things."

725cfa57-2fe9-4160-9a05-1e6c700108a9.Text: "There is only one pure way to know what is to come, and that is the signs that the Undying One sends through the Tarot. All else is the lies of the Archenemy."

719129d1-c24c-42da-8e6d-6fbab5b1ca73.Text: "I still can't believe that you let me stay, Lord Captain... You didn't get rid of me... I'll prove— I'll live up to the trust you've placed in me."

3aac7d4b-e920-407c-ac50-453832fe5d1a.Text: "You put too much faith in the power of your promise. I will find some time to teach you a few psy-techniques that will help you steel your will against the Archenemy's influence."

3b8a20f5-e224-4caa-8fdb-5df44f22529b.Text: "One day, your promise will turn to dust, like a wellspring that has run dry. I pray that on that day I will be there to end this heresy... once and for all."

8de87e6f-a9e9-49f9-9351-d2b4b5f7e8b4.Text: "Idira. Tell me: have you heard Theodora's voice again on the other side?"

cebf09b8-dbed-47dd-bfd1-326df89872cd.Text: "We will only have an answer when the unholy vision reappears on the ship and drags off more innocent victims into the jaws of the Archenemy."

af4750e8-d9e6-4be7-82f0-98500de8fda7.Text: "I'm... afraid to give you an answer. If I say, 'No, I haven't heard anything,' will you boil my brains to see if I'm lying, just in case?"

2e2448fd-eb89-4f6a-a128-82b832f9c53b.Text: "When rumours of Theodora von Valancius's appearance were spreading all over the ship... I saw many flashes of yellow — your crew hoped it was true."

5fcc91e6-55b8-43d9-86a8-2d261f2e91cd.Text: "Lady Theodora's deeds are renowned throughout the Expanse. But I do not think it would have been very pleasant to serve under such an ambitious figure..."
