3b41229b-3200-4cf9-a3b3-b1f4e757f5aa.Text: "Lady Theodora was... a complicated person. But her actions in the face of danger earned her the officers' deepest respect... and her intolerance of weakness earned her the undying adoration of the common labourers."

d0c07fd9-6a4f-44bc-a532-c1c00d8d79ed.Text: "You have merely delayed your inevitable death in the claws of the warp, Veni'Idira. You could have asked for deliverance, but you did not. Why?"

09b889da-ae2d-4c9e-96d3-4749517b6f61.Text: "Because I'm not a brainwashed death cultist. Because I want to live. Because there are people counting on me. I owe it to them to stick around."

1e138a14-58bc-4299-bb87-9bc849777166.Text: "Idira, shereen, don't listen to that kaskha. Listen to me instead — wait until you see what we have planned on the middle decks in your honour..."

2967a62b-87ca-4de8-b61d-cc094e456f59.Text: "The day a witch is sent into oblivion should be celebrated as a holiday."

b31f9fb4-d70a-4986-bec5-5e05a41201fa.Text: "You are remarkably direct in the way you express yourself, Sister."

e28df665-03a9-4727-8f14-fb0a58c4438a.Text: "Terminating the life functions of the unit Idira Tlass has significantly reduced the risk of abnormalities on board. The disposal was warranted."

43ddb8dd-d846-477f-95c0-e11d91949e61.Text: "I understand all that, shereen, and yet... I mourn her. I enjoyed Idira's company, may the Exalted One preserve that gobby kaskha's tainted soul."

6a2fe814-aff8-4d43-a99e-b0b014cb482d.Text: "Perhaps at the moment of her death, she found the peace she had been deprived of in life. At least, that is what I would like to believe."

edb2a720-9e55-4b0f-94e2-5c48d834fd58.Text: "Those who deny Him in life are not worthy of His mercy in death."

23cf8eda-d85a-4acb-aa5d-9b6a67f6907d.Text: "Since Idira's been gone, I have seen the colours on the decks fade. There are fewer shades that make my eyes hurt... But more grey indifference, too."

cb1a3c8b-925a-4943-9b99-fa631dda23c1.Text: "Your eyes see reflections of Sha'eil, and your soul is always open to what lies beyond the veil... Why is it that your abilities frighten the mon-keigh less than those of the quieted one?"

fc9d4474-9d59-4f9c-8484-0a940c0e1305.Text: "I am aware that some grieve for Veni'Idira. They are wrong to do so. She died a human being. Before corruption could devour her soul."

22bd205b-c88c-48e5-a3bd-876ef3fbc1eb.Text: "Wrong? What are you talking about? Why don't you cut out your tongue and sew your mouth shut? Or whatever perversions your cult enjoys."

c7986783-2e18-4b79-810d-450051ba9f7a.Text: "Mistress Kibellah, I understand you were raised by a death cult, but... ordinary people mourn those with whom they have served for many years."

8daec027-056a-4cfe-9be0-95ba68f52864.Text: "Be advised: all acts of sacrilegious theft, encroachment on Adeptus Mechanicus privileges, and looting will be catalogued for justice enforcement purposes."

30bc44ba-6f9d-4a72-9c1c-71e1df03636b.Text: "Is it theft when the goods in question do not belong to anyone? In the tug-of-war between Cold Traders and cogs, possession is nine-tenths of the law."

b96a2bce-06cb-4468-b633-57cfbacb8c3c.Text: "Ah, stop it, you grouchy tin can! At least Jae can actually hold a conversation and not just 'conduct an information exchange.'"

3e1e9f46-d4a4-4403-9734-9b1dd06ed352.Text: "Heinrix, speaking of the Lord Captain's new companion... You have been to Footfall — would you happen to have a special, er... file on Heydari?"

07f39cf4-88ce-4857-816b-103b07d1162a.Text: "If the smuggler had committed enough transgressions for me to have a file on her, our 'shereen' Mistress Heydari would have ceased to be a nuisance a long time ago."

b06777e3-4dcd-4a23-8a62-aa5527033831.Text: "Who would have thought that the lowly Jae Heydari would become part of the Rogue Trader's retinue? The Exalted One is truly generous!"

72f7f9df-4d4b-4644-a4a5-31b4dce70c6d.Text: "Ha. I used to think the same way when I first fell in with Lady Theodora... You'll get used to it eventually. Want me to show you the way to the least worst watering hole on the ship?"

e632693b-64d3-4f53-b160-8240e6e58c15.Text: "The path of the Emperor's chosen takes strange twists and turns... but as long as your heart is filled with faith, I welcome you to our ranks."

481044b3-0371-4194-bc94-12c6b73a0ab8.Text: "I used to think Orks were my worst nightmare... Ah, the folly of innocence! The queues in the Administratum are much, much scarier."

d1a271b4-9b2c-4237-b957-91e2866bb275.Text: "The Adeptus Administratum officials are so... wan. It is as if life itself, in all its vividness and splendour, has left their hearts."

a326e24e-8371-4468-a7c1-32f204920d23.Text: "Lady Theodora once sent me to the Administratum Palace to obtain a certificate she needed — that is two weeks of my life that I will never get back."

bf396217-dfdb-4ce5-b4f9-90d6831de0f7.Text: "This unit cannot help feeling that the functional principles of the Administratum are a parodic interpretation of that sacred dogma of service: 'mimic the mechanism.' This is not what our forerunners envisaged!"

0f408fb8-30f9-4279-b534-01618911cdcc.Text: "What if their goal is really just to torture people? In that case, the Administratum's methods would give the Inquisition a run for its money!"

29baaf6e-5fcb-4a27-9536-9db5ec056f58.Text: "Every servant of the Imperium must fulfil their prescribed duty... and my heart rejoices that my duty is to destroy heresy, not to rot under a pile of papers."

ddf29d91-8623-41c5-b7c4-03a21864f63d.Text: "Once again, the generosity of the Rogue Trader to Jae Heydari knows no bounds! With the Mercatum Tabula Officiale, I will be more useful to you, shereen, and may the Exalted One protect your dynasty!"

8df3619c-b0f1-41cc-ac70-cdcd19e9677f.Text: "I suspect that queuing up for a certificate is not the most effective use of the Rogue Trader's time and energy, but the Lord Captain clearly has a different view on the matter."

8185ce8f-2a79-4504-834f-932a72b94d09.Text: "Mon-keigh are so dependent on scraps of paper... It is as though every word written by your hands possesses invisible power."

b889710c-64d5-43b4-852d-a9c8f4f647c6.Text: "Janus will remain the focus of the Inquisition's scrutiny for a long time to come. What has been happening on the planet is too grave to ignore."

d3a973e6-6dd6-4475-be57-818a404fdd31.Text: "I understand your insinuation, Interrogator. Now let's drop the subject."

6593fe65-0bc9-49a7-a8c1-00f8a394c608.Text: "Is this your way of hinting that they're going to blow up the Lord Captain's planet? That was very considerate, Master Interrogator — thanks for the warning, at least!"

ad97a2e4-202a-4b83-b681-e61048cc5215.Text: "It is sad that the beautiful and lush Janus has been overcome by such grievous calamities. The world is... very beautiful."

7a2b036b-8f79-4993-841c-083b4641d8f7.Text: "What can you know of beauty, a mon-keigh whose cursed eye kills all living things? The Lilaethan is plagued by calamity because of corruption similar to the foulness that you carry within you."

8b4742f0-d8da-4ee1-9ef4-c36718ec0bff.Text: "Ah, Janus... Of all the worlds I've ever set foot on, this is the only one that hasn't tried to kill me at every opportunity. I wish I could stay longer."

eb2b8b05-bcd0-463d-b6c8-efeee0e0fd66.Text: "Leaving the Lilaethan is a difficult decision. But my Path leads me onward... to search for my brothers and sisters. I will make any sacrifice to find them."

e756dd85-fb9b-4c76-add1-abcb25cbf73b.Text: "Hmm. Do not forget that you are merely a guest on the voidship, not an authority. The last thing we need is a xenos on the bridge doling out orders..."

101f5873-99c3-4887-950d-48dd458ec040.Text: "In the event that the sacrifice scenario is executed successfully, your body will not perish without purpose, but will be subject to sacred dissection. Rejoice."

1dbd76e6-2058-40aa-b5a4-be5cb84abf83.Text: "Observing the desecration perpetrated upon the manufactorums of Kiava Gamma is generating... unproductive signals in my cognitive circuitry. Initiating a mantra of pacification and mitigation of spiritual deterioration."

cdbf3c56-ece1-4599-ab53-f7a337f87f41.Text: "Any victory for the Archenemy brings turmoil to mind and heart. Be strong, Magos — these events are especially trying for you."

eb5bf6ed-cfef-4d4a-b966-31fbd5de4445.Text: "Is that your way of saying you're upset? Look, you can just say 'I feel bad' and have done with it. People will understand you and have a chance to offer you support."

903272d4-543e-4155-b926-f10515ca405c.Text: "What transpired on Kiava Gamma will be a heavy blow to the Gaprak dynasty, I suspect... I just hope their rivals on Dargonus do not devour the Gapraks completely after this."

32195520-6d6b-488e-ad5d-9a8cdc25cc83.Text: "Noble families spend energy and time on ridiculous power struggles when they should be focused on strengthening their military might and the holy faith."

da50646c-d7f8-4159-afa6-8cf8fc696e5e.Text: "This is the second world in the elantach's domain that the mon-keigh have allowed to become polluted by corruption. The negligence of your kind... frightens me."

c53efabf-47a7-460b-b91a-b7ac3b534530.Text: "The appearance of the Word Bearers on Kiava Gamma is a troubling sign. Even more troubling is how easily the Fabricator-Censor succumbed to the heretics' blandishments."

6ff50c01-034e-4043-9037-d62b1e6d256a.Text: "Let the discordant rhythm resounding in this temple subside. Let the parameters return to their optimal levels. Let the sacred algorithm be restored and continue in its iterations."

a8197fff-7433-4414-ba68-32de01337b9f.Text: "Preachers of blasphemy and corruption seek out weak hearts and minds in which to sow the seeds of heresy. Let us pray that there is no such fertile ground remaining in the von Valancius holdings."

6e60fcbb-51a3-44db-8a3b-bc6ccc2a8170.Text: "Those beings that settled on Jesevon... I have never heard of such xenos. Their psychic shadow in the warp... it is simply monstrous."

f27cd349-276d-411c-88ec-8e2c1e4056ce.Text: "I hope their presence in the Expanse is limited to that ship. Even if it is, I have already dispatched a message to the Lord Inquisitor. The Ordo will allocate resources to investigate the matter."

1e0525fe-3a57-40de-83b6-6080fcbe9d3c.Text: "I have heard tales from my fellow Outcasts — grim stories of the Great Devourer. I fear those were its envoys, harbingers of a storm from which there is no escape."

1e75ba8a-031f-4cd5-9663-5865da5e2f83.Text: "The demise of Jesevon is a terrible loss. Millions of pilgrims have perished in the darkness of heresy, taking His spark with them."

8c13a45b-9d4f-4d22-9392-10b5abbbb0ee.Text: "The loss is significant but easily rectified. The demise of the voidship itself is a true sorrow for the Imperium. The sacred temple of the Omnissiah is now an empty shell, and the machine spirits have forsaken it."

ee299a84-8e49-432d-b8d7-89fe1cde85b4.Text: "I have seen brave pilgrimages end in calamity too many times to count during my service as Seneschal. I am sure this will not be the last sad spectacle the Lord Captain will witness."

739f0e75-32ac-41cb-af09-f3fbc98938b1.Text: "Magos Pasqal, has the investigation of the augments extracted from your fellows borne any fruit?"

fbe90383-3b7a-4c8f-9e94-fbf47da60ed8.Text: "The unit Heinrix van Calox does not have clearance to access this information."

c983a6c9-9c89-4ea4-872e-63116aaca491.Text: "Attempting to arrest the Rogue Trader's companion on {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship}'s own vessel — it's beyond the pale! I hope the Inquisition does not come after you in the future, Magos."

04e88afc-a54e-4336-ac33-6878bd666caa.Text: "This scenario is unlikely... but not impossible. This unit regrets the damage caused to the sacred machine's furnishings."

f23839c7-2b97-498a-acca-a367245deb79.Text: "Do not fret, First Officer — I currently have no plans to do such a thing."

f9fa4bd8-fe4c-4572-a685-cef20f08b434.Text: "There were survivors among those red priests — good. They will spread the word that death will come to those who defy the Domin's will."

39b9b1c0-4e91-4541-bed6-020348b31ff8.Text: "The whole story surrounding our new Enginseer Prime makes me antsy... It's like a huge machine has been set into motion, and it can't wait to fit all its parts together."

9d0eb7a6-2186-4c60-85ed-62cbb2e37647.Text: "Cast away diviners who see the future in the Immaterium. Statistical analysis alone is truly pure."

4c78c057-c607-47bd-ae47-5f908dfe7a2d.Text: "An interesting observation. Did it come from your mind or the whispers? Either way, don't assign any importance to it: cogs are too good at keeping their secrets."

474f999a-5365-4e2c-9947-695b281f34a4.Text: "The names of the tech-crew who served on the blight-stricken ship have been deleted from memorial prayer code. In view of their shameful non-resistance to defilement, martyr status is denied."

daf3ced4-b4ba-4aee-a821-edbdf210a83d.Text: "Do you seriously think those madmen don't count as martyrs? Becoming a living patch on a ship captured by a daemon — could anyone devise a more horrible death? The thought turns my stomach!"

b8e81367-cb36-40a0-a92f-e29c7522b0ef.Text: "A reasonable decision. All the knowledge that was previously guarded by their vows and oaths has now become a tool of the Archenemy. It is treason."

c2a41e27-d7ef-43eb-8886-7a16350fbc1d.Text: "A vessel overwhelmed by corruption from beyond the veil... A sad and cautionary sight. No one deserves such a fate — not the Children of Asuryan, nor your kind, elantach."

e4cfe94c-f30d-4107-a2d7-d5f9f9274725.Text: "The Archenemy never sleeps, but is forever seeking opportunities to strike at His faithful. This ship is just one example of many, a reminder that we have no right to let our guard down."

608d1271-5560-4dd6-ad31-1735cd7baa4f.Text: "Emotions distorted by the influence of the warp are corrosive and repulsive to behold. The Archenemy purposely perverts the colours, making them unbearable to look at for anyone not yet steeped in corruption."

e94bebba-3e55-4939-900b-628b035369dd.Text: "Master van Calox, your silence oozes dark crimson. You may hide your rage from others, but not from my gaze."

a9d64547-cee4-4299-bd13-865d230256cc.Text: "What can I say, Lady Navigator? It is rare that I find myself forced to allow, let alone tolerate, xenoheresy in my orbit."

76c228a7-2006-4c99-8004-3522709052de.Text: "Ooh, our iceman is making himself sick with anger. My little whisperers have already told me about some of his plans for Yrliet... but he won't make his move without the Lord Captain's say-so."

7edfc37a-c26b-498a-80e6-2d78464e8856.Text: "A xenos among humans. Inviting her to join us is like clasping a serpent to your bosom."

48d93f90-6ed4-4b19-b07a-af25a03c3950.Text: "Yeah, well, there's nothing you can do, Adepta Sanctimonious. Just don't grind your teeth so loud, you'll wear them down to nubs."

eac026b6-00a4-45ce-a1be-32ce1d3d19de.Text: "Don't mon-keigh believe that hardship brings fortitude? Use me as a whetstone for your spirit if you wish, but keep your impure speech to yourself from now on."

3ee2f1eb-7775-44a3-84fa-e31359bfb239.Text: "Travelling in the company of mon-keigh is very... unusual. And enlightening."

265614fc-8728-4d2c-81b5-6a60a17a58d3.Text: "Where the human is driven by a desire for Knowledge that pleases the Omnissiah, the xenos is driven by a morbid curiosity to invent new evils."

1bfba8d7-724c-4f19-8b99-6cb511c5b96b.Text: "Do not be overzealous in your research, Aeldari. For you, the line between permitted curiosity and espionage will be fine indeed."

69498d1e-3e3c-44d3-a517-5514ed30a831.Text: "First Kunrad's betrayal, now this mess... How are you and I still alive, old man?"

25ffeb20-3d33-40c9-87e0-74addf147378.Text: "The mind boggles, Idira, but do you know what? I say we should continue this little tradition we have begun."

ca1036bf-1f09-43f9-beb5-7faacdb83c53.Text: "Seneschal Werserian, I am glad you are still with us and remain as stalwart as ever."

95891857-ab66-473d-8988-8614be2a5c23.Text: "I was on the verge of retiring, Sister... but where would the Lord Captain be without me, hmm? No, it is a little too soon for that."

7b88768a-c96f-4c86-b304-23d06bcfad35.Text: "Are you all right, old man? Who were you talking to just now...? Hey, what are you looking at?"

5aa5b9ff-5538-43b8-9573-24ae002b035a.Text: "Lady Navigator... there are no words to describe how glad I am that you survived."

aa629ba5-a26d-4dec-9a46-55ea9ea73e32.Text: "Your sincere relief and joy are like a vivid painting in this dreadful place, a balm to my eyes. I... I am glad to see you too, Abelard."

da076f2d-2e78-40b4-b21c-fcbe2730d35f.Text: "Martyr status grants the unit Abelard Werserian the right to request emotional inhibition augmentation. Will the unit be making use of his entitlement?"

11c89fcf-ad2b-4a46-afd1-778a67511011.Text: "Thank you for your generosity, Master Haneumann, but I would rather let my memories drive me mad than purge them from my mind."

42ae248e-9313-4a04-b5e7-34b40764df39.Text: "Oh, how I look forward to the blissful moment when the traitor Kunrad Voigtvir receives the punishment he deserves."

577b58bc-1bdf-4b5d-8ae9-cb2c90079975.Text: "He has remained among the living for too long. It is time for him to physically become what he already is in his soul — carrion."

48d0a94e-e25f-49fa-86fa-a1d24fd9c203.Text: "I can't believe I'm agreeing with Adepta Sanctimonious here... but yes, that scumbag is going to pay for what he's done!"

e4db9e3e-e742-41cc-8818-34b037bae5c5.Text: "The Undying One has whispered his name so long, it has been seared into my mind with a red-hot cane. But soon the heretic's soul will be dispatched for His harsh judgement."

b5bb4302-fe05-4ab0-a235-6df4d8c4569a.Text: "Achilleas managed to pick up Kunrad's trail after all. After his failure to unravel the xenos' plans, I did not expect such a quick result on that front."

dab89026-2040-480a-b9fc-aaf40ded564f.Text: "Crimson and bluish grey prevail over Achilleas... Has your censure so broken him?"

6a2dba63-0bf9-4d1d-9ec9-5c4757e67da1.Text: "To truly grasp the plans and thoughts of a xenos is to go mad and forget the Exalted One. If your underling ever did that, I bet you'd shoot him without a moment's hesitation."

0723ecbf-7168-40b9-838b-c2d58c7cc071.Text: "The lying xenos are playing us like puppets... I sense new webs of foul intrigue weaving about our hands!"

58aca5fd-cf3c-4f8f-af36-84bbb2d78d6f.Text: "What is the matter, prisoner? You have been content with your lot for years, and now you clamour for freedom? A belated show of courage."

61d45e22-d636-4246-af36-a890f5b96a5c.Text: "The God-Emperor will not forsake His faithful. We are nearing our escape from this labyrinth... I feel it with all my heart."

94440dee-96ba-4d6b-a0e8-17db7b1b7928.Text: "I cannot shake the dire feeling that we were allowed to escape. That 'Nocturne' could hardly have pulled off his 'prank' in the heart of Commorragh without sanction from somewhere on high."

e052aafb-e5f5-4958-945d-6aec0b32e36b.Text: "Our escape is a show that was staged by forces far greater than our helper. I would like to know the price we will have to pay for it."

9454f3fa-db5e-4402-9049-5a5ee267bc89.Text: "Another reason to find a way out of here and never set foot in these dark streets again. I have no interest in getting caught up in xenos schemes!"

4e8f3fe6-467e-47dc-9e53-64ad47964fe6.Text: "At least we emerged from the arena in one piece and not as mincemeat. That is the best outcome we could have hoped for."

4609ddff-eb81-407c-981e-ffc227c8dc37.Text: "Hope is unwarranted, dreams are premature. Our chances of survival have increased marginally... for now."

cd24df07-870e-4d5a-aea7-826fb581d532.Text: "Each of us has fallen victim to this abyss. The colours of each... have been broken. Sullied. We have left far more than blood and flesh here."

fc0728a9-4607-4c53-b459-b67b7f38d1f3.Text: "These portals... I can't figure out how far we are from the damned arena... Should we be worried about them coming after us? Can we hope for a way out of this?"

4772efd1-dd98-41e7-ab84-fc10bb0c70cd.Text: "Commorragh is a labyrinth. Finding the way out is not always possible, even for its inhabitants. But we were guided by an Arebennian, one of the rulers of the Webway. He knew exactly in which direction to nudge his actors."

ff1207f2-4193-45cc-b261-23261e144611.Text: "Metric calculus is useless — the spaces of unreality are comprehensible only through empirical experience, not systematic analysis."

79b94fa7-4cda-4c58-a71e-cc9b199c81e8.Text: "Now that my soul has been relieved of its burdensome secret, I feel..."

46b99966-1a3a-41b9-abee-dc78800b1320.Text: "Sister, with all due respect to the Ecclesiarchy — spare me the sound of your voice."

5475e379-1ff2-445e-a1fb-5ae6a26fbb10.Text: "Yes, I see. Where there was a maelstrom of colours, now there is unity. But doesn't that scare you? It is as if you were no longer a painting, but a single brushstroke."

13e222f5-d2bd-43ee-b984-8a8a7ea21f17.Text: "Fury raged within me and found an outlet in death. I could not find the strength to cry out the truth to the world. But the Rogue Trader has forgiven my cowardice."

adc1da26-f020-4b7c-89e2-2b2a149907e3.Text: "Theodora von Valancius would never receive a fair investigation and trial now anyway. Only the Rogue Trader can hand down a verdict... and {mf|he|she} has already done so."

7fd4ae63-83bc-4161-b65d-7cc521dc439a.Text: "You caught your rescuer holding a strange contraption and you put a hole through her. In my line of work, keeping strange devices on my person is unavoidable — how about next time you think before you shoot?"

6dc75dc5-fe0f-4907-98e9-6071489baa1f.Text: "So you sent the elantach's predecessor to meet her death. The same mon-keigh who may have been responsible for Crudarach's demise. I thank you."

f5a8c44c-5811-44d1-b8f8-3af32834bf2e.Text: "W-what? You... are thanking me for... Leave me alone, I do not need your approval!"

cc09832d-0b53-407d-aed7-76ec5c1ac428.Text: "Cousin, do me a favour and thank the white-haired mon-keigh a few more times. The look on her face when she hears praise from you... it is priceless."

c7a7719c-4cc0-4766-9c02-ff6ac7e834bc.Text: "Once again, Sister... You say you managed to escape the prison the xenos had put you in?"

85e8c877-32ed-440a-975f-be5fc65002ef.Text: "Yes. At least I thought I had. Then I realised that I had swapped a small cage for a larger one... and I had to find my way out of it."

75164ff5-0978-4bd2-8169-098b1ceaae63.Text: "I see the marks of grievous wounds on your body, Magos, wounds that are beyond healing."

f05b2197-3289-438b-8356-646adc5be60b.Text: "Those in communion with the True Flesh do not fear the mutilations that would cut short the existence of lowlier servants. The beneficence of the Omnissiah has granted me the blessing of outliving corporeal frailty and rising to new service."

6dcd6b58-6571-4570-aab1-a09553bb5b0e.Text: "I still can't believe you're alive, Cass... This place couldn't break you."

2ff7fa96-7c8f-4005-b501-bd6c292f7cc2.Text: "It almost did. If it weren't for the Rogue Trader, I would probably have lost my mind."

ae269507-9ec6-4c6b-be1d-0c69ec42ce6e.Text: "I yearn to see a real sun again! These repulsive, sickening lights above us are playing havoc with my mind..."

fc5d447a-cbad-4766-8179-d40c2e8336c1.Text: "Remember the light of the Astronomican, Cassia. Remember His eternal holy radiance. May the memory of it help you plot our course to freedom!"

51ccd9c1-0ff7-4a09-a300-d043f8ec56cc.Text: "Lady Cassia, there is no need to look at me like that. I assure you, I am perfectly fine."

138120cc-5d41-4dc0-9628-64e5777c38b2.Text: "Do I not deserve the truth from you even in this place, Master van Calox? I can see... the flashes of scarlet that accompany your every movement."

8ac2ca7c-3b75-417b-ade4-fd56d9a829ee.Text: "Your manner — and colours — have changed. They are purer, somehow... More honest."

615b8b73-7963-412e-ac14-12925f3e606a.Text: "Honest? Huh. I suppose they are. Hiding behind a mask is stupid when you're about to get your head bitten off. I'm surprised you didn't figure me out sooner."

68c8d596-4549-4688-a048-c1369a184a9b.Text: "Why are you limping like that? Haven't you healed yourself?"

e09aec74-8f64-4785-896f-dcbb5c561c9a.Text: "It is a long process. I could try to hide my infirmity, I suppose, but I am not as accomplished an actor as you are... shereen."

2444e54b-4daf-47d7-a9b7-8b341f2a8b89.Text: "Those crazy screams in the lab, the whole time I was there... that was you, wasn't it, iceman? How did you survive... that?"

87fc27e4-32a0-4da2-a138-61712929d4d2.Text: "My fervent desire to boil a few hundred xenos in their own skin on my way out of here proved stronger than death."

ab72293f-0b37-4e1d-b582-fc78bec4e423.Text: "You managed to escape from your captors. The Sisters of Battle are truly the daughters of the God-Emperor Himself."

3ae2ed7e-1bb1-4662-ac5f-ea4c47966976.Text: "The deeper the darkness around me, the brighter the flame in my soul. For I have sworn to be a beacon to the faithful, and not even death will release me from that vow."

b546f370-5dba-4dac-9f48-4b334204ecae.Text: "Not even Commorragh could make you leave your post at the Lord Captain's side for long."

acd29cf4-af0e-4976-b698-f434d75d0c2f.Text: "Well, I was absent without leave... but not by choice."

29e6a0a4-d553-47be-98f1-b1ed7b704f8a.Text: "The unit Idira Tlass's cooperation with the xenos captors has been logged. Vigilance protocol activated."

a429fc22-ccbd-47ce-ad2b-518ca367fff5.Text: "The warp'll get me long before I can be strung up by the Imperium. Choke on your logs, you iron snitch."

00976522-8afe-4c95-ad8d-9b4d653ed8ab.Text: "Why did you not stay under the protection of your new patron? I thought you would prefer to remain among heretics like yourself."

6b41f028-967d-4d90-abaf-62eb77cb6dd8.Text: "You mean you'd prefer it, isn't that right? Not a chance. The Lord Captain still needs me — so take your disappointment and shove it."

f660a0dd-f34d-48a2-9309-fee504002707.Text: "I saw the machine you were imprisoned in, but I had no idea..."

c0cf4817-b68b-43f4-ba43-44ec60e3aaba.Text: "Do not let the blue envelop you, Idira. We each had our own trials that we... we fought through as best we could."

41eb2504-b123-4437-8551-886dc806256f.Text: "Heh. No worries, we'll pull through. We're going to get out of here. Soon we'll be letting loose on the middle deck just like before... What do you say, Idira?"

15f2aacd-09ce-4066-80c9-a73601a5cad4.Text: "Oh, I don't know... If I survive, I think I'll be afraid of dark corners for a good six months, let alone dark taverns full of darker characters."

78dc3fff-ee57-41b0-a6a9-23f4aad56599.Text: "I'm curious, shereen... Could your gift help us find our way out of here?"

d4f5fc0a-f7f7-4741-a5f3-b6745075e69e.Text: "It could, in a way. If I opened my Navigator's eye, it would clear from our path any who tried to stop us."

c36910c6-8584-4fc0-a18c-464ec52234d5.Text: "Your motives and methods are woven from shadow, Jae... but they help you to survive even in the darkest corners of the universe."

9f9df940-c596-4100-ae79-52905792bef2.Text: "The only reason I survived this time is because one of the local freaks took a shine to my throat. He liked it so much, he gave it back to me... along with everything else I thought I'd seen the back of a long time ago."

b71b05a6-ea98-4803-b11f-3205269cae05.Text: "You know what you remind me of, Mistress Heydari? A void parasite. You can survive without an atmosphere, even in extreme conditions."

92fa6f50-10f9-4912-861d-f1a5343c2f20.Text: "I'll take that as a compliment, Master Werserian. What use would I be without my talent for survival, after all?"

3d9506cb-ec51-4b20-bf93-8098644238d8.Text: "I witnessed the procedures performed on the despicable thief in captivity, and wish to express my elation that the unit was not fully stripped of the True Flesh."

664e1247-05ba-4222-bd92-6c9a89c1bb2a.Text: "Screw you, Pasqal. I'm glad you didn't bite the dust either."

c41509b3-0389-41e3-9ac5-43583f956cf3.Text: "I still remember the Magnae Accessio ceremony... A magnificent celebration, but so many false colours..."

809fea49-3f77-40a2-8979-34f46ba4ec5f.Text: "Oh, Cass, you should have seen the kind of shindigs Lady Theodora used to put on! I mean, your ceremony was great and all, Lord Captain — don't get me wrong! I'm just harping on about the good old days again..."

f8104ce5-056a-43eb-b279-ed575607b93e.Text: "Mon-keigh consider it good fun to keep sentient beings in cages and mock them rather than give them a quick death? I am not surprised."

5e6f5bd1-1c11-4960-9a39-dd6eaf9253c4.Text: "A pointless rite. The Domin has already been crowned by the death of {mf|his|her} predecessor, and {mf|his|her} throne is the flagship."

5f078177-0c91-44ae-a758-17f6d2443e6b.Text: "My thoughts keep turning to the Magnae Accessio... It was a rather dignified affair, all in all. Except the master of ceremonies complained that he could not remember the end of the night..."

c34664c1-02b4-45d8-bf02-0bbecc8b3f9c.Text: "The pressure of the occasion and too much amasec, I suppose."

a57cd41a-473d-404d-9f87-d969a5f67cac.Text: "I saw him after the Lord Captain retired to {mf|his|her} chambers. The poor man was clutching his head and was clearly a little out of sorts. As to the reason why... I have no idea."

e238187e-faca-4e7e-bb67-0912d625c3e5.Text: "The Magnae Accessio was worthy of the Emperor's chosen. But I am glad that we have left safe walls behind us and are once again striding into the heat of battle!"

d26ef2f7-4d36-405d-bcdc-db536c6abd03.Text: "The tradition of ritualised idleness peculiar to the laity has been deemed frustrating. The utility factor of this unit is falling. I am registering anguish."

ae64effa-af0e-44cb-96ae-883b5bdf2df0.Text: "Indeed, Sister! However, I will not lie and say that the featherbeds and amasec at my shereen's palace weren't right up my street."

07d26c5e-5160-4cf8-9f51-483c901a3c4f.Text: "The unit is experiencing an irrational sense of satisfaction at the death of the xeno-unit Marazhai. The nature of the phenomenon is anomalous."

edcde3ae-ea93-44f4-b333-f74d0759973a.Text: "Draw no distinction in your heart between this vile abomination and his equally foul kin. Every one of his breed deserves the same fate."

06a616d6-c03a-447c-87e0-4c71351f9dbe.Text: "You're not the only one, cog. We should make this day a holiday marking the death of that sharp-tongued wretch! He was a particularly foul specimen, even for a xenos."

bf1cb9f2-2804-44f9-8aa5-3492acdd6cc7.Text: "My dark cousin got what he deserved. A traitor will find only treachery in his Path."

6df64025-aafb-4266-b6cd-2e3656e245ff.Text: "You should think good and hard about what this might mean for you, our harmless xenos."

d1d8af40-2ef0-4376-b8be-3ce95052f15a.Text: "It was too quick. Too easy. The xenos took too much knowledge with him to the grave. And his departure was not... agonising enough. Far from it."

06989d0d-b557-4cdf-b41b-16b6790ff1f9.Text: "I still cannot believe the Lord Captain has decided to take this... this... thing into {mf|his|her} retinue."

9f22b93d-74c4-4966-b6f3-cccacc465e81.Text: "Are you incapable of remembering my name? I can carve it into the inside of your eyelids if your memory is failing you, old mon-keigh."

2bfa40d6-7db2-42d6-ade2-ba305f3b61d9.Text: "Your presence fills me with uncontrollable anger..."

bb1663fc-c16c-4f7e-8860-618a27f4aa6e.Text: "Hush, Yrliet, hush. Do the Paths not teach you to curb your petty passions? Watch yourself, or something may happen that cannot be undone. Again."

c1419987-60b3-4762-8cca-0a3bafe6ce38.Text: "My mere presence makes you shake with rage, I do not even have to do anything to you. Delightful."

6d5f7de2-d6e5-466f-bb15-7454c70dea25.Text: "Yes. I... You... Damn it, I'm so angry I can't even speak. Enough. I'll deal with you later."

ea953831-9a83-4524-a67c-f87996958c27.Text: "The new unit is extremely unpredictable and dangerous. Disposal is recommended to eliminate the possibility of betrayal."

975416d2-f5ed-4262-ac14-6d8be52681e7.Text: "Your language is even more awkward and ugly than the standard mon-keigh tongue — how is that even possible?"

29165bee-3a7d-422e-8b6a-85bb0f50761c.Text: "Listen, metalman, your body... it... Ah, Throne take me — no one deserves such a fate!"

7c5538f6-1e96-4559-8b44-ee19efa22852.Text: "The unit's functioning is at a satisfactory level. The level of compassion in the thief's communication... has been logged."

bc188a79-4f94-434e-a45e-f9b586a1988f.Text: "Xenoblood has violated the purity of the True Flesh granted to this unit by the Omnissiah. It must serve a protracted penance."

2831950f-bb71-485d-83f4-93242fc36e12.Text: "Be glad you're alive. You'll have time to do all the atoning you want... if we make it out of here."

8f52bcd8-87bc-427c-b598-6c267a83637b.Text: "The local mechanisms are a hideous, scurrilous aberration of sacred Technology. But... can a twisted mirror ever show the true face of what is reflected in it?"

368f1420-fcf3-4ba3-9244-a7a3316649ad.Text: "Tread carefully in your quest for knowledge, Magos. Heresy sometimes creeps into hearts dressed in holy vestments."

0d7d1c85-5eba-466d-92c0-4a1aae5cee7a.Text: "You have been through a lot, esteemed Magos — and yet the kaleidoscope of your colours is bright and prismatic, like a shattered pane of stained glass..."

23234a79-8098-4a72-bd05-6368724e1d3a.Text: "The might of this unit's soul originates not in the flesh, which is weak and defective, but in metal, which knows no degradation. It may break, but it is never broken."

38095b81-b464-4720-8d23-690bbbaa0e6d.Text: "You are with us again, red priest, and you are eager to fight. It is good to see that not only your body but also your will is of the strongest metal."

af62e15a-4685-4e59-9192-b588fbd58bd5.Text: "Your positive assessment has been noted. I express approbative surprise that the unit Kibellah, composed of flawed flesh, has also been restored to functionality."

4325e253-54c3-458c-9d32-7e0629789202.Text: "The Cult will not forgive us for gutting their best fighters. I think we are already being tracked by a few individuals whose speciality is hunting champions — our heads will fetch a very high price."

40350238-44cf-4331-8065-9157864973f0.Text: "Can we do anything in this place without making even more xenos want to kill us? Oh, yeah, that's right — die."

4489503b-fa87-4e1e-ae7d-f0fb1d6b8ac5.Text: "Everything you Drukhari touch stinks of shit, even victories."

cf7ca10d-a1f3-4074-b10e-ec1d72d89500.Text: "We killed the arena's most revered warriors... They should fear us now. So why do I feel crimson bloodlust closing in around us?"

e55bf1b4-fc24-421e-896b-268baf7a7a67.Text: "They have to kill us if they want to save face. We're prize game to them now."

45599cbe-c721-4744-a242-6f9a34067bc5.Text: "Let them come to us — it will save us from having to hunt these cowardly wretches in their dark dens."

73e9de67-4056-4383-844c-08ba23a6ee38.Text: "An Arebennian in Commorragh... Great forces have been set in motion — nothing else would draw the most fearsome of all Harlequins to the Dark City."

a2f05b9b-4957-430e-86ce-a3ece9a23304.Text: "And out of everyone he could have chosen as the object of his attention... he chose a mon-keigh. Whatever he is plotting, it will be either a grand farce or a well-choreographed calamity."

1fd367e7-792e-4f3e-84e3-e4a3266516ae.Text: "I hate admitting my own ignorance, but I have never seen an Aeldari like this before. I'm not sure I want to know more about him — my gut tells me it would be a dangerous avenue to pursue."

5824d55c-6abc-40a2-928e-7036c12195a4.Text: "This colourful xenos... has hues different to those of its kin. It is as if they have been... turned inside out and upside down."

bfed82fb-ec5e-4109-8765-9c6db49ca7b0.Text: "The Arebennian are a deadly mystery. They come from the depths of the Webway and bring with them dire tidings of coming disasters. I pray to the gods that our paths will never cross again."

09a1747e-64d7-4516-87a1-1b32009ba829.Text: "Upside down? Everything about his kind is a reversal of the established order — even Archons fear the Arebennian, and for good reason."

6a266478-ebaf-4f0c-ac3a-c1f21312170b.Text: "Whatever lies ahead — we know that victory is assured in every battle, for His Angel is with us!"

467ea8e7-dedb-459b-8753-7b62063242ab.Text: "Glorious it is to hear such a pure and righteous voice, sister in war-making! Let us fight wickedness shoulder to shoulder, the son of Russ and the daughter of the Allfather!"

ead2a8a6-2d9e-4287-a116-181f2190e9c3.Text: "A lone Space Wolf in the bowels of Commorragh... An absurd situation. So absurd that I am beginning to have questions."

9b6a8aa5-84e1-492c-8105-4f522fe4d669.Text: "Do not let your serpent's tongue spew the taint of doubt upon the words of the Allfather's warrior, and you will be allowed to keep it."

740caf30-3763-4304-b47a-cab69743a03a.Text: "Hmm. Gothi, I have seen you. You served that cursed excrement Tervantias. Was the xenos notion of mercy not to your liking, so you choose to run away?"

0279c104-54b3-43fb-a810-4786e283abe2.Text: "You're one to talk, big man. You've been in a cage all this time and not lifted a finger to get yourself out of it, yet you think you can lecture me?"

ccd6b836-a051-45cc-b8e5-21e930071ba8.Text: "Well, well. The meat from the arena decided to stay close to the crowd so as not to become another's prey?"

9973c519-cc72-4c37-a078-3d0c800671e3.Text: "The only reason why you were not ripped to pieces is because the Aett-Vater decided to take on a pet xenos. So, shut your mouth, puny wretch, before I shut it for you."

209d8b0f-f0f4-4d18-b59e-e994f77807b9.Text: "The Aett-Vater keeps an inhuman to fight for {mf|him|her}? {mf|He|She} should keep you on a leash, xenos scum, so you do not forget your place."

44adf959-0139-4377-9fb1-be8b1ed6f09a.Text: "I am not a prisoner doomed to fight for my captor, unlike you, you bloodthirsty half-beast."

b3db5e97-d4f0-4d75-8032-852e5f4c6b4a.Text: "I have been meaning to ask, Interrogator... I have not seen Achilleas of late — what happened to him after the events on Dargonus?"

8e7adce8-de48-4cb5-9667-a51947757b5c.Text: "I disbanded his network of spies and sent Achilleas himself off to track down an easier target. I imagine he has buried himself in his task, trying to make amends. He will be reluctant to show up empty-handed, so it is no surprise we have not yet seen him."

e62faf14-01e1-49af-ac52-33328692a6df.Text: "Time is of the essence, elantach — the sooner we go to meet the survivors from Crudarach, the better their chances of avoiding another disaster..."

e2540adf-70c9-4547-bae6-c0156f4a5ff1.Text: "You're antsy, aren't you? Though I can understand why — things didn't work out very well with the rest of your kin."

9889437b-1d3f-46ec-82a3-4718971ffa83.Text: "Your colours were already piercing, but now they seem to have gone crazy... Are you not afraid that the storm in your heart might devour you whole?"

091f0300-ff56-4d4c-87a3-621789a9bcfb.Text: "I blame myself for failing to notice the perfidy of that traitor Yrliet, but I am gratified that her victory over us was short-lived. House von Valancius does not forgive treason."

ec6e560a-62f0-47f0-8773-d8853c995df2.Text: "Indeed, Abelard, one Rogue Trader dying on your watch is bad enough, but two in a row? People might start questioning your competence, eh?"

80977c5b-5b98-44e5-8376-c5da4776f22d.Text: "Indeed, Abelard, one Rogue Trader dying on your watch is bad enough, but two in a row? People might start questioning your competence, eh?"

f33a456d-f0ce-4d95-ade8-949b6931c576.Text: "We have all perpetrated the evil of tolerance. I hope her death will lighten the burden on our souls, if only a little."

482c763f-87f5-4c5f-80ad-4454d3f6db57.Text: "It is unfortunate that I will not have another chance to interrogate Yrliet. That human-hating xenos was surely hiding a great deal beneath her false persona."

864e2aa3-2fb4-48a8-b67a-5102c766abce.Text: "I do not believe she was driven by hatred of humans. I used to struggle to discern the xenos's colours, but now... I understand. Yrliet was drowning in despair."

f2b0c1d4-6b36-4236-a485-35eb313aa109.Text: "She deserved what she got! We took her in, protected her, and even got involved with her kin... I say we take her body to Tervantias, have him resurrect her, and then kill her again!"

e813bf2b-2626-4e16-960d-d507395515ba.Text: "Lord Captain... Are you certain you wish to allow a traitor back into your retinue?"

43848fbe-f67f-439c-b551-cc303779d61d.Text: "I will not ask for your understanding, grey-haired one — for I, too, withheld my trust. But the elantach... proved better than both of us."

0cd317af-e16f-40cf-83a2-96634516b10c.Text: "Listen. I am... sorry that your follower proved to be a trait—"

f4025b96-bb8f-4178-8958-8dd1ded87822.Text: "One more word and your life will be forfeit, xenos. The Rogue Trader's word is all that protects you now."

2821dbb3-4a0f-43c0-aa57-09b72368b7df.Text: "Your continued existence is entirely dependent on your being useful to the people you betrayed. Never forget that."

429f2e71-3724-4638-ac51-2ce7d17abdcd.Text: "You think your words frighten me, mon-keigh, after all I have endured?"

41ef468f-d636-47f2-93a1-27427cdafcac.Text: "Well, well. It seems the Lord Captain has a habit of forgiving the unforgivable... eh, Red?"

16573339-bb7f-4180-8852-e670ce692c76.Text: "I hear... understanding in your voice? I see. You, too, made a mistake that should have spelt your doom — and escaped it."

39e5c0be-9813-4775-b41d-f37bc5570490.Text: "I know you long to kill me. Will you aim your blade at my heart when I turn my back on you?"

306ad85a-2c57-4dfb-b49c-3e8c75ce5df5.Text: "No, Vil'Yrliet. Unlike you, I will never betray the Domin's will."

04eb50d7-ca04-49df-b637-1ecba2ef9c06.Text: "Kunrad has managed to find himself a henchwoman in the heart of Dargonus... Regina! Who would have thought it?"

2db74320-7aec-42f5-947a-c47d3b59088d.Text: "It's a good thing we caught her in the act — if the snake had got away, your family could have been in for a nasty surprise in about five or ten years' time, old man..."

5b8fae84-ec1c-4721-a3e2-9f646560350c.Text: "Voigtvir will not leave the Werserian family or the von Valancius dynasty in peace until he is dead. Focus on finding and destroying him — that is the best thing to do now."

4c6e072c-8c48-46b7-a835-774a1913e776.Text: "The noble families from your primary world are looking for any excuse to destroy each other, elantach. But leaders must strive for unity among their people."

15287e18-eee7-402b-bd7a-3739a4a682a2.Text: "In all fairness, Yrliet, you are in no position to judge humans for fighting among themselves. Everything I have learned lately about your kind suggests that a proclivity for feuding is universal."

49e3b3b7-f2c3-423d-941b-5b3279cb1b30.Text: "How are they any different to us, dearest cousin, except in their clumsier schemes and cruder methods?"

dfee812d-6e1d-4654-82aa-73ed3271fd88.Text: "One day I shall remind Drivestem that he was ready to bury my family based on some trumped-up charges. One day... not now."

b926271b-9b7f-4eca-a4a9-dea05022d6da.Text: "The only difference between high-society squabbles and squabbles down in the gutter is the fine clothes. If you want to quietly get rid of the scoundrel, you know who to call, old man."

5f8ecb32-f81c-4291-a682-032a8ecfafcf.Text: "Grimy colours swirl around your words, Abelard. Do not let another's poison pollute your soul — this is not like you at all."

bdbfe692-ad15-475c-96c0-ce49a7874193.Text: "Anyone plotting against Amic'Abelard must be put to death. Let their execution teach these vassals how the Domin's first advisor is to be treated."

58685aad-f92e-4a5a-ba51-66f7fba5fb38.Text: "I would prefer not to rely on public execution as a means to solving every problem. Better that the nobility be governed by fidelity to the dynasty's interests, rather than fear."

8acab8e8-316c-4964-bd84-7ef06f0ac7af.Text: "The spilt blood of noble lords is a great misfortune. However, the Lord Captain's harsh judgement will deter these dishonourable schemers from harming the Lord Captain's loyal servants for a long time to come."

98320e7f-c5ca-4dc2-9936-cd3d6e4e778f.Text: "The demise of the Asuryani remnants on the forested world was predictable. Without their craftshell, they were doomed to perish sooner or later."

b42abcfc-bbbe-4401-918a-481f53667e62.Text: "This unit estimates that the xenos vessel crash was not catastrophic. As a result, objects of research interest may have been left at the wreckage site."

f072ad86-6a5b-460d-bc87-a4bd38bc82ba.Text: "Uh-huh. But you and your pals made sure to help them on their way to their extinction, didn't you? Wipe that filthy smile off your face, creep — they were your kin!"

d8db3d1d-10c6-4184-9400-6681f41402f5.Text: "I do not think the Aeldari on Quetza Temer were the last survivors from the craftworld. Nevertheless, their destruction is an important step in purging the Expanse of this scourge."

c500bb57-a19f-4901-967d-6a495fec84f5.Text: "If they had holed up in some dark corner and figured out a way to survive, I'm sure some enterprising soul would have brought them into the Cold Trade by now."

de64aebf-f152-4a27-9eff-1b8b02fd2af0.Text: "No matter. Once I find my brothers, my pack and I will hunt down these withered inhumans and crush them like snow serpent eggs! None shall escape our grasp!"

75be478f-f0b7-4487-b881-7b319afd2da7.Text: "The extermination of the xenos on Quetza Temer was a duty the Rogue Trader fulfilled with honour. The ranks of Humanity's enemies are thinning — glad tidings!"

4df8850b-c44c-48f8-bfd9-32dc5a79c0fb.Text: "I hope the other Imperium forces in the Expanse will take note and continue in this vein. We must put a stop to all the foulness currently roaming the Imperium's domain without licence or oversight!"

9c583949-6439-4e12-a02b-31fbfa0f63f9.Text: "How many of their surviving kin still roam the darkness between the stars? Humanity's ships should fear the retaliation of those desperate to survive."

2ebd4fbf-9f99-4ac2-96cf-689f6f27f4f6.Text: "The mystery of my patroness's final resting place has been solved. I feel... at peace. What an amazing, radiant feeling."

30f486cd-1ffb-45db-a76c-52782ee44435.Text: "Now you know her saga to the end. Preserve it and share it with others — do not let the deeds of the past fall into oblivion, Sister."

7f9a2d4e-237f-4173-b9c6-57594b3ce614.Text: "You are enveloped by a weightless silver cloud, Sister. In its embrace... I too feel at peace."

e82a7305-0139-4fdf-9e16-3d00d1381493.Text: "On Salis Prime we slew another worshipper of the Final Dawn... How many more such heretics are scattered across the Expanse? How many more are preparing to strike?"

e0e4299e-53e5-43fc-bed0-11f3eb33e16e.Text: "I have faith that you will leave no speck of foulness on the face of the Expanse. The silver luminescence of your soul incinerates corruption like a star cutting through the darkness!"

d78760aa-665b-4dc4-ad3c-93d8eeb84883.Text: "Seedlings of corruption can lurk anywhere, Sister. Your sacred mission will never be complete, but you don't need me to tell you that."

2c518373-39c4-4276-9531-b710e2ac6b66.Text: "On my first visit to Salis Prime, I had no idea what treasure lay beneath its snowy surface. Sister, you have shown the Expanse a true miracle of faith."

5435c095-a575-4c05-8e2a-406642203bdd.Text: "Somewhere in my heart, I knew that I alone was capable of finding the way to the final resting place of Saint Argenta. Now... my duty is done."

78ed2b34-7342-4a21-a2ac-47bac85611dc.Text: "I wonder how much cargo that ship was carrying... Argenta, shereen, please don't look at me like that! It's a joke, just a joke by poor, thoughtless Jae!"

09da45ea-22d6-4954-9602-d4d7405914fa.Text: "At last... the mystery of the Atlas is revealed. What I carried in my chest for so many years has been explained... as have my special powers."

4f1cb528-d13d-4285-bec9-40cba0514ed9.Text: "Tisiphone's experiments crossed the line into heresy. Were it not for the special privileges of the Navis Nobilite, your House would have been overthrown and destroyed long ago. I would like to believe that in the future House Orsellio will seek out more... acceptable ways of consolidating its power."

a495cb4f-5416-42e0-995b-a1fe8025afcf.Text: "To know where you're going, first you must discover where your roots begin — so say the sages of Efreet. I hope the answers you find will help you, shereen."

0f64d981-c568-4775-9ce5-a98f04d6a1d1.Text: "For generations, the three-eyed mon-keigh have abused the souls of the Children of Asuryan for their own petty ambitions. What is that if not evidence of spiritual wretchedness?"

48d72c52-3755-452e-ab4d-b9510a32aa5e.Text: "Tisiphone did everything to ensure that the House served the God-Emperor and guided Humanity in the darkness among the stars. In her eyes, this goal... justified any sacrifice, both among the xenos and among her own vassals."

00c51765-02cd-4991-aeaa-745c6fc7b766.Text: "The idea was not without elegance, to my mind. The entanglement of eternally suffering and hating souls in one skein... I suppose the Empyrean itself must have whispered such a delightful and taunting idea to the leader of the Navigators."

a721b129-6562-4dfb-903a-1dcc9be385ab.Text: "Harlequins are frightening creatures. I cannot discern their true hues in the motley jumble of their colours. It is as if their whole existence is one drawn-out joke."

a49dc0d5-340d-4395-98e6-595c585110c7.Text: "The Helmswoman of the Soul Sea should not be troubled by the deceptions of inhuman miscreants. Fear means a crack in your soul's armour — and a speck of corruption can slip through that crack and besmirch your heart and mind!"

209cb278-70c1-4bdb-91d8-f00be77348b2.Text: "Lady Cassia, please return to the present. It is not right that a young lady should agonise over such dark ruminations when their cause is already in the past."

00bd57c6-b7a9-474c-8a62-4527a2c5c61a.Text: "Observing your kind carry out assaults on worlds proves once again that humans have not advanced much beyond clubs and stones."

3c34058b-24d0-4b29-aeca-0ddb0471019a.Text: "The observation of a representative of a debased xenoform whose preferred approach features indiscriminate attacks on random locations and the slaughtering of his own allies has not been catalogued. Reason: low-value data."

bb71fac2-dec7-4d2f-93f9-9ba0fb0f687f.Text: "Mon-keigh do not value the lives of their fellow humans, and are therefore capable of sacrificing hundreds and thousands in a single battle. This is what their art of war — if you can call it that — is built upon."

fee9f473-490e-4604-8851-2ad4d4e1e419.Text: "Keeping acolytes ignorant of all plans is a legitimate tactic. It is the only thing tempering my shock at the Lord Inquisitor's actions."

d017093c-cd32-4114-8e03-800cbc90c30b.Text: "What, iceman, you weren't kept in the loop about the intricacies of Calcazar's plans? Looks like some of the inner circle have been left out in the cold."

6ba304c6-bbdd-4f53-aadb-b0d1c436f37e.Text: "The jackal does not like being kept in the dark. The view's not as nice from this side of the table, is it?"

2bb50932-5ca8-4fe4-a689-265a157791ca.Text: "The Vizsier's intentions were also difficult to discern, but I always followed his word without a doubt in my heart. I am sorry that this same blessing did not fall to you, Veni'Heinrix."

7138dd7e-2ef6-4094-b4cb-61d35e8860f4.Text: "Such monstrous sacrilegious degradation, such significant potential lost. I am registering a signal of supreme sorrow. I am updating the daily protocols with a rhapsodic prayer for the fate of Eufrates II."

95b7abfe-3149-4930-8d76-5be30a292aba.Text: "At least the world is back in the Imperium's possession. Abandoning it to the heretics would be a worse outcome, don't you think?"

9f4dd9c3-d019-4aeb-8f3f-241f540b567d.Text: "Your colours have faded, esteemed Magos. Steel your heart — you have enough strength in you to survive this loss as well."

975fafac-421b-416c-9963-364e4849e0b2.Text: "I still can't believe we've been saved! In the Dark City, I often prayed to the Exalted One, and now I'm going to need a lot of thrones to hold up my end of the bargain, but I have no regrets!"

82d45b60-ac8b-4190-a43d-7a650c6c1660.Text: "Salvation is the consequence of His immeasurable mercy to those faithful to His cause, not the fruit of any bargain — the Emperor does not strike deals."

7a971117-81c4-439d-ae12-dcce8e7c47d3.Text: "Do not underestimate the magical power of oaths. The spirits respect those who make weighty vows — everyone on Fenris knows this."

28bd9f7a-00ef-4882-92df-6522bd438089.Text: "I've been thinking... Are we definitely back? Could this be another kind of torture cooked up by Tervantias? Some twisted dream?"

00f48e9c-2fc7-4b9c-8f4f-d1b57fd9b7f6.Text: "If I ever suspect that you may be right, the first thing I'll do is test your theory — by seeing what happens if I slit my own throat."

595a33e4-fee7-4273-84e6-ee9f51cd3aab.Text: "Commorragh tested us all to our limits, and I am glad that I withstood the trial. It means that it is too early for me to retire just yet."

066fa3ad-a721-45d0-b171-6b995cf7407f.Text: "I pray to the God-Emperor that under Incendia Chorda's rule, Footfall will pass all the trials it must face and emerge purified, resurrected to a new life."

74f7a67b-44de-4723-9764-a03a87dbe844.Text: "No. Footfall — the Footfall we know — will simply cease to exist. What it will become... that's something I don't even want to think about."

de9b2f9d-39ed-427c-b50e-9acd9ede0555.Text: "Prediction: a significant reduction in the human estate will result in reduced dockyard and trade efficiency. Or... did the unit mean something else?"

f95e1618-2b9c-4084-843e-5bce59bb0d42.Text: "Vladaym is no longer Liege of Footfall... Not that I feel sorry for the old weasel, but he did know how to keep the station under control. Will his replacement be able to handle such an unruly house?"

dc099153-81a0-4bf6-84ea-c9a7d84d406e.Text: "Mon-keigh understand the language of pain and death better than most. A few hundred more massacres to drive the message home, and the bravest of your number will submit forever to the whip of their new mistress."

41e0979c-7650-4203-81c1-8b0083acb84e.Text: "Incendia Chorda's methods have enabled her to keep an entire trade protectorate on a tight leash. I have no doubt that Footfall will bow down before her, sooner or later."

50de7d7c-f1ff-4dd5-8634-0fcedd6e296b.Text: "Poor Footfall... Whatever Chorda tells herself, what she has done to the station cannot be pleasing to the Exalted One!"

77db3ea4-e7f9-4920-ad52-f4e3ce356ff9.Text: "Some of your kin do know how to enjoy themselves. Given the fecundity of your species, I suppose replacing dead livestock would not be difficult."

600ddd5c-6cfd-4be9-bee6-92d6e6d2f9f8.Text: "Footfall amazed me the day I first set foot on it, and I was amazed again to see it transformed. Why has the arrival of godliness on the station had such a... frightening effect?"

8b743a7d-7e8d-489a-80bb-015747edb588.Text: "I never thought I would say this... but I preferred the old Footfall."

82efd8e5-8761-4b55-b9b7-69f29b968b7c.Text: "Incendia Chorda's aspirations make sense to me, but the way she realises them... I struggle to find justification for violence against people who ought to be able to look to the righteous for protection."

fe2f53d8-99e6-4921-b993-92dc80b62701.Text: "You won't hear any disagreement from me, old man. No matter how many crimes this station has racked up, turning it into a burial ground hasn't made it any better!"

81895ecc-b16c-4d7c-a8be-985999fe93f1.Text: "The Lord Inquisitor must have had very good reasons for putting Chorda in charge of Footfall."

184306c0-697e-442f-abc9-b7e6bbb22b90.Text: "Did he have a choice, van Calox? Winterscale does not care one whit about the station, and the Lord Captain was... understandably absent."

cda63895-2c1e-4994-972d-8b31d7b9637e.Text: "Your master merely found a useful butcher to saddle with the dirty work so he could keep his hands clean. It is always the way with your ilk."

b1c88b9a-4e11-4f63-be71-7538ef207ed0.Text: "So Vladaym has been left in charge of Footfall. Let's see what he will make of this mess with Chorda."

66cd3600-44ea-4536-8a47-18ba5b0159e7.Text: "The first thing he must do is show greater deference, if not undying gratitude, in his dealings with the Lord Captain. It was only the Lord Captain's intervention that saved Vladaym's hide."

a74b71a9-c8b1-41a5-961f-7a3485dc30ba.Text: "The ability of laypeople to draw far-reaching conclusions has been brought into question. Footfall will remain the same."

c71e466f-c354-4421-938e-6736aea222c4.Text: "Ah... I have a feeling that the Lord Captain's involvement in Incendia Chorda's downfall will not soon be forgotten..."

604bcd4a-a191-4e9d-961f-e0350d38f360.Text: "If the fallen mon-keigh's descendants come after the elantach, the bloody cycle will continue. Life after life. Generation after generation. Until one side ceases to exist."

2bce4d68-c898-4519-a5de-101b50169871.Text: "Oh, quit your worrying, old man. Von Valancius and Chorda have always been gunning for each other. One was bound to gain the upper hand sooner or later — everyone understood that."

7f94b478-0170-4989-814b-7e6e6fef3ffb.Text: "The Kasballica has retained control of Footfall. I suppose all the old agents who oversaw the Cold Trade can be left in place without any changes."

6bc2c523-2a70-4bb2-9309-0df0d7c8a761.Text: "Cunning. Leaking information so I tell all of Footfall about it, and my colleagues and competitors will lie low? Well... I have no intention of resisting your plan!"

f2b98f6d-4471-415c-afbf-6ee79ab7764e.Text: "If they are as soft as the burnt mon-keigh... then you should kill them all and see that the next ones are cooked better."

c84533c4-f305-43f8-90a8-bd9aee597670.Text: "After what went down on Phton... don't you want to ask your boss a few questions?"

2864f858-c4ce-445c-a8c2-30240ac60388.Text: "When the time is right, Idira. When the time is right."

cf4f47b4-128a-4b89-83de-b917b9543374.Text: "Losing a Sage is a heavy blow to the Lord Inquisitor's circle. Finding a replacement for Emelina will be a challenge."

15e5e704-fdea-4a40-885f-21ebaa645ef7.Text: "Sometimes I forget you are an agent of the Inquisition, but then I hear you speak so coldly of your former colleague... and everything falls back into place."

ac199a83-dc6a-4bbe-9071-2e64a89f6863.Text: "I would like to know what methods you and your colleagues use to remedy such a staffing deficit. Finding a Sage may be more difficult than finding a psyker."

0347ec6a-50a1-4856-89eb-06077539c62c.Text: "The Phton System is lost to Humanity. We have no way of stopping what Emelina started."

f266d7b8-1a69-4c2f-97b2-fd7da4d136db.Text: "If a man carries too many grubby secrets around in his head, it will come as no surprise if the muck harbours parasites and poisons his thoughts."

2263b817-8559-45b2-9447-c23c6aab44ef.Text: "You are creating a gateway for the forces of Sai'lanthresh... and you do so under the guise of helping Humanity. Why, when seeking salvation from one calamity, do you turn to another?"

b717d203-02e1-4e8e-96c8-dc7dfa4aaee0.Text: "The thread of true service is one of loss. May the events of Phton IV not weaken your resolve, Veni'Heinrix."

7b445537-34ce-4be1-b74a-c0d3038dd59c.Text: "Do not pretend to have any understanding of loss, Mistress Kibellah. Your mind is too warped to be capable of empathy. Return to your duties."

57eed083-a461-4ddc-b8a3-e35822d003cc.Text: "Silence... Blessed silence... I never thought my head could be so quiet..."

1f1c8d8b-17c3-4a48-b16d-cac76c1bd82a.Text: "I... hope the ship will be calmer now. But I do not trust that thing. Who knows what it might do if you leave it on too long?"

dc240b83-c43f-46fe-89d8-9fa428ac9066.Text: "You cannot entrust your fate to the creation of a malignant xenos mind. However, if it will save you from being possessed by the Archenemy's powers..."

5dea6f9f-d359-4e49-9738-8b06c13f5194.Text: "I feel strange. I was searching for a solution to my 'problem' and I found one, but I turned it down at the last second. And do you know what's strange, Lord Captain? I don't regret it. Not one bit."

cf5b47c1-e477-4cc1-bb79-009f6250729b.Text: "You are fated to be a gothi, a cursed soul who knows the spirits. If the Allfather had wanted a different path for you, he would have woven you a better fate. Do not defy destiny."

b468183e-c11f-48d6-96fd-0d2908d465c0.Text: "Instead of a Haemonculus creation, you have entrusted your soul to what lies beyond the veil... So tread your accursed Path without fear — your destiny was set from the beginning."

cf4a8126-f28b-4b19-8242-c48995d6ad50.Text: "Why would a Haemonculus establish a lair in the middle of the forests of Quetza Temer? I thought Drukhari feared to be in realspace?"

a9ef8a8d-7a04-4d4f-9e7e-59acdf8fcdf6.Text: "Insanity. Desperation. Or the compulsion of twisted creative genius. Every Haemonculus thinks of themselves as an artist — perhaps his next 'design' required him to serve himself up to Sai'lanthresh on a platter."

e1054f55-f26c-4c3a-92c1-52d6a01d1798.Text: "I am more discouraged to see signs of humans in the same place. There is a dark alliance lurking beneath this veil of mystery, something far more frightening than any typical Cold Trade deal."

1c2a6ea0-5ab1-419e-b004-32a1caad8edc.Text: "The sacred halls of research desecrated by the xenos Tervantias I hereby declare subject to purgative eradication. The sacrilege committed in them should not be comprehended."

1edcbe18-e38e-48d7-ad2c-12d9acd9bfde.Text: "Wasn't one of your fellow believers there? Beware. They are involved with the fleshmaster."

7dd040da-ba9b-40b4-a3c3-3ea6b40fd000.Text: "And what, you're not tempted to make an exception? You're not going to declare it the property of the priesthood and take it over? I suppose I can see why, even I don't want to deal with the shit that Haemonculus did."

aa0c8a19-3e30-477b-84b1-10571c334e62.Text: "Huh! I promised that despicable butcher Tervantias that I would watch him die! And I kept my promise... Oh, blast it all — I also swore to piss on his corpse!"

1f14eb7b-5dd0-41a4-adfd-7407eb463d1b.Text: "Well, do not fall into despair — experience shows that you may yet get the opportunity."

192e82e6-6743-4338-bd9a-6f55c6cdc7ff.Text: "I am proud that the von Valancius dynasty does not let old grudges go unanswered. Let every xenos know that a crime against the Rogue Trader will bring doom upon them!"

22bfb334-0532-412a-8220-31120f68ef87.Text: "I do not regret that some associates chose to leave us. Of late they have been whispering suspiciously about the Lord Captain."

e468cb46-9357-428a-bb45-ce82ed74f772.Text: "Better to fight outnumbered, but know that no bastard's going to shoot you in the back of the head because you've 'sullied yourself in the eyes of the Emperor.'"

8f3a9983-b09e-4e85-b759-e73944cf1a14.Text: "We should not have let them leave. We should have killed them for their disobedience. What will the other servants think of the Rogue Trader now?"

8aa9aba2-e7b1-43e2-a46f-da5b4e823515.Text: "I do not understand why some companions chose to leave the Rogue Trader — are we... doing something wrong?"

d1db2abd-b5ab-4a8a-8ff2-aa1a26e01e10.Text: "Perhaps we are. But what difference does it make? You want to live however you think is best, don't you? Not as you are told to live? The right to make mistakes is one worth fighting for."

8583f721-06a8-4982-b5fa-0e0913782f24.Text: "I knew mon-keigh were stupid... but travelling between the stars through the domain of Sai'lanthresh? I cannot imagine a worse kind of madness."

f48fc16c-ce02-48ff-85f9-58c63a1d070e.Text: "In the storms of the warp, we rely on the light of the God-Emperor. Unholy xenos are incapable of understanding true faith."

14f5da4f-863a-444c-a0ba-4ca837835328.Text: "Ha, our heads are stronger than your thin little skulls! Not everyone goes into a frenzy as soon as the ship translates to the Empyrean. I am stability incarnate. Learn from my example!"

96101a4c-fbaf-4808-b481-7ad3bc7d56bf.Text: "I must tell you, Lord Captain, that the crew were... dismayed and confused to learn that your xenos was not sedated after his antics."

d2c142a8-56b6-438b-9836-5d10bf2597e7.Text: "The cattle think their opinions have value? You ought to train your lackeys better, Rogue Trader."

31ab5148-98ce-44bb-83a3-56d04af5e0b0.Text: "I knew I did not imagine the voice of one of the warp spawn. Sai'lanthresh has sent her servants for me... An honour I am prepared to decline."

5bef99b0-cb69-4ec2-8c47-193adb6cb15a.Text: "Those things will be scratching at the walls of your mind every time the ship ventures beyond the veil. If you give them cause again... think of how costly a mistake could be."

7ec3ef03-c8d9-471d-9ec9-001c39352b85.Text: "This Sai'lanthresh is desperate to sink her claws into everyone of your kind... What did you all do to her, xenos?"

96635ac2-1105-4919-80ee-0871737a5d09.Text: "Magos, are you... certain that this Nomos is not an abomination that requires immediate destruction? A creature from a cogitator that has taken over a mobile machine... It is only the absence of your approval that is stopping me from taking immediate action."

20401a15-b4b2-477a-9b11-226f58e7c2a2.Text: "Nomos should be... studied. If it makes the unit van Calox feel any better, I will add that the study's scope includes research into methods for killing the unit Nomos."

69070d18-35c1-409c-a8db-3c7f7227bb88.Text: "Ha, don't even try it, shereen. The cog loses his head at the mere sight of a new toy. All the Omnissiah's covenants and rules go right out the airlock, along with his usual caution."

2e5b4964-f37a-459f-b212-88ed6f926605.Text: "That... that Nomos thing was talking to me. It's weird. Kind of creepy. But it's harmless enough. And very curious."

b9c73c5a-b229-424d-b60c-6219476472f7.Text: "Idira, for Throne's sake, be careful with that creature. We do not even fully understand what it is. Until we do, you would do well to treat it as you would any other dangerous xenos. For your own safety."

271253cc-01c7-4e4c-bdfb-c0dd6ffa73a3.Text: "Heresy attracts heresy. Why am I not surprised?"

379b8a79-0d6b-48cc-8212-0fe3137452e6.Text: "Yrliet, what is the unnatural creature residing on the Rogue Trader's ship? You have been aboard longer than I have — you must know the answer."

a9b6fc7b-bba6-4640-b59c-723e0bbba7a1.Text: "You speak of Nomos, Dark One. It is a guest of the elantach, as you and I are. Perhaps a more honoured guest, so do not even think of examining it using your typical methods — not if you wish to avoid bringing righteous wrath down upon yourself."

fcb4a306-88c0-4345-ad54-b3aef0d5fb13.Text: "Am I to understand that you have decided to openly oppose the dogma of the Adeptus Mechanicus? You are calling for heresy now?"

5ac694ae-6302-4378-a2f8-dcb430deb449.Text: "I am calling for salvation. Do not make your mentor's mistake and try to obstruct me. The Lord Inquisitor acted from afar — you have no such protection."

6514e677-a691-408f-8a1b-f793e9378aed.Text: "It's funny how this is the second time the cog's committed outright heresy, but I'm the one who's a living violation of the Omnissiah's will."

5922ac35-1415-4b85-8acc-d95b1c3488c6.Text: "This unit is no longer plagued by questions or doubts. I am registering purity and wholeness, though scars remain in places where the rebellious spirit was excised."

c4e03fa2-ae54-4664-b983-0a42ccc2c86e.Text: "You have gone the way of the warrior, Priest. A warrior must be ruthless — not toward the enemy, but toward himself!"

f1c1132b-3302-4dc6-a3f1-4acf73a53b02.Text: "I did not doubt you, Master Haneumann. It is good to know that {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship}'s vessel has been entrusted to the care of someone who understands honour and loyalty."

a8f622b3-b990-4623-8d3e-f83473de7df7.Text: "Relying on the judgement of others was a mistake. They only curbed my potential. I will achieve more on my own! The Discontinuing does not tolerate doubt!"

10380d74-69fa-4e5c-986b-335cdcf307c3.Text: "You have been blinded by pride, Pasqal. This is how great heresies begin — a person rejects the canon and abandons faith in Him for faith in themselves."

10be5407-daba-4e84-adb9-e11445739322.Text: "The colours in your soul have changed. They rage in a whirlpool of hues... Attractive and sinister at the same time."

1b3f7d5a-c7ba-4f57-932d-6a0beb963503.Text: "I can only imagine what has been happening in the Dark City since the Lord Captain destroyed the last lock holding back the forces of the warp from breaking through."

a23b18b0-28fe-48e5-a465-19aba984b369.Text: "I would like to think that it will mean the end of the Drukhari nest... but Commorragh is too massive for even such a blow to prove fatal to it."

4d292a9e-7374-42df-83a3-a114b32bd40d.Text: "The enemies of Humanity have been dealt a blow. Fitting retribution for the suffering these monsters have inflicted on the innocent and the weak."

ee7c4edd-a093-4814-bd26-988fcea14792.Text: "Our warband made a fine departure from the Dark City! Commorragh will not soon forget when they played host to the Aett-Vater and Ulfar! I would love to see their feeble spirits writhing in the storm of souls we wrought!"

fa83cc0d-b4f8-4d8d-893c-547f0b2607ac.Text: "I think the pandemonium raging there would be too much of an ordeal even for you, my lord Ulfar. Though I agree, I too wish I could catch a glimpse of the xenos getting their comeuppance..."

04b785d8-6e4b-4699-bf60-8988dea64f40.Text: "Perhaps being there would pose no threat to you, mighty Ulfar, but I would likely lose my eyes at the sight of the colours roiling there..."

974eace6-dd6f-49a8-aaf3-adb7ce5c2249.Text: "Xenos have no souls. But that does not mean they do not know suffering. Let them drink their fill."

3c79c1f7-672f-4709-ad49-2f14a614e012.Text: "A glorious feast in honour of your victory over the Archenemy's servants! Aett-Vater, for your hospitality, I promise one day to honour you and invite you to a celebration on Fenris!"

f3023c73-ed0b-48d4-bda4-7218db960210.Text: "Ha. Janris looked like his collar was choking him when he saw the cost of everything you and your esteemed brothers managed to smash and break..."

5136124f-8fcf-437a-a6fe-ee2929749c70.Text: "Ah, my lord Ulfar, if only we could bring your exuberance to our good old Amasecus... Unlike your brothers, however, the regulars on Footfall would not survive such revelry."

0283bb47-8b0f-4207-ac78-9075a56ec11b.Text: "The saga of my glorious victory over Doomscream is already taking shape in my heart! And, lucky for you all, you are about to hear the beginning of it..."

507a7cf4-7c7c-4ca1-9187-ced6988ae6d0.Text: "Interesting. If I start composing monstrous verses and reciting them at every opportunity, will those around me experience the same amount of suffering?"

d3bb42f1-c1cb-4da6-b6f1-be228deb203c.Text: "Big man, no. Please. I can't take any more. I'm begging you, let me skip this one!"

2af833ec-0e78-483b-b1cf-6ef979072245.Text: "I always welcome your recitals, for they are as deadening to the spirit as self-infliction. Proceed... I am ready."

82b0141b-d647-49ef-9ae7-2381d7e465b4.Text: "May this purity seal bearing the binharic ciphers of the Deus Mechanicus serve to commemorate your victory over the despicable Doomscream. May the spirit of your armour be in good health and vanquish all it encounters."

127c233b-046e-46e2-8042-122fe1690e8e.Text: "In truth, Priest, your fellows did not disgrace themselves either, or prove too great a hindrance to the Allfather's warriors in battle."

789e71da-b94c-4943-9938-155ac957a63f.Text: "Calligos Winterscale has fallen! I never thought I'd live to see this day — he seemed indestructible, practically immortal."

942cea8c-120e-403a-8d48-402373a04eaf.Text: "Yes, and the cause of his demise is the von Valancius dynasty. If I were you, Abelard, I would prepare for a protracted war between the two Rogue Trader houses."

ee674daa-3fe7-42b2-9e94-61d7a01c503b.Text: "There will be no one to start a brawl in the Amasecus... But Octy will be happy about that — Calligos's sprees only ever left her with corpses to dispose of and empty kegs of liquor!"

6321c90b-dd8b-4fc5-8aff-229d25dedfc4.Text: "That Winterscale wasn't half bad. He knew the joy of battle, and he was no coward... though he was still a bit of a runt."

a352497e-f2fd-4964-9246-4413015b0bc6.Text: "Calligos was the kind of man for whom dying in battle was his greatest wish in life. Well, his dream came true."

663acb6a-e2a1-482d-a0a3-29afbfce8c18.Text: "Serves him right for underestimating the Lord Captain! 'New blood' is what he called {mf|him|her}, trying to reassure himself that he had nothing to fear from the Lord Captain, and he got complacent!"

d32decec-582a-4f58-824d-6a2ecd4376da.Text: "The Rogue Trader dynasty has lost its head... Who will replace Calligos Winterscale?"

14e9f1ed-3b42-47ab-b4ed-48df82ee5570.Text: "Whatever the unit's merits, it is unlikely that his successor could be less effective as Rogue Trader. The deceased displayed supreme indifference to his duties."

477fe7c8-2c63-4508-9bb6-3b6b82c782d4.Text: "I can imagine the infighting that will break out over the Warrant of Trade... If Winterscale's descendants go to war with one another, the dynasty is in for a long feud and a bloodbath."

1391042f-4969-4fef-bd1d-1317020a5f2f.Text: "That sly spider Calcazar. He is obviously hatching some secret plot and he is planning to use us as his tools. Cunning as a xenos!"

58a6a175-c118-4e5d-b1de-5232f73809ac.Text: "I would advise you, my lord Ulfar, to choose your words more carefully from now on. I will not tolerate such remarks against the Lord Inquisitor."

ad2d5ba7-db20-4053-9a88-c2f4401e3355.Text: "Ha! Only an Angel of the Emperor can speak of the Lord Inquisitor with impunity! Little people like us must keep silent if we want to keep our heads..."

b9675aa2-8a1b-43dc-9ade-285429266fda.Text: "Ever since the Lord Captain paid a visit to Calcazar, I've had this... uneasy feeling. It feels wrong. As if... not everything has been said."

56e59fe2-f887-4e1c-a488-9e09accc335b.Text: "I was left with the same feeling even without the gift of providence. After all, it is quite unlikely that the Inquisition laid all its cards on the table."

8e5a4b3c-c737-4fbb-a80a-4b22378d25da.Text: "Eufrates II is besieged by the forces of the Archenemy, which means the righteous should be there. Those who harbour doubt and fear may turn aside, and give way to His true sons and daughters."

87aa5485-612c-4ac8-b84e-ec11817d66fe.Text: "Your hierarchy is confusing and illogical. Why should the elantach, who rules over {mf|his|her} own ship and worlds, submit to someone who, like a pest, has taken someone else's place?"

0d82328e-5b4c-4c74-9170-7a6484923750.Text: "Some xenos-sanctioning rituals involve mutilation of the tongue. I would gladly discuss the implementation of this glorious tradition with the Rogue Trader at {mf|his|her} earliest convenience."

9fb5052e-44d1-4ad6-9806-8ac9b940f718.Text: "Because he who sends others to fight and die for him is stronger. Whatever the Rogue Trader might think... this 'Calcazar' is more powerful than {mf|him|her}."

5a971ed1-5d07-49ce-a7f6-80095184efbf.Text: "I sought out the Farseers of Crudarach... but instead of relief and peace, the truth of their fate filled my heart with bitterness."

b15ed3aa-6b10-45aa-beb5-2f4da3133f18.Text: "Why? It is a fascinating display of the achievements of Haemonculi art. You should be grateful for the opportunity to view these creations from the outside rather than as a specimen."

8e7180b2-6f3d-4bc7-aee5-1cf2a579a698.Text: "What a sly and devious soul you possess, inhuman. You pretend to be capable of feeling so that we might lower our guard. But all I see is a scrawny abomination with a cold heart."

bf58a994-c5a1-4e73-98be-714ff1a20eaf.Text: "Outcast, have you ever wondered why the Arebennian chose to direct you toward your Farseers? Do you not dread the hour when he will return to claim the reward for his aid?"

3950b616-dba7-494c-a294-d5897e4c88fc.Text: "My mistakes brought me to the road that leads to the abyss. If that is the price I must pay for the truth... I will step into the darkness without fear."

aec3474a-b2ee-47bb-b141-febbc6308d46.Text: "Crudarach has fallen, its remains hidden in the darkness of the Expanse. All that is left for me to do now is to follow the one who allowed me to walk this path to the end."

bc104395-7ba2-4e55-8c28-14f30cf53d38.Text: "At least you know some semblance of gratitude, xenos. The Rogue Trader is the only reason you are still alive. It is only just that you repay {mf|him|her}."

7ae60183-97ae-4428-9201-e25c5058ea71.Text: "Good riddance to you, inhuman. Allfather willing, we shall see more than one of your ungodly craftworlds blazing under our shots."

73b8b952-f7a2-47a7-86da-01d2c023f6b8.Text: "The remains of the Asuryani are still scattered across the Expanse, Yrliet. I doubt they will survive the coming months."

e7a86cdd-0097-480a-9319-ebb03342d939.Text: "Trying to poison my spirit again, Dark One? In vain — your poisoned arrows have missed their mark."

783ba45d-229b-4a90-a3e5-b91e37ae7159.Text: "Yrliet's kin have made too many enemies to be able to count on anyone's mercy. The Exalted One sees that your kind have excelled in the art of making enemies!"

3eea6188-855e-4e5b-9bc5-50c7d09fd7ea.Text: "Nazrakhei had no reason to leave the Webway. But he must not have had a choice if Vect's wrath was truly blazing at his back."

40fbac19-7c81-485c-bfc1-7cab8f5f83db.Text: "Look, I don't know who this Nazokay was, but the idea that your gangly ass pissed someone off so much that they went to the ends of the universe for your head makes a lot of sense to me."

a07b4167-a3eb-4907-9dc7-ea0b51318260.Text: "It is amazing how one worthless grain of sand, washed up by the current, has brought down a mountain. And... after the look you just gave me, I'll keep the rest of my pearls of wisdom to myself."

94f355ea-1d4d-4a94-86d8-24451f92124a.Text: "The Archon of the Black Heart has fallen... Tell me, xenos, will this do any meaningful damage to Commorragh?"

2d1e44b2-1fca-4744-b39e-997b08b2b2ea.Text: "The Black Heart is ruled by many Archons, mon-keigh. If you were counting on the death of one to be the cause of the destruction of the entire Kabal... then I am glad to disappoint you."

9eb4f6c2-3859-407e-85c8-38fac8c8692f.Text: "This sector is full of ancient xenocorruption. It is not listed as explored. I estimate high exploration potential!"

a337a56f-00c0-4323-b7d8-c15c765e1cb7.Text: "Master Haneumann, must I remind you that we are here on other business? Ah, he's not listening anymore."

2d8ae133-6747-4aae-bfd4-19c23d1e883b.Text: "If you open the airlock and push him out, I bet he'll make a beeline for those worlds... Should we try it?"

105cf423-9e49-4c20-9575-8817003a89e1.Text: "It's strange — these systems seem familiar to me... Where do they remind me of?"

7a4a6f8a-e039-4e92-b9a6-8ca29d3ab9a4.Text: "I have an excellent memory for astronavigational parameters, and we have never been anywhere like this, but... you are right, Idira, there is something strange about these worlds."

7b1a5dc0-a029-49c3-92d1-624627b048f1.Text: "There are hardly any colours here, only inky darkness... It is a bad place, full of death."

2f52fd95-d525-485c-a93b-e38ea1185d1a.Text: "Oghyr territory... I have been in this region once before. Poor in decent prey. Rich in dangerous adversaries."
