7a887fc8-68d3-4d7a-a75b-b9945b3d627c.Text: "I have fought an Oghyr in battle only once. They are ancient creatures that should have been left in the past. Their awakening in these times is... a troubling sign."

6a720a01-94a4-41be-bfd4-2f309717da5e.Text: "I know you have no trust in me, Ulfar, but I give you my word — the information about how your pack fell will not be made public. Your secrets will be safe."

7c8a9ba5-6d84-475d-8a18-cee031d8afbd.Text: "Hmph... I appreciate that. All right, if your word is worth anything, then perhaps you are not as much of a weasel as I first thought."

ee1e7bd4-57ac-461e-a418-705b3430b7be.Text: "Brother Ulfar, do you not wish to pray for the souls of your brothers so that they find their way to the Golden Throne?"

ea1c0d23-2505-4b1e-a4f9-bbe318c6bfa4.Text: "Why do they need spells? My brothers will find their way without them, Sister. Their deeds are greater than any words we can utter."

d3813dd8-3e53-4b82-bb38-22a16064f240.Text: "I'll admit, the campaign undertaken by these Angels of the Emperor would have been worthy even of the Fleet's bravest officers. I am sure the Emperor has noted the heroism of his chosen ones."

00c1eb1d-2c29-4192-8ce8-ef864ad4a1c6.Text: "I will find out who condemned my brothers to death, and I will bring them a harsh reckoning! I swear it!"

1240e848-beb7-45dd-abf6-9948d263616c.Text: "Sure, you finish off the killers and swear revenge on their master. You dispatch him and then go looking for whoever the 'real' culprit is. Just admit that you enjoy it — or that you're just afraid to stop."

d8b0b3fb-f0d3-46ce-ba55-efaaa485c8c9.Text: "Registering a statistical irony: the units designed to perform terminating functions with respect to the adepts of Discontinuing the Cycle have been subjected to termination themselves."

000f46ba-15fa-4760-a10a-0f2af61c6e9b.Text: "The Navigator's Sanctum is directly along the passageway. I pray to the God-Emperor that we are not too late..."

e8c4c5b0-fc1b-4e8b-b92b-4e8e9abbcfec.Text: "It won't open! The damned heretics have blocked the door, trembling at the thought of our approach!"

ffc6cfa4-2f95-4d0e-877b-a02ff64f7f45.Text: "A melta charge will help. There's probably one around here somewhere..."

2f70fd3b-084e-468d-a604-a738df8949c5.Text: "I don't know, Abelard... maybe some kind of secret passage? And... what are those crates?"

ad89178e-51ab-400d-a6df-f8bc6af93468.Text: "My mind is clouded with darkness... Emperor, lay Your hand upon our brows and guard us against the morass of heresy!"

1ff80475-b71c-4c49-bee0-b841eea0019d.Text: "Where did she— it... go? The thing that was standing in front of us in the fire? I could have sworn..."

e54be983-67d5-4c7c-bde1-d67cdcb24211.Text: "To the same place all unholy visions go. Do you want to follow it, witch?"

2425c500-5256-4caa-95da-7fb0dbd821f0.Text: "We're not... we're not just going to let this go, are we? We're going to find the people who did this, aren't we, old man?"

721bfef7-b308-4246-aa2d-978b08713b88.Text: "The heir... is dead. He sacrificed himself... to save the entire dynasty..."

20f841da-7d7a-49c3-9096-ac3a1dc4762f.Text: "Old man, he was never going to make it. He was mutating right in front of us. You just ended his suffering sooner."

9c82e515-2d5d-42c3-9ced-a6d2a23b2839.Text: "A noble deed. Let the crew offer prayers for the hero who renounced his impure life in the name of Humanity."

418a31ce-eddc-4d4f-bb1a-37ef5674b344.Text: "May His will strengthen my heart, may my humble deeds be for the benefit of Humanity..."

7c745289-aea9-4a3d-986a-e6210620fea8.Text: "How long do we have to wait for an audience? How many days has it been already?"

9568ad08-7190-4a80-9d2a-0215ff9b6566.Text: "I heard the Seneschal gave the senior officers another public dressing-down recently. I don't know what it was for this time, but Werserian would latch onto any slip-up as an excuse to give someone an earful..."

6716d908-e37f-44cd-9b71-dbec35144767.Text: "Have you heard? Apparently, the lower decks got a big influx of new blood after the last on-world resupply. Is there some pestilence spreading through the crew, and that's why we had to make up the shortfall? Last time it was blue leprosy that culled our ranks..."

70edecd0-aba8-45f6-8dcb-82657df7af89.Text: "That warp jump was surprisingly uneventful. The one a couple of cycles ago, now, that was tough — the delirium took hold of so many, and the witch was up to her old tricks again..."

4d8aee12-e207-44c9-95d5-c16e8ed66501.Text: "The state of your uniform! What are you doing on the upper decks looking like that?"

fd08f9de-d401-4d38-b0e9-a983a4da0c27.Text: "Useless scum... Maybe I could put you to use as lacerax food, how about that? I should pick one of you to feed to Her Ladyship's animals!"

1df7ca7a-fd1b-426d-a668-1f9f01d0a3d6.Text: "Gracious sir, I repent! I repent of spiritual weakness, of deviation from His commandments! Do not punish me, let me make amends with my deeds!"

b4432bd7-6db5-42db-b751-fadf892d536f.Text: "I beg your pardon, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. After the incident with the servitor, the passage is closed to everyone until the Arch-Militant says otherwise."

544d7728-c6fc-4f86-9d74-0ff177ca741d.Text: "No initiative. No independent thought. Only the Omnissiah's commandments and adherence to protocols."

51e17b98-2076-4b2d-82ad-a101a0f4d762.Text: "Anyone who thinks of following Kraant's example will end up in solitary or like Kraant himself. Speaking of which, his remains still need to be scrubbed from the bulkhead — you will take care of that when we're done here. Understood?"

7fdda311-f540-4674-a9ec-562b9fb63434.Text: "So, from now on, any tinkering with the vacuum locks is to be carried out only in the presence of our esteemed Tech-Priests."

6d652733-a8ed-4631-aea1-e5b6fa4eacfc.Text: You hear the stuttering words of a prayer to the God-Emperor.

0efef0ad-534a-47b6-bd26-84b63c5fc40e.Text: As you approach, something in the servitor's body begins to hum as if in response to your presence. After a couple of seconds, the noise subsides.

953f2285-c692-4400-bff7-007b79916a59.Text: The servo-skull moves with the inexorability of a mindless machine following orders.

4604a769-86d8-4d0f-92a5-85dc7e2f7c8d.Text: "It's a breakthrough attempt. Crew, to arms!"

06bb14ea-9560-4cf9-976c-e016a00bd5d8.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, do not worry — all threats have been eliminated. It is absolutely safe here."

b77e9d0f-664f-4f06-b283-b91e3e703ded.Text: "All quiet on deck. No infractions detected."

48fe55c4-8624-40a8-a601-21841dc9b7c5.Text: "If I see you raise your head again, I'll hand you over to the Tech-Priests for servitorisation!"

045d2d7f-5eb8-49dd-b4b9-8bcd53c6fa96.Text: "Death to the servants of the corpse emperor!"

819f0558-2b63-4318-90a0-c4e39a115ee4.Text: "Laypeople interfering in the operation of the sacred mechanisms disturbs the machine spirits. In the name of the Omnissiah, refrain from any further profane acts."

159a682b-66b3-433e-9deb-1383dcffadbd.Text: "The sacred mechanism has been interfered with without due reverence. The duration of the data processing cycle... has tripled."

fc8f189c-22d1-4b3f-9685-833afcd3a689.Text: "A tech-litany for machine placidity is required. Vox-casting to initiate the consecration of unguents and the preparation of technomats."

7a0fb7c3-28c1-4a31-8dc3-9aac1c8b50dd.Text: "May thy holy connections be guarded against the evils of entropy..."

95e7dae8-bc92-4f24-b997-bc01d5bf6fad.Text: "May the sacred unguents soothe thine articulations..."

46e808de-c0bf-40dd-b2e8-8d82b70d96d2.Text: "Glory to the Omnissiah, giver of Knowledge."

20088bf0-3062-4ae4-bc94-3154de3c2992.Text: The crew member is hard at work, bowing his head in fear and avoiding even looking at you.

7a81e08e-b61f-4fa0-8990-51f193038471.Text: "You are injured. I must dress your wounds before we go any further."

ae0e5198-f67d-44ae-99a0-bfd3fb98dd91.Text: "Throne's grace, where are you going? Until we bandage your wounds and you take up arms, I, with all due respect to the heir of Lady Theodora, will not let you out the door!"

16ef92f6-6f45-407a-ae2c-a2182586cbeb.Text: "Arm yourself — our enemies may find us at any moment."

c5b83a81-3978-41cb-b641-48f9b137375f.Text: "I wish to hear the Infernus Master's report."

28fd7d19-146d-41fb-93f3-4a06eb930031.Text: "How did we come to lose so many officers?"

7490466d-bac4-462c-b901-7d4a01ed2db7.Text: "Do you have any good news to relate, Abelard?"

1b88dfcd-d935-40a1-9156-77cd77938a38.Text: "Perhaps you would introduce those present, Abelard?"

d16cb460-5793-43ad-8d42-417d436b38ab.Text: [Yawn] "I haven't the time to be listening to every last officer on this hulking rig. Abelard, give me a precis — what are the major problems and what needs to be done?"

5c77f028-c3c4-4d4d-a68a-2d4bac7607ae.Text: "What can you tell me about the system in which we currently find ourselves?"

76bcfa03-b976-4382-9c80-64733a07cf5c.Text: "I would be honoured to fulfil the Inquisitor's commission. What is it he asked of Theodora?"

411d7094-b9f3-4412-9bc1-6a6665e7e876.Text: "To summarise: we have sustained serious losses in crew members and we require a new Enginseer Prime and Navigator. Is this all that is preventing us from continuing the voyage?"

236ec7ac-3069-48f1-8346-2ddb84729fea.Text: "Yes. I shall leave the ship at the first opportunity."

e8322cb5-30b8-4f1a-9a98-5b0dcc741771.Text: "Is that so? And what is the task with which she was entrusted?"

a6b54ea8-c8f2-4c09-882f-c078373dd03f.Text: "Drivesmaster, I will hear from you now."

4c6c32f8-7156-492e-b9d3-86bf4ea4aeab.Text: "I came across a strange handwritten letter on Theodora's desk. It was signed X.C. You are referring to the contents of that note, I presume?"

8e6d0bae-c954-469a-b81d-407b77a5b29f.Text: "If there is nothing else of value to report, I declare this briefing concluded. It is time to get to work."

048e5bca-cf58-4468-8361-961aabbd2c07.Text: "Stand down! Release him. I have no intention of punishing a man for a moment of weakness, not after the terrible attack we have endured."

8705a0af-fc51-44ec-934b-65a44663376a.Text: "Experienced Masters of Ordnance are few and far between. So for that reason — he may remain in post. I leave his punishment at your discretion, Abelard."

cd1c809b-1fa4-4f67-866e-0bc8a50297a0.Text: "Thank you all for your reports. Dismissed!"

e543932d-d961-4a49-bbed-e842f7e0720b.Text: "Thank you, Abelard. Greetings to you all."

bcdbd209-7a77-42fd-a9e5-06aaed687da7.Text: "You misspoke, surely — I am the Lady Captain, am I not?"

2161bffd-44c7-4d63-95b7-f173bb66c3d4.Text: "Wait, Abelard. There is an altogether more pressing problem — I do not wish to be the Rogue Trader."

2abbda68-1f30-4beb-b7f4-e3646a6c86a9.Text: "I do not care. I refuse to accept the Rogue Trader title! You shall set me down on the nearest planet."

7e68991b-2cf7-464b-94d0-3271284845d5.Text: "I understand. Let us return to more pressing matters."

2d3bbc4d-27b4-47b9-8f3c-de9a8b7ee5c0.Text: "It is difficult to accept this state of affairs. But I shall endeavour to do so."

8152fa2a-3a7f-42e9-9eea-10e1d5f39d0e.Text: Ordered the execution of the Master of Ordnance.

2143ec14-f90f-4c58-be92-aa50ed9cb835.Text: [Draw your weapon and execute the officer personally] "Let this be a lesson to the rest of you: I did not tolerate such conduct in my regiment, and I will not tolerate it on my bridge."

e5942fda-1f8c-4050-bd0c-bc506866ff5f.Text: Took the heretical blade fragment from the High Factotum.

076d8733-35d8-4c2a-9b2f-0e4b0bfeeb9c.Text: Ordered the High Factotum to dispose of the heretical blade fragment.

a1fc141e-b5b2-418d-8a3b-e3d1b40f193e.Text: Ordered the High Factotum to save the heretical blade fragment to hand over to the Inquisition.

10fea83e-b1f1-4324-9ca6-30a5aeff56ae.Text: "Have you succeeded in tracking down Voigtvir?"

cd3a320f-e59c-41c2-b2ef-07684300b345.Text: "Master of Ordnance, do you have anything to report?"

004243e8-f0a3-45f5-a983-698901f0a51e.Text: "What if I choose to simply ignore this so-called commission?"

ff66b93a-9337-4ee0-9122-9becf3a36db2.Text: "What is on the agenda for this meeting?"

6e41ad3b-3dbd-47ef-aefc-6be67c9d9ca5.Text: "I am ready to start the briefing. Summon the officers."

447c83a2-c6b0-4e3b-929e-7fa9401a80f2.Text: "Abelard, what happened to Kunrad's sword? The one he carried on the bridge, if you recall."

612a2d33-6fa7-4197-9f8f-d28615344601.Text: "High Factotum, what have you to report?"

1bd874b2-ff50-413a-a16d-22fd0829cede.Text: "Very well. Is that everything? In that case, you are all dismissed!"

d820d357-1f5c-4123-a015-0363f0b09537.Text: "Would someone care to translate the esteemed Drivesmaster's words?"

e41b16e7-6226-4acd-b72a-96d742591bfe.Text: {n}Deep shadows of weariness can be seen on Abelard's face, though the old officer's eyes are keen. They rake over you from head to toe — he frowns, mutters something, then nods to himself.{/n} "Well, then, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}..."

7abaa122-df83-43b3-bf24-2385c82ab3f5.Text: "You must now hold your first officers' briefing in your new role as Lord Captain. For many of those who are about to join us on the bridge, this will also be their first briefing. We sustained massive losses among the senior and middle-ranking officers — some posts have had to be filled by the deputy's deputy's deputy, while others go unfilled entirely, and now the deck clans are deciding who will take over the leaderless crews."

3f2c4ff5-59a5-495c-b962-abaeec094f3e.Text: "And lastly, our High Factotum Janris Danrok, who oversees supplies, procurement, and the general material well-being of the ship."

2fe40cb3-d337-44e7-9615-09f72a7b6f1c.Text: "I cede to the Vox Master on this point. Mistress Toliman?"

b6d0bcaf-de09-4f33-bd13-d710b881bed5.Text: "We are in the Rykad star system, and our voyage here was undertaken on the orders of Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}'s predecessor. There are three inhabited bodies in this system, and our attempts to send {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox-messages{/g} have produced confounding results."

041efdfd-1a55-4657-a4b8-8f8e6e5a763d.Text: "The Navis Nobilite station has not simply failed to answer — it seems to be maintaining total vox-silence. However, we did receive a distress signal from the prison planetoid in the system. And Rykad Minoris itself is also not responding to our hails. But what is most alarming is that our {g|Encyclopedia:Augur}augurs{/g} have intercepted signals from the surface that seem to indicate ongoing hostilities on the planet."

83c1b4f1-1752-4d40-8025-d30831a1a32b.Text: "As you wish, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}." {n}Abelard points to a tall, slender woman whose body seems to contain as many implants as it does flesh.{/n} "Vigdis Surri Otta of the Toliman line, our new {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}Vox Master{/g}."

778cd7e8-20a3-450b-84ba-9964e8bf4c18.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, there is one other thing. A confidential matter of the utmost importance. Lady Theodora..." {n}Abelard hesitates.{/n} "Your eternally esteemed predecessor... brought the ship here, to this system, for a reason. She was given a secret commission. You perhaps are wondering who has the authority to commission a Rogue Trader to do anything? And I shall tell you — the {g|Encyclopedia:Inquisition}Lord Inquisitor{/g}, the Hand of the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g}, the chief architect of His will in the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g}."

52194bda-381f-4952-9aae-7c83c1dbe2f3.Text: "Precisely, Lord Captain. But bear in mind that this will not be the end of our trials. The ship's systems must be properly inspected for major damage, which can only be carried out at {g|Encyclopedia:Footfall}Footfall{/g} station, home to the only dockyard in the sector. But we will never reach Footfall without first solving these three immediate problems."

2439bf6c-c2bb-4b06-9065-b3cd4358f4be.Text: "Most certainly," {n}Abelard says, setting his hands on his hips.{/n} "The air generators have been repaired and are running smoothly, although according to the last report, it seems the attackers tried to destroy them. If those damned fanatics had succeeded, you and I wouldn't be standing here speaking now!"

3718720e-e0ef-40cf-acb1-ab066be0fb26.Text: "It is an honour to serve Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}." {n}The Vox Master offers a deep bow.{/n} "Aboard this vessel you have at your command thousands of crew members and hundreds of officers and section chiefs. I am responsible for receiving, processing, and sending all communications between you and them, as well as external sources. I am your eyes and mouth, Lord Captain."

4e6ee2b6-3c6e-4a4d-9344-8b83396c4de8.Text: {n}The {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptaSororitas}Sister of Battle{/g} grimly nods toward Idira.{/n} "The {g|Encyclopedia:Psyker}psyker{/g} is suffering some ailment... or dark madness. She insisted on seeing the Rogue Trader. I judged that it would be unwise... to leave her unsupervised."

7b184b29-3110-46fe-94bc-8e4db5bd8002.Text: {n}Idira's glazed eyes rove over those assembled. One word bursts from her lips:{/n} "Daybreak..."

5fe8284b-43b7-4c5f-832c-4d22c68b391c.Text: "Damn it!" {n}Idira presses her fingers to her temples in desperation.{/n} "Y-Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Here's the thing. I was trying to see the immediate future, and it hit me so hard... my head is still spinning. Something very strange is heading our way, and I can't make out what it is, no matter how hard I try. A single word is all I can make out: 'daybreak.' Or maybe it's 'dawn'... And it's ringing and ringing like an echo, like a bell... But if it's daybreak, then why is it so dark?"

2e30eabf-6566-492e-aeed-6ae1a210f5f8.Text: "Silence!" {n}The bridge's magnificent glass panes seem to tremble under the force of Abelard's roar.{/n} "Enforcers, seize this mutineer!"

a1b0659d-9153-4db9-8237-c06135e199d3.Text: "We cannot extract any information of value from a single word. Can you tell us anything else, Mistress Tlass?"

3b000bdf-9f49-42d8-989d-73c727ddba26.Text: "No. Not yet anyway. The voices are going berserk, all shouting at once, I can't make sense of any of it. As soon as I know or sense anything, I'll report it, all right?"

67d9b38a-d1f4-4b7e-b514-127977ef4485.Text: {n}Abelard stares unblinkingly at the Master of Ordnance.{/n} "Cease your snivelling. You disgrace yourself and your entire clan. Enough. The hysterics are over — let us resume."

8982b49c-ce67-4d46-97d1-3def0c94a41a.Text: {n}Abelard nods stiffly.{/n} "Consider it done. Take him away!"

b9569f31-ecb4-4c92-8c96-4f1422c064f8.Text: {n}The Master of Ordnance stands up, wiping the blood from his broken nose. His face is the picture of shock. What just happened seems to be dawning on him only now, and the knowledge of the fate he so narrowly escaped.{/n}

218fed86-a001-4f63-8405-5271ac48a56d.Text: {n}With a gesture, Abelard relays the order to the adjutants at the far end of the magnificent chamber.{/n}

a38f1bd5-42e7-4286-9ae4-65c029b382f6.Text: "Lady Theodora was to seek out the Lord Inquisitor's right hand man, one Heinrix van Calox. An Interrogator, you understand. All I know is that he is somewhere in this system, that we must find him and offer him whatever assistance he requires, and then deliver him to {g|Encyclopedia:Footfall}Footfall{/g} in the Furibundus System. Finding him without any more information to go on will be difficult indeed, but an Inquisitor is an important individual. The authorities in the system, either the Navis Nobilite or the governor of Rykad Minoris, may know something."

900b4fbb-96f1-4c69-944c-b3819ed67970.Text: "Beside her is Ravor, the Master Helmsman. He steers our ship along the course set by the Lord Captain and monitors the void around us — to ensure that we do not stray into an asteroid field or a pirate trap."

169200db-2aeb-48a4-a759-83c94724e1be.Text: "That is all of it, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. You have a great deal of work ahead of you, but it is a mere taste of the daily burden of a Rogue Trader. Soon you must take up the reins of the von Valancius protectorate..." {n}Abelard gives you another scrutinising look, as if trying to gauge how long you will hold out under this mountain of problems. His face softens slightly, and it seems he is about to offer some words of encouragement—{/n}

37c7e09a-7def-4ba9-b58e-8dcc4bc551da.Text: "Attention, officers! You have been granted an honour — Lord Captain {name} von Valancius will personally conduct today's briefing. Our most gracious Lord Captain is ready to hear your reports."

e6be0089-5170-49f8-8ed9-ed5e2e7ce3ac.Text: {n}A dozen pairs of eyes bore into you, the expressions revealing restraint, joy, curiosity... and wariness.{/n}

d890d9d4-fc56-4c68-a67c-79f93e94767f.Text: "In the second row, we have the three officers charged with overseeing the ship's vital functions. The Master of Ordnance is responsible for the artillery aboard. The Infernus Master, whose crew work to prevent and extinguish fires on the ship. And, lastly, the Drivesmaster, servant of the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}."

f1b97c7b-1b0c-4df1-9f08-ca5872a1b6b1.Text: {n}The three officers salute you — the Infernus Master does so with confidence, while the Master of Ordnance betrays nervousness. The Drivesmaster offers a salute resembling a dance, involving the complicated manipulation of all the {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priest{/g}'s {g|Encyclopedia:Mechadendrite}mechadendrites{/g}.{/n}

8f549009-6ff9-455c-bff9-b7dc4438721f.Text: "You had us worried for a few hours there." {n}Abelard offers a thin smile.{/n} "But after witnessing you fearlessly {d|Encyclopedia:Prologue_WentThroughFire}rush into the fray{/d} on deck, the only thing that surprises me is how long you stayed on your feet: your strength only left you once the fighting was all over. Such fortitude is most admirable in a Lord Captain!"

72876756-1b51-4785-b57e-7e0f8e0e6869.Text: "All others present are adjutants, secretaries, and deputies. They are here to make of a record of proceedings."

a423d427-92c9-41a0-818f-d72cd53708cb.Text: "Yes, Lord Captain!" {n}The tall man bows his head in deference.{/n} "I can report that all fires across all decks have now been extinguished. The preliminary damage assessment — in terms of material losses and crew casualties — has been completed. The results have been submitted to the Seneschal and the High Factotum."

5f812846-631e-4310-98ad-a16d7f232cd2.Text: "The post passed to him after the previous Infernus Master and his next three deputies expired in the line of duty," {n}Abelard remarks in a low voice pitched for your ears only.{/n} "The lad is managing well so far. He can take the heat, so to speak."

ea7248bd-588b-4fe9-a866-6df41f294913.Text: "The medics only just saved you in time — luckily, one of the healers remembered the existence of a long-forgotten augment station in storage. The blessings of the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g} saved your life — some of your internal organs had to be replaced with {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}implants{/g}. The good news is that now we have the capabilities to install augmentations of any complexity." {n}The Seneschal then mutters to himself,{/n} "I swear, sometimes it seems new compartments spring up on this ship of their own volition..."

f1620aa2-f567-45dd-813f-33e5804fcc1f.Text: {n}You cannot help but notice that the Seneschal does not know how to talk to you or where to begin. His hesitation brings an involuntary smirk to your face — as though {d|Encyclopedia:Prologue_CutByKnife}someone else entirely{/d} is gloating at the old officer's confusion. Seeing your smile, Abelard pulls himself together.{/n}

3f3a33f9-691d-4b2b-823a-e4759a094ed6.Text: {n}Abelard is slightly taken aback by the unexpected question.{/n} "His sword? To be honest, I'm struggling to remember... Under ordinary circumstances, I would direct you to Mort, as he was our expert on battle trophies. But as the Arch-Militant has now left us, I suggest you speak to the High Factotum. If there was anything even slightly valuable left on deck after the bloodshed, it almost certainly found its way into his hands."

5f748d14-cc36-4e12-92de-fd80a8c1dff6.Text: {n}The {d|Encyclopedia:Prologue_CutByKnife}alien entity{/d} coiled in the depths of your mind begins to shift restlessly. Its demand is clear: find. But not the people the Seneschal mentioned. You must discover something. Track something down. Shine. Blood. The Truth-begetting primordial steel. A shard left in the body of Kunrad Voigtvir's victim suddenly rises before your mind's eye in stark clarity.{/n}

b423929a-98a5-4ca4-8963-2cf202c4ab0a.Text: "We are toiling day and night to compile a full account of the losses. The task will require next to no involvement from Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} — I will personally ensure that all damaged components are given into the Tech-Priests' hands for attention and that all lost supplies are replaced. There is only one resource that I cannot replenish single-handedly, and that is people. We have lost more than two thousand crew members, and, unfortunately, this number is not confined to the scum from the lower decks, which are easily replaced, but also includes trained professionals."

6f14e33e-c5a6-444d-939f-426bd4e352f2.Text: {n}The Master of Ordnance gives you a gloomy look.{/n} "No. My job's simple — maintain the arsenal and fire where I'm told. But just ask anyone — we've got no able crew, no Lord Captain—"

9be322fd-b509-4628-a6a1-5ea15815cb57.Text: "With great sorrow I must also report that the {g|Encyclopedia:Enginseer}Enginseer{/g} Prime, overseer and spiritual authority of all Tech-Priests on board, fell in battle. The Magos was betrayed by the little flesh that remained part of him. A most terrible loss! There is no one among my comrades aboard whose experience and comprehension of the sacred protocols equals that of the fallen Magos. We require a replacement, and as soon as possible."

77bbd516-53b3-40f0-b654-fb450563b571.Text: "The ship's most senior Tech-Priest — most senior both in rank and in experience — is dead. If we do not find a replacement, we will be unable to resolve the problems with the warp engine," {n}answers the Vox Master instantly, without even thinking — this is not the first time she has acted as an interpreter between the ship's various inhabitants.{/n}

5f1bae69-50b8-45fe-9342-37e23d40352c.Text: "Unfortunately, our Choirmaster, the esteemed Zacchary Weisz, head of the {g|Encyclopedia:Astropath}Astropath{/g} section, is unable to join us. He is in charge of communications with distant star systems. Master Weisz has been in a trance for some time now, attempting to contact other planets in the von Valancius protectorate and inform them of Lady Theodora's passing and Kunrad Voigtvir's treachery. I will deliver a report to Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} on the Astropath's progress as soon as it is possible to do so."

cb308066-0ee6-487c-a5c2-b3945116e860.Text: {n}The assembled officers salute you as one.{/n}

670f549e-094c-46c8-93be-3f100a815a81.Text: "We will be able to make up our losses on the nearest planet, Rykad Minoris. However, the planet — the whole system, in fact — belongs to the Winterscale {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} dynasty. We cannot simply begin recruiting on the planet without first coming to an understanding with the governor. In that respect, I am powerless — negotiations at this level are a matter for the Rogue Trader."

1c1b5795-5590-426e-8719-b2db4181b890.Text: "Especially true given Calligos Winterscale's penchant for attacking first and asking questions later, and the kind of thick-skulled thugs he usually installs as governors on his planets," {n}rumbles Abelard, frowning.{/n}

447bd7b6-153b-406f-9413-7621ed61a92d.Text: "So what?" {n}comes the officer's hostile and bitter reply. It is as if a dam has burst inside and all his pent-up emotions are rushing out of him.{/n} "The ship's in ruins! Every second officer's dead! And now we've got a green Lord Captain who's supposed to lead us to void knows where!"

d53966f6-3d20-4af2-8c6d-6ac017c66577.Text: {n}The brittle laughter of the Master of Ordnance reverberates around the bridge as he is led to his fate.{/n}

eba0d2cb-dc29-4d21-ae64-dd30fd5676d6.Text: "I serve at your pleasure, Lord Captain."

00795ced-1c54-42de-8e8e-d6ff43298e9b.Text: {n}Abelard grunts.{/n} "If only one officer out of the whole lot has fallen to pieces, then that's not bad at all. Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I do humbly apologise on behalf of the entire crew. What would you have us do with the Master of Ordnance? The former Master of Ordnance, I should say. Besides find a replacement, that is, for we already have one lined up."

0ee26bf0-542b-4208-8b66-b4a9e615767f.Text: "Twenty lashes a month for the next six months. Deprivation of officer's rations and privileges for the same period. With the option to extend. Record that in his file!"

379f2185-4b94-4671-a039-4bdd84dd9e75.Text: {n}A voice distorted by a vox-retranslator emerges from under the Tech-Priest's scarlet hood.{/n} "Lord Captain, the foes that set upon this noble voidship destroyed the repositories of hundreds of {g|Encyclopedia:MachineSpirit}machine spirits{/g}. The great {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}warp engine{/g} entrusted into my charge is unharmed, thank the Omnissiah, but its spirit mourns its dead brethren. We have not yet identified a prayer protocol capable of assuaging its sorrow and anger."

e5b1e0c2-6bf4-4be9-a91f-13e7736e844a.Text: "You would cease to be a Rogue Trader. And perhaps cease to be altogether," {n}Abelard says gravely.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, it is your prerogative to disregard anyone you wish in the Koronus Expanse. But not the Inquisition. Never the Inquisition."

dbb15ddb-72f4-49a4-9651-8026677af726.Text: "Right you are, Lord Cap'n. To cut a long story short — the outlook is bleak. The ship's sound, more or less, but without our {g|Encyclopedia:Enginseer}Enginseer{/g} Prime and {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Navigator{/g}, who fell in battle, we have no way out of the system. If we try to set so much as a toe inside the {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}warp{/g}, I don't know what'll happen first, our warp drive being torn to pieces or all of us melting into the bulkheads."

36f83fbf-456a-4587-b714-da2ce8d7bf17.Text: "If I were you, I'd grab this chance with both hands, or else you'll soon be eyeing up asteroids to use as your new residence! In slightly less shitty news — we can go round and round this system till our heads are swimming, as long as the {g|Encyclopedia:Promethium}promethium{/g} and supplies last. And if any thick-as-grox-shit lowlifes come sniffing around, we'll be able to take them out, so don't you worry on that score!"

b9098035-ec7d-46e7-9f42-323a4efb9478.Text: "There is no mistake, Your Ladyship. Lady Theodora before you was also the Lord Captain. Do not take your title literally — think of it as a sacred rank that remains unchanging no matter who bears the Warrant. You have been chosen by the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} to carry the honourable burden of the {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}. {g|Encyclopedia:HighGothic}High Gothic{/g}, whence this title originates, is a highly formal language, and so a certain level of inflexibility is to be expected."

43e01622-4586-48e4-b77e-9e36db73f775.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, if you will allow me to interject — when we arrived in this system, my crew followed standard protocols and conducted a count of all the available communication channels in the region. One of them was a {g|Encyclopedia:NavisNobilite}Navis Nobilite{/g} station. The station maintains complete vox-silence, but even its presence here inspires hope. To have located a Navigator in the very same system is an incredible stroke of luck, a true blessing from the God-Emperor."

a953c575-f092-4dc3-9c53-effa36d358eb.Text: {n}The bearded man with pale, almost transparent skin, large dark circles under his eyes, and a dour expression that seems hardwired into his face, gives a sullen nod.{/n} "Hail, Lord Cap'n. This here ship's as good as home to me, so rest assured she's in safe hands. I'll die before I let her come to any grief!"

35f60bb3-11b3-48cc-8fa0-eb1bdf211fe9.Text: {n}Dressed in an embroidered jacket, the heavyset man with oiled hair offers an obsequious smile and bows.{/n} "It is an honour, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. You may trust me with all matters concerning your comfort — everything will be done to the highest standard!"

2bd54c26-81a6-482b-a45c-3fd25cb15d94.Text: {n}The old officer gasps and looks at you oddly.{/n} "I... do agree that your elevation to your new status was rather precipitous. I assure you there are good reasons for it — not least the fact that without a Lord Captain, the ship would be destined for naught but disaster... but I digress."

6ee15f1c-1866-4565-b941-59d577beaecc.Text: {n}Abelard's voice softens slightly.{/n} "You do not have a choice, {name}. You are the named heir of the Rogue Trader, and your fate is predetermined. Besides..." {n}The Seneschal lowers his voice.{/n} "If Kunrad is intent on eliminating all the candidates, then his assassins must still be out there... waiting. I doubt they are reckless enough to attack you if you are draped in the mantle of the Rogue Trader. But if you were to disembark the ship bearing only the status of an ordinary servant of the Emperor..."

b9de4399-578a-4b92-b586-2464f158bb27.Text: {n}Abelard nods deferentially.{/n} "We all have burdens to carry in the name of the God-Emperor, {name}."

9d992625-64b5-4349-98c2-1419c5bcbbb8.Text: "As you wish, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. The report will be far from cheering — we must find a replacement for the dead {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Navigator{/g}. This is a task that is extremely challenging even under normal circumstances, but the God-Emperor's blessing is clearly upon you. We have just ascertained that there is a {g|Encyclopedia:NavisNobilite}Navis Nobilite{/g} station in the Rykad System. Such Navigator bastions are unbelievably rare, and our having ended up here is an incredible coincidence that can only be explained by divine intervention. You should visit the station, Lord Captain, and find someone to fill the vacant post."

4de73337-5e51-4762-8467-b30354b8adce.Text: {n}The Seneschal makes an approving sound.{/n} "A wise decision."

c9d2b92d-c6e0-4a41-aa2f-b028e758d1f5.Text: {n}Abelard looks at you in alarm.{/n} "I... can scarcely stop you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Are you certain of your decision?"

42f3127f-4751-45f9-a5e2-9f7f02f4f94d.Text: {n}Abelard sighs heavily and seems to age another ten years before your eyes.{/n} "Very well, {name}. I shall relay all the necessary instructions for the landing. It was a pleasure to know you. Farewell."

e9096f08-89bb-4eeb-bdbe-0d19d411c774.Text: "You have endured much in recent days... anyone in your position would lose their equilibrium." {n}Despite his relaxed tone, Abelard continues to scrutinise you.{/n}

14456027-d19b-440d-82c4-f913e6184f47.Text: {n}A sharp bolt of pain lances through your skull as if in response to what you just heard. You understand that it is not the God-Emperor you should thank for such good fortune. The {d|Encyclopedia:Prologue_EdgeHelp}words of the daemon{/d} that appeared before you during the translation to realspace echo in your mind.{/n} "I am the will of the Weaver of Destinies, and today, I will weave a new thread of elusive possibilities and fickle chances. The thread that will lead you out of the maw of irreversibility. The thread that will help you find the keys to salvation."

e74a9cec-f4cb-431a-a5f8-95d2013cc06b.Text: {n}For a brief moment, Sister Argenta's voice sounds hesitant.{/n} "I was also hoping to approach you with a personal request. But it can wait. Speak with me when you have time, Rogue Trader."

41daf3e1-5177-47e1-9ae0-4f34d1047059.Text: {n}Abelard gives a reserved nod and glares at the speechless officers.{/n} "I certainly hope that all of us here have taken this lesson from the {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Commissar}Officio Prefectus{/d} to heart."

c99fe752-f5d9-4335-b2e1-ff6979ce1e0d.Text: {n}The High Factotum breaks away from the rest and approaches you, bowing repeatedly.{/n} "Lord Captain, if I may steal just one more moment of your time... The matter is rather delicate, as it concerns trophies that were left after the battles on the ship. One trophy in particular, I should say."

3a340f1c-2996-4eb8-96e1-de55284f7bd6.Text: "Item two on the bad news list — our {g|Encyclopedia:Enginseer}Enginseer{/g} Prime fell in battle. Without his assistance, we cannot soothe the ship's {g|Encyclopedia:MachineSpirit}machine spirits{/g}. Finding a new {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priest{/g}, and a {g|Encyclopedia:Magos}Magos{/g} at that, will be far from easy. But there is some prospect of success."

c0f5d76e-a8da-4998-a606-06a74ef5f3ca.Text: {n}Abelard grits his teeth.{/n} "No, Lord Captain. In all the commotion, his trail went cold. Our people are still on the hunt for him and any mutineers who may still be skulking in the ship's many corridors... but, frankly, I would not be surprised to hear that we are now one shuttle short. I am afraid that it will be some time before he answers for all that he has wrought."

34f85440-4365-4f55-a83c-2973f4c9896b.Text: "Tlass, cease your buffoonery immediately and report the reason for your intrusion!"

32908725-48e2-404e-aacf-87867d622f9c.Text: "Lord Captain, if you want me to take a closer look into your future, find me on the bridge and we can talk. Lady Theodora was well served by my whispers on many occasions, and I'm sure you would benefit from them as well." {n}The psyker's bitten lips stretch into a wry smile.{/n}

c4cdad8b-8c07-4293-b6fe-461794a32192.Text: {n}The Master of Ordnance chokes back the words he was obviously about to blurt out without thinking. He casts another look at you before turning away.{/n} "I apologise profusely, Lord Captain. Pardon the fool... The ship is in ruins, every other officer is dead, and the Lord Captain is no longer with us. Fear has taken hold of me."

bea5f0f1-79a6-4a35-bc5b-6e3f2fadd73f.Text: {n}He looks up at you.{/n} "But I've heard of you, oh yes! Your {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_MOT_Glory}fame{/d} has reached even as far as the Expanse. I can't be showing myself up in front of an illustrious person such as yourself..." {n}He adjusts his uniform and stands ramrod straight.{/n} "The Master of Ordnance can report that the rest of the arsenal has been saved and the battery is in good order. We are ready to fight, if that is the Lord Captain's will!"

a5b1c74c-21db-4c54-a0cf-1f4f3be35afc.Text: "And the third piece of bad news — the last one, fortunately. Crew losses have surpassed two thousand people. If we do not make good on this deficit, we will not have sufficient hands on board to facilitate normal void travel. This system contains a large inhabited planet — Rykad Minoris. We will probably be able to find sufficient workers there, but there is a matter of some diplomatic delicacy — the planet is controlled by House Winterscale, the {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} dynasty. We cannot simply recruit people from the planet without first coming to an agreement with the governor."

d95be642-cfd4-44ad-93ca-47aebcea7310.Text: "It is equally regrettable that two more individuals worthy of mention could not join us at the briefing: the Master-at-Arms and Confessor Adalbert. The eminent Adalbert must see to the funeral services being held for the fallen officers, of whom there are too many for him to take leave from the chapel. And Mistress Sauerback, who has replaced her late predecessor as our Master-at-Arms, is currently leading the search for any surviving agents of Voigtvir."

67f2f816-5d49-471c-99fc-dff6294db54c.Text: "It appears the heretics were deliberately targeting the vessel's command — they knew exactly whom they were looking for and where they could be found. Which is unsurprising, given that their informant on board was our own Master of Whispers..." {n}Abelard grimaces.{/n}

239ba722-0b14-4443-8af2-027bf55ad9ed.Text: "Reports on the condition of the ship and crew. The Lord Captain is not usually drawn away from her important affairs to attend such routine briefings, but this is a unique situation. I am still receiving updates from across the ship, and they are not encouraging. Getting this bird to fly could take a gargantuan effort, even so far as you personally negotiating with the authorities of the system we are currently in. So prepare to hear a bevy of complaints and excuses, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Take this opportunity to get a good look at the officers who work six decks away from the bridge. And they in turn will have the honour of beholding the visage of their Lord Captain."

ecd4a93a-d40c-478b-a75d-e7ef68e87a25.Text: "The situation is not very encouraging. But without a Navigator, a Tech-Priest, and new crew members, we won't be able to travel anywhere — therefore, we must go to the planet and the Navis Nobilite station and find out what in the void is going on!"

8841eab1-434c-4a04-b532-c5143114a2db.Text: "Vox Master, see to it that you receive five lashes for this show of clumsiness. What is happening to Cassia?"

9d524b83-6e74-4b85-b85e-13ec66f83d02.Text: "Cassia, are you all right in there?"

b542b562-9db8-418e-a9ea-7c7512d0d0d5.Text: "Continue the ritual. That is an order."

8c870ad3-614f-44ae-b282-a8d418d2237f.Text: {n}Several minutes pass before Cassia's wavering voice interrupts the low crackle of the {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g}:{/n} "M-make ready. Initiating the communion ritual."

a55522bf-df68-4d0c-85a0-2a45c6eb69fd.Text: "Come here, Uve." {n}The exultant ring of metal freed from its scabbard. The low sob of the servant. The rhythmic drip of liquid on canvas. The faint whisper of the brush.{/n} "Go." {n}Footsteps hurrying away.{/n}

4d22d9c6-5465-46ee-93d4-c4134a29998c.Text: {n}You hear the exultant ring of metal freed from its scabbard. Then — the stifled gasp of the Lady Navigator, the rhythmic drip of liquid on canvas, and the faint whisper of a brush.{/n}

cd02fdfd-d278-4522-9145-3df176fc7b32.Text: {n}You hear a heavy exhale, rustling fabric, and metallic clicking.{/n} "By the Emperor's grace, the ritual was successful. Your vessel's temperament presented a challenge — its cold steel grip did not allow me to breathe freely even for a second. It was as if the depths of the ship housed not only machine spirits, but something... other. Now I will retreat to my chambers to recover my strength. Send for me if you have need of me."

bb33acca-2432-48bc-9d03-d47f655b8567.Text: "Lord Captain, the {g|Encyclopedia:Enginseer}Enginseers{/g} report that the Lady Navigator's ritual has agitated {g|Encyclopedia:MachineSpirit}machine spirits{/g} all over the vessel. It is no cause for great concern, but we cannot assess the damage until the ritual is over."

ccae3616-ee3d-4829-8a9b-4fee87032772.Text: {n}The {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox-caster{/g} in the Sanctum Navis picks up the susurration of clothes, pious chanting, and the metallic clicking of {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}implants{/g}. Then the serene voice of the {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Lady Navigator{/g} breaks the silence:{/n} "Initiating communion ritual!"

5cb1ec1c-38b9-4591-acbe-de4960b5911e.Text: "And here, beyond the wall of glass, a daughter forsaken by her father yearns for her brother. And the sun's pale disk goes in tireless pursuit... of her? No. Of me. Its frozen rays lie that spring is here. The light is deadened. The Great Ruler is... GONE!"

785c6243-3de9-4a89-b58a-f1eadcce9188.Text: "I... see... violet vortexes lashing an ocean with a million flails... and umber shadows spinning over the surface in a fiery dance... A storm rising above foaming waters. Armadas drowning in fog — the path from one end to another cannot be seen."

b2ed95b4-4367-4d39-bb34-f14948f49099.Text: {n}The Vox Master recoils at Cassia's words and accidentally snaps one of the {g|Encyclopedia:Cogitator}cogitator{/g} levers. The panel beneath her fingers emits sparks, and the vox-caster falls silent. She quickly flips a series of switches and bows guiltily.{/n} "My abject apologies for cutting off the broadcast, Lord Captain! I have never heard the {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}warp{/g} speaking through a {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Navigator{/g} before. The connection is restored now. It will not happen again."

c1c49518-d69e-4faf-a6d3-32f741a33f77.Text: {n}Soul-shredding screams drown out the vox-transmission — the servants in the Sanctum Navis are howling and shrieking like wild beasts, moaning in pain, their throats raw from the strain. And then — sudden silence. The dull thud of dropping bodies proclaims their fate.{/n}

011e48f9-84f4-4d80-a769-d589e195e7e6.Text: "Rogue Trader, I fear I have unfortunate news. Endless blackness has spread across the canvas, dividing what should be whole in two — and my sight cannot glimpse the light of the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} as clearly as before. I cannot turn around, my brush... only draws me onward. The way is blocked."

caab19ac-728f-4c62-b067-cf07c34cf895.Text: {n}You feel a sharp jolt and the ship trembles like a wounded creature. The vox officers report that {g|Encyclopedia:Lumen}lumens{/g} have gone out across all decks and that the captain's bridge is the only place that has not been plunged into darkness.{/n}

6937df1f-5fa2-476f-aea2-3b6eadc21ec5.Text: "It... It appears the servants were part of the Lady Navigator's rite. As it was for her predecessor. I will arrange for the bodies to be removed from the Sanctum Navis after the ritual... or what is left of them."

f48d1bce-2f12-4b55-94a9-955675e6610a.Text: "Which of the planet's inhabitants can we evacuate?"

d4d0bd37-2e9a-4d0a-9839-4861c95e4db9.Text: "We will not waste any time on this world. Pull back and begin preparations for translation to the warp."

bd4aeeed-3b63-474f-9469-17335ddcbb22.Text: "What is happening on the planet now?"

1964a2a4-7db3-404c-a062-67aedd5b300c.Text: "What is the current situation on board?"

e2cf520d-aa8b-4033-9152-ab46a75c4ff7.Text: "Why did you not send a shuttle to the planet for me?"

0914b073-8548-4b4e-986e-2878679c9042.Text: "Do we have any hope of retaking the planet?"

be7fe080-e050-4022-af6a-1428c274c053.Text: "Are the xenos in league with Aurora's cultists?"

8f0b37f8-4d55-46da-ae5c-871307cc1049.Text: "Enough. We have more pressing matters to deal with."

d63b6595-119f-475b-8ba4-86c48c296a88.Text: "Nobles deserve to be saved above all others."

52529813-69d5-4492-9a81-678a7a12f1e2.Text: "Have the pilots extract all of the commoners who have not yet converted to the Cult of the Final Dawn."

c965c76a-7860-4614-8ac3-b932f490caaf.Text: "The Miraculous Fusion Reactor must be saved."

ff03fe84-beae-4804-bda1-17a2e81746d0.Text: "Set an optimal course and carry out an orbital strike on the Electro-Priest monastery. Rykad Minoris must fall."

f1f70da4-9141-42b2-ab72-f88c12302f21.Text: "If we save even one person, it will be worth the risk."

46cc6dd5-3c53-48ae-9bb5-6d8cd2ebbb61.Text: "I suppose there is no point in doing it."

22936ff7-84e5-4344-ad60-8e282710ed45.Text: Sent rescue shuttles to Rykad Minoris.

3cb88e98-5dc5-46c6-b9a6-b32926f0170d.Text: Abandoned Rykad Minoris, leaving it to its fate.

2b2d7d66-6707-4aee-b692-826f1dcc37c6.Text: "That's it. There's nothing else on this planet to save."

c0171880-4a58-42ee-bf05-36450b675e89.Text: Destroyed Rykad Minoris with an orbital strike.

eb29d573-c1f3-4a06-9974-0ecbe2ee89e0.Text: "Why can we not try to evacuate at least some of the people?"

c7fa100a-07e7-4cc0-92fa-1d6b562f07b2.Text: "Before anything else, I will hear an account of what happened to the system's sun!"

0b594bfc-943c-46c6-9785-9cf31e55ba56.Text: "And how were they able to carry out their plan? Why were they not spotted ahead of time? Explain yourselves!"

5f895df2-2096-48eb-8141-4a27f5f262fe.Text: "I wish to know more about these xenos."

fc704f2d-9466-41e0-a942-5d7563c1b13c.Text: "Is there any chance that we could recover the Rykad star?"

04d06477-8b31-4987-95ca-b88f39e76604.Text: "We must send a shuttle to Rykadi Philia. The prisoners there do not deserve to be devoured by the warp."

30204e9b-d1cf-4620-994f-e535d50f6644.Text: "The fate of this world is no concern of mine. Pull back and begin preparations for translation to the warp."

a36a3d24-7717-41b4-9dd8-a936beef67fe.Text: "Do not forget yourself, Interrogator. One more objection from you and I shall forget all about the need to deliver you to Footfall alive."

03aa8e03-15b3-4eea-ae89-43b0b5be0180.Text: "I must do as I see fit. Perhaps I am acting foolishly in the Inquisition's eyes, but that is my decision to make."

e01cb70f-aa4b-4e82-9e29-680ffe90d078.Text: "Very well, Heinrix, let's do it your way. Set an optimal course and carry out an orbital strike on the Electro-Priest monastery!"

c8e18001-b70d-49ad-8142-e28f533e9eaf.Text: "If we cannot stage a mass evacuation, dispatch shuttles to save whomever we can."

72c99ab8-0b41-482e-93ac-8c926e08394c.Text: "Thanks be to the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g}, you are alive, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! We are most gratified by your return, and the crew is full of zeal to carry out any orders you may have."

12be23c9-6f7d-442c-a99a-7bfe7fc2b9cb.Text: "The {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_StarportNobleSaved}nobles{/d} you rescued at the starport have given the coordinates of shelters where we can find surviving aristocrats and their families. As for the common people, saving them will not be possible — we cannot control the crowds, they will rush onto the shuttles and overload them, making it impossible to take off."

330bcfcb-6ba5-4b6b-a9da-ec6170b70a90.Text: "Thanks to Sergeant Malgar's troops, we can manage the crowds of frightened {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_StarportCommonersSaved}commoners{/d} and prevent them from overloading our shuttles. However, I doubt we will find even one highborn citizen among them."

a2b19be1-6e4d-4dd1-aa35-7cf636b81e5b.Text: "The {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Navigator{/g}'s Sanctum is no longer empty, but the warp engine is still refusing to obey the {g|Encyclopedia:Enginseer}Enginseers{/g}. Without it, we cannot perform a {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}warp jump{/g}."

0d0c2f38-c1f0-43b7-b308-f4cad5bd20d2.Text: "I do apologise, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, but we were unable to receive your request for evacuation. The {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox-link{/g} was overrun with vile interference — screams, blasphemous hymns, and other equally sinister noises. Any who listened to the interference for a protracted period lost their sanity. Several dozen operators went mad monitoring the vox-caster in the hope of hearing your voice. Each one of them waited in vain."

6ab15c3d-c6c7-46dd-8325-75051fae6b3e.Text: "Our {g|Encyclopedia:Augur}augur{/g} operators are reporting numerous uprisings and other manifestations of the {g|Encyclopedia:Chaos}Archenemy{/g}'s powers at various locations on the planet. Based on the fragments of communications picked up by our {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g} operators, there is practically no resistance being offered by the governor's forces. Millions of people are converting to the blasphemous Final Dawn cult en masse and assembling in prayer circles."

d37785e6-3708-4544-9939-58fd54144e05.Text: {n}Pasqal's voice buzzes anxiously from his {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g}.{/n} "It may be angry, or perhaps it is lamenting the injuries it has suffered. I will immediately initiate preparations for a prayer service. If the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g} grants me comprehension, I will appease the {g|Encyclopedia:MachineSpirit}machine spirit{/g} of this vessel."

c2be1457-b986-4201-a0a8-5d934458d1e6.Text: "Thanks to you, we have salvaged many shuttles from the starport that we can now use."

ab4242ae-326c-4f37-9570-10b23c2ddd55.Text: "Thanks to you, we have at our disposal several shuttles rescued from the starport that we can now use in the evacuation effort."

cefec02c-f017-4a27-bcbd-157f13d5e500.Text: "Thanks to you, we managed to extract several shuttles from the starport, which are certain to be useful."

38abc364-af26-4a61-9a0c-ef0403626720.Text: "There are still people on the planet who have not succumbed to heresy and who are worthy of rescue. However, we do not have enough shuttles for a large-scale evacuation, and too few shuttles escaped the starport to change the situation."

4762900a-2741-44bb-88b2-dde17eed26d4.Text: "Consider it done. It is likely our shuttles will have capacity to evacuate some people as well."

b28ad89c-e4fc-4199-b2ca-aafca1a0cccb.Text: "We can rule out that possibility. The Drukhari would never ally themselves with the {g|Encyclopedia:Chaos}Archenemy{/g}'s worshippers. If I had to name one thing that Humanity and these xenos have in common, it would be a shared loathing for {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}warp{/g} corruption."

876e7b55-37ba-4f3f-be83-a466f4634de7.Text: "Consider it done. This will bring us to the limit of our capabilities — we have no more shuttles to use in the evacuation effort."

9576f80d-df6d-4d03-bf1c-c66278a98fa6.Text: {n}Heinrix glances at you with weary incredulity.{/n} "Are you proposing that we ask for it back? No, Rogue Trader. The sun is lost. We must accept that as fact and deal with the consequences."

76a08a4e-a158-472a-bc9e-176aad48cf78.Text: "Consider it done. It is likely our shuttles will have capacity to evacuate more people."

59ebd3fc-f58e-4caa-a221-1c4e4059bcbe.Text: {n}You see Abelard's expression change as if a shadow has suddenly fallen over him. He rubs his temple wearily.{/n} "As if we did not have enough troubles on our hands already..."

6de4b094-1249-4913-aebb-c763af34ba95.Text: {n}Heinrix clenches his fists for a moment.{/n} "This is complete madness — bestial, primitive cannibalism. By His light, {name} — Lord Captain, stop this! Order the strike on the reactor while we still can!"

5d9e4d3a-0965-4307-9343-f2c6f0027df8.Text: {n}Pasqal's {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g} emits a crackling hiss:{/n} "This is heresy. The Catechism of Maintenance and Operation categorically prohibits such sacrilegious handling of relics."

a27f2f9f-c864-4c09-b782-a3a3ca26a31a.Text: "There is no need, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. During the recent battle, our {g|Encyclopedia:Augur}augurs{/g} recorded the emergence of a vessel from the asteroid field. It approached Rykadi Philia, sent down several shuttles, and then retreated. It seems the prisoners decided to capitalise on the fact that all eyes were decidedly not fixed on them for a time."

46bcadd5-80bd-48a3-b34a-b5dac3bc692c.Text: "I fear that Rykad Minoris is lost. The situation is deteriorating by the minute — we must leave this system as soon as possible."

3b00893f-26fb-4a77-a176-10ab2b3466b3.Text: "Our only hope of stopping this process is to retreat to a safe distance from the planet and conduct targeted bombing of the Electro-Priests' monastery. If we blow up the reactor, a thermonuclear reaction will follow... the world's oxygen will evaporate... killing off the entire biosphere. In doing this we will save millions of souls from a fate far worse than death, and we will save Rykad Minoris from becoming an outpost of the Archenemy."

5eb25038-b551-483c-a481-4779f0cde48c.Text: "Any delay caused by loading and transporting to the ship will cost us precious time. Do not deceive yourself, {name} — if you indulge your vanity, you will doom billions to eternal torment at the hands of the Archenemy."

5afc5b7e-0ee8-4687-b5be-1d4b26f4274e.Text: {n}You detect a flicker of something beneath Heinrix's sanguine mask. Anger? Bitterness? Whatever it may be, it does not seep into the Interrogator's dispassionate voice.{/n} "In that case, I consider it necessary to point out that the mark of the Archenemy could infiltrate the ship along with any rescued people. Keep that in mind for the future."

c8b7f233-3d2f-448c-bb3f-da62919a0fee.Text: "I stand ready to fulfil the order, Lord Captain, but I must inform you that this course of action places the shuttles at great risk, and even if it is successful, the number of evacuees will be negligible. Do you still wish to begin the rescue operation?"

4c2fb487-c81d-41a1-bb9a-323434f19e1c.Text: "I concur with your decision, Lord Captain."

d386dd90-b18d-4aa6-bb0a-c06afcd461df.Text: {n}{d|Encyclopedia:Prologue_CutByKnife}Something{/d} lurking in the depths of your consciousness bristles at the passing thought of saving people. The spike of horror you feel takes your breath away — it is as if you are planning to steal the prey of a mighty predator. The planet is already wrapped in a thread stretching out from the warp — it deserves to have a new master.{/n}

b328968c-33d8-4401-86c7-c2f66857411d.Text: {n}Heinrix inclines his head.{/n} "The right choice, Lord Captain. May the sacred Exterminatus cleanse this vale of corruption."

46a81998-1b07-4406-8046-893879ecdeea.Text: {n}His face becomes impenetrable, but his voice burns cold.{/n} "I understand, {name}. With your decision, you are handing an entire planet over to the Archenemy, and I will be obliged to notify the Lord Inquisitor of what has happened."

4c81a3be-3cd5-4ff3-a82d-abdf0bc23681.Text: "You should have listened to me, Rogue Trader. We will all have to pay for this mistake."

6dd65913-cb42-4487-952f-97d8c88abf4e.Text: "However, there are still people on the planet who have not succumbed to heresy and who are worthy of rescue. Besides the small number of our own shuttles, we also have the shuttles salvaged from the starport."

69d63dfb-99d7-4d4e-856a-baf4619997d7.Text: {n}You detect a flicker of something beneath Heinrix's sanguine mask. Whatever it may be, it does not seep into the Interrogator's dispassionate voice.{/n} "In that case, I consider it necessary to point out that the mark of the Archenemy could infiltrate the ship with the priests escorting the reactor. Keep that in mind for the future."

90d0e574-8e8a-4ee5-8c86-418a722b1bef.Text: "Whatever fate you choose for this world... I urge you to make haste, Lord Captain! The planet is burning in raging flashes of crimson and purple, I can see it even from orbit. As do I see that the storm is already upon us. With every moment that we waste, it grows ever more difficult and perilous to steer the ship through the warp's turbulent currents."

cfc8d77c-b584-44fc-a7a1-a6110eac5925.Text: "I'm with the lady on this! Enough talking, we need to get out of here while we still can!"

159d2b53-d5a0-4bec-9937-148a420db301.Text: "For the simple reason that the transformation process will soon become irreversible and our sole weapon against it useless. The energy released by the bombardment could stoke the warp energies. I have never witnessed the aftermath of bombing a daemon world before... but there is enough evidence of such attempts for me to say with confidence that you do not want to see it."

d2044352-03a5-4939-a256-ae96b1dec5bd.Text: {n}The Vox Master falters.{/n} "Lord Captain... we saw a number of ships approach the sun. Black creations of inhuman make, amalgams of sharp angles and edges... They surrounded the star, and then... My apologies, but I struggle to find words that could describe that terrible sight. The xenos made the sun vanish into the void!"

d192ab17-d7d7-4b89-85c5-2a698219d27e.Text: {n}The Interrogator closes his eyes and grimaces.{/n} "Drukhari."

c3f776bf-1ad9-46a6-ad62-94103d2d8aab.Text: {n}Heinrix nods.{/n} "A breed of the {g|Encyclopedia:Aeldari}Aeldari{/g}, the most cruel and devious of their kind. The design of their ships matches the description provided by the Vox Master."

6c69ad9e-9307-4739-ac09-43fa5b37ed03.Text: {n}Heinrix gives you a keen look.{/n} "I am talking about xenos, Rogue Trader. The {g|Encyclopedia:Aeldari}Aeldari{/g}, one of Humanity's most ancient enemies. More specifically, I am referring to the most cruel and devious of their kind. The design of their ships matches the description provided by the Vox Master."

30c6e0e8-b09b-4e23-bd00-a497c0f014e0.Text: "Like all {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g}, the {g|Encyclopedia:Drukhari}Drukhari{/g} are a blight on the face of the galaxy, but their technological superiority is indisputable. They abhor and fear warp sorcery, which is why they rely on creations of their twisted intellect — and many of those creations are capable of things that may seem akin to sorcery to the unenlightened eye. The theft of a sun is one example of what they are capable of."

4c0ad27e-011f-4582-9200-f79f681cbc09.Text: {n}Heinrix responds in Vigdis's stead:{/n} "Hold your temper, Rogue Trader. Judging by the Vox Master's description, the system was infiltrated by the most elusive breed of the {g|Encyclopedia:Aeldari}Aeldari{/g}, one of Humanity's ancient enemies. Your {g|Encyclopedia:Augur}augurs{/g} are no match for the kind of technology they have at their disposal."

9a7cf7cc-b53e-4b29-b153-2404de4fb2e2.Text: "Yes, Lord Captain. I will immediately inform the navigation and artillery decks of the impending manoeuvre."

0b42276e-056f-4daf-8f03-198edb2eb1bd.Text: {n}Heinrix nods, his face frozen in a gloomy expression.{/n}

6ab188ce-09da-4cb7-adf3-4614962a71a6.Text: {n}Heinrix glances around.{/n} "The situation calls for immediate action, {name}. We can continue this conversation later if you so wish, but right now..." {n}He gestures at the deck teeming with tumultuous activity.{/n} "I believe you should assume command."

fc1a85c5-c011-4825-bfda-51e7729a5126.Text: "Only death can rescue these people. The Undying One has reached out His hand to this world. It is time for Him to reap His harvest. We must not reject His design lest millions of names never reach Him and instead perish in the depths of the Empyrean. Death is a mercy, Domin'{name}."

f1820ae6-2b2c-4acd-9a07-f6f2381ae113.Text: {n}Heinrix's eyes grow wide in astonishment.{/n} "The souls of millions of subjects of the Imperium are in your hands... reconsider! Rykad Minoris must be obliterated before it is in the thrall of the Archenemy!"

1178f58e-3c1b-4e82-a8fb-a1d85ec88c56.Text: "I'm afraid we do not have enough shuttles at our disposal for this mission. Transporting the relic will require greater resources than evacuating the people."

e08e69a6-1d73-458a-bbe9-b30746a8aa5d.Text: "The nobles you rescued at the starport have given the coordinates of shelters where we can find {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_StarportEveryoneSaved}surviving{/d} aristocrats and their families. As for Sergeant Malgar's troops, they will help to control the crowds of frightened commoners and prevent the shuttles from being overloaded."

eb6436f5-53c4-4384-a55e-9e22d76714d1.Text: "The lives of peasants are of little value. Our prime objective is to save the holy relic — the Miraculous Fusion Reactor — and the Electro-Priests who guard and tend to it."

f284e224-26f4-4443-8bb7-18f0fcf7de6c.Text: {n}Heinrix's eyes, like two deep, dark pools, are resolutely fixed on you.{/n} "The world is doomed — and its inhabitants along with it. The disappearance of the star was the final nudge toward death, the finale of the Cult of the Final Dawn's plans. I once witnessed a similar event — a world that had surrendered to the servants of the {g|Encyclopedia:Chaos}Archenemy{/g} and permitted corruption to enter too deep. At this moment, millions of people are bowing down before those who promised them salvation, and they are willingly giving over their souls to Chaos. A sacrifice great enough to bring forth a daemon world."

46c90efc-53eb-4cf1-988e-9939cb0a9464.Text: {n}Abelard furrows his brows.{/n} "Every moment we spend in proximity to a dying world, we are putting ourselves at risk. Your life, Lord Captain, is far more valuable than all of Rykad Minoris. The von Valancius dynasty cannot be allowed to perish! And so, lamentable though it is, we must rule out the idea of any evacuation."

41e892a5-6a33-4e17-ad09-8044f12d8387.Text: {n}The dark eyes of the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptaSororitas}Sister of Battle{/g} flash.{/n} "We must save as many as we can! This has all happened for a reason. Saint Argenta, whose name I carry with reverence and trepidation, is famed for saving the people of a dying world through the power of prayer. The God-Emperor Himself sent a star from the heavens that lifted the saint and her followers up to the sky, away from corruption and death. We must do as she did — direct all our efforts to saving those people who at this moment look to the heavens in hope of salvation!"

439b2942-0fbd-48b2-aaa6-ed4b27deda6f.Text: "Deviating from the Rite of Operation? That sounds dubious, especially coming from you."

bf37c8a9-a12c-4465-8c62-3ed19368f7c6.Text: "Magos Haneumann, a moment, if you will..."

cd73098f-6ee5-4c06-9c0a-13d75d90a3bd.Text: "Listen, can't you do all of this without me? I am no servant of the Omnissiah, after all."

6dc0e63e-b01d-462b-a85f-8fea8300718a.Text: "The lives of the entire crew now depend on my convincing the ship's spirit to start up a broken component — is that right?"

92bdb664-21cc-44bf-8cfb-a164c7bfb402.Text: [Place your hand in the cybergargoyle's mouth]

6e44a799-3ea1-486a-a5b0-d6b08d87d381.Text: "Pasqal, this is now your ship and your temple! So start acting like it, you blasted cog!"

02593713-b702-431b-8d59-d2b594bff1ff.Text: "Magos, if you do not bring this situation under control, we will all perish. Act swiftly."

d602be03-5012-4cc8-8abc-ca8a0b0a37eb.Text: "By my authority I revoke the inviolability protocol of the warp engine."

c1fbab70-22f4-4538-9444-e9ce28fad522.Text: [Reach out and touch the keys on the instrument panel]

08aa791b-8ddd-44d6-8138-d74c4efefc30.Text: "Do not ever act like a spineless greenhorn in front of me ever again."

40254e9d-6c34-499d-bf32-c8e0d396b0cf.Text: [Contact Ravor] "The Lord Captain speaking. I give the order to commence translation to the warp."

bf46b168-0f3b-40c4-baa7-e810a840fa5b.Text: "Now make this rebellious lump of metal take us out of here."

a21dd2c5-66fd-4814-b99b-35eebfffcd68.Text: "O hallowed machine spirit! In the name of the Omnissiah and the Emperor, reveal unto us your power and guard us against our doom!"

5b5e5df6-6544-453e-b5bd-ceae2c72a435.Text: "Useless pile of scrap! The Rogue Trader commands you — rid us of your malady and submit to my will!"

7ad623ce-c084-453e-90ee-fd9e9fb01d0c.Text: "I know little of the Omnissiah's sacred machines, but what I saw on the screen looked... strange."

0a655f72-7def-44bb-a58d-a2af95f4bf55.Text: "It appears the Omnissiah perceives and knows the power of your faith, Pasqal. He would not have worked this miracle otherwise."

d4dd73f3-ff9c-4666-863b-21c35ded08e8.Text: "Pasqal, I expected you to save my ship yourself, not pray for a miracle. Your performance is unsatisfactory."

ea42f623-5635-4dbd-b4f6-6526b54c64f5.Text: "I am just about tolerating your commands, Magos, but if you force me to stoop to asking you for instructions—"

c4a2be55-a5ee-46b7-8189-104af566a6b3.Text: "Crew, heed the word of Magos Haneumann! Pasqal, I kindly request that you take charge of this mess."

8f7e1264-8033-4d7f-9388-3e20a1236caf.Text: "Machine spirit, this is the Lord Captain of this vessel. Obey me and start the warp engine."

e863aa45-cd1b-43f8-bf04-5dcdcd71a81b.Text: [Gesture at the vid-screen] "What does it all mean?"

a031377c-aaea-46b8-be64-74fd7831d196.Text: "Magos, why don't you assume control of the technomats? Surely their contribution will speed things up."

484666e5-8147-477d-9855-4ba8094b0ee5.Text: {n}The bridge is in upheaval. The technomats' prayers mix together in a senseless cacophony while servitors work hastily to remove a hardened crust of sacred unguents from the warp engine's components. In the middle of all this tumult stands Pasqal with a data-slate clutched in his hands, seemingly disconnected from the flurry of activity around him.{/n}

f6fcb8b6-6e34-45c9-82f1-310ee308b96f.Text:
"Dogma bids that the appropriate rituals of cleansing and reassembly be carried out on the warp sextant. It is a long and labour-intensive process."
{n}Pasqal hesitates before continuing,{/n} "Our best chance is to bypass the sacred prohibition on directly interfacing with the conduits of the Motive Force. A faster and less orthodox route."

78be33db-636f-4000-af72-d7c961c3f929.Text: "Place your hand inside the throat of the cogitator guardian — the cybergargoyle, which has been assigned to guard the forbidden data-crypts. The dynastic blood extracted from your veins will serve as a key to the data core where the machine spirit dwells — to it we will offer our prayers so that we may bypass the protective protocol for defective connections and launch the warp sextant."

4b54d6e9-e241-4e86-b31d-5d143319876c.Text: "Benevolent code, a voice receptor!" {n}Pasqal emits a sequence of binharic signals and then is silent for several seconds.{/n} "I hypothesise that the defect is located in the analyser block. I register a reaction to the signal, but no processed response... A temporary override is permissible."

445ad0da-a457-4716-920a-fecb7a5cf9c1.Text: {n}The metal jaws clamp down on your hand, breaking your delicate corporeal sheath and releasing warm red liquid into its gullet. At the same moment, the image on the vid-screen before you changes:{/n}

62890605-2495-4657-88ad-78cd6d6e770c.Text: "This statement is true. In another temple of the Omnissiah, only His servant would be able to propitiate the machine spirit. However, the architects of this vessel's infrastructure made unsanctioned changes to the standard structure of the cogitator network..." {n}Displeasure creeps into Pasqal's voice.{/n} "...to equip the bridge with a machine that would permit its use by laypeople with a specific biological signature — members of House von Valancius."

9ca44eac-8860-4afb-80bb-8fc72aa65159.Text: "Your interpretation is verging on tech-heresy. However, given your rank, Lord Captain, I will nevertheless respond: for a layperson, you have described our position with relative accuracy. I place my hopes in His revelations and humbly ask for His guidance."

848036aa-813e-4ec0-bad9-b11daccf9c52.Text: {n}Pasqal shoots you a look of fierce pride and says with gravity,{/n} "You are right. This is my temple." {n}His vox booms with power:{/n} "Tech-comrades, heed my instruction."

4995b279-4e96-409f-940a-0c687b25bba6.Text: {n}Pasqal turns to you.{/n} "Lord Captain, the excess emotion in your command will render it unintelligible to—"

56badf91-4046-4739-b31f-d7a69ee883a5.Text: {n}Pasqal's voice shakes with tension.{/n} "That was a non-executable request, Lord Captain. Even if the voice receptor could interpret such a—"

38fa2f2e-82af-4724-8ab6-75f9a93fc936.Text: "Lord Captain!" {n}Pasqal stops and then continues more calmly,{/n} "Please. You will anger the machine spirit before we have removed the restriction."

15a680a4-c886-433d-a728-1b951e8fee43.Text: {n}One of the cogitator's vid-screens turns red. Pasqal sees this and raises his hand, signalling to the rest of the Tech-Priests, then withdraws a connector from his sleeve and connects it to the machine.{/n} "Servants of the Omnissiah, make now the offering of cleansed data-crypts to the machine spirit so that it may be filled with their true and calibrated data. May the Omnissiah have mercy on our souls..."

b68f5917-569c-4467-8982-3ef84622529c.Text: "Lord Captain, I now ask you to address the machine spirit. Speak the following command: 'By my authority I revoke the inviolability protocol of the warp engine.' The voice receptor will receive the vocal entry. Without your sanction, the machine spirit will not accept the data from the warp sextant."

77dc44f7-14ef-4298-88be-4ebb8706f716.Text: {n}In meek solemnity, the acolytes offer up the cleansed data-crypts to the warp engine one after another, repeating prayers of exaltation. After anointing the contacts with sacred unguents, Pasqal inserts them in the cogitator's slots. Your head begins to spin from the holy censers' foul-smelling clouds of smoke and from the loss of the blood that the cybergargoyle continues to drink from you, and the world swims before your eyes.{/n}

b9aecbfb-a59b-458b-9487-a68e7decdabb.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I will not tolerate such disrespectful behaviour toward the machine spirits in my sanctum, no matter how dire the circumstances may be."

805ca503-b62e-45a5-996c-0f7520768190.Text: "Let this mechanism awaken in renewed purity." {n}Pasqal enters a sequence of commands and raises his head, watching the vid-screens. Suddenly, he stops dead.{/n} "No..." {n}His fingers fly over the command runes, entering command after command. His mechadendrites, clicking their pincers, pull at one lever after another. The vid-screens fill with strings of symbols — completely incomprehensible to you, but clearly conveying something to the Magos.{/n}

502f3ce7-76b7-412a-91cd-ef3259cf7727.Text: {n}Pasqal mournfully grates out,{/n} "The mass of errors in the warp sextant's calculations is destroying the data repositories. The offering did not appease the ship's spirit... the warp engine cannot be filled with the Motive Force. We are trapped." {n}A moment later, the Magos continues uncertainly,{/n} "Perhaps, an alternative Ryzan protocol... or an emergency launch of the auxiliary coils..." {n}The Tech-Priest bends over the cogitator, but something in his pose and movements reveals his desperation.{/n}

96b3b3e3-1b04-4831-b07e-c2f57c345632.Text: {n}Pasqal echoes your sentiments with the triumphant sounds of a binharic hymn.{/n}

2f47a367-0c87-46b5-871a-a41307b0d24f.Text: {n}Pasqal intones dryly,{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, addressing a machine spirit in such a brusque manner is categorically unacceptable, even in a critical situation such as we now—"

cb5d1e3c-5917-4854-a4a1-30f3c05c3edd.Text: {n}Pasqal's next vocalisation goes unsynthesised as he sees the vid-screens begin to stabilise one after another. The strings frenetically galloping across the green background are replaced with stable images or regularly updating status reports. Only one monitor remains inexplicably red.{/n}

581c1905-acfd-4188-9ac9-d813cb7c1512.Text: "I must inform you that for the purposes of safety, complete reassembly of the warp sextant and updating of its datasmith blessings are required. If this is not done, then at launch the volume of aggregate calculation errors could result in the destruction of the {g|Encyclopedia:Cybercrypt}data-crypts{/g}. But as we do not have one hundred hours at our disposal, we must omit this procedure." {n}Pasqal looks down at the data-slate in his hands.{/n} "A minor deviation from the Rite of Operation for the sake of appeasing the spirit—"

a5e97e87-3810-49ea-bd55-04ef855371cb.Text: {n}The Tech-Priest's vox crackles in shock, but his report is as clipped and clinical as ever:{/n} "Registering: warp sextant activated. Registering: data stream stabilising. Registering: zero data errors found. Reporting: the warp engine is ready for translation."

8ef38364-a10b-4e6d-85b4-97a85760656d.Text: {n}Pasqal pauses.{/n} "I hypothesise that the ship's spirit heard our prayers and... intervened. It summoned the power of the Omnissiah to do something beyond my comprehension."

e0c66520-7ac6-4260-bd21-283c3167c744.Text: "I hope He will grant me a revelation that will allow me to comprehend the nature of this miracle." {n}Pasqal's vox buzzes with wonder and an undercurrent of exultation.{/n}

20a1a8bb-6006-4a72-98ae-fa701775de0f.Text: "I accept this review and impose a repentance protocol upon myself." {n}There is no true repentance in Pasqal's voice, only awe and slight exultation.{/n}

3d0e1241-6fe5-48e6-847d-1787810e6d86.Text: "Lord Captain — Ravor here. The crew are almost finished carrying out the orders given earlier, and I've just received confirmation from the engineering halls. I don't know what you did, but the warp engine's up and raring to go. We're ready to begin the translation to the warp, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

fce15f93-73f7-4ac7-ae81-d9efb0a58c8f.Text: {n}The prayers of the Tech-Priests surrounding the cogitator almost drown out the sounds of the bustling bridge behind you. Pasqal, poring intently over the {g|Encyclopedia:Dataslate}data-slate{/g} in his hands, extends a {g|Encyclopedia:Mechadendrite}mechadendrite{/g} toward you.{/n} "Please take your place at the cogitator, Lord Captain."

a44ff71e-41e2-42b3-8f19-c14ec1c7e210.Text: "I studied the data and discovered a machine node that was damaged as a result of the heretics' sabotage. The functioning of the warp sextant was tampered with and the ship's spirit, aggrieved by this violation of the Rite of Operation, is now rejecting its calculations. I sought a way to rectify this error and have concluded that your participation is necessary to do so."

331c80c7-6506-40d2-bb67-fd64036318d8.Text: "Lord Captain," {n}comes the crackle from Pasqal's vox — part beleaguered sigh, part interference.{/n} "I am still poorly acquainted with this voidship. The acolytes here have adopted their own customs for conversing with the machine spirits — they do not know me and they express themselves in a little-known dialect of {g|Encyclopedia:LinguaTechnis}Techna-Lingua{/g}. I will trust in the Omnissiah that my analysis of the data was correct — it means we have a chance of appeasing the ship's spirit."

29e35219-c3ca-4d8e-b847-1da03efef8d0.Text: {n}The huge machine in front of you is lit with dozens of vid-screens and hundreds of lumens. The blinking lights and endless rush of symbols and digits on the green background make your eyes water, and a vague sense of alarm simmers in the depths of your mind — the typical reaction of a layperson when confronted with the magnitude of the Omnissiah's creation. Among the numerous controls you see the mouth of a cybergargoyle, the same as at the gate to the Warrant Chamber.{/n}

05a982bf-aa64-4b29-a8e9-e8fd5913a258.Text: {n}Pasqal's voice becomes imbued with imperious force:{/n} "Servants of the Machine God, heed my command. Acolytes, prepare the incense instrumentation for the liturgy of machine spirit propitiation. Senior Technomats, recite the prayer to generate a current data report. Operations will be marked with the campanological protocol '{g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g} Rejoice!'"

7f13b57e-ed33-4555-90ed-4387953476cc.Text: {n}Pasqal's voice grows quieter.{/n} "The laws of the Omnissiah know no exceptions, and so in this ritual I will remain at your side to placate the wrathful machine spirit in whose abode you will be intruding. Follow my liturgies, Lord Captain, and may we receive His blessing."

0dbcbcc2-44a5-4d5c-b9d0-bbf375c0d2fd.Text: {n}At the sound of your voice, the cogitator's servant, whose bronze-bound skeleton is built into the cogitator housing, shudders — with a screech, its skull rotates toward you and then stops in that position.{/n}

5cd64847-6052-4be1-afde-d05a1f91b3a0.Text: "Accept my humble apologies, Lord Captain. Contact with such an unusual creation of the Omnissiah, which this cogitator certainly is, disrupted my focus..."

bdf12c96-02f8-4ed0-b6a1-9a115b140673.Text: {n}While the other vid-screens are filled with more and more strings of symbols, the monitor in front of you blinks and its static image changes. Pasqal is too engrossed in his ritual to notice.{/n}

646e5a8b-16d2-4048-af84-3cfeb9ec11f3.Text: {n}After a few seconds, one of the data-crypts mounted on the cogitator begins to emit sparks. A moment later, another data-crypt does the same. The next bursts into flame and gives off foul-smelling smoke. Around you, the Omnissiah's servants break off from their prayers, and someone bursts into frantic pleading.{/n}

65114c56-d5ff-4dca-ba41-ecb9d5b7ffa6.Text: {n}Pasqal turns toward you, his flickering visor betraying his anxious state.{/n} "Lord Captain, I—" {n}He stops short when he sees the vid-screen.{/n} "Distorted transmissions from the data core.
