He and his escort went ahead, and..." {n}She grows paler.{/n} "I haven't been able to contact them over {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g} for a {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Jail_Late}very long time{/d} now."

226cbf92-5052-4580-a47e-79976702b1f2.Text: "Yes..." {n}She bites her lip.{/n} "No one expected this. Master Casteglia is a nobleman from a respected governor house and a vassal to House Winterscale! All of a sudden, he proclaimed that Rykadi Philia was now his personal domain, that the prisoners were his subjects, and that he would never bow to anyone again... It's pure heresy!"

fe70b103-dc09-493a-9dec-5a34e167cd85.Text: {n}She sighs quietly.{/n} "It's a personal matter. Master Casteglia, the seditious warden, is Lord Evayne's childhood friend. When my lord heard of the riot, the news saddened him greatly and so he rushed here without delay — in hopes of bringing his old friend to his senses, no doubt."

749b74ac-bcd4-4369-8596-1e8f1a419512.Text: "I don't dare delay you any further. Good luck to you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! I will contact Lord Evayne's party over {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g} and inform them of your coming!"

2a942020-bcfa-4e6c-92a9-0c85a7b544d3.Text: "Evayne... Evayne..." {n}Abelard mutters, stroking his beard.{/n} "One of his distant younger offspring, yes. That's as much as I know about him, which means he hasn't distinguished himself in any meaningful way."

df1850ed-7a2e-44ec-8aa0-fdadeb5fd82d.Text: "Give me a reason not to execute you on the spot."

cfe03bbb-b8bc-48e6-badf-0225ae48c008.Text: "Tell me more about the warden and the riot."

4cd1846c-87c9-44c7-ab8f-976d456e3e29.Text: "If I spare you, what do I gain from it?"

bbc6f300-c82f-42f7-9d4e-77ebef7be0ea.Text: [Attack] "I have changed my mind. By His name, I will not let heretical riffraff such as yourselves leave this place alive!"

c02dad99-7480-46b4-a5a1-7dbdaa60fc3b.Text: Took the pirate prisoners into your crew.

1f5e797b-da41-47ab-845a-ba268d0630e6.Text: "I shall not leave you here to die at the hands of the warden's henchmen. Go, tell my pilot that it is the Lord Captain's order that you be sent to my ship. You will join my ship's crew. You have my personal pardon as a Rogue Trader."

d8bc1128-7d5a-49ec-80ff-089523d1bae2.Text: "You are pirates. I came across a voidship belonging to your associates. They were planning to break you out."

2de957c0-7783-461b-b1d3-991de42e5fd6.Text: "Thank the {g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Throne{/g}! Normal-looking faces! We thought we were going to die here with these nutters!" {n}The old man with a gap-toothed smile drops his weapon and holds out his hands in a placating gesture.{/n} "Please don't shoot us, Yer Nobleness! Let us speak a word!"

a0a9df99-72f5-4821-9cf4-4e6e9d10d538.Text: "Here's the deal: we're honest, quiet inmates. We didn't want to riot! But, well, sitting it out wasn't really an option either. The warden's lapdogs made short work of those who refused to join in the festivities. So we had to — you know — play along. But that's all it was — play! We never meant no offence to Governor Medineh nor to the lawful authority of House Winterscale."

acba8339-8cee-4083-9c13-90f3eb9a95b5.Text: "Or that's how it was at first. Then the warden decided it's the optimates, not the guards, who should be in charge of punishments. And that it wasn't the overseers' job to watch the prisoners work — it was the optimates'. Well, let me tell you: that's when these goody two-shoes really started to shine! The guards aren't even in the same league as our dear fellows, the optimates. In the old days, we had maybe five or ten stiffs kicking it a week, and now, well now we were lucky if it was only fifty."

822e1a70-1451-49f8-9feb-b65f37f4f5b3.Text: "And that wasn't even the end of it! Warden Casteglia moved out of his chambers to live right in the quarry, under the dome. And I think something in his new home really scrambled his brain. He began spouting the wildest things like 'the optimates are saints' who will 'behold the truth.' And he started taking them to the quarry. Not all of them returned. The ones who did, you wouldn't recognise them, more beast than man. They were butchering people left and right. Even guards. And overseers. The warden himself had armed them! And that's the whole sob story. But I knew it from the moment he let us have dinners: oh, this won't end well."

89e9aabe-999e-4c34-a4d2-76c20bdcad4f.Text: "Hmm, hmm, now, how can lowly jailbirds hope to thank yer noble self... Ah! I have an inkling. You see, us here, we're — how should I put this — different from the rest of the prisoners in this place. They're all petty thieves from Rykad Minoris, debtors, guttersnipes. They're no one serious! Now, we, Yer Nobleness, are cut from a different cloth altogether. We're fortune seekers from the void."

b6480f49-8917-4572-ac87-4acbad3c5a4b.Text: {n}Heinrix tilts his head slightly to one side, listening intently.{/n}

c79e04c8-73d9-4c37-b915-df4e12de8a15.Text: {n}The man grunts, huffs, then makes up his mind.{/n} "Well, now that's outta the bag... Our fellows were supposed to come get us a long time ago, but they got tied up somewhere, void kraken's gullet with them! And in all this time we had to wait, THIS happened... Pardon me for trying to pull the synth-wool over you, it's just that we want nothing to do with this whole warden nonsense. So what now? Will you let us go?"

22a46966-a3e0-49b5-aea4-8244dec69981.Text: "Why don't we tell you where on {g|Encyclopedia:Footfall}Footfall Station{/g} — you know Footfall, the only shipyard and the best market in all the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g} — yes, so... where on Footfall you can find some very serious, business-minded people, and how you can get yourself a very special discount from them on some very special goods?"

114dc8ba-35c4-4efd-ab22-e616ba328272.Text: "You're serious?" {n}Heinrix glances at you with slight disgust.{/n}

937dbcf8-fdaf-40ee-92fb-e616ad5a8f29.Text: "Oh, that's so great to hear, Yer Nobleness! Just great! Now there's a true aristocrat, not that warden creep! Now then, Yer Nobleness, where was I...?"

bf356e77-c5cc-4319-a81b-bf215419422c.Text: "If you're ever on {g|Encyclopedia:Footfall}Footfall Station{/g}, there's this district there, the Shadow Quarters. It's called that because it's located behind the statue of our holiest {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g}. I've known folks who called it something else, also on account of it being behind the statue. Don't repeat their mistakes, I tell you! Reverend Hieronymus wasted no time finding and burning them all."

9e3ab6b8-7a1a-4ea4-b67b-b8686b18e38f.Text: "Forgive an old man for getting distracted... So! Footfall. The Shadow Quarters. There's a bar there, built into the remains of an old ship. And in that bar, in the back room, a certain Ryzza does her business. Tell her Grandpa Bakhval says hello. You'll be her favourite client in the blink of an eye! There we are. Well, Yer Nobleness... we'll be going now if you don't mind?"

7b0d0cae-02d5-4e8a-99ec-99470fd617b9.Text: "Will do, Yer Nobleness!" {n}The old man smiles slyly and leaves.{/n}

02808c25-8efb-46ca-ac73-c831c7521ee2.Text: "Uh... Thanks. We are most grateful, Yer Nobleness!" {n}The old man glances at you somewhat sceptically but then smiles and leaves.{/n}

33b6721c-bc02-475a-bdd8-f0245bc12fcc.Text: {n}Heinrix lets out a sigh of disappointment.{/n} "Old Ryzza. The most well-known fence on Footfall. I was hoping to hear a new name."

33744489-8908-49ff-8677-9189f5145e04.Text: "Well, this is a welcome change — talking before shooting. Still, Lord Captain, the look of this... ragtag bunch hardly inspires trust."

a0cf09c0-767d-4ec7-869c-c1e8d8d0289a.Text: {n}Idira cracks her neck.{/n} "Sure, no problem. Today you tell us a little lie, tomorrow you stick a torpedo in our side from that ship of yours... if it doesn't fall apart the moment our helmsman sneezes in its general direction."

91848403-ed02-462b-83b7-e948cfa1336a.Text: "This is unwise, Lord Captain. Most unwise..."

ec459162-2779-479f-89aa-886fe5a34b84.Text: {n}Pasqal enquires demurely,{/n} "Does the fact that this serf is presently confined and therefore has previously betrayed the trust of the Imperium's servants need to be vocalised? Or is it evident to the lait— persons uninitiated in the sacred mysteries of logic?"

a38b2f91-7663-460b-9975-63e3badbc92b.Text: "Pah, why soil yer tongue talking about that heretic? But if you insist... Here's how it is. The warden of this here prison, the honourable Master Casteglia, was a crackpot from the start. The previous warden ran things the proper way: prayer, one meal a day, work, a punch in the chompers from the guards, work again. But the new one... Do you know what his first decree was? He introduced lunches and dinners! By the Nine Devils, that's three meals a day! The man was obviously stark raving mad."

9b09b2f5-116b-480b-8f7a-e9170fd5dd16.Text: "Give us a chance, eh? We just want to wait until everything blows over and we can go back to our cells and quietly do the rest of our time..."

7f3dd967-147d-4228-8095-a327f9c846af.Text: "Things only went downhill from there. The guards quit it with the teeth punching — the warden forbade them. Instead, the overseers started counting which prisoners were digging up more things in the quarry or swinging their pickaxes harder or whatnot — and then, would you believe it, they put together a list of best workers! And if someone on that list also showed good behaviour, that's when they'd get promoted to an optimate. That's the upper crust among us jailbirds."

62a15082-e305-4bd8-8360-8e294f23007d.Text: {n}Idira nods knowingly.{/n} "The old codger's right. Whenever nobles start giving handouts to commoners, something always goes wrong." {n}She notices your look and catches herself.{/n} "I mean that with all due respect, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, no offence intended."

f5df1123-ae14-47b6-a178-a6b13f3ff4a7.Text: "The most serious kind, Yer Nobleness! Have you heard about the Fellowship of the Void? It's the largest pirate alliance in the Expanse. There is no leader, of course, but there are some terribly serious captains who decided that cutting each other's throats over loot was — what do you call it — counterproductive. But cutting throats together — now that's anti-counterproductive!"

e8569912-b722-4332-8102-ea50894d9dd1.Text: "And, well, their joint efforts leave them with an excess of spoils, so they need to dispose of it somehow. And I, Yer Nobleness, just happen to know someone who handles such kinds of dealings on behalf of those very serious people."

97ba7ce0-1ee5-42e3-b6df-40c81eb8d7f1.Text: "A repentant, honest heretic. How novel." {n}Judging by Abelard's tone, the Seneschal is utterly unimpressed by the old man's ingratiating monologue.{/n}

69a87863-4634-4420-8d03-bcde778c69a4.Text: "The lowborn's speech is mottled with colours that conceal his true, darker hues. This old man has a long history of lies, and he is using his wiles on us as well, but... I see no foul corruption or ill intent in his words."

76de5798-7ced-4f85-b12c-7f5796548ed7.Text: "Heresy has found its way into the walls of this esteemed House. It is a black day for the Navis Nobilite."

e1d3f8c8-ced0-4c08-b668-42f6478a61f3.Text: "Remain vigilant! The ruinous powers of the Archenemy test our faith."

3035b643-b281-4259-a4e3-8472ac2453fa.Text: "Pathetic worm, you dare to argue with your master?"

5d7bcd27-bd1b-4d29-8e94-765edd036c44.Text: "Confess — what was the old man's last command? What are you planning?"

95f80a1e-d28c-4c7f-9e10-ca905539b81b.Text: "It was not you whom I swore to serve within these walls. My lips are sealed."

eb631287-826f-471a-bc7d-0d4bbee17547.Text: "Give up, Keeper. You have lost this battle. Again."

e0425182-9f32-45b6-819f-2baf3abc117f.Text: "We're getting nowhere with these ones, sir. Permission to execute them?"

5994457b-82c6-4e47-8ecd-3c32e6f23328.Text: "Wretches! You will be consigned to oblivion for your transgressions against House Orsellio!"

6c1cd360-301d-467e-9405-8622141d6684.Text: "Immortal Emperor, deliver your servants from peril..."

f74be827-3543-48a0-93fc-a213e291d332.Text: "Prayers will not help you, servant of the damned."

7ea8751d-43ff-4035-9d51-4f8c76d1af39.Text: "In the name of House Orsellio, I command you to execute the infidels!"

c7aabfca-fe17-4dee-b795-3e6f6ad58b17.Text: "Master, we have some strange guests on the station."

c0765b2a-87dd-47a0-abe5-0db9d171570c.Text: The library is full of treatises by the most distinguished scholars of the Imperium, from Astra Militarum tacticians to Adeptus Mechanicus Genetors.

fa250f8f-857e-4292-95fd-246a08cb02a1.Text: While no one appears to be living in the cage, somebody still filled the trough with dried fruit and fresh water.

4b7d7222-f368-4162-97c2-6b9c7327ff27.Text: "You think I am a monster, Felek? Fine. Have it your way."

b6907221-7767-46ce-be5d-1501af31911e.Text: "Don't touch me! I... I will manage on my own."

b2252699-4e1c-499c-a4b6-8aeff40625a7.Text: "You will pay for this treachery, Felek! What... What is going on?"

f8af0f9a-79dc-4a54-8c51-968089b25cfe.Text: The Lady Navigator's private library is brimming with essays, novels, and personal accounts from the trailblazers and explorers of the Imperium.

f3b8ddc1-f55e-4a47-bcb6-d1e8a056a3c9.Text: The Lady Navigator's statue looks pristine and new.

aa75e5e6-d00c-4d21-92e9-d04d5a6748db.Text: All of the servants perished in the crossfire.

68693b99-7a33-4708-aeae-67eba5013770.Text: Most of these unfortunate souls took their own lives by slicing their guts wide open.

b6a51bd9-67dc-447b-83aa-c392c37475ac.Text: For some reason, the Archenemy's twisted influence has found its way into the station.

1e4b63a5-897e-41ad-a99d-93a8533451e6.Text: "That is enough, boy! You betrayed the Child, our House, and Tisiphone herself! Surrender!"

d3799912-eeb6-449d-a3db-9b778347cec9.Text: "I am the saviour of our House! And I am prepared to pay the ultimate price. Kill them!"

fe012ffd-6838-4f2a-bb72-c8d46682991c.Text: "Rogue Trader... you treasonous worm! I knew I should have killed you."

65c02d9b-6e1f-4034-a397-2e50133f0532.Text: "We should weld the doors shut. Who knows from which side the renegades will attack."

9cc80aaf-3e82-4064-ab08-6adc8238e061.Text: "Hmm. Address your questions to Master Felek."

672e2045-6225-43da-b693-03b3b45e8e86.Text: "Hurry! Each minute may cost the mistress her life!"

0b99bfed-316e-44da-a143-24cebd74ca48.Text: The luxurious feast was left untouched.

846d512a-3e74-4c4d-9365-6e06250c6f3e.Text: "Sir, are you all right? We can't hear anything."

161aabfc-2988-478b-99b5-bcff78fb6e3c.Text: "Now I see... You are in league with them! Is this an insurrection? Yes, indeed... Death to the traitors!"

b43e42f8-415c-446e-8bdc-23060238c95a.Text: "Sir, what are you doing? Get a hold of yourself, sir!"

05a62b7f-31dc-47e3-b73c-5eb9ec96626f.Text: "I know, you are all traitors... Traitors, all of you. They told me, they whispered... Hey, who are you?"

cba2a146-6e2d-4447-ae0b-c51d517825a8.Text: "More of Felek's henchmen? I WILL DESTROY YOU!

9dfadc52-4d4d-4b0b-98e6-2fa5dac575e3.Text: "Where are we? Everyone is here. Turn it off. Turn it off! The Child... Who is speaking? Dinner is served. The stars always shine so bright..."

33e295a5-3b2f-41a5-b446-1fe5ea173ea8.Text: "Sir, pull yourself together! We cannot contact Rykad Minoris!"

198746e3-a73b-4e81-bbfd-59dbe21a1bf6.Text: "What is it they want? Hush! The Child is sleeping. Thirty-three... So what? This is our last stand, but the tongues fall silent..."

5da821b5-0e22-48ce-bf60-ea3a31f134a1.Text: "Why are the shadows moving? It's like they're alive... Is it because I hit my head?"

f9eba86f-2bdb-4fbd-ac43-cdf20a2d14d3.Text: "Hurry up with the search while the veil still holds. You... are hardly fit to handle the daemons."

cbf4410c-b0bb-4200-a691-d1f78b7652fe.Text: "Too many voices... I can hear their rage. 'The door is open — come and avenge us,' they say."

19e6149c-fed6-4e68-b4e6-cc9573648963.Text: The heavy door is secured by a sophisticated mechanical lock. There must be a way to unlock it from somewhere else.

9ac5990f-691d-4f37-bd4d-e20c873474b4.Text: "They all... just lost their minds! Please, don't kill me!"

b67ee17b-7779-488c-9c9a-33fb13c4a323.Text: The caustic stench of reagents sears your nostrils and broken glass crunches underfoot — somebody wanted to destroy the laboratory. Or find something.

784869b9-dd8e-4271-847c-0ee9c1889ac8.Text: "A-are we staying on the station? But isn't it about to...?"

8cea1887-881e-4069-8c84-3216050bacc5.Text: The servant opens his mouth in prayer and you see the stub of his mutilated tongue.

13639490-533c-4d4c-9c00-d12e526a1cec.Text: "The Child's safety is paramount. Glory to House Orsellio!"

d5ddec0f-680f-44e2-812c-2cc88c58044f.Text: "At the ready! The conspirators are trying to break through to the guard rooms!"

a8cd64bc-cdae-4e7b-8337-80e1f41c1dec.Text: "Stand firm! We must not let the miscreants defile House Orsellio!"

0f489342-4ef0-4bac-a9e5-6171fe5134ac.Text: "You... don't want to harm the Child, right? Or... do you?"

bf58511b-dcaa-48fc-bb71-735e0d9dfcb9.Text: It is as if the painting was rendered by several different hands — the timid, uncertain lines are interlaced with rough and furious strokes, coming together in arcane shapes.

885d78d1-b69c-4b35-b13d-93146b6faccd.Text: "God-Emperor, protect the Child from our enemies!"

a65889da-d08a-49a5-a019-6ad102f31cff.Text: You need the mistress's blood to create a control rod.

a7d5a0db-313e-4c35-8c14-a87b29458f1c.Text: Most of the deceased are lowborn servants in elegant attire. All have had their tongues surgically removed.

81c95d92-2a31-40cf-a6ae-7b3acff55776.Text: This injury was caused by Navigator warp powers and is untreatable by any known means. It will slowly and inexorably lead to death.

912750a4-b5c7-4122-8f78-160469f4fc04.Text: "While this may be an alliance of convenience, we shall follow you."

ee5ac323-bd39-43af-953d-c306f77c4779.Text: "It is about time we repay those who betrayed our House. Come."

3b137a7f-2a6f-4a25-bc83-b7a866816ddd.Text: The corpses were brutally mauled by an unknown force, their faces frozen in grimaces of terror.

a0240c6d-f3b0-4c1e-b141-8f22cd7203a0.Text: The corpses were mauled by a force far beyond any mortal capacity. The faces are twisted in pain and the hands are fused with improvised weapons: tools, scissors, and cutlery.

887e4ca8-1469-490c-9c20-85b7e00e479f.Text: The valet flinches at your approach. A silent greeting escapes his lips.

49aa2f7e-bbf3-46f8-956e-f6a4bca7eb78.Text: Uve has had his tongue cut off, just like the rest of the lesser servants of House Orsellio.

d0f09b04-eef3-4a95-858d-1be05574f638.Text: The flesh of the deceased has blossomed with necrotic flowers, suffusing the air with puffs of iridescent spores.

7d23c94d-dd93-4886-a3d5-21db13ef3e2b.Text: It may seem impossible, but the corpses whisper between themselves: "...WE — must — HeLp— HELP — the mistress — THE MISTRESS — tHe mIStReSS — we..."

a2002c79-efad-423c-8c09-f747d6c5b723.Text: Distorted images flicker in the shadows. They linger unseen, but the unremitting gaze of hundreds of eyes constantly slithers across your skin.

6a24983a-0f39-4100-afee-1988e534e881.Text: "This is how the Immaterium responds to the power of those who have dominion over the warp. Psykers... or Navigators."

0913fdf1-be4c-49e3-b1d0-7634c846a498.Text: "I'll be damned! Somebody gave the veil between the worlds a good thrashing, and not too long ago at that. I think our guests from the other side are seeking to break through to our world."

c1f26a23-9494-4f81-9f58-196fdddb2ef5.Text: "We are done fooor! They'll kill us aaaall... I can't take this anymooooore!"

f6a33889-13fd-45c8-a840-7bdfb39b0f9c.Text: "It hurts so much... The pain in my chest!"

09e6a731-4426-4f08-aca5-42e7ac6ff321.Text: "Where is the Child? Is she safe?"

6f758beb-4643-47c6-8369-751d84f25c8b.Text: "What is the curse that has taken hold of everyone in this room?"

e3509984-38e9-473e-a6f9-030e3c21a0c6.Text: "Lady Cassia, I am here to help you. Please, calm yourself."

316b4173-f929-4217-b589-5f0c573b53e3.Text: "By the Emperor, if you do not stop your sorcery immediately, I will shoot you in the head!"

172042e4-dfcd-4a8c-aced-ad157379f3dd.Text: [Bring the stone into contact with Cassia]

9c766997-817e-411e-8761-d3e153e9a6ca.Text: "I want to know what happened between you and Felek."

bca153c7-173d-47a0-9bf9-c8de19770dcf.Text: "What service do you ask of me?"

9f2acfe1-f08f-4b8e-8aed-d1c937ae4c63.Text: "{name} von Valancius. It is a pleasure to make your acquaintance."

3a4abac6-f4ff-4fa9-a5d0-f0ce3d5ae471.Text: "It matters little, you profane creature. You will die regardless."

194db74e-cf2c-4b6c-a1ff-3687107e71fa.Text: "My presence here was requested by your faithful servant Felek Orsellio."

545ee180-88e8-4bc5-8093-948907dac4fb.Text: "I mean you no harm. I came to seek the Navigators' aid."

964c5c15-c1ed-4fa5-ba9b-30c83bb39d21.Text: "I have already dispatched Felek. Do you want to follow him?"

9fa9058b-23d6-40f5-8b82-7423424c6a2d.Text: "I should bring Cassia to Felek as I promised."

ee6122ee-0e6e-4614-9837-30f206986b1d.Text: "It does not matter what my name is."

6543326d-067b-4b97-979b-017769253c63.Text: "To you, old man, I am 'Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} Rogue Trader.'"

dcb0b9f4-cece-47e7-a711-d1d75dc5a741.Text: "Felek is a true monster. Let's do away with him — together."

a1316e95-50bc-440d-b495-68b921f8dacd.Text: [Attack] "I'm sick of this station! I am taking Cassia, and you and Felek shall suffer a less enviable fate."

308c6e09-e1d4-4e6a-a435-6538dbfee5a3.Text: "I have learned from reading documents on the station that the Child is unstable. What does that mean?"

e3c915b6-650b-4dac-aaf7-c26bae66213f.Text: "Felek said that the Child is a monster. A legacy of tyranny that must be wiped out."

302224b3-71ab-43b9-a0ba-4dcba957cff1.Text: "I am simply seeking a Navigator to join my crew."

a0fa4960-d61b-4dda-b9f0-f3132f3a6ca6.Text: [Attack] "Felek was right — you are a crazy old man and you deserve death."

39bc4826-d61f-48ef-a6f1-d4c278b82003.Text: "I will be taking Lady Cassia — now. You may come with us or perish."

c7e4942c-4014-4d51-bad8-abbd1246bb96.Text: "The station is in a state of emergency. Perhaps we can help one another."

288492b5-885a-4e13-bc49-d82680ec7e02.Text: "How could you lose control of your own station?"

6cb63eb9-0dcc-4aac-8f18-d018dabc3f3d.Text: "If you are waiting on help from that quarter, then I'm afraid I have bad news — Evayne Winterscale is dead."

3ea165b4-d3e4-4dec-b06e-7ff82282fe7e.Text: "At present I am trying to determine what is happening on Eurac V."

4ff9ab29-3045-45ca-8668-c1c78c77cc99.Text: "Felek accused you of treachery, Theobald. Why should I trust your words?"

133c7297-eae7-4196-a603-355a923d349b.Text: "I've had enough of this Navigator feuding. That's it — I am leaving Eurac V."

0e19b647-4ad1-41da-a7dc-513fcc3f00cc.Text: "You are talking as though you expect to die here."

9538098e-60cf-48e5-b281-06b3a08d141f.Text: "Let's just say that Evayne Winterscale had cares of his own to deal with, so he entrusted the password to someone worthy — that is, me."

22004851-d3be-4049-990a-847d02757db8.Text: "You need help — there is a medicae deck on my ship."

8f89ed46-1818-4702-81a0-64d723d3fb2f.Text: [Attack] "I came to capture the monster on Felek's orders — out of my way."

4caa227c-c7cc-4252-8517-09951923e83c.Text: "You, girl, may address me as '{mf|Your Lordship|Your Ladyship} Rogue Trader.'"

a42c85ef-0321-49a6-8115-53e73667b804.Text: [Attack] "I have come to rescue Lady Cassia, and you, traitor, will fall at my hand."

41d8e545-0379-4469-9878-098fe9cf8d28.Text: "I believe I have made my decision."

2b8ab201-7dbb-4639-9c60-c5f3223f10c8.Text: "You are seriously injured. How do you plan to protect the Lady Navigator in this state?"

5a8baed7-07da-42d2-9ee5-17b5664183d9.Text: "I saw the reports on the station's main cogitator — Felek stopped the transmission, your message only got as far as the nearest world."

05e74bfc-9d2f-4d4a-9fd3-e7a0e393fcbd.Text: "I am looking for a Navigator to join my crew. You look like you'll do."

10be1733-51fe-4f67-b43c-107fe8b2f9bb.Text: "In the name of House von Valancius I sentence you and this monster to death!"

aa682929-1725-42d9-be6e-3fdc6ab88f48.Text: "The last thing I need is a monster on my ship. Cassia shall remain here, and you shall serve as Navigator on my vessel while you still live."

4486a4df-a281-4e06-a892-a100e7d64e7b.Text: "You will answer for everything you have wrought on this station. Surrender and slowly step away from Lady Cassia."

3822e0bb-817e-421c-8c0e-ace8466a7134.Text: "What vile creature is this? Argenta, rid the world of this heresy."

14d24213-7dcd-457a-b9f6-03f440ebdd3c.Text: [Attack] "Enough talk, old man. I shall kill you now and take what I came for."

d70d50c1-277c-4a19-8d19-a0a1135d36ca.Text: Overcame Cassia's crushing despair with willpower.

7c2c18ec-f7f6-4144-b0e7-47c3a8d00df8.Text: [Overcome the crushing despair] "I know why I am here... and so I will stand strong against any illusion!"

0857a590-dc45-444a-85f1-9694a6be3627.Text: {n}She wearily shakes her head and lets out a drawn-out sound similar to both a sob and the howl of a small wounded animal.{/n} "What... is happening? Was someone calling my name? Are all the betrayers... dead already? And you... who are you?"

151f8609-73c9-4189-b89e-a5208965a256.Text: {n}The pale figure with unnaturally long limbs covers her face with her hands, which are deformed with talon-like nails. Her deathly pale face is coated with blood that continually streams from her scarlet-misted eyes. Her spiny gills, slightly hidden under her dishevelled hair, twitch nervously at your approach.{/n}

7c449c1a-f463-4fd5-8617-332d09dcfa13.Text: {n}Only now do you notice the third eye on the young woman's forehead, hidden by a jewelled ornament. And when your eyes meet, you sense overwhelming, soul-smothering power.{/n}

31fa17d1-dd49-40b6-ac14-735f11c1e05c.Text: "Emperor preserve us, can the von Valancius dynasty be in league with the Orsellio traitors? Wardens, close ranks! Don't let them get to the Child!"

48765a7e-733a-4259-9838-4639e1ad010b.Text: "What you are saying makes no sense. I am the Keeper of Eurac V and the first protector of the Child. Only one person poses a threat now that I can see, and they are standing before me. Tell me, who are you, really? Answer, or you will know the wrath of House Orsellio."

61b6760d-f124-442e-b6af-cd85ffddd733.Text: {n}Idira emits something between a moan and a drawn-out whimper.{/n} "Ow-ow-ow! As if my own little pals weren't bad enough, now this one's barging into my head! Somebody stop her!"

f1e3becf-bb96-45d6-9ecc-3a506186881c.Text: "I am registering abnormal activity in my tear ducts. The salt being produced by my body may negatively affect the performance of my respiratory apparatus. The vulnerability must be rectified. It has been logged."

851d09e9-bcd4-4629-8c01-8d94f36352e2.Text: "What? Why is everything so... dull?" {n}Lady Cassia blinks, waking from a vision and continuing to rub at the place where the stone was set. Her scarlet eyes look cautiously around the room, then at you.{/n} "What did you do to me? I... I can barely see the colours! And your colour... it is muted. Who are you?"

f1c09ae3-20f1-4ebe-964c-6502d67c860f.Text: {n}Hope glimmers in the Navigator's milky eyes.{/n} "Save the sacred Child! Take her away from this station! I fear I do not have... long left." {n}A bluish rivulet trickles down the old man's chin, and he wipes the mutated blood brusquely away with his sleeve. You glimpse strange burns covering his flesh under his clothing. The slightest movement must be causing him unbearable pain.{/n}

d83381d4-003c-40f5-877f-b5af997c2b63.Text: "Is that so? Please share your thoughts."

08839512-c9cc-4e8c-9e7c-c7877275b01e.Text: {n}She looks at you for several seconds, then begins furiously shaking her head.{/n} "No! No, no, no! Get out! Begone! Today has seen enough scarlet! I see them all as they go — gasping pale green, wrapped in black shrouds of hatred... No more suffering, it disturbs the ones beyond..." {n}As she speaks, you are gripped by overwhelming panic. Your heart is pounding, you can feel your blood pulsing at your temples, and your thoughts are racing. Run. Run? Run! But where?{/n}

8fd07a8b-b442-460e-8787-12a1abddca26.Text: "We can join forces, but afterward, the Child stays on the station — with me."

39b2bff3-ace7-412f-865d-ed37c17f381f.Text: "How dare you!" {n}The Lady Navigator's hands reach for the wound, her eyes searching for the perpetrator. When her gaze lands on you, her ruby eyes widen as though she is seeing you for the first time.{/n} "What... Who are you? You are not a warden... or a servant... How dare you touch me!" {n}Pain. Resentment. Dismay. Fear. The torrent of unexpected emotions again overwhelms your soul — and immediately retreats, leaving only alarm ringing in its wake.{/n}

a4960ecf-1775-4968-8061-e93d5f1a912e.Text: "How dare you injure the defenceless Child, the scion of House Orsellio? Whoever you are, you will pay for this transgression with blood. Prepare to die!"

db1e2757-2f75-4fc5-846b-b4715475c4c8.Text: "My eyes fail me, for they are unable to make you out as either enemy or ally. I'm warning you, one wrong move will bring the wrath of House Orsellio down upon your head!"

fe9b3117-3d8c-4786-9b6d-8490d12c81ce.Text: {n}Theobald interrupts him with an indignant shout:{/n} "Enough! I will not have you questioning myself or my charges within the dominion of House Orsellio!"

676f13a0-f576-465d-b6ed-8d29bd873d03.Text: {n}A few minutes or perhaps hours go by, and reality slowly drags you back into the spacious and luxuriously furnished chamber. To the weeping people, to the unusual creature who you have now learned is yet another {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Navigator{/g}. You come to your senses, well rested and mollified.{/n}

b0401bc9-4d39-4b25-b848-6a994c9e6a01.Text: {n}Unease settles over her features and she nods cautiously.{/n} "Pardon my manners, {name}. I did not expect to make such a gracious acquaintance in such a time of great sorrow for our House."

931e1d25-a7f6-4f4a-acb0-956a4d4f2a04.Text: "I'll grant that you do not look like pirates who have come coveting the riches of a wrecked station, or like scoundrels in Felek's service. So who are you?"

0eb0d420-3c7e-421c-b61d-6e6c024bbf67.Text: {n}Cassia's face turns stony.{/n} "On this station, slanderers are fed their own tongues. And then discharged out of the airlo—"

e10fd948-24cc-416b-852d-0bccf9f0abae.Text: {n}The fish-eyed Navigator goggles at you in response.{/n} "To perceive the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g}'s light, one must look with the heart. By all the gold on the Throne, my distress signal reached Rykad Minoris after all! But you... you are not from the Winterscale dynasty."

882c66bf-d6b2-45a6-8bd5-73b57271b4b4.Text: "You forced your way onto a closed station and slew one of its Keepers! Felek may have been a traitor, but he was also a {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Navigator{/g} of House Orsellio. And now you are attempting to threaten me as well?" {n}The old man tilts his head, looking at you mistrustfully.{/n} "While your name and intentions remain unknown to me, I will continue to view you as a threat. And I will not tremble in fear before you either."

5309cc83-fd5a-481b-be10-749000e46fc0.Text: "I?" {n}Cassia blinks in surprise as her pointed nails reach for the jewel on her forehead.{/n} "I am afraid I cannot respond to such an unexpected—"

ca353710-2214-4ffc-903d-89a382f1d7a6.Text: "You can see the fruits of his villainy for yourself. He decided he was not bound by his duties to the legacy of the greatest of our {g|Encyclopedia:Novator}Novators{/g}, Tisiphone Orsellio, who led our House to prosperity for countless years! Foolish boy... The renegades clouded his mind. They sought to seize control of the dynasty before the sacred Child had come of age and taken up the Novator's throne."

7ef998c9-e5b7-4be9-918e-02569b4d1486.Text: "You..." {n}The old man shifts, revealing his face to you — it is threaded with jet-black veins, and his bulging, milky eyes bear a striking resemblance to those of a dead fish. A sickly sweet scent assaults your nostrils, as if the old man's flesh is rotting inside his decaying husk.{/n}

7032682b-c561-4f04-887e-6be6a16db381.Text: "Good. That is good..." {n}The old man nervously licks his lips.{/n} "But do allow us to say our proper farewells."

b68353c6-aa6b-4aa4-ac98-505a0f9c5b2c.Text: "Felek... is my wayward student. He came to Eurac V as a callow youth. I personally mentored him and entrusted him with the care of the Child. He was like a son to me... But he proved to be just another traitor. He sought to steal our most precious treasure, the heir of our House — our sacred Child! To revel in power with others like him, casting our House into the abyss. To pervert the centuries-long traditions of our family."

252af450-0488-4e82-a455-86468f21e1c4.Text: "So choose whose side you are on — a murderous traitor, or the lawful scion of a noble House." {n}Theobald speaks these words softly, looking at the unconscious young woman with reverence.{/n}

f9aac49c-5766-4e00-a48f-205e98242b3c.Text: {n}Theobald dips his head in favour of the proposition.{/n} "Allies are always welcome, even temporary ones. I will revive the Child — do not be alarmed, the power of House Orsellio's heir will help us to destroy our enemies and shield us from Felek's Navigator forces. But you... rest for a time before the battle."

d48f6018-cfee-493e-97b2-d894273b5a9f.Text: "And you believe him? After everything he has done to the station? Felek only wishes to dispose of the heir and take the reins in his bloodstained hands. Do not besmirch Lady Cassia's good name. The Child is the holiest and most innocent creature on this entire station."

47cc1d2a-40f8-4cd5-a293-9469616aaa5c.Text: "What... you have been ransacking Eurac V like common marauders? Whatever you may have read, I have no intention of enlightening you further about House matters. The Child is well, if exhausted by recent events."

c249ce46-da46-4832-a703-5b6fa5920744.Text: "Then you have come here for nothing. Eurac V is an observation station. We do not make contracts and we do not supply Navigators. I must tell you plainly—" {n}The old man winces in pain, but you do not see any wounds on his body.{/n} "—you have chosen a most inconvenient time for recruitment negotiations."

00294c0c-79d8-440f-9bc3-487ce92940b8.Text: "My answer is no. And I do not wish to revisit the topic. The Child will stay on Eurac V, and I by her side. Our ships will come to our rescue at any moment — I managed to send out a message before Felek seized control of the station."

cb94642c-9426-4240-aa0b-31c9d362f4cb.Text: {n}The Navigator anxiously combs his fingers through his bushy beard.{/n} "So that's how it is. Our only loyal ally in the system — gone, along with my hopes of support from his dynasty."

f989f28c-3509-493b-96b7-027b2d22ba64.Text: "Do not thrust my errors in my face! I am twice your age — and twice as wise! Take my advice: trust no one but yourself and the Emperor. Even those closest to you will betray you for gold, power, or a far-fetched idea of a bright future."

dbefb19d-15c9-4d64-9bb8-d3c0781230bf.Text: {n}The fish eyes look at you with unwavering dignity.{/n} "You were not supposed to see me, or Felek, or the sacred Child. Navigators are highly paid for their loyal service to the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g} according to His will... No one would dare judge the guides of Humanity, the chosen of the Galactic Sovereign Himself."

10db059b-5c5b-4470-984f-7d7775878f60.Text: {n}And... quiet descends. Your breathing evens out. Your thoughts become orderly once more. Your heart is no longer trying to beat its way out of your chest. Lady Cassia looks away wearily, breaking eye contact with you. Another scarlet tear rolls down her pale, gaunt cheek.{/n}

944ca089-2a97-4b14-b5e0-a32d8472522f.Text: "{mf|His|Her} {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} {name} von Valancius, heir to the greatest protectorate in the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g} and bearer of the sacred {g|Encyclopedia:Warrant}Warrant of Trade{/g}, extends {mf|his|her} greetings."

ba200a59-34cb-4542-95b3-68b80a146720.Text: {n}You direct all your attention inward — to your heart, currently shackled by another's suffering. Under the gaze of your burning inner eye, the despair and pain begin to dwindle. The darkness in your soul dissipates, the lump in your throat shrinks — and you discover that you are standing in front of a bizarre creature, a young woman whose tears you seem to have dried along with your own.{/n}

4dcd516f-c297-4960-89f4-90809cfe328f.Text: "Attempting to hide your family name will only make me more suspicious of you. However... weak though my eyes may be, they can still make out the noble coat of arms on your attire. And the compass — the regalia unique to Rogue Traders."

718fb114-8bcc-46b4-9bc1-edc799a2bb27.Text: {n}The impassive expression on the Navigator's deformed face does not flicker.{/n} "Haughty. As I thought, you are indeed of noble blood."

7983696c-aab9-4a05-a1df-966952d09776.Text: "Another {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} in our corner of the galaxy? How interesting. Your kind always make an appearance in desperate times, ready to cut a deal that benefits one side alone."

9edf4a58-1640-4cb0-89a7-0ab296190334.Text: "Given that you have not so far drawn your weapons, your intentions are probably peaceful. And so House Orsellio now asks a service of you — save the life of the Child in exchange for future cooperation. Do not hurry to answer, think on it. You can make yourself an ally or an enemy of our House today — you decide."

e443eb2d-d68f-40b5-808b-008e5ecada60.Text: "You came to our station of your own volition — no one summoned you here. You chose to come before me and the Child... and you even plotted with the traitor Felek. It is too late to retreat, now you must choose whose side you are on."

393fb11d-8feb-4d17-b804-5538c7b59863.Text: {n}When you bring the ice-cold charm into contact with her — startlingly human — neck, the stone burns you! Glowing murkily now, it leaps from your hand and, with a hiss and a strange crystalline chime, merges with Cassia's skin!{/n} "Ahhh!" {n}howls the Lady Navigator in pain, as her sharp nails try to find purchase on the glowing stone. But a second later, there is no trace of any wound — only the subtle illumination of the artefact under her pale skin.{/n}

e8237ce0-58ef-4d05-9d48-302f97977124.Text: {n}...is what you wanted to shout in the face of the creature who has enveloped you in its strange power. But your body refuses to obey you — the cacophony of sobs, wails, and weeping around you merge into a single stream, and you become part of that stream. Your hands drop your weapon and reach unbidden for your face. Your jaw clenches and your eyes prickle with tears. Foreign emotions pierce your heart so deeply that you forget your bloodlust — and you plunge into despondency, viscous and sticky.{/n}

e798058c-a831-4502-81b7-d63a5fb3659f.Text: "The affairs of the Navis Nobilite are no business of interlopers..." {n}The half-blind eyes strain to make out your shape.{/n} "...even ones of noble blood. And while your name and intentions remain unknown to me, I will continue to view you as a threat to the Child."

a9ba91dd-7287-4bef-9017-4e567cebab28.Text: "Defending myself before strangers... I never thought I would fall so low." {n}The old man looks at the unmoving Cassia and shakes his head in resignation.{/n} "If the Child's life were not at stake... Very well, I have no choice. Or proof of my innocence."

74807495-b0ba-4e5b-9345-20751fc71602.Text: "Felek? Did he...?" {n}Cassia's crimson eyes widen, but you cannot say whether out of fear or surprise.{/n}

6dc8d8c4-e73c-422d-9ee5-c7435f55330a.Text: "I can give you my word as a member of the Navis Nobilite — if the honest word of an honourable man counts for anything with you. I guarded this station against calamity and incursions from without to the best of my ability. I forced the wardens to strictly observe security protocols, I personally selected every servant... and I faithfully protected the Child during the coup."

b13399b1-1f47-43ad-bbe9-a1ca585f3d3b.Text: {n}Cassia raises an eyebrow in confusion.{/n} "So you are... a servant? Open your mouth, I need to make sure your tongue was chirurgeoned and you were properly branded with our House se—"

126331de-6b18-4388-aba3-7441acde5c61.Text: "And under whose tutelage did you learn etiquette? The Space Wolves? I am Lady {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Navigator{/g} Cassia Tisiphia Evriaella Orsellio. You may address me as—"

386034f9-ee82-456b-822a-cc17296f7e77.Text: "Save the Child and deliver her safely to Regent Aaronto, acting head of House Orsellio, in the Koronus Expanse. Rest assured that the reward will be worth your effort."

9c9fb501-f24c-40bc-b98d-16ace2bf5017.Text: "As I said already, House Orsellio ships will be here soon. We do not need your help." {n}The old man turns away to hide the uncertainty on his fish-like face.{/n}

1294e1af-b5de-4cf9-aacf-b3e65beca6ff.Text: {n}Bushy brows furrow in displeasure.{/n} "Access to the station is no mere privilege — Evayne Winterscale broke the vow of silence he took before House Orsellio! The God-Emperor will judge him. But what about you? Who are you and why have you broken the isolation of Eurac V?"

753225db-25cf-4f19-9e94-372c12313b0e.Text: {n}Theobald sighs heavily.{/n} "And still... I do mourn Felek's passing. The lad was a talented Navigator, one of the best. Today House Orsellio has lost yet another Eye..."

24d94b96-3876-4906-9cf1-e3053d1c6019.Text: "Then what brings such an important personage to a station of House Orsellio, one of the greatest Houses of the Navis Nobilite? And what do you want from me? Speak."

abffc7de-fb76-4e49-86ad-e1b2367368ff.Text: {n}But Theobald only shakes his head.{/n} "No, I am the Keeper of Eurac V and I will perish along with my station. On that note... I have other matters to attend to."

7be652c5-517a-451c-9b91-de91ef485c6e.Text: "Where have I heard that before? That's it — Master Felek was babbling something similar... Or did I imagine that? Was it just one of the possible outcomes that I foresaw? Ahh... my head is killing me..."

3105a7e2-aa79-4de8-b5ab-ea1b67e4444c.Text: {n}A bluish rivulet trickles down the old man's chin, and he wipes the mutated blood brusquely away with his sleeve. You glimpse strange burns covering his flesh under his clothing. Even the slightest movement must be causing him unbearable pain.{/n}

a7972d07-c32e-4c4b-9e1c-0a2c8972f12d.Text: {n}Theobald frowns again, trying to control the tremor in his hands. But despite the pain from his unseen wound, the Navigator is bearing up well.{/n}

ebb31668-1437-4624-b30f-b374c4b96826.Text: "So what are you proposing? That I hand over the Child to you, abandon her to the mercy of fate, cast her out into the darkness of the galaxy with a stranger? Alone?" {n}The Navigator's voice breaks into a shout.{/n} "No, I will not allow it!" {n}Theobald stands over Cassia's body, shielding it, and the air around him turns sweltering.{/n}

799020cc-021d-48fe-b0d6-5d13a28ddc8a.Text: {n}The heat in the air dissipates and the old man lowers his arms wearily.{/n} "All right. Save... Save our sacred Child, Deliver her safely to Regent Aaronto, acting head of House Orsellio, in the Koronus Expanse. Rest assured that the reward will be worth your effort."

7dc040cf-dafd-4f9c-949f-63a75e607168.Text: "The last thing, then, is to deal with the traitors on the lower level. My... final battle in the service of the sacred Child." {n}Theobald looks wistfully at Cassia's insensate form.{/n} "I will revive the Child — do not be alarmed, the power of House Orsellio's heir will help us to destroy our enemies and shield the Child from Felek's forces. But you... rest for a time before the battle."

51efae5c-17c3-44e6-a422-c5fb66ffeffe.Text: "I will answer your questions — I will tell you as much as you are permitted to know."

9758b26e-70dc-412f-9e70-b40d7ce0a375.Text: "Heresy..." {n}Argenta looks at the tall figure with a strange mixture of anger and sadness. Then she lowers her head, and her white hair veils her face.{/n}

88c00458-4d95-4ff2-9d32-77acfece0994.Text: {n}Theobald frowns.{/n} "Curse? You do not understand the sacred gift given to our Child. When the Child is sad, we all weep. When the Child smiles, we all laugh giddily. And if the Child wants blood, the world turns crimson. The Child's will is the will of the great Tisiphone, for she is the heir of House Orsellio."

14948f16-c180-4efc-968d-96e7b71bbdda.Text: {n}The muscles in Heinrix's jaw twitch as he struggles to maintain self-control.{/n} "'This' is one of the Navis Nobilite, the noble caste of mutants who guide Humanity's voidships through the treacherous warp. And now, Rogue Trader, stop asking stupid questions and go negotiate with your new Navigator."

5d423b4b-61b5-45df-98be-af93ebd23ca9.Text: {n}Heinrix jerks abruptly as if he intends to dash forward, but someone else is quicker.{/n}

f7438867-aab8-482c-ba6b-26a4395e6757.Text: "And they call me dangerous with my 'witchcraft,'" {n}Idira mutters under her breath.{/n}

ef29458a-14f5-418e-9ba3-28d05c487ff0.Text: "Watch out, Lord Captain. This one's so deranged it's making the whispers shriek like crazy... He might just open that eye of his..."

1760a159-5e48-4fe6-b496-a0eb3684cb59.Text: "Threatening the head of the dynasty is a grave offence, esteemed... whoever you are." {n}Abelard places a hand on his weapon.{/n}

4dc28bea-0d2b-4932-926f-e72aa5dfa0b7.Text: "I know we came here for a Navigator, but... after everything we've seen, I've got some reservations about this girl."

332291ab-7a37-49a9-a127-8983775eaa04.Text: {n}With a stony expression, Kibellah wipes the single tear that has run down her cheek.{/n} "These are not my emotions. Mine have long since been cut out of my soul. Give the order, Domin'{name}. I cannot withstand this delirium for much longer."

6b5eaf4b-d478-418e-9656-7d77bda9a154.Text: {n}Argenta looks at Cassia, and a painful furrow appears on her brow.{/n} "Such a fragile thing with such a heavy burden upon her shoulders..."

6f47cc8c-c1c0-4299-a4e4-f3776f7b163a.Text: {n}The Interrogator looks from the unconscious Cassia to Theobald.{/n} "I presume this Navis Nobilite House has reasons for treasuring the Child other than uncontrolled outbursts of warp sorcery. What might those be, I wonder? A young, immature Navigator who likely hasn't yet completed her training—"

b8b87cd5-66c6-4a86-a4df-f0e864067125.Text: {n}As the otherworldly creature's gaze slides over you, your entire core shudders in terror. Flashes of {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Signs}past warp nightmares{/d} reemerge from the shadows of your memory... and paralyse your will.{/n}

88d10809-9659-4bf5-9293-65dfdff3c0ea.Text: {n}You gasp for air in terror, drowning under a crashing wave of pain, you cannot catch your breath... Hot tears burn on your cheeks. Why is this happening? Why is it happening to you? Why do you feel so lonely and in so much pain? Do these feelings even belong to you?{/n}

0d59aacb-5b72-4e16-be32-c158d9d9592a.Text: {n}You are enveloped in despairing grief, and an invisible hand closes around your throat, cutting off your breath. Your limbs seem to fill with lead, your heart hammers in your chest, and the desire to turn and flee — from this room, from this station — almost gets the better of you. At the last moment, you master your emotions and your will pushes back against the illusion, forcing it to retreat.{/n}

21adfd5c-de72-42b8-93c3-7c6a5a23b668.Text: "When it is a matter of life and death, every word matters." {n}The Navigator casts a concerned glance at Cassia, now lying in a dead faint.{/n}

e13e9db9-024f-42f2-b8f4-59eb313a190d.Text: {n}Argenta is painfully slow in reaching for her weapon, and the next moment her head drops to her chest.{/n} "I cannot... I cannot!" {n}The face of the Sister of Battle twists in anger, but her cheeks are glistening with tears.{/n}

5a8be534-533c-413f-847c-5b81043fb942.Text: "Lady Cassia, I presume." {n}The Seneschal stares in the {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Lady Navigator{/g}'s direction with a faraway look, then turns sharply away and awkwardly wipes at his eye.{/n}

796e977d-985b-4613-b527-d054ef2023e4.Text: {n}The heavyset old man, who has been kneeling nearby, erupts into low sobs. His eyes, swollen from crying, dart desperately around the room, as though the veil of ignorance has just been ripped away from them.{/n} "The Child... Lady Cassia, where are you? Sacred Child? {g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Throne{/g} preserve—" {n}Despite his venerable age, the Navigator leaps up and rushes to the young woman's side.{/n}

3e2a91ed-8111-4680-974b-ecb3c06e7f03.Text: {n}The young woman remains deaf to your words — tears are streaming down her pale lips and cheeks, and her frail body will not stop shuddering — yet you are still bound by her strange sorcery, and your limbs almost refuse to obey you.{/n}

66e067d9-d452-48c1-9584-3ed28e9c8418.Text: {n}She tilts her head to one side.{/n} "Help me? I do not need help. The {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} protects. I have seen His light, which warms the soul across billions of stars and hundreds of systems. In the depths of the {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}warp{/g} and on the fringes of realspace. His light never goes out." {n}A strange tranquillity envelops you. You no longer hear the wailing, the sobs, the sighs. You are surrounded by nothing but endless emptiness, quiet, calm. And endless loneliness.{/n}

2626bda6-be15-4672-8f91-8388686fd45a.Text: {n}You take one unbearably leaden step toward her. Then another. And another. Your entire world narrows to a single target — the strange creature who has raised a tempest in your soul. As you lift the hand holding the stone — interminably slowly — you notice that up close Cassia looks more alive, more real.{/n}

d78c3dfc-f22c-4efd-bb52-7d0f1ec6addc.Text: "Lies! You want to get your hands on the Child, but House Orsellio will not allow it! Wardens, close ranks! Defend the heir to your last breath!"

6b3264e8-2662-419b-9dab-ef4ab84d920c.Text: "Rash words that will cost you your life." {n}The old Navigator balls his fist, the veins on his arm bulge black, and his third eye opens.{/n} "To me, defenders of the Child! Duty calls us now!"

bb101349-fc2b-46b6-b485-ad4ede34097a.Text: {n}Theobald shrugs indifferently.{/n} "My service to the House is coming to an end. The wounds Felek inflicted on my flesh will never heal. I am... dying — praise the Throne, slowly enough to see that the Child is taken care of."

2320597e-3bdc-4a6b-a0ae-23090cff128a.Text: "I give you my word — I will deliver Lady Cassia safe and sound wherever you wish."

8f65d58d-253c-4a51-9f3e-f6b57874579f.Text: "I do not care. I am not afraid of you."

8dd94ee2-9cd0-4f1b-bd2d-eaf29e109e89.Text: "Forgive the urgency, but we should leave the station immediately. The systems are unstable and may fail at any moment."

9d070990-428f-4320-9eac-71a18fee5b3c.Text: "You can secure new servants once we're out of here."

4b0351fb-f1ab-4878-b35d-3016e6a93667.Text: "I regret that we had to meet under such circumstances."

329581ad-b7bb-42d3-b2da-f2c382f90c82.Text: "Enough tears. You are coming with me — now."

d6ee3f8a-450a-4dc7-8a1e-83c8aed4615c.Text: "The stone restrains your power, and that suits me very well."

42354172-0862-4042-b94a-4a7272c974c4.Text: "I did not know the stone would suppress your power. We will find a way to rid you of it, I promise."

2080f2b5-89f5-473b-85c1-6b7faae2b29e.Text: "The stone will not kill you. Let us set this issue aside for now."

c0a958fe-1ac0-4ef8-84bb-c9e3a4bb65db.Text: "If you wish to leave the station alive, you must first sign a contract. You will undertake to serve as my Navigator until I release you from that obligation."

992a006b-8ad1-4297-9729-255a150fedec.Text: "Lady Cassia, I, {name} von Valancius, Rogue Trader of the Imperium of Man, offer you my protection and grant you shelter aboard my vessel."

297842f3-b2bc-4e8d-8f0a-9c5c285a2b7d.Text: "Lady Cassia, let us aid one another. Become my Navigator, and I shall restore you to House Orsellio at the earliest opportunity."

2f862e62-aa7d-4119-b59b-4e8c42238044.Text: "Would you explain what just happened? You killed Felek just by looking at him!"

0b200b61-47b3-47e3-83bd-b43e7a317cfb.Text: "I promise, we will find a way to rid you of this artefact."

33cef480-4931-47dc-af0c-8261915cf702.Text: "All who can be saved will be given succour on board my ship."

aa4027e4-dbfc-4065-b27d-7dbabbd9079d.Text: "I will provide you with every necessity. Naturally, this includes servants."

0c77dad3-b883-4808-aae6-2152c57ded1f.Text: {n}Theobald coughs up bluish blood — the armour plate on his chest is perforated in a few places, and there is a tangle of metal and viscera where his abdomen ought to be. When the {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Navigator{/g}'s pale eyes find Cassia, he quietly rasps,{/n} "Now... this is your burden, Child... Survive. Return to the fold of your House, as... your destiny demands..."

622cdce1-af1e-4521-bfc2-02bc49fe3ae2.Text: "No... Don't leave me alone in this violet-brown haze! Wake up! Your mistress is giving you an order, do you hear me?" {n}Cassia looks at the Navigator's body in bewilderment, and you are overwhelmed with an inexplicable sense of loneliness and grief.{/n}

9bf9116b-6705-4a8a-baba-7ff6af8bdf74.Text: {n}Abelard salutes the fallen man.{/n} "He was a fine seer of the {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}warp{/g}. He fought for his mistress until the end."

024d3442-50c4-487d-a340-0cc435a3bb0c.Text: "Oh, Theobald..." {n}The crimson tears stain the Lady Navigator's white skin once again, but this time her power does not make everyone weep along with her.{/n}

1742319d-ede4-4e52-b00f-b791999e38c0.Text: "Please, Child, do not be stubborn. Remember your duty to the House and let those thoughts bring you strength."

cc1c705e-5129-4809-ace9-07b415a165ab.Text: "What... What are you going to do to me?"

668191fd-9c67-4bfd-8f70-451baa9dd4c0.Text: "And after this, I am supposed to give the Child to you?" {n}The old man hisses through the remains of his teeth.{/n} "This reeks of Felek's chicanery, and you fell for his tricks! Or perhaps you knew what would happen." {n}Theobald helplessly clenches his fists.{/n} "But, no matter, Regent Aaronto will find a way to rid the Child of this curse."

a038ddaf-9e2f-4060-9551-71fb6974e60d.Text: "Stop it, the Child does not deserve such suffering!"

1cce7e72-b036-4c6c-a6b0-ef1285eea26b.Text: "Striking a deal that profits off the other party's desperation... Just as I thought — you do not have an ounce of honour in you." {n}Theobald turns his fish-like eyes away in disgust and addresses Cassia:{/n} "Child, let this be a lesson to you. A cruel lesson, but you will have to accept this state of affairs for now so the House can achieve its goals. Remember, what matters is that you reach Regent Aaronto."

b75dcea1-b634-44ab-9ffc-8715c0294256.Text: "You need not worry, Child. Your people are ready to die for you at any moment, be it under a hail of gunfire or in the ruins of this broken station. And so it will always be."

338859ef-f61e-46bb-b1fa-732928cd06f5.Text: "How low can a man sink in the pursuit of power... Is your hatred of me really so strong, Felek?" {n}Cassia's ruby eyes fill with bloody tears as she looks the traitor in the face, and your heart is wracked by unbearable grief.{/n}

ef0dcf44-5ea2-4a2a-8420-04fe9283fab5.Text: "I... I've never..." {n}Cassia is almost whispering, but quickly regains her composure, raises her head, and enunciates calmly:{/n} "I did what ought to be done to renegades of House Orsellio. You need not worry, Rogue Trader — I have no such power over the lives of ordinary people."

8e37fce3-89d3-443a-bbc5-f8e20c53c049.Text: "The words fly off your tongue and scorch everyone around you with sparks of venomous green, but then they settle on your soul as leaden ash. You know, the more ash there is in someone's heart, the faster they lose their own humanity."

c9595b1f-7339-4d50-912b-c351d99642e1.Text: "I have no reason to lie, but you still won't believe me without proof. However, I have read the writings of Fergus-Kleon and understand your train of thought. Distrust is an innate defensive behaviour in most creatures, so I take no offence."

0fb9d429-af6c-4521-bdb5-c255fdf0cd7e.Text: {n}Cassia frowns.{/n} "You are engulfed in an aurora of crimson, your hope for pain and battle. But my gift will not help you with that."

be958093-6c5a-423d-b699-7cc7110729f1.Text: "What need have I for your regrets? I... I just want things to go back to the way they were before." {n}Cassia looks sorrowfully at the destruction around her.{/n}

4bab12ca-c65c-4af0-8ee7-4c9f07692f44.Text: "And if I refuse?" {n}Cassia juts out her trembling chin and gives you a defiant look.{/n}

2c78d014-bca3-49e4-ae4e-7fe97a78d899.Text: "But this is my..." {n}Cassia hesitates, searching for the right word.{/n} "My... home."

28cd3c5d-6482-4c0d-8041-3f4e88dfc6f0.Text: {n}Theobald coughs up more bluish blood. It stains the armour plate on his chest, but he remains standing.{/n} "Wake up, my mistress. My sacred Child... It is all over now. It is over."

3f7ac936-075b-4eae-8ae2-2dc1ed92b11a.Text: "What... What happened?" {n}You feel the crimson eyes roving over your face.{/n} "You. I remember you. Have you come to save us?"

5885b0f7-f67e-4a3a-aa70-3dc29aeca633.Text: "Child, please, listen to me very carefully. One last time." {n}The old man bends over in pain and wheezes hoarsely.{/n} "You will now embark on a voyage with this {mf|lord|lady} to rejoin the House and its regent in the Koronus Expanse. I... I will not be able to accompany you on this journey." {n}Another trickle of blue blood runs down the old man's face, this time from his nose and ear.{/n}

99f2b1ce-8a77-46c7-930d-b3c1609819e1.Text: "No... Not you too. Don't leave me alone in this violet-brown haze! You... you are coming with me — your mistress is giving you an order, do you hear me?" {n}A hot wave of despair that is not yours washes over you. Your palms sweat and your heart freezes in panic.{/n}

94dda90d-9782-47d9-a733-0b79f2cda8e6.Text: "Mistress, I fear this will be your only order that I dare to disobey. I am the Keeper of Eurac V, and alas, I have less than a day left in me. Allow me to serve you one last time and honour my final duty to House Orsellio. I will remain on the station and destroy the secrets it holds."

86a89877-d020-4ff3-8fe9-d4b8ea57cbca.Text: "Explain what all this means! Is it betrayal? Or sabotage?"

235062e0-6bcd-48e1-a26b-6ad528027428.Text: "Uh, yeah, no. Enough's enough. I've had my fill of waterworks, thank you." {n}Idira brusquely wipes away her tears with pointed determination.{/n}

894d590d-a8ed-46c5-b940-bc7b81c5f6ea.Text: "Losing a mentor is a sorrowful event. Beginning the mantra of spiritual assuagement." {n}The sound of Pasqal's vox takes on a strange vibration, gentle and soothing, nothing like his usual dry tone.{/n}

aeb575e7-9d0f-43da-b21a-46aab51ec5e1.Text: {n}Theobald Orsellio nods slowly.{/n} "Do not fear what is to come, Child. You are ready to guide any vessel — I know this because I taught you myself. And it is difficult to imagine more worthy company than a Rogue Trader. But remember, your safety is of paramount importance. Get to the Great Regent and fulfil your destiny."

4b5d9c0e-0b0a-4f7f-9898-524f9472b135.Text: "This malformed body held a soul that knew the true meaning of duty. May this righteous man's scales and blood steel my resolve in service." {n}Kibellah makes three ritual incisions to cut away a piece of the Navigator's flesh and hides it in the folds of her clothes, right below her heart.{/n}

523ebab2-0a8d-4cfb-a751-84e429ad5eb8.Text: {n}Cassia comes to and looks around in abject terror.{/n} "Theobald! No... Don't leave me alone in this violet-brown haze! Wake up! Your mistress is giving you an order, do you hear me?" {n}She glares at you angrily, her hatred almost tangible — you can feel it bubbling up in your own chest.{/n} "What have you done...?"

e4ee4f97-0692-44af-bfaa-a3ddfd5772cf.Text: {n}Suddenly Cassia presses her hands to her breastplate over her heart and winces in pain. The {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_CassiaAmuletOn}stone{/d} flares under the delicate skin of her pallid neck, resonating strangely with her powers. Unable to speak, she helplessly claws at the stone with her pointed nails, but to no avail.{/n} "I... What have you done to me? What did you put in my neck? My powers feel like an emptied cup. The shadows around me have grown darker... What is going on? Help me... Relieve me of this burden!"

ce9b9eba-dbeb-43dc-86c5-9a306e1bb70b.Text: {n}Cassia blinks in surprise.{/n} "Not many people would dare talk to me like that. You are very different from the rest."

f909d2ae-c5d8-4074-b07b-63603d4886c4.Text: {n}You reach for the stone in Cassia's neck, but an unknown power prevents you from even touching it — your fingers freeze a hair's breadth from the skin, as if her throat were encased in unseen armour. The stone starts heating up fast, searing Cassia's tender skin.{/n} "Enough... Enough! I beg you!"

375988d6-617a-4260-b60e-43f5be384cc6.Text: "I beg your pardon, but what about my servants? Eurac V is still full of people loyal to House Orsellio!"

b302c177-0a6b-4f76-92d2-5e899d3285eb.Text: {n}The Lady Navigator ponders your words for a short while.{/n}

a9923b78-2546-4786-96a3-65dabeca8a26.Text: "I am afraid you leave me no choice, Lord Captain. I agree. Now take me to your vessel."

5f9df338-0478-4a0f-8fff-0058b066346d.Text: "I... As a {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Lady Navigator{/g} of House Orsellio, I accept your gracious offer of protection. Please, take me to your vessel, I can no longer bear the pain of this place."

59c5584e-37a1-414b-bca4-937c4e4d0f1b.Text: {n}Cassia gives you a curt nod.{/n} "Accompanying a {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} on their travels is an honour for any {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Navigator{/g}. Let us go, I can no longer bear the sight of the deathly pale shadows that drape the bodies of the fallen. "

bc8366e2-1d17-4bf1-a4a9-cbad2f834cbd.Text: "All Navigators are abominable mutants and monsters. So what?"

4ac504df-4f6a-4940-8deb-b66c9f3cf2b0.Text: [Answer in High Gothic] "I am Rogue Trader {name} von Valancius. And I am no enemy of the Navis Nobilite."

8d510600-725d-45ce-abe3-0633548ab33f.Text: "Desist, brother! It was the Emperor's will that brought me to this abode."

d23873fd-197c-44db-ab44-35c32d3f04ab.Text: "Keep talking to me this way, and I will make you swallow your own tongue!"

be0d42b1-ee45-4856-96ba-4d9afbe569d0.Text: "I have grown tired of being your errand {mf|boy|girl}."

2b35c052-d81c-45b9-a793-fe815aea0028.Text: "My men have reported that the station is in a deplorable state."

2f5b2da9-407c-4155-9b39-36aa4c572dc8.Text: "What is happening on the station? Where did all these corpses come from?"

42be264e-7284-4d6c-9153-e7f1d3edc3ea.Text: "I came here in search of a Navigator, so you are coming with me."

fc5a7eb4-d14a-45ed-bf2a-1500dc10f2d8.Text: "Provide me with a Navigator, and I will immediately depart the station."

9c2b985d-04dd-4b64-801a-09df3e8bbf56.Text: "Why would a Keeper of the Station command vile mutants condemned by the Emperor?"

8a3eb78d-2225-46b8-aa95-17e822ab9c4a.Text: "I still have questions concerning the situation on the station."

9c0b1ef9-f6f6-4511-9acf-b37661fca2b6.Text: [Take him by force] "I do not care about your mistress. I am looking for a Navigator, and you will do."

689e2101-4bf4-4fca-b0ff-c81fad66fb11.Text: "What kind of help are you talking about?"

acadc51b-dd85-44a1-89b0-84c735d7e3eb.Text: "The servants alone cannot be blamed for what happened on the station. Most corpses I discovered were either unarmed or feeble."

dd2dcf9d-71cd-42d9-af8f-af409dff83d0.Text: "Destroying the shuttles, shutting off the power, and disabling the security systems — too many things required special access, access available only to the Keeper of the Station."

fdf228a9-0409-4922-9e79-e7d34106f50e.Text: "Enough lies, Felek! I am certain that you are the one behind this coup."

c38e2646-4c26-4c2c-a20b-a7fa386521d9.Text: "I trust you, Felek Orsellio. Let us rescue your mistress."

88a940b7-528e-4b8b-aaa7-ae59d07f64ba.Text: "Felek, you are obviously quite mistaken. I came here to get myself a Navigator, nothing more."

a49c8cf7-b7ec-4b35-965f-91b592d48a17.Text: "You could not be more wrong. But the idea of destroying your House becomes more appealing with every word you say."

60652c9e-d705-4062-a2fc-dbf38651154f.Text: [Attack] "And you will pay for your lies with your life."

77879212-a4ef-4f58-ac91-7d36509d6f6b.Text: "Seems like yet another lie. Tell me, do you ever speak the truth?"

5c5470d3-555a-44b6-aed4-1ea1cf5864fd.Text: "It must have been terrible to live under a monster's yoke for so many years! I shall help you destroy it."

c9ed3f10-b175-4db6-9154-3cb63e981cbf.Text: "I have changed my mind. I will not be an accomplice to murder."

dbbf3b59-695f-49ec-b418-0610dfb5dcbe.Text: "The madmen I fought were convinced that we were the traitors."

40af4fcb-ed9b-4ade-b5a3-2186acfb1eed.Text: "I came of my own free will. My people merely decoded the signal that was meant for Winterscale."

f67d0901-6254-4c10-aabc-517e117e6dbf.Text: "I listened to a recording of a private conversation between the station's officers. You were very lenient toward them, purposefully neglecting the security protocols."

3a3312f5-fcb5-4eb8-995b-3f75bf0bb539.Text: "How do I remake the control rod?"

09e3a1f4-8e3c-4e83-b153-529d4209a63c.Text: "So how am I supposed to power the elevator?"

a715c3bd-1411-498c-ae36-f7b11e50a8e8.Text: "If it is so simple, why don't you do it yourself?"

40248b7f-648a-4241-889f-97344dad392d.Text: "I have many questions regarding what happened on the station."

c448d509-b7d6-43c8-9758-e84c1a1ca265.Text: "The Rogue Trader's aid will cost House Orsellio. But you should rejoice, for your mistress will live."

99c5d37b-7a1a-4235-b345-6e67ab45a574.Text: "I will rescue your mistress, but in return, I require that House Orsellio sign a contract with my protectorate."

dbe0fd47-6e3b-4b87-8f73-0708e9370408.Text: "It will be an honour to save the Lady Navigator from her woes."

073f7ea4-0065-4dae-a292-ea578b16a6e2.Text: "Enough! I would not trust you as far as I could throw you, Felek Orsellio."

f5ed43e9-cd16-48f5-a103-91d812df5736.Text: "You ignored the password that was sent to Evayne Winterscale from the station."

0b394130-8a2f-4b57-9945-b45995faf4ba.Text: "Abelard, if you would be so kind."

c3b9ff2e-968d-4c53-852c-6c3ffc8fc2f3.Text: "What are you babbling about? I know nothing of this Tisiphone or monsters of any kind."

8150efa8-f33d-4980-9fd9-a3c6fd130073.Text: "Perhaps you are ingratiating yourself to me, hoping I will let down my guard."

f6eb76db-5aaf-4b9b-87ea-d9dcb98b11db.Text: "If your cursed Child agrees to become my Navigator, I will gladly rid you of this burden."

529b6b73-4822-43b1-a23c-bd6a4af219d0.Text: [Attack] "I have grown tired of your problems."

360c9492-7b30-49cc-89ae-9dc0e08fa563.Text: "If this monster's death will convince you to finally leave the station, I will kill her."

50d82ef2-9b91-49d1-940a-9d070a2626d3.Text: "Who is who? Who do you see behind the masks?"

af5bb0b8-89fb-47e3-bfa0-ef1a458a9371.Text: "Thank you, I did not understand a single word."

f8cbe163-2eab-44e7-92d5-8f0b9cd33e83.Text: "I came from Rykad Minoris after receiving your distress call."

2b2f4f9f-c4ef-486c-914f-6afe4a544deb.Text: [Attack] "Your words are rife with disrespect, and I will not tolerate it."

b3a5105b-70ea-48a5-b603-270610254195.Text: "What makes you think your mistress is still alive?"

f6cccb1a-79de-4d0d-9d48-ffe1179b3489.Text: "Who is the 'Child' mentioned in the documents and reports found on the station?"

45567fd4-e60a-4fa4-9f41-b7965a675b09.Text: "I saw the security captain's report. Only the Keepers have access to the station's systems, but Theobald stayed at his side the entire time and could not have initiated the self-destruct protocol."

8f505329-a960-4ce9-9446-af669cb643df.Text: "The warp drove the servants insane but failed to affect you and Lady Cassia?"

6135d5d7-c99d-4080-8d49-6a1ca19a8a91.Text: "The woes of your House upset the balance of power in this part of the galaxy. I will help you if not for the sake of profit but for the good of the Imperium."

031d0c24-11c4-4120-b8b7-b8f0b40c81cc.Text: "I can feel there is a lot you are not telling me. Speak the entire truth now or face my wrath."

17c6719c-9e30-460f-93e3-3c8f68013e01.Text: "Why did you not respond to the messages from Rykad Minoris?"

a0a808b3-3cde-4d62-a501-29e355969ff8.Text: "If you turn out to be a lousy Navigator after all this effort, I will personally feed you to a void kraken. Just so we are clear."

19582faf-c61b-4d27-b54a-1ed97982a7e5.Text: "And what will I get in return?"

3658b853-1dcc-47db-8d69-d44dbd83c58f.Text: "Wait! How can a blind man see the starry sky?"

940e22dc-d074-45e4-8b8d-58da906f8ed2.Text: {n}A tall man stops you with a gesture when you approach. Blood is trickling down the pearly scales of his weary face, and not just his own blood. Two jet-black unblinking eyes are watching your every move, and the third one, the mark of a {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Navigator{/g}'s fate, is menacingly pulsing behind the lowered lid in the middle of his forehead.{/n} "Step back! Or I will unleash all the horrors of the {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}Sea of Souls{/g} upon you! {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} be my witness!"

26736dcb-8b3b-4830-8820-a6c4cc24db7e.Text: "You are going to need this charm." {n}Felek hands you a precious stone without a setting. Its luminous surface remains cold to the touch no matter how long you hold it in your hand.{/n} "And may the God-Emperor's light be with you!"

d848e242-b917-49cb-bd1a-9852a711e9f7.Text: {n}Heinrix clears his throat and adds softly,{/n} "The esteemed {g|Encyclopedia:NavisNobilite}Navis Nobilite{/g} are blessed by the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} Himself. Despite their... unique appearance, the Navigators of the noble Houses wield power and authority no less significant than those of your dynasty."

34e92411-79c4-45f0-b4b3-aefc014b34e9.Text: "A pity — we were one step away from eternal friendship." {n}Felek laughs bitterly and opens his third eye.{/n} "Guards!"

0fead905-310d-466b-8ea1-ebe88a987cac.Text: "It does not matter anymore. To arms!"

0b33b8f6-cb78-4223-b4a1-96c200fd378b.Text: {n}Felek falls silent for a few moments and then furiously slams the end of his staff into the floor.{/n} "The madmen have captured Lady Cassia and are now torturing her upstairs while we are idly chatting down here! Help me rescue her or begone, but waste no more of my precious time!"

f40cc8b0-58b3-4d83-b93e-7ad17ea74357.Text: "I cannot say. One is paved with blind faith, the other with hatred and treachery. Both lead to tragedy. You simply have to decide what kind of tragedy you like the most."

4eb22dd0-9f41-4233-8b87-f228978ab8b2.Text: "I hope your curiosity is fully satisfied."

50ffb9f6-e6e6-4426-8099-842acde22f02.Text: "Betrayal. A most banal thing in the life of the Nobilite, don't you think? I was stabbed in the back by my closest friend Theobald Orsellio, the second Keeper of Eurac V and my mentor. On his instructions, my own people sabotaged the generators, blew up the shuttles, and brutally massacred the loyal servants of my mistress. Most unforgivably, they dared to take her prisoner. Greedy scum. I swear by the {g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Throne{/g}'s light, their souls will perish in the darkness of the void!"

847185fb-01f6-4811-bc35-89218a6cbf04.Text: {n}The Navigator irritably brushes away a strand of bloodied hair.{/n} "Trust me, I should know! Everything happened too quickly, there were dozens of reports of accidents, victims, and failing systems... But the only precious thing aboard this station is Lady Cassia's life. Everything else is futile and can be easily replenished."

7d7f39f3-0731-4e47-8bab-94b0ff1d67b9.Text: {n}The Navigator looks at his guards and winces. The soldiers are quivering as if their tormented flesh were being flayed, yet they keep clutching their weapons.{/n}

ae409551-3248-4323-b114-71d778b2035e.Text: "Regretfully, I am not allowed to discuss my mistress, whether with her retinue or the outsiders. She will tell you about herself personally if she feels like it... That is, assuming she survives. I am begging you not to waste any more of our precious time, for it is running out!"

e353ac57-4bcd-42db-a023-ab7b4e41f501.Text: "The warp currents in the system have been tumultuous for dozens of cycles and have worn the veil between our world and the {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}Immaterium{/g} thin and frail, at least here on the station. The {g|Encyclopedia:Chaos}Ruinous Powers{/g} are trying to tear it down completely and corrupt all living things. The servants... were the first to fall victim to it. Oh, their bodies morphed, and pain and despair drove the poor souls mad. The lunatics took my mistress prisoner and almost destroyed the station, but I rallied the few who still followed the light of the {g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Golden Throne{/g} to set things right."

ae578a96-f93f-465b-b65d-aa86f4398db7.Text: {n}Felek's thin lips twist, revealing a row of sharpened teeth.{/n} "I do not know what you are up to, but I am in no mood for games."

b2359dd3-72da-44a7-b393-17852643d1e3.Text: "I would never ask you for such a favour under different circumstances, and yet..." {n}Felek takes his hand away from his rib cage, notices blood, and winces in pain.{/n} "And yet Lady Cassia's well-being is above all. I haven't got many people left, and my wounds are too deep for me to act with precision and swiftness. But you... you may actually succeed."

161dcc48-6c21-4255-a965-58068bb6ef8e.Text: "You think they are worth the life of my mistress?"

25f64688-520a-4264-80b8-d238caee7742.Text: "The {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}warp{/g} corrupts not only the soul, but just as much the body and the mind. Mad and furious, a single servant wielded more strength than an entire squad of the mistress's personal guards. The bodyguards had their minds fogged as well, but their honed will let them hold out just long enough to destroy those who rushed in to assault them with bare hands."

e09035f1-6982-4118-bc6f-916e130cea86.Text: "Did you really think mere servants could plan a coup? The senior officers are just as guilty, half of my guards butchered one another because they suspected treason. As for the real culprit... The coup was staged by those closest to the mistress."

e7d97905-7c46-4dc1-b37b-bd92f0dd1a52.Text: {n}Felek nods wearily.{/n} "I suppose it is time to remove my mask. Congratulations, you've got me. But did you really expect me to be sincere this entire time? To welcome you with open arms, an ally of Tisiphone and her... monster? The accursed Child who has tormented the {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Navigators{/g} of House Orsellio for years? Don't make me laugh. You arrived to help her completely destroy our House. And I cannot let that happen."

d6461a33-6e4c-4f37-aef1-0c665383f06a.Text: {n}Felek exhales loudly and smiles.{/n} "Thank you, Rogue Trader. I... I don't even know what to say. Status and honour prevented me from admitting it before now, but you have awoken hope in me. Hope that I might actually leave this station together with the mistress. Which is why I am about to ask one last favour of you."

4edf3849-33e9-4aae-abda-d98174389bf3.Text: "You do not?" {n}Felek hesitates for quite a while.{/n} "In that case... Accept my sincere apology. For the deception and my earlier behaviour. I had no intention of making an enemy of a von Valancius heir nor of destroying the station that served as my home for many years. They left me no choice! You cannot even imagine what monster lurks in the upper chambers — an evil, a plague, a pestilence on our bloodline that seeks to destroy House Orsellio from within!"

eae4e3f3-20c1-465d-a643-66bf5a44e418.Text: "And Theobald and his followers... just mindless fanatics serving this evil. Lady Cassia is a scion of a merciless tyrant, but it is not her relation to Tisiphone that is terrifying. She is a monster whose powers drive servants insane in mere turns. A cursed Child who can kill a Navigator from the Orsellio bloodline with just a look. I alone managed to get close enough to her over the years. She lowered her guard and trusted me... And at long last, I rid my House of the curse. This is the truth."

3d4c1909-8fff-41c8-8297-cc5e229676b5.Text: "Pity." {n}Felek squares his shoulders and gestures to his guards.{/n} "I was hoping to find an ally in you, but now you are merely delaying the sorrowful end of your story. Prepare to die!"

d220a494-2abd-4dbe-a251-21539098566a.Text: {n}Felek nods cautiously.{/n} "I did not expect to escape the station alive, but your timely appearance... changes everything. If I go up and face Lady Cassia, she will kill me with a glance. I am not lying — her accursed powers hold sway over the carriers of our Navigator gene. But if you manage to press a special charm against her skin, whether by force or by guile, the baleful influence of her powers will recede! And you will be able to bring the cursed Child to me, so that justice can triumph and House Orsellio can cast off its shackles!"

851f0530-1180-4f15-aab5-d73cd9cd5ae5.Text: "You are going to need this charm." {n}Felek hands you a precious stone without a setting. Its luminous surface remains cold to the touch no matter how long you hold it in your hand.{/n} "You need not worry about the Child's powers, they are only fatal to the Navigators of our House. As for Theobald... he succumbed to the monster's madness a long time ago. Poor and misguided old man... He stands no chance against you."

a7f9a82c-95ac-4ba5-84dd-d3b5f7c22de8.Text: "I opened myself up to you, but you have so easily turned away from me even after everything you have heard? How very regrettable. I was hoping to find an ally in you, but now you are merely delaying the sorrowful conclusion of your story. Prepare to die!"

4a341c58-b067-4dee-b226-5e10d07ef4d6.Text: {n}The Seneschal takes a deep breath.{/n} "Before you stands {mf|His|Her} {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} the {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} {name} von Valancius, heir to the greatest protectorate in the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g} and bearer of the sacred {g|Encyclopedia:Warrant}Warrant of Trade{/g}. Allow me to point out that Nobilite custom requires the Lord Navigator to introduce himself first, but given the, ahem, unusual circumstances on the station, {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship} the Rogue Trader is willing to turn a blind eye to your hostility. But just this once."

15fd44c6-cdbe-4b98-94f0-796aa4b73802.Text: {n}Felek gently touches the closed eye on his forehead.{/n} "Thanks to a special gene, Navigators are more resistant to the emanations of the warp than mere mortals. This is what allows us to guide ships through the {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}Sea of Souls{/g}."

04e54707-561d-4805-ae82-e415cf1b8840.Text: "This system has been under the protection of the Winterscale dynasty for many years. Admittedly, I did not expect to meet another {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} in my lifetime... let alone one of {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Nobility}noble blood{/d}."
