bcb46f8e-be93-4326-abff-6e4966ea1ce7.Text: "I have already said Eurac V is sacrosanct. It is the holy domain of the Navis Nobilite, and it is forbidden for commoners from the world below. We had hoped to solve the crisis on our own, but when the situation spiralled out of control, we could not establish contact because the traitors had disabled our equipment."

e0dcc41d-7884-4b72-aff3-90b6616b6f94.Text: {n}The Navigator frowns.{/n} "No one has the right to interpret His will so freely, {mf|brother|sister}. But wait... I recognise your coat of arms. You must be a {mf|Lord|Lady} of the von Valancius dynasty? Yes, I am absolutely positive, in fact."

d9426c05-af9a-4916-afb9-072cb6b2b2ec.Text: "A call, you say?" {n}The dark pits of Felek's eyes widen in surprise.{/n} "Only one person could send you this way, and it must have been Evayne Winterscale. Why didn't he come himself?"

92d0a566-8fe6-4d2e-9e02-3a57224de373.Text: {n}Felek Orsellio looks a little better — his tangled hair is now neatly braided, his wounds are tightly bandaged, and there is some healthy colour under the scales on his cheeks.{/n} "You dealt with the threat and powered the elevator... Well done. I trust you brought the activation rod as well? Remember, every second of hesitation may cost my mistress her life."

4a040c94-4619-4a67-8aa4-b581d26484ee.Text: "You still dare insult me?" {n}The Navigator raises his arms, preparing to open his third eye, but suddenly stops.{/n} "Ah, but I do recognise this coat of arms. You are from the von Valancius dynasty. This... explains a lot. More than you think."

6e6ba860-6440-421f-8db1-7c0553d38e9f.Text: "A pity. He was an agreeable young man, if somewhat naive. But wait... I recognise your coat of arms. You must be a {mf|Lord|Lady} of the von Valancius dynasty?"

753b22d9-d01e-4242-9e63-a7a76189b28c.Text: "You don't say... Getting access to the personal communicator of the heir to a great dynasty is no easy feat. Who exactly are you?" {n}The Navigator cocks his head, as if realising something.{/n} "Ah, wait... I recognise this coat of arms. You are a {mf|Lord|Lady} of the von Valancius dynasty. This explains so, so much."

ef160dce-4385-4744-8e34-a47e57ee9ff9.Text: {n}The Navigator gives a thoughtful nod and then straightens up as if realising something important.{/n} "I recognise this coat of arms! You must be from the illustrious von Valancius dynasty? I am certain you are..."

aafd2cee-1412-4419-9889-54b9ee5cecbe.Text: "Is that so?" {n}Even wounded, Felek Orsellio remains composed.{/n} "I do not think so. You cannot force me, you can only end my life. But this is not your heart's desire, is it? Perhaps... Perhaps, we can help one another and reach a more beneficial agreement."

59b1097d-f414-4808-8847-56e002cd4adc.Text: {n}There is darkness swirling in Felek Orsellio's bottomless eyes as he bares his sharp teeth in a defensive snarl.{/n} "Care to explain yourself, scion of the von Valancius dynasty? What is the meaning of this?"

ae63875c-07c3-49c0-a64d-38ab0f2eb0d0.Text: "I do not think this is possible. Eurac V is an observation station. We do not sign contracts and do not provide Navigators. We delve into the depths of infinity and chart the movements of the warp storms. And besides..." {n}Felek gestures at the disorder around him.{/n} "...you have chosen an inopportune time for negotiations."

ccbbd435-112f-4c72-868a-6ba0851e43c3.Text: "The blame lies with Theobald Orsellio, the second Keeper of Eurac V. The old man... was a great Navigator, but he could no longer control his powers. I begged him to retire, but he was too obsessed with our mistress, Lady Cassia. His madness and stubbornness spelled doom for the entire station, for he opened his third eye in a fit of rage and unleashed the horrors of the warp on those who displeased him. The Theobald I knew would never have used his powers in such a reckless manner. This will be difficult to explain to the uninitiated, but I am going to try."

8ee3c7c8-bbc1-4e36-a15d-70178e49d15b.Text: "The Lord Navigator here is speaking the unvarnished truth. I bet this station is full of voices and whispers, all trying to break through from the other side, waiting for you to reach out and swing the door open wide."

131b5d91-89f6-4478-9ac6-501e1ba1dd35.Text: "The suffocating grip of the Immaterium can be felt across the entire system. It is not surprising the veil grew thin here of all places — the Navis Nobilite can command the warp currents, but the use of their abilities wears down the barrier between the two worlds."

8a8ea563-209f-4392-8639-4a9d29c58180.Text: "In order to ascend to the mistress's chambers, you will need to remake a holy relic sanctified with the blood of Lady Orsellio herself. This is the control rod of the elevator {g|Encyclopedia:MachineSpirit}machine spirit{/g}. I have one part and the other was lost during the mutiny. But even this relic will be of no use unless the elevator mechanism is powered."

032760ef-b222-452d-a844-78dc9c4138b7.Text: "I have a phylactery containing the mistress's blood. It needs to be taken to the laboratory, which is located behind one of the reliquary doors. The most ancient of sacred mechanisms will help to rebuild the rod — the {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priests{/g} ceaselessly performed the rites of appeasement so that the machine spirit would serve the House in its time of need. The fateful hour is now upon us."

b6e161ef-7bc8-4ce3-82a9-83278d8f1d66.Text: "And since fate has brought such an important person into my abode... allow me to introduce myself. Before you stands Felek Christoph August, Keeper of this station. So, you did not come to offer support to the traitors? This is great news. Having said that, you must understand that Eurac V is a holy sanctum for House Orsellio and the path to it is only revealed to a select few. It pains me to say you are not on the guest list."

1271bb11-1524-4742-a6b3-cabc01e735e6.Text: "The station's main {g|Encyclopedia:Cogitator}cogitator{/g} is situated in the guard room. Just enter the correct command sequence, and the sacred mechanism will do the rest."

c032c440-666d-42e4-9560-b425acef7d01.Text: "I never said the feat would be easy to accomplish. The path to the laboratory and the guard room is blocked by the very same madmen who took over the station. They will not negotiate and are not afraid of displeasing the Navis Nobilite or incurring the Emperor's wrath. They bow only to brute strength, something which I currently happen to lack."

22194a11-a485-4c08-bdda-e4a5d231d3ac.Text: "So what have you decided, descendant of the von Valancius line?"

b80c9764-d901-4281-a8ba-19b16b76facf.Text: "Ridiculous! I personally give out passwords to every attendant. What you mentioned when we first met has nothing to do with the access code to Eurac V. You have been misled."

d665b958-28f2-490b-bc1c-921876d385dc.Text: "In this case, I shall turn a blind eye to your unceremonious invasion. But just this once." {n}There is a dangerous glint in the man's dark-shrouded eyes.{/n} "Very well, allow me to introduce myself. Before you stands Felek Christoph August, Keeper of this place. So, you did not arrive to offer support to the traitors? This is great news. Having said that, you must understand that Eurac V is a holy sanctum for House Orsellio and the path to it is only revealed to a select few. It pains me to say you are not on the guest list."

e206609c-db2a-4bd8-ab1f-2c831f72a9ce.Text: "As I'm sure you are aware, there were two Keepers of the Station. Your guess is absolutely correct — Theobald Orsellio, the demented old man obsessed with Lady Cassia and her power. And also the one to blame for the woes that have befallen Eurac V and our noble line."

9406a626-e4d6-48fc-add0-f7d87ae3bbcc.Text: {n}Felek's reply sounds curt and tired.{/n} "So be it. Hurry, the mistress's safety is all that matters. But should you fail, our arrangement is finished."

4863dc19-fffc-4978-b1d7-c6814e08d98d.Text: "You invade the sacred dominion of the Navis Nobilite and have the audacity to threaten me? On my own station?" {n}The air around the Keeper grows thick, and the Navigator's eye trembles menacingly.{/n} "You shall face your inglorious demise, scion of a great family. Guards!"

620b4a33-30c0-4c21-ab32-1b34f84a77c1.Text: "You do not understand! This is..." {n}Felek stops mid-sentence, makes a brief pause and then nods to himself.{/n} "You are correct, this may work. It certainly is possible..."

fa88df47-1306-423f-942f-13e8ed3394b4.Text: "You must be out of your mind to treat the Navis Nobilite like this! Don't even begin to hope that I will go quietly!"

57d35e33-bb5c-4876-b159-cead45aac437.Text: {n}Felek gives an indifferent shrug.{/n} "That's why they are insane. Will you really heed the ramblings of retainers who dared to raise their hand against the scions of a noble bloodline?"

0b40d124-f691-45fe-b11d-00a921dfc1e5.Text: "I cannot change the past and dare not hope you will ever trust me again. But I swear my words and my apology are genuine."

047e5a8b-f935-44c4-bc90-76187d2eeeb9.Text: "You are going to need this charm." {n}Felek hands you a precious stone without a setting. Its luminous surface remains cold to the touch no matter how long you hold it in your hand.{/n} "If you manage to press it against the monster's skin, whether by force or by guile, the baleful influence of her powers will recede. You will be able to take her and leave the station."

e96018b1-861a-4344-b66f-7ed96fc50fe1.Text: {n}Felek looks exhausted, but arrogant resolve bolsters his voice.{/n} "And these technologies were made secret for a reason. I must respectfully decline your request, esteemed servant of the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}. You have your sacraments and we have ours."

9c3bb003-bf37-468b-b213-ff69757bbcbf.Text: {n}Idira suddenly cocks her head and drives her nails deep into her shoulder. Then she starts mumbling.{/n} "The crossroads! There are two paths, both stained with blood, both leading to the accursed eye. They all wear masks, so poor and flimsy, they fall at the slightest touch, one hiding a blind man, another a traitor."

7bb18b9e-c4ff-4e1a-9c9f-b14b1621154d.Text: "My whisperers are giggling nastily, they will not speak, the naughty little things. They say that tearing off the masks is your concern."

5c7792e4-65ff-43e2-8e8d-7e744f51664c.Text: "This station has enough problems without your sorcery, psyker." {n}Felek waves Idira off and looks at you expectantly.{/n}

df0e5522-d65a-4e61-a231-45a9e990f577.Text: {n}Idira nods tiredly and glances at Felek out of the corner of her eye.{/n}

1dbb7110-bb29-4d9d-91e2-617facad6bc3.Text: "Lord Captain, we still need a Naviga—"

c714b9ad-c1cc-4df1-997b-c4187604031e.Text: "Our idle chatter will not save Lady Cassia. But if you need to be sure of something before you can help... So be it."

8dafeb3c-b425-4ab9-a074-65c5c9182440.Text: {n}A spark of concern flickers in the black pits of Felek's eyes.{/n} "You may not believe me, but Lady Cassia is capable of..." {n}The Navigator cringes, seemingly in pain, and furiously exhales,{/n} "...incredible things. Not even the traitor Theobald can easily harness her power."

a3c3c8c1-db79-4e06-b45c-31c9dde4d5dc.Text: "I was lenient — this is true. And in the end I paid a steep price for it — just look at the destruction around us. The insurgents have left almost nothing of my home..." {n}The Keeper spits out the last few words with particular bitterness.{/n}

c947c300-7220-4cdd-a965-242ba644a263.Text: "You... meddled with something that should have been left alone." {n}The Keeper folds his arms and shakes his head disapprovingly.{/n} "'The Child' is what the station's servants call Lady Cassia, for the commoners' dirty mouths must not sully her name by uttering it. You see, it is not beneficial for all servants to have their vocal organs altered. Some prove to be more useful when they are still able to speak."

88d8993e-c25f-480e-8dca-42da11598010.Text: "Which means he did it before the report was filed! Or maybe after. Or..." {n}Felek's stern face twists in disgust.{/n} "You dare suspect me of what happened? The one who is going out of his way to preserve what little there is still left? By the God-Emperor, you will keep these slanderous accusations to yourself."

2581e072-7a13-4b1f-a811-684b86b69a10.Text: "It really is time to end this." {n}Felek squares his shoulders and gestures to his guards.{/n} "I was hoping to find an ally in you, but now you are merely delaying the sorrowful end of your story. Prepare to die!"

80501104-42b2-493d-b258-092cba737b7c.Text: "Recent events have badly disturbed Lady Cassia's psyche, and warp entities always lust for weaker souls, especially when the veil grows thin. You too will be safe next to this charm."

65c889cb-dcb2-4f1a-9782-548434e16f9b.Text: "The lowly insurgents got their hands on a weapon that suppresses my Navigator powers. Their absence makes me a living target, but this weapon is useless against you, as is the bunch of lunatics wielding it. I humbly ask you to deal with the scum huddling upstairs and hurry to adorn my mistress with the relic of our House, a sacred amulet against all evil."

c6c51dbb-5425-4dbd-a320-1910fb14b9c5.Text: {n}Felek clutches the precious staff in a hand resembling a kraken's tentacle.{/n} "I may be a mutant. And yet monsters may wear many a pleasant guise — do not believe everything you see."

40025d60-c2e6-448b-8dcc-f4f56a11fe73.Text: {n}Felek nods curtly.{/n} "You should hurry, then. We will stay here to hold the line and lick our wounds. Good luck, Rogue Trader. And may the Emperor's light be with you!"

73a5620e-0621-42e9-9dda-b938b7a7ed09.Text: {n}Pasqal excitedly reaches for a {g|Encyclopedia:Dataslate}data-slate{/g}.{/n} "Requesting access to the object's {g|Encyclopedia:Cybercrypt}data-crypt{/g}. The Navis Nobilite use independent modifications of standard sanguinary technologies due to the uniqueness of the genetic code inherent in the lineage of each House."

a5a399e9-fe53-4834-9d5a-326a0e110e8b.Text: "I sincerely hope the influence of the Immaterium has not yet affected your body and your soul. With all due respect, I advise you not to remain at the station. Return to your voidship. I need to save Lady Cassia. If you are not willing to help or indeed risk your life, you must leave now."

1526ede5-843c-4143-9401-c393595e1d81.Text: {n}Felek smiles softly and appears relaxed and almost calm.{/n} "If everything goes as planned, you will not have to worry about such things."

f2ce8e55-6ca7-4741-a56f-a048e0b44948.Text: "You will get everything you wanted: a loyal Navigator and the undying gratitude of House Orsellio."

b09356bf-7e8d-4b4b-aed3-6150ca20e2c2.Text: "You came to this station for a reason. House Orsellio will not be able to help you until the current crisis is resolved, but if you aid us now... I promise we will reach an agreement that you will find satisfying, be it riches, influence, or the powers of our Navigators."

d8b3f893-029f-4e0b-84c9-2b01e6204235.Text: {n}Felek squares his shoulders and gestures to his guards.{/n} "I fear no threats from your kind, for I have never felt safe with a monster at the heart of my House. Now fall!"

0c4ff709-27b3-4c54-a1d6-59e24db5456e.Text: "I am looking for the Lord Inquisitor's Interrogator, one Heinrix van Calox. Do you know anything about his present location?"

6f279c88-1ddf-44ff-b88c-c29d49b3fac5.Text: "The {g|Encyclopedia:Inquisition}Lord Inquisitor{/g}'s Interrogator? I think I would know if such an important individual decided to pay us a visit."

579a1126-02d4-4b66-a873-c520ded9b57d.Text: "What a coincidence. I was not going to let you go, either!"

0041c39a-93f6-49d2-bb3a-25d746f3278e.Text: "A traitor? What is the meaning of this?"

2ae6a43a-bef8-4c95-aea9-e381fc645904.Text: [Address Felek] "I held up my end of the bargain, Felek. You are my Navigator now."

ea8afabd-08e5-44e5-ab62-559485847aba.Text: "What is wrong, Lady Cassia? Did I not bring you to your champion?"

3325a3aa-6386-4a73-99ce-537d362f3400.Text: "You have signed your own death warrant!"

bece66e1-f29c-412e-92e1-3d940c1799a4.Text: "I beseech thee, Emperor! Shield me against this evil!"

56315482-2798-4317-a3dd-66758e36dc21.Text: [Address Cassia] "Be silent, monster. Is it not you who has been tormenting your subjects all this time?"

d057dda2-1635-4e7a-b88c-a873313b2034.Text: "Rogue Trader! You... came back." {n}You hear equal parts confusion and frustration in Felek's voice.{/n} "And dragged this monster along. Good."

6bc828bc-5403-47da-b1a7-dc95c214a376.Text: "Forgive me this little lie, Rogue Trader. You served the noble cause of liberating House Orsellio like no other, for which I will forever be grateful. We could have become close friends in another life."

82889fab-3b55-4ae3-a658-a5e043fa6c7b.Text: "Damnation! Why can't you just die already!"

50571d60-a9a2-44db-8f83-b3ec893c4015.Text: {n}An oppressive force crashes down on you, almost knocking you down. The tang of metal floods your mouth, but an unbreakable will helps you to resist. Finally, the horrors spewed forth by the Navigator's third eye no longer have a hold over you.{/n}

9821ccb3-9a1c-408b-86e6-fa506233a9b6.Text: {n}The words get stuck in your throat and your hands refuse to obey. The hatred of Felek overwhelms your entire being. How could he? How dare he betray you? His mentor? His House? You hear a woman scream as if from afar, and the veil of other's conjoining emotions fades.{/n}

537d8cfc-23d3-4443-8449-b76047384594.Text: "You ruined my home and killed Theobald... for this? He will deceive you just like he's been deceiving my people for all these years! The mossy fog is clouding your eyes, but deep in your heart I can see the golden light of truth shining through. You know I am not lying to you."

22ac5a42-c998-49f5-8bf7-d365a0fdc475.Text: "My champion?" {n}Cassia laughs bitterly.{/n} "Felek Orsellio is a renegade. A traitor to our House who butchered my people... You brought me to my executioner without even realising it? How... how sad."

006b1484-616b-4271-b3c8-7471b04522d8.Text: "What are you talking about? I am Cassia Orsellio, one of the heirs of House Orsellio. I am not a monster and I will have you know that I have never tormented anyone! I... I've spent my entire life on Eurac V in the company of Felek and Theobald. And both remained in good health up to this day!" {n}Cassia nods at Felek angrily.{/n} "I do regret it now. I see the acid-green rings of deception constricting you. Felek's been lying to you... Just like he's been lying to me this entire time."

842691f3-e672-41fe-9735-9748f91bf5a7.Text: {n}An oppressive force crashes down on you, practically knocking you down. You feel your skin melt and your blood boil as the very air burns your lungs from the inside. Words get stuck in your throat and your hands refuse to obey, but somebody's scream brings you to your senses.{/n}

a72bbad1-fc90-4ec5-a158-fb4c72e6fc3a.Text: {n}Cassia flinches at the {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Navigator{/g}'s words and clenches her fists. Her sharp nails dig deep into her soft skin, drawing blood. Cassia's face, however, remains dispassionate.{/n} "Traitor."

9c7be0ea-1413-4730-b4a3-0ecd647d258e.Text: "Almighty Emperor be praised, my beneficent mistress is safe! Wonderful, this is wonderful... The weight of the world has been lifted from my shoulders!" {n}Felek grins mockingly before turning grim.{/n} "You monster."

c30e92ac-8967-4da8-ad92-103bcd7ce5a4.Text: "However, the House's reputation must not be jeopardised by your testimony. The girl is a curse on all of Orsellio. She is the legacy of Tisiphone, a beast who kept the entire House chained with fear, killing indiscriminately for any trace of dissent! I had to break the shackles of her tyranny. It is nothing personal. I am sure you understand." {n}The eye on the Navigator's forehead opens wide.{/n}

6c5f3aaf-9316-422d-9b65-d457e03dc689.Text: "Oh no no no, this is bad, this is very bad! The flimsy mask, it's gone, and the gaze behind it is aimed dead at you, Lord Captain!"

5f0624c6-69af-4946-9590-6f8c9e5f249d.Text: "Oh, yes. About that..." {n}Felek Orsellio shrugs awkwardly.{/n}

fc84586a-5e24-4993-bdc7-ec85e78c14b4.Text: "This means that you murdered my only defender and dragged me straight into the arms of the traitor who doomed Eurac V!" {n}Cassia angrily brushes you away, barely holding back the quaver in her voice.{/n}

e6fc5a2e-5802-4005-b396-45145fc8bb18.Text: "Liars like you, sir, do not deserve to call themselves friends of the dynasty." {n}Abelard reaches for his weapon.{/n} "Not that anyone has extended such an honour to you."

9623ccef-ab5a-455e-b3d7-cd04f88310e2.Text: A sealed vial engraved with the initials C.T.E.O.

021197fb-d9fb-4b6a-92a8-01e986d26c52.Text: An elevator control rod made with the help of Navigator technologies.

cc0b574f-a9f3-4954-b9ca-01101fb34b6d.Text: A control rod in the shape of a rotary mechanism.

88f47123-b9a2-41da-9257-1e1802ec297c.Text: Chronicles of House Orsellio, Volume XXI

c5936853-cdb6-4beb-8a38-51fd8143a505.Text:
"- ...tremendous honour!
- Yes, but... this promotion will transfer the entire squad to the Child's personal guard.
- By the God-Emperor! Well, you are a strapping lad, you will probably make it for a cycle or three.
- It has worn down better men than me. What even is the point if your brains turn into mush? I may rip out my eyes like Amos did. At best, I'll just go bonkers like that little shit stain that kept stealing our lho...
- Oh? What happened to that one?
- Threw himself out of a depressurised chamber because some voices told him to.
- Calm down. Keeper Felek said the squad will not have to serve the Child for long. He even gave us a little leeway.
- Unlike that fish-eyed...
- Be quiet! He might hear you.
- Well, you know what I mean. He almost busted our heads because someone forgot to check the catering unit.
- We haven't let in a single outsider in over ten years, but Keeper Theobald keeps finding things to fret over. Imagine the shrieking if he finds out Keeper Felek didn't make us inspect the hangar after Lord Winterscale's most recent visit.
- Throne forbid! I try to steer clear of the squabbles among the highborn. Some of Keeper Felek's orders make little sense, like the last time he commanded that we cut off communications with Rykad Minoris for a while.
- Why would he do that?
- It looks like he grew tired of the Winterscale scion's visits.
- Well, it's always a pleasure to aid Keeper Felek.
- That's right. If the highborn have grown tired of each other, let them deal with it..."

f153393c-fb8d-4734-80c5-f646185bdac4.Text: A purified sample from the ocean world OM-42-K-003.

c5c3a74c-a599-4532-9732-caaf0288f424.Text: Finely ground stone with metal particles mixed in.

a4bb3ad4-c428-4850-9a5e-61f4e13456ef.Text: A shard of fused meteorite, still cold with the icy breath of the void.

b9e2ca35-41de-401d-bdcd-9f6d73f67ae7.Text: A handful of sparkling, coal-black dust.

9d044461-8f42-4d2c-bf01-ef48bf619561.Text: Effulgent shards of an emerald-green crystal.

50dd90be-ed13-4a75-87c4-493d2e56185b.Text: A shimmering crystal that emits a ghostly light.

80f7cb9e-de9a-4b02-91fd-a7df69c6c68f.Text: A flesh sample with numerous outgrowths covered in a mesh of bluish-black veins.

324c5053-4858-4bbf-8204-b2721bba81c8.Text: A flesh sample with fragments of scales and rudimentary webbed fingers.

67b7ef64-53a6-4d05-92da-48e727e4777d.Text: A flesh sample of a tender pink colour, untouched by mutations.

9a7049a0-945e-41ca-be3c-09c5c88db732.Text:
***
Keeper Theobald graciously agreed to provide samples of his skin growths so we could study the influence of the rebellious Immaterium on the flesh of the Navis Nobilite. Just as we thought, Navigators are positively resistant to the restless currents of the warp... The God-Emperor truly does shield some people against corruption and misery. But let us get back to the study of mortal flesh. Another servant will be carried in shortly, I must ready the organ extraction equipment.
***
Adamantine dust and black water! This was the worst idea that could have entered my mind! God-Emperor be praised, I am lucky to still have my head on my shoulders after this reckless experiment. Nevertheless, we did make an important discovery — the adamantine seems to protect the frail flesh of the lowborn to a degree. Having said that, not even the macerator can handle its temper, so we should probably introduce a more complex compound into the formula. All of the data related to the experiment were recorded to data-crypt K-04-OH. I will get back to them later, once I am done with experiment H-41-OK.
***
Have I mentioned that the chunk of meteorite found by Keeper Felek's subjects is completely useless? Although... its shining granules could be used to make new paints for the Child. Yes... I think I'm going to do exactly that.

0bbf2f81-6a1c-4612-b5e0-8289129095f5.Text: Research Notes of Navis Laboratorum Custodian Fortunata Orsellio, Part 13

56544a46-2421-45f6-af70-b295559d64c6.Text:
***
More and more servants are being influenced by the Immaterium, and it has nothing to do with the Child's more frequent tantrums. We've discovered that the corrupted flesh of the mutated reacts most unusually to the crystals we purchased from the Winterscale dynasty. I strongly recommend finely grinding the reagent to catalyse the reaction. Do not use acid under any circumstances! Trust me, you will not like having to tend to the burns for the next dozen turns in a row. This calls for something more... basic. Oh, and one more thing. The Tech-Priests blessed the data-crypt H-41-OK for the calculated number of chrono-turns, which means it is no longer necessary to remain near the device while waiting for the reaction to start.
***
The data-crypt H-40-KO malfunctioned over the course of our research. I should remind the technomats to deliver this sacred mechanism into Magos Dioctius's capable hands.
***

657fcb6b-6b19-4f7a-85e9-4cea60df4f7b.Text: Research Notes of Navis Laboratorum Custodian Fortunata Orsellio, Part 12

7ecce585-c3d1-4c81-93b8-7cf57575ed87.Text:
Experimental section: the Child's influence on the psycho-emotional state of various representatives of the Imperium
Access level: Orsellio-T-prime{br}
Experiment H4545-1
Subgroup: lowborn, male
Test subjects exhibit signs of acute stress. The majority perished of blood loss within a day of being placed in the laboratory chamber due to the inability to halt the discharge of ocular secretions (tears) and the body's subsequent replacement of these secretions with the connective tissue of its internal environment. The individuals with the greatest resistance to the sacred Child's resonance died several chrono-turns later: extensive wounds in the abdomen, presumably inflicted by a jagged piece of metal; death was caused by strangulation with the subjects' own intestines. The subjects' final shouts exhibited concerns over abominable tentacles and void worms, hallucinations prescribed to their own internal organs.{br}
Experiment H4545-2
Subgroup: lowborn, female
The test subjects died within an hour of entering the laboratory adjacent to the Child's chambers. Most had their tongues bitten off or their jaws badly dislocated: some test subjects lacked the physical strength to separate it from the rest of the skull. Cause of death: severe head injuries caused by impacting the walls or the floor.{br}
Experiment H4545-3
Subgroup: a paralysed patient who lost the ability to speak due to the shock caused by a manufactorum accident, male
The test subject noted a tingling sensation in the deteriorated tissue. During Regent Aaronto Orsellio's visit to the Child, the test subject smiled and started humming (most likely trying to carry some plebeian tune) and then attempted to address the servant who brought him food. A lengthy conversation was prohibitive due to the servant's lack of a tongue.{br}
Experiment H4545-4
Subgroup: a defective offspring of Lord P. Orsellio, pronounced unfit for studying the high art of Navigation owing to the mutation of tissues required for installation of the obligatory augmentations that merge one's consciousness with the vessel, additionally they display an overall feebleness of mind, female
The test subjects mirrored the Child's actions for three days. On the fourth day the Child became upset after hearing the news about the untimely demise of Amos Cantarelli, an officer of her personal guard. As a result, one of the test subjects peeled away several layers of tissue from her face and died from the resulting massive heart attack.
The last surviving test subject was executed for attempting to contact the Child.

86bfeb68-bd35-4dae-8a37-fc0abae4655d.Text: The data-crypt carries an inscription written in a neat hand: "K-04-OH."

3fd36066-513f-4f09-bd82-897d9ad62f1b.Text: The data-crypt carries an inscription on its fused casing: "H-40-KO."

9b53c87b-f48c-4155-8f83-c4dd581e0be7.Text: The data-crypt carries a half-effaced inscription: "H-41-OK."

b0016b69-eece-4f13-a1d0-49a326584282.Text: A rough precious stone lacking a setting. It is always cold to the touch.

96419434-0d9d-4d58-90a5-fd9c7359440f.Text:
A good major-domo attempts to nurture only the finest of flowers in the garden that is their master's life. Therefore, new seeds for the garden must be weeded out with the utmost care, so that the garden's trees may yield the sweetest fruit. The lessons below will help you separate the precious seeds from the vile thorns to cultivate the perfect garden for any Lady Navigator.{br}
Lesson 1. A faithful servant always makes sure their mistress's rooms and garments are clean.
Lesson 2. A faithful servant will never offer their mistress the same dress presented earlier in the cycle.
Lesson 3. A faithful servant offers their mistress a glass of fresh water upon waking.
Lesson 4. A faithful servant tastes each dish and every drink before serving it to their mistress.
Lesson 5. A faithful servant will have mastered the art of styling their mistress's hair. The total time that five servants can spend on arranging their mistress's coiffure should not exceed three revolutions of the chronometer.
Lesson 6. A faithful servant lives for their mistress and gladly gives their life for her as well.
Lesson 7. A faithful servant...

28fd194e-ab19-45f4-b854-e36e7c3713ba.Text: Pontius Cipheus Gelacius, "On the Training of Worthy Servants at the Court of the Navis Nobilite"

3b119d5c-cb68-499e-9098-00b6c5989a68.Text: A crumpled sheet of paper with a drawing of a tall woman and a dark-eyed monster... Painted with fresh blood.

c1983626-213f-4f3a-b88e-baef74c9524a.Text: [Examine the security and life support logs]

f1f676f0-f036-4bf3-87f4-a144a31e6aef.Text: [Examine the recent entries of the incident log]

a3f1e9a0-86a1-46ef-a532-12aa43bf9f7f.Text: "Thank you, I can handle this on my own."

90b2e746-ffab-4481-9a95-7120c82a2219.Text: [Return to the list of the available commands]

6c7e4fd9-c5a3-436a-8703-28a2cccfc1d7.Text: {n}You easily bypass the restrictions imposed on the sacred machine. The cogitator's overloaded processors whirr unhappily.{/n}

f8456482-b30b-4dc6-a730-3b74738402cf.Text: {n}Most of the encrypted data has been wiped — you find traces of the purge protocol. Recovery is impossible, but a list of the most recent commands, having been embedded in the machine spirit's consciousness, now flits across the screen in a single creeping line: "ChildDeletePictFlowDisableAccessCodeAnnulStationControlsDeleteActivateShuttleSelfdestructPurgeCommandLog..."{/n}

b0418afe-4aef-4939-a9f8-d158d770d017.Text: {n}Exploring the archives for a while longer yields a surviving excerpt from the guard captain's report mentioning that the security system had recently been reconfigured without his knowledge. His comment reads:{/n} "Only the Keepers of the Station have access to the life support systems... But Keeper Theobald had not left the Child's side, and neither had I. Could it be that..."

637d9db1-8a63-494d-ab2d-120080ec9c5f.Text: {n}The vid-screen blinks and the mechanisms in the machine's core emit a quiet hum.{/n}

1afd4e31-358b-4e50-84b4-45aa1abfb372.Text: {n}The {g|Encyclopedia:Cogitator}cogitator{/g}'s vid-screen is covered in cracks and stained with dried blood. The buttons, switches, and levers were ripped out of the control panel with exceptional cruelty and scattered around the sacred mechanism that now sparks and hisses in agony still refusing to perish.{/n}

d29d8a40-1baf-4ef2-b2bc-84b565b764f9.Text: {n}The broken screen flickers with dancing static:{/n} "WARNING! Data corrupted. Processing... Processing... Processing... ERROR. Manual configuration is required."

2af3b241-2c46-4cb4-bf20-c4eae6cc6f2e.Text: {n}Pasqal's fingers drum out a resonant crescendo on the control panel as his mechadendrites remove the metal cover and the data-cord slides into the machine's innards. The cogitator's body starts crackling with electrical impulses, and the Tech-Priest nods with satisfaction. A few minutes later Pasqal raises his hands above the machine, chants a brief litany only he can understand and pushes the surviving stump of one of the levers.{/n} "My humble prayers have satisfied this machine's requirements."

f257e3e5-fe98-4d59-b99b-fc164b9ca426.Text: {n}The archive data stored on the cogitator's local {g|Encyclopedia:Cybercrypt}data-crypt{/g} is partially corrupted, but you still manage to access the residual logs for examination.{/n}

3003f2e2-fb80-45cd-97ff-347801cf8254.Text: {n}Pasqal casts a brief glance at the vid-screen and speaks dryly:{/n} "The imminent demise of this void station is affirmed. The damage to its core infrastructure has reached critical mass, at which point further degradation has commenced in a cascading configuration."

9a51af67-a24f-42be-89f7-26990e83efca.Text: "Officer H-123 speaking. Two hundred servants have perished due to explosive decompression of the living quarters. We've located traces of mechanical interference. The preliminary cause is officer sabotage. Crews five, six, and nine are cut off from the main compartment. We have enough oxygen for twenty minutes, may the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} save our souls."

acdd3211-1cc0-4601-9590-2847b5319c4b.Text: "Senior station officers, this is the captain speaking. We attempted to contact the Winterscale scion for help, but something is jamming the signal. We never received a reply and cannot be sure it was even sent in the first place. A rescue team is not coming. We are on our own, so remain vigilant. Anyone could be a traitor, you hear me? ANYONE! If you are in doubt, shoot to kill."

9ffedd43-d93a-405e-9fff-3ddc17cee81e.Text: {n}A few manipulations with the switches make you realise the elevator to the upper chambers is blocked.{/n}

b6d6246c-007e-4201-b160-c9a937b395f4.Text: {n}The yellow lights above the control panel flicker to life and a singular repeating message streams down the vid-screen:{/n} "WARNING! Damage in technical compartments A-12, B-3, D-8, and H-24 detected. WARNING! Living quarters L-10, L-16, L-28 depressurised. WARNING! Unable to access the station's docking system. WARNING! Energy regulation system: unknown error. The station will transfer over to emergency power. Immediate evacuation of the facility is advised. WARNING!"

23cc9848-bbec-4cbf-bfeb-9fa46fbb7e2e.Text: {n}The {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox-recording{/g} hisses for some time before you hear a voice: {/n} "This is Officer A-282, do you copy? Several generators overheated on the lower levels, chambers A to D are unpowered! The {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priest{/g} crew sent to investigate the problem is not responding. Requesting back—" {n}The officer's speech is interrupted by shouting and the recording abruptly ends.{/n}

271a3752-6a92-4b64-8921-be12c1414ca9.Text: {n}The log is almost completely corrupted, but you manage to recover the latest entry:{/n} "Identity confirmed: Regent Aaronto Orsellio. Date of visit: classified. Reason for visit: classified. Date of departure: classified."

bf2601f6-7fee-4637-9a18-1bff9f496ec7.Text: {n}Something buzzes in the cogitator's metallic gut. Several red lumens light up above the vid-screen:{/n} "Required access level: security captain or above. Current access level: senior security officer."

41178252-9be4-42e2-ba3a-a878d1e054ff.Text: {n}The vid-screen flashes furiously and the control panel starts spitting out sparks that bite at your fingers. After a few minutes of desperate confrontation, the cogitator falls silent, once and for all barring you access to the classified data.{/n}

e31c312b-efe2-474d-98ca-6ce14f256d8e.Text: "Requesting permission to appease the weary spirits in this creation of the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}." {n}Pasqal bends over the cogitator, his vox-system chanting a mantra of Mechanical Harmony as his mechadendrites carefully twist dials and push buttons on the control panel. A few minutes later the Tech-Priest reports:{/n} "It is done. Access to the archives has been granted."

46401190-0a31-43b7-b63f-f5ea8efd3154.Text: {n}The cogs within the sacred mechanism slowly start turning with heavy grinding and clacking. The tired machine spirits grant you access to the station control — or at least its parts that still obey the cogitator.{/n}

ee8594db-dd30-4cb7-84bd-2f409063ed30.Text: {n}The cogitator's vid-screen goes dark as if the machine spirits had fled their mechanical casket. But your assumption is incorrect, as it fills with static just a few moments later. You can barely make out an inscription amidst the flow of rapidly changing symbols.{/n}

edd850b8-d248-4b5e-a97e-64122697e5f2.Text: {n}You turn a few of the remaining dials and pull the activation lever. The cracked vid-screen of the sacred engine flickers. The cogitator's insides emit creaks and groans and the {g|Encyclopedia:Lumen}lumens{/g} oscillate at random. It takes a while, but eventually the {g|Encyclopedia:MachineSpirit}machine spirits{/g} do grant you access to the cogitator's systems.{/n}

5c9e4fb4-761a-4d72-8410-7fe32a82795f.Text: {n}You push a few buttons on the control panel, but the system rebels and keeps resetting your commands. According to the data, the compartment you are trying to open is depressurised.{/n}

6e83daef-3c11-4237-b895-bd20fe0a4c37.Text: {n}You thank the machine spirits and reset the operating protocol.{/n}

617f5a7b-b9d0-4892-a481-e92adef2dfa0.Text: {n}The vid-screen lights up with a smattering of unfamiliar green symbols and you hear a peculiar click from somewhere behind you. It appears one of the doors in the chamber has opened.{/n}

f8810817-fe9b-484a-852b-e2be3de31466.Text: {n}Report X-880 originator: classified. Date: classified.{/n} "The servants close to the Child have started butchering one another again. An order came from above to have their remains reprocessed."

58363966-e1fa-4a46-8d20-af8a0014faf9.Text: {n}The system cannot carry out your command despite the eager compliance of the machine spirits. One thing is certain, the problem does not lie in the cogitator's mechanisms.{/n}

f73dd378-b4bc-44c7-ab4c-681eacfe6215.Text: {n}Report X-886 originator: classified. Date: classified.{/n} "The negotiations with the Winterscales were a success. A new batch of servants will arrive in ten moons. Escort them to the laboratory at once, it is imperative that we increase the new retainers' resistance to the Child's powers."

003a86b0-7bcd-4e97-98e2-5e9dcba5cb67.Text: {n}Pasqal's vox-systems emit a binharic trill.{/n} "The spirits of this sacred machine require special purification rituals in order to restore utilisation of the lingua more familiar to the citizens of the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}. Requesting access to the device."

a8bae3f6-1641-4205-8241-da9ff9b4b772.Text: {n}A shiver of static runs across the shattered vid-screen.{/n}

f9624883-73ea-4077-9f6b-bad7a7a5155b.Text:
{n}After a brief pause, the data appears on the vid-screen:
- Felek Orsellio. Location: main hall. Status: alive.
- Theobald Orsellio. Location: upper chambers. Status: alive.
- Calomira Orsellio. Location: upper chambers. Status: deceased.
- Alexius Orsellio. Location: lower levels. Status: deceased.
- Rasmus-Estevan Orsellio. Location: unknown. Status: deceased.{/n}

1587801c-dd0f-40fc-b382-c3d83eece90a.Text: {n}Report X-891 originator: classified. Date: classified.{/n} "Data expunged."

34655f9c-6eed-4c4b-b2c4-fdddd56d6c4f.Text:
{n}The Child. Location: upper chambers. Biometric parameters: rapid heartbeat, elevated body temperature, stress level exceeds the permissible limit. Status: unknown error.
ATTENTION! Calming procedures advised. ATTENTION! Upper chambers inaccessible. ERROR: the control rod is not present. If the rod has been misplaced, immediately contact a station Keeper or the Navis Laboratorum custodian.{/n}

a88bce0b-ad5b-4f2d-8ac1-ce4bb284be41.Text: {n}The following vox-recordings are too badly distorted to make out even a single word.{/n}

6cf91cd8-8885-4bf8-b3a9-51494c46d8f1.Text: {n}A muffled howl comes from under the iron shell of the cogitator. No matter how hard you try to overpower it, the system remains inaccessible.{/n}

cbfbbc75-dca7-47af-b620-27ea9f6eb945.Text: {n}The {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priest{/g}'s vox-systems emit a binharic trill, and his {g|Encyclopedia:Mechadendrite}mechadendrites{/g} start furiously lashing at the air:{/n} "I am recording blasphemy! The person found guilty of such cruelty to a noble mechanism must be sentenced to immediate destruction."

4e829db0-aefc-4002-a2de-210da02320a7.Text:
{n}There is a restless hum in the sacred machine's interior, but soon the required information is projected onto the vid-screen:
- Felek Orsellio. Location: main entry hall. Status: deceased.
- Theobald Orsellio. Location: upper chambers. Status: alive.
- Calomira Orsellio. Location: upper chambers. Status: deceased.
- Alexius Orsellio. Location: lower levels. Status: deceased.
- Rasmus-Estevan Orsellio. Location: unknown. Status: deceased.{/n}

ec89df21-b3cc-43d6-b267-c6d742e33745.Text:
{n}The Child. Location: upper chambers. Biometric parameters: rapid heartbeat, elevated body temperature, stress level exceeds the permissible limit. Status: unknown error.
ATTENTION! Calming procedures advised. ATTENTION! Upper chambers inaccessible. ERROR: the main elevator mechanism is not powered. ERROR: the control rod is not present. If the rod has been misplaced, immediately contact a station Keeper or the Navis Laboratorum custodian.{/n}

f26c8e72-7390-414d-bcb1-0dc19f48bfcc.Text: {n}The cogitator takes a few moments to gather the data from the station's active systems and produces the following message:{/n} "The protocol has been executed. The passage has been opened."

d34ebb4d-9231-4a7b-955d-3e2c0d6a850f.Text: {n}The cogitator takes a few moments to gather the data from the station's active systems. According to the report, this door has already been opened.{/n}

8e1e873c-7253-4c0b-9b6b-7377d0b6789e.Text: "Welcome to the Rykad Minoris command centre!"

e94f9350-64e4-4da3-a95e-8496c5623334.Text: Bodies of soldiers killed very recently.

5fffed2d-d6ad-435a-9f94-40bbf5065147.Text: The soldiers' bodies and the general aftermath of the battle suggest that the attackers knew the squad's numbers, ranks, and movement route precisely.

8783b1a1-e17d-4885-9cdd-3c487937072b.Text: There are traces of a recent battle everywhere, including bodies in planetary guard uniforms.

c430d26b-6736-4018-b0b0-652b7e4c5636.Text: "Aurora's foe must be here by now."

30c78e82-413b-4b84-9fdb-80517bf35f4e.Text: "Patience. {mf|H|Sh}e will fall into our trap. The prophet's truth is with us."

91a41309-c400-4758-b80f-7ab15d81c1de.Text: "All hail... Aurora... all hail... Aurora... all hail... Aurora..."

7fd75499-95b3-4a28-b3d6-9f765d7eb045.Text: "Eyes... My eyes... Have you got them? Please give them back to me! Even just one! Please!"

bbcb1f2a-b429-4a50-8a09-f95172c77d9d.Text: "The sun... will rise one last time... the final time..."

851c33c6-6f0d-48fc-b098-440b793a862f.Text: "The light! It's in me! It's inside! It's... killing... me... aargh!"

48c2694d-d6a4-4d27-b2e1-ae3325bbbc01.Text: "The Final Dawn is nigh! I can feel it!"

9f028751-75a5-4c92-bd05-8f6afd49e50c.Text: "The edge... the edge... the edge... of what? I can't remember! Enough! Stop talking to me!"

ca6217d7-1b85-48d5-8765-082818c6a86c.Text: "You have arrived at your destination. And now you will die! For Aurora and the Final Dawn!"

d7525cac-9352-4974-95d2-46a3d8e6d3ad.Text: "We can't walk straight across, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. I'll show you a safe way around!"

92a0c7c0-edc4-40f2-867a-5a78821ef4a0.Text: This young man was evidently killed at the same time as the others. But he is the only one whose clothes and equipment have been taken.

f786ede2-2fbc-4b3b-98e6-3b5ab0fe7f12.Text: There is no doubt the menacing symbols are heretical.

a585433a-57da-4038-ad8c-41c5ffefdab7.Text: The ritual site is covered in ominous heretical symbols, each of which is unmistakably emanating the malevolent power of the warp.

82296784-5c31-4f5f-9d29-9ef7732091a2.Text: A portable vox-caster capable of transmitting signals across large distances.

b2594e1f-1924-473e-bc07-6dbc4925b620.Text: The markings on this vox-caster clearly indicate that it belongs to the planetary wardens. There are visible scratches and traces of blood on the device.

69321813-fd8c-4c78-867b-69a983f99b53.Text: "Right... we have to go around... the main road is sort of... blocked by debris..."

f421502c-6c56-466e-9e5c-7e6e1ab4880a.Text: "Did you think you had won, enemy mine?"

26f4c7d1-2549-4c65-9149-b1836023832e.Text: "This is just the beginning, enemy mine."

bc5e2b06-ed99-42c9-b68b-6da68c3b3920.Text: "He comes! He comes! He comes! He comes!"

7a9a5eaf-ff84-461f-9dc2-c7a46b7ae81d.Text: "From the depths of dead stone, from His prison of cold metal, He will rise — the hour is nigh!"

023600f2-20aa-422e-b846-bca48bd4ea89.Text: "You vanquished Twilight. You cut down Aurora. But she was only one of us. You hear me?"

099b9ba1-6091-4717-87a9-ddb1ceb0c41b.Text: "They are coming, one following in the other's footsteps: the Aurora of the morning and the Aurora of the evening."

bc7ff51b-4bc1-43e4-8513-cd84ea5134df.Text: "They are coming, step after step, the eyeless followers, the voiceless heralds. The great Master and behind him, his loyal Apostle."

a2cffbca-b134-495e-8339-dac7a4185915.Text: "Hear this, enemy mine! We are mere shadows. Followers. You are yet to meet Him who has endowed us with secret knowledge."

e91f46a4-4d71-4f6e-95fe-d4c5ddc1314e.Text: "That is, of course, if you survive this day — the day of the coming of the Final Dawn!"

37ee7640-b35a-4cd0-8d81-569aba5a1e52.Text: "Why are you all huddled together... I can't see a thing from back here!"

366ef110-9309-4e1c-8b4d-15f59b21d3b6.Text: "An actual Rogue Trader? In the flesh? I've never even seen our Lord Winterscale."

4c7ece36-2a1d-43d8-8b5d-81dcbc01170f.Text: "We should've found a spot by the starport. It's where they're going to burn the heretic."

61cebf3e-72f7-4d61-a410-eec2b98fc681.Text: "Look at that distinguished old fellow walking behind the Rogue Trader!"

2615c057-aa42-4fff-b835-8ec97acb6f32.Text: "Look! A holy sister! Bless us, maiden of light!"

99632648-59f8-43e1-963e-7619bc2cd695.Text: "Huh, and who's the pale one? A highborn lady, I suppose? She looks kind of... uh, I'll just shut up now."

e16b8e06-a6f7-4110-8849-0259799b2877.Text: "See that fellow walking behind the Rogue Trader? The way he's staring at everyone! One look and it's like he's plucked your soul right out of your body!"

3ba73036-f08c-43a4-8987-600badcb63ac.Text: "Just look at the lady walking behind the Rogue Trader. You can tell she's not a noble, yet somehow, she's made her way in the world!"

094b05e5-9e3a-4b62-810f-ae6bcf069390.Text: "Oh look! That one there is a Magos! Probably going to pray to the machine and be there to fix it if it breaks down mid-parade!"

45504cfa-6ef3-4e2d-9430-db1818322c26.Text: "Glory to the redeemer! Glory to the von Valancius dynasty!"

518c61bb-12a0-4242-ace7-22d8ed7e72a1.Text: "May the light of the Emperor be with you!"

9de0b868-da30-40ab-822b-ce412b5e1765.Text: "May your glory shine through the ages!"

a57dd6c7-21b5-42bc-a38d-d107ce0aa902.Text: "Glory to H{mf|is Lord|er Lady}ship, the Rogue Trader! Hurray!"

657c8fc9-a857-41dc-a3ae-e285d5b2ef6f.Text: "May the light of the Throne shine upon your path, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship!"

91046750-bd6c-4a8c-b587-50d3b9069958.Text: The soldier stands to attention and salutes in reverence. His eyes are full of bliss and rapture.

26ec6b3a-01e0-4166-b95a-845b5a067310.Text: "How am I to live now? What for? The prophecy came true... the sun has been extinguished, and I — I was an old fool! We are all doomed..."

402e0017-b3a0-4f55-9e2d-d781621bae2c.Text: "Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! It's such a relief you're unharmed..."

4e22c08f-c439-4f64-b95c-62803967df28.Text: "Did they know all along? Were they right? Could it all be because of us... because we were saved?"

0753248e-7e9c-4467-9764-16609b2903a6.Text: "The sun's gone? We must... our children must make it out alive at any cost!"

8f7a1b23-501b-4136-b7f4-7860fb83ea5f.Text: "Quick, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! You have to leave this planet!"

bed9d917-9e8a-4c71-8c9e-69d0350e3927.Text: "The sun... has gone out? How can it be?"

4e61d397-15b0-4aff-a3b9-b14e84305fb2.Text: "Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! You have to get out of here! Quick!"

e6a2f5c0-47c9-4f47-bf1b-e51b816f245d.Text: Judging by the caustic smell and oily stains, promethium was previously stored here. It must have fallen into the hands of the heretics.

9aa417a0-91a4-4e2c-8c6e-048dbdc42733.Text: The drums exude a caustic smell of promethium. Thankfully, the rebels have not yet reached them and set this place ablaze.

4df9c035-4ff3-457f-bd83-a1a3919b6d2c.Text: "They'll get us out of here, right? They'll send a transport?"

eb5153ba-70f4-4c20-bd9d-8a9b671d53b5.Text: "We're gonna die here... Just like that... While the nobles evacuate, we're all gonna die!"

1015c45e-d2da-477c-8ca6-4106aeaa0c89.Text: The grand viaduct for receiving esteemed guests is buried under the rubble.

2cbc1f7f-ba5e-49db-add7-69eaf7257421.Text: "Conserve your ammo, keep your head down! But no sitting pretty behind cover either! Keep fighting! Stand by for reinforcements!"

e01f2393-461d-4617-ba1e-cf7c712148fb.Text: "Ugh, it hurts! Someone give me lho before I go... Come on, lads, don't send me off without lho..."

7d3a1e0b-9a69-4627-a83c-cd1bb5c4ed96.Text: "I wish it was the enemy... It was our own... They ran me over... Scum..."

9e0a9d75-1c3a-4c31-ac35-7ad50de75116.Text: "You thought you had killed Aurora, false believers? Tremble, for I am Aurora! I am the herald of change! Behold the Final Dawn... and die!"

63f5e46f-f5c0-4455-b03b-0b79c857601a.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, what's going on? Has the end of days come? Emperor have mercy! Why do we have to die like this—"

46406c17-0272-4159-8fb2-bf37ce0c1e9e.Text: "Stop snivelling, recruit! You're addressing a Rogue Trader! Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, permission to report! We've been posted to guard the field infirmary! The governor and Sergeant Malgar are over at the landing pads, planning the evacuation!"

9e87b467-fc57-4b20-8403-b7b82b14b0c7.Text: "You sure the machine spirits will listen to you? I bet they're real stubborn!"

26c6beeb-eaf5-4552-8e7c-ce7aca9fc9ea.Text: "Quit your whinging! I've seen the Tech-Priest do it twice. I once even brought a censer to him! Of course they'll lis—"

ebdc317f-0840-482b-b7d7-7dc490596a5a.Text: "Starport, this is the von Valancius shuttle. Prepare a landing pad and ceremonial escort."

8b84f3d8-0e3f-47c0-ad22-2b72c51fb743.Text: "Starport, this is the von Valancius shuttle. Do you copy?"

4000a9ff-65ac-42f8-adf5-9f62229821b7.Text: "Damn it! That wretch is destroying shuttles to prevent anyone from escaping! We must stop him!"

08941e73-bee4-4a67-9174-c786fc8954ac.Text: "The traitor to the Imperium is intent on destroying the shuttles. If we stop him, we have a chance at salvation!"

9279df09-1cea-45a1-a4eb-0ef2719045e4.Text: "{name}! The shuttles! That scumbag's destroying the shuttles! There'll be no way out of here. We've got to stop this madness!"

64ba551e-4a05-4968-a818-429677d5087a.Text: "Ahaha! My sight is true, and my mind is clear! I see death! I see the future!"

e33dbbb1-1597-4a13-9b14-f6fbe89fa80c.Text: From your vantage point, it does not seem like this lavish mansion has been damaged by explosions, but you cannot enter. Something is blocking the entrance from the inside.

9d3f4c6c-9ac0-4a8b-9df2-eb92937dbb72.Text: "Serve the Emperor in your heart and deeds when you join the ranks of His illustrious army, the Astra Militarum!"

32fe8ecc-bde5-40a7-8caa-47f569269731.Text: "Fight heresy, serve a higher purpose, safeguard Humanity's dominion!"

5b2df01d-b14b-449f-a075-7a03cf4602c7.Text: "Join up at your hive's nearest Astra Militarum mobile conscription centre."

ab59d00c-a6cd-4066-82f4-6a37d5551a17.Text: "There is only one outcome! Aurora's prophecy will come true!"

b88c40aa-81e2-4259-b276-4a2dd4c29af7.Text: "I opened my eyes to the truth... and at last, I saw the inevitable future!"

fb1c5dbc-0dca-47b9-8cf6-095f205685f0.Text: "Aurora knows all that is to come... Only Aurora can guide us to salvation..."

cc6d9ec1-f34e-42bd-8383-71f1f92da3bd.Text: "The sun will die, and the world will be reborn! Aurora will guide us to the new light!"

0929210a-bd7a-47cf-8543-5a2efb642800.Text: "This pain... is meaningless. Only she can show me the true light..."

5c0a5360-c52f-4d98-b6b0-3425f77fe03d.Text: "My comrades' deaths will not stop the rise of the new sun!"

ee5345f7-fa4b-4220-b8d5-057a99267d3a.Text: "No one can stop the future! The sun will die! Aurora's prophecy will come to pass!"

08041010-7867-4d6b-a8c5-331a6336e5e6.Text: "The fall is preordained. The prophecy will be fulfilled."

937b3dc1-f899-4125-9b5d-7fb244753b5d.Text: "When darkness falls, only those who have embraced it will find the path to the new light."

701219e3-70bb-422f-bfea-7b7da5a41e95.Text: "This is just the beginning. The world will plunge into darkness, and only Aurora's faithful will find salvation within..."

73b9ac7e-9218-43de-b77a-85f5c73dd9e0.Text: "Arise! Let us welcome the new light together!"

363f6e12-df6b-427d-afa3-a20efd182562.Text: "Can you hear it? The future is coming! My eyes are blind, but I can finally see it!"

98c6a138-f49a-4c85-9296-78ed14e77507.Text: Someone had the misfortune of resting here when the first explosions rang out.

756e0008-01eb-487c-bdae-58257c313e50.Text: "Attention! As ordered by the planet's lawful governor, to prevent recurring rebellions, all planetary guard patrols are to be doubled. All conspirators and instigators will be harshly punished!"

f7e5dc82-cc8d-496b-a19b-7a9ce3b18eb4.Text: The Upperway extends across a wide bridge, which is suspended high above the roiling waters of the river below. The bridge is densely packed with imposing and ostentatious buildings designed to flatter the vanity of the local elite.

b4fb0c1a-16bd-44e8-a9ab-113dc36ca9e5.Text: Errant rubbish lies scattered between the seats covered in stone dust — old programmes, faded tickets, and food scraps of unknown origin.

03a881ab-dbf0-4de4-b1a8-8486ef90f3b9.Text: The temple door does not budge. It may be blocked by rubble from the other side.

515d5e8e-6180-4b71-95cb-693832d7b0aa.Text: The mobile charging stations chatter and crackle — the piercing sound is easily distinguishable even in the surrounding turmoil.

156c3878-5904-457d-9635-16b2aa4505a0.Text: Pamphlets and booklets are strewn around the dormant cogitator, imploring the reader to devote their life to serving the Emperor in the ranks of the Astra Militarum.

e09c69ef-990c-473a-8785-0d2e00598495.Text: "Combat arsenal transferred to the command centre in full. No damage sustained."

c46c8360-bcdc-45ae-ade7-0abe2547a895.Text: Clearly oblivious to your presence, the soldier mutters incoherently and does not react to anything around him.

ce7a458e-cf64-4290-9ae8-a630ad07047f.Text: The floor is covered in clearly heretical symbols and scrawls.

8df77a6a-9ef5-4dae-bb56-5b323cd4508f.Text: The ruined weapon radiates intense heat, and an oily puddle giving off a caustic stench spreads across the pavement.

2140c23b-f74f-4977-82c1-41a859b637d3.Text: This mansion must have been damaged by an explosion or a large shell. You can still see some of its former luxury within.

11f820cd-0f38-4fdf-8b85-b85435d0923a.Text: Something large and heavy ploughed down the entire width of the street. You can only guess what could have caused such damage.

b63b0aca-13ef-4fa1-b3e1-cd5580952c28.Text: The temple's tower collapsed onto the pavement and is blocking the way. It will take days to clear the rubble.

d25d68e4-5ceb-4b13-8998-3d27bd687e76.Text: This shuttle must be what crashed into the building and destroyed part of the street.

069495f1-c77b-4668-b563-2e29c633c62f.Text: The food in the stalls is covered by a thick layer of stone dust. It was all abandoned in a hurry.

6ba4f481-7a7a-4f21-a9bf-8b26f59812fe.Text: The fountain's merry murmur seems to mock the surrounding chaos and desolation.

748fa41c-2dd9-4b9b-a554-5b1f4bc6b8c6.Text: "Success is measured in blood — yours and your enemies'!"

0b8b28b3-6232-4fde-930f-db33ebf9a5dd.Text: "Your triumphal procession will illuminate the entire Upperway! When you are ready to begin, speak to the Master of Ceremonies in the square, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

0e063269-045d-49e2-a6a2-346bb15b3cb2.Text: "Poor, poor old man... I tried to talk him out of it!"

669bd416-6cbf-4fe9-97b3-1a0a90e0fb49.Text: "I hope I'm not making a mistake..."

46e782eb-71c7-48ed-8996-95ca1edc6f05.Text: "We're in one piece... Everything will be all right, won't it?"

8279fa42-ae0c-4869-95aa-43e2a84a9cba.Text: Numerous pumps, compressors, and other machines are thrumming away on the lower levels of the great bridge.

1a9aff98-9122-4153-8d1d-22e11a2b83d7.Text: The goods in this stall are a stark contrast to the rest of the nearby shops. The jars are labelled, "All-purpose synth-powder: fills you up no matter what! Made in Necromunda's best factories."

24e7b99d-d71b-4845-a825-882baa4ada65.Text: Nothing but a pile of shards remains of the sinister lens that the heretics used to burn out the eyes of devout cultists.

9adb4927-27b4-42f8-9d5d-2e54d3ad1942.Text: The heretics used the abhorrent powers of this lens to ruin the eyes of the most devout followers of their cult.

9baf5219-cfb1-41c0-833f-1d56ebb2a775.Text: This mechanical door leads to the lower levels under the Upperway.

6555f4cb-6cca-4127-9bd8-c285685762a4.Text: The cover was haphazardly assembled from whatever the rebels could find.

4ebd31a8-fe7b-4258-b17c-949082a79ef0.Text: Rebels, soldiers, and ordinary workers — everyone perished under the rubble of the ruined bridge and buildings.

244d6264-c1a5-46ba-9f60-51fe8b1a537f.Text: A powerful explosion destroyed a large part of the bridge, both above and below. Could someone still be alive in there?

6042276f-9e95-4564-aceb-a2dc2f74d36f.Text: A solitary young Tech-Priest is offering ceaseless prayers to the machine spirits of the command centre.

4416c9ad-5045-4bd2-85c2-c4aa9fc8600a.Text: This finely crafted statue survived the explosions unscathed.

3b7b9d28-21f4-4979-b3cc-09f48ff16b44.Text: This statue is dedicated to the martyr Jollus Marquette, who converted more than a dozen worlds in the possession of the Winterscale dynasty to the Imperial Creed. His body, frozen in mute prayer and pierced by a dozen black blades, was discovered by his followers in his quarters en route to yet another world.

1f683f7b-100b-45ef-86ff-babea8092649.Text: These enormous transformers emit a heavy, unpleasant hum.

26e490dc-48c1-4882-85eb-8d5fd5d3d347.Text: These enormous humming transformers must be part of a single and much larger mechanism that supplies power to the whole hive.

1ca488fc-b8e7-47eb-b626-c87a211e6853.Text: A ruined shuttle lies on the street where people used to go for leisurely walks not long ago.

48918fc1-e246-4a2b-bf61-fcc476fe0a04.Text: The shuttle must have been shot out of the sky by a powerful weapon before it crashed into the building and fell onto the once-crowded street.

05853c8d-124f-4153-8241-378ac9aa0211.Text: Mount the tank and commence the triumphant march

4fd7029d-5414-4713-be68-e99cc5abbf61.Text: "Why are we giving away our spoils to these people in the first place?"

a637e599-0c4a-4f48-bef8-ae591a3c0eb5.Text: "Tell me what you think of Seneschal Abelard Werserian."

bdc665bd-90c1-4489-8769-c6ccf9e6f0b0.Text: "Remind me: what is it you do on my ship?"

d5a1852e-f9ae-426f-9493-20031c3505ad.Text: "How did you come to serve the von Valancius dynasty?"

398a881e-634c-4d10-9eca-f23bba8402c7.Text: "What was it like working with Theodora?"

389fa94a-8c9f-4d48-94f3-cc1c04533315.Text: "I wish to know what you think of your fellow crew members."

9642da3a-47e4-4667-bce3-8724bfbedc25.Text: "I want to know more about the people who buy our plunder."

77c3da92-e4ea-4da9-af98-deec1b60b4cf.Text: "What is this Fellowship of the Void?"

96f2ea5e-2f8a-4e13-88e1-6d4e09ea97e8.Text: "Send a chest of treasures from distant worlds."

8e403337-f4de-417b-8692-0074cc6e4468.Text: "Send an embroidery loom. Ladies like that sort of thing."

3ee55ab7-c57b-4cc6-864e-c5b127ede9ed.Text: "Truth be told, I know little of gifts. Do you have any ideas?"

8a0c27a3-8942-442c-b8e9-abaec84079c0.Text: "The gifts will not be necessary. Few things are as elegant as the ability to convey one's feelings in a personal conversation."

5d9413b4-574a-4d5d-9b42-1e0c7dd50086.Text: "I care little for stupid games. This conversation never happened."

35f5bb4c-7c81-4cf3-bc6d-b9a7961b7ebf.Text: "How am I to understand the meaning of my immortalium?"

ae8fe027-ab4f-459f-98a4-c105483322bc.Text: "And what am I supposed to do with all this?"

f16c1e3e-e410-4816-831f-8a12fde2aa67.Text: "I shall return when I think of something."

ba8d4f9a-544b-41af-bd2c-5c75a993924d.Text: "I have changed my mind. Expressing my gratitude in a personal conversation will be enough."

cbd2b24f-b71d-497d-86fb-cb02bf79b09a.Text: "No, his participation will not be necessary."

cf1ace81-1447-49bc-a6f7-6488cd8eff3a.Text: "I wish to take a look at these servitors before deciding their fate."

5aeaaa24-b83a-4fce-8382-e9d6e5c7ca67.Text: "I shall take a look at these servitors, but not right away."

74e81e04-ba6d-4a56-9327-a3d281e9215b.Text: "I am ready to look at the malfunctioning servitors."

2d6a99cb-779e-47c7-82ef-0f21dec3344f.Text: "Just dispose of the defective equipment without me."

f4a9af4b-d609-4370-888f-332792d8b0aa.Text: "You were right to do so. Give it to me."

b76d39b9-a407-465f-8b53-791c1d98c44d.Text: "You should keep it for now. As soon as we locate this acolyte of the Inquisition, you will hand the blade over to him."

011715b9-ada1-4fcb-9187-aadd77b11a5e.Text: "How do you know who I'm doing all this for?"

14967d58-1ea3-457c-a154-cec12921ba2b.Text: "I wish to create a small oasis in the Lady Navigator's chambers."

b7a7d4d1-4117-4e5f-861e-d584ba813671.Text: "No, you may not. Tell me what it means right now."

bec63b56-529a-4b76-a2e8-22bb9a7bd157.Text: "One of Lady Cassia's servants delivered it to my chambers."

827d4fe0-a902-43f7-8812-7f09102b1f82.Text: "I am not fully certain, but I can make an educated guess."

99094857-9cd3-4f0e-b3a6-c977e5c452cf.Text: "I was hoping you would be the one to help me make sense of this."

7d9775a0-4352-4d45-8b17-552bbe523368.Text: "Find the most exquisite perfume in the Calixis Sector."

1e0f6cd8-7370-4aa5-9221-130e92dbd59f.Text: "Provide the Sanctum Navis with a singularly superior library."

a4eff60a-033a-4ecb-b00a-b13f03a62852.Text: "Marazhai needs new victims. Bring two cargo bays' worth of people to the decks."

2f6bc243-658d-4309-857b-0f58ec1e8f70.Text: "Vigdis informed me about a problem with the servitors. What happened?"

38c27d47-6530-4d7b-99d4-0881febfb9d5.Text: "Have you ever heard the name Fiery Reckoning? From what I can tell, it is a voidship of some sort. There was a mention of it in one of Theodora's documents I found."

a61b2f8f-b6e7-451a-b3df-1beb008614dd.Text: "Ryzza of the Fellowship of the Void."

5ccaad64-0314-41e3-ae61-92e713aa5651.Text: "Vladaym Tocara and his 'friends' in the Kasballica."

08308df2-41ab-48b3-833e-de857c74cd15.Text: "I wish to give Jae a present. You shall make the arrangements."

718dd601-a28b-4d8f-9e59-2a9789a43129.Text: "I will gift Jae a small colony."

b6988b4c-5cd2-4ce9-b2f8-1f1f1233958c.Text: "Find a dress for Mistress Heydari that will be the envy of the Dargonus aristocracy."

98273dfc-823e-452c-bba0-67b2219e92b7.Text: "Jae deserves the best jewellery I can afford."

6e7a8e84-b350-4783-8e78-e1e4de2926f3.Text: "Upon further consideration... I think Jae will make do without gifts."

ec0c7f51-b911-49bb-8711-e078d8221ef2.Text: "I need some time to think it over."

dfdeb756-40a6-47b9-b982-c5fefb8c0fdd.Text: "What is every smuggler's desire? Her own voidship, which I will gladly give her."

9e04fbc0-0571-4f20-8630-3e09942a95da.Text: "I wish to hear news about the protectorate. To keep apprised of things."

e487a42d-1aea-4ba3-b104-f155a679cc29.Text: "I'd like to hear your opinion of Kunrad Voigtvir, the former Master of Whispers."

14f761ca-f5bb-4e46-8aea-b2250c9799dd.Text: "I would like to introduce Kibellah to some of the customs practised among people of my stature — show her what life is like on the upper decks, so to speak."

0271a271-26dd-4c43-b708-f44ef227003d.Text: "You are not scheming to misappropriate funds for the orphans' benefit, are you?"

a6749a74-f74b-4325-875d-40b495a6646b.Text: "Lavish spending is out of order. Concentrate on your duties."

f1cf56fd-52c2-4a36-870d-5af141f56194.Text: "I trust you with this matter. Spend as much as you deem necessary."

84158fc1-c979-431c-9612-c073de724c9f.Text: "I was counting on you to choose an appropriate ritual."

225e12a2-8d39-447f-a092-0c41fdd9429c.Text: "Have you recovered from Nemesite's attack yet? You came very close to death in the chapel."

cade95d8-ca7e-4b86-a4bd-30fcad315397.Text: "What do you have to say about Vox Master Vigdis Toliman?"

829ab24d-76ec-4721-b30e-046418bf559a.Text: "I must locate someone named Naaki Erebis. Find whatever information you can."

d4a33854-45a1-4f5b-9492-1a2940c34275.Text: "It is not common for the voidborn to settle on a planet."

e9052517-9579-40e3-8b0c-d36397366286.Text: "You have a good heart, it seems. I am surprised."

9a7f8d72-191c-48a1-9357-716580bb883b.Text: "Make sure they get things that will bring them little moments of joy. Sweets, toys... They deserve it."

aa3f4af4-570b-4169-b5d5-7df296887f04.Text: "Nothing extravagant. No spoiling the children — only spend thrones on things that will keep them healthy: food, warm clothes, and training."

72495d9a-dc13-4160-99f5-f2a255ffd827.Text: "Educate them so that they may grow up to be of greater use to the ship. Assign teachers, supply books, and commend the best students with gifts."

aecadb48-82da-4cbe-9f5d-ff161b90d5d5.Text: "I am willing to allocate extra resources to provide for the orphans."

b4c20c1d-0ccf-4235-9650-e54ce13fe19f.Text: "Take me to the wardroom where Glaito is rampaging."

d3d06489-024c-49ac-be75-50928a26b0c9.Text: "Contact the curiosity merchant from the Dargonus palace. A cyber-beast needs new equipment."

5e348e3c-1e80-40cc-b9d3-119f6f74cedd.Text: "Just so you are aware, treasurer: in the past, my duty was to ensure that the governor of every world under my watch paid the tithe without fail, and even the smallest shortage was punished in full accordance with the letter of the Lex Imperialis."

365879e9-b9ef-4cc0-a004-60e4db3f062f.Text: "What do the followers of Saint Drusus acquire from us?"

cafa5e76-889a-4d5f-b929-c62b75f78ec7.Text: "I am interested in the Kasballica Mission."

55a0b30b-81bc-4e90-b189-39349b65fb34.Text: "The orphans on the ship have already been provided with the bare essentials, have they not?"

7f7e4352-d3d2-4429-b565-fdd1b6681569.Text: "Why are some destined to perish in the warp while others must go on living?"

5300aa8b-dd98-4c21-ad64-b927593bb355.Text: {n}The High Factotum Janris Danrok greets you with a cool smile and the merest hint of a bow.{/n} "Pleasure to see you, Lord Captain! How may I be of assistance?"

555a4a7b-5416-470e-a79c-aae694af11f8.Text: "Members of the Explorator Cognisance Fleet, which has been roaming the Koronus Expanse for a good while now. Omnissiah knows what they are hoping to find, but their acolytes regularly show up on inhabited worlds, seeking bits of sacred Knowledge, tracking down mechanical relics... and sniffing out xeno-artefacts, if truth be told. Supposedly, they want to save the ignorant rabble from corruption. A Tech-Priest named Opticon-22 does business with us on the Fleet's behalf. He can be found at the docks on Footfall."

e5825355-6b00-4b32-8bc3-2bb7a3e3c98f.Text: "As you wish, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Would you like the Enginseer Prime to accompany you?"

106853b3-30f6-488a-9da7-3746dda01494.Text: "As you wish, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. How else may I assist you?"

0fef41c0-86fd-4710-9a5a-814cd25e64f5.Text: {n}The Factotum gives a start and briskly makes a note on his data-slate.{/n} "Of course, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

fd7f8d1b-1818-4b71-8f25-1de92a96a3d6.Text: "As the High Factotum, my duties encompass anything that might enrich you and your protectorate. I see to it that suppliers deliver all shipments on time, that our partners do not weasel out of their promises, and that all servants remember that the Emperor's grace can only be earned through toil for the good of the von Valancius dynasty. I also make arrangements to ensure that our hold receives less than thorough inspections by port customs officers, and I find buyers for whatever you wish to sell."

95cb9789-bdad-4605-9a74-0e6796ed6207.Text: "I come from Dargonus, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I have been a subject of your dynasty since birth and have always strived to be of use to the great Rogue Trader. Alas, it was not my fate to be the primary heir of my own family, due to my being fifteenth in line for the title, so I decided not to stand in the way of those behind me in case they attempted to shorten the waiting list at my expense."

6d7c12dc-35f3-4017-9f78-d0720c90eba6.Text: "Oh, now that's a tricky question, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Do you ask it of everyone, knowing they risk losing their head should they let slip a careless remark about your predecessor? I shall put it thus: working with Lady Theodora was never boring and always profitable. The Imperium has billions of subjects, but very few do what they love and what they are best suited to. I would say Lady Theodora was one of the fortunate ones — she was a model Rogue Trader, and she surrounded herself with those who excelled at and loved their work. Hers was a rare talent indeed."

98845954-5884-44ab-b7de-bb92afc84c58.Text: "Keeping tabs on your subordinates? A wise move. Tell me who interests you, and I'll endeavour to be as honest as possible." {n}Janris's eyes light up — he is obviously eager to speak his mind.{/n}

6bcaf64c-ee28-4a82-8745-34b5712c4b9f.Text: "Of course, Lord Captain! Who interests you, exactly? We most often deal with the followers of Saint Drusus, the Explorators, the Kasballica Mission or, Emperor forgive us, the Fellowship of the Void."

9b2db13f-45c7-4933-9a9f-333e33c733e6.Text: {n}Janris lets out an almost kindly chuckle.{/n} "While my brothers and sisters schemed against one another, I studied the exact sciences and mastered bookkeeping, the greatest art of the Adeptus Administratum. I must admit that the accumulation of wealth, something one can control, is far more exciting than hunting, carousing, and the other traditional amusements of my noble peers."

0b1c61ce-8650-4a9e-83a2-41b37cc02b4d.Text: {n}A spike of pain pierces your skull — the entity inside you howls and rages, promising you a million torments and miseries for this treachery.{/n}

d84d6fa1-5de9-40e9-97a1-18d1b648c85e.Text: {n}Janris Danrok shrugs guiltily.{/n} "I suppose you could discreetly ask the Lady Navigator about her preferences in personal conversation."

7174397d-dd24-483f-8e5c-f101c87f1452.Text: {n}Janris shrugs.{/n} "This is the entire point of the ritual, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. How confident are you? What emotions bind you and your partner in this elaborate game? What does your inner voice tell you? Only you can decide how to interpret these events. And only you can deal with the consequences."

abc57cb2-0a86-4dab-8c47-79ad376c1018.Text: "If you wish to observe the servitors' unusual behaviour before you decide their fate, this can be arranged. The majority of the defective units have been delivered to one of the storage compartments pending your decision."

d91b98fd-ea58-4578-b23e-f9bcd7b4dcbc.Text: "Lady Theodora managed to do what even the Imperial Navy could not — teach Master Werserian to carry out orders that he fundamentally disagrees with. I do not know what methods she used, but the result is impressive. Having said that... there is something else you need to know, Lord Captain: your Seneschal is capable of being something far greater than a mere conduit for your will. He possessed the cunning and experience to run the protectorate passably whenever Lady Theodora was away, and that really is saying something. Keep an eye on that old officer, I say... or, alternatively, turn him into a faithful ally."

c3a472d1-1668-489c-9ffd-6c8292844d58.Text: "I hope I never see him set foot aboard this vessel again, not even as a servitor. Although... he would be able to do at least some good that way. Someone has to clean the latrines, after all." {n}The Factotum's bloated face grows stern.{/n} "He gave us all quite a fright on that ill-fated day, Lord Captain. And still, to speak candidly... I never enjoyed Master Voigtvir's company, but I believed him to be a man who knew how to do his job. Regretfully, I was mistaken: it turned out Kunrad lacked the most important quality for a Master of Whispers — unwavering loyalty to the Rogue Trader. And his failing came to light in the most deplorable manner."

3e0fe516-422b-4ca8-a3e8-eef26dd4133c.Text: "Pasqal Haneumann expressed the desire to be present during the inspection, should it be carried out. I suppose the expertise of the esteemed Magos may come in handy."

7d2671d3-ecf7-4777-89bd-8c29fe6e0987.Text: "As you say, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I will immediately give the necessary orders."

90d7fe74-80ee-432a-8a02-cae135d455a9.Text: "Ah, yes, the voidborn... You know, in my family, we used such creatures as quarry whenever we went hunting. Mutants are the bane of Humanity, an unseen tumour that threatens to end us all... But I digress. In the brief time Toliman has spent in post as Vox Master, I have not noticed any significant flaws in her character or anything that would make me question her professional qualities. Needless to say, she is very diligent, as is any voidborn seeking to earn their master's affection. I believe you can trust in her skills and loyalty."

b22a1f1c-79a0-401d-a30b-350f7ae3bfd1.Text: "This... is a highly eccentric endeavour, Lord Captain. Perfect for a person of your lofty standing. It is my duty to warn you that implementing this idea will require a considerable investment of time... and resources. Are you sure of your intentions?"

c917a11d-302b-4770-be20-c4137eae5cac.Text: "I retrieved a blade fragment from one of the bodies on the bridge. A curious article. I saw the need to keep it safe in case it should be of interest to you..." {n}As he says this, the Factotum's gaze slides away from yours and he looks off somewhere over your shoulder.{/n}

e6add2da-7161-4428-9a0c-37203f093a34.Text: "Of course... Please." {n}The Factotum takes his time, but after a few moments he withdraws a small, jagged shard that gleams with a pearlescent lustre.{/n}

dce24c35-09ff-4615-95cd-42b06f89999a.Text: {n}Your shout has an immediate effect on Janris — he jolts as if waking from a stupor.{/n} "Of course, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! I will see to it immediately!"

de958de3-b7f7-497d-91db-2c1d52c5369b.Text: {n}The moment you touch the blade, you hear a satisfied whisper in your head. Now you know — you have taken the first step. But only the first. A long road stretches out before you, one studded with pearlescent stars.{/n}

273cb73a-31d0-4745-9b44-35e92ab9b060.Text: "Oh, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, if this is what I think it is..." {n}Janris ponderously rests his arms on his bulging stomach.{/n} "I once came across a volume on ancient aristocratic rituals in the family library... I think I recall something called an 'immortalium,' a term from an ancient custom of the nobility. An 'eternal flower' that can exist for centuries in the vastness of space. May I enquire who sent it to you?"

2da37fae-47c6-4bc0-9111-8e8072555196.Text: "An immortalium?" {n}Janris shoots you an intrigued look through the lens of his implant.{/n} "May I ask what exactly I should arrange for Lady Cassia?"

80bb635c-0b6b-461e-a53e-98dc02ba0633.Text: "The appearance of an immortalium in the life of two noble personages is a very special ritual meant to wordlessly evoke the true intentions of both parties. Every gesture, act, glance, and statement carries profound meaning replete with subtext. The very act of gifting an immortalium can be interpreted as a sign of favour, uncertainty of intentions, budding friendship... or even a request to keep a polite distance. Sometimes it is all of those things at once."

1ff25701-cea2-4043-a297-b3f025245c87.Text: "Make your move. Do you wish to reject the gift, ostentatiously ignoring the gesture, or accept it on your own terms? According to noble etiquette, the reciprocal gift must display equal effort and emotion. And it must be delivered through a third party, just like the immortalium itself."

04aba0b0-ed2e-4bd9-829a-b2e4443c0a3c.Text: "Your will be done, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Give me some time, and I will make sure your order is carried out to the letter."

da6bf051-3643-48a9-b6a7-98ed63aea473.Text: "The Drusians still hope to bring the Koronus Expanse into the warm embrace of the faith, just as their flock hopes to receive the aid of the Drusian missionaries. Each crate of food, shipment of clothes, or box of medicine marked with your seal is a sign the Rogue Trader {mf|himself|herself} believes in the sect's future success. Reverend Hieronymus is the first among the Drusians and is most often seen in Footfall's grand atrium. A gloomy fellow, but some almost believe him to be a saint."

d0e722ed-65f5-4c31-8f09-f0f56bc75783.Text: {n}Janris bows obsequiously.{/n} "It will be done, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"

cf6558cc-bb5b-4f21-96c8-b92e6f35503d.Text: "Which vendor do you want to contact?"

44a75bd4-0c6c-46dd-8eef-6d5edc0057de.Text: "Is she not satisfied with stealing from our coffers? Ahem, I humbly apologise. Certainly, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, all will be taken care of. Might I ask what you had in mind for your esteemed companion? Given her conspicuous penchant for luxury, the gift needs to be something remarkable indeed."

75e46797-7a58-45ea-ab06-ba4a92f2de98.Text: "To go about this with a practical mind. Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}'s domain spans many worlds, both major planets and minuscule colonial outposts that are nigh-insignificant on the scale of the von Valancius protectorate but could still bring great fortune to an ordinary person. Given Mistress Heydari's choice of trade, she might quite like the option of retiring to a safe haven whenever the need arises. Her own humble demesne... and a place where she won't need to fear the schemes of her vengeful rivals."
