Many laypeople are capable of possessing it, but a wise mind that is not bound by oaths of obedience to the Omnissiah is vulnerable to corruption and freethinking. Even more vulnerable than the mind of an ignorant commoner."

ca14b929-e9e3-40b0-ac3c-61d4795d0328.Text: {n}Vistenza gasps and immediately sinks into a bow.{/n} "Of course, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"

7f28f0a3-a2a6-487f-81ce-2ba1c0fe0c64.Text: "Thank you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Believe me, I am infinitely sorry that the troubles of Janus have reached us even here, the most protected place on Janus."

bc02ce08-6f2b-4383-bac8-83c565beb827.Text: "Oh no, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I would never dare to deliberately endanger the heir of the illustrious von Valancius dynasty! However, I cannot but express my joy that you took some pleasure in what happened."

79c2492c-d1eb-43ad-8c55-2b829200acd7.Text: "I risk angering you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, but this is nothing compared to shamelessly deceiving you. Let us consider the situation dispassionately: even the most talented logistics experts of the Administratum are unable to guarantee stable tithes when shuttles are wary of landing at the spaceport, and the terrified peasants are indulging a dangerous minority within their ranks. Until the usual order of things is restored on Janus, any trade is nigh impossible."

065dd5e6-dc73-49d0-bbcd-0c201596fcb5.Text: "No, it was an ancient creation of Humanity. Our family relic — a personal displacer field generator." {n}Vistenza touches her solar plexus.{/n} "According to Vyatt family lore, it has saved the lives of several members of my line, and most likely mine too, today."

16d72624-c01e-49d2-8e18-c0ae35ad8998.Text: "I am certain that your position will enable you to acquire so valuable and rare a relic as this in short order. I would recommend you do what generations of my family have done — implant it in your body so that you are never parted from it even for a minute." {n}With greater emphasis this time, Vistenza again touches her solar plexus.{/n}

08fab780-65a6-48bf-811a-8ee30a7e518e.Text: "I..." {n}Vistenza trails off, then folds her arms and nods.{/n} "Of course, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

702415ee-5899-4acf-bdf1-dbf998b17bdf.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} has deigned to pay me a visit? To what do I owe the pleasure?"

04a9329c-b762-47cb-a5bd-a66886095fd5.Text: "You have woven your web of deceit in vain — you can no longer hide behind the veil of ignorance. {name} has seen the evidence of your deeds, heard the cries of the tormented Lilaethan, walked amidst the decay that you brought to the Maiden World. Enough of your lies, Chaos wretch!"

fc1c7184-49ed-46b0-b358-8ecc63c76b76.Text: "Let's not beat around the bush, Governor Vyatt. Extremely serious allegations have been levelled against you, which the Inquisition wishes to bring to your attention. Your actions, whether directly or indirectly, serve the purposes of the Archenemy."

cd4fd3fb-0682-43da-97a7-4c39cde82415.Text: "How dare you! House Vyatt will not tolerate such insults within its walls!" {n}Vistenza turns her head toward you with a pleading look.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"

19153e4d-a304-49a4-829a-94548c9d6a69.Text: {n}The woman standing next to Vistenza laughs delicately, but after a sharp sidelong look from the governor, she resumes her air of deferential sorrow.{/n}

72226837-3044-4b93-820f-e3f4e3567c8f.Text: "Enough lies and diversions. If there is even a grain — the barest shadow — of the dignity of the children of the Imperium left within you — confess now!"

fd1d9121-48a0-4165-8bc4-43729d01846d.Text: "You accuse me of deceit! I will not stand for it! Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, what is this about?"

69d845cd-7cf5-43b3-aae7-180e21114f8f.Text: {n}The companion standing next to Vistenza respectfully bows her head. She is doggedly trying not to turn her head toward you, but it is obvious she is watching you through her lowered lashes.{/n}

4d597b57-68a7-4786-b3b1-6f4a2f57f5f2.Text: "I recently began introducing a series of improvements to raise the planet's production output, and thereby reduce the side effects of soil cultivation. Imagine how the backward peasants react when their traditions and methods, unchanged over generations, suddenly disappear... Every change is greeted with pitchforks. I fear that someone is exploiting the rabble's short-sightedness as a means of striking at House Vyatt."

3502c16a-22bc-4fe5-b2ca-05a59505f809.Text: "Xenos? On Janus? What horror has been lurking right on our doorstep! I owe you a debt that cannot be repaid, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!" {n}Vistenza sweeps into a low bow before you.{/n}

77d175bb-c79c-4765-a70f-3ab5194d7479.Text: {n}Vistenza presses her whitened lips into a line.{/n} "I suppose you had strong justification for taking such a decision..."

53097a0a-b6c7-48f9-9c51-c8a61a34ed03.Text: "Well, then. Now that the source of rebellious sentiment has been eliminated, I believe we can move on to other issues..."

b5d3b615-1ad4-43ff-8ab4-66a10ad3fdb1.Text: {n}Vistenza shares a glance with her companion, who is standing beside her. The companion casts a quick, frightened look at you and hurriedly lowers her eyes.{/n}

d662a7ca-6a4c-47ef-a3da-8b37e4bbc7c8.Text: "Excellent! Let's not waste any more time, we should discuss what Janus can offer now that the problem with the rebels has been resolved."

4dffe6e6-2634-43c4-a313-1d0bdf3f027d.Text: "A regrettable display of weakness, Rogue Trader." {n}The air around Heinrix begins to crackle with electrical discharge.{/n} "In the name of the Inquisition, I sentence you, Vistenza Janus Vyatt ab Aram af Koronus, to death."

b38c666d-d203-4919-9670-9b8ff73db7c4.Text: {n}Jae leans forward curiously.{/n} "Gauntness of frame and tall stature are features common even among voidborn, my dear governor. That does not make them mutants. Then, pray, whatever do you find so disagreeable about this... Yrliet's appearance?"

f9d4ec39-895b-4b81-8934-5bc75b490c65.Text: "And before you offend my ears with more accusations or moral admonitions... remember who has dutifully served your dynasty all these years. Remember who has devoted her life to turning Janus into the primary source of wealth in your protectorate. Remember to whom your predecessor entrusted one of her most valuable worlds, without fear of treachery or conspiracy! Without me, without my service, my sacrifice, Janus would be nothing!"

035c9513-933a-4b7b-9e76-4b5708ab4397.Text: "One of my ladies-in-waiting, Amelia. Amelia performs secretarial duties and helps me to remain in constant contact with those families who are most responsible for the productivity and prosperity of Janus. I trust my advisors implicitly, and over time Amelia has become not merely a faithful companion, but almost my shadow! Losing her would be like losing my right hand!" {n}Vistenza laughs and gives Amelia an encouraging nod.{/n}

131dc535-fc49-46ba-9b42-4b2a53a584c2.Text: {n}Vistenza cringes from the memories.{/n} "The strange movements. The strange looks. The abnormally large eyes on an unnaturally distorted face. The pointed ears..."

65e2af3f-b0f1-4e1c-9bae-dacea505b4a3.Text: {n}Jae raises an eyebrow meaningfully.{/n} "Do I have news for you, shereen... but it is for your ears only. I will tell you when we meet our mysterious new ally."

e39af03a-1bdb-4089-931c-15f02273ec42.Text: {n}The companion behind Vistenza brandishes a curved blade.{/n} "Traitor! The Prince saw your treachery — you can die along with the Trader, Vistenza!"

8aab0b62-cccc-4234-a2de-d174638108ad.Text: "As you wish, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I am loath to mention it, but I am still under arrest, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, and I will hardly be able to fulfil my duties under such conditions. I propose that, first and foremost, you deliver your final judgement on the degree to which I have wronged you and the manner of punishment..."

0758b595-1569-4a86-9a1d-de8d14d36e5e.Text: "Thank you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Your mercy knows no bounds!"

66b9da92-c51d-494d-993c-a3475c52400b.Text: "What senseless, pseudoscientific claptrap..." {n}Vistenza falls silent.{/n} "I may call Janus an unruly child at times, but a planet with a soul? A ridiculous notion..."

2acd8e3f-9002-4d14-8a7b-01277d5b0e08.Text: "I will see that it is done, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}... but I must warn you that a burden of that magnitude will bleed Janus dry. I hope you will soon trade your fury for mercy."

c681ea90-d17e-40dc-bed4-69e0eab9890a.Text: "Jungles? The effects of the changes have gone that far? But by my assessment, the biomes should have been preserved intact for future arable land!"

cc791594-de9d-47cf-98fd-0b211bea1fe1.Text: "It really is embarrassing to admit that even Vladaym, may azhi take that man, is better at doing his job as Liege of Footfall than Lady Vyatt is at keeping her world in check."

d4fe5835-fad8-4e68-9f19-658c07b9841e.Text: "Well, in that case, I will immediately order the opening of my personal stores and I will furnish you with the best this world has to offer!"

1188adac-9795-4428-9905-aebc50e748a9.Text: {n}Amelia drops into a low curtsy.{/n} "To bathe in the light of your greatness is a true honour, Rogue Trader!"

537f9467-0d09-4627-9846-b132f4838150.Text: {n}Vistenza turns white as a sheet. She barely manages to grit out the words through clenched teeth:{/n} "It... it w-will be done, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

53042512-cf19-4ed4-8141-4b70f50c2ba8.Text: {n}Vistenza leans forward.{/n} "Janus is a remarkable world, both in terms of its vast potential, and in terms of the work that was carried out to transform it into an agri-world. House Vyatt has ruled on Janus for many generations, and each new governor has without fail contributed to the planet's taming."

ca124b24-b4df-4e39-95bd-fc98ef02e566.Text: "I... I..." {n}Vistenza falls silent — and then cries out suddenly, falling to her knees. You see a bloody stain seeping along her back.{/n}

58800ede-ba23-4e1a-a6d2-7b41d23c6275.Text: "If you are asking about those of our circle, then let me assure you, there are enough noble families on-world to keep boredom at bay. I frequently host guests, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, and my servants arrange suitable entertainments — from parlour concerts to private executions of traitors who break Imperial law."

e0380a6d-2232-4693-85c1-c199c2a12849.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! But... I have no idea what you're talking about!"

dac03e2d-0ffd-4aee-aaa6-dd09f9d2aeff.Text: "The mon-keigh cannot tame the Lilaethan." {n}Yrliet's whisper is full of rage and undisguised contempt.{/n} "Your human breed have tortured this world for ages on end. Perverting it, trying to sculpt your own existence out of a planet that is already perfect. You are the only capricious and stubborn children here."

7e097025-b065-43c8-8b96-f56cd962b765.Text: {n}Vistenza pays no mind to Yrliet's whispering. There are few people in this palace who are interested in the opinions of the help.{/n}

f2130d2b-c4f1-4858-a5ee-7eacd3aebc73.Text: "I... I have never enjoyed such entertainments before." {n}Cassia gives you a hopeful look, then casts her eyes down bashfully.{/n} "It is a terrible shame that we do not have time for parlour concerts. I grow quite tired of displays of bloodshed — it is the same scene practically every time we set down somewhere."

5fd19560-32d0-4ac8-82a8-8bbd2abf3128.Text: "When we are back on Footfall, remind me, my crown-bearing and pallid-featured beauty, to take you to a 'concert' of sorts at a certain 'parlour.' With private dances and heady wines."

bf81296d-0fdf-4986-958d-79bbbcd08b91.Text: "The colours are darting to and fro like startled shadows. The colours know... know that they are the veil that stands between the soul and the truth. If the veil falls, all will turn red and purple. Even now... I can already see the muted purple seeping through."

e728376b-97fc-43f9-9d9f-d6571c35cdf0.Text: {n}Vistenza's companion standing beside her also bends into a slavish bow, while reaching out to offer a reassuring touch to Vistenza's hand — who immediately draws it away.{/n}

4c10a322-b897-46fb-9df8-6f51b2425c7a.Text: "An explanation unworthy of the world's governor." {n}A thin line appears between Cassia's furrowed eyebrows.{/n} "You expect to be rewarded for faithful service and boast about a sacrifice you should never have made. The world has turned its back on you, Vistenza. And now, so has the God-Emperor."

b1257d0f-d6d5-4883-a6c6-59ce0ae10762.Text: "What more proof do you need, elantach? The mon-keigh has confessed to her handiwork."

b1c55292-cf01-4d67-b1a7-04c9759700e7.Text: "Your wicked deeds will not go unpunished, heretic!"

a6a58c26-69e7-4152-9d00-cd7c7c457474.Text: {n}She flinches when she notices Kibellah standing at your side.{/n} "A death cultist? M-my, how unexpected... Must someone face severe punishment in the Emperor's name?"

1fc313ec-12b7-46d4-b577-13aeace3173d.Text: "Someone always does. As for who and when, the Undying One will tell." {n}Kibellah responds with dignity, seemingly oblivious to how sinister her words sound.{/n}

35949ac3-23d3-4eff-9b0b-998eaf66dd9a.Text: "Betray my associates? Forget my duty to our family?" {n}Vistenza's eyes burn like hot coals.{/n} "I'm sorry that you are unable to grasp the full greatness of the powers that have submitted to my will, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I am very, very sorry. Wardens! Kill the Rogue Trader!"

6d3fa4e6-cef0-47b4-857a-fc1a8fb546e3.Text: "Esteemed Arbitrator! Was there an issue of some sort with the latest tithe shipment from Janus?"

ea73f6b1-cb93-490b-9712-b103c32613e9.Text: "The tithe was delivered in full, twenty planetary cycles ago. In other words, precisely on time, Governor Vyatt." {n}There is no indication of approval in the Proctor's dry words.{/n} "I am here on other business."

273b8b27-e536-4ac9-a04e-023be17a9fec.Text: "The fields of Janus are fruitful thanks to my efforts. Your subjects have already begun their transformation into perfect servants who never question and never tire! I am the example that every noble person on this world strives to emulate! And I do not greedily hide my perfection within — I lavish it upon those who are unable to attain it without my help!"

eb465c55-ceb9-4256-b21f-19e451cb8f76.Text: {n}Blinking his visor, Pasqal remarks with a note of curiosity,{/n} "This object is of significant interest. I estimate the survivability of a removal procedure at 26 per cent."

bd90d35c-1f38-444e-aeb0-0fccef8465d7.Text: "Why have you waited until now to report this? The Janus tithe includes people — if you think the Imperium has any interest in your so-called 'enhanced workers,' you are mistaken."

75818110-176f-4403-9231-4ed41d393c1d.Text: "Do not worry, Proctor, I only transfer shipments of regular people to the Arbites. I know the law and would never dare incur your wrath."

941bc543-3662-4398-b674-956a42265074.Text: "Playing the innocent victim will not work. Governor Vyatt, suspicions of heresy have been raised against you — you have exactly one opportunity to refute them."

cd6cde67-20bd-4d40-a406-2665ad55374d.Text: {n}Solomorne's jaw tenses, his cold and heavy gaze boring into the governor.{/n} "Guilty."

664e50a6-4036-4a06-98ca-7f88b48db527.Text: "Quite right, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, for the lacerax is found only here on Janus. Cybernetic beast fights were very popular on Idex, and Ruoldo took a large collection with him when he became Governor of Thassera. What a pity he was assigned to that backwater world — alas, communication between us was cut off as a result. I never met Ruoldo in person, but corresponding with him was a true pleasure."

b6ca820d-6e0f-4127-bd80-8176a02a5f8d.Text: {n}The governor takes no pains to hide the distaste that momentarily seeps into her voice:{/n} "'Removal procedure'... That's just another way of saying 'assassination attempt,' isn't it, esteemed Magos? If you shot me in the chest, the survivability would be about the same."

99954aab-7905-46d8-ae16-65ba2d426600.Text: {n}Vistenza inclines her head.{/n} "I am immeasurably grateful for your assistance, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

0708c37d-a30d-42d6-bf7f-b1c61ce6fd93.Text: "I assure you, as soon as the pilots stop being so wary of the ports, and workers no longer dread their next shift in the fields, Janus will promptly reinstate all supply shipments! I am immeasurably grateful for your help, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"

e4b88d76-628a-455a-bd9a-ba03e89a8621.Text: "By whom? Rebels? Those who tried to murder me? Are you really going to believe the foul words of those enemies of Humanity?"

4a9d0a8f-9522-4f95-81b9-a21c07c02957.Text: "I will issue all necessary instructions for the preparation of supplies. You will receive reports on the first results in the near future, {name}."

8a90e5e0-0295-4dfd-bb95-94f384eb23b4.Text: "I must inform you that your methods of tracking down the rebels have {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_JanusTyrannical}drained{/d} our production facilities of workers. Those lost include not only the elderly and children, but also priceless experts who have now carried the secrets of their profession to the grave. I fear that all you can expect in the coming years are Imperial tithes and minimal provisions for your most important worlds."

98c8e473-156f-4cad-935c-3ae1a6b629a9.Text: "Many agri-complexes were damaged in the {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_JanusViolent}bombing{/d}, and significant numbers of workers were killed. Some worker settlements were turned into craters... I fear that it will require a great deal of work to restore production to previous levels. But trust me — my underlings will make every effort to ensure that Janus is useful to your protectorate once more!"

76549910-6b94-45ec-a86b-9bf481dbf1d7.Text: "In the name of the Emperor, I, Rogue Trader of the von Valancius dynasty, sentence you, Vistenza Janus Vyatt ab Aram af Koronus, to death."

12780fc3-09b8-43b4-8f51-267c8a9281aa.Text: "I will not allow a miscreant like you to continue wreaking evil!"

f7c690c4-740f-48d5-b688-cd7beeeeb9f1.Text: "I have seen many transgressors like you who excuse their deeds with claims about their service to the Imperium. Do you know the difference between you and the truly righteous? Your fear of hardship and pain. It is only through them that we can tread His path. Confess, and I will show you how."

e061976d-9538-4689-aea5-4478795bddb4.Text: "Did she know? She owned this planet for many decades, she probably did pick up on the local gentry's... quirks. But did she ask me outright, as you are doing now? No. Your predecessor was much more interested in supplies and tithes, which I provided without fail."

50aff452-a2af-41f4-a9a4-29cb6335ceac.Text: {n}Vistenza lowers her arm — you glimpse a gilded implant in her forearm.{/n} "Thank you, Rogue Trader. A marvellous, marvellous specimen that will take pride of place in my salon. Now... where were we?"

b13d0db9-d7d0-449a-9acb-a0df91d907a0.Text: "All right, you win. It would be inappropriate of me to deny that I serve such great powers. That's right, all the aspirations and efforts of myself and my retinue are dedicated to serving the Prince of Excess, the most generous of all the lords of the warp."

95a45187-2168-4de1-b1bc-511c3d631488.Text: {n}The servant of Chaos shrugs glibly.{/n} "But before you offend my ears with more accusations or moral admonitions... remember who held this world back from the brink of death when the Expanse began shaking from the fury of the warp. Remember who has dutifully served your dynasty all these years. Remember to whom your predecessor entrusted one of her most valuable worlds, without fear of treachery or conspiracy! Janus would have become nothing without me!"

e05d1111-65ca-4eea-9b85-5053c51c1bb0.Text: "Your actions are destroying my world, Vistenza."

0cf51bb0-c44e-4a67-a84b-914c40ccb1a9.Text: "You are destroying your own world, Vistenza. Without the World Spirit, Janus will cease to yield crops."

74c58562-bfaf-4553-9cab-643614904b24.Text: "Destroying it? I am turning this wild, barbaric planet into something so perfect, it is simply beyond the imagining of any pathetic xenos! Do not insult my work solely because it is not yet complete!"

74b6fc3b-7b29-4e95-a15d-90e09fcd43c9.Text: {n}Yrliet turns toward you, saying,{/n} "What?" {n}...before dropping to the ground, clutching at her neck.{/n}

b8cd45fc-3921-4689-a7aa-1a4a4d460885.Text:
"To be an Aristocrat is to exist in a higher state of being, without a doubt. Each of us is born to realise one supreme purpose — to lead Humanity to perfection through our example, perfection which the lesser beings have forgotten in the endless cycle of war and service. Only by attending to their physical, intellectual, and spiritual needs can an Aristocrat fully devote themselves to that for which they were born — creative passions, whether that be the fine arts, the written word, government, or other more refined spheres of worldly knowledge. An Aristocrat's passion is in itself a virtue and the highest good.
An Aristocrat must satisfy these needs by any means open to them. Nothing stimulates a weary mind like fine amasec, a good flogging, or enjoyment of carnal pleasures with women, men, and animals. In the thrill of passion, an Aristocrat is at liberty to torture or maim the object of their desire. If the clergy frown upon such an act, repent, atone for the apostasy with jewels, and forgive them their closed minds, for only an Aristocrat is given to understand that such acts are in service of a grand purpose.
Should an Aristocrat deliberately curtail their own desires in some way and fail to appreciate the gifts granted them as one of nature's higher beings, then in what way do they differ from the dust beneath one's feet, from the mindless beast, or from the crude, deceitful, useless rabble? Such a pretender is an agonising stain on our noble society, and it behoves every True Aristocrat to return our lost brother to the fold or to stamp out his contemptible life as gladly as we might crush a vexatious bug beneath our boot."

baa55f78-793e-4578-91d8-59bac912cbd9.Text: Ophelius Delenor, "Notes on the Nature of Aristocracy"

0ac15c67-5f2c-4a21-9505-86c60cc2436f.Text: "Vistenza Vyatt has tragically perished at the hands of perfidious traitors to the Imperium who infiltrated her inner circle. She must be avenged — hunt down and execute the conspirators."

054eac2e-1cb8-4e4d-99f2-ff957dd9c9eb.Text: [Lie] "Vistenza Vyatt has tragically perished at the hands of perfidious traitors to the Imperium who infiltrated her inner circle. She must be avenged — hunt down and execute the conspirators."

61a024ac-0e3a-4996-83c9-c383444a6ed9.Text: "Vistenza Vyatt has been executed as a traitor to the Imperium. Her accomplices must be found and put to death immediately."

da2c9ba7-46b8-4989-ae73-06e09ee02791.Text: "Don't ask questions — the answers are no concern of yours. You will receive all future instructions from my authorised representatives."

94a8ea12-3ec6-4c47-bf58-011892c32327.Text: "Out of the way! I don't have time for you!"

343aa254-629c-454f-926c-787a4db8c2e4.Text: "Janus was under two distinct threats: the corruption of Chaos in the form of Vistenza Vyatt and her associates, and the xenos who had manipulated the servants of the Imperium. I dealt with both of them."

301850bd-d8e2-47fa-931a-ec3abfacc944.Text: {n}The secretary is shaking in terror, looking around at the devastation.{/n} "Y-Y-Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! What happened? Where is Lady Vyatt?"

02b2a69e-0b55-4b63-933b-0f5dff4e8616.Text: "Heresy? Xenos?" {n}The secretary makes a protective gesture in the air.{/n} "God-Emperor preserve us! Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, you have surely saved us from our doom! We will immediately begin scouring the planet to root out any remaining conspirators and traitors!"

53dddef8-102e-477d-8b50-c4a5197988a0.Text: {n}The secretary stares at Yrliet in horror. His face twists, but he cannot seem to get out a single word.{/n}

0e7fb672-7c70-42ff-b461-6d8995caf752.Text: "Oh no! Heresy! Heresy on Janus!" {n}The secretary makes a protective gesture over himself.{/n} "May the God-Emperor watch over us! Whatever... whatever the governor did, I had no knowledge of it! We will root out those who colluded with her right away!"

e3080a37-b368-4b0b-b241-58bd9e5437bf.Text: {n}The secretary pauses, then bends into a deep bow.{/n} "Of course, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

56eb20d4-c94b-4ec1-b78b-06046c0d1fa6.Text: {n}The secretary begins to speak, but thinks better of it, instead choosing to step aside and bow his head as you pass.{/n}

76af429e-54a9-4f5f-a8e8-166762e0107e.Text: "The governor... killed by heretics?" {n}The secretary makes a protective sign over himself.{/n} "God-Emperor protect us! We'll soon root out those responsible!"

9ed93955-d645-468b-bcbb-b46d63965b74.Text: "I hope that's the last I'll hear about cultists on Janus."

bbd79159-7c6f-4ae5-9942-2533b668c243.Text: "So, the heretic is dead. Now what?"

0289ab89-2512-4ff7-8fc4-c7b17c4b3ed9.Text: "Are you trying to say that it's open season on humans for Aeldari now?"

19c0e1fa-fcb5-45b0-a2d8-d967da9fdb75.Text: "I will most likely return to Janus in the future. I must keep an eye on my worlds."

d59f4448-28d9-45f0-9322-5fa9196809c9.Text: "I am leaving Janus. And I hope never to see you or your brethren ever again."

dfbe37ae-c4ed-4542-9f15-daf83cd95c52.Text: {n}Yrliet lowers her weapon, but her shoulders remain tense. She finally catches her breath, shaking her hair out of her face in a fluid motion, and looks at you.{/n}

65d71fd5-9a76-4d89-9eff-111c9c7b1c5d.Text: "You are hoping in vain. The seeds these spawn leave behind may sprout in a hundred years — in other people and other deeds. I pray that I am wrong."

bcf58ee0-e006-4435-8a1b-d54c2866769c.Text: "Only if you consider the servants of She Who Thirsts to be human... I hope not. The only thing those abominations deserve is death and burning."

46655ce5-250a-4f4b-836e-4d90ba2db101.Text: "Yeah, yeah, tracking down your kin... and also, there'll be somebody on the ship who scares the crap out of everyone even more than I do."

473c144a-7c21-4992-a804-b61416791266.Text: {n}Yrliet's lips twist into a bitter smile.{/n} "I think that would be best. For you, mon-keigh. Farewell."

ae39c037-45a1-4a17-865a-5421a959b0a4.Text: "It is not your place to deem anyone in the Domin's retinue unworthy, Vil'Jae." {n}Kibellah turns to you and bows her head slightly.{/n} "Your decisions are inscrutable, Domin, but nevertheless, your shadow will keep a vigilant eye on the unclean xenos from now on."

aaade8b2-4e23-49c7-addc-b44c95ac5e95.Text: "I doubt xenos are capable of eliminating heresy on the planet, {name}. But in a situation with limited resources... Throne preserve me if I ever repeat this sentiment, but... the Aeldari's assistance is the best we can hope for in the short term. Barring a radical solution to the problem."

89cb390f-1d8d-4ef4-b4a7-75270c3b36f0.Text: "The Warrant does permit taking xenos servants, but I had hoped never to witness anyone actually invoke this... unique right."

f43c4387-28ec-4543-a17e-f856c4fe89e6.Text: "You have done your duty, elantach. From now on, the Lilaethan has hope for the future — a future without Sai'lanthresh and her followers. This world has yet to be cleansed, but there is a time for everything. Now is the time to thank you." {n}Yrliet bows her head slightly.{/n}

b25d0245-cdc0-4956-8f2d-2678ca0078f3.Text: "Oh, shereen... I pray to the Exalted One that your good heart is not broken by the black ungratefulness of those you welcome into your retinue. My only consolation is that this xenos is still a little different from the damned scum that plague Humanity in the Koronus Expanse."

e2f380e1-29bb-4a5a-a12a-7c4f90f55f0a.Text: "There's no doubt that our visit has... stirred up the inhabitants of this place. But it is unlikely that their devotion to She Who Thirsts will outweigh their fear of your authority — whatever it is based on in your society. You have nothing to fear."

765cc70c-2686-404e-96e4-793ab010ca46.Text: "Xenos in the retinue of a Rogue Trader is an acceptable precedent. Although highly undesirable and fraught with danger."

9b002a1a-f541-46e3-962d-cd458731f317.Text: "If you truly cared for the elantach, you wouldn't be following {mf|him|her}, you would have thrown yourself into the abyss long ago. You are a canker, and the jaws of Sai'lanthresh yawn wide within you. Don't talk to me about dangers, you, a mon-keigh who has no notion of what he is playing with!"

87bc0d2d-4503-4a14-8ffd-4713b447a938.Text: "Admit it, you are awed to behold such an illustrious figure whose fame has spread as far as the backwater that is the Koronus Expanse."

c938572f-1bb2-47f3-9fde-daa2a732cb53.Text: "Theodora von Valancius is dead. I am now the head of the dynasty."

447bbbf8-e852-423a-b81b-84ecb5d218b5.Text: "I hope my coming in Theodora's stead has not disappointed you too much."

5ea25a9c-c6c6-44ca-bc43-3461bf1c3d2b.Text: "Let's finish with the pleasantries, Governor Vyatt, and move on to the purpose of my visit."

84c0aff4-b214-4143-a0c6-ed6809bc97e2.Text: {n}A lavishly dressed noblewoman in an opulent silk gown watches you with an expectant air, but then gracefully bows her head. Gem-encrusted implants protrude from her arms and neck.{/n}

fa1e16cb-a4f8-4c3b-b9c0-9f6e59096585.Text: "I welcome you on behalf of the noble House Vyatt ab Aram. My name is Vistenza Janus Vyatt ab Aram af Koronus. By the grace of the Emperor and the will of Rogue Trader Theodora von Valancius, I serve as planetary governor and Imperial commander-in-chief of this world." {n}Vistenza Vyatt raises her head slightly.{/n}

6df14b33-e1be-4233-9f64-12b05cb9b235.Text: "Such tragic news. I will see to it that the planet observes a month of mourning—"

58dae2db-d242-4681-98de-d25377fa83a0.Text: "Not in the least, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. On the contrary, I am delighted after all these years to once again welcome to my world—"

a83de344-19d5-4bfe-ae64-a666a3d63acb.Text: "I wouldn't dare detain you any longer than necessary, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. If I may invite you—"

d285705c-d70e-427c-bc97-02987aa9c976.Text: "In truth, your arrival in the place of the esteemed Lady von Valancius is quite unexpected."

ebec9a88-b9d8-472c-96c6-a49a394c35f4.Text: {n}The governor parts her lips in surprise, and her cheeks redden.{/n} "Oh! Why, {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_MOT_Glory}yes{/d}, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I am positively enchanted—"

ea3d9a26-9abc-4a3a-b380-5257a99307fc.Text: {n}Vistenza Vyatt turns to Abelard.{/n} "And greetings to you, noble Werserian. It has been years since your last visit to Janus. I am glad to see you again."

af92e9a9-c5dd-40b5-9da0-777b9b8f2565.Text: "It is a good sign when a Rogue Trader's Seneschal does not visit a subject planet for a long time. Isn't that correct, Lady Vyatt? It means the governor is taking care of all matters and there is no need for the Seneschal to interfere."

fd27fb62-e0b9-4331-b67e-21e1e650b8db.Text: {n}Vistenza lets out a musical laugh.{/n} "I hear praise in those words and I thank you for them." {n}She turns once again to you.{/n}

88dcdc06-9c58-490f-b22e-15509f913c91.Text: "Now lead me to your mistress, feckless vermin."

f5349789-3af1-44c4-a3d8-d7bc442eefb1.Text: "Get out of my sight — I'll find my own way there."

6ab0d6d2-fcb7-4b09-b56f-9db3781f9756.Text: "I am fine. I can't say the same for the attackers."

b6f5f109-5fe8-44b9-94ec-a4299e29b6e1.Text: [Kill the officer] "You incompetent, inept, useless pieces of grox shit! What is the point of you, if I can be attacked on the governor's own estate?"

f7a227aa-5507-44a6-8bc8-27de170109bb.Text: "You should all be flogged for such negligence! Who were they and how did they gain entry to the governor's estate?"

680e43d8-f92e-4eac-a16c-998b22317380.Text: "I'll find my own way there. Stand aside!"

1c5ab80a-00c5-4328-b60a-846dd15a5380.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Emperor preserve us, are you all right?"

ea499e9a-6802-47e1-8c88-24fb50ed72ab.Text: "Do not fret, layperson. We have grown used to outrageous slovenliness among the wardens of every world we visit." {n}Pasqal's vox, quiet at first, is booming with fury by the end of his remark.{/n}

dda7752e-92f1-4846-97c9-600f6fc370aa.Text: {n}The officer drops dead before the shocked eyes of witnesses, who look up at you in horror.{/n}

5f9e015d-7d5c-4415-83df-506703568626.Text: "The governor is safe, protected by walls and wardens. Please follow me, I will escort you to her personally."

4718787c-645b-4ae6-8ff6-de75375757aa.Text: {n}The officer cowers under your gaze.{/n} "They are rabble who dare to raise their hand against the planet's lawful authority... I beg you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, allow me to escort you inside. The governor will explain everything to you!"

5edda9a3-f31e-49be-b83e-2d82e4e765c6.Text: "Praise the Throne! If you would please follow me, I will personally escort you to the governor, where you will have the protection of walls and wardens!"

3b6c01bb-5ee1-4945-840b-d36e039f2855.Text: "Pale greyness is strangling this peasant like a noose — his words are laden with fear for our well-being. And yet he fears for his own even more."

d0f439de-5d0b-451c-979c-049f3b1a7f99.Text: "I saw them again. Horrible, unnatural creatures they were..."

5dcfc05b-3bf9-4d1c-bf52-cceb6a7df8a5.Text: "Quiet! Quiet! They've very keen hearing. Best not to talk that way about the Rogue Trader's new favourites."

36491d1b-f0c4-4cbf-ac9b-f516406cffae.Text: "It's been quite a while since Vistenza vanished and these... creatures... started appearing in our settlements. I'm surprised we haven't heard any reports of crimes against Humanity yet."

e8f180ba-1ab8-4b66-9cd1-caab61289873.Text: "Maybe... they're not here to hurt us? As far as I know, the agri-complexes are running, supplies are being shipped out. Life is... just as it was before."

ff6883c3-64c6-48db-b092-d143bac01885.Text: The wall is riddled with holes from lasguns. The plaster has come away in large chunks in some places.

624593a1-cf10-4686-96fa-9120455285d6.Text: The bodies are strewn with holes — each rebel was shot multiple times, and some injuries were inflicted after death.

28b10878-aa15-4c91-b3c4-593862b24e0a.Text: "We keep our word, mon-keigh. Death awakens, war calls!"

51275cba-66c2-4fc1-b1e0-172c6f52ce75.Text: "The threat has been eliminated, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. My people have checked the area — you can take a look around now for yourself, if you wish."

23bacbf0-9b5c-46f4-8bff-b483f7aa448f.Text: "I humbly thank you for your help. My people will take care of the remains and check that the building is clear."

20f2cc2b-64a7-4904-9a6f-9f111bc6ffdf.Text: "Let me go! You lied to me, Trader! Liar!"

68e15f0d-7f5c-4566-be1b-d8b7b6c5c52d.Text: "Please, no! Don't make me into a servitor!"

51f3d505-7b74-4495-bfcf-6ee10d28ef78.Text: "Thank you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Without your patronage, I would already be dead."

75503b80-7e57-418d-bc55-5a601e3664cc.Text: The place seems like it was recently disturbed: dust has been swept from the stones, there is some unidentifiable dirt between the cracks, and you notice several thin scratches on the surface.

85f29200-62e5-45ab-8281-ab6e69586cca.Text: Dark dirt is visible on the whiteish stone — it is clearly not from the soil of the estate. You have already collected most of it.

511cf1ca-1ebe-43ee-b5f9-f9949b9e4d82.Text: Traces of dirt are clearly visible on the whiteish stone — black soil with large coloured flecks. You take a pinch of the strange soil and wrap it in a cloth.

5fe174e5-6dc9-441f-acda-7f846e38ff56.Text: "The Throne preserve me! What is that?"

f44b6c66-cca7-4bb4-804c-31f63191f727.Text: Chains or ropes with shackles on the end can be seen in the water.

62c654e4-5f8c-41a7-95dd-237efb1f3e15.Text: Chains or ropes with shackles on the end can be seen in the water. Something white is also visible through the glimmer — a fragment of bone with marks made by sharp teeth.

968ab771-e5cf-44f6-85bc-58a2986a92f6.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Pay no mind to the bodies — we are waiting for the estate to be cleared completely, so we can be rid of this trash!"

e8db4404-eea4-4023-8278-f3ccc5affd37.Text: A luxurious chapel decorated with symbols of the Emperor. The huge door is locked.

a8c9efdf-daf8-47e3-bc4d-fdea8251ee87.Text: The chapel is built out of luxurious materials, but the holy place looks half-abandoned: you cannot smell any burnt incense in the air, you see no seals of cleansing on the doors, and you hear no prayers — no human voices or vox-recordings.

9c61959e-7ce4-440b-b40a-9191928f52d4.Text: Sealed containers with Imperial insignia and seals of the trade ship that delivered the goods to the planet.

a1590b30-d58c-4ef9-ad0f-e0ef572059c9.Text: Sealed containers marked with the familiar insignia of the Munitorum and additional seals of a forge world unknown to you: the crates contain high-grade weapons, likely made to order.

ec93dc31-b046-407d-8e21-20a8fe06fc40.Text: "An assassination attempt! At the governor's own estate! And on the day of the Rogue Trader's visit, no less!"

2137a8f3-73bd-4cc2-8ba0-83172b9de30d.Text: "Perhaps it is linked? Plenty of high-ranking guests have come for the meeting... Or perhaps they weren't targeting dear Lady Vyatt, but the Trader?"

8d4f6cf4-57d0-44a9-b0e1-c3f0fb4f8f30.Text: "Please! Only a complete madman would resort to such a reckless stunt against the sovereign of this world!"

9bca0fd0-e110-4aba-9583-fc1f97da703c.Text: "The rabble were audacious enough to rebel, so who knows? With all due respect, Lady Vyatt has been too soft on these worms! In her grandfather's time, a serf would have feared to raise his eyes to a noble, let alone his hand!"

52a01aaf-a029-470d-b842-3d2f9dec4cca.Text: The most effective representatives of the local flora are assembled in the flowerbed. Unfamiliar fruits are ripening on the carefully pruned plants.

393c33f4-5613-487f-8c29-0fdbc470da2f.Text: The cheerfully burbling water gives off a pleasant chill.

fa2e2f2e-65d7-4d75-8f24-866a024c85b1.Text: The fountain is an expensive toy for the nobility: pure water is currently bubbling from it, but additional pipes on it indicate the presence of separate siphons for sparkling wine and other beverages.

5ff139c1-ab1d-4ce9-9466-bc7a69194b0e.Text: An otherworldly silence reigns under the arches of the gazebo — perhaps a sound barrier generator is mounted in the dome.

a93edc34-9cd1-451f-893a-13ab373f1e08.Text: The ivy covering the archway gives off a delicate, heady fragrance, although you do not see any flowers.

064acbd5-4ec7-42dc-b5ec-c09ea93c441d.Text: "The estate is under control! You are completely safe, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"

0eaee7e5-f628-4cfe-b765-b99d85428d52.Text: "We will find and dismember anyone who dares threaten our esteemed visitors, rest assured!"

a58aa0b0-b879-4f0c-bf6e-65d667d3f2b1.Text: "When is this brainless rabble going to settle down..."

92cadf99-a983-4730-8115-2a0282bd32c1.Text: "Did you see the mutant wipe out that target? Our guys near the governor just stood there catching flies, and she'd already blown his brains out!"

c8a6110d-864d-438b-98ca-fef24aa44abe.Text: "Tell me about it. She gives me the creeps. She's terrifying to look at, she talks funny, and she knows her way around a gun... Come to think of it, I've never seen that kind of weapon before. I wonder where she got it."

b72b76c3-fbb2-4b00-94da-e7aa2ac5da21.Text: "Maybe one of the locals is making their own? And without any Tech-Priest's blessing, no doubt... Gah, heresy on Janus right under our noses, and we just have to put up with it!"

60e0865a-39c2-46d0-a7ce-ccbf0cfc0127.Text: Damaged vox with a log of the rebels' conversations.

117f46bb-fb82-4b76-89aa-780633fcf9fd.Text: The deceased's arms and face are covered in small boils that ooze cloudy pus even after death.

bd35c908-6d14-469e-b3be-b4f1f5703a00.Text: The skin on the dead person's neck is discoulored and covered in ridged scabs.

987079ef-837f-4635-8481-1ddbee5c264f.Text: "Faster, faster... The sooner we smoke out this louse, the sooner we can report that the clearance operation is complete."

9e62e201-8c52-47c9-a183-a4dc3708c1ec.Text: "Watch where you're pointing those hoses. The last thing we need is a poisonous gas cloud in the air over the estate."

1989d129-483d-4049-84a2-f038573e5f5f.Text: The governor's palace gleams with gilding that has been generously applied to all metal trims and prominent bas-reliefs.

635ab88b-bf4b-4715-a6d0-f78dd8e14ef0.Text: The governor's palace is opulent: the gilt finishes and plaster are updated regularly and frequently, it seems — too frequently even for a building situated on the coast.

aa91f583-73b5-499e-850d-e4e72fe6a4cd.Text: "It is an honour for us to serve such exalted guests, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"

173ab9d6-fdc1-4366-bde5-d8b15514dcfa.Text: "Would you care for a drink, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}?"

090f0e94-2f7e-4ff8-a437-60bd9bf10434.Text: The servitor looks past you, not noticing your presence.

f5fa88d9-ab6a-49cf-9e61-a6f9284660a2.Text: The servitor's mechanical parts produce a quiet whirring, occasionally interrupted by clicking.

1e57d9f7-49bf-471b-8620-d5e2c198afde.Text: A decorative spire hastily turned into a watchtower is a sure sign of a turbulent situation on the agri-world.

7f61fe06-c51f-46df-9ffd-11602a590688.Text: "Do not disturb my contemplation, elantach. I need time."

d6dce3b4-1e5f-4d8f-96bc-22bbee0b187d.Text: "These are marks of corruption... not decay or disease... but how..."

c8a0ae1e-968f-4405-b466-9c63bd70485d.Text: "Speaking of the von Valancius dynasty: when were the last shipments sent?"

06c1bbe9-dd11-4aa8-a1f1-719ae7dd50bf.Text: "When did the collector ships last come to Janus?"

647b94c8-569c-4781-a010-52feec77cddf.Text: "What do you have to say about the governor's helper — Yrliet?"

32b0c85e-fc9d-4d0d-9931-397e3abac0f0.Text: "What do you think of Vistenza Vyatt?"

08d21f86-e076-491b-9c30-8b1ee46fe485.Text: "What do you know about the attack on the estate?"

ba9b2c42-32b9-4f1c-9e70-b1121b9cf940.Text: "Tell me about Janus. What is happening on the planet?"

1c81c0fa-b6d3-4e08-aabd-d7e56686985d.Text: "Who is directing the rebels? Does anyone know?"

f4e93bed-c6ac-4899-9a53-01060e78483b.Text: "Why do you have to send the skull to someone on Footfall?"

a192df32-e444-46bb-8b98-31927e9ca04d.Text: "I want to know details. Where have the rebels struck, and how?"

c57718b7-fcf5-4da6-ab2f-75154a53760c.Text: "What are you doing to combat the rebels?"

96d69c7a-fb64-47c4-81a1-7dc151d5dbbe.Text: "Do whatever you want, just set the seal."

93dd128a-480c-46b1-acbf-b2b5f3ce30b8.Text: Asserted Atilius Quint's irreplaceability in an attempt to dissuade him from servitorisation.

51b5516c-f69b-4417-97ed-b9cf4039b574.Text: "You can serve Humanity while remaining as you are. Could a servitor replace a true administrative officer who is passionate about his work?"

872ad5c8-fe95-456c-912e-a3ac01b656cf.Text: Supported Atilius Quint's decision to become a servitor and respect the Imperium's laws.

698e2016-8dc0-46c0-9d58-5802b22a6715.Text: "He is correct, Jae. Each of us must follow the letter of the law."

8a39471a-749e-498c-b6a3-b1d1966241a0.Text: "Hmm. A curiosity like this would look very nice on my desk..."

de3f53b3-4700-420f-83c5-758a8b1fc911.Text: "Janus needs an intelligent secretary, not a brainless machine. Simply acquire a servitor for yourself."

a79c0f54-80a3-4c8b-adca-88388a6d7f18.Text: "A strange hobby. But you may continue."

c7a3c268-8196-4dff-94d1-63654c47dd10.Text: "I uncovered the servant who betrayed the governor. Here is the place where you will find his body."

726e5fd0-6970-47ea-b048-fc8cd1888b96.Text: "I wouldn't mind taking a look at such a remarkable object."

5da3b348-fec1-4b02-8767-f5503e5a100e.Text: Convinced Atilius Quint not to become a servitor by assuring him of his own irreplaceability.

f6cd9929-6139-43fb-87ca-a1b1419bbb28.Text: "Atilius, there is no need for that. Yes, any servitor can place a seal. But can it do so while granting me a sincere smile or impressing me with its impeccable finesse and attention to detail? I think not. But you can."

72ba39bb-bc79-4adf-a359-f4a5ada43086.Text: "I require a seal to certify a Mercatum Tabula Officiale."

bee87fb4-97dd-4bac-a2f8-08ad732da713.Text: "I do not intend to travel to Janus every time I need a seal on a piece of parchment. From now on, your seal shall be kept on Dargonus."

e8e5c1ea-4694-4740-bb18-42345d4d2514.Text: {n}The stooped man wearing a cloak of the Adeptus Administratum is reviewing information on a {g|Encyclopedia:Dataslate}data-slate{/g} while his quietly whirring mechanical arms fill a long scroll with writing. Upon noticing you, the man stretches his thin lips into a smile and deferentially bows. The light in the eyes of the servo-skull hovering over his right shoulder gently pulsate.{/n}

d821a043-8617-4499-a41f-e6efec0f4cd1.Text: {n}Atilius Quint offers a friendly smile and a bow.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, speaking with you is always an honour!"

98972227-4fef-4e28-8dbc-3b64426a8d06.Text: "Oh, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, our supply shipments are all in order: all foodstuffs and other items are ready for export and are simply awaiting the arrival of the transport ships. However, given the current circumstances on the planet, Janus could not provide even one tranche more than what is already prepared. I am certain the situation will be rectified in the near future!"

4dd2359e-8e7e-4fc7-989a-7300fdb1ab4b.Text: "The absence of a required signature is, of course, the most horrifying thing about this situation."

5d38fd87-bc8f-4518-ba98-48336d6edaf1.Text: {n}Atilius looks askance at Yrliet and offers a strained smile.{/n} "A highly, highly exceptional individual... after today's regretful event, I am beginning to hold her talents in particular esteem! Verily, even mutants who have seen the light of the God-Emperor can faithfully serve his flock!"

92f01464-d5e2-4edf-bf4a-7e4f43a4dbad.Text: "To be honest, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I find her presence most distressing. Of course, I would never gainsay the wisdom of the governor. Who if not she could perceive the true worth of a person, even if that person is a mutant?"

c00ce134-c7d3-4083-b0ff-e3db3a6cd925.Text: "Moreover, Yrliet's particular abilities could be an interesting subject of study for the Magos Biologis. That elongated head shape, those eyes... Judging by the skull that was given to me to send on to Footfall, such developmental anomalies on Janus are not a quirk of nature, but some kind of inheritable trait..."

dd13076d-2a5b-42d4-94e6-fd4df0e9689f.Text: {n}The secretary nods energetically.{/n} "Of course, of course! It would be an honour to assist the Rogue Trader! Wait but a few minutes, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, and your humble servant will have your seal ready."

66165a32-0cf9-47e3-a796-c0c52fdd2ac8.Text: {n}Atilius winces, his eyes nervously darting around.{/n} "The new colony {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_JanusEldarGovern}leadership{/d} issued a number of... irregular decrees. We have been obliged to spend prodigious amounts of resources to relocate agri-complexes and warehouses from the so-called 'L-Than Restricted Forest Area.' We also regularly receive denunciations of various degrees of nonsensicality, all of which share a common theme: they all accuse the people in charge of having ties to... foreign elements. From forest spirits to, Emperor preserve us, agents of xenos."

5aea7404-f70a-404d-80ce-7f7a33023e2d.Text: "By the grace of the God-Emperor, I oversee the administrative apparatus on the planet and serve as secretary. I am also responsible for the logistics related to supplying the planets of the von Valancius dynasty and the timely payment of tithes to the Imperium's official collectors."

b69b5998-f9cb-4ab3-b658-79d9ffdf2f4a.Text: "The governor is a superb leader. She possesses an excellent grasp of all matters and never uses an incorrect form for a given situation. I do not pry into her personal affairs, but if I may speak plainly, a lady who fills out paperwork with such finesse cannot be a bad person, in my view."

cbee8c4a-e94d-4924-88b3-0d86cd38699b.Text: "A disgraceful incident, simply disgraceful! I cannot believe these scoundrels would dare to come so close, and to drag the nobility into this as well... If they penetrated the estate, that means they had help from some worthless servant or other. Security is currently questioning the survivors, but the culprit has not been found. Yet." {n}Atilius Quint smiles unpleasantly.{/n}

c5015960-e45b-4118-8367-6eec730f7235.Text: "Janus is always honoured to receive Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

f9165cbd-04b6-471d-838d-d0d8aa7de379.Text: "Alas, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, rebellions have caused us too many problems in recent times. The rebels are interfering with established processes, interrupting supplies, sabotaging the serfs' work. A few nobles have even been killed, and worst of all — some of the victims occupied important administrative posts! Until their replacements pass their checks, complete all their induction forms, and go through the official appointment procedure, important paperwork is going unsigned! It's a bureaucratic catastrophe!"

e0d00f63-1a0e-4c66-bf9a-22786200213b.Text: "A most remarkable item, I must say, a true anomaly! One moment..."

21380e75-b0d2-47fb-a87c-e8f999c44e47.Text: "It was part of a commission for a jeweller, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. One of the ladies of the court sent this trinket along with precise instructions for the artisan, who was to encrust it with precious stones. One moment..."

33c7511c-dca7-45cb-bcb0-e4e122b10b2b.Text: "Of course, of course, I would be delighted to furnish you with all the information I have. In the last few months, fifteen organised attacks and seven terrorist attacks have been perpetrated. Irrigation equipment has been sabotaged in agrarian sectors three to five, transport routes two-seven, four-thirteen, and also..."

58b208db-b0f7-45c5-92ac-a30ed602fc11.Text: {n}After rummaging in a nearby container, Atilius draws out a parcel, which he immediately unwraps.{/n} "Here it is... I believe the finished piece was intended to be given as a gift to the governor, but under the current circumstances, I doubt I will be able to send it to Footfall any time soon."

625c52a0-5815-4b45-af1c-2bda7371f9f2.Text: "But... After seventy years of service — and not a single directive! Not from Holy Terra or from Dargonus! A complete breakdown in communication! What a farce, what an insult against all processes..." {n}Scarlet patches blossom on the secretary's pale face.{/n} "But this is easily remedied! If the Administratum requires such a servant, then I will immediately begin preparations for servitorisation. The will of the {g|Encyclopedia:LexImperialis}Lex Imperialis{/g} is supreme!"

900a0035-aa73-4db9-92b0-7626f302fb0e.Text: {n}The data is superbly collated, and the map clearly displays the actions of the rebels. At first glance, there seems to be no logic to their campaign, but after analysing the data and the features of the terrain, you notice a clear system indicating a geographical pattern to their attacks.{/n}

9db1a01c-20a6-48a5-8e67-08bf2f82a313.Text: {n}The data is superbly collated, and the diagram clearly reflects the actions of the rebels. Unfortunately, no matter how hard you stare at the coordinates, you cannot discern any logic to the attacks.{/n}

e45ee0e9-8f8c-4048-8622-e65db9f23e06.Text: {n}Yrliet stares at the skull in silence. You can see her jaw working under her delicate skin. After a few seconds, she abruptly turns away.{/n}

be3211be-bf8e-4b46-9729-addcdfa6acb3.Text: "O Throne's gold, the Rogue Trader {mf|himself|herself} has given {mf|his|her} blessing to my impulse! Now I am sure I have chosen the right path!"

3288906f-5529-4571-9c7b-d622c44ea2f6.Text: {n}After lots of prevarication, Atilius's hunched figure sags.{/n} "Of course, of course you are right. I will continue to serve Janus and the von Valancius protectorate as before. And today I will dispatch a request for copies of edicts issued by the Imperium over the last fifty years. Who knows what else we have missed here on Janus?"

c44f4690-f3e7-470d-aa66-186234289555.Text: "Eh? I mean, yes, of course, undoubtedly! Whatever you wish, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, if that will raise your spirits after the recent incident..."

ab81b4e2-3af3-4711-b4c9-3bc1a0ed750e.Text: "The rebels are well armed and well trained. What's more, the governor's advisors are inclined to think that the instigators of the rebellions are very familiar with the planet's terrain and climate. My ordinates are going through registration records day and night, looking for individuals who have completed military training, but we have so far been unable to identify the scoundrel."

1106bcfa-74e3-4320-96f3-71d2567924cb.Text: "Our security services are tracking those who support the rebels, and our regular wardens are wiping out these saboteurs without the slightest mercy, but they keep on appearing. My scribes have been run off their feet, keeping records of all the public hearings and executions, but I am confident that the governor will find a solution soon."

27ce660b-ae0d-499f-8a37-49f92c89267a.Text: "I look forward to meeting you again, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"

81923853-04cd-4403-8b27-0181932cc251.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I painstakingly record every conversation with high-ranking personages, and afterward I fill out all seven accompanying forms personally." {n}Atilius rolls up his completed scroll in a practised gesture, stows it away, and pulls out a new one.{/n} "Your words and judgements are in good hands."

5b7c0fe5-6a8c-4750-a829-0baa2fc58f26.Text: "I suppose... I suppose this will not tell you much. Please." {n}With a fussy gesture, he presses several buttons on his {g|Encyclopedia:Dataslate}data-slate{/g} screen, and a three-dimensional map with coordinates of the attacks appears on your {g|Encyclopedia:Cogitator}cogitator{/g}.{/n}

60616fcc-5aac-401a-a8bb-35494f8503c9.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, what an honour it is to address you in person! Allow me to introduce myself — Atilius Quint, prefectus of the Officio Agricultae. I will preserve the record of our conversation forever."

c83e94d1-7257-41cb-95f2-d45507e76d36.Text: "I thank you. Moments such as the appearance of a Rogue Trader must be preserved for posterity."

73ea1f02-71a5-4dff-978d-3a8dda26a89d.Text: {n}Atilius lets out a barely audible sigh and freezes as if he had been struck.{/n} "Forgive me, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}... I will stop recording immediately. Immediately..." {n}He rolls up the scroll and puts it away.{/n}

18bed122-40f3-4b8b-8acb-3b9a57a1c5e4.Text: {n}The secretary's eyes light with wicked fire.{/n} "What wonderful news! We will conduct the identification without delay and punitive measures will be taken against the criminal's close associates — we will instil those weak minds with the due terror the governor's power warrants."

c100830f-78cf-4a85-9161-fabf8f4405f5.Text: {n}Yrliet freezes completely, turning into a living statue.{/n} "What did you say?"

68ac7748-a6d9-454b-b9ad-f334361f290b.Text: "Oh, madam, have my words upset you? I'm certain your kinsman would be delighted to learn that people wish to make pretty presse-papier out of his remains! And besides, I could be wrong about the nature of his origins..."

85af8fd2-9336-47bb-9ad2-e168b54b3c45.Text: "Without the enemies of Humanity on our land? Wonderfully, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! The people of Janus are indebted to you for {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_JanusEldarEliminated}ridding{/d} our world of heresy!"

d1664bce-52a3-4096-8a4b-d41030c05de9.Text: "Governor Vyatt has everything well in hand, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. The people are still unsettled, but after your intervention, most of the rebels and malcontents have quietened down."

04ec1c7c-71fd-4c41-aac1-bfc0e2d42269.Text: "Oh yes, the flora of Janus can take your breath away! While the fauna can inadvertently kill you..."

a82d883e-496f-400b-b06c-6c9e06143e48.Text: "Here you are." {n}The secretary proffers the sealed certificate with care.{/n} "And you will find me much changed when we next meet, I guarantee it."

01139624-d027-402d-ba8b-a1e4865754da.Text: "Th-the Rogue Trader has once again graced Janus with {mf|his|her} presence! What an honour! Please tell me, what can a humble servant such as myself do for Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}?"

aaca590c-63e8-4783-ade7-4e430298950c.Text: "I beg your pardon? W-what's this about servitors? I have faithfully performed my sacred duties to the Imperium and the Administratum all my life! And guarding the seals is part of that! And after half a century, not a single seal damaged! I keep them in a special case and I oil the handles every month, as the rules stipulate!"

b956e67e-93ae-4301-b567-e51870657e67.Text: {n}Jae shrugs.{/n} "I am merely repeating the word of the Master of Seals on Dargonus — servitors have replaced an entire category of lowly bureaucrats assigned to the von Valancius planets, oh, around ten years ago now."

55b5f01b-fb0c-402a-9cb1-7fc6d610272c.Text: {n}Atilius nods in understanding.{/n} "{mf|His|Her} Lordship has missed the certification deadline? No matter, it is a frequent occurrence within the Adeptus Administratum. If you please, your new seal."

f04328fa-878f-4085-989c-45b2892a3342.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Under the 13th Amendment to the Decree on the Keeping and Use of Sacred Imperial Seals—" {n}The secretary catches your look and swallows nervously.{/n} "I mean, o-of course, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I will arrange for the seal to be delivered into the keeping of the palace of the Adeptus Administratum on Dargonus. However, the ratification process for such... changes... takes anywhere from five years to several decades. I humbly request that you bear this in mind."

6c482e95-c565-4266-b463-85d081e515f9.Text: "Besides the xenos that have {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_JanusEldarAllies}settled{/d} in our forests and periodically frighten the people, everything is calm, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. We have managed to come to an understanding of sorts... Although not without concessions on our part, in particular regarding the placement of our new agri-complexes."

6cd64ee2-3cec-4121-887f-b22db5004471.Text: "The Emperor as my witness, Janus will continue to serve the von Valancius dynasty. But not in precisely the same way as before."

cb57b695-5abb-47e8-b766-cadb8797a7b8.Text: "However, I fear that the {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_JanusViolent}consequences{/d} of the operation to root out the rebels will be felt for some time yet. The flora and fauna, and, most importantly, our agri-complexes will take decades to recover."

4346ca4d-61b6-490a-930e-a3b254bd2c86.Text: "If things continue in this vein, I dare not even imagine what it could lead to! There are worlds that are ravaged by war for generations... generations, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Like that deranged planet by the Nameless Star — so close to our own peaceful system. The inhabitants there supposedly live under the patronage of Rogue Trader Winterscale — I shudder to think what he has created there!"

e22c9642-8d15-4704-86ec-39f5638c79e9.Text: {n}Jae nervously licks her lips — she clearly did not expect this response to her remark.{/n} "Atilius, I do not think the Exalted One has any particular desire to see you lobotomised and turned into a mindless clanking ghoul just because someone somewhere changed a law..."

2313d923-e0ad-4687-88f9-8d01eeb9d515.Text: "I'm afraid you do not understand! The Administratum no longer has any need for Atilius Quint. My life and career are over, but my service — oh, my service is just beginning!"

b9bee314-2d83-416e-8c7a-6bcaede75071.Text: "Oh, yes, of course, of course..." {n}Atilius hurriedly returns the skull to the container.{/n}

a0ebd6f5-968c-4489-a708-7340c8eb8ade.Text: "Indeed it is! Financial reports, logistics directives, waybills for food shipments... Without the signature of the most respected and now deceased head of House Zakaris, shipments to settlements in Aegis-24 have been stopped. The heirs are still dealing with the transfer of holdings, and incoming reports tell us that a quarter of the workings in the affected settlements have already died of starvation, while most of those remaining have left the perimeter and have not yet returned to their designated places!"

c526f088-ef50-437f-96a4-9babf9469a2e.Text: "Ah! My deepest apologies, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! I did not mean to offend you!" {n}Atilius bows low, trembling from head to toe.{/n}

d1ab747f-1830-4a15-af91-465d991799c7.Text: "I knew you would appreciate my efforts to serve the Imperium as the law commands, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"

fff0aac1-b896-4d73-8529-738d88031aa6.Text: {n}Jae looks at the secretary with sincere pity.{/n} "The willingness to jettison everything that makes you you... I'll never understand it. Never."

74ff6890-7c79-4f02-99b8-a47cb4bf1e74.Text: {n}Jae lets out a breath, obviously relieved.{/n} "That is wonderful, Atilius, just wonderful... Just don't go poking at your eyes with a long needle — at least until you receive a direct order to do so from your precious Administratum..."

eeb3aa94-cfdc-4d83-aa7d-a5fd9af99003.Text: {n}Yrliet grits her teeth and burns you with a look of utter disdain.{/n}

eada7fba-d0f3-44d7-8559-9f3799bd5ea3.Text: {n}Atilius's mechanical fingers fly over the scroll as he fills in another line.{/n} "And of course, what great fortune it is to see, for the very first time in all my years of service, an emissary of the Navis Nobilite here on Janus! I humbly welcome the esteemed..."

f79bb79a-bffe-4ccc-b201-4fb3447226b5.Text: "Cassia Tisiphia Evriaella, Lady Navigator of House Orsellio." {n}Everything from her condescending gaze and confident bearing to her calm but commanding voice marks Cassia as the heiress of a great bloodline. Awestruck, the secretary writes down each letter of her name with particular fastidiousness.{/n}

9f571795-f34f-476d-b93f-d627bcaa7340.Text: {n}You cast a {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Militarum}practised eye{/d} over the intelligence provided to you and instantly get a grasp on the situation.{/n}

563037f5-2aaf-4d09-8fc7-e47b17f74f73.Text: "I hope your subordinates will have the presence of mind not to kill the culprits on the spot and instead question them, learn the identities of other rebels, and carry out a series of interrogations and punishments first. Other than that, the approach is valid."

caa700ba-9c2d-4726-b0c3-2cefa6827d4e.Text: "What a sage decision, shereen. Let the rebels' innocent children and relatives rot on the rack as a lesson to all heretics. I swear to the Exalted One, your name will be fondly remembered on Janus!"

e2e74664-6e0c-41ca-b917-78d4ce784eac.Text: "Oh, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}... I must confess that as yet I have not had the pleasure of filling out a sacred tithe protocol form, as the last Imperial ships to come here did so under my predecessor. Come to think of it, that would have been several decades ago... I do hope the logisticians responsible for such an unforgivable oversight lose their heads over this!"

d163aa95-b070-4c5b-bb0f-810af54583c3.Text: "Oh... I must confess, the news of her arrest has shaken me to my core... May I speak openly? I admit that I haven't got a bad word to say about Governor Vyatt, and I hope that when you appraise her efforts, your anger will change to mercy."

45838f92-1ccc-44f4-8f30-2a4aa7eb6352.Text: {n}Pasqal's mechadendrites reach toward Atilius with interest, seeming to unnerve him a little.{/n} "Adequately preserved. It is a pity that it is empty inside — it could have become a proper servo-skull herald for the Rogue Trader. Unorthodox."

9c3bcaf6-3cf3-4e7e-a419-50659fbb2a2f.Text: {n}Atilius Quint nervously tugs at the hem of his dusty cloak and bows respectfully.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, the subjects of Janus welcome you! What cares have brought you to our humble world on this occasion?"

4533fc62-854a-459b-95d0-b764469c796d.Text: {n}Jae's expression is pensive as she twists a lock of hair around her metal finger.{/n} "Interesting, shereen. I assumed we would be dealing with servitors, but no — some places in your domain still have this work being performed by people of flesh and blood!"

448a1b3c-1cf2-4c0a-aa13-36b6cd835c7d.Text: "Here you are." {n}The secretary proffers the sealed certificate with care.{/n} "And may the Emperor bless your path!"

337e8355-a8c1-4949-953a-2b9b759751db.Text: {n}Your {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g} crackles to life. Relief rings in Vistenza Vyatt's voice.{/n} "...{name}? You're all right! What a relief! Please, for your own safety, come inside the estate. We shall continue our conversation in my parlour — I imagine you wish to hear an explanation of what has occurred."

4b05a0e1-70ff-4b9f-a05c-4af34405251c.Text: Remains that have been thoroughly scraped and cleaned.

d4b16c48-e20d-4638-a13e-0014856c9b62.Text: Wrinkled, fibrous berries covered in short fuzz.

2a3c8a34-87e4-4e30-af7d-fe61c600cd40.Text: "You helped the rebels gain access to the estate!"

a50ecabe-854b-4ef5-b084-9498603ed9b7.Text: "Your accomplices will answer for your treachery in your place."

0bffe085-f351-4ecb-8012-adb3cb3a6bcd.Text: "Say whatever it is you want to say. And be quick about it."

fc59989d-7010-4ef5-b73a-428dbadce1c8.Text: "You accuse the governor, with only conjecture and rumour to back up your words? How dare you!"

ead55a02-a63e-418c-bca2-e9695a75a286.Text: "What else is going on in the settlements?"

a292803f-230c-42eb-983c-d73a6ac2c7cb.Text: Executed the servant who betrayed the governor of Janus.

eb396cca-c2a3-43b8-9f64-2722a09f791d.Text: [Execute the servant] "Death to traitors of the Imperium."

c90d9480-4843-4e47-b5dd-5588d3ff6310.Text: "No! I have not asked all my questions!"

e232f9ec-5eee-4432-8e6d-c863cec218a0.Text: {n}Hearing your footsteps, the elderly servant grabs an injector and stabs it into his arm. The area around the needle immediately starts turning black.{/n} "You're too late, Vyatt's dogs! I'm the master of my own fate!" {n}But when he gets a better look at you, the man drops the injector in astonishment, and seems poised to prostrate himself on the floor before you.{/n} "It's you! Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! The God-Emperor must have brought you here! I beg you, help the rebels and save Janus!"

197dfbe6-7979-43d7-8e69-567afd90c058.Text: "I swear I'm not lying! Pray for me, holy sister... for me and for Janus!"

a3e0a142-c170-437b-9f4e-03dc1429aa9d.Text: "Fresh meat to entertain the nobility... some things never change, whether you're on my planet, or anywhere in the righteous Imperium."

2dc7b8a2-35f9-433f-8abc-6c87bd058f69.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, could I have done otherwise? No, I could not... not after everything I've seen in the palace! People being shipped in and tortured. Servants being driven mad. For a long time I thought it was only going on inside the estate... but when I was contacted by people on the outside, I learned that all of Janus is under threat! Only your mercy and the light of the God-Emperor can save us!"

83a5cdc0-6584-4d8a-b866-ccda77f6ab94.Text: "No! Don't waste your time on somebody who's as good as dead already... I'll depart this world happily knowing that I'm free from the clutches of that monster sitting on the governor's throne..."

bea3c61f-2517-4883-8689-910c783a8211.Text: "In the name of the Golden Throne, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, show mercy on the humble workers, the salt of Janus — save them! Vistenza Vyatt, the untouchable governor and leader of the nobility, is creating something monstrous behind closed doors. She uses the Imperium's interests as a smokescreen and purports to be a scholar, but her actions... her actions are poisoning our planet!"

8696947c-f1fa-4578-a90f-e8d2e75aecfc.Text: "Hidden chambers deep within the palace. I've never been inside... thankfully. The servants who are allowed in, the ones the governor trusts... they change. She changes them. Pretties them up. Defiles them."

eaf16349-dd1a-4428-9700-35f1db4a0919.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I'm prepared to swear on my life and soul, may the light of the Emperor preserve it, that it is not conjecture. We have been living under Vyatt's rule for decades now, and things have gotten worse and worse with every passing year... The people can no longer tolerate the nightmare that lurks within the walls of this estate!"

6a7b91c8-2a0f-407e-bc21-d7f5b1927d4d.Text: "Did you know that the settlements that fail to pay their due tithes on time have been allowed to pay with people instead? They even deliver them to order — sometimes old folks, sometimes children..." {n}He lowers his voice to a whisper and leans toward you.{/n} "I've seen those people. I've seen them being delivered to the estate... and then they're never seen or heard from again. They go into the secret rooms and they don't come out again, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Ever."

6775bf23-95ca-493d-8131-5f7b816f4c90.Text: "I'll tell you exactly what I was told by the people who contacted me. These tithes... some settlements have already switched to paying with people. They say that amenable settlements get special treatment from the governor's dogs. They arrange for medicine to be supplied to the settlement. Then security. And then they completely isolate them — all contact between those inside the settlement and the outside world is cut off!"

b280bae2-57f5-492b-8712-e9208e8244bd.Text: "One lad managed to get out — he's the one who told me all this... that the people are rotting alive in there! Strange growths, yellow eyes, stinking like dead bodies... The worst-looking ones are rounded up and taken away... The fellow who escaped, he seemed fine, but within a couple of days of the rebels picking him up, he started seeing monsters instead of people. They had to lock him up away from other folks, the poor sod, and then he... his wrists..."

747cb879-3ef9-4731-8f6f-5962b15c9605.Text: "Deliverance... from what Vyatt's dogs would do to me if they caught me." {n}He forces a smile onto his face.{/n} "I was given the vial along with the instructions about when to let our liberators into the estate."

6b459fa2-a154-4ed4-b67c-16db09abcdf0.Text: {n}The old man drops to the floor like a lead weight. Blood dribbles from his mouth onto his chin, an expression of surprise frozen in his glazed eyes.{/n}

379b6f98-d742-4ffe-8dee-fe66ec102b60.Text: {n}He doubles up, hugging himself, and is wracked by coughing that leaves his lips wet with blood.{/n} "...Forgive me, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. If only I'd known it was you. My eyes deceived me! We have little time now, but I swear I'll tell you everything!"

036eaa9c-960d-4ed4-969f-c837fcbfb64d.Text: "Throne damn you, old man, where did you get this stuff? Poison capsules of this sort are a popular choice among desperate ashmags who are done with being tortured by mad fanatics or worse. Here on Janus, though... there's no antidote."

bd180c6f-f5bb-483f-a0aa-d2ff24d7a465.Text: "Peasants who were taken to Eurac V to serve House Orsellio were never seen or heard from again either. They became loyal servants and toiled for the good of a great dynasty — why should they ever return to their filthy, squalid abodes?"

9d7e88e7-e965-49cb-a420-74dedb8c9317.Text: "I see no shadows of deceit behind your words, and even so... I would have noticed. I know I would have noticed the signs of which you..." {n}Yrliet's face tenses like a taut string, and doubt creeps into her expression.{/n} "Except, whenever Vistenza hosts one of her dances at the palace, she sends me away to search for the rebels. Into the forests, far from human settlements."

b750fdfc-2865-4a91-8acc-a63bcb34495d.Text: {n}Kibellah picks up a drop of poison from the needle with her claw and carefully puts it on her tongue. She makes an approving sound.{/n} "A strong toxin. We apply something similar to the lips of new initiates of the Bloodspun Web. It kills minor nerves and purges one's sensitivity to pain. For this layman, though, it is a certain and violent death."

0078caf8-a7ac-4170-a097-ea3897955f68.Text: "The aristocracy is known for its countless reprehensible inclinations. However, unless these foibles give reason to doubt the planet's loyalty to the Imperium, they do not warrant a death sentence."

1a1561e1-c018-4242-a71b-968c7f6170f4.Text: "Don't waste time asking obvious questions, {name}! He won't last long — make your questions count!"

be53c430-0863-4cea-814f-e2a7838217c4.Text: "You accuse the Rogue Trader's appointed governor of heresy. If your words are false, they themselves are tantamount to heresy. But if what you say is true... if it's true, then your sacrifice will be to your credit, my good man!" {n}Argenta utters these last words with impassioned conviction.{/n}

c87212b5-7759-4070-b388-1ff42fbf6315.Text: {n}Looking closely at the old man, the Tech-Priest utters,{/n} "Nerve toxin. The inevitable cessation of vital functions is expected in no more than sixty seconds." {n}Silent clicks emitted by the visor indicate an ongoing pict-recording.{/n}

9208ff70-3ab4-4d56-a5d5-f4abfb0a1a27.Text: {n}The old servant lets out a moan. The dark stain on his arm seems to creep through his veins until his arms and neck are a latticework of black. The servant's breath quickens and becomes irregular.{/n}

35a2d9a4-c9cb-47a4-8d7e-00604976600e.Text: {n}The servant shakes and coughs violently.{/n} "I'm... not sure I'll last long enough to answer all your questions..."

e59e9f30-c6a8-4942-834a-bbabe3b8b02e.Text: {n}The old man starts to convulse, indicating that he is close to death. He raises his already unseeing eyes to you.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}... if you'll permit a dying man to make one last request... Don't tell anyone that I was the one who unlocked the doors... If you do... they'll... they'll go after my family... my home..."

ce6f1220-29c9-40b2-a16d-dcf6e4837425.Text: "Please, save us... save... Janus..." {n}The servant rasps violently and collapses on his side, wracked with convulsions.{/n}

1f61d2ab-bbc9-43e9-9dbc-5a32b70e69ed.Text: "Tell me, or I'll tear this world apart to get rid of garbage like you and your brethren!"

4ef510ca-9905-4e96-979c-6cb7d54d0a8b.Text: "There will be no end to the war on this planet until I get a handle on the situation. But to do that, I need to meet with your leader."

696c4ad3-a7ee-42f3-bc47-7a97207a65b9.Text: Executed the young rebel on Janus.

6ae21df4-81d0-4e53-b5a0-850384d2bf26.Text: "I am {name}, Rogue Trader and sovereign of this planet. In the name of the Emperor, open this door!"

ad526021-755d-4ce8-8cce-20704ea05412.Text: [Address the officer] "I'm done. Proceed with the clearance operation."

e923007d-d15c-4571-9f04-271623bc6937.Text: "Why should I listen to a filthy insurgent?"

47c2638c-8aa5-46fe-b3cb-ba302491cca8.Text: "Get up and come with me. I give you my word as a Rogue Trader, you will live."

7aa3cf39-4420-491d-937f-31454678dcc7.Text: "How dare you rebel against a vassal of the Imperium!"

9355f546-ca04-40d4-9718-05051ebbf43e.Text: "You're telling me people are seeing evil spirits?"

915da105-12c0-41d1-8e77-d8e310266a67.Text: [Execute the rebel] "I'm done listening to you, rebel."

96727120-3581-4a07-99f1-9bd8dde01c0f.Text: Granted an easy death to the young rebel on Janus.

8201f8a8-6016-40d5-ae30-f3fccfa06abd.Text: [Give the rebel an easy death] "The people waiting outside will put you through far worse torment than I will. Goodbye."

159207ae-c8ff-4788-83e3-f37d71c1400f.Text: {n}When you approach the solid-looking door, a high, boyish voice shouts out,{/n} "Piss off! You won't take me alive! Better to put a bullet in my brain than let the governor's dogs get their hands on me!"

d51f6e93-ce1a-403e-ba36-f4a59a17e81e.Text: "This is one of the elusive and cunning rebels the governor's been fighting for months? Really?"

98763832-9e0b-4d62-9349-5de5b0fa32d2.Text: {n}The boy's body goes limp and drops to the floor.{/n}

26178d76-c2af-474e-81da-7fd3d26fb5c7.Text: {n}The shaking rebel curls up on the ground under your gaze.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, no! Please, don't hurt the others!"

3b0d9b77-908f-4c07-b2a1-c844d6002e3f.Text: "I... no! No, I'd rather die!" {n}The rebel, shaking in terror, brings his hands together and begins to pray.{/n}

0d1b8910-37e0-4015-8f11-3f68fe147bca.Text: {n}The boy hesitates for a few seconds, and then his head drops limply.{/n} "As long as you keep your word..."

12086d1f-5549-421e-8ece-03f4f436f79a.Text: {n}He swallows nervously and looks at you with fear.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I beg you, don't ask me that! I can't sell out the others... I won't betray them!"

7d989b4e-c905-45c0-bcfd-83d0afa9a655.Text: {n}A few powerful blows, and the door flies open, revealing the way inside.{/n}

bb170759-6fc2-45d9-ad40-e73b344e3e60.Text: {n}After several blows, you realise that breaking down this obstacle is beyond your abilities. You can feel the wardens swapping glances behind you, and the back of your neck grows hot.{/n}

7285e69f-24e4-4879-bf25-c4937eeead1a.Text: {n}It takes you half a minute to figure out the archaic mechanism. With a soft click, the door opens, allowing you to enter.{/n}

85405459-6b35-4e94-b939-115d2ef6e71c.Text: {n}The lock refuses to surrender, despite your efforts. What's more, it seems one of the springs inside has shifted around, turning the closed lock into an immovable deadbolt.{/n}

96235016-453a-4f19-ad4e-7a0181061ba4.Text: {n}For a long time, nothing happens. Then, the door opens with a quick click.{/n}

67e67f59-4aed-4bc2-91d5-4a27a41cd79b.Text: "Do you think I'm an idiot? Take your lies and choke on them, you and your damn mistress!"

71dd86c6-8ce9-4c67-81b3-655fd5319048.Text: "Wilco, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Please, stand back — I don't want you to get hurt."

77b45eb0-cc0b-4cbd-84c1-9689af5509be.Text: "From Governor Vyatt! Everybody here knows what she's doing to us. We've put up with it for a long time, hoping that somebody would intervene and help us... But nobody ever did..."

c901b0e4-8cb1-434c-9da3-190afc61929a.Text: {n}The space is small, the corners filled with inky black shadows, but you can still make out the person in the room. He is desperately gripping a discharged lasgun in his hands. The rebel looks at you in amazement.{/n} "It really is you..."

510cf8f4-9bc1-4f32-a0c9-959588d7322c.Text: {n}Inside is poorly lit, but you spot a person standing in the far corner. He is desperately gripping a discharged lasgun in his hands. At the sight of you, his eyes widen in recognition — and fear.{/n} "It c-can't be... The Rogue Trader!"

b0fdc182-61e9-4091-b41e-a5bc630fbe56.Text: {n}The solid door is dutifully blocking your path inside. Trying to break down this slab without some kind of battering ram would be a fool's errand. Your gaze falls on the lock — a military design, typically used for external doors on government buildings.{/n}

b0eb5d03-fcfe-453e-b188-f6eab19fbd62.Text: {n}He swallows nervously and looks at you with fear.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I beg you, don't ask me that! I can't sell out my brethren! It's over for me, but the others... I won't betray them!"

262eedd9-67df-4c17-9471-c664ecbed174.Text: "I... My little sister was taken to the palace. Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, she was so little... Whenever I think about what happened to her, I want to kill everyone, the governor and everyone protecting her." {n}The boy swallows.{/n} "All of us are grieving our own losses."

6225c1d4-b9f6-4460-b7df-a385667183d1.Text: {n}The interior of the building is steeped in gloom. You notice overturned furniture and blood spilt across the entire floor.{/n}
