It seems we have disrupted a vile performance for their distinguished guests."

62c16636-b571-4493-9ee8-ce2299da2f33.Text: {n}Idira spits on the ground.{/n} "If I'd been the one holding the device, she and I would have had words... I'd make sure the stuck-up bitch knew exactly what I think of her."

1fa75478-bda0-4cb7-9afc-a1c7ea785c11.Text: {n}Jae opens her mouth and then freezes, clenching the Aquila on her chest until her knuckles turn white.{/n} "If... I were faced with such a choice... the Exalted One would guide me on the right path."

8e6ec1e8-8902-4175-a112-ad75351fccd3.Text: "Stupid ashmags! Do you really think the Drukhari will whisk you away to a far-off wonderland? At best they'll put you in chains. At worst..."

9b94a88d-cc96-439a-a6fa-2f05cdb8bc21.Text: "Glory to the givers of the Emperor's mercy!"

036f6fa5-a83a-4706-b6fe-9d699fcf73ed.Text: "May the Emperor protect the lords of Dargonus!"

e7057152-4bb1-42d6-b5f0-86083aa92621.Text: Glinting in the light, the coin falls into the clear water and sinks to the bottom.

1e4bb6fb-3d79-4e37-9cd0-f93461f8f88b.Text: "A curse has taken hold of the dynasty... Woe, woe upon us all!"

144fc41c-2fed-467f-8c53-020f08e49042.Text: "Emperor, protect us from the evil that has risen over us!"

11bac42c-b7ce-4140-a086-db217565a2a9.Text: "A heretic at the head of the dynasty! It's the end of times!"

77c5c05e-b4e3-4518-9eaf-4b48bc74e624.Text: "The universe is vast and filled with nightmares both wicked and predatory. Humankind is their prey, the satiation of their hunger."

f348aa07-4016-43ec-adaa-08fc2a9debcc.Text: "Only in His radiance can Humanity find the strength to stand against the terrors nourished by the light of stars unknown. Only in His will can Humanity see the purpose of its being."

17d6bd5c-a16e-4500-87fc-252a8a5735f9.Text: "Offer thy humble prayer to the foot of His Throne, keep Him always in thy thoughts, fear His wrath, persecute doubt in Him, and rise up against any who would defame Him."

5bd8badc-ca83-4044-9162-ba33580aec10.Text: "For righteousness is our weapon, loyalty is our armour, and death for Him is our aspiration and purpose. Hear my word and rejoice: the Emperor protects."

9fdb06d6-77b3-447d-822c-0d2e7822aa6f.Text: "In the name of our prosperity and the triumph of justice, these profaners, traitors, and embezzlers shall face their stern execution! Inform the authorities of any transgressor you know! Praise the Rogue Trader, who cleanses our homes of parasites and predators!"

113b8cac-ba2d-4ebf-af3d-992c08262f25.Text: "Witness these wild and merciless warriors face each other in a fight to the death — all for your amusement, good folk! Anyone is allowed to participate, and the winners of these battles will be granted the privilege of becoming privates in the von Valancius wardens! Be merry and praise the Rogue Trader's name!"

8754f26f-0a0d-4148-8510-a6cd15a78e09.Text: "In {mf|his|her} unfathomable benevolence, the Rogue Trader has decreed that every soul be given a day's rations and a personal fuel cell so that all may be fed and warm on this day. Praise the Rogue Trader's magnanimity!"

990f768c-3c29-43a8-ae43-b6ae06dd12c8.Text: "To remind the people of their humility and loyalty, for the next cycle, ministration in all temples in the von Valancius protectorate will be performed without interruption! Every subject is to attend a service and offer a prayer of gratitude to the God-Emperor. Keep the faith and praise the pious Rogue Trader!"

aceb8d5e-deb5-4e39-b7db-1ff84b7435c3.Text: "Rejoice, von Valancius subjects! In honour of {mf|his|her} ascension, the new Rogue Trader generously shows you {mf|his|her} favour!"

fb031b5c-8c23-4a2a-84c9-84c5270298b6.Text: These magnificent paintings were created in a style that fully complies with the artistic canon approved by the Ecclesiarchy.

eca9309f-d49a-4378-b41f-4aabd3619a70.Text: Wild xenobeasts are growling ferociously, adding a flair of thrilling danger to the mood in the palace.

57ae2a87-509c-41c4-941a-78b9c9fc7c0f.Text: This eerily crackling xenos trophy is a testament to how the Omnissiah's gifts become twisted shadows of themselves in the hands of inhumans.

fe027bae-7c41-48b1-98cf-bb8e64a2e803.Text: A fragment of an Aeldari pillar — a trophy to the Rogue Trader and a never-before-seen oddity to most citizens of the Imperium.

2baab35f-55b5-4ad5-a642-936f975b6ded.Text: This exotic statue, which formerly pleased the eyes of xenos, now adorns the palace of this dynasty of glorious explorers of the Koronus Expanse.

60ac92f0-d901-48d1-bb78-b70c8494c72d.Text: These sinister xenos instruments of death are now trophies demonstrating the invincibility of House von Valancius.

05e19649-edf3-479c-8eda-796ae56fdfd3.Text: The servants are striving to make their music sound almost intoxicatingly mellifluous.

5e7b9120-0248-4948-8be2-4b51a66e0ed7.Text: The dancers' graceful movements are hypnotising, drawing the audience into a blissful trance.

1e89de55-66d1-4a1a-aa42-357dd6fba267.Text: Scattered haphazardly around the table are bottles of expensive amasec, plates of provisia nobilis, and hookahs of obscura.

4082e8ed-e124-47fa-9424-717c67a5d42c.Text: These swords belonged to a presumptuous governor of Vheabos VI who staged a revolt hundreds of years ago. The insurrectionist's hands, preserved against decay, still rest on the swords' hilts.

24efacf8-3dea-4db9-a6ad-8e8a738347cc.Text: The magnificent altar to the God-Emperor is wreathed in the fumes of precious incense.

04d301fd-eb81-4cc9-a247-e9a1d7972b03.Text: Inscribed upon the snow-white parchment are prayers for the brave soldiers of House von Valancius, who carry the Rogue Trader's will and that of the Emperor across the Koronus Expanse.

a3b238d4-9901-4c9b-8338-c3d7028ec88d.Text: The noble features of this guardian of Humanity burn with righteous fury and stern resolve.

b311dcab-e140-494c-8a55-64087c48ef80.Text: A collection of proudly displayed weapons that belonged to distinguished Rogue Traders of House von Valancius.

cfd9dae7-fa4a-41e0-92cc-12887d2ff345.Text: "What a bizarre breed of xenobeast. I've never heard of this kind of abomination before. I wonder what planet it's from."

e9d166f0-afca-4f4f-859d-d5bcfc077a52.Text: "I could swear I once saw a creature just like this one when I was flying over the capital's lower sectors. These xenos must have lived here before us and were never fully exterminated."

d61769d1-d946-4170-98ef-cfa96a40a580.Text: "In that case, these parasites must be done away with post-haste. I've never been to the lower sectors, but I'm sure the common people suffer greatly from such loathsome neighbours."

8a77d65f-05d3-4c05-ab6c-80bef252d97d.Text: "Please, let me go! I'm not a xenos! I'm a person, I just look different... I was born this way!"

6235fc1d-af43-41e6-be9d-3019073d2f36.Text: "What an intriguing mixture of ungodliness and elegance. Xenos creations are so decadently amusing!"

1c558c4c-14bb-428d-a7fd-fdf0d7850c00.Text: "But isn't it too dangerous to display something like this in the palace? What if it brings blight upon us?"

32663ccb-d177-4654-bff9-caf461482cab.Text: "Since it's the Rogue Trader's trophy, its xenos owners were either killed or subjugated. Who are you scared of more, dead inhumans or slaves?"

2e27bd4b-a205-4f0b-91b2-305be853688e.Text: "Well, if it were dangerous, surely they wouldn't have put it here..."

ebda47cf-982f-4d33-a1ba-fb9917fe9949.Text: "Don't, you idiot! I mean, wait, esteemed—"

e4222a55-5cc8-494d-8f3d-9a61ee5748a1.Text: "Blast it! It hurts! Send for a chirurgeon, I feel... strange. And sick!"

4d8dc371-0598-4cb1-acba-fa7d7a8fe511.Text: "Hmph. Shall we wait to see what happens to him next? It is bound to be a most fascinating sight."

3d64e768-18e9-4a9e-8556-2482c8f0673e.Text: "I've heard of the rich history of the von Valancius... but these stories are beyond my expectations!"

525335ee-f5e6-41a1-994c-2ebac99efe11.Text: "I sold an island so I could visit the von Valancius estate — it was worth every throne!"

8555cf67-168b-461d-a088-8a3cbedbee00.Text: "May the God-Emperor keep our protector safe!"

27a5ae57-c7bd-45f2-ab9d-5e7f2c0e9d23.Text: "I know people who are willing to pay good money for such curiosities..."

352af9a0-53c6-4fe7-b396-23efe0570bd0.Text: "...turn your gaze to this object, which is invested with special significance..."

f8d4e357-50ba-4203-9e7a-0f328add974a.Text: "...similar finds all over the planet. Many sages and acolytes of the arcane sciences were puzzled over this trophy brought from a forgotten world on the outskirts of the Koronus Expanse..."

b2df1a31-fb55-4f98-8f60-4400d2db3487.Text: "...a huge role in the development of the Imperial Cult on Dargonus. The mission of the radiant Ecclesiarchy was founded after the arrival of two voidships carrying generations of pilgrims..."

bf996b3e-9331-4150-8d96-f836f211df3f.Text: "...serves as a reminder of the sacred mission of the Rogue Traders, whose every thought and aspiration is directed toward one goal — the service of His will..."

81879d39-cbf9-431b-abb8-64b55bd7d624.Text: "...this artefact was found in the lifetime of a great ancestor of the current Rogue Trader and is revered as a shrine, marking the triumph of Humanity over its enemies..."

c8440e78-8483-4cf8-8095-9c81cda1c2a8.Text: "This completes the retelling of the von Valancius chronicle. Lift up your thoughts to the chosen ones of the God-Emperor and thank Him for granting such a protector to your world!"

29021e13-ef7e-40ff-9814-9f4550451539.Text: "Long live the von Valancius dynasty! The Emperor protects!"

3ac5cc4a-6ac6-4b3c-beb2-a2e746f704eb.Text: "Did you hear what the guys from the spaceport are saying? About these enemies of Humanity?"

d43fed65-8ff3-4eb8-8bcc-2178f7a5c928.Text: "It's just staff on the augurs exaggerating to make themselves feel more important."

b9b458f9-dc0c-4a35-b922-dadfa71cd2f3.Text: "You think? But what if they're telling the truth? Well, you know that thing about Saint Cognatius—"

a6a7d194-6675-4581-bce2-6397362a442e.Text: "Enough already about Saint Cognatius. The voidship perished on its voyage — no enemies of Humanity had anything to do with it."

8da3748a-5e47-4cc2-9fa4-11a3b28c577a.Text: "Yeah, sure, keep thinking like that. But what if they come here?"

5a8810c4-5f75-4ee3-af31-ee3b40bd0847.Text: "If someone is dumb enough to try their luck on Dargonus, they'll quickly regret it. Have you ever seen our batteries? Or the regiments of wardens that are kept on the lower levels?"

9aeecb5d-563e-4048-a630-b33ff1e53273.Text: "Maybe you're right. But if it did happen, what would we do? We'd be stuck here in the lap of luxury, no fortifications, nothing — everything is on the outer perimeter..."

e6e0b627-fa14-42c0-83b6-681956adb247.Text: "Although, if it came to it, there are plenty of nooks and crannies in this place, spots where you could hide and wait it out..."

720b39ee-1629-4c5c-bff9-0e6960f4ff72.Text: "Shut up before I rat you out for treasonous talk! Are you out of your mind — prattling out loud like that? Keep your mouth shut, got it?"

d4bd6390-5581-426a-85a3-92b5e85ed87b.Text: "Not bad, not bad at all... You can feel the confidence in the brush strokes and the artist's commitment to the concept. However, I expected something more extraordinary from a place like this..."

4a679995-c18f-48ac-919d-0010b527230a.Text: "I imagine this was a gift, not a commissioned piece. Considering how often the sovereign is away and how much this place is managed in {mf|his|her} absence, I wouldn't be surprised if the sight of this painting on the wall is a surprise for {mf|him|her} as well..."

caf63928-a787-4e7f-9c5f-3c96096853d1.Text: "Allow me to express my deepest respect for the most esteemed House Orsellio. {mf|His|Her} {mf|Lord|Lady}ship {name} awaits you in the throne room. Servants may wait here for the time being."

565fcb54-bfe7-408e-997d-27798f28aa13.Text: "Oh, Immortal God-Emperor, be merciful to us..."

606be05e-dce4-4056-a066-294c70817552.Text: "Inspire us with strength and give us the courage to overcome troubles and suffering in Your name..."

b421f784-b5e7-4b7d-9b29-d940a220e33f.Text: "In the name of the Golden Throne we live and die so we that we may protect His light from the obliterating darkness..."

dbec2198-8691-41f2-b2bb-676cfd1a22d3.Text: "Let us all direct our strength to fight against His enemies, for martyrdom is the only way to redeem His sacrifice and His wounds..."

8ffa7e1a-af7c-4416-9b6e-90aa3a6a2818.Text: "By Your mercy and Your blessing we march into darkness, turning into dust everything that abhors Your vision, and in this service we rejoice..."

ee8b0525-ca99-47b2-83a8-9ef90df7c373.Text:
"O Galactic Sovereign, protect your flock from aliens! O Warden of Light, send a beam that will show us the path on our dark voyage! We are Your warriors and Your servants, who are delivered from blindness of heart
And put on the chains of hatred, contempt, and malice..."

e353a131-1a90-449f-a26a-be78c280c54d.Text: Artist: Hector Pireman. Material: oil paints, lithopone, artist's blood. Compliance with the Imperial Creed: rigorous.

3e647ee2-bf8a-472f-938e-d932e5133c86.Text: Creator: Ghorda de Montaal. Material: organic pigments, plasteel minium, anhydrous sienna. Compliance with the Imperial Creed: satisfactory.

2ef9a314-9d90-467f-809e-44d405c8b75c.Text: Object: trophies of the von Valancius dynasty captured over the past three centuries. Access level: restricted. Compliance with the Imperial Creed: questionable (special permission granted to the bearer of the Warrant).

6280f388-6b23-4bb9-a025-1004ad50d6b0.Text: "Tech-Priest Signus-Alpha 36 is unable to respond to your request and will be occupied for another 6.48 standard cycles. Please submit your request on Form H-45/2. Average processing time... 5 standard cycles."

68102e3d-010b-4bcd-930f-59a2f175152c.Text: "Tech-Priest Signus-Alpha 42 is performing a turret maintenance ritual and is temporarily unavailable. Ritual process is 42.25840% complete."

309313c0-2d78-4348-a1e3-ccc3d023864a.Text: The servo-skull turns the pict-recorder lens on you and emits a binharic trill.

f4d6cbcf-4198-424c-9eac-ed54d28276e8.Text: "What? My lord, I don't understand what you mean."

d1b35090-17ad-4913-8d6b-f139cda01660.Text: "Stop playing dumb. You know why I'm here."

e43c2d89-3acc-4d30-812e-9e03c369ee44.Text: "Oh, my lord, you shouldn't shout like that — you don't want the whole palace to know about your tastes, do you?"

b67a66b5-82f5-4c0e-a688-d55c872833f8.Text: "Here in this case is everything that I promised. Perfect transparency, excellent sharpening..."

9d9f96d5-75d1-44eb-a10b-301aad029873.Text: "I hope I don't have to check them on the spectrograph?"

686c8de5-4ef0-43be-972f-000b02c5c594.Text: "My lord, what do you think I am? Have you ever had a problem with our product before?"

5bebab67-8761-441d-9b15-0097b31adb8b.Text: "Well, I suppose... We're done here. Guards, follow me."

e6443344-61b1-41e8-b79a-5c84dc5d0f36.Text: "I'll be waiting for your next vox-message, my lord."

0d2b5eee-2597-4fd4-823f-f251c3ec34a6.Text: "What a lovely day it is, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. Your presence only makes it better!"

833b1dab-1b30-4578-a6f3-33d2c3c7ca46.Text: An ancient cogitator linked to the palace's system networks.

8cb9fc52-b2b2-40a7-b937-cd45c89d1ce6.Text: "Anyone who's broken through a flak shield with me, rammed and boarded a vessel with me, and survived a massacre in depressurised modules with me, I'll call my brother or sister."

a419aa3a-0700-4a39-8e40-85cbd6fff79b.Text: "Maybe that's how it is for you void troopers. But down in the planetary infantry, the losses are so high that I'd rather not remember the names of any soldiers ranked below sergeant."

6e431965-a528-4891-ba1f-983c5b1cb365.Text: "Makes sense. If I'd had to grant the Emperor's Peace to get my men out of the trenches, I'd prefer not to remember either."

847a2823-0a5f-4840-812d-b0bc3c4cf941.Text: The battlefield looks more like a bloodbath — the defenders of the palace were taken by surprise and literally slaughtered.

5ed15794-31a3-40e1-a50d-4cfdd2587c67.Text: The bodies of the courtiers tortured by the xenos are covered with wounds, cuts, and open fractures.

cc73b03f-b829-4cc0-b84e-56deec851dde.Text: Among numerous mutilations of the bodies, thin cuts are barely distinguishable — this is the work of a skilled torturer, not enraged fighters.

44836a44-9d59-45fa-b4bb-18938d88ad26.Text: The mutilated, broken bodies belong to the numerous servants of the von Valancius palace.

b999662d-bb61-4578-ac62-cacec07574e5.Text: Numerous bodies litter the ground. Some corpses were mutilated with particular cruelty while others were killed quickly, almost in passing.

0700259b-2a82-461c-8547-d6ab922395ba.Text: The armour of the tank is riddled with holes and the remains of the crew are visible through the breaches.

29ab2748-4405-4f01-9ae3-3d7117bfdcbc.Text: The bark of the tree is covered with thin streams of dark resin similar to streaks of blood.

8852d7f0-3a10-4225-926a-ac46f62e6a78.Text: The gates have been swept off their mighty hinges, most likely as a result of a direct hit from a powerful weapon.

7afbdf9d-1e44-42b7-adc4-4a7eeb311a98.Text: The control panel is broken — the machine spirit has left this machine forever.

de823a58-effe-4c25-b476-19c116152761.Text: The smell of burning and blood permeates the air around the desecrated chapel.

9ababe3e-e6a9-467d-a378-8cb815383f15.Text: Broken furniture, tattered fabric, bloodstains — someone in this room put up a desperate defence against the xenos.

de90f7ba-ce8f-4e13-a311-e11511f88b0e.Text: The stele is severely damaged, apparently by accident rather than deliberate vandalism.

9e7ad338-bf65-483e-92f5-204105a338fb.Text: "We have a transmission! Report from Squad 2!"

3aa6b8ab-dab7-4a76-ab4b-afc7230f56d2.Text: "Come in! Lieutenant, report imme— Lieutenant! We do not read you, repeat! What? Emperor help them..."

b4f688db-55e1-473f-9042-7e74db147891.Text: "Muan gram. What do you have there?"

aafbf9b9-bd1d-4ba5-9300-9534c3f7d586.Text: "I'm not sated yet. The last ones went out too quick."

d404b345-7d0e-4e08-8dbb-f161858aeec7.Text: "Too weak. I need a worthy opponent."

4a6e809d-d7ee-444f-9f4a-6abf0f9f414c.Text: "Xenos... They are inside already! We could not stop them... May the Emperor have mercy... on our souls..."

7e382d9a-6ac3-45e3-9808-d875693a6ebc.Text: The bloodied soldier lets out an incoherent moan, clutching his mangled face.

2a02430c-c249-44f6-8b1f-258b6f6bfa94.Text: You lean over the soldier — and you spot the armed mine hidden under his body.

3ccde5b5-cdaa-43ad-9da7-157c13ee19d3.Text: The warden was injured in a mine explosion.

6874e37e-ed65-456e-8d4f-63f64312f550.Text: The warden mutters words of thanks and holds out an object for you to take.

3750be9d-c86b-4a26-b8ee-2840d447bc8d.Text: "Attack! For the Emperor and the Rogue Trader!"

d9f2d731-6a54-46ad-b523-4b8f17a8a9ce.Text: "We will hold the position... May the Emperor help us!"

f8eafd58-65eb-4548-ae83-6339ec746031.Text: The bodies were mutilated and gutted. Once luxurious clothes of brocade and silk are completely saturated with blood.

7c441a82-87b0-41ef-81ce-fbd1012cc2ca.Text: "I don't want to leave you all alone — you wouldn't appreciate that, would you?"

045c76ec-b3ae-4335-b605-0d5e80dcca69.Text: "Kabalites of the Reaving Tempest — I leave this mon-keigh to you. Enjoy yourselves."

7c379eca-7583-4a41-9544-a2f0f98a43c0.Text: The vox transmits the same repeating recording — desperate calls for help, heart-rending cries and the hysterical howl of a dying man.

12d30f0d-47f4-4fee-80fb-60d8dae866ce.Text: "Soldiers! The Rogue Trader is with us, and therefore the Emperor Himself! Everyone who can hold a weapon — to the front line!"

21492ba8-d3d1-440d-a317-aefbde981c9d.Text: "Sergeant, for what? We've lost already... What's the point?"

a40f101c-211b-45d2-83ff-ed3ae057c57d.Text: "Well, any more cowards here?! To the line!"

2b1ebc9c-bcf7-4877-8cb0-0d63196c3459.Text: "Emperor protect you! I was one step away from death!"

796b0a3b-8754-4836-9b39-d0b985ac39d2.Text: "Our saviour! Long live the Rogue Trader!"

acb8fc2d-7de6-433e-b013-235665963562.Text: "Praise the Emperor, it's you! I thought it was those... those..."

da86b63d-bc73-4dd0-b3c9-099928574315.Text: "Thank you, Rogue Trader! We will hold our positions!"

5679d0dc-a23e-46fc-8a56-ac0cdc54f24b.Text: The servitor appears unharmed and completely indifferent to the carnage unfolding around it.

994f1678-09c0-4d4e-a5d0-6c828d5be190.Text: The ceremonial throne of the head of the von Valancius dynasty.

a1bfaad3-d1ac-4d49-8792-004c2e54fbcd.Text: The fact that the person is still alive is evidenced only by barely audible groans.

dfb59595-c598-4c3d-ae99-0232ff4263ea.Text: "The Emperor protects... I... don't want to die..."

00553bb6-86fc-468d-b44c-34e120d4de0c.Text: The warden sucks in a forced breath. With each breath, a guttural gurgling comes from his chest.

adb42d2f-d8a3-4f9d-b323-a8d90fb300be.Text: This person is still breathing, but deep punctures in their chest leave no chance that they will survive.

3b3592f4-921a-4546-bc6b-d801a46c8cd4.Text: "I will help your friends. Lead on."

a80d69a7-a0d3-4398-b4b6-c4eaeedd2fea.Text: "Mark the place where your companions are being held on the map. I shall find the way there on my own."

da52b6c0-4091-46aa-93b0-a051386c5db8.Text: [Hit him] "Damn peasant! I am a Rogue Trader, appointed by the will of the Emperor Himself. I am the rightful ruler of this world!"

484609a2-e2b5-406e-a719-36e072d9950b.Text: "Never mind. Just tell me what happened here."

7ca39c16-ee13-4484-80af-0143ca69faa9.Text: "You think it was the Emperor who brought punishment upon Santiel's Pride?"

b3ba16e7-ab85-47f9-aff3-88cb92018acf.Text: "Why did House Chorda fail to dispatch a fleet to assist you?"

6b20fefa-78ab-47a8-9e16-5c2042240129.Text: "I have learned everything I wanted to know."

7359b6df-c1d5-49b6-b6da-df0bba024af8.Text: "Helping the rabble is beneath the dignity of a Rogue Trader. Out of my way!"

86c35c3f-4ed3-4ac4-96c0-b0953a0021f5.Text: "You abandoned your friends and fled like a coward!"

aaef2db4-eb4b-4746-949e-6f10d3b3ce0a.Text: [Execute him] "You were too afraid to fight the xenos and left your friends in their hour of need, traitorous vermin!"

2d5aaa4c-f508-40e4-a5ba-b4b2d19b33b0.Text: "Did anyone else manage to survive aside from you? Deep in the bunkers, perhaps?"

412dcdf3-c053-4c38-a1f0-c1c48db4f7cd.Text: {n}The quivering figure wrapped in several layers of tattered clothes is pointing an old lasgun at you:{/n} "W-who are you? In the name of the God-Emperor, k-keep away from me!"

37bbdda7-dcc4-4b13-8101-58dbded49774.Text: {n}Vir scratches his head in confusion.{/n} "That's us. The ones who remain. Those who survived to atone for the faults of our world before His all-seeing eyes!"

530b8f1b-cd45-4102-b42e-e4abc43b5bef.Text: "We land on a world that is frozen to the bone, and the next moment an obliging stranger appears who is only too eager to lead us to the so-called survivors? How convenient. And suspicious."

64c2924d-aa4f-4d83-a3b4-98b40a85d9b2.Text: "Say what you wish, but he harbours no secrets from us in his heart, while the path ahead is full of danger. Trust this poor man, Lord Captain — I do not hear any warning whispers."

a7089102-f764-422b-bdc4-5fb8671de7e2.Text: {n}Vir eagerly gives you a servile bow, but his eyes are full of despair.{/n} "The will of the Heavenly Envoy is His will."

abf81c92-303d-483d-8d5e-1fc7ee46383f.Text: {n}It takes the man several seconds to digest your answer.{/n} "May you be blessed by the Throne, {name}. And I am Vir... just Vir."

fc2928f1-97ec-4618-b41b-b7587f5bc16b.Text: "Who? You... You are one of the star children, right? I knew the Emperor could not have abandoned us! You have come to save us, have you not? May the Throne bless your radiant souls! I am Vir, one of the few survivors on this dispossessed world."

ab5f0fde-9470-4161-928b-9d30c142866a.Text: "Have mercy, {mf|master|mistress}! In these dire times you cannot expect to meet anyone but the apostates! I humbly kneel, and may the radiance of the Throne bless your souls! I am Vir, wretched Vir!"

f80504f4-9192-4592-ad3b-67f273f91c3e.Text: "A-all right, I suppose you would've attacked by now if you were going to... I'm Vir, former scout and now doomed man."

edd17c84-fce2-4670-ae2b-a832f4b18e57.Text: "The elders waited so long for a sign from heaven... They died waiting, in fact. May He smite me where I stand if they weren't talking about you! Y-you will help us unfortunates, won't you? I must go, take you to the others. It is not safe here — the bloody crimson degenerates are always skulking in search of prey, the ones you killed were hardly the last. I will show you the hidden chute. Come, come!" {n}Vir hesitates, awkwardly shuffling his feet.{/n} "And yeah... Thank you for saving my skin."

10fe9cd9-25a4-46b9-8f2a-fda73d9f01a0.Text: "R-really?" {n}The wretch cannot believe his ears.{/n} "Right away! Follow me and don't lag behind. And be very, very quiet! The Nightmares roam the streets, trust me, I know! They will be lying in wait up ahead, so tread carefully."

a02675dc-607f-4d6a-ba34-1d7e56f67459.Text: "R-really? If you say so... Be careful, the Nightmares will be lying in wait up ahead! And I will be waiting for you nearby, in case you need any help. But, I beg you, please hurry, Heavenly Envoy! They could be killing Albris as we speak..."

48e32f86-d2e8-43d4-9bc1-aa8f9ab8e529.Text: "Yes?.. Yes, of course! But please be quick." {n}The shaking man keeps glancing around nervously.{/n}

d7bd48cc-eb83-4fb4-94d7-db1f0e09ba5a.Text: "The Crimson Hand. Marauders, heretics and madmen... The apostates who stole the gifts prepared for God-Emperor — the bodies of those who finished their lifelong labour. And when they cannot find frozen corpses, it is us they come for!"

1f41a55d-c95b-477a-b1d3-5d5e01de15fc.Text: "Who? Oh, you must be taken about the Nightmares... God-Emperor preserve us! These beasts are prowling both in the depths and on the surface, they are the scourge for our transgressions before the Holiest One! Nobody ever returns from their clutches, for such is the will of the Divine. There are some who kill quickly, while others drag people into the dark, screaming. And some have turned into walking nightmares that feed on people's souls..."

5801101d-9f94-4169-ace9-3496bd1fa64c.Text: "If only someone knew! I've spent my entire life in the underhive — I only ever saw daylight once, so I'm not missing it much now. But the cold... It's the cold that was our undoing. The heat still lingers in the depths of the hive — that's where we are sheltering... Well, we were until recently. Until all the heat escaped the central pillar. When it did, myself and the others came up to get help and bring back supplies... and found you!"

6e371c0c-2872-4251-a65c-4167feed72f4.Text: "Not everyone can face death with honour. Weakness begets heresy, and then the others must lay the corrupt souls to rest if they are still clinging to this world!"

711a0266-1042-440f-adfc-ac1f70c16345.Text: {n}Vir gives you a frightened look.{/n} "The bunkers were the first to fall, my saviour. Starvation finished what the Nightmares started. It was easier to survive in small groups, but they too perished one after the other. The three of us... have not seen anyone else alive for a while now, only the corpses and His scourges."

fdd240fa-f566-4963-bde2-f03c01873e90.Text: "Who else but He?" {n}Vir blinks in confusion.{/n} "Only He has the strength to drive the shining Messenger from the sky and shroud the world in eternal darkness, making it tremble! And fill the night to the brim with Nightmares."

8df66328-2386-4ef4-92e1-94ec34bb75a1.Text: "I know not why the Immortal One punished us, but who am I to deny His will?"

f490b081-57ca-44cd-9e32-e2b46bf98bcf.Text: {n}The poor man's eyes grow round and wide with terror.{/n} "Had the mistress of this world learned we lost Santiel's Pride... The punishment would be more dire than any Nightmare can inflict."

feac0510-920c-4685-87c9-1fecd1c75bfa.Text: {n}Vir stops talking abruptly and hesitates for a few seconds, straining to hear something in the howling wind.{/n} "Can we go already?"

ba074be9-f3d4-4671-8f81-2bfcd58fbe50.Text: {n}Vir delivers a fawning bow.{/n} "It will be as you say, {mf|master|mistress}... But I am begging you to exercise caution: the Nightmares found our old passageway and are now grabbing everyone they see. It would be better to go via my chute — I'll mark it on your map and will be waiting there just in case. May the Emperor protect you!"

dada81b0-6627-4377-a6de-1f1e99cf2c81.Text: "In another time and place I would immediately demand you cut the peasant down for such an outburst. And yet... It pains me to see his mind is so tightly constricted by greenish black thorns. Never have I seen such a frightening colour. This person, this hive... Everything here is drenched with despair."

a417171e-85cc-4080-8c8a-63f709657dd5.Text: "The Elders have been waiting for a sign from the heavens for so long... Too much time has passed, so they died. But may He smite me if you are not the one! Y-you will help the ones in need of salvation, w-won't you?" {n}Vir freezes for a second, looking at you reverently and awkwardly shuffling his feet.{/n}

020b8fc5-a754-4cb9-9537-d1d40142f5bc.Text: "You have saved my skin, holiest one, but my brothers in faith and misery were not as lucky! The living nightmares grabbed us the moment we stuck our noses out to the surface, trying to survive. I managed to break free and escaped, leaving my friends behind... Woe, woe is me! I am beside myself with shame. I am begging you, child of the stars, please save my comrades, save..." {n}Vir falters, gulps and whispers almost breathlessly:{/n} "Save Albris. I will take you there even if costs me my life!"

eac821f8-4885-4b29-8054-76939dffb0f6.Text: "Spare my worthless cowardly soul, Heavenly Envoy! I was a regular machinist, I prayed every day, I saw weapons only from afar and tried my best to avoid them! How could I tackle the Nightmares with a malfunctioning lasgun? But I had to. Yes, I had to, but I couldn't!" {n}The man covers his eyes with his frostbitten fingers and wails.{/n}

24ffaa3c-27af-4f43-ba08-30f745a35bcc.Text: The door doesn't give — something is blocking it from the other side.

6af8d3ba-83d4-4e42-af9d-ed1f68f6cc79.Text: "The hive is destroyed, and now there are xenos roaming its streets. Too many misfortunes for one world."

62c20bfd-3853-41ce-a3ff-f65d84734d8b.Text: "Lord Captain, I do not like it here. It feels like everyone has gone mad on the other side — there is so much pain, so much fear... and thirst."

b7f1e028-cfc5-4b56-8548-e65cbd306c29.Text: "What could my twisted kinsmen possibly be seeking in this icy silence?"

3cb2b91d-115f-4182-8b6e-667280cad804.Text: "Vultures! Come to feast on the remains of the dying world? I will not let you!"

4db50cbe-86e7-48f7-b4dd-e57291a6395d.Text: The once majestic bridge for ritual processions was damaged when a civilian orbital shuttle collided with it.

6b3a291e-ecf0-42ba-a88d-38af8d88affb.Text: Charred bones stick out from a massive pile of ash. Some bear scratches that may have been left by a blade or by teeth.

090ab142-9758-44b5-a061-e8319f749086.Text: "Finally I can eat... Praise the Blood God!"

b31fde25-bd78-493e-ac9b-ae98c0b82dfa.Text: The man happily smacks his lips, sucking the liquid out of an eyeball.

0439aed7-f67a-4302-a59d-b366fff6cfbd.Text: "Begone, heretics! Burn in His punishing flame!"

e03171e9-6387-43ba-8d6d-e51a010bef57.Text: "Hee-hee-hee! The Blood God brought you to us!"

6ed02265-a4aa-42eb-a2ae-417fec9a4c54.Text: The empty promethium canisters bear a child's bloody handprints.

fcf3c2f3-53d1-4208-b094-418821ed73e5.Text: Part of a woman's face and several delicate fingers are still frozen to the cold generator. Someone shattered the rest of the body, its shards now crunching under your feet.

400d84fc-9362-4842-8291-cabf536f0f94.Text: Snowdrifts have covered the streets of the hive, sometimes reaching as high as the balconies and rooftops.

95726f23-b6e0-488d-9936-821447fb9a5b.Text: Thousands of bodies have merged into frozen snowdrifts, covering streets as far as the eye can see. It is unclear whether the formations occurred naturally or if somebody purposely piled the corpses up.

c395e630-5a0a-4d11-abca-e08bb5f01b79.Text: A small patch of starry sky can be seen among dozens of lofty towers, a sight previously unattainable for the denizens of lower levels.

1df85a62-da92-45fb-b5e2-337a1aab03e8.Text: The flying xenodevice emits an unnatural light. Strange forces are making it float freely in the air.

44fbe139-caf4-48c1-91b5-066bef110e2a.Text: "Kae-morag... I am disappointed how quickly this world fell. This place is cold and bland."

6e12d3a6-6930-426a-9af2-59029db27459.Text: "Patience. The more mon-keigh find themselves locked in with medusae, the faster they bear fruit."

851eadd6-1c50-4151-9139-d6d0ee5ea6e4.Text: "I cannot wait to gorge on their fruit! Not even your presence will feel so burdensome then."

63f85689-2a7f-4c4a-8b6d-5105368a96fc.Text: "I heard Khorgan brought in a new shipment of engines."

24f3a39a-b6a7-4f57-9b2b-abba767d72f8.Text: "Bhugar's servants are getting everything... I hope at least a couple of the mon-keigh get outside and run into us!"

fd4fe20d-c056-4043-91e9-c15b64f3f3b8.Text: "It seems everybody who survived is hiding down below — the patrols haven't delivered any new prisoners in a while."

bee67051-ecce-41ab-9a27-6c20b76a80a5.Text: "A little while longer, and She will start whispering in my mind... I cannot wait to return to Commorragh and take a place in the stands of the arena!"

c746ea70-13be-479d-9077-fdafe8d92dfd.Text: The chapel's massive doors are sealed by ice. The pale bodies of priests can be seen under its glacial surface.

ea44e273-3bc1-4575-91b6-125600dc39c0.Text: Ice crystals, growing from under the snow, form a vaguely alarming figure.

7b946eea-b1eb-4abe-8cc1-d11dfc5818ef.Text: A delicate young woman lies curled up in a snowbank like a living statue. Her thin hands are clutching a silken blanket.

2eecec18-f19e-4d8f-83c9-be3a59204f63.Text: Even as ice sculptures, the faithful continue to beg the Emperor for salvation.

71edf20f-9fc4-4afc-9444-e8621f45c695.Text: The golden statue of the Emperor is covered with twisted symbols and decorated with a garland of too-small skulls.

fc2fa355-658c-4d22-89c9-ed67da871f65.Text: The God-Emperor silently gazes down upon the once teeming streets.

5b52a6a2-e0a1-43cf-b1b3-048fa8a29bd4.Text: The tower's foundation goes down for tens of metres, and the spires are obscured by the superstructures on the upper levels.

fa267ca5-ac22-47b3-9e3e-50f74deb31cb.Text: Judging by the tell-tale signs on and around the body, somebody gutted the scout and made him dance while trying to hold in his own entrails.

31cd932a-414a-43c3-a6e7-77df524bd4fa.Text: "It is likely that part of the hive is still powered by the cooling geothermal node. But I wouldn't count on finding survivors here."

f77143e1-792f-4bac-9d4c-35f143fb72ee.Text: "Confirmed. The augurs have detected an active geothermal power source."

447cb24f-50d9-442a-a97a-2bab84549a71.Text: "Are the shadows of the departed messing with my mind? I can see lights in the womb of the frozen world!"

c2b8b7eb-0acb-4cc9-b58f-c43417e0a18d.Text: "Look, shereen! There are lights glowing deep in the hive. Is it possible someone survived the catastrophe?"

5e0e5dbb-e524-4acf-81d8-1b9159f0d29a.Text: "May your bloodline be blessed until the end of time, Heavenly Envoy!"

1ff64dc9-633e-4d5e-9a4a-73c529e2bcd5.Text: "Begone, Nightmares! Burn in His punishing flame!"

eb66778f-668f-427f-bc81-7ad902f9e7b5.Text: "Your pathetic god will not help you, mon-keigh!"

1a25e9fc-1d19-4921-b445-ff63ec9e4bc6.Text: "You are in too much of a rush. Hold back your wrath and make the next prey suffer longer."

40989096-aba1-4fd4-a346-dbe31eb9b271.Text: "Forgive me, Albris. You saved me from the Nightmares, but I never was worthy of your kindness."

911804e2-f64a-444e-89be-cc93b938e896.Text: "Vir, is that you? God-Emperor have mercy, they put... they put that... THING on his head!"

3d5ce25b-a0ec-4560-a4e1-3e1a79faae4e.Text: "What the... Albris? What have they done to you?"

3a9a119c-7f3b-4de7-a94a-d4357b754483.Text: "Be quiet, Kleon, what are you talking about? The God-Emperor has sent us His envoy. We are going to make it, you hear?"

0f8bdf3f-913d-4584-a4d8-a8eb80afee9a.Text: Once solemn processions praising the Emperor walked across this bridge, but now it stands as the only testament to the area's former greatness.

1ab8bcf4-a9f3-4ada-9acf-65078a8b4ba6.Text: The words on the old poster are barely discernible: "He who does work, does ea—"

acbb8e57-8ed0-45b3-83a1-f990e8c8b377.Text: It might be reached with proper climbing equipment.

8ded0435-d017-41a0-b949-37f4293acc67.Text: "Oh no, Kleon... May the Fiery Messenger guide your soul to the halls of the God-Emperor..."

63c519a6-f458-46e6-8ecb-53ecb618c11b.Text: An augmented old man with insane eyes stares out at you from the poster. The caption below reads: "WANTED for idolatry."

3083ad70-9d73-447f-8270-cd0be94f68c1.Text: "WARNING! Harbouring traitors to the Imperium is punishable by death!"

436ad591-cdc2-4228-9395-2a27055a478f.Text: "Toil to the citizens, promethium to the stars!"

2c5433be-fb9f-4093-9706-2ae9d39b34a4.Text: Somebody scribbled a few words on top of the propaganda poster: "Levl 5A, Blok C. Cheep."

2eeaa803-edc0-489a-8019-5c7305680768.Text: "Freeloading is a straight route to the underhive."

887c7618-bad2-43c0-9449-8137f27859a4.Text: The xenos acquired a human generator and powered a section of the street so that any wandering survivors would be drawn to the light like moths.

fa0a9da1-61a7-4aa5-8987-4aa36e2e95be.Text: "I thought... I was done for... But the Emperor protects!"

301bc9c5-d332-42ea-b02d-bc54daf65c03.Text: "I'll head on, then. The Emperor protects!"

94f809f8-9593-4439-8513-e6c24b949e96.Text: The scout's body is still warm, but it shows no vital signs.

81067d07-75e9-4e01-b27e-10b15acd486d.Text: The scout's body is covered with dozens of tiny wounds that have already started to fester.

943117c7-a11f-44e4-9799-ff07769aa0d2.Text: "We need to move forward, but... there's likely to be an ambush. Please, go carefully..."

df98cfeb-9c41-4a32-951b-ec2b44da3b2e.Text: "Yeah? I'm here. I haven't gone anywhere..."

134b9aa2-a53f-4c78-a0bd-708e3d1a448e.Text: "Skardas, you went too far! The mon-keigh will be off to his ancestors now!"

0b826a8e-252a-4eaa-a76e-26cc333ac607.Text: "I granted him two dozen non-lethal wounds, so you will have time to enjoy his suffering!"

a2cddf45-eaab-4413-9237-71aadf11d9ff.Text: "No... NO! Kill me already... Just end it, I beg you!"

8456c2e7-91f0-4b0b-9689-4ae4d2d3886f.Text: "May the faithful partake of the Emperor's immortality and find solace in His crimson embrace. Spread the word, brothers and sisters — the feast has begun!"

26674b67-74a9-4854-af86-62dc886d32d3.Text: The fresh snow is marred with footprints and a long trail of blood.

a6b01db9-f69d-4c68-9495-27c3544e3c74.Text: The snow clearly shows the trail of a body being dragged and reveals several pairs of footprints. Judging by their shape, none of them belong to a human.

45788850-f83c-4bc6-bbb6-4dec9f50053c.Text: Frozen in a huddled pose, the corpse stares at his icy, shattered limbs in disbelief.

805df769-a9a2-4896-9599-a54b4bf577fb.Text: Somebody tried to make a sculpture by draping a body with artfully frozen intestines but gave up halfway.

afc6b433-b0d0-46a6-bb5d-20a71b40883f.Text: A shapeless mass of crooked bodies sticks up in the middle of the camp, bound by a single spiked chain.

1b49f4a1-c17e-4c24-ba39-27d6985186db.Text: The box is filled with rubbish and frozen bones. Letters, decrees, and torn propaganda posters have been used as kindling.

7dd454e2-55f3-4e90-8583-b77968fb5356.Text: A faded inscription states the gate leads to the temple quarter, but the rusted mechanisms and seals on the locks reveal this entrance hasn't seen any use for many years.

d8529927-7dd4-4094-bfbf-302c948361f5.Text: Depending on the climate within the hive, warm or cold air is circulating within the pipes.

b4cdee27-144d-4c5f-86fa-a19443fdc645.Text: The pipe is emitting a barely noticeable heat signature, which leads further into the hive.

d8d56b6c-6430-4c31-8103-c4da11e70e98.Text: "There you are! I was afraid those monsters had got you. Look over there!"

b89343a2-b47f-46aa-a830-951f48b9511a.Text: "Hey, hey, don't go there! This way!"

c7f89fa1-22b7-45b4-9522-f11c07588ca8.Text: "Emperor save us! Where are you going?"

fba6f568-e693-44fa-bfe8-c02bc13b68d3.Text:
"My most precious Victa!
Sister Bregenda from the Orders Famulous whom you introduced to us is a real sweetheart! You must have noticed how many new guests started showing up at our soirees after that darling stayed at our estate. Jeoffroi is extremely fond of Bregenda, too — our heir has finally started showing an interest in something other than the exact sciences and has taken a liking to theology!
May the Emperor bless your insightful wisdom.
P.S. Come visit us today after the eighth klaxon, my husband will be at the club with his friends.
Forever yours, I.L."

8d56a042-cba1-4e31-9682-f7949442e128.Text:
"Rejoice, for in ten turns the Immortal Emperor will bestow His grace upon us and embrace our brothers and sisters so they can serve Him on Holy Terra!
The Celestial Burial ceremony will commence at dawn, in full accordance with tradition. Remember to pay the fee so your loved ones do not have to wait for the next cycle before they can join the Emperor.
Additionally, on this holy day the number of work hours will be reduced by one so the blessed denizens may take part in the solemn march from the Emperor's Spire to the Spire of Stillness."

668b0e10-8e1c-4174-a36d-e7689113252d.Text:
"The world turned out to be completely different from what I had imagined. My distant home of Alvi-ar-Tani, though swathed in black sands, is nowhere as hot as this stone cocoon. Not even the force field can shield us from the embrace of the local star! In daylight hours, staying close to the outer walls would be insane — a person would either suffer heat stroke or simply be boiled alive. The surface does not have the time to cool after darkness comes, so living here is like being encased in a steam barrel at all times. Throne be praised, the upper city has cooling zones that provide welcome relief! Despite the predatory prices and absolute disdain the locals have shown toward my quickly lightening purse, the glacial gardens remain my favourite place to relax.
---
Despite all its austerity and piousness, the hive is crawling with lawbreakers — I have been robbed thrice and almost killed twice this cycle alone! It makes procuring obscura ridiculously simple. Not that I have tried it, of course, but the crooks on every corner literally shove it into my face.
---
Another thing that surprised me is the city's incredible work shifts — the planet turns on its axis once every 38 hours, and 25 of those are usually spent in the manufactorums. Another 5 to 7 hours are dedicated to mandatory public service like cleaning streets, attending sermons, and patrolling floors, so only 6 remain for rest and domestic chores.
---
I must have been blessed by the Emperor when Justice Greyberghen invited me to stay at her truly magnificent estate! The view from the top of the Spire of Glory is fantastically beautiful. Up here, one cannot hear the din of the overflowing streets or smell the stench of refuse. And yet the taller the spire, the crueller the star's scalding kisses become. Justice Greyberghen calls it a divine blessing. I am not going to argue and will just quietly take my leave."

9e11d92a-a698-4062-9760-4249cf064336.Text: "Notes on Life in the Hive" by L.G., Historian and Traveller

c15d1ace-ff28-4933-a01a-29509591e065.Text:
"Jervas, may the Immortal Emperor guard you with His grace!
I have done everything I possibly could. Grab Angette and Jolanta and flee this cursed world as soon as possible! I left the writ of passage and some savings in our secret cache at the Spire of Pride under one of the wanted posters. May the Master of Mankind bless Acticus for his assistance. I still have unfinished business at the department, so we will reunite on Footfall.
Your loving brother, Lamprecht von Grotten"

d86640e2-3096-4e32-bf5d-36b08995db14.Text: A gold pendant with a silver inscription: "To my darling S. from D." Inside are hand-painted portraits of an elderly man, his wife, and daughter.

c95b0b3a-f782-4cd1-9e85-9939e6e1f619.Text:
Playing the recording produces quiet whispering, rustling of clothes, noise from the footsteps of dozens of feet, and someone's deep, measured breathing. When the silence settles, a sonorous male voice delivers the opening sermon of the liturgy:
"- Glory to the Divine Creator that sits on the Golden Throne of Holy Terra, whose will created sky and earth, light and darkness, stars and galaxies.
- Glory!
- Glory to the Guardian of Humanity who shields us from the terrors of the void, the madness of heretics, and the malice of the enemies of the Imperium! For we are created in the God-Emperor's image to carry His light, and His will, and His word into the galaxy both in life and after our passing.
- Glory!
- Glory to the Lord of Humanity whose envoys, women and men of courage and virtue, guide our sons and daughters to the only path that is righteous.
- Glory!
- May your souls weep and lament your ignorance of how to love our God-Emperor, the Warden of Light, more than He loves each and every one of us. Cry, pray, repent, and beg for forgiveness, for your love is no love at all. Your great love is infinitely small. And even the most profound love of His most loyal servants is infinitesimally less than the love that the Master of Mankind gives us in return.
- Glory to the Immortal One!
- Now let us talk about how we can love the Emperor's flesh and spirit even more, and how to come closer to His divine immortality in life and after we die."
Rustling and whispering are heard again, and the recording ends.

a7ef7a44-bd46-4fc1-bfec-2730eb7c0c90.Text: A sturdy metal cable that can easily hold the weight of a man in combat armour.

a9117c5f-d65f-4b32-ba65-30f04b00efd8.Text:
"Writ of Passage 90XV55L
Issued to: Pulchrumus Family
Arriving at: Footfall
Signed: Harbourmaster Maleficus Acticus"

35480b3e-e085-4b2b-b013-c2231c8fdcde.Text: [Take the parasite's body to the voidship]

e8b30079-554e-4041-af61-bfaab266aae3.Text: {n}A strange meaty growth the size of a human head is clinging to the skull and neck of... a man? The emaciated face — at least, the part of it you can see from under the pulsating alien flesh — bears no emotion, and the cracked lips hang slackly open.{/n}

973bff19-dcff-4679-9ed6-df59a711dbaa.Text: "This xenoform is classified in the Magos Biologis catalogues as Medusa Malifica. It is an empathic parasite."

bfcb94f5-19d3-4372-a852-70b9083ea368.Text: {n}Pain. Fury. Sadness. Despair. Pleasure. Fury. Sadness. Pain. Despair. Pleasure. Pain. Despair. Fury. Sadness. Pleasure... The feelings wash over you, making your heart beat a mad tattoo, choking your breath, and turning your vision black... Scalding tears streak down your cheeks, crystallising in the frosty air. You can't take it anymore. You are exhausted. Home. You want to go home.{/n}

e509ed5d-13da-4362-ad2f-5929a3b4345f.Text: "Heavenly Envoy, today you saved the lives of the damned who even their own star and the Immortal One chose to rebuke! How is this not a miracle? May fortune always be as gracious to you as you have been to His lowly servants."

2f812559-ae42-474e-ad17-24f2edabe36e.Text: {n}Vir mumbles something unintelligible, wiping the instantly freezing tears from his weathered cheeks.{/n} "—give...Forgive me, Albris..."

91f9031f-5f04-4b30-a344-476e013f2719.Text: "Spare him, I am begging you with all that is still left — spare my friend!"

510d2e3f-cea5-48e8-84d8-c862995ffdba.Text: {n}The thing before you is a xenoparasite that Magi Biologis call medusae. These creatures latch onto the brain and nervous system of their victim with dozens of tendrils and assume control over the body of the host. Their nature is yet to be fully studied, but the prevailing hypothesis claims that medusae are capable of absorbing strong feelings and emotions from their environment, although the questions of how and why are still a matter of debate.{/n}

e156d80a-e15a-4dea-86ff-f09d5286e079.Text: {n}The disgusting, turgid body is clinging to its host with dozens of tendrils. The man is motionless — you are not even sure he is alive in the true sense of the word — and the creature likewise shows no interest either in you or its surroundings.{/n}

6619358e-76c7-4893-bf8d-802434a81134.Text: {n}The parasite appears to be tightly and permanently attached to the victim's head... or so it seems. You spot a certain pattern in the location of the tendrils on the host's body. Making a few incisions here... and there... would probably allow you to separate the creature from its unfortunate bearer.{/n}

8ab3cd26-8d85-4eaa-9121-0979a6e28627.Text: {n}A thickset man of average height is standing before you. His head, some of his face, and the back of his neck are hidden under the meaty flesh of the parasite, whose pulsing tendrils have grown into the victim's body.{/n}

5e6486af-f22f-478e-a0dc-a04478dbdbdd.Text: {n}After a few well-placed cuts, the parasite's meaty body convulses, making the thin tendrils go soft and unable to maintain their grasp. You dislodge them one after the other, and soon the parasite releases its host of its own volition. The creature twitches its appendages in its death throes and goes limp in your hands. The man's body collapses onto the snow.{/n}

827c5363-4bc6-4ef1-9826-22f063203755.Text: {n}You circle the parasite for a few long minutes, trying to detach the rooted tendrils. You are trying to be careful, but at some point the host twitches and starts struggling violently. Your hand slips... The parasite releases the man's body, but both fall over dead.{/n}

ff28ea68-c73d-4246-846f-ff3763777124.Text: {n}The parasite is dead and is of no further interest — you let go, and the small body hits the ice with a sickly squelch.{/n}

c8d73722-61d4-4cfd-826b-4c35a307cab6.Text: {n}You contact the shuttle crew and give the order to transport the survivor to the voidship.{/n}

913b05c0-9aca-4a79-82c7-09231bb869fa.Text: {n}Even dead, the parasite is too valuable to leave on the dying world. The small lifeless body will be delivered to your ship, where it will serve as a specimen for experiments or a trophy.{/n}

3dfbce97-24de-471f-89aa-23a28800c83e.Text: {n}The long silence is interrupted by the groans of the rescued man at your feet. He is still alive.{/n}

007e07c1-a25b-424d-8e8a-14d01f3e091b.Text: "In all that is holy on Terra... You von Valancius poke your noses into every mysterious abomination you encounter — it must run in the blood! Why didn't I choose a quiet post away from the front lines, quartermaster of a magnetic coil warehouse or some such thing?" {n}Abelard, who has been agitatedly rifling through equipment, looks up with a start.{/n} "Lord Captain, you have returned to us! And without the need for a medikit. A lucky escape!"

c1dd84d0-d02b-4a22-95d6-60329567b58a.Text: "It feeds on human victims, which makes it a predator. I suggest that this is all we need to know to make the rational decision to destroy the creature."

980976b1-cc87-4b0e-94b3-a593a2022053.Text: "Shereen, are you still with us?" {n}Jae anxiously waves her augmented hand in front of your face, then lets out a breath when she sees the awareness return to your eyes.{/n} "One of those things turned a whole squad of my guys mad once. Good lads they were too, loyal. Thanks be to the Exalted One for protecting you from the same fate!"

d16a6a08-c4df-48ac-b065-62dbaadedc26.Text: "A little Drukhari beast coveted by a select circle of people. You should see how sophisticated folks fight to win these things at secret auctions — they'll use anything to get one: gold, bribes, swords. And I suppose it is funny when the proud new owner of the creature isn't usually seen again after the auction. But just think of all the gold and securities you could squeeze out of someone for one of these things..."

a517c99d-0633-4261-b53a-757ed0915084.Text: "A-albris... Can you hear me? ALBRIS!" {n}Vir grabs his sagging shoulders with the stubs of his fingers, but the creature does not move.{/n} "I am begging you, Heavenly Envoy, do not kill him! Have mercy! This is Albris, just Albris..."

8c4a0f61-e464-4129-9d74-81f0be7b4558.Text: "I do not know... I don't know! This thing is a Nightmare, I have seen the likes of it before! Bound in chains, listlessly watching... They always accompanied their masters during the gory executions. They just stood there and stared... Always stared. But why is this creature riding Albris now? How... how do we take it off?"

0c31209e-d0c6-469d-bd44-770789a7091b.Text: {n}The creature stands motionless as if you are not even there.{/n}

71ed4bf5-7324-4ee4-8c09-6d79b708ee8d.Text: {n}Frantic with grief, the man pulls out a barely sharpened piece of rusty pipe and pleadingly offers it to you.{/n} "I... c-cannot do it. I do not have either the strength or the fingers. But you are blessed by Him, the sovereign of all the stars in the sky. So you can do it for me."

a791d4fc-68af-4deb-bf48-d710719e3a15.Text: "Albris, you are saved, you are saved..." {n}The man kneels next to the limp body, clutching the man's motionless hand with his finger stubs.{/n} "Still warm..."

dce4dc92-b10d-491a-888c-33aa065b0d99.Text: "Anything but this! I am begging you, no!"

0a25f61a-a4d1-4787-b341-f6bbf2abf014.Text: {n}Pasqal's voice synthesiser crackles in agitation, and a needle glints on a mechadendrite.{/n} "Neural overload detected. Protocol to render emergency aid activated."

ed5d67d8-dc1d-4d33-a3c5-c1cffe2720f2.Text: {n}The unusual pair — a man with an ugly parasite clinging to his head — remain where you left them.{/n}

b1e7a4f7-9a39-4f1e-b40f-3b0b83dbefee.Text: {n}The medusae is obediently hovering in the air. It is entirely unclear whether the creature realises its predicament. You decide to...{/n}

95e279e5-7db9-4557-9e26-dea8c57eb68b.Text: "L-Lord Captain? Are you all right? Forgive me... I didn't even have the chance to warn you..." {n}Idira looks frightened.{/n} "There was a bang, a howl, a blur of colour... a second before that creature... Oh, let's just get rid of it!"

33366a2a-63c1-4566-a646-25c91bef06b3.Text: "{name}, do not look!" {n}Yrliet's shout is the last thing you hear before darkness flows into your mind.{/n}

e300fb70-b109-404d-9fcc-60e7f766655f.Text: {n}Your vision grows dim and you have a sinking feeling in your chest. But you are still alive and are trying to open your eyes. Dark figures dash about in the twisting shadows cast by the fire. One of them is standing in front of you, casually tossing something from one hand to the other... You slowly turn your stiff neck and dumbly stare at the stump where your right arm used to be. The figure comes closer, tosses a frozen hand onto the ground, and breaks off the tip of your nose with a little crunch. Why haven't you died with the others? Why are you still alive?{/n}

41e81764-9a2a-46d3-98cc-efc86f2e1916.Text: "This creature is not bound by any natural law. Its origins lie outside {g|Encyclopedia:Realspace}realspace{/g}. However..." {n}The sampling tool on one of Pasqal's mechadendrites jolts to life.{/n} "It can be studied using the methods of realspace."

aaed12f6-9018-4438-947c-d123d05d3af4.Text: {n}Frightened, cold, hurt... and aching to flee. But these feelings are not yours. You concentrate your will to shrug off the unbidden emotions, and the compulsion recedes — you once again see a man caught in the clutches of a disgusting parasite. The illusion is gone, but inexplicable anxiety still lingers in your soul like the aftermath of a particularly bad nightmare.{/n}

c48619d5-a022-46a4-a872-84e97367049b.Text: "I once was witness to the vivisection of such a creature. These parasites are called Drukhari medusae. As long as its current host lives, a medusae has no need to attack and dominate your mind. If its host dies, be careful not to let it latch onto your head."

38c94779-f9b3-4366-a596-9bfd73798f0a.Text: "I once was witness to the vivisection of such a creature. These parasites are called Drukhari medusae. As long as its current host lives, a medusae has no need to attack and dominate your mind. If its host dies, be careful not to let it latch onto your head."

00a0bd80-39d3-42cf-b40b-c6c508dd7941.Text: "A medusae... A harvester of torment and nightmares. My dark cousins use these creatures to amass emotions and experiences, which they then feed on."

e62be69c-38a4-4620-96f7-c07f4b72604b.Text: "A medusae... The driver of nightmares and torment. My dark cousins use these creatures to amass emotions and experiences, which they then feed on."

ed037006-38ea-420b-ac81-f2f2b0ad9da0.Text: "By the Emperor, just burn this monster already!"

43809e09-f4a9-49cd-ae97-2f5c9350d2ef.Text: "I will never understand humans. You may call your folly an act of courage, or curiosity, or daring. I call it madness."

1390b452-6fd1-4636-9a4f-d94fb20ac8ed.Text: "You were fortunate to regain your senses, Rogue Trader. No one in my memory ever did."

52342fbf-04e1-4739-a853-8ef2fbbdded1.Text: "Rogue Trader, you are alive! I... I wasn't sure I would be able to give you back the colours..."

6c1faa17-2c2b-490f-8048-b468bba30ccd.Text: "Lord Captain, are you out of your mind? How could you be so reckless!.. Emperor be praised, you came back to us..."

5f110cca-9989-4266-af11-e867ee050617.Text: "You have me quite a fright, shereen! Never do it again. But since you already did... What was it like? The fruit, I mean?"

59188245-a5d2-4fd4-a422-d5cd9f8cd026.Text: "May the world be cleansed of heresy, tempered in sacred flame..."

f64c9b7d-c7a9-47ce-8055-fb1b239db178.Text: The processed human remains were dumped to the lower levels — the cold got to them faster than decomposition.

ea363ee8-24b7-41f7-830d-4b13ee9e5485.Text: "Why was I sent to freeze my arse off in the coldest part of the hive?"

351b0585-3475-4ca9-b209-559a30c1c1f8.Text: "I'm so sick of the Crimson Prophet! Can't eat without permission, can't smash a skull without saying a prayer first!"

c9085b65-cd08-4f73-9078-4128ca299686.Text: "And here comes the food! Straight into our arms!"

e5a5a9a3-4e9c-49ab-9ece-834b519859e2.Text: "Tear them to pieces! In His name!"

82c559b3-1b88-4627-ac5e-44a076ede17c.Text: "Quit wasting time, scum. The Prophet is summoning us — it is time to glorify the Blood God!"

2fdf68eb-caec-465b-ad00-7593173fc8d7.Text: Each skull is embellished with a carved prayer to the Crimson Emperor.

7c276d30-0ae6-4f2d-bf53-f9a99e235abe.Text: The madmen used invaluable promethium to maintain optimum temperature.

60a4aae2-453b-4d61-b568-d3e589e2ae0e.Text: The ranged weapon had been piled into a dusty container — nobody used it for a long time.

8e218427-c983-4963-a6fb-f203eeb3ca16.Text: The improvised bunks are soaked with sweat, blood and other foul-smelling liquids.

a05d5830-7d09-46f4-9c14-a4833e4a6a9f.Text: A fresh portion of meat to nourish the insatiable Emperor.

9a871e2c-639c-4985-998e-16675e922334.Text: The broken-down cold room serves as a warehouse for raw flesh.

b7afdfce-c942-4815-8d97-ca64c813030d.Text: "I hope our traps work today. I love gnawing on the sweet little bones of the Children of Redemption — mmm!"

e3c61152-d89a-44b6-a10c-b2e0ac000f4f.Text: "I heard strange noises on the way here. I hope the Nightmares aren't coming our way."

395295b0-5d74-4d0e-bae7-dae50a5c5b35.Text: "I love dead meat — so pliable, mmm, and soft..."

d6368ca3-5534-4ef7-ae96-d7c85ecbb9c9.Text: "Shut up, fool! Hear that? Let's get out of here, someone's coming!"

0442985a-516c-480b-9be9-b2d8f4c1307a.Text: "Shut up and slice before the Nightmares come to investigate the screaming!"

783bb1d5-9aea-44b9-afa6-b9c962fde7c6.Text: "Over here, quick! Before the Nightmares come to investigate the noise!"

f8a348f3-c691-4dd4-8ef0-0acb911bfefd.Text: Not long ago the hive denizens queued here to receive their allowance of corpse starch — a tasteless but highly nourishing ration.

e8e208bf-89fa-433c-b01a-b887fb80ab95.Text: Aside from the artfully cut tendons and gouged eyes, there is a deep puncture in the corpse's thigh left by a thick needle.

84a5b405-b539-46e3-bd9c-c6c434d69dee.Text: There are no visible injuries on the body, which is unusual considering the circumstances.

316fe1b4-6046-4930-ba90-1165d57302b4.Text: There are several greenish punctures barely visible in the neck and stomach areas.

7bb08b4d-e02f-4248-9a13-2893a0544d6b.Text: The poor man's blood resembles a sieve — a hundred of small hooks burrowed into the flesh and tormented the victim until it bled out.

a85191b1-bc92-426d-ae5f-73e0fcc6398c.Text: A hundred of small hooks burrowed into the flesh and tormented the victim until it bled out. Surprisingly, the wounds are still weeping brownish liquid with a barely noticeable amethyst hue and an exotic fragrance.

ebdf8b3e-9cf3-4fa5-b262-42857a32aef8.Text: The Emperor is slapped together from bones and chunks of red meat. The sanguine Protector silently looks down at his subjects while tongues of flame lick at his charred flesh.

3d56a55f-6ecc-4703-9a17-42a341c5bc04.Text: The butcher's block is covered with dried blood and human viscera.

e6efe19d-691a-4945-8ee0-6601d9466df2.Text: The woman's body is chopped into pieces and laid into boxes labelled 'for servants', 'for hunters', 'for the rest'."

909cbac0-70ce-422d-93b2-e90c228d61be.Text: The trap is built to ensure the victim experiences pain while staying alive. It is obviously a Drukhari contraption.

1fbf84bf-b887-4cf4-8b7d-71ffd566c6e0.Text: The pipes fell into disrepair a long time ago. The tracks indicate the dwellers used them as tunnels to move between different levels of the hive.

1f12f7cb-aed6-49d9-98a0-bfe8f243983b.Text: It doesn't work. The wiring must have been cut.

98f7e8a8-d2f7-49a5-adf8-9f9c8d4d77fa.Text: "Yes! Accept our sacrifice, o Immortal One! May the feast begin."

dadd02df-633c-4e74-8a8b-aac1021e082f.Text: "Hey, it's not fair! The prophet will get all the juicy bits again!"

994dbfe0-b2bc-4c76-8af1-68b20dbcc92f.Text: "Good. Another hotbed of heresy has been cleansed."

9d21f023-9375-48f1-ab3e-294360348453.Text: "Oh, they were screaming, screaming so very loudly, but they fell silent now. What? Did nobody hear them?"

02629914-fae3-44c3-9770-307588b50a71.Text: "Ew-w... What a stench. I hope the Exalted One saw us rid the world of his evil twin."

95d481b8-558b-4861-80eb-dc6e50d9e037.Text: "I know I saw a medusae here before these heretics attacked us!"

1c0e8c9b-c77d-44d7-ae21-e7641465fa85.Text: "Keir-ta-oon — the watcher — vanished into the dark corridors. Let us hope our paths never cross again."

a91deb58-38f6-401f-9012-6932588b502a.Text: "Where did the beast that watched the poor lad suffer go?"

2109a3f3-ca09-42b0-a756-5782433103b3.Text: "Suspicious... But this creature does not appear to be aggressive."

44022d38-21d5-4be4-b5a3-c07f4f9a9a5e.Text: This room used to be a feeding bay, but now the tables are covered with gnawed corpses instead of proper food.

72c3e12f-38c3-4290-b36b-afbe6b13c709.Text: The bodies are mangled — some have been burned, others were chopped into pieces. Some wounds were inflicted posthumously.

53c883b6-588d-4b7c-a92a-b980de8d2d5a.Text: "Come closer, child! Feast on the flesh of the Immortal to receive the sacrament of the Crimson brothers and sisters. May you carry out His will by spilling blood, your own and sacrificial!"

f3d367d8-6329-4bd8-a9f5-63816802b493.Text: "Vig, ain't you a lucky one! You left to die but came back and brought help instead! The Elders will surely reward you."

d2125193-8f90-492e-b8ec-44c0f5eb08af.Text: "Are you... The survivors too? Please wait a little, I will bring the Wise Ones. It is they who guide us and decide our fate."

e63f79cd-6359-4df6-ada8-65435c14d7d1.Text: "Buddy, I bet my last ration on you and won! I will be stuffing myself full later tonight."

8a209eda-a145-41b5-a8a2-46c88c30a66d.Text: "There you are, {mf|master|mistress}! The shelter is real close — straight down this corridor."

60c7a5e7-898e-4a2d-a556-7a5945e218d3.Text: The bodies were gutted and picked clean in some places. There are jagged scratches on some of the bones — somebody sloppily carved out entire chunks of flesh from the bodies.

0815f134-6b94-4fb6-8741-efb04e0d7e7f.Text: Judging by the traces, the improvised barricade was broken though from the other side.

a8ae6d39-3c3e-47be-81c6-22f44ebfb88e.Text: Somebody has already swept the warehouse clean — only the boxes with dry combat rations remain.

2930baa7-54e9-48a0-9256-84bf400f54a3.Text: "Behold, brothers and sisters, here comes fresh meat! Premium grade, straight into our arms!"

24bc5a31-72af-4611-a878-c1e85c3418b5.Text: "Lord of the Galaxy has absolved us! The heavenly envoys came down from the stars to save us!"

8c066747-1134-48ca-b59d-634b39b6a04f.Text: "You... had best speak to the elders."

c8623467-8c63-4532-b409-47b353087d6b.Text: "Why have the envoys from the stars abandoned us? Will this nightmare ever end?"

eb8ef800-9299-4437-a939-6b393a540427.Text: "We're staying here? As we should be. Atoning for our wrongs until our last breath — that is our lot."

4c6f0d80-9bf9-499c-a89a-076a6323217f.Text: "W-will they really send us up there to extract promethium? I would rather die here and now..."

8947a1a3-dd6d-4c32-aa2e-92552e798bbb.Text: "The elder went down to the bunger to deliver the joyous news to the Children of Redemption! It will not be long before we cast off the icy shackles of Santiel's Pride!"

6f88b9b1-5dfc-4470-812b-7702e90967f3.Text: "All hail the heavenly envoys, our gracious saviours!"

cf4c7eb8-333a-439b-95a6-d8419563b351.Text: "Emperor heard our prayers! We will soon depart this forsaken world!"

9501f927-4117-4b04-b4c0-3b5df4e4deac.Text: There are hundreds, if not thousands survivors huddled behind the door.

7b8fc798-2526-41b0-8376-2fa2a0822b01.Text: The fortifications are makeshift and are unlikely to survive a coordinated assault.

309e94e9-484a-4305-92e7-fb3a01db4985.Text: An old robe has caught the edge of the platform.

8d714bce-e53c-4940-94b3-3cb139ea9768.Text: Somebody is throwing down slashed pieces of clothing. Many are covered in scarlet stains.

6ffb2b90-74bd-498c-8f51-a5c75c81794b.Text: "What? How did you get here?.. Not a step more, in the name of the Messenger!"

17f6fe48-4999-42c4-8616-20cbdf5380fb.Text: "Wait, brother! Look, they too are the survivors! I will call the wise ones, let the elders decide the newcomers' fate."

402f9848-7e1f-48fd-b663-3f0c17ce0a9e.Text: Hot steam was distributed through pipes from a geothermal pillar in the substation, providing the hive with energy and heat.

d14d8170-c7c4-42cc-8b31-fd6fcdbc8ccf.Text: The walls are covered in bloody palm prints.

44047a34-6925-4a58-aab7-407304fa35dd.Text: "Glory to Crimson Immortality! Flesh of His flesh!"

26377fbd-afb1-405a-8a6b-8a54016be242.Text: "This bhugar has not seen one of the machines for a while. Find it!"

ad25af6e-f18a-4aa9-9ab1-8202eba791f5.Text: "It will be done, berthra-in-kha'a. This bhugar will now proceed with the next experiment."

e7746a98-bbfe-43a7-8b6d-8bdf9cf7f799.Text: "Ber-taa-shal! Who dares interfere with this bhugar's work? Exterminate!"

36aad0f4-a86f-462a-8659-b3826a3b5dea.Text: There are artfully moulded body parts floating in the hissing slurry — just as nightmarish as the ones the wandering constructs had.

047c0020-34a2-4fea-9530-7c505e8c74fa.Text: The xenos have repurposed this butchering table for their own needs and experiments.

db4aec30-cf77-4e74-b5f5-f78a4386ad18.Text: Transparent slime coats the inside of the flask. Whatever it held was released only recently.

603c5f42-dd39-4cd1-b05f-38f5370a3ca4.Text: Biological components slowly dissolve in the basin under the influence of unknown liquids.

d42ee780-85e6-4f45-8ab3-cf80c7bd358e.Text: The flasks are tightly stoppered and labelled with unfamiliar symbols. The purpose of the components within can only be guessed at.

e8332c3e-2a4f-4345-862b-fb5fbe2dd71c.Text: These people were alive not long ago — their warm blood keeps slowly draining into the imbedded pipes.

222b8407-2f9c-49e2-9177-6dbb513458e9.Text: "Will you be able to get to the shelter on your own?"

c3aae4f5-a842-4fc2-9767-9df8fa1f4275.Text: "I am glad I arrived just in time."

92a67a2b-10de-46c6-a119-fbfa475c3a22.Text: "Oh, survivors! I did not even notice you were here."

4c528dc5-23ee-4668-a532-7da75effd8d8.Text: "Get away from me, vermin! It was not my intention to rescue you, it just so happened I was nearby."

885759a5-9703-48d2-9baa-7b4abe5f6693.Text: "Abelard, under no circumstances will I speak to this rabble."

2efa8a03-88b7-4665-bd26-d99724c8661d.Text: "The Emperor protects us all. I am but a humble instrument of His will."

ed0ad635-ade5-49b3-80c0-919babd9a51f.Text: "Tell me how to reach your shelter."

ddcdd9be-caaf-46e5-983a-cb24f1459998.Text: "They're... d-dead? You're sure? What about us, then? A-are we alive?" {n}The sobbing creature before you is closer to a skin-wrapped skeleton than a man, emaciated, bruised, and pale as death.{/n} "E-Emperor be praised for not abandoning us..."

4b0ef163-97f5-4b9b-8a43-896ac0673050.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, please forgive this oaf! Had it not been for you, these madmen would have eaten us alive! Or used us as parts for their monstrous statue! Or..." {n}The red-haired woman stops chattering and lets out a loud sigh.{/n}

2e727656-ac9f-4a91-8af0-7bb761e33c9a.Text: "The h-hive's passageways are like a maze. Some paths will lead you nowhere, while others might offer a shortcut if you restore the power and open the right doors."

451aa858-848b-4a8f-9764-accf7199bb86.Text: "And remember — it isn't just the Nightmares prowling in the dark that makes the passageways dangerous, they are also full of insidious traps! So many good men and women have died solely because they didn't keep their eyes peeled... May the Emperor's light welcome their souls."

f49d052f-6fec-49a0-a7de-17b618d6e6d5.Text: "And... and... keep away from the feeding bay! They say a furious Nightmare is roaming the area. Many of us have died trying to stop it — not one of them came back! Not a single soul did, you h-hear?"

875daaeb-b480-4784-b07b-89f25ccf3d35.Text: "There are a couple in the section that's frozen over, but I'm afraid there is nothing useful left. Personal caches, though? You'll find them all over the place, and most of their owners are long gone."

08b86c07-84c9-4f01-a111-5672eec61bf8.Text: "And so are we! We are so very, very glad, {mf|master|mistress}!"

77922f62-76b3-4f35-90ce-ff09d526df19.Text: "Uh..." {n}The woman awkwardly scratches the back of her head.{/n} "Yes, of course. Forgive my stupidity, {mf|master|mistress}."

c5f5f298-447e-4fdf-9be0-f01589cbf280.Text: "Collect yourselves, commoners! {name} von Valancius, the Rogue Trader {mf|himself|herself} is standing before you! Now prove that your lives were worth saving."

db6c0f06-f2b5-4188-8729-734df3a121c9.Text: "O-of course, of course! We are already leaving. May the Emperor light your path, {mf|master|mistress}!"

ecae0c04-6aa8-453b-9b9e-c6dfbeb20f7e.Text: "Back into the dark corridors, to the Nightmares and lurking crimson beasts?" {n}The woman gazes hesitantly at the exit.{/n} "Of course, it will be as you say. We'll leave as soon as we catch our breath."

750c23a1-517a-4b28-9538-ce218ec839e9.Text: {n}The survivors listen to you, gaping in admiration.{/n}

f8369457-eb6b-49d3-8a0b-64d134211b7c.Text: "You k-know, I just remembered something! The mad geezer, that false prophet of theirs, kept disappearing into the small chamber behind the statue. I have no idea what they keep inside, but nobody other than him dared to go in there!"

56695a5e-fab0-458f-8566-db3616d95c94.Text: "W-wait, {mf|master|mistress}, I just remembered something! The mad geezer, that false prophet of theirs, kept disappearing into the small chamber behind the statue. I have no idea what they keep inside, but nobody other than him dared to peek in there!"

3ee88062-4881-4524-b026-9bbb7557c09a.Text: "I do not know how lowborn commoners such as ourselves can possibly thank you. We scouts are simple people... Our possessions are long gone, but we know the bowels of the hive like the back of our hand. Maybe we could share some useful information?"

0b1f373d-9947-4b19-ad46-40254d0e97f5.Text: "After you leave this vile lair, try to reach the geothermal node. It will be hard to miss — there are four massive pistons pumping what's left of the hot air from the planet's core. From there, keep moving toward the icebound area of the hive. After you hit the wall, turn left and go up the stairs. The Children of Redemption are huddling behind a secluded door, they are the few survivors who have not yet lost their minds in this forsaken place."

cd372050-9b88-4a0c-ae71-3fb62512b1b5.Text: "That's it! We can tell where you definitely mustn't go. Or we can explain how to get to our shelter."

dfa1d1a3-7abd-44e6-8386-06da11c8662b.Text: "It would be a good idea to loot these cadavers, too. The crimson degenerates hoard stuff, precious and useless alike. Now that you've killed them, it would be a shame to let all those things go to waste."

5d5e6df2-03f1-4858-9873-ef5c5dcf586f.Text: "Thank you again for delivering us from harm, your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. We will forever remember your kindness! Or, well, until we die, anyway. Safe travels!"

956836b2-5dff-4c8a-a559-a161553bae5e.Text: "Shut up, you lout! It was this highborn {mf|lord|lady} who saved you, not the Emperor!"

7cea4e2a-2906-418e-af38-8d4df99e2c2d.Text: "There's also a shortcut. Leave the lair and go straight. There will be a ruined bridge on the left-hand side, jump onto it and you will find yourself near the hidden entrance to the shelter."

43c8c58f-6334-47c7-93ef-92b6a4a97286.Text: "The Nightmares drag their victims deeper into the hive, but we are not desperate or crazy enough to risk following them all the way in... I don't know where exactly their lair is, but if you leave this place and keep going right, skipping all turns, you are bound to run into one of their patrols. As for what happens next... Only the Emperor can help you."

b0dc470b-f6e9-45e9-9134-62238ec4445d.Text: "D-don't you worry about us, {mf|master|mistress}. We'll just catch our breath and move on. The shadows will hide us from the Nightmares. The shadows and... just a tiny bit of luck."

d6ec5170-4dff-4f24-932e-28214a3a3c97.Text: [Take a risk and proceed with the examination of the xenoconstruct]

9baf9f0a-ffa7-4e35-b6a5-62a22659d433.Text: {n}Hoping the last blow was just the thing lashing out in its death throes, you resume studying the construct.{/n}

fa6ee627-60cd-4aa2-b006-f1c7df2e46b2.Text: {n}Pasqal is looking at the abominable tech with a mixture of disgust and... greedy curiosity. Without tearing his eyes away from the beast, he produces devices with narrow saws, test probes and analysers from under his robe and carefully inserts them into the claws of his mechadendrites. The last thing to emerge is a small melta charge.{/n}

1c946162-aa25-4701-93c0-bd4ef61c2c1d.Text: {n}Planting the explosives takes some time. Eventually your hand slips, and the timer goes off before you are ready for the explosion...{/n}

f8ecd4cf-05a4-4981-ad34-00a40772531d.Text: [Destroy the heretic machine with a melta blast]

967ce9db-c5f0-415c-91cb-456819d23325.Text: [Examine the signs of damage on the frame]

fe2e406b-5223-4593-aab9-2328d4ebb5d5.Text: {n}Before you is a disgusting construct, a twisted nightmare made real by a fevered genius. An amalgam of rotting flesh and corroded metal is halfway buried under the rubble. The thing is motionless, but a dull green pus is still oozing from its swollen wounds.{/n}

8815c8c1-dd32-4958-b9e6-baa0d6e33ce8.Text: {n}You notice a spasm in the construct's organic limb just in time to dodge its lighting fast blow. The serrated blade whooshes less than an inch from your neck and drops to the floor with a heavy clang. The manipulators in the machine's underbelly give a furious screech, its frame twitches convulsively — and the construct becomes dormant once more.{/n}

d456ecc4-52ec-4e26-9d02-7e310fd96225.Text: {n}The terrifying construct is motionless — the heavy debris has firmly pinned the machine to a cold floor. And yet a single look at the disgusting thing is enough to make your skin crawl.{/n}

de922375-c7a1-46e6-a00b-a5389d76a67a.Text: {n}Heinrix knits his brow at the smuggler's words but says nothing.{/n}

82efb6e3-7fe9-470c-9238-62dd13aae0e1.Text: {n}The massive ceiling beams and slabs are firmly pressing the machine to the ground, having crushed most of the antennae, hoses and reservoirs covering its frame. The marks left by bullets and chainswords are obvious on its armour plates — it does not look like these shots and blows inflicted much damage. However, the construct's tail and underbelly are in considerably worse shape after the explosion tore the armour away and exposed them to the elements.{/n}

3068ed6d-07bd-48f8-8653-b2bd44379d3a.Text: {n}The unfamiliar xenomaterial glistens with a metallic sheen. The construct's body and limbs are a patchwork of stitched flesh that inconceivably transitions to mechanical components, as if organic tissue and metal were somehow fused to make one whole.{/n}

1033961f-e36c-4f5b-80f8-3925ce44383e.Text: {n}The construct's front manipulators were replaced with a massive sword and a mechanic palm. Both limbs are embellished with hooked barbs — doubtlessly to inflict additional suffering to the victim. The machine's armoured plates at the other join to create a prehensile scorpion-like tail with a pair of unknown projectile weapons where one would expect to find a stinger.{/n}

63feb55d-dda4-429a-9097-408108ab737d.Text: {n}You discover the construct's weak spot and carefully cult away pieces of flesh melded with metal. it takes you a while to deposit the samples into secure containers with separated bunches of cable, manipulators and certain gadgets of particular interest.{/n}

967cd7b5-fc3c-4456-8814-b88f3709414e.Text: {n}You take a step closer to examine the crazy construct, but one of the free limbs twitches — and rushes straight at you!{/n}

3d7bac21-a72f-4aa7-9366-e0c17b8b987c.Text: {n}The gruesome tool of the enemies of Mankind remains dangerous even in this condition, so you decide to take no chances. A good charge of promethium explosives won't leave a single trace of this heresy.{/n}

c44aafa3-02dd-45b9-821d-c6d819d1f6df.Text: {n}You barely notice a flash of metal before the terrible impact comes. The massive limb that lunged at you drops to the floor with a heavy clang. The manipulators in the machine's underbelly give a furious screech, its frame twitches convulsively — and the construct becomes dormant once more.{/n}

a16be6d1-e89b-42a4-95ef-fea2d422e0f5.Text: {n}Anxiety makes you feel hot, with acrid sweat eating away at your eyes. When the plasma cutter gets to the place where metal fuses with living flesh, your hand slips, crudely severing the accessible part of the construct and a few reservoirs with oily liquid that immediately splashes everywhere. You gather the intact samples, tear away several manipulators and put everything into a container, hoping these research materials will be enough.{/n}
