b14820d6-825a-4943-a68b-75cb6426399c.Text: {n}Your attempts to separate the reservoirs from the frame remain futile until you push a lever under the armour plates. The vessels empty themselves with a loud click, letting the murky ooze drain into the construct via a series of pipes.{/n}

f9d74333-688d-41d8-b112-defafe09583f.Text: {n}Santiel's Pride lower levels are freezing, but anxiety makes you feel hot. Acrid sweat is eating away at your eyes until the exhausting procedure at last comes to an end and you seal the samples from the unusual Pain Engine in a secure container.{/n}

b37aaabb-5abb-4b61-8bea-b719304f74bc.Text: {n}No matter how long you study the Pain Engine, the reason for its breakdown eludes you.{/n}

8fca603f-29bf-43f7-beaa-fd3bcfc28c09.Text: {n}The massive plates overlap and join to form a long armour-piercing tail, curved like a scorpion's. It boasts a pair of long-range projectile weapons where one would expect to find a stinger.{/n}

39a3b956-ad78-4b79-b7c5-a747632d1656.Text: {n}The machine's armoured frame is covered with spikes and reservoirs — some of them are broken, and you see suspicious sanguineous liquid frozen between shards. The armour plates hide several rows of manipulators, razor-sharp scalpels and anti-gravity generators. The latter have fused into the engine's flesh and allow the construct to eerily hover above ground in search of victims.{/n}

27690480-0185-4fb3-8d02-37c8086721e4.Text: {n}The nightmarish construct remains motionless in the dim light of the corridor.{/n}

76d3a26b-a820-4a5d-b1e0-c64b9bca85bf.Text: "Your power of observation is commendable, servant of the Throned God. I also feel the otherworldly powers changed the creation of my grim cousins."

d164317b-bf1f-4243-bcb3-b6c550570172.Text: {n}You find several loose holds and joints. A little effort, and the reservoirs with suspicious grim murky liquid give way with a click, easily separating from the frame.{/n}

303a9f5c-a8ff-4c72-91ed-e90196df4ab8.Text: {n}Cassia's frail body is shivering with exertion:{/n} "{name}, you are awake! Praise the Emperor! You have been swept up by a tempest of colours and nightmares, a maelstrom of emotions plunging toward abyss... But I showed you the way upward, toward us all." {n}Cassia takes a shuddering breath, her gaze drifting out of focus.{/n} "The effort cost me dearly, {name}. Please do not subject yourself to such danger ever again."

1ba439c3-70d6-466c-87dc-71170bcf07a5.Text: {n}You bring the parasite's appendage close to your face and sense an unusual smell, attractive and repulsive at the same time. The fruit feels ripe under your fingers...{/n}

49702c7d-3180-457b-a511-7d8e84d7d1c5.Text: {n}The dead body of the host is twitching convulsively, but the creature does not seem to be in a hurry to let it go. The parasite's meaty body is covered with strange swollen growths that vaguely resemble succulent fruit. You haven't noticed them before.{/n}

93045d62-cee8-44fe-8da8-9b7da5d4a637.Text: "Ber-taa-shal, stupid mon-keigh!" {n}Yrliet rushes to you and knocks the xenofruit out of your hand.{/n}

72b5eff2-6101-4955-b05f-415f606ef0fe.Text: {n}You forcefully squeeze your hand and the appendage busts with a squelching sound, splattering reddish and yellow liquid everywhere. A pungent sickly sweet stench permeates the air, and all of your attempts to wash it off remain futile.{/n}

ae5a61bb-1293-45f8-8492-a9e709796719.Text: {n}You carefully place the appendage into a reinforced container, trying not to damage its organic surface. The fruit continues to pulsate softly — it looks like it may be stored in such matter a bit longer.{/n}

9d12c1ac-4ddb-4270-bdf3-7b9aaf6bde64.Text: {n}You come closer and reach to separate the parasite from the body of its host, but the creature feels something is wrong...{/n}

ad7f176a-e7c3-428f-9d24-a3a7ae7657bd.Text: {n}Sister Argenta rushes forward.{/n} "You will thank me later!"

a5f2929f-3b91-4467-9258-bee1af7d968d.Text: "O-o-oh, shereen, no-no-no, I know this look and it seldom bodes well! Just toss away this rubbish and let's scram. Sounds like a plan, hm?"

2ea4a107-a52e-41f2-a04a-97e64f33c3eb.Text: "The Dark Ones partake of such fruit to revel in the pleasure from pain and suffering it contains. Mon-keigh minds are not open and flexible enough to survive such an experience, however."

5665e099-7ba8-49e7-aef2-d8b80caf3708.Text: {n}You shake off the compulsion and push the object away from your face.{/n}

f93d8f84-dd0b-4902-be5f-7aecc7d3f92c.Text: "{name}!" {n}How many infinities had passed before you heard this voice? It rings louder and louder in your head, growing ever more urgent.{/n} "{name}!" {n}But what is... a head? And what is a {name}? Colourful shadows slip into the void and drive back the darkness. The yellow ones fill you with warmth, the blue ones grant tranquillity, the red ones give life to a strange feeling in your chest... And you open your eyes.{/n}

ba67bc6e-393a-4190-8518-f18253b615f2.Text: {n}The parasite's slimy flesh melts on your tongue... The taste buds start going insane — a thousand of tastes merge into one that no human language can describe. You salivate, yearning for more... Another piece! A pleasant warmth spreads through your body, making your limbs comfortably numb. The entire world shrivels into a single grain of sand, and then... Bursts into a maelstrom of colours you have never seen before!{/n}

7c9bc85c-d865-40b2-8038-e82e76b197e7.Text: {n}The creature stays affixed to its host, wrapping its vile tendrils around his brain and vertebrae. The parasite's meaty body is covered with strange swollen growths that vaguely resemble succulent fruit. You haven't noticed them before.{/n}

9efbf670-644d-41e3-8327-5c40b6f8c4fc.Text: {n}The growth makes a squelching sound as it separates from the creature's little body. The place where it used to be quickly fills with new flesh as if the tuber wasn't there. The fruit pulses in your hands like a small bearing heart.{/n}

11f2d05e-cc56-4484-8ca2-2966af539105.Text: "Lord Captain, what are you even thinking!?"

18ad2b83-19c8-400d-a121-c6236ae4fd8e.Text: "Rogue Trader, by the Emperor... What are you doing? Take this filth away from your face."

bbafb5c3-564f-4658-b767-dae8d67219f2.Text: {n}You retreat to a respectable distance, the creature hesitates for a few seconds and shuffles away into the lightless corridors.{/n}

f76cf856-55e7-4660-abe0-d8f3062c2190.Text: {n}But the very next second a never-ending nightmare engulfs you. You survive the agony of your own death time and again, drowning in the desire to kill, maim, purify... One time after another, unable to stop — forevermore.{/n}

0973d0a4-37e6-42d6-b070-cbad93f42967.Text: "I have no idea who you are, but it looks like you need this planet more than I do. Let us negotiate a compensation."

afcb9b00-f8c0-48c8-b904-ad21aa6fa418.Text: "I am Rogue Trader {name} von Valancius, {mf|master|mistress} of Santiel's Pride and the sovereign of all souls that are bound to this world. Identify yourself!"

1d801fd9-b27c-4712-89e0-ee804a180165.Text: "Who are you? What is this laboratory?"

68fc5dff-6ad6-450f-adee-32b0e0f3483e.Text: "What breeding program are you talking about?"

f128fcd7-4f60-4f3f-b995-1ccba6e8a9db.Text: "Whoever you are and wherever you may be... I swear by the Throne, xenofilth, I will find you. I will make you rue what happened on Santiel's Pride!"

c10dc130-8e86-459e-be97-238dbc339b91.Text: "If 'Farkir' was the freak I recently dispatched, I am afraid you will not be able to talk to him."

6d1df688-4e6f-4c4d-adf6-f134755a3e05.Text: "I am here to put an end to this madness and to redeem the survivors."

1cdddf3e-6acd-4ac3-81e4-45bf00c52bc6.Text: "I have grown tired of you. I am taking my leave."

765d6bc4-2b08-4a3b-9b2c-da6d1c991e70.Text: "Why steal the star? Was it for some sick experiment you have been conducting here?!"

494b9ae7-5ff3-4ee1-9e08-360ba41ca49f.Text: "Was it you who stole the local sun?"

22ee78e2-2feb-4cbe-b9f0-0dcc57a49cd6.Text: "How are you doing this? How are you making this corpse speak with your voice?"

dd2ad44a-9b2b-4d23-a051-e698f860eaaf.Text: "I am not going to explain myself to a corpse!"

4674a474-5248-464d-834e-9278024967af.Text: "Maintaining routine communication is a mundane task that even Farkir-level servants are capable of, and yet it fascinates one of your kind? A pitiful testament to your primitivism, mon-keigh."

6f7b885f-f805-430f-ad6f-c963146c206e.Text: "This statement is false. The subject is clearly categorised as blasphemous, but the Explorator's creed demands I reject the commandment "know no evil, see no corruption". Unless the subject exhibits dangerous behaviour, it is to be studied."

6ef18a58-c2b0-4c46-a3b8-a0b0417f78e1.Text: {n}Pasqal's mechadendrites reach toward the strange corpse as if by themselves.{/n} "Identify yourself. Are you an operator or an interface?"

e0428343-bdef-4b3a-97e4-0276f1d4d69e.Text: {n}The dead man cocks his head as if he heard something unusual.{/n} "You are a deviation from the norm — the assembled data reveals your kind is not simply prone to venerating deceased individuals, it built an entire social construct based on this particular belief."

e440be68-3529-447d-be6e-466775aea118.Text: {n}The dead man is snapping his jaw with the methodicalness of jammed mechanism. When he speaks again, his voice drops to a contented whisper.{/n} "Excellent, excellent... The next stage. The experiment may be continued, if only partially."

0a48d913-2dc5-4cea-842c-373f955c54ac.Text: {n}The dead man's face twists — not in a grimace but in a painful muscle spasm.{/n} "Hmm. A claim for property fights. It matches the expectations of a species at the lower stages of development."

9f115181-e633-45dd-9d23-6eb7630f60fd.Text: {n}The dead man remains silent for a few seconds — and then continues in the same measured tone, obviously not paying attention to your reaction.{/n} "I suppose Farkir is dead. A regrettable loss of tools and, most likely, collected samples. Having said that... Tell me, specimen — what is your designated function?"

6f196b5a-f062-403b-b10d-8d60c0428a9a.Text: {n}The head drops to the floor and body twitches convulsively. The severed trachea reveals wires and pipes, one of them spewing black tar-like liquid. After a moment the corpse's seizures stop and he lies still, this time dead for good.{/n}

6bc03f9f-680b-45af-a3c8-958388396e6a.Text: "I can see you, specimen. Farkir preserved Subject Eighty Six's retinas just for this occasion". {n}Despite these words, the dead man is not looking at you — he is staring blankly into space right in front of him.{/n}

d6f7f699-3ee4-46ce-a1b0-3832600a4fbd.Text: {n}The corpse hesitates, and then his face twists into the mockery of a monstrous smile. The long dead man emits a hissing giggle.{/n} "This is precious! What an entertaining example of a primitive hierarchical system!"

9ea2c16d-70bf-45ea-8a44-5008ad83ebc6.Text: {n}The dead man remains silent for a while.{/n} "This is not what I asked you, specimen. A diminished intelligence, even for your species... Concentrate."

40144eec-655f-4089-bced-abaf0dcc476d.Text: "Knowing this will impede your designated function, needlessly complicating a simple mind's system of motivation. Execute your program, Subject Eighty Seven."

623d5a4a-d3c5-45da-9cf7-96dd1af4337f.Text: {n}The dead man's throat produces several clicks.{/n} "The injection process was terminated prematurely, thus interrupting the procedure." {n}The corpse falls silent for a few moments.{/n} "However, this is not the end just yet. Tell me your designated function, specimen."

31555faf-e881-4b7a-882c-f02ccfa6856b.Text: "Collectivity. Following hierarchy. Correcting behaviour in accordance with contributed notions of 'common good'. I expect the standard cognitive pattern of your species will manifest in the total sum of your upcoming actions."

8e0886e8-161d-4ad3-a196-82e4a6af278b.Text: "'We' are a concept prevalent among species lacking higher cognitive function and compensating for its absence with pack behaviour. If using the word 'you' was an attempt to determine whether this action was performed by members of a single species... Then the answer is positive. Execute the program now that I have satisfied your curiosity."

0c0b0542-e1af-4ba4-a9ce-e812d1539c3e.Text: "The logic is flawed. I took advantage of a convenient opportunity that arose from the extraction of the star." {n}The dead man hisses and crunches his face in a grotesque parody of displeasure.{/n} "Are you satisfied with the answer, Subject Eighty Seven? Then proceed with the program. I have nearly exhausted my repertoire of subject encouragement that does not involve chemical stimuli."

869a7b12-3182-438f-b7c7-63e345f46a75.Text: "Specimen... I will call you Subject Eighty Seven... You have interfered with a process the purpose of which you cannot understand. My means of restoring control and maintaining the rate of subject injection are limited. However, the setback at the current stage is insignificant. You may proceed in accordance with your natural breeding program. What matters is that your further actions produce practical result."

7bfbc8f7-9b4c-4125-b8a5-9c055484b827.Text: {n}The dead man pulls his cracked lips back in a grisly smile, revealing two rows of rotten teeth.{/n} "I am counting on it, Subject Eighty Seven, I am counting on you leaving this planet after you execute your program. If aggression provides a sufficient motivation toward this goal, then I welcome it."

5eec0791-72d8-403a-a119-dee51024b646.Text: {n}The dry lips part and start moving with a barely audible rustle. Along with the words a strange cracking noise comes from the dead man's throat, resembling the sound of tearing fabric. Upon hearing the low eldritch voice your Elucidator wakes up.{/n} "Kardha ma nae... You are not Farkir."

0d3dd7f2-de2c-4eb8-b2c2-792c0ac72b46.Text: "Excellent, Subject Eighty Seven". {n}The dead man leans forward, pulling the skin and sinew where they meet with metal.{/n} "And remember, mon-keigh, I am counting on your diligence."

63fcd4b6-053b-443c-9c8c-58e896912d06.Text: "What is this..." {n}Cassia's eyes grow wide, and you feel your body tremble in time with her fluttering heartbeat.{/n} "Vile, twisted, alien... Dead colours are pouring from the lips of this wretch, but their master is not here... How is this even possible?"

bc1608d0-e430-49bd-bd27-b3654ce2f140.Text: "The cognitive attributes of this unit are remarkable. It thinks and expresses itself in an unusual way... objectively and concretely. I hypothesise that we have discovered a xeno-analogue to an enlightened tech-artisan."

88d945fc-b898-44bf-bf19-cf43389b1058.Text: "How do you not consider it an abominable blasphemy? Your similarity alone is a spit on your faith."

4a7eb75d-9081-438b-b94f-231eada460a5.Text: {n}The dead man's voice rings with peculiar mockery.{/n} "And what about yourself? Not that you know the answer, specimen."

47550e1b-09a8-4677-af9b-904d38cabc69.Text: {n}The dead man's throat produces an already familiar crackle.{/n} "Out of the question. Lack of practical specialisation. Frustrating absence of tools. Specimens like you are only acceptable as study samples and sources for biological compounds, not servants."

528d312f-310e-4f25-8f59-77d2a39ca391.Text: {n}The man appears fused to the machine behind his back: the edges of his skin have turned blue where it seamlessly melds into a metal unlike anything you have seen before, and his flesh is pierced with dozens of needles, pipes and tubes of bubbling liquid. When you approach, the emaciated human body jerks into motion: the head rises as if attached to an invisible puppeteer's string. Grey skin, lifeless sunken eyes, flesh barely clinging to the protruding bones — before you is a dead man who nevertheless continues to move.{/n}

be0322df-355c-4ad9-9ddc-09067dd0fe1c.Text: "What an atrocious way to greet your {mf|lord|lady} and {mf|master|mistress}! Seneschal, deal with this rabble!"

81b70dbf-b660-4a77-98c9-42b5c1c84591.Text: "I don't believe a single word that comes out of your mouth."

a27ef42b-5f13-4740-9ae4-508dc8a0d6b5.Text: "Who is here?" {n}A thin woman turns to the sound of your footsteps. Her lips are quivering and her gaze wanders. She is tightly clutching a bloody knife in a three-fingered hand.{/n}

56078c0e-9ead-467e-bb8d-cc5e5ffe8525.Text: "Already met... So this is not providence? A mere accident?.." {n}The woman looks disappointed.{/n} "Then... Will you take the lost Ingrid home?"

c64d34f3-4d93-47f3-8c63-d9c700f9a259.Text: {n}The woman nervously twitches her head, trying to keep her face away from you. Her clothes, shoes and weapon are covered in fresh blood.{/n}

10af8f70-6b4f-4c07-8559-c41bbfa32ae1.Text: {n}The woman's wandering gaze suddenly fixes on you.{/n} "Perish in His crimson flame!"

6d28ca0f-3440-44a5-a344-7b5ede85340f.Text: "The Warden of Light measures his trials fairly. Mine is to forever wander in the twilight even if the fire of Ascension is blazing before me."

f9f7a42a-21e5-408b-97fb-2779c704ac75.Text: {n}The scout nods in agreement.{/n} "In a world ravaged by darkness and shackled by ice, you can trust only yourself and the Emperor. And if the Emperor wanted him to die, who am I to defy the Exalted One?"

abf48fde-6845-4bad-b3c5-9b5376137382.Text: {n}The woman's gaze is wandering about your figure but cannot focus. Her clothes are stained by dark red blotches, both old and recent, and the frostbitten hands are covered with rags and bandages. The bag at her feet is bulging with supplies and a stubber barrel is sticking out of it at an awkward angle.{/n}

f13f3079-3f37-47e4-a2c1-345d57850e1a.Text: "It will be done, Lord Captain... Hey!" {n}Abelard takes a step toward the woman.{/n} "Who are you and where are the rest of the survivors? Your planet has been visited by a Rogue Trader, the true owner of this world — who among you shall answer before {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship}?"

bf631156-286a-4043-a86a-25ea41a9a885.Text: "Rogue... Trader? Could you be the ones who wander among the lights in the sky? If so, the elders... The elders will answer. I could take you to them. Past the horrors that lurk in the shadows of this place."

930260ca-5c61-4634-95c1-61990b38bb22.Text: {n}Abelard nods pensively.{/n} "Lord Captain, did you hear that? The poor woman mentioned elders. This is a good sign. Perhaps the survivors managed to preserve at least some resemblance of hierarchy. All that remains is to find them among the rubble."

4a3b35fe-886b-4f03-99a2-f2358c424a7c.Text: {n}It is difficult to say whether the survivor lies or is telling the truth. The corpse at her feet is relatively fresh, and the traces on the body could be caused not just by a knife but by any slashing weapon.{/n}

e01d6fcd-130e-4f9a-aa40-42b8efca9deb.Text: "Your words fill the hive's hallways with slate-grey smoke. I cannot see the truth through it — only the dark intentions of your soul."

3c49a3d3-8667-491b-8ce6-1e5a1bb7f1f6.Text: {n}Judging by the traces left on the body and by rigor mortis, the man perished a short time ago. There are fresh marks on his arms, legs and chest — narrow, deep, bloodless. Some were inflicted posthumously.{/n}

ef336334-a849-49e9-b1d5-d92d9b844c63.Text: "Did this man die by your hand?"

c873cef7-995b-4edb-b8c2-21aac2187c56.Text: {n}A hoarse, sickly voice spits out one word after another:{/n} "Ingrid... An unworthy servant of His, born and raised in the deep bowels of this hive."

c05516b7-3f74-400f-bf77-17496a8ea19a.Text: "I drew the short straw. Went to look for water and medicine for brothers and sisters of mine, but found more — found you! Perhaps..." {n}The woman turns pensive and starts uncomfortably swaying from side to side.{/n} "...such was His divine will? I must take you, yes... Take you to the shelter! The elders. They will explain everything. I just have to show you the way..."

5b78dfb9-80f0-4981-9758-216d0f9556cd.Text: {n}The woman turns her head but doesn't even look at the body.{/n} "He did not. The corridors of our blessed polis are overflowing with danger. People die. The dead should rest in peace. This one does not. Which is why I wanted to take him to the shelter."

b1c28737-3c39-4fcb-832b-90eb18409b11.Text: {n}The woman smiles dryly.{/n} "Of course. Praise to the Emperor of all things — and his crimson light!"

236a74bd-5899-45c8-b791-14da93c42b27.Text: {n}She shrugs.{/n} "May He be merciful to you, and light the path in the darkness with his crimson light..."

7d1a3081-1ea2-4863-ab1b-6f046fa99864.Text: "Very well, I will join your feast."

ce28c81b-4ca3-4be6-ad74-b7a5c266486e.Text: "What is going on here? What feast are you talking about?"

29bb897f-44f9-47b4-aac3-f49728d21642.Text: "Woah, the Emperor on a spit! That's not something you see every day."

fde107f0-2a22-4705-8d82-507bcb100d56.Text: "First, you shall kneel, for you are speaking to a Rogue Trader and the {mf|master|mistress} of this world!"

00bb402b-ced8-41b3-bbdc-d8ca4eb8e0cb.Text: "What do you know about the extinguished star?"

2fbd120a-7b24-4f20-9065-e4f50b727d90.Text: "How do you know that it was xenos who attacked Santiel's Pride?"

4a6c85ee-ba86-471b-ae53-1e18bcfeebc0.Text: "The Children of Redemption did warn me you were a swarm of cultists and heretics."

40afc6e1-c3e0-4fdd-873e-3fe604aac55f.Text: "I have many questions about what is going on here."

b765df35-bb24-4526-8fee-6ce0f0c4ceeb.Text: [Attack] "You have perverted the Emperor's faith and succumbed to heresy! I, {name} von Valancius, Rogue Trader and bearer of the sacred Warrant, hereby sentence you to death!"

ed9ad1e4-05c3-4724-a96a-1cb77e4c64fd.Text: "Rejoice, brothers and sisters, for the Immortal One has bestowed a great gift upon us!" {n}The grey-haired old man in crimson robes smiles blissfully as dozens of eyes peer at you, greedily scrutinising you from head to toe.{/n} "Join our feast, wanderers in the dark. The Crimson Hand welcomes all seekers of salvation!"

eb24e022-0c29-4c9f-aab5-7e959415a8d0.Text: {n}The old man ponders this for a moment.{/n} "There may be enough time for me to answer at least some of them."

10c33550-92d6-4860-8e7c-a6b385d6d658.Text: "What azhi bewitched you, shereen? You are not serious, are you?"

e3c420e4-041e-4aad-b9c6-e4aa0604cad4.Text: "Rogue Trader, the sacred Warrant grants you many privileges. But this... I hope it was a tasteless joke, for your own sake."

cdd77889-f160-4301-8c3b-9452a72ce969.Text: "Few beasts would devour one of their own kind, mon-keigh. I did not expect you to be worse than an animal."

c31588a5-d152-484b-aaa2-8cd0fab0fde5.Text: {n}The old man raises his arms, turning to the statue:{/n} "May this feast honour the Immortal One!"

5f9f0d3f-d16f-41f8-abfa-71d21cfecce0.Text: "A-ah!.. It hurts, it hurts!" {n}Cassia covers her eyes, red tears streaming down her cheeks.{/n} "Sanguine thorns of insanity, black chains of despair... This place overflows with thirst and anguish. I cannot... {name}, we must flee!"

4cf0419d-fc8f-4d67-bd9b-5e1f37f504ab.Text: "What on...?" {n}Argenta stares in astonishment at the statue of the bloody Emperor and shouts angrily,{/n} "Heresy! May His righteous flame purify your souls!"

62090700-c666-4e7d-a343-a448dbd96196.Text: "We renounce our names when the Immortal Emperor bestows His divine grace upon the flock. And yet the brothers and sisters call me the Crimson Prophet, for I have borne His word and spoken His will for many cycles. You may address me thus."

f1d2587e-1ccc-4872-8e57-f16500b2e5b1.Text: "Exalted One, deliver us from evil..." {n}Jae makes a holy symbol in the air and reaches for her weapon.{/n}

f9485a74-c656-4784-a75c-33ff12e5e277.Text: "Serving the Immortal One and partaking of His flesh." {n}The old man points at the two new acolytes who have just tasted the bloody sacrifice.{/n} "Only the Emperor's blessing will let us survive the horrors that have befallen Santiel's Pride. The dead star, the depredation by xenos, the biting cold. The Emperor protects us as long as our faith remains strong and our blood sacrifices continue."

129002a2-3edf-4ca4-a19e-c2d578c830f5.Text: "The Crimson Hand serves the Immortal One exactly as He demands. One day I woke up hungering for flesh, for I could no longer eat a crumb of ordinary food. Plain bread tasted like rotten fish, clear water made me retch like poison. I had an epiphany — the Emperor was showing me the way, promising me salvation! The hive had become an icy tomb where only the chosen ones would survive. The ones who received the communion of flesh as I had."

be4922a2-5999-4857-9ea7-fc1aa78d4c6b.Text: "We once called her Nolla, the Emperor's Heavenly Messenger. She was beautiful and merciless, claiming the lives of millions of men working too close to the hive's scalding surface every cycle."

09365c30-566a-4c26-94c7-c4a371431121.Text: "I witnessed her demise with my own eyes, for on that day I was singing praise to the glory of the God-Emperor with other servants of the Ecclesiarchy. At sunset, when Nolla's burning gaze relented and we went to the peak of the temple's spire, a dark green flash tore up the sky, forevermore eclipsing the Messenger."

7beef892-2566-4c98-9885-06de39ca4ff6.Text: "Did you think I would simply ramble on about divine retribution and the Nightmares the Emperor set loose on our world to punish our hubris?" {n}The old man smiles serenely.{/n} "I have seen many things in my lifetime, including the enemies of Humanity. The Emperor would never punish his loyal servants in such a heretical manner. The xenos set upon our world soon after the star was gone, when the cold had already sunk its claws into our cities and hearts."

4e726602-012d-42d3-b098-1ec551d58308.Text: {n}The old man's eyes grow incredibly wide.{/n} "How dare you! Uttering such disrespect for the Immortal One is heresy! There will be punishment! He will smite you in His fury!" {n}Suddenly, the old man stops shrieking and continues in a serene and blissful voice,{/n} "You must show greater reverence."

bdfa48b6-d718-40ca-adf4-308a31f31bce.Text: "A Rogue Trader?" {n}The old man regards you with interest.{/n} "Oh, if only I had foreseen our meeting! I would have prepared a proper welcome."

7b5313f6-aeb2-45b5-baa2-524074a5a9f1.Text: "Like locusts that destroy everything in their path, they vanished just as suddenly, but not before taking countless lives. I was fortunate to have preserved my flock, for the blood tithe we pay to the Immortal One had imbued us with strength that was denied to the others. Not all the xenos left the planet, however. Some of them keep hunting us, but so far I have failed to divine their darker purpose."

a0aa8c79-cb6d-49f3-a7d3-c772d43268fb.Text: "The Children of Redemption are but a remnant of the past, the victims of centuries of misguided faith. Who are the mad ones, I ask you — the fanatics who revere a star and conflate it with a saint, or the loyal servants of the Emperor who have done everything they can to survive and to keep honouring the Immortal One? And besides... the elders are not so different from us, after all."

dd244bac-ed52-4429-a832-2b8e1c980c94.Text: "Global disasters often produce necrophage cults such as this. It is unfortunate what a desperate man can be reduced to after being cut off from the Imperium... But it would be best to set the anthropological observations aside in favour of practical considerations, such as ridding your world of this filth."

9dd74be3-5ff7-4b72-9c03-7e89a4bca2e1.Text: "I am pleased you have accepted my invitation. When the sacrifice welcomes the slaughter and comes to the butcher without fear, its flesh remains juicy and tender until the end."

55257c43-8ac1-4421-8696-93fac5431616.Text: "Indeed. The patience of my brothers and sisters is running thin."

0a11a7f2-6ed0-4df4-b003-9e70d277084b.Text: "Your veneration of the Emperor is somewhat... Unorthodox."

c1cc7540-b913-4795-b94b-4b29d84effc1.Text: "On my ship you are only allowed to feed on the dead members of the crew, my prisoners and one another."

90220f07-68d0-41bf-8f6c-91d8c1f0facd.Text: "I came from the void between the stars to divine the fate of this world. Who are you?"

c49a073d-0684-42ac-bffe-e6306c12b0b3.Text: "What was the planet like before the tragedy?"

b3aa77d8-ce00-48af-bc34-6fe46fe1e679.Text: "You were lying to me all this time!"

ed5bd2b6-7751-45fd-bc0f-31b7c4ea8963.Text: "A dying world is no place for the loyal servants of the Emperor. I will do everything that is in my power."

22b26646-b1f6-4d9e-8391-7ababf904534.Text: "How did Children of Redemption overcome hunger?"

04a86140-e1cc-483d-afd1-6439c9125121.Text: "I will think about it — assuming I am offered something in return."

fa7d7b97-d34d-48e5-9bd0-d0e7e49130f1.Text: "What transgressions are your talking about? Why would the Emperor punish Santiel's pride?"

6ab0b62b-31dc-467a-abfb-85db60ecb44c.Text: "Tell me about Santiel's Pride. What happened to your world?"

9a0370f0-7eac-4ec2-8b96-1c79464e59de.Text: "Gather your people. I am taking you with me."

d4c2590b-9380-4c07-abc5-7210767fb73f.Text: "I found a profane construct lured into trap."

28234f1e-7558-47ab-a6a5-4011fb050124.Text: "I will decide what to do with you later."

2f2aa11c-9ee4-42d9-91b0-55b5c23122cb.Text: "Scourges? Are you talking about the xenos?"

163433da-af7d-4e45-8d1b-e52cf65cee5b.Text: "I ran into madmen gorging themselves on human flesh."

affa19e8-a9f1-4b7f-bea6-586a7b69dbbb.Text: "Why send people to the surface if it is dangerous?"

0f40183f-3391-4f63-8fa3-55bba896e3cb.Text: [Attack] "I punished enemies of Mankind, now it is your turn!"

7ddac4cb-d941-40a3-986d-4ceb57b60b87.Text: "Nightmare Driver is injecting bodies with some kind of essence. Do you know anything about it?"

2b42c12e-5ace-4d15-bb55-468a4c80cfad.Text: [Attack] "I am His punishment that will cleanse this world of taint and heresy!"

4e29eed7-24ee-4f87-b951-4f8116bc72b9.Text: "I am not going to help you. You will stay on this world and atone for your trespasses against Him."

f5b9864e-0bbe-4392-821b-668044e729ac.Text: "We will establish a supply of human flesh from prison worlds. The condemned and the expendable will suit your needs perfectly."

a5d74ae2-6c9d-4694-91ec-ede5757e6520.Text: "I found a pile of bloody rags near the secret entrance to your vault."

23b3ba20-1878-4820-8703-77173acbef3f.Text: "I saw a plundered storehouse in the tunnels. It was swept clean, but the looters left the supply of rations behind."

096b909c-3756-4820-97ae-557e8362d9a5.Text: "I read the notes of the Crimson Hand prophet. He believed that your communities were not that different — what does that mean?"

5495fe23-bbd6-4674-85b3-f87e9d0a4b6d.Text: "Your rations should last for a while longer. Once they run out, you will go to one of the colonies and atone for your misdeeds with labour."

bfbef05c-7ce5-453e-ba95-7f49b9db179c.Text: "I will not sacrifice my crew or resources. You will draw lots and eat your own until every last one of you is gone."

4228e946-9414-45a9-aee6-0e3c987da9c0.Text: "We may be able to find a cure for your peculiar ailment."

e8924b9e-d18d-4a2b-a0e3-67f43f0a2447.Text: "I found a note left by an escaped follower of yours. It says you forced people to do vile things."

5b3b2227-582d-499c-b312-5a10e3f89a34.Text: "I am {name} von Valancius, a Rogue Trader and the master of this world. Introduce yourself to your over{mf|lord|lady}."

d9203de8-bea6-4705-810e-25df05a8a124.Text: "What happened to the promethium you were extracting?"

cf2e1a2a-30e4-4092-b2e2-dd3418a38a7d.Text: "Stay on Santiel's Pride and beg the Emperor for forgiveness."

8c801663-0e77-4139-b511-5cdfbd4f8d42.Text: "Enough with the prayers. The Emperor abandoned you, but I am still here. Do your duty before your saviour and extract the remaining promethium."

2dbc1336-ac1a-4c4a-b55b-3d515389dad0.Text: "Unless you want to die here and now, gather the people you have left and go to extract promethium. Atone in His eyes with sweat and toil."

8fa65bb7-82e0-4d1d-b720-ab4ef7413351.Text: "I am greeted with lies whenever I ask you a question. All this talk about rites, transgressions, and traditions — I do not believe a single word. Speak plainly or I will make you regret this."

b2c3eb17-f1fa-491e-be06-d756248fcfb6.Text: [Attack] "The ramblings of madmen have exhausted my patience."

f8aa9f4b-680a-48f6-a512-26fa6d8562c6.Text: "It is promethium that interests me. Are the extracting manufactorums intact?"

acc106e2-0f27-44fc-8a34-a43ce3f257b5.Text: "You did the right thing. Sometimes one has to make difficult decisions to survive."

77df578e-ca26-4d15-9e38-e178ae9fe071.Text: "Give me one good reason to keep you alive."

ba2a794c-57ef-4fed-954d-74fc2b1cc14f.Text: [Attack] "You will burn for spewing lies and heresy before the Emperor's face!"

39a704a3-7e8e-4af2-9764-7bc2aa1da5db.Text: {n}The woman makes a helpless gesture.{/n} "I... I am not sure, o Heavenly Envoy. The world has been plunged in icy darkness, but the vats... Oh yes, the vats outside the hive should still hold significant reserves!"

22c72b9b-70e4-45b7-a1e5-c37b0991d498.Text: "Our once holy planet became a breeding ground for evil — we were careless and could not see how deeply the Crimson Hand heresy took root in the heats of His loyal servants, blinding their eyes and corrupting hearts."

cd1f2df1-9820-4d71-b64d-f66019141581.Text: "I cannot lie anymore, An-Vido! Not to {mf|him|her}!"

4d97830b-740e-4988-89e3-4997ae765989.Text: "O blessed world, basking in Nolla's fiery embrace! The sons of daughters of Santiel's Pride were renowned for their hard work and piety, ruled over by Supreme Governor Fabris VI Sauerback and a hundred of the wisest men, the Grand Council, who helped him usher the world to prosperity!"

af8ef951-fbdf-415c-919d-c4b5d2fe352c.Text: "May the Emperor forgive me... But I would rather perish fighting for His faith than freeze to death toiling for your avarice!"

accabdf4-94b0-42f1-998b-c04fe51853a1.Text: {n}The elders trade astonished looks and bow their heads, not daring to raise their eyes at you.{/n}

069bab31-dcd4-45d1-b4cc-3dfe4f8158bc.Text: "What does the Heavenly Envoy wish to know?"

2ee80b5f-3999-4563-bbea-e7cf27037d99.Text: "But the Messenger did not return, no matter how many fervent prayers we addressed to her. Without Nolla's scorching embrace, Santiel's Pride plunged into cold and darkness, and then... His Scourges ravaged our world."

2fbd7e04-a14b-43dd-896d-02fd37abf34e.Text: {n}An-Vido does not sound nearly as excited:{/n} "If... If such is your will, we dare not refuse your mercy. But how do we get all Children to the surface? ? The Nightmare Driver is eagerly waiting to punish what remains of us all..."

9a7fe648-5b56-46ed-8bc5-801e1d77e016.Text: "The times are harsh, o Heavenly Envoy. Not only do people succumb to hunger and depredations of the enemies of Mankind, the frost is alien to the denizens of Santiel's Pride and has claimed just as many lives if not more. Which is why we cut away the garments of the deceased so that later we could cleanse them and process in accordance with the needs of the Children of Redemption."

b4345624-2a2b-42e5-aeaf-4b7b5eda329a.Text: "We fled as far as we could, trying to keep close to the geothermal hubs. But the Scourges are treacherous and show no mercy — they stayed at our heels, tormenting us with their hounds that are still lurking in the lightless passages. Beware, o Heavenly Envoy! The few who survived an encounter with them swear these things can suck a soul straight out of a person's body!"

7214540a-302b-4a9b-bb94-2d4fc9c3bc35.Text: "We... Let corruption seep into the hearts of the citizens of Santiel's Pride..." {n}The young man shudders and looks away despite his face being covered by the mask.{/n} "It overtook our brothers and sisters, clouded their mind, twisted the true faith in God-Emperor... And made him punish our world by taking the Fiery Messenger away and dooming the infidels to perish in the icy embrace of the endless night..."

490d0e21-b4c1-4fe9-8a1c-1f1446e4c5b4.Text: {n}Vego-An wants to object, but freezes in indecision. He turns to you, clutching his hands in a begging gesture.{/n}

986784be-dbbd-4118-adbc-586180f998aa.Text: "This is..." {n}Overcome by emotion, the woman grasps the Aquila on her chest.{/n} "We are deeply grateful, o Heavenly Envoy!"

47da4c84-c0d0-4967-a02f-fb05c437a0c8.Text: "Please forgive my insolence, but what is going to happen to us now?"

e079600d-7ad2-4706-9195-e19769891ac1.Text: "So now... You will take us away from here, won't you?"

d68d6f63-1fae-4618-8d53-7c87a597c641.Text: "From now and till the end of our days, we will pray even more fervently to redeem ourselves before Him... And beg Him to grant you a long life and prosperity."

5e41628e-84cd-4529-8163-7178e132f61a.Text: "On the day of the Celestial Burial Nolla, Emperor's Fiery Messenger, was to ascend to its celestial throne and carry the deceased to the holy chambers of Terra where they would serve the Immortal. But on that rueful morning the Messenger abandoned us! She vanished from the planet's augurs! And so the preachers proclaimed we have displeased the Emperor and commanded the world to unite in prayer!"

2c6718b4-0546-4e86-a0f2-971fe9de855e.Text: "How dares he compare our pure faith to his twisted heresy?! We may be are equally helpless before the Nightmares and we use to share the same world... But it does not make us equal! I would sooner find my end in a monster's clutches than call him a brother!"

3d59fa66-d392-4b64-8979-40b1f8e87845.Text: "To die now or to perish in an icy blizzard some time later? You present us with a choice that matches our faults, o Heavenly Envoy. We will serve the Emperor one last time and redeem the transgressions of this world with our hard labour. We were born on this world and we will die here along with it."

c70c1646-9f28-4b3e-9fd5-a77ef92d178a.Text: "We have nothing to say, Heavenly Envoy. We are His loyal children, the followers of light. Such is the truth, immutable and absolute."

b6876b9c-8e3e-482f-972c-2bc44a02dbb6.Text: "N-no... No, don't!" {n}Vego-An buries his face in his hands, clawing at the golden mask. The sobs and moans grow louder until the young man is openly weeping.{/n}

f2d4f753-2f72-44ca-a9e8-0bec824831c1.Text: "Such is the way, child. We are impure, so there is a price we must pay." {n}The woman gently pats the young man on the shoulder.{/n} "Come. Children of Redemption deserve to know what the fate has in store for them."

21aef0cd-229f-4baa-96c7-d62d4b91c7a7.Text: "Horrible Nightmares sent by the Emperor to punish us... A-are you saying one of them is... gone?" {n}The fragile-looking young man shudders.{/n}

447eda08-5126-4ed1-9f80-579cac4b1967.Text: "Your generosity is boundless, Heavenly Envoy. We rejoice that by the Emperor's divine will and your mighty efforts another child of His was safely returned home."

4f618ffe-19dd-4ac7-b83c-b0e9738ac532.Text: "A funeral procession marches through the hive streets chanting prayers that resonate through the entire world as a hymn of mourning. The deceased are brought out to the surface, many of them for the first time in their entire lives. The departed take their places on the ritual slabs where they wait for Fiery Messenger's ascension, Nolla's blessed star that showers the deceased with its fiery kisses and delivers their souls to the Immortal, so they can serve him forevermore."

08b567aa-ac80-48a4-a2a7-89475b98542f.Text: "Each turn the Fiery Messenger would depart her celestial halls. It was under her gaze that we brewed blessed promethium, extracted it from acid and thunder, and let it simmer in titanic vats. Patiently waiting for Nolla to retire, we departed for the manufactorums outside the hive to empty the boiling vats and refine the promethium for the von Valancius protectorate."

38faa65a-6c21-491a-88dc-af8bb2711372.Text: "The heretic believes that since we were born on one world, breathe the same air and look like one another, our minds must be tainted with dark thoughts just like his own. May the Emperor strike me down where I stand if he is speaking the truth!" {n}The young man is brimming with righteous anger, disgust... You sense no deception. And yet you cannot get rid of an vague feeling the kid is not telling you the entire story.{/n}

3719a2fa-87ff-4944-8cc9-5ce7c6c94f86.Text: "A great and holy festival! Each cycle during the turn announced by the prophets all Santiel's Pride subjects prepare their departed for the ceremony. Sometimes a spouse, friend or a parent of the deceased decides to accompany one to the Holy Terra — and if they are judged to be feeble, weak or body or unable to work for the good of the Immortal, they are permitted to take their leave along with the dead."

d58fb3e8-18b8-4faf-a805-1a41b9a99a6c.Text: "...extract and refine promethium. Build manufactories. Repair ships. Kill. Do whatever you say." {n}The elder's words ring with tempered steel.{/n}

f427f7a5-90ff-4477-a0dc-f4deb981648a.Text: {n}The elders of Children of Redemption are whispering among themselves, but as you approach, they quickly fall silent and greet you with a deep bow.{/n}

90eda4ea-90d1-438e-98e2-727cae8f5bb8.Text: {n}Vego-An shakes his head in dismay.{/n} "Danger besets Children of Redemption on every corner. The wandering Nightmares hunt us to wither our bodies and souls, and the thrice-cursed cultists butcher us to stuff their distended stomachs! Thirst, cold and starvation are our constant companions, but we never gave up hope of reaching out to the Imperium. Of contacting at least someone... Which is why we kept sending people to look for working vox-casters and communication centres."

dd60a986-5f47-4e28-bfc4-2f3ae022c516.Text: "We are the denizens of the hive, from its tallest spires to the very lowest maintenance tunnels. You will find all kinds of skilled people among Children of Redemption: actors and medics, solders and manufactory workers... Most of the survivors huddle behind the secure doors of the shelter's workshops and living quarters."

b3e2c674-d9b6-446c-8a6b-d0600c8c4f81.Text: "We do not know where the creature made its lair. But unless you rid Santiel's Pride of this horror..." {n}The breath that is coming from the young man's mask is chocking and ragged.{/n} "Children of Redemption will never atone and abandon the hive — the Nightmares led by the spawn will wither our bodies and souls..."

78110f3e-395e-46ae-bbc1-c2d0effd4c7f.Text: "Spare us, Heavenly Envoy! We are loyal servants of the Imperium and the von Valancius dynasty! We... How could be admit to such a disgusting heresy? We dreaded your wrath, for we are His most devoted servants and realise the terrible price of our downfall!"

8e011d9a-5857-4e7f-bbc9-36f8dc50c0e0.Text: "What?.." {n}The young man shudders and covers his face already hidden behind the mask.{/n} "Are they... desecrating the bodies of the Emperor's fallen children? But why?"

6ae046f7-97e7-4eda-9d52-8e5027c8c61b.Text: "W-we have thousands of people who can... who can..."

4ced7637-1a29-4357-854d-b63eb35d0540.Text: {n}The young man shoots An-Vido a nervous glance, then turns to you and starts talking so quickly he is almost jabbering:{/n} "O Heavenly Envoy, we will answer any question, but first I... I am begging... help us! Take us away from this doomed planet!"

d1122640-8e5b-4685-b1ff-901938b19bee.Text: {n}The shadows of this world's former splendour — two figures in dirty, once opulent mantles bow before you. They both carry heavy Imperial Aquilas on their chests, their faces hidden by smooth expressionless masks whose faded gold is covered in dents, soot and dried blood.{/n}

4170f25b-ce04-44da-b3ed-ccbe7da8ef98.Text: "Vego-An, have you gone mad? Our repentance is to live in this dark tunnels, among visions and nightmares! Our lot is to suffer, how else can we purge ourselves?"

672a1b13-69a8-4a49-8a96-bcde6204eaca.Text: "We do not have anything to thank such a powerful patron with. But still we hope you can make use of our meagre belongings. The scouts keep their most vital possessions in this crate."

392ee7ed-97c6-47b6-afb6-c669eea75871.Text: "We ordered the scouts to look for corpses... Frozen, not too badly decomposed..." {n}The woman meekly lowers her head as if facing a guillotine.{/n} "Cut away their clothes, washed them, prayed for their souls... And then made a stew out of the bones. At some point we did run into a supply warehouse, except... Our bodies rejected proper food. And so we realised we had been cursed — for now we can only draw nourishment from human flesh."

1827d810-8c23-4bba-8d18-6d88bb077031.Text: "I... I... hope you will be lenient, o Heavenly Envoy!" {n}The young man's face is hidden by a mask, but the quavering shoulders and stifled voice give away his despair.{/n}

edf75c4d-5727-4042-8603-4d481734c3f0.Text: "As long as Nightmare Driver leaves, there is no hope for the Children of Redemption." {n}The woman nods to herself, but remembers who is standing before her and continues,{/n} "O Heavenly Envoy, I see that my words are unclear. Allow me to explain, the Divine Scourges brought along Visions and Nightmares — terrible creatures, monsters from prophecy and legend. They take commands from an abomination no less cunning and gruesome... We call it the Driver."

20fc61f6-1570-4f2c-9c3b-97d43c139f4c.Text: {n}The elder takes a step back, covering the young man with her body.{/n} "Fear is nothing, for our faith strong. Death is nothing, for the Emperor shall deliver us..."

37f07d4b-4649-43e6-bf02-70248f5c726c.Text: "In return? Perhaps... We might extract the remaining promethium from the outside vats so it could be lifted into orbit. But I must say... This will not lighten the burden of our misdeeds! Our lot is to suffer and repent. And even... Even if we wanted to leave the hive, there is no way we could reach the promethium vats. A sword is hanging over Children of Redemption, and Nightmare Driver is its name."

251718a8-78c5-4358-81d7-5b27cde3aa0c.Text: "May the golden glow of the Throne shine on you forevermore, o Heavenly Envoy! We will overcome all of our vileness so we do not let you down!"

0a6b2830-ec01-47e8-b27b-6b67a7192b7c.Text: {n}Cassia scrunches up her face as if she has just bitten into a bitter fruit.{/n} "Your subjects are skillfully dyeing their carmine burden of secrets into a golden glow of supplication. An answer without question, a question without answer."

1a88e368-843b-4801-958e-e228d291ab15.Text: "Danax Alaxius, a cardinal from the shrine world Vinibos, described in his works the tendency of illiterate plebeians to twist the teachings of God-Emperor from one world to another. And yet I remember regent Aaronto telling me that Santiel's Pride is one of the most pious planets in the Koronus Expanse. How could your subjects believe in such a gruesome fable, Rogue Trader?"

5b35631b-f97f-434a-a730-ce806577fefb.Text: {n}An-Vido puts a hand on the boy's shoulder and gives an encouraging nod.{/n} "When the darkness came, Nightmares overran our city. They slashed, ripped, tore at our flesh and sucked out our souls... Hundreds of our people perished trying to push back against the monsters. And yet... We managed to destroy at least one of the vile creatures! I will sleep more soundly tonight thanks to our scout's sacrifice."

03c9c7bd-a2d7-43c5-a9cb-e86f8c0b6d76.Text: "The scouts saw him only once — a lumbering giant stitched together from mismatched pieces of flesh, with three twisted limbs, each ending in a tool so unspeakably vile words cannot describe it. There are bone growths bulging from his spine, and profane liquids pump his innards with greenish ooze."

aeb43d34-0e17-48e5-96a3-28a9aed4d903.Text: "How can you turn an entire world into a concrete hive with combs of iron and then marvel at its lifeless splendour? Poisonous skies, toxic flesh of the ground — indeed, your species can only take, wither and destroy."

2677f369-f4da-4733-967d-e906df5748aa.Text: "Cast off your doubt. The mon-keigh is clearly describing the antics of my dark kin."

7e8462f1-8e28-472d-a970-df5e5a0a507a.Text: {n}The young man nods thoughtfully.{/n} "I think... I think they are. Even after Santiel's Pride was plunged into darkness, we kept hearing the groans of the blessed mechanisms and the gurgling of cherished fuel from the open plains near the Hive."

e5537f47-ca98-4b21-b51b-a8e13305e32e.Text: "The Emperor favours us despite all our faults! When we discovered this shelter, its shelves were creaking from the weight of provisions. Water, medicine, devices, tools and weapons are what we are mostly looking for. And besides, scourges and heretics are clever enough to poison the supplies. We prefer to avoid risks as long as there is another way..."

c931303c-e4df-4676-ac2a-cbfe1fdb9242.Text: "But the extracting machines are bound by ice, o Heavenly Envoy. I mean no disrespect, but I am afraid this world is no longer capable of granting you its bounty. Only the promethium that had been refined before the judgement day can be saved. I mean... could be, had the manufactorums not been frozen and the streets were not beset by nightmares."

5ba2d6e7-a656-47ad-8895-fb5a6eb0d9ce.Text: "Y-yes, of course. We understand, o Heavenly Envoy. And will carry our burden to the bitter end."

e86321af-70d4-4337-b169-d850a58e299f.Text: {n}The elder lowers his head in confusion.{/n} "Divine Scourges, o Heavenly Envoy. The nightmares and visions that descended upon the world after Nolla abandoned us. They killed us, and chained us like cattle, and dragged us into darkness... The ones they did not take, they tortured, revived and tortured again. M-my mother..." {n}The boy's voice breaks, and you hear a shuddering sigh from behind the mask.{/n}

a9ad43ea-ae9c-4153-9db6-18289773582e.Text: {n}A quiet moan echoes from under the young man's golden mask.{/n} "I hope... perhaps... you will change your mind."

1b089a30-75d6-4c0a-93fc-31dc32d4902b.Text: "It is not clear? His divine wrath is so powerful He had condemned us to suffer even in death! We did not know this, o Heavenly Envoy. But now... All we can do is beg Him for forgiveness. And repent harder."

cd7dfc0a-099b-4e9e-851a-fb22beca89a4.Text: "May your every step be blessed, o Heavenly Envoy! We will begin preparations immediately and ascend to the surface in one rotation so that we can welcome our new home!"

fae6d377-8750-4f57-ac39-e7381c01ce99.Text: "It will be as you say, o Heavenly Envoy."

f27b283e-3630-447f-a98e-44ff5ec1ffd7.Text: "But what about..." {n}The young man turns to An-Vido and throws up his hands in desperation.{/n}

e805dde8-eba3-4fdf-aa0d-11acd69b1d6a.Text: "I hope... We will manage to solve the issue of our peculiar dietary requirement. We will take some, ahem, rations from Santiel's Pride, but it will not last long."

59611fc2-e344-47ca-91da-847787e7b9b8.Text: {n}An-Vido tensely observes the jubilant young man. You can barely hear her stifled words:{/n} "May the Emperor protect us and forgive us..."

2441d08a-2219-4a2a-aa5a-f03677f15be5.Text: "But why?" {n}Vedo-An cocks his head in genuine surprise.{/n} "Does our beloved Emperor, Guardian of Humanity and Sovereign, not sit in the divine hall of the Holy Terra among the Saints? Do the souls of our departed not serve the Immortal, basking in the golden rays of His unearthly splendour?"

0012d604-f57c-4ae5-bccf-0d72fbe2158f.Text: "Do not lose faith, Vego-An. The Heavenly Envoy has already done too much. We will be able to take care of ourselves in the new land."

8fcbbf2e-f0ef-4e86-817a-54be75da1594.Text: "You rid us of the Nightmares and were kind even though we did not deserve it. As for the Emperor... He abandoned us and doomed us to suffering. Never again will His light grace the sky of our dying world. So be it. We will repay you with our last act of servitude."

434baa36-bbd8-49cf-91f9-f31c71196983.Text: "To fade away in the cold dark or to slowly dissolve in your vessel's maw... We will accept our fate with dignity, o Heavenly Envoy. However sad it may be."

2adbfaf7-dfe5-41ee-a1e9-2c106a9c4882.Text: "Unthinkable! Children of Redemption will never turn away from the God-Emperor, even though he doomed us to eternal suffering!"

88f4d2e3-f027-461f-a35c-408fad6c3246.Text: "We will pray day and night for this mercy, oHeavenly Envoy!"

0fc68afc-2ff0-497a-b032-2b362e12a40a.Text: "Send your cargo ships once every cycle — we will extract as much promethium from the vats as humanly possible, until the world perishes or we do."

0ffd7458-b9ff-47be-8bc3-f8e196d0c31a.Text: "Back in the old days the Emperor's followers were forbidden from picking up a weapon, working for less than twenty klaxons, and most certainly from fighting the others to the death over a loaf of mouldy bread. These crimes had to be atoned for with lengthy prayers. This new world that the Children of Redemption now inhabit... is not fit for every soul. I pray that the Emperor forgives those who fled, for I forgave them a long time ago."

31128be2-5a1f-47ee-b19c-16d59105bfc3.Text: "And the Lord of the Galaxy heard us and showed mercy! And he led the scouts straight into an abandoned chamber, full of supplies. Blessed are those who are strong in faith and stalwart in patience!"

6cd28ebc-c0c7-46e0-a6fe-9129d134a347.Text: "We spent time praying to the Immortal, depriving shunning both food and sleep, sustaining ourselves with nothing but ice crystals..."

5ee3a0c5-c0e8-4a64-91f8-df3b4acd5a54.Text: "O Lord of the Galaxy, Warden of Light and of all that there is, do your loyal servant's eyes deceive her? A stranger walks among Children of Redemption." {n}The tall figure speaks in a tired female voice.{/n} "We dared not hope for His mercy, and yet... Who are you? Did you really come to save us and to absolve us of all wrongs?"

2edb316f-bc2a-4662-aa55-b22c02c49073.Text: "W-we... Have mercy, Heavenly Envoy, w-we are loyal..."

0bced578-db7f-432a-812e-c440507dc0a2.Text: "When darkness fell upon our world and Nolla, the Emperor's Fiery Messenger, fled her celestial palace, almost all venerable clans boarded ark ships to bring help from the void between the stars."

74212be6-53b0-4e61-8a4a-7cb2301f3fe4.Text: "Few left to witness the last few cycles of the dying world. My mother, Vego-An, was among them. It was her who gathered these people and named the most worthy among them the Elders, thus giving Children of Redemption one final chance for salvation. I took her name and her mask after she died — for such is the law of blood."

cf478438-2c33-4de7-ac9e-ec5491d99859.Text: "Everyone is equal before His face — and so every Child atones for their faults before the Emperor. We cast lots, and the ones chosen by Him venture into the labyrinths above to look for supplies... nourishment... and hope. It is in seeking to atone that we find purpose."

bc8fd31a-6a69-44bc-9261-7ccc626f1cc0.Text: "Each cycle we devoted ourselves to Fiery Messenger, begging her to guide the souls of the departed through void to the Golden Throne. Which is why we, Children of Redemption, mourn our final turns on this dying world. We are doomed to wander the void for eternity, unable to reach the Immortal without His guide. And though we commit the bodies of our dead to flame... The fire's heat cannot compare to Nolla's kisses."

f11fdf05-2881-4d81-809b-4109bb9d919d.Text: "Is it... Is it the Heavenly Envoy {mf|himself|herself}, {mf|he|she} who would come as the legends foretold, following the Emperor's will on darkest day to rescue His wayward children?" {n}The young man's voice under the mask is both meek and quavering.{/n}

a5d81a4b-d81b-4f31-90eb-9284fb1f4c13.Text: {n}The female figure twitches slightly and shoots a glance at the other Elder.{/n}

08d40a76-096f-4f23-944c-1aa67ed1e0fe.Text: "I am Vego-An, and this is An-Vido. We are the elders of Children of Redemption, the last sons and daughters of Santiel's Pride. The Lord punished our world by destroying—" {n}The young man chokes on these words.{/n} "—the blasphemers for their transgressions. All we can do is repent and beg Him for lenience..."

1079980e-8048-4357-a364-e46d9098e578.Text: "Silence, fool! You will doom us all!"

a40f1c31-9f0f-4c56-bc31-d3e96ca3371b.Text: "The... The answer remains shrouded in mystery. We tried everything — but since we started feasting upon our own kind, nothing but human flesh satiates our hunger."

26caad85-10bb-4c5f-b2bb-813e50f10415.Text: "And then... And we... We are your loyal subjects, o Heavenly Envoy!"

003baa71-3d12-4b32-9b3e-9ff6080dc61b.Text: {n}The young man's pitiful voice rises to a scream, and Vego-An turns to you.{/n} "They made us! They drove us over the bodies of our loved ones, over the ice, over the shards of our former lives... They locked us up, broke us, starved! An-Vido's children perished in her embrace, and my mother was torn apart by Nightmares! We only wanted to survive! Survived at any cost! And when the food ran out... I swear by His name, we never killed for sustenance!"

893c4352-160b-4d35-943b-bb102ab4596e.Text: "In times of woe those weak in spirit stray from the guiding light to a fire of desperation... We all fled from the biting cold and His punishment, Nightmares and Visions. But when hunger started to drive people insane, some of them—" {n}The elder shoots a quick glance at the young man and meekly continues,{/n} "—some chose to submit to the inner beast instead of entrusting their lives to the Emperor's will."

1ceeab32-5058-4c36-9fd8-b5c9b3bc08de.Text: "This is what happened to our brothers and sisters. We fled the xenos together, shared both food and shelter. But when hunger started to drive people insane, many chose to submit to the inner beast instead of entrusting their lives to the Emperor's will."

11f2d023-5b85-43f9-8874-1a205cb53e80.Text: "The heretics are calling themselves the Crimson Hand — a living embodiment of divine punishment. Despair and hunger twisted the cultists' minds, for they believe they can obtain a mote of His immortality by devouring flesh of His loyal children... Just like they think He sustains his immortality by feasting on their souls."

2a59e6ea-933f-4501-bb2b-a0f90503e8da.Text: {n}The Elders exchange worried glances. The passionless masks no longer hide their trepidation.{/n}

b0ba2620-0f26-4d41-bb6d-d91df39ed965.Text: "Collect your belongings. You will live and serve aboard my vessel."

12b02e40-1c82-4b6e-a77d-b3862a28e49a.Text: "Are you... Are you from the von Valancius dynasty? The great Celestial Steward of Santiel's Pride, the Heavenly Envoy? We spent so many cycles praying for the Emperor to deliver us from ruin, and now you are here!" {n}The meek voice coming from under a precious mask obviously belongs to a very young person.{/n}

92a0211a-8a5e-4dd3-a638-f8b9d3e2ca7d.Text: "Be careful, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! Everyone protect the Rogue Trader!"

d37fc0bb-e81f-4ed4-8dc3-99a085bc0095.Text: The metal box was brutally forced open. Why would the ship's owners break into it if they could simply turn the key?

01b890ce-8d71-462e-b6e2-91487a491578.Text: Land at the source of the transmission.

31b24745-1209-49ca-8956-2b8d734c582e.Text: Scan the ark ship using the augurs.

1e6c939e-24b5-41f9-89c1-23ee4edf3731.Text: The vox operator has intercepted a transmission coming from the planet. The message runs, "With faith in our Emperor-Progenitor, we are broadcasting this to any who may hear. This is Jesevon, an abode of true-believing pilgrims, colonial designation AIII-649-Minoris. As commanded by our Emperor-Progenitor, we, the Church Nourishing, invite any who need help or are in distress to take shelter with us. It matters not whether you are pious people or apostates. Here in Jesevon, we help everyone."

5ed9e21b-5e4a-4e5c-a2da-a62f64d8f6ac.Text: The pre-recorded message is replayed in the vox-frequency range every one-sixteenth of the planet's axial rotation. The source of the transmission is an ark ship, the Wasteland Wayfarer, which landed on the planet's surface.

3633bc83-e342-4291-ad91-91d6c5bd7b34.Text: Towering motionless on the planet's surface is a majestic Jericho-class ship, the type that transports pilgrim settlers to new planets. This converted promethium refinery vessel can transport tens of thousands of colonists to their new homeworld. The landing was smooth, judging by the hull integrity. The Wasteland Wayfarer is listed on the register of ships belonging to the Cult of Saint Drusus. Its description, make, and vox-transmitter signature match the register record.

05afae02-05c3-44b7-816e-8e491950852c.Text: A settlement has been spotted in the vicinity of the derelict ship. Its architectural and functional design is consistent with the Cult of Saint Drusus's standard templates for founding colonies. No lifeforms were detected. The condition of the structures indicates that the settlement has been abandoned for at least a hundred years.

8c51fc89-2f23-4ac3-82fd-b724c96860e8.Text: [Contact the ship] "This is the Rogue Trader speaking. We're having difficulties here."

66a08bdc-481d-4635-b7f4-6fc895ec2453.Text: {n}The airlock is sealed. This isn't right: you distinctly remember never activating the seal on your way through.{/n}

60c97ea8-279d-4818-bba0-bb3cf9f2df59.Text: "I know I am about to state the obvious, but I will state it anyway! There's something off about this. Something very off."

b061968b-c048-49ab-811f-f79d21568bab.Text: {n}The control panel refuses to heed any of your commands. The mischievous machine spirits are much too lively and unruly.{/n}

9ffbfbbe-f74c-4805-b516-06b6b10219fa.Text: {n}The control panel is being uncooperative. You know enough about machine spirit behaviour to conclude it is not malice that is making them refuse to comply, but a higher-priority order they are executing.{/n}

3380c004-78ff-466a-9a52-1776ab8300f4.Text: {n}The white noise of static is all you hear in response. Either the Vox Master cannot reply, or she is brazenly ignoring you, or comms are being jammed. None of these possibilities bode well.{/n}

7209c201-6eee-4287-8197-502431bb17b8.Text: {n}The plasteel, durable enough to withstand the pressure of the interplanetary void, absorbs your hits with supreme indifference. It will take more than that to break through.{/n}

90bbdbd8-6cf1-4eec-bcd2-d417977fccdf.Text: {n}After repeating the command entry protocol three times, with all the appropriate prayers, the Tech-Priest says in a gloomy, raspy voice,{/n} "The machine spirit controlling this airlock is too simple and guileless to be tricked. It would be easier to deconstruct this airlock than to compel it to open."

8b25fdef-408f-4eb0-b164-42826eae7828.Text: "Excellent, a vox-caster that works. Now we can let the planet know I have graced it with my presence."

f1e98148-e8f1-4c43-b8f4-467446020db6.Text: [Attack] "The world is full of horrors, but your death will make it a much better place."

baabf82b-3961-44f9-adf1-05496cfc5971.Text: "I'd kill you, but I don't want to get my hands dirty. Flee, freak."

7a9ca094-dba8-4ff2-a6fc-1e412c0abdcb.Text: [Make a dash for the vox-caster and try to contact the ship]

4091f7a5-6949-411b-bd5c-dbfc2df17db7.Text: "Do you mean our God, the Master of Terra who sits atop the Golden Throne? Or the blasphemous petty deity of whatever cult you're in?"

9d9d75ac-3378-488d-83ff-44404175081d.Text: "It was you or your accomplices who sealed the airlock, was it not?"

a842b848-4bdd-4184-93a1-bcccccc1ce58.Text: "I understand this to be a trap. Am I correct?"

323e4fdc-5014-4983-91cd-be47c8d04129.Text: "What was that you were muttering? A prayer?"

01ba6ebe-8227-45da-bcb3-d80ff3049427.Text: "Is there anybody else here? Your brothers and sisters?"

41405263-a057-4a04-bdde-def015888300.Text: "Your words are blasphemous lies. Do not sully His name with your tongue!"

cbea6d19-29a4-49cc-9659-fd14e9c3153f.Text: "Put your hands up, take off your hood, and don't make any sudden movements. Or else you'll be dead before we're properly acquainted.

bdfb7c52-2b4b-4621-89a8-81f61c190ffc.Text: "Abominations that looked exactly like you tried to take over my ship. I killed them all."

c2f875d5-07e0-458a-8979-51d046fa4a9b.Text: {n}Hunched over the vox-caster, the hooded man mutters monotonously but emphatically into the machine as he rocks slightly to and fro,{/n} "In the light of distant stars our Emperor-Progenitor wanders wearily. With thoughts and visions of us, He sends us particles of His light. Though His body suffers, His mind lingers on us. Let us therefore nourish Him with the light of our souls, with our prayers, with our faith."

ea136163-2cd4-4f00-bd81-199a370e9dd1.Text: {n}The man falls silent. After a pause he says,{/n} "We know you have come, afflicted ones."

08c9d9a2-84c0-4931-8ff6-3e15c2593b01.Text: {n}Argenta's expression brightens.{/n} "Countless foes and a cumbersome position. O Emperor, I thank Thee for giving us another chance to taste the sweetness of battle and the solemn joy of courageous deeds!"

dfa5d2b4-657c-409a-b083-c57776a551a5.Text: "Shereen, I hate to ruin a dramatic moment, but I do feel it's time for us to... run!"

8fb08934-4d71-4bea-8c11-de333b1be638.Text: {n}Cassia looks around anxiously.{/n} "They can smell our thoughts, they can see their colour... just like I can! There's no hiding from them."

e23f8dd0-e377-4e04-99f8-91c08cec606d.Text: {n}The mutant shrieks, grinning,{/n} "May the grace of our Progenitor be upon you!" {n}His words are piercing, becoming a shrill echo of a hundred... voices? Minds? Growing ever louder, it torments your mind, and before you know it, you reach for your weapon.{/n}

450fb5db-fa57-41b8-9ebd-da28132c5e95.Text: {n}The man smiles the broadest smile his abominable mouth can produce.{/n} "I am Lecocte, Clamavus of the Nourishers of the Afflicted. I am He-Who-Speaks-to-Our-Progenitor. This ship belongs to me."

ed589ec2-e14b-4655-995b-e48cf3406d22.Text: {n}The man falls abruptly silent, as though sensing your presence. Then he says,{/n} "And here come the afflicted."

d4d1675d-0d59-4cce-a9ea-d4674d704472.Text: {n}With a pale hand, he throws back his hood. You see an ugly face, with a flat, wide nose, disproportionately large brow ridges, irisless eyes with enormous pupils, a wide toadlike mouth, and skin that transitions to purple scales at the cheekbones. Standing before you is an abominable subhuman, a mutant.{/n} "Welcome to the abode of the Nourishers."

dba64c46-1c0a-4ae5-b1cf-247ec19a7f22.Text: {n}This being's nature has strayed too far from Mankind's blessed genome. The Creed sees no humanity in deviations like these, and so it commands that such creatures be exterminated without mercy.{/n}

a889034c-3362-4c93-90eb-5b181ded6252.Text: {n}Now you know that even mutants can be pleasant looking, while others are downright freakish in appearance. The man talking to you is of the latter kind.{/n}

21771c64-3b2e-45fd-bb55-cff62db97d24.Text: {n}One look tells you that there is nowhere to hide in this place. Well, at least you haven't wasted too much time.{/n}

63c5e7ce-04a6-4ea3-8e34-a15b5d8cbb67.Text: "I know no god but the Emperor-Progenitor. Others are either figments or ephemeral fleshless spirits."

2bfacc02-8462-47d7-9bca-f2e718dfa25a.Text: "My brethren have sealed the entrance. But you will be able to leave... later. With us. We are all going to leave this place."

0452b9f1-f925-4547-b1b2-2d1ba2dbf662.Text: {n}Argenta frowns.{/n} "The faithful worship the Emperor under a great many names and after a great many fashions. And yet... I do not like this prayer."

9d8880fd-58bb-4edf-b368-d8fc5b9deb46.Text: "Indeed, afflicted one. You have nowhere to run."

d507abae-bdb2-4b17-a060-e115eccb90c3.Text: "I was praising the Emperor-Progenitor so that my brothers and sisters might repeat the sacred words with me. Under stars unknown, He keeps His vigil, and sends us His light. He is exhausted and maimed, but in His graciousness, He does not allow Himself to forget us. And we are grateful. We know that our prayers will quell His agonising hunger, and therefore we speak to Him. We beckon Him so that one day, He and His faithful may come to take us under His care." {n}The man rocks gently in place as he makes his speech.{/n}

3badc0e6-84d8-42fb-8643-c3a5ae7ed919.Text: {n}The man responds with joyful laughter.{/n} "They are here. They are hiding. Waiting. Once we were many; now we are but few. Our blood degenerated. Our flesh grew weak. We were on the verge of death. But you have come, and that is good. You and your people will infuse our blood with a new power. Your ship will take the Nourishers to new worlds. We will rise again."

b8d825e1-39c6-4095-a58c-d78f9adb505a.Text: {n}Heinrix recoils, then grimaces and touches his temple as if pained by a headache.{/n} "This is bad. This is very, very bad... Ready your weapon, {name}."

c3d19cd7-6dcc-496d-a2f9-96f8c32dc465.Text: "Do you believe in the God-Emperor, the Protector of Mankind, who dwells on Holy Terra? Make your answer forthright and clear, for I stand before you as His chosen servant, and this Rogue Trader has been anointed by Him!"

b8e1dc15-dbfc-45b8-8e71-68d41fc3a632.Text: {n}Idira clutches her head.{/n} "Blast it! The pressure... What is this... thundering whisper that drowns out the voices!"

63bc8282-7bf5-4c78-a1af-f6f03e6c2df8.Text: {n}Cassia begins to rock to and fro ever so slightly, in sync with the man.{/n} "Purple. Everything is purple. I can see..."

165e4b4a-ec60-43cd-9518-ba747a1a768d.Text: "Rogue Trader, I'm unsure if you have time for such things right now, but as a representative of the Inquisition, I can tell you that a retreat will not be judged as indicating a lack of faith in these circumstances."

91a3061f-8997-4e73-b521-5f6284c2196f.Text: "Optimal retreat route calculated. Delaying is not advised."

7ef22583-775c-44de-af39-b3926ab512dc.Text: {n}Wherever the dead man's insane sermons are being broadcast to, static is all that fills the air. For a moment you think you hear Vigdis's voice, only for it to dissolve immediately in the static.{/n}

bdd1b383-facd-4f3d-92cc-8ab831197caa.Text: {n}The clanging is getting closer. It's coming from the ventilation shafts and dried-up fuel ducts. The deck under your feet vibrates. They're closing in! The psychic din grows more and more distinct as the abominations rush toward you.{/n}

bba64267-1d7a-4019-bd13-24838c4799a8.Text: "Sister, I fear we are about to partake of something quite different. Or, more likely, someone is about to partake of us."

526ec480-344d-42ff-8a61-738773b999d7.Text: {n}The vox spits out a torrent of static, through which you nonetheless manage to catch fragments of words spoken by a voice not unlike that of your Vox Master:{/n} "...von Valanc— command— rlock..." {n}The signal is lost before you manage to say anything.{/n}

b65398a7-4330-40e3-8053-7abc3e0329cb.Text: {n}Heinrix, evidently at the end of his patience, growls through gritted teeth,{/n} "We must... get out... of this trap!"

8826faf9-2a61-4e97-a0b0-c4f1b7dc87e2.Text: {n}If you had had a few hours to explore the ship, you surely would have found any number of discrete shafts and unlocked modules you could use to leave the ship. As it is, you're only aware of a single possible escape route: through the airlock, back the way you came. Any other path may lead to a dead end.{/n}

2448f97e-0cd3-4bb4-8ef0-12e3d522edbe.Text: {n}Your heart fills with unease and anger. You have heard thousands upon thousands of prayers over your {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Ministorum}many years of service as a member of the Ecclesiarchy{/d}, and what this stranger is saying is a far cry from any holy text you know.{/n}

13523914-bd0f-4c8d-a8c7-7e974093c356.Text: {n}Your gaze falls on a rune-covered control panel near the vox-receiver. A green lumen burns beneath the "Engage airlock seals" switch. The switch socket is corroded and does not immediately yield to your touch, but the lumen changes colour to blood red, and the whirring of deactivated airlocks rises up from the depths of the ship.{/n}

4cfd9991-8a1c-49b7-a440-98ca69b2b904.Text: {n}His features are strikingly similar to those of the mutant scum you destroyed in the dynastic crypt.{/n}

2c15cb07-a743-4cc8-8e64-29e314a4f4c1.Text: {n}The man before you is undoubtedly a Genestealer cultist, a servant of the abominable xenos like the ones who almost took over your ship.{/n}

06cf9b5d-630f-4adf-95b9-db6dfc95e959.Text: {n}The man does not look surprised.{/n} "Though I had not known them before, the Emperor-Progenitor brought me the echo of their deaths, and an image — your image. But their deaths matter not, for you have answered the call. I am elated."

6e565f49-68f1-4ced-8946-601bdf49fb94.Text: "Three sorrowful phalanges point the way to the Emperor-Progenitor. I am glad you have chosen ours."

4e25cb09-820e-423d-b598-5753e8e56cc0.Text: {n}The man's only response is a mocking grin.{/n}

0c24f33c-3aeb-4583-920a-b507e51d67a8.Text: {n}You hear a clanging echo growing louder in the empty modules: like hundreds of clawed limbs striking bulkheads and grabbing onto bars. Whoever is advancing upon you, there are a lot of them. You ought to run for your life before they trap you in this crammed vox-cabin.{/n}

bd409f76-e22d-4148-ab0e-365e01bce07a.Text: "There's an old military adage that says: when you're already in deep... trouble, don't poke around anywhere unless you know what you'll find there. I propose we get out the same way we came in."

a6856b97-5ff9-4515-9e36-f89a7bb14be4.Text: {n}Idira touches her temples and says, in a hoarse voice,{/n} "They're flooding the air with their psychic whispers. There's... so many of them!

ea75c0d4-79d9-4132-b1fe-5d282007058d.Text: {n}The man falls silent. After a pause, he says,{/n} "Praise our Progenitor."

1af47efd-cfc3-4016-b153-94c08b972263.Text: {n}The man falls silent. A satisfied chuckle, without a hint of fear, comes from under his hood.{/n} "As long as our Father-Progenitor thinks of me, I am eternal."

76bf6c96-2a7d-4622-a44a-d600fe495e10.Text: "If these beings are who I think, they will find us. And they will not lose our scent. Run, elantach!"

33899a75-af4b-4f3c-8a21-8110d83c775b.Text: Oh yeah. It is green cube!

a0a4077f-7445-442f-9a94-a3bb179eac83.Text: Look! It is a green cube!

83da9e92-6d07-4608-959f-ab4ea9a88f57.Text:
This chapter takes you step by step through the process of
creating your character for the game

49f4e096-95d5-41ce-8029-3f250c4547cb.Text:
Archetypes are the building blocks of your character. They
both describe what you did before becoming an Explorer and
your position within your Rogue Trader dynasty. This chapter
details all the various Archetypes and also explains how you
can improve and develop your character through game play.

cb80e8ff-e73f-4ddc-9866-f544d1ea1d48.Text:
From Enquiry to Tech-Use, every character has a variety of
learned skills that they can employ. This chapter describes
these skills in detail

1b93467a-476e-4f59-b961-54edd4653997.Text:
Every character also has certain special abilities that make him
unique, such as Bulging Biceps or Unshakeable Faith. This
chapter describes all of these talents

f9fd6f72-822b-45f7-bc8d-287ed20fa90f.Text:
This chapter describes some of the tools, trappings, weapons
and armour your Explorer may use or encounter

1ae6a182-3cbb-423c-ae8d-bf940e491eec.Text:
From astro-telepathy to the mysteries of the Emperor's Tarot,
the unnatural powers of the mind can be both rewarding and
dangerous. The powers of an Astropath are slightly different
from other psychically-gifted individuals, and this chapter
explains what they are, and what happens when they go
wrong.

fdf9b06e-3864-41ba-b2aa-b66ffd440c25.Text:
What's in this book?
Rogue Trader is divided into fifteen chapters. They are:

f82cc29c-585c-435c-b0fa-d5bccdaeb934.Text: The Lord Captain resolved to show leniency and merely asked for a report on the unit's progress.

9c54d62a-75e1-404d-a55e-a85a022a5fae.Text: ...to train the penetrating gaze of the augur arrays on the damaged ship.

81eab641-b381-4047-9cef-b5224da4171f.Text: ...to have Idira Tlass feel out a course. An unholy psyker she may be, but even souls as dark as hers submit to the Lord Captain's will.

419744f2-4acb-417f-8140-43820004eebf.Text: The Lord Captain summoned all of {mf|his|her} willpower so as not to succumb to fear.

681acbdf-d318-46d5-b8b5-732c289cb137.Text: Recite a memorial prayer to the Omnissiah in honour of the ship — a fallen wonder of engineering.

af6175e0-74de-4450-a134-275a836c87b3.Text: After distilling the salient points from Grey Mattina's exhaustive report, {name} listed the areas that warranted a more thorough search.

46c84a5c-575c-4695-be9e-1cafc2e1b9fc.Text: The Lord Captain ordered the unit to return to the shuttle.

b57946bc-0023-44c4-8481-ba9f5361cdac.Text: The Lord Captain ordered that Captain Vesti be removed from command and demanded his final report about the unit's progress.

a8449020-e468-4d2c-a0ab-d4880e33f3ba.Text: The Lord Captain took a risk and watched the recording.

add1624c-ec85-4fec-86af-7b63cbb696fb.Text: The Lord Captain didn't want to risk it, so {mf|he|she} gave the order to destroy the cogitator and retreat.

d293e7dd-6fb9-47cb-84d4-d5b67a36cda0.Text: The Lord Captain summoned all {mf|his|her} knowledge of the wicked influence of Chaos, choosing to combat fear with cold analysis.

cac91978-58e9-42aa-9917-46dc1616776c.Text: ...gave the order to fire upon the dead vessel at range. For that which was born in fire should also perish in fire.

f5c173a6-8ef6-4833-ab74-732a5ceaed95.Text: ...access the ship's power grid and cut off the power to the sector.

db71ad2b-7c60-4f94-af0a-385978521ca2.Text: ...figure out the safest route and try to go that way.

68f673d3-f963-493e-a668-f38ef0dcd0e7.Text: Knowing the typical layout of service bays, the Lord Captain directed the scouts to where the valuable components would be found.

00a094b3-ff00-476e-b47f-53ee8f89f550.Text: After examining the service bay and consulting the augurs, the Lord Captain suggested where the ship's undamaged components could be found.

15c71d1d-9202-4855-a6db-1bfcac52b73b.Text: The Lord Captain reprimanded Captain Vesti for his flippancy and demanded a report on his unit's progress.

2e26ea3d-ab3a-4dc4-aa86-0689f81b60c2.Text: The Lord Captain defused the conflict brewing between the two commanders and requested a report from Captain Vesti on his unit's progress.

ecdc3c87-fecf-4ff8-bab5-ba8d6c3fe9e9.Text: The Lord Captain praised the commander for maintaining morale, and ventured deeper into the ship.

4277df0f-93b8-4bd5-91e6-100eaced257a.Text: The Lord Captain immediately informed Captain Vesti that he would be severely disciplined upon the expedition's completion, and demanded a report on his unit's activities.

1dd4451c-f647-414e-9f6d-c446997971f1.Text: The Lord Captain summoned all {mf|his|her} willpower to resist the illusion.

d440eaac-23fe-4522-914f-f8635eaf7047.Text: The Lord Captain tried to build a dam against the fear, drawing upon logic and {mf|his|her} knowledge of the monstrous apparitions of Chaos.

37ea7566-7c7c-4062-9b05-1894213297b5.Text: The Lord Captain reprimanded the commander for his inappropriate flippancy and they ventured deeper into the ship.

f7074542-24a5-4479-bb07-3faeeb48f8eb.Text: The Lord Captain took drastic action to solve the problem, stripping Vesti of command of his unit and demanding a final report on its progress.

76904feb-a0c4-43ca-a27c-1d528315153d.Text: ...turned away and cast the grim carcass forever from {mf|his|her} mind.

1b845603-615f-481f-9818-37411c461182.Text: Hold a service for the fallen scouts.

0587359f-b6cd-4a88-8b79-93e82fd8d16c.Text: Honour the memory of Captain Nova van Dayne and her crew.

44fe9a7d-8453-4fca-ae5f-de5cd6c2d2e8.Text: ...to turn {mf|his|her} attention to the scout units awaiting instructions.

038ef786-a710-460a-93fe-8895b20cf304.Text: ...ask Abelard, who was well-versed in the layout of Imperial ships, to plot a possible route around the perilous section.
