e55329e2-0150-4be1-a041-fdbdad3b486c.Text: "Enough lying around. Get up and we will discuss how you are going to pay for your rescue."

0456076f-1c80-44dc-8cb3-2b1d44d6b2fc.Text: "Kill for me. Go into the Mangled Sector and find a freak called the Commissar — one of your kind — and spill his guts for me. Do that and you will earn my favour. And in the Chasm, that counts for a lot."

06d10e51-8873-49b6-a499-0454f781c51b.Text: "A prisoner of the Drukhari who thinks too highly of himself. Instead of dying in the arena without any fuss, he is hiding, gathering other slaves of your race around him, and making pathetic plans to get his revenge. And many of your kind are listening to him — see how few humanling Shriekers there are? They used to all come to me, but now they listen to the Commissar and no longer come."

4e70e9d3-6ca0-4a4b-bf4f-797a66fd24c3.Text: "It's an off-putting place. It's the base of the spire in which we live. Commorragh is stitched together from scraps of various dimensions, and in the Mangled Sector, the seams are starting to rip. Space is collapsing in on itself and entropic radiation is off the scale, spawning all kinds of abominations, and the sector itself is slowly but surely turning into nothing..."

fe29f2de-79fc-4714-bde3-29a022ba3cab.Text: "I don't want to drag my whole gang into the Mangled Sector — the place will kill off three times more fighters than the Commissar's crew will. That means I need to send in an assassin. The Commissar's fighters know my Shriekers. But nobody knows you. And besides, you don't have a choice, which means you'll see it through to the end."

931f7c51-9b6a-45f1-960a-93ed4edb6b8b.Text: "Bring me his head. And in exchange, I will share my toys with you. They make surviving in Commorragh possible."

942cee8a-f80e-4779-ace3-5dea9e8e5bf6.Text: "That's what you think. I'm not even going to punish you for your disobedience — you'll think about it and realise on your own that you won't survive in Commorragh without friends. You need shelter, weapons, a healer. And I need what's sitting on the Commissar's shoulders."

a1428bae-f184-418c-8ae4-2c5a0ea2f7d3.Text: "And if you think of lying to me and running... When you're on the street, look out for a humanling dressed in red with a cog on his chest and a face full of misery. See how he is dying alone with nobody to help him. Your death will be just the same."

0acb51e6-1f9f-4605-a764-068e3a042992.Text: "Your begging amused me. It was so... pathetic... and delectable."

cf565fb1-e1b7-4484-ac41-ac0ec858ea17.Text: "As a sign of my favour, I'll give you your slave fighter. They wandered into the den while I was healing you, and said they were your bodyguard."

bfd8131c-8673-4eea-b968-f52db2e82032.Text: "A kind of translucent slug. It is a parasite that can only be found on this side of reality. Mind maggots feed on your memory and they inject toxic hallucinations into your mind to stop you resisting. Drukhari can train these creatures and use them to show their victims devious mirages."

16c3b540-2369-4ffd-b8cc-66c1e0d845dd.Text: "Or you can reject my generous offer and look for help elsewhere. Have you heard about that humanling that's always hanging around the gate to the Anatomical Opera, gasping for breath, and begging the Haemonculus to save her? She can't breathe normally, even the way she says her name is funny — J-Jae H-Heyd-hari, as if she's about to suffocate."

3daceae4-8f2f-4c5e-9187-ebb917ba3c78.Text: "Serve me well, and I will not set a certain someone on you... There is an arena enthusiast who has acquired a scent beast, ferocious and toothy. Right now, he is trying out his new toy on the refuse near the corpse dump, but soon, he will seek out bigger prey, and you do not want to be it."

de0d5d51-5b43-409c-bb14-f8f8d932a8b5.Text: "Here, you can have this disobedient thing. It refuses to do what I say, so it will either become meat for the arena or allow you to strike an extra blow against the Commissar."

e7ccc0d1-a6f6-4070-8239-1239bd1cafa2.Text: {n}As soon as you stand up, you are seized by a strange sense of unreality. It is as if you are still there, in the wicked darkness, and everything around you is merely a twisted mirage. Doubt seeps into your mind like a poison, sundering its contact with your body. You have to make a deliberate effort to hold onto the thought that you are you.{/n}

39092c32-889f-4c9f-aaa9-05bfc2e2123b.Text: "What, is your mind maggot giving you trouble? I saw it latch onto your spinal cord when you were being patched up. A fat, well-fed grub it was, with lots of teeth. It's dying now — they have a short lifespan — and that means its poison is especially toxic. You'll lose touch with reality from time to time, and when the mind maggot dies, the final dose of poison will make you think your body is not your body at all. And then your heart will just stop beating."

55980023-53dc-4507-8fb2-104d2c174cac.Text: "I could have pulled that thing out of you, of course, but I thought — why should I? Consider it a guarantee of your gratitude toward me. When you've earned your healing, I'll release you from it." {n}The lipless mouth stretches into a bloodthirsty grin.{/n}

64444da1-b736-4c92-a421-b00a963cf681.Text: "You are a cocky whelp, but feeble like all members of your race. Your cockiness has not got you killed yet, which means you must be someone important. And you might be useful."

f9f4f667-e35f-465b-b0dc-f692eea73061.Text: "You'd have to be insane to set foot in a place like that. Insane, or an outcast like the Commissar, hiding from the hunt... or you."

9de3a5e4-a53e-4fb5-8c16-285d1b31c629.Text: "Some unhinged humanling went there recently. What did they call him? Wersorean? He was old, but strong... and too loud. His visit probably stirred up all the freaks. You should be more careful and quieter than he was."

cfb1bda2-1657-445c-be4a-50bcca754e90.Text: "Prove that you're useful first. Do this and Malice will see that you have decent toys to play with. But not before. In the meantime, you can pick something out of the junk pile." {n}Malice gestures at a container half-full of shoddy equipment.{/n}

eb5940a0-c509-4b08-9db1-fe12e235714c.Text: "As a sign of my favour, I'll give you your slave fighters. They wandered into the den while I was healing you, and called themselves your bodyguards."

cccb04a9-ee24-40e3-bd03-699cd1d34b2b.Text: "Do your duty, Idira. The von Valancius blood will be avenged."

05a60bb1-5e0a-47a4-a16a-076bacb0ac9c.Text: "Are you distraught because of Vigastes's fate and the deaths of those betrayed by the Commissar?"

ef7cb5f6-3632-4a8d-9127-f9c5fa07566d.Text: "Remain steadfast. We will break free from this darkness."

25bca6cd-c9da-4dbb-92c4-df4326eb8390.Text: "You should have told me the truth. I see no reason to condemn you. Theodora deserved to die for her treachery. As for any other victims... it was acceptable collateral damage."

304bd44b-ea13-4e50-a79e-056d64d9cbba.Text: "And you confess such a thing so casually?"

fc6cf70e-f16e-43df-8a42-e725bbdf245a.Text: "If prayer is helping you get through this, I am glad to hear it."

c985f0ce-2a0f-4b3a-b828-fb586d8679b2.Text: "Darkness, spiritual fortitude... Personally, I am rather enjoying my time here!"

54b42a71-3cc0-406d-a81e-17f8f4af3206.Text: "I do. You are a faithful ally."

14dfff68-9d52-40cb-80a7-fb3bbafe08e1.Text: "There is no one I trust completely. It is one of the principles I swear by."

08d91ec6-c1c3-47a7-a600-40dbadc6b945.Text: "You kept this secret all this time."

c6ac9f25-681b-401f-8c5e-1bd482d395db.Text: "Idira, you are blinded by grief. Stop. None of us is perfect."

6db4a71d-a010-4bbc-b001-648cf27a9747.Text: "I have nothing better to do. Speak, if you so wish."

32862076-e8a4-4476-b531-10ea96c8e6f5.Text: "What's done is done. I hope you will learn from this. Right now we need to think about a way to escape."

449916d2-90e9-4c54-a855-753f1d792ad9.Text: "Enough. This quarrel ends here. Argenta, I have words for you."

d0951297-7652-4a40-b7ed-e788f357e23f.Text: "You murdered my kin and hid the truth from me. That is unforgivable. Leave my retinue. May Commorragh take you."

c04b4759-5f0e-4d45-9748-545f1b48db22.Text: "Do you at least regret doing what you did? Your hands would not be covered in the blood of innocents had you not acted on impulse."

aeaab85e-83e6-4d64-bff9-569fae7c6790.Text: "If Thou seest a flaw in me — smite me..." {n}Argenta's hoarse whispers are nothing like the usual clear, almost mellifluous voice that she uses for prayer.{/n} "Smite me..."

3310b90a-9804-4302-8c33-3f4dfb90eec1.Text: {n}She looks up at you. Her dark eyes gleam anxiously.{/n} "Rogue Trader. You find me at prayer. Darkness surrounds us, and we will require all the spiritual fortitude our ravaged hearts can muster."

438663ad-8cf1-4ba0-9667-8ba7bc816f1b.Text: "In any other case, I would recommend that the Sister of Battle be tried before a high court... but given the circumstances — and the voluntary confession — we can make do with a trial by the deceased's direct heir. You." {n}Heinrix looks directly at you.{/n}

1170c6c1-9a6d-4f1f-9474-5e5f8de55a36.Text: "Ha! We're all wearing masks, even the most righteous." {n}Jae shakes her head in disappointment.{/n}

8141eb63-9df0-43ea-83c5-9f56a1d63f6e.Text: {n}Argenta hangs her head.{/n} "Yes. I am. I was the one... who found those people, I brought them to the Commissar, I prayed for them, and I gave them hope. And he... he sent them to an abattoir! To die for those monsters' amusement! They might have... In their final moments, they might have thought that I, too, had betrayed them!"

a2a3c86a-e12d-43e0-998b-8e5854eaafd6.Text: "I once more failed to see wickedness where I should have seen it... I failed those people, loyal and brave. But it is not only that. I thought, naively, that faith and perseverance had helped us — helped me — cut through the schemes of the foul xenos. That we were on a path to freedom. In truth, though... it was all just another part of the act, and the vile monsters must have been cackling with glee as they observed my foolishness."

9072d2e3-9264-4e93-aacf-efc25d06d4a0.Text: "No. Nothing about this confession is easy for me..."

2969aa3d-5fd5-4a81-8b67-8b4be622823c.Text: "I did not regret killing her, nor do I regret it now. Theodora had succumbed to the Archenemy and its dark sorcery. The entire attack on the ship was merely the result of her and Voigtvir feuding over their spoils. And I realised it in my heart the moment I saw the artefact in her hand."

47daa02d-5c5b-470e-af57-b1e5d570ea9b.Text: "You take enjoyment in the strangest things, Rogue Trader."

6b2c0f64-d71a-4e4c-83e0-f352f6811413.Text: "Thank you for your words of solace, Rogue Trader."

b0418185-dd26-4b1b-a0fa-fd0ccec28310.Text: {n}Argenta pauses, contemplating something. A shadow crosses her face, followed by a flash of unreadable emotion.{/n} "Tell me, Rogue Trader, do you trust me? Please, look into your heart and tell me what you see!"

71e3948a-58a4-41d1-b1f8-a398067307c4.Text: "You HAG!" {n}Idira descends upon Argenta with the intensity of a hurricane.{/n} "Two-faced void rat! Killing Theodora right when the ship was in peril, right when she was doing everything to save us... You won't walk away from this!" {n}The air around her is vibrating, electrified by the power of her sorcery.{/n}

0cc571a2-cfe7-4f4d-a2fb-81f0954a2cb5.Text: "Perhaps... perhaps you are wise to distrust."

e879e63f-fb57-42f2-bf25-1f9fa952c47b.Text: "But what if I am... undeserving of your trust?"

92f89022-726d-4652-9db5-7548727b7afe.Text: "Rogue Trader. To lose hope is to err in the eyes of the Emperor, and I am drawing closer to erring than ever before. The darkness all around me thickens... and the clutches of our captors are strong. If I am to give myself fully to the battle ahead, I will need all my strength. And to summon such strength, I must purge my soul. Tell me, will you hear my confession?"

54114e99-2d00-4f97-b8cf-c95ed227542f.Text: {n}Warp presence floods everything around you, and darkness falls over your eyes. When it retreats, you see a lifeless Argenta lying on the ground. Idira is standing over the body, breathing heavily. Then she spits on it.{/n} "Scum. Stay here and rot."

7ef03c51-db9f-4d68-a6fb-df619eaedf37.Text: {n}Without saying another word, Idira turns away.{/n}

c7d2232a-4a17-40bb-a2cd-4acf2ae394b6.Text: {n}Argenta looks at you anxiously, waiting for your reaction.{/n}

27a7273d-7146-48dc-9a15-0483865c4c7c.Text: {n}Argenta looks at Idira. She frowns. Something unexpected appears in her eyes: a hint of compassion.{/n}

565e496c-57bb-42cd-a38b-e39100c4806c.Text: "Yes. It was me. Not your treacherous kin Voigtvir. Not the cultists. Me." {n}She speaks with a strange blend of pride and horror in her voice.{/n}

c3033f02-2b28-4293-804b-228f0d6c7e6e.Text: "I remember every last detail. The ship was under attack. I grabbed my weapon and ran to her side, because I thought it was my duty to protect the Emperor's chosen. And what did I witness when I burst into her study? Theodora von Valancius, a Rogue Trader, holding a sinister sorcerous artefact radiating with profane light!"

e211e043-6363-4b6a-9dba-296043e96ab0.Text: "It was a lens like the ones we saw in the Rykad System, except it was smaller and far more potent. I instantly knew it to be a weapon of the Archenemy. I had seen objects like it before... on Salis Prime, the planet where I had sought the sacred relic and where I had nearly died at the hands of cultists! So many things were made clear to me in that moment. So piercing was the revelation, so obvious the answer to how those heretics had found their way to a planet known to none but those of House von Valancius!"

33205757-67b1-4e65-982a-86d5ee255e15.Text: "I did. And I despised myself for doing so. Sisters of Battle are taught to laugh in the face of lies and intrigue, but instead, I... I feared that I would face immediate execution for the murder of the Rogue Trader. I hoped that people would think it was Voigtvir or the cultists who killed her, and I was right. But that lie... it burned in my throat. And here, in this horrific reality away from Terra's light, I realised that I could keep my silence no longer."

8874c888-55db-428f-91ab-f6b7ebf348d9.Text: "I suppose... I suppose you are right. I had to punish the heretic — and punish her I did!"

b00efa6d-db21-4573-aa95-75c292e43506.Text: "I regret the deaths of innocents every waking moment! But how could I avert my eyes from heresy? That goes against my very nature!"

cced8468-0f6b-4001-9b4d-1337d36dcf01.Text: "I... expected this outcome. So be it. Farewell, Rogue Trader!"

562aeb6b-045a-4af2-b80a-1a125badd02a.Text: "Learn... I don't know what I am supposed to learn. Must I spare a heretic in order to save innocent lives? Must I try to reason with them? I have pondered these questions a thousand times, and I still do not know where the truth lies..."

82edf164-9711-42b7-ab50-329d94bde786.Text: "I am glad I have revealed the truth to you, Rogue Trader. This dishonesty has been driving me out of my mind."

465e9686-8a1b-4007-8c7a-947b9086c3a2.Text: "But standing in that same room was the honourable Arch-Militant. A devout servant of the Emperor, and the reason I had made it off Salis Prime after the cultist attack. When he saw me firing at Theodora, he instinctively rushed to protect her. I killed him too." {n}Argenta lowers her gaze for a moment.{/n}

ce836f50-c6c6-498e-8a77-4ede75b946fe.Text: "Do you remember the orphans I once asked you to meet with, Rogue Trader? One of the boys was the son of the man I killed. My whole life, I had sworn I would not allow villains to orphan children of the Imperium, and then I did so myself..."

ffcc20f3-d680-40ad-ad81-17a278e375ad.Text: "Why? Why should I stop? Why should you stop me? She'll put a bullet in your head just like she did with Theodora the moment she finds the smallest reason to suspect you of heresy!"

1a026e3e-ef3f-4d5f-ac28-45808f1e479b.Text: {n}Idira is breathing heavily as she looks at you with a mixture of despair and distrust. Then she suddenly slumps to her knees and lets out a tired sob.{/n} "Everything was going so well when Lady Theodora was alive... She appreciated me, she gave me a new life! And the voices were barely giving me any trouble. But then... then... after she... I started seeing her in my dreams, and the voices started calling to me day and night..."

260219b1-32ad-4a58-b032-a59c31235555.Text: "I fired before I could even fully comprehend what I was seeing. Terra's light must have guided my hand, for one shot was all it took. The autopistol's burst destroyed both the Archenemy's artefact and its owner's black heart. But..."

fcc3e73d-6f5b-433a-adab-a586682dbed8.Text: {n}Argenta notices your attention, then, after a moment of hesitation, calls out to Idira:{/n} "You should not mourn her. And neither should you think that she had a particularly high opinion of you. We were all just tools to her. Were Theodora still alive, it would not shield you from madness. You had better accept that and not cling to regrets about the past. Salvation always lies in the future, Idira."

5b8a6629-6a5b-4b1f-98ad-1fefb3eab07a.Text: "I know," {n}Idira responds with resignation.{/n} "But you're still a psychopath who pulls the trigger first and thinks later!"

254f6e04-ef46-4214-aa1b-7e7e9d1decb2.Text: "This is what 'true' faith is really about. Shooting first and asking questions later. Sacrificing the innocent without thinking of the consequences. Where is your humanity, Sister? The world is not divided into black and white."

5a60b180-b366-4413-b7c8-44c365ce7c5d.Text: {n}Yrliet raises her head slightly and looks around, clearly not fully understanding what is wrong, but sensing the shift in the mood around her.{/n}

49b77f43-d2d9-4bd3-8522-7a7e8d1208cd.Text: "Lady Theodora... Mort... fell at the hand of the one meant to protect the servants of the God-Emperor. I never doubted the security of the von Valancius bloodline when you were close, but now the very foundations on which the power of the Rogue Traders rests seem to have been violated." {n}Abelard looks at Argenta with a visceral loathing in his eyes, uncovered by either courtesy or respect.{/n}

4e50b57e-26f4-4109-8c9a-8705c470cad0.Text: "You did not have that right." {n}The Proctor regards his former comrade with the heavy gaze he reserves for the condemned.{/n} "I believe that you saw what you say you saw, but you had no right to act the way you did. None in the Expanse may judge the Rogue Traders. You put yourself above the letter of the sacred Warrant, and in so doing, above the Lex Imperialis!"

889c3a66-22b1-4404-babc-050ca30ceb51.Text: {n}A shadow of horror passes over Solomorne's face.{/n} "If I were her, I— no. I cannot pass judgement on Sister Argenta. She only transgressed the letter of the law, and it is up to no one but you or the Emperor to determine the degree of her guilt."

19c2411f-8e42-4821-b963-50b5d8eabc61.Text: "Is this animal trying to speak to me?"

1b73e474-b890-4e0b-a6cd-7ba865d1020b.Text: "Regrettably, it is. Impudence and gregariousness are inherent traits of the mon-keigh."

946ed036-b3ae-4bf6-b62e-1b6b378021b1.Text: "Let the Emperor's justice be served! You contemptible heretic and you unholy xenos, your sentence is death!"

5b5cb3fc-ce89-4b87-833a-a94f8e09aecb.Text: Malice is badly wounded and unconscious, but his stubborn xenophysiology prevents him from expiring.

6c879338-38b6-4c9f-baa4-5f532b668434.Text: The portal dematerialises anything that enters it. It appears that someone has adjusted its parameters to play a sick, deadly joke.

648dec54-45a5-44ba-80cc-ee3ae6973191.Text: Argenta is absorbed in ardent, trance-like prayer and is not reacting to anyone around her.

247fb2a0-ed0a-409d-ba48-72bbe522f037.Text: The words of a prayer to the Emperor have been raggedly scratched out on the floor of the metal cell.

7b0ca2e1-bf00-4904-b6f4-b9beb780ef55.Text: The dead lacerax's hide and flesh have been burnt to the bone.

7ec0d706-f755-494d-854b-3b7aec227447.Text: The mutilated bodies of the prisoners have fused together into a large pile that gives off a caustic smell of rot.

e6ad7856-bac7-4d91-8a1c-aa357f725165.Text: An enormous eye stares at you through the glowing portal... or rather, the portal is the eye of something enormous. And its maw, patiently waiting for you to step inside.

586d2ba8-a371-473f-bb7e-bc2cafeca702.Text: Looking at the revolting puddle of ichor that reeks of suffering, you can barely make out what remains of the bones of some unfortunate soul that appear to have been digested and regurgitated.

40125079-023f-464d-b8b8-18d7a43d4c71.Text: The irrational design behind this profane mechanism mystifies you.

e145f395-fb89-4d4c-ae85-9ad45b07666f.Text: You are able to make sense of the irrational design behind this profane mechanism and get it to work.

2b557aff-87f8-4ebf-ad3a-eea4397523c8.Text: The xenodevice refuses to obey any tech-chants you know.

6f464d7c-9d10-4b65-bf62-ca7e9e222740.Text: The Omnissiah's power is such that His tech-litanies subdue even the twisted spirit of this xenomachine and force it to operate.

765e8700-7c73-4f5e-99c3-c6e3cd285f58.Text: The dimensional tear that the Commissar turned into a portal is unstable once more and guarantees the death of any who make contact with its energies.

1e094502-2c53-4f72-9625-4768c94fb4ec.Text: The beggar's corpse is infested with countless mutations. Looking at it makes your head throb with pain.

9332e9fb-5cab-4696-bb4e-848d88576170.Text: The beggar's corpse is disfigured by bony growths. Eyes, mouths, and tentacles are constantly appearing and disappearing in the ocean of his flesh. It is difficult to mistake warp distortion of this severity for anything else.

4f15fb01-5e85-4939-800d-289613ed0db1.Text: The ravaged corpse of the beggar who stole your boots. His lips form a serene smile, and his hand is clutching a pistol, which appears to have been fired recently.

877e26eb-f4bd-4c5e-a2ae-ab22b1d7574e.Text: The ravaged corpse of the beggar who stole your boots. His lips form a serene smile, and a blood-stained blade protrudes from a device built around his wrist. It would seem he managed to stab his killer before his death.

18909657-1a75-4112-bbe1-3f0ed5303eb9.Text: The door does not budge: the Commissar's people have blocked it well.

77d1515b-d990-47a9-a42f-54596e4f5124.Text: The razor-sharp keel of the flying craft glints fearsomely in the dim light.

03e8c7e9-337b-4de9-916a-26f97d884513.Text: This transport adorned with massive blades would make for a deadly weapon on the battlefield.

541bbeca-38b7-4bc1-b568-96113e684320.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! An emergency meeting has been called in the Pit — we need you! The Commissar told me to deliver this note to you."

b09c5513-1137-4f79-804a-3dd136523f7f.Text: The Sslyth may have been gravely maimed but his gaze remains proud, piercing, and malicious.

ab99795f-6c48-4577-9679-3831dec89ab8.Text: The Commissar repeatedly clutches at his throat, racked by a bloody gurgling cough.

d8610ca3-bc14-41fb-9f44-742b89f9d8b9.Text: "You have insulted the Cult of the Fatal Thirst, outsider! You have insulted the fighting pit itself! The Wyches are longing for you to die!"

f67341c5-157d-48d7-a105-41363718d648.Text: The makeshift Aquila looks somewhat pitiful, but the evident diligence and passion that went into its creation speaks of the piety of its makers.

693dd7ca-7bd8-48f6-a87d-58bc4dcecb9f.Text: The devoted subjects of the Imperium did not dare to leave its sacred symbol behind in the Mangled Sector.

c0c1dbbb-3f78-4e05-9118-4152ac82303d.Text: "No... No, just kill me instead... {name}... {name}? Kill me, but don't leave me like this!"

dfee0d1e-5dc3-4683-bb19-e8fd65a5028f.Text: In a pleasant voice, the strange device invites you to put your hand in its depths and press the activation button.

b5c49106-580b-4e76-ab6b-659abe96e656.Text: The hideous pile of corpses is giving off an insufferable stench.

bd7714ea-6ebe-4406-9437-ea0424699353.Text: One of the corpses in the pile catches your eye. You manage to cut the synthetic sinew, an expensive augment, out of the Reaver's broken body.

ce40ca27-702d-4e9b-85e2-cb6f22e4c8d4.Text: With your wavering vision, you see a hooded figure that appears to have an omniscope for a head. The absurdity of it nearly makes you laugh.

778f1d69-075f-4d5a-a66c-78c042610b00.Text: "{mf|Master|Mistress}, could you spare the last few drops of your stimulant?"

0411e6db-2cad-4506-b024-3e8bcf2ab36e.Text: "Please leave me in peace, strong {mf|master|mistress}. I'm not stealing or begging. I'll just sleep here for a bit and be gone."

9b194a8c-cfce-47dd-b402-864b76eb5317.Text: The tear in the fabric of space is sparking with entropic energy capable of unravelling the threads of matter itself.

50f507f6-5c5e-4f0b-859d-3312e90e87db.Text: You find nothing that could be of use to you.

09130366-c8ea-4cb0-88cc-6e4592ffe459.Text: "It is close... I can feel it... It is coming to get me, and there is nowhere to hide."

bd969883-5796-46a1-905a-252657a884ed.Text: The contents of the injector bubble playfully, as if urging you to find out whether the liquid inside is poison or medicine.

c164985c-55d2-4d1e-b8df-1e735a60e00d.Text: "Keep them. In return, I want you to help me find a safe place and a healer."

dcb0351a-7181-4662-9438-ec7ce9d05343.Text: "Attend me, commoner! For your help, I shall shower you with riches."

b6001377-8ab4-4336-a9db-41a6bdd3debf.Text: [Point your weapon at him] "This is a robbery!"

39e4792d-e04d-4182-89d4-dc8f1ef0ff51.Text: [Offer him a stimulant] "Are you in the mood for recreation?"

7becf627-9b4e-43f6-9418-3e3a77e5a390.Text: [Offer him your weapon] "I can give you this."

6ab727a5-12fb-4831-99b5-40888f271de9.Text: "Yours may be meaner, but mine is worth more. You could fetch a good deal for it later."

4962807c-7752-4dc9-ac04-5b436306f64b.Text: [Point your weapon at him] "Take them off! Now!"

3fdd2ccd-0c52-4433-9c35-4979f5fb57b7.Text: "What do you say to a trade? You will return my property and I will... give you something in exchange?"

6c4e209b-3ebe-4c10-8f59-c4cbcc7c0610.Text: "For your sake, I hope you are right. My boots were coated in poison. I have the antidote in my blood, but if someone were to steal them from me..."

5639a71c-d2af-41f0-981f-ccdc66af86c8.Text: [Put your hands up] "Right. Your boots. Your pistol. All I have is problems."

fbb1208f-7165-463e-b67e-68592ef789d7.Text: "Protection against thieves. But if those are not mine, you have nothing to worry about."

119e1b0c-3ce1-47c4-a0f6-b4c08036112f.Text: "Hand over everything you have on you."

3c24eb27-231c-4d49-bdcc-5e7360595b35.Text: [Put away your weapon] "I was only joking."

d1228db3-f68f-4026-9498-9ea16d732026.Text: "I need shelter and the assistance of a healer."

38a24349-c284-4167-8815-7fed6a4f3322.Text: [Point your weapon at him] "How is this for a reason?"

4002b079-dd71-41a1-a072-1e9d577126ad.Text: "I say we keep what we have to ourselves."

dc0c3f94-b112-4c31-be77-62f586b3cac0.Text: "I'm begging you. I need shelter and the assistance of a healer."

603de693-f874-4d71-8e82-1fe46320e899.Text: "I wish to apologise for our previous encounter."

9ad095e4-9350-45bb-a310-81a6d939a130.Text: "Hand them over and leave before I take your head clean off!"

521f46fc-9ee1-4b51-a473-31836eeaaa35.Text: Gave your boots to the beggar in Commorragh.

de83daf3-88a0-4fe1-92a3-422410778c2f.Text: "Keep them. You need them more than I do."

624a0d66-5ded-4f84-9371-af902d0e6b61.Text: [Kill him] "To end a life as lightless as yours is a laudable deed."

64da99af-2bf3-41e7-b863-146feaf3e5eb.Text: [Offer him a stimulant] "I'm buying those boots."

a4860c40-a97d-4cd8-960c-a2bfc7fc6d16.Text: "We meet again, scum. Do you remember me?"

f310917e-b4ef-46f2-8e93-91c9873b2e22.Text: "My situation is desperate. I need shelter and a healer."

cb9ce04f-3aeb-4807-9e6d-4cf926adc6da.Text: [Offer him a stimulant] "I'll do you one better."

9cf886e2-331c-431b-a6af-115dc8e16903.Text: [Lie in an imposing voice] "Oh, I do have a weapon. But it is mine."

9749c05a-ef84-4366-a8d9-5d15940a5661.Text: [Throw him a stimulant] "For the trouble I caused you."

d04b6b19-4332-423a-9d99-1796ed438e46.Text: [Offer him your pistol] "I believe this is worth far more."

3c76717a-318f-456f-9460-b0f4e152b5f8.Text: [Keep your weapon trained on him] "Good reflexes. I propose we go our separate ways in peace."

c6209da7-f3b3-4e73-a9af-99e9159de9b4.Text: Restored the beggar's faith in the God-Emperor in Commorragh.

dd6c5057-23c1-4baa-8ec2-a30b43f18af0.Text: "It pains me to behold how your faith has withered, son of the Imperium. Tell me, when you renounced His light, turned to lies and treachery, and, in doing so, became like xenos and heretics, was it worth it?"

715f460c-1dd1-49f3-9e2b-24912081ecc7.Text: {n}It is nigh impossible to identify this horrendous spawn dressed in rags as a human being... or rather, a genetic anathema descended from human beings. The mutant's hideous appearance is complemented by brutal scars and a partially flayed face.{/n}

a8e47dd5-818e-4ca4-843b-bd1401de7ccc.Text: "A trade? A trade works. Got any weapons?"

0979e903-b0cc-46f2-8205-3c9611923f8e.Text: {n}The beggar lazily reaches into his rags, draws a pistol, and points it at you.{/n} "Am I s'posed to believe something as stupid as that? How about this instead? Tell me what you can give me, and maybe I won't kill you for lying to my face."

7f73cf10-397f-4150-b00f-8cf76eb0cdf9.Text: {n}A predatory gleam flashes in the beggar's eyes and fades. With visible regret, he touches the pocket where he used to keep the pistol he just sold you, then grumbles,{/n} "Maybe next time, then, eh?"

659ff390-9a0d-46e8-96ed-8f8c917b7c8b.Text: {n}Eyeing you suspiciously, the beggar mutters,{/n} "You must be out of your bloody mind. You won't last long here."

652dae13-b20a-4de9-820b-3103e3fb2bb0.Text: "Fair. Better to be alive and barefoot than a stiff in warm shoes, you follow me?"

ee0e68e8-67de-4259-b680-1be1a8f3e43b.Text: {n}The mutant sniffs the air loudly.{/n} "You reek of blood. That's not good. That smell draws a lot of attention 'round these parts. I'm outta here."

40ca4cb9-9b49-439a-ba67-6e664ca67295.Text: {n}As you take a better look at the beggar, you notice a certain detail that is at odds with the rest of his appearance, namely, his boots. It is not him wearing boots that catches your eye, but the indisputable fact that they are your boots.{/n}

e375ff49-3b47-4535-a3bf-526d3b57587c.Text: {n}The beggar's features are appalling to the point of being too offensive to look upon.{/n}

8ea7d1f1-4d29-46ce-96d8-df4e597b7982.Text: {n}The mutant casts a thoughtful look at his feet, spits on the ground, and says with confidence,{/n} "Don't think so."

e03d071a-8fc7-4b18-8ce0-ad953c5fa1f7.Text: {n}The mutant arches an eyebrow in bemusement.{/n} "Really? A gripping tale! And why should I give a crap?"

d6e0424c-0cd7-48e1-908d-5561398bcf29.Text: {n}He lets out a gleeful and caustic giggle.{/n} "I think I see how you got roughed up like that. I've looked at you for five seconds and I already want to put a bullet in your skull. Why should I help you?"

5bef4242-0358-4bbe-a59f-fe374c149a8a.Text: {n}The mutant's hand dives under his rags but fails to grab his weapon in time. He freezes and shrinks under the barrel of your gun.{/n} "Don't... P-please... What'd I ever do to you?"

b9b67907-c0f4-416b-8108-9e84f1ff2f85.Text: {n}The beggar reaches for his weapon... and stops when he realises he gave it to you. His repulsive face displays a snivelling grimace.{/n} "Got one over on me, eh? Don't hurt me... What'd I ever do to you?"

e2580b28-3b97-435d-905b-367275b4d0e7.Text: "Bring more interesting stuff to trade next time. Then again, looking at you, I don't think we'll be meeting again."

cc9292df-fbc1-4cdc-b51c-411fd7dec3a2.Text: {n}He grabs the priceless offering, grins, and starts shaking with anticipation.{/n} "Much obliged! Very much! Goodbye to you, strong {mf|master|mistress}!"

874e8564-74d6-43d7-aebd-608c2ebcbd91.Text: {n}His grotesque face shows signs of strenuous mental activity. Finally, he declares,{/n} "Deal. My baby for your pricey trinket. I'll sell it to the Shriekers, they love their shiny rubbish."

afe74b04-4ac4-4f27-9712-88dfa41a292e.Text: "Not convinced. Why don't you back off before I feel like proving that my gun is better than yours?"

2a967321-a5f6-4305-b104-21ea328ce633.Text: {n}The mutant weighs your weapon — or rather, the weapon that used to be yours — in his hand and grins.{/n} "Nice." {n}He looks up at you in surprise and adds sullenly,{/n} "What, you're still here? Get lost!"

ac659139-a5b6-4d65-a185-47768d547eae.Text: {n}The beggar's eyes pop out of their sockets. He does not believe you... or at least is trying not to.{/n} "Boots coated in poison? What kinda idiot would coat their own clothes in poison? Where's the sense in that, eh?"

39641105-1702-4105-ad64-c0420c99cc57.Text: {n}The beggar is lightning-quick: he pulls out a pistol from under his rags and aims it at you.{/n} "I suggest you go on your merry way, my new barefoot friend."

ec46d3a7-2efb-41dc-b1c3-0e7d2a732aea.Text: "Good one. You're a riot." {n}The mutant deftly pulls out a pistol and points it at you.{/n} "Here's my joke. What'll you give me not to skip to the punchline? Trust me, it's a killer!"

7eaa6c36-878e-4d19-b63a-0e807d1dd38a.Text: "Go eat a frag!" {n}The mutant swiftly takes off the boots and throws them at you.{/n} "There, you can have them back, you mad freak!"

25ad81db-06ab-49ac-9499-d626b654ac11.Text: "Bad move. Shoulda led with that while you still had your pistol." {n}You manage to grab the beggar's weapon and turn it away from you. The two of you struggle for a time, grunting with the effort...{/n}

81717685-9af8-4a7f-910a-761559785d0a.Text: "Wise words. I'll be going now. Glad we both got something out of this little meeting. I got your stuff, you got some precious experience."

e1e57122-f8a6-41c2-9c5f-2eb303b504e2.Text: {n}The beggar's hand lunges for something hidden under his rags, then freezes — you are too quick. He slowly reaches down and loosens the laces. A few moments later, you are once more the proud owner of a pair of boots.{/n} "Greedy little sleazebag."

298fafa7-4be2-45a1-bc00-8ff2facf056d.Text: {n}The mutant's expression is impenetrably calm.{/n} "Of course I'll keep them. They're mine. Not yours."

440b4686-6fc3-40e4-9e11-48462cf31dd0.Text: {n}The beggar looks at you sceptically, thinks for a moment, and then nods.{/n} "Fine. Who else should help a hapless soul in this accursed place if not another hapless sap, right? Come, I'll take you somewhere safe." {n}He beckons you to follow him...{/n}

48e7c7ab-107a-4775-b464-e309023df4c7.Text: "Yeah? Well, you had me fooled!" {n}The beggar looks relieved and giggles obsequiously, then pulls out his own weapon, and points it at you. His smile is gone.{/n} "Now, what do you reckon? Am I just giving you a scare too? What'll you give me for not blowing your brains out?"

fe71697d-98f4-44a4-b2c1-b31528ab5aed.Text: {n}The beggar slowly pulls out the pistol from under his rags, holding it by the end of the barrel, and hands it to you. He grunts sullenly,{/n} "I don't got nothing else. What'd you expect?"

5b5dd7e1-212e-48b3-ac4d-d058e6afcb80.Text: "You b—" {n}A neat hole forms squarely between the mutant's eyes.{/n}

86429255-3f6b-45dd-9351-7a08b0918982.Text: {n}The mutant fixes you with a look of hatred and scurries away. As he leaves, you hear him hiss a torrent of familiar profanities that almost makes you feel as though you are back home in the Koronus Expanse.{/n}

44dd5d9f-4cff-447c-8071-112af174a3ab.Text: "You wanna trade? I've got things to trade." {n}The beggar lifts his rags and you catch the dull glint of a pistol handle.{/n} "What've you got? Apart from your innards or whatever that thing is that keeps trying to fall outta your gut."

8a7acd64-d1f8-472b-910d-2b2de7d5f347.Text: {n}You are quick on the draw, but so is your opponent. You both stand still, holding each other at gunpoint. The mutant smiles maliciously.{/n} "You sure it's worth it?"

760c6e79-5a41-4471-a130-13e6bcb56c10.Text: {n}He quickly takes off the boots. The stench nearly makes you gag.{/n}

45a898f8-6fc0-4ff3-b068-7330fc9b2ce2.Text: {n}You seem to have made an equally poor impression on the wretched beggar. He sizes you up and rasps,{/n} "You look like a groxpat. How're you still breathing with wounds like that?"

794a2f68-e15c-4e63-8828-5f9a80410ca4.Text: "I figured that. A trade between two beggars... What a laugh."

d38068e5-fef9-4025-a4b8-f5d9a7adaa76.Text: "I got one of those already. And mine's meaner than yours."

7951da0c-0a32-4e7e-8601-3c71db46b6fb.Text: {n}You manage to grab the beggar's weapon and turn it away from you. The two of you struggle for a time, grunting with the effort...{/n}

596a836b-ca34-4f77-87ca-dd70fff2a710.Text: {n}The beggar heaves a sigh.{/n} "Not your day, is it? Bye." {n}A crushing impact to the chest drops you to your knees. Still reeling from the point-blank shot, you hear the beggar's footsteps.{/n}

c9c73cf8-1d70-4ba9-9a61-cc4de933f8b8.Text: {n}The beggar's eyes glaze over and his lower lip trembles. His mind is no longer here — his thoughts have turned inward.{/n} "I... I really did believe, once. Before I ended up here. And what am I now? I steal boots from corpses, I beg xenos and other scum for scraps. Throne damn it, what's become of me?"

c75b472a-5631-4cc0-93d0-8170365cdda8.Text: {n}As if released from a feverish haze that clouded his eyes for years, he looks around in disgust. Full of determination, he takes off the boots and hands them to you.{/n} "Take them. I have a job to do. For too long have I suffered the mockery of those pale-faced beasts. It's time I paid them back for snuffing out my humanity. So long!" {n}With an expression of grim resolve on his face, the beggar limps away from you.{/n}

b7bde870-2129-456a-a01d-343c52f97a4d.Text: {n}Perhaps if you had been holding your weapon from the start, you would have had a chance to beat the beggar to the draw. Instead, by the time you pull out your pistol, you are already staring down the barrel of the pistol in his hand.{/n} "Here's a lesson for you: it's considered bad taste in the spires to rummage for your weapon for too long. Except this lesson won't do you much good, unless you clear off right now."

fdb42b36-4fcb-48cf-be8f-1aa8a3d12ffc.Text: {n}With a crooked smirk, the mutant grabs the injector.{/n} "Oooh, a combat stimulant! The things you see when you use it! It might kill you, sure... but it's worth it!"

cbce9449-8a5c-44a6-81e0-53d7bd03a481.Text: {n}As you approach, he shrinks in apprehension and pointedly holds out his empty hands.{/n} "Back to playing more larks on me, are you?"

3cc6e116-3393-478b-be66-962009c3c624.Text: "If you got a complaint, I'm sure you'll find someone here who'd love to hear it."

d456692a-8d64-4b83-aae3-77e436d3ea9b.Text: {n}As you approach, he pales and hastily takes off his boots... your boots.{/n} "Please don't punish me, strong {mf|master|mistress}. Spare this wretched freak, crippled in both body and mind. Stay your hand, I beg you!"

79148fb6-c580-492e-a68b-4d88abec08a4.Text: {n}The beggar nods tensely.{/n} "If you're not about to rob me or kill me, I'm all for letting bygones be bygones."

f246338b-4283-4d6f-a3f3-d57455719e14.Text: {n}As you approach, his face crumples pitifully.{/n} "Are you gonna rob me again? Here, take my boots, they're all I've got." {n}The mutant hastily takes off his boots... your boots.{/n}

9b619c90-e396-4c88-b68d-9202865c163a.Text: "How about buying yourself a pair of boots?" {n}The beggar shows off his filthy legs and surprisingly decent boots... your boots.{/n}

c6d7ab21-3489-47f3-91bd-011469058f94.Text: {n}The beggar starts wailing at the top of his lungs, his words dissolving into a sticky ball of incoherent excuses, expressions of remorse, and pleas for mercy.{/n}

83ceea8a-814d-4c00-a511-df42e152a5e3.Text: "They're from a stiff that was lying in the corpse dump... A friend of mine pinched 'em. And gave 'em to me. I didn't steal nothing, I swear!" {n}His ugly face twists into a smug sneer.{/n}

90a067ce-9a54-4483-9ccb-4bb6ec5a09f6.Text: {n}The beggar refuses to die easily. He is desperately clinging to his life, choking on his own blood. Eventually, his protracted agony reaches its end.{/n}

801ba18b-1b60-4853-bcd0-3e9f912977c5.Text: {n}You do not feel any pain — not yet, at least. You merely watch in surprise as a spray of crimson fans through the air. You do not know when your hand seized the beggar's throat. Your fingers clench around it of their own accord. The mutant's eyes go wide and a rattle escapes his reeking mouth.{/n}

9dacc893-e654-4cb1-9588-fe453e6b309d.Text: "Thank you! Thank you kindly for your mercy!" {n}The beggar makes a swift exit, leaving behind a repugnant stench to remember him by.{/n}

c80dc1f5-0120-4b18-a544-78c3bf5ce39b.Text: {n}The hideous mutant does not look as cocky as the last time you met. Armed and not bleeding from a hundred wounds, you must be a more formidable sight.{/n}

5c764a13-4018-461c-aaaf-0530a864d577.Text: {n}He looks you up and down, then lowers his weapon slightly.{/n} "I understand. When the going gets tough, you can't afford to be picky. Come with me." {n}The mutant beckons you to follow him...{/n}

09bb6b93-9138-41f5-9784-11b3f1da1faf.Text: "No weapon at all? That's not good. This here's a bad place to be walking around unarmed. Could've at least found yourself one of these." {n}He pulls a pistol out of his rags and flaunts it by pointing it at your face for some reason.{/n} "A bit slow, are we? Empty your pockets."

45dfbe88-3a26-4053-b099-f85da1cbf684.Text: {n}He catches it with the deftness of an acrobat. His face takes on a hungry and servile expression.{/n} "Thank you, strong {mf|master|mistress}! May Commorragh be gracious to you!"

dbebc66a-6449-4ce2-8cfc-882d1ca9609f.Text: {n}He dies before he can wound you again. You force yourself to release your grip on his crushed larynx. The pain finally reaches you through the veil of adrenaline, but the sensation is hardly shocking. What is another wound to you when your body is already suffering from a hundred just like it?{/n}

803b2546-3b1d-4cf7-b1e0-66c3a24d4271.Text: {n}...then something in his wrist clicks, and a long blade coated with something foul thrusts out of it. A moment later, the blade sinks into your flesh.{/n}

b0ffbaf9-9223-481d-9c45-f6939d06ff79.Text: {n}The beggar's face contorts with anger. With a surprisingly strong kick, he knocks the pistol out of your hand. You latch onto his hand, and the would-be gunfight turns into a fierce struggle...{/n}

05bc29f4-765d-4daa-9847-fc7cb463c0df.Text: {n}The beggar sneers.{/n} "What will you give me for not bumping you off?"

8877c6cb-5d7a-405a-9e14-85737b5d7079.Text: Idira's forced separation from the Haemonculus's device that was connected to her mind was bound to have consequences. Cannot be removed by regular means

baf1007e-4712-45b2-8487-7eccb57a2643.Text: A terminal throat illness that slowly exhausts its victim. Cannot be removed by regular means

d3bb1136-def2-4bd3-881f-c50212732dd7.Text: The agony of the parasite in the Rogue Trader's body intensifies. Cannot be removed by regular means

8cd777c8-fad4-466e-a724-49b39ac509e1.Text: A dying parasite in the Rogue Trader's body that is poisoning {mf|his|her} mind with its hallucinogenic toxin. Cannot be removed by regular means

f2e0d12e-e106-4a18-b32d-c45087aece2b.Text: The Haemonculus's wicked art has hardened the Rogue Trader's body and imbued it with strength for a time.

e3334ef8-a32c-4267-8a19-fa8d80bfe371.Text: The anomalies of the Mangled Sector have stolen Abelard's health and vigour, aging him several decades. Cannot be removed by regular means

4a37a1c8-952b-476b-8961-3e76a59e4800.Text: The unholy augmetics were mercilessly removed from Pasqal's body. His body might be damaged but his spirit and devotion to the Omnissiah are strong and pure. Cannot be removed by regular means

15db063b-9b04-45ed-aef4-88a8f4622e81.Text: A blasphemous xenos artisan has incorporated unholy augmetics into Pasqal's body. Cannot be removed by regular means

1a493964-6033-4934-9cfc-44e3fd88b3d7.Text: Every movement and breath reveals new shades of intolerable pain. All you can do is grit your teeth and conquer it, as an obedient specimen should. Cannot be removed by regular means

05f30b56-e6c8-4c9d-b17f-35ceee1b51ee.Text: Your bones have deformed, curved, and misaligned, making your movements clumsy and your body feel alien. Cannot be removed by regular means

1e4fb4a3-cf0b-4efd-85ba-150427518652.Text: Your body is mangled by cruel torture. You are on the verge of death. Cannot be removed by regular means, but with enough stimms, you will be able to bear it just long enough to find a more efficient solution.

ce5ed9ef-e167-4fad-a581-732a3fcefe44.Text: You can feel something crawling inside your eye. You have lost most of the vision in it. Cannot be removed by regular means

38c74cd8-872e-4037-bfa5-d7c9931217b1.Text: Your tendons have been carefully cut with a thin and sharp blade in order to cripple you without completely robbing you of the ability to move. Cannot be removed by regular means

61c4bfd4-1985-4b02-a842-e67a55737072.Text: Something has upped your skin's sensitivity one hundredfold. Even a slight breeze now causes you searing pain. Cannot be removed by regular means

38e0fba8-1d14-4590-9a1a-6cabde402903.Text: [Command your cyber-eagle to soar over your head] "I am a Rogue Trader, the Emperor's anointed, and I will guide you to His light! But for that, I will need the Commissar's head — who is with me?"

5bc92b03-8bc2-4785-9d8c-ae16f0894f58.Text: "We may be in Commorragh, but I am still a Rogue Trader, and you will greet me as befits my rank. On your knees."

7b8a748a-7447-4576-acd8-e0fbc48fc8ad.Text: "A genuine Commissar in the heart of Commorragh. And here I thought the surprises were over."

417805ab-6a54-43b1-b59b-67e4dd7110a8.Text: [Attack] "Malice will help me survive if I bring him your head."

15ee6885-e7ce-49ca-981f-3438ea51806e.Text: "Founded a resistance cell, did you? I wonder why you have not been killed yet. Most suspicious..."

66a7bd13-44f6-4676-b58f-c9abd415fff4.Text: "Very well. What is your plan, Commissar?"

682fea90-ff4c-40be-b66d-88933ec995ae.Text: "Very well. We will go with the Commissar's plan."

c65616bd-4007-4fea-bb08-b05019d1eebc.Text: "I have other business to attend to."

f2d4ba90-5f92-4231-98ad-314fd4f3a5d6.Text: "What were the circumstances of your capture?"

84498fd8-dae5-444b-9d83-f005c21f8ac6.Text: "Malice sent me here for your head. However, I have no desire to cause you harm."

ffa67a13-2693-4d64-a8de-2ab27887e859.Text: "Then I shall have to kill you too, Argenta."

97a7b142-4d73-45fb-b51d-5aa144e4b8bf.Text: "How do I know if you are a real Commissar? Care to present some proof? You may start by shooting one of these slobs."

0412b6eb-39e3-4a80-ac0e-1f579dfd7ac3.Text: "Keep up the good work, Commissar Sotniy!"

cb822286-f712-4c96-9f7d-d9c8ece9423a.Text: "This is a farce. The Drukhari will swat you like flies the moment you cause them the slightest inconvenience."

9cb324e7-f389-4737-abe9-203018f4c48d.Text: "You must have faced many a danger here."

82a7b2cd-7609-4904-88f7-e708a56420d4.Text: "You know as well as I do that he is doomed. If I kill him, we will gain a proper ally and thus improve our chances of escaping."

0b95c0ab-6f2a-4a42-b97e-f88f09818b83.Text: "I do not trust him. In this place, everyone is a liar."

f31f5b86-4efc-4362-8278-ce5c01ab095b.Text: "To the void with the Emperor and his servants! This is not the Imperium! If we hope to survive, we must be... flexible in our choices."

03edf06b-ad35-4fc3-b7e4-0edfbf87ca12.Text: "How have you managed to accomplish so much?"

b64226d9-321e-44b6-90d5-a1da2f9beb36.Text: "Who are the people under your command?"

296e6f78-4779-42ee-96ae-4cccac0c18e6.Text: [Attack] "I believe my original plan is more sound than what you are proposing. I shall gain Malice's support by killing you."

18bd7273-fb5a-49d8-8d62-df0b431dfda7.Text: {n}The stately man in a Commissar's coat and a tall service cap greets you with the sign of the Aquila and a solemn announcement:{/n} "Another loyal servant of the Throne has found {mf|his|her} way to us through these confounded catacombs! Fear not! Approach! If you have faith in the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g}, then you will find only allies here."

0f147042-2054-4ecd-9265-f3a8698a5329.Text: {n}The Commissar's speech is brisk and energetic:{/n} "Some of our own have captured a small xenos ship that was moored for repairs at a remote unused dock. They eliminated the crew quietly, but left the pilot alive to sail the ship back to {g|Encyclopedia:Realspace}realspace{/g}. We can get to the dock through a dimensional portal located at our old base."

459ea734-beec-46ae-8a81-462a4958bc04.Text: "By that time, our superior officers had already fallen, so I led my people in a bayonet charge. We taught the xenos a lesson in blood, and then... I have no memory of how the battle ended. I came to consciousness in this foul place, disarmed and on the verge of death. I thought I'd die, but it was not yet time for the Emperor to release me from His service."

882f8992-44b5-4bc9-81fe-8442a7389620.Text: "Every morsel of intelligence we have acquired and every step of progress we have made was paid for in blood and pain. The information about the dying Kabal that dreads entering the docks of its enemies and instead moors in an abandoned area was forced out of captive xenos. The knowledge of the portal was bought in exchange for one half of all the weapons we had stockpiled. And taking that ship cost us several lives, each of which was worth more than this whole blasted city."

d3bfe86e-bafb-446f-93d9-7df327d8cfbe.Text: "Fate has a twisted sense of humour. Of all the grubby corners in the galaxy, I've somehow managed to run into a Commissar in the Dark City." {n}Jae scoffs.{/n} "Praise be to the Exalted One, He must be very, very busy right now trying to keep me alive."

d660c25b-2d4f-4055-804e-2840c0949651.Text: "Indeed! The Emperor protects!" {n}The Commissar's imperious, booming voice repeats your call, and the rest follow suit.{/n}

e80bf2c6-2cd5-43f0-bcdf-50f839d00752.Text: {n}He answers with dignity,{/n} "Yes, I have the honour of serving the God-Emperor as a bearer of that honourable station."

3d4f488a-c3dd-4a70-b6a7-f661516c9e4b.Text: {n}The man gets a better look at you, then fervently commands,{/n} "All of you, kneel before the {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}, the God-Emperor's steward beyond the borders of the blessed Imperium!"

d2406c36-0964-45e6-8631-1d6d2d6d6523.Text: {n}The man responds proudly,{/n} "Wherever His warriors go, there must be a Commissar to embolden their spirit and inspire the doubtful. And all whom you see here are His warriors." {n}He gestures at the people around you.{/n}

b8badd38-1444-4330-8c1d-e6075f1f851d.Text: {n}The Commissar's plan is bold, and the odds of it succeeding are bleak. However, it seems improbable that anyone in Commorragh is prepared for such decisive covert action from the city's prisoners, so the Commissar and his people have the element of surprise on their side.{/n}

92e4d5bd-d76b-4dcd-8b48-c0bcb0faf2a1.Text: {n}One might think that the archetypical Commissars from {g|Encyclopedia:AstraMilitarum}Imperial Guard{/g} propaganda posters are all life drawings of this man. He has a large and powerful jaw, his eyes are hard and fearless, and the small scar over his brow adds a certain rugged charm to his features. His coat, though worn, has been diligently cleaned and mended, and the skull on his tall cap has been polished to a shine.{/n}

09a110e6-ce66-4079-a744-a1e1d67f8579.Text: "Was it Sergeant Vigastes's squad that was tasked with capturing the ship? Did he survive?"

410ee2be-a903-4918-9249-ff1826056d61.Text: {n}The man replies with clipped precision,{/n} "Commissar Iako Sotniy, but my brothers and sisters in arms prefer to call me simply 'the Commissar.' I was assigned to a regiment of the Vickentian Zouaves, and I fought in the battle for the world of Kemalt Secundus, where I was wounded and taken prisoner while unconscious. Having recovered from my wounds, I carry on fighting the wicked {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g} as the head of the local resistance cell, which I founded."

e1f014c7-66f7-4778-9f0a-5a1ea43cd473.Text: {n}The Commissar observes his humble army and says with enthusiasm,{/n} "Our first ongoing objective is to keep bolstering our ranks by seeking out prisoners who haven't yet lost faith and willingness to oppose our nefarious jailers. Our second priority is to arm ourselves and train — I teach my soldiers the basics of Guard tactics in order to mould them into a fully-fledged assault unit."

404afe01-0770-491b-8801-b95b4aa6876e.Text: "They've tried, oh, how they've tried! But every time, the Emperor protected His servant." {n}The Commissar smiles fearlessly.{/n}

774764a3-4f38-4ea6-9b12-35e6ff5f4da6.Text: {n}Argenta's expression darkens, and she says mournfully,{/n} "You... are right. A {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}'s life is too precious to gamble away. And yet I grieve that we have to save it by such ignoble means."

52784248-0db6-4771-8f0c-485266690cb2.Text: {n}Argenta's expression darkens, and she says mournfully,{/n} "Although I disagree, I have sworn to accompany you and protect you. I will not break that oath even here, in this den of unspeakable profanity."

99d53678-1a2d-4d46-ba1b-87110af640a7.Text: {n}The Commissar lets out a contemptuous laugh and nods approvingly at you.{/n} "That scaled miscreant has long since wanted me dead. He craves my soldiers, he forced us from our base to this perilous place. But he will pay for his schemes soon, once my plan is set in motion. It is a disgrace to serve one such as he — you ought to join our ranks instead! Together, we will break out of this accursed city."

35b708d6-699d-488e-8925-9766c432ae3c.Text: "We engaged the enemy on the world of Kemalt Secundus in the Markayn Marches of the Calixis Sector. The loathsome foes of Humanity were known to launch raids in the area, so we received orders to defend the good subjects of the Imperium."

1f9eb0eb-7f95-46a8-b8b6-66ef61b35395.Text: "Farewell and keep the faith. The Emperor protects, {mf|brother|sister}!"

c5885036-b790-4814-a272-acc42eb373d6.Text: "Brothers and sisters in arms, destroy the traitor who kills at the behest of xenos!"

52d8a3d6-8ce4-432c-8562-e53a80f923ae.Text: {n}The Commissar's answer is calm and composed.{/n} "A Commissar's duty is to root out cowardice and doubt among His warriors. There are no cowards or dissenters in my troop."

e186d964-1ae7-4a2f-bd44-4265eceeeb6f.Text: "Will do! We stand for the Imperium!" {n}The Commissar turns his burning gaze to his fighters and they erupt in a roar of battle cries.{/n}

689be033-c61d-4ac0-8c8a-cff2361b246f.Text: "Better to die for the Emperor than to live for oneself alone!" {n}There is not a single hint of doubt or fear in his voice.{/n}

25ebb5b6-8087-445e-a578-c338ce0418de.Text: "I hope you will join us in this struggle."

8e03406d-dfc2-4e22-85da-d06eb5fd8123.Text: {n}Every step in the Commissar's plan, when taken separately, seems viable enough. When combined together, however, the chances of success become so ludicrously slim that only a complete madman would agree to this strategy.{/n}

f3545f32-865e-4da9-8b14-5f368cfc1544.Text: "Trust me, {name}, these people can be relied upon. In their darkest hour, they found a source of resolve in faith, and each among them is ready to give their life for their righteous cause. Many already have."

f52c08bb-e87e-4241-8281-6d94528eb09e.Text: "Most importantly, we gather information and plot our escape. And the day when we pave the road to freedom with the corpses of detestable xenos is nigh!" {n}The Commissar's rallying shout makes his people square their shoulders, proudly straighten their backs, and respond with a fierce war cry.{/n}

383f38fe-90f9-45a5-ab2d-c4e45d765bea.Text: "When the profaners descended upon us, we gave them no quarter. The enemy was routed, and my unit drove them back to their ships. Our counter-attack drove a wedge into their advancing horde and thwarted the invasion, but it also meant that we were cut off on both flanks and surrounded. We fought valiantly for several hours to stop the enemy ranks from reforming for a new onslaught... until we depleted our munitions reserves."

dc742ee9-45b5-4ac6-b20d-7b695db3d540.Text: {n}The Commissar mutters scornfully,{/n} "What power do contemptible inhumans have to threaten true faith?"

0052882a-91b9-4c97-bbf4-aa11a3fe4666.Text: "Regrettably, Malice and his Shriekers drove us out and took over the base, so the first order of business will be to confront him there. I propose that you take him by surprise and deliver the first strike — we will support the attack from the outside."

137f6523-e4b1-43f0-8c39-ddaa3a5c50c5.Text: "{name}, wait!" {n}Argenta looks at you with a stunned expression.{/n} "This man is our friend and the Emperor's dutiful servant! Why would you seek his death?"

cd540529-56c2-4f54-8754-380c42e2cfe4.Text: "The Emperor protected him, and he did not fail the Emperor. Vigastes is in good health and waiting for us to arrive."

68a3b513-67ce-4a15-8349-739eff9ae9c1.Text: {n}The Commissar examines you critically.{/n} "You do not look too badly injured, and we are suffering from a severe shortage of medical supplies. Better to save what we have for critical situations."

afc6643c-953e-4494-8e60-3ac587d9bac3.Text: "If the mon-keigh have managed to capture the vessel, they were permitted to do so. If they were permitted to do so..." {n}Yrliet casts you a meaningful look.{/n} "The plan is doomed to fail."

54200e35-0cfa-4b9e-9bd3-be9eb8c30a54.Text: "The streets of Commorragh are like a maze of spider webs into which the Dark Ones lure unfortunate souls. Each thread that leads to freedom turns out to be another cruel deception in the end."

2e28b87b-41f6-400d-bc44-0d896b77f5d7.Text: {n}The two-headed eagle lets out an intimidating cry as it displays the full spread of its wings. Light reflects off the bird's gilded augmetics, creating a halo behind you. Among the endless labyrinth of xenos structures, this living symbol of the Imperium appears as a true miracle.{/n}

dbdaab07-7e1e-4077-a8af-2ba7bb9b240b.Text: {n}Someone exclaims in awe,{/n} "It's an omen! The Emperor Himself has sent the holy Aquila to us along with His anointed messenger!" {n}As more stunned voices join in, a number of fighters turn their weapons against the Commissar and charge into battle.{/n}

e40247cf-a937-473b-9d58-19377f581a3a.Text: {n}Feathers ruffled, {petname} suddenly cries out, causing the attackers to waver for a moment.{/n}

be1bad05-c258-4c17-a6f7-e8b0b5b41770.Text: {n}Argenta breathes a sigh of relief.{/n} "Thank the Emperor."

baa4fa68-9987-4322-8d19-2c6842e46c46.Text: {n}Argenta's eyes flash, and she proclaims furiously,{/n} "The {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g} have tainted your mind, {name}. I will not let you harm this man! Abandon your ill intent, or you will fall!"

4813e8ec-ea65-4512-b2b7-67a58342d8ff.Text: "You have betrayed me, Sister Argenta? Defector! Your faith is weak and pitiful!"

e42d0c12-9118-461a-9264-a098a7dad433.Text: {n}The Commissar pulls out an injector and deftly gives you a shot of healing solution. You notice a Munitorum symbol on the injector.{/n} "Medicine is in short supply here, but we do not abandon our own. May you be well, my {mf|brother|sister} in arms! The Emperor has given us no leave to die."

a24b3e1c-6e4b-4dcc-8781-c4653d9a9a75.Text: {n}The Commissar makes a helpless gesture.{/n} "Forgive me, but there is nothing more I can spare. I already gave you the only fast-acting stimulant I had."

2d6c1701-a912-4068-879a-d010ac256cfd.Text: {n}The Commissar's speech is vehement and decisive.{/n} "My valorous comrades and I sabotage the enemy's activities while we devise our plan of escape."

a49df371-cc88-4600-b08e-422ef233946a.Text: "The core of my unit is composed of prisoners from various Astra Militarum regiments and a number of planetary guards. They formed the assault squad that went on the special operation under Sergeant Vigastes's command. The rest are common people who had the misfortune of being captured by {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g}. Serfs, nobility, Administratum clerks, technomats, void workers, monks... Anyone who found the courage to take up arms. The only kinds you won't find here are heretics, lawbreakers, and cowards."

cd0ff5d6-a29d-4b76-8f1b-7c05639cb34a.Text: {n}The Commissar laughs and exclaims approvingly,{/n} "My brothers and sisters in arms, a new fighter has joined our ranks! The Emperor's grace is with us!"

9b37ca43-483f-406b-b29e-c9316d21ac14.Text: "Why do you send people to the arena?"

74c154e4-d9bb-45a2-94e8-6dd319764a0c.Text: [Attack] "You are relieved of your post, Commissar!"

8bb3c21b-0bba-4d21-be33-8cfa69fd6347.Text: "I have other business to attend to."

cf38bd6c-9294-4750-8d50-9faffd472754.Text: [Nod at Malice] "Was it not our intention to kill him?"

ee706189-cfc5-44f8-9261-0b3d457fbbfc.Text: "Either let him go or execute him. I abhor torture."

a52f11ff-25e8-412b-ba1a-94f7d26a8947.Text: "He is my trophy, you know, not yours. Hand him over."

eb0ab57a-3970-471c-8ee6-b64160298422.Text: [Nod at the fighters] "What do you think those people will do to you if I tell them what your true business is?"

fe8e3404-8f31-47a1-868b-10b73dd5b103.Text: "You are smart and resourceful, if nothing else. You know how to survive. I like people like you. You are pardoned."

809b8a1f-e8b4-49b6-9855-b51d400e4484.Text: "Keeping him in a cage is pointless. He could be of so much more use to you."

141bbeb5-84ed-47da-86d6-68edffa02dd4.Text: "I believe you have a problem. I survived."

83720e3e-c227-407a-bc05-9f635914998c.Text: "What did Malice do to cross you? I want the truth."

eb099228-c573-4fd9-a9ed-7ab674508bfc.Text: [Strike and leave a bloody wound on the Commissar's face] "Do not try to deceive me ever again, worm."

21f70c74-f4c8-41e4-9eef-a3f2a73f289f.Text: [Attack] "I'm afraid I will kill you after all. This is personal."

90d2bea6-a873-4388-a383-85b0cafe3257.Text: "What do you intend to do now?"

230d0c8d-785f-41ae-a7d0-9c4c97116bf3.Text: "How did you manage to work out a deal with the Wyches?"

eb3031de-f958-4ca3-994f-5435c6118bd7.Text: [Attack] "Hear me, people! This liar serves the xenos! You have been deceived! To arms!"

91df5050-c4e0-41e4-b6e6-a0e4d1b0676d.Text: "How did you come to be in Commorragh?"

a1408173-ba74-49fb-98ac-1db1c78bf141.Text: "Why did you decide to masquerade as a Commissar?"

913a6647-d3a4-43dc-9058-f308e110f942.Text: "You look like you are enjoying yourself here in Commorragh."

872eb130-f360-4799-8736-799c9d4abb80.Text: "Listen to me! The Commissar is a liar and a traitor who has sent many people to their deaths to save his own hide and stay in the xenos' good graces. Seize him!"

d4a0b645-18df-441f-974c-2708c9c85295.Text: [Draw your weapon] "If you are with him, then you too shall die as traitors."

4d042da2-c8ec-4a5f-be90-1ea9e5f3a265.Text: "I am looking for a 'maestro of flesh.' Who do you suppose that is?"

1ea3b861-a878-456e-8b19-807df7b9caea.Text: Offered the Commissar in Commorragh to serve for the good of the Imperium.

7f1e40ad-aed3-40b0-98de-69d63da0b594.Text: "You may be a fake, but you have the makings of a true leader. People follow you, and, as hollow as your promises are, the courage that you inspire is real. The Imperium needs people like you."

559b5e10-f9c2-44a0-918b-398d90b1fc4c.Text: [Nod at Vigastes] "Aren't you worried that he might spill your little secret?"

26f50458-4239-4803-bc25-dfab38de400d.Text: "Argenta, I shall be the one to dispense justice. And I shall do so at a time of my choosing."

486564b4-2591-4557-a1c6-406e9f2fbd69.Text: "Instead of staging a fake escape, you could stage a real one. You have the resources, you have the people — so use them. The Emperor will guide you."

3c64f4c7-9109-4fa2-9e61-cbdb949ee9f6.Text: [Gesture at the resistance fighters] "Argenta, stop. Or else those who do not know the whole truth might suffer."

4bb740b8-1b8b-4c4f-aeac-59e204a7abb2.Text: "That was a joke. As if you could make a good leader! Keep playacting."

59159bb2-b739-4e39-ba26-15563a88d7c9.Text: "My brothers and sisters! It is time for you to meet our greatest ally! Rogue Trader {name} von Valancius {mf|himself|herself} is part of the resistance! I ask you, how can we fail with someone so mighty fighting on our side?"

c8dd47eb-5265-4e61-8481-ac3a96f11833.Text: "The maleficent {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g} have already tried to kill {mf|him|her} in the arena, yet their efforts were for naught! The {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} protects!" {n}The Commissar gives his inspirational speech while looking you right in the eye without a shred of shame. His words draw smiles of amazement and exultation from the people around him. You have never seen any of them before.{/n}

a72f1901-da20-481e-b0e3-c350be5603af.Text: "So I provide that spice to the Wyches, and they give me equipment, food, and protection. I guess that means my work is appreciated."

00ae4b60-d1cf-4cc0-8ad1-d9842e29be65.Text: {n}The Commissar makes a placating gesture and lowers his voice.{/n} "Yes, yes, you got me, I'm a traitorous maggot. Just keep it down, will you?"

0bb9a19f-446c-4c86-bd58-c70f430508bd.Text: "Wait, you're serious? Escape from this foul nest of misery, just like that? Yeah, right! Then again, I suppose I do have weapons, provisions, fighters..." {n}The Commissar's mocking smile slips away, leaving him deep in thought. He glances at you in surprise, as if seeing you for the very first time.{/n} "Do you really mean it? The whole thing about getting out of here and starting over?"

76ccf6af-4a1d-4c7b-bd38-3dc61aa6fb4f.Text: "Damn it! I'll miss her patronage... though the same can't be said of her high-handed manner and her habit of using sharp objects to bring 'fun' to any conversation. Well, I'll just have to win over a new patroness." {n}The Commissar smiles nonchalantly.{/n}

784f75b9-9c48-4b1c-b22d-43cc256613d8.Text: {n}The Commissar shrugs.{/n} "Just trying to be useful. The Wych Cult of the Fatal Thirst enjoys this little show I've put on. Killings don't amuse them all that much, they want something more... flavourful. Those people think they're just a step away from salvation, and then they realise where they are. The combination of despair, pain of betrayal, horror, and broken hopes — it adds spice to their death agonies."

efb7a5eb-3183-4318-9c5d-114c3f6cca08.Text: {n}He laughs, looking pleased.{/n} "Of course not. I can tell you from experience that they beat all the brains and imagination out of Commissars during training. I was a nobody from a penal legion of the {g|Encyclopedia:AstraMilitarum}Astra Militarum{/g}."

26e71bfd-bd9b-4696-8e82-c7a4a3fa6279.Text: "As you will." {n}Argenta sighs grimly. She glares at the Commissar and says with conviction,{/n} "We are not finished here, Iako Sotniy. This is not a pardon, merely a sentence stayed."

dbe9e617-d008-4fe3-a3f1-66998aaa1bc0.Text: {n}Argenta turns to you with a look of absolute rage.{/n} "Every breath this miscreant takes might cost another deceived soul their life!"

76bff0b1-b551-4f6e-818f-5a5574c5c541.Text: "The Emperor protects, comrade!" {n}The Commissar expertly hides his derisive smile under a grimace of lofty pride.{/n}

7e45196c-3e78-4acf-8c99-51da8d142268.Text: "My brothers and sisters in arms, we've been betrayed! To battle! Let us spill the blood of {mf|he|she} who obeys the unhallowed whims of xenos! For the Emperooor!"

5d73c971-a63b-473d-b686-4df52fcb005c.Text: "The viper is surprisingly hard to kill — he's chock full of life support {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}augmetics{/g}. I figured a new pet would be a nice bonus to claiming victory and having the den back. Besides, new recruits need a target to practise their aim on, right?"

8e89534c-e9bb-4f5e-85e8-68d7fb849cbf.Text: {n}The Commissar answers with a smug, confident smile.{/n} "Care to find out? Let's see who they believe, their 'brother in arms' who promises them an expeditious escape, or the highborn loudmouth without a concrete plan?"

a58a845c-2c30-4239-ad10-8e93b780e641.Text: "Oh, yes. A supplier of meat for the arena, locked up in a cage. What beautiful and uplifting symbolism. The image alone is enough to get some of our fighters off."

35353e9c-27a8-46f6-aeab-ebc871472ef9.Text: "Hey, now. Why don't we take turns torturing him instead? I'm not greedy. The Emperor doesn't like people who are."

1b459f65-2128-466f-ab4b-4452b6255948.Text: "You suggest that we let him die? After all that he has done? After he condemned so many of our own to a death for the ungodly pleasures of xenos?" {n}The Commissar's fervent shouting permeates the den.{/n} "Will we grant this vicious spawn an easy death? Never! Never! Never!"

a41a18c4-ec46-4e54-a78d-f79113b43097.Text: "You're not thinking of striking a deal with this crafty beast, are you? A word to the wise: it's the surest way to die. That spawn has wiles like you wouldn't believe. He convinces you to trade a cup of water for a battleship, then you blink, and you've got no water, no battleship, only a head shot full of holes."

287af036-27aa-4a03-a6c9-1a1cd1ecc73b.Text: "Don't get me wrong, I'm not being greedy. Feel free to stop by and admire his misery at any time."

2fcedd11-80be-4199-a6c0-0a89718583ba.Text: "Is that a problem? You're not going to... I don't know... kill me, are you? That would be most unwise. Malice used to be the one who could get you things to survive, but now I've taken over. If you kill me, who will supply you with good weapons, stimulants, armour?"

0da1aeaa-5df9-4726-a28d-de2b515ac523.Text: "He robbed me of what was mine. When that scaled freak realised I'd been left without a patron, he brought his gang to my den — this den — and took it away. And my arena portal with it. Then he went on grazing on my pastures and snatching new arrivals who were supposed to be mine."

55cc64dd-264c-4f6a-9ab0-3e444f62412b.Text: "I'll keep supplying meat for the arena. Without Malice around, all human captives will be mine to collect, and I'll have plenty of material to delight our gracious hosts with."

95a59363-4ccc-4f20-9266-3d0d09509d7c.Text: "I happened to find myself in the arena, and... I did whatever I could to survive, which entertained the audience quite a bit. One of the Wyches, Tazarra, took notice of me. She found me and said that I could serve them either with my brains and charisma, or with my blood and guts."

e944d78a-e079-4ec2-b3cc-e14f679d4c4c.Text: {n}The Commissar smirks.{/n} "Oh, you really shouldn't have. I can shout things too, you see. I wonder who they'll listen to."

3282591a-2f69-4375-a08b-b2b88768aa3c.Text: {n}The Commissar fixes his cap with surprising composure and purposefulness.{/n} "That's a shame. We could have become allies."

285668c1-8d43-4166-8990-e91e37836788.Text: {n}He presses a hand to his face. The blood that is streaming through his fingers makes his heroic profile look even more so.{/n} "That... was fair... Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

8c7779ed-7672-4dd7-b2c4-43588a27c15c.Text: "Well, the Emperor does want his loyal children to support each other. Consider this humble gift my congratulations for not dying in the arena."

a594c748-39f5-441a-a65e-85a5760f4eb3.Text: "Glad to hear we have an agreement. Our 'comrades' will be ecstatic to have an actual Rogue Trader with us. With bait like that, they'll swallow whatever lies we feed them."

efef6c80-2458-4e35-b4e1-3d0eb2b10c6c.Text: "You can take something from our stocks. Consider it my show of gratitude for disposing of Malice."

3d0dd404-d3b6-4fa8-baf2-15a37b9ee262.Text: "Ask away. If you feel like becoming a partner, just say the word — I'm all for it."

63884f27-af48-4da1-9ef6-7358ff993521.Text: "I advise you to consider a partnership between us."

bc9152fa-9229-43e6-ba10-0f976d08bdb7.Text: "I've got nothing to hide. There can be no foibles in a disciplinary officer's past and present." {n}The Commissar winks at you.{/n}

eea5574b-fc07-4a03-ac8f-072a28ca5714.Text: "What do you mean by that? Are you asking what my name is? It's Iako Sotniy, I didn't lie about that. You want to know my trade? I've got none. I was born in a hive that was suffocating from overpopulation. All I did my whole life was just... survive, using whatever means fate would throw my way."

f86a1e9f-2b4b-4fc6-a509-9db2aa874c04.Text: "They were forming an {g|Encyclopedia:AstraMilitarum}Astra Militarum{/g} regiment on my planet. Thousands of morons bought the Commissars' groxshit about rations and the glorious duty that is protecting the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}. I wasn't one of them, of course. However, it soon turned out that those thousands of volunteers weren't enough."

4886caf8-f768-49b5-a672-4948a6e8ea77.Text: "Well, first off, because it's ironic. And besides... it's a handy disguise. No one ever looks at the Commissar's face — they look at his cap, his coat, his belt. Plus, simpletons like my former fellow Guardsmen think a Commissar can't lie... Idiots. The Commissar always lies."

7ef36671-2cc0-4204-bc5c-58f18e03af56.Text: "You seem surprised. You're the {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} here. You're the one whose former life was sweeter than this one. But for a commoner like me, our beloved Imperium is just as much of a deadly, treacherous, deceitful place where everyone wants to use you and kill you."

d6fa544d-eb05-4fb7-92ff-65cd7cc4791a.Text: "How about a deal? You take part in my show, and I give you access to the stores of 'the resistance.' You just keep your mouth shut and your finger off the trigger."

8d0acdfd-73e6-4082-8634-47175f0766c1.Text: "Traitor! You condemned them to death! You lied to us! And now I have come to exact retribution!"

bf82ccff-d8cb-43e2-a3a7-df79a9943325.Text: {n}The Commissar's smile becomes unpleasant.{/n} "Sister Argenta, what are these accusations I'm hearing? Could it be that the horrors of combat have rattled you so? Have you been blinded by the ensuing madness?" {n}He adds a well-measured dash of pointed suspicion to his voice.{/n} "Or has our cunning enemy poisoned your mind with some wicked influence?"

028d90c1-bb73-4ab4-83e6-0dfff2867ac3.Text: "In the name of the Emperor, I sentence you to death, Iako Sotniy! For the betrayal of every soul you sent to the slaughter with Sergeant Vigastes!"

bf826d9e-1a43-42c0-8a98-02f657cf0b35.Text: {n}Argenta sighs grimly and gives the Commissar a look of intense loathing.{/n} "I will not risk the lives of those you have deceived. But make no mistake: this isn't over."

bd31baa8-5ea1-4e71-b37d-052c3fec401e.Text: "The righteous will hear the truth in our words. They won't support the traitor! But if we leave them in the dark, they will become his next victims!"

26740088-4cb3-4bb5-984a-4f716abb9973.Text: "Arenas are the wellsprings of life in this heinous place. The {g|Encyclopedia:Drukhari}Drukhari{/g} are forced to feed on psychic energy born of pain and fear, or else they wither and degrade. That's why they go to these gladiatorial arenas — they're like feasts where Drukhari stuff themselves with people's suffering. And Wych Cults are the rulers of these bloody carousals."

5ac1f018-a4ef-4f47-8c38-548a2706436a.Text: "How poetic. I don't know of anyone who goes by that moniker, although... when you said 'maestro,' I immediately thought of the Anatomical Opera. That fancy title sounds like it would fit Tervantias the Archmachinator."

b8890f03-44d9-4c16-afb8-df35f176f609.Text: "The Chasm is the turf of the Cult of the Fatal Thirst, which is led by three Succubi: Tazarra, Keykeross, and Sinisthoria. Keykeross is typically the one in charge of arena fights while Tazarra goes on raids to harvest new fighters. But it's no secret that Sinisthoria is the most fearsome and powerful of the three. She's the one who forged the alliance between the Cult and the Reaving Tempest... though for some reason, she has been avoiding the spotlight lately."

68f03808-0aff-4199-ac5f-7373d48126bb.Text: {n}He barely stops himself from bursting into laughter.{/n} "Oh, give me a break! 'I'm telling ya, Iako! Sure, the Imperium treated ya like dirty cannon fodder before, but NOW it really needs ya, I promise!' Even if I were an exemplary leader and a real Commissar, who cares? This isn't the Imperium. The game is different here."

baeeba29-33a8-45d8-9e43-9acf5dc4634b.Text: "Nice one, you got me! Maybe you can help me with recruitment since you've got such a way with words? We'll laugh about it together later!"

bddafb39-fb59-4987-8d6f-efabfa2bf5b8.Text: "Void damn it! Now I can't get it out of my head! I'll... I'll think about what you said. I need to come up with an escape plan. A real plan." {n}You feel as if he has just undergone some indescribable change, as if now you are looking not at a lying fraud, but at a true hero of the Imperium.{/n}

fad90496-324f-4cfd-8cb4-6eedb5d9ea6c.Text: "Tell me, do you honestly think that the incoherent blubbering of a cripple who just got rescued from Drukhari imprisonment will convince anyone in here? Those monsters tortured the poor lad, he's been through so much! No wonder he's lost his marbles and sees traitors everywhere! Vigastes is no fool, he knows I always come out on top. Now you know it too! Isn't that great?" {n}The Commissar grins and winks at Vigastes, who merely continues to glare at him.{/n}

ecd864f0-ad32-4315-9856-4546f38d05ed.Text: {n}However, the soldiers seem hesitant to comply. They glance back and forth distrustfully between the Commissar and the {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_MOT_GreatDeed}known hero of the Imperium{/d} who has challenged him.{/n}

0df729b2-1d9f-47cc-a087-aeaae8bc6d3b.Text: {n}Before the soldiers can process your words, the Commissar starts clamouring again:{/n} "Attack, my fellows! Death to the traitors! Stand fast!"

a8724207-4e74-4ba7-9f78-5c0ab9797a53.Text: {n}The soldiers swarm the screaming Commissar, burying him under a pile of bodies, out of which blood-stained fists and gun stocks emerge before sinking back in again. The Commissar's cap, torn from its owner's head, flies out of the crowd and lands at your feet — the only confirmation that his reign of treachery is over.{/n}

8de06723-3187-4dd9-bb4b-7ac18325e3c5.Text: {n}The Commissar lets out an abrasive laugh.{/n} "Well, I can understand your frustration... For such a {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_MOT_Glory}famed figure{/d} to have fallen for such a simple trap! Why, if word of this travelled as far as the tales of your former accomplishments, your good name would be ruined!"

7d04dd94-9d54-4d5e-96dc-2e1fef0b5317.Text: {n}Malice looks horribly maimed. One of his arms has almost been ripped off and now is hanging on by sinew alone. His acidic voice, however, is the same as before, and so is the bloodthirsty gleam in his eyes.{/n} "Just their aim? What about their close combat skills? Let me out... Make me suffer. Pit me against three of yours, five of yours... unarmed. Good entertainment for your people, is it not?"

0757f416-8a3d-454f-8470-df8d7ee9a6a6.Text: {n}Smiling triumphantly at his soldiers' unanimous response, the Commissar adds in a lowered voice,{/n} "How can I let such an inspiring prisoner go? My fellow resistance fighters would be devastated."

9781f852-07a1-419a-8248-db36b4d7ca2a.Text: "You want to know who I serve or who I believe in? Myself and myself. No one else. Maybe you meant to ask what my calling is? Hmm...
