a4dbf192-2cb1-4ad0-aa0c-9321d7530ff5.Text: "It just happened to be smarter than the others. Isn't that right, Idira?"

fea50a39-af65-4363-bf15-3af782ff1673.Text: "The operational vector of adoration before His might dictates... the necessity of reverence for the subject where the natural spirit resides in synthesis with that of the machine."

209ae9c3-0987-4a30-baf2-6d306d16d60d.Text: "Request denied. The inflicted damage is critical. The subject cannot be repaired."

9c105c5e-e35e-4962-9b75-892b6f27744d.Text: "But it is also a miracle of His boundless polymorphism." {n}Pasqal's voice carries a metallic note.{/n}

5c775206-9c61-4765-8119-e0739922dd4f.Text: "Presenting a hypothesis. This construct is a mobile execution chamber. A subject is immobilised by the implements, placed inside the construct, and subjected to highly painful disposal via chemical injection. The biological remains are preserved in the built-in reservoir of the construct."

365f2c1a-59f9-47a9-9713-99ab0434caf4.Text: {n}You can clearly see the inside of the mechanism through the holes in its armour. Its gut can open to drag a hamstrung victim inside. Once the victim finds themselves in the monster's "stomach," they will be pierced by injectors that will liquefy them. The substance will then drain to the reservoirs at the tail end of the creature.{/n}

08fb83db-46a6-4c30-84a6-e2f34a61eb23.Text: "The initial chemical analysis of the remains yields... an abnormal result." {n}The vox emits a clanging metallic note.{/n} "It is as if the pain of the victims of this machine is dissolved in them. It is circulating in the metal veins of this creature. It can feel... everything."

9456c97b-c813-4579-b35f-49a6418fdcca.Text: {n}Something inside the creature clangs helplessly and then it starts tugging at one of its limbs with jittery motions, trying to rip it out of its socket. Its body convulses in excruciating pain.{/n}

641f172d-6543-48a7-8c9b-02819dc98819.Text: "It seems the blasphemous creature can feel pain and fear... That is glorious." {n}Ulfar's face breaks into a smile that is both joyous and bloodthirsty.{/n}

c1116c79-e332-4382-9c16-dcf8f7888ebd.Text: "This is an Engine of Pain, elantach. An executioner created by the depravity of my twisted cousins, living flesh fused to a mechanism whose sole purpose is to inflict as much pain as it can." {n}Yrliet's face is contorted with bitterness and disgust.{/n}

3ea22202-82bc-4224-b106-29ea667641af.Text: "Until I get a cup of recaf, my vital status is yet to be determined."

2c357e29-2fde-4522-ab73-ee950ef35902.Text: [Rise. Gather your strength and simply rise]

528b7ea3-e8e4-43f7-b295-2c99ad38405f.Text: "Rogue Trader {name} von Valancius lies before you. Kneel... and help me to rise."

31076d2c-e781-4818-ba2c-ef70fe62a4bc.Text: "I... I have seen you somewhere before. Who are you?"

5fcbed2c-4f52-496e-8669-66f1d2e643ac.Text: Prayed to the gods of the warp to get out of the corpse pile in Commorragh.

de26896a-4ce7-4563-83f1-eacebc857903.Text: [Pray to the warp gods for help]

ddab2ecd-374f-4c46-9cf3-477b2e77c75f.Text: Remembered your duty to your comrades to get out of the corpse pile in Commorragh.

ec3fd786-3cbb-4a9d-a325-58dfca10f237.Text: [Remember all the people whose lives depend on you]

da98f1a5-d9d2-4b36-acfc-40b69a600bbf.Text: Prayed to the Emperor to get out of the corpse pile in Commorragh.

d89c7f1d-0f84-4eff-ac64-540d66ef0c44.Text: [Overcome this trial, in the Emperor's name, for your service to Him is not yet ended]

9d4e6525-2b09-4f80-b934-5e58ab8e32c8.Text: [Turn your thoughts to the warp gods]

f76687f6-402c-415e-9610-07aeb8d0871b.Text: {n}The world is an impenetrable haze of warm pain. You lie motionless — no, you rest! — in the murky gloom, slowly dissolving into nothingness. Sometimes your repose is troubled by unpleasant and persistent tremors coming from the place where your legs used to be. You do your best to ignore them.{/n}

3cfe09f4-b3b6-4361-b607-700a301fb11f.Text: "Away, you vulture, this is not your prey!" {n}A vaguely familiar voice reaches you through the curtain of darkness, but your disobedient thoughts refuse to reveal where and when you have heard it before. Was it just recently, or a hundred lifetimes ago? The trembling coming from your legs is replaced with a violent jerking motion, and then it finally stops.{/n}

dcda0ab4-cd00-4696-a164-f9b3990b037a.Text:
"Alas, the bliss of death will save you not,
The whirling waltz of chance and gloom you'll dance."

eced89c4-290b-4e3c-8958-3b613b15a6c6.Text: {n}You do not immediately notice when something foreign and painfully familiar enters your mind. The frantic whispering grows into many voices, but muffled, as if they are being heard through many walls.{/n}

1da36f32-0a1b-417c-96ef-ceb88ba8a1c5.Text: "...sheltered in the Web of Souls... thirsting... give them to me... look for the signs... opportunities... break down inhibitions... destroy barriers... find the stifler and destroy it... let the Truth permeate the Dark City once more... help you..."

6779718a-b624-4d8f-a612-45a2b132c5d2.Text: {n}A prickling sensation burns your shoulder, and the darkness at last fully withdraws from your mind. Whatever the injection was, it is making your heart beat a frenzied tattoo and your pupils narrow so that you now register every detail of the disgusting place in which you have found yourself in merciless clarity.{/n}

9923ffde-6dc2-49d1-b87f-4f7cfc25c04d.Text: {n}Your cracked lips work in tandem with your burning lungs to expel the familiar words of prayer. Each uttered line fills your body with His light, giving you strength and driving away the pain, as if the Emperor Himself is commanding you to rise. You make another attempt.{/n}

64d6c8ce-65f5-4445-8d53-997278758651.Text:
{n}Quiet laughter reaches your ears.{/n}
"Your legs require direction, Merchant mine,
Therefore, address your pleas to them, not me.
Their thirst for dancing may yet spur them on!"

8113b4e6-de25-40cf-90ff-d0846c72f6c1.Text: {n}You immediately regret this decision. Every inch of your body is suffering. There is a dull, debilitating pain in your head caused by chemicals of some kind. Your body is covered in deep cuts, made either for fun or with sinister intent. All of your organs appear to be intact, but the same cannot be said for your blood — you have lost a great deal. Finally, a strange gnawing spasm occasionally flares at the base of your skull. It is not severe but for some reason it is what concerns you most of all.{/n}

0b505cc7-63f6-45af-9c24-87946b932ce6.Text: {n}Every single inch of your body is suffering. Satisfied with this result, you do not delve into a detailed examination of your misfortune.{/n}

b107a3cc-6180-47d6-922a-26858e429e97.Text: {n}You are surrounded by the dead — numerous corpses, mutilated bodies and pieces thereof. Humans, Drukhari, and other xenos unfamiliar to you lie motionless in this gruesome mortuary.{/n}

28f158d1-7ab2-429d-b7e2-005d3be23945.Text: {n}Your eyes refuse to focus on the blurry figure of the person who came to your aid. He appears to be tall, and... your mind emphatically refuses to continue, for every moment of concentration causes you suffering.{/n}

63fd186d-7d22-4046-b8cf-2f9d681874c4.Text: {n}All your equipment is gone, as are your shoes. You do not even have a knife at hand to fend off enemies, or to open your veins.{/n}

4517f781-e7a7-4627-bddf-6aaefffee049.Text:
"A dream obscure of death, deliverance,
Illuminating will, and agony."

8f851b66-21f5-45d6-b364-ecf42f24bdb1.Text:
"Not here. The roles have been decided now,
But if you play your part, perhaps, the plot
Will draw you back together... or to doom."
{n}The figure's cruel laughter follows.{/n}

0be97766-c266-42d8-bcbe-aa5eb9fcf420.Text:
"This overture in verse, the final lines:
The Merchant's time to tread the boards has come,
Embark you now upon your pilgrimage.
And take my parting gift: a humble prop."
{n}The stranger deposits something in your hand and disappears into the twilight.{/n}

3626fd41-f7ed-4546-8164-12ea167d03da.Text: {n}Your bare feet feel like they are stuffed with rags and refuse to obey. You have to draw upon all your willpower to suppress the rebellion and stand upright. The pain that engulfs your whole body immediately makes you question the wisdom of this act of defiance.{/n}

1908be53-0b6f-4e11-bf42-d0dd2a5a4287.Text: {n}You try to resurrect the faces of your friends in your memory, but they all seem to be cloaked by an impenetrable haze. Pain prevents you from focusing on any one of them, and anger and despair start to overwhelm you. You must remember, you cannot die here! Spurred on by hopelessness, you make another attempt to get up.{/n}

319b01ce-abb8-453e-a27f-d0f0665fb6af.Text: {n}Your cracked lips futilely try to utter the words of a prayer. The familiar lines slip away from you one by one, devoured by the murky gloom of your errant thoughts and flashes of pain. But you refuse to believe the Emperor has abandoned you. If you cannot pray to Him right now, you must get up and survive so you can utter a thousand more prayers later. You make another attempt to get up.{/n}

8b163547-48bb-4684-ad31-64b3a2f16a3c.Text: {n}Your body has suffered too much to obey your mind... or rather, that is how it would have been for someone else, perhaps. But not for you. {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Torture}You have lived through worse{/d}. Anguish and torture could never break you now. You will rise to your feet and press on. All that is left to understand is why you should.{/n}

4e5d8f5b-584e-49ba-9541-836c12e4c9d6.Text: {n}You get up. Yes, your body aches and rebels against you, but your tempered mind is stronger than mortal flesh. You draw yourself up straight and take in your surroundings.{/n}

eae9ecd5-324c-4bb5-b3f9-517aa10aad46.Text:
{n}The figure whispers conspiratorially,{/n}
"I spare my breath. The drape is yours to part."

aa6733ad-82cf-41e5-92bc-4ca8698c7ca3.Text:
"From this phantasmagoria retreat
And deftly seize, my Merchant Vagabond,
The puppet master's strings left dangling.
Again rise up to take your place and dance."
{n}A spark ignites in the darkness, and its light ruthlessly cuts through the gloom that envelops you. An ugly image of the reality around you assaults your retina. You can feel your body again and realise it is filled with pain. Your shoulder is sore from an injection.{/n}

1d9fc89e-d8c4-4f8d-b4f2-62f0d5538b2b.Text:
"Your wordlessness is worth a hundred words,
But here you ply your trade in other gems:
Red rubies of blood, and emeralds of pain,
The dance will leave your pockets fit to burst."

5bc59c0d-a75b-46f1-a6af-fbb0ee69ba54.Text: {n}For a few moments, your prayer goes unanswered. And yet... And yet something does reach your tortured consciousness after a while. The familiar feeling of an alien presence descends upon you, but when it speaks, the voices are barely audible, as though you are separated by dozens of thick walls.{/n}

b7e63f32-e08d-4f94-8697-8b09d135fed5.Text: {n}You may have commanded multiple planets and millions of lives in your former life, but in this new reality, not even your own feet will obey you. As if to punish you for your arrogance, your disobedient limbs send a sharp jolt of pain up your body.{/n}

251919db-2522-410e-8e3f-9069e918b69f.Text: {n}It would be nice to fade back into blissful oblivion and forget your misfortunes, but reality is merciless — your body has already realised the unenviable position it is in and is signalling you with the last of its strength, sending bright flashes of pain into your limbs, muscles, and organs. If you do not get up right now, you probably never will.{/n}

928b6ed6-ba30-4ba3-b185-c544602eb1a1.Text: {n}Hundreds of faces flash before your mind's eye: friends, subjects, and companions. The universe is cruel and full of darkness, and your will and determination are the only barrier between your loved ones and its crushing apathy and brutality. You have no right to die, not here and not now. Resoluteness floods your veins like incandescent plasma, and you make another attempt to get up.{/n}

276fcbf7-076b-4530-98c0-cc12291f580e.Text: The Prey grabs me by the throat, lifts me into the air, and snarls. It seems to want to know why I attempted to kill it.

ba49aba1-73c5-4d3b-a36a-55520f826e3e.Text: ...is trying to locate me among the tangle of spiked minarets.

41fea48b-71e7-4984-98bf-00733ada4655.Text: ...flees down the most predictable and straightforward route, hoping that its strength does not abandon it.

f93e6abb-ff2f-4baa-85a6-1a56578c6936.Text: ...slips away using the bodies of random passers-by as cover.

08090bdb-1f40-4750-aee8-a916e09edd0f.Text: ...grabs someone's weapon from the ground and returns fire at random.

bc6f21d4-17c3-46d0-8050-773f0800de23.Text: ...banks on brute force, trying to break my fragile bones and shatter my joints.

11caa52d-2869-467c-955a-df42dae1a62e.Text: The chaotic burst of violence that bloodied the streets of Commorragh ends just as abruptly as it erupted. Such is life in the spires.

5a7bf602-9df1-4896-ba83-50e45444d46f.Text: ...grabs one of the blades hanging from my belt and aims it at my throat.

8d46f2ad-427b-4364-b139-95b1bc5a6637.Text: ...responds with clinical attacks aimed at my weak points.

b1320f6c-8e06-4a33-a88e-cc5aed99de14.Text: ...allows me closer, enveloping me in a deadly embrace and hoping to suffocate me before I tear it to shreds.

1175c4d8-3996-4442-af58-865f456d5e2c.Text: ...slips away with the skill of one who has lived here their entire life.

ab70be6f-6526-4bdb-8e46-56c1cf7bf622.Text: ...looks defenceless and I attack, failing to notice the trap it has laid out for me.

26876924-899c-4ff2-9459-265ae840e2ff.Text: ...is not where I expected it to be. Having climbed the ledge of a wall, it lunges at me and bellows.

5340b6e8-1f73-4ba0-9ff7-d4855420709c.Text: ...lunges at me first. I realise too late that it is not desperation but cold determination behind it.

8495a05b-351d-46fa-89b7-d00a16c05e46.Text: Everything will be over in moments.

d27e9843-f3c4-4062-b93c-7a69003ce317.Text: The Prey dies at my feet.

7f9ea037-a925-4aa8-9f66-175a84db3d7f.Text: But I still decide to wait and get a better look at the Prey.

a6328fff-ea55-46db-a9ab-8db3a6cf01e6.Text:
The shardcarbine spews forth a stream of crystalline projectiles that howl and shatter as they pierce the flesh of the Prey. A deadly slashing blizzard drapes the street in bloody snow, the bodies of random passers-by caught in the fire falling to the ground. This is a common occurrence in the spires.
Everyone around me flees from the field of death whose borders I have made clear. The Prey falls but it is still alive. I did not expect the hunt to end with the first salvo. The Prey is badly injured. I can easily finish it off in the open.

8485d874-207e-45e5-8813-8fba53341668.Text:
The rising currents carry the smells of pain, blood, ichor, and failed ambitions. The smells of the Dark City.
With my wings flung open, I weave a path through the spires like a dark lightning bolt, chaotic and unpredictable in its patterns. To fly is to hunt and everyone in flight hunts everyone else. Even I, Scourge Garthairyt Bloodfeather, do not have the privilege of inviolability around these parts. I may become someone else's prey, except... probably not today. This day I am the Hunter.
My Haemonculus-modified olfactory receptors pick up the scent of my Prey and I tread cautiously as I approach it. The stench of mon-keigh is foul but varied, and the scent of my Prey is quite telling. A powerful specimen, brash and reeking of the blood of others.
I descend to the minaret that grows out of the nearest spire and provides me with an excellent view. Accelerated reflexes allow me to assess the situation in a fraction of an instant.
It is time.

4b40fc23-e9fa-4f09-aa84-d594956f693f.Text: Powerful blows crush the hollow bones drilled by the crafty Haemonculus. Their lightness served me well during the flight but has betrayed me here on the ground. I lose my footing, my body going floppy like a rag.

ac043403-acc6-477d-a38b-c578a1074452.Text: An almost invisible monofilament is stretched between the walls. It cuts into the joints of my wings — a primitive yet masterfully placed trap. The inertia of my body breaks it and my adaptive tissues stop the bleeding, but my wings hang limply along my body. It will not be easy to return home to the top of the spires.

689bb3a4-807d-49f6-9179-ce06b7e19dcf.Text:
A mistake!
I unleash a new fan of crystalline shards and the flesh of the Prey blossoms with new cuts from my projectiles. Anyone who tries to approach it will be killed by the brittle shrapnel. The Prey should have run away, not given me more chances to cripple it.
The Prey is weak.

617780ca-00cf-4dba-9a5b-bf5df318c137.Text:
Its frantic gaze is looking for my winged figure. The hyperpupils allow me to examine the Prey's face — I can see its eyes scrutinise my gear.
There is no need to hide anymore, so I stand up to my full height and emit a wailing battle cry.
Let the Prey know what will kill it.

99cc1807-4d42-4377-818f-d4bfa6529727.Text: With my wings folded, I ratchet up the jet booster and glide under the Prey. It lands behind me, disappointed.

7f4c857a-edb3-45a0-887d-cb2398a5c696.Text: We wrestle for the blade until I drop it sharply and lean back. My knee strikes the lower jaw of the Prey and the claw hidden in my knee pops out, piercing the bone and plunging into its brain. All of its muscles violently contract in agony.

3988c98b-f7df-42a0-9802-5df5deff91fa.Text: Clever. By escaping from the open streets, the Prey has deprived me of the advantage of my long-range weapon. But I will not let it escape, so I spread my wings and soar over the alley, pelting the Prey with bursts of indirect fire. The chase must not end too soon. The Petitioner wanted my Prey to die slowly.

3b475412-46fe-4d44-8558-6d3df4fdd2c1.Text: With my wings folded, I ratchet up to the jet booster and rush past the Prey like a projectile. I am airborne again, I am flying! The fight will be on my terms!

6183e7a7-7859-476f-8c6d-fefe08ff7f1f.Text: It is with disgusting insight that the mon-keigh locates my vulnerability, the spot under my shoulders where the Haemonculus joined the wings to my natural flesh. The blows to the ganglia make me go blind with pain and hatred. The Prey rolls me to the ground and starts pounding the arch of my elongated skull against the rocks. I hear a crunch and my body stops responding.

dd9a25ae-b198-47e5-9862-86b676d0883a.Text: The outcome will be decided in close combat. Wasting no time, my Prey and I seize one another in a violent, furious embrace. Every decision made over the course of this fleeting hunt is being weighed, tipping the scale that will ultimately determine the winner.

73fc616c-0910-4eef-b14e-8200acf62c4b.Text: Perhaps the body of my Prey was modified or it simply abounds with vigour. Even the heavy wounds inflicted by the first salvo cannot slow it down. I emit a frustrated shriek as I watch the path of my projectiles follow the Prey without reaching its flesh.

011ab0da-246e-423e-ae79-99440ba70016.Text: The Prey has overplayed its hand. The wounds inflicted by the first salvo slowed it down, gnawing away at its dexterity. I emit an enthusiastic squeal as I watch my projectiles torment its back. I am one step closer to victory!

5798448e-9abc-4488-b2d4-e655777fe143.Text: There is more blood. By rushing into the crowd of fleeing bystanders, the Prey has made them obstacles in my hunt. I generously sow death among them.

be3bb5aa-490b-4ad6-adc2-59a06687cfb9.Text: But their deaths bring me no joy, because the Prey keeps eluding my volleys. I let out a disappointed shriek.

1dee87ad-37f8-4cb7-91ae-c77bef596f32.Text: But the Prey's cunning stratagem does not bring it safety. Once in a while, one of the projectiles skips between the bodies of passers-by and sinks into its flesh. I greet these small victories with a jubilant shriek.

6966dc36-5fbe-4792-ab75-f03eb6b78787.Text: The air fills with gunfire. As soon as the Prey fires the first shot, everyone starts shooting at everyone else. This chaotic firefight engulfs the entire street. It spreads across the Dark City like a wildfire, mindless and violent.

6411512f-9ef3-42c6-94b6-c00e40f275bb.Text: I am forced into a steep dive, spinning around and dodging the tracks of multiple projectiles. The damn trick worked and I let out a frustrated squeal.

97cc5db3-5652-4d2e-8352-3ed9cc353492.Text: I duck out of the line of fire with a graceful dive, rush to the ground in an impossible trajectory and unleash a burst at the feet of my Prey. The shrapnel gouges its flesh and I shriek in triumph. I am one step closer to victory.

be1a04b8-7cbb-4352-8f85-e180886c908a.Text: Its frantic gaze leaps helplessly from one spire to another, but my hiding place is too discreet. Triumphant, I revel in my superiority.

fcf4a341-f8b6-4a88-916e-edac4d7a2fdd.Text:
The Prey manages to elude me for a moment by ducking into a crowded street. The jet booster on my back emits a stream of ghostly blue flame and I continue my pursuit. As I storm into the street, I see the Prey again.
This is a nice catch. The Petitioner wanted me to deliver the Prey to her, but I decide to do something different. When it is over, I will impale the body of the Prey on a spike protruding from the highest spire, so that it serves as testament to my victory.

9667ef47-272b-46f2-958c-304f9c3ec721.Text: The initial horror caused by my sudden attack has already worn off. The Prey has suppressed its panic and is acting decisively and boldly. A commendable triumph of will over instinct.

5955c492-3ff9-4298-9d04-a0db043a9bc7.Text: It is frightened. The Prey may have managed not to succumb to blind animal panic, but its jittery movements clearly reveal that reason is being dampened by instinct.

79670f17-a41f-42d7-a10d-c349ab64e619.Text:
It only takes the Prey a couple of furious shouts to convince those huddled in the alley that a monster is coming for their heads. Lies. I am only pursuing the Prey.
I am met with frantic gunfire and, after making a sharp ascent, I take a pair of plasma grenades from my belt and hurl them into the crowd.

f98aec02-b7aa-4551-8384-61ad019274f0.Text: The bodies of the gullible fools who believed the Prey evaporate and turn into bloody mist. The luckier ones fire at me and one of the shots brings me to the ground. I wail furiously and finish them off with pointed bursts from my shardcarbine. To cast me down is an indelible insult!

58eb7cdb-440a-496c-a5b9-2f8d9d064d7f.Text: The few who survived the explosion fall to the ground in terror. The fear that the Prey has planted in them is weaker than the fear that I evoke.

4ecb5195-1c79-4e25-bb80-944aa271d87d.Text: The Prey rushes over to a half-dismantled jetbike, shoves away the slave who is repairing it, and overloads its antigravity engine with admirable dexterity. It barely has the time to bounce back before a deafening explosion fills the air with shards of rock, pieces of wraithbone, and fragments of bodies.

a8d6249d-3bd6-4ad7-b9ff-164cab5685a3.Text: One of the projectiles hits me in the chest and throws me to the ground. I manage to regroup and avoid injury, but get up with a furious screech. I was cast down — an indelible insult!

3ca16876-274a-4d99-a9b2-e2639847f113.Text: I evade all projectiles with a graceful twirl and dash into the roiling dust, to where my Prey is hiding.

6c3aff1b-04b8-4146-adbc-30c35dc7b967.Text: The Prey glides through the alleys of the Dark City with amazing skill for an outsider, pulling away from me. I pursue it with a cry of excitement, but my advantage is palpably dissipating.

98555084-ac77-4beb-8cd7-e33cabda8db6.Text: The bowels of the Dark City are unlike any place my Prey would call home. The unnatural snarl of pocket dimensions confuses its mind and I manage to sneak in a couple of extra shots, marking the trail of the Prey with new bloody footprints.

7613d561-66df-409a-97ad-a726cc273355.Text:
As I turn the corner, I triumphantly realise that I have driven the Prey into a dead end. It is time for the massacre!
The poison I received from the Petitioner as payment for the hunt is contained in the crystalline projectiles and should have worked by now. It will slow down the nervous system of my Prey, weaken its muscles, and render it unconscious.

8ab54b27-df04-4d7f-b4f5-181c472036ab.Text: But when I see the Prey, I fail to discern any trace of the poison's effects. Could the Prey be so strong that its body has overcome my deadly battle toxin?

b39efe24-64ec-4bf0-a58a-fccf76f1f813.Text: When I spot the Prey, I am pleased to note the early signs of the effect my combat toxin is having on it. Its movements are slowed and it is blinking often — spots are floating in front of its eyes by now.

0771368f-ab4d-40a3-85e5-338e681c1dd3.Text: Seeking to slow me down, the Prey...

e4f2558e-cca7-4318-994e-4fbb623f0b14.Text:
Would I tell it if I could? About my Petitioner, Keykeross the Wych? About how insulted she was by the deaths of her fosterlings, the Bloodstained Proselytes, in the arena at the hands of my Prey? About how badly she wanted to spite the Prey's master, the sour-tempered Haemonculus Tervantias who had arranged that insult?
I do not know, for my throat is crushed and only a faint wail escapes it...

c2bb77bf-0118-443d-bbbb-d99dedcffe65.Text: We struggle for the blade but its point steadily approaches my throat. It touches it. It pierces the skin extremely slowly and penetrates the larynx. It keeps plunging deeper, touches the other wall of the larynx, and passes through. I can feel everything. My body softens with pain.

455cb7c8-0290-4a6f-965f-d9d8472f43b5.Text: I try to slip past it to escape into the open, and fail. The Prey lands a couple of well-aimed blows and one of my wings hangs limply along my body. It will not be easy to return home to the top of the spires.

45af7142-7775-4dd4-ab8c-afe7c8a5c8a0.Text:
The Prey dies at my feet. I lean over it heavily, cut off a lump of its flesh, and swallow it with pleasure.
It was a glorious hunt. The Petitioner will pay me for it again. Keykeross is just a Wych after all, albeit a high-ranking one, and I am a Scourge. I earned my special status by agonising changes to the flesh and a bloody pilgrimage to the top of the spires. Her vendetta against Tervantias, which led to the assassination of his latest plaything, is beneath me. For I am a Hunter of the Dark City.

3bcb192c-6a9b-4d6f-ad29-f536c69bbef9.Text: The devious mon-keigh decides to disembowel me by striking at my lower abdomen. I let the blow come through: all the vital organs have long since been replaced by lighter and more efficient counterparts hidden in unobtrusive body cavities. I let the Prey revel in its victory for a brief moment and then callously slit its throat with a swift strike from an advantageous angle.

b31c65ee-e47b-4efe-acc7-2776719ae0a1.Text: The hunt is over. As always, I am triumphant.

7e52cbe0-de41-4e8a-8359-1216cadd1e2e.Text: I plunge my claws deep into the body of my Prey, but it refuses to die. The grip keeps growing tighter and I cannot breathe. I am flailing in the mon-keigh's grip, yearning to break free. I want to fly away! It is no use... Something snaps in my back and I can no longer feel my legs.

55bbc5bc-3397-4b11-a6e0-88410bcfe5e6.Text: I plunge my claws deep into the body of my Prey, aiming for the arteries. Its grip is strong, this is a trial of endurance: whose body will give in first? My bones crunch, but hold, while the arms of the Prey are growing weak. It slumps helplessly to the ground and, with a kick of my clawed foot, I tear open its throat.

2dbfe83e-b5d7-4f73-acc0-88bea965cb94.Text: My flight is swift. Everything unnecessary and atavistic had been cut from my body so that air currents carry it like a projectile from a splinter rifle. Alas, this is also my weakness: I am so light, even a small obstacle can throw me off course. But the Prey has no idea how vulnerable I am in flight.

86e19827-0375-4dad-9d96-347d26062e35.Text:
I am dying at the feet of my Prey... no, at the feet of a mon-keigh. A humiliating end for one who earned the status of apex Hunter of Commorragh through torturous alterations of the flesh and a bloody pilgrimage to the very top of the spires.
Does it hurt to perish like this? It does.
Is it fair? It is.

31f62f36-a49e-461d-9dd8-d803cfb89173.Text: I am unpleasantly surprised when I realise the Prey is aware of my combat style. It covers the vulnerable spots I like to cut open with my monomolecular claws. But this knowledge will not save it from death!

314b3d26-0135-41b5-b6c8-61d54466f757.Text: My embedded glands spew hyperadrenaline into my bloodstream and my artificially grown muscles convulsively swell under the porous fabric of my ghostplate. I torment the Prey with claws protruding from my forearms and knees, and the Prey...

47d7bb3c-75ed-477f-8156-f3617aa227b9.Text: I reach for the shardcarbine with the last of my strength, but the superiority of my Prey is absolute. It snatches the weapon from my hand and it responds to the sacrilege with the indignant ringing of crystal bullets.

bfd674e2-a650-42a7-bbe8-7684a47feff3.Text: My strength waning, I reach for the shardcarbine and shoot the Prey right in the face at point-blank range... The crystalline projectile whizzes within a hair's breadth of its face. A crushing blow turns my magnificent weapon to rubble with a mournful crunch.

a9dae785-988d-4b3d-a0c4-1599014d6932.Text: In the blind alley where my Prey is about to die, there is enough room for me to spread my wings and soar. It does not grant me an opportunity to do so and kicks me back into the cramped street. The Prey wishes to fight where it has the advantage.

88943077-52d5-4f4c-a7c7-406ae582e65f.Text:
A mistake!
Anyone who tries to approach the Prey will be killed by the brittle shrapnel. I unleash a new fan of crystalline shards, but the shots go wide: my aim is disrupted by a two-headed creature as it crashes into my back with a shriek, and the stock of my shardcarbine sways. I will deal with it later: I will break its wings. Right now, only the Prey matters.

0451969a-99f2-4c73-aca7-33aff0007185.Text: I see primitive mon-keigh technology emerging from around the corner, and though I do not fear it, I realise that my plan is thwarted. I perceive fresh marks on the Prey's skin — the floating skulls have pumped stimulants into its body and neutralised the combat toxin that should have sealed its fate.

670834b4-5b9d-46a4-8719-e58beb9ebf0d.Text: ...lets out a repulsive whistle. The mon-keigh's four-legged servant sinks its metal teeth into the back of my head, seeking to chew through my spine. My reinforced vertebrae crack; my vision begins to dim. I strike the mechanised creature, tossing it aside, and grab the Prey by the neck. Its plaything has weakened my reflexes, and I will take pleasure in breaking the creature's legs later. But right now, the Prey...

4e2332db-4a53-4328-b14f-eb79e399d467.Text: The Prey hides well, as if favouring precisely those areas where I cannot see it. Someone is helping it, someone with a view from above, telling it which streets offer the best cover. A loud croak provides the answer. I am forced to chase off the raven following us with a spray of shots before resuming the hunt.

64de11e1-72eb-441e-9bc9-df8eea355cfb.Text:
Sector: unknown depths of the Labyrinth Dimension
Region: Commorragh
Recording location: the Chasm
Material: Garthairyt Bloodfeather's hunt
Extracted: from the bloody remains by the caring hand, scalpel, and neurophage tentacle of Haemonculus Elivanth

fffc736d-7cb3-4578-8092-bda9cd953dae.Text:
A {mf|male|female} mon-keigh. A pampered upper-caste cub who was fed and equipped with the best their race can offer. It certainly arrived in the Dark City recently, the city which has not yet managed to leave a mark of perpetual expectation of doom on its flattened snout. The most glorious game which clings to life the strongest and leaves the sweetest death essence.
The reflexes urge the muscles to act.

5067a01a-a913-4b1a-83e4-c8cb1e61d57b.Text: There is a strangeness to the movements of the Prey as it dashes away one moment and freezes the next. My receptotropin-altered pupils are adept at detecting movement, but they are worse at perceiving stationary subjects. And my Prey seems to be aware of this!

b6713b17-1804-465f-b7de-cc4530ec518a.Text: Sealed in a sheath of artificial muscles, my joints endure the mighty blows and I cut the throat of my Prey with one swift movement.

c25f9ac6-68a2-42dd-982b-ff0cdf110979.Text: I see a monofilament stretched between the walls: a primitive trap indeed. I fold my wings for a moment and I tear it down with a blow from the muzzle of my shardcarbine.

d4eaff67-16e6-466c-9486-cf69c1836bd3.Text: The mon-keigh's heavy body pins me to the ground. The joint of its lower limb crushes the jet booster like an eggshell. I break free of the grip and dash away with an angry shriek. Unpleasant weakness creeps up my spine: something vital has been damaged.

39cbfe8e-d455-4bfe-8fb2-7fcb14739baf.Text: Commanded Abelard to overcome his hallucinations in Commorragh.

8a96427b-39af-405f-a1c3-b6a65f2910b9.Text: "Seneschal, the Addendum Prefectorium Militarum to the Tactica Imperium states that an army officer of the Imperium who submits to third-degree xeno-influence or higher is to be considered a traitor and a heretic. I will have no heretics under my command, Seneschal. I order you to conquer this illusion at once! Get to it, officer!"

009a1ec2-abf3-4440-80f4-18cec6022147.Text: "Seneschal! This is your Lord Captain speaking!"

4e3ec9e2-d87d-4f73-833b-501d88d5116a.Text: "What was the thing that attacked you?"

700e82dd-d88a-4f63-80b7-d1da93e439c4.Text: "No, Abelard! Your family is not here — they are waiting for you!"

bb187c18-e5a9-4d8b-b707-d54747a10574.Text: "Seneschal Abelard Werserian, cease this display! You serve Rogue Trader von Valancius, not your fantasies!"

a74575fe-9311-4b62-a25a-d47c68ae1fc7.Text: [Leave] "Farewell. It seems you will be better off alone with your mirage."

e8975423-3232-4939-b154-61d4baff87f0.Text: "We will find a way to restore your time to you, Seneschal."

5c376ac9-6586-490a-b877-e9c688ae427f.Text: "I, for one, have had enough of this heap of filth. It is time to move, Abelard."

64a719ff-3492-4b2f-b487-1e79b23b52ec.Text: "I will come back for you, Abelard. I give you my word."

17e30f42-73af-4b66-9747-35c6302c7e38.Text: [Inject Abelard with a stimulant] "This should bring you back to your senses."

03324b63-343e-4827-afa4-dd37e6b8a4e6.Text: {n}You barely recognise your loyal Seneschal, Abelard Werserian, in this pitiful, hunchbacked figure. His officer's bearing, his broad shoulders, his direct and piercing gaze — all gone without a trace. What you see before you is a decrepit, quivering old man rummaging through malodorous refuse and mumbling under his breath.{/n}

895f4976-1461-43c4-8509-ebd10ac1c6f6.Text: {n}It takes you a second to make sense of his hoarse lisp:{/n} "Quatharina, love... White amasec and fruits? Of course, love... The children are making mischief again... Quatharina, where are you?" {n}The old man's frail voice is laden with tenderness and longing.{/n}

46058fd3-2617-49f0-a080-aaad550e944a.Text: {n}The old man continues to look through you blindly, as if incapable of realising your presence.{/n}

ab096b69-4160-46e9-b2ee-dada085234db.Text: "Is this damn thing still with us, then?" {n}Abelard's withered finger points at Yrliet.{/n} "There will be no rest for my weary bones."

da2d9355-9c66-491a-b6c8-46a7919fd851.Text: "Oh, Quatharina..." {n}Abelard laughs faintly and immediately launches into a bout of coughing. Deep lines run across his face and a blurry film of cataracts clouds his eyes.{/n} "The Drivestems are at it again... Another council session... Another appeal to the logitiums... They will never be satisfied, love... until they make us and our children disappear..."

b09dfb76-4db4-4d7e-82f3-de7aad709f6c.Text: {n}Abelard gives you a tense, embarrassed look.{/n} "My late wife, Lord Captain. I think, in the time I wandered around here, my sanity may have suffered... a temporary lapse, I hope. It appears my mind can no longer stomach the kind of horrors this place has to offer. I saw her by my side... I saw a different time... a different place..."

0397af90-d54b-4aaa-a39e-3ac81e4a1874.Text: "Perhaps... we should just give in... You always say that Dargonus is not your home, love..." {n}Abelard is looking past you at someone only he can see. There is a timid smile on his trembling lips.{/n} "Would you like that, love? Would you rather leave... leave it all behind... go somewhere far away... away from our toils?"

3ca1b8c8-3447-4b58-8bbc-ccea7a5138fb.Text: {n}Abelard flinches.{/n} "Family? But, Quatharina, you are my family, and you... are dead..." {n}He shakes his head as if waking from sleep, slaps himself on the cheeks, and looks up at you.{/n} "{name}! Apologies — that is to say, Lord Captain!"

7d652b95-bd12-4f9e-b69f-72eb0f40a179.Text: {n}Abelard flinches. A glow lights up in his watering eyes.{/n} "What's that? 'Seneschal'? Who is calling me?" {n}Abelard looks at you and takes a shuddering breath.{/n} "Saints' blood, Lord Captain! You're alive!"

9adca9e0-1b4a-4878-9e89-d9af4803d115.Text: {n}With a groan, Abelard tries to straighten his hunched back.{/n} "Thank the God-Emperor, death has not found you yet! Then again, given the circumstances... it may be for the worst."

0e0e66ed-1f95-45d6-b305-db638156ec9b.Text: "I could not agree more, Lord Captain. I serve House von Valancius!" {n}Abelard salutes you with a shaking hand, and a ghost of his usual stern expression returns to his wrinkled face.{/n}

8e41d6e5-5b0d-44c9-a03a-1e0b252720da.Text: "I have not the faintest idea, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. All I can say is, if I have managed to survive down here, the others stand a chance too. There were no weaklings in your retinue."

0c67e4e7-aab7-498d-8105-6ba175dbe8b0.Text: "Pray, Lord Captain! There is enough strength in this body yet! Your Seneschal will not be so easily broken by some..." {n}He groans and clutches his side.{/n} "I could just use... a brief respite..."

49014450-bc3b-4365-a79b-826312edfe28.Text: {n}Abelard is racked by an old man's hacking cough.{/n} "That thrice-blasted xenos simply chucked me aside like a piece of rubbish. I went to look for you... or for help... and I ended up here. This is where it found me, that... thing. Memory fails me, all I can remember is bits and pieces... and needles. It pumped something out of me, and it pumped something in..."

0ce225d5-c5d6-4e1f-8322-6973ebe64675.Text: {n}He shudders.{/n} "A spawn of nightmares, so ghastly, my mind refuses to picture a clear image of it. Nothing but meat, metal, and many, many needles... It feasted on me. Feasted on my very soul! It would have devoured me whole if it hadn't gorged itself on another before me."

6433c8c9-bb30-49c0-a194-cae5b4b15c7e.Text: "Mistress Heydari... I see hardship has done nothing for your character." {n}Squinting short-sightedly, the Seneschal nods his greeting.{/n}

2b2e4df2-c8be-4761-9ac3-e30631504678.Text: "I seem to be in one piece, except... That creature..." {n}Abelard tries to wipe his stained coat with a trembling hand.{/n} "How should I put this... its needles siphoned the strength out of me! I feel... older by a good decade or two..." {n}He touches his face and exclaims in surprise.{/n} "My word, I think I am older... That could be why I started seeing things. I never thought I'd live long enough to go senile!"

4c58203a-faa6-4e1c-8415-e20db3a6bbb5.Text: {n}Your words fall on deaf ears: the old man's attention remains focused on his conversation with a phantom.{/n}

0dc4631c-0393-40eb-bb08-db6be8acaf96.Text: {n}Abelard flinches. His brow furrows and a glow lights up in his watering eyes.{/n} "'Heretic'? I recommend that you brush up on your regulations before accusing an officer! The Addendum Primum Errandum abolished the xeno-influence categorisation, and therefore..." {n}His vision somewhat cleared, Abelard looks at you and takes a shuddering breath.{/n} "Saints' blood, Lord Captain! You're alive!"

fc635136-77d1-4cfc-982d-ed3b4e102142.Text: "Oh, old man, have you lost your marbles? And your dignity? Muttering things, scavenging. Hey! Abelard?" {n}Jae's voice falters.{/n}

2ebc37a9-3d0f-4474-bf0b-bca55390d2d4.Text: "You will find no rest in this place with me or without me, grey-haired mon-keigh."

d4271ae6-c386-42a0-acc0-0c83f5c25241.Text: {n}With shaking hands, Abelard is still sifting through refuse, oblivious to you.{/n} "Quatharina? Yes, it's almost time... Call the children..."

419fa5c5-1ff7-4e65-a512-875d4f68252c.Text: {n}The dose of stimulant sends such an intense spasm down his limbs that you fear his heart might rupture... but then clarity brightens his gaze. Abelard looks at you and takes a shuddering breath.{/n} "Saints' blood, Lord Captain! You're alive!"

c8445505-fe79-45a9-b1cc-4c5c3ed0c910.Text: "Stop it, old man! We're not dead yet, so come flounder with us. I've been getting bored without your lectures."

cbb4b03a-95f0-43fe-9964-72321cf1173f.Text: "Who is this Commissar you speak of?"

80056bb2-a106-4edd-a3d2-ac3a072aba50.Text: [Gesture at Argenta's audience] "Who are these people?"

ca08547e-e5cc-444b-a2ca-31ce8717b67b.Text: "Argenta, a grim task brings me here. I must kill the Commissar."

9046bd9c-166d-4aff-ac47-6712f72196fa.Text: "What happened to you after we ran into that trap?"

5cd8d795-6fd9-4cf3-a53c-00fc6fa50531.Text: "You will join me, will you not?"

db706a2a-77d4-42b6-ab59-f8432488f345.Text: "I granted Yrliet my forgiveness. Let us end the discussion there."

5a1fb599-b1d4-41c9-bdca-22dab93c80cb.Text: "Yrliet will strive to redeem herself in my eyes."

63727492-174a-4548-8b4b-f45758dfecff.Text: "Yrliet was deceived, as we all were. Her actions can hardly be called trickery."

6b065b74-cbc5-4e10-9b63-6a26d217810c.Text: "My memory betrays me: I lost consciousness soon after they dragged us into the shadows. I came to in a filthy arena — they had set some clawed beast against me. When I slew it, they sent another. I killed them all, one after another, and the unseen spectators demanded more and more!"

8b2f3c7f-3048-461d-8df3-ccfd12b03078.Text: "At last, I had an opportunity — one of the beasts I fought damaged the enclosure, and I managed to escape the arena. You should have seen how quickly the scum who whooped and cheered from the stands set off after me! I forged a path with sword and bolter, and wandered for a long time in darkness... and then I wound up here, where a loyal servant of the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} found me and gave me a chance to serve Him again."

1e8f53a2-a596-475f-bb71-76d92215669d.Text: "Rogue Trader!" {n}Sister Argenta greets you with a glowing gaze and a confident smile.{/n} "The God-Emperor did not forsake His chosen one! I prayed that our paths would cross once more!"

e9cc2741-4936-40f0-b7f1-15aab6f8d3f3.Text: "You truly aren't worth the breath I have wasted on words." {n}Argenta pointedly turns away from her.{/n}

bd16c7bd-67d7-43ca-8a94-e5bb20833bce.Text: {n}Jae nonchalantly waves her off and immediately doubles over, coughing violently, leaving viscous clots of blood on her metal hand.{/n} "Groxseed! It's... it's—" {n}She is interrupted by her hacking cough.{/n} "—a long and grubby story, and I don't want to ruin the moment."

0b40bebf-8463-46a8-959a-2c464b00ba74.Text: {n}Argenta gestures at everyone around her.{/n} "Your arrival is timely indeed: with the Emperor's chosen on our side, we can come out of hiding and exact vengeance upon the enemies of Humanity! But I shouldn't take up your time — speak instead to the Commissar, the one who leads these valiant souls. He will tell you everything you need to know."

03267eb7-0120-44fb-b0b5-024df2a0a867.Text: "Sister Argenta! Thanks be to the God-Emperor, you are here! And you look as prepared for new trials as ever."

c443ca4e-4f07-4344-8504-cbb255a50a25.Text: "Master Werserian. A loyal Seneschal never abandons his Lord Captain, does he? I am just as glad to see you alive." {n}She gives Abelard an encouraging smile.{/n}

52b78276-1bd7-4186-9981-a3b73e8c9f71.Text: {n}Argenta's expression changes drastically when she sees Yrliet.{/n} "Rogue Trader... why is that creature standing beside you? Why has the treacherous xenos not yet suffered retribution for her trickery? I remember what her accursed kin said when we stepped into that trap. Do you, {name}? Have you forgotten that she betrayed us?"

3947e543-67f3-47f0-97ef-fd2dac0f33cb.Text: {n}Argenta's eyes flash with wrath.{/n} "Forgiveness is a great gift that precious few deserve. And even for them, forgiveness comes as a chance to die for a just cause, as Sisters Repentia die with a prayer on their lips! This is a xenos and a traitor. What forgiveness could you possibly speak of?"

f41d01e3-a0d6-4dc0-861a-40d299c7f018.Text: "A loyal servant of the Emperor who has not lost the will to fight even in this impenetrable gloom. He has mustered a resistance, everyone who can hold a weapon and refuses to accept the fate of a toy in the clutches of vile xenos. The dwellers of these dungeons are myriad, and most are lacking in soul, courage, or willpower. The Commissar and his associates seek out the true champions of the Imperium among them and prepare those people for the battle against the xenos."

e083dc5f-6b0c-489b-81b9-22712ec7461a.Text: "Providence itself has brought me here. I assisted the Commissar in his search in hopes of finding you among the captives. I devoted myself to helping the faithful yet frail pluck up their strength and guiding the able yet desperate toward hope. And my efforts have already borne fruit: two squads have gone on a scouting mission to discover safe passage out of Commorragh."

02ba4017-f73b-475b-9bad-ac864ae9a39c.Text: "I found them, subjects of the Imperium who were taken to this den of misery and despair, scattered across this vast Chasm. They were condemned to suffer for the amusement of enemies of Humanity, but the beasts were wrong in thinking we would simply resign ourselves to our fate! I share my faith in the future with them, the future that we will claim with His name upon our lips!"

57aeada6-41c7-43f8-9688-2d555f98dd60.Text: {n}There is a subtle change in Argenta's gleaming eyes, and they begin to resemble glowing embers.{/n} "Perhaps this accursed place has afflicted you after all... You speak of madness that is tantamount to heresy, for you would be beheading the resistance and leaving these adamant hearts, His faithful, without a leader! I cannot let that come to pass, Rogue Trader, and I hope you do not intend to execute this plan in earnest."

569c55e2-2c5f-4b85-b913-5c93a6e1fbc1.Text: {n}Argenta looks at the people around her and nods.{/n} "I have served the resistance for as long as I could. My duty to these people is done — it is high time I rejoined you and pursued my original mission. But first, allow me to offer a few final words of guidance to my flock."

d05e3098-339d-47db-b867-a960f03b73dc.Text: {n}Argenta scoffs.{/n} "You are harbouring a snake, {name}. You will have to sleep with one eye open, for you will find no rest for as long as this monster lives."

bb5eb95a-ac65-4f39-9f17-d4e422116277.Text: "Deceived by whom? Her own kinsman? Do you honestly believe that, {name}? That worthless tale spun by an enemy of Humanity, a tale that could only convince a senseless child?"

8b798dd5-cb77-47e8-9d18-15c1f129d59a.Text: {n}Yrliet gazes at her from beneath a veneer of cold aloofness.{/n} "Your judgements have no weight before the elantach's will. Do not waste your breath on attempts to intimidate or insult me, for your words are like picked leaves that the wind throws against the cliffs."

e27369c3-a43c-4f88-a555-dafafff208ce.Text: {n}Turning her clear gaze to Solomorne, Argenta exclaims,{/n} "Proctor! I have heard about your escape — about a prisoner who broke free from the clutches of his xenos jailers. I see you have even found the Rogue Trader — the Emperor has blessed you with incredible fortitude and resolve!"

71966b41-9b10-42b7-9ece-5317940271a3.Text: "No, Sister, it was {mf|he|she} who found me. And there was nothing valiant about my escape. But you — this place has surely put your faith to the test, yet you've emerged from that trial unstained."

2e964fb0-6fa5-44af-9fdb-cfd94c7e8022.Text: {n}Argenta turns to her audience, and her voice fills with zealous fire:{/n} "Servants of the Emperor! Children of Humanity! Be strong in your resolve and pure in your faith, for our deliverance is at hand! Steel your hearts, for a great trial lies ahead of us all, but the reward for passing it is freedom!"

3267671b-34bd-4432-a2f3-da860ab2b5f6.Text: "If only the Exalted One had given me a sign that his beautiful battle angel had survived to illuminate this disgusting place!" {n}Jae gazes admiringly at Argenta and makes the sign of the Aquila.{/n} "I would have rushed to your side long ago, Sister. You'll not find a more trustworthy ally in this shithole."

d89d462d-b4b5-4d10-8c8f-e3cbed859b66.Text: "Your parlance has changed greatly since the last time I saw you, Jae. Your language is now rife with profanities... and sincerity." {n}Argenta's eyes widen in surprise.{/n} "Your throat—"

8df5d52c-b531-4b1a-9d74-4bfa99f76c3f.Text: "In His name..." {n}Jae clenches the gilded Aquila in her hand and brushes her bitten lips against it.{/n}

431d40b2-ed08-4101-9419-c5b9f5393503.Text: "There is no safe way out of Commorragh. You are lying to yourself and to these poor people. Wherever you send them, the Dark City holds only death and misery for mon-keigh."

d15d5c5e-c084-470b-9604-e2768efcc2ed.Text: "I am recording an instance of manifest grace evidenced by this unit's survival. I praise—" {n}His vox falls silent for a moment, then hisses cautiously,{/n} "I praise the Emperor for this gift."

3aae05f5-9b3e-4bec-808b-d21e66489b78.Text: "Your poisonous words cannot break my spirit and my faith, xenos. I would rather die fighting evil than surrender!" {n}Argenta clenches her jaw and you notice the spark of doubt that flashes in her eyes.{/n}

4841c257-d95b-43a8-89bf-b9650a04e561.Text: {n}With a warm laugh, Argenta winks at Pasqal.{/n} "Let us forget our theological differences for now, Brother Pasqal. You and I carry the same light, and here in the darkness, it is more evident than anywhere else. I have been praying for you."

b548da0e-31ff-4873-9d2f-0b3bf63b7cfe.Text: "For your crimes, I am sending you to the arena. You will suffer the fate to which you doomed so many others."

c5465c2a-b5b6-4155-a981-8425ce0bf9c3.Text: "Tell me, Malice, do you still have something stowed away? Some extra-special stash?"

ca783f88-e551-44cd-853a-1135496e0e30.Text: "Does anyone here wish to challenge my leadership?"

7d18a357-6194-4196-88bc-0a4368a387d8.Text: "In the next fight, you are coming with me! We shall make the arena drink of xenos blood!"

6856e6b4-b842-4edd-9424-5f62edf06efc.Text: "So, you are the Shriekers, the vicious predators who await their death in the arena. Is that what Malice told you?"

e1effe5d-ec2f-4cff-bbaa-8dc4e7cbaba2.Text: [Look around for victims for the ritual]

2eb01763-65bd-4f75-9274-902f53e3ae60.Text: "The Commissar is no longer in charge of this unit. Any objections?"

31283f39-9679-4845-8cea-3b047841b35e.Text: "Where did Malice keep his trophies? They are mine now."

b3a92a94-3392-40af-a8a1-e76caa162cae.Text: "Shriekers, you will fight at my side in the next battle in the arena! Follow my lead!"

74b5e786-5699-4413-aa74-8c268a831214.Text: "In the name of the Emperor, I, {name} von Valancius, give you my word that I will lead you out of this place."

45d67eb8-ecba-4703-9fa3-224251b1900a.Text: "Why throw your lives away for nothing? We have a gang. We have a hideout. We will try to survive."

95b93e87-e443-4a61-9733-d65cefa5d04e.Text: "And lead you I shall! You may live like refuse, but your deaths will be glorious!"

ec56a2e6-180c-48ff-84f3-3f60b84f3c9e.Text: "Do you not understand that Malice was just manipulating you? You died one after another while he prospered off your deaths!"

a9c54f68-b8ac-482f-baa2-d20fcf86c2a6.Text: "I do agree with the part about wretched spawn. However, you aren't fighters anymore. You are my servants. Is that clear?"

8b7524aa-fe27-4d78-a361-259121f6db66.Text: "Forget all that drivel about finding glory in death. We're a gang now — nothing more, nothing else. We look out for no one but ourselves. And I am your chief."

3abb51df-35fb-4111-aa70-0cdf1f536b44.Text: [Make a commanding gesture] "I do not wish to be disturbed."

c0bbdd8b-6e35-4c2b-a2c6-30a4d344081c.Text: [Turn to the Commissar] "How is your neck? Does it hurt?"

fea9f205-f62e-4348-87c2-b5e4d5b581d9.Text: [Speak to Malice] "You should have shown greater hospitality when I first came to you."

5acda577-3923-49d7-9422-a45c75313af8.Text: "I see you do not feel any remorse for your vile misdeeds. Not yet. Well, you have plenty of time."

7c092ad5-be8e-4059-a591-bd081e0b10c8.Text: "Threats are unwise in your position. Better to think on what you have to barter for your freedom."

7afec426-9f16-4e4d-8b7e-0b1fb35fb69b.Text: "I will not become like the xenos. You are free to go."

ff6cc084-7f2b-4c14-a226-4972a0f22246.Text: "Well, I doubt you will get to see that. Send this scum to the arena with the next batch of meat!"

1dff6e2a-c79b-49c0-b251-ffb767247a41.Text: "No longer will you hide behind the backs of others. When the Haemonculus's servant comes to collect the gladiators, I shall be sending you to the arena.."

f720f8f6-0882-4d8d-b4a0-95007875b712.Text: "The xenos has assumed his rightful place."

7417b224-a48c-465e-8b44-609723ac8593.Text: "You did save my life. I am letting you go."

32070909-6b3a-4611-99b5-ff3fd93d5503.Text: Declared the rule of the Imperial Creed in the Pit.

b7d6cf9b-d2ba-4c5b-a53b-9e9965db1d61.Text: [Address the people] "Long have we, true servants of the Imperium, tolerated the xenos taint around us! It is with these words that I pronounce the absolute authority of the Imperial Creed in this part of the Chasm! Go now and strike down the impure!"

e6e721ef-5f95-4238-b680-335c5c9401b4.Text: Convinced the resistance fighters in the Pit to renounce the Emperor.

1ce051da-3d3e-4f64-8ba2-7646fea5816f.Text: "The Emperor's Peace? Why should I grant you the deliverance of the one who failed to protect you from deceit? The one who left you to rot among xenos and traitors? No, the Emperor will not get you out of here. But I will... if your pleas convince me. Kneel!"

fc25d687-fd4e-4331-bd67-9e0a68bc978f.Text: [Sacrifice the resistance fighters to the gods of the warp] "Gather before me. The time has come for your last act of service."

4422769c-bd9c-4abc-a627-04fcba59fd57.Text: [Do not listen to the voice — exterminate them all]

16d9943c-9c49-46fe-a60c-2ca137a8d0b3.Text: [Do not exterminate them... yet] "I have changed my mind. I can still use you."

661823fe-10c2-418a-b89d-a0c7c80735fe.Text: [Draw your weapon] "I hereby grant you the Emperor's Peace."

7246769d-01e2-41de-a550-7464ac93c143.Text: "I have not relieved you yet. The Emperor has no more use for you, but I do. You shall become my serfs. Any objections?"

0e72fd5f-a32f-476c-9f7c-f029cf86c240.Text: "One day, we shall all die for Him! Not as cowards, but as heroes! My comrades, be strong in your faith and prepare to fight!"

853f5bd7-72b5-43b0-8f04-3a3932180da9.Text: [Execute Malice] "You spoke so much about a glorious death in the arena. Instead, I shall put you down in a pathetic cage."

c77b7524-de7e-48d9-8282-19b83374520a.Text: [Exterminate the Shriekers] "You wanted me to lead you to your deaths? This is it, the end of your journey!"

9a398db0-d1d8-41fb-9333-38f37b815dd9.Text: [Turn to the Commissar] "Do you wish to repent, traitor?"

f79887fa-38de-4797-85d6-e15f43157ad2.Text: [Execute the Commissar] "You are not worth the rations. I shall dispose of you."

0d517fae-86d4-4a67-a111-070ee7c9a65d.Text: [Execute the Commissar] "For your crimes, I am sentencing you to death and granting you the Emperor's Peace."

bf5ea9dd-e9ef-4fed-9082-8e272760c600.Text: [Sacrifice the Shriekers to the gods of the warp] "Gather before me. The time has come to offer you to the higher powers."

73070007-d8d5-4c72-bee0-efe6d7ad168f.Text: Executed Malice and the Commissar for their crimes against the Imperium.

06268e93-6e2f-47ec-a147-71dc64e009e7.Text: [Execute Malice and the Commissar] "For the glory of His deeds, for the good of Humanity, and in the name of the God-Emperor, I sentence you both to death! Carry out their sentence immediately!"

4bd796d4-1cf7-446b-9208-e22a4027a498.Text: "There is something you must know: the man who called himself the Commissar was a traitor and an accomplice of the xenos. His promises of escape were nothing but lies."

267a1324-750e-4ddd-b5da-adb9fa59b168.Text: {n}The gang of cutthroat gladiators known as the Shriekers stare at you in terror and obsequiousness. No one dares to wipe {d|Encyclopedia:Ch3_AngerDead}Malice's blood{/d} off the floor: it is a symbol of your status.{/n}

d75b847e-1859-42d1-934b-4776966493ef.Text: {n}The Commissar's former fighters shake their heads in fear.{/n} "No... None, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"

21a36b89-1fec-4167-8c12-1191ae011f0b.Text: "Better to die for the Emperor than to live for yourself!" {n}The grim battle cry shakes the walls of the den, igniting a spark of the Imperium's light in the abominable darkness of Commorragh.{/n}

5d791c51-51d7-4b35-b9f8-7fd5af9b82d7.Text: {n}The gladiators murmur in fear,{/n} "No... no one, no. You're stronger than Malice. Lead us. We're yours."

06015733-3904-41f4-8e40-e62f517d1f8b.Text: {n}One of the resistance fighters points to a container filled to the brim with loot.{/n} "This is everything we found in this vile den. We searched all of that sly xenos's secret caches and stashes."

006da54f-da61-41d2-8b46-928f6183e157.Text: {n}One of the Shriekers answers proudly, chin raised high:{/n} "Yes! We are deathspawn, murderous wretches! Malice led us to our deaths before — you lead us now!"

0cf2a15e-2191-4abb-b326-5fb651c95982.Text: {n}A Shrieker points at a container filled to the brim with loot.{/n} "This is all we had. Malice used to hide the best spoils in hidden caches, but we've emptied them all."

bcdfcb99-e9a6-4948-b008-ceaa9df523a8.Text: {n}The pitiful handful of freaks huddled in the corners of the lair would not make a worthy offering. The alien voice lurking in the back of your mind has fallen silent — you have missed your chance, slaughtering your servants before their time.{/n}

dd24095e-b258-4ca0-bc53-c0e149ba496f.Text: "Who can say, humanling... You can tear the den apart piece by piece, you can torture me — you will find nothing. We Sslyth know how to shut out our sense of pain, and will suppressors have no effect on us. So there is only one way you can get your hands on my treasures: open the cage, give me a knife, get on your knees, and let me carve your throat open. I will reveal the secret to you as you die."

60500f29-c32b-46af-b515-eaaff2ab7a43.Text: {n}A triumphant roar bursts from the throats of the condemned. The hissing of stimulant injectors rises up from every direction.{/n}

ec354c8a-45b1-443f-828e-76ae7a98a7ef.Text: {n}One of the warriors, a woman with a stern face and a grim voice, says firmly,{/n} "Then there is no hope. We are doomed to remain captives of the xenos. But a clean death is a better fate by far. May we beg Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} to grant us the Emperor's Peace?"

a1a6f6fb-df7f-4137-91b2-52ee0e8053d1.Text: {n}The crowd erupts into a wave of fierce cheers. The stimulant-fuelled cutthroats look ready to burst into the arena right now and strew their own guts all over its floor.{/n}

71230f5f-013c-40d1-9d3f-7c8c36f073eb.Text: {n}Your words cause some eyes to flash with anger, but there is no one foolish enough to oppose you even among these gladiators pumped full of stimulants.{/n}

98f8f0a4-63e7-4a32-b3b7-352a2f8d3ec3.Text: {n}Some of the gladiators look confused, while others sigh in relief. You hear someone grumble in the back,{/n} "Finally, a boss who's right in the head. I was so sick of Malice mucking up the brains of fresh meat with his crap."

a1e6f2a5-6f2f-4f16-845f-67a0ef22d233.Text: {n}The gladiators, who were holding their breath, look at each other with relief. They must have taken your silence as a good sign. Or rather, your silence and the fact that you have not killed any of them yet.{/n}

327953b5-7331-4693-9559-08ec06d7167b.Text: {n}You catch looks of displeasure coming from the Commissar's most fervent fighters, but the majority's spirits are only further crushed by this news. They drop to their knees and bow their heads, as is expected of serfs in the presence of their {mf|master|mistress}.{/n}

d04d26bb-9ada-4360-9abb-4764ea0b6e59.Text: {n}The Commissar, whose proud features are utterly ruined, says in a gurgling voice,{/n} "Enjkhoy your little vikhtory while you khan. Khommorragh will rip your khead off quickher than it did mine. Then we'll see who'll be sitting in whose khage."

d61c9d1c-c17c-4698-b6bb-27293d76318f.Text: "To the arena? Nkho! Pkhlease, khan I pkhlease stay in this khage, pkhlease!" {n}The Commissar's feigned pride evaporates in an instant, leaving behind a thrashing, frightened animal.{/n}

fde1d0fe-3799-4b4a-8716-a48a93506182.Text: {n}The Commissar shoots you a venomous glare.{/n}

e1ec752e-3d21-4e0f-962c-cb25c1fddedb.Text: "You do nkhot need to tell me tkhwice. So longkh."

98812bbf-3023-456b-a41b-e9a4f7299420.Text: {n}Malice's entire body is covered in grisly wounds. One of his arms has been nearly torn off and is now hanging by sinew. A human would have long since died from such injuries, but Malice does not even look like he is on his last legs.{/n} "Laugh away, humanling. You've won. 'Betray the one who aids you' — that's life in the spires."

0e784335-1557-4311-b8b0-1842340d1300.Text: "Very well. Once, you surprised me. You didn't die, and I lost my status. Maybe I won't die either. Maybe you will lose something too."

549caa97-75c1-43ac-b52f-dfb507512a40.Text: "Do you not see the irony of the situation? You think yourself the one with the key to the cage... But in truth, you yourself are caged."

e961ea3e-7dec-4d67-824d-773f689d6920.Text: {n}Malice scoffs hoarsely and bares his fangs.{/n} "Not a chance. If I do, you might live, humanling. And I would still be sitting in this cage. No, your problems are your own."

e4711fa8-f4f8-407b-856a-b10fd5caeea2.Text: {n}Malice stares at you with suspicion and then says cautiously,{/n} "Do not think that I will forget or forgive."

7e053894-430f-4b67-8912-4bacee6da015.Text: {n}The resistance fighters are looking at you with a mixture of {d|Encyclopedia:Ch3_ComissarDead}fear and deep respect{/d}. They do not have the guts to break the silence and speak to you.{/n}

60b5cf16-b829-45cd-a316-ba81cd1d391a.Text: {n}A shocked murmur runs through the ranks. One fighter sobs, his face twisted in grief, while another whispers a string of curses, his fists clenched.{/n}

dd652abc-499c-43d3-9bbf-fc31f884d2c4.Text: "To survive. The Khult and I, we had a dkheal. They gkhet playthings, I gkhet protection. That's life in the spires."

02909f68-8d62-4883-8469-3ca6c8f94857.Text: {n}An alien voice sharply invades your mind:{/n} "Stop! Kill... in the right way. Ritual... Sacrifice."

fc1f2335-ed31-4ff3-bfd1-43f721a1ca38.Text: {n}The frozen crowd exchange glances. Your fickle temper fills them with fear and hope that if they obey, your anger will once again pass them by.{/n}

7da7c501-55a5-4f0d-816e-4f7d179f6fe7.Text: {n}The eyes of the Commissar's most zealous fighters flare in displeasure, but most are too crushed by the news. Your fickle temper does not inspire trust, but they have no one else to rely on.{/n}

22c58026-6aef-4f69-92e6-d86bbc06fc1f.Text: {n}Reeling, the Sslyth slithers away while looking straight at you without blinking, either in expectation of a sudden strike or to avoid making eye contact with anyone else.{/n}

d3d3df8c-4efa-423a-8ac3-e11cced889e5.Text: {n}The Commissar turns to you as he leaves, and you see a mad smile playing on his lips and a look in his eyes that says, "This isn't over."{/n}

61f5d61a-ec8b-4a6c-8843-9eac84df0600.Text: {n}The crowd erupts into emboldened shouts. Those who were ready to accept death with humble resignation a moment ago now look up with brightened expressions, gripping their weapons and roaring battle cries in the face of a grim fate.{/n}

9980b3f9-9967-4fa5-addf-fffd8b9ae918.Text: {n}In a united impulse, the crowd falls to its knees before you. You see their eyes, awestruck and warm like sunlight. As they offer their many-voiced prayer to the Emperor, you hear your name uttered over and over again.{/n}

b0308ad6-bdda-4b7d-9d37-7a656d949455.Text: {n}You catch looks of displeasure coming from the Commissar's most fervent fighters, but the majority greet your words with weary relief. You hear whispers among the crowd:{/n} "Well, why not? Maybe we will survive. Malice's thugs were doing all right for themselves. And we'll do just fine without the Emperor."

6d5580f7-201f-4668-801b-d58ccfc184d3.Text: {n}One by one, the proud people of the Imperium drop to their knees. Some of the faces show fear. Some display grim determination. Some bear expressions of serene acceptance. There are no cowards among the resistance fighters — none who would choose life among the xenos to death in the name of the Emperor.{/n}

343926cf-edee-4072-a961-ff43306641b7.Text: {n}A {d|Encyclopedia:Ch3_EmptyPit}gaggle of pathetic weaklings{/d} are all that is left of the denizens of this hideout. They are too terrified of the streets of Commorragh to leave this shelter, as unsafe as it has become.{/n}

60826f17-a785-4bb7-ada1-556d773a591a.Text: {n}Resilient to the end, the xenos refuses to die, clinging to his life with every fibre of his being. But there is nowhere for Malice to hide and, in the end, his cold heart stops. His jaw goes slack and his long, pale purple tongue falls out of his mouth. Malice, the master of the Shriekers, is dead.{/n}

ddbadb84-5ea2-4cb2-af51-6522e04098fd.Text: {n}The people listen to you with wide eyes, hanging on every word with the greed of the downtrodden. As soon as you are finished speaking, you hear a cacophony of roars — and the clanging of weapons.{/n}

e332fc6d-60b7-43fb-91fd-230e81d9899e.Text: {n}Some gladiators let out a triumphant roar and charge in your direction to accept the gift of death from your hands. Others, terrified, scramble away with cries of fear.{/n}

b5ebfae1-1c52-43c5-80d3-6cb413939082.Text: {n}The Commissar meets your blow with a straight back and a raised chin. He gazes into the face of death with a fearlessness worthy of a true disciplinary officer of the Imperium.{/n}

8aa221c4-a357-421b-aabf-96ea8b7b54cb.Text: {n}The Commissar meets your blow with a straight back and a raised chin just as a real disciplinary officer of the Imperium would. It may be nothing more than a fraud's deception, but this fraud relishes his performance and prefers to die without breaking character.{/n}

2462dd2e-4584-4d4d-96a8-ef452f2f80d9.Text: {n}In a united impulse, the crowd falls to its knees before you. You see grimaces of powerless rage and despair at the realisation that even the Emperor has betrayed them. Where once the Emperor's light shone in their souls, there is now only a gaping void waiting to be filled by a new patron. Every last one of them knows that their worthless fate is in your hands.{/n}

d1d2063f-6917-4981-87a0-a528716c5b59.Text: "For our {mf|lord|lady} von Valancius! Kill the xenos spawn, crush their skulls, and let their blood flow!" {n}The bloodthirsty cry shakes the walls of the den, and the mere sound of it makes you feel as if you can taste the blood of your enemies in your throat.{/n}

5cb073e7-bf5a-4a86-93c4-0583bffeb93f.Text: "The stone is what helps you keep your powers at bay. There is a good chance it saved you from losing your mind just now."

87072e45-d744-4d38-b85b-31fa1b2c66b4.Text: {n}Cassia considers your words and then nods in agreement.{/n} "Perhaps I might lose my chance at freedom. So be it. That way, my mind and my powers will remain mine to command. There is no place for madness in the Imperium. For mad Navigators... that is even more true."

fb43a958-bb5e-4150-823c-060eae79609b.Text: "It was not the stone that contained your powers, Cassia. It was you. Set yourself free, for you have no need for shackles."

4c2a3c56-d025-4cd0-8675-819f416faa84.Text: "It is true... You are right. Unless I free myself now, I will be forever the prisoner of my own power... and the fears of others." {n}Cassia clenches the medallion and its energies resonate with her own. The icy stone begins to glow red with heat until it breaks apart with a resounding crackle. Cassia covers the wound with a hand and smiles warmly.{/n} "Are you not yet tired of the sight of this place? It is time we were on our way, Lord Captain."

463a37c5-b0ae-49fe-9ab2-62231fe2c23e.Text: {n}Cassia thinks for a moment and then clenches the medallion. As its energies resonate with her own, the icy stone in her clawed hand begins to glow red with heat until it breaks apart with a resounding crack. Cassia covers the wound and says in a quiet yet confident tone of voice,{/n} "House Orsellio can now trust me. I can trust myself. Such is my decision."

4da42dde-02e6-4b8f-9820-10dde08affcd.Text: {n}Cassia thinks for a moment and then shakes her head.{/n} "No... Though I might lose my chance at freedom, my mind and my powers will remain mine to command. There is no place for madness in the Imperium. For mad Navigators... that is even more true."

162eef54-2ebb-4d74-b398-26586dbe7a68.Text: "Lady Navigator, compose yourself! You are embarrassing the Orsellio name!"

ba06d534-7188-4b30-aac0-d7c73540f594.Text: "You will overcome this, Cassia. You are stronger than you think you are."

7ee27b34-8ff9-4889-834b-ce2a697d1690.Text: Calmed Cassia with a prayer in Commorragh.

40dd3091-b29f-418c-8d98-9276f2d10585.Text: [Soothe her with prayer] "May the Emperor's radiance illuminate our way through the tenebrous gloom as we that are broken of heart turn to His wisdom..."

17b9db2f-f7ce-4f07-b2fd-e5fdc3e3e7ff.Text: "I am not interested in listening to you vent your grievances. Prove that you are still of use to me, or I shall send you back into the darkness!"

5b77f5b0-1514-4f44-b43c-6bf4703f31e1.Text: [Seal Cassia inside the capsule] "I am doing this for everyone's sake."

7fd91c7c-d7f3-4566-97ec-1276e385c43b.Text: [Leave Cassia] "You are a ticking time bomb. I cannot take you with me."

a4fa227c-6a52-48c5-be1a-3adb145c2d85.Text: "I will not leave you here. Come along."

a0bbc221-11ea-44d8-9332-7f206db6ca32.Text: "And now... May I escort you out of here?"

f0321724-4f81-4077-91b1-6cf01e4c4388.Text: [Soothe her with prayer] "...The Emperor is with us so long as we remember our purpose — to serve Humankind and to never give in to its enemies..."

db047fd9-0e37-44b4-90af-7e0d93b724b8.Text: [Pick up a pistol from the floor and shoot Cassia] "I shall grant your final request."

d93c04da-fe84-4b5f-9ad3-8af263cbf5e8.Text: [Pick up a pistol from the floor and shoot Cassia] "I should have killed you as soon as I met you."

8af9342b-0c1a-456d-85ec-b89446effafe.Text: "You are frightened, but that does not mean you can give up. Do not let these emotions consume you!"

54d7f424-d8a7-44a1-a421-0d35c662a884.Text: [Pick up a pistol from the floor and shoot Cassia]

708c0554-8318-4e75-93f9-eb7d22f317fa.Text: "My only thought was to save you."

58c1b63c-80b5-4bb4-ad82-b76e3d16543a.Text: "What you say is true. Growing too close does not bode well for either of us. I hope you understand."

decc56db-84cc-493c-a94f-0d3aebdcb2c6.Text: "I was thinking about a future where we are together."

b4fd86bb-a2dc-461c-98e5-0f9b71cfa612.Text: "Whatever happened to you, we can make it right. Put your trust in me."

1652445c-68e0-4c71-9f2d-49a60b119b92.Text: [Kiss her] "Words fail me as I seek to express my feelings. Let my actions speak for me."

6f20ef9d-3a88-4be8-968e-8f0645b551a2.Text: "Do you wish to spend the rest of your days as the Haemonculus's test subject?"

1b681e34-456d-4945-9300-0106cfe3726f.Text: "For all those years, fear and loneliness were all you knew. Not anymore. Don't you dare wish death upon yourself! When I am with you, I will strive to alleviate your every sorrow!"

95a300b0-9fd4-4689-b244-ced88c1b9121.Text: [Hold her and kiss her] "Don't even think of leaving me, Cassia. I won't let you go."

6ce5f271-cc78-450b-ab12-b2584b9cf171.Text: [Hold her closer] "I fear that if I were to let you go, you might want to disappear again."

074a151b-5fd8-4df1-b678-62560b96295e.Text: [Kill Cassia] "Forgive me, love. I shall grant your final request."

ebb406f5-1679-48a4-8c04-37b05b042076.Text: "We are in enemy territory! Unless you regain control of yourself, I will end this tumult personally!"

261ec958-e3e8-4d86-b419-a18cf45a7924.Text: "Cassia, the worst part is over. I am taking you away from this place."

9fb87bf7-fbbb-4ee8-a114-ebc40588ac9e.Text: "You will pay dearly for the injuries you have caused me. Come with me."

5f928336-3153-4683-afa5-e59be57500cd.Text: "Thank the Emperor, you look like yourself again. Let us depart. There will be other opportunities to talk."

8a8bb758-fb56-4a69-a23e-349adff57614.Text: [Smile through the pain] "All is well, my lady. You can defeat this. I shall stay by your side and help however I can."

e2b1e100-e75c-4060-a2bc-9f1c34576311.Text: "Cassia, we have walked a long road together. Do not make me abandon you here. Keep fighting!"

43af957a-4342-45f6-b2e6-7f47d56ba5df.Text: [Pick up a pistol from the floor and shoot Cassia]

ffbd311d-6ac2-4f02-938e-0cef03a38bcd.Text: "You have had to rein in your gift before. Try to remember how you did it then!"

901fa0dc-c0c8-494a-851e-bb93c596bbf0.Text: "I... feel. At last, I feel something..." {n}You see horror and confusion in Cassia's wide-open eyes. Her face, neck, and hands are gruesomely scratched and sticky blood is dripping from the tips of her claw-like fingernails.{/n} "Ah! Why are there so many of you at once? Red. Black. Violet. Scarlet. Yellow. Dark maroon... Away with you! Stop swarming my thoughts!"

255c132f-8f01-46fc-89a5-cc6b4b75a82d.Text: "The Orsellio name... is no less glorious than that of von Valancius..." {n}Cassia struggles to focus her eyes on you. An unfamiliar expression is imprinted on her pale, gaunt face, one that is stern, confident, and imperious. It is the same expression you saw on Theodora von Valancius's face when you first met her.{/n} "Rogue Traders are not the only ones favoured by the Emperor, {name}. Do not dare threaten me."

686bef1b-19de-40cf-b562-d11378d09818.Text: {n}Cassia clutches her head again, this time covering her third eye, but you can already feel the breath of the warp coming from its gaze. The {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_CassiaAmuletOn}stone fused into her body{/d} heats up under her pale skin, burns through it, and... cracks.{/n} "{name}, I cannot control it!" {n}The powers flowing through Cassia's fragile body make your head swim and your hair stand on end.{/n}

39eadb15-cc7e-4359-890d-fc0d8d1685ba.Text: {n}Cassia clutches her head again, this time covering her third eye, but you can already feel the breath of the warp coming from its gaze.{/n} "{name}, I... I cannot control it!" {n}The powers flowing through Cassia's fragile body make your head swim and your hair stand on end.{/n}

6965cb88-3a3d-4aa7-8dc4-cfc53f9168ff.Text: "I thank you for pulling me out of that... darkness, Lord Captain. And I beg your forgiveness for what happened. I... Oh, let us leave this awful place at last."

70496cd2-d10f-401c-a2ef-0292b381f01d.Text: {n}Cassia struggles to focus her eyes on you. An unfamiliar expression is imprinted on her pale, gaunt face, one that is stern, confident, and imperious. It is the same expression you saw on Theodora von Valancius's face when you first met her.{/n} "...And may His light scatter the darkness ahead, for the Astronomican is the beacon and His guiding blessing to me..."

b66efc24-5380-47c3-a759-129e8f836c2f.Text: {n}Cassia struggles to focus her eyes on you. An unfamiliar expression is imprinted on her pale, gaunt face, one that is stern, confident, and imperious. It is the same expression you saw on Theodora von Valancius's face when you first met her.{/n} "At this very moment, I am trying to save your life. Should I... stop?"

2762a20f-ee2a-48ad-afb7-c4caafde0577.Text: "Remarkable. You believe in me even when I have lost all faith in my own strength." {n}Cassia smiles faintly, enduring the pain.{/n}

60727a31-b984-4a1e-9397-2221312717e4.Text: {n}Your body is burning as if you have been doused with a vat of molten plasteel, and your head is teeming with strange whispers, shadows, voices... Every breath is a struggle, as though something is scratching at your insides, trying to claw its way out of your chest. Your gorge rises. You have survived being exposed to the Navigator's open eye, but will your body and mind hold if it occurs again?{/n}

87190750-aeed-4548-8a1a-8e40014e0d98.Text: "You know, when darkness envelops you... it takes everything away. Leaving no sounds, no smells, no solid footing. Darkness devours every colour that tries to make its way in. Every colour I tried to create inside. Darkness is withering, it swallows the colours, it chews and consumes... But when despair had overtaken me completely, I could sense I was not alone in that darkness. Someone else was with me. Someone intangible, cold, and colourless. And that realisation ravaged my sanity all the more."

b77728ac-e88b-49cf-9252-ad959c18cf22.Text: {n}Cassia closes her eyes and the tremors in her body taper to a stop. With a weary movement of her hand, she adjusts her forehead adornment, taking care to cover her Navigator's eye, and you no longer feel the menace that was emanating from her a moment ago.{/n} "Thank... you? Your words, they helped. I feel a little better..."

79fea924-0dc5-4262-af8d-a33d4bd6bd57.Text: {n}A haze of anger, despair, and fear smothers you like a burial shroud, but this is not the first time you have had to deal with a surge of foreign emotions assailing your mind. You wish you would die here and now. No. You wish you had never been born in the first place. You summon your will and push these thoughts away as though fending off a sword thrust, and Cassia's feelings dissipate before they can latch onto you.{/n}

50d8074f-4497-4505-825f-7e09c8568bd7.Text: {n}A haze of anger, despair, and fear smothers you like a burial shroud. Rage is burrowing under your skin with hundreds of needles and distress is turning your lungs inside out. An inexplicable sense of loneliness and emptiness permeates your mind. You are drowning in someone else's emotions... or are they your own? It no longer matters. You are powerless to stop them. You wish you would die here and now. No. You wish you had never been born in the first place.{/n}

2c802eb1-d06c-4918-bd99-dbba2547bea1.Text: {n}Cassia takes a hesitant step toward you and nods slowly. Her fear and despair spread to you like a heavy burden upon your shoulders. Resisting her emotions was a difficult task even when they were stable. Now her powers have become that much more overwhelming.{/n}

0b17610c-2185-41cc-97a5-d16eac13d657.Text: {n}With visible effort, Cassia clasps her hands in a gesture of prayer.{/n} "...and to believe in His might, and His aid, and His wisdom. And if we still have the strength to fight, then fight we shall to the end..." {n}Her pale brow furrows and rivulets of blood run from her nose and eyes.
