Undeterred, she focuses on bringing her powers under control... until her body jolts as if electrocuted.{/n}

5bcd81d8-4b9d-48af-acac-17781e9a4e0d.Text: {n}With visible effort, Cassia clasps her hands in a gesture of prayer but lets go instantly.{/n} "I cannot, I just..." {n}She suddenly straightens and her gaze becomes impassive and blank.{/n}

276baca0-3d8b-4a5a-a51c-31dcaf72f444.Text: {n}An eerie chill runs down the entire length of your body. It is a feeling you forgot, but recollection swiftly follows: someone else's turmoil and emotions and a will that is not your own... This crushing wave is about to consume you.{/n}

61ca8b07-c046-494d-85bf-1829080788cc.Text: "The Emperor protects, Lord Captain." {n}Cassia smiles, enduring the pain.{/n}

5e33c740-b0b2-4f8c-a00e-83aba0147293.Text: "Were it not for your insistence, I might well be dead at this very moment. Thank you... for not abandoning me." {n}Cassia affectionately squeezes your hand — ever so gently — and lets go.{/n}

5260acf9-f9c1-4214-a52e-798dcf08e904.Text: {n}Taking an awkward step back, Cassia gingerly covers her third eye, as if afraid that she might unleash her soul's tempestuous powers upon you once more.{/n} "You risked your life to save me. For a Rogue Trader, the ruler of a great dynasty, it was... utter lunacy. It was irresponsible!" {n}Cassia's brow furrows indignantly, but her eyes are full of pain and despair.{/n} "Your protectorate, your billions of subjects, they could have lost their sovereign in the blink of an eye. Yet, you... What were you even thinking?"

d734e7fa-ee24-4ede-9021-206903051e59.Text: "You do not understand, I..." {n}Cassia shakes her head and then nods wearily.{/n} "I do not want to stay here forever. I do not..." {n}She takes a deep breath and straightens her shoulders. Her pale brow furrows, rivulets of blood run from her nose and eyes, but Cassia fights to bring her powers under control... until her body jolts as if electrocuted.{/n}

865f2f24-538a-4b41-97ce-be1812176080.Text: {n}Cassia closes her eyes, trying to focus, but then immediately cries out and opens her third eye — just for a brief moment, but it is enough to blast you with another surge of deadly energies.{/n}

25359baa-05e4-4bd8-85fa-8da82114c976.Text: "I... I don't know!" {n}Cassia throws up her hands and closes her eyes in exhaustion.{/n} "I am so very tired..."

4bf32eb9-fcd6-46ff-a129-f9ea9cf41b31.Text: {n}You go for the pistol again but the weight of the emotional shock nearly throws you off your feet. Cassia suddenly straightens and her gaze becomes impassive and blank.{/n}

ca2344ed-53e0-4e5d-96bf-88eabfcc40e3.Text: {n}You try to reach for the weapon lying at your feet but your limbs will not budge. You have a splitting headache and you are seeing double. Your hand slips off and an eerie chill runs down the entire length of your body as Cassia suddenly straightens. Her gaze is impassive and blank.{/n}

4188d351-ec95-4e34-bc7f-ff02f69a8ebf.Text: {n}Frigid heaviness hangs in the air. Your entire being implores you to run. Quickly. Now!{/n}

95058316-7ce0-4a0b-9a92-d1c8db635c96.Text: {n}Cassia does nothing to deter her fate, merely closes her eyes in acceptance.{/n}

8e389239-fef8-47b2-b572-b3f3ba7b1863.Text: "Even my third eye cannot see the Emperor's light in this accursed place. All my prayers will go unheard."

2086b412-27a2-4f7b-bfed-97bc34cd5747.Text: "I... understand. It will be difficult but it is for the best that we forget about what happened." {n}Cassia involuntarily touches her lips and an awkward silence hangs in the air until she notices the {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_CassiaAmuletOn}cracked stone{/d} that has torn the delicate skin on her neck.{/n}

34718c3f-b6c7-4f1a-af3e-1ef3671e9c0e.Text: "{name}, look! The energies sustaining this artefact are almost depleted! Were I to give it just one more push, I know I would be able to remove it. However, after what transpired today, I am no longer certain if Felek and the others were so wrong about me."

a0b43783-7d9d-45ed-bc92-450a5e3acb20.Text: "Might we move away from this terrible place now, {name}? I do not wish to stay here any longer."

3f733d64-2840-4d80-822a-cb6914b9efe3.Text: "Please stop!" {n}Cassia exclaims, gently covering your mouth with a hand.{/n} "My lips... are sore from the wounds. I can feel your heart in your actions, I do. But for now, please... let us enjoy a moment of respite." {n}She caresses your cheek and then steps away, abashed.{/n}

a03f8722-1acf-473f-8323-a9469f4c7857.Text: {n}Cassia glances involuntarily at the Haemonculus's sphere and her body shudders again.{/n} "Might you agree to continuing this another time, {name}? I cannot bear to remain in this place any longer."

56eb6589-3cb7-4a87-9ffc-3ed2a4676c4c.Text: {n}Cassia glances at the Haemonculus's sphere and her hand involuntarily reaches for the Atlas in her chest. That is when she notices the cracked stone that has torn the delicate skin on her neck.{/n} "{name}, look! The energies sustaining this artefact are almost depleted! Were I to give it just one more push, I know I would be able to remove it. However, after what transpired today, I am no longer certain if Felek and the others were so wrong about me."

d16264a3-ef46-48f9-ae9a-233129088fc8.Text: "I... I will try." {n}She takes a deep breath and straightens her shoulders. Her pale brow furrows, rivulets of blood run from her nose and eyes, but Cassia fights to bring her powers under control... until her body jolts as if electrocuted.{/n}

8e994051-fd64-4587-a750-6c5d9c4bc638.Text: {n}Cassia's body is rocking violently, her eyes are shifting back and forth, and her legs are about to give out. Her Navigator's eye twitches restlessly, ready to open at any moment, and oppressive emotions constrict your neck like a tight knot. Cassia is falling apart, barely holding back her raging powers.{/n}

ace57462-7699-4224-89da-8cce6c52d784.Text: {n}Cassia closes her eyes and the tremors in her body taper to a stop. With a weary movement of her hand, she adjusts her forehead adornment, taking care to cover her Navigator's eye, and you no longer feel the menace that was emanating from her a moment ago.{/n} "Thank you. Your words, they helped. I feel better already."

e18c3df5-fc16-4217-90fb-a6f6718e7447.Text: "I wish I were half as confident and courageous as you, Lord Captain." {n}A weak smile crosses Cassia's pale lips and she shakes her head.{/n}

c1f72ffa-15c9-44d5-a42b-2f5d8b4dcd84.Text: {n}You try to reach for the weapon lying at your feet but your limbs will not budge. You have a splitting headache and you are seeing double. Your hand slips off and an eerie chill runs down the entire length of your body. It is a feeling you forgot, but recollection swiftly follows: someone else's turmoil and emotions and a will that is not your own... This crushing wave is about to consume you.{/n}

6c2fa4c8-8d19-4834-a084-d886ab09dcbe.Text: "L-Lord Captain, {name}, wait! Do not leave me, not like this! Just... Just kill me instead!"

d5dd44b9-b544-40c6-841d-2b5319e17f5c.Text: "W-why have your colours turned so suddenly to dark shades of maroon?"

95635193-0036-4b51-b91b-7bfa3e95a8ac.Text: {n}Cassia takes a moment to regather her strength. Then, with a look of surprise, she touches the cracked stone that has torn the delicate skin on her neck.{/n} "The energies sustaining this artefact are almost depleted! Were I to give it just one more push, I know I would be able to remove it! However, after what transpired today, I am no longer certain if Felek and the others were so wrong about me."

703bfc13-9901-4cfa-b06b-ff6263aa6efb.Text: {n}Marazhai recoils, letting out a frenzied hiss.{/n} "I should have killed this thing back then... It's a foul gateway of Sai'lanthresh!"

a2a36426-e38c-48fb-8c98-0b4b9a95dffc.Text: "You still have not realised, have you? A storm cannot be brought to heel. A fire cannot be forced to spare its victim. The sun cannot be commanded to rise on the other side of the horizon. These are not things a person can accomplish simply by having the desire to do so. Even if that person is a daughter of a Navigator House." {n}Cassia suddenly straightens and her gaze becomes impassive and blank.{/n}

362cad0d-04b6-4c4a-9a66-a2ff84ac1afe.Text: "Cass, light of my eyes, you are stronger than this, you hear me? Fight it! Fight it, my pale-faced shereen!"

285f7f34-88af-45bf-bac2-99ec9fbe46fe.Text: {n}Glancing nervously at the Haemonculus's artefact, Cassia nods courteously.{/n} "I would be honoured, Lord Captain. If I might ask you to lead the way?"

fbd5e882-b5c5-4c5b-b162-c8f035b5f11b.Text: {n}Cassia looks away.{/n} "Your words are fair, and yet, trust me... I deeply regret what took place here."

2d5c2356-0105-42c9-8c3d-7a36c4e692ab.Text: {n}Cassia struggles to focus her eyes on you. An unfamiliar expression is imprinted on her pale, gaunt face, one that is stern, confident, and imperious. It is the same expression you saw on Theodora von Valancius's face when you first met her.{/n} "You do not even believe your own words. Look at me... Look! I am an abomination. A monster! And you know what must be done with monsters."

7bfce746-6667-46ab-83e4-c57fcdae6cb3.Text: "Do not speak of such things, do you hear me?" {n}Cassia digs her sharp nails into her head, and rivulets of blood turn her hair from white to crimson.{/n} "I could have killed you when we first met. I could have unwittingly robbed you of reason on your ship. It is my fault you were attacked in your own palace, and now..."

60050a26-b751-4194-b506-05a6351869b4.Text: "Do not speak of such things, do you hear me?" {n}Cassia digs her sharp nails into her head and rivulets of blood turn her hair from white to crimson.{/n} "I could have killed you when we first met. I could have unwittingly robbed you of reason on your ship. It is my fault you were attacked in your own palace, and now... now..." {n}Cassia suddenly straightens, and her gaze becomes impassive and blank.{/n}

9d126acd-2e2f-4f63-90e9-3187416fcbb5.Text: {n}Her eyes are brimming with red tears as she looks at you with passion and tenderness.{/n} "I cannot endanger you any longer, {name}. I... I will not let you suffer." {n}Cassia concentrates, determined to bring her powers under control... until her body jolts as if electrocuted.{/n}

cc910270-dff9-4b0e-a1aa-d44fdd553d84.Text: "When the capsule opened, my mind was drowned in grimy shades of crimson, and umber, and black, and... And I am going barmy, {name}. I thought I could harness this power, but now... You must end this. For my sake, for your own... and for that of all that we have shared. If you do this, I... I shan't object at all." {n}Cassia closes her eyes, unable to bring herself to meet your gaze. Her tremors subside for a brief moment, like a resigned victim going still in anticipation of the executioner's axe.{/n}

1fc58d21-6152-48a2-88b6-cfb119a8a915.Text: "Lord Captain? W-why have your colours turned so suddenly to dark shades of maroon?"

7bdc5f7e-0b52-456a-afac-c00c0aed05ac.Text: {n}Cassia freezes, startled by your touch, and your lips join together in a bittersweet kiss that tastes of blood and tears. You see terror in her wide-open eyes but then her body relaxes, and her eyes close along with her Navigator's eye. She reciprocates slowly, uncertainly, gently...{/n} "Please, no more! I cannot breathe... I fear I may faint..."

f8906c94-f198-4f1d-801b-244b43c749f2.Text: {n}Yrliet desperately clutches the spirit stone on her chest.{/n} "Elantach, hurry! She Who Thirsts is looking through the three eyes of this mon-keigh. Looking at us!"

c1d70b16-68ae-4439-8d6e-90455b582bb4.Text: {n}With a mix of tenderness and sadness, Cassia watches as a viscous crimson puddle grows beneath her body. Her clawed hand brushes carefully against your cheek and she rasps,{/n} "Thank... you, {name}. For doing this for me. I..." {n}A thin stream of blood escapes from her throat along with a cough.{/n} "You were the first soul I came to love in this world, even though I could not even love myself. So, please, live! Live..."

bf7bbcd7-eec6-4adb-b076-a854fc792548.Text: {n}Her pale hand slips off your cheek, her nails leaving behind a shallow cut. Her ruby eyes go still.{/n}

3acb510f-b8b3-48bf-aae7-13e25c3b7391.Text: "I... understand. It will be difficult but it is for the best that we forget about what happened." {n}Cassia involuntarily touches her lips and an awkward silence hangs in the air.{/n} "Let us leave this terrible place, {name}. I cannot bear to stay here any longer."

10b6fb6a-e3d8-45d5-b410-97eb2339e715.Text: {n}Cassia struggles to focus her eyes on you. An unfamiliar expression is imprinted on her pale, gaunt face, one that is stern, confident, and imperious. It is the same expression you saw on Theodora von Valancius's face when you first met her.{/n} "What makes you think you can even save yourself from this place, Lord Captain?"

8e41cf9b-81ef-48df-9587-a64dfdf03786.Text: {n}Cassia struggles to focus her eyes on you. Unending streams of bloody tears are running down her cheeks.{/n} "Forgive me, I... I did not want any of this... Leave, I beg of you. Go! I do not want to hurt you any more than I already have!"

67b390c5-06e0-470e-8675-b1ac313a02df.Text: {n}Cassia struggles to focus her eyes on you. Unending streams of bloody tears are running down her cheeks.{/n} "I... I cannot return to my House in such a state. No, I would rather die here at your hands than imperil my family."

abcd6dc1-1f50-4ffa-a3ab-568e3a2b2895.Text: "No!" {n}Cassia recoils in horror.{/n} "Never again! I shan't go back!"

a1a33d21-339b-4dfa-9b35-fb9f87dbe41a.Text: "When the capsule opened, my mind was drowned in grimy shades of crimson, and umber, and black, and... And I am going mad, {name}. I used to think I could control this, but now... You must end this. For the sake of my House. For your own safety. For me..."

20939225-673f-4ca7-8c91-ae8d4e0a63ac.Text: "When the capsule opened, my mind was drowned in grimy shades of crimson, and umber, and black, and... And I am going mad, {name}! Please, help me!" {n}Cassia reaches out her hands to you in a pleading gesture but her entire body is quaking from the force of her overflowing power, and you can tell it is about to burst forth once more.{/n}

5c9c3573-d5d6-4a5e-a6d5-2dd5e145e446.Text: "When the capsule opened, my mind was drowned in grimy shades of crimson, and umber, and black, and... And it's all because of you!" {n}Cassia clenches her fists and another wave of anger washes over you. Her body is quaking from the force of her overflowing power and you can tell it is about to burst forth once more.{/n} "If you hadn't involved me in your intrigue and schemes, none of this would have happened!"

bfdc58ca-4674-4de9-a259-d1205c9de140.Text: "I do not know. But I know I cannot hope to see the light in my days ever again without you."

062ea631-f60b-4d46-9207-2d2b239a52f9.Text: "Yes... I can see it in your colours. Your soft, warm hues... And the bright flashes whenever you look at me as you are doing right now, {name}. I... I feel the same when I am with you! And I am afraid that I might grow to depend on this feeling. The colours of bliss are... so very fleeting." {n}Cassia gives you an affectionate look and a timid smile.{/n}

94cd5edd-fa11-4bc5-b049-31d5894c4f81.Text: [Kiss her again] "But that is what I am trying to do. To help you escape for a time."

9a5f3b21-6844-43a8-a2b2-b432d77af167.Text: {n}Cassia smiles faintly and closes her eyes before your next kiss. When your lips meet once more, you feel as if your nerves are electrified. She kisses you swiftly and passionately, as if she is truly trying to lose herself in the moment.{/n} "Oh, {name}..."

fd2589c3-778f-4041-b190-2e5b42db866e.Text: [Take her hand] "Please let me stay with you a little longer."

08e25441-8aa6-4bf4-8883-32de496e99ec.Text: {n}Cassia carefully places her hand over yours and lets out a sigh of relief.{/n} "You're alive... Thank the Emperor, you're alive, {name}."

381e4b39-9c70-4b90-ad3d-17bacf351213.Text: "No, I... I shan't leave. I promise." {n}Cassia is not trembling anymore. Instead, she clings to your chest and rests her head on your shoulder. You can feel her heart pounding in a measured, sweet, and calm rhythm.{/n} "Oh, {name}..."

75af5d9b-1ffb-4f27-baaf-2480a61be5a9.Text: "I... I have feelings for you as well, {name}," {n}Cassia says in a breathy voice as she gently holds your hand.{/n} "And these feelings frighten me. But I do not want... to give up on them."

33eaef6d-73f2-4006-b9b4-8833d9865446.Text: "I apologise. I did not mean to disconcert you with my improper insistence."

2248a8da-8a41-4c06-96f7-fd1de768acec.Text: "When I met you, I discovered myself."

eb5f6c9f-08c6-4022-94fc-05eca3e18ab6.Text: "Oh, I can never tell if you are being serious or speaking in jest. How could you find yourself in one who has yet to find herself?" {n}Cassia laughs quietly.{/n} "And yet, your words warm my heart nonetheless. An auspicious sign, dare I say?"

8bb1a906-34e3-46a5-89c8-1f1d8808e0bd.Text: "What could you possibly see in someone like me?" {n}Cassia's voice is almost a whisper. She looks away.{/n}

e99ec4c9-cfb5-45b8-9520-a6cf5e8362ef.Text: [Touch Heinrix's cheek] "What have they done to you..."

f748f5c0-cd8b-4f0d-bb51-636634a472cb.Text: "Why don't we talk about this later?"

7f1b5165-77fa-4f16-a92b-673491cad7de.Text: "I gave the xenos another chance. If she fails, I will march her out of the airlock."

45b6580c-0e7e-4cd7-a218-856414b3f6f0.Text: "Step away from the contraption, and I shall let you live."

836e1d8b-4026-4748-bbe1-080444f3e61d.Text: "Essence of pain, you say? I wish to observe the extraction process."

2f54cc47-0f18-4187-bace-08d783ee5cee.Text: "Something tells me that you consumed those last samples yourself. What do you suppose Tervantias will do to you when he finds out?"

5ef82370-a042-417e-abd0-09211d8b6a05.Text: [Tug at the strings and kill Heinrix]

ea3fe556-1037-45ed-8a61-149a8324543f.Text: [Release Heinrix] "I do not have time to prove anything to you."

0cb684d9-75d8-462f-9639-7d3ba2904189.Text: "The God-Emperor's chosen will not be addressed in such a way by the likes of you, commoner!"

9e93f677-3a23-4622-bdcd-6a104e73c60d.Text: "To the warp with me? A splendid idea, but I am taking you with me, or else Calcazar will have my head on a platter."

e34c1551-ef6c-459c-9081-731cba120b73.Text: "This is no trick. Pull yourself together. I need your help."

69a896f0-23cc-4b55-956a-296d4bfa3715.Text: "Now that I think about it, I would rather leave you the way you are. Farewell, van Calox."

e9cd1648-a4ad-48db-8963-3b62e16a695a.Text: "What happened to you after we were captured?"

4917feeb-ac03-4e55-b253-57c0faeec804.Text: "Can you walk? We do not have much time."

e3fb1f1a-dd26-456a-af53-db17de6e4182.Text: "This xenos is now under my protection. Should any harm come to him, you will regret it."

629bb0c8-8512-4d9c-9efb-9cfb30998235.Text: "Calm yourself, van Calox. The enemy of our enemy is our ally."

2814afe3-4304-40ba-8e0c-a5ff33c53702.Text: "You cannot 'sense' your body? What does that mean, exactly?"

9f329b92-5323-49fb-a011-158e2ed5ef7f.Text: "Yrliet did not want us to suffer this fate."

06f4cf2f-ddc1-446b-add6-a914653fae35.Text: "We are in the realm of the xenos. We need a xenos to help us. Will you object to that?"

99e752ed-7d9e-4545-af60-80f94cf2e073.Text: {n}The Drukhari, who was leaning over a body encased in a strange sarcophagus-like device, turns around. The xenos's face is covered by a mirrored mask, and he is holding tools of some kind. They more closely resemble a torturer's implements than those of a chirurgeon. A guttural hiss comes from behind the mask:{/n} "What do you want, cattle?"

b25c0591-e939-4059-9c90-752c14d80eb5.Text: {n}He flinches at your touch at first... then, as if he can feel who is caressing his cheek, he gasps with relief.{/n} "{name}... is it you? You... you're alive?" {n}Struggling to turn his head, Heinrix presses his lips against your palm.{/n} "Please, find a way to get me out of this thing..."

e58719c2-9e4f-4a86-85e1-06ffcd008b5c.Text: {n}Heinrix takes a step on unsteady feet and stretches out his arm, which begins to tremble from the exertion. His hand finds your shoulder, lightly slides up to your neck, then to your cheek.{/n} "{name}..." {n}He falters, retracts his hand, and steps back.{/n}

42223f1a-cfdb-41c7-9b9b-c91e663ed481.Text: {n}The Drukhari notices your interest and grabs his weapon.{/n} "Get out, cattle."

df83c279-ba47-47c3-a43d-f9a0cd361f03.Text: {n}Cassia's third eye shudders menacingly under the adornment on her forehead.{/n} "Begone, xenos, lest you know the true fury of a Navigator of House Orsellio!"

e944713e-3521-4779-b57e-dc4ab4e4d9a7.Text: "One. One xenos helper." {n}Heinrix is struggling not to raise his voice.{/n} "But you have no reason to be dragging both creatures around with you, aside from an unnatural desire to go to the afterlife sooner rather than later! I wonder which of these two will be the first to make your dream come true."

f37078ce-e0b5-4085-94ba-d3e9afd060cd.Text: {n}You hear a laugh from behind the mirrored mask.{/n} "This machine is a testament to Tervantias's brilliance. See for yourself." {n}The Drukhari reaches for several delicate strings that extend from the needles embedded in Heinrix's body to a strange membrane on the side of the sarcophagus. The xenos's fingers lightly brush against the strings.{/n}

83cf6fe1-3770-4896-850b-b3a56323a9bf.Text: {n}The Drukhari lifts his hand from the strings, reaches toward a recess in the base of the device, and takes out a slender vial filled with pulsing, shimmering red gas.{/n} "Not a single imperfection... Irresistible..."

c33dda24-1f83-4aef-b43c-65f5661784de.Text: {n}Marazhai leans forward, his eyes wide. His fingers curl, digging into his palms, and his mouth stretches into a ravenous leer.{/n} "More."

e587b8de-bc07-4636-bd3d-589da16ee2f1.Text: {n}A high-pitched, otherworldly sound pierces your ears. Heinrix's body is struck by a convulsion so intense that only his bonds prevent him from dislocating his joints. He grits his teeth at first but, after a couple of seconds of this struggle, the torture chamber fills with a scream more akin to a bestial howl than any sound produced by a human being.{/n}

59026c1e-a411-445f-b787-3e7a96750317.Text: {n}Heinrix's head moves ever so slightly. You get a good look at his eyes now: the pupils are constricted to the size of pinheads. He is blind. His bitten, bloodied lips begin to move:{/n} "To the warp with you, beast. I've heard all this before. You won't trick me again..."

e400bd27-1e89-4db2-a864-ff94604826f9.Text: "They moved me multiple times from one place to another, but what those places were, I cannot say. I saw spires in an ocean of mist; I saw the bowels of a Drukhari ship... I almost broke free once: few things frighten the xenos as much as warp powers. I was close..." {n}Heinrix shakes his head.{/n} "One might consider my words heretical, but I would say it was only due to the Haemonculus who brought me here that I survived after falling in that struggle. From there it was just this place, this coffin... and pain."

b9ce1760-ef4f-4fdc-bca1-4fa5ac683517.Text: {n}Something in your voice gives the torturer pause, and he tilts his head. You cannot see his expression because of the mirrored mask, but, a moment later, the xenos hisses, hunches his shoulders, and scurries away.{/n}

c87d8849-46b9-437c-ac6a-b811e5f749bc.Text: "Who are you to order me around, cattle? Out! Or you will be the next one up for extraction after this mon-keigh!"

ad8a0e7a-9b85-425f-b862-829164d09a00.Text: "What? How did you..." {n}The torturer hunches his shoulders and begins to shake violently, no longer trying to hide it.{/n} "How could I resist? Pure, unadulterated essence... An extract of true torment..." {n}The Drukhari's voice deteriorates into unintelligible hissing before he turns and scurries away.{/n}

f3296209-bcb9-4787-bc9b-aa2c2ab2aa2c.Text: {n}He gestures feebly at his eyes.{/n} "I can't see a thing. Give me a moment... to ascertain what they've done to me..." {n}The air around him grows noticeably colder.{/n} "Blast it... I can't sense my body..."

4c675757-a761-4bff-ab3c-fa4e4d242a51.Text: "Why do you care, cattle?" {n}The Drukhari freezes for a moment, and you notice his hands shaking.{/n} "Tervantias sent you for the essence of pain, didn't he? Tell him that the last samples... turned out bad. It will take time to extract pure, unadulterated pain. Yes, a very long time. The mon-keigh is stubborn and strong, but his vitality is waning. I just need... to concentrate." {n}The torturer's twitching fingers reach for his victim.{/n}

eff3cbd9-af3c-4597-bc46-45a3b7a55948.Text: {n}The body inside the sarcophagus is not moving. Heinrix appears to have no awareness of his surroundings: his clouded gaze is directed past you.{/n}

93035911-4bc8-4784-8e0b-cc1464b6d599.Text: "I see you've gone completely off the deep end, {name}." {n}There is anger in Jae's quiet, almost lifeless voice.{/n} "Spent too much time in the company of these freaks, no doubt."

091a0667-1917-4920-a975-bd4a4257e49b.Text: {n}You reach out and unceremoniously tug at the thin threads, which leave deep cuts on your fingers. Heinrix's body does not begin to spasm, but jerks once as if struck by a blow. His scream only lasts a moment — death is almost instantaneous.{/n}

c34551d5-511e-4366-99f4-58d2a0f98dfd.Text: {n}Heinrix's unseeing eyes move back and forth, struggling to see you.{/n} "It can't be... {name}... Is it really you? Where are you? Are you close by? Then, in the name of the Throne, find a way to get me out of this coffin."

9b459617-a90c-4928-9ccc-158356cbe180.Text: {n}Heinrix lets out a husky laugh and instantly gasps and wretches in pain.{/n} "Hah. It is you. Even Commorragh could not spawn something as conceited as Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Release me."

fa3da957-d2ba-46dc-a79e-26eb769b6ad8.Text: "What?" {n}Heinrix winces at your words.{/n} "That monster couldn't have known the Lord Inquisitor's name... which means... {name}. You're alive. Thank the Golden Throne. Find a way to get me out of this coffin..."

198ae157-c41f-43be-9ec0-458bf9e9f7c8.Text: {n}With a speed that is surprising given his condition, Heinrix rips the black circlet from his head and blindly seizes you. A wave of searing pain pours into your body, as if the blood in your veins has been instantly brought to a boil.{/n}

495d638f-d6d8-4261-a381-9c1317776144.Text: "You just made the greatest mistake of your—" {n}Heinrix stops upon hearing your cry of pain.{/n} "What? {name}... {name} von Valancius? You're alive? Forgive me, I thought my executioner had found a new way to torment me. These blasted eyes..."

27cfba0c-a7ce-4777-b7d0-dc5e82901460.Text: "I can... move, yes. Warp take them, I feel like my nerves have been turned inside out and then sewn back like that. For the time being, I will have to suffer pain whenever I take a step until I recuperate. Now that I am free to use my powers again, it's entirely achievable..."

b8ffdd2f-b778-412a-8853-94e549143fe4.Text: {n}Heinrix rubs his face and looks up at you, his eyes somewhat unfocused. As soon as he manages to focus, however, his gaze shifts over your shoulder. Then he freezes, having met Marazhai's gaze. Heinrix's face takes on an expression of primal ferocity.{/n}

3bd155ef-ded1-4a2d-afd5-1e934e4bf413.Text: "What exactly do you intend to explain to me, Rogue Trader? That the thrice-cursed filth that destroyed the Emperor's servants and consigned us to this fate has now joined your retinue? Then save your explanations, because they will make no difference to me!"

b65ae6b9-eb8d-412c-a2e3-c9d47d996ca7.Text: "Ally?" {n}Heinrix is rendered speechless for a moment.{/n} "The skies will sooner fall than I call that filth my ally! You may extend your protection to any abomination that will inevitably disembowel you alive, but do not dare to instruct me on my stance on enemies of Humanity!"

23be0877-daf3-400a-8f01-9794d4643b67.Text: {n}Heinrix's burning glare moves from you to Marazhai.{/n} "The Rogue Trader's privileges in action, I presume? I have long since abandoned any illusions I may have had about human nature, but I must admit I didn't expect someone to stoop so low as to consort with filth like this."

8aa5b2ff-21ed-40f1-a22e-becf417bbb0d.Text: "Insult me again, mon-keigh, and this filth will show you what he is like in anger. This little diversion..." {n}Marazhai scrapes the sarcophagus-like device with a claw of his gauntlet.{/n} "...will seem delightful in comparison."

2c43ae1d-c429-4b7a-b179-84a19b423e3f.Text: "No... no, I don't think so. It is likely just my body reacting to extended bouts of pain." {n}Heinrix chuckles bitterly.{/n} "To think that I have forgotten what it's like to experience such basic impulses. As a biomancer, I can stifle my physical reactions. Perhaps that is why I was chosen for this... device. Because I had distanced myself from the sensation of pain. And because of my stubbornness that forbade me from surrendering."

5f294fcc-38c6-4cf8-b2a2-4f94c71d34a7.Text: {n}Heinrix looks in your direction and blinks his feeble eyes.{/n} "We can go. But you will have to guide me for a little while."

5ecb0d2c-ef00-4c9d-b1c8-be49bbc28814.Text: {n}Heinrix exhales noisily, glaring at Yrliet. Finally, he nods with obvious reluctance.{/n} "You may be right. I wish there were another candidate."

e7039bc0-e1a1-4b59-85da-979da92547ef.Text: "Of course. This is why she sold us out to her kinsman at the drop of a hat."

ac5e8438-b19d-46fb-8f3e-43d8236100e4.Text: "Another chance to murder us all. Have you considered you might be showing a bit too much mercy toward the enemies of Humanity?"

30791133-6724-4616-a786-d2f57dac74d4.Text: {n}Heinrix shakes his head as if chasing away an excruciating dream.{/n} "Enough. Nothing I hear will reassure me."

67df59ab-6b77-4ec3-b761-c59e81213a85.Text: "If I knew, I wouldn't be pondering the question right now, {name}. I think..." {n}He pauses, seemingly listening to something.{/n} "The circlet on my head wasn't inhibiting my abilities — it was turning them inward. Binding them inside my body. They made me torture myself with warp energies... I was burning and mutilating my internal organs... Damned xenos!" {n}Heinrix clenches his fists in fury and immediately winces from the pain.{/n}

96e998ee-59dd-41f9-865a-5d1922a38293.Text: {n}Heinrix blinks his feeble eyes and curses under his breath.{/n} "I will... require some time to recover. When the situation permits, I will find a quiet spot and concentrate on doing just that."

34d1b3d4-1b00-459d-ad13-34150a281fe3.Text: {n}Heinrix barely manages to tear his hateful gaze away from the Drukhari when he notices Yrliet standing next to him and lets out an agonised groan.{/n} "{name}, you must be joking..."

ff1d3663-eadd-4f75-9548-1d3a1112207f.Text: {n}Heinrix squints, struggling to see anything through his unfocused eyes. He finally rubs them and turns his gaze to Yrliet standing behind you.{/n} "{name}... Am I hallucinating or is the xenos who consigned us to this nightmare back in your retinue?" {n}The Interrogator's voice vibrates with incandescent rage.{/n}

19ac8943-9a20-477f-ba32-ed4f0e6c6d8b.Text: "Master van Calox!" {n}Cassia's ruby eyes are tearing up against her will.{/n} "It is as if all the colours have been drained from him. Pale, ghostly shadows of his former hues are still clinging to his soul. We need to get him out of this machine! We must!"

f131e370-c1b1-4be7-b439-b5fe9a15ef48.Text: {n}The torturer freezes, then an instant later, hisses and launches himself at you.{/n}

ead2ae37-efe5-441b-8494-f80d5f037881.Text: {n}You cut the tubes, pull out the hooks and the needles, and free Heinrix from his bonds. He almost falls out of the Drukhari device, just managing to stay on his feet.{/n}

29e238c1-80a9-4ae3-be18-b896ad5be3bd.Text: {n}You instantly recognise the man who is pinned with hooks and bonds to the numerous needles sticking out of the bowels of the device. Despite the deathly pale, bloodless tone of his skin, Interrogator Heinrix van Calox is still alive, judging by his weakly rising and falling chest and his frantically wandering, half-open eyes. His head is tightly encircled by a wide metallic band. Blood is seeping from underneath it.{/n}

c9814055-822f-4e18-8317-1a7385048b6f.Text: [Deactivate the xenodevice] "I am releasing you whether you want it or not."

bb06ce8d-2fdc-480e-bdd4-fbb16559a062.Text: "I am. And it is good to see that you live as well."

eb377031-9c11-4775-94a1-be84fce40e4d.Text: "There is no time to talk. I am taking you out of this place."

dc015b4f-2599-4f72-8013-6997dddd8eba.Text: "You forget yourself by addressing the Rogue Trader by {mf|his|her} first name."

3919343e-638c-4183-8a56-6409d5d593f1.Text: "How did he make your voices stop?"

b530d4a4-1a18-4554-83bf-6ac05ec97d0f.Text: "Does that mean... you cannot use your powers anymore?"

fc201503-0611-4e9e-a54f-adb769578ccd.Text: "This isn't right, Idira. Whatever he did to you, it's perverted."

1d6e4257-490b-41c8-a4cc-112ef8285d10.Text: "Do you truly prefer to live... like this?"

cfaaeeed-eec2-4937-b923-d668a5072269.Text: "You look as if you are about to die. Whatever that thing is doing to you, you will not last long."

c07ed77b-3f6a-41f8-bba2-dde794cab7a3.Text: "This is not living, Idira. It is better to live out the time you have on your own terms than spend an eternity existing the way you intend to!"

3f982749-4407-4e70-a952-6511761d98ea.Text: "Everything comes at a price. Have you considered the price you are paying?"

b33a50e4-3cba-435a-ad14-76486c8f663c.Text: "If I cannot convince you, I will find a different way to rid you of this compulsion!"

9664fda6-5524-4400-828b-2d2f8ddda7e1.Text: "If that is your conscious choice, I see no reason to force you."

84c7843a-18aa-4bd0-9c46-1012bc967445.Text: "Farewell, Idira. I hope this is the deliverance you were looking for."

2ec267d7-7ac6-431d-9bb6-fbddf8270c6f.Text: "You are right, I am not angry... but I simply cannot leave you like this!"

eb0f167f-61a1-4f56-acc0-061a7f42dfa3.Text: "Perhaps we can figure out how that 'thing' works. But we will need to remove it first."

cb05ac1a-9e27-4655-8c36-ec0546e01330.Text: "I believe in salvation through willpower and character, not at the hands of the Drukhari."

7d15b2d0-3a01-4bfe-9b17-1d15a702305a.Text: "The God-Emperor will help you. You must believe that He will."

bb57da44-980b-49a5-b0ff-722eabfd1900.Text: "Let's think about all that after we get out of here."

68c62c3c-dd54-4b5d-9401-3f7ecfcf6e14.Text: Convinced Idira to accept the voices and remove the psy-stifler in Commorragh.

70f9d40a-6c61-4691-be08-3de13d4defea.Text: [Mesmerise Idira] "Why do your whispers frighten you so much, Idira? Have they ever betrayed you? You should not give up such an incredible gift. Accept it, because that gift is who you are."

f9ceabf9-18e0-4058-8e94-2c6ee2a1560f.Text: {n}Idira Tlass is staring at you as if she has seen a ghost. There is a strange, eerie-looking device on her head, a tangle of myriad thin, translucent threads coiled in elaborate, sickening patterns on her temples. Many of those threads penetrate the skin of her face, neck, and clavicles.{/n} "Lord Captain! You're... alive?"

9adca1e5-9a8a-48eb-a024-17ea80dad616.Text: "Yes... {name}?" {n}Idira looks through you with a faint smile.{/n}

7e0520bd-983d-4943-b1ba-eae1f60fcbae.Text: {n}Idira chuckles wryly.{/n} "I just became myself, Cass. Boring old me — a little grey mouse with no streak of madness in her, and no squatters living in her witless head."

9c7d748d-8bd9-4e3a-a409-5155636a4a55.Text: "Wake up, you idiot! This ashmag is just using you, ridiculing you, experimenting on you! We've said it ourselves so many times over a glass of amasec — everything in this life comes with a price tag. Think, shereen. If something looks like it's free, then the price is you. Can't you see that?"

2eb064ad-b2ad-42c8-a76f-f5c7b8d066a3.Text: "Taking me?" {n}Idira recoils, as if scared that you might grab hold of her.{/n} "No! Never!"

3c35c66d-7938-4fd1-b041-d2637a1dce6a.Text: "Oh yes, I live!" {n}Idira giggles.{/n} "I've never felt so... alive."

eb7212af-a228-48b8-9a39-80282ec3ebb5.Text: {n}Idira glances around the room and then looks back at you with a tinge of guilt on her face.{/n} "You know... I thought you were gone. Done for. I thought I'd never see you again. So I... tried to start over."

7c662f25-0022-4c22-bb3f-698a4ca850e8.Text: {n}The longer you look at Idira, the more strange details you notice about her appearance: the odd, earthy tone of her face; the fine purple veins around her parched, cracked lips; the subtle change in the colour of her now lustreless eyes. An unpleasant sense of wrongness comes over you, as if the woman standing before you is not quite alive.{/n}

b25e72a4-5ba2-4eef-b35e-f4350e4baf25.Text: "No!" {n}Idira's shout reverberates throughout the dimly lit room.{/n} "I don't!"

1546da9b-ee3b-47b7-ad51-4335483ed7bd.Text: "They set me free." {n}Idira looks you in the eye and smiles feverishly, drunkenly.{/n} "Free from the fear. From the pain. From... them."

136daf6f-709e-4194-9495-a36f4b94eb46.Text: {n}Idira gestures vaguely at the strange "harness" on her head.{/n} "See this? It's a reward. A reward for my loyalty."

a8c7ddc5-0819-4a35-b74a-ad3b28f796de.Text: "When they captured us, I... I don't remember much from back then. I remember shackles that burned whenever I heard a whisper. I remember injections that made my body go numb. I remember them... dragging me away from you."

1243e92a-bb91-467b-ac05-c7c3f10ab239.Text: "Then I wound up here, at Master Tervantias's mercy. First, he studied me, poked me with needles, opened up my head to get a look at what was inside, but then... then he made the voices stop. He made them stop! {name}, I don't hear the whispers anymore!"

de9b257a-35c5-48e2-b414-3cce2efe65b2.Text: "Our three-eyed doll, Cassia... they took her too, along with me. Her body was there, at least. She wasn't moving, wasn't talking, nothing."

be864c4d-63a5-4a97-9bd1-0cb96f1d8935.Text: "They took an interest in Heinrix too. He almost fought his way out once... The new masters were amused." {n}Idira ducks her head and bites her lip.{/n}

deb2ea0f-d817-4141-9786-a751592ea90c.Text: "But, Lord Captain... How else should I address you? I'm no longer a von Valancius subject. I don't serve you anymore. You're {name}, and that's that. Please don't judge me too harshly, but I don't want to go back to how things were. I've had enough."

3ee8b35b-46a8-440a-8939-a1512ca8126f.Text: "With this, I think..." {n}Idira touches one of the tubes on her head.{/n} "It hurt when he was putting it on. It still hurts, but I'm used to it now. {name}, what matters is that the damned door to the other side closed shut! I don't hear the whispers, don't see ghosts of the future, don't get woken up by tormented screams, and I'm not plagued by visions of the horrors that are waiting for me! All of it just... stopped!"

a1792084-09fa-42cb-8058-ad0e860a10e8.Text: "I can't, no — and good thing, too. You know..." {n}Idira looks around.{/n} "I think the xenos are terrified of human witches. Why else would they keep me half-delirious and out of it? Or do all those things to sever our connection to the warp? They're scared all right! But they don't know how else to fight it!"

970de599-69ac-4d11-8248-fe4797705aee.Text: "'Perverted'! Ha! Like you'd know what it's like to be born a witch! To have your name cursed by all and sundry since childhood, to live as a worthless, dangerous freak whose only use is to become someone's pet!" {n}Idira grits her teeth.{/n} "I know Lady Theodora wasn't like that... and neither are you... but that's not the point. He made me NORMAL! Finally!"

0a9e6e67-3226-422b-be6f-896c502d8a83.Text: "If it means I have to serve a xenos... so be it! All the days I've been here, I've spent in blissful silence. No one bothers me. No one torments me! No one is trying to get at me from the other side, and on this side... nobody notices me at all! I don't want anything else! I just want... to be left alone..." {n}Idira turns away, teetering slightly from the sharp motion.{/n}

5cf3d677-256c-4630-a634-8d22ca430e76.Text: "Like what? Normal? Not special? Yes! To the void with all my 'talents' and 'abilities'! It's the first time I can hear my own thoughts, {name}! They're mine, not some warp abomination's! And not the future thoughts and words of some random Lexmechanic at the cogitator next to me!"

dbc9c208-dcd7-4a62-9c1f-0314f3fd8f56.Text: "I'm helping Master Tervantias! I'm his personal assistant, like... like a secretary! I do... things. Just yesterday, I spent several hours looking for something in the chambers under his operating theatre. So many rooms and dead-ends down there, I wonder why... The day before that, I was setting up one of his machines. It hurt me once or twice, but then I got the hang of it..."

4ea593e5-04c6-4f6c-9efd-0f74f9f0b1fc.Text: "I... don't look so good, do I?" {n}Idira licks her parched lips. Her tongue is swollen and pale.{/n} "I... can't really feel my body. Huh. I never thought I'd be in danger of dying of physical causes, I always thought it'd be from my brain melting away to nothing..."

4c23e2b5-0648-47a1-b123-501b7f28b734.Text: "Master Tervantias would tell me if something was wrong with me. He says I'm a valuable specimen... He values me. And what I do."

350e37c0-6d99-4391-af12-033bd7cd2541.Text: {n}Idira grimaces.{/n} "An eternity? An eternity sounds like an awfully long time... especially here. I hadn't thought about that..."

8f93877a-400b-4a27-bdf6-500623dbc7e1.Text: "There is something that scares me more than spending an eternity here, and that's an eternity there... beyond the door... becoming a plaything of the beasts that call the warp home..."

7d3af5ba-4db6-4c4e-872a-dcdf1f5fdf88.Text: {n}Idira struggles to swallow. You think she might be trying to cry, but no tears come out.{/n} "But if I... decide to leave... then Master Tervantias will surely want it back... He'll want to remove this thing... and then the whispers will return. They'll start... beckoning me again. What then, {name}?"

d4528351-c9e4-4f33-8aba-e4444b7c286e.Text: "You once promised me, {name}... you promised we'd think of something, right? And now we know the xenos have things like this, so that means... there's hope?"

34051de7-a3c4-49de-ac98-c28cb9aec2a9.Text: "You told me yourself once... 'Keep yourself under control, be useful, don't be a burden'... And now you want me to take this thing off? How does that make any sense?"

0f5ac329-c3d1-44f6-a113-dabac15f5fd5.Text: "Do whatever you want... if my words aren't enough to make you leave me alone."

50fa5f8c-d82d-4193-8d13-81604b3369e7.Text: {n}Idira looks up at you.{/n} "{name}, you're not... angry at me, are you?"

8bdea4a6-d48f-457b-8a44-cdc5a2329678.Text: {n}She lets out a pained groan.{/n} "When will you all understand..."

1a18328f-d7d8-4619-b17e-8a80ef297094.Text: {n}Idira fails to dodge out of the way in time. You grab hold of the strange device on her head and pull...{/n}

876fb5c2-a840-4e73-9656-7e7d5c08d77f.Text: {n}Idira shrieks and staggers away.{/n} "No! And don't try that again, you hear me?"

8158bfa1-7e7b-4851-9708-8079c84b6417.Text: {n}Idira stops. There is a glint of suspicion in her eyes.{/n} "That's weird. Now that I've said it out loud, those tasks are starting to sound more like tests..."

8b7ee03f-802c-4c10-a897-1a4c9a21bc15.Text: "Well, this is awkward." {n}Idira forces a laugh as she looks at the shards on the floor.{/n} "Looks like the xenos are right to call us clumsy animals. Oh well, since it's decided..." {n}She shoots you a look of vicious glee.{/n} "Might as well go out with a bang. Lead on, Lord Captain!"

09a0ca6a-f5f6-43eb-bec7-c7c18591cb1d.Text: "Like I have any of that... Ha!" {n}Idira sniffles and gives you a crooked smile.{/n} "Don't let anybody say the Lord Captain's got no sense of humour..."

0477fd83-9280-4e68-8630-2cb413478a81.Text: "All right, that's enough of me running my mouth. It's time." {n}She grabs the device on her head with both hands and begins to pull. The colour instantly drains from her face, her eyes bulge, and she bites her lip so hard it starts to bleed...{/n}

80145848-22ad-465b-a07f-597f03fa5f05.Text: {n}Idira suddenly snorts just like her old self would.{/n} "Uh-huh. Our fatherly Emperor is sure to spare some deliverance for a heathen witch from some backwater world... That's rich."

6e430c02-0dac-4315-88a9-8f8cec8ad4a4.Text: {n}Idira's eyes light up.{/n} "You're right... Once we're home, it'll be a cinch to find some xenotech whiz to make sense of it..."

8b61682c-444f-4d3c-8173-35b4520e6102.Text: {n}Idira says nothing for a little while.{/n} "Just don't say I didn't warn you."

5cc85ada-556a-473b-986b-95bc4dba67af.Text: {n}...with a sharp sound, the tubes slip out from under her skin, spraying blood mixed with some foul-smelling ochre-coloured slime, and the device detaches from Idira's head. She lets out a piercing cry, her head jerking back from the pain — and the delicate device clinks as it shatters into tiny fragments.{/n}

f5fed505-ecc6-4ca0-b0f0-b9b763a0db9d.Text: "What have you done?" {n}Idira ignores the hundreds of cuts on her face, neck, and hands and reaches for the shards on the floor.{/n} "That... that was my hope! My salvation from all the crap that keeps crawling inside my head! And you just..."

14272c10-c2b4-4c76-9f0e-7de943edb3f3.Text: {n}She takes a few moments to fight back the sobs welling up in her throat. Then she quickly wipes her face, straightens, and gives you a spiteful look.{/n} "You win... Lord Captain. Since dying of old age is off the table now, there's no point in me hanging around here. I'm going with you."

2e2067fb-9922-4c7b-9cc1-973abf802120.Text: {n}Cassia gives you a look full of pain and doubt.{/n} "Perhaps we should not deny her the choice to be... free in her own way?"

5a8012b3-b15d-4755-985e-6b7da44ca347.Text: {n}Spellbound, Idira listens to the sound of your voice and weakly repeats after you,{/n} "Because the whispers are who I am, and I am the whispers... Yes, I could live a bit longer with this... incredible gift... because it's so great... right?" {n}Her brow furrows as she wrestles with her doubts.{/n} "As great as it is, it's also dangerous, {name}. The whispers don't just help me. They are luring me to something... irreversible."

5b4b6e14-9618-4c95-aa04-504f50d088a1.Text: "What has happened to your colours, Idira? They have melted into you. No, you have melted into them. You have become a grey blur."

1a50dc06-fd29-4295-b735-d5a46c27861c.Text: "Are you really willing to sacrifice the many colours of your soul to escape the curse that weighs so heavy on you?" {n}Cassia lowers her gaze and rests her hand against the Atlas in her chest.{/n} "If... it really is possible... and it is what you truly want..."

9a684233-81a7-4764-9eae-e08371570d1c.Text: "I am Rogue Trader {name} von Valancius, bearer of the Warrant of Trade and the Emperor's anointed — do not dare reject the immense honour of swearing allegiance to me and doing my will!"

8d31e05e-5191-458b-bf08-4f0270933917.Text: [Address Aebys] "So you and your rabble are the champions of the local arena?"

fc85dda7-965f-4423-9c0e-988b0da84cbb.Text: "So Marazhai was skinned and made to fight like this? Well, that is a balm to my heart. And also a delight to my eyes, where something was still stirring a while ago."

7baa5688-ab7d-4434-91cf-0107d410f62e.Text: [Address Marazhai] "I just wanted to get a proper look at you. Humiliated, stripped of everything you were. And later... later I shall find a way to kill you."

362a91cf-8d6a-4123-816e-a05d6b4c160b.Text: [Snap the Elucidator shut and address Marazhai] "I want to talk. To you."

de6fc7bd-3c70-4a3d-ab78-be7506bf61fe.Text: "You are trapped. I am trapped. We could help each other."

eabebdc2-e333-4ebd-830f-c36501457e8c.Text: "I saw what happened at the trial. You were tricked."

871dbb20-9f2b-4cce-8e3f-70d1ede92c45.Text: "Let's make a deal: you help me take out my enemies and I shall help you take out yours."

38db50be-08b6-416c-a0c8-80ee6d63e868.Text: "You have caused so much trouble for my protectorate that the only fitting punishment is to drag you out of Commorragh alive so that you may pay your debt to me."

95b10438-83ae-4f3e-b87d-3b56b9aad2b7.Text: [Snap the Elucidator shut and address Marazhai] "Your kin do not seem overly fond of you."

06cd6063-88e4-4827-bfc0-fa3523d42b73.Text: "I want to get out of Commorragh alive. I need allies."

b04ddeed-ac2b-482c-83e8-af1815de3c03.Text: [Lean closer] "From the bottom of my heart, I hope you die in agony."

9abc3be9-e0c1-4ee4-b63f-4e192e33468f.Text: "I believe in mercy. Even for the likes of you."

3c9c86c1-eef5-403e-86cf-3a6e0b5ff210.Text: "Oh, so you like being in this dump at the beck and call of this rabble? Aren't you afraid they won't give you back your skin the next time?"

013a7894-51ab-4d03-bf93-4e6e4a47cfc8.Text: [Address all the Drukhari in front of you] "Know this — I will kill each and every one of you! And I do not care if you are champions or not!"

8666c5d0-ff4e-4d6d-8ab6-d112b4d3b16a.Text: {n}Marazhai's eyes flare with turquoise fire at the sight of you — an immediate, uncontrollable urge to kill. The Drukhari seizes the blades hanging from his belt — and freezes at the shout of the metal-studded xenos.{/n}

9542694f-4c4c-41be-8d67-2579f8c49efe.Text: "Careful with the meat for the arena, Marazhai. If Sinisthoria is short on toys for her fighters, you will be punished again. She seems to enjoy pitting you against Khymerae. Maybe this time she won't deem it necessary to give you back your skin after you slay them all."

cb1ba612-f254-44c8-ae02-065b8e193473.Text: {n}The motionless Marazhai turns his head toward his kin, and you notice a thin red stripe on his neck below his ear, like a fresh stitch. Shaking with barely contained rage, the former Dracon stares at you with dark eyes.{/n}

a951bb60-457b-464b-9749-e3cfe96c23e5.Text: {n}Your unassailable arrogance makes the xenos's jaw drop for a moment. After a second, his expression changes to one of rage.{/n} "I will cut your smug throat and make you—"

cb811124-dd14-43e8-bb76-d825b456d447.Text: {n}Aebys frowns at the sound of the Elucidator and turns away from you dismissively, exchanging a few words with the Wych standing next to him. The mocking laughter and haughty looks in your direction leave no doubt about the subject of their conversation.{/n}

30b6609e-50ac-4d08-b244-a1a33a7c824d.Text: {n}Despite the impotent rage on his face, Marazhai manages a sarcastic chuckle.{/n} "Something wriggling in your eye? I see Tervantias has not changed his methods for handling specimens."

f1aa263e-57f3-4bec-a176-9fe0a555931a.Text: {n}Marazhai gives you a predatory grin.{/n} "You think too highly of yourself, little beast. Pray you are killed in the arena before you know the caress of my blades."

c06721c3-c0b9-4037-83da-7f3eaecbfff9.Text: {n}Marazhai looks at you again, now more surprised than enraged. Glancing at the Wyches, he switches to Low Gothic:{/n} "What, mon-keigh?"

b07156f5-6215-4767-9ebd-6bb8c5f8ac8d.Text: {n}The Drukhari narrows his eyes.{/n} "Tervantias's creation must have been a low-grade imitation if the mirage did not completely overwhelm you... Even if what you say is true — what is it to you?"

45e197db-640b-40fa-9533-672ef207e30c.Text: "You? Help me?" {n}The Drukhari snorts disdainfully.{/n} "Why would the quarry help the hunter? If you expect me to believe that..."

2762ea21-7ada-4281-90a7-7dda801355a1.Text: {n}Marazhai casts a contemptuous glance at the Wyches and without hesitation switches to Low Gothic:{/n} "This Wych Cult scum is not my kin. Half-borns like Aebys belong here in the filth of the Chasm—" {n}He cuts himself off, his gloves squeaking in protest as he clenches his fists.{/n}

d600e0d1-0b49-4a56-966b-a15e6ac49629.Text: "Allies..." {n}Marazhai huffs a laugh.{/n} "Are you trying to convince me that you seek an alliance... with me?"

aced855c-55b8-49a3-b2b7-906df24feb4d.Text: {n}Marazhai lifts his chin and lets out a hiss, more pensive than angry.{/n} "I—"

e96689bf-967e-488e-a5d7-8840392c32bf.Text: "Mercy?" {n}Marazhai snorts, but a shadow of doubt flickers in his eyes.{/n} "How strange—"

fdd38df8-3412-4088-a904-008a7b97ca42.Text: {n}Marazhai allows himself a mocking chuckle, but you hear the ring of doubt in it.{/n} "What makes you think I intend to—"

23816ec5-5653-4000-bb3f-09594cccfa83.Text: {n}Marazhai clicks his tongue in irritation and rears back, but before he can respond, Aebys makes an impatient gesture.{/n}

e717e569-19f2-445f-9e73-25114c5d4243.Text: {n}Aebys makes an impatient gesture.{/n} "I am tired of listening to you and your old friend whispering in that primitive babble. Enough. We must go."

68dd9206-a65f-4db9-af81-a48cfe7f4813.Text: {n}Marazhai grudgingly obeys the order, but as he walks away, he cannot resist tossing another unreadable look in your direction.{/n}

28e75825-d070-4884-a8f6-aa749e727cad.Text: {n}The tall Drukhari, whose body is riddled with painful-looking puncture wounds and dotted with metal rings and clamps, lets out a chuckle as you approach and begins speaking in his own language. Your Elucidator hisses to life, translating the words:{/n} "Look, carrion... is this the mon-keigh that cost you your place at the Archon's side?"

ea505222-66cc-41a1-9425-4129be077abf.Text: {n}Aebys's expression turns sour.{/n} "I am tired of this noise. We must go, proselytes. It is time for our next training session."

5dd1795b-c1a6-467f-9f32-8a949b0ceed1.Text: {n}Marazhai's voice fills with venom:{/n} "Oh no, mon-keigh. I will live long enough to ensure such a death for you."

ad1bfddc-2ad8-4f70-8182-54bfc431c31e.Text: "All I did was win another fight. What makes it so significant?"

e7acb2ce-f480-47cd-ab06-7eb250b2e3d2.Text: "I have no orders to give. If you are true sons and daughters of Humanity, the Emperor will show you the way, not I."

92a23c1a-9522-43c9-9962-877fdc8eed37.Text: "Here are your orders: wait. I do not intend to die at the hands of xenos. Once I have destroyed them and found a way to escape, I shall return to take you with me."

25e17643-3630-4678-967e-87f47fdb2625.Text: Inspired the Commissar and his soldiers to fight in the arena in Commorragh.

aa7026bc-cd03-4e28-8170-241cb32bb3b6.Text: "Warriors of the Imperium! The God-Emperor's gaze is upon us, here and now. I am ready to meet my death face to face, for I know that He watches over me. What about you? Will you disgrace yourselves in His eyes? Or will you fight and prevail?"

634e9209-b1a9-40db-978b-7ef00abbcc46.Text: {n}As soon as you walk in, the eyes of everyone in the room turn to you. The Commissar barks a command and the fighters salute you in perfect unison.{/n} "Glory to House von Valancius!"

8ffba9bb-2e05-4c95-8b8e-20ae88eae58c.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, as you may have read in my memo, your life is in mortal danger. Your series of impressive victories in the arena has incurred the ire of the profane xenos. The Wyches won't let you emerge from your next fight alive. As true servants of the Imperium, we cannot let that happen. Awaiting your orders!" {n}His peaked cap gleaming, the Commissar clicks his boots loudly. The only sign that betrays his trepidation is the faint trembling of his hands.{/n}

8e26adab-49e5-4b22-9e6e-6399832ffae3.Text: {n}You hear confused exclamations, heavy sighs, and loud sobs. A dark wave of despair, powerlessness, and disappointment sweeps across the ranks of the resistance.{/n}

564982d1-cc5a-4a5c-be2e-9dc67d80acc8.Text: {n}The Commissar says in a lowered voice,{/n} "You wiped the floor with the Bloodstained Proselytes, the elite of the elite, in front of all of Commorragh. You didn't just spit in the faces of Keykeross and her chums, you publicly wounded the pride of every Drukhari who saw it happen. Pissing on a statue of Vect with everyone watching would've caused less of a stink. That's the Drukhari for you — they love their arenas." {n}The Commissar shrugs apologetically.{/n}

0594e863-a97d-421c-aa93-b51df87406cd.Text: {n}The people's expressions show different emotions: relief, doubt, disappointment. The members of the resistance start exchanging glances and whispering, until the Commissar silences them with a sharp command.{/n}

6c0205ed-13eb-41b1-8d1d-c81d09c50b93.Text: {n}The crowd's fierce and inspired roar deafens you. You see the glowing eyes of the people who have gathered here. This fire craves to be released so that it may consume any and all enemies of Humanity who dare to stand in the way of the Emperor's devout servants. As you observe the crowd, the Commissar's gaze jumps out at you. For the first time since you met him, his eyes are filled with {d|Encyclopedia:Ch3_ComissarRedeemed}genuine righteous fury, without a trace of falsehood or mockery{/d}.{/n}

5ee6477a-b9e7-46ea-853f-c517ba2bc762.Text: "You can count on us, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Our best chance of gaining the upper hand is to hit them with a surprise attack. You are the {mf|man|woman} who triumphed over the Bloodstained Proselytes — it shouldn't be much of a challenge for you to last long enough in the arena until we can strike our enemy when they least expect it. Good luck to you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. The Emperor protects!"

510a9fb3-5225-4216-9ac8-63ad4bf87a38.Text: "You dare doubt the words of a Rogue Trader, one anointed by the Emperor Himself? The {mf|man|woman} standing before you is willing to risk {mf|his|her} life against the superior forces of the detestable xenos so that we may have our long-awaited freedom! Pray to the Emperor that {mf|he|she} succeeds, for He protects the righteous!" {n}A deafening "The Emperor protects!" erupts in response, then the Commissar winks at you.{/n}

fb0c5300-6645-4525-a18f-fea584257a07.Text: {n}He lowers his voice and says to you,{/n} "I'm going to put my faith in you too, you know. I have no idea how you plan on escaping or even surviving, but you've surprised me before on several occasions. I do hope this isn't some cruel joke to pay me back for my past... transgressions. It'd be a shame to have {d|Encyclopedia:Ch3_ComissarRedeemed}rediscovered my faith in the Emperor{/d} only to die in Commorragh. I mean, it would certainly be ironic: the old me would have loved it. Good luck!"

8e7ef5c3-9bb6-45df-a30a-fc71b10dd0d7.Text: {n}The Commissar uses just the right tone to stop the spreading chatter.{/n} "Fighters! Do not lose hope! Can't you see that the Rogue Trader's selfless sacrifice has spared our souls and given us more precious time to plan our escape? Or do you doubt the might of the Immortal Emperor? He won't forsake us! And neither will I forsake you! Take heart, for it is heresy to succumb to doubt. Dismissed!"

0914cf0b-afeb-4b0a-9e55-538be8055289.Text: {n}He lowers his voice and says to you,{/n} "I see how it is. First you {d|Encyclopedia:Ch3_ComissarRedeemed}give me that inspirational crap{/d} about being a 'true leader' and escaping, and now it's everyone for themselves? I believed you, you know. Well, I won't hold it against you. I only have myself to blame for forgetting where I am. Say hello to the Emperor for me."

f23c31ef-7adf-454f-9def-bb912701039b.Text: "I've seen you, you poisonous gnat, leading your comrades to their deaths in the arena. But now you are willing to stand with the Aett-Vater against all of Commorragh, to suffer what is certain to be a gruesome and agonising death? You are still an unworthy scoundrel, of course, but... you have chosen an honourable way out."

0b2c2e45-bb52-4903-be23-155c9c1740c3.Text: "Is there a way I can help you?"

4c1e84b5-3c65-4f3b-8a4a-7754efd14e63.Text: "Come. We must look for a way out."

9788d850-2bf7-42bd-afbd-03bd604259e5.Text: [Kill Pasqal] "You should have done this yourself."

e0a30ebe-6f73-459f-a11f-96bdc5bf31a7.Text: "Then come with me. We will tackle this another time."

9f3bff09-4979-4d0f-93c1-c37018e4a801.Text: "Purge your body of this corruption at once!"

acdd8a9b-b980-4671-b9e1-111f6e4a4940.Text: "That is no reason to back down. Do it!"

ef1425b7-c28e-4896-8ae7-ea389c95baeb.Text: "Then we must look for other options."

1fdfa9ec-af2f-4d26-875b-f31b15c07445.Text: "You are a warrior of comprehension. Survive, then, and comprehend!"

95f88e09-2b83-4814-904b-7aced516fe72.Text: "You are right. You must not carry that putrescence inside you."

c39809bf-c2c1-42ec-b766-fed1da9c6c78.Text: "You are done for. I am leaving."

39540584-8f88-40e4-bd2e-12674c6b5812.Text: "What became of you after our capture?"

42444904-e40f-4674-822b-d758c462ceaf.Text: "If it does not pose an immediate threat to your life, leave the xenometal inside your body for now. We will deal with it later."

19fb27f5-9d62-4137-ba87-b5b04525b6e4.Text: "You must be the one who decides what to do about the abhorrence inside you."

407f4ee1-1fdf-4f9d-9a1a-bf2aee245af2.Text: [Kill Pasqal] "A cripple will only be a hindrance during the escape. I hope you understand."

95d2db73-d8b2-41cb-b628-57b31e3185b1.Text: "Now it is time to focus on regaining our freedom."

a22ea493-a4c8-47dc-b90c-fcf011f3618a.Text: Convinced Pasqal to tear the profane xenotech from his body.

840862e9-c8b2-468c-a044-a37e6df97b54.Text: "Is your faith in the Machine God so feeble that you would allow your body to harbour the taint of xenotech alongside the True Flesh?"

a09aacbe-ca75-4ed5-9e7d-7a79bc7cdd0b.Text: Convinced Pasqal to leave the profane xenotech inside his body.

649ad0eb-af1e-4e56-b396-701b3b71cfa2.Text: "Would you reject knowledge simply because the thought of breaking one pathetic rule frightened you? Think of the possibilities: you could comprehend the technology of the xenos and use it against its creators!"

12191e6a-12d8-403f-954d-6635cad9ffe9.Text: "Why did they remould you like that?"

5f502861-0288-4422-b7ed-a9a66d892266.Text: {n}The crooked figure wrapped in crimson looks nothing like the Pasqal Haneumann you know. Before, his silhouette, hunched though it may have been under the weight of his potentia coil, used to radiate authority and the power of restricted knowledge. Now he simply looks broken. His raiment is soiled with dark red bloodstains and black blotches of sacred unguents. His mechadendrites wriggle sluggishly like dying snakes.{/n}

b24557fb-1f10-41ed-a278-dff42fbf7d4c.Text: {n}At your command, Pasqal sinks his metal hand deep into the wound in his chest and clutches something. You hear a metallic creak... and then his fingers loosen powerlessly.{/n} "Request denied. This unit's motivational complex is weakened."

71cb6cb8-802b-4d7c-8ac5-8421755f3267.Text: {n}Pasqal shakes his head in a surprisingly animated and human gesture for a servant of the Omnissiah who prefers pure Techna-Lingua to primitive body language.{/n} "Request denied. This unit is identified as an anathema. The situation requires... requires... resolution."

1662d125-c503-4724-ba7a-c69018b7eb8b.Text: {n}Pasqal does not look at you, for his gaze is focused inside his own body — there is a horrible gaping wound in his chest, and you see glinting, clanging mechanisms squirming within. Pasqal has plunged his fingers into the wide, dripping maw of the wound and is in the process of palpating his metal innards with great care.{/n}

bacceafc-38ec-4694-8edc-f44119d892e0.Text: {n}It is difficult to say if the procedure that Pasqal has undergone was torture, sacred augmentation, or vivisection. His flesh is covered in fresh sutures interspersed with wounds that no one has taken the trouble to stitch up. An ordinary human would have long since bled out, but the Ferrum Sanctum sustains the bodies of the adepts of the Machine God. His metallic insides are exposed to the eye in all their vulgar and bloody nakedness.{/n}

087cd728-aa58-4dbf-9a39-61d68333140b.Text: {n}Pasqal forces himself upright and says in a faltering voice,{/n} "This unit is ready to serve. Omnissiah have mercy on me."

708c2316-f882-4302-99f4-13022d2822fb.Text: {n}Pasqal looks up at you. His skin has gone yellowish and clammy from the lubricant-like sweat, and there is something strange about the pupil of his left eye. You look closer and realise that its shape is no longer round — it is a tridecagon.{/n}

ab895815-f1a4-4b7d-99fe-7de2941460a8.Text: {n}Pasqal's knees buckle but there is steel ringing in his voice:{/n} "Cleansing process initiated. The process will be completed. This unit is ready to serve. Praise the Omnissiah!"

8b1ac7a3-14e8-434d-8e3d-32bde1ee9ecf.Text: {n}Stubborn fury flares in Pasqal's gaze.{/n} "I am a warrior of Comprehension. And I will comprehend, whether I survive or not!"

a85f6c70-1ae8-45ce-9a5c-749ceeb00cd2.Text: "The probability of total success is low due to expected premature cessation of vital functions." {n}There is no fear in Pasqal's voice. He is not trying to dissuade you, merely... informing you.{/n}

c484372c-cf7a-4d7a-b9e4-dae15b00180b.Text: "This statement... is true." {n}Pasqal's voice grows firm.{/n} "I am a warrior of Comprehension. Comprehension is the Key to all things. I will comprehend the anathema and, in doing so, prevail. I will not yield."

d51defeb-505a-4196-a01b-97622cb3795d.Text: "No data available. Optimistic projection: they are dead."

11924ca3-e567-48c7-88bb-c20ceeb4b7b7.Text: "Request denied. This unit's purity and ability to make logically sound decisions have been compromised." {n}Never before have you seen Pasqal so lost and... helpless.{/n}

bcad6745-7e61-464b-b3c5-a3ca30aff71c.Text: "So... am... I..." {n}Pasqal sinks his second, metallic hand into the wound in his chest. The hand goes in up to its wrist. He grips something with a crunching sound and then rips out a peculiar, crystal-covered metal contraption. Its unnatural outline clearly denotes its xenotech origin. Dark blood gushes from under his respirator, his body convulses, and his vox spouts out a coughing fit.{/n} "The Omnissiah... knows... all! Comp... Comprehends!"

e050183a-45f7-4dcd-8f85-0295e6766e04.Text: "An act... of defilement. This unit was subjected to a profane invasion." {n}The dry words coming from the vox-speaker rustle like sand. Under the cold layer of formality, you sense panic.{/n} "A xenos touched my Ferrum Sanctum. Removed parts of it. And... changed... other parts. Branded my True Flesh with ulcers of forbidden metal."

5407752c-dc31-4faa-93f8-582b729144fc.Text: "This unit was immobilised. Transported to the laboratorium of a xenos with the designation 'Tervantias the Archmachinator.' Studied. Anatomised."

23e871ab-caa6-4865-a865-c2d20246756b.Text: "No data available. I hypothesise that the purpose behind the alterations was... entertainment. Curiosity. He was curious to see what was inside me. Then he remade me... to see what I would do next."

a8531660-46e3-474f-a342-12e2ac7adb9d.Text: {n}The sound of vox-static is Pasqal's only response.{/n}

90cdcea1-ecc6-4583-863e-a25e3d3e4179.Text: {n}He falters, and hints of humanity creep back into his voice. He sounds almost bewildered.{/n} "There are other changes. I... cannot understand what they are. What their function is."

8f4348a3-ad4f-4bd5-8b47-45d21628307e.Text: "He wanted to watch me rip his gifts out of myself."

62ac73dd-ba52-4bb6-82f5-2c69d2c662c8.Text: {n}His internal motors screech, and a cascade of convulsions buffets his body. The indicators on his potentia coil flash in alarm. His voice trembles with pain:{/n} "Cleansing process initiated. The process will be completed."

c4f97679-70a0-4e38-bce5-cf8ae1196616.Text: {n}Pasqal sinks his hand into the open wound, crumples the fragile augmetic with his metal fingers, and tears it out. The metal piece drags wires and veins along, causing a torrent of blood to gush forth.{/n}

5a570bed-7dc5-4190-be37-86504f581816.Text: "By the blood of all the martyrs..." {n}Solomorne's dead gaze is fixed on the maimed Tech-Priest.{/n} "What have those freaks done to him?"

66f9426a-4f4c-4cf3-ba90-39bcca04cd36.Text: "Request denied due to violation of the Ninth Universal Law: the Alien Mechanism is a Perversion of the True Path." {n}There is resignation in Pasqal's voice.{/n}

807053c7-b564-4b0e-9622-1bc44ee29bfa.Text: "Don't you dare give up! Keep fighting!" {n}Solomorne's face contorts in what is either anguish or despair.{/n} "You are the best Tech-Priest I know. You can't just... Who else am I going to trust to help Glaito? The xenos got to him too."

862b93f8-258b-427d-8149-c311ff83cf36.Text: {n}Pasqal's vox crackles in fury.{/n} "New data acknowledged. The probability of complete success has not increased, but there has been a boost to this unit's motivation to resume performance and rectify the Category Three— no, Category Two blasphemy!"

d1cf49a1-3821-429d-a27c-524a713e2b5e.Text: "I am... the Omnissiah's... servant... I am... His... warrior... Flesh... is fallible. But Ritual... honours the Machine Spirit!"

ccec35d7-87d5-4ccc-b595-57dfc1aae501.Text: {n}His vox begins to vibrate ominously as if he is about to burst into a hysterical scream.{/n} "Then this unit was changed. Its sacred augmentations were subjected to restructuring. Complete replacement. Modification. Then this unit received basic medical assistance. Then this unit... unit... unit..."

edade865-012f-4663-bb20-099dcf0eedaf.Text: "This statement is false." {n}The voice from the speaker becomes drier and calmer.{/n} "The impure augmentations were inserted into the technical cycle of the operation of my True Flesh. Their direct excision will, with an undetermined yet high degree of probability, cause the cessation of my vital functions."

c027bd9d-8691-4878-bb9d-b9655b7a4196.Text: {n}Pasqal's fingers widen the edges of the wound. Blood mixed with sacred unguents trickles down his wax-like skin. His sunken chest contains more metal than you thought possible. You see the grey tissue of his lungs pierced by dozens of thin tubes. An unfamiliar organ made of synthetic fibre, imprisoned in a cage of protective rings. The wide cover over his respiratory system that disappears into his trembling larynx. All these augmetics are riddled with small grafts of xenotech clinging to them like rust.{/n}

42606d06-04b9-400b-9079-d41dad6e1e9b.Text: {n}The voice from the vox-speaker fades to a whisper:{/n} "Then he let me go."

8943806c-3f74-4b74-8a9f-7cfe4e5cdf81.Text: "Detecting numerous replacements in chain of command distributors. Alterations have been made to the operational algorithm of the encoder inside my cortical augmetic." {n}Pasqal now speaks with complete indifference and calm, as if reading out an inventory of spare parts at a warehouse.{/n} "The chemical inject-analyser has been destabilised."

b7281a11-8c56-4753-90d8-c12c83d80d63.Text: {n}A moment before you deliver the blow, Pasqal closes his eyes. A single rustling phrase comes out of his vox:{/n} "Let the Cycle be discontinued."

29241578-3253-4f85-be11-c716623bb5d6.Text: [Leave Yrliet with the Drukhari] "I will not intrude in xenos affairs. Farewell."

00514fd4-b381-481c-b5a0-b71ce46cc7cc.Text: [Nod at the victim] "What are you doing?"

ad8f13c8-7a50-4822-aed6-e599c6791c6c.Text: "You survived. Good. I want to deal with you myself!"

870267ea-9bd8-4269-8c0a-ce2d1ba7452f.Text: [Look at the Drukhari surrounding Yrliet] "What is going on here?"

0ab3857c-85e9-4289-81a1-ebaf41fc72ef.Text: "Yrliet, I intend to find a way out of this place. What about you?"

93a5c578-8625-472c-a324-bf7935382339.Text: "Why are you doing this to her?"

af61b872-63ca-4eea-b876-31886c623528.Text: "Your reasons make no difference to me. I forgive you."

19425066-2b58-42c3-80b3-a1d5126e09b6.Text: "We will yet have a word about your deeds. Now, however, it is time to leave."

cf5d62d9-291d-4ad9-b856-e0b35b9ad5c5.Text: "I will take whatever help I can get to escape."

aa7015d9-36c6-4783-9af8-e31c6657f265.Text: [Kill Yrliet] "A taste of hope before death is a traitor's just reward!"

24b3f365-ba1d-4ed7-a738-84b58e53c77d.Text: "No. You will find no forgiveness. Go whichever way you wish, as long as I never have to see you again."

fb55b342-9190-477b-a4bd-ea1a2d67f817.Text: "Even if you have lost your way, I will be here to help you find it again."

e0b16d74-f192-4b6b-a3e4-4b56724a9a32.Text: [Kill the Drukhari] "Yrliet is mine. Hands off!"

584703a2-fea5-4658-8536-9bc97db7f29f.Text: [Lean toward Yrliet and whisper in her ear] "Suffering, you say? Perfect. Show me how much more you are willing to suffer for a chance at forgiveness."

eaccb18f-6b5f-410a-af3b-652d2c42eac3.Text: "Good. Now I will consider taking you with me."

1dcb07d4-b593-409f-b34b-8cd3470ea553.Text: {n}The Aeldari runs a hand over her face before turning to you. Her pale skin is tightly stretched over the bones of her skull, her eyes have lost their glimmer, and her neck is stooped under an unseen burden. And yet you still recognise her, Yrliet Lanaevyss, your former companion and the reason for your imprisonment within these dark walls.{/n}

72fbab93-9574-4af7-b3b4-7037da35a780.Text: {n}Yrliet glances at you, her eyes widening slightly, but that is the only change you detect in her tense expression. Whatever emotions she may be feeling, she is suppressing them well.{/n} "Elantach..."

b09058db-f260-4837-91c3-fcade8196e92.Text: {n}The Drukhari grabs Yrliet by the shoulder.{/n} "You are losing focus, sister! Your spirit stone is at sta—"

fa17b1b1-28b5-4e1d-8ef2-c42dbc301e7b.Text: {n}His kin move to draw their weapons, but freeze, transfixed by the sight of their brother thrashing in agony.{/n}

749935a9-0703-4918-973a-a25e16754760.Text: "Our little guest is learning the art she and her kin lost aeons ago," {n}the Drukhari gloats in a cloying tone of voice.{/n} "The art of delight, unhampered by meaningless taboos. The art of extracting rapture from another's flesh against the will of its owner. The art of walking the path of the Drukhari. Isn't that right, my lost Asuryani?"

e003545d-c38a-449c-92d6-d0705954e1ed.Text: "The Path... of the Drukhari..." {n}Yrliet echoes the xenos's words, and the sound of her voice is as feeble and hollow as an echo.{/n}

abb3ba41-b8ee-46c5-9c65-96161cd97249.Text: {n}Yrliet looks at you in disbelief.{/n} "Your voice... Do I hear a semblance of jubilation? But how can that be, elantach? Because of me, you..."

c3ab2abe-d727-43b8-8f40-6b34a7a2174c.Text: {n}One of the xenos who were watching Yrliet torture the silent victim steps forward.{/n} "Did the mon-keigh come for a taste of pain? Then you must have patience: our little guest still has so much suffering to extract from her first victim... Your prey is far from empty, Yrliet! Do not hold back!"

db8dafb1-920a-42ee-8a4c-487a437cafcf.Text: "Learning. Mastering that which will... bring me closer... to my roots..." {n}Yrliet's voice vibrates with tension, the blade in her hand is shaking, and her knuckles are turning bone-white.{/n}

87b5b77c-b400-4b25-9142-61de2b2b0fa6.Text: "Step back, elantach," {n}Yrliet says in a trembling, barely audible voice.{/n} "You have suffered enough..."

546a2964-702e-4c5b-a241-bd187a5a9077.Text: {n}Yrliet lowers her head as if unable to withstand your gaze.{/n} "That is enough words. If your decision is sown, then act without delay..."

75e25343-fd92-4c69-9ece-af1b7ddf8837.Text: {n}Yrliet takes a ragged breath.{/n} "From the Dark Ones' toy to a mon-keigh's property... My Path shows me no mercy, elantach. Tell me... will your heart find the strength and resolve to forgive me? To allow me to share the path with you once more?"

2aee304a-cb26-48b1-8a64-ff9ab4f8ac24.Text: "Elantach, your generosity... both shames and sublimes me. For its light carries my soul over the grime of my own deeds." {n}Her reply, grateful and soft, is barely audible.{/n}

09ca9cc6-b83c-4d3d-aaa5-db7e4458b4c4.Text: {n}Yrliet nods warily.{/n} "You are right, explanations and understanding are now ours to pursue... And yet, your willingness to take me back astounds me, elantach, and it frightens me in equal part. Asuryan heed my word, I will not fail your faith in me again!" {n}The spirit stone in her breast flashes and slowly dims.{/n}

1ccf1429-68ed-431e-b201-40848b57c249.Text: "Whatever drives you, elantach, it takes great resolve to reach out to the star that has burned your wings once before. For that... I thank you," {n}comes Yrliet's barely audible reply.{/n}

76119724-cef1-444c-9efa-f49a6a8eeb62.Text: "To expect generosity from your heart... was an undue and misplaced hope." {n}Yrliet's gaze is at odds with the cold wind of her words as it flickers out like the last morning star.{/n} "So be it, elantach. Our paths diverge like two winding trails in the unending forest of life. May the stars shine on you and the road you have chosen..."

2aa11a56-351a-434c-9c46-7318a50acc1b.Text: "Spineless carrion!" {n}One of the xenos who were observing Yrliet leans forward and tears the radiant crimson gemstone from her chest.{/n} "At least I will savour the emanations of her soul's eternal agony. Out of my way, mon-keigh!"

5880a452-6c7d-4207-8770-e6dc0888d74f.Text: {n}Yrliet grips the blade in her hand and immediately winces. Her spirit stone is emanating a red glow. She touches it with an expression of anguish.{/n} "The suffering... overwhelms me... No more! I cannot bear it any longer!"

7c4c58ef-de62-49a7-bf41-1cfbbe62fde0.Text: {n}The Drukhari is too enthralled by the victim's torture to react in time. The blade goes through his throat, and the xenos collapses with a visceral wheeze.{/n}

323ded6b-123a-4388-8165-9c82739c72b9.Text: {n}Yrliet lets out a pitiful sound that resembles either a groan or a whimper, but says nothing. Her blank gaze turns back to the bleeding victim.{/n}

7377d86b-e803-4814-b184-9fe8a75dc7d2.Text: {n}Yrliet stares at you without saying a word. Her eyes, clouded with pain, ask a silent question.{/n}

d48a8bee-e3e9-4a17-a2f1-b6b5417dbeb4.Text: "Enough!" {n}It is hard to tell whether Yrliet is shouting or wailing.{/n} "Enough of this senseless... aimless torture! This is not my Path, and it will never be mine!" {n}She turns to you with a faint glimmer of hope on her gaunt face.{/n} "But first I must ask, elantach... After what I did... Drive away the night of my blindness with the morning rays of clarity. Have you truly found the strength to forgive me?"

a9eff09c-dc03-4083-b60e-02fcce1c08fb.Text: "I must have gone insane from my time in this xenos city, but... we should leave the traitor in the hands of her brethren. She does not deserve to be sentenced by a human being — such a death would be too swift and clean for her. Let her suffer for as long as she may last."

ca351470-c790-41ef-badf-5c70792d9b5e.Text: {n}Yrliet is swift and precise: the blade pierces the Drukhari's throat, and he collapses, clutching the wound and drenching the floor with his blood.{/n}

38084168-0e03-40f9-8a78-1ca048ea1cc8.Text: "And now let us walk away from the nightmares that sink their stings into the darkest recesses of my ravaged soul!"

346bb08a-1b49-43c6-8359-f27a5aaad45f.Text: "{name}, you..." {n}The pain in Yrliet's gaze gives way to another, new emotion, tender and immeasurably sad.{/n} "My eyes were blind to overlook the generosity of your soul. If only I had cast off my doubts that had coiled around me like venomous serpents. If only I had sought to share my pain with you... perhaps we would not be standing in the snare of the Dark City now." {n}Her reply, timid and apologetic, is barely audible.{/n}

c4c1b244-0f7a-476d-834b-05615a33d382.Text: "I know you have many questions for me, {name}. And I vow to give you every answer. But please, let us first depart this terrible place. Away... away from the nightmares that sink their stings into the darkest recesses of my ravaged soul!"

cdf77221-acbf-4cc7-b8f1-62652679537f.Text: {n}Yrliet looks up at you with agony in her eyes.
