She bites her lip until it starts bleeding, plunges the blade back into her victim — and screams as her spirit stone fills with crimson light. A twist of the dagger — another scream, and another flash of red. The Drukhari hungrily lean forward, imbibing her anguish.{/n}

06d1b9b0-75c2-4d5e-98bb-c460081c2897.Text: {n}Barely breathing, Yrliet lets out a quiet,{/n} "Please... end my torment..."

fefe7404-0f77-4a39-b04a-54cbd0a96482.Text: "Once Yrliet opens her soul to our ways, she will have a home once more — among our kind. If she refuses, well... then she will have to give up that bauble she wears as a flimsy shield against She Who Thirsts. But there is no cause for alarm... When we are done here, our little sister will need her spirit stone no longer."

09174cb8-3666-407a-aea8-0383cb5793e6.Text: {n}Her gaze is incredulous.{/n} "Are you... inviting me to come with you? Inviting me to the stars, elantach?"

3ef56d33-a6f2-43dc-a3a8-099f4d95982c.Text: {n}Yrliet does nothing to avert her fate — she merely lets out a muted sob. Death shrouds her glassy eyes as a tear runs down her cheek.{/n}

d4b3ff93-9ebc-4289-95c5-0209c74e3c29.Text: "A warrior such as you could prove useful to me."

82165dbd-7b84-4971-8daf-9487bef6133b.Text: "We are both servants of the Emperor, we ought to help each other in this perilous place."

51dd2d60-1eff-4eb2-a12e-d7feb8b7f7db.Text: "Well, my name is known to everyone in the Koronus Expanse. I am {name}."

91f41e63-a17f-4139-b5d0-5a4992f22117.Text: "I hope you are enjoying your meal. I am {name}."

48ac9486-2e16-4f36-af81-096b11b40cb9.Text: "My accomplishments must pale in comparison to yours."

0732940d-f168-43a0-b61e-8e2eeda97f45.Text: [Kneel before him] "Hail, Angel of the Emperor."

3cc61a6b-1584-4f8c-b125-d4b132814ebf.Text: "Pray, pause your filthy repast, for I am Rogue Trader {name} von Valancius."

1346f641-e14d-4e2d-8e95-0c21c3463b51.Text: [Point at the piece of meat in his hand] "Don't they feed you?"

72f2495d-62bd-42a1-a978-8c0c44501c91.Text: "A bad habit, one that raises suspicions of corruption."

f7ad26a8-b38f-4245-ad31-a243320af41f.Text: [Answer just as obliquely] "There must have been a reason for this bloody repast."

7809df7e-659d-4a4e-a4e9-2651ba78a6ee.Text: "How did you come to be here?"

5aecc41d-3ad7-4392-81b0-838f19005cb2.Text: "Why does the Haemonculus keep you in a cage?"

ecafa5f8-0b35-47f1-a138-71b79216bd67.Text: "I never imagined I would see an Angel of the Emperor allow himself to be taken prisoner, and to be content with his subjugation."

7585619b-8250-41ba-9de1-49532ce32db9.Text: "So, you serve the enemies of Humanity?"

c37e477d-2f16-44ae-967f-d3fbf27e7019.Text: "We suffer the same fate. I was also captured by the xenos and they have forced me to kill for their entertainment."

a4409623-7ded-44a3-b40d-a05050db2dcf.Text: "You must be planning to escape, yes?"

ab15ab4c-10dd-4cad-bbb0-e996873f123b.Text: "I wish to know more about your brothers."

b7a59faa-2ea3-4c94-bc23-44a5b3e0f335.Text: "Tervantias gave you to me. Join my party."

a5cbbe3e-844c-49c2-8690-3faecd8fd313.Text: "I am planning an escape. Are you with me?"

3a39886f-ddff-4bb3-9440-72a3cb2fe599.Text: "Don't you want to slay xenos with me?"

a8a0c56a-13db-4351-b2b9-b07ada1eeae8.Text: "Are you a coward, then? Afraid to come out of your cage?"

c3e78f5b-2735-4ba6-bc67-283adb8085e3.Text: [Listen closely to the song the prisoner is singing to himself]

5df91651-75c4-49f2-9e77-29e1efaad93b.Text: "I would hate to hear such savage ditties sung in my court."

b038f1b9-1b56-4dfc-9698-a2030abba4d5.Text: Recited the warrior's litany to Ulfar.

3b2c41e1-fa6d-481d-84d0-e17e4167bb44.Text: [Recite the warrior's litany] "Even a heretic or a non-human can wet a profane blade in the blood of enemies. But a true warrior of Humanity does not fight for gratification or trophies. He fights to carry out His will, for that is his duty. And it is a blessing."

d501b942-64b7-46f8-8477-ea9b1d7ecb68.Text: [Puff up your chest] "You, warrior, have the honour of standing shoulder to shoulder with a true hero of the Imperium!"

02ccf756-2b93-4abd-a44f-6208d49e1a17.Text: "I have enacted my will without fear of death, and my valour was celebrated long before I became a Rogue Trader!"

ddffa4fa-33dc-4c5e-bf4d-aa49e2167566.Text: {n}Singing softly under his breath, the man of enormous proportions is intently stripping raw meat from a bone with his teeth. His unwashed red hair is falling into his face, his beard is matted and blood-stained, and the aforementioned teeth look more like fangs than any human equivalent.{/n}

108f79c9-5a07-4b39-bbc4-272ec3960a2e.Text: {n}The red-haired giant does not stop singing under his breath and does not seem to notice you, intent as he is on his bloody repast.{/n}

07498e5f-9e51-4655-9c2e-f13fe4793bbd.Text: {n}When the song ends, the red-haired giant looks at you in surprise, the ice in his eyes thawing slightly.{/n} "You are one who has supped the mjod of the skjalds, I see. In the Long Hall, some of my brothers would be eager to tell you of their exploits so that you would sing a saga of their deeds."

b260e655-41da-419e-a128-e8124a9eba2d.Text: {n}The huge body with straggly, overgrown red hair perfectly suits the deep, chilling voice of this man, or of this beast in the guise of a man. Tribal scar-like tattoos cover his chest, arms, and back, and you glimpse intricate braids in his mass of unwashed hair. His body bears so many pale scars that you cannot count them all, and muscles bulge beneath his skin like boulders. He looks like a statue carved from stone.{/n}

04b4e915-84e9-4d4a-b84c-2f8becbc556a.Text: {n}It is clear that captivity has sapped this prisoner of none of his physical power. Your assessment is confirmed when you spot the remains of a Drukhari in the pile of carrion at his feet, likely one of the Haemonculus's servants. The Drukhari's flesh appears to be making a fine snack for your new acquaintance.{/n}

ab13ea8e-7e22-4f62-b850-8b6aa72d3679.Text: {n}The red-haired warrior waves his hand with a chuckle.{/n} "Very well. It will be no shame at all to go into battle with you." {n}There is a jealous, taunting note in his voice:{/n} "Even though you cannot hope to compete with an Angel of the Emperor for sheer glory."

3a1fee86-852a-4bd2-9666-9e0deeddaa54.Text: {n}He gives you a searching look, then shrugs his massive shoulders.{/n} "I would enjoy it a lot more if there was mjod. Got any?"

9fb81de3-08f8-44ca-b3ba-8c9cd3c9557b.Text: "They do — whatever they are. You can be sure of that."

14c010f5-cfe1-4b3a-85b0-ff622fe23118.Text: "For Russ and the Allfather." {n}To your surprise, he manages to pronounce this phrase clearly and solemnly even with a mouth full of raw meat.{/n}

44b6fd84-4e00-48a2-bd0d-130980865db2.Text: {n}A red brow quirks upward slightly — in approval, it seems. Without breaking off from his meal, he nods at you. For an ordinary human, such a show of regard is a high honour.{/n}

476d64c0-b8b5-4281-a1d1-37aefbab64e8.Text: "Pray, I will not." {n}The giant continues his determined mastication. Upon reflection, he adds,{/n} "My cage, my rules."

d4539ba4-700a-4c12-a703-6e350f0bbdd5.Text: {n}Picking a piece of meat from between his teeth, the warrior resumes his murmured singing. Between the lines of his song, he tosses out,{/n} "What do you want?"

465da3a2-1fe4-4cff-a099-8bcaa074b094.Text: {n}A less knowledgeable person might not recognise this giant humanoid, but you are well aware that this is a Space Marine, an Angel of the Emperor.{/n}

3c152beb-56a5-4182-94b1-a86dad856492.Text: {n}His body is covered in primitive scar tattoos, the meaning of which eludes you.{/n}

34dedd37-b348-458c-8f51-f85f02a4e31d.Text: {n}The red-haired giant's jaws stop their work. Emotions are hard to read on the crudely hewn face, but you think you have surprised him.{/n} "Fenrys hjolda, mortal. You know the old words. Good words. Strong as a rock. Sharp as the blade of a force axe. Deadly as a kraken's tooth." {n}The words are spoken in the guttural rasp of an inveterate killer — wholly in keeping with the man's formidable appearance — but you did not expect him to slip into poetic epithets so readily.{/n}

826c16c6-a6ef-43df-8837-04b6d0699130.Text: {n}At first glance, the man does not strike you as possessing great intellect — he is clearly more accustomed to mauling and killing than thinking. But you detect a certain shrewdness in his eyes. After looking you over, he says shortly,{/n} "I am a Wolf."

57d4e00d-2ed9-444b-bdc0-f0c3dcb2c7dc.Text: {n}The warrior looks at you in mild surprise, then understanding brings a crooked grin to his face.{/n} "A predator does not eat only when it is hungry. There are many reasons to eat."

fd5859bf-a739-4174-98dc-50b190b15f4c.Text: {n}For a moment, the vicious grin loses some of its sincerity and the bloodthirsty prisoner casts an intense, scrutinising look at your face, as if trying to read your thoughts.{/n}

a036c8e4-caab-4363-b899-cd35387a3641.Text: "I cannot recommend it. The meat of these xenos is steeped in corruption and frailty. As well as the foul substances they inject into their blood in vast quantities."

f7c0659f-357d-4623-aaad-d0315cc5b2dd.Text: {n}The red-haired warrior shrugs.{/n} "I did not invite you to join my repast."

a901385d-fda8-46d0-8c10-92e9c5e159a1.Text: {n}His face twists with haughty disdain. Even caged, covered in blood, and stripped of his magnificent armour, he stares you down with all the arrogant superiority of a post-human.{/n} "Who are you to judge the purity or corruption of an Angel of the Emperor? My soul was flayed to the bone by the icy winds of the Gate of Morkai, and now nothing remains but loyalty to the Allfather and Russ."

3f3e47ea-c823-483b-affd-a5ab0c552616.Text: "My pack answered the Inquisition's call and came to the Koronus Expanse. There was a battle, and then..."

1e12279a-915c-458a-94a7-736a899f077d.Text: {n}The giant lets out a low growl that rings with the fury of a wild beast.{/n} "For his own safety. When I am not busy killing inhuman spawn in the arena, the xenos fear my will."

fd0d7944-233d-4ac9-996a-39aa9619f9e3.Text: "Mmmhmm." {n}Chewing, he wipes the blood from his mouth with the back of his hand.{/n}

512b29c1-b781-4823-b8a6-baf965b2dd0a.Text: {n}He loudly sniffs the air and his pupils dilate slightly.{/n} "Who are you to offer me help? You stink of xenos. I see you are on friendly terms with them. You are not sitting in a cage. And you smell of someone else... Someone spiteful and cunning. You cannot help me."

c6a4a1ea-3c35-4bc6-bfd0-02f6899264c0.Text: {n}He shrugs.{/n} "But I sit in a cage while you roam freely around their city. They do not fear you. Maybe there is a reason for that? Maybe our fates are not the same at all?"

04d6bbde-d012-4bcf-861d-193a7a29bfd3.Text: {n}The warrior's eyebrows lower, and the growl he releases makes your bones vibrate. Something inside you instinctively recoils in the face of this post-human rage.{/n} "Watch your tongue, servant! Or I will rip out your liver and eat it so I can discover from what tainted source comes your stupidity!"

0856a0fa-d482-4011-8b99-3b2d9b5e1166.Text: {n}The warrior uses the pause to tear another lump of meat from his kill.{/n}

0c36a95b-505b-44ca-b97d-1f20b4ae26b4.Text: {n}Grinning, the warrior runs his fingers through his dirty hair, making himself look even wilder in the process.{/n} "And why do you want to know?"

d4938343-5397-4f45-b0f3-c4eebad9c992.Text: {n}The prisoner looks at you expectantly without stopping his chewing. But his expression shifts subtly, as if his affected crudeness of mind and manner has been replaced by focus and cunning.{/n}

eb6b4a34-aabf-4c61-81c9-283e389dd0cf.Text: {n}With a crooked smile, he narrows his eyes at you.{/n} "That butcher sent you to spy for him, did he? Or do they know nothing of the Emperor's Angels, the Space Wolves of Fenris, or the great Leman Russ in your corner of the galaxy?"

80a8d13a-eb43-4646-874f-306ded351930.Text: {n}A hostile glint appears in his eye.{/n} "Gave? Well... If he 'gave' me to you, step into this cage and take me." {n}His snarl reveals his long fangs, and you know that nothing good awaits you past those bars.{/n} "You think a filthy, blasphemous xenos can do whatever he pleases with ME?"

b0e3e749-d591-4571-8e1e-bd56d8415e27.Text: {n}He clicks his tongue.{/n} "Why would I be? You are a stranger. How can I trust you? You could be an enemy... worse, you could be an idiot."

dc274ec2-4139-4335-a818-2e09f8a11a80.Text: "Why didn't you say that at the start?" {n}His expression of dull savagery then changes to a mocking grin.{/n} "What did you expect? Did you think you would waft the scent of slaughter under the bloodthirsty killer's nose, and it would rush off to do your bidding?"

7296653e-573b-41bf-838b-ee671188cb61.Text: {n}A wild, deranged expression comes over his face. In a harsh voice, he growls,{/n} "Come here, you wretch! You have hidden on the other side of those bars long enough! Come in here and repeat your filthy words so I can kick them back into your bloodied, stinking muzzle!"

647c5809-984b-4120-959a-a8514beba1b7.Text: "It seems Tervantias is not as clever as he likes to appear if he's letting me out of the cage. The joke is on him." {n}He rolls his huge shoulders and you hear his joints crack loudly. He lifts his battle knife from the floor — decorated with scarlet runes, it seems to be his last surviving possession. Weighing it in his hand and wearing a sceptical frown, the Wolf says,{/n} "Good steel I have already, but if we are going hunting, I will need my wolfskin."

4148c4e7-f770-4033-b784-f7ac8aff7b6c.Text: {n}You do not know the language. The sounds seem crude and mangled but not entirely lacking the harsh dignity of a form of Gothic, while also sounding similar to the rumble of a landslide, sharp and choppy guttural phrases tumbling forth in a harsh rhythm.{/n}

32fce0c4-9580-4728-a366-2c3e37104c99.Text: {n}You close your eyes and enter the flow of the song, like slipping into a fast-flowing mountain river. Words rise up naturally in your mind — they are not the same ones sung by the prisoner, but you sense their aptness. Verse flows from your lips, full of surprising poetic metaphors and bloody details of a nameless hero fighting monsters under the light of unfamiliar stars.{/n}

21212e02-b548-48e8-9da9-331b5a29cabd.Text: {n}You close your eyes and try to pick up the song's rhythm, to slip into its sharp and idiosyncratic flow. Alas, your words do not seamlessly merge with the stream — as soon as you sing them, you can sense how painfully misplaced they are.{/n}

236153ac-0a42-40cb-bad9-e23df96faff7.Text: "It is about starlight glittering in the blood of heroes. Snow marked by the footsteps of merciless hunters. The fyceline haze that hangs over corpses torn apart by scavengers." {n}A small, warm smile touches his lips.{/n} "In a word — home."

b08f6890-5321-42d9-b973-d59343853f99.Text: "Of course. The Allfather granted me the honour of tasting the mjod of the skjalds. I have composed a thousand verses for my brothers — verses of passion and pride, calls to battle, verses that pierce the heart, and merry ones, like the laugh of a madman who lost his sanity to a winter storm."

846f0eda-2e39-4b16-ae10-269130651ef9.Text: "They will not be sung there. You have not earned the right to hear them."

55c230e0-611f-4dce-a721-c30fbc408d89.Text: {n}The prisoner slowly brings his song to a close and smiles in satisfaction.{/n} "I crafted those verses myself. For a brother who fell a century ago. He was a good warrior, and he had a good death. And his saga turned out fine indeed."

6a344182-3b84-41a4-89a0-620ddc1b16fe.Text: {n}With narrowed eyes, he says weightily,{/n} "To get what you want, you will have to convince two very headstrong individuals — me and my captor, that claw-handed xenos."

a3ef3e4e-0f1f-4c8e-9783-a37d804d45bc.Text: {n}The warrior raises his eyebrows.{/n} "Do you serve the Emperor, or are you a puppet with the hand of that xenos butcher up your arse? How am I to know whose words you speak — yours or his? How am I to know what plot you are trying to draw me into?"

275c6544-3685-4dce-b294-71e8f25f663a.Text: {n}The giant sizes you up with interest.{/n} "You speak well. I have heard these bookish words many times before, but this is the first time I have heard them spoken with such resolve. I see that you believe in them, that you live by them. I respect that. I will help you. Let no one say that I forgot my duty to the Allfather."

9d8176b4-dd07-4709-87d3-8b2f78c8929e.Text: {n}The prisoner grins cheerfully.{/n} "A {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_MOT_GreatDeed}true hero{/d}? Is that right?"

e659acc0-cf61-44e8-9114-bf53c946e9d6.Text: {n}The giant roars vehemently,{/n} "Do you realise who you are bragging to, mortal? I have faced enemies in a thousand battles! The bodies of those I have slain could pave a path from Fenris to Holy Terra! My name is known to everyone in the Chapter!"

2183bdc5-bc97-4cdd-a4dc-3206af7380a3.Text: "Well, I..." {n}The enraged giant draws air into his chest, but suddenly pauses to consider.{/n} "{name}... I think I have heard of you. You truly are stout-hearted, they say, and have proved yourself in the past."

f0388a97-0d72-4400-85c0-50449b64e79c.Text: {n}The scar tattoos on his body, which at first appeared abstract and primitive, together form the angular image of a wolf's mouth with bared fangs. This person must be the genetic offspring of Leman Russ, the Space Wolf of Fenris.{/n}

1d23f671-f840-40e2-8185-b1cf62ab6d43.Text: {n}The giant lets out a frightening, sepulchral roar... which turns into equally savage laughter. Wiping away tears, he stops chuckling, and without a hint of threat in his voice, remarks,{/n} "Fine, you got a rise out of me. And from what I can smell, you did not soil yourself in the process. I respect those with courage. I can work with you."

c0a91a72-9475-40ab-9c15-5d3e84bf468b.Text: {n}Throwing back his head, he lets out a blood-chilling howl, one that contains the deranged mirth of evil spirits dancing on an icy cliff. A predatory grin blooms on his face.{/n} "What did you say your name was?"

702bcddb-b030-4c2d-b21f-1189747bcda8.Text: "But you are just a tongue-wagging fool giving opinions about things that are above your rank."

9073e205-e9c8-4d68-ab2e-3c8f23e81cac.Text: {n}The red-haired warrior finishes his song and laughs sarcastically.{/n} "You are no skjald, I see. It is not for your fireside verses that your friends esteem you, I wager."

3397a1d9-5b07-4fab-8ca9-a5feb50e710d.Text:
"The young wolves yearning
to be meat for their brotherlings,
To a feast of bolters
they went out roving,
though they were but few;
One long of fang, with them
went loping,
Not to see them cut down
by scythes unclean.
The pups he sent scattering
and there stood alone,
the paths guarding;
For a foe he long spied,
One worthy among unworthy;
The song of swords singing
they clashed with clamour and skill,
Until stood the old wolf
upon the bones;
Then by the birds of battle
was he brought down."

7096017a-370e-4a2a-855d-e39ffb3381b9.Text: {n}The giant chuckles.{/n} "Was that clear enough? This saga sounds less interesting in prose."

29e8b2d1-f988-4c2d-8fe0-effb362b2b9d.Text: {n}Flexing his muscles, the prisoner says in a surly tone,{/n} "When I rip your insolent tongue out of your throat, do not ask why. This is why."

9a1c4515-f0ec-4cd0-ad99-96b914528ff8.Text: "What matters is that you are alive and safe."

952a3586-f6cd-41ff-b67f-d703ef25777c.Text: "How did you end up in Commorragh?"

1aef136a-f713-4ef3-9018-9fd29b55e4d7.Text: "If you are nursing such a grudge against xenos, you are free to leave whenever you wish."

0b9a8b29-c8b0-4eff-8cd8-76d6eb0a8a39.Text: "Fear not, I will not allow what befell you and your people to ever happen again."

1f7fb0eb-16e3-413c-95ec-45f8ad3961ab.Text: "You survived. In Commorragh, that is no small feat. You should take some solace in that."

688f0244-0e90-4dc6-9919-607f43ca75c1.Text: "He will receive his due punishment, Sergeant. You can be certain of that."

32cfd809-87fa-4db0-b910-5ed1f2f858c5.Text: "Why don't you kill the Commissar yourself? Lasguns can be used for purposes other than a makeshift crutch."

375c54e2-b7b4-4d2c-a71f-e7113e7b3582.Text: "You have been avenged. The Commissar will not harm another soul ever again."

1c543650-2891-4966-8bd5-f00bcfb4bd54.Text: "Tell me about the Commissar's betrayal. How did you end up in the arena?"

abf2d545-6467-40f0-83d9-412574ed9ea9.Text: "We are not in a position to pick our allies."

cda50c8a-cf0d-4ad0-a12c-64094c3cc238.Text: "When we get out of here, we will dress your wounds properly. The medicae facility on my ship is second to none."

52f0019e-bbaa-4e59-a41e-57e8f0a866c1.Text: {n}Leaning heavily on an astonishingly battered lasgun held together by a long history of field repairs and providence, Sergeant Vigastes glares daggers at the Commissar with clenched teeth. The sergeant himself looks much like his weapon: the horrible wounds on his arms and chest have been hastily stitched up and tightly wrapped in bandages soaked through with now dried blood.{/n}

aafc786b-e608-43aa-99d2-0d9bff9e998f.Text: "That bloody rotter. Now he's using me as a new symbol for his sham tales — a brave sergeant who escaped the xenos' clutches. The new guys stand there gawking, eating up every word, and all I can do is grit my teeth and think about how many people just like them... just like us... did the same and wound up butchered. I'll take {d|Encyclopedia:Ch3_VigastisSaved}being impaled on stakes{/d} over this torture any day."

cea4593b-cc01-4a96-bfde-e8ed16818229.Text: "I swear to you, I knew not what I was condemning you to..."

3492cc2a-3666-4306-b21e-730defa4b2f4.Text: {n}With a creak of his battered lasgun, Vigastes struggles to salute you.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

ea0ef645-7827-4400-a85e-7795aba188bb.Text: "Sister, I'll be honest with you. When I was there, being skewered on spikes like a bug, I cursed your name too. More than once. But when you were pulling me off those spikes, one look at your face was enough to know that you'd been just as much a victim of that sick man's lies as the rest of us. I do not blame you."

42038a37-b3c3-4bad-a786-c51b44bf2d89.Text: "I served on a frigate, the Watchman of the Abyss. I got captured by a Drukhari boarding party. They took me to Commorragh and threw me aboard one of their gondolas bound for who knows where. With the last of my strength, I grabbed the pilot and jumped down into the Chasm. The xenos's body cushioned my fall, so, somehow, I survived. That's where the Commissar found me, before betraying me and sending me to die in the arena."

4de8d491-ccff-4e22-9179-ea82d92e4456.Text: "'Allies' would be a generous choice of words, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. 'Enemies who haven't killed us yet' is a more fitting term in the world of Commorragh."

76433892-6839-4637-8c97-1e5f948bad8d.Text: "The only way to stop it from happening again is to destroy that traitor. He must answer for everything he has done."

5018916f-9380-439f-8e16-388a085542a5.Text: "Sister Argenta offered me first aid, the rest was done by some rookie who barely knew how to stitch. The Commissar turned it into a show of him giving his last stimulant to save a hero of the Imperium. The scumbag." {n}Vigastes spits on the floor and immediately lets out a wet cough.{/n}

033c3ca7-6ed4-48e9-bf3e-669c9bac797e.Text: "You and I must be very different people if you find solace in watching a scoundrel massacre desperate people in your stead."

9fa6dc5d-5a3b-4b6f-af67-cef5e566ee89.Text: {n}Vigastes summons all his strength to salute you with his hand before slumping back onto the support of his ramshackle lasgun.{/n} "I will scorn all my wounds just to give him what he deserves, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Just give the order. I beg of you."

9549fcf1-620c-4416-b0ea-477da795e433.Text: "In any case, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I'm grateful to you and Sister Argenta for saving my life. I hope one day to repay you for taking pity on a man who was as good as dead."

0b6284b1-78a4-4f29-82a2-c3611c67b2ba.Text: "Just look at me, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I have holes in my arms. My legs can't support my weight. If not for these wounds, that freak would already have a pretty new hole in his head. It's not the dying I'm afraid of, mind you — it's missing the mark."

866540af-49cd-4074-978f-712e56d44329.Text: "A lone cripple won't last long in the Chasm. I don't intend to throw my life away after you have just saved it, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. At least here no one is trying to impale me on a stake or pour acid down my throat... yet."

ad86590c-617a-4243-b8ad-7cf8a1437b27.Text: "Sister Argenta offered me first aid, and the rest was stitched up by one of these unholy maniacs. I suppose I should be glad he wasn't so hopped up on stimulants that he accidentally killed me in the process. That many-armed snake couldn't stop laughing. Whenever I screamed in pain, he told my 'chirurgeon' to slow down to prolong my suffering." {n}Vigastes spits on the floor and immediately lets out a wet cough.{/n}

5a9d5b4f-8dd3-40b3-be66-5c8a3e329eb2.Text: {n}He chuckles mirthlessly.{/n} "When we get out, you say? I've heard that one before. That it's possible to escape this place. I believed it, and this is the result. Forgive me, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, but I can't seem to muster enough optimism right now."

a2287716-cd66-4361-a1fe-7cc6e4eca26e.Text: "Once he had found enough 'volunteers,' the Commissar sent me and the others on a special mission: to capture a ship for our escape. By an incredible stroke of luck, he got a hold of a portal that conveniently led straight to the docks. That creep. I still remember seeing the smug smile on his face as I entered the portal. As you may have figured, the portal didn't exactly lead to the vessel of our salvation. We were just cattle for his Drukhari cronies, and our misery and shock at having been betrayed was like a tasty snack for them. We fought back as best we could, but..." {n}The sergeant falls silent.{/n}

de34a999-a2a5-491d-a167-e5ee001b38e2.Text: {n}Vigastes nods, leans on his battered lasgun, and goes back to glaring in the Commissar's direction.{/n}

52d3e9a1-612e-4467-8192-558c4de6e835.Text: "Thank you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Now I can die in peace. Except..." {n}Vigastes frowns as he looks at the caged Commissar.{/n} "If I may speak freely... Keeping him in a cage, like a xenos... Even a monster like him doesn't deserve to rot in this thrice-damned place. If it were up to me, I would execute him as a traitor and be done with it."

de72c904-4775-43ac-b5b7-135d7f8f316f.Text: {n}Leaning heavily on an astonishingly battered lasgun held together by a long history of field repairs and providence, Sergeant Vigastes stares in bewilderment at the Shriekers and Malice. The sergeant himself looks much like his weapon: the horrible wounds on his arms and chest have been hastily stitched up and tightly wrapped in bandages soaked through with now dried blood.{/n}

c87aea58-737d-4f32-b604-545b794f4d59.Text: "I never would've imagined that I'd {d|Encyclopedia:Ch3_VigastisSaved}escape from the xenos{/d} who nearly disembowelled me only to take refuge in the den of different xenos who rub shoulders with heretics."

be876cd8-8e18-4e8f-b180-058add6626d5.Text: "In any case, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I'm grateful to you and Sister Argenta for saving my life. I hope one day to repay you for taking pity on a man who was as good as dead. What warms my heart the most, though, is that the Commissar, that traitor, {d|Encyclopedia:Ch3_ComissarDead}got what he deserved{/d} and will not be sending any more desperate people to their deaths."

b30d13a8-e3bd-41ad-8451-2668300ce1c0.Text: "Safe may be too strong a word, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, but it certainly feels good not to be dangling from stakes and hooks like a grox carcass. It looks like I'll get to serve the Emperor for another day or two." {n}Vigastes tries to chuckle, which makes him cough up blood instead.{/n}

11d8a456-49c9-4c21-91a6-e83827c282a1.Text: "I don't know if he's a real Commissar or not, but he's an exceptional liar and sadist. His method was simple: find people on the streets of the Chasm, give them hope that there was a way out of this place, then recruit them to his 'resistance.' A few stirring speeches, food, shelter, a beat-up lasgun — that's all it took for us gullible simpletons to believe we could escape Commorragh."

2c0a0de0-9d3d-4c36-8f56-c185f2c2363b.Text: "What kind of a creature are you?"

8a2a58e7-fdf8-4927-b411-4b9ce5c748a4.Text: "I know. I grant you the Emperor's Peace. Farewell, Achilleas."

35f44c47-a760-429e-9eea-2cd5115e96d1.Text: "I will save you. You do not deserve such an end."

13f151fe-ef58-420d-8cd4-b666ebf594a0.Text: "What offences earned you this hideous transformation?"

9cf053fe-dce5-4118-9211-d4967abd13a0.Text: "Try to talk this malkin round, Jae. I shall observe."

8898a171-2f0c-4f30-ac5b-a7a773a04cf8.Text: "Quite right. One must not turn down power, whatever the source."

9c5db69b-e0e9-4caa-be4e-05392b4c674c.Text: "A sensible way of doing things: where those with wisdom and high status remould their inferiors to suit their needs."

efe46b53-f2d1-43b6-9f80-e4c0ec406ade.Text: "It takes a true fool to ask to be transformed into such an abomination."

3d4394e9-85d8-4e64-a0e0-c260bd125a4e.Text: "Heinrix was never more wrong than when he chose such a pathetic creature to be his agent."

0abf7699-cd6c-427c-a6aa-0f92e0e09ef5.Text: "You were trying to survive. In a way, it was the sensible thing to do."

4a8ef629-9bdb-468e-b640-19c67555ad92.Text: "Perhaps it is the only way to survive in a frightening place like this. But you have my sympathy, nevertheless."

030cfac4-e544-47a9-b13e-6efaa215aab9.Text: "I now see what you are. This is enough."

f530f76d-defc-4c25-9fec-da98df866441.Text: "You must have been very weak, given that you opted for an augmentation of such magnitude!"

1a1b3d7e-f11d-46c1-b0ce-a5a8ce782a89.Text: [Attack] "I will show you which of us is really meat."

2638b287-2383-41fb-87b3-95220a45e354.Text: "What is wrong with the Haemonculus giving you new organs instead of an implant?"

8e83f869-caf5-4913-887c-b858f9577811.Text: [Take a closer look at the mechanical parts of the monster's body]

40b10d87-67a9-4eea-a5c2-cbc28795be97.Text: "Does your master always keep you on the verge of going berserk?"

299a51cf-63e7-49a5-b675-94cb56da0102.Text: Saw a glimpse of humanity in the Acothyst's eyes.

084aa97d-6c73-4bc5-8c76-9519654af1ec.Text: [Peer through the slits of the mask into the monster's eyes]

84691274-f533-4c4d-9050-1301bf4e49ed.Text: [Address the monster] "This woman is with me."

5c33ab49-5472-4cba-a92c-9d8127da85ae.Text: [Address the monster] "Don't let this one pass. She has done nothing to earn it."

9f82d8ec-abb6-478c-ae38-074f400f99b0.Text: "I promise, we will find a way to heal you."

b66b8db1-3709-483d-8763-5461a57b0295.Text: "I did not relieve you from your oath. Fetch me something of value from the Haemonculus's caches... and a cup of recaf."

51ec92d5-b762-420c-8c6c-3b076f5abf51.Text: "You seem to have lost both your charm and your usefulness. I will not rescue you. Farewell."

6460bd42-1e3b-444d-89c1-52c3bdfdf716.Text: "Achilleas Scalander, I sentence you to death for treason."

ba352c29-31e2-4525-90b0-67137ac2a3a3.Text: "I did not expect us to meet again."

4819be5b-5379-45a3-87f1-dd1b57038540.Text: "Jae! Where did you learn to speak so crudely?"

21f700fc-85ee-46c2-a2e4-fc48b5a2e564.Text: "Why have you been pretending to be a dumb brute?"

517e57d8-97e4-4838-a948-17cbc27470d3.Text: "It seems we have much to discuss, Jae..."

16a90383-3156-45cf-bba0-74a5ae640b95.Text: "Meat. The master ordered that you be let through." {n}When you approach, a few augmetics spring to life inside the monster's bulk. An injector hisses, filling its blood with compounds that cause its veins to bulge and its muscles to swell and twitch spasmodically.{/n}

1c5b36b7-9104-4c90-a74f-4fc8ee105997.Text: {n}The monster greets you with a menacing snarl.{/n} "Meat."

6cc7bacc-9472-482d-a991-fdf505d575c8.Text: "He... remade me. He put colonies of mutagenic infection into my flesh. Pumped me full of chemicals. Cut me open and took out some pieces. Irradiated me. I do not know what else he did... He took his time. It was painful. By the time he finished, I could not remember how he had started."

afb0de38-d18f-4e02-9d9e-54faded4d041.Text: "Ill-met, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I trust... you will... do the right thing."

712dd94a-14f4-456f-9bd2-97e02df87b24.Text: {n}The monster snorts and puffs out its massive chest.{/n} "I am an Acothyst. Servant of Master Tervantias, his meat driver."

ed783034-d9d1-4b9d-b435-751e60bdc488.Text: {n}The monster's voice is so calm now you cannot help but recognise it.{/n} "It is I, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. As you can see, I have... changed since we last met."

d73565de-e476-4634-9783-0541cdbcbad8.Text: "I am a brute. A cursed soul boiling with rage and locked inside a gaol of tortured flesh. My new organs make me go blind with loathing. My mind... has degraded. The Haemonculus had no need of a servant prone to excessive cleverness."

2a19ecd4-3a02-4a5c-9b16-50e1e258c0f1.Text: "It was followed by another thirty-one eternities, and at the thirty-second I broke and agreed to tell them everything they wanted to know. To carry out any order. They made me their sleeper agent and left a parting gift: each night I experienced an eternity every hour. I almost stopped sleeping, survived on a diet of recaf and injections and waited for the day they would order me to betray you."

007c70b3-1eac-4e49-bccf-4662a1204214.Text: "So tell me what you want, you piss-brained ashmag, I can get you anything! Is it combat toxins? A new blade? A force sword, a poison dagger? Or maybe a few bodies to play with?" {n}Jae lashes out in hysterical desperation.{/n} "Azhi got your tongue? Say something, damn you! Is it sex? Gold? Blood? Weapons? Sex and blood? Weapons and gold?"

e3c48a2f-5c80-4cec-a536-e71205aebda8.Text: "Not offences. Labours. I toiled to be granted this honour. I begged for it. And I received it."

40df9e8e-4c9e-47bc-adad-90cc17a23e8f.Text: {n}The monster's throat gurgles.{/n} "I am an experiment. Tervantias decided it would be interesting to sew mon-keigh pieces into a Wrack."

73b334f5-4815-41ad-aa6c-0b1f0b1b1a6c.Text: "Yes! I am the strongest now!" {n}The monster pounds his enormous chest with his fist.{/n}

b5a43cf3-48e5-4a8c-8360-0559496abe27.Text: "The master is wise. The master decides. Everyone obeys." {n}The giant warily bows his helmet-clad head.{/n}

c0e474cc-2581-4429-addb-bca712c60e48.Text: "You are weak, meat! That means you are the fool!" {n}The monster wheezes, thick cords standing out in its neck.{/n}

fc62f1e3-d296-4572-a25d-ad639b9fd4d6.Text: {n}The monster grunts in a menacing and condescending manner.{/n}

ab991873-f9d7-411b-a03e-c16d74be3ed7.Text: "It is the weak who need sympathy! I am not weak!" {n}The roar is magnified by the echo inside the helm and hurts your ears.{/n}

7413f740-5c8e-49b2-8def-caf1589197db.Text: "Regret is wasted on the damned, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I... chose my fate because I turned out to be weak."

3e1575a0-f57f-4e11-ac8d-b1ea9569d10f.Text: "Oh, no. It was short-sighted of me. I regret I lacked the tenacity to die. It would have been so much better."

2db5a26f-a2f6-4ab4-b388-4f53c876a381.Text: "You condemn me, no doubt. It is certainly your right to do so."

c89069f3-59fe-4948-b3dd-f0daea301708.Text: "I do not think... I am... permitted... to die..." {n}Achilleas's voice quivers, building up to a bestial howl.{/n}

d0e47730-9dd0-4c62-a102-f032b3ac88fa.Text: {n}The monster huffs strenuously. It seems to be perplexed by the sophisticated nature of your social gambit.{/n}

9e0abe2a-1a5d-47fc-a367-18f98bd75595.Text: {n}The sullen hiss of a pump built into the hulk's body is your only reply.{/n}

e579f8f3-8f5c-4983-8f58-a797623720c3.Text: {n}The injector system clicks as it drives pistons into the giant's body, and it responds with a blind howl of unadulterated rage. The brute lunges, but its strike does not startle you.{/n}

a704298b-2575-4943-9976-15163bb234ea.Text: "The master gave his permission." {n}The hulk subtly moves over.{/n}

3d87a6ea-d56d-4f0c-b7a3-c7c1dca46a44.Text: "I get new material while the master cuts. I manage his business. I look after... I look..." {n}The monster's voice keeps growing calmer with every word, approaching a normal pitch. Some mechanism inside the hulk's body springs to life with a hiss and injects something into the clear tubes gnawing at its flesh. A moment later, the chemical makes the giant roar with the same blind rage as before.{/n} "I watch!"

177182b6-1051-45a8-b8bb-23d33b798df4.Text: {n}Among the many mechanical augmentations embedded in the creature's flesh to boost its combat performance, you notice a set of complex devices meant to control the biological processes in the monster's body.{/n}

23dcaf59-3e93-4e66-aeb0-03f3c3b4f12f.Text: {n}The rage fades just as quickly, and the voice drops to a rattling croak:{/n} "I am not foolish. I am weak and condemned."

df735415-4f5e-4069-a1aa-8a3e77838e24.Text: {n}The voice fades for a moment and the next phrase is uttered with unexpected calmness:{/n} "The condemned need it not."

ce4c3bfc-7d1d-4d9c-b244-e9c568297765.Text: {n}The Haemonculus's servant howls and starts punching the black mask with its massive fist. A choked sob-like howl is heard from the inside. Then the huge hand unclenches and a much softer, almost human voice calls out:{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}..."

ac9d561f-de46-4ad6-a859-16cc711751e7.Text: {n}The profane mind of the xenos has defiled the very principles of body augmentation. The longer you look at the metal embedded in the monster's flesh, the louder your mind rebels against the idea of comprehending and understanding this foulness.{/n}

9af369b6-044e-4573-8df9-51e20a15fad8.Text: {n}The monster gives you an indifferent shrug.{/n}

571a726e-a1f0-46d9-bd50-3721d0a8a1f4.Text: "You..." {n}Jae's eyes grow wide with fear and hatred.{/n} "You... {mf|son|daughter} of a grox and a dockside whore, that's what you are! You filthy {mf|ashmag|kaskha}! I will... I'll..." {n}Jae bites her lip, drawing blood, and throws her hands up in defeat.{/n} "May the azhi screw you and your protectorate several times over, {name}!"

b039d100-d1d7-471f-bbf0-cfe879d7a3c6.Text: {n}Jae dodges the rampaging beast and addresses you pleadingly:{/n} "{name}, shereen, light of my eyes, help a grunt out, will you? Or friend... whatever! I'll owe you one, and I always square up, you know it! I never weasel out of deals like this one, I'll pay you back in full!"

cafc60af-f50b-46c5-98c0-41a93d8c1547.Text: "May the Exalted One shower you with blessings, shereen! I always knew you were a decent sort, not rotten inside. A bit out-there, but not rotten." {n}Jae bends over in yet another coughing fit and spits out a crimson-tinted clot.{/n} "Ugh, azhi take me! I should move my arse while I can still carry it around."

40bbda8f-3a40-4464-800c-462b2afb7b09.Text: {n}The monster tries to shift his trembling bulk and get up but fails. Burned by an excessive dose of combat steroids, its muscles have deteriorated into a half-digested mess too weak to carry its massive body. The giant wheezes and sinks its grey fingers under the edge of the mask, ripping it away with the crunch of dislodged bolts. The flesh gives way and you see the creature's face.{/n}

27819cf1-a3dd-4cfb-85d8-f454cf0d3779.Text: "This is fair. He made a huge mistake by trusting me with this mission."

84234260-86c1-4e4b-b58a-e32a1309285c.Text: {n}Your blows speed up Achilleas's agony, but it still lasts a long while, giving the traitor plenty of time to feel one last moment of suffering.{/n}

838bfb41-1b7f-4c20-8c67-45245c117d22.Text: {n}A low-pitched chuckle comes from under the mask... or maybe a snarl that sounds like chuckling.{/n} "I do not think my newly found lucidity lasts long enough to let me find recaf worthy of Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} anywhere."

73349a17-2913-4e7a-ae0a-cf3a0c3d7595.Text: "Spare yourself the effort, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. You will not be able to and it is not something I want. In case you did not understand, the existence in this body is far worse than the torment they subjected me to. I am glad it is about to end."

b146044d-dbda-415a-97e5-fdf020ee020c.Text: {n}A gloomy sigh escapes the creature's augmented lungs.{/n}

40c40b3f-31e5-4baf-95e9-1e1901be3d00.Text: {n}The augmented body was built for battle and can endure plenty of punishment. It dies slowly and reluctantly, stretching Achilleas's suffering into another eternity of pain. But just like all things, it too comes to an end.{/n}

c98de9ae-3179-4b3e-a05f-5f9f3a6f7055.Text: {n}Just like the rest of the body, the stitched-up face is a patchwork of flesh: pale Drukhari skin, spotted hide of unknown origin, and strangely familiar burn scars... You know these scars and the single eye looking at you from the misshapen head. They used to belong to a man named Achilleas Scalander. A spy for the Inquisition. A traitor.{/n}

01b6a4fd-7c58-4171-ac07-c3d16c7b5ceb.Text: "They broke me. When the Drukhari attacked Dargonus, I was captured and tortured. It lasted an eternity, and then they stopped and I realised that merely a minute had passed. The time in their hands is as malleable as other people's bodies."

a8871e62-4656-411e-b72d-dbde759da6aa.Text: "Then great happiness came. I was at last allowed to go though with the betrayal. Then I was no longer needed and they delivered me to Tervantias to be remade."

b3ede17d-8889-493a-9348-67e21de8e94b.Text: "Now that my body is dying, Tervantias's grafts have weakened and I can think more clearly now."

6743e703-e2fb-48a2-b98a-2f26e6aa6d2e.Text: "Talking to you awakened something in my unconscious mind. I do not think it will last."

34aaff09-37d4-4ad7-95e8-10ef4ff228f7.Text: {n}You know who this voice belongs to. Achilleas Scalander. A spy for the Inquisition. A traitor.{/n}

cf0011b6-4f53-4318-bda3-d65201695ffb.Text: {n}The monster's right hand reaches out for Jae's neck, but the left one intercepts it halfway. A click, and the cloudy ooze from yet another jar seeps into the hulk's backbone, causing it to twitch as if it had been electrocuted.{/n} "The master... forbade me... to break... Go away!"

eb2a6003-e4df-46ba-a929-3289222b7c21.Text: "I am not weak! I am strong!"

30d325bd-a2ff-4414-9f18-3f9037a643d2.Text: "An augmented warrior is called a Wrack because the Haemonculus invades his nature like a conqueror, wrecks the mundanity, and creates perfection from whatever is left. An Acothyst is the superior among the Wracks as well as the strongest and the most frightening."

cbce4133-6114-48b6-bfe5-3337da0f926f.Text: "Here's the deal. I need to see your master. To take back what is mine, you hear me? He and I have unfinished business — it doesn't concern you. And besides..." {n}Jae notices you and breaks off.{/n} "Shereen... You're alive! You—" {n}She grits her teeth.{/n} "Apologies, {name}, one moment." {n}She turns back to the monster.{/n} "I'm with {mf|him|her}! I only need five minutes — don't be a sekhek."

63d286e0-8de3-47c8-bb78-15974977aa9e.Text: "Because they're not organs — they're shit! The mines left me with busted rags for lungs, and when the carcina started..." {n}Jae sobs.{/n} "I nearly died, shereen! By the time I saved up enough for an implant, I was coughing up blood every day. I almost didn't make it... And now this xenos ashmag, this son of a star jackal and a blood-faced Drukhari slut grew a carcina out of my own flesh! And shoved it back into my throat along with some shitty organs he'd grown in a bloody jar!"

6b19914c-000d-4aea-8a25-4db6c5337081.Text: {n}Jae guiltily lowers her head.{/n} "We sure do, {name}. I guess the rip-roaring yarn about the princess from a desert planet won't cut it anymore. But I'm begging you..." {n}The woman raises her head and looks at you, eyes glistening with tears.{/n} "Later, okay? I need to see the Haemonculus. I NEED my implant! Don't let me die the way the rest of the mine rats do. Not that way, shereen... Any way but that!"

c28f513e-5ee3-454c-a375-290db1c32f4c.Text: "It is the carc— the carcina, shereen." {n}Jae spits out the word and shuts her eyes tight as if the word itself could hurt her.{/n}

5b90a3a2-e0be-4079-8f4e-eecbe588060a.Text: {n}The growling becomes deeper.{/n} "Anger is useful. The master wants me to be angry at all times. The anger leaves no room for the forbidden thoughts." {n}The wheezing sounds glum, almost desperate.{/n} "The forbidden thoughts are forbidden!"

1df6793e-c054-4206-b222-afe46d044fe1.Text: {n}Synthetic hyperadrenaline glands and growth steroid tanks regularly pump batches of poison into the giant's bloodstream, causing it to boil and its mind to perpetuate a furious agony.{/n}

43ca4776-95c2-4d51-bc7b-0305f6f9b134.Text: "Hey, you pile of hot dung! Yeah, you, you dumb ashmag, I'm talking to you!" {n}Jae Heydari's looks match her coarse speech: dishevelled, ratty, and bereft of all her jewellery and rakish glamour. Her eyes, locked on the gatekeeping monster, are brimming with fury and desperation, and her voice... her voice resembles a gruff bark.{/n}

d58cab49-c101-41a5-ae15-0a29af011e88.Text: {n}The monster is looking at the frenzied Jae Heydari in cold silence.{/n}

276b834e-6e5c-474c-8bd9-e25ca0d35bd3.Text: "You get lost too. Or become a corpse."

6ef6ec39-e770-428f-afd5-d5832d579e33.Text: "I will make it up to you, {name}." {n}Jae shoots the monster a scathing look.{/n} "And we are not done talking yet, you bloated tub of lard!"

32d50f18-0903-45a7-840d-07e5f5a637dc.Text: {n}For a brief moment, you lock eyes with the monster inside the cramped dark of the visor. The creature hastily turns away and growls, but you are certain you have glimpsed something human in its eyes. Fear, perhaps, or grief, or maybe even... shame?{/n}

e3aad487-e86b-4b6b-abe7-fac934b45f3a.Text: "Get lost. Both of you. Or become two corpses."

2b69467c-edc2-4a1e-9100-3a31389fd93d.Text: {n}That voice, the one that cut through the haze for just a moment... It is the voice of a break. The same break that {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Torture}your tormentors{/d} once tried to achieve. The ones who tortured the mind that dwells in this abominable spawn succeeded in maiming their victim — yet they could not destroy them completely. But why did that voice sound so familiar to you?{/n}

ea570412-1c53-4c23-8f0f-f1c3e39079ad.Text: {n}The monster leans forward to take a closer look.{/n} "The master said no. Only {mf|he|she} is allowed. Go away."

3d30ee86-03c6-4bf0-8c46-673227ac7eff.Text: {n}Heinrix clenches his fists.{/n} "I see the xenos' minion has been handsomely rewarded for his treachery. I had a sliver of hope that I might still be lucky enough to kill you myself... but I will not do so now. No, not by any means. To languish in this... form... and be deprived of His light is a far greater punishment than any I could devise." {n}Heinrix spits on the ground in disgust.{/n} "Damn you, Achilleas. Damn. You."

a078f2ed-3a67-48ea-80eb-46dbfc2a6762.Text: {n}A sound erupts from the monster's throat, a distorted, mangled, but still recognisable human sob.{/n}

9ed5f87c-b0a5-46ad-8d31-589d4c6814f2.Text: "You are right, {name}." {n}Heinrix's voice rings with shame.{/n} "It is my fault. I did not see the weakness in time."

65e511c5-a819-4782-9b84-28bb1821d32a.Text: "Ooh, looks like you're not the sharpest tool in the shed, you piece of—" {n}Jae breaks off, starts coughing and throws her head back, drawing a laboured breath. To your surprise, you see living flesh where her neck implant should be, punctured by narrow scars showing where the augment was once grafted onto the woman's skin.{/n} "Now listen here, you ugly mug. I have an offer to make, and you'd do well to take it..."

99b5feb1-8713-4ac0-8699-bfbb7a5338ee.Text: {n}The oaf clumsily scratches at the fresh scar at the top of its head and concedes:{/n} "Fine. The master permitted companions. She is a companion now."

2aec8076-453b-4591-8d2d-a02e4f2eee32.Text: "Crude shmude!" {n}Jae casts you a desperate look.{/n} "{name}, it's not about how I look and talk right now. I need to see the Haemonculus! I absolutely must, got it? If you're so offended, I'll wash my mouth with soap, but later, shereen! Later!"

60ae11a1-ea45-4def-aa54-32ccf0ed02bc.Text: "I... was in there, you understand?" {n}Jae breaks off and helplessly points at the entrance to the Haemonculus's chamber.{/n} "That's where he... cut me. The many-armed ashmag took away my breath! He started by cutting off my head, but I was alive and conscious. I hung from the wires and watched what he did to my body! He took out the implant, the throat, and the lungs, the whole thing! Then he grabbed a chunk of flesh, messed with it, sewed it into place... And everything came back!" {n}Jae is overcome by a hacking cough, flecks of blood on her hands when she draws them away from her mouth.{/n} "I'm dying, {name}! Dying again!"

1507ab98-9612-4580-ba77-d35e8bf967a2.Text: {n}Heinrix staggers back as if from a blow. His unblinking gaze is fixed on the monster in front of you.{/n} "Scalander?"

cc998f3e-8a3d-42d6-a6cf-880d64b1bc40.Text: {n}The monster lets out a distressed howl in Achilleas's voice.{/n} "Master van Calox, you are alive... I hoped death had taken you before those monsters could do to you what they had done to me..."

fd0aa578-1335-41e7-ac17-a31820c9a4f3.Text: "Malice, what does it want and why is it calling the shots here?"

5d554562-b5bf-40dc-bce5-c108dcd127ac.Text: "What does this have to do with me?"

d6b5ff9e-ff65-4a6b-8ac6-c5ac59368520.Text: "To the warp with you both! I am not going anywhere."

83b07467-0264-40ba-8388-db31d235e659.Text: [Reach for your weapon] "Don't you even try forcing me, you scum!"

9c2c25cf-092a-464e-971e-4242bff30c79.Text: "I came for the meat, Malice. Meat for the arena." {n}The rumbling voice of the creature stitched from flesh, pain, and fury echoes inside the black helmet.{/n}

7440de87-d2ae-4e8d-ba14-70314f615297.Text: "And it is waiting for you. Shriekers, the sand is once again thirsting for your blood! Those of you who will give their lives to entertain our masters, know that I never cared. Those who will come back alive and in one piece will have as many stimulants as your pathetic bodies can handle." {n}Malice shifts his gaze to you and grins wickedly.{/n} "Give my best regards to the arena, fresh meat."

a9e3de83-1334-4eb0-a44d-70b9adcf9049.Text: {n}The booming voice that erupts from under the helmet is full of scorn and barely contained fury.{/n} "Bring your untransformed meat to heel, Malice, or it will not even make it to the pit."

94b28d3b-9dda-4543-a88d-16cb26196dd0.Text: "This is a servant of our lord Tervantias, the Haemonculus allied with the Reaving Tempest. This entire sector of the spire, the Chasm, is the domain bestowed upon him by the Kabal. This is where he harvests materials for his art... Screaming, pleading, panicked materials. And this is where he recruits gladiators for the arena."

eb17aa85-08bf-4379-b9f8-b9bc656d06fd.Text: {n}The hulk's body is criss-crossed by thick ugly scars as if someone stitched it together from different pieces. Its huge muscles are disproportionately swollen and riddled with peculiar wire-like augmetics running under the skin. Its backbone has been stripped of flesh and encased in the steely grip of a spinal transplant, and its face is hidden by a black helmet.{/n}

69954d85-ea1e-40fb-9c68-0e3f9a2dbb9b.Text: "Don't irk the servant of the esteemed Haemonculus, humanling. Follow him, do as he says, and once you find yourself in the pit, try to survive and entertain the masters."

792daa24-55f3-4830-abbd-ae098f199d5b.Text: {n}The monster's grunting, slurping voice sounds oddly familiar.{/n}

630777fe-a05c-4174-aca1-c2a31db04c2d.Text: {n}Malice looks visibly pleased when he says:{/n} "Now you are a Shrieker. Meat."

97a14d5b-70b7-4514-8668-4977b97c65f0.Text: {n}Malice shrugs indifferently.{/n} "You don't say. Does that make me a scoundrel, then? A liar? I stand in awe of your perceptiveness."

8419bc47-774d-4b28-9d39-fc371aefb2f9.Text: "How smart of you not to resist, humanling. Save your strength for the battle."

4365732e-70d8-4cb6-8f73-e7e6f59b7e5c.Text: {n}The monster points the muzzle of a device sticking straight out of the folds of its greyish flesh at your forehead. Its angry voice becomes uncharacteristically serene, almost normal.{/n} "Do not resist. It will only make things worse."

6719565b-eed0-46dd-bde2-ba5e9fdfe0d6.Text: "Move it. The masters wish to drink of your suffering."

76730f99-85a3-42d1-b3a7-c67fc92ce039.Text: {n}The monster snarls in frustration and points the muzzle of a device sticking straight out of the folds of its greyish flesh at your forehead.{/n} "I don't have time, meat."

ffa3f6dc-9429-43d3-bc89-e8c07ee0a9e9.Text: [Attack] "Yet another accursed xenos concealing its lies and treachery in florid riddles. Enough!"

c9c4836c-8085-4936-beb9-7a16231acc66.Text: "I do not understand what you want from me, xenos."

d8663261-fa03-49ff-a7a7-c12d0bca9363.Text: "Yrliet, one of your kind, lured me here. I wish to find her."

adf06023-5daf-4a2b-85c2-67a44b9b0e3d.Text: "Do you know where the Drukhari are holding the psyker Idira?"

e214c2e4-9ea0-4848-b8b8-b708e9b42ad9.Text: "My Navigator, Cassia, is missing. I doubt she will last very long here on her own."

a0454b09-e3d8-401a-9d29-8563a1c7cc12.Text: "I wish to find my companion, Heinrix."

2872d99d-156f-4392-a920-dd4ba64f720b.Text: "I had a mercenary in my retinue. A bodyguard would be useful to me here."

61fa0ecc-f4b2-46b6-838d-236e5736780f.Text: "Before beginning a conversation with a Rogue Trader, xenos, it is customary to bow. I am waiting."

776d89d1-f4fe-4f8b-ae41-f7ebadd48a9c.Text: "What is this dance you are so intent on drawing me into?"

9baaa739-a58f-446e-91a8-2a1763f6037e.Text: "I have no intention of dancing to your tune or listening to this raving. Find yourself another toy."

8842a192-6dba-43a7-b7b5-f5115f443bb0.Text: "Do you know what he wants from me?"

dbe8d9dd-66c5-425a-9e11-cb61b2ba3982.Text: "Forget your riddles for a moment. I am looking for my missing companions — do you know anything about their whereabouts?"

9fe79d1d-f03c-4f11-894f-59d4084ba2bd.Text: Deciphered the sonnet of Nocturne of Oblivion.

c0c9fd24-c375-437b-95c2-55b85430f34c.Text: "Everything is perfectly clear. There is a certain 'maestro of flesh' who conducts experiments on the bodies of others. He has a laboratory that can only be accessed by fighting in the arena to draw his attention. With his assistance, I will be able to escape the Chasm. Oh yes, and your name is Nocturne of Oblivion. Have I missed anything?"

525c8396-4962-4c17-9531-8514e7ba63e5.Text: "I am looking for my bodyguard, Kibellah."

15e53c0c-fbdb-4127-a9d4-b501e6dddc7d.Text: "I wish to find Pasqal, my Tech-Priest."

21f03217-47b9-45cc-8722-05215690ec07.Text: "I shall endeavour to find the person of whom you speak."

89509bae-bd7e-4369-9b4e-f3a1e9d943c2.Text: "If you are unwilling to relieve me of your presence, at least spare me your senseless verbiage."

7bf404cd-1a22-46a5-a1d7-1dbc4eb502cc.Text: "Let's go. We should not linger here."

d3e413df-2824-4b3d-afa8-a00fa62d0ab8.Text: {n}The stranger standing before you brings to mind a motley-coloured, long-limbed doll abandoned amid carnage and detritus. The bright colours of his sleek costume seem comical against the unremitting gloom and hostility of this place. Only the sorrowful horned mask that hides his face and the dark hooded cloak he wears pay tribute to the overwhelming air of hopelessness. Every move the xenos makes sings with theatrical precision and a predator's grace. You cannot decide if this person is an accomplished dancer or a master assassin.{/n}

a6b67e64-05be-4bee-ad7c-0f6a178d004f.Text:
"This crib of putrid flesh offends your taste?
Oblivion comes now. Here its Nocturne plays.
I am that starlit strain that chills the soul,
The piece that doomed throngs pitches into dance.
You are among them, Merchant Vagabond.
So tread the steps I say, escape fate's grasp."

2a6d0e0e-9a73-497e-9d83-46c3c464e897.Text: {n}You have never heard of such xenos before. What is he doing in the Chasm, and why is he standing before you now?{/n}

1503d9af-f31f-45c3-8a0e-eccdb9d2c2fd.Text:
"A melody of snarling agony,
Beguiling now, by rending flesh bewyched,
Through sinew, bone, and grisly pageantry,
It calls the blood-soaked drape to come unstitched.
A haggard chorus in the hall behind,
Their flesh employed to serve the maestro's art.
No prayer for mercy slips from throats confined,
The baton sets the beat of every heart."

1eaa07bc-aeb4-49d3-96ee-516dab5726f1.Text:
"Amidst the shadows dancing round us here
A crimson streak I spied by flesh consumed,
Malevolent, but not his own, I fear,
A vagrant languishing, alone and doomed."

84eb0c68-ef29-4ef3-abcf-b5e75dc6f28e.Text: {n}Yrliet takes an involuntary step back, her face filled with fear.{/n} "Arebennian! Doom incarnate! Of all the places in the galaxy... you show yourself here!"

e929414e-7573-4c7f-87fc-91128cb37749.Text:
"Alas, my wants are neither here nor there...
But turn the question on yourself instead.
Pursue the melody, and find the key."

dbc756da-64f0-486f-9ffa-fbb5d85adb91.Text:
"Of glimpse and whisper dream the blind and deaf,
But you eschew them both for darkness mute.
I will not be a pest — I've said my piece."

f6349455-39b2-48e0-accd-0a5065b4d6db.Text:
"To lose the Path, and then by touch again
Discover it — such is the Outcast's lot.
On parlous streets she treads a bloody trail
That leads her on through pain and wickedness."

9dc888fa-6b57-457f-87fe-958e7258c56f.Text:
"The one who mastered flesh's mysteries,
The soul's enigma is what plagues his mind.
All those who glint unnoticed by the rest
He now holds prisoner within his hall."

8648e321-17a7-4658-9f37-d1f69e8871aa.Text:
"A dream to play, the maestro does declare,
His flesh now sings in chorus with the rest."

0899dcf2-3fc0-4296-95b9-73159cec4868.Text: "That business done, we must resume our dance."

338d044a-cf79-4e54-b87c-178e1915be8a.Text:
"Your wait will test your patience and my own.
To pass the time, a sonnet I'll intone."

fc433195-30ec-4c76-8d65-560c3fe8250f.Text:
"The steps you know already, Vagabond.
A knife-edge minuet you must perform,
Between oblivion, foes, and your own friends.
So heed my sonnet well — it holds the key."

77d0f133-2edd-44fa-a1e5-197bb6b97a5e.Text:
"The Merchant Vagabond rejects {mf|his|her} role?
But only curtain's fall will smash the chains
And fully break Commorragh's iron grip.
So heed my sonnet well — it holds the key."

0e958cd8-7ecf-4597-aa29-71daf5408077.Text:
"And entrails are for him an instrument,
And veins a living stave sans parallel,
Yet death to him is no impediment,
For corpses tunes do carry just as well.
Through spectacles of blood and gore forge past,
Should crave your eyes to glimpse sun's light at last."

f68748b8-fe7a-4398-8abd-0c3b8725dee5.Text: "Perhaps when we stop to rest in a place of quiet, you will find time to hear me. But for now, we must go."

52372e7e-6b7c-46ce-8796-c9555aad5ae5.Text: {n}Solomorne's eye is seized by a tic so strong that he has to press an iron finger against the lid to stop it.{/n} "I... bloody... hate buffoons and their Throne-damned verses..."

de965675-a6a7-46be-81c0-c1112c3dc6cb.Text: {n}You had already recognised this creature during the trial, but now, with the Drukhari poison purged from your body, your mind is clear.{/n}

16651856-bb57-4a4d-b0fe-b5bcfb2f7cec.Text:
"The Outcast and the Merchant — what a pair.
Bereft of blood and hope, without a path...
The parent cloaks the cradle once again,
And babe is doused in darkness as before.
But death is near, Asuryan's child — make haste."

642f1af2-7395-4448-bb5b-644c5a96d3c6.Text: {n}A shiver runs down your spine. This is a Harlequin — the deadliest of all Aeldari warriors. You have heard of small Harlequin Troupes taking out entire armies of enemies, whirling in their mesmerising and terrifying dance of death.{/n}

45960d96-bf79-43ac-96d9-536587758823.Text: {n}The xenos stills and looks at you intently. He is not accustomed to anyone so adroitly and quickly navigating his verbal labyrinths, that much is clear. At last, you hear a low chuckle behind his mask and the xenos claps his hands slowly, saying only one word:{/n} "Brav{mf|o|a}."

d754df3b-fc30-4aae-aeca-f5c6baae6728.Text:
"Whose life so dearly does the Merchant prize
To boldly now disrupt night's melody?"

95608857-f594-4473-a468-3768479491f6.Text: {n}An indigo ripple passes over the xenos's body and he dissipates like a bad dream.{/n}

c60faf95-1b16-4ae0-aee8-79607897fc8b.Text: "{name}." {n}Normally unwavering, Yrliet stops in hesitation.{/n} "I promised that I would never again hide my soul behind a frozen wall of hubris and doubt. But this place... has too many eyes and ears to be sharing such thoughts."

9f95a9b5-561e-47ce-b6ea-51c09f7180f5.Text: "Then go and dance. Do not forget the key."

5fc962c8-8090-4ddf-abc2-75e6a10b6fb0.Text: "Care to tell me who that was?"

1ea3b710-c776-4b92-894c-355366a92a22.Text: "How do Solitaires differ from other Harlequins?"

6955451a-b1d1-4b55-91ad-ef08fe44f0ee.Text: "What was he doing at the court?"

b64c6773-9f4a-4d53-b6ea-ead0212b4b16.Text: "Why did he call me the Merchant Vagabond?"

1e6c3f45-0aad-4bb7-8b88-3a56ea3ab421.Text: "I thought some illusion had clouded my gaze when I beheld the Arebennian at the Archons' court. For he is an omen of monstrous things to come..."

6a0efa66-99d3-404b-9cd3-772a4c4b8988.Text: "My... brother? My kin? Like the {g|Encyclopedia:Drukhari}Drukhari{/g}, he is not one of the Children of Asuryan. You mon-keigh call those like him Harlequins. For they are memory. They are oblivion. It is the Harlequins' duty to remind our kind that, despite our differing Paths, we have but one enemy — {g|Encyclopedia:Sailanthresh}She Who Thirsts{/g}. And among the Harlequins, there is no creature more unpredictable or perilous than the Solitaire. Their entire lives are a spectacle where the art of performance and the art of killing are intertwined."

244859f0-93e6-42af-8478-bba1d3996671.Text: "Harlequins perform the Dance Without End — the tragedy of our people's past. There is one role which only an Arebennian may perform... the role of the Enemy — She Who Thirsts, the reviled {g|Encyclopedia:Sailanthresh}Sai'lanthresh{/g}."

ab6c887c-0e80-4571-ab91-5f1c88f4aa0f.Text: "To delve into the mind of She Who Thirsts, even for a moment, is extremely perilous. Many have lost their sanity and even their life attempting to portray our kind's greatest enemy upon the stage. Only the Arebennian are capable of such a feat, and for that reason they are respected and feared by all Aeldari — from the Farseers of the Asuryani to the Archons of the Dark City."

404fa085-64b8-4760-8c9e-5a27dbab816a.Text: "The Arebennian's role is one of terror and isolation. They walk the Path of Damnation, doomed after death to surrender their soul to She Who Thirsts, and even a spirit stone cannot guard them from this fate. And Cegorach, the Laughing God, must go into battle against Sai'lanthresh for the soul of every Solitaire. For in his victory lies the Arebennian's only hope of salvation."

d04fa061-59d7-4d40-8175-7e237d5e1af6.Text: "To the depths of my soul. If you are truly wise, elantach, you will do the same."

51abcb91-ff0e-429f-878f-fd6a0fb652f4.Text: "That I do not know. But what is not hidden from my gaze is his interest in you, elantach. Tread carefully — attention from an Arebennian bodes nothing good. Many believe that even speaking to one is tantamount to a death sentence."

a3f670f0-6dd6-4486-a3fb-0fe729ceaa10.Text: "Who knows? Those like him see the world differently and see no need to explain their metaphors to others."

04a3e238-37ff-42e4-a410-ff4c52c6767a.Text: "The Arebennian weave their speech from shimmering threads of hidden meaning that even I cannot fully grasp. All I can discern is that he is sending us to... someone or something that can help us escape the Chasm. Based on the description, the 'key' is one of the Haemonculi of the Dark City. They are famed for their experiments with flesh. And the path to him lies through the arena... So, you must fight if you wish to attract his notice."

f934601f-b4c6-40ae-b494-1da1fffee6dd.Text: [Look at the chronometer] "Your timing is impeccable. You may leave now."

cacd4422-70e2-45f2-9077-3764b3227fde.Text: "Wait for a sign and run into the portal. Understood."

8b12d1b1-ba0f-4135-8aa6-0ca462ad0dea.Text: "You have helped me more than once already. I am listening."

b5907bd1-8662-461b-9eb1-cae7dc3ae009.Text: "I shall deign to spare you one whole minute of my extremely valuable time. Do not waste it."

13dfffc5-d9ff-40b7-b643-72f02b2502aa.Text: "One more word about roles, dances, or keys, and I will shoot you myself. Begone!"

81a31238-c1c2-4a70-8241-f4b4184b0031.Text: "A mouth? What are you talking about?"

f71eb6f9-0a82-440d-81bb-3fcaebcb794c.Text: "If I will be walking into a trap, why do you not simply extract me now?"

cbc0577f-cf31-417a-915c-3c3dbd61b9b6.Text: "If you wish to help me, why don't you finally demonstrate these exceptional skills of yours and aid me in battle?"

74704869-76c9-4cf4-b6f7-35d2c7764bcb.Text: "Wait for a sign and run into some kind of 'mouth.' Understood."

5b269fb5-03db-47f6-9404-82324bf7ebe8.Text: "I do not know what I expected when I agreed to accept your help. You are talking in riddles. Again."

63b51777-7e48-44fd-ba85-12f5f0959154.Text: Understood every detail of the escape plan proposed by Nocturne of Oblivion.

5537744d-7309-482c-b7cf-f9cb162c0b09.Text: "So, Keykeross is planning to kill me in the next fight, but you are ready to effect my escape. All I must do is survive the arena, wait for your sign, then run. You cannot possibly mean into a literal mouth, so you must mean for me to leap into a portal of some kind. Do I have that right?"

cb5340e2-41db-4943-a88e-b6a536ac23d3.Text:
{n}The already familiar baritone calls out to you from the shadows.{/n}
"The key unlocks a door that then will lead,
To one that only happenstance will free.
Your chance I'll be, to me the bolts will cede,
Your part comes next — to break the bonds and flee."

261df6de-b341-43ca-8db7-96c51bf52b93.Text:
"To you, the Merchant Vagabond, I bring
The gift of providence, but will you look?"

4d023fa5-fdc3-4195-b2c4-3c01a0d870b2.Text: "The portal. He means the portal to the arena."

de89b172-cc89-4253-8b98-04fcdb7dad89.Text: "I think the Arebennian is referring to the portal that takes us to the arena. Is he planning to do something to it?"

bde21cf6-72b1-496c-be45-b21492527471.Text: {n}The xenos's colours are like those of a broken kaleidoscope — your eyes water at the mere attempt to pick any one thing out, and your head is splitting more than ever. Yet despite this, you are subconsciously aware that the dark lilac cloud surrounding the slender figure poses unspeakable danger. And that the bright sparkles of silver indicate that this danger — at least, for now — is directed at you. When you avert your gaze and slowly exhale, the vision falls away as if it was never there.{/n}

7c4a7708-ec36-4d1c-995a-c2b428097687.Text:
"Oh nectar sweet — your name is ignorance!
Make sure to savour every drop before
Your glass is drained by insight in a blink."

92a5a3b4-022a-42ff-ac86-e1fb87cb8d63.Text:
"Well, as you wish, this gift is not for all."
{n}The Harlequin vanishes in a cloud of blue smoke, leaving you with nothing but the feeling of unease before the coming battle.{/n}

7ba29a4c-83f7-4faa-a060-c20de8f59da6.Text:
"Both opening and warning is my boon,
Your fate hangs by a thread drawn breaking tight,
But with a show of patience opportune,
The Merchant certain death will turn to flight."

e0ae18d0-83c6-4c27-b039-7b89e90d26cb.Text:
"'Tis wise indeed to count each moment past,
To nothingness they stream like grains of sand,
They steal your hours and days until at last
They turn to dust in reaper's wasted hand."

1fedd951-0a21-47fd-a870-46c6d1ce6486.Text:
"You stride not into battle but a snare,
Of guile and strife a neatly woven net,
Lust's mistress lifts her sword into the air
And baying for your blood her pack does set.
So dance a ring around oblivion,
Await a sign from night's own melody.
Catch sight of it, and then, make haste, begone!
One yawning mouth, one leap, to set you free."

0fc227e5-2a4b-483e-9e84-33d9f189b7c5.Text:
"Poor show! The spice of life is mystery,
Too bland a spread would sour your appetite,
The sign of mine, fear not, you'll clearly see."

f7cf1ee6-4a87-4c11-a7c6-94dbb9630e69.Text:
"The greedy mouth that swallows brave and bold,
And after few releases from its hold,
The Vagabond this maw already knows,
Why, to your fights it marks the start and close."

2b8cf4c0-1b6e-4fee-bb37-6f76d5eb88f4.Text:
{n}The Harlequin laughs darkly as if you have uttered some naive inanity.{/n}
"In vain you grant compassion to the mask,
Though you and I play roles, desire has none.
Your part on stage — to break through barricades,
While mine's to chalk in darkness players' marks,
And lead the company to its finale."

3f51140c-0fe1-4c51-9bf0-cb87e0999b4f.Text: {n}The xenos lays a finger over the mute lips of his mask and vanishes, as if to convey that your conversation is a great secret known only to the two of you.{/n}

ffb3adc8-b654-44fc-aeb3-2e0529020104.Text: "A wait, a sign, a mouth. Remember this."

e2ab2308-cf69-4f2e-973a-5b155dc36d2d.Text: {n}Marazhai is squirming with rage he does not dare to unleash on the Harlequin here and now. He hisses through clenched teeth,{/n} "All who have taken part in my downfall will be exterminated..."

28d30272-ebd1-4678-83eb-e15f1a07dc30.Text:
{n}The xenos, tilting his head to the side, looks at Cassia with curiosity.{/n}
"So many things can three eyes glimpse at once:
Sha'eil's veiled paths and caverns of the soul,
But with a thousand sights you could not see
The wrecks of fate beneath reality!
Past's creaking waltz will twirl you round in halls
of intertwining serendipity,
But not just yet — the dance calls for a pair,
Your partner is, for now, tied up with me."

d11cfb0d-0b44-4ebc-84f3-71ac7363e503.Text:
"...and sooner than you thought, my Merchant thief!
Just like a drop of ink you fell upon
The page before this play's dramatic end,
Wherein your own kin's blood you will see shed.
Perform the lines required and vengeance will
Descend upon the stage and play its part.
And then away from spires on Merchant's trail,
Across the worlds a parlous road you'll tread,
And death you will find there, or else a path
To remedy your second enemy."

0b3e1f66-7919-4105-9871-288c05e2c9e8.Text: {n}Marazhai digests the Harlequin's words in silence. At last, a shadow of the usual smirk flashes on his face.{/n} "I... I hear you, Arebennian."

14b9e322-073b-4ab0-a45e-0f34c5363cb1.Text: "When the cursed jester says 'mouth,' he means the portal at the stadium. But where is the sense in that? It will just take us back to the Chasm!"

ef73b7ee-406a-4f19-93cb-1a402d38ef2d.Text: {n}The Harlequin sweeps into a low bow, like an actor who has performed before a true lover of high art. He seems satisfied with your answer.{/n}

6e198a1c-bdd8-419a-801f-db41ba4d8e3d.Text: {n}The xenos means the portal that leads to and from the arena. But why would you return to the Chasm?{/n}

f990e43b-d271-49e5-9b5c-ea52fc41ac74.Text: {n}The xenos's clarification is as vague as the rest of what he says.{/n}

da4b4d24-6034-4e27-9ee3-3e6b6c8c22a2.Text: {n}Sudden pain grips your skull and your vision clouds over. But as soon as you resurface, a dramatic scene appears before you — the streets of the Dark City are teeming with hundreds of colours, from grimy grey shades to extravagantly bold hues. At first they blend together in your vision, but soon you are able to distinguish their sources. People, xenos, animals, you... and, of course, the Harlequin standing in front of you.{/n}

f1f3b6e7-f73b-455b-ace2-975fed4708d6.Text: {n}The Harlequin observes you with interest, his silence speaking volumes.{/n}

a9a63741-c599-4838-a375-3969e1e43a41.Text: "{name}, your colours! What... what have you done to {mf|him|her}, xenos?" {n}Cassia lifts her chin and the third eye on her forehead flutters threateningly behind the eyelid.{/n}

f081d80a-4095-46b8-81c3-277f629a469c.Text:
{n}At the sight of Marazhai, the Harlequin lets out a nasty chuckle:{/n}
"The trapper caught in snares of his own make!
The plotting of your play was up to snuff,
But Nazrakhei rewrote the denouement
Decided in the darkness of the wings.
Amidst the sombre spires and hunter's game,
'Tis wise to stop and once more check your knives—
For that which glittered in your hand before
You may now find a-twinkling in your back."

af8b8a95-5c66-4c80-8b8b-4bba13d73c27.Text: {n}Cassia clutches her head at the sight of the Harlequin and scarlet blood starts trickling down her cheeks.{/n} "Your colours, xenos, are fractured and wrong, as if refracted through a distorted prism! What should be familiar is dispersed. And the bedazzling shades won't stop twisting madly..."

f4c5da20-a67d-4166-a5c4-75e33047ece6.Text: You hear the light footsteps of xenos coming from the terrace and their voices brimming with anticipation.

8e78b5e7-e31a-4bf0-8887-a3e1dd4a87b8.Text: [Make an imperious gesture] "Now, to the purpose of my visit. The Reaving Tempest has decided that the Kabal that survives the celebration will be allowed to become their ally. One Kabal. Not two."

56f1e0bb-3350-4956-935c-72928d6d352f.Text: "Ulfar, I wish to speak to them before you... do what you intend to do."

acb43f19-3f0d-43cb-81f9-5003aedcc23c.Text: [Turn to the growling giant] "And just who are you?"

4a431c87-8591-4b71-a1d5-965f56954a41.Text: [Smile] "So, which one of you is worthy of getting the first taste of my pain and which one will have to settle for scraps?"

f14ebd40-024b-4544-a1dc-e22c3b8978b0.Text: "I do not wish to ruin your celebration with bloodshed, nor do I have any interest in you. Let us part in peace."

c776223f-f8af-4938-9d54-4ed7608b52a8.Text: [Turn to Ulfar] "How did you get here?"

b9122aea-a089-4454-aaeb-a1a099c64ee5.Text: "Enough of this nonsense. I came here for a purpose, not to give myself over to your deplorable delights."

d6e0042e-9bcd-4c6d-858b-ca917f1c8823.Text: [Wink] "Oh, yes, that is exactly why I am here. For enjoyment."

2d317b4f-26a8-447e-8ede-b70a1f260cf2.Text: "Do either of you know what I am doing here?"

44af57ad-2cac-4f5e-8c80-5668e7b7a49a.Text: Stoked Ulfar's anger using the right words.

4ecfb71b-9be9-4047-82aa-f272de28ff64.Text: [Address Ulfar in a silken voice] "Even if you are being manipulated wherever you go, is slaying xenos truly such a terrible fate? An eternity of killing them, one after another, and another, and another..."

c82d895e-705e-45e4-a9b3-2ece7022229e.Text: {n}The elegant red-haired xenos takes a sip of her wine-like liquid and gives you an appraising and somewhat surprised look, then smiles and says to the xenos standing next to her,{/n} "What's this? New playthings, no doubt. And here I thought the Reaving Tempest was intending to offer up your paltry Kabal for our entertainment."

4c8d2cbe-adef-4f80-b97a-752dcefe20c4.Text: {n}The tattoo-covered Drukhari she is addressing, who is absent-mindedly sticking serrated needles into his own gums, scoffs in response.{/n} "The Poisonous Whisper should learn to live up to their name. Lest the Kabal of the Wounded Skies live up to theirs and make you bleed upon the Dark City, you sharp-tongued pest."

bef58158-9eda-45de-aaa8-6d097dbc72f6.Text: {n}The symbols on their armour are different, indicating that these two belong to two different Kabals. If their venomous glares and thin smiles are anything to go by, they are ready to go for each other's throats at any moment.{/n}

b54d8294-d655-4143-b359-82ce42aeadab.Text: {n}Marazhai turns his head, looking around the room and grinning in fiendish delight.{/n} "This is one of the satellite towers of the main spire of the Reaving Tempest... What luck! Yremeryss's throat is now that much closer to my claws... But first I have to deal with my sister's pathetic guests."

d8b41a81-78a3-4101-b265-1a92c25283de.Text: {n}The red-haired xenos licks her lips.{/n} "There is enough suffering in you to satisfy everyone. All it takes is the right approach."

6f11785e-13fc-4864-97c2-b97765c0c35b.Text: "The Kabal of the Poisonous Whisper may be feeble and few in number but inflicting pain is a talent you possess. I will allow you to make the first cut."

d486ec0f-6435-49fa-97de-1fe06e047e95.Text: "You belong to the Wounded Skies. I will help you remember the name by burning it into your eyeballs."

ac82c2a0-b413-4d83-8d07-a530871a41d2.Text: "The Wounded Skies are always so hasty and so eager to rush ahead, they fail to notice the daggers being shoved into their backs by more worthy aspirants who are offended by their witlessness." {n}The red-haired xenos gracefully places a hand on her weapon and the male Drukhari mirrors her gesture.{/n}

337e1f8b-8758-4d36-9b22-dd4a12fdc711.Text: "I will give you no explanation, mon-keigh. Perhaps you have angered fate and the gods for them to have pushed you to such a miserable end."

41cbd9bb-dfca-4014-9f06-ee45e8617f01.Text: "I've had enough talking with xenos. Their words are thick with lies. Once you let them touch your ears, you become a puppet pulled by their strings! We will put them all to death in a whirling bloodstorm — that will be a deed to honour the Allfather!"

7caa9cf0-69eb-441f-b59e-8d3ea51fc36c.Text: "Words, words, poisoned words everywhere!" {n}Ulfar bares his teeth and his expression darkens.{/n} "I am so sick of you puny inhumans who know not of honest battle, steeped in the mire of your own intrigue. You have dragged me into that same mire with you. Is this proud warrior destined to wander your wretched lair forevermore, slaying xenos for other xenos' amusement?" {n}His voice changes, taking on guttural notes and sounding far from human. There is no sign of jovial rage left — only a grim thirst for blood.{/n}

26993d71-5a98-480a-bb75-924708a478cc.Text: "Ooh, I like this one. I want to cut the tendons in his every limb and watch him burn in the fires of his powerless frenzy."

1091abe0-6e6f-4552-af2b-d32c15755498.Text: "Why?" {n}The fangs in Ulfar's mouth — or rather, his muzzle — appear to have grown larger. His distorted expression strikes you as odd: all his emotions have melted away, leaving behind nothing but predatory indifference.{/n}

c9833c36-66e7-4ef2-8b39-5623f782ddd2.Text: "A big-mouthed xenos came to fling his brazen mockeries at me. When I chased after him, he dived into a portal. Where is he? I want to tear out his liver and taste it!"

c1e35f7b-2c07-4c9f-9485-775a9560bf4e.Text: {n}Ulfar throws back his head and lets out a terrifying howl filled with longing and the cold promise of a swift yet painful demise. The sound of it leaves no doubt in one's heart that bloodshed is now inevitable.{/n}

6aea21e3-70b3-4c04-b8a6-8abfead74e2a.Text: {n}Achilleas lets out a raging guttural cry. Pistons sink into his flesh with a hiss, injecting it with a dose of alchemical rage. The smell of imminent bloodshed sends the monster created for carnage into a frenzy.{/n}

5b7279b5-c0ff-403e-96b0-231f62900318.Text: "Let us feast, then. Don't be scared, mon-keigh, you won't die too soon. I intend to savour every moment."
