80bab494-89dd-4515-a11e-d0a81f2fafd2.Text: "I have no right to judge you. But Pasqal does."

06258932-dda3-4517-9172-b760c032baed.Text: "A fine victory, {name}! They will tell sagas about the day the contemptible Uralon fell! The cog-priests should offer you a fine cup of mjod for saving their prayer world." {n}Thorbald nods at the two gaunt bodies in crimson robes lying on the floor.{/n} "If you hadn't, Uralon would have bathed them in a hundredfold more blood."

47d4fbcb-c893-4328-b4a8-05675b16af88.Text: "And that it has unlocked his jubilation functionality. He was a fine priest, and it's a shame to lose a comrade like him. He was a warrior at heart, so the Allfather granted him the highest warrior's honour — a glorious death in battle. We will drink to his memory at the feast so that the Iron Wolf may be merciful to his binharic spirit."

f19123c1-55fb-4669-8ee1-129168de2da3.Text: "As for you, Ever— Ulfar Thunderlung, you have proven yourself. The Stormbiters will tell all about your feat and your roaring song."

0ba6fd06-716c-419e-89bf-5bb80cae646a.Text: "I thank you, Thorbald. You and your brothers fought well, you did the Wolves proud. It will be my joy to share a cup with you at the victory feast, Ironhide."

7371ac01-9ddc-4e0d-a05a-406adf99545b.Text: "Knowledge will not fall into oblivion." {n}Taking great care not to ruin the Tech-Priest's features, Pasqal reverently extracts the neural cogitator from her skull, then does the same to her sister.{/n} "The Quest for Knowledge is the Omnissiah's mission to us."

2642393c-bc16-4e30-9087-33387a265f0d.Text: "It doesn't become a noble warrior to bark at his battle-comrade after a good fight. Ulfar Thunderlung has proven that the spirit of the Baleful Howl is alive and strong. So let ravens fly where he has walked, and let them tear at the bloody harvest left in his wake!"

004bf3fc-d94c-4254-ad54-70a42811a657.Text: "Estimated level of threat to Archmagos Amarnat increased. The unit identified as the Maimed Hunter is now regarded as the most probable source of danger."

f6b56777-670f-41b9-a0e8-f297ceaeab94.Text: {n}Something strange has occurred to the two women's augmetics — it is as if they have begun to grow inside their flesh, spreading webs of metal around them.{/n}

235719fb-d3a2-48dc-a286-08170717b7d6.Text: "Aishara, that conniving spittle, she silenced our vox-voices." {n}Thorbald tries to revive his caster to no avail.{/n} "By the time we get back to the surface, the Inquisitor's mutts will be gone with their prize."

dee78aca-056f-45b8-9e9c-ebf63d210f93.Text: "Unit Opticon-22 was a worthy representative of the Explorators. On a conceptual level, he perceived martyrdom as equivalent to a definitive success in performing his function of serving the Omnissiah. Expressions of regret are inappropriate, for I estimate that in his final functional moments, he experienced the highest form of pious exultation."

6284ed40-36c9-4e65-a6b6-76edf4de5b05.Text: "Brother... Take my thoughts. I kept them. Keep them now." {n}Her final words are a faint whisper.{/n}

d4b712f2-2de0-44cc-b05e-dbe4766c37c8.Text: "Several of my brothers will carry on fighting their battles in the Allfather's host. The rest have survived. We've shed much of our blood, but a Wolf's hide is tough and his spirit is stubborn — when you take us down, you had better finish us off. The Stormbiters live on this day, and the next!"

d76be5f4-1b3d-4a57-9292-19ffd0e4d48b.Text: "Attempts to slow down the degradation process are irrational, for they only prolong my suffering. I wish to cease to be." {n}Her eyes close.{/n}

8e738760-77bf-4f1b-b005-ed664f89dad4.Text: "He knows." {n}She points at Thorbald.{/n} "He was there."

b1679d4c-a241-434f-9f4b-0300d0476699.Text: {n}Thorbald glances at you in shame.{/n} "She speaks no lies. The first task the Inquisitor gave us in the Expanse was to destroy a cult of tech-heretics. The deed was done. This Amarnat, was he a good priest? Did Calcazar drag us into something foul?"

5da8580a-6621-4331-b84d-4827bf116cca.Text: "I know not. Calcazar's kaerls did not allow anyone into the hidden arsenals. All we could see was them dragging crates up to the surface. 'Tis the age-old way — we fight, they sweep up the spoils." {n}Thorbald grimly nods at the pair of corpses.{/n} "We brought these from below. For all I know, it was his kaerls that killed them to seal their lips."

3e0ee277-0396-4681-ad07-e0f93a779766.Text: {n}You see no signs of violence on the two women's bodies, but their porcelain-white skin proves without a doubt that they are dead. Their hands are clutched together in a death grip.{/n}

4df45391-4efd-4ce6-b71d-924bb0b79938.Text: {n}Pasqal's vox sounds as if a hot metal string just snapped inside:{/n} "This unit is waiting for an explanation."

5527a3a9-ec8b-4bbb-a9e3-93376b389ed4.Text: {n}Thorbald throws up his hands.{/n} "Nothing, I swear on my honour. He disappeared, and so did his ship. There is no blood of his upon our hands."

75b7a387-4b76-4d69-a557-0271bbc4b139.Text: {n}Suddenly, you hear a click inside one of the Tech-Priests' bodies, and her eyes open wide. A spasm shakes her gaunt limbs, making Thorbald clutch his weapon. Her lips twist into a crooked line, forcing out two words:{/n} "The Yoke!"

e7fc1cca-0c43-40a2-8f44-d3172f39c9ce.Text: {n}Pasqal switches to rapid binharic trills, but Axiomantha merely shakes her head. Pasqal demands loudly:{/n} "Our identifiers are identical. State the reason for the duplication."

80657eb0-ff53-4f51-aadb-6fb46ab28021.Text: {n}She closes her eyes and whispers almost deliriously,{/n} "A portent left by the Messiah. A cog pattern in which the righteous may see the Deus Mechanicus."

9768d19e-ea80-4f9e-8344-6277ed1375a0.Text: {n}Pasqal says nothing for a while, then enquires thoughtfully:{/n} "The Maimed Hunter. What are the unit's status and parameters?"

ad7253db-e213-41c8-9900-4401b655cf44.Text: "Coming. Concealed. Proceed with caution, for the Hunter too sees the Messiah's signs."

1cd10635-7899-4207-8497-5ecc2c42d403.Text: "The Geminicrats. The twin Magi who joined their minds in their devotion to Mars. I remember. Proponents of the right to create unificates base their defence on this momentous precedent."

224197c2-10af-482b-958f-29b96519441f.Text: "May Blackmane guide you through the black of night, Ironhide. Know that if your pack calls, the Baleful Howl will always answer!"

14ff021e-3672-4e2d-a412-16141e125b23.Text: "The Cycle will be discontinued, sister." {n}Pasqal speaks the words of the sacred motto with an air of mournful consolation.{/n}

257dc572-c63f-42d0-b691-7646088683a1.Text: "Truly a Wolf's place is among the Wolves!" {n}Ulfar grinds his teeth, no longer hiding his shame and anger.{/n}

80bb6ecc-1985-4809-b2fc-fd22aeaa39f3.Text: {n}All you hear in response is wheezing static.{/n}

0b334f3b-d0b7-4c8d-a7c8-b90e3e9ff1d2.Text: "May the Wolf That Stalks Between Stars keep their departed souls."

8541c4a8-6845-45b8-a972-aa23468b6886.Text: "Something foul. The Inquisitor seeks to use us to obtain a mighty weapon. And that he kept this design even from us, the Allfather's warriors sows suspicion in my heart. Does he keep his lips sealed because he knows that we won't support his game? Does the worm of treason lurk within his mind?"

cdb57c22-9f43-4637-abe9-debb1ddbfb03.Text: "May the winds of the warp drive your drekkar swiftly, Rogue Trader! And may the truth not escape your grip."

549340ae-e5ed-4a3e-82cd-74596735411d.Text: "Creation of unificates is dangerous knowledge that has long since been denounced by many as a procedure not blessed by the Omnissiah. It is based not on a direct prototype envisioned by the precursors, merely on loosely connected technologies."

59e28851-29e0-4aa0-83ba-c61ce3376c30.Text: {n}Ulfar looks away and rumbles heavily,{/n} "I was there too. I fought those judged by Calcazar."

7cd0e351-2ff9-444d-a8e7-70f3b158fa22.Text: "Magos... Axiomantha Haneumann. That is my identifier."

650ace05-87af-4b84-92e5-d6c05787ab1a.Text: {n}Ulfar mutters, his expression as dark as a storm cloud,{/n} "It was not my concern, only another's will. And it was the Chapter's business. I have already told you more about the Wolves than many of my brothers would have said in my place."

32b86f48-5bb1-4471-86c7-1401776fc2b6.Text: "At first he tried to do everything swiftly and quietly, but his agents and the cog-priests loyal to him failed to capture the leader of the tech-heretics. That's when he realised he needed indestructible warriors. He needed us. The cog-kaerls were powerless against the Wolves' might, and we brought carnage to the Explorators' ships and worlds."

283721e3-36a1-4cc7-a681-c5a0cab5136f.Text: {n}Thorbald frowns and says in a hollow voice,{/n} "And yet doubts smother my heart. Did we sully our Chapter's honour with deeds done for a dishonourable end?"

0d39304d-d15d-438f-b3a9-a505939c46b2.Text: {n}Pasqal's mechadendrites snap up in a whirlwind of alarm, and the recorder in his vox activates with a click.{/n} "Initiating interrogation procedure."

19fa2c79-d8c7-4be8-bd7d-f1d761cbca39.Text: "My instinct tells me as much." {n}Thorbald grits his teeth, his face growing grim until it resembles an emotionless stone statue depicting an ancient deity of storms and thunder.{/n}

b958da0d-5dc7-42a8-a2af-ab97945093ea.Text: {n}A violent roar erupts from Ulfar's throat as his face turns red.{/n} "What can you know of what it's like for a warrior of the Allfather to be among mortals? You are my battle comrades, you're almost a pack to me! But you do not carry Russ's blessing, you are not of my blood! You think I enjoy keeping my mouth shut about the Wolves' secrets? You think I come from secretive schemers whose thoughts crawl and slither like vipers? It disgusts me!"

8889670f-a2c8-48a1-9cd7-53c0b6dbd4fb.Text: "Thank you." {n}Ulfar looks away, and you can just make out the string of Fenrisian curses he utters. You can surmise who their intended addressee is.{/n}

1a8a8f2e-6a15-4ed9-a347-a5186ac1a7d0.Text: {n}Pasqal utters coldly,{/n} "Unit Ulfar claims that he was a tool in another's hands. This statement has been archived. Then let every tool be treated as befits its function."

836be6f6-b664-4fc3-a2ec-6cb35d6b8b5e.Text: "Yes." {n}Her agreement comes easily, with a weak smile.{/n} "Ethics are an insubstantial construct of emotion. I acted logically. I continued to comprehend rather than terminate my vital functions."

0eecf3ed-5752-49e3-a1f8-8bb980c2cfd5.Text: {n}Ulfar responds quietly and sullenly,{/n} "You are a worthy ally. I never meant you or your brethren harm, cog-priest."

74efbf0e-1b9d-4aee-b7af-28c1ea5cc609.Text: "The sweet scent of rotten meat prickles my nostrils. But it is not the fallen bodies I smell, it's the hands of the Inquisitor's minions."

865ada83-75cf-46b2-b5d1-1d4756a42d2a.Text: "'Tis what my instinct tells me too. My heart never had a strong faith in Calcazar's words before, but now whatever phantom trust I had is scattering into smoke. We must ask questions and get the answers. By force, if that is the way it has to be." {n}Both Wolves affirm the last words with fervent and murderous nods.{/n}

2c0fb5d5-e6df-4f5d-beb1-b084ce9c9bbb.Text: {n}The Tech-Priest responds with a faint and enigmatic smile.{/n} "You have found yourself at the centre of a tangle of paradoxicality."

5a0a23cb-8c87-44ac-b893-82da2041a5d2.Text: "She was me. A phenomenon of flesh divided me into two identical bodies at birth. The Omnissiah's wisdom let me overcome this physiological flaw by braiding the separated mind. I was the first unificate in the Fleet."

893125f9-1f1c-4ad9-a060-d85fb6d74f85.Text: "Reading the unit's Noospheric signature. No evidence of corruption registered in the algorithms. Detecting substantial logical disruptions within the augments. Threat level: low."

6d480847-03db-4c8c-a5b0-365efda8d60d.Text: "I was never his servant. I was forced to serve. When our circle was broken, he offered me a choice: submit or die. He threatened to kill half of me if I refused to forge for him. He needed Archmagos Amarnat's knowledge, and I had it. I saw no sense in resisting."

71c24995-81ca-4740-9310-c84c3be38b95.Text: "Her True Flesh has betrayed her and become a heavy burden of metal within her body, something that is not of the Omnissiah's design. Something devoid of function." {n}Pasqal speaks the last words with audible disgust and sorrow.{/n}

b80b5fa4-3621-494e-8422-8a64c3588a47.Text: {n}After this less than coherent response, Pasqal continues sharply,{/n} "I seek Archmagos Amarnat. Where is he?"

1522002a-1070-41c8-bba7-1eb671c51558.Text: "If you wish to know more, then hurry. The turning of the cog will soon cease."

f57be00b-ee72-4014-8e03-413035559fe5.Text: "Reconstruction... impossible." {n}The woman's whisper is barely audible, but the weak voice that is coming from her pale lips still sounds more alive than the mechanical hiss of a vox.{/n}

7b4ee4b0-d44e-4914-9f7c-f9ffa5e98a6d.Text: "No corruption... only damage." {n}The woman's whisper is barely audible, but the weak voice that is coming from her pale lips still sounds more alive than the mechanical hiss of a vox.{/n}

2acd5daa-d7cd-428a-80d0-d252e5350dc1.Text: "The shelter has fallen. The Maimed Hunter... comes. Cessation of vital functions inevitable." {n}Her eyes momentarily roll back, but then a metallic chirr inside her chest brings her back to consciousness.{/n}

d8cd7060-c587-4e4d-b06b-62afebdcbafb.Text: "Get me a healer priest! We have heavily wounded here!" {n}Thorbald roars his command into the vox, but there is no immediate response.{/n}

1973f8fc-d1b0-43e1-ba19-c75e26e5f391.Text: {n}A pained shadow falls across her face.{/n} "The chapel was attacked. The preservation protocol commanded me to hide within the inner artefactorium and block all outside access to it. Prolonged presence in close proximity to the object was prohibited by the algorithm, but the preservation protocol had a higher priority. The object... affected me. I resisted. Resistance led to structural change."

8a97a92e-351a-4fbc-b12e-7f3392897e78.Text: "The Yoke. The weapon we forged at the Lord Inquisitor's command. The destroyer of worlds."

bd3ce74b-2838-4a51-89e3-ba118e57e0d9.Text: "An enigma. The project was kept secret from everyone, including the smiths. We forged fragments of it... It was a tool for controlling energies of staggering power, and it was not the Omnissiah's blessed gifts that served as its foundation. It was forbidden knowledge, knowledge that we comprehended."

bc586018-4442-4212-969d-426738b8e257.Text: "Let them celebrate their trifling victory. Little do they know that the Truth has already triumphed, in {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_Eufrates_ChampionOfChaos}bringing forth a mighty champion{/d}." {n}Unseen to anyone but you, Uralon's image surveys the bodies of two lean, scarlet-robed women lying on the floor.{/n} "The lot of the weak is to lay down their worthless lives to pave the way for the strong to ascend their thrones."

ecd27f52-a191-405c-9ef6-1b9a5890e33e.Text: {n}Uralon chuckles.{/n} "The Inquisitor's servants are raising it to the surface as we speak. The full extent of its might is unknown even to me. In the right hands, it will lay the foundation of a new era in which the Great Four will reign in the Expanse as their champion's effort bears fruit. Your effort." {n}Uralon nods toward the two corpses.{/n} "These priestesses knew about the weapon but perished before I was able to get the truth about its nature out of them."

e614cc17-db75-4dd3-a608-4fa771356a49.Text: "A difficult thing to explain... to a {mf|layman|laywoman}. Metamorphosis phenomena occur in the object's vicinity. Sacred technology and even ordinary plasteel start to behave... wilfully. Shifting, restructuring, and altering their fundamental attributes."

7db898b3-63c3-4607-8836-5199c27278f0.Text: "It's difficult... to process... Have I fulfilled my duty to the Omnissiah? May I rest now?" {n}She looks through you as though she can no longer see you.{/n}

72e22f75-adc1-4981-8130-9e4a861f1d41.Text: "This place was a shelter. The Lord Inquisitor hid me here... and not only me." {n}A high-pitched groan of pain interrupts her words.{/n} "The Maimed Hunter... A figure of termination, an unknown variable. Amarnat's nemesis. I never met them, but I inferred their existence based on statistical evidence and logical conclusions. The portents of entropy foretell that the Hunter is near."

c9373ea7-f338-4cac-8041-435d5e908afa.Text: {n}There is not a single wound upon her white skin, but there is no doubt that she will soon perish. Her augmetics are failing as if they have been sabotaged by some entropic influence. For a moment you consider it a sign of tech-blight, but then you refute the thought — what you are witnessing is not decay, but transformation of the matter from which the Tech-Priest's True Flesh is made.{/n}

e1aaa06d-15b8-432a-a488-29d369bad87b.Text: "I was... a disciple of the Messiah of Discontinuing. When he was laid low, I found myself here. I hid from my reckoning. I reached out to the Omnissiah's wisdom as I pondered and considered. Logic revealed much to me even here, in my prison."

066c2690-f628-495f-b5f5-d759268f87d1.Text: {n}There is not a single wound upon her white skin. You cannot understand the reason, but she is most certainly dying, like a wilting metal flower.{/n}

f69b640f-c2a3-4dca-aa0c-1ac83baed0cf.Text: "The unit lacks clear answers. Her cognitive abilities have been damaged, but analytical data suggests a... higher validity to our identifiers being an exact match. It is not a consequence of malicious falsification. It is more akin to an act of purposeful direction."

862cbc7d-6fc6-41a0-b105-7eb500259c95.Text: "Now this half of me is dead. The rest of my mind... is fading. The sympathetic principle is insurmountable." {n}The Tech-Priest closes her eyes and starts whispering something incomprehensible, sinking deeper into the depths of oblivion.{/n}

7e5c7068-1723-45c8-9d0a-fd7912e9890b.Text: "Are my words obscure? That is regrettable. Processing becomes difficult when you only have one half of your mind. Certain notions, data, and logical instruments were left... in the less functional part of me."

5799d44e-947a-43e2-a2fa-8b9b188b5f3f.Text: "His petty desires and ridiculous thirst for revenge obscured the Truth from his eyes. He chose his sacrificial destiny himself when he strayed from the path charted for him and allowed his failures to make way for you, champion."

1529782d-2ee9-4025-a14f-0f7fa2491c55.Text: "Against... anyone. Its power is absolute. The first experiments with this tech-relic were calamitous. The tech-blight... is merely its echo. Its potential is so much greater." {n}She stops, as if frightened by her own words.{/n} "It never should have fallen into the hands of the laity, but the Lord Inquisitor stole it. Its secret was procured beyond the dimensional gate, beneath the dark stars, and passed over to Amarnat. Calcazar destroyed the Messiah of Discontinuing and robbed him. And claimed the secret for himself."

217dffbd-70ed-4573-adcf-4bd89d7346a6.Text: {n}Suddenly something clicks inside the body of one of the Omnissiah's servants. Her eyes open wide. A cramp runs through her thin lips. Her lips twist in an arch. A single word escapes them:{/n} "Yoke!"

7749e70d-7d4a-45e0-b101-6f2709cec003.Text: "I never even knew there was a weapon! I was told of traitors, and I tracked them down! I claimed no trophies, I had no part in any dark intrigues! You think I would have wished that sneaky, scheming viper to get his hands on something so powerful? I wouldn't even trust him with my axe!"

e825e0a3-c5a4-40ac-87db-ddc7a744e8a2.Text: "Imagine yourself gazing upon a surface of water that was disturbed by a stone an era ago, but the ripples never stop coming. That is what it felt like. The object propagated echoes of change."

7775e5ee-383e-4205-a2e7-4189b6377e6a.Text: "Wait. The manufactorum's dungeons are vast. I will lie low in them and bide my time until the moment comes for me to appear before you in the flesh again. And while I wait, I will work on this world from the inside to prepare it to accept the Truth when the time is due. One does not need armies to open the world's eyes: all it takes is to sow the seeds of corruption and wait for them to sprout of their own accord."

1ea77e1a-8df8-4055-8ed3-dbe38f97f600.Text: "We were continuing the work of our mentor, Archmagos Amarnat. It was his wisdom that made our toils possible." {n}Axiomantha's words render Pasqal speechless.{/n}

7cb4f103-f1ad-4e84-a23b-c10041f0f83a.Text: {n}The servant of the Omnissiah freezes for a moment. You hear mechanical clicks and binharic chirring, as though unseen mechanisms in her body are struggling to run a diagnostic. After a while, the sounds die down.{/n}

c1aa1591-d6a8-4c7d-842f-26ee8e9a3f02.Text: "Go forth, champion. May the Truth guide you."

a0432ede-2cc9-4595-823a-84d1bf3b619c.Text: "You are wasting your effort, champion. The Inquisitor's minions have jammed the vox-transmitters. By the time you reach the surface, his people will have slipped away with the Yoke. But worry not, for this is an outcome the Edge of Daybreak has already told you about. It will be the beginning of your ascent, not an impediment."

8a22e42a-cbae-40a6-ba15-811d28e01ec4.Text: "Intertwining probabilities that will give rise to a new era. The Inquisitor has used you to obtain a weapon with the power to obliterate entire worlds. Or rather a part of that weapon. He knew he was crossing the line, so he concealed his plan even from his allies: both you and the pups who called themselves Wolves. You should follow and track him, champion. The Inquisitor will likely attempt to complete the weapon and that will be the true moment of your triumph. For, when it is completed, you are going to take it."

01716ff1-b71c-44a0-831e-aaf7370bbbbd.Text: "He knew." {n}The woman points her finger at Thorbald's body.{/n} "He was there."

94f23707-10e8-4b06-bc4a-e6a469e377f0.Text: {n}Pasqal spews an angry tirade in binharic and glares at the fallen Angel of the Emperor.{/n} "Why is it that even the most capable of laypeople can never be reliable sources of information?"

7db95661-845f-4c47-bba3-df36e9ad6f67.Text: {n}Heinrix casts a grim glance at the mighty warriors, but does not contradict them, either out of agreement, or doubt about his survival were he to raise an objection.{/n}

80c391b0-8e4b-45ff-862d-ddafe837cd59.Text: {n}Heinrix shakes his head in amazement.{/n} "A yoke? A means of restraint... It sounds like a project on a grand, planetary scale — and this is the first I'm hearing of it. Perhaps there was a hidden purpose to my assignment besides combatting the cult and accompanying you, {name}. But why?"

40e75672-6939-4d13-926b-8c8134c2afa9.Text: {n}Clicks are heard in the ensuing silence. For a while now, Heinrix has been trying to bring his vox-transmitter back to life — to no avail, judging by the twist to his mouth.{/n}

a6659456-bfaf-40de-9daf-87e1d1b2c265.Text: "The warp take me, what kind of ordeal has the Lord Inquisitor really dragged you into?" {n}Abelard shakes his head.{/n} "Never mind. But what am I talking about? Calcazar's links to House von Valancius obviously go back to your predecessor's time. There is no telling what other secrets Lady Theodora took with her..."

7ba8d79e-4140-40d0-a7b9-ce55c9734f15.Text: "Knowledge will not have the capacity to be absolute until the coming of the Omnissiah. We do not know of such pre-technology, but can we claim with certainty that it never existed? Do you remember stories about—"

f6fddec5-3d94-4933-91f8-ad28e65f1dc3.Text: {n}Uralon bares his teeth.{/n} "How I long to see the moment when you cast off your mask as a {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_MOT_GreatDeed}'hero of the Imperium'{/d} and let your true power show. Your redoubtable reputation will make your betrayal all the more bitter and unexpected to the corpse emperor's servants. Do not lament the loss of your former renown, for a different kind will take its place, one more befitting a champion."

4d9635da-4dbc-471b-bf5a-f20f4bfe801f.Text: {n}After taking a closer look, you realise that every augment seems to have begun... mutating, developing new forms and functions not envisioned by their creators. It seems probable that this is what caused their demise.{/n}

bebf0807-cc9e-4a35-b498-00523a078cca.Text: Eufrates II lies before you, ravaged by corruption and drained by war. The Skitarii cohorts have boarded the shuttles, and the valiant militia of the Koronus Expanse are inspecting their weapons for the last time before deployment. The fearsome Space Wolves frigate, bristling with weapons, stands ready to unleash its deadly force upon the world overrun with heretics.

07d1e544-20f5-4efc-9f1d-853d1d1ce10d.Text: Shaken by what is to come, Eufrates II awaits its harsh pacification.

dd770005-5927-47e7-aa09-bd7467b00065.Text: This abominable weapon once adorned the hand of the Helbrute known as Doomscream, the heinous champion of the Word Bearers Legion. The monster's hand was severed in the heat of battle, and the remains of the corrupted bolter were used to forge a new, more compact weapon. The malevolent spirit dwelling within this dark relic demands that the sacred unguents used to appease it must be mixed with the fresh blood of innocents.

10ab3548-994d-4d32-9eb8-771c311963d8.Text: "I wish to remind you that the Lord Inquisitor entrusted me with overseeing this war. You will show respect for my status."

920e6562-015d-41d9-84fa-517fee0dd509.Text: "Opticon-22, how did you go from overseeing logistics to commanding armies?"

b0bce338-f1d0-42b6-aa1a-ac6b4f6d32e0.Text: "Answer me this, Thorbald: if Opticon-22 were to come to Fenris and start ordering you around, what would you do?"

31e1b8eb-19b8-4230-80af-af2dbb47534c.Text: "Thorbald is right. However destructive the assault might end up being, it will be nothing compared to the damage that every moment of our hesitation does to the planet."

021415ba-51f8-4477-aeb0-b2d5e978714b.Text: "You are looking at {name} von Valancius, Thorbald Ironhide."

62b637ab-41e4-47d0-9031-c85e43f22c16.Text: "Heresy runs rampant on Eufrates II, and you two would rather waste all your strength on bickering? Then you are nothing but fools!"

895d61ca-be0d-477c-9b82-d29a8d7f6a9a.Text: "I have heard enough petty quarrels for one day."

92d4464c-9865-48dc-b88f-ddae06ad5cd2.Text: "I shall now present to you the plan of our assault on Eufrates II."

2d23428e-509c-4824-918c-9d80227c6fc5.Text: "Why have you still not commenced a planetary assault?"

981765a1-b68f-4592-a29a-15941405ee86.Text: "Opticon-22, what do you propose our plan should be?"

7f7061f2-ab85-46f4-84a5-e8a391f8336c.Text: "Thorbald, what would you do if you were in command of this operation?"

9a6e7fde-06d9-4f59-9e9a-bd2357dbd92e.Text: "I require a full report on the situation at the front."

153aedd5-2933-4df9-a5dd-b4faf479d621.Text: "I have heard your opinions on this."

418c222d-aff7-48b6-bc51-417cbd1213da.Text: "What we require is total annihilation. Raze every sacred facility and chapel that our enemies could use as cover."

b1e9a982-93c6-4f51-8b41-676c39461388.Text: "We will begin by bombarding the enemy's positions, then advance cautiously. We must conserve our troops."

417deed3-1455-4546-9487-f75ff6f90bed.Text: "Send in all our forces even if it means sustaining heavy losses. A swift onslaught is key to our victory!"

6c2ea93e-fc85-4de2-8ef4-136b37c4fed8.Text: "Opticon-22, I must say my curiosity is piqued. The Explorators are hiding something on that planet, something you refused to show to anyone and are now loath to destroy. What is it?"

1da4f71a-180e-4b82-bb5a-5c3f0496268d.Text: "And what are your responsibilities as a special operative?"

3479fb23-a0e8-4501-b1d3-bc492be666f7.Text: "There will be no spitting aboard my ship. Do I make myself clear, esteemed Lord Thorbald?"

1a72ce8b-1b51-4405-b19d-9006047f1771.Text: "You two do not get along too well, do you?"

04d2d7d1-56cb-4c92-85a3-8fae64a640e9.Text: "What troops can you spare to reinforce our army?"

0564601c-1408-4b95-b144-62562b178179.Text: {n}The leader of the Explorator warriors appears on the bridge, and the deck trembles beneath his metal gait. He has acquired a new set of fearsome armour since the two of you last met, and his mechadendrites are now fitted with more formidable weapons of destruction.{/n} "Unit Opticon-22 initiating //identification//official greeting// procedure. Unlocking the option of strategic data exchange."

b3faeee0-ee33-40f2-9691-2d9917485bcc.Text: {n}The Emperor's Angel who follows in his wake is clad in armour the colour of a tempestuous ocean. You hear his voice, throaty and brimming with untamed boldness and strength:{/n} "Which one of you huskaerls is {name} von Valancius? I am Thorbald Ironhide, and I wish to see the mortal who has been granted the honour of leading my pack into battle."

50456259-d6ad-4f66-9f5d-5b84c11268bc.Text: "The Lord Inquisitor entrusted me with the task of forging an alliance between the assembled fleet and the forces of the Cognisance Fleet. Once this task is complete, I am to act as an observer and a special operative."

10b10536-d89c-4617-8c13-92a955b932f3.Text: "This //command promotion//hierarchy status update// was executed following the //death//decommissioning//deconstruction// of the ship Teeth of the Wrathgear. The fleet's war conclave was operating aboard that vessel. Unit Opticon-22 received premature //rank promotion//modernisation// to Magos Dominus based on his extensive catalogue of recorded combat engagements."

038d2b5c-59c9-4618-95a5-7d4b12c7abd0.Text: "May your service benefit from the updated protocols that were bestowed upon you and the new analytical data that was entrusted to your elucidation."

0b4c94bd-312d-47c6-9136-b9420c7d6788.Text: "May the Omnissiah //guide//operate// this unit in his //cause//mission//algorithm// of service to Him."

755f1058-0194-47b9-9fb9-adf0c00d7c03.Text: "So shall we begin our war council, or shall we wait for heretics to corrupt this planet completely?"

089d4f91-5785-44eb-ac00-c8b876d85314.Text: "I happen to have some experience with large-scale bloodshed, Rogue Trader. That, and I never fail to deliver results."

da1d5a4b-1d53-495f-bf7d-78e5b8fecac3.Text: "The militia forces have already been transferred to Opticon-22. All I have left under my command is a tactical unit explicitly instructed to carry out the Lord Inquisitor's special assignments."

20ea3d2d-f311-4efb-899e-53f523d82712.Text: {n}Thorbald takes the measure of you and nods in satisfaction.{/n} "I know the habits of a warrior when I see one. You're no indolent hjokke. Good! I give my approval — we will hunt the baseborn heretics together."

4b5fc52d-da5b-4f00-baf6-cab869589e29.Text: "The Lord Inquisitor will be delighted at the news that some semblance of order was established in the command. I wish you luck, Rogue Trader."

892ce181-25da-4225-a394-f1e860f818a8.Text: "Fenris would never need to be liberated from the Archenemy's servants! Wolf blood is indomitable! And you, {name}, should choose your words carefully lest you provoke my anger!"

4e659704-fef8-4b0e-b46a-5ed46a808b8f.Text: "You have not changed, Brother Thorbald — high-handed and brazen without measure, and you carry yourself on another's drekkar like it is your own."

68145f37-910c-492e-bfc6-aa11b416638e.Text: {n}The Wolf bursts into booming laughter and bares his long fangs.{/n} "Such is the breed of leaders, Ulfar. We stand out. 'Tis you, Everlost, who cannot find his way when the sun is right over his head." {n}Another explosion of Thorbald's boisterous laughter drowns out Ulfar's stifled yet furious string of curses.{/n}

eaa6a1ff-a8a4-4d35-85ce-b39b8882d347.Text: {n}Thorbald's face turns purple, but he cannot come up with a retort. Opticon-22 lowers his head repentantly and lets out a binharic trill. Neither of them can find the words to rebuff your pointed accusation.{/n}

040b4560-fb7f-457c-9ef6-2c39ae7d6ddb.Text: "What good is another war council with a cog-priest who knows not the joys of battle, who cut off his parts and replaced them with augments to please his all-knowing master? He will propose again a cowardly plan unworthy of warriors as is the custom of his brethren—"

02c30b5a-dbcc-45e8-a9ef-964ec0b73ea5.Text: "Registering a display of //impertinence//data insufficiency// in regard to the //military craft//eradication methods// of the Adeptus Mechanicus."

d72f71a5-f246-4267-9339-2b4abf3bc8bd.Text: "There is a //conflict//critical error//categorical lack of understanding of the imperatives of this operation// within our chain of command. Unit Thorbald Ironhide is in favour of the strategy of mass destruction, which would constitute an unacceptable violation of the Rite of Operation. Every square metre of the manufactorums is //sacred//of high productivity value//."

da0f0207-df61-444f-ad12-3946795a9f9a.Text: "Which is why the cog-priest is so intent on hindering and sabotaging our assault by refusing us forces and landing drekkars. But Thorbald Ironhide won't fight on the terms of priests! If my battle plan is rejected, the Omnissiah's servants can retake the planet themselves! Maybe they think their lives mean nothing compared to their precious cathedrals, but a Wolf knows what his life is worth!"

f5d16fe8-065e-4fcb-93fe-e3e4bb39dc40.Text: "I'm afraid the Lord Inquisitor did not give me the authority to elaborate on this matter."

598c3870-6d0b-4ecd-a1c3-4239c2577622.Text: "Our strategic analysis points toward a full-scale offensive as the optimal course of action. The losses among the //troops//insignificant personnel//laity// will be numerous but will not exceed acceptable parameters. Replenishing such losses will be less arduous than repairing the damage that may otherwise come to the manufactorums."

4d1ce76b-1879-41fa-ac26-4e1ad083a2a4.Text: "Eufrates II is a forge world. Manufactorums and extractiums take up most of its surface. Upon //corrupting them//disrupting their production algorithm//, the heretics enhanced their ranks with possessed mechanisms and //false//defective//traitorous// Skitarii whose protocols were disfigured with indoctrinating scrap-code."

705193fc-087b-4547-bb22-6b3818562226.Text: "We may outnumber the enemy, but ours is a poor warband. All it has is steel kaerls of the Omnissiah and scantly trained serfs from across the Expanse. While our foe is the detestable but nevertheless deadly putrid-hearted traitors from the ranks of the Word Bearers. And their vessels protect the Machine Cathedral from orbit."

94b971ac-c2d1-443f-847f-a66d4a67f3d4.Text: "Choose your strategy wisely. It's not every day you get to heed the advice of a seasoned warrior, one chosen by the Allfather himself to bring death to the foes of Humanity."

8780b79b-8111-438d-910d-a310d12f3129.Text: "Analysing... This statement is true. The consequences of the heretical //corruption//disruption of the procedural cycle// are nearing critical levels. In order to prevent them from surpassing those levels, Unit Opticon-22 is prepared to nullify certain protocols related to preservation of //sacred relics//high-priority production facilities//."

81dd4952-e1d2-456f-aa9b-5502731d6bcb.Text: {n}The Space Wolf bellows with unpleasant laughter.{/n} "I would like to see him try... Fine, I hear you. No one will accuse Thorbald Ironhide of disrespecting the masters of the house where he arrived as a guest. You will hear no more arguing from me — only silence. I will kill the heretics in the manner chosen by the esteemed cog-priest."

7658461a-3183-4f48-8256-89e500fa06bc.Text: {n}Thorbald looks down on you with an expression of wry amusement. Opticon-22 is silent, but you can still feel the disapproval in the rattles coming from his vox.{/n}

40b1a021-6799-4b44-b495-4069b02bfd09.Text: "The first step is obvious — we eliminate the Machine Cathedral's orbital support. But what planetary assault strategy will you choose following the destruction of the enemy void fleet?"

012a0648-28e4-49d9-9c48-2d6b09fb8247.Text: "Your plan bores me. This is not the Space Wolves' way of war. But such cowardly strategies are the limit of the Omnissiah's cog-kaerls, so you have my approval."

dbbde200-e757-441f-9032-d7a61c43b202.Text: "Ha! The Space Wolves respect a good onslaught! Your huskaerls better be loyal enough to charge into the fire without faltering!"

c31e2afa-e30f-4e26-8de4-595da6fd8bd8.Text: "Strategy confirmed as optimal. Updating the Skitarii tactical programs. Transmitting this unit's general //blessing//authorisation// for offensive action."

cb32621a-9df3-404f-89d0-8480085a06f8.Text: {n}Opticon-22's vox rasps mournfully,{/n} "Complying. Correcting primary mission parameters. Removing immunity status from the //sacred//formerly sacred// facilities on the surface of Eufrates II."

15cb777b-24c6-44b7-bdbe-a3ef95a0bc05.Text: "My pack will do all that is asked of it and stand at the vanguard of the assault. Until we meet on the field of battle, {name}." {n}Thorbald looks at Ulfar with a smirk.{/n} "And I say the same to you, Ulfar Everlost. 'Tis a pity your pack will not share in this glorious victory with us."

c62fa4b8-56b7-4c0e-b5df-b2002a115d34.Text: {n}Ulfar lets out a bestial grumble and says to you,{/n} "That boastful grizhof talks too much about my pack. He knows where my brothers are, I can smell it. Before we dive into the carnage, summon him to your ship and let me question him — I wish to hear what he knows... while he still has not lost his blathering tongue to the heretics."

8627f816-cf9e-40df-bfcd-47c9021fde12.Text: {n}Thorbald merely scoffs in response, and Opticon-22 produces a short binharic litany. Despite their united displeasure at your words, they do not look at all conciliated.{/n}

c1c0e4cd-3c23-4c10-8990-233354d3c454.Text: "Now let us move on to discussing how we intend to kill the heretics."

b5b58ae8-60c7-4c71-af95-ca5d28e3602a.Text: "The Lord Inquisitor will be pleased to learn that his authority was not questioned at this war council."

4b53e6d9-e8cd-49ca-9a20-d76012cb3ec2.Text: {n}Thorbald's face reddens, and he rumbles in a hollow voice,{/n} "I do not wish us to feud on the eve of battle. Very well. The Wolves will fight the way the cog-priest deems fit."

bb063608-a65b-4294-9238-b196f15ad112.Text: "Request approved. Unit {name} von Valancius is authorised to issue decisions of the highest execution priority. Unit Opticon-22 standing by for instructions."

612d618d-9c63-482d-b0b4-773d9669ba54.Text: "Analysing... This statement is false. The sacred assembly halls require machine //healing//repairs//, not further destruction." {n}Opticon-22 lowers his head in an unrelenting gesture.{/n}

a38b55fa-1080-4085-9656-9900d0d581c6.Text: "Complying. Updating the Skitarii tactical programs, transferring the least //valuable//enlightened// units to the first wave of offence. Estimating a high percentage of //losses//disposal// among the support personnel."

35373fd3-d41a-4690-9d05-9bbf84715db7.Text: "What's this? A show of character?" {n}Thorbald growls and locks his indignant gaze with yours.{/n} "Fine, I will respect your wishes, warlord. But the bitter taste of suspicion burns my mouth." {n}With pointed contempt, he steps away from Aishara.{/n}

c5a919f4-be36-471d-8726-8fd261a0283a.Text: "Hear, hear! I can smell your killer instinct, {name}! Let us break their spirit!"

d8516dd4-af4d-4403-a147-3b3770f38dc5.Text: "Rein in the impudent priest while there's still time. Or this battle will end in disgraceful defeat."

5c877248-5da9-4797-a145-dee11b011ff5.Text: {n}{d|Encyclopedia:Conviction_Heretical3OrMore}A silky whisper weaves words{/d} into a kind of unholy pattern in your mind:{/n} "Minions of a false god. Blind in their faith. No unity among them. They will never learn the Truth... but you will. I will show you the path, Child of the Dawn, but in order to walk that path, you must hide our intentions behind a facade of loyalty to the corpse emperor. For now, learn about the false believers' plan and prepare. Now is the time to listen. The time to act will come later, and when it comes, I will tell you."

1bda2e3c-d61e-4c2b-810a-b8697c643145.Text: {n}Aishara raises an eyebrow and chuckles.{/n} "My presence here is entirely unaffected by your approval or your objections, Rogue Trader. But I'm pleased to know you endorse my appointment to this position."

ac2fb438-9a7c-41b9-9674-7e2a1d067218.Text: {n}The Tech-Priest's vox creaks stubbornly:{/n} "Request denied. The Omnissiah's //mysteries//procedures// conducted on Eufrates II are to remain undisclosed according to the //protocol//vow// of preservation of the hallowed from the profane."

b7fc7906-244f-4be0-a2a7-b91954497051.Text: "This is why on Fenris we have the priests follow the warriors, not the other way around. The priests never think about the battle ahead, only their tenets and taboos. But a Wolf — a Wolf must think only of battle and his enemy's death, not about preserving cathedrals or counting the trophies that await him."

976c89fd-799d-4acc-8e36-b0a6676026d4.Text: {n}Aishara casts a suspicious glance at you.{/n} "An interesting reaction, Rogue Trader. Not the kind of reception I've had anywhere else. Granted, I am an acolyte of the Inquisition, but I haven't even begun to get inside your head yet, or indeed considered it. Perhaps some other time. We have work to do right now."

3bfec101-cec7-473c-adc9-5d14f130da53.Text: {n}A cackle comes from inside your head.{/n} "Only you can hear my voice, Child. Do not talk to me. Just pay attention." {n}You feel the intruding presence recede to the periphery of your mind, to bide its time there.{/n}

f344d243-66ea-4e03-ac65-9f50830230d8.Text: {n}You feel the intrusive presence recede to the periphery of your mind, to bide its time there.{/n}

6bad7e0c-6802-425d-a720-a90021a0c930.Text: {n}The unholy cackle fills your mind again.{/n} "The travails of mortals are so amusing. Wandering in the dark, ignorant of the paths open to them and of their own fate. How pathetic! They are not your equals, for you know your way. It is a path littered with the bodies of believers in the Truth: an acceptable sacrifice in the name of your future greatness."

60444ba5-dce5-461e-bace-bb2e94f153a3.Text: "But in order for the threads of chance to allow us to meet and for you to fulfil your purpose, you must bring along the blade shards that wove our destinies together. Goodbye, Child of the Dawn. I will be waiting for you." {n}The voice is gone again, dissolved in the echoes of other people's thoughts.{/n}

658479f4-5613-4a14-b205-21bc3dc8dcad.Text: {n}Heinrix and Aishara exchange glances, but do not say a word. You cannot help but notice the furrow that forms on the Interrogator's forehead at the sight of his colleague.{/n}

887591a8-1189-497c-950d-92f1effacc5a.Text: "Are you having another fight, gentlemen? How predictable." {n}A woman in heavy armour walks onto the bridge cloaked in an air of superiority. You remember seeing her before — in the retinue of Xavier Calcazar when he barged into your chambers after your Magnae Accessio.{/n} "Thank you for not starting without me. Acolyte Aishara, dispatched by the Lord Inquisitor to facilitate the operation on Eufrates II. My role on this war council is that of an advisor."

9d62fdbe-e26d-4b39-9042-013e45b75dd9.Text: {n}The woman's words are drowned out by your growing headache: irritation, contempt, and disappointment rack your mind like a three-tailed whip, accompanied by a hundred {d|Encyclopedia:Conviction_Heretical3OrMore}furious whispers{/d}{/n}: "The time of daybreak is almost upon us, and you have failed to make the correct choice at the crossroads of fate! The Truth that is hidden from the unseeing minions of the corpse emperor could have illuminated your sight, granted you... boundless freedom. But you proved to be weak. You would not fight, you would not listen... A child unworthy of the Truth. A {mf|blind boy|lost girl} unworthy of freedom!" {n}The alien presence melts away from your awareness like sticky sludge, no longer willing to waste its word on one such as you.{/n}

6b8f26ea-fb70-4e3d-be03-3fc779788e2c.Text: {n}Thorbald raises his gaze to look at your psyber-raven circling over the bridge. The Wolf smiles broadly.{/n} "On Fenris, only the worthiest are granted the company of such creatures. Since you have the will to handle one, your courage must rival that of a Rune Priest. The two of us should see eye to eye."

b38f6022-87d7-4c0c-b140-2e9e2d10dd48.Text: "I would rain down vengeful skies upon the enemy. I would plough the land of Eufrates II with shells, shatter their defences, level the fortified towers, throw their host into disarray... And in that whirlwind of fury, I would lead my glorious pack to pave a path of blood for the cog-kaerls."

6779c996-a01b-4a22-bf1c-1ccf5e659aa9.Text: "Our forces have secured minor footholds on the surface but are unable to deliver an effective blow to the //headquarters//operations centre// of the profaners in the Machine Cathedral at the heart of Manufactorum Sigma-S-13. According to the available data, it is the current location of the //arch-heretic//termination target// — the {g|Encyclopedia:DarkApostle}Dark Apostle{/g} Uralon the Cruel."

b393b27d-1987-450b-b10c-957f7be76b0a.Text: "There is no surprise in my heart — the Inquisition is, as always, too ashamed of its dark deeds to reveal them to honourable fighters." {n}Thorbald makes a show of spitting on the floor.{/n}

29cd3885-9cf0-47ab-8f0b-75598c0d1aee.Text: "You read hearts like they're inscribed with runes, {name}." {n}Thorbald lets out a mocking chuckle.{/n} "'Tis true, my brothers and I grow tired of this cog-priest and his naysaying. For whatever reason, he thinks himself our lord."

6ec352f8-500b-449e-9faa-6fa01b1b3644.Text: "I concur with this statement. Given that the //military action//sacred purgative crusade//eradication procedure// is taking place on a world devoted to the Machine God, Unit Opticon-22 insists on his privileged status in the matter of strategy selection."

174cff54-ef30-49de-8385-d2bd13e8c9aa.Text: "Did you think these words would fill me with fear? The Wolves are here because we wish to bring death to the heretics, not because your Lord Inquisitor commands it."

03d33ad2-5b29-4e12-a756-611ba9e3d43d.Text: "Request denied. Unit Xavier Calcazar lacks the authority to determine the fate of a sacred Adeptus Mechanicus world."

79c12005-cfd8-403e-8eeb-6f814cfd76a2.Text: "What is Uralon after? What is he trying to unearth?"

6ce7c439-36a0-4856-9f57-beba7f6ad51b.Text: "Ulfar, we set out to hunt the beast."

6c68eabf-50d3-4ede-8999-fc96b95ece50.Text: "Whom did you send your brothers after?"

a3ac2592-663e-45d6-bc9c-999b86bb520e.Text: "What manner of witchcraft was he attempting back there?"

1f508d86-ae61-4e0e-8e9a-7fe7806caf95.Text: "I do not approve of this plan."

9f485ba7-860e-4656-ac59-cbd03922a797.Text: "If Ulfar kills Doomscream, will that prove that the Baleful Howl lives?"

2210ab94-9201-4bdd-b199-930bdf73de83.Text: "For the Emperor! Watch yourselves out there."

a8521360-c7ed-4995-98bc-650f0c91532e.Text: "A glorious fight awaits! Take heed with the silver-tongued traitor, for he is old, sly, and strong. But, by the Allfather, the Wolves will spill rivers of his blood today!" {n}The horrific display of profane sorcery appears to have filled Thorbald with joy and anticipation rather than fear.{/n}

336ae0c4-cd53-44a8-85c9-1c3d2e3a692a.Text: "Do not ask, for I know not myself. Calcazar treats his allies like a Fenrisian mushroom farmer treats his produce — he keeps them in the dark and feeds them shit. He didn't see fit to enlighten us about the secrets of Eufrates II, but 'tis no matter. Whatever it is, we mustn't let the loathsome malefic claim it."

6dffca3b-158c-4597-a31c-848fc6071b15.Text: "Halbrandt, you stick to the original plan! Take two brothers and go after Doomscream. Our scouts report that he took refuge here in these depths after being defeated in battle on the approach to the Machine Cathedral. I want to take the unholy tin can that holds his traitorous brain back to Fenris. Good hunting!"

a4bb929b-ae00-418b-a883-06ca8dab3324.Text: "You're a brave one, and not easily deterred! Good! Then find a way to reach the tunnelling platform while we give the mangy sorcerer something to worry about." {n}Thorbald exchanges glances with his warriors, and you could swear they all smile in anticipation inside their helmets.{/n}

39c087ae-48fb-48bf-bcc9-2ebf4e2326fd.Text: "Tread lightly when facing him, young brother. Yes, the beast is mad and hideous, but he is withal mighty, old, and graced with the Archenemy's profane patronage. His hateful sermons abound with malefictions, and his weapon claimed the lives of hundreds during the assault. We grievously wounded him, true, but we haven't seen the last of this foe."

4e6b0191-215e-46aa-981b-a8ed8d8c4179.Text: "No, or else his head wouldn't still be attached to his neck. But my pack has heard plenty about his strength and ignominious misdoings. One can see the evidence of his malefactions all across the Koronus Expanse like bear tracks upon fresh snow. We stalked him and looked for a chance to clamp our jaws around his throat, but the craven knows well how to hide behind the backs of his heretical lackeys."

b32dd468-8029-448e-be8e-3c75f5fcb127.Text: "He wished to wake the tunnelling behemoth. If you hunger for my thoughts, Uralon is searching for something down below, in the manufactorum's deepest halls. My warriors destroyed the energy fount and silenced the drill, but the detestable malefic still found a way to revive it with his heinous magics."

4db9fc78-3d25-46e7-a011-80bf39aa465a.Text: "Our mortal foe lurks within this den of heresy. A Helbrute by the name of Doomscream, an ancient and vicious traitor. He barred our advance when we were approaching the Machine Cathedral and felled hundreds of brave champions. A terrible wound he took, but the beast still escaped our grasp. 'Tis time we cornered him and ended his vile existence!"

920f90a8-6db9-4cd1-8ece-0af9a478fe96.Text: "We will see, young Wolf. We will see."

6fa5f7ef-6ca8-436a-959d-d3c4f4994a2d.Text: "That's for you to sniff out, {name}! Perhaps there's a way around. We will give you enough time to look."

5b156745-4419-44b6-8b0d-c24eb67d984f.Text: "Well, what are we to do, {name}? 'Tis not our place to whimper that the Allfather has sent us a fight different from the one we saw in our sweet dreams."

c89e1f06-4e30-4766-b699-a45aa0d00ac3.Text:
"We won't fail you!" {n}The eager Space Marine lets out a hungering howl.{/n}
"Proudly tread the hunters grim,
In chase of a beast of steel and blood,
Fangs bared sharp in thirst of prey.
Let glory cloak their mighty gait!"

1ddab239-e36d-4943-8ff2-c594ac5df42a.Text: "An old and vicious heretic, a Helbrute whose veins boil with poisonous rage and savagery. His mind and body have so been warped by the Ruinous Powers that his very existence is an affront to the Allfather's warriors!"

ab2c9f2a-addd-4d67-9c0f-bc498a0289c7.Text: "Then you will go with Halbrandt, Ulfar. If fortune favours you in combat, he will be witness to your feat, and if not, he will aid you in battle."

d3d96edf-b766-48ef-af17-8226eba76e87.Text: "And I've regretted it ever since. Brother Ulfar has already marched toward his death a dozen times, and only the Allfather's eye kept him from meeting a gruesome end." {n}Thorbald grins in approval.{/n}

057d95db-ec58-4558-a7e6-6b8d276233ef.Text: "Do you seek to best me in hunting, Ulfar Everlost? None are faster or deadlier than the Stormbiters!"

1c3d7a56-9e9e-4099-9fd0-3b6ade3d6b88.Text: "If it comes to pass, I will be the first to raise a cup to the proud name of that ferocious pack."

c400bb3c-ae66-4d9e-b472-fa3c34b59b5a.Text: {n}You feel a sinister grin blossom somewhere beyond your reason's edge. The familiar voice intrudes upon your train of thought again.{/n} "Blood will be spilt indeed, but the warrior is mistaken as to its source. Allow him to relish that lie born out of ignorance. Allow him to believe that the Dark Apostle will fall by his hand and yours. My hour is drawing near. I will appear again, one last time, when the moment comes to make your mouth speak with the voice of the Truth."

9aa14b3a-2d3a-4400-8d5f-5f79c81787db.Text: "A fine thing to hear! The sorcerer will fall, for he can't but fall." {n}Thorbald nods his approval, unaware that he wasn't at all who you were talking to.{/n}

4900e5b5-5528-456a-8478-914d35eb295e.Text: "Don't let your temper get the better of you, warrior. I had no intention to slight your honour but to warn you." {n}Thorbald frowns, unaware that he wasn't at all who you were talking to.{/n}

13b41e30-a25d-485e-ad2a-4e3f80de5d6c.Text: {n}Borrowed thoughts clear out of your mind. You know the things they spoke of are true. They will be back one last time at the crossroads of fate where you will have to make the choice that decides everything.{/n}

5f28e24f-6f92-44e9-a97b-2db89184e5fa.Text: "Another blasphemy. They are too many to count now." {n}Pasqal's dry voice is rattling like a heavy vehicle's chain track. His visor lights up a blinding green, then blue, and you hear a metallic moan coming from everywhere. It is as though the manufactorum itself is being tortured.{/n}

186c1707-44d4-4ac3-afe0-086fcb838676.Text: {n}Thorbald's expression darkens.{/n} "My heart had little respect for Opticon-22, but he fought Doomscream with honour and fell with courage. A worthy fighter he was. His killer must pay the bloody toll!"

7bf8114a-4350-4afe-8b4d-4a15a1936e12.Text: "Doomscream? He hides in this den? Step aside, Halbrandt! I will be the one to slay it! I claim this quarry for the Baleful Howl!"

28431713-7582-402e-befa-ca4640c2e602.Text: "Doomscream? He hides in this den? I wish to slay him for the glory of my pack! Aett-Vater, take me into your band! We will track this beast down and fell him before Halbrandt can!"

2c5622c7-ed0b-47cd-972a-0e594804f981.Text: "Luck be with you, warriors. Heidur Rus, {name}!"

84e3f767-2d14-43ad-a040-fa37c30b8c9a.Text: "Worry not for the Rogue Trader, Thorbald. I've seen {mf|him|her} in action — it's the heretic who best beware meeting {mf|him|her}."

81dcdc10-abf6-4771-a09b-863ada176693.Text: "The generous Thorbald honoured me with a place aboard his landing drekkar so that the Baleful Howl could split the skies over Eufrates II."

8ec6cc57-ad27-40e9-ba2b-014cf3c395b2.Text: {n}Ulfar laughs heartily.{/n} "Then we have work to do! Do not dally, Aett-Vater, and you might just catch up to us!"

ea3b82f3-1e88-45b5-ab88-ade0d519ede7.Text: {n}The vox-caster is producing nothing but static.{/n}

8fa9b932-f1d8-411e-ba04-30748777a75e.Text: "Lift control to strike team. Come in, strike team."

3c6da2fa-b630-433b-befa-7b0c793b301c.Text: {n}Aishara's voice cuts through the static:{/n} "We read you, strike team. This is lift control. Report your status."

89eded6e-113f-460c-80c8-ddcaeb424833.Text: {n}Aishara responds after a brief pause,{/n} "Acknowledged, strike team. Beginning the extraction of the priority cargo."

e0c9ea9a-9aa6-496d-8667-b7a4f702af73.Text: Declared to the Edge of Daybreak your wish to taste the wisdom of the Immaterium.

a506c9bb-25eb-47c7-8f22-c9ab0e33332e.Text: "Edge of Daybreak, I seek no conflict with you. I wish to drink of the wisdom of the Immaterium!"

9439349c-fc02-416b-8b06-e6851fabb2b2.Text: "Grow as many eyes as you want, Voigtvir — I will gouge them all out!"

ed9fb498-d3b4-46fd-9a80-3623ecec78a1.Text: "The Emperor protects! Death to the heretics!"

ce525426-3231-4128-b011-02634137356c.Text: "I propose a truce. Give me Voigtvir and one half of the treasure you seek, and I shall let you walk away with your life."

279ec803-6970-4c8f-ac03-1f3c3295c508.Text: "I am Rogue Trader {name} von Valancius, and none shall lord over my subjects but me."

7c1e893f-1e86-472a-842d-424b3f0c66ba.Text: "I know that sword. Its shards were used in two attempts on my life. Unsuccessful attempts, might I add."

688e4972-3985-4148-8993-cc4041671a9f.Text: "Kunrad, fight it! Can't you see you have been deceived and used?"

2cee4bba-e055-4283-8367-0c19814b6829.Text: "Well, this is interesting. Go ahead, Kunrad. Make way for an opponent who is worth my time. I am ready!"

0ed1079f-c26b-447f-aea6-b116106402c5.Text: [Laugh] "Poor Kunrad. Theodora despised you, and your new master butchered you like a grox."

b85d6789-2e17-4fb9-aed8-20832a5d264b.Text: [Stab Kunrad with the blade without saying anything]

925e25f0-63fa-4b08-8bed-4c538a917803.Text: "What are the secrets you can tell me?"

c994e6d9-7969-4010-9714-1cd7d5e84991.Text: "I have killed thousands of your servants. Have you no desire to avenge them?"

a2313b90-f93e-4403-b524-991b96ec6e2d.Text: "I swear fealty to you, Master. Let your path guide me to the Truth."

a92828c1-9eff-4197-bfb0-7a330dd2fa18.Text: [Attack] "I will be a champion — I have endured too much to bow my head now!"

15a07c66-cfef-4ef5-84e9-376acf5bdbf4.Text: [Attack] "There are no masters other than me. I will not bow to you, daemon!"

2d692fda-ca7a-4a86-ae64-920ca4c3f16d.Text: "You will be next if you dare stand in my way."

eb921241-daca-47bf-b3fd-36f35b57411a.Text: "I killed the one you were so eager to summon — I killed him before your very eyes and you did not even interfere, did you?"

4d25f041-9ff6-4e58-af61-6ed95d17f293.Text: "I am not your lord's servant and I am certainly not going to obey a wretch like you! No blood will be spilt here save for yours."

4b3e52df-7386-408d-90fb-0600af21ac77.Text: [Kill Kunrad] "Fulfil your destiny. Become an instrument of the Edge of Daybreak!"

913046c0-0b0c-41db-9f94-9f4abaed0ed9.Text: [Stab Kunrad with the blade] "Reign in the abyss, you bastard."

b26fa293-03a4-4fe7-a6c2-70237da5cd74.Text: [Call your psyber-raven] "I shall bend your power to my will. I even have a suitable vessel prepared already."

f8813954-93da-4e0a-965b-76019763bc42.Text: "We meet at last, Edge of Daybreak. I have heard quite a lot about you."

da68bdbd-97a4-4e0e-8e30-0ad318d77226.Text: "For the Emperor and Humanity! I will cast you back to your unholy warp!"

ac2c73ac-07a1-4a18-8488-99a4115b634c.Text: Spoke the words of the Truth to Uralon on Eufrates II.

f6ede435-d899-4b10-b2b3-156f814e0de8.Text: "The Edge of Daybreak. I have suffered much grief committed in devotion to your name."

8be6c024-2d75-4b83-8d75-b812066dcd39.Text: "Spill the blood of these defeated weaklings? Just that and nothing else? I will gladly make that trifling sacrifice! I must admit I expected more from the Emperor's Angels."

5e9f903e-f795-4533-98bd-0b16346db656.Text: "Your spirit was bound within the shards of this blade?"

d0166204-064c-4cf4-af6f-f3295a848437.Text: "My victory was predestined, for you were outnumbered. You are a handful of fools who worship a dead fallacy. I have the Great Four on my side. May they revel in the blood that spills from the veins of heathens!"

8a41655f-bd45-4299-8576-b53a4e62c818.Text: "You are late, {name}. Your allies have fallen. Perhaps it's time to admit your defeat? If you do, I promise... no, I won't promise you anything. Whatever you choose, you will die a slow and excruciating death."

577890dc-db39-43ec-a0b4-6c62edac81b0.Text: {n}The suave whisper blossoms in your head again: an echo of words that were never said and yet are as old as time.{/n} "The moment has come for the Truth to be revealed, Child of the Dawn. Speak the final name to fulfil what was foretold: 'Sameth.' I will await our meeting."

8fbdc183-3bf3-46bb-9910-edbf4182092c.Text: {n}All but choking with frustration, rage, and confusion, Kunrad merely clenches his jaw until it cracks and stares daggers at you without daring to defy the sorcerer.{/n}

151baae3-4a0c-4e0a-89de-a3f73608512b.Text: {n}The wounds left by Uralon's blows are dire, but the Emperor's Angels are known for their hardiness. You have arrived just in time to stop the profane sorcerer from finishing them off.{/n}

652d245c-b56a-4905-bfe3-832a70cee566.Text: "It is what I am called. An old name imagined by an old race. They feared me, but still they could not resist the pull of my secrets."

b2c0b228-0e5e-4f9a-82d3-787803a5e910.Text: "Let's see if you will be so insolent when I slit your throat and bathe your precious Warrant in your blood!"

80ace9fc-e242-43dd-9b78-553bb9d6666a.Text: "One does not bargain with death — one bows before it!"

357403b8-7b3e-4b77-9960-2690bc84d6db.Text: {n}Uralon staggers back from the blow. Your strikes have crumpled his blood-red armour, and his face bears a grimace of pain. He turns his mad eyes to Voigtvir, who is thrashing in his own blood.{/n} "Brother Twilight, the hour that was promised to you has come. The Edge of Daybreak grants you the honour of serving as his weapon. Be awed by your high destiny!"

1739ef4a-83a9-4585-8f2f-102770ac946c.Text: {n}Voigtvir's turquoise eyes widen with understanding mixed with terror.{/n} "What? Now? But I'm... I'm not ready! It's not what you promised! You said I would reign!"

51221a26-7725-4830-af72-2ae7fa589a46.Text: {n}Uralon draws a blade shard shimmering with unnatural light.{/n} "Ways change, Brother Twilight, and nothing lasts in our lord's hand. But you will reign indeed — as a vessel for your master." {n}The blade cuts Voigtvir's coat and chest open, sinking deep into his flesh and finding its way to his heart. The glyphs carved into his skin by his ruthless mentor begin to glow so bright you can see them clearly through his clothes.{/n}

07212630-0ad4-4f3b-a949-9f5731a74246.Text: "Curious... However, your path is woven a different way. I gaze into the future and do not see you among my ranks. That means I have no need of you."

5a3ebd62-d643-4ab6-9d6c-8a0cc36eafce.Text: "I did not lie, Brother Twilight: the hour that was promised to you has come. You truly do have a special part to play." {n}The Dark Apostle turns his gaze toward you and smiles. You feel a throbbing in your chest as the dark will that you have absorbed along with the blade shards reaches for Kunrad's heart.{/n}

32eb6cbb-d24a-4620-bd2e-e2a7af22b529.Text: "This one will be the last. What you in your ignorance brazenly call shards is in truth a triune relic, the seat of the great spirit of the Edge of Daybreak, one who serves the master himself, the Changer of Ways. You do not deserve to behold his visage... but you will."

1944a6ef-3e5f-4859-9b6f-35391b476283.Text: "So be it... as long as I... get my revenge on you!" {n}Voigtvir doubles over, but his voice is still seething with malice.{/n}

d695f492-74bb-4144-b42d-b8330cb0ec20.Text: "I... hate... you!" {n}It takes Voigtvir a colossal effort to force these final hateful words through his sliced windpipe.{/n}

16cf25e4-fa6e-4d24-b24a-09fdae903b6c.Text: {n}The pernicious warp energies seep into his body, causing it to glow and flicker. With a mad cry of pain and exultation, Kunrad Voigtvir ceases to exist, and a mighty winged figure rises from his bloody remains.{/n}

bd2c643b-34ac-472f-887d-30ef6022997d.Text: "Ones that are only revealed to the select few who have sworn fealty to me as their master. The secret words spoken at the dawn of time that bring death and ruin to all whose ears they reach. The true names of forgotten deities that will summon bloodthirsty shadows to serve you. Forgotten knowledge that can create an empire or pulverise one. All of that can be yours if you acknowledge me as your master and take the path that I show you."

ee4bee2d-c004-4031-8391-8a90fc1ebe3c.Text: "They have merely fulfilled their purpose. I foresaw every death, every last gasp, every gaping wound. All that ocean of blood was spilt at my will, for the sake of this moment, for me to be incarnated and for you to arrive here and take your place beside me, Child of the Dawn."

c866e35c-d950-4e2b-89d7-61bbf76dc4ab.Text: "So be it! I accept your oath, Child of the Dawn. Your path of service and greatness lies clear before my eyes, but in order for the Weaver of Destinies to choose that exact path for your future, you must not disclose your allegiance to it yet. Craft your first secret. Conceal that it was you who spilt the blood of the false believers. Lie and let fallen servants of the Dark Gods take credit for your acts. Gain fame as a champion, the smiter of heresy who has crushed the despicable apostates. And right now, allow the Golden Throne's agents to complete their clandestine machinations. In the end, you will reap what they have sown and your might will know no limits."

9f721d5a-b9b8-4aff-8506-5c27f012edbb.Text: {n}The daemon laughs raspily again.{/n} "So be it, Child of the Dawn! Reveal your essence and try to contend with the will of the Weaver of Destinies!"

19cbc03a-13db-426e-96a0-95b795b8bdea.Text: "I behold you, Edge of Daybreak! Enter the transient realm of reality and rule it. The Child of the Dawn has spilt the blood of unbelievers and fools so that you can be incarnated right here and now. Glory to the Truth!"

66629c5b-35b0-4d79-b439-af0e42b17999.Text: "We shall part ways for now, champion. I will lie low in the dungeons of Eufrates so that our enemies think I fell by your hand. But I shall resurface. Soon. Very soon."

f66fcf8c-257e-4993-8a76-6e6355aead0e.Text: "Child of the Dawn, your might... is doubtless. Your path to greatness lies before you. But you should know that in order for the Weaver of Destinies to choose that exact path for you, you must not disclose your allegiance to the Dark Gods yet. Craft your first secret. Conceal that it was you who spilt the blood of the false believers. Lie and let fallen servants of the Dark Gods take credit for your acts. Gain fame as a champion, the smiter of heresy who has crushed the despicable apostates. And right now, allow the Golden Throne's agents to complete their clandestine machinations. In the end, you will reap what they have sown and your might will know no limits."

e6dcb541-95ea-46b1-a3ea-b526d6662128.Text: {n}The daemon beckons you with his clawed hand.{/n} "My time in realspace is nearing its end. Come close and claim your reward."

ac689560-0746-4591-b687-89125d03e893.Text: {n}At the daemon's last gasp, blasphemous words slither into your ears, slide along the edge of your mind, and sink their teeth into your heart forever. The blood in your veins begins to boil as the corruption rises from it like steam, pouring out of your mouth and eyes, merging with the dissipating shell of the fallen daemon... and taking on a new form. You are holding a relic of Chaos, one imbued with the rage of Vog'Haik'Sameth and moulded by your very soul.{/n}

828cdd5c-e4ee-41bd-b9bf-1bc7b0aabf22.Text: "I stand in awe of you, champion. Overpowering the master... No puny mortal could have possibly done that. The Primordial Truth itself speaks through your deeds."

61ba0a0c-24c0-4244-96d8-b0bf8e9f19c0.Text: "The master was testing you; I had no right to interfere. He beheld every path and he said himself that the Great Four had blessed each of those paths; therefore your deeds have the Truth's blessing. You are a champion and I dare not oppose your will."

86cf1b53-9828-4ea2-823e-8e56424136c6.Text: "I am here to help you along your new path, champion, not to stand in it. It will be a pleasure for me to behold you walking it and strewing it with the corpses of blind fools and false believers."

15870119-0635-43d6-8d64-50ed9e30b1eb.Text: "Remember the master's last words. Conceal the truth of what happened here, allow the servants of the false god to carry out their plan, and collect your due."

45e5ca8f-f134-4218-849b-4c113e5fc872.Text: {n}Bitter disappointment is visible in the sorcerer's eyes.{/n} "You reject your destiny in the name of your worthless pride? Such a shame. Off with you, then! May the pious receive the gift of sacrifice!"

c95d327e-b5a7-4af3-8470-81d738bd2e10.Text: {n}A ferocious roar interrupts you. Overcoming their grievous wounds, the Space Wolves — all of them — rise to their feet. They are headed by Thorbald, who looks at you as if you were a walking lump of rotten flesh. His blood-smeared face is contorted in a grimace of furious contempt.{/n}

e944d466-06c6-42ed-9dc4-b95856a39536.Text: "Indeed I was bound. The dancing souls, the Aeldari, rose against me, lured me into a trap, and shackled my spirit with the shape of this weapon. For aeons I remained in this prison, subtly forcing my will into your wretched, immalleable world. But even a shred of my power was enough to tempt countless souls. Here I am now in all my glory."

b643af79-8e3c-4ef3-ad1f-a090d65e0f5b.Text: "You cannot fathom how pathetic and foolish your threats sound, fleeting creature. I am an eternal mystery, while you are an evanescent spark. Fade away."

f7f207fa-56da-4172-8f61-54440261008c.Text: "The memory of you will disappear sooner than the echo of your insipid name. I have no more need of you. Begone."

717d7e63-6cbe-44e9-ab79-25c944eee095.Text: "I will not forgive. You lying piece of fekke! You dare mock the sons of Fenris? You dare make seditious speeches and insult the Allfather? I will not forgive! So you say you want our blood? Then come and get it!" {n}The Space Wolf leader lets out a long howl.{/n}

ac59f037-5e0a-4e7f-bc08-e2cff22c787d.Text: {n}The sorcerer touches some unholy amulet and the haze of a protective field envelops him and Kunrad.{/n} "Child of the Dawn, I will not interfere, for this is a sacrifice you must make on your own. Fulfil your destiny! May the pious receive the gift of sacrifice!"

57cb0210-efc1-41de-aef3-1c6fa50457ca.Text: {n}The last of the Space Wolves is slain. Courage and fury are not enough to defeat fate, from whose threads your purpose is woven. The Space Marines' spilt blood covers the battlefield, slowly flowing together to form unholy patterns and blasphemous runes.{/n}

bd936fef-3417-47af-b307-f9b178313db7.Text: "This was a worthy sacrifice, Child of the Dawn. The master will be pleased. Now take the final step and weave your thread forever into the ornament of the inescapable future."

ea8d723e-914b-4b51-9452-4e77b6631dad.Text: "Explain yourself, Uralon! This is not what you promised! You said I would reign supreme! And now you're welcoming my enemy with open arms?"

8bb994bd-70d2-4793-9e65-c6534456aa93.Text: "Goodbye, Child of the Dawn. I will watch your deeds." {n}The daemon waves his hand and a portal opens. The Edge of Daybreak disappears into it.{/n}

67fae259-fbe9-4f7f-b4db-309d4d437890.Text: {n}The glyphs carved into Voigtvir's body by his cruel mentor are shining blindingly through his clothes.{/n} "I... hate... you!" {n}With a terrible effort, he squeezes his furious last words out of his blood-filled windpipe.{/n}

ff1dc521-9cf3-4e9e-9eb1-df958996662d.Text: "You have proven your loyalty, and so henceforth you will be my new prophet, Child of the Dawn! Now swear fealty to me, Vog'Haik'Sameth, as you and your cult bow before me. You will possess secrets and knowledge balanced on the brink of oblivion, on the edges of futures that never came to pass. But there is another path that I see. One in which I become a desolating weapon in the hands of the champion of Chaos. You should know that both paths — the one where our threads intertwine and the one where mine is cut short — will lead you to greatness and glorify the Primordial Truth. The choice is yours."

d65d7643-93be-4782-83cf-27328c774ae0.Text: {n}Abelard adjusts his grip on his weapon as he surveys the monstrous creature.{/n} "Why do I get the feeling that I have seen, no, not seen but come across this warp spawn before?" {n}The old officer frowns, as if trying to pry a stubborn memory out of the depths of remembrance.{/n}

ca9d6dfb-71d1-41f1-956e-5277ff031b3f.Text: {n}Idira screws her eyes shut... and when she opens them again, blood is running down her cheeks.{/n} "I... see... light..."

a9909dba-1d79-43fa-8dff-2c5c420e726f.Text: {n}Marazhai grips his weapon tighter as he looks over the monstrosity facing him. Suppressed fear blends with dark admiration in his eyes.{/n} "Come on, {name}... what are we waiting for?"

2bcd36ed-bdad-4884-b186-be8d8f790bda.Text: "Edge... of Daybreak... I witness you..." {n}Uralon musters enough strength for a faint vengeful smile.{/n} "Enter the forlorn halls of reality and claim them. I gave all that I had in your name. Hail... the Truth..." {n}His giant body goes limp, his face forever retaining a wicked expression of triumph.{/n}

a004698b-a15a-4655-9963-60c28c056aaf.Text: {n}Heinrix's face twists for a moment. He clutches at his chest as if he is having a heart attack... but, a moment later, he straightens and glares at the daemon with grim determination.{/n}

b9f990c1-83cf-4a37-99d7-9fb669ecdd30.Text: {n}The mighty being is defeated. The warp energies gushing out of its disintegrating shell sweep over you like vile winds. Vog'Haik'Sameth raises his monstrous head and fixes his gaze on you.{/n}

633cfb0c-1550-4658-86ec-7726baa0271d.Text: {n}The daemon laughs raspily again.{/n} "A true Child of the Dawn who hungers for infinite power. Contend with me, and the outcome will decide whether you are to fall to that which carries the will of the Weaver of Destinies — or make it your servant."

0e7a6add-c871-487d-93ba-d6fa0b77b605.Text: {n}The psyber-raven hovers over the shifting form of the entity, absorbing a part of its essence. The raven's black eyes flash with azure and gold, and its beak lets out a fading burst of laughter in the voice of the imprisoned daemon.{/n}

dacd448a-2899-40d0-a1ef-54c4b96cfb4e.Text: "My imprisonment ends. I am made manifest. Rejoice, mortal witnesses, for I have come to lord over you." {n}The daemon lets out a hoarse, cawing laugh.{/n} "I told you that you would welcome my return to reality."

57703f94-b433-467b-a80e-a306dad38689.Text: {n}Uralon burns you with a baleful gaze.{/n} "Did you think that saying {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_Eufrates_UralonFaithDamaged}empty prayers to a withered husk{/d} could disrupt the course of my magic? For this sacrilege, you will be purged harshly."

b79f93ef-cca2-44a0-a66e-ce1b41f40fdf.Text: "What? What is the meaning of this? I—"

1a88056f-fdd1-4fd8-bcf8-e6a78036786b.Text: {n}The wrath in Uralon's eyes gives way to surprise, then triumph.{/n} "You speak the name of the Third Dawn. You have come to me not as a thrall to the corpse emperor, but as a servant of our master. If that is so, I will not fight you, and instead will allow you to share the great honour of spilling the blood of false believers in a sacred ritual!"

b8c4fb59-1dd9-46b5-ae8f-cffd086475a5.Text: "Silence, Brother Twilight. I was asking the one who walks the thread of Daybreak." {n}Uralon addresses you again.{/n} "Will you accept the honour and spill the blood of fools who blindly believe in a false god?"

740629a6-73aa-4064-a6f7-cb051670195f.Text: "My name will only resound louder now that I am incarnate. Every secret, every grain of knowledge in this pitiful reality will carry within it an echo of my name!"

5c3acaab-8f0c-4482-b88d-f69d96de6c50.Text: Interrupted Uralon's sorcery with the litany of purification on Eufrates II.

3a3c61bc-b58e-4646-84ed-20680063258e.Text: [Speak the litany of purification to smother the profanity of the sorcerous words]

403beae3-cf96-4a6e-a441-b6f1d953723e.Text: "In the name of the God-Emperor, I am here as your judge and executioner!"

1e611e3d-c5f7-47b1-884e-e7381aad55c2.Text: [Sniff the stench that hangs in the air] "I never thought sorcery could reek so terribly."

1050c231-4130-4677-921f-37a5edfe6a80.Text: [Address the sorcerer] "Do you have a name? Or shall I simply refer to you as 'the heretic'?"

6ecee434-b90b-4ed2-9f67-722b4c32ad30.Text: "You must have been preoccupied with something profoundly important if you paid no heed to me obliterating your army."

b9d3b9e7-b07c-47e0-ac47-800a567d08f7.Text: "And what is this treasure you covet so terribly?"

add7cb26-f10f-4b86-8716-ebb7de0a26f7.Text: "Have it your way. I will kill you without a care for why you came here."

649107b8-7d57-4e48-a443-bb422f83b62a.Text: "If you are so confident in your victory, then what are these secrets for?"

60af4dd0-d827-4efd-bda4-2d3f4e57ce1f.Text: [Lie] "I already know what you seek here. Spare me your smug pomposity."

a3ee10b9-f44d-414e-b0ba-08e97f3e3749.Text: "Thorbald, let him know that I find his words too brazen for my liking."

f8ad13c0-38a9-4e15-ac3a-34ad087bc500.Text: "No more words. Thorbald, we must stop him."

1d15bdbe-fb97-490d-a424-60e023175093.Text: [Smile at Voigtvir] "Your death will be a delightful addition to my triumph."

82d963b9-3b80-451d-8171-f4ddd45d0afc.Text: "Voigtvir, what the devils are you doing here?"

7c1d6cbd-8ed9-4d84-97c4-bcd671234187.Text: "Surrender, and House von Valancius may show you mercy. If you prove to be of use."

e74210ae-585d-4ef7-909c-0fd2e1742953.Text: "You are on a path to your own death, nothing more. You have almost reached the end."

30610004-fd99-4f20-99d3-75a7a99db654.Text: "Do not dare speak Theodora's name, vile traitor."

443fdc8c-ea09-4e02-bfd5-c947a41321c5.Text: "There is nothing for us to speak about."

b8ae3ccc-3134-4445-b661-bd32f5260b36.Text: {n}The giant clad in dark crimson armour is in the middle of a sinister litany, his words turning into a repulsive ethereal stench and flakes of otherworldly ice. He does not notice your presence.{/n}

29a614eb-0003-4f71-b3d9-504f2a732092.Text: "Enough, Brother Twilight. Your lips will not speak a word more than it is a heathen's place to hear. Ignorance is their cloister. Let them remain trapped there."

98ccfebe-949f-46d5-ae6a-7a4f0052d070.Text: {n}The platform beneath the sorcerer's feet is the drilling machine's massive tunnelling shield. This mighty mechanism can gnaw through underground rock, bunker bulkheads reinforced with adamantine, or anything else that may lurk in the planet's depths.{/n}

16ef1059-4956-4a1e-b432-83c14880766c.Text: {n}You can feel the strings of the surreal force emanating from the sorcerer's fingers and wrapping around the enormous disc of the drill. He is feeding its sacred batteries with his profane magic as if it were the Motive Force, subjugating the Tech-Priests' creation to his will.{/n}

add41825-10cd-4bf9-ab9c-5f1ae5065c9e.Text: {n}Watching this loathsome act of desecration take place before you fills your head with an unnerving sensation. You realise you will forever remember these disturbing, inhuman words the sorcerer is speaking — they have embedded themselves in your memory in place of something... important that was there before. Try as you might, you cannot remember what it was.{/n}

ee425e13-7fb0-40dd-bb0f-d255c7235e25.Text: {n}The sorcerer does not turn his head as his voice rolls over the room:{/n} "I see you, mortal thing. I sense your meek mind."

965ef39f-4be9-4190-996b-70daebb52e36.Text: "Will this do?" {n}Thorbald takes aim and sends a bolt right into the sorcerer's back.{/n} "Hey, you foul-blooded spawn of a worm-ridden womb! We've come to rip your guts out!"

6365992c-cda8-4c28-94a9-7140aac68adc.Text: {n}The sorcerer's voice vibrates unnaturally, seething with anger and contempt:{/n} "Ignorant creature. Your pitiful ridicule offends my ears."

6e26a6ca-72d0-43df-97aa-399cc587257c.Text: {n}The sorcerer scoffs. His deep, unnaturally vibrating voice causes your insides to shrink:{/n} "What good is the name of a rotting corpse propped upon the Golden Throne? It carries no fear for the disciples of the true faith."

4e5cbfc4-9ed5-4a2e-a67a-40f48a3045f3.Text: {n}The sorcerer reluctantly turns his burning gaze upon you.{/n} "So you are the one who was so eager to meet me and your own demise? Rejoice, Brother Twilight. Today, you become the new Rogue Trader."

ecccbbcb-bfd3-4528-8e04-17a72d1fdfa7.Text: "You know my name well.
