I am Uralon the Cruel, Breaker of Misbelievers, Truthspeaker, Triumphator of Faith, {g|Encyclopedia:DarkApostle}Dark Apostle{/g} of the blessed Word Bearers Legion. Kneel and offer a prayer of gratitude, for your death could not bear a worthier name."

bda99adf-33d5-40f4-8bc4-9c8f8869df0f.Text: "Death for the glory of the True Gods is a blessed fate for any believer, so why would I rob them of it? Every martyr who perishes in Their name only empowers their reign. I was tasked with a different mission — to make the Koronus Expanse behold the sheer impotence of its most eminent protector."

065e5775-27a7-4e6e-a2aa-053a8ad42f3f.Text: "I will keep this from you so that you may perish in the darkness of ignorance. Pathetic. Your master didn't even tell you the reason why he sent you to face your death. And neither will I make this poisoned cup any easier to drink."

569e8950-edde-4922-b6db-3c2c23109a03.Text: "With joy in my heart!" {n}Thorbald points his weapon, and his shot strikes sparks off Uralon's pauldron.{/n} "You are a negotiator after my own heart."

0674fb19-130f-4f05-97f8-f35d7ed43174.Text: {n}The sorcerer lets out a chilling laugh.{/n} "Save your feeble lies, for they are unworthy of my ears. I can see into the souls of mortals, and there is nothing in yours but confusion and fear."

d2063afe-a004-401b-95b8-d681709274c8.Text: {n}The sorcerer's disdainful voice deteriorates into a feral rasp.{/n} "When you fall, I will find your soul in the warp and flay it clean of this cloak of arrogance and obtuseness you have wrapped yourself in."

f2bc5ea7-307a-450f-9dc4-376ff10095ba.Text: "Very well. Kneel and pledge yourself to the True Gods of the warp, for great revelations are a reward for the faithful." {n}He gestures at you imperiously.{/n}

884551f0-73f2-4c5e-9cb2-dda25454c885.Text: {n}Thorbald nods at his weapon.{/n} "I doubt you intend to obey, but I will still advise against it..."

83e821f6-3621-4a4d-8d40-039b027d3e65.Text: "I can tell you have tasted the mjod of the skjalds. 'Tis doubly satisfying to kill a foe after shaming him with honourable words of scorn."

21fd753a-3a88-4ba5-8b61-6354d882b90a.Text: {n}With a solemn gesture of his hands, Uralon thunders in fury,{/n} "Let those who blaspheme against the True Gods beg forgiveness in vain, let their lips be sealed, let their hands be severed, let their souls be reaped and scourged!"

473e38cf-7222-4758-9e7a-13456ab63cfc.Text: {n}The Wolf lets out a chilling howl, and his pack ready their weapons, acknowledging it as an unequivocal order to kill.{/n}

ec5a1228-4a69-4d0b-b412-4983d13e601f.Text: {n}No longer able to control his temper, Voigtvir exclaims,{/n} "You did me a favour by coming here! I would like to pass a few words to the late Theodora — will you kindly grant me this request?"

fd62ee19-3e68-43cb-98e1-6e88f7a2c6ed.Text: "Silence!" {n}The giant's voice shakes the walls.{/n} "Your witless attempts to insult one another are interrupting my prayer to the True Gods!"

c501023b-9ccd-4381-a6e3-db4dba492545.Text: {n}Voigtvir's deformed features twist into a bloodthirsty smile.{/n} "Yes, master. I will rectify my mistake and reclaim what was stolen."

7df35be9-f2dd-4cef-9a22-41c0bd818542.Text: {n}Voigtvir cocks his head sharply like a bird, and laughs mockingly.{/n} "I am on a path to greatness, {name}. True power, of the kind you and Theodora could only dream of. The Edge of Daybreak promised to weave me a truly remarkable fate!"

67b37f01-78d1-4064-a7ba-2f27f0cf620c.Text: "You don't have the right to offer me pardons or deals. You're a fake!"

b35609d7-7b0c-49ea-875c-baa9beb86767.Text: "An empty threat. I have the upper hand this time. In my next prayer to the Dark Gods, I will thank them for letting me destroy another Rogue Trader of the von Valancius line."

8566aae7-01d3-4e44-820a-54d496077e6b.Text: "I say it every time I pray to the Dark Gods!"

4be28346-4c15-4318-8759-b9b124ea9288.Text: "Indeed. I have nothing to say to a corpse."

7c73310d-bbdc-414c-947c-2fdd32bf3236.Text: {n}The same cannot be said about Kunrad Voigtvir who stands at his side. His completely mutated turquoise eyes flash upon seeing you. He flinches but remains silent, hesitant to interrupt the ritual.{/n}

310a1aa3-de25-40c3-8e67-2fc6c0b69dcc.Text: "If only you knew what powerful weapon awaits us down below! With it, we will make the entire Expanse—"

4ab39ea6-2b64-444a-8fef-2a8bf342ade9.Text: {n}The sacred words sustained by your indomitable faith illuminate the air and send a mighty echo across the room. So great is their strength that the sorcerer's words drown within and the currents of heretical power swirling around the drill begin to ebb. Once the final words of the prayer escape your lips, righteous light envelops the drill, washing away the unhallowed taint. The sorcerer, scorched by the radiance of the Emperor Himself, growls in pain and rage.{/n}

84a8ce2a-d08f-4b1d-958e-2088e05dd402.Text: "Once Calcazar's treasure has been stolen, his secret hoards plundered, and his name shamed, the dogs of the false emperor will see the Truth. No one will protect them. No one will heed their pleas. Only by bowing to the masters of the Immaterium will they earn the right to live."

fae32032-02f4-4b5e-adbb-4d99c1a11c31.Text: {n}The corrupted servants of the Deus Mechanicus scuttle around the heretic, muttering twisted prayers of ignition in attempts to persuade the Omnissiah's majestic beast to awaken and rend the world's flesh.{/n}

7bbffbdb-bbaa-48f9-aa12-b36fe27fae91.Text: {n}Kibellah's earnest laughter resounds through the shaft. She wipes her eyes, ignoring the looks of bewilderment.{/n} "You? Death? Oh, Undying Emperor..."

59018765-3006-49ba-8868-280cc684832a.Text: "I wish the best of success to Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship."

c4cf936d-3af0-45d1-a981-eda2baf6d506.Text: "To arms— wait! It's {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship} von Valancius! I thought it was Chorda's dogs with another inspection... Stand down. False alarm."

b92004bc-d207-478d-b4d7-0ef3f7e83a5e.Text: "I beg your pardon. There are many other matters requiring my attention."

6545cb40-8d92-4d40-9d3e-cf80db2bb5ad.Text: "So you have been put in charge? A curious choice."

6f753dd0-a0d6-40c2-9eb8-52b9428ef33a.Text: "What can the Saint Drusus mission offer me?"

04b5d22b-0976-4be7-b6fb-25a59ea8d25e.Text: "What is your opinion on the situation on the station?"

57ae4d43-5296-4d0e-a7c1-b83db76843fe.Text: "Long time no see, Chaplain. What are you doing here?"

76d70859-b539-4418-8ad8-c1e341c0233c.Text: "So I'm running things now. I'm running things till some big old reverend of a higher rank than mine shows up, tells me to get lost, and takes over. It's an embarrassment for the head of a mission to have scars all over his face, making it plain for all to see that he did ungodly things in the past."

a0ce81ce-e619-4b8c-ab04-6fe7cd5e3a36.Text: {n}As he sees you, he bows — respectfully but none too gracefully, as if he is not used to making the deferential gesture.{/n} "May Drusus watch over you, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. I never thought I'd see a Rogue Trader in this kind of establishment, especially in these troubled times."

e00d9b1f-bb7d-45ff-a0a3-07cdbe1e211a.Text: {n}As you approach, he bows deferentially.{/n} "Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship, it's nice to see that Saint Drusus has protected your neck from the heretics and the xenos since we last met. Shame how it's always sad events that bring us together. The last time was at a funeral, and now it feels like half of Footfall needs a memorial service."

ffca8c34-1779-429a-9ff1-2890515d6a1a.Text: "To the children of the Emperor who make generous donations to our godly cause, we gladly gift specks of His gracious light embedded in our relics."

c60a498d-ae5c-4a25-a295-4435afddc8c5.Text: {n}Shadows have made their home under Chaplain's eyes.{/n} "If Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship has something to say to the Drusian mission, you can count on having my ear. Reverend Hieronymus's demise has left me... the senior missionary on Footfall, I suppose. I'm authorised to speak on behalf of my brothers and sisters."

556f3bab-666d-4338-90f5-dceb53936fbc.Text: {n}The imposing man covered head to toe in scars is hard to mistake for anyone else. You are looking at Chaplain, confessor to the late Denz Bellardo, whose funeral now seems like an eternity ago. His arms are crossed as he surveys the room with a gloomy expression.{/n}

95fe1b56-f5af-4ed3-9a14-9754d805d58a.Text: {n}Chaplain jerks his chin up defiantly.{/n} "Honestly? Perhaps this began as a cleansing, but since day one, it's looked more like a frenzy of fanaticism. Granted, people with a clear conscience have always been few and far between on Footfall. But is that a reason to exterminate everyone for the pettiest infractions?"

ab04aaab-7da3-4e77-ac83-e8b483034bad.Text: "Same as always, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. Bringing the Emperor's light to the lowly and downtrodden. And I have my hands full here on Footfall — the station's teeming with hungry, maimed, and frightened people."

8d7dbd5f-5577-4e64-b016-344b4a96e9d7.Text: "The Ecclesiarchy once tried to make a decent preacher out of me, but fainthearted and brash young brat that I was, I decided that wasn't the life for me. I traded a worthy life in the Emperor's light for greed and what I thought of as freedom at the time. I became a pirate, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship."

5a9cefb4-e55e-484b-a040-6cff4917703d.Text: "I'm known simply as Chaplain. I'm a missionary of Saint Drusus. I do sermons, public prayers, and funeral services for the lowly and destitute. I have to say it's been mostly funeral services of late... But perhaps you're more interested to know how a priest got so many battle scars." {n}He chuckles as he looks at his arms, which are covered in pale white stripes.{/n}

bfa28e04-1c33-4def-8f5f-9d4d240c7eb9.Text: "I do. A grand man he was, with a strength of character that was only rivalled by the fervour of his faith. It was he who ordained me... ordained me properly, not in the pirate fashion. He taught me a lot, even though I didn't always agree with him. It will be a long time before the Expanse sees another servant of the Emperor quite like him."

42e31eaf-b68b-48ba-a3e2-a7aad8709463.Text: "What he did to Her Ladyship and her kin was, of course, cruel and criminal... But he was pursuing a grand goal, a goal of his calibre. He was trying to wrest an entire sector, an entire Rogue Trader dynasty from the clutches of depravity. I hope that one great sacrilege does not taint the memory of his supreme goal and his other good deeds. After all, he never made a secret of having a blemished soul, just like the rest of us. None are unsullied."

b9344a06-0cf5-4cb9-89a8-d4a42ca3880b.Text: "I'm going to miss him. I hope I can live up to his memory and be at least half as fervent as him in bringing Saint Drusus's word to those in need of redemption."

babc5250-3e57-4e8c-a227-f411fc1fccab.Text: {n}A warm smile brightens Chaplain's rough features.{/n} "Safe and sound in my care, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Barely any time has passed, and I already think of her as my own, and the girl herself clings to me. She took to learning the ways of voidfaring with gusto, and she is already better at numbers than me — a true trade captain in the making!"

8042755e-1f86-4678-96b5-3230786bd7a4.Text: "I hid her somewhere safe for now. It's a bad time for the girl to be on Footfall — she has seen enough woe and blood as it is. More than enough."

0135fe43-e1dc-4695-80a1-fe46fa3d091c.Text: "The laws of death worlds can be surprisingly unique at times. But for the home of the Space Wolves, the Emperor Himself commanded that special customs be established... ones that may be beyond the understanding of ordinary people."

7f5d2f6e-25ff-43cf-8549-f2d6514236b5.Text: "I have done many unclean deeds and seen many unsettling things. And I have become a sincere believer — imagine that. Deadly battles and my comrades' nightly confessions of their atrocities did for me what my mentors couldn't. Who else could they confess to? I knew the words of the prayer, if nothing else. That was how I became the ship's chaplain. Then I renounced my criminal ways altogether. I died as a pirate and was reborn as a missionary: thus commanded Saint Drusus, who himself passed away and was resurrected by the Emperor."

13cdf8c2-2bac-44a7-bc43-df587fee6c62.Text: "You'll hear no argument from me. When we lost Reverend Hieronymus, my brothers and sisters despaired. But I, hardened killer that I am, had seen my comrades die before. So I made... suggestions to them at first, and then gave them instructions. In hard times like these, with so many people suffering, we couldn't afford to wallow in a puddle of grief. My brothers and sisters heeded me, and then somehow got it into their heads that I was in charge now."

f4c60298-1061-4cb0-8cb0-37c10c1f77c1.Text: "Her Ladyship Incendia Chorda, in her righteous zeal, doesn't see the atrocities her enforcers commit in the Shadow Quarters, using her name as their shield. I interfere wherever I can, but to be honest, I'm almost spent. Helping everyone is more than I can do."

2ba59723-0306-410d-a7af-d47511b92279.Text: "Saint Drusus teaches us to bring people back to the Emperor's light and only punish by death those who've crossed the forbidden line and turned away from Him irrevocably. I'm my own living proof that even a thoroughly rotten scoundrel can take the path of redemption. Are we in such deep retreat from the heresy we're battling that the flamer and the noose are the only tools we have left?"

2507072b-a291-4cee-8c23-8c24099242d8.Text: {n}His large fists clench into twin mace-heads.{/n} "Her Ladyship Incendia Chorda, in her righteous zeal, doesn't see the atrocities her enforcers commit in the Shadow Quarters, using her name as their shield. I intervene wherever I can, but to be honest, I'm almost spent. Helping everyone is beyond my abilities."

ed41b539-5864-4649-8f8e-76e8409fbfd6.Text: "Shame that Reverend Hieronymus won't listen to me. He's too zealous. He sees the face of vice too clearly and finds it too abhorrent. Looking at Footfall makes him sick, and so he... welcomes the cleansing."

e2761432-477d-4112-a075-7008fec9bd4d.Text: "Yes, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship, it's a curious turn of fate." {n}Judging by the pain and anger that flash in Chaplain's eyes for an instant, he knows full well who instigated the violence against the Drusians. But he contains himself.{/n} "Her Ladyship Incendia judged me herself, and hard as she tried, she saw no darkness in me. It was a bit awkward, as a matter of fact. Not that it's anything to rejoice at. She ordered me to personally carry out her verdicts against my brothers and sisters. A heavy burden... But better me than her executioners." {n}The man falls silent and clenches his fists until they crack.{/n}

8e5e139e-99bd-49e5-a9a3-7373932eaa09.Text: {n}Shrugging, Ulfar mutters quietly,{/n} "I know piracy is condemned in the Imperium... but on Fenris, participating in a glorious raid on a neighbour is considered a valiant deed, not a shameful one."

a0a27d50-854f-4a17-8894-950335e33573.Text: {n}The priest in front of you looks imposing. He is tall and muscular, and has scars on his face and arms. His whole appearance seems to tell a story of many heretics who met their end at the hands of this adherent of the true faith.{/n}

8e26640c-346b-451b-871f-189b2a39f00a.Text: "The law has found its way to Footfall, after all, I see."

eba4388b-2460-4bdd-a207-6c0c11055545.Text: "What manner of slaughterhouse is this? Some atrocious travesty of justice?"

e446ce87-b5b2-4c71-9fc4-a580a6f465a8.Text: "I have heard enough. Your feud is no concern of mine."

feb2f4df-fc04-4b52-9fd8-80dd7debaea6.Text: [Scoop up some of the man's brain matter] "Watch carefully."

24ec69d2-8652-4db5-b164-4c94d6154ecc.Text: "Stop talking before I have your mouth sewn shut."

9c4f98b9-6d73-44f2-a9f9-386ea3be3c47.Text: "No. I will do no such thing."

703adeb4-d04e-45b4-aed3-213e87789ce9.Text: [Draw your weapon] "No more judgements. Cease this disgrace and get off Footfall."

7579f9f1-db8b-4839-983e-71e04537ed53.Text: "And what is it you wish to judge me for?"

3f54412d-36ed-4352-80b2-f2f5301d16e1.Text: "I have just broken out after being held captive by xenos in Commorragh and butchering my way through scores of enemies of Humanity. Tell me, am I truly the greatest enemy of the Imperium you have been able to find?"

29136aad-bfab-42f6-b0fb-c6e7948729e4.Text: [Draw your weapon] "I am ready to defend my honour before this court. Whom should I kill to put an end to this farce?"

835b1f81-3e3c-42b5-a048-a8bb44970495.Text: "Would you look at that, Heinrix — I have been an enemy of Humanity all along. Care to comment?"

2e525549-9b29-4f7f-afa3-56f56fb33216.Text: "To the Nine Devils with you, arrogant halfwit. You have no right to judge me."

d86a00da-451e-481b-ac6f-49100dbbed47.Text: "So you are in charge of Footfall now?"

e3870c5d-dfc4-441b-927c-1fa18dc14c63.Text: "And whom is it you are judging?"

a38a86ca-6493-406d-abbc-3840e06644c9.Text: [Chuckle and point at the hapless assassin's corpse] "I can tell you are quite popular with the locals."

f9529814-4562-4ef3-bea1-e59deedda596.Text: "We shall see whether Footfall will thank the Emperor for your reign."

f1817aa1-a8fb-49f2-8b5b-d66b4289e159.Text: "Enough words. Your accused await, and so do my duties."

3e76cd16-7ad4-43b5-a327-f6586c091e78.Text: "I applaud your efforts. This place was long overdue some proper law and order."

c245b4d6-76f6-4f17-858b-f193cf730b9f.Text: "There is nothing just about this trial. Your accusations are contrived, and their purpose is simply to turn the entire population of Footfall into pliant automatons!"

9b94b749-1b31-4cca-92a3-3dfb1e470be7.Text: "And what do I stand to gain?"

e9df82fe-ce11-400b-ab93-f306716c382a.Text: "I will help you deal with Vladaym."

0d19f2cb-a7fb-4c41-9620-dc502329e426.Text: [Lie] "I will drag Vladaym before this court."

927178e0-0cce-40f0-a8af-4b0eaaaacba4.Text: "Admit it: you simply enjoy turning people into slaves. Why do you feel the need to come up with excuses for sowing carnage?"

1fac76e6-8e72-4ad3-9465-23ba49a47d42.Text: "What makes you think you are entitled to govern this place as you see fit?"

dee1a8f7-a505-4e7e-a7d2-4b5fa57a77c9.Text: "Why did Hieronymus go to the Adeptus Amasecus?"

dae68ee5-03eb-4f99-a71e-cff09537b31b.Text: "How long has your court been in session already?"

3d224317-02b7-4008-8ad2-76599bf448c7.Text: "Some of the people you wish to execute are useful to me. I purchase valuable equipment from them."

55079211-055d-4b88-b3b0-17b61e05edac.Text: [Put the poor man out of his misery] "This entertainment of yours reeks of corruption."

70f0f492-de8c-483c-9b53-83570ace72e8.Text: "A delicacy most sophisticated. I must have a taste myself, perhaps at a later time."

94ac9c6a-8ab6-45ad-a357-c69a3eed1c4d.Text: "I suggest we do not delve too deeply into this discussion."

6b03639e-ff37-4a19-9632-98317bf9c1a6.Text: "Your sentences have deprived me of several suppliers of valuable equipment."

164e81e2-d949-4abd-98b8-f9f77b9b97a1.Text: "What fate did you bestow upon Falco?"

9a1b2f09-a39e-4cc5-8791-27689a7d7891.Text: "I am going to see Calcazar. I have questions for him."

b4e477f4-1e6a-4422-a1e8-43e973522fbf.Text: Saved the victims of Incendia Chorda's judgement by letting them swear loyalty to House von Valancius.

f1a60ede-6258-4d66-963e-2e836037c334.Text: [Address the crowd] "Those of you who acknowledge me as your sovereign are viewed by the law as subjects of House von Valancius and therefore are exempt from Chorda's judgement. I will take you aboard my ship."

81b4194d-07c5-4db3-b19f-7122c5e66933.Text: Submitted yourself to Incendia Chorda's judgement.

b91c22cf-20fa-4519-b20f-50e4d8bd9ddb.Text: "You said you would not rest until you had judged every soul on this station. I, too, wish to stand before your court."

cdf65106-16c9-4f61-a064-bd20884b0d12.Text: "What do you wish me to do?"

a25d0c47-ab2f-43cf-856b-da292dde8c57.Text: Used forbidden sorcery to conceal your nature from Incendia Chorda.

3ffa286a-507e-44f8-b980-3f3f78661013.Text: [Whisper the words of the forbidden spell] "If you can see corruption in me — indict away!"

7f175369-e57c-4275-b20b-b0b0478f332d.Text: "I do not see a single tome of the Lex Imperialis in this place, which means that you have spurned the letter of the Emperor's Law and that of Holy Terra — your judgement is your own. How far have you fallen in your hubris, Incendia?"

cd1c6939-3023-440e-8449-18f87a07a0cf.Text: [Point at the man with the open skull] "What... is that?"

41c33890-e304-4fb5-b4d9-827961e81026.Text: "I haven't the slightest desire to get involved in your petty squabbles."

610a27c2-cc5c-4de9-9350-5ef3c143c075.Text: "Correction: Calligos Winterscale is a dead traitor."

2657e32a-4356-4f77-b0ae-0fd43124a0d6.Text: "I wholeheartedly share your indignation. Calligos is a reprobate."

c6472452-bd18-4451-af9a-b9c2faf18506.Text: "Have you and Calligos lost your minds? The Expanse is in a calamitous state, and you two are busy settling scores! You must cease this at once."

e5585ba9-0e6f-403a-83e4-9d132d9a1181.Text: "If you ask me, you are simply using the situation to plunder his protectorate. Should he call upon House von Valancius for help, we will answer."

889cbd70-382e-421f-ad47-3487a132d573.Text: {n}Incendia Chorda is absorbed in reading a long strip of parchment. Her left hand is holding a silver spoon, with which she is carefully scooping up brain matter from the open skull of the man contorted next to her.{/n} "{name} von Valancius. I was informed of your arrival."

c1bd27e6-e09b-45f5-ab6d-1726157ad45b.Text: {n}Incendia looks up from her parchment and enquires tensely,{/n} "What brings you to me, {name}?"

c05ee3a3-3a49-481f-a930-d9f4f58b61fb.Text: "I never doubted you, {name}. The Emperor protects."

80733a4a-b0c4-4866-9b5d-f77ff34fe7ef.Text: {n}Exhaustion has marked Incendia's features with a criss-cross of lines and deeper furrows. Her cheek is forever twisted in a continuous nervous tic, yet her eyes are ablaze with indomitable resolve. A dazzling aura of power and righteous fury surrounds her like a mantle. She gracefully brings a gold-plated inhaler to her lips, takes a deep breath, and the fire in her gaze flares like a plasma thruster.{/n}

8873a8ad-734b-41e4-bf6b-c25cad06051c.Text: "Yes, it has, although its journey here took far too long. But never again will it release its grip on this station. I vow it."

21000bb6-d7c1-415c-a57a-fb11b9345b5e.Text: {n}Incendia cracks her neck, which must have grown stiff after so many hours of reading, before picking up another sheet. Everywhere you look, servants are buckling under heavy stacks of new denunciations, warrants, and other documents.{/n}

19194584-56e9-4ed3-b95d-7d62deb3c563.Text: {n}Incendia jerks her chin up and responds haughtily,{/n} "This IS true justice. Unprejudiced, inescapable, and equally merciless to all."

7e9b758c-ba1a-4047-88a0-e55128b419ec.Text: "The Lord Inquisitor has bestowed upon me the honour of bringing order to this cesspool of pirates and heretics. To rid Footfall of the corruption that has fettered its limbs and turned this Imperial station into a hotbed of freethinking and inefficiency. And I will not rest until all have been judged."

545fd453-c2bd-49cc-8eb4-b4900b2fe1a7.Text: {n}Incendia studies you with a predatory smile.{/n} "It must have been the Emperor's providence that brought you here to my court. It would be my pleasure to indict you for the crimes you have committed."

f94c4206-35ca-4c3d-a68f-64f83b39a185.Text: "It pleases me that you get to share in the triumph of Footfall's purging with me."

0181fd4f-7f56-4ecb-9c00-5296dcbfe26a.Text: {n}You swallow the brain matter, and it slips down into your stomach without the slightest issue. You hear a weak moan from the victim — and catch Marazhai's enraptured gaze, who looks like he could faint from sheer exhilaration.{/n}

8c191df0-d49c-4ba3-8a6c-8452fe017be5.Text: {n}Incendia touches a panel on the throne's armrest and is immediately shielded by a refractor field. You hear the sounds of alarms going off in the distance. A mocking smile cuts across her face.{/n} "Go ahead, {name}. Give me a reason."

beb97ae1-3e6b-4381-974e-60380f9cc990.Text: {n}The warrior clad in Inquisitorial armour announces,{/n} "The Lord Inquisitor's instructions were to maintain order and ensure his allies' safety. Using any methods, however extreme they may have to be."

e94281cb-d6df-4516-be70-bea3c9fbf99d.Text: "My regards to you, {name}." {n}He glances at Incendia proudly.{/n} "I knew I was right about you."

bcc07eff-fcac-4b59-8d3f-67c095c6db52.Text: "There, there, {name}." {n}Marazhai's voice is dripping with feigned pity.{/n} "Control yourself. Nevertheless... I cannot say the sentiment does not delight me. Even if you still have much to learn." {n}He graces Incendia with a condescending glance, then looks back at you with repressed pride.{/n}

09d121d5-7eba-4e9d-81d4-b9cdd8cb5a80.Text: "Do not hope that mimicking me and listening to your pet inhuman will let you glean the things I have gleaned from the taste of this heretic's thoughts. I do this with disgust and in the Emperor's name, while you are driven by morbid delight and twisted curiosity."

cdd6167d-538b-4f2d-b59d-df0294bcf72f.Text: "Everyone knows how freely you interpret the strict prohibitions of the Emperor. With a feeble heart, you grant mercy to those who do not deserve it, you do not punish transgressions with the utmost severity, and you do not strike terror into your subjects that will bring them to pious trepidation. You waste your energy and attention on the needs of nonentities instead of turning them to His service. Under your hand, dangerous freethinking and satiety flourish, and will soon swell with the plagues of anarchy and decadence."

9a2aefbc-25b5-4762-a719-de70c569af85.Text: {n}The warrior clad in armour adorned with the sign of the Inquisition speaks in a voice that is even and dry like paper:{/n} "The Lord Inquisitor is aware of Rogue Trader von Valancius's arrival on Footfall. He allowed it and gave no order of persecution. Rather, the Lord Inquisitor's will is that Rogue Trader von Valancius be treated with respect befitting {mf|his|her} high status. In her assertions, Lady Chorda is coming dangerously close to abusing her authority and violating the chain of command. This is your warning."

8cdb160e-3154-47db-9a2b-5a6dee781502.Text: {n}Incendia's pale cheek is hit by a spasm. Her lips curl as she mutters,{/n} "I have no intention of questioning the Lord Inquisitor's orders. Perhaps he wishes to receive you in one piece so that he may conduct a personal interrogation."

df8a3248-9ac6-4c9c-82a8-672bf550cf5d.Text: "That you are loathed and feared by the enemies of Humanity does not make you pure in the eyes of the Emperor. But perhaps He saw fit to set you on a different path, one of righteous xenocide and blood-soaked redemption for your faults. I would never dare to gainsay His will."

48892348-ad03-4737-8d6c-cf22c2bbd17e.Text: "That the enemies of Humanity see you as their rival in the fight for Humanity's souls does not absolve you in the eyes of this court."

f560ef87-415b-4741-a6e2-02c1d0cd9dff.Text: "Your... intrepidity gives me reason to doubt the sufficiency of my evidence. Perhaps I should hold off on delivering the verdict. Briefly." {n}Her outraged expression does not bode well.{/n}

a18e0aea-4af3-48ce-88d0-21ed992c9c5e.Text: "Speak your piece, {name}. You are but a step away from making statements that will be considered an infringement upon my privileges, so I invite you to continue."

6502cded-f6a8-463a-96d9-2d4dbf3da7a7.Text: {n}After clearing his throat and presenting his Interrogator's regalia, Heinrix pronounces imperatively,{/n} "On behalf of the Koronus Conclave, I hereby inform Rogue Trader House Chorda that, by order of Lord Inquisitor Calcazar, Rogue Trader von Valancius has been placed in the custody of the Inquisition. Any attack on {mf|his|her} safety is to be treated as an act of interference in the affairs of the Inquisition."

a258906c-7657-4f5f-85ec-2af7e2065a9d.Text: "You insult the Emperor's judgement! You taunt the Rogue Trader! You blaspheme! Do not think for one second that you will get away with this!"

767d877d-a3bf-4166-8a76-2712cf08f244.Text: "Indeed I am. When the Lord Inquisitor enacted martial law in the Expanse, I offered him my support at once. Footfall was chosen as the Lord Inquisitor's headquarters, and the position of Footfall's Liege was temporarily abolished for the duration of this war... or perhaps longer than that. All authority was transferred to the station's warden — to me. While the Lord Inquisitor is preoccupied with matters of strategic planning, I am tasked with overseeing security and order."

1c62c00d-713b-4b02-abf2-78897ac5e75b.Text: {n}Incendia, who is engaged in reading one of her many parchments, greets you in a voice that is sonorous and solemn:{/n} "{name} von Valancius, I am pleased to see you. In this dark hour, when all the filth of the Expanse has caught the scent of freedom and crawled to the surface, it is comforting to see a faithful ally at my side. Together, we shall {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_Footfall_VladaymHanged}finish the purging of Footfall{/d} and restore order to every system in the Expanse!"

aab04d64-7414-446d-bf20-8a0071386417.Text: "Everyone knows that your cursed ship hosts traitors to the Emperor and worshippers of the Ruinous Powers. In every port you visit, people disappear and the seeds of evil cults take root. You shamelessly flaunt your perverted morals and offer patronage to those who revere you as if you were a deity. Your capital is a cesspool of filth that spreads heresy throughout the sector."

3a39e398-785a-4029-bb68-9156e2ff8072.Text: "Let us weigh the gravity of your transgressions, {name}, and learn how you have sullied yourself in the Emperor's eyes."

36c4a6ef-9aa4-4c1e-bb8d-1f86672f64d4.Text: "You pretend to be a faithful and devout servant of the Emperor, but you show no true zeal or fervour in faith. Your ship does not shake with hymns and chants to glorify His name, and your capital has not been led into pious trepidation. In so dark an hour, you have been granted the honour of being a light of righteousness in the eyes of the Expanse, but your light... is traitorously dim."

1d0ecb21-42b2-464d-a741-5ccdc25c78b8.Text: "I deem the evidence against you sufficient to cast you as an enemy of Humanity."

8fdb24f7-f977-4de1-88f3-c3f7ab35b42c.Text: "All of them! Thieves, smugglers, pirates, traitors, heretics, deserters! Abettors, harbourers, cowards, and perjurers! Any who has ever trespassed, any who has ever protected a miscreant or kept quiet about a crime they knew of. They all will be condemned!" {n}With obsessive determination, Incendia starts going through her papers, seemingly no longer aware that she is doing so.{/n}

573cdf2e-8d44-448a-9bb3-89ce47bce98a.Text: "We have made several attempts to arrest him, yet he has evaded capture each time. Reverend Hieronymus has gone there to convince him to surrender quietly, but his efforts have likewise been unsuccessful. In the interest of Footfall's integrity, Tocara must be apprehended."

d4f16d85-fdde-4c53-9254-fa9b15b3a893.Text: "Together, we shall make that scoundrel pay for his crimes. Let him drink the cup of His wrath to full, a cup that will be delivered by our hands."

379c47bc-d3c9-490b-abcc-5d04de8dc9e5.Text: "As the Rogue Trader in authority, I order you to aid me in bringing him to justice."

fc313499-e942-480f-a5ce-fd2203d8c4e4.Text: "The asteroid where the Adeptus Amasecus is located has been cordoned off, but my enforcer will take you there. I want you to lure Tocara out of his hole and seize him so that he may stand trial. Do this for the sake of Footfall's liberation and pave the road that my justice will tread."

aa5b8f75-cad5-4eb6-a31c-39dd3938cf56.Text: "Not a single pure soul has been brought before me, {name}. Be it in their deeds or intentions, all have been guilty before the Emperor."

682e2ceb-e259-4635-bb9c-d41dd21b121e.Text: "And let my vow be heard: I shall not leave this station, I shall not yield to sleep, I shall not let my body be washed until every last criminal who hides in this lawless den has faced His judgement!"

2905883b-d40b-49ed-ad7c-cfca316c6652.Text: "The universe is a terrifying place. We are surrounded by the Archenemy's machinations and xenos scum who would deny us our right to exist. The threat is inconceivable, and human weakness will not help us avert it. If man is weak, I rid him of his spinelessness and feebleness, endowing him with a sacred narrowness of mind and eradicating all that prevents him from utilising his whole self in the service of the Imperium."

e0163e09-f31a-472e-9c94-e2672ade943e.Text: {n}Incendia's face twists in displeasure, and her voice trembles with anger and tension:{/n} "You still cannot grasp the fact that everything has changed, {name}. Gone is the time when you could do only what you wished to do. It is now time to do what you must."

7d068083-a65a-448f-b883-70db0400c2ff.Text: "Not carnage, but judgement. His judgement. And I know of no other delight than serving Him."

975451d9-7f80-4c80-a246-436026d28aab.Text: "I thought I was speaking to you, and yet I hear Theodora's words, greedy and full of hubris. Your 'gain' is the order that will come to this station and its obedience to the Emperor, His law, and His stewards."

5ff1c545-6d12-4b8e-81c7-adf9be373028.Text: "Such is the law of Footfall. Any Rogue Trader who arrives here assumes the right of absolute authority. Surely it is not that thug Tocara who deserves to rule this station. He will soon be hanging from a noose, and so will his Kasballican henchmen, and so will those Anver firebrands whose outrageous activities brought Footfall so much grief."

ce49af9a-bf3f-4527-afa2-aea8bd2da434.Text: "And there is much to do on that front. Pirates and smugglers, apostates and Cold Traders, deserters and outlaws... Every one of them warrants attention."

6313a991-67c0-4623-8f6a-97eb9af8913b.Text: "Why wouldn't I? That vile rogue's infamy is known to all. He patronised thieves, smugglers, and pirates. By his leave, heresies and unholy cults flourished. That he has evaded punishment this long can only be described as gross negligence, which I intend to rectify in short order."

444521c4-9128-4135-b9d2-0e962ebefbe3.Text: "Reverend Hieronymus headed where the rebels are seen most often, so he could preach to them and sway them to repent. Alas, he still cannot see the difference between those who have erred and those who are beyond any hope of redemption."

4e8e3e08-55b5-4ee3-8d6e-cc952bdb1eca.Text: {n}Incendia seems slightly perplexed by your question. She starts moving signed sentences from one stack to another, then says uncertainly,{/n} "Three... weeks. The court carries on day and night, so my sense of time eludes me."

38a9f60c-ec3f-4908-8e72-e3ddaed49c6c.Text: "The scoundrels and thieves will be replaced by honest suppliers. Even degenerates such as the Kasballica can be of some use in the coming crisis, but their wilful leaders need to be replaced with more pliable and trepidatious successors. It is the only way for us to protect ourselves from being stabbed in the back."

16461aad-0c28-404f-8aba-97d90fb8a6bb.Text: "Since you, {name}, helped me {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_FootfallNotAlly}curb Calligos's... appetites{/d} once before, I will invite you to divide his territories with me. Once we have extinguished these roaring flames of wickedness, House von Valancius will be welcome to partake in the conquest of that profaner's worlds."

84aacdf4-72a8-4c6e-8d5b-01e085292f27.Text: "I thought you and I were allies. But if you wish to challenge my authority... you are welcome to try." {n}Incendia touches a panel on the throne's armrest and is immediately shielded by a refractor field. You hear the sounds of alarms going off in the distance.{/n}

9df0a85e-625c-4d9e-a84e-058091773430.Text: "In the Liege's chambers, coordinating the Expanse's defence. His attention is focused on matters of vital importance, and he is not seeing any supplicants."

f6bb471b-d36d-4550-a43f-f960cb64861b.Text: {n}The soldier wearing Inquisitorial armour echoes Incendia's words:{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} cannot see the Lord Inquisitor now. However, he bade to inform Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} that he will summon you later, when circumstances permit."

1145bed7-f8aa-454a-9521-a1446a9cbee0.Text: "He is no more, then. Regrettably, he {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_WinterscaleDead}found his demise so easily{/d}. Calligos was meant to confess before the court and taste the detestation he deserved."

e3e774c7-43a3-4f31-9e1d-0790b3e1f12f.Text: "Astrocartographers will soon have their hands full erasing the name 'Winterscale's Realm' from star maps. The castigating disgrace that will fall upon the dynasty will be a fitting punishment for Calligos's crimes."

a4689e23-b155-4ab9-8819-20b29cc07c77.Text: "Negotiating with that mad dog is off the table now. He will merely laugh at your talk of reconciliation and execute your envoys. For too long has Calligos revelled in impunity and believed himself the king of his world."

2348d493-b511-40d7-b8b6-6c656b2d4b51.Text: {n}Incendia's smile turns vicious.{/n} "I do so enjoy candour. When the one who stands before the court admits openly that {mf|he|she} shares the beliefs of someone about to be pronounced an outright anarchist and traitor to the Imperium... I say such a confession should earn {mf|him|her} a swift and less agonising execution."

e70dce5c-955c-4908-b809-12f3be7c571f.Text: "If Her Ladyship is gravely threatened, we are authorised to detonate the dome over this sector. Doing so will trigger an explosive decompression. The attackers will be destroyed during depressurisation while Her Ladyship will be protected by the field projected by her throne. I urge you not to take steps that might be interpreted as an act of aggression."

ce8b07c8-ceb9-46b6-b104-c3f2f8d8e28d.Text: {n}Incendia does not bat an eye at the man's death.{/n} "A laughable accusation. Do you think yourself capable of detecting corruption?"

09776027-612e-4a99-a18b-37c02537224f.Text: "A pure soul cannot conceive or fathom the workings of an unrighteous mind. The weak embrace their ignorance, while the strong banish it. If only you knew what it is like to be familiar with every shade of corruption that lurks in depraved souls..."

bf1c9afd-846a-4689-bc02-21ffbd3fc075.Text: "I have deepened my understanding of the petty and odious urges that drive the weak-willed to degeneracy. I have learned to see these urges in their eyes. If only you knew what it is like to be familiar with every shade of corruption that lurks in depraved souls..."

1989a471-0668-400a-a9fc-38e70d96a0bb.Text: "It is not some perverted craving for pleasure. I educate myself to discern the corruption that dwells in the hearts and minds of the impure."

e25af888-8d3b-4c5d-b76c-a73ecdf36afb.Text: "Wait. You have a duty to the Emperor that you must see to. Vladaym Tocara, the deplorable rebel who once ruled this station, has slipped from my grasp. He is inciting the people to revolt, killing my servants, and hiding from my wrath with the dexterity of a void rat. My informers claim he often appears in that den of unrest that bears the irreverent name the Adeptus Amasecus."

230de526-f3f0-4624-8a1e-2e66e450b8b1.Text: {n}She is not lying. You can tell by her eyes and her voice, trembling with earnest faith, that Incendia genuinely believes in every word she just said.{/n}

3be0d4f8-168d-4885-8620-622b1b368ee9.Text: {n}No matter how hard you try, you cannot discern what makes Incendia's voice tremble when she speaks of justice — the zeal of true faith or the lusting ecstasy of a maniac.{/n}

6ac74ee9-2aa3-4b4b-aabe-280b7f680b0c.Text: {n}One look at Incendia's full dress uniform shows that it has not been changed in many days — the collar is greasy, and the braid trim is stained with sweat. The air is tinged with the smell of an inhaled stimulant that is used to give serfs the ability to work multiple watches without rest.{/n}

aa79b9b1-dbd0-40e8-b050-680f09a7184e.Text: "As long as you refuse to cooperate, Footfall's isolated sectors will remain off-limits to you. Go and consider my words... and your position." {n}With a brusqueness bordering on the offensive, Incendia dismisses you with a flick of her hand.{/n}

6eb1dbfa-8072-44a9-b41f-92d0a497ccad.Text: {n}Cracking her neck, stiff from many hours of reading documents, Incendia again dips her silver spoon and scoops out brain matter from the open skull of the poor fellow standing next to her. Everywhere you look, servants are buckling under heavy stacks of new denunciations, warrants, and other documents.{/n}

d48b5678-273b-4f25-9957-42ffdfc9540f.Text: {n}Incendia wearily leans on an armrest and looks at you with contempt.{/n} "Take this pitiful gaggle of miscreants, {name}, if you so desire. My trial will not end here — I have the whole of Footfall to judge."

8aedf8ae-d2ed-4f2f-98f3-35bb024883fa.Text: {n}It is difficult to look at Incendia for long — you cannot stop glancing at her eyes, burning like embers, their gaze so hypnotising and oppressive that it fills you with the shameful urge to cast your eyes down.{/n}

b2f85e6e-ba6b-411a-be74-a34caf5c9ede.Text: "I have encountered sanctioned death cults that practised cannibalism as part of their way of praising the Emperor. A surprisingly large number of them harboured heresy within."

177979b3-007a-4273-a9b9-710ded1b02be.Text: "You have suspicions about me? Well, it is your duty to suspect. But do your eyes see any trespass here? No. I have committed no malefaction against Him."

7d7433d7-5bf0-475a-b6e1-331633f1fd99.Text: "As for that pirate Ryzza, there is no need for you to mourn her. Yes, she did come across valuable prizes at times, but more often than not those prizes were tainted. Surely some other rat from her crew has already taken over her profane trade at the Amasecus and will be open for business... until I hang the lot of them, that is."

1b2342ab-18fd-47a8-80e5-33cfa0a0db62.Text: "If you are looking for Tocara's replacement, let me give you a name: Octaviana. My spies have discovered that, after his trial, she became the head representative of the Kasballica on Footfall. For now, I allow her to conduct her unscrupulous dealings — the Kasballica has promised to pay us generously with resources we need and fall in line if I halt the repressions. Those fools... I am only granting them a short respite before the inevitable trial."

c1722373-7482-4336-8ca0-84486f247abe.Text: "His crimes were grievous, but they were no barrier to his receiving mercy. The heretic was purified in a holy procedure and converted to a new mission to serve the Imperium as a servitor. As were many, many others."

ba74473a-7e36-40b0-82b3-19a331754c05.Text: "I'm afraid you will not have the opportunity to ask them — the Lord Inquisitor has left Footfall. He charged me with the defence of the Furibundus System and departed on a secret mission in great haste. None are privy to its details." {n}Incendia's tone carries a note of wounded pride.{/n}

c8ee8480-5285-4ab5-bc63-155326544cd1.Text: {n}The hopeful crowd in the Atrium starts hysterically clamouring their oaths of fealty to House von Valancius. Not one of them thinks twice about clutching at the lifeline you have offered them.{/n}

54f21bda-47c4-4885-a39a-1a1c7508ec53.Text: {n}Incendia stares at you in amazement.{/n} "You truly wish to stand trial? Very well. May your zeal serve as an example to the rest."

799dbe62-bd2b-48d5-a0c6-a40faeeee59d.Text: "Winterscale is a traitor! While the Expanse burns, ravaged by heretics and unhallowed xenos, he abandoned his duty completely and had the nerve to ignore the Lord Inquisitor's call to battle. My servants are capturing his worlds and ships while he hides from his reckoning, indulging his base urges. Soon enough, he too will stand before judgement."

1becc088-0da8-4980-b4e9-d842139dfea8.Text: "Take joy in the sight of a new and transformed Footfall." {n}Incendia tiredly closes her eyes, then pulls out a small book of Drusian prayers and starts reading. A serene smile soon spreads across her face.{/n}

a88293a0-e81e-4edc-8ffc-c4e7ff91181c.Text: {n}Incendia leans forward and peers into your eyes. Her gaze, like a monk carrying a rushlight, wanders down the corridors of your soul's fortress, checking every corner in search of the slightest faults or traces of corruption. Moments pass as Incendia conducts her thorough investigation, until at last, she reclines on her throne again. A weary smile touches her lips.{/n}

fb29d17f-3427-4432-813c-2dd3f00808b1.Text: "This attempt was mediocre and far from the first. But my enforcers and my throne keep me safe." {n}Incendia pats an armrest and smiles.{/n} "Its refractor field is impervious even to tank shells. That thief Tocara had this sacred Drusian relic stashed in one of his storerooms."

b0bf3305-fb70-4b14-a91f-f008e02a9267.Text: "I see no sign of taint in your soul, {name}. You are pure before the Emperor, and thus I acquit you and grant you His blessing in parting. Go forth and bring His punishment to those who have turned their back on His word."

aa0c4af9-ee57-4b2b-999f-9d467d2404eb.Text: "In due time, I shall weed out all the taint that has bred here on Footfall for so long. And then pious fear, loyalty, and devotion will once again become the pillars of this station under His watchful eye."

2a31f2e7-6628-4469-925f-a1f5504243bf.Text: "I promised you that I would clean up Footfall, and I have kept my promise. By virtue of {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_FootfallNotAlly}your support{/d}, the station will once again be an outpost of the Imperium — a purified bastion of industriousness and righteousness. The heretics who dared defy me have nearly been eradicated to the last."

b1ce6e5a-4834-4f10-83e0-84cfec14174c.Text: {n}She looks at you with a gloating smirk.{/n} "Once, you {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_FootfallAlly}hindered my efforts to subdue this station{/d}. And yet here I am now, dispensing justice to the wicked. I only regret that I was unable to begin sooner — then Tocara's troublemakers would have already been crushed, instead of lurking in cargo bays and maintenance tunnels. Regardless, I will deal with them soon enough."

97dcf130-4a8b-4842-883b-c256e72d10c1.Text: {n}Marazhai's eyes are locked on the wretched soul who has had his skull cracked open. The corner of the Drukhari's mouth twitches, stretching his gaunt face into a twisted grin.{/n}

a4bbc61a-9b04-4649-a261-36df8bc10766.Text: "Perceiving corruption? What lofty yet paltry hysterics. Your methods, however..." {n}Marazhai looks Incendia over and lets out a wanton laugh.{/n} "This place is soaked with pain, much like the torture chambers of my old spire. It takes a skilled hand to elicit such refined, artful anguish. Impressive! I am amazed by this mon-keigh's ingenuity... and her intricate means of indulging her passion." {n}His gaze shifts to the bare-brained man.{/n}

0a5dff04-ea95-4842-8e41-ad95b66487d6.Text: "Remove that profane filth from my sight. It sickens me to observe the degraded inhuman's pathetic attempts at vying for attention. The only thing that stays its immediate death are your Rogue Trader's privileges that grant you the right to drag around such xenos refuse in your retinue. However desperate my wish to exterminate it might be, I shall not go against the word of the law here, in a place where His solemn justice is served."

eae60c16-8494-40bf-ac74-8a1d47147188.Text: {n}Incendia sinks her silver spoon into the man's brain and slowly consumes the revolting morsel.{/n} "I must know the taste of a criminal's thoughts. It is how I learn to recognise their patterns."

15177235-09fa-40ac-91aa-a67bb8b2ef24.Text: {n}Marazhai appears to have ignored her tirade completely and continues speaking nonchalantly, his gaze still focused on the wretched victim:{/n} "Such a shame it is that the Rogue Trader I crossed paths with is not capable of enjoying such fine delights... or is {mf|he|she}?" {n}He watches you, his eyes devouring.{/n}

5d38cab1-d1ed-428b-bbc1-44cb0c07d6dd.Text: {n}Marazhai looks at Incendia's meal. An intrigued smirk appears on his lips — the xenos is waiting to see your reaction.{/n}

2e23aeee-e623-4286-b5f7-a1c7535cc6bb.Text: {n}Marazhai clicks his tongue and looks away, immediately losing all interest in both you and Incendia, and in everything that is happening in her hall of justice, apparently.{/n}

df0eccc8-1950-4577-8ee2-52dc1046fc89.Text: {n}The brain matter spills inside your mouth, slips down into your gullet... and instantly triggers a wave of nausea. You barely stop yourself from losing the contents of your stomach with everyone watching. Your eyes tear up, and your vision goes dark — and not a shred of your suffering escapes Marazhai's notice as he savours every shift in your expression.{/n}

356e1fde-ff83-4ca9-85f7-7a8da667c23c.Text: {n}Marazhai flinches but reacts too slowly to stop you. He turns away with a resentful hiss, visibly disappointed.{/n}

b032c9ce-beb2-4c71-97dc-90cc73212352.Text: "Then let us begin." {n}Chorda leans forward and stares intently into your eyes. Scarcely has Incendia's gaze met yours than she begins writhing in pain and clutching her head. She takes a deep breath and tries to look you in the eye again, only for a new flash of pain to almost make her cry out. Confusion and fear are visible in her eyes.{/n}

c18b41a4-c1ae-4993-9cc2-797b3a2d5da7.Text: "I... cannot. I cannot see your crimes. How is this possible? Someone like you cannot be pure!"

5fe25efd-cc3c-49e1-8f0f-dd1e08aa6642.Text: "What is this abominable act His daughter is committing?" {n}The Sister of Battle whispers incredulously as she stares at Chorda's monstrous feast.{/n} "There must be... a reason..."

1b62c633-3a01-4036-93cd-8e179e07bd72.Text: "Does it not satisfy you that order and Imperial Compliance will be restored on Footfall? I see you learned too much from Theodora — namely, her hubris, greed, and indifference to duty."

0d071dc3-f2d6-41ea-a65b-bf55831b16cb.Text: {n}Something wild sparks in her pale eyes.{/n} "You know not the first thing about perceiving it. Sensing it! Peering into people's souls and seeing the heinousness therein. You do not know what it's like to look at their faces and see the brand of their impious deeds. But I know it all too well! And none shall escape my wrath!"

525e3ed9-8d66-4ede-9a30-171c4e57c903.Text: "Has it by any chance occurred to the Inquisitor that he, too, is getting dangerously close to something slightly insane? How can a thing like this be tolerated? How can anyone look calmly upon these atrocities and think everything's going as it should?"

afd3f805-2f79-41bf-87b7-4e15b1f46b76.Text: "Calm yourself, Idira." {n}Abelard steps between the psyker and Chorda.{/n} "I can understand your anger, but by the God-Emperor, another word out of turn... and you will find yourself following those unfortunates."

3c99f61d-5bbb-4c8f-ac20-70396b3acc61.Text: "This is no tribunal. This is slaughter."

bcb9b518-4302-4ce8-897e-e3b5a0c71a8a.Text: {n}Argenta grimaces.{/n} "Loath as my soul is to concur with a xenos... it is indeed."

b79c2240-5164-405d-8aa4-0c0e90ddc30c.Text: "More and more new convicts are being granted the great boon of undergoing Servitude Imperpituis and, having rid themselves of reprehensible consciousness, of serving the Imperium free from doubt and weakness. Footfall will once again become a bastion of law and righteousness — I will eradicate all heresy that prevents the faithless from giving themselves over to the good of toiling in His name!"

b92cb1a6-c420-428d-a29f-5cc7bd256aad.Text: "Flesh and blood can grant revelations, but not like this. Devouring flesh is a profane act." {n}Kibellah looks with disapproval at the open brain and the pulsing blue vein within.{/n} "This is not the way to serve the Undying One."

824e8c9a-aa76-4262-a0ee-d303777d7cf3.Text: {n}Idira lets out a quiet whistle.{/n} "If even Skully is bothered by it, then it must be bad."

8bc756dd-a815-48a8-816a-7522eab8c2a5.Text: {n}Solomorne makes a decisive motion as if to step into the line of fire in front of you.{/n} "I remind you, Rogue Trader Chorda, that you may judge common people, but not someone who is your equal. Much less..." {n}You receive a long, hard stare.{/n} "...{mf|him|her}. Take care when making accusations."

fba04f26-6322-4276-a3c4-e7200059f942.Text: {n}Incendia's eyes gleam in triumph as she points at Solomorne accusingly.{/n} "I long refused to believe that Theodora had bribed the Adeptus Arbites to turn a blind eye to her misdeeds, but now I see that heresy has corrupted the servants of the Lex Imperialis. Which means that all judgement in His name is now my duty alone."

6ba88d21-a37c-47f1-b64f-0330845f25cf.Text: "It is well within her right to decide the fates of the station's inhabitants, but that does not change the fact that this is a perversion of justice. This is what happens when a judge is driven by morbid fanaticism instead of the Lex."

7f9af0e2-3f0a-4bdd-9644-bd3919e54d2a.Text: "Do you think that I find enjoyment in this? Looking at vileness upon vileness, listening to one excuse after another? I loathe this and despise every malefactor out there. If I were weak of will, I would have obliterated this foul station with nuclear fire. Instead, I am here to offer each of them the right to be judged in His name and the chance to return to His fold renewed."

598c080d-14f8-452e-a228-823c5a3dcc95.Text: "You have the gall to accuse me of heresy? No, you are the one indulging your hubris by thinking that {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Arbitrator}your former life{/d} outweighs the deeds of your present! Hide behind your dusty tomes all you want — I will show you true justice."

2dea2d4b-91b5-4a76-b058-fdd212b22012.Text: "But remember..." {n}Incendia's eyes flash maniacally.{/n} "None of the rebel leaders are allowed to die before their trial. I forbid you to execute them without my leave."

ec4c2357-5310-4767-aec3-60933cb9f6e7.Text: "I understand. I, too, had always accepted Reverend Hieronymus's relics with great reverence. However, there is more to the followers of Saint Drusus than Hieronymus Doloroso. Speak to the missionary everyone calls Chaplain. He preaches to the rabble at the Adeptus Amasecus. After Hieronymus's death, he became the new leader of the pious on Footfall and the new keeper of its reliquary."

823c5109-efd2-4ede-932c-8d269f2530cb.Text: "Have you come to wish me good luck, Vladaym?"

7fefe1f0-a6ea-4811-b879-a546fef0ca5e.Text: "Octaviana, the Amasecus is going to have to get by without my tips for a while."

0633b5b6-bec7-4bfe-82be-1d3aadaa3ba2.Text: "Is blessing me the only thing you're here to do, Hieronymus?"

e04a1939-dcb0-4465-8883-eec7e88795ba.Text: "Is blessing me the only thing you're here to do, Chaplain?"

1e390a53-2d82-46fb-ae6d-3d51d3950972.Text: "Ryzza, are you here to discuss business or just to wish me good luck?"

c909a5f0-8cc4-4b17-905d-54c91394be54.Text: [Address the trembling pirate] "What do you want?"

3bfcea6b-0ec5-434c-a23b-5b586458edbd.Text: [Turn to the officer] "What are your orders?"

29ddabad-1e10-4047-80d7-1e3d85cce915.Text: "You really ought to give up the smuggling. Or you'll end up like someone we both know."

4591d6b5-4f83-46c0-a2de-2a543ea7307e.Text: "Quit acting like a bartender and start getting used to being a criminal kingpin."

91531979-c6cb-4ca0-ab5e-fbaeda4c3967.Text: "I expect you to maintain order on the station."

314b23e2-da2a-4e1c-9ad1-98f2002aade8.Text: "May the Emperor help you in your undertaking."

e3181746-d10c-4dcf-ae57-fb3608b2e959.Text: "Do not forget about mercy, good shepherd. It is as important as justice."

5906746c-7108-4a9d-b583-d9583e3509eb.Text: "Wear your scars as a reminder and do not repeat your past mistakes."

9d77707a-736e-4ae1-9a39-98cc0620e1c0.Text: "Remember Hieronymus's mistakes, Chaplain. And do not repeat them."

5ab5e5d1-e3c4-4f6a-b3b9-3111073012cd.Text: "If I were you, I would swear off preaching and go back to piracy."

a665e42a-e241-4869-8267-4945c2d69df4.Text: "Glory to the Omnissiah. Try to be worthy of your predecessor."

6caf4c68-59c8-4568-8d7d-450681f30481.Text: "Just know that when I am back, I will cleanse the Expanse of the Archenemy's servants. And you had better not be among them."

8b020651-c8f0-4381-8abc-6dbb0237ff73.Text: "How dare you show up here and tarnish my good name by talking to me, pirate scum!"

4bbf9fdc-45c6-49ff-88ee-856d3bec1ad5.Text: "Do your duty, but do not be needlessly harsh. The Expanse is still inhabited by free people."

f16a26a8-9f05-402b-b8af-2e9bc29cfffe.Text: "Protect the Expanse while I am away."

e6a7e516-2702-475a-93d5-c0bf9e211cf1.Text: "I expect my worlds to be under your special protection."

bd38032a-0b4c-4406-80c4-ef5f07afdb95.Text: "When I return, I expect you to have learned to act like the Fellowship of the Void's new leader and not a snivelling wimp."

41f6c9eb-fb40-4e63-9a8c-ac63a7dcd89e.Text: "Your plundering operations should be in overdrive. I will return with valuable trophies."

dbf7cc31-b7a1-4ae2-8db1-2a527daee6ed.Text: [Smile] "No shenanigans while I'm away. Or I'll have you strung up as soon as I'm back."

e8a2a9ed-698e-4004-ac71-8e0a4946d281.Text: "Why, Opticon-22 was a paragon of eloquence compared to you, cog."

f0cf6b68-e5bf-48b3-88b9-a98ee7315f41.Text: "A word of advice: give up smuggling and take care of Footfall instead. Or you will end up on the gallows after all."

41cb1f6a-4f74-4af2-bc9e-252001cd7d20.Text: "Tell all your associates that they work for me now."

b64d1fb3-c820-45e7-b220-e74092a8338a.Text: [Turn away without deigning the wretch with a reply]

fc077423-3ccb-478b-acf9-a3ba21c8b81f.Text: "Keep up the good work, but remember, you are running your business under my protection now."

7b98ba80-d8ea-469e-bc51-211193133ed5.Text: "Look for rich customers. I plan on returning with a great wealth of trophies that will need buyers."

9285e17c-726a-4713-a2d8-1fa62bc2d245.Text: {n}An entire group of people salutes you. Most of them — an escort of honour consisting of members of retinues, associates, secretaries, bodyguards, and assorted others — bow deeply to you and shout their greetings, making a lot of noise. It appears the news of your impending departure has already spread throughout the station.{/n}

61b235c2-752a-4076-8117-5349adae4ba6.Text: "I don't even know... You were {d|Encyclopedia:DrusiansRep_Min}never particularly interested in our mission{/d}, so you might as well think of me as an old voidsman who's come to pay his respects, not a clergyman. So, from one conqueror of the void to another — good luck."

932eaae5-8f36-4911-86f9-14e027f48244.Text: "Subject's status assessed as {d|Encyclopedia:AdMechRep_Max}Highest-Trusted Ally{/d}. In accordance with the mutual support manual, please confirm your readiness to receive a //fee//donation//contribution// from the Cognisance Fleet. Asset description: standard expeditionary supply set for a Revelation-02 voidship and a personal //gift//tool//blessing//."

2e2eefa1-3682-4d99-bc1c-932cd0e8de35.Text: "Leaving us, are you, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship?" {n}Vladaym Tocara is once again in his clean, decorous Imperial bureaucrat persona, as if the cutthroat who carved himself a bloody {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_Footfall_VladaymLiege}path back to the Liege's throne{/d} never existed.{/n}

e307f61b-009b-4be7-bf71-614de935ff07.Text: "My flock tells me Rogue Trader von Valancius is going off on a long expedition. It would be unrighteous to let you go without a blessing for the journey."

33c3e4fd-655f-47f1-9dfb-2379ebe82d04.Text: "The Lord Inquisitor has left us, and now you too? Footfall seems remarkably empty after recent events. All our decent patrons are taking wing."

c78e099a-243f-469c-96ef-0d4be7b75339.Text: "Communicative interaction option unlocked. Purpose of data exchange: strengthening ties and delivering //a gift//material assets//a donation// to an ally."

ac4045bf-81cf-4a06-bb11-a249a83fee02.Text: "Salutatory functionality initialised. Glory to House von Valancius. Trading terminal Zeta-42//33-Mu ready to perform the designated function. Glory to the Omnissiah."

1a110de4-e437-4045-bb33-70d7d197bc3a.Text: "We barely got the news that the Lord Inquisitor had left his cosy Footfall perch, and now you're off on a long journey, too." {n}Ryzza grins contentedly.{/n} "Thought I might as well come to see an {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_RyzzaAlive}old acquaintance{/d}."

44b72603-1857-4d03-af5f-e79541109592.Text: {n}A man with a scraggly beard bows deeply to you, {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_RyzzaDead}shaking with terror and awe{/d}.{/n} "Glory to the Emperor, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! You might not remember me at all..." {n}He seems to really hope that is the case.{/n} "I'm a merchant from the Fellowship of the Void... which has survived on and around Footfall by your good graces..."

5554bac4-1fdd-4cee-95cb-ce157c39b861.Text: "There is word among my flock that Rogue Trader von Valancius is going on a perilous voyage. So accept this blessing for the journey, noble {name}."

d1bdca19-74fd-401b-bc99-98cd3ce37339.Text: "We won't go bankrupt, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. Please accept this small gift from me... and my business partners." {n}Octaviana hands you an old, and, no doubt, {d|Encyclopedia:KasballicaRep_Mid}very expensive, bottle of dark-red amasec{/d}.{/n} "The best medicine against the terrors that lurk in the dark unknown."

7214fb87-6fd0-43a4-9901-815d2e6ab294.Text: {n}An officer in Imperial Navy uniform folds his hands in the sign of the Aquila.{/n} "It's an honour, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! I'm here on my superiors' orders to pay my respects to House von Valancius."

56dc5500-2b51-48b0-812b-0347a79c866a.Text: "To promise something, too. My mission will look after your subjects. {d|Encyclopedia:DrusiansRep_Max}You've done us a lot of good{/d}, and it would be unrighteous not to repay you in kind. Members of my congregation are already loading supplies to your ship. And I have a personal gift of appreciation for you from the Cult of Saint Drusus. With people like you, this God-Emperor-forsaken corner of the universe still has a chance to become a fine place."

fd9cf340-51c3-4150-a2b7-dc55ef3cfab8.Text: "Yes, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. On behalf of my organisation, I would like to express our regret that we have been {d|Encyclopedia:KasballicaRep_Min}unable to establish a productive business relationship{/d}. But that, I hope, is... a temporary complication, and you will eventually see the potential and promise of what we can offer you."

7541cc85-e51d-4c3d-bf01-317eca4d4a25.Text: "May Drusus the Warrior grant you good fortune in battle. And good thrust to your engines."

a6a14da3-1063-427d-bcc1-4fead0ce3124.Text: "I will remember, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. We'll all remember Reverend Hieronymus and the lessons he taught us. May the God-Emperor have mercy on his soul."

d9ae3cf6-08ec-4a4c-ba1f-cc01a0291d3f.Text: "Sometimes I dream about it myself, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. A boarding party is so much easier to lead than a congregation, so the Emperor be my witness. But Drusus the Warrior has given me a tactical objective, and so I'll pursue it."

c73ae0b3-ef69-47c4-909f-d2ed0e25588b.Text: "Request approved. Information concerning the joint cleansing of the sacred world catalogued under High-Value Data."

94605a03-9490-401a-8843-4c27c6772021.Text: "The Omnissiah knows all, comprehends all. The best of functional prosperity to you."

95ca4421-b168-4328-9baa-c1d1485452e9.Text: "Algorithmic setting accepted. Motivational framework 'Protecting the memory of a worthy unit from ignominy' catalogued. Glory to the Omnissiah."

ab6cec73-de50-4e8c-b07b-f1f8c7d42afc.Text: "Recording a blasphemous disparagement of this unit's technological capabilities. Transgression absolved due to the high value of the unit {name} von Valancius. Glory to the Omnissiah."

1246df74-1fc4-4bf5-af4c-6004e82cf27a.Text: "Ahem... I've lived too long to take such suggestions seriously anymore. Thank you for your concern, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. I will bear it in mind."

bc30bab7-a83f-4442-8d85-2fae17bbba8a.Text: "Ah, old Ryzza is going to have to do some serious prowling about before she finds something sizeable enough to satisfy so demanding a customer. But have faith in me. I'll manage."

b45bfb1c-1cee-4539-9c4e-5377b7ae7ea3.Text: {n}Ryzza stifles a chuckle.{/n} "Well, I hope you don't forget old Ryzza. You know, pick a softer rope for old time's sake."

35ae4dc8-8449-4529-be58-b3f56e1dca1d.Text: "I dare not express how flatterfied I am to hear that! I promise Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship I will take every effort to prove worthy of the great trust extendiated to me! Now that I have your support, I will most certainly bring those sons of bitches to heel!"

12d394a9-c870-4466-a6f6-de3426106603.Text: "I dare not make excuses for my most despicable blunders, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! I merely beg your mercy and clemency! We'll set everything right! We'll prove our worth! We won't fail you, I swear!"

0674d38d-d4c0-4be7-8deb-04efb6eb155c.Text: "The Fellowship of the Void will be glad to oblige a patron of such high standing, influence, and authority! And whoever isn't glad will be obliterated!"

12c3e844-c23c-4136-8670-f27159271c6c.Text: {n}The trembling merchant bows in adulation.{/n} "Why, thank you, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. It's such a pleasure to hear that. We're going to live up to your trust, be on our best behaviour, and not needlessly get in the way of high lords and ladies!"

d752d8d2-1fed-499c-a520-fbba8899c590.Text: {n}The pirate wipes the sweat from his brow, evidently relieved.{/n}

e00ec74a-82b0-41aa-b211-89252639f8c5.Text: "Although what you said is at odds with the Imperial Navy's official policy regarding this sector, I promise I will relay this to my superiors."

0219ca84-02c8-409b-87ea-0bba2033d8ec.Text: "We will not forget our duty, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. These stars will be ours!"

68cacf00-309f-4284-8a42-064177664568.Text: "The von Valancius protectorate can rely on the strength of our void armour and the might of our macro-cannons. We will see to it that your subjects are not harassed."

031a6a6c-2346-4fc0-87ae-5a3f29cb523f.Text: "Information exchange request accepted. The Cognisance Fleet regrets that an {d|Encyclopedia:AdMechRep_Min}allied relationship of higher status has not been established{/d} between its mission and House von Valancius. Therefore, the Cognisance Fleet gifts you the following asset: a wish of good fortune. Glory to the Omnissiah."

deb5b6f3-fa07-4fa7-b5a9-63da7c89427e.Text: "Why, of course. No business partner of the Kasballica Mission is {d|Encyclopedia:KasballicaRep_Max}more reliable or more lucrative{/d} than Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. Therefore, accept this gift and others that will be delivered to your ship as investments in your success."

81e46183-6b1d-4d30-8800-e74f2795e1b0.Text: {n}A multitude of voices answers you with good luck wishes, blessings, parting advice, and words of respect — shouting over each other but alike in their sincerity. For a second, you feel especially clearly that you likely will not see any of these people ever again.{/n}

1f9d0e90-ef65-4094-b7bc-8f9d2bd69da1.Text: "It's all right. You've been a generous tipper, so we're not doing too badly. And not just we as in the Amasecus... The organisation I represent — you know which one — has also prospered thanks to its deals with you. And my partners would like to contribute their investments to your expedition. The supplies are being loaded into your ship's hold, and this is a {d|Encyclopedia:KasballicaRep_Max}personal gift{/d} to you from the Kasballica Mission."

238ef016-f143-4d0e-9cb7-4d02f2753779.Text: "And to {d|Encyclopedia:DrusiansRep_Max}pledge my help{/d}. Go forth without fear. The Cult of Saint Drusus will watch over your subjects' faith. You are one of the pillars of faith in the Expanse, and thus it would not be appropriate to see you off to the ungodly dark morass between the stars without a gift. Other and lesser offerings will be delivered to your ship, so that you may have no want of anything on your journey."

baf073d3-b591-46b7-8bf9-1baeb79f1944.Text: "What gift of greater value could I bring you? Our mission may not be among your dynasty's closest confidants, yet {d|Encyclopedia:DrusiansRep_Mid}your deeds are laudable{/d}. And we will pray for you in your coming endeavour."

86ed4ec0-6e21-47d1-b517-a7442dcb989c.Text: "Yes, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. You're a {d|Encyclopedia:KasballicaRep_Mid}valuable business partner{/d}, although I'd much like to take our trade relationship to a higher level of trust. When you're back from your expedition with trophies, remember that I can offer the best price."

a66f6a55-e31d-447f-ad69-586bb77c79e7.Text: "But my partners and I are still hoping to partake of your riches in the future. Unfortunately, Vladaym did not succeed in {d|Encyclopedia:KasballicaRep_Min}establishing a robust business relationship{/d} with Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. I hope you and I can set this right upon your return."

518c496f-bbc6-488c-85db-b24c7baae0f7.Text: "Business. It's a custom among the Fellowship of the Void never to see a {d|Encyclopedia:PiratesRep_Max}friend{/d} off on a long and dangerous expedition without gifts. The supplies are being loaded to your ship as we speak, and this... this is from old Ryzza personally."

e13e5650-6631-4472-b442-c7e4c5e36606.Text: "Just to wish you good luck and let you know that when you're on your way back with your hold full of trophies, not one ship of the Fellowship of the Void is going to try and have a go at you. We {d|Encyclopedia:PiratesRep_Mid}respect{/d} Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship."

bdce5753-77fb-42cc-986a-cd39eed547f7.Text: "To wish you good luck. You've {d|Encyclopedia:PiratesRep_Min}avoided{/d} doing business with the Fellowship of the Void, but... perhaps that may change in the future? When you're back and your hold is bursting with trophies, you can find me at the Amasecus. Drinks are on me."

0f776e64-2f9d-4179-9664-02f7c867110d.Text: "The Fellowship of the Void is elationed to have the great and illustratious Rogue Trader's protection. It has tasked me with bringing you these modest gifts that will be of use to you on your expedition, besides being a token of our {d|Encyclopedia:PiratesRep_Max}special defereverence{/d} toward your person."

a1f7d120-5e57-469c-8997-4b1e22870ac9.Text: "The Fellowship of the Void has the {d|Encyclopedia:PiratesRep_Mid}greatermost respect{/d} for every deal it has ever concluded with Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. We may not be loyalsome allies today, but we are holding on to our hope of becoming them going forwardwise."

d0869cfd-f353-445f-8485-b90d725beb5c.Text: "The Fellowship of the Void is desperately hoping that upon your return, you'll appreciate our {d|Encyclopedia:PiratesRep_Min}willingness to cooperate and the prospects{/d} for great mutual benefit that our cooperation opens up."

6e3e42a5-d3a5-49be-98a2-2e8d74944dd8.Text: "Glory to the Emperor, Rogue Trader. The best of functional prosperity to you."

77300867-7ab5-48b8-b04a-92c52f0d9d0c.Text: "Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship, before you leave Footfall, I would like to present you with an official {d|Encyclopedia:FleetRep_Max}statement of gratitude{/d} from my organisation. The Imperial Navy values House von Valancius as loyal comrades-in-arms — allow us therefore to reiterate our grateful appreciation! Please do us the honour of accepting a modest quantity of supplies to support your courageous expedition."

f9ad33f9-053b-4f80-8dde-ad1c9a44fc97.Text: "My command has tasked me with letting you know they strongly value our allyship with House von Valancius. Although at this time, we have not managed to build a powerful alliance, they believe that we will be able to {d|Encyclopedia:FleetRep_Mid}strengthen our treaties{/d} and bring the light of the Imperium to the Expanse going forward. Someday."

e0a2a8aa-460f-4935-b7be-ab710d7eff92.Text: "My command regrets that we {d|Encyclopedia:FleetRep_Min}never succeeded in establishing a strong relationship{/d} with your protectorate. But we hope to fix that going forward."

c80a0e24-ee27-4e88-85aa-afff74ad0b3a.Text: "Have no doubt in my memory, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. House von Valancius can always count on a worthy percentage of my organisation's income as thanks for your generous patronage."

4988f9c8-cd44-4b57-b030-f34fb29458bd.Text: "You've always known how to make a person root wholeheartedly for your cause, Lord Captain. Rest assured, my organisation will find the rarest and most special items to offer for your trading consideration."

a09359b4-f293-4426-a925-03591adc184e.Text: "All the best of luck to Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. And be vigilant."

904339b8-1302-4706-b19f-c905032da6e9.Text: "Thank you for the warning, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. After Vladaym's trial, I don't exactly find him an inspiring example. The more time passes, the more I appreciate the opportunity to be a simple bartender."

9e4d8016-2f48-4b78-869d-d7459cc52386.Text: "I value your faith in my humble person. I hope running a criminal organisation is no more complicated than running a bar."

44726707-b34d-4cae-8c75-1c59594dbb7c.Text: "We've learned our lessons from recent events. And as for those who haven't learned theirs, I'll see to it that you can personally string up those slow-witted fools once you're back."

9b5168b7-0494-4925-86cc-d4cfc643c765.Text: "And to wish that on your journey through the darkness, the Emperor grants you revelations and {d|Encyclopedia:DrusiansRep_Min}opens your heart to our teaching{/d}. If that happens, come to me, and perhaps you might decide to make our cult part of your circle of close friends."

534a4942-c554-468c-b445-dea48ab39d2d.Text: "I hope to hear a thrilling story or two when you're back. I'll save a bottle of something special for the occasion."

44e61ab7-64e1-4035-a60f-9007674bcc33.Text: "Keep the faith, young von Valancius. The Expanse needs your faith."

ca8f7c1e-48eb-4f13-aee4-41aef4b53c03.Text: "I hope mercy will be a healing potion and not a cup of poison served to my flock. But I have heard your words and committed them to my memory."

3222003d-994b-40a0-9205-78def5f179f2.Text: "These scars are trifles. I bear much more terrible marks upon my heart. They are my faith."

4f7a8ac6-f707-41c4-b2f3-eb0a927f72a8.Text: "And to promise that the mission will pray for you. Although you chose not to place the Cult of Saint Drusus among your closest confidants, you have made {d|Encyclopedia:DrusiansRep_Mid}generous donations{/d} to our cause, and we will remember your name in our liturgies."

3696fe2b-9278-414b-9791-9c2bb9eabc1f.Text: "This unit //regrets//is disappointed at//is indignant at// the fact that {d|Encyclopedia:AdMechRep_Min}links of sufficiently high priority have not been established{/d} between House von Valancius and the Cognisance Fleet. While unable to place any research assets at the disposal of House von Valancius, this unit //hopes//prays//is counting on the reliability of the prediction// that your expedition will be successful."

7949063b-2dce-4236-bc94-16824428f9f1.Text: "Information exchange request accepted. This unit is grateful to House von Valancius for its {d|Encyclopedia:AdMechRep_Max}long history of cooperation with the Cognisance Fleet{/d}. As a bonus reward, a standard quantity of expeditionary supplies and a personal offering will be transferred into the ownership of House von Valancius. Glory to the Omnissiah."

a34af308-992c-4da0-b05e-b1ef575e6162.Text: "Brainwashing, murder, manipulation. Your methods command respect."

dc385ede-5363-4c7a-a730-d09f6a497703.Text: "I see frightened people trying to save their lives."

4f69422b-e647-4bd1-855e-ee38a1ca4127.Text: "I see what you see. They must all burn."

bb95716f-6942-4010-80d1-feff3c1e343f.Text: "I see a pathetic old man who revels in the suffering of others."

d70a7b0d-7a42-42cc-afbb-3a3aac089be5.Text: "I agree that it's long past time to burn this den of snakes."

8b9dae76-48ac-448f-9cef-a4e371b95917.Text: "The law of the Imperium is harsh, but not every transgression is punishable by death. Incendia thinks herself above the law, and that is heresy."

b789520c-be74-41fb-863b-2a68eb0d1f14.Text: "I found cryo-vaults with people inside. People who were murdered by your brethren."

ee108d3f-54b2-48d5-87c3-f9381b8985f7.Text: "Arguing with you is pointless. What will be will be."

6f03a58a-5242-424c-af09-7153221cb84f.Text: "Do you support Incendia's reign of terror?"

34523d00-a966-4caf-87f2-d9241d31b7a9.Text: "You created this monster. Now it is your duty to stop Incendia."

51f2176b-341c-4e9b-9eea-1796fa1888d9.Text: "Cast away your doubt, Reverend. Incendia's justice is righteous and fair."

0717c781-de5f-4e92-87c9-637ecb02fb38.Text: "Why are you preaching here, among rebels?"

bdc6d087-e3d3-4026-93b7-bedd97707ba1.Text: "I would like to see the Drusian relics."

d4d12671-864b-4faf-a853-9c01ab0bd9ba.Text: "Why are you not appealing to Incendia's mercy?"

c954d83c-3bb2-4306-871d-1fb4fc99ebb5.Text: "You preach repentance, but Incendia gives no one a chance to repent."

4a951e0d-5338-44e3-a649-44a1a037f8aa.Text: "You are a fanatic who tortured and manipulated her for years."

f4bb4c50-6026-484a-90a4-e9099de9b907.Text: "Shame that you did not kill Incendia too while you were at it. That would have saved me a lot of trouble."

06ad0e8e-ccab-4623-9b81-0b7c7102449e.Text: "Most curious. Let us return to other matters."

236649e7-aedd-41ed-b8b8-0ebd5091362f.Text: "Rotten souls cling together, do they not, Reverend?"

073424b3-4583-4762-b9d0-01339a66077b.Text: "I am not interested in your moralising."

b54862b3-ad3f-4efd-aa61-fce3f1c4350a.Text: [Point to Chaplain] "You are harbouring a pirate among your brethren?"

719ed5ae-b9a5-4c94-91e5-112cdb548737.Text: "Reverend, I want to stop Incendia. Help me."

abc5627e-7815-4348-b5e9-fd22f7f88987.Text: "Saint Drusus's is a doctrine of redemption, but Incendia has forgotten about that. What else may she have forgotten?"

38ea8be2-707c-4feb-8a6d-657e27896285.Text: "You have said it yourself: no one is pure, including yourself and your brethren. Her justice will not pass you by — you will perish too."

3c0fb230-444c-4476-ab98-3a60cd3e7c4b.Text: Saw the dark secret within Reverend Hieronymus.

6cf9f2ac-89f6-4538-8538-572f70efa057.Text: "Reverend, you carry the seed of vice within you. Repent before it sprouts."

3b9cb125-e85a-4d85-a78a-a711e4262ac7.Text: "You do not believe in Incendia. Or in the Emperor. Your faith is a mere smokescreen for your fear of death, Hieronymus."

1eb43ce0-23d7-4688-97c2-7a455c9578da.Text: "Because you know that I speak the truth. And Incendia will see right through you as well, Reverend. And you know better than to hope she will be merciful."

06bdfb53-ffb4-421d-878b-a1997df8a7d6.Text: "Then why did my words cause your face to contort in fear and not righteous anger?"

963ef663-ce49-4f3c-a02e-f32e0330f960.Text: "I will show you the way, Reverend. The Emperor will not protect you from death. But there are forces that can grant you freedom from fear. Pray to them. Beseech them."

368153c5-6a17-420e-86a0-9121d4aca95d.Text: "You will find your own path, one that is devoid of fear of death, and then you will show it to others. Suffer, and ye shall discover."

930f90cf-303b-43bf-a4b6-ef304c082c24.Text: [Smile and draw three contiguous circles in the air — the sign of Nurgle]

9fcccefc-40a3-43db-bb21-d541003a0c7c.Text: Reminded Reverend Hieronymus about his faith in redemption.
