Putting oneself above the Emperor is the most terrible act a Rogue Trader can commit. I have lapsed into heresy... and I must be condemned."

cc245c53-63f7-4cc2-92ad-12259f944ffd.Text: "Judge me, {name}. I, who have strayed, commit myself to His mercy and His harshness."

409d6688-efa2-4c44-8002-276913c892bd.Text: "So be it. The court hereby finds Incendia Chorda... guilty." {n}With a graceful movement, the Rogue Trader draws an ornate pistol from its holster, brings it to her temple, and shuts her eyes.{/n} "Have mercy on me, Emperor, Protector of Mankind, Master of Holy Terra."

06ad191a-d8d8-40a3-8918-cb55f4c9fb6c.Text: "House Chorda had tarnished itself, but not by the deeds of the pirate Aspyce alone. All of you, her heirs, were corrupt too: the bad seed that sprouted in her grim shadow. You were greedy and egotistical. You had forgotten the Emperor's laws and commandments... After Aspyce disappeared, one of you was going to take her place, but you would have been no better than her. And so I weeded the field."

763a2754-bf13-4234-a808-8db73f06e48d.Text: "I deserve no quarter. But I accept my punishment, and I shall go into exile to serve my penance. Farewell, {name}."

8f134c94-037c-4e41-9b5f-92604cd6647b.Text: "I... I only dreamt of being a worthy servant of the Emperor: of doing His will; of punishing His enemies; of turning this corrupt and decrepit system into a place that is worthy of His light and does not diminish His greatness."

96cea719-8d50-4869-9211-ed63342c3438.Text: "Arrogance was born in my heart, and it trampled over my sense of duty. I forgot the Emperor's commandments, which are as strict as they are merciful, and became a bringer of death and death only. I was not serving the Imperium of Humanity. I was building a pitiful parody of His creation."

cdcff913-cdde-4c52-b813-1f42389c7f69.Text: "No!" {n}Hieronymus cries out in woe and looks around the room with ferocious eyes.{/n} "Incendia may not have been the holiest and purest of the Emperor's tools, but who will be left here when she is gone? Him? Her?" {n}Hieronymus points his finger at Vladaym, then Ryzza, and finally, you.{/n} "You? Are you going to protect the law and the faith?"

fbf4fce4-1f5e-40a4-b695-66a12ca57566.Text: "And yet treachery was committed. As well as the assassinations of my relatives and an attempt on my own life. He is a murderer, and a murderer must stand trial."

1c0de9af-df05-4f71-9144-4d9d3117a864.Text: "He committed a crime... though I do not see the brand of judgement on his brow. It was not heresy, but something different..."

f62e60a9-7b57-4a1d-bfaf-dbb91e0f0053.Text: {n}Hieronymus collapses on the deck, choking on his blood, his eyes wide open. Suddenly he cries out in a booming voice,{/n} "Woe! Woe is coming... A mournful glow that blots out the sky... A rapacious crowd of enemies at the door... Traitors who are like rust, eating away at this house's bulkheads... Treachery and corruption are everywhere... Even the wardens of purity are themselves tainted... None... are unsullied..." {n}Blood fills the preacher's throat, and he falls silent.{/n}

5ee2c19d-c7f8-426a-8045-066b5121b50b.Text: "Hieronymus Doloroso, you are guilty of causing death and suffering, and you are guilty of assassinating members of House Chorda. Yet I see no corruption in your soul, and therefore I have no right to judge you. You will be judged by the Emperor. I am setting an act of faith for you to perform. The central atrium's support systems were damaged in a recent terrorist attack by Tocara's followers."

b4f28e52-4dd0-4223-82c5-3bf8e3bba513.Text: {n}Vladaym accepts death with a mocking smile, never looking away from Incendia, who presses her lips together in annoyance.{/n}

7a36ef65-0ddd-41f9-8e6a-cc0bd624a39d.Text: "Give me one reason why I should show lenience to this wretched traitor."

82e0d28a-6026-48b5-ad1f-31e4abd90492.Text: "Justice has been done. Enforcers, arrest all the lesser rebels. They will face trial in due course." {n}Incendia's voice is majestic and imperious, causing everyone to bow their heads in obedience.{/n} "Thank you for your aid in the cleansing of Footfall, {name}. The Emperor protects."

db10756a-3085-4d53-b558-18daccfa146f.Text: "Hieronymus Doloroso... House Chorda forgives you for your crimes. You were a tool of the Emperor that was meant to punish our house. Therefore, go... and let your conscience be your judge."

07bc60a1-f472-485e-915b-d70c438f2a37.Text: "A noble goal is no excuse. There can be no excuse! Nothing justifies making peace with corruption!"

a46adc2c-8264-4dcf-95a1-3d52049bd82a.Text: "I'm no butcher. Her Ladyship's enforcers may leave the station... Except those personally complicit in the killing of my employees' friends and loved ones. I have a responsibility toward them."

3e7c016c-740b-4ba6-b93c-596362c77c34.Text: "That was too lenient a punishment. It will not serve as a lesson to others. Your impetuousness disappoints me, {name}."

f2dc5492-10c9-4039-82b1-2ea588e3a31b.Text: "I am not Aspyce!" {n}An uncontrollable cramp twists Incendia's face.{/n} "The law is the same for all! Anyone can be tried, and none among us is immune! Hieronymus Doloroso, you are hereby sentenced to death!"

de699327-7bac-428e-83be-593f5ca301b1.Text: "I see how you are trying to control me by invoking her unholy ghost. Stop or you will be convicted of attempting to meddle in His justice!"

088ddfe1-47fc-4060-a70d-f0dec7562c91.Text: "Emperor's faithful! Our protector was caught in a web of conspiracy! She was lied to! Therefore, let us avenge her and carry on her cause! When thou hast stepped into the nest of corruption, destroy those that dwell therein! Smite and torment them like His wrathful instrument that knoweth no fear! Avenge His sorrow and shun pity in the name of thy love for Him! To battle, for Incendia Chorda and the Emperor!"

5894f372-6439-4118-8d94-563773e3e32e.Text: "I understand. A time of war requires Footfall's public liberties to be curbed temporarily. This station will cause you no trouble and will provide any help that's required. I'll communicate that to those... partners of mine who've been lucky enough to survive Lady Chorda's rule."

bbddd16f-3e3b-45f5-8ad1-73be91c37a77.Text: "Congratulations, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. You have one less rival in the Expanse."

63df44d7-f49b-49d2-bd54-a3ce02a29588.Text: "What? Damn—" {n}Vladaym's head explodes, spraying blood everywhere. Liege, criminal kingpin, armed rebel — all that he was, now reduced to a corpse hitting the floor with a thud. His glasses fly off his nose and lie cracked and glinting lifelessly.{/n}

37d95fe1-191f-4f3e-800c-326444690a3d.Text: "In that case, I see no point in arguing. What the scoundrel's sentence should be is obvious."

2976fdc9-854e-4fea-a850-09c4f9744a24.Text: "The idiot never realised who the station's new owner was. Well then, congratulations on your new acquisition, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship."

3982ba72-1977-4512-b78b-e978d40f3d4f.Text: "I do not negotiate with heretics. Or the dead."

10ed4a8b-f00a-4f5c-864b-67b9c508f9e9.Text: "You had a choice, to remain loyal to the Emperor or to join the ranks of heretics. You made it."

2e34e565-eba6-4a3e-b715-5bf1cb68ed42.Text: "Our missionaries accidentally discovered the hideout in which Aspyce had hidden her captive relatives. And I chose you, Incendia, to be the restorer of House Chorda's honour. I caused you agony. I took you down a path of suffering. I flayed away your skin of vanity and complacency. I made you believe in Him and put your hopes in Him. I made you what you are now."

19f88569-ddc4-483c-83bb-41820a17687a.Text: "You are a traitor, just like Theodora! Your dynasty has long since needed a lesson in obedience."

9ed81177-1b05-4e7b-b835-bee9397f8fc6.Text: "Boys, kick this lunatic out of my bar."

129c93ef-5873-4a72-8cc2-d32b1a28059a.Text: "I accept your judgement and thank the Emperor for this chance to serve Him a little longer."

da7606ac-6c92-4331-8f0d-6038a56132cb.Text: {n}Incendia raises an eyebrow and asks in a concerned voice,{/n} "Has horror driven you out of your mind, {name}?"

430ebe08-c2be-4c20-82fb-dfa537bdc960.Text: "As is your whole despicable rebellion. Good to know you have finally realised that."

9cdff764-36a2-473b-860f-e36998305ad3.Text: "What? Hieronymus... I can see you are hiding something. Repent, Reverend."

1c7e7057-91b5-4d7c-b7f5-ad0e5586e127.Text: "Lies! I take no pleasure in stooping to the despicable and revolting things that heretics do! I detest them!"

54ff16dd-6ca9-4fa8-aa57-102531384951.Text: {n}Incendia freezes and does not attempt to stop you. She just stares silently.{/n}

97904dd8-34e6-405c-83d9-99a91beea381.Text: "Emperor, have mercy on me! I had doubts before, but now I see they were unwarranted. Of all defenders of the Expanse, only she was worthy of being His shield. Her repentance is but further proof of it. I was a fool to not believe in her. Is this how the cleansing of Footfall ends?"

f208e6e4-7fb4-426b-91e1-f13e0049db7e.Text: "I saw right through her. Her every crime. Her every tainted thought. I perceived the seed of corruption she was wearing on her chest: an unholy vow and collateral for the promises given to her by servants of the Archenemy. Yes, I knew... I sensed it the moment I looked upon the corrupt old wretch."

366dc49f-86a8-41bd-97ae-2a456c1c2c8f.Text: "Then he should have pleaded, not rebelled! He should have come to me, knelt before me, and begged for leniency! Mercy was possible then, but not now! To rebel against authority is to rebel against Him!"

6365e4d6-8450-4625-ba42-11d594653542.Text: "No. This betrayal changes nothing. It merely proves that no one is pure, not even Reverend Hieronymus. That makes my mission of banishing impurity all the more important for the triumph of what is agreeable to Him. I will deal with the reverend myself, once I have stamped out your corruption."

d65aaa08-2a47-4a6d-86a7-c6af82794c19.Text: "You think you can judge me?" {n}Ryzza whips out an amulet with a beast's fanged head crowned by horns. She grins ominously.{/n} "You shouldn't have done that. I have something up my sleeve, in case the worst came to the worst. I, Ryzza, reject your accursed justice and your accursed Emperor! I accept the deal that was offered me, and surrender myself to the Edge of Daybreak! Die, you redheaded monster!" {n}The fanged head opens its mouth, roars, and spits out a flaming arrow at Incendia.{/n}

2766c468-1de6-4beb-8306-d5ef14b43e24.Text: {n}Something changes in Incendia's face, revealing shame and naked vulnerability. You have seen that tortured expression on her face only once before, at the mention of her despicable predecessor, Aspyce Chorda. Incendia shrinks and tenses, as if aware that you can sense her weakness.{/n}

c44c1e02-9b90-452b-9978-1c119e51278c.Text: "Weakness, freethinking, and inner wickedness create heretics, not I. I destroy them."

94b3c608-f2e1-48ad-8572-9b4a4ea5bc9e.Text: "The Emperor pointed me toward wickedness, and I destroyed it."

f34a1d8a-3412-44c5-8208-e09a13abd40a.Text: {n}Vladaym smiles wryly and drawls,{/n} "So... are you going to give me a weapon too? Fantastic. I humbly accept my sentence."

89f901c3-8fd3-420f-a674-230d1216a15c.Text: {n}Vladaym is looking at you and no one else.{/n} "If you're going to sentence me, do it fast. Don't give me to that raving hag." {n}A well-aimed gob of spit lands at Incendia's feet.{/n}

37b83e7e-ba50-4270-bb48-1033cf6305ed.Text: "I made you His warrior. All people are unrighteous. Only the wild beasts, the blazing stars, and the elements are without fault... And I made you the Emperor's beast. The blazing star of His wrath. The elemental justice of the Protector of Mankind. I stamped out every passion in your heart but the passion for championing His law. I raised you above the weaknesses, morality, and mercy of humanity. You are a monster chained to the Golden Throne and enacting its will. The perfect retribution."

58f5a2a9-95f7-4552-a68a-0bd88c67d99c.Text: {n}Vladaym surveys the carnage and says, dryly and morosely,{/n} "What a mess. Thank you for helping me deal with it, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. Your help has been invaluable — but the Kasballica Mission will nonetheless try to approximate and match its value in the most generous of terms."

6d80a068-d094-4827-a778-29f2ec7b6780.Text: "Have mercy on me, Emperor, Protector of Mankind, Master of Terra."

0e146f8b-b19b-40ea-841f-0739b28931d3.Text: "The right to die for the Emperor is a privilege, not a punishment. This wretch is unworthy of it."

ddfc3af9-435b-4fc1-b834-c0e3e47db60e.Text: {n}Incendia's hands fold swiftly into the sign of the Aquila, which meets the blow like a shield. Flickering flame runs down her pale fingers, leaving no burn marks. She whips out her weapon, and a shining ray blinds everyone. A hundred times more powerful than what any inferno pistol can produce, the blast atomises Ryzza before she has time to utter her last curse.{/n}

719ecf18-5ad1-4dff-bfdf-55f3275c4715.Text: "I like the idea of negotiating. As soon as an heir formally succeeds Lady Chorda, I'll send a truce envoy to them at once."

0a787436-111e-4391-a92e-5529bfcbb1ea.Text: "Incendia, my daughter, I am {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_Footfall_HieronimusAlly}at a loss{/d}. You are pursuing a noble goal, yet seeds of horror sprout where you have trodden. Where you have executed one heretic, three more are created by the fear you inspire. The Emperor's justice must fill hearts with fervour and reverence, but you only sow grief and misery. The schemes of Humanity's enemies take root easily in such soil."

c2a4ec25-edc9-4c25-944e-c24f4e1bc840.Text: "Then you, too, have fallen prey to their deceit and trickery, Reverend. Was it not you who preached that mercy breeds connivance at corruption? Well... As you used to say, none are unsullied. That includes you."

fb228344-1a1d-4381-8309-63daf7ee0b2f.Text: {n}Hieronymus nods at you surreptitiously and folds his hands into the sign of the Aquila.{/n}

51b1b5f0-7efd-4aa5-a1ff-5413c6fd53e1.Text: {n}Flame rages in Chorda's furious gaze as she surveys the bar. Her figure seems to exude a ruthless radiance, cruel, like the scorching sun of a desert world.{/n} "Rebels and heretics! I, Rogue Trader Incendia Chorda, Master of Footfall and Defender of Justice, am ordering you to lay down your arms! Harsh justice awaits those who surrender. An ignoble death awaits the rest!"

12ed694f-6999-4096-8e84-6efcb490a899.Text: "At present, it is an inferno of boiling poison. You will head there as part of a penal crew and repair the damage. No respirator, no void suit. If the Emperor is merciful to you, you will survive."

228caeb7-20a7-4bd2-a529-3ac39196c7ad.Text: "I see heresy! Who is contemplating a strike against the Emperor's law? Who dares raise a hand against His steward? Ye faithful! Let us fight and {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_Footfall_HieronimusNotAlly}die for the pious Incendia, the banisher of corruption{/d}, lest we allow blasphemy to be committed!"

71205fbe-4e6b-49f3-8640-570bac5fdaea.Text: {n}Incendia clenches her fists and sinks her teeth into her lower lip. She is racked by doubt. Finally, she says darkly,{/n} "A single drop of poison is enough to pollute an entire lake. And his brothers and sisters have drunk copiously from that lake. The Saint Drusus mission on Footfall will be decimated, and severe penances will be imposed upon the survivors. Let them atone for their cult's crimes with suffering. As for Hieronymus... he is guilty."

7cf103fd-74b0-450f-a03d-0afcbfa0fe50.Text: {n}Vladaym grimaces.{/n} "I'll admit, that is devious. May my every scream be a curse upon your names."

0dd3b8df-7b97-4186-a37b-fa350e866c32.Text: {n}Incendia's eyes flare with malicious excitement.{/n} "So be it. Vladaym Tocara, for your crimes, you shall be subject to agonising execution. Let your dying screams echo within the walls of this station forever as a lesson to all who are prone to corruption and disobedience."

69f5eafe-1c03-4fdf-a9af-ddf799cfd4a5.Text: "There is truth in your words, {name}. Goodness is born of servitude. Vladaym Tocara, for your crimes, you will undergo Servitude Imperpituis and be passed into the ownership of House von Valancius."

8b5f67e0-f3d4-4acd-9377-d1f249a87d56.Text: {n}Incendia raises an eyebrow in surprise.{/n} "That sentence is too lenient, {name}. What will you gain by making him your servant? What lesson will be learned from that show of mercy?"

85e82004-177e-457e-8e67-96711c4dac58.Text: {n}Vladaym looks at you in disappointment.{/n} "So you're denying me a quick death? Then again, an eternity as a mindless walking pile of scrap on your ship is better than another second next to this crazed monster."

895ab884-fc91-424c-9c97-e296a4f8f154.Text: {n}Vladaym takes out his pistol slowly and says in a lazy drawl,{/n} "Incendia Chorda, I, Vladaym the Vackemo, am ordering you to get off my turf before I blow your brains out and throw your corpse for a loop."

5e462c1a-03b1-4db6-9e03-6346fe668ac2.Text: {n}Incendia gives you a long look and addresses Vladaym.{/n} "Vladaym Tocara, you are hereby found guilty. The court sentences you to a lifetime of penance. As a serf aboard the von Valancius flagship, you shall atone for your crimes with humble labour for the rest of your life."

d9724e17-9f30-44b9-9f3b-fed42754f3d5.Text: "No! Only blood can wash away treason. There is no way back for those who have renounced the Emperor!"

a2223461-7837-4892-99d1-6989b48c3c30.Text: {n}Vladaym suppresses a contented smile and says,{/n} "Well, I'm good at putting things in order and getting my hands dirty. I did that for an entire station, so I think I can handle a couple of ship decks. All for the sake of my atonement, of course. I humbly accept my sentence."

ec51d379-ad29-48da-b048-7c97835e0c03.Text: "And because of that, we are supposed to pardon you for your past offences? Commoner Ryzza, you are charged with piracy, with aiding and abetting rebels, and with blasphemous heresy and worship of the Ruinous Powers. {name}, I grant you the right to enact the Emperor's justice."

853e4219-006d-4c38-b56d-0c640a70b4ed.Text: "You think you can judge me?" {n}Ryzza whips out an amulet with a beast's fanged head crowned by horns. She looks at you, grinning ominously.{/n} "You shouldn't have done that. I have something up my sleeve, in case the worst came to the worst. I, Ryzza, reject your accursed justice and your accursed Emperor! I accept the deal that was offered me, and surrender myself to the Edge of Daybreak! Die, {name} von Valancius!" {n}The fanged head opens its mouth, roars, and spits a flaming arrow at you.{/n}

346f100d-3646-4d40-a239-1c1be89f20f1.Text: {n}Your hands fold swiftly into the sign of the Aquila, which meets the blow like a shield. Flickering flame runs down your fingers, leaving no burn marks. Before Ryzza can make sense of what happened, you whip out your weapon and wound her, making her fall to her knees before you. The amulet turns to ashes right in the pirate's hands.{/n}

9848d1c8-0cc2-4321-a3f8-880de3b0c4a4.Text: {n}The pirate holds out her hands, terrified.{/n} "Spare me, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship, I beg you! I had no choice, I— I had to protect myself! Wait, let me..." {n}Ryzza takes out a small data-slate and hands it to you.{/n} "This contains the coordinates of my secret stash. You're welcome to everything in it. Just let me go and you'll never see me again!"

6028c0c4-e2ed-4f61-9b60-66e5299fd0b0.Text: {n}The weapon in your hands starts glowing blindingly. Your holy attack atomises Ryzza before she has time to utter her last curse.{/n}

b62567b0-d596-4526-8217-406f76d8a887.Text: "Faith. The shield and the smiting blade were gifted by the Emperor to His servants. I saw the light of our Protector in you all along, {name}. I am glad He chose you to enact His punishment." {n}Chorda looks serene, and her voice has mellowed. Her face is completely calm, no longer visited by her nervous tic.{/n}

81c5a56c-e73b-4516-9de7-e66f2ec60fe3.Text: {n}A harsh smile appears on Vladaym's lips.{/n} "Fair enough. So long, and damn you all."

4e077db2-53e3-4cf7-bc21-093433a7aaed.Text: "Now that we've dealt with the pressing issues, do you have any other instructions regarding the station's governance going forward? After all, Footfall is now under your exclusive personal protection." {n}Vladaym and everyone in the bar look at you expectantly.{/n}

9ea8dadc-fe82-43b1-b659-ab1ff4dcd3d3.Text: {n}The eyes of everyone gathered in the bar converge on you. They are holding their breath as they wait for Footfall's new ruler to issue {mf|his|her} first decree.{/n}

7ddb74f8-1c53-4f86-8609-ee501b2fc683.Text: {n}Everyone present makes the sign of the Aquila and joins in a prayer to the Emperor. You see anxiety and doubt in the eyes of many. The recent atrocities are still fresh in the memories of everyone present, but no one dares question your will. The light of the Emperor will return to Footfall. One can either accept it, or be incinerated by it.{/n}

ae2af081-5c74-473b-9e5d-ec12387e1af8.Text: {n}The entire gathering glorifies your name with a joyful chant. In their eyes, you see hope with a dash of mistrust. The station's inhabitants are not used to such magnanimity. However, something in your voice gives them hope that you are not putting on a show, and that perhaps this is the beginning of a new and less grim period in the station's history.{/n}

07f32842-a0f0-4576-ae38-1ac47c5af55f.Text: {n}Furious shouts of elation shake the pub's walls. Everyone's eyes light up with anticipation of a life free from the Imperium's laws, and many are already busy thinking about who they will stab in the back to grab their coveted place in the sun.{/n}

2619f478-33b3-4e2f-9f6f-d125b74d2b7e.Text: {n}The people breathe a sigh of relief and glorify your name loudly. After a period of tribulation and hardship, Footfallers are glad that there will at least be something familiar and unchanged left in this world.{/n}

2caed1c8-a851-4687-80ab-ee53cacd01db.Text: {n}The fabric is soaked with the blood of the heretic sworn to the Ruinous Powers. The crimson drops hold tiny echoes of her unrighteous soul's agony. These barely perceptible particles used to be Ryzza until only a few moments ago — and you know they are all it will take to summon a being from beyond the veil into realspace. You pocket the handkercher.{/n}

25c5e1b4-f7ba-431a-9adf-f9c0928fa078.Text: {n}Ryzza {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_RizzaRedeemed}kneels obediently{/d} and looks into Incendia's eyes with resolve.{/n} "I confess to my crimes. I let the corruption of heresy into my soul and rejected the light of the Emperor. I will accept my fate, but I'm begging you to be lenient toward the crew of my voidship. Only I am tainted. They knew nothing of my treachery."

5cafc308-f9ec-4b84-95d8-6cc2118984c4.Text: "In that case, I am ready to hand down your sentence. Commoner Ryzza, you are charged with piracy, with aiding and abetting rebels, and with blasphemous heresy and worship of the Ruinous Powers. Given your repentance, I will grant you a quick death. As regards your crew, they will face trial in due time, on the same terms as others on this station."

0133af5d-4a6e-4d02-80ab-31094b20df0e.Text: "A quick death is the only mercy one can show to a servant of the Archenemy. Heresy cannot be forgiven."

b3e68db4-7c9a-434a-a35a-0bd90b2cf553.Text: "Faith. A shield gifted by the Emperor to His servants. Did you not recognise the light of our protector, {name}?" {n}Chorda looks serene, and her voice has mellowed. Her face is completely calm, no longer visited by her nervous tic.{/n}

69a50d64-7754-41df-ad3d-2fa494a46e19.Text: "I am only doing what the Emperor commands me to do."

79238d25-782c-44b2-8187-e8bb0583b72d.Text: {n}Incendia offers a prayer to the Emperor, then pierces Ryzza's heart with a quick and well-aimed shot from her pistol. The pirate meets her death with dignity, keeping her eyes on Incendia until the end.{/n}

9fdf697d-0e55-4fc7-9044-84314a553f86.Text: {n}He glances at Incendia's body and enquires with grim composure,{/n} "Does Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} have any preference in regard to what should be done with the remains of... the lady?"

b168242a-d98c-40e7-917f-1e3b9dfe6196.Text: "The people of Footfall will find many ways to pay their respects to Her Ladyship. They are... quite exercised about this whole affair."

d3f7bd5d-3040-4ff2-b250-be31e9ad16c0.Text: {n}Her weapon drawn, Kibellah enquires calmly, even respectfully,{/n} "What would you have us do with your remains once we are done here, Lady Chorda?"

4c4a098e-3e6c-40bc-9adb-eccf0d3d7790.Text: "Arrogant wench! I will have YOUR remains strung up along with the corpses of your pitiful sect that has perverted His Creed!"

be7bcb68-4d3a-4738-8fb5-dd3c6ae51dce.Text: "If you are still able to speak after your defeat, I will repeat my question then. You have earned an honourable rest."

973983d2-36fb-4eab-b54d-e9e84c97d3fa.Text: "No, Incendia, do not invoke the Emperor's name as justification for your mistakes. There are different kinds of authority — you are the one who drove these people to the brink, so you are responsible for the carnage that followed."

d92b102b-8dc6-456b-8f6e-619a7fe17077.Text: "Every Arbitrator is taught how to suppress a rebellion without starting a bigger one. Instead of doing your duty with a cool head, you let your seething hatred for heretics get the better of you — you will serve as a prime example of how not to do this job."

9cecd606-3bd7-43b1-9f2c-78d2cd80e651.Text: "So you're going to string me up like a pirate? Well then, whatever bad place my soul goes to, once I become the ruler of it, I'll be back for you."

9e89b93a-5df5-4c00-8747-80795008aa7c.Text: "How did a quivering wretch like you become Ryzza's successor?"

1fcd52f4-abac-483d-a14a-d507596064b0.Text: "Those who have reconsidered their ways should be pardoned. Your initiative is commendable."

0f981586-b676-449a-a310-e2b5717e707b.Text: "Are you a pirate, you poor unfortunate?"

c1d2b550-78f4-4a19-9fae-cedaf1596bd2.Text: "If you are from Ryzza's crew, you are a heretic too, are you not?"

8c564ccc-8da4-4d41-8f57-25a52bdc3ede.Text: "I have no time to continue this conversation."

d763f7ae-fded-4447-a5b6-9a030ed901cb.Text: "'Ultramost' is not a word. The same goes for about a quarter of your vocabulary."

233316aa-752c-471e-b270-b7f1ee6979dd.Text: "Do not think your crimes have been forgiven. You will pay for them, not only in thrones but in blood as well."

66a24e70-a669-4df6-a3ec-69958890149c.Text: "What are you pirates still doing on Footfall? Do you still not realise it's time to run?"

f587181a-3117-430d-a70a-351637fba291.Text: "Calm down. That was a test of your mettle. Yours could be improved."

d139e373-226a-4603-9bb9-08944ee7dd44.Text: "Oh indeed? Odd how your long-held tolerance of corruption has suddenly run out."

bf0d76dd-3dc5-4747-b9ee-760591f86e21.Text: "I think I shall sentence you to death. For smuggling and piracy."

822f566c-b16b-4ae3-907e-743a34fe25a4.Text: {n}The man has a scraggly beard and a metal plate on his forehead. He is trembling like a leaf and looking around anxiously. When he sees you, he stands to attention and makes an awkward attempt to bow deferentially.{/n}

21a81db7-2e5f-4979-b745-4eeb095a5038.Text: "Y-Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! How can I be of... servicity? I'm from Ryzza's crew... her former crew, I suppose, now that {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_RyzzaDead}she's known the Emperor's peace{/d} and all. Anyway, I'm the Fellowship of the Void's new, err, commercionary agent on Footfall. I'm eager to assure Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship of my ultramost respect and offer my services. There's business to be done, reign of terror or no reign of terror, am I right?"

f7567d4e-8854-4ea9-af5d-43a99b4cd7ec.Text: {n}The pirate looks away, embarrassed.{/n} "I drew the short lho joint. After Ryzza went on, you know, her last raid, none of us would volumpteer to replace her on the station."

5b6ed2c1-31fc-4b59-b6f2-bab10ee0bf26.Text: "We'll give it our all and hold nothing back! We'll join any fight for the righteous cause, to redempt ourselves with hardship and endeaviour! For the Emperor and Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! Just don't banish us from Footfall or vanish us altogether!"

12e29450-cb67-46ae-b5c7-694c5c88f57c.Text: "R-right away! For you, only the best valuables and rarifieties!"

e9b8a97b-6c92-4d3c-8ace-faa90b01b076.Text: "What? No, Your L-{mf|Lord|Lady}ship! I— I'm—" {n}The non-pirate starts to shake.{/n} "I'm an independent merchanteer who sells foffity poppity — I mean forfeited property — to customers of the highest repute. Call me— why, don't call me anything, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. In times like these, a name is just more trouble. Let me just be your fri— useful acquaintance!"

76e27239-4ec9-4618-86f7-0c15c5a10863.Text: "We d-do, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship — but where do we run to? The Expanse is a nightmare of a place right now, what with all the fiercerous xenos and fertrocious heretics and furifying daemons. We'd rather wait it out here, close to normal people! P-putting our hopes in Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship's merciousness!"

056a9191-6b94-41e1-a706-c153a282442c.Text: "P-perish the thought! Ryzza... just went completely insanitary, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Started making dangerous friends and getting into d-deals with some right dodgy-looking fellows. Everybody tried to talk her out of it. It's one thing to sell heretical trinkets and such. It's a whole 'nother thing to wear them. But there's no arguing with her, is there? It's all old Ryzza this, and old Ryzza that, and don't lecture me, or I'll gut you. Sh-she went bonkers, and that's the long and the short of it." {n}The pirate spits irately and is immediately frightened of what he just did.{/n}

1b2cb3ae-45e7-4875-a98a-e377fa902cb8.Text: "Anyway, she had it coming. As soon as me and the boys heard Ryzza's number was up, we sent all her pals for a walk under the stars and slammed the airlock behind them. We'll have none of that, thank you very much! We're the priests of pro-Emperor! Me, I became that much stronger in my faith when I found out His righteous justice had bashed the old heretic!" {n}He puts his calloused palms together in an awkwardly lopsided but heartfelt sign of the Aquila.{/n}

b53b4a46-3bf1-4a33-8422-5e503ad9661f.Text: "I'll be here if you need me, Your L-{mf|Lord|Lady}ship! At your servitudilance!"

ea91a6a3-4c93-441d-b002-dd1e1cccd7e8.Text: "Y-Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! I greet you with ultramost respect! Let's get trading, shall we?"

9a4d91d2-0b58-4dc8-90d2-a687e0dfb3b1.Text: "Don't be too harsh on us wretched unfortunables, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! We're, you know, victims here too!"

d72d5a69-0afc-4d2a-b09a-e7d55370f05d.Text: "Why, of c-course we'd have given them no quarter back then either! But, you know, Ryzza... She was a horrible woman who kept everyone terrified to their ultramost core. M-many tried to overthrow her, only for her to dispatch them in some proper gut-wrenching ways. Her atroxities gave the whole crew the shivers."

ae65b50c-c4f0-4ae3-a4f1-f636035da0a6.Text: {n}The plate-shaped implant lands on the deck with a loud clang. There is a hole in it now, and bits of the pirate's brains are stuck to it. The bar falls silent for a moment, but then the chatter resumes just as quickly. No one is much interested in another dead unfortunate who was foolish enough to anger a Rogue Trader.{/n}

2085ccf3-3019-42d4-95fc-850873235fb5.Text: {n}The pirate gets up from his knees, huffing and trying to cover the stain on his breeches.{/n} "Of c-course, Your L-{mf|Lord|Lady}ship. M-most appropriate. Keep us in pious fear so that we have nary an ill thought, corruptuous as we are!"

e0581391-96b1-41c5-a55a-e7b732c46319.Text: "It's a pleasure, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! We make extremulously short work of heretics!"

99cdc604-b95a-4210-8970-b2ec7a64ea6a.Text: "Your previous ringleader was keenly aware of one rule: never get near a tithe ship — never even look in the direction of one. Or else..." {n}The Proctor makes a gesture, and Glaito gnashes his teeth, leaning closer to the "commercionary agent."{/n}

ff923623-3cfe-4510-bfd5-8be019b880a4.Text: "M-my mistake, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! I beg your gracious condensention! I'm not versed in the languages of nobility, but neither do I wish to offend your gracious ear with my lowly nervacular!"

cab0b9dd-5d9f-4033-b4df-a7a2039a610f.Text: {n}After casting a sceptical look at the plump layman, the Wolf growls,{/n} "Are these your pirates? I see a dispiriting sign of the degradation that has overtaken the Expanse."

e1b838b4-5e98-478f-9ab1-2b40efd2f95a.Text: "P-please! We are overacquainted with the way of things and with the expassing of the most dishonourable Captain Sargona. We would never, never think to encroach upon the sacred tribute. Never!"

afed5d10-ef41-4c87-af7c-c8cd7f60b86e.Text: {n}The pirate falls to his knees.{/n} "M-mercy, Your L-{mf|Lord|Lady}ship! We'll do whatever you tell us to do — repent good and proper, and accept any punishment and battle the xenoses for yours, and for the Imperium's triumphant glory! Besides, if you executionise me, our lot will be too scared to keep on trading with you. Is our Fellowship of the Void of no use to you anymore?"

bc296c12-2aa6-4506-b009-d97c6759818c.Text: "You are no mere servant. Where did you learn to hit like that?"

942714d9-93fd-4422-afdf-8b0f9eb6dc40.Text: "I wish to know where he has gone."

f85d3159-21dd-42db-a301-b4d57dca72db.Text: "Tell me where he went! Or else..."

f9dc5c9f-a3e1-4183-ac6a-e92c26ee636f.Text: "Heinrix, kindly get your old acquaintance to talk."

b18c364e-caaa-476c-9a8a-39de6a4ab1de.Text: [Hurt Froscher] "Let me ask you again. Where has Calcazar gone?"

eaf9676d-a3fc-4e3f-8e37-d725b57733ff.Text: "I am going to torture you for a long time. A very long time. But you will tell me everything in the end."

c28deff0-e805-436f-9650-fe9d26c9e401.Text: [Leave Froscher in his current state] "Let this be a lesson to all who oppose us."

c13aa97b-a3a7-435e-b7e2-306424660248.Text: [Kill Froscher] "Enough. I have no further need of you."

33b490b9-bbfe-4680-835c-9799accb4cbe.Text: [Kill Froscher] "I have no further use for you."

37f2ff08-6661-4f7e-8026-405e1df13c4f.Text: [Let go of Froscher's arm] "Go. I will not kill you."

204f963e-a654-4644-b4a4-73eb157c517e.Text: "What was the plan Calcazar was going to execute?"

95cc5e37-905f-4fbe-ab71-37764211deaa.Text: [Kill the servant] "That is confidential information. And its confidentiality must be protected."

9602b88d-3850-4790-9c26-4ccd1a171e53.Text: "Tell me where Calcazar has gone and you will live. Don't you see he has abandoned you?"

5c65b1d2-6ccb-48bd-bbb2-6d58e8c10da4.Text: "Go, Froscher. Heinrix and I are sparing your life."

c44fad1e-3d71-44ac-8289-0e6d9282a3c3.Text: [Finish Froscher] "Accept this last mercy from me."

bc54bf0a-fe6e-480e-b4c6-c784103d3b24.Text: {n}The old servant casts a sharp, appraising glance at you.{/n} "How can I be of use to Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship?"

340c6275-063f-4fd1-87a9-5849a65a5b15.Text: "Cadian... assault... Date and circumstances of enlistment in the Lord Inquisitor's retinue... classified..." {n}The servant squeezes out a venomous smile.{/n}

89f22823-4131-4e1c-961d-f8b78afca540.Text: {n}Ulfar growls sullenly,{/n} "Cadian. I've seen your breed in action — true warriors. And you weren't born with a hole where your heart should be, I can see it in your eyes. How could such a beast agree to be the Inquisitor's hound? And you have worked your way into his inner circle — why does he want you so close at hand? To frighten and slay innocents? To spy for him?"

811b81e1-4bd4-4d9c-af76-7bdacf903ca1.Text: {n}The hall bears the marks of a clean-up — quick, thorough, and unceremonious. The smell of ash from burned reports hangs in the air. Every trace of the Lord Inquisitor's stay at the palace has been destroyed. The only reminder of it is the elderly servant, sticking out like a nail amid the emptied space.{/n}

eef87fe2-a195-4dbf-a79a-93476d954f8f.Text: "The Lord Inquisitor is away on an urgent mission." {n}Froscher's colourless voice matches his starkly unhelpful reply.{/n}

fd85adff-f019-4019-ab81-2d39c21dacc4.Text: "I regret to say that no specific instructions were given in your regard, Master van Calox."

e9edc766-43e6-4266-ac05-ba2ea2641945.Text: "My master has no need of my services on his present expedition. I was tasked with cleaning up." {n}As soon as the conversation turns to Calcazar, deferential and ecstatic overtones brighten the servant's dry voice.{/n}

2fd7f06c-78d8-4dcd-ae83-4379643905ad.Text: {n}Abelard winces.{/n} "And once again, the Lord Inquisitor permits himself to treat the Rogue Trader as a common servant... It baffles me that you are still willing to put up with this audacity, Lord Captain."

b4414683-37c3-4088-90ec-ee2a9bfb41c2.Text: "The Lord Inquisitor warned me that Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship would enquire about that. He left me {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_XavierTrust}instructions{/d}." {n}The servant's face relaxes, as though he has fallen asleep. What he says next carries an echo of Calcazar's rumbling voice.{/n} "Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship, I regret that we never spoke. A matter of special importance has forced me to leave Footfall."

50c0219f-b3ae-4433-b227-db7d7104ef9e.Text: "I was instructed to tell Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship that the Lord Inquisitor advises against making that enquiry." {n}The outrageously rude words are spoken in an impeccably polite tone.{/n}

c17f976b-ce0f-4d15-ad37-240bd5f866d2.Text: "As you may guess, I have a plan for defending the Expanse, but the events on Eufrates II have shown that the plan is compromised. The breach of secrecy has left no time for preparations. I must accomplish something... monumental. And dangerous. Some would say too dangerous. But I hope that your loyalty and agile mind will lead you to fully appreciate what I intend to do."

c1213f22-84df-479b-a4ab-91facecb1446.Text: {n}Jae clicks her tongue in disappointment.{/n} "I will have you know, shereen, that here on Footfall, they help insolent ashmags like this one relax and find their tongue. And the methods they use aren't of the pleasant variety..."

c0aa4215-7170-4ace-ac24-186dc8fd1535.Text: "That was a mistake." {n}A blade appears in Froscher's hand: a common Cadian-pattern, monomolecular-edged bayonet knife whose handle is covered in scratches from years of use.{/n}

6519ee5f-9ba4-4005-8126-a32e9ebf2282.Text: "{name}." {n}Heinrix's tone is ice-cold.{/n} "I am offering you my services as an Interrogator should you find it necessary to extract the information you need from this recalcitrant individual."

a06851bd-105f-4156-839b-432c46382b2c.Text: {n}The gleaming blade makes a series of lingering flashes on your retinas. You very narrowly dodge the stabs aimed at your eyes and throat, grab hold of the man's wrist, which might as well be made of stone, and start twisting it out of its cracking joint. A crushing elbow blow connects with your jaw, but the lightning-fast hand-to-hand fight ends in your victory before you even realise you have been attacked.{/n}

789424ec-babe-42b0-9f52-83b83e3cba6a.Text: {n}You manage to jerk your head out of the way of the serpentine strike, saving your eyes, but the blade rips your flesh open. One after another, it finds your internal organs: the liver, the lungs, and the kidneys. Overcoming the pain, you grab hold of his hand, which might as well be made of rock, and start twisting it out of its cracking joint. The pain makes your foe cease his resistance, and you realise that the fight that almost cost you your life has lasted no more than a few seconds.{/n}

e3500a0a-37d5-40a0-b2a4-43223b233fba.Text: {n}Froscher rasps stubbornly,{/n} "My master told me to stay behind to prevent the possibility of... pursuit. Your meddling in the Inquisition's affairs is a mistake."

93eabbc6-94f8-45ce-b139-1aea195ad6c3.Text: {n}Heinrix turns to Froscher and raises a hand. Otherworldly cold envelops you.{/n} "I will only ask you this question once..."

ed73fa07-6175-4c2e-b12d-c907360c4712.Text: "No!" {n}Froscher's voice breaks along with his resolve as his legs give out under the unseen influence of biomancy.{/n} "Master van Calox, stop... I have seen your work first-hand. I know what is left of the people you interrogate... Porta Septentum. Dimensional gate."

6b25ad24-b3f8-438b-9267-81be23b8800c.Text: {n}Courageous spirit can overcome anything — but weak, pain-fearing flesh can't. When Froscher's nerves begin to snap under your pressure, he blurts out,{/n} "Porta... Septentum... dimensional gate..." {n}The servant bites his tongue furiously, livid at his body's faithless weakness.{/n}

f7d37251-4706-4d50-a3a3-4d22c9d74e1e.Text: {n}Satisfied, Marazhai tenderly caresses Froscher's cheek.{/n} "I wish I was not so short on time... I would have employed something far more refined. But, I suppose, even such rushed work has delivered the desired results."

fc72df09-4ffe-4a23-b559-eaaac6c49fd1.Text: {n}Heinrix lowers his hand.{/n} "Most sensible of you, old man. Good."

630406f8-47da-4af9-816c-10aa3fffd6d6.Text: {n}You hear the crunch of a shattered joint, nerves snapping, tendons creaking. But that is all you hear; the servant's lips remain stubbornly sealed.{/n}

0025ee29-4cb8-4f0f-9910-744ea7eec276.Text: {n}Froscher glimpses something in your eyes and sighs in defeat.{/n} "That's true. No one can endure torture forever. He went into the Porta Septentum, the dimensional gate. And I have failed him."

af07a453-a1c0-4d10-94fb-af989735ce09.Text: "I am no longer young. My money is on my stubbornness against my weak heart. Let's see which breaks first."

e0e3296d-c1c0-4869-816a-0a57a9112f0e.Text: {n}It takes time to beat answers out of the lump of meat that once called itself Froscher. At some point, between the squelching sounds of your blows and the cracking of broken bones, you manage to force several words out of his mouth. "Porta Septentum. Dimensional gate."{/n}

1a77cfde-995b-4e30-81f9-38e9dd8360fc.Text: {n}Marazhai lets out a disappointed sigh but does not intervene.{/n}

cfd4d7c5-4406-4c2d-8d51-3bd13dcf2119.Text: {n}The servant, now a broken man, looks at you with hatred in his eyes.{/n} "You won't stop my master anyway. Don't follow him... Better run away."

61b038d1-8649-498f-8951-c981f90dffdc.Text: "Of that I am ignorant, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. It was decided due to secrecy concerns that I should not know the details."

4b5897fb-b300-413f-9e3d-784584a48709.Text: "I understand, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship." {n}The man makes no attempt to defend himself. He accepts death as one would accept an unpleasant but necessary medical procedure.{/n}

3d8ff7a7-03ad-4557-81af-341f4ec4e046.Text: "Farewell, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. I hope you help my master achieve what he set out to do."

1bfa22c6-ffed-45a0-9b79-ea1508f0f23f.Text: {n}Froscher shakes his head with a sad smile.{/n} "Always faithful, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

873fca43-72f1-480c-b70c-50dbcdd477cb.Text: {n}Abelard's face turns a deep red.{/n} "You blasted..." {n}With visible effort, he swallows the insult he was about to spit out.{/n}

162ab9ff-b4eb-4927-a530-25c34311f870.Text: "However, it would be a shame to miss out on this opportunity to see the skills of certain members of your retinue in action." {n}Jae glances over her shoulder.{/n}

8dd78ee3-ea25-441f-b261-8026eed57842.Text: "{name}..." {n}Marazhai's voice is sickeningly sweet.{/n} "I can see that this mon-keigh is disinclined to speak... Let me have my way with him."

20da177a-7153-4bb1-b914-ba1b97bb3492.Text: "Arrows of Kurnous, we are too late... Elantach, at your word, I will track down that mon-keigh to the ends of the galaxy." {n}Fury rings in Yrliet's voice.{/n}

e1f3d9df-21c0-4209-900d-82076df00150.Text: {n}Marazhai moves with practically imperceptible speed. Froscher only manages to grab the handle of a previously concealed bayonet knife when Marazhai appears before him and pierces his tear duct with a thin blade. Froscher goes still, his hands hanging limply, as the Drukhari starts trepanning the man alive.{/n}

c847ce98-280c-4def-ada5-080c703c2638.Text: {n}After a while, Marazhai casts a bloodied piece of Froscher's skull aside and inserts the blade. The man flinches and starts quietly howling a single note, his mouth drooling and his eyes rolling back. The howl rises to a deafening shriek before he sputters,{/n} "P-P-Port-ta Sept-t-tentum... D-d-dimensio... g-gate..."

2650e7b2-2e67-405b-8f85-248350e9690f.Text: {n}With a derisive laugh, Marazhai turns away from his mutilated victim.{/n}

a24ee1e6-7162-4b59-a86a-c6c8c83b9708.Text: {n}Froscher presses his lips together stubbornly and reaches for his tall boot. You put more pressure on his maimed wrist to make him stop.{/n}

b50ad5eb-c591-436b-a536-83e7c66d9e28.Text: "That is why I am giving you an option to find me and, I hope, join me. I am travelling to the ancient dimensional gate in the Porta Septentum System, and beyond. If you wish, you can follow me and share with me the burden of responsibility for what is to come. And if not, pray for me, for I could use any help I can get. The Emperor protects, {name} von Valancius."

d19e4de4-2dfd-44f6-9fb6-814cc1e069bb.Text: {n}You might decide to show mercy... Later. When you have answers. Something almost tangible seems to touch your throat, freezing the words in it. Fate is yanking the leash insistently, and the fingers on Froscher's battered hand tighten their grip.{/n}

24b83b17-b8a2-4b6d-85df-9ee285cc07d8.Text: {n}With a weak smile, Froscher replies calmly,{/n} "For my courage, sir."

15f3ca3f-77f5-495f-bea2-bd3a6a9e9edc.Text: "Something tells me, shereen, that we've missed our engagement with the Lord Inquisitor. So terribly rude of him to have departed in such haste, leaving us to wonder what he is planning..."

45842a5e-efce-42d5-b098-f1303fa107ef.Text: "That's it?" {n}Heinrix looks at Froscher in confusion and anger.{/n}

5089b29e-e65c-45e5-a345-e44f0c82614d.Text: {n}Argenta frowns, painfully processing what she just heard.{/n} "A call from His servant must not go unanswered, but... what is this plan for defending the Expanse that the Lord Inquisitor hides in the shadows? These tidings bring unease to my heart, Rogue Trader."

a35a4e3d-511c-431d-ba0a-c2d3673e4d26.Text: "And that is the truth. Pour every last drop of that heresy fuel away, right now."

16245b11-3934-4097-9f4a-3cf6e8170be7.Text: "Ryzza and I need to have a little chat."

bb7083f9-7865-4055-81b9-080ecec6ff52.Text: "Here's to me and House von Valancius!"

97e42492-0808-4acd-bafc-81f19d6ecb1f.Text: "How about a deal? Help me, and I will let you use my name for commercial purposes — 'the Adeptus Amasecus: the Favourite Bar of Rogue Trader von Valancius.' Is that not a generous prize?"

c3ea5c3b-3cfc-4839-8b84-ea38a6a0f59c.Text: Promised to make the pirate Ryzza pay for her crimes.

bba08735-b509-4413-b2f2-c862900ebdfc.Text: "The Emperor's justice does not forgive heretics. Mark my words, Ryzza, you will be facing it very soon."

4bc253c8-444f-45a0-9e42-a2790a838868.Text: "I am interested in the Fellowship of the Void's wares."

ab6ff970-b77e-4cec-aaf6-f6cf1213d2cd.Text: "Are you not afraid the enforcers will come for you eventually?"

62c1df57-e94c-41af-bf14-e45b2e335622.Text: "Just in case you need to be told — if you ever entertain the thought of helping Vladaym, chase that thought away. He is not long for this world."

acf97596-f919-4453-b680-2823d4206726.Text: "I don't think we're going to come to an agreement."

86dc7f0c-aaf2-421a-852f-983634463590.Text: [Show her a data-slate with an exorbitant sum] "A rather immodest reward for a modest dealer, don't you think?"

b0c544b0-4da8-4761-89a3-dde4f33fd154.Text: "Even if you outlive Vladaym, I have the means to ensure it won't be for long."

eb1366b4-b2de-4ab3-8f0d-ec1138d19b07.Text: "Spoken like a cowardly crone, not a dread pirate captain."

7092c2f7-db6a-464b-b81a-539c915d33cf.Text: "Why not haggle with me while you're at it, you old rogue."

8f88fc0c-c0ff-48fc-a739-564e9ab20cd7.Text: "I will try to protect you from being put on trial."

7f538d58-c146-40a4-8063-099bffc42133.Text: [Lie] "Of course! I'll put in a good word for you. Incendia will listen to me."

6c815196-77ac-477e-8d1c-98551f88cdd7.Text: "The Emperor will protect my soul from the pernicious powers of this liquid heresy. Pour me one."

cff38e80-60a8-4185-83f1-fcc5b44d1539.Text: "Let us finish it together for the glory of House von Valancius."

75ea5d81-4ad8-4f1e-becc-f80f86964b5d.Text: "Then here's to Calligos's health and his foresight!"

cbc7fab1-0eb7-4b04-ad4a-cecb6c8df4eb.Text: "He is not coming back. I killed him. Go ahead and pour me one."

49b5ce3a-26b2-4884-932b-d096946f33e6.Text: "Here's to the fall of Incendia Chorda!"

c5441df2-2bd6-40e8-ad85-10995fc2991d.Text: [Smash the bottle] "Such hospitality toward a scoundrel like Winterscale!"

285924bd-ae76-440a-ad7e-c1b88ebfaa99.Text: "How have you been faring here without me?"

16879b5c-ce04-40c1-a060-5ba88850c375.Text: "Do you think your Kasballica employers will be pleased to learn you refused to help me?"

330da5b2-f73d-45db-8075-999256ad507f.Text: "Have you seen Jae? She left my ship and has not been seen since."

21700b1f-ddb1-4173-bea8-319585d667cb.Text: Convinced Ryzza to turn away from heresy.

c9876d39-51dd-4093-acea-e9de8b5d0178.Text: "Ryzza, the forces you have opened yourself up to will be your undoing. And what's more, your crew, too, will pay for it with their souls. Because of you."

05bffb9c-dfce-4399-9ca6-472008b97280.Text: Convinced Octaviana to aid the rebellion against Chorda for the sake of the people of Footfall.

c08ed286-60cb-4360-b365-76ba1caf4473.Text: [Gesture at the people in the room with a sweep of your arm] "This is not about whose idea it is, but who we are doing it for. For the people on Footfall. For you, Octaviana. For your freedom from an insane zealot's reign of terror."

1f8e678a-ac38-422b-884a-717f25c62881.Text: Revealed to the pirate Ryzza that you and she had a common "influential ally."

c4923d08-0f1f-4d03-879f-3d9b61ec6018.Text: [Draw the Chaos symbol in the drops spilt on the bar, then wipe it away] "What if I told you that you and I have another very influential ally?"

84c0fbe0-0c22-4ed0-9dce-74824b15465d.Text: "Octaviana, we have a plan to stop Chorda. Your help would be welcome."

e0059b74-89f3-40f6-9f9a-60f01b8d3040.Text: "Drink this poison and end it all? Things are not going that badly yet."

5eb8be89-6680-4eab-bd9b-44892e1a894d.Text: "I will be part of that plan. And I will be risking my neck along with you."

1fe23aed-cb5a-46ac-9b82-0314c0128443.Text: [Raise your voice] "Your time is running out. Are you going to wait for your death, or will you try and put up a fight after all?"

4a9edf75-36c9-4b58-839c-5a93227c75b2.Text: "I have struck many deals with the Fellowship of the Void. Are you going to ruin our alliance just like that?"

c23ffdad-8faa-4dca-bd76-d3dc163389e7.Text: "Your soul is full of corruption. You haven't fallen in with the Archenemy's forces, have you, Ryzza?"

e4679150-ae00-46f5-b7b3-fce4658474c9.Text: {n}Octaviana looks tired but {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_FootfallAlly}finds the strength to smile briskly{/d}. She pours two shots of a clear yellowish liquid with streaks of promethium in it, and slides one toward Ryzza.{/n} "Let's drink to Her Infallible Ladyship Chorda's mercy and good judgement. Wherever they may be right now!"

54f7ddec-fa55-48f6-9f27-fe4ef53cb8c7.Text: {n}Octaviana looks {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_FootfallNotAlly}exhausted. Her cheeks are hollow, her fiery hair is dishevelled, and her jaw augmetic is vibrating{/d}. Her hand trembles as she sets down a dirty shot glass, fills it with a cloudy liquid streaked with greasy promethium, and slides the shot toward Ryzza.{/n} "I'd advise you to take your time with it. This is the last of the rotgut on all of Footfall."

a10daf11-4bf6-4718-b4d3-522194c1002d.Text: {n}Ryzza downs the shot, grimacing in satisfaction.{/n} "You have quite a way with words, Octy! Yes, indeed, one would hate it if Lady Chorda's ill health affected our own. Have you, by any chance, run into Lady Chorda's good judgement on your journeys, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship?" {n}The pirate laughs hoarsely.{/n}

a7e36ddf-063e-4df8-911d-f8e80d0acace.Text: {n}Ryzza downs the shot in one gulp and stares gloomily at, or rather through, Octaviana. The jury-rigged augmetic replacing her leg raps nervously on the floor.{/n} "Welcome to the station of the dead, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship."

095b542f-7ffd-4cf9-886d-20a3dc93589c.Text: "How can I be of service, my {mf|lord|lady}?"

d69441eb-ab53-4856-9285-5d3eb0b3b694.Text: "Shut up, Heydari. You came back alive, and that's good enough!" {n}Octaviana's face twists into a scowl, but her whole body leans forward toward her old friend.{/n} "And don't beat about the bush. I know exactly why you've come to Footfall in such a rush. But Jae... your guys got killed, every last one of them, before Chorda even set foot on the station. Some were found dismembered in the Shadow Quarters. Some became a heap of ash at the crematorium. And Falco launched the luckiest ones into orbit around the station, so that everyone could see how much he despised you and your patron, if the Rogue Trader will pardon me for saying it!"

3d4f53ab-bd89-4a94-a997-678b9c8d5e67.Text: {n}Octaviana smiles tenderly.{/n} "If they show up, I'll blow up the Martyr's Endurance before I let those butchers take me alive. And for now, I'll be behind the bar, refuelling my roughnecks. It's a rotten thing for a captain to abandon ship, isn't it, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship?"

66b696c6-9d51-47af-8627-6658cd3c66cb.Text: "Some captain. If I were you, I'd scram while the scramming's good. I know you're attached to the Amasecus, but this hole isn't worth dying for. I have a shuttle hidden away nearby, so we could take off right now..."

da784b3c-6b4b-43bb-8982-ae87c13947af.Text: "More like the favourite mass grave of Rogue Trader von Valancius. In a different time, I'd have given my arm for that kind of publicity, but... not today."

2000f195-c9b4-42d4-a4b7-ff0a90730388.Text: "Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship, his so-called plan is nothing but the death throes of a cornered and condemned man who's grasping at imaginary straws. The Vackemo was once smart, shrewd, and wily, but now he's simply refusing to admit he's already lost. We modest dealers are no match for a Rogue Trader. It would be different, of course, if we were strongly motivated or had a Rogue Trader on our side..." {n}Ryzza looks you straight in the eye, her meaning quite clear.{/n}

5a38f140-0c46-4d9b-8eca-c214c329e9de.Text: "It pains me to hear that, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship."

cb8b324f-87df-444c-b1a3-45804f9d205f.Text: {n}Ryzza's eyes widen.{/n} "You sure know the path to old Ryzza's heart! Be careful it doesn't go pop. Of course, taking on Chorda is madness... But then again, you don't get paid this much for anything less than madness."

807e5cc5-14c3-466f-bd6f-d30580f99a0b.Text: "Oh, what the warp, my crew and I will take part in your little uprising. But don't ask me for details. Old Ryzza prefers to keep quiet about the behind-the-scenes workings of her insidious and sudden strikes."

48f79a79-8c69-4723-9be2-fb307d2f9792.Text: {n}Ryzza grows pale.{/n} "You're very persuasive, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. I feel distinctly motivated to get down to business at once."

304ba114-d8aa-4c12-bcec-67a3cb2ea557.Text: {n}Ryzza smiles dryly.{/n} "That would be regrettable. That said, tracking down an ageing voidswoman in the sprawling Expanse could be quite tricky..."

5542df1d-3c5a-4c57-a374-8c3233ed69ad.Text: {n}Ryzza's eyes flash and she scowls.{/n} "Don't talk to me like that, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. The times we're living in! Barely anyone in the Expanse remembers who old Ryzza is... I'm not getting any respect anymore. That means they need a reminder. And they're going to get one!"

5da749df-10ce-465a-938a-4e37edc1b286.Text: "I haven't been goaded into doing anything in a long time, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship." {n}Ryzza laughs out loud.{/n} "'Cowardly crone'! Imagine that!"

74c13e5b-58d6-45be-8bfb-80cfc4f63eba.Text: "I'm sorry, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship, it's the only way I know." {n}The pirate laughs a strained laugh.{/n} "That's all. I wouldn't presume to trouble the gracious Rogue Trader with my concerns any longer."

2d194957-c4fb-44d9-86ce-048d0820561b.Text: {n}Ryzza smiles contentedly.{/n} "A fine deal, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. I'm glad we've had such a frank conversation."

a2646854-470d-42fa-9347-b12380000b46.Text: "For you, always, my {mf|lord|lady}." {n}A dusty but finely made greenish bottle with a wax seal appears on the bar.{/n} "Lord Winterscale's favourite blend. So good it's not entirely legal. However, during his last visit, His Lordship told me to put a bottle aside until his return. And who knows if he'll ever return here now? It would be a waste."

4fa9a320-d4d0-46df-be51-56be0e6f65c9.Text: "Just rotgut, my {mf|lord|lady}. The last bottle. And Ryzza's already guzzled most of it. They've outlawed amasec. Said it's pernicious to the body and the mind, and directs the soul toward heresy."

eeee7cdd-3ad2-4eb9-aa18-34c8e6cb7f6f.Text: {n}Octaviana finds the cleanest shot glass, rubs it a few extra times to be sure, and fills it with sickly yellowish liquid from the bottle. The drink burns your entrails mercilessly and leaves a subtle aftertaste of mould, but its taste meshes amazingly well with the atmosphere in the bar.{/n}

70aa71d2-3537-4dfe-a43b-c85e7aa556bf.Text: "Right. A true Rogue Trader takes care of the simple folk. Unlike the hag the Emperor served us up with. May the glorious House von Valancius flourish and multiply its riches. And old Ryzza is always willing to give a hand."

0768968e-3f9a-4deb-bc96-f22c8152f536.Text: "Killed him? I suppose we can skip the details. It's dangerous to ask too many questions of the {mf|man|woman} who took down His Lordship Winterscale. All right then, here's to your courage in battle!"

10dc8921-7cc0-407a-a962-27613bcb4e82.Text: "If there's anything in the world Her Infallible Ladyship hates more than us, it's Calligos Winterscale. So I'll heartily join your toast!"

e61e7e23-d48c-4242-9e92-41929dfc8e8a.Text: "Your courage and forthrightness are admirable, my {mf|lord|lady}! Down with Chorda!"

7cb45e1d-2cc7-4d4b-abc7-f7575948be27.Text: {n}Octaviana grows pale as she shifts her gaze between the bottle shards and you.{/n} "Have mercy, my {mf|lord|lady}! I never knew you, too, were an enemy of the Winterscales. Pray, don't be angry! It won't happen again!"

f2480f5b-4982-4f38-bb4d-0eff7e5dab37.Text: "Badly. But we're in no mood to lie down and die yet. There are still people who can't stand Chorda's regime, and they are fighting. A sting a day, always somewhere new. Vladaym may be on the run, but he still has people loyal to him."

0fbb5551-13cc-41bd-ae81-a6c67c6e23e9.Text: "Badly, my {mf|lord|lady}. Her Infallible Ladyship rode into Footfall {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_FootfallNotAlly}on the back of the famine{/d} and straight off began running the place her way. Things were just lousy at first, but then there was real carnage. Vladaym tried to start an uprising, but he didn't stand a chance. The people were starving. Half of them enlisted in Chorda's service for a ration pack. The rest were hanged."

4ea76670-fd76-4f06-82d9-8ddfa19240d8.Text: {n}With an obedient and world-weary expression, Octaviana opens the bottle and pours its yellowish contents on the floor. She states dryly,{/n} "No more orders for rotgut, then. A glass of water, my {mf|lord|lady}?"

d88a38f6-24ba-493f-9ab5-c75a44285167.Text: {n}Octaviana joins in loudly at once:{/n} "All hail {name} von Valancius!"

109a2ce8-f99e-44f9-9ff0-f0baafa60cdd.Text: {n}Octaviana rubs her jaw augmetic anxiously.{/n} "The silly girl went off on her own to get her people out of Falco's clutches. I told her to wait a little till we sorted out our current business. Then we could've bled him together. But no, not Heydari. That one's as stubborn as a herd of groxes. She said her guys didn't have that much time, and then she vanished."

9c443f97-63cb-49a2-ae03-5fb7a8db353d.Text: "That ashmag..." {n}Jae's voice is full of anger and thirst for vengeance.{/n} "No, there's still something he needs from me. So not all of them are dead, or at any rate, it will be better for him if some aren't. Where is he, Octy? Speak!"

124379eb-2778-4614-9f40-32551ff4c255.Text: "Got lopped off by a fan blade. There was an enforcer raid and I had to take the ventilation shaft. It used to be a reliable escape route. We'd shorted the fan a while before. Well, the bastards found out about it, and got it working again. Everyone got turned into mincemeat, and I was lucky." {n}Ryzza pats her prosthetic joylessly.{/n} "That was the day I realised the war on Chorda wasn't my war anymore."

2fedbec3-4de0-42ae-b307-129bbc630f23.Text: {n}Ryzza casts a glance in Octaviana's direction, waits for her to take the hint and look away, then says,{/n} "At Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship's service."

cc3bfb92-7d43-4c37-b342-63312a614fd0.Text: "Ah Octy, I've missed the fiery sunset of your hair, shereen! Sorry I haven't brought any gifts today, but we're certainly going to down another round or two—"

ca06a2aa-408c-4b91-b36a-b4df2983355d.Text: "You know very well where." {n}Octaviana waves toward a drab-looking door covered by a sheet of metal.{/n} "The sewers are where that rat belongs. You know, he was going to rat us all out to Chorda. Including Vladaym. You should've seen Falco's face when Vladaym led the Inquisitor's dogs to him first, ha ha!"

36dbbeb4-cce1-4eb4-8178-0e164c2583b7.Text: "I don't have any fighters, but I do have a shipment of xenos weapons. Lethal, but with no guarantee of quality. Figuring out how it even works is tricky enough. But that still beats the junk Vladaym's thugs are armed with. They can have a round on the house."

79922052-0f44-42c1-85fa-73d792a1f8b5.Text: {n}The woman looks at you pensively.{/n} "And by 'we,' you mean you and Vladaym? He always has a plan. But it's certainly not always the best plan. Why should I trust in your idea?"

c23035ff-0a62-409a-9bda-b73e2af4a726.Text: "You're personally willing to stand against her? That changes things significantly. With you, the resistance has a chance... You certainly know how to turn a situation around, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship."

50cee8e8-26c5-4ecf-9da1-1abaf12c1c85.Text: "I'm sorry, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship, but if your plan fails, we'll all be strung up while Her Infallible Ladyship won't lay a finger on you. Your risk and ours are poles apart."

2d72340e-11c2-46e7-bd5d-8ee4e69fbe8b.Text: {n}Octaviana looks away. It seems your words have touched a sore spot.{/n} "You're right. Time is running out. There's barely any left. I don't give a damn what your plan is. I'm in."

0c797204-98b1-4228-bfa3-623a87b04eab.Text: "Perhaps. Or perhaps tomorrow Her Infallible Ladyship will anger the Lord Inquisitor, set off on a campaign, and fall in battle against the enemies of Humanity, or simply choke on her own spite. And then I'll be alive, and she won't."

25af11ac-f577-47ee-bb8c-2b9c0d9e137d.Text: "Hmm... It is generous, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. Very generous. If we don't all get killed, the Amasecus will be flooded with thrones. All right then, it's a deal, but I have one condition. Write me a document saying your heirs have no right to go back on the promise. Because, as you can understand, if this doesn't work, there'll be a new Rogue Trader von Valancius in the very near future."

2c899ad1-f66c-49ba-b07b-34a2279a0939.Text: "It's an honour for old Ryzza to have a conversation with Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, just like that."

8259c3a7-daf5-422f-905f-e17e76896357.Text: "You're in an enviable position, is all I can say, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. In the Atrium, you'll find hundreds of people who are awaiting trial and would give anything for a dose of lethal poison."

e97f991a-385a-47c6-b434-0a8f2f82b4c7.Text: "Don't waste your silver tongue on me, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. We're not going to come to an agreement. And what use would I be in this war of yours, anyway?"

d9b6ea27-66a1-4158-8f0a-118a1a897af8.Text: {n}Ryzza flashes a wicked smile and replies quietly,{/n} "I can assure you I wasn't going to. Vladaym the Vackemo has no future. He doesn't see it, but I do. And you do. When you come for his head, or Her Ladyship Chorda does, you can trust old Ryzza to stand aside... Especially if she can guarantee my safety."

8a39f09e-949f-4fe1-8895-5326f32b98c0.Text: {n}Your eyes see through the pirate instantly, and you sense that the burden of her transgressions is so heavy that it will soon drag her under. Her fear has allowed a malicious will to sink its claws into her soul and tear it slowly to pieces.{/n}

7c0a92b8-36fc-4dc1-81fe-0c8a4d6c09a6.Text: {n}Octaviana lowers her voice.{/n} "Vladaym has let the station slip away from him. Plenty of people aren't happy about it, not least his business partners. Should something happen to Tocara, come here. {d|Encyclopedia:KasballicaRep_Mid}Your dealings with the Kasballica{/d} shouldn't take a hit because of the old Liege's ambitions."

d0e8da11-3dc2-4e67-922f-8eddae83b7cb.Text: {n}The pirate narrows her eyes.{/n} "What, so you're like {mf|Her|the other} Ladyship now? One look, and you can tell the wicked from the righteous? I suppose it's easy enough to guess that a pirate has a misdeed or two to her name, but no one has ever accused me of serving the Archenemy before. You wound me, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship!"

de134f75-25b0-4dda-a1b4-8dcebdd52fd2.Text: {n}As much as Ryzza is trying to turn it all into a joke, there is anxiety in her eyes, and her hand is reaching unconsciously for something concealed under her shirt on her chest as if she is trying to further hide it from your gaze.{/n}

cda9df3b-e247-4ed4-8f46-b7dc9a758cd7.Text: {n}Ryzza is clearly trying to turn your question into a joke, but her anxiety is understandable. The situation on the station is not helping to set its inhabitants' minds at ease — especially those involved in illicit activities.{/n}

bde49cfd-0d85-4aaa-a168-6a88e2b7daf1.Text: "Good thing I'm not a heretic then, as you doubtlessly know. I'll be putting my hopes in your mercy, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship." {n}Ryzza smiles darkly, trying to hide her agitation and bewilderment, as her trembling hand brings an empty glass to her lips.{/n}

afac72a6-b310-4249-b461-7b82e846bd9e.Text: {n}Ryzza's expression turns to stone. She peers tensely into her glass as if trying to find some answer at the bottom of it. Finally, she raises her eyes to you, looking incredibly tired.{/n} "You're cruel, you know, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. The way you found where this old pirate was hiding her conscience and dragged it kicking and screaming into the light."

384f3549-f270-4533-925c-a9cce1d4c584.Text: "I got in over my head and almost took my guys down with me. I'd be a crap captain if I allowed my fear to kill my crew. Thank your esteemed self for talking some sense into me. Got a light?"

fd7eb4c5-86ce-4501-96d0-ae709f15d210.Text: {n}The pirate casually rips some kind of amulet from her neck, bearing a fanged beast crowned with horns. She tosses it into her near-empty glass of rotgut and throws the match you offered her after it. The contents of the glass are immediately engulfed in unholy purple flame. A minute later, all that remains is ash and a nasty puddle of black metal at the bottom. Satisfied with the result, Ryzza smashes the glass on the floor.{/n}

2ecebe51-a23a-41ef-807c-9838b029d858.Text: {n}The patrons greet your last sentence with an enthusiastic roar. Your heartfelt speech has resonated with the commoners and seems to have stirred Octaviana, too.{/n} "You certainly know how to be persuasive, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. You're right. You're ready to risk your life for us, and here I am being picky like a noble offered a nutribar made of corpse starch. You can count on me."

1f0208a2-2af7-4e49-b9d0-1d8787e1fc68.Text: {n}Your eyes see through the pirate instantly, and you sense that the burden of her transgressions is so heavy that it will soon drag her under. Pushing her over the edge wouldn't take much effort. The pirate herself seems almost eager to plunge head-first into the murky waters.{/n}

b682b28e-0817-40d7-907f-e6a529e35e75.Text: "Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship is trying to drag old Ryzza into dangerous business. Give it up. I'm much too fond of my own skin."

cd27ab95-9189-44fe-b7cf-ca827139ad31.Text: {n}Ryzza's eyes widen.{/n} "You too? I'd never have thought that your esteemed self would... This changes everything. Now I see I made the right choice when I put my trust in... our influential ally."

5027ba99-6752-458e-834f-d48867cc6e01.Text: "He'd have had more if it weren't for Reverend Hieronymus. Many have fallen for his sermons and taken to repenting and confessing. He's turned so many to the faith, that they don't dare touch him anymore. The old man's a force to be reckoned with now."

21c41ed0-db29-4d7c-99e2-f27669fe8791.Text: "You're putting pressure on the most vulnerable spot, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship — the pocket. My fellows will be very disappointed if I ruin our relationship. I'm afraid you leave me no other option but to say yes."

630b2d88-8fb8-4c66-8300-aab6741d139b.Text: "Reverend Hieronymus is the only one who's flourished amid this madness. He and his missionaries spend days and nights preaching till their throats are sore, talking about the suffering we've brought down upon ourselves. It's almost like he'll grab a flamer himself any day now. And what scares me isn't so much his fiery sermons, but me being on the verge of believing them myself..."

d7716dc5-b8d7-449c-9d59-eb3df0ace1bc.Text: "Give it a rest, Ryzza. I'm not holding you here, so stop trying to drag me away with you."

6450c746-9e16-45de-be62-900a8481c37a.Text: "Trust me, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship, if I'd wanted to take part in wars and rebellions, I'd have become a bandit, not a bartender."

03306be7-fef6-425c-a831-e139eb192e91.Text: {n}Octaviana frowns and shakes her head.{/n} "They won't be pleased. My higher-ups value business partners such as yourself. Which means I ought to help you if I don't want to die an ugly, long, and painful death."

441227eb-3609-48e3-a389-67d1698a6abf.Text: "How are you doing working under Incendia Chorda's rule?"

9144d538-3a5f-455e-8d01-1e348e3eab55.Text: [Show data-slate] "I have data on planets that will be of interest to your owners."

d747269f-2b7b-487a-ab9c-35b0b696e1d1.Text: "Why do you keep saying 'Glory to the Omnissiah'?"

6da9c5f8-9733-47af-97c9-d75328b0cc64.Text: {n}The Tech-Priest, who sports an Explorator emblem on his scarlet robe, directs the unblinking gaze of his augmented ocular lenses at you and says, in a hissing voice,{/n} "Salutatory functionality initiated. Glory to House von Valancius. Trade Terminal Zeta-42//33-Mu, property of the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMechanicus}Adeptus Mechanicus{/g} Explorator Cognisance Fleet, ready to process incoming requests. State your request. Glory to the Omnissiah."

1792982e-8254-4a95-89dd-6b2b6acbced2.Text: "Replaying automatic notification. Hear and heed. With your cooperation, the sectors within the purview of the Kappa Thread supply line have been explored in their entirety. As stipulated by the protocol, further requests for information exchange with the unit Zeta-42//33-Mu regarding planetary scouting are blocked. This trade terminal is initiating a data transfer to the Cognisance Fleet conclave."

5844d6ca-e04d-4998-8a6e-a2145aee5ed5.Text: "Data concerning the unit {name} von Valancius's contribution to the cause of total comprehension has been added to the information packet due to be transferred to the Cognisance Fleet. Per the mutual aid encouragement subroutine, it will be noted in your file that you have been granted privileged service status. Glory to the Omnissiah."

8fe736d6-6381-44a6-9a7c-a1b457deed4c.Text: "Information request declined. Acceptable response not found for the following reason. Hear and heed. Request falls outside Processing Trade and Information Requests and Offers functionality. Try restating your request." {n}Without missing a beat, the Tech-Priest adds confidently,{/n} "Glory to the Omnissiah."

073dd8de-4742-493f-a762-6cd6ce93d433.Text: "Request processing channel opened. Trade terminal Zeta-42//33-Mu hears and heeds. State your request. Glory to the Omnissiah."

d135929e-25f6-48be-aff1-5202842e299d.Text: "Identification request accepted. Acceptable response found. Hear and heed. This unit's identifier is Trade Terminal Zeta-42//33-Mu. Designated purpose: processing trade and information requests and offers made to the Adeptus Mechanicus Explorator Cognisance Fleet. State your request. Glory to the Omnissiah."

dd461344-2650-4182-be79-1979aee720ed.Text: "Information request accepted. Acceptable response found. Hear and heed. The unit Logis Opticon-22 was instructed to leave the location Footfall and head to the strategic location Eufrates II in order to provide support to the Explorator Cognisance Fleet. After standard rites were performed on Trade Terminal Zeta-42//33-Mu, it was deemed an adequate functional replacement and received the blessing to process requests at the location Footfall. State your request. Glory to the Omnissiah."

4049ad89-34bf-4bf2-9a59-d1b825ab96e3.Text: "Information exchange request accepted. Acceptable response found. Hear and heed. The information supplied has been deemed norm-conformant and is acceptable. This unit is grateful to House von Valancius for its cooperation. It will be rewarded in accordance with the mutual aid encouragement subroutine. Glory to the Omnissiah."

9fc17334-c59b-46fd-add2-7d0e6af3759d.Text: "Request-processing functionality suspended. Glory to the Omnissiah."

cd025719-73b6-420a-baeb-fc1bc281bd4c.Text: "Information request accepted. Acceptable response found. Hear and heed. The unit Rogue Trader Incendia Bastaal-Chorda and the specified unit's actions have no significant effect on the operation of this Explorator Cognisance Fleet mission, since the specified unit has no jurisdiction over the Adeptus Mechanicus or any assets thereof. Glory to the Omnissiah."

d69fd666-1ddc-4234-9ce0-559d7d6075a3.Text: "Failed to parse request. Are you seeking to access the trading interface? Glory to the Omnissiah."

7130735a-369e-4389-b274-0c34179fb925.Text: "Replaying automatic notification. Hear and heed. The Cognisance Fleet approves of your wish to contribute to the cause of total knowledge acquisition. The Cognisance Fleet is open to further data donations."

4d54f3d1-c128-4cd7-bb74-27b3ffa4bfdc.Text: "Who do we have here? A couple of hardened insurgents?"

b9171229-4709-449f-a794-ae354a4fbfea.Text: "Why would I take part in that?"

e47fb475-46d9-4d24-aca6-b8ec6eed995d.Text: "What forces do you have at your command?"

1b71e287-dfca-4cd4-a158-717691df2292.Text: "You are so docile! But I merely wanted to see how quickly you would renounce your faith and start grovelling. You are obviously not getting out of here alive."

7fb82724-160f-4701-818a-06e110552542.Text: "What does Ryzza have a problem with?"

0a046f15-dc19-4b70-9692-2f9e18398d36.Text: "News of Incendia's death is hardly going to please the Lord Inquisitor."

4637616b-d8bb-42af-80d1-36e2d06d77ee.Text: "I see no issue in letting Incendia know you are here. Get ready. Your enemies will be here soon."

d6ec706c-fb7b-41b1-99e9-ecec57b8b652.Text: "I see your position of authority has not changed you. You remain the bandit you always were."

15f98a7e-dac5-41c8-8674-a6e84d1291a3.Text: [Laugh] "What a sorry sight — the old outlaw, hounded and hiding like a rat."

126c8ff0-4b15-465a-bd5c-a8a6138c6780.Text: "Well, between Incendia and you, she has done the better job of imposing order."

f4d941d0-c8e1-438d-8ce3-8fb3683603c2.Text: Attacked the rebels led by Vladaym Tocara.

c6b2c806-8334-41cf-85e0-21b76b1445a6.Text: [Draw your weapon and shout] "In the name of the law, every insurgent present here is under arrest!"

f877f9c8-4cc9-4506-a7e3-70c1256f510b.Text: "I will go and take a look around."

f6f3af2d-1719-4ac8-9d1b-e45ee53b234b.Text: Agreed to overthrow Chorda in order to save as many lives as possible.

cc627c27-c1c0-41bc-aa47-3ca8eafd5dc9.Text: "I will help you overthrow Chorda. Each second of her continued rule will cost the lives of hundreds of innocent people."

b3276056-1ff3-4eae-9ba5-3a4c657a34e7.Text: "Are you aware that Octaviana is already coveting your position in the Kasballica?"

b6d7cacb-3295-4197-a191-b416998df048.Text: "I am going to see Calcazar. There are serious things I need to discuss with him."

800df51c-34cf-4904-9946-b1dde14dfa6e.Text: "Jae has a few questions for you. Regarding Falco and her gang."

36fd72b1-55e5-4ccd-8899-46fc24458789.Text: "What kind of help do you expect from me?"

947673bf-c6bc-4f05-9da3-14fc9a3339d9.Text: "How is the station doing? I can see you have everything under control again."

1c2264b9-02ca-4f75-8f00-daa0e801dd41.Text: Agreed to destroy Chorda and denounced the Emperor's justice.

16e81878-bb89-40da-8941-a2f104a66247.Text: "Down with Chorda. The Emperor's justice has revealed the rot at its core at last. Let us drown it in the blood of self-appointed champions of the faith!"

e8d38f41-e9e7-4106-8094-bb53850bc371.Text: "Let us trade. I need your organisation's merchandise."

ab9297b3-1f67-44b0-a303-ba6c0090fa1c.Text: Made Vladaym Tocara kneel before the Great Beacon.

5e4175e9-8ea2-41e9-a196-ae5c394fe31b.Text: "You want my help? You can get it — on one condition. In my protectorate, I am worshipped as a deity. Fall to your knees, renounce all other patrons, and swear allegiance to me, the Great Beacon, the living {mf|god|goddess}."

86d71ce5-6dc1-4609-8238-9cf07b52cf59.Text: "I would like to make a deal with the Kasballica."

cecd5f2b-f7f6-41c7-a01f-d214087186f6.Text: "You have no other options, Ryzza. If you abandon Footfall to Chorda and flee, where are you going to sell your goods? Or restock your supplies? It will just be a slow death for all of you, with no ammunition, no water, and no air. So quit bargaining with fate and stick to the plan."

98dc68ac-b661-4f0b-940a-c147f8623a93.Text: {n}Vladaym slides his glasses down his nose and looks up at you. His eyes are tired but alight with anger.{/n} "Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship?"

66ce0e78-0913-4aea-a060-1c3f734f2fcd.Text: "Plan? More like a suicide pact. You have no allies, no weapons, no... nothing!" {n}Vladaym and Ryzza notice you, and the old pirate grins sarcastically.{/n} "You're a runt trying to play with the big boys, Vackemo. You've taken on a Rogue Trader dynasty with only a handful of heavies and a couple of guns to your name. The way I see it, your march to the gallows is more of a gallop."

dc2c8974-fa28-4bde-8cf0-0ba31fbb6500.Text: {n}Vladaym replies, in a stiff, formal tone,{/n} "My apologies for being unable to receive Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship in my office. My present status imposes certain... limitations on me."

6605137a-1cd4-4324-af92-1fdc5a215fac.Text: {n}With a wry smile, Vladaym corrects you:{/n} "Ungodly, lawless rabble-rousers who are a threat to the security of this station. Kindly refer to us using our full titles, please."

cfdc2ff9-dd38-4c57-b030-65c412690143.Text: "You are hard to ignore, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. You have a habit of radically altering the state of affairs of whatever situation you wade into."

6d0c842c-c5ce-47c7-af60-b4b7ee74f5dd.Text: "Greetings, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. And as for you, Vackemo... I've got nothing to add. Your plan's utter crap — I don't gamble on those kinds of odds. I'll leave you to think about your prospects. Maybe you'll realise that using my shuttle would be a better idea... while me and my shuttle are still here."
