36deb7ad-016a-4d55-9851-45d467da99b5.Text: "The Sky-Herald stands at the crossroads — I see all of {mf|his|her} choices and see none of them... But this servant knows one thing clearly — the Starborn must go to the Deadlands to destroy the one who should have been long dead."

d70c0aee-123e-43ae-84c8-c599f12bbedc.Text: "Leads-Ahead is the half-sister of this servant of smoke, fire, and ash. She was the first to emerge from the mother's womb and thus named the next ruler of the tribe. And this servant was the shield to fend off disasters from his ruler. Many years later, when the gift of the Eagle-God awakened inside this servant, Leads-Ahead named her brother the priest of her tribe."

afe070ee-2f48-440c-a78b-998331fff128.Text: "That's strange. I can't see or hear anything from the other side... But I'll go ahead and say it since nobody else wants to — I don't like this one bit. So if the darkness leaves the forest, something bad will happen? I thought it was usually the other way around."

c0c0bcc2-24ae-4b66-b4b4-dbfdb255b607.Text: {n}The sinewy old man bows his head in reverence.{/n} "With your arrival, the blessing of the Two-Headed Eagle-God has descended upon Quetza Temer, O Starborn! This servant of the skies, earth, and those in between foresaw this conversation in his dreams a long time ago. This servant hopes that the Sky-Herald of the faraway stars will bring peace to the forests of his tribe."

b8f0f793-08a3-4b23-92ae-849d55db1fa8.Text: "Speaks-With-Gods welcomes you, Starborn." {n}His violet eyes are reverently trained on you.{/n} "How can Speaks-With-Gods help you this time?"

fdbfa266-8931-4c50-880a-7d2a7ca24f06.Text: "I pray for this with every breath, O Starborn."

721c4bf4-873f-41fc-b1bc-f967dfab3ddb.Text: "The lingo-cultural analysis of the target's speech suggests that the expression 'three life-dwells' equals one hundred and fifty standard Terran years."

a1b50018-b674-44de-8f4d-0dead23f6b97.Text: "Either my memory's as empty as an amasec decanter after a party, or I've heard this before."

9da43320-a6a1-45ed-978f-25b7dcaa6e8e.Text: "Iron-clad guardian? I suppose you mean Calligos Winterscale's Arch-Militant. Worten the Grey seemed dangerous to me even on our first meeting, but our time together spent wandering through the forest cemented this notion."

36046f2d-1777-429f-b2dc-32170f0f4715.Text: "The absurdity of this old man's words hides nothing but snow-white reverence... He has no intention of offending the Emperor. There is only a golden glow in his heart akin to that of His most faithful followers."

92f0c000-d5d2-4aa5-ba97-bbd6dd04ce55.Text: {n}Suddenly, the old man throws his head back — his body shudders, and droplets of blood burst from between his clenched teeth.{/n} "The sunset rays will paint the heart of the forest crimson if the darkness leaves it, and the two stars will part, then meet again! Crimson... Crimson... The fading light can still be saved..." {n}The priest covers his face with his hands and breathes slowly, finally coming to his senses.{/n} "F-forgive this servant, Sky-Herald. The waking dreams are often the most... painful..."

2d17db19-28cb-433e-9aeb-cd147fe7e09f.Text: "No. I want to finish her myself."

8dbfedfb-6000-471b-9faf-773de8d6c721.Text: "Strike carefully. I need her spirit stone."

85bddcc5-4ace-4a85-9767-4e0da24acede.Text: "She is no longer a threat. Leave her be."

550492c4-f1d2-4e57-9f70-aebb30a0897c.Text: [Whisper before killing Yrliet] "She Who Thirsts will be delighted with this offering. Farewell."

396aa20c-00e3-4a3a-963d-b4a8ee0baa30.Text: [Kill Yrliet] "Your blood shall be my reward. Die, xenos!"

1ee1061e-0f97-499e-b216-a9f17a8ea0a2.Text: "Why so quiet? Will you not even curse me before your demise?"

17fe2718-9592-4bb7-a0c7-8570311c2e8a.Text: "No, death is too light a punishment for you. You will live and suffer in the knowledge that, despite all your efforts, you could not save anyone."

53967819-980b-44cb-b8f5-f98ee3c98c9b.Text: "I have enjoyed our hunt and look forward to the next one."

fc5793c8-4069-483c-8e82-7410fdbbce09.Text: "You could barely keep up with me. Is your age getting to you, Calligos?"

0fa41583-1ce9-4ac9-8de9-916d7640733a.Text: "What impudence! Did I order you to kill the Aeldari?"

507415eb-7d34-4176-8f05-18cf19fddcb5.Text: {n}Calligos towers over the slaughtered Aeldari corpses, roaring with laughter, not noticing the blood that has covered him from head to toe trickling down his face right into his throat.{/n} "What a thrill, new blood! It has been some time since I last enjoyed myself so, but I'll be damned if I don't crave more!"

e5b48e24-6628-445f-87cd-9ccd8aa724f7.Text: {n}Yrliet's body is covered in grave wounds, and her shallow, infrequent breathing is barely audible. She struggles to her knees, but she does not look at Calligos — her gaze, brimming with hatred, is trained on you.{/n}

0bbc0aa1-cfb3-4909-8b28-f7c379ec62e3.Text: {n}A thought surfaces in your mind, one that clearly does not belong to you, yet your body reacts to it with a burning possessive desire. A thought that is both alluring and revolting: you must offer her spirit stone to She Who Thirsts.{/n}

fd8ed947-a8fb-4f5c-8f36-3d6ba0357cb8.Text: "I could do that duty for you..." {n}Argenta casts a disdainful look at Yrliet.{/n}

0180852b-de3b-46a6-8059-d719ed2be0a6.Text: {n}Staring into Worten's eyes, Ulfar snarls grimly,{/n} "Instinct tells me that our duty is not yet fully done." {n}Ulfar shifts his expectant gaze to you. He unobtrusively makes a sign with his outstretched hand. This gesture, one of the most universal among the mute languages of the Imperium, means "ready to attack on command."{/n}

aa81371f-4dc8-4eed-bb6c-0ade79a1032c.Text: "What now, new blood? Feeling pity for the xenos?"

7ef6ae73-0d71-4a20-8fb4-98e038f82673.Text: "I don't care. The purpose of prey is to die at the hunter's hands. More blood for the Rogue Trader's throne!"

b3656b8f-1c34-4e32-a2aa-027f644002b1.Text: "You fought well, little bird. But not well enough. More blood for the Rogue Trader's throne!"

fb2cf233-78e4-4978-a380-a059dccaf669.Text: "There are so many rotting Aeldari around, but you still want the stone from her in particular? But you fought well — your trophy is yours to choose. More blood for the Rogue Trader's throne!"

f8152448-d18a-424b-8bb2-fb48a1c02af4.Text: "You fought well — you have the right. But do not hesitate, or this right will become mine instead."

c09d39b6-f9ff-48df-ae76-ea7f71ae4a50.Text: {n}Yrliet does not avert her gaze even when you approach her. No curse or word escapes her lips. The time for words ended the moment you took up arms against her kin.{/n}

09985f7d-3433-4fe4-aec0-d90ea734dbf2.Text: {n}Proudly raising her head, she burns you with her spiteful gaze. Even in her final moments, she does not stoop to insults or spitting in your face. Such are the Children of Asuryan.{/n}

97b2964a-5bcf-4991-8b11-7076b3d0c1b1.Text: "Sorry, new blood. We've been talking for too long — I grew bored of it." {n}Calligos shrugs his shoulders and winks at you, unfazed.{/n} "And yet I've enjoyed running around the forest and tearing the xenos to shreds with you. A good hunt indeed. And a good hunt calls for a proper reward! Worten?"

5d809492-ef92-4999-9697-a9c74dece8bb.Text: {n}The headless body of Yrliet slumps into the mud, and the fire of hatred in her eyes dies soon after.{/n}

024cf501-0435-479c-9908-d222aedd8848.Text: {n}Yrliet's eyes flash with genuine fear... and then her headless body slumps into the mud. That is how you will remember her: pathetic and terrified of a fate that, for her, is worse than death. Finally broken — by you.{/n}

a863cf80-6276-4f7d-9834-85aee5aab06f.Text: "This has been a fine hunt! I have enjoyed fighting together, new blood. You deserve something good for your efforts. Worten, reward {mf|him|her}!"

b5e0e346-9f02-4b49-aeb5-549f69e8ed3e.Text: {n}The Arch-Militant reverently hands you his blade without even shaking the fresh blood off it.{/n} "May the {mf|master|mistress} sate this blade with the blood of {mf|his|her} enemies. My lord would be quite... pleased." {n}As he says this last phrase, he gives you a broken sneer, and a vicious flame flickers in his eyes.{/n}

c777b875-44d2-46cb-a25c-bc816a7e0538.Text: "As am I, new blood. I shall see you among the stars."

5241d374-766b-4031-ae8b-2f0a06763257.Text: "If you ever grow strong enough to challenge me, I will gladly cross blades with you, {name}. Perhaps I'll even tear your big-mouthed head off! Farewell for now, for my hunt is over."

73a50790-01c6-4add-ad88-fcc70803cf35.Text: "Farewell, new blood. I am done hunting for the day."

e82b2faa-9471-4d5f-8fa1-e613a3b035a0.Text: "You've got a long way to go before you can order me around. Are you angry? Good. Anger is power. When you build up enough of it, come and find me, and we shall fight as equals and see who comes out on top. Farewell for now. My hunt is over."

f1e6afb7-6df4-4219-8438-ac5827eb1412.Text: {n}Marazhai observes the unfolding scene without the slightest hint of compassion for his fallen "cousin."{/n} "Now all is as it should be. Farewell, Yrliet. You were useful to me... for a while."

32a794b5-a89f-4910-8efd-9239e1649111.Text: {n}There is no gloating in Ulfar's voice, only quiet satisfaction.{/n} "Farewell, xenos. I warned you that one day this moment would come. You are certainly not the vilest spawn of your species, you are even principled in a way, but... This is right. Simple as that."

6cc043fa-e5f6-44b1-9f73-747f52cf63dc.Text: {n}A faintly curious smile appears on Kibellah's lips.{/n} "Puncture her lungs. Let them slowly fill with blood and make her body burn... It is a long, excruciating death. A fitting end for inhuman filth."

abb4ccfb-766c-4ab8-a155-73c705e923e1.Text: [Attack] "You are deaf to others' words and blind to your own deeds."

64faf65c-42c6-4f9a-8b02-0d3e4141f0af.Text: "Ulfar, what must be done to a warrior who has disgraced himself?"

24d4d74f-218f-4b84-96be-473c0bfcd729.Text: "For a while now, I have had my suspicions about the source of your remarkable strength. You have turned to the Ruinous Powers."

1597b94f-e70c-491a-9794-e1afee8a2d7b.Text: "All of Quetza Temer is yours by right. But this is too much."

c5f18e40-c3ce-4015-ae27-849013774c05.Text: "O Emperor of Humanity, grant the fallen salvation and the living strength! Deliver us from the foul breath of corruption that we may offer our lives..."

02c53d34-0def-4adf-9bae-7f9b55e3ba11.Text: "I believe that Worten is the one responsible for your delusion. Back on Dargonus, I noticed that he is not who he claims to be. Yet you seem to be unwilling to acknowledge it."

cf0c422e-5660-44f3-8298-1e7a0eb7df5c.Text: "You have turned a calm settlement into bloody carnage. What other evidence does one need?"

a6919f73-487a-46a7-8383-41c1d31a46cf.Text: "I hope that your people will be able to take care of you. I will see you among the stars, Calligos."

ec6f510b-40cf-49eb-aef1-39ae269ea758.Text: "Look around — your own retinue is terrified of you!"

7c830a56-de98-4c1f-a4e5-430f85afbdf5.Text: "Oh, you could, and you did. The Archenemy took over your soul, and rage took over your body."

fc9efe02-51b9-45de-8d98-6c4b0a309b32.Text: "Succumbing to Chaos? Pathetic. The much-vaunted will of Calligos Winterscale proved to be hollow bluster."

fe1801f3-5b3f-4302-964a-a09b47437184.Text: "What happened to you, Calligos? What have you become?"

54b2487e-47cf-470f-8135-54cb2352b261.Text: [Attack] "By the power vested in me by the Imperium, I hereby condemn you to death."

7afc4589-26a8-45a6-a173-5587ed1d28be.Text: [Attack] "Your body and soul are tarnished by the Archenemy and are to be cleansed. Repent!"

eebeda23-8b1d-44d1-b2cb-68dd9c779bac.Text: [Attack] "There is no room for words. You are guilty and will pay for what you've done."

e6c72c6c-7161-42d7-a8a5-801ec550651c.Text: "Don't move. I will call for help."

128122a7-db34-47e0-9dfd-8e203164a333.Text: "I know that you killed your own Seneschal."

1c05e3fd-2a95-4a9f-901e-feecb9a1ff52.Text: "I saw the bodies of the xenos in the forest. You didn't just kill them — you carved up their bodies and enjoyed every moment, thirsting for more blood."

7fe925ff-5e71-4ce3-946a-d96c493058f2.Text: "The Winterscale I have heard of would have never thrown his worlds to Chorda only to indulge in mindless hunting."

d4d60c0e-7446-4363-b1a0-1ab33c9bd49c.Text: [Finish Calligos] "You are a mere shadow of yourself now. I grant you mercy."

7897c024-d6e0-4397-8aef-27a44af2aed5.Text: "I had hoped that you would listen to reason. I was wrong."

16ce1a8f-9079-4a31-b1dc-8289abd2f354.Text: [Finish Calligos] "I commend your ability to read one's intentions."

52b5e081-e26e-43a7-aa93-736f7af706b5.Text: "I will take you to the Emperor's Vow."

1200712f-8fa7-44eb-b9d0-d47c95e0abc7.Text: "Your spine seems to be damaged. There is no walking with that."

69432a9a-249f-4fb7-965b-436c06f447e9.Text: Revealed Worten's true nature to Calligos.

7b3bfb72-30ff-428e-bb11-ab8e2d36c0aa.Text: [Point a blessed finger at Worten] "There stands the Archenemy's spawn that has corrupted your soul. Behold him as I do, here and now!"

51794905-5c43-4782-864c-6e65b6a7480c.Text: [Point a blessed finger at Worten] "There stands the Archenemy's spawn that has corrupted your soul. Behold him as I do, here and now!"

efdae3d5-2b93-4adc-a493-cad2b2c11c6f.Text: "Why the Throne did you rush to save me?"

2f13ec88-40d6-4978-9e11-3884d2f1ea89.Text: [Finish Calligos] "Winterscale at the feet of von Valancius? A perfect opportunity to behead a rival protectorate."

de53beee-329a-470e-be5a-0934a377e6da.Text: [Finish Calligos] "Wounds of the flesh can be healed. Those of the soul and the mind cannot."

a31f02a0-ca49-41c5-8cdf-190a3c8eedb0.Text: "Your Arch-Militant is a heretic and a servant of Chaos. He is the one fanning the flames of your rage."

1d0b2a81-1c01-4edf-b83e-1b19e587b8fb.Text: "This massacre is your doing, is it not?"

cc16148f-4bb4-4e70-94ac-812771fa2b1e.Text: "I see that you've had an excellent time here. Why didn't you invite me?"

fd80ab6b-24c1-43c7-a0dd-6ad21ceec005.Text: [Raise your weapon] "Explain yourself. What is going on here?"

50565d31-c797-4e8d-b442-9a6a689b75a0.Text: "The blame does not lie with you, Calligos. You were manipulated by malevolent powers."

6229b361-fc95-43a2-bd46-2171f37e0a53.Text: "Unlike you, I don't make friends with xenos — I use them." {n}Calligos waves his axe in the direction of the Sslyth.{/n} "Or kill them. The death of xenos is the supreme good, and showing mercy to the enemies of Humanity is not in my nature."

7056c057-db40-4981-947a-e7db42f9a002.Text: {n}Worten the Grey seems hypnotised by his master's words, his bloodshot eyes alight with a slowly growing flame — unnatural, frightening, daemonic.{/n}

9d1245a6-0879-4e62-8e61-91f51c087ac7.Text: "Ha..." {n}Marazhai ecstatically breathes in the metal and salt floating in the air.{/n} "I am growing fond of this mon-keigh!"

5528e8f7-8902-4c6a-ba38-895096193ccb.Text: {n}Not paying any heed to what Worten just said, Calligos grimaces in disdain.{/n} "Did you and Chorda bond behind my back? Is this a plot to bore an old man to death with your incessant preaching?"

03635e96-3c2d-4f1a-93c9-91b6e5651886.Text: "No one forced you, Calligos. I merely enabled your desire, fostered it — and made your crimson rage blossom! You suspected, yet your own pride stopped you from recognising your weaknesses." {n}Worten's speech becomes more and more distorted with each word, and a thought swells in the back of your mind: you wish to kill him, tear him apart. Here, now!{/n}

4c0bd690-8ed0-4a24-8692-524e1aa603cb.Text: "What are you saying, new blood? Have the xenos addled your mind in so short a time?" {n}Calligos looks at you with a mix of surprise and confusion.{/n} "Didn't Theodora explain to you that in the Expanse, baseless accusations went out of style a good hundred years ago?"

70b1d929-5b5b-4a83-bc1c-b8624bb0b824.Text: "I raised that boy and taught him how to kill. Yes, Worten is fearless and fierce, but it's just what one would expect from a loyal dog."

ada6f83c-6a22-4f92-8948-06b743e41661.Text: {n}Calligos clicks his teeth and bursts into a fit of laughter, but then quickly calms down.{/n} "Testing the boundaries, are we, {name}? I like your boldness, but you shouldn't stick your head so far into the beast's throat."

1d3c80ba-9d03-449d-9156-1f568344ab77.Text: {n}Abelard starts in surprise.{/n} "Are you... quite serious, Lord Captain?"

7796bbdc-564b-4ac7-826f-e58d1e128f41.Text: "A saint..." {n}The Arch-Militant bares his teeth, and his eyes become even more bloodshot.{/n} "The Emperor won't help you here. My master will tear you apart and bathe in the blood of your allies!"

398bd54b-b76d-4a7b-b1a2-8176cff7e56c.Text: {n}Calligos's smile vanishes. As if not hearing his Arch-Militant's words, he coldly retorts,{/n} "Why would I explain myself to you, new blood? I rule my world as I see fit. You are a guest here."

2733ab83-6c0a-45e5-84fd-b9d2ee7cbcfe.Text: {n}Winterscale grins at his retinue, but it is not enough to dispel the oppressive silence. The Tech-Priest bows her head until her face is completely obscured by her hood. The Navigator nods curtly and quickly averts his eyes, and the Sslyth is licking a fresh wound that may have been inflicted by a power axe.{/n}

2afe9ce0-e90b-4120-8037-c02db52c35cb.Text: "What's the matter? Am I truly so terrifying that you cannot even look at me?" {n}Calligos growls in exasperation.{/n} "Where is that ridiculous psyker? At least he knows how to honour his master with his words. Old man!"

2ca4f668-878d-40e5-b00f-e1e857bf7d69.Text: "{mf|He|She} is trying to weaken your spirit, master. Lying, pretending, scheming... You know they're all the same. Rotten, cowardly, weak... Let's break them, master! And offer their skulls to the Skull God!"

c42e8d2f-f00b-4cc7-b209-7fc21a18ad8e.Text: {n}Flinching as if struck by a whip, Winterscale stares at the village with the look of someone who is seeing it for the first time. Confusion and unease creep into his gaze.{/n} "What happened here? Who dared?" {n}The realisation forms new lines on his face.{/n} "No. I surely couldn't have. Or..."

2b0740e8-81f7-4b4e-b623-276b9e674ec4.Text: {n}Calligos's eyes flash with fury.{/n} "Oh, how you irk me, you pitiful von Valancius pup! I'll do your dynasty a favour and finish you off right here and now! Rotten, cowardly, weak... Blood for the dynasty throne, skulls for the Skull God!"

9e8478c1-29b2-458e-9945-dbbda19166f7.Text: "Well, you did rush in to save my fallen soul, didn't you, {name}?" {n}A feeble smile appears on his battered face.{/n} "It's the least I could do for the one who so arduously tried to make me see."

a49c2aa6-792a-4117-87db-1f1f0f2451cc.Text: "That it was! What irony... I have waited for so long to find a worthy enemy, but ended up raising one myself and even appointing him as my right hand." {n}The Rogue Trader laughs, almost choking on blood.{/n}

ee83fd4a-0dbc-406c-9b6a-a38c7ebaca46.Text: "Come now, new blood. Let me accept His punishment and revel in the taste of atonement." {n}Calligos twists his lips into a caustic smile.{/n} "For Throne's sake, I'm talking like Incendia now... {name}, I want you to promise that you'll kill me if I ever start praying too much. I have had enough of worshippers... of all kinds."

4dd76dc9-f91b-461a-9068-97ace4036556.Text: "You have a point." {n}Calligos closes his eyes, having guessed your intentions.{/n} "Nevertheless, I am glad that it is at your hand that I die. I shall see you on the other side, {name}."

8bfb6c7f-df47-4fc9-9d96-9253b60f1644.Text: {n}Calligos's eyes slowly clear. He turns to look at Worten the Grey and immediately recoils.{/n} "I... I see it! The corruption, like a cloak around him... and around me?"

a8ddff22-1d49-4bdf-9f3e-8eaff9122ed9.Text: {n}Despite being oblivious to his Arch-Militant's words, Calligos unwittingly tenses his back and shoulders. The look in his eyes is even more feral now than before.{/n}

c4ac4683-97be-4a31-982f-d11c77624b9b.Text: "His palette... is mixed in a very strange way. The red completely covers his eyes, but everything around him glows gold and silver. I think that His Lordship Calligos Winterscale simply does not see the true colours of his deeds."

dd05c419-34b5-4fee-aa4e-20251e1ec7c7.Text: "They were born on my planet, living their pointless lives for a single purpose — to one day satisfy their master. They have fulfilled their purpose!" {n}Calligos responds with a crooked grin.{/n}

91057c34-4e83-41dd-b206-9b82b6c150f2.Text: {n}The Arch-Militant's smile becomes even more bestial. You blink, and your eyes finally see the truth — there it is, the epicentre of corruption. Like a black whirlwind, Chaos energy rages wildly around Worten the Grey, reaching for Calligos, trying to close its hideous clawed tentacles around the Rogue Trader's neck and pierce his heart.{/n}

f26e4129-3fb2-4056-8d9d-c6c4b7ab31c2.Text: "Bloody pile of scrap, I will tear off your mechadendrites and stuff them down your throat!"

60dfd695-2d26-468f-86a4-762aa74cec08.Text: "The Rogue Trader seeks to befog your mind, master. Such insolence! Slit {mf|his|her} throat, quickly!"

a762c8d4-a712-406e-8abc-0515e9663ce8.Text: "I smell corruption. A great deal of foul corruption." {n}Ulfar stares fiercely at the carnage.{/n} "They were killed not for need or cause, but for pleasure. I know what bodies look like when someone revelled in the slaughter — they look like this."

478cbf55-bed2-4fbb-b7c4-cee04bddd505.Text: {n}Ulfar's voice resounds like a headsman's axe striking the block.{/n} "Mock him, put him to death, trample his personal badge, and expunge him from the sagas. That is the way of Fenris."

63cf5c08-631d-4db2-b9d3-49e1eda82f61.Text: "This is your last chance, Calligos. Cleave this upstart in two with the axe that I blessed for you. Skin {mf|him|her} and bathe in {mf|his|her} blood. We will forget everything and continue on our journey — to hunt and to kill. This is the way you prefer to drown out your loneliness and boredom, is it not?"

481918b0-c09d-40e2-a102-4c65a13c194f.Text: "I am the Rogue Trader, a warrior of the God-Emperor and the great ruler of my dynasty. They should tremble in the face of their master's power! But not out of fear, no. Out of reverence."

108cab30-2a1e-46ad-8021-ed81a27bb16e.Text: "Weak, worthless fool! I have spent so many years growing this rage inside you, and still you resist! Did you think you could refuse the blessing of the Skull God at the last moment? Well... one way or another, he will claim you all." {n}Worten's flesh bursts, and the last thing you notice is his hateful gaze turning to you.{/n}

3a61ea36-a34d-4cb2-ad97-218f95d93d24.Text: {n}Kibellah's eyes quickly take in the mutilated corpses, absorbing every gory detail.{/n} "Sacrilege. This was more than just a massacre, it was... an offering to one's own thirst. The one who did this was not trying to honour the Undying One, but rather... someone else. Something else."

56c399ae-7acd-4870-9a78-0281356ca7a5.Text: "To accept death from a Sister of Battle would not be the dullest of fates." {n}Calligos smiles bitterly.{/n}

7d61d5b7-512e-44ec-beb8-738d2131c920.Text: "This is all your doing... You wretched cur!" {n}Calligos swings his axe at the Arch-Militant, but he evades the mortal blow with the grace of a viper.{/n} "I showed you mercy, and you have been corrupting my soul this entire time? Forcing me—"

99255a9e-845d-4219-8afa-59be412fb6e0.Text: "And I succumbed to them." {n}A doomed expression falls across Calligos's face.{/n}

590b5b8e-499e-4826-8a8a-2be20ea8be62.Text: "The Rogue Trader cannot atone for his crimes before the God-Emperor. His soul will only be saved by the cleansing flames."

6c403143-542c-44a8-8119-b88d161c952b.Text: "There is nothing to think about, Rogue Trader. Calligos Winterscale was thought to be one of the most remarkable people in the Expanse, but even he succumbed to the Archenemy's influence. When the fish rots from the head, the head is cut off with no regrets. So do what the Imperium expects from a bearer of the Warrant."

9208626f-87cc-48a1-8aef-2483a0d350d8.Text: "Calligos Winterscale is the hand of the Emperor that shields the Expanse from Humanity's enemies. He has seen his true nature and that of his deeds. And while I would rather not admit it, he would serve the Imperium far better alive than dead."

f3bada15-0220-4c20-9692-50962175b7ed.Text: "Blood for the Rogue Trader's throne! Skulls for the Skull God!" {n}Calligos Winterscale laughs uncontrollably, looking around the blood-soaked village. His eyes are full of rage, as if absolute insanity has possessed him.{/n}

0a45554c-78dc-4ce3-8db7-010cebe98ce2.Text: {n}Calligos howls in desperation and rage, but he has nothing to say to you.{/n}

c87fac2b-ee88-46f6-a361-e7848c7f7597.Text: {n}Calligos Winterscale lies on the ground, staring into the endless sky of Quetza Temer. His pelvis is twisted unnaturally, his legs are not moving, and an exposed bone shard protrudes from his right arm. Blood streams down his chin in a thin rivulet with no sign of stopping.{/n}

dd3a2cfd-140f-4127-944a-e8079ca3ae7c.Text: "There it is, the face of a true Rogue Trader! I'm proud of you, new blood. You will go places, just like me!" {n}Calligos's smile in the face of death is one of vehement spirit.{/n}

d73c824b-fc30-4bd4-a6a3-9b7f1bc1b3fd.Text: "Mercy may not be exactly applicable, {name}. Unless, of course, your intention is to get rid of a rival." {n}Winterscale remarks in a goading tone.{/n} "My body has augmetics installed that track the condition of my internal organs and injuries. The Emperor's Vow already knows where I am and what state I am in. The rescue squad will arrive soon, and the chirurgeons will heal my wounds in time."

58649ca1-3be2-4b63-98e6-c854e4cc4a2b.Text: "Have it your way." {n}Calligos lets out a tired sigh.{/n} "I don't want you to think that I am desperately clinging to life. My successors are sharp... not all of them, of course. But I will be rooting for them from the other side — so that they keep things interesting for you." {n}He twists his lips mockingly and closes his eyes.{/n}

c6367f4a-98e6-42f5-b2af-af3f3ebce434.Text: "There is no need. But if you are so concerned about an old man's health — I shan't stop you."

94e07bef-52c2-4f12-9b44-5e2c7259a09b.Text: "I will remain here with what's left of my escort and wait for help. And you should go — there are still so many undiscovered stars and unknown worlds out there..." {n}Calligos's gaze once again turns to the sky, where the first stars begin to appear.{/n}

7fb62df0-7814-416d-a83b-a2ecc1ba3c9c.Text: "You think that I would let you {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_Quetza_WinterscaleCalm}dampen my hunting spirit again{/d}?" {n}Calligos smirks.{/n} "Besides, you were too preoccupied with your xenos friends! Even those such as we who write the fates of worlds cannot have everything all at once in this life."

2b8b75e3-5522-4875-9584-60c997a59180.Text: "Farewell, Rogue Trader." {n}Calligos uses the last of his strength to salute you, lets out a loud sigh, and loses consciousness.{/n}

98485153-e45d-4d70-a340-9c10fdc98fef.Text: {n}The remaining members of Winterscale's retinue have dispersed around the village's centre. The Navigator apathetically observes the massacre from a distance, the Tech-Priest appears overly fascinated with assembling and disassembling her own leg augmetics, and the Sslyth mercenary is razing the village, wholly satisfied. Only Calligos's new psyker, Speaks-With-Gods, is nowhere to be seen.{/n}

338c6fd2-7913-4fec-af22-3271d19e9535.Text: {n}Calligos turns around and gives you the broadest of smiles.{/n} "Ah, {name}! How was your hunt?"

099ccc13-9480-4acd-869e-8ce4c3b998f3.Text: "Are you challenging my master? He will shred you to pieces and bathe in the blood of your allies!" {n}Worten grins, no longer playing the part of a dull-witted henchman.{/n}

cb408aa4-68a6-4ee8-acf3-eadf62109ce2.Text: "It was a good fight, new blood." {n}For the first time, Calligos Winterscale's voice is calm and humble.{/n}

a561d2d7-2d95-4217-b1e6-0f5bcebb368c.Text: "It seems that you may be correct!" {n}Calligos does not look dismayed by your words in the slightest.{/n} "After all, I can't even feel anything below the chest! Aside from an overwhelming feeling of helplessness, of course." {n}He lets out a contented wheeze instead of a laugh.{/n}

d3bf3319-1327-459a-aa61-f6ea98098e00.Text: {n}Calligos turns around and finally notices the blood-covered Arch-Militant. Something about his servant seems to have puzzled him.{/n} "What's wrong with your eyes, Worten?" {n}The Arch-Militant bares his fangs rabidly. After several moments of silence, Calligos absent-mindedly looks away,{/n} "Where were we? Ah, yes, new blood. Have I already told you that your accusations are baseless?"

5eae9941-6269-4506-9637-2711b532ef87.Text: "The unit that identified itself as Speaks-With-Gods has been annihilated, Lord Captain. You personally conducted the execution. Your reasoning was, I quote..." {n}Calligos's voice emerges from the Tech-Priest's intricate system of cables and speakers:{/n} "You think I need saving, old man? You say you can see the future? Well, did you foresee this?" {n}The buzzing of a power axe is blunted by human flesh, followed by a cry, a gargle, and the dull sound of a body falling to the ground.{/n}

d717fb30-abee-4709-9df7-66d57df25d4c.Text: "I... don't remember anything like that." {n}Calligos shuts his eyes and grips his head in confusion.{/n}

63ad740f-56b1-442a-81cb-06f2f5e471be.Text: "My body and soul were meant to belong to the God-Emperor, but I have failed Him." {n}A bitter smile crosses Calligos's lips.{/n} "It seems that our righteous Incendia was right after all..."

f42a0b2e-eefa-4266-8e60-69d0bbbc85c0.Text: "What nonsense are you spewing, new blood? Aerdrig died at the hands of the xenos who attacked our camp at night!" {n}Either Calligos is a skilful liar, or he truly cannot remember what actually happened.{/n}

a2c1f6c5-f7da-41fb-9584-c797d64390df.Text: {n}Under the oppressive weight of Winterscale's gaze, his entourage grows even more lifeless and submissive. Everyone but Worten the Grey is trying not to look into the crazed eyes of their master.{/n}

0b85c004-fdef-47c6-bbf6-aa78599817bc.Text: "I am registering a Category— aborted. Confrontation estimated as imminent. Blasphemy registration unnecessary." {n}Pasqal adjusts the grip on his weapon. His visor turns scarlet, and the dot of his aiming laser lights up on Worten's chest.{/n}

d89c95dd-6bf9-40dd-a3b5-778e89b405f5.Text: {n}Calligos looks at Kibellah.{/n} "You there, holy assassin... Care to do something for me? It's nothing new to you."

9ffccf7a-2829-42c4-80ad-b34acb51bca8.Text: "No. You have corrupted too much of your heart to plead for a swift death. And you are too badly wounded to survive without immediate aid. Lie here and die like an animal." {n}She turns away from him indifferently.{/n}

e51e7a70-189e-4813-87d3-09d3803b8d66.Text: "Domin, don't. He is broken in both body and spirit. Helping him would only disfigure his heart further... Or if you do help him, you should at least sever the tendons in his hands and feet, then cut out his tongue. That way, whatever monster he has become, he will no longer be a danger."

39bafc80-f204-437d-a35f-b4cfbb0f7797.Text: {n}Glaito silently bares his teeth as Solomorne casts a cursory eye over the scene of carnage.{/n} "Pointless butchery." {n}The Proctor's voice is dispassionate, but his nostrils flare ever so slightly, as if he had caught a stirring scent.{/n}

679e3120-31aa-4aab-9d4f-5dc7d1b8bfe7.Text: "If I could ask the Emperor one question, it would be this: 'Why is the Warrant inherited?' By the Lex, what can a man who wreaks such mindless slaughter possibly give the Imperium?"

d51a8a3b-9674-4af8-9fa2-3f50ccd55ab5.Text: "By the Golden Throne!" {n}In a daze, Argenta looks at the butchered bodies of the local villagers — men and women, young and old.{/n} "What offence did these poor souls commit to deserve such a gruesome fate?"

f49425ea-5ad1-469a-95a5-c6d0d4a1c44c.Text: "As they should be!" {n}Winterscale roars, and a loud echo rolls through the forest.{/n} "I am a Rogue Trader, warrior of the God-Emperor and the great ruler of my dynasty. They should tremble and prostrate themselves before me at the slightest sign of my anger, and beg for forgiveness!"

6d6f8f75-c8c2-4186-ba2a-dbd94f409c22.Text: "This mon-keigh killed his own kin just because he could not kill mine?" {n}Yrliet's face is shadowed by a shroud of guilt.{/n} "I... did not wish for it to end this way, elantach."

e4b8fcd1-447f-4fed-9a4d-06639b771555.Text: {n}Calligos's smile grows faint, condescending.{/n} "You {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_Quetza_WinterscaleCalm}convinced me{/d} to stop hunting the xenos, new blood. But thirst and melancholy got the better of me sooner than I anticipated. I grew bored. And those worthless peasants squealed so miserably that I wanted to strangle them more, and more, and more..." {n}His eyes briefly glaze over.{/n}

2d90faf9-7b15-4914-91de-01b8e697bc00.Text: "If gold and authority ever turn me into such a soulless ashmag, you better shoot me where I stand, shereen!"

1da0a1e6-c0fa-492a-a825-5b7b3341d4b2.Text: Told Calligos that the two of you shared a kinship upon perceiving the corruption within him.

5049a4e5-3d2e-4424-8821-5c3acb5fa8a4.Text: "So much for a reunion of old friends."

e084891a-937f-417b-b83b-d9edecf340e1.Text: "Then the first order of business is to return the priest to the heart of the forest and calm its rage."

4281d42a-f05b-4a6f-b57b-de5d2c1ee2e0.Text: "Calligos, look at me. I am {name} von Valancius."

319dfb4d-7978-4e47-84e9-ea179384ccb3.Text: "Easy, easy! I came here to solve your xenos problem, not become part of it."

dc4766c4-d0ab-4fad-afab-3eadcf5440e0.Text: "In the name of the God-Emperor, Calligos Winterscale, do not make me kill you!"

d92b57fa-c50b-4373-8802-34efdff11dc7.Text: "You know what, Calligos? Let's swap. I have grown quite sick of Marazhai."

e6743295-5a54-4298-8ed0-1f95780db103.Text: "I am here to return Speaks-With-Gods to the village and pacify this forest."

30406362-76e1-4fc2-9206-ec0dd2c705a8.Text: "How do I put this... I set out to aid you and got somewhat lost."

a2b00530-8c6d-44da-bb7d-b1247ed6ac5d.Text: "I have a business proposition. Let us unite against Chorda."

f56f420f-ebee-4097-a37b-77e152ecef16.Text: "You announced that a xenos hunt was on, so I decided to join."

3e2dd3c7-609d-4b70-8980-d85864d6bb8a.Text: "Your servants tearfully begged me to return you to your voidship. I magnanimously agreed."

d7786ed5-fa54-4042-8aa8-9f6b7b9fad37.Text: "I am here to resolve your conflict with the Aeldari. With as little violence as possible."

3990d509-5160-49ec-b39b-17762e3073b1.Text: "You have already destroyed four xenos ships, is that not a great victory in itself? Cease this hunt, and I shall make the xenos leave your worlds forever."

0a6b22ee-4d35-4c3d-b2f3-8df837b4bd12.Text: "I would gladly hunt xenos in worthy company."

607d6231-6fd8-40f4-a052-5e150964f9c1.Text: "I should like to ask a few questions about your presence on Quetza Temer."

578d9416-2d7e-4069-8525-41b533315a00.Text: "I will try harder, Marazhai. Give me a chance. Stay, and you will not be disappointed."

172a1116-03aa-42c2-84b3-8bdbc27dd1e1.Text: "I would gladly do battle with you, but I fear I may accidentally swat that tired old man."

2b3fcf94-fa66-4d41-b5db-a7f94cf4c920.Text: "Calligos, I see that you and I are kindred souls, in a way."

c4cf8566-ae03-471b-8937-20ced0c6afca.Text: "Worten, you are not as simple as you seem. What are you plotting?"

aa33759d-9e39-47be-a67c-1caa586ca31b.Text: "Did I give you permission to speak? If you forget your place one more time, you will be punished."

cc014119-434d-4b97-b9e6-8d976c529c1a.Text: "Don't sheathe your axe yet, my lord. More game rear their heads, eager to lose them." {n}The mountain of muscle next to the laughing Rogue Trader menacingly rolls its shoulders. You recognise the hulking man as Worten the Grey, Arch-Militant to Calligos Winterscale, who accompanied his master to your Magnae Accessio.{/n}

90655e1f-dc1a-4b9d-b841-314ae41ed771.Text: {n}Calligos's expression borders on admiration as he nods toward Ulfar.{/n} "You have interesting friends, {name}! I've always wanted to test my strength against a Space Marine... But fighting side by side with a mighty ally is always welcome as well."

dc5105b2-6969-4d3c-9d99-e11bc9d8cb57.Text: {n}Worten the Grey has not changed much since your last meeting — still the same brute of a man with bloodshot eyes and a dull expression on his face. The Arch-Militant does not pay you any mind, faithfully staring at his master's mouth, awaiting orders.{/n}

fed7ce5f-d664-49a4-a892-b6d2e4576e10.Text: "Well, what are you waiting for, new blood? I wandered these forests for thirty nights and did not find the way to the old twig's village. We'll see if you bring us better luck. Move out!"

c94ffa35-4339-4e99-8292-a62063b4cab2.Text: "O Starborn, graciously allow this priest to speak. The one before you is not—"

50fb4047-ede2-4785-ab2e-e7909ea7592a.Text: "Silence!" {n}Calligos barks at the old man, his eyes blinded by blood and rage.{/n} "I did not feed you to the forest beasts for one reason and one reason only — you may still be of use. If you do not want to die with these xenos... shut your mouth."

a4652216-9e64-4d3d-92a5-f87872f0e1dd.Text: "Plotting? I am merely a loyal servant of my lord. As long as I keep devising new ways to spill blood and crack skulls for him, my lord Winterscale is satisfied. And that means, so am I." {n}The Arch-Militant's lips part in a feral grin.{/n}

e0a5a286-1d4c-4d37-b5f9-34f2b6ad46ed.Text: {n}Calligos shudders from your words as if from the taste of sour wine.{/n} "I suppose no xenos would be desperate enough to feign devotion to the Imperial Creed."

9855b122-701a-45aa-a5e0-cdc61eb1a509.Text: "I have no friends, only enemies and servants."

feba4c05-8a9a-4957-9c42-9fe0d6873a22.Text: "But of course! And I am the God-Emperor of Mankind!"

4baa4fb5-1284-429c-8d94-7c631c7a7a6f.Text: {n}Calligos blinks in surprise and suddenly bursts into laughter.{/n} "Careful! I am as ready to do business with hotheads as I am to hack them off."

d07c5532-0894-472f-aef2-b396bba21da8.Text: "I do not have problems with the xenos. The xenos have problems with me." {n}Calligos licks the blood from his split lip, and something in his eyes changes.{/n}

20d4d460-8a92-4ba9-b0d1-3a70bd7d5e49.Text: {n}Marazhai smiles contentedly and raises his head even higher.{/n} "Hmm. You may one day be worth something after all. I trust that you will remember my leniency toward your weaknesses... and increase your efforts accordingly."

3d2ce6f9-9db6-4812-83fa-a180a3eac545.Text: "Oh, truly? The Aeldari next to you is but a trophy, then? And by strange coincidence has absolutely no connection to the happenings on my planet?"

09891528-3fc5-4b28-a0bf-c7efbde230be.Text: "Oh, truly? The Drukhari next to you is but a trophy, then? And by strange coincidence has absolutely no connection to the happenings on my planet?"

d5df887a-2f6f-4ba0-9b19-bb71c1c3c740.Text: "Have we a deal, then? An exchange of leashes? Von Valancius receives the Sslyth, and Winterscale the Drukhari. Let's see how well a pneumo-collar fits you, xenos..." {n}With a grin, Calligos reaches for Marazhai's neck.{/n}

9bbcb8fa-3964-4f6c-84ff-2d9281265704.Text: {n}Marazhai coolly brushes him off, nearly slapping away his fingers.{/n} "Spare me. I spent too long getting used to one mon-keigh to begin the tedious process anew."

5b191b00-58db-4417-a4ab-09a2dec3290f.Text: "So, it seems there won't be a transaction, and both sides keep their own." {n}Calligos throws one last glance at Marazhai and turns away.{/n}

04be9e4c-97d4-49bd-88b6-fc3c9cbe35fd.Text: "Oh, truly? The pair of xenos next to you are but trophies, then? And by strange coincidence have absolutely no connection to the happenings on my planet?"

b938ca10-cc58-468c-ba4f-315dec446a5c.Text: {n}Calligos blinks in surprise and suddenly bursts into laughter, lowering his axe.{/n} "I admit, I admit, xenos are not quite well versed enough in the Rogue Trader art of making ridiculous statements to pass as a member of one's retinue. But then what's this?"

29809cb4-2b7f-4905-acd8-9d99d335185d.Text: {n}Winterscale looks you up and down again, and recognition dawns on his face.{/n} "Is that you, new blood? Fancy meeting you here! What in the void are you doing on my world? On your own, no less?"

3b65d82a-e49c-4393-bc22-80766948dfbb.Text: {n}Winterscale looks you up and down again, and recognition dawns on his face.{/n} "Is that you, new blood? Fancy meeting you here! What in the void are you doing on my world? And in such company?"

8857368b-8055-4fee-84f3-07d4ec1acdf8.Text: {n}As Calligos bares his teeth ominously, the old man quickly starts whispering something into a strange seashell-like adornment he wears. Brown sparks flash in Calligos's hair, and a cloud of steam suddenly bursts from your mouth.{/n}

b0b3c9c7-be9e-457b-8285-f7768c6566f0.Text: {n}Calligos squints suspiciously.{/n} "How do you know the old man's name? Has he been a spy for you this whole time? Speak!"

57e35ecd-6c43-4951-8352-22a42ac76369.Text: "Loathsome old twig!" {n}Calligos angrily shakes his head, trying to throw off the psyker's spell. When your gazes meet again, recognition dawns on his face.{/n} "Is that you, new blood? Fancy meeting you here! What in the void are you doing on my world?"

33ac2271-63eb-4fd1-87d4-c71d223511bf.Text: "Then you're somewhat late, {name}! As you can see, the hunt has already begun. And this time it's not even my doing: the prey came to fill my hunting grounds by itself, so how could I resist?" {n}Calligos laughs without a shred of restraint.{/n} "You know, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship von Valancius, why don't you join in the revelry? I'm not greedy — this world has enough trophies for the both of us."

4907bf6c-fd54-42a9-ad16-9f1867b1be5e.Text: {n}A panicked binharic trill escapes from under the Tech-Priest's hood when one of her mechadendrites goes limp, sparking in multiple places at once. The servant of the Omnissiah gently picks it up and wearily wields her combi-tool until the manipulator starts moving again.{/n}

50565a13-887d-49e5-9436-8eb9fb34cc4d.Text: "Well then, welcome to the Quetza Temer hunting grounds!" {n}A wildfire lights in Calligos's eyes as he gestures around.{/n} "Everything here, from edge to edge, is filled with detestable xenos. I am not greedy — there are enough trophies for everyone."

86e8a589-525d-47f0-a31f-d8e22a3f8940.Text: {n}Winterscale contemptuously spits blood through his cut lip.{/n} "Useless voidborn freaks! When I return, I'll tear their legs off for doubting my strength. And their heads — for not being able to settle their problems themselves!"

1234bcf9-4134-4b16-8187-565b99e1a1c3.Text: {n}A contemptuous grimace distorts his blood-smeared face.{/n} "I could not imagine a proposition more boring. Why would I care about that pious prig Incendia? She's as predictable as the stopper from a bottle of dammassine. Now, the xenos — they are slippery, predatory, merciless... That's what I call a real opponent!"

5387c1ff-d37d-48ca-a231-a85bb9ed5de4.Text: "Is that so?" {n}Yrliet arches an eyebrow in surprise — a facial expression she has unconsciously adopted from mon-keigh.{/n}

d383ebb0-c5d6-4e5a-a0e0-1b643a4f899e.Text: "You know, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship von Valancius, why don't you join in the revelry? The forests here are teeming with xenos bastards. I'm not greedy — there are enough trophies for us both."

230d85f4-c6b4-44d8-be0b-13e881a67342.Text: "Who said I want to return to the voidship? I still haven't met a worthy adversary, one who would grab me by the throat in a death grip! The hunt is not over yet, {name}." {n}A wildfire ignites in Calligos's eyes.{/n} "You know, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship von Valancius, why don't you join in the revelry? The forests here are teeming with xenos bastards. I'm not greedy — there are enough trophies for us both."

94f5b1b7-05b4-49cb-a420-f869b458808e.Text: {n}Worten the Grey has not changed much since your last meeting — still the same brute of a man with bloodshot eyes and a dull expression on his face. However, unlike Calligos's other servants, the Arch-Militant does not look exhausted, and neither does Calligos. Both are filled with rage and thirst for battle, as if the hunt has only just begun.{/n}

3e4df31e-1f15-4ab1-95e9-c24aff21b249.Text: {n}Speaks-With-Gods looks on with trusting violet eyes, and you notice silvery sparks glimmering within. His thin, wounded body shivers from the slightest gust of wind, yet you can still sense the power contained in his elderly frame. He nods meekly and gives you the same simple, genuine smile as his sister from the tribe.{/n}

209e2a91-a2de-4633-8f11-95a72056724e.Text: {n}Unsurprisingly, at your first meeting, Calligos Winterscale appeared before you in a more favourable light. However, under the layer of dried blood and dirt, you still notice a strange detail — the Rogue Trader appears neither wounded nor exhausted. Having spent a good thirty nights in the forests of Quetza Temer, Winterscale has merely swapped his dazzling smile for a feral grin and drenched himself in the blood of his enemies.{/n}

424ccf7d-b4fe-42f9-8bd9-5d0391ffb1d7.Text: {n}On your first meeting on Dargonus, Calligos Winterscale appeared before you in a much more favourable light — brilliant, collected, steadfast. Now his hair is tangled, blood and dirt cover both his face and hands, and his armour has been tarnished by the humidity of Quetza Temer's forests. Instead of a dazzling smile, the Rogue Trader's face is darkened by a sinister grimace.{/n}

9a71f0b4-ed19-4bbf-a539-6b9ff4fc4f8c.Text: "How could you betray me with such ease, elantach?" {n}Yrliet reaches for her weapon, but the bloodthirsty gazes of the onlookers cool her rage.{/n} "Very well. If such is your revenge for my own betrayal, then I accept it. However, I will not let you reach my kin so easily!"

c886834a-c248-4c27-9f4f-770bd75fb957.Text: "Ha! I knew that the heir of Theodora would not be some spineless upstart! Come, von Valancius, surprise me!" {n}Calligos demonstratively waves his axe, the interest in his eyes burning with new strength.{/n}

c5e27082-7219-4e41-b7ad-f39a359c2c87.Text: {n}The tall Navigator in ragged clothes of silk and silver proudly wears the coat of arms of House Cassini. Half of his face is ruined by a fresh scar left by acid.{/n} "{name} von Valancius." {n}The Navigator nods politely. Though he tries to hide it, his voice is filled with pain and suffering.{/n}

271fc7d9-613f-4fdd-8b59-d11818b04f94.Text: "Hsss..." {n}The Sslyth mercenary looks around viciously, frantically clutching their weapon. Their body is peppered with wounds, both old and new, some rotting and some almost healed. Their yellow pupils narrow when you lock eyes, but the xenos quickly loses interest.{/n}

9fa2ce43-972d-4a04-924b-e2c1fa6d7122.Text: {n}The thin old man looks on with trusting violet eyes, and you notice silvery sparks glimmering within. His body shivers from the slightest gust of wind, yet you can still sense the power contained in his elderly frame. He nods with a meek smile.{/n}

480712dc-f226-464d-a86b-b16452aa18fd.Text: "Quiet, Worten. This hunt truly has dragged on for quite some time. The ever-twisting paths, the paltry game... The dullness of it all is suffocating." {n}The rage on Calligos's face changes to dejection.{/n}

21c7ae66-f8f5-479e-8ea6-a02f9c34d283.Text: "True. I am not as generous with my enemies as you are, {name}." {n}Winterscale scoffs venomously, staring you straight in the eye.{/n} "Had the xenos attacked the capital of my protectorate, I would not be so spineless in my retribution. I am almost curious as to what makes you grovel before me, begging my forgiveness on their behalf."

7e706ca8-48ed-435d-a72d-b6f4edd63285.Text: "Really? And I should like the tenderest sea serpent steak and a bottle of Calixian amasec. What misery — for ten moons already I have been forced to subsist on grass, roots, and insect larvae!" {n}Calligos growls restlessly.{/n} "Save your questions for later, {name}. I'm not talkative when hungry. Let's find a way to the old man's village, and then I'll give you your audience."

09ba404c-2c1e-4538-bea8-ec1abe8f927f.Text: "What are you on about, new blood? Is this some absurd attempt to gain my favour? Don't embarrass yourself, I am in no mood for jokes." {n}You see confusion in Calligos's eyes. It seems the Rogue Trader himself has yet to realise what he has become.{/n}

5ede3589-d04d-49de-9c93-6888c4988e78.Text: {n}Worten the Grey casts a curious look at you. As soon as you notice, the heady smell of blood hits your nostrils, accompanied by death cries and the sound of tearing flesh assaulting your ears. This is it, the source of the corruption that has taken hold of Winterscale's soul.{/n}

788a7da6-d8b5-46ac-bd7f-ab18beeb4e61.Text: "Currently, I am dissatisfied by you testing my patience with empty babbling!"

e7991fa6-74b8-48b6-b58b-7f75a10a0c4f.Text: "What are you babbling about? You dare compare your pitiful soul to mine, xenos? Mistake, big mistake!" {n}You see confusion and fury in Calligos's eyes. It seems the Rogue Trader himself has yet to realise what he has become.{/n}

a73e5b78-69a5-420d-b53a-89b11a4195b3.Text: {n}Marazhai smiles at Winterscale in return.{/n} "What an intriguing mon-keigh... I would test whether his ability matches his audacity."

4466fa24-4e4e-4207-8821-e7f0ea0a7fbb.Text: "Trophies, you say..." {n}Marazhai glances at you, then pointedly turns all his attention to Calligos.{/n} "In you live the rage and bloodthirst of a killer, mon-keigh. The way you see the world and the cattle around you is to my liking. Perhaps I chose the wrong Rogue Trader? Perhaps I should change retinue and join your hunt?"

849136e5-9a7e-4c66-8a9a-0e075f7a2569.Text: {n}Calligos roars with deafening laughter.{/n} "Why, new blood, even your pet xenos knows which of us dominates in the art of slaughter! A Drukhari... Thinking about it, I would exchange the snake for your gangly pet. The Sslyth bores me terribly, not a single surprise is left in that thing. But your kind, as I know well, are masters at playing with prey..."

296ec756-94c8-4d5e-9224-b6655064785c.Text: {n}Calligos continues speaking, but Marazhai is no longer looking at him — his narrowed eyes are focused on you. You suddenly realise that the Drukhari's comment had a single purpose: to gauge your reaction to his insubordination.{/n}

519aee91-28cb-422f-a9ce-8be0723a8aae.Text: {n}Marazhai's eyes blaze with dark fire, but he promptly lowers his head in a show of deference.{/n} "I spoke out of turn, {name}. It will not happen again."

a6d39773-7dcd-49a9-81ce-7185eabe3349.Text: {n}Calligos shifts his gaze from Marazhai to you, then back again, with a stunned and somewhat disgusted expression.{/n} "Then... the snake remains with me. And you... you keep your gangly pet on a shorter leash. You clearly need him more."

96145191-2db2-49de-87f9-06e00e572080.Text: {n}The inquisitiveness in Marazhai's gaze fades. With a sigh, he turns away.{/n}

532b0595-122d-4aae-b926-afe59d67fbd4.Text: "Choose your words carefully. I do not find all Rogue Traders equally pleasing." {n}Ulfar gives Calligos a defiant smile, an open challenge to fight.{/n}

1798cbd7-a7d1-49ba-823d-57bc0813ad73.Text: "Lord Calligos must have lost his mind. Why else would he mistake the Lord Captain for an enemy of Humanity?" {n}Abelard lays a hand on his weapon apprehensively.{/n}

6df19647-5f38-4489-843d-6ea885e8cfd7.Text: {n}The old man guiltily lowers his head.{/n} "The forest-home of this priest and his people had always been full of wisdom and life. But the fire-rain called by the outsiders-from-the-darkness one great moon and one small moon ago angered the forest spirits. This priest must find his way home, to the heart of Quetza Temer, and perform the soothing ritual alongside his tribe. Until he does, the spirits will suffer and twist the trails. Until he does... the Starborn will not be able to return to the stars."

32e28fb1-3023-48eb-bc40-e6eee07c8557.Text: "Honestly, a xenos hunt sounds excellent. The xenos are always guilty, and any rules about the execution of people do not apply to them. I've been itching to clear my head with a good fight for a while now."

f482836d-affe-410d-a425-a7299e02ccb4.Text: {n}At these words, the Arch-Militant shoots Solomorne an almost conspiratorial grin, as though they were old friends.{/n}

7741279c-ffa6-45ff-be67-eb7f6e0d51bd.Text: {n}Calligos briskly turns on his heel. The blade of his power axe shines threateningly in the sun, covered in fresh blood. Upon seeing you, he breaks into a bloodthirsty grin.{/n} "You repeat yourselves, xenos scum! Do you really believe that I will fall for your trick twice?"

f41f5013-7654-4fcc-9642-f9d2d967fcac.Text: "Retreat when the enemy's bones already crunch underfoot?" {n}Worten sneers.{/n} "Alien blood must flood the lands of Quetza Temer! Only then will the xenos have paid for their insolence."

62040ad1-bdcf-41f0-afba-c67873791db2.Text: {n}Marazhai stares after Yrliet, and a malicious smile appears on his face.{/n} "We will meet again... cousin."

45863d7f-aef9-443b-a20e-47bf3c47c729.Text: "I have yet to see a real fight. How much longer must we wander in circles, avoiding battle?"

3ab4049d-ff63-4e34-86a7-0edce1e05900.Text: {n}Yrliet gives you an intent look and curtly nods, her shoulders relaxing slightly.{/n}

67108887-3cbb-4895-99e3-ded06fd4cbfe.Text: "I may accept your proposal, {name}. But only when I am certain of the destruction of the remaining enemies. Of course, that's assuming we find them in this accursed forest!" {n}Annoyance and malice drip from Winterscale's every word.{/n}

976cdade-2ea5-499a-a319-2ebd8367e151.Text: {n}A shiver of unholy delight mixed with visceral fear runs down your spine. It is certain — Calligos's rage is fed by the blood-red flashes of corruption coiled tightly around his soul. Ever-hungry, primordial, and destructive, it consumes him more and more with each passing moment.{/n}

001db7fa-f5bf-4b6c-af11-07be137173e1.Text: {n}Winterscale grins darkly, stopping the shot with a gesture.{/n} "Let her go, Worten. Give the bird a head start. We'll see how kindly the forests of Quetza Temer will treat their new victim. This is even more interesting."

6355af14-dff4-4307-a3ef-5a1557f25b52.Text: "Kae-morag, mon-keigh, it is I who will make a trophy from your skull and proudly wear it on my belt if you do not hold your tongue!"

e8e0f3c3-7c24-498b-a91e-a6f49c436298.Text: {n}Marazhai's face twists at your words — not from anger, but from disappointment. It seems he expected a different answer.{/n}

a1639780-ecd0-466f-9952-f86e6d0ddbdc.Text: "I am here to deliver my people from death at your blood-soaked hands, mon-keigh. Thank the elantach that your fragile human skull has not yet been pierced by my shot."

6c0a15b0-1847-47f3-9626-f9d5aa9a3490.Text: "I have some questions to ask of you."

7b741db1-c682-4064-bb8a-37d5f6e8ee9e.Text: "It is time to go seeking Aeldari."

91adff6a-de44-470d-9590-5b0bb370e53d.Text: "Actually, I do have a few more..."

8bc12732-5409-4eef-b153-5a8f974c987c.Text: "How did you survive in the forest all this time?"

6f859034-2a83-4bbf-ae54-3ac773e4edff.Text: "I saw the corpse of your Seneschal at the forest camp."

f91131f6-173d-440e-8d39-2915515688a3.Text: "Interesting. The Winterscale I've heard of would have never thrown his protectorate to Chorda so easily."

20627e79-470e-4b19-b597-4ab9f197deec.Text: "Erbreght ap Daeff made a promise that your dynasty would fulfil any request for me if I were to lead you out of the forests of Quetza Temer."

4fea9e08-a238-4a29-a438-55b8063980fe.Text: "I hear you have decided to oppose both the Lord Inquisitor and the Chorda dynasty."

c70a7016-a7c8-483c-b923-fc6ad2de95c9.Text: "I have noticed that your people look utterly woebegone, while you do not have a single scratch on you."

1e91201d-9860-455c-9bd2-4e3c95b81f18.Text: "There is no persuading you, is there?"

66bcbe59-24c6-453a-8a81-0c6f416921fa.Text: [Leave] "I need just a little more time."

4e1d3cdf-8cf6-4a66-af4a-321845f6f68a.Text: "Their craftworld perished at the hands of my dynasty. I wish to make amends for Theodora's mistakes."

53ec7de0-bf41-45d0-b3b4-3f1c70c3859f.Text: "Would you, perhaps, agree to sell those xenos to me?"

5be7adca-130a-482f-a2d8-c5fd4380e6c2.Text: "If you were to agree, you would have a Rogue Trader and the head of a powerful dynasty in your debt."

bfb8864a-e0d7-419c-830e-98e821afac30.Text: "A nice walk that, wasn't it, {name}? You may have helped us navigate the living forest's clutches, but don't let it go to your head. I would have managed by myself sooner or later." {n}Winterscale chuckles and repeats,{/n} "Sooner or later."

c5094c85-fbc9-4383-92cc-ad31a66842ea.Text: "One day, you too will grow sick of all the talking, and then you too will choose shooting xenos on a wild planet over endless intrigue." {n}Cheerful notes ring in Calligos's voice.{/n} "Fine, we have plenty of time. So be it, I will give you a private audience. If dear Chorda knew how close-knit we had become, she would have surely branded us conspirators!"

241172a2-4ef9-40a4-8873-b93b402a4d89.Text: "It's about time indeed, {name}!" {n}Calligos gives you a friendly pat on the shoulder and summons his retinue with a gesture.{/n} "It may take a while to find their trail, but Worten here has a keen eye, and his sense of smell can rival any old dog — we will do just fine! Especially with the forest being on our side now. Let's go, and try not to fall behind!"

903cc2a1-9c2d-4ac1-ba0d-847089020de4.Text: {n}Calligos laughs openly.{/n} "Maybe I will, maybe I won't. Wait around for a couple of decades, new blood, and let others get used to you. It is not often that we have a fresh new Rogue Trader in our circle."

9f9d07e8-381b-4112-a68f-deef94256a9e.Text: "Your enquiries are curious, to be sure. Quetza Temer is a planet with a rather dreary backstory. A long time ago, it supplied my great-grandfather with tonnes of succulent fruits and thousands of cargo containers filled with a special building fibre processed from the local forests. The population all lived in large cities a safe distance away from the tangled paths and trees. And then this quiet life was dashed by xenos raids."

ffb3b662-24c5-40ac-a6de-d5c88857b484.Text: "The old man was a weakling, and that is why he's dead. That's what happens when you can no longer fulfil your duty to your master." {n}Worten grins in contempt, his entire being expressing his disdain for the Seneschal.{/n}

c7fc7a6f-3bcd-4d85-827c-d9c600ff96d4.Text: {n}Winterscale's expression hardens.{/n} "Consider my idiot voidborn nephew dead. Besides... You haven't led me out of the forest yet — you've only brought us into its heart. I still have time to kill all your precious xenos before I become formally indebted to you."

efc94a10-48d5-41ef-b9e2-9d5262c24b9f.Text: {n}Calligos carries himself with an air of indifference, but the sudden furrows on his forehead betray his regret.{/n} "Many fine warriors have perished on this hunt. Raise a toast to their name when you can."

5b7a0cc0-dc58-449e-9ff0-ed18d8b51bb3.Text: {n}Calligos gives a dismissive wave.{/n} "The unworthy always die during the hunt."

b5c82ff9-bb15-4c9a-916b-44c633129c69.Text: {n}The Arch-Militant, previously indifferent to his master's words, raises his head. His burning, curious gaze fixes on Yrliet.{/n}

346a43a4-dc16-4cd0-8efb-f84f1e9b3ad8.Text: "I shall consider your words, and that is all I shall promise."

3ed97227-5b1a-4e78-b2e1-9023e38b2fad.Text: "His callous words are painted crimson and purple... and yet bright veneers can never truly mask the deep colours of sorrow."

0145036b-603b-4d2f-93f2-7fc03c2f4185.Text: "A void kraken may eat them both, for all I care!" {n}Winterscale makes a wry face and clenches his fists in anger.{/n} "Acting as if their war on heresy in the Expanse is just starting. Ha! I've been living it for decades. And I don't need an Inquisitorial preacher, and I certainly don't need Incendia's goodwill!"

26e09bd9-2850-4b4f-97df-029dc087e996.Text: {n}Yrliet gives you a grateful look.{/n} "We all carry the mark of our ancestors' guilt on our shoulders."

d8f7ffe0-b715-478b-b2f5-a90f7abd2d57.Text: "If I did, {name}, the price would be steep." {n}Winterscale sizes you up with a cunning gaze.{/n} "I have more than enough money and power. I shall need time to consider your offer."

0b01d6b0-60e8-45e7-a436-0fa775db26f1.Text: "Frankly, your desperation excites me, {name}. It even makes me want to know whether you are driven by foolishness, or treachery and cool calculation." {n}Winterscale looks at you appraisingly, scratching his chin.{/n} "Well, I'm quite curious to see how large a dagger you might stab me with. I shall think on your offer, but that is the only promise you will get from me."

a5e7bb93-4195-4848-853d-00b2d423840f.Text: "The forests of Quetza Temer are not like the jungles of Catachan, new blood. The only thing that could kill you here is your own stupidity... or an unfortunate coincidence in the form of a stray xenos or a rare predator. Rainwater for breakfast, nutritious larvae for lunch, and fermented fruit in place of wine for supper! One could not wish for better hunting grounds!" {n}Calligos laughs, then falls silent, evidently unwilling to share the details.{/n}

bde5a784-352a-41ca-99b8-e3fd02c970ac.Text: {n}Yrliet presses her lips into a thin line.{/n} "Alas, elantach. You cannot control the thoughts of this mon-keigh just as you cannot make a river flow backward. Words cannot always move the mountains and dry the seas. Sometimes... only blades can."

80660ba6-a82b-49e4-bc4b-f4a8921e6371.Text: "Don't think that you can outsmart me at such games, new blood. You've been a Rogue Trader for barely any time at all compared to an old hand like me." {n}Calligos scoffs acidly.{/n} "If that was your argument for the xenos, alas, you have miscalculated, {name}. And I do not wish to discuss this any further."

c0cf45f6-1bef-4972-9620-b4eadcc049e2.Text: "Do not turn your gaze to me, elantach. It was not my kin who desolated this world."

4a9432fd-eceb-459f-8673-c5af647aaee7.Text: "Are you trying to buy me or insult me, {name}? I have more than enough money and power. And infinite boredom. I have seen many things in my time. I have tried everything there is to try, and now I am surfeited with any pleasure that exists out there. The only thing that can make me feel alive is the blood of my enemies on my hands."

31e67bf3-1fb2-4d1e-94cd-a8426666833d.Text: "They burned down the cities and shackled our people faster than our ships could help. In the end, the local governor ran away, leaving the remaining people at the beasts' mercy. And the people, in turn, fled the big cities that attracted the xenos. And that is how the forests that the rabble feared became their salvation. The planet fell into decay — there was no one to populate the cities, and there was no one to extract resources. Quetza Temer expected three new arks filled with settlers to arrive from the Imperium. But in five hundred years, not one of them has reached the Expanse."

ab22dc4e-a4b4-415d-8fb6-cf98a5aadd53.Text: {n}Marazhai gives Calligos a lazy look.{/n} "I remember the times when this planet was nothing more than a source of amusement for the Kabals. When its supply of squealing meat ran dry, so did our interest."

7878f0bf-116c-4628-b79b-d784d6721915.Text: "If that was your argument for the xenos, alas, you have miscalculated, new blood. I do not wish to discuss this any further."

0c6bc92b-854c-4213-866f-fae64489b3cd.Text: "I did help Aspyce Chorda once with one of her colonies out of sheer kindness, and she showed her gratitude by stabbing me in the back. The promises of Rogue Traders are not worth much these days."

9935d2e0-6ad9-40e1-91e7-65ab90ab5ce0.Text: {n}Winterscale examines him as if thinking of the most efficient way to snap his spine.{/n} "And now the beasts have returned to become meat for my amusement. Glorious."

4f1dcf58-a048-450f-994c-ef9a686ecb0e.Text: "The planet is withering, and yet, you only turned your attention to its problems once you had found a way to make them into a source of entertainment. At this rate, it will be centuries before the Imperium's investment of colonists pays off — assuming Quetza Temer is ever able to pay tithes at all in its wretched state."

97170132-8fe4-4cf2-946e-3d70043ae801.Text: {n}Calligos snarls, flying instantly into a white-hot fury.{/n} "You think you can judge me? Me, a Rogue Trader? Draw your weapon, then, and we will see what the much-lauded Arbites are worth. Feel free to call your dog to help — I will handle you both myself!"

1a88ef35-dd66-4802-9424-857cb31cb549.Text: "I will not attack a Rogue Trader, nor will I judge him, but I am obligated to remind you about your sacred duty to the Imperium — even if I must do so at your displeasure."

60aafa55-c28f-4b18-a590-13843a296c2c.Text: "You care about them that much, new blood?" {n}Calligos bellows in disdain.{/n} "Go ahead, then. Try to convince me that the vile xenoscum deserve the mercy of Calligos Winterscale. But remember: you only get one chance to try."

2716a1d0-b2cb-4d8f-b224-95bb47bc7500.Text: {n}Calligos shrugs.{/n} "Everything in this galaxy depends on one's efforts and willpower. A simple truth that many Rogue Traders sometimes fail to see from their self-made tower of pride and vanity."

024786cb-0844-482a-8c84-16736e33eac4.Text: "Are you finished with all of your high society errands in this groxpen, {name}? The forest has calmed down, but now I am starting to lose my patience."

96f91c93-5d3d-4a97-9dd4-bb75d37d532c.Text: {n}Winterscale's gaze dulls.{/n} "The thrill of the hunt is an unfamiliar concept to you, I see."

78eb12a5-a2ce-4852-8312-abbb002e4f52.Text: {n}Calligos's eyes widen with excitement.{/n} "Mistakes? I would give a couple of distant planets to witness the death of an Aeldari world with my own eyes! You have amused me, new blood, so I'll grant you one more try. But so far you've only been stoking my appetite, not killing it."

66c89efe-5b0b-4589-8c05-f52772c3f788.Text: "Ask your question. You may even get an answer."

f9a1dd50-5d3d-472f-a362-fc4be7a01ab4.Text: "That means that my people are weaklings, and I shall change that soon. As for me, I have been of stout constitution since the day I was born."

89928c12-9c22-4d2e-9624-1b6e5acfcb2d.Text: {n}At first, Calligos shrugs his shoulders indifferently, but after looking closer at his companions, he raises his brows in surprise — it seems that the Rogue Trader just realised the validity of your words.{/n}

e58c1d43-024a-4452-bfff-265ceef4458b.Text: {n}Winterscale flinches as if from a blow, and doubt darkens his gaze.{/n} "Testing the boundaries, are we, {name}? I like your boldness, but you shouldn't stick your head so far into the beast's throat."

a7e7bc20-753a-4eff-93a7-ce6b84689a2e.Text: {n}Winterscale's smile twists into a wicked grin.{/n} "I do not tell you how to run the affairs of your dynasty. You should keep your nose out of mine as well."

0b136cc3-283b-410d-ba19-6e6d8824a1bf.Text: An altar to the gods of the warp.

427f1d55-1aca-453a-89ee-9c9d7e5930ee.Text: This altar to the gods of the warp is made up of several parts: they must have assembled it here after transporting the components from elsewhere.

9e6d1384-7aeb-4548-883a-40f197e42f41.Text: There are human remains under the ice.

40030c5f-1549-4495-9fad-7cd4217168ea.Text: The contorted bodies look like they suffered from violent spasms, indicating that the vicious, unbearable cold was the cause of death.

15494006-658b-432a-b74c-e65606a21267.Text: The captives' skin is ruined by necrosis: these wretched souls were probably tortured with cold.

29a0b964-2ed8-4187-81a4-ea2d7c262499.Text: The planet's weather constitutes a serious obstacle to a successful landing.

82680dbb-0ceb-4a18-be4b-6d0569717e23.Text: You can just barely see dark, twisted silhouettes through the crack: these people froze to death.

23bd95ac-9274-4a20-80a4-53ae7985400c.Text: You notice a number of dark objects that are hidden beneath the ice: remnants of an ancient battle, most likely. A strange glint catches your eye.

4adc89bb-edc6-46d7-92a2-40c2965dec92.Text: "Did you come here to help Calcazar?"

60dd4d33-c8be-490f-930d-8bd71de2f656.Text: [Look at the retinue accompanying your copies]

1d65a05e-2553-46b8-a40f-76a52ee45185.Text: "It looks like this version of me became a mindless zealot."

0a2068ca-838d-48c2-a869-5a37845e88af.Text: "It will be my pleasure to end you. For Theodora."

6a219011-30af-44fa-a9a1-467453f8634c.Text: [Look at where your doppelgangers came from]

0dec10c2-50d2-4435-a5f1-7e51995eeec8.Text: "And how many feats of faith have you accomplished?"

e9aab792-b3d6-4b40-9f59-2dfba36e3062.Text: "So what brings you to this dangerous place, most peaceful one?"

6b41dc34-4c30-416d-b137-8150f473e780.Text: "Why do you care so much about other people?"

5bcb38ac-dfd2-42a1-ac06-e8a0fbf1d24b.Text: [Address the arrogant copy] "You seem to think you are better than the rest of us, don't you?"

22fadd4e-594a-4f29-9322-4600ff9b85d0.Text: "I wish I could visit your universe. It seems to be brighter and kinder than mine."

a2eb015a-629a-4111-9406-200396278016.Text: "At last, I have some worthy interlocutors."

e18df1c2-11df-4b7c-9c51-5b3e19ad0c96.Text: "I do not like this. I shall have to kill you all."

304ccdf9-0a3a-40b4-b8ef-44ae824423ed.Text: "Have you achieved much on your profane path?"

560bbe9a-4a99-4f6d-a3cc-c3b16258c40d.Text: "Under different circumstances, we could have become allies."

da86cb29-18dd-42ae-b060-17d6dd77cf56.Text: "There is something hilarious about the way you are revelling in your villainy."

018d54e8-1f67-46ca-b7b2-4f57b7ef966c.Text: "Have you achieved much without loyal allies?"

ee73f339-44e9-4fb4-8a73-e97479cd654a.Text: "So you tricked everyone in the end? Nicely done!"

5e0e1e59-f8a7-41dd-b95e-9f50b60afa6c.Text: "I feel sorry for you. You had to shoulder the burden of power all on your own."

eb57a427-d20c-4e00-98a9-01876d9c41f1.Text: [Address the cursed copy] "So one of my versions chose to serve the Archenemy?"

2e7df581-7622-4a59-b396-55783659fef2.Text: [Address the peaceful copy] "You seem to be the only one who isn't trying to pick a fight?"

d7dccc77-e585-46e8-8f75-afe67d67f5ed.Text: [Address the pious copy] "Your faith seems to be stronger than that of us all combined."

5d8053a5-8611-482b-8ad4-1f12abaf9596.Text: "I wonder how you acquired such an ego."

1c52ebfc-0528-4f89-8dde-4085847f9ef9.Text: "Why do you seek to enter the crypt?"

08bc808d-b0c1-4356-9df7-6171e7be396e.Text: "You are a parody of what a Rogue Trader is supposed to be. Quite the epitome of hubris, greed, and brazenness."

d07308c4-c475-4373-8aab-386724d665f1.Text: "The situation has just become... complicated. How are we going to resolve it?"

f7494a4f-db2c-4cab-ab9f-dced1fa99ee0.Text: "I am giving you a chance to settle this affair peacefully and avoid self-destruction... In every sense of the word."

5e307acc-b002-46e7-9763-6544653178cf.Text: "This version of reality has no need for you. Farewell, the ones never meant to be."

472d26fd-db8b-4423-9325-36216c9d3ca8.Text: "Now I'll show you who is the original and who the imperfect replicas."

b733fc91-2a87-4073-ae87-aa2f76ccb273.Text: "I will not share the contents of this crypt with anyone. Die!"

4f6df4cb-a8f5-4558-8fba-ce43b4338054.Text: "The Emperor is with me, and that means you are going to fall!"

f3b969e3-c33d-4e62-b14f-ebaf72b36fb3.Text: "You are simply too weak to be a Rogue Trader."

c9462503-7b98-4119-9294-e7ef9279b9aa.Text: "I wonder at what point your soul was tainted by heresy."

cadb17f2-a4fc-4c80-bd77-487d93ebcedd.Text: {n}Reality bubbles before you and bursts with an agonising shriek. A few silhouettes now stand in your way. Three of them seem to have your face... And yet the differences are striking. Each has been marked by other accomplishments and different experiences, making you feel like the protagonist of a tale about a pair of twins separated at birth.{/n}

542af110-bf25-49c2-9504-8dab7209bf6b.Text: "The future is not known to me. The Lord Inquisitor did not give me the full details of Operation Precious Sentinel, but he mentioned its importance to the entire Imperium. I have come to lend him my aid... or to stop him if his plans go against the will of the God-Emperor."

788fac38-e2e2-448f-b151-7b80b62a1c2c.Text: "Emperor, bestow strength upon me to smite yet another obstacle as I carry out Your will!"

8082f26b-239c-41fa-9ccf-707b149d56d1.Text: "If you are sentient creatures and not mere eidolons, I suggest you back down without a fight. I did not come here to claim your lives."

bf68d922-6609-4607-a148-b16f5357a2e1.Text: "My Master, Changer of Ways, is this of your making? No, I can feel it is not. You are not playing tricks on me, you are... sending me prey for a great sacrifice!"

9ebc2c8d-9288-4ed6-b0b9-15bc70278523.Text: "Is there some ironic lesson in what is going on? Should I be looking in the mirror a little less? Or perhaps try to look at myself from the outside? Or is this a hint that I am my own worst enemy? I shall ponder this in my memoir."

c325ce36-3a77-4e8d-885d-27d8d3292149.Text: {n}The last of your doppelgangers has proudly entered your world alone.{/n}

f815d300-5c98-4f36-bc70-9aafc188ea94.Text: {n}Idira opens her mouth and you see the blackness between her teeth in place of her tongue. A hundred otherworldly warp voices speak instead of her voice:{/n} "The master requests a sacrifice... A living sacrifice... Toss them into the warp... Their paths will be unravelled and woven into yours."

e15805c7-55fe-4930-a749-c73bfa2b3bc8.Text: "I am ready to acknowledge your repentance and dispense justice."

4bb47b61-87c9-4ce0-ba73-1cecbab15c64.Text: {n}The blatant abuse of the fabric of existence is causing the motes of reality to flare up. You see the mirages of the Koronus Expanse in their glow, altered past recognition by the decisions you have made... or could have made in some other world.{/n}

290bd893-61e5-4bb7-8713-76ea81037fc8.Text: "I do not serve — I reign. You grovel, but I dominate and rise ever higher."

b8c0569f-aa73-4db9-81db-92c978023fd4.Text: {n}Argenta says glumly,{/n} "I wish to speak to Idira when we kill this heretic and return to the ship. This encounter is a sign calling for vigilance."

83b3f91d-a071-4e8f-88ab-301f78602cff.Text: "I do not enjoy pointless violence. Power and authority can always be used for a more worthy purpose... Well, almost always. Unfortunately, sometimes violence does have a point, but it gives me little pleasure even then."

edc69e21-37d5-48a7-8f0d-21f464677229.Text: "What?" {n}Idira looks worriedly at Argenta, who is glaring at her with a pointed look.{/n}

002ef1e6-af60-4e7a-a792-6d2820f16ed6.Text: {n}Your replica smiles in understanding.{/n} "I am {name} von Valancius the Magnificent. And if I know myself, which I most certainly do, you are now pondering what that makes you. The answer is simple. You are my reflection from a less glorious reality, a product of the malign influence of the treasure that I seek."

43339220-3086-4e54-a21f-1d58fdd35201.Text: {n}The doppelganger makes the sign of Aquila and utters,{/n} "I am a blazing paragon of Humanity, unbroken by tribulations, the first to venture into the darkness without fear and the one who unites and brings back that which was forfeited. I am a Rogue Trader of the God-Emperor."

88007a5a-a530-4ac3-8d06-307d7e37757c.Text: "Some refer to me as the Warden of the Expanse, but I prefer being addressed simply as {name}. Nice to meet you... ah... me-from-a-different-version-of-existence."

c6f771c9-d63e-4815-8db4-eae87434039a.Text: {n}The last doppelganger smiles coyly.{/n} "Speaking of me, I am the only version of ourselves who chose the path to true power. I serve the Master, the Changer of Ways, and I already chanced upon my reflections in his dreams. Which is why I am the only one without a dumbstruck expression on my face."

1c9d8930-d4fd-41a0-be23-d444bf74845e.Text: "I think it has less bloodshed than yours. I brought peace to the Expanse, soothed the flame of Incendia's zeal and stopped Calligos from falling to vileness. The two of us even managed to become friends. I sheltered the Aeldari refugees and convinced them to join forces to fend off the Drukhari. I granted pardon to the pirates and renegades who strayed not out of malice but because they had nowhere else to go. Calcazar called me a heretic, but no one paid heed to that castigation."

e135259f-9601-47ed-b61f-32855316cdb1.Text: "It is never too late to create it around you."

2595551c-44be-4578-a664-37871abd8a6c.Text: "This much is true. But a gate admits many guests, and not all of them mean you harm."

dc2db36c-51c8-4b93-97a3-9441e7fe5f2e.Text: "Fascinating. Many have called me weak, but I have always had enough strength to protect my people from those who saw them as a defenceless flock."

8adaa3b9-3b41-4db1-9c0d-60613f617d08.Text: "I hope my answers will change something."

82c30e5c-1588-45a5-b890-fde63ae925e5.Text: "Truth stems from the Emperor. You are lacking it, which means you are not the true von Valancius but a flawed replica born out of a flawed reality."

5a712847-b1b9-4eff-bd80-197536503db7.Text: "I see now — you are a von Valancius from a reality of impenetrable dullards. No! It is you who are me!"

7b26c1bf-2f47-498c-b9dd-44b010e8ce08.Text: "It would seem that being better than others and suffering loneliness is my fate in every reality."

910851ce-4292-421e-b4d7-a3f65f90937b.Text: "Hubris is a pit for a Rogue Trader. It makes it easy to forget who you are supposed to serve. I can see you have been powerless to evade it."

ceb8d327-f99c-4862-a91c-464f4091e404.Text: "This is what being a Rogue Trader is all about. You simply lack the imagination to grasp it."

f6536731-0738-4cad-8243-babc80d245cf.Text: "I came to claim the treasure. Whatever it is, Theodora found it, which makes it mine. Xavier will regret trying to steal from my dynasty." {n}The doppelganger smirks.{/n}

9e75267c-cdde-4c20-86e7-387ba9ca5886.Text: "I have a sneaking suspicion this meeting will end in bloodshed, but I still thank you for the kind words and hospitality."

9a52d9c5-5161-47ad-9a28-4b4fcd28eb47.Text: "To your reality? Funny that. Reality is malleable like clay. I feed it with the energies of the warp and shape it to match my whims. I am the {mf|master|mistress} of realities and you are a jumped-up interloper."

fb3abdd3-2a6b-435f-9b16-e4ba3d07ede6.Text: "If there is something we all have in common, it is the way we solve problems. It is nice to feel like a whole person."

4b28877b-6488-4d37-8f10-a0ef2c3a4788.Text: "Your path must have been darker and bloodier than mine, seeing as you prefer to choose the most violent solution. There is much pain in your reality."

5de4a838-c4a5-4dfe-a638-811d155bb6a2.Text: "You killed me?" {n}Calligos grins widely.{/n} "Was it a glorious battle?"

d0c668ce-4cfd-48ff-890c-6b7da62f148a.Text: "What a grotesque, impossible reality. My Kabal would never ally with... our useless kin."

c7f8df60-c928-489e-bd6f-52021c38a501.Text: "Indeed I have. I am the most influential figure in the entire Expanse. Calligos was slain by the xenos and his successor Evayne became my puppet. Incendia chases pirates, not realising it is me who is raiding her colonies. I was able to make a pact with the Kabal of the Reaving Tempest against Calcazar, forcing him to flee.
