Blasphemous merging of sacred technologies with forbidden ones: registered. Further transgression registration discontinued." {n}The drill on Pasqal's mechadendrite screeches in fury.{/n}

4e0036c9-dcb3-4dee-b54c-1b748b691fab.Text: "There was no more need for them, seeing as the Yoke was almost complete and the situation was escalating out of control. Theodora was dead, the Cult of the Final Dawn had reared its head and was preparing to strike. And Yremeryss had forgotten her place: she was putting forward too many elimination requests, and when I told her to curb her appetite, she retaliated. The theft of the Rykad star was timed to occur when Master van Calox would be on the planet. The Archon wanted to rob me of one of my agents and send a message."

7ffe412a-fba5-4581-8e5c-014a0bee338b.Text: {n}After a brief pause, Heinrix nods and responds gravely,{/n} "I no longer recognise your authority, Lord Inquisitor. My apologies."

28ae8bec-aa4f-4e71-8487-71ef73ad96c4.Text: "However, you will not be there to see it, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I will have the C'tan Shard destroy your body so thoroughly that there won't be the slightest trace left of you. You may find it lamentable, but there is simply no place for the likes of you in the future that I am creating."

a704f20e-912a-4ec9-a71a-9b83b5a758c4.Text: "Theodora's research destabilised the Shard's prison, and my project only made it worse. Whenever particles of the C'tan Shard's energy seep out, many curious phenomena occur. The destruction of the crypt, the warped reality... When I tame the monster, I will order it to stop disrupting the laws of the universe."

475c7086-e942-4524-8d57-7ad94787c096.Text: "I'm afraid the Rogue Trader is right, Lord Inquisitor. I will not."

ba725ba2-893e-4429-9a0d-769ed78b4741.Text: {n}Visibly offended, Heinrix looks back at you coldly and mutters,{/n} "I had no intention of complying."

ad24600f-3223-40b0-bc6e-666a1b2d3cdf.Text: "In that case... Heinrix van Calox, in the name of the Emperor, I hereby revoke your Inquisitorial privileges and declare you Excommunicate Traitoris. The punishment for your heresy is death. I bid you farewell."

e4239458-63e2-4de7-82d2-d6dbafb2d48b.Text: "So instead of eradicating Theodora's misdeeds, you chose to inherit them?" {n}Argenta's voice rings with righteous steel.{/n}

0942fb31-c374-4f45-b0eb-6bd900bb9742.Text: "With all due respect to you, Lord Inquisitor, I shall ask you to refrain from any further threats directed toward the blessed Rogue Trader. Lest you face repercussions from me."

7855b0d5-25f9-42f6-9121-c450892e03f8.Text: "How courteous of you to warn me, Master Werserian. I will remember your words."

f1e318ac-bee0-4eaa-bd36-0d62e45778f8.Text: {n}Gritting his teeth, Abelard says quietly,{/n} "In the old days, House von Valancius would have declared war over something like this. And fought until the offender was dead."

fb22328b-c8ee-4fe7-97e7-112b93c32050.Text: {n}Incendia closes her eyes wearily and says with sadness in her voice,{/n} "No, Xavier. Heresy is always heresy. And judgement always comes in its wake."

185d29e9-e8d8-4b83-b9c8-b5cac53355cd.Text: "A specimen of an ancient predator race, devourers of pulsars who feasted on star systems. Reality itself bent to their power, but many millennia ago, an ancient xenos race managed to defeat them, shatter them into pieces, and lock them away in prisons like the one you see before you."

ade978c4-4f04-4cfd-b531-6c00aeabdac0.Text: "A containment device similar to this one, except... better. The Yoke was devised by the brightest minds of two races using the ancient wisdom of a long-gone xenos civilisation. A prison capable not only of holding the C'tan Shard, but also of controlling it while releasing fractions of its being. An instrument of obedience and destruction. A masterpiece whose creation required immense effort."

f35972ca-389b-41cf-ad91-eccea07ae1c7.Text: "Do you mean to say that a human is not capable of such a feat? But I am not just a human — I am an instrument of the Emperor's will, one of many. And the Imperium is omnipotent. If I were to fail, another would follow in my footsteps. That is how Humanity makes the impossible possible: with the hands of particular people in particular circumstances. Your scepticism is unwarranted."

09dc3133-dcf2-4559-9cee-5ee51f1ad2f8.Text: "I am not in this for my own sake. I am doing my duty. And as for the scale... Do you know what ensures the indomitability of every member of the Inquisition? The knowledge that they are personally responsible for the survival of the Imperium, and that the fate of billions hinges on their actions. Do you understand? Personally responsible. Compared to that scale, do you think I am daunted by the gravity of this mission?"

57bf618a-5600-446d-954a-b64850176706.Text: "They raided an outpost where my agents had been meeting with the Drukhari. The pack took prisoners but lost the esteemed Brother Ulfar. I hoped they would give their all to the search, but instead the Wolves forced this system's coordinates out of the captives and came crashing down on my head. They had no gate to transport them — they used nothing but their warp engines. Thankfully, they realised their situation too late, so Tanakia managed to neutralise them."

f29e46d8-4dfc-4cba-a851-bb039244c6b3.Text: "Not at all. Operation Precious Sentinel is in its final stages. The increase in xenos activity is a vexing yet trivial development in the grand scheme of things. They were supposed to guard the device, but they slept through the intrusion, and only the C'tan Shard's emanations could make them stir."

b3b3cc82-2051-4191-8ba8-a3bece7f7deb.Text: "Enough, {name}. It will only be heresy if I lose. If I prevail, it will be a triumphant feat in the name of saving Humanity from the horrors of this universe. And I will not lose."

97d72dd0-1359-459d-9a3f-63c4b9dfebf9.Text: "And then the Koronus Expanse was engulfed in flame. I had to rush the operation and declare sector-wide martial law. The Webway Gate that Yremeryss's warriors had been using was destroyed and the facility on Quetza Temer razed. I evacuated the half of the Yoke that Tervantias had completed, but was too late to retrieve the second half from Eufrates II."

5e936662-2db3-42f7-95f4-4d230e6dbe14.Text: {n}There is not a shred of hatred or disappointment on Calcazar's face.{/n} "And you showed such promise, too. I blame your heredity... Farewell, {name}. I vow to find and destroy every single seed of corruption you have sown." {n}He glances at his retinue.{/n} "Execute the heretic."

0883674a-dbe0-4978-baa1-ab35f6e6995e.Text: "I commenced Operation Precious Sentinel — I left a garrison on Epitaph, took the key to the dimensional gate from Theodora, sealed the gate, and started the creation of the Yoke. I kept Theodora and her heirs in my sights, just in case. Not long before her death, I assigned Heinrix to her and ordered her to rendezvous with him on Rykad Minoris. But Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} inherited him instead. I admit I wasn't aware of you — Theodora managed to keep her secret heir up her sleeve."

2403c8c2-92a4-4f38-b7a3-3362c5b7bdef.Text: "But the human mind could never have comprehended the Shard... alone. And thus I appealed to the inhuman mind. I struck a deal with the Drukhari."

90e44a04-af1f-4da4-8361-e3c01c312bec.Text: "It is one of the most complicated and perfect creations of a race much older than the Drukhari. It is no mere object, but a treasure trove of technology. A wise master could uncover many secrets simply by observing it."

dfc789c2-6fcf-4b5a-ac42-53f482dcb4be.Text: "Alas, the operation demanded it. Through the agents of one of my acolytes, Emelina, I contacted Archon Yremeryss and made a pact. I gave her access to the technologies contained within this relic and destroyed her rivals in the Kabal — she would relay information on their raids to my spies, and I would solve the problem. In exchange, her Haemonculus, Tervantias, forged the Yoke for me."

25c87521-4040-4010-a4e4-527b793a071b.Text: "Knowing full well how precarious her grand plan was, I made no attempt to talk her out of it. With a little luck, we wouldn't have need worry about Commorragh's influence."

7e409a9f-b3e4-4eff-8e5f-6a3235874def.Text: "Unfortunately, I had to send Emelina away and remove her from the board. A shrewd woman of principle — I used to value those qualities of hers, but suddenly, they started to get in the way of my plan. It would have been safer to eliminate her before she could figure out what was going on, but... I must have grown miserly over the years and was loath to part with a good agent. Or perhaps I was simply being sentimental."

df335a17-06e2-42af-81ca-73306c6e47f7.Text: "This new information about a pact combined with the astro-observation data collected in this star system resolves the inconsistencies identified earlier. Unit Xavier Calcazar stands accused of stealing the astrographic records of the Cognisance Fleet."

7f7a8f69-07cb-4bb8-88d6-15985a4d83ee.Text: "I am amazed by your analytical prowess. Yes, I needed stars to feed the Shard. The Kabal of the Reaving Tempest could steal them and bring them here, but it was imperative to preserve the exact energy parameters so as not to trigger the object's premature detonation. I procured the necessary information on suitable stars from the Explorator Fleet's data-scriptorium."

2300b0f8-4855-44a8-9721-a176f49724ab.Text: "Registering a Category One blasphemy. Unit Xavier Calcazar is hereby sentenced to intravital dissection and study. Upon the cessation of vital functions, the unit's remains must be disposed of in disgrace."

ccb1c1fe-d73f-4e19-869c-2e91db7e6e6a.Text: "I readily believe that. Since we are being so candid, I must note that you proved to be a much less convenient tool than I had anticipated."

a95c6c34-1ccd-4c40-b1be-7aa24dc34435.Text: "Over my years of service, I have come to realise that the main problem that Humanity faces in this war is the imbalance in power. Our opponents are not races or nations, but incomprehensible monsters. And it is high time we acquired one of our own. My Yoke will bind this creature and make it a chained guard serving the Emperor."

e5928a43-df87-4aa6-bcbc-c5db0e2805a4.Text: "Coming here was hardly prudent of you, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. You and your dynasty have {d|Encyclopedia:Conviction_Heretical3OrMore}lost my trust{/d}, and now judgement awaits you."

40ea886e-7abc-4b44-8073-8ff461173194.Text: "That is not the full extent of my vision. There are other Shards similar to this one, scattered across the galaxy. I plan on seeking them out and confining them all inside the Yoke. Each conquered monstrosity will bolster our defences."

73a96aed-a9b7-472a-a861-165a63657eb5.Text: {n}Heinrix looks at you with icy calm but does not utter a word.{/n}

f79a2721-a75f-4027-8808-c7a87424ca9c.Text: {n}Argenta, in the full glory of her battle focus, is reciting a prayer in an ardent whisper.{/n}

04a58490-bd94-4b25-a3eb-a3258e9329c6.Text: {n}The red-headed giant gives you a menacing, exhilarated grin.{/n} "We meet again, you two-faced worm! I've had this feeling gnawing away at me, as if I haven't yet fulfilled my duty to the Allfather... As if I haven't yet killed someone I should."

82447167-268d-45f6-8076-f1a5b1337dc7.Text: "You are the one who is attempting something mad and dangerous by acting with insolence toward me. By the Emperor, {name}, I am in no mood to squabble with a Rogue Trader. Not even with Your Recently Installed {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

4de8c5f5-b22b-4363-a99f-5cc90af0e081.Text: "Illuminating, Lord Inquisitor." {n}Heinrix's tone would have frozen anyone else solid, but not Calcazar.{/n}

ae7dcef0-9391-4be0-ab88-f3a7b1dd5415.Text: "Master van Calox, I am pleased to see you. How was your journey?"

dbd73b9f-8077-40f9-90ca-fe2a8d46db65.Text: "That's the second time you have threatened the Lord Captain."

dcc82d4c-c5e0-471c-85f3-facf2cb50c2f.Text: {n}Heinrix's lip curls.{/n} "It is unfortunate that I was not privy to all the details of this plan."

acf83f6e-606c-4a8e-95c4-5678c36acce5.Text: "Heinrix, eliminate the Rogue Trader." {n}Calcazar gazes at the unmoving Interrogator.{/n}

78299f55-8f61-4184-98fc-f83b48b25450.Text: {n}The Inquisitor's face hardens. His eyebrows furrowed, he replies grimly,{/n} "I reject your accusations, Incendia. And I will forget your words... this once."

0e1cc259-9d55-4e17-bb57-bc3a54bb1406.Text: "Exactly what my duty dictates: saving the Imperium. Isn't it obvious?"

3855da1b-8e23-4da3-b89e-29162918be23.Text: {n}After a moment's pause, Calcazar says quietly,{/n} "Your verdict is clear, Incendia."

9681294e-6932-45b1-b340-4227776f0e28.Text: {n}Marazhai half-closes his eyes as if he has just heard something incredibly inane.{/n} "Grand spires of stupidity and unfathomable depths of opportunity is a dangerous combination for a single mon-keigh."

8ac3eeb3-75e5-4788-ab5e-89527c932997.Text: "You underestimate the Dark City's size and its resilience. It has survived thousands of dysjunctions and will survive thousands more to live on as fuel for your nightmares."

1c821bfd-ca0e-457e-bb3b-d177ace10a5c.Text: "What? Rykad's sun... vanished because of me?"

393fedec-214d-474f-bbe0-2da6945cc491.Text: "I still fail to see the connection between the disappearing star and the Cult of the Final Dawn... How could the xenos catalyse the fulfilment of the Archenemy's prophecy?"

9aa14bc1-d717-4605-abb9-e9db35cbe580.Text: {n}Idira shakes her head.{/n} "Perhaps... perhaps the powers of the warp knew ahead of time what was destined to happen. Before the cult infiltrated the planet... Before either Aurora showed up in the system..."

bef817c6-7e66-4636-967d-43ce549a19f7.Text: "Your actions have been questionable too, Lord Inquisitor. You may be within your rights to judge and punish bearers of the sacred Warrant, but here, among the uncharted stars, a Rogue Trader may easily find themselves executing an Inquisitor who is steeped in heresy." {n}Cassia's clear and confident gaze turns to Calcazar.{/n} "I see the canvas of your soul... and it is tainted with the gory hues of dried blood."

86a37fb7-c5b7-4def-909f-0a29f5af0ba5.Text: "Enough! I will have a separate conversation with House Orsellio."

22b9665d-9ec8-40b4-8acd-a24449ad1499.Text: "No one in this world is capable of taming the power of the true Yngir, the star devourers. And if you think even a small and imprisoned part of one of them is going to yield to you, you are mad, mon-keigh. Mad and short-sighted."

500a5875-e993-4f99-b987-10d12770918c.Text: "To put it plainly, {name}, I am averse to this proposition."

767209f7-a9fe-4996-9ab4-627a909003e4.Text: "Of course the Inquisition wants to collar it. How typical." {n}Jae's honeyed speech dissolves into soldierly crudeness:{/n} "Throne damn it, even I can see that no good can come of this groxshit crazy plan!"

b9c29a60-3e51-47fe-b055-c915b1bb46c8.Text: "The Yngir are no mere predators, mon-keigh. They are not just another sentient race. The ancient tales speak of a great war between the Yngir and the Old Ones. And in that war, the Yngir found allies to whom they promised unbounded gifts. You have seen them, elantach. Your species call them Necrons. The Yngir granted them everything they needed to fight their enemies, but their largesse came at a price. Tricked into a state that was neither life nor death, the metal warriors served the star devourers for aeons, until they finally rebelled and confined their masters to prisons such as this one. Do you wish to be tricked by their power too?"

b7a77c09-4c0d-4abc-8c56-7999af817987.Text: "Your unsanctioned xenos has a point, Rogue Trader. Which... isn't the same as saying she is right. The Imperium will harness this creature's power. And turn it against our enemies."

5c7979ce-ec51-4414-b905-e272d55e7b39.Text: "Well noted. Yes, I acted as their executioner, as regrettable as those losses were. However, to overestimate their importance to the Imperium would have been folly. Every single day, Humanity pays a far more terrible price, and that must be brought to an end."

3d48d5b9-b84f-470b-96d9-86be0603f447.Text: {n}Idira's eyes widen — the cold light of prophecy shines in them.{/n} "The future... the future you are creating — it blinds... it burns... It is filled with the suffering of millions... for the sake of the phantom salvation of billions... salvation... in the bosom of a xenonightmare."

a22d6aeb-de02-477f-9dd5-6ccd9d0dfd19.Text: "Fear. I hear nothing but fear in your words. It was fear that made you believe that His grace alone is not enough to stand against the rising tide of darkness. It was fear that convinced you to seek salvation in the abyss of xenos filth. You are no guardian of the Imperium. You are just a greedy old coward."

dbc62e76-7fdd-4d05-b3d9-164dedc5fd5d.Text: "The protocols dictate that the Inquisition is beyond the authority of the Adeptus Arbites. But not only have you put yourself above the Lex Imperialis..." {n}An angry growl creeps into Solomorne's voice.{/n} "You are playing god! I swore to keep order in the Imperium, and now, I'm just supposed to stand by and watch you do this? No."

28460b9c-d01b-4271-aa0e-105233beced3.Text: "And that brings us to the most interesting part of our conversation. You know my plan, so now I want to know yours. Will you admit that I am in the right and join me in this undeniably ambitious act, or will you try to stop me? I will be upfront with you: if it is the latter, I will be forced to remove you. But I am sure you realise that already."

cbf3f9c2-4df3-4e2a-bb6c-1c626b4844fb.Text: "So be it. Before we begin, I will say this... I am encouraged by your pragmatism, {name}. You have surpassed Theodora and my expectations, and I am grateful to know that I will not determine the fate of Humanity alone, but with a dependable ally at my side."

f8251f82-d9e6-4d70-ba06-7aff04785ce8.Text: {n}The Inquisitor nods calmly. There is not a shred of hatred or disappointment on his face.{/n} "Farewell, then. I am glad to have made your acquaintance, {name}, despite everything." {n}He glances at his retinue.{/n} "Eliminate the Rogue Trader."

116c25ef-6be7-4a68-a9e4-0a0365d70f1c.Text: "We call it a Shard. And yes, as you have noted quite aptly, it is the reason I am here. This construct contains an ancient, or rather, a pre-ancient being of cosmic power. They were called the C'tan. The entity is currently trying to escape, and I am here to collar it." {n}Calcazar nods at the giant device, whose design clearly points to it having been brought into the crypt from outside.{/n}

fd206471-3679-4285-85d1-38a7c6e2bf44.Text: "Abelard, no matter what happened, you were always at my side."

5f409d73-083a-46e0-8f40-57d560f2c8a6.Text: "You have a highly organised mind, so you must have already considered what you are going to do once this campaign of ours comes to an end."

86c2bdaf-c4d5-4dee-98b6-b46e9e19e3a6.Text: "Are you ready to follow me all the way?"

f5257928-1085-4070-be1c-74784c625027.Text: "Get ready, Abelard. We have quite an ordeal ahead of us."

ed0538d1-ebe0-48fe-a48f-ce7ca0ebeac7.Text: {n}Abelard looks at you with a tired smile. He cannot resist giving you his characteristic appraising glance.{/n} "Well, Lord Captain... My service to you began under the most remarkable circumstances. I should hardly be surprised that you have delivered us into circumstances more unexpected and surprising than ever before. Of one thing I am certain, the von Valancius dynasty will cover itself in glory today."

6f1edb71-7a2b-478d-bc46-bbb6637a3e6e.Text: "Yes, Lord Captain? We are all awaiting your order!"

826313f8-4f23-4835-aa59-e7f86e3a2474.Text: "A Seneschal's place is at the Rogue Trader's side. As you have learned, others can betray and abandon you in your darkest hour. If the Lord Captain cannot count on {mf|his|her} Seneschal, there is no one {mf|he|she} can count on. That is not a fate that I wish for you, so I am doing my duty."

8a927ac4-8e47-4fd8-a8f7-e3d87eb9469a.Text: {n}Somewhat embarrassed, Abelard tucks his thumbs into his belt.{/n} "Now that I have your blessing, it is about time I took care of my family. The Werserian clan has gone without its patriarch for too long, I should make time for my descendants before some noble upstart tries to chew them up again."

8e2f9862-2c91-40bf-8ce5-9e8f5eeeb3fd.Text: "What am I going to do? I will continue to serve you and see that you do not get into even worse trouble, though I fail to see how that would be possible." {n}Abelard chuckles grimly.{/n} "I swore an oath of loyalty to Lady Theodora, and then to you. Therefore my place is at the Rogue Trader's side and nowhere else."

83b8ae31-8c8c-4f4a-b67d-618273999243.Text: {n}Abelard looks up at you, a perennial weariness filling his gaze.{/n} "I have but one place to be, Lord Captain, and it is at your side. This is all I have left, so believe me, I will serve as your Seneschal for as long as I still draw breath."

b2a8a862-89f2-4ee5-bac6-180ae398e24c.Text: "As always, Lord Captain, I would follow you into fire and back. God-Emperor be my witness, I have had the honour of serving under two Rogue Traders and survived one, so there would be no shame in going down alongside the other. If it comes to that, naturally." {n}Abelard's chuckle sounds slightly sharper than usual.{/n}

d3e70584-1b02-404f-bb11-54e31967235e.Text: "We have been through worse..." {n}The old Seneschal grins cheekily, and for a split second looks younger by a good hundred years. He then bows his grey head.{/n} "I serve House von Valancius, Lord Captain."

c4adf899-6e93-4b3a-bda8-861254d9e609.Text: "Those who dwell upon these worlds have long been dead. But not even the dead are exempt from the God-Emperor's judgement!"

8330147b-58db-4c96-ad2a-3165c0090e0b.Text: "The raging fire of our crusade will shatter the darkness of these decayed systems!"

07c8bfa3-eeb4-49c4-b922-e3abc9104a85.Text: "If you ever feel your spirit weakening, come to me and confess, and the virtue of castigation will purge the flaws from your heart."

84e75fdc-1efb-47a0-a02b-37c4468af126.Text: "Your mercy gives meaning to my wandering in darkness."

ed17ee10-ecd9-4b36-b6cf-78d267dcd9b8.Text: "I am here, at hand. Say the word, and I will wield His wrath against our enemies!"

5b06ab77-68a6-42fa-97f6-b06ea9f1d050.Text: "The snare of condemnation still visits my soul. The road to redemption will be long."

4f81fc7b-c3f1-46e3-bf98-03db5308d56c.Text: "The dark masters' gaze is upon you. I can see the burns it leaves upon your soul."

f7fbcbb2-ea45-4382-abb8-4a62877ae8cf.Text: "Pain speaks to me. It wants to be felt."

aab1618e-eecd-45cb-9e23-2c48266da264.Text: "Things are dull when there is no fight to be had. I think I shall go hunting on the lower decks of your ship for a while."

ddaf7e88-f106-49ae-ae94-e83cb608ac85.Text: "They say only madmen fear nothing. What drivel! I no longer fear anything — do I look like a madman to you?"

2c7f3333-3b84-4aa0-933f-20986e2c7aaa.Text: "You think the denizens of these forsaken systems can suffer? I do hope so."

054e060b-cc17-4aa7-aa35-6b14353d1bc7.Text: [Kiss] "I would rather not wait several lives. Let us find our blessing in this one."

adbce197-cfb9-4a5a-ac41-793d7f79712d.Text: "I am glad you are sharing this moment with me today."

7ec37fd4-0d7a-4425-bde6-c21402f06c78.Text: "Steel yourself, Lady Cassia. The hour of battle is at hand."

c348a7f1-ed6a-4ec6-9967-f61ec2ea9793.Text: [Bow] "I am honoured to have you among my companions, Lady Cassia."

4f42c75a-b9c4-41a2-a7fc-25d7ffead8c2.Text: "This is probably not the future you dreamt of. But if all this ends in victory for us, what do you intend to do next?"

2cd22db3-cd67-492e-93be-973a396db3a5.Text: "L-Lord Captain?" {n}Cassia's pained, worried face seems to grow even paler.{/n} "The end of our journey draws near. I keep wondering... will this story have a happy ending? Or will we face an imminent but heroic demise..."

e6ff6f5e-1b73-46d5-b02f-b1ea6703085c.Text: "This place is drowning in anxieties the colour of olive haze, though many try to paint their insecurities over with deliberately bright hues." {n}The Lady Navigator's sombre gaze slides over the faces of those present.{/n} "Pale grey shadows swirl in a mournful dance, heralding the danger ahead. I cast them away as I cast away my doubts. There is no turning back."

e79e7a0f-aeb6-4bad-9a81-2f14ac233968.Text: "{name}." {n}The faint smile on Cassia's face makes you momentarily forget about the impending battle.{/n} "We have travelled a long road together. Let us finish it together as well."

0f389cf9-6269-4b4e-b0a0-ab09a0d3e31f.Text: "Lord Captain." {n}Cassia nods courteously.{/n} "When I met you on Eurac V, I could not have imagined that I would find myself on the threshold of a great battle one day. Does the blue flutter of doubt and fear overwhelm my heart? Perhaps. Do I wish I could turn back time?" {n}A bitter smile graces the Lady Navigator's lips.{/n} "Never."

3ed5a519-7713-4304-bd0c-4428488879c9.Text: "You have been my guide in this world this entire time. How could I turn my back on you at the last moment?"

f277c888-a06b-4bd5-82f8-1bbefceecf38.Text: "My love." {n}, Cassia brushes the invisible weight off your shoulders with a light movement, and your heart feels a little calmer, {/n} "What lies ahead of us is uncertain. Perhaps darkness and oblivion. And yet I feel no fear, no trepidation, no doubt."

6658c88f-2c6e-45aa-9d2b-1232fbc9aceb.Text: "This is what friends are for, {name}. To be there for one another, in times of joy and in times of sorrow — I learned it all from you."

5c06c357-f495-45d5-82c1-c6b76ea3d5cd.Text: "And when trouble recedes, I shall share a thousand more moments with you, my love."

4a555f66-6b46-4100-a731-f67eac4412b8.Text: {n}Cassia shrugs uncertainly.{/n} "Perhaps I shall stay on your ship for a while longer, if you wish. I... do enjoy travelling among the stars of the Expanse. Or should I... should I return to the fold of the House at the next opportunity? Ah, I do not know."

33eb1242-2bcf-4d02-a09a-38efc6fffa6a.Text: "The throne of the Novator of House Orsellio has sat empty for too long. The machinations of the Great Regent, the feuding between the branches of the same family, the attempts on my life and yours, too... I must rectify these mistakes. And take what is rightfully mine."

65ec903b-e442-4227-876c-cdd0f1bbb376.Text: "I have been running for too long, {name}. Hiding behind others while my home, my family... were being torn apart by hatred and strife. And what could a young, inexperienced girl do to those who were so desperate to either destroy me or bend me to their will?"

b87724c8-c20f-4f33-a472-54b1a4ef63b2.Text: {n}Cassia looks distressed.{/n} "I... I think I should return to the fold of the House Orsellio and claim the Novator's throne... If my family has not already been torn apart by a bloody feud."

99e21f21-bb7a-467b-ab93-5115007cea30.Text: "My heart is fluttering, Lord Captain, but not because of fear or doubt. I... am ready to face what is coming."

3d84f9f2-cd85-4476-9b0c-f080e22e4b08.Text: {n}Cassia smiles bitterly.{/n} "The throne of the Novator of House Orsellio will no longer sit empty. But... my only regret is that I shall have to leave your ship and the darkness between the stars that I have come to love so much. I hope you will visit me, {name}."

79059763-0934-472d-800c-ed5e1bac531d.Text: {n}Cassia's palm gently rests on your cheek.{/n} "To be here with you, to share the last moments of peace before the inevitable... If either of us should die in the coming battle, know that I will look for you in the next life. Until I find you again."

9cac2c50-c208-4602-af8d-07b6a4c7c93d.Text: "I see flashes of mottled colour swirling at your temples. Did you... want something?"

56a791f6-5ab0-4853-9d67-4115c0e8d1c8.Text: "I... only wish to spend as much time with you as fate has given us. Among the futures I see, it is the only one my heart can bear."

437832c0-3782-4d8f-9996-4c9f0c9f632a.Text: {n}Cassia shakes her head, laughing softly.{/n} "It would be wonderful, my love. But will the stars let us?"

13e84039-c97d-4953-b8b8-8fd92fcb8fd6.Text: {n}Cassia nods pensively.{/n} "It is time for the most important lesson of all, Lord Captain. Thanks to you, I am here and ready for anything."

8108ef31-0174-405d-8f66-a15b32c82d80.Text: {n}Cassia smiles demurely and curtsies in response.{/n} "I am honoured to be your companion, {name} von Valancius."

b78d9aef-fabe-4c81-9937-d0d3bf91753e.Text: "Until duty calls me... I would like to spend the best moments of my life with you, Lord Captain. And only the stars know what will happen next."

85b7eee6-05c8-4d8c-b721-cd86996d6db2.Text: "You are imagining things, Maatashi. I came to make sure you are ready for the journey. You are a combat unit, not a palace courtier."

ecd2e19e-b702-4c8a-920a-59b513f7f943.Text: "If you enjoy wishful thinking so much, I am not going to dissuade you."

4c82f594-722c-43cb-bc06-6100f10052ec.Text: "Let us not waste any more time."

09b54f6d-cdbf-4ba8-ad4d-f921d9c1161e.Text: {n}As you approach, Maatashi raises her gaze to you, never ceasing her action of working the cutting side of her claw with an otherworldly glowing stone.{/n} "Is there something you wanted to tell me? No? You must want to hear something from me, then." {n}The power of enchantment emanating from the Daemonette makes you see not a monster of the warp but a seductive warrior maiden.{/n} "Have you grown fond of me, {name}?"

58ca59db-30e1-48fa-84d8-f059e3ddd3cb.Text: {n}The Daemonette flashes a grin that is part joy and part fury.{/n} "You think someone like me can be taken by surprise? I can turn a dozen mortals into mincemeat in the time it takes you to aim that ridiculous cannon of yours. Do not worry, I am as ready for a slaughter as I am for a feast. After all, one is not so different from the other."

a33ea076-301f-4c99-b0bb-3f1f0205b361.Text: {n}Maatashi makes a peculiar graceful bow, hiding a satisfied fanged smirk.{/n} "I am flattered. I suppose I will have to dutifully watch your back since you are being so nice to me. I hope you will not disappoint Slaanesh and you will make a grand feast out of our enemies' suffering."

494111a8-a6f1-4973-b582-0d962c48fd22.Text: "Take care of your mortal hide, {name}. I heard that great things are expected of you, it would be a shame if you died too soon."

936f33bb-3d15-4f78-9365-9ce21d4a5db3.Text: {n}The angry eyes narrow, unable to hide the burning malice.{/n} "The cheek of it! And yet you still dare to stand next to me. I know what you want to hear, but no, I will not abandon you in your most trying moment. After all, who else would amuse me with such arrogance? You are adorable in your hubris!"

8784255a-397f-4d3e-a4a6-650fef83df8b.Text: "You will meet your mentor again down there..."

739f2df4-d9fb-4874-8e2c-50f989993bf5.Text: "We will survive this trial also. And when it is all over, we will be together."

db70325f-0960-4365-9ff6-1a9b92423d49.Text: "When all this is over — what will you do?"

8fe7e35c-3de7-4ff5-b861-91a6f60931e9.Text: {n}Heinrix van Calox nods to you.{/n} "Our journey together approaches its end. One last push and the secrets of the Expanse and Calcazar will be laid to rest. I can't wait — I'm tired of the shroud of secrecy that has hidden the truth even from me."

7d878c80-14d2-46d6-8dac-445b0462f5e4.Text: {n}Heinrix van Calox touches your cheek, his fingertips skating over your skin.{/n} "One last push, my love. One last trial and all will be set right. Are you ready for it? If not, I will be your resolve. Just say the word."

0c4ea6c2-2147-4d28-96b0-8a6375f2f11e.Text: "And I have questions for him. I want to know why I was left in the dark about everything that was happening in the shadows of the Expanse. Why all the acolytes died on the way here... Well, almost all of the Lord Inquisitor's acolytes. Why..." {n}Heinrix exhales sharply and stiffens.{/n} "I want to hear what he has to say. And then make my judgement."

88e98808-8525-412d-ba43-f122bc7a8eea.Text: {n}Heinrix smiles thinly.{/n} "Former mentor. In his eyes, I am now a heretic who has betrayed everything I once fought for. And you know what? I don't care."

ab5eebb7-15b3-45bb-9ec5-2e03b1ec2599.Text: {n}Warmth and lingering sadness appear in Heinrix's eyes.{/n} "Yes. We will be together, for as long as our duty will let us."

6d4d6c18-18c2-4202-a60a-60f32e52d3e9.Text: {n}Heinrix draws you close and brings his lips to your forehead.{/n} "Together. Always."

d9007ce4-af75-44d8-8c64-a6955b21898f.Text: {n}Heinrix presses his lips together and shakes his head.{/n} "I feel uneasy even thinking about it... but if Lord Inquisitor Xavier Calcazar falls today..." {n}Heinrix locks eyes with you.{/n} "Someone has to take the rosette of the Ordo Xenos, at the very least until the Inquisition enclave determines who will be a worthy successor to Xavier."

7631bea1-a3e9-47d3-8ad1-b12cf811f23c.Text: {n}The Interrogator dips his head.{/n} "Lead on, Rogue Trader {name} von Valancius."

ebb6e2d6-08d4-48ba-9a26-3fad3b4e0c9b.Text: {n}Heinrix inclines his head when you draw near.{/n} "The shuttle is waiting. No need to drag this moment out."

49980bb4-8a18-4285-84a8-d834916f2357.Text: {n}Heinrix's touch is warm and ardent. He clasps you to him and breathes,{/n} "I will be your determination. Your courage. Your resolve. I will be everything you need in this dark hour."

dea2c322-aabe-4d71-b763-9cf9da85390d.Text: "Haven't we already talked about this? I'll remain by your side — no one else will dare decide my fate for me." {n}A grin dawns on Heinrix's face.{/n} "And to save me from idleness, I'll find something suitable to do under your leadership. Is there any occupation worthy of a former Inquisitorial Interrogator in your officer corps? I already have a few ideas of my own."

0304ba8d-6e71-4872-b5cd-0437359707b1.Text: "How about, Idira? Grant me one last prediction — for the road?"

1c92d80a-6ef0-43e5-b127-440a0c8521c1.Text: "I am glad you have been at my side all this time."

bc67ddae-06f9-4862-9617-e477ff5c9c16.Text: "What do you think awaits us after this last skirmish?"

bd934f8a-8aa4-434f-85c1-da1f008d3b1f.Text: "Pull yourself together, Idira. We have a tough battle ahead of us."

ae03bbe8-d124-458b-a520-5cfceef9b6f5.Text: {n}Idira nods when you approach. The numerous tubes in the device on her head gleam dimly.{/n} "Lord Captain, I am ready. I guess everything will be settled now, won't it? This long, convoluted story, the time has come to end it. If you order me to go into the fires of perdition, I will do it right away. Just let me know."

cfed5efe-9b27-48f5-b52c-c8d4bfc66fec.Text: {n}Idira looks up at you with reddened eyes. Despite the tired look on her face, she smiles broadly, either at you or at something behind you.{/n} "Well, Lord Captain... My little whisperers have grown quiet, it's like they know the long thread we've been following is finally at an end. It's now or never, isn't it? Thank you for everything either way, Lord Captain."

b598edda-cf8b-445e-a044-149a3b3a4872.Text: "Well, Lord Captain? Has the time come? Command me, if so."

4d6520c1-331b-40cc-9d97-9c278c5452f9.Text: {n}Idira shakes her head.{/n} "No, Lord Captain. Just like I promised, I will not open the door to the warp without reason. I already know that you are ready for whatever is waiting for us down there, so it's up to you to decide what your future will be."

17ad0f40-16d2-43bc-a41f-da110d5846bd.Text: "You think the little whisperers are going to play nice? Hah, they weren't that useful even before, and now they're more likely to mess us around than save our bacon." {n}Idira laughs ruefully.{/n} "Lord Captain, your fate is in your hands alone. Do not let the words of a deranged psyker confuse you — you're not meant to listen to the grumbling beyond the veil."

3aee2095-7074-4a84-a7aa-5eb2aa497f4e.Text: "Well, I have no doubts about you, everything's going to come up roses for you! As for me..." {n}Idira catches herself.{/n} "You know, maybe I won't live long, but it'll be a good life. I'll leave behind so many tales to tell! Let them remember my name over a mug of something foamy and laugh at the stories of my — well, of our exploits."

4565a180-2d01-48ee-b169-850ccecf37e2.Text: {n}Idira gives you a long look.{/n} "I've gone through so much to keep you and me safe... I don't think I'm interested in anything other than living up to the expectations placed on me. I am an instrument of your will, Lord Captain. And that is enough."

b323e5c9-287e-4bda-8d46-d0718aa1fa9c.Text: "And, you see..." {n}Idira looks away in embarrassment.{/n} "If I don't have much time left, I'll at least spend it with the person I really care about... I almost lost her stupidly, but I've wised up a bit now. So... I'm going to treasure every minute I spend with her."

ac742d66-1294-4d57-9c1f-e4d15e9abfc2.Text: {n}Idira sobs at your words.{/n} "I... thank you, Lord Captain. I can't imagine why you've shown me so much kindness, after everything we have been through... You are the only reason I'm still alive! There were so many ways I could've died..."

4c4d150a-1660-4a94-9aa1-a0ede07c7d82.Text: "I know I've been harping on all this time about 'Lady Theodora this,' 'Lady Theodora that'... You know, you may never become who she was, but she could never have been who you are, either. And I'm glad it was you who replaced her, and that life threw me together with you, and not with somebody else. So there. Now let's change the subject before I get all sentimental, all right?"

d79a3e91-adce-46bc-90ca-a9bfe48d5b14.Text: "I am ready, Lord Captain. Just say the word."

080d83e1-05e5-45b8-bae6-09c158710378.Text: {n}Idira's impassive expression momentarily shows a glimpse of emotion.{/n} "And I am glad to serve you, Lord Captain. You gave me what even Lady Theodora could not. You gave me a future. It is a great gift, and I intend to repay this debt in full."

b60b4aa8-ee64-46af-b813-d8dece904d26.Text: "If it were an easy battle, who would ever bother to tell tales about it? Nobody, that's who! Let's show 'em, Lord Captain."

1a70f7aa-cc6e-4081-ad2b-b4630dfe3783.Text: {n}Idira sobs fearfully, but in the next moment hugs you back.{/n} "There, there... You really have lost it, haven't you?" {n}She is silent for a few seconds and mutters something before letting you go.{/n} "Thanks."

847d3af5-475b-44c5-936e-98cf52fced82.Text: {n}Idira greets you with a bustling chorus of voices, her own barely audible among them:{/n} "Lord Captain! You got my little voices all excited, they all want to crawl out of my throat to greet you. They can sense it, I bet. That it's the threshold of the final door. Your door. Will you risk stepping beyond it? Hey, have I already told you I'll follow you anywhere? Or does that one happen later?"

097ef66c-203b-46d4-9335-c96d25c3fbfe.Text: "For the road? Which one, Lord Captain? The roads, they twist, and coil, and tangle together, and separate again... We... I mean, I! I can't choose the road for you, please don't even ask! Just walk right on ahead, and the road will wind whichever way you want it to."

860c1f80-ff8b-4a33-9778-3d48a3ed7ec1.Text: {n}Idira laughs in many voices.{/n} "Will do, Lord Captain! Let me just pull myself together, piece by piece. This little voice goes here, that one goes there... Just a couple more, and we'll have the whole Idira! Sooner or later..."

ed736b89-286a-40d8-a7d5-d4b4151fddc9.Text: {n}Idira looks up at you with a disconnected expression and couples it with a fake smile. She smells of cheap amasec and stimulants.{/n} "Lord Captain. It'll all be over soon, won't it? Finally over..." {n}She falls silent for a long time.{/n} "I'm sorry, I haven't slept in days — the voices just won't leave me alone. I'll get over it. I won't let you down. I promise."

dfe63bc3-da4a-4456-9084-b8c8ed5cd500.Text: {n}Idira narrows her eyes warily, as if not fully convinced of your sincerity. Then her expression softens.{/n} "Thank you, Lord Captain. I guess you're the only reason I'm still alive — most people in your shoes would've killed the wild witch long ago. Though, well, we both know I don't have long." {n}She smiles darkly.{/n} "Well, no point in talking about the depressing stuff! Let's talk about our suicidal expedition instead!"

146f69db-b146-4c02-93ee-32572ba1f093.Text: {n}Idira shrugs.{/n} "I stopped believing in afters long ago. You've got your protectorate and new heights to conquer, which I'm sure you'll do in no time. And I've—" {n}Her voice cracks for a moment, but she inhales loudly and composes herself.{/n} "Lord Captain, please don't make me think about what's waiting for me."

90959f16-d4b6-4762-bdaf-7ef7a8ad6958.Text: [Kiss Jae] "Thank you for walking this long road with me."

60ea4884-9564-495a-899e-50e126de3768.Text: "I just wanted to say that I am glad of your company. Especially now."

59f9ff56-07f6-48b5-a271-0ba442713106.Text: "Cast aside your doubts. The Emperor protects!"

3ff82d21-a84b-413b-b16c-7217b22d3773.Text: "I am curious to see what you will do once all this is over."

4d2d14c1-8074-4732-9669-8c0f8ae022cb.Text: "Get a grip, Jae. We have a hard battle ahead of us."

a3d5cb22-82ae-4042-a7c8-5ef8e4cabd85.Text: "Are you afraid of what is to come, Jae?"

06924119-dbca-4243-a8fe-66d00246706d.Text: "Whatever comes our way, we can handle it."

88fab1e4-eb89-4f16-93f3-9bba308f2572.Text: "The Exalted One once wove our destinies into the glittering tapestry of this world with gold and silver thread, shereen. And today the pattern of our lives will either be completed..." {n}Jae snaps her metal fingers deliberately loudly.{/n} "Or the tapestry will be torn asunder. Personally, I prefer to place my hope in the first option."

0f4e50c9-f1b9-446f-9d21-795627149f39.Text: "Shereen, luminary of the Expanse and ruler of a thousand stars! On the fiery wings of your determination we have come to this abode of darkness... But will those not possessed of your radiance withstand the onslaught of the void?"

8cc26740-9114-46fb-986b-03d137059616.Text: {n}Jae intertwines her fingers with yours, snuggles up to you and whispers in your ear,{/n} "To the Exalted One's throne or into a cold abyss, it matters not, my beloved. Wherever you go, I will follow."

90f1393c-88dc-49c8-a2a1-f2d277648bc9.Text: "I don't know, shereen. Being drunk on unbridled freedom sounds nice. It's so close — I could reach out and grab it like the tail of a comet... and leave the Kasballica Mission behind, start doing things on my own without having to rely on your good favour. Limitless possibilities lie ahead! I just have to... survive the coming darkness."

d7f04dad-042c-4fb8-9f69-e4eb211d945a.Text: "I think the best place for people like me is in the shadows, shereen. I know how the Kasballica Mission operates in the Expanse. And how desperately it needs talented intermediaries to work with the powers that be... How fortunate it is, then, that Jae Heydari possesses the Mercatum Tabula Officiale and is a trade representative of the Imperium." {n}The Cold Trader shoots you a self-satisfied smirk and winks.{/n}

f215dc13-2aca-4e3a-8c33-53d2c8b61ca3.Text: "Well, I still intend to turn a withered shrub into a flourishing garden, shereen. As Liege of Footfall, I will clean up the filth and stench that Vladaym left behind and turn a decaying station into a magnificent trading port."

29ac4def-a055-4712-bbd7-3376ddc2e6ab.Text: {n}Jae raises a brow.{/n} "Did you or did you not grant me the honour of becoming your vassal, shereen? The right hand of the Rogue Trader — I will guard the prosperity of your protectorate as eagerly as I guard my own life."

31f68a57-88cc-47b7-bc32-d15fa65a1e2e.Text: "All the world lies open before me, shereen. If I wish, I will return to Footfall, to the Kasballica Mission and the Cold Trade. If you wish to keep me near, then that is where I'll remain. A free spirit, a free agent!" {n}Jae sings sweetly, but the turmoil in her eyes reveals her uncertainty about her own words.{/n}

47044def-1c41-4291-a36f-2feb0f2aa0d7.Text: {n}Jae chuckles.{/n} "The Exalted One, you know, may have other designs on our souls. But what remains faithful beyond faith itself? We can but trust in His grace. The Emperor protects, shereen."

00f7bccf-628c-48ab-a532-73fd3b8fa099.Text: "Shereen?" {n}Jae's solemn gaze is suddenly fixed on you.{/n} "Long have I followed you wherever you go, like the midnight moon striving to catch up with the morning star. How is it that in chasing after your light, I now find myself on the threshold of an unknown darkness, one in which a terrible enemy lurks?"

ed88ded0-3ff4-4081-8552-0ccab7061437.Text: "Wreathed in the righteous flame of the Exalted One, you have laid a path for your enemies through the starry darkness, shereen. And the battle between the stout-hearted and the heartless draws near." {n}Jae touches the gleaming Aquila on her chest.{/n} "Do you think fortune will favour us this time?"

0c722358-2276-4f3c-beb2-1c607afb3112.Text: "Ah, shereen, you found the most discreet and frugal words to wrap the passion I kindle in your heart. I am not endowed with such rhetorical perfection, so I will respond more ardently: I too am glad that the Exalted One wove our destinies together."

a5cbb98e-55e5-46f3-a6bb-006ad6ee2290.Text: "Our alliance is like a miraculous oasis blooming in the fierce desert heat. I am glad to be your partner, and friend, and ally in the fight against the enemy."

128c5518-ea6d-4d43-a989-0598a499248c.Text: "As long as you need me, shereen, I will be a smiting sword in your hand, a punishing scourge whistling over the heads of your enemies, or a loyal helping hand."

747571c4-4b99-4217-9082-a4c91d7a8737.Text: "Without you, I never would have reached heights that others only dare to dream of. Jae Heydari always repays good favour with loyalty — whole-hearted and unbreakable."

23771e06-1691-4dd0-bfef-a0c30aa90618.Text: "Shereen, your words are like honey to my ears!"

f2cf3e41-e6c3-4c99-aba5-89752fedf1b8.Text: "Rest assured, shereen — when it comes to matters of being and oblivion, Jae Heydari has the coldest mind and the bravest heart."

f5354ee7-269b-4330-ba7d-2fc1675b7930.Text: "The battle against the enemy? Pain? Oblivion?" {n}Jae smiles and shakes her head.{/n} "Oh no, shereen. My only fear is that, after these tribulations, we will never be the same again. And I do so enjoy being me."

f68907af-8838-4d80-a7bc-8fef4fbf9818.Text: "I am not afraid of dying, shereen. I am afraid of staying alive only to discover that everyone else has perished in the darkness... So, do try to avoid any fatal wounds."

1e1c3f27-f888-4e4e-a43a-b4c6ff549055.Text: {n}Jae shrugs vaguely.{/n} "Better a live void jackal than a dead but noble lion."

09602b6f-62cb-4204-94ac-9da890ad421d.Text: "I fear you underestimate your own power, shereen. And overestimate the capabilities of ordinary mortals."

ac73fafd-cc7b-4511-afad-6e214f4ed7cf.Text: {n}After a pregnant pause, Jae continues in her usual playful manner:{/n} "So... what brings you to me, shereen? Not parting words, I hope? Because I despise goodbyes. I feel as though they rob me of my future. You never want to hear 'goodbye,' after all, but only ever 'see you again under the same stars!'"

01568911-c6ce-4dcb-9b6f-7271be6d8bd7.Text: "You mean if it's ever over? And if the azhi don't play their evil tricks on us?" {n}Jae raises an eyebrow and shrugs.{/n}

6d8b50fe-f03f-4e0d-a63c-5855ab4842b5.Text: {n}Jae responds to the kiss with eagerness and passion.{/n} "You have become my very special friend, shereen. Try not to die on this expedition. I do not wish to weep over you."

65bb296c-4676-4a9b-8cc6-0abd305940e9.Text: "I will definitely return, and when I do, I wish to continue our... games."

e63620c3-066b-4333-bc03-0b61f9c2197a.Text: "Will you remain with me when this is over?"

7b391d68-9043-4617-a730-003cb789d55d.Text: "I hope your blades have been sharpened — the hour of the great battle is near."

83d2e567-2e12-415d-9525-24f4763b18d5.Text: "Whatever comes, I am glad to have fought shoulder to shoulder with you."

bd591867-01d7-47cd-b89f-5ffe829d4115.Text: {n}Marazhai is meticulously inspecting his gear, but turns his entire attention to your person when you approach.{/n} "{name}! There you are! You have something very special waiting for you, do you not? A trial that will determine whether you stay on top or become dust under the feet of your enemies."

b3b76e44-f1ca-4e4d-9d7c-02c12bba99a4.Text: {n}The Drukhari's fingers close on your chin.{/n} "My obedient little pet, are you being insolent, making demands of me? When you return... try asking properly and I will consider it."

f5b81509-a784-45a9-871b-0a0fc22e0da4.Text: {n}Marazhai gives you a wryly slavish look.{/n} "As it pleases you, {name}. You know how I love to do your will."

9b00496b-7dbf-4258-b3b1-b4f1941affd1.Text: "Games? No, the time for games is past." {n}The ever-present mockery evaporates from his eyes and he looks at you with frightening seriousness and... trepidation.{/n} "Only blood-soaked truth lies between those bound by domination."

5d04a454-cd78-47af-9c55-97138dcd6bb4.Text: "Of course not. My Kabal is waiting for me." {n}Marazhai stares past you into the middle distance.{/n} "The Reaving Tempest that tore a piece out of the Black Heart... An interesting future awaits me and my subjects. Perhaps we will be crushed. Perhaps we will be feared. Whatever happens..." {n}He looks at you.{/n} "It is the life I was born to live."

1cabb0a8-36d1-4371-a0f3-4b590f4d5eb1.Text: {n}Marazhai's lip curls.{/n} "Your buck— your ship is but a tiny shell in the universe of possibilities that is open to my talents. Though the Reaving Tempest has ended, I can find a replacement for it. Not in Commorragh, but in the other dark corners of this sector. Sslyth, corsairs, mon-keigh — there are many who long to bend the knee to one who knows the canons of war and the tenets of slaughter."

d620197b-fa36-48f4-9bf7-0c273b2fc2e5.Text: {n}Marazhai lets out a hiss.{/n} "I have not decided what my future will be. When the time comes, I will inform you of my plans. Or perhaps not. I have not decided that yet either."

84623b1d-652c-4578-8524-8e84aca2fac2.Text: {n}Marazhai cups your chin with a clawed glove, pouring sweet words like deadly poison into your ear:{/n} "But I have trained you well. You are determined and hungry for suffering... Oh yes, you will find rapture in what you are about to endure. You have already transcended the boundaries of stunted mon-keigh morality. You understand what others do not. Whether you triumph or fall, you will do so with an understanding that is beyond the grasp of your kind."

15298f3e-29e4-470d-a2e1-40530cecd241.Text: {n}Marazhai smiles thinly.{/n} "Careful — or else I might think you have gone soft and weak." {n}After a moment's hesitation, he adds, in a quieter and more agitated tone:{/n} "I will say this only once, {name}: you are the reason for all my misfortunes, but you are also the reason why I survived — despite the fury of all Commorragh and the wrath of the Black Heart. Consider this confession an expression of my gratitude."

0236fc16-795a-4fc0-be59-d33fca6c7d5b.Text: "Or..." {n}Marazhai's eyes dart to the side.{/n} "Or I will find something... completely different. But something replete with meaning."

19b6cd11-4fee-4e99-b49b-a04c910b61e7.Text: {n}The Drukhari bares his teeth in a bloodthirsty grin.{/n} "My weapons are always ready for new victims, {name}."

3a850938-88c2-4ee2-8901-62c29b48631c.Text: {n}Marazhai clicks his fingers impatiently.{/n} "Well? Why are we dawdling? Our delay may give the enemy the advantage. Or have you been overcome with sentimentality at the last moment?"

0ef2e886-d8ad-48ad-a112-3cc7c73877cd.Text: "When the campaign comes to an end, will you stay on duty or return to your fellow Tech-Priests?"

ac5a79f5-4010-407f-899e-ae60016b41cb.Text: "You do not seem too worried about the coming landing."

fd2a92ec-6c37-4d86-88ca-6c320226887e.Text: "You took good care of my ship and equipment. The dynasty will not forget it."

a62048ca-66c4-4880-bef4-4547b1ebc1ff.Text: {n}The Tech-Priest is checking his gear, whispering prayers to the Omnissiah. He looks up at you and speaks matter-of-factly,{/n} "The tactical equipment audit is ninety-seven percent complete. No critical failures detected. The Omnissiah shows favour."

ba56ac22-d7dd-470f-862a-2aabee550518.Text: "The decision on the future of this unit will be made by the conclave of the Cognisance Fleet. A great transgression has been committed, and there is great repentance to be borne. If it proves intolerable to the vital functions of the unit in question, it will console itself with the thought that it has made an effort to rectify the sacrilege it intended."

447037e5-10c8-484e-befd-4f5797f22d64.Text: "It has been a joy to serve such a distinguished person, but duty calls the Amarnat Collective to a different mission. The message of change must be proclaimed. The believers must be separated from the doubters..."

a95d3bac-3c38-4efa-b361-4e7f617d1b26.Text: "There is no such thing as good fortune. May the statistical probability be predictably positive."

3bf74430-b5b1-4ad4-8eef-430d4a6216a0.Text: "This unit hoped that travelling with you would reveal his purpose. The Omnissiah judged otherwise. Perhaps the time has not yet come, in which case servitude must continue. Glory to the von Valancius dynasty!"

2727a0fe-5f52-445d-9bd0-afdea623fc6f.Text: {n}The vox makes a rustling noise that sounds like a chuckle.{/n} "A mission of reconnaissance is a blessed and desirable one for an Explorator. The data-soul of the one who explores, analyses, and charts overflows with the joy of servitude." {n}Pasqal lowers his eyes.{/n} "I would be honoured to disembark with you."

e2b3ca5a-65a3-463d-b53c-d698e2c7b861.Text: "Where the iron flowers of the Omnissiah bloom, there must also be His passionate gardeners. Thank you for honouring this unit by letting it serve the formidable spirit of the von Valancius dynasty's flagship and Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

8f1305de-c7b1-412f-a81e-8bf3b85dffc5.Text: "The tactical equipment audit is complete. The machine spirits will not fail you."

d37a7252-1787-483a-8158-59dd56a682c0.Text: {n}Pasqal... no, Amarnat looks at you curiously.{/n} "The experience of our comradeship has taught this unit much. The trials and battles we have gone through have produced trust, sincerity, mutual understanding. Amarnat will lead his flock through the flames and forge the sect into a religion."

f4ca5111-491f-475b-ab2d-b9ef9adcf5e0.Text: "It has been an honour to work with you, but the time of servitude for this unit has come to an end. Servitude is the way of the one who has questions, and I now have the answers. I will gather my flock and give them answers, not as a servant, but as a ruler and mentor."

804be0b5-5d78-45ec-ad8f-b31df9f7ff89.Text: "I am glad to have you as my faithful ally, Argenta."

ee9c85a7-90ba-467f-b969-b338febbfd02.Text: [Make the sign of the Aquila] "Together till the end, Sister. In His name and for Terra's light."

4ab29bf4-e57c-4c67-8333-007cc185aeb6.Text: "Have you had time to think about the future? What will you do should we prevail in this pivotal battle?"

246f09d5-7621-4d50-afc4-639cfef5639a.Text: "We are almost out of time. Prepare yourself, Argenta!"

78150c7b-1013-48bf-809d-714f7a50fc72.Text: {n}Argenta's face, which has grown haggard as of late, looks like the face of someone stricken with fever.{/n} "At last. The final battle approaches, Rogue Trader. My heart awaits it eagerly."

fdb3a2fa-ae20-42b4-b36b-ab9a3c122331.Text: {n}Argenta greets you with a clear and burning gaze.{/n} "I pray, Rogue Trader. I pray that the hearts of your comrades remain strong, that their — our — courage holds, that our weapons prevail. I pray that the light of Terra does not turn away from us even for a moment. That the fire within us only burns brighter as the foes before us grow fiercer."

65517088-28bd-4613-a199-bfce00529244.Text: {n}Argenta rolls her shoulders impatiently.{/n} "When is the battle, Rogue Trader? This idleness is torture!"

51796cd2-675b-4a7d-9132-af9d8d3bcd56.Text: "May we all fulfil our duty today," {n}she half-whispers.{/n}

a57298ef-f21d-4dd3-9098-9af16bc6d7e9.Text: "And I pray for you. Terra's light is what guides us through the darkness, but you are the force that keeps us from straying from the path."

990ab295-5b24-40d7-a6a9-132cc3cd3bed.Text: "We must destroy our enemies in this den of dark forces. And we will do so by His will and in His name!"

995c487b-6812-4b6a-b93b-de9b7a5b5c26.Text: "Rogue Trader! It is time, isn't it? We are approaching the den of darkness to deliver the decisive blow."

8ec7f5b4-b2c6-41ea-ae3c-5739046622aa.Text: "In His name and for Terra's light!" {n}echoes the voice of the Sister of Battle.{/n}

1ea24834-41c6-42de-a4cd-83a16ecc6f6e.Text: "Gladness is fleeting. Do not be enticed by it, Rogue Trader. Think only of your calling and be emboldened by it."

6567cbe2-b24a-41a7-82a5-e19d1259a43c.Text: "A Sister Repentia has no future. If I am denied my death in the coming fight, I will set out in search of new battles. Again and again will I charge into fire, eradicating enemies of Humanity until my heart stops beating."

c8883eeb-223d-417f-be5b-e2be3590340c.Text: "I will carry on in my service to the Emperor as I always have. But no longer as a fledgling Sister of Battle, but as the keeper of a relic that has been bestowed upon me by His will. I want to bring light to all the faithful in the Koronus Expanse, as Saint Argenta did in her lifetime. And I know I am ready for this mission."

55770fe8-3ba3-4d45-8346-34bbb3532d0d.Text: "I long to set out on a journey of my own. Forgive me for saying this, Rogue Trader, but I have followed you long enough. There are too many restraints, too many distractions — and meanwhile, thousands, millions of heretics out there have yet to be found and destroyed. I am the only Sister of Battle the Koronus Expanse has, which means I have much work to do."

2d3597a0-28c5-4459-881a-e5380f7fc158.Text: {n}Argenta looks caught off guard.{/n} "I haven't, no. I am just as lost as the day I first found myself in the Koronus Expanse and realised the sheer cruelty of the warp's trickery."

469e6aca-7d42-478c-aca0-6f850492ef6b.Text: "I would not have reached the end of my path without you. So I say this without hiding it: I am just as glad to be fighting shoulder to shoulder with you!"

7973965d-70b8-49f4-90f5-0a5c2a3ed27f.Text: "Oh yes, better to have me as an ally than an opponent! For no foe of mine can survive the wrath of the keeper of the great relic."

f73fb0ad-5477-41c9-afb1-7477645b8ac8.Text: "You found your pack, and our campaign is nearing its end. What are you going to do next?"

fc5973ba-180f-4ba9-a5cb-30c05a161e6f.Text: "I am glad the Emperor brought our paths together."

2e990d55-edfe-47c7-9d27-ed0d6209ec80.Text: "Xavier Calcazar is waiting for me down there. Should I give him your regards?"

d00f350a-96aa-4f61-964f-de0d794bd17d.Text: "I am not a priest, of course, and the spirits do not always speak clearly to me, but I did cast the runes. You have a great challenge ahead of you, Aett-Vater. Be very careful, or better yet, take me with you. There is no better way to guard your safety."

c4c07d3f-9ee9-4a79-b444-b990ff6343ef.Text: "I will return to my brothers and sing the saga of the Baleful Howl pack. I will carry it all the way to Fenris and pour its ringing verses into the ears of the Jarl and the Great Wolf himself. Its burning words will warm us during the fierce Helwinter." {n}Ulfar grins.{/n} "And the brothers at the table will nudge each other and point their fingers at me and say, 'It was he who crafted such a beautiful saga! How generous the Allfather has been to him!'"

cfa398d1-4b75-4cf1-ba55-35fcc6d35fb0.Text: {n}Ulfar shrugs.{/n} "I will go wherever and ask every person I meet, 'Do you know the face of evil?' Then I will find that evil and kill it. Until I find someone who kills me. If you want to seek me out, follow the bloody trail in the snow. And should you find my cold body at the end, do me a favour and give me a proper burial, Aett-Vater."

4ae263c6-e6f2-4fa2-997f-ac7703e8f322.Text: "Fenrys hjolda, Aett-Vater." {n}Ulfar bows his head solemnly and respectfully, an untold honour granted to a mortal who has impressed the Emperor's Angel with {mf|his|her} deeds.{/n}

e1d9f9ca-eb73-44ae-b55f-582e82c3a8dc.Text: "This only proves that we will not lose, Aett-Vater. Go into the foulest hole in the universe, where only lowborn and wretched inhumans crawl, fall into darkness, and then cry out, 'Who here believes in the Allfather, sisters and brothers?' And even there, in the world's most rotten pit, you will hear an answer, and if you reach toward the voice, you will find a worthy companion. Everyone who believes in him and follows in his footsteps is given the chance to become... someone greater and more worthy."

20b693c4-2b53-44c4-b3fc-f871250e22b3.Text: "Aett-Vater? Is your heart at ease? Does a dark foreboding gnaw at it? Just say the word, and I'll replace you at the head of the squad."

77e872c2-737c-4188-bc2a-e390c861cb2c.Text: "I would rather talk to him myself. My angry and vengeful heart tells me that only he knows how and why the Baleful Howl pack died. It also tells me that I will not forgive myself if that puffed-up arsehole Calcazar somehow dies before I rip the answers from his leering mouth."

1d2c4989-e4e0-4636-8c8c-916386aab3fe.Text: {n}Ulfar smiles, but it is a smile that belongs on a dead man's skull.{/n} "I will go as far as I can. Plunge into the darkest depths, into the lair of evil itself, and then... That is where my hunt will end so the hunt of the Beast can start. Do not follow me, Aett-Vater. Do not risk it."

e0f01589-2359-48c8-93bf-952feb2f6004.Text: "Permission to take off. We are heading to Epitaph."

1d5a5ddd-eefe-4386-a444-5b76e3a82c2f.Text: "I still need to say my goodbyes."

018b83d9-2c26-4ee7-b5d4-58fdd661cca0.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, the shuttle is ready for landing. We have the exact coordinates for a secure landing site. Will you authorise the start of the expedition?"

1bbb351e-fb2d-4161-917e-230b58fd3189.Text: "Acknowledged. Glory to the von Valancius dynasty. Be safe, Lord Captain."

954a4e2d-2a85-4925-8ddf-d411dce927b1.Text: "As Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} commands. We are standing by."

c2888246-33a3-453f-b836-4b3e64441b64.Text: "Lord Captain, the shuttle is ready and waiting for you. Would you like to launch the expedition?"

6838d8c1-8196-424c-baf8-ac67261dacf6.Text: "But your spirit stone was shattered. Should you die, Slaanesh will devour you in an instant."

35a55733-9cc4-45a6-9eec-31ce7b51971a.Text: "Our journey together has not been an easy one. But I am glad that both of us are here today."

6fdcff56-d17b-4f2c-a8f7-2fdd5c6b0f6a.Text: "Standing united against a common threat. Is it not what sentient creatures do?"

ead845ba-b1b0-49f5-9630-33204f067a7c.Text: "Will our paths diverge if we survive?"

d1daea58-e39a-4b95-bae9-3e5023d67fdd.Text: "Our fate will be decided in the coming battle."

badcbaae-6324-48b6-90f8-8e8897dfc3dd.Text: "{name}." {n}Yrliet's voice is soft and melodic, enveloping you with calm.{/n} "No matter what lies ahead, I will walk this path with you to the end. Such was my promise, and such is the will of my soul."

ce913157-a0f8-4a9f-aa65-abe64ee659c2.Text: {n}Yrliet looks at you, her emerald eyes shining with quiet determination.{/n} "When the Path my lost soul was following crumbled beneath my feet, shattered, plunged me into doubt... you were always there, elantach. Despite how much you hated my kind. Despite what my kin were doing. It is time for me to repay you in kind."

f0b4f732-21ce-4157-86a5-1b5a348abf0d.Text: {n}Yrliet folds her arms in a welcoming gesture and greets you with a meaningful nod.{/n} "Each journey has a beginning and an end, elantach. Here and now... Our journey leads into the maw of a merciless enemy. And only by breaking through the darkness ahead can we move on."

207bb30d-c2a1-4dd3-bae8-b976668ca5b1.Text: "I have a different role to play in this world." {n}Yrliet touches the spirit stone and smiles faintly and strangely.{/n}

6bf25816-85a6-4126-a7dc-15798d68e991.Text: "We are standing on the edge of a cliff, elantach. Darkness and struggle lie ahead of us, fear and doubts lie behind. I am ready to step into the unknown to end my journey and begin the next."

a2f132fe-f6d3-4680-aa7b-0537c6f6bdce.Text: {n}Yrliet turns pale, but her eyes spark with even greater determination.{/n} "Then I will survive, {name}. And I will do everything I can to keep you alive, too."

eabee442-54f2-495a-a5e9-68333b016917.Text: "As we walk down the road of thorns, we acquire not only scars but priceless treasures also. To know a stranger's soul, your own must shine just as brightly. I saw the light of your soul, {name}. It will drive away the darkness before us."

a85e23db-5031-42f0-9842-cd314420fcd2.Text: "We both defended what we held dear, just as life has taught us. And today my soul is at peace, for we can share the pain of the coming battle between us so it is diminished."

5d761f8e-f917-4bbd-9033-c3bbe0d90638.Text: "Our travels were full of heartache and countless hardships, elantach. And so the darkness ahead does not frighten my weathered heart. Nor does it frighten you."

8c81fc71-1ea8-46f0-8914-dcdd53540a60.Text: "True. A human and a Child of Asuryan... We will fight side by side like a pair of blades, and the enemies will fall before our fury."

b05efdd9-32e3-4d41-b441-1522aa23daed.Text: {n}Yrliet cocks her head in surprise.{/n} "I promised to walk your short human path alongside you, {name}."

a868eada-efa7-4fc3-9a6a-c62eb7a30d0c.Text: "Some day they will, elantach. Exile opened my eyes to many things, but the Path of the Outcast weighs heavily on my heart. I think... that I see my new Path clearly now. It sings to me, calling me forward — the Path of the Warrior, the protector of those I could not save before. All that I have learned about the world, about humans, about you... I will take this knowledge into my new life. And into the lives of my kin."

3d41da9e-482e-4aff-b64f-48566394833b.Text: {n}Yrliet shudders.{/n} "I do not think I will wish to return to my kin soon, elantach. Will I even be able to? Perhaps I will join you in your quest to explore the distant stars. Perhaps..."

3031547b-e4fc-462d-84be-2c372d9210a8.Text: {n}Yrliet averts her sad eyes.{/n} "I will look for those who are not ready to return to life on a craftworld. Those like myself. The future is too... vague. And my Path is leading me into the unknown."

1ed62480-a40a-4222-8b18-bcf0c075744d.Text: "Sometimes silence is the best answer. But is it really what you have come here for?"

7f93cfdd-6199-4ac8-b968-4afed23ee489.Text: {n}Yrliet's voice rings like naked steel:{/n} "I am ready to drive back the darkness, elantach. Are you?"

1d97d5cb-7a0d-437b-a0e4-930c67e2aeef.Text: The bloody streaks seem even more grim in the green subterranean glow.

f8ddc1b7-2080-4a1a-bf5f-efcdd12434ad.Text: A rotten, metallic scent wafts from the pool of dried blood.

1ae4e077-2990-4d81-853d-b4bd5913c302.Text: The blackened tracks of blood extend further, leading you into the depths of the corridor.

1ad81aff-8d4a-43d7-89d9-468d08c3e6fc.Text: This cogitator was installed here recently before it was destroyed by an unknown weapon.

a6e0e595-4303-4193-a2f6-ea9f901d8387.Text: The Inquisitor's soldiers are dead. Something unspeakable mutilated their bodies and dumped them together in a pile.

f255e23e-f0ed-4bd8-82ec-2b9249ac50bc.Text: A rotting corpse is slumped over the cogitator. What force could have thrown it?

250dce18-de0f-4633-a6f0-4b388d6af61a.Text: Military equipment and mechanisms for sacred machines. Everything is untouched.

d464a308-569b-4e48-999f-bbddf2a4a6cd.Text: Incomprehensible graphs and elaborate tables flash on the screen of the research machine one after another.

4ce44b36-62c4-45a1-b42b-c0fcba7592fa.Text: Looking at the unnatural glyphs causes your head to ache. At the press of a key, the vid-screen displays the following: "Status: Beginning data transmission to the sacred calculator. [missing data] ...Shunning the imperfections of the flesh, its transience, and its finiteness [missing data] the New, preserving a bond with the Old through rhythm, images [missing data]."

c43dcecc-9395-461f-b737-60575ccfef79.Text: The sight of the xenosymbols is repulsive, but your will is strong. At the press of a key, the vid-screen displays the following: "Status: Beginning data transmission to the sacred calculator. [missing data] ...Shunning the imperfections of the flesh, its transience, and its finiteness [missing data] the New, preserving a bond with the Old through rhythm, images [missing data]."

0d1a903d-014f-46a7-a942-eea4fcfd39fd.Text: The surface with the symbols trembles like rippling water, making you feel nauseated. The vid-screen awakens at your touch: "Status: Beginning data transmission to the sacred calculator. [missing data]... its finiteness, we have embarked on a new trajectory amid the stars [missing data] and symbols. Before existence [missing data]."

c0800073-9a2a-4338-af1e-9942eec8cab4.Text: The surface with the symbols trembles like rippling water, but it has no effect on you. The vid-screen awakens at your touch: "Status: Beginning data transmission to the sacred calculator. [missing data]... its finiteness, we have embarked on a new trajectory amid the stars [missing data] and symbols. Before existence [missing data]."

30b447ee-da75-45c4-831e-5fddaef919d9.Text: A roar bursts from the column, painfully assaulting your eardrums. The vid-screen awakens at your touch: "Status: Beginning data transmission to the sacred calculator. [missing data] ...and have become immortal. We have become [missing data] turns to darkness, it shall be conquered and it shall tremble in fear [missing data]."

2444a0e9-143f-495f-a3e6-78d399c98a6f.Text: The column emits a low roar, but you are able to withstand it. The vid-screen awakens at your touch: "Status: Beginning data transmission to the sacred calculator. [missing data] ...and have become immortal. We have become [missing data] turns to darkness, it shall be conquered and it shall tremble in fear [missing data]."

e977b7a7-9e54-466b-99f7-fd83018b321f.Text: "...Stars know that it is bestowed upon them to fade. Worlds know that is bestowed upon them to turn to ash at our coming."

a1a4eb6a-61d6-4628-8127-4053df080a3e.Text: "The living will be granted the communion of fear and suffering, the gift of destruction and its inevitability..."

55d9cb51-2c55-4bc4-ba34-0bcd854820b0.Text: "...Greatness will be beheld and known. Despair will be born and savoured. All verminous spawn will be eradicated in our wake."

c094facb-2b4d-4c45-8dff-2b880f2cd847.Text: "Their anger boils up in maelstroms in the void, the stars fade and die in the name of quenching their thirst, those who resist them turn to dust, the dictate of their will comes. Therefore we, Yekhmet, stand guard as the limit."

43eeaeb1-d2b7-4846-a4c6-92a09fab78bc.Text: The walls appear as if they were cast from a single piece of metal and seem impressively durable. It is impossible to gauge how many centuries have passed since they were built.

879ef3fb-d6e6-45b1-8c77-341b0ae5c2d7.Text: Barely perceptible heavy thrumming permeates the walls of the crypt, which are adorned with strange geometric shapes.

081672ec-ba8b-462b-b529-409afbdedf87.Text: The edges of the platform are twisted and melted. It appears to have been deliberately damaged by a powerful explosive.

91288914-a492-46b4-9ff1-af214e0134c0.Text: These censers were erected by Tech-Priests to ward off malicious xenos machine spirits.

b7edbab8-e25d-4d13-9abb-9d38f318405d.Text: The bodies of the Skitarii who accompanied the expedition. Judging by the thick layer of dust, they died long ago.

9e468df7-77de-4924-9ab9-c4f11f54b018.Text: The bodies of Skitarii, whose flesh and armour have disintegrated in various places. Judging by their wounds, they were shot during a hasty retreat.

c2fd2a0b-43d9-4a60-9073-023618f8d1db.Text: Judging by the debris, the passage was blocked on purpose.

e4a48733-6407-45b0-9d84-8abbcf07b54d.Text: The creature emits a low hum alternating with strange metallic screeching.

00e75009-fcbe-4490-a4f9-5cf7cd2cc993.Text: "The invasion has come to pass as foreseen. The impudent perpetrator must be destroyed. Rise, ye who have known slumber, and exact your punishment."

d9b45474-a2fc-4b19-af6d-e59b5a5509e6.Text: Beyond gratifying an inhuman's unnatural aesthetic sense, the purpose of this xenos structure is unknown.

253dce0d-2782-4fbc-be09-6b80b61159c5.Text: You are looking at part of a system of pylons used by small xenos repair machines to move around the crypt.

09c134e8-46d6-4adb-bdb8-ea3d91e985d2.Text: The creature is completely motionless, like a black statue. The dark metal of its body shows no discernible damage.

3def2bb4-32ae-435b-a588-11d5eb0aba1e.Text: It seems as though the dark hollows of its lifeless eyes could flare with the flame of ancient hatred at any moment, but the eye sockets remain empty.

a42da158-8a2a-4289-91c9-d09e294445f9.Text: All but buried under a thick layer of dust, these crates contain equipment still in prime condition. It is as though even in the face of death, the Tech-Priests would not dare offend the machine spirits by handling the equipment with anything less than reverence.

6bae068b-d629-41b6-85d8-1e1384168018.Text: [Give the vile slab a hearty kick]

dd092aba-110f-4590-ae14-65b4e7345224.Text: "They would be devoid of any difference, or they would not be reflections."

a91f7698-f827-486b-9830-53857acd1523.Text: [Place your palm on the Pestilence symbol]

45518b86-4192-4e9d-aa42-3671922c6aea.Text: [Place your palm on the Unravelling symbol]

a2303157-2aaf-4787-9a46-c0986b11bda4.Text: [Place your palm on the Malefice symbol]

60a3c724-02ca-4638-acf6-a221eb9e6711.Text: [Place your palm on a random symbol]

b877f8dc-7c09-4fa9-9481-b62c8f2269cb.Text: "No, for every mirror has its own defect that flaws the resemblance."

3fb6ed6b-9211-4d3f-9a14-d65bd2fe63f5.Text: "Eternity cannot be escaped, and therefore cannot conceivably be reflected."

9c1d3a2f-9f17-4e93-9a5c-7da34182c33a.Text: {n}The obsidian smoothness of the enormous slab begins to ripple and roil. A set of mysterious symbols appears on it, as if impressed on its black surface by an invisible finger. The three brightest ones are {d|Encyclopedia:Ch5_NecronKnowlege}symbols for "Malefice," "Pestilence," and "Unravelling."{/d} They shimmer forebodingly, like a martyr gasping for air as life drains from them.{/n}

896491fd-c29d-4ffc-8e08-76d9f70259a2.Text: {n}An inscription above them reads:{/n} "My Lord who hast known eternity, I heed mine guarding words that I spoke at the dawn of the wrathful stars! He who is condemned to torture by imprisonment must languish forever in the labyrinth of many dimensions, lest Their plagues befall us. A minute breach in the impossible prison would suffice for the spiteful will, the destructive thought incarnate in unperishing flesh, to obliterate existence. I lay my hand upon the vessel of the past, and I am revealed the doom that awaits one who breaks the commandments."

f5e47a48-0226-4680-b578-af4687ff0390.Text: {n}Wrinkling his nose in disgust, Ulfar asks,{/n} "Do you go poking your fingers in every kind of xenos filth you encounter, Aett-Vater, or have you just taken a liking to this? Would you like me to chop off that hand before something happens? It will be quick and almost painless. We'll choose a nice augment for it... No?"

60fc461f-ff5b-45c9-b6ee-7f2f2dd79b35.Text: {n}You clench your teeth and press your palm harder into the slab. The pain is but an illusion. You overcome it and let the second vision into your mind.{/n}

bc07f6c6-91d5-48a7-8d96-33c46962e69c.Text: {n}You cannot stand the pain anymore and jerk your hand out of the slab — unscathed. The flickering symbols freeze at once and begin to fade. The symbol for Pestilence is the last to disappear from the slab's surface.{/n}

fc323d64-3b2b-41d8-91e1-59f237dccfd5.Text: "My Lord, I am revealed the nature of the Unravelling: an interminable flow of unmanifested defects of my eternity incarnate. The world known to me is unidentical to the other worlds, nor is it one with them. The other manifestations, the unlikenesses, will wage wars upon me, seeking to absorb and thus obliterate me. I dare not lose my way and doom my eternity to perdition. I am firm in my memory that mine alone is the true eternity whose existence is rightful. I will shatter the mirrored unlikenesses."

c72bdae3-4af8-459d-9e93-ff74fa92bbd4.Text: {n}As soon as your palm touches the symbol, the slab's metal pulls it in, enveloping it like water. The text is transformed:{/n} "My Lord, I dare not divert my gaze from the guarding words! I am revealed the second plague, the Pestilence. It is not enough merely to behold it; I comprehend it, as my own lifeless shell learns the truth of its doom."

e0edd6ca-68d8-43a0-9048-425536b07e8f.Text: {n}The symbol you touched splits into three that are akin to it, similar and yet different from one another. A message materialises in front of you:{/n} "My Lord, Their third plague, the Unravelling, is beyond comprehension; therefore I put before myself a question bearing clarity."

722605c2-e745-40dd-9b2e-74b685051efc.Text: {n}One after another, new inscriptions appear on the slab's surface. They dash around maddeningly fast, overlapping each other. Amid this chaos, only one inscription latches onto your mind, causing it acute pain:{/n} "My Lord, in my measureless eternity, I remember Their doom. I am revealed the first plague, the Malefice: a wormhole that invades the very essence of thought." {n}Your vision goes dark.{/n}

b3a87ebe-306a-44d2-995a-5deb5ea31bd3.Text: {n}Reality cuts through the darkness of eternal sleep like a cold blade. You sense wrongness, and gain a clear understanding of the nature of that wrongness. Your engrams have been tampered with and damaged. You try to move, but in vain — you are buried alive in the metal crypt of your own body. Some of your fellows are faced with the same fate. Almost as soon as they emerge from their stasis sarcophagi, they freeze like mangled statues, tilt sideways, and collapse, crashing to the floor. Maddened legions march mindlessly past them toward a gaping chasm, and tumble obediently into its merciless maw.{/n}

74dc7d76-9ac8-45f0-be57-05d6a92e25b7.Text: "My thoughts are sparse, and they are erroneous. I know that the cascade of defects that is my Unravelling has already done its work of destruction. Woe is me."

df58bb1c-e274-40b0-869d-534ffeb16d5e.Text: {n}The slab withstands your anger stoically and continues its silent display of the same incomprehensible symbols. This calls for less barbaric methods of interaction.{/n}

ee352726-916d-4711-9211-c19d5b155a4b.Text: {n}As soon as your hand touches the symbol, new sentences start appearing on the slab's surface. They dash around maddeningly fast, overlapping each other. They seem to be trying to burn alien and unsettling messages into your mind. Discerning these messages, let alone comprehending them, is beyond you. Your nostrils are bleeding. The searing pain inside your head is like dead fingers digging their nails into your brain and trying to squeeze it out.{/n}

47315146-9832-471b-8141-d2e0c64d965e.Text: {n}You snatch your hand back in a hurry and look away. You feel nauseous. The sense of being invaded is gone, leaving only its horror behind: a horror you are not sure is your own and not forced upon you by the will of a different mind.
