That she herself ended up a captive only shows how nefarious and brutal these creatures are by their very nature. Whatever story she spun you, {name}, it was the height of naivety to believe it."

3a2d6b21-519d-4386-9b60-49f2ff91cd56.Text: "If I may be candid, I have certain... reservations about Ulfar. There is no question that he is one of the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusAstartes}Astartes{/g}, the divine warriors of the Emperor, and his help will be invaluable in our attempts to escape Commorragh. However, as Chapters go, the Space Wolves are extremely... distinctive. I can't reveal all that I know without breaking the prohibitions of the {g|Encyclopedia:Inquisition}Inquisition{/g}, but I'm asking you — be careful when dealing with the warrior."

d172c5d4-c7a0-4ab8-988f-8afc430a49e0.Text: "Once, when one of the miscreants broke free, those in command simply depressurised the bay and got rid of the culprit, along with the prisoners and crew tainted by him. But even after that, I heard the echo of inhuman suffering and terror that filled that part of the ship. It grieves me to recall that episode to this day."

3242c20e-c93c-4fee-9f52-e5278cb3b825.Text: {n}Heinrix stares at you without blinking. Then his mouth twists into a pained grimace.{/n} "By the Throne, {name}... why have you still not put the {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g} to death? First, treachery, and now the murder of an agent of the {g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Golden Throne{/g}. What will it take for you to act — a knife in your own heart?"

10b5ac72-7f9a-447c-888a-1d80e2f4e53a.Text: {n}Heinrix opens his mouth to say something, but in the end, he only nods, puzzlement on his face.{/n}

fb0e310a-9271-4891-9858-7020b1d4fe7b.Text: "I have finished healing my body. It doesn't hurt to move now. And it's a good thing too — not blinking is extremely drying to the eyes." {n}Heinrix's words are heavy with grim humour.{/n}

27231969-8f4f-45a8-a06f-217b859d8e89.Text: "Regrettably, little, {name}. Commorragh is the city of the {g|Encyclopedia:Drukhari}Drukhari{/g}, the sprawling xenos domain built in the very plexus of the {g|Encyclopedia:Webway}Webway{/g}. This is the home of their Kabals, and the launch point for their raids into realspace. The xenos' most supreme leaders dwell within the shadows of this place. And this is where the Drukhari bring their bounty — as they have brought us."

a6179ae0-65ce-4f05-9737-722ae3ead587.Text: {n}Heinrix considers the question.{/n} "I cannot offer a ready-made escape plan... but I do know that the {g|Encyclopedia:Drukhari}Drukhari{/g} are constantly vying and warring with one another — their chiefs take pains to keep their servants from complete mutual destruction. If you can find a way to exploit their personal feuds, we might have the faintest chance of survival... and an opportunity to slip away."

8a970380-b923-4218-82d0-78b2081f0f12.Text: {n}Heinrix's brow shoots upward.{/n} "Your concern for my... needs, Lord Captain, is extremely unexpected. Would you like to remedy my deficit of personal interaction? I would not be opposed to a pleasant conversation, if you can find the time."

4ad132e3-e5ff-4ae1-a02a-4d7668c9afe6.Text: "Do you actually want to hear what I have to say on the topic? Or was that just a polite turn of phrase that demands only an equally polite and insincere 'You are mistaken, Lord Captain'?"

9e291b53-9a38-495c-8ee6-324a035087d1.Text: {n}Heinrix's mouth stretches wide into a bloodless grin.{/n} "Then I will pour out my personal thoughts on the matter in my report to the Lord Inquisitor. That is, of course, if I ever get the opportunity."

edca3257-0839-44bc-99de-9bed2f6c7117.Text: {n}Heinrix closes his eyes, his expression that of someone holding back a wave of harsh profanity. Then he hisses out a breath through clenched teeth.{/n} "Worse."

db81963b-9823-4d2b-bdf5-1224a944c4c5.Text: "Yes, but not here. I wouldn't want our conversation to be gossip fodder on the bridge and in the officers' mess."

0804f0e8-0a2d-4f9d-867f-85d1830df60b.Text: {n}A dark and slightly crazed laugh burst from the Interrogator's lips. He breaks off after a moment, and proceeds to speak in a measured, icy voice:{/n} "Allow me to state the most likely version of events. The xenos Yrliet embarked on a plot with the xenos Marazhai. Achilleas discovered said plot and paid for it with his life. And afterward, they fed you this poorly concocted tale to exonerate the enemies of Humanity of wrongdoing."

125b3c87-76c4-40ef-8571-99c4ec284e53.Text: "What you should have done so long before now, {name}." {n}The Interrogator's eyes gleam with malice.{/n} "Nevertheless, if you keep your promise, I will be extremely... no, indescribably grateful."

5052cf4e-76d8-4422-ae88-1a1b4d785bd6.Text: {n}Heinrix looks at you for a few seconds, then gives you an almost imperceptible smile.{/n} "Perhaps. When we both find a suitable time."

422e6569-3e15-4fd1-8421-3f03efa824af.Text: "Hmm. Your equivocation is regrettable, Lord Captain. But I will await your decision."

f359f724-da20-48cc-8ab7-f507bd3d9549.Text: {n}Heinrix shakes his head and does not deign to respond.{/n}

d185da29-46b0-4115-9992-e2853fd313fa.Text: {n}Heinrix lets his head fall back and thinks for a few moments. Then he laughs spitefully.{/n} "The xenos Yrliet must not be enjoying her sojourn in her cousins' capital if she is eager to help her own victim. The irony."

7e1c8aad-d3b1-4817-92e1-9d269bdf72e8.Text: {n}Heinrix's eyes are fixed on you as if he is pondering something. At last, having made a decision, he says quietly,{/n} "Now that my mission is concluded, I can devote my time to other things. Such as that long-promised conversation with the Lord Captain."

4e643ed8-e666-4f7b-82a9-7266235be74f.Text: {n}The Interrogator's forehead creases momentarily before smoothing out again, his expression impassive as always.{/n} "Already done, Lord Captain."

ca21cf5f-7e5d-43eb-9749-e5144ebb9b75.Text: {n}Heinrix dips his head, smiling.{/n} "When you find the time, let me know."

970dc0f6-2f68-4a18-bfac-44e3b624a38d.Text: "No. First, I was accorded the status of a {g|Encyclopedia:Psyker}psyker{/g} fit for service in the {g|Encyclopedia:AstraMilitarum}Imperial Guard{/g}, where I then spent several years. It was only afterward that I became an agent of the {g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Golden Throne{/g}." {n}Heinrix stops there, clearly not intending to elaborate further.{/n}

2f92db48-a57f-42c0-89f7-540e7f72a12e.Text: {n}Heinrix looks at you intently.{/n} "You are agreeing to hand over the unsanctioned psyker to us?"

fcc39367-d0d4-4677-a434-f65efcc7a55f.Text: {n}A slight smile flits across Heinrix's face before being replaced by his typical stony expression.{/n} "What can I do for you, {name}?"

3849c695-2a0f-4e24-b01f-a61d14dfd84b.Text: {n}Heinrix leans toward you, his gaze filling with warmth.{/n} "You have my complete attention, {name}."

e4eead1f-eb09-4d7d-b97f-ebf99afc5c33.Text: "There are ways of breaking into her memory and extracting the secrets she is still keeping within herself. I will see to it that no secret escapes the grasp of the Holy Ordos."

0b0b5fbb-542b-4b1c-994c-55344651ff93.Text: {n}Heinrix's face is frozen in an impenetrable mask, as if you were looking at a stone statue, not a living man.{/n} "Lord Captain. I thank you for your assistance with my mission. Thanks to Rogue Trader von Valancius, the Inquisition has stopped the enemies of Humanity — even those hiding in its own ranks, on this occasion. I will no longer be making any claim on your time or resources."

150f21fa-fdbe-4c48-9782-638435ff8a62.Text: "This is not the first time — or the last, I fear — that I will cause the death of someone close to me. There have always been reasons for it. Sometimes the reasons are dictated by duty. Sometimes by my own personal volition."

f67e0b96-387f-45c6-bf35-e0c823a66142.Text: {n}Heinrix takes your hand in his and brings it to his lips.{/n} "You grant me too much mercy, {name}."

bf13b36b-414a-4cec-b8e2-22c9a3ad69bf.Text: {n}Heinrix looks at you without blinking.{/n} "Does that surprise you? It shouldn't." {n}Despite his icy tone, the spasms arcing across his face reveal his true state.{/n}

19f63821-cb0b-4f5d-80b8-5d89d1d3a9f0.Text: "I will remain part of your retinue, {name} — that will not change. I will continue to accompany you until I receive orders to the contrary from the Lord Inquisitor... if ever." {n}Heinrix's face darkens.{/n} "Who knows? Perhaps one day my journey will end like Emelina's. But that day is not today."

3b1e63e3-dfe3-437b-8d23-60449d3c8d9a.Text: "More than. The data we retrieved is already in the hands of the {g|Encyclopedia:Inquisition}Inquisition{/g} — in the custody of those who can extract the secrets of the future from the claws of {g|Encyclopedia:Chaos}Chaos{/g}. The {d|Encyclopedia:CompHeinrix_Rough}sacrifices{/d} made to the cogitator will not have been for nothing."

77ac123e-791b-4483-8bfe-c0760c1ed267.Text: "Emelina used the powers of Chaos to gain the upper hand against xenos. I touched a cogitator built by cultists to learn its secrets. None of us is pure. Xavier..." {n}Heinrix hesitates, and then resumes speaking, now choosing his words with extreme care.{/n} "The craven-hearted say that the career of every Inquisitor ends in either death or heresy. The Lord Inquisitor has borne this burden longer than any of us. It would be naive to think that he had only ever used puritan methods — and even more naive to suggest that such methods have in any way weakened his loyalty to the God-Emperor. And that is all I will say on the subject."

6c2bfed4-0632-4b9e-9ae1-11cb79396b4c.Text: {n}Heinrix dips his head, hiding a smile, and his voice drops to a heated murmur:{/n} "Then let's not waste any more time here."

4fdddeac-43c1-4114-bead-844e80097858.Text: {n}Heinrix's imperturbable expression instantly changes to something secret, dark, and harsh.{/n} "Thank you for your cooperation, Lord Captain. I will personally rid the universe of this carrion — just as soon as I have conducted a highly prejudicial and wide-ranging interrogation."

75dbaff3-9e64-49b0-8083-e7786f3b1b71.Text: {n}Heinrix leans forward slightly, his eyes intent on you.{/n} "{name}?"

542cad24-2bcd-4b8e-870f-bf306cf79995.Text: {n}An unreadable expression is frozen on Heinrix's face.{/n} "Is that... what you want, {name}?"

a793f68e-70c8-468c-9bc3-7c261f06cbc8.Text: "Games, you say? Well, then, I totally agree — games truly are a waste of time." {n}Heinrix's voice is tinged with bitterness, but his expression does not change.{/n}

b0d8214c-994e-493a-a7c2-18226e1d0af8.Text: {n}Heinrix stares at you for a moment, then looks away, saying nothing.{/n}

b1dbf693-712a-494d-aebf-8f36e813048f.Text: {n}A smile lights up his face.{/n} "I would very much like that, {name}. After you."

b3cd6f62-af67-4a61-8aba-917aa470f354.Text: {n}Heinrix gallantly inclines his head.{/n} "It would be a pleasure to acquaint you with all the intricacies of the game that I know of. Lead on."

9ac4345e-7798-491c-9cae-9ef5b84cc026.Text: "Of course. The {g|Encyclopedia:Fabricator}Fabricator-Censor{/g}'s machine was {d|Encyclopedia:CompHeinrix_Humane}stopped{/d}. Not another soul will be sent into the mouth of the {g|Encyclopedia:Chaos}Archenemy{/g}. In time, we will succeed in uncovering and stopping other schemes of the cult."

c2897045-8f9f-4f78-a8d9-debab485ef71.Text: "Mistress Heydari is a dangerous person, and dangerous people like dangerous things. Jae is probably partial to good weapons — she even has a small but enviable collection. Such a gift would not only be practical, given her perilous trade, but it would also show that you have taken an interest in her as a person and her tastes. Such demonstrations are very important when dealing with infor— people with whom you would like to curry favour."

cdadc182-fdfb-43a2-9eb3-5150e0ff401b.Text: "Yes. This is a conversation best had away from prying eyes and ears."

944d541d-0239-4132-9ee2-d39c8536bbf5.Text: {n}Heinrix sees you and straightens to his full height.{/n} "{name}. Let me pre-empt your question: you want to talk about what happened after the Magnae Accessio."

ae536c97-9f0e-4022-8e62-0405a96ab4f5.Text: "An explanation? Lord Inquisitor Xavier Calcazar deemed it necessary, after observing the new Rogue Trader von Valancius in a social setting, to have a private conversation with you. The lack of warning is used to dispose the subject toward a more direct conversation and less prepared answers. You, {name}, emerged whole and unscathed from the encounter — trust me, that counts as more than a happy ending to a conversation with my mentor. And you have been given a gift — an official demonstration of his opinion of you and your activities. I will struggle to find anything to add to that."

d7d4218e-4750-42a1-9a12-3e94ae8f93d4.Text: "We will not discuss this again. As I see it, the Lord Captain would do better to focus on {mf|his|her} immediate duties than to continue ruminating on what is past."

dc6336e8-4947-4666-8763-309526219a94.Text: {n}Heinrix raises a brow.{/n} "I'm glad to hear it. My fears that our conversation would take an unpleasant turn were not realised."

1ea0862f-be4f-44bf-93b3-cf88d94cce61.Text: "I cannot guarantee that the Lord Inquisitor will never again announce his desire for a face-to-face meeting with Rogue Trader von Valancius at his convenience. If that happens, the meeting will take place. And I presume the two of us will have another unpleasant conversation, in that case. I will be ready for it." {n}Heinrix's face shows nothing but icy calm.{/n}

65512a81-c3aa-4755-b72a-f7859cd18560.Text: {n}Heinrix's gaze thaws.{/n} "I'm glad that I... that my... I'm glad I was able to help."

b5ebd6f9-ac63-4d8e-a847-e29bd42990fc.Text: {n}Heinrix stares at you with what is a strange expression for him — he looks as if he has been cornered and pinned to the wall. Finally, he lets out a slightly shaky breath.{/n} "I... don't know." {n}He immediately winces at his own answer as if it physically pains him.{/n}

289dca75-f527-4d39-a1dc-88707cd53981.Text: {n}Heinrix's shoulders tense suddenly, and he shrinks away slightly.{/n} "If that is all..."

3336a9bf-2fbe-427b-b730-d0cb6b2aac81.Text: {n}Heinrix permits himself the ghost of a smile.{/n} "We dealt a blow not only to the cultists, but to the Archenemy itself. I cannot help but be pleased."

26938220-5542-43fc-b535-e4df83cdb520.Text: {n}Heinrix does not move a muscle, but looks you right in the eye.{/n} "Think of the power dynamics, Lady {name}. Such a display of 'initiative' by me in public would be interpreted by your subjects as an attack. Or an attempt to tarnish your reputation — but you couldn't care less about that, could you?"

44175f6b-b45b-434f-927b-3835c64aa654.Text: {n}The Interrogator falls silent, clearly irked by his unusually stilted speech.{/n} "I hope my answer has not hurt you. Now, with your permission... we will return to safer topics."

b4754640-16db-42f5-aacf-77dd73808a8c.Text: "Undoubtedly. And it is likely that my former colleagues will succeed in that purpose, sooner or later." {n}Heinrix smiles crookedly.{/n} "Don't count on them losing interest in destroying a traitor — I know I wouldn't give up. But you have nothing to worry about — I will do everything I can to ensure that when they come for me, you will not be harmed."

384f6e62-5098-4342-b266-0558685e92ee.Text: {n}Instead of answering, Heinrix takes your hand.{/n} "Stop worrying about my decision. It's not going to change. I will stay by your side — forever."

f6fbbcd7-d0f0-44a7-8817-03f6ce27464b.Text: {n}Heinrix says nothing, making no attempt to hide the bitterness on his face.{/n} "Accepting that is... unbearable for me. Scalander was a true citizen of the Imperium and a fine agent... and the worst part is that the moment he ceased to be either passed beneath my notice!" {n}The Interrogator closes his eyes, whether in shame or anger, you cannot tell.{/n} "I have no excuse for my offence against the Golden Throne."

4b70ee05-af6f-4a7f-8efe-d55f19d0acc2.Text: {n}Heinrix looks at you with undisguised fury.{/n} "The presence of a weapon of Chaos on board a voidship is heresy, and you try to justify it by claiming that your interest is purely pragmatic? It is precisely because of 'pragmatic interest' that people who were once loyal servants of the Throne become criminals. Your privileges are but a thin veil drawn over the sacrilege you have committed."

8e14add0-6662-49ec-bfce-2cf88d71a171.Text: {n}Heinrix's gaze seems to fall unbidden to the brand on your neck. His mouth twists in disgust, and his eyes radiate contempt.{/n}

9f14ecd9-53f7-468f-b8a6-c34e123be89a.Text: "{d|Encyclopedia:MiniJealousyRomanceBroken}It has come to my attention{/d}, Lord Captain, that you have formed a particularly close relationship with another member of the retinue." {n}Heinrix's voice is devoid of even a hint of its former warmth.{/n} "I wish you well in this new association. Now let us discuss other matters."

4a881bf6-8023-4e77-84da-60531f42d375.Text: {n}Heinrix lets out a dry chuckle.{/n} "If I were to summon a daemon or rain down fire on everyone's heads, we wouldn't be standing here talking right now. However, {name}, I took the life of a family member — in my opinion, that is more than enough drama."

823d0314-6d21-4ebd-a167-f8733560c986.Text: "Are you so certain that the cult has not spread its roots elsewhere in your domain? I fear I will have to remain a while longer, {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}. Besides, I am in your retinue not solely for the sake of my own mission, but also to serve as..." {n}Heinrix hesitates, reaching for the right word.{/n} "...an advisor sympathetic to your endeavours. I am under orders, I remind you, to 'provide escort and support in deeds great and small that serve to safeguard the territories of the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g} against its enemies.'"

2878f3ac-b227-4e91-a379-916b81a16b34.Text: {n}A furrow forms between Heinrix's brows.{/n} "By this declaration, if I understand correctly, you are stripping the {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g} of your protection as a Rogue Trader and delegating the fate of this enemy of Humanity to the {g|Encyclopedia:Inquisition}Holy Inquisition{/g}?"

49e7081e-167a-491b-bd4e-80b2cb65a50a.Text: "I received a report that you were attacked by some 'creatures from the shadows.'"

dc291fa0-0beb-4110-ae3a-822498eac209.Text: "I want to know what happened before you took me to Commorragh."

2ffdb2ea-e72f-437a-8f7d-2bfe079820eb.Text: "What were those creatures with you when you captured me?"

321482b4-e95a-46a3-9dc8-9ad4d7601818.Text: "I value good fighters. You are one."

f60cd96a-64ce-4b88-b8cc-c032a34787ac.Text: "I have something to discuss... something for your ears only."

bbeef904-81d1-4c8f-afe0-9811cc48afc3.Text: "You and Yrliet conspiring together — how did that come about?"

78d3e03d-afa1-4d34-a692-9a78d3358215.Text: "In what way do your kind differ from the Craftworld Aeldari?"

ec60a4a2-7b92-43b0-bb0e-3559ba816f54.Text: "What happened to you after the trial?"

2d020eac-0737-493f-a20d-4fa512ea35f0.Text: "What agreement did you make with Nazrakhei?"

1c41e02e-a9f7-4fd4-b6ba-c9f766f893b5.Text: "You lie. Drukhari cannot survive and escape the pull of Chaos except by feeding off the suffering of others."

e799f6e8-76f6-40a1-ab85-7ff14ce908f4.Text: "I cannot believe that Achilleas betrayed Humanity..."

57ec6192-90bc-4f10-b270-7568e82dda36.Text: "I require help to escape from Commorragh."

13e32863-fee8-4ae8-a3e1-0517b75d78cc.Text: "You must leave my retinue and my ship."

cbf881e0-c22c-4cc1-9db1-4ff30c309ca5.Text: "I wish to know more about your kind."

aeddbfc5-c13a-4ee5-89d6-bc71a5403514.Text: "I am. Leave my ship, or I shall have you thrown out an airlock."

1deaca41-eecc-4f2e-980a-a959070611c7.Text: "Your knowledge of Low Gothic clearly leaves something to be desired. I said nothing of the sort."

9f36ad33-5a84-4ece-86a8-697a901a1fbb.Text: "What did you hope to gain by agreeing to become a Proselyte?"

def77267-bc53-4ba9-bad6-771d75800e2a.Text: "You did not find much favour among the Wyches, it seems."

eb0c77f9-71b2-4ddc-ad16-5fda61df3d1f.Text: "Any thoughts on how we can escape this place?"

6b9096b4-2ebc-4cd1-b85b-cd5a894dd980.Text: "The theft of Rykad's sun — was that your doing?"

09c996d4-c099-4f88-9e59-dd77699c538b.Text: "You are from a Drukhari Kabal, correct?"

b48353c9-bdb7-4c9f-942a-6023665831e8.Text: "I wish to know more about the Wych Cults."

dbdc9a86-da09-4a36-a51f-f8ee8645ed21.Text: "I am interested in the Haemonculi Covens."

bd11f146-01de-4d45-ac3f-f5a0d81a4846.Text: "How is it that the great and terrifying Marazhai was only the Dracon of the Kabal and not its Archon?"

93afdb60-b5b0-4ca1-a952-974f789b8c61.Text: "The more I listen, the more it seems that, for a proud Drukhari, you very much enjoy submitting."

20703c86-9c3d-4dc6-97fc-15ba6424f608.Text: "You have numerous titles, I recall. Tell me about them."

6c949852-94a3-4e33-a02f-85543f32078b.Text: "You were the Dracon of your Kabal. What does that mean exactly?"

99bebdb2-6ecf-46c2-904a-67c2dde3ccf7.Text: "Nazrakhei and the Kabal of the Black Heart — what is their relationship to your Kabal?"

f948abf9-e82c-48fb-920b-039b82c42347.Text: "Your kind are obsessed with pain. Why?"

bc76b583-cfa9-4d36-8711-06ca6b482c85.Text: "What sparked the conflict between you and Yremeryss?"

1215da8e-8f7a-4dff-bf6f-69055a067556.Text: "After what happened on the officers' bridge, how are you coping with the warp crossings?"

2d811613-409c-439c-b9b2-f968062cb7ca.Text: "But still... what do you know about Yrliet's craftworld?"

05f781d6-6fb1-4dfa-9185-69b99e835912.Text: "Yrliet said that you feed on pain to save yourselves from Sai'lanthresh."

e7110ebc-ce90-466b-9c74-927cd5c14295.Text: "So, you had no intention of helping Yrliet?"

5012d277-685d-400d-b11a-036d3ce259ba.Text: "Well, at least she won't be upset now when she learns the truth."

f467a0e1-0dc8-45d5-9990-1e1a44576169.Text: "When given the chance to join me, you took it readily. That surprised me."

7575dee1-5a53-4de1-a4f6-bef7a146f31c.Text: "I wanted a pet xenos in my retinue."

49c4f26f-99dc-4722-befc-95f12307353a.Text: "I think you are just sadists and psychopaths, every last one of you."

826694d3-c3cb-4e93-88bf-e5f529acafed.Text: "I have been meaning to ask you... When offered the chance to follow me, you took it readily. Why is that?"

e7c9ec02-4f0c-4ae1-ada0-c8124565bb28.Text: [Do not pull away] "I would like to understand you better."

af11680c-5e21-45d9-b4db-5af578308afd.Text: [Squeeze Marazhai's wrist] "Submit? No. You will satisfy my interest — my every interest — whenever I demand it."

cc43053b-bf49-4f65-8481-5a33b109cd3d.Text: "What were you and Tazarra doing in my protectorate?"

168ff94d-4d46-4e8a-b244-163d9e93925a.Text: [Bat Marazhai's hand away] "Take your claws off me!"

403c4818-7a6b-4304-acca-4d26af9f0c37.Text: "I want nothing more to do with you or your sick fantasies."

971014bf-98de-4def-a80b-ca8cfab52a2c.Text: "Why do the Drukhari hide in the Webway? Why not live in realspace?"

e681faef-7c1b-44db-a83a-c00989ffcf23.Text: "What do you plan to do next?"

1be4a2ed-8094-40ea-a987-37ce52aabf1f.Text: "I wish to know more about you and your Kabal."

0fdd5c16-ef11-4480-b035-0c727ee380ef.Text: "No. Just — forget about what I said."

886afdb9-1269-439c-96e6-6f537f9c99cc.Text: "Enough. Not another word about what passed between us."

41ba3ee2-be12-4198-8bd6-dae61d4f5f19.Text: "Tervantias the Archmachinator. What is your connection to him?"

0bb976c8-ddaf-4e65-b537-fef9aa3a8929.Text: "Do you have any idea where his other lairs might be?"

1b85c823-236a-4e7c-b0d5-c0ea6eb50c10.Text: "When did you have need of his expertise?"

ea6d7d5c-9e36-491a-a217-743ebf784572.Text: "You call yourself a Trueborn. What does that mean?"

cd4d49ec-371a-463b-ad7b-b33e8f917d3e.Text: "You speak Low Gothic. Knowing your kind, I cannot believe that you learned it willingly."

03384a9c-5d2d-40d8-ba8a-bbab9f6a1e07.Text: "You made a promise to the Mandrakes that you cannot keep. Aren't you afraid of retribution?"

ccff1dbb-b5b5-414d-a782-6e52c0513e43.Text: "The tribunal — what was that about? I was being tried by the Inquisitor, and Heinrix and Theodora were there. Why?"

f2022662-e2aa-48d6-ae95-3c56217fff24.Text: "You have finally dealt with your last enemy. What is next for you?"

f9a22160-f211-470d-ab24-4ffbb3ebf83b.Text: "I demand an explanation, for one thing! What were they?"

c3d53eee-312d-4700-a6bb-ead9bb1925ab.Text: "The Mandrakes are still giving you trouble, hmm?"

f894f9dc-0263-48af-832c-463a3727d585.Text: "I keep hearing the name Asdrubael Vect... Tell me about him."

a99f5beb-3fea-4eb7-a7e0-1476e2236a70.Text: "My companions have made no further attempts to kill you?"

f1b3bbb8-3d9f-44c3-bad0-cea4bd956c66.Text: {n}Marazhai Aezyrraesh stares down at you from his formidable height, his head slightly tilted to one side. The lean, wiry xenos is encased in black armour — not even a sliver of a gap has been left between the tightly fitting plates, which bristle with mutely gleaming barbs and hooks. Set in a white face striated with crimson tattoos, dark eyes devour you, burning with predatory, malevolent interest.{/n}

890b3e2e-ad70-46dd-a6d6-f241779013a3.Text: {n}Marazhai narrows one eye.{/n} "You want to know how and to what end I orchestrated all of this, {name}? Ask your questions."

1baac0b6-a0a6-4ea1-8fbd-4eeb11025b70.Text: "{name}." {n}Marazhai stares at you unblinkingly, observing your every move.{/n}

e6782688-be6c-48c4-8a54-0a51cdf352cd.Text: {n}At the sight of you, Marazhai cocks his head in an almost bird-like motion.{/n} "{name}."

5d97c5b7-b890-482e-8c13-47120febf96d.Text: "What exactly do you want to know?"

a605556c-63b3-4109-952c-8fc9f9107d87.Text: "How the information was reaching his agents, the burned mon-keigh himself did not even know, but based on the units involved and other details it was clear: no mon-keigh in realspace could have gathered such specifics about raid complements and objectives. No, it was inconceivable. The information was being fed to you by my own kind. And I knew who. Yremeryss Aezyrraesh, Archon of the Reaving Tempest, my former mistress. A cowardly bitch who punishes anyone who threatens her grip on power. I knew that to win a war against her I would need the support of the Reaving Tempest's patron — the Kabal of the Black Heart. So I allied with Nazrakhei, who presided over the trial. I promised him that Yremeryss would be humiliated. I promised him evidence — a lowly mon-keigh that would disgrace Yremeryss in the eyes of the Archons. For that performance, I needed you."

9631ce19-5f1c-4e40-8bf0-15bbe69c5e07.Text: "Eviscerator of Illiridos, Blaze of the Barkhag Kingdom, and Slayer of Carrocius the Pale... Illiridos was a world inhabited by our distant Aeldari cousins — until I led a reaping raid there. The Barkhag Kingdom was a separate cluster on the fringes of Commorragh before it went to war with the Reaving Tempest. And by the time I left, I was wading through the blood of its inhabitants."

4f930af8-da92-4515-b045-b68722d5f1ad.Text: "The Dracon is the first among the blades of the Kabal of the Reaving Tempest, and the Drukhari who stands but one rung below the Archon. The Dracon leads raids and wages wars against other Kabals, keeps the arrogant Trueborn and half-born upstarts at bay, and has the pick of any opponent in any battle. Yremeryss used to have others in her inner circle... but I ensured that they all disappeared, one by one, and that their successors were too terrified to take their place. That was when my sister engaged an Incubi Order to serve as her bodyguards. Incubi... do not respond to fear or bribes."

59e68b11-981d-4e31-8902-37688e769df2.Text: {n}Marazhai's face breaks into a smile.{/n} "When a mon-keigh is left alone with me and my art of pain, I plunge them into a deep well of suffering from which they will do anything to escape. Your kind have fragile souls. Your convictions and principles are a delusion that lends a mirage of meaning to your lives. Achilleas and I had plenty of time alone together before your arrival. When he went out to meet you, he was already mine. I bought his loyalty with a promise — to never touch his body or his mind ever again."

39be141f-48a8-4923-a497-65b774604ed7.Text: {n}Marazhai leans down toward you, interest smouldering in his eyes.{/n} "And what is it you want to talk about, {name}?"

27bfc68b-b06b-4173-8469-0bdf0b9c3a78.Text: "Conspiring? No, no. There was no plot between us — she merely rushed to my bait. At first, I planned to use the one you trusted — the burned mon-keigh with whom we had spent long, long hours awaiting your arrival. But my cousin was so swift — afterward, she tracked down the mon-keigh, killed him, and took the device that he had been using to contact me."

fd289457-d38c-4eea-97bd-017899376e8e.Text: "When Yremeryss ordered us to lay waste to the mon-keigh settlements, Tazarra and I encountered resistance. I have hunted your kin too long not to notice how well you in particular were fending off our attacks. The rout in Tazarra's arena, the appearance at the plundered vessel... your kind are usually powerless against us, but not on that occasion. I began to suspect that you could not have managed it without outside help. Help from our side."

7091967b-128b-4c5b-8ce8-52b50de54913.Text: "I had no intention of ending my days playing the role of meat in the arena. And then you..." {n}Marazhai leans in and locks eyes with you.{/n} "You blithely offered me an alliance. After what I had done to you... Why?"

f464c6bf-5daf-403d-b8e8-590ed9d49ac4.Text: "Because the ecstasy of suffering is the highest form of pleasure, accessible only to superior beings. By your very nature, creatures like you are incapable of knowing such gratification."

4c976e18-9995-4255-b5b7-2b13a9394343.Text: "Overthrowing an Archon is far from easy, even one who has already tarnished her reputation. Every member of a Kabal has their supporters, and Yremeryss is no exception. Nazrakhei promised me a sham trial in the Obsidian Court with a predetermined outcome. Yremeryss should have been convicted and dethroned. I was supposed to take her place and turn the Reaving Tempest into a loyal vassal of the Black Heart."

c44ff4e5-7e99-46c8-af7f-7283b2a910d9.Text: "They have not. To my deepest regret. Perhaps it is I who should try to show some initiative now." {n}Marazhai smirks at his unvoiced thoughts.{/n}

8880efcb-2a15-4ee4-aac5-90f21285565d.Text: "I planted the first poisoned seeds in her soul back at our first meeting. I dropped a hint that I knew what had become of her world. I lured her in... and left her with you. Time took care of the rest... that, and an unpleasant discovery aboard your own ship."

024b0047-d9fb-4a60-9211-d3692ef227e4.Text: "She told me what she had seen in your chambers... a piece of her home, destroyed, twisted beyond recognition, reduced to a trophy on a wall! Yes, that was the breaking point for her. The final drop in a deep well of doubt, dispelling her naive trust of mon-keigh once and for all... And then she came seeking answers from her dark cousin."

848142aa-f86b-49e7-8699-13020c424f3c.Text: "I did not ask her to hand you over to me — no, doing that would have made my poor cousin doubt herself even more than she was already. I simply told her where to seek out the traces of her craftworld, and the answers to her questions — a favour for a kinswoman, nothing more. And then I made ready for your arrival, for the only way she would reach that place was with you."

4da5248a-6cd0-44e6-828f-e64d3f4d8cdf.Text: "Mandrakes... a foul breed that lurks in the bowels of Commorragh. Their ability to find paths through the shadows was put to good use. I promised them forbidden trophies from the Reaving Tempest's coffers once I am Archon..." {n}Marazhai hesitates and then gestures to indicate that he is finished speaking.{/n}

84864037-1f85-4c88-9ee2-98d8ae4272a4.Text: "I was handed over to the Wych Cult to do with as they wished. First they made me fight the dregs in the arena, and then, once they had had their fill of my debasement, I was granted entry into the Bloodstained Proselytes."

fe25dda4-b22d-403d-bbd0-7d004654357b.Text: {n}Marazhai's mouth stretches into a grin.{/n} "You tried to acquire a pet once already — and how did that go? Surely you do not think that your imaginary leash, which failed to restrain Yrliet, would succeed in holding me?"

a2e5b177-4fe8-478b-abc6-6b6939da2818.Text: {n}Marazhai's lips stretch into a grin.{/n} "We will see which of us submits more readily to training."

64c23143-f6cc-4819-b955-f88a4cbdf8a7.Text: "The Kabal of the Black Heart is the most ancient of all the Kabals. And the largest. It casts a shadow over all Commorragh, and when the Black Heart strikes, you submit or you die. The Reaving Tempest was not prepared to perish, so when the Black Heart's shadow stretched as far as us, Yremeryss's predecessors chose to bend the knee and become their vassals."

6a0f4b04-4d7b-4c1b-b57a-0ec7e4facfcc.Text: "In all ways. The Asuryani are feeble shadows of our ancestors — we are their true inheritors. The Asuryani hide from She Who Thirsts behind their Paths, relying on the visions of their precious Farseers, who are blind to the reality around them. We Drukhari laugh in the face of the unknown — we thrive off the carnage and pain we inflict."

8c6c8c7c-822a-4fb7-916b-729b79b49e09.Text: "The continuation of my existence. When I lost my standing, I became fair game for anyone tempted by the prospect of slaying a disgraced Kabalite — for vengeance or just for the pleasure of the kill. In Commorragh, a lone Drukhari is a target. My talents may be prodigious, but I hold no illusions about my chances."

2e58a2a5-1b47-4d0e-b9b0-922220cf4d33.Text: {n}Marazhai's smile turns vicious.{/n} "You are such a poor liar, {name}."

bbebe82d-e265-45e1-a941-60b80b0e426b.Text: "You cannot hope to understand the intricacies of Commorragh and how it is structured, {name}. We are all each other's allies and worst enemies here, towers of strength and duplicitous traitors both. The Cults have always been half a step below the Kabals in the hierarchy, and the Wyches relished the chance to abuse someone who once looked down on them."

c474cf0d-6c40-432c-a819-47a73182000c.Text: "If our conversation is finished..." {n}Marazhai impatiently clicks his fingers.{/n}

70fd1843-b86e-4471-bacf-b7933c0b5b83.Text: "Now that I have gained a foothold in realspace, I must find a way to win back my Kabal. Yremeryss is dead and the Reaving Tempest will be torn apart by Commorragh... But if they allow themselves to be slaughtered, I will feel no particular pity for that worthless scum."

1f11bfdd-261b-42b1-b18e-afa14c6c620c.Text: "On a mountain of bodies, bathing in our enemies' tears and blood." {n}Marazhai licks his lips.{/n} "Do not deceive yourself by thinking we will escape this place alive without violence. I, for one, hope that there will be plenty of it."

d7749e53-d166-4970-8bcb-54521906a78f.Text: "But there is one unfortunate detail. An Arebennian has stepped into your path — one of Cegorach's tribe, who lurk in the tangle of the Webway. I have heard them called Harlequins in your tongue. The one that appeared in the Obsidian Court is the most dangerous and unpredictable of all. I am beginning to think that his visit is a sign that the events unfolding around us have not been left to chance. Perhaps they are the result of interference... at the behest of the highest authority."

820f6c9c-d51a-4ca9-8151-3aa85c445403.Text: "I had no part in the stealing of any sun, {name}. But can I guarantee that it was not the work of Kabalites acting on the orders of other leaders within the Reaving Tempest?" {n}Marazhai frowns.{/n} "No. I cannot speak for Yremeryss and her minions."

4d70acd0-2878-414a-91ca-b339915c3283.Text: "Do not keep me waiting too long, {name}. My weapon is tired of languishing in its sheath."

77a48193-acc1-408f-ae71-06bf333409e6.Text: "And also..." {n}Marazhai runs his clawed fingers along your cheek, leaving bloody gouges.{/n} "I have not finished with you yet. No, not by half."

f2605949-f214-48bf-9c2a-28f0ac85f088.Text: "The Dark City is the bastion of the Drukhari, the most magnificent of all our strongholds. The Kabals, Wych Cults, and the Incubi inhabit the place, with swarms of Scourges flying overhead, and a myriad of misfits and horrors, including the Covens of the Haemonculi, wallowing underfoot. Which do you want to know about?"

79752d53-3976-411c-92b4-069836f59486.Text: "And lastly, Carrocius the Pale... He was an ancient Haemonculus who betrayed the Aezyrraesh at the behest of another Kabal. That was not a military victory but a personal one. In his attempts to make himself invincible, Carrocius had sewn inside himself the deadliest creatures from the depths of Commorragh. It did not save him — I cut out every one of his eight hearts and sent them to his former Coven as a warning to the rest."

0f6c5820-f590-45dc-a872-62334e6d3a52.Text: {n}Marazhai licks his lips. Then he smirks.{/n} "It was a punishment. One of my raids was... not as successful as it should have been, and Yremeryss ordered Tervantias to forcibly implant the knowledge of the repulsive mon-keigh language into my mind — supposedly so that I could at least benefit the Kabal by coaxing the mon-keigh into their cages. Five days I spent under a cerebral burner in the spire's main hall, to the delight of Yremeryss's entourage. I dislocated every joint struggling in agony against my shackles — but I would endure it all again to expel this poison from my head."

2bdd870d-ec97-45fe-af74-68a4c0ec8df9.Text: {n}Marazhai nods, his eyes boring into you.{/n}

26294739-43bc-4d13-9a12-2010140421b6.Text: "The Kabals are the foundation upon which rests the power of the one who rules Commorragh — Asdrubael Vect. Whether it is a mob of berserkers or an organised cartel, their essence is the same — an army of killers ready to ravage entire worlds at the behest of their leaders, or to rip out the throats of a neighbouring Kabal in a war declared by the Archons."

d6d505de-5ea3-4093-a030-3968dc4a8d2a.Text: "The aloof Incubi... they dedicate their lives to the art of killing, so much so that they do not plot or chase after delicious torment. All their hatred and longing for suffering are channelled toward perfecting their skill."

a168fa1d-a358-4093-baf1-ff24fa6fb7df.Text: "Winged Drukhari who have chosen to go through an agonising process to become such a monstrosity. They escort raiding ships and inflict the first strike on the enemy. In Commorragh, these creatures huddle in flocks so that they do not fall victim to the more formidable of their kin."

31136748-7660-4d79-a59d-468e144ac5dc.Text: "What more do you need to know that you have not already beheld with your own eyes? They are the mistresses of the arenas, and they are the gladiators who feed the audience, in their ravenous agony, with exquisite spectacles. Cults often travel to realspace on the Kabals' raids, to revel in the pain and to capture fresh meat for their arenas."

826e52ff-ab0b-4b67-abc4-2b5b9c259f8e.Text: "Artists of the flesh who prefer to hide away in their laboratories and create nightmares from the materials their servants supply. Engines of Pain, Grotesques, Wracks — all are the fruits of their subtle craft."

19ffafa0-8698-4153-abcf-69daad4c396b.Text: "Are you sure?" {n}For a second, the corner of Marazhai's mouth quirks upward in a sneer.{/n}

4048d7f9-bb10-4491-ba01-1cb1d1dc9a39.Text: "Yremeryss never liked the Kabal's subordinate position. Her words, and sometimes her actions, directed against the Black Heart prompted whispers of discontent and fear among those who served her. I was not willing to renounce the protection of Asdrubael Vect's own Kabal — if I had succeeded in overthrowing Yremeryss with Nazrakhei's aid, many within the Reaving Tempest would have supported me."

e9e0d70b-f100-4f1f-913a-680e5d8b0550.Text: {n}Marazhai's eyes narrow and he stares at you for several seconds as though he is trying to bore a hole right between your eyes.{/n} "An amusing example of a primitive mind... Any Drukhari towers over any mon-keigh, and we do not conceal our attitude to livestock. But my Kabalite kin? Every one of them should be treated with caution, and those who have already demonstrated their power and might are a deadly threat in their own right. I do not revel in submission — I accept things as they are. And I wait until a point of weakness reveals itself and calls to my blade."

1f833a8a-6614-419f-9185-f1cdba30ae8c.Text: "Farkaza Aezyrraesh, Poisoner of Asdruzhar and Shaimesh's Elect, was one such exalted leader of the Drukhari. The result..." {n}Marazhai casually waves a hand, inviting you to admire his person.{/n} "...was worth the effort."

7b15e2ab-c44c-41b1-98b0-8ee2140a4a8d.Text: "What do any of my kind do in realspace, {name}? We were reaping. Commorragh was clamouring for meat — the Dark City had suffered losses in the latest dysjunction. We needed sources of sweet pain to prime its minds and bodies. When the Archon bade my Kabal collect the harvest from the region, I did not suspect that it would turn into this game between you and me."

204f058a-93dd-4363-b9a8-04c8afa49a78.Text: {n}A subtle shift occurs on Marazhai's face, as if a shadow has just fallen across it.{/n} "No. No one speaks of the overlord of Commorragh without good reason. Amusing you is certainly not reason enough."

cc83bdd2-7bdf-4dfd-a006-bb79a8305ab2.Text: {n}The dark, devouring eyes gleam with interest.{/n} "Ask your questions. I will decide which is worthy of an answer."

c4ec7a71-e2b4-46e9-a64f-aeb48867d921.Text: {n}Marazhai looks away from you.{/n} "Then go, {name}. I will find something to amuse myself with."

43ad75b1-5893-4e2c-959f-ffc4d40dadbd.Text: "Must there be another reason beyond survival and ambition? Commorragh does not tolerate weakness. Commorragh respects only strength and cunning. Either you climb upward on the corpses of your enemies, or you become one of the steps underfoot."

154652de-b8e1-4136-a043-095248cfee64.Text: "Since the first time, I have been slowly acclimatising to voyaging through the veil. Only mon-keigh could have conceived of such a suicidal method of galactic travel. However, it is novel. And exhilarating." {n}Marazhai waves a hand.{/n} "At least now I know what I am facing. And consequently, I will find a way to withstand it."

fc735077-5198-434d-8a62-014a5b5a0246.Text: {n}Marazhai's mouth stretches into a wide, feral grin.{/n} "Careful, {name}. My tolerance for such remarks will run out eventually — even given your depressingly simplistic mind and non-existent instinct for self-preservation."

e20fce21-a052-4c46-b166-ce2b69d07238.Text: {n}Marazhai laughs.{/n} "The words of a feeble cousin from a breed accustomed to blaming all their woes on forces outside their control. Do you want the truth, or the lie the Asuryani tell themselves as they teeter on the edge of extinction?"

8585bba5-5722-4fe6-b7d9-0f85fea4f461.Text: {n}Marazhai smirks.{/n} "You saw to it that {d|Encyclopedia:CompMarazhai_Free}not one of my wishes would be refused{/d}. Your crew sense my power over them and fear me — I bathe in their terror every time I set foot on the bridge. Good. Livestock should know their place."

5dce99ac-8d90-4644-b1f3-afc43c155d25.Text: {n}Marazhai's lips curl into a smirk.{/n} "You granted me {d|Encyclopedia:CompMarazhai_Compartment}territory{/d}... not the kind I am used to, but more than enough to keep me occupied while this tub cuts through the veil. Your crew know which sector of the ship belongs to me... and, apparently, they have designated it a dumping ground for rule breakers. It does not matter. Their screams all sound the same."

254e54ef-4757-485a-a99b-0330ba8e93a3.Text: {n}Marazhai glowers at you.{/n} "You dare to ask me that question, {name}? Every time this barge pierces the veil, I am {d|Encyclopedia:CompMarazhai_Locked}left alone{/d} with all the nightmares of She Who Thirsts. It costs me all my fortitude and strength to fight them off... and there is never anyone at hand with whom I can indulge myself — only cold walls and a sealed airlock!"

8bef0329-750f-4b97-ab8e-124b64fa3f89.Text: "I know it exists. I know that my Kabal found it, helpless and stationary, unable to protect its sons and daughters. I know that Yrliet's kin began showing up as prisoners in the Reaving Tempest's spire, where they were founts of exquisite, delightful pain. I spent too much time beyond the limits of our home to learn more than that... but that was enough to tempt Yrliet with false hope."

839fb8d8-8c63-4cf3-a8ea-3deacb0071bd.Text: {n}Marazhai lets out a strange half-cough, half-laugh.{/n} "A slip of the tongue, surely? It almost sounds as though you are attempting to get rid of me."

1c04d633-bcf2-4541-bab6-4b0900819fe3.Text: {n}Marazhai laughs long and deeply.{/n} "Why do you say that? I promised to reunite her with her kin. A long-awaited reunion in a torture chamber — I find that... very touching. They would have had so much to discuss, but there would have been time for fun as well — we cousins get together so rarely, after all."

995a48c3-afc8-4ea7-b1fc-41aa9762d76c.Text: "We have already had words, {name}. I have no reason to conceal the truth now — Yrliet has outlived her usefulness to me. Watching her face as she learned the truth was priceless."

deaaa07a-b616-40bd-baac-e48fb9c1a275.Text: "No, she will not. You were kind enough to get rid of her before my words shattered her fragile little heart."

aa718a73-567e-47fe-845d-65cb9cff16ce.Text: "I intrigue you? An interesting turn of phrase." {n}Marazhai leans even closer and reaches toward you, grasping your chin with his clawed fingers.{/n} "You are not afraid of me, but... intrigued by me? Well. Perhaps I will deign to satisfy your curiosity. If you submit to me."

61225c47-f6c2-45e5-ad88-16fcb9110ff4.Text: {n}The Drukhari's gaze turns murderous. He seems ready to lunge at you... but at the last moment, he looks around and stops himself.{/n} "Pray to your carrion lord that our paths never cross again, mon-keigh."

df9b06b1-45f4-496d-8dbc-a494253d89c3.Text: "Watch it, {name} — it is mon-keigh who run and hide, not our kin. Commorragh is the legacy of our ancestors. They found a way to penetrate the tangle of the Webway and move through its twisting labyrinths. Few would hazard to travel in this splintered kingdom, let alone erect bastions in it. The Drukhari are the only Aeldari who do not fear the horrors of the Webway, for every peril we overcome makes us stronger."

2bcef11a-a9c0-471f-b17c-39d98fe12b9a.Text: "Hmm. A spur-of-the-moment decision, I think. Temptation got the better of you, did it? You ought to consider your actions more carefully, {name}."

1d22f677-f67f-4767-a823-2dce8f5595e4.Text: "My good, obedient little pet..." {n}Marazhai looks at you from beneath his lowered lids.{/n} "I will find a way to enlighten you... and to take pleasure in your education."

a71714b3-cc6c-4b2d-8026-d3c8608ab8da.Text: "Did you not hear me when I answered you the first time? I do not like to repeat myself."

9c295988-247b-4e4e-b356-c0bbab3b75dc.Text: {n}Marazhai lets out a barely audible gasp, and you cannot tell if his surprise is real or feigned.{/n} "Ah, a connoisseur of power in all its hues? Then..." {n}In a single move, he twists his arm out of your grasp and looks at you from beneath half-lowered lids.{/n} "You have made yourself clear, {name}. This could be... interesting."

883433ac-a8b8-4570-af35-abd4ea8ec722.Text: {n}The Drukhari holds his head slightly higher, staring intently into the distance.{/n} "If they come calling again, they will be given the same welcome that I gave them before. So, temper your fear — the Mandrakes are only interested in getting to me, and I know how to deal with unwanted visitors."

2d8dce6f-308f-4acd-9f20-9820984cb7f0.Text: {n}Marazhai pulls away with a chuckle.{/n} "Then stop saying things you do not mean, {name}. It is dangerous for your kind."

921c72d5-df6a-4311-8ae2-934d34f03f12.Text: {n}Marazhai glances around the bridge. For a moment, you think you detect uncertainty in those mocking eyes.{/n} "I... must adapt to my new circumstances. And to this bucket that you mon-keigh call a voidship. These alloy bulkheads... so primitive..."

db62e461-ad78-42aa-8767-db58e8ead814.Text: "To present myself at the meeting place with what remains of the Reaving Tempest. I am overcome with curiosity — is it a trap? Or are my former vassals so desperate that they are really playing in the open? Hmm... We will see."

41240987-2c2e-4f51-ac36-3196d6966361.Text: "This concept of 'next' is useless here. When the time comes, I will return to Commorragh and {d|Encyclopedia:CompMarazhai_Archont}claim the Archon's throne{/d}, the seat that is mine by right. But for now... for now I will remain here, by your side. I sense much blood and suffering to come — it would be a shame for me to miss it."

7adb94a6-986a-4851-a536-076e41fa352f.Text: {n}Marazhai shrugs.{/n} "The Kabal is as good as dead... and {d|Encyclopedia:CompMarazhai_Corsair}everyone who wanted me dead{/d} has perished along with it. Now that I am no longer being hunted by assassins, I am free to choose my next steps." {n}The Drukhari makes a pensive sound.{/n} "It is a strange feeling. I will grapple with that later, but for now, new blood and fresh suffering await us. I would hate to miss all the fun."

c45ecd38-f84e-4402-974a-f55a5bece65d.Text: "Then what else do you need to know?"

adb26f9d-9cd1-4e6b-9bed-175857fe2e73.Text: "Hmm. An amusing explanation of something you cannot hope to understand. But a predictable one."

dd9ad9ba-9445-43cc-bdb3-9b0cd6f6d8af.Text: "Huh. You abandoned that topic very quickly — why am I not surprised?"

bcc24321-4d49-4e2a-b696-70266ceb57c7.Text: {n}Marazhai clicks his tongue.{/n} "It was the Mandrakes that I used to get to you before — creatures from the depths of Commorragh. They thought they could ambush me here, on this barge of yours. I taught them a painful lesson. I carved the symbol of Aezyrraesh on one's throat and hurled it back into the shadows — to serve as a message to whoever dares to come for me the next time."

4ac0f755-6d4c-4f04-ad18-c5aafe01e2ec.Text: "It is a caste in Commorragh. Noble Drukhari born under certain circumstances — their cradle before birth was not an amniotic gestational tube, but a living womb. Carrying a foetus for such a lengthy term is as good as a death sentence for a female Drukhari — she is too vulnerable to her enemies' attacks and she is of no use on a raid. In Commorragh, only the most powerful Drukhari, who are able to surround themselves with the best protection, can allow themselves such an extravagance."

8bf3fb08-ada3-4e6c-ba53-0e36698733b1.Text: {n}Marazhai sounds sincere, but it is clearly his truth that he is speaking. Something in his face makes you think there is another reason why the Drukhari race chose such a tumultuous dimension to be their home.{/n}

6576c380-2aa9-4213-8f99-ebbea51caaac.Text: {n}Marazhai speaks unhurriedly, almost lazily, and with poorly concealed pride.{/n}

04602e77-1253-4bc3-aacd-d00975380e52.Text: "And now it is time to learn what is happening with the Kabal of the Reaving Tempest, leaderless and abandoned to the mercies of Commorragh. Hmm... the survivors will probably be driven into realspace to fall prey to Sai'lanthresh... {name}, you must find them. If we encounter the remnants of the Kabal in this dimension, I will want to speak to them."

bfa2ff54-7176-4299-8e17-cec6162d96e7.Text: "We shared the same blood and we emerged into the world from the same womb. We were both Trueborn, and we both stood above the scum that comes from tubes and vials."

08031abc-ff87-4b0a-928f-f73d2ba415a7.Text: {n}Marazhai narrows his eyes.{/n} "Keep your arrogance in check, {name}. Yremeryss was clever and deadly, and if I had underestimated her abilities and strength, I would have been food for the ur-ghuls long ago. The very fact that she surpassed me speaks for itself. I refused to give her cause to cast me out as a traitor. No, our rivalry, our little game that ran since our birth, took time. And another thing... when you are at the top, you need something to stave off boredom. This game amused us and terrorised the rest of the Kabal."

7961aea8-b3ee-4e16-9b14-60c677da1017.Text: {n}Marazhai's lips stretch into a smile and he beckons indolently at you.{/n} "Come, my little pet. I see how your desire to be near consumes you."

98133ba9-6c8c-488f-917c-df7365779837.Text: {n}Marazhai lowers his head at your approach. The corners of his mouth lift in a smile full of promises.{/n} "I and my attention are yours, {name}."

0b3d2a43-8e6d-4fff-8a06-6fce9c0d9aa7.Text: {n}At the sight of you, Marazhai's eyes flare.{/n} "What do you crave, {name}?"

3284170d-b9a0-405b-96d8-c28faf5e3905.Text: {n}With an enraged hiss, Marazhai whips back his arm as if to slap you — and then, by an incredible force of will, restrains himself and lowers his arm.{/n} "Mention the word 'pity' to me once more, {name}, and you will bitterly, bitterly regret it. Our conversation is over."

7204b806-adbd-466a-813f-cfcfffb6fbbd.Text: "I began sending out spies and assassins. My eyes and ears infiltrated your vessel, your cities, and they discovered a trail that led back to one of your worlds. A trail that ended with a burned mon-keigh — the source of the information about where and when my Kabal was going to strike. A little trickery to draw you away from the planet..." {n}Marazhai waves his hand.{/n} "...and I had your little informant in my grasp."

d4487c0c-3b51-4520-bd42-85af72374207.Text: {n}Marazhai glances at you.{/n} "Hmm. That is true. But I am not merely a hireling, {name}. It is strange you did not consider that when you offered me an alliance. But... it does not matter."

9b22c4bb-8175-43ac-88d1-acd904f510ed.Text: {n}The fire in Marazhai's gaze is instantly doused, and he steps away, his eyes looking off to one side.{/n}

8d6190f1-2ae5-488f-bdec-01a6a7fb655a.Text: {n}The Drukhari looks at you, a mocking tilt to his head.{/n} "What is wrong, {name}? Are you scared of what I have begun to uncover within you? Can your weak mon-keigh heart not endure my truth?"

2cf9b6c1-c464-4eeb-9603-d8abbf88f166.Text: {n}Marazhai smirks and runs his tongue along his lips.{/n} "I could sense your craving the second you stepped onto the bridge... And I crave the same. Come."

39128b68-c321-4e37-af6d-6895067182a1.Text: {n}Marazhai bursts into contemptuous laughter.{/n} "You almost had me convinced, {name}! You almost made me think you were... something. Well, you have shattered that illusion now — and I have nothing more to say to you."

6b187be7-f5f9-49dd-bcca-25f954c0f73f.Text: "With great pleasure, {name}. I hardly have any wish to dwell on such a disappointment."

0031c3ef-9c12-4ac0-8f1b-39a6667296ad.Text: "Oh no, {name}. You will not get off so easily. I will find a fitting punishment for this misdeed."

d3332a9a-aaf0-4c8b-81f7-9a439bc1f71b.Text: "I hear and obey, {name}," {n}says Marazhai, without even a hint of true submission.{/n}

3470d2d1-de0e-4aa3-95e7-afc47f2ae0ce.Text: "Tervantias was Yremeryss's ally, not mine. The Reaving Tempest is his patron, and patron also to the Wyches of the arena. I have had cause to seek out his artistry several times, and each time with difficulty — of late he has been gone from Commorragh more often than he has been in it. He was probably in one of his lairs where he hides his other experiments and creations."

9eb319ec-ca02-47ab-9248-28b8cf124680.Text: {n}Marazhai raises an eyebrow, looking bored.{/n} "I have some recollection. What is it to you?"

9aa65218-1381-49e9-99c7-b2dc5aafa043.Text: {n}The Drukhari tosses a hate-filled look at you.{/n} "It must be said that Nazrakhei did not have to try very hard to turn the court against me — not after the stunt you pulled before the assembled Archons."

c9a0b073-6779-47fd-81c2-99dfb637c8f9.Text: "After Tervantias quarrelled with the Wyches and was stripped of the Kabal's protection, his havens in Commorragh were turned into a deadly trap — I imagine they have been ransacked and destroyed by now. His other hideouts may be somewhere in the tangle of the Webway... or in realspace. But that last possibility is madness, even for a Haemonculus."

987730e0-4ec6-4db9-ac93-9239bc4071c0.Text: "When the Grotesque of a rival Kabal ripped my arm off at the shoulder. When I needed a substance to wring the truth out of you in the Obsidian Court. When I had personal desires that only a master of flesh could satisfy."

dee465b8-93bd-4389-90f4-7f3babefa47b.Text: {n}Marazhai folds his arms and gives you a pointed smile.{/n} "You are just dying to know, aren't you, {name}?"

45b5b85a-b3bb-461e-9460-c12e7ca4b9cf.Text: {n}Marazhai looks past you.{/n} "Nazrakhei was supposed to be the axe that fell on her neck... but it fell on mine instead. It was devious and worthy of praise... but why? A secret pact with Yremeryss? Or is there another reason? I will tear the answer from his throat along with his final breath."

e08b4bbe-c616-497a-8144-3134e58bb9fe.Text: {n}Marazhai's mouth widens into a wicked smile.{/n} "Of course. If I am not mistaken, you met the infiltrator yourself — a Kabalite who left a larva from Tervantias in one of the mon-keigh. Or did you never work out the reason for the treachery during the raid on your ship so long ago now? Hmm. Then there is no need for me to mention the sleeper agents hidden on your worlds."

9deee4f6-70ab-4304-a380-202ae15667f6.Text: "Who?" {n}He looks at you in bewilderment.{/n} "I have no idea what you saw in your stupor. The Haemonculus's creature does not elicit specific images — it muddles your mind, forcing it to paint suitable pictures evoking confusion or fear. Neither Tervantias nor I care about fussy mon-keigh rituals. The larva must have created a suitable environment for you, one in which you would be more willing to answer my questions in the Obsidian Court."

d46e171f-39f1-4fcc-bc07-2d6dc87e3b2e.Text: {n}Marazhai reaches out and touches the mark emblazoned on your neck.{/n} "My little pet, how pretty my mark looks on your flesh. It gives meaning to your existence. It tells the world who owns you. Perfection."

34a66f95-c2f3-4376-b24a-186ec2ad20c5.Text: {n}As you approach, Marazhai turns his head with deliberate nonchalance to reveal the brand on his neck.{/n} "How can I serve you, {name}?"

bc8dc3f0-594b-4eab-af32-8243634549f6.Text: {n}The Drukhari narrows his eyes at you, but says nothing in response.{/n}

db48ef4e-beea-44ad-8125-a047d7f74983.Text: {n}Marazhai looks at you with mocking condescension.{/n} "I admit you have amused me greatly, {name}. You {d|Encyclopedia:MiniJealousyRomanceBroken}lost your nerve and ran away{/d} without so much as a word! You have humiliated yourself so thoroughly, I can conceive of no deeper degradation." {n}The Drukhari laughs with genuine relish.{/n} "Ah, I do not even wish to sully my hands by killing you after that! You may live — with all the ignominy of a worthless, cowardly wretch."

6a9226f9-cca0-4a9d-8bc1-a84b37ec29e1.Text: {n}The Drukhari scoffs.{/n} "Let them come for what they are owed. They will regret it." {n}Despite his self-assured words, concern brings a furrow to Marazhai's brow.{/n}

8fa773eb-670b-49e1-924e-c3156808942a.Text: "Ah, you worked out who it was, did you?" {n}Marazhai smirks, but the expression immediately falls from his face.{/n} "The beasts have not settled down after the fiasco in the Reaving Tempest's spire. They want my blood and pain, which is why they decided to come to your barge and try to take me by surprise. They failed."

f7a33835-4aaf-40e7-b1ac-c38c5d9ca4cb.Text: "You lived in seclusion on a closed station until Felek committed his sabotage? So then you must be the Novator's successor!"

0b1016c0-f07e-405e-8423-3f6de2566168.Text: "Let us go to my study — no one will disturb us there."

08d8db37-9d40-47d9-89f8-a90c1098149d.Text: "Certain Navigators in your House fear the Atlas's powers."

9c5893e9-73c4-4701-8be8-ca8bcac2a51c.Text: "Allow me to ask you a few personal questions."

7710ebf6-d951-433b-98d9-51c1f1397b2f.Text: "I like the noise people make here. It fills the ship with life."

94f53cbd-6858-4646-a234-f82fbb06a1de.Text: "Why don't we invite the Great Regent?"

e22393a8-62e5-4df5-abaa-30a13027d1a5.Text: "Is answering a simple question that difficult? I asked you to tell me about yourself, not your family."

c0e284e8-f132-4268-b495-a399fe882e65.Text: "Navigators identify so strongly with their House. It must be difficult for you not to be able to lean on your elders. But you have my word that I will look after you."

0df96648-3f21-4f4f-b756-f48832e036b7.Text: "This is where I must beg my leave."

44acb2b2-5f00-42d2-999b-d1bb086d4568.Text: "Might my friend consider the immortalium a kind of declaration?"

2acac2f9-6237-4eff-956a-e13f9406f2f7.Text: "So you've never lived anywhere other than Eurac V?"

57bcec37-b263-48af-9123-ff0428da41f7.Text: "You did not mention the Starway Atlas when we met."

d26d23c5-dcae-4dba-916c-5b5a7cd45ec3.Text: "Why don't we talk about something else?"

ae0ea4a1-876d-4918-b15f-3ed359dd9a0a.Text: "And if my friend does not wish to accept the gift at all...?"

81143cc4-e8c4-4478-aedd-88c4ec3c5130.Text: "Is the Orsellio Prophecy system named after your ancestor?"

52b21d6d-944c-4356-b0de-6f96cafd0014.Text: "With your permission, I would like to talk about something else."

4e996922-fc8b-4de6-b20a-5a8ff930edf6.Text: "I take it House Orsellio has a rich history?"

6aa0876f-a835-4a0d-bd29-c498000f5899.Text: "You are not obliged to carry this burden alone. It is the duty of subjects to care for their future ruler."

b6355e63-8aaf-49f4-9b4c-667ca69b6bd8.Text: "Do not dare to touch me with your abhorrent powers!"

f485949d-6ba0-49ed-a2d3-20a94f029d43.Text: "I know the gift is from you. Won't you tell me what it is?"

b05153ba-0e1e-44af-9f2f-dfbdebfbbc06.Text: "I suppose I shall take my leave of you for a time."

e5e7292b-27ad-472f-95c9-2e6f3790902f.Text: "The old woman resembles you a little too much, don't you think?"

626da408-99ed-4f3b-8c43-98ac6fc46186.Text: "Yes, you have definitely lost your mind."

88c931a9-6f21-448b-b67c-79ab0de743ac.Text: "No more games, Cassia. I reject your immortalium."

a7e386f8-a81d-4c26-95ad-babb5d2f2abe.Text: "As tradition requires, I hereby resolutely declare my acceptance of your friendship."

aceef3ec-cf80-42c7-8c2b-285f241f1d1c.Text: [Close your eyes and give in to Cassia's will]

8ac76b82-21d2-420b-a025-0f2ff8c26aa2.Text: "What awaits the Navigators of your House now?"

c8001c8a-f502-4a63-9ab1-0a789b8f6966.Text: "Crossing the warp storm seems to have changed you somehow."

f0d9b3a8-3c11-49b0-b945-e404e084d941.Text: "So now you are the full-fledged Novator of House Orsellio?"

c628ab2b-6899-414c-a588-7ed36631705d.Text: "And you don't know that old woman?"

3e7abdf5-11d6-4a99-973d-1c43bea5bfa6.Text: "You can stop there — I have no interest in such things."

9a027d90-9fc5-498d-bf62-2c246365532c.Text: "Very well, you have given me enough hints. I shall work out for myself what I must do now."

21faad0e-80b6-4181-b097-21230d1761ff.Text: "A relationship? In truth, Lady Cassia, being near you has made me reckless. Will you accept my feelings as a reciprocal gift?"

ab9c0bd1-6496-40c3-bd19-2bc883525173.Text: "No, of course not. Let's just forget this conversation."

175ed9b5-3e0d-488a-a520-e4daf52cc7f2.Text: "Your third eye — do you always conceal it?"

4d4ab522-7606-4ae6-98be-0ebc9b593e65.Text: "What does it feel like to guide a vessel through the warp?"

25c271e1-1021-412e-bf75-ff88dabafefe.Text: "So the Atlas is some kind of crystal that is implanted in the Navigators of House Orsellio at birth?"

561b817d-dce0-445e-bc0d-4428db6fc447.Text: "I cannot blame them. Navigators are mutants, albeit highborn mutants."

8f9f0280-6492-4f89-9246-1d384e190562.Text: "Who cares for the opinion of the short-sighted rabble? They can serve us and die for us, and keep their thoughts to themselves."

1aa2118d-ce4e-4943-ba31-a464946f7a4f.Text: "You said you wouldn't share your secret with just anyone. Does that mean that I am someone to you?"

bd312092-b2f6-422e-84bb-ed0961b03d92.Text: "You have a point, it's about time we made the decks quieter. I will have the lower ranks stripped of their vocal cords."

b6c68cd3-79aa-4ddc-be64-d1cab5a8b6e2.Text: "A ruler cannot maim people just because it is in {mf|his|her} power to do so. On the contrary, it is the duty of every ruler to look after {mf|his|her} subjects."

f7892f98-b7d4-4089-ac1d-e953c3279288.Text: "You may find it difficult to believe, but the practice of depriving servants of their voice is not particularly widespread outside House Orsellio."

9adf52f3-6b9e-4322-8aad-4b6c09a65f9a.Text: "There is no need to apologise — you mastered the power in order to aid another. To aid me. I am grateful."

a4b696a6-9062-4964-baa1-60852fd335eb.Text: "You are beautiful, Cassia. Do not let anyone or anything convince you otherwise."

8a4d4cb2-f194-4c0a-8c79-33c40d2b9b31.Text: "There is nothing shameful about wanting to help. But you should ask my permission next time."

09dbaabe-0a12-4b8d-8062-f8d9c33c9d5a.Text: "Don't you dare use your powers against me ever again."

b2226722-5949-4acd-83d2-18e65ba46131.Text: "Sorry, Cassia, but I would like to know more about you personally, not your family."

239cc66a-fa94-467b-9de2-0f210fa8560a.Text: "I have decided to help you with your search for the Atlas. We are going to follow Tisiphone's trail."

4abb613d-bfe3-48ef-a5fd-34076771147f.Text: "I have heard rumours that you are not getting along well with the crew."

17a78477-8d07-4fe8-8e0e-0819752c14c3.Text: "So we are embarking on a suicidal expedition?"

22fd2f51-abbd-45c9-9e5d-bd22a05519d6.Text: "How does it feel to be cut off from the Atlas that nourished you since birth?"

d06b5452-9959-46f9-8fb5-3a3a83f5770a.Text: "So now the entire power of the Atlas is in the Novator's hands?"

dd3c90a4-2d9c-4f4e-981f-c3fe0c206b6e.Text: "Don't you think the renegades are going to make another attempt to destroy you and the Atlas?"

8fe96547-2266-468b-8bd3-9d9f19765dcf.Text: "You mentioned not being alone in the darkness of the artefact. Was it a figment of clouded reason — or was there really someone else with you?"

2507de37-920c-4171-88a0-2635126622d1.Text: "I hope you understand why I had your House's delegation executed."

2e2e9da1-a7bc-4a4f-b1f9-47c2d358586b.Text: "I hope you're feeling a little safer now that Elina Orsellio has been executed."

60e40232-4a1e-406e-8118-d8d237f26f27.Text: "I hope you understand why I had the Great Regent executed."

2918331b-a912-4cb7-8eae-020c0d5c6f4e.Text: "I noticed that your love of painting is reflected in your speech as well. You associate so many images with hues and colours."

e4ff50bd-0441-42a1-911d-1b7f4a30ab65.Text: "I have been through quite a bit of pain on your account."

49567080-8811-4c9f-8bd2-03998606d419.Text: "Sadly enough, a lot of what your eyes saw in members of my retinue has turned out to be true."

2faae686-00bb-4f51-8836-620d0620f959.Text: "Jae is no princess from a planet of wonders. She's an ordinary soldier who plays her chosen part well."

70c056cd-a89b-4ae2-a124-ba9c619a42fd.Text: "Argenta killed Theodora during the attack on the ship, not the cultists or Kunrad."

0da0a95f-a663-4897-b31d-2832e5e2290f.Text: "As you may have noticed, we're here because of Yrliet."

42416d0b-af4f-42cf-baec-8d4e5fe318f7.Text: "I wonder what colours you see around you."

c79e4bf8-9735-495b-8f63-76dd74e85e6a.Text: "I do not believe you to be insane, but I am also at a loss to explain what is happening."

0806cafb-74fb-4539-9c8f-967c531453ca.Text: "Forget I mentioned it. I shouldn't have brought it up."

07285205-3a28-4d28-a015-d86d15d49348.Text: "I cannot help it — the sight of you brings only improper thoughts flooding into my mind."

c40a0855-0636-4993-87e0-f960c6f2cee0.Text: "Do not take my words to heart — they were born of common courtesy."

ded5fd7a-b7c2-41cc-80e5-ae26bd21a83c.Text: "Let us say that a close friend of mine, whose name I shall not reveal, recently received an immortalium as a gift. How should he respond, in your opinion?"

571b1d28-4fdc-4c19-b094-f19af228606f.Text: "I received a priceless gift — a living flower in a crystal dome. Does this mean anything to you?"

7cec15ce-9e19-4c92-a15a-43e726154327.Text: "Why don't we talk about gifts? If you're not opposed, of course."

31170bd8-3804-4138-a497-7972a6c3f66e.Text: "Your valet delivered a rare gift to me. At your request, I dare presume?"

c5426c0f-4ff7-4560-8384-e6fb4e434ef6.Text: "Did you have friends? Someone you could turn to for a simple conversation, not a discussion of yet another lecture?"

1d55725b-ecc5-487c-976d-16f4584f28cc.Text: "What if my friend is willing to accept all its diverse facets?"

cec654ac-8002-4bcd-a7b1-119c57825560.Text: "You said that my friend could choose to accept only one aspect of the gift?"

a881b8a2-aa6c-4562-81b7-14f3d7ce8924.Text: "Thank you for sharing your thoughts with me. My friend has much to consider."

9aee64b4-7fb0-4d69-9ac1-0bdb6c6877dc.Text: "And what gift would you choose? If you were my friend, of course."

6abf33e0-dd14-445f-9ed2-b31ebe3a8bbe.Text: "So... House Orsellio has been left without a Novator?"

0241adca-0308-486c-984a-39c0b711c7f1.Text: "Don't you think the renegades are going to make another attempt to destroy you and the Atlas?"

0c12f47a-4144-493b-aab2-ff19f541140c.Text: "There are several books I would like to discuss with you... in my chambers."

ff3ee4e5-e03b-4774-8b3f-15dbf1ce52e7.Text: "Tell me about your life on the station."

2fbd62c6-38ff-48c5-a39f-ae13ec4b2f7b.Text: "It is best for us if we end our relationship."

8a65871f-3d86-49b3-a9cb-cf2472327445.Text: "I am pleased you accepted my offer after all... Even though it was quite unexpected."

0cf4dfbf-d799-493d-b4c7-489dab0be151.Text: "Not at all. But people come together and grow apart. It is the way of things."

888922fc-4ec6-4f7b-a40b-da14e031e93b.Text: "I was just joking. I wanted to see your reaction."

b637c6bc-63dc-432c-991b-aa47bfb7afb8.Text: "What kind of gift do you think would please Jae?"

0f8c9d23-1714-4f4b-ad48-5305d8808a3c.Text: "Lady Navigator, it is time we close the chapter on our cooperation."

682d01d0-64d9-432c-a018-0919d5b57716.Text: "My decision is final. Lady Cassia, you will disembark at the next port."

27cb8662-dc89-4a5d-b129-5cbb4e6a729f.Text: "Lady Cassia, being near you has made me reckless. And thus I ask you to accept my ardent feeling as a gift equal to yours."

eea5857d-c5a8-40be-a062-7ada38926d8f.Text: {n}A second later, an invisible force envelops you in a swirling torrent of emotions, and your heart skips every other beat — in time with the Lady Navigator's breathing.{/n}

42fa93ed-3d8a-44d4-8b09-90321259f4f2.Text: {n}When Cassia's powers recede, the austere reserve on her face is replaced for the first time by passion — in her eyes, the curve of her lips, the slight tilt of her head. With a small nod and a smile on reddened lips, she holds out her hand, pale and trembling.{/n}

ca050daa-ba76-4cac-a42d-61a9a46f6874.Text: [Kiss her hand] "I did not dare hope."

1a45f208-c88f-4222-ad1c-1ca29c3c5575.Text: [Cover Cassia's hand with your own] "If someone had told me that one day I would take leave of my senses like this, I never would have believed it."

baa8b1a5-58aa-4c9d-8237-61bbb28302e1.Text: [Tenderly squeeze her outstretched hand] "At last, we have become a little bit closer."

492d4013-7dc6-407c-9b10-e81f97b5d5d5.Text: [Politely draw back] "Some treasures should not be touched, even by those who most covet them, my lady."

fa3f3bde-3e69-4f59-9e34-a1126b19a6be.Text: {n}The inhuman pupils of Cassia's ruby-red eyes narrow, and the floor starts to feel wobbly under your feet.{/n} "You acted within your rights, Lord Captain. What the representatives of House Orsellio permitted themselves on the Rogue Trader's capital world... is simply unacceptable."

62c1772f-561e-4b1d-b224-a49b0ec1b622.Text: {n}Cassia shrugs noncommittally, raising her questioning ruby gaze to you.{/n}

1e244751-d156-48c0-8d45-ed9183ce430a.Text: "Absolutely! That is what I will do next time!"

8ff9438c-6875-4161-b280-be7ce9abff16.Text: "Greetings, {name}. The aid you are rendering to House Orsellio is truly invaluable." {n}Cassia offers a tentative smile.{/n} "What subject shall we discuss this time?"

69de394d-8ed5-4233-a7c9-210abedb2f18.Text: "It will take some time for the House to recover, but without the main Atlas... and their greatest fear — me — the House clans will be able to find peace once more. Perhaps they will even find a way to return to that ill-fated planet in the middle of the warp storm and destroy the Aeldari stone... or harness its power. But I still hope that the Starway Atlas will die with the current generation of House Orsellio's Navigators, and that a new era will dawn for our— for their House."

76a73b07-6bea-4961-81c7-95fd412ebe82.Text: "You are the only one who I trust to hear this confession — the thought of being {g|Encyclopedia:Novator}Novator{/g} both frightens and sickens me. How can I manage an entire House if I cannot even control my powers? I... I am just grateful to you for always being close and guiding me to the right path. Thank you, Rogue Trader. It will be an honour to keep guiding your vessel through the Sea of Souls — until you decide otherwise."

a6d33748-4c42-4cfb-a38c-56f53706f66d.Text: "Then lead the way — and I will answer all of your questions."

68ad4ad7-ef0c-43cb-98c4-86b404466ff6.Text: "It may be difficult to describe... You see, every Navigator perceives the {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}warp{/g} differently. My mentor, Great Regent Aaronto, always described his travels through the Immaterium as a journey through a vast wood with countless paths. And I, assisting him in the first voyages, futilely tried to follow his example. But the wood would not reveal itself to me."

84544474-97d1-4389-8e58-9ccb34e54e4e.Text: "You will hear no objection from me, Lord Captain."

f61f384f-4bc7-4971-8182-7ba936f5a1f7.Text: "Thank you for listening." {n}Giving you a slight smile, Cassia nods in thanks.{/n}

33892058-a271-4930-82ab-820cff24cde6.Text: "When the dark blue ice of my soul made Felek's heart stop on Eurac V... I instantly knew. And by then there was no sense in lying to myself."

e9268358-44f9-4be4-a0d7-602e1257af11.Text: "N-no? No, I do not believe so." {n}Cassia fidgets uncomfortably, not knowing what else to say.{/n}

60b1dfb8-361e-45e5-80b9-bd7b2e6e56d9.Text: "You... you can hardly ask me to speak to the feelings and intentions of another person?" {n}Cassia strives to remain disinterested, but her eyebrows arch in curiosity.{/n} "But since you asked... I think your friend should recognise the full gravity of the ritual. An immortalium is a gift of many meanings — it cannot be taken to signify only one thing. Is your friend willing to accept all its facets? Or only one? Or perhaps... is he unwilling to accept it at all?"

08b1c42d-6e11-48a9-b653-49de144835b7.Text: "No more does the leaden fog weigh down upon the Sister of Battle. Argenta set it free, and the fog became shadow — the shadow without which no light can exist. A pure hue, the only pillar of peace still standing amid the roaring flames inside her soul. The fire burns scarlet and gold... Whether for good or ill, it is not within my power to know."

a385c998-ee61-49c5-b19c-098016ece797.Text: "Seneschal Werserian is among the few whose colours are a pleasure to look at." {n}Cassia's stern gaze grows a little warmer.{/n} "Whenever the Seneschal speaks, heavenly crystal clarity spreads around him. And whenever he is angered, dark-blue clouds condense over him. And in his rare moments of joy, a pure gleam of sunset pink caresses the souls of those near him. Out of your entire retinue, Lord Captain, he is the only one I would trust with my life."

425f9cc1-29ac-4802-a725-199d6454083c.Text: "As the only voice of our family on this vessel, it is an honour. As long as your questions are courteous, I will answer every one of them."

db0d889b-ec4e-4172-ab7e-2e9c29e46854.Text: "Oh yes! The Navigators of the House came to the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g} fairly recently — a mere two hundred and eight years ago. Before that, our ancestors expanded the borders of Humankind's dominion for the glory of the Emperor, blazing trails to different corners of the galaxy."

88299657-6b7e-4f37-814c-903611e3ede9.Text: {n}The young woman inhales sharply, a tiny furrow appearing between her eyebrows for a split second.{/n} "A {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Navigator{/g} is given life only to serve their House. Our every breath, every word, every deed is for the good and prosperity of our House. By looking at me and not seeing the House, you only see a fleeting shadow. If that is what interests you, ask."

afc8a9ed-7a76-4ef8-beea-7f9710596b95.Text: "I have enjoyed your company, {name}. Thank you for the conversation."

9cbaa882-0f39-4c6f-88e8-c994322fcf53.Text: "Hardly. According to the chronicles of the House, I was born on one of the Orsellio worlds. Virt... Irtvi... Oh, what was it..." {n}Cassia absent-mindedly rubs her temple.{/n} "Please forgive me, Lord Captain, my childhood memories are too vague. Sometimes I dream about the colourful birds that built their nests in the garden. Or the servants dressed in purple livery. Or the blue fog that rolled over the lowlands behind the palace... But everything is covered in a rosy haze. Perhaps it is my imagination, not my memory, that is painting these pictures."

67b18141-17db-4805-99e6-24090b9047be.Text: "There was only pitch darkness inside the Haemonculus's artefact, but there is scarcely any more light in the streets of the Dark City, in whose blue-black haze I am almost blinded by pain." {n}Cassia frowns as she watches the shadows dancing in the corners.{/n} "Clumps of brown and dark green blend with the settling ash of misery, all woven together in a tapestry of every shade of darkness."

b64ab0fc-9f7d-47c0-a327-d99a5593c196.Text: "You... are right. To do otherwise would be selfish and too disrespectful to both our dynasties. I will pass on the invitation to my House." {n}Cassia tiredly rubs her breastplate where it conceals the Atlas.{/n}

95b874da-5724-47ab-8f7f-9a2b4fdc9592.Text: "Just as a {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} stands at the head of a protectorate, a {g|Encyclopedia:Novator}Novator{/g} heads a Navigator House. It is the Novator who decides where to look for alliances and which path their bloodline is destined to tread. As for our House..." {n}The young woman purses her lips slightly.{/n} "The transfer of power to a successor is currently underway. In the meantime, Great Regent Aaronto Orsellio is ensuring the stability of the House."

c11e1b67-5bbc-4124-9b47-8ff812447be5.Text: "{name}? How nice of you to grace me with your presence. I was just thinking back to our journey to the Palace of the Atlas... That is, to the world of xenos." {n}Cassia puts a hand over her mouth and laughs softly.{/n} "Remembering that most reckless act has enveloped my mind in a whole palette of hues. But when I think of the great risk you took for House Orsellio's and my own sake, an azure shawl instantly descends on my shoulders, and amber sparks flash inside my soul. Please accept my sincerest gratitude."

f7aea799-8141-4d60-b966-cf06be607e7a.Text: "You are engulfed in clouds the colour of dark umber. They carry an old pain. And... doubt?" {n}As if in trance, Cassia reaches for your shoulder with the tips of her fingers.
