013bbe17-cc30-4c1f-a2b7-283ff2542662.Text: "In light of the oddness of our matching identification codes, I find merit in his hypothesis as to the existence of a... clandestine malevolent agent or conspiracy operating inside our fraternity."

b3cf0f92-e8f6-42fc-ad99-841c786053af.Text: "This statement is false. The True Flesh is a gift from the Omnissiah which, rather than degrading the body, elevates it toward its perfect image."

8585f317-bd38-41dc-869d-1b475d5c3cbb.Text: {n}The vox-synth emits a rattling binharic mantra.{/n} "May your labours be effective and fruitful."

020d14ab-e4de-45c4-998d-bb3c1ea97313.Text: "Two packs, just like that? The Space Wolves must have taken his request seriously."

ec705a52-6be1-4a45-9ba6-160decfd395d.Text: "How were you planning on getting out of here?"

9156cd15-29c7-49e7-9956-ce7376bf02ed.Text: "I no longer wish to see you in my retinue."

a2e6af21-7beb-427c-8136-39f71f2f0cfd.Text: "In icons I have seen, Astartes look much less... wild."

57f77077-d757-470b-bced-95ae037ae318.Text: "How did you end up a captive?"

4d66137c-673b-4414-92f0-1fdd3015af06.Text: "You are right. Where would I be without my first oarsman? Forget what I just said."

ddf343d6-e714-4fc2-a4bc-70552c6ffb4c.Text: "Tell me about your time in Commorragh."

6ca23cad-aab1-4837-84da-b8cc85c04f4a.Text: "I am sorry about your brothers. They were courageous warriors."

92a987cc-2aaa-4c48-bf2b-49ede61179a8.Text: "I also believe that the Emperor is a man and not a god."

7d2ddc90-c54e-42f5-aeaa-c3bb8ead04e4.Text: "Ah, a different faith, but the same old idiocy."

f8679e66-caae-4c45-9785-3967d9810f3f.Text: "Why did the Space Wolves not trust the Lord Inquisitor?"

94ee1d07-4108-4886-a413-c0a6428a2d7c.Text: "Whatever your path has been, may the Allfather never forget you."

134826dd-7edd-4cc4-bc03-4714d4613a86.Text: "I never imagined the Emperor's Angels would be such savages."

e1d78459-5105-4019-b8d9-aa19d83b7159.Text: "Tell me about your path in the Wolves."

6164ed6f-d02e-4e75-a272-fb91a92f3103.Text: "Some kind of huge monster that rules over all the others? The lord of the ice trolls?"

a5504d4e-0e3e-4c11-9dcd-0eb9a8ba4012.Text: "Little is known about it. That means hunters fear to encounter it, and it is the most dangerous!"

2f264127-8387-41c3-93dd-5f6ade584c13.Text: "I do not know. It simply occurred to me. The name is amusing."

0a111b0e-cd19-4be8-bc3f-cdfa40203494.Text: "For a Space Marine Chapter, you are far from orthodox."

7a9f8889-7652-46b2-9a36-55ab27136202.Text: "Does that mean you do not believe in the Immortal Emperor of Humanity as a god?"

44dbdc62-ac91-4f6c-bc31-54cce96bc07a.Text: "What else do your wise priests do?"

1eb994e8-62a5-49f8-b5ff-8eddbde70a00.Text: "Tell me about your brothers, the Space Wolves."

c03fa498-0b1d-4c22-9d86-68e94bbad7a6.Text: "Why did you come to the Koronus Expanse?"

b89342e0-64a1-4add-b9c1-fec9c45f3174.Text: "What do you know of Xavier Calcazar's plans and objectives?"

81926704-c6ad-4a4d-b54f-463db187e8c7.Text: "I do not trust Calcazar. He is suspicious."

7ffb9e91-4e75-4c34-9fd8-7f45814ed291.Text: [Point at the wolf necklace Ulfar is wearing] "Is that a powerful charm?"

01fcec70-f360-4b0f-b66e-0872c8943c29.Text: "You spoke of full names that give you strength. What is your name, in that case?"

a989b3cf-b981-449a-9722-38d3adb56525.Text: "I still wish to hear about the Curse of the Wulfen."

84f2000a-9a16-402e-b0a4-8feb2c49d865.Text: "Your brothers were foolish to return for you. It was a mistake."

ad35c82f-9f72-426b-a7c5-e0cfb374ca4e.Text: "Do you believe the creature's curse holds any power?"

3e10f796-482a-48bd-80a0-8c764f09f5c4.Text: "All you can do now is avenge them. But even that will not bring them back."

a5269994-637b-4c84-b10b-5a933a863ef6.Text: "Why do you wish to meet with Thorbald?"

a1a24a0d-eebe-4d07-82de-a5f79d19220a.Text: "Inform Thorbald that he is invited to board the ship."

e5d91e79-4d36-4610-b2cd-370d6166d835.Text: "So, now you know where your brothers were heading. What will you do?"

e29d27a6-3d0f-4b5f-b595-a71b8e168a7a.Text: "It has to do with the omophagea, yes?"

3489fdc3-4259-422f-a0ee-44fe629e35ee.Text: "You are not being fed enough. That, or you simply enjoy it."

86e9be3e-dabb-4d82-868c-7c4cfa7d37ae.Text: "Is it a means of tricking your captors? Pretending to be a monster?"

8086b39f-1982-435f-9d89-2ae70e57ba63.Text: [Cast a suspicious look at Ulfar] "I have some fairly... grisly ideas."

c9bad701-85fb-4209-8e1c-4322d83f385b.Text: "We have picked up the trail of your pack in this region."

3a8cc989-e915-4c04-9d75-d7573fabb2b6.Text: "You Fenrisians seem to bring wolves into everything."

4456e3a8-0865-4128-8f3a-3805bca9876f.Text: "I wish to know more about your pack."

03019291-6643-4e22-9836-fb9787fcd81d.Text: "I have noticed your penchant for poetry."

af4256ab-2330-4df3-b5d7-efc77d90d246.Text: "If you are willing to talk about yourself now, I am listening."

9c2d33da-a488-4959-bcb8-aed60169da66.Text: "I could never presume to give orders to one of the Emperor's Angels. You should be in command."

8dc1befd-8954-433e-aa2a-4b13ca5d2379.Text: "It sounds rather savage. You shall call me Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

7a78edcb-bff7-47bd-8c12-3a4f04d3a961.Text: "Well, I believe that the Emperor is the God of Humanity and our guardian."

ccc61a38-b6be-43f4-b0a0-d3f405c39f4d.Text: "I wish to express once again my sorrow for your fallen brothers."

8d6baa94-5134-4aa6-b8c2-47773307e981.Text: "This means you must perform feats of glory in their honour, that their names may be remembered a thousand years hence."

9f0c4937-36cc-46dd-be16-7a4589646beb.Text: "What will you do now, last of your pack?"

af2b6b9c-2917-412d-9e83-3f9f74b19486.Text: "You have fulfilled your duty. I congratulate you."

4a24cd1a-0028-430b-924d-c8a041d19784.Text: "What debt did you owe the Inquisitor?"

60a2b359-1ced-4680-b70e-efe46b2ff02a.Text: "Do you still believe in the power of the curse upon you?"

c5cb9c56-6c8f-4cde-9eae-f756dddf302c.Text: "What are you planning to do with your newly acquired freedom?"

98c9152f-bb74-4648-827c-b59de3659cd1.Text: "I saw... strange things during the battle. Was it a mirage or warp influence?"

e149a2ce-489d-435e-9783-ae6e9c10cfe1.Text: "Tell me, what gave you the strength to resist giving in to despair?"

7a7bd6b1-56cf-455b-bf26-af3c68bf507d.Text: "How did you come to terms with your solitary fate?"

08926cf0-e441-430e-b545-e1adb7aef293.Text: "What if it is not a curse, but a gift? A gift of long life and many great exploits."

ed3928db-be54-4f8f-b2d0-0eb840bbe9af.Text: "You subject recruits to heinous trials. Why?"

924a8909-689f-4f16-be46-fa432eb5016e.Text: "Did you sense the moment when your spirit broke?"

55daf732-4b8a-45db-bbe9-32cb920f3729.Text: "Calcazar has ideas above his station. He dared to speak to me without proper respect!"

3333cf08-9774-43c6-bd38-37b162de1bc1.Text: "I have also met Xavier Calcazar, and I trust him."

2c37fd20-9337-45c3-8685-31c689d3dfa3.Text: "We had gone on a raid for xenos prisoners and fell into a trap. We had no war machines to support us, and some of our squad were wounded, so we were forced to retreat. I ordered my battle-brothers to leave, but I remained behind to meet our guests. I do not know how many of the feeble wretches I slew, but I would have killed even more had their towering piles of bodies not hindered me in combat."

baf17d66-46b5-4e63-a0f2-022d95931ef9.Text: "Let us raise our cups, Aett-Vater! In honour of deeds accomplished and in expectation of those yet to come!"

aabc886f-37e3-4df4-9cd3-fcdb78442376.Text: "The pack of Thorbald Ironhide is now laying siege to Eufrates II. Even if my pack is not with him, he may know where they are hunting. I must meet with Thorbald and ask after my brothers."

2b3f4a13-52a3-4283-bd2b-49aa2d05726e.Text: {n}The giant Space Marine casts you a sidelong look, grinning broadly. Wily self-satisfaction is writ large across his harsh features, though he tries to hide it.{/n} "I have had a few thoughts on that score. But don't try to pry them out of me — when the time comes, I will share them with you."

25a66098-6126-4c23-8189-4c4d260f4539.Text: "See, Aett-Vater? The Allfather wants us to know that the threads of our wyrds are intertwined. It was not by chance that he drew your path and mine together. It was not by chance that he led us to one and the same place. So come with me when the time is right to seek out my brothers."

5db0bcdc-0267-454e-9621-592884a80154.Text: "The storm is coming, the krakens are rising from the depths for a bloody feast, and you want to leave your drekkar without its best oarsman?"

5324f198-e8bd-4b31-9d52-e56f777bea1a.Text: "Not everyone is granted the right to ask such questions, but you... I shall allow it. What do you want to know about the Astartes from the glorious Fenris?"

150aad47-f061-433f-b358-42732febfe74.Text: "That was my path to Commorragh, Aett-Vater."

eb35e300-3179-458b-946c-840298f54260.Text: "An Inquisitor by the name of Calcazar put out a call for aid. My Wolf Lord did not refuse him and had two packs deployed to the Expanse. We never trusted this ally, but a blood debt for a service rendered in the past forced our hand."

d539c6eb-601e-4614-a088-af4f76fec920.Text: "So be it. Our brief acquaintance will be mentioned in the saga recounting my escape from Commorragh. Take pride in that!" {n}With a booming laugh, the red-haired Space Wolf turns away.{/n}

f4114d46-1a61-45e8-9ded-9d50ad1528f3.Text: "As you wish. I do not know what I did to anger you, but I will not argue. Farewell, {name}. My gut tells me we're all in for some foul weather. Meet it valiantly. I will continue my hunt alone."

fdc3b9c2-4172-44a3-85e0-3ecb4e269636.Text: "You enjoy telling jokes, I see. I do as well." {n}Ulfar's mouth stretches wide in a feral, unsettling grin.{/n}

4fb23a78-e818-437b-bb81-3b0cf20ca8ba.Text:
"In warm furs the old man
does shroud his body,
In cloaks of secrets woven
shrouds the sly man his plans.
To know his dire purpose,
swallow not the words of poison
but his gristle."

c9057b76-75fe-46ad-9b49-dc939324aaea.Text: {n}Despite his worthy attempt to play the fool, the Space Wolf cannot deceive you. Ulfar does not fully trust you and is carefully observing your reaction.{/n}

381585cd-bbc3-41d0-95ea-88167bbcbcd2.Text: {n}Ulfar lets out a sullen growl and pins you with an icy glance that sparks something within you — awareness of the monstrous chasm separating you and the ancient superhuman standing opposite.{/n} "Their saga is one I will not sing to you. You have spilt no blood with them nor shared with them meat and mjod. Their spirits might be outraged if they knew I had sung of their deeds to a stranger."

93e84b32-c2ec-4b9d-8d1d-633f3a71425e.Text: "I was given to Tervantias for his amusement. In the arenas of Commorragh, Astartes are a rarity, and he sent me out there to kill gladiators." {n}With every word, the bitterness and hostility in Ulfar's voice grow.{/n} "Living as an inglorious butcher and a xenos's puppet... I hated it. Constantly. Every moment!" {n}After roaring and raging in Fenrisian for a time, Ulfar catches his breath.{/n} "I had to take care of my mind, before it was twisted to the Seven Hells."

22a8648c-2860-4010-90fb-541283ee7166.Text: "At night, when I sink into meditation, I hear them howling. They are hunting in Kjalhalla, and my heart yearns to join them. One day we will meet again."

b7db08e9-79e5-46e3-b28b-7aa318fa767a.Text: {n}Ulfar growls mournfully.{/n} "It was. They deserved a more glorious death. And their sagas should have gone on longer. It would have been better for me to die that day and for them to live on to slay enemies for the glory of the Allfather."

f1207962-a8fb-404f-9669-aa3d86a55d88.Text: {n}A vicious grimace twists the warrior's face, giving it a beast-like appearance.{/n} "And I will have vengeance! By blood and by fang I will have it! My fallen battle-brothers I will glorify, feasting on thousands of fiends' hearts!"

b9fd8cc6-8750-468e-af58-176f50513002.Text: {n}The giant Space Marine laughs, looking you up and down.{/n} "Simmer down, Aett-Vater. If you want to read the magic incantations and invoke the Allfather, I will not stop you." {n}Ulfar's smile twists with malice.{/n} "But do not spout brazen words at me or else you will answer for them in a duel."

f9228d15-f102-4933-b6e3-ef54aaa60205.Text: {n}With a menacing roar, Ulfar clenches his monstrous fists.{/n} "One more insolent word about Fenris and we will have ourselves a duel. Do not test my mercy further — even unarmed, I will end your feeble life."

a2869740-4baa-4484-a1c7-de267f236042.Text: {n}The giant Space Marine grins, baring his teeth, and enquires innocently,{/n} "Why do you think?"

b974dc24-ace3-4426-a46e-bf97cdf3917c.Text: "But there is more to our spirit than grim destruction alone. In the hall of heroes, we hold feasts the likes of which you will see nowhere else. To thundering laughter, we raise our horns, tell our sagas, and honour our glorious fallen."

44b64caa-fcbc-438a-a368-aee2dbe52a97.Text: "I spent years in training before I passed through the dreaded Gate of Morkai, bowed on the rune stones before both his heads, and walked into the valley of dreams. As for what I saw there, do not ask me — that is between me and the Death Wolf. The Rune Priests scoured my soul but found it untouched by corruption. I returned and I partook of the Cup of Wulfen. The Canis Helix entered my blood, and the agony of transformation changed my body to resemble that of a beast, and my mind was drowned in the dark depths of bloodlust."

f6cf56ab-5d13-40b8-9495-54cfed8952e1.Text: "We will all one day fall. The Sun Wolf will fall, vanquished by Morkai; the light will go out; and Wolf Time will come. The storm of the Final Battle will pass and then there will be nothing. All know this, but not all can believe and understand it. I can... now."

a2220eb7-fdfd-46f3-a7ab-c2c7915be592.Text: "I will leave. Do not ask where, for you should not be wherever I am. I will become an exile, a feral killer. Before my wits gutter out, I will draw myself apart from humans and go where only inhumans and wicked creatures dwell. I will be their scourge, their curse, their hunter that stalks in the night, that ravages settlements and kills all in his path. I will be the Allfather's spite."

41542b52-9429-4dac-8b5c-359e43f65799.Text: "Vlka Fenryka." {n}This guttural pronouncement sounds primordial and ruthless.{/n} "That is our name in the old tongue of our world. We are the fiercest of the Allfather's warriors, his executioners, his retribution."

8d2a5860-95b4-4158-8f11-f289fc5d1ea2.Text: {n}Ulfar narrows his eyes, glowering.{/n} "What are you suggesting? Do you think that being a prisoner has corrupted me and sown within me a foul yearning for flesh?" {n}The giant Space Marine's upper lip curls, revealing his terrifying teeth.{/n} "Do not provoke the wolf."

f899a4ea-ad06-4aec-ac50-b70e3ef3393f.Text: "The Allfather loves all wolves. Even the cursed ones."

77f0f92d-f3d2-48e0-ac89-695b33538eea.Text: {n}Ulfar shoots you a menacing look from under his brows, but then, unable to restrain himself, bursts out laughing.{/n} "You are not wrong there! Every other word out of a Fenrisian's mouth is 'wolf.'"

3ecf54d7-de05-4796-a240-6b4072af9caf.Text: "A complete accounting of all my deeds would land like an avalanche upon you." {n}Ulfar proudly points out a marking on his armour in the form of crossed bones.{/n} "I earned this mark of endurance when I slew a chieftain of an Aeldari tribe. He dealt me a serious injury, and the Wolf Priest said I would not survive it... but it has not killed me yet. Two years I lay in a delirium after that battle."

23874d59-eb25-42b1-b923-b06deb5f93bb.Text: "And then comes the Season of Fire. Volcanoes awaken, waves wash over whole islands, and only the land of Asaheim offers salvation to those whose blood and grit win them the right to live upon it. Clan fights clan, crows circle over battlefields, and wolf howls rise up to the sky. That is my beloved home, there is no place in the universe like it," {n}Ulfar concludes wistfully.{/n}

4bd814cb-1b32-4f1b-9c8d-f8c86fcc4135.Text: {n}A wily glint appears in Ulfar's eye.{/n} "Tell me, Aett-Vater, what is the most fearsome foe on Fenris?"

63c5fa49-28bb-466c-b50e-743c8993055b.Text: {n}You mentally go through the list of the deadliest creatures on Fenris, but your thoughts seem to settle on one strange name: "wrath-badger." You have read about this animal — a small and ferocious creature about which very little is known.{/n}

4b1f862e-ca7c-4fc7-88a3-dd0a75431e94.Text: {n}Fenris is known as a death world for good reason. There must be dozens of lethal creatures that inhabit the planet, but which is more fearsome than all the rest?{/n}

3e33ed86-cc02-4b1e-a37c-b1429fe53b9f.Text: "The frosts of Helwinter are fearsome, but known and predictable. No."

eac8d378-8aff-47e8-9c56-535524a365e5.Text: "The Worldsea is vicious, but one can escape it on land. No."

44741ed5-cd04-4345-986e-1dcb8e2a121b.Text: "It is true that humans are more dangerous than any animal, but true terror does not come garbed in familiar flesh and blood."

3e8f30d6-95e9-4e33-aa33-4d6961045428.Text: "One cannot speak of Fenris without mentioning its wolves. Wolves are fearsome. But there are no more fearsome wolves than us."

848f1d8f-c352-41b3-a63a-72cd4cb9964f.Text: "An answer carried on the wings of the raven of wisdom. We know much of the terror of betrayal. Know now the name of the most terrible of all traitors."

74ed57c6-6901-49b1-b245-59233bbbff71.Text: "You speak of the Ice Troll King, I think? I am surprised you have heard of him. But he was slain long ago by Harald Deathwolf when the monster descended upon the Tide Hounds. A great saga was crafted from that hunt, one I like to sing at feasts... But no, you are wrong."

163c03a0-1a86-4f64-83e8-9ac23f74c7d7.Text: "No, you are wr— what? Why the wrath-badger?"

f1915ddd-f4f1-4093-9274-4b74a26f1298.Text: {n}The guttural roar of a storm rumbles in the Wolf's voice.{/n} "The Curse of the Wulfen is the most fearsome and most terrible foe on Fenris. In the heart of every brother there lives a dark beast, bloody and forever ravenous. He hungers to kill — not for glory, or duty, or his battle-brothers, but solely for the sake of killing. For he who falls to that dark beast, there is no joy or thrill in slaughter, there is but dull rancour."

fac7bcce-9df0-4fb8-9742-59dfb0f84cff.Text: "An amusing name for an unamusing beast. I have a brother whose face bears the scars of a wrath-badger's claws. No creature that lives on Fenris is harmless or amusing, not even wrath-badgers."

01e206ee-d139-40e2-aacf-18a384927ed1.Text: {n}The giant warrior's chuckle slams into your chest like a strike from a sonic weapon.{/n} "Very good! I hoped to tell you about the black curse of the Wulfen, but your answer wasn't bad either! Wrath-badger, ha!"

e5465d2b-6cac-4b50-abf1-4f48b15db978.Text: "The Wolves do not take orders from outsiders. We keep the old ways, not the Codex Astartes. We fight in packs, and we are trained and healed by our wise Rune and Wolf Priests. We do not find honour in adorning ourselves in laurels, but instead etch the full names of our fallen kin as a promise of vengeance and draw strength from that promise!"

1410c6c9-99d2-430d-ba94-a03ffe5232c2.Text: "Lakkan the Runed Wolf once shared the mysteries of the healing potions and the secrets of magic sagas. He taught them to see the past and future in thrown runes, to call down storms, and to carve powerful talismans."

92fd110b-165f-45c8-a4bd-c8889b1bfaa7.Text: {n}Ulfar heaves his mighty shoulders.{/n} "The Allfather is not a god. He is the best of all humans, our perfect forebear. His blood flowed through the veins of Leman Russ, and Russ's blood flows in me. Does that make me a god? My respect for him has no end, and I am ready to die for him, but... what place does faith have here? Is the Allfather like the massive Iron Wolf, whose every tuft of fur forms a mountain on the surface of Fenris?"

2148d7f3-6baf-41f8-8dd1-3f186cfbb6ab.Text: "We believe in the Great Wolves. In the deadly Blackmane and fierce Drekan the Thunderwolf. In redoubtable Haegr the Mountain Wolf and in the Bloodied Hunter. In the Wolf That Stalks Between Stars, who follows us wherever we may go, and in the uncanny two-headed Morkai, guard of the realm of the dead. Of the Great Wolves, some show us their favour, others are more malign, but each teaches us a lesson. For that we praise and honour them."

bac98e49-97f9-456e-aca9-6a8abb6f4c78.Text: "Do you? And there I was about to round off my story with a short four-hundred verse saga about the gifts of Lakkan the Runed Wolf."

8fd45709-5acc-4485-9227-962a0b5504f1.Text: "You helping me to compose a glorious verse in battle against Doomscream — remember? As the last word left my lips, I realised that the bond between me and my brothers was stronger than weariness and woe."

c244b9d1-44b2-424d-893f-6855ef30ad91.Text: "Do you remember when I was overcome with rage in the Reaving Tempest's spire, and you reminded me who I was supposed to be fighting for?"

a9c3ff59-2759-4033-8ca3-36ce07dd0a17.Text: "When I told you of the death of my brothers Arnoolf and Skyaddi, you paid tribute to their valour, and for a moment I felt as if I were back home on Fenris. And I wanted to return there."

9f8209b7-0d31-4cb7-afe7-0a87b8eed267.Text: "When we stood over the body of my brother Ignilf... you spoke true words. You brought my home back to my mind. And then I knew that I was not ready to abandon all hope of seeing it once more."

edf2ec29-c089-4407-b6a2-590555a5afc6.Text: "Do you remember the verse you helped me compose in the battle with Doomscream? Icy sorrow rang in every line of it. That was when, I think, I first understood the path that had been laid out for me."

c512cc26-7260-4059-97af-4a6f779a6056.Text: "When rage overcame me in the Reaving Tempest's spire, you told me that it was my duty to avenge the fallen, to slay xenos... and you were right. Whether I am alone or with my brothers, my duty remains unchanged."

e031e8eb-ada4-49b1-973b-9eafd48eb3e9.Text: {n}Ulfar points at the other shoulder pad, depicting a black beast head, and he declares in the tone of one instructing,{/n} "This is the Great Blackmane Wolf, patron of slayers and totem of our Great Company, the Blackmanes. All know that we are fearsome and hungry for the struggle of war, that we are cunning, deadly, and show no mercy. Speak our name and thunder rolls!"

9dde4bcd-11dd-4657-bf99-7d82caa14ac2.Text: "When I awoke on Fenris, I set out for the wastes at once, and there I hunted a blackmaned wolf and killed it with my bare hands. For that feat, I was granted the rank of Wolf Guard." {n}Ulfar affectionately strokes the wolf fur laid across his shoulders.{/n} "That fearsome beast remains with me to this day, and I carry his furious spirit."

cef058c7-a7aa-441a-8326-09b55d948e24.Text: "Being alone... is not so terrible. When I told you of the death of Arnoolf and Skyaddi, you said that they should not have come back for me. The words taste bitter in my mouth, but if I had had no brothers to begin with, then I could not have doomed them to a terrible death."

ac63faa7-f24e-4149-b2c8-100891f072ce.Text: "Everything became clear to me when I stood over my brother Ignilf's body, and you called me the last of the pack. That was when I realised what road was calling to me."

7ba536cd-f2d6-4f7d-9570-9f898b355b6b.Text: "The Allfather bestowed him with outsized arrogance for one with such a feeble body and modest destiny. When we arrived in the Expanse, he was insolent... but then he realised his thread was about to be cut short by the claws of my wayward brothers."

5e4b60bf-60ab-4b4f-8ea5-c201094ad602.Text: "A gift straight from the Seven Hells!" {n}Ulfar bellows angrily.{/n} "What is the valour of a deathless warrior worth? Where is greatness in the exploits of one who shrinks from death? When the Wolf Time comes and my fallen brothers march into the final battle, where will I be? Sitting alone in the Fang beside a fire that went out long ago?"

2b99690f-338a-4030-b9b7-2627c25240f3.Text: "Many times I have heard the clicking of Morkai's fangs next to my ear..." {n}Ulfar wards off evil with a superstitious gesture.{/n} "...but I have never allowed him close enough to sink them into my rump."

afa9ad49-013c-478c-aecf-dbec709ddcba.Text: "The path of an Astartes leads into the fangs of horror. Any threat that can be endured by the mind is one that mortals can handle. But we are needed where the unthinkable begins to happen. Things that understanding cannot help to bear. Things that, once beheld, turn minds into bubbling, pulsating dreck."

3bec37e6-5dcb-4ff2-9e50-ffd3a0cee422.Text: "I thought many things when Doomscream fell. The verse I spoke in that battle was steeped in fury and despair. They no longer frightened me."

28c99e0f-ab6d-441c-a53c-1d365252d579.Text: {n}After a moment's silence, Ulfar replies,{/n} "Ulfar Redmane. That is what my brothers call me."

27bd9a64-c3c3-49ec-a083-3f75fbe2a2c7.Text: {n}Given the warrior's boastful nature, the indifference with which he revealed his name is surprising. It seems he does not trust you enough to disclose his true name.{/n}

75a0062d-dd82-4e25-9e04-2a1c0454270f.Text: {n}The primitive culture of Fenris could well have bestowed such a simple and banal name upon Ulfar. There is nothing to wonder at here, all you feel is pity for the Space Wolf.{/n}

168dc7ef-5298-47a1-88fa-39ede11ac83a.Text: {n}After clearing his throat, Ulfar adds in a more ordinary voice,{/n} "I hope you're not going to put off the feast. Our escape demands a grand celebration!"

897786b0-e461-4963-932c-6462cfe276d8.Text: "Do you remember when I was overcome with rage in the Reaving Tempest's spire? You did not try to dampen it — on the contrary, you embraced it. And that was when I began to embrace it too."

5c0ac091-fe8b-4b78-b556-94aaa6b0e399.Text: "Do not be taken in, Aett-Vater. His words are persuasive, but until I see the blood trophies that prove his valour and loyalty, I will not be putting my back to him."

598f7ff9-8303-420f-9688-c067f129b11d.Text: "When I told you about what had befallen my brothers Arnoolf and Skyaddi, you did not praise their glorious deed, but only loosed bitter words about the inevitability of death. I knew those words were true."

1418d334-c700-44de-a712-7764217e0a2d.Text: "But still smouldering under all was the hope that I would find my brothers alive, which stopped me from drawing the black shroud of sorrow over my head. But then... Do you remember what you said to me? You said I was too late. Ulfar Everlost was too late. Again."

8c4c73f4-6eec-4212-a2d3-ee455c37e7cf.Text: "I felt something strange in my mind then... Like a low growl, over and over, saying, 'Rip. Tear. Blood. Kill. Beast.'"

c4ddd696-7dc8-41b7-ae7c-be9c2fb9f1d1.Text: {n}His face darkening, the Wolf continues in a subdued tone,{/n} "My return from the dark was long and cost me... greatly. When I stood in the hall of the Fang once more, the Rune Priests imbued my body with the remaining gene-seed and implanted the necessary organs. But those trials were nothing compared to what I had already endured."

12ad03c2-ea41-4606-9c48-74bc14791c93.Text: {n}In a gravelly voice that sounds like cracking stone, Ulfar answers,{/n} "When I overcame the darkness of Wulfen in my soul, I set out for the Fang. Every neophyte must undergo a hunt during this journey. One might fight a fearsome wolf, another a sly snow wyrm. I crossed paths with a Doppelgrendel. A cunning and rancorous spirit."

06fb6165-95ef-4678-a4e5-71fb2afe32e6.Text: "For five days and nights did we bring our wits and wrath to bear in battle. The spirit changed its guise, but in the end I gouged out its eyes. Fleeing, it hissed a curse — nowhere would I find an honourable death, vowed the creature. My saga came to an abrupt and inglorious end, like a noble banner mouldering and fraying at the edge. When I made my return to the Fang, clutching that crushed eye, the Rune Priest looked at me and his face grew grim, but he said not a word, save to confirm my victory."

e089c43e-d7ab-4a79-9ec0-699859932f1a.Text: "Everything became clear to me when I was thrashing around in a delirium, recovering from the wounds dealt to me in the battle with my brother Ignilf. Many dark visions appeared before me then, and each one bled the warmth from my burning heart, one drop at a time."

4a2238a5-881c-4f1e-97b7-7765942a331a.Text: "Each time I bury a brother, I secretly envy him." {n}Ulfar's mournful words land heavily like cliff rocks cleaving off into the sea. His face darkens until it resembles a grim idol hewn by a primitive people.{/n}

7dfcc15e-a91f-4b2d-b2fc-cd24c3ebe6e4.Text: "The ages weigh heavily on my hands and heart, and one day I will be too tired and feeble to wake up and rush into the fray! What will they call me then? Ulfar Who Slept Through the Battle? Ulfar, Morkai's Unwanted?" {n}At the last words, Ulfar makes a gesture to ward off evil.{/n}

8813249c-3ad8-420b-bf38-4c6858d3ed6a.Text: "An ordinary man who encounters this evil will go mad with despair. But we are incapable of feeling fear. It is simply not in our nature. Instead, we feel unbearable rage. We must select the neophytes who will look into the eyes of the unthinkable and roar — that is why we need our trials."

19c5c4b0-3c46-40f1-9a36-cb65a633e7e2.Text: "We also decided to be cautious. His words flowed like honey, and he seemed an honourable man, but... Lies always look like truth, don't they?"

6c265044-fd1e-4d34-b823-5b9b3e733757.Text: {n}Ulfar's voice drops to a conspiratorial whisper:{/n} "Though the body of an Astartes is built to be immune to the effects of drink, we invented a way around this taboo. The mjod we brew can overcome even our blood. It makes us drunk, and makes our feasts jovial occasions. Ah... mjod... You can brew it nowhere else but on good old Fenris. No other world is home to such poisonous plants."

fbc8e222-47b8-4254-ace0-b52f29de8490.Text: {n}You suddenly feel a whisper of... something menacing radiating from Ulfar. A necklace of various formidable-looking teeth hangs around his neck, and the teeth are carved with intricate runes.{/n}

90ce764d-9713-4b36-9c97-9bdd88f6a5db.Text: {n}He heaves a sigh and it comes out like a growl.{/n} "They wounded me and captured me. They froze the joints in my armour. When they dragged me to their ship, two of my battle-brothers descended upon the xenos and tried to free me. An insane plan, but it almost succeeded... Almost." {n}A grimace of pain is fixed on Ulfar's face, which is shadowed with grief.{/n} "And so there were three of us taken captive. And then there were two. And then I was alone once again."

159cf063-fd9a-4dcd-8229-7730ee5aa8f2.Text: {n}Ulfar falls into a bleak and solemn silence.{/n}

dfe6b19b-aaeb-4f1a-b59e-2a3a72f01562.Text: "I was a seafarer. Every spring we would go out onto the Worldsea and slay many-armed krakens and ravenous sea drakes. And then the Season of Fire would come, and we would dock on Asaheim to battle for our clan's right to inhabit that land. I was young but already fierce and facing down foes twice my size. The Chooser of the Valiant, who had watched the fateful battle from the cliffs, deemed me worthy and took me to the Fang for healing. My clan was proud!"

3954e1fa-1b10-4a38-8522-5d652fd482bb.Text: {n}You know the story. After the First War for Armageddon, in which the Space Wolves and the forces of Armageddon fought off the terrifying incursion of the Archenemy, the Inquisition ordered that the heinous event be covered up and the planet's mortal defenders be thrown into labour camps and sterilised.{/n}

6a122c56-de02-4562-bbc8-634328540e3c.Text: {n}You have never heard of the Months of Shame. It is probably something from Fenrisian history.{/n}

44c71706-394f-4de6-9feb-4652dee050a8.Text: {n}The Wolves defended their erstwhile comrades and evacuated many people to Fenris. The confrontation ended in a bloody massacre, and the courts of the Inquisition have not appeared in Fenris's system ever since.{/n}

aff1e22b-9da0-4926-bf92-00e4629f752c.Text: "And their sagas will be sung in the hall of the immortals, sowing valour in the hearts of the young!"

cc00995b-f8a6-470b-a026-6bfec69edaec.Text: "And of my glorious victories there are many more besides — not for nothing did the jarl grant me the accolade of Terminator." {n}He proudly displays the sigil on his chest — a stone seal in the shape of a wolf head on top of a cross.{/n}

8df43a7c-1dac-4758-a6ef-1216f4db1c8f.Text: {n}Ulfar replies evasively,{/n} "An ancient strife. If you do not know of it, then you are not supposed to know."

85f7cadf-46e8-4bdf-8edb-14c4a9530fa7.Text: {n}You sense not the slightest power emanating from the charms Ulfar is wearing.{/n}

fbcb5227-a5e9-4fe5-9153-27bacbb8bdb1.Text: {n}Smiling in satisfaction, the Wolf graces you with a magnanimous nod.{/n}

eb5cb460-c6fe-4b5f-83a7-9b0695a66e3a.Text: "There is no peace among the stars. Who will carry out his will in this grisly place if not blood-drenched savages?"

d72362e9-abe5-4343-a6ac-885174c4aeab.Text: {n}Ulfar sucks in a breath, tasting your scent.{/n} "Instinct bids me to remain silent. Such knowledge is not to be shared with just anyone, only those who possess my complete trust."

f9030f71-20a1-42f3-a1a8-3a5f4390b120.Text: "Even among the brothers, my pack are counted as the most rabid glory hunters. When we were young, we knew no taboos or limits to our pride. Years passed, and suddenly we are veterans, but our avaricious hunger for exploits is undimmed." {n}The giant Space Wolf's words seem to radiate heat, as from a roaring fire on a winter's night.{/n}

bc6c2604-e794-4fd7-971e-64367e36ec90.Text: "The Inquisition! Pah!" {n}Ulfar nearly spits out the words.{/n} "Rats scurrying around the Allfather's house and ruling it in the master's absence. Cowards, they are. The last into battle, but the first on any war council. We saw what they were worth in the Months of Shame."

37151c5d-fcfe-407f-8747-bc6e6a498dec.Text: "Find my pack. As we speak, they are likely performing some bloody service for Calcazar. For that reason, I want to have a word with the Inquisitor."

76eb029f-e381-4c65-ab65-3aa4c1f67db1.Text: "If anyone knows where my pack brothers are now, he does. But it is not right to speak of such things within others' hearing — that is why I thought it better to keep silent at the war council."

a442138b-68e8-4590-8b1d-0281628bb403.Text: "What do you want to know? What brought the Space Wolves to the Expanse? Or how I ended up in the non-humans' Dark City?"

9514895e-6299-484c-b15a-e32e6bada49e.Text: {n}Ulfar points at what looks like a claw mark.{/n} "And Jarl Ragnar carved this one when I beheaded a despicable sorcerer, the archdespot of Tyranica II." {n}The warrior's bragging demeanour fades away, and his voice becomes thick and dark like poison in a goblet.{/n} "Many brothers fell victim to him, and we do not sing that saga before mortals, for the preservation of their minds. Alas, I failed to behold my own glorious deed — my eyes streamed with blood, and I hunted down the sorcerer by scent alone."

6ed2c254-f1c8-44b6-949f-983b5d101365.Text: {n}Ulfar leans toward you, and with a friendly, only slightly feral grin, says,{/n} "Should what I told you reach other ears, I shall take your tongue."

0c972a16-990d-4958-b7e1-fe3e1890637d.Text: "Help you to deal with the enemies who besieged your home, and then head for the coordinates that Thorbald gave me. Well I know, Aett-Vater, that you are dauntless, and if I but say the word, you will join me in my seeking, but... the place I will voyage to is a perilous one. Few can survive in it, and though duty leads me there, I do not want my debt to be paid with your blood."

3f90d50c-fb13-4546-ad82-e2cfe3d79fad.Text: {n}Ulfar chuckles.{/n} "That is my moniker, yes. My voice knows no fatigue whether fighting or feasting. I can recite the glorious sagas and terrify foes with my battle cry for hours. This fine name was given to me by my loyal friends Arnoolf Bloody Axe and Skyaddi Twice-Thinker."

8d1d5991-7f7a-45ec-80d7-bfab022c8682.Text: "Our gene-seed is unique. Leman Russ blessed us with the Canis Helix, a genetic gift that heightens our senses, making them sharper than those of brothers from other Chapters. The Canis Helix kindles a bloodthirst in our hearts and changes our appearance to resemble the lethal wolves of Fenris."

f52990c9-0c49-4730-adc0-f7cb1f14cdf2.Text: "The bonds between us were many. Arnoolf was my sworn brother. It was he whom I faced down in the battle where the Chooser of the Valiant noticed me. Arnoolf too was deemed worthy. We went from bitter foes to setting aside the enmity between our clans and becoming close friends." {n}Ulfar shows you a blade covered in red runes.{/n} "He gave me this blade to show that the past was forgotten. Quick to laugh was Arnoolf, and fearsome in a fight, almost as fearsome as me."

641f52ea-1847-4d8a-b796-fb33699c4d0b.Text: "Do you know of the implant called the omophagea? It is one of the blessings the Allfather granted to his Astartes. Nerve nodes that connect the stomach walls and the spinal cord allow me to absorb information from the genetic code of the flesh I consume."

1c40e61b-aeb7-490d-88d2-498f42fb75ab.Text: {n}It appears this warrior of the Emperor is blessed with brute strength but is neither cunning nor ingenious. He is clumsily attempting to hide his total lack of strategy for escaping behind tantalising evasions.{/n}

68f5c833-f58b-4ea0-98b4-7abdef9bf2f4.Text: {n}The omophagea is clearly involved here — the genetic gift granted to the Astartes by the Emperor. This organ links the brain and stomach of a Space Marine, allowing him to absorb information from the genetic code of any flesh he consumes.{/n}

178ae723-54e0-45e0-befe-0fb7225c8ae0.Text: {n}The answer seems clear to you. This bloodthirsty warrior has simply gone mad in captivity. Come to think of it, he was probably slightly deranged even before he was taken prisoner.{/n}

8144ff28-5d7c-469a-94c2-6cc914994e0d.Text: "You are very well informed. Far more than a common mortal ought to be. Yes, it is true that I have gorged on the flesh of my enemies to reap the secrets from the steaming flavour of their meat."

61775572-3e2f-42b8-8aa5-f7e123f20afa.Text: "Skyaddi Twice-Thinker, well, he was sent to us by the Allfather to see that we did not meet our deaths as young pups. He had enough thoughts in that head of his to make do for me and Arnoolf both. It was Skyaddi who taught me to compose verses. The spirits prized his wisdom, and the runes hearkened to his voice."

ffad1c13-bd6b-4f33-99f4-d1febb8e98c1.Text: {n}Ulfar snorts contemptuously and spits on the ground.{/n} "If I wanted to sate my hunger, I would sooner swallow rocks than the meat of these lousy degenerates, these pathetic minions of the false gods, these heretical sacks of corruption and cowardice..." {n}Ulfar's rumbling rises to a profanity-filled tirade in Fenrisian.{/n}

4b2ae32c-f6b9-4b3a-bb45-31afb3f0097f.Text: {n}The smile of a maniac dawns on Ulfar's face.{/n} "You think I have fallen into the sweet embrace of madness?" {n}He roars with good-natured laughter.{/n} "No, I have not lost my mind. Not yet, at least."

9ef8fb63-a0d6-438c-afdc-2d2f042a6b5e.Text: "Partly, Aett-Vater. It is true that I have led the puny xenos on a false trail to dull their vigilance. But that is not the only reason."

1f157c52-0abe-4a1b-a472-d5595ee4cc2d.Text: {n}Ulfar suddenly frowns and adds haltingly,{/n} "You, of course, are a maiden, not a father... but we have no word meaning 'maiden commander' in our tongue, as all Space Wolves are men."

6ca6a592-384d-43f9-b21e-c5d63dc1fd43.Text: "When the xenos took me prisoner, Arnoolf caught up with them and slew a score of them with his fine axe, and Skyaddi called down a storm so mighty that the abominations' jetbikes were whipped into the winds' furious currents like leaves. But even that was not enough to take them all... We were captured. Tervantias took Skyaddi first and turned his body into... something unthinkable. Then he took Arnoolf, and during the many hours of torture, my brother's only response to the freak was disdainful laughter, and then he fell silent."

0352847e-9a0a-4e4b-98f5-17d8d12d7b0c.Text: {n}Something has changed in Ulfar — on the surface, he appears healthy, but the light in his eyes has gone out, replaced by the blood haze of {d|Encyclopedia:CompUlfar_Wulfen}creeping madness{/d}. His dry lips are tight and shrivelled — glorious sagas will struggle to pour forth from such a mouth. His voice rattles with a malevolent growl:{/n} "Aett-Vater. It is good that you are alive."

8dfccc97-b4a4-418e-8932-d4e991010bd1.Text: "It is wise to hide one's past from a stranger, but shameful to hide it from a friend. Ask away."

b640a484-d68c-4e93-bcfd-808ac0894be6.Text: {n}Something has changed in Ulfar, as though a burden that has weighed on him ever since your first meeting is finally gone. There is a serenity in his harsh features that there never was before. He bows before you with respect.{/n} "Aett-Vater, it is good to see you. I swear that {d|Encyclopedia:CompUlfar_Pack}your name will not be forgotten{/d} when I return to Fenris and sing my saga."

b2365af0-a0b1-4038-ab30-add5ca67323f.Text: {n}Something has changed in Ulfar. His features have become starker, sharper, and the merry glint in his eyes has lost its sincerity. He is grimmer now, and his skjald's voice has gained a funereal hoarseness.{/n} "Aett-Vater, witness to {d|Encyclopedia:CompUlfar_Lone}my oath{/d}, I greet you with honour."

bf6a1ffa-d87c-4f6b-86d7-9b45e393ca1d.Text: {n}Ulfar's voice turns cagey.{/n} "He saved our brother who had lost the pack and... was unable to look after himself or the Chapter's honour. Calcazar returned our brother to Fenris and kept secret the misfortune that had befallen him. The jarl knew that the Inquisitor's actions were driven by opportunism and the desire to have us mighty warriors in his debt, but honour forced him to be hospitable to the stranger and swear an oath of friendship."

405df640-f7ac-4ce5-a7b1-c93785407074.Text: {n}Though it wields immense power, when it comes to the Astartes, even the Inquisition chooses to make requests rather than commands. The Space Wolves are not known for being close allies of the Inquisition. How strange, then, that the Chapter sent not one but two squads in response to this request, when one squad alone is capable of crushing a planetary uprising.{/n}

b62fbc4b-173f-4b3b-85d2-81d10270160f.Text: {n}The Inquisition wields immense power. The entire Chapter might have come to the Koronus Expanse, had Calcazar requested it.{/n}

eef9f4c7-ca87-43f3-abce-e21d020229c9.Text: "Everything on Fenris has power. I have fought in a hundred battles, and suffered a hundred injuries. Even Wolves are not certain to survive such grievous maiming. But I always survived. And with each new victory, my thoughts took a darker turn — what if I truly am destined never to die with honour? What if my death will be foolish and inglorious?"

359193c4-17ee-4afe-8c73-ee90f87c9d36.Text: "This is the name given on Fenris to a pack-father. A commander or captain. An aett-vater answers to a jarl — the commander of a Great Company. Since you are the one who commands your crew and I follow you at present, I am granting you the honoured title of Aett-Vater."

c4f028af-159e-4efb-b55f-3a968b0b0557.Text: "We call ourselves the Baleful Howl, and our sign is known to all Wolves." {n}Ulfar proudly points at his shoulder pad, which is emblazoned with a crude depiction of black fangs.{/n} "We are old Wolves who have seen much and endured much." {n}A shadow of disquiet dampens the warrior's boastful exuberance.{/n}

4ec0f915-2905-463e-810c-549c0817e859.Text: "Before becoming an Astartes, I dreamed of becoming a skjald, a keeper of stories. At feasts I often sing of my brothers' exploits. Thousands are stored in my memory. When I am near, Wolves fight even more ferociously, for they know their deeds will be immortalised. One of the Tech-Priests theorised that our songs contained hidden psychometric codes to increase courage. Maybe there is such a thing in other places. But on Fenris our sagas are spun from memory, from respect, from pride."

f35f3dc4-4c25-4dd6-9908-df3b1cf612df.Text: "The Allfather gifted you with strong intuition. This was made by Skyaddi Twice-Thinker. The spirits liked him, and one could feast a whole long Helwinter night to the words of his saga, so keen was his mind. He was my friend." {n}Ulfar's face, lit a moment ago with ruthless pride, seems to darken as if a shadow passed across it.{/n}

105fbeb1-5c86-4e82-a74a-63ce33f50be3.Text: "Or is he as enormous as the Sun Wolf, which rises to hunt every morning and fills our world with light? The Allfather is not a god, but the highest of Humanity. Ordinary humans struggle to grasp this, but we, his warriors and offspring, remember the truth."

308df6a7-b1bf-4bdb-a3f7-1fc93e3da710.Text: "These are dark days you are asking about, Aett-Vater." {n}Ulfar lets out a rumbling sigh, draws out the rune-covered knife that you saw him carry in the Dark City, and begins to spin it between his fingers, finding his equilibrium again.{/n} "Let my keen-edged friend be a witness to the veracity of my words."

3ff98d0d-75f2-4a88-8f2a-fe05c3031870.Text: "The Koronus Expanse is a wild hunting ground teeming with prey. And the Space Wolves will be the first to turn its snows scarlet! The jarl decided to send the most indomitable hunters who hunger for honour and bloodshed. One pack would have fulfilled its duty for the sake of pride, but two... two would seek to outdo each other for the sake of glory."

e6d3af19-1796-4180-8c4d-fbb101dc6ab1.Text: "Thank you. Their stories will not be forgotten, but will live on in the Chapter's legends. We wolves do not fully die — we leave to hunt in Kjalhalla, and one day we will return to this world for the final battle. Glorious will be the day when we brothers are reunited!"

d6bd928b-2165-44d4-afcc-106803b483ef.Text: {n}Ulfar sadly shakes his head.{/n} "The pack is no more. I could become a Lone Wolf, an avenger of the fallen, but my heart yearns for something else. I have missed the company of the warriors of Fenris. When we finish your business here, I will seek out Thorbald Ironhide and accept his generous offer — I will bind myself by ties of blood brotherhood to the Stormbiters. My duty to the Allfather is not yet fulfilled."

09cfa2a4-55bc-46e4-8468-ed616310074f.Text: {n}Ulfar's rumbling voice seems to reverberate in your very bones.{/n} "Our fearless Wolf King is Leman Russ, son of the Allfather. Our world is Fenris, and our home the Fang, which rises from the World Spine into orbit. We are the thunder in the bloody storm of battle that calls to us! That is who we are!"

234b1726-6891-4609-a1fc-f7adf285adf2.Text: {n}The giant's gaze thaws.{/n} "Fenris is home. A harsh land of harsh winters and harsh people. When comes the Helwinter, a fearsome season of frosts, the merciless Worldsea freezes and great white bears, snow wyrms, and ice trolls go on the hunt. Then the murderous frost retreats, and boats of harpooners sail out to ply their craft, capturing sea snakes and krakens."

cd1cf9d1-ed11-42d3-8e62-e62c1a70e471.Text: {n}Ulfar demurs, but a satisfied smile plays on his lips.{/n} "It is true that I am capable of commanding you and your people! But as a warrior of the Allfather, it is too easy for me to forget the limits of ordinary people."

e6cbfaaf-19b3-4f32-a05b-acb1d978f9d5.Text: "Be worthy of it. And see that you do not disgrace this glorious rank."

5705acc8-a668-4c05-a244-2b254788f1a2.Text: {n}The Wolf's smile is full of condescension.{/n} "Your credentials are unknown to me, but none of them bestows greater honour than the one I have given you."

87f15d6e-5d84-46ab-9eb0-db86ad70d83f.Text: "Every morning I made entreaties to the Allfather, and every night I appealed to Russ. I trained my body, read the litanies, and in the darkest moments, I recited my own saga. I recalled every battle, every wound, every brother. And that is how I survived." {n}The red-haired Space Wolf fixes you with a fierce glower and then turns away.{/n} "I always survive."

eb47f170-f0fd-4fa0-ad4d-f5982557bc61.Text: {n}Ulfar glowers and growls menacingly, and something primitive and ancient inside your brain descends into hysterical terror.{/n} "Our traditions are steeped in centuries of blood-soaked glory. They are not yours to judge, human. You have been granted an honour, so shut your mouth and try to be worthy of it!"

22481f22-9066-4b93-9f2b-02a009f2f3ed.Text: {n}Ulfar responds with an equally firm nod full of meaning.{/n}

81f73f62-b2ac-4edb-b731-32a177b89442.Text: "Believe what you wish, Aett-Vater. The Allfather never wanted us to revere him as a god, but we are not ordinary men. I do not know what his intentions were for the rest of you."

728c5598-b735-4995-b97d-f01c0200dec9.Text: "It makes his deeds all the more glorious. Battling gods is child's play when you yourself are a god. But if you are a man — now that is the stuff that sagas are made of."

0ba3ed2b-ab89-4b75-b503-e988de3abb22.Text: "I could not have done it without you, Aett-Vater. Know that, now and always, you will have friends on Fenris."

6e123a49-2a44-47d0-9470-df3c3deb1614.Text: "It is difficult for non-Fenrisians to grasp our wisdom. It comes along with the cold and death."

52550621-f64b-4491-b084-198978478bf2.Text: "The curse is strong, there is no doubt about that, but my spirit is stronger than a Doppelgrendel. I overcame one in combat, so can I not overcome its magic? No, one day I will find a glorious death on the field of battle!"

7b4f049e-f35f-4b4a-9cc1-af9e6118b456.Text: "Should you hear a howl of triumph in the night, know that I am on the path of retribution."

6e168a05-2b8c-494e-beb3-8d5c92038618.Text: {n}The Wolf maintains his own mournful silence.{/n}

33a18b07-df29-477d-86c3-2e55f9f5c960.Text:
"More than words stringing,
A secret weaving,
Magic in its marrow,
Not to ear or mind speaks the saga,
Its spell-sounds deeper strike,
and the heart hearkens."

e79176f3-8eb6-4871-adea-55ad188c4fe9.Text: "It is strong, but I am not weak. Before, I survived because my duty to my brothers compelled me — to shrug off any wound, to rejoin the fight, to defend, to protect... Now that duty is gone and nothing is holding me here."

f92d67a2-0dfb-4aa5-8258-6d1a05be05b0.Text: "Fight, Aett-Vater. I will seek honourable combat and vanquish the Allfather's enemies until the day there is none worthy of defeating me. The name of the Baleful Howl will sail like a drekkar along the rivers of unholy blood that I will spill. Blackmane is no longer my patron — from this day I tread the paths of Lokyar, the Lone Wolf."

eb496b4a-a335-4bf8-ac11-600a795beb41.Text: "The joy in my heart is dead, Aett-Vater. I feel only rage... But that is a lie. In truth, I feel nothing at all anymore. I simply wish to tear someone asunder. Soon, that feeling will be all that is left inside me, and then even it will fade. And I will be hollow."

b0188446-1791-49e0-b533-08ab35c02d22.Text: "I no longer want to deceive myself with false hope. Each of us has our own fate. For some, it is an easy one; for others, one full of sorrow. Mine is of the second kind, I think. To be ever lost has been my fate from birth, but only now have I found the nerve to accept that path."

8be2352e-b757-4ed8-a7e5-4479113ae45b.Text: "Dreams brought on by mjod mixed with reality and the spells of the Doppelgrendel. How can I say what was true and what was a mirage? Were we fighting against a spirit, or against my deranged brother? Did the ghosts of the fallen rise up beside us to weigh our valour on the scales of honour, or did the drug make us do battle with the wind? It is all true, Aett-Vater, or perhaps none of it was. The people of Fenris have long known how thin is the line between what is real and what is legend, and we were in a legend."

1f890785-77fa-4cf2-9e77-7f8853c3c2cf.Text: "That arrogant chief thought he could give us orders, but we Wolves have always followed our own instincts and hunted in our own way." {n}The red-haired Space Wolf chuckles smugly.{/n} "I wager that boiled his blood."

6cbe2bad-7038-418d-9403-34d1c204e5d3.Text: {n}You receive a wolfish grin in response.{/n} "Insightful. We'd had no dealings with this Calcazar before this and we did not trust him. Two packs meant twice as many eyes to watch out for his games and schemes. And then..."

3b9b6f19-ec18-475e-8eff-4addd5ac8513.Text: "Your counsel, Aett-Vater. It is what gave me strength."

cb1b310e-8ec4-488d-aa55-d4631bfa4e09.Text: "I have slain many xenos and feasted on their flesh. My captors have watched me do it, and taken glee in it, while I have been gathering information and planning my escape."

ffd08c22-073b-45e4-9e5a-1f609967bcad.Text: "Like a spirit of wyrd itself, you showed me my path, Aett-Vater, while my eyes were still closed to it."

fcc2908c-81bc-4a5b-a7b8-71cec6b65dd5.Text: "Every crack was small, but together they shattered the bastion of hopes living within me."

911342c4-1c90-412b-9614-78cac36444eb.Text:
{n}With thunderous laughter, the giant warrior triumphantly roars:{/n}
"Broke free the bold
from captors grasping!
Dark City's feeble dungeons
eternally disgracing!
Flows now this saga
in the hall of glorious feasting
Where all extol the Wolf mighty
and the Aett-Vater cunning!"

9c07df56-cc74-4c2a-a2c0-c51273d126f5.Text: {n}Ulfar says with grim curtness,{/n} "They fell. With honour."

c2212e2a-dcd3-4e18-bd78-6f1e12953303.Text:
Seneschal Abelard Werserian is one of the closest associates of the late Theodora von Valancius. He has spent a decade serving the Rogue Trader's protectorate, and he clearly intends to spend another decade keeping a close eye on every negligent servant or under-trained officer.
The elderly Seneschal does not show it, but the death of Theodora, whom he faithfully served for many years, shocked him. Abelard is willing to do anything to ensure that Theodora's successor becomes a brilliant Rogue Trader worthy of {mf|his|her} predecessor.

571d1c35-bb2a-4829-ab16-42614cc22ecd.Text:
Sister Argenta is one of the blessed Adepta Sororitas, sometimes colloquially referred to as the Daughters of the Emperor. Furious in both battle and prayer, the young warrior yearns to bring light to the dark corners of the Koronus Expanse.
Argenta travelled on the voidship of Theodora von Valancius. On the fateful day when the vessel was attacked by the servants of Chaos, she joined the future Lord Captain and helped repel the attack. The sister proved herself to be both a dauntless warrior and a reliable comrade-in-arms ready to destroy any enemy of Humanity.

06b8b4db-2b9c-4482-a311-1f5bf1edd540.Text:
Cassia Orsellio is the young heiress of a Navis Nobilite House. A unique Navigator gene allows her to guide Humankind's voidships through the warp, gazing fearlessly into the depths of the Sea of Souls. The price for this incredible gift is terrifying mutations that devour the girl's fragile body, further alienating her from Humankind.
After surviving an assassination attempt on the station Eurac V, Cassia found herself in a Rogue Trader's crew much sooner than her mentors ever expected. Years spent studying tomes and maps failed to prepare the girl for the challenges of the outside world, and of her own Navigator House, which is being torn apart by a power struggle for the Novator's throne.

8eb03812-0cdb-4bc6-b1d5-823f8476bd1b.Text:
Agent of the Golden Throne. Interrogator of the Ordo Xenos. Right hand of Lord Inquisitor Xavier Calcazar. Heinrix van Calox, a sanctioned psyker in the service of the Holy Order of the Emperor's Inquisition, is bestowed with many titles and considerable powers, which he directs toward one goal — the fight against the enemies of Humankind.
Van Calox is aboard the von Valancius voidship by order of the Lord Inquisitor. In his battle against servants of the Archenemy who threaten the Koronus Expanse with untold calamity, Heinrix is ready to sacrifice the remains of his own humanity, but if he does, will he then be any different from the monsters he fights?

30cc7b2c-8e3b-4bfd-9462-f0dc19765572.Text:
Idira Tlass is a psyker diviner in the service of Rogue Trader von Valancius. Daughter of a distant world and a product of a doctrine alien to the Imperium, she perceives the curse of sorcery as a gift she deserves — for only the most skilled and strong can endure the touch of the Immaterium.
Years of using her sorcerous powers have cost both Idira's mind and soul dearly. With each passing day, her ability to keep the malignant forces under control weakens, and so the moment when the warp will devour the diviner without a trace creeps ever closer. Who knows if Idira will be able to come to terms with the inevitable — or if she will turn to other forbidden forces in search of salvation?

ff80dbca-02af-42aa-a384-4fdf3747be8b.Text:
Footfall is full of daredevils, criminals, and those who walk the fine line between righteousness and heresy. Someone who has tread that line for many years without ever crossing it is Jae Heydari, head of the smuggling network under the auspices of the Kasballica Mission.
Jae Heydari and the Rogue Trader are bound by a pact of mutual favours: the wisdom of a Cold Trade specialist in exchange for the high patronage of the Emperor's anointed. However, there is much more to Heydari's past than disagreements with the Kasballica Mission — a past she prefers to keep well buried.

5035ffb1-fe81-4f43-9562-84cb4f8b3ef1.Text: Marazhai Aezyrraesh, Dracon of the Kabal of the Reaving Tempest, is the embodiment of all the true qualities of the Drukhari, the most brutal and deadly branch of the Aeldari. He is driven by an unquenchable thirst for violence and power over others, which he achieves through subtle cunning, dubious deals, and — to his great delight — the slaughter and torture of his enemies. A fateful encounter with the Rogue Trader changes his fate forever: stripped of everything that once was his by right, the former Dracon and exile of Commorragh is now forced to ally with one of the "mon-keigh" to survive... and perhaps to find a new way to rise again.

b1afaa85-7b80-4858-8a3d-79aa51d7be83.Text:
Pasqal Haneumann is a venerable Magos of the Adeptus Mechanicus. For the glory of the Machine-God Omnissiah, he performs sacred maintenance algorithms and protects the blessed mystery of Technology from the ignorant. As a member of the Explorator Fleet, Pasqal leads an eternal crusade in search of sacred Knowledge.
After meeting the Rogue Trader on the hive world of Rykad Minoris, Pasqal joined the Lord Captain's retinue. He hopes that such a powerful patron will help him find his long-lost mentor, whose mysterious message prompted Pasqal to embark on this journey.

0d716b10-b00a-4611-9999-eac1b2a879fd.Text: Few can match the glory of the Space Wolves, the fierce and proud sons of Leman Russ, bloodthirsty hunters from the world of Fenris. Ulfar set foot on the warpath many decades ago, and a trail of blood has stretched out behind him ever since. He enters every battle with a triumphant howl, for there is no fear of death for one whose saga will be reverently sung by his brothers in the Hall of the Great Wolf. His violent temper and boyish desire for glory and boasting have not been cooled by his years of fighting nor by his ordeal of being held captive in the Dark City of Commorragh. Having joined the Rogue Trader's retinue, Ulfar has resumed the writing of his saga in the Koronus Expanse, and the enemies of Humanity tremble at the sound of his battle cry.

0f0b6da8-531b-497a-8018-79829f888b61.Text:
Few can claim to have survived an encounter with a xenos, and even fewer to have struck up a friendship with one of these creatures. However, the privileges of a Rogue Trader allow one to make acquaintances even among the Children of Asuryan — that is what the kin of Yrliet Lanaevyss, a mysterious and taciturn Aeldari, call themselves.
The Path of the Outcast led Yrliet to the agri-world of Janus, where she met the Rogue Trader. In joining {mf|his|her} crew, Yrliet hopes to travel to the distant stars and uncover the mystery surrounding the demise of her craftworld. This Aeldari will go to any lengths to accomplish her mission, taking even the most desperate measures.

1099b29a-28c0-4256-9b20-f446b2538c3d.Text: "The bond between Kibellah and me is stronger than that of simple emotion. And although she may have lost her way and cannot appear before me right now, I will wait for her. I will become her light."

d12e0010-37ea-44e9-9421-fe2e8f2b0fcc.Text: "I'm only yours, Sol. Always have been and always will be."

981af622-8d59-4678-88c6-d56937992a5f.Text: "Kibellah, our bond is stronger than that of simple emotion."

5866b7d7-0fc4-474b-ac9a-6c5256178544.Text: "What is the point of choosing? Can't we all come to an agreement that is to everyone's satisfaction?"

ee2ef4b1-cf5d-4e7f-a5b1-ac3c32df8e95.Text: "Cassia, my lady, the only future I see for myself is one where I am with you."

f1ba1ec1-16cc-4658-a036-0fc0cdf7bb3c.Text: "Jae, I will forever be your shereen."

fe02ee37-dea6-4585-929e-bd237c5f7f8e.Text: "Heinrix, I need you and no one else."

ca532d3f-8493-4a04-9088-1cde3655b1ca.Text: "Yrliet, I will never trade the bond that you and I have created for anything in the world."

a17498aa-8d05-4a67-b052-5771c946a831.Text: "Marazhai, stay with me. The rest... they don't matter."

87d55a8c-37f8-43dc-8f1b-bb83e382ed36.Text: "Too much is weighing on my mind right now. I am not in a position to be distracted from my duties by personal matters."

a83d7367-ed60-4b5c-a1c8-f849c67f4424.Text: "The one I love is not with us now, but my heart belongs to him nonetheless. His name is Solomorne Anthar."

5c68aa73-c5a8-4735-915b-b8fd89e5978f.Text: "Lord Captain?" {n}Cassia raises her chin. Her posture and gaze are reserved and dignified as is becoming of nobility, yet her trembling voice betrays her emotional state.{/n} "The decks of this voidship abound with swirls of dirty colours — some of your crew are spreading ludicrous gossip about you allegedly collecting people's hearts like victory trophies. And that your... collection... boasts more than one exhibit. Please, dispel my doubts — or do our feelings for each other count for nothing?"

e81448e4-c546-4ed2-8782-a99f5106b602.Text: {n}Jae smiles softly.{/n} "Shereen, I never had any illusions about saying vows over water with someone whose heart was one half of my own. And I have little time for people who feel compelled to poke their nose into another's bed and assert their opinion on what's right and what's wrong. But your passionate self is stirring up too many... ambiguities in your retinue. All of us are packed together all the time, we vie for your attention, and it might lead to animosity. The right thing to do here would be to clear up any misconceptions."

efd15092-1e68-4457-8c9d-af3e1339e5a4.Text: "A minute of your time, {name}." {n}Heinrix's expression is stoic as usual, but there is disquiet in his darkened eyes.{/n} "It's no secret to me or the crew that your relationships with members of your closest circle are complicated. I said nothing, expecting you to resolve this... controversy, but everything has its limit. If you don't mind, I would like it if you clarified where you and I stand."

c02db3f8-5b9b-42bc-8fb0-6468f0181984.Text: "{name}." {n}Yrliet takes her time before continuing. Her expression is difficult to read, but you notice that this is the one time when she must struggle to look you in the eye.{/n} "Our journey together has been long. You have learned to hear me, and I to see you. And I see it now: there is room in your soul for more than just our bond. I... can understand this. But I am unwilling to splinter my own soul because of it. Tell me: which bond will end today? Ours? Or another?"

c7811be7-359b-44f2-a696-128febca5a01.Text: "{name}." {n}Marazhai is examining his metal-clad fingers with an air of pointed boredom.{/n} "A regrettable rumour has reached me that you have been lavishing attention on certain members of your circle. Do you mean to insult me with your neglect? If your intent was to bring another source of entertainment to our feasts, you should have asked my permission first. I will not tolerate being kept in the dark."

377aacdb-514e-4eaa-8f93-70f26074ff39.Text: {n}No emotion shows in Kibellah's expression. She inclines her head as if she were receiving a perfectly agreeable order.{/n} "The words of the Tenets will never again trouble you, Domin'{name}."

a778a3f5-9e99-478a-aac3-41f7708c1a55.Text: {n}Jae smirks.{/n} "Hear, hear, shereen. Even the deftest rider can't charge ahead on two mounts at the same time. And even the most passionate woman won't tolerate rivals forever."

8c8e99c1-0a5a-4051-9b5a-8b7731be1fa4.Text: "No more uncertainty." {n}Heinrix folds his arms.{/n} "If the Lord Captain wishes to commit to a relationship with someone else, I won't stand in her way..." {n}He swallows with difficulty, then his expression darkens.{/n} "But nor do I intend to be part of an idle dalliance."

04c32c99-2822-4be5-968d-f1e37a16d0d2.Text: "I do not understand, elantach. Must I truly partake in such a base ritual? The subtlety of our bond... is not something that can be put into words. And certainly not something that demands proof or explanation." {n}Yrliet brings her hands together in an elaborate gesture and turns away, but you can see that she is still warily observing your reaction.{/n}

ae8732f4-a5da-46c0-b1c4-8d152604a943.Text: {n}Marazhai examines you intently.{/n} "I have had enough of all this fussing. Why have you still not made it clear to your servants? Put them in their place, or I will save my time and energy for someone who appreciates them."

b83b2367-363e-46f5-9ccc-a7a19f97dddd.Text: "Your proposal is... outrageous!" {n}Cassia's face turns red.{/n} "If it was your intention to insult me, Lord Captain, you have nearly succeeded."

ab07d753-4fbe-41a4-abcd-af186bb114af.Text: "As far as I'm concerned, there is no reason for me to kick up a fuss about it. But who would agree to share the Rogue Trader with a lover as dazzling as I?" {n}Jae smiles sweetly and impishly.{/n}

dc4e6770-617e-44f5-915d-4d4e05000383.Text: {n}Heinrix looks you in the eye.{/n} "I would rather avoid any agreements that could further complicate our lives."

2db4f78d-b971-4944-ad7a-e1c83b917b8e.Text: {n}Yrliet recoils, her lip curling slightly.{/n} "I told you I am not interested in your base passions... and you assured me that you were not driven by them. If a harmony of souls is not what your mind and heart desire, elantach... then it is time to accept the truth. There is no shame in changing the path you have chosen. The only foolish thing one can do is run along the same path in the opposite direction."

3237ec91-3127-454c-96a1-5239de9fcfa4.Text: {n}Marazhai lets out a portentous throaty laugh.{/n} "Perhaps I could find a use for this new plaything. But it wouldn't intrigue me as much as you do, and you know well what I do to toys that fail to captivate me. I break them."

a1a78181-7c48-4bff-8df5-3b2ff9267594.Text: {n}Silence falls in the room as everyone's attention is drawn to you.{/n}

dd8b245e-829b-4992-8cb4-1465feb5bc36.Text: {n}An enchanting smile blossoms on Cassia's face.{/n} "And it is a future that you and I will treasure... together. For as long as the stars allow us to."

93f58611-78a2-421a-a2a2-c06e9ab4989e.Text: "I know. When you're near, I can hear the song your heart is beating, and that song carries my name." {n}With a blissful smile, Jae closes her eyes and says seemingly to no one in particular,{/n} "It's good that everything has been cleared up."

d362276f-982e-4439-b608-a00b5d4d98c8.Text: "{name}..." {n}Heinrix smiles lightly, and the tension in his shoulders releases.{/n} "I will never doubt you again. Not for a second."

e6a786bc-abcf-4391-a459-ff821ef02aef.Text: {n}A fleeting smile softens Yrliet's austere expression. She nods wordlessly, for kindred souls do not need words to understand each other's thoughts and feelings.{/n}

a08acb48-5c85-4ef7-90e1-b91d2b019a8a.Text: {n}Marazhai's eyes narrow in satisfaction.{/n} "I had no doubts about what I would hear."

850beba3-218b-492a-8b5f-61119adcb57f.Text: "I..." {n}Cassia's feelings pierce your heart like a white-hot needle, filling it with sadness. But they quickly retreat as she catches herself and clenches her fists, cutting the skin on her palms with her claws.{/n} "In that case, I wish you... only the best, Lord Captain. Even if I am not meant to be part of all that is good in your life."

47ca51e5-7eb6-4132-b44b-655d027fc36f.Text: {n}Smiling without enmity, Jae says with genuine warmth,{/n} "If your heart sees clearly where its delight lies, all I can do is be glad for you and praise the Exalted One."

bcf044a5-c24c-4885-99be-e3fcee0b3ce2.Text: {n}Heinrix's face instantly turns to stone as if there never was any emotion on it to begin with.{/n} "Thank you for clarifying, Lord Captain. If I may take my leave now."

f2107ac6-0e74-455d-ae80-4fcba0a192c7.Text: {n}Yrliet nods in understanding.{/n} "I accept your answer, elantach. Follow the call of your soul, and it will one day shine brighter than any star."

17569e89-d37f-4925-8c24-9d5fd9204ef7.Text: {n}Marazhai clicks his tongue.{/n} "Such a pity... I was finding our little game quite amusing. Very well. Stay and languish in your dull and limited world — I will find something more interesting than you to occupy myself with."

f1d7311d-4756-4e3a-ae89-f421a9156a16.Text: "The Lex Imperialis does not forbid relationships or even marriages between multiple partners. But I have always found them repellent."

c308130b-d0d6-4598-9fab-58f93de54ad5.Text: {n}Solomorne, standing slightly off to the side, remarks in a hollow voice,{/n} "I don't know why I came here. The nature of our relationship is self-evident."

c9d8ccea-b49c-4264-97a9-33e56c9415cc.Text: "{name}, some people think that something other than service binds us together. Of course, that's not true. I do not wish to bring discredit upon you: declare to all who is dear to you and who is only a servant."

6712d45d-6ea9-4ada-a4dd-73c1da4084f0.Text: "You are too kind to me, {name}. You should have named another — I don't deserve you and I certainly won't aspire to be in your confidence ever again."

8d9a257d-c9e9-4651-b0a5-347a583906ab.Text: {n}Solomorne folds his arms over his chest.{/n} "Our relationship didn't start off smoothly, {name}. But we're past that now... aren't we?"

4e58ffd8-4c1c-4efc-9cc8-be0d833a9482.Text: {n}A few moments pass in stunned silence.{/n}

d408b5a1-9e1f-4ba6-b97c-c707dfb57245.Text: {n}Kibellah brings a hand to her face before beginning to speak:{/n} "Domin'{name}, your road splits and branches, giving birth to many new trails. You cannot walk them all. Torn as you may be, you cannot cut yourself into pieces. Stop, and choose which thread is yours, for there can only be one."

3d95815a-7e77-4885-bead-d9f1eaf04b15.Text: {n}Kibellah's stare feels like it could burn right through you.{/n} "Domin'{name}... one cannot share their soul with many. A choice must be made."

8a27ff95-3e6b-440e-8c11-f9317092410f.Text: "Do not insult yourself with such words, Domin'{name}."

f07bb9a1-5e51-47ae-9751-0437d0ed725a.Text: {n}Kibellah closes her eyes and whispers,{/n} "You and I, Domin'{name}. No one else."

025ff69d-f84a-471f-8107-0524b0c19777.Text: "The officers never stop discussing your personal life, {name}... Our personal life. They claim you have multiple suitors, which of course I don't believe. Refute these rumours openly, and I'll have cause to shut down those gossips."

c45a7e87-053e-4948-8520-26d23f389973.Text: "I swear I will never make you regret this choice. Never again."

d054b88a-b45e-4f4c-bf7a-0675abfdd169.Text: "It's hard for me to hear these words. But that does not make them wrong. An Arbitrator and a Rogue Trader should not muddy their working relationship with feelings."

a9c9587f-df1c-49e9-a3b8-f6043c68a630.Text: "Lord Captain, your presence is required by members of your retinue..." {n}The Vox Master's voice sounds tense, even somewhat frightened.{/n} "And I believe that they will not accept a refusal."

eaaba40b-a2a4-4737-8eba-edd08db47e67.Text: "The aberration dared violate the sacred ceremony and was obliterated. Retribution has been served."

980052f5-e839-40b0-92b7-a30b55016740.Text: "Nemesite has fallen! All hail the Lord Captain!"

a0c9d6b3-783b-4eb8-8441-6013c7ee2683.Text: "All hail the Rogue Trader, who solved the mystery of the sacred relic."

e3e7b18c-2777-4e5f-a899-36bab10acbc7.Text: The cold floor under your knees, initiates fumbling around in the distance — and nothing else. You are quickly overcome with boredom.

a55fea03-7582-486d-b673-65c248f274d1.Text: You immerse yourself fully in prayer and feel the presence of something greater.

77a2188c-9f49-462a-ac1b-3cc73513668e.Text: You offer your prayers, asking for the strength to defend what you hold dear.

ef96b3be-2653-401e-9642-502b6f753dc5.Text: You recite a prayer — the one you remember best.

ae470d49-7a28-4b0d-8661-22a34e8ef444.Text: "Your accomplices! I want their names! Or else I'll start breaking a bone for every excuse I hear out of you vile traitors!"

22d247d5-9064-411f-80ee-a1e176041410.Text: "Mercy! We're innocent. I swear on the Emperor's blood!"

fbd3a93b-d175-4520-bfc8-53877f7352e4.Text: "Initiating machine spirit appeasement service. May the sacred rite of reboot normalise the system response."

dce16553-5c9b-4fa8-bc9b-405464d4044c.Text: A heady odour rises from the smoking censer.

82163bbc-5fad-4e46-a89d-1bb39cae96a6.Text: The censer clinks melodiously with every swing, filling the air with fragrant smoke.

4c3fd1cf-f535-45a1-8b79-e194aa41a6c5.Text: "Thank you kindly for your assistance, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"

3cd28409-fe41-4b2e-a5ee-5eadba31d89a.Text: "He has a grenade! Protect the Lord Captain!"

208b2fe3-8933-4481-b223-c2a8f2e9bd93.Text: "Traitorous vermin! I'll get you, wherever you are..."

ae5cf88b-fb60-45b1-b1d3-20cff7e706f1.Text: "Lord Captain, confessions and denunciations have been arriving regularly. All troublemakers will be punished."

4a32b108-4733-4f16-bd5d-2221ef7d06c8.Text: "Don't move, Master Danrok! You are bleeding too much as it is!"

0bfafcac-c745-4d73-abbb-b80671accec6.Text: "Emperor grant me the strength to conquer my own arrogance and lust for power. It is a difficult thing to admit, but it looks like I am little more than a dishonourable whoreson."

39a0698d-ca73-48a6-b629-ed08b90cd9e3.Text: "Lord Captain! The great relic has been stolen! This is sacrilege!"

a4875b28-de2f-425c-89f7-531c6f7f5dd8.Text: "Emperor's mercy! This confession is blasphemy, terrible blasphemy! Who is this heretic lurking aboard? And how do I cleanse my soul of what I've heard? It burns! It burns my mind!"

dc08a1d4-2b69-4f7b-b558-83ea1530c5f9.Text: "The relic is calling, pleading to be returned from captivity..."

732124f3-4202-4f38-9fbf-62cfe759fde7.Text: "A Drukhari! What's an accursed Drukhari doing here?"

ab42195c-fcf8-45f0-9ec0-d77166aa1229.Text: "Emperor deliver us from the abominable xenos!"

820e77c2-3edd-44e8-aec6-ae4f510bdaf1.Text: "The Drukhari's harmless while the Rogue Trader's around, right? Right?"

46490536-7afa-4af0-8416-be7cf858b8f4.Text: "Light of Terra, do not forsake me in my hour of need. Do not abandon me in the dark."

d1efa215-b2d1-40e8-8daf-b331bede27ef.Text: "Protect us from the warp's terrors, from the unclean xenos, and from every evil that goes against Thy design."

eafcc50b-8dec-4d7c-bf27-810c89c551cf.Text: "May the voices of angels never fall silent in my dreams! Let me make their wishes a reality!"

2df910f7-0be2-47c4-9b77-b6805785bfe5.Text: "I shall drink of my enemies' blood; I shall feed my faith with rage; and then, I shall return to battle to reap the deaths of the unworthy."

4d29eb3c-f743-4c9a-b445-a334b161c2a8.Text: "Grant me power! Bless me with glory! Whisper to me whatever sacrifice I must give, and I will offer it gladly..."

f577a986-061d-4f99-935e-042303b82e2d.Text: "...mortify my passions, cleanse me of corruption, and vanquish my vices, for Thee I glorify, O Emperor!"

f57483f8-83c6-4cfb-854c-06859fd144f4.Text: "Ignorance will only lead us away from the Emperor's wisdom. So, go forth in search of knowledge, and fear not the path of thorns and darkness."

e609bbd9-d5a1-420b-af3b-4cac1b2b165d.Text: "Remember: ignorance is virtue, mercy is weakness, and there is no greater reward than to die in His name."

b0da49d7-9dc9-4bd5-aed9-f45d92189f65.Text: "Holy shall be the receptacle that holds the relic; tireless shall be Thy servant who lives but to labour."

17da205c-8bf1-482c-b132-87d0e4627e62.Text: There is a volunteer's mark on the servitor's forehead. This man chose lobotomy willingly and at quite a young age.

ccf962c6-aac7-4821-9782-b2d949a45b83.Text: "Let us bring His wrath down upon our foes! May their retribution be inescapable and their punishment severe."

5b7d4395-f81b-47eb-be72-5d3a3493a38c.Text: "After hearing this, I will have to spend no less than three watches praying for Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"

f6d40921-7a18-485e-b95b-52f97ed357cd.Text: "Reliquary maintenance cycle proceeding normally. No deviations from sacred protocols detected."

cb73931a-3fbe-432a-9931-e3ab7d245dba.Text: "Glory to the Angel of the Emperor!"

b8125764-4010-4276-adab-bce0e311b6e1.Text: "A holy warrior! A miracle in the flesh!"

a6d55f34-fc9a-4a77-9e81-a8a813776455.Text: "What a scrawny parody of a human."

0576721a-c4d5-445f-8c00-0df3a68707d4.Text: "I hope the xenos keeps its hands to itself."

894c5650-1227-4235-ab71-505a73c99bb0.Text: "Master Danrok is succumbing to his wounds! Get him to the chirurgeons!"

733dabf2-a732-4fc7-92a5-97b2dd16da27.Text: The machine in the shrine confessional emits a low hum as it processes the congregants' vox-recordings.

280b2697-bdc4-4b2b-9ebb-803b4ea2afd6.Text: A collection of antique weapons. Though they are no longer fit for battle, their sight continues to inspire righteous souls to new feats of glory.

0d9c2354-8264-495e-a039-aec568de2af2.Text: Among the antique weapons, you spot the maul known as the Ferrum Fatum. Legend has it that its head split when it cracked open the skull of the loathsome daemon Brenazzar the Flayer.

5a6bbf42-b550-4fb7-809b-05f7abe846f6.Text: An ancient-looking chainsword rests on the weapon rack. Its fuel engine is missing.

dd382286-be88-4399-b16d-f5455c9525bb.Text: An ancient-looking chainsword without a fuel engine rests on the weapon rack. The shape of its teeth makes you think of the Ulma Universalis, a pattern from the Angevin Crusade era.

49c7482d-83af-44f3-8531-ab52fbbd95c4.Text: The skeleton inside the sarcophagus is holding a spherical object gleaming with gold.

9eac46b9-f861-48b6-9957-3a36e0cf6e39.Text: The chapel's servants were unable to mount a resistance in time.

105ac74d-d7ea-4f82-81c3-dfe49c466e4f.Text: "The Imperium Invictum: the shards of an unknown Angevin Crusade warrior's twin blades returned from pirate captivity by the grace of the Emperor."

9270e5e1-7ea7-4cbe-af8a-580c8f836962.Text: "The Rex Regalia: the partially restored blade of Zathudas the Earnest, a missionary who decimated the abominable xenos and fell in a deathly battle against the unrighteous."

cd8738ff-6006-46bb-ad4e-e0ba607dadc9.Text: The relics are untouched, which suggests that the attackers were after something else.

df1437b9-e18a-4c9c-a08a-5cc446a50a44.Text: The reliquary has been ransacked and the sacred ashes of past Rogue Traders and their servants stolen.
