f5d4642c-f33d-4a5d-b92c-a4cc763cd548.Text: {n}Smelling the warmth of a sentient creature, the unsightly leaf latched onto the living flesh with lightning speed. If you had not destroyed it... who knows what would have become of its victim's nervous system and mind in just a few seconds?{/n}

1f3d39d0-c402-46e1-b727-d58cd0862eec.Text: {n}You have heard the stories about the unfortunate souls who were careless enough to get too close to the "brain leaf." Its fleshy fronds, each with a semblance of individual consciousness, merge with the nervous system of its victims, turning them into mindless carrier puppets.{/n}

f4bd6402-34cc-40f2-b1c2-97cd64bd275c.Text: {n}This is the first time you have encountered such a plant. It is unknown whether the ivy is the last specimen of the native fauna or part of the collection that belongs to the owner of this place.{/n}

d5189e59-ef3f-4fb9-aa3b-2bdfb41affed.Text: {n}You cast a glance at your companions.{/n}

9380d9d9-ff68-4ba6-8562-2f2650532839.Text: {n}Marazhai examines the grey leaves with genuine interest, then shifts his gaze to you and back again, keeping a respectable distance from both.{/n}

674c684b-3cfd-416d-8bdb-f408f60ea77d.Text: "How strange... This ivy coloured its surroundings in a caustic green, just like a predator singles out its prey before pouncing. Never before have I seen a plant able to cast its own colour."

66d8ffb1-011b-40dd-8bc8-2068ab6fde39.Text: "Lord Captain, my friends from the other side are whispering. They say it would be great to shelter this here broom with us. But I will say it is best not to open the door too wide when they start knocking from the other side."

6565d6a4-71d3-4458-ad08-0179fe47445e.Text: {n}The grey vine still hangs sadly from the wreckage just like it did a moment ago.{/n}

3412224a-43e5-4e5e-9262-0d55f7f0421a.Text: "But of course. This is a task for the Seneschal."

c82c39bd-2a05-45ef-b703-5bbe7f3a2c2f.Text: {n}Argenta nods eagerly.{/n} "To rescue a living being from a prison of darkness and stone is a small, but noble deed."

c82511b4-513f-41a8-b67e-ac2a1622b6fa.Text: "Don't say poor Idira didn't warn you." {n}The woman winces and cautiously reaches for the wilted wine.{/n}

a8cda4bf-b64f-4708-bcee-b47b8d6460e1.Text: "You are right, elantach. The poor thing has been suffering in the dark for a very long time."

76a47625-a652-45ba-a5eb-9adbf585068c.Text: "Thank you, but I will have to decline such dubious pleasure. My eyes are watering from the acrid green that surrounds its leaves. If it were up to me, I would order to have them chopped up right away!"

d4dd4550-4882-4aec-bd88-55255cc96f69.Text: {n}The mechadendrites swiftly and accurately pluck several fleshy leaves, deposit them in a container, and put it into your hands.{/n} "Organic life forms are not considered a research priority. However, I find your thirst for knowledge impressive."

842334ae-bb43-4907-be12-b8924c3171be.Text: {n}The interest in Marazhai's face vanishes in the blink of an eye.{/n} "I'm not going to waste my time on this. Tell someone else to do it."

70cfdb9e-52ea-4d2b-8624-2d9dee597e76.Text: {n}Ulfar looks at the plant disbelievingly.{/n} "No, Aett-Vater. He who was born on Fenris and has learned its harsh lessons can smell danger. And I say this is a baneful vine. Burn it and be done with it."

168319e7-16a0-4e5c-8afd-e06a4d155bf8.Text: {n}The meaty leaf falls onto your metal prosthetic with a slap and settles down listlessly. You wait for a while, but nothing happens.{/n}

ebc14d33-a77d-42f0-a6d3-8f6a7e4d3b6e.Text: {n}It takes an incredible effort to remain conscious, even though your body is acting against your will. You realise you are reaching for your weapon. You blink and see it in your hand. Then you blink again.{/n}

b52b1c4a-62b4-405e-a9ad-09960cb5d69b.Text: {n}And so you leave to do what you must, never to return.{/n}

e57bbe03-6fbb-4043-affd-4ea6e730c04d.Text: {n}You stretch out your hand toward the grey vine and touch the wilted leaf. A sharp pain pierces the back of your palm, but after a moment it is gone — and so is everything else. The room wavers, the floor and ceiling change places, and your stomach turns inside out.{/n}

2b136f65-379e-4d2a-818e-111491702313.Text: "N-no, I... Although perhaps you are right." {n}Cassia comes closer and touches one of the leaves with a sharpened claw.{/n} "Ow!"

3ce8840d-aa36-4c4c-86fa-e2ed8fa0fdb3.Text: {n}Kibellah carefully wraps her hand in a rag, cuts one of the leaves with her metal claws, and offers it to you.{/n} "Take caution, Domin. Living in the lower bays, one quickly learns not to touch things on a whim. I doubt we should do so in this place."

35786eec-7fef-4ee5-9f86-39cb2144c283.Text: {n}Solomorne plucks a leaf with two iron fingers and holds it out to you.{/n} "Just this? Hmm, this thing looks nasty. It's a good thing I've made it my habit to touch any suspicious objects with only my augmented hand."

157695cc-b2e1-411c-b834-04c860a428c4.Text: {n}A white veil covers your eyes — you see nothing... and you want nothing. Realisation suddenly dawns. You cannot live here. You must find a way out and slake your thirst. You must save your progeny.{/n}

9aed8972-7386-4681-ab82-26dafeb3a027.Text: The shadow auctions attract connoisseurs of forbidden artefacts. A lot this size could earn their owner a full shuttle-load of treasures.

50f11ee9-a8cb-46a6-942d-b43f35c67fce.Text: The spiky xenochest looks like a chunk of solid rock with no cracks or fractures. One side is decorated with the maw of some hideous creature.

39e33588-66aa-41d2-956e-adf028946706.Text: The scrolls with broken seals of the Ordo Xenos describe the process of studying Aeldari test subjects.

022a9322-e6ef-4d89-b0b5-9df8648269fb.Text: The mouldy pages contain knowledge of heretical sorcery. Most are crude forgeries.

e7eddca5-eac3-4900-8b99-f82b5dbc4b4a.Text: The weighty tome is bound is human skin and stitched with black thread. A gruesome symbol bleeds on the cover.

9c8ebbef-ae95-4383-96dc-a4fd071d3983.Text: "Pathetic human, your spirit is too weak to embrace such knowledge! ACCEPT YOUR PUNISHMENT!"

c745c966-eaa9-4c75-82ca-09402f7082e0.Text: "Your spirit is weak, human, and yet the court has deemed it worthy. ACCEPT A BOON FROM THE GLORIOUS RACE!"

c83e50e7-13a8-413e-9478-afac36014c5a.Text: A pile of dusty scrolls that contains nothing useful.

f3faf6be-b4ea-485d-b330-66e338a24a35.Text: The only noteworthy item among the mountain of documents and archival manuscripts is a seal with the truncated symbol of the Adeptus Administratum.

0d05cbbd-471e-430b-a101-c2dda94f9d67.Text: The table is strewn with expertly forged seals, Adeptus Administratum forms, Astra Militarum entry passes, and even an Inquisitorial rosette.

a831e96d-823b-4d38-a02f-a1d4929398de.Text: "This ancient tome seeps with decay and purple rot. Do not approach it!"

1ecf0159-181e-45b7-9712-6a7b37a79076.Text: You manage to make out a medusae's limp tentacles through the murky glass. The parasite has died regardless of what it was being kept here for.

7160ebff-941e-40dd-a32f-4af07c7ecb97.Text: This contraption was assembled by a madman. The components do not match one another and only serve to confuse and confound, but you manage to spot the hidden trigger in time. It's a trap!

152da977-8a4a-42d2-8cb9-56630d392a03.Text: Somebody carefully polished shards of Aeldari rifles and chainswords. There is a label with an individual number attached to every piece.

ce1672b4-ea13-482d-9c9b-8f112ca905f2.Text: "Don't panic! Look for the power source, we need to turn off the current!"

8214808c-efad-451c-ba60-1732628de793.Text: "Throne take me! Shoot the generator, shereen, and I will clear the way. Do not try to disable them all!"

1ba818e1-fbd1-4a4b-9bf8-107f1ae03d72.Text: "The sacred current flows through the wires to the energy generator. Tame it, and the path will open before you!"

698ddfdf-001e-4690-904d-a346e4851bfb.Text: "Elantach, you should cut power to the electric shackles and then rid us of these tripwires. Act swiftly!"

be08ecb5-0f03-43c2-97ee-80923f72afb1.Text: The fresh corpse in fancy attire, likely that of an adventurer rather than a smuggler.

efc3bed9-cbeb-4f3e-8505-0736d734abdf.Text: Light flickers on a metallic figurine, one depicting a mysterious alien amphibian.

facfe6f5-a9ee-43c4-bc25-3362ce0a1e4b.Text: The weapons, the treasure chest, and the rare xeno-artefacts were here the entire time... But somehow you had not noticed them before.

ffd082d8-0ed0-412a-bec8-8e7149ad3faa.Text: Priceless xenos weapons, jewellery, and peculiar artefacts... You have not noticed them here before.

a5c7f3be-cce1-4495-b7e0-aba69a4085c9.Text: "The servants of the Omnissiah fear and despise such tech-heresy. More than once I have been required to punish the wicked souls who succumbed to the temptation of xenotech."

7197eb4e-57ed-49af-9538-c7b25dc7f929.Text: "Get back or this creature will turn you into mindless slaves!"

8a733128-92e0-4770-81c5-d1c328b9cb09.Text: "I have seen this place before... This poor fellow was happily sitting on a mountain of gold, and then he drowned in a torrent of blood."

4589d37e-de75-439c-b4ef-ec857fae960f.Text: The reserves of promethium fuelling the local generators have almost run out.

d601cea0-acb7-4785-9eee-fd580f0a3ae6.Text: The containers are stuffed to the brim with dry rations and corpse starch. Such quantity of provisions could feed a small detachment for months.

32ef61fc-5fbe-4099-99f2-3566e639238a.Text: The containers are covered with unknown markings and stamps.

0c049ea9-2a2b-4832-8a47-394f73583de2.Text: According to the labels, the containers with insulated uniforms and snowshoes were to be delivered to an Astra Militarum quartermaster on the frozen world, Zenerag II.

b05da95f-0454-4d55-ad61-17f1d2ff580a.Text: "Scrap metal and chequered patterns. But of course. It's an unspoken rite of passage for a Cold Trader to fleece an Ork at least once."

b0bdf42e-8ad3-412b-8746-76807677fa78.Text: "An excellent place to hide one's ill-gotten gains from prying eyes. Stay sharp, they will not be happy to see us here."

2af76c7c-af2f-4938-8f71-0539b3b4c0d4.Text: "Shereen, I was thinking. We cannot just leave this... xenoheresy lying here. Allow my guys to do the heavy lifting, and I will owe you."

91f06721-56d4-4b7e-ac24-a9a22d414647.Text: "The mindless mon-keigh could not have earned the gifts of the Dark City! Who has dared to bring them here?"

961b3672-ee40-42f5-ad43-24ca2ad117d1.Text: "Hah, at long last we can have some fun!"

5d38c6d7-7a58-406c-bd2f-ad9fdb8f5b63.Text: The artefact looks unstable and may summon another wave of xenos at any moment.

7883f212-b8f4-440c-bf0c-373f56085d83.Text: The artefact has exhausted its power and will remain dormant until the sphere is returned to its core and collects enough energy.

367a91ed-3bd3-4601-b052-4d12e10aa133.Text: There are handprints on the dusty surface. Something was recently taken from here.

b60761bd-941b-4d65-8e45-19a88174e3c7.Text: The particularly strong Orks wear hulking, impenetrable armour, complete with a lethal weapon not entirely dissimilar to a power claw.

f11054b1-7be7-49ee-8398-09c5309567cf.Text: A huge metal jaw is painted red and covered in hundreds of dents. It is heavy.

3dabd0f1-e05c-4268-8540-047d102c77ac.Text: A fragment of an Ork energy weapon capable of teleporting targets using warp energy. Roughly sawed off with a las-cutter, cannot be repaired.

6541b266-ab98-476f-ad2d-5687010fa528.Text: Fossilised teeth, pieces of armour painted with a chequered pattern, rusty metal parts and other rubbish.

ba168b4a-caa0-4553-ab6e-b34729f0ec80.Text: Strange improvised weapons are laid out on top of the crates: a rocket on a stick, an ugly black-and-white chequered gun, rusty axes, and brass knuckles.

32273709-1c5f-4bb2-8d2a-8153f523005d.Text: "It is imperative that we rid this world of xenotech, which defies the teachings of the Machine God and the very essence of His laws. With your permission, my servitors will later cleanse this place."

176ff325-904a-4e09-a360-5d5ab7abda11.Text: "Once this great vessel was filled with the hum of servomotors and the trill of sacred electrics! But the machine spirits have forsaken this place."

c79e5d2e-21e8-40cf-8dac-2f4c39b307d7.Text: Implants resembling the limbs of an enormous insect are stacked inside of an airtight container. A note taped to the lid says: "Ram-gol, rak-mol... eh, screw it! Push this on some not-very-bright customer."

e87fd8eb-b002-4af8-ac85-31963aa2c567.Text: The grav-bike has been gently washed clean of traces of soot and blood. The attached label reads: "Ordered by Master M. L. D."

7bf2b6c0-003a-4f71-ac80-b5ef3d8c4bfe.Text: "Fresh delivery from Merd'Kee: Aeldari weapons — 5 containers, Ork rubbish — 10 containers, Drukhari armour (cha-ching, baby!) — 3 units, unidentified xenos shit (what, again? I asked them not to bring this to us anymore!) — ??? units."

77de2365-125e-45a2-8e5c-167d3444bcdb.Text: The machine spirit does not react to your attempts to revive the cogitator.

08a1f7fc-73fe-4c66-813d-910530337b60.Text: "Surprise, you {mf|ugly bastard|vile wench}! Didn't expect this turn of events, did you? Thought you could just waltz in here? If you're not dead yet, watch your back from now on — this is just the beginning!"

bf208e0a-3a2a-42f8-91da-8a089f571dfe.Text: "You're still breathing, I hope? I plan to draw out your suffering. Make you beg for mercy the way my boys begged when they were dying from your blasted xenos toys!"

3f216337-9555-432d-8b32-63b478e8b6e3.Text: "You see these corpses? These fine lads and lasses paid the price for my greed. And for your lies. We'll both be receiving the Emperor's punishment, of that you can be certain!"

acd970c0-4368-4d9e-8468-cd7280e84cfd.Text: "Curse you, Merd'Kee! Curse the day I threw in my lot with you! Die from your own wares, you xenos filth!"

05fe080a-29c4-42f0-86db-e7c595b6653c.Text: "Get back, Rogue Trader! This tome is full of heresy, you best not touch it!"

90144912-3860-4570-82b4-9c39087d1bce.Text: "I would advise against touching this possessed artefact if you still value your soul."

d79fe6ae-04ce-469c-b65e-55ce5afa27fe.Text: "Stop! When the spirit is weighed, there are only two outcomes for the mortal flesh... Reward or punishment... Judgement comes!"

70007ca9-150e-440c-aff6-c82c2ce5bb87.Text: A xenos race called T'au employs self-aware machines they call "drones." Judging by the marks on the hull, this specimen was gutted quite deftly.

d0c98c4a-59f3-43e5-b1a5-526b67dd3e0d.Text: A self-propelled rail carriage that once transported hive residents between stations.

d48b5c5f-8f9e-4014-a2af-7ca12374a82d.Text: Empty canisters, dry ration wrappers, and petrified faeces. Someone was cooped up here for a long time.

bc34a475-8b40-4ed6-ab86-46377e1ebbb3.Text: "Glorious! I was starting to get bored."

8f107007-11b4-4f04-a7e1-172686ed5dcf.Text: "Kae-morag! The sacred armaments of the Children of Asuryan must rest with the fallen, not serve these mon-keigh scavengers!"

bf3a7f8d-723f-46d4-a2ca-77654b703397.Text: {n}The weighty tome is bound in the skin of a human face, laced with a cord woven from tendons. A sinister crimson symbol dominates the cover, but it is difficult for you to make out. The details elude your scrutiny and the strokes twist and shift, furthering the confusion.{/n}

74573310-6ad9-43ee-be92-533b23312e36.Text: {n}The fiery tongues reluctantly lap away the taint of heresy from the book, their warm colours fading as they engulf the tome. The bloody symbol on the cover melts, and you hear a shriek so loud that the pain pierces your eardrums. The final flash reveals the heretical sigil in full, but only a moment later, you cannot recall what it looked like.{/n}

4a6caf4d-e207-4cb0-b3ea-e10bbb57016a.Text: {n}A hundred hands writhe under your skin, seeking to force their way through, some in and some out. Your eyeballs push at their lids and sizzle, ready to pop. You grit your teeth and remind yourself that all this is just an illusion conjured by the dark sorcery of the warp.{/n}

11b5d126-eaf2-49eb-b4ef-acd7f7f4cbe9.Text: {n}A hundred hands writhe under your skin, seeking to force their way through, some in and some out. Your eyeballs push at their lids and sizzle, ready to pop. You open your mouth to scream, instead spewing out a torrent of dark blood. The agony ends only when you lose consciousness...{/n}

c67ac0cc-5d8f-4e87-87d2-5489fa49bb2b.Text: {n}Touching the book makes your hands tingle and you feel a spell of dizziness coming on. The symbols on the pages rearrange themselves, vowing vicious torment, and the stretched face on the cover starts to resemble your own.{/n}

60051123-3b8e-4c23-b3de-bb166ee49342.Text: {n}Feeling that nothing good can come of it, you slam the book shut.{/n}

ae7f8da5-b9b4-4d33-94fe-c429eba1e586.Text: {n}With every page, the pain in your body intensifies, and an ominous voice echoes in your head, whispering in an unknown dialect.{/n}

fe05c387-1a4a-4552-a426-7b3859ff0223.Text: {n}The rustling builds and builds, culminating in a wild, undulating shriek. You feel your skull burst into a thousand bony splinters piercing every inch of your body. An insatiable desire to slash and maim fills your very being. The few moments of struggle feel like an eternity but end in your triumph. The delinquent writings that fill the tome faintly echo in your mind until finally, they fall silent.{/n}

e57024a1-91e6-405c-8780-803fd3afc9df.Text: {n}You walk away, struggling to suppress the urge to come back and glimpse under the cover.{/n}

0551fb4e-474f-45d5-ac1d-b4d1bff39705.Text: {n}When you wake up, you still tremble at the memory of the suffering you have endured.{/n}

52b13d5d-ca74-453e-a7c6-ec51ad212587.Text: "Marazhai, what do you need the stones for?"

b97fb2cf-15c1-4434-8ee2-f697757a7c6f.Text: "The stones are my prize. I am taking them."

c5b03767-31d8-4bbb-8c77-e7c27113e97e.Text: "What?.." {n}Yrliet's face betrays her surprise. When she speaks, there is sadness in her words:{/n} "How could the spirit stones of my kin end up in such a gods-forsaken place? Elantach, please, allow me to watch over them."

74e5dff8-9d73-4702-9c2f-29314151f291.Text: "I could perform a three-night ballad about the creation of the first stone, but alas, you do not have the luxury of eternity's favour. You should know what is important — the stones shield the spirits of the {g|Encyclopedia:Asuryani}Children of Asuryan{/g} from the insatiable thirst of Sai'lanthresh after they die. They also enable the ancestors to share their wisdom, even sometimes lending us strength to fight our enemies."

6010bec0-1fb8-4d47-9537-7849955c331e.Text: "Your words are like a breath of fresh air, elantach. I will take good care of them."

38a6798d-8e1a-45ed-be4d-6d440e0911d3.Text: "Or {name} can give them to me." {n}Marazhai's voice is dripping with dark hunger.{/n} "I will find for them a proper use."

2a4c04d5-5967-4d7a-9b9a-cb9de82320b8.Text: "These smuggler wannabes were hardly aware of the true value of this treasure. If you ask me, shereen, these stones can be sold to a reliable and very rich collector at a profit. And when I say at a profit, I mean it."

301b2631-415b-49b1-8fdc-36422601f0c6.Text: "Someday you will trade your soul away for trifles. I just hope I will not be around when it happens."

28c7a1ab-dd94-4dc8-b1f5-4a7e2ebc66ff.Text: "Imagine you have a heart just ripped from your enemy's breast. It seems fragile and fluttering, but clutch it in your hand, and it will tear open the skin and plunge you into an ocean of sensation. It's a torment and ecstasy that make your blood boil and your soul burn in agony... Oh yes, I will find a good use for the useless spirits powering these stones."

0e653b33-f231-4281-a42a-e9231b180379.Text: {n}Marazhai's dark eyes light up with a malicious fire.{/n} "It will be my pleasure, {name}."

14b91e33-a478-432a-921f-35ddcd71cb50.Text: "I certainly do, shereen! You can be certain of it!"

04da8d8f-9e72-481c-a177-f446f6bb779e.Text: "No!" {n}Yrliet showers you with a stream of Aeldari speech so fast the Elucidator cannot keep up. Exasperated, she turns away.{/n}

1ab18fb2-1243-4a6e-bc9a-7cc4c36aa65f.Text: "How long do you intend to torment my kin? The elantach is no fool and {mf|he|she} will not indulge your malice and hatred!"

c871b88f-29a7-4457-8247-2be49fb83427.Text: "Big Pugh lost what little remained of his mind since Merd'Kee brought in the latest xenotech haul. I understand that in our business every man looks after himself, but Merd'Kee doesn't even blink an eye when his booby traps mangle our fellows! We spent three days mopping up blood and he just kept dragging more rubbish into his cabin, nursing that vile chunk of stellar metal and glaring at everyone like a wild beast. Throne be my witness, I will personally cut the Stryxis down with a chainsword if {mf|he|she} brings us another dangerous artefact! We're honest Cold Traders, not heretics!"

fd4d8470-9642-4212-b969-46f00a43d86f.Text: Still warm to the touch. Barely perceptible electrical impulses ripple through the veins of metal, making it glow.

60fda272-0f1c-42e6-8f38-67532e3deefe.Text: The pictograms are embossed on a perfectly smooth surface, but when you try to read them your head begins to spin, and the symbols inexplicably change their positions right before your eyes.

f3ad9efa-3ecd-4f17-861e-f6c1b1bdb930.Text:
"- Jen, did you hear? They're going to bring in another batch of xenotech. Life is going to be good!
- Idiot, we still haven't dealt with the previous delivery. The clients don't wish to take risks after... Well, after the accidents.
- Who cares! There are people with more money than common sense in every system. You know what matters? That's right, what matters is that we are making mountains of thrones.
- I've got a bad feeling about this.
- Jen, turn that frown upside down! You'll start looking like our wrinkly supplier lad if you don't... Or is she our supplier lass? Whatever."

9215ad64-2f13-44fd-a539-42e3482e7b1e.Text:
"- Hey, Doe, what are you messing with? The big guy said not to touch the goods.
- Bugger off, Arlie. And mind your own business.
- He has ears everywhere, you know.
- I said, bugger off! I'm not going to rot in this hole until Pugh gets his shit together.
- Throne take you, Doe, we've already lost four men because of this xenos shit! Put the stones down, mate, what'd ya say we wet the old whistle instead.
- ...
- Doe, what are you doing? What are you doing, Doe? N-no, no, get away from me! A-a-argh!"

42d3919c-4b72-454a-b90c-b8bdc42ccc37.Text:
"- It's alive, a-a-alive!
- What? Why are you screaming?
- That th-thing! It's just latched onto Luffa's face, and she went mad!
- Throne be damned...
- Cut it off, cut it!
***
- H-hey, guys, w-what's wrong?
- We're missing the Drukhari crates, lad.
- B-but I was told to look after the...
*The sounds of several bursts of bolter fire*
***
- Run, run, run, run!
- What the... Oh, Throne take me!
- A-a-a-argh!"

50df9dc3-b8e4-4a04-abc8-2298900a18d0.Text: [Disconnect the power supply to the tracks]

13a4d6df-0dc2-4f89-af8d-40e29b098f85.Text: {n}A subdued rumbling comes from under the cover of the ancient cogitator, as if the machine spirits resent being awakened. After a few simple directions from the control panel, the vid-screen flashes to life and starts blinking, waiting for your input.{/n}

e8d4a423-4681-474f-a567-098a74d39021.Text: {n}The mechanism lazily grinds its gears but grants you access to the requested information.{/n}

b133ccb4-64b6-4021-b9fe-1183a9aed096.Text:
"Day twenty-one, third month of the cycle...
Now that's what I call good fortune! We hit the jackpot. This xenos peddler, a Stryxis, sure did show up in time, the competitors have been popping up like fleas on a half-dead rat. Merd'Kee has already brought a bunch of rare and exotic shit, and I have never been paid this much for a single order before. Life is good thanks to him (or her?), and is going to get even better!"

a50126eb-c6b5-4d65-bd2b-9e3a8017c2e0.Text:
"Received: 6 crates of tech upgrades, 4 blocks of T'au firearms, 8 units of miscellaneous Drukhari devices.
Sold: 7 units of Aeldari devices, 5 Ork weapon crates, 3 units of T'au artefacts.
Awaiting delivery."

d14d8eed-25c0-4f88-b0f3-9387c3657fe9.Text: {n}A relay clicks inside the dusty machine.{/n}

aa70a178-ceec-4ea8-a2a3-f092e8fc58f8.Text: {n}The whirring of the obsolete cogitator's mechanisms grows into a strained whine, and the crackling from the abandoned tracks abruptly stops.{/n}

cb7f3868-123b-418f-a181-10bec6418ff0.Text:
"Received: 8 crates of Ork armour, 12 blocks of Drukhari blades, 10 units of Aeldari devices.
Sold: 8 units of Drukhari devices, 3 blocks of T'au firearms, 15 units of devices belonging to an unknown race.
Overhead Costs: disposal of bodies. Keeping an eye on Doe. I've got a bad feeling this won't be the last of it."

632542d9-a52e-4d5d-97dd-ccab868fc7a6.Text:
"Received: 24 units of unidentified artefacts. Let them stay unidentified and in my room.
Sold: 18 units of Drukhari, Aeldari, and Ork firearms.
Stolen: ???
My own people are stealing from me now! What did that scoundrel Merd'Kee promise them? I'm going to find out, and there will be trouble."

e13d420d-bb53-49bb-a1ff-8203e7a714bf.Text:
"Day six of the ninth month of the cycle...
It is time to end this. The thrones are coming in faster than I can spend them, but I am starting to lose count of the people who died. Yesterday, I walked past a dozen of my people and couldn't recognise four. The customers are starting to ask why there's so much blood on the delivery crates.
Damned if I believe that crooked-ass xenos rat again! His deliveries are killing my guys, and there haven't even been any shootouts. Next time Merd'Kee comes here, he won't be leaving this place alive. I'll make sure of it."

d79da1d2-7e51-4ee7-a1f0-1764d18aa165.Text: "Ugh... We are not done just yet. We need to turn on the ventilation system, quickly!"

68e9e536-7730-471b-9929-cac1d18a6971.Text: All the panel says is, "Emergency lockdown engaged. Officer access key required."

6d294758-1b34-4b5b-a669-2cd4ad905ed6.Text: The panel is flickering with green light.

8448af04-f5e1-417e-9735-e786bc95bb77.Text: "My lungs are still full of poison, {name}. What we need is the emergency ventilation system."

1bb8b501-ae3b-403a-ad23-2be7b08274dd.Text: Some unknown accident caused the elevator shaft to collapse. Reaching the lower levels at this point would require sending a mining team.

1d9718cf-a34d-43c1-b488-fc121fb67d61.Text: Someone sawed off the emergency stairs and tried to conceal the damage.

315a941f-9af3-4af1-b957-50f532f1ecba.Text: The words on the sign are barely legible: "Fa lity XVII. Pla ry D enc Forc s."

7ac251f1-b201-4c8a-bb81-2fdaf2029770.Text: "At last... I can breathe freely... I was afraid I would faint before long!"

92f7a0d5-122c-4ca7-9443-ad4e4b57f6b6.Text: A decontamination shower — a rare sight for regular Planetary Forces. Its purpose is to eliminate harmful agents.

be72aafc-281f-477e-ae91-c04b7efeecfb.Text: The mummified corpse has its arm outstretched toward the exit. On the soldier's neck is a broken respirator adorned with the Imperial Aquila.

675b5f1a-9db4-4d89-b157-be9a5982b269.Text: "Some fresh air at last. Truly we are at fault for taking such things for granted."

47f84deb-dbde-4f17-85eb-dcb6abe59126.Text: "Ack! I thought my head was killing me because of the gas... but the gas is all gone. It's the dead. Lamenting their own sorry fate."

0d011c0b-d7b5-46d9-8872-36f96097c470.Text: Corrosion was merciless to these old Imperial bayonets, chainswords, and lasguns.

b0d8a92e-e822-4731-b4c2-f97aa6344ae8.Text: Several crates of dry rations survived to this day. Each one bears a seal with the coat of arms of the Winterscale dynasty.

e3082b88-d356-4986-8033-eab579ee8461.Text: The machine spirits are silent, their hunger unsatisfied by the backup generator.

b917a3f3-94d4-42f6-ab3b-25e40d1dfd01.Text: "Shereen, even my bionic lungs can no longer handle the hospitality of this charming place. Is it, perhaps, a good time to turn on the ventilation system?"

54126e2d-d631-421e-99e9-e8076659d486.Text: It looks like the bunker still has a working generator.

cf5e26c9-67be-4026-bba8-02eb856dc6ef.Text: A valve is required to regulate the flow.

f369ff82-9f61-4840-b9f2-1c31f3e66372.Text: Yellowish gas is slowly seeping through the rusted air duct system.

a6e7384b-12ec-4a8d-b171-41acebbaed6e.Text: "The basic rituals have been performed. The spirits of the sacred machine humbly await the order to activate the emergency ventilation system."

042f77ea-4da2-4ce1-93db-c49918a88437.Text: "It seems that the poisonous vapours somehow found their way into the bunker's ventilation system."

2a62fade-7e3d-43f4-bf57-cd1aabeadbdf.Text: "I hear whispers... They are telling me to embrace the long sleep..."

79e3145f-1119-461a-b87e-8fa614828630.Text: "Aahhh... All these vapours are making me sleepy..."

3efac325-b6cd-4d81-9b82-2eb122029b06.Text: "It seems the soldiers fell asleep all at once. And never woke again."

6cf4d40e-1390-4cac-a38c-b2a47eb6c539.Text: There is nothing useful among these rough old scrolls.

e7ae8034-4b85-4e85-8168-fe54b74d0904.Text: A few parchments bearing the Winterscale seal contain plans for military operations and a mention of the Doomsday Weapon.

485334fe-8ff5-4682-a52d-24d8b64679c6.Text: "Hold fast! The Star Allies are with us!"

253a5c5c-0a3c-45ad-a3d9-e59baa209afa.Text: "For our families, for peace, for honour!"

5a9db537-32f3-4220-9d4f-474788cb1ada.Text: "Let us purge our world of betrayers of the Imperium!"

fbf13c5c-66ac-4f1a-9dbd-3c543da118df.Text: A rusted reservoir for storing drinking water. It is only half-full.

17f6c31a-ed47-41b8-b02c-af0da9aa4c55.Text: "The mon-keigh poisoned this world, and then the world destroyed them. At least the primitive technologies they left behind can spare us from suffering the same fate."

3690a891-a5c2-4931-9095-bee7f972cb2b.Text: Rusted part used by the military in rudimentary life support systems.

6c17e5b6-43bc-4e0f-8378-9f4e16a7a8be.Text:
"Entry C. It's been a hundred cycles, and these idiots are still none the wiser about who they saved from the storm. Going back to my camp is no longer an option — damned rats chewed through the protective suit, and these pissants are out of repair materials.
Entry CIV. There are some decent people here. Just civilians, like my mother. This one girl, Zimmy, even made a habit of coming by in the after hours. She asked me to teach her the letters — so she can write to her father who went to the surface two turns ago. Foolish child. The war has taken its toll on both sides. Hold on, am I sympathising with the enemy? I better put a stop to this.
Entry CX. I was finally allowed entry to the upper levels, and, lo and behold, what did I find there? The same supply crates as those gifted to our lords by the Star Allies! The same rations as we've been eating, the same weapons as we've been fighting with! So our lives have simply been toyed with...
??? If Winterscale has betrayed us, I must report this to the command. No matter the cost.
??? I got my hands on a cutter and decommissioned a few blocks of explosives. No one noticed a thing.
??? I bribed the archivist with a dozen rations — now I just need to get the schematics for the life support systems.
??? Rats brought disease from the surface, the medicae unit is packed. Just the right time for a quick short circuit.
??? Zimmy drank the poisoned water and vomited a lot of blood. The schematics were inaccurate. But now I know for certain which pipes go to the living module and which to the barracks.
??? The senior comm officer suspects something.
??? It's time."

f7e3b45a-26a7-407a-ad9a-495eeac238ad.Text: "Three hundred and forty-eight years ago, our ancestors arrived on this blooming world, built the cities and the manufactorums, and founded here a society free from heresy and fear. But the Immortal Emperor of Humanity, Warden of Light, saw fit to test our faith — a great war tore open a rift between our ancestors, dividing them into two factions and turning the world into a boundless battlefield. Each day, we fought the enemy, so that our children could see the dawn of a new era — an era without blood, pain, and tears. Brave people, living and dead, paved with their bodies the road to our future. And one day, the skies answered our prayers — the Great Star Allies descended from the darkness of the cosmos and bestowed upon our great army the Doomsday Weapon. And so we brought righteous anger upon our foes, and ended the centuries-long war, and welcomed the dawn of the new era! The universe will hardly notice our deed, but the God-Emperor sees all. We, children of a great nation, must dedicate ourselves to this sacred mission — to survive and revivify this world, as the most beautiful flowers are revivified from ashes. And hence do not despair, sons and daughters of the Imperium, for our Star Allies are behind us, and the God of Humanity is with us! I know that help is coming, and soon the skies overhead will shine once more!"

f9386e26-f22f-4117-ae7a-770e7828bf32.Text:
"I'm tired. How long has it been since Doomsday? I think it was the thirty-sixth year when the heretical cholera wiped out half of our people, including the old bookkeeper, Heilgar. Time has stood still for us since. It was so long ago... and what a convenient solution to the overpopulation problem, hah! The commanders think we bought this 'coincidence.' Morons. Still, when I look in the mirror, I see my father — the same wrinkles by the eyes, grey temples. Which means that I'm over sixty. And we've been underground for longer than half a century. No sky, no sun, no joy. And no hope. If that damned propagandist scribe tells me one more time that I 'must not lose faith' — I will make him eat his own tongue!
Sure, we were once so certain that we had won — the weapon of the Great Ally boggled the mind. I still remember how the skies shook, before me and my ma and father were evacuated to this wretched bunker. But where has it led us? When I took over my father's post at the comm station, I learned that we had long since lost all communication with other PDF bases. And the stars respond to our calls with silence.
These days we don't hear any bombs landing outside, but things are still restless in the old bunker — first a water purifier failure, then a fire in the medicae unit. Rats chewed holes in the exposure suits, and now we can't go up to the surface anymore. Are these accidents? Or have we had a saboteur in our midst all these years? I'll keep an eye on the troops. I don't believe in miracles, but... we still have enough supplies on the lower levels to last us another fifty years or so. If Yuald can finally sort the air duct problem, that is! Next time we meet, I should ask how the repairs are going."

f8ee1020-5950-4c8f-b373-5eb0feebc745.Text: "First I hear some wicked laughter, now I'm seeing higher-ups in our dump... Must be going mad!"

15f077f2-9d77-416f-b132-3380f91ae5d9.Text: "I barely have anything left, but I'll give it all to you! Just please don't kill me!"

6a9f7a31-53c5-491d-a3b3-b8bf1a30c8c6.Text: "Have m-mercy! I... I've already been robbed blind!"

3ab6f6f3-d5bc-4b3c-845a-21ab584c8cad.Text: "A person of your status, here...? Please, have mercy on us!"

d2999687-3cc3-46d6-81f3-e0bfceb58e06.Text: "Huh? Who's there? That terrifying laughter... that wasn't you, was it...?"

bf38509b-1aaf-4d8a-a606-7c160eb4dc07.Text: "What... What was that just now? I only remember eerie laughter and darkness all around me..."

b112eddd-9a07-473a-b022-5d38a883d66c.Text: "Hey, that's mine— T-take it, take it! No need for guns..."

71337a2c-8fd4-43b6-9705-0b7c86f28990.Text: A toxic flow of murky liquid comes down from the higher levels via ancient, rusted pipes.

ef1fb4de-35c9-47a9-ba30-9154d4034ac5.Text: This filthy excuse for a table is smeared with someone's dinner consisting of algae and corpse starch.

9bb7bea6-9b91-46b4-99a7-76412e35bf03.Text: Other than the fact that the stains on this dirty wall resemble a symbol of some kind, you do not see anything of note.

65e143ae-bd29-45ea-823b-09f5b6e19903.Text: You feel a slight prickling sensation at the back of your head. The barrier between the worlds has grown so thin here that you can feel a breeze coming from the other side...

0d9cb2cf-230f-4ac5-ac4d-1f3dfbb473b9.Text: You hear shrill, baleful giggling coming from behind you, and it is getting louder. But there is no one there...

405d4ebe-a027-4508-81a0-2dd41a7dcdf8.Text: The wall is black with dirt and soot.

e4fd49ee-fa23-4ab0-91ab-2dd5e3fea4b3.Text: Under the layer of soot and grime, you notice an unholy symbol scratched into the wall, and one look at it is enough to make you nauseous. Someone is watching you.

9270a8f5-dfc9-4c11-8839-48bd4e677a2d.Text: Shoddy utensils, flimsy stools, and greasy mattresses stand by the entrance, strewn with rags. This must be someone's pitiful dwelling.

58948d8f-3799-4926-ab5a-8943f1123be6.Text: The voices belonging to the many residents of the lower levels merge into a single humming noise — unnerving and oppressive, much like the surrounding catacombs.

462a5527-65a6-4996-b7b7-58dcf07ec36e.Text: "I like your weapon — gonna take it for myself!"

5f1d0f8a-92b2-4035-ad51-70c76b93a8ef.Text: "I don't know who you are, but you showed up on my turf for nothing. Kill everyone!"

810a23f2-5a8b-42b8-8d4b-6341b035c2a0.Text:
A thick diary filled with entries written in neat, precise handwriting. Its author was documenting the events of his life with thoroughness bordering on obsession. After browsing through its pages, the following entries catch your attention:
{br}
"Exodus. Watch 1.
Never thought this day would come — I'm addressed as 'master captain' once more. How many times did I swear never to venture into the void again during those two Terran years I spent among the mangled ruins of the Unheralded Reckoning's bridge? Unfortunately, life in a gravity well didn't bring me peace.
Reverend Hieronymus promised me that performing a selfless feat of devotion would bring me serenity. Maybe he's right. But I'm still writing in this journal during the long nights to keep my sanity. Just like I did for two years There and seven Terran years after that Here. We'll see if I'll be able to live without the Somewhere that is our Wasteland Wayfarer's destination.
{br}
Exodus. Watch 237.
The crew has reported hearing strange noises from the ventilation shafts for a third time. Alas, I'm charged with pilgrims, not seasoned voidsmen: the venture scares them, and they've already managed to make up their share of absurd ghost stories. I asked Reverend Gravik to calm them down. He's the official head of the pilgrimage, so they ought to listen to him.
{br}
Exodus. Watch 240.
The vent inspection is finished. Just as expected, there was nothing to worry about, just some torn tubing striking the hull.
{br}
Exodus. Watch 393.
Reverend Hieronymus was wrong. Faith does not bring me peace. I prefer not to take any sides in the theological dispute that has broken out aboard our vessel, ignoring the debates altogether. I'll let Reverend Gravik handle it. I'm slightly concerned about this schism, but as long as both groups are peaceful and agree to follow my orders, they can bicker and shout all they want.
{br}
Exodus. Watch 810.
The Great Day has arrived. The Wasteland Wayfarer has successfully landed on the planet's surface. I wonder if it'll ever leave it.
A settlement is already being built down the hill. Its official colonial designation is AIII-649-Minoris, but Reverend Gravik said he's going to name it Jesevon.
When we first stepped onto the surface, Reverend Gravik's congregation and the Nourishers used different airlocks to leave the vessel. Seems like they've ceased any and all communication.
{br}
Exodus. Watch 1212.
Today the last pilgrims left the Wayfarer for Jesevon. I'm alone once again. They invited me to go with them, but I made up an excuse about needing to keep watch at the reactor since my ship is still used for powering the settlement. Truth be told, I just didn't want to go with them.
They say less than a thousand pilgrims are still loyal to Gravik. The services at the main temple are performed by the Nourishers, and the Saint Drusus statue is cut only up to its knees. I can't understand their beliefs, but I don't think they will help me more than Reverend Hieronymus's faith.
{br}
Exodus. Watch 1287.
I was awoken in the night by a dozen pilgrims from Jesevon. They were armed and scared and said the Nourishers had arrested Reverend Gravik.
They were bewildered and didn't know what to do, wanting me to act. So act I did. Since Reverend Gravik is the official head of the pilgrimage, I deemed this an incident of civil unrest. I cut power to Jesevon and demanded Reverend Gravik's release via vox-comm.
We are holding the line.
{br}
Exodus. Watch 1290.
The Nourishers have come to us. Gravik was with them. He was calm and said that the conflict had been resolved. He took the confused pilgrims and their guns with him, and I restored power to the settlement.
I have no idea what's going on.
{br}
Peace. The watch is of no consequence.
Today I received the brotherly kiss, and now I Believe. I can clearly see the spiral path among the stars set for us by the Emperor-Progenitor. Now I can hear my brothers and sisters. I am finally alone no more."

7d749cc3-d2f1-4953-b720-c40925cde01f.Text: "Hmm. This will do for an ambush. Lord Captain, I advise you to post some of your people here."

e0f83eb4-db86-4916-83c5-ad593847e96e.Text: "That ventilation grille. It's a suitable place to wait for our guests to arrive."

74087f23-0ded-4677-8336-76f533a9389e.Text: "Take a look at this, shereen. You couldn't ask for a better spot to set a trap."

ba221414-1ea8-47b4-b5d9-ad3b5efa9fe3.Text: "The machine spirits of these sacred devices demand a rite of calibration. Once it is performed, they will be willing to serve you."

e8893f64-003d-4b68-98ec-6ded35ce88e9.Text: Show the data on the vid-screen

98eab69f-5322-4fbc-a62f-ecc8932da658.Text: "Two days ago, another chapel of the God-Emperor burned down under mysterious circumstances... Locals say they heard explosions..."

c4c0fafb-3ae8-49e8-936a-d14afa41b979.Text: "Well, now... What strange times we live in, my lord. Who would have thought that someone would dare to challenge His rule over us all?"

9c203c24-25b6-4643-9057-598dc0dcb996.Text: "Lower your voice. We should not attract unwanted attention."

5639a906-139f-412e-afa2-d9d2dc29b094.Text: "I did not mean to belittle the Beacon's greatness... Still, you are right. I will say no more."

0f0fa1dd-71c4-4ca5-9223-bbc2756f2907.Text: "Our {mf|lord|lady}'s priests visited these halls recently. They said they were looking for... rebellious minds."

6282a95a-f49c-4fff-a7db-7b9d85d059f4.Text: "Why look here, in the Rogue Trader's domain? There are plenty of insolent ecclesiarchs in the city."

95ac59c4-5fe3-4ea0-a0f9-33756073e24e.Text: "Ha. I believe their numbers have been culled quite thoroughly of late. Now they hunt those who practise the old faith in secret."

ddf17a95-02af-4641-85d1-c2debe76e3b6.Text: "It makes sense. There is a danger in those who do not openly accept the Great Beacon as their true {mf|master|mistress}."

1035fe70-6bae-43fb-b5f6-a4ed4283ce68.Text: "It is a boon to stand in your presence, Great Beacon!"

47d3d495-8f71-4ab5-bd0d-8bd62478b580.Text: "Great Beacon, your will is my command!"

36dad547-8fd6-4816-b1ec-310b67c7613a.Text: "I have heard so much about your benevolent deeds... It is an honour to speak with you!"

513ef483-2c58-4f80-b888-6acd564ad79f.Text: "The soul of your people is with you, {name}!"

92568cbc-3386-441e-b2c7-748687a1e73f.Text: "The morning service at the palace temple was simply marvellous! Now I can scarcely believe that sermons used to put me to sleep..."

c7de68b6-f6f6-421d-9c18-26ee0b12618d.Text: "I will agree that much has changed under the dynasty's new leadership. {name} von Valancius inspires staunch devotion in all of us."

59a1cb51-2fca-416c-ba3c-8da94a44e739.Text: "I gave the order for one third of my estates to be turned into enforcer barracks. Bringing Dargonus to piety demands sacrifices of all!"

9586f12a-ca1e-4592-9397-546e3c295c5c.Text: "Indeed. I am surprised that some of the von Valancius servants yet cling to the heresy of hubris."

fd218ddd-59b2-4207-a6b9-828bd920a2fe.Text: "We can be thankful that their numbers are dwindling by the day. I am sure you heard the news about the Cariti family?"

4a8e1995-ebf3-4c14-8c6f-1a9cd6695b1a.Text: "Of course. And if you were to ask my opinion, I would say they finally received their comeuppance. They had sown discord with their brash speeches about their own rights long enough. It is small wonder that they erased this shameful stain from the face of Dargonus."

4a75e4d5-2e1b-46a0-9953-3d0d26c55c6a.Text: "Glory to the hero of the Imperium! Glory to House von Valancius!"

08ef7766-ea22-429c-b2e1-3bd78b9e70b0.Text: "For your deeds, you ought to be recognised as a saint of the Imperium, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"

15db5f97-af99-42d2-a843-132fbda4ea01.Text: {n}Clementia bows low to you.{/n} "Welcome back, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! No doubt, your path was blessed by the God-Emperor Himself, for your deeds in His name are manifold and renowned!"

f365ed07-62c3-4051-92a1-7457fd3df8ea.Text: {n}With obvious trepidation, Clementia offers you a low bow.{/n} "Welcome back, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}... or, as your subjects refer to you, Great Beacon. I only wished to report to you personally that your people's devotion surpasses all expectations, even for a person of your stature. They build chapels in your honour, speak your name with awe... and even address their prayers to you, Lord Captain."

e93f321e-a4df-48a6-b381-c93af5cdb80e.Text: {n}Clementia bows to you.{/n} "Welcome back, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! I am glad that your path has led you home again, for I have splendid news for you. Your subjects have requested to present you with a humble offering from the people."

2f4819a8-fe5d-4994-a1a5-63d8ba16e016.Text: "You need not worry — your servants and I have confirmed that it bears no heresy or danger. It is truly a token of adoration and respect for Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}." {n}Clementia pauses for a brief moment, then shakes her head with a smile.{/n} "Never before have I seen a ruler who was more merciful to the God-Emperor's common servants, more in touch with them, than you, Lord Captain. I hope that you will not reject this sincere gift from your people."

599c5048-8b0b-4673-98b9-cc1efe8e4cb0.Text: {n}Clementia shoots you a look of worry mixed with fear.{/n} "Representatives of your cult recently paid a visit to your palace... in order to make sure that your name is appropriately revered not only by the commoners, but also atop the spires of Dargonus. After the visit, they entrusted me with an item of exceptional importance, a gift for Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, blessed... by higher powers. Please, accept it..." {n}She passes you a bundle with an expression that suggests that she is eager to part with it as quickly as possible.{/n}

e170854d-afd0-439f-a442-3b00ff7d3fcc.Text: "In your absence, we had the honour of receiving eminent guests from the Ecclesiarchy. The Adeptus Ministorum has seen fit to reward your diligence in keeping Humanity pure and obedient. I am proud to present this gift to you, for every resolute servant of the God-Emperor considers it a blessing to be guided by a {mf|lord|lady} as righteous as you!"

a70641e6-3b73-4fa9-8c66-0f8399b085fc.Text: "That concludes my brief report, Lord Captain. Hail to the Rogue Trader! Glory to House von Valancius!"

b1d179b6-1857-48bb-8a8d-30c456fe1e0c.Text: "I will fly out to the governor right now."

e020fe20-5cf3-4a6e-8daa-56ec9420b508.Text: "Inform the governor that he will have to wait. I do, indeed, have other business."

9cbe7ba6-ad92-4b06-8f53-299880c2404c.Text: "I still wish to fly out to the governor immediately."

5525dde6-761d-4515-af5a-6c08046aaf1a.Text: "Congratulations on the victory, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! The entire vessel was impatiently awaiting the news of your expedition's success! The rumours about you not simply saving the Tech-Priests' monastery but actually eliminating the source of the mutiny are spreading like wildfire — the vox-transmissions from across the world speak of nothing else!"

0253142f-40ae-4d06-a3dd-1461d1563f10.Text: "Governor Medineh is waiting for you in the command centre to discuss matters, but I ask you to delay the visit and turn your gaze to the Navis Nobilite station instead. We are in desperate need of a new Navigator, but all our communication requests are still being ignored. I do not see how anything other than a personal visit from a {mf|man|woman} of your stature can convince the representatives of the Navis Nobilite to break their silence."

05d12510-0c41-456f-ae85-2445b137c779.Text: "Would you like to fly out to the governor immediately or do you have other business to attend to?"

f1ac71fa-b20d-4f34-8a1b-b250554836fe.Text: "Good journey to you, Lord Captain! The Emperor keep you!"

0cbdd56e-89d7-45f0-9f60-f3e6fc4ef6c0.Text: "Of course, Lord Captain. Congratulations again, and may the light of the eternal Terra shine on you!"

ba950488-d555-4b45-b4b7-141ef282e0fd.Text: "I am flying out to meet with the governor immediately. Prepare the shuttle."

1825324e-a1fe-4578-ab04-1f33789b3943.Text: "I am ready for the Triumph! Let Governor Medineh know I am on my way."

ec59fb83-442a-43bf-baa2-b0eb7abffd9f.Text: "I still have business in this system. Inform the governor that he will have to wait."

739681b0-550f-463c-b763-68cbb28c6ace.Text: "I will not stoop to pillaging. Abandon the station, we are leaving."

127be893-ff89-4cae-b464-e04c9ce9e8aa.Text: "Gather any components that may be of use on the ship."

fe7f9e36-a433-4267-bda0-055d47b23af1.Text: "Loot everything, from jewellery to the very last manuscript."

32b1cd5a-3aa5-46f8-a0e4-30ea9aea9179.Text: "Why is it always business with you, Vigdis? Couldn't you sometimes just visit and tell me how wonderful everything is?"

c0b159a1-aee8-4bb7-9d27-39bfd95a06c2.Text: "Thank you, Vigdis. This will be all for now!"

447b8db8-6833-4950-a119-2b8615d0bcad.Text: "Lord Captain, congratulations on acquiring a Navigator! Please spare me a few moments of your time, as there are several matters that require your attention. First of all, I wish to report on the condition of the station, Eurac V."

ab8fe4f8-494a-495f-848d-1e7c63ae74b1.Text: "Regrettably, we arrived too late to evacuate the residents of the station. The warp disruptions affecting Eurac V twisted the bodies and minds of its attendants. The corruption failed to affect Lady Cassia, thank the Emperor — the Navigators are trained to resist the Immaterium's pull."

8b807731-4bfe-4ec1-83eb-86f25a866e7c.Text: "With your permission, I would also like to remind you that we are still looking for an Enginseer Prime. Both the vessel and its machine spirits are in desperate need of oversight by an experienced Tech-Priest. We are also missing some crew, and, much more importantly, we have not yet located Heinrix van Calox, the right hand of the Lord Inquisitor. Now we know for certain he was not at Eurac V, so we should keep this in mind when making any future plans."

94af4d3d-5e87-4763-8daa-c0c6d0e2fda0.Text: "With your permission, I would also like to remind you that we are still in need of more men and women for the crew. And we have not yet located Heinrix van Calox, the right hand of the Lord Inquisitor — as we can now attest, the man vanished into the shadows of the star system, and was not present on Eurac V. We must keep this in mind when making any future plans."

c155649a-bb1d-4e9a-a6bc-46bba5303381.Text: "Had you opted to begin your visit to the Rykad System with a different destination, the station could have become critically unstable. Fortunately, the decision to immediately visit the representatives of the Navis Nobilite bought us precious time. We can either focus our efforts on disassembling the station and procuring technological components for our own vessel or attempt to save as many valuables as we can."

77a2eb7c-16d7-4fa8-87f8-26615bfaf756.Text: "I would also like to remind you that your subjects on Rykad Minoris are waiting for your arrival to celebrate your triumph over the heretics and insurgents. Will you depart immediately?"

1ac13611-7bc6-42da-bfdb-f276965e8fb6.Text: "I would also like to remind you that Governor Medineh is still waiting to talk to you in his command centre."

99c89fd0-fe7d-42b2-aed9-8af1e74254de.Text: "Certainly, Lord Captain. If you are interested, this week passed with a record low rate of minor disturbances on the lower decks. A senior technomat from shift eight came up with a new formula for a lubricant used in kitchen servitor implant maintenance. The quartermaster of store compartment eleven reported recently that we are spending ceremonial decorations at least twenty percent slower than expected, which means we have enough tablecloths, carpets, and lamps to last us fifteen years of grand receptions instead of ten. Even considering that some of the stock was burned during the cultist attack on the vessel!"

978a80c3-c971-4d46-881d-58f89d1edb36.Text: "Order the augur crew to scan the station."

65b7f5c7-d152-4d4d-881c-194f7dc42dd5.Text: "We will not invade a Navis Nobilite station without first acquiring official approval."

392937be-e5a5-4e25-b641-81a16fbcd659.Text: "Contact the station again, I will negotiate personally."

59619e5e-fe24-4726-a18c-950ba333998d.Text: "Turn back? No one dares to give me orders!"

a1b92aef-3974-4b0a-ba0c-a6f0e2cacb4e.Text: "Order the crew to commence docking with the station."

a5621521-ed3e-4e23-9fe5-38e2e6f8eec0.Text: "Turn the vessel around. We will return to the station at a later time."

8ff8a233-4b5d-4e24-8917-e6a1979b7ed5.Text: "Lord Captain, reporting: the heralds of the Navis Nobilite continue to maintain vox-silence. Perhaps due to Eurac V being off-limits to visitors — we intercepted signals from the beacons drifting in the station's orbit. The demands are clear: we are told to turn the ship around immediately."

8e14b431-8315-476d-932f-69a39e658711.Text: "Yes, Lord Captain!" {n}The vox remains silent for a while, but then you hear static and Vigdis's measured voice:{/n} "The officers from the augur crew performed a full scan of the station, but the information is imprecise. They note wave distortions of unclear genesis that are throwing off most of the readings."

839c18f9-93c0-4594-99a9-07df90531514.Text: {n}The vox relays the cadent sound of grinding gears and clicking tumblers.{/n} "I am sorry, Lord Captain. The station does not reply even after an official greeting by a Rogue Trader and the declaration of your intent to negotiate in person."

43751e79-fa4d-41cb-a42d-c81630b9083d.Text: "We have also detected an accumulation of space debris near the station's docks. Presumably, it is the remains of interplanetary shuttles. Perhaps the esteemed Navis Nobilite House requires aid... and therefore, cannot respond to our vox-transmission."

0a0d00bc-64f4-4bec-b0b8-8cd2ced443f9.Text: "Forgive me for intruding, Lord Captain, but I feel it is my duty to remind you that the Navis Nobilite are highly respected citizens of the Imperium, Humanity's guides through the warp. The power and status of a highborn Navigator House is akin to that of your protectorate. To aid them in their hour of need is to acquire an influential ally."

f26e08d4-f19f-47ad-800f-0ed92e9de029.Text: "Affirmative, Lord Captain. We do not know what is happening at the station, so you will have to look for the esteemed Navigators blind. Dock safely, and may the God-Emperor light your path."

6d2597f1-b3ee-4ef8-88c6-58f97b2db5af.Text: "We were able to ascertain that the reactor core of the station is still active, but many compartments are unpowered and some fully depressurised. The signs of biological activity are largely present in the central module, which means the station has not been abandoned. So, the question remains, why are the esteemed Navigators' heralds ignoring us?"

edbf463a-fe26-4476-ae62-0c96c8b4bffc.Text: "Lord Captain, only the Navigators are blessed with the gift of steering ships though the Immaterium. Anyone else would succumb to the same nightmarish influence it projects on the crew and the vessel. To attempt traversing warp space without a guide is a fool's errand!"

e3d776f0-aeae-4eeb-b1a1-cf3657749a74.Text: "Eurac V continues to ignore our broadcasts, Lord Captain. I daresay it may be due to the malfunction of the station's vox-systems or a station-wide emergency preventing contact."

0125a0d8-27a3-4bb9-b907-e33ca008ebf0.Text: "Ravor, damage report on the unknown vessel."

4a3944e9-ea96-4b00-a5f5-1ec5abccbd26.Text: "Thunderfang, now stop playing games and explain again what your business is here. And this time I highly recommend the truth."

74968114-a1ab-4bff-8fab-4d3c0461f1a8.Text: "Ignore the vessel. Follow the charted course."

841cd2ec-6cc1-46f5-8c9f-8fca747fd844.Text: "Ravor, can we establish communication? Let the vessel identify itself."

a18a1dd2-ac47-48f4-b573-12c42cc1685e.Text: "Thunderfang, why can we not identify you?"

62cb7bab-eb56-47a9-9c2c-c86e3bc774da.Text: "Thunderfang, your vessel is badly damaged. What happened to you?"

a841d9af-a295-4882-9d11-6a3e91acc962.Text: "Main gun deck, on my order! Aim weapons... Target, 'Thunderfang'..."

d5b05360-ef51-4ff3-84f7-56f08f98119c.Text: "Fine, Danrok, have it your way. Main gun deck, belay that order."

2dd3816d-750a-4911-b308-05fadc368911.Text: {n}The vox crackles to life, and Master Helmsman Ravor addresses you.{/n} "What we have here, Lord Cap'n... It is not very noticeable, but there's a voidship sitting in the local asteroid field. It sure is quiet, like it's huddled up in there on purpose. It's not like I am surprised, the thing is more scrapheap than ship at this point. Somebody sure went to town on it. We are registering critical damage to the hull and depressurisation of several compartments. Oh, there is an incoming transmission now, too."

8d3d2fc6-8365-4988-b805-a8c23077d9ba.Text: "...Hear us?" {n}The vox-transmission hisses and abruptly cuts to static.{/n} "Do not require assistance... peat, do not require assistance!"

843bedd1-5854-481d-9bf5-fabf0bffa915.Text: "...Copy?" {n}The vox relays a different voice.{/n} "...Keep following... they'll pass us by, won't they? ...ror protects!"

cc1e5990-2c1c-4d60-96f3-398f7d948f4e.Text: "We were just flying, minding our own business... Straight out of the blue and opened fire!.. Miracle we could get away... Emperor protected... And then more fire! Who?! Void only knows... Roasted our tail, bombed everything... The folks, our folks are left without our help... We never got to them..."

b7d529a4-6829-4818-b5f7-189bf65b9305.Text: {n}The vox responds by bursting into a cacophony of sounds, words, and emotions — someone chuckles bitterly, another swears with some foul expletives, and yet another hisses, furiously demanding that the others shut up. You manage to make out little from all this noise...{/n}

3311eaa5-7687-4f1b-ab07-fab1b76e07bf.Text: "Lord Captain, I am told our augurs cannot determine the allegiance of the vessel. To be brief, there is an unidentified and badly damaged vessel within an asteroid field near the Rykadi Philia colony that is refusing help... Which, not to put too fine a point on it, has not yet been offered to them."

0c47ca07-f7a9-48fe-a04e-0b324e03abbd.Text: "Yes, Lord Cap'n. The connection is established. Unknown vessel, we are receiving you. Identify yourselves. I repeat, identify yourselves."

1924d9fe-52cf-4423-8451-a1a9ed1f6d82.Text: {n}For a brief moment the vox only hisses and snaps, and then several voices at once start shouting over one another.{/n} "Do not tell!" {n}—{/n} "Tell him!" {n}—{/n} "We are done for!"

44555e57-7206-48bd-9973-99b8dc5992cf.Text: "This is Thunderfang!.. We are..." {n}One of the voices falters uncertainly and is replaced by another.{/n} "...a merchant vessel! Do you copy?.. We are a private ...chant vessel!"

cf3070e8-93ce-480a-8ef5-cc48742331f6.Text: "A merchant vessel. Of course, they are. Damn my stupid head, where did I hear this name before? Thunderfang..."

01657fb9-0671-4b41-bdc1-0d54d4eb168e.Text: {n}You can make out hoarse and furious whispering even over the crackling of the static.{/n} "Why?! I don't know!.. What if... Certainly not!.."

69643ef9-1321-420e-974f-0e4971a21d26.Text: "Happy now?! What have you done... diot! It is too late now..." {n}The vox-channel is again filled with the angry whispering of several voices.{/n}

4ddccee4-75fa-42ee-b484-1424bf0cd3d8.Text: {n}The whispering dies and a clear, youthful voice cuts through the static.{/n} "Our vessel is badly damaged... amage is preventing the correct inden... ide... indentification! We assure you... ceful merchant vessel. Thunderfang does not require aid..."

170e4a64-3a33-43b9-8fd3-973cc0fe0692.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I beg forgiveness for my impertinence, but let me remind you once again: we are currently locked in the system, without the ability to jump anywhere else. Be reasonable, do you really, now of all times, want to get rid of a trading partner? And remember, the Fellowship of the Void is very likely to learn of what is about to transpire..."

26f3418c-6f4a-4349-beae-34d0d0af9e9b.Text: "Lord Captain, will there be any new orders concerning the voidship inside the asteroid field?"

19622780-2738-4e53-94dd-92d1b1bb2606.Text: "Lord Captain, we are observing the voidship, Thunderfang. Laser-based vox-communication is available."

524cea52-389b-4bca-8a03-7e8ff66176dc.Text: "Telemetry shows multiple hull breaches, most likely caused by the guns of a combat ship. Several compartments are leaking air. The bridge has been almost completely obliterated. Two of the engines are critically damaged. Somebody gave them a thrashing so solid they barely managed to limp away."

03bcfe66-f4af-4b86-a26b-87f0e6b0d4f4.Text: {n}The whispers and static are drowned out by a clear and slightly frightened voice.{/n} "Do you copy? We are from the Fellow... of the Void. We did not come here to loot... on a different business. To help our own... out of jail... Do not hurt ... lease. We already had our chronos cleaned. How about... striking a deal? Our hold is full of... lunder, I mean, goods."

5f4ea864-37c6-4466-b211-9710fb1673bc.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, please restrain your anger! The voidship has a spacious hold — perhaps they would be willing to establish trade relations? Let us at least find out who they are before you smite them with your righteous fury!"

9598e518-b86a-4216-9e8d-1a2070e26e50.Text: "The main gun deck is reporting a successful salvo. The augurs are reporting a successful hit. We do not register any survivors. Death to the pirate scum, glory to the von Valancius dynasty!"

1703f038-0a66-4e68-80bc-1097a738aba1.Text: "In case you are unaware, Lord Captain, the Fellowship of the Void is a disorderly assembly of several dozen pirate factions in the Koronus Expanse. They consider themselves above regular heretics solely because they sometimes have vox-conversations with those whom they are about to board. Were it up to me, I would make them eat a salvo from the macro-cannons to shake the scum loose from the decks. They certainly deserve it."

d9cd7f71-06b1-46a7-adbc-4e6988464969.Text: {n}The honeyed voice of the High Factotum interrupts the translation with a polite cough.{/n} "I would wait on destroying the vessel if I were you. Although the moral aspects of their livelihood do cause some awkward questions, the Fellowship of the Void remains a major supplier of goods to the local market. Perhaps you will find dealing with them acceptable... especially in a situation where performing a warp jump is impossible!"

66fdabeb-b07d-4d3e-99d5-c92490e07962.Text: "We are en route to the starport."

83833b7f-0c79-4d7d-98a4-862120936d2e.Text: "Break away now, buy us some time"

9b16b578-9670-4def-82cf-3c27acea1466.Text: "Go on the offensive. Do not worry about me, I will take care of myself!"

dc254912-3098-4e2b-b3df-e5990a428e36.Text: "Vigdis, status report on the Lord Captain, if you would be so kind. Are the celebrations on the planet over yet?"

c685ccfd-e099-4fa3-8d67-bca9c2d46d51.Text: "Vigdis, this boredom will soon drive me insane. There are not enough targets at your shooting range, and they wear out too quickly! Is there any news from the Rogue Trader? I cannot wait to finally get on our way again!"

a91c8dbf-1b41-481c-ac47-71c2e43bdffa.Text: "Vigdis... Have there been any alerts in the last hour? What about the augurs? Any messages from the Lord Captain? I can feel... Oh, my poor head! I can feel something wicked coming our way."

3c92a29d-b21d-4afb-89e1-8cf49cfa4b38.Text: "Vox Master, requesting the Lord Captain's expected arrival time back aboard the vessel."

d2a55eb1-f244-4a39-a18d-204e4da11dfb.Text: "Has there been any news from the Lord Captain? Everything is shaded so blue... I do not like it."

25b1fdaf-055f-4b05-ab2c-3f89552ec502.Text: "I need an update on any fluctuations that the augurs could have detected over the latest rotation shift. And get me a direct channel to the Lord Captain. Are the celebrations down below over yet?"

830895e5-1aad-4f8e-ade1-b4a25d45a78a.Text: "The celebrations on the planet continue. According to the vox-broadcast, the procession has barely reached the halfway point. I can contact the master of ceremonies and clarify..."

872b319d-e8ef-48c9-ac6a-b81e08036977.Text: "Emperor deliver us! What is going on?"

137ffe27-d64d-444e-b724-a1378ab4d1c4.Text: "Lord Captain! Lord Captain, this is Vox Master! Please provide your location! I am sending a shuttle after you immediately!"

f04351c5-e490-4e12-b582-1aa9db5e47f3.Text: "Lord Captain, I cannot hear you! The static... vox-channels are overloaded... Repeat the message!"

1acdcd56-c5fc-4a06-b345-ad9b18140463.Text: "What is go... on... Lord Captain, we have just witnessed the disappearance of the system's star! We must immediately evacuate you from planet. Provide your..."

74d7d2c2-fa72-4a41-b7dc-2f21e29e9305.Text: "On the ro... star... Lord Captain, I can barely hear you! You are in the starport, did I get this ri..."

cc30b841-e08a-49bb-aa54-fe4b96065f42.Text: "Lord Captain... The augurs are detecting several unknown vessels emerging from the warp! They are on trying to head us off, intercept in fifteen minutes!"

805cecb2-ef7f-4b0c-bf4f-062a033c2b0a.Text: "Vigdis, deal with the shuttles and the Lord Captain's evacuation! I am taking command. All stations prepare for battle!"

c70d3c83-5db1-46e2-b4c7-575e3274d2d1.Text: "Enough talk! Vox Master, get the Rogue Trader out of there!"

a8b8860c-5d96-4b9f-a2cf-585d6f4e5e72.Text: "Lord Captain, if you have any last commands, now is the time to give them. The connection may be completely lost when we engage the enemy."

743b1595-fbf7-494e-9beb-637efee575b4.Text: "Oh, how they are screaming... they are screaming... Come on, Idira, pull yourself together! Come on! A-a-agh!"

29f352b4-14e0-4b28-af20-892b93c93fef.Text: "Situation assessment: critical. Initiating senior officer combat response protocol."

3fab4dec-6e3e-49b3-a1ed-b1f953d5e1bc.Text: "Everything is... red... everywhere... is red... and he is watching... watching..."

8d1627d2-d728-4b1f-847c-8480f4f80989.Text: "This warp activity is anomalous, that world is dying. Vigdis, get the Rogue Trader out of there, now! I will assume command of the voidship until {mf|he|she} returns."

020c8b15-66a6-4a61-8e28-d9e8b1046658.Text: "Vigdis out. Lord Captain... God-Emperor protect you. God-Emperor protect us all!"

3103dc48-a871-4f96-9b9a-c1969d640ab2.Text: "Permission to report, Lord Captain. Over the past few days, I received several messages from different decks, complaining about anomalous behaviours in the ship's cogitators and servitors. The machine spirits are restless and rebellious, and no tech-litany or ritual of pacification can rid them of this obstinacy. The Tech-Priests can deal with the vessel's systems, but the servitors... they make errors in their tasks, disobey orders, change the assigned rituals, or sometimes downright freeze as if in a trance."

3b61584a-b242-4be6-b0e9-fab02678c033.Text: {n}A click comes through the {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g}-channel followed by a weary sigh.{/n} "Lord Captain, occurrences such as these are caused by errors in {g|Encyclopedia:Cogitator}cogitator{/g} calculations or have some other sensible explanation... I beseech you not to take after those who whisper about the ship being cursed or possessed."

c7bd004c-8560-4e4a-8662-187db3a96494.Text: "The technomats inspected the servitors and concluded they pose no danger. According to the servants of the Omnissiah, such behaviour is caused either by the echoes of minds not completely eliminated or by manifestations of the machine spirits' will. Nevertheless, the faulty servitors make the crew's tasks considerably more difficult, and High Factotum Janris Danrok would like to discuss how he should deal with the defective property. He is awaiting your audience on the bridge."

dcae9a0f-c6e4-4db6-8f8c-f80e655f8653.Text: {n}Idira joins the channel and chimes in playfully,{/n} "Oh, don't start, old man! All these 'peculiar happenings' have long since turned into local legends. A door slams shut, a {g|Encyclopedia:Lumen}lumen{/g} starts flickering... Folk have grown used to all that, so our resident ghost has decided to up the ante. I'm telling you, things are only going to get worse from here!"

1bd783f8-d520-40bf-be53-42ea47d0e7b7.Text: "Send out the order to prepare my troops for boarding. I will personally take part in the exploratory expedition."

487ac706-3fe2-4ffc-b681-7cd4c6018546.Text: "Avoid all contact with the wreck. Relay the order to keep moving."

c332086f-11c3-4f29-be62-c846d7b86e74.Text: "Lord Captain, the augurs cannot determine who the ship we approached belongs to, but the telemetry clearly reveals it is an Imperium vessel. The hull is badly damaged, but there is air in some of the chambers — which means they are hermetically sealed. What are your orders concerning the discovery?"

11e0be3c-df16-48c9-8c44-bb39a6ed88c5.Text: "Lord Captain, we have approached the remains of the unidentified vessel. Your orders?"

a45f02f2-5683-4bcb-b8f9-5b5bea02f8b8.Text: "Stand down. There will be no search party. Let us consider this... a small sacrifice."

461ab682-6afd-4435-9faf-e8eb2d779e1c.Text: "Do whatever it takes to find my missing crew member!"

ec4611e8-2e36-4309-81b9-41cb41fce482.Text: "This world has already claimed one of our own. I will take no more risks."

c049703b-aa3b-4612-9076-cb1e0666681c.Text: "Lord Captain. Seeing as not all members of your retinue returned from the surface, the ship's augurs have initiated scanning protocols, and the shuttle crews have commenced with pre-emptive preparations."

0b67a92b-a827-435c-a748-c4b7a20fc87a.Text: "As you command, Lord Captain. The rescue expedition is aborted as of now."

786a012e-ee60-4c9e-bdc9-bcb7fdb398f1.Text: {n}After several hours of searching, the senior officer is brought aboard, barely conscious. His exhausted mind has no recollection of the day's events, but the healers have noted that some of his bodily functions somehow underwent an almost imperceptible yet inexplicable transformation. Whether this change is permanent or not, only time will tell.{/n}

720032c4-4180-44e1-8a5f-61d43896a1d7.Text: "Of... Of course, Lord Captain. It will be done."

4cfb6195-f8bd-41a1-8ca5-ef7178a3a99c.Text: {n}After several hours of searching, the senior officer is brought aboard, barely conscious. Her exhausted mind has no recollection of the day's events, but the healers have noted that some of her bodily functions somehow underwent an almost imperceptible yet inexplicable transformation. Whether this change is permanent or not, only time will tell.{/n}

6b22d605-5950-44b6-a6a1-dd194a052c81.Text: "M-my apologies, but the recon officers have just delivered an updated report: we have intercepted a distress call from the planet's surface! There is a high probability that the portable transmitter sending it belongs to the missing officer! Requesting permission to dispatch a search party!"

db725607-5a7f-453f-aa95-38707a8ce2ad.Text: "Set up a mining outpost, but only use servitors. They are impervious to mental intrusion."

2407f406-3b9e-453c-a55d-c11ac8e5a5a1.Text: "Put the planet on the list of inhabitable worlds."

1d03d17b-9d58-4d5e-9a6a-ae6f023deedd.Text: "Emperor be praised, you are alive, Lord Captain! The moment your shuttle entered the planet's exosphere, the comm-networks received an unidentified symbol that drove the vox-spirits into a frenzy. We lost all contact with the planet and your expedition for quite a while. Will there be any special orders regarding this world?"

9cecc279-bae2-4041-8769-a05620fa1ae6.Text: "As you say, Lord Captain. The discussion has been added to the archive."

07e9cf3f-3a6f-4919-98cf-3c31f20cb9c9.Text: "Lord Captain, the crew that was sent to the surface reports that they have cleared the collapsed passages leading to the lower levels. After exploring the abandoned rooms, they discovered valuable cargo that has already been brought aboard."

e647324b-de77-46f7-a01c-8695be5b9096.Text: "Lord Captain, according to the telemetry, the parameters of this system match those of Telikos Epsilon — home to the agri-world Janus that belongs to the von Valancius dynasty."

2817162c-4dfa-4b8d-bced-abd7f317b366.Text: "We have received a vox-message from the planet. The agri-world's governor officially welcomes the Rogue Trader and reports that she has begun preparations for a formal reception to celebrate the arrival of the planet's sovereign. Your subjects are looking forward to your visit."

4544a6a5-e9a7-4ef7-b672-352f707e02a1.Text: "Lord Captain!" {n}The Vox Master's voice is quivering with exhaustion.{/n} "The situation has been brought under control... more or less. It will take some time to eliminate the consequences of the attack completely, but the vessel is capable of motion. We may even be able to conduct a warp jump if you feel we should leave the system. Allow me to bring you up to date."

a8306144-edb3-4659-b232-66d6c367f05c.Text: "I have... bad news, Lord Captain. The panic, or perhaps the pernicious influence of the power that reached the crew via the voxes, riled up the unlettered rabble, driving them into a paranoid frenzy. For some tragic reason, they decided the Omnissiah's adepts were to blame and slaughtered everyone they could reach. Devoid of help and protection, the maintenance bay crew suffered tremendous losses."

8c0bce04-dbf0-4192-a529-7e5425a73c26.Text: "We lost some of the armoury and its auxiliary bays, Lord Captain. The false orders sent from the bridge were carried out to the letter. No one even stopped to consider them — it was the ingrained habit of rigorous obedience that led to disaster. The subsequent explosions obliterated most of the ordnance and service personnel, and also damaged the adjacent decks."

1662ddfb-9b99-4803-8ca0-12f5b22bae4c.Text: "The middle decks... The middle decks are in mourning, Lord Captain. During the attack, some bays were cut off from the power and life support systems. The rescue crews failed to reach the trapped people in time. The death toll is still being finalised, but we have lost thousands."

dbaab03c-d6a2-4831-b167-695118283789.Text: "Kiava Gamma went silent after transmitting the harmful signal. I will refrain from sending enquiries to the {g|Encyclopedia:IndustrialWorld}industrial world{/g} to avoid a second attack. I am afraid we have exhausted our options for remote analysis — more information can only be obtained by closing the distance or even sending an away party to the planet's surface."

2ce0bf6b-0826-4c96-9559-b94136ae5238.Text: "A note was added to the reports — enforcers found a group of officers killed by a rogue servitor on one of the lower decks. It is not clear what they had been doing, most likely carrying out a false order. The deaths were caused by multiple fractures and lacerations to internal organs."

34f4c588-bb6a-4026-b330-b86d6278915f.Text: "The bridge suffered heavy losses — many of the officers responsible for key systems perished during the attack. The consequences for the vessel... are most grievous."

508beb8e-0d6f-4b96-afcd-a69eddd5b452.Text: "Fortunately, the bridge suffered only minor losses — the reports mention only a few casualties that have already been replaced."

5beb983c-33a0-48a4-a6ac-9600dc087854.Text: "The bridge suffered significant losses, but the survivors have managed to restore key systems to working order."

7cf5b67d-67ac-472a-abee-6d3ed4d61515.Text: {n}The vox clicks as Heinrix joins the channel.{/n} "{name}, we haven't managed to discuss the nature of my mission. I was assigned to your entourage for a reason. Time is running out, so I will be brief: I must be present during your expedition to the planet. I trust the 'greeting' we received from Kiava Gamma has dispelled your doubts about whether the events on the planet require my scrutiny."

b153e7c4-baa5-44a8-87e3-cf5aaee13737.Text: "And one final thing. Numerous cogitators and deck control terminals were damaged by gunfire on the bridge. The repairs will take a while, and some of the vessel's systems will be offline until they have been completed."

118c8b9f-8c3f-4d26-bc71-b3198a03b746.Text: {n}The vox clicks as Heinrix joins the channel.{/n} "The time has come to remind you about our agreement, {name}. I must be present in your entourage during your expedition to Kiava Gamma. I am counting on your cooperation."

e271af25-0d10-4e16-9357-a41580fa3b11.Text: "Thanks to the efforts of senior officers, we did manage to get the situation under control. The losses on the decks are minimal, and the number of casualties does not exceed two thousand souls."

a35ae6da-a0be-4d8f-90b1-2d5cba27b0ab.Text: "The crew is awaiting further instructions, Lord Captain."

c6e08200-9030-41e5-a7ea-fca4b0a899ab.Text: "Why can I not go down to the surface of this planet?"

3899b202-e9f3-46f5-b14f-3e79d31d0d90.Text: "What kind of secrets are they hiding?"

4146739b-ff60-4317-94f4-944e56553453.Text: "Let us not disturb the Tech-Priests. Get ready to depart."

1c1f3737-22a7-446a-8266-a076c812794d.Text: "Who do these Explorators think they are? Vigdis, send them a note stressing my indignation!"

93c5379d-6329-43c5-8ce4-317e0bbd5ddf.Text: "This is the forge world Eufrates II, it belongs to the Explorators of the Cognisance Fleet. They colonised it centuries ago. Unfortunately, we do not possess the privilege of landing here."

5b65f19d-de3b-4fa9-be0b-65748ee88153.Text: "This world is declared off-limits to the laity due to the sacred rites of the Adeptus Mechanicus being performed on its surface. I am afraid the restriction applies even to Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

8daebd6f-e7bb-4c74-8b09-459e445ce298.Text: "Unfortunately, the Treaty of Mars gives them the right to restrict access to their domain. Should someone attempt to violate their sanctuary, the Tech-Priests are authorised to open fire, and the firepower of their ground batteries is capable of destroying an entire squadron. Initiating a confrontation is... not advisable."

2fd7b2e5-49c4-4c36-9421-9c90cb701330.Text: "Rumours say the servants of the Omnissiah are calculating the formula of ultimate destruction in the secluded tech-crypts of this world, seeking to confine it to a rigid system of previously unseen weapon primers.
