Others whisper that the local denizens have dedicated their lives to the restoration of a ruined divine weapon from the Dark Age of Technology whose power and technological perfection are so holy that a mere glance from a layman would be an affront to the Omnissiah."

5233894e-96f8-4424-9368-f54bbc91d002.Text: "Lord Captain, we are once more within reach of the von Valancius protectorate. Of utmost urgency is restoring communication with your planets and bestowing the wisdom of your decrees upon their stewards. Developing colonies, claiming new territories, and establishing trade links — all this is now your privilege... and burden."

d441aac4-c73c-4fb3-ac21-1f9945f315e1.Text: "Unfortunately, we have not yet restored communication with any of your colonies. However, we hope the situation will change very soon. Do you wish to be briefed on the current state of affairs in your protectorate?"

94d7b8c2-cb98-4d35-b136-285bd5b71456.Text: "Welcome back, Lord Captain. During your absence, we assisted the ground forces by coordinating their movements from orbit. Detailed casualty and damage reports have been submitted for your perusal."

76c1c660-1c7d-4a43-b598-9e9744b297bc.Text: "I regret to inform you that the capital world has been dealt a {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_DargonusLate}serious blow{/d}. Xenos raids are rarely protracted affairs, but this one lasted much longer than any other — the enemies of Humanity eliminated or captured millions of your subjects. Most of the defence systems were obliterated, and several administrative complexes were razed to the ground... It will take time for Dargonus to fully recover."

7714cdbc-ff98-419d-b973-52cddffee9c5.Text: "It is with deepest awe that I inform you that the {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_DargonusEarly}timely intervention{/d} and the resilience of the world's defenders managed to break the back of the raid, which had threatened to turn into a protracted war. Dargonus suffered losses, but the hive has sufficient capacity to restore the administrative networks and industries as expeditiously as possible. The world remains intact despite the insidious blow dealt by the xenos."

0cf90299-693f-4027-86e1-476820a0d26e.Text: "I have been given Scalander's reports that he failed to deliver in time. They indicate that xenos activity dropped sharply after you departed for the Cinerus Maleficum. Considering the scale of the Dargonus raid, it is safe to assume the {g|Encyclopedia:Drukhari}Drukhari{/g} used up all the forces at their disposal — and may now require some time to replenish the losses. Achilleas is presently recuperating from his severe wounds, and without his aid, we are temporarily blind to the scheming of these enemies of Humanity. However, our strategists are still hoping for a lull in attacks and raids, which will allow us to gather our strength for a new conflict."

b6359b93-6d1f-481c-8070-e24dda7910b9.Text: "Tell Dargonus the Rogue Trader is coming home."

a99a85c4-0803-4393-9fa2-43a541058c97.Text: "My subjects should exercise patience. I will go to Dargonus later."

082563be-6823-4b00-84bf-e250df901f7a.Text: "Lord Captain, Master Helmsman on the line. I can report that the quest for the capital world of the von Valancius dynasty is finally at an end — Dargonus is straight ahead! We have received countless greetings — your subjects would like to know when their {mf|master|mistress} will be arriving."

307e16b7-9740-43a2-a1ae-c47b873ee848.Text: {n}After the connection to the Master Helmsman is cut, the device crackles with Heinrix's voice.{/n} "Lord Captain, I will be pleased to accompany you during your visit to Dargonus so I can personally introduce Achilleas Scalander — a servant of the Golden Throne who previously attended Lady Theodora on Dargonus. I am counting on your benevolence."

7abb7fe5-e1d9-4673-ae79-9d6dc680ac93.Text: "The merchant captains taking refuge in the orbital docks of Dargonus race to send you priceless welcoming gifts, hoping to buy your favour and to make an impression on the Rogue Trader."

f30f9ea4-1105-459c-a7e9-6050187ea884.Text: "Lord Captain, our Astropathic Choir received a message from Dargonus. The noble houses express their gratitude for the restoration of trade routes between the remaining von Valancius planets and express their deepest condolences for the loss of the worlds that did not survive these dark times."

55c788be-e51d-405a-8f2c-1fc4995d7b35.Text: "Ready to report, Lord Captain. The Dargonus fleet has been sighted in orbit around the capital world — the von Valancius coat of arms on the vessels is unmistakable. Signs of recent combat are in evidence around the planet — metal fragments, debris, and energy clusters. The majority of the vessels are operational, but some units are damaged. No aggression from the fleet has been observed — on the contrary, the captains are hailing you."

e5a65ecb-f237-4ceb-aa53-3776dfe50582.Text: "I fear this is not a simple gesture of welcome, Lord Captain. Someone had the temerity to attack the capital, and — Golden Throne be praised — Dargonus had the strength to fend them off. You must get to the bottom of the situation quickly, before word of the von Valancius protectorate's potential weakness spreads all over the Expanse."

7e0b6e36-d1c2-43e0-b6de-e72850881738.Text: "Lord Captain, Drukhari ships are patrolling the system. The likelihood of slipping past their patrols unnoticed is... close to zero."

6dd12a2e-0b57-4e12-bea6-4791e4ca6351.Text: "Excuse me, Lord Captain, but the ship's augurs detected something unusual in this system. I thought you would be interested in perusing the augur data."

22cfb646-52ef-4196-be98-f895eb7618e7.Text: "Wreckage of a large ship drifts lifelessly inside the star's gravity well, presumably a former vessel of the Imperium. Scans detect the signature of a functioning ship component among the debris. Additionally, telemetry has revealed numerous biological markers inside its compartments despite there being no operational vessels in the vicinity."

49b5e364-381f-47a8-b5de-3585bfab5d2e.Text: "A peculiar structure was discovered on the surface of one of the local worlds. It is emitting weak radiation of an unidentified nature, but aside from that, the augurs have failed to register any activity on the surface of the planet. In conjunction with its other features, it would be feasible to classify this planet as a dead world. It is possible to land next to the edifice if you deem this necessary."

9cc03822-b51b-4294-b47d-db7a95d05254.Text: "A distress signal is being broadcast from the surface of one of the local worlds. The transmission quality is poor and the message cannot be deciphered either due to distortion, due to the damage done to the retranslator, or perhaps because the message is being broadcast an unfamiliar language."

052f6789-d519-4649-9901-4bbc96490cf2.Text: "When scanning one of the worlds, the augurs have gathered data from a certain geological anomaly that could not be fully investigated. According to the reports, the object resembles a... bottomless wormhole. I cannot provide any more details as the augurs' machine spirits became enraged due to the absence of logic in the acquired data and refused to process it further. Perhaps we can learn more by sending an away team to the anomaly."

bc8f6ec9-2851-4901-bc07-d44af4851bcd.Text: "We will not abandon people of faith in distress. Prepare a landing party and my shuttle. I'm taking the monastery under my protection."

d4c6c8b2-ff06-4f93-b3b0-e3a6bdac3350.Text: "Those people are victims, not invaders. Prepare my shuttle. I shall head to the planet and resolve this conflict."

a69aa5ba-9bf3-4062-9ed0-9c11893f521d.Text: "This is of no interest to me. Ignore the transmission."

f560c328-d6bb-48f9-8ae1-852b486b609e.Text: "Lord Captain, we have received a transmission from Foulstone. It was sent by members of the Order of the Hammer, votaries of Saint Cognatius, whose monastery is the only settlement on the planet."

82f2b512-e699-40c4-a032-fd92e98b9732.Text: "Or rather, it used to be. Some time ago, a transport vessel, the Naviica, unloaded several thousand refugees from a planet belonging to Rogue Trader Winterscale. The Order of the Hammer has judged this invasion to be an act of aggression and is asking for Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship's protection."

9462212a-04ca-4d93-b452-a0b71997cd70.Text: "Lord Captain, the vox-systems intercepted a distress signal coming from an Imperial vessel. The system contains a ship that belongs to the planetary fleet of Dargonus, the capital of the von Valancius dynasty. The transmission is repeated at regular intervals but the message itself is corrupted — a cacophony of requests for help, groans, and shouts... What in the world? It is your name that they are shouting, Lord Captain."

cf71e958-5570-4642-b3f7-f49df9f3fbb0.Text: Allow the servants of the Archenemy to prepare the "special cargo" for the defiling of Footfall.

993d7fa2-f29b-4d6d-a237-a74a54a56459.Text: Sent provisions to Footfall, giving the station new hope.

f7e97b24-becd-462a-91ed-883241835f89.Text: Send provisions to Footfall, giving its inhabitants new hope and asserting their right to rule over the station

055f95a3-79bd-4e9f-abb1-a7424aeedb3d.Text: Decided not to send provisions to Footfall, leaving the station to be claimed by Incendia Chorda.

126371c0-d9e9-4af4-97d2-5a25246dd54b.Text: Do not send supplies to Footfall, allowing the righteous Incendia Chorda to restore Imperial order on the lawless station

13a56ff5-ccea-4b6a-a71c-2dbc750781d7.Text: We now have control over the granaries of Janus. Should the Rogue Trader wish to bestow {mf|his|her} favour on the Liege of Footfall Vladaym Tocara, {mf|he|she} can do so.

221227a9-fa2f-453f-b5eb-f3bbd59d08c9.Text: Governor Vistenza Vyatt's circle have embraced the cause with fervour. It will not be long before the shipments of contaminated provisions spark a special reverence among Footfall residents toward their highborn benefactor.

7e022bc0-eb36-420f-81f8-d262552201e6.Text: Without provisions, Footfall won't be able to resist the will of Incendia Chorda for long and will quickly succumb to her influence.

d460ae79-c834-44c6-806e-1a5b0dbaf3c1.Text: To welcome the new Rogue Trader, the Adeptus Mechanicus's planetary office brought to the ship an offering of several versatile macrocombines, ancient machines whose carcasses had been found on Janus and carefully restored. The sacred steel titans will serve the von Valancius dynasty.

1a7b031a-7234-4070-90a2-a21b53ff163c.Text: We now have control over the granaries of Janus. The promise of help given to the Liege of Footfall Vladaym Tocara can now be fulfilled, should the Rogue Trader so desire.

465f310d-859f-43c4-9300-f1918a203521.Text: The inhabitants of Footfall Station will praise the Rogue Trader who spared them the painful choice between starvation and succumbing to the reign of Incendia Chorda.

201e019a-d537-44f6-ad94-fa1a5ad26f74.Text: "I request a personal audience with Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} whenever it is convenient. There is a rather pleasant matter that requires your attention."

01701cac-62df-4426-b426-c09dd80d6c52.Text: "I need a little more time to consider my options."

7cbcde9f-3b30-4497-b7ed-f543c05aac39.Text: {n}The Vox Master is silently waiting for your decision.{/n}

7344cdca-7b58-42ac-8ad4-5d5847db43dd.Text: "Bombard the surface from orbit and purge the world from any and all navigational charts."

282fd4e3-34d1-4fc7-8aa5-17e1a7571409.Text: "This world's resources will serve us yet. Order the construction of a mining station."

79020c38-1bdf-4743-9589-996e0c344afd.Text: "This world was not worth my consideration. Leave it as is."

7139de17-585b-4018-93de-8a4545d4a00f.Text: "Lord Captain, how do you wish to proceed with this world? What are your orders?"

637ced35-15c2-4c2e-8f6e-6c28d7e2558a.Text: Restore the manufactorum in the shortest possible time without subjecting the wounded planet to a merciless purge

b1bec7c3-45aa-48d0-a84b-ab7b6eb2cfbe.Text: Purify and restore Kiava Gamma no matter the cost

e1217d10-8192-4ae9-b91f-c3b581900314.Text: Restore the manufactorum... using the heretics' engineering plans

3ca5c32d-8eb7-4efb-a20d-76e7d638d068.Text: The world's industrial heart has fallen to corruption, but numerous faint vox-signals from the periphery indicate that the planet's small manufacturing clusters survived without succumbing to the heretics. The sacred machines and hallowed lathes from these abodes have been reverently transported to the safety of the ship's holds. The fate of Kiava Gamma hangs in the balance.

4546b8a8-67fd-43cd-8bc7-cbb3a3b85227.Text: The blast furnaces are lit again, machines once more fill the air with screeches and squeals, and mag-trains of wagons stretch in lines from one workshop to the next. But the cogitators' binharic chants carry alarming rumours of malevolent and foul traces of corruption still lurking in the deepest chambers of the manufactorum.

b64966e1-f4b8-4dfa-877e-418208ca25fa.Text: The servants of the Adeptus Ministorum heeded the call and began to assemble a holy crusade to purify Kiava Gamma. It will take much time and effort to root out every tendril of corruption lurking in the dark corners of the manufactorum.

3eca5fb2-585f-485f-ad36-cd977c1cb8c3.Text: "In addition, Governor Drivestem has sent a private message to Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I humbly ask the Rogue Trader for an audience so I may deliver it."

b44ab895-0c96-488b-bafd-fa4f6d5734a1.Text: The blast furnaces are lit again, machines once more fill the air with screeches and squeals, and mag-trains of wagons stretch in lines from one workshop to the next. But no one except the chosen are allowed into the deeper chambers of the manufactorum — this is where heretical Daemon Engines are now being forged in blood, darkness, and secrecy.

005e1e45-2cbb-446a-ada1-79f1f710624a.Text: "Lord Captain, we received some data about an object that may be of interest to you."

dea5dcf0-f687-42a1-afc6-fcd9047772bc.Text: "We intercepted a handful of transmissions reporting a difficult situation on the lower levels of the city. The descriptions are most... vague, but the aforementioned district has already been fully isolated from the rest of the settlement for a few months. There are rumours of some cult from which nobody has ever returned."

de455f98-13d2-4fd7-8802-d284480f45a0.Text: "I deemed it necessary to relay the information in person in case you wish to visit this place."

191bd839-1371-485a-89a4-90ae81395c9f.Text: "The local station refuses to answer our calls and will not establish a communications channel. Such behaviour is usually typical of pirates and heretics. The dutiful servants of the Throne have nothing to hide."

4c755837-3518-45e3-ba07-e10026eb6e6a.Text: "So you're saying that not only will I break through the Maw to the Imperium, but I will cover myself in glory as the conqueror of the raging warp. Forward!"

90f386b5-0375-460f-9f40-dc4d49b0ee79.Text: "I did not inherit this voidship only to destroy it in the roiling Immaterium. Let someone less valuable deal with the Maw."

f5368bc2-f6a9-4d60-b70e-fcce69d5a34a.Text: "Lord Captain, Ravor on the line. The Astropaths are going crazy in their little chamber — they are reporting severe warp disturbances along our intended route. It looks like the Maw is completely impassable. I've seen this before, yes, and, if you ask me, going in there is not a good idea. For us or any other voidship."

5e64f0b8-195d-4082-aa4f-735f73c3a6c4.Text: "I'll see to it, Lord Captain. The Emperor protects."

df4e7a6b-0638-4708-9128-c48fb9a7f2eb.Text: "I don't care about a few missing commoners. Don't bother me with such nonsense again."

7f69ff4c-7af7-4bf3-a84f-85700cc26804.Text: "I don't care about a few missing commoners. What's a hundred fewer bilge rats?"

97fe15e5-543b-4562-9cb9-dffd31584d26.Text: "Order an investigation — I want to know why my subjects are disappearing."

c22973ff-7f10-4ebf-b801-630f1196bbf2.Text: "Hire workers on the next suitable world to replace those missing and ensure that the elders do not forget my generosity."

5c8ce12e-ee1b-4533-8c7f-c7db18ebcb29.Text: "I don't want to deal with this. Send them to the castigation bay and depressurise the airlocks!"

8eb121b7-b972-4719-9ef1-28611077a715.Text: "Make them gnaw on their own limbs. When they are done, subject them to Servitude Imperpituis."

9c350bbb-425c-4c5c-9356-9cf68a8f6281.Text: "Organise the supply of human meat to the cannibals, sourced from criminals and other expendables."

5d4b2ea3-b29f-4581-81b2-29fe3ed23149.Text: "Missing people? I think I know who's responsible. The Children of Redemption — the cannibals from Santiel's Pride."

8a17d940-b79d-47cc-a821-ba7c6a9e2a75.Text: "Tell them they may stay on the voidship. They are only allowed to feed on the dead, captives, and each other."

384df137-1ad5-4d38-825b-c1cc29ef0dd3.Text: "Lord Captain, the elders of the ship's clans are pleading for help — over a hundred members of the crew from various families have disappeared without a trace in the past few weeks! I've checked the crew's records — none of the missing has ever set foot off the ship before, and they all worked deep in the belly of the vessel."

6e6705d6-8631-4780-9039-7fb3c7c57e2e.Text: "Your word is law, Lord Captain. Still, I doubt new workers will make up for lost family members."

43961267-f79a-4733-a477-76ec0bc4681d.Text: "That is... strange. I previously received reports about renegades and smugglers abruptly ceasing their godless activities on board, and I was immensely glad to hear it — does anyone miss having rats in their pantry, I ask you? However, loyal subjects are disappearing this time, and that is a completely different matter!"

071ccbd7-b450-407b-b04c-f42c1573b80c.Text: "I'll see to it, Lord Captain!" As soon as I have more information, I'll let you know immediately!"

2d578e7a-c49a-4a90-9ba9-8c84176f6c00.Text: "It will be done, Lord Captain. We will root out the heresy aboard our vessel."

3f7a6a6d-714f-41ac-9ac6-06d277efb8a9.Text: "Emperor protect us! Lord Captain, this cannot go on!"

d5c63633-067a-4734-b102-f19d8356389d.Text: "Remind me what you were hoping to find out?"

bf64af52-0d8c-4d10-b13a-f8dd8f603d3e.Text: "Remind me what you wanted to find out?"

8e45e564-9089-4595-9a5c-762c1cb9e3b4.Text: "The report is received. Thank you, Pasqal."

2e1d2cf9-d915-4184-967e-65d17c84ccb3.Text: "I wish to inform you that the sacred rituals addressed to the spirit of the ship have been performed. The tech-liturgy and the rite of the machine blessing ended with a datameditation in order to comprehend the nature of the miracle sent down by the Omnissiah. Acquisition of sacred knowledge has not been recorded."

8618c779-53d3-4098-a01f-699ad112e4cf.Text: "When the ship's warp engine was filled with the Motive Force despite the mass of computational errors, a true technological miracle was achieved. No doubt it was the grace of the Omnissiah, but no such occurrences have been described in the catalogue before. Hoping to gain sacred knowledge of the nature of what happened, I embarked on blessed research and prayer."

cb081740-f094-478e-b4d7-f1ac12400c97.Text: "Hypothesis: in extremis, the ship's spirit is capable of making unpredictable calculations and actions. It is impossible to predict how it will behave in any given situation, but I believe the spirit is currently showing obedience — at least for now. I recommend that we continue monitoring the ship and be prepared for new manifestations."

167fbf5d-9d98-478c-8891-71128c87432a.Text: "How the spirit of the voidship was able to call upon the power of the Machine God and activate the warp drive remains an unknown. Yet, during my meditative ritual, the Omnissiah gave me an equally valuable revelation — the sacred spirit that lives in the bowels of the ship's mechanisms differs from other analogous forms. This spirit holds a unique power that cannot be called anything less than a blessing of the Machine God."

fff3bddd-841b-4f9a-a5ec-5cb060ba96f3.Text: "I want nothing to do with this. Send in the enforcers."

2f013fa9-dfa6-4aee-beca-24b0b38ab433.Text: "I'll deal with it personally. I need the exact location."

975e7ff7-98d3-4b28-bd34-1f5b900c44ab.Text: "Seal the compartment before exiting the warp and depressurise it after we make the translation to realspace."

1d16f4b7-e816-4efe-a478-3aa72f3086bd.Text: "Lord Captain, do you remember the rumours about a group of officers discussing the reappearance of the late Rogue Trader on board? Then the anomaly was allegedly seen by only a few people in different compartments kilometres away from each. However, this time there are hundreds of eyewitnesses, and all the reports are coming from the lower decks."

078469e4-c328-4061-993b-83b96250d83b.Text: "The messages we have received are incomplete and vague, little more than yelling and hysterical claims. There are reports of casualties and unrest. The compartment in question has already been sealed off, but I thought you might want to look into what's going on for yourself. The situation is delicate and... what's especially disturbing... there are mentions of Idira Tlass being present at the scene."

14fb89d9-f872-4df6-9952-aef8db336df5.Text: "Idira broke her micro-bead so I wasn't able to find out anything from her. But, Lord Captain... Idira is a psyker, and we are in the warp. You are the only one who would risk setting foot in that compartment. And if you do not... if you do not, we will never see Idira again. I beg you, Lord Captain, do not ignore this matter."

fd9edc3b-5691-4a9e-ac67-7cd67c5bd251.Text: "Lord Captain! Enforcers are reporting significant casualties on the lower deck. There is no other information about what is happening in the compartment — no one has returned yet. Your immediate intervention is required."

b0952ef1-6fe3-41ec-bd10-5254d5b17f78.Text: {n}The vox falls silent, but an hour later another transmission request arrives.{/n}

558aa3f5-805e-47ba-a94a-ca80805f613b.Text: "B-but... I'll see to it, Lord Captain."

5b358796-2b97-473f-933e-2f44fd849930.Text: "Lord Captain, we have an emergency! We have received word that there has been a sighting on the lower decks..." {n}The Vox Master's voice breaks.{/n} "...a sighting of Lady Theodora!"

f56d2de4-3c8e-45f4-b303-3e8d3258cf6d.Text: {n}Despite the carefully maintained distance, Vigdis's voice trembles with fear.{/n}

9d4dc119-b4e0-49c1-985c-62b074f93696.Text: "Find the source of the rumours and punish those responsible. I don't want any unnecessary deaths."

2d265064-3b7b-42b2-b3b1-f56fcd22541e.Text: "Destroy the rebellious clan and find a replacement among the neighbouring crews."

def8eafb-879f-40ed-9aa3-0c5585d2f213.Text: "Pacify the entire void shield crew. Those who succumbed to the provocations of the unruly are no less guilty."

97ca13bb-b163-47dd-8d6e-90393370e337.Text: "I have no desire to meddle in the affairs of the ancient voidship clans. Let them sort it out among themselves."

4ae15173-91de-4ac9-96ea-a29dc9a433ea.Text: "My wishes, Vox Master, are for the enforcers to sort out the situation before we forfeit the crew wholesale. Investigate the rumours and find the real culprits — and no violence!"

6df5e5ea-7818-4efe-9ffd-8d2079fc0c59.Text: "Lord Captain, I bring dire news. A feud has broken out between the clans that maintain the void shield arrays. Rumour has it that the late Lady Theodora was seen on the lower decks, and so one of the families called for a rebellion against the usurper of the voidship — that is, you. So far, no one believes their mad tales, but unrest has begun at the fringes of the compartments. The ship's enforcers are ready to eliminate the instigating clan or pacify the entire void shield crew — the decision is yours."

9d97548f-4225-4871-b789-6e8794b8b966.Text: "Lord Captain, as Seneschal Werserian would say, there are no innocents in such cases. The clans are endangering the entire voidship, tussling over a strange and obviously false rumour. If you so desire, I will convey your wishes to the enforcers later, but right now the unrest must be stopped, and the people returned to their direct duties or replaced."

f086ff9a-9d9b-4614-85f5-58e816f5a002.Text: "Rumours of Lady Theodora's presence on the voidship have been circulating for a long time and appear to be a deliberate provocation rather than ordinary drunken ramblings. Perhaps someone is intentionally stirring up the masses to rebel against you, or perhaps it is the influence of the warp. Enforcers are already investigating, but right now we need to stop the conflict from escalating any further — as long as the unrest continues, the voidship's shields will not be operating at full capacity."

59ed9b4a-91d2-4386-b8ab-d0c82df89dd2.Text: "A risky decision, Lord Captain. I will on pass your instructions."

6ed57e76-04ec-4e42-8207-844854bd4d78.Text: "Give me a proper report on the refugees. How were they quartered? How are they supervised?"

98143c34-b5de-4e03-b9de-19633b3d3147.Text: "I need to know more about the killings."

9cc8fbf1-601e-4a42-b114-115de41508e8.Text: "Perform cleansing liturgies on the decks housing the refugees. We shall banish this blight with the strength of our faith!"

9160998e-2ab2-4373-bdab-4a052a9c3ec8.Text: "Increase surveillance. Assign enforcers to watch the passengers."

984d4231-3c2e-4475-a34b-c49c483e80a3.Text: "Add a triple dose of sedatives to the rations of all Rykadians."

a1b9ba09-e419-4336-ac7f-d424185e4db3.Text: "If this is not the work of cultists, then I could not care less. Once they are off this ship, that will be that."

8b4da452-167b-4d83-9e00-9d78451cd06d.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, something sinister is unfolding among the survivors from Rykad Minoris. There have already been several cases of evacuated refugees being found either dead or dying. All of them had been blinded using various means. I fear there is reason to believe that there were agents of the cult among the people who came on board."

6df7577b-c424-49a0-afd4-a6c46269cc92.Text: "I knew the anathema would not fully release its hold on those doleful souls just yet. Then let us march and drive it away!"

6c97f58b-7966-47f2-911f-e5aff1f0870f.Text: "The serfs and the planetary wardens were assigned to two auxiliary lower decks. The commoners are riled up and frightened by the calamity, so, to keep their senselessness in check, we only assign those of sound mind to work and pump sedative gas through the ventilation into the compartments holding the rest."

78e6949d-b373-4d3a-81be-7d0f148d8bc8.Text: "The esteemed nobles and their families were given quarters befitting their status. The horrors of the massacre in the streets are still fresh in their minds, so initially they made regular trips to the lower decks to take out their fears and anger on serfs from our own crew. It would have been disrespectful to confine the nobles to their compartments, so we used shackles of a different sort by generously supplying them with amasec and intoxicants."

ac61d880-a6c4-4839-a6a8-980ee101721f.Text: "The venerated Praetor Electroid Dahr-Impulse VI and his retinue took refuge in one of the engineering bays. Or, more accurately, they barricaded themselves in. The wise servants of the Omnissiah are fearful beyond measure that ignorant laypeople might damage or offend their Miraculous Fusion Reactor, so they cloistered themselves in their own personal fortress."

e42c3bb4-9119-47bb-98de-be2311b92e72.Text: "Eleven bodies have been found thus far. The first victim had their eyes burned out with a gas torch, the second had acid splashed in their face, the third was found wandering around, on their last legs and with metal pins sticking out of their eye sockets. They died before we could interrogate them. The rest were killed and disfigured in similar ways — through blinding. No trace of the killers' identity was found."

01458e0e-f756-47d0-974d-bc49dfabe3a7.Text: "If I may interject, there is no need. The interrogations have already been conducted. I put the enforcers on alert as soon as the first body was discovered, though I decided not to disturb Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} until I had the results. Well, now I do. We have already arrested... let's see... four perpetrators at the scenes of crimes that had yet to take place. Those... those are not murders. They are suicides."

eedbcb07-d79d-4e09-ab39-010ce452fc68.Text: "The people we apprehended were about to blind themselves and end their own lives. I am confident that all who perished did the same. When questioned, they all said the same thing: they are haunted by the sight of the dying Rykad Minoris. Even in their sleep, they still see the same horrific picture, so the sad wretches would do anything to make this nightmare stop."

f8a2aca4-acd1-4f24-a54f-9f54c4c6a98b.Text: "Certainly, Lord Captain. Except, I am afraid, it is not just the refugees." {n}Abelard's voice is grim.{/n}

e50fedff-3ab5-4986-98ef-42bc9fd9d76a.Text: "Three out of the four people we arrested were members of the crew. They watched Rykad Minoris die, and it left their minds scarred. We all bear the mark of that dark catastrophe, for it was the attention of the Ruinous Powers that branded our very souls. May the God-Emperor have mercy on us."

d57fcfeb-4a2f-449c-9fed-23f5f8aafe0c.Text: "You were warned, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. It is regrettable that you did not listen."

09226b7f-3b76-4d49-9003-480d4372c8cf.Text: Build space plasma engines on Kiava Gamma and transport the planet to a neighbouring system

0783361e-6614-424e-83de-f977988ba2da.Text: Turn Santiel's Pride into a cemetery world

32bfee2e-c685-49d9-9912-8450dffd01b4.Text: Impose a destructive tax of repentance on the world

8a28b099-33d4-4006-ad2b-729ee9eed8e5.Text: The main hive city of Santiel's Pride has been devastated, and promethium mining has been halted. The surviving population has dispersed, with recorded instances of departure from the Lex Imperialis and the orthodox Creed. Due to the disappearance of the system's star, the planet will drift off its orbital path and die in the void in less than a solar year.

5133d158-b5f2-482d-87f6-fb8c207c2d79.Text: Servants who strayed from the law and faith of the Imperium were forcibly returned to the promethium pumps. The penitents laboured under merciless supervision day and night, dying from cold, thirst, and the lashes of cruel confessors. When the last of them expired, the procured promethium was carefully gathered into blessed cisterns. Mixed with the blood of the those cleansed of their impurity, it carries the seething wrath of the Emperor Himself.

6917cd30-b67f-42dd-a944-ebfc27cde17c.Text: By the mercy of the Emperor, the production of promethium will be resumed and will continue until the very hour when the gravitational grip of the void tears Santiel's Pride from its orbit, sentencing it to the cold embrace of darkness.

5fa2fb3a-65ea-4c13-9a63-0b32b8064c11.Text: Santiel's Pride will become a cemetery world, a dark and majestic monument to the bloody battle between the xenos and the Imperium of Man. One day, the gravitational pull of the void will tear the world off orbit and swing the planet into its cold embrace. Even after, everyone will remember Santiel's Pride.

4e09ad0d-d654-4419-a301-994601e675de.Text: The ruins of the once-great hive bade a silent farewell to the last shuttle that will ever cross the dark skies over Santiel's Pride. Explosive charges, drilled into the crust of the icy world, set off a chain reaction in the promethium deposits and shattered the planet into pieces.

6abf5bec-c3ce-4132-bd48-cebe55f262ce.Text: Santiel's Pride is too important a world to be abandoned by the von Valancius dynasty regardless of the catastrophe that befell it. The forges in the depths of Kiava Gamma will soon roar with incandescent heat, magnificent plasma engines erected in orbit, vast and inscrutable in their splendour. One day the engines will be delivered to Santiel's Pride, and the frozen planet will move to the neighbouring system where it can rise again to its former glory. For now, the extraction of promethium on its surface will continue on whatever scale is deemed possible.

15add030-7305-4458-85e9-dbd61a65f91a.Text: "Another system is missing its star?" {n}You hear a quiver of outrage in Heinrix's voice, followed by a deep exhale.{/n} "We need to see if there are xenos on that frozen world and, should our suspicions be confirmed, exterminate them. If you disagree, let me remind you that the protectorate of one of the Rogue Traders of the Koronus Expanse has lost several billions of its subjects. Can you be certain that the same won't happen to Dargonus? Or another of your worlds?"

e051811a-b43b-4ba4-b8c6-3541e43a5bf9.Text: "Spare yourself the trouble of hoping that there is anyone left to save down on that doomed little planet. All the mon-keigh were either taken to Commorragh or disembowelled on the spot." {n}Marazhai's voice trembles with sudden excitement.{/n} "However, the lackeys of the pathetic Archon who sent their Kabal here... Who could it be, I wonder... Oh, I eagerly await a chance to meet them personally."

a8302244-df18-48d2-824b-1fb326f99cd4.Text: "Thank you for your comprehensive report, Ravor." {n}Vigdis takes over the channel, her vexation showing only in the force with which she clicks her vox.{/n} "Apologies, Lord Captain. As the esteemed Master Helmsman just stated, the augur crew is troubled by the anomalous absence of a star at the heart of the system. As for the hive world... I'm afraid it is forever lost to the Imperium, as are the lives of billions of its children."

7b779778-5cce-42b8-8c37-b356bb5927a6.Text: "Stars do not vanish from the sky without a reason — the same villains may be at work here as in the Rykad System... Lord Captain, Santiel's Pride is an object of strategic importance to the Chorda dynasty. It alone covers the promethium needs of their entire protectorate. It is not difficult to figure out what happened — the damned xenos had their work cut out for them, but, by the Throne, they succeeded! This does not mean we can leave the important strategic assets for them to plunder. I suggest we do House Chorda a favour and salvage the remains of their promethium."

77ed7033-87bd-42c7-bb57-6a9689d4ef09.Text: "Lord Cap'n, the ne'er-do-wells from the augur crew are reporting we've reached the Nolla Septum System where a promethium-refining hive, Santiel's Pride, is loca— Bend my mother over the Golden Throne!" {n}The transmission ends abruptly and resumes with a loud click several moments later.{/n} "Emperor preserve us, Lord Cap'n, the entire system's darker than the inside of a {g|Encyclopedia:Grox}grox{/g}'s arse! The local star, it's... it's not there!"

9ea7aa39-86d5-4e95-8e88-3beda2225fe6.Text: "Forgive me, shereen, but I refuse to believe that among the billions of Chorda's subjects, there wasn't at least a handful of desperate souls still trusting in the Exalted One's providence, clinging to life. Who will become their salvation if not you?"

88fb580c-4c41-4fab-b960-246b39af53fa.Text: "New information has arrived. Lord Captain, we managed to detect a residual heat signature on one of the continents of Santiel's Pride, but there is no clear indication of its origin. The crew is waiting for further instructions and praying for the souls of the deceased with extraordinary zeal."

f06c0a2b-10e5-45d0-9db1-333f34e9a18c.Text: "Sharpen your blades, Marazhai. We are hunting xenos tonight."

616c9074-ea42-4f19-bed8-004bf2d5229d.Text: "You never cease to amaze, mon-k... {name}." {n}A sinister laugh oozes from the vox-system like viscous blood dripping from a metal plate.{/n}

1c3f4795-89f4-4d7d-bab1-34485092362e.Text: "Dispatch rescue teams to the world. They better not return without survivors."

7a436287-1c43-4df2-82e5-51aa6c4df751.Text: "The order is clear; the rescue shuttles have been dispatched to the suggested evacuation points and the likely locations of hidden bunkers. Is there anything else you desire?"

a1972a30-7266-4cdb-aa98-c44532ce9439.Text: "Start promethium extraction immediately. We must exploit the world's remaining potential while it is still maintaining orbit."

9cddc9ab-ac59-47ea-9936-6ffcf9794dac.Text: "I will order the colonial expedition chamber to start deploying the extractium. Will the Lord Captain give further instructions?

b40f3138-fd3b-4bf6-a65b-49ff92c11bff.Text: "Tell the crew to get the shuttle ready. Let us not delay and begin exploration of this dead world."

18c35f0a-a1d8-4052-85cc-adc462da1ff6.Text: "It will be done, Lord Captain. Is there anything else you desire?"

a311ada9-1451-480b-9793-e2b8cd2beb2f.Text: {n}The Helmsman's sour voice fills the channel again.{/n} "If you are so eager to freeze your esteemed arse off, Lord Cap'n, who are we to object?"

423ea418-464a-466c-9695-c469f7186a6e.Text: "It would not be proper to disturb the burial grounds of another protectorate. We are leaving."

4ead7d69-b194-4b45-a1ad-9475a1e8cde8.Text: "Right you are, Lord Cap'n! Void take these xenos and their filthy tricks. They stole a star... Bloody abominations."

ab72ce7d-a4aa-4793-8a00-47ff5f5e260e.Text: "Enough. There are other star-filled systems waiting to be explored."

8e0998ff-d9a9-4c3e-a508-3e8d4cdde40f.Text: "Lord Captain, we have received a vox-message from the rescued vessel. The ship's command sends their inordinate thanks for your assistance and reports that a shuttle has been dispatched to deliver something to our ship — it seems the captain has decided to personally thank you for saving his hide. As soon as the transfer takes place, the ship will depart the system — I imagine they are worried about the integrity of their hole-riddled bucket and want to get as far away from this perilous system as they can."

4867e811-4ad7-4b9e-8ae3-84e4f856cb28.Text: "Destroy the object alongside everything else that happens to be in there."

e43611da-7e67-4885-8fe9-3f05b8adb745.Text: "Transmit the order to continue the voyage."

50da4692-1144-4180-a4e7-f6e85a104d06.Text: "Will there be any instructions concerning the object we discovered, Lord Captain?"

d3f43c57-871c-4f77-bc0c-a5684d6bad9c.Text: "Lord Captain, according to telemetry, we are in the system of Kiava Gamma, the main {g|Encyclopedia:IndustrialWorld}industrial world{/g} of the von Valancius dynasty. However, our Astropaths report that attempts to contact Governor Gaprak have been unsuccessful."

b8215852-ad66-4c58-a444-050f3b6d4b97.Text: "But wait..." {n}The Vox Master is silent for a few seconds.{/n} "Lord Captain, a new report! Kiava Gamma is sending a request to exchange data. Should we accept it?"

0401f119-129e-42f4-a726-e71f6aafa699.Text: "As you command, Lord Captain." {n}The Vox Master switches to a nearby comm channel to relay your instructions to the crew. For several minutes, nothing happens.{/n}

c6313951-899b-41f3-8c8c-9c40f7c816d3.Text: "Lord Captain, we ignored the transmission as you ordered, but the vox-system has detected a dozen more incoming requests! Their number is growing every second, and each one is becoming more insistent and stronger. I think... I think I hear something..."

4b25e54c-26c5-40b7-8731-b56b4b2a4257.Text: "Lord Captain, reporting: the manufactorum is ignoring all our requests and continues to send us its own. The longer we do not accept their messages, the stronger and more persistent the incoming signals become. I've... never seen anything like."

a2f128e2-41ac-4a2d-bee6-ab573940a843.Text: {n}Suddenly, a deafening screech erupts from the bridge's vox-system. You hear violent tirades of garbled binharic code like the low chuckles of machinery.{/n} "L-L-L-Lord Captain! Int-t-t-terference d-d-d-detected in the compartment's vox-syst-t-t-tem. Looks like the bridge is c-c-cut off from the rest of the v-v-voidship..."

c0cf935a-7862-488c-9c09-7c6d635c444a.Text: "Of course. Warn them to expect my return to the voidship."

9cdd8956-c1c9-40cb-ad00-359720b110d7.Text: "Good news. I'll head to the Liege immediately."

c138d939-0871-4082-b7f7-1e7e0898d0f8.Text: "The Liege can wait. I have other business to attend to."

d4bf14da-c4d6-44b4-a611-d09a61ac739f.Text: "Lord Captain, I am pleased to report that the inspections have been completed and all identified system failures have been resolved. The voidship is ready to depart Footfall. The crew is waiting for your further instructions, and there are also a number of issues that need to be addressed."

436b8cd0-9ea3-409e-a4b2-74f705ac7b9d.Text: "As you wish. The meeting will wait until you next visit the bridge."

616d7f01-0fab-40da-beb8-431f1f421ec5.Text: "Lord Captain, I am pleased to report that the repairs have been completed. There is only one last formality left — to visit Liege Tocara. As soon as you speak to him, the voidship will be ready to leave Footfall."

2f5e5b04-7970-4739-b21d-844bc14983bb.Text: "We also received word from Proctor Solomorne Anthar, the Arbitrator whose squad we retrieved from Rykad Minoris. He has requested an audience with you and said he will be waiting at the Footfall docks."

ba34de83-69df-4714-994f-162ed377dac5.Text: "Of course, Lord Captain. The officers will await your return."

e87ae170-62e7-44db-9f26-07b61e4776c2.Text: "Lord Captain, there is a voidship in the system that belongs to the Imperial Navy. According to telemetry, the ship is badly damaged — most of the peripheral service systems are presumably disabled. Hmm... according to the augurs, most of the compartments are depressurised, but there are biosignatures in one of the internal maintenance bays that the machine spirits have not yet abandoned. There might be somebody alive in there."

90b7ac59-4fcf-42c6-b9a3-f7037d7e1c85.Text: "Lord Captain, the station's airlocks have been sealed from the inside. A vox-recording is stating that the priesthood of the Altar-Templum-Calixis-Ext-17 sanctuary have no desire to communicate with the laity and are refusing access to guests on the basis of the Adeptus Mechanicus's privilege of inviolability, granting them sole jurisdiction over their sacred sites."

e4cec742-ea0d-4d80-8bea-bc8f98d7f840.Text: "Lord Captain, we have received an Astropathic message from Dargonus. Achilleas Scalander reports a xenos raid against a merchant ship in the Silence of Mer-Segrit!"

cee80b3e-75ab-4539-b9da-9ce0a93a42fe.Text: "The coordinates of a hypothetical contact have been forwarded to the crew. If you wish to support your subjects and fight back against the xenos personally, we must hurry — it is unlikely that a merchant ship will be able to resist the enemies of Humanity for long."

526afa67-da6c-4e96-b2cf-f7693d642979.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, repair parties have already landed at the largest extractiums on Vheabos VI. Reliquary mining machines were carefully removed from under the ruins and respectfully brought to the ship for repairs and healing."

beffe7e4-a8f8-4866-b522-145a786890d4.Text: "Lord Captain, we are approaching Oasis V. In old chronicles, the planet is referred to as a flourishing agri-world, though war raged there for many centuries. As a result of some unknown cataclysm, the biosphere failed and the planet turned into one massive storm that destroyed all life. However... we have picked up a weak signal coming from the depths of the world. There may be survivors underground."

4ad22ddf-5fc2-4721-81f7-4430b15ae8a1.Text: "Lord Captain, reporting: our voidship has passed through a cloud of cosmic dust of unknown origin. Unfortunately, the dust particles were covered with an icy shell that has frozen into a thick sheet on the voidship's hull, blocking some of the technical vents. It will take time for the servitors to clear the ice. Until then, our manoeuvrability will be somewhat reduced."

656258a1-9c76-42f4-b05e-4283a76cb0a6.Text: "Lord Captain, there is an unusual cluster of binary asteroids before us, rich in rare metals and valuable minerals. They are moving in a fairly stable orbit, which suggests the possibility of constructing a mining station inside the drift."

5a1e6613-2727-4752-b6d9-aa696a2563ab.Text: "Ahem... Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, we have arrived. According to my agents, this is the system where Kunrad Voigtvir and his pet pirates do business with the enemies of Humanity."

3d078a8f-46f9-49c2-a5f6-c8cbc95ff987.Text: "The augurs detect no vital signs on the station, which means the next deal has not been negotiated yet. We still have the time to prepare a proper welcome." {n}The servant of the Inquisition gloomily releases the final few words.{/n}

ce02ed7f-b441-4293-ac97-5cb0420480d0.Text: "This is where our paths diverge, Rogue Trader. You put your own goals above all else, whereas I am a weapon of the Lex Imperialis — and my duty is not yet done. Farewell."

9bfc0d37-61bc-4464-a3f3-223911cf391e.Text: "Lord Captain, according to our telemetry, we have arrived at the coordinates you specified. The augurs do not register any activity on the surface of the local planets, biological or otherwise, but maybe the xenos are using their arcane technology to conceal their presence."

32ca341f-c865-4c46-a6d7-e7ce16a80a95.Text: "My kin could have been faced with a new threat, scavengers like pirates or something worse. If they were taken prisoner..." {n}Yrliet's voice is trembling with something that could be either anger or fear.{/n}

7594d9ce-8ba0-447a-8ca3-0c000202218c.Text: "Despite this, the augur crew managed to locate a faint signal at the system's edge. According to their data, it is coming from an unidentified vessel drifting in the orbit of a local gas giant."

ac4ab1dd-e46f-414f-b9a2-077e9298d7c5.Text: "I am begging you, elantach, let us go to the shuttle! I can feel that the thread of fate has frayed and is about to snap. I cannot miss what may be the only chance to solve the mystery behind the disappearance of my home."

b6fa6c4b-f4f6-4a45-8a25-c004f2828cf6.Text: "Let us fend them off in honest combat. Brace for impact!"

8ddedd56-4a16-4bdd-8d58-6db7a8d13fbb.Text: "Lord Captain! They have fired boarding torpedoes! It looks like the enemy has decided to take us down with a single decisive strike."

4ec26901-a02c-4ff1-a992-6a93910207ab.Text: "Our anti-void crews cannot hit them. These projectiles are equipped with augur-blinding countermeasures and steering thrusters to evade targeted fire. I advise Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} to prepare for battle — collision with the head torpedo will take place one deck below the bridge."

66857d57-8736-4776-b730-fd45ca9ab08c.Text: "Yes, Lord Captain. Sound the alarm on all decks. All crew members get ready to repel the boarders!"

2e1838d2-177f-4056-b8d3-efb577e7718d.Text: {n}You are distracted by Vigdis's worried voice coming from the vox.{/n} "Lord Captain, I apologise for disturbing you, but your presence is urgently required on the bridge. I managed to stop everyone from barging into your study, but I am not sure how much longer I will be able to hold them back..." {n}Before the transmission cuts off, you catch someone's outraged voice in the background. Indeed, it appears that your intervention is necessary.{/n}

f112da17-0fa0-4f39-b395-2cbc4048d289.Text: "Vigdis, give me details on the combatants."

cc98d628-1639-4f24-9b8b-2b34e18b5bf7.Text: "Let us not interfere. We are leaving."

dcc46182-7dbb-466a-ade1-71a70298ed3b.Text: "What is so important about Eufrates II that is worth fighting for?"

6782dde5-1434-49e8-b8f7-6120a229c17b.Text: "Lord Captain, our augurs have detected active combat operations in the orbit and on the surface of Eufrates II. We tried to contact the Explorators on the flagship of the Cognisance Fleet coordinating the siege, but received a strongly worded demand not to interfere under threat of armed retaliation."

0631fa7c-d095-43ac-9d52-6d330270df0a.Text: "Their reaction is the result of reasonable wariness, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. The agent network of the Cult of the Final Dawn spans entire worlds and has proven its effectiveness time and again. I presume the Tech-Priests are afraid of letting a treacherous vessel into their combat ranks."

f025bfd4-4efb-4191-8cd4-26fa7b250a2b.Text: "This sacred forge world had always been closed off to the laypeople. I believe that it was only at the threat of having it utterly corrupted by the Ruinous Powers, that the Explorators had begrudgingly accepted their profane allies setting foot in their blessed world."

647b06fd-bf2f-47bb-bd87-0e59cd6b04b3.Text: "The world is besieged by a squadron of the Cognisance Fleet supported by a joint armada of vessels from across the entire Expanse. Among the latter, we are registering vessels recruited by the Lord Inquisitor to defend the sector. They are opposed by the Final Dawn scum led by the blasphemous traitors from the ranks of the Word Bearers."

8e5f6b5f-5b40-4d8d-84a3-a5d2e750887c.Text: "We are detecting parity between the forces as both parties employ conservative strategies with the aim of gradually achieving positional superiority. Tactical prognosis suggests that this impasse will persist for a while longer."

45da1796-e584-406e-9acf-5195d2c312bc.Text: "I take it that they are not threatening to fire anymore? That's better."

4d192c98-e0c3-4741-857d-4c58a1c14b74.Text: "Summon them to the bridge — we will hold a council."

deb1b73b-f6a8-474d-9cb4-5d286d38286e.Text: "I must attend to other matters first. Tell them to wait."

03dd14c9-e4ff-4d6a-bfd6-0e2c50cc6fb8.Text: "Lord Captain, the united corps of the Explorators and the militia forces is ready to attack the heretics who took over Eufrates II. The commanders recognise the Lord Inquisitor's sanction and agree to cede the right of supreme command to you. They ask that you summon a council of war in order to establish the plan of attack. How should we respond?"

2a00a520-54eb-4b72-8215-2078cba910e1.Text: "If Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} so desires, I will relay a demand for an official apology for the act of outrageous impudence that took place."

bfc56e8a-cfb7-4072-b4df-682d4e2429be.Text: "As you will, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. The commanders hope that you will be ready to summon a council as soon as possible. Without your support, the fleet cannot begin the attack. Every second counts."

23885c75-8617-446d-9208-7f6e43e2d7ee.Text: "Consider it done, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I will notify the commanders that you are ready to meet with them."

4af82a3b-85f4-4e0f-af2c-05428ff579b1.Text: "A sensible piece of advice. I still have unfinished business at Footfall."

aff67422-7b8c-48a3-86bc-aa7f71e3f191.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, we have a long expedition ahead of us. It would be reasonable to replenish supplies. Ammunition, spare parts, better equipment... Who knows what we are about to face?"

43257ea4-ad19-4a83-a91f-aed550c3a1bd.Text: "What other options for landing on Footfall do we have?"

177a40b4-ddd0-4d08-91d8-7429db286958.Text: "Very well, let us take a look at Footfall's new hospitality."

93334590-da5b-4773-92e1-57f1a4dd4b43.Text: "I am not walking into this mousetrap. Not now, at least."

a726d7ee-760b-4933-b517-41046fb27f28.Text: "Let's go and see what happened to your crew."

ee30618d-7ec6-45af-a4d7-184a4713a141.Text: "We will deal with this later. There are more pressing issues to address right now."

4c9ae8b6-bb0d-403c-987a-fc47e9f6b4d5.Text: "I could not care less about your crew and their troubles. They will have to sort it out on their own."

5efcfe74-5084-4746-a4e9-f9df8ec6eab0.Text: "Lord Captain, we have received a vox-message from Footfall. The Inquisition has declared martial law on the station due to the threat of Malleus Extremis. Docking will require special permission and even most of the asteroids have been cordoned off."

4cfb19ad-4503-4c97-b6e7-cf82721dcb63.Text: "The station's custodian, her Ladyship Incendia Chorda, sends her greetings and invites Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} to disembark at the docks with a small retinue. Her enforcers will meet you there to escort to another chamber for a private audience."

3d674a2a-e69d-48a7-aa75-ea63e4769678.Text: "We have none, Lord Captain. The augurs are reporting that all docking gates not watched by the enforcers are locked and rigged with explosives."

195eadc2-fa1d-4523-8bdb-c0fe9c750bcf.Text: "If this is all you have to say..." {n}The Vox Master unceremoniously boots Jae from the channel.{/n} "Apologies, Lord Captain. What will be your instructions?"

f3b9de47-13d9-4cc2-9991-d3589b150a5f.Text: "He threw a wrench into the works, making my trade network fall apart like a badly assembled chrono. No income, no profits, only damages! All because my right hand is chained up on one of Footfall's asteroids. How about we pay Falco a courtesy visit? I am sure your imposing visage will loosen his tongue... And maybe, just maybe, untie the hands of my crew."

14ce08cd-826a-4f89-b9b6-774205f3a56f.Text: "Shereen, have I ever mentioned that you are the most fragrant rosebush in the entire blossoming garden of the Koronus Expanse?"

c1681372-3b33-4346-bd13-1ed692bb8cce.Text: "I will look forward to this fateful hour with trepidation and impatience! Glory to the Exalted One, for He spared your heart from indifference and haughtiness."

2fdcab28-2849-4f08-9209-11226780ee0e.Text: {n}A stifled voice rattles out of the vox but falters.{/n} "If the galaxy itself bows to the will of the Rogue Trader and the God-Emperor, though the Rogue Trader {mf|himself|herself} is naught before the power of the Master of Mankind... Then who is Jae Heydari to object to your decisions, shereen?"

8dd0b28c-962d-4afb-adbe-0cc63bd881c5.Text: {n}The vox crackles with static and Jae's honeyed voice fills the air.{/n} "Vigdis, the salve for my heart! Forgive the intrusion, but I have important business with the Rogue Trader!"

8dd333fe-2faa-49eb-b636-ba4c7f303388.Text: "Forgive my rashness, shereen, but we have not yet discussed the Astropathic message I received from Footfall. It looks like my numbskulls had gone and got themselves captured by some rival ashmags. Vladaym is too occupied for schemes, and besides Incendia Chorda has already put him in his place, which leaves only Falco, may the azhi swallow his heart! That cowardly son of a mangy {g|Encyclopedia:Grox}grox{/g} is demanding Mercatum Tabula Officiale in exchange for the lives of my crew!"

fa88e79c-c940-4337-acef-89c51f5767c0.Text: "Oh, shereen, I simply wish to remind you about my numbskull crew who got themselves captured by some rival ashmags. Vladaym is too occupied for schemes, and besides Incendia Chorda has already put him in his place, which leaves only Falco, may the azhi tear his soul to pieces! Footfall is straight ahead, and I would rather not waste the precious sand still left in the hourglasses of their lives."

dd783d33-3786-4bba-a086-b08e9cf71cbc.Text: "Lord Captain! I bring you new information about the xenodevice that you discovered during your... time away. Ever since your return, the Tech-Priests have been making every effort to comprehend the nature of this mysterious technology — and they have succeeded, to an extent. After many rituals and pleas to the Machine God, they awakened the xeno-artefact. For but a moment, it produced a holographic copy of a planet and coordinates that matched a location in Langrenn's Belt. Perhaps you will wish to see with your own eyes what this destination holds."

a576546f-d0b6-440e-a55a-1dcfb1a87124.Text: "Now he dares to summon me as his servant! The nerve of this arrogant bastard!"

5e906fa2-e3d3-4d2e-ae82-6dc1aefedf2f.Text: "Then let us set course for Footfall. This must be very important."

969abb9f-ab20-4805-8ac0-5d2daefcc845.Text: "Xavier will have to wait until I conclude some more urgent business."

3544cf14-5883-4711-aa57-d30d11859aba.Text: "Lord Captain, the Astropaths are reporting a new message. It says Lord Inquisitor Calcazar is sending his regards to Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} and is hoping to meet you in his palace at Footfall at your earliest convenience."

3cd116fd-4e7e-4400-9bae-9b588f32a710.Text: "My condolences, Lord Captain. I will leave you alone with your thoughts now."

9c2b9b8f-d93e-4c62-ba4f-cb5bfde5ee4f.Text: "What is so unusual about the saboteur and the way he was captured?"

3bf0e811-eb22-424d-9909-83ee23310c35.Text: "Very well, I will speak to him."

9edbf47a-7161-4f62-8143-6881fa9f011c.Text: "Executing him will suffice. I have no desire to waste my time on trespassers."

b222cc02-b6a9-47e5-800b-939ce6e6af24.Text: "Lord Captain, an urgent message! Our enforcers have arrested a dangerous saboteur who attempted to gain entry onto the bridge. This incident... may be worthy of your attention. You see, both the saboteur and the circumstances of his capture are rather strange." {n}You cannot tell if Vigdis sounds baffled or worried.{/n}

fbaf8f36-8673-4b3e-99d6-175f18d836cd.Text: "I think it would be reasonable for Magos Pasqal to take a look at him as well."

4d2d7a4b-1338-4e93-8cfc-77dc1160f6e3.Text: "The thing is, Lord Captain... The saboteur is most definitely a Tech-Priest. He found his way aboard the ship and penetrated all our security systems with staggering ease. Both his ability to communicate with machine spirits and the combat potential of his augmentations are extraordinary... Nevertheless, the enforcers managed to capture him."

257b1a4a-9e69-4d13-aff0-ca174ea72205.Text: "During the arrest, the intruder... he offered no resistance at all. Instead, he asked for an audience with 'the great machine spirit.' When he realised that the enforcers had no idea what he was talking about, he asked to meet with you. I considered it necessary to apprise you of the situation."

038f9cc7-58db-4675-9ee2-e8e065166738.Text: "This infiltration of a Rogue Trader's ship operated by authorised Enginseers casts doubts on my tech-comrade's stability... if he is indeed my tech-comrade, that is. Regardless, I request permission to communicate with the captive."

b10b7029-d99a-4757-9d24-4f91f5594160.Text: "Understood, Lord Captain. The saboteur will be brought to you."

bf898d6c-2e2e-40bc-9757-2cd7238f98f1.Text: "I ask that the protocol of this conversation include a minor declaration of doubt in regards to the soundness of this directive." {n}Pasqal sounds displeased but holds his temper.{/n}

5f968d87-f65f-45e9-b528-23450fbcee24.Text: "What does Vladaym's execution have to do with rebel propaganda?"

5682e7bd-16cd-429e-81b4-e2daa20251f9.Text: "Thank you for your report, Vigdis. You are dismissed."

f149925d-cb8c-488d-a5cf-8cbb03101937.Text: "Can we find and destroy these recordings?"

969d5350-e8af-48e2-a7b7-6bf68664b3e8.Text: {n}The vox comes to life and emits Vigdis's worried voice.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, our reconnaissance has intercepted a certain recording actively used by the enemies of the Imperium to spread propaganda and sow discord among its people." {n}After a moment of hesitation, she continues,{/n} "The recording contains fragments of the vox-transmitted execution of Vladaym Tocara, the former Liege of Footfall. The data-slate with the recording has already been delivered to your quarters in case you wish to study it."

6c290f05-fb51-4356-a730-0b9b7a1dea4e.Text: "Tocara's grim execution turned him into a martyr, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Initially, this vox-cast was meant to sound only on Footfall, but the rebels managed to spread copies of it beyond the station and disseminated them among the populations of other worlds. In the recording, Vladaym denounces the Imperium's justice and incites others to stand against it. The deprived and the dissatisfied see him as a symbol of their fight against the wrongs of the cruel system."

12804fa0-e763-462b-a327-fd5622512250.Text: "Alas, there is more. The end of the recording includes a fragment where Vladaym repeats ominous incoherent phrases in his near-death delirium. Some particularly impressionable individuals now believe it to be a prophecy of sorts. Reconnaissance reports that every day the lower levels of Footfall see more and more lunatics with glassy eyes mumbling the words of this 'prophecy.' They do not pose any threat yet, but it is an indication of greater troubles to come."

47e759d0-a13d-4e2b-93fa-9916fad0966d.Text: "Our reconnaissance is eliminating rebel outbreaks on our worlds and destroying every found copy of the transmission, but I'm afraid it is impossible to estimate how many copies were made and where they currently are."

2ca0c7bd-8f88-4f73-8694-270836b39e55.Text: "Contact the ships at the gate. I wish to go through."

00c91e27-ce1f-4445-88f4-3e27a978098b.Text: "Who is attacking the Lord Inquisitor's forces?"

69675ead-cf88-4df8-9248-4ad7bea26e2c.Text: [Switch on vox-communication with all decks] "Crew, this is the Lord Captain speaking. I am taking the ship into the unknown, where danger lies and glory awaits. Are you with me?"

71dd8ca8-9e73-4fad-a411-0002252c4011.Text: "Onward. No matter what this journey holds for us, I am ready."

46766f24-28ac-4431-9e42-313e56e7bc6a.Text: "I still have unfinished business on this side. We are changing course."

bfa8db93-30aa-4bf7-bd4e-024f26f68828.Text: "There is no time for audiences. Take us to the dimensional gate and prepare to jump."

961babf1-d84d-4b92-8cd5-e4849314031f.Text: "Main gun deck, commence the blessed ritual of loading. All decks, begin combat preparations. We are giving battle."

ad6b5249-7baa-4be9-a53e-56525585eaaa.Text: "Lord Cap'n, we are passing by a construct marked on the star charts as a dimensional gate. Our augurs are not showing any suspicious energy readings. The device is dormant, thank the Emperor."

402a45bb-6c59-4e5f-9a76-002c823a43d4.Text: "Lord Cap'n, our augurs are detecting energy currents of indeterminate nature within the dimensional gate. It appears to be active. We see a number of ships near the gate, and judging by their markings, they belong to Lord Inquisitor Calcazar's personal squadron."

ed1b3b23-305a-417c-b366-d009845920ac.Text: "Incoming message: 'You are entering an area declared forbidden. Any attempt to approach the xeno-artefact will be considered an act of rebellion against the Emperor. Leave now or be destroyed.' Lord Cap'n, would you prefer to send your reply with the help of the vox-clerics or the main gun deck?"

66c103c8-a335-4138-b29a-9c1bdbfcee45.Text: "Incoming message: 'Sanction for approaching the xeno-artefact granted. Sanction for passage to the other side granted. Safe travels. The Emperor protects.' Looks like the Lord Inquisitor has warned them about our visit."

b545c101-09f7-4f27-8a60-744adf2faa1b.Text: "An ancient xeno-artefact, older than Humanity itself. Judging by its design, this is a gate leading... somewhere. Possibly straight into the wicked abyss of the warp, considering all the nasty shit that used to roam around here. Many captains, Her Ladyship Theodora included, have tried to reveal its secrets, but it seems that no one could figure out how it works. Good for them, if you ask me."

5fe10244-0cb4-48e3-ba4b-a6304750cf61.Text: "I don't want to repeat the rumours and I don't know the truth, but it was bad. There was word of ships and even whole trade convoys disappearing. Captains started avoiding the system, until eventually the Lord Inquisitor came here and made short work of it. Hasn't been much in the way of rumours ever since, actually — the Inquisition made sure voidsmen kept their mouths shut. Whatever the gate used to spew out, it must have been profane and a danger to Humanity."

8541eb1b-c26d-4b22-bc1c-77485154a302.Text: "Lord Cap'n, I would advise against approaching the gate. The Inquisition has declared the entire area around it off-limits and packed it with mines. Our augurs won't be able to detect them."

650f5b37-54b8-479f-bca3-649146f612d2.Text: "Her Ladyship didn't exactly share her plans with us, always kept them close to her chest. But I'll go out on a limb and say she was searching for a way to open the gate and see what's on the other side."

1cf8b8d5-79c3-498b-8ee2-333566883056.Text: "House Chorda is transmitting a vox-call to the Inquisition forces. They guarantee safety if they surrender at once."

3380caa6-a1e8-4fb4-a09b-f9b27c93b936.Text: "We detect Aeldari voidships among the arrived allied vessels."

4d627bdf-1c2e-4d0e-abbb-997ac6d9e8d4.Text: "The Cognisance Fleet conducted its own analysis of this xeno-artefact. All records of the expeditions to the site were added to the exploration catalogue."

8ed15184-ffb9-4e06-8700-2f88272766bb.Text: "Right you are, Lord Cap'n. Glory to House von Valancius!"

6b7847dc-254f-43c2-9b4d-be0425f176ec.Text: "Lord Captain... Don't take it as cowardice, but duty obliges me to ask. You do realise that this may end up being a one-way voyage, don't you?"

d4ff76ff-8d9f-4b20-8cdc-b0d69d623b85.Text: {n}For a while, you hear no response. Then the silence is broken by the sound of heavy footfalls. The rhythmic stomping grows louder and louder. Thousands of feet strike the decks as if marching into oblivion under your banner.{/n}

1057270d-d502-45d6-92b1-8bb521de06c4.Text: "Yes, Lord Captain! Whatever is waiting out there, beware: von Valancius is coming!"

ff7cb6d3-f1be-4298-871c-be168f64ec7b.Text: "Loud and clear, Lord Cap'n. Changing course."

d0521fc3-974f-44c8-b774-da4cd07eaa4b.Text: "I know this place. Calcazar summoned both our packs here to seal this portal to terror and woe. Much blood we did spill that day... Alas, it was not the blood of xenos or warp spawn, but that of the cog-priests of Calcazar himself. While they were working on the gate's foul machines, the breath of evil coming from the other side was turning them into frenzied monsters."

d1e7bb2a-b636-4275-8b3c-ffe7f4dc3a9a.Text: "All crew stand by, we're about to begin the translation procedure. Glory to the von Valancius dynasty!"

ca6a4eae-c3ec-4ee1-b2bf-d17438436f25.Text: "We see Word Bearers ships! Uralon the Cruel is leading his warriors to our aid!"

346ffd00-6eeb-449d-8834-b91802f4e469.Text: "You heard the Lord Captain! Battle stations! Wait, who in the void is that?"

ea7a647c-9efd-4745-b894-54b3869c23fb.Text: "The augurs detect ships marked with the coat of arms of House Winterscale."

68b1caa4-8b87-48a9-a24d-bd340b2f86c8.Text: "An approaching shuttle convoy is requesting permission to dock and asking for an audience. Their markings suggest that they are not part of the squadron left by the Lord Inquisitor."

721e5551-2ae1-41e6-a5d7-f9e0f9b21c3e.Text: "You heard the Lord Captain! Battle stations! Death to the enemy, glory to House von Valancius!"

b7b4fa53-ea47-4172-93f3-e07fff677f1c.Text: "Some of the enemy ships are breaking formation in haste. They are regrouping and falling back to repel an attack from the rear! Looks like someone has arrived to lend us a hand. The enemy is scattered, now is the time to engage."

afabf8ec-2d82-46dc-a636-3bd19aa76625.Text: "Ignore the request. There are more pressing issues right now."

4e5aadac-f380-48b5-8fd0-6edf5782c34d.Text: "And this is all you have to report?"

50db6d7b-8a33-49e7-8a48-f11d90ecad21.Text: "I heard Calligos was hunting xenos. Where is he now?"

c223400e-1008-4509-81e7-e706bdedbffb.Text: "Why did your master order you to contact me?"

cf9725e4-f029-4d2c-9355-c831f0626fa2.Text: "I have no intention of talking to Calligos right now."

96a18087-b940-4fb8-a945-3f88fafd3083.Text: "Your kin attacked an Imperial world. I need to know what happened before I make a decision."

9f481caa-0c07-4996-98da-f4a7f670ca29.Text: "We will save the Aeldari from Calligos's wrath."

2a26da60-d00c-4333-a32c-cfc093793146.Text: "Actually, I have changed my mind. I am sick and tired of dealing with Aeldari — I hope old Winterscale has slaughtered them all by now."

13f4915d-155f-409e-b880-35400b9cf6f2.Text: "What is the Emperor's Vow doing here?"

2984a3b8-641e-4b3d-a1cd-30d78b56d40b.Text: "Do you want two Rogue Traders to go missing on one single cursed world? It is not going to happen."

92aff869-39f6-4f8c-9723-1dd68ff8c4eb.Text: "I do not care for the old man, Winterscale. There is one condition: if I bring him back dead, the deal will be sealed by his successor."

471368f7-a977-4273-820f-7682c7993edd.Text: "Very well. I need more allies like Winterscale."

38324073-6772-481e-8e5a-ede38dfc233c.Text: "Actually, I am here to rescue the Aeldari."

bd39ddae-5c4e-4a29-8994-36801214ff03.Text: "What a shame! I seem to have missed all of the fun."

10a12cb3-cb5c-4e9d-b84c-f6e82a87a36d.Text: "Something tells me the story does not end here."

f5d3e2c3-c296-494d-be42-0d941bc6e3e7.Text: "Was there anyone else with Calligos aside from this Worten?"

cfd80333-96b7-41e0-b14d-295f46d9c370.Text: [Attack the ship] "Do you mean to say that the Emperor's Vow is missing its Lord Captain? How very fortunate. First I shall deal with you, then I shall see to it that Winterscale meets the same fate."

936f7c60-c646-4183-9428-1365eaf8f8eb.Text: "So what do you want from me?"

cb6db1bf-f84b-4911-b44d-3b12fcf4d3da.Text: "I think I know what you want from me."

3040517f-4046-482a-98ae-378b62b7233b.Text: "An excellent way to show Calligos who is the strongest Rogue Trader in the Expanse. Count me in."

94442d55-afe2-42e2-bee0-2073206676b2.Text: "Winterscale may be quick-tempered, but the Aeldari attacked his world first."

3674f268-5527-42a4-a8e1-269c45788c75.Text: "I will try and convince Calligos to seek a peaceful resolution to the conflict."

62de64c1-7a0d-45f9-b696-86b891fd4fa4.Text: "Restrain your emotions. Anger only serves to cloud your sight."

5e576f07-b55e-4741-949a-cd4a54cb094d.Text: "Calligos Winterscale succumbed to the influence of the Archenemy and was put to death for this transgression."

419fd3fc-4cda-4593-8025-53d924e0a3e9.Text: [Attack the ship] "I have decapitated the Winterscale dynasty. The time has come to decapitate its fleet."

5ef1bd88-9bd8-46f7-a913-660f64f2fb0b.Text: "You must have lost you mind if you think a Rogue Trader is obliged to report to you."

aa7b2918-6d08-465b-8cd9-5835e0e72f67.Text: "Your master perished after battling the daemon masquerading as Worten the Grey this entire time."

19eb7558-1436-4f8a-bf45-7028a464d6af.Text: [Lie] "I could not find Calligos in the endless woods. It was simply an impossible task."

39ee53e8-db9b-49c6-939f-49cf0b7be8b8.Text: "Before dying, Calligos permitted the xenos to leave the world unhindered. Let their ships pass into orbit."

337a8e80-5a6a-43ad-8754-dbded475f0a3.Text: [Attack the ship] "Who said I was done with you?"

10055a94-bcd4-4aa0-94a8-611579e73c77.Text: "There are still some xenos left on this world. You will allow them to leave it unhindered. Consider it payment for my time and efforts."

5535a608-3fd2-48e6-9795-78105fd794cb.Text: "All right, calm down. I need to take care of Winterscale's flagship right now."

a25a3b0e-ddc3-41ce-80bc-ab114880c7b4.Text: [Change back to Vigdis's frequency without saying anything] "There was some interference. Where were we?"

3ed27631-6115-46da-9ed4-77776d1fe6b7.Text: "How could you not find your master over the course of thirty days?"

f894da34-8da9-4096-814a-cf87d73e967e.Text: "Negative. I am not yet ready to meet Calligos."

c0987f92-2e59-425d-8ece-83c9c58442b7.Text: "What information does our librarium have on the Winterscale flagship?"

25882b34-2c71-43e6-b870-74f96b5d99e3.Text: "I need more information. Order the augur crew to extend the range of the wave emitters."

5ca7780e-bd4d-4fc0-b127-f59de7374c01.Text: "Does Winterscale not wish to speak in person? Quite an ambiguous gesture."

82526580-8569-4989-a467-9fc48ecb3744.Text: "Not even the void of the cosmos can hide your anxiety, Erbreght. Now speak."

2f23d7ef-e99e-458b-99b3-6b5ba988c011.Text: "I wish to speak directly to Calligos."

9e7a05e0-c596-41ab-8c2f-fcfed8147fc6.Text: "Permission to speak, Lord Captain. The augur crew has registered activity in the orbit of Quetza Temer, one of the worlds of the Winterscale dynasty. According to the report, the Emperor's Vow, the flagship of Rogue Trader Calligos Winterscale, is positioned over the southern hemisphere."

4d0a0ab6-909c-435a-bf9f-7752bb216962.Text: "I presume the xenos hunt is in full swing. And the hunter has already caught the scent of its prey."

17673b69-2e0f-4b05-a29a-37ee4b36dc21.Text: "N-no, of course not." {n}Vigdis's vox crackles nervously.{/n} "The officers are about to extend the range of the wave emitters."

c6dd2cbb-e9e2-4c2c-89bb-dc063252987b.Text: "I am afraid the Lord Captain did not give such an order. This is my own personal initiative." {n}The Vox Master loudly clears his throat, looking for the right words.{/n}

09aa0495-d5fc-402c-965a-77e1b870f2b4.Text: "Calligos Winterscale's flagship is still maintaining orbit above Quetza Temer. Should we hail the bridge?"

0be069f7-2dfb-4ac0-a694-269299cf2230.Text: "The Emperor's Vow sends its greetings to the glorious ruler of the von Valancius dynasty! This is Erbreght ap Daeff, His Lordship Calligos Winterscale's Vox Master, who has the honour of speaking on behalf of his lord today."

0310d978-4bf9-45be-8330-c52a2b9c22eb.Text: "{mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship} Lord Captain {name} von Valancius returns greetings and demands you state the reason for establishing a vox-channel immediately."

6e9aab96-9b07-49ac-bfec-56478e63682c.Text: "By the gold of the Throne, the scions of von Valancius are shrewd to a man!" {n}The Vox Master loudly clears his throat, looking for the right words.{/n}

b332471c-43c9-4e72-9418-ca00ab078831.Text: "It is known for a fact that the ship has undergone many modifications, including the replacement of macro-weapons for long-range laser batteries and short-range macro-batteries. And... I am afraid this is all we know, Lord Captain."

b7620d89-0de7-4512-a30b-6d42ed0e2a56.Text: "Incredibly ancient, incredibly complex, incredibly unpredictable... And extremely demanding when it comes to resources? Had I been one of the highborn, though unofficial, rulers of the Expanse... I would definitely have chosen this voidship for myself."

19966715-3b1a-4ac5-93f7-93907bc8ab39.Text: "The librarium of House Orsellio also held records on the Emperor's Vow. Its most famous owner, to be precise — Sebastian Winterscale, a fledging Rogue Trader of great promise. It is not known how Sebastian acquired this ship, but Lord Captain Winterscale used it to traverse the Maw and find a new home in the Koronus Expanse."

b7a3b9a8-2ebb-4fb0-b3a5-2a1ab25645e2.Text: "It will be done." {n}By the grace of the machine spirits, the air gradually fills with discordant noises until the Vox Master flips the last tumbler on the cogitator's panel.{/n}

4058dae3-70da-4c5f-90c0-edca98126427.Text: {n}Yrliet's vox remains silent for a long while.{/n} "Do as your human heart commands, elantach. I know how fickle it can be."

1d8e6861-1ced-4a82-abe6-b035a5a15827.Text: "I understand that the request is quite... onerous. But I still ask Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} to consider my offer."

57c6d670-366d-4893-9da9-861193d5e2bc.Text: {n}Erbreght ap Daeff stays silent for an inappropriately long period of time.{/n} "In this case Worten the Grey best return in a body bag. The data transfer decree has been signed. My crew will send you the landing coordinates. May the God-Emperor look after you!"

a8d06e61-a4d9-492e-947f-5ef0b8cb76ca.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I bow before your courage on behalf of the Winterscale dynasty. The data transfer decree has been signed. My crew will send you the landing coordinates. The God-Emperor's grace shine upon you for many years to come!"

ab2ae41a-8ccc-4b92-8fac-ef416fd2e6ee.Text: {n}The Vox Master's thundering voice falls silent, and the machine spirits terminate the connection between the flagships of two great dynasties.{/n}

117a7c8c-27bd-43e5-aeee-5c210b198acf.Text: "Elantach, negotiating with your stellar rival may resolve the conflict between our species... Before it is too late."

9648b54c-fa1a-4e4e-96b3-5503f1b7aac6.Text: {n}Erbreght ap Daeff's booming voice is deafeningly straightforward, just like the voice of his master. There is no falsehood, no venom, no malice, only sincerity and a burning desire to act.{/n}

c74aaebd-9fcd-4710-9bea-ba9d7b9c0989.Text: "Do you really see justice in the frayed tapestry of fate offered to those of Crudarach, elantach? Your predecessor destroyed it, unravelled it, burned it to the ground... And scattered thousands of souls into the wind!" {n}The Aeldari's voice is ringing with sorrow.{/n}

2ad1dc1e-6a2c-4520-bd76-101845c74dbc.Text: "Justice? Perhaps. Everybody in this world deserves justice. The seers who led thousands of souls to slaughter by defying their visions. A handful of survivors who attacked a mon-keigh world in a fit of suicidal fury. An Outcast who discovered... affection."

5c1cd754-2833-4ba8-b904-c8fc17d0791e.Text: "Were the other mon-keigh even half the likes of you, {name}... Perhaps... A fragile peace between our species could one day become possible."

d50516da-fd6b-483b-9688-db5e8bf814f2.Text: "This... is fair. I will accompany you to this tumultuous world."

9a6ead3b-e868-4039-9d07-c6e191b1a2b0.Text: "{mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship} Lord Captain {name} von Valancius returns greetings and wishes to speak to Lord Captain Calligos Winterscale directly."

789785f0-eded-4f5a-a04a-3493354ad6f7.Text: "I do not wish to offend, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, but I am the most senior officer aboard the Emperor's Vow at the moment. As for the Lord Captain..." {n}Erbreght ap Daeff clears his throat, looking for the right words.{/n}

ec61ad30-d303-4700-ac79-a4d5d549bd32.Text: "I do not wish to offend, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! The Lord Captain would never miss an opportunity to enjoy a personal conversation with... a {mf|man|woman} of similar station. {n}The Vox Master loudly clears his throat, looking for the right words.{/n}

8d08bce9-34c8-4c94-9cbe-09f8ff2b22ae.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, words cannot begin to describe the fortune with which the stars have graced the servants of the Winterscale dynasty this day!" {n}The Vox Master loudly clears his throat, looking for the right words.{/n}

30cb60d1-dac8-4713-9b23-f325143a03c3.Text: "Anticipating the next question, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}... No. I am confident the Lord Captain is still alive, his body and spirit do not break easily. And besides, he is accompanied by Worten the Grey who would sell his soul if that helped to keep the Lord Captain out of harm's way."

0b73e386-24e8-4bb6-99c7-4198e14aa666.Text: "You see, the Lord Captain had yet another heated argument with the esteemed Incendia Chorda, and he had... a very good reason for his displeasure. I dare not discuss His Lordship's affairs, but I can divulge that we set out to protect the dynasty's rightful demesne from the invasion of the profane xenos. This is how we arrived here, at Quetza Temer."

394ed697-af5d-4e19-a951-866554b22552.Text: {n}The Vox Master loudly clears his throat, looking for the right words.{/n}

b1632970-f397-4edc-a13c-a4b059038842.Text: "'There is no better hunting ground when you need to cool off your head,' I believe the Lord Captain said. We easily crushed the pathetic mockery of a fleet that was laying siege to the unfortunate world. Of course, most of the xenos fled, but we did reduce a few of their ships to chum for the void beasts!" {n}The Vox Master laughs cruelly.{/n}

d6b8dd2d-835a-4f5a-9ca1-d3f504395a33.Text: "My kin... Did they really manage to escape from the iron grip of your master? Answer me, mon-keigh!"

26f522e5-6437-42a6-8fd2-625341ecb4e0.Text: {n}A confounded silence fills the air.{/n} "Few of them did. And not for long, xenos."

e671728b-56fb-491c-a174-3c552d4cd1cb.Text: "Do not be upset, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. One of the ships crashed on Quetza Temer, so at least some of these slippery xenos must have survived and are still wandering the forest. True, the Lord Captain did wish to descend and finish off this elusive prey, but even he has not been able to escape the clinging grasp of the thicket for over thirty days now.
