It will be an even greater ordeal for these wounded creatures."

91c87377-7db7-4aa4-b501-9f6b7235cafd.Text: "Then you are a bit late, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. We have eradicated everyone we could reach. One of the ships even crashed on Quetza Temer, and the Lord Captain did wish to descend and finish off the elusive prey. At best, there are a few solitary xenos left wandering the woods... But even the Lord Captain has not been able to find his way out of them for over thirty days. It will be an even greater ordeal for these wounded creatures."

3cfe6d9d-d1ab-48b2-9929-95f2a6f15916.Text: "Things are not so simple, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. The Lord Captain last contacted me from the landing point currently right under the Vow's belly. We lost about a dozen shuttles and several hundred scouts in the first days of the search, all of whom went down to Quetza Temer and never came back."

ab0286d7-5469-45e8-8a49-09e6e7a38632.Text: "A full hunting party consisting of half a hundred hand-picked enforcers. And His Lordship's personal retinue, naturally."

e44851e5-1b9c-48ad-92f3-39a27642e01e.Text: "I was hoping... you would be different from her. It was a vain hope. Do as your human heart commands, for this Outcast no longer has a place in the ruins of the mon-keigh soul." {n}Yrliet's vox remains silent for a long while.{/n}

92b885cb-e2e4-443f-8200-4f712854638a.Text: "Our shuttles are relentlessly sweeping the airspace where our people perished. This way we were able to reduce the search area to just a few thousand kilometres... Which still does not change the fact that people in the thicket are disappearing without a trace and something is jamming the vox-transmissions."

b94d80cc-507b-4b08-b9ef-8948d3c8f96a.Text: {n}Vigdis's report is suddenly interrupted by Idira's anxious voice.{/n} "Lord Captain, Lord Captain! This is it, right here, so very close! The quiet whispers — they won't stop! They keep buzzing in both my ears that my little door is somewhere on this world."

c7d8820e-d9d4-48ae-bdb1-61419f215b1e.Text: "A generous favour in return for a generous favour. Find Lord Captain Winterscale on Quetza Temer and bring him back to the Emperor's Vow. I swear by the Golden Throne that I will convince him to side with you in any conflict that occurs in the next hundred years. After all, I am allowed to make deals on the Lord Captain's behalf while he remains unavailable."

7d10bf28-d158-4e4e-bcab-574865db947a.Text: "They do say that rising stars burn brighter than the old." {n}Erbreght can barely contain a booming chuckle.{/n} "The data transfer decree has been signed. My crew will send you the landing coordinates. The God-Emperor's grace shine upon you for many years to come!"

de982031-34cf-4780-85e7-e527c5ab2a3d.Text: "May Asuryan protect his children... We must halt the frenzy of your stellar rival, elantach! Or else, by Isha's tears, his subjects will not escape retribution!"

c45b6948-8b40-4ca0-9fc6-ecae3a1ab85c.Text: "Then he deserved it!" {n}Yrliet's sonorous voice suddenly rises to a shrill cry and abruptly falters.{/n}

69de29b2-1407-417c-884d-e2083b099dfa.Text: "Hurry up, elantach, before there is nothing left to decide."

3ca62c62-5239-4bcd-97ea-3fa32ca55998.Text: {n}Yrliet breathes a confused sigh.{/n} "Sometimes you speak just like my kin, elantach."

491407bf-13d4-405f-ac52-b2521cf6d6a8.Text: {n}As soon as the expedition returns, Vigdis Surri Otta hails the Emperor's Vow.{/n}

0ff8ae83-b3de-4a7c-98af-46ca0af1e679.Text: "Our chaplain was praying for the good health and speedy return of Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, {name} von Valancius." {n}There is a tense pause and Erbreght ap Daeff's hissing breath fills the air.{/n} "Allow me to enquire about the fate of Lord Captain Winterscale... Perhaps you were lucky enough to meet? Unfortunately, in all this time he has still not contacted his subjects."

27356bf7-d7d2-4269-9a02-cfba36459579.Text: "The cup of fate runneth over, elantach, but my kin have already drained their vessel of grief down to the bitter dregs. Before your stellar rival has time to claim the lives of the last children of Crudarach, we must stave off oblivion for those who only lament the loss of their heart and home. I am sure the Children of Asuryan had a good reason to attack a mon-keigh world."

f54625c8-8afc-48a1-ab3f-79ade5f050ea.Text: "So, this is how things turned out. The death of His Lordship is a great tragedy for the entire dynasty. The vastness of my grief is mitigated only by the knowledge that the Lord Captain perished in a fierce battle. He would have it no other way."

0533bc6c-0172-4be0-a3ab-24866abc0a95.Text: "Absolutely not, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}" {n}The Vox Master hurriedly clears his throat, filling the air with static.{/n} "I just wanted to make sure... However, compared to your peace of mind, my concern is insignificant. Forgive this servant his temerity."

624d8cde-3b6d-409e-bf11-a4f8957c3aaa.Text: "I would never doubt your words, Rogue Trader, had we not been talking about Calligos Winterscale. The Lord Captain could not have been conspiring with the Ruinous Powers — we were pursuing and eliminating them together all over the Expanse!"

fac028e2-df07-40a3-a3f2-93e69303f2c1.Text: "Worten was... What?" {n}The exclamation is followed by a stunned silence.{/n}

4ee05e1e-9180-4a97-8850-21c65c6de0c0.Text: "So, this is how things turned out... But we will not lose hope. The Emperor's Vow humbly thanks you for this information and for your time, Rogue Trader. I wish you a safe voyage through the dark waters between the stars."

b18441ea-693c-4d35-a77c-0831ba91e872.Text: "The foe is attacking! Man the ca..." {n}Erbreght ap Daeff's furious snarl is cut short as the connection is terminated. The engines of the Emperor's Vow bloom with blue and gold flames as the plasma weapons aim at your port.{/n}

979c74f4-6cc4-49ec-a383-ca9638a7ccb5.Text: "So, this is how things turned out..." {n}Erbreght ap Daeff hums sceptically.{/n} "Anyway, the Emperor's Vow humbly thanks you for this information and for your time, Rogue Trader. I wish you a safe voyage through the dark waters between the stars, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

f53ebe33-8dc1-4d50-aaf7-e701b61b92af.Text: "Emperor protects!" {n}The Emperor's Vow terminates the connection.{/n}

cd1157fc-c4ae-44af-9c1c-5eeb4b6d9f6a.Text: "I... will relay your words to his heirs. Along with the news that it was {name} von Valancius {mf|himself|herself} who became his executioner." {n}The Vox Master's voice is cold as ice.{/n} "You have done much for our dynasty... We will never forget that."

ab0d6a8e-4b70-462b-80af-04b82d93b293.Text: "As soon as the Lord Captain's heir claims their rightful title, I will immediately notify the new Rogue Trader of our agreement. You may have to wait for a few years, the transfer of the Warrant is... a rather delicate affair."

70a0f546-edb7-488f-8add-c86dfea18278.Text: "Lord Captain, I beg Your forgiveness, but it appears the Emperor's Vow has already detected our presence in the system and is requesting permission to initiate the data vox-transfer. What would you have me do?"

9caf5039-c18e-4fa2-9619-4708fb2367bd.Text: "I am afraid you have not fulfilled all of the conditions, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Calligos Winterscale must come back aboard, dead or alive. Unfortunately, as of right now his current location and status remain unknown."

14584c0e-0ea1-4ec5-9754-680618ebb071.Text: "This does not sound like the Lord Captain at all." {n}The Vox Master sighs doubtfully.{/n} "We will make sure the xenos leave Quetza Temer and the boundaries of this system. Safe and sound, of course."

036bee60-bb6b-4f7e-96c2-5416451e948a.Text: {n}The Vox Master follows your words with a tense silence.{/n} "We will make sure the xenos leave Quetza Temer and the boundaries of this system. Alive, of course."

03f9d975-fbe8-4507-ae1e-81efa765bdb7.Text: "The door from my visions! The one I told you about, remember? Nothing major, just my last hope for salvation."

f8d03c07-6131-45c3-8a43-233a71565de0.Text: "Of course, Lord Captain. I dare not interrupt you any longer!"

013ff953-b461-4163-aaf1-24a811269f72.Text: {n}After a brief hesitation, Vigdis's voice comes through the hissing of static once more.{/n} "Allow me to repeat, Lord Captain: the Emperor's Vow, the flagship of Rogue Trader Calligos Winterscale, has been detected in the orbit of Quetza Temer, one of the Winterscale worlds. What are your orders?"

de85e7fd-e589-4608-951d-c4352b8cab59.Text: {n}Half an hour later, you hear the Vox Master's nervous voice from the comm-bead:{/n} "Lord Captain, a report came in from the shuttle bay. The xenos Yrliet... has departed after convincing a hapless pilot that it was the Rogue Trader's personal order for her to be transported to Quetza Temer. The pilot saw no other option but to comply. Once the shuttle reached the surface, all contact with it was lost. That is where their trail ends."

60b003df-2dc2-489a-81e9-280ee57a92b4.Text: {n}The booming voice fills the air, startling a few officers on the bridge. However, you feel that Erbreght ap Daeff's ostentatiously confident tone is meant to hide his concern.{/n}

80e4535f-05cb-4228-b9ed-311a90ac703e.Text: "Throne take me! Ahem. Beg your forgiveness, Lord Captain. The Emperor's Vow has detected the empowered emanations of our augurs and is requesting permission to initiate vox-transfer. What would you have us do?"

4eff1408-fbf4-475a-843b-98a22db418ee.Text: {n}In minor turn of the chrono, the Vox Master reports again:{/n} "Lord Captain, the data has been updated. Quetza Temer's largest continents suffered from a moderate xenos planetary invasion. We also discovered the wreckage of several Aeldari vessels on the periphery of the system. Another vessel crashed onto the world, causing minor seismic activity. A dozen shuttles of the Winterscale dynasty are patrolling the space directly above the crash site."

c4ac4bca-fc07-4496-a4a0-69cb2a24ef8b.Text: "I have only been lucky enough to see an Avenger twice in my life. The Imperial Navy considers this ship to be... something of a relic. A mighty yet clumsy vestige of the past. Its firepower is second only to the Imperium's battleships, but I have heard quite a few stories about the fickleness of Avengers and the confusing design of their engines."

1021492e-8049-47cc-a688-bb57757c1ee7.Text: {n}For a while, the vox broadcasts only the clicking of Vigdis's metallic manipulators.{/n} "The Emperor's Vow is a cruiser carrying up to one hundred and twenty thousand crew. Length overall: six thousand metres. Beam: one thousand metres. Estimated time of service in the Winterscale dynasty fleet... several millennia."

43e1b5d0-2139-4111-8839-ce7d471c904f.Text: "You see, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}... One of the Aeldari ships crashed on Quetza Temer, so the Lord Captain chose to descend and finish off the elusive prey. But he has not been able to find his way out of the local woods for over thirty days now. And this... concerns me greatly."

f55b3695-9a2d-41c2-9708-ea1b6b18113a.Text: "Was there a xenos in flashy clothes speaking in rhymes, by any chance?"

4b341571-51e3-453c-858c-4bbe7803a9be.Text: "Store the weapons into crates, seal them, and hide out of sight. There is demand even for such goods."

9e87243d-8db4-440d-8174-80c8412498ef.Text: "Process the bodies into corpse starch. We could always use more provisions."

08612d57-df2d-48dc-a135-aff3302f33d6.Text: "Provide them with cabins and put them to work. They are part of the crew from now on."

72679929-5d07-4ff5-b6e9-4929920b700f.Text: "That damned xenos deceived me. Throw this 'cargo' out of an airlock."

93f5f8a8-eb4a-435c-aa54-d6db6df12e7b.Text: "Out the airlock with the lot of them. We have no use for unwanted passengers."

dc1a3e44-34e5-4a53-b16f-83d3a26040f1.Text: {n}The Vox Master's puzzled voice distracts you from your duties.{/n} "My apologies, Lord Captain, but I have just been delivered an urgent report. Cargo Bay 73-G has received some unusual... cargo, if one can call it that. The crew considered disposing of it, but did not dare to do so without your direct order."

2523a9a6-6b18-4c67-bb27-190fbff89b95.Text: "The cargo itself is weaponry — intricate blades made of bones and living flesh. Those weapons... they keep repeating your name, Lord Captain, and claim in their moans that you saved them from Commorragh. Next to them, the crew found a strange horned mask of xenos origin."

6ecc0705-54c1-4e69-9a28-ca0e116c4f3d.Text: "The cargo itself is a pile of corpses. None of the people were on the crew manifest. Judging by the injuries, they were killed instantly and painlessly, before somehow being delivered to the ship. Next to them, the crew found a strange horned mask of xenos origin."

6cd77eae-0ad4-4f15-b74c-30678fbb4e53.Text: "I suppose 'cargo' is not quite the correct term. It is a crowd of people in worn military uniforms of the Imperium. They insist that you are their commander who saved them from Commorragh. If their account is to be believed, some masked xenos who spoke in riddles somehow managed to transport them on board."

d809fc6c-4342-436a-af72-0bc169e8bc3f.Text: "I suppose 'cargo' is not quite the correct term. It is a disorderly crowd of people and xenos demanding to see you. They call themselves 'Shriekers' and consider you their leader who saved them from Commorragh. If their account is to be believed, some masked xenos who spoke in riddles somehow managed to transport them on board."

267cf563-fa74-4170-ab82-b49525d95bb1.Text: "They are led by an Imperial Guard Commissar by the name of Iako Sotniy, a rather spirited man with a booming voice. He claims to have played a key part in your escape from Commorragh and that he is ready to serve faithfully in the name of the Imperium."

9c34faf9-a1da-4850-9639-aa038cc1d42b.Text: "There is one notable figure among them — a certain Sergeant Vigastes, a severely injured man armed with a worn lasgun. He has asked to send you his gratitude for saving him from the Dark City and declared his willingness to serve under your command."

9d6a24d9-e8fd-4d04-afa7-e9b5aea5f74d.Text: {n}Vigdis falls quiet for a moment, either processing what she just heard or making enquiries through other vox-channels. Eventually, the vox comes to life again.{/n} "No, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, and I doubt that such a conspicuous character could have slipped by unnoticed. I will inform you if the crew reports seeing anyone like that."

9237ec60-c73b-4a57-bdf1-8d318c531738.Text: "I will see to it, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I dare not disturb you any longer."

017fc461-6acb-452e-af4d-e6936b22f577.Text: "I suppose 'cargo' is not quite the correct term. It is a disorderly crowd of heavily scarred people demanding to see you. They call themselves 'Shriekers' and consider you their leader who initiated them into the Imperial Creed and saved them from Commorragh. If their account is to be believed, some masked xenos who spoke in riddles somehow managed to transport them on board."

887b3585-4f4e-48e8-a81e-8b8c0155c50f.Text: "Nomos, where did you get this information from?"

8a55b3f5-a6cd-4ced-b916-edb6acfd6864.Text: "Judging by the orbital trajectories, this is the parent star of the system. If the lumenoreader is right, back in the day it used to be huge and angry with a bite to it, not this half-dead firefly."

865ae13e-9dbd-46a1-8572-2606607efe81.Text: "I have no answer, Lord Captain. The data suggests that this star should have been active for several million more years."

ac30d067-9c90-41d2-8ed4-954e7dcdfed7.Text: "It was attacked. Suddenly and fiercely. A hungry predator bit into its magnetic field and drank as much of its energy as it could. The predator was starving and would have surely devoured the star whole had it had more time."

35ae6441-dfc8-43e5-88a0-4a8f7c91cfb9.Text: "I can't imagine what could have drained a deadly beast like that. The lumenoreader swears that the rays of this star would have continued withering all life in the system for millions of years more. It was too young to have faded like this. It's like it was... gnawed out."

3362d4a3-0bfe-4572-9986-bc00644cb002.Text: "The star right ahead of us is native to this system. The lumenoreader reports that its structure has been... altered."

f4dbf5c4-cac7-4424-81b2-8264297f018b.Text: "I do not know, but I can read the traces of what was committed here as if I have seen it happen a hundred times."

05ac51da-74fe-437b-a9d0-ab18899dc918.Text: "Don't you think that we are observing far too many stars here?"

8860bfb2-e11e-4878-a651-158b68533f89.Text: "As curious as all this may be, we still have a job to do."

b231cb8a-2381-4d2d-834b-d8d9aba7938d.Text: "Those things... I've never seen anything like them before, but the panel of the ship's Tech-Priest lumenoreaders says that they are star corpses. Not just corpses... They called them 'stellocide victims.'"

951e6a05-4382-4e04-946f-0ef0bfedaa76.Text: "I have no answer as the lumenoreaders have been quite vague. As far as I understand, they suspect that the death of these stars was unnatural and greatly premature. The reason for so early a demise is unknown to them."

e6af92c0-3b46-4bc5-b25c-416f937f486f.Text: "Your observation is quite accurate. The stellar trajectories point to all but one of the stars being alien to this system. The other stars were... somehow transported here from the outside."

9ccab62c-4961-493a-8360-4d7e916251e6.Text: "Who knows with those star sages. Apparently, when a star dies a natural death, it's different. These look like they were murdered and plundered. All of their energy was siphoned, like when a spider sucks the innards out of a fly. And witnessing these husks, if you don't mind me saying, scared the lumenoreaders so much that they wet their metal trousers."

15022335-cb03-45e9-bedb-4974ededbb3a.Text: "I agree, Lord Cap'n. The stellar trajectories also suggest that most of these stars didn't use to be here. Someone was hoarding them in this system, and I wouldn't like to have been here at that time — the gravitational currents would have been pure chaos. Who could have pulled off something like that? Was it Drukhari? Dragging stars around like they are their property is quite in character for those damn xenos."

f43ca763-0c7e-417e-b41e-290dde4e5ccd.Text: "Lord Captain, the panel of lumenoreader Tech-Priests would like to inform you that we're looking at the remains of dead stars. The exact term they used was 'stellocide victims.'"

a9e1d731-5fd1-4fbe-b616-0ad2f1c5a382.Text: "Research the tomes in the Rogue Trader's private library. Perhaps it will give us insight into these monsters."

ff6c0f2a-bc03-4fed-a1d2-10c0d45c21fb.Text: "What is this trophy we have acquired?"

72a3f1da-bbd7-4eec-83e4-68de93a8c6df.Text: "Do we really know nothing about this enemy?"

b95e97a6-9847-402c-b551-676dbb324ac7.Text: "Bolster the crew's morale. Give out additional rations to those who showed valour in battle. This is just the beginning."

3baf554e-e627-4de8-9e33-e20dc01fecb6.Text: "Lord Cap'n, what were those things? They took off from the surface of the world where you landed!"

d0cccfe9-8671-4008-9fb8-75d519ac1646.Text: {n}The vox clicks as it lets someone into the channel.{/n} "The Oghyr, {name}. That is what our legends call those decrepit relics, those walking corpses that supposedly existed even before our time. However, they are far too real to be dismissed as mere legend, and so are their cradles in this part of the galaxy. Reaving Tempest scouts have long been reporting encounters with them in realspace. And it bodes no good that the Oghyr have awakened from their sleep and are attacking anything in sight."

b49a4c31-ad66-4ffc-bb53-c25f9897b4a9.Text: "The Enginseers are at a loss. They say it's a gift born from the Omnissiah's wisdom, but its image was imperfect, and therefore it was eroded by corruption and unbelief — whatever that means... The ship's minor conclave has gone into datameditation to produce a resolution regarding the admissibility of using this item."

47ee51e9-8992-4ef9-8756-0756d5bc2631.Text: "'So vast were the Nephilimechs' abilities and so immeasurable the depth of their minds that pride tempted them. The Nephilimechs rejected the design of the Deus Mechanicus in favour of their own. The order of existence was defiled, and a great war of absolute destruction came. The Nephilimechs were overthrown and exterminated, with only a few managing to hide from the Omnissiah's eye by extinguishing their minds and shrouding themselves in oblivion.'"

3c40b1b5-7802-4563-8dcc-6ac0cf4a6ed6.Text: "Nothing but tales and rumours. I've heard stories — about sickle ships that reap entire squadrons like ears of grain, about crews that know no fear, about the veil of death that shrouds them and corrodes their enemies' ships like rust. Those stories aren't worth a grox's arse, though, because they also say that none has ever survived encountering those sickle ships. If that were true, there wouldn't be anyone around to tell those stories, would there?"

e61b8f23-c38c-4088-8c0e-fac5a1f7651b.Text: {n}Several hours later, the Vox Master's report comes in.{/n}

9cbf489c-b799-43de-8146-5f3ea3a729c7.Text: "Lord Captain, the Carto-Artifex claims to have found a mention of the xenos we have encountered. The records indicate that they are known as 'Necrons.'"

50b9bbd8-d2ba-443f-a1d7-53f12498c216.Text: "The ship's minor conclave has delved into datameditation to find the answer to this question. I'm afraid we're going to have to wait."

42990d47-a5d6-4f0b-973b-d7996cd64a5c.Text: "I must disappoint you, Lord Captain. Our research has yielded no results."

efe7a1b2-f1e4-4fa2-b354-e7812c14c936.Text: "I have never seen ships like that, never seen such technologies either. We've fished a trophy out of the void, a relatively intact fragment of a wreck, and sent it to our Enginseers. And, just in case, we've isolated the compartment where they are performing their comprehension liturgies."

816dbb50-26c2-4b06-bc75-81c4e970c666.Text: "Permission to report, Lord Captain! The ship's systems are in order. The crew is operating as normal. As for the xenos who attacked us..." {n}Vigdis's voice trembles.{/n} "We're all confused here. A fragment of one of the vanquished ships has been brought on board as a trophy and sent to our Enginseers to be studied."

15c03be6-6618-4338-aa65-e80f198919bc.Text: "Data available. Those creatures are Nephilimechs, the Omnissiah's fallen angels. Citing a quotation: 'The first machine spirits ever created by the Omnissiah were in will, in body, and in power. Unmatched in their perfection, they were realising the design of the Deus Mechanicus into being. But the principle of entropy conceived by the Omnissiah was fundamental, thus even the perfect became flawed through the overabundance of their perfection.'"

3734cb2d-a82b-4db6-aab0-c7e9561edc6b.Text: {n}An hours-long silence follows as your order is being executed. At last, the vox comes to life again.{/n} "...Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, the Carto-Artifex claims to have found a mention of xenos similar to the ones we've encountered. The manuscript refers to them as 'Necrons.'"

eb5358a9-c89e-47af-90d4-23f39cb482b3.Text: "'In their change, the Omnissiah created new machine spirits and destined them into servitude, so that they would remember the limits of their power and would not descend into pride. As for the ultimate perfection, the Deus Mechanicus abolished it from the universe, and thus it was no more.'"

2f1093b7-25f2-4ec9-adbc-69fa9f3351d3.Text: {n}An hours-long silence follows as your order is being executed. At last, the vox comes to life again.{/n} "I'm sorry, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. The Carto-Artifex has found nothing that matches the description of the heretical xenos we've encountered."

70855889-d334-4931-8f39-f91eba32aa29.Text: "I am afraid so, Lord Captain. All I can offer you is the crew's idle tales — talk of cursed sickle ships one may run into when straying far from known routes, and of those ships' monstrous crews..."

9958efa5-eafe-48b3-8d61-c7f69e903174.Text: "The Oghyr are lifeless shells. They feel no fear, no doubt — nothing at all, in fact, not even pain or suffering, which makes them unpleasantly dull prey. I doubt that we have seen the last of them, so keep your servants on alert and do not ever think of underestimating the Oghyr in combat. I have seen with my own eyes what their gauss weapons are capable of. For a mon-keigh, facing an opponent like that would be a lethal challenge."

86ff0047-58f9-4d63-8b12-60f7290c3b42.Text: "Turn back and retreat at full engine speed."

a824fd77-6ae5-4b9f-b3ec-88ddab6d67c1.Text: "Lord Captain, a xenos squadron is on an intercept course! It's the same abominations as before!"

42b4a7bb-32ee-4ab5-9ce8-1db19d3beec5.Text: "I'm afraid that's impossible, Lord Captain. Perhaps Ravor could have managed a manoeuvre of that sort... but right now, all we can do is fight."

8acc7b1f-2791-447f-8900-9861a36ec1e9.Text: "I think they are guards. The ships took off from the surface of the planetoid as soon as we bathed it with the eye of our augurs. I'm not an expert on xenos minds, but I know my void manoeuvres, and I can tell you this: they are angry, and they are approaching on a direct and unambiguously aggressive trajectory."

b8a3828c-dea7-4938-a842-539a57622dc8.Text: "Orders received, Lord Captain! Glory to House von Valancius!"

d8210d91-f692-443e-9d2a-1828ad508693.Text: "I'm afraid that won't work, Lord Cap'n. They are pushing their engines to the limit, so I guess they really want us dead. I believe combat preparations are in order."

9ee1a3ea-ec20-465e-a0cd-7f086d918f60.Text: "Lord Captain, a squadron of xenos ships is on course to intercept us."

d979eeb5-3f73-426e-bd1c-a83ea0142749.Text: "Lord Captain, unidentified sickle-shaped ships have taken off from the planet we just left. They're approaching swiftly and readying their weapons for battle. Get ready! It's about to get hot in here!"

393a85bd-3357-4ffa-aa8d-121f3835bcaf.Text: "We are going after the Lord Inquisitor."

9976a186-101c-487a-93d1-438e7d4bffcb.Text: "What are these gifts that we received?"

7ee10f21-f717-419d-bddd-ba0889beaee9.Text: "Translation complete, Lord Cap'n. Current coordinates unknown and indeterminable. All that's in the ship's immediate vicinity is the dimensional gate that has gone into passive mode and a large amount of debris. No enemies detected."

9e11068d-9970-4cde-a4d2-835884145a18.Text: "Lord Ulfar may need to be informed that the coordinates his esteemed brothers travelled to match a location somewhere in these star systems."

32fd2c3a-0663-401a-9da8-c8ef465b12d2.Text: "The Enginseers have proposed a hypothesis that it has entered some kind of recharge mode. After accumulating enough energy for a new translation, it will activate again... Or at least that's what all of us want to believe. Badly."

6ec8d29a-fd9e-495c-9f26-738225f2ccbd.Text: "Those are ship carcasses. Judging by their markings, they were part of the Lord Inquisitor's fleet and likely acted as a patrol force. The damage doesn't look like it came from any weapon we know, and the way the debris are scattered suggests that the battle was short. Someone attacked and destroyed every one of them in the blink of an eye. Someone we have never encountered before."

1bf827b6-2542-4536-870a-3dc87ee4b473.Text: "I can't say, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. These are unfamiliar stars, and the system is not listed in our astrogational data. We are in uncharted territory."

31e54d7f-9acf-4cac-adae-d5875479b4ba.Text: "As you command, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. If I may just point out, the expedition equipment prepared in advance for Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} and your retinue has been maintained well and is ready for use at your order."

04d12b04-b524-4d0d-b064-a74eb7b1a839.Text: "The gifts passed to us by our esteemed allies from Footfall have likewise been inventoried and prepared for service."

4da15fe1-f1e0-49c4-b7fe-6fd67b9c7579.Text: "I am delighted to be of use to Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

e0f213c6-4bc1-44d3-b304-854e524b38c8.Text: "The devout preachers of the Cult of Saint Drusus supplied our holds with a number of relics blessed by their prayers."

758183cd-b7f9-4b71-8b80-4353bc6c8009.Text: "Venerable representatives of the Cognisance Fleet supplied us with gifts of the Omnissiah normally unobtainable by the laity."

3762ddd6-e706-417c-888b-4cbaf4ce0b2d.Text: "Merchants from the Fellowship of the Void gave us a share of their most precious trophies. Dubious though their origin may be, they are quite useful nonetheless."

2354678d-7fe4-4961-918c-7fc67598ab02.Text: "Agents of the Kasballica Mission supplied us with a shipment of goods that circumvented any official customs inspections due to their strictly illegal nature."

5945bd73-581f-4271-a705-587b865f69e2.Text: "Imperial Navy officers supplied us with spare ship parts, fuel, and everything one may require on a long and perilous expedition."

56cd8e13-0989-4fea-b4b3-6135c5bdf126.Text: "If Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} wills, I can provide you with an itemised report and sweet-voiced servants to read it out."

b2ab1db4-2449-4e01-a531-1f4c87523c87.Text: "Everything has a reason. The threads of my and my brothers' wyrds are tied together. I see Blackmane's will in our meeting finally approaching. Let us find them, Aett-Vater, for such is our destiny's wish."

b36da064-b463-4098-96ac-aeb99c47cfea.Text: "Let us continue our search for Calcazar."

999d70a0-00bf-496b-8d06-cd9e00b3447a.Text: "The dimensional gate is still inactive. Passage is currently impossible... unfortunately."

99f16500-d237-4b3f-926a-5e4aff38cc09.Text: "I have sent a request to the Enginseers already. I won't insult your ears with a 'maybe in an hour, maybe in ten Terran years' type of answer. They have no idea, but that doesn't stop every cog on board, from the senior officers and down to the last technomat, from begging for a shuttle and permission to poke around in that thing."

ce4e3e61-eb5b-482c-a76c-a28352a605d1.Text: "Greet the redoubtable Vladaym Tocara, the great Liege of Footfall!"

39045db6-2ee8-4e6a-9a57-c245ab4ada83.Text: "Are you joking? Is that really him?"

3c5c17b7-92ed-440d-a177-b1f503f0fc85.Text: "The very same. I watched with my own eyes as they dragged him aboard the vessel and handed him off to the Tech-Priests for servitorisation."

36efbc96-f7d3-4751-86dc-bcaf6a40c146.Text: "Looks like what they say is really true then — not even status can save a heretic from Imperial justice..."

565870bd-2b49-4b0c-a1ab-0e89a0a09e60.Text: "Are you hiding from me behind those thick bars, mon-keigh? Don't be afraid, open the cage — I promise to kill you last."

864e157e-3da3-42cb-80a8-4fa3944abb44.Text: "I can't take any more... Please, just kill me..."

f85401b8-d7b5-4048-859a-46575acf90ff.Text: "{mf|Lord|Lady} {name} von Valancius! My life belongs to you — command me as you will."

9bc83062-d844-4ebf-b449-b46ea5f13de2.Text: The Drukhari's eyes bore into you contemptuously through the bars. Victims bearing fresh wounds shiver in the corners behind him — "food" for the xenos.

569b199c-4241-46b7-9456-a3a3818cc666.Text: It is hard to tell if the gore on the bars belongs to the prisoner or to whoever languished here before him.

b0c19198-701d-4d81-a7d9-58349e0e9a2b.Text: The captive's skin is littered with fresh scars in the shape of heretical symbols. Judging by the amount of blood on the floor and the caged man's ragged breathing, a replacement will have to be found soon.

64e95a8b-4c9e-4497-8bf1-a17412e4766f.Text: The desecrated statue glares menacingly at the people cowering below, as if promising severe punishment to those who dare to disobey the {mf|master|mistress} of this vessel.

c58ece8d-0ec5-4adf-8b3f-3027e975fe28.Text: Behind the glass of the altar lies the banner of Saint Cognatius, a relic left behind by one of the Imperium's greatest and most mysterious missionaries, who converted more than one world to the righteous faith.

bdf4fd82-3a7e-4832-a3b2-9d903b92d9cd.Text: A quote from the sacred text catches your eye: "Ruthlessness is the kindness of the wise."

798e9ddf-48cf-4eae-8106-8467f37bea12.Text: The majestic statue glowers sternly over the bridge, unceasingly watching the servants of the God-Emperor toil for His glory.

d499e868-51d7-47a5-bd18-ea88c2e9a770.Text: The majestic statue towers over the bridge akin to a benevolent guardian watching over the crew.

acc6653b-52d0-45ca-9b58-5edff92ad3a2.Text: The imposing armillary sphere is designed to show the positions of celestial bodies within the current system.

347c1415-0c8a-49e2-828a-42b13f5cb5ed.Text: The Celestium Observatorum looms over the deck. While the spirit of this ancient mechanism has gone silent forever, the words intricately inscribed on its frame can still serve as a source of resolve: "A keen gaze sunders the darkness abloom with deceit and reduces all corruption to ash."

5eab686f-d846-4dc0-b0c6-cf173c41c631.Text: The promenade has a dedicated rest area. The velvet cushions on the bench seats look soft and comfortable.

a0417346-6588-4344-a5f9-53ca32291fc7.Text: This binocular observation mechanism allows the Lord Captain to calibrate macro-cannon fire directly from the bridge should {mf|he|she} see fit to take personal command when defending the ship from the many threats of the void.

b24c3d28-82ff-4baa-91df-462b499bf345.Text: The spirit of this sharp-sighted omniscope can reveal the dim light of distant stars to one who has the courage to plot a course to unexplored systems and illuminate the darkness therein.

ffe9b2d2-601f-4d15-acf1-fc22fa7f65a8.Text: Somewhere in the streets of the capital of Rykad Minoris, a deranged defender of Humanity is wandering about. His trail of blood could likely still be picked up and followed.

a9c1acea-00a1-4577-9f1f-27d2a84b4881.Text: The High Factotum may know what happened to the shard of the corrupted blade that was lodged in the victim's body.

6ae23337-d57b-4d85-834c-01397328d3a2.Text: The crew losses suffered during the cultist raid can be remedied on Rykad Minoris.

4bdb2289-a874-45cb-a6fd-5657358f3b36.Text: The voidship needs a new Navigator. One may be found on the Navis Nobilite station.

1d916e88-8a87-47bd-91f8-0a11349dc7ee.Text: The voidship requires a new Enginseer, who may be found somewhere in the system.

bab2aff4-a18e-4e05-b68d-390afd9a836c.Text: The unusual behaviour of the servitors should be discussed with High Factotum Janris Danrok, who is responsible for all assets on board the voidship.

1c98b070-6c65-4453-861e-86c31add9ddd.Text: A servo-skull at the Footfall docks delivered a strange invitation to the Lord Captain, inviting {mf|him|her} to a meeting about something called "Contract Logisticar Theta." The servo-skull's master, who goes by the name Opticon-22, is waiting at Dock Alpha-Rho.

2407f7d2-1e6b-468c-883a-b7565ee39ef2.Text: The culprit on Kiava Gamma was named as Dementz Haneumann. Pasqal wishes to confirm his identity and punish him.

8e43ef2f-cbd4-45f3-a791-f5855223fc23.Text: After contact with a mysterious entity, one of the senior officers has gone missing in System Speculo. Return to the voidship and scan the planet with the augurs to locate the lost officer. If it is not too late.

566eff18-f5c1-41c6-b8bb-7634d7af27c0.Text: To unravel the mystery of the strange ship, the Rogue Trader must go through the door to the Main Computing Cathedral.

812e7611-9eca-490c-b05b-644cb3eec0ce.Text: An Administratum clerk has asked the Rogue Trader to retrieve a container of implants from the furnace of Footfall's crematorium.

084f0093-0803-4f30-97a5-f2b8bfb7ab93.Text: Jae has hinted that she would be delighted to receive a gift from the Lord Captain that was worthy of the relationship the two of them share. For a Rogue Trader, procuring just about anything is a trifle — all it takes is commanding the High Factotum to do just that. As for choosing the gift, however, {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship} will have to rely on {mf|his|her} own acumen... or the counsel of members of {mf|his|her} retinue.

929ee7ef-e4f2-41ae-8cb9-9e91ad7e5e0d.Text: Jae has proposed that the Rogue Trader and she celebrate her acquisition of the Mercatum Tabula Officiale with her crew on Footfall. A social event in the company of Cold Traders could prove to be an exciting diversion.

1ec9db4d-52fa-4a3e-8db4-34884ab52b7d.Text: The pilgrim ark turned out to be a trap. The only route out is through the main airlock that the Rogue Trader used to access the ship. The Lord Captain must hurry before the inhumans catch up with {mf|him|her}!

0f7e653b-4956-4c02-b0e0-eff72181488e.Text: The recolligers from Reta Machsimova's crew require shipments of uniforms and provisions. As a show of gratitude for the Rogue Trader's assistance, they are willing to provide ship components extracted from the wreck of the dead voidship.

3f1c69fa-3ad9-4195-a642-17e59dc6d075.Text: The elders of the Children of Redemption from Santiel's Pride are pleading for help — a merciless beast is hunting survivors in the depths of the hive, stopping them from leaving the refuge.

cbdc70d1-795c-41bb-8d0d-56c77a2eeb6c.Text: Talk to Yrliet, the mysterious mutant on Janus who volunteered to help in the struggle against the rebels. She should be by the gazebo in the orangery on Governor Vyatt's estate.

bcb6ea28-e2bc-4ebf-bcc9-8b9245ef27a3.Text: The Rogue Trader's retinue has suddenly grown smaller. The reasons for the departure did not sound particularly convincing, so perhaps it would be best to investigate what is happening at the Shriekers' den in the Pit.

8f2823a6-5ed6-4454-ad83-a362c098e5f0.Text: The Haemonculus's profane creation known as the Chtonos has escaped from its maker. This biomechanical abomination now stalks the Mangled Sector, preying on unfortunate victims.

aac8b1a7-0da5-464b-a34f-2b93d6362aaf.Text: After coming to {mf|his|her} senses at the corpse dump, the Lord Captain discovered that {mf|his|her} boots were missing. Finding them is a matter of honour.

924438f3-837e-4fdf-9dab-2f07eb221a79.Text: Heinrix mentioned needing time to recuperate somewhere in a quiet corner of the Shriekers' lair. Maybe now is a good time to see how the Interrogator has been holding up after his torture.

9a04421f-7ae8-49d4-959a-ff6b025cf7de.Text: Jae Heydari thinks the Rogue Trader should throw a little celebration at the hideout to mark the reunion of their small squad.

e316bd2f-4bc6-419c-8a7d-3bcb621429b0.Text: The Rogue Trader has agreed to let Marazhai deliver the blow that will claim the life of Yremeryss, the Archon of the Reaving Tempest.

1f0cfe15-05ec-460e-b427-0a32194f87b1.Text: The Rogue Trader was tricked into fighting as a gladiator. The one who did this can likely be found in the Pit, the den of the Shriekers. That is where the Rogue Trader should go if {mf|he|she} wants to get even — and also to equip {mf|himself|herself} with decent gear from Malice's stores.

5ede4f93-9663-4157-be8a-9bb974a88a01.Text: The Haemonculus Tervantias wants to create a new monster. He needs special organs and body parts worthy of becoming a part of his blasphemous titan.

e618e7ca-3c2b-45f5-9d6a-be327fb0d8ae.Text: The Lord Captain's allies want to meet {mf|him|her} in the Pit to discuss what to do next.

2332f714-220e-4669-8274-721427d626d4.Text: One of the Emperor's Angels, a mighty Space Marine, is being held captive by the Haemonculus. Convincing him to join the squad would be a wise decision.

d0d51ce4-3617-4d7e-9421-2fad38faeb66.Text: An Aeldari spirit stone is a rare find, even in Commorragh. Some sort of mad scientist or a gang leader may consider buying such a commodity.

df25b2f0-c12d-417d-8fec-ce4179e97d12.Text: An arrogant lizard-like xenos named Malice is suffering because of the cold. He might help the Lord Captain if {mf|he|she} fixes the broken heat convector. Preposterous as it may sound, this may be a real chance to obtain some aid and survive.

635c3aba-d8d5-468d-b4bc-94408b30f125.Text: High Factotum Janris Danrok and Vox Master Vigdis Toliman are ready to share the latest news from the Expanse and the protectorate.

89a641ba-4695-4b44-bc38-7f1cb0404480.Text: Three friends spent cycles surviving on a lifeless world until villainous xenos drove them into a trap. Will the Rogue Trader become the light of their salvation?

0144c788-a4d7-4fe0-8f5e-c1bdf8c299e7.Text: She Who Thirsts wants Yrliet's soul in exchange for her blessing. The altar in the Rogue Trader's study is ready to accept the offering of the xenos's spirit stone.

af7677f2-b329-4c97-864a-5fb7386e72bc.Text: Help Jae recover the cargo from the secret warehouse, the entrance to which is located in the north-eastern part of the Shadow Quarters.

cc71dbff-8f7e-4cbe-98e5-11865b7ee4f6.Text: Jae has received a troubling Astropathic message. She is willing to share the details with the Rogue Trader in a private conversation.

845b925a-ee74-4709-afe0-dfa795a539c0.Text: Jae is convinced that the threatening Astropathic message was sent by her old rival in the Cold Trade, a privateer by the name of Falco. Only by going to Footfall in person can the Rogue Trader get to the bottom of this situation.

5f05c487-845e-4aeb-8334-6569e89908e2.Text: Jae is certain that Falco is holding her gang in the sewers. A location that is difficult to navigate and traverse — it is sure to be a trap... both for Jae and the captors. It is time to enter the tunnels via a secret passage in the Adeptus Amasecus and beat the opponent on their own turf.

7cc59891-8054-4e01-b0bf-dcd77833df38.Text: The antiquated ventilation system interconnects all parts of the sewers in this sector. To neutralise the captors, all the Rogue Trader needs to do is pump sleeping gas through the pipes at the right time.

ec008968-92f1-472b-8f97-f97ed3fb3ff7.Text: The sewer ventilation is cut off in several locations. The Rogue Trader needs to find the closed valves and direct the air flow to the room with the captives.

a51f9673-f985-4fc0-907e-06fb2b9c7893.Text: It is time to proceed with the final stage of the plan: pumping gas through the sewer ventilation using one of the abandoned cogitators.

2ee8532f-0042-4ac1-a4f5-897e3dfe4d79.Text: Pump the gas into the vents

3b0dd6d3-b512-48ea-9079-1b029082d18a.Text: Jae intends to make her brazen nemesis pay for all the misfortunes she has suffered because of him, from forcing her to leave Footfall to kidnapping her gang.

9158faad-9ddc-4d65-999c-a4bd62ad802b.Text: Jae needs some time alone to think about what happened. The Rogue Trader should seek her out later on the ship's bridge.

d5f5d355-f51f-4b32-94b9-7697bba1940f.Text: Talk to Jae on the ship

174aadb6-6034-42f3-afc1-faa10b0193e4.Text: Jae has come up with a plan for how to neutralise the captors. And the only way it can work is if she and the Rogue Trader act stealthily.

c19fd3d0-d5a6-4d30-b9f8-e86ddc8eee21.Text: Find a way to get the cogitator working again.

cb839c24-eba6-4ddd-92da-f7867ddcff83.Text: Jae's gang, including the surviving twin, Torra, are a hair's breadth away from death.

6e0c7a2b-50d1-4d99-850c-cc27a4f076bd.Text: The Rogue Trader has opened the valve AN-1.

41bf8a02-ccc9-401c-b154-935ec4a94268.Text: The Rogue Trader has opened the valve OD-2.

0a9c11aa-b629-4b34-9a60-5fb87e176b7a.Text: The Rogue Trader has opened the valve PO-3.

1fceb386-dee9-4252-918a-410f41ba1dd5.Text: The Rogue Trader has opened the valve ZT-4.

fe683128-7127-4b16-b96b-9c11c6cb872f.Text: The Rogue Trader has opened the valve UD-5.

6cfddb0e-991f-49d9-8164-a265894d5c5b.Text: Jae eliminated an old competitor and took a break from chasing grand opportunities. She has bought herself some peace and quiet, but was the price fair? Hardly. But when has life ever been fair to her?

5c81bb6b-acac-4e06-9dfa-01bf77ceca26.Text: Jae has received an alarming Astropathic message all the way from Footfall. Neither its sender nor its contents bode well for her.

5bbea1e3-442d-4551-b565-67ae760f7156.Text: Unfortunately, while the Rogue Trader was patiently waiting for {mf|his|her} turn in the queue, one of the seals on the document expired. The whole certification process must be repeated from scratch to obtain a valid Mercatum Tabula Officiale.

da53b3eb-d4b0-4f43-8bff-a6e5cfd9717c.Text: Bring the new document to the certification officer

6bc513c1-e07d-453f-ad76-cc0f603d4d84.Text: The palace of the Adeptus Administratum is located in one of the spires of Dargonus, the capital world of the von Valancius protectorate. The Master of Seals, the keeper of ancient laws of the Imperium, can tell the Rogue Trader everything about the procedure for obtaining a Mercatum Tabula Officiale.

34ac803c-40e8-4094-ab74-75fbfbe6d532.Text: Talk to the Master of Seals

7dde7279-d0cc-4175-aa84-7855482c3242.Text: The Master of Seals recommended requesting one of the seals in the Rogue Trader's palace. Clementia Werserian must be in charge of the Administratum servitor.

7908fb57-bbcb-4935-9a78-3d09e0809b18.Text: Janus is the second most important administrative centre of the von Valancius protectorate. One of the seals must be kept by one of the officials there.

f9efd6ea-e861-4ddc-b7a4-d3e16eb8e94e.Text: Getting the required seals turned out to be quite a task due to the distance and lack of coordination between different Adeptus Administratum branches. Now the Rogue Trader just needs to return to Dargonus and certify the document with the Master of Seals.

bda06d63-666e-4008-ba4b-18e2a7643bec.Text: Return to the palace of the Adeptus Administratum

e0d6a5f1-6fe1-4a4e-9f83-605c037b4a69.Text: The Administratum clerk refuses to accept the document without the last seal certifying the document and two previous seals. As dictated by the laws of the Imperium, the Rogue Trader will have to stand in the queue with hundreds of other petitioners to obtain it.

6a894203-f6d7-4f4d-a03f-21cb53df43d6.Text: The document has been finally certified. One last signature and Jae Heydari will receive the title of official trade representative of the Imperium.

19942389-cbe1-4dee-acee-baf359bc2ea6.Text: Return to the Master of Seals with Jae

bf5e99b1-1a44-49a2-b1ea-ddc3414ad702.Text: Jae requests an audience with the Rogue Trader to celebrate their success.

69c1cc3f-2d1e-40a1-9045-3ce50737f2d8.Text: The Rogue Trader needs to obtain a blank form from the Master of Seals.

d4e5c675-c098-46de-884a-2ca4304c0b52.Text: The Rogue Trader can certify the new document with a previously acquired seal.

e54a7f94-1bb1-4c0a-b34b-aa73544ae61f.Text: One of the seals is kept on the agri-world of Janus. A visit to the court secretary is in order.

8cf96728-e7e2-42eb-8670-d21a9910bd51.Text: The seals must be certified by the Master of Seals in the Administratum Palace on Dargonus.

56c3796a-e7f0-4e60-b224-778556c3930d.Text: Jae thinks that the lost seal may be in the possession of a pirate, fence, or collector of stolen goods.

e824ce99-df69-4b6e-b202-9d4af1726019.Text: The seal can probably be found on one of the House Winterscale worlds in the Forgotten Twins, Langrenn's Belt, or Nameless Star systems.

c68da40a-0ec9-4d9d-b32f-151b0a5e0d12.Text: If the Rogue Trader does not want to wait in queue with the other petitioners, {mf|he|she} can return after the Magnae Accessio ceremony and certify the document without the long wait.

f0d1c1d5-81e0-4213-9642-4ea108cc7c64.Text: One more high-ranking member has joined the Rogue Trader's retinue. A Mercatum Tabula Officiale may not possess the same power as a Warrant of Trade, but now Jae has the force of Imperial law on her side.

eaae0876-8bc1-41ab-94cd-c657309ffe09.Text: The certificate of an official trade representative of the Imperium can open many doors for Jae Heydari. But without friends in high places, Jae can forget about her dreams of power and wealth.

2bc57928-9619-471a-81f9-989c968527fe.Text: Find the disgraced stranger in the Adeptus Amasecus bar in Footfall's Shadow Quarters.

e7d4b052-621c-4167-b482-bad09d04e598.Text: Argenta asked the Rogue Trader to talk with her on the ship as soon as the opportunity arises. Better not to put it off for too long.

d8ac1f57-c17c-4140-a81d-6677dc27bf94.Text: The Lady Navigator is at odds with the crew, which is causing serious problems on the ship. The Vox Master has asked the Rogue Trader to speak to Cassia to remedy the situation.

eed1f298-66d4-4428-bd9c-517747c06de0.Text: The Cold Trader who recently joined the Rogue Trader's retinue is ready to conduct business big and small. The Lord Captain can listen to Jae's intriguing business propositions on the captain's bridge.

363d4538-c9df-4d9d-9a8b-9494fbdadd64.Text: Marazhai desires to meet with a group of Kabalites of the Reaving Tempest who are likely to be banished from Commorragh. The former Dracon insists on personally dealing with those he used to command.

5732d910-51f4-4cd6-a878-7e9cbcd29e3d.Text: Marazhai wants to pick up certain prized possessions from the Spire of the Reaving Tempest.

e78f2889-d848-4982-af6d-7f2d538a5ba1.Text: The Vox Master has asked the Rogue Trader to speak to the Lady Navigator about her treatment of crew members

4ba72d05-c260-44a3-9d6c-b9b3be6f9b6d.Text: The Interrogator has asked the Rogue Trader to set aside some time for a private conversation.

087d40b6-2d1f-47cc-9f8e-88c7a226009c.Text: Talk to Heinrix about the Cult of the Final Dawn

797de4d4-4260-4c67-a843-2e5c6cf6e92a.Text: To fulfil his mission, Heinrix must make his way to the industrial world Kiava Gamma and make planetfall as part of the Rogue Trader's retinue.

76a59008-035b-44db-920d-1f7e6f81ced1.Text: Strange activity has been detected on an industrial world, activity that matches intelligence received by the Inquisition's Interrogator. It is vital to explore the location and find someone there who can provide more information — whether willingly or under duress.

2efb5284-a37b-4260-bf9b-cb143d03bbba.Text: Find out more about the cult's activities on Kiava Gamma

d3cae5a2-23d7-467d-8c27-a652b67494cf.Text: The acquired data is enough to suggest a theory about the crucial role of the cogitator in the cult's plans. It would be wise to find the machine immediately and conduct a threat analysis. According to the Lexmechanic, the entrance to the chambers containing the cogitator is somewhere in the manufactorum.

c7541d1f-b1aa-4cef-9906-dd8d45625200.Text: Find the cogitator mentioned by the Lexmechanic

647bee4f-f1a6-4d27-8833-1b46251b509a.Text: The cogitator created under the guidance of the traitorous Fabricator-Censor has been discovered in the depths of the manufactorum. The heretical machine needs to be stopped, but the results of its calculations could benefit the Inquisition...

0960b4ac-3d80-4774-89d9-8862cdf4db7a.Text: The Fabricator-Censor's cogitator has been destroyed — the daemon that fueled the machine with its hate has broken free. The warp spawn must be destroyed.

418444ca-980e-4309-9be6-3b6dc87d52d4.Text: The Interrogator wishes to debrief after the mission and has requested an audience with the Lord Captain.

b9cf71f8-f28e-4833-b2cf-539829cf1dcb.Text: Talk to Heinrix on the ship's bridge

bdb82745-9af4-4970-8090-44d66c8dc28e.Text: The interrogated Lexmechanic provided the code to the secret chamber hidden in the bowels of the manufactorum. The cogitator must be there.

13694783-e5c1-4d29-adcf-8aedd9652d2d.Text: The secret of the Cult of the Final Dawn, hidden deep within Kiava Gamma, was revealed. The cursed machine, which calculated the future using the blood of innocents, was destroyed, and the daemon fueling the machine with its malice was killed.

e3ca6163-860f-4e19-b9f3-c088a8dbb738.Text: Heinrix possesses information about some of the plans of the Cult of the Final Dawn, plans connected to the industrial world Kiava Gamma. The future struggle against the cult will depend on the results of his search, which is the reason for his joining the Rogue Trader's retinue.

723763f7-3f95-4547-af58-29f0191d93b6.Text: Heinrix wishes to discuss a certain sensitive matter as soon as possible.

0076a936-5770-4aec-a5e1-f0f636710bb2.Text: Talk to Heinrix about the urgent matter

43d70c60-3296-41e5-a0ac-16fc0c129886.Text: Phton IV is located in one of the fringe systems of the Koronus Expanse.

5ff8fea3-28fa-4bd0-8ae4-443cf9d1792d.Text: Reach the system mentioned in Emelina's message

28d10f2f-3fdd-49d3-86a6-7dc9b921ad94.Text: Preliminary assessment of the situation in the system is bleak. It is imperative that contact be established with the survivors on the planet's surface immediately.

75c9dff4-8a77-4e85-ae71-9681f8952cf7.Text: The surprise attack perpetrated by the enemies of Humanity has already claimed a number of lives — the attack must be repelled and the dark xenos exterminated.

bde437ce-bff9-42b5-b250-2806ee120627.Text: Emelina Lichtenhart is somewhere in the archaeological mine — that is where the survivors have told the Rogue Trader to go.

fbdb6173-6f9c-4567-9bc5-13cefd1280e9.Text: Whether because of negligence or system failure, a mass xenos incursion now threatens the last human shelter on Phton IV. The enemies of Humanity must be destroyed!

51c00777-782e-4ea5-9ec0-e0ecfaf7cfbc.Text: Emelina Lichtenhart has tainted herself by dabbling in powers stemming from the Archenemy. Interrogator Heinrix van Calox is ready to announce his verdict.

dbc63382-1afb-4b19-a8b8-f37ecd380064.Text: The Interrogator will be ready to discuss the incident on the bridge of the von Valancius flagship.

9617f812-8ab5-40a6-b5a4-2dac5b482d62.Text: Talk to Heinrix on the ship's bridge

94861cc4-1232-4a1f-ae91-c74c73caa6ee.Text: All details of the events that took place on Phton IV were classified as decreed by the Ordo Xenos of the Holy Inquisition.

36362b6c-97e6-4489-a0a6-ed4afb5eac4a.Text: A certain message received by the Astropathic Choir of the von Valancius flagship has disconcerted Heinrix. Whatever caused this sudden unease, the Interrogator has requested the Rogue Trader's assistance and stressed that the matter demands {mf|his|her} immediate attention.

e9946449-8392-4833-8111-61f11adeded1.Text: A group of enforcers have managed to contain the xenos in a single compartment. The von Valancius subjects must be questioned in order to glean the details of what happened on the deck.

817f7fda-8d70-4fe5-ba98-148720e80c69.Text: Meet with the survivors on the officers' deck

3d7fc111-4c6a-428d-807a-9e773448c1ce.Text: The enforcers have unsealed way to the compartment containing the xenos in question. The Lord Captain must now explore the corridors in search of the threat.

b166c9e8-67f1-431f-853d-f55a305f4fe4.Text: The runaway xenos has been found. His present state poses extreme danger to anyone around him. The Lord Captain's intervention is required.

abfe702b-6bda-459a-8521-7c8e962c49ec.Text: Warp entities are confirmed to be manifesting in the compartment. They must be eliminated at once.

5403af9f-b5b9-4d75-8d00-b99b00d42548.Text: The immediate threat to the crew has been neutralised. A decision has to be made regarding the fate of the Lord Captain's unstable companion.

b41a748f-aa36-434a-b904-dc71cba6c9a9.Text: Once the tensions have eased and the aftermath of the carnage has been alleviated, the Lord Captain should enquire about the xenos's state of mind.

2395ea0e-349c-44f4-b4c6-a0e8db522e6e.Text: Talk to Marazhai on the ship's bridge

47234c87-a5dc-41e0-8673-b45fdd43d0cb.Text: The situation on the officers' deck was resolved. The victims of the xenos's mad rampage were interred in the void upon the ship's translation back to realspace.

15c69a26-9d4b-48ad-ac24-e0c99ac2fd27.Text: The very first warp jump with a Drukhari on board has resulted in tragedy. Numerous disembowelled victims left on the officers' deck mark the path walked by Marazhai, who seems to have completely lost his mind. The source of this threat needs to be located and neutralised.

edbbfc1d-011a-4991-a11a-675ba8f605bd.Text: The Drukhari envoys wish to see the former Dracon of the Reaving Tempest. The meeting will take place aboard the von Valancius flagship.

c28da912-8905-4b88-b50d-8e63f29241d5.Text: The remnants of the Reaving Tempest have found temporary refuge on one of the planets this side of the dimensional gate. The Rogue Trader is expected to travel to the designated system and find the world indicated by the xenos.

0b75e7c5-5e3f-4fb8-93b7-186e72dd6065.Text: The augurs have detected a congregation of xenos in a certain area on the world's surface. The shuttles are prepared to launch.

54da747e-dad0-47e3-8a82-0725fc816b92.Text: The Rogue Trader needs to accompany Marazhai to the appointed meeting spot... and, possibly, straight into a trap.

a724f451-3713-43c7-bceb-04ae40285023.Text: Nazrakhei has been allowed to live for too long — it is time for him and his lackeys to pay his many dues.

3d1daab8-785b-45f9-a1f3-834b9da7e9a5.Text: Destroy the Archon of the Black Heart

0c5270e9-c55f-4b8c-80ed-78a45833e66b.Text: Marazhai wants to have a word with the Rogue Trader on the bridge of the von Valancius flagship and discuss the recent events.

a3837c9c-52ab-4838-961c-5bdb57dd3388.Text: The Archon who double-crossed Marazhai got just what he deserved. The circle of incessant Drukhari betrayals is finally complete — and the victory was claimed by he who had previously remained a mere pawn in this murderous game.

8148b2a5-8d17-424c-ad1c-cf37d24e1fed.Text: Marazhai Aezyrraesh has not been forgotten by his underlings — or his enemies. The xenos who left Commorragh alive has drawn the attention of the remnants of the Kabal of the Reaving Tempest — for better or for worse.

59452582-a46e-4754-be84-a61d6a8434ab.Text: The Navis Nobilite delegation is looking forward to meeting the Rogue Trader and Lady Navigator Cassia on the capital world. The chancellor, Clementia Werserian, must be notified about the meeting.

a561239f-a395-4d58-9d44-6c48fcec6785.Text: Arrange a reception for the Navis Nobilite on Dargonus

4590be03-b972-45a2-8983-0d2f2eda6ee3.Text: Orders have been issued and the Rogue Trader's servants are finishing preparations for the reception. The Navis Nobilite delegation has arrived at the palace, awaiting the appearance of the Rogue Trader and the Lady Navigator.

d9259044-8e36-4fa3-a673-d28e21808a19.Text: The meeting with the regent turned out to be a trap — the Navigators attempted to kill Cassia, and they almost succeeded. The mortal threat to the Lord Captain and Cassia must be eliminated immediately.

bac0c268-2518-46c5-b1b7-0ae63ecfb584.Text: The instigator of the attack is dead, however, he was still a representative of House Orsellio, like the rest of the Navigators. It is time to discuss future relations between the von Valancius protectorate and the Navis Nobilite Houses with Regent Aaronto.

3cab5424-b313-4f2c-8404-bb2bc3a586e3.Text: Question Regent Aaronto about the assassination attempt

e90def8e-22e7-4e5a-bef2-b561cba59e6b.Text: Cassia has asked the Lord Captain to discuss the events of the ceremony with her.

44faa5f8-8f32-4da2-a582-0f46fcbd5245.Text: While the Rogue Trader's servants are dealing with the fallout from the attack, the Navis Nobilite wait with trepidation to hear their fate in the throne room.

f74972c8-714a-4a43-a0da-4d59b51cda2b.Text: Do not allow the instigator of the assassination attempt to leave the palace grounds

5abf43b0-99d1-4e83-a338-ab1635995537.Text: The grand reception in the Rogue Trader's court ended in a bloodbath. Despite Cassia Orsellio's best efforts, the future of her house is unclear.

afaffacc-4986-4335-a230-6623e381519d.Text: Representatives of the Navigator House Orsellio have requested a personal meeting with Cassia and the Rogue Trader. The meeting is intended to settle unrest within the House, to discover the fate of Eurac V, and to show the Navigators that the daughter of their House is doing well.

da037877-7c19-4e0b-b177-3fe812625707.Text: Cassia intends to recreate Tisiphone Orsellio's rituals from her visions in order to find the way to the physical Palace of the Atlas.

a544e414-90dc-48b3-9c5f-a9934e056eb0.Text: The ritual recreated an ancient warp route which brought the Rogue Trader and the Lady Navigator to a world hidden in the eye of a warp storm. What secret does the planet's twisted heart contain?

33e73e39-d103-4d66-9777-bce501e31d82.Text: The warp-disfigured world offered more questions than answers to the Rogue Trader and the Lady Navigator. A Troupe of Harlequins was lying in wait in these ancient Aeldari ruins. What is the connection between these xenos and House Orsellio?

0b1e6dfd-cdea-4696-939f-ece40adefede.Text: Learn the truth about the Atlas's creation

792a027c-7566-46ac-b040-2f30d4d326ab.Text: The Lady Navigator wishes to discuss all that transpired on the ancient Aeldari world once she has had time to collect her thoughts. The Lord Captain can find her on the ship's bridge.

42899bcd-cc3a-4b5f-b9da-bc4c7e07d1d3.Text: Talk to Cassia on the ship

4018296e-c23e-4c4c-b360-2df0d61aa98c.Text: The Rogue Trader has decided the fate of House Orsellio. For tampering with a xeno-artefact and betraying the Imperium, the heretics paid with their lives. Now it is time for the Rogue Trader's retinue to return to the ship and make their way back to the Koronus Expanse through the raging warp storm.

be5d5c8d-3ea2-451c-905f-21aefafb88db.Text: The secret of the Starway Atlas has been laid bare, and House Orsellio has paid a high price for their years of supremacy. So has the Lady Navigator, for her family's mistakes.

a2fd0a44-5425-4f2a-ae19-91de5b7869d2.Text: The Lady Navigator is plagued by visions about her House's past, the Starway Atlas's creation, and the vague and elusive mystery that hides the truth about the nature of House Orsellio's power. Cassia has asked the Rogue Trader to follow her visions so that she may expose the past and understand her true purpose in this world.

248c34be-8cea-4711-b025-a90e7b618b44.Text: The technomats sent by Ravor have failed to resolve the issue. The Rogue Trader will have to inspect the lever {mf|himself|herself}.

b62cee89-8182-4aa4-9771-9cf2fc5839ab.Text: One of the ship's fuel levers is in a poor state. Inspect it and diagnose the problem.

94c07c16-0aaf-48ce-931c-49740cf15762.Text: Inspect the fuel lever on the ship's bridge

7b87d564-7978-4b43-965a-ccdc598c5740.Text: The Forgotten Twins System is of particular interest to the Rogue Trader.

e0f50a4b-98a6-41e4-8785-cc192fd2000c.Text: Visit the Forgotten Twins star system.

a24c884a-89d1-4bbc-8497-c5f8c2b29627.Text: Strange tasks have stopped appearing in the Lord Captain's log.

e43ac617-dc3b-4a14-83e3-f7f30fba2ef5.Text: Certain matters demand the Rogue Trader's personal attention.

57010476-fcc0-4daf-b05b-8e1aaba89539.Text: Perhaps the data on the Rogue Trader's personal cogitator could explain the strange entries in the Lord Captain's log.

33d5286f-cdd8-4b3f-a2f6-7f9ccf239943.Text: Check the Lord Captain's cogitator on the bridge

35605195-e401-4b7b-8f63-c371c875d4cf.Text: The ship's vox-system is in need of thorough calibration. Meet with the Vox Master on the bridge to discuss the matter.

afc7d667-1101-45ee-bad9-8f62e209d2a1.Text: The senior officers would be the first logical source of information about the ship's past.

0a04592a-ce48-4b14-b80f-b18eff3fd576.Text: The dynasty's Seneschal is the Rogue Trader's most trusted advisor. He is a figure worth questioning when it comes to the secrets of the past.

a45d2bce-3fd1-4c51-a6d7-c5e435f6dad6.Text: The diviner Idira was part of the former Rogue Trader's retinue. Perhaps she can help unveil the truth?

6a5957c8-ed5b-46dd-9dc9-f8a88a5ece35.Text: The caches on Dargonus and Kiava Gamma contained fragmentary information about Theodora's clandestine activities. Reminding Nomos about this data that once allowed its consciousness to awaken may yield some results.

120d7908-be51-4484-80f3-a8315e868c4a.Text: Talk to Nomos about Theodora's caches

1bdca6df-1e9f-4c11-b8f7-11ebd277e857.Text: Perhaps the answer to the mystery of Nomos's origins will present itself in time.

7182a1ab-dcd3-492e-9886-7c324695fa79.Text: It is time to discuss the findings and discoveries with the very entity that asked the Rogue Trader for help in the first place.

0276f52f-6e5f-4c9f-ba34-a460c208693c.Text: The von Valancius flagship and its Master Helmsman Ravor are inseparable. The right questions may jog his memory.

76ab77f3-a090-4f81-9e91-f70d2ad6b6af.Text: The Vox Master may be able to tell the Rogue Trader something of substance.

b4c8d581-f151-4eae-8fea-d004d622f9ac.Text: The mystery of Nomos's birth has been laid bare... and yet too much remains shrouded in mist.

8b457110-b1f4-4a70-b004-93eb14aabfe3.Text: Nomos does not remember how it came to be. Perhaps the past of the von Valancius dynasty holds the key to understanding the mystery of how this strange entity appeared in the bowels of the Rogue Trader's voidship.

c2c0cc33-f839-4c83-bda5-b8d018e39f97.Text: Explore the locked-down chamber to assess the potential threat to the ship and crew.

7ef851b0-26d8-4473-a477-280190a45635.Text: Something wearing the guise of the Rogue Trader remains on board the ship. Further observation and eventual elimination of the unidentified phenomenon is the recommended course of action.

01828aa7-8294-4dfe-8cde-5939c5e99f48.Text: An aggressive creation from the Immaterium has been discovered on board. Destroy the creature before the ship and crew suffer even more harm.

3037389d-203a-4563-a950-bb0d481f5b59.Text: Kill the monster from the warp

d2243fcc-2266-4a5f-9ab1-f39687516f8b.Text: The direct threat has been eliminated, but the threat of a repeat occurrence remains as long as the psyker cannot control her abilities.

3ea1cab6-3f4a-44f8-992b-6cb73ac4231b.Text: During the examination of the compartment, Idira Tlass was discovered and destroyed as the presumed cause of the dangerous warp activity. The situation has stabilised, but the Lord Captain's retinue has lost a psyker.

d88b2c6e-1ee2-45bc-aa5b-d96e33ddd1d6.Text: During the investigation of the situation, Idira Tlass, the alleged cause of the warp activity, was eliminated. The situation has stabilised, but the Lord Captain's retinue has lost a psyker.

35dc893b-4e97-4aa7-8fad-ac55c5cb77f5.Text: The source of the inexplicable and perilous phenomena on the lower deck was Idira Tlass, who had lost control over her abilities. The situation was addressed before it could deteriorate further, and disposing of the aftermath was entrusted to the bay's inhabitants.

3f9228c8-a246-4384-9f9c-e49ab3652c48.Text: A message has come to the bridge reporting that the departed Rogue Trader has appeared on the ship. The name Idira Tlass was mentioned, an unsanctioned psyker. The Lord Captain must act to find out what is happening and to neutralise the potential threat.

5aacc074-ca7d-426b-a367-8e5a994dfe4a.Text: Idira wants to talk about her visions. She says her future depends on it.

78f0e538-b70e-4966-816e-21c4d75f93d8.Text: Idira has earnestly requested that the Rogue Trader explore the Koronus Expanse in search of an unknown world that she keeps seeing in her visions. Idira claims that her senses will tell her when the goal is near.

695d41fb-6578-4822-a208-fc160b63ef2d.Text: Find the world from Idira's visions

b5444374-6815-4201-a2eb-2cbe8c22d0b8.Text: Idira is convinced that the place from her visions is located somewhere on the surface of Quetza Temer. She entreats the Rogue Trader to help her find it.

ce4ee37a-d37e-46db-a593-045acb584511.Text: Idira's foresight tells her that the Lord Captain has discovered the location of the door from her visions. She begs the Rogue Trader to take her to this mysterious door.

b590bd40-ad93-4099-a389-bab370b45423.Text: The door was being concealed by a powerful psyker. All that remains now is to go through and find out what lies on the other side.

a7a1f7f1-b1bf-4e11-98ca-979a0fd78eef.Text: The Farseer is under the Haemonculus's control. He must be dealt with.

ef476dbe-ce29-4b8e-8eb1-ac7fd52a5eae.Text: Idira now holds in her hands a powerful device known as a psy-stifler. She has turned to the Rogue Trader for guidance on what she should do with this ominous xenocreation.

f49e1faf-715b-4244-8525-906308f69399.Text: Idira wishes to discuss what the future holds for her. The Rogue Trader can find her aboard the ship.

a08f8560-083c-4043-bb11-76907a7c29ed.Text: Talk to Idira on the ship

72135e65-36e8-47d7-bd0a-63c8effec399.Text: Idira Tlass, the unsanctioned psyker, was deemed too great a danger to the voidship's crew in her current state. Despite Idira's protests, the Lord Captain personally put the psy-stifler on her. The threat of a warp breach has been neutralised. As for the xeno-artefact's influence on its host's personality, the exact effects are yet to be fully observed and studied.

36995396-8985-4543-9e51-aec1e7a6728f.Text: Idira Tlass decided not to put on the psy-stifler and accept her fate. There remains a significant likelihood of a warp breach occurring in the foreseeable future. Any changes in Idira's state as an unsanctioned psyker will have to be closely monitored.

ca037851-c60a-4d4a-a526-c7073c8e1548.Text: The price of tapping into the xeno-artefact's powers was deemed too high. The Lord Captain personally destroyed the psy-stifler, thus breaking Idira Tlass's will and forcing her to accept her inevitable demise. There remains a significant likelihood of a warp breach occurring sometime in the future. Any changes in Idira's state as an unsanctioned psyker will have to be closely monitored.

d5fcd5e5-f8ca-4115-bb26-62fc33d9f6d9.Text: Idira Tlass put on the psy-stifler of her own free will. The threat of a warp breach has been neutralised. As for the xeno-artefact's influence on its host's personality, the exact effects are yet to be fully observed and studied.

55f1a657-e629-44d3-9ee0-599408d3fd99.Text: Idira Tlass, the unsanctioned psyker, was deemed too dangerous to be allowed to live. The Lord Captain carried out her sentence {mf|himself|herself}.

70abb629-8b65-48ce-b922-412b82824118.Text: The Lord Captain decided that following a psyker's visions was a foolhardy endeavour. Idira Tlass's request was refused.

a091eca1-276a-4fa4-913b-fdef5e2f8db4.Text: The Lord Captain has decided to explore the landing site first and assured Idira that {mf|he|she} will take her with {mf|him|her} when the time is right.

1b868ec7-0816-4051-b87c-06384e32957e.Text: The mystery of the door has been revealed, as has the true meaning of Idira Tlass's cryptic prophecies.

7a6091af-21f6-4956-8a6f-e3ec51b4c971.Text: Idira Tlass has approached the Lord Captain for help. She is plagued by mysterious visions that she believes could change her fate.

d9d98ddb-cfed-4aca-ab4d-dfca71ed34ae.Text: A junior officer subverts standard protocol to secure an audience with the Lord Captain — there is a problem on board affecting both the lower decks and the highest-ranked officer, Seneschal Werserian. The situation is unusual and requires the intervention of the Rogue Trader.

ad234685-0221-471a-82b5-f816742031a1.Text: Deal with the situation regarding Depot 4

8ec4235f-e4bc-47c8-8f46-5698eccf8c81.Text: The Lord Captain must assess the actions of Seneschal Abelard Werserian. This requires the Rogue Trader to survey the situation in Depot 4.

a4954f6d-ac83-485c-9b92-34bd4a0e5670.Text: Go to the site of the conflict with the Seneschal

a7b09726-ecb5-431e-a513-2bce70f2e3db.Text: The three clans that instigated the unrest in Depot 4 are awaiting a response to their demands. The assault unit dispatched by the Seneschal is also awaiting orders.

6197c323-1827-44c1-9d1a-2637d653e419.Text: The Seneschal wishes to speak to the Lord Captain in private about the results of the visit to the lower deck.

e07eb5c3-fdb2-47ce-88a8-9c1d8e3f592d.Text: Talk to the Seneschal in calmer surroundings

b916cf2c-473c-42eb-a3a1-db11b3b76c08.Text: The situation in Depot 4 has stabilised and Seneschal Werserian has received instructions regarding his future service.

8f0df0af-3e4a-49da-a34f-6c3b1976acc5.Text: The Lord Captain has received a plea to assess the actions of Seneschal Werserian. As a result of Werserian's decisions regarding a situation in one of the sectors on the lower decks, the problem now threatens to engulf the whole ship.

2c697da3-dea0-49a8-9b06-62ab2c965deb.Text: The Rogue Trader must travel to Dargonus in order to assess the situation on the capital world.

d2148d99-26b0-4696-bfba-5c93df86cba9.Text: The evidence against House Werserian seems dubious, and Abelard refuses to believe that his family had anything to do with the conspiracy against the Rogue Trader. Perhaps the Lord Captain could establish some sort of alibi for {mf|his|her} Seneschal's noble house.

6f82e4dc-cdc8-4bdd-aa85-bd346fde5f81.Text: An unknown party both framed House Werserian for crimes most grave and is culpable for causing supply disruptions, instigating riots, and spreading false rumours. The Rogue Trader must find the one who stands to gain from all this.

c22704ec-934f-40a5-95ea-1a5f1cd34769.Text: Even though the broken member of House Gaprak did have a hand in the attempt on the Rogue Trader's life, Abelard is convinced that someone else is behind the entire plot.

0ce574ac-da7a-4806-9428-50792d6c5493.Text: The Rogue Trader must say {mf|his|her} piece and deliver the final judgement. Governor Drivestem must be notified when it is time to pronounce {mf|his|her} verdict on the accused.

50c39529-06eb-42c9-99ef-d94e286ebeee.Text: Abelard has asked the Rogue Trader to find some time to discuss the events on Dargonus.

5a648710-3645-405f-a07f-89093f1507bc.Text: Talk to Abelard on the ship's bridge

7fd8e16d-3360-473b-a67f-719987a6f303.Text: The Rogue Trader's judgement has been served. Dargonus can now return to its everyday life that requires no involvement from the planet's exalted sovereign.

85fec159-b44b-4644-9c8b-f949dc442610.Text: House Werserian stands accused of treason. On behalf of his family, Abelard has asked the Rogue Trader to intervene in this matter in hopes that the truth may be revealed — whatever it turns out to be.

f53ccf07-911d-4f2d-baf1-5667e71e471b.Text: Argenta has something to discuss with the head of the Drusian mission and is counting on the Lord Captain's support.

1c6a81ec-3711-42f7-80f5-5432a1cbcce8.Text: According to Reverend Hieronymus, suspicious individuals are conducting rituals in the Shadow Quarters — in a place marked with a blue and gold sun. If they are heretics, they must be eradicated. The presence of Sister Argenta is highly advisable.

65b51ac0-c740-4f30-9b77-9728f7eceb4d.Text: Search Footfall's Shadow Quarters for the heretics' den

3ac573ee-9b23-41fc-ae58-b1ee42fcea2b.Text: Sister Argenta has asked the Rogue Trader to discuss recent events in private on the ship.

d7c42071-d7d8-4b28-ad84-31bf547f7ff6.Text: The Sister of Battle has requested permission to pray before the great relic that is the Warrant of Trade.

344e360a-efaf-404d-94ff-c068c8b5f3f6.Text: Argenta has shared critical secret information with the Lord Captain. Now a way must be found to the unknown planet.

88200bb3-5c40-44f9-90b0-31302f94d39c.Text: Sister Argenta has asked for the Lord Captain's help with a personal matter.

4821006d-1c24-45a7-b252-26e2bc2f65a0.Text: Argenta's daring foray during the assault on Eufrates II was fruitful — a captured heretic mentioned the name Salis Prime during interrogation. The information extracted from the cultist is sure to help Argenta find the way back to the planet. Argenta will inform the Lord Captain when that happens.

8b803bca-e2b1-4590-9b8d-a09e5f48dfcd.Text: Wait for Argenta to approach with news

055672a5-e614-4545-ba81-aa8f117c1fc6.Text: The mysterious planet and the sacred ship await.

50cc6f2a-e6be-449b-ab8f-6d283700023c.Text: The path to the sacred ship is blocked by a cultist sorcerer by the name of Brother Afterlight. He must be destroyed.

0e0e195e-02d6-4915-b500-dd04c3ee54cc.Text: Sister Argenta is gone, and there is no way to follow her. All the Lord Captain can do is wait for her to return.

08122f14-47df-4206-bc04-2357dbbfebe7.Text: Return to the ship and await word from Argenta

7c34c8c4-12b7-473e-a26d-15a0edfdc919.Text: Argenta has completed her pilgrimage and found her path.

2959833e-bcf0-4d3e-8223-e9c039238f9d.Text: At long last, Argenta and the Lord Captain have uncovered a clue to the possible location of the world of Salis Prime, and with it, that of the saint's ancient ship to which Argenta wishes to make a pilgrimage. However, the planet also serves as a hideout for the heretics who have already come close to taking her life once before...

b2cb1f43-22f1-4c04-8059-eae3a8e6e9d0.Text: Examine the data on the command centre cogitators

69e66726-0634-42d2-aae8-44570a18eb83.Text: Magos Haneumann has lost his escort and asked the Lord Captain to escort him to the governor. Establishing an alliance with a high-ranking Adeptus Mechanicus member may expedite the search for the new Enginseer for the voidship.

91bcfd7f-e969-4c0c-8b53-26468638d689.Text: According to Pasqal Haneumann's hypothesis, Archmagos Amarnat, currently using the pseudonym "Abel Haneumann," is at the Hallowed Electrodynamic Cenobium.

2a1b1694-4e49-4283-a9c8-f5a052a3bb7c.Text: Find Archmagos Amarnat in the monastery of the Adeptus Mechanicus

779f960d-1d60-4c4b-9606-9bf3c1a71c18.Text: Pasqal Haneumann did not manage to meet his mentor. But in his pursuit, he found a brother in faith bearing a strange name, who is somehow linked to the Archmagos Amarnat.

c24bdac2-9eff-4480-8888-8a8609b0d49b.Text: Tech-Priest Pasqal Haneumann has arrived on Rykad Minoris at the request of his mentor, Archmagos Amarnat. The planetary rebellion has interfered with their meeting, but Magos Haneumann is adamant about finding his teacher.

36d81a83-7eb0-4f68-9458-40252dda3fd6.Text: Find clues that could explain why the lift is blocked

ba4ba7e1-36ea-4a2e-a475-b2ab4484eed7.Text: Order the control servitor to activate the lift

d14cec81-3fc4-4982-99f9-d0b5c722b36a.Text: Repel the onslaught of the ship's guardians

4f099c53-263c-43ae-b969-38d58b135c1d.Text: Pasqal Haneumann now knows the truth about his past. The dilemma of the Amarnat Collective has been solved.

4254726f-e957-461d-b846-01d5f2780771.Text: A signal from the Ark Mechanicus Hermetico has summoned Pasqal Haneumann to an urgent meeting. Once this voidship served as the seat of Archmagos Amarnat, and thus it is Pasqal's assumption that the time has come for a long-awaited reunion with his mentor.

7eef4b4e-c0f9-4c41-a96c-444be45025a6.Text: The Ark Mechanicus Hermetico, presumed to have been lost decades ago, has reappeared in the known systems of the Koronus Expanse. The first step is to reach its location in System Speculo and send a boarding shuttle to the Hermetico.

e56d83ee-6017-4767-af21-890559bd6095.Text: Archmagos Amarnat's ship is in ruins. The Rogue Trader and Pasqal Haneumann will have to investigate the events that caused this state and discover the identity of whoever sent the message that brought them here.

e18cb5d6-b764-4a0e-ba4c-f70d239ebf2d.Text: The lift up to the observatorium is blocked. To reach the ship's bridge, the visitors will have to find a way to remove the lockdown and make the system obey Pasqal's orders.

752d8c5e-cbcb-42c8-b5df-b62e1041d9e9.Text: Nihel, Pasqal Haneumann's tech-sister and fellow member of the Amarnat Collective, has lured the Rogue Trader and {mf|his|her} companion into a trap. She and her retinue must be destroyed.

4451fc4d-d47b-4f3e-9d9d-93195154ac2d.Text: Ulfar has proven that, for as long as he lives, so does the Baleful Howl pack. Thorbald Ironhide gave him the coordinates of his brothers' last known destination, but this path leads to places of terror, wicked and uncharted.
