ecc9323a-e7e2-4af2-a68e-19e13be052a5.Text: The Space Wolf Ulfar wants to find his battle-brothers. Thorbald Ironhide, leader of the Stormbiters pack, may know something about their whereabouts, but will he share his knowledge with Ulfar?

c203917e-d86b-4e09-9013-b4cd33c877fa.Text: Ulfar wishes to speak to Thorbald Ironhide about the fate of his pack before the assault on Eufrates II commences. With the Rogue Trader's approval, he will invite the leader of the Stormbiters to the von Valancius flagship for a meeting.

8e2a80a7-e5ff-4695-b9d6-703b69e7646a.Text: Thorbald is willing to tell Ulfar where the Baleful Howl pack went if he performs a feat of glory on Eufrates II.

4108c647-827a-4110-b405-d02284b496ca.Text: Go to Eufrates II with Ulfar

790a1f24-2ee8-4927-b2f9-08e1d22e9eec.Text: Doomscream, the Helbrute whose unholy might was made apparent during the planetary assault, now prowls the Machine Cathedral of Eufrates II. Young Halbrandt from the Stormbiters pack wants to exact retribution on Doomscream, but Ulfar intends to beat his audacious brother to the prey and claim the glory of defeating the monstrous heretic for himself.

9484dc0b-1c19-4ecb-9aed-fc41b6be0978.Text: With the feat performed, the condition agreed upon by Ulfar and Thorbald has been fulfilled. It is time to demand that the Stormbiters leader make good on his promise.

00d0e33a-b478-4417-94ad-94f282500bbb.Text: Enquire of the Vox Master about Ulfar's health

512a63c7-df6b-4371-b542-52169c871727.Text: The coordinates provided by the esteemed Thorbald Ironhide lead to a place somewhere within this star cluster. The Rogue Trader must explore these systems to find where exactly Ulfar's pack was headed.

2fbe67e3-73c2-4205-a653-bc7b31693e40.Text: Find the place where the Baleful Howl pack went

a273b173-04ed-4e0a-8dda-3b858c8ac401.Text: Ulfar disembarked from the Rogue Trader's ship and headed to the planet that is presumed to hold evidence of his pack's presence, and he did so alone. If the Lord Captain intends to aid {mf|his|her} ally in this expedition, {mf|he|she} too will have to make planetfall on this frozen planet.

9fa0812a-c69a-4c51-bf4c-00a90a8e19aa.Text: Gravely wounded, Ulfar was transported back to the ship. Despite the chirurgeons' expectations, he did not perish from his injuries and is hopefully now ready to explain the reasons for his abscondment to the Lord Captain.

cd0f9851-fd02-4925-9a17-e4e4ad257880.Text: Find a way to speak with Ulfar.

4d08d5ff-4e4b-42a7-ba46-e41df88e0ce9.Text: The ship that brought the Baleful Howl pack to this world has been discovered, and therefore the Space Wolves themselves must be somewhere nearby. A reconnaissance mission is in order.

6f5d84fd-0383-4e16-8174-28bc21b71f2d.Text: The Baleful Howl's death was a grim one, and their raging souls demand vengeance. The Rogue Trader must lay the fierce Wolves to rest.

c1b0f6fb-2303-4ce1-be7a-929bf0324c1f.Text: The fate of the Baleful Howl is now known, and the threads of the valiant pack's wyrd have been severed. Their last surviving brother, Ulfar Thunderlung, must now forge a new path of service to the Allfather for himself in this universe.

33795dca-f18a-43cb-b249-65925c00e368.Text: The Baleful Howl, the pack of Ulfar Thunderlung, are known to have vanished in the star systems where the Rogue Trader's destiny has led {mf|him|her}. The mighty Space Wolf is bent upon finding his brethren.

e001bc09-47fb-4fbf-b120-00cd04f3034e.Text: On {mf|his|her} travels, the Rogue Trader may encounter Aeldari who fled Crudarach and now find themselves in dire straits. Yrliet has promised to reward the Lord Captain should {mf|he|she} manage to rescue them.

90595e36-9009-4ec6-b182-81b789b67de1.Text: In exchange for the Rogue Trader's help, Yrliet provided the coordinates of a cache left by her people. It can be found in the Last Chance of Cyrene, in the orbit of a gas giant.

62cc87e9-1439-48fa-bb71-dcdeb1f29a79.Text: One of the Aeldari ships that fled Crudarach headed for distant stars, to the Odaenathus XI System.

1f141592-134c-4b53-95d9-c16b7bc9645a.Text: Yrliet claims that one of the Farseer Muaran's visions showed Aeldari ships being consumed by a golden blaze somewhere in the Tenebris Aquae System.

6e58752f-67d1-41a3-8668-004d26cf1c35.Text: Yrliet is convinced that some of her kin can be found in the system known to humans as the Forgotten Twins. That is where the Aeldari Farseer's visions have sent her.

cb2f033c-cd2b-4530-94d0-f9cee310ddb5.Text: The Aeldari who escaped the craftworld Crudarach met a mournful fate.

c586bca5-f979-47dc-b604-56f2a6fd395f.Text: Prior to the fall of Crudarach, some of the Aeldari fled the craftworld in hopes of finding salvation. After spending centuries in isolation under the watchful eye of the Farseers, the xenos survivors were robbed of the life they knew and found themselves in an unfamiliar and strange world. The Koronus Expanse could prove to be too harsh a place for these lost souls.

569382be-cfd1-4066-b0ab-b76b06a02e76.Text: The captured Farseers from Crudarach are being held in the Archon Yremeryss's spire. The way there lies through the streets of Commorragh, filled with the enemies of Humanity.

66ef4d50-4d55-4667-a232-3aa3b119eec5.Text: Reach the Spire of the Reaving Tempest

65157b34-5aa3-4a88-832b-485fd4ee6adb.Text: Yrliet has split from the Rogue Trader's group to rescue her kin from Crudarach — the Farseers may hold the answers to many questions regarding the disappearance of her craftworld. She will reunite with the Rogue Trader in the spire again as soon as she succeeds in her mission.

6f2118c8-204a-4b81-be5a-7cd429cb33c0.Text: The Spire of the Reaving Tempest is filled with hostile xenos, deadly traps, and moans of suffering. The captured Farseers are being held somewhere in its labyrinthine depths.

ccc6f513-9490-4dce-835d-0979100b3928.Text: Find the captured Farseers in the Archon's spire

be64ac20-b39e-4fd2-adbd-0f4d4a633364.Text: The only surviving Farseer from Crudarach is ready to open the Webway Gate and help the Rogue Trader to escape from Commorragh to realspace. If he manages to survive the journey, that is.

e39a311f-00e2-457b-949b-71faa8b43a20.Text: Escort the Farseer to the Webway Gate

cd82be79-431c-49b3-b880-a9c84b4a7b7a.Text: Yrliet wants to privately discuss what happened in Commorragh. The Aeldari will be waiting for the Rogue Trader at her usual place on the bridge.

4b89472d-397b-40fe-9362-43df14b3fff5.Text: Talk to Yrliet aboard the voidship

29e3c9cd-2964-48d3-bcf0-60482e581f1e.Text: The Haemonculus condemned four Farseers to monstrous suffering by locking their minds in one body. Their encounter with the Rogue Trader ended their torment... one way or another.

5d3db36f-bba5-447a-b3e7-e49c57a0f342.Text: For morbid fun, the Haemonculus locked the soul of a Farseer in some kind of game board — every move, every touch means pure suffering for its victim.

ca2d35f2-c43e-480d-85bc-47f14c40ffa1.Text: One of the Farseers turned out to be a prisoner of another experiment of the Haemonculus — his fate is sad and merciless.

cf82bdb6-98b2-4560-9ad4-0df45a609825.Text: The Rogue Trader's retinue stumbled upon a Farseer with a clear mind. Some way must be found to release him from the instrument of torture!

255e4a43-6063-4472-90c9-28879d0ef58f.Text: The Farseer Eklendyl Ma'ersh, who was imprisoned in the heart of one of Commorragh's spires by the Haemonculus, told Yrliet the bitter truth about the fall of her home, the craftworld Crudarach.

41bd4819-2648-454e-9459-137daf923386.Text: The Harlequin named Nocturne of Oblivion has told the Rogue Trader about the captured Aeldari Farseers from the lost craftworld of Crudarach, who are being held in the Spire of the Reaving Tempest. Upon learning about her kin's misfortune, Yrliet asked the Lord Captain to help her rescue the surviving Farseers to learn the truth about the disappearance of her craftworld.

dc146504-b31c-4492-b82d-7c484b98b646.Text: The Farseer Muaran, who resides on the agri-world of Janus by the Lord Captain's leave, has told of a trap that has taken hold of the Aeldari survivors from Crudarach. According to Muaran, this transpired on a verdant world whose name is hidden in the mist of visions — Yrliet and the Lord Captain will have to find it on their own.

9cdbb852-dc59-4faf-8b10-935ec03b558f.Text: Find the world where the Aeldari are stranded

fd38eed3-eef5-4a4b-87fe-8be88becd374.Text: The lush greenery of Quetza Temer is hiding the Aeldari from Calligos Winterscale's wrath, and an unknown anomaly is preventing the Lord Captain from pinpointing Calligos's location from orbit using the ship's augurs. The Rogue Trader's only option is to travel to the planet {mf|himself|herself}.

a623fafe-e41f-471d-a142-81f75964b7d5.Text: Find the Aeldari in the forest

9bc0cf42-64ce-4384-91e3-36162b7af6cd.Text: The Lord Captain is facing a difficult choice: to help the Aeldari per Yrliet's request or to side with a fellow Rogue Trader. But there is a third path: to act as a mediator between the opposing sides and attempt to resolve the conflict with as little bloodshed as possible.

84c3a0f9-4296-4136-8174-38a68c0c4e0c.Text: Listen to what the Aeldari have to say

f15d3430-36be-40cb-82cb-d6f33302bafc.Text: Having found no support in the Rogue Trader's words and actions, Yrliet disappeared into the forests of Quetza Temer. Will their paths ever intertwine again?

ff0c273d-c516-4256-a600-31ce51102f44.Text: A Path of thorns led Yrliet Lanaevyss to the forests of Quetza Temer, where she fulfilled her duty as an Outcast.

ebc7695f-0155-4bb7-a7b4-cbdf64efa66e.Text: Yrliet knows that the surviving Crudarach Aeldari have united their remaining forces. However, forced proximity between humans and xenos in the Koronus Expanse does not bode well for either species. The Lord Captain will once again have to intervene in the affairs of the Aeldari.

422ac161-81d2-465d-af22-742a848fa723.Text: Xavier Calcazar personally met with the Rogue Trader on {mf|his|her} capital world. Such keen interest in the new head of House von Valancius is intriguing... and disquieting.

279ebab4-89f1-4400-8a43-174594779e55.Text: Lord Inquisitor Xavier Calcazar is a powerful and mysterious figure who plays a pivotal role in the fate of the Koronus Expanse. His power is so great that it extends even over Rogue Traders.

46138e05-e478-43ab-9d4a-e8fbacd65de8.Text: A wreckage of a voidship not belonging to Humanity's fleet has been found on the surface of Rykad Majoris. The architecture of the surviving parts points to the vessel belonging to one of the xenos cultures.

61f9a73b-1070-4ada-bb67-ab1636cffd5c.Text: According to the satellites, one of the unidentified voidships circling the nearby star has landed on a large uninhabited world in the system.

342527ae-70e9-4b9d-8437-01114c56be07.Text: The cache has been found, but it was looted by the denizens of the Shadow Quarters long ago.

b3a318a3-675b-48f5-ad30-cecf51f2c259.Text: The destroyed bridge in the Shadow Quarters may contain a cache left by the builders of Footfall.

d3ab6bae-bd16-48b6-8a8b-9a9e128b7d0d.Text: The cache has been found! The information in it suggests that there are more caches to be found on Footfall.

10f8e612-e892-4d38-b7bb-46d12b1f6d8e.Text: Footfall's Great Cathedral was never built. The turret that would have crowned its colossal dome is now located in the Atrium, where it serves as the Chapel of Saint Drusus. There may be an ancient cache inside it.

498babaa-7ebd-4fe4-917d-64d3dfaab12a.Text: Space Marines did in fact come to the Koronus Expanse after receiving reports of xenos attacks. Two Space Wolf units were dispatched under the leadership of Lord Inquisitor Xavier Calcazar by the commanders of this famed Astartes Chapter.

91705067-8b02-43e7-85f6-60bb59297ed0.Text: Travellers arriving on Footfall bring with them rumours of the Emperor's blessed Angels coming to the region to repel the xenothreat. The holy warriors are few in number and are fighting in the farthest-flung reaches of the Koronus Expanse.

ad98a5af-b3a8-4d8d-8cb4-51a1ee2f505d.Text: Angels of the Emperor in the Expanse

de93738f-b0ed-4ce7-bb43-d13c1a287742.Text: The Lord Captain figured out the Kasballica's plan.

e8a0a1c2-d8b3-4b00-9605-6b4a218e78db.Text: A Kasballican ship is seeking burning worlds and is willing to pay for information on them. The purpose of their search is unknown.

bdb8b97c-694e-4a8e-a350-e0deb0834d9c.Text: Captain van Dayne, in her final dispatch before she perished, requested that her family relics be retrieved from a cache on Kiava Gamma.

3a71fd42-dba0-43bb-a0bc-edd3961f37f8.Text: Word of the Lord Captain's unusual fondness for bizarre rodents is quickly spreading across the ship's decks.

6a581802-7c1d-4182-b6a8-163f188d6ac2.Text: The Lord Captain's augurs have pierced the veil of magnetic radiation and discovered a strange human-made complex on the planet's surface.

30ca0813-56b9-4c7a-ab62-3f8c0bdd146c.Text: The Rogue Trader's augurs cannot pierce through the magnetic storm raging above the planet. Only truly powerful sacred technologies can gaze into the eye of the storm.

c3c6697c-2336-4f41-aa0a-962644531781.Text: The Rogue Trader's crew encountered the Kasballican ship again.

90fd50af-03da-498e-88f4-236da26aeaf7.Text: The friendly Kasballican ship that is searching for burning worlds and any scraps of information on the same has indicated in which region it can be found in the near future.

0908c827-12c4-4fe0-8209-caee35718354.Text: The cargo has been found and, by right of salvage, now belongs to the Lord Captain.

83cdc37f-b3d4-41fe-93f2-3ec22cf6b643.Text: A careless officer sent a valuable piece of cargo from a ship into the rubbish chute. The cargo may have been jettisoned somewhere in the Hundred Dreams Crossroads or Langrenn's Belt.

02cf7f8e-6fa1-4731-9d33-c9b87c16f2e6.Text: The Rogue Trader's crew encountered the Pilgrim again.

72e78ff6-bc14-461f-a60d-5747c345c506.Text: A wandering trader calling himself the Pilgrim is eager for information about worlds rich in energy crystals. He has indicated in which region he can be found in the near future.

385cc491-f0e4-4b74-96ab-be633475307b.Text: The pirates on the station suffered a defeat at the hands of the Lord Captain.

59ada45d-a093-4593-82d3-c7b4b8a8573c.Text: A plundered void station in Langrenn's Belt, according to numerous testimonies, is serving as a base for a band of pirates who aren't above doing deals with xenos.

dc277119-82ff-40d6-9291-ccc0a0027292.Text: The wandering trader calling himself the Pilgrim gave the Rogue Trader ancient Imperial documents as a token of thanks. If the scrolls are to be believed, around two centuries ago, at some "crossing of paths" in the Expanse, an entire Imperial world perished.

f1f1124a-aede-47ab-9019-d152f9740f16.Text: The ship has been found and its cargo will now be used for the good of the von Valancius dynasty.

10699f1a-8324-490a-ab2b-3827766ff313.Text: Decades ago, a ship called the Inevitable Triumph went missing on course for Footfall. A shuttle from that ship has been discovered not far from the Aviorus System.

fec59bbe-e564-4aff-9b5c-cdf62b016009.Text: Kiava Gamma has been left to the mercies of cultists — servants of the Archenemy who have transformed the industrial world into a furnace of evil and heresy.

0af48058-5cd9-46b6-9455-c54f51dd622a.Text: Accounts vary in the details, but they do agree on one thing: on Kiava Gamma, a world owned by the Rogue Trader's dynasty and rich in ore and minerals, some kind of catastrophe has occurred.

9cfa1d89-2fb0-4add-a7bf-f94a5d3bd83a.Text: The rumour turned out to be a cruel lie. The population of the world near the Frozen Prince were granted no ascension — they were annihilated by the servants of the Archenemy.

7fedd04a-ab50-4469-ba40-264d476e0e52.Text: According to pilgrims on Footfall, one world near a cold star in the Cinerus Maleficum reached such spiritual heights that the Emperor raised up all its people to join Him in His halls.

7214d734-8152-405e-80bb-b6217f764f2b.Text: Emperor's Miracle in the Cinerus Maleficum

f6d8229e-4445-422f-b4ee-414f0cbb1ef0.Text: The Wasteland Wayfarer has been found on a world destroyed by ungodly xenos.

82ea05ea-71e9-418c-84c1-5b78e7d8bc32.Text: Footfall is still waiting for news from an ancient ark known as the Wasteland Wayfarer, which set off for distant stars in search of new worlds. The vessel's last Astropathic message supposedly came from the Cinerus Maleficum.

000dc8cd-0695-4f57-9ab9-8e812517e998.Text: The discovered ship turned out to be the Wasteland Wayfarer — an ancient ark of Drusian missionaries who perished on a world destroyed by ungodly xenos.

cdcba978-4b20-4ba5-b7fc-bd45b11c7d12.Text: Marazhai the Drukhari, in his own unique fashion, informed the Lord Captain about a human vessel that had suffered some kind of calamity in the Cinerus Maleficum. Then again, it is unlikely the words of a xenos can be trusted.

c2ee63ef-a48e-4ff7-9989-75b3cf85a06d.Text: Abandoned on Foulstone by the Naviica's detestable captain, the refugees were forced to seek shelter and appealed to the stern hermits from the Order of the Hammer, followers of Saint Cognatius.

a7deea92-5dc8-4f2a-a2b7-bf40e9010610.Text: Thousands of refugees from Winterscale's Realm arrived on Footfall aboard the transport Naviica but found no refuge there and set out for the desert world of Foulstone.

02b54385-1c65-4d5d-82af-99bc14c7124c.Text: Enhanced augurs discovered an armoury world beneath a thick layer of ice, which once belonged to the Imperium.

3eff3bf3-6011-431a-919a-043fb9398c79.Text: The Rogue Trader failed to uncover traces of human civilisation on the frozen planet, despite possessing documents attesting to that fact. Perhaps the problem lies in the ship's augurs — they are simply not powerful enough.

660b890a-9496-4caa-a8a9-d9baa1cb2fb3.Text: The outpost received the needed resources.

c174ee4c-0922-44ef-b719-4d7e31b89eec.Text: An outpost in the Forgotten Twins is in need of resources — provisions.

712a108e-5b85-4c1a-b218-3215a3242820.Text: Now a Tech-Adept is overseeing development in the scavenger colony.

4f1667e2-3a50-4735-a440-d228bc75f23d.Text: Reta Machsimova, head of a small colony of scavengers who have made their home on an abandoned ship, is seeking help from someone with expertise in ship apparatus and ancient mechanisms.

8e54289a-bd60-4bcb-9d6c-50a4e8566da6.Text: It seems Rogue Trader {name} von Valancius treats worthless scavengers as equals. What has the dynasty come to?

f646bbb3-dfea-488f-ba99-e104b24d1a43.Text: The function of the archeotech component remains a mystery even to the servants of the Adeptus Mechanicus.

ab5e6e07-bbe4-4770-ac3a-087e21315784.Text: The Rogue Trader's crew stumbled upon the plundered remnants of an ancient Imperial vessel. An intricate component was discovered among the meagre pickings that remained, and servants of the Machine Cult identified it as a piece of an archeotech mechanism, its purpose unknown. A remarkable find!

42b61a30-b284-4b05-ba09-9c6714beb36e.Text: Machine Cult members constructed a remarkable mechanism from the discovered archeotech components — an interstellar compass that points the way to the heart of the Expanse.

0580ff07-c6ba-4614-9ed8-66a332ca3b59.Text: The Rogue Trader's crew once again came across the plundered vessel containing the ancient machines. This time, Tech-Priests greedily inspected everything down to the last cog, but all they were able to scavenge was another fragment of the archeotech mechanism. Perhaps somewhere in the Expanse there are more ships like this one.

97f7f94e-67e4-487e-9a4b-3534aa94c125.Text: The discovered ship was laden with the incalculable riches of Imperial colonists, who were doomed to die before they ever reached the new lands they sought.

223576f3-325b-462e-8fb8-3a1df1831a30.Text: Owing to {mf|his|her} keen intellect and more than a bit of luck, the Rogue Trader managed to discover several ancient Imperial ships and restore the archeotech compass mechanism pointing to the location of the fleet's mother ship — the Mu-Rho 79 System.

937d372b-adfd-43d7-b666-486bc88180d9.Text: Associating with vermin always leaves its mark. Rumours that Rogue Trader {name} von Valancius is spending {mf|his|her} time playing with space rubbish are quickly spreading across the Expanse.

1373ffd9-35c9-4f39-bfb7-d24ad0d870cd.Text: The colony of recolligers has been found.

8d70b502-8d11-4fd2-8137-8b4605fbd5eb.Text: A couple of jumps from the Cranach System, a small group of recolligers have taken up residence on a drifting wreck. The legality of their actions is far from clear and the servants of the Adeptus Mechanicus are not pleased. However, if one sets a goal, one can make a profit, even from the lowest drudges of the Imperium.

ebcfddab-62a7-4058-bc80-01faf92c158c.Text: The thefts of the stars were perpetrated at the direction of the Haemonculus Tervantias, as he required their energy to continue working on some unholy "masterpiece" of his.

215a84fb-7a64-409a-ab54-bc6e1059597b.Text: On extremely rare occasions, the Drukhari have been observed stealing suns in the Koronus Expanse. Such notorious raids wreak devastation across entire solar systems, but it is the frequency with which these malicious xenos are depriving Humanity of valuable stars that raises suspicion. What could have prompted this increase in their rapacious activities?

4eec49d7-3ef5-4dba-ad3a-e9f6fa59657d.Text: People are saying that Rogue Trader {name} von Valancius never misses an opportunity to make a profit, even if that means shaking down pitiful scavengers for tribute.

f1524c31-b745-4aac-94f6-3d3931a7a620.Text: The Rogue Trader's crew survived an encounter with a warp anomaly.

91d9de53-ebce-4897-b99b-9aa3c549f897.Text: The governor of Amberworld has spoken of a heavenly chariot of a certain King of Distortion — a local god who deforms the bodies of the people. It seems this "chariot" is some kind of anomaly manifesting in the system.

67e9166c-1da3-429a-b438-7d4067e7ae95.Text: There are indeed fragments of a xenos reconnaissance vessel lying on an ocean world in Porta Septentum.

aaec7ae2-c942-49d5-a463-21945379faea.Text: Rumours have reached the Rogue Trader of a xenos ship that was wrecked on one of the ocean worlds of the Koronus Expanse.

b34f1e17-a581-434a-a585-42adf840fc20.Text: War departed the planet long ago, leaving in its wake a shroud of poisonous substances that are rapidly killing every living thing. The war-torn world has been irrevocably transformed into a dead world.

75eca516-f0ec-462d-9bbc-73e3cdbc84cc.Text: In a region of the Nameless Stars lies a doomed world owned by Calligos Winterscale, one that is trapped in the agony of a centuries-long war.

4265e3f3-2195-4303-b0a5-fb62c7eb5a9d.Text: The discovered stash belonged to an unknown pirate faction, and now they are out for the Rogue Trader's blood in revenge.

e14384db-04cd-470a-88bc-ba5823de2432.Text: The Rogue Trader's crew discovered a cache on a frozen world. The cache was filled with suspicious substances. One can only hope the owner will not be too aggrieved by their loss.

cf199f59-996b-489f-bb83-627f2b87b9bd.Text: The xenos who have invaded the Koronus Expanse are Drukhari, a type of Aeldari. These merciless killers are well known to the inhabitants of the region, but their attacks have sharply increased in recent times.

ef95ce60-6150-48a8-8c06-751f9a98b6df.Text: There are whispers on Footfall about xenos — those cursed enemies of Humanity — carrying out raids on inhabited worlds and ruthlessly destroying Imperial outposts.

566686bf-73c9-4cbe-8fd3-0e3413899705.Text: Some unknown party reached Tervantias's laboratory before the Rogue Trader and stole whatever device the Haemonculus had been working on.

38794455-8f8e-4311-94be-cd780daeaa05.Text: The Haemonculus Tervantias has lost all interest in his former work and become obsessed with completing some unknown "masterpiece" as swiftly as possible. There is no doubt that this sinister and corrupted creation will bring great woe to Humanity, and so it is imperative that the Haemonculus's handiwork is found and destroyed without delay.

94eddbfa-a5ae-4782-a679-f17c2b3ab803.Text: The Rogue Trader is not the only one who has {mf|his|her} sights set on the protectorate's stolen property — other pirates, just as eager to take House von Valancius's riches, are after the Elusive Contempt as well!

07f465ca-425e-4d8e-911c-5493c0521e1e.Text: A band of vicious pirates have been plundering cargo ships throughout the Expanse with impunity for centuries. Not even the illustrious Theodora von Valancius was able to bring the scoundrels to justice, for they successfully avoided a deadly encounter with her. However, the Rogue Trader now has a chance to put an end to their brigandage: the ships of the troublesome gang have been spotted in Langrenn's Belt, led by their flagship — the Elusive Contempt.

ce298fb9-739b-4f61-8a3a-bafeff86af92.Text: The pathetic pirates sought to claim that which belongs to the Rogue Trader but lost a sizeable part of their fleet. Regrettably, the Elusive Contempt managed to escape once more.

f53b7d8f-1739-4ba2-94f4-c2de83fecd67.Text: The flagship of the elusive pirates has been spotted in Latotian's Passage. The criminals plan to plunder the cargo ships of the von Valancius dynasty — such audacity cannot be allowed to go unpunished.

82d8d3e8-395a-4f40-a6d1-6716e7d10898.Text: The Lord Captain caught up with the legendary pirates and exacted just punishment for all the crimes they had perpetrated.

3e573c8e-c222-42e2-9392-ad3e13dfd657.Text: The Elusive Contempt, the dread pirate ship, has been spotted once again! The pirates have stopped for repairs in the Silence of Mer-Segrit — the time has come to rid the Expanse of these criminals who have betrayed the Emperor's tenets!

577dddff-ae37-41fe-bc9c-2bc82df242e7.Text: The Vox Master has reported that an abnormally large asteroid the size of a small planet was spotted in the system of Sotto's Tomb. The asteroid may hold rich deposits of valuable resources.

88d51534-1c67-49de-bc5c-4418fbe6b048.Text: The ship that was once regarded as one of the best exploration vessels of the von Valancius protectorate was corrupted by the Archenemy.

4bf1900c-4ca5-43aa-ba95-832c8a1e2d99.Text: Several ships have vanished in the Litoribum Maledicta. Astropaths from across the Expanse are broadcasting alarming warnings to each other about an unknown threat in the region.

7f8ce628-e527-423c-a8d7-c4a248d35da6.Text: Reverend Hieronymus Doloroso himself was behind the deaths of the members of House Chorda preserved inside the cryo-vaults. He murdered them to make Incendia the Rogue Trader.

4ad84ecd-02dd-493d-94f4-9d48d4790111.Text: The Rogue Trader encountered a number of followers of Saint Drusus on an uninhabited planet. They were guarding a covert underground facility, ready to kill any intruders without mercy. In the depths of the facility, the Rogue Trader discovered cryo-vaults containing dead bodies.

e044b31e-f19e-4b8f-83d3-2a1e5e8209a0.Text: Eufrates II is engulfed in the fires of the war on heresy, yet the Cognisance Fleet is categorically rejecting any offers of aid, incapable of overcoming their wariness of the laity.

e6849ba8-e88c-40c6-9259-b4f9b52eb698.Text: Eufrates II, a sacred planet of the Adeptus Mechanicus, is in peril! The Cult of the Final Dawn has taken over this world and seeks to seize control of its forges. The Explorator Cognisance Fleet has recalled its ships to protect its domain, and Lord Inquisitor Calcazar has sent his own forces to assist.

9f341e82-bceb-4105-8a94-f732da849ac4.Text: The Rogue Trader encountered a spectral phenomenon that had the appearance of the gargantuan black shadow of a grand cruiser.

ffcfe821-83b1-42f4-8770-4e018e5af519.Text: Echoes of dark songs and legends have reached the Astropathic Choir following a series of indistinct distress signals emanating from every corner of the Expanse. The last of these signals was traced to a voidship in the Omicron System.

6644dd9a-955b-4671-8b72-ac993fd5cb21.Text: The coordinates led to a Drukhari beacon surrounded by an unholy spectacle of abominations of the Haemonculus's make. Upon coming into contact with the prism, the beacon transferred the coordinates of a certain planet.

ce31a322-199d-41fa-8e14-a878ef5d029c.Text: The ship's finest minds spent many watches trying to understand the purpose of the bizarre prism found in Commorragh. The researchers were lucky to activate the object only once — unfurling in an array of petals, the prism reproduced the holographic image and coordinates of an ice planet in Langrenn's Belt, before snapping shut once more.

65de05f5-fca1-4ab8-8834-690e6d3ccc04.Text: Another xenos beacon was discovered in the designated spot. For what purpose did the Haemonculus place them on different planets — and for whom?

cf76bbe9-1eea-4069-aa6c-1a88ff7d28bd.Text: On the snow-covered planet, a sickening sight unfolded as hundreds of ungodly mutants wandered in an enclosure equipped with spikes, hooks, and other instruments of torture, caught in the throes of unbearable agony of body and mind. The Drukhari beacon, fed by their torment, reawakened the Haemonculus's prism, which gave the coordinates of a lava world in the Narmer IV System.

a4f32702-7668-4a8e-99fd-e8440bbdbd56.Text: After receiving the signal from the beacon, the prism pointed the Lord Captain to the next planet.

def0b1c1-df65-4937-89b2-f6679df1d609.Text: The Haemonculus's prism found by the Rogue Trader is capable of tuning into Drukhari beacons located throughout the Expanse. After establishing a link to a second beacon, also powered by the suffering of hideous mutants, the xeno-artefact reactivated. The device pointed the way to the next planet, a shattered world in the Lapidus Mortus System.

a6128af2-879a-46b2-aa89-b6f261e47422.Text: The final set of coordinates brought the Rogue Trader to the most abhorrent of all the sights {mf|he|she} has encountered on this long journey — yet at the end of it, at last, the Lord Captain found a worthy reward.

ba6bc033-cba9-4937-8850-1fd78545edd1.Text: On the third planet, in the middle of a pasture for maimed mutants, another xenos beacon lay waiting, greedily soaking up pain. After making contact with it, the prism displayed a short message from the Haemonculus addressed to an Archon: a fascinating journey full of hand-picked, tormented victims was drawing to a close. A lavish bounty awaited the one who made it to the end. The prism gave the coordinates of a death world in the Hundred Dreams Crossroads.

b55c7b91-fc7c-4ce2-b504-ad2278df89f1.Text: The unholy spawn responsible for thousands of horrible deaths was once a local aristocrat who had become twisted by the Archenemy. Its reign of terror is over — the Lord Captain made sure of that.

bf14d89c-b760-493f-8610-6cc616c1aa53.Text: There has been an unsuccessful attempt to restore an abandoned colony in the Mundus Nullius — the colonist ship went dark shortly after its arrival in the system. The vessel's fate could be worth investigating.

563d2097-9922-4614-9406-a6efe50cbc1f.Text: News from the Orsellio Prophecy System — numerous xenos vessels have been sighted on one of the planets. The reason for their presence on this world is unclear.

ae9a0efe-fc27-4b5c-981e-abcce125cf41.Text: A group of heavily damaged xenos ships has been sighted in Langrenn's Belt.

e9de64c1-5a8b-4449-a55a-b6bd2ce26b25.Text: A strange anomaly that looks like a hole in the fabric of the void draws in any ship whose crew is foolish enough to get too close.

13993d30-38b8-4b12-8512-f477fdeb61f2.Text: Ships in the Koronus Expanse are reporting an unidentified space anomaly in the Narmer IV System. All that is known about this phenomenon is that space itself becomes warped and unstable around it, and any ship that approaches the anomaly zone disappears without a trace.

1970fddf-4e03-480f-84ed-eb9ad799ad1b.Text: Santiel's Pride was bled dry and despoiled by the Drukhari raiders. Even the system's star was stolen.

ff497aab-ec0a-4d65-b953-3a9c74b55cbe.Text: Santiel's Pride, a world that is part of House Chorda's domain, was attacked by the vicious Drukhari. Soon after word of the raid was sent, the system went silent. Not a single ship has come from it since.

abae09f8-6bd5-4e75-b0ff-095b89fb63b9.Text: In the smuggler den ridden with traps and xenotech, the Lord Captain came upon a mysterious artefact.

a5205d5f-cd64-432e-a4a6-1187ed3f6f08.Text: Vigdis has reported that a pirate vox-cast was intercepted recently. Apparently, one of the planets in the Cradle of Khepri holds something quite valuable.

65fe24df-3adf-4910-adc4-35cd233309c4.Text: The cache contained a load of sacred relics and valuable equipment. These items now rightfully belong to the Lord Captain.

0a212e37-85d0-4ac3-a9f0-b4123a2da9d0.Text: In an attempt to purchase her pardon, the heretic and pirate Ryzza gave the Rogue Trader the coordinates of one of her caches containing her ill-gotten gains. The Lord Captain had best requisition the plundered goods before other pirates discover them.

0454a1a3-af28-4f41-be3b-834a4ba5b947.Text: Not only did Calligos Winterscale survive in the inhospitable forests of Quetza Temer, he even managed to add to his collection of xenotrophies.

695427d3-17a3-4ab3-b629-5ac71a561810.Text: A tragic fate befell one of the greatest dynasties in the Koronus Expanse. Rogue Trader Calligos Winterscale and his closest followers perished in the hunting grounds of Quetza Temer.

b02cfc25-b3c5-4a77-a338-3afe3d7afca0.Text: Calligos Winterscale's flagship caught up with its prey in the Nameless Star System.

d5a50b5e-3565-4166-93df-9d2357d0a1a3.Text: The ungodly Aeldari have intruded upon the realm of the most indomitable Rogue Trader in the Koronus Expanse, Calligos Winterscale. Reckoning comes for the xenos, for the hunt is on!

6ed7ab92-539d-49b3-87d6-a72e9a510f8b.Text: Another Imperial world marked by the Archenemy's corruption has perished in the darkness of the universe. Amberworld's execution at the hands of the Rogue Trader von Valancius was an act of mercy and salvation — glory to the Imperium!

1b5e6773-7700-44c5-bb5c-1987e21b5ffa.Text: Apparently, the Rogue Trader has struck a deal with the entity that has controlled Amberworld for many decades. It is probably nothing more than a rumour. Could the Emperor's anointed really have made a deal with the Archenemy?

a5e6d068-fbea-4f70-93c1-ace101929118.Text: The Rogue Trader, by the force of {mf|his|her} words and faith, overpowered the unfathomable entity serving the Archenemy. Glory to the von Valancius dynasty!

2185bea9-e4ba-4a39-bc5d-61dfcc8a4352.Text: The Magnae Accessio ceremony has taken place on Dargonus. The name "{name} von Valancius" is spreading across the Koronus Expanse in a resounding echo.

9a6223b0-c4a1-4ad0-b60d-18b057c1ed56.Text: Footfall welcomes the new head of the von Valancius dynasty. What happened to Lady Theodora? What is the new Rogue Trader like? Questions and rumours are increasing by the hour.

44fc00a9-ffa7-4476-a122-ea3f637afcc1.Text: Countless servitors tend to the pumps of the holy irrigation engines that water the crops, while the wise Magi Biologis study the genome of the harvested specimens to discard the mutated strains.

27ce8f47-8492-482f-bf62-40656fed353b.Text: All fundi receive +50% productivity bonus and +N% bonus for each of the same building on other colonies.

22fc40c2-47e4-43c9-93fc-64c1c6b429d5.Text: On these fundi, fruit and grain are processed by a myriad of purifiers and threshing machines, fermented and distilled in large vats in order to finally get strong and pure amasec.

01dd4fb4-86e1-4402-8997-62107d0c9c4f.Text: In huge vats, organic materials with psychotropic substances are chemically purified and distilled into pure euphoria, bliss for wicked souls.

d001404e-0120-4e95-b064-1721f82bc297.Text: Here, they make food with old primitive methods, exorbitant expenses, and in tiny amounts. Although, consumers can be certain that their grox steak lived a happy life.

d933618a-16e7-4319-bc2b-1a22f2db28bf.Text: These enormous industrial farms provide billions of Imperial subjects with sustenance. It may taste awful, but it's nutritious.

14c40654-ea2a-46db-9741-66cca969f26d.Text: The gas fundi collect billions of tons of raw organic matter and process the hydrocarbon gas which is released during decomposition.

3929e4cd-5b97-4534-9aa9-48b650210eea.Text: All fundi receive a +100% productivity bonus.

35a6e602-e8a5-41fc-8b41-6ef79003207a.Text: Rich soil is not necessary for growing crops — water with fertiliser is more than enough. Hydroponic fundi work according to this principle allowing plants to grow under any conditions.

fcceb799-f37b-4dd7-adbc-fc8a91d6c5e2.Text: The fundus's productivity can never drop below base level.

d219d972-b7f8-4f4b-897f-bd9f5e6b3f25.Text: Taking plasteel through the holy cycle of pressing, stamping, and clasping, artisans forge it into indestructible armaplas.

377229f8-37c3-4b94-bce8-641d08fe461c.Text: The forge-cathedral of the Adeptus Mechanicus. Here, amidst hours of arithmetical liturgies and gruelling lexprayers, Tech-Priests awaken blessed cogitator spirits.

1654abd2-2a61-4cfe-b50c-b8910f13606c.Text: Celestial ships of the Imperium are, in fact, cities sailing through the Void constantly demanding new parts. Wharfs like this one supply them with everything they might need.

22e91173-678c-4d07-b423-72b0d07cd4ff.Text: Under the blessed domes of this chapel Tech-Priests update their servitors' data-vows and pledge their allegiance to the Omnissiah on all vox-frequencies.

f7815d8f-1d28-43e5-9b29-0cf86c198c55.Text: All manufactorums receive a +50% productivity bonus.

f0a75b95-452b-4ca7-a4d1-4d981ad3226d.Text: After passing through many stills and filters, raw organic matter, possessing high energy potential, is turned into highly flammable promethium fuel.

e7f0616b-624a-4f9c-878d-07d856dca9f4.Text: This is where Tech-Priests turn human matter into servitors, fusing flesh and metal, relieving the human mind of all unnecessary functions and leaving only the bare minimum necessary to serve.

c17033ea-300a-450e-94fb-e402532bb002.Text: The colony suffers a −15 contentment penalty.

72898a4b-3b52-49e8-82f4-3a929e06ac7e.Text: Stringent questors from the Department Munitorum oversee the arming and training new recruits whose life and blood will be given for the Imperium.

e8e4e08d-99c5-46e7-9364-500dd79db561.Text: The colony suffers a −20 contentment penalty.

c91f9b4b-b26e-4bdb-9dee-28bbaa11091c.Text: In the auspicious flickering of lumen lights, furious machine spirits of tanks, armoured carriers, and artillery platforms awaken. Along with the cogitators, they crave the blood of the heretics and xenos.

78797b32-e1ff-43da-82af-92e38946ac71.Text: In the mandibles of lathes and the wombs of alloy tanks, soulless steel takes on its perfect form — that of a weapon.

501b1e3f-af7f-4b92-9ab4-d760bca9bee9.Text: Endless mag-train platforms descend into the monstrous depths, where seismic cannons bellow, pulverising rock into dust and freeing the metal ore within.

ae945160-0ea6-4d6f-a379-80c2ebefa21a.Text: Promethium fire, under the pressure of several atmospheres, help fuse ceramic powder and plasteel into heat-resistant ceramite, a shield for the warriors of the Imperium protecting against all kinds of evil.

6d011721-807d-47ee-bc1d-362c681074d7.Text: Here, inorganic chemical compounds are extracted that are later used in other industrial production.

c748b8aa-ca67-415e-b26f-2055201aa7f4.Text: Heavy machine blades grind ore and rock into the finest dust which is then mixed with a bonding agent to produce rockcrete.

8ae3d9bf-afd6-46b0-8d28-cc1b1edeb986.Text: Manufactorum cementum produces 10 BP in a cycle.

e73637e8-6a55-44a0-92b9-c08aa165dbff.Text: Heavy mining equipment, equipped with industrial lasers, vaporises even the most solid rock to help reach the most valuable ore deposits.

0cdb5624-be88-41e3-83fa-cf57554a9bcf.Text: The rumbling fyceline quarries are rightfully called "caverns of death" among the workers. And yet, despite frequent casualties, fyceline mining never stops, for the Imperium is always in need of more ammunition and explosives.

1fe90f70-8a47-44de-abd2-0b2c1b90faef.Text: Extractium tunnels bore many kilometres deep into rock and soil, permitting access to valuable ore and mineral deposits.

076b902f-8a6b-4478-bd5b-67eb00bb273e.Text: The Adeptus Mechanicus have devised blessed hydraulic machines that pulverise even the most unyielding stone and free the precious minerals that are needed by the Imperium.

6c89dfd2-d241-4935-bde0-e4aeda9926e0.Text: All extractiums receive +50% productivity bonus and +N% bonus for each of the same building on other colonies.

561a08c3-c981-4534-8ab3-4f5660e31fd9.Text: In the smouldering heat of the foundries ore is melted and purified, turning into sturdy plasteel, which protects Humanity from its enemies.

49c29e6a-1df3-48ad-bc0b-da71cd860a4e.Text: In giant moulds the liquid rockcrete mixture engulfs the plasteel frame, after which it hardens under pressure from the presses. The resulting ferrocrete is incredibly durable.

8de5656f-4e44-49d5-81df-3b0e61a8765c.Text: Manufactorum cementum magnus produces 20 BP in a cycle.

5b00c8cc-eae7-4039-ab7b-232053b5cf3f.Text: Giant excavator scoops remove the upper layers of soil, exposing the sand deposits. Whole regions are turned into giant strip mines.

62344a4a-8c68-49b6-bd91-254689583a0a.Text: Thousands of scribes register cargo, ordinates publish manifests and communiques in the name of the Imperium, and the lenses of watchful cogitators process myriads of documents. Many traders dream of carrying out their business as far as possible from the bulwarks of the Adeptus Administratum and its red tape.

0fa85a43-4307-4da1-bde1-32c26dcdc80e.Text: The colony receives a +50 efficiency bonus and suffers a −20 accessibility penalty.

982ab66c-7e30-4ffc-8a9a-54abe6caae0b.Text: The brave Tempestus Scions protects worlds from the threats within — criminals, rebels, and dangerous cults. Its methods are far from humane, but such is the price of peace.

61e7c8d5-eeee-4439-97e0-547a7d21aee9.Text: The colony receives a +70 security bonus and suffers a −30 contentment penalty.

0e8f00b7-d4ac-4dcd-9f6c-e1cebc90ae54.Text: A complex of underground vaults reinforced with plasteel and equipped with everything needed for survival. Colonists might successfully wait out an assault or several calamities, provided that helps arrives before the supplies of oxygen and rations inevitably run out.

ddc60a71-2607-42da-9857-fa899559cc1e.Text: This massive complex of buildings provides all types of depraved pleasures — a whole city dedicated to bringing joy to impure souls.

71179d3d-b827-457f-beaa-5953edd76850.Text: The colony receives a +35 contentment bonus and suffers a −35 efficiency penalty.

9b6ecbe3-311e-4d16-a9c8-0f1b8f52b8d4.Text: Many who have forgotten the Creed flock to the pleasure palaces. Here, not only can exhausted manufactorum labourers enjoy themselves, but also the most blasé of highborns.

968edd6a-5796-4003-a344-b4f82ee68ceb.Text: The colony receives a +50 contentment bonus and suffers a −50 efficiency penalty.

3754091b-e8bf-4fdf-be90-995b538132b7.Text: This giant vault stores and distributes goods that are necessary for the colony's well-being — rations, fuel cells, unirobes, promethium, etc.

15c98cfa-ee3b-41c1-9761-900566d87dca.Text: The colony consumes N% less provisions.

03881ff4-0793-4a48-b20c-d09511687908.Text: Negative events are N% less effective. The probability of population growth is N% higher.

481240d3-739a-439d-a878-cc646c7dcb27.Text: Purifying altars are set up under enormous airtight crystalflex domes, which purify the water and air and enrich them with beneficial substances for the colonists.

dbeedd1b-da32-4a9c-8480-bd1680957d1c.Text: The probability of population growth is N% higher.

6ae53a44-3a8f-4d80-89ba-84f262904dd2.Text: This military base is a veritable stronghold for the planetary defence forces. The ability to quickly fend off any threat outweighs the discontent of subjects who are forced to tolerate these crude soldiers.

cca2a6aa-e3e7-4d4a-a024-57072484c812.Text: The colony receives a +100 security bonus and suffers a −30 contentment penalty.

63da2d58-acd0-452b-af9f-cd1ebf5007c4.Text: Orbital stations like this one can accept cargo from voidships that are too big and heavy to land on the planet's surface. It brings prosperity to a colony, but at a price of attracting less than savoury elements.

6db9cbc7-baec-44f9-84f5-e43bc37292a6.Text: The colony receives a +50 accessibility bonus and suffers a −40 security penalty.

ab4edddf-db60-48c1-a4bb-4c69d00b7eca.Text: The colony receives a +35 efficiency bonus and suffers a −20 accessibility penalty.

cd98909b-03a6-4834-ab5b-1db3456e8491.Text: The crème de la crème, the highborn, of the protectorate live in beautiful palaces surrounded by armies of doting servants. For the privilege of being ascended above the myriad of commoners, they pay with service and absolute loyalty to the Rogue Trader.

62850e05-c1de-4556-be7e-cd7396f322e2.Text: Highborn villas provide +5 to the profit factor.

a5469350-3571-43f9-8537-5eae50d76a1f.Text: A starport serves as a portal between the colony and the outside world, allowing voidships and shuttles of various traders to land. Here, pirates mingle with well-meaning voidship captains in search of bigger prey.

9255bbe1-1a61-42c9-9a13-0e378bbad948.Text: The colony receives a +30 accessibility bonus and suffers a −40 security penalty.

9f07a7ac-4026-41db-a6ed-8c60da56e20e.Text: "I am proud to see that I have raised a worthy successor. Do not hesitate to go hard on them, Jocasta!"

cb9437ad-eb74-4b31-844c-701a4991a957.Text: "Hold on, Master... Just stay with us!"

603bdf71-c86c-401a-a9c4-40e8bf1652c7.Text: "Keep firing, you oafs! No cowering and no hiding! You see the traitor, you kill the traitor!"

309ccfac-0c65-46e1-9a65-ebcdd9614461.Text: "The accursed traitor shot him at point-blank range! The Master-at-Arms is not looking good!"

640c4bb4-322c-4a56-8c19-c5368b955ee2.Text: The heretic's body is riddled with holes. An improvised single-shot gun lies smoking in his hand.

9558736d-9989-4493-ac9d-d2e50b5b8cf6.Text: "The ship could use a prayer or two right now, but it's too early for a funeral! My repairmen are already hard at work fixing the damaged compartments. We can and we will make it!"

a9b84ce6-6d81-460a-be86-398c20e31c5d.Text: "Fire on the third, shutting off the air supply... Extinguished... Depressurisation on the seventh, blocking the airlocks..."

2fa0933d-58d9-4eec-8ecd-990a3d57f4b3.Text: The newfound death cultists on Dargonus offer nightly prayers for the Undying One to guide the Rogue Trader's hand in battle.

ff45e9c2-05b5-4bf5-ab66-0d092dbb94b3.Text: A secret compound donated by the Bloodspun Web serves as a formidable weapon against any creature made of metal.

15e1f440-5189-49cb-ae8a-a3053f78d412.Text: Everyone knows that the enemies of the Rogue Trader are extinguished by death itself.

b2939e8b-dfa2-452a-b01c-01627c6c5a25.Text: A cultist of the Bloodspun Web sacrificed his sanity to deliver the prophecies of a strange enemy to the Rogue Trader.

bbb42675-77fa-499a-bd13-fbc479721ee3.Text: The Rogue Trader cunningly weakened the Engine Vandals and cleared the wastelands of the enemy.

7bdf2e6c-e71c-49b3-bbaf-7edf5bb6fa2e.Text: The Rogue Trader permitted the Bloodspun Web to direct the struggle of minor cults against oppression, thus multiplying the number of death cultists on Dargonus.

ed003992-bfe5-40d5-b692-a5ec5a70f4cd.Text: The Rogue Trader ordered the Malpians to accept the teachings of the Bloodspun Web, halting religious confrontation.

6f0eb2cc-0a24-4084-8a8f-a1169f8aac1c.Text: The Rogue Trader turned the Pure-Voiced Prophet over to the Bloodspun Web, whereupon he mysteriously disappeared.

3324f1d2-beff-4b5e-94e5-452d4cce5636.Text: The Rogue Trader exterminated the xenodisease using the knowledge of the Bloodspun Web.

94128e6e-0c21-4b95-838d-4665c6b3ec96.Text: The sacrifice of a Bloodspun Web cultist revealed that an unknown evil had caused the convicts' murders, extinguishing the fires of rebellion.

0eb281c9-3096-4f67-b672-d4cba6ef4ad4.Text: The cultists of the Bloodspun Web exterminated the leaders of the rebellion without mercy and stifled dissent.

977e808e-7758-41f8-ad36-25dc5f94802a.Text: [Embrace Kibellah] "That trial is behind us now. Never again shall we part."

719bb901-cdc8-40cc-bbe7-6411de97c04d.Text: "Please, don't. No one could have foreseen what would happen."

7d7cc668-0c16-4ea8-a085-7ad26a8f0c27.Text: "We are alive and we are together. Nothing else matters."

503bb876-e2f0-47da-8c5a-870b300f3518.Text: "I can't argue with that. You have failed in your duty to protect me."

e7817851-96f0-4922-be42-17d0268ab66b.Text: "I am waiting to hear how you intend to redeem your faults."

c40ff85b-c687-40c8-bbf7-0de61795891c.Text: "Whatever you are going through, we will face it together."

9a81cb94-559b-455d-b407-a7bb4ef4dd63.Text: "I want to be with you. No matter what."

25082ce6-c95f-4932-8c5a-a83e5b53b04f.Text: "All right. Let us pretend that there was never anything between us."

3639c0c1-a206-4cda-a74a-1a9085f140fe.Text: [Touch Kibellah's hand] "I need you, not a blade of the Web. Please. Don't leave me."

92055aae-b82e-41ff-99ca-92099d55099d.Text: "Am I to understand that you cannot handle your own problems?"

94e00bff-bdf1-4fd3-acbf-5748962b40cc.Text: {n}Kibellah, having stepped into your chambers, stares at you with eyes wide and brimming with emotion.{/n} "Domin..." {n}A moment later, her hands touch your face.{/n} "{name}!"

7adf0a6c-fa97-4d1e-957e-c36d57df5e63.Text: {n}She melts in your embrace, her trembling touches expressing her feelings better than any words could. She releases you and looks into your eyes with a mixture of longing and relief.{/n}

90437639-41bf-4b2a-aa07-1527e9f8a11c.Text: "I believed... I knew you were alive... I saw your shadow in the labyrinth, looking for a way out, meandering in the dark yet still guided toward salvation by His light. And now you're here, Domin'{name}..." {n}She slowly pulls away. Her tender expression gives way to something else: pain, despair.{/n} "Right here, where your blade rested in its sheath, pointless and useless."

ee179bc4-8ce5-4607-b03f-f99472b40054.Text: {n}For a moment, you feel as if your bones are going to crack from the intensity of Kibellah's embrace. She catches herself and relaxes her hands, sliding them up and down your body in a bashful caress.{/n}

4738a407-5298-4fff-9a89-0e60da1eedfd.Text: {n}Kibellah's eyes glisten, and she quickly lowers her gaze. She steps closer, carefully touching you, as trying to confirm that you are not merely a figment of her despondent mind.{/n}

afacd2dd-da07-489f-b77c-4b24d1e750b0.Text: "Your silence is worse than any accusation, Domin'{name}. I deserve as much." {n}Kibellah closes her eyes. Her fingers begin to twitch.{/n}

9da8b4c0-b236-497d-a836-bed4d480fbdd.Text: {n}She lowers her eyes, her gaze bleak.{/n} "I have broken my oath. I let your foes prevail."

87672fb5-51b1-4b0b-bb73-56f71da205dc.Text: {n}Her fingers curl into fists.{/n} "The Undying One is giving me His signs! He must have warned me, but I failed to see!"

7bf307b7-1a3c-415e-b101-89316d84d350.Text: {n}Kibellah clenches her fists, her knuckles turning white.{/n} "It does matter. It matters that I, your shadow, your blade, could do nothing to stop the threat."

7c9bd50e-993a-462c-9afa-d5e5cb2e99cf.Text: "I..." {n}Kibellah hesitates a moment before finding the will to speak:{/n} "On the day that you and I bonded in the labyrinth, something upset the order of things. All that the Vizsier taught me, all that makes me what I am — and here we are, reaping the fruits of my irresolution, my weakness. Naught but His providence saved you from falling to an unrighteous death."

fd335ec0-ab82-4d42-b970-bec186c4ec5c.Text: {n}Kibellah looks at you without blinking.{/n} "The Tenets demand irreproachable service. Only thus are we able to read hearts and to see threads. The Bloodspun Web will not accept a failure."

39a60192-879b-45ff-acdc-b7a65944ae1f.Text: {n}Kibellah goes still... and then, as if coming to a decision, she looks away and nods firmly.{/n} "Your reproach is just. And that is why I must let you go. Everything that is preventing me from following the thread of the Web will be excised from my heart and mind. Thank you for pointing me toward the solution, Domin'{name}." {n}She bows and walks away.{/n}

f44f4ed9-e36c-4f13-ab73-865ffec2ead6.Text: {n}Kibellah winces painfully.{/n} "Yes. All fault must be erased."

309eee36-d4e9-40a6-907d-4a4818528890.Text: {n}Kibellah lets out a bitter chuckle.{/n} "Together? You have no notion of what it's like when errant thoughts and emotions obscure your inner sight. Your world is... full of transitory passions. It is woven from them. It lives through them, without having to care about any thread other than your own, including mine."

1f1636f0-1639-43b6-bd0f-18bc336b6d4d.Text: "Perhaps our bond is not as heavy a burden on your heart as it is on mine, Domin'{name}..." {n}Kibellah licks her lips as they curl into a malicious smile.{/n} "After all, I'm not the only one you have bonded with."

9cb5c6de-3561-49ee-9d27-7803d45038d0.Text: "Vil'Yrliet is a spawn of heresy, and yet you act as if you and the xenos are close... This perversion born of whim, this unnatural tolerance... I fail to understand — is it the Aeldari's doing, or a shortcoming of your own soul?"

71a39fc0-0a56-4eaf-a209-72c3839430e0.Text: "Yes, I am. And that is the very downfall I am facing. Do you not understand what I'm telling you? Can you even understand? Are you as devoted to your thread as I am to mine?" {n}Kibellah narrows her eyes, studying you.{/n}

f181ced9-1cb9-4b90-a43d-0c2e2c23e9da.Text: {n}Kibellah speaks in the cold voice of a spinner of death:{/n} "The Web demands that we create a distance between us. I cannot be your blade so long as thoughts and worries of another kind shroud my path through the labyrinth." {n}Despite her tone and her words, you see longing in her eyes. And a glimmer of... hope?{/n}

d8f7426d-3bdf-48e3-9323-8da534e711c5.Text: {n}Kibellah looks at you with no expression whatever, save for a thin line that forms briefly at the corner of her mouth: a stifled grimace of vexation.{/n}

0dac70af-5ea1-403d-a209-c55377b5ecff.Text: {n}Kibellah squeezes her eyes shut.{/n} "I was hoping... that you would be stronger than me..." {n}She sobs, as if buckling under the weight of decision that has been thrust upon her.{/n} "The Web demands a sacrifice that I can't bring myself to give..."

a8ff68a3-301f-4b72-bfa3-a6ba9c104db1.Text: {n}A single touch shatters Kibellah's facade of cold aloofness. She lets out a painful moan and interweaves her fingers with yours.{/n} "Domin'{name}... I was hoping you'd be stronger than me..."

a4d0a8d2-345d-407e-a1d2-80a40b43185d.Text: {n}A light sigh escapes her lips. She closes her eyes for a moment, and when she opens them again, you see a crimson flash of resolve within.{/n} "So be it, Domin'{name}."

99cdd853-dc8e-458a-baec-1b911616b4a1.Text: "I... I need to be alone — to understand who I am... with you. Perhaps I should try on a different mask for a time and see how well it fits me." {n}Kibellah falls silent. Slowly, as if pushing through water, she withdraws from you and turns away.{/n}

9b659c24-db9b-40c7-855f-dcb8862bf8af.Text: "Your desire is boundless. What can I do to match it? I intend to find out..."

ad31ed9d-0a9e-485e-9593-3e9c8501b43e.Text: "We must return to the world of reality, but... how I wish I could stay here with you a little longer..."

60f30137-acb5-4ee8-8626-b061bb0b2d59.Text: "Ha. So, sitting on your throne has not cost you your flexibility... That is a welcome discovery."

07e201ae-16da-4388-9e69-5e1edf8f25cf.Text: "I could watch you like this forever, swathed in the bliss of passion's wake..."

0d9659ad-f1d9-4f4c-95bf-0534942e00ed.Text: "You are... different in intimacy from what I expected. I am discovering new sides to you..."

b2d5278f-dd45-4c73-a5f5-d0e9a34b0ebe.Text: "I will accept you regardless of whom you decide to be. No one can make that decision for you."

fcab4e8b-8c98-44a2-9a3d-c01fae0de9c8.Text: [Ignore her behaviour and continue your dinner]

47bb1c61-8c3e-405b-9bc3-d4879ee7fb98.Text: "Care to explain that scene back there?"

47f52e66-15af-4e51-b613-6cc12adeaadb.Text: "Be very careful with what you say."

e0513645-b7f2-401c-9303-48f5a3f61b41.Text: [Hiss under your breath] "Your life is forfeit, you cur."

04e7b771-99d1-4d27-a025-bb2cfe6f1fc2.Text: "I believe it does, yes. I only hope that you genuinely feel comfortable in this role."

307fc841-8d51-4ede-9dd7-bc91ddfd3b4a.Text: "Finally, you have stopped embarrassing me in public. That's something I can't complain about."

1d73cbb8-8d76-4b5f-84c5-f3f8cf7ceb81.Text: "I am the {mf|master|mistress} of this planet! You should save your thanks for me!"

db483f22-1caf-457e-a40b-6030a5ce52fa.Text: "It looked as if you were being coquettish with the master of ceremonies."

4a0aa413-93c1-4330-95a6-faf7830743eb.Text: "You are acting strangely. It worries me."

ba43799e-fcd3-4958-8ae2-deadd05225dc.Text: "This enthusiasm for social occasions is... unexpected, Kibellah."

a4f5ae42-5e68-417a-a2ec-0f7b91e85d70.Text: "I simply marvel at the change. I am glad that you have found a way to enjoy the pastimes that are customary to my peers."

5fae6c14-cca9-461f-8b9d-6e0756d58593.Text: "I liked you the way you were before."

e844ed9f-fc50-4bdf-a60b-a91abe33e9cd.Text: "It is as if you were someone else, as if the real you had hidden herself away from me."

1412920a-4d3b-46e0-9e06-470ee8594f94.Text: "I was surprised when I heard you had voiced a desire to make another appearance."

dc3ea2dc-9e31-4b60-b0f9-9bfe9a1a20db.Text: "It's enough to make your head spin, isn't it?"

6e5f9f3e-eb5e-43dd-a5f2-740ceba21b87.Text: "You should get some rest. Let's end the evening here."

eb73d4a6-7c88-4e68-b089-e2c26ea56593.Text: "Stay with me tonight. We have the whole palace to ourselves..."

b0d34788-5d01-4ce4-8465-debc33525e4c.Text: "What has happened to you? What is this bizarre transformation?"

b148b35d-3953-416e-aa39-0e3f026b152c.Text: "You are right. My servants have earned a great deal of praise."

8c57cc3f-a095-4ee7-9d65-28d6d436d184.Text: [Lower your voice] "I enjoy watching you toy with these enraptured fools. Do go on."

311c896f-9a61-45c0-af5e-db7da6e50b9f.Text: "No! No, I need the real you, not a blade!"

8143b9f9-dc76-4fdb-a76c-be727b4b9cf0.Text: "You are beautiful in your desire to cast aside your humanity for the sake of perfection. You wish to be perfect? Then be perfect with me."

c90bf8b8-ec17-4614-ac25-ce2790e751ab.Text: "No. I am tired of your emotional tribulations. It's over between us."

b341bdb3-afaf-4600-8462-c459d0c664e2.Text: [Touch Kibellah's hand] "Come back to me. Please."

e5582c55-ce48-4f92-bcb3-861ca6293366.Text: [Smile] "It appears you have managed to avoid terrifying my subjects with your very presence this time."

d93a7dc8-a5a4-4708-ac9d-4a31ba5192d8.Text: {n}Something has changed in Kibellah. As she stands next to you, you take in her posture, her movements, her gestures. Every detail in her appearance is different in some way. She has chosen to forgo the regalia of the Bloodspun Web on this occasion, and neither does she emanate an aura of frightening lethality. She casts an eye over the space prepared for you, then glances at the master of ceremonies. With a languid drawl, she says,{/n} "I must give credit to your subjects, Domin'{name} — their eagerness to satisfy your wishes is enough to melt one's heart."

d9bafedb-e8dc-419f-89e1-83fa97425458.Text: {n}The noise of the hive reaches the balcony as nothing more than a steady hum, like the rumbling of a distant ocean. The beautiful decorations and fine delicacies before you could easily make one forget the rot and suffering that permeate the sprawling city below.{/n}

3d9383c1-112d-422d-9493-84c759e0b5f8.Text: {n}A tangled network of streets and bridges — the main hive — spreads far below. The people buzzing about in lit areas seem no larger than gnats at this distance.{/n}

e2b16d06-f5a9-4a84-b92e-595a50fb9eb5.Text: {n}The master of ceremonies adjusts his attire and gives you both a ridiculous smile, seemingly hypnotised by the sound of Kibellah's voice.{/n} "A— anything to please {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship} and {mf|his|her} lovely companion..."

e98b518b-7441-4c2b-ae1f-0efbbae9e7a1.Text: "Thank you... for everything." {n}Kibellah laughs awkwardly.{/n} "I think I've had enough of your world's rituals for now. I guess I can't see any of them through to their appropriate conclusion..."

59939bab-a0b5-4139-ab63-27f325f6c69c.Text: {n}Kibellah pulls you to herself.{/n} "Let's go. I want to leave this stage overlooking a whole world. I want to be alone with you — to be... true with you as never before."

99656a71-9a9e-4abc-8c14-f294ccc5cebe.Text: "I merely wanted to offer my gratitude to your subjects, Domin'{name}. I had to express my appreciation for all this, at least." {n}She gestures at the decorations and the food.{/n} "Or should I be thanking you for doing all this with your own bare hands?"

34323eb3-fc0e-45aa-83e3-59dbed6c602c.Text: "I am absolutely delighted." {n}She sips her drink.{/n} "Last time, I failed to grasp the sheer beauty of moving in the highest circles, Domin'{name}. I appreciate that you have arranged this evening for me — my second chance. I do hope that my demeanour suits the expectations of your inner circle better this time."

b4ea9b77-655e-4733-aec4-aa9f721c7777.Text: {n}He stops abruptly. Lacking any better option, he bends into a particularly servile bow, then backs away, clearly wishing he could turn himself invisible.{/n}

0e4eaad8-4f64-470a-99ef-51430d87ec15.Text: "You are so tense, Domin'{name}. Come, a glass of wine will help you relax."

75e637de-67b9-4da1-9fae-730f2261c377.Text: "—the greatest reward," {n}he finishes awkwardly. He glances at you with a more sober look in his eyes, bows quickly, and hurries off into the shadows.{/n}

ddfb1ecc-79e2-4f89-b81d-9496d244c647.Text: {n}Kibellah's manners are impeccable — one can only wonder where this artful mastery of social customs came from. She glances at you as she lifts her glass.{/n}

315e723e-5ad8-4691-83e1-d3d6bf27c647.Text: "—for humble servants who bask in the radiance of your attention." {n}He bows and scrapes before retreating with an overly courteous expression.{/n}

9df5e3af-ffab-4ebd-8fd9-481a069b1c14.Text: {n}Kibellah looks at you, casually swirling the wine in her glass. Her gaze is suddenly clear. Without taking her eyes off you, she pours the wine on the floor and sets the glass on the table.{/n} "Well, thank you for showing me who you truly are. It is... an impressive feat for somebody of your status." {n}She stands up.{/n} "Thank you also for solving a dilemma you were not even aware of. And now... I must return to my thread."

8a161cb6-573e-4163-b1ab-34e1bcd9cb67.Text: "My desire to appear among the people in your circle surprises you, Domin'{name}? How so? Does it not please you that I wish to be part of your world, embrace it, surrender to it? I was rather... graceless on my first excursion out into the upper class. But that will not happen again."

82f105e8-768d-426f-ace3-2a459eeefd64.Text: {n}You hear a murmur of adoration from all around you.{/n}

589283f0-8001-4157-9f11-b865c86c64da.Text: {n}Kibellah gives you an affectionate smile.{/n} "It is the least I could do to thank you for introducing me to it."

b8549df6-b404-4fd1-b958-8a1bc55e23de.Text: {n}Kibellah lets out a soft laugh.{/n} "Time. Time flows on, changing everything it touches. Now is our chance to stop clinging to the past and let the inevitable take its course."

12d4e2ce-1415-43fe-b96b-b77a7fe47d8e.Text: {n}Something inside Kibellah, in her momentarily unmoving gaze, flinches — but then immediately disappears again behind the veil of courtliness.{/n} "We all have our parts to play, Domin'{name}. The truth oftentimes lies deeper than where our eyes and ears can reach."

a1b80347-7ffb-47af-bf65-b56f1bbd61a1.Text: "The better I understand the world you live in, Domin'{name}, the better a shadow I can be for you..."

7af1e860-4702-40b4-9bcb-2f67a5bc383d.Text: {n}The servants and junior officers stand at attention. It seems that Kibellah's newfound parlour confidence has made a strong impression on them — all eyes are on her, as though she were emitting some form of invisible yet deeply alluring glow.{/n}

fd755963-7343-4aff-b0c6-61623bdd9c0d.Text: "...and the finer blade I can be in the hand of the Undying One's servant." {n}Kibellah lowers her head and remains motionless for a few moments.{/n}

1817e717-0078-4cf9-b67f-c8da4fd612e6.Text: {n}Kibellah stares past the balustrade with wide eyes, seemingly mesmerised by the view, by the great, beckoning fall. She leans forward... and then clutches the handrail so tightly her knuckles turn white, gasping in wonder.{/n}

10fbec65-6b62-4924-aaed-ac26977d1683.Text: "I am your blade. I am your shield. And today, here and now, I vow to do whatever it takes to become the perfect weapon in your hands. Already, I am changing, Domin'{name}..." {n}She looks at you with burning eyes.{/n} "Tell me: does this Kibellah please you?"

82c6b352-b366-450e-81b1-46fd422d3cb2.Text: {n}She cradles her face in her hands and stares out beyond the precipice once more.{/n} "When standing eye to eye with their fear, one can see their true desire. Mine is to be somebody who pleases you. I wish I could break every bone in my body just so I might build myself back up and become someone who truly deserves you. Today, I have tried on a mask — the same mask worn by those who spend their entire life in your presence..."

ba31ecb1-23a8-47c3-ad5b-9e1855285bdb.Text: "I've never..." {n}Another stifled gasp. Then a laugh.{/n} "I have never seen such heights before in my life. No distance on the ship comes close to this. I feel like this emptiness might swallow me whole..." {n}Kibellah turns to you and smiles, this time sincerely.{/n} "It's beautiful."

24f458f9-8dd5-484a-937b-8ac0e501ea83.Text: {n}She reaches out a hand to you and gently touches your cheek, her fingertips sliding down your skin.{/n} "With you, I feel... different. Nothing like how the Tenets say I must. There is so much more to life than my clan's deck..." {n}Her gaze goes blank.{/n} "And discovering it has unravelled my world."

4f3f025c-1d09-49e5-bfdf-82a0b85dbbd6.Text: {n}She lowers her head.{/n} "It is so strange to hear the Domin give me a choice... And yet I fear that such a choice might burden my soul too heavily in His eyes."

2c17cecd-6fb5-4685-abc9-59b448291b90.Text: {n}Kibellah closes her eyes.{/n} "Perfection..." {n}She turns to gaze at the streets below.{/n} "All this time, I thought that the teachings of the Web were a blessing bestowed upon me so that I, its most devoted servant, might achieve such perfection. But only here, now... looking down upon the world..."

0cd5d03f-f531-4807-b8a3-ee3103029d6e.Text: {n}Her whisper, barely audible, is filled with dark pride.{/n} "You and I, we are different from those down below. We are free to choose our own path. And if I have to break some antiquated code to become perfect... No, I won't leave the cult — but neither will I abide by its limitations."

3c97df10-538e-4cb1-ac52-ff2e3b9fe7e8.Text: {n}Kibellah raises her chin, her eyes wide, and pierces you with her glare. The corner of her mouth twitches, baring her teeth in a crooked smile.{/n} "I see... Your wish is my command, Domin'{name}. I return to where I belong, and leave you standing here at the top... alone."

a3e6ad1c-8064-4d14-bb20-cf13729f8126.Text: {n}When she looks at you again, her eyes are glassy, suggesting that all her thoughts are now turned inward. She resembles an empty shell, governed by a mere fraction of her mind, while the rest of it eludes your sight. You notice that her hand that is lying on the table is not completely still: her finger, with subtle twitches, is tracing a familiar pattern...{/n}

9500cfde-b77d-4074-acbf-cfa4f31ea08e.Text: {n}She tilts her head to the side.{/n} "I am searching for answers in the same place where I have always found them." {n}She drops her gaze with an expression that invites no further conversation.{/n}

91c0df23-76f4-4f1c-8bf2-1511a498bc07.Text: {n}Kibellah does not look at you directly. Instead, she merely shoots you passing glances, as if she is not quite here. Her lips, however, bear a pleasant smile.{/n} "To me? Nothing unacceptable for the present circumstances."

3dee90e2-4453-4cd5-b3c0-119ca88aba69.Text: {n}Kibellah jerks her hand back, quickly and nervously.{/n} "What do you mean? I am here, with you. Where else could I be?"

9934a311-2ac3-4111-90ae-9a0ca94484d7.Text: {n}Several long minutes pass. In the suffocating silence, Kibellah's aloofness becomes all the more disturbing. Finally, she takes a sip from her glass and says in a suave voice,{/n} "The hour is getting late. Could you please show me a view of the hive? I would like to see your domain."

66f39539-61a4-4f4f-a761-b4f4449f80a1.Text: {n}Kibellah recoils in confusion.{/n} "But... the Tenets... What about... I've tried so hard..." {n}She freezes, tears glistening in her eyes.{/n} "I thought... it's what you needed the most... But the real me? How can I alone ever be enough for you?" {n}She trails off, unable to meet your gaze, but her hand finds yours and grasps it desperately.{/n}

fb462ec5-1d7a-4ea0-8401-77f73de7e955.Text: {n}Kibellah looks at you closely. Instead of speaking, she clings to you and gives you a long, breathtaking kiss filled with sincere warmth. When eventually she pulls away, she gingerly touches your cheek with her fingers.{/n}

6e56a75f-fcb0-4f21-9072-d2b76b7eb29f.Text: "I am a spinner of the Bloodspun Web. We know how to tread silently, how to be invisible... how to wear other people's masks. The guises of your subjects... are not particularly subtle. Their courtly sheen, too, conceals the faces of predators and killers, does it not? I had little difficulty inventing such a mask for myself."

2ea7712d-10e0-4eb4-84c2-d795675c65ae.Text: {n}Kibellah smiles with just the corner of her mouth.{/n} "Did it, now? Is that not what people of your standing engage in — a game of insinuation, casual glances, ambiguous smiles, unspoken promises? If you read my words and gestures as truthful, you were mistaken. I am here with you and you alone."

a2a66072-d4cb-4769-b837-c11786acd793.Text: {n}Kibellah shakes her head.{/n} "When I was not 'strange,' I was mocked. Would you not prefer someone with more tact and propriety by your side?"

cfbaf065-9270-4ffd-a9f3-ae17a5e2d245.Text: "Comfort was never something I aspired to earn, or was even taught. It has no bearing on my choice of thread."

939d9906-23fd-4584-b7cb-200e2494c75f.Text: "I can still do just that, Domin'{name}. You had better choose your next words carefully." {n}Kibellah shakes her glass slightly as if threatening to drop it.{/n}

b74ca4a5-7922-4453-8955-ec86b07273df.Text: "Besides, does it matter what mask one wears? Any mask can be refashioned, moulded into a perfect fit..." {n}Kibellah closes her eyes and goes still. She seems almost like a broken toy.{/n}

4075a95b-1962-4a78-a8e4-c41264aef39c.Text: {n}Instead of responding, Kibellah lowers her eyelashes and smiles with the corners of her mouth. A hard furrow on her cheek betrays the delight she takes in the predatory little game she is playing with your subjects.{/n}

747be435-2ec4-4af4-814a-254e53a4baf3.Text: {n}You remember Kibellah as she was at the first event organised by the High Factotum. Somehow, her former outlandishness has completely vanished, as if she had spent her whole life attending only the most lavish receptions and enjoying the high society of the upper decks. She even looks like she is actually enjoying all the attention.{/n}

23ff1a7c-5000-42b2-99d5-54b44094befe.Text: {n}Kibellah casts you a look.{/n} "Well, then... shall we?"

495368d2-1eef-4310-b8cb-548672517a19.Text: {n}Kibellah casts one more look at the man.{/n} "Thank you. You truly have gone above and beyond to impress your {mf|lord|lady}."

000e97aa-e6bd-4e84-b901-00926ec1e090.Text: {n}The master of ceremonies seems to have forgotten about your presence entirely as he gives your companion his undivided attention.{/n} "Why, Mistress Kibellah, your praise is the greatest reward—"

919d3292-b761-466e-b5e7-c884aae7f446.Text: {n}Ever since you sat down at the table, Kibellah's gaze has been directed past you. Her newly discovered manners are just as refined as before, while suddenly resembling the movements of a marionette.{/n}

2362c8cd-7ec1-4bc9-8b24-89e4867ffd8e.Text: {n}Kibellah smiles as tears begin to drip from her lashes.{/n} "And there's the answer... as I knew it would be. The labyrinth does not hold the keys to every mystery — some must be found in other people. In you. You are my answer and my blessing... The blessing to be myself."

8e1ac622-5f28-4d38-aeaf-6a52d96513ef.Text: "Be that as it may, I will have no part in this enterprise."

b60e5386-d0d2-4db1-92a1-cc83a1bfe00e.Text: "I do not think this is such a good idea..."

f8ea2199-ac96-4cc1-bf9a-821da214ed87.Text: "What? Kibellah herself wants you to organise another event?"

240401bf-fac1-4676-80e9-74f82bd0fc63.Text: "Well, then. Let us enjoy one more moment of leisure."

f3932e52-1fec-4e79-8b8c-d8316a880f80.Text: "I am sick and tired of her quirks. I will not waste any more of my time on them."

94745573-15bf-4160-b67a-da80ac0cb08f.Text: "If she dislikes my orders so much, then she can go back to the lower decks. My decision stands."

ecdf714d-3f99-48da-9d96-f660430f6088.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!" {n}Judging from his tone, Danrok is practically bursting with hidden enthusiasm.{/n} "I humbly apologise for distracting you from matters of the protectorate, but I simply must beg for a moment of your time. After all, this concerns the illustrious Mistress Kibellah!"

86080527-50e1-4c76-8e61-08b3d221ba92.Text: "Doubtless, it has not escaped your powers of insight that she has been... rather not herself lately. Truly, Mistress Kibellah's soul is a tenebrous place, but even I noticed the change in her bearing. When I finally had a spare moment to think on what could be done to address this, it dawned on me: another social occasion! I daresay the first one went rather well, did it not?"

66a0188f-ae81-490e-9f33-6e956dfbdd92.Text: "On the contrary, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! I approached Mistress Kibellah with a conversation, and she herself suggested that a repeat event would be appropriate and even desirable!"

e54549b3-7c3a-4ee0-ad1f-91326ce2e351.Text: "Precisely! I was somewhat flabbergasted at the proposal, I must admit, but if such is Mistress Kibellah's wish, how can I not try to please both of you once more?"

9e73d39b-da15-4c36-a8be-718b0c994bee.Text: "Marvellous! I already have some ideas in mind... This time, a more private engagement on Dargonus, with a view from the spire! I shall begin the preparations as soon as we arrive on the capital world. When you are ready, just find me at the palace — and this most pleasant evening can commence!"

cd07c1c4-a588-4cbf-854c-b51f45d97d39.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! My apologies if I have incurred your displeasure by approaching you at a bad time! But, ahem... do you not think that such a harsh refusal might push Mistress Kibellah away? She has been looking rather... lost, as of late. Are you certain your decision might not cause her to withdraw from the world entirely?"

96bc234f-3e8c-428d-9763-ef346ae78c2f.Text: "Oh... Yes, certainly, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I will... deliver your response to Mistress Kibellah. I dare not disturb you further."

2959814b-5988-4de8-bd8f-f29fe1d5ccc7.Text: "Not yet. I must take care of something first."

53024c44-3843-45c6-a4f0-fb7ce163fcfd.Text: {n}Janris Danrok squares his shoulders as you approach and gives you a dazzling smile.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Would you like to give the order to begin your enchanting meeting with Mistress Kibellah?"

41ff364a-8b2a-4fe7-a34f-cb17f3903612.Text: "Fabulous! I shall see to all the arrangements. There will be a short wait, but I assure you: both you and your companion will find this evening unforgettable!"

62ce610d-bb4c-4ce4-b7df-e57e70a44e81.Text: "I will forever treasure the memory of the day I first saw you. You too have opened up a new world to me."

a308704b-7308-4ee8-ab31-3967ebd16507.Text: "I knew I had stirred something in your soul — back then, on our first evening."

eb0ab74c-52d4-44c2-8d03-6d552f366e84.Text: "Can't we just... forget about the labyrinth?"

1551d532-f65f-4bc4-93e7-1d3115047a87.Text: [Enter the labyrinth] "Well, then. Follow the sound of my words."

cf99dfc2-6d5b-4e20-ad6d-06f2543a0ccf.Text: "You heard me! I've had it with your 'Tenets' and 'Webs' — and with the rest of your heresy too!"

58ddf30f-4a63-46c9-8d60-4a48899e1317.Text: [Pause] "I was startled and misspoke. I am sorry. What were you saying?"

9e52afbc-d939-4ee1-b735-73bc6ad8d361.Text: [Guide Kibellah through the labyrinth without breaking its rules]

27a6ceca-fa2f-47a2-8352-ee4c538b13ad.Text: [Find a way for Kibellah to pass between the lines of the labyrinth] "We don't always have to play by the rules, do we?"

96ff0056-8620-4669-813f-d64668906f82.Text: [Sing] "Follow my song, Kibellah. I sing of you."

de56fce3-1b6d-4420-bd5a-9b36d750bdf6.Text: [Pray] "Follow my prayer. I pray for you."

92cbe48a-19db-43b2-a999-ecf6bae43b1e.Text: "Don't torment yourself. Go back to your world. We might be far from one another, but our love will live on."

70c8d7e7-9e56-4adf-ab9b-e2271f212b12.Text: "We will find a way to be together. However different our worlds may be, we can overcome any obstacle."

c9e7bdad-62cc-41e2-99c9-88ad4a80a26f.Text: "I am glad to see you have realised your... potential."

ed288518-e0ce-4640-bea4-09b64c6cb980.Text: "But I know nothing about the Grace of the Web..."

c3694ef6-ff35-45cd-ada1-5deea1402953.Text: [Gesture at the lines on the floor] "What happens to it now?"

3e9b9d9a-c766-43c4-a9b6-4ddfc4fe20a1.Text: "We are out of the labyrinth. A new eternity awaits."

c4fd56d7-b07c-4654-8b26-fdf59f1ca297.Text: {n}Your chambers have undergone a profound transformation: familiar patterns stretch from the entrance all the way to the far end of the hall, forming an intricate maze. Its passages meet and diverge, all of them blending together in an almost hypnotic experience, and the aroma of sacred unguents tickles your nostrils.{/n}

b7aaf654-704c-43a0-a46d-242d80e2ed2a.Text: {n}Kibellah looks rather out of place in the soft gloom of the chambers — a thin, angular tendril, an intruder in a realm of soothing shadows.{/n} "Domin'{name}, it's time we left the labyrinth."

3ede9105-7681-46b9-8ee0-bc60ede256b9.Text: "The end of one road. The beginning of a new one. I wandered in the labyrinth looking for answers, but all I did was confuse myself. The solution... was you. Now, we must find our way out of the place I've led us to, but I no longer trust myself to do it. I know the maze too well. It's too... familiar. You will be my guide."

741b236d-652e-4197-b9c9-f545c691336a.Text: "Can you truly read my soul so easily, Domin'{name}? Or are you just showing off in front of the one who trusts you?" {n}She laughs softly.{/n}

b7dec33d-b0ee-41c8-be60-330c3324f501.Text: "Ever since you appeared in my life, I've been looking for a way out of what my existence has become." {n}Kibellah sighs and smiles gently at you.{/n} "And I've realised...
