I can't do it alone. This time, you will be my guide. Please... take me out of this labyrinth. When we're free of this trap I've lead us into... we can look at what the future holds."

a6196ffd-9102-41e8-bd34-fefbddc80a84.Text: {n}Kibellah laughs quietly. It sounds like a mix of purr and growl.{/n} "This maze... I want to leave it behind — to go beyond these constraints that have become too limiting for me, for both of us. Come with me. Our new life cannot begin while our shadows still thrash within the walls of the trap I've lead us into."

eb50b996-e283-4e79-a56b-7be2dabed7b4.Text: {n}Kibellah falls still as a statue.{/n} "What? But, Domin'{name}..."

7f5074b4-23a8-4efa-a98f-156ef4a07626.Text: "An eternity in the embrace of that which will welcome us both."

02558425-1c57-40cb-813a-0dd1c08ed63e.Text: {n}She gestures to the maze instead of answering.{/n}

42913b4f-42a1-4076-b9dc-3ea3ed1bff88.Text: {n}Kibellah lets out a piercing cry. She clutches her throat as if suffocating — or as if trying to suffocate the urge to attack. She arches her back... and before you can blink, she is gone.{/n}

63310ad2-76df-4745-a67e-666ed1568895.Text: {n}You take a step, and Kibellah echoes it, entering the tangled web with you. You notice a set of tiny stitches on her closed eyelids. She is relying on her hearing to walk, having completely entrusted herself to your will.{/n}

96f0332d-94b5-4ac6-ada0-6c70435be871.Text: "When I first set foot on the upper decks... first entered your world... I was blinded. The brilliance of your realm felt overwhelming, and the longer I stayed at your side, the stronger the confusion grew. The thread of the Web was slipping away from under my feet. I was losing my purpose. And yet... I kept on searching. I knew that I didn't have to give up on my past to take the plunge into the future."

0854d7e2-48ee-480e-b915-2d6f9432c021.Text: "When I first stepped into your world, it blinded me, and so I clung to my mask of calm focus. Any other spinner in my place would have been overwhelmed by what I saw in your realm. When thoughts of you began to cloud my mind and steer me away from the Tenets, I noticed it happening. Our bond is steadily cutting the threads between me and my purpose."

8dcb7c8a-61b3-482d-a0a1-e8b8f269cd09.Text: "When I set foot in your world, a world of bliss and luxury, I was still bound by oaths and teachings..." {n}She steps forward with the grace of a stalking predator.{/n} "By everything that the Bloodspun Web encapsulates. I needed time to realise that such bonds were not for me. They are meant for those who fear people like us — people who stand above them, who are stronger than they are. I will not be compared to those miserable creatures."

10611e91-cc0a-41b4-9a5a-03a9b07f199d.Text: {n}You guide Kibellah through the maze, away from the centre, and closer and closer to the exit. Her movements are precise, and she carefully follows your every instruction.{/n}

f4275959-952e-42d7-9ae0-3aabccb05c6d.Text: {n}You notice a tiny break in a line — perhaps Kibellah's hand flinched as she was drawing it. You guide her down that path and tell her where to tread next.{/n}

84b0d9ca-6acf-43f4-a963-b03cb18772f3.Text: {n}The corridors weave and join, cross and branch, in an attempt to confuse all who wander them. The odour wafting from the lines on the floor makes your head swim.{/n}

fb815438-94de-4322-81ab-1322f231ef84.Text: "The Tenets of the Bloodspun Web are my whole world, but to you, my reality is as strange and foreign as the upper decks are to a spinner. When I realised this... after you had carefully guided me, letting me find a new thread, without intervening, without pressure... I saw the beginning of it: the Grace of the Web — a teaching that the Vizsier did not know about. This teaching is mine. And yours."

86eb81d9-72d5-438a-9f6a-c26c2ab4c735.Text: "I searched long... I tried on different masks... I struggled to find a new thread, one that would accept you without repulsing me. But here's the truth: I am my own past. The Bloodspun Web is my home and my destiny. It is everything I know about the universe... and I'm not ready to leave it behind. If I did, your Kibellah would disappear. The web stretches through me, feeding my soul and mind. And so it will always be."

a52bc3d3-314c-4f29-b948-1267e92150d7.Text: "It was a struggle to finally see the power I hold in my hands. I am no mere spinner: I am the best of them, the chosen one. I have the right and the will to lay down the rules. I am strong enough to walk upon the Web without being edified by he who has already joined the Undying One!"

1d191708-9642-42f4-9bf8-3bcc7f16d59e.Text: {n}The moment you start singing, Kibellah joins you, like an echo of your every note. Your voices flow in a duet as you guide Kibellah toward the exit...{/n}

6c4de5c6-11a6-47c8-8d00-69c3bbc4e90e.Text: {n}She recognises the prayer and immediately joins you. She recites the familiar words, merging with you in a single plea to the Undying One, and confidently steps in the direction of the exit...{/n}

8d8fa68a-594c-44c6-a282-a9ddb9f17e68.Text: {n}Together, the two of you emerge from the twisted maze. Kibellah's hands dart to touch yours, her fingers interweaving with your own in a silent greeting — then, she withdraws her hands and lifts them up to her face. A dagger flashes in the dim light, cutting the delicate stitches. Kibellah looks at you with new eyes.{/n} "My love..."

c7dbf405-86c6-457c-a447-9bcf9ebe32c5.Text: {n}Kibellah slowly lowers her head. A stifled, painful sob rises from her very core.{/n} "I accept your decision, Domin'{name}." {n}She falls silent again, waiting to hear your guiding voice.{/n}

b8ffa971-a104-407a-8028-c0006efb758c.Text: {n}You listen to the comforting sound of running water. For a moment, a horrific scene surfaces in your mind: blood pouring from the pipes in a drowning torrent... but the image is dispelled by Kibellah's touch. She is warm. Alive. And so close.{/n}

5f7fc13c-bfda-4932-b760-12e37fceb21f.Text: "The Tenets are impermanent." {n}Kibellah's voice is barely louder than the water.{/n} "Death is the end of all, and even they cannot avoid that end. Their time has come."

20a806b7-ec7f-4bbf-a101-58eeade9ed83.Text: "May these waters mend the mistakes of the lost." {n}Kibellah presses a hand to her chest, staring at the rippling surface.{/n} "May they wash away the missteps, cleanse the soiled hands, clear the clouded mind... and as we wade in, may they grant us the strength to follow our thread."

24afc538-acd9-4124-8101-b6925569d24b.Text: "A pool of clear water is not something one finds in the bowels of a ship..." {n}Kibellah's hand slides down your shoulder, pulling you closer.{/n} "Today, we can allow ourselves a little... relief. Forget all about the Tenets and the Bloodspun Web... Although, who knows — perhaps my apprentices would benefit from a lesson in pleasure. Perhaps their mistress will teach them one day."

e412010d-eb37-4955-88cb-f383a40b8a4e.Text: {n}She touches your cheek and presses her forehead to yours.{/n} "The union of two. The joining of fates. The interweaving of souls. Thus, the Grace of the Web is born. Our thread. Our world. Our destiny. I love you."

ceef7164-e2cc-42e9-bd11-9b613590e1e1.Text: {n}She raises her head and looks directly at you.{/n} "Always remember, Domin'{name}, that I love you. I will carry this love into the embrace of death when the time comes for me to reach my end. Remember. Remember..."

0b28f57d-e04b-462a-96f7-a54ce5ca59a7.Text: {n}She plants an ardent kiss upon your lips.{/n} "Enough words. Today, we belong only to each other, no one else. Masks, facades... those are things of tomorrow. Not of now. Love me, and only me."

9ecb1798-d0e8-43e2-847b-feac2ccf91a9.Text: "Domin'{name}..." {n}She speaks so tenderly that she loses her breath.{/n} "I would defy the Tenets — no, every law in the Imperium — just for a chance to be happy with you... but I know I won't be." {n}She falls silent, waiting to hear your guiding voice.{/n}

b6669cb9-03a6-4b71-aa38-feef29a85e59.Text: "I can love you still, from the shadows of the web. If that isn't enough for you... I will withdraw into the darkness. I will take our feelings with me and keep them far away from you."

9b1e910f-b941-43e3-b801-971ef6939c63.Text: "Yes, you do. The knowledge lies within — deep in your soul. The Grace of the Web is upon you."

3937527c-4d35-417e-b3f8-c970faa9914b.Text: {n}She laughs.{/n} "And who has been my guiding light? Who has walked me through the darkness to this revelation? Lead me on, then. To freedom. Our freedom. Forever."

6a263bdb-fa0e-4d8b-a1cc-c6245ce1e268.Text: {n}Kibellah laughs with a light-heartedness you have not heard from her before.{/n} "The Tenets of the Web are behind me — so, why think about something that's already gone? Take my hand — let us wash ourselves clean of the ashes of the past and step into the future."

6626f94b-1374-4b5f-be5f-ea691834866e.Text: {n}Kibellah places her hands on your chest.{/n} "Why don't we burn it all down? Walk away from this absurdity and celebrate together. I even have something in mind..."

1ab5572f-8d24-406b-9780-3ab2bbcda42f.Text: {n}Kibellah looks at you, her smile calm and sad.{/n} "We have passed the labyrinth's web. Ahead of us..." {n}Tears glisten in her eyes.{/n} "...are new trials. But I believe that as long as we keep each other in our hearts, we will always prevail. Come, Domin'{name}." {n}She whispers so quietly that you can barely hear her.{/n} "Let's cleanse ourselves before we go back to our threads."

f0f5cab8-7d4a-4612-9174-4d0726d434e9.Text: {n}Her hands wrap around you, joining at the back of your neck. Her lips meet yours, and together you dissolve in the flood of her tenderness and passion as she loses herself in the kiss.{/n} "I love you, {name}. I always will. Until the end of the last star in the dark void."

1d0cae18-a238-4316-a492-b2635a730e9c.Text: "Forever..." {n}Kibellah's expression tenses — she wants to look at you, but she does not lose control.{/n}

ee2cec4b-b257-49db-8b42-d3f263157ed2.Text: {n}She shakes her head.{/n} "I've left too many tracks within its walls. I must complete the journey."

c27a1d64-100b-4210-82e2-34ea9470b1fa.Text: "You were different just now. More... feeling."

52ec2e11-6b3d-4aff-9983-840be34e1b55.Text: "Why should I go on this... journey?"

b27b1778-7e1a-41cf-8015-922a48e0c6a2.Text: "No... enough! Remove the stitches. I want no more of this!"

2520b9e1-8deb-49b8-8369-687d9a173e12.Text: [Take Kibellah's hand and step forward] "I trust you."

0280472c-b9ca-447a-b907-3d1f3666b94a.Text: [Take Kibellah's hand and pull her toward you] "Trust me. Follow me."

1073e7d5-ddcf-4087-ada4-052d49f38531.Text: "It was a difficult experience, but we did it together."

5421d3d0-9824-4030-80b2-99d55e6ca52d.Text: "I would rather not go through something like this again."

f1b62a69-4154-4c7b-88cc-ae1dd355c3ce.Text: "I saw a glowing labyrinth — just like the one you traced on the officers' deck..."

378bec9c-a863-446b-8d50-fff2e6937f9a.Text: [Immerse yourself in the pain of your past and trust Kibellah to guide you]

84e553bf-fc38-426b-858f-c1449cb3ba7b.Text: {n}Kibellah bows her head in a short greeting. Her eyes practically glow with anticipation.{/n} "Within these walls, under the spectral watch of the dead, in the land that our deeds have cleansed of pestilence... I wish to take you on a journey: the ritual of finding light."

8cffbca2-b4a9-4d75-8a62-40bc58f6ed05.Text: {n}She slowly brings a hand to your face and touches the corner of your eye.{/n} "Sight is your ally and your foe, for it exists only to perceive deeds and be oblivious to intentions. I will teach you to see without eyes, Domin'{name}, as I was taught once. Will you permit me to sew your eyes shut and guide you through the ritual, along a thread unseen?"

562f3657-6d1f-4778-9235-2fb4763051a3.Text: {n}Darkness is merciless. You learned this while trying to hide from the {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Signs}nightmares{/d} that torment you. No matter how tightly you shut your eyes on those long nights, the haunting visions would not leave you alone, either in sleep or during waking hours. The moment Kibellah applies the final stitch, you can feel it: the horrors are already here, lying in wait for you to make even a single misstep. And when you do, they will drown you in that merciless darkness.{/n}

98a2b980-e837-4b6c-a920-af6d46c9a069.Text: "No, Domin'{name}. My stitches will be precise and my hand careful. Once you have passed the ritual, I will unseal your eyes, and no harm will have come to you."

00d9c6dd-8aca-4cca-b03b-b20fd674ed6e.Text: {n}Kibellah steps away, her hand sliding off you to hang limply by her side. You barely hear her as she says,{/n} "I understand. Perhaps the distance between us was never meant to be crossed. Go, then."

a220ce8b-4168-4969-99ac-9cd87bc060e9.Text: {n}In the gloom of the crypt, the needle in Kibellah's hands could be mistaken for the flash of one of her blades.{/n} "Close your eyes, Domin'{name}, and humble your breathing in a silent prayer to the Undying One."

0724d5dc-d70c-4a16-828c-0cb31ca40c77.Text: {n}Your eyelids hurt after having been punctured and stitched together with thread. The sensation muddles your thoughts and evokes an eerie dread from the depths of your heart. You are blind. Not a single ray of light can creep into your world, and your only awareness about your immediate surroundings is based on subtle noises. Through the veil of pain, you hear Kibellah's quiet voice:{/n} "We accept His blessings with a single purpose: to serve Him in our unity stronger than any chains. Come to me, Domin'{name}. The sound of my voice will show you the way, if you can unfetter your heart..."

400ef7e1-a2f7-4ab7-8412-e8c594e7c081.Text: {n}She pauses before answering. She moves her hand down, cautiously touching your chest.{/n} "There is... much between us that I have yet to understand. Decks and bulkheads separate us, but greater still is the spiritual distance. You have entered my labyrinth, and I have been to your world. But there is still so much more that we must learn about each other. I am inviting you to walk my paths so that you may see into me. And I into you."

dd14dca3-2c42-4a97-9281-ee20b9fe3062.Text: {n}You push yourself out of the depths of pain, submitting completely to Kibellah's voice. A moment later, it starts to become louder and clearer. The disturbing pain does not disappear, but now you know where to go — and you follow your guide.{/n}

77093c44-2a95-4c55-9f8b-5e25195ff926.Text: {n}The loss of sight must have affected you on a subconscious level. You cannot get the throbbing pain out of your mind. Your legs are shaking... You feel forever lost in the darkness with no way out, other than the faint hope of following the echo of Kibellah's voice.{/n}

ca6d6027-2428-46ef-b273-5c22bbc303a1.Text: {n}You focus all your attention on your physical suffering... and the pain retreats, as if intimidated by your resolve. You take a step and then another.{/n}

7d39a243-fa6c-4ae2-a353-d412699d919d.Text: {n}Suddenly, Kibellah's voice seems to multiply, as if every word were being spoken by several copies of her in unison:{/n} "Along the threads that form the web; along the rays of the star whose heart turns ice into flame; along the tracks we have left for one another, we shall come together in a unity that will become our revelation — in death which grants true sight; in death for which all are fated..." {n}Your knees buckle — the anxiety that has been with you since the beginning of the ritual now clamps around your throat like a collar of steel.{/n}

d0ee3149-125b-40b4-b105-25b4f2394050.Text: "Where the joining of opposites begets a collapse, a collapse that will become an act of creation: from the ruins of meaning, sacred halls will rise, and He will be pleased..." {n}Her tone changes subtly — as if the ritual prayer were somehow transforming into a love song.{/n}

5122e961-aecc-4fc3-b7f3-c2fd839f2a0a.Text: {n}You muster your strength and renounce the phantom terrors. Your weakness forgotten, you follow the guiding thread that shines in your mind — the thread of Kibellah's voice.{/n}

f50cefa5-689a-4719-b3fe-3b207f6c6c3c.Text: {n}You channel your force of will to push the suffocation aside, refusing to let it force you to your knees... and you can almost hear the ringing of metal as the collar around your throat finally loosens. The guiding thread of Kibellah's voice shines on in your mind.{/n}

3c7750f4-d716-4275-98e3-84d5c63f7674.Text: {n}You are powerless before this smothering fear. The anxiety swallows you whole like a wave, and as you are pulled under, you can no longer hear Kibellah's voice for a few long seconds.{/n}

a0896a85-58a0-4eef-ac4f-998c42c81860.Text: "All who rest in these halls do so as a reward for the deeds they performed in His name. May the end of our journey be as glorious as that of all who came before us..." {n}Kibellah trails off. Eventually, she adds, softly and quietly,{/n} "Take my hand. Thus shall we walk into the halls we are destined for."

c0342ce9-0edf-4ceb-be19-74a456c85c52.Text: {n}You feel a slight resistance... but then she lets out a trembling sigh and steps toward you, placing her hand in yours.{/n}

5a299d1d-e3ee-435c-a8e2-56eb147d1db0.Text: {n}A strange sensation comes over you, as if the two of you had found yourselves in a confined space, delirious from the lack of air and intoxicated by each other's warmth. You can see Kibellah — and a maze of dully flickering crimson lines beneath your feet. She exhales,{/n} "It's wrong... It's all wrong..." {n}She squeezes your fingers.{/n} "But I trust you. I'm coming toward you. The distance is fading away."

a1167855-bf50-41b7-a661-06fd4c927bd5.Text: {n}...and you feel the darkness touch you. Directly ahead, you see Kibellah, holding your hand. Her eyes, so full of warmth, are looking at you.{/n} "You've found me... despite everything. Now, dive deeper... immerse yourself in what unites us at this crossroads..."

fe1eafd6-b636-4c98-a64b-b6584ae690d1.Text: {n}...and though your eyes are still blind and your body trembles, you feel warmth — her warmth. Despite everything, you have walked the road of darkness — and reached the one who has been guiding you with her voice. You feel her breath on your neck and hear her words in your ear:{/n} "We've gone deeper. We're closer now. Closer than ever before."

3870c452-8ef1-4ca6-b0af-f1e43a103668.Text: {n}The gloom begins to part as a razor-sharp blade cuts the stitches on your eyelids one by one. You feel gentle touches, your wounds sting a little... and at last, you can see once more. The dim light of the crypt blinds you so badly that Kibellah appears as a faceless dark silhouette before you.{/n}

21861986-d7af-45cb-9313-2447a61272ad.Text: "And once again, you have witnessed my truth, Domin'{name}." {n}Kibellah does not look at you — her gaze seems to be directed inward or, perhaps, nowhere at all.{/n} "Light has been found. We have passed another circle on our way to the truth at the heart of our bond."

8d0c92ea-74bb-4358-8c11-1eac82aedcb8.Text: {n}She touches your cheek with her fingertips.{/n} "No. I should be the one thanking you. Few are worthy of this ritual. I have never performed it for anyone before..." {n}A smile blossoms on her lips.{/n}

34bab3a9-9e99-4154-b93f-5e2544a23831.Text: {n}She looks at you with an elusive smile.{/n} "Yes, we did. That is how the ritual of finding light is performed: not alone, but together, by those who are bound in His light, in His name."

5ffd30f9-9c1d-4c68-9cae-6b915f4dfb13.Text: "There is no need. The ritual is complete. And this experience... do not try to make sense of it — simply accept it, as one would accept death."

2fb68f64-7e0d-4833-87fc-cdceb048cba1.Text: {n}Kibellah takes a deep breath.{/n} "You... saw it? Then you're walking down its winding paths... together with me. You must have truly come to know me if our minds have touched so." {n}She frowns.{/n} "I did not expect your trance to extend so deeply. I... must think about this."

fa351968-98b0-4ecd-ae88-fb7704b23c32.Text: "You must return from death's halls out into the world. And please..." {n}Kibellah presses a hand to your chest.{/n} "All that the ritual has revealed to you — keep it in your heart. It is your treasure alone."

d5bc1884-3740-4eec-b9b0-eafae531f12b.Text: {n}You hear silence... and suddenly the ethereality around you is replaced by something else, something normal. You hear footsteps approaching, then a whisper:{/n} "I'm here. Don't move. Let me take those off."

dca8b725-eca5-42bd-9dc8-f21def998544.Text: {n}You open your eyes and see light once more — and Kibellah, wearing a saddened expression.{/n} "I should not have distracted you from your labours, Domin'{name}. Please... return to your thread. I will think upon all that took place here."

a0eb0363-bf50-4780-a321-9f65e92c0d1f.Text: "We wear masks on our faces, not on our souls." {n}The corners of her mouth twitch.{/n} "I may be a spinner of death, but I'm still a human inside... as are you."

5979f409-e6f5-4ce8-83bd-c53d188b5ea0.Text: {n}A new, unfamiliar pain seeks to consume you, so you find sanctuary in the older, more familiar ache. The torment that you went through in the {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Torture}past{/d}, the torment that could not break you, eases your suffering in the present. You take a step and then another.{/n}

ed48e91f-27e2-4a02-93c9-679601040664.Text: {n}This is not some metaphor. Your {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Psyker}gift{/d} makes it clear that your and Kibellah's minds now share a psychic connection, one that both of you are helping to sustain.{/n}

e46d6dcb-003b-4470-b4d4-99dc4bb8bc07.Text: "Of course. I will be there shortly."

a6add150-2391-409f-a584-6a66d362a73d.Text: {n}Kibellah's voice pulls you from going through a stack of reports.{/n} "Domin'{name}... I wish to see you. Meet me in the sacred crypt, where we destroyed the minions of heresy. It is important."

5b0fa3ae-af11-4b34-b08a-ae6c0abbc702.Text: "There is no threat. I have been granted a revelation, and I wish to show you something. Now that the crypt has been purged, there is no place better suited."

94948e74-1ad4-4862-98e5-1c8678d4a29a.Text: {n}You hear genuine excitement in Kibellah's voice.{/n} "I will be waiting, Domin'{name}."

2c4e82b5-dbc2-46b4-96b6-2d2491576838.Text: {n}The vox is silent for a while save for the crackling of static. Then, Kibellah shuts off the channel without another word.{/n}

7724393b-134d-458e-957a-2ae49e57014d.Text: "We have certainly become closer. This pleases me."

05ac5f73-15b5-4b81-ae0a-f4616256c49d.Text: "I do not want to speak of souls. I simply want to enjoy you and your company."

be4bb1ea-8473-4642-b876-fc5d22e87768.Text: "I did not know physical intimacy held any interest for spinners."

ca75dc52-3f86-450b-b376-456be07b8d40.Text: "I am not certain there will be a second time. That won't affect our relationship, will it?"

fc0f98db-4f80-4cbf-a31c-8d9033b275ae.Text: {n}Kibellah draws a finger across her pale skin, tracing a long, fluid line from the curve of her hip to the sharp ridge of her clavicle, through the pattern of ritual wounds and battle scars.{/n} "We have gained knowledge of one another, {name}. Through the revelation of the flesh, we have spun a stronger spiritual bond between us. Do you feel it?"

3560511c-f5d7-4be0-a2c9-46ad83ac9a0c.Text: "The Bloodspun Web does not encourage the pleasures of the flesh, but nor does it forbid them. A spinner is free to enjoy carnal love, but what draws them to it is usually curiosity rather than passion. Or... a special feeling, a sacred feeling that must not be sacrificed to ascesis."

479d4939-2fe1-402d-849f-0369e64bc7f8.Text: {n}Kibellah shrugs.{/n} "If you feel no desire, do not compel yourself. For now our threads are tied together by invisible bonds — anything else is unimportant."

5f35d7a3-304e-41d0-aac7-e081caf0b9b6.Text: {n}Kibellah's eyes drift closed.{/n} "Yes. It was... a new sensation. Every moment with you was replete with meaning. Empty lust would not grant such depth of feeling."

6d7b7834-68c3-4e66-a8e1-8d68f6e7421c.Text: "I believe this is but the first of many revelations we will receive." {n}She stretches languidly on the bed.{/n} "Each new encounter promises the opportunity to know you better and to... reveal myself to you. We will explore our bodies and souls to attain total unity."

9aa55a24-2375-4a95-ad88-6e75e3c0927d.Text: {n}A wan smile briefly flickers on Kibellah's face.{/n} "Then the shadow will be silent. The Domin's will is law."

94d59a4a-77a1-49fe-9e7d-350390a96696.Text: "And I must spend some time alone. I must traverse the labyrinth with new knowledge... of us."

ebab69d4-e114-4c55-87f7-6b1749c7d981.Text: "I doubt that Kibellah will enjoy this..."

3e6d9a8a-2c77-4a8b-9d5c-f9fe1dcdc4e0.Text: "I have changed my mind: cancel the gathering. Kibellah has no need for such ceremonies."

ae06a004-90ad-447e-b3a5-cdd270191d59.Text: "Very well. Let us show her the world of the Rogue Trader after all."

63cc58e1-3521-4f1f-adb0-37060c71a53c.Text: "Are you arguing with me right now?"

db7b9722-4fa1-4df1-b743-1c68170bfdd2.Text: {n}The High Factotum's voice rings with pride.{/n} "Lord Captain, I have done as commanded: everything has been prepared for your 'ritual' for Mistress Kibellah! A select few upper deck officers are ready to leave their posts to attend this formal gathering and praise Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}'s name. We can begin at your convenience."

1be9276b-046d-4949-bd7d-a2bd13284e54.Text: "I am confident that Mistress Kibellah will appreciate the effort, both yours and mine! What could be more representative of the Lord Captain's inner circle than a formal event in the company of the most eminent members of the crew?"

83bb12df-ffb3-4fb8-af7c-c26681b8cff5.Text: "It will be done. I shall signal the servants and notify the invited parties immediately. Let us demonstrate to Mistress Kibellah just how strong our vessel's spirit of camaraderie truly is!"

bb0b4874-e681-48d1-a901-befb10c2ba36.Text: "But... but the officers' morale! And Mistress Kibellah!"

41a85b1c-9da4-4c8e-b0d6-8fef8672d57d.Text: "A-absolutely not, Lord Captain! I will make no further mention of this matter!"

90790c44-4139-4687-a56f-f63fa275cedf.Text: "What exactly are we going to do?"

ec502f64-2203-4897-a555-8c6a376d7baf.Text: "What is all this on the floor?"

81efc418-79e4-429a-80d2-3b22febe41b1.Text: "I am ready, Kibellah. Let us begin."

ce20e7d7-8eb1-410d-b13d-949c74df215e.Text: "Get on with it. The sooner we are done with this, the better."

496c6778-4de8-4a46-853d-27018cf43142.Text: "Thank you for performing this ritual, Kibellah. I believe we are done here."

7c9bf821-da5f-4ef6-9d0a-760087fbbf6a.Text: "Can we stop with this nonsense now?"

e7353bfd-34dc-4f44-bcb1-217aeb50ca93.Text: "This fight — what a captivating expression of your culture."

5e748a51-9ad7-4304-a96c-e63bcb16ada1.Text: "Can you tell me what this really was? What is the true meaning of this rite?"

c58ba38d-cbfc-49b6-9e71-9c0626462abd.Text: "I only seek to understand why this matters to you — to understand you."

ec938eba-b0f2-4125-a70e-34ae141f1db6.Text: "I did not mean to offend you."

89fbf4bd-6227-4e1f-b0b7-c12c306cf124.Text: "My world is more than mere lustre. Perhaps it would help you to have a closer look at my life."

d16338f0-659c-4489-87bc-2f5b79afc331.Text: "Would you like to see my world, Kibellah? You have allowed me to witness your ritual — it is only fair that I show you one of mine."

dc98f0f8-67a6-4bb7-b025-2b0f53093e17.Text: "Hmph. Yes, you are right. Our rituals are simply too different for us to understand each other."

30791b5e-55f7-4447-be37-a3a48de2cf43.Text: {n}Kibellah moves in a peculiar semblance of an athletic exercise, her movements tracing an inscrutable pattern.{/n} "Are you ready to step into the labyrinth, Domin'{name}?"

09f3c468-9e63-48a8-a916-fb6fad3de3c2.Text: "You are empowered by the will of the Undying One Himself, and yet... when I look at your life, I am surprised: you follow a different thread, one that does not seem as strict to your thoughts and deeds. There is so much..." {n}She thinks for a moment.{/n} "...lustre."

1129b09a-2a89-47ce-b2e0-2125b7007012.Text: {n}A crease appears on Kibellah's brow, but besides this, nothing in her composure could be interpreted as a sign of vexation.{/n}

547bb746-9e69-448f-aade-b93c80326535.Text: {n}Kibellah draws a curved blade and offers it to you.{/n} "Your weapon for the ritual. Watch the lines on the floor: you can only pass through the gaps. The rest you need not know." {n}She bows curtly and assumes a combat stance.{/n} "Enter the labyrinth, Domin'{name}."

45138d55-51dd-4a7b-b77c-183e1764e808.Text: "This is the ritual of binding. By the Undying One's will, our fates are now as one, but I must still guide you into the maze of my mind. Although it is my predestination alone to walk its corridors in search of answers, your image must become part of the tangle. For I am your shadow, Domin'{name}, and your presence will aid me in sensing whatever threats may be looming over you."

ecab1286-2576-4acf-b532-e03ac530e629.Text: "Instructions. Directions. A depiction of the puzzle that can only be solved within one's own consciousness, by following its bends and turnings. I do not require these lines to find my way, but for you they will serve as a guiding thread."

ffbb5d8e-8d84-470e-9a9f-6d805f601eb4.Text: {n}Kibellah's breathing is steady, and there is no change in her solemn expression.{/n} "You are now upon the path. Your shadow now walks the labyrinth, and my gaze can now see when danger draws near you." {n}Her lips continue moving for a while longer, her eyes tracing the lines on the floor.{/n}

430ddbbb-cf01-4252-9d7c-c5a9eda2b4d0.Text: "Thank you, Domin'{name}. Trust me when I say that it was important. For me. For our bond."

6399da79-0127-41de-8e3b-5ecfcbba15e2.Text: {n}Kibellah looks up at you. She gives a reserved nod in response.{/n}

1ccf2630-052d-4ccf-bc46-936908ade762.Text: "We are not doing this for your amusement, Domin'{name}, nor is it an 'expression.' That which you do not comprehend still has meaning."

d658f37e-ef64-4fbc-904c-6e2c8fb996e0.Text: {n}Kibellah glances at you with apprehension.{/n} "You are not required to understand. You have joined the ritual. That will suffice."

443adb9e-bf9c-47f9-aba1-82109e93bedc.Text: {n}Her face remains dispassionate.{/n} "Your words have caused no offence."

faaf4261-8007-4069-b7e9-5160d500ad34.Text: {n}She raises her chin.{/n} "Understand... me? Why, Domin'{name}? My fate is preordained, and our places assigned. We both must serve the Undying One as His design foretells." {n}Kibellah hesitates. You see her eyebrow creeping upward before quickly straightening once more.{/n} "But if such is indeed your wish..."

886ad4f6-c9a7-44ba-a19a-ee7c188dd9df.Text: "My path of service to the Undying Emperor is one of many twists and pitfalls. Every mind is fraught with weakness, and only by honing it tirelessly can one achieve focus and prime one's perception. I envision the Tenets of the Web as a maze of tangles and dead ends. Each time I go into a trance, be it one of the soul or of battle, I walk this path from beginning to end. And now that you are a part of it, you will be there with me when next I enter the labyrinth."

e05556f4-0700-4fe3-b63c-4d3cdd4fb36d.Text: "You may deem it strange. You live in a world so far removed from my own that such rituals must seem absurd to you." {n}She permits herself to smile in the very corners of her mouth, and a spark of flustered curiosity lights up in her normally aloof gaze.{/n} "I am sure I would find your rituals equally mystifying."

edd78c30-a582-4b36-8ff6-31a75017992f.Text: "To partake in one of your ceremonies?" {n}Kibellah pauses to think, then offers you a respectful bow.{/n} "'Returning the courtesy' — that is how you say it up here, isn't it? I will await your invitation."

02a0aa52-3d52-4d52-a0f1-58738f7342fd.Text: {n}She narrows her eyes.{/n} "Your world is alien to me, Domin'{name}. And yet, having some knowledge of it could help me to improve my service to both you and the Undying One. Permit me, then, to observe one of the rituals that fills your life. I will do so with gratitude."

97a30340-a50c-4ff4-99d7-406b134bb5fa.Text: {n}She nods.{/n} "Let us abide by our respective threads."

64a71231-db61-4ee9-86a8-3709baaee2db.Text: {n}Kibellah straightens, stows her weapon, and gives you a short bow.{/n} "The labyrinth has accepted you. We have danced amid the crossing lines and minds, and by the dance we are now bound."

e9400d16-5657-4c6a-9c0d-70c1d175ca78.Text: {n}To an outside observer, what happened here would have looked like an ordinary fight, but your senses grasp... something more. They allow you to perceive a fragile bond that has formed between the two of you in the midst of this blade dance. It is as if Kibellah's mind has opened up, reached out to yours, and... acquainted itself with it. A surprising display of power and direction for someone who possesses no psychic abilities — or appears to be unaware of their own gift.{/n}

39b990fe-66a3-4700-b23f-f7a608738b75.Text: "I see you have found a delicacy that is to your liking?"

1aaa8f60-c923-417d-879d-152d84bc85cd.Text: [Lean closer to Kibellah] "Never regret an action that has given you what you want. You and I are here, alone. What does one little lie matter?"

18081913-8223-49ed-a676-915b1967c74f.Text: "How do you like the 'ceremonies' on the upper decks?"

4747f1d7-52bd-4a5c-91dd-88146d359fe3.Text: "It is high time that this dull evening was over and done with. We should return to our duties."

23f5cc2d-3765-4e4b-b1e1-a8cf4288eb13.Text: "Camaraderie. Spending all your days in toil can be... dreary".

001c7da3-a43c-4977-a6a8-adcfc11e2556.Text: "Gratitude. My crew is willing to give their lives for the dynasty, and this is my way of praising their service."

680159f2-d060-4f50-ab20-667cc3848628.Text: "Power. These people came at the snap of my fingers. They look at me, hang upon my every word and gesture, hoping against hope that I might grace them with a smile or a glance."

24c736c5-d499-470f-a8b8-fef2d08a7fdf.Text: "You are my comrade — I cannot simply dismiss you and your wishes!"

f0202abc-5d7b-4b1d-9adb-b09443973244.Text: "I have come to value your company."

0643dd76-751a-48e5-bf29-dd82aec68a0b.Text: "I wanted to show you that there are other things in life besides service and duty."

60308d3f-f5a0-42a3-9861-bb8867363b4e.Text: "Thank you for this evening. I hope it will not be the last."

e0f363c9-c770-4246-a61b-5f901d59139d.Text: [Look at the other attendees] "Could it be that someone here finds the conduct of the Lord Captain's guest disturbing?"

2dfbbac9-40ed-4fb0-8d29-3fed36cfb2c9.Text: [Smile at Kibellah] "I see you have already mastered the art of commanding attention. You seem to be quite in your element."

019ee280-63c3-4e0a-baf8-a01d9771b439.Text: "I sense that this gathering was a terrible mistake."

dfbd7e4d-a63d-4d72-b0c4-04310798e13d.Text: "I have no use for a blade that tries to deceive and toy with me. Remember that."

7be17084-575c-43d3-b3f9-7e6cd8cf33a4.Text: "That is the first time you have been honest with me about your desires. To see your sincerity — that is the truly priceless gift here."

6e9904d1-dc44-4abe-b4a1-7d836a934745.Text: "You are my instrument, my blade — one that I intend to maintain."

e1ef3940-0447-4898-b563-e15a06b558b7.Text: "I want to stay with you, somewhere private."

5f409b32-54d3-4389-8ac3-3c9cdc09a63c.Text: [Gesture at her spinner's mask and regalia] "Your choice of attire is not customary for such gatherings."

22757087-f1d2-4418-91d5-0b806fa69567.Text: "I grow weary of the crowd. Take a walk with me."

56ecc560-6715-42f9-874e-87fc6132deb0.Text: {n}Kibellah stands out clearly from the officers in attendance — both for her favouring the full regalia of a member of the Bloodspun Web over formal attire and for the empty space around her. The other attendees are keeping their distance, as if an air of mortal danger repels them from your companion.{/n}

a3aff0fa-781a-4a7c-a6fb-9a2ca9db990e.Text: "Domin'{name}. You are here." {n}Kibellah sounds neither excited nor solemn — her tone is indifferent as her fearsome metal claws clutch a slice of fruit from one of the plates.{/n}

83f3e4c4-dde0-492d-b726-24c468c17fd0.Text: {n}She smiles.{/n} "Food like this is impossible to come by in the lower bays. I do not know what this is, but it tastes incredible." {n}Juice is dripping down her fingers and hand. It seems she is the only one here who has not lost her appetite — the officers' faces have turned into pale, alarmed masks, and none of them is in a hurry to enjoy the feast.{/n}

f2c3a3aa-76c0-47b0-a8f5-98e3e5368475.Text: "I am attempting to peer through the florid shell to the core, yet it continues to elude me." {n}Kibellah looks you in the eye.{/n} "What is the purpose of this ritual, Domin'{name}? Explain it to me."

43315e3e-4ee5-45ea-8e50-f52bd6a60d4f.Text: {n}Kibellah avoids your gaze as the two of you walk away from the other guests. She seems calm, but the slight tremble running down her right hand betrays her agitation. Once you are alone, she looks straight at you.{/n}

31774d2b-ae43-423e-954a-cb03f431db93.Text: "I have discerned what you are doing here, and I know that your calling it a ritual was a ruse. True rituals are constant, immutable, like the cycles of the cooling machines in the ship's bowels or the shifts of the bays' servants. This was... spontaneous, something you prepared just for me, and then you stayed at my side the entire time. Now, here you are, granting me yet another request. Why is that?"

0ad7a01f-1839-498c-a11b-8fa663f822b1.Text: {n}Kibellah's face darkens for an moment, but then, almost immediately, her faint smile grows wider.{/n} "That is a luxury that no spinner can afford." {n}Her voice drops to a soft whisper.{/n}

fc29db3b-9f79-425a-90f4-3a3994c7cc4f.Text: "Dreary? Is serving one's thread not the greatest joy there is? You of all people should know this, Domin'{name}."

3e38079c-c978-4bc2-92ef-9b30bcf93528.Text: "I am too conspicuous beside the rest of your servants." {n}Kibellah looks at the other guests, and they quickly avert their eyes.{/n} "A fitting mask — that is what is required for a ritual like this. I came unprepared. It will not happen again."

efb87177-0bc0-4db1-b8fa-7d5bdf52bb40.Text: "Does one merit gratitude for doing what their duty demands? Would these people act differently without your show of appreciation? I hope that is not the case."

e4e9a0be-1b89-4584-9be3-25c645fb884a.Text: "Is that so? I hope that this power you so cherish serves a purpose other than hollow vanity."

29d82f8a-18f1-42f5-9ffd-7e516e2777b2.Text: "I have seen enough to understand what masks and gestures His servants use around you. That is enough. Let us each return to our respective threads and aspire to give our all to the Undying One, now and forever."

52747331-6808-4d83-b35d-4acfeefb8092.Text: "I feel wrong. Strange people, strange sounds and gestures..." {n}Kibellah lets out a sharp breath. Her gaze becomes vacant, and her hand reaches for the table knife.{/n} "I am... losing myself in this whirlpool."

9263c52c-7198-4f9c-877c-948ebbf3910b.Text: {n}Grasping the knife, she begins to carve lines right into the expensive wooden tabletop. A nervous murmur runs through the crowd. Their tense gazes are locked on the harmless-looking, barely sharpened metal utensil in the hand of the cultist of the Bloodspun Web.{/n}

257f6669-d3ec-4ee9-acf9-9f2c3790ec8a.Text: {n}She tilts her head, studying your face.{/n} "'Other things,' Domin'{name}?"

e0af2426-972c-4524-baf6-bb7c438e14a3.Text: {n}Kibellah looks at you with mild confusion.{/n} "My appearance tells those around me who I am. Everyone here is wearing a mask for their respective thread. Is this not a requirement for your rituals?" {n}She glances at the opulent room, the dazzling decor, and the handsomely dressed officers.{/n}

831ebe60-9a68-4f7b-b89b-273bf05e6538.Text: {n}Your words diffuse the fearful attention focused on Kibellah as a strike cruiser scatters a raider squadron. The officers stop staring at your intimidating companion.{/n}

1e3c19fc-8792-405b-a5bb-140db2aa9efc.Text: {n}Your words force the other attendees to avert their gazes, but there is still a lingering sense of apprehension in the air — every officer now appears to be straining their hearing to detect Kibellah's slightest movements.{/n}

2cf3c630-985d-46f8-8ff6-e6fc32a1960e.Text: {n}She blinks in surprise and looks up at you. She glances back and forth, seemingly privy to the meaning of your words... and then, her clear, genuine laughter fills the room, startling everyone around her.{/n} "I suppose that's true, Domin'{name}! I will not fluster your subjects further."

bdc707e2-c717-4017-bc28-7577cf583208.Text: {n}Your joke goes over her head — she is too focused, and neither your words nor the other guests' oppressive attention can interrupt her trance-like process.{/n}

1df070f6-2453-4938-9447-d2c3537c46d8.Text: {n}She is clearly aware of the looks she is getting and the frightened whispering flowing around her, yet her expression remains impassive.{/n}

520576f2-3ccc-4ade-acaa-47db295c51de.Text: "Then take me there... {name}." {n}You can barely hear Kibellah's voice as she speaks your name plainly for the first time.{/n}

489388bc-1b56-48df-abbe-2ae8fdadce4b.Text: {n}Kibellah glances at the maze she has inscribed and sighs.{/n} "Whenever I lose my thread... whenever I am forced astray by the outside world... I return to the labyrinth. It has all the answers. My meditation helps. In finding my way out, I regain myself and praise the righteousness of serving the Undying One."

828a2f86-1622-404e-a297-c307b8748541.Text: "Why? You have looked behind the curtain at my existence, and now, I have looked at yours." {n}Kibellah stares at you intently.{/n} "I do not think that we have heard all the words that should have been spoken here today. Is it because you do not wish to say them in front of... witnesses?"

d414544b-3a8c-45bd-b18a-59ae78f4a8c5.Text: {n}Kibellah freezes.{/n} "Your words ring with danger, Domin'{name}." {n}She brings a hand to your neck and slides it down.{/n} "But I can understand why you would think thus. Such is the Domin's destiny: the burden of power... The burden of living as a predator."

27210b9d-39e5-4973-84b3-d473f7d8badb.Text: {n}Kibellah's lips stretch into a smile. She slowly places a hand on your shoulder.{/n} "I... share your anticipation, Domin'{name}."

fbd60e8a-3cc9-4a7f-9eb1-d72eac1852ec.Text: {n}Kibellah draws a ragged breath and steps away from you, her burning eyes glancing aside.{/n} "The time of my visit has come to an end. Thank you for the ritual, Domin'{name}, and for answering my question. Now, I must go back to my own thread."

7217eebc-3c79-41f7-9eba-6a170501d7ab.Text: {n}With the dignity of a true nobleman, the High Factotum glowers at those in attendance and silences them with a vicious smile. The anxious voices die down.{/n}

54715d6b-d4c9-4a3e-a31b-47dac5f8270a.Text: "You wanted to sharpen me." {n}Kibellah's expression hardens.{/n} "You are wise. Now that I have studied your world, I can excel as your protector, your servant. Thank you for gifting me this clarity."

47695a83-eb73-4efb-af32-b97a5eba56ac.Text: {n}Kibellah reciprocates — hesitantly at first, then passionately. Her lips are warm and soft — surprisingly so for someone seemingly woven from muscle and unyielding will.{/n}

0d932e17-2264-4615-865c-b6143671f568.Text: {n}Her eyes widen slightly.{/n} "So, that's how it is, Domin'{name}..."

cdaa8b71-8614-4680-a5d7-03c567e8d3a6.Text: {n}Kibellah closes her eyes, her lips carrying a slight smile that seems to hold some unspoken secret.{/n} "As it pleases you, Domin'{name}."

104f73f9-70fd-41e6-8ee3-316ebdad8064.Text: {n}She suddenly looks away. A smile touches her lips.{/n} "When you asked me if I wanted to look at the rituals of your world... I was not entirely candid with my answer. Yes, to see the Domin's world is a priceless gift, but... what I truly wished for was to see it with you." {n}She gives you a searching look, narrowing her eyes.{/n} "What do you think, Domin'{name}? Has your blade failed you?"

d6c12923-0fd5-49f3-9c41-3cee11bb1a65.Text: {n}She stops abruptly, her eyes tense.{/n} "I must ask. Everyone knows that your heart is taken — you have already tied yourself to another thread. Do you mean to say that you would break this bond so that I could become your one and only chosen?"

7cb3cf8b-189b-4f34-9251-f2031fef2a42.Text: {n}The tension in her voice fades, giving way to warmth and trust.{/n} "So, then... what will your next step be, Domin'{name}?"

6d50c49f-c424-4562-827f-df9a9ce87914.Text: "There is no place for idle benevolence, neither along your thread nor along mine." {n}Kibellah's eyes seem almost to glow in the dark.{/n} "Yet, you offer me attention and privileges that are both undeserved and unnecessary. Why?"

624e3728-8580-403d-8c28-03137c16e35a.Text: {n}Kibellah lowers her head, then looks up at you with warmth.{/n} "Here, at the top, everyone's blood still carries a craving for what my cult sees as weakness: attachments, intimacy. I understand, but I have no need for them. And yet, I am grateful for the offer." {n}She shakes herself slightly, as if throwing a familiar cloak of aloofness over her shoulders.{/n} "We must now return each to our own thread. Thank you."

4ae23301-9775-4f44-b102-d0aace18c31d.Text: {n}Kibellah gives you a curt nod.{/n} "You have kept your promise. We have each gained a glimpse into the other's worlds, but now, we must return to our own. Thank you, Domin'{name}." {n}She bows solemnly and takes her leave.{/n}

7c44659f-8cd2-4fd9-8c44-d7430fd620d9.Text: {n}Danrok, whose keen, worried gaze is locked on Kibellah and whose mouth is stretched into the most courteous of smiles, gives you a hurried bow.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"

1bbe7c8e-65e2-4f12-a62d-0a7e226e5b81.Text: "I didn't mean to complicate your ritual."

7dafbd7b-823b-4fd0-a3ca-b63c91101b89.Text: [Smirk] "That is quite the confession. You have submitted to an opponent who didn't even land a single blow! How does it feel?"

ee869662-6264-4fa9-aa62-c4d442bd4206.Text: "I doubt the God-Emperor forbids our bond."

990914a8-1e7a-433b-9ae4-0cbbf8cb78ae.Text: "Thinking about someone you hold dear is perfectly normal."

990e342e-ebd2-48bb-a098-7badac448cec.Text: "Why are you so distraught? Can't you reserve even one small part of your life to yourself?"

32e612f5-17df-42c9-b371-1089b2a9e54d.Text: "I would accept that the appearance of someone important in my life was bound to throw things into a bit of a disarray."

889ab253-a01c-456f-b497-da687251d889.Text: "Desires and passions will not stand in my way. Predators do not bow their heads. Nor are they deterred by obstacles."

671b58e3-f768-45e2-aabf-cffd7d6a25a8.Text: "I am tired of your woes. There won't be anything to distract you anymore, because you and I are done."

787ead14-a06f-46d2-b87f-d402754a6eeb.Text: {n}Kibellah makes a ritual gesture, but you notice her fingers tremble.{/n} "Domin'{name}, you need to know about what happened. You and no one else."

ff101f9d-e1d5-48d3-a41b-08e3b1b0c6ea.Text: "During the divination that revealed Adalbert's betrayal to me, my trance was interrupted. Instead of converging on a single point, my thoughts were thrown off the intended path, and I lost my thread." {n}She looks up at you with distress in her eyes.{/n} "What distracted me... were thoughts of you."

537ff3af-6558-4c23-8f5b-2ac42b0d62d2.Text: {n}She nods.{/n} "Your image intruded upon my mind when it was supposed to act as a blade seeking its target — when all of my being was focused on fulfilling my duty. My trance was broken, and I committed an offence against the Undying One."

85ff8b39-1db3-46ff-bd15-7168a7f0cbba.Text: {n}She shakes her head.{/n} "I know, but your shadow blocked my vision when I was looking for a sign from Him."

7e7f75c9-3043-4852-bcfd-b9b9848f4403.Text: {n}Her brow furrows.{/n} "You've chosen a poor time for jests. Through training and abstinence, my mind has been shaped to be impenetrable to outside influence. And still, you forced your way into my mind's eye and put the whole ritual at risk."

fe031451-8353-4826-9cf1-40ac39a95ffd.Text: "I was able to restore my trance and banish all thoughts that didn't belong. But that this happened at all is still worrying." {n}She pauses.{/n} "You... are dear to me, more so than I first realised. But my duty is to serve the Undying One. What if..." {n}She falters, then looks at you intently.{/n} "What if your presence in my mind, in my labyrinth... goes against the Tenets?"

16811956-1dab-4cdc-9002-0023e496869a.Text: {n}Her eyes flash.{/n} "Every life becomes death. Every thread of choice is part of the Bloodspun Web. Every movement of my soul belongs to Ahn—" {n}She stops short.{/n}

6db32571-7d73-4d33-89f2-007e5bc5b8cd.Text: "You don't understand. It may be normal for laypeople, but not within the Bloodspun Web. Not for me. If I lose control of what makes me a faultless weapon — then what will be left of me?"

f4bbd770-0a81-431e-a965-e4125e7544b9.Text: {n}Kibellah's eyes narrow into slits.{/n} "Careful, Domin'{name}. Not even you can presume to speak for Him. His designs are unfathomable — the best we can do is read the signs and hope that our service pleases Him."

895cf167-b268-406f-a4e9-f300a913d25f.Text: "Domin'{name}... our fates are connected. We walk the same labyrinth. Tell me... what would you do if your mind's worries were to dull your resolve and mar your spirit?"

f7f2f1ee-70d4-43af-8b61-4922ba3de5f7.Text: "But..." {n}she exclaims before momentarily falling silent. Her glare burns into you... but then, her expression shifts.{/n} "I understand. The Tenets are not your destiny. You cannot tell me what to do. We may walk the same labyrinth, but I must find the path myself."

d869ec23-64a5-4ce2-a2da-c777098f7a0c.Text: {n}Kibellah gives you a look of painful doubt — and tenderness.{/n} "Enough. Let us go back." {n}Before she turns to leave, her fingers wrap around your hand and squeeze it passionately.{/n}

67a7c2f5-acac-489e-be93-825313ae11f3.Text: {n}Kibellah nods, though somewhat uncertainly.{/n} "Of course. It would be strange to expect you to say otherwise, Domin'{name}."

92950c3b-a33b-441f-a4ef-0fe5efb9b6fc.Text: {n}She lets out a quiet laugh.{/n} "Your life is in enough disarray as it is. Still, your ability to exist in pandemonium without losing sight of your goal deserves some praise..."

98e52c70-a7d7-4174-80be-44456b5965ed.Text: {n}Kibellah focuses all her attention on you. Her eyebrow tenses in some desperate struggle.{/n} "You are right. Predators never stop chasing their prey. Never." {n}She smirks.{/n} "The Vizsier hardly would have approved of me ignoring the Tenets... but he also never had to face the kinds of trials that I have."

b4c879cc-d8cd-4d32-bb9a-f694b3ce1b14.Text: {n}Kibellah closes her eyes. She looks as if she wants to say something... but she merely nods instead.{/n} "I accept your choice, Domin'{name}."

5ab271f6-de09-45b5-a24a-d526183a8dc6.Text: "Forgive me. And thank you for this lesson. I am so used to relying on the Vizsier's teachings that, when faced with an obstacle he did not warn me about, my instinct is to seek advice from others." {n}Kibellah touches your chest.{/n} "Thank you for letting me pick myself up, {name}."

ca2148ec-ec6b-4d56-9cb7-14d57e7eed13.Text: The sarcophagus has been turned into a container — supplies, ammunition, and bandages lie in an unceremonious pile on top of the bones.

66c98bac-c76f-4778-8432-9abec5e9885b.Text: The defilers dumped the remains on the floor, then connected a water pump to turn the sarcophagus into a cistern.

ab1e719f-7ebc-4994-9387-ed8427f21c3f.Text: The monument was shattered to give the defenders a better field of fire.

c98741c4-4b58-4191-a511-051a3e2b1db3.Text: There are large footprints in the dust, but the two feet are of different shapes — one human and the other clawed and horribly mutated.

e508d8bc-245b-47eb-bda2-4b0c6393622e.Text: A black viscous substance, resembling partially dried saliva, is slowly eating through the surface of the monument.

e82852cd-a892-43e8-a0b5-9d1360bafb22.Text: Needle pistol shells are scattered across the floor. They do not belong in this realm of tranquil glory.

b1feab19-024f-430a-8fbb-71e4cf3d5786.Text: "Cargo K-189, check. Cargo L-458, check... Throne, there's still one missing!"

639b3e7f-9b1e-4c67-a6aa-3acb44eb7966.Text: "You counting them for the third time won't make the box appear out of thin air. Let's admit that it's gone and go report this."

16b247fe-cc61-4acb-b056-53762210457b.Text: "Wait, I'll have one more look! Cargo A-113, check. Cargo B-982, check..."

446f23eb-b1c3-4bae-bc2a-9618690e61f6.Text: "That brainless lug! What's it doing now? The valve is the other way! Look, it's turning the air again!"

7fc2acc0-8dd5-4552-b421-aa9b272e4313.Text: "Did it break down already? Try turning that thing around manually, it's got an emergency panel on its back."

aca332c2-71f6-4d65-ba52-d86a59c3434a.Text: "Hey, where's Haub? Too much rotgut before the shift again?"

b94f8a1e-75bf-4e4f-b88c-91e4dda50dda.Text: "No, he didn't listen to the briefing and stuck his hand in the reactor. How the machine spirits didn't kill him instantly, I have no idea."

beb46490-1252-452b-b447-c6ede809161a.Text: "No, Tech-Priest Deltar sent him over for servitorisation. Maybe he'll do some actual work now."

11a3c544-dabc-45f2-9613-b1ea650f912d.Text: This amulet, in the shape of a fanged serpent with a sharp tail and three clawed limbs, once belonged to a Magus of the Genestealer Cult of the Ravenous Star.

8bd6d2b7-9649-496d-bae8-da5a8b3ee188.Text: "You heard what happened down in the crypt? They say a bunch o' heretics and monsters'd nested there, but the Lord Captain {mf|himself|herself} went and crushed them all!"

437d16db-70f4-456d-9313-c7f28754bf2b.Text: "I'm telling you! I heard they even gnawed all the old bones clean, and that they didn't look much alive themselves."

ec899f62-4f5b-4bc9-a111-9a9d09b2ca58.Text: "Terrible, that... Let's hope it didn't anger our dead. Wouldn't want them walking the decks!"

b33d9999-e1c0-46c0-8ace-c97086968c47.Text: "It is a black day! The villains have butchered our champion! Who will protect us from the enforcers now?"

c7b5a22f-fd17-465f-aa3f-cd2f34b0b10f.Text: "Nobody will, you bonehead! So hold your tongue, unless you want to be strung up along with Nemesite."

ff9a776c-fc96-4eb7-ad4c-89c88cd8d5e4.Text: "I'm not d-doing anything wrong! Long live {name} von Valancius..."

694f6bb4-c77f-484e-9759-5e3ebe1acaf5.Text: "So... this Nemesite is not a hero after all. He just goes around tricking people!"

75a8e50c-2da5-48ff-a1a0-56e26de6830c.Text: "Try harder! Nobody is buying your mewling. What, got too many teeth in your head? Can't talk properly?"

97c5ceb7-4050-4280-8dd8-b4d3b2a22217.Text: "People! This Nemesite is a menace. He sleeps on bones and devours human flesh. I've seen it myself! While we're away fighting the enforcers, he's just gnawing on the limbs of our fallen."

4818f25f-954a-4f23-aeba-8693c1fd260c.Text: "Clog the tunnels! I was wondering why he was helping us all generous-like. Us common folk really are without a champion!"

59d0d972-cd7f-4eeb-8638-1635e8426f08.Text: "Groxshit! {mf|He|She} would never let you go! Not after treason!"

a35f5256-1ece-4558-9137-99899b2df30f.Text: "I am telling you, {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship} has pardoned me. {mf|He|She} is not our enemy! What Nemesite says about {mf|him|her} is all lies!"

fe71a8db-11b5-48ec-b770-8b6af49a8ad8.Text: "But if Nemesite is lying about the Lord Captain, maybe he's lying about other things, too. What if he's not our champion at all?"

85f25b5d-3bee-41c0-8a9e-347873b70abc.Text: "Attention Freight Hub LD-987/A14! The Lord Captain is in the bay!"

435a3dcc-b89a-4d4f-a2e9-3febddd86d8e.Text: "That wasn't your brother. They say those monsters steal your sanity and poison your soul."

7287a1fa-4877-46ca-ac2b-0f10b71aac81.Text: "But when did it happen? Right up to that moment, he was his usual self, joking and smiling. What if there was something I could've done? Something to save him..."

a2f916e9-b497-4dad-aee3-32ea18f10566.Text: "I'll ask you one more time, worm: where did you get the blood? Whom do you serve?"

11ed7f5b-c6a2-4d32-af49-2defcd078188.Text: "I don't know nothing about no blood! I'm just a welder! I work in a workshop!"

4d1a2c40-4dde-45b4-8f8a-920326d2c090.Text: "Are you talking back to me? I'd like to see you weld after I break both your elbows!"

4b07267d-cf07-4fc3-b697-0e69f1116a6d.Text: "Or else what? You're not allowed to clobber me — Lord Captain's orders, God-Emperor preserve {mf|his|her} soul! Are you gonna yell at me? Yell away, I get plenty of that from my foreman, I'm used to it."

2e5d4bc9-b090-4468-b3fa-4024bb991b03.Text: "You think I need a baton to make you wish you'd never been born, scum? Mouth off one more time and see what happens."

3cee6a0c-9eaf-4ca0-9291-5667704dde5a.Text: "Why'd they stop beating us? They even gave us water... Is this some new enforcer trick? Hope torture?"

11f4f798-2574-40b1-b535-d3d69f0a9705.Text: "Einrich stood up for us. I heard he even went to the Lord Captain."

9ffae9b1-f506-4767-9cff-b8e76d9be785.Text: "Huh, I had no idea our Lord Captain was the merciful sort. Emperor bless {mf|him|her}!"

f07e7731-6619-473c-a9cd-c5fb21cfc5c6.Text: "I heard the Lord Captain personally ordered that the beatings be stopped. The enforcers can rage all they want, but they won't defy the Lord Captain."

5e7386c2-5c44-4934-be8d-00ec22c75b9e.Text: "Why are you helping me? If you get caught, the Master-at-Arms might have you executed..."

731297d9-dcb3-4d17-8121-16064c75b5d2.Text: "I come from simple stock myself. I couldn't just stand and watch them treat you like dirt. I had to do something."

9fba9b36-cc8f-420d-80a1-b2aa2ffd41d1.Text: "Who do those enforcers think they are? First they throw us out of the mess hall, then they pack the compartment with workers and smear blood all over the floor!"

ea419c7f-e3bc-4e9e-806e-40d31487e43d.Text: "Not much we can do, is there? This is serious. They've been publicly shamed, so now they're doing all they can to crawl back into the higher-ups' good graces."

60353b47-d47e-4e4c-b4a4-351932439b18.Text: "So, let them do that on their own deck! What does it have to do with us?"

56ae6c23-ff57-41a4-9aad-c7766f5d84fb.Text: "Why not tell this to the Master-at-Arms? She has a special maul for just such occasions."

152a6854-6696-404c-8f6e-81b930b5d9b0.Text: "You have no right! I am an officer of this ship, not some furnace stoker!"

832eb6b3-8d2c-438e-8e67-bf8f2ae295bf.Text: "I do not care if you are the Master Helmsman. There has been an assassination attempt on the Lord Captain, so no one is exempt from inquiry. The enforcers have been given special powers to deal with the situation."

8849383d-ba1d-4bf8-8e3b-5fd47d0c8d8a.Text: "I have orders to follow! And I will not submit to any interrogation. This is a clear abuse of authority!"

ee09317e-b4ea-4182-b210-d050c5398398.Text: "You are acting suspiciously, officer. First you deny involvement, then you try to escape... Let us adjourn to the interrogation room. Or will I have to use force? I certainly have the authority to do so."

a1ebfd0d-f81a-4076-88e2-02d03e11d48a.Text: "This is a waste of my time and yours! How many times do I have to say it? I didn't see anything! Go find some serfs to beat up, I've got better things to do."

4eac9cca-ee82-49c3-8931-0a13a6b29bd7.Text: "Beating's been banned. But your important officer's business can wait, sir — we need to have a chat."

106123f4-8020-4708-bd32-c2ef80888b43.Text: "Try and make me. You can't lay a finger on me."

d90f5ea4-500f-4a5d-aed0-f56631cce724.Text: "You shouldn't have said that, sir. I'll have to write up a report on you now, and that's no quick job. You'll be stuck here with me for another hour while that's done."

25c5cd8e-c9e4-4da2-8929-c7089aed721a.Text: "When will they let us go already? My shift foreman's gonna cut my rations. He'll say we've been dawdling."

42945178-078c-4846-902c-584e68baa4b6.Text: "You're worried about your rations? I saw them take your foreman to a little room that nobody ever comes out of again. You might be next."

e6521fa6-7023-4107-b016-b93be5d14976.Text: "So who's the foreman now? Who's gonna be giving out the rations?"

6d39f1db-a946-4844-8bc6-f1da2996390b.Text: "Any enforcer who walks up to you is your new foreman, judge, and master. Pray that they don't lop your head off, or you won't have anywhere to put those rations of yours."

d003f42b-f223-4274-a74c-f84447883851.Text: "This break's dragging on a bit, isn't it? I'm not used to sitting around this long."

100ffdbd-7f9b-43a0-842e-d9c137e0bf4e.Text: "Break? What do you mean, 'break'? This is an interrogation, you dolt!"

0b8e3806-4cc5-4e76-9139-2e284772411f.Text: "Use your head — we don't have to work, just sit here answering questions. The enforcers can't even hit us, just shout at us once in a while. I think I'll actually be sad when they let us go."

1941f532-2117-4cdf-aac5-7d397cfa0da0.Text: "I don't know what scares me more: your stupidity or your relentless optimism."

e7e89737-7d8c-4e50-8041-f99e070d1ecb.Text: "The water supply system in the Lord Captain's quarters has been desecrated by the infusion of undesignated fluid. A sacrament of reconsecration is required."

1ecf71bc-5bb9-47b3-b19b-1be2306771c7.Text: "Initiating the changing of the water filters and the thrice-flushing of the pipes with blessed disinfectant solution."

bc8f4664-2cec-4d1c-86c0-61ced1b4487e.Text: "May the spirits of the pumps not be angered, may the pressure meet the standards of operation."

7ce2c25e-1762-4a54-9371-985f4e659b98.Text: Instil a sense of impunity in the traitors by removing the deck enforcer. The quarry must not see the trap being laid.

16b0cd78-8ca8-4b9d-84dc-e2ed430cb048.Text: Plant a rumour of an impending raid among the workers using a local gossip

7af5f6c6-aec1-405e-84b6-9c73825ac5b1.Text: Identify Nemesite's accomplices among the commoners

6e8ead3d-324f-4033-9fd8-fa2a36b98444.Text: Thanks to Kibellah and the Lord Captain, the solemn legend of Nemesite, aberration and false champion of the oppressed, will soon be consigned to oblivion.

d1a07d18-b800-45fa-86ac-4c2c77bc6385.Text: A living legend from the lower decks threatens the safety of the Lord Captain and the entire flagship. It is now time for Kibellah, the Domin's blade, shield, and shadow, to spin a sanguine web and catch this sower of discord.

315da663-2ef2-4870-9ae7-f85d5d040a3c.Text: High Factotum Janris Danrok was gravely wounded during a raid on the voidship's shrine. He begs the Lord Captain to join him there and hear his confession.

82f8282e-f9cb-4265-a73b-66d77712e571.Text: Before heading to the plasma drive chambers, Kibellah has asked the Lord Captain to perform a blood rite that would bless her hunt for Nemesite.

9be288f7-fe47-4a42-9687-e45201508434.Text: The evidence left by the raiders in the voidship's shrine points to the plasma drive chambers. Kibellah must now ease the vigilance of the local workers, who may be harbouring followers of Nemesite. She will then force the troublemakers to reveal both themselves and, eventually, their so-called hero.

dc093f46-33c9-414d-9e40-ce03bfba5509.Text: Nemesite is planning to strike during the formal ceremony of the swearing-in of the officers that is to be performed by the new ship's confessor. In place of the usual distinguished guests, the Master-at-Arms will instead fill the chapel with disguised enforcers. The moment Nemesite decides to attack the not-so-helpless guests, the trap will be sprung.

505704dc-59bf-45d0-a78b-0e0ff9a2e5a7.Text: Eliminate Nemesite during the ambush on the officers' deck

ca214c4d-8c0a-4d0b-87df-d840d76b40c0.Text: A divination using the Emperor's Tarot and blood spilt over the flesh of the betrayers has pointed to a man close to Nemesite. The traitor is Adalbert, the ship's confessor.

6d5bb175-bae3-4de9-a5d8-a19fe0923d81.Text: The Lord Captain has managed to lure Nemesite into a trap, but the resurgent legend of the lower decks will not give up without a fight.

58fb68f9-26e0-40b7-a291-32f3b6e53350.Text: The traitor's guilt has been established. It is time for the ship's confessor to receive his due punishment.

2e9ebc0c-f283-45a0-bc0c-2abedf6a5025.Text: After taking Nemesite's head as a trophy offering to the Undying Emperor, Kibellah withdrew to ponder the curious intertwining of their destinies. Perhaps she will share her thoughts with the Lord Captain later.

3bdfca02-3ff3-4e50-a287-6fb5c2ff6d91.Text: The Master-at-Arms has sent enforcers to gather information on Nemesite's next move. Once the report is complete, the Lord Captain and the officers can then devise a plan of action.

599dd876-dc1d-4ac5-96df-7f15e7283bfe.Text: Talk to Kibellah before leaving Dargonus

b1db2377-5bc6-412e-9d1a-9d88c2764e05.Text: The Bloodspun Web has a new Vizsier and is folding into a new pattern.

0cf1d4d6-684c-4477-ac65-1df7fd82aaf2.Text: Kibellah is tormented by a spiritual affliction causing her to stray from the Tenets of the Web. Lest she lose herself completely, the Domin must walk the path of her fear and doubt — toward death itself.

0c7d9da8-2235-4840-9936-46c8a9366bb9.Text: Kibellah has murdered an officer. Master-at-Arms Sauerback expects the Lord Captain to judge and sentence her in person.

4a16492d-f2ff-4363-9e3b-9cb5dd7bbe7c.Text: In order to help Kibellah overcome her doubt, the Lord Captain must get inside her troubled mind. Only a powerful guide, a psyker from the Astropathic Choir, can put the two of them in a telepathic trance.

afdf622f-435b-480a-ba38-ce58b68e378a.Text: In exchange for Kibellah's life, Death whispered a name: Naaki Erebis. Just who this person might be is unknown, but Janris Danrok has access to the entirety of the ship's chronicles and archives. He can help.

486c9ec7-6cef-4450-8228-8a23ef187793.Text: Task the High Factotum with finding information

730893c1-0eeb-4990-9b95-d5c0c1f89ab4.Text: Finding out more about Naaki Erebis will require a trip to Dargonus to meet the Erebis family, who have been summoned to the Rogue Trader's palace.

2143012c-4485-41de-8c83-63de285f89ac.Text: Kibellah has suggested that the Rogue Trader talk to each individual member of House Erebis in a more casual setting.

9d3c7c49-fb6d-4123-90c0-0a9abfc8f18d.Text: Talk to the members of the Erebis family

059e4fa2-bfad-448e-8528-04cf99a45ef1.Text: The truth regarding Naaki Erebis is out, and Kibellah has made her choice. The Rogue Trader is to accompany the Second Spinner to the temple, where she will report to the Vizsier.

af357b11-24af-4f50-a017-61fb0ed769a3.Text: Report to the Vizsier of the Bloodspun Web

74031d02-6910-4e70-a07a-0b8af59f6472.Text: Kibellah has invited the Rogue Trader to a meeting in the ship's crypt.

64b030ca-1086-4503-a9dd-a047d1c0ca84.Text: The priests of a sacred cult operating aboard the ship have requested an audience. The Vox Master awaits the Rogue Trader's decision.

41c46d94-15c0-4b96-9957-29ba756524cb.Text: The issue affecting the compiler's interpreter module has been fixed.

38c1a41d-49fe-4d5e-bb28-79167e8a5acf.Text: The issue affecting the first receiver has been fixed.

59737c14-38aa-4997-bd9e-51c6dd692da8.Text: The issue affecting the second receiver has been fixed.

befcabdc-4940-4e42-9e86-c55c18e26249.Text: The issue affecting the transcriber has been fixed.

d41d3aba-9921-400a-8050-eecafa20f48c.Text: The issue affecting the routing cogitator has been fixed.

7480c4f3-a8dc-43c5-a310-f2172c983b7c.Text: The Rogue Trader has successfully dealt with the compiler malfunction.

90d4e69b-85a1-4681-b10e-1ab95d5a4c07.Text: The compiler at the Astropathic Chapel has been malfunctioning. The Astropaths are in sore need of help, and the Rogue Trader may wish to provide it.

93291afd-d868-4ad1-bfe3-f735e59b32a9.Text: The mechanism that permeates the entire chapel has been malfunctioning. Every issue causing the problem must be identified and resolved.

38c614cb-a54a-47cc-abde-111dc3ef922c.Text: Fix the issues affecting the chapel's machinery

d21e1eec-5491-4c4f-869f-123a436a06e7.Text: The Astropath who reported the malfunction to the Rogue Trader will welcome the news that the sacred mechanism is fully operational again.

23cb7765-b5b0-4253-80f4-4775028742a8.Text: The Choirmaster has handed the Lord Captain a suspicious message containing Kunrad Voigtvir's call sign.

4ef6a9e6-b9d9-461d-b648-ccfdb757258b.Text: Scout out the planet the message to Voigtvir was sent from

498b1f5c-e805-4adf-9a95-2193f5e36a9d.Text: Once the sacred machine is repaired, Choirmaster Weisz will be able to deliver previously indecipherable messages to the Rogue Trader.

b0124ecf-2019-4efe-a415-8fb4eb8851c5.Text: A psychic scream is coming from Astropathic Station VX-02-537, driving the ship's Astropaths mad. Choirmaster Weisz has asked the Lord Captain to visit the station and silence the scream so that the Choir may contact the dynasty's worlds.

e797b526-6da2-4460-a698-fa47bf242290.Text: The armillary sphere on the officers' deck has pinpointed coordinates on one of the worlds in the Pelium Solitas System. There may be something of value there.

df470343-71a1-431e-bf6a-da97062c1a6c.Text: The Lord Captain spent too much time in the pestilence pit by the voidship's freight line, and now {mf|his|her} skin is covered in inflamed blisters. There must be someone on board who knows how to purge the Rogue Trader's body of this affliction.

92898f9b-0a19-4a6a-a542-6e102c29aef4.Text: The maker of the second confession has been found — it was the High Factotum.

9f4e6b3a-50a6-49c6-9a85-94b6af1ac7e6.Text: The maker of the third confession has been found — the Vox Master was the one who left the last message.

ac9592ba-a2a2-4eb4-a39b-6557a929c808.Text: The maker of the first confession has been found — it was the Choirmaster.

cb35d840-9276-4b86-a1d0-69d91389bbbd.Text: Senior officers would be a good starting point for investigating who left these messages.

fe27ad18-97ce-43ce-af8b-e77e7cbe41e1.Text: Find the makers of the confessions

15ad7aa9-1d10-46eb-adf1-af90dbeb8dea.Text: The Lord Captain found the makers of the three unusual confessions and satisfied {mf|his|her} curiosity.

61813377-a3a6-46db-b664-f54dc76c87da.Text: The Lord Captain heard three unusual confessions that interested {mf|him|her}. The first two voices seemed to be male: one lamented the fate of those who have died in the warp, while the other was concerned about the well-being of orphans aboard the ship. The third confession came from a woman and mentioned "lop-eared kleppas."

60c8bb02-40a3-4419-a863-57f365e6af4d.Text: "That thing you did right at the end... I'm not entirely sure that's legal."

90c61f41-3942-4aa3-8cdb-1fdb21708121.Text: "It's nice to know I'm still in shape."

3f6f7d05-8c65-48ed-ace4-5f0e0e6ddd64.Text: "I have to admit, I didn't realise that being assigned to a Rogue Trader's ship would lead to such exploits."

29132f11-55a5-4942-8c3d-4482a98d7ce0.Text: "You're harder to keep up with than the worst fugitives in Calixis."

ea2eb01e-8fb1-40fd-86fc-c341e6ef5fec.Text: "...may the Emperor, He That Holdeth the Key to all Destinies, bless the Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}, {mf|him|her} who descended from the sky on a bird of steel..."

8fcaeb24-9b86-4961-b9d6-2c99447cb25d.Text: "...we thank You for Your miracle, for without the stars' blessing, we are blind..."

753ebee8-cf00-48e3-84ae-0fc0fc3353c6.Text: "...may Your ear forever be merciful to our pleas..."

058a9a69-9a16-4aaf-a3f1-a2e47c72791c.Text: The servile crowd is muttering prayers. No one dares raise their timid eyes at you.

39834818-0db7-4842-b621-c3902f115279.Text: "Who's there? Is that the Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady} {mf|himself|herself}? You shouldn't have come here."

1514d4a9-0528-4cd5-bf99-863fc3fbe8ca.Text: "Fates become tangled in this place, and faces change... Who knows if by nightfall you won't have lost yourself..."

90cbd26b-16dc-4837-8e1b-ece1912f9527.Text: "Just a piece of advice: beware the shimmering blue. Or else you'll end up like Gorgorius Falt..."

c37e3bbf-61f5-4e5d-ac2c-328a31f84ff0.Text: "Have I been branded? He... he tricked me!"

a88c5753-1bd6-438d-88ec-4f809e33bb71.Text: "Garra, stop! I'm your master! Maive, help!"

08144d42-0e2f-4a98-b41e-0c6387a6d9e0.Text: "Would you like some water, Fair-Faced One?"

4f4d3a4b-5e7c-4629-a603-4b1225849a41.Text: "Who drinks water at a feast, you dimwit? Hurry up and bring me some amasec!"

d05f75e9-242b-4ebc-be7d-ad4fc7f5d32e.Text: "Apologies, my lord. I will open a new bottle at once."

adac0dac-3852-48f5-b10f-3a02543f5eac.Text: "Did you see Lady Noella's rotting face? No amount of whitener can fix that. They say the poor soul has been trying to cover her sores with limewash. The kind they use for walls..."

45753e07-824b-4535-8d55-373397e5182d.Text: "Well, I don't feel sorry for her in the slightest! Everyone knows your face doesn't go bad unless your thoughts are impure and your soul is full of vice!"

677d50c3-627d-40fa-ab93-9c8d7bac1031.Text: "Ah. Yes, of course. May I borrow your rouge?"

4f02500e-5098-4e51-bacf-96f1c612a3bf.Text: "Over there! That's the carriage the Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady} drives around the sky in!"

ab4540b5-9aa2-4600-a48a-ba4ac1cdc437.Text: "I heard it's chained to the firmament. And the Emperor Himself lifts it up."

50a2f1a6-f7af-4e14-a7df-f85a02bcc524.Text: "Are you stupid or what? That's not the kind of thing the Emperor would do! The chains are fastened to clouds, that's all."

85882340-5ede-430c-95e1-d7c56e23c47b.Text: "Take whatever you please, Your Celestial Highness! Everything is free on this festive day!"

0c915420-ccec-4e55-9803-81995f83148c.Text: "Are you also a ruler of the stars? No? Then you can pay for yourself and for {mf|His|Her} Highness!"

1833b74a-921e-4bcd-a1f6-9463a027de3d.Text: "Did you see the feast they threw for the Celestial {mf|Lord|Lady}?"

0ef52e35-2b9a-454d-b925-7a94529b783f.Text: "Do you think anyone will notice if I pinch off a little piece?"

cace20fb-a868-49e4-9b15-1dafb033152e.Text: "Go ahead. But don't get caught, or you'll be working the bone mill the rest of your life..."

594cdd6a-0fc5-4aac-b7d3-9cd035d0b281.Text: "CL-3, what's the progress report on the plan? How long until we can get to the system we need?"

2ec6ef5b-4f5d-41d1-afb0-1148505d8ee3.Text: "The answer is a dozen steps away, K-19."

55704f28-3ed0-4959-971f-99b3b7867c79.Text: "The Adeptus Arbites salute you, Rogue Trader!"

b36defee-a683-4a9c-a203-d24a8271f755.Text: "The spare parts merchant in Dock T-4095 is on an illicit shipment spree. Half of his paperwork is fake. I think he will lead us to the Red Martyr's syndicate — he just needs a nudge."

bdb00c5c-9f75-4a8c-9de0-df85b99d7a1b.Text: "Place a sizeable order, send a down payment, and set up a meeting. We'll catch him in the act."

c6185e17-8d94-4b85-8dd0-0de80df3f63c.Text: "Grab some explosive rounds from the armoury. He won't get far with his legs blown off."

3b51d108-a7e8-4119-89d0-6b2144876a6a.Text: "Solomorne will rejoin my retinue. I will collect him in person."

4aaebec1-710b-464d-a7f7-50a1f289f28a.Text: "Discharged? That is his problem. I have no time to deal with it."

2de09ccd-483c-48aa-8cba-2f1c55bd5ba2.Text: "I have had enough of lawmen. Send the cur to the Marshal. And from now on, I do not want to hear from any Arbitrators coming to me with their problems."

377ec6a0-9e6c-45a0-b3c2-222b7059cbc4.Text: "You are right. Solomorne may prove useful to me yet. I should retrieve him."

7fc75e9f-66b1-47f2-bed0-e0434e2cd725.Text: "Lord Captain, I am afraid I have bad news to impart. The esteemed Master Anthar will no longer be able to accompany you. According to a message from the Adeptus Arbites, he has been discharged and is currently an overseer on Vheabos VI. However, Prefect Vultur has informed me that you have the authority to challenge that decision and have Master Anthar reinstated."

590c3398-22a0-4a18-b472-4d926ddba7a7.Text: "Then I will send a request to have Master Anthar reinstated, and notify the overseers on Vheabos VI of your impending arrival."

ff523fee-8d0e-460d-88be-9bfabcdfa632.Text: "Do you recall the internal Adeptus Arbites mission he went on not so long ago? As far as I know, it was a failure, which led to Master Anthar being deemed unworthy of his rank and unfit to serve you."

7cb2a91e-3a21-4611-98da-b4ea3c561ae6.Text: "I understand perfectly, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! What good is a blundering companion? But, on the other hand, accepting Master Anthar back into your retinue would strengthen your alliance with the Arbites." {n}Janris clears his throat.{/n} "To the best of my knowledge, the Marshal values his former Proctor a great deal. Besides, if Master Anthar really were guilty, he would have been executed. It would appear that some sensitive matter is involved here, in the same vein as the cases brought before you at the Palace of Justice. If you show your concern and sympathy, the Arbites will trust you as they did before."

4fd66516-f58f-473f-80c7-f366bcb5a44f.Text: "I would like to note that his cyber-mastiff is still on board. Due to the damage the dog sustained on Thassera, Master Anthar left it in the care of your Tech-Priests. I heard there was an implant malfunction. The servants of the Omnissiah have patched up the creature, but they have also warned that a final synchronisation of its implants with those of Master Anthar is required before the cyber-mastiff can be considered fully repaired."

fe32b811-0c44-41cd-ab4e-cd7526de673b.Text: The cyber-beast's previous owner is hardly going to need its protocol anymore.

6350f866-56fe-48da-8106-a915bf27443e.Text: The curiosity merchant mentioned an Explorator Tech-Priest he had known but lost contact with, who owned a cyber-beast equipped with an unusual protocol. Perhaps the Rogue Trader will be able to track him down in System Speculo.

25599849-8177-44eb-8732-d425b01287ca.Text: The Renegades' Fall was shot down and crashed. The captain's heirloom was found among the wreckage.

27147bdd-2cd1-4212-bfe9-33e5d8f00b7e.Text: The curiosity merchant told the Rogue Trader about an unusual piece of cyber-beast equipment that the captain of the Renegades' Fall had refused to sell him. He provided the coordinates of the place where he had last met the stubborn man.

3ebed516-5f56-472b-91f2-c742d393129d.Text: "Proctor Kellick! There was talk of purges at the trial. By what criteria will our integrity be assessed?"

665ba2ca-b06e-47cf-b9f0-3d9202a4ed49.Text: "The criteria will be set by the Rogue Trader."

47bed171-2fd3-4b84-a67a-217133056098.Text: "Listen attentively when {mf|he|she} speaks. Do your duty. And, for Throne's sake, ask fewer questions."

2ba3e8b9-cb3b-4544-8aec-7fd521948f89.Text: "The new Marshal will be better than the old one. We have no margin for error."

53e396e6-d44b-41f4-a3c8-6eda62efc12e.Text: "Proctor Kellick! If the Adeptus Arbites no longer exists... What's going to happen to us?"

3d062dd9-f930-4dbe-ab0d-0d3eb66c770a.Text: "We're going to get out of here, find ourselves a place in the Expanse. And... I'm not a Proctor anymore."

412c5420-0c9e-4ec1-8281-6ce1e8849a02.Text: "May the Emperor witness our oath before the new Marshal!"

d2c288eb-cb20-4dcd-ae64-ede3e6832df6.Text: "Long live the inviolable von Valancius dynasty!"

94e07aa5-c50b-4bd3-b27d-e024f33e6cf9.Text: "So... The Lex no longer prevails over all..."

7146d826-2961-4dd7-9ffa-ac0d488705ad.Text: The production lines of Dargonus suffered due to the collapse of the hive city Scipione 84-249.
