7258f510-7690-4f09-9a86-6f17ed49fdbd.Text: The survivors of hive Scipione 84-249 were admitted to the von Valancius flagship and other Dargonus cities. The rightful denizens are agitated after losing their jobs to the more accommodating refugees.

bf71a29d-67a4-4879-beb4-6aa7db9821ea.Text: The survivors of hive Scipione 84-249 were admitted to the von Valancius flagship and other Dargonus cities. They were entrusted into the care of the Dargonus nobility.

f9ae8b82-22bd-41da-a084-c72dfef2a031.Text: The Rogue Trader ordered the establishment of labour settlements around the ruins of Scipione 84-249, where survivors from the collapsed hive were gathered.

71899df2-3076-47b9-870d-e5995310ab1e.Text: The Rogue Trader ordered the establishment of labour settlements around the ruins of Scipione 84-249, where cults of wasteland strugglers were founded.

7721af53-6fcc-4a3c-9e97-b69d3f063f22.Text: The Rogue Trader ordered that the refugees from Scipione 84-249 be exterminated. Having sworn an oath of vengeance for this massacre, scores of fugitives escaped to other hive cities.

eb214c91-a515-4113-9f18-80d92397a480.Text: The Rogue Trader ordered that the refugees from Scipione 84-249 be exterminated, set up cordons, and prohibited all movement between the planet's hives.

cadddb2b-41aa-499d-8647-0bd94456ad18.Text: The Rogue Trader struck a deal with the Engine Vandals and promised them payment for anything of value they happened to have. This patronage was met with discontent among the population of Dargonus.

5255da37-8206-4739-9ea0-3ee14a9bb328.Text: The Rogue Trader struck a deal with the Engine Vandals: with the approval of the Adeptus Mechanicus, the dynasty would purchase any pieces of technology these rovers might be willing to part with.

baebd976-7917-4e69-a525-f76a0e302ffa.Text: The Rogue Trader hired the Engine Vandals to guard the perimeters of the planet's hive cities. In spite of this, robberies and other violations of order still occur from time to time.

019ebcb5-156a-410f-bee2-6eb769b8df3e.Text: The Rogue Trader used the Engine Vandals as a means to terrorise the Dargonus aristocracy. The barbarians' appetites were sated by the riches of the local nobility.

66b6d593-098a-4a17-b6a8-89b55e4ef385.Text: The Rogue Trader exterminated the Engine Vandals over the course of a long, gruelling, and glorious war.

8d22a37f-8b30-4d48-a95a-97c3ef4e8857.Text: The Rogue Trader used trickery to divide the Engine Vandals, who ended up destroying each other to the delight of the rest of Dargonus's residents.

44718f5f-b94f-41cd-9df0-2d70de5c8ab5.Text: The Rogue Trader unscrupulously stole psykers from other rulers. In retaliation, they now refuse to have any dealings with Dargonus.

d98ece71-9491-4de7-9fa3-c3a3381ef300.Text: The Inquisition lent their support to the Rogue Trader and used deceit and force to obtain psykers from other rulers in order to replenish their ally's Astropathic Choir.

76fef520-0d88-4a7d-a901-e80d17bfdb99.Text: The Rogue Trader parted with a tremendous sum to hire the most experienced Astropaths in the Koronus Expanse.

c385305a-7b7e-4673-92ac-2b8d57e359b6.Text: The Rogue Trader reached out to Theodora's old partners, who sent a group of seasoned Astropath veterans to Dargonus.

674a2c0f-84fa-492e-b073-69b90ed39dce.Text: The Rogue Trader recruited unsanctioned psyker outlaws into the Astropathic Choir of Dargonus. The capital is disturbed by their shady activities.

304f76de-94aa-492d-8583-3f8835f48b38.Text: The Rogue Trader recruited unsanctioned psykers from Idira's home planet.

cbcb818d-6b6d-49cd-b629-3e0205fff7cb.Text: The Rogue Trader commanded the Ecclesiarchy to cease their attacks on the minor cults of Dargonus, halting their persecution.

4f65a98b-18ae-4723-ad29-fbbe101de482.Text: The Rogue Trader placed the minor cults of Dargonus under {mf|his|her} personal protection.

cc1dce98-9763-419d-9d99-beff17020529.Text: The Rogue Trader authorised the use of force to crush the minor cults of Dargonus.

6ef6e26a-c0c0-43d4-a13b-998cce20082c.Text: The Rogue Trader ordered that the minor cults of Dargonus be crushed and their clergy taken hostage to ensure the population's compliance.

5d255f06-c3d8-418b-a5f5-9e0f68b23d80.Text: A Genestealer uprising broke out on Dargonus.

0a473d34-eb1a-4822-9cdd-c8d22f3385ab.Text: The Genestealer uprising was successfully crushed.

f72efae0-ee67-4435-bc8b-7737ccef8947.Text: The Genestealer uprising was dealt with at the cost of much blood and suffering.

2f952a0f-19d9-4f44-9378-583ba3c3c437.Text: The Rogue Trader sent the Malpians on a pilgrimage to find Saint Cognatius's relics.

1e43be29-436c-47e5-89a0-d5f8f26f4f88.Text: The Rogue Trader rebuked and punished the Malpians for their actions, which offended them deeply.

5948b66c-860e-407b-8985-833c824d8e9a.Text: The Rogue Trader ordered that a trial by combat be held between the Malpians and the Order of the Hammer. The latter emerged victorious.

1dcae8fd-e09c-4d4c-a665-113894ecbc33.Text: The Rogue Trader ordered the formation of a debate group for theological disputes, which had the side effect of distracting the monks from their duties.

3bb517c2-f68f-4b52-bfe5-feb95bb7450e.Text: The Rogue Trader tested the Malpians' faith.

c7f46031-320b-460e-af25-9b2d7a5f862c.Text: The Rogue Trader ordered that a hundred Malpians be admitted into the Order of the Hammer, ignoring the monks' protests.

01006dbe-4ad6-4116-934a-597224492295.Text: The Rogue Trader made the belligerent Lugnalia the new prelate and lent Hieronymus's support to her.

bca67e72-f98e-4131-ab02-6ba6fcd8830e.Text: The Rogue Trader made the belligerent Lugnalia the new prelate.

34a9b9a6-17d7-40c7-a26f-7a2ec1b0b837.Text: The Rogue Trader made the diplomatic Tychon Drivestem the new prelate, House Drivestem paying generously for this appointment.

a6eff3ad-cbc7-4c54-a6e0-221d57027e91.Text: The Rogue Trader made the diplomatic Tychon Drivestem the new prelate.

01f2968b-e6ad-44e6-9857-25ab082de334.Text: The Rogue Trader made the pragmatic Nigmus the new prelate after ensuring his obedience by gathering some damning blackmail.

31d1a874-5814-421c-89af-2a3838f3fcce.Text: The Rogue Trader made the pragmatic Nigmus the new prelate.

e159fee4-c8c8-4ae3-aba7-119e658ff321.Text: The Rogue Trader made the Malpian Inocrant, a deeply pious man of simple views, the new prelate.

b4e7ef78-0f08-4c1e-bbed-7d3ef1c5247a.Text: The Rogue Trader helped the Explorators take custody of the Crucible.

e14838fc-06ad-45c1-a326-7e4de7430d59.Text: The Rogue Trader helped the Order of the Hammer take custody of the Crucible.

45297fc2-5c48-4302-b498-b385357795d7.Text: The Rogue Trader entrusted the Crucible into the collective custody of the Explorators and the Order of the Hammer.

24926f59-03bc-4ec6-8b7f-d54518a36b24.Text: The Explorators were outraged by the Rogue Trader's decision and responded with an act of vengeance.

c754ac37-be2f-4044-935e-31d4a97096a8.Text: The Order of the Hammer was outraged by the Rogue Trader's decision and now holds a grudge against House von Valancius.

7ac0262e-6e59-425c-a4ed-86f4e5d7a5cb.Text: The Explorators and the Order of the Hammer are incapable of overcoming their differences.

e98f3815-531c-493e-b031-fcadc5cddba1.Text: The Rogue Trader decreed to have the Touched act as spiritual guides.

70777494-636b-42fb-8b81-f452d045ada0.Text: The Rogue Trader decreed to turn the Touched into servitors.

3485ae6c-13ec-4803-9038-aa4696616201.Text: The Rogue Trader decreed to admit the Touched into the Order of the Hammer as monks.

781f13b7-8cfd-4192-89a8-0654891fb0e7.Text: The Rogue Trader decreed to turn the Touched into warriors.

015a8b3f-b3a6-47da-98dc-2035f16a32ce.Text: The Rogue Trader decreed to use the Touched as workers.

ec60d956-b8ab-4e89-bcda-b675b8c43e92.Text: The Rogue Trader decreed to have the Touched disposed of and any knowledge extracted from their heads.

8e7ad3bd-644f-425f-aae2-f2f3754f1403.Text: The Rogue Trader decreed to have the Touched disposed of.

f95675b6-a6ac-49bf-9502-f8e2953612a9.Text: The Rogue Trader decreed to have the Pure-Voiced Prophet eliminated quietly.

696dbe28-aee6-493a-8e77-38fd860d875c.Text: The Rogue Trader publicly executed the Pure-Voiced Prophet, causing an outrage among {mf|his|her} subjects.

c2a1050b-8928-4b94-8a0f-16368bf855aa.Text: The Rogue Trader tricked the dangerous Pure-Voiced Prophet into giving up on his problematic mission.

8aabfc32-e8d7-457a-b5b7-a802a3cd5c51.Text: The Rogue Trader forced the dangerous Pure-Voiced Prophet to join the Order of the Hammer, much to the displeasure of the rabble.

ab9d83ee-d26d-4dc0-b436-e7b043a31235.Text: The Rogue Trader gave the Crucible to the Pure-Voiced Prophet and provided him with an escort consisting of warriors of faith.

647986b3-40da-4823-843d-d3f351b9c2f9.Text: The Rogue Trader gave the Crucible to the Pure-Voiced Prophet and let him leave on his mission.

623b9de0-6129-41d7-8f6d-b3e2494929c5.Text: The hallowed Crucible turned out to be a mechanism for reshaping planets. Foulstone was struck by powerful earthquakes that scarred the monastery of the Order of the Hammer. Soon afterward, however, the planet's harsh wastes were transformed into lush pastures.

c2b7ec33-407a-47f3-972f-f090db98aa66.Text: The Rogue Trader relocated the retches to separate agri-complexes so as not to disturb the rest of the population and prevent a rise in tensions.

2e299adc-1114-4296-9bd2-1cbe526e32e5.Text: The Rogue Trader prohibited the people from taking action against the retches, but their presence sows unrest and unease among the population.

70763057-66d0-4074-9162-acaf34ddac72.Text: The Rogue Trader ordered that the retches be exploited and used for genetic research. Their presence sows unrest and unease among the population.

399ad939-f7ee-475f-84d1-a524efa3220b.Text: The Rogue Trader ordered that the retches be relentlessly exploited. Their presence sows unrest and unease among the population.

96b07acd-9542-4a94-9c85-82308e2f136b.Text: The Rogue Trader ordered that the retches be exterminated and their bodies handed over to the Adeptus Mechanicus Genetors for study.

e3a0f21d-14ed-4ddf-b060-59f71296889e.Text: The Rogue Trader ordered that the retches be exterminated.

02962a8b-82e5-4916-b872-ca7c178dceff.Text: A sector of Janus has risen against its denizens: the agri-complexes are being destroyed by both the wildlife and some mysterious anomalies.

35ad8c4b-e308-481a-b695-e9e7ebee640f.Text: The Rogue Trader commanded the Adeptus Mechanicus forces to incinerate the rebelling sector on Janus with phosphex and radium weaponry.

98545d4d-4570-4625-8971-620974cab69f.Text: The Rogue Trader commanded the enforcers to incinerate the rebelling sector on Janus with promethium and bombs.

8bc04432-6dda-43d5-9b95-62008decdb5a.Text: The Rogue Trader issued orders to set up fortified research complexes deep within the rebelling sector on Janus to study its environment.

2b79515b-ed54-43f5-af7a-4895ae520ac2.Text: The Rogue Trader issued orders to send scouts into the rebelling sector on Janus. Many lives were lost as a result.

574ad3d5-b12c-4bf0-9752-d2aa645f970b.Text: The Rogue Trader issued orders to have some of the retches seized and questioned about the current situation in the rebelling sector on Janus. The retches told their captors how they could leave and live a harmless existence next to the sector instead.

a9e5e949-6593-4d45-86ed-89db8e2021da.Text: The Rogue Trader issued orders to have the rebelling sector on Janus isolated, sacrificing some of the territorial production for the sake of control and safety.

64109244-48ed-42c4-8448-4faa88b075db.Text: Mysterious ghosts have appeared on Janus and started wreaking havoc on the agri-complexes.

df727dab-3f34-4e0f-a483-4826cd352daf.Text: For a ludicrous sum, experts on subduing xenos spirits constructed a series of warding obelisks out of fragments of ancient Aeldari machines.

08e1ffbe-fff5-4247-bbd7-2f3b72905177.Text: Muaran used fragments of ancient Aeldari machines to construct a series of obelisks that could ward off the spirits. However, the obelisks require frequent repairs using elements of xenoconstructs.

0c86b4db-9782-4fa6-947b-80929324bfec.Text: Idira banished the spirits of Janus by performing a dubious planetary ritual.

c6c1e3e9-8583-48fa-a472-e5374ae87c2f.Text: Vistenza banished the spirits of Janus by performing a bloody and unhallowed ritual.

a16b0e12-b5a7-4365-b430-62ca374b434f.Text: Exorcists arrived on Janus, engaged the spirits, and banished them. Many of the exorcists then remained on the planet to preach asceticism and austerity among the population.

db1441fc-e0d5-4cf6-ad08-84d25c8326f1.Text: Janus's militia fought the spirits and defeated them, suffering heavy losses in the process.

5e6febd8-caba-4797-8770-10722e951edd.Text: The Rogue Trader established a productive relationship with the punitive unit of the Ordo Xenos that had arrived on Janus to investigate the ongoing events.

4a91d1c6-0dc3-42db-af8d-8087e55aa7e5.Text: The Rogue Trader permitted the punitive units of the Ordo Xenos to conduct interrogations on Janus, which has left the population terrified.

540f52b7-305c-4417-97de-3220636d4eb4.Text: The Rogue Trader presented the punitive unit of the Ordo Xenos with a group of Aeldari. The acolytes destroyed them and left the planet, certain of their success.

96694441-883f-4dde-afad-ac276e40a18d.Text: The Rogue Trader presented the punitive unit of the Ordo Xenos with a group of cultists. The acolytes executed them and left the planet, certain of their success.

1bbe3f0a-06ab-4b2e-b3d8-fc1e7528c93e.Text: The Rogue Trader carefully hid all evidence of {mf|his|her} deeds from the punitive unit of the Ordo Xenos. Perhaps {mf|he|she} even succeeded.

6cb20122-ceae-44bb-a644-ecd1cbc3b87d.Text: The Rogue Trader arranged the death of the punitive unit of the Ordo Xenos after having arrived on Janus. No one is the wiser that {mf|he|she} was the one behind this incident.

e7733ad9-3bf3-493a-9067-67f5c54ded0f.Text: The Rogue Trader attempted to lure the punitive unit of the Ordo Xenos into a trap on Janus, but the servants of the Inquisition managed to avoid it. Minor disruptions resembling acts of vengeance started springing up on the planet shortly after.

c7e54f2f-36c4-4d1d-b24e-abd9e403ec97.Text: The Rogue Trader forced the punitive unit of the Ordo Xenos to leave Janus. Minor disruptions resembling acts of vengeance started springing up on the planet shortly after.

2db591a0-d2c6-4170-b19e-6eb876d96187.Text: Janus is ravaged by an anomalous storm.

38c8f743-b923-40d0-9bad-c462ed488280.Text: The Rogue Trader's servants defeated the flaming blue spirit, thus bringing an end to the anomalous storm on Janus.

db328b45-0fb1-4085-b696-0145e51a4676.Text: The Rogue Trader's servants defeated the flaming purple spirit, thus bringing an end to the anomalous storm on Janus.

5fb7ecfd-9647-488b-9105-195cfda7d367.Text: The Rogue Trader's servants defeated both xenos spirits, thus bringing an end to the anomalous storm on Janus.

bde7de06-a717-4f17-84a9-7103b8aee064.Text: A catastrophic explosion occurred in the afflicted sector on Janus, triggering a shock wave that reverberated around the entirety of the planet's surface.

3a75d16e-89b3-4d19-a8c9-390d3258e773.Text: The Rogue Trader gave the warp vox to the Inquisition so that they could listen in on the heretics' plans and track them down.

2933c616-784a-4860-b490-a903d9ad1e75.Text: The Rogue Trader ordered the loyal hereteks to use the warp vox to listen in on the hostile heretics' plans.

c77f8619-8ca9-43d1-af6a-9162edb7fc2b.Text: The Rogue Trader decided to use the warp vox to listen in on the heretics' plans, but this process costs many operators their lives.

50c4c298-5f71-45da-a589-5342aff93b1a.Text: The Rogue Trader used the warp vox to broadcast sacred hymns into the Immaterium.

3af55d3d-4bb3-461f-aa67-45e37efbb29e.Text: The Rogue Trader gave orders to use the warp vox in place of the Astropathic Choir of Kiava Gamma.

7d3c34f2-18cc-4ba5-a42f-ec773851d697.Text: The Rogue Trader ordered that the warp vox be destroyed and its remains studied.

1e62260f-4e5a-4d5a-af62-a3072ac8dac0.Text: The Rogue Trader ordered that the warp vox be destroyed. It had a devastating effect on the manufactorum's technomats tasked with its destruction.

8158ddfe-6c68-4397-ad6e-bf9f60b3c90f.Text: An outbreak of tech-leprosy on Kiava Gamma decimated one of its manufactorums.

fefc53aa-3f0c-41d9-a9d1-8599179b702b.Text: Through mysterious means, Pasqal exterminated the tech-leprosy that had afflicted the manufactorum. The production facilities are being restored.

c62bc94b-1846-4d1f-87bc-271a5b6483ea.Text: The Rogue Trader destroyed the source of the tech-leprosy with an atomic strike.

07015069-7b2c-4c26-8d80-fa542d158710.Text: The Rogue Trader isolated the epicentre of the tech-leprosy outbreak and provided access to researchers from the Kasballica Mission, for a price.

29ec3003-8e2a-409a-a9d3-12b3bb55f1bc.Text: The Rogue Trader isolated the epicentre of the tech-leprosy outbreak and began studying this mysterious pestilence.

3c07c411-88b5-4b25-ba37-0164d9fbae54.Text: The Rogue Trader set up a quarantine and mercilessly set the epidemic's epicentre ablaze.

100bd7c9-1b3f-4107-aa99-b55aa5065dc0.Text: The Rogue Trader purged the epicentre of the epidemic, but minor outbreaks continue to occur on Kiava Gamma.

d1b73401-1092-4ac8-a7d2-7c8d1ca9d368.Text: The Rogue Trader purchased a number of psychically active Tech-Priests from the Adeptus Mechanicus and used them to facilitate Procedure 0-C.

7c34150a-7388-4b09-ade6-546b1088e05a.Text: The Rogue Trader ordered that Procedure 0-C be maintained, which caused a decline in the production efficiency of the world's manufactorums.

170ca859-4383-4f6d-b065-8ce54cac2fe5.Text: The Rogue Trader gave orders to utilise knowledge of xenos mechanics in order to study Procedure 0-C.

4faf1071-fc16-438a-85fc-2d068eb2ef43.Text: The Rogue Trader ordered that Procedure 0-C be studied. Many are tempted by the ancient knowledge and set out on the path of sacrilegious creation, incurring the fury of devout adherents.

66bd6bdc-69ec-4e14-ad3c-1804ee820d27.Text: Techsorcists of the Inquisition eradicated Procedure 0-C to prevent the spread of dangerous knowledge and potentially sacrilegious acts of creation.

863ef3ca-f5c5-4a17-b8b9-c8c3088cca4d.Text: The Rogue Trader forbade Procedure 0-C, displeasing many in the ranks of the Adeptus Mechanicus.

eae8d9d7-3593-4191-ad14-1ec5239cacc1.Text: Kiava Gamma was attacked by schismaticals from the Cult of the Final Dawn.

2a30b24f-7d32-4003-9908-d366e5d9d1fb.Text: The data-angels of Kiava Gamma helped the Rogue Trader to repel the schismaticals' assault. The world's population is singing hymns to express their gratitude for having saved their lives.

da46da5e-83dd-42bb-8baa-660331817cff.Text: The Rogue Trader purged Kiava Gamma of both the schismaticals and the data-angels.

f30a6fbf-558b-4178-aedb-76e68b31c7f5.Text: The Rogue Trader captured a data-angel and dissected it for the sake of knowledge.

86baf305-be48-4358-91e6-0facd085ab4d.Text: The attack of the schismaticals from the Final Dawn devastated the planet.

512b5704-adc1-43aa-a028-4f723612e498.Text: The Rogue Trader made an alliance with Null Caliph.

4a5a127e-561d-4577-ab76-d1c52fb2c090.Text: The Rogue Trader offered Null Caliph great gifts.

3eb4218f-e53c-4015-a548-e2a324895b92.Text: The Rogue Trader subjugated Null Caliph and forced it to serve {mf|him|her} as a Navigator.

217f5de4-a57a-46d8-aa3f-d87d39ec6714.Text: The Rogue Trader destroyed Null Caliph.

3305c70e-c07e-429d-a7d9-f699423d0e82.Text: Null Caliph turned its warp eye against Kiava Gamma, bringing about a terrible calamity.

f98e92ba-7d18-4eca-a690-f69f1b13cc45.Text: The Rogue Trader's servants studied the strange pictures left by the mad convicts.

8203c529-6f0f-4e30-9b88-b9b711a8765e.Text: The Rogue Trader's servants studied the strange pictures left by the mad convicts. Many prisoners were harmed in the process.

05407a17-7b26-4743-ba6c-f23895647b3f.Text: The hired smugglers discovered strange tunnels that the mad convicts are disappearing into.

2738d128-4a6c-4773-8fe0-5bb8afa105b6.Text: The Rogue Trader's servants discovered strange tunnels that the mad convicts are disappearing into. The search and the exploration of these tunnels used up substantial amounts of time and resources and distracted the guards from their primary responsibility — watching the prisoners.

39914cf6-737b-477d-9840-4a4b2fbee3ac.Text: The overseers coerced the convicts' leaders into dealing with their underlings. The leaders ordered a massacre.

08b3b898-5b6a-4551-a16a-0ada61107efa.Text: The overseers beat the mad convicts to death.

6223a0c3-d41e-4279-bd45-563d2738ba4a.Text: The Rogue Trader sent the overseers of Vheabos VI into the quarries. By recruiting new ones from the ranks of the convicts themselves, the Rogue Trader ameliorated their prison conditions and granted them some degree of control.

46de4a23-4461-4da2-a1c3-0ded7e522abb.Text: The Rogue Trader ameliorated the penal labour conditions on Vheabos VI.

72a97572-5aa6-4642-992e-2aadeec478ce.Text: The Rogue Trader ordered that the disobedient convicts be lobotomised.

28df2bbf-636a-4835-ac42-71a6c453636f.Text: The Rogue Trader ordered the authorities to harshly quell the unrest among the convicts.

deb92dd1-65f8-4b63-864a-349c0034cf4d.Text: The bloody divination ritual showed the Rogue Trader the unnerving and mysterious crime that had taken place on {mf|his|her} world. The mad soothsayer's ramblings about a sinister enemy have united the colony's population.

814fc3fd-5ed3-4006-bd71-bdca8beee9f5.Text: The Rogue Trader learned about the unnerving and mysterious crime that had taken place on {mf|his|her} world. The disturbing evidence has filled the colony's population with dread.

43ca24e7-6887-4296-8650-ef6275099df9.Text: The monstrous steel insects attacked the colony's mines, leaving much destruction in their wake.

ceec2881-5e7b-4444-9ea9-91210ab05cdf.Text: The Rogue Trader's servants fought the monstrous steel insects, using the strategy of the Adeptus Mechanicus and prevailed with minimal losses.

08dacbd9-6a61-48ee-8df4-804dc78e5ad0.Text: The Rogue Trader's servants defeated the steel insects in a bloody battle.

c00efe41-8251-4d01-8c94-90648ccd86cf.Text: Brave convicts carrying explosives sacrificed themselves to collapse the tunnels and stop the steel insects from reaching any more humans.

f8f8ac14-2c7e-4ce3-9a9d-2651539a3074.Text: Stockpiles of explosives were detonated in the tunnels to trap the steel insects underground. The operation had mixed results.

03e73a25-1a9b-4774-a227-f408d22f324f.Text: The Cult of the Final Dawn triggered a mutiny in the colony on Vheabos VI.

99f8e945-4f47-4edf-a7cf-f3812bb12a8c.Text: The overseers brutally suppressed the mutiny on Vheabos VI.

1f16e2f0-0874-4e6f-845e-6a68575a3dde.Text: The convicts' leaders put an end to the mutiny on Vheabos VI.

81aa4c12-1ab7-4f41-b77f-abd79ebb0080.Text: The gas attack ordered by the Rogue Trader killed thousands and ended the mutiny.

3844cc29-23b8-4278-a2ed-63a9eb4f648c.Text: The overseers terrorised the mutineers until the uprising on Vheabos VI was over.

38fcc2b5-8cec-41d9-bee9-61c460d4d711.Text: The Rogue Trader's threats made the mutineers on Vheabos VI surrender. The planet will not soon forget the cruelty of {mf|his|her} methods.

01925d76-db45-4011-9408-5da934f163ae.Text: The Rogue Trader used the services of mercenaries to quell the mutiny on Vheabos VI.

5ffe2be7-ff5a-4a41-9c2e-7dff612e97bd.Text: The Rogue Trader promised pardon to those who would help crush the mutiny on Vheabos VI, and the convicts eagerly answered the call.

ac8a821b-3d0b-4294-b482-ace809bbdee7.Text: A terrible act of sabotage laid waste to one of the mining complexes of Vheabos VI: the mysterious xenos poisoned its water supply.

d5cff5d4-a605-4c5e-a7fe-4797adfc63f9.Text: The mysterious xenos sorcerer was spotted in the depths of Vheabos VI and promptly destroyed.

775a2014-795d-41f7-a465-a34d0722d1a8.Text: "What is the cause of the catastrophe?"

e9211d51-7417-4c2b-8da7-20fc5c15c8b0.Text: "Signal the hives to open the gates — we will not abandon a single person in the wastelands."

f458f895-5ffe-494d-8498-9f56eadddb0c.Text: "Establish labour settlements in the ruins of Scipione 84-249 and relocate the refugees there. They have much work ahead of them to restore their former home."

1642ef30-4e64-4e1f-9e13-fe1775ee0463.Text: "These commoners think that I would be merciful to those who facilitated the hive's destruction? Eliminate any who would try to enter the cities!"

2f4f128a-0cbc-47cd-adfd-7de0d601c0dd.Text: "Abelard, remind the noble houses of their duties."

e235c810-39c3-4bb3-ae0e-49877766bcff.Text: "Argenta, see to it that the Ecclesiarchy does not ignore the laments of the dispossessed."

6eb89d5c-b86a-4d4e-9878-d61abe7922a4.Text: "Heinrix, set up prohibitive cordons at the perimeter of the hives."

ccf43bfc-2797-4dc7-8202-0593d3b17eea.Text: "Terrible news from Dargonus, Lord Captain. A subsidiary hive city, Scipione 84-249, has been destroyed in a series of cascading failures. Production has halted, and millions of people have broken their vows of obedience and are fleeing. Many of them are perishing in the wastelands and overloading the transport lines leading to neighbouring hives. The surrounding residential sectors are becoming increasingly agitated by the influx of refugees. What is your directive regarding the distribution of these refugees?"

9b2845d8-1835-4a3a-8a21-5f23c0cb8297.Text: "It is still unclear. The noble houses are casting blame on one another. Agents of the esteemed Achilleas Scalander stationed in Scipione 84-249 died heroically while trying to save the population from this disaster. Their final reports mentioned some vulnerabilities in the industrial sectors of the lower hive but did not go into further detail. All your servants are currently too busy dealing with the consequences of the crisis to investigate its causes."

dde9c772-2a43-4d52-ad2b-802fcf104ac7.Text: "The death of Achilleas's agents troubles me — it may not be a coincidence. Until the causes of the disaster can be concretely established, I would avoid letting refugees into other hives — there may be saboteurs among them. I recommend setting up prohibitive cordons, where the refugees can be contained in the wastelands between the hives."

3eb5b3bc-2d98-41a7-ba37-bdf78ab8c360.Text: "The Emperor bids us to face the often cruel strokes of fate with dignity. If the other hives do not wish to accept the unfortunate victims of this tragedy, then let the victims themselves teach those living in the hives a lesson in resilience and humility. I'm sure that the Ecclesiarchy will aid the refugees in constructing camps to survive out in the wastelands and establish a community of proud desert-dwelling martyrs. Such harsh conditions will be a crucible of fortitude and fearlessness, this tragedy a feat of spirit."

b4ec0f98-218c-4a74-bf1f-70054b04633a.Text: "The noble houses are trying to wash their hands of this — how predictable. And yet, it is their duty to see to it that the planet meets its tithe obligation and brings glory and revenue to the treasury in your absence. Let the aristocrats see to the refugees and not stop until every last one of them has been put to work!"

5a0e318b-6a25-4f10-9ed6-78f9d67234a7.Text: "I will draft a few orders for my informants on Dargonus."

3d6ed6af-c2c3-4b3c-9363-b6b2066f5c20.Text: "He who dares to remain deaf to the pleas of the destitute shall be branded a traitor to the faith."

36c40a04-fb1d-41b2-a8fe-460c6a12fb78.Text: "Lady Clementia will ensure that your declarations find their way into every ear and are zealously embraced."

bd634580-859f-46b8-94f3-fef4f6f551b2.Text: "Not a single miscreant responsible for failing the Rogue Trader shall ever find peace on Dargonus!"

138a5698-da11-4571-b45b-59fd35d7dbc3.Text: "Your mercy truly knows no bounds, Lord Captain! They shall pray for you every watch!"

4c3f7eb4-ab49-479c-8b96-ae87325b829a.Text: {n}Dargonus's nobles took no pleasure in distributing the refugees. Some of them have found their way into the personal service of the nobles, thankful to receive a nutribar and a mat to rest on for four hours between shifts. Others could only attain the most gruelling jobs at the manufactorums and service stations. They may be oppressed, but they have survived, a diaspora scattered across the hives of Dargonus.{/n}

afe123d8-d50f-4128-a6e8-bcb1f2235ecc.Text: {n}Large labour settlements were set up around the ruins of Scipione 84-249, and the refugees from the wastelands and neighbouring hives have been rounded up there. In the harsh wastelands scorched with industrial poison, with only a bare modicum of food and clean water, the settlement residents have begun the arduous and dangerous task of rebuilding their fallen home.{/n}

55e75331-1883-4d07-b9d2-05dad69ce205.Text: {n}The refugees quickly realised that they would not find shelter in the hives and dispersed across the wastelands. A harsh lesson in discipline has been delivered to the capital.{/n}

6b868b7e-5fa1-43a5-bdf2-55d04347b756.Text: {n}The hives that have accepted the refugees are now overflowing with surplus labour — the refugees are willing to work twice as hard as the usual workers, who are already exhausted by their everyday toils. Many refugees have entered the Rogue Trader's service and replenished {mf|his|her} ship's crew.{/n}

754f494e-5b3f-4027-a2f6-93256fc9df63.Text: {n}Many of the Ecclesiarchy's priests sought to share in this burden with the poor souls, coming to their villages and preaching to them about the righteousness of hard work. Some priests have even chosen to stay in the camps permanently, where the desert cults of Aconyte martyrs have begun to gather around them, glorifying the Lord Captain for granting them the right to suffer for the glory of the God-Emperor.{/n}

349984a0-8d9e-40bd-bb1a-cbbd7cf2372b.Text: {n}Van Calox's agents have run a thorough investigation to identify many of the refugees who had managed to reach and hide in the hives. Remembering how the Rogue Trader had treated their relatives and neighbours, they could have plotted their revenge... if only they hadn't been expelled into the wastelands.{/n}

ff42849a-fdaa-4b66-a237-326f47dd27f5.Text: {n}The local inhabitants of the arcologies were less than amenable to being deprived of their jobs and gave their desperate guests a rather hostile welcome. The Scipions were forced to fight back, rallying behind their leaders, the workers' foremen. The streets are awash with violence.{/n}

174d4c96-820e-4078-902a-e9900eb17824.Text: {n}Those Scipions who still managed to sneak into and hide in the hives harbour a strong resentment against the Rogue Trader who condemned their relatives and neighbours to death. They have vowed not to forget their dead.{/n}

14b6041c-5625-4307-b201-b067612fc51b.Text: "How do they survive in the wastelands? And why do they reject my rule?"

d2ae7f70-01ac-4554-9e78-f5698324562c.Text: "We will do as Kibellah says. Lay down bait and poison the Vandals."

fe3c8101-ab28-4471-95e3-93e3200a1b49.Text: "Let the foremen negotiate with the Vandals. We can spend some thrones and avoid these problems altogether."

ef14560c-7835-4105-9fb3-1d523c28f114.Text: "If they are so tenacious and militant, let them guard the hives in exchange for a small tribute."

1772185b-c8db-4566-a4a6-5515db56aca5.Text: "Destroy these engine heretics and show them no mercy!"

66266191-666b-4ea3-9927-acdeb1d806ee.Text: "Pasqal, draft a message to the Omnissian renegades. Let them serve the acquisition of Knowledge."

78a54d88-53ea-4390-8147-28e99a17b470.Text: "We will follow Yrliet's advice. Spread rumours about a great prize of some sort among the Vandals. And when they are done fighting among themselves, conduct a raid and finish them off."

696d5585-5921-45d1-a5f9-572feba5ab06.Text: "Lady Cassia is right. We should help them and give the aristocrats a real threat that will keep them in their place."

f8357649-e7a7-4987-8f77-654faee71288.Text: "I wish to hear what my advisors have to say."

a968db29-e0da-457e-a2e2-dc140f4864a9.Text: "Lord Captain, we have received a report from Dargonus. Some common folk from the now-ruined Scipione 84-249 have succumbed to the heresy of defiance. Forming into gangs known as the Engine Vandals, they now ride across the wastes on wasteland-adapted cleaning Goliaths. They have declared themselves outside the law, raiding the hives' outskirts only to escape retribution in the toxic wastelands."

8606be1f-db35-4bdb-9989-3865a15c7eaa.Text: "It is... strange to teach you the methods we employ to fight against you."

d4fbcd96-b571-4bb2-8d1a-4369367d1c9c.Text: "I am still naive of even the basics of these games played by the powerful. But my intuition tells me that this is a winning strategy."

0e7f56e0-9a8e-49a4-a959-59307a4058a5.Text: {n}A meeting with the leaders of the Engine Vandals was organised through the mediation of the foreman clan. They have gladly accepted the dynasty's proposal to serve.{/n}

ce62de75-1de9-444c-b7e0-1edf22cf07fe.Text: {n}A rumour about a heavy weapon shipment getting lost somewhere between two hives was spread among the Engine Vandals clans. A fight over seven armoured trucks, rumoured to contain cargo that would provide enough firepower to breach the defences of any hive, broke out in the wastelands. When the depleted winners had finally cut open the trucks' lining, the only thing waiting there for them was a squad of enforcers, enraged by three cycles of sitting in tight, dark spaces.{/n}

9729f66a-530d-4755-811f-59aaeaa9e855.Text: "If the Engine Vandals have managed to tame the ancient machine spirits, then that means there are technomats or even Tech-Priests among their ranks. That renders them... negotiable. It would be efficient to utilise such renegades instead of disposing of them. A promise of reward for every piece of technology found in the wastelands of Dargonus and returned to the dynasty will ensure their obedience and tractability."

275e0c72-81be-443d-b3e8-dd0bc287b4fc.Text: "If you wish to exterminate them, elantach, do not waste your time on hunting them down. Instead, deceive them into destroying each other. Tempt them with a prize, a weapon, or a trophy that they can fight over. After the mon-keigh are finished slicing each other up for the right to obtain it, your warriors will finish the deed. This tactic often proves effective against your kind."

0d9b7d92-6eff-4a5a-a3ff-8b94fe2b00e0.Text: "The aristocrats of Dargonus despise them, but are also secretly afraid of them, correct? Renegades who can invoke such fear... I wonder, had there been such exiles in my House, would their presence have curbed the ambitions of my brothers and sisters? Would they have supported me in case of conflict... Oh! I am scheming and conspiring right now, am I not?"

b2fad906-9332-482c-ae52-56fc700bdcd6.Text: "I am certain they will be diligent. Else they risk their one source of existence — your mercy."

cc369b90-7226-42e3-8d97-bcd29c0e42c5.Text: "It is a union of workers and technomats who used to serve on the lower levels of Scipione. Small-scale shift bosses, useful common folk who have proved their worth with diligent labour and valuable knowledge. Of course, they rank much lower than the esteemed merchants, to say nothing of the aristocrats, but... the common folk heed their kin, and the foremen have both the authority and the ability to manage them."

a4aaab05-dd39-48c4-bd54-d3bfe4fc4a68.Text: "Bereft of the grace of shelter behind the walls of the blessed hives, they are willing to do anything to prolong their fleeting lives under the open sky. They curse Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}'s apparent cruelty."

f8b02ded-77b7-49ce-9c3d-b4f6ea684e99.Text: "Many of them did not want to obey your more than equitable decision to send them to the restoration site of Scipione, and thus they have fled the labour settlements, committing the heresy of disobedience!"

a58daf6d-dc5b-4863-ac8e-3550d2c9d3ef.Text: "Despite your act of grace, these ungrateful heretics are fleeing the hives, abandoning their work stations, and inciting others to do the same! They even dare to spread lies and slander, stating they are being used as slaves — so great are the appetites of the yesterday's refugees!"

3cf87a5f-f07a-4af4-81c0-a1ba26256d2b.Text: "Rumour has it that the foreman clan in charge of debris removal in the ruins of Scipione associates with these Vandals. We could pass on your words to the renegades via the foremen... or force them to disclose the locations of the rebels' nomadic camps."

20350725-651b-4949-819f-c75d8280632c.Text: {n}The tribes' best warriors have died in the slaughter. The survivors were taken in by the foreman clan — more workers are always needed for rubble removal. It will be years before the Engine Vandals' numbers replenish and they can pose a threat once again.{/n}

1faa0773-4ee5-45cf-ab56-257c9cabcf7c.Text: "An answer worthy of the God-Emperor's servant! We shall find a way to handle this heresy."

72f689b9-3389-420a-8698-3609532d7c2d.Text: {n}Of course, the outskirts of the cities remain prone to incident — the savage warriors of the wastelands are always eager to raid, and rumours of petty skirmishes between them and the hive guilds regularly give the people cause to worry.{/n}

954c12f2-bb08-4c0d-bb1c-f7173bb2e0af.Text: {n}The war with the Engine Vandals took a lot of resources and effort, and supply chains between several arcologies were disrupted by the reprisal raids. Some of the populace has died of starvation or due to technical failures. Nothing, however, could stop the enforcers.{/n}

e397bc99-d1f9-4ec3-84f7-a0c27f23a4f0.Text: "Bravo, Lady Cassia. Do not be ashamed of the unique abilities bestowed upon you by your heritage. They are your birthright."

27885b54-b54d-407f-acf8-c4cac162aa15.Text: {n}Having received weapons and information, the Engine Vandals slaughtered several brash and troublesome aristocrats in a few successful raids, sowing fear and reliance on the Rogue Trader's protection. The roar of their engines was akin to the crack of a whip over the heads of frightened cattle.{/n}

17039933-080e-4576-bc59-e77883c03139.Text: "The Web teaches to look for the enemy's vulnerability in what drives them. If the enemy is compelled to seek sustenance by attacking your demesne, prepare a trap full of poisoned gifts. Let them eat and drink to their heart's content. The poison will weaken them. And then you will strike."

60a56822-a5a6-4d66-a853-8d70c217ebdb.Text: "Poison is but a tool. The enemy will be condemned by their own vices."

c59ba67c-c62d-42e4-961f-52feaf50a233.Text: {n}The Vandals took the bait: a defenceless caravan laden with provisions. The gangs feasted, unaware that the food and drink were flavoured with powerful toxins. A wave of sudden deaths soon swept across the wastelands, followed by a ruthless punitive raid.{/n}

a316e0cb-e533-4e40-a8ca-a3cfb5167388.Text: "May the lost be found yet again."

3c644858-6cd8-401d-8196-55d9ae4aadd5.Text: "It is a rather uncomfortable way of life, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. They are always on the run from acid rains and hurricanes, keeping a decent distance from the hives if they do not plan on raiding at that moment. They get their food from abandoned outposts, paying for it with the lives of those killed by autonomous security systems. Water and promethium are rationed very strictly."

e2a416f2-9fbb-4604-9b2a-376a88924003.Text: "The Scipions keep to themselves, but the foremen have not shown any signs of disloyalty. They were the first to volunteer to return to the ruins of Scipione 84-249 and start clearing the rubble. They are... certainly useful and well accustomed to praising the Emperor through their labour. Moreover, their grief at the loss of their home and the resilience with which they have borne it have made them heroes and martyrs in the eyes of other commoners."

9737ad9b-bbab-4c24-b587-680500bb2e9e.Text: "They live by marauding, occasional hunting, and plundering — sometimes their own kin, and sometimes the outskirts of the hives. They are a tribe of degenerates and barbarians that is rapidly developing its own clan culture. The civilised residents of the hives shoot the scum any chance they get."

867f49b1-b01d-4dc3-b3e2-4fa83a8be3ca.Text: {n}Hive raids have become a rare occurrence. Expeditions are returning from the wastelands with relics that were once lost to the vast plains. The foreman clan then delivers these relics straight to the dynasty's coffers.{/n}

a40ef639-922e-4a87-9a60-c841f1798b2d.Text: {n}The former servants and serfs of the Omnissiah that are now a part of the Engine Vandals were glad to actively collaborate and redeem themselves in the eyes of the Deus Mechanicus. The common folk did not dare condemn this pact, fearing the menacing priests clad in scarlet.{/n}

7855c780-ed2f-46f1-9c46-30673587f878.Text: "I will relay your order to them at once."

2515123f-b9c2-49cb-a120-e66822c97f52.Text: {n}The foremen have established a mutual understanding with the Engine Vandals by promising them food, water, and other necessary supplies. This gave birth to disgruntled whispers flittering throughout the arcologies — the Rogue Trader rewards heresy with special privileges!{/n}

a4d6e618-8c44-4eff-962a-87d11b435231.Text: "What is the cause of this affliction?"

4aa2d243-1e68-424f-a8f5-45bdb5769746.Text: "Where did the former Astropaths come from? And can we get more of them?"

5237df4f-bb85-4b68-aeda-dc17fddd0695.Text: "Bring me sanctioned Astropaths. Steal them, take them by force, threaten them — bring them to me by whatever means necessary."

8d25dfbb-0184-4337-93c2-0fc518c86e6d.Text: "Hire unsanctioned psykers. We cannot lose contact with the capital."

eaca9eac-3930-4c8e-a0ab-a8d4dff2521d.Text: "I am counting on the help of the Inquisition, Heinrix."

82d35c3c-6eee-4e03-a4d9-31c16eb07079.Text: "Idira, give me the coordinates for Leira. I will task the Dargonus fleet to make the journey and find us new Astropaths."

cc602571-7373-49dc-9ba9-24067462c279.Text: "Abelard, it is time to reach out to Theodora's old friends."

2473264c-f290-4c66-83a3-9f513f60eb03.Text: "What say my advisors? Where can we obtain a new Choir?"

304deb09-4f7e-4d12-b401-43cec8fa6ec0.Text: "Hire sanctioned Astropaths for any price. We need them."

d3c8aaf4-8365-405f-82bb-a31c539b02d8.Text: "Lord Captain, there has been a tragedy on Dargonus. Governor Drivestem has been dedicating most of his time to restoring the Astropathic Choir lost to the warp storms. But the psykers he assembled were struck by an unknown affliction. They heard... something, and it cast them into madness. The Astropaths lost sleep, started clawing at their skin to the flesh and muttering gibberish, and eventually went completely berserk. They had to be eliminated, and now only a few of the most resilient Astropaths are upholding the connection to Dargonus. But how long will they last?"

47644424-a9e5-4325-9576-5108f41969da.Text: "We could also try getting by with the resources that are already available to us — by seeking out fugitive Astropaths and having them train psychically-active citizens of the protectorate who show promise. A most regrettable violation of His laws, but, considering our grave situation..."

f1052a80-4667-4be8-a71e-5e67113e91c0.Text: {n}Naturally, this has led to much bloodshed, and many planetary governors have turned against the von Valancius dynasty, after having their valuable servants so unceremoniously taken away from them.{/n}

ec4042de-2ec5-427b-a0f3-957c1e7cbff8.Text: "It will be a heavy blow to our treasury, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. But we will manage."

67b5e57f-16d1-4721-b546-f810233681f8.Text: "Astropaths are among the most finely trained servants in the Imperium, who have beheld the light of the Emperor Himself and gained a special bond with our Master. I strongly advise the Rogue Trader to recruit only sanctioned psykers who are capable of keeping their talents in check. If there are not enough, the Inquisition will assist you in locating... and acquiring more."

6b26aa64-c927-4d15-ad31-566d0a8b0247.Text: "There are a lot of psykers on my home planet Leira, Lord Captain. Do you know why? There, we are not despised, persecuted, or enslaved on the Black Ships. There, we are sheltered from raids, educated, and respected. Of course, it's all done in secrecy from outsiders, but I can suggest which rulers to contact. Maybe the von Valancius family name will be enough to make a deal and obtain a better trained group of Astropaths than some criminal rabble."

cd8ca1d6-44ea-40e7-bcdc-3e3771257037.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, Lady Theodora not only had enemies in the Expanse, but friends as well. Those whom she helped out, rescued, and saved. I think these people can offer a helping hand. Among them are several powerful planetary rulers, who possess both Astropaths and a deep respect for your family name."

b31c401b-54a8-4e63-ad31-008846319d0e.Text: "I have received complaints that Governor Drivestem has devastated the minor Astropathic Choirs of the protectorate. He scaled them down by almost half through blatant abuse of his authority. To take more people from these Choirs would mean depriving ourselves of the connections with other worlds. We could try to hire sanctioned psykers from other domains, but... they will be few as the road to the Imperium is perilous."

d92bf87d-c35c-49c9-9a93-a6761ef92a81.Text: "Woe to any who would try to resist your will, Lord Captain."

30c23f94-4b05-4437-8110-2fddb4c5e425.Text: "You will get your Astropaths. The von Valancius dynasty is too important for us to just turn a blind eye to it in its time of need."

c0a6cf3d-c5c3-4498-b77c-59d834b7a5c9.Text: "Lady Theodora's archive likely still holds the coordinates. I will pass on the names of the more cooperative rulers on Leira to Drivestem."

345f6a95-b42c-4ba2-bdc6-3e12505d42d3.Text: "It will be done. I wonder how many of them are still alive..."

f572e3e6-03af-4452-9732-da371531a17d.Text: {n}Not even the most influential rulers could resist the fearsome agents of the Inquisition, who requisitioned their valuable servants to meet the needs of the von Valancius dynasty.{/n}

61f84099-6680-437e-a428-482af116352a.Text: {n}Through shady dens, secret sanctuaries, and pirate lairs, von Valancius agents managed to track down two dozen psykers whose abilities had never been tested or restrained by the Emperor's servants. These dangerous outlaws were brought to Dargonus.{/n}

69987d85-7e77-4d11-afa1-8763551b07ce.Text: {n}A wave of armed skirmishes and detentions swept across the Expanse. Ships carrying powerful captives have brought the new Astropathic Choir to Dargonus.{/n}

1a203e5d-1c0c-4af7-87fa-63de50bf970c.Text: {n}Using old navigational charts, the ships of Dargonus set out toward the distant planet. They returned with powerful and well-trained psykers in tow... and with news that the planet Leira had completely succumbed to heresy in recent years, and that its location should be purged from all maps.{/n}

5254b985-ccbe-4472-b046-f75c4102c666.Text: {n}A ship carrying two dozen Astropaths soon arrived on Dargonus. They descended to the surface covered head to toe in protective amulets as if going to war — the news of the tragedy that had befallen the previous Choir had quickly spread throughout the Expanse.{/n}

e54649de-ac2b-466d-9e57-98b7be8cd9bb.Text: {n}There has been no recurrence of the disastrous Astropathic madness, but the new Astropaths have all reported hearing strange whispers ever since their first day on the planet.{/n}

a2c2c646-20d1-4ad8-8767-b705d322f318.Text: "Who knows? The schemes of heretics from the Cult of the Final Dawn? The treacherous magic of the xenos? Perhaps it was a planned diversion, or perhaps merely a stray echo in the Immaterium."

7e10876b-1c32-4e16-802a-e3f31195da95.Text: {n}Each of them conveyed words of amity from the rulers who had sent them. And each asked permission to visit the family crypt to pay tribute to Lady Theodora.{/n}

a7682f7c-0699-41cd-a50f-461154ba7aa4.Text: {n}Those were hardened veterans, willing to risk their own lives in exchange for the obscenely large payments promised to their loved ones and masters.{/n}

c9679011-bf1b-4a38-99d4-b6f3362208f3.Text: {n}The new Astropaths were dangerous to both others and themselves. Their wild, untamed talent caused horrifying warp manifestations, but the casualties were a small price to pay to allow Dargonus to hear and speak to its {mf|master|mistress}.{/n}

52d88c59-2b2b-4611-91f9-971ff4d1f002.Text: "Is there any reason to believe that the disturbances are inspired by heretics?"

4bd0dcd4-22a8-403c-be65-5427e75aa1a6.Text: "We will send a spinner to Dargonus bearing guidance. Let us see how firm they are in their belief."

51c5ce9c-64f0-49b9-8fd2-5f8c9882f42e.Text: "Detain the preachers of these troublemakers and send them to be re-educated."

bc74491a-c792-4680-a398-395adeaac4b2.Text: "The Ecclesiarchy should curb their appetite. They should go fight against dissent somewhere where it will not end in riots."

31097e91-b50b-473b-810a-8bde06e522d3.Text: "The enforcers should support the Ecclesiarchy and chase away those half-heretics."

1bfa666e-a66a-4e84-9031-96eb2a56fa7a.Text: "The minor cults are hereby under my protection."

5b08db7b-bcf0-48bd-b1aa-b8ad4d99c39c.Text: "The Lex Imperialis shall be a new pillar of faith for all without exception."

5a0239f0-c789-4b74-9bc8-f4a6c4fcd752.Text: "Why are the foremen involved in this as well?"

2ac33b0d-f84c-45f7-b521-258038153973.Text: "I would like to hear what my advisors have to say."

66f37385-e047-47c1-b515-e71f5c228bde.Text: "Dargonus is crying out for aid, Lord Captain. Riots over the interpretation of scripture have broken out in several hives across the world. While hunting for the agents of the Cult of the Final Dawn, the Ecclesiarchy clamped down on the planet's minor cults, attempting to force correct adherence to the Creed upon the populace. The commoners grumble about the oppression of the minor cults, even daring to claim that the holy ecclesiarchs have assumed the sole right to speak for the God-Emperor."

6a6520bb-286d-403c-946b-40e53df149b7.Text: "The preachers there used to teach the Scipions the importance of hard work and of the labour collective's familial unity, but seldom the importance of order and hierarchy. They offered their congregation a form of faith that was as simple, cheap, convenient, and functional as their work clothes. And now they seem to think that the priests, who wallow in luxury, want to take this away from them."

712b3553-6d4b-4d1b-bb39-dd26da0ce939.Text: "The foreman clan, around which the disgruntled commoners have coalesced, are rallying crowds of workers into the streets in order to prevent the Ecclesiarchy agents from entering the sanctuaries condemned for dissolution."

5e78df44-e9b2-4500-8608-eb1248603937.Text: "Many of the disgruntled flee to the ruins of the Scipione hive since the foreman clan has promised them protection and support. It is even said that the foremen supply the malcontents with weapons converted from industrial equipment in case of large-scale clashes."

b9c04873-d23b-410e-8db6-13a634525178.Text: "A great question, Lord Captain — this group does come up in the reports from the capital world rather often. I can assume that this is due to the fact that in their now-ruined home, Scipione, they used to have a prevalent, more... simplistic form of revering the Emperor."

9a5c6d0a-6687-48ef-ba75-cd8ae538d8c2.Text: "The enforcers and the agents of the Ecclesiarchy have been able to curb the malcontents so far. But division grows wider by the day."

1983e00b-186a-48b4-9f8e-12196aa581d1.Text: "Small deviances in the Creed beget large ones, and large ones beget heresy. Our faith is founded upon absolute trust in those above us, and if these people's beliefs push them toward dissent, then those beliefs have been wicked from the very beginning. But that does not necessarily make the preachers themselves wicked — perhaps simply misguided. We could pass them into the Ecclesiarchy's care for re-education so that they may see the truth... and it would also guarantee their flock's obedience."

9d18013b-c87c-45f6-b9f1-b28457f51ac0.Text: "Shereen... perhaps you should stop allowing the fat cardinals and their servants to do whatever they want to your people? Rein them in — faith in the Exalted One is not contained within ranks and titles, but within the hearts and hands of the common people. And even this can take many forms as well! Let those who shoulder the welfare of Dargonus at least choose in which manner they pray to Him — take the minor cults under your protection!"

5ddd3f3e-9791-46b9-b537-0d4f2699255f.Text: "Good. The hostages will keep their flock from making rash decisions."

18804cd6-f23f-4774-9fc3-1a3c4945416d.Text: {n}The enforcers firmly dispersed the crowds with shock batons and choke gas. They burst into the chapels of the condemned cults, beat the servants, smashed any sacred symbols deemed unorthodox, and smothered the dangerous embers of spiritual disunion looming over the planet. The relics that were not an affront to the God-Emperor were confiscated.{/n}

94ab9cca-b2a7-4fc0-8369-4990d1906fdc.Text: "A very wise and informed decision, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"

ce897cbb-c8ca-405d-8df2-b665e3f3e192.Text: {n}Thanks to the protection of the Rogue Trader, the agents of the Ecclesiarchy were forbidden from entering the chapels of the minor cults.{/n}

f6b0f994-68e9-4a02-a279-bfefd258b039.Text: "Praise be to the God-Emperor and His steward!"

a8b8a204-a0e5-47d1-a625-2518e5c6cbee.Text: "Your mercy will go down in the annals of Dargonus, shereen!"

83b803fe-505f-4d71-9944-e49f91a8c680.Text: {n}The disobedient preachers were shackled and brought into the sanctuaries of the Ecclesiarchy to learn the true meaning of the Creed through humility and obedience. Their flock, intimidated by unspoken threats of violent reprisals against their spiritual leaders, have since fallen silent.{/n}

a5ade08d-4adf-47e1-bfe7-70864b3c3705.Text: {n}The common folk rejoiced at the news of their victory. Scoffing at the "gilded priests," they offered up a thunderous prayer for the Rogue Trader.{/n}

ec9cf0f0-0379-4879-a5b2-fa2d6b1d042a.Text: "The Arbitrators will see to it that the leaders of the faithful follow your command without any fuss."

fe7474aa-873d-44c2-b0a4-ba95d5183a8d.Text: {n}Squads of enforcers, supported by the Adeptus Arbites, presented both sides of the conflict with codes containing the Emperor's Law. The few who dared to oppose the imposition of the Lex were summarily executed, and the Ecclesiarchy and the minor cults bowed their heads and ceased fighting.{/n}

c9539307-cc2a-4075-88e4-94906cf038bb.Text: "Agents report that the disgruntled are actively negotiating with the wasteland dwellers — the remains of the so-called foreman clan. And it seems the wastelanders are willing to offer their support."

d4d0a21c-1857-457b-a675-4fe7f707c209.Text: "Thankfully, no, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. The rabble-rousers zealously oppose heresy, fill the ranks of the planetary guard with new recruits, regularly outperform quotas, and attend prayer service. The foreman clan has been actively involved in uncovering the underground devotees of the Ruinous Powers and has discovered two large, successfully operating cells. Our agents are quite confident that the likelihood of them harbouring agents of the Cult of the Final Dawn is far lower than in other segments of the population."

80c7c821-8af9-40c6-a952-a437b2a387cb.Text: {n}The representatives of the Ecclesiarchy are now forced to move around the hives in the company of numerous guards, fearing attacks from the enraged schismatics.{/n}

0fa47f90-cbc2-4c11-9923-a7943d995337.Text: {n}The agents of the Ecclesiarchy, having been reminded who truly rules Dargonus, have grown quiet. They have instead tried to win the schismatics' trust without further sabre-rattling by promising labour concessions for those who would abandon the minor cults and renounce the schismatic teachings.{/n}

5e872498-787e-44ac-ac86-61252927ba6c.Text: "Those who wish to worship Him in their own way must prove their right to do so. The only help that would be proper in this situation is to provide instruction. Send one of the spinners to show how they can defend themselves. They will either take up arms and protect their faith or bow down."

4da2afad-9965-415a-aaff-e14e4af1214f.Text: "Now they are the makers of their own future."

b4b65162-6e71-4f19-98eb-84817af3e86e.Text: {n}The spinner's instructions fell on fertile ground. The congregations of the sects rallied and began to smash the gathering places of their saintly persecutors. Fear forced the priests to cease repressions, and before long, new doctrines similar in philosophy to the Bloodspun Web began to grow among the minor cults.{/n}

12fc3a3d-1c9c-4333-8627-987af067cfa7.Text: "So, they are struggling to interpret the scriptures? I know one sacred text that proceeds from the Emperor and that invites very few conflicting readings — the Lex Imperialis. None of the troublemakers would dare question the importance of His Law or misconstrue what is written. It would serve them well to settle down and study the Injuncta Cardinal from cover to cover."

93f73473-f616-4ff4-8205-b6d552b676de.Text: "The enforcers must arm themselves and stand fast. With all their might, let us crush them."

1f6c1e23-9f8e-44bb-b03c-60885ed2bd72.Text: "What exactly did my people find out?"

8de80cee-f5b9-424f-a8e3-530e00dd21a5.Text: "I like Ulfar's plan — we shall do as the Emperor's Angel said! Let us crush the infected sectors from orbit."

7006f8d7-07b9-4901-8d4b-4e2c4b80e09f.Text: "We shall make this quick and quiet. You should get rid of the leaders first."

45da63d0-2833-444f-8e3b-55847449179e.Text: "The foreman clan is a cover for this disgusting cult?"

903790a6-5866-48f4-8052-e71b07fe7f8f.Text: "What forces do they have at their disposal?"

47958302-1b85-416e-a547-be85da6ada87.Text: "The enforcers should attack the headquarters swiftly and suddenly."

b9d667e3-d90d-456a-875c-020b4fb09cd6.Text: "We should give them a taste of their own medicine. Organise collapses and system failures inside the infected sectors that are guaranteed to destroy them."

4c9be437-b381-40f8-91d8-5c92e14f3529.Text: "Heinrix, prepare a plan for a psychic attack. After that, we shall launch a surprise assault on the cult's headquarters."

0098f434-b767-4580-869c-ff0ede3e3079.Text: "Marazhai, we shall feed the heretics to your kinsmen. And then we will finish off the disorganised enemy."

bfc10405-acf8-4f9a-99b5-e402745abb4a.Text: "Do those abominations look like the ones on my ship? The same cursed brood?"

faac8420-5fe7-48cc-8c54-3ace0508fd3e.Text: "Argenta is right. We will announce to the people that we have an enemy in our midst. They should come to the aid of the enforcers who will be attacking in full force."

33c9e8de-f4d0-4486-a7ba-26b8818c0d24.Text: "What is this mutant plague that has affected our capital?"

c1ca29fd-15f8-4a9b-9d9a-939b65e7ccd5.Text: {n}Everything was over after one planetary cycle. The filthy shrines and the heretic sanctuaries were set ablaze, the cult's agents mercilessly exterminated, and the rest of the aberrations' strength crushed amid street battles.{/n}

5d56b121-3ed2-49b0-9c6f-be9f0847ab24.Text: "They are called Genestealers, and they are not simple mutants. They are a xenos plague that breeds inside the human brain, forever distorting their genetic makeup and enslaving them to the brood. This is much more threatening than the Drukhari fleet that ravaged the capital earlier. If they are on Dargonus, then they will try to overtake the entire planet sooner or later."

f42c43bf-43a4-4a22-90ea-b3b28dac7370.Text: {n}The next planetary cycle brought heavy losses for Dargonus. Mustering additional forces, the heretic cult struck back. The raging hordes of degenerates, sabotage, explosions, and skirmishes claimed the lives of thousands of the dynasty's best servants. But the outcome was predetermined, and the filthy shrines of the heretics were set ablaze.{/n}

1a877ca5-0862-482b-99ac-b69c91693c67.Text: {n}The wrecked ships came crashing down in great flames — an impressive demonstration of the strength and power of the Rogue Trader, who had turned the very sky against {mf|his|her} enemies.{/n}

82dd52bb-4f0f-4982-8e7a-baabd90d93cb.Text: {n}Raging fires incinerated the shrines of the heretics, and the enforcers, following behind the searing wall, finished the job in a quick and bloody fashion.{/n}

508549b0-019a-4201-b547-d7957abaedf7.Text: {n}Unfortunately, the cult also had shelters that were impossible to strike. Realising that they stood no chance, the heretics' leaders gave one final order — retaliate!{/n}

4ca64f95-bd81-46f3-9139-b8e094857001.Text: "{name}, raise the people to battle, and publicly proclaim war. Tell the people that the heretics are hiding among them and the millions of loyal subjects will grind the thousands of traitors to dust. May Dargonus cleanse itself of this filth!"

80b2a41e-7f61-4f18-8837-6f10fb6788a3.Text: "The unsanctioned psykers gathered on Dargonus are ready for the psychic engagement. Sadly, they are not very skilled, but they do not fear death — they are too used to its constant companionship. The enemy will not strike fear in them."

2cf1a72c-9e8f-4e3b-bca8-17a9506f8ed1.Text: "May your servants stand against the heretics, a glorious indestructible wall!"

82bba760-580a-4a02-9608-8cd6a95fdd84.Text: {n}Marazhai's caustic laugh sends shivers down your spine.{/n} "Let others sully their hands. Just one beacon — and my kinsmen will descend upon the affected hives. Perhaps they will cause some additional casualties here and there... but, have no doubt, none of your enemies will survive, even hiding in their little nests."

801be3ad-d874-4605-9a8b-b9060e7d5172.Text: "The cleansing should be thorough. A good few wrecks of dead ships still linger in orbit after the day the xenos scum attacked your world. Command your fleet to pick them up and send them plummeting toward the nests of this spawn trying to encroach on your domain!"

5b2a620b-8a5e-499a-b0da-395dcdaf636d.Text: {n}The main forces of the cult were thankfully gathered at the Scipione labour settlements, where the extermination process caused low collateral damage.{/n}

796687b6-d512-47ba-907c-6bb4c30003f1.Text: {n}The Engine Vandals arrived to assist the cult, led by the voice of the brood. They too had been corrupted by the gene plague. The outskirts of the hives were scorched by promethium flames, and tens of thousands of innocents perished in the ensuing inferno.{/n}

2f09562b-bd68-4fa8-ab6c-05ee04c6a47d.Text: "The heretics mostly consist of workers, but some have infiltrated the guard as well. Their weapons are primarily made from repurposed industrial machinery. The cultists are fearless and will readily sacrifice themselves for the sake of their common goal. But the worst part is their psychic threat. We cannot even begin to gauge it."

a492c7e4-9b7e-467c-99ee-3515a3c8c654.Text: {n}Only one thing filled the Rogue Trader's servants with unease. Inside the cult's main temple, they found the den of some grotesquely enormous monster — it was empty. They did not find the beast. If the Emperor had been merciful to Dargonus, the monster would surely have perished in the fires that had engulfed the hives during that cycle.{/n}

0422bc69-4e41-40fc-96c4-c9fb9700f972.Text: "I will tell you where the inactive beacons we can use are hidden on Dargonus... You thought that you had discovered all of my secrets, did you?"

048b988d-d3ce-4001-b9f2-a1b6944ac392.Text: "I will send the Inquisition directives developed specifically for this scenario to Dargonus."

abbcbe9e-b24e-44c6-9694-1002dbc3a5c5.Text: "The messengers of the Great Devourer... My kin can sense the shapeshifters, but you should stay vigilant, elantach. For a species as psychically weak as the mon-keigh, their arrival may spell death."

83455ddd-f991-41ae-8249-b8fcd0788505.Text: "Living in the secluded labour settlements of the ruined Scipione, they could act with impunity, but at least it prevented them from infecting the hives as severely as they could have done."

e7185fa4-854b-4805-93b6-b1edebc4dd8a.Text: {n}Thankfully, there were much fewer cult hideouts in the hives than expected. Losses were relatively small... on a planetary scale.{/n}

e7e2942d-81d8-4447-a310-e498e2e3dc4b.Text: {n}Unfortunately, the cult realised that their secret had been discovered before all the leaders of the heresy could be exterminated. The final order was given — retaliate!{/n}

c78b94ac-4c83-48c9-aab2-30ac00ffd81f.Text: {n}The surprise raid of the Drukhari proved to be an excellent distraction — the heretics could not have guessed that this attack was being directed at the behest of the Rogue Trader, who had uncovered their despicable conspiracy. This attack granted the Lord Captain's servants some precious time.{/n}

cd068288-840d-4a6d-a94e-027fb813f7ac.Text: {n}The allies of the cult among the Engine Vandals heard the voice of the brood pleading for help, yet very few of them answered — those leaders still loyal to the Rogue Trader had been warned in advance and had treacherously killed most of those intending to raid the hives.{/n}

bb8a5169-292d-4c4a-8133-57620781801c.Text: "Terrible news from Dargonus, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Your vigilant servants have discovered an abscess of treachery on our capital world, one that has grown far too large and could rupture at any moment! The informants report that the group known as the foreman clan is actually a cover for a horrendous cult of genetic aberrations, who currently have their people in every echelon of the hive! They are traitors to the purity of Humanity, traitors to the Creed, rebels and heretics!"

fc8b992b-d154-4e3f-a5f3-e0601190a943.Text: "One tenacious clerk from the Administratum questioned the authenticity of the reports coming from the ruins of Scipione 84-249. He personally observed the debris removal and entered the lower levels of the fallen hive. There he discovered signs that proved Scipione had been infected by the gene plague. Thousands of corpses of the extra-armed abominations had been buried in a mass grave!"

46cdbde6-58c7-41c7-a5cc-52eb2a2d5de3.Text: {n}At the appointed time, the hives of Dargonus shook from the thunderous tread of combat vehicles. An army of enforcers came to wage war on the mutant heretics. The heretics, despite having time to prepare their defences, could not match the planetary guard's weaponry.{/n}

cb8982dd-02c9-430b-ac0c-34b45235f82e.Text: "Indeed. They probably began by recruiting workers — it is easy to blend in with the labouring riffraff. Posing as a union of technomats, they were able to conceal their secret operations and infiltration into the upper echelons of power. Each new crisis allowed them to gain more of our trust and resources."

5fc007a9-32fd-4fe3-b1bd-cf916ddd2788.Text: {n}The enforcers were supported by an enraged mob led by a fanatically howling priest. The fight quickly devolved into a bloody riot.{/n}

cabbd692-25d4-4a67-b4ef-5d0b1d292fa0.Text: {n}The clueless followers of the minor cults rallied around the foreman clan, seeing the attackers as yet another attempt to oppress them. They were unaware that they were helping sustain a genetic plague that had infected their world.{/n}

04b992e9-5303-4f4f-9846-d73b8e8fe0b2.Text: {n}But the heretics did not go down without a fight. Soon, an enraged outcry of psychic energy from the brood swept through the hives, plunging the dynasty's brave warriors into horror or bloody insanity. The Astropathic Choir managed to drown it out with their menacing chants, but this was a test of wills, and only the most disciplined and steadfast psykers withstood its sheer force.{/n}

48306621-8170-4c6d-aded-4845164e4278.Text: {n}At the appointed time, the undeclared war against the cult began — the leaders of the cult were quietly eliminated, all without lifting the veil of secrecy.{/n}

159d7265-62c0-4d9d-8be9-d4151fe57abf.Text: "We fear that the tribes of the Engine Vandals will support them as well, partially influenced by the plague and partially lured by the promise of a good raid."

343f32c5-c466-4b33-9749-e3058fefbcb6.Text: "Some of the Engine Vandals could be infected by this plague, but most of them are more likely to come to our aid — they are too used to eating out of Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}'s hand to bite it."

da560459-df10-434d-8d0d-e831bd3a9d58.Text: "If we had not crushed the Engine Vandals, they could have joined the ranks of the cult. At least we warded off that particular threat in time."

727a7468-1bd4-4c66-9104-1e54ac101889.Text: "The Astropaths we have forced to serve on Dargonus are afraid. They do not wish to become a living shield if the enemy launches another psychic assault at us. I fear that this line in our defence is quite fragile."

7b7ac797-32ad-4557-91a1-3519966989f0.Text: "The sanctioned psykers we have gathered on Dargonus are prepared for the psychic engagement. They are disciplined, powerful, fearless, and will remain unwavering against the blows of our sinister enemy."

8d0c6e37-b5f2-4200-88e8-a2730e5890b7.Text: "Absolutely right. It is impossible to negotiate with the degenerates. Our only option is to completely annihilate them. We should start from the top. Should we attack decisively and quickly, or should we show our hand by bringing assault vehicles into the capital and gain an advantage in firepower? Do we quietly eliminate their leaders, or do we rain destruction upon the infected territories and cleanse them of traitors?"

9a2b02b3-f6a9-4fae-bbf6-a969932baa32.Text: "Praise be! It was wise not to let them into the hives on pain of death! Scurrying through the wastelands, they could only recruit the Vandals dwelling there, and very few of the cult's cells managed to form inside the hives themselves."

1b159eea-27bb-4185-8139-010d64bbf168.Text: {n}At the appointed time, the infected residential sectors were synchronously shaken by explosions and collapsing structures. Though innocents also perished under the debris, the heretics could not escape retribution.{/n}

2aa15ffe-60f3-4567-bf51-93f4540925ab.Text: {n}Sadly, both the plague and the influence of the foreman clan had already spread far and wide, multiplying the death toll.{/n}

cbb35288-424d-4999-8350-59706d1e097b.Text: "Since all of them are linked by a common will, we could start by launching our attack there. If the Astropathic Choir could drown out the voice of the brood, we would be able to launch a sudden strike and act quickly enough before the enemy could restore cohesion and alert their forces to the assault."

aa242161-f6f7-48d6-896c-fb84e2513dc6.Text: {n}At the appointed time, the enforcers started their simultaneous raids in all the hives of the capital. Relying on stealth and surprise, they did not use heavy weapons of war.{/n}

1c69505e-d4f3-427b-9af5-8feaf9cc6d00.Text: "A fair price for the cleansing of our capital."

b163f13d-8488-4852-86d4-63227437abed.Text: "Ha, how I would enjoy seeing the carcasses of the spacecraft burn in the atmosphere and come crashing down on the heads of these miserable heretics!"

06ba80ee-314f-4a2f-964d-65b49f5b140f.Text: {n}The inhabitants of the hives readily threw their support behind the enforcers after watching them severely punish the minor cults — the lesson in obedience had been learned, and the volunteers hoped to obtain some spoils from the losing side.{/n}

c656a914-5c46-4469-8807-79c051102602.Text: "I am afraid so, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. The descriptions from Dargonus are quite similar to what we have witnessed ourselves: the same deformities, the same underhanded tactics. Either they are kin to our aberrations, or they are another branch stemming from the same foul root."

8ec46658-21b1-4585-ad08-03f51ed968fe.Text: "When Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} stood up for the minor cults, they received a golden opportunity to recruit more openly to their ranks, which are now brimming with fools who have yet to realise that they are partaking in a heretical conspiracy."

c84417c1-1194-4e0f-a0b5-66b87d9f8d85.Text: "Apparently, their unholy sermons speak of 'the three sorrowful phalanges of a finger pointing the way to retribution and unity.'"

a1123269-0241-42a1-9159-d1a917100bb2.Text: "May the mutant heretics perish in the cleansing flames!"

3a8529a1-65a1-4ee7-bf9b-2baada896a1e.Text: "The death cults that had sprung up through the intercession of the Bloodspun Web had gotten wind of the trouble and sent quite a few misguided parishioners to the Undying One, depriving the heretics of some recruits."

c3ee3328-04f5-429a-a1dc-c856296b9225.Text: {n}The death cultists of the capital world took to the streets and swirled in a sacred dance, their blades whistling as they cut short the lives of the wicked — a great ritual to praise His name.{/n}

830199bd-8e95-4814-ac34-ec6096f5ee61.Text: {n}At the same time, the Astropathic Choir launched a truly devastating attack on the grim psychic shadow hanging above the hives of Dargonus. This attack stunned the brood of heretics and temporarily cut off their psychic communication.{/n}

5e829feb-8cea-447b-ac91-23bdc803435c.Text: "He also found the remains of Achilleas Scalander's people. It seems that they had noticed the signs of corruption, and the traitors, aiming to cover up their crimes, buried their misdeeds under the ruins of the hive! On the way back, the clerk's transport was destroyed, but he miraculously managed to survive. Now the heretics think that they have covered their tracks once more, and so they continue their plots, oblivious and unprepared for our attack."

b8f31e75-b68a-4bcc-a405-b1b152d204bb.Text: "The suppression of the minor cults dealt them a harsh blow. By bringing the flock back into the fold of obedience, we have reduced the number of potential new recruits."

9453abbf-1f46-4def-8cfe-c3b21ed5bd8d.Text: "A horrendous distortion of the human form! It seems that they spread their poison by biting and enslaving their victims. Some of them are indistinguishable from normal humans, while others are disgustingly ugly — the heretics hide them away from prying eyes. They seem to be connected by a common consciousness and are absolutely loyal to the despicable cult! The Astropathic Choirmaster of Dargonus has suggested that the cult may be behind the extermination of the psykers on the planet — he can sense the ghost of a powerful consciousness of some sort."

10068935-19cf-425e-90d2-5bbfea45fc07.Text: "And most despicable of all is that they have perverted our faith! They revere the God-Emperor in the form of a four-armed monstrosity. Their prayers are full of hatred toward those in power and promises of a reckoning when their dreadful 'deity' will come and equate them with their oppressors... With us, that is. Many fools and troublemakers have fallen for their lies."

37fce4bf-f56b-40db-b094-aae07d5bed5d.Text: "By letting them infiltrate the other hives, we allowed them to spread like an epidemic. Now their cult has cells everywhere."

577a91a9-5512-41a2-b8a8-0a7b66c35b0d.Text: {n}When the heretics finally realised that they were facing extermination, it was too late. Their leaders were slain and the rest of them died amid the carnage of the street battles.{/n}

a5d47f7b-6eff-4999-a1a3-1514ea8b922c.Text: {n}The element of surprise facilitated the swift extermination of the cult leaders, leading the rest of the heretics to lose heart. The filthy shrines of the heretics were set ablaze.{/n}

2bac9c13-1168-48bd-93b7-9fcb3fcf70d0.Text: {n}Alas, the element of surprise was not enough to decapitate the cult. After the initial shock, the heretics' leaders rallied their kinsmen for a final confrontation.{/n}

ad8477d9-38a6-4d9c-8fbe-528c7c73add5.Text: {n}A pathetically small band of the Engine Vandals who answered the call of the brood died ignominiously outside the walls of the hives.{/n}

38b27aae-d216-4677-9d53-8226da5b0729.Text: "We shall allow the Malpians to prove the strength of their convictions through a severe trial of faith."

8b7e680b-9fde-4cf7-9bf5-211ba77a914f.Text: "Let them bring forth their representatives and try to negotiate some form of coexistence."

5aac2d70-6ed1-4765-be91-9ef29f72e8a7.Text: "These guests who seem to have forgotten their manners will be summarily punished — one week without water rations. We share the indignation of the Order of the Hammer."

938bf110-e008-4a9c-9fa7-58ebcab82102.Text: "Heinrix is right. Let us send the most zealous ones on a repentant pilgrimage to retrieve the relics."

fad6fc59-6602-4463-a93f-8d2fb5d91de9.Text: "The Malpians display impressive zeal. I charge the Order of the Hammer to welcome one hundred of the new arrivals into their ranks. Let them learn one another's ways and come to accept their distinct paths toward the reverence of Cognatius."

67d6f093-6ec2-449e-9a8a-9de373d81bba.Text: "Who is this Nicomedes and Philopimenes? What is the issue here?"

5c39fc9c-7d53-41b9-8c57-78ca0886ae32.Text: "We should follow the edict of the Fifth Ophelian Council. Let might decide whose beliefs are just."

b57eb330-0d25-4cc2-a922-9ed0a69c6137.Text: "The Malpian preachers belong to the Bloodspun Web now. Bring them aboard."

b02d1872-a6cc-4942-9667-715bb72d9ea6.Text: "Lord Captain, the world of Foulstone has been upset by a conflict between the followers of the Order of the Hammer and the refugees from the Winterscale dynasty's domain. An argument broke out near the tomb of the renowned holy man Nicomedes Keefe, and the tomb was damaged in the fray. The pilgrims revering Keefe's rival, Philopimenes of Malpi, claim Keefe to be a thief who had stolen the relics of Saint Cognatius and violated the sacred mystery of his resting place to sate his greed. The Order of the Hammer is furious at the heretical statements and the desecration of Keefe's burial site."

e18ad30c-61ef-4409-811b-08d1fe1dae15.Text: "Saint Nicomedes Keefe is a missionary who arrived in the Expanse alongside the founders of the Order of the Hammer, offering them valuable guidance for colonising Foulstone. He converted many worlds to the Imperial Creed, but his most famous feat was his search for the burial site of the legendary preacher, Saint Cognatius, who conquered the Expanse thousands of years ago, leaving behind scores of relics. Keefe was able to track down some of those relics. The Order was named after the power hammer of Saint Cognatius, Piety's Charge."

f7ca5a46-423f-4751-8965-a414056fa7e1.Text: "Philopimenes of Malpi is a priest from Winterscale's Realm. He preached in the same times as Nicomedes Keefe and denounced him for the false veneration of Saint Cognatius. He believed that Cognatius preached the incomprehensibility of the highest wisdom to the people, and that any attempts to learn it would only lead to heresy. He called the search for Saint Cognatius's burial site blasphemy and the collection of relics looting and soliciting. In his opinion, the sacred objects should not be congregated in one place but should find haven across the many worlds. The relics are power, and their aggregation gives way to pride."

256b9698-84bd-4d3c-95db-ced02d382b8e.Text: {n}Several thousand refugees have been sent on a pilgrimage of penance to search for the relics of Saint Cognatius. Many believed that it was just a way to get rid of these inconvenient people.{/n}
