a53069f0-5f47-485f-8bcf-4e3ef0e8239f.Text: {n}The rebels were severely punished. Several dozen of the insolent renegades have died of thirst as a result of this penance, and the rest have been subdued.{/n}

1e7ae969-8bbc-4cf0-a58d-06a39ca52c5d.Text: "They will not cause us any more trouble."

22abf8f9-61df-47b8-9b23-0d93aa4fbe93.Text: "For a group that has just arrived in a foreign realm, the Malpians' conduct is insolent at best. Penance should be imposed on them. We will send them on a pilgrimage to find the relics of Saint Cognatius and to learn the ways of Saint Keefe. In this way, they would be of use for returning the lost relics, and the Order of the Hammer would be satisfied with a just verdict."

58ef1a83-68d4-4911-b972-f93b18041995.Text: "There was a similar theological dispute at the Fifth Ophelian Council, and the conflict between the two cults was resolved in sacred duel. Twenty champions from each side came forward, both sides vowing to accept the victor's teachings if they lost. I propose to invoke the council's edict and settle the dispute in the same way."

ffa260ad-a134-4a71-b329-834413cbc750.Text: "Hmm... They believe that their faith is superior? Then let them prove it. Subject them to a severe test of faith. If they survive it, they will have proven their steadfastness. Even if the Order of the Hammer does not accept their arguments, it will be easier for them to recognise the newcomers' right to interpret the way of Saint Cognatius if they prove it with their own blood and pain."

67762e24-50cf-4368-8c64-e604c324e56f.Text: "I have had ample experience with saintly saviours like him in the past. Whatever great cause they proclaim as their mission, they genuinely, naively believe that people really do need them. If we round up enough orphans and lepers who would trip over themselves to beg our prophet for salvation, he will soon forget all about the Crucible and his holy mission. I know a few guilds of professional beggars who would be delighted to offer their services to us."

e0c59589-6468-48d3-9c00-fb1c90654144.Text: {n}The Order of the Hammer thanked the Lord Captain for {mf|his|her} protection and staying true to the agreements between them.{/n}

9b37343c-25ba-4887-9011-b8debd7453ff.Text: {n}One hundred Malpians have volunteered to undergo the trial of faith. Sixty-two have survived, proving the steadfastness of their beliefs and earning the respect of the Order of the Hammer.{/n}

b589e7df-1825-4018-a200-037cf87728f1.Text: {n}Four dozen fighters clashed in a bitter struggle. The forces were an equal match, and thus the duel righteous. By the end, only the indomitable Hectarchius, the prelate of the Order of the Hammer, was left standing, and, honouring their vow, the Malpians bowed down to him and accepted the teachings of Saint Nicomedes.{/n}

ab062c07-a492-468c-b4d5-cc84a706b3b8.Text: {n}The indomitable teaching of Philopimenes of Malpi laid down deep roots upon the hard soil of Foulstone. The followers of his teachings were zealous and determined.{/n}

5b9d1647-3455-4b8b-bd4f-0ceeb2cd939d.Text: "The Malpians have renounced the concept of possession. Their vows are true and similar to ours, but they lack humility and reverence for the dead. The Bloodspun Web could embrace their leaders. We could teach them. We could soothe the turmoil."

61e97d75-180f-4c42-aaf7-95906ebc31f3.Text: "From this day forth, these people serve the Undying One."

17bef33e-c69f-4a1e-b039-149b72de00ae.Text: {n}A grim and solemn procession of preachers came aboard and made a vocal renunciation of their former lives. Disturbed by the loss of their spiritual leaders, the refugees quieted down and no longer defied the Order of the Hammer.{/n}

f2083ce9-9db2-4185-8442-e5c9b1caabf0.Text: {n}One hundred Malpians were tonsured into the Order of the Hammer, and the two teachings were forced to coexist within the walls of one monastery.{/n}

90827196-b1bf-476d-a840-9d2b3da15ea0.Text: "Let them show the weight of their words and teachings."

0503e124-53e9-4a2b-acd6-24a7c77fc2d6.Text: {n}Putting forth two dozen wise men from each side, the two cults have sought to find a common interpretation of the way of Saint Cognatius. They may not have achieved dogmatic unity, but they have at least managed to find a way to coexist on the same world.{/n}

c79dbe0e-47d7-460c-959c-3b53367f25dd.Text: "I will arrange for the duelling grounds to be prepared in the monastery."

b30234e7-a53d-4b5f-a510-883a38c1983f.Text: "Solomorne is right. Why choose one? I hereby order the candidates to pool their efforts."

b4c64d44-f92c-4896-8dc9-5c873b74a026.Text: "Does Prelate Hectarchius's death not strike you as odd?"

12b3420c-1873-4eec-a445-c35c5d41591b.Text: "How does the order intend to carry out Saint Cognatius's mission?"

592e259d-01b0-431a-9344-01335454b38c.Text: "I wish to know more about the candidates."

9017b8db-44c3-4ffc-be14-cde9e95a67ec.Text: "Let Lugnalia meet with Hieronymus Doloroso. If he approves of her candidature, we will support her."

728c1655-4c29-4421-9363-91fb34d49264.Text: "Abelard, see to it that House Drivestem thanks us for the assistance we provided to their kin."

f3c41251-dddd-4d6c-ac14-6226525527cb.Text: "Idira, uncover some of Nigmus's little secrets. I need an obedient prelate."

6a9eedd1-4c8c-4412-a567-0330eb80fae5.Text: "I need an obedient prelate. One such as Brother Nigmus."

07171c41-621e-4e85-b179-b619f7cf587f.Text: "I bring woeful news, Lord Captain. Prelate Hectarchius of the Order of the Hammer has passed away."

5a7ae4de-dc34-48d6-89b9-c832bd4e6823.Text: "Immediately after the launch of the orbital vox-spire, he entered the halls of recording and, having sat on the command throne, was granted a vision. For over three days, Prelate Hectarchius preached about Saint Cognatius being reincarnated in a body made from the saint's own holy relics. This spiritual feat depleted Prelate Hectarchius's strength, and he peacefully departed for the Emperor's Throne shortly after the sermon's conclusion."

5ba0188d-44a7-4080-b55e-1ac44c42366e.Text: "During the great purge conducted by the righteous of Foulstone, a den of subhuman deviants was uncovered. The prelate personally led the purge, sustained a grievous wound, and died the next planetary turn. On his deathbed, he was granted a vision where Saint Cognatius was reincarnated in a body made from the saint's holy relics."

099aef58-3093-4093-ad8e-3e1145b49d7c.Text: "The Order's elders believe this to be a sign that Saint Cognatius's relics, currently stored on planets throughout the Expanse, must be brought together. The Order is preparing for the election of a new prelate, under whose guidance it will undertake this holy mission. The majority of the votes are divided between Prioress Lugnalia, well known for her fervour, and the merciful cellarer Tychon. The minority of the order sees the oikonomos Nigmus, a humble and reasonable man, as their prelate."

20cdba1d-2f3b-4852-b3cd-73913fd38680.Text: {n}The support of the Rogue Trader aided the elderly monk in being elected prelate. Equally famous for his piety and ardent distrust of literacy, Inocrant has vigorously proclaimed to the Order that ignorance is bliss, expressly forbidding any meditation of comprehension at the shrines of Cognatius. Surrounding himself with illiterate zealots, he preached to the mob about the limitations of knowledge and the absolute superiority of faith.{/n}

89624698-3bda-4727-891b-33441f207a17.Text: {n}House Drivestem has been informed of the honour granted to their family and has humbly requested to cover all expenses related to Prelate Tychon's endeavours.{/n}

e68faffc-be79-46e1-a9e0-c23e63be3a67.Text: {n}Idira's investigation uncovered no egregious crimes in Nigmus's past, but it did reveal a few minor but less than virtuous faults. The new prelate will agree to anything to keep his secrets hidden.{/n}

4d1f26b6-d8d8-4338-8e92-b1c2b7d34ae9.Text: "There was nothing strange about his wounds. He could have recovered from such injuries thirty years ago, but not now."

61070cbc-4a53-4cac-a789-e48b2da207d6.Text: "He yearned for a worthy spiritual feat, and, when presented with the chance to serve as the voice of a saint, he gave what little strength remained. When he died, he was exhausted, but content."

8d64e371-e5b6-41e3-b6a3-5545d32a4b93.Text: "The conclave aims to procure all the relics that once belonged to Saint Cognatius, all that can possibly be procured. Given that the saint is a legendary figure, many items in the Koronus Expanse have an alleged connection to him. However, it seems unlikely that any of the relics' owners will be eager to part with them. The answer to the question of how the Order of the Hammer is going to retrieve them depends on the identity of its next prelate."

e34f0ff4-465f-4f02-b476-f64a86aae5ef.Text: "Prioress Lugnalia was converted by Hectarchius on one of the heathen worlds. She then served as his bodyguard for many years and eventually became the protector of the order's reliquary and the leader of its military branch. As for Brother Tychon, he is an aristocrat by birth, he had an excellent education and could have lived in luxury had he not renounced secular life for the sake of ascetic vows. He is intelligent, thoughtful, well read, and, most importantly, genuinely merciful."

6fb66035-da07-4e65-b3de-8d3ab262675f.Text: "Few things can be said about the oikonomos Nigmus. He has never been famous for his prowess in battle or his sermons, but the monastery has never wanted for anything on his watch. He is a most reasonable and unobtrusive individual."

fb32cfd5-ab6f-4534-b1d0-b478d56a87b7.Text: "I have sympathy for Prioress Lugnalia. Let her meet with Reverend Hieronymus on Footfall — should he accept her as a worthy leader, we ought to support her."

14e2ac4c-5b2b-4159-9b62-ad9540d08b2b.Text: "A careful and sensible oikonomos sounds like a safer bet to me than a fanatic or a clever aristocrat. The voices say that he has a few paltry secrets, and knowledge of those secrets guarantees us his loyalty."

112cc4ee-4305-49c7-acce-28f42bb32d39.Text: "Brother Tychon... He and I have met, back when he was called Tychon Drivestem. He wasn't a monk back then, he was a grandson and heir to Urbend, Governor of Dargonus. An honourable young man with a spark in his eyes. His ascension would mean much to the Drivestems."

c2a14c61-8460-4c3e-b0f3-712494ccb00f.Text: "I will inform the conclave of your decision. The order won't be able to ignore such compelling advice."

e4d7bf7a-4b81-4f54-bc60-9d16eebb1fcc.Text: "Will do. I bet Urbend never thought the boy would be of any use to the family. Now we will have to endure a decade of him boasting about 'the Drivestem blood that always strives for great heights.' Tch."

e3e325ae-8272-4f7d-a2ca-933b45bd609d.Text: "The voices will tell me where to look."

e7783e88-7e10-4a07-ac54-5bd60b4d97df.Text: "The priesthood of the Order will be furious, but would not dare to oppose your will."

eba4ed2f-2d62-41a9-ad97-b4113163db34.Text: "There is another candidate as well — Elder Inocrant, but his flock is very small. Inocrant belongs to the Malpians and was recently accepted into the Order. The priesthood assumes that, as the prelate, he would not push hard for the searching of shrines, but, on the contrary, would preach the bliss of ignorance, hindering the comprehension of Saint Cognatius's wisdom."

c928196f-e3b8-4855-8e75-353476199eae.Text: "Hmm. The three of them together would make a passable prelate. I mean it. None of the contenders can match the late Hectarchius in authority, so, regardless of whom you select, the others are unlikely to accept them as their new superior without complaint. You should bind them with oaths and compel them to work together."

91b38f0d-2044-452f-b4ac-39ebbe7d1caa.Text: "Each of them has their strengths and weaknesses — so let them complement one another."

98b7fe76-6397-4054-8cba-2fc9d70ad437.Text: {n}Although surprised, Hectarchius's successors saw the unorthodox decision as a sign. The late prelate's three-day sermon, along with the appointment of three new heads of the Order, might point to three being the number of genuine relics of Saint Cognatius still remaining in the Expanse. Energised by the momentous shifts in the life of the planet, the prelates, now styling themselves as the Triad of the Hammer, eagerly set out to search for the sacred objects.{/n}

10affab1-140d-49de-8235-a7209974f27b.Text: "I'm afraid it does not. The esteemed Hectarchius began his service as a battle missionary, and has long grown weary of the peaceful life befitting a man of his status."

1c5d39e0-cbb9-4106-9c06-b543c0621363.Text: {n}Prioress Lugnalia has been chosen as the prelate of the Order of the Hammer. A faithful militia is taking up arms to stake their claim to Saint Cognatius's relics. The neighbouring worlds look upon Foulstone with worry and fear, just as they do upon its {mf|patron|patroness} — the Rogue Trader.{/n}

f3c46c80-9123-49d9-9524-c1198706057b.Text: {n}Brother Tychon has been chosen as the prelate of the Order of the Hammer. Peaceful emissaries departed from Foulstone for many planets to form alliances and reinforce spiritual ties with the holders of Saint Cognatius's relics. This diplomatic mission will undoubtedly require sizeable financial support.{/n}

4f091e26-d062-496d-b071-d51c5dadb43d.Text: {n}Brother Nigmus has been chosen as the prelate of the Order of the Hammer. His careful policy is far more oriented toward satisfying the Rogue Trader than successfully collecting Saint Cognatius's relics.{/n}

7711e68f-bbc9-4870-a85d-a1d6e11191d9.Text: {n}Reverend Hieronymus arrived on Foulstone and met with the prioress. After a confession and a philosophical discussion in private, he acknowledged Lugnalia as being worthy of a high ecclesiastical station and guaranteed her the support of the Cult of Saint Drusus.{/n}

52289e49-7eb0-496d-a2a5-4ffaa6f26006.Text: "Cassia has brought up an interesting idea. Let a convincing miracle happen that would prove that this Crucible is a true relic."

c657793f-6a36-483f-bb73-6495a006d74b.Text: "If they all need the Crucible so badly, then they should agree to alternate service to it."

131f1f22-960d-42c3-8782-cf8543eb49c2.Text: "If the Explorators can prove that the Crucible is an archeotech mechanism and not a relic, then they may become its curators."

577b6274-a567-408c-886a-6cfe1fbf2d9e.Text: "Pasqal, find a precedent that would convince the Order that you are right."

1f9aaf09-98b3-4086-879a-44175ad092c1.Text: "The Order should make a list of all the documented miracles involving the Crucible to argue their case."

4c2ecf07-252f-40dc-93b7-988d6bc23bf0.Text: "If the Explorators start the Crucible, then they will take it for themselves. Otherwise, they should leave."

5dda7364-118b-4683-83bb-665fb4fc518f.Text: "What are the main points of the dispute?"

5874f6e6-a9b9-4180-bf6e-72b49a9e796b.Text: "Jae is right. Make it clear to all those involved that, if they will not come to a consensus, then I will take Crucible for myself."

dae3c634-c6d9-486f-a2b5-31744e0c964e.Text: "Call a congress of believers and respected Ecclesiarchs. We will overwhelm the Explorators with sheer numbers."

f2fabddf-3405-4af2-be1e-4361a4f14919.Text: "An incredible find has been made on Foulstone, Lord Captain! A lost volume of Saint Keefe's diary has been discovered during the restoration of his crypt. By following the saint's words, the Order of the Hammer was able to find a cryptoark containing a tech-relic of Saint Cognatius — the Crucible. Keefe's writings on it are vague: it is called 'the sculptor and transformer, granting life and grace.' The Explorators have sent a delegation to lay claim to the treasure, which has sparked a heated dispute that has been going on for many days."

d80908d3-0fc2-476e-85a4-4b2ce2ee6b2c.Text: "I will relay your will to the representatives of the deliberating parties."

1441d4bf-0b47-452b-b6be-347e64ff3840.Text: "The Tech-Priests claim that the privileges of the Adeptus Mechanicus oblige the Order of the Hammer to hand any sacred archeotech over to them. They argue that the Crucible should be considered not a personal possession of the saint, but rather an object temporarily entrusted into his care. The Order of the Hammer rejects this thesis, insisting that the right to care for such sacred objects belongs to the Ecclesiarchy's cults, and since Cognatius was canonised, then the Crucible should be regarded as a blessed relic, not archeotech."

6e5a10e7-8cb6-441a-b877-b5222bd18f93.Text: {n}Despite the formal agreements, both sides remained unsatisfied with the results of the deliberations.{/n}

b88f4195-d1ca-49e4-a851-2df191771401.Text: {n}As soon as news of the Rogue Trader's bellicose stance on the Crucible reached the ears of the disputing sides, they unanimously decided to start looking for a compromise. It only took them several cycles to reach an agreement on their collective maintenance of the Crucible.{/n}

0333cd9a-bf4b-451a-b70e-0467a2d9a1a0.Text: {n}The outcome of the dispute angered the followers of the Adeptus Mechanicus. The Explorators feel that this decision in favour of the Order of the Hammer should be recorded as a violation of the sacred privileges of Mars, and that this fact should be taken into account during any further interactions with the involved parties.{/n}

b257c642-58f9-4135-958d-88220b75d93e.Text: "It is likely that the research contained in the ancient treatises and archival repositories of the Adeptus Mechanicus will provide factual information on similar precedent. I can spare some of my computing power to find such a case and provide my brothers and sisters with the information that is necessary to win this dispute."

41443d38-633b-461c-95e4-bb445cb1966f.Text: "I believe that the Chronicles of the Amalinian Conclave describe mystical miracles witnessed by zealots while praying at an ancient banner of Saint Capius... Should the Crucible perform a similar miracle, then no doubts will remain that it is indeed a holy relic and not the property of the Adeptus Mechanicus."

f11ee223-eff3-4714-a1ee-e2433ddfc253.Text: "Shereen, do you know the best motivation to make your enemies ripe for the compromise? The danger of losing any sort of benefit. It is within your power to take the Crucible for yourself using the privilege of your Warrant if you so desire... Why do you not imply such a possibility to the parties involved?"

43e6c6c5-1ef2-461d-acc4-3f66e64f6f20.Text: "Request approved. Initiating the ceremony of accessing the Fleet's catalogue."

864ef6e0-2419-4c6c-83e8-bcf61d2552ec.Text: {n}In spite of losing the argument, the monks of the Order of the Hammer soon found enough humility within themselves to make peace with the results of the deliberations.{/n}

9dca9859-8551-4533-9c6c-b3fe32050a30.Text: "Now I feel uneasy at the thought that I have become the mastermind of this deceit."

37af4e54-f2e1-4b58-a814-c66eca20a795.Text: {n}After some time, the Crucible revealed a miraculous vision: sacred images of martyrs appeared before the awestruck witnesses and blessed the ancient artefact. And even though some claimed to have caught a glimpse of some suspicious individuals operating lens machines, most of those present acknowledged the fact of this miracle, and the status of the Crucible as a relic.{/n}

ce211dd3-1bc0-4178-b956-f73cc3737286.Text: "Let's see how long it takes for them to come to a consensus now."

09f61fa6-9a8a-4fe0-bf33-5b719e9d7cab.Text: {n}Research into the Crucible has identified it as a device for surface terraforming. Fuelled by the geothermal energy of the planet, it could turn a wasteland into a blooming garden. However, a way to launch it has yet to be found.{/n}

f5113d11-8eea-4e5b-af75-2f03b4d95e50.Text: "Prelate Tychon is advocating for the doctrine of co-protection, and the Explorators' intransigence grows ever weaker. Perhaps they will agree on a compromise."

88aa5e01-dd95-402f-83c4-593f4989118e.Text: "Quite. The discussions have been happening now for more than eight cycles without interruption. Both sides have provided more than a hundred experts on scholarly wisdom and law and have put forward around four thousand theses, arguments, and testimonies. A special Administratum commission, comprised of two hundred armed clerks, has arrived to pass a verdict and enforce the law. This may well be the largest religious dispute in the Expanse's history."

40f161b4-e62e-404a-800a-94361a1b36cc.Text: "Prelate Lugnalia is vehemently defending the rights of the Order and seems to have managed to instil a touch of righteous fear in the Explorators. Perhaps it will keep them from taking revenge if the dispute does not conclude in their favour."

40838c3b-b67e-4bb4-92ed-b92082f8d756.Text: {n}In spite of the many hours spent praying over the machine's dashboard and anointing its parts with sacred unguents, the Explorators could not arouse the Crucible's machine spirit from its slumber and tame it. Disgraced by the failure, the Tech-Priests were defeated in their claim — the artefact was declared a relic.{/n}

37797a16-57d5-4d11-9096-cef2e436a768.Text: "Prelate Nigmus does not seem to be too keen on fighting. It seems that he is subtly preparing the Order for the loss of this dispute and is trying to avoid an uproar in the priesthood."

c8573213-c032-4028-934f-69620e0797df.Text: {n}When the precedent discovered by the venerable Magos was presented at the arbitration, the monks of the Order of the Hammer had no choice but to bow to the will of the Explorators.{/n}

635a2038-d054-40cd-a16b-283b8793e269.Text: {n}After some preparation, the Explorators presented several pieces of evidence to support their claim, the most convincing of them being sacred blueprints of parts similar to those used in the Crucible. By the end of their speech, most were fully convinced that the Order of the Hammer's relic is indeed archeotech. Protests from the dissatisfied minority that called many of the Explorators' arguments into question were ignored.{/n}

f68c7bb0-e533-48e4-a1e2-c9563a402254.Text: {n}Day and night, logisticars and scribes pored over the list of recorded miraculous events related to the Crucible. Alas, they had to refer to chronicles so ancient and fragmentary that not all of the Tech-Priests were satisfied with the multiple tomes of research presented to them. When their work was complete and presented during the arbitration, the evident sanctity of the ancient mechanism was officially acknowledged. The Crucible was destined to remain in the purview of the Order of the Hammer.{/n}

a4caa109-d817-4138-9992-08f77d00ffac.Text: {n}Obeying the word of the Rogue Trader, the Explorators and the monks started looking for ways to reach a compromise. It took them several cycles to formulate and record all the agreements and vows, but eventually an alliance was concluded.{/n}

ec7293d8-cb7d-40e9-a29d-761a6d99cf85.Text: "The trio of prelates have called upon pilgrims to mobilise — a tactic for spreading awareness of the present situation. In diplomatic terms, the Order of the Hammer has not made any threats; however, there is a clear implication that, unless the Tech-Priests back down, the Mechanicus risk incurring the wrath of the faithful."

5ed394a1-65c7-4d62-8ea9-969aa6cfe0ba.Text: {n}People concerned about the fate of the Crucible descended upon Foulstone in droves. Among them were not only high-ranking clerics but also powerful aristocrats and other people of influence and piety. Realising the likely consequences of continuing their struggle, the Tech-Priests had no choice but to back down.{/n}

d46d588b-b0ec-4063-82ad-94a13bef1923.Text: "Prelate Inocrant is not participating in the dispute due to his lack of oratory talent. But at the council with the priesthood, he raised an interesting point — proposing to the Explorators to start the Crucible in order to prove their rightful heritage. There is reasonable doubt that they will be able to do so, however — the relic is too old."

9e80f4a6-8ab4-46d1-9384-c4cbb5ef18db.Text: {n}In the process of forming their alliance, the monks and the Tech-Priests have discovered they have something in common — both groups hold strong convictions and are truly devoted to their relics, and thus the two sides are now endeavouring to see one another as true like-minded supporters, not mere reluctant allies.{/n}

3a57e3e4-938a-4cba-b318-752c038c8c4c.Text: {n}The Explorators have made peace with their loss and asked permission to conduct several of their own rituals with the Crucible. When the tech-liturgies had been completed, the Tech-Priests departed Foulstone.{/n}

3c5e912b-3034-4b63-8ad5-f9358519c0f2.Text: {n}The monks continued to lament the outcome of the deliberations long after they had ended. The devout believers refused to accept their defeat, and for a long time after, many discussions and heated debates were held regarding the Crucible being unjustly entrusted into the Tech-Priests' care.{/n}

89a58087-257a-4065-b436-710d40574820.Text: "I shall listen to Ulfar's advice. Brigades of the Touched should be formed to serve on the other planets."

1cc2eff9-abc5-4e35-9a76-dfc2b0e305e2.Text: "Exterminate the Touched and make changes to the great sculpting to prevent them from being created again."

b993736e-b52d-446b-9d92-406d492f7965.Text: "Pronounce the Touched the property of the Order of the Hammer. Let them continue to serve the faithful."

c9242853-bfaa-4eae-baed-f83d8be62e96.Text: "Hold a public tonsure ceremony for the order with a service dedicated to Saint Cognatius."

30245de3-362f-4cd2-b13c-4bf3dd481990.Text: "We will go with the Tech-Priests' solution. Servitorise the lot of them."

5d456bcb-5a37-4e72-a26c-1dd6926a458d.Text: "Have the Touched act as spiritual guides as per Prelate Inocrant's proposal."

35794160-fe39-48da-92e3-de335384797a.Text: "Pasqal, you have my permission to study the Crucible's algorithms. Dispose of the Touched."

0ecd5c22-4710-4920-9f2a-ff2c7b3566bb.Text: "Lord Captain, the Crucible's great sculpting is underway — Foulstone is being transformed right before our eyes into a fertile world with lush groves and clean water. However, there is evidence that the Crucible has also created... humans."

02765eda-cd12-4954-8464-7c1aa0f7b55d.Text: "There is a split among the faithful — though many call it a miracle sent by the Emperor Himself and want to quickly put the Touched to work, a part of the population is frightened by these soulless creatures born from the ancient machine. They demand that the planet's learned men intervene in the great sculpting and find a way to stop the production of the Touched."

c3e4c65d-3045-4496-ac39-8997491bb919.Text: "They do not appear to pose a threat — the autopsy of several specimens has shown that they are physiologically identical to ordinary humans. No traces of corruption or xeno-influence were found either. However, their obedience is a double-edged sword. They obey any orders without knowing or caring who gives them. And thus, nothing prevents a cunning intruder from bending them to their will, creating an army of obedient slaves or spies at their disposal."

7107142b-76eb-4975-8de2-714ab83c02c4.Text: "The disciples of the Malpian teaching believe that the souls of the Touched are too pure to cause harm to anyone. Those adherents of simplicity and purity have taken a liking to these meek and open-hearted creatures."

5a43df16-63cb-4c19-9ba1-4da1bf120b92.Text: "I will draft a detailed plan of the ceremony and hand it over to the prelate."

82c05b7f-d6bc-4bbc-b155-c2bbc3310ea6.Text: "They were begotten by the relic of Saint Cognatius, which means their existence pleases the Emperor. Your people must be reminded that it is so! Arrange a public ceremony of tonsure to initiate the Touched into the Order of the Hammer and a service dedicated to reading parables about the acts of Saint Cognatius and his followers."

4fecf452-6837-4254-b8e6-5e2d72c5ac30.Text: "Why don't you make the first move and assemble a mighty force from these Touched ones? If they are so obedient and diligent, then they will make fine troops. Assign a loyal commander to each squad to keep an eye on them, and these strange people will turn from a threat into defenders of the Imperium."

ed0bcc0e-b20a-4f40-8594-c87b639d9d2e.Text: "Lack of will? Registering a high probability of manufacturing failure within the Crucible's sacred processes. It is recommended to dispose of the finished batch of units and halt production of new ones. The algorithm of the great sculpting requires further examination."

9de5e477-8dd7-4596-8d0b-e12c66c50984.Text: {n}Under the guidance of the brothers and sisters of the Order of the Hammer, the Touched carried on with their toils, cultivating the land and building new settlements.{/n}

6f165766-dc03-4f2e-b208-4f9b9ea389a9.Text: "But do pick loyal commanders who would be ready to die for your cause, Aett-Vater."

6a366a78-47d3-45f1-b944-6a6a54f7df7c.Text: {n}The Touched did not resist their newfound fate — nor any other order, for that matter. They were not particularly skilled at warfare, but they were obedient, dutiful, and most importantly, indifferent to their own deaths. Soon, the first regiments were taken to orbit on voidships and dispatched to other areas of the protectorate, as well as to the Rogue Trader's own flagship.{/n}

6327f8f7-598b-4bdb-a1c1-7c4b7254faf6.Text: {n}The Touched did not try to defend themselves or to resist in any way. They accepted death in much the same way they lived life — quietly and obediently. The unrest among the citizens has simmered down, and the great sculpting continues as before, but the development of fertile land has noticeably slowed without the Touched.{/n}

77d4621d-7d36-469b-9b10-b26095b323e5.Text: {n}The Tech-Priests' investigation uncovered a number of defects in the operation of the birthing vats within the Crucible. It was these defects that caused such strange obedience within the Touched. The proposition of making improvements to a sacred relic filled the Tech-Priests with the most profound dread, and thus Foulstone was left without its taciturn workers. However, the priceless knowledge extracted by the servants of the Omnissiah was a great reward in and of itself.{/n}

da3f1e09-c448-4845-bd03-2e6d7b2d89c7.Text: "The servants of the Omnissiah have proposed a pre-emptive measure against this threat: subject the Touched to Servitude Imperpituis and inhibit them with binharic vows of obedience."

e079e6f5-d3f4-422d-93c0-aa329ebe7848.Text: "The Tech-Priests who serve the Crucible came upon birthing vats built into the relic. The machine is constantly growing new Touched within them."

a162738a-71c0-493e-896b-2f7f3a1bfd1b.Text: {n}The people's wariness of the Touched never went away. A number of reports have described cases of persecution and even violence toward the Crucible's creations — such was the rabble's fear of them.{/n}

5d65d2ee-4166-47c2-a478-7397db8c2e60.Text: "From the mouth of the relic came several thousand people who, speaking an archaic form of Low Gothic, demanded to be given orders. They cultivate land, build houses and production facilities with obedience and, in general, have a remarkable range of skills and knowledge. However, it seems that these people completely lack their own free will, and for this, the monks have named them Touched."

17b8fee9-bf6a-479a-a2e4-b384aef5383c.Text: "The knowledge will be extracted by any means necessary."

6c3b807b-e870-4985-92f7-337d4cc6f2b2.Text: {n}The heads of the Touched were opened, and inhibiting engrams were implanted within to ensure that these obedient creature would follow no malicious commands.{/n}

3e6e48e4-449d-4e89-9d89-1ca0bec174dc.Text: {n}The spiritual tutelage of the people of Foulstone was entrusted to the quiet, compliant, and withdrawn creatures known as the Touched. They did not preach or root out impurity, and they even seemed to be unaware of their high status. They simply worked without saying a word, and thousands of believers took vows of silence and obedience to follow their example.{/n}

9719e652-0bc2-48cb-990d-3cdfd8e935b2.Text: {n}The public induction of the Touched along with their diligent service eventually solidified their image in the minds of the people as the executors of Saint Cognatius's will sent to the faithful to ease their burdens during the great sculpting. Any concerns about the Touched possibly posing a danger were completely dispelled.{/n}

e4e49703-3f56-44dd-9d54-b69afafb2833.Text: "Prelate Inocrant even suggested to elevate these... dimmer subjects of your dynasty to spiritual guides. Inocrant finds that an immaculate heart is a better shepherd than a sharp mind."

95f9add5-17d2-44d6-b2b2-d886afcf8b4b.Text: "Execute this dangerous agitator publicly. The colony must have order!"

e932fe01-f7ef-4949-ad75-44ea58be2d80.Text: "I entrust the Prophet to the care of the Bloodspun Web. Let my world no longer be disturbed by his delusions."

cdae4723-0f68-4875-a5cc-66539a6fb6c3.Text: "Heinrix, have your agents rid us of this troublemaker."

9316fe19-2fc7-4a1e-8e1b-b7cdbfc9e4cc.Text: "Jae, see to it that a delegation of doleful wretches keeps our 'Saint Cognatius' distracted."

d8a0064a-6ced-4662-b502-03ba30ae5086.Text: "Argenta, provide the saint with an escort that will accompany him and the Crucible on his mission."

0f1e09aa-20c6-428b-8100-1a253f86aa30.Text: "He must be inducted into the Order of the Hammer. Forcibly, if necessary."

d08c771f-7d20-48e2-89f3-65fa511771c2.Text: "I wish to hear the opinions of my advisors."

20fa3774-85f5-4a78-af55-9508a43a0953.Text: "What do we know about this so-called Saint Cognatius reincarnate?"

8ac688b8-babe-4a0e-8e57-097437044a64.Text: "Make him undergo the trial of purity. Let him die trying to prove his holiness, at least so he can stop troubling the people."

0e8c491f-9137-4322-8c6b-66f9bdb0558e.Text: "Give the Crucible to him — let him use it to bring worlds into the Imperium's fold."

8fdc016d-fbca-41ef-b56f-7904bbecae48.Text: "Lord Captain, the situation on Foulstone requires your attention. One of the servants tasked with the Crucible's maintenance has declared publicly that he has been liberated of all worldly concerns, for he is none other than the reincarnation of Saint Cognatius. There are some extremely questionable reports claiming that he has performed miracles. Supported by a congregation garnered by preaching, he has asked for Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}'s permission to depart from Foulstone with the Crucible in tow so that he may continue Saint Cognatius's work and use the relic to transform worlds, ones true to the faith of the Imperium, into lush, splendorous gardens."

05e8a386-ca69-477f-ba29-b07170e0ec9b.Text: "The Archenemy's lies take on many guises — but the Emperor's miracles are a hundredfold stronger. On more than a few occasions, He has bestowed epiphanies upon the faithful, even those of the humblest origin. I myself bear the name of a poor orphan who was granted miraculous powers by His grace. So, give me time, and I will find you the most loyal agents to escort Brother Pure-Voice on his travels. They will keep him safe if he is pure, or punish him should they sense deceit in his words. But I have a feeling that his rebirth is a true wonder!"

1bcf3b6d-f797-47e7-8bc7-97bcd89bf527.Text: {n}The Pure-Voiced Prophet was mobbed by an entourage of professional beggars and cripples. Upon seeing how many people need him on Foulstone, the saint reincarnate gave up on his ambitions of spreading the faith to new worlds. He vowed not to leave the planet for as long as there remained even a single soul in need of his help. He only left Foulstone once — to bless the Lord Captain's ship and counsel {mf|him|her} to carry on Saint Cognatius's holy cause.{/n}

3a6df23f-c1d6-41bf-871f-a88b78ddfa10.Text: "They will see to it that his disappearance is sufficiently mysterious so that the believers delve into speculations about his ascension instead of trying to look for the truth."

c11bd46f-3590-4070-b84b-7aad26c3b061.Text: "Gladly, shereen. Manipulating blessed simpletons is the easiest thing in the world. There is nothing they crave more than to feel needed."

29e519df-eeda-4163-a69d-c57510a028ef.Text: "I'll get to it immediately! I will choose the best people for this task, the most devoted!"

6ebb7b24-b405-4973-a2b6-70e7d10bdd88.Text: "Tibor Hyke, a technomat from Footfall. He now prefers to be called 'Brother Pure-Voice.' An unremarkable commoner with no family. Gaunt, unkempt, covered in scabs from working the Crucible."

17a3fdf2-a5de-4a72-9a81-494f7678d5f8.Text: "I have had ample experience with saintly saviours like him in the past. Whatever great cause they proclaim as their mission, they genuinely, naively believe that people really do need them. If we round up enough orphans and lepers who would trip over themselves to beg our prophet for salvation, he will soon forget all about the Crucible and his holy mission. I know a few guilds of professional beggars who would be delighted to offer their services to us."

cd9eb8e4-69fe-4283-ac8c-b62b6a9124af.Text: "It will be done. I will arrange for additional security measures to be taken — the false prophet's death is bound to cause some unrest."

4196c6b4-7b1a-4475-87d5-5624bb9fec3d.Text: "I will inform the prelate that the potential saint is to be provided with access to the relic and a ship to bring the Emperor's light to wayward worlds."

12e471f1-9daa-40a8-b9f9-fcfa02c7054b.Text: {n}The Pure-Voiced Prophet was arrested and mercilessly executed in front of the people. The execution reminded the Rogue Trader's faithful subjects about the virtues of obedience but stoked anger among the rabble.{/n}

d3cda39e-e926-416d-a306-100eb5caf230.Text: "I will provide the prelate with additional forces for the arrest and anointment of this so-called prophet. The common folk may be opposed to his detention."

a8834f08-b7ce-4c09-990d-35e4b330a0f1.Text: "It goes without saying that such a generous gift to the Koronus Expanse could bring great renown to Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, but at a heavy cost. Foulstone would turn back into a wasteland and you would lose the prestige that comes with having charge over such a valuable relic."

0fa9b758-44fe-40ab-85f1-f8bc0f41d869.Text: "The Undying One does not release the souls that have come to Him. This man is either lying or misguided. An experienced spinner will help him see the truth... or repent the deception."

8dee9122-904d-4c0a-b5d1-305eb2844adc.Text: "Let our duty be done. The Undying One is duty. The Undying One is death."

5f56e87b-450d-45fc-8576-e7639b5f9d9b.Text: {n}The Pure-Voiced Prophet disappeared in a single night. They found only a strange image of a labyrinth inscribed in his blood on the floor of his chamber. His followers gladly believed that this mysterious sign marked the ascension of "Saint Cognatius" to the Emperor, and made the cell a place of worship.{/n}

55d30ef4-55b4-495e-a2a8-eccac17e4a83.Text: "He became obsessed with it from the day it was discovered. He never left his maintenance post, never rested, barely ever slept, fasting and living off stimulants and condensate from the relic's cooling circuit. Then he started having 'revelations' and eventually 'saw the truth'... or he went completely insane. His sermons are directed at commoners, appealing to them for humility and mercy. He often speaks about his former life as a saint, and many of these tales match known legends about Saint Cognatius. No anarchical pronunciations or radical deviations from the Creed have been found in his words... yet."

93b63083-28b5-45c9-a977-e9fed810b47d.Text: {n}The Pure-Voiced Prophet mysteriously vanished. Rumours of his miraculous ascension immediately spread among the rabble, and soon there were those claiming to have witnessed the event.{/n}

807e9e77-d8a3-4cc3-abc7-fdd3464b0b30.Text: "False prophets in the streets are a common occurrence. Their sermons breed turmoil, riots, and acts of disobedience. The Inquisition recommends that such unstable agents be isolated and quietly removed."

3178ac3f-17c6-47f6-bf72-f83e8ca45a7c.Text: {n}The Order of the Hammer is pleased that the suspicious prophet troubles the faithful no longer.{/n}

cd6e9739-04b0-42df-b460-e2ebf4f754cd.Text: {n}The Pure-Voiced Prophet was subjected to the trial of faith and perished the next planetary turn, proving that he was nothing but a liar. This stoked anger and turmoil among the rabble.{/n}

2fcca222-aa75-4a33-879a-9c744f4e891b.Text: {n}The Pure-Voiced Prophet was publicly arrested and inducted into the Order of the Hammer. He now studies the art of humility, and his words now show far greater obedience and spread fewer alleged revelations. The prelate permitted the preacher to lead a mission of pilgrimage to the Lord Captain's ship so he could offer prayers for {mf|his|her} health and bless {mf|his|her} ship.{/n}

3a939ab5-b20c-4555-8124-89215246facb.Text: {n}Having loaded the Crucible onto the requisitioned voidship, the Pure-Voiced Prophet gathered up his flock and set out for distant worlds to spread His word. The spiritual authority of the Order of the Hammer suffered as a result, and the loss of the Crucible sowed substantial unrest among the populace. Before departing, the preacher expressed his appreciation by sending the Lord Captain a gift — a relic that, according to his own claims, once belonged to his previous incarnation.{/n}

b6791df6-2653-4da3-9e7f-33a6dfd4b9d5.Text: {n}The stern guards selected by Sister Argenta vigilantly provide protection for the prophet, ensuring that his thoughts remain pure.{/n}

1a98e6d8-7509-4245-8a56-fca8d1ffd712.Text: "What do my advisors have to say?"

491d5cf7-6d9c-440f-b26a-57053f7e722e.Text: "Resettle the retches into separate agri-complexes where the crowds will not tear them apart. We will study them."

00892833-0b02-4397-813f-32b83d6256f9.Text: "I take these unfortunate souls under my protection. They are victims of a mutation, not villains."

015e3428-9980-4e90-b054-29311b085ea0.Text: "I will suffer no mutant to live. Hunt them down to the last man."

4a776789-d7c6-468a-a16d-106b99f42de8.Text: "Let them atone for their flaw with labour."

82be6d55-6b85-47f8-bbda-06c821fcf003.Text: "Take the required number of these retches to be studied by the Adeptus Mechanicus. Destroy the rest."

d2487d61-4a1f-4214-8d96-725ceeec6b75.Text: "Take the required number of these retches for study and let the others work. Cassia, please share your knowledge of the Genetors' craft with my servants."

b5f9c658-b153-4c9f-bd14-2ddc8c0b6fe4.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, there are alarming reports coming from Janus. A number of strange mutations have been spotted among the population in remote agri-complexes. Aside from the obvious disfigurement and the subsequent estrangement, these mutants — called 'retches' by the rest of the colonists — are coming together to practise a primitive form of religion involving ritual worship of the land. While they display no disobedience or hostility, their very existence is concerning."

78485227-54f6-4b6e-bdf4-e542292f5cbf.Text: "The mysterious xenos advisors you appointed to oversee the planet have shown unexpected interest in the mutants' vulgar religious practices. They advise against persecuting the retches, but instead they recommend segregating them in separate residential sectors and placing them under observation."

fa5cb28b-b146-4392-8597-3097a7d909be.Text: {n}The mutants were put under surveillance. One of the watchmen spotted a mysterious relic in the hands of a group of retches that turned out to be an item of xeno-origin. It is unlikely the mutants understood the nature of the object they worshipped.{/n}

b69934d3-75b9-4710-92c1-e9ecc924ee13.Text: "Governor Vyatt suggested the mutation may have been caused by one of her genetic experiments aimed to 'improve' the working populace. She notes the docility of the specimens and asks not to treat them as abominations that would otherwise be purged."

6af813f4-a5dc-46d7-aee3-87f8f3e93ab3.Text: "The Janus nobility humbly awaits your decision."

28241888-9e99-45e0-8058-87e6cd8279cb.Text: {n}Having to live in proximity to the retches disturbs the good, honest serfs and leads to outbursts of aggression and violence.{/n}

467191f3-1208-403a-a99e-f5337ea319c5.Text: {n}The Rogue Trader's servants graciously accepted information on the mysterious Genetor arts from Lady Navigator Cassia's own hands. They started an inquest to discover the nature of the mutant strain. The retches' twisted flesh revealed its secrets on the autopsy table.{/n}

ff104f97-ddbc-4317-8398-7ee2709c820b.Text: {n}The wise Magos Biologis proceeded to study the degenerative genetic branch. The fruits of their research will be presented to the von Valancius dynasty.{/n}

b9424421-8140-467a-911a-fe1cdf17791b.Text: "Their mutations cause the loss of skin pigment and the shedding of hair. Some have started developing a translucent third eyelid similar to that of reptiles, others have succumbed to progressive atrophy of the larynx, causing the loss of human speech. At the same time their tendons become denser and more elastic, providing increased endurance and load resistance."

35faf395-a2b6-495f-8259-891c8565e2f6.Text: "I feel these mon-keigh have been touched by something wondrous."

ce042ddd-2db3-42b9-a474-1ffd60db7898.Text: "May the cleansing be calculated and rationally executed."

22938f3a-4cee-4789-83f4-fef1f160649a.Text: "I saw your agents' pict-recordings, the signs these mon-keigh leave behind, their idols. And I cannot deny a connection, though a pathetic and extremely abstract one, to... the symbols of my people. Their guttural prayers echo the sounds of the Children of Asuryan's speech. The probability of them having come into such close contact with our civilisation is non-existent, yet they are still somehow connected. Protect these people, resettle them to distant abodes where they will not be harmed for their peculiarities. And keep watch — someday the truth may be revealed."

d5539c3c-cb84-401a-87d8-56d16644efb5.Text: "This mutation has not been properly studied and is missing from the catalogue. I am not registering a basis for delaying the commencement of immediate genetic purification. I recommend launching a thorough investigation into the genetic make-up of this forbidden strain."

6938d6d4-a0ab-4b02-84d1-a02e32a2cffa.Text: "The blessed sanction of the Imperium does not grace these mutants, but nor does it declare their existence anathema. Should we sentence them without further study? There are mutants whose existence is fully sanctioned, such as Ogryns, Ratlings, Pariahs, Pelagers, Felinids, or Troths. Our library had many treatises on the Genetors' craft, and I could impart some of that knowledge to your servants... purely theoretical, of course."

0f21ec36-01a9-4188-aeb2-ccc780e9e0d2.Text: "The members of the Magos Biologis you tasked with healing Janus have found the mutation to be missing from the catalogue and recommend studying it and eradicating it immediately afterward."

f6ff3600-70b5-4245-9e03-7d8afd3b1086.Text: "As for their barbaric religion, they are deifying both the soil and Janus itself. To them, working in agri-complexes is a form of worship, which has had a positive impact on productivity."

2bbdee95-04ed-4e42-889b-331f315d24db.Text: "The retches are commonly ostracised due to their grotesque appearance. There haven't been too many cases of mob justice yet, but they will become commonplace after the mutation's deformities become more obvious. The retches tend to form groups with similarly afflicted people, their average level of intellect is low. They all belong to the labour caste and communicate among themselves using a primitive vernacular of their own invention."

1c463e6f-cbfd-4ad7-a3c3-720e1f675a5a.Text: "I hope my House will not judge me for this."

4c4470c4-0668-450b-87c9-0b4245386818.Text: {n}All over Janus the pious serfs are exterminating the retches and their tainted bloodline. Suffer not the mutant in your abode!{/n}

97c1c017-cb13-4432-afb5-e712c1408ac2.Text: {n}The retches continue to toil arduously for the good of Janus; however, the leniency shown to the mutants may lead to dangerous consequences.{/n}

afc4141f-3d2d-413c-9dd3-3470483b13ec.Text: {n}The mutants were resettled to distant agri-complexes where their unorthodox appearance will not put them in danger of being massacred by the serfs.{/n}

06072345-3740-4b8c-bdfd-c72d473bb42a.Text: "Methodically eliminate everything in the region. Plants, animals, retches — everything."

0ca51313-826e-4522-b5cf-2efd0d92aef3.Text: "Begin the purge of the tainted region. The Magos Biologis are cleared to employ weapons of mass destruction."

2c7c3f0e-b76e-4e8b-ac00-6d8dd9492363.Text: "Permission to advise granted. I await your proposals."

a4077103-6e4f-4818-9476-cc96055b2aba.Text: "Send in the scouts. Let us see what they manage to find."

a04164b6-b7ca-4d41-944d-52ae34ba9478.Text: "Set up research outposts in the affected sector."

c4ff2b61-aa83-47c4-9899-943d61d51c44.Text: "Isolate the region and start rounding up the retches. Make them tell us the truth about what is happening."

34299e1e-ef30-4351-9d4f-b2787d5cac93.Text: "Isolate the region and commence research. We must understand what we are dealing with."

fa606444-c6b4-4f0e-a5d6-ff539aa189e3.Text: "Troubling news has arrived from Janus, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. While digging an irrigation ditch, workers found a xeno-obelisk made of unknown material. It was delivered to a laboratorium and subjected to a number of tests, one of which caused... a reaction. The obelisk generated a low-frequency vibration, and the events that followed were catastrophic."

df6ab3fe-712a-4c26-bada-906571ed3082.Text: "I am sending specialists to Janus capable of forcing compliance."

090d5904-46fd-4133-b03d-5d0faa1ead19.Text: "The Chem-Princes are hastily summoning militias and getting ready to start a purifying crusade. They await Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}'s blessing."

3d0b4aa3-6abb-4033-9e5b-c3a9ca4883aa.Text: "The esteemed Ultrequisitors are gathering outlaws and fortune-hunters for an expedition into the heart of the region. They assume a priceless trove of xenomechanisms is waiting for them inside."

e1567515-6d0c-498b-acc2-9dccfb3f6622.Text: "The Adeptus Mechanicus recommend we fence off the afflicted area. According to their hypothesis, this anomaly is the world's attempt at self-recovery and therefore should be studied, not interrupted."

95ec48d8-fb8c-407e-9772-0ba537f9d7e3.Text: {n}The tip of the spear was comprised of Skitarii maniples armed with radium carbines, phosphex bombs, and other equally fearsome weaponry. The land that they left in their wake resembled the scarlet wastes of sacred Mars.{/n}

7c672504-1bdf-4127-a5fc-264265c9787a.Text: {n}The retch was thoroughly interrogated, and so were dozens of other captive mutants. What little they were able to tell was of no significant value — most of it was nonsensical peasant superstition, although all the retches as one claimed that if the afflicted region was left alone, it would not expand. This assertion was soon confirmed, and the neighbouring agri-complexes soon resumed normal operation.{/n}

5ae7beca-5df6-4f75-97ef-02dff3b03f2c.Text: "The vegetation demonstrated a remarkable ability for wild growth — it took the plants only two days to overrun the agri-complexes in the region. Extinct species of local megafauna have been spotted in the newly formed jungle, aggressive and acting in unnatural cohesion."

a988e6bf-3285-4dac-8477-17e97496ab83.Text: "We purged most of the miscreants as per your orders. Only a few dozen at most managed to sneak into the region."

4768d748-cac5-4e8e-af8a-fdec2c939148.Text: "In accordance with your decree protecting the retch populace, no one attempted to detain them. As a result, almost a thousand specimens flooded into the region."

0db22bee-0cb9-48e5-81d7-c4d139b33555.Text: "Some were stopped by the watchmen appointed by your order. Unfortunately, about a hundred still made their way into the region."

083b2514-8950-44b2-a01a-ca589c2ea4a0.Text: "Governor Vyatt relayed a message that neither she nor her retinue understand the nature of this anomaly but are deeply concerned and advise its immediate eradication."

e71b7706-62d6-4af0-a10f-1cbfbcddcdf0.Text: "The xenos you allowed to stay on Janus advised your servants to abstain from visiting the region and then ceased virtually all communication."

ec5962b8-d2bd-46e1-8853-86852a0e4147.Text: "Janus's natural world is rising up? It is a lucky coincidence that the planet boasts experts who specialise in both controlling and destroying life. Reports from the Magos Biologis chapel make no mention of storing weapons of mass destruction, but I have no doubt they possess some. They always do. I see no reason not to let them use them against all this, whatever it is."

b1d2e221-08be-4b66-85e9-afc98054b8fb.Text: "Deployment of fortified research stations in the affected sectors is recommended. The benefit of gathering more information justifies the increased casualty rate among personnel."

98db7688-a6b7-4d9e-8cc1-2947a17e3d2f.Text: "The retches know more about this pestilent growth than we do, something we must quickly rectify. We should capture some of these mutants and force them to cooperate — that way we can learn what it is we are dealing with."

51ea6d35-b600-438f-9d3b-e32a87e1225f.Text: {n}The scouts who ventured into the heart of the afflicted region discovered ancient xenos creations emerging from the ground. The jungle reacted to the incursion by expanding and swallowing up some of the neighbouring agri-complexes.{/n}

ea43c80a-3614-472c-8749-f655038cec00.Text: {n}Fortified observation stations were set up in the largest clusters of ruins. The priceless data and artefacts collected there were paid for with the lives of the many watchmen who fought against the onslaught of Janus's enraged wilds.{/n}

e99d1e5d-c54d-4b53-a7ea-edabddff4d3a.Text: {n}The afflicted region was isolated. Soon after the quarantine had been imposed, one of the escaped retches emerged from the jungle and handed the wardens who met him a parcel containing some kind of xeno-artefact and a message: "Accept the gifts and leave the world in peace."{/n}

71dbc95e-278c-400b-8899-004cfd4f8a3a.Text: "A series of anomalies were recorded in the Epsilon II Majoris region — it is almost like Janus itself is fighting us there. Many logistical chains have been disrupted. The only people who visit the uncontrolled territory are the retches fleeing deeper into the region in greater and greater numbers. The observers report strange fires in the sky at night, completely imperceptible to the augurs."

66fd78b4-315b-4606-b68b-0ba8897c9d3e.Text: "We do not know. It is as if they all received a signal telling them to abandon their work and rush deep into the afflicted territory."

c4912b34-6ded-4457-85b0-6d8d2cf5e7b5.Text: "The rebelling wilds will soon become a scorched wasteland. A job well done, I say."

147f0ad7-a93b-4aa9-b4e5-5ada18f3cfb1.Text: "May the Omnissiah be merciful to the souls of those who will give their lives in the name of obtaining Knowledge."

c8646502-3641-4245-8cb0-21ef430c7446.Text: {n}The assault on the corrupted region began. The campaign led to unexpected and inexplicable anxiety among the peasantry. The Lord Captain had no choice but to assume personal command and direct the operation from aboard {mf|his|her} ship, boosting the soldiers' morale and demonstrating {mf|his|her} military prowess.{/n}

4efc6372-1d67-41c9-88e6-96451f3a4d6b.Text: "Let Governor Vyatt deal with the problem"

a9eefe0b-359d-48c8-9dc3-e6f9d086fd09.Text: "Idira, ensure the enactment of the Ritual of Silence."

05517b7d-afb1-42c3-9754-5be2c31a4eb9.Text: "Argenta, invite the esteemed specialists to Janus."

d4c7a2e5-d39c-4c76-b94a-b86e992c5921.Text: "Tell Muaran that the limits of my hospitality are not boundless, and that he should seek to solve this problem post-haste."

644cb15e-75f7-458d-b441-8323c1007268.Text: "Jae, find your xenowhisperers and have them exorcise the spirits."

281e580d-78c7-42c1-b4ef-481ad8cfafe0.Text: "We will get by with our usual methods — by fire and sword!"

a6943089-d54f-4717-a04a-f536ea4314c8.Text: "What is spawning these wraiths? Is it the corrupted sector?"

c530e711-016c-4383-88d7-b9b1853327d2.Text: "What do we know about these wraiths?"

48a2c816-e13f-4edb-b1a5-d0a6d151b258.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, Janus is reporting about a disaster — ghostly xenos figures that appear at dusk and go away at dawn. In a ravenous swarm, they attack one agricultural facility each night, freezing everything they touch. The attacks take place in the complexes closest to the uncontrolled sector of the planet, where nature itself has turned against us."

6dcfe25a-3eae-49b7-b4e3-212ac70eef6d.Text: "Governor Vyatt claims that she is capable of dealing with this herself. Her servants are already getting ready to conduct... some sort of procedure that will pacify the spirits."

3fef2943-75ac-4486-b79d-ba817de8f971.Text: {n}The moon above the corrupted sector of Janus turned red. Thousands of serfs, rounded up by Vistenza's servants, became part of her "procedure," their blood spilling onto the soil and mixing into the world's rivers.{/n}

1d374918-3aca-412d-b02e-684886b00033.Text: {n}At the appointed time, dozens of psykers around Janus started a rite known as the Ritual of Silence. Surprisingly, no catastrophe followed... none visible to the naked eye, at least.{/n}

49523f65-3f67-44d6-94c9-95e52a5538eb.Text: {n}A group of haggard priests, dressed in holy robes and accompanied by a retinue of repentant flagellants, arrived on Janus. Armed with scriptures and lasguns, they led their flock into battle against the inhuman wraiths.{/n}

7c8b7bed-a5a0-49d6-b575-0f2d725375b6.Text: {n}Locals have called the obelisks installed in the agri-complexes a blessed miracle. The energy resonance of the obelisks has formed intangible domes providing shelter against the wraiths.{/n}

c6b40312-9dc7-43ce-b865-4bd9e03fff6c.Text: "Of course, shereen. Jae Heydari has friends everywhere."

eaffc4a9-8793-4bd8-a01e-d9dc865f56ba.Text: "It is likely. They gather at its borders at the break of dawn and whirl in a wild dance, howling and destroying all living things, then disperse into thousands of fading flashes. The agricultural facilities that happen to be in the way of their dance fall into disrepair."

f44aa038-3792-4f00-997a-ff6c5d156e84.Text: "Not much. They are incorporeal and difficult to discern, but they happen to have Aeldari features. The spirits draw the warmth out of humans, plants, and inanimate objects, but it seems that they do not hunt consciously, but rather they simply do not notice anything in their way. At dawn, they dissolve into mist. The wraiths also differ among themselves — some are as dark as the void, and others shine like the stars in the night sky."

3c0afa16-ca6b-4298-aa7b-6a9269557067.Text: "Instead of relying on wicked ways to solve these problems, it would be better to turn to our good priests. There are skilled exorcists in the Ecclesiarchy who know how to drive out dark spirits."

f2288e00-9e6b-4f5b-8ade-068cf382c082.Text: "When dealing with xenos, one should be prepared for the manifestation of all sorts of ominous mysteries. There is a whole caste of specialists among the Cold Traders who use rituals to expel spirits from xeno-artefacts. Perhaps we should ask these xenowhisperers?"

4a5db2a5-1c5c-4051-b086-c730533c7d52.Text: "After... certain events on board, I became interested in ghosts. I bought a book on Footfall — an illegal one, of course — that describes a so-called Ritual of Silence. It's said to be able to pacify violent spirits on the scale of an entire world, but... I can't vouch for the safety of this ritual."

7398af24-f688-409d-9014-f05ab9e457b0.Text: {n}Without a doubt, the things your subjects saw were daemons, whose twisted image drove their ignorant minds to insanity.{/n}

ed8bf55f-c534-4a2c-a652-df237b2f252f.Text: {n}A group of suspicious characters covered in talismans arrived on Janus. After seeing the dance of ghosts first-hand, they conferred, and then made a short trip into the jungle. They later returned, their numbers diminished, loaded with ancient Aeldari obelisks stolen from the ruins.{/n}

47ac9df2-2858-4257-bd9f-39d69f257f3a.Text: {n}After arming themselves and rousing their spirits with rotgut, squads in the employ of the agricultural facilities' various rulers gathered to fight the incorporeal xenos. Alas, conventional weapons proved to be wholly powerless against spirits, but it seems that the sheer number of resulting deaths caused such a strong psychic resonance that many of the wraiths dissipated or retreated.{/n}

b051fa33-d914-4aae-a7fe-1e47ace3aa8e.Text: {n}Muaran, in all his arrogance, did not condescend to answer. However, mysterious obelisks, apparently taken from the Aeldari ruins, were found inside the endangered agricultural facilities a few cycles later.{/n}

a8d86cd3-90af-41a2-ac85-e255601edaeb.Text: {n}An invisible force pushed the wraiths away from the structures, stopped their horrifying dance, and shielded the Lord Captain's subjects from the rampage of the xenos.{/n}

8cbaa692-7be3-4f02-9249-9ddf7c940569.Text: "Fortunately, not too many facilities were damaged — our irreconcilable struggle has moved the borders of the affected sector. The important production lines have survived."

2595d29b-ae37-44d8-8e07-42bfcc3e14d1.Text: {n}The wraiths did not disappear completely after the battle, but they have started to appear less often and avoid human settlements.{/n}

ffb92c57-b6cb-4680-baf9-7047bb95d833.Text: "The xenos, Muaran, has sworn that his diaspora was not involved but refused to share any further information, alluding to the 'unreliability of the human mind.'"

dfd84d90-37d2-42c7-8fb0-eaab8a1027f3.Text: "In the name of Janus and the von Valancius protectorate!"

5260bf53-604c-4823-ba00-3b1bfdee6a39.Text: "I shall relay to the Lady Governor just how much trust has been placed in her."

376c7e9e-59df-4ee7-b224-8aae2ff9e868.Text: "I hope this gamble doesn't cause even more serious problems."

11f0d742-3d5b-4dc6-9ace-e9aaf1fdfedf.Text: "I shall draft the message using the utmost formal language that will brook no denial... I hope this xenos knows a thing or two about the art of diplomatic sophistry."

92074883-4ef3-48e2-bd44-e2ebcc820d10.Text: "The priests will not leave their children in a time of need."

f0e34b53-b258-472d-8310-253c3eee2d3d.Text: {n}Something is not right. The wraiths appear on the planet's outskirts and rush toward the heart of the contaminated region instead of invading from within it. Furthermore, their differences may suggest that there are two groups of wraiths opposing each other.{/n}

5d894737-0235-479a-96d5-aa3ab62e3d22.Text: "How much did the Inquisition sniff out?"

eb978410-900a-47cc-91cd-53868003a084.Text: "Have Vistenza surrender some of her people. I want the Inquisition gone from the planet immediately."

47f35884-2f66-4529-abfa-c6b5925b1678.Text: "The Aeldari will have to sacrifice some of their kinsmen to sate the hunger of the Inquisition."

163feef9-5e42-4567-8ec2-b44760d1bd34.Text: "Heinrix, tell Lady Xue that I consider them our allies."

88065d2e-8f51-4647-b52f-15131a6dd14f.Text: "We shall trick them. Have my servants persuade the Inquisition that there is nothing of significance on the planet."

01720db3-ee44-40ce-b7dc-ad7efcbac36a.Text: "I order the expulsion of those impudent fools from my world!"

4c5af21c-d79a-46c9-ad91-c5313090407c.Text: "Marazhai, I'm sure you can devise a treacherous trap where our uninvited guests might perish."

ab2ffeaf-ea98-4e93-97a3-f88be9fa747c.Text: "What think you, my officers and advisors?"

f36a8761-082a-462a-8f6f-d270feee04da.Text: "Heinrix, why was I not notified of their arrival in advance?"

e290a0d6-5c98-4fce-97ac-1f3b0cd0ed00.Text: "From this moment, the acolytes shall receive all possible assistance in their investigation."

283cbc44-325c-4235-88dd-26d5e4fd06d1.Text: "Lord Captain, an Ordo Xenos punitive unit, led by acolyte Lynett Xue, has arrived on Janus. The Inquisition forces have already taken control of the governor's palace and intend to enquire into the recent anomalies on Janus."

5827fd81-770c-41b3-8024-4f910eeb0cdb.Text: "Governor Vyatt and her retinue have left the residence and fled to some secret shelter. Many of her servants and lesser followers have been executed. There's no doubt that Lady Xue knew what exactly she was looking for."

cfe1dfca-c446-4d72-b9d2-61423e574a48.Text: "The xeno-inhabitants of Janus have been quick to scatter into the impassable forests and lay low to avoid the attention of the Ordo Xenos. Lady Xue's people are already combing the thickets and questioning suspected xenos collaborators."

838e74c9-c257-4fab-920d-dfc62f2c299c.Text: {n}During her investigation, Lady Xue was able to establish that the genetic changes in the retches' bodies were caused by mysterious substances secreted into the water by xeno-obelisks. These substances did not contaminate the water until recently, as shown by the analysis of the Magos Biologis. The same xeno-obelisks appear to be linked by a chain of energy communications, also serving as sources of unknown radiation that seem to have caused the outbreak of contaminated growth in the currently uncontrolled sector of the planet. This also seems to be causing the appearance of the mysterious phantoms.{/n}

9f88ddb8-e722-4fcb-996b-f448c5835ed4.Text: "Someone must die to shield their comrades from further tragedy. Alas, such is life."

7f9fbdf3-08f6-4abb-9a00-735b446353a6.Text: {n}After Lady Xue had set up her headquarters at the governor's palace, she began to investigate the situation on Janus. All those feeling guilt for their crimes before the Emperor could only stay silent and pray.{/n}

fae924da-0a1f-4517-b1b6-86066bc35099.Text: "Oh, I love coming up with cunning traps for mon-keigh!"

7ae0335e-0deb-4cfe-9864-e93c749cfea6.Text: "Cooperating with the Inquisition would do us more good than trying to hide the current misfortunes of the colony. I can send them a message to keep us informed about the interrogation... as a favour."

f8683835-a6ba-4dfa-afc3-5587a2ae8f53.Text: "If only we could throw them a bone, and let them find the evidence they want, one that we can get by without... The rest could be concealed away from their inquisitive eyes. Like a sand lizard shedding its tail, sometimes one must cede the battle to win the war."

e5b56449-9a56-440b-80d5-f4d983b2ff12.Text: "If someone were to walk around my domain so brazenly, they would certainly regret it. Lay open the trap, lace it with poison, put down the bait, and wait for the enemy to end their own worthless life."

ff731bf1-419b-47cc-be0e-2634ce9da647.Text: {n}A group of Aeldari warriors fought a hopeless battle against the Inquisition's forces in the jungle. All the xenos fell, but not without taking Lady Xue and her closest advisors down with them.{/n}

74517898-0ca4-4243-b499-425a0fab174d.Text: "I am surprised that they have informed us of their arrival at all. It demonstrates a semblance of trust."

b4bdf8a7-a495-4e7d-ae0a-d48ce602e2da.Text: {n}The Lord Captain's servants have taken great pains to conceal any and all evidence to create an information vacuum around the Inquisition squad. Alas, it is unlikely that Lady Xue, who has since left Janus, was taken in by this deception — her group will most likely land on the planet once again in secrecy, and the agents she recruited during her sojourn on the world will obtain the information she needs.{/n}

f2338c08-60e2-4891-9a9c-9b050ce46276.Text: {n}Following a fabricated trail of clues, Lady Xue and her party went deep into the jungle. After several cycles, agri-scouts found the group's dead bodies. The remains of the deceased acolytes were sent to the Inquisition with honours, and Lady Xue's notes found their way onto the Rogue Trader's flagship.{/n}

5f94b2c6-a43e-4f49-a695-5441b10d699f.Text: "Lady Xue is a prudent and cautious acolyte. She's not prone to rash and daring antics."

c5226f98-844f-442c-b979-c05bad244edc.Text: {n}Under the steady sights of lasguns, the Inquisition squad was escorted to the shuttles and sent on their way. There is no doubt that they will make new attempts to infiltrate Janus, and no one knows exactly how many newly recruited agents they left behind on the planet.{/n}

75c7823d-dcd5-4697-95d3-9a0b1f700a84.Text: {n}The elaborate trap designed by the xenos failed — as if Lady Xue had been warned about it in advance. She disappeared into the crowds of serfs along with her people, becoming an outlaw. There is no doubt that the surviving agents of the Inquisition will cause a good deal of trouble in the future.{/n}

7f018c13-e38b-4eb0-bc97-76a28111daae.Text: {n}The depleted but victorious Inquisition squad left Janus with the bodies of their fallen comrades in tow. The enforcers who provided invaluable assistance to the Inquisition in battle were publicly commended and rewarded with generous gifts. Lady Xue's records mysteriously disappeared just before the squad's departure, finding their way onto the Rogue Trader's ship.{/n}

3f605e20-99a3-4e6f-8196-4007ef55e152.Text: {n}According to Lady Xue's theory, there may be some sort of ancient mechanical construction on Janus that has awakened from its slumber. It is possible that the anomalies occurring on the planet are merely the side effects of the blasphemous machine trying to start itself.{/n}

0f89ab53-b1cb-4316-a715-b83918898492.Text: "I see only one way to make the Inquisition's sojourn on Janus brief: be proactive and give the acolyte what she is looking for."

9e7a8cc0-e1ea-4eea-a5b2-fbed79d26011.Text: "It's the best option: the Inquisition will be satisfied and Janus will return to normal all the sooner."

3c87f799-384f-4df1-946f-b1b22cf81b14.Text: {n}The Rogue Trader's servants eagerly set about finding the smallest trace of anything that might be useful to the agents of the Inquisition. Lady Xue's people were so inundated with denunciations and testimonies that the acolytes suspected sabotage disguised as aid. However, the zealous assistance bore fruit and put the Inquisition on the right track.{/n}

3406844a-0c84-4f70-b7f8-1e06da5067f3.Text: "The initial interrogations have set Lynett Xue on the tracks of the retches, toward the anomalous region. But her people continue to... dig deeper, so to speak."

4371f727-f88a-4296-8b76-3acede41892c.Text: "The search of the governor's palace was interrupted by a fire, which, for better or worse, was extinguished before it could destroy the residence. Hundreds of servants perished in the flames. However, the Inquisition still managed to discover traces of heretical rituals and have started their search for the governor."

88725482-7f9e-4f80-9d9b-47623add2aaa.Text: "Several battle squads have moved out in the direction of the Webway Gate — how they came to learn its coordinates is unknown. So far the only things they have been able to find are xenos ruins."

697d1a05-93ae-4d3b-8feb-0c32155c326c.Text: {n}The Inquisition's raid on the heretics' lair was successful — dozens of high-ranking aristocrats who worshipped the Ruinous Powers were exterminated. Lady Xue and her allies fell in a battle against a daemon summoned by the cult as an act of vengeance.{/n}

99e3fd52-af61-491c-bbe0-6f304fe9cf68.Text: "To serve Janus and the von Valancius dynasty!"

6b0f5311-8dee-43d4-be01-5330f781fd46.Text: "Have this retch, Khegh, lead my soldiers into the forest. We are ready to cooperate."

26f48fa3-228e-4003-b5fe-012574506049.Text: "Send the best enforcers into the heart of the storm — have them find its source."

69d11caa-8ea5-4463-99d0-58f054091f80.Text: "Tell the squad to support the blue spirits. Yrliet, make sure the men know the right words."

0eb39cf3-7e26-4468-a628-c56e3af23a93.Text: "My people will enter the fray on the side of the purple spirits. Marazhai, see to it that they come to an understanding with the phantoms."

681714fb-cdf0-475f-8a26-e78917b76231.Text: "I am ordering them to attack the spirits. Both kinds."

9ccd4c22-20ee-4e21-9419-92ae996a5686.Text: "Tell my warriors that they are fighting for Janus's future, one where the world is free from vengeful xenos, and that their Lord Captain is watching!"

210b822e-fbb3-4d7f-bfd0-429f556f121e.Text: "We will not interfere. Let the xenos kill each other."

1edd4756-63bb-4125-87fe-877cf3e0eb5e.Text: "Our people shall go into the thicket with Muaran to help him."

4325d660-fec8-4057-adab-f5bd87e8531a.Text: "Have the enforcers strengthen Lady Vyatt's squad."

c856d18c-fb3c-4aa7-9a24-a6a45c6a4d07.Text: "My people shall help Lady Xue break into the heart of the storm."

8697a917-7571-481e-9853-fa7904d35427.Text: "Calm down and report what exactly is happening there."

9750a08f-f775-44b0-9c47-2ad32adb1e3c.Text: "What do we know about this cataclysm?"

62d54ab2-2a00-4b72-bcb1-c4ae21ff039f.Text: "Some retch by the name of Khegh has come out of the wilderness to meet our people. It is hard to understand him, but he has managed to explain to the soldiers that 'Halchyon and Kessei are fighting. Halchyon in the usual way and Kessei in a wrong, corrupted way.' It seems that he wants to collaborate with us and is trying to ask for help."

6fb289ad-d6bf-416c-a6c0-9705f0934e15.Text: "All the retches in custody have instantaneously gone mad. We cannot pull a modicum of information from them, even though we have a sense that they understand what is happening much better than we do."

dd45f97e-f121-4682-bf3c-bb25488cf84d.Text: "Unfortunately, the anomalies are as deadly to xenos as they are to humans. Muaran claims that this is the consequence of our attacks on the corrupted sector... then he added something disrespectful about 'the mon-keigh' that the Astropath couldn't make out due to interference."

b7960b79-78fe-49f2-8d3b-131d5c95acbc.Text: "The escort squad reports that the xenos are managing to find safe routes through the corrupted sector using their inhuman senses."

39c8122a-308a-44d2-a3ea-92e1be66ea72.Text: "The escort squad reports that trusting the xenos turned out to be a mistake — the corrupted sector attacks them with the same ferocity as it does humans. They were not prepared, and causalities are high."

47f70c83-c4f8-4dc4-9692-50a40a5f2009.Text: "The escort squad reports that the servants of Lady Vyatt are casting blasphemous protective sorcery that seems to effectively ward the ghosts away, helping them to move forward."

169f770f-be73-49f9-9e56-5b535b739e58.Text: "The escort squad reports that the blasphemous protective sorcery cast by the servants of Lady Vyatt attracts the enraged wraiths to them. Casualties are high."

90f429f0-9328-4f3e-896b-cd20aca930f5.Text: "Our people have reached the xenos ruins that once served as either a palace or a gargantuan machine. They have encountered an extremely high concentration of spirits. It appears the spirits are fighting among themselves with two particularly vivid ghostly figures among them. One of these prominent spirits radiates blue light and seems to be clad in Aeldari armour. The other is engulfed in purple flames and clad in a xenos ceremonial raiment. They utter sounds reminiscent of Aeldari speech, but any attempts to translate them have proved unsuccessful thus far."

af0d22c6-f336-4a0a-b286-a7f41a5eb93c.Text: "It is an old dialect, from a time before the Fall! Order your warriors to aid the spirit wreathed in blue! It fights for the Lilaethan's purity against the despicable sorcery! Even an echo of this spirit's voice is enough to understand that its cause is just! I can teach your people how to explain to the blue spirits that they are not their enemy."

35902065-b6e9-421c-a206-2cd916f89fe7.Text: "So strange it is to hear the words of our ancestors, those who witnessed the apex of our glory. I... find myself rather enjoying the words of the spirit clad in purple. That one is a master of delights, a commanding prince of wisdom. So much more compelling than the pompous blue-flamed fool. Have your servants support the purple-sheathed one, and I will tell them the right words to stop the purple phantoms from slaughtering them."

753b8d23-80a8-4985-9f65-2acf1a015a64.Text: "What does it matter what those spirits are babbling about? They both must be slain! Aett-Vater, turn to your warriors and inspire them to fight for their home to the very last! They have already made sacrifices to get this far — so remind them what those sacrifices were for!"

9692fe20-8350-463c-8b67-0a7db492349d.Text: {n}Alas, the von Valancius forces were too drained by the long march and the losses they sustained. The whole squad was wiped out by the ghosts, only a handful surviving the massacre. Several hours later, a bright flash lit up the forests, and a shock wave from some colossal explosion swept across the entire surface of the planet, turning the agri-complexes to dust.{/n}

7fa6ca9b-73c0-4529-9b9e-edf299f7330b.Text: {n}The scouts attacked, destroying the purple spirits one after another. The blue phantoms recognised their new allies and did not harm them. Once the battle was over, the dignified spirit swathed in blue flames reached out to the scouts' thoughts, granting them visions.{/n}

0d3a43fc-664f-476f-900a-a46931e25ad0.Text: {n}Filled with courage, the Rogue Trader's warriors charged forth as if their sovereign was at their side. Their wounds, exhaustion, and losses forgotten, they each fought with the strength of four soldiers and exterminated the spirits, both blue and purple alike.{/n}

09b682a9-bebb-4c1b-afdb-faf41538c2eb.Text: {n}The scouts attacked, destroying the blue spirits one after another. The purple phantoms recognised their new allies and did not harm them. Once the battle was over, the regal spirit swathed in purple radiance reached out to the scouts' thoughts, granting them visions.{/n}

ecd7d748-e699-4540-aaff-8cabf9ddc248.Text: {n}The warriors of Janus marched bravely into battle, descending upon the xenos spirits. The regal figure in purple was banished first, and soon the blue warrior followed, disintegrated by a plasma mine explosion. As the spirits dissipated into thin air, the battle-ravaged ruins crumbled. The day was won for Humanity.{/n}

561f7a1b-7b58-4103-9873-d7562012c27b.Text: "The ruins are illuminating and the temperature is rising. The auspexes are picking up a rapid increase in emissions on various spectra. There is a sense of grim foreboding among the scouts. They are standing by for further orders."

95a2fa9e-988a-48ec-9ae5-395a2e4b35ba.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, we've lost contact with the squad. The observers report that a blinding flash was spotted at the heart of the afflicted sector. And that there is a shock wave approaching. God-Emperor help them."

412b0b5b-079b-49af-9c5a-2a0d8a6cea51.Text: "The deadly spirits have become more material, and now everyone can see that they are not dancing — they are fighting! Fighting and chanting two names — Halchyon and Kessei."

ca36e1db-b22d-4a18-90dc-4956dbb90abb.Text: "The leader of the Inquisition squad, Lady Xue, did not grace us with a full report since she has been hastily preparing for the expedition into the heart of the anomaly. But she mysteriously claims that 'we have become witnesses to an ancient feud between xenos, and, in spite of our unfamiliarity with their conflict, it is important to choose our ally in this struggle wisely'... Whatever that means."

9858a133-70e5-4761-be0c-c18aef99d098.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! A monstrous storm has broken out on Janus! Apocalyptic anomalies are tearing our agri-world apart, and their epicentre is in the corrupted sector! Something must be done before the whole colony is destroyed!
