We must find the source of this... madness!"

23ad4aa9-4cb2-46ce-9093-e103976c1a68.Text: "Lady Vistenza has conducted some sort of... meditation, afterward gathering all her most skilled servants. Now her squad arms itself to strike a blow at the heart of the cataclysm. She has sent a message saying that 'it would be a great Pleasure for her to carry out this retribution.' The word 'Pleasure' was written with a capital letter — perhaps it is some kind of cipher."

7ac67563-2029-432f-be28-990c69b88cc7.Text: "The xenos Muaran has taken his squad out of the forest and is making ready to enter the corrupted sector. He requests aid and promises that we will understand what is going on 'soon.' It is not clear whether we can trust such an enigmatic creature."

0e598596-ac63-4e0a-ab6a-a973231bcee8.Text: "The escort squad reports that the Emperor protects them this day: they advance through the corrupted sector with few casualties."

50165cfe-5c5c-40b7-9396-62e170a8a8ca.Text: "The escort squad reports that the anomalies have already whittled their numbers in half, but that they are determined to advance forward or die trying."

c1d4847d-bd20-4a8d-84d2-4cb6d80b4bf8.Text: "The escort squad reports that the mutant has not deceived them, from what they can tell, and that their route is clear of anomalies."

cf353ee5-1e13-4d49-ad54-9e5cf3beb1b9.Text: "The escort squad reports that their route had been clear of anomalies until a panicked soldier shot the retch in the head. Immediately afterward, they were assaulted by the wraiths and have suffered heavy casualties."

78c455d7-1e95-44b4-94b1-b4d0432e8394.Text: "The escort squad reports that the people of Lady Xue are demonstrating incredible skill, swiftly dealing with the anomalies and advancing toward the epicentre."

76210776-c0d4-4f14-a98b-520758bc2634.Text: "The escort squad reports that the acolyte and some of her retinue have died in a horrifying anomaly, and that our people have suffered heavy losses but keep advancing nonetheless."

a1fb9a8f-9903-4459-990e-a09a589e2b20.Text: "During her reconnaissance, Lady Vyatt's people were attacked by the ghosts despite their prior indifference toward mortals. They have managed to retreat, however, and Lady Vyatt is confident that she can crush such a small resistance."

d5cb643f-8515-40fa-8868-2042e01564a1.Text: "Thankfully, there are much fewer of them than there were before. Gaps have even appeared in the horrifying cyclone of dance twisting about the epicentre."

6ac9bd2c-1830-4f08-ab9d-e0cd08e22a74.Text: "During her reconnaissance, Lady Vyatt's people were attacked by the ghosts despite their prior indifference toward mortals. Her fighters have been annihilated, and there is no doubt that a tough battle lies in wait for Lady Vyatt."

56a49da6-5c6e-488d-b09e-ba7072453738.Text: "The anomalies seem to be more merciful toward xenos than humans. Muaran specifically thanked Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} for refraining from attacking the corrupted sector — he claims that it has made his journey much easier."

1efc3187-66bf-4c35-8415-d100d0bb3f04.Text: {n}The anomalies stopped ravaging Janus. A group of explorers carefully approached the site of the battle and began gathering evidence to shed some light on the recent events. Piecing together the knowledge that they had gathered, they were able to retrace the history of this world.{/n}

578d17db-cfc7-48ab-85c7-4773bcd1f261.Text: {n}The planet, which was inhabited by Aeldari prior to the Fall, at some point became one of the many theatres of the war between sensual excess, the dogma that reigned over the xenos of that time, and ascetic self-restraint. A local ruler, Kessei, was enlightened and wise, yet susceptible to depravity. In his desire to transfer his soul to another form of existence, he created a mechanism that would let him take over the bodies and minds of all his people. One of the ruler's bodyguards named Halchyon rose against the tyrant and mortally wounded him, but could not stop him from merging with the machine. Halchyon then gave his life to bind his own spirit to the device and continue fighting therein. This tragic conflict marked the end of all Aeldari on the planet but preserved an echo of their souls and those of their leaders.{/n}

45304363-7d35-46e5-b619-b75b5b92ae58.Text: "The xenos Muaran has ordered the squad to attack the purple spirits and ignore the blue ones, but your people are waiting for confirmation from you."

c97467a4-9cfc-428b-a4fd-2537a9380a9e.Text: "Governor Vyatt claims to have 'sensed' that the right decision would be to support the purple spirits in this battle, but, naturally, she defers to your judgement."

7486b411-133a-4867-9a35-adb042a6402f.Text: "Lady Xue intends to fight both sides of this spirit conflict, but your soldiers are waiting for you to confirm her orders."

5ff078c3-caac-4f38-bf01-8c4902ad23b6.Text: "The only relatively safe areas are those parts of the corrupted sector that have been scarred by our weapons. For some reason, there are fewer anomalies there than in other places."

8f9fecb7-b386-43fd-962c-8f0058f46504.Text: {n}Then the spirits disappeared... but for how long? The bodies of the fallen and a strange relic discovered amid the ruins were the only proof that, for a single day, Janus was once more engulfed in a war between long-fallen xenos.{/n}

7f54c759-fc79-4ef4-a0c8-2671d4affbfe.Text: {n}The shock wave rolled across the surface of the planet and levelled its agri-complexes.{/n}

22a49ada-277e-4357-83c2-d7d46da3f417.Text: "The moaning earth, the purple glow in the sky, fires crashing on the ground from above and turning all they touch to ice, a terrible noise sweeping through the cities and killing anyone who hears it... The furious storm has covered half the continent, but we can see its epicentre from orbit — the ruins of a xenostructure complex. What we thought to be the debris of buildings has turned out to be a machine... And now it rouses from its sleep, emitting blue and purple lights from the spheres fused into it."

d9608a2f-db4f-44fd-8fcd-06877169cf24.Text: "Pasqal, gather a team to study and deconstruct the device."

d09f8ab2-88d6-4c6b-b600-fb095934579e.Text: "How could Delphim construct such a powerful and monstrous machine?"

75e81fef-81db-42d9-a292-2489409be3c4.Text: "Assign Transmechanics to listen to the voices of the warp. Have them report on anything they hear."

86f8c1fd-bc25-4413-9f9a-b7fa84271f5b.Text: "Switch the machine from receiving to transmitting. We will use it in place of the colony's Astropathic Choir."

bd38c74b-71ba-4314-b8ff-e4c3ad1f526b.Text: "What are the risks of using this machine?"

dbe24a32-745c-48d6-ba5e-984144193cdc.Text: "What does my retinue think about this?"

e3371eb8-d32e-4486-bc51-e20fede10fb4.Text: "Then so be it, Argenta. Shake the warp with a wrathful sermon in honour of the Emperor!"

9269fc82-8c6b-452a-8382-a90878d2eb31.Text: "Have my special servants from the forbidden workshops study the mechanism and make use of it as a replacement for the world's Astropathic Choir."

00bc4c3f-532c-4417-b863-6125f274c282.Text: "This blasphemous creation must be anathematised and deconstructed. In the name of total knowledge acquisition, the principles of its operation must be inspected beforehand in great secrecy. Requesting the right to investigate the heretical device before disposing of it."

06dcad04-fbf7-462a-ae9b-2f9170399626.Text: "Typical of contact with the Immaterium. It intercepts information from the warp, which puts the minds and souls of the staff serving the machine in jeopardy. The warp is treacherous."

1b5975e9-7ba4-4d69-9085-688286031e27.Text: "Lord Captain, the Tech-Priests have made a sinister discovery on Kiava Gamma — a blasphemous machine built at the behest of the wicked Cubis Delphim. This mechanism is capable of picking up the whispers of the warp. It also occasionally transmits a discordant binharic melody to nowhere in particular, but no encrypted data or other threats have been detected — it seems to be a functional side effect of sorts."

7b888503-79b9-4cc5-aaf4-287dc78ea7e0.Text: "Of course, the idea of using a machine instead of Astropaths to contact the voices of the warp may seem tempting, but... this machine is teeming with corruption. Its fuel tanks are satiated with the liquefied souls of your subjects. It has enough for now, but... someday it will have to be refilled."

a673ea89-cd6c-49a8-be49-adbc64ae3ec8.Text: {n}The squad of the Inquisition's acolytes secretly requisitioned the corrupted machine. After a short while, some rather curious anonymous warnings began to arrive on Dargonus, and each of them had undoubtedly been paid for with the blood and soul of a selfless defender of the Imperium.{/n}

10dc0479-69a5-44ad-ab97-6fd74375e3ce.Text: {n}Despite the short shifts and meticulous control, many Transmechanics were disposed of after their contact with the monstrous machine. But the small scraps of information they obtained justified their sacrifice.{/n}

6b5b5e37-44d2-430a-b8c6-ea84eeac8f50.Text: {n}The invited preachers, strict and stern, started to take shifts reciting a formidable litany about the inevitable victory of the Emperor into the vox-caster. Their angry words flew straight into the Immaterium, reverberated in the ears of the spirits that inhabited it, unable to hide from this righteous diatribe. Whenever one of the preachers perished, another would take their place, and there was no shortage of volunteers.{/n}

7f543ba1-6fe5-40b7-b6b2-da1032ada99b.Text: "On behalf of the Inquisition, I hereby declare a ban on any contact with this device. It must be removed and given to our acolytes. Normally that would be all, but I will explain further — out of respect for you. The Inquisition can... reap benefits from this heretical machine. Our trained acolytes are able to carry a vigil near it, carefully listening to the dark whispers of the spirits of the Immaterium without succumbing to their corruption. We could discover their plans... and warn the Rogue Trader whenever any threat would loom over {mf|his|her} domain."

836f7e1e-1004-4f7f-bdf9-6b5590217968.Text: "The daemons wanted us to hear their vile speeches? Let them hear our righteous cry! {name}, let me summon the most zealous preachers who would dedicate their lives and zeal to reading a litany of fury and rage to this machine. Let the inhabitants of the warp hear our voice and fear us!"

c4edd18e-d76f-49b8-983c-480c69ecb8ea.Text: "Your command shall be relayed to the manufactorum attendants."

0d11f617-db6e-4d27-b9c9-ed541a0fa3d5.Text: "Our duty of total knowledge acquisition will be fulfilled. The Omnissiah knows all, comprehends all."

f18d6cd3-6850-4deb-b2c5-69b954abc149.Text: "By defying the dictums of the Omnissiah and venturing into the perilous field of experimenting with warp technology. It is dangerous knowledge... but the ancient and incredibly complex vox-core of the mechanism is much older than Delphim was. He probably found it here and made use of it to his own ends."

d4218c03-dfca-4bdd-832f-6a04dd0b9d9b.Text: {n}Thanks to the information overheard in the whispers of the warp, many heretical plots and blasphemous messages sent by the Cult of the Final Dawn have been uncovered. The protectorate has gained a new line of defence.{/n}

cec90fd7-4cf0-4c58-a46a-4bd2ce3bb305.Text: {n}The mechanism, turned into an Astropathic repeater, could convey messages much more reliably and clearly than the Choir could. Strange errors obfuscating the message's original meaning would occasionally slip in, but such inaccuracies have been considered acceptable.{/n}

8f68f533-8bac-4480-9981-aa01159be28e.Text: {n}The device was ruthlessly but carefully deconstructed. The Tech-Priests who conducted the examination relayed their findings to Magos Haneumann, at which point they were righteously disposed of.{/n}

ed06bb98-d097-41c7-99fa-05953ce4aca8.Text: {n}The device was mercilessly but carefully destroyed. During its death throes, the device emitted noises that drove other mechanisms to madness and ruin. But it was finished, and faith in the triumph of the Omnissiah filled the hearts of the righteous.{/n}

1af98f6d-2fdc-495e-bfbb-99e2ac8fe465.Text: "However... the secret artisans to whom you have entrusted the task of dealing with the... legacy of the wicked Delphim, claim to be able to use this device to your advantage and... without any risks..."

ad0d71cc-512a-492a-a4c7-e222dad20a2b.Text: {n}The sinister heretics under the protection of the Rogue Trader moved the machine to their wicked lair. Listening to the echoes of the Immaterium, they welcomed more corruption and dark knowledge into their souls.{/n}

815c9a97-4b3e-4d24-a592-7dce08796197.Text: "Do as you wish, Pasqal. You have my permission."

5c3c1d76-812f-427f-866f-f71483b5f3b7.Text: "Launch an atomic strike on the centre of the epidemic and incinerate the plague."

1f1e469c-ca0b-4d11-b35e-b10f35677c71.Text: "Isolate the manufactorum. Jae, invite those who would be willing to pay for the chance to study this tech-leprosy."

3d473f54-88a4-4564-b797-9067ed874b78.Text: "Create an exclusion zone around the manufactorum. We must study this plague and find a cure for it."

6873dafb-8ec5-4bd6-bb7c-894923b10146.Text: "Abelard, send our officers to organise the quarantine and purge."

3c9ac621-3db9-4daa-9eca-c0aa0e8a260e.Text: "Send Tech-Purgator squads into the centre of the epidemic."

6a01f1fb-300b-433e-bd98-2d0bef540da0.Text: "Kibellah, let the spinners share their secret."

a2e271c1-dc49-4b02-be82-e2a9b2a9a445.Text: "I wish to listen to the suggestions of my advisors."

ac4fe539-327d-4a10-84e9-a74e987079bb.Text: "Lord Captain, after the unsealing of Lady Theodora's secret workshop on Kiava Gamma, an epidemic of mysterious tech-leprosy has broken out. Augments mutate into distorted forms, killing their hosts. Machines and even entire assembly halls break apart into fragments that devour each other, fusing into grotesque and insane forms. The Omega-18 manufactorum, the epicentre of the epidemic, is cordoned off, but the disease will burst out of there sooner or later."

1481e198-b248-4933-87d9-71340689d18e.Text: {n}A cure for the mysterious disease has still not been identified, but the study of the tech-leprosy strain has made it possible to control samples of the disease using magnetic impulses and turn it into a dangerous weapon.{/n}

6a915fcf-16d7-4f26-94eb-e8c2229908ea.Text: "We have not faced anything like this before. The plague only affects mechanisms, forcing them to transform and lose all functionality. No one has been able to provide insight into the nature of this disease or how it found its way into Lady Theodora's secret workshop. It is possible that some secret research was being carried out there."

bcdef198-5f9f-433a-b470-c278a321b470.Text: "Oh, you will not regret it, shereen!"

25b6caaa-0922-410e-bc4e-8692bc974dcb.Text: "Your request is accepted. I shall withdraw to perform the sacrament."

ed0804b6-ac11-4c1b-89ef-69dc3cc040ae.Text: "Your special servants, who bear knowledge of the prior desecration of Kiava Gamma, are as susceptible to the disease as any other person. They have assured me the disease has nothing to do with the Ruinous Powers and comes from a xenos source."

6a518504-15be-4f76-8772-2a0dcab7aaf2.Text: "The eradication of the infection is the highest priority, but to completely eradicate the manufactorum serving as the epicentre is to inflict serious damage to the resource supply. This unit... I can propose another method of purging. However, the sacraments of the Omnissiah that are available to me cannot be revealed to the laity. I ask that you place your trust in me."

38184f83-359e-4adb-aeb1-c0a8addf9e4e.Text: "Shereen, do not be so hasty with this purge. This phenomenon may be of interest to other specialists. There are many who do not agree that all Knowledge belongs solely to cogs. What appears to be a plague could hold amazing possibilities. If we could isolate the manufactorum and let these inquisitive minds inside, they would happily compensate us for the loss of production capacity."

8c2d88b1-67a6-409f-821c-aceebb39c929.Text: "I have suppressed eighteen different epidemics aboard the flagship, and our officers have experience in setting up quarantines. We will send them to Kiava Gamma to lead the Tech-Purgator squads. They will not return from the epicentre until the infection is eradicated and the preventive exclusion zone is taken down."

1c607819-6056-45b0-9eeb-ab34ba4d88eb.Text: {n}The tightened quarantine measures imposed by the more experienced officers have prevented the corruption from entering other manufactorums, and the disease did not spread any further.{/n}

1e483cc3-51c1-41bd-a1b3-4a59e2d85ee1.Text: {n}The mysterious "interested parties" arrived on the planet with an entourage comprised of malateks, excommunicated technomats, and shady-looking scholars. Without even trying to haggle, they paid exorbitant sums to obtain access to the previously unknown xenodisease, and then headed off into the bowels of the dying manufactorum.{/n}

78240848-1480-4d85-9c9e-04a68a35b770.Text: "Death is the same for all things. Only the Undying One is eternal."

c25ae413-3708-45c5-9d8c-f786657e42b8.Text: {n}The Kiava Gamma manufactorums began production of the compound given to them by the Bloodspun Web. In tanks of armaglass, it was sent to the pockets of infestation and sprayed on warped machines and affected people. The workshops were cleared of tech-mutations.{/n}

bf1ee989-7409-4ed2-8687-381805b14669.Text: {n}The bombardment with megaton shells wiped the manufactorum out. The epidemic had subsided, but the loss of the grand workshops affected the production capacity of the world.{/n}

503ab4f4-98a0-4444-aa59-da4c73817b87.Text: {n}By the heroic efforts of the Tech-Purgators, the manufactorum was purged of the disease, sector by sector. The affected machines and dead bodies were consigned to the sacred plasma flames.{/n}

b34d971f-d45c-4f23-9278-21d0d829694a.Text: {n}However, after the Tech-Purgators returned to their workshops, new, smaller outbreaks of tech-mutations were detected. They did not come as a surprise and were isolated quickly, but the production processes of the planet suffered some damage.{/n}

f0ba7740-d5af-4f36-a672-46586964767f.Text: {n}Many of the Tech-Priests who had once maintained this manufactorum were left without a function and transferred to serve aboard the Rogue Trader's ship.{/n}

e86a2f8f-66f6-41b7-8917-3dc8b7198891.Text: "Even metal dies eventually, scarred by corrosion. To combat those who have stripped away their flesh and replaced it with machinery, the Bloodspun Web has procured a remedy, an acidic compound that burns through steel. We stand ready to help. To burn out this tech-leprosy."

e6a7c277-a38c-40ef-9978-c6f7e5b3b07e.Text: {n}The Tech-Priests, armed with a mysterious device they assembled according to the instructions of Magos Haneumann, entered the bowels of the manufactorum. What happened there is unknown. Reports speak of a blue and green flash that illuminated the manufactorum, and the epidemic subsided overnight. The distorted mechanisms were honourably melted down, and so were the bodies of the dead Tech-Priests who carried the machine of Magos Haneumann, as well as the burnt remains of the machine itself. The eminent Magos refused to comment on his chosen method of purging, calling it a "revelation of the Omnissiah that he himself could not comprehend before it left him."{/n}

5db4e7fe-23f9-45ba-a2e3-8d8cd75aad14.Text: "Take all the Magi out of their cells and destroy these cells immediately."

873e3e67-afc1-4f4e-a7ff-c5d1a961d625.Text: "Idira is right. Find Tech-Priests to fulfil the Procedure among the 'unworthy' Tech-Priests on minor stations of the Expanse."

7c2ec4a2-81c4-4503-8eba-fccfb1f21d4b.Text: "Yrliet, share the wisdom of your kinsmen with my people."

33ce8ae2-f6c0-4e8c-8eb4-2cee53447cf3.Text: "What do we know about this Procedure? Could it be part of Delphim's legacy?"

44b76c8c-2665-498b-8df7-9ddcfbe23f65.Text: "Heinrix, I will be grateful to the Inquisition for the help with eliminating the Procedure."

afe24965-b5be-46cf-a56c-6996d75eca75.Text: "Perhaps my advisors have a few words to share?"

20753bee-fdd2-47f6-ba89-b7a22c0745b6.Text: "Study this Procedure — we must know what we are dealing with."

270b93e8-9d17-4510-9dbc-0b491623a00d.Text: "Lord Captain, a strange anomaly has been detected on Kiava Gamma. A series of orders, defined as Procedure 0-C, has forced itself into the production algorithms. The servants of the Omnissiah define its execution status as 'most sacred' and therefore follow its instructions to the letter. In just one cycle, cells were erected in all the manufactorums, connected by cogitators, or more precisely, their computing channels. This network forms a pattern similar to those applied to the digital cells of machine spirits."

ca3ad2b6-2738-4092-87c1-e24eb4a9144d.Text: "I find this sacrilegious suggestion to be in breach of the data-unity protocol."

1e96a61e-6a77-4cec-95a2-51e65d416656.Text: "Your... most trusted servants, those toiling in the secret workrooms on the planet, also found the code of the Procedure free of corruption. And were highly keen to learn more about it."

d26cbc7f-5384-4fae-b596-b6895ca0de5d.Text: "They are singing? It is surprising that your race was able to achieve such a harmonious form of interaction with crafted tools. My kinsmen, too, use psycho-acoustic harmonics to guide our creations. I am not a Bonesinger myself, but I might be able to tell your servants of certain... principles that define the sound of the universe."

4372d499-2503-4fb1-8e1b-51cfb6cefdf2.Text: {n}Execution of the poorly understood Procedure 0-C was forbidden. In their efforts to root out its directives and remove the Magi from the cells, the Rogue Trader's servants faced resistance, resulting in bloodshed and death.{/n}

0421941a-dfa4-45d8-8919-7b6aecfe3af9.Text: "A signal seemingly from nowhere that has the highest execution priority. A perfect weapon for capturing the planet. It should be anathematised, and I am ready to summon a cadre of competent Techsorcists from the Inquisition."

fa68b292-0ab3-4be2-a82d-c968ca69583e.Text: "I am familiar with the gifts of the Omnissiah and have personally trained several specialists for the Lord Inquisitor's retinue. There will not be any problems."

6d43849b-dfa3-4e24-8775-c6d5c41e2087.Text: {n}However, the Techsorcists of the Inquisition who arrived on the planet tempered the anger of the Omnissiah's servants by confirming the legitimacy of the Lord Captain's actions.{/n}

7e5bdfd2-ab9c-4fb7-9bdf-d4a6a2cfad57.Text: "We will see if the mon-keigh are capable of learning from the civilised."

541d296d-36e2-4504-827d-f60148cc0bbc.Text: {n}For a small fee, the dynasty managed to purchase many "ineffective" servants from the Adeptus Mechanicus that demonstrate increased psy-receptivity. They were placed in the cells, and Kiava Gamma's production rates were not harmed.{/n}

363fa9ea-e8b4-42b0-9f1f-d61bd4983629.Text: {n}The dynasty's servants began their investigation, seeking to determine the nature and purpose of the mysterious Procedure. Awestruck, they encountered ancient creations of datasmithing impossible in the current times, but could not fathom the wisdom of the digital archeotech.{/n}

08c7a313-9b76-4e67-8fae-54b3aa478367.Text: "We cannot trace the source of the signal that activated the Procedure or identify its purpose. The Tech-Priests oppose the idea of studying the Procedure, as it 'violates the sacrament.' Supposedly, the minds of the Magi immersed in the cells are involved in some grand-scale computation. The servants of the Omnissiah have tested the planet's cogitational network seven times with purifying algorithms of varying degrees of severity, proclaiming it clean."

9de00b7c-5b88-40fa-90be-e446bfc4cec1.Text: {n}Suitable candidates were granted the right to take their place inside the datadream cells. The loss of such valuable servants has naturally affected production on the planet.{/n}

6053830b-563d-42a8-b21f-4610a8f1af0e.Text: {n}The blasphemous study of xenos Knowledge undertaken as part of the investigation led to a series of heretical acts of creation — the tempted minds of the Magi sought to apply the secrets of the Aeldari to their research. The culprits were servitorised and the results of their work placed in a protected, forbidden catalogue.{/n}

aa4f0e70-0dba-4f6f-b84e-6f58ddaeff28.Text: "The 0-C Procedure commands Magi with an above average psy-receptivity index to enter the cells. Those Tech-Priests who take their seats in the cells fall into a blissful datadream and begin to sing binharic hymns very similar to those that periodically whirred from the warp vox of Cubis Delphim. The performance of the manufactorums has dropped — many of the Machine God's servants have abandoned their posts and are pleading for the privilege of fulfilling Procedure 0-C, but the enforcers have taken custody of the cells and ward these volunteers away from them."

c130b80f-4c53-414f-a994-4d9fe555ce5b.Text: "You say these cells need to be filled with high psy-sensitivity Tech-Priests? Sure, but why use our own servants? Just check out a few remote stations and outposts, look for cogs who were banished as unfit — and you will find three times as many more suitable candidates than in the manufactorums. Psy-receptivity rarely goes hand in hand with high rationality, and such Tech-Priests often end their careers in some backwater."

a95dfac9-38d3-464e-8db8-48cdd4bcae39.Text: {n}Procedure 0-C is being carried out without fail. The binharic trill rings throughout the world's Noosphere. According to yet another inscrutable directive, an enigmatic object was delivered to the Rogue Trader's residence on Kiava Gamma.{/n}

4befd0c1-b31d-4a29-9391-1c58c806bb1b.Text: "They will be glad not to feel like human refuse for once."

2856d437-7d6e-41b6-88a5-6313ae7bb63a.Text: "How did the cultists infiltrate my world?"

c60db250-f3f4-47b9-910a-b4bf0707fb84.Text: "The data-angels must be banished — just like the schismaticals. This is my world, and I will not have it endangered by uncontrollable elements."

8cc46ff0-092f-4fc5-8392-e6bc2e95c519.Text: "Marazhai is right. Capture one of the data-angels for me and use any means necessary to learn more about its nature. Destroy the rest along with the schismaticals."

7df1a5b6-2692-41dd-b770-edf16909ce01.Text: "Pasqal, sanction the ritual of bonding with the backup cogitators."

90df77de-6bac-40eb-9097-cb7f79ae3cf2.Text: "Let us join forces with the data-angels and get rid of the corruption together."

72a259a7-972a-4fe8-8b9c-1960c9539cf6.Text: "We're following Solomorne's plan: lure the enemy into an ambush, then destroy them all in one fell swoop."

2c023d93-b2a4-4540-a8b1-7c2c259fa913.Text: "I wish to hear the opinions of my officers and advisors."

3cc677f3-9097-4bdf-b88f-1c8691c195b8.Text: "Let the righteous warriors of Kiava Gamma exterminate all the data-spirits!"

151ceb69-2233-496b-921c-60a28061ebee.Text: "Order my secret artisans to stab the cultists in the back."

caaf724a-d7c3-45c0-a89d-e9919830f192.Text: "Lord Captain, there has been an act of sabotage on Kiava Gamma! The Cult of the Final Dawn has invaded the planet, cultivated a pack of schismaticals in the bowels of the manufactorums, and set them upon us! The attack was so sudden that we almost lost all the workshops, but... we had help. Some entities, already being called 'data-angels,' have invaded the cogitational network, seized the cogitators and servitors, and used them to repel the first onslaught of the schismaticals. Now there is a fierce struggle taking place all over the planet, the Noosphere of the world is boiling."

905dc71c-ffce-42a6-a3f2-dd42469f0653.Text: "This was a part of a coordinated attack that hit the entire Expanse. The heretics must have been preparing for a long time."

35a945fb-ff2f-45e1-b126-d953a80b0b2b.Text: "Thanks to the fact that the planet had been thoroughly purged of the corrupting influence of Cubis Delphim, the cult now has nowhere to hide and no collaborators on the planet. They have utterly failed to compromise our world's defences."

e6328b99-59ef-4615-a84c-801bdb1b3326.Text: "The cultists have contacted your secret artisans who toil in the forbidden workshops. The fools hope that they will betray Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} and join in the attack. We could use their delusions to our advantage... If our enemy truly is mistaken, that is."

d42adac6-7604-49f0-af87-3be85a0fff1a.Text: "I wouldn't trust those uninvited 'allies' of yours — such magnanimity is wont to come with unsavoury intentions. Learn more about these creatures. Order your servants to hunt one of them down, torture it, and gain knowledge through the process... since they are incapable of finding pleasure in it."

06bbcd4d-4fc6-4c03-8968-f78477833a26.Text: "The manufactorums of Kiava Gamma are equipped with backup cogitators to ensure the continuity of production in an emergency. The severity of the situation authorises the disruption of the service algorithms, and I am prepared to sanction a ritual that will allow the data-angels of the Omnissiah to absorb the cogitators' computing power to combat these wicked spirits."

f59e4c9a-dd13-44ef-b0a2-c634732e7742.Text: "The request to perform the sacrament is accepted and will be fulfilled immediately."

51073a38-72e1-4ee9-9119-86c59862f6ac.Text: "A shame I will not able to witness this... vivisection."

dbba5c02-463c-4249-be30-f12ee72df511.Text: {n}Having gained access to the cogitational reserves and after being infused with power, the data-angels charged at the schismaticals.{/n}

fd813922-89ff-4f8b-b8ca-58bd6b43f837.Text: {n}After luring one of the data-angels into a specially prepared cogitator, the Lord Captain's servants imprisoned it and gave the signal to destroy the rest of the uninvited guests. The Logis-Mechanics crushed both the data-angels and the schismaticals with comparable ruthlessness.{/n}

26da5519-295e-4da0-b28b-2bbdb814b703.Text: {n}Abandoning their fear, the defenders of Kiava Gamma began to destroy the cogitators afflicted by data-spirits, making no distinction between the data-angels and the schismaticals.{/n}

56cb6fad-8786-4e18-ba1f-d26c7aa4b1a3.Text: {n}The hordes of data-spirits were tech-exorcised and exterminated, and the afflicted mechanisms purged and restored. The Tech-Priests gave praise to the Omnissiah for protecting the production algorithm from severe disruption.{/n}

2d5fcd35-ff5d-4bcc-810f-81d44be44eb6.Text: "Not much. They are machine spirits, beings born from the art of datasmithing. They charge into battle chanting the same binharic mantra that the participants of Procedure 0-C chanted."

a30391e8-e8d3-46ec-a784-85da03f8f563.Text: {n}After banishing the schismaticals, the data-angels withdrew into hiding inside the cogitational networks, leaving the servants of the Omnissiah to guess at who or what these beings were.{/n}

04db1d42-26a6-4f06-ad59-047d7e01f684.Text: {n}Arming themselves with codes of purity and sacred logis-hymns, the guardians of Kiava Gamma charged into battle, vanquishing both the data-angels and the schismaticals alike. While the attack code boiled the Noosphere, the warriors destroyed every afflicted cogitator in their path without mercy.{/n}

0a8f4cb5-059d-48d7-9843-52b08e30d382.Text: {n}In a cunning act of betrayal, the heretics who had sworn oaths to the Rogue Trader afflicted {mf|his|her} enemies with a particularly devastating scrap-code that made even the blessed data-angels and the corrupted schismaticals wither to nothing.{/n}

cda89518-1b20-4adc-990f-7320c147fae7.Text: "Fortunately, we received information about the impending attack at the last moment. The signal was intercepted in the warp by Cubis Delphim's machine."

248c6d7a-a7ac-4d8e-a27a-970f34d43c1e.Text: {n}Their forces combined, the data-angels and brave Logis-Mechanics charged to attack the schismaticals.{/n}

522de06a-85e2-49d1-a352-6edf13db86f3.Text: "The tactics playbook for putting down planet-wide revolts has just the thing for this: we begin by ordering a series of cascading power blackouts, thereby forcing the cultists to redeploy their troops away from any manufactorums that have gone offline. The 'data-angels' are sure to follow them. The schismaticals will respond by trying to gain control of the power distribution hubs — where the Tech-Priests will have set traps to eliminate all the intruders."

a0a721b9-6cef-4dc5-b297-d1cbce6c8ceb.Text: "They act from within the cogitational nodes linked to the cells used in Procedure 0-C, successfully driving the schismaticals out of neighbouring sectors. If we can get their support, we can definitely pry the manufactorums from the corruption's grasp."

9d031108-e8fe-4080-8acf-71d0bac08549.Text: "But there are not many nodes where they can reside — perhaps because we destroyed the cells used in Procedure 0-C. This is quite beneficial to us, should we choose to... refuse the aid of these strange creatures."

e85634bc-1810-4510-becf-43a853bdd352.Text: "The Logis who have been observing them — the same Tech-Priests who previously investigated the cells used in Procedure 0-C — have deciphered traces of their activity and discovered patterns pointing to the possible creators of these data-angels. If they are right, then they bear the seal of the Explorator Cognisance Fleet."

0d4fa2ad-7fa9-4e31-abea-3cfd6fe0c21d.Text: "Humanity will reclaim control of Kiava Gamma."

1cbd8a70-5414-42a2-a1c7-b507df940b4e.Text: {n}Entire continents went dark on Kiava Gamma, forcing the cultists to lay siege to the Motive Force's distribution sancta. It was there that the world's defenders were lying in wait, armed and ready to destroy both schismaticals and "data-angels" alike.{/n}

4c0b0b51-8a4f-47f0-82a9-bf9d845f851c.Text: {n}A fierce fight broke out in the Noosphere of Kiava Gamma. The data-spirits put up a furious resistance but eventually began to lose ground. The workshops and the manufactorums survived at the cost of severe damage. Now that the battle has subsided, Kiava Gamma can start its slow and painful healing process.{/n}

1c619238-6df6-4d2d-83c7-cca767ccb664.Text: {n}The captured data-angel was interrogated, dissected into functions, and studied. Seals of creation were discovered inside its logis-chains, which may eventually reveal the mystery of these creatures' origins.{/n}

251eb15f-04d4-416f-99df-97fb3ae4f02e.Text: {n}The data-angels were slaughtered to the last, their remains dissipating into the world's Noosphere without a trace.{/n}

a22e0442-45aa-48b0-a5d6-5e12b214fd12.Text: "Accessing the Fleet's catalogue. No mentions of operations on Kiava Gamma detected. No information on data-angels detected. Hypothesis: either there has been a calculation error, or the information is locked behind a higher level of sacrament security clearance."

5120b5d0-b75d-408f-9b74-4fe2015a3d9b.Text: "Do we have any idea at all what it might be calculating?"

2e0f5b8f-7d88-4478-9f7f-b3b9b9a2e77c.Text: "I want to know more about this data-loom. What is it?"

34927c96-0fd4-4f67-8e69-bb3505300462.Text: "What do my advisors make of this?"

71f8c362-c3a6-47bd-901b-042becfcb203.Text: "Pasqal, create your mediator and forge an alliance with Null Caliph."

6d5cef1b-e379-4330-9962-70840b9824b5.Text: "Make contact with Null Caliph. I wish to form an alliance with it."

5b4a2130-6079-4987-bafc-b8dac2f444d0.Text: "Idira, come up with a way to force the machine into submission by assailing it through the warp."

437e4304-71e6-4377-a627-1d5ee615c74b.Text: "This is my planet, and the machine must submit to my will."

3b2e8140-1d65-4360-abae-8e6ff98a8065.Text: "Cassia, send word to the Navigator Houses. Null Caliph must be destroyed."

1ead6635-aebe-4522-a446-03e129aab5d4.Text: "I authorise the dismantling of this dangerous mechanism."

1206a501-b69a-4269-aa2d-3d1c8dee0ae1.Text: "Perhaps my secret artisans will find a way to control the machine."

f1dac7b5-e19b-4e13-ad55-fdf311f54ff6.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, a cryptic message arrived from Kiava Gamma. The Fabricator-Censor reports that they have 'beheld the Eye of the Divine.' I requested details from your... less devout servants, and they clarified that the inquest group, which has been investigating the many inexplicable events that have taken place on the planet, followed a trail of mysterious binharic harmonics and came upon an ancient and abandoned data-complex. It is connected to the manufactorum by a maze of communication lines and contains a gargantuan data-loom. The mechanism's markings show that its designation — or, I should say, its rather menacing name — is Null Caliph."

677a7283-35f2-4760-bb98-495a6ad4f808.Text: "It is an ancient production facility, far older than the colony itself. Some assembly lines bear the marks of the Cognisance Fleet. Perhaps the first Explorators who came to the Koronus Expanse set up a station on the yet uninhabited planet. The station was then consumed by the developing industrial colony and eventually... forgotten. It is possible that whatever plans they had for it were so clandestine that its creators' death ended up casting it into oblivion."

787e55bb-0f38-478a-880b-61dc365315dd.Text: "According to the Magi, it can calculate routes through the Immaterium without rest or fear of corruption, given the fact that it has no human soul. They claim that its power is comparable to that of a Novator of a Navigator House. Apparently, Procedure 0-C was initiated by this mechanism to integrate Magi with high psychic potential in order to expand its own computational capacity."

c1bbc853-dc0e-43d9-a829-d3509e332b66.Text: "Because your servants have been monitoring the execution of Procedure 0-C, they rather boldly believe that they have gained some insight into certain patterns of its supercalculation. They claim that they could help achieve an understanding with Null Caliph... or defeat it in battle."

d32081b8-daf5-41dd-bb7d-11e49b3d03a4.Text: "Right now its calculations are severely hindered due to the weakened state of its computational powers. We assume the termination of Procedure 0-C contributed to this."

18a88d88-cb05-4f43-b2d5-2de7e2fadc1d.Text: "The great machine spirit that identifies itself as Null Caliph bears potential as a valuable ally, one that could replace the need for Navigators comprised of fallible flesh. We must make contact with this holy entity, for to do so is to honour the Omnissiah's tenets. That the Tech-Priests who had the audacity to disturb Null Caliph were deprived of their Motive Force is a testament to the might of its data-voice. I hold the knowledge to create a mediator that could interface with the fearsome machine spirit and ease the burden of its revelations on unprepared minds."

5d940400-fec7-4ecb-87eb-39b12e8a46f2.Text: "If it stares into the warp, then it's vulnerable to attacks from the warp. Never thought I'd ever suggest something like this, but... If we want to make that machine obey us, we should assault it through the Immaterium."

59fd355b-8c59-4e83-9bbd-027619e64e66.Text: "A Navigator data-loom? This abomination makes a mockery of every Navigator House's legacy. The very fact of its existence is profoundly sickening and vile. Null Caliph must be destroyed post-haste! Allow me to send word to the other Navigator Houses — they will waste no time in dispatching their forces to destroy this monstrosity."

94e038bd-4976-4c69-8936-48b5e7da38c9.Text: "Request approved. Transferring revelations on the mediator's creation."

b7681322-ba21-4ea8-950f-6c8e1e24f417.Text: "Let's see if the Immaterium can scare a heart of metal."

18a0369a-9df2-4118-ada0-3a08172cc8d3.Text: "A group of machine spirit tamer Tech-Priests will initiate the rites of purification at once."

9cafbb6a-f82f-45d3-9cbe-4261bea3279c.Text: "Thank you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I shall send servants to your Astropath at once."

50d51608-5f58-4f72-b170-f90297f89b82.Text: "I will order the preparation of the assault tech-force."

04a68eb0-e62c-463a-ac72-48bf141c9b18.Text: {n}And Null Caliph answered: halting its sacred calculation, it bestowed its favour upon the supplicants. With its tireless, unblinking eye observing the warp currents, many a traveller have been saved from peril.{/n}

979e5514-21ec-4037-907a-1e0a9ffda4a3.Text: {n}Null Caliph's answer was harsh: it did not wish to be distracted from its sacred calculation or offer its capacities to aid the Rogue Trader. Only the countless lavish gifts offered to the data-loom persuaded it to share minute grains of its wisdom with mortals.{/n}

dee008f3-d44c-4ba6-86fb-4ff9e6975302.Text: {n}The united army of Navigators arrived on Kiava Gamma and brought its wrath down upon the powerful data-loom. Many perished under its frenzied gaze brimming with warp energy, although their sacrifice saved the lives of countless righteous servants of the Omnissiah. At last, the data-loom was defeated.{/n}

47e4acb7-26d3-446f-ae4f-d5ba6f66e32c.Text: {n}The Lord Captain's secret artisans connected to Null Caliph's processing units and introduced pernicious doubt into its calculations. They waited for the great mechanism to hesitate for the first time in its existence, then began their merciless assault.{/n}

c9c60400-7647-4253-abac-76f5c8503962.Text: {n}A group of trained psykers attacked Null Caliph without warning. They assailed its powerful mind with their gifts of the warp, all repeating the same command: "Submit!"{/n}

c5418f12-1aba-4d22-b8d5-d400bf1d0b1a.Text: {n}The Tech-Priests solemnly began the ritual of binding Null Caliph in the chains of data-vows, joining it to the planet's cogitational network, all the while extracting priceless technological mysteries from its memory.{/n}

d86aabd2-13db-4d62-a75d-818903558e27.Text: {n}The blessed boards were carefully detached from the processing unit, forever ending Null Caliph's contemplations. These ancient cogitation modules will now serve the machine spirit of the Lord Captain's ship.{/n}

ed0d7cfe-bdf3-41db-9fa2-b794ec45a035.Text: "The catalogue contains no data to support this hypothesis. It does, however, contain the designation Null Caliph. The Null Caliph Initiative is a project of the fabled Archmagos Opticon-107, whose function was the initial exploration of the Koronus Expanse. All information on this project was removed from the catalogue as per the Fleet conclave's decree following Permissibility Hearing 16. By that same decree, Archmagos Opticon-107 was stripped of his title as the conclave's Prolocutor-Supremus."

abd5c5c1-774a-4aea-b13a-e900cdb216e8.Text: "The data-angels that we encountered earlier were born of its cogitational might. Full of vigour, they soar around its computational aura, which radiates into the Noosphere. Their response to our presence has been favourable thus far."

ff6954ea-6a17-49f1-8996-8b05c24c5d81.Text: "The data-angels that we encountered earlier were born of its cogitative might. They reacted aggressively to our intrusion into Null Caliph's brilliant Noosphere, but we already know how to deal with them."

e73cad29-f053-4d52-802f-2651483e7d9f.Text: "The great calculator seems indifferent to mortals. It has expressed a lack of desire to interact with us or destroy us."

6f44f36b-dd21-4388-907f-1a69db8ca3b6.Text: "All we have is a hypothesis, according to which Null Caliph can... see into the warp, similar to a Navigator. Any interaction between technology and the warp is, as you are well aware, kept under the careful supervision of the Adeptus Mechanicus, so you can imagine just how unique this mechanism is."

2e43d3c6-0dc6-4314-8913-c3c21343025f.Text: "The Tech-Priests reached out to Null Caliph once more using certain excerpts from the dictates of Procedure 0-C, and the machine's reaction was benign. It showed no hostility."

70ff4ef7-9cad-46ba-b564-a6b5e4865471.Text: "We have studied the Noospheric remains of the Tech-Priests who dared to reach out to Null Caliph. Their minds contained excerpts from the dictates of Procedure 0-C. These traces were brimming with anger."

ef32072d-1268-4975-b0f4-dc1274cfdfcd.Text: {n}For the first time in its existence, Null Caliph suffered pain, and it was unprepared for such an assault. After a fierce struggle, it ultimately yielded. The Eye of the Divine now served the Rogue Trader.{/n}

c14c93d4-d14b-484b-bcc3-f16dff789bbb.Text: {n}Even the power of a binharic demigod was not enough to oppose the Rogue Trader. But before its resistance was broken, the Eye of the Divine turned its gaze to the planet's manufactorums, and horrific warp manifestations claimed the lives of thousands, even disfiguring the manufactorums themselves.{/n}

c08fda23-dff1-4358-9972-de679eb68f24.Text: "Null Caliph is immersed in sacred astrogational calculation and has shown no inclination to make contact. The Tech-Priests that connected to it were punished for the intrusion with a lethal ejection of their Motive Force. The only thing they managed to find out is that the spirit of the data-loom is not bound with the vows of compliance that would normally restrain a machine spirit of such power. This... astoundingly mighty entity bows to no one, driven only by its own aims."

acf62afa-f887-4f23-b72b-60c358e0c860.Text: {n}The battle was brutal, but Null Caliph's unrelenting enemies did not fear death and continued assaulting the binharic monstrosity with all their might until finally it grew silent.{/n}

cb8822b9-6c78-4e6e-a345-0e2f3a1aefe7.Text: "A sacred computational mechanism of great power. Its body is vast, and the wisdom and mettle of its machine spirit would befit an Imperial Titan. Machines of such might and splendour are kept carefully hidden from the eyes of the laity and worshipped on certain planets as great logis-oracles, sacred angels of the Omnissiah, or demigods. Null Caliph's structure includes remarkable pieces of archeotech, parts of it extending far throughout Kiava Gamma like a void kraken's tentacles. We now know where the warp transmitter modified by Cubis Delphim came from — it must have been part of this mechanism."

a2c3dbad-816b-44c6-84b0-92f8d8e2517e.Text: {n}Magos Pasqal Haneumann imparted his secrets to the Omnissiah's servants on Kiava Gamma, allowing them to assemble a mediator device that softened Null Caliph's voice. The Magi then prayed to the mighty machine spirit, humbly asking it to make an alliance with the Rogue Trader and share its mysteries.{/n}

0224e896-a2e2-451a-8cf3-837a8d22d20e.Text: {n}Many Magi lost their lives trying to make contact with the great machine spirit before it noticed how frail their bodies and minds were before its might. Taking pity upon the servants of the Omnissiah, it softened its data-voice. The Tech-Priests then entreated the great spirit to forge an alliance with the Rogue Trader.{/n}

4609c6cb-38be-4f80-ab49-9b5fef2cd9de.Text: {n}The Omnissiah's warriors suffered great losses from the warp energies unleashed by Null Caliph's wrath, and yet, in their decisive assault, the data-loom was brought down.{/n}

589d11de-bdbb-4355-9202-8b734e25d9da.Text: "Currently, its calculations, operating at full capacity, are approaching completion. We assume the perfect execution of Procedure 0-C contributed to this."

cb4c07b8-cff9-4719-949f-bc2c58a2daa8.Text: "What are those symbols being scratched out by the convicts?"

61b7c993-961e-4860-840a-45e9464ec846.Text: "Have the guards monitor where the workers disappear to."

cd37f94a-ee90-4be5-87bc-3709644646d1.Text: "The servants of the Omnissiah are hereby allowed to examine any convicts that demonstrate odd behaviour."

b07549dd-770f-4a5a-be56-9b72f22f3d35.Text: "Abelard is right. Have the convicts' leaders stop this mess, or else they are going to regret it."

78c3876e-82d5-4bc7-ae38-250fe8fb770c.Text: "Jae, have your savvy associates investigate exactly where my servants have wandered off to."

ef8d648c-e465-4083-8674-7308af0eb16b.Text: "We should investigate this anomaly. We may be dealing with something sinister here."

1050bdda-f3ff-4b2a-aaab-7f3a568900e8.Text: "Have the guards knock this love for cheap theatrics out of the inmates' heads."

41b36b5a-78f6-4fa1-a9c4-047e34d0f09a.Text: "We do as Solomorne said: we apply pressure to the senior ranks of the colony — they are clearly involved in what's going on."

aca35332-37b3-4598-a49a-b6628ddb3a66.Text: "Some are possessed with the urge to use their nails to scratch blasphemous symbols on tools, machines, and even their own bodies. The most mad have painted the walls of several mines from floor to ceiling with the symbols and then gone off deep into the mining tunnels. None of them could be found. The overseers consider it a ploy to divert attention away from the escapes and an impending rebellion."

f072ba14-11c1-477d-b06e-10a1413de364.Text: "Disappearing prisoners? What is the point of running away from penal servitude if the entire world is a prison cell? No, shereen, these ashmags have found some sort of smuggling tunnel network and are hiding there. And the drawings are their secret language, which they use to give orders to their fellow prisoners. I know some guys who can find such secret places and decipher these languages."

4506831a-d6db-4802-a028-8030f0b949a6.Text: "If the convicts continue to disappear for no reason, then unrest will soon follow — whether out of fear or hope for the possibility of escape. To stifle this, we must put pressure on the convicts' leaders — my experience suggests that such people can hold more sway than any overseer."

8a762ec0-22d9-4c10-afcb-5f88041f5422.Text: "I am detecting an intriguing pattern in the drawing of the symbols left by the prisoners. Hypothesis: they have a practical purpose. Requesting clearance for the Adeptus Mechanicus to access the mines and investigate the specimens."

853ae743-070f-4849-a76f-565b0a5d18d5.Text: "I will immediately pass your orders on to Vheabos VI, Lord Captain."

19eb6d39-3b5e-419f-a232-d8c030b1f6a0.Text: "For a generous fee, my people could find even the smallest stone tossed to the bottom of the sea, shereen."

f49356a1-ec00-46b2-b46b-c3e41be044da.Text: {n}Although many overseers had to be removed from their posts to conduct the surveillance operation, it did eventually lead the investigators to a series of recently cleared tunnels.{/n}

b5fb3bbc-9e3c-4ae2-b0da-db04702ff22a.Text: {n}The wise servants of the Omnissiah interrogated the strange prisoners. The examination of their brain tissue did not reveal any mutations. Those labourers who had completely lost their utility were granted servitorisation in order to maintain production levels. However, one discovery was made after all.{/n}

248cae2e-865f-41db-9ec0-5e1b7848f562.Text: {n}Worn down by sophisticated interrogations, the leaders ordered the rest of the convicts to exterminate anyone who showed signs of insanity. The purges wiped out many workers, but the disappearances and strange phenomena have stopped.{/n}

b3e9784e-c0ed-4672-a26d-33e89580c020.Text: {n}A squad of daring smugglers slipped into the mines and discovered long-collapsed tunnels that had been cleared very recently.{/n}

73c90655-fc7e-4bb6-9914-7f1066697a07.Text: {n}The overseers interpreted the Lord Captain's orders in their own way — they simply beat every prisoner they deemed strange to death. Nevertheless, the disappearances and suspicious behaviour have stopped.{/n}

40fbe637-abed-4144-8a4c-e1d27077cdc7.Text: {n}An unnaturally even wall covered in strange symbols caught their attention. The tunnel went down deep and was not on any of the mining maps. The colony administration gave orders to conduct an archive survey, banned work in the sector, and had guards posted there until the origins of the tunnel could be established.{/n}

52ba20ac-9099-4c11-93be-74a089a25c5d.Text: {n}The prisoners' drawings were too... systematic. They could not be mere gibberish — the sets of repeating dashes and dots were far too similar. But if it was indeed a secret code, then, judging by its complexity and the impossibility of decoding it, this language was definitely not invented by a convict.{/n}

c14428b5-e1e6-46f5-92ee-1d5d47e68859.Text: "A fish rots from the head, and a prison begins to collapse because of its overseers. It is suspicious that no one has managed to get to the bottom of the problem: lean on the senior staff to get the information we need — someone in the prison must be exploiting the situation for their own ends."

8a15c3b1-4027-4f4d-9016-59a9681b91ee.Text: "We will restore order and expose the corrupt authorities at a single stroke."

78ebd70f-436e-48a3-bcac-88c349fb9e5e.Text: {n}Interrogations revealed that a senior overseer had been obstructing the investigation and helping the fugitives to escape. He had hoped that the crisis in the colony would be a pretext for the ignominious dismissal of the colony's current head, against whom the traitor had nursed a personal grudge. Before his execution, the heretic gave up the coordinates of the recently cleared tunnels, from which he had cleverly diverted the enforcers' investigative efforts.{/n}

8a523488-2124-4a96-961d-01f227a095fd.Text: "Lord Captain, a disturbing report has come from the quarries of Vheabos VI. The convicts have lost their minds: they forget how to use tools, they huddle together and continue to stare aimlessly into space, even under the lashes of the whips, ruining the mining deadlines."

f76ce831-8e67-4e6a-84cc-bd507e7cce19.Text: {n}Sadly, the spirit of educated enquiry was in limited supply among the overseers — most of the strange prisoners were simply beaten to death during their interrogations. But one of the overseers, who possessed a gift for the artistic, did notice something unusual.{/n}

f1bd290e-10dc-4fcb-ac34-88b8d18e8229.Text: "It is hard to give these drawings any sort of intelligible definition. Unnaturally round circles connected by lines. The lines are interrupted by groups of dots. Some patterns follow a certain common logic while others are unique. I can provide Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} with picts of them."

2aea35a4-2625-43b3-8a36-dcc7b5771505.Text: {n}After examining the pict, you realise that the symbols are connected through a strange logical sequence.{/n}

4845c3c1-fc92-41b6-bac7-4b4b0091bb88.Text: {n}The pict shows a completely absurd and miserable pattern made out of dashes and dots, illustrating the primitiveness of a peasant's brain.{/n}

a450f791-25a6-4d52-80e8-59dae5faefe2.Text: "There is no sacrifice more worthy than one made in the name of the Quest for Knowledge."

1d934d4b-7045-49e2-aa73-e405cb023c09.Text: "Those who have been exiled to a penal world for atonement and yet continue to sow disorder deserve no pity."

868ab773-faff-4f10-bace-da98bb608aaf.Text: "Let a spinner of the Bloodspun Web examine the bodies and give answers."

dc730f87-a5d0-448e-9572-20b1597e294e.Text: "Exterminate all the scoundrels who dare to rebel against me!"

5835832e-4f52-4efb-82b5-97340892dd43.Text: "Shall I hope for House Orsellio's aid in sharing their knowledge of brain excision and how it should be applied to serfs?"

10363ee8-364f-4ff3-856e-ff5d82502dac.Text: "The convicts have revolted against the unbearable actions of their guards. Order them to stop torturing the prisoners beyond reason."

a708d585-02ce-4b6f-9872-06e491357470.Text: "Idira, have them find a psyker strong enough to determine the truth about the killer from the victims' remains."

4aa4db35-8e99-4b1e-b331-c8c659199793.Text: "Punish the whole prison administration and send them to the mines, then select new administrators from the prison population."

db982feb-b030-44c5-9f49-3c022d460081.Text: "Conduct a thorough investigation. We must understand the prisoners' cause of death and track down the culprits."

84c97aa7-102a-455f-8236-595be1ffc7de.Text: "So who did kill the people found in the mines?"

cd842399-48f6-426f-a6f6-488d87b5517b.Text: "Lord Captain, the mines of Vheabos VI are once again in turmoil. At the depths of level MD Zeta/05, the overseers have discovered a mountain of mutilated bodies, seemingly crushed by the millstones of the mining machines. All the dead are convicts. The overseers believe that there is a cult of heretics operating in the ranks of prisoners, offering human sacrifices. The prisoners themselves claim that this atrocity was committed on the order of the warden to rid his prison of the more 'inconvenient' inmates. The warden tried to reason with the raging mob but was mauled to death instead."

7ae59319-5251-4318-8d7a-9ff05a33239b.Text: "His defiled remains were found inside one of the cells where prisoners were being tortured during the investigation of the 'strange' convicts."

70779e6e-7708-428e-b852-976807e80da7.Text: "To serve Vheabos VI and the von Valancius dynasty!"

19d5a9ed-04f4-4f00-bd56-9ea750e51e51.Text: {n}Several thousand of the prisoners who actively partook in the riot and the warden's murder were smoked out with gas, seized, and executed in the fires of the foundry press in front of the rest.{/n}

537ccc95-ce55-48d1-b037-bfb3c0faf241.Text: "We shall share this wisdom with the von Valancius dynasty."

bb8de7e2-8720-49df-983b-fda61bbdb9e3.Text: {n}The convicts who had their brains excised lost any urge to cause violence and provoke others. Now they find quiet pleasure in monotonous work and lack of communication with other people. The overseers note that the experiment has been highly successful.{/n}

adb34b99-2d20-4692-bf98-5ec1153a65a5.Text: {n}After learning of the Rogue Trader's intercession on their behalf, the convicts wept and prayed for {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship}. The overseers generously abstained from vengeance, only hanging the ones who provoked the riot, to which even the convicts themselves had no objection — it was only right, after all.{/n}

6e5ebc8b-27f4-458a-9f62-cf4ca6fc3508.Text: {n}The rules of the mining facilities were relaxed to a degree: the overseers were strictly instructed not to use their shock batons during preventive beatings — only their fists and feet — and the cruel practice of decimation was replaced with humane deprivation of rations as punishment for not fulfilling the quota. The convicts rejoiced.{/n}

0fb80057-8a6f-4985-8259-60a51a83363b.Text: {n}Upon carefully inspecting the dead bodies of the convicts, the overseers concluded that they had not been killed by a human — no known weapon could have inflicted such wounds. The bodies were demonstrated to the convicts, and the riot died down as the realisation sank in that some unknown force was behind the murders.{/n}

cf1e7b39-0b74-4210-b2b8-095c6e9990a0.Text: "A mob of commoners mauled a noble soul who was attempting to reason with them... How awful. Perhaps the underground madness has spread among them and assumed a new form, turning them into monsters in the process? It would be cruel to kill them if this is the case. It is much more humane and well-intentioned to excise their brains in order to curb their ferocity and penchant for disobedience. My House did the same whenever the serfs rebelled in their ignorance — a rather merciful step."

d4a036d8-029e-4b4a-8693-50c7696adf57.Text: "I don't care about the overseers, the convicts, or their problems — what bothers me is the dead bodies. Who left them — that is the important question. If the bodies haven't been destroyed yet, then we could conduct a certain kind of... divination. The ritual is less than appetising, but a psyker with a strong stomach could learn more about their deaths."

f9aeded7-17f0-45a2-9056-0ffdcabbf295.Text: "Shereen, if the governor and a pack of overseers cannot handle their duties, should they not take the place of their wards? And could there not be worthy administrators among those who oppose them, those who could do better?"

5a17661e-51b0-4330-a76a-c6e67bfd806b.Text: "That remains to be established. The riot has... complicated the investigation. Perhaps it was the work of the warden after all, or perhaps there is a cell of the Cult of the Final Dawn operating among the prisoners. But the few picts of the corpses that the overseers managed to take contain an oddity: if one were to use their imagination, they could see a certain... pattern in the scattered bodies. One that is vaguely similar to the one these 'inconvenient' prisoners had been drawing."

26134119-f577-4443-a646-912940264c5b.Text: {n}The former overseers were sent to the mines, not all of them surviving even a single cycle in the company of their former wards. The most respected convicts among those who ended up on Vheabos VI for venial misdeeds such as family debts formed a new, more efficient administration.{/n}

759c4af5-3dcb-45b0-8944-a1c809f1596b.Text: "I would also like to note that level MD Zeta/05 is part of the same tunnel system as the mysterious unmapped tunnel we discovered earlier."

2281007a-0711-461a-9f5e-1c5eaa02107b.Text: {n}The investigation did not yield anything to help identify the party behind the murders that had sparked the riot. Level MD Zeta/05 has been sealed.{/n}

efc73e2d-01ee-4800-8894-57d355bea7a2.Text: "The traces of death are like an open book to a disciple of the Web. A skilled spinner can go to the mines and reveal what brought death to the convicts."

584fc3ca-79dd-40b4-82bf-a949cefb05b5.Text: "May the secrets of death be revealed to the servant of the Undying One."

2f434365-af89-40d5-bc14-3dc97f4dc285.Text: {n}The cultist spent days without sleep or sustenance, studying every wound on the mutilated corpses. At last, the Undying One bestowed a revelation on him: the spinner sensed the victims' dying throes and proclaimed that a dark entity had claimed the souls of the convicts. Crippled by his visions, the man lost his mind and kept rambling, spouting gloomy prophecies of the terrible adversary. But his duty was done, and the rebellion abated as fear of the unknown rallied the inhabitants of the colony.{/n}

321ce0ce-e2e5-40fd-ae17-1e13624836c7.Text: "The overseers have managed to isolate the rebels inside the mining facilities, but an assault would result in high losses of workforce. On the other hand, the prisoners are ready to lay down their weapons, cease this violence, and repent if the Rogue Trader would only demonstrate some compassion toward their plight, possibly by reforming some of the more severe punishments."

6c57238a-16f4-4a3d-8fce-ef490ba975fc.Text: "I'm pretty relieved that I won't have to take part in this dirty business myself."

b6c47f28-3c37-44b1-987d-ad8031b5146f.Text: "I will also arrange for investigators from Dargonus to search the convicted officials' private quarters."

56ef787e-85f9-4943-b152-355e65f2ee64.Text: {n}The psyker found among the prisoners was not sanctioned, but he was gifted enough to perform the ritual according to the instructions sent by Idira. While digging through the intestines of the dead bodies and mumbling to himself, he beheld the dark figure that had committed this vile deed. The vision stripped away his mind, leaving him an incontinent loon. Although he was unable to describe it clearly, it was still obvious that the figure was not human. The riot has subsided.{/n}

8cb05d61-9830-474d-91cf-c786867b76b0.Text: "Let us drive the enemy back into the darkness, as Solomorne has proposed."

50f5fb28-59e6-46a7-b5ed-b0cc229fc957.Text: "Arm the convicts and the overseers and have them fight the invaders."

cdced295-c1cd-4a43-af8c-5b8d36d11684.Text: "Choose convicts ready to atone for their misdeeds through the honour of martyrdom. Give them explosives and send them to blow up the tunnels. We will seal our enemies underground."

70fd4a7f-c449-4e3b-90ec-1b399812759b.Text: "Blow up the tunnels to prevent any more casualties."

c5818c3a-fb8f-47d9-8076-4a9508c17d91.Text: "Lord Captain, the Astropathic Choir has caught glimpses of horrifying visions coming from Vheabos VI. Something has breached the colony — from underground. Soon after a new sector of deep tunnels had been put into operation, it was overrun by monsters. They lurk in the darkness, swarm in the shadows, attack quietly, and leave nothing in their wake, consuming flesh, plasteel, and rockcrete. The chirring of a thousand claws heralds their approach, and desperate cries can be heard in the silence of the tunnels. Praise be to the Golden Throne, these creatures do not seem to be interested in getting to the surface. However, they have seized several active mines and are doing Emperor only knows what to them."

6cdf3b1d-4cf9-4207-a436-7687ff029c51.Text: "We have to block off this threat and protect the people. To do this, we must blow up the tunnels, but... to make sure that the plan works, it has to be done in areas currently occupied by this unknown enemy. I am sure that a dozen brave souls can be found in the colony, ones willing to accept the grace of martyrdom and carry the explosives into the darkness below."

813741e5-11df-4579-946a-c9373ee49222.Text: "The threat is unknown. Establishing the nature of the threat is the top priority. Collateral losses are insignificant. Requesting authorisation to coordinate an offensive operation to be carried out by penal battalions in order to determine the nature of the attack."

cd8f4427-5f5c-44da-9828-f7fbf858e888.Text: "Heed my words, for I ask of you to kindle the flames of faith in your chest, against which no corruption can stand."

2083c67f-8103-4765-8306-a2ebcc453b69.Text: "Let them rot in the darkness under the weight of the world's soil!"

eb2900dd-b59e-40c3-95dd-fb3467cd5d81.Text: "May our tactical analysis be graced by optimality."

bfc9daba-145c-4c2c-93a4-0609bfc04995.Text: {n}Squad after squad was sent into the depths. The convicts and the overseers, putting their past conflicts behind them, rallied against the unknown enemy, realising that few of them would return... if any.{/n}

2266ac3b-7a54-4fb2-a33d-59d4801f1c79.Text: {n}Making the sign of the Aquila, those chosen to carry out His will descended into the darkness without a single complaint or groan.{/n}

cf31c390-34cf-4447-bc29-18e5a4ebe5e8.Text: {n}Remotely controlled trolleys loaded with explosives were sent into the dangerous tunnels. Many lamented that the cave-ins from the explosions would not cover enough ground, and that the enemy would be able to find their way back to the colony yet again.{/n}

7a1136a2-5874-4516-83a3-a8b335f1fabf.Text: {n}The plan of Magos Haneumann was constructed with ruthless logical perfection, weighing efficiency against human losses. The smaller units were sacrificed without hesitation in order to preserve the larger forces.{/n}

47c6f6bd-e115-4989-ae33-a189a48acd8d.Text: {n}The Vheabos VI defence squads met the swarm in the darkness: monstrous insects clad in metal carapaces and tearing everything apart with their mandibles. The carnage inside the narrow caves cost many lives, but in the end, the creatures were exterminated, and their vile lair, not unlike a metallic crypt, was ransacked and claimed as trophies.{/n}

364fb2d2-dea2-435e-8a1b-ac59bc7672ab.Text: "We drive those monstrosities back underground, and use heavy drilling machines to simulate an offensive from multiple directions. Then, we block the majority of the passages, leaving only the best-defended ones open. Let's see how those miscreants enjoy being trapped."

f8f0c6e9-bd00-4789-98ee-47d375f654d0.Text: "We may lack the forces to exterminate the invaders, but we have quite enough to drive them back and win ourselves some time for the battles to come."

334debc4-d109-440a-8fde-ea219a17513a.Text: {n}The new extraction sector shook as drilling machinery tore into the rock. From the depths of the mining drifts came the sound of screeching and scraping.{/n}

3ee837b6-606f-429b-bcba-e1cfce07e799.Text: {n}A hideous swarm of metal-reinforced insects charged into the defenders of Vheabos VI, but the tactic worked. The enemy was vanquished, and what remained of the swarm disappeared into the planet's bowels. One could only hope and pray that enough time had been won to prepare for their next invasion.{/n}

39e6c64d-70a2-4127-80e5-46b3a3635b36.Text: "Few who have faced them have survived to tell the tale, so the information is scarce and hardly reliable — their accounts, if you will, are a jumble of facts mixed with wild speculation. The frightened workers call these monsters a swarm because they crawl along the tunnel like a wave. They say that the enemies are vast in number and resemble insects. One of the fortunate survivors, mad from the horror, emerged from the mines holding a wrench engraved with strange markings. The pattern was exactly the same as the one the mad convicts had been etching into the walls."

1f47ec57-bf6b-4572-bdba-3303fd26d155.Text: {n}A series of tremors shook the mines, and the monstrous roars of crumbling earth filled the empty tunnels. Clouds of toxic smoke erupted from the depths of the mines. The blockage of stone and dirt has separated people from the terrible invaders... whoever they were.{/n}

e216fd3b-7a8f-4c84-a990-80607cb564cb.Text: "The overseers have already admitted to... somewhat bending the restrictions on digging in the vicinity of the unknown tunnels we recently discovered. New mining drifts have been placed dangerously close."

6d4190b3-d2f1-4acd-b7c9-bf40cbb6ba0f.Text: "What is the current situation on the surface?"

5b0bbed3-314a-4620-9b6a-ed979b59e006.Text: "Ulfar, show my people how to instil fear in their enemies."

2887ea31-0a55-4c5b-9c9f-7aa9a3c3e8da.Text: "Stop the riot immediately — casualties are of no concern."

9df32f98-37f9-4312-adec-40d52bd74f1c.Text: "Tell the overseers that I expect only one result — success."

d4991bdd-8663-41be-9762-933f387f97b6.Text: "Let the rebels know that if they do not stop the riot, I will bomb them into submission. We will give them something to truly fear."

a5ad55b7-77d9-473e-9aae-3d87ee652556.Text: "Address the convicts' leaders. Have them repay my benevolence."

e7821992-2e23-4cbb-8b5d-88f0addb1bad.Text: "Why did the cultists head to that particular area?"

2e6f9b20-6c63-4ba3-90ae-835b6dced7b8.Text: "Promise a pardon for those prisoners who would help to quell the rebellion."

5f5875a3-ff54-4f50-97ee-bbd737ca0c60.Text: "Kibellah, summon the spinners. Let us break the enemy's resolve."

9a1f2c21-e425-4bae-a40c-b9c2d0b53095.Text: "Seize control of all communication channels. We are following Solomorne's plan."

2bc0dbd1-066f-4d26-a9f3-23c189f97fbf.Text: "Corruption has infiltrated Vheabos VI, Lord Captain! The cultists of the Final Dawn have agitated the convicts into a full-blown uprising, promising them a chance at escape. The planet's cargo port and guard facilities are now under siege!"

2481f761-e0a3-42a1-b3e8-8c99ffff1574.Text: "The overseers are reporting tremors — it seems that the heretics are trying to clear the cave-ins that we used to ward off the subterranean monsters."

548619ca-a875-4e55-9188-8872e8aac3d2.Text: "The security post that we set up in those mining drifts reported a skirmish and then went silent."

2b1147da-cdfd-4ec0-aad3-877997ac19d3.Text: "The overseers are trapped inside the guard facilities, and the convicts are now united by their common hatred for the dynasty and are obsessed with the tales of freedom."

1e775bc7-cf05-4a8f-be50-7b434a04deea.Text: {n}As the mercenary shuttles arrived at the cargo port, the docks lit up with crimson flashes of lasgun fire. Eager to prove themselves and earn a permanent contract with the Rogue Trader, these dogs of war were well motivated to put up a fierce fight. Under the onslaught of such skilled foes, the convicts quickly surrendered.{/n}

b2cb3c67-238a-4345-bd24-ba1f43a0ca0a.Text: "Ha! I shall teach them some secrets of this art!"

ce75b9d3-1e20-4255-b499-33d9eacd7e1d.Text: "They will hear your words, Lord Captain."

ec44b34e-2e26-4378-b0e9-376f070a3d50.Text: "Those who were tempted by heresy shall perish."

73d2d890-fe75-4a9e-9c7b-ae6a8a66526a.Text: "I am sure that these well-armed dogs of war will make quick work of the rabble."

df9356de-9f4f-4448-9e40-23edc74ade5b.Text: "Heretics seek out those who are weak of spirit and entice them with promises of salvation. But such spineless lot lacks the resolve to fight and will drop their weapons should someone give them reason to fear. The purpose of many tactics in warfare is to sow terror in the enemy ranks, and I know some of these tactics well. Make them quiver, Aett-Vater, and those weaklings will forget all about their heinous intentions."

cc651660-a7cb-41bd-b4d2-81c66c38610c.Text: "May the misguided be brought back to their senses before it is too late."

bf996388-8a1b-40bc-8340-88f7563d421c.Text: "Lord Captain, your resources and status allow you to make use of one of the most blunt and affordable tools of all — mercenaries. These dogs of war will storm the warp itself for the right price. Provide the overseers with some hired backup, and you can consider the crisis resolved."

1e9c26bd-92df-4e34-97c3-69102ecf897b.Text: "Unfortunately, we do not know the heretics' true objectives... but there is nary a doubt that they are pursuing a sinister and wicked goal, and therefore must be stopped!"

63a12d3a-4fca-4a4b-9d92-624ecb877d4f.Text: {n}After receiving orders from the Lord Captain {mf|himself|herself}, the overseers charged — perhaps out of fear, perhaps owing to some newfound courage — and, despite suffering heavy losses, managed to break the ranks of the insurgents. The people had once already ripped their homeworld from the claws of the enemies of Humanity, and soon the cultists would feel their unsated wrath crash down upon them.{/n}

115f56bb-552d-4fab-983a-8278abd5fba3.Text: {n}The leaders of the conspiracy, the cultists of the Final Dawn, were confronted in the mines. They had surrounded a strange dark xeno-obelisk covered with glyphs, trying to awaken it from its slumber. The glyph patterns were similar to those that the mad convicts had drawn before. The monstrous construction contained enough energy to tear the planet apart. By heroically disrupting the cultists' plan, the guards caused a malfunction within the terrible machine: instead of exploding, the obelisk emitted a blistering heatwave, melting itself and turning those around it to ash. Vheabos VI had been saved.{/n}

1733e0b0-8d65-49b7-8888-56d62d151a1d.Text: {n}The few words passed on to the leaders of the convicts had an incredible effect. On an invisible signal, the convicts turned against the cultists — first the instigators, and then the rebels. The overseers, finally able to break out of the cordon, watched in astonishment as their "wards" compliantly surrendered their weapons after emerging victorious.{/n}

e8b0d895-782c-4b68-834b-366ab5de37a3.Text: {n}The colony's security systems awakened, its powerful air blowers pumping toxic gas out of the bowels of the planet and into the ventilation systems of the mining facilities. The rebellion was quashed in mere minutes — thousands of convicts and overseers had suffocated.{/n}

ac7d297d-5917-485c-9de8-b0ede121bbd3.Text: {n}Following the advice given by the formidable Space Wolf, the overseers carried out a series of reprisals and acts of intimidation. Leaving behind mutilated corpses and infiltrating the rebel camp under the cover of darkness, they crushed the rebels' morale and forced them to surrender their weapons.{/n}

653b59ca-a76c-4418-94c9-16383c2555cb.Text: {n}After hearing the stern words of the Rogue Trader, most of the convicts lowered their weapons and surrendered in horror. The overseers finished off the most rebellious and relentless.{/n}

9289fa3c-bb09-4cbb-8cc9-1660956b0cfa.Text: {n}Grasping at the chance to leave the accursed mines, some of the convicts turned on the rebels and joined the overseers' side. Each of them dreamt of freedom or even the great fortune of serving aboard the Rogue Trader's ship.{/n}

0b58b184-d638-4985-a373-fcd349737c2f.Text: "It is enough to kill a few to make the many lose their footing. Let the spinners bring death to the prominent instigators, and the rest will be intimidated. They will open themselves to an attack."

fca320cd-ca8f-48fc-9f39-f6e1dbb8de43.Text: "The spinners come, for death has whispered the names of the wicked."

d6bf4747-f179-430b-b26b-c680d5ea0144.Text: {n}The servants of the Bloodspun Web launched a series of lightning-fast and silent attacks, stacking the corpses as grim messages. Frightened by the elusive and shadowy assassins, the heretics abandoned their lairs and fled into distant tunnels. The rebellion was decapitated.{/n}

8e21bc32-2315-4e42-8ab6-660d8a6f8de1.Text: "We lay our own siege to the planet, then seize its vox-frequencies and broadcast the plain truth: that the convicts are fighting for a barely habitable rock, and that without Imperium authorities in charge, they will die. We will drive the message home with quotations from the Lex Imperialis, declaring that any resistance only aggravates the transgression."

62fd5b13-e620-41f5-b2f8-f3d4cc8c9a18.Text: "The criminal rabble's morale is low. They will surrender soon."

0c2d9b98-3336-40aa-b722-cf12ddf149c9.Text: {n}Never pausing for a minute, planet-wide broadcasts described in vivid detail how Vheabos VI would prove to be a death trap for the rebels. That disheartened many of them, and they soon turned their weapons against the Rogue Trader's enemies in the hope of receiving a lighter punishment.{/n}

afa9ec08-82be-4b4a-9fce-507968db83a6.Text: "Incidentally, during my time as a jailer, I successfully petitioned for air filter reserves to be slashed, making the world more dependent on outside supplies. Thus, every breath the rebels take edges them closer to death — literally."

522eaebc-758a-4791-8d61-d40211b85b3a.Text: "The cultists themselves have not joined the assault. They have scurried into the mines, deep into the tunnels that were infected with xenos corruption not too long ago."

e7fe90da-1f65-4597-ad6e-daf4fdb7bdf5.Text: "The overseers are trapped inside the guard facilities, but there are many among the convicts who are loyal to Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. They remember your charitable mercy and may yet switch sides."

6fc06f59-8653-4083-bf9b-d6eeebee0053.Text: "The overseers were caught unawares, but, fortunately, they have already gathered their forces and taken up solid defensive positions. Those who serve on Vheabos VI are loyal and merciless, ready to face any number of foes in your name. I am confident victory will be theirs."

f384b61c-e681-4793-9b3b-5d23e9305dba.Text: "Ulfar's advice is sound. We will leave bait for our enemy."

9a8871d8-f213-43d3-a7c3-5bcbb7a203fd.Text: "Marazhai is right. Set a series of traps and provoke it to attack."

c123de39-8a6c-4022-9040-bd1381215f81.Text: "Send out scouts. We need to find its lair."

bfce0a0a-91cd-4173-9d8f-af2b4225a1bd.Text: "Yrliet makes a good point. Find some effective disguise against our foe and wait for it to strike."

47127db3-b159-41bf-8fb1-6424e2c78105.Text: "Place all mining complexes on high alert. Stay vigilant, and sooner or later, we will spot it."

a84a9ed8-1b48-44e0-8330-23082c6af2a8.Text: "No one can see it, but snares do not need eyes. Leave some gifts out for our unwanted guest."

77c97082-c1b7-4802-890c-4f0826c825f6.Text: "Lord Captain, Vheabos VI begs for help! Something terrible prowls the planet, searching for a way to wipe out the planet's inhabitants. Victims died in small groups at first, so they dismissed it as simple accidents — a poisoning, a crashed transport, a fire. But the death toll has started to rise, and explaining everything as mere coincidence is no longer an option. The enemy appears to be testing out different methods of killing your subjects, like it's looking for the most efficient way to murder as many of them at once as possible. Our pict-traps sometimes catch sight of a blurry dark shadow walking among the people, but no one has actually seen it with their own eyes."
