03eff0d8-076b-4766-b2bd-5147e6366568.Text: "A glorious hunt to the cunning hunters!"

cca12398-de11-4ba5-b4b9-a1a96be7f3ca.Text: "I believe in you. Being irritating comes naturally to mon-keigh."

e1c4384c-9ae0-4e8d-a4db-c5856548522a.Text: "The art of hunting relies on the art of hiding. You cannot see your target... then make it so the target cannot see you. Deceive its senses and seize your advantage."

8ed4168d-6294-4d00-a359-d60c4e677b6d.Text: "A predator walks among your people? Well, then it's time we became predators ourselves! Your servants can't see it and don't know where its lair lies, but I will tell you how to find it: you need to spark the beast's curiosity. Leave something it craves out in the open and mark it so that you can track the beast as it's carrying the bait away in its jaws. That is how we hunt cunning prey on Fenris."

73a06047-dd04-4ddc-8482-f61d0f8b18f5.Text: "Ha! You call it your enemy, but you are mere pests in its eyes. This isn't war, this is extermination. You are a nuisance, and that is your asset. Understand what it is you do that vexes it so much, and you will understand how to drive it mad. All that will be left then is to lay a trap."

370f2792-8c60-477e-b906-13fcc8e6f136.Text: {n}The wardens were better suited for punishing convicts than lookout duty. At last, an alert came in: one of the inner gates that had previously been sealed was being opened. The guards who arrived on the scene saw a dark figure and opened fire. Wounded, the creature fled.{/n}

5148c134-b471-4347-bb3a-0b0830ba6b99.Text: {n}To attract the enemy's attention, a "lethal incident" was staged: a radiation leak caused by an open transuranium container. Shortly after, a handful of this hazardous material went missing, and the wise Tech-Priests used the radioactive trail to locate the monster's lair.{/n}

927c6675-c31b-4632-96c5-04884be68345.Text: {n}Before fortune could smile on the hunters, one of the mining complexes was wiped out after its water filters had been "accidentally" contaminated by chemicals.{/n}

44012de9-9e66-46a2-993f-969abb1b4e0f.Text: {n}The colony's wardens experimented with several means of disguise but did eventually succeed in hiding themselves from the eyes of their mysterious foe.{/n}

74d7cd83-6d36-42fe-9012-fa19c6cf22cc.Text: {n}Alas, setting traps was not one of the wardens' talents, and for the longest time, the enemy managed to avoid them. Eventually, however, an explosion signalled that the beast had been caught. The wounded creature was then discovered and driven off.{/n}

65d17149-1b70-4932-bde7-fea2d28e7ff8.Text: {n}Alas, it took some time for the colony's wardens to come up with an effective camouflage that could hide them from this mysterious foe.{/n}

07c93326-a05e-4206-be12-8efdafcda3b8.Text: {n}The warden whose unfortunate lot it was to keep watch inside of an air purifier spotted a strange shadow right between the working mechanisms and the lead cover. The enemy had grown careless and finally revealed itself. The brave warden raised the alarm, wounded the creature, and fell in battle, but his comrades managed to chase the beast away.{/n}

7acf344b-aa66-4b10-bcd1-e4e27b4e3dbb.Text: {n}A series of tempting lures marked with radiation was left for the mysterious enemy to find, but the wardens' efforts were hardly inconspicuous, and for a while, they could not fool the beast.{/n}

11c52cb0-e8e5-468c-b0ff-42134f8e83cd.Text: "May the Emperor grant us victory over this foe!"

02f12e71-574a-4a86-b718-cda629054456.Text: {n}The vigilant wardens were up to the Rogue Trader's task: having placed the colony on high alert, they waited for the moment when the enemy would reveal itself.{/n}

847d58b1-97cf-450c-baae-26de9c912716.Text: {n}Fortune soon smiled upon the diligent hunters when they discovered promising-looking tunnels beneath the surface.{/n}

b97feba9-2797-466a-8ada-046f442e83fa.Text: {n}Assuming that the creature had been angered by the mining efforts, the overseers increased work shifts in remote sectors. The assumption proved to be correct: the beast came to destroy those who had disturbed its rest and walked right into the traps laid out for it. Wounded, it fled.{/n}

66a78336-0d13-47f7-9459-d3c21b079749.Text: {n}Soon enough, the mysterious shadow walked into one of the devious traps and, wounded by the powerful explosion, ran for its life.{/n}

ac92c296-635a-4dc2-8a7a-343381eb6563.Text: {n}Cornered in its den, the monster fought its final battle and was slain. It was a terrifying xenos with a metallic skeletal body and a single emerald eye. Its lair turned out to be a crypt-like chamber, and beneath it was an entire fortress buried in stone. The walls were covered in glyphs similar to the mysterious patterns that the mad convicts had been drawing.{/n}

4a0185e3-f737-4f38-9071-5c23a0a6726c.Text: {n}The chamber also contained the dissected remains of the missing miners. The Omnissiah's servants studied the bodies, the crypt, and the xenos's corpse, hypothesising that the inhuman belonged to a caste of sages among its kind. It had remained in stasis for ages untold but had recently been awakened either by the mining efforts or the explosions caused by the Drukhari invaders. After killing everyone who had approached its lair, the creature tried to wake its brethren, but millennia of tectonic shifts had crushed the underground fortress. The creature was alone.{/n}

ed51e0e5-4c08-45fe-a65d-3945e2fe105e.Text: {n}The hunters searched everywhere, but, given their lack of experience, their efforts remained unsuccessful for a long time. However, eventually, they discovered the enemy's lair.{/n}

e0aed45e-151f-4ec1-98e2-fd2f6c6d8a02.Text: {n}Regrettably, the wardens were not particularly skilled in deception or provocation. However, they did eventually lure the enemy out with large-scale underground blasting operations. The creature came to the mining site, walked into the traps, and retreated upon having suffered a painful injury.{/n}

8521e1a0-77f3-43c5-be48-c7a0597c2a09.Text: {n}The fearsome insects, the ones that assailed the colony, were the only tool the xenos had left, so it chose to lie in wait. But when the heretics of the Final Dawn sabotaged the fortress's reactor in their attempts to destroy the planet, the xenos grew restless and started searching for a way to exterminate the humans. Now the last xenos survivor was dead, and so was its entire race — or at least, so prayed every denizen of Vheabos VI.{/n}

69091e03-d328-4ca6-9833-9a035de6e3cf.Text: "Various sorts of mechanical failures. Ventilation systems emitting substances that have no business being there. Auspexes registering spikes of radiation. Maintenance systems shutting down for no apparent reason. It all resembles extermination experiments, with your servants playing the role of test subject."

468f03e3-da6d-4d00-be4b-f50244b43bb5.Text: This creature throws a fire charge at target creature, creating a 3×3 {g|Encyclopedia:BurningEffect}burning{/g} area which lasts for 2 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rounds{/g}. Any creature which enters that area (or stands there at the moment when the effect is applied) suffers <u>(from 10 to 12)</u> {g|Encyclopedia:FireDamage}fire damage{/g} with 50% {g|Encyclopedia:ArmourPenetration}armour penetration{/g} and burning (6).

137a36ad-529a-436d-bc20-b75e26113fe7.Text: Whenever an enemy {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hits{/g} the captain with a {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee{/g} weapon, the captain spends 1 stack of fire barrier causing an explosion that {g|Encyclopedia:PushGlossary}pushes{/g} adjacent enemies 1 cell away and deals <u>(from 12 to 18)</u> {g|Encyclopedia:FireDamage}fire damage{/g} completely ignoring {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g}.

843432dc-f43c-4b99-b426-b36d81fc80cd.Text: At the start of combat, the captain gains +<u>(2 × psy rating)</u> fire barrier stacks and becomes immune to {g|Encyclopedia:BurningEffect}burning{/g}.

e12a570e-0d0d-4fcd-8adb-a7585f19861c.Text: Unleashes a torrent of 4 flaming projectiles, each dealing <u>(from 8 to 16)</u> {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} and inflicting {g|Encyclopedia:BurningEffect}burning{/g} (6). The projectiles have a 60% chance to fly along the central line, and a 40% chance to deviate to one of the lateral lines.

b41ce1fa-98e4-45e6-955b-1e15aa9cfebb.Text: This creature blows up a dead ally's body, replacing it with a minion of {g|Encyclopedia:DecayEffect}decay{/g} depending on that ally's type. If the target ally is a guard, a Poxwalker Guard appears in their place. If the target ally is an officer, a Plaguebearer appears in their place.

688abc46-41ec-4af8-bef9-439911e180d7.Text: Whenever an enemy moves into a 1-cell radius around the bodyguard, he immediately makes a single regular attack against that enemy reducing their {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} to 0. This attack can interrupt the enemy's movement.

7c20323d-7233-4181-ae24-bd69d61c954d.Text: Each stack increases {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}Weapon Skill{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerBallisticSkill}Ballistic Skill{/g} by +5 and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerPerception}Perception{/g} by +10.

931da37c-777e-41c8-8247-bdad75000214.Text: Whenever an allied {g|Encyclopedia:CareerLeaderGlossary}officer{/g} dies, this creature gains +1 stack of {g|f:3e487d5d02384da5a8be7f93364af88c}Thirst for Revenge{/g} (+3 stacks if Captain Sargona dies). Stacks up to 5 times.

a5577e4c-4241-450e-94eb-be3e9282d0e7.Text: The Chaos Space Marine will attack the target marked as hated by Aurora.

c75fc95c-a3e4-4a93-bf08-da472bcb5153.Text: The Chaos Space Marine wants to blow up the shuttle!

5465ebc4-637e-4604-a1e7-5c0b5f836101.Text: When being attacked, this creature will unleash their hatred against the last attacker.

63bb2dda-17aa-4ed8-9167-6078323212e2.Text: When this creature attacks the target suffering the hated by Aurora effect, this creature's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerStrength}strength{/g} is increased by +50% for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.

52db2ec8-fd2c-4edf-8dde-f485990ff5bb.Text:
Kicks an enemy, dealing <u>({g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}TGH{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} + {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerStrength}STR{/g} bonus)</u> {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}.
This attack cannot be parried and {g|Encyclopedia:PushGlossary}pushes{/g} the target 3 cells away. The target must pass a Toughness {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a −20 {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} or fall {g|Encyclopedia:ProneEffect}prone{/g}.

7e2d1152-2893-4ea3-b704-802470eff883.Text: Ignites a Space Wolf's blood and increases their {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}.

56d20675-901f-482e-8e36-7082ce1ebd4c.Text: This creature is enforced by their Primarch power. They deal +100% {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}.

31b18f5e-03b0-4866-b050-743b93345412.Text: This creature's next attack scores a critical {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g}.

a99d3c95-34c9-4a97-9d5e-0e61f66f8f0b.Text: This creature syphons power and vitality from an ally, healing itself and applying a shield that negates incoming {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} from the next 3 attacks.

a31e16ca-5b4e-4371-a4af-be83c52bb135.Text: Deals 100% bonus {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} with 100% {g|Encyclopedia:ArmourPenetration}armour penetration{/g} to targets with the {g|Encyclopedia:BurningEffect}burning{/g} effect. Successful attacks also inflict liquid flames.

fc21481b-907d-4cf0-b2d6-82ee3a461526.Text: Suffers additional {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} while there are no allies nearby.

ecf25c54-ed0a-428d-8dae-a246716a27f7.Text: Incoming {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} from {g|Encyclopedia:RangeAreaAttacksGlossary}ranged attacks{/g} is increased by +<u>(5 + 3 × {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}WS{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g})</u>% until the end of combat. Does not stack.

9f379e33-1dc1-416e-9c82-c0495c17c008.Text: On a successful {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g}, this character applies the confounded {g|Encyclopedia:NegativeEffectTypesGlossary}negative effect{/g} on their target for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}. The targeted enemy cannot use {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g}.

173a4afa-0a48-49ff-811d-5c9c18b1f856.Text:
When Uralon's ally has less than 50% {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}, Uralon sacrifices 20% of his own wounds to grant this ally +<u>(maximum ally's wounds / 2)</u> {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g}.
! Can only be used once per target.

2bd5b96e-a9cb-4d47-9ca3-1b05e0a4092c.Text: Cannot be the target of the {g|f:3aceacf1ab554c61b4b876271b5e76ba}Dark Pact{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g}.

e0af5b74-df1c-45b8-9512-204761a46652.Text:
Uralon gives an ally an extra {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} with {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} equal to <u>(2 × Uralon's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerFellowship}FEL{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g})</u>.
This turn, that ally's attacks limit equals to <u>(Uralon's FEL bonus / 4)</u>.

603a99de-4aeb-47ad-b8fc-f891fd94d971.Text: Uralon gains +9 {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g} for each allied Chaos Space Marine in combat.

10bf7a24-3302-45ac-bf6f-7fdb390e08e2.Text: With our unholy weapons we will cull the unbelievers and let the Word of Truth into the world!

ad165e42-99a8-401f-ab34-b96909fd08f8.Text: All Chaos Space Marines gain an extra {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}.

8662a4db-e2ba-4002-b864-8ba19000b0de.Text: This creature restores {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} equal to the {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} dealt by its {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee attack{/g}.

caa80149-1204-49d6-abd4-85e2e137a0cb.Text: Each time this creature suffers {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}, its own damage increases by +1 for 2 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rounds{/g}. Stacks.

fa6f82ab-3262-4367-ba70-174b637397b9.Text: The Ghostwolf dashes through an enemy, ending movement in the cell on the enemy's opposite side. They then make a {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee attack{/g} which inflicts the {g|Encyclopedia:MeltingEffect}melting{/g} effect for 2 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rounds{/g}.

668c060c-e0dc-48b2-b23b-fdaed767573a.Text: The Ghostwolf emits a bestial howl, commanding allies to change weapons to axes.

225f98f7-d93f-489e-900c-0bc7aa0986c5.Text: Whenever the wielder's attack with this weapon scores a {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit{/g}, its base damage is increased by +{uip|Damage|9f76314d15a24116bf349701ecc396cc} until the end of combat.

45f8cafa-97ab-47f3-8c3b-0fef913b64a1.Text: An attack with this weapon deals +{uip|Damage|0f41b613afe24784af011bb8bd400cfc}% more damage to targets at full {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g}.

71409849-7f62-4696-86db-5bbdf600776f.Text: The target must pass an {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} or become {g|Encyclopedia:SlowedEffect}slowed{/g} until the end of combat. Attacks with this weapon always score a {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit{/g} against slowed targets.

a15a2dde-aee5-49c9-a92c-9090d342ef14.Text: A {g|Encyclopedia:DeadeyeShot}deadeye shot{/g} from this weapon inflicts the {g|f:67ea9e6b76b347359ab2cbc7a3be143c}prey{/g} effect on the target.

bf9a3cf2-ace8-430c-a143-0629f55e3b3a.Text: Whenever the wielder's attack with this weapon {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hits{/g}, all their allies adjacent to the target make an {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attack of opportunity{/g} against it.

86974de7-7900-45b4-ac97-18904908d0f7.Text: When enemies {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} with this weapon suffer damage from {g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}bleeding{/g}, they deal half of that damage to adjacent creatures.

4d0d7e7d-9669-4091-b263-68bde402c160.Text: The target suffers this weapon's {g|Encyclopedia:ToxinEffect}toxin{/g} effect and +3 levels of toxin for each other type of damage-over-time effect it is currently suffering.

2ab5eb74-cc38-47ad-9285-2bcacf6882e0.Text: After the wielder deals any {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} to the target with this sword, until the end of combat they gain +3 {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerPerception}Perception{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerIntelligence}Intelligence{/g}, and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g}, and the target suffers a −3 {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} to those {g|Encyclopedia:Characteristic}characteristics{/g}.

657ab832-5c17-479d-81c6-79bc83b859cd.Text: Enemies that suffer from the {g|Encyclopedia:ToxinEffect}toxin{/g} effect cannot {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} or {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g} attacks performed with this weapon.

35c808de-2be7-417d-930c-fef5b181ddc6.Text: The target must pass a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} or suffer a random common {g|Encyclopedia:NegativeEffectTypesGlossary}negative effect{/g} for 2 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rounds{/g}.

20dfaa2a-e091-4349-8668-86a7b25c676a.Text:
Targets hit by this weapon must pass an Agility resistance test or become {g|Encyclopedia:ImmobilisedEffect}immobilised{/g} for 1 round.
At the end of its turn, the affected target must pass an Agility resistance test to remove the effect or suffer direct damage equal to <u>target's AGI bonus</u>.

d310b61f-7ff9-4f67-afe5-cca478f9df72.Text: Flame weapons have 2 special area attacks with different areas of effect.

694f2b9a-ff8e-4e5f-b944-6f7a3d166a81.Text: Laser weapons are effective against targets in {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}cover{/g} and targets with high {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g}.

8499b4de-15af-4995-939b-d8b1ba6aa430.Text: "Mentor... our last duel was your final lesson. The wounds you left are your parting gift. I will treasure them, until the Undying Emperor summons me."

6bafb100-f47c-42b5-8ddf-eb168b69fc9c.Text: "The old man went out knee-deep in blood and trying to kill the person dearest to him. I thought only deranged psykers died this way, but here we are."

5709de0f-4b63-41d5-891f-5ace7591df34.Text: "It is this sentimentality that will forever keep you from rising above your own primitive nature. If it must be so, then... you can live out the rest of your days as prey."

6add1c69-3dd5-4f6d-8096-12f79b80739c.Text: "Why are you smiling so suspiciously? Your colours... they dance so whimsically when I am near."

6ba189fb-8689-485c-8123-fbec69dfb5ef.Text: "I was just wondering what this soaring, stirring feeling was — first love! Ah, I can feel the butterflies in my belly, the heat in my cheeks..."

93a2471b-d01f-4837-b624-63468b5bb2f0.Text: "No offence, Cass, but it's all your Navigator business. I woke up in a foul mood this morning, but the Lord Captain took one look at you and I suddenly had a smile stretching from ear to ear."

54fc23ea-b8ec-4a9a-9baa-9cccdcfd0c41.Text: "Curtsies, eloquent glances, even an immortalium... It has been a long time since I saw anyone observe the aristocratic rules of courtship. And so devotedly at that."

e025279a-8779-4e99-9d96-eea208eeb2fb.Text: "Will you be putting that in your reports too, van Calox? You are without shame or conscience. If you dare upset Lady Cassia, by the stars, I will make sure you regret it."

b751483b-053e-452a-976b-d3af31b437ab.Text: "The rituals that the elantach and the Sha'eil seer are performing... they contain none of the savagery for which mon-keigh are known. I am almost enjoying watching their senses blossom."

39582ba9-70b8-4925-8049-76425631fd0f.Text: "Looks like the Lord Captain and Cass have been on the outs lately."

9e1a9462-5c90-4e85-8300-c945cba436b8.Text: "Hard times can forge tender feelings into something stronger. Sometimes it takes a good fight to reach true understanding."

c4e513b4-e5fd-4e6d-81d7-4361a6946fe0.Text: "I wonder if Cass and the Lord Captain are comfortable with... well... with all the Navigator quirks? The sharp claws, the delicate gills..."

6a6c9fef-f0a1-4d56-838a-b28d98c6c49f.Text: "Heydari, stop. You can wonder about it if you like, but spare the rest of us and keep your thoughts to yourself."

6efbd85e-7bcc-447b-a626-8692907cbb68.Text: "The union of two political units has been recorded. Anomaly detected: the predicted harmony is absent. I am registering disquiet."

9d8126e5-ed83-458b-8647-29a8da6e2132.Text: "Come now, esteemed Magos, the union of House Orsellio and the von Valancius dynasty is a grand occasion. Any who share their 'concerns' are merely envious — true friends give their support."

4560a9d8-76b4-4860-a5a1-3d6daee2bfc6.Text: "Stay out of it, you soulless tin can! People's fates can't be reduced to your stupid calculations."

3cb60983-8b1e-41a4-9001-abd152f2b739.Text: "So, ahem, the marriage of Lady Cassia and the Lord Captain... A worthy union between the heads of two great dynasties."

d6aa807d-195b-4d21-b3a0-7f5e28d72aba.Text: "You feign concern for duty and the elantach's domain, but I know the truth. You are worried and saddened by a union that lacks any genuine feelings."

fe3bfc02-c440-461e-a4c7-7fb869858fd4.Text: "At least this marriage is not based on hatred, contempt, and intrigue — an unheard-of luxury for most aristocratic alliances."

a1716008-a69f-4f67-bef3-22123220ee43.Text: "I see all your colours flashing... Ask me. You have never stayed silent before, either out of politeness or pity."

0c92570f-a0f1-45b2-b4a7-289729178fb0.Text: "Cass, you're... you're not being fair to me. Funnily enough, after all the time we've spent together, I've grown fond of you. And... well... I'm sorry, Cass. I really am."

edd7d7ae-8bb6-4c83-ada1-659d6e94299a.Text: "Your feelings for the elantach are hindering you from guiding the ship through Sha'eil. Pull yourself together, three-eyed one! Your weakness could cost us our lives... and even more than that."

adf69043-1cbe-47cf-92c4-3970cb20ca8c.Text: "I cannot put my finger on it, but I seem to be on the receiving end of more attention recently."

a92cf53b-31d1-4b6b-9826-3549cd5b992a.Text: "Tell you what, van Calox, let this sink in: if you mess the Lord Captain around, you will not answer to the Inquisition — you will answer to me."

62f0b30b-7322-4373-a8d4-39d93884947e.Text: "My little whisperers have told me all about you, iceman... but you're not frozen anymore, are you? You're starting to melt a little bit. Did somebody leave the door to the cold-storage open? Ha!"

ecdc774c-e238-412b-972d-4ac9ca24d423.Text: "The colours of the Lord Captain and Master van Calox change when they are next to each other."

0952451f-e581-419f-8210-0a9bc61fb150.Text: "Cassia... I do not need a third eye to see what is right in front of me. You need to learn to rely on your normal eyes as well."

e226793a-bffa-48fa-a96e-4309164d7361.Text: "You know, van Calox... you and I have not always seen eye to eye, but if there must be someone standing at the Lord Captain's side, you were far from the worst candidate..."

9451297e-ac10-4477-8c92-1a2b41b451af.Text: "First Officer Werserian. The very thought of ordering a man of your years and service to shut up is anathema to me. So let's not reach the point where I am forced to do so."

324e6049-c6a1-49c9-a260-5f3fc7d54dc5.Text: "I now know what the expression 'beautiful couple' means. I am sorry that this exquisite picture was not destined to be realised on the canvas of reality."

87c8be08-6e1d-4f87-a63f-434011df6f51.Text: "Thank you for your kindness, Lady Navigator. Perhaps... it is for the best for everyone involved."

d5388c4c-eec1-40d4-85af-b69345161eb0.Text: "Heinrix, my voices near you are whispering dark and monstrous things. This has never happened before, never... What is going on with you?"

ed4c5000-7753-4892-87df-25a8f32fc3a2.Text: "I'm... fine. A little... tired. Our recent trials would have worn anyone out. Listen less to the warp's exhortations and focus on the task at hand."

bb618054-e6e0-490f-8722-84139bb434ce.Text: "Stop looking at the Rogue Trader like that, Heinrix. Nothing will happen to her while we are here."

456c41ec-570a-418b-8412-cb189d586ee2.Text: "I know! I know. There's no need to tell me... and besides, Sister, you would do better to keep an eye on your surroundings instead of me."

dafedf9a-afa0-4e83-8d29-90a2c4130865.Text: "Abelard. Just get on with it — say whatever you are going to say. It will certainly be preferable to your silent and palpable condemnation."

3a81e36b-5b76-4d3e-9654-5e4bbc7d5b61.Text: "I am torn between two desires — to lecture you about your shoddy timing and choice of setting, or to express my astonishment at the Inquisition's methods of moral support."

91f02e98-f4e7-49b0-b2b3-0cbd9db258dd.Text: "Jae... is being quite open about her connection to the Lord Captain. Unusual behaviour for a princess. It seems the nobles on Efreet have very different ideas of propriety."

a356c9f6-4b6a-4666-9614-5de6255178a8.Text: "Quite open? She'll be leaving picts of their bedroom antics in our quarters soon enough."

bfdee320-44ba-4d5b-b3ec-e4f5e0427f06.Text: "Jae likes to flaunt her trophies and wealth — the Lord Captain is both to her."

9c7c484c-3d09-4492-8e0e-dc4b8724851f.Text: "I do not like the Lord Captain's interest in Mistress Heydari. She is useful, but letting her get so close is imprudent."

44fdc451-23c2-4a77-a45c-e03b51a80604.Text: "{name} might be risking the contents of {mf|his|her} pockets and {mf|his|her} heart with Jae, but not {mf|his|her} safety. Jae's a hustler, not a villain, so the voices say. And I like her."

6e98646c-00c0-4601-b7f9-d75309d3834e.Text: "Listening to you now, First Officer Werserian, I wonder if you guarded Lady Theodora's bed as vigilantly as you do the current Lord Captain's."

2d32f20e-52ce-4faa-a110-0fd36a316e99.Text: "Mmm, what an interesting bouquet. This is because of the Rogue Trader, isn't it? I cannot discern which it is... strangled ambition or simple jealousy? Would you like me to help unburden you?"

58f1b566-504c-420b-9e0a-302c70de4900.Text: "After seeing how the Wyches of the arena used you, I'm afraid I don't have the stomach for it."

7dcfd779-bf07-4285-99ca-1923cea0c8a1.Text: "You spout a lot of dangerous groxshit, you gangly creep, but you definitely should have kept your mouth shut this time. You'll be lucky if you don't end up strangled."

968e8d7c-dc11-47fd-a8b1-688f5dc05ff9.Text: "Your colours have become darker and gloomier. Why is there so much sorrow in you?"

56cd8601-e681-4f1f-ad11-861e5d3118b3.Text: "What do you mean, dear? Jae Heydari knows no sorrow! Her heart is like the fickle wind that is unburdened by the dust of the earth and rushes ever onward!"

42d23d19-6993-44a9-b0ff-364e205611e5.Text: "Hypothesis: the cause of the unit's emotional suffering lies in the disrupted romantic-communicative bond between—"

18f71129-48c5-4076-83ec-74a2c572ee13.Text: "Shut up, cogs for brains! Or I'll strangle you with your own tentacle!"

e67ebc53-ddd0-4ab6-be10-1596ddb1b1f5.Text: "I admit that I am somewhat disconcerted that the Lord Captain has continued {mf|his|her} affair with Jae after the truth about her background came to light. It was a poor enough match before, but now..."

df71568a-22f8-4e1d-be66-b29f45d5504b.Text: "My kind are free of mon-keigh prejudice, but... is it possible to feel passion for someone who is dishonest with you?"

d85f40f0-992c-4836-b33e-e56b709243e6.Text: "That is what I am wondering. Perhaps she does things in bed that mean {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship} would forgive her any transgression. But who am I to say...?"

6154fdbd-7e62-4c60-a2e5-bfa0f2f60b34.Text: "Sister Argenta, tell me: how do you call the heart to humility when it is overcome with... jealousy and doubt?"

985e4611-ecd1-4d45-bc1a-c6bd49de184d.Text: "Fill your soul with pure love for the God-Emperor, and all doubts of the heart will at once be hollow."

643149b0-8c19-482d-b668-64ce5c2756b9.Text: "Stay away from the Lord Captain, xenos. And do not even think about pulling any stunts. One wrong move, and..."

7beb16fe-2f68-41f2-bb2e-1f425bf9dff7.Text: "Oh, mon-keigh, why reveal your fear and insecurity in such a crude manner? Does the Rogue Trader grant me greater liberties — is that why you are so anxious to drive me away? That is your failing, not mine."

0cb16a4f-ab13-46f3-abe6-6d6797b667d5.Text: "Cass, I've heard whispers that you've been crying into your pillow at night. I don't believe them, of course, but you have been really down lately."

5d3e8ce5-a7c5-4ea1-8911-2afc1e7adb9f.Text: "Not at all! It's just that I... I always wanted to be someone's one and only, but life has taught me that we do not always get what we want."

03eb93b1-37d7-4232-b90b-f4afbd39fdfd.Text: "Heinrix, I never thought I would say this, but... you and I have something in common, wouldn't you agree? What do you say to discussing our shared passions? Swapping stories?"

1227c4fd-b40b-429a-9637-83dd53791925.Text: "Ahem. At least have the decency not to make such shameless suggestions in the presence of our... 'shared passion.'"

c247659d-40dd-43a0-9673-ef4d44b64215.Text: "I never thought such... monstrous iniquity would take place on the von Valancius flagship. I am sick of reprimanding officers for improper chatter about what the Lord Captain and the xenos are up to on the lower decks..."

aed8458a-3dab-477d-9b79-f9e99da0c842.Text: "Don't grumble, old man. Personally, I'm just glad the Lord Captain's quarters have such heavy and tight-fitting doors. The screams... aren't as blood-curdling when they're muffled by a thick layer of plasteel."

f2c8f5a6-c0b7-4cb9-b728-d4a66107ac1b.Text: "It is not the wicked tongues you should fear, but what the elantach will become if {mf|he|she} does not turn aside from {mf|his|her} chosen Path. The ways of the Dark Ones eat away at the soul... and reveal secrets better left unacknowledged."

1405e007-c52c-4a9b-8d7c-05292e294b47.Text: "The decks of the ship were enveloped in alarming yellow and terrified green whenever Marazhai walked among the crew... but now the same colours flood my gaze when the Lord Captain appears on the bridge. I am... frightened by this change."

86d441e6-5b94-43a8-83bb-ad52688d373d.Text: "The cattle are quickly learning their place. Good."

48a832a0-dc0b-4ff0-a709-884db77807ba.Text: "Did I tell you, Lord Captain? The crew noticed that you have stopped your... ah... visits to the lower decks, and begged me to convey their deepest gratitude for your mercy."

cf4fb072-79f1-4388-a965-66526c4cef9f.Text: "If the cattle are bored, I can visit them on my own. I will do so at the first opportunity."

59f19b18-bdaa-4c0f-8388-44aa3dd4b7ed.Text: "What could be the cause of it, I wonder? I cannot wrap my mind around it. Has our shereen the Lord Captain stopped walking {mf|his|her} pet xenos? What a sad — and long-awaited — split."

90de6d05-d3ad-4a6a-8fc5-db6ec359f497.Text: "What do you want with the elantach, Dark One? Why do you devour {mf|him|her} with your eyes as if you were plotting evil?"

9f935954-c71d-4c74-bcd6-e026b409df44.Text: "Mmm. You, cousin, no longer hold any interest for me as a plaything. But I must dispel my boredom somehow... and I seem to have found a thrilling new way to do so."

1dd61621-bad2-40ff-97d3-930a833f33f1.Text: "Oooh, Red, if my little whisperers are to be believed, 'evil' doesn't come close to describing what's on that stick insect's mind..."

4747d3a3-cb46-40a6-a990-ca87521d7085.Text: "How could the Rogue Trader allow you into {mf|his|her} retinue? What failure of will led {mf|him|her} to find a place at {mf|his|her} side for an abomination like you?"

a8ac2cd6-44eb-4752-8cf4-545a445ef557.Text: "Do you really want to know the answer? Curiosity. Curiosity which I will satisfy... in the most complete and pleasurable way possible."

a628b189-baaf-4f92-964f-1660b2d4a158.Text: "The xenos has a habit of distracting the Lord Captain at every opportunity. Her conversations are taking up precious time."

4c473136-c01b-46d5-a2cf-ed640d389de6.Text: "The Rogue Trader is showing the xenos too much indulgence. She should be kept on a short leash, not treated like an honoured guest."

1b3b198e-cee3-4d89-95e4-8b54f0cdd953.Text: "That xenos has a name — Yrliet. And yes, the voices are giggling. They say there's something going on between them, something brewing... Eugh. Not. My. Business."

a1b1f1b3-6deb-4fbd-9280-e16a0a4f5a17.Text: "Are you trying to gain the Rogue Trader's trust? To beguile {mf|him|her}? It won't happen. I'm watching you."

0335b39f-a139-473b-92b1-c23de19095f8.Text: "What are those primitive thoughts roiling in your head, mon-keigh? You are living proof of how simple your species is, but the elantach seems to be different..."

8473553d-9a08-4c5b-80c8-aa4d55f0fa6c.Text: "I can feel your eyes boring into me, mon-keigh. Enough. Your foul powers mar the soul like the arrows of Kurnous."

bb2afa34-3362-4af6-a836-bf750b947ca0.Text: "Oh, I am... sorry. Your colours have suddenly faded, and now it almost hurts me to look at them. It is... because of the Lord Captain, isn't it? Hmm. Silence is also an answer."

815cd0b1-978f-446d-bf8f-8b107674ce77.Text: "I keep listening, just trying to understand... Now that the Lord Captain has rejected you, are you going to start freaking out and acting weird again?"

48c2b327-9b3c-45fa-9c4e-673ad7db7ad6.Text: "If you had committed to your 're-education' in Commorragh, you could be savouring your pain and loneliness like a fine delicacy right now. Ah. We all regret missed opportunities, don't we?"

50e68405-85d2-463f-abef-15fcad68cedd.Text: "There is only one missed opportunity that I regret — the opportunity to rid the world of you back when we first met."

e99d8000-679a-4ef9-ab14-7dd59a83ad5b.Text: "Yrliet may have saved the Lord Captain by sacrificing her spirit stone, but she was the one who caused the danger in the first place. Again."

2e8323f9-3c48-40dd-af47-daa3c8a34ee4.Text: "If the Lord Captain hadn't made off in a mad dash to interrupt the xenos ritual, we wouldn't have had to save anyone. Yeah... Those two deserve each other."

641022af-6435-442b-a5bd-25e52a7fff84.Text: "Isn't it beautiful? For the sake of the Rogue Trader, Yrliet has forfeited her most precious possession. How much pain that choice has caused? How much fear?"

1a221afd-9fa2-40c8-8148-5ca439667d6b.Text: "The Rogue Trader has grown so close to the xenos that {mf|he|she} has delved into her very soul, comprehended her feelings... Ungodly, unforgivable heresy!"

615b17a1-3d6f-4504-895c-4d95ed06ac03.Text: "Objection: the Lord Captain's behaviour differs from the standard expression of feelings. Hypotheses: (a) the xenos is lying; (b) the Lord Captain is lying; or (c) there is an unknown variable. Further observations are required to establish the true nature of this phenomenon."

c5681cfc-3c87-4f8d-8fe3-9c863e6e6273.Text: "I see a silvery-blue glow around the Lord Captain and Yrliet. These colours are... unlike anything I've ever seen. It is as if their feelings exist on some unknowable level."

1f9dba77-9725-4834-b289-193224f22a34.Text: "Everyone knows: your presence is poisoning the mind and soul of the Rogue Trader. One wrong move, and I will end your miserable life without question!"

a72229bd-47b0-4755-8ae5-cebe0d59cbf2.Text: "There it is — the mon-keigh pride. You think the elantach would wallow in darkness without you to guide {mf|him|her}. But {mf|his|her} soul shines so brightly that it will dispel any gloom, and so I do not fear your words."

b2bfe816-c14f-457a-9f65-3ceae06f2c2a.Text: Into the bowels of the monastery

ef34f3fc-5d4a-4ebd-b1f9-006897b40e29.Text: "I do not know the words of that hymn, and so I will ask you to enlighten me."

b6946a26-8217-4844-81c8-810820154b64.Text: "I may not be a member of your priesthood, but you and I are of the same faith!"

a68fdc41-64ee-4ba5-9d20-33badee1c068.Text: [Disconnect one of the wires from the body]

412f20f6-8da8-40f3-ad3e-786f790a5a50.Text: "Another attempt on my person and I will cut you into pieces!"

6c62bcd0-526a-42d4-a6d2-23b62252cd4f.Text: "Let us praise the twin charges, the body electric, and the Omnissiah who lights the spark of reason within us. And let us carry His charge to those who have turned their minds toward His light."

9fc9c8d2-9f8a-4aa7-9c51-0f792720b093.Text: [Improvise] "Glory to the Holy Martyr Galvanica, and may a great... em... abundance of current persist in her induction coils! May electrons flow through thee as they flow through... errr... sacred copper!"

fa9cd8a9-d2d5-4373-b3aa-6ecb2db77dba.Text: "Tell me what your datadream is like."

2969b128-b523-4d29-9473-4a7c10aeb570.Text: [Destroy the body] "The cultists might get to him. That is undesirable."

4113bee9-2d53-4438-9e94-b29144e147e8.Text: "Stick to ordering your monks about, corpse. I will not be chanting anything for you."

450039a3-5820-4541-9fba-d0e1138778a7.Text: "Would you prefer to wait until they get their dirty hands inside your sacred reactor? Do you have any idea what they will do to it?"

b5ca919f-8023-4fc9-a017-0e557cf26a70.Text: "The monastery is under attack by heretics. Can you help?"

d02dd870-c96e-4496-bfa7-6e35489bb581.Text: "Different though His names may be that we use to crown our prayers, all our thoughts and intents still stem from the one pillar of all that is holy and sacred. I was once one of the Adeptus Ministorum. I serve the God-Emperor, whom you call the Omnissiah, and thus we are of the same flock."

d49a628f-cc52-4091-9ad3-7bb11d33f9c0.Text: [Bow] "Apologies for disturbing you, but I am in need of your wisdom."

213a26fc-bea6-45b1-a5ba-c5431e2c6793.Text: "Pasqal, apologise to the esteemed Tech-Priest on my behalf."

1e797ecb-3ba0-4b23-98b9-00d642a15955.Text: {n}A {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priest{/g}'s body rests on a metal table, surrounded by sparking spirals of copper coil. A patina of sacred unguents covers his withered flesh. His {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}augmetics{/g} have been polished with great care. Intricate electoos cover the dead man's crossed arms and bare torso, and strands of wires envelop his head.{/n}

4e66d6d3-313e-4724-820d-5df1f574cb4d.Text: "The First Article of Faith says, 'The Motive Force is life.' Therefore, so long as it fills me, I am alive."

984a9e4a-042d-4d81-aabc-9a5c7e236322.Text: {n}As soon as you touch the copper-coated wire, searing pain stabs through your fingers and wrist. The world becomes very bright for a second, and then darkness falls.{/n}

c5c3d7c4-271b-4c37-bbc6-e14d050efc0f.Text: {n}A discharge runs through the wires that envelop the Tech-Priest's head, and a forbidding hiss comes from the vox-system on the ceiling. A soft voice, sounding as though it is struggling to overcome its dreamy torpor, addresses you sternly:{/n} "I shall fear no enemy, for the Motive Force is with me, and its discharge will smite any who lift their hands against the righteous."

f26edbe3-375b-4b5a-936c-455f3e0c24d9.Text: "In my datadream, I saw their unholy requests and rejected them angrily, for it is said in the Fourth Article of Security, 'No unbeliever's hand shall intrude upon the operation cycle.' They have seditious designs on the relic — but should I give you, who does not belong to our faith and fellowship, my blessing to stand up to the blasphemers?"

aeed886e-7837-4cb1-92be-e8cbde20f6ce.Text: {n}A rustle comes from the {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g}.{/n} "Drive the unworthy away from the altar, tech-brethren, for it is said in the Sixth Article of Security, 'Let Knowledge be locked away from the ignorant.' The words of my sermon must not reach dark minds."

11196b28-a9e9-4efe-aa4b-e91065e89b89.Text: {n}The body seems motionless, but you notice a slight tremor in the fingertips. This ancient servant of the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g} must be datadreaming. His mind, enveloped in digital reverie, can persist for hundreds or thousands of years while his frail body is decaying. This sacred state of trance is a great reward only earned by the wisest and most pious servants of the Machine God.{/n}

b25b59c5-9795-4bda-90a7-0be9437bf004.Text: {n}As you look closer, you note that small tremors run through the Tech-Priest's body every now and then. There must be a faulty wire in the tangle around the dead man, sending Motive Force shocks through his lifeless shell.{/n}

b287428d-33f8-4283-a4c5-fa75edf3b15d.Text: {n}The light in the crypt becomes a little brighter and sharper, and the smell of ozone fills the air.{/n}

b90f8e89-9497-4148-ad50-8835edeaa8db.Text: {n}Sad binharic trills are heard from Pasqal's vox. His {g|Encyclopedia:Mechadendrite}mechadendrites{/g} bend down to the floor in an apologetic gesture.{/n}

298419a9-fc6a-43f4-a7ba-c08ba0746faa.Text: {n}The vox's voice grows louder:{/n} "Praetor Electroid Dahr-Impulse II, by the will of the Omnissiah, the prior of this monastery and the guardian of the Miraculous Fusion Reactor, now and ever, world without end."

f2f3427f-7057-4581-a8d3-d67311b7a962.Text: {n}Pasqal looks at you indignantly.{/n} "I am registering sacrilege! This devotee of the faith was posing no threat. Terminating his vital functions was unwarranted."

9125a285-359a-49e5-892f-7eafb0ef2437.Text: "This statement is true. The First Article of Security says, 'Fear above all evils the defilement of Knowledge,' and its command outweighs the prohibition contained in the Sixth Article of Security, 'Let Knowledge be locked away from the ignorant.'"

07c73c78-a7b5-4432-89ee-fc6c20bf25e5.Text: {n}Next to the table the body is resting on, you see small amulets crafted from burned cogitator circuit boards. There is no dust on these small offerings. They were clearly left here recently.{/n}

edcdab76-18b0-4f4f-bd71-d163dfb8089c.Text: "Absolution granted. I sense no profanity in you, only a curtain of ignorance drawn over your mind."

3e2ef550-b967-446d-99fc-acc9277b37ae.Text: "I know not what your name is, nor what your faith is. I will not waste my blessing on a misbeliever."

8435e3eb-736b-424c-ac2a-ac37c1b3b28b.Text: "The relic... The mere thought of its desecration is a blasphemy. The mere chance of it is a sacrilege."

a8d03389-d387-4833-a748-880a5b14283a.Text: "So be it. In the name of shaming the unbelievers, I grant you the blessing of special access and protection from the rage of the Motive Force." {n}Dry cracking sounds come from inside the crypt's walls as awakened cogitators process the ancient Tech-Priest's command.{/n}

8bc9407e-2cca-45a6-bf9e-6466edb6dcdc.Text: "Absolution granted, tech-brother. May the charge of the Omnissiah's grace persist in the batteries of the faithful."

bdff0708-f4af-4a68-b281-f855e025e6e4.Text: {n}The obstinate elder's vox hisses and rasps.{/n}

e64d3a35-898c-40f6-9fd1-1ef124500f5a.Text: {n}The Second Galvanic Hymn is a revered and miraculous prayer of the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMechanicus}Adeptus Mechanicus{/g}. Naturally, you know it very well.{/n}

106e80b6-0fa0-4478-94c5-6499931b6713.Text: {n}You vaguely remember hearing about a Saint Galvanica, a martyr if you are not mistaken. She is probably who the hymn is dedicated to.{/n}

b754108d-b918-47c6-8d9a-b3c44bd77d26.Text: {n}The vox on the ceiling comes alive and lets forth a solemn binharic aria that turns into a crackling, somnolent voice:{/n} "In this dark hour, I am ready to bring you good tidings, tech-brethren! Now respond with the words of the Second Galvanic Hymn."

88c0d0b5-04ac-461d-8306-2b1ed19fdcd2.Text: "Here, in this cell of mine, I have conquered death, and my mind has soared toward the Omnissiah in a blessed datadream. My body is decaying, but my spirit will remain by my master's side. For I am the sacred sentinel of the code, the guardian of the sacred relic, and the eye that watches over the Rite of Operation."

6371db62-0178-4ef4-8c66-a88bf7613b4a.Text: "I am one with the Motive Force, and it opens my mind to the sacred impulses of Knowledge. My reason has become as fast as the flying electron and the ray of light, and time is no more for me, for I am eternal. In my binharic reverie, I comprehend the wisdom of the Machine God and share it with the humble priests who come to my cell, thirsting for my Knowledge."

7ec85e89-9e68-4fac-b264-d5e59a6091e1.Text: "My tech-brethren will suffer no sacrilege to be committed. I hear their prayers, and I trust in their fury."

fc6817e3-ce9a-4c2b-9114-b6784b2623e7.Text: "Such... purity of colour. I have never seen anything like it! Deep tranquillity shrouded in a cool-white cloud. Such unity of thought and spirit... The dead are incapable of exuding such hues."

04a0d540-1451-4199-b21f-8a9a812853db.Text: "Denied, for it is said in the Eighth Article of Diligence, 'He who seeks Knowledge, let him receive it in accordance with his rank and admission.' The prayer that is unknown to you was hidden from laypeople for a reason. But you will not be denied my wisdom, for the Omnissiah looks favourably upon those who are drawn to knowledge."

a216a0f4-3b22-426f-bf41-49b0930f581b.Text: {n}Pasqal respectfully bows his head before the dead man and carefully touches the shrivelled body with the tip of his mechadendrite.{/n} "Honoured adherent, I thank you for showing us the truth of Fabricator General Pechrovahr's maxim: death does not end the service of a spirit driven."

85e8871e-454a-47dd-aaf9-4d655cdde6e0.Text: {n}A single blow is more than enough to terminate the residual vital forces in the frail body. The {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g} on the ceiling bursts into an indignant wail that becomes a thin, single-note squeak.{/n}

c12ddd7c-42b7-4d93-9e42-1836dd227897.Text: "So what is this Final Dawn? It is all your followers ever talk about."

910c48a4-9f14-4180-858d-a2c472d37f67.Text: Kept the handguard of the heretical blade for yourself.

f985b69a-955b-4637-ae90-4700e84f08cd.Text: "Silence, heretic. Your crazed preaching will not touch my mind."

dc30ed98-8319-40e8-a2d3-5a1093a96599.Text: "Step away from the sacred reactor and I might allow you to surrender."

121b9949-3b61-4e45-bf2c-a9a57d8d9900.Text: "What a talented enemy! Can you do the governor's voice?"

000a4117-957b-495f-a434-34024828f0a7.Text: "Whose servant are you? Is Uralon a daemon or just another heretic?"

bfca32ab-479f-4202-9ade-895799549db8.Text: "Are you trying to blow up the reactor?"

115339a2-3d81-44fe-bfc2-f01969dd5830.Text: "I think that is enough heretical talk."

bf918bb0-a823-4e16-a07c-5850fb468380.Text: [Inspect the control panel damaged by Aurora]

105f3dd9-4d62-47b1-8130-0c8887ccda91.Text: "Let us finish cleansing the monastery, Pasqal."

8f94b76a-272e-4ee7-9ba4-ff4f8fcb72a0.Text: "The Edge of Daybreak? Is that your unholy patron?"

f5c8763e-cbf3-4738-aef1-88d41adb89a5.Text: Vowed to rid Rykad Minoris of Aurora's tyranny.

a73092e1-eca4-4d3d-bf09-431aff556d24.Text: [Attack] "Enough. I will rid Rykad Minoris of your tyranny."

70c0d8fb-fe91-40a7-80d1-5aa9acfb4a1a.Text: Vowed to kill Aurora in the name of the Emperor.

b3704780-99a1-40f9-bb0e-e27978d4b5eb.Text: [Attack] "In the name of the God-Emperor — die, foul creature!"

d92deb8c-924a-477f-9ef8-b38f1a0f4869.Text: Made Aurora believe she was acting against her master's chosen one.

55ff85ad-6b42-458f-a63c-9536dc027824.Text: "Take a good look at me, Aurora. Predestination has changed. Now I am your master's favourite. Will you dare to go against his will?"

3eef76df-390d-4e12-bd7d-2ec5def76938.Text: "Will you be finished soon, Master van Calox? I cannot stand being made to wait."

aba9c0e1-4ee3-4a50-8be4-e770866ec8a2.Text: "What servitude are you talking about? What predestination?"

9f2fefb1-c5aa-4f17-959f-796a4606784e.Text: Gave the handguard of the heretical blade to Heinrix.

30463295-ebc4-4b29-8eb8-54c89c0f51ed.Text: "Heinrix, take a look over here. Is this by any chance what you are looking for?"

9c48bfbb-c708-431d-85da-ec7730c10f31.Text: Threw the handguard of the heretical blade into the depths of the reactor.

c732b1ff-3ba6-46dd-a150-8e161d3c93fa.Text: [Toss the shard into the depths of the reactor]

7a96948e-677f-4484-8865-a4462c9ed47a.Text: {n}The face of the woman who stands before you is hidden behind a grotesque barred mask. Yet the voice pouring out beneath it belongs to someone else: it is the husky, sombre bass of a void wolf, a boarder of ships.{/n} "How predictable your path is. How static. All the possible deaths you have skirted, only to perish here, in the fiery tempest that will mark the Final Dawn."

296267c8-76e7-4bfc-9d61-fb359792b6ef.Text: {n}You cannot make out her blasphemous words, but the name the heretic keeps repeating — the Edge of Daybreak — digs into your hearing like a blade into defenceless flesh. Its sound is almost physically painful. It spawns strange and impossible phantoms in your mind.{/n}

f5e7a595-f080-432b-b05c-1f79f004c5f3.Text: "I would take some time to wrest from you the details of the 'future' that the cult prophesies. Hopefully, when we're done, what's left of you will still be capable of coherent speech."

011811f6-7c87-4037-8a46-bab9550e7d60.Text: "The motley hues have rejected her, leaving... only a greyish-green thread — the noose that the heretic put around her own neck. I have seen this many times before. No one can escape fear itself."

e6ff5927-0df6-4169-a810-8c666242b859.Text: {n}The corruption that was born within you on the day of Theodora's death answers the call. Aurora's words seem to mesmerise you, conjuring visions in your mind's eye of a flame-engulfed world in which muttering eyeless ghosts wander about, untouched by fire, and the whispers of daemons resonate together to shake the scorched rock below.{/n}

8c740c31-8e3f-4ca9-84b8-2af2223843a7.Text: {n}Heinrix raises his head, gets up, and makes a wry face as he carefully examines Aurora's weapon.{/n} "This unholy object is the work of inhuman hands. And judging by the cold I am sensing, it is a tool of the Archenemy... I am most grateful for your vigilance, {name}."

8284d637-9bb5-4388-912a-5ab5bf2fc2ae.Text: "Do you cling to your blindness so desperately? Do you think it will protect you from the blinding radiance of the truth?"

b55a5a45-1929-45df-8b3f-d3e5dc8262dd.Text: "Surrender? The gall of it. You are chained to the falsehood of a {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}dead god{/g}'s religion. Captives do not take captives."

ae0cd0af-cc16-4f7f-a861-9e2ea9a364c8.Text: {n}Pasqal lets out an intimidating binharic trill and announces grimly,{/n} "With the Omnissiah's blessing, the Rogue Trader von Valancius has come before the Miraculous Fusion Reactor, seeking to perform purification and eradicate the corruption. All unauthorised persons are hereby ordered to lay down their arms and humbly accept their punishment."

21926c1a-132d-4110-a646-fdb6e2885f87.Text: "I cannot. Slaves such as you and he have no voice. You are mute."

2cba1632-ad5e-484f-aa9c-a73f24128504.Text: "Humility is the lot of the meek. I am a harbinger of great changes, and visions of the great cataclysms to come have incinerated what humility I had in my heart."

764bbc86-167f-4096-8c67-90bc1e4a893f.Text: {n}The woman's voice breaks and shifts to a different pitch and timbre — a martyr's voice, young, fervent, and in pain:{/n} "Time has all but run out. I can hear the fist of the future knocking on the door of the present. Choose quickly what you want to be when it walks in: a blind slave to what is gone, a faithful servant of what is to come, or a corpse."

f849aaf2-eab1-4baa-b98c-27b32afb8173.Text: {n}A blinding voltaic arc bursts forth from the broken control panel and strikes at Aurora's uncanny mask. Its metal heats up. Smoke billows through the bars. With a howl, the cultist collapses.{/n}

d2e74e05-4e9f-4e4b-9382-c39df20da9ee.Text: "Conversations about truth always frighten ignorant minds."

938a9b80-56b4-45b3-9506-273df2555261.Text: {n}This is no human-made object. It was grown from {g|Encyclopedia:Wraithbone}wraithbone{/g}, a material favoured by the {g|Encyclopedia:Aeldari}Aeldari{/g}.{/n}

98113460-1e42-4251-87e7-5bec2802d592.Text: "Do you think they are blind? They see far more than you do. Through reflections in mirrors blessed by the energies of the {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}Immaterium{/g}, the Edge of Daybreak reveals to them visions of true existence and gives them glimpses of what is to come. The eyes lie: our erstwhile masters have taught them to see only what is consistent with the lies they tell. The gift we give is that of true sight."

8737ee68-6d2b-4b0f-b315-aafce3a9f758.Text: "Our teacher. Our saviour. Our merciful god born in the Immaterium out of the woes of those labouring under a legacy of ignorance and servitude."

18b4e89b-2282-42f2-931b-d4e235b6df89.Text: "It does have a vile temper. But I have assistants who can help tame it." {n}The woman nods casually toward the maimed Electro-Priests whose hands are affixed to the control panels with steel stakes.{/n}

b829c01a-473d-4e11-9a0b-31f5255fac8f.Text: "Executing. Let the Omnissiah-given Motive Force flow and all obstacles in its path be eradicated."

5155461f-f38e-4aa6-8ccc-5b946da61b8a.Text: {n}The woman's voice becomes thin and brittle like that of an innocent child:{/n} "Execute them in the name of the Edge of Daybreak!"

48285e40-c7d7-4554-be19-0157c29fff05.Text: "What you'll be is a living torch blazing for His glory!" {n}Argenta's voice burns with pure hatred and trembles with impatience to make the promise come true.{/n}

ae34c388-c801-4ad7-b539-1ab3592eb7b9.Text: {n}Heinrix grimaces in disgust.{/n} "The heretic took her secrets with her. Pity."

1d096c79-a2e3-4c3f-9525-84c7a4ffd614.Text: "Ah!" {n}Cassia squints and looks away.{/n} "Yellows, reds, violets, oranges, blues... Wild colours that scorch the eyes. But where the motley masks end, nothing but a colourless void remains."

3a698a1c-192d-430a-ab85-e4c081688fee.Text: "Enough." {n}Now an aged, rattling voice speaks to you from behind the bloodstained mask.{/n} "You are powerless to halt the approach of what is to come. I see a {g|Encyclopedia:CicatrixMaledictum}crimson trail{/g} leading Humanity to its doom. I see the glow of the Final Dawn, and that means existence has made its choice!" {n}A dagger flashes in Aurora's hand. She drives it into the control panel with all her strength.{/n} "Now you will see it too!"

3dba1efc-4a1c-42df-910b-b4fd5ee6ff06.Text: {n}As you touch the handguard, an otherworldly cold envelops your hand — only for a mere instant, as in the very next second, you send the corrupted weapon flying into the shining abyss. The terrible wail of several dozen voices pierces your mind for a moment, only to turn into a deafening shriek and break off as a clap of electricity is heard somewhere beneath your feet.{/n}

a0150646-8afc-4f4d-8c14-7351d9ec3140.Text: "Everyone born in the Imperium has a predestination. The soldier, the commoner, the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusAdministratum}Administratum{/g} official, the technomat, the void rat — all are consigned to serving the {g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Golden Throne{/g} and then dying a grim death for its glory. The Imperium never thinks twice about treating people as exploitable and expendable. After all, they are the most easily replenished of all resources."

90127f3d-5eb4-447f-8ca9-b2b134b5ce24.Text: "My name is known to you. I am Aurora, servant of Uralon the Cruel and the spark of the Final Dawn that is destined to set Rykad Minoris ablaze."

3c656691-5705-4075-a271-4356c559a0ac.Text: {n}Resounding laughter comes from behind the mask.{/n} "Your flippancy is so amusing. Why, you have no inkling of the chasm that separates us. He is a prophet who foresaw our impending doom and who graciously bestowed upon us the right to choose a different path. He is a shard of ancient wisdom from a time before we were slaves to our bitter predestination."

5ca98823-6ffa-42be-901f-bc5dad2980c4.Text: "Even your path is predestined, {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}: you will inevitably perish on your quest to expand Humanity's domain, and your end will be particularly grim and ghastly. The fruits of your efforts will be enjoyed by others: the eternal aristocrats who dwell on {g|Encyclopedia:Mars}Mars{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:HolyTerra}Terra{/g}, and other safe worlds."

f8e96e89-8b00-44fe-9b18-f8b83959970b.Text: "I am lighting the spark of the Final Dawn. Sometimes the future revealed in the Edge of Daybreak's visions is fragmented between the facets of possibility, and the view is unclear. I have glimpsed the importance of this place for what is to come, and I have solved the puzzle. The flash of purity will transform this world and bring it closer to the {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}Immaterium{/g}, in which it will be reborn. False believers will perish in the fire, whilst the faithful will find their salvation and their new form in it."

3f17f81d-7fe6-480b-b8cd-b2dbf3d12a91.Text: "Brother Twilight, known to you as Kunrad, marked you as a target. Your foiling of his plans sealed your death warrant. It is now a predestined certainty that changes can no longer affect."

ad67735a-2f19-42f4-b376-4315ad64cbb3.Text: "A great path for one who was born into the Imperium's bondage but shunned her predestination in favour of the changes promised by the Edge of Daybreak."

0cc168c5-29ef-4f87-987d-074999dd9bb2.Text: "They insist that it is the natural order of things, but that is a lie. It is an order that benefits them."

6bede5b8-4f73-4fa0-a2ce-48f7c00f7a11.Text: {n}The woman turns her mask to Pasqal and gloats,{/n} "You have arrived just in time, little cog. The schismaticals use your regalia like a mask to subdue the reactor."

dede6cd3-9176-4ea9-8c4a-6995f9984666.Text: {n}Pasqal's vox rasps musingly,{/n} "A cog. I cannot comprehend why apostates try to insult me by comparing me to the sacred symbol of our faith. It is irrational." {n}His visor lights up like a crimson herald of bloodshed, and his drilling mechadendrite whirrs viciously as it readies to strike.{/n} "The sacred cog grinds all corruption to dust. From the dust, I will build order."

06cd8d73-eb56-4c40-b20f-3f7fb6239357.Text: {n}Heinrix gives you an appraising look, then shifts his gaze to the cogitator's control panel.{/n} "An impressive blow. I suppose whatever she used to breach the frame was melted by the impact of the Motive Force... Hmm."

2f2d13e7-f5b5-4ede-bbfe-4f2bcf1e2b93.Text: {n}The cogitator is probably well beyond repair, but your attention is drawn away from the sacred machine and toward the dagger sticking out of the control panel. On closer inspection, it turns out to be the lavishly decorated handguard of a sword whose blade has been pried out. Its pommel is decorated with a strange adornment resembling an eye covered by a scaled lid. What remains of the blade has a blue sheen to it — the same tint as Kunrad's weapon during the mutiny on your voidship.{/n}

a8a6d274-7513-4ad6-9132-4002594533b2.Text: "You false believers will never shackle the ever-changing truth!"

e5649754-9e8b-4859-b64f-327d997d3f20.Text: {n}Pasqal examines the corpse with contempt, then concludes dryly,{/n} "Confirming purgation and termination."

05030053-5ebd-424d-af71-f0c36afb2ee7.Text: {n}One of the servants of the Omnissiah casts a tortured glance at you, his voice trembling with horror:{/n} "Blasphemous spirits have crawled under our skin and into our sacred iron. Take the Motive Force of our bodies, I implore you. We do not wish to offend the Omnissiah with the sacrileges our hands are committing."

ed872721-b1e7-4559-a6c0-bd943b9ad38a.Text: "They resisted for a long time, but now their bodies and souls belong to the schismaticals. Line after line, the scrap-code they produce will awaken the reactor's unyielding spirit as well. And it, too, will yearn for change and freedom."

d3dd3908-b0a4-40d7-9491-56eed548a1e2.Text: {n}After Aurora finishes, she studies you silently for a while and says in a pleased voice,{/n} "You can sense the truth of my words, can you not? You have softened your soul enough for it to sense, almost as clearly as mine does, the coming changes."

3acae339-cb77-4127-be23-ac913fbb832b.Text: {n}The Electro-Priests rip their hands off the command panels, rending their flesh on the stakes that pierced them. As their schismatical-controlled bodies are imbued with the Motive Force's radiance, all the unfortunates can do is scream in horror and plead for a swift death. Aurora begins muttering an unholy litany in broken Gothic.{/n}

04c0eb79-96f6-466a-8a40-415a0579cfa1.Text: {n}The woman takes a glass prism out of the folds of her clothes, and looks at you through it with a mocking chuckle. The prism's bluish-pink sheen imprints itself on your retinas as though it has been burned into them.{/n} "Guess what I see when I look at you."

376dee4b-f6fa-4563-a7c3-efa95a1a0c0d.Text: {n}The woman's face is hidden behind the mask, but there is a sharpness to her voice that convinces you that her face is contorted in a grimace.{/n} "And he remembers you, {name} von Valancius. Your little {d|Encyclopedia:Prologue_WentThroughFire}purge by fire{/d} will not make you invisible to the Weaver of Destinies."

49f7d019-ad63-40f3-913a-45e6009ec949.Text: {n}The iron helmet is firmly attached to the heretic's flesh. Her face is impossible to make out in the darkness behind the bars of her mask, but after peering at it for a little longer than necessary, you wonder if, for a moment... you saw something move.{/n}

e031d287-6fd0-47c9-bfbb-5cca6ac9d66d.Text: "In that case you should consider losing the eyes too, sister, 'cause your visions are all wrong. My whispers are telling me something completely different about who dies here and how. I won't spoil the surprise, so let's just say it will come as quite a shock to you." {n}Idira grins maliciously.{/n}

131af40e-25fb-4f46-91af-791d9d80317f.Text: "I said it would come as a shock to her, didn't I? Her eyes literally sparkled with astonishment." {n}Idira's smug grin gives way to an expression of concern.{/n} "That said, my friends from behind the door won't calm down. They keep sneering and guffawing as if the joke's on us and not her."

701fa0c5-e7ad-47c1-9507-6e9c617fe015.Text: {n}You cannot see the woman's face behind her mask, but her voice is trembling with what could be anger or fear.{/n} "And he {d|Encyclopedia:Prologue_EdgeHelp}spread the word about you{/d}, {name} von Valancius. The interloper who got in Brother Twilight's way... I will avenge him."

198f508a-6d8a-4033-83a0-13e4a7fffd55.Text: {n}You cannot see the woman's face behind her mask, but judging by her tone of malicious triumph, you could swear she is smiling.{/n} "And he remembers you, {name} von Valancius. The silly {d|Encyclopedia:Prologue_WentBack}saviour fantasy{/d} you have been acting out amuses the true masters of those people's fates."

3b0d50f2-7f10-43c2-afe1-6619d78cb755.Text: {n}Aurora hesitates. Then a madwoman's hoarse laughter comes from behind the mask.{/n} "You are no successor to Brother Twilight, oh no. You are a mere impostor believing {mf|him|her}self to be a decider of fates! I deny you! I deny you!"

f4465009-db1e-496d-9400-96e25f4ec79e.Text: "What is this poison you speak, Rogue Trader?"

6b107959-fca6-42af-9ba1-dd7f89a41062.Text: "Salvation from a death whose name is yet unknown, but whose approach is sensed by many. Soon it will claim every inhabitant of the Koronus Expanse. Do you think anyone will come to our aid when cataclysms shake our homes and planet-wide genocides are unleashed? Will the Emperor help? Or the idol of iron they call the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}? No. We will die alone and abandoned. Only one deity is promising salvation: the Edge of Daybreak. Mercy and salvation will come to all who believe in him and purify their souls in the light of the Final Dawn."

fdbfb8bb-8dda-4d9f-9fc9-f0997b1399c9.Text: {n}Heinrix eyes you icily.{/n} "Interesting choice of words, {name}."

6ce64d2e-c7c9-475b-adb2-f4249f675600.Text: {n}Aurora's entire body flinches as if she has been struck. A cough sends a scarlet spatter through the grille of her mask.{/n} "What— what is this? Punishment? But for what? I have not renounced the Edge— I— this cannot be— execute them at once!" {n}Aurora attempts to recite an unholy litany in broken Gothic, but her own voice fails her as she is shaken by a violent coughing fit until she can barely breathe.{/n}

879f6bd6-a897-44cd-b25c-2faa9562fbb7.Text: {n}The Electro-Priests rip their hands off the command panels, rending their flesh on the stakes that pierced them. As their schismatical-controlled bodies are imbued with the Motive Force's radiance, all the unfortunates can do is scream in horror and plead for a swift death.{/n}

2ab60fd4-72fd-484e-8f33-5af109e93cd1.Text: {n}Heinrix approaches Aurora's body and leans over it.{/n} "A minute, please, {name}. I need no more than a minute..."

5032a5b1-934d-419c-91d5-1a77a748622b.Text: {n}As you lean over the shard, you suddenly hear a multitude of voices. They blend together and individual words are distorted, as though they are mocking your attempts to grasp their meaning. The nagging whisper is like the burning red scratch of an unholy claw upon your mind.{/n}

5cab962e-452e-4193-83bc-58f9eb6598a1.Text: {n}Heinrix takes the strange shard out of the control panel and studies it for a few seconds.{/n} "Curious..." {n}Heinrix stows the corrupted object away and turns to you.{/n}

ee99195a-dd48-4cd9-855a-f243cc4f28ed.Text: "What was that?" {n}Heinrix appears behind you.{/n} "Did you think it a good idea to throw something into the reactor? I'd refrain from such experiments if I were you."

50a45596-4c86-4fbf-bc8a-0f84304eefa2.Text: "Patience is one of the greatest strengths of a powerful dynasty, {mf|Lord|Lady} von Valancius."

111cff2f-5646-4a5c-a0fc-45f7639cc81f.Text: {n}Heinrix efficiently searches Aurora's corpse as if he is looking for something specific. After checking every belt and pouch, he straightens up with an annoyed sigh, glances at the mangled cogitator, and walks toward it with a resolute stride.{/n} "I've found what I've been looking for."

d2b89e89-04ab-4991-884f-c82d5155ab15.Text: "Rogue Trader, on behalf of the Holy Ordos, I thank you for your cooperation and release you from requisition. From this moment on, I am at your service. I am ready to come aboard your ship and head for Footfall as soon as you deem it possible. That is, if you do not have other business in this system, in which case I am prepared to assist you in its prompt resolution."

b6e568b8-c0de-4a34-aee6-06c7df6ff097.Text: "The light... is gone. Was that it? The Final Dawn? But why was it so different from what our teacher promised?" {n}Aurora shakes her head blindly. Her voice is now the voice of an ordinary middle-aged woman, frightened and in pain.{/n} "You will pay for this. You will. You—" {n}The woman's body goes limp and collapses to the floor. Her iron mask hits the ground with a dull thud.{/n}

7b31466b-fab1-4af2-b9ea-a92ff134a072.Text: "Your own death. You just haven't recognised it yet." {n}Kibellah leans forward and whispers with a smile,{/n} "Remember its face."

e160e8a7-734b-46dc-8714-f5c9435e503a.Text: {n}No matter how hard you try, you cannot get it out of your head. Are you really going to carry it around in your mind... forever?{/n}

fb27db36-38ac-42a1-95f1-d95a7b6e5fba.Text: "For blasphemous violation of the relic's protocols of operation, this profaner shall be destroyed. She is not eligible for atonement as a servitor."

488a3ae6-0fa3-4826-b216-ad9165051a55.Text: {n}However, you manage to muster your strength and banish it from your mind.{/n}

6e77b1a8-54ef-4bbc-b53b-9843c937758c.Text: "Rogue Trader! I can't wait to close this creature's mouth with the seal of death. Or are you saving this glorious deed for yourself?"

41d8545a-16c2-4656-92f3-6514bbf5446a.Text: "You will never tame the spirit of this ancient and noble machine, ignorant layperson."

f107bb26-d762-4239-a787-5e4ae7d4972b.Text: {n}When you touch the abomination, the whispers in your ears become louder and more... bloodthirsty. You pocket the trophy surreptitiously, just before the Interrogator appears at your shoulder.{/n}

5b3c28da-72da-4c79-9f03-92a8ec6ff5a4.Text: "How did you kill those heretics? What technology did you use?"

5d2d194e-badf-4948-a848-80596297913c.Text: "Ask him about Amarnat. You came here because of him, after all."

636bae7a-e456-44de-a987-353cfe2c6d4c.Text: "Who are you, servant of the Omnissiah?"

b9a3776f-660e-47dd-aa2d-f269345151dd.Text: [Try to take down the Tech-Priest crucified on the machine]

91c9c3de-ac57-48d9-b425-23bf5479ffe1.Text: Decided to try to save Abel in the Electrodynamic Cenobium.

2e9a46e5-41f2-4eda-b1de-f509bcff209f.Text: Granted the Emperor's Peace to Abel in the Electrodynamic Cenobium.

f033e426-f2a4-4169-89bf-19b06c2cc5ff.Text: [Grant the Emperor's Peace to the Tech-Priest] "Let the tainted be eradicated."

975f6403-537c-4165-9e71-e41553720967.Text: Refused to remove Abel from the corrupted machine in the Electrodynamic Cenobium.

e4cc4357-e373-460f-87ed-c7abf7cb892e.Text: "I would rather leave him as he is. There must be a purpose to whatever ritual he has taken part in..."

ab1f5238-cff8-41bd-9a60-8c380b469a46.Text: [Send a purifying charge of the Motive Force into the possessed man's body] "May the Machine God heal you."

c47d8ae8-c8dc-4d29-9d8c-2378e48c9eb3.Text: [Grant the Emperor's Peace to the Tech-Priest] "Enough. He is beyond saving."

656fb277-1fe0-4249-ae91-2b774950d76a.Text: [Recite a prayer to the Emperor] "Deliver us from the evil that has come for our souls from the abyss of the Immaterium..."

19922511-7abd-4a2e-b057-7c5759d0107a.Text: "You can talk once we get him out of here."

af552b70-d689-4ad9-97b6-0911c4b7eb55.Text: "In the cycles of the foreordained... there lurks a flaw... of worship..." {n}The Tech-Priest's body convulses. Pained, plaintive creaks of binharic prayers come from his {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g}. As moments pass, the signal becomes less and less clear, as if something twisted and wrong were being added to it.{/n}

576bb2e0-e94c-42d8-aa98-9ba9df095414.Text: {n}Pasqal studies the {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priest{/g}'s face carefully. His vox-system moans in a tragic vibrato:{/n} "Subject unidentified. This is not the blessed Amarnat. Stranger, I request your name. How do you know my mentor's motto?"

03376f7b-82f3-4718-a410-a4d9dd65052b.Text: {n}Kibellah gives Pasqal a long look, her eyebrow raised in a silent question. Pasqal responds with an equally long silence, then creaks,{/n} "Thank you for your cooperation. Request denied. The Catechism demands that this act be performed by an authorised unit."

5800fc12-63c6-4e07-8f7a-4dfa8ae64a94.Text: "The fire of the hearth... sent forth sparks. The name... of this spark is... Abel... Haneumann."

a940940c-065d-4828-ab62-9b18a0570503.Text: {n}The Tech-Priest looks over at Pasqal. For a brief moment, his speech becomes clear:{/n} "The echo of my call has reached you. Good. The iteration is at its end. The design is fulfilled."

0e8f5fa9-52c0-474d-b8a1-bba5fe9c9e2d.Text: "What design? Why are you calling yourself by my name? Was it you who summoned me to Rykad Minoris? What for? I categorically demand an answer!" {n}Pasqal's voice rises to an intimidating howl, but the delirious Tech-Priest does not seem to understand what he is saying.{/n}

5e010888-0b76-4722-abce-3c5fb7c1e5d5.Text: {n}There is a look of gentle condescension in Abel's eyes — strange, given the circumstances.{/n} "The hubris of the mind spurs him to build monuments to himself. Do not regret, for all is predetermined by the iteration—" {n}A devastating coughing fit cuts him off, and you hear a clang of tearing metal from inside his chest.{/n}

79018643-fae8-4493-91e1-498810dd1a7c.Text: {n}There are deep burns all over his flesh, and the skin around his {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}augmetics{/g} is charred. Blasphemous spells have been carved into his sacred iron, forming unholy litanies of scrap-code. It is amazing how robust this Tech-Priest's life support systems have proven to be in maintaining the spark of life in his grievously wounded body.{/n}

26cc2440-775a-4ccc-9282-dd046d115888.Text: "An intention both bold and honourable — to open new gates for the waters of Knowledge and Comprehension. A plan written so that the righteous may follow..."

517dc9e7-141a-424d-bfa4-8edae6276100.Text: "The subject has not been identified and has no record in my catalogue. Interrogation is impossible due to the subject's evident affective state of clouded consciousness."

52bbffc4-fd91-4572-a4ab-a65a48434c44.Text: {n}A blast of the Motive Force runs down the Tech-Priest's body, and his face contorts in a mocking grimace. Malformed binharic code, repulsively jarring on the ears, pours out of his vox.{/n}

49129198-0699-406f-aab6-9999303b3f69.Text: "Information archived to the effect that the circuit restoration hymn is the entrance password to the Electro-Priests' hiding-place." {n}Pasqal responds with the dour rhythms of a containment aria.{/n} "I note with great sorrow that the cultists' ritual has been partially successful. My tech-brother has been tainted by corruption. He is in the grip of a schismatical, an unholy imitation of a machine spirit. I request immediate activation of the techsorcism protocol."

fbfb60ae-aa99-4e19-8295-ce35755f8417.Text: "Request denied. If we are not granting him salvation, let us at least grant him a merciful deactivation."

6556adce-8f78-40c7-a05b-0a272b2a37da.Text: {n}As mangled as it is, the Tech-Priest's body still clings to life. It takes several blows to end his corruption-tainted existence. But even after that, a repulsive giggle is heard over the static from his vox.{/n}

f66befab-8e3c-4636-bfc6-add16daad951.Text: {n}The possessed man responds with a burst of repulsive laughter. Every now and then, a word or two of Gothic finds its way into the binharic obscenities pouring out of his vox, in what seem to be the schismatical's tentative forays into a language that is alien to it.{/n}

4f042f05-2dc3-4cdc-b87d-35a47a0334c0.Text: {n}Pasqal's {g|Encyclopedia:Mechadendrite}mechadendrite{/g} touches the dead man's head carefully, grips his neural augmetic in its claw, and extracts it from its socket with the utmost care. The skull bone cracks dryly, and brain matter taints the sacred metal.{/n} "Rest in purity, tech-brother. The Knowledge you have attained through your efforts will be preserved and purified."

50a7ae3b-f3db-4268-9a08-9468188ff913.Text: {n}Pasqal's mechadendrite extends a thin drilling needle. Sacred unguent glistens on it. A code purification aria is heard as the needle sinks into the possessed Tech-Priest's skull and touches his neural augmetic, forming an electric circuit with it. Extreme strain is visible on his face. Furious litanies pour out of his vox.{/n} "Result: failure. Requesting assistance."

a64a5ef3-7a72-4985-beea-c5a401cfeacc.Text: {n}Undaunted, you grab one of the severed cables and press it into the Tech-Priest's body, and a shock of formidable power shakes the possessed man. Machine oil gushes out of his mouth. His vox hisses deafeningly as the flow of the Motive Force burns the corruption in his sacred iron. The overload destroys some of the circuit boards of his neural augmetic, resets his code, and erases the schismatical from existence.{/n}

7fb61f30-a1a1-4d84-9885-52fb762788fa.Text: {n}Undaunted, you grab one of the severed cables and press it into the Tech-Priest's body. A shock of formidable power stuns you, the possessed man, and Pasqal. The schismatical's mocking voice grows louder and more malicious. The augmetics under the Tech-Priest's skin become so hot they burn right through it, and blasphemous symbols appear upon his pale flesh.{/n}

46d9dbcc-2da1-4994-91c4-b86928a47188.Text: {n}The sacred words cause the possessed man to convulse, but the strength of your faith prevails over the unholy spirit's power. Boiling machine oil streams down from the Tech-Priest's ears and his breathing mask. Word after word, you push the abomination out of his innocent flesh and back into the warp's oblivion.{/n}

368b184f-e36e-411c-ad07-0b204ac34337.Text: {n}The possessed man's vox takes to echoing back the words you say, but distorting their sound in foul mockery. The synthetic muscles tense up, arching the body. You could swear you hear the unfortunate man's stretched tendons snap with a quiet, revolting screech.{/n}

5d3167c2-15ec-4153-9b16-fa68dee81acf.Text: "An ugly mockery of a noble machine spirit, created by the warp. Sometimes a few lines of despicable scrap-code or a small clump of the Motive Force falls under the {g|Encyclopedia:Chaos}Archenemy{/g}'s influence and degenerates into an abomination of this sort: one whose very existence is an insult to the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}'s wisdom."

1d77bd4f-1d59-45ce-82ef-4b5887124cdd.Text: {n}With a jerk, the drill leaves the possessed man's skull. Pasqal's vox says, in a gloomy, hoarse voice interspersed with static,{/n} "There is no hope. We have done our best. Initiating merciful deactivation protocol."

0b03f32c-fc6f-4b8a-ab3b-c2ffd3f740bc.Text: {n}The Tech-Priest's eyes roll up, and he loses consciousness: crushed, yet still alive and no longer in the thrall of corruption. With the utmost care, Pasqal takes his body down from the mechanism and lays it on the floor. His stirring litanies of gratitude to the Omnissiah echo through the hall.{/n}

e35a6ffd-652d-4a9a-822f-1a3bb1765463.Text: {n}As soon as you touch the Tech-Priest's battered flesh, he shifts his gaze to you and says, with sudden clarity,{/n} "Many sparks have gone out... but not all. The electric shepherds are alive. In the darkness... I heard their prayers. Find them. Save them. Recite the hymn... of contact circuit restoration, so that you may behold... what is hidden."

cbd50246-73fb-4bca-b646-8f5c456466c5.Text: "We are the flame of Knowledge that drives the darkness away." {n}Pasqal is quickly inspecting Abel's wounds, paying no mind to the blood and sacred unguents staining his sleeves. His vox rasps soothingly,{/n} "Do not fear what is to come, brother. We are already here."

2e423516-1967-409c-adc0-442b0ae27328.Text: "...and trust in the great pattern of revelation and uniform progression toward it." {n}Pasqal's voice is trembling with... elation?{/n} "Those are his words. I have not heard them in so very long."

65292750-eefe-472f-9a1c-b061adce93d6.Text: "Eschatos. This word does not appear in my catalogue. But I am aware of its existence. Perhaps it sounded in the blessed Amarnat's sermons. I must consult my notes."

933cb284-d574-4a59-8904-11a54ce179f6.Text: "Existence... has worn thin and threadbare. Eschatos... has discontinued the Cycle."

6769beb8-506c-4817-9f54-da986ed98049.Text: "Rest, tech-brother. We will come back for you when we have done our duty to the Miraculous Fusion Reactor."

faa0ffa0-c9e2-4561-919f-2cc0c91fb0fb.Text: "Lord Captain, the Omnissiah commands a pious mind to strive toward uncovering the truth. Therefore I will not stop until I find my mentor and understand his connection to this servant of the Machine God. I request the privilege of joining your retinue as a rightful companion. I can offer to fulfil the duties of an {g|Encyclopedia:Enginseer}Enginseer{/g} on your ship in exchange for the right to follow you and conduct my own investigation."

64f76524-f1e9-4260-adc5-9b1c7ba8331e.Text: {n}His body convulses. His joints twist at unnatural angles with the sound of bursting steel couplings. As the possessed man thrashes about, his internal augmetics emerge gradually through the hanging tatters of his flesh, as though an iron homunculus hidden inside the Tech-Priest were trying to cast off the meat cocoon it no longer needed.{/n}
