6197960a-e779-4247-9d19-8609fe850d04.Text: "A cold premonition... rakes the heart... The probabilities are dark and frightening... Brother, I do not wish to gaze into them."

8e30d137-151c-428b-9430-4236c1009c38.Text: "No." {n}The Tech-Priest's weak voice grows stronger.{/n} "He came because of himself."

c58e1321-f424-446e-a03b-81ec98e16651.Text: "Myself? To redeem myself... To correct a mistake... Possibly. But how do you...?"

d2bb9882-cbaf-4252-8b15-812eceeed5f7.Text: The machine altar is operational, but will only respond to a special command that you do not know.

8ccedad6-995d-41d3-bfef-dd0d463bbab5.Text: The machine altar accepts the contact circuit restoration hymn with a deferential whirr.

865e40a0-555e-4b5c-a2bb-0f47d4332d9a.Text: Despite all the suffering he has endured, the Tech-Priest is still alive, though unconscious.

f9b47789-929e-48a5-bafe-d7e214a7c2d2.Text: The fighter's body is still warm: he only bled to death a few minutes ago.

a1dd9f88-9a8d-474f-a4db-dcc0d68cece7.Text: The heretics who came too close to the Motive Force-infused mechanism were killed by a single devastating lightning strike.

99d9185d-5f4e-46c4-a943-bf622699b1b5.Text: These dead heretics are suspiciously different from the others: the symbols on their clothes are drawn wrongly, and standard-issue military uniforms show through the blasphemous tatters.

78641f48-9801-48fc-a9c2-4c460b67837d.Text: "You shall be purified by the Motive Force, blasphemer!"

9b64177e-3aad-41d9-9268-6c91d204b308.Text: The sacred statue has been shattered into pieces at the hands of the blasphemous heretics.

6e271475-44be-4e21-875b-483b277eabe2.Text: The pieces are molten at the edges. The statue was likely blasted by a barrage from a multi-laser turret — the type found on landing-force shuttles.

5d037217-5f14-4081-8d15-3ee13f41b011.Text: The wayward machine spirit refuses to obey you.

8e33983a-6307-4e5d-843d-45e7f269a728.Text: The bodies of careless cultists have been thoroughly fried by an arc of the Motive Force.

89acfbbf-e5d9-4b04-8efc-5221bb57abfd.Text: A Motive Force field seals the passage, threatening to incinerate anyone who touches it.

6b270623-7655-4fb4-b15f-1f46e0fda3d4.Text: The hard, uncomfortable somno-meditation bed is equipped with neural ports to connect the sleeper to the monastery's cogitator network.

7aa4d3d8-cb81-4135-8b02-6be2cbd085ab.Text: "On the Maladies of Machine Spirits and the Ways of Diagnostic Divination."

c3429a4d-555c-478f-a68e-7a5de127732f.Text: "May the charge of the Omnissiah's grace persist in the batteries of the faithful!"

433da59f-6a41-42b5-85c0-53664bfebc98.Text: The Motive Force spirits are furious that the circuits directing them have not been duly maintained.

0f6618f7-9a9d-48a5-8208-fcb4162933c8.Text: It would appear the Electro-Priests damaged the Motive Force circuits on purpose to turn them into a trap for the intruders.

11d1a27d-f75a-450d-b531-2c8cbdc230d1.Text: These dead people had come decently equipped, but to no avail.

2aed9a7b-b9e6-4e61-a21d-9c34c029f3fd.Text: Judging by the dead people's equipment, they were the same wardens the governor sent to the monastery's aid.

d4af5fa3-b6e6-4a83-b11c-91cf1e7ba7c7.Text: "May the Motive Force persist in the batteries of the righteous."

978a6033-211b-4c8b-99f8-16533a3f00a8.Text: "The circular cogitator. The Electro-Priests' hiding place must be nearby."

87998d00-b8d9-4557-b7c0-a7fd21ed243d.Text: "To make this machine spirit do your bidding, you have to know the correct prayer. The sentinel will ask for a password."

66f2c97e-4aa2-4078-b118-5a048dff8712.Text: The Electro-Priest is in the trance of magnetic meditation.

ab8dbf8f-08f5-42e7-bf14-3bca10fed6f1.Text: The mummified Tech-Priest rests on the table, enveloped in wires.

5f684418-0729-4ce6-a894-7d541be6e255.Text: The heretics were killed swiftly and ruthlessly. They never had time to reach for their weapons.

471fc774-a0a6-47c1-95e0-1aff3627aec9.Text: The cultists were killed with a hit to the back from some kind of electric weapon.

70ace22d-0048-4cd2-a364-fae58406bd8b.Text: The locking mechanism that keeps this gate sealed demands a binharic prayer.

74e816d2-c544-4b7e-9a62-4f76794bdb08.Text: The computational altar is surrounded by a great number of candles and commoners' measly offerings.

70474c4b-0ac2-48ef-80eb-f8665ec76340.Text: Laypeople unworthy of entering the Hallowed Cenobium humbly said their prayers next to this computational altar.

48491c01-50ba-4195-8d03-3dea9e8e89fd.Text: The binharic hymn awakens the gate's latching mechanism.

4930da16-1106-443a-85ce-4a0629f60809.Text: "The Hallowed Electrodynamic Cenobium greets its saviour."

160289dd-6cfa-436c-ae0c-08545afa879a.Text: A symbol for the Omnissiah is inscribed on the wall, with grooves of electric discharges fanning out from it like a river.

8fd822e5-fcfc-4bbd-94bf-5828680dfa25.Text: You note that wire junctions are often marked with the symbol of a key that appears to connect two lines.

e8e60d02-bd1d-47f2-9992-054adcefd0af.Text: A multitude of symbols are carved into the enormous generator, but you cannot decipher their meaning.

732196c1-96ea-48bb-bfb8-a288d0504c10.Text: A multitude of symbols are carved into the enormous generator. You realise they are the foundational tenets of the Electro-Priest religion. Standing out among them is the triumph of reason over all other facets of human nature.

daf7a8ff-90e2-4437-824c-72f4937db2e7.Text: "We'll cover the landing area, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! Glory to the von Valancius dynasty!"

86d355fc-1c2a-45f5-804e-eded56af1f82.Text: "Death to the profaners who have defiled the sanctity of this place!"

f1a4e536-fd54-453a-86e6-17b7f7e10f20.Text: The command throne is not yet ready for the power unit litany.

5f37f702-a911-4478-8ad3-216770503406.Text:
Praetor Electroid Dahr-Impulse II's blessing is a promise of protection from the fury of the Motive Force.
Grants 50% {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} against {g|Encyclopedia:ShockDamage}shock damage{/g}.

dc893f6e-c737-487f-8964-72dfdde568d8.Text: [Use your officer's voice] "In the name and for the glory of the God-Emperor, heed my command!"

93f2e84d-0f91-4925-aeeb-9f5a2755e011.Text: [Address the servitor menacingly] "Your function is to serve. And I command you to serve!"

07f270e2-c982-4ab7-9bb3-b4ca1cbae4f2.Text: [Carve your name into the servitor's pale flesh]

99bc235f-42ca-4e1f-8916-740787247683.Text: {n}A heavy crown of golden neural augmetics rests upon the {g|Encyclopedia:Servitor}servitor{/g}'s head. The crown is bent and broken from ruthless gun-butt blows. The pale body is covered in blasphemous inscriptions carved into the withered flesh.{/n}

1637cd85-ace6-4c16-a49e-19778c5205a4.Text: "I identify this acolyte as a distribution servitor. I am registering upon it traces of sacrilegious violation of the Rite of Operation. The probability of its responsiveness to commands is below average."

d16677c8-b522-4408-8fd4-41a11c9bd7b2.Text: {n}A shower of sparks bursts from the mechanism upon the servitor's head, and black, ash-tinted tears make tracks down its pale cheeks. A weak whisper comes from the servitor's lips.{/n} "Ready... to perform... my function... Glory... to the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}..."

dfaf7218-8c7d-4439-b336-6f01f65169cf.Text: {n}The human machine is unheedful of your order.{/n}

2616a120-7677-4e60-95e4-65a225a49ed3.Text: {n}A shower of sparks bursts from the augmetics on the servitor's brow, and several black, ash-tinted tears run from its empty eye sockets.{/n} "Ready... to serve..."

0e625ee9-12d0-4db1-aa17-2bcc2816428a.Text: {n}The rite of ceremonial restarting fails to awaken the insensate servitor. The augmetics on its brow spark weakly.{/n}

6d9fd27c-8454-42fb-8416-6f6a4334fe1d.Text: {n}The servitor observes your act of petty sacrilege with complete indifference.{/n}

e9ffcda8-84f0-4ae9-9fc7-69809f347536.Text: {n}Pasqal clicks the claws of his {g|Encyclopedia:Mechadendrite}mechadendrite{/g} in disapproval.{/n} "Do not be disrespectful to the ancient machine spirit this acolyte serves."

842f1960-6a43-41a2-8a70-700d737f7df4.Text: {n}A powerful discharge comes from the {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}augmetics{/g} of the servitor you have disturbed. Its entire body convulses. The mouth opens to let out a horrible guttural howl of pain. The heretics around you shriek as they notice you, but their surprise quickly gives way to anger.{/n}

030032d6-7150-4386-ba6d-0c5c6ee69eb8.Text: "Energise the hall's power units to the maximum."

00c45ef6-6509-4ab7-9a4d-ef94e1f1b419.Text: "For the glory of the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}, let this machine spirit sleep, that it may awaken and serve again." {n}Pasqal gently touches the servitor's crown, deactivating one of its segments.{/n} "Let the outer neural connection circuit be plunged in darkness." {n}Another touch, and several lights on the crown go out.{/n} "Let the command response hub fall silent."

a8467d5d-84ce-48f0-a3be-40eb8f524786.Text: {n}Pasqal switches to binharic speech, accompanying his every action with a line from a sacred hymn. It is amazing how the reverent awe in the {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priest{/g}'s voice can be discerned even through his rattling {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g}. Suddenly every light on the servitor's crown comes alive.{/n}

d0ac3502-f1eb-4b6d-b68e-14e29135fcbd.Text: "Pasqal, kindly sit down on the throne and recite the litany."

4a351513-4b91-4255-a560-a29070c499d2.Text: [Sit down upon the throne and recite the Litany of Actuation] "I am about to be greatly honoured, or else thoroughly charred. Maybe both."

3dff48e1-0cdd-4559-950b-7323074a6929.Text: "Pasqal, saving the relic and your mentor justifies a minor infraction of the rules!"

c17eebf3-1216-4001-9f80-26937a29df30.Text: [Advance menacingly toward Pasqal] "Are you disobeying a direct order? I have blown out Guardsmen's brains for less!"

eb2b4bb5-cf98-45f1-95cf-019b57c322eb.Text: {n}A {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priest{/g}'s corpse, his throat slit, sits upon a splendid command throne laced with finely wrought Motive Force paths. A contorted expression of righteous anger is frozen on his face. A black blindfold covers his eyes.{/n}

b661cbd3-8155-4430-8c97-08f79a4cb237.Text: "This is the lumenodeacon's command throne. This is where the power unit actuation and shutdown litanies are recited from. The blessed lumenodeacon himself has the honour of closing the circuit the Motive Force flows through."

eec82975-e978-493a-83da-48d200636e59.Text: {n}As soon as you lay your hands on the command throne's panels, a painful sting of electricity numbs your senses for an instant. Your fingers cramp and your vision grows dim.{/n}

3fedf9b2-0926-48f0-bb87-f205b289be81.Text: {n}Clinging on to the blazing shreds of your fading consciousness, you repeat the words of the litany after Pasqal and touch the command runes, as the unabating lightning rips through your muscles and makes your bones crackle.{/n}

f53d5cd1-6b90-44e8-a8f8-d52b4ea34ad2.Text: {n}You try to repeat the words of the litany after Pasqal, but you cannot control your tongue, and the convulsions that wrack your body prevent your fingers from touching the right command runes. Before oblivion has engulfed you completely, you manage to get up from the throne and just barely keep your unsteady footing.{/n}

ca0e50f8-a503-402f-91bb-d37814289417.Text: {n}Pasqal casts a scrutinising glance at you, then nods reluctantly.{/n} "Situation deemed an emergency. I request the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}'s forgiveness for the transgression about to be committed." {n}The Tech-Priest's body winces from the Motive Force discharge, but his vox begins to recite the sacred words of the litany as his fingers activate the command runes with precise, unhurried movements.{/n}

a4dc9c1e-503a-498d-81be-8b637afbaca7.Text: {n}Pasqal's vox screeches resolutely,{/n} "To violate the Rite is to trample upon the faith."

40847700-3511-4ef6-9219-019cb54ce429.Text: {n}Pain is visible in the Tech-Priest's eyes as he looks upon the sacrilege.{/n} "Forgive us, Omnissiah, for such a gross violation of the Rite of Operation. Repeat the litany after me and activate the command runes I point to." {n}Pasqal's vox starts reciting the sacred words, gloomily and hoarsely.{/n}

cbd9ffd3-56e1-49a4-b566-cd2206f05141.Text: {n}Someone in the crowd of heretics shouts a warning. Your tampering with the throne must have been noticed.{/n}

d16715cc-6f47-456f-bd97-d1955a146583.Text: {n}Pasqal freezes, and a quiet whisper comes from his {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g},{/n} "Request denied. I am not authorised to sit upon the lumenodeacon's command throne. Such an act would be considered a sacrilege."

d3b1d7a8-1fa6-4275-80ec-1ee6b25fd4de.Text: "I am recording a successful activation of the power units."

3670199c-b9d6-4cd1-aa81-51dc28e12dd8.Text: [Stealthily sabotage the machine] "There was a young Navy officer on my old bridge who once disabled a whole relay grid this way..."

cff9ab4d-9e43-4b9b-8f76-59f04049caf3.Text: "Forgive us, honoured machine spirit. We are obliged to interrupt your work."

72017a58-10e6-4f91-93ec-e33749b0705e.Text: {n}The altar is adorned with gilded skulls. Threads of metal that used to be electoos are fused onto the bone. Once majestic, the altar has now been desecrated with blasphemous images of blue-green suns. Some of its levers and buttons have been pried from their sockets, but the mechanism still glorifies the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g} with its operation.{/n}

87d47e14-4500-4ba7-a9c3-fc843f570624.Text: "I identify this as the safety system control altar. For our diversion to succeed, this blessed machine must be executed — and may its {g|Encyclopedia:MachineSpirit}spirit{/g} forgive us."

9c34c7be-5343-426f-b5c5-5184a289098e.Text: {n}Pasqal offers a short binharic prayer, then enters command after command to set up a trap for the machine spirit inhabiting the altar. The code born out of the {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priest{/g}'s tinkering causes the spirit to flutter confusedly in a snare of impossible commands, heat up the altar's circuit boards, and perish forever in the showers of sparks that burst forth from the melting wires.{/n}

6ab323f9-8abe-4930-8793-7a2c5c2462e6.Text: {n}Pasqal offers a short binharic prayer, then enters command after command to set up a trap for the machine spirit inhabiting the altar. But the Omnissiah refuses to give His blessing for the killing of His angel, and the Tech-Priest fails to beguile the keen servant of the Machine God.{/n}

f7f46d25-858a-4a9f-baf4-e644f279c543.Text: {n}Using a pried-out switch as a lever, you move the altar's platework aside and rip out a bundle of wires from inside it with one brutal jerk. The maimed machine cannot survive such a desecration.{/n}

4a7c20d0-cd09-4a2e-b0c9-7193fab23fe4.Text: {n}As soon as you touch the altar's inner wirework, the stern machine spirit sends a powerful electric discharge into your fingers. The spirit will have none of this blasphemous violation of the Rite of Operation.{/n}

1a11c3b1-aeb6-4908-8364-6c4a4654aaa4.Text: {n}An alarmed cry is heard from the crowd of heretics. It looks like your tampering with the altar has caught the attention of someone too keen-eyed to be fooled by your disguise.{/n}

0ccf6817-5ec0-4404-a810-83a6a3b51737.Text: {n}A mournful binharic requiem pours forth from Pasqal's vox.{/n}

1b0ab19b-fda0-45e2-82d6-c2f3375845ff.Text: "May we be granted the Omnissiah's forgiveness for this act. I am registering a general shutdown of the security system."

3f561fae-ef37-4a67-ae35-d75490940742.Text: {n}As would any veteran {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Navy}officer of the Imperial Navy{/d}, you discover a fatal vulnerability in the machine's design — exposed connectors under a thin metal plate. You slide your dagger into the crack and cause a short circuit that halts the flow of the Motive Force.{/n}

8ea08046-e8e5-40f2-b54f-4a93a5cff313.Text: [Point to the corpse] "What did you do to him?"

05d5ef8b-1ff0-4536-9184-46d66fbe7736.Text: "Pay no attention. She talks all kinds of nonsense."

23ff6455-df0c-46a7-bef9-51068ae5c551.Text: "Kneel and repent of your heresy before a Rogue Trader, filthy sorcerer, and I might spare your life."

3f3cfd1e-0a48-46ea-ac33-c0dd7e46fb71.Text: "Seneschal, isn't this the chap we're supposed to find for the Lord Inquisitor?"

2c4bfa6c-005a-4c83-a0d0-d5e9eeaf8c1c.Text: "I see you take no end of pleasure in your job. I've barely introduced myself and I'm already being grilled."

e9b2cba7-c0d4-49a5-bdb9-ecfcf8e996c6.Text: "Theodora is dead. Slain in battle by enemies of Humanity."

0c21114e-0662-4a73-9550-b629da8356b2.Text: "Can this conversation wait for a better time? I'm here on the Lord Inquisitor's orders, to see to his acolyte's safe and timely arrival on Footfall."

c2afe490-c5cf-4f4d-90cd-ce9061c588ff.Text: "I am here to collect you. I am under orders from the Lord Inquisitor to offer any assistance you may require, after which I am to provide you safe passage to Footfall aboard my ship."

29b770da-37a5-454d-bf6f-8ca71d2ba726.Text: "I can help you with Aurora. Let's join forces."

1b165219-cd1d-44eb-87a5-72ac3c4a6e22.Text: "This wretched planet's troubles are none of my concern. I'm taking you to the ship. Now."

b43f2f00-98bf-45fb-92b5-53b80d6318c4.Text: "Precisely what were you doing at the monastery?"

a32e9f57-3d3b-48e4-b14a-ef680701ea14.Text: "Idira's predictions are seldom wrong. I will be watching you."

9f05f77a-77e2-43db-a0ce-84baa01f5fce.Text: "Idira is a member of my personal retinue and is under my protection."

67693478-a153-4684-83d1-0dc899c5dbc9.Text: "Von Valancius... To the best of my knowledge, that dynasty is headed by the esteemed Theodora von Valancius. Has there been a change of circumstances?" {n}Heinrix watches your expression closely.{/n}

49b249a4-599f-40eb-a91d-17d30b039008.Text: "I convinced him to cooperate." {n}Heinrix bows his head, cracks his neck, and grimaces.{/n} "I can influence living bodies. And I find that the interrogated are much more eager to share information once the blood starts to boil in their veins."

93c1b214-dd70-466f-b39b-41b72a6cedbd.Text: {n}The tall, dark-haired man sizes you up with a quick glance; a supernatural chill is making the air around him crackle softly. The expensive fabric of his jacket is stitched with gold thread and marked by several reddish brown stains. A force sword and a {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g} hang from his belt, and the emblem of the {g|Encyclopedia:Inquisition}Holy Inquisition{/g} glitters on his chest.{/n}

d2398621-5b76-48f1-9d3c-bd03059f7927.Text: "Yes." {n}The man turns away slightly to clear his throat. The room starts to get noticeably warmer.{/n} "Since you know who I am and are in no hurry to kill me, I infer that you serve the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g}, not His enemies. Allow me to introduce myself — Interrogator Heinrix van Calox of the Imperial Inquisition's esteemed Ordo Xenos. With whom do I have the pleasure of speaking?"

54d44cb7-ab9d-4ca1-a197-1cbea368b2c3.Text: "And in this, we must be like {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Him{/g}." {n}The man nods to you.{/n} "My greetings to you, fellow servant of the Master of Mankind. I am Interrogator Heinrix van Calox of the Imperial Inquisition's esteemed Ordo Xenos. With whom do I have the pleasure of speaking?"

8ec9bb9c-a41a-431d-b105-6b03f9b581b4.Text: "Hm! I dare say it is, Lord Captain. Now if it were possible for the gentleman to properly introduce himself and dispel our doubts—"

66ce624b-1f25-4465-a687-1f8b9a1709be.Text: {n}The man looks over at Abelard and then at you again.{/n} "'Seneschal'? 'Lord Captain'? Do I have the pleasure of speaking to a {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}? Allow me to introduce myself — Interrogator Heinrix van Calox of the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Imperial{/g} Inquisition's esteemed Ordo Xenos. I must confess I'm perplexed to meet someone of your standing in a place like this."

2b9564a4-55e9-44f7-8a70-1920eedc0308.Text: {n}The man smiles acerbically out of the corner of his mouth.{/n} "A {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}... With all due respect, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, my right to sorcerous powers was bestowed upon me by a greater power than yours. Allow me to introduce myself — Interrogator Heinrix van Calox of the Imperial Inquisition's esteemed Ordo Xenos, member of the High Lord Inquisitor's circle and, by His Lordship's grace, sanctioned {g|Encyclopedia:Psyker}psyker{/g} in the service of the Imperium. If this suffices as introduction, permit me respectfully to enquire, what manner of circumstance has brought a Rogue Trader to this monastery, currently overrun by heretics?"

25dfff9a-2478-4704-90e7-484d2c49ffd9.Text: "D-don't you inquisition me! I'm under the Rogue Trader's protection!" {n}Idira looks at you pleadingly.{/n}

f5209b78-794d-40bc-aee9-ef9a5da1c8dd.Text: {n}Heinrix's eyes narrow.{/n} "Your name rings a bell... You're one of the heirs to Rogue Trader Theodora von Valancius, isn't that right?"

812871e0-c838-4a36-9282-7407f422b752.Text: {n}Heinrix pulls back and looks away with visible effort.{/n} "I do admit courteous small talk is not my strong suit. What brings you to the Sanctum of the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}?"

fa44fea7-9b1c-41c3-b34b-5e53e3dac7e3.Text: "The news is lamentable... My condolences. And I presume the heir to the sacred Warrant of Trade and the lofty title of {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} is none other than yourself. Well then... what precisely has brought you to the Sanctum of the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}?"

14fec655-4aef-48a3-9dee-12d86ec9b067.Text: {n}Heinrix ruminates silently on what you have told him. Then he makes a "hmm" of satisfaction and says,{/n} "Then the timing of our meeting is fortuitous. I am requisitioning you and your retinue for my task."

9a0dda96-c9b4-43f4-a8a5-8d7aec339550.Text: "I came to Rykad Minoris on a mission, which a rebellion prevented me from fulfilling. The governor is convinced that malcontents from among the rabble were the instigators, but I immediately suspected a more sinister presence at the root of the mutiny. My visit to the monastery and a few unhurried conversations with some of the rebels—" {n}Heinrix glances at the dead body at his feet.{/n} "—confirmed my suspicions."

06956d5c-1361-431e-a8fe-55727dc9b634.Text: "Someone by the name of Aurora is leading the rebellion. Data indicates that the head of the cultists is here right now, in the sanctum of the ancient reactor. Given the prophecy of the Final Dawn and the especial efforts made by the enemies of Humanity to seize the monastery, their goal is to gain access to the holy power source's control circuit and trigger a process that, once started, cannot be stopped. In other words, to detonate the reactor, thus being themselves the cause of their much-touted 'final dawn.'"

c7f73da2-18d9-444a-8fdb-e433a186c5b6.Text: "Perhaps I haven't made myself sufficiently clear..." {n}Heinrix leans forward a little and looks you dead in the eye.{/n} "In the Lord Inquisitor's absence, it is I who embody the will of the Holy Ordos. The Inquisition is fully intent on thwarting the vile prophecy that threatens doom for an entire planet. And I am not leaving the Rykad System until any such threat is removed."

a26cc491-58b3-4101-abbf-1ca5d1215ebd.Text: "I am positive that not all of the Electro-Priests within these walls have perished; the heretics spoke of shadows emerging from side alleys to make short work of the cultists invading their abode. I surmise that the entrance to their hiding place is somewhere in the hall near a machine known as the 'circular cogitator.' I imagine it's one of the local sacred relics which the Electro-Priests treat with special piety."

a5809621-b273-409f-a039-786d79625363.Text: {n}The Interrogator rests his intent gaze on Idira for another moment before shifting it to you.{/n} "Your retinue, you say? Then let's go back to my previous question. With whom do I have the honour of speaking?"

0d936e32-3280-4bd1-816a-626431fdf304.Text: {n}The Interrogator rests his intent gaze on Idira for another moment before shifting it to you.{/n} "I'm afraid paying attention to such things is my express duty. But let's leave that aside for now and return to the issue at hand. With whom do I have the honour of speaking?"

2c54e3ea-839a-409b-9ec6-8d793cf96625.Text: {n}The Interrogator chuckles.{/n} "And I will be watching you. Now that we have declared our intent, let me ask again: who are you?"

70d713c6-ba48-4b5f-843f-46010503caed.Text: "Requisitioning!" {n}Abelard is left speechless for a moment.{/n} "Young man, your choice of words is unseemly to the point of insult — you are addressing a Rogue Trader!"

0013fa1a-83e8-4749-b2ea-16c7270c182c.Text: {n}Heinrix casts an apprehensive glance at Abelard.{/n} "I don't imagine you'll be any happier if I say 'taking into Inquisitorial custody.'"

7db6c4c8-2c58-4980-ab5f-f86c77609764.Text: "To aid His faithful servant in the fight against corruption is the solemn duty of all whose actions affect millions of the Imperium's subjects. 'Let your example guide those who will carry the Emperor's light across a thousand stars.'"

9289e441-38f9-4931-903f-98909c879e32.Text: "You are familiar with the works of Inquisitor Alastar the Redeemer? Not every acolyte can say the same, let alone... people less initiated." {n}Heinrix arches an eyebrow, examining the coat of arms on Cassia's clothes.{/n} "Please forgive my lapse in manners, Lady Navigator Orsellio. It is a great honour."

29a1051d-dd4f-4ea8-b3fb-ac3f38ceb93d.Text: {n}As Heinrix van Calox speaks, you suddenly notice the way he is looking at you — with his eyes slightly narrowed, as if he is peering into your soul... a soul that is touched by the gift of sorcery. The change in your expression does not escape the Interrogator's notice, and you see the corner of his mouth twitch. He must have instantly recognised a {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Psyker}fellow psyker{/d}.{/n}

5828a56d-4fdc-412c-8d4d-3aa7a74ff501.Text: {n}You try to focus on the man in front of you, but you cannot shake the image of the {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Torture}deadly torture{/d} he inflicted on his victim. Your pulse quickens, blood pounding in your ears and sweat beading on your skin.{/n}

5a5b086b-8a21-42d3-93ff-721e7240c995.Text: "Starting with her." {n}Heinrix nods at Kibellah.{/n} "You have provided exactly the kind of specialist that this situation requires."

a76a788e-fb21-4473-8b2b-c21ba96edb94.Text: {n}Kibellah regards him coldly.{/n} "I am the Domin's shadow. If {mf|he|she} says the word, I will protect you. If {mf|he|she} says the word, I will take you to the Undying One."

0944887a-db91-4b4b-a3dd-d6e102a15f96.Text: "I arrived here with an escort squad, only to lose it in our very first open skirmish; the monastery is swarming with heretics. The soldiers I requisitioned from the governor fell in battle, bled to death, or deserted. I had to make do with catching and forcefully interrogating individual rebels. It is from them that I learned what I relayed to you just now."

7d4758d1-b3bf-4874-a60a-ed47a5a300fb.Text: {n}Idira recoils from the Interrogator as if scalded, and starts swaying to and fro.{/n} "Sh-shadow! A great big sun-eclipsing chain-weaving shadow! I can see the threads, myriads of them extending toward us all, and all of them creeping off toward him like snakes, shrouding us in poison. My oh my, do I sense trouble, and it's right in my throat! It itches!" {n}A puff of black smoke comes out of the {g|Encyclopedia:Psyker}psyker{/g}'s mouth and dissipates at once.{/n}

caf460db-bfb5-4d57-8e3c-c0ab4e46ac30.Text: "Thank you. Regrettably, the governor's people showed themselves to be unprepared for the perils of this place." {n}The Interrogator glances at the limp body clad in the colours of the governor's wardens, and sighs briefly.{/n} "And extracting blade shards from a person's stomach is beyond my powers. I hope that a Rogue Trader's retinue will prove more capable than a group of soldiers fresh off the base."

f955cf58-6ebd-42c7-942c-56a356927ae1.Text: "Blasphemous insanity." {n}The {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priest{/g}'s visor flashes and turns a bloody scarlet. A soft hum of some activating systems is heard from under his robe.{/n}

c131e3ba-3170-4595-8077-81a37df6aa00.Text: {n}Heinrix eyes Idira keenly.{/n} "A psyker. Interesting. And a diviner, at that. Even more interesting. Are you sanctioned?"

eb1d010b-c3bc-4b3e-9cfe-ea6ee8c171a0.Text: {n}He casts a repulsed glance at the {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_CultistClothes}heretical garb{/d} you are wearing and comments softly,{/n} "I would also advise against this type of disguise. Haven't you ever heard the adage 'the mask becomes the face'?"

31bc8330-14bb-43c4-b9c0-4f8ae0cb9216.Text: {n}The Interrogator takes a gloomy look at the {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_CultistClothes}heretics' tatters{/d} you are wearing and says, with clear reluctance,{/n} "I suppose I must put on a disguise or else I will stick out like a sore thumb. Luckily, I have— I had... a prisoner."

57b088cb-4f54-4df5-8edf-1ee0b26496c0.Text: The wraithbone handguard of a sword crafted by Aeldari weaponsmiths. Its pommel is adorned with a sinister eye that reeks of corruption.

9bf8cda9-f958-4fab-81f1-d395cc72bbb7.Text: A glass prism crafted by the cultists of the Final Dawn. It belonged to their leader, Aurora. If you look through it long enough, your vision begins to deceive your mind, showing what could be instead of what is.

ee5ce398-8f8b-4cad-a93d-89f0df2b10af.Text: [Lean uncomfortably close to the cultist] "Are you sure you want to remember my face? Curious people like you rarely live long. And their short lives are often very sad."

2f9a9fb0-5e89-473f-a446-daf84217790b.Text: [Smile mysteriously] "Perhaps the Master has blinded your eyes to trifles so that you may behold what is true?"

47aec2c5-d670-4a43-8b41-671e3e350017.Text: [Flash a menacing gaze] "I don't know you either, you know. What's with all the questions? Are you the governor's spy?"

b2687d83-1c71-4ade-9ec2-d771307dfcbb.Text: [Throw up your hands sheepishly] "I'm new. Was sent here to slaughter unbelievers, and I've only just finished."

3e19652f-db5f-4d62-9351-3f99c3fcc192.Text: [Slap the impudent man] "Who am I? I am the Rogue Trader of House von Valancius!"

1a2f3f41-4aac-4c88-9472-564277a3dc38.Text: [Bash the cultist's brains out] "You are so observant. Here is your prize."

a0bd1963-e061-4b9f-9c79-4cc8b789d0d6.Text: [Think on your feet] "You do not know me? But the probability of you knowing every member of our fellowship is statistically negligible. If we analyse and derive an objective probability value..."

d739f8d8-0bb8-42ec-8c7f-d9230aeb52d1.Text: {n}A grim-looking heretic walks up to you resolutely, blocking your path. As he studies your {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_CultistClothes}disguise{/d} with suspicion, you note that his left eye has two conjoined irises while his right eye has four.{/n} "I don't know you. Who are you, and why haven't I met you before?"

dce05e12-6e2b-47fe-be3e-cf173f7919c9.Text: "Enough beating about the bush. I know a filthy dog of the governor when I see one, no matter what rags they wear. To battle, brothers and sisters! For Aurora and the Final Dawn!"

46ef6acb-9eac-4964-b1b0-b0654660f55e.Text: {n}Stunned by your response, Idira bursts out giggling — more out of surprise than mirth.{/n}

df3f345c-8d3b-4cab-8772-864ec64486bd.Text: {n}Heinrix lets out a quiet groan of frustration.{/n} "We sullied ourselves with these rags for nothing..."

4c01b011-8a0e-4d2a-bf8d-1a56fed51eb3.Text: {n}Your reply, imbued with mystical significance, was evidently to the cultist's liking. He smiles haughtily and says,{/n} "May our Master blind you too, {mf|broth|sist}er."

bc647aec-60fa-4bea-a1de-2db89fde628c.Text: {n}The heretic continues glaring at you with suspicion.{/n} "What kind of nonsense is that?"

d68d89d2-5778-4b6e-87d9-21ed331d50ed.Text: {n}The cultist is taken aback, and staggers backward a little. Fear flashes in his mutated eyes.{/n} "Ah, to the abyss with you! Go on your merry way, {mf|broth|sist}er."

376a0a86-94c6-4744-a1dd-a6cf2c28fe77.Text: "A spy? Me? Everyone saw me killing the false believers. But where were you while I was doing that?"

4947264e-a821-4aba-845c-72f47e486cf0.Text: {n}The cultist smiles bloodthirstily.{/n} "Ah. You're new. That's right. Every newcomer must slit a false believer's throat to prove their loyalty to the Edge of Daybreak. Did you enjoy it at all? You don't have to answer. I can see you did. Go ahead, {mf|broth|sist}er."

4b1bf991-6642-45ee-9d34-20532755b34c.Text: "New? I didn't have you pegged as a snotty rookie. Bit too confident, the way you hold that weapon."

52b5e391-54e7-41f3-86fe-66a81575fa73.Text: {n}The cultist stares at you in disbelief, holding his cheek. Crestfallen, he gives his fellows a sideways glance with his eerie eyes and mutters dazedly,{/n} "Kill h{mf|im|er}."

9bf06d92-c610-4c1a-981b-020420f64d75.Text: {n}The cultist's eerie eyes fly out of their sockets and land on the floor with a wet squelch. The heretics stare silently at their fallen comrade, stupefied. Then they charge at you.{/n}

a212fc99-a7cd-4173-a84a-88fbf6dc234c.Text: {n}The cultist squints warily and lays a hand on his weapon.{/n} "There's something off about you."

f401d08d-a0fe-4e8c-986b-49bcd3677f7f.Text: {n}Something — either your meaningful tone or the forbidding look in your eyes — causes the cultist to react the same way as the {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Criminal}hundreds of other pawns you have intimidated{/d}. He lowers his head and backs off like the coward he is.{/n}

89890634-e027-4571-9658-27fcc0c8245e.Text: {n}The cultist's strange eyes glaze over at the wealth of terms that are clearly unfamiliar and {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_MOT_Mind}incomprehensible{/d} to him. He hastily waves you off.{/n} "A clever one, aren't you... Go, go and bother someone else with your sadistics..."

7198f3d3-5618-4563-bed9-cc4e4b65441e.Text: "Dahr-Impulse VI... It was to you, was it not, that Logis Abel came seeking an interpretation of his datatrance?"

d0b8a14a-1256-48de-a66e-b5c4880a09c5.Text: "You are not like other members of the Adeptus Mechanicus I have met."

15d636bb-5191-4864-829e-8d2045329f99.Text: [Make the sign of the Aquila] "The Emperor protects."

61eac1a9-1dfd-42c2-96ff-769e0cefd68a.Text: "In the monastery, I was attacked by people who looked like Electro-Priests."

fb1443da-4d52-4b35-831e-5c2b7c1caa00.Text: "I wish to get to the holy reactor."

565bb15a-5fd5-4d82-8a3b-891a41c4d12b.Text: "My enforcers and the governor's guards can help you reclaim the monastery."

dd7a3468-edae-4837-8284-2ecabb94cae2.Text: "You made the right decision when you chose to avoid combat and save yourselves."

1ff90a84-0780-4501-bfdf-29f305c5efa9.Text: "A true person of faith would never have hidden and let the enemy take over their temple."

eb73a2ef-ff90-40be-b99c-6af681498dd6.Text: [Scoff] "I was under no misconception that anything resembling a fighting spirit could be expected from humble priests."

37b43396-991d-48dd-b281-4b722382a98f.Text: "I have rescued him from the insurgents."

7210e5cd-1183-488d-8b90-af36d0719c47.Text: "I, Rogue Trader {name} von Valancius, declare this monastery to be under my protection."

4f58a281-774b-45fa-8fcb-cce4fc57a7ea.Text: Convinced the Praetor of the Electrodynamic Cenobium to render aid to the priests.

2e89a50f-ddb5-4aa3-af9c-f15cbcc9d8a8.Text: "The time has come to prove your loyalty to the Omnissiah, Praetor. In the name of the God of Humanity, strengthen my numbers with the faithful eager to fulfil their duty, so that they help me punish the blasphemers."

9bdb5cb1-47ef-41ce-b461-41f12fd43422.Text: "We serve the same holy being, the same many-faced divine revelation. I greet you."

cb3823b7-045e-43ca-8a4c-32711aafafcc.Text: "Why are you calling me a pilgrim?"

6f09d8a3-b0ef-4046-a875-ca12f1afda38.Text: "What happened here and how did you manage to survive?"

b1096355-1b77-4a72-9698-dfd404381b9e.Text: "I have a few questions about this place and the people in it."

40db98a5-ffc1-4de0-9208-1d1628e2eff3.Text: "What kinds of visions was he receiving?"

18a9d268-3ebd-4e13-ac1e-2fabe28c335c.Text: {n}A shortish, muscular man wearing the scarlet colours of the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMechanicus}Priesthood of Mars{/g} steps into your path. The wrinkles on his cheeks and forehead point to his propensity for frequent outbursts of fierce anger, but right now, he is showing no signs of aggression. Glowing blue patterns of electric tattoos, or electoos, show through his oddly bluish-tinted skin.{/n}

a601e880-10b2-4889-b534-df4a45815954.Text: {n}Pasqal keeps his solemn silence, but the quick clicking of his {g|Encyclopedia:Mechadendrite}mechadendrite{/g}'s claw betrays his excitement at being so close to the sacred {g|Encyclopedia:Archeotech}archeotech{/g}.{/n}

8059df25-a557-4709-b417-1fcf9003f14a.Text: "It would be pointless to describe the Miraculous Fusion Reactor. Only through beholding its ferocious power can one comprehend its blessed essence, and fear the might of the Omnissiah. Its core was found four thousand years ago and delivered to Rykad Minoris by the holy warrior of faith Locke-Impulse I during one of his campaigns. Its sacred spark has not gone out for an instant, and the walls and power units of this cenobium have been erected around the relic in order to protect it from ignorant laypeople, as well as protect them from its formidable might."

8b096182-3228-48c0-8bcc-d4d67ea92dc5.Text: "Confirmed. The presence of laypeople on monastery grounds without the Praetor Electroid's blessing will be regarded as a sacrilegious violation of the holy Rite of Operation."

77c9097c-2b70-449d-9ac9-1032886e6360.Text: "When the heretics descended in droves upon this cenobium, we gave battle. But the unholy foes buried the Omnissiah's warriors under a mass of their bodies, thus extinguishing the defenders' sparks of purity. It was then that I ordered my few surviving brethren to retreat into the monastery's secret chambers. Upon taking refuge there, we began to destroy the blasphemous intruders in surreptitious ways. Alas, as fiery as my brethren's anger was, I had no right to permit them to die in honest combat, for the task of taking back our abode still lay ahead for us."

df4293b9-46f0-4993-99a3-e3df344356f5.Text: "Stop, pilgrim. You have no enemies here, for the corruption of heresy has not touched our fraternity."

89ff60e0-fe95-4277-a74e-16f4ed0a7d95.Text: {n}The man responds curtly, as if giving a military command:{/n} "The Omnissiah knows all, comprehends all."

4a626f54-3a7b-46f8-8cde-700956b3da81.Text: "I hope the Omnissiah preserves Tech-Brother Abel's life, that he may continue to comprehend the mysteries he has tapped into."

09fbe736-7e44-4a60-883d-b66980aaa1c1.Text: "The Hallowed Electrodynamic Cenobium receives you, pilgrim. I am Dahr-Impulse VI, a servant of the Motive Force and the Praetor Electroid of this sacred monastery."

02c44094-fde2-4404-a1a0-8352a98de278.Text: "Sad news indeed. Tech-Brother Abel was chosen by the Omnissiah to be a comprehender of great mysteries. May his spirit's Motive Force come into being anew in the fount of the Miraculous Fusion Reactor."

b6aa7129-f628-43b8-b096-2d5f943fdf7d.Text: "I cannot allow this. Laypeople are forbidden from visiting the monastery, and only a select few are allowed to behold the ark and the relic within. You and your retinue are pilgrims of a special status bestowed by the Emperor. However, should any soldier unblessed by the Omnissiah cross this monastery's threshold, I will deem them a heretic and have them put to death."

503c90b3-f281-4a5f-8dc0-e4ec7dd473ce.Text: "The hard-working servants and dwellers of this cenobium. Electro-Priests of the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMechanicus}Adeptus Mechanicus{/g}. The Corpuscarii did us a great honour by entrusting into our care the sacred relic around which the Hallowed Electrodynamic Cenobium was built."

fc5c0f40-5577-4190-9bd0-ec9c8ddc6e01.Text: "We have devoted ourselves to the worship of that aspect of the Machine God which is known as the Motive Force. It is the blessed divine spark that creates impetus in the universe. The Omnissiah, in his mercy, gave the world the gift of the Motive Force, and we follow its impulses in order to increase it, bring it to laypeople, and protect it from unholy hands."

0eeb5ac9-5b78-4e54-9fd6-39a5f11014fb.Text: "Thank you, pilgrim. It was not easy, watching unholy intruders stampede through the chambers of my temple. We all envied our brethren who had fallen before that sacrilege began."

7146d93b-b927-4bfb-a76c-f32cb1790a2d.Text: {n}The Praetor Electroid's face becomes stonelike.{/n} "My body is brimming with the fury of the Motive Force that wants to be unleashed upon the heretics who have dared to desecrate my temple. But this is pride, and it is incompatible with my rank and my duties."

e595e546-29c4-4df8-a36a-6307d11dcc5d.Text: {n}The Praetor Electroid, too, falls sorrowfully silent.{/n}

b61a05ff-660c-46b4-8047-79622ba6f8f1.Text: "The relic that this monastery protects provides the entire planet of Rykad Minoris with the blessed Motive Force, and we, unworthy though we are, are glad to serve the ancient machine that dwells in this place."

1cb674cf-43eb-484e-accd-3bb1660b18da.Text: "'The Omnissiah's Tears' is what we call this phenomenon, this dying away of unworthy flesh. As we shun the layperson's primitive means of looking at the world, we gain the ability to sense the Motive Force around us with our entire bodies."

9539ab8d-a6b4-43a2-b4a0-2088ebe4f63c.Text: "That is a lamentable mistake. We knew of no help that was on its way, and were not expecting to encounter any allies in the monastery's chambers. But I see that you are alive, and I mourn the senseless deaths of my brethren."

a3b8d88b-38e0-41d0-8982-e9c283bca934.Text: {n}Heinrix opens his mouth for a second to say something, but changes his mind and quietly clears his throat instead.{/n}

6c7d295b-e282-442b-adb8-bb8cc71a1c11.Text: "The ark is hidden from pilgrims' eyes. But considering the extraordinary circumstances of your visit to this monastery, I grant you that right. The hall that leads to the high reliquary has been barred by the enemy, but I will open a secret path for you. Enter the ark and experience the Motive Force, pilgrim. We will pray to the security systems that they may refrain from punishing you for your intrusion."

e2148e91-e527-4e45-930c-e744938b6750.Text: "Sure, better to die protecting their lumens and coils than to accept help from 'unworthies'! And we're left to deal with the mess as usual..."

276f7ada-25a6-42ab-a868-bb08d34af264.Text: {n}A tight bandage covers the man's eyes, yet he turns his face straight toward you with no hesitation. He has a sharp, screeching voice not unlike a bird's cawing:{/n} "May the charge of the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}'s mercy persist in the hands of the faithful."

e41c072d-5642-4d6d-b5ea-759a4776b995.Text: "Only those laypeople who desire to experience the Motive Force are allowed to cross this monastery's threshold. All others are profaners and criminals. You do not belong to the fraternity of Electro-Priests, but your intentions are good. If you were not seeking the Omnissiah's wisdom, then it was the Motive Force itself that brought you here to find it."

2d95f465-9afc-48a7-94fe-96a8bc97d353.Text: "May the charge of the Omnissiah's grace persist in the batteries of the faithful!"

3235494d-72d1-4512-97bd-f530169238f6.Text: "His mind has always been able to combine facts and conclusions into harmonious wholes that were nothing short of beautiful. Many among my flock found his sermons poetic."

e4d7b51b-98ba-4ec4-a076-810e64201f79.Text: "Truth is like light, and blocking its path is criminal." {n}The Praetor Electroid nods majestically.{/n}

295cac5f-3c4b-42ff-8836-3d51090587f8.Text: "Our faith imposes a duty of obedience on us. Every Electro-Priest is given numerous electoos that combine in a blessed voltagheist circuit, allowing feeble flesh to withstand the might of the Motive Force. That is why our skin glows with its light, and our eyes boil and melt when we are ordained."

5ef4b4ee-1bbd-46f5-8d93-bd67dbaf9844.Text: {n}The Praetor stays silent for a long time. Finally, he lets out a deep sigh.{/n} "Thank you, pilgrim, for reminding me of our duty to Humanity. I will send the Cenobium's warriors to your aid if that is what His warriors want me to do."

3954ab39-4599-48d0-85f7-b970e876ce17.Text: {n}Cassia nods thoughtfully.{/n} "Yes, I see... House Orsellio follows the same rules when it comes to outsiders."

0792e676-2610-4897-a57c-2cb1f0f8645e.Text: "I am pleased to be the conductor of truth."

6fc2a296-0ee3-43ac-be5e-d11aabdf3a04.Text: "I must commend the skill with which your secret chambers are concealed." {n}You hear a tinge of wounded pride in Heinrix's words, as if he is upset about failing to discover the Electro-Priests' shelter.{/n} "Your choice of tactics was wise as well. There was no point in losing more lives in the massacre that the cultists wrought."

38ad5734-dbe7-4462-9f0e-1a3e7631127b.Text: "You have the honour of hosting the Rogue Trader of House von Valancius. I urge you to follow proper etiquette when interacting with the eminent bearer of the sacred Warrant."

8f4a770c-df05-49da-86d8-38b0065e35e2.Text: "Within these walls, worldly titles are nothing before the Motive Force. Your deeds, however, speak far louder than titles, for your path here is sprayed with the blood of desecrators."

d45e083e-7f2c-4b27-a427-560dca95ca27.Text: "I wonder if you would have so touchingly mourned the Lord Captain's death or if such sentiments would have only been awoken by the sound of our voidship delivering a punitive strike from orbit."

3829f0fd-fe28-4306-92f3-708429fae0cb.Text: {n}The man offers you a deep bow, respectful of the words spoken by a {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Ministorum}former Adeptus Ministorum servant{/d}.{/n} "May the Motive Force in your righteous limbs never fail in His holy service. I greet you in kind, {mf|brother|sister}."

06afc566-bcf6-4427-bbec-2bd47581161e.Text: {n}The Praetor Electroid looks at Kibellah and gives a dignified nod.{/n} "You have brought an assassin. Good. She will find much work here. Are you ready for new toils, blessed slayer?"

611cb4ea-f536-4240-adcd-103593938762.Text: "Always. Can it be any other way?"

695e6827-ef4a-46fc-b196-a62fd055b324.Text: "May the Motive Force persist in their batteries."

f98c009b-5864-4f45-b42c-87b013125361.Text: {n}The man bows his head.{/n} "The Motive Force brought you here at the right time, pilgrim."

071b401b-f6aa-4e87-8dc3-7fae53cdb020.Text: {n}Pasqal bows down humbly before the man. A trill of binharic signals comes from his {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g}, to which the Praetor responds with a solemn gesture of blessing. Pasqal turns to you and says,{/n} "The rank of Praetor Electroid is a sign of high standing within the Electro-Priest fraternity. To have been granted an audience is a great honour."

67591715-aa1c-4aae-ad4e-dbe498652c34.Text: "Yes. Tech-Brother Abel arrived here to engage in a magnetic meditation that would help clarify his visions. Unfortunately, the heretics' machinations prevented us from completing the ritual. The esteemed Logis volunteered his help in defending the monastery, but contact with him was lost soon afterward."

d68bd144-af92-45ee-8f23-283a7999ef20.Text: "This holy place will be protected against sacrilegious practices. I swear it."

87bd8ed2-0b9f-46a2-841b-9efe7cdf2d28.Text: "We did not speak much to each other. He preferred to devote his time to solitary reflections in his chapel. The Omnissiah has given Tech-Brother Abel a gift of great insight, which allows him to discern each individual facet of existence rather than the overall view. This makes his logic different from that of other people."

fe5b17da-ab93-4b27-962d-66c816b543e1.Text: "The leader of the heretics fought her way into the ark wherein dwells the Miraculous Fusion Reactor. She is trying to desecrate the Rite of Operation with her unholy litanies so that the relic may be corrupted and the world of Rykad Minoris may perish in a fount of fire. But my brethren, in their magnetic meditation, are hampering her efforts by chanting access request prayers in unison, thereby suppressing the commands that the blasphemers enter." {n}The Praetor Electroid nods toward his entranced comrades.{/n}

f473d1f4-9b33-402e-a729-cd42286a10d7.Text: "The Omnissiah's revelation was encrypted with great meticulousness, which indicates its great importance. Grasping it fully is beyond my ability, but a single touch was enough for me to realise the enormity of the secret concealed within. Or, more exactly, the Secret Design, which was how Tech-Brother Abel referred to it. His mind had discerned in the world around him traces of some grand silence that he wished to comprehend."

0505bbde-6802-40fc-b917-d66307fbce93.Text: "...the twin poles of opposite signs that herald the motion of the current."

680e0dea-0e85-49a8-ac28-24293c6dfef6.Text: "...the Motive Force that floweth through veins of copper."

0754a377-8ac3-4761-8375-bb6728416b7f.Text: "...the Omnissiah, from whom the holy discharge springeth forth."

936f1510-fb8b-4493-9e31-f011484a0155.Text: "...the blessed Cathode that beckoneth the timeless electron."

ce522210-1967-4c87-86e8-4b8d5fabeed4.Text: "...the mighty Reactor that performeth the sacrament of fusion."

628e1f82-af47-4029-9d53-c33187344f2f.Text: "...the Closed Circuit, wherein the path's start and end are tied in a knot."

79509e7c-730c-438e-8633-04a4f64a60d8.Text: "...the Memory of ages that is preserved most zealously."

5efab13a-ce6c-45cc-b734-ea4de2774020.Text: "...the faultless Soul that the current washeth over."

8991982b-3277-4158-bf48-ce5c13a5b499.Text: "...the mortal Body and the mechanisms thereof."

f077bb3c-252e-47d1-afe5-597b3d0fa139.Text: "...the immortal Reason that hath created the spark."

341b68b0-9e95-4233-86c3-601b933f75b0.Text: "Pasqal, kindly remind me how this hymn goes."

1b6f6be1-6097-48bc-a08a-239699a5cb45.Text: "...the splendid resistors that conceal within them the rite of transfiguration."

28c7ff21-b967-4b25-9291-7b672b00e123.Text: "...the watchful breakers that protect us from the sacrilege of the short circuit."

fdffa7b2-65d4-42ce-88f7-321295b7fa83.Text: "...the hallowed contacts whose touch conducteth the current."

fdd17aee-91af-45bd-9024-39aa16b4bdd8.Text: "...the arcane key that closeth the circuit."

f2afdd48-f454-462f-8bff-2aeda54db89a.Text: {n}The cogitator's green screen lights up as you approach it, and displays the flashing message,{/n} "Pilgrim, only the words of the First Galvanic Hymn will reveal to you the gifts hidden behind the veil of knowledge. Now chant with me: 'Let us sing this canticle to...'" {n}The device's keyboard lights up, clearly expecting you to enter the rest of the verse.{/n}

04572ca5-da95-4e85-9802-96b249ca77eb.Text: {n}Pasqal's vox lets out a noisy groan as if he is clearing his throat, but then stops abruptly. After a brief pause, he averts his gaze and says in a rasping voice,{/n} "It is not known to me. Only high-ranking servants at shrines of energetic prosperity are permitted to perform the First Galvanic Hymn."

ef976948-a978-4cff-a5a6-81a5aa4ec740.Text: {n}Abelard snorts and struggles to suppress an involuntary smile.{/n} "Emperor help us all. The esteemed Magos has been caught out not knowing a prayer, and now he's floundering like a cadet in an exam. I never thought I'd see the day."

7d880918-7ab0-46d4-bbc0-21d0160e3c27.Text: "Now finish this prayer, pilgrim: 'May the unity of the sacred charges power...'"

7dee6d32-0a89-409a-95cd-ff60324c395a.Text: "Verse two calls to you, pilgrim: 'Let us fill our souls with gratitude toward—'"

aaf51953-0c9b-4a24-a482-060180a007b6.Text: {n}A solemn binharic trill comes from the cogitator.{/n} "Verily so! A pilgrim who has learned our ways is worthy of the gifts of the enlightened."

6d811e49-d453-4805-b3ec-b996c7a24b37.Text: "Only one who has learned the path of our Cenobium is worthy of its gifts. Walk the path of the enlightened, absorb their age-old wisdom, and sing with me again." {n}The screen goes dark in disappointment.{/n}

52e1985f-d9cd-4490-bfca-0641a007ac7c.Text: Donned the heretics' clothing out of curiosity.

02278170-47d0-4e8b-bd46-b5fa4b29aab2.Text: [Laugh] "I'm actually curious to know what it's like to walk in a heretic's shoes."

93d8dda2-4710-4b94-adb0-4b7a8ee1ca7c.Text: "What is the essence of your plan?"

81c9f049-1e42-4739-a5f0-4568d200555d.Text: "We must save the esteemed Tech-Priest without risking his life."

59dfd381-e232-4355-9830-e446ca31e8a3.Text: Refused to don the heretics' clothing.

61a5c46f-34a2-4d0d-a9fc-e450187c80dc.Text: "I will not allow corruption to touch you. We will vest ourselves in faith and kill every last traitor to the Golden Throne."

fd84f029-3c5f-4cdb-ba8c-bb04e6247ba1.Text: "Are you suggesting we pass on the chance to kill them all with our own hands? Forget it. I'm not missing out on the fun!"

1f1d7c03-642c-426b-b51f-4c019719f686.Text: Donned the heretics' clothing to save the Tech-Priest.

64bceee7-b957-4628-a09d-b4ca47a23868.Text: "If it helps to save a worthy man, I will put on the cultist's robes."

1d9ff4b6-de1a-4d09-b06c-6ea03864d2d9.Text: "You do realise this plan sounds like suicide?"

74461177-1a21-4a11-8394-7e56508e2c19.Text: "You would disgrace yourself by donning these tainted rags?"

403b3a9c-b1da-48fa-8b3b-dbfbb71d5149.Text: {n}A crowd of cultists has surrounded a {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priest{/g} crucified upon a mechanism. A rhythmic whisper repeated by a hundred voices blends into some blasphemous enchantment. Powerful discharges of the Motive Force run through the machine, causing the unfortunate prisoner's body to convulse brutally and forcing woeful cries of pain from his lips.{/n}

8706c867-2d3c-4c06-b98a-72fa34852fb3.Text: {n}The Tech-Priest's hoarse voice echoes under the ceiling:{/n} "In the clenched claws of stagnation — in the shackles of Iteration Zero — under the iron wing — let — the Cycle — be discontinued!"

be55d20f-5703-4fa1-8816-04042be36df8.Text: {n}Pasqal's {g|Encyclopedia:Mechadendrite}mechadendrites{/g} spring into combat mode instantly, and a wrathful rattle comes from his {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g},{/n} "I am registering a severe violation of the purity protocol! The blessed Amarnat has been captured by heretics and is being tortured!"

79df4aac-dc4a-4551-9b71-f9307df39fb0.Text: "The safety system protecting the hall is controlled from the machine altar, which must be disabled. If all these operations are performed, I can guarantee that not a single blasphemer will survive the Omnissiah's wrath that will be unleashed upon this place."

5c964981-992e-4fde-a12b-127baa9b422d.Text: "Confirmed. I do not observe his face, but I recognise his words. 'Let the Cycle be discontinued' is the blessed Amarnat's motto."

cf42e434-4070-4d63-929b-d598c2159a8b.Text: {n}The heretics have taken up positions everywhere, and many more are doubtlessly hiding in the passages leading out of the hall. For now, they are all focused on the sacrilegious torture of the Tech-Priest and do not notice you.{/n}

4fbf9c33-f1ec-4da2-91fe-411719ed46eb.Text: {n}The mechadendrite points to the corpses of heretics lying nearby.{/n} "We can use the blasphemers' clothing as a disguise. Unrecognised, we can sabotage the power units, overloading them and thus cleansing the hall of heretics."

151c524e-2e1b-4b32-b4c0-3a1e57babfb8.Text: "My analysis of the situation indicates the overwhelming numerical superiority of the enemy. In an open confrontation, the blessed Amarnat may be randomly or deliberately harmed by fire. I have an alternative proposal to direct engagement."

8f350103-1f6b-4c3a-879a-cb5c5b93ff7a.Text: {n}The lightning discharges have charred the cultists' corpses. Whiffs of smoke rise from their empty eye sockets, whose contents have evaporated. Their clothes, covered in the blood of innocents, are crudely painted over with emblems of the {g|Encyclopedia:Chaos}Archenemy{/g}, which exude a repulsive air of soul decay.{/n}

609cb91d-f24e-438c-a05d-50641e075cf0.Text: "So be it. May the Omnissiah protect the blessed Amarnat in the coming battle. Death to the blasphemers!"

9ded10bc-d1e9-4c63-ac81-e81104489846.Text: "I pray that the Omnissiah gives the blessed Amarnat enough fortitude." {n}Pasqal grimaces as a new wail of pain rends the air.{/n}

cc354c1f-c0ea-4e39-b75b-69e9e051c26d.Text: "A devotee of the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g} is capable of withstanding great bodily torment with no loss of functionality. But where flesh reinforced with sacred iron will persevere, the purity of spirit may perish."

609a4fc3-6246-4c65-96f5-96754481d568.Text: {n}The heretic's garb clings to your skin like a greedy leech. Tingling and foul fever spread over your body, as though these tatters have imbibed the vile contents of their former wearer's soul.{/n}

27545a87-51b4-463b-9956-f376340b32a6.Text: {n}Pasqal deadpans,{/n} "The only unbearable disgrace is that of a duty unfulfilled. The rest is merely spiritual attrition."

ee16455b-92a8-42d2-afad-1bd914baa069.Text: {n}With a look of revulsion, Kibellah picks up one of the rags with the tip of her blade.{/n} "Nothing but your word, Domin'{name}, can make me don this filth. Once we are done, I will scrape my skin clean with a metal brush and bathe it in caustic lye."

b858d309-2778-4809-b0cf-bfbeaaea9d22.Text: "I hypothesise that the heretics have made the blessed Amarnat a participant in some variety of sacrilegious ritual. Through sacrilegious torture, they are trying to break his will and turn him into an unholy terminal with which to control the reactor's outer power circuit system."

b672f8f0-fca1-44f5-bf6c-3e2d1f88c374.Text: "Uttering a Litany of Actuation for the power units from the lumenodeacon's command throne will direct the Motive Force created by the blessed reactor into the hall. The {g|Encyclopedia:Servitor}distribution servitor{/g} is keeping its output within the set parameters, but upon receiving an order to increase it to peak values, it will turn this place into an electric trap."

3fee4bad-b912-41b8-8ad8-fd3fd713aa6e.Text: "I shudder with disgust at the mere thought of having to touch clothing adorned with unholy symbols, let alone wear it! This is the first step toward falling, a small compromise with evil that will lead to something greater. Is there truly no other way, Rogue Trader?"

0dc99057-f9cb-48c7-91db-c9f57d94460f.Text: "The signs of the Archenemy are not just painted symbols, but conductors of its will. The words of their prayers, even spoken without faith, their coats of arms, even deceitfully worn — all this increases the presence of the Ruinous Powers near you and draws their corrupting attention to you."

46ef25ae-29a0-4d97-b61c-47fbc8de3aac.Text: {n}Cassia stares in horror at the corrupted clothes and the scattered human ashes.{/n} "D-do not make me..."

776baf97-66c6-4f3a-bd01-5e8bbdaad64d.Text: "The Tech-Priest's colours are stained with grime. They are diluted. Painted over with rot... And yet his heart still holds a cinder of bright red. This dying flame... can be ignited anew."

31d82bdb-b6e7-46a4-8eb2-2f1b63c69f32.Text: {n}A sound similar to a laugh escapes Pasqal's vox.{/n} "This statement is true. Then what do you propose? To flee? I have tried to employ this behavioural strategy in the past, and it brought my soul no relief."

7d21dbb9-5fe3-4c5f-82fb-9b0bf8419db2.Text: "You are an Explorator, aren't you? What are you doing here?"

af8e4969-37c4-43e3-8675-91ede48357cc.Text: "Permission to transfer information granted. What do you wish to tell me?"

8519fa3f-cfff-4db8-b26b-c8b89abe221f.Text: "What is the Cognisance Fleet doing in the Rykad System?"

0407d74b-bd04-4fa9-8e7f-ca46c0323083.Text: "Show me your arsenal. I accept the commercial transaction."

64f64574-247d-45af-98c7-1a8a67637f03.Text: "The governor is carrying out his immediate duties. I do not intend to interfere."

7086b3a0-91dc-4a58-8df5-475c4b0758b4.Text: "Do you know anything about the Tech-Priest Abel Haneumann?"

a2027fc1-87b4-4abb-9ff7-bf9720788af9.Text: "What will I get in return for my help?"

80c3ae5e-7301-4892-833d-0a5a50a6c526.Text: "I will discuss it with the governor."

a5a6b5c3-29b4-4b0f-9fc3-a00ff09d3638.Text: {n}The painfully thin Tech-Priest turns sharply toward you. The sudden movement makes his chromed augmetics briefly clang. His grey eyes, set under furrowed brows, almost blend into the pale skin of his face, and he levels you with a heavy, dour stare.{/n}

7fd3c271-a5e3-4a0e-97c1-44219271f078.Text: "Unit Quartz-Krame requests permission to negotiate trade agreements. Are you open to a commercial transaction?"

7e6bf779-614a-4f1b-9855-8d241b6f4cac.Text: "Retrieving archived data. Over seventy Terran years ago, the governor of Rykad Minoris and authorised representatives of the Explorator Cognisance Fleet made an agreement. Its goal was mutual benefit through cooperation. Unit Logis Quartz-Krame is the Fleet's appointed trade agent. The unit is responsible for maintenance of the arsenal and the combat machinery."

3a3bf411-e6da-4599-bfd8-946882faf3bf.Text: {n}When the Tech-Priest notices Pasqal, his eyes widen. His vox-unit immediately lets out a string of screeching binharic, a tortuously long tirade in which the volume rises and falls seemingly at random. When it is finally over, the Omnissiah's servant bows his head in deference.{/n}

78573758-8e10-41ed-b7e6-5f1be67b705e.Text: "I observe that this world's authorities lack diligence in the performance of their duties."

a894a338-c40d-4815-80f9-845266250437.Text: {n}The Tech-Priest says, sharply and curtly,{/n} "Haphazard and careless decisions on the part of the Rykad Minoris governor have led to unacceptable consequences. Communication with the Adeptus Mechanicus sanctum has been lost. Troops must be sent to the Hallowed Electrodynamic Cenobium without delay. Restoring communication with the Electro-Priests and ensuring the sanctum's security are our top priorities."

c5856fd1-d70e-4261-9b03-ee6bb0f68aaa.Text: "The Cognisance Fleet's presence in the Rykad System is negligible. Its research activities in the system have been concluded. A limited presence is maintained for the purposes of logistical support. Fulfilment of vows to maintain the Omnissiah's creations. Spiritual oversight."

30485f12-9bf7-4ab5-8005-4dba0613e460.Text: {n}The priest pierces you with his grim gaze as his vox-caster tensely crackles. A few seconds later, he nods briefly.{/n} "Answer accepted. The future of the Adeptus Mechanicus sanctum remains under threat."

c611c965-177e-47a3-a8ff-f0c049076912.Text: "Unit Quartz-Krame has had no previous communications with Unit Abel Haneumann. The memory sector contains other data related to this query."

53fda185-5825-4c76-93c3-7793f133eca9.Text: "Blessed are the valiant warriors, for there is no end to the darkness without them." {n}The Omnissiah's servants exchange short binharic mantras filled with intimidating solemnity.{/n}

fe432457-c47d-49b1-8993-7fb3f7639061.Text: "This statement is true!" {n}United in their denunciations and brimming with righteous criticism, the pair in red exchange knowing nods.{/n}

529f9c2b-25b3-429e-b632-66ae7917aa3a.Text: "Identification. Unit Logis Quartz-Krame. Official trade representative of the Explorator Cognisance Fleet. The unit supervises supply routes in the Rykad System. Ensures the security of the combat arsenal. Performs commercial transactions and secures mutually beneficial contracts."

0b83781a-2363-4652-bcc6-d1f64fdb37b8.Text: "Unit Quartz-Krame requests permission to transfer information. The Rogue Trader possesses a supreme degree of power. The potential to influence the current leadership. The ability to restore order in the Rykad System."

3b7445ac-d1a4-43d0-bd85-ee7cd95db488.Text: "Various resources and data storage devices of interest have been extracted by the standing army of Rykad Minoris for preservation purposes. The command centre currently hosts a cogitator that was used by Unit Abel Haneumann. Appeal to the cogitator's spirits for further information."

db46cb43-83ba-42df-a4ea-6c24e218a50f.Text: "Unit Quartz-Krame is grateful. The Rogue Trader is highly likely to successfully influence the future actions of the local authorities."

ddd7b27f-c880-4c4d-a869-3f11701f8d9a.Text: "You are the head of a Rogue Trader dynasty. Your position enables you to exert influence—" {n}The Tech-Priest pauses for a moment.{/n} "—and pressure on the subjects of the Imperium. Unit Quartz-Krame requests assistance. The actions of Governor Faisal Rykadi ab Medineh af Koronus must be influenced. Demand that troops be sent to the holy monastery of the Adeptus Mechanicus."

7f49ccd3-2559-475c-9063-480db2d08bf8.Text: "A detailed complaint. I recommend you consider Unit Quartz-Krame's request to transfer information."

03e066ab-47f0-4a8f-8b41-5fd152dfb389.Text: {n}The Tech-Priest stares at you without blinking.{/n} "Awareness of the fact that the Rogue Trader did not stand aside and has influenced the future of the Hallowed Electrodynamic Cenobium. Including the possible rescue of the most holy Electro-Priests. Unit Quartz-Krame can promise no more."

621824e4-90c9-425c-9fab-3735b3c14baf.Text: "Blessed are the armourers, for there can be no Imperium without them."

f298caa0-23b7-41d7-bf75-536ff266763f.Text: [Go to "Logis's private archive. Result of Logis Abel's datatrance"]

1459c8d2-3889-4c6b-ab1e-95b962eb8992.Text: {n}This cogitator looks a lot older and more worn than the ones next to it. However, it has evidently been well cared for: numerous parts have been replaced, not a single key is jammed, and fresh seals with prayers to the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g} adorn its surface. One of the side panels has been removed. Bundles of gold-notched cables run from inside to a small data-crypt that was connected only a short while ago.{/n}

326e70e7-7922-4880-93f5-56657034a74a.Text: "Logis Abel's conclusion: the insurrection on the planet had been long in the making, with the participation of external actors. It is alleged that two cycles ago, 'Aurora' arrived in the Rykad System — the rumoured unholy prophet of the insurgents. The subsequent ship movements can be attributed to weapon deliveries. But what is the nature of their activity near Rykadi Philia? Governor Medineh's attention must be drawn to—" {n}The final entry cuts off abruptly.{/n}

3d8fd5d9-5358-42d9-a7db-bfa91ee6348c.Text: "The machine spirits are ill-disposed toward you. Allow me to appease them in the appropriate manner." {n}Pasqal leans over the cogitator and sets to work.{/n}

7b154927-9052-4949-a5bb-db11716a9a22.Text: "The satellite Zafireh the Keen reports that a ship drifting nearby has hurriedly sped away. The ship had sent an encrypted vox-transmission to the insurgent-controlled areas of the surface of Rykad Minoris. Another transmission was directed to planetoid Rykadi Philia. Both transmissions were signed 'Brother Twilight.' Their contents could not be decrypted."

0d128cb6-6cd5-4eff-8da7-05a1892cd717.Text: {n}You have bypassed the security layers. The cogitator is ready to reveal its secrets.{/n}

249d4b50-6507-41b1-a9b0-6af70a15893f.Text: {n}Despite your efforts, the stubborn machine spirits are unwilling to reveal their secrets.{/n}

99e05b0e-6dc1-4792-a09b-f9da7bdef7cb.Text: "Upon Logis Abel's orders, the archives of every augur station on Rykad Minoris and the two primary satellites of Rykad's star have been queried. Said satellites are named Magos Ma'rouf and Zafireh the Keen, after two great champions of faith, whose external cogitators were placed inside the satellites' cores after their shells perished. The purpose of the sacred computation requested by the Logis is to uncover the external influence behind the ongoing insurgency."

3243cb64-a5ff-4927-b1f6-e86697ecb405.Text: "The satellite Magos Ma'rouf reports that a ship has translated into the system. Its signature is consistent with the records of the flagship of a {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} dynasty, House von Valancius."

570748aa-c4ec-421d-a3a4-6d749030a711.Text: {n}Pasqal leans forward and runs his fingers over the keys. The cogitator's screen blinks and responds with strings of unknown characters.{/n} "I appealed to the machine spirit to open Logis Abel's personal archives as well. It has accepted my request."

822aa92e-3842-4f5a-a825-bd9036be3b80.Text: "Computation result: positive. Multiple instances of interference and malfunction detected, suggesting that the ships moving across the system deliberately blinded the sacred {g|Encyclopedia:Augur}augurs{/g}' eyes. The first of these ships is thought to have arrived two Rykad Minoris cycles ago, early in the winter. The most recent one arrived a month ago."

40c9dbf3-47a0-487a-b97d-f382d2a8c856.Text: "I cannot see the Secret Design but I can sense it, shackled in stasis. The minds of the initiated are slumbering in the neural harness of their vows. I am registering an impulse of change. I surmise a potential influence on the stasis of the Secret Design. There came a time when the spiral was turned into a circle, but the cycle can be discontinued."

5339c3d9-a0e8-49d9-858e-45d75db6b450.Text: {n}The entry contains planetside coordinates marked as "Heavy augur station jamming. Possibly a hidden insurgent base?"{/n}

5e7f529a-7516-434c-bf36-5e3c29e307b4.Text: "The cycle can be discontinued... I recognise the words." {n}The voice from the {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g} is soft and pensive, barely audible over the static noise.{/n} "I believe I know the intended recipient of the message in the Furibundus System. It was me. Omnissiah, grant me the wisdom to fathom this mystery."

99511efa-2eca-48fc-a60b-4887d5a8a064.Text: "The revelation granted by the Omnissiah to Logis Abel in the course of his datameditation has been recorded verbatim. Logis Abel is seeking an audience with the venerable Dahr-Impulse VI who may assist in interpreting the revelation. A request has been sent to the governor's palace for a shuttle flight to the Electrodynamic Cenobium. A message has also been sent to the Furibundus System."

c548e9fd-2c4d-401c-b1ff-2cf8a5bdc405.Text: "My ship's crew has suffered heavy losses. I wish to secure replacements on Rykad Minoris."

5ddd449d-9a0a-476e-9ca1-0b851937f3a0.Text: "I need fresh crew to replace those killed in the attack on the ship. And I need material compensation."

fd156d08-86c7-47d2-ba66-b20ffa7080bb.Text: "Pasqal, what is so special about the cenobium and the relic? What is in there that has drawn the attention of an Interrogator of the Inquisition?"

b56b5ceb-070b-4a80-ba7c-94a8e2865eb3.Text: "I am not yet ready for the triumph. I still have not found a Navigator for my ship."

526f6033-8197-43e1-974e-f967e19086e9.Text: "I have other business in this system."

f03cdf4b-9ee5-4f81-a8f0-6f44626352f4.Text: "What a curious exchange of pleasantries. Is there some kind of discord between you and Abelard?"

e82b33ba-4c9d-4212-82c4-4f8d3f0a2302.Text: "The convoy was ambushed and massacred. The only surviving soldier turned out to be a traitor and was personally executed by me."

59090b2d-4fc0-4690-b0a5-c3bbc0d0219d.Text: "The convoy was ambushed and massacred in its entirety, save for one private's miraculous survival. I am counting on you to investigate the incident."

cae88b5e-76f3-4893-b1eb-65e351558ba4.Text: "Is there anything else I can do on this planet or in this system while I wait for the end of the revolt?"

16d633ed-20ba-48ea-8daa-e6298892a6c0.Text: "Heinrix van Calox, an Interrogator of the Most Holy Inquisition, is operating in your system. Do you know where he is?"

13123349-177a-40ee-b866-a9cc8f82e0c9.Text: "Are you so confident that you will crush the insurrection soon? My own impression has been the exact opposite."

c9c2b54d-46d2-427b-89ae-534eb25dc5d9.Text: "That is all I wanted to discuss."

5533f2ff-f992-4668-993a-8dfb961d9ea1.Text: "Our ship was attacked, Theodora was killed, and I claimed my inheritance. That is all you need to know."

2894f45e-6c70-4c10-b75f-af59988f0f59.Text: "The convoy was ambushed. There were no survivors except Private Camille Regias. I must commend his extraordinary loyalty and resilience."

239a64aa-1f1e-418f-8fb5-820d583d5092.Text: "Scores of crazed people with scorched eyes are stalking the city."

1959ebca-c09f-4af9-98a8-753c9c1c542c.Text: "The insurgents talk of a 'Final Dawn' — the impending demise of the world."

a3cbe8eb-6194-410f-bd36-a35b6859fa19.Text: "I should be the one asking that question. Our ship was attacked by heretics. They killed Lady Theodora!"

929a53c2-89c4-4106-ab07-a2fa9bfaf858.Text: "I wish to know more about the monastery."

b8e6e02d-c8ae-4cdd-9559-e3903d883359.Text: "The insurgents are using the Archenemy's artefacts, enchanted lenses, to perform unholy sorcery."

da65d9f3-de24-4942-9bb7-9e6dbcae0a4e.Text: "I wish to discuss the insurgency on the planet."

ae25e1be-5527-4d8c-8c96-4a3e8677d5ea.Text: "My kinsman Kunrad Voigtvir von Valancius has betrayed our dynasty and the Imperium. If he is hiding in this system, I want him handed over to me."

10d4051f-68d4-4a66-8d2e-91c5ddb6b23b.Text: "You ought to leave your bunker more often, Governor Medineh. I have only recently arrived in this system and I already know much more about the uprising than you do."

7326f6dc-0d7a-4390-9e31-07b794408641.Text: "I can see that it is not in my power to convince you. Let us change the subject."

0e6a9cc1-a2a3-4308-875a-84b30f762e8c.Text: "Why did he fly to the monastery? That seems suspicious."

33549321-918f-475c-993f-2feca5d425ff.Text: "Where can I get more information on this individual?"

dc9afb20-2412-4746-930e-4ecae2cbcd3c.Text: "Pay no attention, Governor. She's a little off her rocker."

5527c7d2-324d-4f1b-b781-cad7558be203.Text: "The insurgency is headed by a certain Aurora, a prophet who, according to their followers, possesses mystical powers."

58c5727f-59c0-4b0b-a2b1-398b90baf77a.Text: "Tech-Priest Quartz-Krame claims you have not been doing enough to ensure the safety of the Adeptus Mechanicus monastery."

aaa8b63b-ce4f-4fda-b53e-862aa8a13642.Text: "My reasoning? One would have to be blind not to see all the signs of cultist activity! Have you ever had to deal with such a threat before, Governor Medineh? As a soldier of the Astra Militarum, I have, so do not waste my time with requests to prove the obvious, because I speak from experience!"

a1d72a5e-4d5f-44d8-a497-f11c834ffe32.Text: "The insurgents managed to steal a vox-caster. They have been listening to your people's communications."

d093c6a2-d581-403e-83c4-481dbf11ea31.Text: "You have picked an interesting time to quarrel with a servant of the Omnissiah, Governor."

528e6ae6-d7df-44d8-93a1-e7517f9bff0f.Text: "This Magos is part of my retinue. You have no right to give him orders."

43e5329c-7f94-4cd9-a73a-524f67696394.Text: [Let Pasqal deal with his own problems]

cfdb0151-5410-4d46-890f-476f8555fb85.Text: "Why are you so determined to get to the monastery? Is it just because of the relic?"

3f1c5b01-ff12-4c8a-b18f-711cb1f67465.Text: "It would be my pleasure to assist the Omnissiah's servant in reaching the sanctum."

e309183b-37c0-4990-a589-89ed1239bdc5.Text: "Witch, you will abstain from your sorcery in front of the governor!"

a696a52a-dcd2-4ae6-beee-f7956704ff67.Text: "The rioters are too well organised, too well informed, too well armed. There are signs of indoctrination into heretical beliefs — they are clearly being directed by someone competent and charismatic. Governor, you are dealing with an Archenemy cult that is growing at an alarming rate."

1a471d4c-6a61-4d0d-91ed-06c99bb416cd.Text: "My esteemed predecessor died at the hands of cultists, may the Emperor incinerate their souls."

cb5a3f1d-bf73-49d1-868a-6a24eb8316e1.Text: "This world belongs to Winterscale. Do the Adeptus Arbites truly have the authority to interfere in the rule of governors appointed by a Rogue Trader?"

facb9d5a-4622-4f23-9dd9-728746364627.Text: "I would never think to oppose a servant of the Lex."

78cc1527-d845-40ae-807e-c8bc558e7fc0.Text: "Do not even try to involve me in this, Medineh."

847c6568-c18e-4d09-acfc-e97162168933.Text: [Shrug] "I suppose there is nothing else for it."

089e1d4c-e9be-468e-aa67-6ba2ac020f52.Text: "So, you are just going to sit the whole thing out in this bunker..."

8507fe85-6076-4ebc-9622-c3a26b94560b.Text: "Proctor, do you also believe this rebellion was orchestrated by nothing more than a few lowborn lunatics?"

7e9e85cc-9116-402b-b329-074a476dca9e.Text: Stressed that civilian casualties are unacceptable when talking to Solomorne on Rykad Minoris.

1ce4b546-beb5-4394-ae52-b96a4dfe1e6e.Text: "Killing innocents is unacceptable, even for the sake of saving a world."

b8880d33-91c9-4460-8707-3002fbc19e80.Text: Supported Solomorne's plan to reclaim control on Rykad Minoris.

ed786389-9867-40b0-82ff-b7a5ed74e9c8.Text: "A sound plan, Proctor. Only harsh measures can restore order."

b1576a7c-b4a2-4bb1-89c5-69989845c0a9.Text: "I wish you luck in your investigation, Proctor."

8d126a99-2488-4784-a3a6-03ade7703a96.Text: "I wish to commend the courage of one of your officers, Sergeant Malgar. He and his soldiers valiantly defend the starport."

b608b914-d4e0-4185-8a1c-62e7a1330dd7.Text: "Please pay her no mind, Proctor. She has... episodes sometimes."

9c4a32d3-6052-465f-aa54-0116e151c31e.Text: "How dare you work your sorcery in front of the Proctor, witch!"

69c9d508-6d12-4f36-8805-940d87c0691f.Text: "Why do you think the rebels are hiding among the civilians? They could have shelters elsewhere."

ae1860b8-9752-4588-8cc6-f4345fa51b17.Text: [Lower your voice] "Governor, you didn't steal the tithe ship, did you?"

8d5393e7-f2ad-4ad9-93a5-acd3d9002a9d.Text: Advised Solomorne to destroy more of Rykad Minoris's population in order to instil terror and obedience among the survivors.

63490b3f-0dc8-4153-9628-7cf8ab578373.Text: "I recommend not taking civilian casualties into account. These people are in need of a good lesson in pain and fear."

9ecdcb98-bc6e-407a-a30a-405b73220c76.Text: "The anti-aircraft battery that was giving you so much trouble has been destroyed."

72720df2-277f-402a-9285-048ce69558f7.Text: "What has perplexed you about my companion's name?"

c5ed53f3-94dc-4ab0-8130-fcef0ba1ac46.Text: "Why not shell the monastery if that is where the insurgents have gathered? Or deploy a landing force?"

1dc72290-4be1-429b-9100-42fe0cd24d2e.Text: "What do you know about this Abel, Governor?"

6338b075-0864-417a-876f-742761683097.Text: "I realise that you yourselves are in a difficult situation, but my crew has sustained heavy losses. I must replace my missing crew members."

5b1e2968-8ef4-47ac-9628-6bf6a49492d4.Text: {n}The tall, dark-skinned man turns toward you and greets you in a curt military manner:{/n} "Faisal Rykadi ab Medineh af Koronus, governor of this star system. Welcome to my temporary headquarters."

a2938e49-96d7-4250-97f4-437f5a54d3e8.Text: {n}Idira tenses up and listens, then turns around sharply to face Pasqal.{/n} "I can hear my friends' snide whispers through the door. Be careful on your search, Magos. If you stare into a shattered mirror for too long, you might see yourself in it — in every shard at once. Mending it is that much more of a tainted affair then — the new reflection is deathlike."

6df2bb39-1a5d-4729-a4d8-b6f3439ed501.Text: "I would also like to salute the saviour of Rykad Minoris and have already given the order for a celebration to be held in your honour.
