We will mark your victory with an ancient custom — the triumph. You will drive through the city streets accompanied by a guard of honour, as befits a {mf|hero|heroine} who has vanquished the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}'s enemies, while your trophies will be displayed to the jubilant crowds. Let me know once you have concluded your business in this system and are ready for the triumph to begin!" {n}Governor Medineh is positively ablaze with enthusiasm.{/n}

5a4f2fe0-7710-4ea9-a475-16e1b6666713.Text: {n}The man's gaze falls on Abelard. His eyes slightly narrow.{/n} "Werserian."

9d63bc96-edad-4b18-945a-b4b971a96a48.Text: "I'm not seeing the convoy I'd sent to meet you. What happened? Did they fail to find and escort you? If that is so, I promise you their punishment will be swift and severe."

f72af8fb-469c-409e-89c3-b8f29e94665f.Text: "Excellent! We'll see each other at the square, then. May the light of the {g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Throne{/g} be with you!"

7ad76417-6686-4090-89d1-1e4f0b9a1bf2.Text: "Then I daren't delay you any further, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship."

be8bcb36-f458-4f99-b01d-7707bd2f750b.Text: {n}Abelard nods in approval and remarks quietly,{/n} "Excellent, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. A Rogue Trader has no use for leniency."

35e80220-6b9d-48e9-b6ce-468990ef07c5.Text: "That is an outrage. I will have the personnel vetting procedure changed immediately. The slightest suspicion will be grounds for arrest!"

b7252330-e0c8-4d8b-b1fb-66d94c55e85b.Text: "Oh, we will, I assure you!" {n}The governor gestures to the guards.{/n} "Take the suspect away. And find the executioner on duty. He should be done with interrogating the captured insurgents by now."

aabb0d12-5ead-4a26-a512-044756d76c8d.Text: "The weapon the insurgents were using to shoot down shuttles over the city has been destroyed. Now nothing is preventing you from returning to your ship. If you wish to find Master van Calox, you should go to the cenobium of the Adeptus Mechanicus."

69bdf3e6-7379-437b-88d6-3d608ff21ee5.Text: "An old misunderstanding. Over a century old by now. It isn't worth your time, Lord Captain."

4306cf8d-587f-4ee6-bdcf-c25b3f4425cc.Text: "Governor Medineh, I intend to gather further information on the person calling himself Abel Haneumann. I do not exclude the possibility of it being an alias of my mentor, the {g|Encyclopedia:Archmagos}Archmagos{/g} Amarnat."

4c72c9f5-b7bd-4881-bb1a-0d426b4ca70d.Text: "Only one good soldier in a whole convoy! Pathetic. Head to the barracks, private, and await new orders."

0dc54fe2-d163-410e-ab43-fd745e31de54.Text: "Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship, before we proceed with discussing the matters that are of interest to you, there is a question I feel compelled to ask. It was only recently that Lady Theodora was the head of House von Valancius. I have received no word of her demise. How is it that you are now the {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}?"

0ff40ebf-84c6-48f9-a877-80cb9767fe04.Text: "Glad to hear it. That is quite enough mad ramblings and eye problems for one day."

0611e23e-babb-4a6a-8b0b-f45bac9041dd.Text: {n}The governor frowns, and a deep shadow falls over his face.{/n} "Rogue Trader von Valancius! Slain! Unthinkable! Please accept my deepest and most sincere condolences, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. Do not hesitate to let me know how I might be of help!"

dfe72f8b-1559-41af-ac14-cbecee33e93a.Text: "The cenobium has been run by the Adeptus Mechanicus ever since the colony was founded. The sacred reactor guarded by its priests powers the entire planet. I can say no more. It is a forbidden place that even I have only been allowed to visit once before."

8204ce4f-0eeb-4ec8-bc74-f4fb75b91251.Text: "If you'd like a distraction, a smaller and safer uprising to suppress at your leisure, there is a planetoid in my system called Rykadi Philia. It hosts a prison colony whose inmates rebelled at the same time as the heretics on the planet. It's an all-round preposterous situation — it should have only taken us a couple of orbital shots to take care of them, but..." {n}The governor slightly purses his lips.{/n}

64c9a663-fb58-4951-a1ad-e1b95afe37fe.Text: "Then I will see you at the starport, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. The master of ceremonies will organise the procession in a way that should allow me to share the ceremony's finale with you. And after that, Emperor willing, the Proctor will clear me of all charges, and the woes of Rykad Minoris will be over at last."

66d17cef-aa51-4f28-8b54-0d89fdaa9ad4.Text: "The rabble's usual superstitions. I'm sure this Aurora is a charlatan muttering some doggerel, which their dim followers think to be magic spells. This does, of course, warrant their eventual burning in the furnace of penance. But it does not point to there being anything special about this insurgency."

086155ad-4ba7-47fa-8717-50d07c0fe8ee.Text: "The insurgents are maiming their own? Good."

ea187500-cdc3-49bb-9ae0-a332a16e9fa0.Text: "Yet another superstition. Surely you don't expect me to believe in it?"

5adc7b53-2243-493c-b6f2-c5124caff792.Text: "It's not much, but it is something. I will order an audit of our equipment and see to it that our communication channels are more closely monitored going forward. However, it was only the accidental success of an otherwise disorganised mob of heretics, who have no understanding of the art of war."

81d3260c-b9d7-4a3e-94df-a08f7660a08d.Text: "I've heard about these lenses. What makes you think they're enchanted? Any fool can light a fire with a magnifying glass. That's no sorcery."

69a3da0a-0860-4320-a107-c24af7e73a87.Text: {n}The governor's eyes darken, but your unwavering gaze makes him give in.{/n} "All right. All right! Perhaps, I've underestimated the mutiny, writing it off as the rabble's usual nonsense... However, if it does involve corruption and an underground cult... this needs to be investigated. I'll assign additional resources to it and take the issue seriously. You have my word, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship."

8a57a481-12ba-4e49-ab3e-0f877a5439b2.Text: "According to the Catechism of Maintenance and Operation, my tech-comrades were supposed to lock the monastery gates against laypeople and activate the traps. I deem it optimal that an ordained Magos should provide his assistance."

0d0f2f5d-0a8f-45fc-8cc2-547e07e41d62.Text: "The sergeant who managed to impress a person of such noble standing will be recommended for decoration."

90c347d0-f16c-4d5e-a471-3f22471cbec9.Text: "Unfortunately, right now you won't be able to leave the capital and set out to look for him. The rebels have got hold of some ancient weapon and made flying over the city impossible."

e56e916f-ce2e-48d4-9bdb-564fe95a0848.Text: "I have never been there before, but I would presume that the sacred relic of the reactor is capable of great destruction should it end up in heretic hands. The fury of the freed {g|Encyclopedia:MachineSpirit}machine spirits{/g}, once released from the sacred circuit, will destroy everything around them. The degree of damage inflicted may render the world of Rykad Minoris uninhabitable."

f1343a0d-a835-44d1-bb8e-a5c8de69e1e2.Text: "Is that so?" {n}The governor maintains his composure.{/n} "I'd like to hear your reasoning."

6ea95f5f-2868-4291-b1e4-1bdeba197dcc.Text: "Fulfilling this request puts the monastery in danger of major destruction. The consequences of this decision for the world of Rykad Minoris could be catastrophic."

13fc1b00-1b44-4bed-bbce-520fe022c4e0.Text: "Heresy must be purged from those blessed halls. I declare any desecrator who defiles the relic's power a Category Three blasphemer deserving of immediate execution."

9d5c0b7e-6eff-4f02-b60c-4791c69db939.Text: "Voigtvir is a traitor? Why, any family, however noble, has an unworthy scion or two. Naturally, we will surrender him should we find him within my jurisdiction. Unfortunately, I have no information regarding his location. However..." {n}The governor pauses to think.{/n}

4efad800-55ad-4437-9c59-987691873b11.Text: "We have a {g|Encyclopedia:Cogitator}cogitator{/g} here at the command centre, it's connected to a {g|Encyclopedia:Cybercrypt}data-crypt{/g} from Logis Abel's sanctum. It aggregated all the {g|Encyclopedia:Lexmechanic}Lexmechanic{/g} reports. Unfortunately, the access prayer for it is unknown to me. If you manage to convince the stubborn machine, you might learn something about Kunrad's movements. I'd hazard he fled from you on a ship, not on a pair of wings!"

8a6bab91-a1c7-44a1-b263-836930724eb9.Text: "It's been my pleasure to enlighten Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship."

8168a42b-917c-4ae5-8eb4-73c7dcd9134a.Text: "You're Haneumann? Hmm... Glad you're alive." {n}The governor raises his eyebrow and stares at the {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priest{/g} in surprise, but refrains from further commentary.{/n}

3599f3e8-63f7-4cb9-a2aa-2b6290ea80a8.Text: "There is a {g|Encyclopedia:NavisNobilite}Navis Nobilite{/g} station in this system, but those hermits don't do business with anyone. Not even I have ever been invited on board. However, they've been known to make exceptions for members of Rogue Trader families. Perhaps, they will make one for you?"

dc1d0f2f-2ce9-434d-b5f2-71fe91c0c6df.Text: {n}The governor looks at Pasqal with curiosity.{/n} "According to the reports we've received, Logis Abel Haneumann set off for the Hallowed Electrodynamic Cenobium a short while before it was stormed. I'm glad to find out that you're safe. Perhaps you possess information on Master van Calox?"

c324ac20-ddc3-4d9a-ace7-85b717a75359.Text: {n}Pasqal's vox rasps in confusion,{/n} "My name is Pasqal Haneumann. Not Abel. I know nothing about such a person."

259baee3-3859-4c5a-924e-d44922ca1ea8.Text: "I've never met him in person. That esteemed Logis supervised the work of Rykad Minoris's Lexmechanics for many years. However, he rarely left his cyberchapel, and I never had the honour of making his acquaintance. A true anchorite."

e65fd785-62ad-4edc-8aa2-f4e554d5278c.Text: "When a Logis of the Adeptus Mechanicus wants to go somewhere, we don't ask why, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship."

4cf342f7-39c6-4ba0-b053-46f65c8d9cc5.Text: {n}Idira shrieks and blindly reaches for the air in front of her. She rubs her eyes nervously.{/n} "Oh for {g|Encyclopedia:Grox}grox{/g} sake! What the... Lord Captain, I... I can't see a thing! Only darkness. Pitch-black darkness."

2c88c8df-6108-43fd-bc9a-0bb1e478e6eb.Text: "I would have suggested that you inspect the esteemed Logis's sanctum, but it was destroyed by the rebels. We recovered several data-crypts and connected them to the cogitators at the command post. They might provide you with some information."

d63a7750-ac73-42c4-9ea5-4eae403dab02.Text: {n}The governor's expression changes drastically when he sees Cassia.{/n} "Lady Navigator? What an honour! I never thought that House Orsellio would grace our world with a visit. I only wish I could have received you under different circumstances."

457ab1af-6333-4126-a722-bcc51b5a30bc.Text: "Then permit me to ask a question. My name aroused your interest, Governor Medineh. Why?"

92a85fcf-a6de-422a-9349-7923fb45baa3.Text: {n}The governor chuckles nervously and fidgets with his collar.{/n} "Are you being facetious, ma'am?"

902a898c-6eb2-402d-919f-870eeb9be511.Text: {n}The governor lowers his voice.{/n} "I do. Master van Calox has left for the Hallowed Electrodynamic Cenobium. It's an ancient monastery of the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMechanicus}Adeptus Mechanicus{/g}. I don't know what his objectives are. Needless to say, insurgent activity has been observed in the monastery's vicinity. But I suppose that's too petty of a problem for an agent of the Most Holy Inquisition. Besides, I have already sent a small detachment of reinforcements there."

3f04d229-37de-4ecd-bfc0-b3c1b4d1001a.Text: {n}It is amazing that a mechanical voice from a vox can sound so confused:{/n} "That name might have been used as a signal intelligible only to its intended recipient. In that case, its bearer might be {g|Encyclopedia:Archmagos}Archmagos{/g} Amarnat. Initiating an investigation and data collection procedure."

ff622ffc-e628-4726-b2bb-6ae1d788ff6a.Text: "As compensation for your consideration of my request, I, Magos Haneumann, officially undertake to accompany you in the Rykad System in the role of bodyguard and to protect you at all costs until your life functions cease. But only within the limits of the Rykad System."

745e70a2-0dc7-4a2c-84d6-4dd20876a65a.Text: {n}Notes of anxiety creep into the voice that rattles from Pasqal's vox:{/n} "On behalf of the Priesthood of {g|Encyclopedia:Mars}Mars{/g}, I, Magos Haneumann, am officially initiating my participation in the operation. I must inspect the state of the relic and assure myself that it is under zero risk of falling into heretic hands."

433d78f3-94b1-4d16-a00a-85a0542748ee.Text: "No, I'm quite all right. There's darkness... in my mind. But I haven't gone blind, no. It is the darkness that I see. It is the only thing I see."

223d3001-3f7d-43cd-856d-2a7ba121586c.Text: "No idea what that means, but the whole thing reeks, Lord Captain. I don't like the look of it in the sligh— oh!" {n}Idira stares at her hands as if she has never seen them before.{/n} "It's gone."

9f8907ab-f2e2-4c13-a872-f9159307f1cb.Text: "I have no idea. Darkness just enveloped me — bam! — like some kind of veil. But I've not gone blind, no. It is the darkness that I see. It is the only thing I see."

a418739f-0330-4733-8b84-9197f6793a7e.Text: "Lord Captain, this is serious, take a psyker's word for it! Darkness has never shrouded me like this before. But I have not gone blind, no. It is the darkness that I see. It is the only thing I see."

1c065141-0975-43ff-a9ac-22e40f697dc4.Text: "I can't express how grateful I am for your help. Now that the insidious heretics' designs have been thwarted, nothing stands in the way of my plans or yours. With Aurora dead, the spirit of revolt is waning. Entire squads of rebels are surrendering. We are witnessing the final days of the uprising. I have already signed the order to allocate two thousand first-class voidfarers to you. Their transfer to your ship should begin any minute now."

88741b49-e946-43a7-8b1d-d2da2ff68e86.Text: {n}Medineh breathes a sigh of relief.{/n} "You have no doubt been through a lot lately, ma'am. Small wonder your vision had a dim spell with all this shooting everywhere, let alone all these maimed and maddened insurgents. It will be all right. The festivities will distract you and you'll feel right as rain again!"

08564e26-a4d6-43ab-9234-c10ca2cd251f.Text: {n}With a heavy sigh, the governor wearily covers his face with his hand.{/n} "Of course he does. That Tech-Priest... is very insistent. I ordered a squad to be dispatched to the holy cenobium of the Adeptus Mechanicus. They haven't been heard from yet. I'm afraid, this is all I can do under the present circumstances. I don't have a single soldier to spare here in the capital."

8799ac65-5d62-435d-bd81-ca82b88a8772.Text: {n}Cassia purses her lips, and an echo of grief knocks the wind out of those present.{/n} "House Orsellio is grateful for the support that you have provided to Eurac V these many years."

0aca45f3-577e-47b0-bc08-f199c087d0d4.Text: "Evayne Winterscale has made several diplomatic visits to Eurac V on behalf of his father. The Great Regent would never have granted entry to someone dishonourable, which means... no matter what happened on the planetoid, we must aid the highborn."

432929d4-9b85-4f36-a479-7f82e0217b5d.Text: {n}Governor Medineh offers Heinrix a somewhat strained smile.{/n} "Master van Calox, it pleases me to see you in good health. I hope that you accomplished, uh, what you intended to at the Electrodynamic Cenobium."

13e0b7be-d55c-44c6-9d37-2b442bde4c89.Text: {n}The Interrogator nods without saying a word.{/n}

4162700f-fdfa-4c2e-96d1-4eaa99988481.Text: {n}Heinrix presses his lips into a thin line.{/n} "Not quite."

06c07655-35ac-4061-acf8-abac093c4676.Text: {n}After an uncomfortably long pause, Medineh clears his throat and quickly turns to you.{/n}

b2cf7481-6946-42c5-8073-0825ee386c59.Text: "I categorically object." {n}The governor clenches his fist.{/n} "As much as I respect the sanctity of your monastery, I have on my hands a whole capital that needs to be attended by the Omnissiah's servants. We have lost many eminent Tech-Priests — incidentally, one of them perished in that same monastery. Mechanical failures could occur at any moment. Putting it bluntly, you may consider yourself forcibly recruited into the city's defence forces." {n}Medineh and Pasqal glare at each other, their unyielding gazes like crossed swords.{/n}

fd5f9fd7-960c-4232-aeaa-da459d0b1df2.Text: "A critical situation calls for decisive action. I simply cannot let every learned Tech-Priest go to their death the moment they hear about an endangered relic. I need people who can do more than praise the Omnissiah to look after the capital and its millions of citizens."

7d511f1d-6850-4643-a3d6-a91a4cb17cd3.Text: "Evayne Winterscale went there. He is a relative of my suzerain, the great Rogue Trader Calligos Winterscale, the master of this system and a dozen others. I imagine the young Lord Winterscale is very eager to prove himself to his distinguished kinsman. I see no reason for you not to join him. It's a small planetoid, the prisoners' numbers are few, and they have little in the way of weapons. It's more of a sport for noble lords{mf|| and ladies} than a real rebellion."

355284ea-a0b5-4ba5-86f4-c480ccf011eb.Text: "You mistake me for a fool. I know that he arrived separately from you, and I would bet my life that no—"

1e242ccc-db66-48ea-8fe7-e579b64eca38.Text: "I am glad to hear that Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} supports my decision. Esteemed Magos—"

8fcf7d54-9742-4f85-8442-34ae4a009524.Text: "Esteemed Magos, our technomats will apprise you of the issues with our power distributor—"

34fad0cb-b0d8-4c75-bf8c-348462ad7826.Text: {n}The governor's voice dies down in the low growl of a drilling mechadendrite. Its tip is directed straight at the bridge of his nose. Medineh clears his throat and grumbles stubbornly,{/n} "So this is the negotiation technique you have resorted to? Do you think this is the first time I have been threatened with a weapon?"

97f5de96-33bb-4438-a28e-4c04bc6edb68.Text: "No. But this could be your last." {n}Pasqal's voice is akin to the sound produced by his drilling implement: steady and calm, but ready to explode at a moment's notice with the crunching of bone and the squelching of tearing flesh.{/n} "I am heading to the monastery because I must. Is that clear?"

e0eec8a1-6d67-47cf-bc92-cb4c61e31e01.Text: {n}The governor mutters through gritted teeth,{/n} "Abundantly so... Magos."

b792f9db-8fee-468c-9dea-eb0e58ce05cb.Text: "It is why I came to this world. I am expected there."

b651e170-2e4d-4243-8771-8daa69d26084.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I trust you will grant me a place aboard your shuttle. The Adeptus Mechanicus will be grateful for your cooperation."

4643f21b-7838-4e96-beb0-f3805f6d1c24.Text: "Thank you for your cooperation, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}." {n}The drill stops.{/n}

578da235-6c4c-492b-be30-91e76ea27013.Text: "Lord Captain, I didn't do it on purpose, it just happened! I've never been in such complete darkness before. I've not gone blind, no. I can see the darkness. And only the darkness."

c6a44805-7c5c-4940-9d6c-048ed172c080.Text: {n}The governor bows his head in acceptance.{/n} "Of course, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. You will be compensated for any losses. And I'll see to it personally that your ship's holds are filled with the finest goods from my personal reserves."

4d47625d-21bd-4e91-bb06-329c5592ccdf.Text: {n}Governor Medineh hesitates before answering, his face slowly turning purple with anger.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}..." {n}he grits out through his teeth.{/n} "I know who you are. I have heard of your... {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Shame}'exploits.'{/d} And I will not allow a stranger — let alone another Rogue Trader — to speak to me in such a manner and make demands of a subject of His Lordship Calligos Winterscale!" {n}He takes a breath and continues in a calmer tone,{/n} "The matter is closed. Let us speak no more of it."

9b11aaf4-fe84-49bf-8801-d7e2af607795.Text: "Greetings, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}," {n}says the governor in a dismal voice, glancing reflexively at Solomorne.{/n}

8f4ebbc7-8eb2-47a4-967b-9452340826c1.Text: {n}Then the governor notices Kibellah's clothes, and his eyes go wide. He adds, softly and cautiously,{/n} "This... woman, she is your bodyguard, I presume? Or is she here to..." {n}He stops, choosing not to finish his question.{/n}

82e39f49-c9dc-434c-86ef-a6891adf7be3.Text: {n}The Arbitrator marches forward relentlessly and halts one step away from the governor, looking down at him.{/n}

55074bbd-9dce-4884-9708-3b8e98fdcaa4.Text: "Governor Medineh, in the name of the Lex Imperialis, I, Proctor Solomorne Anthar, arrest you on suspicion of involvement in the theft of the shipment of the Imperial Tithe. Taking into account the state of emergency on this planet, I will permit you to retain your authority under my direct supervision. From this time forth, you will give the Adeptus Arbites your full cooperation — in particular, by transferring command of the strike groups and other resources to me."

2ce4415c-0e5a-4d70-8692-73fd43b9cfef.Text: {n}Medineh, though deathly pale, proudly raises his chin.{/n} "Arrest me? Transfer my resources? Your demands undermine my efforts to suppress the rebellion! Excuse me, Proctor, but this accusation of stealing the sacred tithe is simply..." {n}He stops talking under the Arbitrator's oppressive, merciless gaze.{/n}

c807b26b-ff14-4cce-8d79-ab5d536884e2.Text: "Denying guilt only adds to the suspicions against you, Governor. Now, let us go over everything one more time. The tithe was stolen from your world. You are culpable for this incident whether you were personally involved or not. You will provide the resources I have requested without objection, as this measure serves to re-establish control over the planet. Comply, or I will consider your refusal an obstruction of the investigation and take steps accordingly."

381c0573-24f0-4316-ac54-2fbbcf34d93b.Text: "It seems I am left with no other option than to obey your will. As His law-abiding servant, I honour the word of the Lex Imperialis." {n}Medineh shoots you a quick glance.{/n} "Unless {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship} has anything to say on the matter, that is."

65087bef-06a4-45f7-a580-816f77fed571.Text: {n}The governor puts his hands behind his back, either to appear more confident or to hide the tremor in his fingers.{/n} "In that case, please accommodate yourself, Proctor. But before I give you the access codes, I must—"

6d1f2bfc-5c02-4d64-a0a9-de3e92c806dd.Text: "We do. Besides, I doubt Rogue Trader Winterscale will find it disagreeable that the Arbitrators have helped to clean up this madness. As for the governor, I imagine the Emperor's anointed will benefit from learning how diligently his servant has been performing his duties."

a738ce5f-3769-42e4-b0f7-580bc1b4ba37.Text: "No." {n}Solomorne turns sharply to face the governor.{/n} "The reports I received on Rykad Minoris indicated that the situation on the planet was stable. Either this stability has been upset by a conspiracy of the Archenemy's forces, or it merely took a congregation of madmen to threaten your authority, Governor. It is in your best interests to listen to what the Rogue Trader is saying."

9ff7c1c4-678a-430d-a94b-d7f421df4361.Text: "Give a protracted self-exonerating statement? There's no need. All information required of you will be obtained during questioning — without witnesses, be it your personal guard or the Rogue Trader. Just you, me, and Glaito." {n}The cyber-mastiff lets out a heavy growl that sends a shiver down your spine.{/n}

398664ae-95d5-4bce-b73b-9d29c9378e13.Text: "Stop the heretics from taking over the starport and other locations critical to the investigation. At the same time, we will crush the heretics' resistance — most of them are hiding among the commoners, and a series of concentrated strikes against the residential districts and infirmaries will send them running. That is when we'll finish off the rebel carrion."

af2e3fcf-ebc2-4ce1-8152-0ba4ffa0972e.Text: "There is a difference between effective tactics and terror. You are referring to the second. This world must not lose more people than is necessary, or Rykad Minoris will struggle to return to serving the Imperium."

d8b8b094-e6d2-4431-868f-1ee1f5fe6b21.Text: "Blood of the Throne... I will be governing over nothing but ruins and corpses by the time you're done!"

9f040f79-98d1-4dd8-a842-bba6ec76eaee.Text: "Have faith in my methods, Governor. I am not going to depopulate your world — after all, it needs to be able to continue paying the tithe."

9a63b988-fc3c-4696-a77d-c2138d5280a0.Text: {n}The Arbitrator's voice rings with steel:{/n} "Aversion to collateral damage is a weakness that heretics exploit to the fullest. While you stand here pitying and hesitating, the enemy is busy fortifying their positions and replenishing their losses. Stalling dictated by mercy only magnifies the damage the world will suffer."

2d9f54f7-9b34-4ffe-9fff-91d9272d7175.Text: {n}Solomorne gives a slight nod.{/n} "Better to cut off the hand than to let the infection overtake the whole body."

6dacfbaf-551c-44dc-90ce-d10acb912dce.Text: "Yes, this is far from what I was expecting from this assignment. The things we do for the mission."

074f6c11-ee3e-4b85-a311-baaf14cb3d82.Text: "Of course, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. You will be compensated for the damages." {n}The governor nods without any enthusiasm.{/n}

11e53ad5-ae50-47e3-b48c-fcfdb4b9d772.Text: "In regards to your own participation in the triumph, Governor: you will accompany us to the starport to provide timely answers to any questions that may occur to me as I inspect the terminal there. That being said, you should appear before your subjects at least once at the end of the ceremony — doing so will help to maintain order. There is no reason to let the people know that the world may soon be in for a change of leadership."

1a994490-cf7d-4506-bb2c-8f9928882b13.Text: "Martyrs' blood... Tell me this is just a hysterical outburst on your companion's part."

b5d263bb-69eb-4df2-ab80-9660356d273b.Text: "I can offer you several thousand fine, obedient servants. However, I'm sad to inform you that I won't be able to do it until we've dealt with the insurgency on the planet. I'm sure you won't have to wait long. The rabble will soon be duly punished for their heretical scheming."

fb9d54ad-6572-4736-90d5-804fe8950fa9.Text: "I know this from a few intercepted vox-exchanges and a couple of scumbags we've interrogated. But first and foremost, I know from experience. Such mutinous rabble always feeds off its families and associates, who also provide a source of recruits to support its ranks. And, of course, there is the heretics' contemptible habit of using the local population as a shield. We need to flush them out of their nests and starve them of resources."

31a0af57-ed1b-400c-a880-bde06a978033.Text: "Not you too! I swear on the Golden Throne and the blood of all martyrs: I never even considered committing such an act! Please, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, do not insult me with such suspicions."

fdbd1ab0-2454-4412-af77-a6bd8ea3acda.Text: "That's excellent news. Thank you for your assistance!"

49a44fef-2ab0-48b9-adfc-22a1d7bd2839.Text: "Change is coming... The Edge is nigh..."

4070212e-ff9d-4ebe-a3ad-d785eb7b5135.Text: "The blinded ones are harmless. No sense in shooting them and drawing attention."

1241c60f-3e6c-48a2-afb5-e1033b9abfb3.Text: "Don't kill the Tech-Priest. We need to take him alive! Neutralise the others."

b0c97b86-4fb8-43e5-9f7b-166fb76f3732.Text: "Let those who seek Knowledge find it. And let their enemies reap naught in corruption but woe."

9d9558d3-e845-45b1-bc26-41872c540043.Text: "May Knowledge be thy fate. Let the Cycle be discontinued!"

94f22f6b-78bf-42de-be3b-fef8f55451e5.Text: "Gain true vision... Renounce false sight... All will be revealed..."

09a02aa9-eddc-49f4-aa3e-7306c7f38cf9.Text: "Folks, how about you don't come any closer and I don't shoot you?"

097c29cd-c40e-42e2-8ad4-08d10453a053.Text: "The eyes lie... The Final Dawn purifies vision..."

36649b0a-3db8-4bca-89d9-d8bd2c241fca.Text: "Can you see the edge? It will burn everything you know..."

c24d558c-3770-4f5b-bddd-d098b3851e3b.Text: "Thinking of leaving us behind, cowardly scum?"

ae899a42-5909-450d-8ff1-7d16044de261.Text: "Sergeant! Cease this incitement to mutiny! That's an order..."

892e3d53-4c9f-49fa-bfdb-6d628880e466.Text: "I give the orders here. And I order you to shut up."

3c41c23f-80af-4ec0-bd6f-5441dd9fe6b9.Text: The insurgents have been feigning grave injuries. An inventive way to look unthreatening, one has to give them that.

434c3987-579d-4535-9474-658c773447d4.Text: Not only were they able-bodied all along, but their skilful actions also suggest that they were seasoned fighters merely posing as insurgents.

6a77b496-68a1-496c-9199-2264dabcf9bf.Text: The side of the shuttle has obscure pilots' jargon scribbled all over it instead of plain honest Gothic. Making sense of these scribbles is beneath you.

9fac6074-9fda-4e70-8b35-733693d6de04.Text: Written on the side of the shuttle in pilots' lowly slang are the words: "Do not touch! A shipment of tithes to the blessed Lord Captain Calligos Winterscale." Perhaps there is something worth your attention in this shuttle.

ed1c712e-f1f5-4b14-a8c2-c2bad5403feb.Text: "I can still hear those eerie whispers."

c711297d-8705-448e-b2f1-76812fa518cb.Text: "It's time to get out of here."

6d4dca10-b326-4b23-b613-02189afe7cfa.Text: Your shuttle has been burned and will never fly again. The pilot's charred body is stiff, hands still clenching the levers.

c28fdeae-bd7f-4f58-9192-35a32891ca20.Text: "You appear to be injured. You should go back — you will be given medical attention."

03c12351-1477-4f59-8a62-730327d08658.Text: "You must be quite devoted to your mentor to be willing to wade into this mess for him."

9ea807e6-3d90-4d3f-8af0-02fd255afd4e.Text: [Point at the exploded machine] "How did you manage to kill off a slew of people and blow up a sacred machine without even laying a finger on it?"

d497d87b-d568-4045-a541-13e3488dac70.Text: "I invite you to join my retinue."

b247f0e1-451d-4255-b3b8-db5dbac9af40.Text: "I am Rogue Trader {name} von Valancius. I mean you no ill."

09308b72-d105-4292-8101-8bff8e7250e6.Text: "Abelard, this is no time to lose your composure. Present me."

838a2ef9-3345-461e-a578-ea64da1bc5b7.Text: "Stop immediately, or I shall have you thrown into the remains of that machine to finish burning."

36722324-5d84-4010-affa-5c1f7ed0d3c2.Text: "Why do you wish to see the governor?"

99c039f0-e978-4add-8484-44a86d752184.Text: "You do not even know how you caused such an explosion?"

6e007f98-dfac-4bd6-bd20-2563c4d52b3a.Text: {n}The man dressed in crimson should not have survived an explosion like that. However, he is alive — you hear the wheezing of the respirator that covers half of his face.{/n}

4396064f-58b1-4cb2-9df5-bc6b82a241b8.Text: {n}The vox emits a contemptuous hiss:{/n} "The suffering of the flesh is a negligible factor. Metal conquers, meat is conquered. I recommend a swift advance." {n}The emaciated Tech-Priest, his robe shredded by debris in many places, doggedly grips his power axe, leaning on it like a staff.{/n}

99ad3e94-f446-4b89-8654-841bc5057ec2.Text: "I identify as Magos Pasqal Haneumann of the Priesthood of Mars. By the grace of the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}, I am currently assigned to the maintenance personnel of the station Altar-Templum-Calixis-Ext-17."

f4aa78b4-d727-4bef-9576-c9a93546264a.Text: {n}The Tech-Priest turns around and stares aghast at the burning remains as if he had nothing to do with what just happened. His vox produces a mournful prayer.{/n} "I... This was my doing?"

77e12f93-4e1a-4acf-a8c8-6f881341e49b.Text: {n}The Tech-Priest hesitates, glancing at his mechadendrites as if consulting them. Eventually, his vox-system responds:{/n} "I came here to carry out a sacred mission. My mentor, Archmagos Amarnat, summoned me, and I hastened to answer his call. But the rabble's unrest prevented our meeting, and I was on my way to Governor Medineh to determine my mentor's current location."

3569c4f1-e323-4346-8f4f-475a7cb54346.Text: {n}Idira has been staring at the Tech-Priest, biting her lip. She finally leans in to your ear.{/n} "The voices are being weird about him... They're saying garbled, conflicting things... like they're talking about completely different people... but he's not a threat to you. Even if that's a bit hard to believe after all the fireworks."

237280c2-48b2-4a4c-8d68-6fcd7543253d.Text: "My escort was ordered by their commander to discontinue their movement and await to be merged with your group. Then, due to their incompetence, they let themselves be killed. It was an unacceptable complication to my task." {n}If the Tech-Priest's voice carried any compassion for the dead, the dry words that crackled from his vox-system did not convey a shred of it.{/n}

f048eea5-ef98-4983-9338-06caee304edb.Text: "The Omnissiah granted me a revelation. The spirit of this machine was dying, but it wished to perform a service, for such was its design. I sensed this and... appealed to it. I do not know how I did it — I merely followed my intuition. The understanding granted by the Omnissiah was not permanent — it has left me. " {n}The Tech-Priest appears shaken.{/n}

c0dac73c-b94d-47da-8916-3790ff648882.Text: {n}Small wrinkles gather around the Tech-Priest's exposed eye as if he is smiling under his respirator mask.{/n} "Cessation of vital functions is an unavoidable phenomenon and therefore an insignificant one. The doctrine of worship repudiates the fear of death."

78cdf865-cf28-40c2-ae6e-43467f6eeb7c.Text: "Acknowledged. Predicting successful and mutually beneficial cooperation."

a0bd63e9-60a6-481f-aca9-8fd30c65168e.Text: {n}A trill comes from the folds of the partially smouldering crimson raiment — it is binharic speech, the sacred language of the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMechanicus}Adeptus Mechanicus{/g}. The binharic hymn transforms into a {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g}-synthesised voice that sounds like thunder rolling over a vast plain:{/n} "Not another step."

b355b5be-1515-4c38-8e25-73a6bac4c090.Text: {n}The menacing blue-green glow fades in the Tech-Priest's gaze. He lowers his arm, and your equipment ceases to malfunction.{/n} "The convoy received an order to meet you. It is no longer functional, therefore I propose that we continue to advance to the rendezvous point with the governor's soldiers." {n}The Tech-Priest stares resolutely forward, his {g|Encyclopedia:Mechadendrite}mechadendrite tentacles{/g} rising gracefully around his hunched figure, which is illuminated by the flames of the smouldering remains of the machine.{/n}

1e9bf1ae-0f54-4ee2-80b9-a0ef82034ca9.Text: {n}Clenching his teeth, the Seneschal grits out,{/n} "Rogue Trader {name} von Valancius greets you, honoured Tech-Priest, and graciously grants you permission to remain in {mf|his|her} presence."

bf6c4bea-daac-40e6-9fbd-eadf3d2415dd.Text: {n}Abelard steps forward to shield you from the stranger.{/n}

5f96de84-09c1-4a6e-9014-8b2b8cc10d2a.Text: {n}The Tech-Priest's visor focuses on your attire and examines the symbols on it.{/n} "I identify you as a member of a high stratum belonging to Rogue Trader House von Valancius. I am detecting no need for confrontation."

8061f761-d6d7-470c-8f1d-b98ae0b3dfd1.Text: "Altar-Templum-Calixis... I have heard the name before. The station appears on House Orsellio's star charts, in the Furibundus System, not far from the void colony of Footfall. You have travelled a long way to come here, esteemed Magos."

03145e7c-8f74-4446-b1fc-c571a14eff49.Text: {n}Then his expression hardens, and he adds cryptically,{/n} "With my mentor's words, the Omnissiah gives me the algorithm for redemption and triumph in service. I will be redeemed, and I will triumph."

9821af3f-587d-443f-8538-044cc8b447ad.Text: "By the Throne... What is that servant of the Omnissiah made of? Adamantine— Argh, blast it!" {n}Abelard clutches his head as his ocular implant is racked with a wave of interference.{/n}

96f61ff9-5ea2-4811-9e3a-0f42a94693fd.Text: {n}Kibellah stares at him in surprise.{/n} "How strange it is to hear such words from one who is not of the Bloodspun Web... We have much in common."

76a56d02-7ad1-4186-8a92-4166af0a5fd4.Text: {n}His gaunt hand rises to stop you, and immediately your vox howls in pain and your machine equipment starts crackling. The Tech-Priest's blazing power axe disgorges a cloud of righteous sparks, and his visor glows menacingly in blue and green.{/n} "Flee, for I am death."

067e13c3-e3ab-49a4-b29e-0b3db3891919.Text: "How can some pathetic rebellion be cause enough for such a lacklustre welcoming ceremony in honour of a Rogue Trader's arrival? It is an insult."

24be5351-4923-433b-8714-58b2adebdefa.Text: "You must be mistaken. I am the Rogue Trader of House von Valancius."

a986d6a8-64cc-4347-83f0-e397dfe00488.Text: "I am the Rogue Trader von Valancius! Give me a status report, this instant!"

6353f3ae-ac5d-452c-b57c-bee041bc27e9.Text: "How dare you, commoner? On your knees, before I blow your brains out!"

dc3e04bf-7b1f-485f-8611-57b12d11020f.Text: "Is the path ahead dangerous? What exactly awaits me there?"

680b1ae1-9032-4828-8292-7ceef880552e.Text: "You are a good soldier, Malgar. I will see that your heroism is noted."

2ea4140e-507b-42b6-a10e-b33ffa627fde.Text: "A good fighter would have long since reclaimed the starport. Move out and attack, you cowardly knave!"

669ab69d-17b2-4127-bddf-23dbd4e1f47f.Text: "I cannot leave you and your people without aid. Reinforcements will be sent from my ship."

a3d29bdc-1a01-4f53-a762-478e5c2b6c2e.Text: "Some dirty dog nearly shot down my shuttle!"

353bc75e-3629-496a-ad1d-f3d6aba85550.Text: "I am going to see the governor."

f678e567-4b6d-4605-b191-630ae2093adc.Text: "You are a fool. The governor, who is safe and sound in the rear, has left you for dead, and here you are, preaching about glory."

58bd30c9-39ba-4948-ae9f-aeaf54a167fc.Text: "I wish to see the governor of this planet."

2b9db738-00bd-41f9-8677-3c758bd516bb.Text: "Do you happen to know if a member of the Inquisition has come here?"

fc1f2026-d846-44f3-94f1-a87bb0af2f75.Text: [Pat him on the shoulder] "You are doing fine work, Malgar. And so are your troops. It is people like you that hold the Imperium together!"

b11cf653-ffcb-4ea9-b531-1714fc1e8aa4.Text: "Abelard, enlighten this rabble about the proper manner of greeting the God-Emperor's chosen."

bfcce0c4-112a-4477-ae9b-58d232624cce.Text: {n}The starport greets you with the din of ordnance and the smell of explosives tickles your nostrils. It is difficult to tell through the smoke who is firing at whom.{/n}

f8aa620e-1c12-4961-b660-78240caf0bc2.Text: "A very important person from the Adeptus Mechanicus arrived on the last shuttle before they locked down the sky. He kept on asking whether anyone by the name of Amarant or Amarnat or something like that had recently arrived. Barely answered any of our questions, though; said he was under no obligation to tell us anything."

f61cd852-f60b-46b8-9989-0105cb8f07dc.Text: {n}Your imperious tone proves more effective than any official regalia, and the commoner collapses to his knees.{/n}

e657d8dd-ebed-4008-98aa-a870407b9479.Text: {n}At the word {g|Encyclopedia:Inquisition}"Inquisition,"{/g} the sergeant's face fills with awe.{/n} "I don't know, {mf|sir|ma'am}! There definitely haven't been any visitors like that on my watch! You might have to enquire at the headquarters, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, {mf|sir|ma'am}!"

57edb198-5db2-4380-9a1f-a96d9f642453.Text: {n}With a mixture of awe and terror, he snaps to attention, raises his freshly cut chin like an exemplary soldier, and barks,{/n} "My mistake, {mf|sir|ma'am}! At once! The starport is under the control of the governor's wardens! Perimeter commander is Sergea—"

990fab4b-7ebb-4ddb-8a9e-a0574a53cf89.Text: {n}A frag grenade explosion cuts off the rest of the sergeant's words. Shrapnel flies everywhere with a piercing screech. One of the soldiers falls to the ground, clutching the remains of his forearm that is now adorned with crimson tatters. Blood is pouring out of the stump, and the soldier's agony is short-lived. The sergeant curses and hastily says an army prayer for the dead.{/n}

4c03e5fa-2937-47e8-b8aa-ea7bbc2c23ee.Text: "The rebels burned down the palace right at the start, but the governor, by the grace of the Emperor, is still alive and continues to oversee the defence efforts from a fortified command post."

00fa48fd-bf8e-47d5-b170-7f691b0b242c.Text: "{d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Raycad_Early}Nothing good{/d}." {n}The sergeant sighs heavily.{/n} "Those bastards will shoot anyone walking the streets. Our own troops were ordered to fire without warning. You better move with caution, {mf|sir|ma'am} — on top of everything else, we mined the streets when we were pulling out."

5b465485-c596-4c56-8373-241c7f02c5cf.Text: "Affirmative, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, {mf|sir|ma'am}! It's all those damned rebels — those maggots somehow got their hands on an anti-aircraft battery and it's causing our shuttles no end of trouble. That thing really packs a punch! You're lucky they missed you — I've seen them fry two shuttles carrying reinforcements, not a soul survived."

bc1cbf32-e17f-4dc4-b710-4d44d0aa4f81.Text: "Apologies, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, {mf|sir|ma'am}! I couldn't have known, I wasn't notified! Had we known we were expecting such an eminent visitor, we would've... you know... at the double... with all due devotion!"

2cb4dd2a-c812-45d9-9733-472ccd39e04e.Text: "I don't know what the situation is like there now, but the governor's personal vox operator recently made it to the starport. He left us the new vox-codes and departed on a special assignment, but not before telling us that the command post is well-reinforced and in no danger of falling."

1eae0db6-f147-4966-83bb-1c7a4038a442.Text: "Pah, by all the saints! I'm Sergeant Malgar, and you lot report to me now. Straighten yourselves out and drag your arses after me, I'll map out a defence sector for you." {n}By the end of his tirade, the sergeant's voice grows quieter as his eyes focus on your expensive gear.{/n}

cff5942a-b544-4451-8bf6-a11768d8fbd2.Text: "Halt! Weapons on the ground, or I'm firing!" {n}A man in a torn and dirty uniform hobbles toward you from behind the chunks of rockcrete and crumpled plasteel. His cracked helmet is adorned with a crooked label that reads: "Sgt Malgar."{/n}

feb9a599-33d1-4348-b966-afc96c3ed6ec.Text: "If I may report, {mf|sir|ma'am}, as long as the rebels keep shooting their damned anti-aircraft battery, there is absolutely no way to shuttle you to the governor. It would have to be on foot, and the streets are dangerous."

5585146f-be16-4ece-8168-468837b7e688.Text: "I have no one to send with you as an escort — I assigned all available troops to accompany the esteemed Tech-Priest to the governor. I will vox-cast orders to them to wait for you. And I'll inform headquarters — they better send out a convoy to meet you halfway! Meanwhile, we will follow the governor's orders and hold the line here!"

d0839f11-75ec-4301-a4d6-62b3103fc1dc.Text: "I live to serve!" {n}The sergeant's eyes are gleaming with pride. His expression is that of genuine happiness.{/n}

40c7a059-0fc5-4f44-b563-bcbd2cc3600b.Text: "All right, so our skies are in lockdown, the rebels are shooting down anything that flies, and you lot just happened to land in our rear without a scratch to show for it? And on a shuttle like that... Where did you get it? Stolen from the palace, isn't it?" {n}He is visibly awed by the resplendent gold of your transport.{/n} "Grab 'em, lads, we've got ourselves a rebel landing force!"

7c1e1aaf-adb8-42ff-b4a8-624904ba9f8a.Text: "I live to serve!" {n}The sergeant's grim voice rings with a martyr's pride.{/n}

ea51ba4b-febc-44d5-9d51-bf1338b90c93.Text: {n}A shadow of doubt crosses the sergeant's face.{/n} "No surprise there... It's a soldier's lot to serve and die. Not the governor's, though, that's not his duty..." {n}He gives you a flustered look.{/n}

ef5b0c27-3849-477e-a001-d2109ee0ece8.Text: {n}Horror fills the sergeant's eyes.{/n} "Apologies, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, {mf|sir|ma'am}! We will rectify that at once! Follow my lead, you lot! I'm giving you two minutes to reload and patch yourselves up, then we are routing the rebel dregs!" {n}He roars his commands, organising his troops for what is undoubtedly a suicidal offensive.{/n}

f1abd537-764a-4899-a111-33714b9d24c4.Text: "I live to serve!" {n}The sergeant is so astonished that he only barks out the mandated words of gratitude after a non-mandated lengthy pause.{/n} "We won't fail... We won't forget... We'll be praying to the Emperor for you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, {mf|sir|ma'am}!"

e7966628-86c0-46a0-9cd2-40cb70643656.Text: "There is fighting in the capital, but we're {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Raycad_Early}holding strong{/d}, giving no quarter to the rebels! The {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} protects!" {n}The sergeant's voice is brimming with daring confidence.{/n}

f084bff5-3e86-4715-b77c-dfc86ebf2555.Text: {n}His remark about mines lodges itself in your memory. More than anything, you will need to watch the ground and not your surroundings — you'd rather risk a shot from a rebel or a jittery soldier than experience a few handfuls of lethal frag shrapnel resting on top of some three hundred grams of explosive fyceline.{/n}

aae4b843-c04d-4319-b8f9-ed26130fd370.Text: {n}The sergeant's answer is not particularly helpful. When danger is all around you in many forms, it is impossible to prepare for it.{/n}

128c17b3-3c1f-40bc-a829-e43ccd6b433f.Text: {n}With a rasping cough, the sergeant turns back to you.{/n} "Pardon me, {mf|sir|ma'am}. Sergeant Lasse Malgar reporting! My unit is holding the starport on the governor's orders! How may I serve?"

d5a0b736-72d8-4891-b1eb-1634ad109d81.Text: "They're {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Raycad_Late}crushing us{/d}, the scumbags. It's been a whole turn since the last reinforcements came in, we're running low on ammo, every other fighter is wounded. I don't know how bad it is in the streets, but they'll drive us out of here any minute."

ee17c8a4-bbe9-4a45-80e9-09ea1fdbed02.Text: "Sergeant Lasse Malgar, {mf|sir|ma'am}! Eleventh-generation loyal soldier of House Winterscale, awarded three commendations for faultless service. Ever since the olden days, His Lordship the {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} has recruited soldiers and shipwrights on Rykad Minoris, so there is no greater honour for a Rykadian than serving His Lordship with diligence!"

13ed2404-7a9a-4712-9da9-4de31083fe2a.Text: "He demanded to talk to the governor personally, so I had to send a quarter of my troops with him to keep trouble at bay."

f01086ab-d5da-4b31-96d8-324356bcca57.Text: {n}Among the cracked rockcrete and bent plasteel, you notice a man in the warden's uniform. He stares at the gleaming gold of your shuttle in surprise.{/n} "Did the governor send his personal guards? No matter! What are you standing there for, meat? Are you waiting for the rebels to blast your bucket again for good measure? The skies over the capital are blocked by enemy fire, all aerial traffic has been halted! What pest gave you clearance to deploy?"

8ee8d4ac-761f-4700-a36b-fad1be0c11ef.Text: "My unit was here when it all went to the groxes. The {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priests{/g} linked to satellites reported sightings of strange voidships in the system. They were orbiting the star until one of them set course for landing on Rykad Majoris. The governor took precautionary measures and ordered to increase security at the key facilities — everyone knows that whenever something's not right, you better double the warden details. The alarm was raised, and we were sent to secure the starport. It's the only reason we were able to hold it."

070a94a1-fa4d-42d2-857a-3847e6ac7243.Text: {n}Idira frowns as her gaze grows distant, as if she is looking through the sergeant.{/n} "You're a good soldier, but you've got a lot of blood on your hands — both yours and others'. You know, the same hand that salutes now might falter in darkness. Rank and epaulettes won't save you from the bitterness..."

0f6677a4-381e-49d8-8c65-9b7733ec155e.Text: "Pardon me, my lady, but I can't get my head 'round these fancy words you're saying. I've seen plenty of blood, but, trust me, I'll fight till my last drop!"

a538cd5b-108f-47d0-b99b-f7d3e719d204.Text: "Then Felek tore off his mask... precisely because he knew about the trouble on Rykad Minoris. He knew that none of our allies would come to our aid." {n}Cassia lets out a sorrowful sigh.{/n} "You may continue your report, peasant."

c2db9951-33d3-46db-a52a-8c45d7fe17a4.Text: {n}Abelard clears his throat.{/n} "You stand before Rogue Trader von Valancius, you ignorant worm! Snap to attention this instant and give {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship} a formal report!"

9546f33c-d789-4df8-972d-d446353cc2fe.Text: {n}Abelard turns purple.{/n} "By the Holy Throne, what is this mess..."

714f3502-9a99-40ee-8619-3949bf1aee2f.Text: {n}Idira glances around.{/n} "They're in a rough spot, old man. Go easy on them."

d8d5103f-3f80-43a3-9dc4-4ea90822cb09.Text: {n}The sergeant shakes his head in disappointment.{/n} "Ah, if only Sergeant Davian of Tertium was here... He may have completely lost his marbles, but if I'd let him accompany you, you could have walked all the way to the governor's palace without any harm befalling you."

85740e5b-6ca5-4281-be18-54f63c62b46c.Text: "One of ours — a veteran. No idea how he wound up here. The man's from Atoma Prime — the other end of the galaxy. Silent chap, crazy eyes, but you should see him slay enemies of Humanity. There's none like him." {n}The sergeant casts a glance somewhere past the starport.{/n} "When it started, he went missing out in the streets somewhere. Worse news for the rebels, though: he's an absolute beast in close-quarters combat."

5d8318af-c487-4d4a-bd27-3ef5d51205a4.Text: "My mistake, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Didn't recognise you, {mf|sir|ma'am}! Please pardon my blunder, it's a bloodbath in here—"

909cf2a7-6441-41b3-8d75-4c76230a9026.Text: {n}The sergeant sighs heavily.{/n} "All of our roadblocks are gone, the whole place is in the rebels' hands. The city is {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Raycad_Late}almost lost{/d}, so no help will come, we are surrounded by rebels. And watch your step, {mf|sir|ma'am} — the streets are chock-full of mines."

7d77917f-161d-41e6-9e7e-62cb4c4fbbf0.Text: {n}The sergeant blushes slightly.{/n} "I live to serve!"

ea874677-0fe8-425d-95f5-34f9262d4e43.Text: {n}Another explosion interrupts the sergeant's words. With a sigh of relief, he turns to his soldiers and spits out a booming series of commands.{/n}

587dcb89-02e0-49fc-8d9b-c807576a339d.Text: "Ill thoughts, {mf|sir|ma'am}! We've fallen on hard times, the ground keeps shaking, things keep exploding. The people are scared, they've forgotten all about their duty. And that's when those, Emperor forgive me, 'preachers' came... They started riling everyone up! Sure enough, we shot a few, but they just kept coming, more and more of them."

b5535612-0119-45bb-955f-5e9f3eba60a3.Text: {n}The soldier grows more and more pale with every word you say. As soon as you are done speaking, he falls to his knees.{/n}

4875fa9e-ca0b-45c3-9d80-656bd7ff9b30.Text: "Unrest, {mf|sir|ma'am}! Armed rebellions in both the capital and the provinces. First the lower levels sparked, then it went up the spires — they hit the {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox-hubs{/g}, the arsenals, the mag-train stations."

e110cb80-2b89-4efe-923b-d3f998340f3d.Text: "Sergeant, where are the people who were sent to assist you from my ship?"

b522e2be-f2e0-4eb5-af20-685710019c9c.Text: "Another in your position could have forgotten that the Emperor protects all of His subjects. But surely not you. It is your duty to help anyone you can."

f97cbdee-5bf6-47d4-bed8-ed06cd80304c.Text: "Sergeant Malgar, I demand an immediate report! What is going on here?"

bb28d98f-6144-4448-868c-8d54cda0146d.Text: "Governor, would you care to explain to me what is going on here?"

7863dfb3-898a-47c4-89e2-cfd3c1bf1d2f.Text: [Point your weapon at the sergeant] "How dare you treat highborn officials in such a manner?"

2fd3094a-a97a-4b5b-861b-1faf9fe2fdcf.Text: [Point your weapon at the sergeant] "You will drop your weapon, servant, or I will end you like a rabid dog!"

7fcb58a5-8932-4151-944f-f9663be4b012.Text: "Malgar, now is not the time to massacre each other. It is not the first time I have done the impossible — I will get everyone out of here, including your men."

758ae50d-c790-4dcd-a128-93c0515e651f.Text: "I agree. Let us save your people and escape this place."

d43d04b7-7e52-45de-87ad-a73a440ac1a2.Text: Convinced Sergeant Malgar to lay down his arms and not kill the aristocrats.

5babc405-eb76-4365-b0da-badbdb74d2d1.Text: "Look at yourself, servant of the God-Emperor. Whom do you serve? Humanity or its foes? How dare you speak of justice with kindred blood on your hands? Lower your weapon if you value your soul!"

99cc932f-2ad7-4bb9-9373-60cfb27b8a7f.Text: "It would seem you intend to rise up against the very foundations of the Imperium."

2fb0e0d0-2655-4a8e-a2e7-26b0a4c8faa8.Text: "Do you truly wish to see them dead? Each and every one of them?"

8763f6ba-411d-44d6-aef0-49bbb626025f.Text: "I care nothing for these people, just get me and my retinue off this planet."

58fea3c3-1da5-4656-812c-77d492789b16.Text: [Address the nobles] "Would anyone like to say anything to Sergeant Malgar?"

3d0b4904-c02b-4e4c-aa3e-fb083db7d2a2.Text: "You are acting like an executioner. You think you have such a right?"

97e5ec58-a320-46c6-967c-e0f634829723.Text: [Examine the people in front of the shuttle]

ac8909c3-8880-4a52-867b-19595104e271.Text: {n}The sergeant holds your gaze for a long moment, then with a heavy sigh he lowers his weapon.{/n} "If anyone else had said that to me, I would have laughed and spit at their feet. But you're a {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_MOT_GreatDeed}hero of the Imperium{/d}. If even half the stories of your exploits are true... Well, I will trust you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, {mf|sir|ma'am}."

97215ee5-2ec2-4661-aae8-e1c389502325.Text: {n}The stench of fyceline and blood blankets the starport. Echoes of shouts and gunfire drift over the landing pads. The shards of plex-glass crunch underfoot. You recognise Sergeant Malgar amid the crowd huddled next to the shuttles — he was the soldier who greeted you upon your arrival on Rykad Minoris.{/n}

ee0da2bb-867a-418d-8d75-84d4e3ce2901.Text: {n}The governor turns to you but does not get the chance to say anything as Malgar strikes him with a stun baton.{/n} "Don't trouble yourself, Lord Governor. I'll explain myself!"

77907224-74d5-4144-a365-2b52ae596084.Text: "So, since my people aren't highborn, they can be treated however you like, is that it?" {n}Malgar lets out a bestial growl as he turns to face you.{/n} "I'm not letting anyone go! I'll show them what it's like being left for dead!"

25ee96d6-cff2-4a47-b629-f59297ee5f32.Text: "They already went back to your ship, {mf|sir|ma'am}." {n}Malgar is trying to sound respectful, but his voice is vibrating like a taut string.{/n} "Good people, your soldiers, they {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_SergeantGrateful}helped us out{/d}. Unlike this carrion!" {n}He looks back at the nobles.{/n}

efd040ef-68f6-4d09-998d-17abea7f55ad.Text: {n}An angry murmur runs through the group of nobles. Some are uttering the deceased governor's name in horror, others are begging you to kill the deranged warden, some are hoarsely wishing eternal torment upon Malgar. But none dare to raise their voice and answer you.{/n}

ba546824-255d-42c9-9bff-387a335c11eb.Text: {n}The sergeant's chest is fitted with a sturdy-looking flak vest bearing insignia customary among your troops. One of the {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_SergeantGrateful}enforcers you sent{/d} must have given it to Malgar as a gift.{/n}

cb08c629-5d50-4d9d-ae5e-330225d93fec.Text: "That's not true. I am loyal to the Imperium — the Imperium of Man, the Imperium of the {g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Golden Throne{/g}. I am ready to fight the darkness among the stars and aid {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}His{/g} servants, so that His design may triumph. But I refuse to believe that the Imperium needs a bunch of arrogant nobles more than us honest workers and warriors."

310e4c69-2510-4ef5-a972-6f37805dc7c0.Text: {n}The sergeant frowns at you.{/n} "I don't know why you stick up for these parasites. They never would have helped someone like me. But they don't deserve to die either, you're right about that. Not all of them, at least."

fc5a5028-dc2d-4c98-8fa1-d59f4d754d09.Text: {n}The sergeant pauses before nodding heavily.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, {mf|sir|ma'am}, you {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_SergeantGrateful}helped{/d} us when things looked grim for us. I'll do as you say. Why you want to save these parasites, that I don't understand. But maybe not all of them deserve death."

e2b7e82d-627d-408f-8b4b-2524edd7768a.Text: {n}The sergeant simply shakes his head.{/n} "Do what you will, {mf|sir|ma'am}, but I'm not helping! I refuse to save the selfish scum who were about to leave me and those I hold dear here to die!"

b11a2c7a-09b4-41ec-996c-b81630b1f0d8.Text: {n}The sergeant shakes his head.{/n} "No! You may have {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_SergeantGrateful}helped{/d} us, but that doesn't mean that I will be saving these leeches! But I won't stop you from leaving either, in honour of your good deeds. Save yourself, {mf|sir|ma'am}."

b55aa776-789a-428f-85c8-0a828e1d0ce7.Text: {n}Malgar bares his teeth like a madman.{/n} "Oh, now you feel like barking orders too, do you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}? Figured you could get your privileged arse off this planet before our families? Go ahead and try."

257f7734-5541-4ad7-b0a5-63885a1133c8.Text: {n}Abelard looks at the governor's body, his brow furrowed.{/n} "Madness... punishable by death."

49530714-e59e-44ef-b2d1-b4fbb61c823a.Text: "I do! The decision to leave the commoners on the planet did come from the governor, but they supported it! They're accomplices! No one tried to stand up for us."

74b33a21-bdae-409f-9970-eb51d6fb18ba.Text: "As much right as they do when they act as our executioners! We are but common subjects of the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}."

8ae62a93-8cef-4176-86fa-77f3c52372bc.Text: {n}Malgar nods heavily.{/n} "All right. You {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_SergeantGrateful}didn't abandon{/d} us in our hour of need, and neither will we. Get aboard any of these shuttles, we'll take you to orbit."

777160a1-3988-4751-8d0d-96ed7121c417.Text: {n}Malgar aims his own weapon back at you and lets out an angry, almost deranged chuckle.{/n} "Nothing scares me anymore, {mf|sir|ma'am}, so I won't falter!"

f25bf7b6-ac23-4c83-aa6c-64ee3c38c6d6.Text: {n}Idira flinches and starts babbling desperately:{/n} "No, no, no, don't say anything, don't say anything, don't say anything..."

3ec895fe-af6a-4df7-b2b9-710ad4459b2a.Text: {n}A group of bloodied and frightened people is wedged between Malgar's wardens and the shuttles. You recognise them as the governor of the planet and the members of his high-ranking entourage. Their expensive attire has been torn in the fight and many bear wounds left by bayonets.{/n}

5e11bb77-c07a-430e-ae11-4a2ef8cbcd0c.Text: {n}The chorus of the nobles' screams cannot drown out the sergeant's spiteful whisper:{/n} "Enough. You've said your piece."

2fdfd743-ddc9-4492-b968-eae94bbbce01.Text: "We don't have time for this. We need to get to the shuttle, now."

e3802460-8323-4a8f-b8e3-19887f55fbc1.Text: "{d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_SergeantFreeThinking}You were right{/d} when we first met, {mf|sir|ma'am}." {n}Malgar mutters through his teeth.{/n} "Now I can see that the governor is a scumbag, unworthy of even a drop of our blood."

86cf3ab9-4e3c-49bc-a634-99edbc3f65dd.Text: {n}The sergeant spins around to face you, his face a twisted grimace of anger.{/n}

3d583ac3-1272-4f24-b8e0-a536e92149b4.Text: "Our esteemed governor and his gang of cronies have been cowering behind us, and now, when things got rough, they thought they could scarper. And leave us here to die! We've shed our blood for him and broken our backs to provide for him! And after all this? You think that's fair, you piece of {g|Encyclopedia:Grox}groxshit{/g}?" {n}Malgar's stun baton hits the governor in the chest, causing the adornments on the governor's uniform to jingle in unison.{/n}

d01333ef-07bd-40d1-a188-e4d66fce0bf7.Text: "I knew you would understand!" {n}The sergeant's voice is trembling slightly. He signals his troops and turns to the shuttle, about to board it.{/n}

c7ae8887-52a8-44bb-8880-d8bf381623bb.Text: {n}A dull thud comes from deep within the starport. Heavy footsteps shake the rockcrete, raising an unpleasant tremor in your bones.{/n}

0dfeffbb-4872-4d0a-8ced-d81ff540f9f7.Text: {n}The governor spits out blood and opens his mouth to respond, when his head explodes. His body falls limp to the side, his remaining eye staring upward.{/n}

7f7b2769-7a7b-49ca-9176-6713ffcfe192.Text: {n}Malgar raises his gun at you, only to immediately lower it. His hands are shaking. Shame and despair are showing through his mask of bloodlust.{/n} "For crying out loud, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship, {mf|sir|ma'am}... How could you say such a thing..."

854645b2-519d-427c-bc4b-bfb84095aa70.Text: {n}Some of the nobles are paralysed with fear, others have succumbed to despair. Two corpses are lying on the ground with their arms outstretched. Black blood has pooled under one of them. The other's skull has been split open like a nut, encircled by a pinkish-crimson halo of bone splinters and bits of brain matter.{/n}

f4c1a7b1-c6b3-4977-95ad-838b9f089f04.Text: "For generations upon generations, the nobles of this world cared for Rykad Minoris and ensured the prosperity of its inhabitants. And this is your gratitude, peasant? For killing a nobleman, you deserve to be executed where you stand." {n}Cassia throws out her hand, and Malgar's knees buckle.{/n} "My mentor was right — the rabble truly have no honour."

abf7b4d4-a863-4b21-b3fb-2e7a9bc7aa31.Text: "There is something else you are hiding from me, isn't there? More classified secrets?"

244c9860-11bb-4c60-81bb-13c6d096a282.Text: "Pray not for her survival, but for her honourable death, should it come to it."

fec9f857-99a5-4233-89eb-41c5edee9645.Text: "I hope that no harm comes to her."

986d7e6e-fb0a-40dd-ac75-6d3989df739a.Text: "And what exactly were you doing here on your own?"

5de6e214-0eb7-4f0b-9968-6bb784102493.Text: "I am a Rogue Trader. Why don't I simply order you to tell me everything? It is well within my rights."

73a6e10f-93be-482b-bcbf-2118ba7de2c8.Text: "What if what you know is priceless intelligence? And you were to die before you could relay it to anyone?"

84d4928f-3d64-4ef9-80aa-4cb31ece87dc.Text: "Whatever punishment you are afraid of, I can do worse things to you. You had better start talking."

7cf813ed-cf16-4abd-844d-318c39228f9a.Text: "So be it, then. You may keep your secrets."

6907d70a-0a5f-4d10-9f8c-c077592e2fec.Text: "I am looking for an Interrogator of the Inquisition who may have arrived on this planet. Have you heard of anyone matching that description?"

7af4914d-e5f7-48d1-9ea1-f58e91815bcc.Text: "Do you think the governor can handle the rebellion?"

46c31c98-4ce9-4e32-a8c7-c5fbd40ce973.Text: [Wink at Idira] "Mistress Tlass, would you kindly read all his thoughts for me?"

f349a142-3175-4075-94bb-0d6f6e2630bc.Text: "So why did they send you to the starport?"

1d7e72fa-0782-4690-a1ba-0b358e8c671c.Text: "Good. Despondency gets you dragged in front of a firing squad."

39b0b256-c187-4fb6-a63d-c6b77ffacd54.Text: [Brutally maim him] "You know, I think I will punish you for disclosing classified information after all."

6b8b6af4-bc54-44b6-9cef-d64b11b011b0.Text: [Strike him] "Get out of my sight. You are a waste of my time!"

93a13356-dc68-42f7-a89e-3224000864f6.Text: "Worry not, for your Raquel is alive. I met her on Rykadi Philia."

f9936d04-192c-4fde-bd5d-f65affe3aaf3.Text: {n}He falls to the ground with a cry. His once-handsome face has been disfigured by a deep laceration, he is missing half an ear, and his nose is crushed and twisted to one side. It is unlikely that Jaspar can afford a sawbones capable of restoring his good looks.{/n}

d6576133-d5f2-4859-9654-e05b688bd790.Text: {n}Jaspar looks away.{/n} "It's nothing classified, just... personal. There's another reason why I'm here. My betrothed is missing. Raquel Vekhari, the esteemed Evayne Winterscale's personal pilot. When the riot reports came from Rykadi Philia, Lord Evayne headed there personally. Then this rebellion started down here, and we lost communication. No one knows how they're doing up there."

a3df5834-2a4a-4c3a-adaa-decffce531b9.Text: {n}Idira winks back at you slyly.{/n} "As you wish, Lord Captain! We'll reveal all his secrets in a jiff! Though I can't guarantee that his brains won't melt into mush in the process. But that's collateral, right?"

1af4fc92-7499-40d7-9844-c3e3bc78435d.Text: {n}He shuts his eyes, bracing for an attack on his mind.{/n} "With all due respect, my {mf|lord|lady}, I can't let you do that! My mind is like rockcrete, so even your witch couldn't pull a thing out of it." {n}Though, he doesn't sound particularly confident.{/n}

2ad3477a-4b17-4425-9d94-193e90633d52.Text: {n}He grimaces and blushes, but still shakes his head.{/n} "I can't. I just can't. I'm an aide... a confidant!"

302956d8-1d35-488d-881e-91a5aca5e8f4.Text: "The esteemed and honourable scion of blessed Rogue Trader Calligos Winterscale, master of the Rykad System. At the behest of his illustrious father... or grandfather... or uncle... well, his illustrious relative, Lord Evayne took up residence on Rykad Minoris."

b93e7a9b-09ee-46d2-9a5c-9c7136f5e857.Text: "The Emperor protects, my {mf|lord|lady}. If someone you love is in trouble right now, may He protect them too."

275137f5-3f01-42d0-9658-971f66be807f.Text: "Forgive me, my {mf|lord|lady}, but my wish is to see my Raquel alive again. She's... She's everything to me."

c3f8f782-8455-40cf-a33f-7a50ef87d29f.Text: {n}Jaspar smiles, but his smile looks a little less carefree than a few moments ago.{/n}

c2d2ab8c-713b-47bd-b6ea-8a5a58c272c8.Text: {n}He stops talking — a little too abruptly.{/n}

7b810092-4328-4d3b-8121-0d2b32acd223.Text: {n}This chatty officer is every spy's dream. He is pathologically incapable of keeping his mouth shut.{/n}

14d22f52-af2c-447a-a89d-24221cbf03f7.Text: "It was my pleasure to be of service to you, my {mf|lord|lady}. It's been nice to chat to someone... normal." {n}He glances warily at the body of the nearest blinded lunatic.{/n}

4ac104d7-9a24-49fc-ba46-697b462bba9a.Text: "Well, all right, if you really are a Rogue Trader, I'll tell you everything."

ae28e718-cb32-499a-a564-d629da0004cb.Text: "Well, that would make me a saboteur and a traitor, wouldn't it? Yes, you're right! This is an emergency!" {n}He looks relieved.{/n}

a2ac7fef-700d-405f-b288-a8a81efd8ad8.Text: "I give up. No need to do anything to me." {n}He does not look frightened, however — relieved is more like it. He glances around with a conspiratorial look and whispers,{/n} "Please don't tell anyone, all right? Or the governor will make sure I'm punished."

e5ae8cad-801e-4904-b4c0-1db673256969.Text: {n}Jaspar's face quickly turns grey as he says,{/n} "I have. But I don't know where he is now. I'm sorry, but I don't like discussing the affairs of the {g|Encyclopedia:Inquisition}Inquisition{/g}."

f5372a45-58e7-4307-9f42-1ff78e4bc037.Text: "I have studied several deceased individuals with similar injuries. Their sensory organs were removed by means of thermal influence of concentrated light beams. The tissue samples obtained from the wounds have demonstrated a predisposition toward unnatural, impossible mutations that defy the laws formulated by the Magos Biologis."

187a3507-e4d4-4050-9843-4788f3492ba6.Text: "There's not much anyone could tell you about it. That station belongs to the Navis Nobilite themselves. {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} knows what they do up there or who even lives there. They scorn ordinary folk; the only person they're willing to grace with an audience is the esteemed Evayne Winterscale."

59b94ec1-cc68-442f-8d16-29292a610a78.Text: {n}He gives you a pleading look.{/n} "Please don't torment me like this, my {mf|lord|lady}! I wish I could tell you, but it's absolutely prohibited."

25fcf702-f045-4c2d-bc94-6ecdde16d7ba.Text: {n}Jaspar mumbles evasively,{/n} "Well, obviously. I'm not some pessimist to say otherwise..."

defab292-b797-4c19-abb3-3c12a540cd97.Text: "You really won't? Well then, if you ask me, things are pretty rotten!" {n}His words come flying at the rate of stubber fire.{/n} "Those rebels are strange. We would've easily quelled a normal riot — we're not some commoners, we're Rykadians, the naval elite of House Winterscale. But those people, they're... vicious. They know no fear."

b5af686c-7d7b-403c-ab79-8cd9f469ee73.Text: "Is this a test, my {mf|lord|lady}? Everything will be fine, victory will be ours, glory to House Winterscale."

3be8b2c4-ef75-43f6-a7dd-a1ae9a89d041.Text: "And their attacks, they're so precise, it's like they know what's going to happen ahead of time. The command executed seven officers on suspicion of espionage, but it's not about spying. They say the leader of the rebels is some 'two-faced' Aurora who can see into the future. Now, she is the real danger."

31f93022-331b-4a74-9624-f8d3a3cfa72e.Text: "I'm supposed to deliver updated {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g}-codes and, how should I put it... assess the situation. The planet is a real mess at the moment — the rebels have found their way into our vox-net and are now eavesdropping. This made proper communication impossible. The Hallowed Electrodynamic Cenobium had sent out a distress call before it went dark."

6aea5721-0873-4774-86c1-60d212f9b4c3.Text: {n}It is beginning to sound like he is complaining.{/n} "That place is creepy. They say they order shuttles with servants from Rykad Minoris on a regular basis. I guess they're too important up there to change filters and clean compartments themselves, huh? Except, I've never met anyone who has served there. It's like no one ever comes back."

5c4ffb33-0957-498a-9299-e34339a7a985.Text: "A {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}?" {n}After casting a quick glance over your gear, he nods in understanding.{/n} "Oh, so you must be from House von Valancius's ship! The starport's augur surveillance station reported that it had detected your ship entering the system. Then you heaved to, sent a shuttle to another unidentified ship — a very strange one at that — and then that ship departed."

8af7932a-7a0f-44e5-9f0f-4aa6f3f4a8fb.Text: "The fault is mine! I beg your forgiveness, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Orders are orders..." {n}He shrinks, looking at you in terror, and departs with haste. It seems your anger scares him far more than the prospect of running into more rebels.{/n}

ba72e972-f170-43d4-af08-d07a037bb026.Text: "You know what I'm afraid of? That they'll come back, and those rebel scumbags will shoot them out of the sky. I wanted to find a place that's high up, set up a vox-caster there, and send them a transmission: 'The sky is closed off, don't try to land.' But I didn't make it in time — those blind dogs chased after me, and as I was running, I tripped and broke the caster." {n}He hangs his head sadly.{/n} "I worry for her. She's an excellent pilot, but I still worry."

d0174220-32f0-412a-b929-037a948b09eb.Text: {n}He glances at you sadly and says,{/n} "But still, I can't divulge anything classified. You may be a Rogue Trader, but I have my orders. And if I don't follow them, the governor will have my tongue ripped out and demote me to a servitor."

c4113633-e8e5-4017-ace2-8f5be5c9ef62.Text: "Really? That's marvellous! May the Emperor protect you for a thousand years and then a thousand more for bringing me such good news!" {n}He beams in elation.{/n} "I'll name my firstborn after you, I swear! In fact, I'll name all my children after you!"

08d882d3-7e48-4edb-b70e-d3ba9acacac1.Text: "You're right, we shouldn't stay here or we might run into rebels. I'll go find a safe place to watch the sky for any landing shuttles. May the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} protect you, my {mf|lord|lady}."

3ab2c16a-1611-41a2-bac1-11403be7efb5.Text: {n}Jaspar's face betrays a fierce inner struggle before he blurts out,{/n} "You know what I think? I find it curious that blessed Calligos didn't make him the ruler of our world. Lord Evayne is his blood, but it's the governor who rules us! Then why do you think he sent him here? I think he's been exiled!"

4b3eaa9d-e078-45c4-b71b-620e5fe6bdb0.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Mercy! I... I confided in you and only you... It won't happen again, I swear! You were right to punish me, I won't tell anyone anything I'm not supposed to ever again! Please, spare my life!" {n}He staggers back in terror without taking his eyes off you. The telltale brand you left on his face is crying blood, staining the rockcrete.{/n}

6b788fdc-b73f-4653-a9f2-f87fe6f1c77b.Text: {n}He pales, his eyes darting between you and Idira.{/n} "N-no need, my {mf|lord|lady}! I'd rather volunteer everything myself than let this one rummage around in my head — she might break something. But I beg of you, don't tell anyone, or the governor will turn my brains to mush for sure."{g|Encyclopedia:Psyker}{/g}

974f0faf-014f-4a31-803a-fefe47401b25.Text: "As if there was much to pull out..." {n}Idira sighs and shakes her head.{/n}

c6181051-4c4a-4641-87a6-38970784629d.Text: "Your brothers and sisters lived and died for a great cause — serving a Navigator House and therefore all of the Imperium. It is a high honour, one that few could bear."

feeb740e-e42c-4683-9c79-53a5ab27d299.Text: {n}Idira scoffs and rubs her hands together in excitement.{/n} "She can see into the future, is that right? We'll see about that — she's up against the wrong psyker! My breezy whispers may be vague, but they've not failed me once. I can tell you without asking my ethereal friends that her future doesn't look too bright now that the Lord Captain is involved."

b484a391-7f48-4ef5-96ce-59fbf7762339.Text: "As if there was much to pull out..." {n}Idira sighs and shakes her head.{/n}

ca283cac-cbc2-46fb-82a6-9a48245103bb.Text: {n}Only now does Jaspar notice Cassia, and his eyes go wide with fear. He opens and closes his mouth a few times helplessly like a fish, unable to utter a sound. Instead, he just nods nervously.{/n}

70197470-ab1b-4d77-b59b-dac778b79ab5.Text: {n}The young, shaggy-haired soldier is still pale; nonetheless, as you approach, he holsters his pistol — the hallmark of good discipline. He gives you a somewhat frightened but genuine smile.{/n} "Thank you, my {mf|lord|lady}. You arrived in the nick of time. I don't know what those babbling creeps wanted with me, but it definitely wasn't anything good."

22f6af7f-fd6c-4881-8cb4-bec95f2ace1a.Text: {n}Abelard shakes his head disapprovingly, but his eyes are understanding.{/n} "That is why all members of a voidship clan share the same employment. No matter how devoted a servant of the Emperor is to their duty, there is always the danger that family ties might disrupt regulations and order."

3b73b30c-642a-4737-850d-0b6684882e96.Text: {n}Jaspar pauses for a second, then mumbles,{/n} "But, uh, the augur surveillance station's reports are not to be disclosed to third parties... But you know that already, don't you?"

1248f3bd-9974-4eeb-894a-1db250da827d.Text: "Lucky Jaspar, the governor's aide and personal vox operator. I was dispatched to the starport on special orders," {n}the young man proclaims, desperately trying to tame his tousled hair.{/n}

c3b47266-c955-4a70-b73e-af630cdd629d.Text: "I hypothesise that this act of mutilation is part of some blasphemous ritual intended to invoke the {g|Encyclopedia:Chaos}Archenemy{/g}, rather than a typical case of prisoner torture."

0f24ae9a-b0fd-4a41-888d-482bbcae7b17.Text: "All thanks to you, my {mf|lord|lady}. Those blind lunatics are all over the city right now! These rebels, damn them to the void, go around maiming anyone they get their hands on and scorching their eyes. Then they leave the poor sods driven mad by the pain to wander the streets, babbling nonsense."

51dbfec9-8fd7-49c6-980b-cfb1f4e3bc03.Text: {n}He lowers his voice and adds with gravity,{/n} "The command doesn't want anyone to talk about it, but I've heard whispers that it's not just some nonsense — it's heresy, actual heresy. Because listening to it scrambles your brain. It made one patrolman freeze in his tracks while the blind mob got hold of him and carried him from his post off to who knows where."

cece2193-fc9d-4561-8c96-44779b4b19a0.Text: "And who even knows what's happening in the system. There's been a riot on Rykadi Philia, the prison planetoid. Eurac V Station is silent, although, the Navigators there have always been a reclusive bunch. I was hoping I'd be lucky enough to run into a pilot or captain here who could give me an update, but... that's hardly a possibility right now — the rebels are blasting anything that tries to land out of the sky with their damn cannon."

73dde09e-1562-40dc-a14d-6b4e617be5d0.Text: "Following Governor Medineh's special instructions, namely..." {n}He grits his teeth with a pained expression, furrowing his brow.{/n} "Oh, right, it's a secret assignment, I can't talk about it."

9596ba95-071c-4349-ba66-0d3c4fbe62a4.Text: "What was that weapon they fired at us?"

9447cf7d-8e65-4a92-aa47-56e3088a6d99.Text: "Take me to the governor's command post."

752eb59c-2ab8-40c9-8911-768e7f6549b8.Text: {n}The pilot dressed in a crumpled uniform adorned with the von Valancius coat of arms still looks quite pale. Her white hands bear red marks left by the wheel. The scream of terror she let out when the missile flew right past your shuttle is etched in your memory.{/n}

546bdf1a-7953-429d-a84d-380fb86349cc.Text: "Lord Captain, the pilot is right — we cannot put your life at such risk. We will have to wait until the governor's forces deal with this menace... or until the rebels run out of shells... Surely they aren't sitting on a whole depot of them..."

06f4600a-ad53-422d-bbce-e6ec3356ebf2.Text: "Can't say I know, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, but the shots it fires certainly fly quick. I've never seen guns like that before. And they were firing from far away — almost from beyond the bar... the horizon, that is. Who gave those yobs a terrifying contraption like that?"

97df9fc3-3326-442f-9d02-e2c215b4eac8.Text: "My bad, there, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Senior flyer... Senior pilot Nimas, appointed by the senior deck officer to serve on your personal shuttle."

23dae718-ec76-4eb3-972f-4ccb4e830fe8.Text: "I'm awful sorry, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, but... I can't. The Emperor saved us once, but if they shoot at us again, we'll be blown to smithereens for sure. If I get Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} killed in such a daft fashion, {g|Encyclopedia:Drusians}Saint Drusus{/g} will make me polish white-hot wing flaps with my tongue after I kick the bucket!"
