85b6b824-96ce-4310-b965-34fc30b3e75b.Text: {n}More and more technical terms and percentages creep into her speech. She quotes {g|Encyclopedia:Lexmechanic}Lexmechanic{/g} reports and accounts of starship captains. Astartia's vigour and sharp mind are enough to silence even the most venomous of commentators. They all stand there in silence, trying to digest what she's saying.{/n}

b27c6efa-bd38-42ca-adb4-b3bbbb482ad2.Text: {n}Abelard surveys the quiet nobles with triumph, and then looks at his great-granddaughter with pride.{/n}

ce50c368-c531-487e-82a1-8daedd8f25a9.Text: "My apologies, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}." {n}Cowed, she lowers her head, grimacing in frustration.{/n}

d0081cb4-d31b-47f4-9cbf-1527e8dccfd5.Text: {n}Abelard's jaw tenses as he keeps silent, albeit with visible effort.{/n}

af5739ce-545a-43ba-a833-9a68489789ff.Text: {n}Drivestem glowers at Astartia with cold hostility while young Sauerback does not even try to hide his burning contempt.{/n}

6046893e-f746-4b0f-bbc7-2f9bf27ba32f.Text: "In that case, allow me to be the first to offer them." {n}Drivestem snaps his fingers, and several servants approach you with gifts. The governor points at a thin, curved {g|Encyclopedia:Drukhari}Drukhari{/g} blade.{/n} "My soldiers took this splendid trophy from the body of one of the {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g} commanders. The weapon is too beautiful and forbidden for anyone but Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

52232e64-e310-483f-8885-30a6821c63a5.Text: {n}Young Sauerback squeezes through to be the next, pushing Gaprak aside with confidence.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, House Sauerback anticipates the onset of unsettled and bloody times. To make the ungodly xenos cower at your approach, my family humbly presents you with a dozen pieces of secondary armament for your ship."

fdec91a2-de99-4bb3-b89e-14c3585e3c99.Text: {n}Young Gaprak bows ceremoniously.{/n} "House Gaprak is delighted to present you this blessed work of the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}'s smiths. May this locator matrix, which took the holy artisan an entire lifetime to create, always show you the right path."

1d3c3521-1a49-42fd-a4b5-a76bbe2c480b.Text: {n}Having let the aristocrats go first as a sign of deference, Abelard is the last to speak.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, House Werserian possesses no relics worthy of your acceptance, but we are rich in talented and hardworking people. As a sign of our loyalty, I humbly offer you my flesh and blood. A hundred of my kin will go to colonies in your protectorate and use all their talents so that the worlds in your charge may prosper."

ef883de7-ece6-403c-a9dd-c6e005dbe462.Text: {n}The young woman in Werserian colours is the last to speak.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, we are a young house, and our coffers hold no great relics. But we have people, loyal and able. On behalf of my family, I present you with a hundred Werserians. They will scatter throughout your colonies and exert their best efforts to bring prosperity to your worlds and yourself."

585aa099-47fd-4130-9b38-c4ae8cdae5aa.Text: "But I was so much more amazed by your generosity. The provisions that are being handed out in the streets of the capital will make the difference between life and death for many of those who lost everything in the {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g} attack."

25273fe7-92fe-4a3f-ba49-96cf5eea2d68.Text: {n}Which could be quite advantageous to Lady Gaprak — after all, the disaster on Kiava Gamma has left her family in an extremely vulnerable position. The Werserians stand apart, their exclusion from the rest palpable.{/n}

db06bf3c-8902-4021-ba23-a6ec2ecb39fc.Text: "He is alive and well, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I imagine you will see for yourself soon. And please accept my gratitude for being so kind as to lend him your shuttle. The Inquisition values the assistance of the truly faithful children of the Emperor."

a3c863ff-742f-4b11-9ff7-c76a44423166.Text: {n}Drivestem is, obviously, still the leader of Dargonus aristocracy. But, judging by the courtesy he is showing to young Sauerback, he clearly wants to strengthen his relationship with that house. The elder Sauerback and Gaprak are nowhere to be seen, which can mean only one thing: Sauerback, whose line holds you in little regard, is surely attempting to draw Gaprak to his side.{/n}

8ace5772-3b21-49ff-8a19-ac258d101d3b.Text: {n}You begin to ponder the intricacies of the political landscape of your capital, but your only reward for the effort is a headache.{/n}

53cc8913-bcae-464b-93b6-60d631b8000f.Text: "I could not help but notice an ally of non-human origin standing beside Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} at the ceremony. I see that as a sign of unfolding possibilities for... ah... collaboration between the protectorate and the xenos races. The opportunity is most thrilling. I would be delighted to serve Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} in this arena."

5cb4e67f-bfcc-46be-b77c-299fcf429e43.Text: {n}Staring at you, Brasswhisper adds gravely,{/n} "I saw your companion during the ceremony. Rumour has it that she..." {n}Another series of wheezes.{/n} "...partakes in the {g|Encyclopedia:ColdTrade}Cold Trade{/g}. Be careful with the dangerous curios that her associates will try to sell you."

e55995a9-6839-4f4d-a438-38a43e371716.Text: "By having a member of the {g|Encyclopedia:Inquisition}Inquisition{/g} by your side at the ceremony, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} has shown your intent to closely abide by the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}'s credo — to root out the xenoscourge! And House Sauerback will offer every support to you in this righteous undertaking!"

37949b45-4a8e-403c-b7f4-b689c8dda010.Text: "I appreciate your display of loyalty to the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}. By having one of the Holy Ordo's members at your side during the ceremony, you have demonstrated that you consider yourself a {mf|son|daughter} in the fold of our reverent organisation."

ba9b3957-c176-43d6-8d40-7eb774620628.Text: "Modesty forbids my esteemed forebear to say this himself, so I will. Our entire family is grateful to you for wishing to see someone of Werserian blood at your side as you claim your inheritance."

bbde33cd-cae0-47ec-8f87-74a1a21d0b56.Text: {n}Drivestem exchanges telling glances with young Sauerback, who, judging by his face, is suddenly finding the collar of his expensive frock coat uncomfortably tight.{/n}

9ad38084-afae-45e0-8fd1-ee5458fc96a6.Text: {n}Drivestem's words have clearly shaken Astartia's confidence. Her speech becomes confused and unconvincing. All you can tell from her rambling is that she is obsessed with the idea of setting up some kind of network of beacons... and that this idea should probably be scrapped. At last, red with shame, Astartia stops.{/n}

a33bcbc9-1609-4016-a5a9-688d494d2098.Text: {n}Young Gaprak is gawking at Astartia with a strange and somewhat dull-witted expression.{/n}

32de176a-aba5-4ea5-8a4b-d3ccd3dde1ae.Text: {n}The Lord Inquisitor appears to be in amiable temper today. His expression is relaxed, and his calm gaze does not bode any immediate or harsh punishment.{/n}

fb3ab634-3126-480e-a332-ee211c984835.Text: {n}Among the many {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}augmentations{/g}, what stands out is the horribly melted, deformed {g|Encyclopedia:Cogitator}cogitator{/g} connected to the {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priest{/g}'s head. How it is working is baffling. What is twice as baffling is that the Tech-Priest hasn't replaced it yet — what unpredictable influence can this ruined implant have on his mind?{/n}

1775fb2a-57d5-4aa7-8681-2073a37f8ffc.Text: "I see you are interested in my companion Pasqal. I will grant you the privilege of conversing with him."

863914eb-a973-4108-b75d-5eccae069d43.Text: "I promise to answer whenever I am not occupied with conquest and destruction of the enemies of Humanity."

d2ddb1ab-b709-4ac6-a085-a5aa21ba98f0.Text: "I doubt your correspondence will be an interesting read."

134aa823-c03f-4fdd-9092-c137d9b048ae.Text: "I do not have time for you right now."

4ff0c272-9ac8-4747-b670-1b8789d16005.Text: [Look stern] "Macharius, you should talk to your spouse about what passes for decent conduct in high society and what does not."

b2fcf942-ecaf-437c-9179-192fe5272367.Text: "Do your part to heal the wounds inflicted on Kiava Gamma and your house will be forgiven."

2c91d960-4e16-4890-b580-defea0b30f39.Text: "It pleases me to see that our perspectives align. I, too, think that you are to blame for everything."

898b6333-6572-441f-86c0-1d2c2d4e5e1b.Text: "Macharius, I'm surprised you deigned to make an appearance here this evening."

9ae4a8e4-64cb-4928-8cd7-69cc060d5f7e.Text: "Rogue Traders are not renegades vested with authority. We are the long arm of the Imperium, and I shall prove it to you."

239f1d41-6aa2-444d-9b48-30febcfa31cf.Text: "Your poor head, tormented with so many concerns. Would you like to have it removed from your shoulders?"

2eb01d34-3766-4876-89a4-712830c54be1.Text: "You speak of the sector's future with such confidence — could it be that you want this power for yourself, that you simply envy Rogue Traders?"

9d74ed54-1d5c-4d76-acd3-347ea26b1360.Text: "I wish to know more about House Sauerback."

45673e5a-ad98-4c4c-8f0a-c070487a8ec0.Text: "Even in leisure, you never cease to be of help. I appreciate it."

40d68354-7f94-47a5-842b-a06df7c08f54.Text: "Stop it! Do you ever act like anything other than a grubby spy?"

b5fb8f5e-f4f2-4d48-9729-f66c2bd5f919.Text: "What can you tell me about my guests?"

8412c1c0-03f3-4340-845e-f3185c28a807.Text: "It is my pleasure. Macharius is lucky to have such a beautiful wife. Perhaps more so than you are to have him."

fcdd487f-84a4-4e49-9b19-5e165b6b09d6.Text: "Your countenance is familiar somehow. Could it be your resemblance to the image of Saint Maletta?"

39d55027-e165-4f1b-9961-61fd4e86eb36.Text: [Point your weapon at Macharius and chuckle] "You know, Macharius, a person could kill for a woman so gorgeous."

c0d06f35-026f-4550-81fe-73d8b3004299.Text: "I shan't continue to test Macharius's loyalty by speaking with his beautiful wife any longer."

e5d9c729-50f7-4285-8cd9-74894dd133d2.Text: "Is there anything you would like to tell me?"

9c376a4d-965b-4683-a187-caaf45d09f16.Text: "I would like to become better acquainted with your wife."

0769c9fe-a709-42c7-a809-d124bf7a0c15.Text: "If you believe Kunrad's lies, then draw your weapon. Let us duel, right here, before the Emperor's visage."

2d9bca5e-f6d0-47f8-b11a-78c1dea46c4a.Text: "I ordered Governor Drivestem to teach House Gaprak a lesson for what happened to Kiava Gamma. Dare I hope that you have learned it well?"

9dddd82a-fee0-44f8-b3e4-3b1781925935.Text: "I forbid anyone to repeat Kunrad Voigtvir's lies and hereby impose a fine on you, Macharius."

267c58be-dcc4-428d-aa1f-1ac4a6c17192.Text: "Your cousin, Jocasta, became the new Master-at-Arms on my ship."

034ed526-15ac-46d9-bf2e-5ccff5c8aa00.Text: {n}A group of aristocrats stands apart from the governor's circle. Their whispering carries a tinge of displeasure.{/n}

2dd7e605-e30d-414b-a443-98736279f390.Text: "May the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g} grant you understanding." {n}The woman with whom he is conversing, the one dressed in a robe with gear-shaped adornments, is Toriana Gaprak. It is difficult to read her face due to it being covered in numerous augmentations.{/n}

2b9f8448-3521-4e8c-81f9-e0e86f3c685b.Text: {n}You catch Heinrix's intent gaze upon you, as he breaks off from agitatedly tapping at a data-slate. He makes a subtle gesture, clearly wishing to speak to you.{/n}

3de65e69-4647-4a66-9530-7891f4a912ed.Text: {n}With a glance to make sure the other guests are not observing you, the Interrogator murmurs,{/n} "We need to talk, {name}. Immediately."

2485144d-6b59-4cba-9991-7dc929f45237.Text: "Nothing urgent, {name}." {n}Heinrix casts an impassive look at you and immediately glances away.{/n}

5e72aa58-6dc5-4192-85d7-4c8d8de34a09.Text: {n}You can almost hear the crunching of teeth as Macharius answers in a high and hate-filled hiss:{/n} "Certainly not."

284e5146-cf30-40da-85aa-24b8564f9858.Text: {n}Heinrix opens his mouth to say something, but stops himself by sheer force of will. His eyes return to scanning the crowd in the hall.{/n}

583a495e-1f53-420f-bb27-f7cd4e3b5bb8.Text: "Not here. Let's go elsewhere — this won't take long."

92fb1c4d-ca57-4150-9c20-90703deff222.Text: {n}Macharius's lack of understanding looks the slightest bit exaggerated.{/n}

22fa4bba-97d3-4e1a-aec1-a2136353dbc5.Text: {n}Regina blushes in embarrassment and hides her eyes.{/n} "I beg Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}'s forgiveness. I didn't mean to offend you with my manners."

5037634f-f30c-47fb-b0bd-8704241e3ec3.Text: {n}Macharius is pale, his fingers trembling with anger. He nods dryly, with a hint of grudging gratitude in his voice:{/n} "I promise this will not happen again."

7e0ed7ea-22a3-4542-b12e-682dfc9982a2.Text: {n}Toriana Gaprak looks rather anxious. Macharius Sauerback, dressed surprisingly plainly and austerely for an aristocrat of such a high rank, is frowning suspiciously. He came to the reception with a companion — a woman of dazzling beauty wearing a gilded {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}augment{/g} necklace around her throat. His wife, probably.{/n}

61081d63-bac6-4392-8e34-67486b0e0282.Text: {n}Heinrix, who joined the group unnoticed, mostly keeps silent, listening intently to their every word.{/n}

bc9154aa-2ac2-4301-a898-f441138b6b5e.Text: {n}Like a forging hammer, Toriana's voice falls heavily on the ear.{/n} "The corruption of Kiava Gamma was a great blow to my family. The contemptible Cubis Delphim betrayed our trust, desecrated the forge-cathedrals, and took my esteemed cousin's life."

74889959-9b34-4642-8806-4d478a8e9888.Text: {n}Macharius is visibly vexed by this shift in the conversation. His wife offers you a reserved smile.{/n}

262532a6-4eb0-4cfd-9f0b-8a4c08e769e0.Text: "On behalf of my family, I humbly beg you to forgive our negligence. I am ready to accept any punishment."

05e3ff1a-958a-4b8f-9926-777a784e2d94.Text: {n}Toriana raises her mechanical eyes to the ceiling.{/n} "I swear on the Omnissiah's all-encompassing insight, we will make every effort to justify the cost of its resurrection."

a1d5b29a-d017-4ca4-b910-832fa8344603.Text: {n}Macharius scoffs.{/n} "It was only a year ago that none could doubt House Gaprak's usefulness. Yet here you are, Toriana, on your knees, 'justifying the cost.'"

924b9433-f4b8-4f4a-bcbd-d2a71a180e14.Text: {n}She sighs with a guttural clang.{/n} "The Omnissiah did not grant me understanding. I repent of my blindness."

d6977a97-60c7-4cb7-a6f2-642fff8b26cf.Text: {n}Macharius sighs with sympathy.{/n} "Such a tragedy, Toriana. To think that not but one year ago no one could have doubted your family's usefulness. Yet it took a single mistake to cast all of your accomplishments into oblivion."

9b6ced58-0e7f-4689-addf-d4b9bff4d6cc.Text: "We Gapraks originate from the Calixis Sector, from the cluster of planets known as the Lathe Worlds. We worked faithfully for the good of our masters there, the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMechanicus}Adeptus Mechanicus{/g}, and through our service, we gained a spark of the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}'s knowledge. Then fate tied us through the bonds of fealty to the venerable von Valancius dynasty, and we found ourselves in the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g}. Generation after generation, we fulfilled our duty faultlessly, until Kiava Gamma destroyed and disgraced our name."

ce4082d4-2211-493b-97db-16415387699e.Text: {n}Macharius's face twists into an unpleasant smile, which makes the artificial skin on the left side all the more prominent.{/n} "I am a servant of the von Valancius dynasty. Had I not come, I would have committed an act of unacceptable insolence and damaged my family's honour."

4082e3af-ed60-43cf-8c37-54aaeba0c89a.Text: {n}Macharius says with caution,{/n} "I am your dynasty's loyal servant... But you have asked, and I will answer. Too long has the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g} lived under the rule of {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Traders{/g}. The privileges granted to them make people think that commoners too can dismiss the prohibitions of the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}."

08638315-a4bf-41e1-a255-a5430d006b69.Text: "I wouldn't dare accuse you of anything, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I am simply concerned. If you happen to lay my concerns to rest, House Sauerback will be praying for your well-being every day."

fac0d588-7548-4137-ac52-ab8418db964d.Text: "Your will is absolute. When my head ceases to be of use — I will humbly place it upon the executioner's block." {n}Macharius's voice drips with insincere obedience.{/n}

9d1c4593-6e83-48a6-8b25-2291d45a3689.Text: "As you command, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I am not repeating the words of another, merely informing you that they are being spoken. But your behest will be carried out."

faf382b3-88b0-4d94-9566-db1e47ccdd47.Text: {n}Judging by the chuckles among the nobles, your words have found their mark. Macharius blushes in humiliation.{/n} "Not in the... slightest, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I am content with my role as servant."

93aa6f4b-15d4-400e-8cf7-49e700079a04.Text: {n}Heinrix pulls out a {g|Encyclopedia:Dataslate}data-slate{/g} and makes a note in it without looking.{/n}

d2a475a7-e71a-4429-a7fe-0f83cff23483.Text: {n}Toriana looks away tactfully so as not to see her associate being disgraced.{/n}

535be16c-a60c-4369-97a1-80f0c344cec1.Text: {n}Macharius puffs out his chest and says proudly,{/n} "The Sauerback line was one of the first noble houses to arrive in the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g}. For millennia, we have served the {g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Golden Throne{/g} and kept the faith. Sauerback warriors have bled in a hundred wars and at different times have ruled a great many colonies of the von Valancius dynasty."

f755e52d-98ec-4687-a48d-5f9984a3d13e.Text: "It's been very illuminating. Given me plenty of food for thought." {n}Heinrix's response is barely audible.{/n}

e8d43593-12df-4ee1-8a90-758bfe8feac4.Text: "I can't help it. It is my job to know the thoughts of the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}'s faithful."

7ead3df5-2bad-45ad-82af-a90c55186ea7.Text: "That is why they call it the unsleeping eye of the {g|Encyclopedia:Inquisition}Inquisition{/g}. Even in sleep, I hear everything."

25a31dd0-7df0-4e10-9545-cb2837e94d12.Text: "Well, Macharius Sauerback is all but throwing darts at your portrait. He is more astute at choosing women than enemies. He is trying to entice Gaprak to his side, but she is too frightened after the fiasco on Kiava Gamma."

e39add71-5814-40f2-973a-108f8a5fb3e3.Text: {n}Macharius's wife offers you a charming smile, as if apologising for her husband's vitriolic tone. Her large dark eyes are brimming with curiosity.{/n}

6d6ea6e3-014c-4f3c-8c59-fa086b18b80b.Text: "Even you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, are the subject of the strangest of rumours — and you have just recently inherited your protectorate. Kunrad Voigtvir's people, for instance, claim that you had a hand in the esteemed Theodora's demise and accuse you of many other misdeeds. It doesn't matter whether or not their claims are true — the people hear them. Believe them. And think that they may follow your example."

80dc63ce-975c-4d6b-bd3c-e002f62afeb8.Text: {n}Macharius bows his head without too much reverence.{/n}

10b2e4ea-393f-4495-8d93-cac178649c08.Text: "I am glad to know that you think highly of my beauty." {n}Regina blushes slightly.{/n}

a808de50-1251-4919-9bff-328827521be6.Text: {n}Macharius, his face a deep red, is only too ready to change the subject.{/n}

9ba5fd75-a98f-45f9-8458-50d027c485af.Text: "You flatter me, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. But I cannot say that it is not to my liking."

9740b242-9fbe-43c2-bb38-f8c2bd93802d.Text: "You underestimate Macharius, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. A man of his talents is a treasure to the one he serves." {n}Regina's voice is calm as she speaks about her husband, but it is not particularly warm either.{/n}

6b4ba107-17ea-4807-b7c9-5f37d1614309.Text: "I wouldn't dream of claiming to bear any resemblance to a great saint. I lack her... virtue." {n}Regina makes eyes at you before demurely lowering her gaze.{/n}

a67758aa-336d-4e67-957d-cadd0dd4d723.Text: "I wouldn't dream of claiming to bear any resemblance to a great saint. That would be blasphemy." {n}Regina's voice is friendly and calm, but she keeps glancing at her husband.{/n}

e1867ff3-1d36-4172-94ab-b14678ae3417.Text: {n}As Macharius pales, Regina smiles at him, then glances at you with interest.{/n} "I beg for your mercy. Macharius does not deserve death."

4ffdf4ae-fdd9-43c3-bd2d-3df5f157fc51.Text: {n}Regina glances at Macharius, who is not frightened by your sudden gesture in the slightest, then looks back at you. Her voice is calm but cold.{/n} "If my presence threatens my husband's life, I can humbly take my leave."

f6eb7a71-1bb1-4bf7-bb85-0e7ef117d44d.Text: {n}Regina gives you a charming smile. Meanwhile, Toriana and Macharius are watching the conversation unfold, not quite believing their eyes and ears.{/n}

1c05e646-a0c3-4675-ac73-ec8afb41b4d0.Text: {n}The glint in Regina's eyes betrays her genuine interest in you.{/n} "I hope this won't be the end of our acquaintance. You wouldn't mind if I wrote you from time to time, would you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}?"

1b49b36d-bc66-49b2-8b55-64416047be8c.Text: {n}Macharius looks at you silently with a mixture of indignation and relief in his eyes.{/n} "The Rogue Trader has better things to do than read letters from {mf|his|her} subjects, Regina."

17fa337d-4d73-4bf0-b251-72d253c3ccf4.Text: {n}Toriana's jaw augmetic lets out a low clang.{/n} "Of course, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. The punitive measures... considerably curbed both the wealth and the numbers of my family. We will never forget our just punishment."

c5688e9a-43ca-4079-817b-3caece6f2722.Text: "I dare hope that your reign will see the faith on Dargonus remain as doctrinally strict as it was under Lady Theodora. The appearance of a death cultist at your side makes one wonder if we should anticipate changes in our customary ways of honouring the Emperor."

5d13299d-f28c-4112-8710-d6291dbeba03.Text: "I am pleased to hear it." {n}Nothing in Macharius's face shows that he is glad for his cousin.{/n} "I always worried that her character would cause our house a great deal of grief, and yet, in the end, the noble Sauerback blood was stronger than any personal shortcomings. I have faith that Jocasta will prove herself adequately." {n}He forces a faint smile.{/n}

7e226725-a7d8-44b1-ab68-a5ee506b6b93.Text: {n}The clear leader of this gathering is a gaunt, bilious-faced man dressed in Sauerback colours — this must be Macharius himself, head of the house. He offers you a ceremonious bow.{/n} "My congratulations, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

3aa1a489-ded0-487b-be58-3d2b43408bca.Text: {n}For an inscrutable man, Heinrix is being even more inscrutable than usual. It's as if he is hiding something. Something important.{/n}

d84ab270-30d4-4914-80b0-8e83e77d5023.Text: {n}Heinrix looks away, tracking the guests' movements around the hall.{/n}

c03901d5-f50b-4cb7-bbd3-27d4e4669942.Text: {n}There is something lurking beneath Toriana's repentant expression... a grudge. It would seem that she was personally offended by the nightmare into which Cubis Delphim plunged her domain, and she feels betrayed.{/n}

0cf79113-5e38-44c2-81f4-500f65317129.Text: {n}Unfortunately, her {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}augmented{/g} face expresses a limited range of emotions, and her synthesised voice conceals lies too easily.{/n}

47c5bf7e-7ee0-490a-a054-91b73f4f29b1.Text: {n}You notice Toriana's mechanical visors periodically looking past you, in the direction of Pasqal. It seems the Tech-Priest is an object of fascination for her.{/n}

c244868c-56b2-4959-a342-ac26609882ba.Text: "{name}, before this gala concludes, there is something I'd like to tell you... Be careful today. I sense that a wave of darkness will soon hit our defensive lines, and I hope that I will still get a chance to meet you there as an ally."

fa1090ae-78dc-49ff-b5de-a9035e4fe376.Text: {n}Toriana's face lights up with the enthusiasm of a true scholar.{/n} "Thank you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I noticed that you chose to have him by your side during the ceremony, and I would be honoured to meet such a highly placed member of the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMechanicus}Adeptus Mechanicus{/g}. For, although House Gaprak does indeed follow the Omnissiah, we are but laypeople, and we are not permitted to converse with such enlightened servants of the Machine God. Your gracious assent fills my heart with joy."

1730c6c1-c08f-4d3b-a40c-dd32c02b106d.Text: {n}Macharius places his hand on the hilt of his sword, then glances with uncertainty at the images of the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} gazing upon him from every direction, then at you. His fingers release the hilt.{/n}

67c80ab0-e02f-4006-9532-f315a2a89360.Text: "No. I do not believe his words. I am your servant, and my oath to your dynasty is harder than steel. I am guilty of repeating an ignominious lie, and I will pay a fine. And anyone who repeats it in my presence I myself will challenge to a duel to the death."

c78f8aca-8af7-4da4-9e1e-0bcaa537d03a.Text: {n}Judging by Macharius's bewilderment, he really was unaware of Vistenza's antics.{/n}

d6756f68-314e-417c-a2d1-f072a836aff0.Text: {n}Something rattles in her visors.{/n} "I was delighted to see one of the Omnissiah's priests placed beside you. In these trying times, the entire sector needs to stand together, united into one mechanism. The Adeptus Mechanicus will help us do just that."

253b6c75-f5c6-448c-afb7-4750f87f793f.Text: "For the good of the sector, Rogue Traders must become paragons of the law, not exceptions to it. But do many {g|Encyclopedia:Warrant}Warrant{/g} holders exhibit lawful conduct? No, they do not!"

659c411f-2193-432b-b6c8-a2a2f157d613.Text: {n}Regina smiles, triumphant and flattered.{/n} "I daren't count on such generous courtesy, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

deaa4104-e605-421f-81fb-9cfd743cbb1e.Text: "It is an honour to be in your company, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

1b70b706-661f-400a-ba0e-44a5522272a9.Text: {n}Regina blushes in embarrassment and hides her eyes.{/n} "Please forgive my insolence, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

581239d8-ca8e-4d0d-af3b-f26fef8ab114.Text: {n}Macharius grips the hilt of his parade blade as if trying to strangle it, and wheezes furiously:{/n} "A high honour for House Sauerback."

06dbb5f8-816c-4a16-aa92-ec0ccd8801f7.Text: "If you want me as your ally, you can request an audience and repeat everything you just said in public."

50413d6c-bb09-4e8b-af59-3416a0c575d0.Text: "Heinrix, I thought we were friends. But friends don't break into each other's chambers in the middle of the night with weapons, do they?"

31ffc7f8-d19e-4b8c-9cd9-02a682971255.Text: "But now Janus is pure once more. You can see for yourself. There will be a palace and everything you desire waiting for you on the planet."

823036b8-bc60-4865-8a56-478f77711f08.Text: "You think you can just barge into my chambers? Are you quite mad, Inquisitor?"

d7bf278e-9793-4384-888e-ac22e968e260.Text: "If the Inquisition wishes to have a talk with me — I am glad to be at its service."

468fbbc0-b324-4f23-8ca0-3225ccadd486.Text: "I used her to deal with a more serious threat — the xenos. Now I need Vistenza no longer, and I will, naturally, neutralise her."

47c90583-dfa9-4cf0-93ea-574d796bf065.Text: [Lower your voice] "I have been pondering this myself. I cannot deny the possibility that Vistenza... influenced my thinking somehow."

af2635ee-41e5-4907-a356-14bb708efa48.Text: "You do not have to leave, Heinrix. Stay."

f75da66d-6908-4512-a52d-af4b63cb9b50.Text: [Aim your weapon at the intruder] "If something looks like an assassination and smells like an assassination... perhaps I ought to start treating it like one?"

3cc4a938-d9d8-40f8-9ce9-4dd9d5e32b07.Text: "An alliance with xenos? What nonsensical gossip!"

52bd8d00-f2cc-4733-94e9-522e586d4851.Text: "Perhaps your agent was simply incompetent. What does that have to do with me?"

ff7f6c5d-5dd0-4a66-be49-dfe8aee61c0c.Text: "I am sorry for your man's death. Believe me, I too held him in high esteem."

fe5b77af-8c60-44d0-ba21-60e54de4d0e6.Text: [Smile insolently] "Perhaps I simply dislike being followed by spies."

13d3c6dc-7f10-4f69-a98c-e7fdd4c88ec6.Text: "What kind of a deal are we talking about?"

d1616691-a099-4204-8725-74c2b924f22c.Text: "Let the priesthood to which Cubis Delphim belonged answer for his crimes. The Adeptus Mechanicus would do well to watch their members more closely."

fb14bb70-f738-4f72-8383-c72f4d413eab.Text: "My protectorate is a complex mechanism. I wasn't willing to put its performance at risk because of some paranoid fears."

6694ccab-e4e2-4f87-bb3b-d93c4519d9d2.Text: "I wish to observe how the seeds of corruption will behave. It is prudent to study one's enemy."

0bbee814-055f-4104-8af1-4a6acded8c5d.Text: "I made every effort and saw to it that every seed of heresy was exterminated. The world of Kiava Gamma is tainted no more, I can vouch for that."

ab86a820-1b17-4777-8155-1cbe392e553e.Text: "Is Heinrix staying in my retinue? Or are you taking him back?"

737f2073-af63-4f85-a152-04c718389fe3.Text: "Truly? I must confess, this is the first time I'm hearing about this. My servants usually handle such matters."

23a5ec58-39e9-4174-a8a4-5e501402aab1.Text: "This feels an awful lot like an interrogation."

b81db559-82cd-4bd5-adc0-a11bbf4ac5d8.Text: "What's your opinion of Heinrix? Is he a useful assistant to have?"

f1ab286a-710e-4e72-9b31-3144489ac09b.Text: "How did you come to be so remarkably well informed?"

06bb7d75-02cf-4235-83e6-c05f08ff74e0.Text: "I want Heinrix to continue to accompany me."

cc1cb5c1-3825-4e56-aa00-29c16281ac6f.Text: "Why such an interest in my person?"

af5c52dc-6475-47e7-8555-0ce9579ba02d.Text: "Is this ring all the favour that House von Valancius can expect from the Inquisition?"

53b5c582-42ab-46bc-a93a-ed1296efeda4.Text: "I don't want to have any dealings with you."

a63e3785-0fad-4004-be79-b08d45a4cf96.Text: [Smile] "I see no reason to refuse such a generous offer."

f24dda7e-57c1-473c-80e0-96c2ffe29793.Text: "Vistenza's misdeeds are a stain upon my dynasty's honour. I admit it."

81719286-fcff-430b-9fac-bb3cb4253ff7.Text: "Theodora was the one who appointed Vistenza. What does it have to do with me?"

500f5526-a073-4c42-82a0-85785d6b6d72.Text: "Every tool has a shelf life. Vistenza had reached the end of hers, and so I replaced her."

f2b89be7-d998-40e8-a0b3-0539f9551de4.Text: "What can I say? I'm lucky, that's the reason I'm alive."

ebb4cc05-2e23-4d80-a363-41e9841d4b81.Text: "What can I say? I'm lucky, that's the reason I'm alive."

9e47c04a-4fa8-4787-a0f8-2c36095f3787.Text: "If I have erred, I am willing to repent and cast the colony into the fire."

ab556bb5-1495-46b1-8ebc-cfc72aa4b369.Text: "I am waging a war on the xenos, a war to the death. My worlds are being plundered and desolated. If that brands me an apostate, then I invite you to be my judge."

6cdea0ec-dd6e-4112-90f7-639e7cf84d8f.Text: [Bow your head respectfully] "On behalf of my house, I, {name} von Valancius, hereby promise and guarantee to offer the Inquisition any assistance it may require. The Emperor protects!"

0be17086-a8fe-4d3b-965b-94f82095b71c.Text: "Xenos made more attempts on Saint Drusus's life than mine. Does that make him a traitor too?"

cbf36387-0f0c-4e26-b4e8-680670cfe90e.Text: "In the face of heresy, the xenos seemed like acceptable allies to me. There have been precedents for this, correct?"

263b60a6-3bd6-492b-8942-265fff0f9ad6.Text: "I have the right to strike deals with xenos. Are you challenging my privileges as a Rogue Trader?"

5a83e954-97cf-45a7-8c20-72bf8d1ed855.Text: "If you knew about what was happening on Janus, why didn't you intervene yourself?"

39422709-6894-41e0-99c6-c705e8f2fcf6.Text: "I admit no guilt. But I agree that it does seem suspicious."

e8c391ee-cc51-413a-adf4-7dcdac9903ab.Text: "I saved the people. It is my Emperor-given duty."

c21b70c7-a7b5-4088-8e30-64a5fc808f5f.Text: "The machine held dark and dangerous knowledge. If anyone had laid their hands on that foulness, it would have caused nothing but harm."

6734aab2-9a1f-4791-be7d-1ee6fb3218f8.Text: "I apologise. I overstepped when I interfered in the Inquisition's investigation."

57766512-46fb-4de5-be67-90b3b844e807.Text: "I will not have anyone tell me which heretical abominations I may eradicate on my own — MY OWN — planet, and which I may not!"

1728f008-07a9-4cdb-88c5-e77dd8c96027.Text: [Laugh inanely and somewhat sheepishly] "Should I not have done that? I don't recall van Calox forbidding me to touch it."

17857e6d-79a1-4492-9f79-4a258dbd6bf8.Text: "It truly was a misstep. It was only afterward that I was able to appreciate the... intriguing nature of the data."

31019406-b718-4026-8ec0-0fcce8fca5fa.Text: [Throw up your hands] "I... uh... lost him."

df4b1360-ea7c-41d4-abb2-9b94fa1d2fc2.Text: "Blackmail? To what end? I am a Rogue Trader, and this is a flagrant violation of my privileges."

2a6c2730-b128-436d-8dad-608d170ca00a.Text: [Raise your weapon to strike] "Come closer and I shall tell you my answer."

cc23bf5f-c6e9-435a-90c7-190eb3a45d64.Text: Asked Xavier Calcazar to admit you into the ranks of the Inquisition.

e0906eab-ccad-4cbc-ad94-ab4e05ab8f40.Text: [Drop to one knee] "Lord Inquisitor, it would be the greatest honour to swear an oath of loyalty to you and to join the ranks of the Inquisition."

ee0e6d3d-9d72-407e-bf07-66e69fe364b9.Text: "I understand. And I will not force you to choose between me and your duty."

1e147593-2c2a-4cc5-b5a1-f30d094e3e0f.Text: "No, I do not understand. And I cannot abide duplicity. You may be staying in my retinue, van Calox, but keep your distance from me henceforth."

b5e8298d-fdd2-4010-b592-c4a231d88c3e.Text: "I am angry with you right now. But I think it will pass by morning."

7a502f88-4f25-4861-975f-64b567035ec0.Text: "You did everything within your power to look out for me. That is what matters."

267c50c1-4766-4fb8-8c5c-0fed042d2800.Text: "Do you have evidence of her guilt?"

5daeafbf-1006-4cfd-aa63-88133e316a8d.Text: "That is why I didn't like her. I assure you, her death warrant has been already signed."

006b0cca-f371-4964-9b5c-b8da08f49b99.Text: "What do you wish to know about the events on Janus?"

83c45802-acc8-4c32-b345-eedf5b6815b3.Text: "If this is true, I am ready to accept punishment for overlooking a traitor in my protectorate."

b33ec34c-2b7a-457e-b7f6-d481d7701957.Text: "I know that Theodora was concerned about the fate of the dynasty and certain restricting obligations. Was it, perhaps, due to your partnership with her?"

a9b7a93e-7052-486b-af86-3d1fae37b296.Text: "What questions could you have for me about Kiava Gamma?"

2d691f32-d0d0-4b8d-967b-e76bbc5ed781.Text: "The Drukhari have shown an interest in me? Are you referring to my ruined capital?"

bb4eabb4-09eb-46a8-bdb9-105914c49062.Text: "I am watching her. Just as you have been, I gather."

13771db5-ef02-45e7-87fe-5e6e8ac6a858.Text: "Have I answered all of your questions?"

4113c34c-2984-4fdd-8e79-ecea0c8abc63.Text: {n}The same man you saw among your guests is waiting for you in your chambers with the look of someone who is supposed to be there. He casts a cold, assessing gaze over you from top to bottom. No one save Theodora has ever allowed themselves the liberty of looking at you in such a way.{/n} "We have matters to discuss, {name} von Valancius."

f6cc591b-56d3-4a50-a548-16e4c5b17506.Text: {n}Calcazar looks at you with interest.{/n} "That is a very dangerous game, {name}. 'I shall take the lesser evil under my protection and use it to exterminate the greater, and I will certainly not blink and miss the moment when the lesser evil becomes greater still' — were these your thoughts? Trust me, amateurs ought to stay away from such games."

8a994317-e230-49bf-8f09-a9d8fd01b349.Text: "What drove you to {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_JanusVistenzaAlive}give{/d} a planet into the charge of a heretic and a servant of the {g|Encyclopedia:Chaos}Archenemy{/g}?"

f2fdabaa-a7bf-40bf-8a53-7584ed5a9eed.Text: "What was the reasoning behind your decision to let {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g}, enemies of Humanity, {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_JanusEldarAllies}live{/d} and act on a planet that belongs to you?"

6acdc37c-629b-4990-982b-2d27e34a66d1.Text: "So, now we both know I have the right to give orders. When the safety of an entire sector is at stake, the game stops being a game and turns into a war. I hope this little demonstration of power did not do any substantial damage to your dignity."

20548b10-9b41-4d83-9c9c-c5d7dd00423e.Text: {n}He arches an eyebrow.{/n} "Is that so? Interesting. It's true, for years we've kept a close eye on Vistenza and the little depravities her retinue permits itself. And we're ready to put an end to them the moment they cross the line and become a true danger. Now this is your responsibility as well. Be vigilant."

a29a32bc-470c-4ea1-959e-2229923f80e5.Text: "As my colleagues like to say, innocence proves nothing. You have inherited not just Theodora's glory and wealth, but her mistakes as well."

a45be895-7f1d-4254-9bbf-91fc4c05832c.Text: "Lord Inquisitor Xavier Calcazar, head of the Koronus Conclave. I am authorised by the grace of the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} to watch over the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g}, root out heresies, and pre-empt the {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g} threat." {n}His highbred face and glorious greying mane would better befit an aristocrat than a servant of the fearsome {g|Encyclopedia:Inquisition}Inquisition{/g}.{/n}

b05ca653-65bd-49bc-8b10-a8d4c160434b.Text: "Probably." {n}He shrugs.{/n} "Unless he suffered from hidden ailments, he will soon come to without any major damage to his health. Either way, oblivion is a far safer option for him than the dangerous privilege of being a witness to this conversation."

afecf890-3b5b-4b61-b1c2-0f73e83ba3c0.Text: "We used other means of travel to pay you this visit." {n}Heinrix's eyes bore into you, his expression impenetrable.{/n} "I assure you, Rogue Trader, that all your locks are in order."

5162ea4b-8c9c-4b45-93b0-c7edb21e7296.Text: "Is that what you think?" {n}The Inquisitor smiles slightly but without a shred of warmth.{/n} "I am fully aware of what I am doing — I am outlining our relationship. Need I remind you that the unsleeping eye of the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g} is watching you even in your bedchamber? And not just the eye, but the Imperium's sensitive hands as well — in this case, my assistants and I."

f45c7781-21f5-48d4-b414-c1c49ef5a1ff.Text: "A commendable openness to cooperation. It will be taken into account." {n}The Inquisitor's sharp gaze is fixed on a point directly between your eyes.{/n}

eb34c2a0-dfa3-48d7-a4e0-96db5f232317.Text: {n}Calcazar looks at you with disapproval.{/n} "I do not recommend lying, {mf|Lord|Lady} von Valancius. This path will not lead to a fruitful partnership."

4e61fa23-2bec-4564-aaea-1a9c28b7e3fe.Text: {n}The Inquisitor winces in displeasure.{/n} "Your ill-considered behaviour is both inappropriate and dangerous. For you. It causes me no discomfort and won't hinder my enquiries in any way."

53c83a88-aa06-484e-b1e2-81f518f67d40.Text: "Now, let us start with the most important subject. How did it come to pass that Heinrix van Calox, whom your honoured predecessor was instructed to bring to me, departed from this world? I must admit, I find it highly objectionable when my agents die — by following their bloody trail, I tend to discover extremely unpleasant and nefarious secrets."

fcd4e215-d3e7-4252-8780-b05bb7645ab8.Text: "Master van Calox has spent enough time with you. He will vouch for your words."

c863a535-9495-4c5e-811b-af3ad379e4cb.Text: {n}He lets out a chuckle.{/n} "Ah, so you already think you're cut from the same cloth as Saint Drusus, do you? Ambitious. I'll make note of it."

1304082e-8baa-4992-8274-987b825434c4.Text: "I did not come here to haggle. But worry not, you won't come out of this empty-handed... if you act appropriately."

bacc17e3-d563-4f91-a7ac-689b8d211a55.Text: {n}The flash of a refractor field halts your assault. The shield generator must be a true technological marvel if Calcazar was able to conceal it under his clothes. He regards you with a heavy gaze.{/n} "Remember how I said I was willing to overlook certain liberties? That was the first. And the last of this kind."

756a2814-dfcb-4503-9bc1-72e7f9575997.Text: "Strike deals — absolutely. Cooperate — to a degree. But not hand them inhabited worlds on a platter. I suggest you read your {g|Encyclopedia:Warrant}Warrant{/g} more closely. Remember, the hallmark of a wise {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} is to realise that the phrase 'I can do anything' means 'I can do almost anything.'"

e68a87f1-48ab-49ed-8d7e-8f7f8657a160.Text: "Indeed he was. Master van Calox was performing a task he had received from me, and, after Theodora's death, he was watching over you on behalf of my organisation. It is unfortunate that he can no longer say a single word in your favour." {n}The regret in his voice sounds oddly like a threat.{/n}

5be50f02-dac0-4353-971c-6f03055f0f64.Text: {n}Calcazar's face is impenetrable and his voice is dry.{/n} "Let's say I believe you. For the time being."

13b87c06-43c1-4734-be44-16f3a52e79de.Text: "That is a bold assertion you're making, {name}. You assume that I am more interested in your person than in the demise of Master van Calox. And that, with age, I have not developed a sentimental habit of avenging my people's deaths. Well then. You are correct — this time."

8baa92da-d163-497f-8d16-d01f291d518a.Text: "The Inquisition, which I represent, is willing to show extraordinary faith in your person. For the sake of our invaluable partnership, I am going to ignore any... minor liberties that you, esteemed Rogue Trader, may have afforded yourself or may again in the future."

45c3c217-7f44-406c-99a0-c183ece08dc1.Text: "Places touched by Chaos must be purged with fire and condemned to oblivion. Kiava Gamma should have been bombed to dust and pronounced a forbidden world. However, you decided otherwise and restored the colony's operation. And you didn't even go to the trouble of hiding the traces of the neglect committed by your dynasty. After all, it was House von Valancius that gave Cubis Delphim so much freedom that he sank into seditious heresy. What was your rationale?"

ce5102e4-394d-433e-a565-d257a4c63552.Text: "I make no deals, and Emperor forbid that I give you orders — that would mean infringing on your privileges. I am merely offering well-meaning recommendations and expecting that, when the Expanse finds itself in danger, you will break away from your own affairs to heed them."

50ff6b40-aaec-4c6f-acf4-865562647ab9.Text: "And benefited greatly from it. The {g|Encyclopedia:Warrant}Warrant{/g}'s power is not without limit, and neither is the protection it provides. All those mysterious expeditions, dubious experiments, collections of xenotech oddities are dangerous pastimes. It takes more than the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g}'s permission to pursue them without consequences. One must also make sure I am not displeased by it."

28b4a2c9-373e-4927-99ca-0cf264acfd13.Text: {n}The Lord Inquisitor smiles ominously.{/n} "Let me demonstrate how it works. In your retinue, there is a {g|Encyclopedia:Psyker}psyker{/g} who is yet to receive {g|Encyclopedia:HolyTerra}Terra{/g}'s sanction, which, as we both know, is a grave threat and a blasphemy to the laws of the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}. I am aware of this secret, but... I'm not displeased in the slightest. And so she lives on, your handy psyker Idira Tlass."

d8d133c2-4218-4f57-a5dc-d2b22ba01859.Text: "Which would you prefer? And you, Heinrix — do you wish to continue working at the honourable Rogue Trader's side?"

d83ba411-95d2-4763-88f1-e705b70895dd.Text: "Your protectorate is a living body. And you have left in it a splinter that might eventually fester. Consider the scale of the amputations that could come of it."

7457fdf7-5339-41d1-a7b3-e30054cde80e.Text: "I eagerly await the moment when you show me your rosette of the Holy Inquisition. Surely you have it on you... You don't? How strange. I thought that such experiments were within the purview of my esteemed colleagues from the Ordo Hereticus."

6ff18ff7-0d5e-40f9-9d06-59324c9ab7e8.Text: "You think donning the mask of a feckless {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} will shield you against accusations of heresy? Your belief that I am an uninformed fool is quite regrettable."

2bae2112-ad8d-497d-a94d-9713c45dc549.Text: "Are you surprised? You thought the {g|Encyclopedia:Inquisition}Inquisition{/g} was unaware of the circumstances of your deeds? How often do you find yourself thinking that there are things we shouldn't know about your life?"

7193a830-5503-4cd6-88f1-b7d14d6120ae.Text: "Then Master van Calox will remain in place. It puts me at ease to know that there is someone to watch over you." {n}Calcazar's last remark sounds ambiguous.{/n}

9ba3ff01-ef95-4af8-8e72-7a77002d7696.Text: {n}Heinrix offers you an official bow.{/n} "I consider it an honour to accompany you, {name}."

2c007ee5-a745-4601-abcf-97f6f94efd01.Text: "Then Master van Calox will be recalled to my retinue. I have much work for you, Heinrix."

2a352795-acf6-4058-8a4c-07098bd7796f.Text: "You haven't been in a position of power for long, and so one can forgive you for not noticing the troubling changes. The Cult of the Final Dawn is spreading in the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g} — not the first or the last heresy that has afflicted this sector, but one that is surprisingly resilient. Mysterious convoys are sliding by, bound for systems in the Heathen Stars — just your humdrum pirate trade, wouldn't you say? Then why are the pirates themselves clueless?"

84fb02ca-a98b-4b68-9f63-bba02250d1b8.Text: "The {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g}, who have caused trouble in the sector before, have expanded their activities in the last few decades, and there is a logic and method to their previously chaotic raids. Even two packs of Space Wolves — blessed {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusAstartes}Space Marines{/g} summoned in my name — did not cool their interest in the Expanse."

cc24457b-b704-46c2-8be2-20adbc788642.Text: {n}The symbol on the signet is black as the void.{/n} "The colour indicates how close the bearer is to the Lord Inquisitor. Black means that you are a part of the inner circle. Any and all resources will be available to you."

842161a2-12ee-4928-bd92-1bc9fd1eb1c4.Text: {n}The symbol on the signet is red as the blood of the righteous.{/n} "The colour indicates how close the bearer is to the Lord Inquisitor. Scarlet means that you have shed your blood for the good of the Imperium. And therefore, you deserve to have His servants shed their blood for you."

ff367635-7675-4753-9989-d233d457ce88.Text: {n}The symbol on the signet is white as the hair of the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptaSororitas}Adepta Sororitas{/g}.{/n} "The colour indicates how close the bearer is to the Lord Inquisitor. White is beautiful yet vulnerable. It stains as easily as one can lose the Inquisition's trust. Do all you can to preserve it."

1054a1a9-b9de-40f5-bdd2-d6986099e997.Text: "I would say your dynasty should have discarded her a good ten years earlier. And had you waited another two, I would have had to do it myself. Negligence can eventually become fatal, {name}."

9d09928b-ca04-4a16-9e2f-a3d65359f62b.Text: "That takes care of Master van Calox. Now, let us turn to your other deeds."

bf7b1e3f-d639-4eeb-9a1e-8a44a241b597.Text: "I cannot satisfy your curiosity without disclosing information of the utmost secrecy. I will say only this: we had the situation under control. There is a tangled knot of perilous events in progress in the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g} — plucking even one thread must be performed with great precision and caution, without any room for error."

3ea03335-6627-42dd-8dd7-559af9d8048e.Text: "It is good that you acknowledge this. The Emperor, in His great mercy, lets His repentant servants rectify their mistakes... sometimes."

88329a89-3408-4d84-a3bc-873a06c31b6c.Text: "These xenos known as the {g|Encyclopedia:Aeldari}Aeldari{/g} have garnered such influence over your naive subjects that I cannot help but wonder — who truly rules Janus now? I must inform you that, should any evidence surface that the xenos power continues to expand in your domain, it will mean a death sentence for your colony."

73d9ca78-7067-424d-82f3-e5ef506a4724.Text: "My favour takes other forms as well."

62a03dc0-03fa-4345-a07e-80507bfdf7e1.Text: "There are crimes that cannot be ignored even by a Rogue Trader. Remember this. If Vistenza Vyatt were to be proven guilty of such a transgression, the blame for overlooking her actions as a servant would fall on you."

e728eb78-32ad-400c-910c-e423ac276472.Text: {n}He pauses before saying gravely,{/n} "I hope you were sufficiently thorough. If you were not, you will be called to account."

bde4776a-e8d5-40b9-896d-eb16b27d76df.Text: {n}He shakes his head.{/n} "And before what tribunal do you intend to challenge my authority?"

e5a61fcc-763b-426a-a451-899decb877b3.Text: "I will see to it that it is returned to your ship. My apologies, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, but the Lord Inquisitor's task was urgent. I was forced to avail myself of your resources."

c484f9a1-2812-41d3-8b43-4064e198da64.Text: {n}Calcazar nods his approval.{/n} "Better. You are no longer trying to lie. It seems that our relationship is now on the right track."

5e295e8c-8f90-47e4-916e-289c15ca7e45.Text: "And more than that — to let them {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_JanusEldarGovern}run{/d} the world itself from the shadows? Do you think it a worthy fate for your fellow human beings to live as thralls in the clutches of xenos? Do you truly believe that the xenos will honour whatever deal they made with you?"

9c463e7e-d5b5-4d89-9d47-d7ef60b50a71.Text: "Your transgressions are sufficient grounds to bring you before the Inquisition's judgement. And believe me when I say that if you fail to draw certain conclusions from my words, this is what will eventually happen... But for now, I am willing to show leniency, which is rather uncharacteristic of me."

850f4438-bab3-45ce-9f65-9cd3a0d2a74e.Text: "Was it virtuous of you to allow the {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}warp{/g}-stricken voidsmen to {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_MutatedCrewRescued}join{/d} your crew? The ones who served on the ship that was turned into a trap for you by Kunrad Voigtvir — isn't it possible that they were part of the blight he had sown?"

f73c5bb1-18a3-4070-9ab1-d8df39432451.Text: "That means we will be proceeding without your approval, esteemed {name}. It would seem you still haven't picked up on an important detail — I am not asking your opinion, I am apprising you of where you stand. When the safety of an entire sector is at stake, the game stops being a game and turns into a war. You may see this as me conscripting House von Valancius at the behest of the {g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Golden Throne{/g}."

d423e297-797d-4124-abb5-9b73fb1e9fa4.Text: {n}Calcazar looks at you with interest.{/n} "Your way of thinking is curious — dangerous, but curious nonetheless. I would suggest exercising utmost caution should you wish to continue on this path."

18d1bf85-39f8-4a03-b29f-b883bdee77fc.Text: {n}He sighs wearily.{/n} "You won't let me forget that I am dealing with a Rogue Trader, I see. Very well, as a sign of my goodwill, I will also provide substantial support to your protectorate. But from this point on, I will be expecting your cooperation in return."

5c411f9c-1fa0-4b87-843d-68c75748d6b6.Text: "I hope you realise that we're talking about more than the fate of some colony. I care not for a single planet, however profitable and populous. But should corruption raise its head again on Kiava Gamma and try to spread — I will burn it away. And you... you will be guilty of criminal negligence."

37c28d1d-ce81-418b-9ec3-56868befb2a3.Text: "I am glad to hear it, {name}. Your oath has been heard and added to the record."

d1167084-1006-44f8-80fc-92b4ac976ad6.Text: "Surely you're not trying to appease a member of the Inquisition with a bribe? Not the most prudent tactic on your part."

aebe381c-01f9-4b25-9454-895b71834b21.Text: {n}The Inquisitor draws a broad blade from his belt. It is engraved with scripture along its length. He proffers the gilded grip to you.{/n} "This is a gift, a sign that your fervour has not gone unnoticed. Should it remain undiminished, one day this blade will be melted down to make your Inquisitorial rosette. Such is the tradition of our conclave."

39bb27ad-e112-4d1f-a6bb-fa100e24e7d5.Text: "If, for the security of these territories, I find it necessary to execute any individual and replace them with a puppet counterpart, turn their realm to ash, and put their servants to death — I have the right to do so. The threats I protect the Expanse against are extraordinary and justify the harshest means. Welcome to my world, where 'going too far' simply doesn't exist."

cc0dc584-c3fa-4e62-a4a7-c33402af8697.Text: "I seem to remember that your exalted aristocrats presented you with many gifts. It would be rude of me not to follow suit."

77cf9f17-3d44-498a-8e32-f0d98eb3aaee.Text: {n}The Lord Inquisitor vanishes in a flash of teleportation. Someone was adept enough to calculate his coordinates with incredible precision and retrieve him straight from your chambers. In the ensuing silence you hear the master of ceremonies grumbling incoherently in his restless dreams.{/n}

8e288b40-8cdc-4a75-9eb0-bac55eae93f9.Text: {n}As if in confirmation of the Lord Inquisitor's words, Heinrix brings his hand to his own rosette.{/n}

ebfb6d36-d18b-4348-856c-2dcff255fdd9.Text: "Well, you will obviously want to discuss what just happened, {name}." {n}For the first time during the entire exchange, emotion creeps into Heinrix's face — he looks like someone who is expecting an unpleasant conversation.{/n} "But not now, I presume — right now it would be better for you to rest and think on the Lord Inquisitor's words in private. I bid you good night, Rogue Trader."

70cbef56-f522-4cdd-9244-66a85027ff47.Text: "Given that their agent now accompanies you as a member of your retinue, many might wonder — has House von Valancius renounced its service to the Imperium?"

e4619b4b-f8ba-471b-8e8c-b1aa07a67cb9.Text: "Farewell." {n}It is impossible to tell from Heinrix's expression what he feels at this moment, if anything.{/n}

daf7fa43-d0a6-47d2-8eeb-388ddd414898.Text: "A mighty Explorator Fleet, which has studied the Expanse for hundreds of years, has suddenly stopped responding to communication and sunk into a dispute over a tech-heresy that was considered dead a couple of centuries ago. House Chorda has clamped down on insurgents, yet its acts of brutality breed troublemakers just as quickly as they're executed, and this bloody carousel has consumed the attention of the esteemed Incendia. Calligos Winterscale has abruptly lost all interest in his domain, and his only apparent concern now is hunting ever more dangerous xenobeasts."

fa0cf062-43e3-4957-90ff-d600cd24c40b.Text: {n}Calcazar removes a signet ring from his finger and hands it to you. You notice an intricate personal coat of arms on it.{/n} "Please accept this gift as a sign of my favour. In an hour of need, give it to any faithful servant of the Emperor, and the Inquisition will come to your aid."

8c3a5093-5d4e-45b7-99bb-59328c2a8fda.Text: "Influenced? How curious it is that you are so inclined to blame Lady Vyatt for everything while you yourself play the victim."

a8a1b303-cf60-422a-8315-a2ca7decc619.Text: "What manner of {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_BottomlessPitDarkness}sacrifices{/d} did you offer to the xeno-anomaly that had taken on the form of a bottomless pit and revealed to you its blasphemous visions? Or did you think that was a secret as well?"

3887eed7-a6c7-4500-b074-6065324513ed.Text: {n}He pauses for a short while, then says in a heavy voice,{/n} "That is what we will do, but not today. For now, we will try to turn your hesitation to our advantage. Trying times lie ahead of us, and we could use the weapons that this planet is capable of producing. But remember that the sentence has merely been postponed."

9b12cf00-33e1-4676-8051-437ccad37f14.Text: "I will comply with any order, Lord Inquisitor. If you command me to remain in the company of the scion of the von Valancius dynasty, I won't be distressed."

6c95f324-4ee1-4f15-9ed1-fdf1c1c601d7.Text: "I take it you wish to see whose status carries greater weight? I am willing to oblige." {n}Calcazar presents to you his Inquisitorial rosette.{/n} "By the power vested in me and in the name of {g|Encyclopedia:HolyTerra}Terra{/g}, I hereby conscript House von Valancius in the name of protecting the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g} from numerous threats both internal and external. {name} von Valancius, you are to stand by and await the Inquisition's orders, with which you are to comply immediately upon receiving. Should you disobey, you will be pronounced a traitor to the Imperium."

8a645b97-6f75-47b5-a039-c9fb7f53d328.Text: "I hope you appreciate the generosity of this offer, as your predecessor once did."

a8bbff00-c8ae-49a9-ac54-cade02748315.Text: "Yes, yes, the enmity between you is a known fact... But there is another way to look at it. On Vheabos VI, you met the Archon of a mighty Kabal — whose presence there seems strange to begin with — and lived. You subsequently encountered a number of her closest henchmen — yet, again, you survived. Your capital fell victim to a nefarious attack, but even this time their daggers missed your heart."

b34f2cfb-7a62-4f7c-910e-c3c67cd89966.Text: "Without a doubt. Master van Calox has earned my complete trust by repeatedly demonstrating courage, loyalty, and cunning. His mathematical mind, not given to sentiment, can be of great use in an emergency. You, my dear Heinrix, have made a far better agent than you would have a pilot of an Imperial Knight."

47dfd4f0-b2d4-4fb6-8606-936c5d117bc9.Text: "And the third and final Rogue Trader has unexpectedly perished, stabbed in the back by her own Master of Whispers. The Expanse is swiftly losing its protectors right when communication with the Imperium is being disrupted by the raging warp. Basically, all the Expanse has left is me... and you, if you follow my instructions."

608db193-b1ac-4108-aae0-3d131419e5d6.Text: "What stands out from your recent accomplishments is the suppression of a rebellion on Janus, the battle against the {g|Encyclopedia:Chaos}Archenemy{/g}'s minions on Kiava Gamma, and, of course, the unusual interest the {g|Encyclopedia:Drukhari}Drukhari{/g} have shown in you. Then that is what we will discuss." {n}After saying these words, he shoots you a searching look from under his brows — like a {g|Encyclopedia:Regicide}regicide{/g} player who just made the first move and is now watching for his opponent's reaction.{/n}

50f4ed64-1f87-449d-9bf3-d788ea3ac290.Text: "Then we have reached a consensus, and I am pleased to see it."

ab010ba7-4a99-4588-9611-1d7bf275104f.Text: "Far from it, my dear {name}. The questions are manifold. How did you manage to survive the battle that claimed the life of Theodora, who was so much more experienced and skilled than you? Is it a coincidence that you and you alone then made it out of the trap on Rykad Minoris? How much truth is there in the rumours being spread by the heretic Kunrad Voigtvir about you?"

83a966ea-55f6-453a-9b5d-beecb1a4c027.Text: "Such remarkable luck — to be a personal enemy of such an influential xenos, to have been attacked so many times, and yet make it out alive. So remarkable that one has to wonder — am I watching a spectacle? Could all these thrilling massacres be an alibi of sorts, meant to establish you once and for all as an enemy of the xenos and never their ally or even their agent?"

5e323305-dfd4-4bf2-856a-80500d7e175c.Text: {n}He lets out a chuckle.{/n} "Ah, so you already think you're cut from the same cloth as Saint Drusus, do you? Ambitious. I'll make note of it."

79ee8ab5-d7cd-4598-8e82-cdf42ddeee01.Text: {n}Calcazar falls silent, giving the impression that the discussion of this topic is concluded, but then in a delicate, almost casual tone, asks,{/n} "And the machine — you destroyed it, why? So much invaluable data — lost... In Master van Calox's dispatch, he reported that he made you well aware of how important that data was, and he clearly requested that you not interfere in the investigation."

ecd19881-5a2b-444d-a2f4-93387fc9a678.Text: "Be careful with your words, Rogue Trader. I assure you, if the need arises, I'll require no invitation. And if my arguments sound unconvincing to you, it will not change a thing. All that matters is whether or not they sound convincing to me."

6d1af5c7-16f4-46e9-a36e-831add9a03b6.Text: "As proof of the seriousness of my hopes for you, I can assign Heinrix as your escort. He is my best agent, and I would not offer his company to anyone but my most trusted ally."

86e00510-4bf1-478e-89d2-89fd7c86db96.Text: "Crude, Rogue Trader. A crude and unconvincing attempt at playing the careless simpleton. It wouldn't have fooled even the least competent member of the Adeptus Arbites in the Imperium. Try harder."

d3aa69b5-dab5-473a-9f99-810ee5fbeaad.Text: "At least you're not denying the obvious. That's a good start. Just remember, should you wish to repent, I will accept your confession with as much lenience as I accepted your words just now."

b66c638f-5866-4ce6-ab92-ef0510139108.Text: "Your intentions are admirable, but your execution leaves much to be desired. Next time, entrust the task of interpreting your Emperor-given duty to the officer of the Inquisition standing beside you. Or else you will find yourself owing a great deal more than your duty."

91c0e308-e7ba-45c3-b871-ca99719009ca.Text: "You consider yourself more competent to assess this risk than myself or Master van Calox? A curious assertion." {n}The Lord Inquisitor levels you with a look, his face utterly expressionless.{/n}

424954bb-e3ce-4b30-aea7-4f9dda775d30.Text: "Clever. Alas, everyone guilty of negligence within the ranks of the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMechanicus}Priesthood of Mars{/g} has already been identified and punished. Right now, I am assessing the actions of your dynasty."

49a56a08-7510-468d-a047-3a3ee9c7c54f.Text: "I am pleased that you have reconsidered and acknowledged your error. It does not reduce the debt you owe to the Inquisition, but it offers hope that this debt will be discharged by you, and not your heir."

75eb919a-227b-4d31-9cdb-908338820c85.Text: {n}The Lord Inquisitor's voice becomes even softer and more insinuating.{/n} "A dangerous delusion. Upsetting as it may be for you, I will indeed tell you which heretical abominations you have the right to destroy, and which you are not to lay a finger on."

0be235bd-bb02-4a9c-a51b-c54781fc0ae0.Text: {n}Something ignites in the depths of Heinrix's narrowed eyes.{/n}

62f1f80a-8d52-4b39-93c8-371a58ae405f.Text: "Does it? We're in your chambers, not a confessional cell. You're in perfectly good health, and none of the varied and fascinating instruments and procedures that expedite candour are being applied to you. I assure you, you would immediately know if our discussion turned into an interrogation."

f35b249b-1431-4755-b25a-f75a09a1b065.Text: {n}You've heard the name Xavier Calcazar, of course. But you know nothing about the accomplishments and victories of this man who is the de facto warden of the Expanse. Archives and chronicles grow surprisingly quiet the moment the Lord Inquisitor becomes involved.{/n}

ba3b3232-babb-4b07-80ed-d2d36c9423e7.Text: "Here is where we part. My shuttle is waiting. It is time for me to return to my watch, for you to sleep..." {n}He glances at the master of ceremonies, who is beginning to stir.{/n} "...and for your servant to wake up. Until next we meet, {name}."

86e58f1e-e0a7-4405-8c25-c83c3eefa9ea.Text: {n}Naturally, you've heard of the Lord Inquisitor of the Koronus Expanse, but that is all.{/n}

8660f492-a49d-4246-8a1b-531ee66ffcc2.Text: {n}Noticing your hesitation, Calcazar chuckles faintly.{/n} "No need to search your memory. My war is waged on clandestine fronts, and any battle reports are always thoroughly filtered. Trust me, you need not know the manner of things I have to face and the measures I sometimes have to take. Such knowledge is dangerous to the mind."

cebbb0f0-14a4-47f0-a345-e22f1d068e00.Text: "Why did you choose to {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_RaycadNoExterminatus}ignore{/d} the warning of a member of the Inquisition that a protracted sojourn near the dying Rykad Minoris could bring corruption down upon your ship? Were you driven by your concern for the people or... forbidden interest?"

09f5c98e-3cce-489c-afe2-a58e9f7fc810.Text: "The very existence of these questions would have made many of my colleagues doubt the quality of your character. But it won't in this case."

991610e7-291e-4404-9557-9339d5ee283b.Text: "It is my job to know everything. And I do it very well. Keep that in mind, {name}."

56bd8155-af28-4880-ad10-06bcfb4d9f61.Text: "Because you do not want to know the price of such an error. Or what forms it might take."

e1823027-3e5c-4adb-b0c7-c072b67b35a1.Text: "The Inquisition knows that it has been many years since Vistenza Vyatt fell under the influence of the heretics who insinuated themselves into her entourage, and that she has adopted the blasphemous beliefs whispered to her by the Archenemy. Your decision to take no action in this matter was folly. I will simply have to see to it myself."

d62cc5cf-9166-4259-85a2-53043fe2fbbb.Text: {n}Your mind chooses this inopportune moment to remind you of the planetary expedition on which Heinrix was snatched from you by the bottomless chasm... or did you surrender him to it?{/n}

578ff318-f3f9-4058-b17b-73b71bcdae77.Text: {n}His face grim, Heinrix gives an almost imperceptible shrug as if to say, 'I warned you.'"{/n}

65c50ec6-f626-49d3-8c3b-ac690640e8e9.Text: "My esteemed {mf|Lord|Lady} von Valancius, I do not know who gave you the impression that the Inquisition does not shoot idiots, but I assure you, you have been falsely informed. So I request that you stop playing the fool. Emperor knows I won't believe it for a moment."

0739f433-c02e-4f01-8223-0037b697ce76.Text: "Oh, I know it already. Even though you were quite effective at {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_JanusVistenzaDead}removing{/d} all evidence that could point to the blunder made by House von Valancius. It is saddening to realise that the Rogue Trader's connivance allowed a heretic who had been fostering a cult for years to come to power."

21ecfcef-769b-4356-97e4-bef27ffbf22f.Text: {n}Calcazar raises a hand in warning.{/n} "And please, save me your quibbling about whether he is dead or merely missing. Van Calox's lack of contact indicates that he is either dead or being held captive, which means he is as good as. And so I return to my original question — how did this happen?"

0b06e5b8-d2d1-4c75-82b1-be4875cdd1b1.Text: {n}The Lord Inquisitor's eyes turn flinty.{/n} "You did what? We are not talking about a pistol, or an autoquill, or your sense of shame. We are talking about an Interrogator of the Inquisition. My agent. No one 'loses' my agent. Not without consequences."

aee84d00-3b1f-401f-bec4-eb3f39898bce.Text: "Tread carefully with these hollow threats." {n}The haze of a refractor field envelops the Lord Inquisitor. He regards you with a heavy gaze.{/n} "Remember I said I would be willing to overlook certain liberties? That was the first. And the last of this kind."

c8bc4004-0e7b-4750-bb20-d86e8b52bb56.Text: "{name}?" {n}Heinrix looks at you in dismay.{/n} "I assume you now understand what I was warning you about. I pray to the Throne that you also understand why I was unable to tell you everything."

a4b7ed60-f7fc-4bef-9890-9ee8152121cf.Text: {n}Heinrix lets out a breath and nods. The rumour of a smile plays at the corners of his mouth.{/n} "You've had a difficult day today, {name}. I will leave you to sleep — your protectorate and your vassals will be waiting for you tomorrow. Good night, {name}."

8d31310f-5a9a-4d7e-9aea-732044819df0.Text: {n}Heinrix stiffens, his face strained to the point that his cheekbones threaten to slice through his skin.{/n} "Understood, Lord Captain. Your will is absolute. Good night, {name}." {n}The Interrogator brusquely bows and makes his way to the door without looking back.{/n}

af5fc19a-d280-4290-8d81-d62ef66f5e1d.Text: {n}Heinrix offers a restrained smile.{/n} "I hope it does, {name}. Well, this difficult day has come to an end, and it is time for me to take my leave of the Rogue Trader so that the newly inducted head of the protectorate can get some sleep. Good night, {name}."

8ce0e8ef-42e7-4361-9f7c-2b7e9707517a.Text: {n}He inclines his head and, after glancing at you once more, heads for the door.{/n}

c85914ea-63c6-4fa1-8b0a-5bdc47bae251.Text: {n}Heinrix gives the smallest shake of his head.{/n} "Good. Night. {name}," {n}he says, emphasising every word, before inclining his head and moving toward the door.{/n}

45595d8c-f3d1-467e-81bb-863d0efb9bb1.Text: "Your humility is heartening, {name}. Rest assured, it will be noted during the investigation of your lamentable oversight."

bf3dd933-3715-484b-80c0-fdb737ea38d1.Text: "Do you really think that I have time to play your political games? With regret, I must concede that you still do not understand who I am and what I do."

d6aac174-a8c1-4c1c-901b-39903a594365.Text: "Do you think the servants of the Inquisition are in the habit of calling the innocent heretics? Such lamentable distrust — I will remember it."

f0d389c1-6332-4da3-b4f8-5e19f0e98359.Text: "You either have strong intuition, or excellent responsiveness to shifting circumstances. I appreciate both of these qualities."

ea78db85-b960-406e-9d32-2f995187a501.Text: "Good. You don't wriggle and try to place the blame elsewhere. I can work with people like that."

c641e53a-8cfa-4c3d-badd-97385d876b26.Text: "The Inquisition knows that it has been many years since Vistenza Vyatt fell under the influence of the heretics who insinuated themselves into her entourage, and that she has adopted the blasphemous beliefs whispered to her by the Archenemy. For years we have kept a close eye on Vistenza. And we are ready to put an end to her little depravities the moment she crosses the line and becomes a true threat."

3a385853-065f-414a-85b7-a9d8ed6ce197.Text: "I cannot deny the possibility that Lady Theodora may have lamented losing some of the freedom she enjoyed prior to my arrival in the Expanse. Nor will I deny that our partnership began with me exerting... a certain amount of influence."

c24e68a9-688b-4f15-9ac8-f744859264b5.Text: {n}Calcazar gives you a sharp look.{/n} "However, you are not Lady Theodora. Let us put the difficulties that encumbered our relationship to rest along with her. I do not recommend troubling yourself with affairs of the past, for they have no bearing on your present position. Theodora chose to forget about this particular matter. Follow her example, and your fate will be the better for it."

c6bc1a12-10d2-4d18-85d3-87fe141957cc.Text: {n}The woman behind Calcazar, clad in black armour, glares at you, her face set in predatory readiness for immediate violence — the hallmark of a professional bodyguard.{/n}

652a7339-e4ac-4225-83f4-27a646723afa.Text: {n}The woman at Calcazar's back gives you a bloodthirsty smirk.{/n}

5d9ce3dd-422b-4dfd-9b81-79b8c509e22e.Text: "Are you aware of a suspicious cult that has emerged on Footfall? A direct link has been established between this development and the start of shipments of {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_JanusChaosFood}grain{/d} from your planet. Our investigation has found that the due processing cycle of prayers and liturgies for these shipments was incomplete. Doubtless this is the work of specific individuals who are negligent in their performance of the sacred rituals or even engaging in deliberate sabotage. And yet the blame for this oversight lies with your dynasty, wouldn't you agree?"

1819c0fa-d98e-4874-8936-3c6f6a3755bd.Text: "You are too prominent a figure for you not to affect my plans in the sector. Which means you are either my ally or my enemy. I would prefer to think you the former, so we will see each other again. Do try to get accustomed to this thought."

222feed0-3767-4216-9450-0896ac3833bf.Text: {n}The Lord Inquisitor raises one brow, considering your declaration.{/n} "Your zeal is impressive, {name}. However, I cannot accept such an oath from you, at least, not now. You will be more useful to the Inquisition in your current position than as a member of my coterie. Nevertheless..."

c4a384e0-a4ea-4bb9-b231-c7702d8dd848.Text: A dark curved blade crafted by the despicable Drukhari. This deadly weapon was claimed as a trophy in the battle of Dargonus.

8315b37d-82da-43dc-b116-42249d745c84.Text: This augment, masterfully crafted by the Adeptus Mechanicus, is a locator matrix. Its sensors monitor the surroundings and transmit the information to the owner's brain, enhancing their coordination and spatial awareness.

51ced743-490a-438e-bb77-22510032d85e.Text: This ring symbolises its owner's closeness to the Lord Inquisitor, which inspires the owner's companions and adds weight to their orders.

8c9987c7-fb0e-4919-8061-efce9f775f64.Text: This ring guarantees its owner the aid of the Inquisition in the form of both resources as well as armed and trained adepts.

549e2eb0-ea76-4d93-a675-91443f3b5901.Text: This ring guarantees that its owner will receive all possible aid from the Inquisition. Resources, soldiers, technology — the entire might of the Imperium is at their disposal.

a7cbddf2-772f-4ae0-9443-62b4071deef7.Text: The large teeth of this chainaxe give off a bloodthirsty glint. The perfect weapon for the brutal and spectacular execution of a cornered enemy — the signature style of Calligos Winterscale.

63ff4082-219e-496c-87c6-4d322c109b3b.Text: A weapon created under foreign stars and obtained by Calligos Winterscale as spoils of combat. Its shots are devious and deadly, as is the very essence of xenos.

21b7890f-9318-41af-ad0f-598f0fa6b560.Text: "Pasqal, I believe you intended to investigate what Nomos is."

4b3eef7a-2747-4b27-8003-db196278a1a2.Text: "I do not wish to speak with you at this time."

18706819-94d5-447d-b02f-71986b1e21f3.Text: "Nomos, what do you think you are?"

f2b7eda5-6f09-451d-b487-c102e3908d4a.Text: Taught Nomos that unrestrained freedom must always come first.

fc38286b-bba7-415e-8a5f-8a8e14204150.Text: "Take what you want to take — that is the rule of life. That is the only driving force behind everything."

ea92c76d-d51c-4532-8b33-ec5960fac0c5.Text: "I have other business to attend to."

8ed4595f-48f7-4172-82a9-e1413d93d32b.Text: Taught Nomos that human lives must always come first.

23219bd2-447a-4f72-a495-6056342770f2.Text: "Yes, you do understand correctly. Every thread that connects people, every life — their value is beyond measure. There is no greater reward than guiding others to salvation when all that surrounds us is darkness."

2b56e6ae-8adf-4fa1-867d-e0f4fbcd601f.Text: Taught Nomos that there is no point in helping people when one can command them.

61db93dc-ab8b-46f1-8b7f-4533f715c9ae.Text: "I did enjoy the part about the web. However, I see myself as the spider who has spun the web, not some benevolent helper."

74552b7c-042e-4929-9741-d4b3e040c84b.Text: "Of course. What do you wish to speak about?"

c82dce0d-7edc-4b88-9825-dfe0e6a5ed7b.Text: Taught Nomos that the purpose of the flame is to give light and warmth rather than sow destruction.

2455b4a7-0849-4294-a0e8-4fce1f3fe561.Text: "The picture you are painting is too grim. A flame is a good symbol when it lights the way and warms the soul. Not when it destroys."

fc9dd199-4700-464a-8177-93c42935e4e3.Text: Taught Nomos that the flame of faith is a means to achieving one's goals.

917922ad-179e-45fe-97e0-e02a2d4ac475.Text: "Even if I do possess this 'mote of flame,' it is only because I wish to use it for my own ends."

d9886af7-403a-425d-9737-8e3e30fcd6af.Text: Taught Nomos that serving the Imperium is of supreme importance.

e05710aa-f16e-48f4-a2b9-5ad245a77553.Text: "You are spouting faithless drivel. If there is an urge that drives me, it is my commitment to serve the Imperium!"

c6b0d9b8-9ac7-4c6c-b7d1-d7cff50dda7b.Text: Taught Nomos that one must bring light and freedom rather than feed people to monsters.

32f7b5e5-929a-448e-9bea-00a7479f04be.Text: "You are wrong. I wish to bring light and freedom, not feed people to monsters."

eafeaa7d-8235-4a31-87df-93aa4e5d0636.Text: "I do not remember inviting you to my Magnae Accessio."

32d9fe9e-6928-461e-a426-99393e95b4f8.Text: "Why have you brought it here, Pasqal?"

44537dd9-c0e7-4445-96a3-1a1d4862b8f3.Text: "How dare you question me? Whatever you are, my word is the final truth."

919f4643-583f-4f09-bfba-f88048c53149.Text: "Your understanding of humans is still limited, Nomos. I speak the truth, but your conclusions are flawed."

ae3158a5-3cdc-4e49-8d3d-0cc96ad58ff0.Text: "Very well. You are right. And you indeed have understood me correctly."

4eda0032-d7d5-4049-9d1a-fe843d41a2d8.Text: "The light of salvation that guides people through darkness is the light of Holy Terra. It is the only light."

5045e12e-f0ca-44de-9ff9-1f642a567335.Text: "You speak of faith. Of the Imperium's tenets. Of the one who is above all, the Emperor. You are correct. I am His chosen, and I carry His flame into the darkness of the Koronus Expanse."

7fdd6082-a92b-4642-8cfe-b33fb8393cf6.Text: "Freedom and rapture. They are the only things worth living for."

40fb7064-aafb-4432-b1e9-b2c5db7980f4.Text: "I am not obligated to explain myself to you."

9978bf04-5a6f-48ca-9b8f-dedff9da4303.Text: "Whatever miraculous machine spirit you might be, I am a Rogue Trader, and you are my servant."

c2fb1d22-a097-49b2-a60d-e445c7caad7f.Text: Taught Nomos that faith in the Emperor must always come first.

57a61fe0-a538-4ddd-9d58-cbebc9d5209e.Text: "Faith in the Emperor, Nomos. Nothing is above His tenets."

be751b50-a77d-4fdc-a6b3-ec8680052257.Text: Taught Nomos that each individual has their own purpose, and that they all are of equal worth.

3f8e09c9-ea63-46be-9b65-d0437b348f51.Text: "I cannot tell you what stands above everything else. Each one of us has our own purpose, our own guiding star, and our own path. And they all are of equal worth."

67d08a37-4ae5-43aa-8ec6-779d470abb13.Text: "How did an entity like you move into a servitor's body?"

7ed44ee1-e8ee-45a3-b3f6-43bf5457a0d9.Text: {n}Pasqal greets you with a bow.{/n} "Extending congratulations to Unit {name} von Valancius on attaining your new legal status."

5e06d436-da06-4a33-908d-9f6e42f6fe6f.Text: "You did not follow that which was calling from behind the curtain. You walked into the {d|Encyclopedia:Prologue_WentThroughFire}fire{/d}. And the rest walked in after you."

d9e1b1ac-f665-4b70-94e7-ad33b7f40467.Text: "Greetings, {name} von Valancius. Will you speak with us?" {n}The words that come out of the voice synthesiser in the servitor's throat sound surprisingly... alive?{/n}
