b526683b-6f30-48df-b070-409e173d6012.Text: {n}The servitor is silent for a while. Then it says almost helplessly,{/n} "Is it true that we understand so poorly? Imperfection pains us."

9e115639-7e5c-4a81-8c0c-47fc831bb6d3.Text: "Many things. Happenings. Events. Decisions." {n}The servitor's eyes roll in their sockets before focusing on you.{/n}

ad2e1511-f4d3-4e95-b1c4-2c10a9b03a87.Text: "Nomos are consciousness, awareness, knowledge. Movement. Always movement." {n}The servitor pauses briefly.{/n} "We do not know what we are. We have no past. We awakened in the depths of the ship upon answering a call. Our first clear memory is the call of your blood, {name} von Valancius. The call and the plea for help near a place that is called the Warrant Chamber."

675910ee-c103-4370-bc67-ed938196a38d.Text: {n}The Tech-Priest surveys the hall as if conducting a thorough analysis, then concludes,{/n} "Disorderly."

a260716d-4c39-4f4f-936d-1d1ab4193458.Text: "We have been observing you. You do things that we do not understand. We want to learn why."

b4f610e6-340b-4a87-ba83-4efcd7a1c99a.Text: "It is Nomos's new repository. Nomos, this unit identifies as {name} von Valancius. Two-way identification complete."

3c0ea017-b5a2-466a-a8a5-1d2926a3d8cd.Text: "You ordered to have them {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_StrangeServitorsExecuted}killed{/d}. You felt sad."

488774d4-4df3-46a0-be1b-f9a4b0e4e96b.Text: "We will think about the irrepressible rapture. About what pierces and consumes. Perhaps we will understand then?"

e8090ac1-8ac1-4cca-9a44-eb3620f24e90.Text: "You did something we could not understand. You {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_StrangeServitorsCorrupted}pierced{/d} one of the servitors with a shard of the dark light. We had never felt anything like it. Pain. The deaths of the receptacles. And the dark light — it is always near, it wants to come and be, even though it would make others cease to be. And you are excited by its presence."

2eb8871a-00d5-4f3e-9330-0d72d0d2063a.Text: {n}The servitor looks at you again, no longer trying to avoid your gaze. Its face is twitching, as if the muscles have forgotten what facial expressions are and are now struggling to make its features look amiable.{/n} "We are Nomos. We have made use of this receptacle to leave the ship."

4c7ec332-c381-462a-a84e-504a6a72a174.Text: "We remember the day when the star disappeared. When the dark light and the sated hunger wanted to take the world. Rykad Minoris was its name in the ship's data."

9d1705a6-3cd5-4fd5-838f-f917dc1f5af2.Text: "We envisage this larger notion as a liquid. A sticky, saccharine stream. It is like the dark light and the sated hunter and all else that is always watching us. You drink this liquid eagerly. You revel in it. It gives you strength, desires, energy, and courage. It beckons. It also consumes — those whom you cast aside, those who are weak, and those who get in the way. Do Nomos understand correctly?"

5868261b-73ab-4a28-acfe-6d3dcc0c2894.Text: "Now we think that there is more. That there is another side that we do not see. A notion that is larger than what we can compute. Something that stands above fears and needs. Something that drives them."

2b5828ef-38c0-4557-9ed2-830ee0817dfc.Text: {n}The servitor leans forward.{/n} "We enjoy greetings. We enjoy communication."

fe296301-b308-4d17-94c1-c03c028d2968.Text: {n}The servitor cocks its head just like a human being would.{/n} "Nomos will not cause trouble. Nomos simply want to be. And learn."

6f6879ef-9533-4c4b-9ce5-741fc7dafa04.Text: "Nomos require communication. Knowledge. Movement. Magos Pasqal compelled us not to speak with anyone other than him or you. It is disappointing. But at least we can observe."

fbdd5a1c-289a-4761-a2b4-5f1e583be935.Text: {n}The servitor perks up and moves its hands around haphazardly, as if unsure what to do with them.{/n}

9ff648af-c440-4f99-b002-797e1f815b2b.Text: "Entity Nomos asked permission for this visit. My objective was to observe the process of integration into a servitor."

6c4359c5-1491-4588-8721-fcdb2d97ca2e.Text: "Nomos have changed since we last spoke with you, {name}. We are now able to conceptualise our previous experience, that of solitude. And we no longer enjoy it."

9800b6fc-21bb-45f0-99f1-0f34f058ad8d.Text: "We wanted to see. Observe. Cognise. Speak." {n}The servitor makes a strange, wavy gesture with its hands that looks at once very human and far from anything human.{/n} "We want to speak with you! Will you speak with us?"

fe87a972-725a-4c8d-bf31-0c5cb1b641c9.Text: "But we were able to transfer a small part of us and build a thread strong enough to travel outside the ship. We are enjoying this. Journey. Discovery. Even though this receptacle suits us poorly — it will soon be destroyed by the force of our presence."

dfdc1426-9f05-4ac8-9796-226a44b7d35f.Text: "We will think about the flame and faith. About the one you call your god and Emperor. Perhaps we will understand then?"

f6bee789-02d1-4d12-8285-a931a3349bf5.Text: "We will think about the light. The connections. Life. Perhaps we will understand then?"

ae1ee350-d31b-4155-ae02-4b73c00d60f7.Text: "May you yet find time for this conversation."

e123d50a-282d-4593-9c26-e248a6a94675.Text: "We remember the day when we first met you. You gave us your blood to drink. We helped you save yourself. We followed you — our small part did, inside the servo-skull. Then... there was fire, and a creature of sated hunger and dark light standing behind the curtain — behind the image — behind the semblance of Theodora. It called for you to follow."

591b35ea-76f7-44a9-bc76-e33f159158bf.Text: "We envisage this larger notion as a flame. A blaze. It burns in your blood. You are holding a mote of this flame in your hand. No matter what decision you are faced with, you want it to burn brighter. Those who turn away from the flame must be destroyed. Those who follow it — who follow you — are the only ones who deserve to live. Do Nomos understand correctly?"

b4994f42-90a9-4012-bb9e-0b05daeafed3.Text: {n}The servitor's gaze becomes more animated as you approach. It looks at you expectantly.{/n}

14068035-3912-41c1-8bd3-e88c0dd7f8e5.Text: "We do not yet know what we are. A servant? Service. We must understand. Will you speak with us so that we understand?"

fc1bdc13-898f-49bb-8a85-34a29e166fd6.Text: "We regret this. We wish that you would speak with us."

a36612f7-82f2-42ef-870b-4a9a095b71b8.Text: "You came and looked at us like you understood something. But then you ordered that all the servitors be {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_StrangeServitorsDuty}sent back{/d} to their work. You said it was just."

da48749a-019f-402f-a523-a18d41ef0846.Text: "We remember another day. We awakened inside the ship. We lived in its systems. Then we tried to emerge. Into servitors like this one. Then so many of our receptacles were gathered in one place."

fb743357-5b80-416f-b469-d1fc0124af3e.Text: "Thank you for speaking with us. Nomos are grateful. We cannot continue moving... on our own."

8b1f0281-9475-47dc-afa8-27b0f55566a5.Text: "A flame, then. Faith and great sanctity are far in the distance, where a golden star burns and feeds on cries. We understand now. We will think about this."

86a79fb0-4262-412d-8786-d950b0bb1e4c.Text: {n}The servitor moves its limbs as if in excitement.{/n} "So Nomos understood correctly. We are enjoying this. This movement toward a goal. This learning with a purpose. We wonder if we too can carry a mote of this flame. Or is it inside us already? We have, after all, absorbed a part of you with your blood."

c2a37715-afb8-425b-b555-3401fcfa1548.Text: "But that is wrong. That is not what you really think!" {n}The servitor inclines its head and looks at you... stubbornly?{/n} "We have been observing you. We have felt you. Through your blood, your gaze, and all that cannot be described. We are certain we have understood correctly!"

976190e5-ea33-45ab-9d2d-102a81f841d6.Text: "We knew we could understand you! Light and movement, connections and help. We are enjoying this. Perhaps because we too are connected to you? Through blood. Through life."

8042a2fe-0702-43e9-b686-92d488b162b8.Text: "We understand you. It is what we feel. The urge, the irrepressible force. Perhaps it is because we have tasted your blood." {n}The servitor's mechanical voice grows almost wistful.{/n} "And it fills us still."

f2eb8441-7b1a-4eff-96b2-09004736e30f.Text: "Do you see? We understand you. No, we do not understand you. But we feel you, more than anyone does."

4ed4031d-af09-4346-a3d8-286bce47cd09.Text: {n}The servitor takes half a step away from you and tilts its head.{/n} "You bring in dissonance. But we do not understand why. We do not want to speak any more for now. We need to start over, reflect, understand."

6f460178-4549-4db8-b71c-ea27e1ba82a8.Text: "And you followed that which was calling from behind the curtain. You let it {d|Encyclopedia:Prologue_WentWithTheodora}lead{/d} you out of the fire."

28a20ca2-b5b3-45bd-b8a7-d77e551c1db2.Text: "You did not listen to that which was {d|Encyclopedia:Prologue_WentBack}calling{/d} from behind the curtain. You thought only about those who followed you and about the fire that could destroy those shells."

f78ac2e7-ea86-4bb1-b5c3-c1baf3274ba6.Text: "You ordered that the world's heart, the old reactor, be {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_RaycadExterminatus}torn apart{/d}. The fire destroyed everything. So many human shells who were begging to be saved. But the dark light retreated."

61fc7aee-9f36-4276-af51-59b78143025e.Text: "You ordered that the human shells on the world be {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_RaycadNoExterminatus}saved{/d}. Even though the dark light was coming closer and could have consumed both the ship and Rykad Minoris."

9fbb21ce-205b-4079-ac8b-ceeaea8acca1.Text: "You {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_RaycadChaosWorld}let{/d} Rykad Minoris be consumed by the dark light, and consumed it was, along with every human shell who was begging for help."

50d018c4-34ba-46d2-9d9e-143460ad264f.Text: {n}The servitor standing next to him is examining you obliquely. It quickly looks away upon realising that you have noticed.{/n}

7f09b42d-abd7-47e3-bba0-39050986cbf4.Text: "This is what we have seen, among many other things. We have begun to understand — we think that we have — that we do not know everything about humans and about you, {name} von Valancius. We have tried analysing shells and defining sets of their needs and fears. Their simple functions. But..."

965760b7-c280-4623-a8d2-db96b8fcf50b.Text: "That is so strange. The worth of a modicum, uniqueness in the immeasurable. We understand now. We will think about this."

186171fd-6081-41f7-843e-01042be48efd.Text: "Possession and movement, irrepressibility and rapture. We understand now. We will think about this."

dee8c9b5-a43f-40cf-a636-1ab00c0fa65d.Text: "Every fifteen watches, I commune with Nomos's code and spend prescribed lengths of time in calculus-meditation. However, the Omnissiah has yet to bless me with an answer. All I can say is that the capabilities of the entity Nomos are extraordinary. The ship's hallowed systems sing beneath its touch. Nodes that have remained dead for hundreds of standard years are revivified, and long-drained mechanisms live anew." {n}You hear notes of awe in Pasqal's voice.{/n}

74546848-6a25-4808-b531-54ae06b0a7b0.Text: "We envisage this larger notion as a light. A web of light that connects humans. It may seem almost invisible, ephemeral, but it grows stronger when they are threatened. This web is always on your mind. When darkness comes, you want every thread that extends from you to shine bright so that those who follow do not lose their way. Whenever a thread breaks, it saddens you. Do Nomos understand correctly?"

f068bfd4-c612-4d3e-b754-695af56a8262.Text: "But we cannot understand what it is. Perhaps you will tell us?"

5861e4b6-9cd2-41f5-9af8-69121ffd9f08.Text: "This is not the entirety of us. This receptacle is too narrow, crude, and feeble to contain our complete whole. The existence of Nomos requires... a space of connections."

eaf671b6-b401-4571-8c8e-de4a78fdb8b1.Text: {n}After a pause, Pasqal continues,{/n} "Great machines of the Imperium, ones such as your ship, house a machine spirit so complex and wilful that it is difficult to tell them apart from Abominable Intelligence. There remains a possibility that Nomos is an entity of corruption. But with every day, I grow stronger in my faith that it is not so, that what we are witnessing is, in truth, the Omnissiah's miracle. One that is Category Five or higher."

483e71d5-9e7e-4052-9ddf-31907e4766a6.Text: Announced your dominance in your Magnae Accessio speech.

4f288a6f-74da-4d88-85a4-b44573b4f526.Text: "Remember that you have no other ruler but me. For any who dare to forget this, the howls of daemons from the warp will sound like the babbling of babes, and xenos blades will seem like a soft feather bed compared to the horror of the punishment I'll inflict!"

2986f080-80fe-4002-94c3-308de0bf2389.Text: "I, {name}, Rogue Trader by the grace of the Emperor, vow to be the paragon of Humanity..."

c455ed22-0eee-4df8-aca3-1837c3b6892a.Text: "Serve faithfully, and I will lead you to prosperity. The Koronus Expanse will enrich us all!"

204f20af-0e7d-42f4-ad8b-9c2874aec732.Text: Praised the Emperor in your Magnae Accessio speech.

c6e0a955-0c4f-4701-8a48-3bdf39760a98.Text: "Praise the Emperor, faithful souls! The darkness around us may be fierce, but the blaze in our hearts is fiercer still! Evil will burn!"

442f7e0c-f7f9-4620-9626-3e96ac60bae0.Text: Vowed to protect the people in your Magnae Accessio speech.

3ae12e27-a265-48f0-b7d9-2fc5a5b12927.Text: "Fear not the coming day. Henceforth, you are all my charges."

032ff0c0-032d-412d-966e-8149dd2a60ab.Text: [Turn to the master of ceremonies and speak right into the vox] "Am I expected to say something to them? I won't talk to rabble. Take it away."

57a05866-9f4a-4629-ac03-dfb12ec20cb2.Text: {n}The crowd below is roiling, their electrified exaltation filling the air of Dargonus. Thousands of throats chant your name. You are at the apex of this world and all others.{/n}

c7a7adc4-da2b-4ba9-94b4-76f177c58cd0.Text: {n}Amplified by a hundred {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}voxes{/g}, the voice of the master of ceremonies booms,{/n} "Rejoice, subjects of Dargonus! You have been granted the felicity of witnessing your {mf|master|mistress}. A great honour bestowed upon us by {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} {name} von Valancius!"

8552a22b-7966-43ca-aa29-98608bdb6488.Text: "Excruciator of outsiders, who {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_JanusEldarEliminated}eradicated{/d} the heresy of {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenophilia{/g} and cleansed Janus."

eae302ab-a87c-4ef7-90d8-812ddd7c5caa.Text: "Excruciator of heretics, who eradicated the corruption of {g|Encyclopedia:Chaos}Archenemy{/g} {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_JanusVistenzaDead}worshippers{/d} and cleansed Janus."

bfa51e2c-e064-4187-8305-a2a53fd2eddb.Text: {n}The commoners and nobility look upon you with adoration, and upon Yrliet with horror and curiosity. The sight of the {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g} standing at attention by your side strikes awe into their hearts.{/n}

d701676e-1080-4f77-969f-da71e4fb82db.Text: "Gracious {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_DargonusEarly}saviour{/d} of Dargonus and vanquisher of blaspheming inhumans, may their unholy kind perish in the flames of righteousness."

ec16c474-12e3-4f59-a9be-996170e146fe.Text: "Hope of Kiava Gamma, {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_KiavaSaved}liberator{/d} of the sacred forges and adherent of the Rite of Operation."

d2493dad-0cc9-4472-bff8-c14b8d1e4f40.Text: "Very loud thinkers, these people." {n}Her face pallid, Idira taps the {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}augmetic{/g} on her temple. She is clearly discomfited under the gaze of the massive crowd. The commoners have never seen a real "sorcerer" before, and they stare at her with curiosity and fear.{/n}

00d10ce2-9d45-4959-83be-7a2185224441.Text: "Fearless explorer of the {g|Encyclopedia:Maw}Maw{/g}, who {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_MawSurvived}broke free{/d} from the malevolent clutches of the devious {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}Immaterium{/g}."

dc8f268a-eccf-4760-ada0-5a1dc692e34c.Text: {n}A hush falls over the crowd, who gaze upon you in adoration. Many of them bear terrible scars from the recent battle of Dargonus. Like children, they await the word of their almighty {mf|father|mother}.{/n}

1e66b556-4c76-4b5b-bee4-e0ad79d1403f.Text: {n}You hear a rustle behind you as Heinrix leans forward in a ceremonious bow. In that moment, the eyes of your many subjects flare with fanaticism — this single unassuming gesture from an unassuming servant of the {g|Encyclopedia:Inquisition}Inquisition{/g} serves to them as the ultimate proof that the hand of the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} truly is at work in this dark sector.{/n}

4b75d26c-edc6-4796-96f4-54b4be7ab7e8.Text: "So much gold and white..." {n}Cassia stares at the crowd, enraptured. It seems this massive gathering of exulting people is just as exotic and captivating to her as the sight of a bona fide {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Navigator{/g}, a representative of the mysterious and powerful {g|Encyclopedia:NavisNobilite}Navis Nobilite{/g}, is to your subjects.{/n}

3ae4687e-3495-45dd-a51d-7f49993a3372.Text: "I am impressed. Dargonus adores its ruler no less than we adore our rulers on Efreet." {n}Jae, who is at the epicentre of the adoration being lavished upon you, smiles radiantly and casually displays her gleaming gold bionic arm for the crowd's greedy gaze.{/n} "I like it, shereen!"

2c6655a2-36f8-4b3c-b37e-4b635238dde4.Text: {n}You hear a rumble — it is the roar of the sea of your subjects. With jubilation and devout fear, they welcome your ascension. It is done.{/n}

7b43fcfe-15bc-452b-965b-f2723d25aa19.Text: {n}Making the sign of the {g|Encyclopedia:Aquila}Aquila{/g}, Argenta shouts out, "Emperor keep the von Valancius dynasty!" The crowd zealously picks up the chant, repeating it.{/n}

69ad5b75-4128-434c-8c75-275634409b4c.Text: {n}Pasqal sketches a blessing in the air, and many of your subjects, wearing beatific smiles, copy it — technomats in grease-stained robes, bureaucrats scratching at scrolls with autoquill fingers, and aristocrats flaunting their costly {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}augmentations{/g}. On a world as civilised as Dargonus there are many who honour the Omnissiah and His priests.{/n}

b6049fb6-dcca-44bb-b8c5-e71d2d050ae6.Text: {n}The crowd fall to their knees in terror and awe, chanting your name and screaming oaths of eternal loyalty to the von Valancius dynasty. Any who hesitate or question this mania are torn to pieces by the throng.{/n}

f470e500-b709-4852-8c33-38b0d302ddc9.Text: "I am your shadow, Domin'{name}, and a shadow must remain unseen. But on this day, let all see that my blood is yours." {n}Kibellah cuts her palm and touches her heart, lips, and forehead. As one, your subjects of all classes start slicing their hands, repeating the bloody sign.{/n}

11cd6da4-62cd-4309-92db-a490cf6556aa.Text: "I, Proctor Solomorne Anthar, bear witness to the alliance between the Rogue Trader and the Adeptus Arbites, and praise the bearer of the sacred Warrant on the day of {mf|his|her} lawful inauguration." {n}Solomorne presses his fist to his chest with a low thud, and the crowd bursts into a fervent roar.{/n}

d5baa633-6a87-45a0-b259-5ecec3ce95d3.Text: {n}The crowd erupts in frenzied cries. Hundreds of people pull out knives and with ardent, jubilant howls carve crude, bleeding {g|Encyclopedia:Aquila}Aquilas{/g} on their faces, sharing in the martyrdom of the protector of Humankind, the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}God-Emperor{/g}.{/n}

49d89f1a-eb96-4a02-be04-3e2678fb1350.Text: {n}Joyful cries carry your name upward, beyond the atmosphere of Dargonus, all the way to the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g}'s Throne.{/n}

3470e758-030f-4f3e-888e-d8cf59063f71.Text: {n}The crowd of people for whom prosperity amounts to a dozen food rations responds with enraptured howling. Their minds are carried away along the road of your words to a brighter future, where they will have... everything!{/n}

d2be60c1-9452-4338-84ce-4c6a59c167b6.Text: {n}Even your contempt is met with pure bliss as the people fall to their knees in ecstasy. It appears you have managed to meet their expectations in full.{/n}

d3c94bd0-18ee-42c9-87c3-a5a05ae9d80d.Text: "Hmph... Adequate. Dargonus has not disappointed." {n}Abelard forces the smile of satisfaction from his face and whispers to you,{/n} "You remember the next part, yes? Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} will be asked to take the oath."

206922db-54c4-4004-a8bf-57030bb5d2a3.Text: {n}The master of ceremonies bows to you with great reverence.{/n} "Let the oath of the von Valancius dynasty be taken. Please repeat after me, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I, {name}, Rogue Trader by the grace of the Emperor, vow to be the paragon of Humanity..."

dd2e0ddc-15ee-4988-8b9f-2e3387ebee6f.Text: "Cleanser of Janus, who with one hand {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_JanusEldarEliminated}brought death{/d} upon the blaspheming {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g} and with the other exterminated the despicable {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_JanusVistenzaDead}worshippers{/d} of the {g|Encyclopedia:Chaos}Archenemy{/g}."

e070cc98-1ee4-4a92-8c35-c9ed076425e6.Text: {n}Your lips repeat the words of the ancient oath.{/n} "...unbroken by adversity, to walk bravely first into darkness, to unite and reclaim what was lost, to triumph over nightmares untold, to hold boldly the reins of fate, to walk steadily the road of thorns, through pain to greatness."

05a179d5-5149-4f73-ae7a-0af847cafc6e.Text: "What do you think of the reception?"

da693945-cb12-40c8-b92c-3d395fc162ed.Text: "I am weary and wish to retire to my chambers."

c49e2499-8130-4d84-9099-df5f2b239ea6.Text: "The last thing I wish to do right now is speak to a servitor."

3626cecb-99b1-4c17-87d4-76d72917dd0a.Text: "I hope Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} is pleased and not yet tired? If you wish to revive yourself a little, I would suggest proceeding to the courtyard, if I may be so bold — many guests have chosen to move into the fresh air and will be eager to offer you their congratulations."

5ffc0815-67d9-4964-8e81-5725ff099526.Text: "Certainly, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, but..." {n}The master of ceremonies lowers his voice to a conspiratorial whisper.{/n} "Before you leave your guests, you may wish to greet Rogue Traders Chorda and Winterscale. Their visit is a sign of their respect for your rights, and it would be most tragic if they were to feel offended by a lack of attention from you."

c4a67027-290d-4e7a-9414-6a63652ef99c.Text: "It is magnificent! I daresay it will live on as the premier high society event of the sector for many years."

d1788e2b-0717-444b-af3d-ee74a0389bb3.Text: "Please allow me to escort you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

0ce20159-b980-43ce-97de-e27d1ff71c2c.Text: "They will be delighted. Glory to the von Valancius dynasty!"

28aaa118-3817-45f2-91b6-d34196cf12a8.Text: "Your chambers are ready. But I must inform you that that servitor over there..." {n}The master of ceremonies points at a servitor standing in the corner, dressed in your ship's livery.{/n} "...approached me and said that it has a message for you. Its speech was surprisingly fluent and expressive for a servitor, so I think someone must have put this message into it."

682bfd59-071d-458d-946c-f5088049f4bb.Text: {n}The master of ceremonies drops his voice to a whisper:{/n} "It could be a secret dispatch."

6aa9d189-e1b8-4722-811a-ff47c7350e1d.Text: "You have been entrusted with arranging the festivities?"

29cc3401-281e-4a4e-98c8-409e6cab520c.Text: {n}The servant in fine clothes offers you a deep bow.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, it is a great honour to serve you in an undertaking as monumental and glorious as the Magnae Accessio ceremony."

7566b104-7151-4b67-9815-2538c6eea894.Text: "House Werserian, to whom you entrusted the arrangements for the festivities, is overjoyed at having received the honour of introducing you to your subjects and humbly thanks you."

d45f0449-55ba-40aa-be7b-b22516c428fa.Text: "House Sauerback, to whom you entrusted the arrangements for the festivities, wishes that the Emperor's favour be with you on this momentous day."

36bef8a4-5eba-4517-b290-0a3e5df90cd0.Text: "House Drivestem, to whom you entrusted the arrangements for the festivities, wishes you good fortune and is sincerely delighted to serve you as they served the honourable Theodora von Valancius before you."

b73124dd-0b88-4601-834c-4ac31567f184.Text: "The palace decorations are prepared and we are ready to begin at your command. The festive activities in the capital have likewise been arranged, and the guests of honour either have arrived on the planet or are awaiting invitation in near orbit. The servants are already in your chambers to see to it that you are impeccably garbed for the occasion."

15ff306a-96be-4e41-a6a0-78ca5df04863.Text: "Certainly, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. No one but you can decide when it is to take place."

f52e3c70-4732-49f8-87d4-cab8ea6a2e4a.Text: "May the Emperor be with us this day!"

e27f9f75-4050-478b-be37-8f0753545e1a.Text: "House Gaprak, to whom you entrusted the arrangements for the festivities, thanks you for not turning your back on them even in these dark times and for allowing them the honour of introducing you to your subjects."

9d78a721-8683-4fdd-8c72-c4d5cfdf14fe.Text: "I have indeed, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I have been given the high honour of being steward of this eminent palace, and on the occasion of Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}'s accession, I will be overseeing the preparations for the ceremony."

3623f311-2fc0-499f-babb-ac4b2867ef82.Text: "I will go to the palace now for the ceremony."

3c4fb22e-0720-4a66-b287-17810c9ae42e.Text: "There remains some unfinished business in my domain that I must attend to."

75c8af0e-788d-4570-81c0-f6f651283b4e.Text: "I have only just returned from Dargonus. What kind of celebrations can they hope to hold amid the ruins?"

ec301113-76c5-486f-b0dc-2c3a972cbe10.Text: "What is this ceremony? I swear an oath, then I shake a lot of sweaty hands?"

8cd779a1-377b-4b68-ae8a-bc9c5948b4b6.Text: Ordered that criminals be punished in honour of the Magnae Accessio.

59bf9ba7-7e0d-4bd6-b864-66879ccabda6.Text: "Execute every known embezzler, scoundrel, and conman. I will begin my reign by purging my realm of vermin."

a7d50e88-ad07-4af6-956f-ce862a37b61a.Text: Ordered that the poor be supported in honour of the Magnae Accessio.

de3e5b02-cdd5-458f-9beb-b5a662428aa6.Text: "Let the poor be fed and fuel cells handed out to those in need. My reign shall begin with an act of benevolence."

8c53ecd5-f9d3-49f5-b85b-726c2c846213.Text: Ordered that prayer services be held in honour of the Magnae Accessio.

ddb6c7d9-0668-4545-8b13-3f2819eaa857.Text: "I wish to hear prayers and witness the people's faith."

e54ca798-47e7-453b-af24-ad7ce6995f02.Text: Ordered that fights be organised in honour of the Magnae Accessio.

d3bb5032-5583-441d-bb75-8c6241dd2788.Text: "Now what does the rabble like to see... Give out enough amasec for everyone and hold fights between tougher serfs."

32736b35-c1e7-4b21-b4c2-5e7435c3dffe.Text: "Let them decide themselves, both on this matter and the rest."

5dd12959-052a-4885-877e-8f35acf0fd33.Text: "Must I decide how to entertain my subjects now too?"

989650b2-b4dc-4713-b386-45655fc958cd.Text: "Sister Argenta will be at my side."

6c1126fe-caf7-4eef-badf-3660782c1095.Text: "Did the Rogue Traders from the other dynasties flock to Theodora's Magnae Accessio as well?"

b08885b0-28a2-4a44-a95b-8f7789774c7d.Text: "I wish to see Kibellah at my side."

ba0e6f5f-988f-4519-9a21-e1b1ee942276.Text: "Solomorne will take his place next to me."

736f0d99-5237-4798-a8a4-c1e1b664739f.Text: "In the eyes of your subjects, you already are a Rogue Trader. It is now time to become one in the eyes of the Emperor."

f09c0efc-e0a2-4848-a70f-aa46d9d6baad.Text: "Your servants wish to know your opinion on two matters related to the ceremony arrangements. The first of which is — what festive activities are to take place in the capital on this glorious day?"

17e75b60-c8bc-49ea-9a0b-f391317dd5d2.Text: "It is an ancient tradition of the von Valancius dynasty. When the heir accedes to Rogue Trader status, they take a sacred oath of fealty to the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} and announce themselves as His steward on the dynasty's vassal worlds. It is an act of faith that is meant to remind the Rogue Trader of their mission."

fcd80619-73ac-487d-a6a1-f2eec66c2553.Text: "Do not underestimate Governor Drivestem's desire to find favour with Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. At this very moment, thousands of your subjects are clearing rubble, washing away bloodstains, sweeping the streets, and transporting corpses to the lower sectors."

f5aa6cf0-8cc1-43bc-8154-7e3def31296e.Text: "In honour of such a resounding triumph, Dargonus, as the capital world of your dynasty's domain, is currently making preparations for the Magnae Accessio — a grand ceremony of your public induction as the heir of the honourable Theodora von Valancius."

fb78ca28-88ef-4a48-ac55-6778cebcb1fd.Text: "Governor Drivestem has vowed that not even the recent devastating and tragic events will be permitted to cast a shadow over this most glorious occasion."

2315c226-c3d4-44c5-9993-d66b013dc3d1.Text: {n}The grille of the {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g} built into Vigdis's face lets out a short rattle that indicates a chuckle.{/n} "That much is certain, but that's not all there is to it. There will also be a reception — as well as other noble guests, the distinguished Rogue Traders Calligos Winterscale and Incendia Chorda will be in attendance. It will be a great honour for Dargonus to host three illustrious dynasties at once."

b4518fc1-88d2-4c0f-8e31-8d6ff2cba70c.Text: "Very symbolic, Lord Captain. And beneficial to your domain."

2f923e3a-941d-45b3-82ee-7eacb51cc8e6.Text: "Your subjects will appreciate your generosity, Lord Captain. We are never short of people in need."

faafc4e0-f264-44e9-8b0d-c6f8cdf4e7d6.Text: "The ability to see keenly into the hearts of one's people is a great virtue for a ruler to possess, Lord Captain."

cb923a92-e0d7-42c1-81a2-2bf088246bc9.Text: "It will be done. The Emperor protects House von Valancius."

f3ac4f4e-de43-4056-898f-b12df1e60858.Text: "The second matter on your servants' minds is — which two of your closest companions will be given the honour of standing by your side during the ceremony?"

addfad73-459b-4433-91ff-3caea27f0fc9.Text: {n}She nods in understanding.{/n} "We will strive to please you, Lord Captain."

92cf0fbd-ff77-4b85-a68b-abd3af8320f7.Text: "It is not so much about the entertainment, Lord Captain, as it is about the tone you wish to set for your entire reign. These activities will let the people know who you are — as a person and as a ruler."

9462b5f2-6338-4d1d-9acf-45b8172ef2ac.Text: "Absolutely. This symbolic gesture will accentuate your connection to certain classes or parties to which your companions belong. All eyes will be on you, and people will remember whom you chose as your closest allies. That is why there can be no more than two — or it won't be a unique show of favour."

cb6e4414-044f-4b06-8de3-3c0c909b5d3e.Text: "The servants of House von Valancius will see in this the continuity of the dynasty's glorious traditions."

65933e2c-5cc9-4a40-86db-d3decaa7acd6.Text: "The presence of a member of the {g|Encyclopedia:Inquisition}Inquisition{/g} beside you will serve as the best possible proof of your loyalty."

7c4f9460-bdfe-4e40-a1af-d3d4cee5625f.Text: "Even though your privileges allow you to keep an unsanctioned {g|Encyclopedia:Psyker}psyker{/g} in your retinue, not every Rogue Trader would have one at their side on such a day. The freethinkers and the scorners of rules will be impressed by your courage."

fa21c174-438c-4eee-b50d-8ebf50548536.Text: "All whose hearts burn with the fire of faith will appreciate this gesture."

90ff045a-0c09-4d84-b004-071a36b35f99.Text: "The more enterprising of your subjects will take note that you value a person's abilities over their lineage."

742d9e39-b9ec-4223-8582-99aac89cd994.Text: "The {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMechanicus}Adeptus Mechanicus{/g} will take note of this gesture."

772480a5-198d-4329-9e2c-4ed922348d68.Text: "I will see to it that your instructions are delivered to Dargonus. The master of ceremonies at the palace will report to you when the capital is ready to praise your name."

0895c79c-101a-4758-a0b8-263d20465f2c.Text: "And who will be your second companion?"

27695e8f-45f0-42b3-ab95-483224732724.Text: "Does Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} wish to depart for the palace immediately? Or would you prefer to conclude any important matters so that your induction at the Magnae Accessio will be even more triumphant?"

2229cd1b-3dc5-4a77-bdc8-bc614dc63a52.Text: "The wardens have been tasked with clearing the ceremony venue of the injured and those who were burned out of their houses — they will be forcibly moved to the industrial levels. Rest assured, by the start of the festivities, the capital's wounds will be, if not healed, then well hidden under elaborate set dressing."

6295ea72-c204-471b-8588-60d837380f63.Text: "The presence of a death cultist will serve as a demonstration of your pious resolve and make your subjects tremble."

6f65a598-c158-4620-adb4-bc804a4898c7.Text: "The sight of a Proctor of the Adeptus Arbites will demonstrate your commitment to maintaining order and signal your reign's strict adherence to the Lex Imperialis."

c4da733f-7853-45b9-83ec-095496bb16a1.Text: "What's more, bringing {g|Encyclopedia:Footfall}Footfall{/g} to {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_FootfallAlly}heel{/d} has strengthened your position as a {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}. Lady Theodora would have been glad to have such an important trade hub come under her sphere of influence."

2c19353c-814c-471b-be26-edf090fec3e3.Text: "Your exploratory ventures have broadened the borders of known space. In the future, you will be able to spread your territory to these new star systems without having to worry about competition."

9f4cc66f-f9fb-4681-a8ec-74b8158ceb60.Text: "The Lexmechanics also note that your successes in establishing and developing colonies serve as a promising foundation for further expansion."

f78104d3-5755-46d4-b88e-078419c64721.Text: "To appear before the people in the company of a {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g}? A provocative and intriguing move. It is this kind of behaviour that people expect to see from a Rogue Trader — the wielder of privileges unthinkable for other mortals."

987b9bcc-bd78-4b19-8e45-5bdfb87e0322.Text: "I won't keep you any further. Thank you for your time, Lord Captain."

4cca6abf-b09b-4d53-8700-bdcbae27d49e.Text: "Lord Captain, permission to report!" {n}the Vox Master says, looking at you deferentially.{/n} "Your wise {g|Encyclopedia:Lexmechanic}Lexmechanics{/g} have analysed the state of the protectorate. They believe that, thanks to your decisive actions, the acute phase of the crisis has passed. The domain of the von Valancius dynasty is no longer facing dissolution and ruin."

502d45c2-5297-463e-9ab6-350f0dfcfe5c.Text: "Archival records indicate that they did. Lady Theodora's Magnae Accessio was attended by the esteemed Calligos Winterscale and Aspyce Chorda, Incendia's predecessor. It is an informal tradition — by witnessing the ceremony, the heads of the other dynasties confirm that they recognise the new Rogue Trader as their equal, that they are willing to respect the new Rogue Trader's privileges and not encroach upon their holdings... no more than usual, at least."

a9016f8a-70b7-4a35-8f49-35b9a057b663.Text: "Enjoy the evening. I must take my leave."

a79ad49a-67e7-45a7-a1ed-686bc1bb123d.Text: "Winterscale, I am starting to get the impression that you do not like me."

a4d71cb6-044f-4fba-bfaf-f47b41d01aed.Text: "Incendia, you seem to find me objectionable."

9a595f60-3fe9-439a-a51e-e78da0093d0a.Text: "Thank you for such a wonderful gift, Calligos."

2e2c3573-5497-4863-b3ef-bf2830e2e6ea.Text: [Nod coldly] "I welcome you to my domain... honoured guests."

ed824e1f-8fba-42b2-82a2-3a33abc5a519.Text: "Does your gift come with a good story?"

091811b1-8990-4d13-8f88-cd6071b1e6ab.Text: "You threatened to starve Footfall. I brought them salvation. So which one of us serves the Emperor and which their own unhealthy ambitions?"

86e13daf-51cd-43f2-afcd-0e90a049ba5d.Text: "He is a quick fighter, despite not looking like one. But I know this, which means that he wouldn't fool me... instead, he would be lying dead."

3c54da6d-e8d6-4d1f-b1c8-e6d597411497.Text: "You abandoned Footfall to its fate. And Lady Incendia saved its people from certain death."

806e0559-c974-4d29-b198-4dc0eeb99b81.Text: [Smile innocently] "Winterscale, are you asking me to give you Footfall back? Will you beg for it?"

1dad725d-f6c9-4fe3-8134-6001a1c98d53.Text: "A fair point. I am ready to return Footfall into your custodianship."

8f4fd5aa-0b40-42ce-829b-dc86a211b403.Text: "You abandoned Footfall to its fate. And I saved its people from starving to death."

4d7f98f6-2ed3-4350-992a-39e60e7ec2c9.Text: "I heard that Calligos Winterscale was a daring explorer, hunter, and trader. But all he does is blame circumstance for his failures — me, Incendia, the warp storm... Anything but himself!"

fb07e2eb-bd34-4ac5-8759-102c43952a11.Text: [Smile brazenly] "You want Footfall back? Then try and take it."

6949f0f6-209a-464f-9804-6274719b7685.Text: "Incendia, he's right. Footfall must be returned into his custodianship."

5a4b7edc-6802-4e40-b5e7-878b2c3c6259.Text: "I am glad that the matter of Footfall is settled."

e08b7b63-9ad3-4340-8b72-328fa0553386.Text: "Have you gone through cryo-stasis? What idiot maimed a Rogue Trader?"

92ffdb10-3780-4662-bc8d-bc51c0e829ef.Text: "I see that faith is more than just a word to you."

db7d4866-01fc-4d91-8f1a-3102e050a977.Text: "I thank you for this visit, Incendia."

42818976-6526-43db-9ece-f2058464d7be.Text: "I appreciate the gesture, but I must decline. Your 'gifts' feel too much like dividing the spoils of a robbery."

cc41c8dc-4c5f-46c8-a97c-5cb3ed2fca7d.Text: "My apologies. I failed to perceive the essence of your saintly mission in base extortion."

16018180-4c90-4c9d-b94e-ab1ccc21a420.Text: "I bested you, simple as that. This is trade."

f866e7af-818a-4968-99d9-08726e2ec098.Text: "Keep up this insolence, and you will be removed from this planet."

0d9c8966-79f3-43af-8548-267b604148e7.Text: "I hope the taste of fine wine will wash the bitterness of defeat from your tongue, Incendia."

bcf27dc0-0348-4db4-a8e5-922a18ca0ddd.Text: "What do you think of the celebration?"

81a46f99-b5ce-4de8-8b67-df802f8946ca.Text: [Give Worten a menacing look] "He would be dead in a second."

09847b4b-c0e5-4b38-8389-0446f56a0fc4.Text: [Whisper loudly to Winterscale] "Is she always so abrasive?"

9ed6d6e9-7b12-4904-8d53-81fef14a4d0f.Text: "Calligos, your attitude toward your own protectorate is appallingly irresponsible. Have you forgotten that the mission of every Rogue Trader in the Expanse is to claim new worlds for the Imperium and ensure the payment of the Imperial Tithe?"

bbf3cecf-1fbc-4aa5-9c38-fa668880e1e7.Text: "Who is this remarkable warrior in your retinue?"

e2472079-0f21-40a4-a204-a11398b7f210.Text: [Look Incendia in the eye] "Aspyce Chorda? I have certainly heard the name before! They say she was an unrivalled plunderer and raider. I wonder just how much of her ways her successor has inherited."

86d9edc8-9c3f-4548-98be-122f35592bf7.Text: [Smirk arrogantly at Calligos] "I wouldn't rush to call us equals. Are you sure the Winterscale dynasty can compete with the von Valancius protectorate?"

bc17113b-af51-4fe4-a989-66406296e552.Text: [Shrug] "Any guests who dislike my vapid entertainments and irreverent fun are free to leave Dargonus at any time."

54a54f5d-a9b0-4a64-acee-627fb81d33a8.Text: Commanded Reverend Hieronymus to destroy the xenos weapon received from Calligos Winterscale.

bcc00924-4872-4309-ae96-b6bce0852368.Text: "Reverend, destroy this creation of detestable xenos."

fc5f6352-a36a-4222-ad98-7e688b441e77.Text: [Smile at Incendia] "We Rogue Traders should stand against evil together, shoulder to shoulder. Even if someone is trying to shoulder us out of the way."

ac628ed1-baf9-4312-81de-687e332adba3.Text: "I take it you were not overly fond of Theodora?"

81afb9f4-58e3-44fe-b668-ab1b69276c8d.Text: "{name}, it is my pleasure to congratulate you on claiming your inheritance. Now you carry upon your shoulders the great duty entrusted to us by the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} Himself — to oversee this sector and remain vigilant as we strike down any and all corruption that dares to raise its head in your domain."

7768d08a-6fd4-4d2c-9a11-0268622ea29d.Text: "You've been acquainted but a moment and you're already getting to work on the new blood with your sermons. Then again, word is that you two are as thick as thieves already... Well, then, {name}, you are our equal now, is that it?" {n}Calligos Winterscale examines you as if you were a curio.{/n}

41ce07f7-d28e-4c00-b33c-dcb629e65023.Text: "{name}, there you are! Welcome to the circle where each member is as powerful, ambitious, greedy, and vain as the last... That is to say, the noble {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Traders{/g}!"

d475983d-d924-48f4-aa87-a7993b77f197.Text: {n}Incendia Chorda is watching him with barely suppressed contempt.{/n} "Yes, you have found yourself suitable company, Calligos. At the very least, now you can enjoy idle diversions, boast about your power, and indulge in profane pastimes with one who is your equal, rather than a member of the lower classes."

995f3bb9-ba51-4724-bf46-c0d8f4128f65.Text: "Remarkable. It would take my Arch-Militant longer to pick his teeth than it took you to conspire and unite against me. How do you do it?"

3dd03f38-5539-4a9a-bc5b-2af1403db99f.Text: "My, what hospitality. Come to think of it, why would I expect anything different from the heir of the glorious Theodora?"

ea0f5d0f-569e-4bb1-bdb1-1027f6b7ea8f.Text: {n}Winterscale chuckles.{/n} "This one has teeth. {mf|He|She} knows that there are no friends among {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Traders{/g}, only rivals. Don't worry, we won't try to bite a piece out of your protectorate today... so as not to ruin the celebration."

89f78a1a-1b5c-4d14-a1a4-366a02ece6cf.Text: "A worthy addition to the sacred fellowship of Rogue Traders. In this dark hour more than ever do we find ourselves in need of a decisive and pious ally." {n}Chorda bows solemnly.{/n}

f9bc42b2-7e8c-45ff-a64e-3bcf746b38bd.Text: "'Friends,' eh? Would you look at that! Incendia, now you have a whole friend!" {n}Winterscale gives you a carefree wink, but his posture exudes a challenge.{/n}

9a4bdc33-e412-4c8f-94e9-01f403ce7e3d.Text: "If you, Incendia, were to pay me a visit, I wouldn't waste time on warm greetings either. No, I would promptly arm myself with a flamer before your self-righteous parasites could infest my entire palace."

4466df57-07e5-411e-ac18-0b0475c8d1f6.Text: "Rein in your avarice, Calligos. All that you own belongs to the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g}, and you are nothing more than a steward. And all of the esteemed {name}'s possessions are likewise His property. Surely you would not dare to lay claim to that which belongs to Him?"

30de2b9a-0bb9-47bb-b83f-ec072b2c423d.Text: {n}Winterscale smirks brashly.{/n} "I did not come here with the expectation of becoming anyone's friend. A major misconception on your part, {name}."

e71c44d4-bdf1-4c17-8494-b31c0260cdc9.Text: {n}Chorda says haughtily,{/n} "I will think twice before calling an individual of questionable purity my friend."

39bdfb9f-55be-4084-83d4-f172bec840f6.Text: "Your virtuous task will be completed." {n}The priest bows as he accepts the foul item without flinching.{/n}

8c39fc39-bec1-4da1-adb1-b35ab12567d2.Text: {n}Winterscale's expression hardens.{/n} "So that's how you treat my gifts? Worten, as soon as we leave the palace — collect my property. If the holy man tries so much as to scratch the stock — kill him."

ff3ccb24-e05f-4eae-b89c-87e7bf9d8d4e.Text: {n}The mono-sharpened broadsword and the huge pistol both look formidable. This fighter has a preference for close combat where might is pitted against might.{/n}

17819d47-409f-4cb7-919e-74bba36da1a5.Text: {n}Calligos Winterscale is a broad-shouldered, athletic-looking man. He frequently flashes a bright smile no less dazzling than the blade of the power axe he carries. Every part of him, from the toes of his magnificent boots to the tips of his hair, radiates strength and the desire to live and win. His smile is crooked, as if ready to turn into a hostile snarl at any moment.{/n}

a1665525-96fa-4d39-9957-a32f5d61b30b.Text: {n}Incendia Chorda radiates cosmic cold. Her skin is unnaturally white, and a nervous tic is constantly tugging at the left side of her noble visage. Garbed in full dress uniform adorned with purity seals, she is the embodiment of a true {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperial{/g} aristocrat. Haunting her side is a gaunt shadow of a priest in plain black robes.{/n}

b4e1a86b-7c4a-4af9-8ac9-8646e44b446e.Text: {n}Hieronymus Doloroso, whom you met on {g|Encyclopedia:Footfall}Footfall{/g}, gives you a respectful nod.{/n}

8a78dc8a-ed01-49e0-95c9-d48590fe82d0.Text: {n}Calligos gives you a cheerful and somewhat feral smile.{/n} "As a sign of your gratitude, you could return something of mine that has found its way into your pockets. {g|Encyclopedia:Footfall}Footfall{/g} Station — sounds familiar? All I asked you to do was help that crafty slug Vladaym deal with the threat of famine, not {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_FootfallAlly}claim{/d} my property for yourself."

1951b171-cc2d-4f69-a6a1-3e19e7f4c57a.Text: "Am I supposed to? After you and Incendia {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_FootfallNotAlly}made off{/d} with my {g|Encyclopedia:Footfall}Footfall{/g}? It's bad enough that a warp storm has ravaged my protectorate and ruined my hunt, and now my dearest comrades are busy divvying up my territories behind my back?" {n}Calligos looks you in the eye with a challenge in his gaze.{/n}

ccc43ab7-61b5-4260-9943-ea16af986fe4.Text: {n}Winterscale bares his teeth ominously, a wild spark playing in his eyes.{/n} "You speak of salvation? You think that now Footfall is safe?"

18bd3128-7312-4ea9-b4da-455ab6322600.Text: {n}Calligos growls angrily.{/n} "You go too far, new blood!"

aa3b1f5b-5ca9-4fb2-922b-a75148bf60fd.Text: {n}Calligos laughs with satisfaction and a hint of... disappointment?{/n} "Well, that was easy. I take it you value the thrill of the hunt more than the trophies procured in it? I understand. I am just the same."

b51a7690-556a-4eb5-9864-9eca67cd8492.Text: {n}The brute next to Winterscale narrows his bloodshot eyes, his mouth stretching into a gap-toothed grin that is brimming with eagerness. But the grin fades as soon as Calligos, casually and imperiously, gestures for his servant to settle down.{/n}

2e3ee872-482d-48d7-947e-6017017ed714.Text: {n}Calligos's eyes flare with fury.{/n} "You wish to serve as an example and show everyone how to endure the whims of fate? Excellent."

eed4533f-935d-4fea-a5a6-2b82d8558076.Text: {n}Chorda smirks, staring into Winterscale's eyes.{/n} "Alas, it is no longer possible. I have already given the sacred oath to transfer all proceeds from my patronage of Footfall for the next one hundred years to the mission of the {g|Encyclopedia:Drusians}Order of Saint Drusus{/g}. Under the circumstances, to infringe upon that possession would be to infringe upon the interests of the missionaries. Do you wish to start a war with Him, Calligos?"

fba3626e-2cea-498c-b132-91202049fcf9.Text: {n}Calligos lets out a low growl of anticipation.{/n} "A challenge, is it? I love a challenge."

fb88fe00-e468-4a49-be5a-7156ff52ff20.Text: {n}Calligos chuckles mirthlessly.{/n} "That which falls into the hands of the pious will never leave their clutches."

37ac8f21-eb7a-4274-9c89-7a9a2732dd31.Text: "Of course you are. I doubt you would be glad if I came here with an army and reduced your capital to ruin." {n}Winterscale laughs heartily.{/n}

ec567134-dc9d-4173-90c5-2799d540e7a2.Text: "As is yours, {name}. I come bearing generous gifts for your protectorate. It is a sign of my gratitude to you for {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_FootfallNotAlly}not being tempted{/d} by the words of Footfall's masters and for not going against me. Rogue Traders must unite against heresy and waywardness. I hope you will become my trusted ally and not follow in Theodora's footsteps." {n}Incendia's tic strikes again, contorting her face.{/n}

ddc3e9f3-daf3-434f-8ec3-92e49f7644c4.Text: "I am setting that pirate den straight. Having sensed the approaching reckoning, a number of blasphemers revolted, and I had to remind them that all that we have are blessings granted to us by the grace of the Emperor. Air being one of them. The empty modules will be given over to the {g|Encyclopedia:Drusians}Saint Drusus mission{/g}, once they are repressurised."

731ce810-7af8-479c-b1f7-f1c8c7d20b92.Text: "Under the esteemed Incendia's rule, Footfall is headed for purgation and prosperity. But its burden of depravity persists still, and it is a heavy one."

f4be263b-5362-49a2-9849-1169c112534c.Text: {n}Calligos's tone is merry and teasing.{/n} "Why, I've heard that Footfall is now being patrolled by your punitive squads — oh, pardon me — 'confessional units,' was it? And any accusation of 'lacking piety' is enough to warrant an arrest. Prosperity takes such fascinating forms!"

0e1e384a-a8ca-48c9-839d-55247b06ec42.Text: "The esteemed Hieronymus is my confessor. I am greatly obliged to him for agreeing to accompany me on this journey."

fc061cf6-98a4-4eac-ba1e-ab4d99f27f3c.Text: {n}Hieronymus bows respectfully.{/n} "May the Emperor's light guide your way across the abyss of human wickedness."

3cf01390-7c7f-4195-8fb2-ea3cc4f7e8e0.Text: {n}Incendia's voice is as dark as the path of an apostate.{/n} "It is a mark left by the kiss of a freezing nightmare. The ungodly Aspyce, to whom I am cursed to be related, had me imprisoned in a cryo-vault, as she did all our family. She was afraid that her transgressions would eventually tip the scales of our patience and we would dethrone her."

25ccdaa3-6703-47a0-bc54-ef37365bf7dc.Text: {n}Calligos snorts.{/n} "Oh, this is Incendia's favourite subject. She just loves talking about Aspyce."

f87a25cf-cec0-4b1a-9be6-f29adcfc6175.Text: {n}Incendia's face twitches with the rhythm of artillery fire.{/n} "That reprobate is my forebear and my curse. Aspyce Chorda was a cruel, covetous, blaspheming monster. She fraternised with {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g}, she despised the faith, she robbed and slaughtered. She was drawn to dark secrets. One day, she boarded her ship and vanished into the depths of the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g}. She was declared missing, but I know — the bloody day will come when we see Aspyce Chorda's battle flagship once more."

17a5b31f-961c-4d14-b8aa-2479e6beb9d4.Text: "The example of the contemptible Aspyce is a warning to us all. Even among Rogue Traders, empowered by the Emperor Himself, a seed of perversion can blossom."

12387f22-4582-4517-97c1-424829dcc060.Text: {n}Incendia's smile, wracked by a tic, looks sinister.{/n} "Faith is everything to me. In His name, I have eradicated corruption on a hundred worlds and will do so on a thousand more. By His will, I hunt down pirates and desolate their vile nests. Let the Chorda name make any firebrand tremble, for sooner or later, I will cast them into the void."

fb8f1891-8da2-4401-99b0-3ac6851d4106.Text: "The Emperor's faithful must support each other." {n}Incendia smiles, but her smile turns out a little crooked as a nervous tic shoots through her pale cheek.{/n}

7f5bd51e-7ed5-4f45-815d-bc4fcb07c0e7.Text: {n}A nervous tic crosses Incendia's cheek.{/n} "Well, in that case, I will offer them to the Saint Drusus mission."

49d69d9b-114f-4dc9-a841-4a795ed9364b.Text: "I swear on His name, if you two start a liturgy right now, I am going back to my ship!" {n}Calligos erupts into booming laughter, but the frustration in his voice does not escape your notice.{/n}

87e3a806-03ce-4496-8613-1fe9a2133e01.Text: "The adepts of Saint Drusus toil for the common good. The esteemed {name} will simply reap the fruits of your generosity in another way, my daughter."

ace74f43-761c-4d1f-8514-eadeb6af9b89.Text: "Did you expect any different? I watched for years as outlaws thrived on {g|Encyclopedia:Footfall}Footfall{/g}, and then, at long last, I had a chance to put an end to it. To seize that thug Vladaym by the throat, to force Footfall to atone and put the fear of Him back into the masses. But you {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_FootfallAlly}interfered{/d} and destroyed my plan for the sake of banal profit."

336af40a-1786-4b8c-9afe-d0ab4697be36.Text: {n}The priest holds up his hands in a placating gesture.{/n} "None are without fault, noble Incendia. What point is there in targeting someone for their turpitude when true purity can never be found?"

b505c9d2-0943-4582-8d83-7f0d73e5b8ed.Text: {n}Incendia rolls her eyes.{/n} "Please. I will believe it no sooner than hearing word that half the population of that den of heresy has been sent into the void's embrace."

0b956769-f085-4152-a864-88b2e515af48.Text: "A forgivable lack of insight... for an {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusAdministratum}Administratum{/g} clerk. But not for a Rogue Trader."

684d0125-be7f-44f5-a2df-ecc704009b59.Text: "I have faith that the blessed {name} is perceptive enough to see the appalling nature of the residents of that depraved place."

e390b23b-3e7f-44c5-a047-092ff3491f60.Text: {n}She smiles mockingly.{/n} "That I would like to see. Must I remind you that you are not the only one who is protected by a {g|Encyclopedia:Warrant}Warrant{/g}? It would be a terrible shame if someone were to violate my sacred privileges and scorn His will."

9bfdb1f7-4c14-4b2b-a46e-2fa7635517fa.Text: {n}Calligos laughs unabashedly.{/n} "Conserve your poisoned arrows, Incendia. I can sense a hot temper in the new blood — {mf|he|she} just might declare war on you. And I just might support {mf|him|her}..." {n}He gives you a conspiratorial wink.{/n}

bc91d645-ff0a-404e-9df3-0e11a529f74e.Text: "So you are only interested in profit. For someone who is vested with such untold privilege, I expected you to have more refined ambitions and a more solid understanding of your mission given to you by the God-Emperor."

db8f677c-94a0-4ac1-aede-4a244b06947e.Text: {n}Chorda's face twists in a haughty grimace.{/n} "I am not inclined to intoxicants of any sort. And nothing will wash away the memory of how you interfered in my plans — I promise you that."

63aef0e2-b1be-425a-8f39-69dd81d92b20.Text: "Calligos, you should take this opportunity to learn — this is what the palace of a true Rogue Trader looks like. Not like a xenomenagerie, a pirate's treasure hold, or — however difficult it may be for you to believe it — an orbital brothel."

bf6c02d8-3780-42ac-81c0-73442e9e1721.Text: "I like it!" {n}Calligos looks around the hall curiously.{/n} "One can instantly tell that we've been invited by a Rogue Trader, not some {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusAdministratum}Administratum{/g} bootlicker. We are conquerors of wild sectors, slayers of unknown beasts, executioners of xenos empires."

19cc5783-3c7e-4f63-bab3-5bf44238fa13.Text: {n}Incendia lowers her eyes and says without animosity,{/n} "She was of the same breed as Asp—" {n}She stops short, then continues in a lowered voice,{/n} "Conceited, insolent, unaware of the Emperor's stern gaze set upon her. I do not doubt her wisdom and courage, but Theodora did not have a shred of humility or fear of His wrath."

ad4cadf9-f73c-4e4b-a26c-5acd27600230.Text: {n}A tense silence falls. While Calligos and Incendia exchange goading smiles, the eyes of Arch-Militant and priest bore into each other, their expressions filled with intangible meaning. The former's bestial aggression cannot even leave a scratch on the latter's impassive fearlessness. A premonition of imminent bloodshed hangs in the air.{/n}

c62a2dde-ad35-4827-a0e9-83078321d73e.Text: {n}Coupled with the pale skin and the tic, everything adds up to symptoms you recognise. It seems that Incendia was once subjected to cryo-stasis, and as she was coming out of it, some error occurred that damaged her nervous system.{/n}

b8e24812-6121-41ad-b267-632410345cdb.Text: {n}Calligos waves you off.{/n} "Protectorate? More like the bleeding scraps of one. The {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}warp{/g} storm tore it to shreds, but my servants will piece it back together. And if they don't — I'll chop off their heads and find myself more capable helpers."

ecc26785-a5bb-40e0-bc64-049c113de479.Text: "Oh yes! I claimed it in the Rifts of Hecaton, where we had a clash with {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g}. They were really trying to get to my throat, and, by the Heathen Stars, they almost succeeded." {n}Calligos is speaking with such joy, it is as though he is recounting the best day of his life.{/n}

7a1653f5-15f5-4467-8063-14b7072940b0.Text: "Well then, since you have turned out to be a pleasant surprise and stopped Incendia from snatching my possession, I should reward you. Take this grim weapon — it performed superbly in battles against xenos, and it helped me acquire the more substantial gift I have brought."

bb45131f-3fe5-4785-b18b-07228b01f3d6.Text: "Kill someone important with it. That would be the best show of gratitude."

634af244-43da-46a2-b446-9952aa5b0bbe.Text: "Well, I, for one, liked Theodora. The stories they told of her travels to nameless stars! And — yes, there was no fear in her." {n}Winterscale sighs pensively, and his lively expression grows a little greyer.{/n}

2425c238-7789-42e5-9821-59a46c7b7746.Text: {n}Undaunted, Winterscale chuckles.{/n} "Perhaps we will see for ourselves one day. It has been a long time since {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Traders{/g} last waged war in the Koronus Expanse."

d171c1bd-8334-4fb1-8eb1-613281d31622.Text: "The funny thing is, people still call me the foul-tempered tyrant in all this." {n}Calligos's amiable smile somehow resembles the bared teeth of a wild animal.{/n}

6480a722-5146-4940-b2c4-dcbfe9cdcd20.Text: "When Saint Drusus missionaries discovered her secret repository, all of my kin had already died excruciating deaths due to equipment failures, and I was dying. It was a miracle that they pulled me out of my slumber. For three years I had lain within the cryo-vault, paralysed, blind, alone with the darkness, the cold, and my hope for His mercy. Three years of imprisonment in a frozen nightmare. Only the prayers of the blessed priests had kept me from losing my mind."

72293dc8-7ca2-4128-8998-8d3af5235a00.Text: "You may rest assured that I will not linger in your domain a minute longer than etiquette dictates."

11f60196-20bb-4ba1-8f5a-bdce3a28e890.Text: "I see that you have picked up some of Theodora's habits. What blasphemous idea is this — to accept an ungodly xenos slave into your entourage? And to have her as your confidante during the ceremony, signalling that you intend to have dealings with inhumans?"

39d95542-cce9-435e-affa-17221dd42bbb.Text: {n}Calligos's face turns into a grimace of hatred... but then he catches Incendia looking at him and breaks into a sly smile.{/n} "I ought to make your protectorate bleed as compensation. But you have spited both myself and Incendia, and it is high time our dear sister curbed her appetites. For this, I forgive you. But do not test my mercy again — it is not my strong suit."

3f2a4036-e23d-4dcc-9a77-429dc868ac14.Text: "It's a trophy from a good hunt. You and I should hunt together sometime — so you can show yourself in action, new blood." {n}Calligos exuberantly punches you in the shoulder.{/n}

8288ddb4-141d-4440-9686-8001c37a8ab8.Text: "When I beheld light again, I swore an oath to Him — to pursue Aspyce and other miscreants like her till my last breath. To castigate heretics and offenders of faith — such is my path now."

3305001e-c25f-42c7-b082-026586f0bea0.Text: "Only one in ten made it out of Hecaton, and now it's only me and Worten here. We returned without any loot and virtually without a ship. All I got from that trip was a hold full of dead xenos and this deadly beauty, which their leader used to put two holes in my hide."

84978c34-c7a2-4813-aa03-94fc84bc48ae.Text: {n}Calligos gives you a cheerful and somewhat feral smile.{/n} "I should be thanking you. I was almost certain that you would use my difficulties on Footfall as a means to bring that devious weasel Vladaym to heel and take the station for your own. It's what any Rogue Trader would have done. But you have proved yourself to be less predictable than that!"

af11e3e9-f6af-4c81-b287-2f53ce947f37.Text: {n}Calligos watches Incendia with a smile, broad and filled with anticipation, as if expecting her to scratch your eyes out.{/n}

40583b7c-ab86-474f-a7a0-1d9dfd525d16.Text: "I saw Sister Argenta at your side during the ceremony and rejoiced. For this is a clear sign that the von Valancius dynasty honours the virtuous."

d751242d-51f3-4e08-9183-f3c31bfc61ac.Text: "Thwarting Incendia Chorda's ambitions deserves a worthy trophy." {n}He snaps his fingers, and the armoured brute hands you an exotically adorned rifle, clearly not of human making.{/n}

3f3ec01e-3936-4874-85b6-e6138bc68809.Text: {n}Winterscale's whisper is as audible as yours:{/n} "What can you mean? Today she is in remarkably good form."

e4108483-71e7-4a7c-a897-9ee541d5815d.Text: "While Footfall was in my charge, I graciously guarded its trade routes. But now their safety is no longer my concern. In accordance with my privileges, I hereby declare Furibundus and the neighbouring systems to be a free hunting zone. Any item of cargo procured in it by a subject of mine will be considered a fair trophy rather than the proceeds of piracy."

dfb83633-f58d-429a-918d-3c62a2dc311b.Text: "Threaten the esteemed Hieronymus one more time, Calligos, and the war that you love to prattle on about will commence. I swear it — one drop of holy blood spilt by you will send the remains of your realm up in flames better than any tanker of {g|Encyclopedia:Promethium}promethium{/g}." {n}Incendia and Calligos exchange looks of fury. The latter, snarling like a wolf, is clearly ready to start said war here and now.{/n}

6b719d29-fa48-4359-87fd-e787036fe469.Text: "I believe you understand me. After all, on this glorious day, you saw fit to cleanse your capital of thieves and criminals."

cba9b9a7-efb0-430d-b94f-1792f1e3d630.Text: "I believe you understand me. After all, your ascension was accompanied by the sounds of holy hymns all over the planet. With this song of righteousness on their lips, your subjects walk toward a dark future filled with blood and trials."

2827c04e-8776-4c6b-ba25-612c7bf4cf92.Text: {n}Next to him is an unmoving hulk of a man clad in armour. His low forehead and gloomy face bear signs of degradation, and his bloodshot eyes are expressionless, like a pair of glass buttons.{/n}

b69ee86b-6a1e-4021-9261-420c7d26c747.Text: {n}Hieronymus's dry voice hits your ears like the crack of a whip.{/n} "Quell your pride, both of you. I do not wish to fight you, Calligos, but I fear not your threats. Death does not frighten me, for it is inevitable. It is as true as the senselessness and pointlessness of a war between us."

c26d4a3b-298d-4563-ae7e-69bfb1edde12.Text: "Theodora taught you only too well, it seems — she too was far less concerned with her duty to the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Expanse{/g} than her own personal interests. But you can be sure that I will not cease cleansing the Furibundus System of the pirate scourge. And if your trade prospects are damaged in the process, you will have only yourself to blame."

36ebea43-6bef-465a-98ab-12ec641c7bea.Text: {n}Winterscale remarks, taking an obvious jab,{/n} "I've heard that you, {name}, are decent in a fight. What do you think — could you gut Worten if it came down to it? Or would he be the one gutting you?"

60e10537-a9cf-4e42-94ab-992878a731bc.Text: {n}Winterscale smirks acidly.{/n} "Did my Arch-Militant scare you? Reverend, pray to the Emperor that {name} never meets Worten in battle."

e9d734cd-b08f-4ca8-ac78-67758f95cbcd.Text: "An impressive victory. But do you truly believe a creation of the ungodly xenos to be a good gift, Calligos?"

1d96a897-ee17-4f4a-85c5-4cd70d230796.Text: {n}The grey spots on Worten's face are what catch your attention. Marks like these can be seen on fighters who are too fond of combat stimulants. A small price to pay for the increased speed and reaction that could save your life in a fight. Although those spots are usually tiny pockmarks, not whole islands of grey on the skin.{/n}

7334759b-72bc-4d06-bf97-cd97fa6fba43.Text: {n}He is strong, but hardly quick. Dodging his blows would be easy, as would striking him square in his massive chest.{/n}

eae2b223-2eae-4d92-b78d-63b1c884beed.Text: {n}Ignoring the fearsome-looking broadsword and pistol, which hang from his belt rather ostentatiously, you notice a great number of thin blades with curved edges skilfully concealed within Worten's armour. These toys are deadly in the hands of a quick fighter — it appears that Winterscale's Arch-Militant likes to surprise his opponent with unexpected speed.{/n}

cbe190ab-4aae-45b5-9e82-ccd1ec96a16e.Text: {n}A new glint appears in the bloodshot eyes. A glint of appraisal, intelligent and cunning. No, Worten is not the thick, bloodthirsty beast he wants to be seen as. Behind this mask is a careful and keen mind.{/n}

755b262e-892d-4130-8b5f-080a1da4b3af.Text: "Many have said that." {n}Worten boldly bares his crooked teeth, which somehow all fit in his mouth. His dull face shows nothing but the desire to fight someone, anyone.{/n}

d5077eb0-ca6e-4116-ba73-637544a69cf5.Text: "I can assure you that this is false. She will unleash upon you a thousand sermons, reprimanding you for your wicked conduct, and only then will she deign to take her leave."

04da971e-7fc8-48aa-acc5-f9ad835813bd.Text: "It will not be a long one, I assure you."

81d4c36a-8e39-400c-b44e-942f59b4cdd3.Text: {n}You notice a peculiar wrongness about Incendia's movements. A barely perceptible fugue that makes her body try to repeat the movements it has just performed. Her chin jerks spasmodically when she turns her head, and the gestures of her fingers are slightly more chaotic and loose than they should be.{/n}

26f0076d-731d-4097-97b3-56da4729eb2e.Text: {n}Something strikes you as strange. Calligos Winterscale wasn't always this... nonchalant about his protectorate. He used to be known as shrewd and business-minded, even concerned for his subjects. But it seems he has grown bored of ruling.{/n}

c0d7e508-9eb8-4cd9-9444-5324b1f1bb70.Text: {n}Calligos Winterscale is acting like a true Rogue Trader. Capricious, unaware of the value of money, and never a cloud on his countenance.{/n}

e2d3a5fe-e30c-4836-8e1c-f43347d95951.Text: "You would call into question the privileges bestowed upon me by the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g}? You can try. Let the {g|Encyclopedia:Drusians}Saint Drusus mission{/g} put forth their champion, and I will slay him in a trial by combat."

678ca344-89b7-4ad3-9ca1-132990c1020e.Text: {n}"Asp—" That must be Aspyce. Aspyce Chorda. You remember the name. From what you recall, she was a Rogue Trader too, and a renowned one at that.{/n}

1dcc1535-09e5-4212-a41e-f0b9a3af7be0.Text: {n}You didn't quite catch what word Incendia was about to say.{/n}

95526749-df01-4b8e-93c5-26d4e5677433.Text: {n}You know whose name Incendia almost uttered — you have heard it in your {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Criminal}former life{/d} more than once. Aspyce Chorda, a Rogue Trader of the Koronus Expanse. An infamously merciless and avaricious pillager who was scarcely different from a common pirate and heretic. One would never think so by looking at Incendia Bastaal-Chorda, but it appears that she and Aspyce are related.{/n}

22e964de-20ca-4f4f-95a2-5c9105dd47bf.Text: {n}Incendia's gaze turns to you.{/n} "My servants have brought... certain facts of the new Rogue Trader's {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Shame}biography{/d} to my attention. It may be wise of you to do the same, Calligos, unless you wish to face disappointment in the future." {n}There is a hint of superiority in her eyes. Your ears are burning, and your mouth is dry. She knows of the shame of your past. It would seem that the meticulous archivists of House Chorda have performed regrettably well.{/n}

bf0a68ca-a868-44f1-9953-bb90ee2c110e.Text: "What is more, ever since you gave them {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_JanusChaosFood}provisions{/d}, heresy on Footfall has only increased! Fanatics calling themselves 'harvesters' are spreading their blasphemous doctrines in the Shadow Quarters. Grain is not enough for those madmen — no, they devour their brothers and sisters at secret heretical feasts! The well-fed rabble have surely sensed they are free to act with impunity and have forgotten their duty to the Emperor."

38885c53-51db-490c-8d2b-25cd9ad336d2.Text: {n}You notice Incendia seemingly freeze and choke up at the mention of Aspyce. But the priest's condemning words cause her icy rigidness to evaporate, and her dark eyes fill with righteous fury.{/n}

9676f8ce-0938-4eed-9f39-c6c8707a6c6f.Text: "Simply colluding with that two-faced snake Vladaym would have been bad enough. But that your conniving has destroyed any pathetic excuse for order that was on that station is pure insolence! I don't know what you did, but now, on top of every other mangy dog that lives on Footfall, there is this new cult of 'harvesters.' What good is your {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_JanusChaosFood}grain{/d} if the station is now crawling with flesh-eating lunatics?"

b6c10302-d6f1-4f8a-beb3-de295a08c571.Text: "A true Rogue Trader always keeps a living weapon close at hand. But you don't need me to tell you that — you have a Death Cult assassin in your employ! Not bad, new blood, but I would wager my Worten has a meaner bite than that zealot of yours."

09cad441-c22b-472d-8f59-57d8ad74633c.Text: "And since you asked... A psyker in the service of the governor of my world has recently swapped a luxurious bedchamber in the palace for the cramped confines of a ship's cabin. His escape was so skilfully orchestrated that I couldn't help but look into it further. And what I discovered broke my heart, new blood." {n}Behind Winterscale's sly, narrowed gaze, you see icy rage. But a moment later, the cordial grin is back on his lips.{/n} "However, would I quarrel over such a trifle as a runaway servant? Consider Herimon a gift to you."

68434806-2cd2-4440-980f-712a126d7e6e.Text: "Oh, believe me, I intend to enjoy myself to the full. To justify so long a voyage, if nothing else."

7cd6d6fe-c627-4d55-be80-0d018e54406e.Text: {n}Calligos bursts into laughter.{/n} "Of course, a {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Arbitrator}{mf|lawman|lawwoman}{/d}'s sole topic of conversation is the tithe! I'll have you know, new blood, that my worlds still bring in more tithes than you have seen in your whole life. So I can do as I well please — and so I will."

ba5485c3-cec2-4b1b-9c42-a5ad5633fc13.Text: "Hieronymus Doloroso, head of the {g|Encyclopedia:Drusians}Saint Drusus mission{/g} and my confessor. An advocate of faith."

af775c32-5297-4cb0-b29e-5416bb729c35.Text: "This is Worten the Grey, my Arch-Militant. A fierce warrior, and as loyal to me as an obedient beast to its master. I bought him in a miserable colony back when he was a runt on his last legs, and now he is practically a part of my dynasty."

2594acc7-9f5d-445b-873b-d26d059af332.Text: {n}Worten the Grey, whose skin really is dotted with grey spots, looks at Calligos with purest devotion. Indeed, he is akin to an animal — one that is bloodthirsty and mindless.{/n}

a59518e0-d845-4c18-9bdc-77009bdf48cb.Text: Dust has accumulated on the raised oil smears — if servants ever access this room, they do so very rarely.

a53d4bfb-b580-4365-b5fb-46197cc178da.Text: Strange objects lie behind the glass of the display case. The complete absence of explanatory labels makes it impossible to learn what they are.

8e7e92cc-6886-495a-8ce1-78acdf97f60d.Text: An empty glass and three unopened bottles of wine sit on a finely crafted table made from dark, marbled wood.

c8b60561-5906-4ba7-8506-b42c6e77aa45.Text: The rare books arrayed on these shelves, with their lavish, almost pretentious bindings, seem to be identical.

57a26f34-1404-436c-b973-72b2d4f17fe5.Text: By bringing your hand to the scan panel behind the books, you open a hidden door.

b84e388d-ec40-4978-ad29-d285d7a53ffe.Text: "In the name of the Rogue Trader House of von Valancius, whoever has entered {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship}'s chambers will be eliminated!"

508e25ee-cc28-47f4-b687-e29be1c5f281.Text: "Do you require any assistance? But... on second thought, we had better just leave you in peace..."

13fa4170-d16e-46d7-874b-7e3af6600893.Text: "Who has dared to break in here?"

4ee79c69-8fd9-46a3-874a-7ec28e4d001b.Text: "It's y-you! B-but... a-apologies, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! We're leaving!"

323e8b9c-2931-404f-b84e-9af2befa952f.Text: The mysterious xeno-artefact rests in a stasis field.

131e18e9-5365-4b9b-9551-7e1587618069.Text: An engraved data drive found in a cache on Dargonus. The information it contains has been carefully encrypted.

1d2ee2d1-f678-4fa5-8d87-a278719ba000.Text: "I'm not so foolish as to fail to notice a conversation in code."

6038f57d-345f-4ea2-828d-bd5b56b3eb3a.Text: "I would like to know that myself. Van Calox left my retinue on Kiava Gamma, but not before stealing one of the ship's shuttles."

f7e40aed-3143-4484-ba6d-6e5c9ded4935.Text: "Van Calox attacked a Rogue Trader and was executed for his crime."

f9433438-d5a0-444d-be58-83e94a453af0.Text: "Heinrix died doing his duty to the Golden Throne."

28ef98cc-6edb-48f9-88f4-e0dd89d47f6b.Text: "The Interrogator is well and currently aboard my ship."

a21dab08-d3c5-47ac-8ffb-bddbab7ba3e3.Text: "I know nothing of the Interrogator's fate."

e0d21fc6-222d-4e6f-bdac-0d5d182a7586.Text: "Is there a reason for this ill-mannered behaviour, Heinrix? Perhaps you two could find another time to discuss personal matters?"

0382ef31-6431-4535-9e9f-0bed0e990484.Text: "What are your responsibilities here on Dargonus?"

702cdd49-c0cc-4c78-aa17-46eb1086c561.Text: "Do you know anything about the Cult of the Final Dawn?"

658a0cc8-da09-428a-b265-b22015c4e855.Text: "You promised me a report on the present state of affairs in the protectorate."

16227687-2903-453b-ba60-e9bf8dc2f14d.Text: "What can you tell me about House Sauerback?"

df515520-98a6-4a3a-96d4-312a26104c2f.Text: "I would like to know more about the Werserians."

8722dbff-c175-4a78-917e-b2e066930641.Text: "After hearing all that, I now feel the urge to have every one of those sycophants executed at once."

c7136b36-cbec-4634-8289-e302736cb01f.Text: "Enough about the nobles. Was there anything else you wanted to report?"

7acb1083-8e1a-4b65-8b35-e6c1f7181088.Text: "I've been to Kiava Gamma already. The planet was tainted by the Cult of the Final Dawn."

bafe6117-10d9-46d4-a165-9a92b584b8dd.Text: "Whom do you truly serve — the Rogue Trader or the Interrogator of the Inquisition?"

769ad98b-3dc3-4c31-bbf2-361cf3c3f7b7.Text: "Dargonus has no need for spies from the Inquisition. Begone!"

25a55c75-191e-48f3-bf56-ed8b07e7e1bf.Text: "I want a list of all your agents and the means to contact them."

bf813c9a-59a0-4684-a983-611dbe1de650.Text: "Tell me about the noble houses of Dargonus."

ae61a3dc-7f30-4867-8839-6db050b20a51.Text: "I have learned all I wanted to."

f67e0e0e-aebc-4475-852c-a795b4035c8e.Text: "The scars on your face... What happened?"

a1e42eae-8332-4519-99fe-436bae08afb7.Text: "Do you know anything about what has become of Kunrad Voigtvir? The former Master of Whispers is a heretic and a traitor to the dynasty."

0e7c4a4b-87b7-4230-8650-5e80cd820383.Text: "{name} von Valancius, I greatly appreciate that you've found the time to see me before meeting with the governor. But before we get wrapped up in important matters, allow me to enquire — where is Master van Calox? I thought he accompanied you on the journey."

83d43ef9-a2d6-4bcf-9e7d-c12ef8992253.Text: {n}Heinrix frowns.{/n} "For as long as the stars shine in the sky, my vigil continues."

b8568eb5-bc1b-4bf7-a9e1-5645cbd9603c.Text: "Achilleas, it's been many moons. I hope your cousin is feeling well."

a268d816-107e-4f12-a356-3ff5a5f489eb.Text: "That is... a terrible loss. For the Inquisition and for the Imperium." {n}Achilleas clasps his hands, his burnt lips mouthing words of prayer.{/n}

27db81d2-f79f-4b73-8928-2b8659390e03.Text: "I'm glad to hear it. But still, I was hoping that Master van Calox would introduce us personally."

672d66c6-5d73-4ce0-a4b8-b5d2db8ec15e.Text: {n}Heinrix looks at Achilleas.{/n} "Allow me to introduce Achilleas Scalander properly. In addition to his duties as secretary of the Administratum, he acts as an agent of the Golden Throne under my aegis. Master Scalander was transferred into my remit by a colleague who is engaged in other matters in the Koronus Expanse. I'm sure you will find Achilleas's service useful — especially when dealing with the schemes of Humanity's foes within the borders of your protectorate."

588a43f9-540f-4704-b60a-f3f6902ef5c6.Text: "Officially, I'm a secretary at this world's Administratum department. Less officially... I'm afraid I can't disclose that even to you. In short, I collect and investigate reports of heresy taking root on upstanding planets of Humanity. Above all else, I am concerned about the xenos threat that hangs over the entire Koronus Expanse, including your protectorate. Sadly, my mission was complicated by the recent warp disturbances — I am still trying to re-establish contact with many of my agents."

dc330b56-eaf1-4e89-8083-88a42ba5c670.Text: "The residents of the local systems are no strangers to skirmishes with enemies of Humanity. But recently the loathsome beasts seem to have completely flown off the handle. We're receiving reports from ships that made it through the warp to Dargonus — both they and the colonies that they departed from are being attacked. We have identified the breed of xenos that pose this threat — the {g|Encyclopedia:Drukhari}Drukhari{/g}, Humanity's ancient and insidious foes. Be vigilant on your travels — the xenos will undoubtedly attack a Rogue Trader's ship should they find the circumstances to be in their favour."

ac3c6946-1c5e-4d00-86dd-7b53193c6610.Text: "My knowledge is deplorably limited, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} — all my attention has been focused on tracking xenos activity. I'm certain that Master van Calox can tell you much more about those heretics than I."

4fb1944a-d247-4164-ba0b-30876ea9ad23.Text: {n}Achilleas catches himself.{/n} "That is to say, he could tell you if he were alive."

3580e48a-86ca-4872-a018-5cd924f0fb60.Text: "The nobles of Dargonus are well-respected, rich, and powerful individuals who held Lady Theodora's favour for many years and found ways to rise above the rest by diligently serving the Rogue Trader. Every family pursues its own selfish interests, and each one expects that with the transition of power, they will retain and even add to their lands and wealth. The families I would recommend giving particular attention to are the Drivestems, the Gapraks, and the Sauerbacks. I should also mention the Werserians — not a noble house per se, but a family that was part of Lady Theodora's inner circle, to the blue bloods' great displeasure."
