c91372ad-291b-4dc1-a16d-50987e443305.Text: "I have already forwarded all official reports to your Seneschal. As for the conversation we're having right now, I wouldn't trust any paper or data-slate with its contents. You see, Lady Theodora, may the Emperor have mercy on her soul, was perfectly aware of Dargonus's political environment. You, however, have only just arrived on the capital world, and I thought it would be best to bring you up to speed. Frankly, the nobles of Dargonus, much like nobles on most worlds, are akin to spiders in a jar, ready to pounce on whoever is the weakest... or whomever they deem to be the weakest."

0ac2bb7a-4b75-4871-8c44-075e8a713ed3.Text: "The Drivestems are the ancient governor house of Dargonus. Predictably, the greater the wealth of the von Valancius protectorate, the fuller their coffers grow. Their reputation is flawless except for one detail — we have evidence that Urbend Drivestem's rivals seem to have the misfortune of regularly falling victim to xenos raids. I find that these attacks are always a little too advantageous for the Drivestems, but we lack solid proof — and it might never surface."

563985f1-0396-4f4a-9612-6bf7699522d5.Text: "The Gapraks hail from a remote forge world, and among their distant relatives, there are many servants of the Omnissiah, and the house itself is close to the cult of the Adeptus Mechanicus, both in spirit and in their business connections. The Gapraks oversaw the industrial shipments within your protectorate — until recently. Ever since the Astropathic communication with Kiava Gamma was severed, they've been quite concerned about the security of the planet placed in their care."

0375109f-2397-4696-96dc-ca435398cbed.Text: "Religious and hardworking... The Sauerbacks own many enterprises, including distillation manufactorums that produce promethium. I must note that lately members of the Sauerback family have been prone to overly liberal statements about the von Valancius dynasty — they believe that Lady Theodora was a bit too keen to leave her worlds without proper oversight."

b073ae91-4b8b-4e8f-adfa-e599ef01b114.Text: "The Werserians are a line founded by Lady Theodora's Seneschal and as such are nominally considered nobility — at least from the standpoint of the Imperial Navy, from which Lord Abelard hails. On Dargonus, however, their position is precarious — firstly, they never were granted an official title, a process which has been impeded for decades by the old houses of Dargonus, and secondly, the other families do not see them as equals, but more as upstarts clinging to the Rogue Trader's favour. The Werserians are responsible for the capital world's fleet and the majority of the cargo shipments on domestic routes."

15af811c-e6ed-44f8-a7bc-6c9c0ba92fed.Text: {n}Achilleas shrugs.{/n} "You are, naturally, well within your right, Rogue Trader. But remember that this will cause the multilayered bureaucratic system of Dargonus — of your entire protectorate, in fact — to come apart at the seams. And that's not even considering the likelihood of attempted reprisals from their families and allies."

c6e5b234-ba8d-4bb1-ad47-9df2504da99c.Text: "There was, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. And this time, it concerns the main reason for my presence on this planet — xenos and the threat they pose both to you and to Humanity as a whole."

f3aed3ee-81e2-4f9e-b247-17194508d3ee.Text: {n}Achilleas shakes his head.{/n} "These are grim tidings... It's a tragedy that an {g|Encyclopedia:IndustrialWorld}industrial world{/g} of such tremendous capacity was brought down by the pernicious influence of the Archenemy. Perhaps my... colleagues can pick up the cultists' trail in the cold void. Of course, it would be a small consolation to all of us."

a956ffc3-3fc4-4b52-bd1d-cd3803e754b8.Text: "And whom does the Rogue Trader serve? The Golden Throne? The protectorate? Could it be that one stems from the other? And if so, is there any sense in discussing it?"

d6a7fd7f-3034-4d6c-b1ce-adf89d754bcc.Text: "I would never defy a Rogue Trader on {mf|his|her} capital world. However, I am here on direct orders from the Lord Inquisitor, whose authority, pardon my brazenness, supersedes yours. I cannot leave my post — at least not until he recalls me personally. Please, stay your anger, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. For I am doing everything I can to rid the von Valancius worlds of the threat of burgeoning heresy."

9dd1b47b-7249-41c6-8689-6f621df2a5a3.Text: "I sincerely hope that I can answer every one of them."

bb6acb1c-eba7-4acd-a9fe-3fc4bd91d442.Text: "Thank you for your time, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}." {n}With a formal bow, Achilleas takes his leave.{/n}

009cc786-dbff-4dd7-ba07-58b2f811bfc3.Text: "The closer an official is to a Rogue Trader, the braver and safer they feel. I would just like to remind everyone that rubbing shoulders with xenos is a heresy that can be overlooked only in the case of the von Valancius heir, not {mf|his|her} servant."

71b15333-879a-4b8e-87da-d8109f0d57ea.Text: "I can understand your desire as a Rogue Trader to have everything under your control. And yet I am not at liberty to make use of classified information related to the Interrogator's agents in whatever way I see fit." {n}Achilleas lowers his gaze and nods politely.{/n}

f0b84dd6-73e7-461f-8a3c-af843af9666c.Text: "The last few months have been difficult for the people who report to me — my eyes and ears scattered throughout the Koronus Expanse. Warp disturbances, Astropaths overcome with madness, ships disappearing in the Immaterium... many of my observers and contacts have gone dark or have been killed by some calamity or other. Still, I managed to establish communication with some key... individuals who were able to warn me about incoming threats, including xenos raids."

830c9e10-527d-409c-95d8-8851e02d84c1.Text: {n}The slender figure, clad in robes made from expensive fabric, shudders from violent coughing. Pressing a gilded respirator to his face, the man takes several deep breaths.{/n}

5e78bdff-868a-4720-b83c-54d03a322123.Text: {n}Achilleas nods to you pensively.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, how may I be of service?"

59440d00-5700-4523-87cd-4df19fb7e322.Text: {n}Achilleas's genial expression is instantly drained of all emotion. He looks at you for a few moments, then nods, as if to himself.{/n} "I thank you for your candour. I hope that the Lord Inquisitor investigates the matter thoroughly."

d4868d98-dedc-43fc-9ce8-5202684ecaf9.Text: "I will gladly refresh your memory, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

4ffe6632-f120-4aba-a85a-d27fccaa78f5.Text: "I would hold off on the death sentences. Act with restraint and wisdom, present for all to see sufficient proof of the unwanted house's guilt. Do not mistake me — mass executions are one way to solve your problems — but in that case, you should weigh up every possible scenario before you act."

a18fee3d-0ab3-40b9-a09d-07caaf65cfff.Text: {n}Achilleas looks you in the eye without blinking.{/n} "It is within my power to supply you with intelligence on where and when the xenos will strike next. I do not doubt that Governor Drivestem will beg you for protection against the xenos, and in this fight, the information from my contacts will serve you well. I beseech you, {name} — if I ever report a threat looming over a ship or a planet, do not dismiss it. Sometimes it takes an intervention from the Rogue Trader and {mf|his|her} mighty voidship to avert a disaster."

b4e27fac-20e1-40eb-bb10-58ccbe6a7cb0.Text: {n}Achilleas bows and brings the respirator to his burnt lips.{/n}

415af535-0eee-4fca-9c61-a95c81d88b82.Text: {n}Achilleas nods grimly.{/n} "Word of his treason reached Dargonus too late. Kunrad came to the planet and left it almost immediately, once he had sown discord in the minds of the gullible and naive. The worst of the rumours he started was that you were the one responsible for Lady Theodora's sudden demise. Of course, your loyal subjects did their best to skin alive any who showed signs of doubt. But it seems unlikely that the wardens got to everyone who has allowed doubt into their heart and now nurtures it in secret."

c68f3de0-51f0-4b25-865e-3bc97456c0da.Text: "About..." {n}He coughs.{/n} "...five years ago, there was an accident. Several tanks of promethium exploded in the storehouse at my estate, and I was buried alive under the rubble. The Emperor preserved my soul, and the skilled physicians of Dargonus saved my body — except for my lungs, with which I had to part. I presume the incident was an attempt on my life, but the identity of whoever was behind it remains a mystery."

d7b6c063-bb3e-454a-9d61-3562976dfb8a.Text: "Unfortunately, in the host of Humanity there are those who are willing to grovel before our enemies in the hopes of a valuable reward. You may be interested to know that we are on the trail of such heretics..." {n}Achilleas glances at a data-slate.{/n} "Overwhelming evidence indicates that a plundered void station in Langrenn's Belt is being used as a base by a band of pirates who are not above dealing with xenos. I was unable to persuade the chancellor of the need to dispatch a ship there, but... perhaps you would like to pay a courtesy call to these scoundrels yourself?"

5e95235f-06e6-4ed1-b193-eacab3a8d026.Text: "Achilleas is the critical link in a long chain of people who toil day and night, putting their lives and souls at risk, to protect Humanity from its many enemies — your enemies. To send Scalander away is to blind both your eyes and be left ignorant about those who are seeking to stab you in the back."

427011ee-439e-471a-88b5-398c7f130395.Text: {n}Heinrix lets out a sigh of disappointment.{/n} "There's no point in pressing my agents — none of them would ever reveal such vital information. Especially not in my presence."

d930a33a-26b4-4ee0-b977-6945a9dad1cb.Text: {n}Achilleas covers his burnt lips, trying and failing to suppress a coughing fit.{/n} "She... she is in good health... She sends her regards to you, as well as her wishes for your swift return."

498cd11f-603b-47ab-a334-90323aaabc49.Text: "My apologies, {name}. Given the break in the communications between systems in the Expanse, it has become difficult to maintain contact with agents. Receiving this report and assessing the situation is my primary responsibility."

e10aec21-2e0c-46fe-9d9b-a3b4f242fca5.Text: "So it does." {n}Achilleas thumps himself on the chest with his augmented hand. You hear the clanging of metal against metal.{/n}

3208210e-8e4d-4734-9954-4d95b369a0a7.Text: "Your insight deserves credit, Rogue Trader — then again, I expected nothing less from Theodora von Valancius's successor."

7e785b32-c8cb-46ed-b76c-b657ff6a4bb2.Text: "My apologies, {name}. Now, to the reason why I asked to be present during the landing on Dargonus."

79bed9b7-945d-4844-825a-572104ee93a7.Text: {n}Achilleas blinks in surprise.{/n} "I'm sure that such actions must have had valid reasons. I hope your property is returned to you eventually."

51ae8c76-7421-4f73-9d3d-3762d8bdc77a.Text: {n}Achilleas bows.{/n} "According to the message I received a few minutes ago, Governor Drivestem has arrived at court. I imagine that the chancellor is already prepared to arrange the meeting — all that's left is to notify her that you are ready to see Urbend."

0f9862e1-66da-47d3-8d0c-b37099c34622.Text: "Greetings, {mf|Lord|Lady} {name} von Valancius. Allow me once again to express my deepest condolences on the loss of Lady Theodora. I will do everything I can to track down and destroy all of Kunrad Voigtvir's accomplices on the capital world."

ac8c0ccb-b079-4c8c-930c-bb30212d3878.Text: "Master Scalander is unwell, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. The Administratum has sent me to be his temporary replacement."

be3c6000-b05d-4165-b558-da0140f1a719.Text: "May the Omnissiah bless the von Valancius dynasty!"

9a6e4e24-fb6a-496e-a0bc-cfa111793f12.Text: "Long live the Rogue Trader, ruler of Dargonus!"

f99a84aa-5d69-4228-9e4d-206e7d1a09f1.Text: "Everlasting Emperor preserve the von Valancius dynasty!"

8037a84c-515c-4b3f-a551-4fd74a307505.Text: "The Hand of the Immortal One has returned to {mf|his|her} cradle!"

63ac7346-e538-4d12-a414-3de873d7d2b5.Text: "Hail to the sovereign! Hurrah to the von Valancius line!"

fc969011-e415-4d3c-a4fe-0932a9e4a17f.Text: "God-Emperor keep you from heresy and corruption!"

c65a64fc-252f-4cc2-a46c-fc8d2fe86752.Text: "And descend did {mf|he|she} upon that world from the skies, and ushered in a golden age!"

131cf31a-a18d-41d9-9c7f-f9097674c28f.Text: "But... who is that? Where is Theodora von Valancius?"

f1e38488-89a4-48c0-bb51-0a073f4fc6ff.Text: "Protector of Dargonus! Emperor bless you and your domain!"

2583ebb7-4fa8-46b2-8050-ddb922db4543.Text: A servitor in the tattered robes of the Navis Nobilite stares vacantly through you. "Just punishment... shall befall the villains... who have disturbed the peace of the Rogue Trader..."

ca4509cc-f689-4c54-8f30-81ed64f23e38.Text: "Long live {name} von Valancius, bearer of the Warrant of Trade and sovereign of Dargonus! Shame and dishonour await those who dare to stand against the Emperor's anointed!"

a8640ef8-f2e0-42ea-a91f-fb4dd2dd5584.Text: "Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship, do not worry — your trophies and treasures are completely safe!"

03fc59fd-50f5-4b6a-9eb8-1c1efd59ca60.Text: According to the inscription on the statue, this is a gift from House Gaprak to the von Valancius dynasty.

dddae7d0-166b-4e4d-81df-071e8efe5866.Text: "I never thought she would have the nerve!"

e934d9a9-498a-49cb-8ac2-d2a6df334bdf.Text: "Imagine that! And when Madam Ulana admonished that upstart, she merely laughed in her face!"

597a6842-1ef7-45e9-a8ef-5d4bb70ebc88.Text: "If every whore who's ever cosied up to a lustful clerk starts carrying on like that at society engagements, I may very well start shunning such occasions!"

dfa0d824-e9f0-48ee-9174-7d02003458f7.Text: "Perhaps the new von Valancius will pay more heed to the purity of our society than the previous one?"

1f531bf4-d494-4a8d-ad87-04379e3b1c12.Text: "Or do the opposite, and introduce {mf|his|her} own customs. Who knows which would be worse!"

c31d6439-ca0b-4e9e-a4e4-13f88b3fef39.Text: "Ah... lower your voices, ladies. Someone might overhear."

33cc590b-2a57-48dd-9fa4-439b4e9f8961.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! It is such an honour to appear at your court! Please allow us to leave your presence with our deepest apologies, we never meant to disturb you!"

10adbded-ca57-4472-ac34-c385f057d6e6.Text: "How do you find the young Gaprak? The principal heir of a noble house... I heard that the daughters of the Arch-Inscribirator are inappropriately obliging to the young man."

bc0d0fa4-565b-4997-8bc1-43d016c21c4c.Text: "That is hardly surprising — only the unsightly specimens from the Administratum circles could find that scrawny runt worthy of attention..."

7577218b-92ee-47ca-bbe8-069d57198319.Text: "Is that right? Why, I have heard that the young man is mad about the daughter of another family entirely. But I am not so sure if his parents will approve of his choice!"

daa20357-09a1-412c-89b1-2b00c6034e15.Text: "What? Whom do you mean? Oh, enough with the suspense!"

9bd94b59-81cc-4820-a04e-ce9b8abddf53.Text: "Ah! {mf|Lord|Lady} Rogue Trader! Please forgive our improper talk!"

d3f138bc-037f-4fee-90c8-c97fa84f8d56.Text: "Oh, this is so embarrassing! We will depart this instant so as not to offend your ears!"

6aa34771-a791-477f-a1b9-c359d117d4bc.Text: The large painting upon the altar depicts some saint whose visage you do not recognise. The frame has seen some wear and tear.

71885611-fd11-4ce0-9057-e36775ed3c2b.Text: Standing upon the altar is an ancient image of Saint Macharius. Its regal frame is covered in marks — the relic was claimed in a battle on a remote and forgotten world.

779d653a-acd6-4cb1-8aa4-eb4577d70f70.Text: "I am with you once more, Lord Captain."

680a76c3-9fe7-4a74-8453-2b82d10ee5e5.Text: "Lady Theodora would sometimes vanish for a long time within her study... quite literally, as they say! The servants couldn't find her, and then she would just reappear at her desk!"

58c35a5a-2136-4dda-ab0d-197627c5fe22.Text: "What a blessing to see you in good health, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship!"

55d3b9bc-4c6a-4376-bbc9-849e1c68baee.Text: "Long live the Rogue Trader and {mf|his|her} house!"

c7a80df0-3a37-4b33-8c7f-c0947e32a635.Text: "More revolts on the lower levels of Hive Pharas. The rabble is losing all fear of its rulers."

b2a70943-aefa-46c5-9a57-d7395d49bf7c.Text: "What we need is a Tempestus corps. After all, Dargonus is the capital world of the Rogue Trader's realm — you'd think we could count on seeing symbols of power befitting a planet of such a class!"

53ee7a0c-afe2-4f62-9c72-fa6bfbda4aeb.Text: "May the Emperor bless the dynasty, but, verily, to let your own abode reach such a state is pure—"

6629da6a-9780-49cf-82af-f161e128db6e.Text: "Indeed. I was about to say something that would have been unbecoming of a nobleman."

976299ed-eb5c-4bc9-9c47-378e7466da2e.Text: "I have had the chance to exchange a few words with the first assistant of the High Factotum."

1b5bf74b-9921-4002-a6e6-98d0d5216113.Text: "You don't say! You mean, one of {mf|HIS|HER} servants?"

ad0b8121-8bf5-430e-8cd4-a17abf348a6e.Text: "Yes, yes, that's the one! From {mf|HIS|HER} ship! Would you like to hear the latest news from Footfall?"

33b5a29e-579f-4978-b5e9-5671a16c77a6.Text: "Most definitely! Incidentally, does the High Factotum still take private orders? I wish to obtain a number of valuable items from Lord Tocara..."

40feee33-49ea-4cc4-9739-86f8b30311ab.Text: A mysterious item undoubtedly created by inhuman hands.

fb0a4ff8-69f0-4f69-80ff-a518a1097f80.Text: The cogitator is producing rhythmic sounds, among which a faint ringing stands out.

6ff19100-fb84-46c1-9fe2-3f0e1d059af3.Text: The shelves of the library are laden with dusty tomes — your eyes linger on the works of several Administratum adepts and the memoirs of some unfamiliar explorer of distant death worlds.

2e2b052c-b34f-43a0-a24f-4feaadac09cd.Text: A fine painting in an expensive frame.

4eb5ed23-8bcf-4801-bb9b-1c2650530c09.Text: A living, fruit-bearing tree in the heart of a hive world is a fantastical sight. They probably use a lot more water to tend to this tree than the average Dargonus citizen can hope to receive in their daily ration.

f9d3f976-d457-4794-8bc7-50e6610a08aa.Text: The machine spirit refuses to obey — the turret control remains inaccessible.

2dafd0a6-7c5c-4509-83b3-418d1f280c76.Text: "The main throne room is up the stairs and straight ahead. Your subject Achilleas Scalander informed me that he humbly awaits the opportunity to meet with you there."

c87d5d49-ed21-4ea8-90f7-6c36b57016ae.Text: "Welcome, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! Let me inform you of the location of the chambers on your dynastic estate."

aa57cdee-e650-4a35-89f3-49a6a832ec0c.Text: "If Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship wishes to rest after your long journey, then your personal chambers are up the stairs and on the right."

ce1ccf38-1b9b-46e1-8fa6-3d2a3eb30efe.Text: "If you need anything — whatever your soul desires — I'll be right next to your chambers, eagerly awaiting your orders."

e9787a8c-048e-4e05-99d4-1e593a710d61.Text: "What are you doing here? You are supposed to be cleaning up in the blue chambers!"

efe46ddb-7346-49e5-9696-59aa6be306e6.Text: "What? Again? The handles and the handrails in the blue chambers are polished five times a day! Might as well send a servitor!"

f74a642d-9953-41c8-933b-1bf09160608e.Text: "You talk back to me one more time — and I'll grant you your wish. You'll be cleaning up as a brainless, battery-powered tin can!"

f42c7e79-c1e7-4acb-ac38-fb735a3e660b.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Please pardon all the noise — we're leaving!"

da7c9a15-79d4-4ec9-8da9-a1d3fe0614e9.Text: The quiet humming of servo-motors is occasionally interrupted by clicking coming from somewhere within the servitor.

29d76515-c60b-44bc-939d-2079e5026ec9.Text: The plaque lists the names of each Rogue Trader to have led the von Valancius dynasty dating back to the day the capital world was founded.

278695eb-b16b-4dd5-9fa4-baa9f0a99666.Text: "Over the last twelve cycles, the production in Hive Shargarah has increased by 1.385 per cent. Correlation with archive data required."

22782c55-1849-43d9-98fb-d3613cfc3cf7.Text: "Extracting cogitator data... data error encountered. Discrepancy: 0.065. Audit and material reassessment for the past 12 cycles required."

73088809-db43-4f8b-b9ee-27198297ad45.Text: "Identifying... Rogue Trader, greetings from the crimson priesthood. May the Omnissiah have mercy on the machine spirits in your weapons and void vessels."

fa094667-4500-4ceb-a852-ea7ba14bf192.Text: As you approach, the Lexmechanic subtly bows his head while continuing to emit binharic trills.

bb804a1a-3006-4111-9ebb-04a279ff7632.Text: The Lexmechanics are exchanging binharic tirades, not noticing your presence.

8eb4a315-4179-4768-9cb7-0758f7ddb68f.Text: The bed for the head of a Rogue Trader dynasty is befitting the status of its owner.

2fc3107c-b26a-476e-be74-a58baa289a13.Text: The leather covers bear the names of the authors, mostly philosophers and theologians from Dargonus. The spines of the books are trimmed with gold.

ffa1dde6-b960-4785-a27b-865b543ad8f0.Text: There is a faint mark on the polished mantelpiece, which was likely left by a glass.

375a04fe-510a-4f47-8168-6d209a21667a.Text: The remains of a plaque can be seen on the frame. Alas, the inscription is completely indistinguishable due to the patina.

4e4be866-9900-4a78-9800-09106a0de2c6.Text: A sturdy safe equipped with several bizarre mechanisms.

5eb24027-0edd-44c1-9e0d-06158f84cc10.Text: This antique piece of furniture is obviously well cared for, but its surface is still covered with a lot of scuffs, scratches, and stains — traces of the previous Rogue Traders who sat at this table.

275767e7-d81a-48ab-886e-9b7e32b2b306.Text: The von Valancius dynasty throne — a visible symbol of the Rogue Trader's power, which now belongs to you.

7d43d560-07e7-410d-84cd-b91ead0ecbbd.Text: [Pour a glass of Grand Master's Blood]

0adc1aef-beba-4277-9fc6-b813c148b509.Text: [Pour a glass of Boon of Terra]

a94b9add-2842-4fb6-9e3a-70a3b18ac14a.Text: [Pour a glass of Flame of Purity]

b6286eaa-6fe1-4490-8bc0-fe6b5582975f.Text: [Choose the book "Litanies of the Motive Force"]

a8f01728-f678-4546-aecc-e03aa6fea816.Text: [Choose the book "Love Is the Only Truth"]

0216f837-bf33-4d4f-b071-33d57fb21b93.Text: [Choose the book "Xenos Anatomy: A Scholar's Observations" from the series "One Shot, One Kill"]

fc96290f-7359-4afd-87b1-284866dacc2b.Text: [Choose the book "The Invincible Army: Analysis of the Tactical Triumphs of the Astra Militarum"]

2868f343-4a13-4b02-8b0a-afecb1a30282.Text: [Choose the book "Parsimus Dewain: A Biographical Sketch"]

f321a11a-bf39-4af4-b376-d57a4dabe04d.Text: [Choose the piece "The Symphony of Honour and Duty, Part 2"]

92c39c15-ff4d-47e5-a7e3-6ad424fe75bf.Text: [Choose the piece "Ode to the Most Holy Inquisition"]

3cc2c4bf-23c3-45b1-aa0f-13351a470341.Text: [Choose the piece "Skitarii Choir: The Rhythm of Machine and Blessed Metal"]

03da241e-e3cf-4247-a7f6-32d572ca7275.Text: {n}The room is still with silent expectation.{/n}

bebbe6c9-5746-4e0c-88a6-8a833deadeec.Text: {n}Three sealed bottles sit on the sturdy-looking low table. They are labelled "Grand Master's Blood," "Boon of Terra," and "Flame of Purity."{/n}

e3b9bdb6-ca71-4910-9246-04418f2ccc24.Text: {n}The wine fills the glass, glittering in the dim light of the room like liquid gold. Its tangy flavour burns your throat, leaving behind a spicy, biting aftertaste. You hear a short, faint hum as an unseen motor stirs into motion.{/n}

de61fc0b-85f5-452a-94d0-981871ad7f2a.Text: {n}The full-bodied wine is sickly sweet, and you feel a warm sluggishness wash over your body.{/n}

be234904-b784-4821-978f-e304cb834ddc.Text: {n}Several books are stacked next to the sofa. Some appear ancient, while others look like they have never been opened.{/n}

39f8c874-5e4f-49fe-8ed0-9d48f5f417a7.Text: {n}A siren shatters the tranquil atmosphere in the room — alarms have been sounded!{/n}

54450827-2818-403c-a02b-8d98d10ead93.Text: {n}The book in your hand looks interesting. The prospect of spending a couple of tranquil hours immersed in reading appeals to you...{/n}

90c98e19-1621-4073-a2d8-2348b9312d6d.Text: {n}As you pick up the book, a hidden button in its spine clicks under your finger.{/n}

ef55398d-540c-4aed-a076-c65f0955b846.Text: {n}The vid-screen of the data-slate before you displays the names of several vox-symphonies.{/n}

556aed5e-a70f-4ef0-aee7-35202a1f35e0.Text: {n}The same monotonous melody continues to pour out of the vox-speakers.{/n}

1ce65a97-81b3-4ab9-ae77-2c329b0f298a.Text: {n}You hear a loud click inside the vox-speakers, and the piece that was playing earlier starts anew.{/n}

d210a1f7-2759-4b13-ad13-3aaa876385d0.Text: {n}The music in the speakers momentarily grows louder, filling the entire room, then goes back to normal, seemingly without any change.{/n}

dcc0a5fe-3373-4012-a910-53909e02f09f.Text: {n}After the alarm and the palace guard's intrusion, the calm and comfortable atmosphere of this room has faded somewhat — not even here can a Rogue Trader find a moment of privacy!{/n}

94043324-7a0a-4ecc-bcf8-88719f438c0d.Text: {n}This secret room is remarkably quiet and almost homely. Perhaps your predecessor used it when she sought complete solitude. Listening to the muted melody coming from the vox-speaker, you can easily imagine Theodora reading a book with a glass of expensive wine in hand.{/n}

67fb49f5-5cde-4cfc-abb3-acda7422adb3.Text: {n}You recall the vision of the past that Idira told you about — she said Theodora's favourite wine was Flame of Purity.{/n}

38983dea-32c6-4fe4-a13b-c8811a945e91.Text: {n}Among Theodora's data that has been restored using your cogitator is the phrase "Litanies of the Motive Force" — it is the title of one of the books here.{/n}

3c1fc6cb-33fb-4f9d-b645-45d795635a57.Text: {n}The cover of the book titled "Litanies of the Motive Force" looks rather hefty, as though its spine contains a miniature device of some sort.{/n}

6f5c94aa-490c-489a-b6ba-755a8e631953.Text: {n}No book here catches your particular attention.{/n}

19e94685-f830-4118-bab7-501600ae2a61.Text: {n}You recognise the melody that is playing right now — it is the first of thirty-six parts of "The Symphony of Honour and Duty."{/n}

115803f7-1c4d-4898-9988-86d4b2136b90.Text: {n}The melody that is playing right now sounds familiar but does not stir anything in you other than an unexpected wave of inspiration.{/n}

56c5a65a-5b73-45a5-96b0-e681a1a662f7.Text: {n}The room responds to your actions with a quiet grinding sound, and a small nook reveals itself in the nearby wall. Inside, you find a data-bank bearing the von Valancius coat of arms.{/n}

aebacdf5-dd9a-4941-bea3-33758ab311ab.Text: {n}You notice a short inscription in the book, "From a faithful servant of the dynasty in lasting memory — D.V.V."{/n}

c47e3c23-308c-47a8-a9a2-5919a599faca.Text: "The Emperor protected us on our journey through the stars."

f1be4043-7ab5-4e6a-8d30-9b8fd943dd26.Text: "The Emperor blesses those who strengthen Humanity's domain through their deeds. You have reason to be proud of your progeny."

7e6b0c0c-805a-4703-82a5-7fe5fa197cab.Text: "It was terrible! I did not realise my demesne's security was so illusory."

aa6d0552-d155-4b1e-ab0b-c301d27a7dfd.Text: "We had some incidents, but those are irrelevant at this moment."

8c8d67e4-da45-480f-8e77-62e9b0c73046.Text: "All that concerns me is the prosperity of my protectorate."

10f5d983-3f86-4a72-bfab-b5242b21fbb3.Text: "Why isn't the governor here with you to greet me?"

bc182d6b-715a-42b9-a251-6a0373d720f6.Text: "I would like to rest before the meeting. Where are my chambers?"

1738e261-3907-4acd-9d1a-14a450e73514.Text: "Hold on a moment, Clementia. What did you say your last name was?"

14c3f31d-ecc0-437d-860d-c828564b79d2.Text: "The Emperor protects! Welcome home, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}." {n}The stately woman in a long full dress uniform makes a graceful curtsy. Her short, greying hair does not obscure her stern features.{/n}

913941f6-aa92-465e-99bc-ec2129026746.Text: "It saddens me to hear this, Rogue Trader. I hope that here, within the walls of your family estate, you can rest and regather your strength."

e0f343e6-e42e-42eb-b8b8-11e76861e9b0.Text: "Does Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} wish to survey the grounds? Or perhaps we could sate your curiosity by answering any questions you might have? Governor Urbend Drivestem has been notified of your arrival on Dargonus and will visit the palace shortly. The preparations for the official visit are well in hand, but Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} still has plenty of time before the meeting."

60f398d2-8044-4951-b7c6-ba1df0679ffd.Text: "Apologies, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Governor Drivestem's residence is on the other side of the world — by the Administratum Palace of Dargonus. We sent word as soon as you entered the system. But it takes time to travel the great distances of your domain."

5f6c253f-e829-4f7e-bbdd-c7f9d9505e2a.Text: "For House Werserian, your dynasty's well-being is of paramount importance."

f94973e3-82ee-4cbc-9056-0de0eb7fd88e.Text: "They are very close, just down the hall. That is also where the study and the audience chamber are." {n}Achilleas's face brightens with a pearly-white smile, restoring some of his former good looks.{/n} "Lady Theodora's study has remained locked since her last departure, but, on account of your arrival, we've arranged for it to be tidied up — it is ready whenever you may need it."

96380843-f1f6-4ad9-bdcd-71b39277620f.Text: {n}Clementia nods politely.{/n} "You heard correctly, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I am of House Werserian — Lord Abelard's granddaughter and direct descendant."

7a28b5da-fa3a-4dab-a7ce-978f869edb92.Text: "I apologise for my bluntness, but I have a request to make. Perhaps, before the meeting takes place, the illustrious Lord Captain could spare a few minutes for a conversation with me?" {n}Achilleas bows his head.{/n} "I'm certain that you will find my report on the state of affairs in the von Valancius protectorate most useful."

f9f8478e-d82e-4e28-91b0-429e3b57c0c4.Text: "Your yellow words becloud the Rogue Trader... yet I can see the swampy muck behind the veneer. You are trying to shield the Lord Captain from the unseemly truth, but it is a servant's duty to share every truth with their master."

1f9d9213-2964-4d5f-932f-41b2d787fa95.Text: {n}Clementia flinches and nods uncertainly.{/n} "Of course... You are right, Lady Navigator. I believe that the governor is testing the limits of what is allowed. An audacious move on his part, but Her Ladyship always favoured audacity."

84e94bc8-f915-4bd0-b7dc-f872739daca2.Text: {n}Chancellor Werserian appears unruffled, but you cannot shake the thought that the governor's lateness is a subtle political gesture designed to test the limits of what is acceptable when it comes to interacting with the new Rogue Trader.{/n}

a9b65ca5-92a1-47ca-91d7-72f9d85a2318.Text: {n}She has a point. Dargonus is a vast world, and a trip from one pole to another must take a considerable amount of time.{/n}

f8e87b42-64d9-4176-b382-db760e2ce681.Text: {n}The young man quickly brings a respirator to his burnt face and bows his head courteously. His raven black hair veils his burns and skull implants, and his thin metal fingers creak quietly as he offers a welcoming gesture.{/n} "Achilleas Scalander, secretary at the Administratum department. I hope your journey to Dargonus was not darkened by unwanted troubles?"

d2f869a5-a2a5-4015-b089-a30fd85b42e6.Text: "I am Clementia Werserian, court chancellor of the von Valancius dynasty. On behalf of all of Dargonus, please accept my deepest condolences on the untimely passing of Theodora von Valancius. Her departure is a terrible blow to us all. But as one star expires, another always flares to life. And, although still overcome with bitterness and grief, your subjects hope that you will become the trade dynasty's guiding light in these trying times."

a279dfdd-15aa-40a9-ba9b-0b2d9e9856e6.Text: "Clementia." {n}Abelard offers a reserved nod. She nods in return, and the lines on his brow soften ever so slightly.{/n}

47be6517-46a3-4c81-88a6-0f2d0b343ca4.Text: "Quite right, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. What happened cannot be changed, but you still have great deeds ahead of you. So let us look to the future with hope in our hearts."

6f5125ca-7e22-476f-9633-8220c9a83fb1.Text: "Chancellor Werserian has held her position at the von Valancius court for many years. She earned Lord Captain Theodora's respect through acts of great perseverance. There's no room for doubt — blood had nothing to do with it."

ff9014d5-cf4d-4447-bdad-66e033ab8643.Text: {n}Achilleas makes the sign of the Aquila.{/n} "And may He remain merciful to us till the end of time."

c03bff33-4590-423b-9144-1277f37aa208.Text: {n}Abelard looks at you in surprise, but then immediately puts on an air of indifference.{/n} "Thank you, Lord Captain."

f8fc0341-451f-43cb-bb15-b8290820d338.Text: "The succession of service is an effective good. It grants new generations understanding of their function within the mechanism."

06a0ed86-f970-420f-ab36-e63259e715f3.Text: {n}Abelard looks like he wants to object, but, seeing your aloofness, simply crosses his arms without saying a word.{/n}

05d574f3-37ad-4b91-80d0-062e3e36ac5d.Text: "Come now, Urbend. I am as much of a parvenu as Abelard."

e985c876-579d-448a-a3b7-08541fd0a22f.Text: [Lie] "Accursed xenos took Vistenza's life. But her death was avenged."

c7f5c323-93cc-4fb4-9728-a9d5e5dd29e7.Text: "Such intriguing concern for the Vheabos VI outpost... Doesn't your house happen to own the extraction stations there?"

830b813b-b8ec-41b2-a125-0e674f50a04d.Text: "Theodora von Valancius deserves more than that! You will declare a full year of mourning."

f8a98101-8446-4ecb-b111-5fbb41eb3131.Text: "There is no need. I am the new ruler of the protectorate — let my subjects rejoice at my arrival instead."

bd4740f1-83dd-4d6a-a77b-6385f315ac08.Text: "Your presumption is wrong. I will bestow this honour upon the Werserians."

893346c4-07eb-45bf-95f6-5f74e306ec80.Text: "It's all the same to me. Do as you see fit."

d729ffd4-f951-439f-aa54-7ff99d9b0273.Text: "Kunrad Voigtvir, former Master of Whispers, is a heretic and a traitor. Has he shown his face on Dargonus?"

eb9117a9-0a11-4034-a4e1-26f5cc62c2bf.Text: "We met a ship from Dargonus not too long ago. The crew was transporting a strange artefact and went mad during the flight."

4c54195e-2934-4e8f-a8d1-35deb5d9031e.Text: "Tell me about yourself and House Drivestem."

30996843-276c-464d-9cc1-4da3f34f1958.Text: Ordered that the discontented Dargonus aristocrats be servitorised.

18545ccb-b476-4230-901b-742d26fbbc66.Text: "I sentence all who have dared to make heretical remarks about the Rogue Trader to Servitude Imperpituis. Machines aren't prone to dissidence."

74ba0307-c439-4076-8610-e5d5233ab489.Text: Recognised the concerns of the discontented Dargonus aristocrats.

f154299f-d976-455e-acd3-3b3ec12e2238.Text: "My subjects' doubts are understandable — too many things have changed in too short a span. I will prove myself worthy of my position."

87455996-efd0-47ea-be00-f3d285ff90d8.Text: "I couldn't care less about what people think of me. I am Theodora's successor whether they like it or not."

74e25291-ecf2-4d4b-a6fd-f85b008c163e.Text: "I have already been to Kiava Gamma. The industrial world was overtaken by a cult of Chaos worshippers."

33f2a3ce-933a-4299-b568-0e02dc20ec00.Text: "We won't wait for the investigation. See to it that punitive measures are taken against House Gaprak."

8c4b288e-53e5-4107-beb3-9828eb1061b8.Text: "I doubt the Gapraks had anything to do with this incident."

e6d98855-1ca5-409d-8551-b3bbbc103548.Text: "It's too early to draw any conclusions. We will wait for the results of the investigation."

60563782-e462-417f-b3ca-284830a196c6.Text: "That does it for the planets and the trade routes. What else?"

23e9db4f-13ce-4a7b-b5e0-aa725006ef5f.Text: "I would like to complete my inauguration as Rogue Trader as soon as possible. When is the ceremony?"

e811bb43-5a52-4baf-a917-bb98fcacbd34.Text: "I've already visited the agri-world Janus. Governor Vyatt found herself facing a number of problems in my absence."

a95faaea-cc0e-4880-98f7-6d7fb024193b.Text: "Vistenza Vyatt is no longer in charge of the world — she is dead. I have delivered Janus into more capable hands."

3c39cc0f-c8a8-497c-bfb8-e101a7912a73.Text: "House Gaprak will represent the new Rogue Trader."

b1518006-115d-4fe4-907f-a581d0d37066.Text: "The world still manufactures heavy machinery... but they have nothing in common with the type of production the Gapraks are familiar with."

eab5f274-116a-4b2f-aa41-b0bf18a8e144.Text: "You could say that. Still, all her worries are behind her now, and Vistenza continues to govern the agri-world."

258c7609-8d95-4527-9383-8af4ea2d64ca.Text: "The production facilities of Kiava Gamma will serve Humanity once more, rest assured."

389d5861-2f30-4817-aa2f-d9cc50522030.Text: "I don't care. Just don't fight too hard over the bone."

1e6e35e1-e860-4d31-b958-4bd5c7639aa4.Text: Ordered that the discontented Dargonus aristocrats have their tongues cut out.

25a2d04d-9484-4165-a3e9-34b6e3b892c1.Text: "Publicly rip out the vocal cords and tongues of every slanderer and replace them with vox-implants that sing the praises of Rogue Trader {name} von Valancius without interruption. I should think that will serve as a reminder of who rules this world."

41d4116c-124d-47b6-baf8-26f9a45f4f75.Text: "Kibellah, I entrust this burden to the Bloodspun Web. Unravel the tangle of plots and foil them."

4d8fa0f0-cb6c-4dd8-a2ff-575083e3150c.Text: "I shall be the one to judge what behoves me and what does not."

6e63db3e-ed8c-4ef2-9923-88d74e83d2f8.Text: "I do honour traditions, Governor. Later, when things in the protectorate settle down, we will declare a mourning period."

aefa7a89-1282-4f70-b999-5049f3af248b.Text: "That will be all, I take it?"

281bd281-3a2f-49f6-9d93-6f5f70d83e74.Text: "What exactly do the Dargonus nobility expect from me in light of the loss of routes and communication with other worlds?"

c4dc2923-d806-4d46-9fe0-d59b9470c45d.Text: "You will learn about everything in due course."

b01a175b-bbdd-4973-8186-0d7a896b2568.Text: "Send the disgruntled nobles lavish gifts on my behalf. And make sure that my generosity does not go unnoticed by the rest."

009b3166-441a-4121-b5b6-3352d2ce144f.Text: "Eliminate the most prominent malcontents quietly, but do not threaten entire families. Hopefully these steps will be enough to keep the rest from causing any more trouble."

267daaf3-f710-414f-9ba8-0b29babdef6f.Text: "I care not what those hyenas are yapping about behind my back. Leave them be — they are no threat to me."

1a0376b3-17b4-4444-9d48-4f9e15ad1f92.Text: "Make arrangements for public purges. All who have sullied the Rogue Trader's name must meet their death on the executioner's block."

dfda3eec-811b-451a-9fed-23dcfba04252.Text: "There is no need to alter any traditions. The dynasty will be represented by House Drivestem."

7badee37-9c7e-40f1-98bd-94aab42171aa.Text: "House Sauerback will carry out this duty."

0152dd30-ab87-4cd4-bdd0-1a5ceb1be082.Text: "Vistenza succumbed to worshipping the Ruinous Powers and was executed."

a161c201-5fd0-4f76-b3b4-642f6444f009.Text: "One moment. Which houses can represent me at the ceremony?"

2a7ff1bc-fc87-44fe-8e40-73c6e8ba2342.Text: "{name} von Valancius, twentieth in {mf|his|her} line, Rogue Trader, keeper of the sacred {g|Encyclopedia:Warrant}Warrant{/g}, and ruler of the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g} from the Cranach System to the Hundred Dreams Crossroads — I bid you welcome!"

ab17d9a9-6a00-446d-8a30-d1f151a99329.Text: "As for me personally... I am a humble servant of the Emperor and a loyal subject of the Rogue Trader. And, to my great pleasure, I had the honour of calling myself Lady Theodora's close friend."

f71776d2-530f-470a-a23a-2090c213d710.Text: {n}Drivestem's voice fills with appropriately measured indignation:{/n} "Profane fiends! May the Emperor smite their breed for the death of His diligent servant Vistenza!"

38a29711-9265-4861-aa77-d1f08c88ad68.Text: {n}Drivestem's beady eyes widen in fear.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! I beg of you, do not interpret my words as an attempt to influence your decisions in any way... You see, without Vheabos VI, the {g|Encyclopedia:Manufactorum}manufactorums{/g} on your worlds will need to make haste to find new suppliers elsewhere and arrange for new shipments, and in these troubling times, they run the risk of delays and other most tragic mishaps! My only concern is for the prosperity of the von Valancius dynasty!"

f727a5be-166b-437e-bf6b-acca1e9a82f1.Text: "I will immediately give all necessary instructions, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!" {n}He casually presses a few buttons on the {g|Encyclopedia:Cogitator}cogitator{/g} built into his gold bracer.{/n}

75a2a8ba-7b41-476e-a9e5-d6306cecdd64.Text: {n}The bewilderment causes the wrinkles on Drivestem's glossy face to soften.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, these are centuries-old traditions, sacred customs and rules!"

3f088407-d572-4be4-9e24-d4116b87997b.Text: "We will investigate this at once. As well as the fact that the ship had to acquire a permit with the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusAdministratum}Administratum{/g} seal. Does your nephew still serve at the Administratum Palace?"

5e38e8bb-17fb-41f6-86b3-78797610c513.Text: "We are all troubled by the fate of the {g|Encyclopedia:AgriWorld}agri-world{/g} Janus that supplied Dargonus and other planets with foodstuffs — empty stomachs can drive even the mildest rabble to revolt. Furthermore, House Gaprak is perturbed by the loss of communication with the {g|Encyclopedia:IndustrialWorld}industrial world{/g} Kiava Gamma, which is in their charge. But if you wish to know my opinion, the world that deserves your attention the most is the penal world Vheabos VI — one of the key mining suppliers in your protectorate."

565278f6-d416-4b2f-8db7-93623126eec8.Text: "Esteemed {name}... Lady Theodora was a strong leader, and we ought to follow her example. Let us lean on our wisdom and persevere in spite of this tragedy. Together. And let us carry on where she no longer can by leading the von Valancius protectorate to even greater prosperity!"

2a6c22b5-84f3-4c91-bc01-aa010686fd9f.Text: "Do not forget who it is you serve, Urbend Drivestem. If it is the Rogue Trader's wish not to have a mourning ceremony..." {n}Abelard's voice grates unpleasantly.{/n} "...then so be it."

798a2df2-0360-4764-9324-8ca8bc1d6a37.Text: {n}The governor pensively strokes the rings glittering on his fingers.{/n} "Lord Voigtvir visited the capital some time ago, but he did not request a personal meeting. A heretic, you say? Now I see where all the whispering in the corridors has come from..."

d52b9080-da14-40f9-a4db-166526843d43.Text: {n}The governor presses a number of buttons on the cogitator built into his bracer and looks up at you in surprise.{/n} "I don't understand... The ship did indeed depart from orbit, but it did so — if you can believe it — on the Rogue Trader's authorisation! That is why no one dared to impede its departure."

1c905627-b5a0-4266-860c-b8cd0cc27f06.Text: "It would be my pleasure to enlighten you. My house is the oldest and most respected on Dargonus. My ancestors walked side by side with yours for many generations as they cared for this world's welfare. Our duty is to supervise the governing bodies within the systems subservient to you, and we are responsible for the protectorate's logistics and economic stability."

158784f2-c9f0-4242-90cf-a0cab2f22659.Text: "I shall be frank with you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Lady Theodora's sudden death was a blow to every one of us, and the absence of any sort of verifiable and complete information about her successor gives grounds for all manner of rumours and misinterpretations — especially if someone is deliberately inciting unrest and discontent. Naturally, none would dare challenge you by accusing you of something as sacrilegious as murdering a Rogue Trader... However, Kunrad Voigtvir was once a true boon to the protectorate back in the day — and as such, some might heed his words."

548ffe0a-d7fd-47f7-87fd-2a05d3692a32.Text: {n}Drivestem pauses, mulling over the gravity of your words.{/n} "Such woeful tidings, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}... I assume that House Gaprak is in for an official investigation? If I may remind you, they have particularly close ties to the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMechanicus}Adeptus Mechanicus{/g} and serve as patrons of Kiava Gamma. Not to speak in the defence of criminals, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, but from where I stand, the outbreak of heresy on Kiava could hardly have been perpetrated by a noble family who stands to lose the majority of their wealth should the industrial world fall..."

4d20fa2c-1d47-4819-8938-9f5a9e57724e.Text: "I shall immediately make all the arrangements so that your order can be carried out properly." {n}Drivestem bows.{/n}

0a3abfd1-c52a-4312-a9bf-cf4c534419dc.Text: "Why, {name}, your desire is most commendable, but please do not forget — a ruler should never bow to their attendants, or some might see it as a show of weakness."

cb506ad8-b4f8-4851-a204-93ca0374a6bd.Text: "My thoughts exactly, Rogue Trader! Guide the protectorate along its path — and in time, all things will return to normal!"

e06a9d0c-e892-4750-97a5-273717ea073e.Text: "If you are adamant about this, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}... I will ensure that the sentence is carried out."

a29acd82-029f-4343-a9cd-0123bd520078.Text: "I am glad that our views on this matter align, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

6e7aa35d-9dcb-4e03-97a5-7531a032b960.Text: "House Gaprak will be overjoyed to hear it! I thank you for dispelling the darkness around the fate of Kiava Gamma!"

edb99da6-3375-4221-9576-ad89f011e8b5.Text: "I am delighted to hear it. Many on Dargonus live in hope that food deliveries to the capital will resume soon."

aa66102b-e25d-47f7-ad53-e24deef5cac1.Text: "I never doubted Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}'s decision. I can tell that the future holds a fruitful partnership for us, and prosperity for all Dargonus. I shall immediately relay all your orders, most gracious Rogue Trader. May the gold of the Throne illuminate your path."

87d33f9a-9620-40f6-bdf3-1dedc1f6983b.Text: "I'm afraid that, until you deal with pressing issues, the ceremony will have to be postponed. Many trade routes are still unavailable, the central worlds of the von Valancius protectorate are going through a crisis, and the {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}warp{/g} disturbances, if void observers are to be believed, will prevent important guests from reaching the capital."

1653a018-1c5c-4a97-b446-618aac2659e4.Text: "And one last thing, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Your inauguration as bearer of the sacred Warrant is but a matter of time, and I would like to enquire about one crucial detail. I imagine you are intending to uphold the centuries-old tradition, bolstered by an equally long-lasting friendship, of being represented on Dargonus by one of the noble houses. I presume that, as before, this duty will be accorded to House Drivestem—"

98f36613-d64e-4961-b40c-0492b808ab63.Text: "Truly? The Vyatt line is one of the oldest in the von Valancius protectorate — if the inheritor of such well-respected blood could not handle whatever had befallen her, then the situation must have been extraordinary indeed..."

f1862d14-2e95-40f2-ab93-8bb92ba929fc.Text: {n}Drivestem's eyes open wide.{/n} "The Vyatt line... is broken? Such horrible news! Oh, it will shake many who were connected to the Vyatts and who are used to the immunity that comes with our class..."

69b7a3d5-f0d3-49aa-a183-24e5d4ae33c7.Text: "But what of the industrial world? Are we to expect trade to recommence?"

bbbcd7cc-3803-4ea3-9a12-feab83385b96.Text: {n}The governor glances at Kibellah anxiously, then immediately averts his gaze. Then he looks at her again, but when Kibellah lets out a grim chuckle and stretches her lips daubed in fresh blood into a petrifying grin, the governor turns away from her sharply, all but squealing in fear.{/n}

9337ced4-4942-46a1-aa97-08e8fff26120.Text: "Once Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}'s wrath descends upon the guilty, have no doubt — there won't be a soul on Dargonus willing to share their fate."

6468f05c-1a09-4e6e-9a97-ccc5bdf5e5cd.Text: "A noble decision, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Let us hope that others do not mistake your magnanimity for weakness."

34b679bb-d9ca-42db-9828-8df6ec0efcf5.Text: "Now, to issues on a smaller scale. There is a certain degree of tension in the capital due to the unorthodox succession to the sacred {g|Encyclopedia:Warrant}Warrant{/g}. Chances of uprisings are minimal, of course, and the spreading of rumours is nothing but a sign of weakness of mind and spirit. Nonetheless... I have prepared a list of minor houses that have demonstrated unseemly discomposure at your succession. What is to be done about them?"

7b511a8e-c44a-42f7-a75c-4edee35cc98c.Text: "With a hand stern and strong, isn't that right, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}? You bear a stronger resemblance to Theodora von Valancius than I thought. May the stars shine upon her path in the darkness. It will be done."

c91ba3f9-b7cb-46d2-a1a1-65546798b3d6.Text: {n}Drivestem's face breaks into a bitter smile.{/n} "I shall immediately relay your commands, most gracious Rogue Trader. Thank you for your time."

8e156075-539a-4302-92be-a6c1e00f8950.Text: "Any of the noble houses located on Dargonus! The Drivestem family, which I lead; the Gaprak family, with long ties to the Adeptus Mechanicus; the Sauerbacks, known for their piety and diligence in service... Perhaps I should also mention the Werserians, who have some influence, but who are not actually of noble origin. Any one of these houses would be honoured to represent you at the ceremony."

e7cd6472-1a63-47b6-bf43-aaeecec2ef23.Text: {n}The governor hurriedly lowers his head in an obliging bow, but you catch a glimpse of the grimace on his face. He is clearly displeased by your words.{/n} "In that case, I think it's appropriate not to change the established order of things — you will be represented by the governor house of Drivestem."

1271eb82-ed8a-410d-91cb-2991292ffb6b.Text: {n}Abelard turns to you and bows respectfully.{/n} "Lord Captain! To accompany you at such a critical hour is the greatest honour for the Werserian bloodline! Have no fear — we will not fail you."

3d53c7f5-de08-4560-aa83-f372e2a662ba.Text: {n}Drivestem pales in terror. It is clear from the unseemly grimace on his aristocratic countenance that his fear is not feigned.{/n} "R-Ruinous Powers? Truly horrifying news. I commend your resolve and unwavering severity! Death to the enemies of Humanity!"

8d0d89d8-0b89-4d91-b37d-891e5a0f9472.Text: {n}Drivestem gives you a look of admiration. It seems that he is quite aware of your fame, and this opportunity to curry favour with such an {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_MOT_Glory}eminent figure{/d} is one he does not wish to miss.{/n}

5433f5a6-bc9c-4e8a-b02e-85dd22ebde57.Text: {n}As much as the governor is trying to appear sincere, there is something in the curve of his nervous half-smile that you find troubling. Is it a hint of reproach? Mockery? Condemnation? Or is it merely your {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Shame}guilty conscience{/d} playing tricks on you under the governor's keen gaze, stirring up memories of your past?{/n}

e7f07c8f-f220-4c4f-ae07-24ac91cf1a34.Text: "Alas, it won't be an easy task to accomplish. Some time ago, the {g|Encyclopedia:Astropath}Astropaths{/g} of Dargonus flew into a rage, and they had to be... subdued. We are gradually restoring our ability to speak with neighbouring worlds, but the contacts are still weak, and the routes are tangled and no longer lead to the systems that the captains expect them to. Given that the vast majority of ships in the Dargonus navy travel without relying on the services of {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Navigators{/g} — without your engagement, the well-being of the von Valancius dynasty and billions of its subjects is presently at risk."

d80e5a8e-4a32-41fb-8ffd-7fcc5a289916.Text: "And yet you are still a descendant of a great dynasty. But I shan't tire you further with my humble opinion."

dc9c3e51-ccb1-4545-9cc2-9c80c381d89f.Text: "As you will, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}." {n}Drivestem bows his head.{/n}

82516cbf-7f21-46e0-ac6f-0418258de7ca.Text: "Thank you for your time, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Since duty calls, I shall take my leave. May the Emperor's grace be with you!"

7d49d776-3e81-47a7-a108-457a974548f4.Text: "Command the spinners of the Bloodspun Web — and they will set a fine snare of retribution, Domin'{name}. We will whisper names, and that whisper will drown out insolent voices."

94e6ed40-a322-4dd9-b8b0-1e39411b9063.Text: "Hmm... Well, I'll be sure to notify the Gapraks of Kiava Gamma's current situation. Thank you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

8ca87267-ddc0-4d5b-8783-c242fa060661.Text: {n}A cold sweat breaks out on Drivestem's face. He forces a subservient smile on his face.{/n} "This will bring the noble houses into line for years to come, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. It will make them fear not only blasphemous words, but also their own shadows."

990c4632-7821-4bab-9091-7dad2bc2ce19.Text: {n}The governor stares at you with a mixture of worry and incredulity. Nevertheless, after hearing your words, he bows his head in obedience.{/n}

66fdd8ee-a748-41d3-9d82-a2d4b3d08d59.Text: "Urbend Drivestem, governor of this great world. First and foremost, please accept my deepest condolences. It will be difficult to recover from the loss of a woman as great as Theodora von Valancius. It pains me to think that she is no longer with us. The citizens of Dargonus and of the entire protectorate grieve alongside you. Please allow us to declare half a year of mourning so that we can honour the memory of our beloved lady."

8a5053fa-9428-4ded-a1ee-07626cc49c6c.Text: {n}Drivestem tosses Abelard a look that lacks even the smallest shred of respect.{/n} "Forgive my boldness, but I must remind you that the Werserians, whose lineage traces back to a Navy officer, are not of the Dargonus nobility. Such decisions may have adverse effects on your subjects' loyalty, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

ebc9f64d-af0b-4e60-9174-240eea2117cd.Text: "It will be done, Domin'{name}. Let the sacrament of the hunt commence."

3614093a-b7b9-4cd9-9f28-f7b7e7f4f2e7.Text: "Lord Captain, it would seem that Kunrad somehow got his hands on a copy of your authorisation — or perhaps even the original! A tool like that in the hands of a traitor does not bode well!"

faf098bf-812b-4dfa-b8e4-7c10b85fb9ec.Text: {n}At Urbend's last words, Abelard lets out a sound that could be interpreted as either a snort or a cough. Urbend gives him a look, which Abelard meets with an expression of utter nonchalance.{/n}

ce5f3b37-f86b-4cd9-aefe-25b967c3a9f3.Text: "Hmm... This is a truly regrettable bit of news. What's more — leaving Dargonus has been forbidden for several cycles now! It seems the Werserian family has once again failed in their primary responsibilities." {n}He shoots Abelard a condescending look.{/n}

a62f7dbc-57b1-4dc8-aa8f-12719ac4e9be.Text: "{g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}Xenos{/g}, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I don't rightly know where to begin..." {n}He rubs the bridge of his nose wearily.{/n} "Otherworldly beasts are not an uncommon sight in the Koronus Expanse — they have been a menace to the worlds this side of the Maw for decades. But now... now those abominations are on the rampage. They show no signs of fear as they attack ships, either damaging them to the point where they become unfit for transport duty or outright gutting them!"

c0ec1391-7ef0-4247-82df-dea90b002e9b.Text: "Only you have the power to stop this madness! We are in the process of restoring the Astropathic Choir of Dargonus. Luckily, we were forced to slay only some of the deranged psykers, although those that remain are as yet unable to transmit messages. I hope Master Scalander will keep his word and offer you his support in the war against the xenos. According to his reports, the region of Vheabos VI has been of particular concern in the last few cycles... which is all the more reason to discover the colony's fate as soon as possible."

7f1f7d72-7e2d-4da9-a069-4a380968c641.Text: "An elegant solution, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Other families will assume that your relationships with the defiant houses are more complicated than one might think, and the agitators will receive the message that they are being watched."

bf7f10a9-bf51-492f-a150-6ad3b175f7f7.Text: {n}Urbend looks at Abelard tiredly from under his heavy eyelids.{/n} "Perhaps a parvenu installed by Lady Theodora cares not for the sacred traditions of our founding ancestors. But {name} von Valancius is a descendant of the true children of Dargonus."

9af11074-1994-434a-b5df-06b6cd45d958.Text: "Perhaps the parvenu installed by Lady Theodora cares not for the sacred traditions of our founding ancestors..." {n}The governor gives a meaningful nod in Abelard's direction.{/n} "But {name} von Valancius is a descendant of the true children of Dargonus! It behoves the ruler of a world to honour its customs."

b0d0fbac-f31d-45f4-a5f2-a58b915d15b1.Text: "The way you speak of Drivestem... I hear a hint of either contempt or resentment."

8e9fd7d6-95e5-4fd2-958e-3da9fbe36f2f.Text: "What can you tell me about Dargonus?"

e1d12959-659b-4dd7-9870-431b72e683f5.Text: "Does the capital stay in contact with the other worlds in the protectorate?"

c9e34888-2429-40a9-b3b0-0cd3066ca9d7.Text: "Are there any other issues that I should be aware of?"

ca9a1863-70fb-45a1-ae90-6f05633a549c.Text: "Tell them that I'm ready to see the governor."

2e4caef0-c27a-4818-b27a-ab011cf582a3.Text: "The governor can wait a little longer. I still have matters to take care of."

9d1068cc-29c6-423f-9c79-ea3dd0ccb7ad.Text: "What about the meeting with Navigators of House Orsellio?"

e4642218-55b3-4e63-aa16-7f3a99298e09.Text: "Mistress Werserian, I require that a document be certified. Where is the court servitor, the keeper of seals?"

551ab06e-1be0-42b5-9796-abb6589f3890.Text: "I presume the one responsible was punished promptly and harshly?"

86f30a56-fd10-4213-a3ed-efc968642c07.Text: "Announce that the reception is starting. I am ready to receive the Erebis family."

5d6ce467-9e49-46e1-bd12-58f32c94f53d.Text: "Announce that the reception is starting. I am ready to receive the Erebis family."

383e12e6-cb46-4a7e-a494-f18fdf03feca.Text: "I need to certify this Mercatum Tabula Officiale."

68144de7-b98e-41cf-b5fa-360382372a70.Text: "You may figure out your problems yourselves."

a17ef96c-04d1-434d-9b93-b9d1451576ef.Text: "There is something I must discuss with the chancellor in private."

f2c23d29-977a-464b-988a-6447d6aa2219.Text: "I ought to have you flogged for withholding critical information."

145f9867-7ab5-4397-b253-0dd20a0e51d5.Text: "I'm ready to receive the delegation from House Orsellio."

96d1de10-11f7-4bf4-bd61-8e9e94df6f81.Text: "If the noble houses are so volatile, what sense is there in keeping them?"

1c0e4e47-9f00-46a3-8a54-a2e2d2cfa02c.Text: "Achilleas Scalander — does he cause any problems?"

d33f77e0-70ed-49a4-b72c-bb163dd827c1.Text: "Make arrangements for a reception worthy of the refined tastes of the Navis Nobilite."

b1c405bc-d3c2-4c4c-87c8-7abdef19d7d8.Text: "A meeting with the Navigators is just a formality. No need for any extravagant receptions."

3ebb1f29-f9b5-4f79-a579-e1bab10c4f82.Text: "Yes, Cassia and I are ready for the talks."

c1ec6e0e-4c94-4887-ad51-e2a684f36b86.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}." {n}Clementia bows her head politely. For a chancellor to a Rogue Trader, she is dressed rather simply — a parade doublet, polished boots, and a comfortable cloak. She bears a sabre in a gilded scabbard — whether for show or protection, one could not say. Only her ring with the Werserian coat of arms indicates that she is of the highest social stratum.{/n} "The governor is waiting on the periphery of the palace. Please let me know when you would like to see him."

b9e08787-90c9-4b6f-93af-797e8bf4b3bb.Text: "No... no, I don't believe I feel either, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}." {n}Clementia's steely eyes stare into the distance, her jaw clenching visibly. She speaks in a polite but clipped manner, clearly flustered by your insight.{/n} "We have different views on how to run a world. We sometimes have discussions over the laws that are enacted. But we both work for the good of the von Valancius protectorate, that much can be said without a doubt."

282ee031-b632-4b45-8c12-71e0013f9c2e.Text: {n}She looks surprised.{/n} "Why, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I would never! Of course, the governor and I are not exactly close friends, but I respect his contribution to the protectorate's development, and I'm thankful for his concern for Dargonus."

2a72bfd9-86ba-418d-a395-cc732889e825.Text: "I serve the von Valancius protectorate, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

e316622b-a7bd-4332-a5a2-52ec86d921eb.Text: "To put it simply, I am your trade representative. Any and all decrees, deals, official communication, and meetings are first reviewed by me and then forwarded to you and from you down the hierarchy."

89391e79-9f92-4e76-a357-59e1dde78181.Text: "All deals and important decisions are made here in the capital. Many years ago, an ancestor of Lady Theodora signed an agreement with the Adeptus Administratum which allowed for efficient management of the world and the neighbouring systems. In accordance with the decree, a share of the planet's population was assigned to the Administratum and converted into servitor scribes. They now toil across the entire world."

bf684ce0-8704-4b69-866b-ae046d0d2bc4.Text: "Unfortunately, not at this time, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. After the few representatives of the Adeptus Astra Telepathica on Dargonus went into a frenzy, some of the psykers were tragically pacified by the respective authorities. Since then, communication with the neighbouring systems has been unreliable at best. Thanks be to the Master of Mankind that you managed to find your way to the capital!"

beafb465-7afa-49e1-80b5-d80a6afa1ddc.Text: {n}Clementia is different from most nobles — not just in the way she's dressed, but in her bearing too. Although, judging by the scars visible on her skin, at least some part of her education took place on a battlefield, rather than within the secure confines of a lyceum.{/n}

eb12e382-5986-42d1-9048-7e1642ca89cb.Text: "Apart from the disrupted communications, Dargonus was recently raided by enemies of Humanity. However, the fleet, under the command of Captain Marthius Werserian, triumphed over the accursed xenos. If you ask for my opinion on this matter — we have the situation completely under control."

10df412e-a414-4083-bdcc-65609a4be3b4.Text: "Is that truly all that concerns you, peddler of xenoheresy?" {n}Clementia's words cut Jae off like the swing of a sabre. Then Clementia turns to you, her head lowered in shame.{/n}

de7c01a4-d57d-4112-b971-71f86eb6c895.Text: "Urbend Drivestem is a well-respected man — and not just on Dargonus but throughout the protectorate. For many centuries, his house has supported the capital's administration and the logistics between the von Valancius systems. The Drivestems' efforts secured years of order and prosperity for Dargonus. What's more, Lady Theodora personally insisted that Lord Urbend specifically be made the next governor."

e5099f0c-edc2-44a0-b721-81a776eb7dc6.Text: "They lost your seal, shereen. They lost it and tried to hide the fact from both me and you."

ce36e062-02c4-4572-9328-0a6d64fc076f.Text: {n}Clementia bows before leaving.{/n} "I shall arrange for him to be escorted to your study."

e3f64a2d-56cc-4c97-9b55-bca73bbfd422.Text: "Certainly, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. However..." {n}Her thin lips twist slightly.{/n} "I do not concern myself with the governor's feelings, but I must warn you — your action or inaction may be interpreted in a certain way. Now, if Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} will excuse me."

89d20585-4815-4422-854d-eb2db3b70155.Text: "My purview also includes overseeing Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}'s property — the palace, the estates, the many gardens, and other demesnes on Dargonus that you have inherited from Lady Theodora. And whenever you are present on Dargonus, consider me your personal secretary."

aad41a8e-3d1c-45ea-8466-179fe0098ed8.Text: "I am at your service at any time, day or night, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

731f6d9d-5102-4feb-bf8d-5f22b8430cfb.Text: {n}You catch her avoiding your gaze for just a moment — for the first time. It's obvious that Clementia is looking out for her house's good name. But despite the confidence in her tone, you can tell that she does not entirely believe her own words.{/n}

998925db-d042-44be-b5bc-1d9048b169e8.Text: {n}Clementia raises her head proudly — she is obviously pleased with her house's accomplishments.{/n}

08798628-ae9f-49fa-a930-d867b98c1cc3.Text: "Understood, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}." {n}Clementia promptly makes a note on her data-slate.{/n} "Would you like to hold this meeting shortly?"

1ad51bad-9d38-4854-ac16-aaafcbdfdfae.Text: "Over the many centuries, an intricate hierarchy has formed within the ruling elite of Dargonus. The great houses do more than plunder your treasury — it is replenished, to a large degree, thanks to their administrative work and their lands. Naturally, you can get rid of anyone whom you consider surplus to requirements, but right now, it could threaten the fragile stability that is currently holding the protectorate together."

31b9b621-476b-4e35-9e77-8484ab70e358.Text: {n}Clementia immediately focuses on the data-slate in her hands.{/n} "Allow me to report — the esteemed Navigators of House Orsellio have taken residence in the guest estate and await a meeting with you. How would you like to receive them?"

fbbe20cf-312c-45be-9622-8698bc0809ac.Text: "Then I'll have messengers sent to retrieve the esteemed guests."

4e8cb8be-6cde-4ef2-b7e2-efba42b1207d.Text: "Members of the Navis Nobilite have little patience for long waits, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. But I'll think of something."

21ec54be-dc84-4668-baea-4a92bca4c241.Text: "I am afraid that my words may anger Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}." {n}Clementia lowers her head in shame as if offering it up to be removed from her shoulders.{/n} "The seal you are looking for was lost over a quarter of a century ago. Her Ladyship Theodora von Valancius ordered a new one to be delivered from the Imperium, but... as you well know, we are a long way away from Holy Terra. And with warp storms ravaging the Koronus Expanse, we have been unable to receive a replacement to this day."

afe982c1-f79d-4534-a6ee-085211da8d59.Text: "However..." {n}She refers to her data-slate.{/n} "One of the worlds under Calligos Winterscale's rule, like Dargonus, was granted the honour of keeping the sacred sigils of the Administratum. The archives of House von Valancius mention three systems that are presently under the control of House Winterscale. Those would be the Forgotten Twins, Langrenn's Belt, and the Nameless Star. I am confident that the Administratum Palace is located on one of the planets there."

67af05c7-c10a-45a5-b8e7-1a2fc7a226b5.Text: "The loss of the seal is certainly a great tragedy, but... self-flagellation?" {n}Jae clicks her tongue disapprovingly.{/n} "Admit it, Chancellor, you simply enjoy wallowing in pain while praising the Emperor's name. What the Exalted One requires of His servants is pure faith, not hollow torment! What possible use could He have for our tears? Those are just the ravings of the Ecclesiarchy, and you just walk whatever road you are being herded along, as blind as an obedient sheep."

86679092-80b3-4286-92b4-32e47bc9dd51.Text: "We have a better chance of finding the seal in the pocket of some rich collector or fence than on a remote world owned by one of your rivals, shereen. I suggest we make contact with any traders we may encounter in our travels — people in my line of work tend to have a good eye for such things. There is every possibility that someone has waited their whole life to fleece... er, to return the great relic to its rightful owner."

e9791705-8c42-4e56-be5f-5807b1bebc9c.Text: "Rest assured, Theodora von Valancius ordered to have the malefactor dealt with accordingly. Servitude Imperpituis, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. He now performs his duties to the Imperium without reservation or error."

254f36e4-b3a3-46ed-94c2-1c139ffbf0b0.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}?" {n}Clementia looks away from her data-slate.{/n} "I hope your stay on Dargonus will be beneficial to your physical and mental state. I understand that the heir to a protectorate must have {mf|his|her} hands full, but one shouldn't forget about rest."

da3777e6-ed6a-4ed3-994d-cae5f436e95d.Text: "Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship, I have been told that you summoned the Erebis family to your court. Your subjects in question, along with their four offspring, have already arrived at the palace. They will attend the reception honouring your return to the capital world."

fa5d2aaa-cc0c-42bf-b722-a712204371b2.Text: "Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship, I have been told that you summoned the Erebis family to your court. Your subjects in question, along with their four offspring, have already arrived at the palace. They will attend the reception honouring your return to the capital world."

7ed37bd5-e49f-4a01-b08c-31e18584dad5.Text: "Of course, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. How else may I be of service?"

a2946124-b532-49a9-a59f-56722786b60e.Text: "Of course, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. How else may I be of service?"

a7759011-2663-4659-8729-58de1dfdbe7f.Text: "Could it be that you've found the lost seal, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}? Or have you, perhaps, brought a copy from a distant Winterscale world?"

9b10de2a-4d45-4dd3-88f8-cf27e5e14ffa.Text: "Again?" {n}Clementia's surprise gives way to embarrassment, and, with an understanding look, she places the stamp you require.{/n} "As you requested, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. A fresh certification for the Master of Seals."

bd086cef-e0ae-45b0-8460-43b2e51482d2.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! I apologise for this ugly scene, but might I ask that you rein in Mistress Heydari and put a stop to her... inflammatory actions toward me?"

435b1828-c89b-4091-9f06-049b37b107be.Text: "As the Exalted One is my witness, shereen, I've tried everything I could to spare you any unnecessary headache over the seals for the Mercatum Tabula Officiale! I even showed this aide with a temper worse than a sandstorm the certificate with your signature. But your chancellor merely kept batting me away with her flail of baseless denials! I suspect that the reason for this has nothing to do with my humble personage."

996ba47a-a385-4a93-87f6-a43bec478a58.Text: {n}Clementia purses her lips and glowers at Jae.{/n}

cf448a76-b2cb-47e3-84f9-1aa00140134e.Text: "Dargonus is also the seat of several noble families who run all the major planets in the protectorate. If I may express my not-so-humble opinion, they care very little about who exactly stands at the helm. Those piranhas think about their own profits just as much as they do about the prosperity of the protectorate itself, if not more."

decbe441-284f-405c-888a-a2fa739dfce7.Text: "Oh no, this isn't about me at all." {n}Jae narrows her eyes as she peers into Clementia's face until the latter finally looks away.{/n} "I see. Well, Chancellor? Will you tell us yourself, or should I help you?"

1bdc614b-ce52-4b9e-bf0c-2a46d0744397.Text: "Ah, but, shereen! What about the Mercatum Tabula Offici—"

c74a3eb3-b5ce-424e-a29a-d6daf30a5318.Text: "I beg your forgiveness, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I should have reported this earlier, but there was never a good time. The seal Mistress Heydari is looking for was lost over a quarter of a century ago. Her Ladyship Theodora von Valancius ordered a new one to be delivered from the Imperium, but... as you well know, we are a long way away from Holy Terra. And with warp storms ravaging the Koronus Expanse, we have been unable to receive a replacement to this day."

6daf8d47-d4c2-4987-a430-cf1e1870e747.Text: "Hold your tongue, peddler of xenoheresy, and speak not of things you know nothing about!" {n}Clementia's words cut Jae off like the swing of a sabre. Then Clementia turns to you, her head lowered in shame.{/n}

4c5a33e5-c2b9-468b-9774-1920d4719efc.Text: "Oh, by all means, shereen! I dare not waste any more of the precious balm that is your time on matters related to me. If I may excuse myself."

159f7e22-052b-4561-9c56-4d912f69cc27.Text: "Unquestionably, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}." {n}Clementia accepts your words with ice-cold calmness.{/n} "At day's end, I will submit myself to self-flagellation at the Werserian family chapel. A hundred lashes — and if that won't be sufficient, I will add five dozen more."

8381fe85-1377-4ecd-b2ac-883529a76573.Text: "I do not fear pain, for it offers redemption. It would benefit you to learn this lesson one day, Mistress Heydari."

40c5ee5f-99cf-4e53-93ce-dbd152c79c9d.Text: "I'm afraid I have to refuse, thank you."

f7d00b65-321f-42da-be99-285a0baa47ed.Text: "And lastly, Dargonus has its own fleet — a luxury unavailable to the vast majority of other worlds in your realm. In addition to warships, the protectorate also employs privateer ships which are used to transport cargo between worlds."

2f29e204-6170-4083-8bee-973173a202ce.Text: "I shall humbly await the day when Dargonus has its seal once again."

909d3822-3bcb-4319-9382-5741181ea50e.Text: "Why, none at all, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Secretary Scalander is an outstanding individual and a loyal servant of the von Valancius dynasty. In Lady Theodora's absence, we collaborated on a number of issues related to the well-being of your domain, and he has proven himself quite capable. And, I don't know why, but even the governor trembles before Achilleas. Which is... unusual for a man of his, shall we say, standing." {n}The last word brings a slight smile to her lips.{/n}

ab43025a-2f7e-4546-8124-2be524bf6b4e.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, Governor Drivestem is waiting in the audience hall. I advise you to respond to his lateness in kind — that way you can let Urbend know that his behaviour has not gone unremarked. But I would not delay too long — right now, the court is closely observing your every step."

58b172fc-980d-436d-8720-e0828ec0d534.Text: {n}The sharp gaze, the impeccably straight back, the composure — for a moment, you feel like you're looking at a younger version of Abelard himself, not his heir. Judging by the scars on the exposed parts of her body, Clementia saw her fair share of combat prior to assuming the position of chancellor.{/n}

51739e2f-e5b4-44db-9bcd-4385aa39518a.Text: [Give Clementia the seal with the Winterscale coat of arms] "Could this be the seal in question?"

7fbcef61-7d26-4876-9d81-181660df6f62.Text: "This is, without a doubt, the Administratum seal from Winterscale's Realm. But why is it the original and not a copy? Ah, I think I understand. Well, the laws of the Imperium do not prohibit heirs of other houses from using the seal in times of need. I will order to have servants of the Machine Cult create a duplicate so as to avoid such embarrassing predicaments in the future."

ee93c769-4c91-459f-8d54-00c7431bb3cc.Text: [Give Clementia the seal with scratches instead of a coat of arms on the handle] "I procured this seal from a travelling merchant."

b56df915-844e-4cab-8094-425282ea6e03.Text: "It's... By the Golden Throne, it's the lost seal! What it must have gone through in the quarter of a century before it ended up in the hands of— but no matter. I will arrange to have it restored right after I certify your document."

714db82e-6e71-4117-9517-70da312e7eba.Text: "Praise be to the Golden Throne and the God-Emperor, you're alive!"

dc1e4012-51aa-41e0-ae80-2063042a1e31.Text: "By the yawn of the darkest abyss, Achilleas, why did my expert on xenos fail to prevent the Drukhari assault?"

e47d74e6-170c-4a94-95de-a85d03bd54ae.Text: "Were you able to glean anything from your attackers?"

7f42ffa6-0aa1-4073-b865-a5a1327e2d39.Text: "That's enough talking, Achilleas. I will contact Clementia and have her summon a medicae. Get out of the palace while you can!"

67155be8-2755-4828-9ccc-7523cb9f42d0.Text: [Strike him] "You have failed me and all of Dargonus!"

8a6b245d-1077-4d36-a71e-f8bc34d4f29f.Text: {n}Covered in Drukhari blood and his own, Achilleas Scalander looks around with a haunted expression on his face. He finally manages to focus his gaze on you and lets out a barely audible gasp.{/n} "God-Emperor preserve me... Could it be... Is it truly you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}?" {n}He is struck by an excruciating coughing fit, his hand grasping for his respirator on its golden chain, but it is missing.{/n}

db8ff3e4-5d9f-4c58-81ce-78375d118543.Text: {n}Heinrix {d|Encyclopedia:CompHeinrix_Rough}impassively observes{/d} Achilleas's torment. Then his lip curls as he shakes his head.{/n} "Poor show, Scalander. How could you fail to notice the impending danger? Perhaps I was wrong to have had such high hopes for you?"

9cf80a3d-c34e-45a5-93ec-5c067864b0e9.Text: "When the report came from orbit about the xenos attack, I was in the Administratum halls, resolving the matter of your succession. I rushed to my shuttle and prayed to the God-Emperor that I would reach the palace before they struck. But before I could get rid of all the picts and documents I had gathered, the palace was besieged. I had to take a risk and... burn it all. The xenos surrounded me when I was setting fire to the last remaining orders. And they decided to... have fun with me."

9852cb38-392b-4835-8c00-ae3eb7a20a3f.Text: {n}The Interrogator examines the room, the evidence of a struggle, and Achilleas himself.{/n} "You {d|Encyclopedia:CompHeinrix_Humane}did well{/d}. You held your own. I'm glad we made it in time."

b23cca09-6333-45e4-a1bd-e10308b81895.Text: {n}His burnt lips twist into a bitter smile.{/n} "Oddly enough... I was, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. The Drukhari had no idea that a mere Adeptus Administratum secretary could understand their alien speech. While they were deliberating over how they were going to kill me, they mentioned that other 'mon-keigh' had been helping them all this time. Renegades, or pirates, or... something of the sort. It will take time to identify these traitors to Humanity, but I give you my word that they will pay for what happened on Dargonus!"

edb4cbcd-5948-44cb-b838-56ea0bf37610.Text: {n}Achilleas looks you in the eye, his gaze unexpectedly clear.{/n} "Nothing. But... they didn't ask me anything. They didn't look for anything. They didn't so much as poke around the place... Strange."

c93a9b2d-41c8-4da9-8065-d1d8143ec215.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I've been praying to the Immortal One for your swift return! The people of Dargonus fought to the last, but the onslaught of the enemies of Humanity... was vicious and brutal."

ad739017-fc10-4fe2-b6d8-0b2e6d512eaa.Text: "I... I focused all my attention on investigating the attacks across your protectorate.
