I suspected that there was something bigger behind the xenos attacks, but... an assault on the Rogue Trader's capital? Foolhardy, even for Drukhari. I'd never have thought..." {n}He closes his eyes, grimacing with guilt.{/n}

1d908520-1e88-4666-9d8d-2c5dcd5d2142.Text: "It is the Drukhari's favourite pastime to torture people for amusement. I doubt they had any inkling you were an agent of the Inquisition."

6469c431-a7e6-40a7-b980-4fef895e594c.Text: "Why?" {n}Achilleas lets out a slight chuckle.{/n} "Such is the nature of the enemies of Humanity, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. They have a taste... for our pain."

40d2018b-0527-4b95-80c0-5f8225d65226.Text: {n}Achilleas's body is covered in an unthinkable number of cuts and injuries — the Drukhari put great effort into filling his every moment with searing pain. However, none of his wounds are life-threatening.{/n}

1251cf1e-cb1d-47f6-8a6f-03373b9a845a.Text: {n}It's difficult to assess how badly Achilleas is wounded. He can still stand, but his body is covered in hundreds of cuts and injuries. It would be best if he were transported to a medicae facility, into the care of healers, as soon as possible.{/n}

8ccbbff9-31b6-4bab-a49b-826dcfc759e0.Text: {n}Achilleas glances at Heinrix, his expression pained.{/n} "I..." {n}He coughs weakly.{/n} "I've failed you, Master van Calox."

a89debfc-c718-455d-8c5c-90822c06ea70.Text: {n}Achilleas frowns, presses his burnt lips together, and drops his gaze.{/n} "And yet... And yet I still failed you."

61de6b79-c551-4f5b-9d76-449b77988a36.Text: {n}As you hastily close one wound, another starts bleeding. Alas, you couldn't offer Achilleas any substantial assistance in such a short time.{/n} "There's no need, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I have enough strength to walk to the infirmary."

937485e7-b4c9-4360-a66b-48dfda5510b0.Text: "You are too kind to me, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. We have more important matters to consider than a few broken ribs. Please do not trouble yourself about it."

00f2660c-03d1-4191-95d0-f3db49f07d58.Text: {n}Achilleas doesn't try to dodge or cover his face. His split lip swells immediately, and a thin rivulet of blood runs down his chin and disappears inside his collar.{/n} "And I will give my life to atone for my faults."

8c5bbaae-fe3a-4d18-b37e-193975bde852.Text: "And therein lies the reason for your failure, burnt mon-keigh. Your mind was narrow, as the minds of your kind are wont to be."

ddbcb9c0-f7b8-45a4-b766-a8545f031842.Text: {n}Achilleas shoots Yrliet a hateful look and mutters through his teeth,{/n} "I... am... aware..."

809710cb-befd-4fce-819c-06268ccd420e.Text: "When you're up against Drukhari ashmags, you plan for the absolute worst scenario. But before you do, you multiply that abysmally bad scenario by ten... or better yet, by thirty."

62de0845-138b-4b27-8375-cc001d83d7e9.Text: {n}You notice a brief flash of sympathy in Yrliet's eyes.{/n} "There is no wisdom in blaming yourself — a mon-keigh's intellect is weak and can never fathom the depths of my dark kin's treachery and twistedness of thought. Had there been another mon-keigh in your place, the paths of fate would have remained unchanged."

cf605d6e-0ee4-41aa-a10d-c68833f41614.Text: {n}Cassia reaches a hand out to Achilleas's shoulder and gingerly removes something unseen from it.{/n} "Your hues... are covered in a layer of soot and ash, Master Scalander. I can see the loud, bleeding colours underneath. May I... put them at ease for you?"

0a15d035-68af-485a-adf4-3c5a6beea3ec.Text: "Or it is that you do not remember anything, mon-keigh. And it was their intent that you did not."

6a7a03e8-86fa-4856-bed5-a7c90cb17f57.Text: {n}Achilleas bows his head guiltily.{/n} "It is a great honour to hear such words from Lady Orsellio herself, and still... I must refuse. My scars, both physical and spiritual, are my reminder of the mistake I made. And my key to—" {n}A coughing fit interrupts his words.{/n} "...redemption."

e952954d-e045-49c0-ae15-f36baf018be6.Text: "His wounds are shallow — the foe did not want to cut his thread. And yet each wound has touched a nerve, to plunge the victim into a pit of agony. Every cut is a message — not to us, but to the one whose body has become a sheet of parchment." {n}Kibellah's lip curls in disgust.{/n} "A message of unclean words."

12f888df-4f09-42f8-b3a9-27f81e5bee46.Text: "Hah, so that's what distracted the xenos... your appearance at the palace. I was only able to break free from their clutches because the void-damned Drukhari suddenly dropped what they were doing and ran off." {n}Achilleas's amber eyes glitter viciously as he nods at the corpses at his feet.{/n} "It was a mistake on their part to turn their backs to me."

d9b1f3ff-d002-4cb4-b606-b6d75fdd9ea7.Text: {n}Achilleas closes his eyes shut.{/n} "Holy Emperor, deliver me from the memories!"

ea0d53e9-9289-4fea-be62-1c76d628f42c.Text: {n}His burnt lips twist into a bitter smile.{/n} "Funnily enough... I was, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. The Drukhari had no idea that a mere Adeptus Administratum secretary could understand their alien speech. Over the course of my torture, I came to understand that the xenos had been receiving help from humans all this time. Renegades, or pirates, or... something of the sort. It will take time to identify these traitors to Humanity, but I give you my word that they will pay for what happened on Dargonus!"

60546095-2b96-4b9f-9ea5-b264bbf70218.Text: {n}You feel a gust of cold that brings shivers to your skin. A moment passes, and Achilleas takes another breath — this one much deeper and steadier. The smaller cuts close almost completely, but the deeper wounds continue to bleed.{/n}

3d4be585-08f7-4b63-8ca1-65b3de08bdb2.Text: {n}Gritting his teeth, Achilleas bows and withdraws to the gatehouse in front of the palace.{/n}

c242285b-82c4-4c8f-bec1-db59781778db.Text: "I thought I was done for. Thank the Emperor you arrived when you did." {n}Achilleas gives you a strange look, as if still not fully believing his luck.{/n}

ce265cf4-8766-44d7-97b9-c63aead80126.Text: "I... You shouldn't have, Master van Calox. Your powers are wasted on me."

ef0e2f7e-d38a-4ba5-b839-4ba4f278ae97.Text: {n}Your fast efforts pay off: your knowledge of medicae allows you to stop the bleeding in several areas and somewhat ease his pain.{/n} "You... shouldn't have wasted your time on me, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

f2b8653a-a86e-4763-a0a4-d5e9cb5e56da.Text: "Get back, xenos! You won't take me alive!"

33f65257-2051-41eb-aa84-070ada974682.Text: "Ksher-mon'ne, mon-keigh. You're still good to me half-dead."

ae672e99-33ee-4cba-ab2d-d081359fc450.Text: "Do not worry about me, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Dargonus above all else."

11fa8cbc-286a-4085-af02-12ad1993f25b.Text: "Senior Secretary, sir, please don't move. Allow the wounds to close at least a little."

84913ca3-8144-4179-a256-df3da6513472.Text: "The Drukhari are after living victims above all else — why would they waste their forces assaulting the palace when they could be storming another city?"

630fa234-d6fe-40f0-b8ee-4bb533488ae3.Text: "I need details. What has transpired on the planet?"

6d243c99-cd68-48c6-acd9-1221933061f3.Text: "When all of this passes, expect mass executions among the planet's defenders. All of you have failed those you swore to protect!"

33a80f46-eb76-42df-b68a-94a7b1f1f1da.Text: "You did all you could. Xenos are dangerous opponents."

53034ce3-f06e-4b24-b569-4addd1d5cb68.Text: "I vow to make the xenos pay dearly for every human life they've claimed!"

d1285c81-420c-43a7-971e-52c3679bd44d.Text: "I don't see a single Arbitrator. Have they decided to cower behind the walls of their headquarters?"

ccdfb63c-cf05-48b2-91cc-8eff111a9db9.Text: "Begin a detailed assessment of the damage as soon as we're done here."

c20ece3b-6593-42e6-9d11-f94f4ee87b89.Text: "This is an outrage! Xenos have pillaged my palace? My precious residence?"

5e45993d-5f2d-4fe2-992b-ee230cc1089b.Text: {n}Clementia looks haggard, with deep shadows under her eyes and her hands trembling slightly. She is staring at you with a mixture of amazement and bitterness.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}... is it really you? We'd {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_DargonusLate}lost all hope{/d} of seeing you again!"

893f6378-4b0a-42a0-b811-24e8a470bab3.Text: {n}Clementia is looking a little dishevelled, but her appearance otherwise remains unchanged — her steely gaze and tightly pressed lips speak of perfect composure.{/n} "Praise the Throne, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_DargonusEarly}you're here{/d}! Your subjects need you now more than ever!"

1fb58654-25fc-4fe9-ba59-90a6d46971c0.Text: "All guilty parties will receive severe punishment, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, but until then, we must rely on the surviving defenders — please, let us postpone the trials and executions until the situation has stabilised!"

db27a10d-a912-4ebb-8147-2c8aa8b420c9.Text: "The attack began a few hours before dawn over the capital. They first attacked the fleet — we received boarding calls right before we lost communication with the crews. Their sacrifice wasn't for naught — the ground troops had the time to start mobilising, and the civilians went on to organise the defences."

4cece433-26d9-44bd-93c7-bd8947c02bd1.Text: "The PDF is in the process of {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_DargonusEarly}exterminating{/d} the enemy forces on the planet. Extra batteries have been assigned to the assault on the palace, but without a strike force that could make it inside, we won't break their resistance."

d02e3fee-77b0-43ce-8d08-99f942e9f5e5.Text: {n}Clementia closes her eyes for a second, giving in to the overwhelming exhaustion.{/n} "The PDF is on its last legs, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. We've been waging a war of attrition for {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_DargonusLate}too long{/d}, without any chance of support from outside. I pray to the Emperor that your arrival will change the tide of this operation."

1baf7067-8a63-4494-9bc2-57417cfdee41.Text: {n}Clementia bows.{/n} "With awe and gratitude, I transfer the command of the ground operation over to you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. The local troops are at your service. I beg of you — save Dargonus!"

29314ce1-7284-412f-9a37-b9c63c8f46a6.Text: "Several hive cities managed to hold their perimeters, others sustained greater losses... and two cities were completely devastated. Our intelligence still knows nothing about the fates of millions of people. There is a high likelihood that we've lost them forever."

5d13a34d-64f8-477c-a7a6-37ba8054b827.Text: "The secretary's exact whereabouts are unknown. But, under normal circumstances, he hardly ever set foot outside the palace grounds... I'm sure you realise what this could mean."

5d915897-336b-411d-a464-338f8197973b.Text: "I'm afraid so, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. The attack on the palace began later than the rest, once the reserve forces had been transferred to other regions. Which is... particularly odd..." {n}Clementia falters.{/n} "They weren't tempted by an entire city, at the apex of which your residence stands. No, the wedge of the enemy forces targeted the palace specifically."

184eb7a3-8c68-4ea6-99d0-6f191f26c617.Text: "We've cut off the periphery forces from those that made it inside the palace, and we continue to storm the building. We've killed so many of those beasts, but the xenos are repelling our assault with ferocity — it's as if they're waiting for the right moment. Or perhaps they haven't yet completed whatever goal they're pursuing inside the palace."

4116e0ad-88aa-46de-b795-f211d6c2b435.Text: "I pray to the God-Emperor that the Adeptus Arbites will repel the enemy and have time to aid the other parts of the hive."

89956f51-2d3c-4945-84de-9eb8f5132c8d.Text: "I have a feeling that the palace is the anchor point of the enemy's raid. Our vox engineers are registering unknown signals coming from your residence to other areas on the planet — the scum must have set up a control centre inside. We take out their command — and we'll weaken their peripheral forces."

1f647129-9d0e-4b4e-a710-4a2dfc393d93.Text: "Lady Werserian, where is Achilleas Scalander? I thought I'd see him here, by your side."

42081e15-cc12-4ba7-82a4-4dad1fa767a0.Text: "Dargonus has been hit by a mass xenos attack. The fleet's resistance was broken in mere hours, then the invaders commenced a planetary raid. The planetary defence forces were able to hold the inner perimeters of several cities, two of the attacks were stifled on the approaches to settlements, but the fights continue — here as well, in the von Valancius palace."

df069c96-7205-4b4e-a751-38dac256fc7d.Text: "Alas, I don't know the answer, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. When the xenos attacked the palace, they sent a force so great that the increased warden presence and the defence perimeter were wiped out in minutes. By the Throne, whatever they're looking for in there, they've spared no troops to get their hands on it!"

5dd2e4b5-5102-4420-98af-f8af4dc10313.Text: "The governor is currently protected within a well-fortified bunker... as are the heads of the other noble houses." {n}Clementia grinds her teeth audibly.{/n} "Still, each family has provided all available resources to the defence of Dargonus — or rather, the defence of their respective regions."

fed982a9-df47-4a1d-8f3f-45340c6706c1.Text: "Not at all, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. There are approximately one hundred Arbites in the capital right now, and they are all defending the Administratum. Thanks to their bravery and fighting prowess, it is one of the few places in the hive that the xenos have failed to overrun."

f3daba3f-9851-46ed-aa3d-1bae31d1849c.Text: "Thank you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, but once the battles have concluded, I would still like to launch a large-scale inspection in the Defence Forces. Our losses are too great — I want to make sure that this is all due to our accursed enemy's superior numbers, not traitors in our midst!"

d788ce9f-0c75-4859-bdf7-392e4ab3b8ee.Text: "Oh, what I wouldn't give to join the punitive expedition, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, but my duty is to the welfare of this planet, not military operations." {n}Clementia's voice grows sterner, and she practically spits out,{/n} "This is my plea to you, Rogue Trader — make them rue the day that they decided to assault Dargonus!"

c6394262-322d-4f7b-98a8-be41e90d978e.Text: "Indubitably — as soon as the situation on the planet stabilises. In addition to our own territories, serious damage was done to the Adeptus Administratum department stationed on Dargonus — I hope this won't lead to any kind of accusations against House von Valancius..."

c8cb1436-f93a-440b-967d-cd4109b7d947.Text: "I received a message on the Arbitrators' vox-frequency — they are successfully defending the spire entrusted to them. Even if all Dargonus falls, that place will hold."

71a0f514-6c3c-42af-b408-e3c0eeacbaf5.Text: "I am not hearing enough awe and servility in your voice, Clementia. Is this how you show your gratitude to your saviour? Try one more time."

51983dbd-ef77-4d44-accb-8fe8c80cd9ca.Text: "I was doing my duty, nothing more."

2adba205-745b-400f-80da-0f22fa888d13.Text: "After such a debacle in our defences, Clementia, you and the other mediocrities who supposedly look after my capital world can expect a thorough purge in the near future."

865a4d16-b6dc-44c9-8a77-c74b88089460.Text: "Stop wasting time talking and attend to your duties. There is still much work to be done."

a8fa5919-3a92-45e8-8b9a-c7a875bb790d.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}... Thanks to your breakthrough, we were able to clear out the estate. Right now, with the aid of your ship's augurs from orbit, the surface troops are sweeping the streets of the hive. Squads have been sent deeper into the city, several units have been assigned... my apologies, of course you will learn of all this from the reports."

47a5481d-d18c-42b8-b2ec-26c8d2170620.Text: "We have transported Secretary Scalander to the medicarium. His recovery will take time, but the healers' prognosis is optimistic."

e78411a0-d0a1-4234-80e1-4a602cd44446.Text: "Your appearance on Dargonus is a boon from the God-Emperor, who has brought us salvation. On behalf of all of Dargonus and House Werserian, I thank you for delivering us from our foes."

ff7ed04d-a78d-4a9f-9b6e-a19ed90e2fc7.Text: {n}Clementia clears her throat, momentarily at a loss.{/n} "I... please forgive the brevity and clumsiness of my words, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}... It's just, the situation... and the circumstances..." {n}She recomposes herself and begins firmly and steadily,{/n} "O great Rogue Trader, the God-Emperor's anointed, bearer of the sacred Warrant, deliverer of His will! On this day, solely by your will, we, dirt-dwelling worms, have been left our lives, though their worth is less than a single beat of your heart!"

4308d1b6-7082-47b1-b231-19cd8a6c9efd.Text: "I will see to it that everyone responsible is informed of your wishes." {n}If Clementia is frightened, she does nothing to reveal it.{/n}

cc18fdd9-1107-4731-8631-2760b85a245e.Text: "We offer our lowly thanks for the grace bestowed upon us by your mercifulness. May the von Valancius name be praised through the ages! May all worlds to the ends of the galaxy know of your virtues! May His grace be with you till the end of time! All hail the Rogue Trader, saviour of Dargonus!" {n}Clementia catches her breath, then adds in a lowered voice,{/n} "With your highest consent, there is one more thing..."

d98c52e6-9f1a-4fba-a265-444ece9ebec1.Text: "We will continue the clean-up of the estate and the neighbouring territories — we must deal with the rubble, the corpses, and any other aftereffects of the fighting. The surviving forces will be enough to repel any sporadic enemy attacks if any are launched — according to the latest reports, the xenos are pulling out en masse. If other matters require your attention, I won't detain you any longer — please allow us to ensure that Dargonus is returned to its former glory."

f9433f4f-c612-4dd6-a67c-cc469368ab8f.Text: "And by your will, you have preserved countless lives, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Dargonus owes you a debt that can never be repaid."

593d39e8-9075-431c-9c9f-20e52af5cfa2.Text: "Indeed, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! But from now on, the bulk of the worries will be shouldered by your subjects."

8581134d-11f5-453d-9fbb-48a87c3e4644.Text: "Mistress Toliman has sent a message requesting an audience. She has a critical report to deliver and she will be waiting for you on the ship's bridge."

70a75006-8a5c-461d-a7da-e1fb4ae5a0cc.Text: {n}Jae winces bitterly.{/n} "I never thought words of praise could make my soul feel as if it were being suffocated. All this bowing and scraping seems wildly over the top."

7912355c-fa92-4c93-8816-6ccde0eaf3b7.Text: "You deceived me when you appointed the place of our final battle!"

0cc42783-00a7-4abe-8633-21a71aaa8230.Text: [Attack] "You will pay for every slain servant of the Imperium!"

76c878c9-ec32-4af1-8a8f-c4aa53196f4d.Text: "One xenos is down. One more remains."

031e5d04-4437-41ec-86a6-f93dc71339e2.Text: "Do you have any idea how much your raid has cost me? One tanned xenos hide won't be enough to pay for the damage!"

5c11594f-766f-40e0-b601-ec4811c85828.Text: "Tazarra was under the impression that we were working together — what nonsense did you put in her head?"

71f8efeb-761f-4e8d-9efc-2d0be7056f92.Text: [Attack] "I've grown tired of you — it is time to die."

97c6d17b-a84b-4242-ab09-fd0d3569d7b0.Text: {n}Marazhai casually gestures with his hand, either welcoming you or inviting you to admire the brutalised hall.{/n} "At last! I was beginning to think that your lumbering bucket had perished on the way back! Such a resolution would have satisfied neither you nor me, would it?"

6bc68ff1-4951-4bb1-abd8-378926eccab6.Text: "You are still with {mf|him|her}, cousin?" {n}Marazhai's voice is dripping with saccharine mockery.{/n} "How fares your search for your lost family? Or is being at a mon-keigh's beck and call occupying all your thoughts and time?"

b2a38c13-44a2-4d6e-a324-dec7d4ff9668.Text: {n}The sight of a xenos lounging on the dynastic throne makes Abelard's face turn crimson.{/n} "What... How did... You will cease defiling a relic of the Imperium with your presence, xenos scum!"

c8da1a97-09f1-4c82-8b2c-7230ec0a6612.Text: "What, this abomination?" {n}The Drukhari taps a finger on the armrest.{/n} "With pleasure. But first, I will finish my conversation with your master, mon-keigh."

e15f6131-6378-40d4-a47b-4c0956cb454d.Text: "You will be silent, Dark One, or I will silence you myself!"

5991c02b-cc45-4bc2-a26a-bc149ac232d0.Text: {n}The Drukhari freezes for a moment.{/n} "Oh, I can feel your anger... your rage... and your pain from witnessing the state of your halls. I trusted that you would appreciate our efforts here. I could have long vanished in the tangles of the Webway without awaiting your arrival, mon-keigh... but I could not refuse myself the small pleasure of savouring your torment at the sight of what I have done to your home."

8c874f78-1c44-4ff6-970f-559a96760e3d.Text: "The sole thing that your kind is good for, mon-keigh, is your ability to suffer. I have long been surfeited with physical pain — your kin provide it in abundance from their cages in Commorragh. The pain of the soul, on the other hand... is a rare delight. After all, I had to recompense you for all the trouble you have caused me."

722352dc-2a39-43fd-9baa-71b235230e41.Text: "However, did I not give you a gracious gift as well? That pesky, meddling Tazarra who harrowed your little worlds for so long... you have garnered her head, and I — a peaceful existence where she is not constantly in my way." {n}He gives you a thin smile.{/n} "To die at the hands of a mon-keigh is the worst possible punishment for a champion of the gladiatorial arenas of Commorragh. Her final moments were torturous."

5d4f9501-9f49-42dd-bf8a-ed980d8cd2d4.Text: "Do not get greedy, mon-keigh — you should be satisfied with the handouts that I so kindly throw you."

ffae5a9d-c4cf-4469-b9d0-6b21e7fa94e3.Text: "Mm? The pompous waste of skin thought that I would associate with mon-keigh? I wish I did not leave her death to you and instead cut out her heart myself. Still, to take note of my interest in your person was quite perceptive — even more so for a brainless arena Wych."

1bc7821f-c569-4546-b73d-a8551d43aec6.Text: "Now that our meeting has taken place, my business here is done. I have spent enough time in {g|Encyclopedia:Realspace}realspace{/g}, and it is time to bid you goodbye."

c080d82a-a0c8-42e4-9c50-81e54b0edffa.Text: "Deceived? Equals can be deceived — but you I merely used. You played the part given to you perfectly — you were exactly where you were supposed to be, and did exactly what you were supposed to do. Everything except die."

44960dd9-6b69-4862-88f3-fd29923e4a84.Text: "Aren't you glad to see me, Tazarra?"

8f55db2f-4ba7-4224-a814-f991f9093d9f.Text: [Attack] "In the name of the Emperor, for the glory of Humanity — die, monster!"

c2333034-cc96-43cd-b702-8325b850c3a9.Text: [Attack] "Me? Working with a xenos? Die for your blasphemy, you beast!"

d0ff1422-86d4-48ae-a48f-d557ba6cbd96.Text: "Tell me what your objective is in the palace — and I might grant you a swift death."

1c409b18-e6c9-4845-b387-00dc6972a40d.Text: "Wait, what cur are you talking about?"

c34b237e-f8a5-482e-91d0-a03aa91faa64.Text: [Attack] "Your little raid has cost me a fortune — I do not forgive such losses! Die!"

62c50843-ed9d-4662-9bc4-a487767fd31b.Text: [Attack] "How does it feel to be used, Tazarra? You have entertained me well — now do me a favour and die."

1595bf5a-7b97-4991-a825-daed3f018bc7.Text: {n}When Tazarra notices you, her face contorts into a mask of rage. The Drukhari's lips stretch into a predatory grin that bears no trace of her former haughtiness — only the promise of pain.{/n} "You! Malformed mon-keigh, putrid vermin! You will pay for every moment that I have spent on this pitiful planet!"

90ef879a-1dec-4392-b3af-6cdc3fce0407.Text: {n}She lets out a battle cry — and charges forward.{/n}

b0071c71-9ee7-4c0f-bc95-b0195e3fc501.Text: "This is it — the true face of the Dark Ones. Her anger at you is so great that she has shed her mask — and revealed the beast beneath!"

a35a0e06-5879-4bed-b557-c01a41b5e544.Text: "Oh, now that you have finally arrived, I am filled with anticipation — the anticipation of skinning you, impaling you on hooks, and making you dance for mine and the Archon's amusement!"

ac2b7cee-57f2-4bbe-badc-2c7af66bd2b6.Text: "I will not stoop to explain myself to a mon-keigh — let alone a worm like you. A swift death? I will teach you the true art of killing — one drop of blood, one moment of insufferable agony at a time!"

1bf0a1e1-02b4-4135-b480-e1eea9b5af42.Text: "Then I will say that I have had enough of others' games. Sisters, praise the Muses!"

35c96e01-4f09-4e1c-9e7d-f4b9e9fe2ad3.Text: "Enough..." {n}Tazarra bares her sharpened fangs.{/n} "I will beat the truth out of your dead bodies — yours and Marazhai's. Sisters, attack!"

ee502922-0dd4-4377-8b5b-0396cf6773e6.Text: "Little Asuryani, the mon-keigh's obedient servant. Try to survive the future, and then the two of us will still have plenty of fun." {n}The Drukhari licks her lips with her forked tongue.{/n}

43491f4f-b3cd-47fe-8160-9cb9f40eaea5.Text: {n}Tazarra's shriek drops to a hiss.{/n} "I suspected that you and that Trueborn cur were working together. He did not make me and my sisters linger here on a whim — he had a reason, and that reason involves you. Yes? Is that it? Tell me... just nod, so I can stand before the Archon and accuse him of treachery and compromising the raid!"

c5cd33c2-164d-475c-9b3c-2887ef77e61b.Text: {n}The horrible scars the cyber-eagle's talons left on her face are a vivid reminder of your previous encounter. The scarlet glint of her battered eye fixes upon you in anticipation of revenge.{/n}

2c1b3bf2-03b6-46a5-8bf7-58101060c445.Text: "Squabbles between false allies is the favourite sport of the Drukhari. After torture, that is." {n}Heinrix sounds pleased — he is clearly enjoying the sight of the xenos's rage.{/n}

cf482b7e-9af9-4d66-a76b-9a22f8dcf2e5.Text: "What did you wish to speak with me about?"

bcc0340a-2810-4c62-9337-e9a7b1c80054.Text: [Draw your weapon] "I appreciate the warning, Idira."

f39f6883-4181-4c46-95b4-33b17d56768e.Text: "My business with the Liege is my own. It is no concern of House Chorda."

d4408188-cc24-41b5-a04e-02034b19e0bb.Text: "So you seek to rob the station blind — a station that is facing famine — and you're proposing that I join your little feast of vultures?"

4325a5c0-e299-4cd9-acf6-b04d129fb533.Text: "Would you mind elaborating on the terms of your proposal?"

74acf57f-1c13-41ec-b9bb-cabb8b5c6369.Text: "I don't have time to stop and chat."

cb4ac42e-9bdc-459e-b390-a8f807c3364d.Text: [Hide the truth] "Quite right, I am Lady Theodora's envoy."

04b8730c-fb76-43bb-974e-c65530700524.Text: [Reveal the truth] "Theodora von Valancius was killed by heretics. You are speaking to her heir."

50f7e727-b5c7-4598-9d7a-84795bea518c.Text: {n}A well-groomed young man calls out to you. He is clean-shaven and dressed in clothes that are expensive but unshowy, with a bright Aquila embroidered in a prominent spot.{/n}

d4348915-96b3-4f10-84d8-d78e71a5d3d7.Text: "{d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_FootfallOfficial}Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}{/d}, I humbly ask for a minute of your time! I am Bastian in Derama Bastaal-Chorda, youngest cousin of House Chorda, envoy of Incendia Bastaal-Chorda, {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} of the Koronus Expanse by the grace of the most holy {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g}."

8c3bde63-6646-4397-bfef-2b8cfed46c76.Text: "Noble {mf|sir|lady}, a minute of your time, if you please! I am Bastian in Derama Bastaal-Chorda, youngest cousin of House Chorda, envoy of Incendia Bastaal-Chorda, {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} of the Koronus Expanse by the grace of the most holy {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g}. And you must be an {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_FootfallIncognito}envoy{/d} of Theodora von Valancius? I noticed that you arrived on the esteemed lady's ship."

3521856f-f064-4cb5-b1e2-c3a9e6144131.Text: "Splendid. It's a pleasure to be speaking with an equal — truth be told, I get a little flustered in the presence of the powers that be..." {n}Bastian smiles meekly.{/n}

a5e25542-77cd-4b9c-a3d4-9d1d4bb8a0c9.Text: {n}Bastian's eyes go wide for a moment as he processes the new information.{/n} "What a tragedy! What a terrible loss... Please accept my condolences, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! May the Emperor's light be with the righteously departed, may their brilliance never dim in the memory of their descendants... And please likewise accept my congratulations on attaining the status of Rogue Trader, albeit as a consequence of such a tragic event."

9e8a37fe-e171-4877-8260-38f514c6c24d.Text: "The Emperor's most loyal servants should be more concerned with carrying His will through the stars and less with divvying up profit among themselves," {n}Argenta says disapprovingly, but quietly enough so as not to interrupt the negotiations.{/n} "Especially when the well-being of one of the Imperium's worlds is at stake, even one such as Footfall."

319ff14b-b75d-48c9-ae25-897b186615ac.Text: "Not at all. Would you like to take these negotiations somewhere more suitable so that I may go over the details?"

40a093b7-d3bb-48b5-9b20-86d7f33c1d6e.Text: "A shame, truly a shame... Perhaps we could meet later? At a time that is more convenient for you?"

ba80d21f-d2a7-457a-aa7e-149406bb95f6.Text: "A matter of the utmost delicacy... You see, you've been to the residence of the Liege. Vladaym almost certainly appealed to you for assistance in the arrangement of shipments to Footfall. The von Valancius protectorate is famed for the abundance of its main {g|Encyclopedia:AgriWorld}agri-world{/g}, Janus. It would be odd for him not to seize on such an opportunity when Footfall is on the verge of famine."

210731cd-0140-435a-bd97-7aa7f5828001.Text: "However, the Chorda dynasty pursues its own interests on Footfall. We have already announced our terms to the Liege, but he is stalling — I imagine, in hopes of getting a better offer from you. The Chorda dynasty believes..." {n}Bastian smiles and gives a slight shrug.{/n} "...that cooperation would be preferable for both Rogue Trader houses. If you refuse Vladaym, thereby forcing him to agree to a deal with us — the Chorda dynasty can promise you a share of the profits from the future contract, as well as certain other perquisites. Everybody benefits!"

bf9bac26-1695-4ab1-86f3-4b2169f8411f.Text: "It's simply business. Honest and straightforward. Footfall is a den of bandits and profiteers. They may not be outright heretics, but they are far from the light of the Imperium. They should be grateful that Rogue Traders allow this den to exist in the first place. Demanding fair payment from them is only right."

28dac2a6-7753-4050-ab41-7e7c568f0b92.Text: "That's wonderful to hear. I had no doubts about our dynasties' mutual interests."

4a6f7b35-1bf1-44b5-b70b-35359cfe68b5.Text: "Strong words. Perhaps you would like to give my proposal a little more consideration?"

fadb971f-d401-4a9e-823b-06d184eeedc5.Text: {n}Bastian smiles and opens his mouth to offer another piece of sugar-coated courtesy, when suddenly...{/n}

3c113769-48d9-4164-b7a6-2feaea1fd453.Text: {n}Idira, who was yawning in boredom a moment ago, flinches and clutches her face, her fingernails digging into her skin.{/n} "They're coming! Again! Brothers of the ones who came before! I just don't get it — do they all have a death wish?"

ac852411-b4af-4775-843e-c8e880ceb7bc.Text: "Behind your smile, Master Bastian, teal shadows swirl. Others may not see them, but your worry cannot escape my eye. What are you afraid of? Your house's wrath should these negotiations prove fruitless? Or the wrath of House von Valancius?"

f7144277-90af-4179-b4fd-32200eb80c29.Text: "Chorda, hmm. They are some of the most influential Rogue Traders in the Koronus Expanse. But not on Footfall — this station is under the control of House Winterscale. Something tells me that we are about to hear a most curious offer..." {n}says Abelard under his breath so that only you can hear him.{/n}

6a1024e1-3d08-4e03-9466-e50e19eb932d.Text: "What?" {n}Bastian stares at you in surprise, then turns around...{/n}

93590d13-2215-4f0e-ba9c-e6c8b481d145.Text: "Vladaym may be a putrid-mouthed ashmag, but he's no fool. The terms of the deal must have been ludicrous for him to refuse a {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}'s offer. Catastrophically unfavourable, I'd say."

88f43773-1446-4982-882e-5c7706e34d91.Text: A corroded plaque has been roughly hammered to the crucified body: "Anver heretic. Executed for crimes against the Imperium of Man."

ef6e84d4-3044-423d-a290-4fcb35653453.Text: Unwilling to die, the bar patrons made their last stand right there.

d93af227-b49f-47b0-a829-aca6623ab4b0.Text: The stinking mass of charred, partially incinerated corpses smoulders under the weight of fresh bodies.

042ab765-6505-4aec-a115-38d7c3a6388a.Text: "Long live Her Ladyship the Rogue Trader Incendia Chorda!"

4ed6cf2e-ddcc-44d4-916e-809f4242a833.Text: "At last there will be order on Footfall now."

c4b17a25-ef1f-4c0f-8787-6bce24d1d935.Text: "I was lurking in the Shadow Quarters and begging only yesterday, but look at me now — standing guard! Still can't believe it... Long live the great Incendia Chorda!"

a730f55c-42b0-46eb-bfdb-abb1f461e2f7.Text: "Soon... very soon! Footfall will be purged of heresy! Just a little bit more..."

4864e618-2793-4c06-84bf-283191bdd3a9.Text: The sweet rotten odour and the scent of incense mix into a thick, nauseating stench.

8332ea4e-86a5-48ed-9f63-9d4d622881e0.Text: "Rogue Trader. Do not obstruct the Holy Inquisition's investigation."

1aefab81-2554-41c4-8c3e-2207238a6dc8.Text: "You, too, may find yourself at the centre of an investigation, Rogue Trader. Be cautious."

13a12485-eef0-4b26-b759-030cd2adf301.Text: The man in front of you is scrutinising a data-slate. The insignia of the Holy Inquisition hangs from his chest.

32661ca5-3786-42f0-b50f-0581f8a8a640.Text: "Please do not disturb the pilgrims — the mass is underway..."

d742f946-d358-4468-b626-2be910a813f9.Text: "Her Ladyship Incendia Chorda is waiting for you."

81469acf-1563-48fd-b794-e254efe258aa.Text: "By the will of the honourable Lord Inquisitor Calcazar, the palace is off-limits!"

46d8d78e-ebc4-4e95-8fcd-1a0b4ef093f3.Text: "Dishonourable fiends! I wish you all died as one!"

199c89f8-0547-4cb7-8bdb-a49e7cb97f2f.Text: The hardships and suffering this woman has endured lie on her face like a deep shadow. She stares unblinkingly into the distance as if not even noticing you.

bdb5be43-b5b8-4662-8c4d-89fde6d22aba.Text: "I am begging you! I... I am innocent! I swear by the Throne!"

dc39f0e0-9cd6-4a14-8aa6-4d9bc94723d0.Text: The dull, cold stare of the creature in the cage is unmistakably inhuman.

65053b8d-4e63-480c-866d-2798a7b43b68.Text: Above the creature's elongated eyes, you see the remains of quite human eyelids. It looks a lot like this "xenos" is the work of a not particularly skilled surgeon and a slightly more proficient makeup artist.

e5f242b4-d20f-4e8d-b81b-a4db1134d8e6.Text: The creature in the cage looks foreign and menacing.

8b298601-1438-4f1f-82ae-f1e6bb7277b5.Text: It is clear that the one in the cage is not a xenos — just an ordinary voidborn who lost in the mutation lottery.

9f10b582-4e4c-49a8-a1c3-2e95b1040191.Text: "Yaldaree. Behaviour: Duplicitous, aggressive. Habitat: Woods. Diet: Infants (2 to 3 a week) Fears: The Emperor, righteous people."

084e782a-0627-404e-8761-297b0e5d8aa0.Text: "Durrukhara. Behaviour: Villainy, malice. Habitat: Everywhere (hides among people). Diet: Doesn't eat, feeds on blasphemous thoughts. Fears: The Emperor, prayer, righteous thoughts."

ce1e61b1-9056-42ce-8363-45b54334f8f2.Text: "Xenobeastus Unknownus. Behaviour: Cruelty, trickery, rampant mating. Habitat: Void (doesn't need air). Diet: Rocks. Fears: The Emperor, fire."

4456b127-d6e7-4984-9cb3-bb567c170341.Text: "I'm afraid our establishment has been forced to suspend our xenos display."

70b7c735-4f90-4165-a762-22fffc165c8e.Text: "Come one! Come all! Peer into the eyes of the enemies of Humanity!"

cf1f6017-4b38-4f35-919d-4cb43fb85441.Text: "The best attraction on Footfall — caged live xenos!"

6d5eced7-79bb-46a4-a52f-c9c7d0de523f.Text: "Looking is free! And for just a couple of coins, you can take it out on the wicked beasts!"

c537b6a0-0fff-42df-ab79-5082a3d2488a.Text: "Punish the xenos — a coin for a go!"

86f36e1b-231b-4afe-88dd-e968c56eba6d.Text: "You're in deep, friend. You've made some powerful people very angry."

ec33567d-46a1-4cc2-8e0f-d1390333c7f0.Text: "Vladaym told us to make sure you're not seen around here again. And we will."

fc1cda75-2991-49cb-8120-e67548064b28.Text: "I see that your repentance went well."

25dea8f1-294f-4b9b-b8af-ff7f157bc909.Text: "To accept charity from a pirate and a murderer is unbecoming of a servant of the Emperor."

e94acdde-3708-408a-9115-05f6b4cfb4c1.Text: "I've heard accounts that Drusus wasn't a Guardsman, but an aristocrat, and it was contenders for Golgenna's position who made an attempt on his life. And he didn't rise from the dead — the assassin just decided not to kill him."

932153bb-2ad3-46bb-9cbd-8c18c1450d2f.Text: "Can we move our conversation to a place more befitting people of our rank?"

3ab16a04-8d87-46ad-84b7-6d2e5692ea07.Text: "How do you know who I am?"

10c5d2cf-3c0d-4885-ad19-e22f0edfaf7b.Text: "Why don't you go to the Liege with this matter?"

5011bf05-25ea-4aa2-ba2b-5c312a9c9753.Text: "We will verify this rumour, Reverend Hieronymus."

a27f92e9-acb5-4b1b-a610-cf330d696bf1.Text: "Rogue Traders are the Emperor's anointed. I act at His command, as evidenced by His signature on my Warrant."

08f489ac-bdf8-44df-bc6d-78aae3bc120d.Text: "Sister Argenta stood by my side during the assault on the ship, and I could use her assistance going forward."

7ba9a6d7-4f13-4b34-a436-42dbfb4e8773.Text: "Frankly, I have no need of Sister Argenta's escort."

4836f618-2695-42b8-a8ed-06e090c28b4c.Text: "What do you think of the justice I served, Reverend?"

95aeb615-77a2-416c-8424-636d5f4d504d.Text: [Draw your weapon] "For your crimes, I hereby sentence you to death."

73bc7ddb-b870-4309-87ae-56f66f47ae03.Text: "Keep up this attitude, and you'll be featuring in my next confession."

9c4b7361-db92-4410-93a5-90f8f29b05c0.Text: [Draw your weapon] "A sanctimonious blowhard who has clearly taken leave of his senses. I'm sure killing you would be a forgivable trespass... for a Rogue Trader."

058318c6-667f-46d0-9655-99eb97c16bfd.Text: Admitted to being a reprobate in front of Reverend Hieronymus.

8865f377-64fa-418a-8293-eadecc3348bc.Text: "Have no doubt about me. I'm a complete reprobate and an inveterate miscreant whose existence is an affront to the Emperor."

ac554b05-ebf5-46a7-ab87-6176525fead6.Text: "I'd like to take a look at what the followers of Saint Drusus have to offer me."

2de003c5-6d10-4c65-8b16-32858b2ae18a.Text: "The Emperor is merciful for allowing you a chance at redemption."

1119e70d-1b60-478c-a464-f01e59f141e7.Text: "Ah, so, now that you are sated with baseness, you think you can lecture people?"

0d50900d-863c-4885-b5c1-c9e62ed2ac38.Text: "What is the proper way to worship the Emperor?"

6b9559ee-cd6d-4dfc-bb5d-0057bdb24248.Text: "Who is the enemy of the Imperium?"

d96a3973-b7bb-4b36-a823-a65e1464ad49.Text: Praised the Ecclesiarchy while conversing with Reverend Hieronymus.

be59de0b-9cbe-4536-8915-bfe85e759f28.Text: "May the Emperor bless His faithful servants."

0e047e5a-c9cb-4c37-a720-ddf9754bf861.Text: Doubted the virtues of the Ecclesiarchy while conversing with Reverend Hieronymus.

ae268274-98d7-4e80-a8e1-f035819ab4e3.Text: "I imagine it is very advantageous for the Ecclesiarchy to pose as a congregation of saints. Forgive me for not buying any of it."

8592f3b1-1df2-4e36-af1b-67ce5d3c0f70.Text: Admired Incendia Chorda's piety while conversing with Reverend Hieronymus.

04773884-9b74-41f3-90c0-3856d550e657.Text: Disapproved of Incendia Chorda's bloodlust while conversing with Reverend Hieronymus.

4e2ebd25-7dc3-4973-bff0-b7a4332f4822.Text: "Since when is orchestrating massacres a sign of virtue?"

b9533dcc-491e-49b1-9674-f26aae243bb4.Text: Criticised Reverend Hieronymus for seeking Incendia Chorda's favour.

1772005c-2722-4b27-8d6f-256a0b895a5f.Text: "I see. You have found yourselves an excellent patroness, and now you're all too eager to spread the word of her piety."

1044e311-4694-4bef-87c0-2d9cf47337cb.Text: [Throw him a couple of coins] "A holy man, are you? Here, some alms for you."

991ab6ef-9e98-48ec-9b9e-be38b93cd4b9.Text: "I hope his soul now burns as bright as his victims did."

61513a1e-316c-44d6-a796-6831f1e65be9.Text: "A sentimental old man trying to buy absolution from his tumultuous youth... How pathetic."

d1f12bf8-b5b2-4a0e-9af3-392d1721b311.Text: "It seems to me, zealot, that it's the killings that bring you joy."

6368afe1-64a9-4c50-acea-218ec39aacab.Text: "I don't have time to be dealing with this."

ee49aa23-e9e7-4e2b-8e72-bfdc4ab5b62a.Text: "Footfall now has a new patron — Incendia Chorda."

997e52bc-ada9-43c0-8b7b-55f49cfea28a.Text: [Give him the diary of the captain of the Wasteland Wayfarer] "Your expedition perished."

d36fcef9-0fb0-4db0-aeb0-91300520b189.Text: "I come across heresy surprisingly often these days."

16cf805b-ac35-40be-b0c2-2407322bccb4.Text: Greeted Reverend Hieronymus with the sign of the Aquila.

685e0c9e-6c2f-434e-87ec-1f5779bd3d72.Text: [Make the sign of the holy Aquila] "I put my faith in the Emperor."

a6f5e476-cc3a-4b96-8f83-8d19d7ab9f27.Text: "I have changed my mind. Carrying the burden of your crimes until the end of your days is punishment enough."

fd41f30a-3d83-47a2-beae-a051c7dd62be.Text: "I found this scripture in the ruined abode of Jesevon..."

0e365b98-a118-484f-a0ef-002537ceaebd.Text: "Your request has been fulfilled. The cultist den in the Shadow Quarters has been cleared out."

61ff8a3a-e976-4fff-8787-c7fcf121370e.Text: Warned Reverend Hieronymus about the blasphemous nature of the scripture found in Jesevon.

13a27af9-e0f2-428d-af46-08a8ff1f8459.Text: "No, Reverend. It is a blasphemous text, the product of the mind of a heretic and an apostate who betrayed Humankind. One should know the face of one's enemy."

806aa8a5-36bb-43e4-8dd8-ba6d2d19896f.Text: Presented the blasphemous scripture found in Jesevon as sacred texts.

d6d23332-e659-4bce-9355-c9c6160993d7.Text: "A fascinating interpretation of His word. It is certain to be an interesting read — you might even learn from it."

4933bc40-eee1-467d-b017-0dffe17a249a.Text: "Are you still peddling the sacred relics of the Drusians? The hypocrisy."

5c5ba15f-d434-4155-b7fb-76ce1d31b8be.Text: "Tell me about your new path, Reverend."

b3ab45d4-2cd3-4f8c-b2e2-d5485da9773c.Text: "I would add something to that if doing so weren't beneath me."

615adf54-861c-4d3f-895e-909999807aba.Text: "I do not wish to enter into a debate with you."

3e2794c1-0788-4dc0-9e54-ffbd1e8940c3.Text: "Many would consider your remarks about the Ecclesiarchy to be heretical."

f6b74dd8-edd4-4421-b5e0-006a682a4273.Text: "Correction: I have no need of your protection, but I have nothing against your presence aboard my ship."

ee00001b-e462-492d-accd-1aab847ff421.Text: "Is it true that the pirate Denz Bellardo was your parishioner, and that he endowed the Drusians with donations?"

60e3f8d0-d543-46a8-bdc9-aa63981a4b64.Text: {n}Hieronymus nods in thought.{/n} "Follow the call of your soul, Sister. The Footfall reliquary will be preserved even without your contribution... as it was in all the years preceding your arrival."

f7109ce9-5ea3-466e-a16c-5d7793fb1a05.Text: "In the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g}, being a {g|Encyclopedia:Drusians}Drusian{/g} means being the one true believer, and our strength is great."

b9a5cc04-c718-4dde-994f-fb1c1dcdb3ad.Text: "It was. Reverend, let it be known to you that Theodora von Valancius's ship was attacked by servants of the {g|Encyclopedia:Chaos}Archenemy{/g}, who appal the heart of any righteous soul," {n}she says, nearly hissing with fury.{/n} "And not all of them met a fitting end. Some fled, and more than that — their blasphemous words clearly pointed to this attack being part of a larger design."

9e74b382-4112-4fd9-97ee-b6f49203e3a4.Text: {n}You've obviously heard this story before. Who hasn't heard of Saint Drusus? You may not be as versed in the details as Reverend Hieronymus, but his description of the events seems to check out.{/n}

f0e2795a-7600-48c6-a107-338d1d681990.Text: {n}Hieronymus's gaze is alight with awe. He breathes in the smell of burnt flesh and promethium and says to you,{/n} "Behold, noble {name}, as Footfall transforms before your very eyes! In the wake of your toils, this den of depravity will once again become a testament to the Emperor's greatness, as was its original design. Does it bring you delight?"

3e008324-30da-4bd5-b088-c3cde22115d5.Text: "None are unsullied. The corruption that drowns us is so impenetrable that I see no difference between the purest and the vilest."

9c18eb63-c6d0-458a-b370-af3bbf78e7ba.Text: {n}Argenta's disgruntled gaze bores into you, but she says nothing.{/n}

e53f95c8-0786-4ff7-9426-42ce68fdcb65.Text: "Why? For a missionary, his temple is the patch of deck beneath his feet. From where I stand, I can clearly see the life of my flock, all its bustling, blooming, and wilting. Here I can see their vile urges, futile hopes, and flashes of sincerity."

eef0cdd7-a835-4b92-989d-0c0740cb4790.Text: "If I were in the habit of locking myself in a temple, would I have made it in time to intervene in the massacre of your subjects from Kiava Gamma? No, truth resides not in golden halls, but here, in the square, among the people. Golden halls are home to other, far filthier things."

aabe7db6-624a-409a-a05a-7628edeb833a.Text: "You aren't afraid to speak freely, are you? You think yourself more virtuous and cleverer than others, even those whose eyes and ears have absorbed more light and wisdom than you?" {n}Hieronymus's eyes flash ominously.{/n}

ff611f6a-8eb5-4e2d-b808-030237010add.Text: "In those days, I saw with my own eyes the shameless ugliness of the soul. I repented of my hubris, left the position of prefect, and became a travelling missionary. I have been one ever since. As for my world... Twenty years later, the Holy {g|Encyclopedia:Inquisition}Inquisition{/g} consigned it to purifying flames."

333d921e-c215-4d51-9333-6b618d71296c.Text: "May the soul of Denz Bellardo, the Emperor's unworthy servant, one day be cleansed through suffering."

3b5da344-c8dd-49c0-b89c-d39839ea9d37.Text: "Reverend Hieronymus, I wish to join the esteemed Rogue Trader's crew and help protect the von Valancius dynasty from the forces of the Archenemy. I am divesting myself of the responsibility of guarding the Footfall reliquary."

985cbcdb-2685-44f8-a23b-b9e735428dc3.Text: "The Emperor has blessed me with acute hearing, and the people did the rest. How many members of your crew do you think came to confess the moment they arrived in port? How long do you suppose it took me to piece together the truth from their words?"

ee8c7e42-fc7c-4c8b-80d2-79b511cce888.Text: "This is where I bid you goodbye, Sister. Noble {name}, is there more you wish to ask me about?"

3924b42a-ff65-4376-81ba-0bc0c1f39f77.Text: "I cannot ignore Reverend Hieronymus's request or the threat of heresy on Footfall. If you can't undertake this task, {name}, then I will go to the Shadow Quarters myself!"

c84c029c-d268-4bea-ae7a-ca0edf1480cc.Text: "I grieve, young von Valancius. We did what we had to, but I mourn our {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_ChordaDead}loss{/d} all the same. Incendia's soul may have been lost, but it was still purer than that of many vipers that call themselves holy fathers of the Ecclesiarchy. Her life could have served as an example of true faith to many..."

51df1153-26c5-447f-88ef-e7bc73d5b7f3.Text: "The Liege and his accomplices {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_Footfall_VladaymDead}found the retribution{/d} they deserved. My heart rejoices at the thought of the justice delivered, yet it grieves me that Vladaym could not find it in himself to follow the path of repentance. With his intellect and resolve, he could have become a worthy servant of the Emperor, if only he had applied his talents."

d97f317c-a456-4e22-bd6c-6c0275eaa336.Text: {n}Smiling madly, Hieronymus spreads his arms wide and thrusts out his chest.{/n} "Then do not tarry! Deliver the Emperor's Peace unto me, if you think yourself worthy of passing His judgement. May your hand not waver under the weight of all the malefactions it has wrought."

adf5f667-faec-4aaf-a6cd-2adf302490d7.Text: "And what misdeed will you be confessing?" {n}Curiosity sparks in the bony face as the corner of his mouth lowers in a crooked smirk.{/n} "Will it frighten me?"

952a5779-b59b-45e2-9873-191604e331ba.Text: {n}He looks at you in silence for some time, then shifts heavily, as if his joints have turned to stone, to offer you a bow.{/n} "I still remember who {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Traders{/g} are. Masters and conquerors of the savage sectors of the void. Short-tempered messengers of the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} who carry His word into the heathen darkness. Crossing a Rogue Trader is folly if you want to keep your head on your shoulders."

f0b62a1c-2656-452b-b129-1619dacf0cb7.Text: {n}His smile dims.{/n} "It is true. Death would have been too easy a liberation for me. To live knowing what depths of wickedness my soul is capable of is truly an agonising fate. And yet in that agony, there is serenity."

360676ca-889a-4884-9f95-63cc23ab521c.Text: "Please accept my apologies, my esteemed Lord Captain. My words were... lacking in respect."

f153b907-068c-4b1d-abbf-67ace90b1ac4.Text: {n}He studies you with his heavy gaze, then erupts into a fit of laughter, his voice so hoarse, you fear his vocal cords are about to snap.{/n}

3830cece-abf8-404b-9fdc-e71b387c70af.Text: "Well, at least you're not lying to yourself. You are a filthy blasphemer and a blight in His eyes. As am I. As are we all. This is the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g}, and there is no virtue here, only profaners steeped in villainy."

7468df04-3617-4346-8c06-5718c364d267.Text: "What am I doing in this den of blasphemers, pagans, and the vilest of souls, you mean to say? Well, Footfall is the first and last stop in the Koronus Expanse. It is the point of arrival for those who have just started on their path, and it is also where those who are reaching its very end return, their souls wounded and bleeding. I embrace both the former and the latter, so that they may cast an honest eye over their impurity."

31110043-153a-47ce-ad05-dc01d73bab69.Text: "Furthermore, rumours from across the entire sector amass on Footfall. If I hear crewmen whispering about a reclaimed shrine world or expressing desire to carry the Emperor's light into the darkness among the stars, I help my flock in their sacred duty. Devoted trailblazers need assistance both spiritual and material: tools, equipment, even garments and simple everyday items — anything that might help pilgrims on their long journey and during the first days of the harsh frontier life is worth its weight in gold to us. May any help you offer to the effort of gathering such things be blessed."

2ef286f1-5e5f-4e03-a3cb-a40d5aa658aa.Text: "I bear another, darker duty. The Expanse is filled with the tainted creations of unholy heretics. These insidious objects are a danger to the soul, but I know what to do with them. Should you on your travels come upon dangerous, corrupted objects — bring them to me, and the reward for your vigilance will be even more generous. The Drusian mission has much to share with the Rogue Trader."

6f17d5e4-1422-4398-a609-77ee0c3cd66b.Text: "My sermon planted the seed of faith in the heart of another Rogue Trader once — Incendia Chorda. Perhaps you are destined to become my second fledgling."

4d4e5a49-3a25-4edb-aede-0494f2f57481.Text: "Neither my past nor my present hold any secrets. But take heed when gazing into my heart, for many dark thoughts lurk within."

0e27539d-85f2-4d45-8d4c-e0795bf557ac.Text: "I am surprised that you had any to begin with."

e30eb8ec-ab5a-494d-b4f4-5efdb4bff0d7.Text: "We are a sanctioned Imperial cult which honours Saint Drusus, Scourge of the Bale Childer, Bane of Xenos. Just as he once fearlessly ventured into the Calixis Sector and spearheaded its conquest, so do we travel to untamed reaches and expand the Imperium's borders. We are pilgrims and scouts who descend into the darkness of lawless sectors, and our eyes are inured to vice and filth."

36db266d-cb30-45d8-985c-bf7b17bed5aa.Text: "He was a great saint, irrepressible and decisive. Drusus served the Emperor as a simple member of the Guard, who fought in the glorious Angevin Crusade and rose to the rank of general. It was a gruelling conquest — the Imperium invaded the Calixis Sector, back then a savage expanse populated by xenos and heretics. Drusus delivered many defeats unto the enemies of Humanity — he brought down the Twisted Kings on Acreage, liberated the planet Dreah from the unholy Dark Daemons, and had many triumphs."

967cb59f-1852-488f-9544-678bee24564c.Text: "But then they encountered a race of unholy xenos. Rivers of blood flowed. Golgenna Angevin died in his headquarters, the crusade was about to crumble, but then... we received unexpected help from a foe."

0142d00f-039b-484b-a9a3-9105f61e0abe.Text: "A wretched fiend. Blinded by my ambitions, I served in my home planet's {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusAdministratum}Adeptus Administratum{/g} division. I was a shrewd and sly bureaucrat, and I soared to great heights, to the very chair of prefect. In thirty years, I turned my home from a withered fringe colony into a prosperous world. Our wealth grew as we bloomed."

77296f3a-7f66-43a6-baff-fcf9f3699e2f.Text: "But the bloom was a veneer for rot. Opulence had depraved us, and luxury had seduced us with its sordid promises. The planet's denizens no longer wished to pray or work, they only sought entertainment and dangerous philosophies. A thousand vile heresies and a million appalling vices bred on my world like mould on a nutribar."

80751be5-730d-42b5-8a0b-8144dad824a1.Text: "Who said I had redeemed myself? I doomed an entire planet to degeneracy. You think a decade or two of wandering with a mission is enough to atone for that? No, I am a poor excuse for a shepherd in His eyes."

a2bcbf55-835c-40de-ac18-e186eedf3a32.Text: {n}He nods calmly.{/n} "You are quite right. I am a wicked, irredeemable scoundrel. Shall we embrace, {mf|brother|sister}?"

db5321f1-4b28-4798-89ed-437f7166095b.Text: "You think it is so easy to put into words His essence and splendour? The {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} is the perfect deity that reads our hearts and grants us His light. He led Humanity out of darkness and horror, He created our great home. He experienced torment and pain, which only made Him stronger. That is a lesson to us all — purity is not to be found at the bottom of the dirtiest hive or in golden palaces, but only among the ranks of those who suffer."

6cb2d382-ef9a-42c5-8d22-c502692eac5d.Text: "Pray to Him, destroy His enemies, and touch not their poisoned gifts. Cast aside all doubt and be vigilant against the weak souls beside you. When you see a sign of taint — burn it away without pity. Pain is good, it tears the crust of vileness from one's soul. And remember that if you see no fault in you or around you, then you are not being diligent enough in your search. Or you are being too lenient on yourself, averting your eyes from the truth."

60ff14e2-93b9-46fc-b872-39da9a5373a5.Text: "Think nothing of it, young von Valancius."

851106da-26a6-426c-b460-43f441212e91.Text: "It has three faces. The inhuman {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g}, who wish death upon us simply because they are unlike us. The pitiful subhuman mutants — abominations that wish death upon us because they envy us and are ashamed of themselves. And the {g|Encyclopedia:Chaos}Archenemy{/g} that reigns in the {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}Immaterium{/g}, which wishes death upon us by its very nature."

57fdb7d0-bd5d-4f95-8570-efb07544152b.Text: "You speak of the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMinistorum}Adeptus Ministorum{/g}? Well, these heralds of His word hold great power. Every priest, myself included, is part of its hierarchy, and the Ecclesiarchy possesses the unique right to judge what is virtuous and what is malign. The Adeptus Ministorum prays and cares for the temples, it sends missions such as my own to every corner of the dominion of Humanity, it fights against heresies."

dadaab47-d95e-4326-a84f-f29537b14ea8.Text: "Have you heard of Aspyce Chorda — pirate, blasphemer, xenophile, and egregious apostate? Incendia is her heir, and a rarity among Rogue Traders. The protection of the holy {g|Encyclopedia:Warrant}Warrant{/g} typically leads to the swift atrophy of conscience and pious dread, but not in Incendia's case."

ed99b3b4-18b5-4245-a2d5-9479cb134712.Text: "She relentlessly hunts down pirates and firebrands, and brings rebelling colonies to repentance, establishing strict discipline. The weight of her wrath is great indeed — the colonies she punishes are girded with orbital rings of heretic corpses as a warning to the survivors. As her personal confessor and guide, I find no end to the joy her triumphs in faith bring me."

0495d6c7-34fc-48c2-a5fc-7ca109d2c45b.Text: "You think that His mercy extends that far? I have seen many who wish to be our shepherds. Power clouds their vision, and their greedy hands scoop up all that they can reach. The Ecclesiarchy is long overdue for a cleansing."

978ee4e1-2a37-4204-90c2-e42ceb158db9.Text: "And rightly so. The Ecclesiarchy harbours plenty of covetous and power-hungry recidivists. They've forgotten what it means to be a shepherd. They've grown soft and sluggish. For too long have their souls and bodies gone without suffering."

8cb0ddf8-517c-4f4e-a119-9381a87347fd.Text: {n}Hieronymus pauses, then adds grimly,{/n} "However, these are nothing but words. The real Ecclesiarchy is far more frightening, vile, and dark than it once was."

d105ff15-3063-49bb-82db-c966d055ba8c.Text: "It's good that you realise this. It may be difficult to admit, but mercy is a weakness and a gateway for degradation."

395fda57-9954-4527-8303-ed0a70570b7f.Text: "They aren't massacres. This is a war on apostasy and treason, and in this war, Incendia Chorda is inflicting grievous wounds upon the wicked."

f3c11bba-6091-4578-8474-d33eb4f4228b.Text: {n}He chuckles.{/n} "What good are her riches to us? Faith gives us all we need. It is she who is indebted to us — it was a {g|Encyclopedia:Drusians}Drusian{/g} expedition that discovered the cryo-vault in which Aspyce had imprisoned her. If it hadn't been for us, she would be resting there still in her frozen slumber."

23546b72-486f-4ab8-9a45-1b2f415cf3f7.Text: {n}Argenta stomps her foot in a fit of temper.{/n} "As you wish," {n}she mutters through gritted teeth, before turning to the priest.{/n} "Reverend Hieronymus. I must go and... pray in the temple. We can talk once the noble {name} has departed."

cc4de15a-ed50-4dd0-a861-b0a9d4cf7d42.Text: {n}Funny. The story of Saint Drusus you know is completely different.{/n}

257b83a2-d158-42c7-9c9a-188e4ca768c8.Text: {n}Hieronymus shakes his head mournfully.{/n} "It appears that Sister Argenta was mistaken about you, and only now has she realised the truth. But never mind that. Was there anything else you wished to discuss?"

2a6e77b6-2a07-4d85-b583-7e7b92473723.Text: {n}Hieronymus is looking past you, absorbed in his own story.{/n}

7c0dacf4-a217-493f-87bf-12ae8e09aa5e.Text: {n}Hieronymus looks at you with a smirk.{/n} "Well, of course you've heard that. But just consider for a moment whose words you are repeating right now. The one who put them into your head — do they mean the Imperium well? Think on it."

9161d1f1-3148-461a-81c4-451d8916a82a.Text: "Footfall is consumed by profanity, but even here, true heresy — serving the Archenemy — is a rarity. The cultists who now dwell in the Shadow Quarters mark their abodes with a sun inscribed in blue and gold, and perform strange rituals in secret. The weak find solace in believing these reports to be rumours, but I well know that evil lurks all around us. And I wish to see retribution."

0c5fd354-c36e-4264-b41a-9c67e23713d2.Text: "I do not walk the paths pleasing to the Liege." {n}Hieronymus frowns.{/n} "Vladaym is weak and riddled with worms on the inside. He seeks to please his {g|Encyclopedia:KasballicaMission}Kasballica{/g} masters, those peddlers of relics of the unholy {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g}."

3bf2917b-aa85-4ca8-8c36-2614979f3f37.Text: "With great pleasure!" {n}Argenta lays a hand on her weapon.{/n} "I almost wish for the rumour to be true — my heart yearns to battle some heretics!"

3dded2e0-4263-418c-8660-a5694e0e8d81.Text: {n}A grim smile brightens his features, and he makes the sign of the {g|Encyclopedia:Aquila}Aquila{/g}.{/n} "I hope that their suffering was commensurate with their deeds."

d911d7cc-8b86-4e88-9962-9e6f7af53ba3.Text: {n}The man with a face so drawn it appears to be made of nothing but skin and bone fixes his unblinking, birdlike eyes on you. The priest's simple black clothes have next to no adornments, and they do nothing to mask his unhealthy gauntness. In a cracked voice, he says,{/n} "The {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} protects."

f389905e-28c3-4192-92be-9027d5899f68.Text: "I am Reverend Hieronymus — Hieronymus Doloroso, as I'm called. Head of the {g|Encyclopedia:Drusians}Drusian{/g} mission and possibly the last hope for the wayward souls that inhabit this fringe forsaken by our Master."

bf3bd3c7-7cec-494d-84da-545651ec4b84.Text: "But He protects only those who are pure of heart. Do you think yourself one of them? Be leery of this conviction of yours. Many who have risen to the pinnacle of faith have fallen from it into the embrace of pride most degenerate."

4ebe8e8b-ca5c-4eab-bf02-eae61ad51ab1.Text: "I have no need of baubles, play with them yourself if they bring you joy. Money can buy neither peace nor salvation."

bda5d030-2c34-49a8-9692-eededebae935.Text: {n}His gaze bores into you as if he is trying to penetrate your thoughts.{/n}

d2d59bcb-422b-4b5b-a874-73591a4f4069.Text: "And you must be the young von Valancius. That name carries weight... and it is a burdensome one, for its reputation suggests that Theodora encumbered it with many a transgression. I wonder, will you seek to shed them, or will you carry them onward, picking them along the way like ripe fruit and savouring their sweet poison?"

1cc95103-b0f2-438d-8e32-21e628aead42.Text: "A woman of great gifts, but few considered virtue to be one of them. People whispered that power had corrupted her, made her believe that she was entitled to anything she wanted. It is known that she showed cordiality to {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g}, broke taboos, and violated dogmas. Then again, so do nearly all {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Traders{/g}."

3c8411fa-8061-4ef7-9314-07c746e193ba.Text: "And did He grant it to you personally? The Emperor has entrusted His servants with the future of Humanity, but people are too weak and flawed to prove themselves worthy of His trust. Only suffering can cleanse us, but we fear it and thus remain sullied."

73761f1b-ecb2-4e50-9c23-fbcd643369b8.Text: {n}He gives you a scrutinising look, then his tone softens:{/n} "Well, then be twice as diligent. For this sector will seize any chance to test your faith."

15cb6003-0aaa-4310-baff-355ddc6994bf.Text: "I only pray that the blessed Incendia does not find the burden of the offences of Footfall's denizens so indelible as to cleanse the station in a fiery fount. Even though it certainly deserves such a fate."

d5cb4c4c-8fb6-4fcb-892d-10c9e2366cde.Text: {n}He gives you a scrutinising look, then says dryly,{/n} "We'll see how long it lasts under the onslaught of the profaners who inhabit this sector and who are repulsed by all things sacred and pure."

eaa17844-e3a0-4438-830a-7cd4f95bb57f.Text: "Just as Saint Drusus found his martyr's death and was reborn in faith, so do we search for the purifying power of trials and suffering." {n}From the folds of his black robe, he produces a thin pamphlet.{/n} "Read this. It contains the basics of our dogma. Perhaps you too will sense the truth in Saint Drusus's words."

4cf6c67a-9997-472c-bc35-9ef2327100f6.Text: "I do not like death. And I do not rejoice when innocents die. But who is innocent — the one whose neighbour succumbed to the cult of the Archenemy? The one whose brother became a pirate? The one whose daughter renounced both the law and His light? Are they innocent? Or are they blind cowards who indulge evil? Do you grieve for them?"

774cf34c-90f0-4b7d-8f2a-431e19a05251.Text: "And many others would find them truthful. I am a preacher of a radical teaching that renounces fear. I've left the bounds of the blessed Imperium to carry His light into the darkness of the frontier. I've come to know depravity first-hand and am now able to perceive it under any guise. I think I can afford myself a modicum of truth."

dd8c3baf-e6b8-44ee-91a9-113700f93222.Text: {n}The priest's voice is rasping and harsh, but you still manage to pick up a strange change in tone. There is something hidden behind this shift in his speech — something that he did not consider necessary to explain.{/n}

7fc5be2c-a662-4945-ace8-47cd0ada9551.Text: "It is. Over the course of his life, that reprobate had burdened his soul with many vile and egregious acts. His confessions were akin to a grand catechism listing Humankind's immanent vices and enormities."

126c4407-59bc-4bbb-ad12-a3724f99d533.Text: "It was all the more painful for him to realise that, of all the heinous acts he had committed, not one had been forgotten by the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g}. Denz Bellardo was afraid of death and that which would await him after. He hoped to atone for his misdeeds. Yearned to convince — if not the Emperor, then himself, at least — that he had been more than a conscious speck of malignant mould his entire life."

f8b93704-0ad0-438a-9d0a-936322d5c47f.Text: "And it is true for miscreants above all others. The greater the transgression, the more miraculous and wondrous the repentance."

5284a2b1-fc6d-4aea-8a04-f56156f25693.Text: "I'm sure it does. Repentance but primes us for the salvific torment of the soul, it does not supplant it."

10adbb4f-38d6-4f1f-84f7-e81086bf9a04.Text: "So it is. We are as contemptible in our faults as we are pathetic in our desire to run from the realisation of our own base nature."

eaa22009-17f1-472e-9214-c7d9636ed8a6.Text: {n}He looks at Argenta who is standing nearby, and his voice softens slightly.{/n} "Greetings, Sister. I congratulate you on your return. Was your pilgrimage fruitful?"

1009d099-11c4-4ad3-be0e-9ae00f65a6f7.Text: "Indeed. Her loyal servants have already appointed confessional units whose duty it is to patrol the station and invite its denizens to repent of their many crimes. As the Emperor is my witness, His pious aides have their work cut out for them on Footfall. For depravity, much like the void, is immeasurable and omnipresent. But is that any reason not to try and conquer it?"

d811994f-d755-4329-a3c0-8959c3f0d7b7.Text: {n}He studies the diary for a while in silence, then says grimly,{/n} "Captain Virkyl was a kind but fallible man. So was my brother-in-service, Gravik. So were the millions of pilgrims who boarded the Wasteland Wayfarer many years ago."

b09db3f7-f386-4eb7-add5-6bd937413909.Text: "It grieves me that their kindness failed the test that the void presented them with. Let their deaths serve as a reminder to us — corruption has many faces and can stain even the purest of souls. Thank you for the news, Lord Captain. Colony AIII-649-Minoris is hereby officially declared fallen and lost."

928f7b02-21c2-4b91-9e7b-7e6087d30618.Text: "Indeed. Dark times are upon us, and wretched souls grow ever more eager to embrace heresy. Both on Footfall and elsewhere, its foul buds are coming into bloom. Troubling news is arriving from many planets. There are whispers of wicked things taking place on Kiava Gamma. And just recently, a transport ship by the name of Naviica, teeming with refugees, arrived on Footfall from Winterscale's Realm. Their world was stricken with blasphemous sedition, and such was its severity that they had to flee to save themselves."

f507adf2-2c79-49c8-b89a-a0bea3754a84.Text: "The Liege refused to accept them, and so they headed for Foulstone, a desolate cloister of the righteous. It was wise of them not to linger in this den of vileness."

c14500ad-9462-4a0a-ae0c-f8051c6ebed6.Text: "Is that so? And where is this world located? The Calixis Sector or the Koronus Expanse? Which system?"

e8eea924-17d0-4cda-88f3-5082c26e3f43.Text: "The very memory of that den of vileness insults my faith. Through prayers and solemn vigils, I wiped the name of my homeworld from memory — else I would have planted the seeds of regret and heresy in my own soul."

9a18a15e-25f7-4795-84d7-e5ddab2148be.Text: {n}Argenta silently makes the sign of the {g|Encyclopedia:Aquila}Aquila{/g}, her bright eyes burning with unyielding flame.{/n}

c1f7f527-cef0-466f-8444-17421a31de12.Text: {n}Jae touches her golden Aquila on a chain. Her voice is brimming with vexation.{/n} "May the Exalted One smite me if I'm lying, but faith and the Ecclesiarchy are of different worlds. The former is pure and grants salvation, the latter festers on the body of the former so that its adepts can profit off the labour of those who seek strength in hoping."

1961baf9-78bb-47a1-848a-617bf754bc86.Text: "I'm clever enough not to toil for Imperial clerks who grow fatter by the day, and pious enough to tell the Emperor's light from the gold of an icon's frame. I say we leave it at that, my good man."

2db948a5-5dd7-4c7d-b26c-13f3449eab74.Text: "Bad omens. Dark times have come — ships from the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g} barely appear in the Koronus Expanse anymore. In Footfall's Shadow Quarters, taint thrives, and the people here are corrupt enough to succumb to it gladly."

e1363e4d-5f1c-4b12-846d-29e1beb0e9cd.Text: {n}Idira starts giggling at Hieronymus's words.{/n} "He forgot to mention people like me... My whole life people have told me I'm filth on the face of Humanity, its poison, its bane..." {n}She stops abruptly with a sob.{/n}

963c6ecb-1612-441c-826e-4bf781807b09.Text: "There's more and more talk of how poorly things are going in the Expanse — some days it seems I can't take two steps without hearing some peasant pontificating on the matter, hmph! Even if it is as dire as they say, the von Valancius realm will not crumble under the blows of fate, no matter how devastating. Chin up, Lord Captain! This is no time to lose heart and lament your lot."

28d9047b-4a28-475a-989f-1d746edae1f5.Text: "Not only is your hope false, it is also dangerous — among His servants, there have been people of greater integrity who sullied themselves in their attempts to rise above the rest."

614c67c7-a3b3-4b57-97b6-9a126edd84a4.Text: "Your words about the past are drowned in murky hues of sickly green, and your talk of the present falls in grey flakes of ash upon the shoulders of your listeners. Sorrow... truly weighs heavily on you, Reverend Hieronymus. And that is why the fire in your words is devoid of golden radiance — the faded flickers of teachings leave nothing but black soot on their souls."

b2a2a5eb-8ff7-4a79-9acd-2e2dcdbca4f0.Text: {n}Hieronymus Doloroso's unblinking eyes fix on Yrliet.{/n} "I know not why His voice, vested to protect the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}'s borders from the intrusions of the enemies of Humanity, would see fit to keep an ungodly {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g} in their retinue. But I say to you: repent, young von Valancius, and pray to the Emperor for forgiveness, for your soul has forevermore been stained with the taint of an outsider. There can be no virtue in that which is contrary to His divine will!"

81f0c6df-b7da-432c-bedc-5391c2882206.Text: "The path of true believers leads into darkness — to search for worlds that have lost His radiance, steeped in depravity. Blessed are the deeds of those who give themselves into the void and the warp in hopes that their actions might bring light into the darker reaches of the Expanse and deliver a previously barren world into the Imperium's service." {n}Hieronymus is silent for a few seconds.{/n} "And all the more bitter is the realisation that not all brave souls will succeed in their mission. Footfall still awaits news from the Wasteland Wayfarer, an ancient ark of a ship headed for distant stars. Her last Astropathic message was sent from beyond the Cinerus Maleficum, and the stars have kept her fate secret since."

ab18c5ed-02b5-4e5a-92aa-a3858a057a31.Text: {n}You barely recognise Reverend Hieronymus. His body is covered in swollen ulcers and abscesses, one eye has almost popped out of its socket, oozing with revolting greenish pus, and the other eye is clouded with cataracts. He parts his lips deformed by chemical burns and says,{/n} "The Emperor protects."

e7ae8838-5a1c-476c-be9c-db588aa9635b.Text: {n}Hieronymus bares his blackened gums in a semblance of a smile.{/n} "The Emperor was merciful to me: my body is ruined and withered, but my soul received a chance to wash away at least some of the accreted taint through blessed torment. The filth that I had to endure was nothing compared to the vileness that I nurtured within me, passing it off as virtue. I will wear the mark of my penance with pride. Let all see that remorse is a path of thorns, but one that can be walked, and I did not hesitate to pay the price."

d5e01aab-ec82-45ea-afc1-779095d2cee3.Text: "I should have confessed my crimes to Incendia myself, but I was a spineless coward. Thank you for taking on that burden and freeing me from the shackles of lies and fear."

d8237d06-4079-4102-a7b7-ad3e6a9dfa1c.Text: {n}Reverend Hieronymus is bowed in prayer. His brow is furrowed, and his eyes are filled with grief that he does not attempt to hide.{/n} "Greetings, young von Valancius. I am offering my prayers to the Emperor for the souls that were robbed of a chance to serve Him for a little while longer. All that consoles me is knowing that their final moments were those of anguish, and thus, of sublimation. What brings you to me?"

62e184cc-1db1-486e-8a8d-b7b3ca6aa6f1.Text: "The xenos sent their assassins to the great Drusus, but the Emperor's will shielded His servant from the attack. Slain but resurrected through a miracle, Drusus asserted himself at the head of the Angevin Crusade as its Lord Militant and saw the xenos extermination through to the end. He brought the Calixis Sector to accord and was proclaimed a Living Saint."

8951216d-b73c-4ec9-8b74-e534d1ed9f8e.Text: "Remember that we are all guilty! My blood will not wash away the faults of your soul, however desperately you may wish it were otherwise. The Emperor prote—" {n}Hieronymus barely has time to make the sign of the Aquila over his chest before his body slumps to the ground with a blissful smile on his cracked lips.{/n}

a11ed6cb-b1a4-41c8-a02d-3329445de500.Text: "Rumours around the Expanse say that the accursed {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g} have grown bold and are rearing their heads. They attack ships and settlements, walk under the suns of Imperium worlds like kings instead of cowering in the shadows. What next? What adversities await us if such disgrace is happening already?" {n}He shakes his head sternly.{/n}

3675f877-f85c-48a7-96b2-bc0fe2660a6c.Text: "What is it? A martyr's work from a lost colony?"

e19c2fc9-2214-4b20-81b0-cb991f897816.Text: {n}Hieronymus nods grimly.{/n} "Your vigilance is great. We will steel our hearts against this new breed of heresy that is pressed into these unclean pages."

dea50e53-8686-4139-a540-ca015ac08c45.Text: {n}Hieronymus nods absent-mindedly.{/n} "Rest assured, the text will be studied in detail."

c09feabb-2086-494a-9b04-35126f41e133.Text: {n}Reverend Hieronymus is bent down in prayer, but his barely discernible mumbling is far from the praises one would sing to the Emperor. Flies buzz around the preacher's forehead.{/n} "Greetings, noble {name}! It is thanks to you that I found a new path. The righteous path. A path on which no true believer will ever fear death! All thanks to the revelation your words have bestowed upon me. How may I serve you?"

6214b188-9e8e-4730-bc1a-a91ff4c2d88d.Text: "It was done. We {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_ChordaDead}cut short the life{/d} of the one who set Footfall ablaze. How blind I was to think Incendia was righteous when she was only a parasite crawling out of the gut of a false god! Now I behold that which the morass of subservient adoration of an impotent corpse had shrouded from me. I see the path I will walk on, the path I will take to lead my flock." {n}A black fly emerges from the old man's crooked mouth and skitters into the preacher's nostril.{/n}

4a1b9fb8-b028-4245-8512-7b9950c5cf5f.Text: "These gifts are tainted with falsity — I do not need them. Take them, if they help you guide new lost souls toward the right path or destroy those who would prevent you from doing so. I would not sell them to a true believer in a false god."

56541d86-8acf-4e2b-b478-ff16fbcdb88c.Text: "Mine is the path of life eternal. I realised the futility of my carnal fears — I was afraid of death, not recognising its inevitability. But this inevitability is what leads to life unending, decay and death give way to a new existence. It is obvious even here on the station: look at the serf nibbling on a ration made of corpse starch. Look at the rats rummaging through the entrails of a dead ruffian. Finally, look at how the death of Incendia has allowed the seeds of true grace to sprout within my flock and me!"

5bb14769-5ee6-40b8-84e8-a10a50f4088d.Text: "This cycle of death and rebirth, and the happiness of realising that we are but pieces of rotting meat, this is my reward and deliverance." {n}Hieronymus lowers his voice to an ingratiating whisper and smiles at you with blackening teeth.{/n} "Such is the wisdom of Grandfather Nurgle, my new shepherd. Your words sent my mind questing in search of answers. It was then that I had a vision of a beautiful angel of rotting flesh covered with boils and pustules. He revealed the truth to me. He delivered me from the meaningless fear of death. And now I will free others from it. Is it not wonderful?"

8e402e51-3b8b-4c21-ac21-66c4cb727a44.Text: "The Emperor protects." {n}The priest makes no effort to hide the sneer in his voice.{/n}

af2d2122-dfe6-4b53-b3aa-e59f22f1ff5c.Text: "The Emperor protects." {n}A swarm of flies burst from Hieronymus's mouth as if wanting to defile the false blessing he has just uttered.{/n}

62f53f51-5cef-4e32-9819-36690e0c9a47.Text: {n}Argenta recoils and folds her arms indignantly.{/n} "No need? So that's how it is!"

69ea259a-60d1-4900-b620-e27e086bd137.Text: {n}Yrliet is busy studying the local architecture. It would seem that she finds Footfall's bustle far more interesting than Hieronymus's words.{/n}
