d8852083-07c7-4e6b-a33c-33c991b4028a.Text: "If the Liege is neglecting his duties, I shall become your patron."

58637f31-c5f9-4b42-afbd-d74882270cf3.Text: "What can you offer in terms of payment?"

077f3647-46d0-43b3-82c4-92149b78ab1c.Text: "What kind of cargo was stolen from you?"

e111902f-7bc8-4f4c-b1e0-8c8327ba16d4.Text: "Are you asking an upstanding citizen to be party to the trafficking of xeno-artefacts?"

0a3771c7-6542-493e-91ea-cdcd8f248d5f.Text: "I should have you executed on the spot for such a suggestion! Your cargo is nothing but foul xenoheresy!"

d1fcedd2-bd9c-440a-b0dd-1f84e3e8d969.Text: "I wish to ask you a few questions before I decide."

b4c8c726-9341-4599-8c33-3264957093ce.Text: "I suspect that Vladaym wants to keep the cargo out of your hands. And I want to put him in his place."

ede5af1e-96bf-4fce-ac1e-1a759a19c612.Text: "Actually, I'm here for you, Jae. I would like to see you in my retinue."

b079b852-d0d4-4953-be20-4df14709064b.Text: "So far, you have shown me nothing but bluster. Prove your usefulness. Now."

027719fa-a752-4b9a-b81c-3090a4ed14b6.Text: "Have we met somewhere before?" {n}The woman looks at you with the glassy eyes of a drunk, and you notice the two empty bottles that had been keeping her company before you arrived. She looks completely out of place in this dingy, smoky bar. The fancy attire, the abundance of jewellery, the {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}implants{/g} plated with precious metals — her appearance not only screams wealth, but also audacity, for only an audacious person would flaunt their wealth in a place like this.{/n}

8ceb5c66-a9f3-404a-aacb-2183c33a9e81.Text: "You see, shereen... There's one cardinal rule on Footfall — anything goes as long as it doesn't get in the way of business. I'm someone who's been able to exploit that rule to the fullest, and in recent years I've hit it so big I've become a speck of sand in someone's green eye. They used to throw small wrenches into my dealings here and there, but now they've decided to really put their backs into it. Some rat's stolen my cargo and dragged it off to the seediest part of the Shadow Quarters — a crummy place, even for connoisseurs of Footfall's unique atmosphere."

8fd67d6e-79b8-4772-af20-a91cfa403abc.Text: "Oh, honey to my ears! A balm to a spurned soul!" {n}Jae gracefully tosses her jet-black hair out of her face and gives you a beaming smile.{/n} "I knew the God-Emperor would bring us together right when you needed my services! Me and my talents are at your complete disposal."

c371fef2-b146-476d-ae0f-4d9d0f6b5051.Text: "Life? What kind of life can a distressed servant of the Exalted One have, left at the mercy of Footfall's slavering dogs? My situation is still precarious, shereen... and I'm still desperate for help, for which I'm willing to pay handsomely."

5bc93b53-fadf-4c1d-9d88-c86fa3577f2b.Text: {n}The woman, after taking a sip from her glass, chokes and quickly clears her throat.{/n} "{name}! {name} von Valancius... my deepest, humblest regards, {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_FootfallOfficial}Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}{/d}! I never would've imagined I'd be standing at the bar in the Amasecus next to an honest-to-God-Emperor {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}!"

55cb4ce6-feb5-4d70-9fe6-16a71ddc31a5.Text: "Well, then... here's to our meeting, {name}. It doesn't take a genius to figure out that you're {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_FootfallIncognito}someone special{/d}, since you've been granted an audience with the Liege of Footfall himself. It's always a pleasure to make the acquaintance of someone powerful." {n}She takes a sip, and pauses... then resolutely sets her glass aside and turns to you.{/n} "And the timing couldn't be better."

8227634e-3a4a-4968-ac2c-1b4b3dfe7a1f.Text: "Right... Here, that's where those ashmags are keeping the stolen cargo. Out the bar, over the bridge, and to the left — there, in the depths, you'll find a small courtyard through which you can get to the place. I'll be waiting nearby — you can come when it suits you, but the sooner you do, the better. I'll see you then, shereen!"

7faa73a1-52be-42c9-be4b-9b357cdaee9d.Text: "When I asked the Liege for protection, we had a mutual misunderstanding. I believe Vladaym, in a most lamentable fashion, has forgotten his duties as guardian of the downtrodden and wronged... so I'm in desperate need of a new one. And you, shereen, fit the bill perfectly. All I need is for you to drop by one dark corner of Footfall's Shadow Quarters and pound it into the thieves' heads that taking Heydari's property carries certain risks."

5bd95909-bfbe-4f50-8ce7-e7f29e1927b5.Text: "Of course, I am aware that my personal means cannot compare to yours, shereen, so I do not hope to impress you with money. But I can offer something else — my boundless knowledge! Surely you will appreciate the services of an expert on trading operations. Where I'm from, they call this kind of deal 'wisdom selling.'"

04fc2111-08b1-4d50-beca-59c8c48532ec.Text: "I have heard a great deal about how... open-minded the members of the von Valancius dynasty are. And Lady Theodora especially."

606f2ea8-d37c-4417-975f-20b8c8fb202d.Text: {n}Jae appears to be a serious operator on Footfall. The Liege's refusal to help means the loss of a potential ally. So Jae is encroaching on his turf. If Vladaym is not responsible for the disappearance of Jae's cargo, he will certainly benefit greatly from it.{/n}

5cb12369-1fca-4f3b-980e-8b0d3b021025.Text: {n}It seems Jae is too minor a player for someone in the Liege's position to devote any attention to her problems.{/n}

22f9dabc-e2cb-4493-8d4e-9372aae2ef6a.Text: "Goods of incredible rarity, shereen. But it's not just that — two dozen of my people lost their lives in the impenetrable emptiness of the void to acquire them. I cannot leave their families with nothing."

d9afa62b-0fc3-4e0f-99bc-dc97fdaa95ac.Text: {n}Ordinary smugglers do not dress so ostentatiously or behave so brazenly, and they are unlikely to spoil the mood of the Liege of Footfall with their mere appearance. This woman lost many people to obtain these "rarest of goods," and to get them back, she turned to Vladaym Tocara, the patron of all Cold Trade in the Expanse. Her cargo can be nothing other than xeno-artefacts — creations of the enemies of Humanity, branded with heresy.{/n}

6f4f1e40-08f9-4aee-bada-7035c70074fd.Text: {n}A simple and obvious thought occurs to you: the ostentatious outfit, the deliberately brash behaviour, the tales about valuable cargo — it is all smoke and mirrors. Most likely, Jae is a small-time smuggler eager to latch onto a bigger fish. She failed with Vladaym and now she has set her sights on you.{/n}

d2dbf076-b18e-4feb-9626-e892f202f380.Text: "I thought we were on the same page from the start, shereen. Please accept my sincerest apologies if that is not the case, and allow me to explain myself."

c48b8c84-d493-40ff-becd-c1154f2ce545.Text: "If I had told you directly, you would have become... shall we say, complicit. But since those illicit words did not escape my lips, you would hypothetically be agreeing merely to help me recapture a few containers. And if the azhi suddenly decided to thwart our plans, then all the void dogs would be unleashed on me alone. My sincerest wish was to protect you from any unnecessary trouble, shereen. I swear by the Exalted One!"

9245269e-e5ce-4fab-a427-b2fe0bd38188.Text: "Should I take that as a no?"

1cc98dba-1a12-4da6-be04-29fdcec8e3db.Text: "A fair deal, shereen." {n}Bridled excitement simmers in Jae's eyes.{/n} "If your heart desires, we'll split the recovered cargo... fifty-fifty. That will be fair. But if goods of incredible rarity do not interest you, then I'll make it worth your while with some bonds equal in value to a couple of full holds."

80d3dca4-297e-48a3-b720-a30ac62d8ce1.Text: "Ask as many as you wish, shereen. Trust is the key to a successful endeavour."

fd4c67c1-228e-4718-b0d6-f5967034b811.Text: {n}Heinrix coughs and says quickly and quietly,{/n} "She's a Cold Trader, a smuggler who deals in xenos artefacts. Apart from this heresy, I know of no other grave crimes committed by her."

1619c965-f860-4f94-84a1-a15f53727901.Text: {n}Her dark eyes light up with keen interest.{/n} "You truly know how to do business, shereen! You demand payment before giving an answer because you're aware of the weakness of my position... I respect that. And I don't know if it's the alcohol talking or just a feeling I have, but I want to take that risk with you."

df4bff0f-641c-4084-83c1-b6450c0dbea1.Text: {n}Jae salutes you with her glass in greeting.{/n} "Shereen! Glad to see you in good health! Have you, perchance, been moved from indifference to sympathy already? With regard to my predicament and all."

627a22ab-a0ba-4f18-8e15-9716e213d788.Text: {n}She reaches into her polished boot and produces a small package, which she offers to you.{/n} "True jewels are meant to be held in the hands of the worthiest, shereen. Please, accept this humble gift." {n}Jae smiles mysteriously and takes a sip of her fragrant drink.{/n}

369ebe0e-a54e-4f23-aafb-13892e7e8c04.Text: {n}Kibellah narrows her eyes in contempt.{/n} "Your trade is heresy. Your every word and gesture reeks of vice. Vice is all you can peddle."

810f5b8c-ad33-4493-8d5d-bfbc0e74e8c0.Text: "I've heard about a Heydari from Footfall, a local Cold Trader of little prominence." {n}The Proctor nods slightly to himself.{/n} "Not worth my time."

a3d68978-58b9-4d22-ba09-af83ee6708be.Text: {n}Jae's smile grows even more dazzling.{/n} "I do hope this cursory and altogether inappropriate character assessment from the distinguished Arbitrator will not hinder you from forming your own opinion of my many illustrious talents!"

4ce325a6-38a7-411a-8e1a-01f461bab592.Text: {n}Jae's eyes lose some of their lustre.{/n} "That's too bad... too bad. Well, in that case, thank you for listening to the tragic tale of a lady down on her luck. If you happen to change your mind, I'll be around here somewhere... actually, probably right here." {n}Jae bids you goodbye and turns to the bar.{/n} "Hey, Octaviana! Get me another bottle!"

616ed01b-43e0-481f-ae8f-c962a6abb0c7.Text: {n}She smiles somewhat groggily as she examines you over the glass that is raised to her lips.{/n} "Greetings, shereen. With whom do I have the honour of speaking?"

83a9dbad-6e75-4766-bc5c-33239cf4b743.Text: "Jae Heydari, at your service. Professional trader, shrewd commercial broker, and — may azhi steal my tongue if I'm lying — the most honest dealer on Footfall. Nonetheless, we all have our problems, and at times even one's many merits aren't enough to solve them. Perhaps it would be no trouble for a person with your kind of power and standing to assist someone with my kind of predicament?"

c65e928a-f873-4531-a8af-54b95439b797.Text: "May the Exalted One bless you and your progeny!" {n}Jae instantly pulls out a {g|Encyclopedia:Dataslate}data-slate{/g} and shows you a map of Footfall.{/n} "Then here's what we'll do. We shouldn't be seen together before we make it to the safe house. I'll head there first. I'll take my own special route so I won't be spotted."

7e68d86e-2f0a-4967-8386-f0c210a096f7.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, shereen, wonderful to see you here! You're practically a regular at the Amasecus now — the local flavour is clearly to your taste." {n}Jae laughs and brings a glass of amber liquid to her lips.{/n}

37f2b5b2-1c60-483b-b2cd-50d4187976b5.Text: "Better than the last time we met, shereen, may the Exalted One bless your path! However, it gets less and less comfortable for me on Footfall by the day — without the Liege's favour, this {g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Throne{/g}-forgotten station is a rather dangerous place to be. Maybe I'll move somewhere far away, as soon as I figure out how to rid myself of some unwanted liabilities and offload some inconvenient goods..."

23b37b77-229b-4de0-89a4-bd9c22adb5b7.Text: "No way am I passing through System Speculo again. It gives me the creeps every single time."

2f4704c1-3375-4e8a-ab65-3712b4503cf4.Text: "Footfall is the best place in the Expanse, and no one can convince me otherwise!"

a94015af-07df-4db3-94e3-d66d66d9fffd.Text: "Our Navigator once mixed up the systems Pulvis Platinum and Palatium Stellos. The captain flew into a rage, but what can you do to one of the Navis Nobilite?"

ae2077dd-e42a-4fe0-ab2c-bda1f75db26b.Text: "A turn doesn't go by without some drunken sod falling off the bridge outside the bar. Some might say someone should install rails on that thing, but I say someone should learn to hold their booze!"

cdd0ab99-5e95-4800-8714-69a0ae079e1b.Text: "As a kid, I used to think it was fun to throw rocks at servitors, but now I kinda feel sorry for them."

e3e54562-1a18-40d2-9f62-2bd92931fa0a.Text: "I tried that amasec of yours, and let me say this: rotgut is still the better booze!"

65f124c3-7ef9-4748-b8a0-efb54a155db6.Text: "Octaviana was a real knockout in her youth, and she's even more gorgeous now!"

9d036c25-c55c-4294-88c3-9ef33c4e5fc7.Text: "I think my nose got longer after a warp jump. Think I should go see a priest about it?"

cf65c371-4c28-498a-9448-28e40b42aff0.Text: "Oh, shereen, but isn't it reward enough for you to behold the light of my eyes?"

3e8f2a60-28dd-406f-b38f-0cfa7ef2b07a.Text: "Until we meet again, my kind friend!"

19b33f5e-d16e-4979-99b2-df6ab1456f92.Text: "Oi! Heydari! You do remember you owe me, don't you?"

fcbe71d2-cfa2-4022-beec-8ebe4ed919ff.Text: "Hah. I just can't stay mad at you for long, hon. Fine, off you go, then."

9502df43-7ffc-408c-ba65-a9b993b4b08b.Text: "That was a bad move. Just terrible."

c73776db-30e0-489c-b141-39c5b17f37aa.Text: "Who are you to teach me, ye lump? I was born with a regicide piece in my hands! My folks may well have conceived me on a gameboard!"

a47d46e8-16f8-4a60-a49e-fb771f366d77.Text: "Ugh, I bet I'm gonna sit here playing for ages again, and the foreman will have my head for it. But how can I leave? The game's just getting good!"

788e9798-693f-4ca8-91ab-305850b559a8.Text: "Five turns ago, the Footfall regicide champion got her head blown off after her win, and there was a knife fight for the second place."

3cdf130f-30db-465d-91af-76d11567fc67.Text: "Yeah, those were the real regicide days. The players are all wimps nowadays, and the stakes just aren't the same..."

c3787d12-0b48-41aa-b188-260afc6562a2.Text: "Things are back to normal on Footfall, I see."

ac6e0d13-5cbf-4328-a331-04fa9e971495.Text: "Who are these boys you work with?"

1d5af68e-fde6-45b8-9e0a-da0657b33d83.Text: "Let's see what you have to offer."

d2bbf282-79cd-4828-b710-60ebac66b87d.Text: "What kinds of goods are you willing to buy?"

1f34279b-fa87-4b4d-a206-aaeee3cba89f.Text: "How haven't you been arrested under Footfall's new patron? Have you not been approached by the confessors?"

27e0f10c-964b-4130-a468-ef28b116fa38.Text: "You seem to be at peace. Have you turned your back on heresy?"

a53b026d-991e-49d2-a0d1-ce599d4a06c4.Text: "Is that so? Very well, let's return to our discussion."

f04290db-1a18-4966-9523-067f0fc9a6b9.Text: {n}Ryzza falls silent, though her eyes don't leave your face. Her expression gradually shifts — from tactless interest to astonished deference.{/n} "I know you, {name}. Who would've thought a {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Criminal}high-flyer{/d} such as yourself would ever land in our neck of the woods... The audacious schemes you've pulled off, they're the stuff of legend — even the {g|Encyclopedia:KasballicaMission}Kasballica{/g} could learn a thing or two. For somebody like you, I'll offer only the best prices. The real deal."

0c9a2e82-1ffc-46cb-8d25-2dbb960241d7.Text: "We call ourselves the Fellowship of the Void — an association of enterprising like-minded people who help the upstanding citizens of the Imperium rid themselves of the possessions that are weighing them down."

1a2f150c-9133-4850-9b8c-014a3a2d48e4.Text: {n}Ryzza lowers her booming, raspy voice.{/n} "You heard about how the clipper Saint Cognatius got hit recently? The cargo was cleaned out, everything of value taken. Well, that was my boys' handiwork!"

65a8cb18-266a-4bf4-8b19-962c0315581e.Text: {n}She chuckles darkly.{/n} "Do you mean to threaten me, Tech-Priest? Well, then, I'll keep a record of this conversation, too. I wonder which of us will feel the harsh hand of justice first? Will it be me, standing in chains before your brethren, or you, standing in an airlock before my boys?"

fff4140b-7633-46a3-8bdd-d1abe2c4414f.Text: "I want to congratulate you on your initiative. {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_Footfall_VladaymDead}Smacking Vladaym down{/d} in the moment of his triumph — that was a shrewd move. I think even he would see the poetic justice of it, if he wasn't currently floating headless in orbit with all the other fools whose luck ran out."

c7022521-f490-47d9-94f4-15432e13a054.Text: {n}Ryzza nods solemnly.{/n} "It's a heavy burden, but someone's got to shoulder it, don't they? I'm glad you see where I'm coming from!"

422d3c4b-626f-48dc-8acb-687e9062d842.Text: "Tech is always the best. If it's broke — no sweat, we'll fix it or take it apart. And if you score something so nasty that your fussy everyday traders won't even look at it, fear not, just bring it on over. Leave it to me and my boys to find the right buyer!"

e50da80f-d83c-4098-86eb-0dd808f59328.Text: "And I'm almost used to the new leg." {n}She raps her knuckles on the augmetic.{/n} "It can break bones just like that, and it looks solid enough!"

ad9c9d1f-c18d-4873-ac75-d6ea04b70c6f.Text: {n}The woman looks to be in her forties, and she is surveying you with interest. Her right eye appears almost black against her dusky skin, while her left eye emits a greenish light filtered through the smudged lens of a prosthesis. Her arms are tattooed all the way from the base of her shoulders to her knuckles.{/n}

0987f751-dbfe-4064-95db-293fe22065b7.Text: "I should also thank you for finally {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_Footfall_HieronimusDead}shutting up Reverend Hieronymus{/d}! If trials really do cleanse the soul, then after weeks of listening to his shrill hectoring, I must have the soul of a saint."

259cb4d6-ca91-41e7-9b39-5dc95821863f.Text: {n}Ryzza plasters a shocked expression on her face.{/n} "Please, no need to be so crude! Your esteemed self no doubt is aware that Hieronymus preaches that asceticism is a virtue, and that only by rejecting material wealth can we ascend in faith. Well, I couldn't agree more! We are merely helping the servants of the Imperium to be a little more like Hieronymus... and taking a small commission for our trouble."

2dd1f946-4189-4e08-a0b4-451de4628475.Text: {n}Ryzza nods seriously.{/n} "I have, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. No more profane amulets or anything. All cultists and heretics who wormed their way into my crew took a long walk out through a short airlock. And the servants of the Ruinous Powers who took advantage of my moment of weakness and pushed me toward heresy were sent to meet their own Dark Gods." {n}Ryzza smiles nastily.{/n} "I doubt they'll recognise their minions after what I did to them, though."

f05cb257-0503-43e8-a614-a2c12d08b30c.Text: "Confession? What are you on about? Old Ryzza just likes to embellish when she wants to make an impression! The nonsense she spouts in the presence of important people..."

fa2e3c3f-4148-4cb5-87fd-bd15dea1bd72.Text: {n}You notice Abelard's face twist in disgust. It would seem he has a rather strong opinion on the individuals to whom Ryzza refers as the Fellowship of the Void.{/n}

c8cad089-688f-4126-a1ac-e8a7d27726de.Text: {n}Heinrix gives you a look, one that is more amused than suspicious.{/n} "Quite the admirers you have, Rogue Trader..."

318fa7b5-2803-4275-84e6-adb5b7a63c1a.Text: "By the way, my boys have been buzzing in everyone's ears at the Amasecus, telling them about what happened in the Rykad System. And they didn't hold back when it came to describing their encounter with the kind {mf|lord|lady} who wasn't about to rob them of their already battered hides." {n}Ryzza nods meaningfully and gratefully.{/n} "Old Ryzza doesn't forget a good turn, and neither do her friends — you can take my word for it."

4fc16e37-6163-4ca5-aeb7-eaac47d02462.Text: "Ugh! What's a lawman doing here? I hear you got Sargona — groxes gore his soul. So, what? Now you've decided to go after the rest of us?"

8564f350-fcf7-4497-b2e3-e68427705353.Text: "I am not here for you, heretic. So, keep your head down and remember that the next time we meet, I might feel more generous and spare a bullet or two just for you."

279e2b7b-6c1d-4d85-b256-74be8a02e05f.Text: "I knew it, lawman — as long as we don't touch the tithe, it's like you can't see us." {n}The woman turns back to you, looking very pleased with herself.{/n}

9602233b-1cf3-4d56-807f-67f780ea7277.Text: "Welcome back!" {n}Ryzza raises her glass to you, smiles, and "winks" with her prosthetic eye.{/n}

7ef0abd3-88b8-4bb9-a73f-c1809463cfe8.Text: "So I don't know if I'd agree with your esteemed self that things are back to normal, but I'll gladly drink to the new normal. To your health!"

15749b56-e4fa-42b2-bda2-e035a2373982.Text: "Looking for something specific? You're buying, or maybe selling? Don't be shy, just ask — old Ryzza knows all kinds of folks. My boys will fetch you anything your heart desires!"

5e15d2d7-c927-46fe-9763-6b5d892fb46d.Text: "How can old Ryzza serve your esteemed self? Does the {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_FootfallOfficial}Rogue Trader{/d} wish to buy, or sell? No need to be shy — old Ryzza's boys will treat you right! And we've got special offers for business partners."

bec04d9f-355b-4a52-ae38-5f4aa457b8f5.Text: "The handling of sacred technology by laypersons uninitiated in the Omnissiah's priesthood is a Category Eight blasphemy. Incriminating evidence of profane acts perpetrated by the unit named 'old Ryzza' has been recorded for use in future judicial proceedings."

38a714e1-2c7c-4523-99d1-e57af55aaa04.Text: {n}Ryzza's face breaks into a broad smile.{/n} "That old rascal! I thought he'd croaked in the mines a long time ago, but old man Bakhval's still {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_PiratesLetGo}alive and kicking{/d}, you say? Me and him have been through a lot of interesting scrapes together, and, oh, all the weird and wonderful things we've sto— acquired. Bakhval wouldn't send his regards along with just anyone — you must've done him a good turn. And because of that, old Ryzza's going to give you a special discount."

31ae8318-c23b-402b-a254-edc41b9cb37d.Text: "Well, how should I put it... with the Lord Inquisitor on the station, folks still have to keep a bit of a lid on their activities, but with Incendia and her hounds gone, I can definitely breathe easier. Shipments are slowly starting up again, anyone who worked with Chorda has been thrown for a loop Footfall-style, and folks can do business in the Amasecus again without any trouble."

f7d738df-14a4-4526-b837-8bb1506bfc42.Text: "What confessors? Haven't seen any confessors here." {n}She smiles grimly.{/n} "And if you hear folks say they saw some people enter a room and those people never came out — it's all gossip and slander. I got no problems with no confessors."

7c9eecb2-fe26-46d0-adbe-46f79e51666b.Text: "Fear not, young man. We took care of the attackers. Do you know who they were?"

90aac293-6e21-4c9e-bef7-9aa94e03eb5f.Text: "What was that? An attack right on dock?"

6a97853c-acb7-4e0f-9a05-6de48fad4871.Text: "I'm ready to pay the Liege a visit."

b0146806-92ac-41c9-a468-e4da4e0ec052.Text: "I would like to have a look around the station first."

94e16652-2e8e-41bb-b1ee-87a1af1da622.Text: "A gang of puny thugs attacked me — the Emperor's anointed, Rogue Trader von Valancius. Such a poorly organised attempt on my life can only be seen as a personal affront!"

4364f39a-27cc-41dd-9005-9be8fc8a8afb.Text: "Stop quivering, unwashed worm, and answer me — who would dare to attempt such an outrageous attack?"

f8c207e1-23d7-4055-93a8-e75eafacb67c.Text: "Does this kind of thing happen often around here?"

d1aaa2d7-76d8-4684-8ed4-209f8beff402.Text: "Go and report this to the Liege."

302d7e4c-2a81-49a9-9214-f2324909afd7.Text: {n}The welcome procession is not particularly long, but it does attract attention. Everyone is dressed in their finest apparel, every button gleaming. Standing in front of the others is a woman with clearly expensive {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}implants{/g}. She bows in a solemn curtsy.{/n} "{d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_FootfallOfficial}Rogue Trader{/d}! Footfall welcomes you! On behalf of the Liege, Lord Vladaym Tocara, allow me to express my joy at your arrival. The Liege awaits you at his residence, but should you have other business to conduct on the station, I will be honoured to serve as your guide!"

f5ca46a0-1605-4c05-8f18-3f5724772f31.Text: "There are certain problems, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, but the Liege can acquaint you with them far better than I."

234c6d16-6268-455c-a43d-5713aeaa252f.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, forgive me for not welcoming you with the appropriate obeisance. We were told that you would prefer to {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_FootfallIncognito}arrive on Footfall incognito{/d}, and so we are trying to attract as little attention as possible."

6333fe3d-64b1-4d57-9e3f-cb717fa2f4ca.Text: "I'm here on the behalf of the Liege of Footfall, Lord Vladaym Tocara. The Liege awaits the chance to speak with you at his residence, but if you happen to have other business to attend to, I can serve as your guide and tell you about the station."

86c730e9-0b96-4c1c-a201-5c9bca21162f.Text: {n}Behind her polite, soft tone, you detect the slightest hint of nervousness. It is as if she is reciting a reply she has carefully prepared beforehand.{/n}

0db55d68-b571-4270-900a-73195777c593.Text: {n}Her reply seems candid, her tone pleasant and smooth.{/n}

39659121-08a3-42ca-bff1-b07a1ee2b6bc.Text: "Shooting, yes... Attacks on nobles, not very often... Unless it's the Anvers. They're vicious. Not a week goes by without them killing and gutting somebody. They're wicked h-heretics. They respect nothing. They f-follow no rules!"

d83d6f6f-3bcc-48fa-97ce-61b11dfab133.Text: "I would wager that this was not an assassination attempt, but rather a common raid. The halfwits had no idea that they would run into you, Lord Captain. Still, it wouldn't hurt to be on our guard. The great have been known to fall to the pathetic, we can attest to this from our recent experience..." {n}Abelard frowns and rubs the bridge of his nose as if fatigued.{/n}

aff30bf5-aa66-4b4b-9a6b-67a30518d58c.Text: {n}Abelard sighs and casually places his hand on his weapon.{/n}

1f8af745-0bc1-4a23-9a24-1d454b58b152.Text: "Of course, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Please, follow m—" {n}She doesn't get to finish.{/n}

eba8a8a3-0a20-40f3-814a-9cd8e8f84e23.Text: {n}The shivering young servant looks up at you with horror in his eyes.{/n} "Emperor p-protect me... They killed... killed..."

3b843f98-95ee-4a02-b589-658eef270a09.Text: "Certainly, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! As you w—" {n}She doesn't get to finish.{/n}

0e30736f-3165-4b97-a1ba-63b21b2a4965.Text: "You really should talk to the Liege about this. I'm just—" {n}She doesn't get a chance to say the rest.{/n}

5d5e6f5d-b99f-4f29-9421-0c547e6538b5.Text: "Y-Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, those guys were A-A-Anvers... they're a gang... they're the worst, I'm telling you! They're scared of no one, not even Liege Tocara..." {n}He glances around like he's expecting more bandits to appear.{/n}

376935d6-5876-4282-973f-67e7379b252c.Text: "Every time. I warn them, and then they go all, 'Dear Emperor, our lord and saviour, how could this have happened, who could have thought?'" {n}Idira spits on the ground in annoyance.{/n}

e5123ef8-86aa-4376-bec1-837499b7aa41.Text: {n}Cassia's lip curls slightly.{/n} "This is so familiar — behind the amber-coloured scattering of words of welcome, far less appealing hues lurk, murky and diluted. The look of someone accustomed to lying and hiding their intentions."

9f05e01c-8000-42b6-af34-3fa53780afdd.Text: {n}Idira jerks her head, shakes it, and hisses through her teeth,{/n} "Someone's coming. And they're coming for us. Watch out, Lord Captain."

3a2b332a-b443-4752-842d-1a953d3e7f74.Text: "Judging by the voices, there's a lot of them. Angry. They've got teeth, but they aren't that sharp. Their strength is their numbers..."

0d492831-80ea-441a-8687-3ea4014d0120.Text: "Pray, what are you talking about? What could you mean by such a cryptic pronou—" {n}She doesn't get to say the rest.{/n}

28cd08e3-c987-447e-9a74-892ea51451ab.Text: "Yes... I'm sorry, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}... I'll just go report to the Liege... They killed her, they killed my lady, oh, this is terrible!"

bc3810c9-e827-446b-b893-880029065a9c.Text: "Are the servants of Footfall's new patron giving you trouble?"

9510160f-f82d-42c8-813e-e45b9d480a16.Text: "I received an invitation to a meeting."

0cd42d79-cee6-486c-a121-5d23f266d87a.Text: "I want to make a trade deal."

8fe81d37-0d65-405f-8f19-53ee909b6486.Text: "You are an Explorator? Then why are you here instead of exploring faraway systems?"

450701cf-0a58-4d02-b593-fa6dabc1d5c1.Text: "I seek the friendship of the Adeptus Mechanicus."

d2e26637-3d7d-4655-b9b4-dae0015354ba.Text: "Why are you here and not, say, at the Liege's palace?"

8711a38a-4452-49b7-86e0-625bef532c42.Text: "I confirm I am willing to accept the payment."

01bb7373-7a5e-4388-8889-c944473b03b9.Text: "Pasqal, do these words have a translation?"

bea8a2f5-bfb9-48d0-b1bf-8069e77403d9.Text: [Show the data-slate] "I have collected planetary data that may interest you."

6f98f919-a9fb-46de-b92a-a049af471cac.Text: "No payment is needed. Consider the promethium my gift and a sign of my hope for collaboration in the future."

6a64689e-3143-42a5-b6c7-e2dac18cc136.Text: "You seem to be speaking Gothic, but..."

2e8b980d-3f53-4957-a340-f59466a725f4.Text: "Why are you interested in xenotech? Isn't that heresy?"

122cd40f-5dea-4e12-99fc-5646d94f2726.Text: "So what happened in the Tinaurus System?"

78b19d12-a6f1-4bea-9fa7-06b63bd671f5.Text: "You waited thirty years to pay up?"

82cbfbb2-de78-48b1-8200-c48a3d629374.Text: "You are saying that my dynasty has had extensive business dealings with you?"

f239309a-2aae-4498-ae77-504b4ffaa09b.Text: "Why do you want information about planets?"

00fd8ab8-5f31-4091-b322-033eb9e762b8.Text: {n}The tall, hunched {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priest{/g} stares at you unblinkingly. A breathing mask conceals his gaunt features, the skin on his hands is of a sickly grey hue, while his {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}augments{/g} show signs of combat damage and are plated in black chromium, giving him a general air of lugubriousness.{/n}

9dcc367c-fc59-4c5d-8e3e-58134b854adc.Text: "Negative. Units that identified themselves as confessors did indeed //perform an intrusion//approach us//. They were informed that members of the Adeptus Mechanicus exist outside their jurisdiction. A theological dispute followed." {n}Opticon-22 falls into a cryptic silence.{/n}

372e79c3-5363-4f30-a11a-d0a1e6b5a8ee.Text: "Access has been granted to the following options: information exchange, strengthening of diplomatic links, //trade deals//donations//."

29d3bf58-dc2a-4342-927e-80f5ef35c247.Text: "The stipulated //payment//reciprocal offering// from the Cognisance Fleet can be made to von Valancius assets at the current time, after which the contractual obligation will be //fulfilled//archived//. Confirm your status regarding acceptance of the //payment//reciprocal offering//."

39a1f1cf-c9c2-4a28-90ee-2f4d75a2760a.Text: "The Cognisance Fleet is an Explorator Fleet //formed//produced// by the Adeptus Mechanicus for the purpose of //surveying//optionally conquering// the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g}. The fleet's core squadron is located in — data classified — while auxiliary echelons and autonomous void vessels are operating throughout the entirety of the Koronus Expanse."

e3d95ad3-b3ed-4902-a68a-86a6d2762ef6.Text: {n}Not without a hint of pride in his voice, Opticon-22 snaps,{/n} "Data classified."

1ce260e5-6285-47a3-87f9-599f6ec0ae18.Text:
"This unit functioned as a senior planetary scout for the duration of — data classified — procedural cycles. It was distinguished with:
1) three promotions by one grade,
2) the right to a tier 2 sacred {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}augmentation{/g},
3) a notation in the fleet-wide archive as a 'valuable unit.'"

8cd9034a-fe76-4c3c-a6de-ef58def63e0f.Text: "The designation 'Opticon' is an identifier with //an illustrious history//a significant number of archive references// and is used by many Explorators in the Cognisance Fleet. The extension '22' is a custom addition made by the current unit designed to highlight the unit's unique personality."

f0c34f83-8f3c-4f2e-a5a9-29175602d355.Text: "Valid assessment. The Tinaurus System was //a great test of faith//an assessment of this unit's durability threshold//an act of destructive xenocide//."

259fbff8-338b-4f8b-a53f-99bac31fb61f.Text: "This statement is true. The Cognisance Fleet concluded 1292 contractual obligations with the von Valancius dynasty as //represented//led//administered// by the counterparty identified as Theodora von Valancius."

5a4ea208-3683-4b55-b988-2ee75c0be659.Text:
"This unit performs:
1) residential representation,
2) maintenance of the bureaucratic machine for the purpose of ratification of the insulating boundaries,
3) management of the Kappa Thread supply line,
4) compilation of astrographic reconnaissance data."

df038fb5-e956-4c2a-a4f3-bd58a5e19c58.Text: "//Universal mobile orbital deployment extractiums//Astra Arator processing complexes// in the quantity stipulated in the contractual obligation. Each unit has undergone a cycle of maintenance liturgies and has been assessed for conformance to the sacred Standard Template Construct."

ada3788b-866c-44af-a900-a1027d1b2e7d.Text: "Prolonged communication with laypeople of high social standing causes this unit //vexation//desire for forceful cessation of vital functions//, //grief//decline in motivation//, //righteous fury//willingness to initiate purity protocol//. Remaining in an area of repair and maintenance of sacred machines is beneficial to this unit's cognitive functions."

0cead8d8-8871-40a6-9c39-c326715e9f51.Text: {n}Pasqal and Opticon-22 exchange glances and a short series of binharic signals before bowing their heads in satisfaction. Opticon-22's head bows noticeably lower than Pasqal's.{/n}

b453e601-fd0c-40ae-8919-48592b738a62.Text: "May the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}'s favour be with my tech-comrades." {n}Pasqal reverently touches the Explorator insignia on his robe.{/n}

842a76a7-6193-44d2-9d98-85cde7b65a4b.Text: "This statement is true. The behavioural dynamics typical of lay groups are frequently devoid of logical patterns and are taxing to analyse."

126d44a4-3743-4204-bdae-f957a3b41133.Text: "The request is accepted. The sacred machines will be loaded into the hold of your vessel. The contractual obligation Logisticar Theta is concluded. The Cognisance Fleet thanks House von Valancius for its cooperation."

2abda748-c0f2-4431-9dba-78414194122e.Text: "This unit is satisfied with the outcome of this communication."

b5e0804a-7c52-42a2-90b5-434fa4d99b20.Text: {n}A hiss of static resembling a sigh comes out of Pasqal's {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g}.{/n} "Opticon-22's functions can be conveyed through flesh-speak as... functioning as the Fleet's diplomatic mission, overseeing shipments, ensuring that the laity does not encroach upon the Explorators' sphere of interest, and collecting data on star systems."

56a1f257-a9b9-4a13-9f8f-a3ca6ddb25ea.Text: "After a reconnaissance mission in the Tinaurus System, this unit was promoted to the rank of Logis and transferred to Footfall in order to perform the functions appropriate for its current status." {n}There is something close to wistfulness in Opticon-22's otherwise emotionless voice.{/n}

1d68383c-78f1-4b8e-9537-7acb62964a61.Text: {n}Pasqal and Opticon-22 turn to you and snap in unison,{/n} "Data classified."

35bfc3f8-e58b-4ab5-9967-d7cd41acfa0b.Text: "Oh, it most certainly is, esteemed one." {n}The venom that is seeping from Jae's honeyed voice could probably kill a large grox.{/n}

5b349eae-7b45-4a25-86bb-6c73edf3b61f.Text: "I presume this 'theological dispute' involved the use of the Omnissiah's sacred gifts. Of the force, plasma, and otherwise martyrdom-bringing varieties."

a411706c-dc4b-4b59-9ae3-ca157ecdb63d.Text: {n}Abelard lets out a long and heavy sigh.{/n} "There was once a Tech-Acolyte in Lady Theodora's retinue who knew the unique language of the esteemed Tech-Priests... I only began to realise the true value of his abilities after he'd been devoured by a xenobeast on some nondescript world."

04592e3d-78e2-46ed-b763-f19b1e528a88.Text: "The Cognisance Fleet //finds it reasonable to believe//believes// that forbidden knowledge in the hands of the laity causes destruction and violations that go against the Omnissiah's will. Weakness of mind and will unleashes xenoheresy, which consumes the laity whole."

dcfe7417-0dea-4647-a4e1-a0f36452e918.Text: "An example that demonstrates the outlined pattern: a void station in the system of Langrenn's Belt. According to the data available to the Cognisance Fleet, the heretics on the station have trade relations with xenos for the sake of obtaining dangerous and pernicious technology. The destruction of these heretics is of high priority, but not high enough to demand immediate action."

8c5ad3ed-444f-4058-b31a-76a8f69b7a3e.Text: "The asset allocation process concluded... 2.663 Terran years later. Transportation of assets to the Furibundus System took... 16.862 Terran years. Final delivery of assets to Footfall took... 0.331 Terran years."

ff4c1eff-7df0-4161-8e87-29edef114a83.Text: "Confirmed. I wish to //discharge//reciprocally validate// the mutual contractual obligation designated Logisticar Theta."

0b608b03-78d3-4907-9d47-a648856ee8be.Text: "Under the contractual obligation in question, 34.761 Terran years ago the Explorator Cognisance Fleet received from //representatives//authorised units// of the von Valancius dynasty a volume of high-grade promethium equal to the fuel capacity of six Tantalion void tankers."

a0db5376-b177-4493-aca9-6ed322c7e3a8.Text: "Received it, and then didn't pay. Compensate. Remunerate. Settle accounts. Should I go on, or is that enough synonyms?"

a53c7602-4d68-439c-ab81-f209a70dd1df.Text: "Execution of //payment//reciprocal offering// is in accordance with the specifications of the contractual obligation. Allocation of assets from the holdings of the Cognisance Fleet was initiated when the tankers reached the main squadron... 14.905 Terran years after the initial transaction."

9ad0b03c-4501-4ec3-8bd5-003efcb8e1e5.Text: "Clever. If you had been purchasing fuel for a squadron at the other end of the Imperium, you may never have had to pay at all — we would have turned to dust before you made it there and back."

df470172-135d-417c-847e-b88e2315df28.Text: "Great creations of the Omnissiah, blessed be His beneficence, which has bestowed upon these complexes industrial might and a full cycle of reproduction and life support."

c3253ab2-67be-4909-a114-eaa808f66e61.Text: "The Explorator Fleet will also accept information about planets in the Koronus Expanse that have not previously been recorded in the planetary register."

7e6c3ab8-d7e3-4e57-8e77-6be2158920aa.Text: "The request is accepted. The contractual obligation Logisticar Theta is concluded. The Cognisance Fleet thanks House von Valancius for its cooperation. The status of the unit's requests will be increased."

9b262016-e02c-46f9-91fc-a9e41f5611d6.Text: "Omnifaceted study of the Koronus Expanse is the //sacred mission//operational objective// of the Cognisance Fleet. Information about the planets and star systems of the Koronus Expanse //must//will// be compiled, studied, and transferred to the holy repositories of Mars upon completion of the //great march of Exploration//mission//. This process increases the totality of knowledge and decreases the totality of ignorance in the universe."

c06d9d06-86aa-448f-9f3a-f872866960a3.Text: {n}With a respectful nod, the Tech-Priest takes the data-slate.{/n} "The collected data is //of interest//significant//compliant with the criteria for cooperation//. The Cognisance Fleet thanks you for your contribution and guarantees the provision of a reciprocal //service//indulgence// in the form of parts and equipment."

4a5c0ca8-9b6a-4d1f-b6a8-c6f2f00aad5f.Text: {n}After surveying the data, the Tech-Priest rasps,{/n} "The collected data is //of no interest//insignificant//not compliant with the criteria for cooperation//. I request a more substantive dataset."

6fedb7ee-e3b0-4411-9149-f2d26427c3c5.Text: "Reporting: with your //help//contribution//, the sectors within the Kappa Thread supply line have been fully //studied//cognised//. In accordance with protocol, a moratorium has been placed upon further cooperation in the sphere of planetary reconnaissance. The moratorium can be lifted and cooperation resumed upon receipt of direct instructions from the Cognisance Fleet conclave."

42906248-4b92-49d5-8f73-d10f0ea404c8.Text: "Initiating official greeting procedure for //esteemed//high-value// visitors. //Glory//Success// to House von Valancius." {n}A binharic aria begins to flow from the scratched {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g} attached to the Tech-Priest's chest.{/n} "Requesting information exchange regarding contractual obligation Logisticar Theta."

a828ef70-2c40-4efa-9e6f-363fad04c8da.Text: "The Cognisance Fleet values the laity's diligence in furthering the goal of total knowledge acquisition. Privileged service status is hereby granted. A note to this effect will be added to your file."

6718c078-8be2-4f58-b248-7bdb78b883cc.Text: "Reporting: the Kappa Thread supply line is ready to continue cooperation with the von Valancius dynasty in the sphere of planetary reconnaissance."

5569c530-9b46-4355-b619-c99d73f7a123.Text: "//Recognising//Greeting//Transmitting deference signal to// the unit defined as the liberator of the sacred world of Eufrates II. May the Omnissiah protect His //faithful//vow-algorithm-compliant// servants."

a94cf5a0-a39f-425b-9307-ce1de8efd546.Text: "The most substantial was Pact 8-Yul, in accordance with which Archmagos Cubis Delphim, Data-Usher of the Sevenfold-Hallowed Workshop of the sacred world of Eufrates II, was transferred to the planet Kiava Gamma to //perform the duties of//minister as// its Fabricator-Censor. The services of such a highly //enlightened//enhanced//authorised// servant were //recompensed via the offering of//paid for with// a seven-year contract granting the Fleet's exploration vessels maintenance privileges at the Kiava Gamma facilities."

2617acbd-76dd-42bc-b335-9edb482fcdc5.Text: "That is true. In the last couple of decades, Lady Theodora took pains to form a strong relationship with the Cognisance Fleet. She turned down a dozen candidates looking for the right tech-monitor to watch over Kiava Gamma."

4927304f-3cc7-490f-a778-980bf953a60e.Text: {n}The humming servo-skulls hovering around you break into a veritable aria of binharic greeting sounds. Opticon-22 responds with a measured nod.{/n}

a60336e0-1500-4b84-ad7f-b75e5bc18c09.Text: "Initiating identification procedure. This unit is defined as Logis Opticon-22 and is a //fully authorised representative//structural part// of the Cognisance Fleet and the priesthood of the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMechanicus}Adeptus Mechanicus{/g}. Access has been granted to the following options: information exchange, strengthening of diplomatic links, //trade deals//donations//."

1f636f06-5e27-41ac-b293-43c757bfa17b.Text: "The priesthood of the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMechanicus}Adeptus Mechanicus{/g} //is interested in//considers expeditious// cooperation with Rogue Traders. Under the terms of the Treaty of {g|Encyclopedia:Mars}Mars{/g}, it is willing to provide services to the von Valancius dynasty. The priority of service tasks can be raised if diplomatic links are strengthened."

9d9ab47d-4acb-4e65-a6d4-a1664c056e06.Text: "The informational capabilities of flesh-speak are lacking." {n}Opticon-22 is silent for a long time. Then he says,{/n} "I function as the Fleet's diplomatic mission, oversee shipments, and ensure that the laity does not encroach upon the Explorators' sphere of interest."

b7d1ceed-d9e1-4ec0-9ad1-f98d8376d0d5.Text: "My archive contains data on the reconnaissance of the Tinaurus System and the associated special circumstances. I express my respect for a veteran and adherent of the Fleet."

40f34b0f-d1a4-482b-aced-efe3b882df9b.Text: "What became of the ship that you used to get here? It is the property of the von Valancius dynasty."

d16044a5-67e4-49f8-9dcf-c267e877ecad.Text: "I need information. What happened on Kiava Gamma and how did you end up here?"

5a025216-a763-4782-9b81-58f34f7ba5b8.Text: "You were hurling accusations at your masters. That is a sign of treason, and it must be punished accordingly. Do you realise this?"

b4ef6ff4-42d3-4e02-aa70-cd2fc35f962d.Text: Ordered that the resentful refugees from Kiava Gamma be punished and the rest let go.

5cafc700-89b5-4212-91da-b565c9cca7d9.Text: "I'm giving you one hour to hand the ones shouting profanities over to the enforcers on my ship. They will be executed. The rest of you are free to go."

0196717c-e62b-45f0-8119-6d29c011cf3c.Text: Ordered that the resentful refugees from Kiava Gamma be punished and the rest taken aboard the voidship.

69e06676-6ed2-4d9e-b9f5-982e1282f3bc.Text: "All those who shouted profanities are to be handed over to the enforcers on my ship — they will be executed. The rest may join my ship's crew."

25f4c34e-a3e5-49b0-842d-c86f841e3418.Text: Pardoned the refugees from Kiava Gamma and took them aboard the voidship.

c85f59ed-0e8d-4da5-a8b1-6b474c9dee19.Text: "You are pardoned. You may board my ship and continue to serve the von Valancius dynasty."

6b282659-a00a-43ca-8160-9b371e643da8.Text: "Get out of my sight, all of you."

97a19329-1f78-4854-83fd-02d2364eafc9.Text: Executed the refugees from Kiava Gamma for disrespecting their rightful rulers.

9564f332-ad07-4f3d-be21-0e162197c595.Text: [Attack] "For insulting the rulers whose reign has been blessed by the Golden Throne, I sentence you to death!"

a81b642b-feaa-4f76-b377-f809f54ff7ae.Text: {n}The refugees from Kiava Gamma are looking at you, some with apprehensive frowns, some with unconcealed gratitude.{/n}

a9f7249a-0df7-4b08-aca7-80da00f30d82.Text: {n}The refugees offer deep bows, stuttering over their expressions of gratitude.{/n} "It will be done! We'll do as you say..."

91d5f614-b674-4a63-b1a8-2431f0de496a.Text: "Come now, shereen, relent. What can an illustrious Rogue Trader expect from wretches in rags whose weak spirit could not withstand a single blow of fate?"

e4b66f92-c50d-46ed-bc4a-ec086fb91fbd.Text:
{n}Idira freezes, listening to something. Then she blurts out in a changed voice,{/n} "The first beast, its body wounded, crawled into a hole under the palace of an eminent lord. The second beast, its skin in ulcers, perished in an asteroid grave.
The third beast, its essence cursed, is curled up in the glow of a yellow sun..."

f71490fc-5bc9-44e9-bb91-7a03a7d9478e.Text: "We told you everything back in the square... Things are rough on Kiava Gamma. Maybe there isn't even a Kiava Gamma anymore. The planet was attacked by a horde of heretics — they shouted unholy prayers and cut down people left and right. We heard everything from orbit, listening to one {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g}-cast after another. We realised there wasn't anyone left to save, so we thought we'd run... but then it was like our crew went mad somehow. The captain smashed his own head against a {g|Encyclopedia:Cogitator}cogitator{/g}, and so did half of the officers. Everyone who survived did their best to steer the ship into the {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}warp{/g} and here we are..."

38118b47-dbbf-495a-a217-cd0ff683b108.Text: {n}One by one, the refugees fall to their knees.{/n} "Please, have mercy! A few idiots shouted some things, that's all! We shut them up ourselves already. It was their grief and fear talking... Please don't punish the rest of us for it!"

e554bff6-1b15-43e9-b68a-1928174fa1fd.Text: {n}The refugees bow deeply and obsequiously.{/n} "It will be done! We'll do just as you say!"

4e23c288-a28d-4e02-a884-682ab33930fd.Text: {n}Their eyes beam.{/n} "Praise be to the Emperor! We're saved and pardoned! We'll do as we're told, we won't say another word..." {n}Bowing hastily, the refugees back away from you.{/n}

f0e0bd7d-1512-4397-9e4b-6c0124d2d067.Text: {n}The refugees grab their meagre possessions and all but run away.{/n}

9d593443-92c2-406e-8a1e-3e0dd46f66f8.Text: "Only three ships made it out alive, ours being one of them. We don't know what happened to the other two, they never made it to Footfall. Maybe they disappeared in the warp, or maybe something else happened to them..."

6363411e-b267-4026-b7af-f68c52a72f5b.Text: "Apologies... we couldn't save it. The ship was damaged during the escape — we're lucky it got us all the way to Footfall. It's at the far docks, but there isn't much use for it anymore — it doesn't look like it's going to fly anywhere, and the local recolligers have already removed some of the valuable parts. You can send your people to take apart whatever is left, scavenge some components."

a81576a4-28d3-41b2-8ce7-09580c92305c.Text: {n}Pasqal's voice sounds impassive and cold:{/n} "Vituperation directed at the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMechanicus}Adeptus Mechanicus{/g} was likewise registered. Denial is meaningless."

f9aff931-85e4-4e53-b4c5-56d7c274a6fe.Text: {n}Heinrix looks at the man closely, then at you.{/n} "Corrupted vox-casts... A special breed of heresy that requires knowledge of unholy arts. Kiava Gamma could have fallen under the influence of twisted {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priests{/g} — having once succumbed to corruption, they forget all limitations imposed by faith and delve into unbridled and dangerous research."

a4335860-0381-4303-9253-de6d16e30dcc.Text: "The map of the Expanse was revealed to me before the Sea of Souls roiled and tangled the paths. How did you, desperate ones, reach Footfall all the way from the Cranach System without a {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Navigator{/g}?"

103e7f46-214e-4377-9586-015e9f53c9ad.Text: {n}Frightened by Cassia's appearance, the refugee covers his face with his hands, trembling violently.{/n} "P-please forgive my w-worthless words... We were feeling our way in the dark, you c-could say — all we had is some old maps. We prayed to the God-Emperor day and night while our helmsman plotted the course. A m-miracle, it must have been, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"

35109c51-f8fe-4fdb-a0ac-7fdbe54068fb.Text: [Give him a dazzling smile] "Master van Calox! I knew you could not resist my charms!"

ee278281-0d1b-4c81-a6c4-655316f0f320.Text: "I am pleased to see you again, Heinrix."

6fa35bc5-4c27-40d1-8657-09ba0f8c9d80.Text: "Greetings, Interrogator. To what do I owe the pleasure of this latest visit?"

dab4cc44-92f9-4124-84a6-08eae871cd77.Text: [Step closer and lower your voice] "I am ever so glad to have you back."

f23ed7c8-c50a-4969-836e-0f05cfc4bef0.Text: "What exactly caused this need to rejoin my crew?"

492efc42-3746-414f-b8c7-9d3d28a4a4ec.Text: "I can't really say no, can I?"

092089d9-e629-4ac7-b68f-ed73fa323a21.Text: "Heinrix, would you mind translating the torrent of verbiage you just unleashed upon me?"

e6e25898-fe8a-46a3-b624-0226681e09c7.Text: "I object to such an abuse of power by the Inquisition! I am a Rogue Trader, not some peasant to be pushed around!"

bd966f6d-6d9b-427d-9aec-31388279647e.Text: "I, Rogue Trader {name} von Valancius, welcome the agent of the Golden Throne aboard my ship and take on the responsibility of assisting him in the fight against the evil that threatens Humanity."

08642e73-6bf4-46cf-8bbe-b66ec2acc1a8.Text: "A sanctioned psyker with an Inquisitorial rosette in my retinue? For free, no less? The other Rogue Traders will be positively green with envy!"

c1b836f7-c052-4705-a1fb-16abca7fbf48.Text: "I'm not fond of the methods used by the Inquisition, but I will assist you in any way I can."

ada944eb-0edc-48dd-979d-36eb4e1b6299.Text: {n}Heinrix sighs.{/n} "Your directness of expression does you credit. Alas, your ship will have to accommodate me once more."

f552b6aa-3c25-4091-901e-402e81503072.Text: {n}Heinrix momentarily closes his eyes, as if your first remark has thrown him off and made him forget the speech he prepared.{/n} "Rogue Trader."

80d763bc-168a-4ba9-b42f-d5fcba3a062e.Text: "The Inquisition? {name}, you never mentioned you socialised with such... distinguished servants of the Emperor. I'll bet it takes someone truly remarkable to warrant such eminent and close attention!" {n}Jae lets out a laugh.{/n}

b477fe7d-4dac-4fd6-bd1c-73d37fa40615.Text: {n}Heinrix glances at her and tilts his head slightly.{/n} "Mistress Heydari. Ever since my first visit to Footfall, I've been hearing about your colleagues and personal talents. But I'm afraid your full name escapes me — would you kindly refresh my memory?"

aab649b7-6738-4f8b-ad06-617e9eb6a1f8.Text: {n}Heinrix allows himself a hint of a smile.{/n} "I'm glad to hear that my presence aboard your ship did not leave you with any unpleasant memories. I hope your disposition won't change once I have explained the reason for my visit."

ceb57d75-8313-40d3-8f08-581d2723df27.Text: "Only to our mutual duty to Humanity. It is that duty that demands that I disturb your peace once more."

0514e016-4582-4859-ac31-cc73bc862be8.Text: "I was able to contact my mentor and report the tragic events that transpired on Rykad Minoris. I also received some information from my agents regarding the movements and actions of enemies of Humanity, including the {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g} that we're assuming were involved in the theft of the star. According to their findings, the threat now hangs over other worlds... this time yours, Lord Captain."

34345112-27f6-493f-a6d2-b50ae5607518.Text: "Not at all, First Officer Werserian — I'm not in the habit of leaving a trail. But I thank you for your concern."

4056bc5b-33d5-4946-94b3-f2225b23c230.Text: {n}Laughter gets stuck in Jae's throat — she pales slightly, but still forces an apologetic smile.{/n} "I don't mind, shereen. Let my full name remain naught but a stray sound to you, plain and uninteresting."

d0ec94c8-3320-435f-b484-af2eaf9bd5c3.Text: "Master van Calox!" {n}Cassia's voice is brimming with genuine joy, which she immediately hides behind a facade of highborn primness.{/n} "Since you are with us once more, I do hope you will find time to finish our conversation about the literary works of Kronhaller the Blessed."

528ad010-7fcb-4c22-8b0f-c95623af7b78.Text: "I will make every effort, Lady Orsellio."

6a9fa280-3332-4f42-b5b4-6fb31c9bcbb8.Text: {n}Heinrix clears his throat and begins in a pointedly official tone,{/n} "By the order of Lord Inquisitor Xavier Calcazar, whose duty is to stand sentinel over the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g}, the {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} of House von Valancius is to take on board the agent of the Most Holy {g|Encyclopedia:Inquisition}Inquisition{/g} and provide escort and support in deeds great and small that serve to safeguard the territories of the Imperium against its enemies. This decree is effective immediately upon announcement and remains in effect until decided otherwise by His Excellency Calcazar."

38999d58-445d-4b4f-85f0-57ffcc7caf6b.Text: {n}His mouth twists slightly.{/n} "The Lord Inquisitor has deemed that my presence aboard your ship and in your retinue would be significantly more beneficial to the fight against heresy and evil than my return to my mentor's side. Our parting before our arrival on Footfall was premature."

1ecebf00-e89a-416c-8cf8-5c55e49e6944.Text: "The cause is the activity of Humanity's enemies, including the Cult of the Final Dawn. In my absence, the situation in the Koronus Expanse has changed. I have received an exhaustive report from my agents — this heresy has taken root in the region where the von Valancius worlds lie. You probably already know about the fate of the {g|Encyclopedia:IndustrialWorld}industrial world{/g} of Kiava Gamma. If not, then I will share what details I know, but not here. Better to talk on board, where we will not be overheard."

a9de6126-8284-4a37-b448-c46948a3423b.Text: {n}Heinrix studies you for a moment — then ever so slightly, as if not wanting anyone else to see, shakes his head.{/n}

ee155f4b-087d-4004-8fe7-0025d7a42de8.Text: {n}One barely noticeable motion — and a resplendent metal rosette flashes before your eyes, the symbol of the Inquisition's limitless power.{/n} "Control yourself, von Valancius. You are a step away from uttering words that could be interpreted as defiance of the {g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Throne{/g} — quite possibly the worst heresy that can be committed by a servant of the Emperor." {n}A moment passes, and the rosette vanishes in the folds of his cloak.{/n}

e2d9a124-3e60-4005-b810-5342a8f8f37a.Text: "I understand, {name}. But duty to the {g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Golden Throne{/g} is seldom a pleasant burden to bear — especially for those in a position of great power."

417891c5-11ce-4ee8-a2e2-8072d283fd10.Text: "Not the most common response to the news that I will be constantly breathing down your neck. You aren't wrong, though. I prefer to repay favours in kind — assist me by ensuring that my work is unobstructed, and I will assist you in return."

425dc0ef-6e34-4a1a-a535-56df96991b03.Text: {n}Heinrix gives a reserved nod.{/n} "An answer befitting a righteous servant of the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g}."

0793b97d-88b5-4872-9d0c-bb7013f1b720.Text: "I must also deliver this to you." {n}Heinrix pulls out a sealed letter.{/n} "The Lord Inquisitor specified that the contents of this envelope are for your eyes only. I would ask you to read it as soon as you have the time."

d2143d35-81f4-4ef3-a658-a4ae52a64dcb.Text: "That is everything for the time being. Are you headed to the ship? Or do you still have business on Footfall? Whatever the case, I can either wait for you on board or accompany you as part of your retinue."

2cb66eea-7a27-4474-9091-1c06eebdf7d5.Text: {n}Idira's whisper is barely audible:{/n} "All I got from it is that ridding ourselves of this snitch won't be easy."

f95a925c-ba5e-4bbf-ac55-2532ba03f67b.Text: "If duty has brought you aboard the Rogue Trader's ship once more, then such is the Emperor's will. Welcome back, Interrogator."

7d41c15d-af85-4f0c-8a83-99f5545b7a92.Text: "Thank you, Sister. It is an honour to be travelling with one of the blessed {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptaSororitas}Adepta Sororitas{/g}."

2e117924-f202-465c-9d1d-89e67a33bfab.Text: {n}Idira stares at you in bewilderment, then at Heinrix, then bites her lip and snickers gleefully.{/n}

e8b5113b-a78d-4823-b443-ac11874ad978.Text: "Honoured Interrogator, what a surprise. Did you, perchance, leave something in your cabin?"

7322236d-3985-4506-b162-59b773388c67.Text: "Thank you." {n}Heinrix gives you a ghost of a smile before his face takes on its usual expression.{/n}

94a65d7d-24b9-4473-aa3b-0021be4a23f0.Text: "I want to take a look at the catalogue of components available for purchase."

97d63bb6-516e-4cc4-ab44-2e366f3a5900.Text: "From where do you source the components you sell?"

82e05b65-2a0e-4ff6-a8a4-747bb4285041.Text: "I would like to know more about the Merchant Fleet's operations in the Koronus Expanse."

7d3cc24d-5195-44bc-95a3-16e8e157bb21.Text: {n}The vox-channel clicks, and, after a brief pause, a dry, low voice hails you:{/n} "Greetings, Lord Captain. I am honoured to speak with the Rogue Trader of House von Valancius, may your name be known through the ages. Chartist Captain Austerius Thorfast, bearer of a free charter of the Merchant Fleet. How can I be of service?"

bbbe1f98-4a81-4869-b7f9-fd8d342e1c91.Text: {n}A familiar voice cuts through the hissing of the vox-channel.{/n} "Greetings. What can I do for you?"

65c6b1ea-ae67-43af-a932-3873e91898c4.Text: "We develop supply routes for Chartists. You see, my ship is a representative of the Merchant Fleet in this part of Imperium territory, yet we do not have a fixed, charter-defined trade route. Our mission is to establish business contacts with voidfarers in need of regular ship repairs and those who are interested in specialised goods."

08fe2fe6-7d24-4cb4-9a5f-e9659f4b85f8.Text: {n}The hololith projector lets out a piercing beep that indicates an incoming holo-message. A moment later, the projector flashes with a series of images of various ship components.{/n} "I believe a Rogue Trader may be interested in such articles. Would you like to know the details? I am ready to comm you a catalogue of the components we have available."

a1f09cd0-a7a8-4fec-ade9-3550015fadb5.Text: "Are you asking me to disclose our suppliers to you?" {n}Thorfast laughs airily.{/n} "Well, frankly, they come from both everywhere and nowhere. We get our wares either from lucky voidsmen who stumble upon an abandoned or dilapidated ship somewhere in a neighbouring system, or from unlucky ones whose sorry tub arrives on Footfall in such a state that it's easier to take her apart than to restore her."

7d7e653c-d9c3-46d7-abad-d7571b0f672a.Text: "We don't have many customers who are willing — and able — to acquire enormous piles of plasteel and sacred tech the size of a small asteroid. So our catalogue rarely acquires new stock but remains up to date."

858dcdfc-4b0a-4c12-8e69-2f7ed3a3cb31.Text: {n}Thorfast pauses to think.{/n} "The Koronus Expanse is the outskirts of the Imperium... in many ways a frontier, where the distances between inhabited worlds are great and the void that fills these gaps is full of dangers. And I am not just talking about the enemies of Humanity — there are plenty of void anomalies and warp disturbances capable of destroying even a time-tested vessel."

de70458d-4751-40f3-8583-8ac01b4e434f.Text: "For the most part, all the Expanse has is fleets of different organisations and small flotillas of merchant ships. Uninterrupted communication between worlds is a matter of life and death for many outposts of Humanity, so even in this dark corner of the Imperium, there are Chartists and ships assigned to the various Adeptus. Alas, the Expanse has next to no stable trade routes, so the job can be precarious at times. Then again, no one is more intimately familiar with the hardships of local commerce than a Rogue Trader."

dd518270-a280-4230-9a5c-1f03bfdd42fc.Text: "Lord Cap'n, we have the flagship Drusus's Blessing with a small escort dead ahead. They are requesting a direct vox-channel. Patching you through..."

ec4c17d5-247e-48ff-b228-1ce8b4e17f0e.Text: "I was expecting a welcome more befitting a visit from a Rogue Trader, not a scene."

523fada3-7c11-4350-986d-9a65452b8ddb.Text: "...my patience. You remember the way out. Dismissed." {n}The tall man in austere grey clothes makes a show of looking past the woman he's addressing.{/n}

6328405c-2613-46f7-9f70-c5d2d8d01678.Text: "Vladaym, Vladaym, Vladaym... What azhi put such harsh words into your mouth? You talk like you're an Imperial clerk, not one of us." {n}The woman, who is standing with her back to you, lets out an ostentatious sigh, then her tone changes dramatically.{/n} "Where's my cargo, Vladaym? Falco has it, doesn't he? So that's how you do business with your old friends these days?"

d6c09172-06d5-4ee4-85f3-d0f5dd4c8162.Text: "So you don't remember. Then the help will remind you. Guards, escort her out."

c672e180-63b8-4936-ab83-264f9d2b81e0.Text: "Heydari, move." {n}The massive guard leans down to the woman and says in a lowered voice.{/n} "Jae, get going while he's letting you. Go drown your sorrows at the Amasecus and thank your lucky stars you were able to walk out the door — you won't get the chance next time."

3aea06fa-08a7-479e-beea-a7ab69ab5701.Text: "First an insult, and now threats? I see courtesy and tact are no longer a valued commodity on Footfall! Oh well, I'll find myself a better deal." {n}She turns on her heel and heads toward the exit. As she passes you by, she gives you a quick once-over, winks at you, then immediately turns away with a flip of her jet-black hair.{/n}

471921ed-ef55-4fca-949a-4d581c6a763e.Text: {n}The tall man, who has long since noticed your presence, is studying you intently.{/n} "Vladaym Tocara, Liege of Footfall. Let us please proceed to my office — a spread befitting a visitor of your rank is waiting. Your entourage will be accommodated nearby."

b8c75185-01c1-43d7-b47f-b4155cd61f82.Text: "My apologies. It was no sign of disrespect toward your esteemed personage. Please allow me to prove it."

e628f48e-9608-4eed-8502-eaaad19f2c36.Text: "There's an establishment not too far from here — they let people torture fake xenos there. I want it to stop."

161e8266-d982-4481-b696-c2e05523e4f3.Text: "Thank you, Liege. A terrible loss for all of us."

6cab150f-950e-47d1-a4b4-b6b958f3866b.Text: "Have there been any xenos attacks on Footfall?"

a24889b2-a4ea-4269-bfcc-0315a4f56828.Text: "I would like to know more about the Anvers gang. Why haven't they been dealt with yet?"

370d5082-83aa-4bdf-a527-a11037262df8.Text: "Let's get down to business — I'm interested in your wares."

d2969f0c-5a9e-4c16-a0e8-a1a3f8712dd1.Text: "Who was that woman the wardens threw out?"

ce4129e4-833b-4e6e-8b85-4e2a180e6f27.Text: "I was attacked. Right at the docks."

ccac0aec-ed47-419c-a3b0-b535caf7632a.Text: "What sort of patronage do you seek from me?"

c792b955-a468-4294-8351-30748ee8e1da.Text: Approved of the xeno-artefact trade on Footfall.

94355b0c-5ba6-4ef8-91ef-c497ea34bab1.Text: "There's no shame in selling one's trophies for profit."

f9101733-59f6-40ed-bcd9-c9d0658b11cd.Text: "Get on your knees and ask properly. Then I will help."

9e6f6491-b10a-4e5d-8488-987d27ed75fb.Text: "Frankly, my question was born out of idle curiosity. Solve your problems however you see fit, they are no concern of mine."

1d2bbf24-6be8-4360-ac37-557aa33e4540.Text: "So you're just a void rat from the dregs? My, how high you've risen."

4fcd4ea3-91d8-4707-9d6c-5cccb58bfca0.Text: "So Footfall is cut off from all of its shipments, the local gangs are running wild, and the local hustlers are throwing tantrums in your residence. Are you positive you're in control of the situation?"

217f4681-c1a6-4dfc-869e-ddead0ae513b.Text: "The negligence with which you do business is insulting for an individual of my stature."

60ace560-17ce-419d-870a-f7484dc8060e.Text: [Grin at him] "I can tell they've been a real pain for you. I bet you'd love to gut those jokers, wouldn't you? Come on, admit it — you would, wouldn't you?"

8ae10cb3-9496-4ae9-b996-95b3e02bed44.Text: "I can't be the only one you've asked for help."

d0f71f02-eb1b-4d93-af2d-a6876428e88d.Text: "Very well. I will help you with food shipments."

f9744bf5-1825-4a99-90ed-7d3628d4003a.Text: "I won't help you. Deal with your problems yourselves."

70a57476-7ab8-4eaa-812f-3e1879d5dc8e.Text: "So what are the terms of this deal?"

ef611528-3bd1-44ef-aae0-1c534f36020d.Text: "Are we talking about dealing in xeno-artefacts here?"

6bd3f325-6dc4-41ef-b6ca-1585a15ab6ff.Text: Disapproved of the xeno-artefact trade on Footfall.

d3d1c186-163e-4c41-af7a-c79a9521b7cd.Text: "You should consider your words more carefully. An admission like that sounds dangerously close to heresy."

85fcf66a-9747-4e6b-bcad-ce2f230dd608.Text: "Keep your bribes for the off-world Administratum clerks, you idiot. You're addressing a Rogue Trader!"

195c687d-8c7f-466f-9df7-69d01a6a0bef.Text: [Aim at Vladaym's head] "So I can just blow your brains out and then instate a new Liege?"

ef2d81a3-1835-478c-8cf3-a727c872c6da.Text: "There is a sound logic to having the sharpest mind run the station. The Administratum would've installed some pitiful clerk instead."

4e200975-fc47-4370-bbbe-ddf5d266a49c.Text: "I am sorry for the loss of your assistant."

d407ff1b-e88a-4d5c-8ed5-859ec2ef2fb0.Text: "And what will happen to you if I tell everything I've just heard to the leaders of the other gangs?"

25b02baf-6f2f-441e-8418-cb7edb7a0531.Text: Commented on the important role the xeno-artefact trade on Footfall plays in learning more about hostile xenos races.

929a28d3-5eb3-41f9-a1d5-f8c9d0aa6bf6.Text: "I do not approve of fear of xenotech. One must know and understand the enemy."

72bef2e7-b3f5-49fa-8b3e-95993d0373fc.Text: "The payment will be unfair, as I will be robbing you blind. But you will remain in charge. Do we have a deal?"

0ec70e77-2e80-41f8-923d-97b6498ef5cc.Text: "Naturally, I find this utterly unacceptable and have no desire to speak about this. But my Seneschal is a good listener. Lay your disgraceful gossip on him."

78428199-07d4-407d-a822-5fa178b735de.Text: "Well then, I suppose Footfall will have to get used to its new harsh {mf|master|mistress}."

60c9e733-43c2-40ab-bc37-3556119edb14.Text: "There was only one person who stood to gain from this murder — you."

65d48912-62df-4804-acd3-d92fa44621ea.Text: "There is a certain charm to the bloody mayhem that reigns on Footfall."

5be064c5-1c8e-4f80-a3d6-7d0f457863a0.Text: "I am beginning to resent how frequently the people I converse with on this station wind up dead!"

20e1f47c-b840-47bb-ba79-55675629b77a.Text: "I am most certainly expecting compensation for this inconvenience!"

46978400-bc7e-48ac-8cda-0a85fef68d9c.Text: "What is happening in the Shadow Quarters? Why is there a quarantine?"

85a7045e-35a8-4311-bc26-f1fbb2b30ffc.Text: "You could have at least supplied the people trapped in the quarantine zone with food and water."

2c0b0341-17ea-4954-9051-3b7d68bd723e.Text: "I've been told that, when the previous Liege was faced with a similar situation, he ordered that the entire asteroid be detached and dropped into the star."

c4ba4b0d-b272-410c-9f37-0dd68c005b0a.Text: Sent medicine to the people trapped in the quarantine zone on Footfall.

cf7c3016-6971-4b6c-ae37-7f503db7c0db.Text: "I wish to help the people in the quarantine zone. I will have medicine delivered to them from my ship."

14d05a64-5233-453d-ae7f-cba526fbb9de.Text: "I wish to enter the quarantine zone."

87d453be-3f06-4f1a-916f-70666f971205.Text: Agreed to wait until the people in the quarantine zone on Footfall had died.

8dbdaec2-c586-40e2-aa32-c8cdb64436ca.Text: "You're right, Liege. The deaths of the people in the quarantine zone is a necessary price to pay for the station's security."

9bee58dd-cbd1-4150-9efa-c6b9a743bafe.Text: "I believe I said I wish to enter the quarantine zone. You would dare defy the will of a Rogue Trader?"

8ddde491-a8d3-47e7-8b59-624017d10a8b.Text: "So then, I'm free to walk around the former quarantine zone?"

5de96d26-bdc6-4751-8184-aa6940b0a6ab.Text: "I did what you could not — I found and neutralised the Anvers' agitator-in-chief."

4b484511-0fa4-48a6-9bae-1a316f438b8f.Text: "So I am free to push you around however I like?"

0f4837a4-7900-4cae-8a35-0d0088d67906.Text: Agreed to help Footfall without demanding anything in return.

5d12af20-cdc0-4d56-bdd9-e575324fe59c.Text: "I will help Footfall, but not out of desire for profit. I have no interest in obtaining any favours in kind or becoming your patron — only in saving people's lives."

f39f27a0-06d1-4485-a3e9-00427755cdd9.Text: "So, how is life treating you under Incendia Chorda's firm hand?"

6148e13f-3253-4b00-adb7-4c65c8ad056f.Text: "Relax. I simply got myself a lapdog."

aa8f81ea-b8b2-43bb-933a-18972660c64c.Text: "You need to show more respect. Jae is my new business partner."

e7ab2b96-ddc1-4b28-9272-657c659a581c.Text: "You're right, it is none of your business."

54ed991c-9dea-4a22-b923-897323ec3438.Text: "Enough chatter. I'm here to do business."

7e3370c3-20e4-4975-87d0-bab437fac96b.Text: "Jae has joined my retinue to atone for her misdeeds before the Emperor."

14abaf94-04d4-488a-8fab-c78530b9057f.Text: "If you are so fond of my acumen, then do not insult it by putting on a brave face now. We both know that you have far greater need of me than I have of you."

1e867b00-16af-4c12-a3fc-56c6490268f6.Text: "I have already been to the quarantined area. It really does have a fair number of infected people."

b4c3da8f-4d88-42b0-b71a-130e0fd810a0.Text: [Reply in High Gothic] "I accept your condolences."

898cc099-671c-45a2-95cb-f3196bb72bb7.Text: "Has Proctor Anthar visited you recently, by any chance?"

b3050b4c-ff83-4403-bff8-70496c13577c.Text: "Something tells me you used to be a bit of a bandit yourself."

f6acc447-ba18-444b-9d8e-65d2fdce773b.Text: "I've heard more sincere expressions of grief."

9a0d8275-2890-4423-907a-adf499a87a5e.Text: "Who holds the reins of the xenogoods trade?"

5ac5b400-493e-4e42-88fa-cf271e55c17b.Text: "A man who introduced himself as a servant of House Chorda asked to have a word with me. And then — imagine the odds — someone blew his brains out."

7e1212c9-1e12-4c22-b8d3-d7254961ea6f.Text: "Where does one go to make a few deals here on the station?"

2d5e736b-9e34-40ba-80a6-fafbdb639a80.Text: {n}While you are engaged in small talk, you get a chance to take the measure of Liege Tocara. His expression is aloof and focused, his gestures curt and firm, and his speech calm and quiet — as though he is used to people always listening to what he says. Judging by his observant gaze, he has been studying you in turn this whole time.{/n}

a5313a46-9aad-4bc8-b077-3cdff87528ab.Text: "I hope that under your guidance, the dynasty can recover from this blow and attain even greater power."

cb3f1b83-c684-48ea-aba1-3310527b2dc8.Text: {n}It's strange — a small-time hustler, even a particularly audacious one, wouldn't likely quarrel in public with a figure as important as the Liege of Footfall. What seems stranger still is that the Liege knows this small fry by name...{/n}

fd1809f2-b119-453a-a193-ab3d7594a3d4.Text: "It was a bold move on your part to announce yourself as the new {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} of the von Valancius dynasty despite not yet having your status confirmed by anyone of import from the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}. I appreciate such traits in people — it's good to understand who you're dealing with."

7c196a6a-c2d4-4a53-a963-eb6f9e6969d3.Text: "I am impressed by your prudence. Your decision to arrive on {g|Encyclopedia:Footfall}Footfall{/g} incognito without announcing either the death of the previous {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} or your own status — it was quite wise. The rumours will spread sooner or later — it's impossible to keep secret something that's known to the thousands of people serving on a voidship. But for now, you are free to reap the benefits of anonymity."

631c1b78-69d5-45fd-8488-885192c37f6d.Text: "As you may have noticed, Footfall is currently in a state of crisis. Its people would benefit from the patronage of a figure such as yourself."

0980f7cc-7974-42a1-964f-64d8f9da7f42.Text: "For us here, {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g} are more of a source of income than a threat..." {n}Vladaym freezes, gauging your reaction.{/n}

572b7519-81b2-47ec-8f2c-37f74dd5dbd7.Text: "I am at your service. You can expect the most generous discounts."

f5c89939-2756-4279-8941-71348091dadf.Text: "There can be no misunderstanding between us, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

9154d0f6-b12f-43d2-a7c3-9a81f77a5dd8.Text: "I'm glad to have satisfied your curiosity."

4a9f0b4f-68dc-47c4-bf64-92c8f4836c4e.Text: {n}Vladaym's expression hardens, and he makes a frustrated gesture.{/n} "A dead woman walking. Some, however, still call her Jae Heydari. A small-time hustler with big ambitions that will lead her to a sticky end."

5b970e2e-2c47-47c9-a60e-25177e4c921f.Text: "An outrageous stunt, a show of disrespect for both you and me. Sadly, such incidents on Footfall are akin to natural disasters — impossible to predict or pre-empt, they simply happen."

21d9cc23-0593-4afd-8f05-342c670093c8.Text: "Many consider Footfall to be a pirate den, but believe me when I say that there is a difference between organised crime and gangs of thugs who have nothing to lose. You were attacked by the latter. The Anvers are a gang of punks who spit on our customs and hierarchy. Even their leader is more akin to an ideologue — a rabble-rouser who calls for people's heads. Not a commander. Sooner or later, we will find him and have him strung up — that will likely cool his followers' enthusiasm."

54b56328-670c-495a-b005-0de74631b1b7.Text: "It's a delight to be talking to a business-minded individual."

a4e47895-75d8-4ecb-8624-ea262dcf00f8.Text: {n}Behind the carefully built facade of composure, you sense anger. It appears that this man is not used to losing control — but that is exactly what is happening.{/n}

47778a83-684a-4989-a485-895677c37b39.Text: {n}His words sound confident and calm. It seems he really isn't terribly worried about some band of voidborn rats.{/n}

9e64c30c-b17e-42ff-8927-3dd97fb106bf.Text: "Protection. Not military protection, but a different kind of security. You have, of course, already encountered difficulties with {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}warp{/g} navigation on your way here. I'm afraid the scope of these difficulties extends far beyond this area. Reports of disrupted routes and ships vanishing during short jumps are coming in from across the entire sector."

20cc2aed-39e6-498f-b8a6-b6fa5d0e4438.Text: "In this matter, I would. If this visit of yours goes awry, it will destroy Footfall — what good will your favour do me then?"

6d559b98-740d-4456-9773-15fb163d78b1.Text: "Troubling. {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}Xenos{/g} raids are growing more frequent, trade is suffering, and fringe worlds are going under. Rumours of atrocities being committed by enemies of Humanity are causing excessive panic due to their... exotic nature."

be3ad1e5-a077-4220-8c35-b8abf38f67c1.Text: "The core of the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g} forces in the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g} has departed for the sector's borders to combat the xenos threat. There has been no word from them for a while now — then again, with the distance and the current issues with Astropaths, that is not entirely out of the ordinary."

f9f0a40f-2ccb-466e-adf1-549265752acb.Text: "Still, we are not yet alone. From several of the worlds hit by xenos attacks, we've received reports of fierce warriors who descended from the sky and entered the fray. The fragmentary accounts lead me to believe that the blessed {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusAstartes}Adeptus Astartes{/g} are operating in the Koronus Expanse, and I await news of their victories with great anticipation."

667769ea-109b-4e03-b60d-ee83882c9172.Text: "And this brings us to our main issue... Footfall is a repair shipyard and a trading post — we barely produce anything ourselves and are largely dependent on incoming shipments. Especially food shipments. The station, naturally, has some reserves, but the supply issues didn't start yesterday. Footfall would be obliged if House von Valancius would assist us by signing a contract for food deliveries."

36a1e30c-03e9-4a78-97a3-c5acc54dc19c.Text: {n}A shark-like smile appears on Vladaym's face, bloody and vicious.{/n} "Back where I grew up, they call it 'throwing someone for a loop.' They carve a particular sign on the person's forehead, then load them alive into the slag disposal chute, and send them out to orbit the station. Every thirty years, we clean the orbit and count how many stiffs bearing which signs have been floating around.
