You have no idea how much I want to throw those little thugs for a loop like in the good old days."

d976ffbc-4346-4667-94e9-8207f0d6e4ee.Text: {n}You have heard of periods of warp instability, including cases where the Maw would become completely inaccessible for navigation for years on end, thus temporarily cutting off the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g} from the Imperium. Even so, Vladaym's words are particularly alarming — it seems that {g|Encyclopedia:CicatrixMaledictum}something{/g} has had a profound effect on the Maw.{/n}

f39b22de-acd8-448b-ad88-ba644ace94aa.Text: {n}You're well aware that the {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}warp{/g} is unpredictable and its fluctuations are a common, even expected occurrence.{/n}

e777aea6-219f-42b4-b062-d8bf1f244b1d.Text: "Naturally, I tried contacting other {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Traders{/g}. But the terms of House Chorda would have bled Footfall dry, and as for the esteemed Calligos Winterscale — instead of a food shipment from him, I received a transport, the Naviica, packed with refugees. I had to send them off to Foulstone — so many extra mouths to feed would have only worsened the crisis further. I suppose all these {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}warp{/g} fluctuations must have created more pressing concerns for Lord Winterscale. And so I put my faith in you, the third and last of Footfall's allies."

eb8973d6-698e-4e36-8cf3-93cc9108e6a9.Text: {n}Vladaym takes a quick sip from his glass.{/n} "I am immensely obliged, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I assume you're going to need time to get the shipments up and running. I can wait. On my end, I promise you complete cooperation with your endeavours."

5d249d82-be53-419a-8eef-11d3a3707e68.Text: {n}Vladaym presses his lips into a thin line. After a long pause, he says,{/n} "I wouldn't dare defy a Rogue Trader. But, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, should you reconsider... Footfall will remember your magnanimity."

9bf29917-82c8-4066-9e89-77bdd494920a.Text: "It's simple. Delivery of food shipments from your fertile worlds — Janus, I imagine, I'm quite familiar with that jewel of the von Valancius protectorate — in exchange for fair payment."

7a953443-ccca-4925-8f48-dd02da50479c.Text: {n}The Liege almost inaudibly grates his teeth and draws back a little.{/n} "I imagine it was absolutely necessary, seeing as you found a way past the cordon, thus putting yourself and all of Footfall at risk of infection."

caa78e28-a477-4dc9-a3e4-011485735591.Text: "Shortly before you did. He was interested in certain sensitive information, which I happened to possess, and he also required access to the dock cogitators containing logging and administration data. Naturally, I offered my full cooperation and provided the esteemed Arbitrators with a designated area at the docks where they could work away from the bustle and din of the crowd. I assume that is where the Proctor is at the moment."

9bafda8f-f684-462a-a06c-7c2ec07a207e.Text: {n}He nods calmly.{/n} "A fair point. You can, however, be assured of the sincerity of my desire to cooperate with you."

18f38791-dc36-420b-b4fc-b2ed6f1c1e18.Text: "Greetings, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Do you have business with me?"

e5dc7387-b05e-4439-9bce-bcd19ac5f69c.Text: {n}He grits his teeth slightly before answering.{/n} "I've been using all my resources to delay the moment when the station is hit by famine. I haven't gotten around to the Anvers yet. As detrimental as they are, they're no players. When their leader dies, the rest will scatter."

f9489be7-d9a3-43cf-b2a9-8882b5840786.Text: "In a manner of speaking?" {n}Miraculously, Vladaym has managed to frame the last sentence as a question.{/n} "Footfall is a place where anything can be bought — and, mind you, where anything can be sold."

d61e27c4-39d0-4c3b-a936-c157636940ad.Text: "I hear you. You must have misunderstood. What I meant was, loyal servants of the Emperor often trade their spoils here on Footfall, including those claimed in battles with otherworldly beasts. Any other forms of interaction with xenos are, of course, persecuted without mercy."

352ac8b8-a7fc-459e-aa13-79f4d567f193.Text: "If you're looking for goods that can entertain you, find Octaviana at the establishment called the Adeptus Amasecus. The chemical bliss that she offers is refined and possesses a satisfactory degree of purity. Just don't ask her to pour you her signature drink — it's meant for common Footfall rabble, not discerning clientele."

8ebcfe93-6be2-4684-a423-048fccd4fbe7.Text: "Here. I am the main dealer on the station, and it would be disrespectful of me to suggest that you take your business to Footfall traders of lesser importance. Still, you might take an interest in a few people of note — for example, Reverend Hieronymus Doloroso. This servant of the Ecclesiarchy is rumoured to purchase sacred relics from captains, and other traders don't seem keen on becoming his competitors."

f70b33c2-ba83-4bdf-92d4-d174e3dc0f0b.Text: {n}Vladaym listens with a stony expression.{/n} "You are very perceptive."

55a4a027-a2bb-4173-8d35-87bbfe1868e8.Text: "Well, now you know what you're buying. The situation is difficult, but should you decide to offer your support, you'll forget about the existence of trading hubs other than Footfall. Because you won't have more loyal friends anywhere else."

352add63-451a-49d0-8877-ab302d087494.Text: "The {g|Encyclopedia:KasballicaMission}Kasballica Mission{/g} — a criminal syndicate that has seized control of the entirety of the Cold Trade in the sector. {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}Xenos{/g} creations are in high demand, and so every single colony has a Kasballican agent or two. Opposing their commercial interests is a lot more dangerous than using their merchandise."

f216aa81-6e85-447a-b86b-7b7448e3abf2.Text: "You aren't wrong. My path was long and bloody, but in the end I rose from running a gang that had staked its claim to a treatment filter station to becoming the Liege of Footfall. Many died to make this possible. And those who survived figured it would be more convenient to put me at the head than continue the slaughter of the turf war. I can only hope that my elevation and the peace that came with it have done the station good."

42b70405-b245-401e-912f-2395ef6b284d.Text: "What?" {n}Your words seem to perplex him for a moment, but his face remains cold.{/n} "Oh, that. Yes, her death was a regrettable development."

4d67fe98-6c38-4b9f-b640-4b2999ac59d7.Text: {n}He gives you a tense look, then says quietly,{/n} "Could a humble gift from me smooth over this inadvertently caused affront?"

c3f579e0-89df-48d6-9a7c-f13674cd6f8e.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, the first ships from Janus have already arrived. The station is no longer facing famine or the predatory interest of the Chorda dynasty."

cb99b0a0-32af-4f29-8cc7-53836076fb5c.Text: "Greetings, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I don't mean to hurry you, but I do hope that our deal is still in place. The station continues to experience increasingly severe shortages of provisions."

7b13d0a0-2e5a-410c-ab5d-233efd8d68b5.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I've received news that Footfall shouldn't be expecting deliveries from Janus anytime soon. I thought we had reached an agreement. It's regrettable, but, since you're not interested in gaining allies on Footfall, I will have to offer my friendship to the esteemed Lady Chorda."

44b1be85-3b91-4407-b51e-f5f0eacb9011.Text: {n}Vladaym gives a curt nod.{/n} "It will be dealt with."

6feee464-3322-408a-a753-9c3dfdd2304c.Text: "There is a certain custom on Footfall — any Rogue Trader who arrives at the station and docks is considered to be its absolute ruler. And the Liege their loyal servant. That makes me your servant." {n}Vladaym's arrogant bearing contradicts his words.{/n}

9dd860b7-c611-42bf-86b8-09c2c5380997.Text: {n}He grinds his teeth and bows his head repentantly.{/n} "I beg your forgiveness."

ec7a5ecd-cb10-4eb4-b1be-d01d920d399c.Text: "Communication with the Calixis Sector has been extremely unstable. Of the ships that have dived into the {g|Encyclopedia:Maw}Maw{/g} in recent years, none have yet returned. The last ship that came through the Maw from the other side was struck by a temporal anomaly — the jump took almost two decades in {g|Encyclopedia:Realspace}realspace{/g} time."

cd6e175c-8231-4656-9468-8ef061a0642b.Text: {n}A pale ghost of a smile appears on his lips.{/n} "Still, making friends with this organisation is as profitable as it is dangerous to make enemies of them. And it just so happens that I've managed to earn their trust, and on Footfall, they conduct their business under my watchful eye." {n}He sends you a meaningful look.{/n}

b5cc133c-c5e3-4b3b-a01f-b11170782761.Text: "And I, in turn, will remember your gracious attitude. And I'll remember it when the esteemed Calligos Winterscale returns to discover that Footfall is no longer under his patronage."

372341b0-fdde-4d10-bf90-0844d5b0c875.Text: "Surely you don't think that this is my first time at gunpoint, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}? You can do it, of course. But I don't think that the one you appoint will last longer than an hour. Let's spare their life and refrain from testing your theory. Especially since I'll be of use to you when the esteemed Calligos Winterscale returns and sees the losses his protectorate has sustained."

27a9b271-2b7f-4cc8-a959-32ad31d4d365.Text: {n}His eyes turn glassy, the pupils resembling a pair of gun barrels.{/n} "That would be undesirable. You see, sooner or later the esteemed Calligos Winterscale, decades-old patron of Footfall, will return."

8302a865-3ab6-4986-8bba-eed2f0b742fb.Text: "I appreciate your breadth of thinking. In this day and age, few choose to allow themselves such a thing."

3116a534-ec4a-4489-8365-9cf58224533f.Text: "You can try, but they won't believe you. Because if you're right, they'll have to start a war, kill me, divvy up the station again. Why would they want that?" {n}Vladaym chuckles dryly to your face.{/n} "It's not enough to tell people the truth, one must make them want to believe it."

246e8b5b-846e-4699-9f6a-943f27e95804.Text: {n}Something dull, bloodthirsty, and dark surfaces on Vladaym's face.{/n} "If you and I were just people — ordinary people — this void rat would've already made you eat these words along with your own teeth." {n}Then his usual formal expression returns.{/n} "But you're an illustrious Rogue Trader, and I am the Liege of Footfall, and such lowbrow larks are beneath us. So — yes, my path was long."

c90cd39f-7083-425b-866f-8a3c1bd5985f.Text: {n}He carefully pulls out a small metal box — clearly saved for an occasion exactly like this one — and just as carefully hands it to you.{/n} "This is my gift. A curio confiscated from smugglers. I hope you find it to your liking."

20dffc7c-6939-49e5-bcd6-c7a8cd48e31f.Text: "That is a reasonable business proposal. I wouldn't have even gotten this much from the esteemed Incendia Chorda — she would've both robbed us and asserted her own authority. And so I agree." {n}He pauses, then adds with a dry smile,{/n} "You're a dangerous {mf|man|woman}, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

0c909f12-9b4f-4a56-b814-79683d6f8e3b.Text: {n}Vladaym straightens in his chair and says in a polite but completely indifferent tone,{/n} "Let's talk business. On behalf of the elite of Footfall Station, I offer you my condolences, {mf|Lord|Lady} von Valancius. We mourn Lady Theodora's loss and we hope this sentiment is taken as a sign of our good intentions and willingness to cooperate."

c5b8d61c-e8f9-49f7-81b6-3ee88352d5ea.Text: "Why would Footfall agree to such a deal? By accepting it, we would anger the esteemed Incendia Chorda without gaining anything. Let's discuss more realistic prospects for our partnership."

ea785b68-50ec-4c00-bfae-b2fcbb313f61.Text: {n}Vladaym's eyes narrow as he gives you a calm, appraising look, then kneels. His body, unaccustomed to such displays of obedience, moves slowly as if the air has suddenly grown thick.{/n} "If this is the price for the station's prosperity, I will pay it."

444cc52c-11ae-4679-9f13-e5cdb9aa787f.Text: "I beg your pardon, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. It was impertinent of me to offend your ears with such appalling words."

c199c932-546b-4db0-82eb-98bd56327afd.Text: {n}He glances at you cautiously.{/n} "I'm not intimidated by them, obviously, and I do everything in my power to keep them away from Footfall. But my power has its limits."

ea0e2dde-eeff-4941-aecc-a6fde8c17bb2.Text: "Footfall has had a harsh master before — Calligos Winterscale. And we gratefully accepted his strict protection... for as long as he was around. Now we're in need of a patron of a different fibre. Why else would we incur the esteemed Winterscale's wrath?"

41b5270a-571e-4595-92fb-c55b6e5d916b.Text: "I'm convinced that your connections with Footfall will allow you to broaden your knowledge and understanding of xenos considerably. I will see to it that your curiosity is satisfied in every way."

b02e4b32-4055-4c40-882e-32f9af6ee5b2.Text: "He will be displeased upon finding his demesne encroached upon and will try to take it back. And Calligos Winterscale's displeasure is a very... very hazardous phenomenon. A fight between two Rogue Traders will ensue, and, as ridiculous as it may sound, its outcome will most likely depend on the allegiance of the station's humble Liege."

1f747b29-666a-4eb7-8e0c-113c9697cccc.Text: {n}The Liege stares at Heinrix. Slowly, very slowly, Vladaym nods to him.{/n} "Van Calox."

0ecbfc94-04c8-437a-9624-02148f4231a8.Text: "Blasphemers of impure thought." {n}Pasqal's vox erupts with furious, hissing static.{/n} "The Cold Trade is a shameful encroachment on the privileges of the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMechanicus}Adeptus Mechanicus{/g}." {n}He glares at Vladaym, whose transparent eyes are clearly avoiding Pasqal's.{/n}

bd15809b-877a-488b-aad5-87f484c0795e.Text: "I beg your pardon, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship, but it was your wish to arrive on Footfall incognito. By doing so, you have deprived me of the opportunity to provide you with numerous guards befitting your high status. Therefore, I strongly advise you to exercise caution on the station until you decide to publicly announce that Footfall has the honour of hosting a Rogue Trader."

dbc3edcd-8714-48f3-9c07-41f784662239.Text: {n}He gives you a long look, then says calmly,{/n} "I'm not versed in the language of the {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Nobility}aristocracy{/d}, but I do hope that you didn't say anything unsavoury. Either way, you've established a certain distance between us, and I will make note of it."

0092ad62-ebc5-48cd-9b3b-7081b99d8652.Text: "However, as long as you remain incognito, it will be difficult for you to use this privilege. Keep this in mind if you wish to communicate with the less knowledgeable inhabitants of the station — for them you are an ordinary visitor to Footfall."

f06301e5-aec4-44db-a1eb-7ab10b34575c.Text: {n}His eyes turn glassy, the pupils resembling a pair of gun barrels.{/n} "That would be undesirable. It will be difficult for me to convince the venerable Calligos Winterscale, a patron of Footfall for many decades, that my actions were not personal whims, but rather the orders of some Rogue Trader who arrived on the station incognito. If it were me, I would not believe it for a second."

b98df528-4a68-4677-a06d-6c18d5341940.Text: {n}Vladaym doesn't look surprised.{/n} "The Anvers again, I presume? Those anarchical degenerates don't care whom they shoot, be it my servants, yours, or those in the employ of House Chorda."

1beb3d20-e4a0-4517-a8f7-8b8b15ef9e35.Text: "If you're suggesting that those outlaws were acting on my orders, then I vociferously deny anything of the sort."

1972aef5-77b7-4303-9801-df51279092eb.Text: "I do hope that, should our partnership go smoothly, I'll be able to contain this 'bloody mayhem,' as you put it, on Footfall's lower levels, where its charm can continue to bring you joy without interrupting Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}'s conversations with gunfire."

5a33d968-deee-4ce5-88f4-f01a29497546.Text: "That is indeed lamentable. But these are the times we live in, and this is Footfall. Its denizens don't always look for a reason to spill blood."

3e887381-8634-4b9f-95cc-cbd50bee17b7.Text: "I once again offer my apologies for the sheer number of threats that Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} has encountered since arriving on my station."

6a53b0ef-0c64-4e45-a250-aeeae1bcdf69.Text: "I suspect that this agent wished to negotiate a deal that would have you refrain from hindering Incendia Chorda's efforts to strangle us with the threat of hunger and demand our obedience? If so, I don't believe I will be mourning the man's passing very long."

83be9f61-b51d-4646-bbaf-75e39d93c538.Text: "However, if you are merely alluding to the possibility that someone who cares about Footfall's fate could have started a rumour on the lower levels that House Chorda's agents were looking to assert their authority on Footfall... Well, then your suspicions are entirely logical, as was the man's inevitable death at the hands of the Anvers."

301de743-b050-400e-8257-13841635438c.Text: "Oh, that..." {n}He grimaces.{/n} "Who knows? It could be an actual epidemic. Or perhaps the two families that started it all just came down with food poisoning at the same time. We're on a space station — the best solution here is to isolate the area and wait for the problem to resolve itself."

18f4cf16-7a5d-4e3a-a148-2b555a4d61d9.Text: "She is irrelevant. Since I'm the one in control of the situation on Footfall, I can speak on behalf of all of its... noteworthy residents."

82ba8cbc-f364-43d8-9a29-0940e202f623.Text: "Yes, he did. And what a senseless decision it was. There are more reliable ways of disinfecting an area without having to lose a whole asteroid. That manoeuvre of his destabilised the station's integrity, and the consequences of that were still being felt up until I became Liege. When I entered office, I had to negotiate with the {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priests{/g} to make necessary repairs, and it cost me a preposterous amount of money and resources."

fc83dc52-7d60-4547-aa37-8332108da950.Text: "I could have. But I'm certainly not going to," {n}Vladaym says in a bored and casual tone.{/n} "I wouldn't even under normal circumstances. And with the threat of famine hanging over the station and our prospects so unclear, well..."

12a9679a-1455-40b9-b8e4-650eb707efe8.Text: "Which it has, essentially. The reports say that there hasn't been a living soul in the quarantine zone for days now. My people are in the process of dismantling the barricades, removing the mines, and preparing to purge the place thoroughly with fire."

997a1b7d-506a-4ab5-a12a-a82cd1aaac15.Text: "I can't bar you from doing so. But I can't help but note that it's not the wisest course of action. With all due respect, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

a71e2431-a305-423c-bc2f-91c702421a7a.Text: "Out of the question. You would be putting both yourself and the station at risk."

8d0c50a0-462f-4ff2-9b7c-e20d93aa73f8.Text: {n}Vladaym clenches his teeth and remains silent for a moment.{/n} "Your imprudence could spell the end of you and the entire station! But — as you wish. I will have my people clear a small passage for you. It will take time, mind you..." {n}Vladaym scoffs.{/n} "The place has been mined properly. It will take days... if not more. But you will get your way in."

ff75b9e3-df39-4cb0-91d1-f4656467ed4f.Text: "I'm glad we've come to an understanding. We will wait until there is no one left alive who can spread the disease. Then we'll meticulously burn the place and fumigate it with a special compound. That should solve the problem."

550468f9-ab0e-4099-90d9-db3b4d4325d4.Text: "That is excellent news. Pleasure doing business with you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

430417ef-d784-4003-a623-273342e5436d.Text: "The lockdown has been lifted and the entrances cleared. There have been no strange deaths in Utility Crew 3, the team that's stationed there. It's up to you to decide how great a risk you're willing to take."

d7bd0748-7745-4e1f-8a4a-4f8b27987735.Text: "That is a truly outstanding accomplishment, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Footfall can now rest easy. At least until the next mad hoodlum makes himself known."

d62a232b-a7d5-47e3-9070-9d1a5badb0ad.Text: "Then I won't take up any more of your time."

8c0825a8-1582-438d-a852-6f24bf6086a5.Text: "I'm glad I've found such a generous and reliable patron. Naturally, your protectorate can count on Footfall offering the special consideration I promised you before."

5f0c66cc-adac-4232-badb-246e1c87babe.Text: "I must admit, right up until the last moment I did not believe that you would come to our aid without an ulterior motive. Your ascension makes me wonder if life in the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g} is changing in the most unexpected way."

2a8bfc7e-80b8-491f-afac-c13149d7df34.Text: {n}Vladaym's gaze is slightly distrustful.{/n} "Such charity is a rare sight in the Koronus Expanse. Even figures as powerful as Rogue Traders do not show it often. Thank you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

d18524bf-eb70-41cb-80c8-620c8950b88d.Text: {n}Vladaym's face sours a little, but his voice is calm and dry.{/n} "New rules have been introduced, and many businesses are suffering losses and inconvenience caused by the actions of her confessional units. But we are Footfall. We know how to survive under Rogue Traders of all kinds. And none of them has yet been able to change this station's identity."

b4cd6341-cf39-44f7-8b87-dd4b57073c72.Text: {n}Vladaym notices Jae standing behind you, and you see his jaw tightening with tension.{/n} "And what are you doing here?"

a6f0c2a2-4f90-4cc2-872b-e09cc307b008.Text: "Vladaym, Vladaym, you must have thought you were the only one on Footfall who knew how to make friends." {n}Jae shrugs and smirks condescendingly.{/n} "Told you I'd find a better deal."

b052d739-4e1b-46c5-b6c7-218974636c67.Text: {n}Ignoring Jae, Vladaym pointedly addresses you.{/n} "I'm sure Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} had reason for getting mixed up with a small fry like her. Perhaps you were amused by her false promises of quick profit. Or some more intimate aspects of such... relationships. In any case, that's none of my business. Just remember that, here on Footfall, the truly good deals worthy of your attention can only come from me."

88dfa294-d630-47c5-8b1b-817bf24d05ca.Text: "Without a doubt. Please forgive my digression. What brings you to me?" {n}His response is dry and reserved, but he never stops glaring at Jae.{/n}

096c51da-5b65-4e89-9b69-b0139f8bc211.Text: {n}A hint of irritation creeps into Vladaym's otherwise impenetrable expression.{/n} "Certainly, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I apologise for my lack of manners. I was... unprepared for this development."

83a4627e-5591-416a-8af5-ab46f49d2d66.Text: "Shereen, your words warm the heart better than the finest Calixian wine!"

fc6fe356-0cb6-450e-91e2-7f638023f066.Text: "No, there haven't. Attacking Footfall in general is not a particularly reasonable thing to do. Many ships are docked here at any given time, and even the listed weapons on board would make for a decent fighting force. And that's not even to mention the firepower that our esteemed merchants have shamefully hidden from the station's customs officials."

d52373a0-4595-430d-86e7-854bec54d4c3.Text: {n}A ghost of a smile appears on Vladaym's pale lips.{/n} "Of course, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. And now — shall we discuss more pressing matters?"

32ddb9da-1580-481e-9c85-a5c04a46b324.Text: "Glory to the Exalted One who cares for us all!" {n}Jae makes the sign of the Aquila over her chest with an uncharacteristically serious expression.{/n}

32119979-1f70-476f-93df-86ddadcaea52.Text: {n}Vladaym grimaces in vexation.{/n} "In my experience, people like her tend to turn a new leaf only when the door of the airlock shuts behind them, and not a moment sooner."

7ca9f8bb-8f0b-43fc-ba42-d3d9d1fcfad0.Text: {n}Heinrix responds with an equally reserved nod.{/n} "Good day, Liege. I am accompanying the Rogue Trader. Please pay no mind to my presence."

37b5a04e-2590-4721-b585-c4986e21a0f5.Text: "Your request is difficult to fathom and even more so to honour, Master van Calox. But I'm glad to hear there aren't other reasons for this visit... unlike your two previous ones."

95686d11-286f-4dbc-8f0a-f2e7aabb3840.Text: {n}The mask of cold courtesy vanishes from Vladaym's face as soon as he takes in the air, which is permeated with the miasmas of sewer stench. He grimaces, desperately fighting the urge to turn his head away, but eventually regains his composure.{/n}

709d7ff8-9d66-4bfd-8f85-50a0bb94080d.Text: "The honoured Liege's words aren't devoid of sense, Lord Captain." {n}Abelard winces, as if he finds the very idea of agreeing with Vladaym on any matter profoundly distasteful.{/n} "I must say, venturing into a den of disease does not sound like the wisest of ideas."

29916880-6e04-4bbc-b4d3-9a3d116e02b0.Text: "Indeed, my dear Vladaym. The honest people of Footfall would love to know why their illustrious Liege is failing at his responsibilities — can't leave your house without a gun these days. Well... I suppose it's always been this way, but now, as well as a gun, you also need to bring a couple of goons with clubs. Oh, the expense!"

24872a96-66bc-48db-a97a-a699addfd381.Text: "How peculiar. I've never met anyone whose words appeared so smoky and hueless. You're like an exotic beast that changes its colour based on its surroundings. Observing you will be interesting."

4e2cb9dc-2ec2-474b-9019-06d326e6391a.Text: {n}Slightly alarmed by the unwanted attention, Vladaym bows his head respectfully.{/n} "I am always delighted to entertain the Lady Navigator with my humble personage."

7e22d4cb-a733-4d21-ac67-f01e1fb0d55a.Text: "Rest assured, I will be candid — my lips are bound by the oath of service. What exactly interests you on Footfall, this abode of merchants, xenotech traders, and — only a few — bandits?"

93261242-b6bc-4186-b09a-0308e7498e71.Text: {n}Officers from Port Wander, where you still have contacts from your {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Navy}days in the Navy{/d}, often talked about the whims of the Maw, the only route from the Imperium to the Koronus Expanse. Even so, Vladaym's words are particularly alarming — it seems that {g|Encyclopedia:CicatrixMaledictum}something{/g} has had a profound effect on the Maw.{/n}

278889e8-0033-4ada-b58c-3d2e2f384bdd.Text: {n}Vladaym gives you a keen look.{/n} "I know enough about {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Criminal}who you were before{/d}, and what you do to people who oppose you without good reason. I will arrange to clear a passage in the barricade. Hopefully your rashness will not spell the death of this station..."

7eebc38f-64bf-4807-8704-bc39fe8d4984.Text: "I've heard much about your {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_MOT_Mind}rare acumen{/d} — or I should say, about the profoundly impressive results you managed to achieve by using it. I have always had a fondness for individuals who can destroy their enemy or gain a powerful ally with just a few well phrased sentences or precisely issued orders." {n}The corners of Vladaym's mouth twitch, bringing his expression dangerously close to a genuine smile.{/n}

9db6f26c-859e-4c5b-a543-e9bd40ab6307.Text: {n}Upon noticing Kibellah, Vladaym quickly assumes a bored expression. Carefully, without making any sudden movements, he wipes his glasses and, as if absent-mindedly, puts a hand under the table.{/n}

2f9ec87e-b166-44b2-baa9-4c36d870f1e3.Text: {n}Kibellah gives him a thin smile.{/n} "You are far more interesting than you seem at first glance, Liege."

998d8184-8696-43be-84b5-18e8e4e191ce.Text: {n}Vladaym responds with a vague smile of his own.{/n} "Yes, I am the most amusing man on this station, my lady."

a841ef45-5393-483e-a8da-1b331654e39d.Text: "Proctor." {n}The Liege's face takes on a most dispassionate expression.{/n} "I heard about Sargona's death and the successful reclamation of the tithe from Rykad Minoris. Do you require more information on any violators of the Lex Imperialis? I assure you, Sargona was the only heinous criminal of this calibre on all of Footfall."

163b10c5-831a-4a5f-84bd-814c2ea9b695.Text: "I will be the judge of who is a criminal in the eyes of the Adeptus Arbites. As for my presence here — that's just to give you a reminder of the sound of the Lex Imperialis and the sight of Glaito's teeth."

e0bb2b07-3787-4366-8cbd-3ec2ad6d0f2b.Text: {n}Vladaym moves to stand up, but then pauses and gives you a look.{/n} "One more thing, as a gesture of my sympathy for you. Kiava Gamma — that world belongs to your protectorate, doesn't it? Footfall has heard rumours of some great trouble brewing in that colony. A ship arrived from there, and people are saying some utterly nonsensical things about the crew. Perhaps you'll be interested in hearing news about your property."

c1f0651b-d53f-41c4-8240-54e1dce20945.Text:
"Now is our time, not theirs.
Go to their homes. Drag them out of their beds.
Carve open their bodies like carcasses at a slaughterhouse.
The Imperial Navy, Kasballica, Chorda, von Valancius — their names mean nothing now. Tomorrow will erase them from memory.
Go and seize power, as much of it as you can carry.
A N V."

eff10d13-073a-4c92-b8da-509d64e612e5.Text:
"We need no rules or leaders.
We are not an organisation. We are a force of nature.
A N V."

77873c4d-a549-4c97-8eb8-7b99e6fc109e.Text: "Abelard, would you kindly inform this bandit vermin that we've come to execute him."

785f51d8-84b1-4e14-a08a-f2913d7fc073.Text: "You've ruled over all of Footfall with fear. That is a serious achievement. I could do with people like that. So let's talk — I prefer to use human resources rationally rather than charge in with guns blazing."

d060461f-c827-480b-acdf-58286cc0ec93.Text: "If you have something to say, then say it."

a7120240-dfa4-4aaf-bb9a-7136a04b2ba6.Text: "I'm more fond of fire and metal."

00cc93ab-537e-4210-9777-8e103e76ca2e.Text: {n}The man with a shaggy mop of dark hair is dressed and armed about as well as everyone else in here. And yet he is unmistakably the leader. He takes a step toward you. He chuckles. He spreads his arms wide in a welcoming gesture.{/n} "My guests! What a joy it is to see you in my humble refuge. I see you've come here to be introduced to the truth. Which will you choose, then — words, or fire and metal?"

25fbf8cc-a13f-4dfc-aa73-5fecac28966d.Text: "You already know the answer, heretic!" {n}Argenta grasps her weapon.{/n}

1f135537-3928-4a48-aa4f-709192dc723b.Text: {n}Abelard glowers menacingly and says in his best "officer" voice,{/n} "By the order of the head of the von Valancius dynasty, a fully recognised {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} with all the attendant rights and privileges, including authority on Footfall, you riffraff are hereby sentenced to death! May the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} have mercy on your souls, for we will show none."

da1c19da-3ae1-442f-8a8a-a040a9656c32.Text: "Bow to the likes of you — the bloated old masters of the universe? I'd rather die."

1be67a0f-0d08-4e41-8ee3-49692baaf929.Text: {n}The man cringes.{/n} "Bloated old 'masters of the universe' who don't realise that their time has passed. You think you can scare me?"

c135ca23-1b89-4f40-b757-f794497e53d5.Text: "Do you even know what our name means, outsider? Footfall calls us the 'Anvers,' they do not stop to look, listen, learn." {n}The man pauses, then half-closes his eyes and proclaims in crude but clear High Gothic,{/n} "Auxilio non veniet. Help will not come. The {g|Encyclopedia:Maw}Maw{/g} has closed, the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g} is on its own now. A new era has come, and we are its sovereigns!"

a3eed70d-ea33-41e0-b3e5-738777c8b467.Text: "I will. Your time has passed. All of you — bureaucrats, the {g|Encyclopedia:KasballicaMission}Kasballica{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Traders{/g}, conceited aristocracy, and other worthless trash — all of you will soon burn!"

b0c6cb25-f351-4943-8503-3fcfa35bdc19.Text: "Good. Fire and metal are the essence of life. People aren't worms, we are truly alive only when we're ripping our enemies apart!"

07bc5b0f-8d19-4d63-97fd-e358516e8568.Text: "What's in the containers, Jae? And don't even think about lying."

de3e0bf5-d76b-475a-bf0f-958749e844cf.Text: "This cargo belongs to the von Valancius dynasty. Is Lord Tocara trying to encroach upon the property of a Rogue Trader?"

7706319d-7386-408a-9a94-9f87b11b19ed.Text: "You are absolutely right. I have nothing to do with this shipment or the woman standing next to it."

5d503745-5dc0-4acf-9580-a1e6066fd6f1.Text: "I hope your vaunted 'wisdom' is worth all this trouble."

ea694a76-e069-4f64-a55e-a7529bc4192d.Text: "I wish we could forget decorum entirely in each other's presence..."

d6397f58-42d2-4b09-8c86-28ed03cc38fc.Text: "Burn this heretic — she consorts with xenos!"

b6ac78b5-1346-42f3-bb5f-262f0343c6dc.Text: "Jae Heydari, the owner of this cargo, is presently under my protection — under a Rogue Trader's protection. Tell your master that he should think twice before crossing her from now on."

2e405a88-37d4-440d-9b86-2af9ec925226.Text: "It's a pleasure to have such generous friends. Do send my regards to the Liege."

8f0f8cd8-d33d-46f1-a33b-a6f8aae5e07c.Text: "Does Vladaym really think that my friendship can be so cheaply bought?"

f302ffce-2589-4e9a-bc69-e32169fe2f4f.Text: "You're offering a faithful servant of the Emperor a shipment of xenoheresy? Who do you think I am?"

0edaaf72-a366-4d4f-8b09-1260fea37285.Text: "You should have admitted right away that you deal in xeno-artefacts. I've always been fascinated by non-human technology."

55e6f0a6-24f0-4190-bfe6-44d7abe85d3c.Text: "Hold on, I want to examine the other containers too."

80b39050-0829-46ba-bcc9-60c6ba8b6862.Text: "What, we're just going to leave your priceless cargo here unattended?"

1582f9de-91dc-4038-be6c-e9949e617b54.Text: "I'll take what we agreed to. But I never want to see you again."

554f0723-7d89-4d40-9e8a-ec5f15188076.Text: "A Rogue Trader could use someone with your talents and connections, Jae. I would like to see you in my retinue."

a14e70d5-b0ae-453a-ba25-3c591acf252f.Text: "If you want us to stay partners — no more secrets or half-truths."

977ec1ce-1115-4d18-a0a7-e28990a4d95e.Text: "I'll be merciful and give you a choice, heretic. You can atone for your deplorable crimes against the Imperium through your service to House von Valancius, or you can die where you stand."

bd9d3d46-cc27-4d81-b0f9-40ff5928e09d.Text: "When I do something and why is solely my decision to make, and I'm not going to explain my reasons to anyone."

fed484ec-3498-4fbf-830b-852c9ee1cfa6.Text: "What do you mean, 'gift'? The cargo is mine either way — I had no intention of parting with it."

ebc5d76b-4d18-4c36-91d1-400b1906f72d.Text: "I'm confiscating this shipment, not accepting it. And I'll have words with the Liege yet — I would very much like to know what prompted him to appropriate prohibited xenoheresy."

3f3e2a6d-47a1-4083-a220-582d30e93469.Text: "Tell me about your 'business' on Footfall — the truth of it, and don't leave anything out."

33cba7b8-042f-4a32-902c-2ef7bd9ab0d5.Text: "You could have told me from the start that you were up to your elbows in xenogoods. Do not try to be coy with someone who was once in the business {mf|himself|herself}."

5c009d80-2a0c-422a-93f4-7f61d188c738.Text: "I see nothing wrong with making profit where it does no harm to oneself or the Imperium."

9deb4d8d-e1e8-4608-8666-b59a81fcc1b1.Text: "Lines have a tendency to blur — usually unbeknownst to the person walking closest to them."

7eee361d-7253-4f7b-8a37-d1f9475f7a01.Text: "I wanted to talk like normal people do. For a {mf|man|woman} of my status, it's a rare treat."

a55b0e36-620f-4ec1-9794-220e13cc7636.Text: "You were hardly forthcoming yourself — neither of us have been completely honest."

5e982bd1-97a5-4374-bc87-a737d26bea86.Text: "Your words are full of heresy. And you... you are simply repulsive."

8ff12ac9-68a8-47a0-9d0b-d1cb64834c76.Text: "A principled rogue who can think on her feet and is not afraid of inhumans. I like you more and more, Jae Heydari."

4bacb9c2-ee96-420f-9157-2f3c10083268.Text: "Two... Three... Five... Thank the Exalted One, those ashmags didn't have time to make off with anything yet!" {n}Jae carefully inspects the containers emblazoned with markings from some unknown freight operator, then smiles and touches the comm-bead in her ear.{/n} "Give me two minutes, shereen — I'll send the coordinates to my loyal crew who will deliver my property somewhere safe."

5386b1d4-5519-40f0-af38-9b02538d4b44.Text: "I am Vladaym Tocara's personal agent." {n}The man hesitates, choosing his words carefully.{/n} "I came here to remove from criminal circulation a shipment, the distribution of which is banned in the lands of Footfall — horrendous xenoheresy that has been fraudulently delivered to a bastion of the holy Imperium." {n}He looks at Jae.{/n} "I do not doubt for a moment, most noble {name}, that your presence here is merely a misunderstanding brought about by another's manipulations..."

236a477d-be4f-43f9-b716-c7832c26e979.Text: "Has anyone ever told you you have an incredibly piercing gaze?" {n}Jae's smile fades.{/n} "Well, shereen. This cargo is particularly valuable to me because it came from afar — from the Heathen Stars region. From distant trade partners of mine. Both the partners and the cargo are, shall we say, of a culture that is foreign to Humanity—"

eb41b26a-29ee-43db-9b0c-7352d97e93ba.Text: {n}Jae gives you a thin smile.{/n} "Lying? I hate lies. I'm all for clean deals, shereen. And I can assure you with utmost sincerity: my business secrets will not, in any way, shape, or form, cause harm to your reputation, your wallet, or your head."

4d7615fa-6dec-4818-91cc-c0cb9c707888.Text: "And... done!" {n}Jae removes her hand from her ear and turns to you.{/n} "We're good! Now how about we relocate to a more pleasant and private space to discuss the details of our deal, specifically, payment for your efforts?"

2358478f-0dea-4069-9a4e-27bc6a188e44.Text: {n}You get a good look at the contents of one container whose lid is slightly ajar. Under the yellowed plastic, you see numerous cases of odd shapes and sizes. Some of them are transparent, and in the dim light, you can barely make out the strange objects within.{/n}

eee5ceaf-3bde-42b3-bc94-98d2235b01ad.Text: "Oh, I know what you're talking about. I know a few guys who couldn't keep their hands to themselves and ended up losing them. I wouldn't be so good at what I do if I didn't know how to assess risk. Besides... the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} protects, shereen. It really is true. I've seen it myself time and time again."

ab2543c4-213d-4792-8ad8-6681f97148f2.Text: {n}No doubt about it — the container is full of xeno-artefacts, heretical creations of the enemies of Humanity. The very sight of these strange and unnatural objects fills you with a vague sense of unease, even without knowing exactly what these cases contain.{/n}

9b3577a1-3095-4a53-ac68-c24ee2f75f0a.Text: {n}It's completely impossible to discern any details in this low light. And yet the mysterious silhouettes inside the box leave you with a vague sense of wrongness.{/n}

3800b185-08da-4405-939f-34d2f6d2f258.Text: "Listen, {name}. I'm genuinely sorry about this... confusion. Vladaym and I have had our difficulties, but I never thought he'd want to clean me out and do away with me in some dark corner... at least, not so soon. If you hadn't agreed to our deal, shereen, my gang and I would already be floating in orbit around one of Footfall's asteroids."

5f6175f2-ac8c-4ee6-9581-cf51d71a2993.Text: "And... yes, my shipment contains xeno-artefacts, possession of which is a death sentence for any commoner... But you, shereen, do not strike me as a commoner. If I had told you directly, you would have become, shall we say, complicit. But since those illicit words did not escape my lips, you would merely be agreeing to help an unfortunate soul — me — to recapture a few containers. My sincerest wish was to protect you from any unnecessary trouble, shereen. I swear by the Exalted One! And I do hope that this, ah, misunderstanding will not affect our future cooperation...?"

72da1aab-6c27-4a40-a3c6-65342748dd91.Text: "I can't believe I've just seized a shipment of xeno-artefacts from one smuggler on behalf of another." {n}Heinrix's lip curls as he examines the contents of the box with disgust.{/n} "I'm sure that the Rogue Trader knows what {mf|he|she}'s doing and of the consequences that might result from making 'friends' like these."

4719089f-2884-4ec4-a1e7-4f12179b4435.Text: {n}He bows deeply.{/n} "He will be overjoyed to hear your words, no doubt. It is with a light heart that I part with you, my {mf|lord|lady}."

852b012b-1592-477a-aaa3-3757af77d3e3.Text: {n}He looks away.{/n} "I am terribly sorry that my words have upset you — they were not meant as an insult. Please accept my deepest apologies. The cargo's fate is yours to decide — I will deliver your words to the Liege."

58964c52-3755-460e-a788-f000a33ba7cd.Text: "Yes... most certainly. I will deliver your words to the Liege." {n}He bows deeply.{/n}

c0e607ba-b842-4c3e-8ad4-76fd1ea8eee5.Text: "Stop right there, in the name of the Liege!" {n}The gaunt, pale-skinned man in grimy clerical robes glances at you — and immediately falls to his knees obsequiously.{/n} "Your Excellency! Please forgive my vehemence, most noble {name} — I never expected to encounter such eminent persons in this corner of Footfall!"

2804789b-f1ba-4272-8db1-548d80fbce53.Text: {n}She shakes her head in disappointment.{/n} "That's too bad... Too bad. Well then, I thank you for your help. My people will deliver the promised reward to your ship. If you happen to reconsider, you'll find me at the same spot. Goodbye, shereen."

5f60b932-322f-49d7-91da-e407f3b5341a.Text: "Either way, I'm entirely willing to join your retinue. From now on, my knowledge and experience are entirely at your disposal!"

374b0043-1c33-41a2-8592-362d369d57f3.Text: "I swear on the goodness of the Exalted One!" {n}Jae makes the sign of the {g|Encyclopedia:Aquila}Aquila{/g} with an unexpectedly solemn expression.{/n}

49c66f44-da54-4074-9c64-ba0951cb6e92.Text: {n}Jae shrugs.{/n} "Every business relationship has its quirks — if you want to call the shots, I don't mind. I'll gladly serve for the good of the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g} as long as it keeps my head on my shoulders."

560509bf-1ca6-453d-889d-bbb6bf5fc1c0.Text: {n}Jae watches him hurry away, then looks at you.{/n} "I wish I could see Vladaym's face when he finds out he almost stepped on the toes of one of the most powerful people in the Expanse."

37cd02f7-1ba0-452e-9406-23f1edc6b4f5.Text: "Exalted One bless you and your entire dynasty! I wouldn't say no to marking the occasion properly — it's not every day you embark on a brilliant new business partnership!"

a75779bc-cced-4a9b-8e57-3cb3ae4d3fff.Text: "What a scandalous proposal!" {n}Jae lowers her eyes in feigned abashment, then immediately shoots you a sultry look.{/n} "Scandalous and tantalising."

a37c9504-a9a3-445b-9dd5-fbf43b2edfbe.Text: "Well, what can I say, shereen? This isn't the first time someone's said that about me. Don't think it'll be the last time either. But it doesn't matter what we think of each other — what matters is... can we come to an agreement?"

8a76e4bb-15fc-43fc-830a-c07f6a72d626.Text: "Guilty as charged!" {n}Jae raises her hands in joking capitulation.{/n} "You're right on that one, so I guess I'm in no position to criticise."

f3045b4a-f85c-4d5d-b760-3437f9b53cc5.Text: "That is so... human, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I guess people at the top have a lot more in common with regular folk than some might think."

de13e4e7-5622-4111-af48-b64aaf1ed6c1.Text: "Absolutely, shereen. I didn't mean to ruffle your feathers."

b921565b-c938-4b1e-b677-b358fd724a19.Text: {n}Jae gives you a pearly smile.{/n} "We think alike, shereen. Well then, does this mean I can hope for our partnership to continue?"

f643938a-0bc3-4ecd-892f-2f2e2ec043ab.Text: "Oh, and one more thing... If you're interested in a rather lucrative offer, one that can give the von Valancius protectorate a leg up... I'd say now isn't the time to be thinking about such things, but once we get back to your ship... perhaps you could spare me a minute, shereen?"

013e31dd-97c5-492c-a06b-9b2cdd2fb081.Text: "This statement is true, with the exception that you yourself are an uneducated laywoman and a thief who ought to stay away from the technological perversities of non-humans. I am now requesting your preventive disposal."

9fa8522d-6167-41c1-afcc-3b08d4874502.Text: "Uneducated? Me? I've held things in my hands that you, cog for brains, can only dream of in your oil-soaked data-fantasies. Stop hiding behind piety and law — you're simply defending your clique's monopoly on anything and everything of interest and monetary value."

ae44a034-9972-4794-bcb5-d3a21006d2bd.Text: "Why don't we leave it at that and—"

e73a8d86-e4e8-46a2-9752-b5c6ff2f939c.Text: "Mistress Heydari, you didn't answer the Rogue Trader's question." {n}Heinrix's voice sounds dull and almost bored.{/n} "I can assist you with that, if you wish."

e5142ea5-2527-4275-8330-4f33ca001164.Text: {n}Jae gives him a look.{/n} "I don't think that will be necessary. I was just about to get to the point."

41eedf6b-5bf8-431b-857d-30098af9bf80.Text: {n}Abelard gives you a look of reproach.{/n} "You sully the von Valancius name by inviting people like her into your retinue, Lord Captain. The decision is yours, but do not be surprised if unsavoury rumours start to spread on Footfall."

8738a306-180f-4eb2-8470-ec38ec093a6f.Text: {n}Argenta regards Jae.{/n} "It is a strange circle you are forming around yourself, Rogue Trader..."

3716e79e-f8ae-4d98-b51a-68b58965cf73.Text: "Sister Argenta..." {n}Jae gives her an almost lecherous once-over.{/n} "I've heard all about your deeds on Footfall, but I never would have guessed there was an angelic beauty behind all the idle gossip!"

051c4d26-f961-4326-970d-5464ceceed4a.Text: {n}You used to transport goods of a similar nature {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Criminal}yourself{/d}. The container is packed with heretical works of xenos, enemies of Humanity whose creations nonetheless never fail to arouse enough interest to fetch a tremendous price on the black market.{/n}

c6fedd5b-92c2-4640-a102-6bf5902a26df.Text: {n}Jae takes a step back and gives you a slightly puzzled but enraptured look.{/n} "So, I guess that makes us colleagues, then, isn't that right, shereen?"

e5fe2f31-7485-4e6f-9b45-fc5ab3041698.Text: "There are no chance encounters when you are loved by the Exalted One. I like you more and more too, shereen." {n}Jae winks and flashes you a captivating smile.{/n}

2a3bcce3-387e-41e3-80ee-856fc9a483ae.Text: {n}Jae opens her mouth to reply when you hear the sound of many footsteps behind you.{/n}

fa5f2a81-d913-4aab-aa3b-591f0f0ab824.Text: {n}It is too great a coincidence that the Liege's representative should arrive in the Shadow Quarters just after Jae has recovered her rightful spoils. It seems that the guards reported the problems with the shipment over the vox, and not to just anyone, but to the Liege's personal agent. Vladaym Tocara knew about the shipment from the start and planned to take it for himself, and get rid of Jae if he could. Behold — the grubby, underhanded struggle between Cold Traders. And had it not been for your impromptu deal struck in the bar, Vladaym might have succeeded.{/n}

80753623-a343-4e10-8908-d3a02e22b405.Text: {n}This is too convenient. You sense someone has been set up here. But who was the target? And who set the trap?{/n}

429a2fcb-5f69-419e-a92b-b2994dd22856.Text: "Vladaym! That son of a grox! That void jackal! He was in on this from the start!" {n}Jae hisses through her teeth and reaches for the pistol at her hip, but she suddenly turns to you with a wary expression on her face.{/n} "You didn't believe a word that ashmag said, did you, shereen?"

1c6b6517-58ba-46a7-8c1b-c47ff4d1a8b5.Text: "Domin'{name}, if it is indeed your wish to let this heretic into your retinue, then allow me to carve a vow of service into her tongue. Let the pain prevent her from uttering words of deceit and remind her of obedience."

7af065df-397f-4e52-b264-6dff991fb4fd.Text: "Don't even think about it, you crazed kaskha, unless you want me to add a few extra bits of lead to the metal adornments on that sulky mug of yours."

8472fc60-b288-4fc1-83b6-c27c89014eb6.Text: {n}Solomorne folds his arms, his posture implacable and oppressive.{/n} "Joining the Rogue Trader's retinue is a rare chance for someone like you to leave her shameful activities behind and start serving the Imperium. Do not squander this opportunity to become an honourable person, peddler."

698b20d8-7f36-4631-b328-d01ff55cc60a.Text: {n}Jae graces him with a furious smile.{/n} "Why, of course, I will do everything in my power to do what the Exalted One has blessed me to do best — increase the Rogue Trader's wealth! Would that not please Him, you think?"

c5a32c8f-e795-4ef3-b0a7-9a8df9f65afe.Text: "And don't forget to tell him that I'm not mad. But I will be collecting the debt, sometime."

d2d1e5c4-94e7-4e63-ab2e-9624ff5e1de1.Text: "Most noble Excellency?" {n}Jae purses her lips slightly and shoots you a confused look.{/n}

b0bd1abb-d518-48b4-b109-489350e59382.Text: "And while we're at it... shereen, when were you going to reveal your true identity to me?" {n}Jae cocks her head to one side curiously.{/n} "I am infinitely flattered by your attention, but if I had known I was talking to a {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}, not an envoy of one, I would've shown some decorum..."

66375612-df1b-4159-bf28-4c69324dd655.Text: "All right, then... This isn't my first year in the Expanse. It's not my first year in business either. I've sat at the negotiating table with all sorts — not just loot hunters or smugglers either, but with {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g}, ones intelligent enough to believe that mutual benefit was a better outcome of our meeting than mutual destruction. I know what the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMinistorum}Ecclesiarchy{/g} has to say about that. But, speaking from the bottom of my heart — I know where the line is between an ordinary deal and a betrayal of Humanity. And I never cross it."

eec52431-b666-4a72-9de7-dbdce6612109.Text: "The damned wench ran! A terrible shame, this is... Most noble {name}, I humbly beg your forgiveness for this unsightly scene! I hope that this episode won't affect any of your agreements with the Liege... whatever those may be!" {n}He hesitates for a moment, then seems to catch his breath.{/n} "Please accept the cargo taken from the accursed heretic as compensation!"

c9906231-2342-4716-be2d-2d00a5a193f1.Text: "No, no! Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I beg you to forgive this wretched serf! A terrible misunderstanding... a thousand apologies... I won't disturb you further..."

53fa07fb-a23c-4a48-9810-cb6c30e88a9b.Text: "Nothing to worry about — after all the ruckus we've caused here, I doubt anyone will go anywhere near the containers. I am, however, infinitely flattered by your concern for my — now our — property!"

50a3544d-34eb-434d-808e-48d0e2dff8da.Text: "What? You... No, I won't go down so easily!"

52dbd001-5c6c-443c-bddb-43ec0eabbd78.Text: [Execute Jae] "Jae Heydari, for betraying the Imperium, I, {name} von Valancius, hereby sentence you to death."

2e6979b9-d626-4bd1-8d72-febf60f49742.Text: "I was able to infiltrate the quarantined area without your knowledge."

9e9bf257-a9d7-4082-8467-8d25d92393aa.Text: "The source of the disease was a pack of mutants. They have been exterminated. A few survivors remain within the perimeter, but they pose no threat."

9e36997b-9dd7-478c-b313-4ba0a667da39.Text: "So is the quarantine zone safe now?"

474ae43b-91ff-4c7b-b257-cf28f5c8892f.Text: "Utility workers again. I had to shoot a couple of your colleagues, you know."

3535e6c1-fd35-46f0-b137-997c9962364b.Text: "So you don't know exactly what happened in the district? Disease, bugs, or something else?"

7055488a-db61-4e3b-8e56-b50a181e56cb.Text: "Are the people trapped in the quarantine zone being provided with aid of any kind?"

27b97840-5b49-4820-963e-ee3ee3adee62.Text: "I wish to enter the quarantine zone."

4117e38e-7604-44d4-b528-d34cdac3e373.Text: "I bid you farewell. Carry on and remain vigilant!"

d4c3f201-f1e3-4042-8a32-a7dd4cba9c4a.Text: "What measures have been taken to deal with the problem?"

9747734e-5ebc-4c02-aa5a-381c28990405.Text: "The source of the disease was a pack of mutants. They have been exterminated."

5bfc3faa-1fe2-4d94-87dd-3abf6afb3a1c.Text: {n}The man stops and salutes you with his flamer.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! What an honour! The whole of Footfall is talking about the new head of House von Valancius! Foreman of Footfall Utility Crew 3, at your service!"

1d276025-0aa9-45c1-b927-96ff265125bd.Text: "Greetings, {mf|sir|ma'am}! What brings you here? Did you want to watch us break our backs out here, eh? Footfall Utility Crew 3 is proud to work for the good of the denizens and guests of the station!" {n}The man winks and salutes you with his flamer.{/n}

ab0d56ae-d205-4228-9d8b-099855ad5708.Text: "Ah, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Please don't be angry, but we haven't cleared a passage for you yet. Soon, though! Not that many mines left..."

04940b99-648d-42c1-b6c3-8bc91e967f48.Text: {n}The foreman of Utility Crew 3 is whistling some jaunty tune.{/n}

ddf4d2d0-cb9a-47da-80f2-3a45bd51093d.Text: "Well, that depends. We figure everyone who could have died is dead and rotting. And disease and parasites don't usually live in corpses. We threw a few expendables in the quarantine zone, and we can say for sure that it was thirst that killed them in the end, not disease."

f6962bcb-891f-4619-9dca-fd3d1bc2d8f0.Text: {n}The man pales slightly, then gives you a rather strained smile.{/n} "Well... it happens! I hope they didn't die because you didn't like the way they'd fixed your privy, heh heh."

54994fea-de2c-435b-95b4-5b33d114c362.Text: "Of course they don't, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. No threat whatsoever!" {n}He nods enthusiastically.{/n}

0a62b020-03c5-44ee-b353-910bbae795b6.Text: "Just burning rats. And some trash, and some parasites of other sorts. The district's under quarantine, you see. It got hit by something nasty. A disease. Or maybe it isn't a disease, just some bugs an' worms what crawled out of some ship or other."

e35e035a-29d0-4c59-b85f-408ad07d466d.Text: "It is a bit odd that it happened here and not at the docks, I'll grant you. Things like that usually start there. They even spray the place with some gunk to kill all the bugs an' worms. But I guess something slipped through. Two families in that block way over there snuffed it. And the Liege wasted no time getting the district surrounded so that nobody could leave."

db99605c-4ba5-4370-b98f-25f5d77b2ebb.Text: "A thousand apologies, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, but no, we don't, and we'd rather not find out. Who in their right mind would want to get closer to whatever it is? We've contained the foulness — and that's good enough if you ask me!"

2850346a-2bd8-4663-b454-de0854f0f3da.Text: "No. We don't. And we don't wanna find out. If something nasty's cropped up, the right move is to contain it and kill it with fire. Not go in to see what it is and why it's there."

6b0caa01-4e0d-4e66-8609-a131039a5bdb.Text: "Pfft. Of course not. I mean, I heard Reverend Hieronymus has been praying for their souls — which sounded more like, 'Retribution fell upon them, and rightly so.' That's the most they can hope for."

031818e1-0dea-4743-925a-83359fd543fb.Text: "You're looking at them! We stand here, burn the foulness, and we've got people standing guard so that no one escapes. Put some mines down — a whole load of them — for the same reasons. The water, the sewers — all blocked off, to stop any communications getting out. The air's open, I s'pose, but the foulness doesn't seem to be airborne — there haven't been any strange deaths outside the district."

00349320-c9a7-43af-96b8-c4cff482329f.Text: "But I... I just... Will do! I'll report it right away!"

8f140ffd-8a97-4fb9-8640-c84fc139bf6b.Text: {n}The foreman's smile becomes a little less sincere. His searching eyes wander over the ranks of his subordinates. Then, he sighs.{/n} "Normally, not even a rat can get past us, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! But you are no ordinary person. You possess special talents. I dare not judge. If you got in, you must have had a reason to."

0f567fe7-57ee-410d-8f76-b0e6c0a74fd0.Text: {n}The foreman looks you up and down with a long gaze full of suspicion. The barrel of his flamer turns in your direction with seeming nonchalance.{/n} "That's a load of groxwash, {mf|sir|ma'am}. We did a thorough job sealing off every passage, what with quarantine being about no one getting in — or out. Don't joke like that anymore, or I might take you at your word." {n}The flamer releases a noisy burst of fire into the air.{/n}

424240af-2c24-4b80-b7ef-743c40a7fef2.Text: "Ah, you again. Greetings! We were just in the middle of removing the cordon, you see. The epidemic's over, apparently. If there ever was one, that is. Me and the lads are gonna light the place up a bit, and then it'll be right as rain!"

ef20fc7e-f27e-4661-980d-19df67d228b4.Text: "Ah, it's you again! An order came down in regard to your esteemed self — we're to clear out a passage and let you through. So here we are — clearing and disarming the mines... I don't know why you're in such a rush to bite it, but — eh, it's none of my business. You just wait, and we'll make a way in for you sooner or later."

0b99239c-7de0-4365-b4eb-ab53e2aad7e1.Text: "Who knows? They found them in their hovels, already dead. Blue sores on their bodies, and they stank something awful, which is why the lot that found them didn't even risk looting the corpses. Good on them, I guess. Doesn't mean we let them out, of course."

66f8eaf1-dd93-4d69-bae9-261a87b7284e.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, have mercy! I can't say no to you, but the danger is just as real to you as it is to the whole station! We'll... We'll clear a way for you. But it'll take time, a lot of time — it won't be easy to break down the barricades and disarm the mines." {n}He gives you a long look, likely hoping that you will reconsider. But, after receiving no reaction, he gives the order to his assistants.{/n}

a811e342-9ca9-465f-8488-360e40965947.Text: "No dice. Not gonna happen. We're letting no one in. I'm telling you right now, bribes and intimidation won't work on me, so don't even try. You can file a petition with the Liege if you're so desperate. But my advice to you would be to go on your merry way. The void's got plenty of nasty, dangerous holes, you don't have to die in this one in particular. You'll go in and die, and that means I'll have more corpses to burn..." {n}He pointedly turns away.{/n}

ecd52447-a0f6-4481-8358-00c5c9bcfda3.Text: "Negative — it does not 'happen.'" {n}Pasqal's voice turns peevish, and his visor lights up red.{/n} "As a representative of the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMechanicus}Adeptus Mechanicus{/g}, I am registering a complaint with Footfall Station Services. The crematorium in which the burning of the late Denz Bellardo's body was to take place remains in an unsatisfactory state of maintenance. Two circuit stations within the sewer infrastructure are missing their standard support unit. That is unacceptable!"

6e930af7-711e-4ba1-b551-fd341b635d51.Text: "Mutants, is it? Hmm... Funny thing about mutants — you keep burning them, and they just keep popping up! Well, thank you kindly for the help and the details. Footfall won't forget it. Me and the lads will drop by their lair and clean up, make sure there's no disease left!"

e3fd0c47-61ac-4421-b684-a7006ad661cf.Text: {n}His outburst over, Pasqal appears to calm down — the colour of his visor changes to blue, and his mechadendrites stop snapping so violently.{/n} "Report to your direct superior that I, {g|Encyclopedia:Magos}Magos{/g} Haneumann, have requested an immediate inspection."

f0d5b157-b3ed-41f7-b0c9-0e889799c61f.Text: "Whoever said that joy follows duty either never had any duties or lived a very miserable life."

0524228d-b1ac-4f0b-9f3e-28db0354722e.Text: "Fearlessly do the faithful tread, heedless of the horrors of the universe, the Archenemy's temptations... and that terrible stench, Emperor forgive me."

1a597052-12ab-47e6-b464-6c6c29801f53.Text: "When I dreamt of the outside world, it looked... different. Less harsh."

8cecba37-06d1-4846-a392-57a8d973958a.Text: "You might think you would get used to it the second time around. But no, it's just as repulsive as before."

7a4c8c35-ea33-49ec-807a-4c730dfaf3ad.Text: "In theory, we're all in deep shit. But in reality, it's just me."

744ce493-0fea-47f9-bf54-c14216597838.Text: "There are some things in life that you're better off not knowing or thinking about — ignorance of them is a blessing from the Exalted One. Well, right now, I'm feeling a little less blessed."

584963d2-404a-4e48-9269-3047025e6335.Text: "There is definitely something wrong with your race, mon-keigh."

e2b7c02b-ef87-4689-8ac5-4e177b5f85d4.Text: [Brandish your weapon] "Hunger won't kill you this instant. But this might!"

1c6c597e-13d6-47d9-87bb-fdd281ea4790.Text: Prevented the hunger riot on Footfall by ordering the distribution of food from your voidship.

712661bb-6e5a-4af9-aa62-58402b264bf4.Text: "Stop! I will have food delivered from my ship to the Shadow Quarters to be handed out. There is no need for violence!"

5d1c816b-7ba2-4f44-a919-7e68c61014ca.Text: "Open your larders! Give us all you've got! Or else we'll just take it ourselves!"

8b15f7ad-ffc2-437b-b60a-a591d630ecc2.Text: "Yeah, right! Run back to your holes, rats. If you've nothing to eat, it's not my problem!"

990de737-eb45-41f6-9b97-80679741709c.Text: {n}Idira observes the rabble dismally.{/n} "Back when I was a kid on my home planet, a whole district was left without rations, so we tried to pull this kind of stunt on a local shop... The owners just started shooting, no questions asked. Hah. Never took Footfall's wardens for pushovers..."

e76bce5a-bf5e-4372-b722-bbac6762dd55.Text: "Please, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I'm not to blame for any of this! This riffraff wants to rob the bar! They say they got nothing to eat!" {n}The guard spits.{/n}

a9314ddb-8a2c-4f44-ace1-2b52b55b088c.Text: "Just some riffraff what wants to rob the bar. They got nothing to eat, they say! Come over here, {mf|sir|ma'am} — have a bit of fun with us, we'll shoot 'em full of holes!" {n}The guard points his weapon at the crowd.{/n}

a1dc90e6-e75c-4032-b99b-7429d1ca7d2f.Text: {n}The rioter backs away.{/n} "What the—? We just can't catch a break... Come on, people, all we're getting here is our brains splattered!"

4edccb0b-d93d-4d66-9b67-5253ebdf9182.Text: "You can't scare us! We'll take your knives and your guns and sell them to feed our kids! Get 'em, lads!"

fddaa061-9a79-46a3-9570-f59406459720.Text: "Right, I've had enough of you scum."

74f218ef-3f4c-4175-aac8-fa3679d42150.Text: {n}The rioter stares at you in disbelief for a whole minute.{/n} "R-really? You'll help? The Emperor must have heard us, He must have! Please, send the food soon. Our whole neighbourhood is starving!"

9e666e10-41dc-4125-8acd-82aac887097d.Text: "Found someone to beg from, did you? Now shove off! Quickly now, before I hurry you up with a bullet in the back."

cfac7737-7064-4f3a-b061-85340548bfdc.Text: "These peasants are engulfed in flames of maroon and yellow. In a few moments, despair and hunger will overwhelm them, burn them from within, smother their fear of death... and become a storm of grimy crimson."

415b8c05-b5ab-4ad0-a941-622f9bb3afb1.Text: "You will, will you?" {n}Kibellah pulls a dagger out of her sleeve, the weapon's edge still damp with blood — either her own or someone else's.{/n} "What about this blade, which has opened the throats of more heretics than you have lived years — will you take it too?"

24066dae-3ff2-4cbf-be84-cb69745d6299.Text: {n}Abelard shakes his head.{/n} "Old Danrok will have a fit..."

914ad9da-03cb-4c6b-85d7-592b8d53406e.Text: "I think he's got a few scraps to spare. Come to think of it, it's about time someone cut HIS rations — the High Factotum's trousers go up a size every year."

3ef825c5-91b2-438f-b289-0de0ba3ed38f.Text: "Open your pantries, you rotters! We know you're feasting in there while we're starving!"

30149d5c-e0c0-492b-bb5b-998669e0f285.Text: "When times are tough, you gotta share!"

9e90e8aa-d07c-4ef0-abd8-d5a970b5e9c7.Text: "Aah! Get 'em! We'll make a break for it!"

dcb59f2d-df1a-4e01-add7-95b0ed6e4038.Text: "Hold it right there, rabble! Or I'll shoot!"

07bbfa69-f55a-40ef-9270-d22439f28a88.Text: "You thought you could rob Octaviana? We'll show you!"

1d1cb1f0-e75f-44b0-9563-a342842bafa0.Text: "Take what you want and get out of my sight."

bc577b96-aaf8-44b8-a26d-63699a9e8aa4.Text: [Give alms] "Take what you need, and here's a little on top."

35442718-02b2-485f-ae54-a0966ebd6aaf.Text: {n}The urchin sniffles loudly to get your attention.{/n} "'ello there, Your Higherness! You're just like they say! So {mf|'andsome|pretty}! And strong! And your clothes are so sharp!"

25ad3226-cfd9-45e4-800b-a6d731045baf.Text: "Right you are. I'm as good as gone!" {n}Glancing sadly at the boots on the corpse, the urchin darts away.{/n}

917efa55-f036-4a4f-8b3d-997f28a492cb.Text: {n}The urchin sniffles loudly to get your attention.{/n} "'ello there, {mf|sir|lady}! Nice job you did there with all this lot! Very 'eroic, it was!"

cb4ed5a3-4650-464a-bfe4-c49d54e26a75.Text: "Much obliged, {mf|sir|my lady}! I'll be done in a jiffy! The boots, the pockets — and it'll be like I was never 'ere!"

2f7da3e7-2c4d-4727-992f-62c9188d2eac.Text: {n}He looks at the alms with suspicion, but then gives you a beaming smile with the remaining half of his rotten teeth.{/n} "Golly, thanks, {mf|sir|my lady}! Thanks a whole bunch! May the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} and all His angels protect ya!"

4704b858-6a97-4e59-9428-3e2713d6b340.Text: "Er... Can I poke through the dead guys you just dropped real quick? I just wanna take a couple of things... like the boots on that fella over there..." {n}He gives you an obsequious look.{/n}

f44a4e7f-3d12-4a95-954b-613fa33a5d7a.Text: [Try to move the metal sheet out of the way]

648d5d6c-3783-4859-b544-e08d8b204bf8.Text: "Please, don't be afraid. I mean you no harm."

04250604-e824-4f37-8dc2-8153ecd6bdc1.Text: [Blow up the barricade along with the survivors] "I'm sorry, but I cannot risk leaving you alive."

b31dec53-b68b-4218-8d9d-0d4ce019fb51.Text: "I will verify your claim about the mutants."

72709058-df58-41d6-9a71-e7fc87ac0c83.Text: "You weren't lying about the mutants. They have been exterminated and won't infect anyone else."

85192d4a-3cbf-4bb9-a67a-a3d89de80f52.Text: {n}You hear the sound of falling objects from behind the thick sheet of metal, followed by angry hissing:{/n} "Quiet! I said quiet! Before someone finds us!"

4747339c-edd1-48e2-832e-a593bdc15acf.Text: {n}Giving Jae a sidelong glance, Pasqal wheezes in displeasure,{/n} "I am putting forward a supposition that they traded in samples of xenotechnology. And those samples behaved as expected in the hands of the ignorant — they brought death and extinction to Humankind."

79a77e6d-a1be-4506-b99a-5d7bd81f0171.Text: "I agree completely — ashmags need to be kept away from the Cold Trade. As for the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMechanicus}Adeptus Mechanicus{/g}'s conviction that everyone other than themselves is a moron — that I disagree with."

8013896a-ff21-4153-87b4-5a95704cff69.Text: {n}A cry of terror rings out from behind the barricade.{/n} "No! Never! We're not letting anyone in!"

140617a6-5781-4fae-9f24-ccc0e158c147.Text: "Please, have mercy! Don't kill us! We're not infected, I swear! It's them, they're to blame! It's them!" {n}Her pleading is cut short by a violent, wheezing cough.{/n}

4e200106-9215-4e9f-9a22-729694b80a0d.Text: {n}The sheet is very heavy and must have been propped up with something from the other side or wedged shut. Moving it seems impossible.{/n}

fe45b55f-1f06-429f-983c-e416fb9d6154.Text: "We'll tell you everything, just please, spare our lives! We know where the disease came from!"

21768486-2aae-4a07-bcbd-db2f5685d0f6.Text: "We do... we know..." {n}Another coughing fit interrupts the woman's words.{/n} "It's them... those damned mutants! They have a hideout somewhere under our block, we used to see them skulking in the shadows all the time..."

dd4a5050-0374-4a9a-9ad9-b59497749085.Text: "The two families who died first, they had dealings with them. Traded something. And they caught some mutant blight. I know they did! Those mutants are very tough, they're always sick with something, but they don't die of it. But ordinary people definitely do!"

2db2337d-391c-4d6c-93f8-7385e5615539.Text: "We got lucky, though! We're alive, we're getting by — the disease couldn't claim us!"

fd0390ab-58fc-44f1-b87d-5eb5b4f52e36.Text: {n}It is very quiet behind the metal sheet.{/n}

99e1ecd0-5bea-4a5f-804e-25f93c99ea32.Text: "No! We don't deserve this! We don't! Oh, Mummy, I'm so scared... Mummy..."

e1b18f41-7a72-40b3-bec8-e8b5997f7aff.Text: "We're not lying! Look for their entrance, it has to be close by!"

e3b8ffe7-0c68-41a3-9708-70ce697d7645.Text: "Praise the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g}! You... You'll tell them, right? Right? That Crew 3 or whatever they're called. Please tell them, then maybe they won't kill us..."

512cfa7b-178d-4dba-9961-83c8602638a9.Text: "I see we are up against true masters of stealth, shereen. We should keep our voices soft and gentle, or else we might literally scare them to death."

3fe0a334-d8ff-40f1-9e56-1255c4899ab4.Text: "Death... dressed in black... walked the streets... and sowed... sowed... disease..."

908be9d8-ec85-440a-9ead-285d3037f23e.Text: "Brothers and sisters, look... they cleared the way! We break through! It's now or never!"

e3435217-5f6c-4cc0-b10c-6ed5f969b5af.Text: "I won't die here like a rat! Go! Go! Shoot everyone you run into!"

97130796-1ad9-44bd-9892-ca149f260ce4.Text: "I'm bored... I wish they'd try to break out again..."

e1a803d6-e7b3-4226-9888-37636eb7e95e.Text: "They won't risk it, they've learned their lesson. Let's go shoot some cans instead. Fancy a wager?"

033ecc25-92ca-4dba-8033-e4e842d3b618.Text: "Sure, I'm down. No wagers, though. I lost half my pay to you that time, remember?"

65823da1-9bbd-4d02-8abf-a3660442e29d.Text: "Bet I could hit that jar over there."

7f4c7728-3e08-4998-9d63-6d17bcdb1d9b.Text: "Shut your gob! Don't you see — the new Rogue Trader is walking here!"

0a2527e7-657f-4531-8afb-f9d2285b1889.Text: "And? You think a Rogue Trader is gonna run to the Liege to report that we're wasting his bullets on target practice?"

ee332c4e-8f86-4151-92a2-bf6032f2dc81.Text: There is a groove here in the dust... like someone left tracks behind before hastily covering them.

6c7e0bcc-96aa-4889-b3ba-14b2c6321d1f.Text: Someone spilt water here, and it hasn't had time to dry.

c4026544-7467-4a2f-987a-de74dbe4b104.Text: These columns look too elegant for their surroundings.

99803501-2dcf-427b-8626-82d21b054169.Text: These columns appeared here back when the station was founded, when it was assumed that Footfall would become a wondrous palace in the stars.

f3f6eb5c-bf85-4c49-a558-06614cf863af.Text: A mishmash of cables and devices.

0a0eebac-824b-4b4f-b17c-3811a4a191bb.Text: In this mishmash of devices and cables, you notice equipment from totally different eras — some ancient, some merely old, and others hastily tossed together in more recent years.

0c1c2ad1-14d8-4028-ad81-8157d8e3400b.Text: This ancient statue does not look very well preserved.

e0cb3454-d0e8-40a6-8559-b7e694f64233.Text: This statue undoubtedly depicts Parsimus Dewain, the legendary Rogue Trader who founded Footfall.

d43b43b2-2950-4275-802a-67499b6a48fa.Text: "The body of the leader of the Grey Knives gang was found in a dump, and her head in another dump. Disrespecting the Kasballica isn't good for you!"

c4bcf2db-8cf4-431e-9471-2d225e686f0d.Text: "Two families were found dead in the southern blocks of the Shadow Quarters, their bodies covered in sores. The area has been quarantined, and all who breach the restrictions are being killed on the spot. No surprise there!"

bdd43b34-8dfb-46aa-a523-947f7e77483d.Text: "Repairs of air filtration systems have started on Dewain Prime. Rejoice, everyone — the rich will finally breathe easy!"

dd774315-2f6a-4f89-a747-9d7861e732db.Text: "Lord Tocara has officially permitted rotgut to be made by anyone. Lord Tocara also owns every workshop that makes distillery equipment on Footfall. Unofficially, of course."

1ade557b-cb4e-4e97-a8f3-26d08d334422.Text: "Thanks to our benevolent asteroid-dwelling suppliers, the price of heavy metals has almost doubled in a single cycle."

6f285c1f-26d6-4b60-bf21-ea7872308f71.Text: "Incendia Chorda has replaced Calligos Winterscale as Footfall's greatest patron. Get ready to show some piety!"

311c5dc2-19c6-4793-9adc-8f58140efea2.Text: "Our 'agency' is temporarily suspending its coverage of Anvers activity. They're cutting people faster than we can report the deaths!"

fad5c1f5-b7bb-4d16-85e6-01d216934a4c.Text: "And yet — we have news about the Anvers! They finally fixed the typo in their famous leaflet!"

f1b3879c-69c0-4a96-b3b8-57e035a8419b.Text: "Rumour has it that the ones who pacified the Anvers were the new arrivals from the von Valancius ship that's currently moored at Dock Alpha-Rho."

d61c2d3b-d50d-46a3-9b9b-0edda87e2a6e.Text: "Rumour has it that the one who pacified the Anvers was {mf|Lord|Lady} von Valancius {mf|himself|herself}."

eb2e6ec3-fe7c-4dd2-bd93-7a6df10a6056.Text: "Not a single Anvers attack has been reported lately. The favourite protagonists of our news service have vanished into thin air."

94a60135-e296-4402-9ee7-75a6c4854159.Text: "The fierce Sister Argenta is on the prowl in the Shadow Quarters. Those of you with signs of mutation or corruption better run as far as you can."

852439ad-bff0-4cfe-91ef-62dc28fd3322.Text: "Sister Argenta was seen in the Shadow Quarters again. Expect to find the roasted corpses of mutants and heretics in dark corners!"

6554a9db-9735-4065-a441-0f3f0b36a8d6.Text: "Footfall's food stores are depleting quickly. The Liege and his people are trying to cover up the crisis."

4e07e980-7a6c-47d9-baab-8ff6f28c0660.Text: "The Liege has pretty much admitted that the station is facing famine. There has been no news regarding food shipments from Winterscale or other sources."

6b56a8e5-4dbf-4d5d-a13f-196263e73c7b.Text: "Food riots are raging in the Shadow Quarters. Stores are dwindling. However, multiple sources have reported ships loaded with food departing House Chorda territory."

dbfe8fbd-1b14-4392-8ce9-28a9a9f813d9.Text: "A food shipment has arrived from the fertile world of Janus, a vassal planet of House von Valancius. The station has a new favourite Rogue Trader!"

3043c523-2b10-4595-bc94-725de7fe5e88.Text: "A ship owned by House von Valancius has arrived on Footfall. A group of Anvers who tried to attack the arrivals was promptly and thoroughly thrashed."

9a39f74c-e90d-4dfc-a471-124a90b630e5.Text: "Attention, creditors and other interested parties: Jae Heydari was seen in the company of an unknown affluent figure. A new patron, perhaps?"

27deb940-1b20-46c0-bf15-d22bdc7abda7.Text: "Attention, creditors and other interested parties: Jae Heydari has found herself a powerful patron — {mf|Lord|Lady} von Valancius."

dd38113f-f565-4063-82a9-9f7cffc08a36.Text: "A transfer of power took place within House von Valancius. Rogue Trader Theodora is dead. Her heir, {name} von Valancius, has arrived on Footfall on a visit."

b49d9015-9752-4a27-98c7-3ae82cbf7a76.Text: The device, which bears an odd resemblance to both a cogitator and a furnace, reacts to your presence with a faint blink of its lights and an inscrutable binharic signal.

6f9bca6e-b39b-4d9c-818a-5de951d369c1.Text: These old research cogitators are unpowered.

be22566e-8ac4-49c0-864e-8e744a5bb225.Text: What few scraps of flesh remain on the Tech-Priest's body have withered away almost entirely. The augmetics underneath are shamelessly exposed.

495dc0c5-4e1f-4436-aee8-faae93560e31.Text: The thick layer of dust is a tell-tale sign that this place has had very few visitors. Despite that, you can see faint footprints that were left by whoever came here last.

a6fe2d71-13cc-4ff0-9730-15bd9c672b74.Text: "Take a look at this hideous abomination..."

1b17887f-42d5-4bdc-94de-29eb33569e7f.Text: "Which manufactorum do they even make these at? Must be some kind of sorcery!"

5e163d39-8c2a-4df3-b9d2-54d796a7c0ae.Text: "Oi, watch your mouth before someone hears you slandering the Lord Captain..."

ad0a21e6-74ae-4793-b327-27e588286176.Text: "But it's true, it is! One of the senior officers came too close to this thing — clean lost his mind, he did. Wrote some mad inscriptions all over his cabin and now won't stop mumbling nonsense!"

7548e17d-4ad0-40a9-a093-053d4fc66110.Text: "Enough already. Don't go around repeating ludicrous rumours."

905bd70f-00cf-4795-bdbc-cbda19edd945.Text: "Uh-huh. And you better take a couple o' steps back from the beast — that thing could pounce any minute..."

86dfda4e-f072-4b90-90b5-68dad550a84e.Text: "You heard what happened on the middle decks?"

94cfa632-108b-4a2d-82b7-4825e8f8cf77.Text: "Those poor sods? That's rotten luck, to get crushed to death by a collapsed door..."

3e9eb1fd-cdf3-40a1-ba79-8e5cc1734611.Text: "It didn't collapse! And not all of them died — lots of them lost an arm or a leg though. The surviving officers say the compartment door slammed shut precisely when their group was going through it."

2b109ec2-e933-421a-911f-5abc40c1ba4d.Text: "Yeah, that's what I heard too. It closed, then opened, then closed again, mulching everyone who got caught in it..."

6ca91db9-fbe3-45ab-8c2a-a18e782e1ad3.Text: "...Bay DF-541. Reported issue: unauthorised airlock opening. Describe your situation."

215395c9-d60b-4671-80f2-ee7c609c7ac4.Text: "...registered. The airlock door is not responding to commands. It is opening and closing without any operator inputs. There have been casualties."

8945f67d-628d-4afa-a39f-283f1721d1ac.Text: "...checking. Bay DF-541, the airlock passed inspection fewer than five watches ago, no malfunctions were identified."

084304f9-5794-4ff4-9762-641c3e628257.Text: "...Bay DF-541, technomats are on their way. Stand by for further instructions."

7ccd8bb6-2ddd-4d29-a436-34d190f9e8b9.Text: "...records show a total of 98 irregularities in the operation cycles of doorways on the lower and middle decks."

60124372-d891-4824-804d-f127182f82ac.Text: "The inspection showed no technical issues with the malfunctioning mechanisms..."

e2a60e5a-ec48-42ce-b019-18fde08e2ef1.Text: "...Hypothesis: the machine spirits of the vessel are wrathful."

2268bb54-616b-4ce2-a88e-d1637e589071.Text: "...Directive: conduct a liturgical rite at once to appease the raging spirits."

5313679e-4870-41fd-b210-617c1653594f.Text: "Throne almighty... A report's just come in from medicae. Listen to this!"

d822ba31-eaca-4446-bf0b-49bc0f136a26.Text: "Four hours ago, 87 reconnaissance operatives were delivered to the medical facility with identical injuries..."
