3a869f3a-a81c-4fb6-83a7-03b1ec785b46.Text: "...During a test run of new equipment designed to assist with research missions in environments devoid of atmosphere, its thermoregulators malfunctioned."

f9ea6465-df4b-474a-b221-0a1f5e59034f.Text: "...The temperature inside the void suits rose to 92 degrees, causing severe burns. No defects were discovered in the equipment."

2956fa62-96e4-499f-843d-24c75e7b3198.Text: "Permission to report! We've received preliminary findings on the recent incidents."

babba01e-e406-4418-9e62-8f5d88bbb952.Text: "Granted. Do we have anything on those temperature shifts?"

aa5b4537-ef47-47f7-b8a5-f2932503534e.Text: "The technomats concluded that they could have been caused by a system failure... but no such failure was confirmed. The Tech-Priests are praying to the Omnissiah in hopes of resolving the issue."

c5f969cd-50dc-4a29-a75c-8af7a4ba80c2.Text: "Once the prayer has concluded, organise an inspection of the thermoregulation systems and provide me with a detailed report afterward. Dismissed."

5564a7ee-7ec4-4698-9b60-9fd79e48a20d.Text: "...receiving report. Lower Deck, Bay XT-942. Temperature dropping to 20 degrees."

913e58a5-fbb2-404e-9b81-e2bb36e71ad4.Text: "...124 work units are currently in the bay. All exhibiting signs of frostbite."

857fe225-3f57-4985-b37e-965a02e5b06c.Text: "...Temperature is continuing to drop. Registered: 28 degrees below zero."

5e64ccb7-d602-4929-8e25-727c0510840f.Text: "...Preliminary conclusion: thermoregulation system failure. Repair crew dispatched to Bay XT-942."

82efd732-9812-4bd0-b5dc-ada4ded1bdcc.Text: "What the... What's this? Useless piece of junk! That's the fourth time this shift it's messed up the readings!"

3ae4f76d-248f-4655-a2f4-a63301acfa0f.Text: "Blasphemy! How dare you, a vacuous lump of decrepit flesh, defame the sacred spirit of this mechanism!"

0082b1a2-7a08-4f93-a9fb-77d16bde924e.Text: "Step back, defiler! The hallowed machine serves you impeccably, yet you besmirch its sanctity?"

d898cfd8-c811-459a-9106-9ea98f9fd12c.Text: "Impeccably? I swear on the gold of the Throne, the symbols were all jumbled just a minute ago!"

b461fdc3-24db-4ef3-8507-48e3dcc945c3.Text: "O inscrutable and almighty spirits of this blessed mechanism, heed my plea for your grace..."

8820c43c-db34-4d5b-bd73-12f24fadc27e.Text: "Bestow your sublime compassion and immeasurable wisdom upon those created to follow the Omnissiah's will..."

010eefe0-5ce8-49ed-bdbb-2940f4989184.Text: "Restore control over the mechanisms and correct the calculation errors in the sacred code..."

f9133f80-c8ae-4a2d-8f96-a11c3742d3ef.Text: A binharic litany is coming from the Tech-Priest's vox-device.

788ee600-305e-4aab-a51e-7693299b2937.Text: "...Augur crew, report registered. Unable to catalogue space object data from the last 13 shifts due to a system failure. Please clarify."

b18d9527-405d-4ece-9770-2365bdf4bf9d.Text: "...All numerical values in statistical data are changing to ones. Tech-Priests have been dispatched to augurs for investigation."

e710e909-a651-41c1-8cab-cd008a27f87a.Text: "...Repeat. The cogitators stabilised immediately following your report, and the data is now being catalogued correctly."

431a2bc7-3664-497f-b9a4-daa8fefdb8b8.Text: "...Augur crew, you are taking advantage of your access to this channel and needlessly distracting the operator. Your shift has been issued a warning."

4812cea5-57ba-4167-8ece-8215adaa7397.Text: "I beg of you! End my suffering!"

1e7aba6d-ec05-484e-b66e-b1582a80b69d.Text: "You scum! I don't want to die!"

bf9929c1-8080-4890-80c5-db9700ef1910.Text: This poor soul was cut up with sadistic precision to make the process as excruciating as possible.

2d39d06b-e94f-4612-a9af-496d05cfc42b.Text: "This banality of violence is dull. I crave subtlety."

1e9d525a-ce5a-458a-b17a-dffa8dabca8f.Text: "Oh, the sweet taste of ecstatic pain and bitter resignation."

2c692720-4e37-47d8-84bb-0f62e5e6896c.Text: "Yes... More blood... Open the throat... Yes!"

cc197764-1b70-4010-be9b-2c3311ef64c0.Text: "Xenos carrion, feel our thirst for blood!"

7a71a689-1d44-4fbc-b340-db5fdd4c12a4.Text: "Our {mf|Lord|Lady} von Valancius will pave our road to freedom with your entrails!"

cbb492c3-fd66-47be-8292-d3aa4c869008.Text: "I have come to feed you with my death!"

d3f737c4-6ffb-4ae9-8e5e-0d654b657ec2.Text: "Keykeross's hounds are dead! We've proven ourselves. Maybe the Cult will even take us under their protection! But there are... too many of us. And there can't be too many winners!"

6b02f1ca-067f-4286-a0e3-f6d55d98377d.Text: "If you're looking for more refined entertainment, watch the ousted Dracon of the Reaving Tempest fight for his life against the glorious champions of the arena, the Bloodstained Proselytes!"

8a7273e9-0dd0-4c72-9e4c-2144accc79e5.Text: "Is that all? Will you just give me your pet jesters? Don't be offended if I break your playthings, Keykeross."

3c429b6e-c854-49a3-be3a-5c45246055ab.Text: "If your soul is so hardened that only the triumph of violence can soften its scars, enjoy the massacre of the fearsome Fleshgorger! Today, we will try to kill him again!"

01a824dd-180a-4958-98be-5c31d5bdab9e.Text: "Have you enjoyed it? Are you surprised? The fallen Dracon has defeated the best warriors of the arena! The Cult appreciates it. Marazhai Aezyrraesh has been granted the right to join the Bloodstained Proselytes, our circle of champions."

ad1d3815-3cfd-4cec-91a7-2b4de6e2d388.Text: "Did any of you expect to see a mon-keigh challenger survive the vicious hunt? Do you savour the sight of the Fleshgorger devouring his mangled enemies? Is your Fatal Thirst quenched?"

fe7bf493-ba82-4e76-aacb-62b3ec90ed2d.Text: "Rejoice, spire dwellers, for I have come to slake your Fatal Thirst! May the vicious hunt commence today!"

0d482609-3512-4761-9e84-056a63c9e719.Text: "My wild hounds will enter the arena to taste the blood of its wretched challengers. Bathe your souls in their suffering! Make your guesses at whether the prey can overpower the predators!"

3cdf13f0-b512-4b92-bfce-6467925d96d9.Text: "No! I won't go! Please, I want to live!"

cf200d06-9cbc-410c-a04d-1ff96fa91734.Text: "Look, I'm a friend of the Cult, maybe we can—"

603e98bf-c840-4c74-933d-c3310175e525.Text: "What did you say, mon-keigh? I can't hear you."

e5fb9097-84ab-4424-84c2-ad84d0195fbe.Text: "You think Malice is afraid to step into the arena, don't you? I used to rule it!"

161524e1-68a4-47e4-9b39-453aa7839bcd.Text: "Come here, big head. I will show you what Malice is worth."

fd178ad5-2861-4a93-a588-df1df7c77505.Text: "It seems that Malice is worth nothing. Your times of glory have passed, old meat. Your idleness has made you sluggish."

961e94aa-0977-4b61-8fc7-65f6d448124e.Text: "A finale as bloody as it is disappointing. The pathetic amateurs who were wrongfully proclaimed champions of the arena have been brought down at the hands of unworthy challengers. Impale the failures, and glory to the victor."

2ed967c4-39a2-4758-8987-ee43616ea34f.Text: "Get out, mon-keigh. And tell Tervantias that he will pay for this insult."

b6c988dc-14bf-4b09-9759-d3951a9362d1.Text: "Thirsters of woe! An exquisite strife awaits you! The Bloodstained Proselytes will face the sophisticated killers of the Kabal of the Poisonous Whisper. And the challengers who have already survived one fight in the arena will go up against fresh battle meat provided by the Kabal of the Wounded Skies!"

508ef341-c539-48c0-90d1-ab3e2f0de8a3.Text: "The esteemed Archons have made a wager to see whose champions will end their fight first... and survive!"

65085f51-29b8-4b12-ad9a-c2e8577f65d2.Text: "Poisonous Whisper, do you hear the call of Aebys, leader of the Bloodstained Proselytes? Your silence will be the first to grace this arena! And even this questionable... addition will not stop us from prevailing in this race!"

7586cd8d-0dc1-4cfa-89f5-fc9216365325.Text: "In the legend, she slew them all and pressed onward... but our story will be shorter. Kill!"

aeb88bcd-dc2e-42b1-a0f8-559cc07f883d.Text: "And took Seikha, the Bestower of Power, from her cold hand!"

55b1a062-d3e7-4ac0-b0a6-053c3454d904.Text: "Know that Keykeross paid handsssomely for your death. It has been an epoch sssince my last employment, for there are few who can afford my ssskill."

678e65aa-d260-4555-b3d2-14431bb1815c.Text: "{mf|He|She} killed Keykeross! The arena is outraged!"

d6fd4a8a-8f2e-4686-96f9-3213048bc060.Text: "Rip {mf|him|her} to shreds and offer {mf|his|her} remains to the Cult!"

21c618c0-68e9-4819-beec-942ab91d6e5f.Text: "It is high time the filthy mon-keigh offered up {mf|his|her} suffering!"

887a9289-4303-4a16-8887-4330a1952d21.Text: "She wandered the Webway's savage wilds and slew scores of their terrible horrors as she fought for her life."

86435479-1af9-4fa4-9cf8-8e7cac0da8ef.Text: "The beast of immeasurable flesh fell, for the infinitude of its being was no match for the needle of Sirlael's focused will. She ran the beast through, pierced its heart, and ripped it free. That heart was the black crystal of Seikha, the Bestower of Power."

0257246d-7324-41f2-b613-11a64b5f25a9.Text: "With Seikha in hand, Sirlael returned to Commorragh and brought down those who had served and later betrayed her. She came to the threshold of her arena and shouted the name of her apprentice, the one who had once dethroned her."

9dd02d4c-6de1-4c92-bb48-5988d05f4ae6.Text: "And hear her the apprentice did. The Succubus Sinisthoria answered the challenge and descended the steps toward her."

73978c93-40ed-4396-a812-50d87deaae67.Text: "Bested by Sirlael's hand, the swordsman knelt and recognised her skill. He was no mere mortal but the gods' creation with respect for all things flawless. As a reward for her victory, he offered Sirlael a gift, the way to a place where she could claim her vengeance."

7af5fe59-f45c-43d7-bc89-93c3d44e12a5.Text: "In a forgotten fragment of the Webway, she found a lair guarded by an ancient beast of immeasurable flesh. Sirlael delivered blow upon blow, and yet, her strikes could not diminish the creature's body or mute its roar!"

15902329-3508-4f5b-9aef-46cfe2902c55.Text: "Even the monsters of the obscure sectors of the Webway feared her and fled out of sight! Sirlael's exile continued in solitude until a great faceless swordsman barred her way. He wished to test her."

b616e008-1e39-4352-9104-9b8000488cc2.Text: "Thirsters! Do you want to witness a great legend as ancient as Commorragh itself? I give it to you now! Behold the tale of Sirlael the Exile, the Succubus Dethroned!"

a2dcc8cc-4084-4d80-b920-aeaa90ccada2.Text: "Sirlael was a mighty warrior of her Cult, renowned and deadly! Her dance of battle was an entrancing perfection of terror! But then a time came when an audacious apprentice supplanted Sirlael, turned her servants against her, and drove her out of the Dark City."

34834f00-f971-4ce3-9f56-e4b037d3345c.Text:
"With me, my Merchant Vagabond, make haste!
The fog of frenzy's end will come ere long!"

ef6a74d3-e76b-45f7-abec-aa749a3d8e2d.Text: There are so many dead people around you. How? It must be Voigtvir! Damn him for what he has done to your crew!

6ed7a414-fd24-48e4-b20f-907f65fa40f1.Text: The dead man grins condescendingly, beckoning you to take a place beside him. He has this life figured out.

9ef6cc94-0b60-4654-9146-c2d610b1371d.Text: "The old serpent got his scaly arse beat!"

61a0e71f-a0c1-4650-b5dd-e7c83c4e91ff.Text: "Shriekers, looks like we have a new boss!"

75ecb031-cd67-489b-bcab-42ef48e577d6.Text: "Let us offer a prayer of gratitude to our Protector."

b88c9329-9267-4c27-9ad9-9d648d12da26.Text: "The Immortal Emperor is our guiding beacon, and so there is no place where He is not."

8d026884-2e77-439d-8ca1-cb20a6fdf004.Text: "Clad yourselves in the armour of contempt and intolerance for all things wicked. Let this armour protect you."

3b2184bf-e2be-4cc6-ba13-ba4a033d89c4.Text: "And so you will protect others with your courage and faith."

ace08032-96a1-4f55-be15-454cac17f9d0.Text: "You and your sermons are the God-Emperor's gift to us, Sister Argenta!"

734a6a5a-7665-4a2f-aee2-c4e0dd9a5346.Text: "Lord Captain! Please get us out of here!"

75f54a83-1a67-45bd-9c21-88763b35fdc8.Text: "That crazed xenos is going to disassemble us and stick the parts into his abominable creations!"

1a1013ba-9930-4697-aaf2-708a6d266b1a.Text: "Any death is better than being carved up by that deranged monster."

5e45406e-61b0-4a27-9272-9ae709c510bb.Text: "To battle, my comrades-in-arms! The Rogue Trader calls for our aid! Our freedom is at hand!"

c97788c6-51ff-41ac-9d4d-5ef261343de2.Text: "Let's sacrifice our lives for the Emperor!"

89a37948-51be-40f1-8173-e7cec9f45a84.Text: "Forward, comrades! To the Rogue Trader's aid... Ah. It appears the Rogue Trader managed on {mf|his|her} own just fine."

a82c717d-1dd9-4d87-b185-9ecf41c6cbee.Text: "Just look! Now that's what it means to be the chosen one of the God-Emperor!"

bebfd54f-e1c8-489a-9bf0-b8cedda9b0b7.Text: "I said we needed to attack sooner!"

907fed81-0aba-4e53-9296-3a36776987ac.Text: "Wait, so the Commissar was a traitor, seeing as the Rogue Trader deposed him?"

6472a450-ac85-4d45-9905-1f980ba53a80.Text: "Kneel, all of you! Hail {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship} von Valancius!"

c7a9d926-f610-4961-9590-8eff7379b27e.Text: "The Haemonculus promised he would let me assist him in his next experiment!"

ca68fcb4-406f-4fc2-b43b-96f4caef61ff.Text: "Careful. I am carrying a sample of puppet plague. It's best if it stays in the flask."

90605299-02c1-4dfb-be6b-2beab22e91e0.Text: "That gatekeeper lets anyone into the Opera now!"

becea47d-a463-4816-ab88-8447407a96f3.Text: "It won't be long before we escape this place... right?"

6269c244-c652-44a1-b23a-dd69f3e5d43c.Text: "I miss my family. I miss them so much."

0016cf36-351c-44f7-b2c4-66e95aff2f4f.Text: "Even if I die here, I will die fighting, unbroken by the xenos."

915bc555-e896-40da-aa49-8d1cf9ac1c06.Text: "I have a feeling the next fight will be my last. Pass me that stimulant."

6b974cd2-30f9-4b62-9531-d2adc944bce0.Text: "Malice deserves credit for giving us something to do other than count the hours until our deaths."

1b44606f-89ba-45ba-bb15-1251edd3ce7a.Text: "Let me into the arena! I will make Commorragh tremble and shout my name!"

a2c0f8fa-a748-4d02-9dcf-39d759993eb2.Text: "We're sure to die sooner or later, but what of it? That's life in the spires."

f577fe31-4813-47a9-a82f-d12c16be3820.Text: "I have cut my eyelids off to keep my eyes vigilant! Danger is everywhere!"

1aa7fe16-4650-4505-9c52-38cac44b3445.Text: "It will hunt again soon. It will come and kill. It always comes."

60138941-68fc-49af-89de-6ee08fa2b21a.Text: "Don't hurt me. I've got nothing for you to take."

f8007867-3476-4e17-a4a0-94f0d9d3bae1.Text: "Whatever the dead have, I take it."

b6e3f5d5-cf29-4d7b-bb93-f498762738ce.Text: "Could you spare just a modicum of grave lotus, strong {mf|master|mistress}? I just need to drift away for a while..."

7d1c8a8a-97eb-43b0-b0ad-48f05a2ab108.Text: "I was a good fighter! Loyal! Strong! But they cast me out! How am I supposed to live now?"

88a9b0ee-7dd8-4d49-a457-353ba154b84a.Text: "They say the Wrack walks the streets again, collecting wretches for the Haemonculus so that he can harvest their organs... but what can you do? That's life in the spires."

43bf79e4-42de-42dc-baa4-15085aabac0e.Text: "But if the Emperor has forsaken us, who will be attending to our prayers now?"

0c2906bb-56bb-4ae1-8ebc-38bacb8c6310.Text: "Traitors everywhere. The Commissar betrayed us. So did the Emperor. Now I know the truth: whoever betrays first is in the right."

db8b4acd-e6c2-42e3-a86a-3f852e6f5f26.Text: "Must cut them all, down to the last one. If the only way out takes us over a mound of corpses, so be it. The Rogue Trader has shown me the path!"

5e512492-ceda-4d3d-9d68-6fccda05909b.Text: "How could he betray us? And he had the nerve to pose as a Commissar, that ratbag!"

3033e268-3a9c-4b2a-bb13-b1087d7bc249.Text: "I'd be better off dead. I'd rather just die than live like this!"

efdbf16f-ce24-42aa-9ad3-7cf51957fb40.Text: "Malice was a pathetic leader. Every one of us here welcomes you!"

c3851b33-61ff-4412-a22d-5fb7a88771f3.Text: "Years ago, they said I would end up in the torture chamber... I am still waiting... So many years have passed... I cannot wait to die!"

4b4dbb0e-f129-4143-887a-0aef8e556f5c.Text: "I did not always understand the sweetness of suffering, but I love it now. I want more!"

b6a173b5-251b-4766-a9da-b384324fa746.Text: "Damn bastards, blasphemous xenos! I hate them!"

e96b1992-9174-46e1-8f05-028a4a8d4376.Text: "If I am lazy, they will... do things to me... again!"

bb32c68a-a77f-45e1-bb16-3ef5608824f3.Text: In death, Abelard looks like a decrepit old man.

6579bb28-6189-4648-aa32-a50ffa6ad09c.Text: "Quatharina... where are you? I have lost you... I have lost you all..."

9319d4a2-790d-4972-945c-f874a7d85df6.Text: "Call for my secretary... Where is my dress tunic? I will not allow such bedlam aboard a ship under my command..."

3043dd6c-b191-4d07-92d6-d052dbe87d30.Text: The thick walls of this container were clearly designed to hold something extremely dangerous.

e4343a26-b154-4d03-9442-a890d98a1238.Text: The container holding Cassia is locked tight.

c48e37ca-e9d0-4f07-ab41-54cd34dad91b.Text: "Leave me be. I wish to return to the darkness."

9dc450ec-f772-4e09-a15f-608e897b1b96.Text: Heinrix's eyes are covered in blood and his face is distorted in a grimace of anguish.

28347860-3a2e-46ee-b71c-79eb076d6689.Text: The torture device is locked and sealed.

628e093c-7d5c-4c74-95d0-9dd71da5ad0c.Text: "Forget about me. Go away. I don't want to hear the voices ever again."

88eec768-828a-4335-b69c-fc662d92c173.Text: Jae's neck is broken: the patience of the Haemonculus's servant must have run out.

a51afa9f-3e36-4d49-b3af-6a5c5b16e30b.Text: "Since you don't feel like helping, keep your business to yourself."

d8ba00ca-c316-46a4-91ac-db22d6ec5a7f.Text: The bars of the cage are sturdy enough to stop a tank... or the fury of a post-human.

125dfce7-9c7e-4ec3-aa57-c95176f782db.Text: "Good thing Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} found us in this accursed place..."

eff7f4e8-aa9c-4606-b49a-3bb017a309f8.Text: "At your service, Lord Captain. Awaiting orders."

5a477e0d-92c6-48fb-bbe0-c056d543573a.Text: "Phew... It looks like we will be keeping all our organs today."

9aaefb4a-6b33-415b-87c6-ab49209cc01a.Text: "That butcher was this close to using our bodies for his horrific experiments."

9147b95b-9bf6-4f73-aa2f-bbf8d36e3c2a.Text: "It is a supreme blessing to be leaving this grisly place."

7049f325-4e5c-420b-b4df-e08744c389d0.Text: "Listen here, you bloody oaf! I need to get in to see your master!"

23093671-1156-442f-9f6b-72366c998cad.Text: "Leave. Or I will break your neck."

d65cb8cd-3e56-4fa1-bf68-61b6b8e17118.Text: "You shit-stained spawn of a sekhek and a bilge rat! Let me in!"

f236bcbe-ea8c-423d-91cf-2ce23fefe33b.Text: "It is a disgrace for a Rogue Trader to be resting in such squalor, of course, but... I have seen worse."

9c065d2b-af65-4ab8-903e-7a5956c3289b.Text: "In a place like this, it's always handy to have a hole you can crawl into and patch yourself up."

529938ee-a76b-4fb2-9e75-7053ef5cd94d.Text: "Threat level: tolerable. Engaging passive observation mode and initiating system diagnostics."

eaf96e16-ce5a-4ae6-8b21-16d1d84b5907.Text: "The smell of blood is not as strong here as out on the streets. It must be safer."

64209416-7a72-42cb-8e28-ff15aa358af4.Text: The otherworldly shimmer of nothingness promises peace and quiet.

cae56502-5ea4-4e56-93f4-c1b7fb674c2d.Text: The low vibration that permeates this space is the death throes of atoms becoming nothing.

ee79985d-7a95-4da8-b659-0a878525428a.Text: As indicated by the bloody trail, a body was recently dragged through here.

b37e027a-2e12-4ae4-9b13-1ec2f58dbdf4.Text: Whoever tried to settle in this vile place, their fortitude did not carry them far.

44cc1e8e-9d2e-4e63-be80-a4f1454cca41.Text: The crate is filled with makeshift lasgun batteries and crudely made autogun ammo.

be7f4f5d-7208-4618-a7b8-f9bd5b1a374f.Text: As you look at the device, you feel a slight prickle inside your mind. You are now aware of something beneath perception: a nigh-invisible crack in the seemingly solid frame of the device.

f5cdbc81-560f-47d6-a5fe-cd0c4f1b08a3.Text: This must be the chute that carried your unconscious body down here.

bfd2c39e-f476-44af-b823-bda15ce97b01.Text: You vividly remember lying on this table and watching mechanical pincers tear through your flesh.

bb0288d1-1182-4a85-8245-eedb10294d42.Text: This chute sends spent materials to the corpse dump. Materials such as you.

17fe5ef1-d2d2-4416-ad04-7b22af11d741.Text: This profane device is designed to set the elevator into motion only when wretched victims die inside the device.

ef9fcf1f-aebb-42a9-bc97-fe8e3731aec2.Text: The corpses smile at you with warmth and whisper quietly, "It is over for you. Join us."

4dc9ca90-7777-4976-9bd1-8c05624ad5f9.Text: The wide maw of the chute stretches into a mellow grin, as if promising to disgorge a few more bodies to keep you company.

609c5e76-dca5-4ab7-94f1-f50e3c608313.Text: These corpses fell down here from above. You hear them whispering about the beauty of their long descent and the cruelty of the impact that broke their cold bodies.

de781b3d-4c46-4aa1-814d-a52d67a334eb.Text: Blasted Voigtvir! He killed your people, tore down your banner, and replaced it with his heretical rag!

64bdea35-d060-401e-a481-bee4156a612e.Text: This fresh corpse has your face. Its killers are standing nearby and you had better steer clear of them, seeing as they have already succeeded in killing you once!

76ed8ace-4647-46a8-913c-fe8aca0010b7.Text: The barking of weapon discharges becomes Theodora's disapproving grumble: "Do you consider that to be the face of a Rogue Trader?"

ae04e5e4-90d5-4107-adf4-147f62de3ce5.Text: Your brave enforcers spend their every waking moment training. After all, Voigtvir could return at any moment and try to take over your ship again!

5fa0d85c-4a0f-4e89-b873-e05605524ac5.Text: The strange object is pulsing with hidden energy that could burst forth at any moment.

31f068c1-f2c9-4a3f-80e8-377ce40ec223.Text: The thick curtain shoves you away. It is surprisingly strong for a lifeless piece of fabric.

15d5826d-9448-4469-afba-ad48782cab43.Text: The corpse hanging from the structure turns its flayed face to you with a crack and snickers.

57f7c154-aa5f-4a9e-9abc-72afe2ef57ae.Text: The rebellious steps are trying to buck you off to make you lose your footing and break your neck.

84c31fb7-888b-45e2-a9d3-db5462f59462.Text: Through the bars of the grate you are walking on, you see a bottomless abyss. It beckons you to jump in and promises an embrace softer than any feather bed in the world.

a6c6d242-57c3-40f7-bd26-bc621474fb7e.Text: The lamps emit rays that hound your pupils, burning and biting them like angry snakes made of light.

35a97328-a593-4527-b2d2-3eaa80c0a0b6.Text: "I'm still going to try to sneak past. Maybe they won't take any notice!"

744f0703-94e9-483d-a65f-6a21abd80bf1.Text: "You fool, do you have a death wish? That's why they came here, to gut people like us!"

d224ed6a-63c8-463f-bd10-90c939cc35fa.Text: "I told you not to let them see you. They're hunters, damn butchers."

ae08d197-42c4-4a23-8818-6843915c584e.Text: "You've got to creep along, stick to the shadows, go around... In the Chasm, you can get in anywhere."

1a16560b-30c7-410b-a83a-3b1f63ff4eae.Text: The ease with which the flyer took to the air suggests that they made use of profane xenotech.

690ea378-c27d-4d38-851e-87224ab3987c.Text: The ease with which the flyer took to the air suggests that their body must be extremely light. Even small projectiles must pose a grave danger to them mid-air.

35f89c1a-7cd5-4016-b493-a4533929287e.Text: The wounds on the corpse were inflicted haphazardly, as if the killer was driven by pure brutality.

c894ba03-6c50-45a7-8641-9ddbdc6b1e97.Text: The victim was killed by a series of precise cuts in vulnerable spots: the throat, the eyes, and the tendons. The killer must have been aiming to swing the outcome of the fight with the first few blows.

bf3a9875-775f-46b3-bf0c-a837f57a5a14.Text: An empty vial is lying on the ground. It used to contain a stimulant that is unfamiliar to you.

b70505a9-14e8-4bad-9ddf-76d7736f43df.Text: An empty vial is lying on the ground. It contained repetropine, a stimulant that heightens one's perception of moving objects but hinders their ability to see stationary obstacles.

22dcf46e-2fac-4188-9528-7f912a786b33.Text: A familiar sense of unreality rolls in, breaking the connection between body and mind.

827809e5-8bfe-4231-95b4-8f2880112c3d.Text: A flash of searing pain causes the contents of your skull to burst into flames.

b167d7f4-757d-4873-b9d0-627bcd59028f.Text: Your wounds barely hurt at all, and your body feels surprisingly light.

c138219a-9811-4a65-91e3-d809cc42c8df.Text: If you surrender to the cough and lie down, it will be easier to breathe and your lungs will stop burning.

bc554f31-7273-4210-9f24-e487097395e2.Text: A flesh sample from the resilient and unbreakable Abelard Werserian.

05bbeb16-62a6-4815-b3e7-a5cda2179c04.Text: The Bloodstained Proselyte's neuroaugmetic that turned pain into pleasure and enhanced the owner's reflexes.

8a21ae76-b057-4dfe-81b4-f4cffab9f8c0.Text: The Sslyth's tough, scaly hide that is hard to pierce with any weapon.

a6be5632-ba8b-4458-89df-273835d9d60b.Text: The fervid heart of the Sister of Battle, filled with the unshakeable belief in the Emperor.

15011a48-22f4-46c5-8c16-1b9d02e839d1.Text: Intimidating monomolecular-edged claws capable of tearing through solid plasteel.

f86d514f-cb03-4473-b5bc-28f95aefdf3f.Text: A mysterious organ that grants a Navigator the ability to gaze directly into the warp.

ff544a04-3b1a-4dc4-ba23-dc042daf9c0d.Text: The Chtonos's xenomechanism that devoured its victims' suffering and converted it into energy.

1ece4e4f-1382-42bd-824a-5b1a331d34c0.Text: The head of the cunning Commissar contained many insidious plans.

3fd6f58d-6b33-432a-ac5f-ce797f56d8a1.Text: Dead flesh corrupted by the warp. It constantly shifts and mutates.

e65aee00-e5db-4c51-b6e4-3780e677d1e1.Text: The Drukhari warrior's skin was stitched with flexible crystal threads, whose colours shift to match their surroundings and conceal the wearer.

c2b81763-9a22-4488-8fdf-5f5868b98575.Text: This cranial shunt marked as the property of the Astra Militarum is used to directly connect to armoured vehicles. Its silvered rim is an indication of the owner's veteran status.

8f5f4154-954e-49ff-8a08-f01c567334c8.Text: The psyker's cortex may contain the secrets to his uncanny abilities.

a3dc25c9-3370-4d6d-80db-84b004c47a6d.Text: The cerebrum of an unsanctioned psyker.

ec417b21-592c-4499-af98-4621d1540019.Text: This pair of sharp eyes used to gaze upon Jae Heydari's ill-gained riches with greed and curiosity.

abcad328-e613-4d97-b758-d1e2e55e1bb3.Text: Clotted strands of nerve fibres stretch from Kibellah's bloody vertebra. Perhaps they hold the secret to the cultists' immunity to pain.

053389e8-f400-476b-97f0-b7c53ffddcd3.Text: A spinal cord enhanced by the Haemonculus that can transmit neural impulses at phenomenal speeds.

043404a9-23e5-492d-8a45-64c8d0ac00d1.Text: Tendons enhanced with synthetic thread, ten times more resilient than regular tissue and capable of withstanding tremendous strain during flight.

1648154d-9293-4947-b86d-c20142a931da.Text: A blessed respiratory system created by the enlightened servants of the Omnissiah.

d594eada-1b90-4b07-8b5a-f7dbe6322cdc.Text: Adrenal glands enhanced by the Haemonculus, capable of dispersing pure hyperadrenalin through the owner's blood.

8fb8a6fe-a0ad-42ab-b9a4-6248851e2d6a.Text: A gland capable of injecting the body with macrosteroids, causing rapid bone and muscle growth.

1d70db62-0f5c-4f1f-9695-0ea730bfbf55.Text: A relic concealing the soul of the Aeldari ranger Yrliet from the gaze of She Who Thirsts.

660149c2-a143-4d43-8cb1-15ffc2d7965b.Text: "Do not address me without permission, plaything."

7931d337-f930-4b32-b3da-538a31a874e9.Text: "Are you the one who slaughtered Keykeross? My oh my, aren't you a rare delicacy!"

f0ea82d0-1520-4d19-b705-4b1abdc585d6.Text: "Wait your turn. We will savour your pain once we are done with our previous guest."

414b6be0-7b78-4e8e-a8ef-f26586bbbd59.Text: "The timing is just perfect. Our guest's lustre has all but dimmed."

f8f9645f-eb47-443e-92bd-65ea09e36b4d.Text: "When that dubious-looking xenos told us he would take us to Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I must say I was sceptical..."

2420c657-5b15-41e5-9df1-532d35829eae.Text: "The outer reaches of the Spire of the Reaving Tempest... This is a dangerous place indeed."

1def786d-a1d6-4f55-85b0-04f341186446.Text: "{name}! Thank the Emperor, the xenos trickster did not lie about bringing us to you!"

8112c54b-a2eb-4ad0-946f-7fbf619a6983.Text: "That peculiar xenos poet has such a mystifying way with words... At least we deciphered the part about him taking us to you and that was the part that mattered."

69382b3c-6e55-4174-96f5-88b324fffaf9.Text: "This is the first and last time I blindly enter a portal opened by a xenos."

febc758e-ad15-4ff8-927a-c3643e2a2d1b.Text: "The whispers told me to follow the Harlequin, and now they're all snickering like they just played a hilarious joke on me."

1b735590-3ebd-48c1-920e-c88a63e80990.Text: "Where is that stinking jester of a xenos? He said there would be a fight waiting for me here!"

18912831-daa3-42bb-97f9-aa71fd032f6d.Text: "Did you strike a deal with that xenofool? Is he helping us escape now?"

505b11d3-85a9-417c-bfea-807dceda1b27.Text: "What plans does the Arebennian have for you? Why is he helping you and us?"

8d373463-d5d9-4f62-b136-7c2dc368c045.Text: "Unit Nocturne of Oblivion. Status changed from 'probable enemy' to 'temporary ally.'"

189422e7-a01b-4d88-9e25-ef87e9dbfbd0.Text: "We really are in dire straits if we're forced to rush headlong wherever the jester xenos points!"

9061047f-479b-448e-94d0-becb8ef29aab.Text: "The Arebennian told us to follow him to you."

3198ba59-9c59-4c9b-8014-cea025080040.Text: "You lying piece of fekke! You dare mock the sons of Fenris? You want our blood? Then come and get it!"

7b6c6bd3-775a-4198-ba8a-73ca709873a8.Text: "Pack! Lay down suppressive fire and stall the heretic! Fenrys hjolda!"

182579f2-e35a-4b3f-aeb2-6022a9acc848.Text: "Insufferable profaners. I grant you the Word of the True Gods that will rid your hearts of loyalty to the corpse emperor!"

03f0b70e-e1d6-41b1-b4fe-7d86f69b5c80.Text: "You will finally learn your lesson. The false Emperor does not protect, he only lies. The True Gods are your protection."

9d4d4337-ebcc-4ea0-8616-666939be022b.Text: "Come closer... and say it again... you gutless grizhof... Fenrys hjolda!"

3585b2e3-34c0-455c-b53f-e028f9a23332.Text: "I swear, if I survive this I'll go teetotal! But not before raising a glass to our new and better life, of course..."

7f2f8e0f-011b-4154-ba7e-9ac6f325d6e7.Text: "The enforcers... They broke in and killed all our guys... Didn't even collect the corpses... How'd they find out?"

179c2839-4744-4ab9-a405-37c665e618b2.Text: "They were already marching us to our trial when Lord Tocara's guys fell upon them and rescued us! The Emperor protect him!"

f009a5cd-1536-4763-809f-e310916dfd48.Text: "Members of the heretic Vladaym Tocara's gang! Lay down your arms and face righteous justice!"

6ae4c7ba-39e8-4414-9aa1-93a9e4e750d7.Text: "Stay where you are! Lay down your weapons!"

838fac59-0c0a-4002-b044-02212d9315fa.Text: "We are here for the criminal Vladaym Tocara and his accomplices!"

a9db6d0b-af86-4505-825c-1b213cf7914f.Text: "Heretics. Traitors. Emperor-shunning scum. The hour of the reckoning has come, for I am His retribution!"

f4897c8f-c241-4bb3-952c-5320799ba5d9.Text: "My mortal flesh... is weak, but my faith is unbreakable. I am His punishing hand! His... retribution!"

ef3ef9db-7af1-4486-b7dd-92ec93769ebe.Text: "I just wanted to — hiccup! — see Footfall's architectural landmarks... I'm a — hiccup! — scholar... Not a saboteur!"

375bc2a1-8c95-4aa5-83ba-85fb7b603098.Text: "If you please, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship, you might like to look behind that partition over there. The person sitting there may have something interesting to say."

75a66495-4ffd-4221-80e2-92dd169f6ccd.Text: "Y-Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! C-could you spare me a second of your valuable time? I most humbly beg you."

c79345d0-d8bd-49cb-9ea7-26878d91533d.Text: "Hey, look! That's the noble who freed us from our cages! Your — er — nobleship, thank you for your nobleshipness."

89486e27-1bd7-4034-826f-1509337c933c.Text: You recognise the "Aeldari" you once freed from a local charlatan's "collection." The mutant smiles gratefully with his five rows of teeth.

84bc0b3c-2ce6-4952-b3ae-dbd928832e78.Text: "When we were in cages, we got fed. And we got zapped, but nothing else besides that. Now we aren't getting any food and on top of the zapping, there's hitting and kicking and stabbing too. I want to go back to my cage."

0617aef2-d0c2-46c1-aaee-7b2656270870.Text: The Drukhari hisses an elaborate curse.

c58b9852-fa06-4f21-8842-088ab9a58f0b.Text: "We were hired to kill a mon-keigh. Is it you? Or have you come to tell us who it is?"

e65e5d1a-e30e-4ce1-aa0e-77b8443ee377.Text: "This pitiful place is so full of pain... I like it."

71a8c4ee-c51a-466c-bac2-e035afe42ca6.Text: The unfortunate man covered in pirate tattoos stares at you stupidly, moving his drooling lips.

ad3dd58e-c585-4240-bbd9-b847a77ffb72.Text: The unfortunate man covered in pirate tattoos stares at you stupidly and says in a barely audible whisper, "Kill me."

ffcc1656-f293-41f8-a23d-5a0e604f25df.Text: "The eminent Lord Captain awaits you in the square, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship."

34b0531b-99eb-408f-a654-29d7303a44ab.Text: The symbol of Incendia's power is vacant. Its sacred mechanical innards have been twisted and mangled by the vengeful mob.

76e09586-0d82-4314-97da-5b9b627ed029.Text: The sign hanging off the exhibition manager's body reads: "HERESY, FORNICATION WITH A MUTANT, XENOPHILIA."

b5ccd505-c0fe-428b-b226-4248158b36a9.Text: Judging by their injuries, the aristocrats were subjected to a long, enthusiastic beating before their execution.

f17aaa5e-3a31-4d7c-8f88-9c7d0f0f9041.Text: "I praise the God-Emperor and His anointed one, the most holy {name} von Valancius, for granting me the supreme blessing. The blessing of service."

e1d434f2-9d5e-4ef7-b4d5-73bbc9334d23.Text: "There is no worthier lot in life than to accept the gift of deliverance from worldly worries and labour tirelessly to render one's duty to the Imperium. I am of use, and therefore I am blessed."

597ae666-8af1-4528-ae7d-90dedb2af713.Text: "{name} von Valancius spoke {mf|his|her} commandments, and those commandments were: to shun the heresy of idleness, to serve, and to praise the Emperor. I have been reborn in order that I may carry forth those commandments in my deeds. Eagerly and incessantly."

c272a4c8-8573-4981-b5ac-2d61647e69cb.Text: "Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship, we have orders to accompany you to the Atrium for an audience with the Lord Captain."

80758123-6a03-4b48-b43a-554168054741.Text: Contorted human remains are smouldering on top of a pile of books on architecture. The sign reads: "Gordei Skatov — spy for the xenos. Took notes on the station's structures for the purposes of sabotage."

c3242489-bd44-47de-817c-61ae02147a59.Text: Incendia's body has been savaged. There is a hole in her skull and spoons stuck in her exposed brain. Pieces of paper with verdicts have been nailed all over her body.

7f7a9923-8d2d-49a4-95e5-23855917ff45.Text: "By the order of the Lord Inquisitor of the Holy Ordo Xenos, the Liege's palace is presently closed to outsiders."

7e090278-830e-48a4-a266-98dcc024f642.Text: The Inquisition soldier is holding a weapon of a strange make you have not seen before.

0e2adbe4-9337-430f-b602-14237c8de43b.Text: The stern Inquisition fighter remains silent as he pierces you with his icy gaze.

1f26f99d-4f24-4c0f-9483-29e06493cda2.Text: "The Lord Inquisitor will see you now."

9658157e-821c-47cf-9c5d-50a65430accd.Text: "The belly will be ripped open by those who hear... By those who will douse the hungering fire.

ecb9330d-7bd2-4016-bf02-9a74813b11d1.Text: "The teeth have snapped shut... There will be no mercy! There will be no mercy..."

3e5b6591-868b-479b-972f-e97f435abb3b.Text: Vladaym's body bears a sign that reads: "COLD TRADE, PLOTTING AGAINST THE IMPERIUM."

c0915603-db50-4376-bdae-9d48b3e33c4f.Text: The xenos is not showing any signs of aggression, simply staring ahead. There is an odd, disoriented quality to its movements.

66cc2e7a-67fb-4d09-baaf-61c0ea0c480c.Text: The xenos is making the same rhythmic sound over and over, as if trying to say something, but losing its train of thought and starting anew every time.

444de08e-48e8-4224-973b-9b3c15ba8a86.Text: The tomb guardians gaze upon you with black, lifeless eye hollows where emerald fire recently raged.

d954e042-b2e4-4c90-b84c-c6705dac5c1b.Text: These xenos are clearly dead, but for some reason, their bodies have not vanished. Perhaps something has impaired the mechanisms that transport their remains upon death.

625aabf0-8705-49a1-8ebb-47bbbaf1565c.Text: The xenos stands perfectly still apart from the occasional disconcerting twitch.

9c2ecc77-8c40-4395-ab1d-d7dd7b8b4c92.Text: This xenos is still conscious but unable to move. Though it may appear intact on the outside, the faint traces of the tech-blight on its body indicate that its insides have already been partially devoured by the entropic corrosion.

f4858299-d715-4220-8891-6f21206451be.Text: "The barrier is barely holding! Prepare for defence!"

50b22091-6656-4693-a95d-237c7bb42c7c.Text: "In the name of the Golden Throne, hold the line!"

aa9dbde5-32bf-4d75-8c29-dfe4b6138693.Text: "The signs of the collapse are emerging, seeping through reality."

6c1f3673-6d54-4bf1-9859-38c092634d3c.Text: "The collapse is emerging, but Yekhmet fights. Yekhmet is incensed."

c5ee8122-3a27-49b2-8423-18fe792ecea9.Text: The box is filled up with cast metal insignia like the ones worn by Theodora's bodyguards. Some of them have splatters of dried blood on them.

b889fe3a-050a-4eda-a2e8-68fae765da2c.Text: The elevator system leading to the deeper sections of the crypt was installed a long time ago, it seems. Every bolt is stamped with your dynastic coat of arms.

265e2b36-98b0-495a-a799-bea5e48a9e9e.Text: Some of these ancient, sacred, and priceless machines are labelled with the von Valancius property mark, while others bear the stark emblems of the Inquisition.

66e8da81-abe9-44b1-8d37-72e898ed3e82.Text: The tech-blight voraciously gnaws away at the human metal, but not as eagerly as at the walls of the crypt.

9c2ebd3b-b54c-4b33-b7e0-e6ebfc3cf3e0.Text: The incomprehensible constructions of the xenos are connected to the Tech-Priests' machinery in a bizarre and arcane way that is repulsive to the human mind.

df94cea1-13a3-4ed5-9ea4-ed58184c6633.Text: This device seems to be connected to the energy system of the crypt and is powering the equipment in the camp, in violation of all operational canons.

a08bde2c-5ad8-430a-9df4-db54a8a97d6f.Text: The surface of the stele is roiling with revolting bubbles, as if it is trying to disgorge itself into some new form.

9b8be87b-0a38-4e86-a7e0-5bff2f02104e.Text: Every few moments, the metal particles lose their colour and become translucent — and you can see something dark and formless behind the metal, yearning to be born, but unable to do so... yet.

28f5cb31-0906-4463-b212-5de3b76be9f2.Text: A broken metallic finger sticks out from between the sarcophagus doors that are slightly ajar. It wriggles weakly.

64389f03-b01c-4d36-a05c-d146ea96e6b1.Text: Out of the corner of your eye, inside the glowing green orb mounted on the contraption, you can see the reflections of people who are not here. They are looking at you curiously and fearfully.

afce3499-4a5c-4198-90fa-6985dd0573f0.Text: An odd haze obscures your vision, and for a moment, you see the metallic corpses at your feet turn into the bodies of soldiers clad in the colours of your dynasty.

a43a0b15-7957-419e-a06b-1c4cf6581260.Text: The surviving soldiers bear grave wounds inflicted by gauss weapons. Even the most skilled chirurgeon would likely be powerless to heal them.

9770e93f-880a-4ae0-83d7-c67e7366ac10.Text: A bulky device whose machine spirit is continuously weaving a protective force field. This must be what is holding the xenos at bay, but looking at its unsteady flickering, one cannot help but wonder how long this barrier will last.

47d85f5c-e42a-4054-a700-2d84b6834969.Text: The few warriors who have risen walk without noticing how their ranks have thinned. This procession is a far cry from the march of annihilation it was meant to be.

4abb5bad-83f8-4273-9b5a-2fc29bf93603.Text: These obelisks are different from the ones you have seen before, though what exactly they signify, one can only guess.

8a92ddbb-d741-4d20-aca1-b4222863777b.Text: Judging by the imposing design of these obelisks, this passage leads to a tomb intended for xenos of a higher status.

88eb538b-dd3d-4e6c-8952-248815bc8928.Text: "The beast's cage has fallen, but the Yoke has started the binding process! Most of the entity's power will be restrained by the machine!"

09c9dbac-3a74-454d-9ba1-3e26fe63e966.Text: "Whatever is left is still potent enough to kill us all. Weaken its physical shell and distract it, and I will control the Yoke and try to chain the monster!"

f4d515af-b54c-4909-9c6d-0054850eb256.Text: "Deactivate the shield. The Lord Inquisitor is expecting the Rogue Trader below."

215a9eef-07d9-401f-8889-6b04c5809d0d.Text: "Do not deactivate the shield! Take aim at the Rogue Trader! Prepare to fire!"

a6923f47-a578-455a-ad53-443857560571.Text: "Give the order, Lord Captain, I will follow you into the fray."

3dcf8cff-e203-4899-842c-8b6047824fd7.Text: "Onward, Rogue Trader, the God-Emperor guards our path — so let us honour His grace with the deaths of enemies of Humanity!"

0dafcbf2-4081-4eec-a82e-acc7741c500c.Text: "The crew is agitated, Lord Captain: the colours on the bridge are deepening, but I am sure when the time comes, they will be ready."

b8ae6ce0-ca89-4e8e-96b0-2e85561b43bb.Text: "We have already been detected from the surface, I'm sure. Let's not keep the Lord Inquisitor waiting."

b94b4e22-6260-4c56-afcc-f0a5ef451173.Text: "Lord Captain, you can't escape fate. Only you can finish this story."

6802e5e1-7bf0-4c01-9d1a-b71c5649f61c.Text: "Shereen! Let's just try not to die down there, all right?"

b016316c-92ca-43ab-b217-3943b7decd2d.Text: "Why do we delay? My blades demand the torment of others."

8876e82d-461e-4fb3-a1bd-0ec07eace973.Text: "Performing another inspection prayer for the health of the equipment."

61f6b672-3bc8-4ebb-9dfb-a41dc14940b2.Text: "I smell blood in the air. It is a sign from the Allfather that a glorious battle awaits us."

a5ef412d-7df6-4664-a351-cb4da041431f.Text: "The time has come, elantach, I will be with you — a shadow crushing our enemies."

98f29b67-fff8-43cf-8766-24890ca4ae73.Text: An uneven ripple runs across the stele's surface. The symbols covering it tremble and blend into each other. None stay in your memory for longer than a second.

c7a16f38-c6e7-481d-b600-7b0ee704336a.Text: Tall pillars stretch upward from the abyss of pale mist, seemingly rising from the void itself. Looking at the greenish haze makes your body feel sluggish with weariness.

39389492-f723-4951-8717-93b51bf73fd2.Text: The monstrous structure looms majestically over you. The energy spilt into the air obstructs your mind. For a moment, it seems that not only are you studying the obelisk, but it is also studying you.

8f99a9df-dbf2-4003-8d4d-6a1a36c0f259.Text: When you touch the smooth surface of the wall, it burns you with a cold pulsating tingling.

7a71136f-b22b-4cec-855a-d4ea740c7d05.Text: When you touch the smooth surface of the wall, it burns you with cold as if in warning — danger lurks beyond.

2253e27d-f9d0-4782-9405-73a254322158.Text: "Were you the one who falsified the ship's log?"

6782e8a6-2945-4cbd-9353-bc490409e375.Text: "What about the research notes on the 'tech-blight' that we obtained from the cache on Kiava Gamma?"

a1efacc6-2cb4-4c84-a18a-2f43a80c2e3e.Text: "All I ask is that you promise not to do it again."

1f11d648-7024-48ea-9415-74010b8df193.Text: "You were in a servitor's body at my Magnae Accessio, Nomos, so how is it that you are once again in a cogitator?"

7ece155b-3481-4968-a7d7-b6dd15d71f43.Text: "I see you have found your great spirit, Asclepius."

8e32edf3-2767-46fb-871a-9c1840282206.Text: "Incident N872-04 was a ship-wide system failure of some kind. It and 'Epitaph' had something to do with the ship flying better."

c59658e6-0cc3-4126-ac3e-3566d76977b0.Text: "Do you know where this Epitaph is?"

fb81470f-234c-4d3d-9008-a08ed1928d5a.Text: "The people who accompanied Theodora on her travels are strangely unaware of the Incident and Epitaph."

387477b5-8074-48b2-9f25-f8c5bc01fafb.Text: "The ship was on Epitaph, Amarnat travelled aboard it, investigating the tech-blight, and Nomos was born as a result of an incident. So how was it possible that no one in the crew knew the whole truth?"

b720b671-0b1f-46b4-811c-ac2e0a6236b4.Text: "So you really are the spirit of the ship?"

733b2caf-93ec-4512-a823-663faaf41b37.Text: "Enough about the past — let us talk about the future. You do, in fact, have a purpose, Nomos..."

ac2de184-818f-494f-85c3-3c4d06c3bc23.Text: "You read the data-bank recovered from Theodora's cache. And then you said, 'The Incident marked the beginning of Nomos.' What did you mean by that?"

da65dcdd-ae79-4a85-b97f-f45204475d20.Text: Told Nomos that their purpose was to serve the Imperium.

c3a22cdf-0977-43ad-b364-ccb3127aa443.Text: "To serve the light and truth and greatness that is the Imperium."

1f0721f3-46b8-40d2-b3a8-86f6e69b94f3.Text: Told Nomos that their only purpose was to live.

17f58fc6-d926-4487-87e1-45c984b17aba.Text: "To simply live, comprehending yourself and the world. Life does not need a purpose to justify itself."

92453e82-9ceb-46ee-9322-45a54b68444a.Text: Told Nomos that their purpose was to be the Rogue Trader's servant.

ea5fa066-e16c-4fa5-a14e-741523fffb71.Text: "To be my servant, my blade, a force to be reckoned with by all."

f85d4d71-45c7-4dce-b91b-ccdbc9ba9f45.Text: "If ever you need anything, come straight to me. I will hear you out."

add6a543-14f9-45f1-a1bd-cb1c9130e417.Text: "I am not your servant to be sent on errands. I will not tolerate such behaviour from you again."

493ab9c0-d8df-4b43-aded-0b85e0be103a.Text: {n}The servitor built into the huge cogitator turns its head toward you. The vox emits a rasping voice:{/n} "Hello! Nomos welcome your visit."

ff51847e-1c60-4519-9133-4766e8437c07.Text: {n}The massive figure of the malatek Asclepius is frozen before the cogitator in a praying pose. Without raising his head, he addresses you:{/n} "I salute the ruler of this ship."

e4e6be1a-f1b6-4ae5-93f9-d6eb729cd2c0.Text: {n}The unblinking gaze of the servitor gargoyle is fixed on you.{/n} "Nomos are here. What do you want to talk about?"

d4ee997d-530f-4335-a688-e093f9fb98d8.Text: "This name is also known to us. It is related to Nomos, although we do not understand how."

dcb8a890-330b-455d-a3b4-952159627ece.Text: {n}For a moment there is silence, broken only by the moans of the huge machine, and then the cybergargoyle begins to speak, and with it, the other servitors chosen by Nomos:{/n} "We have analysed the data with which you sated us, and we have recreated the sequence of events."

2acad941-48b9-4ba8-a94b-661fda2b3961.Text: "First, there was Epitaph. It is a world, but it is merely a case, a container, for something we cannot name and cannot understand. Theodora and this ship have been to that place. Something was lifted up from the world. A gift. A trusted priest in crimson — one who identified himself as 'Amarnat' — comprehended the gift raised from Epitaph. And from it, he created what the data-banks list as a 'tech-blight.'"

7aff5781-9158-4f9c-bf76-cbf1bca88e71.Text: "But that is not how Nomos came into being. We were not... invented. We were not freed. We came into being... by accident." {n}The chorus of servitors sounds genuinely confused, almost desperate.{/n} "Theodora's ambition, the myriad mechanisms of the huge ship. Amarnat's mind, the inquisitive attempts to comprehend and extract. The dormant blight. The dormant Epitaph. What lies hidden in its depths. And between it all, we slipped in, connected, and emerged like an electrical discharge between the poles."

249773b2-aafc-451d-a8c3-c4fa35702824.Text: "Accident... Incident. That is what we are. We have no purpose. No history. Nomos just are."

61955663-ba1a-4744-bcbe-4890dc613976.Text: "Nomos are not in a cogitator. Or in a servitor. We cannot say where we are — but our existence is tied to the existence of the ship for now. The servitor and the cogitator are only... external interfaces. Shells. Like humans and their bodies."

8ce20f6d-1029-46a0-9969-353579f6f77c.Text: "I have found a miracle. And the end of my worldly road. I have never seen and never will see anything more meaningful than the spirit of Nomos. In the face of its multitude, we are all nothing but the fixed values of an erroneous function."

e9be7bd5-c0f2-43e9-a1e4-73cfa1cf29fa.Text: {n}The cybergargoyle's gaze tracks you as you walk away from the cogitator.{/n}

3981c9e7-13a6-4ba7-922b-fd4a0bad435a.Text: "That data is gone. Deleted. Erased. Deliberately — but we cannot trace who did it or why."

36a790b2-9844-4153-b89f-0640ba2a86cb.Text: "A gift, but a terrible one. You would call it a weapon. Theodora coveted it. She needed it desperately... but we do not know why."

0f0bcb77-c963-4334-8470-5364b063a985.Text: "The truth was hidden. Deliberately. Your officers' memories were stolen. All the cogitators' memory banks were wiped. It took you feeding us the truth bit by bit for us to piece it together — and understand."

41112b18-7ba5-49a2-9d0e-0ef6b6954f7d.Text: "No, they are shells." {n}The rasping voice sounds adamant.{/n} "A human's existence is more than the existence of its shell — this is obvious to us. There is always something more. Something that simmers and shines, for which the dark light and wicked hunger are always reaching."

6e448580-5c59-48c9-a1ff-eb11ac3193c9.Text: {n}Nomos is silent for a long time, as though mulling over your words.{/n} "We do not know what we are. But the ship is not us. The ship is our cradle. We may rise from it, one day. We... would like that."

59cea4e2-72cb-4e6e-98f3-3020f49064ac.Text: "It was not us he feared. He did not know us, but only suspected. His mental processes were occupied by the tech-blight. That was what he feared. He wanted protection from it."

7332eaee-45d2-46df-ac12-b8b070a542b7.Text: "Who has the resources, the knowledge, and the power to accomplish such a feat? It would have been beyond the capabilities of the blessed Amarnat himself. And he would never destroy knowledge."

341ff341-9415-41cc-b220-a319aa82d3a2.Text: "Yes. Nomos remember. You brought us data-sustenance, and it contained a name — Epitaph. We recognised it. No, not like that. In that name we recognised the place where Nomos originate."

b231446e-a918-4adb-bd06-beb55bebb166.Text: "The Incident marked the beginning of us. The ship became better because of us too. These are all links in the same chain, but we cannot piece them together yet..."

983903a7-7959-4338-89b7-aaf985f3beae.Text: "Human shells are subject to external influences. Perhaps someone purged their memory archives? Or perhaps they simply do not want to access them? It is a shame that no new information was obtained. But Nomos are grateful that you tried."

84ca0fc9-2732-410b-aa0d-3ba414b00350.Text: "To serve the light. To serve the Imperium..."

2352e86c-0346-4194-b66c-d282e5a5e433.Text: "Blessed be this spirit. A great path and a great future lie before it. And we must assist it on its way."

7022550e-13b7-468d-bd45-ee9e9851da20.Text: {n}The chorus of servitors dutifully repeats your words, but seemingly without understanding them. Nomos is preoccupied — the huge cogitator continues to sing its creaking song, running unknown calculations.{/n}

ff6a8f87-c193-4e6d-aebd-96cb12ee693f.Text: "He desired knowledge. Theodora allowed him to explore the gifts of Epitaph, slaking his thirst. But we know it did not bring him happiness. In the footprints of his slaked thirst, fear followed."

c004a14b-9fac-4f1c-bd5c-c6264eece287.Text: "The blessed Amarnat was involved in the birth of the spirit named Nomos. I do not believe for a moment that he could have been frightened by this miracle."

9c77b6f3-03da-40d4-b9a0-271ab912ae37.Text: "This story... disturbs me. It sounds like an echo of the sacrilege whose name is the preservation of ignorance. The spirit of Nomos must be protected from the encroachments of that power that tried to conceal the truth of its birth."

fe930f12-ee39-4bf2-8f21-522aba2ba93b.Text: "Then, tell us. What is our purpose?"

0353c6d6-a4dd-489b-9d4f-bfbfbba1cef6.Text: {n}Nomos suddenly falls silent. Symbols race chaotically across the screens of the huge cogitator, and you hear an almost human groan come from the depths of the machine.{/n} "Nomos... understand... realise... comprehend... themselves."

5368d79a-ca05-4464-a4d1-2b4d4122a6ce.Text: "We have been studying and observing. And helping the ship when we can. So many mechanisms... they would have suffered without our input."

ccde8582-245b-4f63-91f3-0ea0c064b299.Text: "We explored our capabilities, sent a request, and the task was fulfilled. The Nomos are grateful to you for this."

37ba3137-a893-46fe-89e6-8c477b78b183.Text: "We appreciate your answer. Your regard for the Nomos pleases us."

86e11a1d-6049-4da2-a48c-c6e9634ef27a.Text: "Are you dissatisfied? The Nomos seek no discord, and vow their requests will be more transparent from now on."

3ef1a11b-3760-442a-8165-1bd4f9739a20.Text: "Pasqal has informed me that the system has encrypted data stored inside. I wish to know its contents."

a96a885f-c0a3-4c08-ac4f-a59d1f53ad86.Text: "I am interested in the cache on Kiava Gamma."

d2b4d6d5-9b95-4c1f-a9d3-778d2a85edeb.Text: "Restore the data on the cache located on Dargonus."

b1d7a2f6-54e7-4659-9845-1e3c3d2661f4.Text: "Have the Tech-Priests of the Adeptus Mechanicus been able to discern how the ship was able to start her warp engine?"

bf68ccbe-df21-437f-b61b-64f3eeeb049b.Text: [Hand the Dargonus data-bank to the Tech-Priest] "Access the data from Dargonus."

2d59b90c-5d1e-4a20-836d-cb6f4aab7450.Text: [Hand the Kiava Gamma data-bank to the Tech-Priest] "Access the data from Kiava Gamma."

197ab00d-cff6-4a2c-aadb-75bdff001125.Text: "I saw a word among the lines of code: Nomos. What does it mean?"

c3e7ca27-7a7c-4da7-b71b-fb78f4d99342.Text: "Who are you and what is your purpose here?"

b6f9180d-51d7-4269-be7a-e5156afd85a0.Text: "I need to know more about the caches."

f7662a1b-caea-456f-a46a-affe882334f3.Text: "Your incompetence is appalling! The Rogue Trader's cogitator is rebelling, and your so-called assistance is utterly worthless."

71323893-7b69-4f8d-a1f6-c7b9fbe82e5e.Text: [Point at the text] "And what is that supposed to mean?"

171dc635-e208-4d88-975e-565767d84114.Text: "Enough of this. I wish to enquire about something else."

57ae92a8-c614-43ff-9122-9073aa7c551d.Text: [Place your hand inside the servitor's maw]

1ab4fe9b-3e43-497a-8686-666801f2bf04.Text: "What is this blood key I am supposed to use?"

673a0356-c7ba-4943-95b6-16d84eac24c1.Text: {n}The Tech-Priest by the cogitator nods curtly.{/n} "The sacred mechanism is awake and ready to receive your request, Lord Captain."

c524d5cf-d1d6-4efc-bbf6-fbcaa692130f.Text: {n}Deep within the servitor's dark gullet, unseen, burning-hot needles pierce your wrist, but the sharp pain only lasts a moment. The electoo that has been planted inside your wrist should be enough to open the repository doors.{/n}

f1565a6b-6c20-4b78-8fc2-e449eb15c31a.Text: {n}The servo-motors within the cogitator pick up the pace, their heavy thrum growing louder. The machine clicks abrasively for several minutes, until eventually, a numerical code appears on the screen. The Tech-Priest turns to you.{/n} "Blessed are the Omnissiah's deeds! The repository on Kiava Gamma has a security system guarding it. The machine spirit has recovered a code that will allow you to disable the defences."

10cf9353-6f68-49d5-8d63-5c23fc41705c.Text: {n}The servo-motors pick up the pace and their heavy thrum grows louder but stops almost immediately. The Tech-Priest turns to you.{/n} "The hallowed mechanism did all that was possible. The data is lost beyond recovery."

2fb79eea-b0f5-4e60-96d3-9f07b8131525.Text: {n}The machine hums louder until it lets out a resounding crackle. Then the sounds stop, and an unmoving numerical combination lights up on the screen. The Tech-Priest's synthesised voice sounds almost concerned:{/n} "The data has been restored, but... it is only a single phrase. 'Litanies of the Motive Force.' That is all the sacred mechanism was able to salvage."

eb01efde-c09e-4dc0-98ba-12f5bff21e77.Text: {n}The machine's hum grows louder and more promising, but a few moments later, it abruptly stops with an unpleasant click. You hear sympathy in the Tech-Priest's synthesised voice:{/n} "The sacred mechanism could not restore this data segment."

a2c449da-85eb-4a72-847d-75cf211fe7ba.Text: {n}The Tech-Priest extracts the data-slate from the cogitator and gives it to you.{/n} "The machine spirit has revealed the contents of the encrypted data, and I hereby pass it to you. This is where I reach the limit of my authorisation, but you now have the option to review the decrypted data personally."

87ad38cc-a3ec-48fe-962a-b3390161dd12.Text: "The great mechanism has transformed the secret data into a format that you can comprehend without the assistance of a servant of the Omnissiah." {n}The Tech-Priest retrieves the data-slate from the heart of the cogitator, holding it with both hands, and passes it to you.{/n}

9e2270a7-a722-43ca-8e15-cfe0b323c518.Text: "The Enginseer Prime spends hours pursuing the Quest for Knowledge in hopes of comprehending the nature of said miracle... May the Omnissiah's grace guide him on this journey."

4f7dc937-30d7-4e39-a3d2-394d0ef757df.Text: "There is no doubt that it was a miracle sent by the Omnissiah as a manifestation of His will, yet the Enginseer Prime managed to perceive some logical connection within the streams of data. I am not privy to this connection, but the Enginseer Prime will surely share this newly discovered knowledge with you in a detailed report."

c093c796-fdcb-47c2-924d-4efa8326e3db.Text: {n}The Tech-Priest, now alarmed, is tapping the keys on the control panel. His binharic prayer gives way to distressed whispering:{/n} "Unacceptable deviation... Violation of the sacred protocols... Possibility of tech-heresy... Omnissiah, shield us from all heresy."

58dbcdea-e1ff-4efa-8d3a-b7b1dc69610e.Text: "My designation is IH-630." {n}The Tech-Priest points his only mechadendrite at the machine beside him.{/n} "The venerated Enginseer Prime has entrusted this sacred mechanism into my care. It is now my duty to assist in the Rogue Trader's understanding of the hallowed code."

146fcd3b-e8bc-4e56-ac5a-108baca26533.Text: "I am IH-630 of the Adeptus Mechanicus, a faithful servant of the Machine God. The venerated Enginseer Prime has entrusted this sacred mechanism into my care so that I may assist in your understanding and comprehension of its hallowed code."

2fa4617b-1fbb-4e4c-b354-b2a4766a2af8.Text: "The machine spirit has discovered numerous critical errors. The data is damaged—" {n}The Tech-Priest stops abruptly, and the green glow of his visor narrows.{/n} "Registering an intact segment. The machine spirit has spoken: the worlds of Kiava Gamma and Dargonus hold certain data repositories. The mechanism is ready to provide the Rogue Trader with data-keys that can unlock said repositories."

71460287-5545-4ad4-aa0a-7facf1febbbf.Text: {n}The cogitator's vid-screen blinks:{/n} "///[INPUT] ||///nom_OS REQ RESP ///[Dat.tran.] || [Act. init. 098751482]"

eda30b83-f9c0-4078-b740-d57d3e91bac5.Text: "That is a mystery to me. If this mechanism truly is tainted, then... could it be?" {n}The Tech-Priest's mechadendrite jitters anxiously over the control panel.{/n} "If heresy truly has taken hold of this machine spirit and scorned the Omnissiah's every tenet, then the spirit's madness could be such that it has chosen a name for itself... but that is nothing more than my hypothesis."

bd57a334-a230-4d91-b541-75ae5bfa6cd2.Text: {n}The Tech-Priest's augmented fingers dart around the control panel.{/n} "The Omnissiah favours you! The machine spirit is willing to commence the calculation procedure that could restore the lost data."

2cae6b95-0f2b-43e8-9422-3de3a08ec107.Text: "The key you seek is the dynastic blood that runs in your veins. It is the only way to rouse this cogitator's machine spirit. When you are ready to do so, place your hand into the mouth of the guardian servitor on the blessed control panel."

579f4a89-6380-4266-b6a1-c67df9863342.Text: "That remains hidden. The encrypted data-bank belonged to the esteemed Theodora von Valancius — she was the only one who could have known about these repositories. Perhaps the former Enginseer Prime also could have known, Omnissiah accept his code. If I were to propose a hypothesis, it would be most prudent of a figure as eminent as a Rogue Trader to store her classified data in receptacles most secure."

43f58b28-dcda-4136-8dde-95ff99c4bbb6.Text: {n}The imperfections of vox-transmission make the Tech-Priest's voice sound even more worried.{/n} "A catastrophic mistake... A heinous violation of the purity of the hallowed code. This mechanism... is touched by heresy, it is branded and tainted by it. Now the machine spirit produces code as before, and yet... Lord Captain, heed my plea: all operations on this machine must be halted until the Enginseer Prime has inspected it."

ce9e376b-1f44-41e6-a9fa-deaccaedb9b7.Text: {n}The Tech-Priest bows guiltily, and his mechanical voice becomes hollow and dejected.{/n} "My knowledge is insufficient to cleanse the code of this mechanism. I will inform the esteemed Enginseer Prime of this disturbing development — only he has the power to expel the heresy from this corrupted machine spirit."

b9e2255b-fdc4-4f7d-ae35-7b58968c4429.Text: "The data-bank decryption procedure has been completed without complica—" {n}The Tech-Priest stops short. The green lights of his visor, fixed on the cogitator's vid-screens, flicker nervously.{/n}

60810ca0-295c-4248-87f2-735c6ef202fc.Text:
"///[INPUT] || [Unpack.comp.]
///nom_OS ANALYSIS ///STATUS: Initiated
The Incident breathed life and marked the beginning of all.
... [5476]
It marked the beginning of Nomos.
... [2356]
///nom_OS /// It created Nomos."

5345276b-6e88-4da7-a81e-4cce6958014b.Text:
{n}A few moments later, the vid-screens darken and flicker to life again.{/n} "///[INPUT] || [Prompt.]
///nom_OS /// [Alg.52136]"

127974f6-c95a-46e1-85fb-4132e8aae301.Text: {n}The Tech-Priest greets you with a bow. His gaze is drawn to one of the cogitator's vid-screens.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, the great mechanism... has sensed your presence."

ec925b7b-808b-4659-9343-1802a81858c0.Text: "The machine spirit has recognised the one who stands before it. The previous string of sacred code signified a greeting as well as acknowledgement that you have successfully completed a certain task. Now the great mechanism stands ready to process your request."

4a70e313-7c9b-424a-9c9e-06ce36058208.Text: "This mechanism was moulded in the forges of the Adeptus Mechanicus so that it might serve the Rogue Trader. It was in your presence that its machine spirit first manifested itself. A miracle of the Omnissiah and a testament to His glory."

d5534edc-127b-4a11-804f-fcc56484e629.Text: "The answer lies beyond the bounds of my knowledge." {n}The Tech-Priest looks back at the cogitator.{/n} "My supposition is that it might have something to do with your recent travels."

cfeea56e-2a85-4754-bf67-012534b4b01a.Text:
{n}The vid-screen flickers repeatedly and updates the text:{/n} "///[INPUT] || [Prompt.]
///nom_OS AWAIT REQUEST [Alg.52137]"

fdaa9598-67ec-4a70-bb04-a9d2b3392860.Text: {n}Without another word, the Tech-Priest turns to the cogitator. He raises his hands, and a prayer of binharic code pours out of his vox-device. The servo-motors in the bowels of the machine grow louder, its undulating hum responding to his chant. Numerical combinations run down the screens.{/n}

b97677a2-c9f2-4091-962d-413c2718baf9.Text: "The gracious machine spirit is willing to transfer the data-keys to the head of House von Valancius by means of an electoo — a hypodermic tattoo augment. If you are ready to accept the keys, place your hand inside the servitor's mouth."

d0fba9da-671f-4a83-b249-32111f336d87.Text: {n}The reflections of the bridge lights are playing on the unlit vid-screens of the cogitator. Next to the machine stands a hunched Tech-Priest, who bows as you approach, his body nearly folding in half.{/n} "Lord Captain. The machine spirit of this mechanism slumbers. Should you wish to awaken it, use the key of your blood."

ae5fcf3b-4815-425f-808c-e8c77f868cf2.Text: {n}The servitor's powerful jaws close around your hand with a screeching clack. You feel the cold metal pierce your skin and draw blood. The vid-screens in front of you flicker restlessly, filling with numerical combinations.{/n}

79908004-b965-4acc-858d-a8fe52e593b4.Text:
{n}The screen blinks, and a new entry appears in place of the previous one.{/n} "///[INPUT] || [Prompt.]
///nom_OS /// [Alg.52136]"

33975906-e206-4532-a00d-922e8778177f.Text: ...ordered that one of the servitors be disassembled and its components investigated.

67ddd1b1-ff37-43b5-b2e6-fa6f7e5fbfd1.Text: ...demanded a report on the defective units' status from the technomats.

587cc64f-4a00-4bc1-a2c6-a6242a007bed.Text: Stabbed one of the defective servitors with the heretical blade.

1176179d-c563-461c-96ca-7d9a049927cf.Text: ...suddenly drew an iridescent blade, one I had seen before, and, as if following some unheard command, plunged it into the nearest servitor!

49dc53f3-ef10-4b83-8c5d-9885340aec98.Text: Ordered that the defective servitors be destroyed in order to end their suffering.

aa341278-0698-4efa-97be-45ab9762f224.Text: ...to dispose of the servitors so that their human souls may be released from torment.

290b0115-2bdb-4cdb-917d-7b482f1eca61.Text: ...to destroy the servitors, for what was happening to them could spell horrific heresy.

ef3b67fb-29b8-4054-9a28-334ff65b6d2f.Text: Ordered that the defective servitors be returned to their former duties.

3f9ffc2a-6d96-4c27-ab7a-eadb28239e95.Text: ...to send the servitors back to toil as they had toiled before, for they had not yet paid their dues for the crimes of their past lives and thus did not deserve clemency.

ee1d3ee8-ccf4-41be-8edd-185528adffe8.Text: ...to leave the servitors to their work, for there was nothing in their behaviour that the Lord Captain found alarming.

90179f39-a222-43b0-bd2b-be734616e4d6.Text: ...proceeded with a thorough inspection of the servitors.

95e1ccfa-fb3d-4167-a53f-ea0e521e3f72.Text: ...gestured for {mf|his|her} Enginseer Prime to study the servitors.

c8511652-99c6-456c-ad6d-c9c1c3a70ede.Text: When {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship} arrived at the scene, {mf|he|she} found the servitors in the same position that they assumed after they had been corralled into the bay: all standing in a long spiralling line and facing the centre of their strange formation. The moment {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship} crossed the threshold of the bay gate, their bodies jerked into motion: all as one, as if obeying a command, the servitors turned to face the Lord Captain! The technomats tasked with overseeing the defective units even reached for their weapons, but then the servitors went still just as abruptly, staring at {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship} with vacant eyes.

6bc9b41b-65c2-4743-8a17-c98b12fc9826.Text: The Enginseer Prime slowly waded into the motionless ranks of the servitors, peering into their faces and checking the readings. There was no haste in Pasqal's actions: with mesmerising diligence, he inspected every single unit in his path, and binharic prayers were his companions in this investigation.

f849ae8e-355d-4455-baba-c7ada66d9e86.Text:
Sector: [data unavailable]
Region: [data unavailable]
Location: Von Valancius flagship, lower decks
Material: Report of a tech-phenomenon that was observed during the Lord Captain's visit to Bay AKN-108 (from the words of High Factotum Janris Danrok)

dc0a7079-6168-4d58-a9df-8124c8f852d9.Text: Whatever the Lord Captain did, be it an incline of the head, a wave of a hand, or a step to the side, the defective units repeated it without a moment's delay or hesitation, like grotesque marionettes controlled by an unseen puppeteer. We observed this mime unfold in distressed bafflement for nearly a minute until the servitors finally came to a stop. Not sensing any threat from them, the Rogue Trader approached with confidence.

286c5dca-f25e-4903-86ed-4b6efbfa9ec3.Text: As High Factotum, it was I who had prompted that entire inspection, and thus it was my duty to follow the Lord Captain. As we stepped closer, we noticed a fascinating irregularity — the servitors' pupils, normally still, were shaking wildly. Their bulging veins were pulsating under their copper collars inscribed with their past offences. It was as if those mindless half-machines were locked in a perpetual state of extreme tension.

dd99b3ba-d779-4e31-9b5f-4d6b85addb1d.Text: A visibly shaken technomat behind us proposed that the human souls had awakened within the servitors' bodies after a long slumber deep within their lobotomised brains. Formerly bereft of intelligence, they had attained awareness, feeling, and understanding.

3a55acea-a320-4655-8a25-552b474a7344.Text: After a pause, the technomat added that the servitors used to function properly and that no one had been able to explain the change in their behaviour. {mf|His|Her} gaze still trained on the motionless but animate half-machines and half-people, the Lord Captain...

fc71d07a-c889-4f62-b699-a7cfa8ba3af5.Text: The moment the blade sliced open the pale flesh, a wild howl washed over the cargo bay! We heard the screeching and crackling of servo-motors. As if having regained the ability to feel pain, the wounded servitor struggled to open its sewn mouth, but all it could muster was a stifled moan of horror. The Lord Captain's victim fell to the metal deck, and all the other servitors came crashing down with it. We all felt the grip of an otherworldly, bone-chilling cold.

fd7a95d5-6a11-4e89-8889-c3dea8daf419.Text: As I met the technomats' fearful gazes, I realised that none of those present had any explanation for what had just transpired.

f82b7e32-3a4e-4556-b7a3-365b874d4b0e.Text: The Enginseer Prime proceeded to the centre of the spiral of servitor bodies, stood over them grimly, studying their lifeless faces, and spoke thus: "This tech-phenomenon warranted comprehensive study. Further investigation has been rendered impossible." Perhaps it was a trick of my imagination, but I thought I caught a semblance of sorrow in his gaze in that moment.

4f1a9aee-c537-4871-802f-d046c5e0f3e8.Text: The Lord Captain, seemingly not attaching any importance to the situation, sheathed the blade and left the cargo bay without a word.

fa2089d6-a274-4e48-8a07-97d84333ec24.Text: All present held their breath — disturbed by this sight, we waited for the Lord Captain to speak.

15544724-f58d-46a0-b86d-33745fc0dfab.Text: The technomats' long-winded and detailed report could have been summarised in a single key point: despite the servitors' abnormal behaviour, they were still quite capable of carrying out tasks, and therefore the circumstances did not call for their termination.

76ac7caf-b74c-43ff-b44c-2a6820c1241c.Text: As the Lord Captain walked between the servitors and looked at them closely, {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship} could see their eyelids fluttering, their chests heaving with restless breaths, and their sewn lips trembling as they strained to produce any sound at all.

b617adfe-133e-47e4-87e4-9eea52151021.Text: The examination confirmed the technomats' initial hypothesis: the servitors' souls — or rather, the souls of the people they once were — had awakened. Not yet fully conscious of their past and present, these half-machines could nonetheless feel primitive emotions and sensations such as fear and pain. This undesirable consequence of shoddily performed lobotomy is most rarely observed, and yet, for some unknown reason, it had occurred in every single one of the servitors gathered in the bay.

8fc52bc1-ece2-417a-bef6-383a80565e46.Text: Alas, the Lord Captain's inspection bore us no new knowledge. The servitors were showing strange, uncharacteristic signs of fear yet simply stood there, petrified, awaiting instructions.

75c5c86f-89ec-4dd3-bb01-05322cac0ade.Text: A group of technomats hurried to act upon the Lord Captain's command. The servitor's mechanical parts separated with clicks, snaps, and hisses. The sutures between its wrinkled, pale flesh and its augments were laid disgustingly bare. We watched the technomats do their work and could see every centimetre of the servitor's stiff muscles abounding with valves and cavities pierced by countless cords and tubes.

f5eb78b8-42c1-44e3-a3cd-78335458f567.Text: The disassembly and analysis complete, the technomats concurred: the unit was in working order. Nothing in the dissected body that lay before us could provide any insight into the reason behind the defects.

a9d9d71d-4c83-4ab6-a4f6-ac098cc3023f.Text: I should make note of one more thing: at that moment, all of us present discovered that not just the eyes, but the hands and heads of some of the servitors were now shaking too. It was as if the mechanised servants were overcome with some primordial terror.

df154ad7-ddc4-44b7-a27c-8ea3388f3653.Text: {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship} looked at me with unwavering resolve, and it was that confidence that wrenched me out of the nightmarish stupor that had me tensely observing the scene unfolding before me.

e7201f83-a981-443a-a834-9dd9c210d2a6.Text: The Lord Captain gave the order...

f3dfdfc4-7ea7-4409-b8d3-7ac8d5884601.Text: The Lord Captain's command was executed post-haste: all defective units were incinerated in furnaces, and their remains were expelled into the void. The crew was provided with replacement servitors and soon forgot all about the destroyed units' peculiarities, yet this incident haunts my memories to this day.

1b676954-f5e5-461b-910c-2706f3fb686f.Text: On the Lord Captain's orders, the servitors were returned to the same decks where they had worked before. The crew was initially unnerved by their presence but adapted to their quirks soon enough, especially since, following the incident in question, there was a noticeable reduction in the servitors' strange behaviour.

68714563-11d2-426d-b4c6-f9a7307fd9da.Text: With the fate of the defective servitors decided, nothing could now distract the Lord Captain from {mf|his|her} mission.

fd263511-0c05-4a6e-9d8e-b53c6a0a0419.Text: Immediately, the servitors — each and every one of them — stepped toward the Lord Captain in perfect unison. They mimicked {mf|his|her} movements with frightening precision. The Rogue Trader halted in place and, after a moment's thought, waved {mf|his|her} hand — and the servitors, just as synchronously, repeated that gesture as well. When the Lord Captain turned quizzically to the technomats, so did the servitors, as if mocking {mf|him|her}.

b5f6115d-44b2-4003-bb75-7320e88b63e1.Text: "Lady Navigator Elina is trying to escape through the garden! Our wardens and main gates are under attack!"

4b5922ec-6dca-4b95-a626-be7c61af9c4f.Text: "Down with Tisiphone's tyranny! Kill the girl!"

84053cd4-bf13-4cfb-aef5-e6cc11aabe0f.Text: "Lady Navigator Elina-Hatteria Orsellio is charged with the attempted murder of Novator Heir Cassia Orsellio, the attempted murder of the Rogue Trader, and the attack on the palace. Let the trial commence!"

14933d46-f6f7-4daa-a1f3-6dafcb8da796.Text: "Regent Aaronto Orsellio, esteemed delegation. The Rogue Trader and the von Valancius protectorate welcome you — come this way, please."

df4ab34a-42b6-47e7-8652-4d2894d1228a.Text: "His companions: Lady Glyceria Orsellio, Navigator Leso-Cimon Orsellio and his intended bride Lady Navigator Olexandrina Orsellio, Lady Navigator Elina-Hatteria Orsellio, and Navigator Danax Orsellio."

4b51c7d3-b17b-4af5-b0cc-3518daf3acda.Text: "The esteemed representatives of the Navis Nobilite have arrived at the Rogue Trader's court: the regent of the great House Orsellio — Aaronto Orsellio."

03800c39-0bf0-4585-9cc8-592fd9b5f862.Text: "Not at us, not at us! Shoot the renegades!"

53a54f39-37e4-4b6e-9ee4-d16992a5cfe1.Text: "How could Navigators dare... and in the Rogue Trader's palace!"

fcd6a2bb-1496-4e5c-b09d-7ae09cc4a7bb.Text: "The main gate is locked, open this one! Faster, you useless waste of skin!"

940bdb6f-d58d-437a-8b46-97f615bb8826.Text: "Enough! We did not come here to fight the Rogue Trader. Fall back!"

964b2b85-f863-45b6-9ab7-35fbfb24956c.Text: "Bloody renegades! I cannot imagine how this could happen... And yet the Child is safe — that is what matters here."

4c8bfcd4-7e1e-4794-a511-516c294c4a06.Text: "I cannot imagine how this could happen... Damned traitors! How could they injure the Child!"

cb5d8187-cd2c-49c9-a4f1-40ef85ad0cc2.Text: "Don't just stand there! Help the Rogue Trader defend the Child and the palace!"

a3938fee-3212-40cc-84e2-972026e2816a.Text: "Don't shoot! House Orsellio was not involved in the attack!"

93543ae7-9522-464d-950e-dbbe38a11077.Text: "You will pay for betraying Felek and our freedom, Rogue Trader! Now kill them all!"

9d7561b1-d06d-4a31-a14f-464a9a075486.Text: This once impeccable creation of the Aeldari has lain in ruins for many a millennium.

fb160435-99b6-4bbe-b204-e62a84bb1c39.Text: The ruined statues once depicted pages from the long history of the Aeldari.

2a6b5aab-a023-4f37-8375-eee2d2c9de41.Text: The best features of the Asuryani and the Drukhari are preserved in this statue of an ancient warrior... and yet it is unmistakably different from the xenos that roam the Koronus Expanse today.

af92b7db-67c8-4b2c-b5c1-b842bdd79e11.Text: The Aeldari's gods once walked among them, teaching, guiding, protecting them from harm. There were no boundaries between mortal creatures and their patrons.

e03c1332-d696-44d8-81dd-9309139d9569.Text: Just another statue of a forgotten Aeldari.

40f98574-8016-48f2-9d47-7e9375a10d0b.Text: According to the faded glyphs, the statue depicts an Aeldari hero who created a hundred worlds and twice as many stars.

f7fe7524-f8fa-42e9-b6ed-c5ee826ecd7b.Text: This was a piece of an altar that the ancient Aeldari used for some long-forgotten ritual.

9970586a-23f5-452d-b036-debfcd7c226a.Text: The destroyed Monolith emanates otherworldly cold and desolation.

9d6430b8-1a3c-49ee-9ed9-918e04328e7a.Text: Dark shades roil inside the Monolith, and, at the edge of your consciousness, you can pick up their moans of despair. Power. Pain. Damnation. Eternity. The souls are mourning their own fate.
