83eac075-d234-48d0-bba4-eaa78e4dd9b8.Text: "Pasqal, I think you should go with these people."

697ecd52-c1e6-45ed-a20b-f0e5e4312e44.Text: "Are you saying this bloodthirsty hulk is... a saint?"

09927110-ef23-4f78-a1e9-7b1e010afb42.Text: "I am not handing Pasqal over to you unless I see evidence. Let us get to the bottom of this matter together."

f5607dc9-833b-44ff-8f2d-2cfff14d0485.Text: "Get off my ship. Now. And if you ever try to arrest anyone in my domain again, you will regret it."

48c7a3db-d9a6-408b-a1c0-e8105b05f059.Text: [Grimace] "Does the big fellow have to roar?"

415e7b06-749f-40fe-ad3b-8577bcbf11b0.Text: "On what charge are you trying to arrest a member of my retinue?"

7a553254-9748-49ed-8960-a95c49acd2a8.Text: "I insist on a joint investigation. Arresting a Rogue Trader's retinue member without any justification stands in breach of the law and my privileges under the Warrant of Trade."

85c9bade-dad2-4b62-8c03-b9c10f58188b.Text: "Pasqal has accompanied me on my travels for a while now, and I can swear to it that he is no criminal."

17d59825-852c-4bfd-a8bf-2343f3d9a7fa.Text: "What do you have to say to this, Pasqal?"

94d12d84-fa1d-474a-a6aa-a13eb336a192.Text: "How do you suppose Pasqal was involved in the events on Kiava Gamma?"

1d58d02d-10ed-4f76-9fcd-c2a5ecdfb0b9.Text: "Wait a minute. What is happening on Kiava Gamma? That planet belongs to me."

1d3d5d4e-f05c-418c-afdb-b71afb0215e8.Text: [Point to the furious servant of the Omnissiah] "Do you have proof that this Tech-Priest is who he claims to be?"

e3a6db46-ba11-4663-917e-b1763a0fde03.Text: "I have been to Kiava Gamma, and I can assure you Pasqal has nothing to do with it."

6f3df40c-7ef5-4d2d-912c-e475b26de723.Text: "Glory to the Adeptus Mechanicus. I am ready to cooperate."

1c177ab5-2dfe-458d-a736-998aa32ea4a6.Text: "Who dares to arrive on my ship uninvited? Asking for trouble, are you, cogs?"

c9100037-6f2b-4b2d-bbaa-a21b66c964ce.Text: [Address Opticon-22] "I think you and I should continue the discussion in private. The big chap is creating friction."

3e9c1534-a314-4d49-897e-6f8fc763f2f7.Text: {n}The enormous Tech-Priest points his hand at Pasqal and lets out a booming roar not unlike a factory alarm. It makes your very bones vibrate. Herald servo-skulls marked with the emblem of the cog follow in his wake. They blare shrilly,{/n} "Thou shalt not suffer a heretek in thy forge, for rust begets rust. Pasqal Haneumann, in the name of the Adeptus Mechanicus, you are under arrest."

f7fcc7f0-7763-4563-808f-0d1086b21215.Text: {n}The hunched servant of the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g} turns to you.{/n} "Diplomacy mode engaged. Announcement: the Adeptus Mechanicus //offer their apologies for//would like to inform you of the necessity of// conducting an operation to //detain//arrest//terminate// a faulty unit on the {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}'s territory."

e8273bfa-62b1-4f4c-ba6a-053a7d5be5f6.Text: {n}The Tech-Priest's deep, guttural roar blends with the servo-skulls' high-pitched whine:{/n} "False witness!"

e8e49f7c-f8ec-47e3-89c9-53f7a5ee6686.Text: "A sacrilegious conspiracy! I refuse help from laypersons. I am a cog of the Deus Mechanicus that grinds down corruption, and I will carry out the sentence immediately!"

fff0ce1b-a192-43bd-8481-83f20dee49dc.Text: {n}Pasqal freezes, but green sparks light up in his visor. He extends a hand toward Tarzus and replies, in a clanging voice,{/n} "Let the Cycle be discontinued!" {n}You realise Pasqal's words are coming from both his own vox and Tarzus's. Then every sensor on the executioner's battle harness lights up at once, blindingly, and the wounded armoured leviathan lets out a deafening roar of pain.{/n}

0955eebc-7c7c-45e9-bc86-f7fce2db5d71.Text: "Primary identification procedure. Presenting status regalia. Declaring my identity as Magos Explorator Opticon-22, a unit of the Cognisance Fleet, supply line inspector of the Kappa Thread Fleet, posted at Footfall Station."

711013f6-6200-44dd-9703-5afa3f328627.Text: "Negative. Upon completing his sanctification procedure, Tech-Brother Tarzus //vowed//modified his engrammatic augmetics' algorithms in order// never to //desecrate//sully//tarnish// his //mouth//vox//cognitive process// with flesh-speak."

3e3685a6-c89f-44bd-8ac3-a827f5dd0a77.Text: {n}You identify the rare armour the enormous Tech-Priest is wearing as a Secutor's plated, mechanised suit. It carries the imprints of many battles and has markings that announce its status as a relic. Some of the armour's damage looks fairly severe, to the point of endangering its operation.{/n}

f0df85f9-28d2-4ed2-970a-9c738297ac0f.Text: {n}The sound from the Tech-Priest's vox is like the moan of a bending steel beam. A servo-skull declares,{/n} "For vengeance I thirst as I tread the path of vengeance, following a blasphemous miscreant's bloody tracks."

1ac90d93-2a03-4c05-a089-f33dc8d7bef8.Text: {n}The enormous Tech-Priest is clad in unusual armour clearly made for battle and which has seen many of them. You cannot identify its type, which is no surprise. The Adeptus Mechanicus have hundreds of specialised models for any item.{/n}

af068ced-d877-4c63-99d2-9ac276232a9f.Text: "Archiving. Tech-Brother Tarzus opposes lay participation in the //investigation//search for the truth//. The unit Opticon-22 advises in favour of the House von Valancius representatives' participation request."

e136908b-d41a-4f85-91d5-c11da933a5df.Text: "This {g|Encyclopedia:Heretek}heretek{/g} is accused of stealing personal identification codes, spreading tech-heresy on the world of Kiava Gamma, and making an attempt on the life of a servant of the Omnissiah." {n}The deafening roar from the Tech-Priest's vox makes you grimace in pain. You touch your ear and notice blood on your fingers.{/n} "The faulty unit will be removed! In the name of the Omnissiah, I condemn you!" {n}Lightning flashes across the warrior's armour. Agony resounds in the blare of his vox-alarm.{/n}

1578a314-102e-4459-967e-b0440054d9a3.Text: "The statement is false. Tech-Brother Tarzus Haneumann is willingly undergoing holy //torment//deterioration//, which however //does not affect//does not critically affect// his cognitive capacity for data analysis. Unit calling itself Pasqal Haneumann, we have information that implicates you. Having learned that you are //a member of the retinue//a maintenance specialist in the service// of Rogue Trader von Valancius, we have come here with the goal of //meeting you//intercepting you//engaging you in combat//."

815ce6ca-2706-4d27-9bb7-db0f5a1ed5c1.Text: {n}Pasqal replies firmly, his vox crackling with a hint of indignation,{/n} "I deny these charges. I never plotted against my tech-comrade. My cognitive purity vows were never distorted. My unique identification code was never stolen. I am the true Magos Explorator Haneumann, and I am not guilty."

7aa7fe83-913d-48e0-a072-f9af9491c5dd.Text: "Cooperation request reviewed and denied. Despite their high standing, members and representatives of House von Valancius are part of the //lay//uninformed//tech-unversed// stratum that is unauthorised to interfere in the internal investigative proceedings of the Adeptus Mechanicus."

14dc395a-51af-48c1-b828-36571bad937d.Text: "Our data suggests that the unit which used Magos Explorator Haneumann's identification code performed an unauthorised upgrade on the planetary vox-array and introduced data deemed to be scrap-code into its operation. This fact points to this unit's criminal complicity with the heretek Cubis Delphim."

5c974b2d-4cfb-457b-82ff-7aaa194f9fc4.Text: "According to vox interception data, the planet's Fabricator-Censor made //incorrect//blasphemous// modifications to manufactorum working procedures, which qualifies as a lapse into sacrilege. The Adeptus Mechanicus are hereby officially notifying House von Valancius of having commenced an //investigation into//operation to remove// Fabricator-Censor Cubis Delphim. Estimated time to procedure completion... three point seven solar years."

eef8cb74-bbd4-4312-bcca-3016d76c9dac.Text: "Attention! Priority notification. Service units of the Kappa Thread supply line are unauthorised to confront the Rogue Trader. Command: retreat and re-initiate negotiations."

7897ba20-4184-4980-be23-2915fba7c97e.Text: "Confirmed. According to the archive entry 1E-99237, Magos Explorator Tarzus Haneumann //served on//maintained// the ship — identifier classified — in the capacity of a reliquary caretaker. He sustained extensive damage to both the organic and the sacred part of his body in //a series of sacrilegious breaches of the Rite of Operation//an assassination attempt//."

3287ec8d-f979-4e91-bc83-b4948894caf2.Text: "Request denied. Tech-Brother Tarzus has passed sanctification and has relic privileges. I lack the //authority//access level necessary// to command this unit." {n}There is a hint of animosity toward the bloodthirsty Tech-Priest in Opticon-22's voice.{/n}

8ebcecbb-79c6-40fb-a277-e49b4cfd0b57.Text: {n}Despite the hood hiding his face, you recognise him as Opticon-22, whom you encountered on {g|Encyclopedia:Footfall}Footfall{/g}.{/n}

82b4c14b-856d-4637-8ecf-cd575a836190.Text: "Identification codes recognised and confirmed. These units are who they declare themselves to be."

9c9120a8-fbf0-4989-b1f7-14658186898b.Text: {n}In contrast, Pasqal speaks quietly and coldly:{/n} "You are malfunctioning, tech-comrade. I deem your logical conclusions questionable."

8b51231a-2b2e-4222-a7a0-6dca61a28e0e.Text: "The Adeptus Mechanicus regard this act as voluntary //martyrdom//self-destruction// for the glory of the Deus Mechanicus. This battle harness is classified as cogni-armour. The machine spirit living in it is strong and wise, but it took major damage in the course of Magos Gracchus's last battle. Besides sacred litanies and imperatives of service to the Omnissiah, the armour broadcasts a continuous signal of suffering and agony into Tech-Brother Tarzus's mind."

46f00bad-5c52-4a03-b1d1-7d4c9faee2d0.Text: "Request approved. Ready to work in cooperative mode."

d57deeb2-43f0-488c-93e0-88f24d43507b.Text: {n}Tarzus gives you a haughty look and lets out a howl of wrath.{/n}

7d9b2137-3afa-4523-b934-dea067e795a2.Text: {n}The tall Tech-Priest who spoke to you looks more peaceful and makes a point of not drawing his weapon. There is an air of concern about the way he frequently glances over at his fellow, scrutinising his condition.{/n}

eb5be4a6-3cf4-44b9-9bb0-7e1934b03332.Text: "This statement is true. Brother Tarzus has the //honour of wearing//authorisation to wear// the sacred battle harness that belonged to Magos Militant Auspector Gracchus, one of the first //champions of the faith//holy scouts// to join the cause of conquering the Koronus Expanse. After //his death//the termination of his vital functions// at the hands of xenos, his damaged Goliath-class armour was preserved and given the status of a relic."

785e0884-eb81-4d0b-887d-cb164d169f55.Text: "//Owing to a statistically fortunate coincidence//By the Omnissiah's grace//, enough of his operational capacity was preserved for him to don a Goliath model sacred battle harness, which would preserve his //vital functions//functionality//. Archive entry personally data-sealed by the captain of the — identifier classified."

4bd0de14-2356-45da-8ec1-65d3411fef1c.Text: "Analysis of the security system showed that the //assassins//heretics// infiltrated the reliquary using Tech-Brother Tarzus's unique identification code. Someone had //stolen//duplicated// Brother Tarzus's identity, which is a Grade Three transgression. And the unit making the allegedly criminal claim of being Pasqal Haneumann is known to have previously //used//entered// the stolen code."

cead055e-db2a-4041-b763-62583544269b.Text: {n}Brother Tarzus lets out a terrifying battle cry and raises his weapon with an amazing alacrity for someone of his size.{/n} "Let those who have spurned the procedure reap the fruits of their sacrilege!"

f6a2f0a8-8345-46d8-b5ba-4526374a5bb7.Text: "Request for cooperation reviewed and accepted. I request Tech-Brother Tarzus's consent to the co-participation of representatives of the von Valancius dynasty in the investigation proceedings."

209788ef-e007-4613-8b53-ff1c0539cf34.Text: "Negative. The data collected by Tech-Brother Tarzus has been deemed sufficiently comprehensive for //the verdict to be passed//termination//."

35dff1db-814b-4b5c-b158-5ba44564ae39.Text: {n}Solomorne folds his arms.{/n} "Your accusation does not follow protocol; you have no authority on the Rogue Trader's ship; you did not account for Pasqal's status as a member of {mf|his|her} retinue — shall I continue, or is the inadequacy of your 'arrest' clear enough already?"

7139fb99-ef07-4bea-88e9-b4790091da9e.Text: "These statements are true. However, I am prepared to answer my tech-comrades' accusations. Further intervention from the unit Solomorne is undesirable for ideological reasons."

b2774864-cadf-4ba9-8cd4-b37a58e76655.Text: {n}A group dressed in the crimson of the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMechanicus}Priesthood of Mars{/g} walks toward you. Their gazes are fixed on Pasqal.{/n}

14fe4c5e-1efd-4dea-8ee1-5b35b5d490da.Text: {n}You note that the group is not monolithic. Some of its members are more heavily armed and follow a large {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priest{/g} clad in battle armour. Others keep a respectful distance and cast enquiring looks at their own leader, whose hunched posture belies his tall frame.{/n}

acd4375a-b30b-4fc4-aec8-3edc34e8f63e.Text: {n}The slivers of flesh revealed under the steel are marked with terrible chemical burns. Every now and then, convulsions shake the Tech-Priest's body, and a painful-sounding hiss comes from his {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g}.{/n}

e66c0c69-220e-4a41-913a-8f5400062d29.Text: {n}Brother Tarzus lets out a terrifying battle cry and raises his weapon with an amazing alacrity for someone of his size.{/n} "Wasting time is sacrilege! The sentence will be carried out immediately!"

779d9ca8-ae6b-45fe-89f7-f5e7faf4813c.Text: "Willingness to cooperate recorded. Mandate expanded. I request //the right to conduct//non-interference in// the operation to //detain//arrest//terminate// the unit falsely identifying itself as Pasqal Haneumann."

db85b92f-ec89-4953-a144-b4f3f0869c82.Text: {n}In a burst of chattering, the servo-skulls hasten to translate their master's mighty binharic howl:{/n} "An instrument of the Omnissiah authorised to punish and exact vengeance, known by the designation 'Tarzus Haneumann.'"

ea4e711d-3d12-49ec-adb6-9da0170e6f57.Text: "Conflict of authority detected. Official message: the Adeptus Mechanicus //are aware of//respect//recognise// your right of ownership of this territory and declare no intent to commit an act of aggression. This is an operation to //detain//arrest//terminate// a faulty Adeptus Mechanicus unit, the fugitive falsely identifying itself as Pasqal Haneumann."

49681c6b-5841-47fa-9414-302b5c4ed169.Text: {n}The servo-skulls screech:{/n} "Mine is a pure and binharic tongue that preserves only what is true and shuns scrap data."

b2ee0868-aadc-4205-b9e9-fa14c0983ffe.Text: This augmentation belonged to the fallen Tech-Priest who called himself Dementz Haneumann. It was torn out of the heretic's skull after his demise.

bc44c07c-4496-4c77-bb43-7ecf7dde8520.Text: "The Messiah of Discontinuing? Is that how you refer to Amarnat?"

d4955b9b-22b5-4d4f-ad4c-a4a4ea0a3ac9.Text: "Pasqal, what did you do to Tarzus?"

08730141-adbe-49a6-bcef-d505374b2a64.Text: "I am sorry that you had to kill a comrade."

732db875-806c-4b37-8cf3-6f467aa8ea61.Text: "I am not tired at all. In fact, I can finish you off too. Do your worst!"

39db8f02-2f91-4b23-bb86-443684b4f61c.Text: "Now that the conflict has been resolved, you may remain aboard my ship."

b4f732cd-9d27-4e4d-8872-148648121e09.Text: "Clear off. Or I will spill yet more blood and sacred unguents."

5b079da6-4790-4764-bf12-7c836e434991.Text: [Whisper] "Whatever you just did, it's working. Keep going."

191768a2-5767-492a-acc1-1f9693c49ff3.Text: "Pasqal, there is one small point I'm not clear on — what just happened?"

31a25814-0385-4b35-b307-ba4c1987016f.Text: "What is the reason for this act of genuflection?"

ddd665d4-b8c0-4351-8f06-836d8643ea8d.Text: "I presume the conflict between you and Pasqal has been resolved?"

2d7c8cca-febd-4d94-91da-b758ef5820ca.Text: "Do you know where Amarnat is now?"

0060bf51-97b6-4737-a3c8-55ae666e6f17.Text: {n}Pasqal's {g|Encyclopedia:Mechadendrite}mechadendrite{/g} briefly touches the shoulder of Opticon-22, who bows respectfully.{/n}

07fd78af-8df4-43e4-a2ab-3771a646322e.Text: {n}Pasqal's confused reply comes from his vox in a rasp:{/n} "Unable... to fulfil... request. The Omnissiah granted me an epiphany, and I... muted the maimed {g|Encyclopedia:MachineSpirit}machine spirit{/g} that was filling Tarzus's mind with fury. I do not fully understand the manner of my appeal to it. The situation perfectly mirrors the incident on Rykad Minoris where I appealed to the machine spirit of a malfunctioning mechanism and laid it to rest."

864c3924-7c90-4f79-973c-6e0173000c1b.Text: "I also //regret//have a negative assessment of// this event."

4a52d462-8961-4c80-b41e-e392f81e356d.Text: "Requesting diplomacy mode for further communication. I am not authorised to use force against the von Valancius dynasty's supreme leadership."

19958df9-f68a-46bd-a44d-ec42aea06d7a.Text: "The {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMechanicus}Adeptus Mechanicus{/g} still accuse the unit identifying itself as Pasqal Haneumann of criminal theft of a unique identification code. Unlike Tech-Brother Tarzus, I am not authorised to immediately //arrest//execute// the unit, but neither am I authorised to drop the enquiry."

0925827e-74a2-4cdb-a7bf-c2b0c5d14f97.Text: "The unit that called itself Tarzus Haneumann //is dead//has been disabled//. This material asset is beyond restoration or reuse as spare parts."

788d1cfb-295d-417d-8042-5249893c45b7.Text: "The Kappa Thread supply line delegation is leaving Dargonus, expresses gratitude for the //hospitality//ceasefire//, and proclaims its intent to return to Footfall to resume performing its regular functions." {n}The {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priest{/g} looks over at Pasqal as if waiting for something.{/n}

e9bc39f0-b130-44a9-88a9-2b9e0734bbb0.Text: {n}After a pause, Pasqal bows his head, and a binharic requiem pours out of his {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g}.{/n} "Despite his misconceptions, he was a servant of the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}."

6de05d7e-3f4c-423e-a510-cfb29d0066ec.Text: "There are no apostates among us." {n}The piercing voice from the vox-synth is more overwhelming than Tarzus's thunderous roar:{/n} "Tech-Brother Tarzus and the machine spirit that lived in his battle harness succumbed to the suffering that beset them. Their judgement was rash and erroneous. Now their torment is over. I declare them martyrs, and am requisitioning Tarzus Haneumann's {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}neural augmetic{/g} for the purposes of preserving his blessed memory."

8bd6fda4-4793-446c-a54e-1b9d4e827e95.Text: {n}As astonished Tech-Priests look on, Pasqal leans over the slain man's body and extracts the augmetic from his skull. His movements are as precise as they are respectful.{/n}

3ba7edf9-8092-4c30-a4be-7824837ba2e4.Text: {n}The Tech-Priest makes an imperious gesture, stopping you from continuing.{/n}

342f55e1-1bfe-429d-8ad7-1fe4cd60d9ec.Text: {n}With each word, Pasqal's voice grows more powerful and majestic:{/n} "You saw the agony your Tech-Brother Tarzus was in. His unbridled, pain-spurred faith intimidated you, yet you were silent. Reverence stopped you from raising your voices to proclaim that the machine spirit with which his mind had merged was morbidly afflicted."

7c50bd0a-b606-4819-a605-155500833adb.Text: {n}There is a clang as Opticon-22's knee presses into the floor. Crimson-hooded heads are bowed.{/n} "Let the Cycle be discontinued."

f1914900-9b9e-4875-9521-ffa05800d060.Text: {n}The radiant light pouring out of Pasqal's visor grows dimmer. Static creeps back into his voice:{/n} "Let the Cycle be discontinued, tech-comrades."

cc051d13-498a-405c-9c4b-87ee7fcbcf62.Text: {n}Pasqal's vox-synth crackles somewhat tentatively,{/n} "I decided to sustain my words with an excerpt from one of the blessed Amarnat's sermons, 'On Loss of Internal and External Function,' Verse IV. My analysis deemed it... appropriate."

a96a8d4d-7c2b-478e-8718-abb1f18eb57b.Text: "The data received provides a basis for calling the fallen Tech-Brother Tarzus's hypothesis into question. //Out of respect for//Due to lack of authorisation to indict// the followers of the Messiah of Discontinuing, we will not proceed with the //detainment//arrest//termination//."

c00f97cc-5318-48e7-be26-4b6bf13aceb6.Text: "It has been a long time since the words of the Messiah of Discontinuing were last spoken //openly//over public communication bands//. We respectfully welcome wisdom's return."

0e0d7d10-59c8-489e-b3e0-19ecb0d9bf29.Text: "This statement is false. Contrary to what many servants of the Omnissiah //thought they knew//preferred to believe//, the Fleet's Supreme Conclave never //formulated//issued// an official statement on that decision."

28caa50e-18b5-40ef-ad0c-e035691e28bb.Text: "Data unavailable. No reports have mentioned Archmagos Amarnat since the incident on the Ark Mechanicus Hermetico which led to the //presumed destruction//disappearance// of that voidship."

020c2b27-8e69-4dbe-95ea-4d158f02056a.Text: "Negative. I had no contact with Archmagos Amarnat and was never a member of his //flock//disciples//retinue//. However, my analysis of the doctrine he outlined inspired in me deep //respect for//trust in// him."

dbc0d2d5-d9cb-4bc6-a4c5-43fa1a83c8ea.Text: "The imperative of reverence had paralysed your will, and you watched a tragedy unfold in silence. The Sixth Universal Law states that Comprehension is the True Path to Knowledge. Yet the procedural Cycle has robbed you of your Comprehension. Therefore — let the Cycle be discontinued."

c2666284-3587-4dc2-b3d8-838caee662ba.Text: "So he is not forgotten after all."

19811012-ba8e-4379-a851-b844c37502c3.Text: "My archive has no data on the Hermetico incident. The vessel was the blessed Amarnat's base of operations. Is it... lost, then?" {n}Pasqal's voice is filled with anxiety.{/n}

28f8d42b-24e3-424b-bb44-6b4201956125.Text: "The Omnissiah knows all, comprehends all. Thank you, Tech-Brother Opticon-22."

87dc7ee6-d333-4428-8bf3-748e712be4fa.Text: "Thirty-seven percent of the Supreme Conclave's members openly supported Archmagos Amarnat's views and //disappeared//were removed from the chain of command// under circumstances that were classified. The Supreme Conclave has not had a quorum ever since."

c3772178-baaa-4a11-9c05-60c87ca462a2.Text: "Following Archmagos Amarnat's partial //laicisation//removal from the chain of command//, that was the authorship attribution on a series of sermons on Discontinuing the Cycle that were disseminated across the Cognisance Fleet."

18c466d0-106a-4f62-b9cf-2e98c9f81e6e.Text: "It was, in fact, a title used by many. In times past."

d2da1c45-cc1d-439a-b6b3-dd3360be49ec.Text: "If these ashmags dared to touch something from the cargo..."

bc0cdcfd-84ab-4627-87fb-9ff41dc6d9e8.Text: "Open the doors for us... guide our way... twist our way... we beseech thee, our lord!"

02b30aac-9df8-47c5-9684-a488aacf75e5.Text: "The Edge of Daybreak! The Edge of Daybreak!"

33aea89b-02b2-4e64-8730-be6f1b586344.Text: The entrance was completely demolished by the explosion. There is no way inside.

b3b2bd47-d195-4d5d-9a6d-abae0ac3cf6f.Text: Someone has disturbed the established order of the bookshelves: among the works on politics and military craft, you now see the conspicuous gilded cover of a handwritten book on "The Secrets of Gallant Conduct."

3487a666-5153-41f9-930a-37cb717d61a9.Text: "What an... exhilarating feeling. You are turning my head, and I do not even want to resist!"

efc1782f-f01c-41bd-8486-b53eb0c64010.Text: "{name}, your back and neck! Let me put some ointment on them. But... am I mistaken, or do you like my claws?"

bf693b70-b36f-45f1-88ab-4abcc92e8e1b.Text: "I feel all aflame in your arms... Free to do what I like, how I like..."

1d3f64af-2c3e-45c1-a742-5279c352fba3.Text: "I wish I could stay with you a little longer, but duty... calls us both. Until the end of watch."

bf3fc6fb-f2e4-4175-97ef-b436b7f816ef.Text: "My powers almost got out of control when we... well... How embarrassing!"

e3dc44de-e061-419c-8261-b6a3891ad741.Text: "Look, we can get down to the water this way! Could we, perhaps, take a brief detour for a closer look?"

8124a263-eacf-40dd-a0d6-b3020e9fafe7.Text: The servant's docked vocal cords were recently replaced with a silver-plated vox-implant.

feb1f58e-e900-416d-a29d-6f856fb61c0f.Text: "I serve the Imperium and House Orsellio!"

321091ab-0cef-4f25-954d-623c9b6d7ccc.Text: The servant makes an elaborate gesture clearly meant to announce your arrival.

203263a1-9982-44fb-a8d8-509e490fe838.Text: "Lady Cassia, His Lordship has arrived at your invitation!"

bfc73060-7be4-425c-a2c2-4f0ff2d287c2.Text: Secrets of Gallant Conduct: How to Express Your Feelings to a Noble Lady

8c769da1-02d2-4a6a-8953-62b02382e9d0.Text: This precious pendant on a fine chain can only be opened if one is familiar with its secret mechanism. Inside are painted portraits of Lady Cassia and the Rogue Trader, and on its back is an engraving that reads, "Never Fade."

dffa055e-98dc-478a-8152-fde217b98f59.Text: [Catch her hand and bring it to your lips]

71f6d006-bc2d-4712-9b3d-5bfbaa42e2bc.Text: "Were you expecting to see someone else?"

7acdf938-6e9c-4250-ba73-862f9448bb55.Text: "Lady Cassia, I am overjoyed to see you in good health."

91e61029-736b-4a1f-8649-60c0e4aa8316.Text: [Give in to your emotions] "I want you..."

7eb6550c-cfaa-469f-ae9b-0788d1669e38.Text: [Hold her close and kiss her tenderly] "My thoughts of you gave me strength."

2f62cedd-e6fc-4c58-a713-d554c4054735.Text: "I am Rogue Trader {name} von Valancius. It will take more than a pathetic gaggle of xenos to break me."

7e50661d-78ec-447e-9859-6d2302ee2192.Text: [Hold Cassia close and kiss her tenderly]

547e2a0e-0124-442e-9efa-42f2e607893d.Text: [Pull Cassia closer and press your lips to hers in a passionate kiss]

9ba6f75d-03b4-4d4c-8e19-0ed97a87827d.Text: "I am terribly tired. I would like to be left alone."

46bfe528-85b7-43e7-811c-b8c9d85d9351.Text: [Hold her closer] "I fear that if I were to let you go, you would run away."

21ec2974-b4b0-48c6-bc69-5d3a5f87bbc7.Text: "I only just returned, and already you are pestering me with idle chatter."

35e8e8f8-4118-42cd-9cfb-01236e2e271a.Text: [Hold back the urge] "I wish I could make this moment last forever."

450d5145-e9ec-436a-b554-f78bca077b1a.Text: "{name}!" {n}Cassia whispers the moment she finds her breath. Her pallid face is flushed, her hair is dishevelled, and her delicate shoulders are trembling with agitation and barely contained tears.{/n} "It really is you..." {n}Cassia reaches out her clawed hand and gently touches your cheek, but then, startled by her own impulse, immediately jerks it back.{/n}

df3428b1-31c1-4d5e-b4df-14301cbd439a.Text: {n}A scorching slap sobers you in an instant, and you see Cassia's huge eyes staring at you in fear.{/n} "I knew it. I knew that this is what you truly wanted from me all along!"

7e2ebfad-bb8d-4e00-9143-c818e4c3d79f.Text: {n}Cassia flinches, but, instead of recoiling, she grips your fingers tighter.{/n} "I was afraid that I would never see you again..."

8833da3d-2183-496b-9ef1-26e063ade47c.Text: "What? No, of course not." {n}Cassia bats her eyes in confusion.{/n} "Each and every day, I came to these chambers to pray to the God-Emperor, wishing only for your swiftest return."

3362ace0-1941-4055-90ad-5dfc9e7e2bb0.Text: "Your colours..." {n}Cassia frowns and waves away an unseen cloud hanging over your head.{/n} "They have darkened, become more... sickly."

da1eb8a7-a611-44f6-908f-50634789997c.Text: "When you disappeared, all the worlds and stars of my dreams ceased to matter. All my thoughts were of finding you. I knew... I could feel that what happened to you was far more frightening than death. And now you have returned from the Dark City in one piece. By the Gold of the Throne, I am elated, but how did you...?"

246c2cd9-f858-4366-86a9-7a6e6b23dc43.Text: {n}Cassia flinches as if struck with a whip, and the fire in the depths of her eyes fades.{/n} "I am sorry, Lord Captain. I merely wished... to welcome you back. So... now that I have... I dare not delay you longer."

1069151b-0569-4956-abbf-7da18816a259.Text: {n}Cassia nods — slowly, without any need for words. The warm gaze of her ruby eyes is drawn to your lips.{/n}

cebb791f-ead1-473f-9d0f-1bdb20b855fe.Text: {n}Cassia freezes as your lips join together in a sweet kiss, but then her body relaxes and her eyes close. She reciprocates slowly, uncertainly, gently...{/n} "Please, no more! I cannot breathe... I fear I may faint..."

9608295b-1911-42c7-86c1-75e0670b6894.Text: {n}You sink your fingers into Cassia's gossamer hair and ravenously kiss her trembling lips, not letting her go even for a moment.{/n} "Please, no more! I cannot breathe... I fear I may faint..."

2ff41149-aacd-4bb4-9f7a-8623347c0015.Text: {n}She covers her face with her veil in embarrassment and rushes out of the room without even saying goodbye.{/n}

4d3505a2-1e1c-48e8-9e9b-00bd7e36c096.Text: {n}A moment passes. Cassia blushes even more and hides her face in her hands. Thump. Thump. Thump. Your heart races after the rapid beating of hers, each new breath you take is deeper than the last, your body is tingling, your face is burning, and so are your hands and neck... Cassia's powers ignite your desires as you stand over her, driven by passion.{/n}

fe8cb1ef-7f13-4197-8421-d4bf51af9b75.Text: {n}Cassia leans forward, quickly kisses your cheek, and places something cold to the touch into your hand.{/n} "This... This is a gift. It is nothing special. I just meant to give you this when we met again."

5c2aa619-9312-4fdc-ad68-56cb9f28f5f4.Text: "I respect your wishes, Lady Cassia. If you think we must end our relations here, then so it shall be."

5ca887a0-5839-4f1d-8516-8f0cbd081efc.Text: "Who said there was anything between us in the first place? I've just been toying with you, nothing more."

e956e253-50d5-4a7b-99ce-521ae3c55030.Text: "Lady Cassia, have I upset you in some way?"

5d694ea7-f089-424e-9f99-8c9275eacd18.Text: "Have I not been convincing enough in expressing my feelings to you?"

ca98e8b9-54a0-4eb7-85de-eac06c54f318.Text: "It is already too late for me. I cannot bear the thought of a life without you."

586c08a6-d19d-463c-82cd-63609476e203.Text: "Is renouncing one's duty truly the only way to be with another person?"

036c0449-a980-4e4e-91ab-2add0c34cd40.Text: "When I hold you in my embrace, I feel like I am home."

a4d9ba1a-f1cd-4f31-9924-5ca7627db658.Text: "I find myself smitten with your raised chin, your refined manners, and the stern look in your eyes whenever you scold me."

470a3e54-52db-4829-8b11-c1eef2538210.Text: [Take her hand] "Now please let me tell you about the Cassia I see."

c8faf326-f298-41b5-834b-fff1ecb20836.Text: "You have studied thousands of books. You wish to learn everything there is to learn — and I am dazzled by your keen mind and curiosity."

527ba8f6-01e6-4c84-8cdc-6e9121e54a70.Text: [Kiss her] "We will be together, our fears be damned."

eeb0ac5d-0d7c-4e7f-bfd7-081a50a70c30.Text: "In that case, is it really wise to waste time on preludes and quarrels? Let us instead cherish the here and now. For as long as the stars allow us."

c4ce3fab-3565-45f8-9a30-37df10b6dce1.Text: "You are exhausted. Come, I shall lay you in my bed and stay to guard your slumber."

b20f2880-e7b5-4889-995b-c816c4317608.Text: "It saddens me that you cannot see your own gracefulness and beauty."

96f91ad6-f463-47c1-93ac-a0898dd74582.Text: "I do not care. I chose you, as you chose me. That is what truly matters."

5a1438d5-c74c-4694-b7df-b63c7412f546.Text: "I could have died a great many times, and yet here I am, standing before you."

5ebef14b-1aef-4147-b9b3-a84e36f68a6b.Text: "Enough! You want this to be over so badly? Well, you'll hear no argument from me. Now leave!"

9a238682-a79f-4721-a8e2-9ec29e153cb7.Text: "You are killing me at this very moment."

db95b802-f0e8-41f3-bdec-956aba872428.Text: "I am too deeply in love with you to make light of such things."

227fe1f2-6f62-4315-8c2b-2b35459bbb17.Text: "Is it to you? It seems that you are the one who has been toying with my feelings this whole time."

7c183776-f184-4076-bf67-16b1e1885039.Text: "When I hear your voice, my heart beats faster, and your touch makes me lose my mind altogether."

cbbb1377-d34c-4d87-9642-dacb6579441a.Text: "I hope to see a future where you never tire of me."

ece77ac1-10b7-4368-9dd4-f78a4eff4e96.Text: "That is disgusting! Get out of my chambers, now!"

ff815e28-cf4e-4bbb-bf5f-514f793fc04d.Text: "You are right. Our feelings are a liability. But House Orsellio and the von Valancius protectorate could benefit from a dynastic alliance. What say you to that? Will you agree to become my dearest wife?"

6318a2f8-6fae-42b8-b0d2-f630f172062d.Text: "Your eyes shine like rubies against a sunset sky, and your skin and hair are like fresh snow. Never before have I seen anything so beautiful."

df4ed8f1-df07-4d54-a814-dc7a2a2157b2.Text: "Please, stay with me just a little longer."

d693860f-7e48-44be-b2b4-e0f8f74519ab.Text: [Pull her in passionately] "I shall help you forget about the worries of this night."

c05f4ac8-85fd-48c6-bcf4-97d61e730459.Text: [Offer her your hand] "I love you. Let us go to my chambers and find our bliss."

ced650bb-f174-4ec6-ac8a-58052c10023e.Text: "Lord Captain?" {n}Cassia clasps her hands together. You can sense an air of cold aloofness about her.{/n} "We... must speak. Now."

b31415f4-db15-4189-9826-6b68625b495c.Text: {n}Cassia trembles, opens her mouth, and even moves her lips, but the words refuse to come out.{/n} "This... I... I have said so already."

df79248f-3257-4a93-92ba-627dd6de893a.Text: "Oh, {name}..." {n}Cassia looks at you with tenderness and longing, but then frowns in frustration.{/n}

dc834eae-437b-4534-bf8c-abad1366fecf.Text: "That's not true!" {n}Cassia sobs in desperation and hides her face in her hands.{/n}

293c844a-92ca-41cc-ac60-d3b5662ee666.Text: "No." {n}Cassia quickly shakes her head and looks away.{/n} "Last night... it was wonderful! But I... I... just wasn't ready, you see? What if I made a mistake, {name}? What if we both did?"

a5ea97e0-a8a1-4901-ae37-63c54b26ecb6.Text: "Please, that is not what I meant..."

1e1a7e91-53d3-49b9-bd5e-7c52f9292d01.Text: "No, that is merely what your heart is telling you. I see human feelings every day with these very eyes." {n}Cassia opens her eyes, frowns, and purses her lips.{/n} "Emotions are fleeting. They wither all too quickly sometimes. Love, fear, attachment — everything passes."

c8f80930-5ee1-496d-8eb3-152afeec39ce.Text: {n}A familiar sensation envelops your being. The pain in your chest is suffocating, and you fall to your knees.{/n} "Why can't you understand? I'm a Navigator! A mutant! I'm... I'm nothing but a tool in His hands, in Humanity's hands. And tools... are not supposed to have feelings."

3457cb17-832b-4086-93ad-9e6d69bf54d4.Text: {n}Cassia reaches out her trembling hand and grasps yours.{/n} "I love you, {name}."

02d86bf0-357e-4200-975a-31b134c6d1c9.Text: {n}Cassia's eyes tear up, but her face and voice remain resolute and impassive.{/n} "Wonderful. Then that is all there is to say."

a5a88ce3-c6b0-41e7-9a6d-b4f5e4f8f15e.Text: {n}Her tightly pressed lips part in a reserved smile.{/n} "Thank you for your understanding, Lord Captain. You have been a paragon of gallantry, just like the dutiful warriors in the books I loved reading so much. How cruel it is that life is nothing like a story with a happy ending." {n}Still smiling mirthlessly, Cassia nods and walks away.{/n}

4efea1cd-d81f-4c1d-a610-847794bd1ddb.Text: {n}She quivers as she makes a weak attempt to slip out of your hands.{/n}

d9a08733-b9c3-4567-8880-abacc4a2c399.Text: "And does it not perturb you that I'm a wretched mutant? That my own subjects see me as a monster? That your servants fear my company more than facing a mortal enemy?"

06eaf346-e04a-4ea3-a45b-68296ff40457.Text: "I know not what the future holds for us. But I'm willing to take a risk... and find out together with you, my love." {n}Cassia covers your hand with hers, and her knees buckle treacherously.{/n}

efa46392-d61e-4e01-ace4-93a7d8c7b188.Text: "Oh, {name}, that's..." {n}Cassia looks abashed but does not withdraw her hands.{/n} "That sounds wonderful! No one has ever guarded my sleep before. You will be the first."

2fc0cc27-66d2-4f82-96bd-5dc73239b0a7.Text: "People go mad when I'm near. They die. I could kill you by accident!"

3d89b9c3-a714-4ed1-b384-3f9a08da80fe.Text: "Me? What has got into you? Why does it not perturb you that I'm a wretched mutant? That my own subjects see me as a monster? That your servants fear my company more than facing a mortal enemy?"

104092e1-64db-4d3c-aa45-e2d62ee56123.Text: "Is all this just a lark to you?"

656b222b-fd84-4800-86f8-16c2a549bf3a.Text: "No!" {n}Cassia pushes you away and steps back hesitantly.{/n} "Please don't come any closer!"

35b4a67b-3813-45e4-aeb1-8a68471a0fd0.Text: "A time will come when my duty to House Orsellio will call upon me. And you... you have already been summoned to do your duty to the God-Emperor and your protectorate. Would it not be better, then, if we ended things now? Before... before it is too late. If I truly am dear to your heart, you will understand." {n}A tense silence hangs in the air, and Cassia turns away to hide her emotions.{/n}

2a9c3e65-c683-4a98-bf31-c7c9cd2adb3c.Text: {n}Cassia clings to your chest, her body trembling.{/n} "Then all I want is to lose myself in your embrace. Yours and no one else's."

de1114b5-22d7-44db-a9b7-31048512195e.Text: {n}Cassia listens in silence, her eyelashes lowered and her head slightly bowed. A barely noticeable smile tugs at the corners of her mouth.{/n}

c433fbe1-bd86-429b-b15f-d2554745452c.Text: "{name}, stop. I... I hear you." {n}Crimson tears stream down her cheeks, but she is smiling — and hers is a smile of joy and freedom.{/n} "I can see your colours, so pure that I'm afraid I might scare them away. Only when I stand before you, fully dressed, do I feel utterly bare and defenceless. You have captured my heart. Made me fall in love with you. And shown me how to love myself."

22beef8a-6c57-4bae-b07a-051ba63339d8.Text: {n}Cassia's lips touch yours in a long, tender kiss. You relish each other for a while before she withdraws and, after giving you a parting kiss on the forehead, flutters out of the study.{/n}

e69cc3a7-0153-4708-a340-f95c31711045.Text: {n}Cassia takes a few anxious steps around the study, then says reservedly,{/n} "I have given much thought to all that has happened. And... to us. Perhaps you do indeed have feelings for me. Perhaps I have feelings for you in turn. But we..." {n}She falters.{/n} "We are not meant to become something more."

dbea71c5-a312-4522-a32f-07c9d57865dd.Text: {n}Cassia sobs and rolls up one of her sleeves. From her clavicle to her elbow, the skin on her arm has grown so thin that you can see every vein, muscle, and tendon within.{/n} "A new mutation, {name}! Just like that, in the middle of the latest warp jump. And this body will go through even more ghastly changes in the future. I don't... I don't want you to see what I become. I don't want to see you grow to loathe my hideousness."

d45910a8-3020-4443-b98b-c45deb4e4698.Text: {n}Cassia stands perfectly still, unable to speak another word. With a look of emptiness and detachment, she rolls down her sleeve, turns around, and slowly, as if in some sort of trance, leaves the room.{/n}

f2f75252-1653-4717-abe2-1ad2f7d8c051.Text: "The here and now..." {n}Cassia smiles and unconsciously steps closer to you.{/n} "Do you truly believe in these words of yours, {name}?"

08e73369-a0bf-4ba5-acaa-28d8b2a04242.Text: {n}As you open your eyes at the sound of the early watch siren, you see Cassia hurriedly struggling to pull on a stocking that is refusing to cooperate. When she notices that you are awake, she recoils in surprise.{/n} "{name}!"

a6ff5476-2109-4cda-b302-29ce1349787f.Text: {n}Cassia hurries away, but turns around as she reaches the door.{/n} "I don't want to doubt, {name}. And I still love you with all my heart, but... I need time to reflect on this. Time and your patience, that's all I ask. I hope you understand."

d4f590ec-adcc-4854-8e5b-b22cd64cafef.Text: {n}Cassia looks dazed and possibly... saddened? She considers it for a while in silence, then offers you a reserved smile.{/n} "Naturally, {name} von Valancius. Once our incessant haste has passed. Once the turmoils of the Expanse have settled and our dynasties are ready... this marriage will take place. And I will be honoured and proud to call you my dearest husband in kind." {n}Still smiling mirthlessly, Cassia nods and walks away.{/n}

b0c93ae7-b4cb-4834-a1fb-c52d7e801652.Text: "What have you done to me, you monster?"

db025f6c-1d78-497c-962f-acb69368f420.Text: "Stay out of my head! I will deal with this myself!"

202d3201-54d8-468b-865f-d4f323983f63.Text: "If you would be so kind... If this continues much longer, I might..."

c746ed58-ea8f-455f-8b90-cca56242afa4.Text: "It is quite all right, I can handle it myself."

6bc9de0d-c7c8-485e-a031-1b36ffa2802f.Text: "I am myself again, thanks to you."

d4d73c6f-6353-4196-a2aa-553c0f442824.Text: [Kiss her hand] "Your world is magnificent, Cassia. I am glad to have had the chance to see it."

f98906c1-93d7-4062-b967-e11687a8804e.Text: "I've had it with your oddities and uncontrollable powers! Stay away from me."

7d923d25-8e37-4f9d-b588-e0ae00ac7b40.Text: "Yes, of course... All I need to do is suppress your powers with mine before even more harm comes to you. Please... please let me do this."

91f16416-5fe6-4fc0-8a19-a05a8aee4dcc.Text: "It's... It's all because of me! When I bathed you in my Navigator's gaze, the energies of the Immaterium did not destroy you, but they did somehow affect you. And now... Oh, God-Emperor, what do I do now?" {n}A noose of pale yellow tightens around Cassia's throat, and erratic flashes of red and dark blue whirl around her head.{/n}

51c79598-9076-46cf-b48c-c948593505a6.Text: {n}As your lips touch, the air around you lights up with cascades of golden and pink sparks until a crimson haze eventually separates the world from you and Cassia. You breathe in her scent, and your hues merge together, raining down multicoloured mosaics of barely contained emotions.{/n}

c726a4df-a193-42d0-997b-6acf7f6d6075.Text: "{name}, what's wrong?" {n}Cassia leans closer, and her figure becomes swathed in bands of vivid hues. Pink, dark maroon, orange, bright blue... You see Cassia's colours sparkle like gemstones, and the sight takes your breath away.{/n}

77771910-641c-4e46-b56e-f25745f36561.Text: "This is... mesmerising. I can see the colours of your soul, just as you can see mine."

35ffdf4b-6ddc-45bd-809f-fd5031d1d726.Text: [Embrace Cassia and kiss her] "I do not revile this power, nor do I revile you."

4bed161d-4d21-41d5-bc99-127d307896b8.Text: "My eyes... I can see the colours that you see!"

ca3e671d-648a-4163-a54b-03715ac01bea.Text: "I think I can now see people's emotions too. It is quite all right, I can handle this myself."

a25f1e87-a84f-4018-8ed4-65245bd05a97.Text: {n}Cassia carefully places her cold hands around your face, her claws slightly digging into your skin at the temples.{/n} "Trust me, and never stop looking at me." {n}You focus on the two softly glittering rubies on Cassia's face. A moment later, you feel her will consume your being, all your emotions and worries. What remains is nothing — and this nothing dissolves the dimming colours of the surrounding world, Commorragh's turbulent flashes, and the peaceful silvery glow around Cassia's slender figure.{/n}

7e29456a-61a5-4066-97c4-a44a6f118358.Text: {n}Another lancing pain in your head knocks you off your feet, and you barely manage to plant your hands on the floor before your vision is completely obscured by a blanket of colours. Slowly, the world re-forms around you, and nightmarish Commorragh erupts in the vivid splashes of another's emotions.{/n}

078dedad-2406-434b-a6f3-2626f1d54cfe.Text: {n}Cassia steps back fearfully, hugging herself and avoiding your gaze.{/n} "Forgive me... Please, forgive me, {name}. I... truly did not mean you any harm."

52cf6807-3ce1-4d3c-b3df-dc74643fb297.Text: "I..." {n}Cassia blinks with a dazed expression, her eyes darting frantically.{/n} "It's... It's all because of me! When I bathed you in my Navigator's gaze, the energies of the Immaterium did not destroy you, but they did somehow affect you. And now... God-Emperor preserve you, what do I do now?" {n}The colours are swimming before your eyes, and you are hit by another wave of pain.{/n}

70989fad-5c7f-407e-98a7-7697782fe30f.Text: "Do you... see it too?" {n}Cassia awkwardly pulls away from you, and crimson embarrassment drapes her shoulders like a gauze shawl. Then it melts away, and you are released from the ripples of this unnatural power. You do not even notice the moment when the pain and fear vanish, and somehow, you are confident that this sensation will not be nearly as difficult to bear next time. And that there definitely will be a next time.{/n}

c7e63c69-00fd-41e5-9615-59abccc61e90.Text: {n}You breathe in her scent, and your hues merge together, raining down multicoloured mosaics of barely contained emotions.{/n} "Please, no more! I cannot breathe... I fear I may faint..." {n}Cassia awkwardly pulls away from you, and crimson embarrassment drapes her shoulders like a gauze shawl. Then it melts away, and you are released from the ripples of this unnatural power. You do not even notice the moment when the pain and fear vanish, but you can feel that this is not the last time you will experience this sensation.{/n}

c3aa1abe-e91a-41a5-9905-09dbfe8b05ed.Text: "I can only hope that things will stay that way." {n}Cassia lowers her head guiltily, not daring to look at you.{/n}

905c09aa-6b70-4544-8f94-b73abc55e058.Text: "Please, if... something like this ever happens to you again, please, tell me right away. I will help, I will ease your pain! Even though I don't quite understand how my powers spread to you, all I know is that I cannot bear to see you suffer. For now... please get some rest."

8fe3646b-a3b8-4bd9-bed9-eedf466b2c66.Text: "{name}, do you feel any better? Is there anything else I can do for you?" {n}Cassia's face looks even paler than before. You see an expression of worry — a natural human emotion without any vibrant facets or accompanying headaches.{/n}

43a51f43-d627-4ca3-b32f-8b3f4165980e.Text: "And I am glad to have become part of yours." {n}Cassia smiles warmly, but her gaze quickly darkens.{/n}

ef0e6df6-3285-472a-8bcf-3d302fc7c2f9.Text: "{name}, can you hear me?" {n}Cassia's clear voice echoes inside your head, the veins at your temples are pulsating, and a burning hot drop of blood falls into your hand.{/n} "Your nose is bleeding! Here, use my handkercher!" {n}She helps you up and looks into your eyes nervously. A dark green halo shines around her head. "She is worried," you suddenly realise with clarity.{/n}

e00ee701-15f9-4ace-975d-2c26ffa0115a.Text: {n}Cassia freezes, startled by your touch, and your lips join together in a bittersweet kiss that tastes of blood and tears. You see confusion in her wide-open eyes, but then her body relaxes and her eyes close along with her Navigator's eye. She reciprocates slowly, uncertainly, gently... and as she does, the air around you flares with cascades of golden and pink sparks until a crimson haze eventually separates the world from the two of you.{/n}

6dfc335f-4267-46f3-ba25-524e62dbc588.Text: {n}You shut your eyes and try to focus, but the approaching nausea and the blood that trickles from your eyes instead of tears are too distracting. Frustrated, you open your eyes again, and a new torrent of colour crashes against your mind, forcing you to empty your stomach.{/n}

e82a833a-be4f-472b-bc16-be6e8655573c.Text: {n}You close your eyes and summon your strength, trying hard to ignore the approaching nausea and the blood that trickles from your eyes instead of tears. You grit your teeth and drive away all thoughts of the colours that have flooded your head and of the experience of standing in the gaze of the Navigator's eye. Eventually, the unseen clamp on your mind releases, and the pain slowly dissipates along with the strange power.{/n}

40b11b5c-797a-455a-962b-7dba28dcf766.Text: "Alas, a title alone is not enough to hold everyone's attention all of the time."

1f1ecd28-4ef8-422a-baa6-9bc2ee713a49.Text: "The events that took place on Eurac V must have shaken you greatly. Are you well?"

b6f1486b-756c-4b51-8b06-ad19d65096f8.Text: [Point at the book in Cassia's hands] "I see you are fond of reading."

698c4245-7749-4d81-b569-f9cd69989932.Text: "I hope that you have had ample time to calm yourself and your powers."

1553a23a-506e-4bba-b4d8-a18e0ab1ac9f.Text: "It pleases me to see you adjusting to life aboard the ship."

0ea74eb5-a4df-4f46-9e7e-d6196bda2bb9.Text: "Perhaps my people did not wish to disturb you."

9953c809-656c-46c9-9d74-137041b801f1.Text: "I believe this conversation has reached its natural conclusion."

c2f96ce7-acc2-4907-8533-28eb0007891e.Text: "It is indeed difficult for me to feel empathy for a mutant. However, the crew's well-being hinges on that of its Navigator."

499aeb53-6bfb-42f3-93ad-279c694cb8f0.Text: "What I find childish is your manner of addressing me as if I were your friend and your mistaken belief that anyone here would be interested in hearing about your emotional turmoil."

86635a1c-7109-4f31-87f1-a4ba576dbe71.Text: "I understand what you are going through. My own life was turned upside down not too long ago."

3214aae2-701d-4c11-9220-58765992e2de.Text: "I am not in the habit of finding amusement at the expense of my people. Just remember to keep your emotions in check."

47aa8b7f-b358-48a1-b6af-7a51af2c67b0.Text: "I would rather we find amusement elsewhere... perhaps in the privacy of my chambers?"

8b067a88-33ca-4c41-acce-677dabb2eede.Text: "What do you think you are doing here? I did not give you permission to leave the bridge."

adfb4011-f9b9-4cdb-9c5a-afb489be35f0.Text: "Your only attendant is your valet from Eurac V. Do my servants not measure up to your standards?"

4cd14fca-7cf7-4749-846b-0d372e7441b5.Text: "Is it so bad that we are enjoying each other's company? Or would you prefer to proceed straight to my chambers?"

4fa10f67-7f2b-44aa-9281-ab750c2babf3.Text: "I am afraid I must return to my duties."

2872076e-f606-4233-84d1-8fa3fcf888d7.Text: "You have nothing to apologise for. Human emotions are natural, be they good or bad. And it is just as natural to share them with others."

53205d42-cf47-4b15-b2ee-8963a362c528.Text: "I am beginning to think, Lady Cassia, that the feelings I have for you are far more complicated than common sympathy."

f2e101ea-41f9-4edb-adc2-6b2e7ecda523.Text: "Are you satisfied with your new attendants?"

8da96782-d6d6-458a-abe3-13255a17c745.Text: "Quite right. So I would ask that you mind what you say from now on."

34f9aff1-bdd6-46eb-9a42-9660c3bf7dd6.Text: "If I may be so bold as to presume, my subjects must have found themselves overcome by your rare beauty. As I have."

30fa6137-7ae0-4e72-b6eb-f9318ccf67e1.Text: "I do not tolerate idlers on this ship, and my officers know it well."

4a3bee92-2111-41e8-abd9-d31058c7a6c4.Text: {n}Cassia blinks in surprise, her eyelashes fluttering, and a delicate blush suffuses her cheeks.{/n} "Words like that, Lord Captain, could easily be misconstrued. You should familiarise yourself with some of the works in your library to learn the appropriate manner of conversing with a lady."

df6fd1de-8718-42bd-b7ae-c01e61c9f6c2.Text: "I would not dare to make fun of a lady's feelings, especially not one who has captivated me since I first set eyes on her."

c3d644b9-d05a-43b5-b529-c7b98f6e8101.Text: {n}Cassia frowns, and her cheeks turn even paler than usual.{/n} "Lord Captain, what do you think you are doing? Saying such a thing to someone with whom you are barely acquainted? It is... outrageous. It's obscene. You should better familiarise yourself with some of the works in your library to learn how one ought to behave around a lady."

0ea22786-8275-428e-b337-957d206e33ef.Text: {n}The Lady Navigator is engrossed in perusing the dusty tomes, which appear to have been neglected by the other officers, be it because of sloth or dullness of mind. When you walk closer, Cassia looks up at you, starts, and hides a weathered book behind her back.{/n} "Lord Captain? My apologies, I... I did not notice your entrance."

5ac6e843-1c21-4e97-9c34-4f4f93d1d1ca.Text: "I was not aware that a Navigator of my station required such permission. I shall henceforth be more... astute in following the particular regulations of your ship." {n}Cassia's reproachful gaze shifts away from you as she continues to hold her chin high with dignity.{/n} "I shall burden you with my presence no longer."

6ca6a97c-52b4-4527-aa44-533734d3022b.Text: "Or because my presence offends them." {n}With an expression of courteous aloofness on her face, Cassia offers you a curt nod.{/n} "Then I must take my leave as well. I am due to inspect the Sanctum Navis after the communion ritual and prepare the chamber for the upcoming warp jump. Thank you for your company, {name}."

b723b1aa-d959-4733-9e27-ea6e504ecfc7.Text: "No, no, it is not that at all, Lord Captain." {n}She nods genially to her taciturn servant.{/n} "It is just that Uve is quite capable of carrying out his duties by himself. He is well accustomed to my... my whims and preferences."

9b21e432-3622-43bb-9efa-fc3c95fb5c4e.Text: "There are people on this ship who are far more impulsive and dangerous to others. And far less devoted to the God-Emperor than a herald of the Navis Nobilite." {n}Cassia tosses her head back and straightens.{/n} "But I did not need your words to see the shades of umber unease that whirl around your subjects whenever I am near. Were I not acquainted with such a reaction... I could have found their behaviour and your question just now insulting."

058ce8b2-61ac-400a-b075-2b3024aa04b9.Text: "Compared to Eurac V, your ship is a boundless world of unfamiliar hues. And yet the abundance of bright colours can at times be wearisome on the eyes. The bridge and the decks are so... clamorous. In my search for a place of quiet, I was fortunate to come upon this islet of serenity filled with rare tomes and practically devoid of colour."

27f05874-fec8-4270-8600-e6523d4c8c68.Text: "Oh, this..." {n}Cassia carefully shows you the book, which turns out to be a collection of works by the Cadian naval commander and poet Aelius Quent.{/n} "I found this fascinating read on one of the shelves, and I must say it has caught my eye — its every chapter is written in verse. I find it so... beautiful and enrapturing!"

565d1c3b-328f-43d1-a4ea-c7e2023b0ee7.Text: {n}After an awkward silence, Cassia frowns and purses her lips.{/n} "Lord Captain, would you kindly explain to me why you are pestering me with these questions? Enquiring about my mood and my needs, showing an interest in the books I am enjoying? You are behaving as if you possessed a shred of fellow feeling for one such as I!"

f410b718-abed-4027-a8c1-2d6376eb512a.Text: {n}Cassia cringes ever so slightly, adjusts the adornment on her forehead, then awkwardly hides her clawed fingers in the folds of her clothes. The unnatural appearance of Navigators often becomes the topic of gossip among lowly servants and officers alike. It is clear that she does not feel comfortable aboard a ship teeming with new people.{/n}

e3f4c347-8bbf-4a71-961d-0db162bbf899.Text: {n}Struggling to maintain an expression of polite indifference, Cassia covers her burning face and swiftly exits the room.{/n}

0c738185-269d-42b0-98b6-c99cf40962c0.Text: "Your servants are somewhat sluggish when it comes to attending a noblewoman of the Navis Nobilite, but they are quite tolerable. Thank you for your concern."

a558b510-625b-4f5c-88ac-b6f4a484f04e.Text: {n}Her answer is too mannerly to be genuine and too vague for you to perceive the truth behind it.{/n}

25d4d802-1948-4de4-9470-006303065959.Text: "I... I did not..." {n}A blush of embarrassment tinges her pallid features, but she regains her composure quickly.{/n} "Please forgive me this regrettable lapse, Lord Captain. There are times when books sweep me up, and I lose myself in their pages and forget about the world's existence. Was there something you required of me?"

b0f57cba-f914-482d-b180-9c3f1f38eb63.Text: {n}Cassia flinches, but her face remains impenetrable.{/n} "I was merely trying to show proper decorum and make conversation. But you are right, {name}, in saying that the word 'friend' cannot possibly apply here. In any case, this conversation is beginning to drag on. I must excuse myself — there are matters that require my attention in the Sanctum Navis." {n}With an expression of courteous aloofness on her face, Cassia turns away and leaves the room without dignifying you with another look.{/n}

9e844340-31ec-46ef-b5d6-45b3ba434546.Text: "Indeed? I... I did not know. That is to say, I could not have known, as it is the first time we are speaking in a circumstance so..." {n}She glances around the room, growing somewhat sheepish.{/n} "...private. My word, when I found this place, it was so full of officers. Why did they all leave?"

349c434c-aa86-4fcf-8d5b-cef5ad9b8635.Text: "Of your... whom? Ah, I see. You must already consider me part of your crew. Yes. Yes, of course, I... I shall strive to live up to your expectations, Lord Captain." {n}With an expression of courteous aloofness on her face, Cassia offers you a curt nod.{/n} "And now I must excuse myself, for there are matters that I must see to in the Sanctum Navis."

c6f7fa07-ccea-4d49-85c4-40c2ebf77e2e.Text: "One should not underestimate the Navigators of House Orsellio, Lord Captain. Like a shawl of pale smoke, a faint malaise hangs upon my shoulders, but it will not be the slightest hindrance to my duty to Humanity. And my duty to you." {n}Cassia's response is reserved and pointedly decorous, clearly intended to create a distance between you.{/n}

b265c18b-6e58-4ba7-bca0-3f9746443ec0.Text: {n}Cassia thinks for a moment and nods curtly.{/n} "Then I must take my leave as well. I am due to inspect the Sanctum Navis after the communion ritual and prepare the chamber for the upcoming warp jump. Thank you for your company, {name}."

64156c9a-2515-42ca-80c3-7e2f429083fd.Text: {n}Cassia cringes ever so slightly, adjusts the adornment on her forehead, then awkwardly hides her clawed fingers in the folds of her clothes. The unnatural appearance of Navigators often becomes the topic of gossip among lowly servants and officers alike. It is unsurprising, then, that Cassia prefers the company of one who is used to how she looks.{/n}

78a6ea6a-29b6-40b7-934f-aeeac913ef71.Text: {n}Frightened by her own words, Cassia covers her mouth, pales, blushes, then pales again, and hides her face behind the cascade of her snow-white hair.{/n} "I... beg your pardon, Lord Captain. That was no way for a Navigator to conduct herself."

1f306f19-6857-4ca3-a368-93466762b52c.Text: "At the same time, I find myself overwhelmed with new excitement and... anticipation. At last, I have set foot outside my familiar walls and into a world that I have only seen before in the pages of books. Your ship alone is a treasure trove of remarkable artefacts and curiosities. And just imagine the things that await beyond! But... my delight must seem childish to you, surely? In your heart, you must be finding all this quite amusing."

4d1e6c5d-76ab-4d68-bfb0-99655396ad34.Text: "Yes, I... I understand. I offer you my apologies once more." {n}Cassia covers her burning face and swiftly exits the room.{/n}

b92e93eb-c1a8-47f5-abcf-69c4b86d7cdb.Text: {n}The primness of her expression cracks, revealing a great weariness beneath.{/n} "Please forgive me, {name}. I cannot even understand myself right now. Your words and attention have reminded me of life on the station. Of Theobald and Felek. I do not understand... They were merely the Keepers of Eurac V, so why do memories of those two make me feel a strange heaviness... here?" {n}She places a hand on her breastplate.{/n}

88d83c80-b213-4756-8842-241e7cb91487.Text: {n}Struggling to maintain an expression of polite indifference, Cassia turns on her heel and swiftly exits the room.{/n}

85c8468d-80cb-4988-9e12-2fef824f3966.Text: "Eurac V had a vast archive of its own, of course, although most of the works within had to do with scholarly disciplines of some sort or another. Only in my sparse moments of respite was I allowed to escape into the pages of more embellished works." {n}Cassia gently brushes the dust off the cover with her thin, clawed hand, her eyes filled with longing after reminiscing about her lost home.{/n}

848b3a15-139c-4ae2-a898-06caa7dbd33c.Text: "Lord Captain?" {n}Cassia looks up in surprise, her ruby eyes staring at what she sees behind you.{/n} "So many colourful sparks are flaring to life and dimming all around you. It is a veritable ocean of emotions! There are so many of them that I can barely see the pure-white sincerity of your words."

c33b1df8-2920-4cc6-a440-d92bf59e3d5f.Text:
"If so... please allow me to excuse myself as well."
{n}With an expression of courteous aloofness on her face, Cassia offers you a curt nod and leaves the room.{/n}

a444eee4-5134-4419-8f02-8d7a7872b7b9.Text: [Lean close to him] "Trying to play the buttoned-up Interrogator again after what happened in Commorragh? It won't work."

26484e67-0b94-4d88-a436-0cb8fca9997e.Text: "You're right. It's time to end this."

de705ee6-5086-4ad3-be29-985ba0867f2a.Text: "I insist on overly close contact, Master van Calox."

376b01e4-7e83-417d-8659-4d5114525295.Text: "The Lord Captain believes that Master van Calox has had insufficiently close contact with my person. Why don't we remedy that in a more private setting — right now?"

5160ce8f-269e-489a-b9ba-e44abd5cef42.Text: "Are you trying to end things with me?"

e92f49b5-c063-4696-9828-c8dcdd71b734.Text: "When we were in Commorragh... when we were... together..." {n}Heinrix hesitates.{/n} "I wasn't thinking rationally. I was putting my own desires ahead of my duty. I suppose I was counting on never getting out of that place alive."

37007754-b145-40f0-9047-2a2f1db68e05.Text: "When we were in Commorragh... I allowed myself to get carried away. That place, it affected us all, and..." {n}Heinrix takes a breath.{/n}

23ea7f93-9691-4dee-9c8c-cdf694568da3.Text: "With your permission, I think we should continue this conversation in your study. I only have one or two questions." {n}The Interrogator's tone brooks no argument.{/n}

6d1891c1-53b5-4b92-bbb2-83bce14dd6b9.Text: "What I'm trying to say is... if the Lord Captain believes that overly close contact with an agent of the Inquisition will have a detrimental effect on her reputation and jeopardise her image as the God-Emperor's chosen, I will respectfully accept her decision."

ded4154a-e235-4b4e-a7ef-618282355996.Text: "No!" {n}Heinrix cuts himself off before continuing in a quieter voice,{/n} "But I am aware that with Commorragh behind us, passions have cooled, heads have cleared — continuing this may not be... what you want."

52e4c8d6-a34e-4d13-952b-b6e5969aeb76.Text: {n}Heinrix nods slowly, at pains to conceal his bitter disappointment.{/n} "Of course. Thank you for your answer, Lord Captain."

abb08f73-b02c-4163-be7b-8edc42d9ca7a.Text: {n}Heinrix's face brightens.{/n} "Thank you for your answer, Lord Captain. I hope we will find a time soon to discuss it... in a more private setting."

7fb7e3c3-b0a0-4ddb-bc0d-9890e788afd7.Text: {n}Heinrix's eyes fill with relief — and heat.{/n} "It... would be my pleasure to accompany you, Lord Captain."

d3cb545b-4972-4097-947c-bcba765a0161.Text: {n}Heinrix struggles to maintain his grave expression.{/n} "What of it?"

813e8e94-5188-4549-b84a-0028dc6fae64.Text: "Now that we've gone over the board setup and the basics of play, we can move on to openings... next time. Thank you for your time and attention, {name}."

f0d6ea9b-6da1-455b-b5b6-bce4e5c6c0b4.Text: "You're picking things up remarkably quickly. You must really enjoy the game!"

37ae59be-96c6-4b97-9970-a1fab7bfc58e.Text: "You have grasped next to every nuance of this game that I know. It won't be long before you start beating me, I suspect."

b70f5932-3f14-44c5-855a-f90b09521086.Text: "An excellent game. Thank you for this! I eagerly await our next opportunity to face off on the board."

d3d712b6-6dd1-4a8c-b8d3-06c9e6bd0257.Text: "Wait, how long were we playing? I completely lose track of time when we're in here."

27df8a7a-c10f-4e4c-85c8-61c4fb018019.Text: "Let's go with a different set of pieces next time. I want to see how you will fare then..."

4da2a335-03f5-4840-a17d-45f83661c309.Text: "I think that's enough learning. It's time we started playing in earnest — no holding back and no allowances for lack of experience."

543c9020-474e-4e31-872d-e7f77dca9a67.Text: "I wish I could stay here with you for a while longer. Even just an hour..."

ae570749-4248-4b5e-afe7-86f6a80db716.Text: "You drive me insane. Your every look, your every touch..."

32044c49-dc82-43f4-b15f-2fd23fc95845.Text: "We haven't even parted yet, and I already miss you and your touch..."

5c7abd25-edc8-4bec-b636-b04675cc3f74.Text: "Blast it... Now I won't be able to think about anything but you for the rest of the day..."

75ccf4e0-1fa5-48b4-8ee1-fb04596be01d.Text: "This has felt like an interrogation rather than a conversation for a while now."

5172c344-1fb1-4ffe-983d-935df35c43e4.Text: "Let's talk about what interests you instead."

11b1000e-7a0d-4ab9-a24b-fc373bda8412.Text: "You can relate, of course. Your life once changed beyond recognition as well."

b2d949f7-4ae0-4953-b623-a31891a7f7a7.Text: "To be honest, I am thrilled with my new life."

7b80edc4-2290-4cfd-b715-64dc5c40f964.Text: "Being Rogue Trader has its advantages. For instance, I can torment a servant of the Holy Inquisition with impunity."

75bca9e7-610a-4ff6-859f-434ad41e4626.Text: "Why don't we discuss the Holy Inquisition's plans in the Koronus Expanse? That is a light, undemanding topic."

8670e87a-061f-4f56-8369-385e5dacda25.Text: "Let's talk about your romantic preferences. It's always a stimulating topic, don't you find?"

98e4c410-4abe-419f-9a56-582d8fb23954.Text: "I have never understood this strange pastime."

2a602b4e-9610-4d5e-91a4-bd780c014fa0.Text: "You are boring me, Master van Calox. Let's end our conversation here."

3a932dd6-3e4d-4d21-93bd-8bc70ecb49fc.Text: "Perhaps it would be easier to find common ground over a game of regicide."

ff88761d-cb52-4ac3-97be-3d8219b31de7.Text: [Smile] "I recall your colourful metaphor involving amasec and cheese."

ba113e75-997d-4a65-9b98-3302a23f0c3d.Text: "Why are you apologising? For the first time in this entire conversation, you did something you actually wanted to do."

3f15cf80-164f-4cdc-a59c-2e1a1574d6c5.Text: "I am pleased to see at least a hint of passion in you at last."

a23b8681-b8b0-4992-ac33-e4bb9cd249e0.Text: "I suppose it really is time to end our conversation."

e179ed81-6f27-4964-8ef7-023420c13c22.Text: [Return his look] "I am not talking about fleeting dalliances."

e51aa3ec-b3f6-4034-8b2d-84eda6ff3c8c.Text: "You dare praise the qualities of other women in my presence?"

08c0a4b9-9827-4329-b2a7-aa36a89c0416.Text: "You have, and I do not wish to waste any more of it on you."

9e223609-cb59-4614-9490-cee4667cff16.Text: "What you are saying is that this laboured conversation was a pretext for studying me?"

9b8b0748-8056-4527-870f-49c088abbcf0.Text: "Are you talking about the regicide board? The game on the board isn't mine."

e174be4b-e688-412e-bcb8-6cc38390d020.Text: "I don't know how to play regicide. But I'm confident that you will make a fine teacher."

9a43354a-5a70-4fe2-bc17-e882c6aba705.Text: "I know how to play regicide. Perhaps we could talk over a game from time to time."

f43cc372-4d24-4ec4-8556-bf95a499ee56.Text: "I have much more exciting ideas about how we can spend our time together. But regicide sounds good as well."

8babfe39-0d88-4130-9d17-7ddc0c792629.Text: "I do not think a Black Ship is an acceptable environment for a child."

ca3ae388-3721-4419-b275-90e77f4a4fa7.Text: "Really? In that case, I shall choose the next topic, if you don't mind."

41624380-f1fc-41ab-bc5a-a5a447913855.Text: {n}You spend a couple of hours in leisurely conversation with Heinrix van Calox. All the while, you cannot shake the feeling that the Interrogator's questions are in pursuit of some goal other than simply sustaining the genteel chitchat. When the general topics at last are exhausted, an awkward pause hangs in the air between you.{/n}

b339d9e4-ec1a-4a8e-9033-d8d27e4ad91d.Text: {n}Heinrix says nothing for a moment, then:{/n} "Speaking of surroundings, I would like to ask you about something that caught my attention."

f4038e99-d738-45ee-8fa4-7f6a3b0ca277.Text: {n}The Interrogator's eyes narrow.{/n} "Me? Hmm. Well... there is one thing that interests me."

ad6c8540-2aad-4f2d-a5e2-5c8ee4253ebf.Text: {n}The Interrogator glances at the desk piled high with papers.{/n} "I suppose the news of your inheritance of the Sacred Warrant came as a complete surprise to you. Abelard mentioned searching for heirs once... and how some of them felt about their lives changing forever. Not all of them fully understood the duty they were taking on." {n}Van Calox says this in a deadpan voice, and you cannot tell if this apparent indifference is real or feigned.{/n}

51c1b399-f086-4673-a2dc-8974d14dbbd9.Text: "What? What kind of a question is that? I don't place any importance on such trivial things... Red? Yes, I suppose my favourite colour would be red."

ae3fb97d-c52a-42b7-8524-283843c9c39a.Text: {n}Heinrix looks at you in polite bewilderment.{/n} "I place no great importance on the minutiae of my daily life."

f3a4a290-ac89-4923-ac44-1c7d0d9a891b.Text: "If you gained satisfaction in serving the God-Emperor in your former position, then now you merely have greater opportunities to demonstrate your potential."

2c1d8df2-e210-4913-8dbf-6106c1495153.Text: {n}The Interrogator is silent for a few moments.{/n} "True. But that was a long time ago, and I was still a child. Children quickly adapt to new circumstances and environments."

ab0d969d-3f54-4121-8f8c-09c28bea663f.Text: "Driven, inquisitive people rejoice when they are given the chance to reach their full potential in service to the God-Emperor."

35d61b4e-4a3e-4459-88b2-9e3d9c44ed00.Text: {n}Heinrix stares at you with narrowed eyes.{/n} "A portion of impudence must be inherited along with the Sacred Warrant, I see. You are very sure of your untouchability, {name}, aren't you?"

0d1dd282-e6d5-4f80-b49e-0107588c5992.Text: "A secret?" {n}Heinrix thinks.{/n} "Well... I was not completely candid with your earlier. About when my life changed... I wasn't so young that I wasn't troubled by thoughts of what could have been. Sometimes I dream about training on my family's Knight. Sometimes I miss my sisters. Sometimes I wish I had been spared the psyker's curse. Sometimes I try too hard to appear impervious to regret and pain."

c993b9ae-017d-4c87-97e2-1e733c52819c.Text: "That is a very strange question, don't you think? A secret... You already know more than enough about me, {name}."

4308d89d-a345-430e-b4a8-053941dc97e1.Text: "A long time ago, I once had a fleeting romance with a baroness on Narvellon 19 in the Calixis Sector. Raven hair, olive skin, and a fiery temperament. I suppose that's the combination I like." {n}The Interrogator's eyes narrow ever so slightly, as though he is anticipating your reaction.{/n}

41ffdfdd-f9b3-41b0-b2ea-847c21665c8e.Text: "The Silvermark Flank Opening. Why use it in the middlegame?"

7ebaa976-e9e4-4aff-84ae-d10afe9e2825.Text: "Oh, yes." {n}Heinrix smiles wistfully.{/n} "Or rather, I used to play back when I had an opponent. I usually lost, but regicide is one of the few domains where failure carries no consequences, except the chance to get better. And it was a very, very long time ago. If you'll permit me..."

abc552f1-dd96-4b18-927f-44b3d2242a9f.Text: "Really? That's a pity..." {n}Heinrix makes a pensive "hmm" sound as he studies the positions on the board.{/n}

48184097-a109-4dfa-95c2-d0c95dd8d5a3.Text: "I've got it. The Calixian Prong with a diversionary sacrifice, drawing the opponent into zugzwang. Elegant, very elegant." {n}Pleased to have unravelled the mystery, the smiling Interrogator looks up at you and, upon seeing your expression, coughs and looks away.{/n} "Apologies. I got carried away."

289be766-7454-4d3f-9f0f-3a1f27858071.Text: {n}Heinrix inclines his head.{/n} "Very well. I will not detain you any longer. Thank you for your time, and I apologise if you found my company tedious."

7600c31c-af28-46eb-8af6-18631170693a.Text: {n}Heinrix bites his nail in thought, his eyes not leaving the board. Then he reaches out and cautiously moves a piece. Then another two pieces. And another two. All of his attention is absorbed in rearranging the pieces on the board.{/n}

4958037e-4ef8-4e30-a62c-c196b1838d0c.Text: {n}Heinrix looks at you.{/n} "Perhaps? If you're offering..."

cc4b7f71-acf1-49ef-90e0-e184ddbedd5a.Text: {n}Heinrix shifts awkwardly.{/n} "I did? Hmm. Interesting observation."

eed9abc5-6202-4b93-af9d-59b4fc68bc27.Text: "Your memory is excellent... I suppose you've caught me there. Such extravagances are not always available when I travel to different worlds in the course of my duties, so I value the moments when I can enjoy them."

366932d1-e860-4688-94a6-15b0da662b39.Text: "What?" {n}Heinrix stares at you in alarm. You feel the room grow colder, but perhaps your mind is playing tricks on you.{/n}

9bb5a7c4-671e-4931-8a60-27878157b5f1.Text: "Now I feel as if I am being interrogated. Asking about how you are dealing with your radically altered circumstances is far less invasive than this question."

239ccbe2-4d31-4dad-8cc8-768068adf5ac.Text: "Forgive me, but it seems your talent for small talk is scarcely better than mine. And besides, you already know the Inquisition's plans where I am concerned — to accompany you."

589837b8-ecf0-43fb-b7dd-d09482e86a41.Text: {n}Heinrix's face breaks into a feigned sad smile without an iota of genuine compassion.{/n} "I'm sorry if my unseemly anecdotes upset you, Your Ladyship. Shall we talk about something else?"

6457922f-6570-4336-bebf-796bb3ef4d24.Text: "The nature of my duties does not permit me anything more than that." {n}You can almost see the ice forming in his eyes at these words.{/n} "If we've exhausted this topic... let's return to my question."

e35fd358-bf1b-42e9-bd7b-0cc75602315e.Text: {n}Heinrix laughs a little, as though trying to hide behind humour.{/n} "Of all the secrets in my keeping, that is the least dangerous."

783cb627-77ca-4115-85c6-f4c71814e877.Text: {n}Heinrix hesitates. Then he leans slightly toward you and says in a low voice,{/n} "You seem to always say what you are thinking, no matter how inappropriate or risky it may be to do so. No one else is so reckless as to act like that in my presence. Talking to you, {name}, is like a breath of fresh air."

8da296fe-b90a-4e32-a6d8-0d6c5682fdb3.Text: {n}Heinrix hesitates for a few moments, then he steps toward you and takes your hand in his.{/n} "Thank you for this conversation. You ask very interesting questions — not the ones I am used to." {n}He brings your hand to his lips and gently releases it.{/n} "I hope we will find another opportunity to talk."

5311d21e-7918-4b8d-b46d-6a1735d0dd24.Text: {n}When the Interrogator straightens and looks at you, you notice an unusual detail for the first time — his eyes are different colours. With a nod, he steps away and heads for the door.{/n}

a45fb304-7ee3-441c-8720-dbc2817b8c3c.Text: {n}Discomfited, Heinrix clears his throat.{/n} "I am just trying to make conversation, {name}. To find out what interests you and what your life is like. Nothing more."

e73c443c-3121-4fa0-b0b5-866ff5a9aa81.Text: {n}The vox on your desk buzzes to life and you both jump. Heinrix inclines his head.{/n} "You are wanted. And I have taken up enough of your time..."

a15312d3-b282-4a64-bdc8-92d3110be9da.Text: "No. Just deferring to your duty, Lord Captain."

1aa8c1ee-e36a-4374-abe3-0cdfaf829090.Text: "You have made yourself quite clear, Lord Captain. Thank you for the conversation."

ff1c0fb6-d2cf-42ad-87df-09e4c9a2a948.Text: "In that case, I must leave you to your duties."

cd9d8364-68a4-4d59-bfb1-46dce9985ca4.Text: "That... isn't what I said." {n}Heinrix looks down with a laugh.{/n} "I'm not looking for heresy or deviations from the Imperial Creed. I'm... trying to have a conversation. To learn about your life and what interests you. You can judge how well it's going for yourself."

ab7a03ad-9b47-45a6-b8bc-40e0163f2a61.Text: "The regicide game. As soon as we came in, I noticed the combination and I couldn't help wondering about the thinking behind white's strategy... But your face tells me this game is another thing left over from Lady Theodora's time."

d422133b-c922-461b-bcc1-45c87e6ee71f.Text: "Ah! That's a shame. I noticed the combination as soon as we came in, and I've been eager to ask about the thinking behind white's strategy..."

e10c7b0e-ac26-43e0-9e22-8f1afa4631bf.Text: {n}Heinrix lapses into silence as he intently studies the pieces on the board. You see his jaw relax, and a spark of life kindles in his eyes.{/n}

29b95198-bf23-4dbe-a947-e7445ae85074.Text: {n}Heinrix runs a hand through his hair.{/n} "You're right. I haven't been able to break out of my usual role — asking targeted questions and then just sitting back and listening. My work leaves no room for personal desires, and I rarely even ask myself what I want. This game, it distracted me from... me."

84d57c98-720c-4b82-9f20-701e1ad956fc.Text: {n}Heinrix's face brightens.{/n} "It would be my great pleasure, {name}. I may not know as many tricks and combinations as the person who once taught me, but I can introduce you to the basics—"

67275744-d282-4992-b77e-e5a69dd2e18a.Text: {n}Heinrix's face brightens.{/n} "I will gladly join you in a game. Back when I had an opponent, I spent all my free time at the board and—"

d324c36c-49f4-4e2e-89c7-ed622912a557.Text: "Your politeness conceals the truth, {name}. But thank you for trying to spare my—"

83583c7d-a80e-4cce-9ece-f5644a1941bf.Text: {n}Heinrix's lips tremble, from suppressing either a smile or a grimace.{/n} "I would gladly join you in a game—"

bfff079f-eb07-45ac-98fe-141beeea9cbe.Text: "It was their duty to do so. I was no longer suitable to become a pilot. I was a disgrace to my entire line. The way they treated me... I struggle to condemn them for it — they had spent years and years of rituals and training on me, burnishing a rotten apple."

85566a9a-c4bc-4c28-9dbf-bd8fd09cf866.Text: "It is an acceptable environment for a psyker who cannot control his powers."

8dd8573b-0b88-4808-965f-6edf354b92be.Text: {n}Heinrix looks at you, intrigued.{/n} "Be my guest. And what do you want to talk about?"
