4f62a25d-35c7-4a16-a6ed-3c12b315c7ea.Text: [Kill Mercy] "It would be a mistake to let you live."

a426e574-3335-4f04-a448-2132019c9331.Text: "The smug bastard finally shuts up. Why is everyone so terrified of you? I can't see it."

ea94173f-cff9-4f88-aba0-49b9c91bd979.Text: "Jae, this one needs to die. See to it."

aecc58f0-9812-4d2d-885c-ae6f14daac89.Text: "Live. But do not ever let me see your face again."

8e84248c-1807-461d-86a6-3b3c322d8f41.Text: "Perhaps one of the senior traders wishes to say their piece? Or is he the only one who gets to speak around here?"

be4e0cee-c219-496e-8c1f-eafe5757e9f8.Text: "I do believe we can consider this meeting closed."

12d83e99-471c-40ca-b0ad-81286002c4d6.Text: [Strike him again] "I did not hear your answer. Disappear from Jae's life."

a79f71f9-9f71-41b0-808d-dd601eec0a32.Text: "You still see Jae as the girl who needed your protection. Forget that girl, she is a different person now."

aa854e7e-5395-4f6a-9984-62403ae13dc1.Text: "I am certain that Jae's management of Falco's assets will be more profitable for the Kasballica."

7bb02980-9455-445d-86ac-3dd04373e564.Text: "Jae, perhaps you have an argument to support your claim?"

eaf17f92-e98a-4804-9599-ca6c4e840985.Text: "Perhaps you should listen to the circle, Jae."

8fe7d0b4-bc63-4063-bd85-311f5375c5b1.Text: [Give Jae an encouraging smile] "You're not going to let them fleece you, are you? Do you have a backup plan?"

7a981902-5760-4778-8871-a04d1f6d1f94.Text: "Octaviana, now is the time to remember your fondness for Jae, if you do indeed have any."

efd7164f-a916-4235-9e63-2b59472ff2ce.Text: {n}Tense faces turn toward you, the faces of people who are hard-nosed, hard-fisted, and hard-hearted. The Cold Traders maintain a deferential silence, which is broken only by the hiss of the smouldering lho roll-up being smoked with relish by a dark-haired, aristocratic-looking man in a sumptuous coat.{/n}

31a126ff-7c00-404f-83a4-2dcccdc55efd.Text: {n}Octaviana, who is seated next to the regal-looking stranger, quietly but in a commanding voice, declares:{/n} "The seats have been claimed. Now we discuss the Trade." {n}Her words sound weight, the opening of a ritual litany.{/n}

601ddd44-768b-457d-8b78-b747cdffcaf6.Text: {n}Vladaym, tossing a sidelong look at the regal-looking stranger, in the dry and solemn intonation of a priest, declares,{/n} "The seats have been claimed. Now we discuss the Trade."

d4889c44-4175-430b-800d-8dc157c09826.Text: {n}Jae, her face frozen into a battle mask, glares at the dark-haired stranger, who responds with a subtle, patronising smile.{/n}

fb17d98e-7c8c-4c82-8889-05d1cb8d0f45.Text: "The circle will hear Jae Amira Fathreen Tameri ash Efreet." {n}Mercy pronounces all your companion's names with deliberate meticulousness, never taking his laughing eyes off her.{/n}

f3d67144-298e-4bde-9cd9-d2ac50d0920a.Text: "I am laying claim to Falco's business. His territory and his crew. He tried to take mine and he lost, so now I will take his. And I want the circle to endorse my claim." {n}Jae continues the staring match with Mercy, aiming every word at him like a bullet between his eyes.{/n}

54ebcd43-6dda-49c8-9f84-d64428e1d115.Text: "Is that so?" {n}Frowning, Mercy exchanges a look with the other Cold Traders. As though reading some kind of answer in their glassy eyes, he shakes his head.{/n} "Can the circle agree to that? After all, Falco's sentence was not handed down by us, but by you alone. Does that mean that now you speak for us and instead of us? A dangerous proposition."

ffb16690-829e-43a6-8479-00862d6faf31.Text: {n}The peddlers of the Cold Trade sit in meek silence. When the dark-haired man's gaze casually falls on them, their heads drop lower. Jae, with her chin raised, seems to be the only refutation of this man's absolute superiority, but her strained expression makes it clear that she is not unaffected by his presence either.{/n}

85351709-42a2-4280-a79e-dd40f8d821cc.Text: "But what vox will pick up your voice in the void? What friends will repeat Jae Heydari's words spoken here? The Rogue Trader? No — what friends in the organisation? You have none... though you once did." {n}Mercy's gaze on Jae is patronising and strangely sympathetic.{/n}

23f0cc4f-0a24-4ca4-90d7-3ec5a5a1e560.Text: {n}Mercy winces in pain at your words, his face no longer guarded by the lavish armour of his self-assurance. After tossing a weary look at Jae and receiving an affirmative nod from her, he sighs heavily:{/n} "It is true. She is a different person now."

e8872cb8-9408-4902-9acb-97713164083e.Text: "And greetings to you too, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. We are delighted to welcome a guest of your stature... even one uninvited and so discourteous. But then. he who never remembers an insult, never takes up the burden of retribution." {n}The dark-haired man smiles at you with cold civility and, it seems, even slightly condescension.{/n}

3fdfa9c0-8676-4376-8617-0b3488f1fad5.Text: {n}The dark-haired man responds with a sanguine smile.{/n} "You have been misinformed, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} — you have come here as an honoured guest, may jubilation fill our hearts that such a lofty personage is honouring us with {mf|his|her} regard."

cf7b0911-1203-4bc0-906c-1819037bf2c6.Text: "Greetings to the blessed Rogue Trader. The nature of our profession obliges us travelling merchants to be hospitable hosts." {n}The charismatic smile exudes deferential amity.{/n}

f778f400-4d01-49f8-bca2-81a15f4e2895.Text: "Quiet vox to you all, chegnars. Rogue Trader {name} von Valancius has come to our meeting to ensure that {mf|his|her} interests will not be harmed."

bbc03c89-7c4a-4f03-8660-6fad9ddd4484.Text: "It would be foolish to pass up the mountain of money that would come with friendship with the von Valancius dynasty." {n}Jae's polite words are not enough to gloss over the previous threat, and it seems they were not intended to do so.{/n}

03eb6851-4b91-4711-8c1e-9488d5fdf74f.Text: {n}Now the Cold Traders are looking at you and only you. It would seem they are more afraid of you than Mercy.{/n}

ebfe9b68-d44c-4750-8412-f5c5286c9507.Text: {n}The Cold Traders maintain their cool composure. This is hardly the first time these hardened criminals have been threatened.{/n}

4daf4d98-3df5-417b-afc0-ff970be48917.Text: {n}Mercy's laughter, velvety and appealing, causes Jae's brow to furrow in torment.{/n} "You listened well, shereen. You found yourself accused, and so you cast an accusation in return — a logical move."

fa9f938d-17bd-4586-a3b1-24f2ba4d426e.Text: "I rejoice to see the pearls of wisdom I have sown grow into trees of sound decisions. Shereen, I expect you to be ready to appear before me at any time to receive instructions. I offer my particular thanks to the Rogue Trader — it's not every day that the Emperor grants the chance to observe a truly wise {mf|master|mistress} of destinies who knows that the pinnacle of all Humanity's graces is the making of friends, not the making of enemies."

bd133e21-cefa-4a7b-bd70-569966f0b2e9.Text: "Whatever you say... shereen." {n}Jae looks askance at you, her eyes icy with hurt. She blinks and tears wash the sorrow from her gaze. Her eyes are once more filled with polite courtesy... like a beautiful shell containing a dead and rotten mollusc.{/n}

01a99ab7-4547-4c69-b12f-a29a7c549695.Text: {n}Jae responds with a brittle smile.{/n} "The ease with which you read my heart frightens me, shereen."

d55579fd-8852-4b41-9006-465d59f07329.Text: {n}The crashing sounds of doors being kicked in and screams fill the room. The sharp tang of burning fyceline hangs in the air. The Cold Traders freeze, giving the barrels pointed at them their full attention.{/n}

6afb2db6-08f0-4660-a14f-3b152bf7c0b3.Text: "Only short and bloody songs are born to the sound of weaponfire. You think you can force—" {n}The whistle of the bullet that flies just past Mercy's ear makes him swallow the rest of his florid speech.{/n}

a43620ab-c845-4ea5-9ef5-f82342349012.Text: {n}His spectacles glinting, the Liege drily retorts,{/n} "I appreciate Mistress Heydari's talents and Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}'s interest in her fate. But we are not a band of pirates, but an organisation with rules, and we abide by those rules."

658467ef-6bcb-4921-935c-6bf705243630.Text: {n}Jae's lips burn against yours and leave behind the taste of tart wine balanced with honey sweetness. She kisses you with the desperation of a woman who has found a sip of water moments before she dies of thirst.{/n}

de635c77-7ca2-41d1-8380-25241f3598a0.Text: {n}Not listening, Jae beckons you closer with a delicate gesture that brooks no argument.{/n}

50f6c3aa-5d52-441b-a548-165994cc94b8.Text: {n}Clamping a new lho roll-up between his pearly-white teeth, Mercy coolly replies,{/n} "I am not an idiot. I am not going to argue with a Rogue Trader and a loaded autopistol."

58677eab-0b77-4738-a223-66824763c4a0.Text: {n}Despite Mercy's strange sangfroid, it is clear to you that this is a man unaccustomed to enduring such indignities, and equally unaccustomed to forgiving those who have wronged him.{/n}

d9c5344a-ffcb-4608-9b72-6533dfb9494c.Text: {n}A strange calm comes over Mercy. Faced with facts he cannot change, it seems he has simply decided not to trouble himself with any feelings on the matter.{/n}

524773c4-12c7-4a57-a696-5b9af4c59a78.Text: {n}Blood pours over the Cold Trader's face. It is sure to leave a hideous scar. Clenching his teeth, Mercy grits out:{/n} "I'll remember this meeting, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I promise you that."

c07e2f26-193e-4869-b9f0-7e3dc8f4ee37.Text: "That's true." {n}Mercy's last words fly from his lips, which are twisted into an impudent smirk. The sheen of his aristocratic hauteur remains undulled right to the very end, when he crashes lifelessly to the floor.{/n}

e090c57c-4799-4692-a3ba-41cece529edc.Text: {n}Staring sadly at the body, Jae says,{/n} "Thank you, Eust. And goodbye."

32119d5d-2527-4c4b-bf34-a10ea07b7d41.Text: "Well do I know this victory dance. In matters of the heart, defeating one's opponent is not enough — one must humiliate him in front of his beloved. Jae, are you suitably impressed? Enough to fuel tonight's passions?"

930cc609-9a82-429a-869c-b3b2caa18499.Text: {n}After a few moments of silence, Jae grimly shakes her head.{/n} "He gave so much to me. He trained me, he took care of me, he was even kind to me. I'd be the worst kind of scumbag if I repaid him with a bullet in the heart. Just stay out of my way, Mercy. I don't want to kill you."

109aa146-0240-41af-9f3b-e75f686406c3.Text: "And a long life to you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

78a292e1-491c-4845-a519-a82726318c00.Text: {n}Mercy casts a genial look over the Cold Traders.{/n} "I am the most senior-ranking person here, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Didn't you explain this to your companion... Jae?" {n}The smuggler's given name rolls off Mercy's tongue with easy familiarity.{/n} "And if you are so concerned with showing respect for seniority, you will be comforted to know that I have held my position far longer than you have yours."

cd945a37-e665-4d15-a022-57017e2fb0c9.Text: "You may be leaving, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, but Mistress Heydari will remain here until the circle's meeting is concluded."

7691228b-a163-4d43-afa4-ac05bbf9f8f4.Text: {n}His expression unchanging, Mercy says nothing as his eyes bore into yours.{/n}

ef5167ec-c5be-41f0-aa2b-4a3f2dec2f44.Text: "Any objections...? Don't think so. Our trading is concluded. The circle will not obstruct Jae Heydari's claim." {n}Turning away from the table, Octaviana privately winks at Jae and whispers,{/n} "What took you so long?"

69f73144-27b1-4991-87e7-2ef6d3f3f125.Text: "Most certainly. The circle approves Jae Heydari's claim. Our trading is concluded. The representative of the Mission on my station..." {n}Vladaym emphasises these last two words, and Jae gives him a grateful nod.{/n} "...undertakes to ensure that the interests of Mistress Heydari will not be harmed."

aa1a9ab7-ebfb-4b39-b80b-b0d708a873b4.Text: {n}Blood streams from his broken nose.{/n} "I would not dare to refuse Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I suspect you have many more equally compelling arguments up your sleeve."

c0bd7f59-9b27-42cd-b9d2-1c2fdadd7b23.Text: {n}You discern an interesting mix of emotions in Mercy's eyes as he looks at Jae: irritation, warmth, interest... even resentment. For him, she is something more than simply an opponent in a business negotiation.{/n}

326fc806-a885-4087-a44e-a5b31f51d154.Text: {n}The Cold Traders' eyes dart to each other. You can tell by their faces that Jae's words have hit their mark. But an imperious and slightly irritated gesture from Mercy brings the silent flurry of conversation to an end.{/n}

c70e14d5-97f3-4da1-aa63-e549cdefd6d2.Text: {n}The Cold Traders stare at Mercy, their faces giving nothing away. It seems they have ears for only one voice now.{/n}

1739eca8-730a-456d-84a4-2a489eb757da.Text: "Money can't buy a new head to replace one that's full of bullets. You're asking us to set a dangerous precedent. You are putting a bejewelled grenade in our hands... shereen." {n}You do not fail to notice the way Jae's shoulders shudder at Mercy's last word.{/n}

b69ec6f1-6336-4495-a428-bbea80d82f7e.Text: {n}Mercy's words drip with vitriol:{/n} "Too much has transpired today for it to simply be forgotten."

588c4541-aa21-47cf-b725-91ac8d1a5c24.Text: "It's a bit late to start worrying about that now, shereen." {n}The anguish that has permeated Mercy's voice is black and inescapable, tracing scars left by grief and resentment on his face.{/n}

2d752987-8b73-4193-bb5f-8afcfc62c52b.Text: "Falco was sloppy, and he paid too much attention to..." {n}Jae shoots Mercy a sardonic smile.{/n} "...side projects. My network of contacts is larger, and my patron is more powerful..." {n}Another venomous smile.{/n} "I guarantee that revenue will increase by at least a third."

13e13d15-0811-464b-ad0e-25f4bcd938a9.Text: "We are traders, not fighters — we prefer the language of deals over the language of battles. But that does not mean we can be intimidated. Our organisation operates in the shadows, and we are used to opposition from the powers that be. We keep our blades sheathed, but give us cause to show you how sharp they truly are, and you will sorely regret it. Such knowledge is enough to poison the mind."

2926f7e5-f6d8-4669-89d8-103d33e6a471.Text: {n}Jae takes a deep breath and with compelling seriousness, says,{/n} "You did not stop Falco from robbing me. You did not stop him from killing my friends. Has the circle voted for my removal? Not as far as I know. Either you admit that you allowed Falco to break the rules, or you have to act like they still matter. According to the rules, Falco was out of line, and I punished him... on your behalf, let's say. So his Trade is my trophy and the circle's reward for my trouble."

c501a59a-833a-48d9-aed7-4683e65ca872.Text: {n}Jae casts a look of despair at you and presses her lips tightly together.{/n}

d8fc09ad-c25a-4f65-92f9-1e57ccce079e.Text: "Mistress Heydari's wishes could be met... with some caveats. If, together with Falco's contracts, she assumes the burden of his obligations to me, I can stand as assurance for the circle that the organisation's interests will not be infringed upon. But I will naturally expect any connection that exists between Mistress Heydari and the Rogue Trader to be severed completely. Working with third parties we can accept, but what we cannot accept is any allegiance that originates between the sheets."

d0886ca5-6778-402f-a05f-525f757ba217.Text: {n}The stranger exudes aristocratic hauteur. He takes drags of the fragrant lho with visible gusto, his fingers idly playing with a button on his jacket and from time to time smiling enigmatically at his own thoughts.{/n}

b3c8d6a2-711f-40f6-b889-b1585e9884c2.Text: {n}After hanging her head and saying nothing for a long time, as though thinking things over, Jae declares in a hollow voice,{/n} "All right. I accept your terms."

ddc7592b-66a3-4896-bd78-d8f76230c3a6.Text: "Don't." {n}Jae quickly stops you with a gesture, which brings a self-satisfied smile to Mercy's lips. But the smile drops away at Jae's next words:{/n} "I'll do it myself."

206aeb78-1360-41a1-939c-9342d90d4ad9.Text: "Quiet vox to you all, chegnars. Quiet vox to you, Master Mercy." {n}Jae receives polite nods in response. The Cold Traders' faces that are turned toward her reveal a mixture of support, compassion, and wariness, as if in proximity to an infected relation.{/n}

274c44de-7455-4a19-b31e-567e40038efa.Text: {n}Jae's reply is a whispered warning:{/n} "Only if I'm going to sink them into his throat. Otherwise, he'll pull my teeth and keep them as trophies. Trust me, Mercy is the vengeful sort."

a09363d7-05fd-4058-a13a-b6a626726a0e.Text: {n}Casting her eyes down and pointedly not looking at Jae, Octaviana grimly states,{/n} "My power is power that was given to me by the organisation. Following the rules is my payment for that power."

cc1bc0d9-89b5-441b-ae27-2bb605e73903.Text: {n}Smiling smugly, Mercy addresses Jae silkily:{/n} "You remembered the rules once too. I trust that, with sage guidance, we can refresh your memory and revive your fidelity to our laws."

eb9ade8d-8c6d-4c9e-93ed-0ed6d76fd797.Text: "I wasn't sure what I would do. But you helped." {n}Jae's face is very close to yours.{/n} "Kiss me."

348e2395-a0a8-42ed-a824-97f84b7fdb6e.Text: {n}Jae's voice is low and threatening:{/n} "Choose your words carefully, Mercy. People with greater prudence than you have died for a slip of the tongue in the Rogue Trader's presence."

cb941552-26dc-4e19-a374-0a0ed840e398.Text: "Greetings, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I am Mercy, the organiser of this gathering of upstanding and enterprising men and women. The jubilation that was engendered in my soul at the news of your visit was not overshadowed even by the host of questions it raised — primarily, about how your interests came to lie in such close proximity to ours that I was granted the honour of seeing you at a meeting of the Mission's highest circle. Questions arise and are resolved, and the wise should not darken their hearts with them." {n}He gives you a radiant smile.{/n}

4a88033a-1ed5-4ffd-9e48-6289c3a6246e.Text: "In the eyes of the Mission, we are tools, carefully selected and arranged. One may be employed for their craft and acquisition of profit, another for protection and bloodshed. I am used for dispute resolution and oversight. And for bloodshed... though only on rare occasions. As such, no other voice but mine will sound in your ears."

186587b9-782b-4492-a4f7-43e1915b5c95.Text: {n}An old, familiar expression appears on Jae's face — the look of a satisfied predator.{/n} "Mercy, do you remember what you always scolded me for? 'You are too quick to deny the thought that you might deserve something, shereen' — that's what you said. Thank you for the lesson. This time I will not be humble. Falco's contracts are mine. Falco's crew is mine. Speak up if you disagree. The rest of you — at ease."

b916efe1-ba9f-4979-8244-9ba905b45a8c.Text: "Breaking through the avalanche of the past that was covering my grave was not easy, shereen. But I have risen."

8c69a47e-fd43-4e9c-babd-591264d46b38.Text: {n}The world stops for several moments, but out of the corner of your eye you can see Mercy's face twist into a pained grimace.{/n}

d6e10b2c-f965-43d4-861c-addb5a311022.Text: "Does this thing offer any practical benefit?"

4d11a44c-1f75-432e-9949-7714e5bcadef.Text: {n}Marazhai turns to you — he is holding a crystal coruscating with otherworldly fire.{/n} "{name}... look at this. Your enemy's soul is in the palm of your hand, under your complete control, at the mercy of your desires. Is this not the greatest revenge for past wrongs?"

084e437e-8e79-4cba-a93a-0b5e0a21fee1.Text: {n}Just bringing your hand near the crystal is enough for you to feel the wave of psychic energy emanating from it. When your fingers brush the icy surface, the maelstrom of another's emotions bursts into your mind — hatred, bloodlust, terror, despair...{/n}

4ce17f0f-f0d9-4e2b-9687-8efcff28a01a.Text: {n}...and, unable to endure the onslaught, you draw your hand back. Marazhai scoffs, blithely drags two fingers across the crystal, and returns it to its proper place on his belt.{/n}

83296333-b89b-4c20-83ce-611ca9841a91.Text: "It does. Yremeryss's suffering will give me strength on the battlefield. Perhaps one day I will want to replace her soul with the essence of another, more worthy opponent... but that will not come to pass any time soon."

1a463a9d-e405-483a-bc36-fb55f37a4b82.Text: {n}...and suddenly, in this whirlwind of agony, you discern new shades of feeling — hints of triumph and the thrill of mastery over a defeated foe. Marazhai's eyes, which have been watching your face closely, widen, and his lips curve into an exultant smile.{/n}

68529a20-ca83-41f9-ab9e-3606e2c34245.Text: "The rush is dying down... What do you say to another slaughter right now? No, no... We should savour every moment."

02d30b4e-f0be-4658-9801-731cf4f57074.Text: "You are so receptive to everything I give you... One day, I will mould you into a masterpiece of ecstasy."

34eb2e2c-cff1-4af8-bab9-7b1b6a45a4b1.Text: "The sounds you make when you are in pain are exquisite. I will make you scream louder next time."

e2191694-7ffa-4021-a576-8211ea0e58bd.Text: "Did I imagine it, or were you holding back? Do not dare. Give all of yourself to me. And do not be afraid to break me."

807c37af-e8c0-41ca-a8e8-a89c9c2a196d.Text: "You are quite creative with the agoniser. It pleases me to see my old toy delight my new one."

d7cc7b4d-6013-4569-8d8a-d0de7804ff25.Text: [Let Marazhai carve a brand into you]

e383a859-abc1-4166-bd50-bf2e47adb550.Text: "You... wish to take someone from my retinue?"

66c73a72-0be3-4596-8773-65eb7cacb9ff.Text: "I shall give you one of my retinue."

e0ba60de-8bc3-4a25-886d-8064fe44e3ad.Text: "I broke off another attachment for you!"

0f359ba2-1385-4718-b951-a5fd37d91fc4.Text: "Is there anything I can do to make it up to you?"

8e1ab145-0c23-41d9-94ae-9955208701ee.Text: "Void take you! I won't give you anyone!"

ec681509-316b-452e-82b6-9301a3d08f8d.Text: "You are behaving strangely for an obedient pet xenos."

56bfa4c7-026c-445c-be80-0a9682fbcb44.Text: "You intend to carve a brand into me?"

22ba8a77-952f-4408-8e65-9c0f28b2b230.Text: "In the Imperium it is customary to brand sanctioned xenos."

b68a68cd-5500-4e9d-a095-befc2c23abfe.Text: "I will take no part in this. Not now, not ever."

591aa1c1-5e6b-4d07-be72-5cd1df9db183.Text: "You and only you will wear the brand!"

90de0352-119d-4c1c-bb9c-efbcdc03feb1.Text: [Grab the blade and burn a brand into Marazhai]

e228f4d7-1cdd-4f15-9c95-a5d09064c0fb.Text: "Stop! That's enough! I no longer want to be involved in this!"

210149b4-7bec-417e-9e62-245506e061d9.Text: {n}At the sight of you, Marazhai casually kicks his feet off the desk and stands.{/n} "{name}. I must speak with you."

ef9de5a8-50c4-48ee-9061-f04834a08321.Text: "You break the rules, time and time again. I am sick of the stench of fear that rolls off you every time I present you with a new revelation. And worst of all... I am bored of you, {name}. I do not want to waste any more words or deeds on one who refuses to play the game properly."

1f2b2fb3-e49b-4473-b40c-97e1a0b7b38f.Text: "Mmm, the little assassin who thinks she knows everything about pain. What a revelation awaits her..."

f96ceda0-929d-4830-b5a6-a5a4a3974241.Text: "Why not? You have failed to appreciate what I have offered you. You must make amends for your transgression. My request is very simple — a sacrifice from your inner circle. I will have my fun and, perhaps, forget your offence. To me... it is a small price to pay."

db45a2ff-e042-451d-b11f-c0d8b92e06ae.Text: {n}The touch of the metal elicits agonising, unbearable pain that tears a bloodcurdling shriek from your lungs. With a few flicks of the blade, Marazhai carves a symbol into your neck. The air fills with the stench of burnt flesh and the xenos's laughter. Having finished his task, Marazhai leans back to assess his work.{/n}

444b0b88-8873-4c2b-a372-3e7e67ec9aa7.Text: {n}You suddenly realise that he is moving remarkably slowly — a stark difference from his leap just moments ago. He seems in no rush to lower his raised hand, and then he hisses,{/n} "What is wrong with you, {name}? Have you forgotten your place?"

f384e353-ca49-4c11-9059-198490490571.Text: "It would take too long to recount — and why should I? I have no desire to waste my breath on this conversation."

0c37c7df-5aea-41f6-a2f8-8a6b17ad7936.Text: "You are afraid. You refuse to experience what it means to be on the edge. What it means to know pain. How will you ever venture beyond your pathetic limits when you cling to them with all your might?"

e5beb46e-b3d8-43d7-a391-41d2a79657cc.Text: "I gave you a gift. And what did you do with it? You cast it aside, too cowardly to experience even a grain of the pleasures it promised."

97fb0ba0-564c-41f1-82a2-bd658e46353c.Text: "I told you I needed to track down the fugitives of my Kabal... A small price to pay for the privilege of feasting with me, I thought." {n}Marazhai narrows his eyes.{/n} "I offered you everything, and you gave me nothing."

315bb5c9-30e6-477e-9271-95e39958b035.Text: "You break the rules. You set them yourself, at the very beginning... and then you started straying outside your role, mixing up words. You either possess or allow yourself to be possessed. There is no in-between."

a45857bd-c643-400c-b8b6-12042db02088.Text: "All this time... I thought... I honestly thought that you..." {n}Marazhai lets out a low hiss.{/n} "Enough. You... have ruined everything, mon-keigh. I will not come to you again. And you... you can forget what happened between us. I will not waste any more of my time on you and your weaknesses."

208c23d3-b3ac-4ed4-b4a1-ef62cbfb3fa5.Text: {n}Marazhai freezes, his eyes radiating shock and bitterest disappointment. A moment later, he effortlessly pulls his wrist free of your grip and stands, sheathing his blade and muttering untranslatable xenos profanity through gritted teeth.{/n}

a0e97cd8-d5fb-48db-ae5f-e6f8b90ec1c6.Text: {n}Marazhai tilts his head to one side.{/n} "Why should I care? Do you think I should be flattered that you, a mon-keigh, chose me over all others? That you found my offer superior to the primitive bonds of your kind? That is a given, not a sign of your munificence."

5c52dfc0-988d-42a4-9db5-242545d82108.Text: "No. There is nothing I could deprive you of that would cause you pain."

1e7ef7bd-91ab-4757-9f5b-d6484bf5027c.Text: {n}Marazhai's eyes, which previously smouldered with a strange fire, suddenly blaze with the rampant flame of madness — the same madness that took hold the moment he was sated with another's pain. He barks out a short, hysterical laugh.{/n} "Yes... Just as it should be..."

10542589-41bf-4f5a-b645-7383bd92db0b.Text: {n}Marazhai grips your chin and turns your head, admiring the brand.{/n} "Well now, my little pet. I hunger for a feast. And you... you will come with me. Now."

49a2dbf5-21c9-493e-b730-28f90830d107.Text: "And now..." {n}Marazhai's tone and posture instantly shift — he ducks his head and looks up at you in a show of almost playful submissiveness.{/n} "I hunger for a feast, {name}. Now. Immediately. Do I have your permission?"

30304942-fe7c-409d-8014-c4c4ac3028d4.Text: "The one the mon-keigh call a witch? I will do you the favour of ridding you of that shredder of the veil."

d4ebd744-57a6-43a5-9459-dd4fdb6df845.Text: "The old mon-keigh? I suppose there is enough life in him to occupy me for a while."

7752a0e6-50b9-4885-ae70-bc3819c31f58.Text: "The abomination herself! Oh, I will take great pleasure in gouging out her accursed eye!"

52da94fb-2ba1-47a0-932c-1e8c8241d474.Text: "The sweet-voiced mon-keigh. The time has come to make her hoarse with screams of pain."

a2e3bdc7-31fb-41f8-9ced-5e452d49767f.Text: "Ah, the strong and stubborn one? He will last a long time. A very long time."

67ac8ea5-2c06-4309-9667-44c4c3246add.Text: {n}Something flickers in the Drukhari's eyes. He casually waves away the suggestion.{/n} "No. Not him. Choose someone else."

65f21ec7-3f1f-4df9-b7eb-63c48e760411.Text: "A talkative mon-keigh who thinks she understands my kind. She will soon enough."

53913035-c4f9-47b2-9054-a169e17ee51c.Text: "Ah, the little mechanical martyr. I think he as well as I will enjoy what I do to him."

1755fd1a-447c-4422-abdc-6258a189ac6c.Text: "My dearest cousin... It is long past time for me to bring our kinship to an end."

c24b022c-d996-498b-bcbc-e217ca3fc721.Text: "I will take the victim discreetly — to your crew, one of their number will simply... vanish without a trace. There are plenty of dark corners on this ship... Yes, and one more thing." {n}Marazhai narrows his eyes.{/n} "You are not invited to this feast. I alone will revel in the torment of your offering."

a7529dbc-5021-40f6-b0ec-54e21654bf6f.Text: {n}He pauses, then strides over to you and drags a claw along your cheek. His voice, which just a moment ago was vibrating with irritation, is now as smooth as spiced honey.{/n} "But when you are ready for another walk... you know where to find me."

244729ef-a81a-4949-8cac-1956b14afeb5.Text: {n}Lounging on a chair, Marazhai lightly waves a narrow Drukhari blade back and forth over a lit candle. His eyes meet yours over the flame, his voice dripping into your ears like poisoned honey:{/n} "{name}. I have been waiting for you."

fee34389-6e43-4f3c-88a0-76683f4e3a67.Text: {n}The Drukhari rises from his seat with the fluidity of a predator.{/n} "The time has come to discuss what binds us together. What you have experienced under my unflagging watch."

a818c75a-4861-47dc-9e0f-713073f7a07d.Text: "All in good time, {name}." {n}Marazhai twirls the red-hot blade between his fingers and smiles.{/n}

eb6f538e-0303-42f6-b198-a78b5f4206a4.Text: "Ha! Another sign that you grasp the nature of our bond. But I am not stepping out of my role, no. Not yet."

732cb47a-1e2c-4347-82fa-2570900927da.Text: "I already mentioned that we Drukhari are the true inheritors of the ancient Aeldari. The Aeldari who reigned over the entire galaxy. Who inspired terror and awe in the lesser races. Who knew truths that others feared even to glance at. Our distant kin — the ones who dwell in realspace in eternal fear of Sai'lanthresh — are but a shadow of that former greatness. We, and only we, carry on the greatness of our ancestors."

efb104b2-3604-48b5-9216-4f0e829c845c.Text: {n}Marazhai tests the weight of the blade in his hand.{/n} "I have spent long enough among the mon-keigh. Listening. Watching. You are hobbled by petty passions, such as the strange thing you call 'loyalty.' And 'friendship.' And worst of all... 'love.'" {n}He shakes his head as though he regrets even uttering the word.{/n} "We are spared such weaknesses. We see deeper — and in that depth, there is only mastery and submission."

f66c7fc6-de8d-45cd-965a-e46eb2f82282.Text: "Since the very beginning... we have understood one another perfectly. Since the very beginning, roles have been assigned... and accepted. You are different from the rest. You know the rules of the game. You want to transcend the limits of your species. I have watched you for a long time, {name}. And I have decided that the final step must be taken. To make explicit who is the possessor and who is the possessed. To set the seal." {n}He raises the blade and looks intently into your eyes, taking slow steps toward you.{/n}

03858907-7f84-41e1-b9be-86d26c076101.Text: "Of course." {n}He tilts his head to one side.{/n} "You belong to me. All of you, unreservedly. The time has come to affirm the order of things, once and for all."

7bf2eb3d-41de-45e1-a961-a03a084f42ed.Text: "I have no interest in pitiful mon-keigh rites. I speak of something different." {n}His voice drops to a soft hiss.{/n} "Do not make me repeat myself."

351f15e8-50f1-4b85-8070-1b538e576b74.Text: "Hmm? You would allow me to do that? After everything we have experienced? After how... submissive I have been, you would let me walk around without your brand?" {n}The Drukhari's eyes are taunting, flashing with malice.{/n} "Does that mean I have mistaken our roles? Well... we shall see."

d47c9cf4-5438-4ddf-b52f-c104b7047495.Text: "Is that so? Then why did you attempt to peer into my truth at all, mon-keigh? Why did you so diligently perform my every whispered command? Do not say that you were not singed by the sparks of the flame that burns eternal in me and my kind — the flame of domination and violence, the fundamental truths of this world. Even your primitive senses... are capable of that."

67b54d9d-e548-4ccb-8446-08542314310b.Text: {n}Marazhai freezes.{/n} "What...? This is a great honour for one such as you... and you are going to reject it?" {n}The expression on his face is new to you — one of genuine surprise... and simmering rage. With a guttural growl, he stows the blade and casts a baleful glare at you.{/n} "That is it. I am leaving... and I will not be wasting any more time on your doubts and weaknesses, mon-keigh."

79c2cb89-719e-4272-a3d6-3dc35f62031f.Text: {n}Marazhai is so swift you barely register his movement — in a single bound, he forces you to the floor, pins you down, and raises the red-hot blade...{/n}

022788c7-cc04-485d-bd70-687a45374609.Text: {n}You seize Marazhai's blade with surprising, even suspicious, ease and press the blistering tip against his neck. He thrashes and lets out an agonised howl, but your grip is firm — you do not allow him to move until the red-hot metal has seared the von Valancius symbol into his pale skin. Finally, he jerks away from you, bringing his fingers up to touch the brand on his neck.{/n}

5731a6f9-c45e-4f32-841e-1900c891bcbc.Text: {n}Marazhai freezes, breathing heavily, his eyes radiating shock and bitterest disappointment. A moment later, he unleashes a torrent of untranslatable xenos profanity and rolls off you, sheathing the blade.{/n}

43b31fa6-8c30-4494-aade-3e4486cd6eea.Text: {n}You pluck the blade from Marazhai's hand with ease — for a moment, you think he deliberately loosened his grip. But he certainly did not anticipate your next strike — with a crunch, you drive the blade under his jaw, piercing his throat and shattering his vertebrae. One last astonished, disbelieving look... and Marazhai Aezyrraesh falls dead to the floor.{/n}

1d628098-bc8f-4d53-940e-f14d672ba262.Text: "I thank you for your indulgence." {n}Marazhai's voice quivers with excitement.{/n}

4cecb768-318e-4e05-8185-5e88ba26ac57.Text: {n}Marazhai lets out a barely audible hiss, but he casts his eyes down.{/n} "I... will... wait."

38613a1e-1d39-4bef-a8d5-4d6101dc348e.Text: {n}Marazhai's voice is utterly devoid of colour and playfulness — he has reverted to the same imperious tone you heard back on Grantis.{/n} "You once wanted to gain forbidden knowledge — the paths of the true inheritors of the ancient Aeldari. The essence of my world. Things that are inaccessible to ordinary mon-keigh. Things that bring me pleasure. And, I must say, you have proved to be an abominably poor student."

6cf7457b-234f-4f11-8c61-d565067c69d3.Text: {n}Marazhai goes still, thinking.{/n} "Perhaps there is." {n}A shadow of a smile appears on his face.{/n} "How much do you want to stay with me? Whose life do you value as much as my indulgence?"

e083aee0-6d97-46d9-a916-16f77e871846.Text: {n}You feel the full force of his contempt as he looks at you.{/n} "I have nothing more to say."

a9e27836-e87e-444b-a91e-27b30fbc7e0c.Text: "That boring mon-keigh? Though if I start with his beast, he will grant me an unforgettable bouquet of misery."

643a91aa-cede-4c6e-b86f-290e3532a1a7.Text: {n}You seize Marazhai's wrist, seeking to remove the blade from his hand. He glares at you in outrage.{/n} "What are you doing, mon-keigh? Have you forgotten your place?"

32c76f43-ffa6-452b-a299-3b35cb87841e.Text: {n}Marazhai's eyes flare.{/n} "A name. Give me a name."

3df56458-c7c8-40eb-80ca-da025a343123.Text: "I do not need gifts from you."

c0edb6fe-6c55-498f-9617-7917e571b49d.Text: "Then again... I think I shall choose, after all."

531c57e1-dea6-4fec-8274-f43a331c5502.Text: "I like the idea of smothering passion."

0e799bf2-a379-496e-8c17-b43525cd6ac9.Text: "Perfect ecstasy? I think I'll choose that."

80ad4855-667e-4cc9-a49c-14ad63f7920c.Text: "Take this filth and get out of my bedchamber. I never wish to see anything like this on my ship ever again!"

69d29314-3f02-4749-9ae6-5860a4a08275.Text: "I... appreciate the thought. But I will not be availing myself of all this."

d9071251-ddcf-4505-9e0b-cf5c3b16637f.Text: "Well, since your gift is already here, now is the perfect time to try it out."

cedc530c-8f3c-467b-999f-9caa9c9b41a5.Text: "I think I shall try out all the facets of your gift... on myself."

21983856-e965-4953-a9a5-bb8f1564842f.Text: "I wish for you to fall victim to these pleasures. And I... shall watch."

b09d58e3-ac79-4252-8311-4dae7f26c8ac.Text: "{name}." {n}Marazhai sweeps into a bow and raises his head, looking up at you from below.{/n} "Allow me to claim a moment of your time, Rogue Trader. I have come to repay the concern you have shown for me."

fb451180-9e89-454b-9e3a-3b90c2bc4c3e.Text: {n}He looks into your eyes.{/n} "The vestiges of the Reaving Tempest that we encountered in the void... You could have refused my request. You could have disposed of those spoils however you wished, but you deigned to indulge me... and so I must express my thanks — as only I can."

80e432a6-a497-410e-ad58-e030cd3e3a86.Text: "My little pet..." {n}Marazhai stares down at you, smirking.{/n} "I could not help but notice how obedient you have been of late. I am pleased with you."

1f472538-d830-43b1-9ae7-5a88aa18a08c.Text: {n}Marazhai's fingers grip your chin and force your head up.{/n} "The remains of the Reaving Tempest bowed down before me when they saw that I had not lost my authority even beyond the bounds of the Webway. I think you have earned a small gift from me."

871f4280-146c-4771-a43e-4dea973d946f.Text: {n}Marazhai tilts his head to one side.{/n} "Tell me, which offering would excite you most of all? Thousands of touches that bestow tenderness and pain? Passion capable of smothering the life out of you? Or perhaps perfect, shattering ecstasy brought by billions of tiny peaks? The choice is yours."

f6babd28-23f5-4169-91ab-1089f0e79bb8.Text: "Is that so?" {n}Marazhai's smile turns into a feral leer.{/n} "What can I say? I like to surprise."

d8319f10-f692-44f7-8030-e0f3c510bc66.Text: {n}Marazhai's face twists into a grimace of frustration.{/n} "Do you reject my proffered gift?"

32366c05-1de1-4547-a112-2a99462e8850.Text: {n}Marazhai heaves a disappointed sigh.{/n} "You are wrong. But I will not try to coax you into partaking of the pleasures I can give you. Do as you will."

ac2d0aa6-4136-4c05-b82b-3db77f8c24c1.Text: "Then stop testing my patience and tell me what you want."

e01b11d9-e3b9-4089-960c-4ebe658a5189.Text: {n}Marazhai gives you a dark look full of promise.{/n} "Very well. Allow me some time and I will give you what you desire."

455dd248-85e8-496d-bf2e-b99c80ac3c52.Text: {n}His voice vibrates with excitement.{/n} "Just look... Who else could offer you such a gift? The delights of my kind, selected according to your desires!"

dbb8fef2-dd2d-493a-86e6-91bbe3dd3333.Text: {n}Marazhai raises his eyebrows in feigned confusion.{/n} "Did you yourself not choose that which your soul craves the most?"

25c2dde9-fa62-459a-b1a1-06ed15416efc.Text: "These Wyches, who were banished from their Cult for their connection to the Reaving Tempest, are exquisite artists of the blade. Thousands of touches will cover your entire body with the finest of cuts, delivering the sweetest pain — but never granting ultimate release. The object of their artistry will teeter on the border between life and death... for hours."

09104601-b6d0-4109-940d-8cf1e6f3f623.Text: "A Sslyth's entire body is but one giant garrotte that crushes not only bones, but the very spirit. With each passing second, the pressure grows... and grows... and, suddenly, your chest cannot expand enough even to take a breath, and your consciousness begins to struggle in its death throes. Little compares to the passion born of suffocation in terms of sheer power."

3137ccb5-8053-4b8a-9ede-cab82606d842.Text: "This Engine of Pain created by a Haemonculus is a delicate mechanism — an orchestra of suffering and torment, equipped with a thousand needles, knives, and syringes that inflict the most sublime sensations. It will suck out your soul, grind it to dust, change it forever... and then revive it, restoring all essences and feelings to your veins. There is no ecstasy greater than that experienced by one who has endured this Engine's torture."

d2d58bd8-444d-4a7b-a751-a6e179ae8388.Text: {n}Marazhai clicks his tongue in vexation.{/n} "I have taken great pains to gratify you... and this is how you repay me for my labours? Hmm. Have it your way. Perhaps your palate is still too... bland to fully appreciate what has been offered to you."

1b9bcd38-307a-4236-b63a-3ffb9c8403fc.Text: {n}Marazhai bites his lip, holding your gaze and waiting for your word.{/n}

94cdb58b-244b-4801-b59e-e89c450c3160.Text: {n}Marazhai responds to your words with an indulgent nod.{/n}

f513729f-df20-40ef-aa4c-2365458f8581.Text: "Of course. But I... will be watching you with interest, my pet." {n}Marazhai's eyes blaze with dark fire as he gives you a gentle nudge in the back.{/n}

e58d8589-7c3e-4600-b079-f1309bd2c4f2.Text: {n}A satisfied smile spreads across Marazhai's face — which he immediately hides by dropping his head in a performative bow.{/n} "I will not disappoint you, {name}."

6932eb21-55aa-49bc-848e-ac3e5e97e6a7.Text: {n}Marazhai glares at you, his lip curling slightly, as though your response has spoiled his plans in some way.{/n} "As you wish, {name}. As you wish."

04023c21-243d-4a9d-9c42-6f1c0624c4ba.Text: "Lord Captain? I wanted to warn you — Marazhai is on his way to your quarters. He will be with you any minute..."

45736679-9390-494b-902d-847ad37c9cef.Text: "I did not save Marazhai's life so you could take matters into your own hands! Put your weapons away, all of you!"

8b88d778-47f1-44e6-8514-e80e8e5c4f28.Text: "And what, the rest of you just stood by and watched?"

b3f4f9c7-1e6e-447d-93cc-ad723305371c.Text: [Draw your weapon] "Let's rid the world of this scum together."

1d6e8dc7-3133-4b63-a14b-d7883da423f6.Text: {n}Time seems to stand still when you enter. Figures cast in shadow, huddled against the walls, turn to you — everyone except the few standing frozen in the middle of the room with weapons in their hands.{/n}

d0bfbe05-e0b2-4f43-a21e-e9fdcd56abb5.Text: {n}The air around Heinrix seems to crackle with cold. He is grimacing and spitting blood, clearly in pain from a bruise on his cheekbone.{/n} "Pretty quick for carrion..."

e1a27ef3-37c2-4698-967e-e29f5c6ca8d0.Text: {n}Argenta is panting, but her weapon is steadily trained on Marazhai.{/n} "May Thy will fortify my hand, may my faith in Thee grant me strength..."

3eb7cf6c-40c5-4eac-8ec4-b4af3259cf48.Text: {n}Ulfar's rumbling malicious laughter echoes off the lair's ceiling.{/n} "A nimble pest, aren't you? You could have surrendered without a fight — I would have snapped your neck and spared you torment. But you chose to die more painfully..."

be75087c-3e71-4153-a375-3e994418b978.Text: {n}Despite his proud stance, Marazhai is clearly struggling to stay upright. His armour is battered and chipped in places, and his twisted face is marred with bloody streaks.{/n} "Closer, mon-keigh... closer, if you are so eager to know the caress of my blades..."

7fb1b0d6-b171-4a9a-a8c6-fc39b1a704ca.Text: {n}Marazhai, whose armour is dented in a few places, lets out a guttural laugh.{/n} "What are you waiting for? It is about time we finished our little dance!"

603135ff-366d-461d-8890-e5d7a214449d.Text: {n}Marazhai lightly brandishes his blades, laughing mockingly in his opponent's face.{/n} "I can continue dancing with you for a long, long time... but I am growing weary of your pathetic attempts."

851a8128-16bd-4761-902d-f9da88ea9a95.Text: "Not all your lackeys are well trained, {name}. As soon as I crossed the threshold of this squalid hole, I was forced to take up arms."

8b5b2506-8809-44fd-800e-535e30536506.Text: "I am merely doing my job, {name}." {n}Heinrix's voice drips with sarcastic venom.{/n} "I have not heard you officially declare yourself the protector of this xenos, and so the Ordo is fully within its rights to act!"

3eeebc70-f287-45f1-944f-7db7fe6498ab.Text: "The abomination that you have allowed into the ranks of your companions must die. This is His will and my duty, Rogue Trader." {n}Argenta's eyes burn with a frenzied, incinerating fire.{/n}

83420770-e57d-4d44-a217-13abcdf916f5.Text: "Ho there! I decided to unwind by chasing this stringy xenos across the ceiling! Join me, Aett-Vater!"

cb14443a-db4e-49eb-b43e-88128493b01b.Text: {n}Marazhai chuckles hoarsely.{/n} "I do not care about your lackeys, {name}. But they do seem to care about me. The mon-keigh do not know their place in your circle. A pitiful spectacle."

0bc1fcb6-0e6a-4d45-b631-74311f1e021c.Text: "Who am I to stand in the way of the Imperium's justice?"

e949db58-a271-4d4d-a8ad-8fdb10f6a224.Text: "Lord Captain, it's none of my business... but seeing that pasty scumbag get the crap beaten out of him is fine by me!"

476cd4c7-3d5f-4574-979b-fa68812b0878.Text: "I refuse to pay for the deeds of my dark cousin."

92256e0a-a022-4849-8997-efd24367e1e0.Text: "Shereen, true wisdom lies in knowing when to step forward, and when to step back and blend into the wall."

f0eaa3e3-7365-486d-acdc-4c0333283a39.Text: "Corporal punishment is one of the most effective methods of subduing unsanctioned xenos. I was curious if it would work on Drukhari."

af79483a-91c8-4182-887f-d9e924324875.Text: "Intervention in the conflict was deemed unconstructive. The unit identified as the xenos Marazhai does not have sufficiently high priority to trigger protective strategies."

54618589-a0ad-49ce-af0c-9baab34069e6.Text: {n}Heinrix curses floridly in a dialect of Low Gothic that you do not recognise.{/n} "Damn it, {name}! Your leniency toward enemies of Humanity... no, toward this particular duplicitous and despicable piece of filth crosses all bounds!"

d5f74894-5aaf-4b5f-8309-3d4f3b69c611.Text: {n}Argenta's gaze upon you is full of condemnation.{/n} "I will not oppose you, Rogue Trader, though my soul may clamour for the destruction of this foul thing. But I will wait for it to give me cause. I will wait eagerly."

53758432-76d6-4724-8b73-660b34b1813b.Text: {n}Ulfar slams his gauntlet-clad fist against his armour, heaving a sigh of disappointment.{/n} "I am not one to end the battle while a xenos still stands... But no matter, scrawny inhuman — we will get the chance to finish this another time."

6277807a-fc74-44e8-8950-3533894ba3ad.Text: {n}Marazhai takes his eyes off the exit and looks at you. The contorted mask of battle rage slides from his face, and he sheathes his blades.{/n} "If your lackeys have seen enough of the show, I have business to discuss with you, {name}."

479b4330-0c31-4f6a-97e2-aaf7d73d87a9.Text: {n}Marazhai lets out a furious cry and, raising his blades, rushes at you and your companions before you can move.{/n}

9b3dff0a-f45f-4b4b-a0aa-4a18b495f6ff.Text: "The right decision." {n}Heinrix's eyes blaze with otherworldly ice.{/n}

fa25de3b-2b79-41f3-a6dc-aee74daee0a9.Text: "There are some things in the universe that cannot be changed. Wolf meets xenos, xenos dies. Let's finish him, Aett-Vater!"

48ad5d81-f1aa-4a82-bf61-67df8ca01d04.Text: "His name did not fall from your lips, Domin'{name}. That is the only reason to draw one's blade in this rotten city. Otherwise, most everyone here should be slaughtered."

2d8f655a-c4b6-4d60-bb1e-1c0248846c4d.Text: "This foul creature became your property when you took him into your retinue. I will not attack your pet xenos, but there is nothing to stop me from watching and praying that others less constrained by the obligations of His servants succeed in the attempt."

868f89cf-0a65-42ca-9ddf-cf5b46500ae3.Text: "Leave me alone in exchange for Yremeryss, and you can have her."

449e90c4-9a57-4673-a3a0-72de527b0557.Text: "You have the nerve to disrespect the person who just dragged you out of the arena alive?"

256e106b-8131-4cbe-b5e2-82cfaa33f558.Text: "You have a complicated relationship, I see."

01dff334-e909-4677-be73-1c67d8756181.Text: "Very well. Should we encounter Yremeryss at any point, I shall allow you to deal the final blow."

63e19a17-0ee5-4388-bf66-8e103599b0a6.Text: "What do you want with her soul?"

f3382d4e-b19a-45c9-a608-02cd99a1e046.Text: "I do not plan to concede this kill to you."

5b4eb7c2-4bda-4d3d-8b0f-0f6dda28114d.Text: [Look at what the plate was covering]

a3f89d93-842b-405b-a8f8-aeb08f4f6cde.Text: "I will not help you. Hunt Yremeryss yourself."

e17033ee-785b-4a3d-8948-c97f69acf3ba.Text: "Your armour is held on with hooks that dig into your body?"

c1085d42-a575-4462-b5a2-74fbb081df8f.Text: "You. I have never seen a Drukhari at such close quarters before."

f1630465-f495-402a-b5a3-b79482335021.Text: [Seize Marazhai by the throat] "I will gladly look upon a world in which you know your place."

93dc517b-960a-442c-869f-5edbae60e9a7.Text: "Why do you hate Yremeryss so much? It was your own fault you ended up in the Chasm."

8f312b20-bf1b-4b62-9693-b83073eeb2a1.Text: "Armour held on by meat hooks? You Drukhari truly are perverted scum."

5e400082-3dbd-4403-adac-df80924ae88a.Text: "You want to kill your own sister?"

531e14f9-d308-44e3-bb3f-cb8ca0c5484a.Text: {n}Marazhai is casually inspecting his armour for damage, seemingly unperturbed by the attempted reprisal against him.{/n}

2bd22019-282d-43c6-8c52-8b9ee719b1ea.Text: {n}You can see the jaw muscles twitching in Marazhai's face — it seems the attack on him has managed to upset his equilibrium after all. He is carefully inspecting his armour, which has obviously suffered damage in the arena and the recent fight.{/n}

14668c17-91a5-4f05-a637-a077c2924b7e.Text: {n}Marazhai makes a casual gesture, in the same motion returning the plate to its proper place.{/n} "I am finished. Let me know when you are planning to kill someone — I cannot stand this lull."

ae69a987-4247-4088-98d0-49d73a8d8285.Text: {n}...and you notice the gleam in his dark eyes and the hint of a smile on his twisted lips. Marazhai could easily rip your hand from his neck if he wanted to — he is playing along with obvious enjoyment.{/n}

65c2cc7e-8743-4a94-88be-469058766395.Text: {n}...and you realise that you cannot discern the emotions in his eyes — they slip by so fast you cannot count them. And yet, he makes no attempt to remove your hand.{/n}

2ae4c589-10de-4701-8a72-0c48bb0be344.Text: "The soul of Yremeryss, the Archon of the Reaving Tempest. It should belong to me. I do not know where... I do not know how... but that bitch tried to dispatch me without sullying her own hands and she deserves to lose her life. Her soul will remain in my Soul-Trap." {n}With a lazy nod, Marazhai indicates the dark crystal hanging from his belt.{/n}

ae358bd3-53b4-447f-b942-2982e7fa2eaf.Text: "Dragged me out alive?" {n}Marazhai allows himself a thin smile.{/n} "The only reason you walked away from that fight in one piece is because I was on your side. Your self-delusion runs depressingly deep."

3c8422dd-6ae2-47ea-b7b9-70fe0cff0556.Text: "Simply killing her is not enough for me — no, it is too... banal? Keeping her imprisoned for all eternity in a cage of misery from which there is no escape — that is a fate more to my liking. Her fury and torment will feed me until her spirit dries up, like a fountain of blood spraying from a sliced artery. And also... it might make her resurrection problematic."

493a9ae5-6027-466c-8588-4fa4b90c63a7.Text: {n}With the claw of his glove, Marazhai hooks one of the crushed plates of armour on his thigh and examines it meticulously.{/n} "When we at last face each other — and we will face each other, even if I have to gut all of Commorragh to do it — and if you are there when it happens, do not even think of trying to deliver the final blow. Only an Aezyrraesh has the right to take the life of an Aezyrraesh — and that right is mine."

c0d24f07-6901-4bca-95b2-f08e4a6e6c90.Text: "Hmm. The answer I was expecting. I do not expect to wait long for the confrontation — when my sister learns of what occurred in the arena, she will send assassins, or decide to come herself..."

93af774d-c70e-4799-b292-f6cb0db1fb6b.Text: "I did not tell you to think about it, {name}. I told you what I need from you. And your response has displ—"

2d74b7ed-7f66-45b8-8a1d-3c90d30f1dc7.Text: "Hmm. Perhaps I did not make myself clear. The right to take the life of an Aezyrraesh—"

b43e25a0-3921-4ab3-9dcf-e55af337a997.Text: {n}Marazhai breaks off — all his attention is now focused on a bent plate on his shoulder. A second later, he grips the edge of the plate and, with a strangled groan, tears it off — the piece dislodges with a hiss. Marazhai begins to straighten the bent plate with his hands, revealing the surprising strength contained within his lean body.{/n}

dc584b7e-9bf4-42c8-b20e-1505fe812060.Text: {n}The underside of the plate is fitted with two thin hooks. They do not look like normal armour fastenings, and they are also coated in something wetly glistening.{/n}

c9a8a9a3-6e3c-448a-bba6-55c2eae43710.Text: {n}You are shocked to find no under-armour or clothing — it seems the thin, light armour is attached directly to the Drukhari's pale skin, roped with veins. You notice two pinprick marks surrounded by purplish bruises — something pierced his flesh here, and that is what kept the armour plate in place.{/n}

e794ac76-0376-4af7-8676-f561c41936ff.Text: {n}With a hiss, Marazhai replaces the plate and turns around without a word, not dignifying you with a response.{/n}

b7476828-2ccf-42d9-90d3-9f974557c2de.Text: {n}After a few seconds, some ancient awareness spikes in you — the rapt attention of a deadly predator is focused on you. Your eyes dart up — Marazhai has noticed your interest. Silently, he turns his head to you and leans down. His eyes bore into yours, his gaze mocking and charged with promise.{/n} "What are you looking at?"

6a2137ea-f34c-4690-a7a4-50b7916c79d5.Text: "Ah, yes... I can hear your frantic pulse, {name}." {n}The Drukhari tilts his head.{/n} "What is it you feel when you look at me? Primal fear? Paralysing horror? Inexplicable awe? Allow me to explain: you are enthralled by your proximity to death. Your consciousness is swooning at the unlikely fact of your continued existence. But you do not recognise this, because you have been prevented from exploring the limits of your sensation. No such constraints exist in my world."

82d39351-7859-4a05-9ffc-344e7fea976b.Text: "Correct. Directly into the nerve centres." {n}The Drukhari's head falls to one side and his voice takes on a velvety undertone, as though he is savouring every word.{/n} "Direct stimulation of the trigger points, provoking constant, unrelenting pain. Do you know how pleasurable it feels when your suffering rings out in unison with another's? The overwhelming ecstasy when your own agony bleeds into the agony of your enemy? My world is woven from that pleasure, {name}."

86adf95a-5051-4442-a76a-f3e1803b113a.Text: {n}The cold touch of the clawed glove takes you by surprise — grasping your chin, Marazhai leans forward, so close that you can see the narrow band of dark turquoise around the Drukhari's dilated pupils.{/n} "I can show you that world, {name}. I can teach you. If you do as you are told."

32ecd464-d013-4620-b542-34427facd951.Text: {n}Marazhai lets out a low chuckle.{/n} "I do not expect a primitive creature such as you to understand something so beyond your intellect. All I need is for you to understand your obligations to me."

0bdeb696-2670-4279-a4a4-4d2e66165164.Text: {n}The Drukhari's eyes widen in astonishment. With a hiss, he intercepts your arm, gripping your wrist...{/n}

1fd7cb31-9d79-4d65-8fcf-3d0d3d5ffea7.Text: {n}Marazhai's lips stretch into a smile.{/n} "An obedient pet. Good." {n}He leans even closer — and then shoves you hard away from him. With a nonchalant expression, he steps back and slaps the plate back into place on his shoulder.{/n} "Then start by carrying out my order. If we meet Yremeryss, she is mine. And now — go, {name}. I am finished with you. For now."

256dec8c-41b3-4b4d-bc7a-601cb77dd96d.Text: {n}Marazhai laughs contemptuously.{/n} "Very true, {name}! All you need to do is focus on your obligations."

2c41b160-ceb9-4d04-bf45-692e3d0dcd2e.Text: "Let us see how you handle the tasks I have already given you. Remember — Yremeryss is mine, whenever and wherever we encounter her. With that, I have nothing more to say to you, {name}."

a035aa8f-e2b2-4d83-99e1-9d3d5334d876.Text: "Only an Aezyrraesh has the right to take the life of an Aezyrraesh. You will give me the chance to end the existence of the Archon of the Reaving Tempest."

e6c8db64-86ca-40d3-880c-87e6f62b8821.Text: "Then let us return to my instructions. Yremeryss's soul and my right to kill her."

1f125aa8-f4cf-4996-80d8-96d3307b1291.Text: "Yes?" {n}The Drukhari looks deeply confused.{/n} "Your astonishment is making me think that the mon-keigh are even more primitive than I first suspected. Do not tell me that blood ties carry certain prohibitions and taboos among your kind?"

416071be-ddc2-492b-b737-c5b902d3b4e8.Text: "Yes. I valued her until she went too far in her attempts to dispose of me. She valued me until I refused to bare my throat for the blade without a word. Our relationship has come to a dead end. Now the tie between us must be severed."

2bc6dc53-f7f9-4279-b347-07c53883186a.Text: {n}Marazhai dodges the blow with a smirk and draws back.{/n} "You should not have done that. But it does not matter. Let us return to your obligations."

017ea674-5f13-4907-80bb-c57c5daa110a.Text: "Naive creature... The Haemonculi of Commorragh — including Tervantias, whom Yremeryss favours — are able to regenerate our slain kin from small pieces of flesh held in amniotic tubes. Any Drukhari you kill on the field of battle can come for you again — albeit at a price, since the Haemonculus claims a portion of their client's soul as payment for this precautionary measure. Perhaps Yremeryss was desperate enough — or insane enough — to resort to such a contract. Who knows, having Yremeryss's soul in my keeping might make her regrown form — if one appears — defective. She might not remember me or you at all."

9cd0eb1d-403e-43d8-8583-4297ad77958c.Text: "Mon-keigh..." {n}begins the Drukhari, but he stops short. You see his face twist as he forces out the next words:{/n} "{name}. There is something you must do for me."

273c8769-054d-430b-bc0e-a2990db43289.Text: "Good, {name}. Know that you could never doom her to a worse fate than the one I have prepared for her. Now that this conversation is concluded..." {n}Marazhai slaps the plate back into position.{/n} "We can both be on our way."

79dcc038-690d-471b-bcce-85c6130951f2.Text: {n}Marazhai tracks you from beneath his lowered lids — his gaze is appraising, as though trying to work out how much of a threat you pose. Then he looks away and begins inspecting his armour with pointed nonchalance.{/n}

75238ce3-8c0c-465c-8126-937e63488bfa.Text: "It is all... somewhat more complicated than you are capable of understanding. Our game of old must come to an end. My first step went awry because of Nazrakhei's treachery. Now all I must do is finish what I started — destroy her with my own hands before she destroys me."

9d42ac2d-1c6f-43b4-a031-caf69159f89e.Text: {n}The Drukhari sneers at you.{/n} "Your fear is almost tangible. Delightful. But let us return to why I called you here — Yremeryss. And your obligations to me."

5464d1bc-27cb-4135-8bc4-3cb34af37934.Text: "I... do." {n}When you release your hold, the Drukhari stares at you for a few seconds, his head slightly bowed.{/n} "Before I leave you... may I request that you leave Yremeryss to me?" {n}You hear supplication in his voice that seems sincere and mocking at the same time.{/n}

8ac032d2-810c-45d3-8185-e6fe0fbc03f9.Text: "I... do." {n}When you release your hold, the Drukhari stares at you for a few seconds, his head slightly bowed.{/n} "And I will not forget my place... so long as you do not lose your grip." {n}Marazhai's eyes gleam ravenously.{/n} "As you have already promised me Yremeryss... I will leave you now. When it is time to kill... let me know."

3987bca4-5c65-4c66-8343-5b974cd5ecef.Text: "Yremeryss is my sister. What does it matter?"

45c1d141-7ac3-4689-9155-6c7116a126da.Text: "You are putting the lives of thousands of crew members and billions of protectorate subjects in danger!"

48753cc3-e6b5-458f-b8c2-6e5691263049.Text: "Lord Captain, your decision will doom us all! Lowly pirates perish, risking nothing but their own skin — but what of you?"

fbd4166b-d01c-43d3-9676-b2650138ec04.Text: "You first must find peace inside your own soul."

c929a93d-5df4-4bb7-b35e-77e8f5450cd0.Text: "In truth, you believe in nothing at all, {name}. Not the God-Emperor, the Archenemy, or even people. You barely believe in yourself. I pity you."

c494f88c-f0c0-4414-9bfe-56b643ac5b81.Text: "The light in your soul pierces the darkness, ready to give hope to those who need it most. Accept your light."

35e76187-64d6-41ea-acd8-b04da3f6c503.Text: "Do you see yourself now, elantach? Just as radiant as others see you?"

e06b8b62-cb86-4405-896b-39c7491d503a.Text: "It is natural for mon-keigh to desire closeness with their own kind. But this same desire gives rise to doubt."

5ba93f1d-0ae0-43fa-aa44-422a3a75dafa.Text: "Your words could be misconstrued. I am a mutant. Are you just toying with me?"

01cbbc24-d03d-4340-a786-d72cc1c998c7.Text: "Everything you now have was served to you on a silver platter. But do you deserve it?"

af1a9d96-d867-4a75-9ff9-5a7f0dcab829.Text: "Once betrayed, it is hard to put one's trust in others again. Especially those closest and most loyal to us."

9ffd7993-5aef-423d-ad09-2246fc052d3f.Text: "To the void with the soul, gods, and friends. Only power can bend the galaxy to one's will!"

629cad4b-52f6-4e1a-9545-f0bebccc0308.Text: "When duty closes around your heart like an iron trap... would you choose intimacy in captivity? Or would you break out of the trap and be free, leaving your wings behind?"

0ea7ddfe-d18e-4dd3-9574-1e9df857863c.Text: "Stop addressing an acolyte of the Holy Inquisition as you would an admirer at a high-society function. You are far too frivolous a person to lead such an illustrious dynasty."

7e36492d-0483-441f-93ee-26a098554140.Text: "Am I here to kill you? To betray you? To serve you? Am I friend or foe? What do you think, {name}?"

25d2dd15-4b78-4edd-a81e-1ecd4008c7e0.Text: "The darkness has already taken root inside your soul, and it cannot be undone. But you still can accept it and seal it deep inside. Fight! And do not ever give in to it again."

ac839541-ac82-4002-9bb1-df2a12c42c49.Text: "Elantach, you... you pine for the eternal power granted by corruption. I promised not to judge you, but it is my duty to warn you."

c0438d7a-c76a-4fcf-8a5a-057823a5a220.Text: "As long as I still can use {mf|his|her} thrones, I don't care."

8262b021-559e-48fa-82d9-cc20e202c948.Text: "Putting on airs, Lord Captain. You are as distant from the common folk as rusty old Footfall is from Terra."

71591ec0-c8c5-4064-adb8-abaf3133e7d1.Text: "But this fire provides you with power. Accept it fully. Accept yourself — and tame the raging fire."

954d28ba-5ccf-4db6-b612-4ded8c5892db.Text: "The fire of faith burns bright in your soul, burning you from within. You risk losing yourself if you ever succumb to it."

f6f1b50b-9cfd-4613-b673-a6c1f8649042.Text: "The fear of being used... We all have it. But the more we have to give, the stronger it grows."

9cc215d1-1079-4482-b4c5-ae877c2c91aa.Text: "Of course I'm with you only because of your throne and your power, shereen! You didn't hope my feelings were genuine, did you?"

1608786a-d785-4fb2-9f64-6d322895ae11.Text: "You are doing everything right, don't worry, shereen! I will happily take your place when you are gone."

d6351ff9-e57d-4647-80b5-b84c961f71ce.Text: "I don't know who this mon-keigh is, but your memories of them are akin to slimy mud after the rain. Let's wash it away like spring water, shall we?"

bf7e4021-8dfd-48c9-9ecb-e2e520158ccb.Text: "Have you already forgotten me, {name}? Oh, don't ever forget me — not even for a moment. Because as soon as you turn away, I will plunge the shard of my sword into your throat!"

b4fd2407-b994-4d45-9e01-627ed76acaf7.Text: "Remember that everyone here is just a reflection of your thoughts, feelings, and desires. Do not be afraid to look them in the eye."

2b742384-5dc4-41f0-8e97-70b4129e0cff.Text: "We did it, elantach! So far your world resembles the real one, but soon you will learn to go deeper."

36007b52-657f-4af0-8dc2-3c00845f6c69.Text: "Free yourself from your unnecessary burden, elantach. And let serenity enter your soul."

54373d12-2b99-43cd-b9c9-37e7f3d683ad.Text: "Your soul resembles an untended garden where the weeds are suffocating fragile flower seedlings."

16164e09-64c1-41cf-b53d-a8a2458b7b18.Text: "Unit {name} von Valancius's crimes against the sacred laws of the Omnissiah have been logged. Retribution is imminent."

083860aa-874a-4104-941a-6236e08f78ea.Text: "If the light of the Emperor alone can be our guiding beacon, yet only true gods grant power... Is it possible to achieve peace in all corners of the universe?"

62d0b96c-89ec-4c1c-a99b-68f4498a17e3.Text: "All sentient beings are afraid of death. You have to accept the fear first before you can get rid of it."

e5e34d8d-5f54-4203-8143-07153a60058f.Text: Fresh blood soaks into the priceless silk coverlets, forming an ugly stain under the corpse... your corpse.

2d2a2b71-b399-457a-97e2-ebe25768f7b0.Text: "The burden of responsibility lies on your shoulders, elantach, and your soul grows dull from weariness. Break the chains of exhaustion."

80a0f0ed-d1e3-4b05-9291-2d2d0181d4d7.Text: "Deep loneliness binds the mon-keigh with threads of affection. But shards of unhealed pain tear them again and again, creating new wounds."

a6ca83bd-fe0d-4888-a89d-a72ea393fbf9.Text: "I'm just a dog to you. A dog allowed to eat from a golden bowl, but only until you get bored of him."

163407e2-9414-42bf-81ca-4d7a2b1b90b0.Text: "Hide behind the Warrant all you want — I can see right through you. One day you will make a mistake, and then, rest assured, I will be there. The punishing hand of the Lex Imperialis."

d45088d2-b8c5-41e2-9127-fa196a87d924.Text: "Some words you need to hear at least once to believe them."

82102756-530f-45b4-a6ac-84345c93b1c5.Text: "I am proud of you, {name}. You have become a worthy successor — and perhaps even the best Lord Captain."

d15566b2-8252-4701-a786-e0db0a068214.Text: "Only the mad and the foolish never doubt their strength. The wise are full of doubt, but they know how to let go of them."

64357da1-1a26-48ad-b849-1c80e4fb840c.Text: "You just got lucky, mon-keigh. But luck is the only thing you have. You are weak... So prepare to suffer!"

b7c79695-23bb-4b7b-b04a-24733026f590.Text: "Everyone — from the lower decks to the senior officers — hate {mf|him|her}. I hear their vox-transmissions. Mutiny is brewing."

c5640e73-a8cc-4b53-bd2d-b5310751d8e4.Text: "We got rid of one Rogue Trader, and we'll get rid of {mf|him|her}, too."

fed2490d-e1f2-4910-bc13-07c151924193.Text: "Standing at the helm, peering into the darkness of the cosmos... You feel as lonely among the stars as I do among my own kin."

3061f62c-f9e8-4c2d-a35e-2242f9ff0edd.Text: "My world resembles an endless road, piercing the galaxy itself. You and I are in the middle of this path. I can see no beginning or end to it..."

5fdad06b-595e-41ae-a7e4-c0bea7b8f322.Text: "But I can see where the road ends for you, {name}. It ends much sooner than mine — like a fleeting flash, the glimmer of a fallen star. A short, beautiful moment..."

e472f96d-0b9f-40b0-8f6b-c59308ef9de0.Text: "And this road, this moment, I wish to spend with you. Not as a human and a Child of Asuryan, but as equals."

ceab61ca-1fb1-4adb-ab84-a2527bda1f13.Text: "I knew the mon-keigh would not have believed me if I had told them about the treachery of their loyal watcher of outsiders. They would have ended my Path. My life. And the children of Crudarach would never have learned the truth. But... would the elantach have believed me?"

08b7223e-dc6e-4983-8d6b-741bc051801d.Text: "I did not fear oblivion before, knowing that my soul would one day become one with the Infinity Circuit of Crudarach and join my ancestors. But now... now I am shamefully afraid of every battle I have to face."

cc2887bb-25d4-4aca-9c61-89847010597a.Text: "Oh, Asuryan, why would the Farseers do this? The mon-keigh are not the only ones to blame for the death of our home! Our own leaders condemned thousands of precious souls to suffering! I... I..."

f73b745b-4ed0-4967-aa48-42e1711fbf80.Text: "My poor little cousin! You were so desperate to save your spineless kin, yet all you did in the end was fail them, fail yourself, and even your curious companion, your elantach."

d5a91e86-50fa-43a3-aecd-efe75407abbc.Text: "I... I failed them all. Could I have acted differently? Would it have mattered?"

668024fa-5489-4936-8255-7b226486137f.Text: "Relax and enjoy the process, cousin! Pain and suffering is the nectar that will save your soul, not your paltry baubles!"

a5cd0228-8784-4185-906d-b1c7bda67f31.Text: "I stumbled. I almost lost myself. I do not want to bring pain any longer — to myself or to others."

2ed2f277-304a-4a6d-9e03-880b89f03d66.Text: "The home that I lost. The kin whom I could not save. And the elantach whose predecessor was to blame for it all. Fear and despair took hold of my soul. I had to do something, anything..."

d2030448-72c9-4cbe-8bee-7de81dd24f7f.Text: "The memory of a loss is always stronger than the memory of a gain, especially when you lose something as significant as a home. Or an entire world."

f3647125-53ee-4e57-a66f-afbd01ec7c4e.Text: "I paid the price in full. I have lost myself and even... my meditation. Neither my soul nor my body may know rest now."

6e7c7d63-2aab-40b6-9669-b79c5bfc89a2.Text: "Do not wait for me, {name}. Go. And I... will sit here for a while longer."

26c51d5b-331a-4d62-a165-3d4e6d5d519d.Text: "Your soul shines brighter than the stars, {name}. It is a pleasing light... warm and inviting. I am glad I was not wrong about you."

13e514db-ceed-4338-a854-16524530827e.Text: "Every time I immerse myself in the depths of your world, I feel my soul fill with serenity. Warmth. And... relief."

706051c1-8f42-4395-8282-92e0d063cf1b.Text: "When we meditate together... the pain in my soul recedes. Do you feel the same?"

5d16071c-10d9-4497-b20f-ecde63b4388f.Text: "Let go of everything, elantach. Doubts. Fears. Emotions. Cast off the weight of your body. Clear your mind."

d3e08786-c7f4-4339-951e-8237102774e1.Text: "Good. Now try to look inside your soul. Look at it, shining timidly, and... dive in."

a94be4ab-db0f-47cc-b55f-c12f4fa798cc.Text: "You haven't heard? The Rogue Trader's new pet forced some of the servants off the lower level. That's where she lurks now, in the shadows."

0a99a2fe-d90d-49b2-ba6b-711d5107638e.Text: "Hey, didn't that xenos scum use to skulk around here?"

db4b96bd-1a85-4fc9-94a2-c3980a4b09ea.Text: "Instead of admiring themselves, mon-keigh should direct their gaze to the world around them more often."

87bd2a57-acf9-496b-b23b-cb93577d98c2.Text: Dispel the turmoil in your soul

21e7d8e4-5e85-47f1-86e8-7b7499a3bffd.Text: Accept and let go of your doubts

3bf58478-aa80-48cc-b98c-4a1cab993004.Text: "More Aeldari claptrap. I wish I'd never asked."

cc9a3d80-c363-4498-9135-7330b65be412.Text: [Close your eyes, empty your mind, and speak the word] "Li-lae-than..."

34914536-a10b-406b-a89b-9b794f394e83.Text: "I never expected to hear you say such things in reference to me."

1a94627f-d7ce-4f07-9336-ad87c9a308aa.Text: "Paying me compliments now? So you are attracted to me!"

bc65f98c-0ddc-4718-a86f-833fa12759e3.Text: "Thank you for telling me how you see the world."

d0a6590b-fa60-4d45-bab9-2dec24e715e8.Text: "You have come too late for an audience, Yrliet. My receiving hours have long since ended."

182349ad-6c2c-4435-b4d8-0e1633ae365c.Text: "I haven't understood a word you've said."

9991dd21-90ec-4703-820b-86b1510f2f71.Text: "Remind me: what is it I asked you?"

fc035039-c015-4e67-b365-de12544b839d.Text: "Of course. If you are ready to give it."

1e0f6076-5fb8-46fa-b0fd-b4270f0c5b87.Text: "I think I am beginning to understand."

82017050-362b-4df8-bd14-8e1b259acc4a.Text: "I try not to think about you at all — and I will order my crew to do the same."

18b15010-aa85-4285-9199-05259864b821.Text: "A foolish question. The world belongs to Humanity."

a3ea34e2-a73a-4446-9097-33efb63743ee.Text: "Oh, that... The topic no longer interests me."

4b9dee55-9ddb-406e-bec1-9a2db7e7edc7.Text: "I see you as an intelligent and highly dangerous being. An ally, at present."

0b214fa8-b5f5-4987-9a8c-221e16a98d2d.Text: "I find I am especially drawn to imperfection and destruction."

4666150a-2933-4be4-926b-06c784aaec3b.Text: "I see the suffering of those around me, and it compels me to act."

cdd28650-7470-4fcc-b64f-9ceab6e6f60a.Text: "I see the uniqueness of every creature, every thing. And it pleases me."

876269c2-caec-4487-b161-f9182617b14a.Text: "I also see something greater in the world around me, something deeper than the outer guise of things."

af2f2f1b-c4b4-49c1-bb58-77854ceca9cb.Text: "To me you are a foreign yet beguiling world, Yrliet. I hope that one day I will come to know you. And on that day, my own world will become much deeper."

2e5d3a2a-bad5-410d-9480-7d0de15aa0b2.Text: "You are beautiful and alluring. I like you."

8d23bb59-9606-4a26-9aed-f3f935eedf7d.Text: "The world is full of random occurrences. I recognise this and surrender myself to the courses of fate."

84a81d6c-6723-4ea7-9fe8-6187d8f39f25.Text: "Do not worry, I am not attracted to you in any sense of the word."

ca499576-8179-4297-8aaf-f5695d203de2.Text: "Your appeal is... unusual. It springs from within, evoking disquiet... and a craving to know what is hidden from my eyes."

ed6489fe-5ef7-46d2-bc7f-d97ff54a2819.Text: "In this world of endless war and peril, I see only one beacon of hope, and that is the God-Emperor."

1a6c20c7-ad55-4a47-a506-60695afdf7ac.Text: "It is a word like any other — there is nothing special about it."

74403c23-93cb-41bf-8539-33e2e388e596.Text: "Thank you, but no. Is that all you wanted to say to me?"

b9237e94-0207-48a5-87a4-82d32878aa44.Text: "I believe I am tired of this conversation now."

573ee325-dabd-4d2c-b00e-204b41eeb51f.Text: "I try to turn my attention to that which delights my ears and my eyes — music, art, wealth, and power, of course."

1d805e89-617b-417d-b2ec-ab8e653ce131.Text: "You posed a question to me not long ago, elantach. And now I am here to present you with my answer." {n}With fluid grace, Yrliet emerges from the shadows of the captain's bridge. Her face seems to glow under the lumen light, her expression slightly more pensive than usual.{/n}

c6f04e47-9edc-4746-89f0-22e009bb5f06.Text: "You try to split the world into pieces, to fragment it: into light and dark, truth and lies, self and other. But I see the world as a single whole, and in this lies its simplicity and complexity. It is not enough simply to see the world and hear its voices. You must understand it."

84a272cc-5a9a-4d90-9a59-d346bc621487.Text: "Instead of the lifeless clamour of monstrous mechanisms, the roar of engines, and the discordant voices of your followers, I hear and attend to silence. It arises in moments of spiritual serenity, and in that stillness we become witnesses to the transformations of our own inner world."

150ecfc2-3668-4f8b-86c2-a1dac7535b69.Text: "I am but speaking the truth, elantach. However, I ask you not to make the mistake typical of your kind — my words contain no insinuation nor any call for you to act. Your soul... shines brightly in this world. I see you, and this will never change. That is all."

a7737c81-18a6-47d8-b6d3-a0444f9fae2f.Text: {n}You almost miss the flicker of disappointment in the Aeldari's eyes.{/n} "This is only the beginning, elantach. I have more to tell you."

8485a86c-b610-42b1-bf23-3cd79ff92b5c.Text: {n}The foreign word rolls around awkwardly in your mouth and, once released, it immediately sinks without a trace in the sea of voices on the captain's bridge.{/n}

6984b6f3-1034-497e-97f0-9b5675a04628.Text: "You are rushing, elantach. Try again. Do not force the word — let it take you with it."

e056f00d-f9b8-4215-9cd6-40a6f61712c6.Text: {n}The Aeldari turns away, but before she leaves she looks at you once more:{/n} "Do not take my words to heart. There is no shame in thinking as others of your kind do. It is much more difficult to follow a different path from the rest."

c60b0cd5-7313-4731-a9fc-4c745fd73a03.Text: {n}Yrliet's face hardens and she puts as much distance between you as she can.{/n} "Our conversation has opened my eyes — your understanding of my soul is just as limited as your kin's. Let us stop there. You no doubt have important affairs to attend to. I will not distract the overlord of the mon-keigh any longer."

4d3fa309-b144-40ab-9686-43519adaf91c.Text: {n}The Aeldari inclines her head and makes a subtle hand gesture whose meaning is unknown to you.{/n} "Some questions are destined to remain unanswered. You no doubt have important affairs to attend to. I will not distract the overlord of the mon-keigh any longer."

8d19c514-ec5f-444c-b98b-ff705d74f8de.Text: "We talked about how we each see the world in our own way. You were eager to know how Aeldari see the world. Do you still wish to hear the answer?"

8b129122-b9c8-4925-9c08-1fe9c30a6ad9.Text: "Then listen closely to my answer, elantach. You may struggle to comprehend what is to be said, being accustomed to revelling in your own might and skewing the world to suit yourself. Pitch your understanding not toward my words, but the sense that lies hidden in the shade of their sounds." {n}Yrliet half-closes her eyes, her words unfurling slowly and melodically.{/n}

f03a852b-0f63-4383-b573-7ceedcf10826.Text: "And what do you make of it, elantach? How differently do you see the world?"

41ff2e85-86f6-4f7f-accd-40a3e3ccec6a.Text: "And in you, elantach... I see much more than just another mon-keigh. Your true essence lies in your will, which is capable of changing the world around you and within you. It lies in your ability to create and to understand your creation, and in your ability to destroy. It lies in what your kin's minds cannot grasp, what their primitive sight cannot behold... But I can see it."

8ac5965b-4201-4d22-8700-64ae9598db51.Text: {n}Yrliet's breath hitches quietly.{/n} "Your understanding of the world is not all that different from your kin's. Perhaps my conclusions about you were premature."

7ec37a6b-e965-47b2-b208-d4d5695fbc72.Text: "Sometimes it is so." {n}Yrliet closes her eyes as though she is sinking into a memory.{/n} "Even the ruins of long-forgotten worlds contain the stories of the past and of those who came before us."
