98369f2a-d555-42ae-aef7-a6acbe5a10c8.Text: "It will be done. 'Jericho' class transports were never meant for battle. The Master of Artillery swears he can destroy the vessel's reactor with a single shot from the main battery, triggering a chain reaction that will completely obliterate the vessel."

6da7dcf8-2e9f-4ab7-86c7-355bf3d75dcf.Text: "As you wish, Lord Captain. I hope nobody else falls prey to their treachery."

8913e608-249f-422e-a699-e86925facc7e.Text: "They said they could feel their fanatical loyalty and... hunger. I figured you might need help and ordered to have a squad of enforcers sent as backup. They found the airlock had been disabled, but managed to pry it open, albeit in a less than delicate manner. Emperor be praised for their ingenuity."

4b0d6c33-c32b-4dfb-8b36-724e1d613a0a.Text: "Lord Captain! We have found the trail of the Elusive Contempt! The ship was sighted in Latotian's Passage. If we go after the pirates right now, we can catch them before those arrogant scoundrels slip away again."

7658135e-a241-4fb0-a8e9-780f257435da.Text: "Lord Captain, the Astropathic Choir has received word about a pirate fleet that is preparing to attack one of our richest extractiums. I believe it's the thugs from the Elusive Contempt again. Their next target is one of the planets in the Silence of Mer-Segrit."

990467b8-35e0-41c3-9187-6fdd81ce4ea9.Text: "My apologies, Lord Captain, but Idira insists on being granted an audience. She seemed quite anxious and headed straight to your chambers. I believe she was muttering something about 'a solution to all her problems.' I could not convince her to wait for a better time, so I am afraid she will be there any minute now."

ce051443-1b57-4316-b418-3fb214623b7c.Text: "Punish them for their disrespect by letting them dock at the farthest and most dilapidated airlock so that it takes them an eternity to traverse the ship."

1316b5c8-dadf-43b9-a417-d1a664b9122e.Text: "Receive the delegation. They may indeed be here on important business."

f1107b61-ee19-429e-8ef5-0aa2437b510f.Text: "Tell them to get lost and learn some manners."

105357b2-b4b5-49d8-9144-9a9c39e14094.Text: "Lord Captain, a transport shuttle bearing the markings of the Adeptus Mechanicus is approaching the ship. Magos Tarzus's delegation intends to board our ship and gain an audience with Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}... This is exactly how they phrased it. He intends, not humbly requests."

1d32d864-d4a7-4193-b4d2-43bceede7ee3.Text: "The honourable servants of the Omnissiah have ignored our request. Such arrogance is hardly trivial, it rather appears to be part of their intimidation tactics."

8638923b-3dd0-44c9-9127-8fc56e020a1d.Text: "Esteemed Magos Tarzus reports that his mission is of critical importance. Logis Opticon-22 on board apologises for the disrespect currently being shown."

7d3143c7-72a5-4b14-8a61-86cb63d120e3.Text: "Many of my tech-comrades neglect diplomacy when interacting with the laity. It is regrettable."

36eab5e8-fca9-4f0b-bf40-ea3d0bca29b0.Text: "Requesting permission to be present at the audience granted to my tech-comrades."

c6df0deb-b85a-4e5f-b6e5-270c3ea23f60.Text: "Lord Captain, sorry to disturb you..." {n}Vigdis pauses, as if listening to something.{/n} "It's pandemonium outside the bridge gate — one of the officers seems to be demanding an audience with you in person. I think I hear Master Werserian's voice... in any case, I wanted to warn you in advance."

70801b98-2cc6-4698-b23f-343b0710ebad.Text: "Will you leave my entourage if I refuse?"

22ca2039-c4b2-4a58-b373-8b0b64e0eb04.Text: "Why is this conversation so important to you?"

838bde7a-b48f-4a6e-878c-9f7323bb0391.Text: "You will have your meeting with Thorbald. Come to the bridge."

cb2be27d-1edf-4f10-84b2-2f3ff96b5402.Text: "The assault is more important. Go look for him yourself if you must."

a9f3f7ac-3a9d-45ee-b67f-9ad964ecff32.Text: "Don't close your ears to my words, Aett-Vater, or we may quarrel! Before we go to the bloodiest of battles, allow me to summon that impudent boaster Thorbald Ironhide to your ship! The world of the cog-priests can wait until two Wolves have spoken their words!"

ec893fe0-0574-417c-8158-4b770333fe53.Text: "That I will, Aett-Vater, or they will call me Ulfar the Wayward, He Who Forgot His Pack."

8bf11977-60d6-4fc7-9f03-ba8c25dc1770.Text: "And if the enemies blow his head off in the assault, who will tell me where to find my brethren? My pack! I must find them!"

567dceb1-9e8a-4386-ac27-0822fad8685c.Text: "That's better, Aett-Vater! We'll talk to the brazen blowhard first and crush the heretics later!"

68ac1be6-1ab5-4e36-8d76-a4f54a4cdf29.Text: "Farewell then, {name}. May Allfather guide your hand. I hope our paths will cross again so you and my brethren can meet."

28dfcdd4-06b8-42c8-b579-5f41f6c72473.Text: "Understand, Aett-Vater, how important this conversation is. It is my hunting path, and we can either prowl together, or I shall walk it alone. I hope you heed my words, for I do not wish to abandon your warband before my debt for being freed from the xenos thraldom is repaid."

de0cfc4b-c6a3-4f33-bb2f-461b3773a60a.Text: Reta and her people are grateful to the Rogue Trader for {mf|his|her} help.

54a4bbc2-dccc-455e-9f4f-574b499e93ba.Text: "The High Factotum has departed for the shrine, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

0d4b6dfe-c2d2-43f2-b931-0c5a824bdfc7.Text: "Defensive positions! Do not let a single one break through!"

6f54f862-a885-45df-8d38-c3e24553ef83.Text: "Must I really wound myself for this?"

f37cc25d-4bae-428e-a44e-196cc318a306.Text: [Make a small cut on your palm]

e827d36d-2538-4059-a138-b20eb9487d25.Text: "Is this some kind of psyker sorcery?"

83f205b1-4351-4fdf-bfcb-731a70144c05.Text: [Hand back the dagger] "You have my permission to go on this hunt, but I will not disfigure my own body. It carries enough scars already."

d8feca0d-f5b6-4c13-b6c5-dc708cb35a6c.Text: "May your fury and resolve be unshakeable."

bc64ff48-d4ed-48b2-8dd0-5457162b3041.Text: "I trust you, Kibellah. Let us begin."

fe91ed59-bc7e-4ffc-b3ed-55a93505444a.Text: "I would prefer to forgo any interweaving of souls."

26d305e8-7920-4659-9f38-2e8f3abb00b4.Text: "I bestow my blessing upon you and so on and so forth... Can we finish this up now?"

4d7f7b45-1759-4298-bbd9-f6cc7f2bcfc0.Text: "I see... strange things. Within you and without."

3fd009ce-827b-402f-8506-66c4f13980d3.Text: "So I would become a part of you? What does that mean?"

ae44fade-463e-4e23-bbab-27a72ae9153a.Text: "May your loyalty to the flagship be ever our steady guide during this mission."

8f780ee9-1ae5-4264-9212-163c98f291bf.Text: "Be merciful. Those whom you hunt may be victims themselves."

89b49238-626d-405a-aa12-45e0cdf0013a.Text: "You are my Domin. I am your blade, and I am honed by your blessing. My arms are strong while your will is strong. And as long as the Undying One hears your prayers, my feet will go unheard." {n}Her blade kisses her palm, and dark blood begins to trickle and spread over the bottom of the ritual cup that has just now appeared in her hands.{/n}

20ef8b48-6c99-42e0-b9c1-42475afb64c9.Text: "The price of victory, the price of defeat, is always measured in blood. Give the Undying One but a few drops today, and he may prevent your flagship from running thick with scarlet rivers tomorrow."

b636ec78-7e55-4526-aab8-b7b42bba1285.Text: "The twining is the blood oath I have made to my {mf|lord|lady}." {n}Kibellah dips her fingers in the spilt blood and traces a symbol, first on her own forehead, then on yours. It appears to resemble a blade that is cutting through an intricate knot.{/n}

66916817-3454-4928-8d36-6592c6a1c0af.Text: {n}Kibellah thinks for a moment.{/n} "Your body cannot accompany us on this chase, Domin. But your spirit... there is nothing the spirit cannot do. The twining is complete: you and I are now bound by the blood oath. Think of me while I hunt, as will I think of you. Become a thought flowing through my mind. If the Undying One is gracious to us, He will send you dreams, and in those dreams you will see me. If He is more gracious still, those dreams will be truthful."

88385688-9260-453f-b730-179efb2406eb.Text: "Sit down now, Domin'{name}, and listen. Let the ceremony of twining begin." {n}Using a finely honed blade, Kibellah carves an intricate symbol into the floor. She then produces a small bundle wrapped in incense-laden parchment and sets it alight.{/n}

06292d7a-25e3-4116-ab0f-03ae36ee0f49.Text: {n}You perceive a faint smile from beneath the death mask. Kibellah hands you the cup, and begins tracing her finger around the bottom while whispering a prayer:{/n} "Watch now, Domin'{name}. What does thy seeing eye behold in the converging patterns of blood?" {n}She draws your attention to the symbols she has inscribed.{/n}

d5f6f18e-43e8-46a0-80fe-a58feebcd6fa.Text: "As you wish. Then I will be beyond the reach of your will's echo." {n}As Kibellah's fingers make the farewell gesture of the death cultists, she accidentally grazes your shoulder. A jolt courses through your body, dazzling your senses, and you tip over the ritual cup in surprise. The blood spreads across the floor in a strange pattern.{/n}

8b24f56a-0055-4d91-a6d4-955f2699b7e7.Text: {n}You see shifting images in the blood: a spider crafting a fine web, blurred shadows that could resemble either a swarm of void rats or an enraged hound, crossed blades, a card of the {g|Encyclopedia:ImperialTarotGlossary}Emperor's Tarot{/g}... But as soon as your gaze lingers on any of them, reality bleeds through the fluid shapes.{/n}

4caac398-dfb4-4a61-81aa-62b352014862.Text: {n}Kibellah looks at you intently before pulling out a vial of scarlet liquid and pouring it out into the cup.{/n} "The blood of a dozen martyrs, mixed with their tears, sanctified by their dying prayers, and gathered at their final breath. This artefact is hardly as powerful as the Domin's blood, but since you refuse to give yours... this should suffice for the ritual to commence."

55c6c2a6-27b7-4f4b-a0be-dd93d72db704.Text: {n}She snaps in irritation,{/n} "Do not sully your lips with such suspicions. We are neither {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerGlossary}witches nor accursed sorcerers{/g} — we are His votaries, and for our true service, we are thus rewarded. This is no profane psychic art, but the blessing of the Undying One, bestowed upon the spinners of the Bloodspun Web. A thin thread of spiritual kinship that connects the fates of the Domini with those of their shadows."

ef62a9d5-3f3a-44f2-9a1e-36200c00fce3.Text: {n}The skull grins benignantly.{/n} "You are learning to see what is hidden behind the familiar shell. Keep practising, and years later you will be able to see the truth even with your eyes closed."

162bc72a-d8d7-4200-a867-82df1fd6a839.Text: "Your spirit will come with me to the plasma drive chambers while your body remains motionless. If the Undying One graces you, you will hear what I hear, see what I see. You will think my thoughts as if they were your own. But if you shout out to me, if you give me an order, I will not hear it. Only the ripples of your mind can reach me through the winding thread."

3f5ab9e6-8ff5-4337-891a-6c8d49caa642.Text: "One who follows the thread of the Web fights not out of rage, but with a mind as cold as stone. Nevertheless, rage can become a potent weapon in the hands of a punisher. I... understand, Domin'{name}. I accept your blessing."

a2489968-46be-42bf-badf-9aa25194ab85.Text: "I am your shield. Your shadow. Your weapon. Your enemies will find only vengeance in the close embrace of my blades."

77a18e5e-3348-46f4-8a70-fbb5acac4e8e.Text: "There is no turning back for those who have defied the {mf|Lord|Lady} of the Ark, who have traded the arduous path of service for the sweetness of false promises... At least, not commonly. But I will remember your words, Domin."

8b558e25-615d-4057-8e59-dfadf7f3e4c8.Text: {n}The pain gives way to a burning sensation as Kibellah grasps your hand and squeezes it over the ritual cup. But this new discomfort is quickly replaced again, this time by a dull numbness and the faint warmth of blood flowing from your open wound.{/n}

4d47fb79-d42d-4c43-8600-502424f4a6ad.Text: "With our blood, with our will, we shall spin a scarlet web, the symbol of the hunt. May it herald our prey's demise." {n}Kibellah puts the dagger into your hand, and you suddenly feel how heavy your eyelids have become. Your heartbeat slows inside your chest. Her words linger, then rush through your mind in a deluge. The heavy scent of incense envelops you and makes your head spin.{/n}

c406fa78-187f-4d7a-8b73-339f9aa9a1fa.Text: "For the twining to happen, you must first expand your mind, see the unseen, hear the unheard. Those who live and die by the Tenets of the Web often burn sacred essences, and your body is not yet accustomed to them, Domin'{name}. Your mind is trying to grasp at its new boundaries. Do not resist. Breathe deeply. Learn."

dd3d1115-7355-4641-8505-8e6d431f22d2.Text: {n}Kibellah can call it what she wants, but {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Psyker}your senses{/d} tell a different story. A fine thread of psychic connection has stretched between your minds. It is too weak to let you see or feel through another's consciousness, and yet... it is too strong to be dismissed as insignificant.{/n}

a475bcaa-b0ff-4116-8e08-38ee5c3e254d.Text: "Anoint me with your blessing, Domin'{name}, and may the ceremony of twining commence." {n}Kibellah's face blurs before your eyes. No matter how hard you try to focus and dispel the vision, in place of her face, you see a death mask, a broken skull with hollow eye sockets.{/n}

c9afcc74-d3d8-4464-a6dc-82821c7a44fa.Text: "Soon your spirit will be able to follow me. I will bid the servants to carry your body to your chambers, where you will not be disturbed. Wait in silence and safety. For me, the hunt has begun."

796f748f-62e4-43b9-88b5-34cfe05cc597.Text: "Soon your spirit will be able to follow me. Wait in silence and safety in your chambers. For me, the hunt has begun."

7ff9a80c-d9cc-4d2d-956f-c803c737f77c.Text: {n}Kibellah's footsteps fade away, melting into the same impenetrable darkness in which your consciousness is extinguished.{/n}

82632a78-4b76-4d0e-b78e-d5cfef655778.Text: The ambush against Nemesite ended in a bloodbath that left many enforcers dead. The Master-at-Arms was forced to reduce the number of patrols in the engines module temporarily, which caused disturbances among the crew.

3c261173-4bc7-4200-aab3-0b3710212726.Text: Kibellah used her body to cover her Domin from Nemesite's shot, suffering a grave wound as a result.

92012d55-44c6-4c92-b842-9a7c81c56074.Text: "Whole ranks of warriors have feared the Domin's gaze. Rebellions have withered at the wave of {rt_mf|his|her} hand. You are no warriors. You will not withstand {rt_mf|his|her} gaze. Remember that."

09af7682-705b-4551-bcef-1f6e6a8fa602.Text: [Sense the smell hanging over the crowd]

1703b98a-29d0-4929-9f72-9250bf852595.Text: "Which of you was it that dared call the Lord Captain's judgement unfair? I demand to see the accuser."

5c44f1d9-58ca-4c00-a12b-d1f7d7bde2d6.Text: "Already you are rioters in everything but name, and then you ask why you have been shown no trust?"

b23268a6-b321-49c0-9159-a85c7051b8bc.Text: "You should be grateful for having been blessed with both toil and injury. Who would you be without them? Nothing but worthless rabble."

ea5f824e-6a76-4a6f-b235-d52527364156.Text: "Death will claim you all, but not today — unless you are truly keen to meet its embrace."

b0ac9a00-ff9b-468c-b89e-f023e9335b82.Text: [Bare one of my blades] "Do you wish to die? I swear that anyone who follows the mutineers will perish this day!"

79f96bae-154a-4321-8bd6-9f303838eda0.Text: [Use my throwing knife to take an idle swipe at Rapier's face] "Seal your lips, heretic."

404286ae-6a53-4b6f-bef1-16bc39fe85fc.Text: "The Domin takes care of all, for such is {rt_mf|his|her} burden. But {rt_mf|he|she} cannot save everyone."

2ee578c3-ed2b-4d86-bdde-c761b8361c93.Text: "Your seditious words have been heard and will not be forgotten. I hereby chastise this compartment for its profane thoughts."

e2420343-a227-4d7e-82ec-8a05ec3e6fd6.Text: [Reveal my blades] "Do you seek to challenge me? You may try."

7968f4ad-d0fd-44fe-8188-309923ff689c.Text: [But {rt_mf|his|her} voice does not resound in my thoughts]

e85bf0fd-13fd-44eb-8dc0-7d7435cf2896.Text: [Silently watch the Undying One's foes perish]

19dd70b4-8826-4357-b5ca-68874d146e36.Text: [Lose myself in the dance of blood]

a353b55a-cdf6-4efe-962b-3ff6618b187f.Text: [Feel the flowing rage of these poor wretches]

2530ad68-ac92-4ec4-b386-e848e17d06fb.Text: {n}The laypeople press in from all sides, pushing and shoving. Their faces are ablaze with terror and rage, and a violent energy boils through the mass of bodies. This power will be difficult to contain — frightened people are dangerous people. The hunt was meant to go differently, but such is the Undying One's will.{/n}

803fd45c-5527-4664-84f4-006acfe68a8c.Text: "They have the almighty baton. All you have is the source of the power that feeds the whole ship. Why shouldn't they take you for granted? It serves you right, you cowards!" {n}His ugly shriek spills like venom upon the sweating faces as they slowly draw closer and closer.{/n}

2a4ec263-a078-4d54-a0fc-72381723fecb.Text: {n}I take a deep breath, and something stupefying, noxious, and luscious disturbs my senses. This is no ordinary odour, but something subtle and... foul. It carries the same stench as Rot.{/n}

974687d8-50a2-443c-bb68-8993545a3553.Text: {n}Twisted faces and bestial snouts. Stench and spittle bursting from open mouths. Staring eyes, clenched fists, hair standing on end... They are smothering me with their mass, pressing, demanding, lamenting, complaining... They are ugly in their offence, and like all offenders, they yearn to be punished.{/n}

0f8de6fb-b040-484f-a79d-30eff26dc21c.Text: {n}The crowd draws nearer, and Furnace shouts at the top of his lungs,{/n} "Do you hear? They have nothing to say! Even they know we are right!"

57f94934-1767-45da-a47c-81cf70f1b5af.Text: {n}Strong. Heavy. Enormous hands whose blows should be feared. A great belly that has become a symbol of his success. He does not starve, so those who follow him will not starve either. A powerful leader, recognised by the whole pack.{/n}

9c34d8f2-2bdf-4db0-9477-d4e666a83d09.Text: {n}I turn my thoughts to {rt_mf|him|her}, for it is {rt_mf|his|her} people that are standing before me. What would {rt_mf|he|she} do, the one whose thread I anoint with my blood?{/n}

53a31782-278b-423f-b124-f5c88b719195.Text: {n}The crowd falls silent as the sacred promise of death reminds them just how precious the gift of life is.{/n}

b5ca381d-e971-4c2f-9e01-289991face75.Text: {n}Faced with the blade, all the strength and authority have been erased from her features. The crowd looks on in horror at the one whom, just moments ago, they had been willing to die for. They have seen how easily her power was overthrown, and they are seized with fear.{/n}

653ec8ad-e33e-4307-a0c2-35d0529ae1b5.Text: {n}They grow still, as though a sheet of ice had formed on the roiling surface of a water tank. No one dares to be the One Whose Name Is Spoken. No one dares to leave the crowd and lose the protection of anonymity.{/n}

448650d8-d78f-4706-af69-6745647cbe2d.Text: {n}My words frighten them — wound them — because they are just. And that makes their anger swell all the more.{/n}

e563fd57-08f7-4204-9e43-9efffeca9e80.Text: "Why are you surprised? Have the officers ever treated us otherwise?" {n}A new voice, sandpaper-rough, tears through the rumbling of the crowd. Its owner is ragged and filthy, and a feverish gleam burns in his eyes. His words inflame the people's minds, like rot feasting upon a wound. Rot cries out mockingly,{/n} "That's because you're afraid of them, but they're not afraid of you!"

bd829da5-a45f-4f07-85fd-0387aab66baf.Text: {n}None of them are steeped in corruption, and so the sweetness of trespassing still intoxicates them. Their minds are captivated by how close they have come to the forbidden. They have not earned an immediate execution... not yet. But do they deserve to be saved? Why save them at all?{/n}

703695a1-663b-4259-8ed4-4db47fabdc7f.Text: {n}I address the one who commands these people and who possesses the authority to execute and pardon. Am I to hear {rt_mf|his|her} thoughts?{/n}

a27617f2-6117-4396-82b6-a58ef6d484c8.Text: {n}But the whisper of the Undying One will not forsake me.{/n}

4ded5c15-2236-442c-9c7a-e075fa1b5cc5.Text: "{rt_mf|He|She} only cares about {rt_mf|his|her} flunkies!" {n}The bile spraying from Rot's mouth sizzles in the workers' minds like acid. It is burning them through.{/n}

3bc4b625-e3b1-4db7-8ad6-20b1a21155eb.Text: "That's right! Deal with it, you lowlifes! They are not afraid of you!" {n}Rot's voice seems out of place in the hanging silence, sounding foreign, bereft of power. The word of the punishment has returned a shred of reason to the minds of the workers, for all is as it should be. Insolence has been followed by retribution. The world makes sense once more, and is no longer frightening.{/n}

8271b746-c598-46ab-a63d-431784d04339.Text: "You see! They're already itching to kill us, and we haven't even done anything yet! They're not afraid of us!" {n}The bile spraying from Rot's mouth sizzles in the workers' minds like acid. It is burning them through.{/n}

96b24ff3-5205-4afc-a2a0-1d3836790ad6.Text: "We will not commit rebellion, but we will not allow ourselves be slaughtered by villains, either. The law and the Emperor are on our side!" {n}A young woman steps forth, slender and supple like a rapier.{/n} "If they want to crush us with the fear of death, let them kill us: it will only prove our righteousness!" {n}The ringing call is a command, pressing itself into their hearts. The foul stench of sacrilege almost knocks me off my feet.{/n}

7aaea1d8-4c1e-4f7c-b2fb-b70e5872de52.Text: {n}She is fragile, but there is a strength in her, an authority, taken for granted and understood by everyone. She is clearly ready to command, with legions willing to die for such maidens, beautiful and resolute as they are. She carries no banner in her hand, for she herself is the banner.{/n}

893d6a0f-ea54-4bcd-af0f-c93ef48901d1.Text: {n}The crowd reeks of flowering treason. I delve down to its root and realise what it is that rejects His will so: His sacred privilege is being attacked. He alone chooses who may journey to Him, but these three... instigators, they are determined to make this decision for themselves, dragging the souls of all around into the fires of violence with them.{/n}

51e22f16-5dbe-4486-b976-3cc39f9eaed0.Text: {n}But the noise around me drowns out my own thoughts and stops me from focusing on {rt_mf|his|her} image.{/n}

757bc126-8004-4dd7-ab27-1305759f0c11.Text: {n}The crowd does not answer. They do not hear me. The sacred promise of death no longer moves them, for they have fallen under the enemy's spell.{/n}

f224c86d-3339-4698-800b-d22a37eed4e7.Text: {n}The spilt blood becomes the tipping point. The crowd erupts into cries. They no longer hear me, for the enemy has them in their grasp.{/n}

45c8bf02-82ab-4958-91a4-8497a572ae49.Text: {n}A hoarse shriek rises above their heads: "Strike down the heretics!" Within moments, the raging mob begins tearing, punching, and trampling the three seditionists, reducing them to nothing but a mass of flesh and bone. This is wrong! I need them alive!{/n}

af656044-e23b-4404-b8d7-509935fa0f8a.Text: {n}The crowd is too enraged, stunned by their fury. Fists rise and fall, each time with more and more blood on them.{/n}

a4d68f1b-dc51-46f2-9f7f-58de39946cc2.Text: {n}It is too late. The crowd is too enraged to fear any more violence. It thirsts for blood, and those I wound scream with ecstasy, glorying in their agony.{/n}

b334917a-ec01-4d9e-823c-5cbe070d6335.Text: {n}My words are drowned out by the bellowing of men looking to kill. I look for those who volunteered to assist me, but they are nowhere to be found.{/n}

e99a4e28-aa98-4b22-bfd8-06e8f658578b.Text: {n}Everything ends quickly and bloodily. This delicate flesh cannot withstand the rage of those who have realised that they were almost sent to their execution.{/n}

f2a8064f-ab62-4e65-accc-f92201089e44.Text: {n}They surround me, threatening, pointing fingers, cursing. They dare not strike, not yet... But already their enormous bulk presses down upon me as the smell of blood in the air grows thicker by the minute.{/n}

10689af0-a1da-452b-81b8-e1b8bcbda4ba.Text: {n}I can bear it no longer. The blades in my hands sing, and blood streaks across astonished faces. I am done speaking and exhorting — I merely dance on the thread that I have spun. I bestow death and blessed wounds. I catch a glimpse of Rapier's cloven face and Furnace's open belly. Rot's severed hand falls at my feet, and its owner flees howling. I dance, and breathe, so freely!{/n}

9c9d2a72-3bc6-4322-bb84-b1ad9e758898.Text: {n}They hear me no more. They cannot, for the poison of disobedience has utterly filled their minds.{/n}

fab2bbbd-2e3f-4122-8352-f42829ff03d0.Text: {n}The crowd presses forward, harder and harder. My breath is growing short, my bones are crunching. Somebody is screaming in my face... I endure the stench.{/n}

f40ba351-de08-40fe-9583-65a25af0774e.Text: "Do they think they can hide their {rt_mf|master|mistress}'s {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Shame}disgrace{/d} behind such threats?" {n}The bile spraying from Rot's mouth sizzles in the workers' minds like acid. It is burning them through.{/n}

462fcd31-1c01-4901-aa95-2058bb2b44ae.Text: {n}That tantalising, elusive scent of rage... It is more than a stench. It is a tool. The weapon of the despicable trio, which they use to influence the minds of the laity. Invisibly intoxicating their minds!{/n}

7c854baf-d337-47fd-97d4-75ff1e40afc8.Text: {n}One voice rises above the others, the voice of a burly, bearded {g|Encyclopedia:Technomat}technomat{/g}, low as the roar of a furnace. Furnace smells of sweat and sacred unguents. He is not afraid, he merely pretends to be. Beneath the shudder of terror, I hear excitement.{/n} "Do we deserve to be executed, my brothers and sisters? Have we not laboured with the sweat of our brow? Have we not perished from the outbursts of raging machine spirits? Why do they call us rebels? Why are we being punished?" {n}Furnace's words make the crowd seethe even more.{/n}

db281731-2a3f-49a1-a779-44a170075c78.Text: {n}But there is something else mixed into their righteous indignation, something that taunts them, excites them, angers them. It is something foul, hovering in the air. Aberration.{/n}

588d13ae-553b-4f73-ac5e-8f72e6d4e521.Text: {n}The flame burns high, for there is strong fuel at its heart. These people have amassed many grievances. The enforcers are cruel to them, for they believe that fear eradicates treason. The officers despise them, for their clothes and hands are filthy. The quartermasters rob them and withhold what is owed to them, for their clan is not strong enough to make demands. They are vulnerable. Their hearts are vulnerable. The Undying One commands us to spin a web to catch such hearts before they plunge into the abyss of treason. And so, I am spinning the web.{/n}

6276797b-d7fb-4f95-ae6a-30c7a405b492.Text: {n}Skinny and scrawny, Rot leers at me with his gaping mouth. He is a nobody who has nothing. His body has wasted away from disease. His hands are five fingers short. His fate is sealed. And that makes him convincing: everyone knows he has nothing to gain for himself, and thus no reason to lie. His poverty is his armour.{/n}

24e5442e-7dd5-4996-90b9-fbe79c105963.Text: {n}They are impudent upstarts who have put themselves above Him... and above me, the Second Spinner of the Bloodspun Web, His chosen servant. The realisation of such audacity burns my very soul.{/n}

ed6d61c7-f4dc-4ab9-ac48-4b0c99a9dbc9.Text: {n}At last, I perceive a glint of understanding and willingness to listen on their pale faces. I point to Furnace, Rot, and Rapier, and I know that no words are necessary as the crowd speaks out for me:{/n} "Traitors!"

7f090ee8-c1da-42c0-bf80-3b26fc63d22d.Text: "We're not warriors. We're common people! And we will not be intimidated by some retired {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Commissar}Commissar{/d}!" {n}Rot's voice seems out of place in the hanging silence, sounding foreign, bereft of power. The image of the posters chills the crowd's hearts: a person can be killed, but a living embodiment of punishment is invulnerable. Everyone gathered here knows that their futile battle is already lost.{/n}

e87cb6f6-b1be-4e18-b879-30cbd36cf95c.Text: [What will the appearance of the survivors tell me?]

960affb7-993a-4eb4-a106-9c8a0b32d64d.Text: [Are Flaming Voice and Steel Mistress still alive?]

5318f93f-2a58-4cdc-bd70-3b270f708fc5.Text: [What can these corpses reveal to me?]

7e2bf20a-b8ca-4e09-84e2-3ad831ac1192.Text: [It is time for the next step]

bbe41d69-20de-4cef-9aae-d37eecffff70.Text: [I draw the beginning of the Spread]

e53f900f-1d68-4496-9342-ce080276aaa6.Text: [I draw the heart of the Spread]

3029fa27-1aa0-4ded-b90c-780386032a46.Text: [I draw the end of the Spread]

f07fa4c7-df29-4ba2-ac59-eb71534c94dd.Text: [Suffering will banish all that besets the labyrinth]

d506b2de-ef63-4c60-8756-d2c485ce2f34.Text: {n}It did not go the way I had planned. The smell of blood lingers in the air like the stench of impending defeat.{/n}

afeea63a-a3b0-4002-af89-4021c96bfc7f.Text: {n}Two bodies are sprawled before me. I have severed their threads. The third blasphemer has managed to escape, but his disembodied hand also lies on the floor. Useless meat.{/n}

db2ce9e3-daea-44b9-8af8-2236f022f2e1.Text: {n}They huddle in the corners, terrified of my blood dance. They no longer think of rebellion, only of the keenness of my blades.{/n}

75c31f62-a9a8-4d7b-87c3-420be4804f31.Text: {n}They huddle in the corners, ashamed of their own subservience. They tried to convince themselves that the blood they so foolishly spilt would absolve them, but... they know it is not enough.{/n}

ff7fd796-0844-4608-ae6e-9cd0fd047aa9.Text: {n}Their threads have not yet been cut. I realise with astonishment that they are standing close to me. Flaming Voice is furiously reproaching all those who had only recently joined the revolt, while Steel Mistress booms like a siren, shaking her maul and threatening punishment. They are useless to the hunt now.{/n}

cf590052-fda9-40e7-b0f5-9cd269777e50.Text: {n}Very little. The faint traces of the vile mutations that twisted their bodies. The foul stench of corruption emanating from their meat. The deformed, strangely coloured brains in their crushed skulls that spawned the heresy of sedition.{/n}

2e59bde9-d3ae-4ce2-9d7e-7e2fed0b438c.Text: {n}A thrill runs through the strands of my consciousness. Is this... Domin'{rt_name}? Can I truly feel {rt_mf|him|her} again, or am I imagining it? I need to concentrate. I gaze at the puddles of blood and the patterns they form. I see... I see... a labyrinth. The Undying One has given me a sign!{/n}

a477edf7-836b-4d24-bbad-659ef1816b17.Text: {n}A stream of blood gushes across the floor, and His Tarot cards lie on the carmine splatter. Everyone is silent and stares at me. I am reading the omen.{/n}

bafe0d97-c44c-4f85-9feb-80c06962fa6c.Text: {n}The Hound. I gaze at the card and at its depiction of the Astra Militarum armoured vehicle that bears that formidable name. The pursuit of truth, sacrifice, and victory — this is me, and I am on the right track.{/n}

7a63504b-6af8-490c-b06c-bd513339e0fb.Text: {n}The Harlequin, inverted. Lies, manipulation, a shadow play blocking my path. But it is a lie exposed — a deception that must be revealed.{/n}

8213cfee-54ed-4305-a8d0-b979f5f50567.Text: {n}The Preacher. A man who carries an idea and proclaims it... But who is it? Nemesite? One of his supporters? Someone already slain or someone still alive? The divination is unclear, and so I draw a fourth card. It is dangerous to ask more of the Undying One, but I must know!{/n}

da0daa5d-cdaa-4c8e-b3ae-e61c3fa441a3.Text: "The Undying One has manifested his omen in the traitors' blood. The hunt that has begun will be completed by the unveiling of a great deception. Our enemy is elusive because he has a powerful ally, one who espouses faith in the Emperor on this vessel. The ship's confessor is in league with Nemesite. He will be the next prey."

fee01b8c-91a7-45f9-a874-b62df4403442.Text: "Adalbert. That scoundrel! I will prepare a team of enforcers to arrest him, but I need the Lord Captain's authorisation. Impressive display, Mistress Kibellah."

faa09118-ff25-46fc-b2b2-d2caf8ec1d0f.Text: {n}Thoughts of Domin'{rt_name} crowd my mind, irrelevant and harmful though they are in this sacred moment. I do not immediately realise how foreign they are to the here and now. Why am I thinking about {rt_mf|him|her}?{/n}

8654809f-b5fd-4641-8791-fe6246f6167f.Text: {n}Thoughts of Domin'{rt_name} creep up from the shadows and leap at my focused mind like a predator. They claw at it, robbing me of my concentration... Why? I must not think... about {rt_mf|him|her}! I must not wish for {rt_mf|him|her} to be near me right now!{/n}

7d5ba623-9281-4630-bf84-f9abdbc03f1e.Text: {n}The knife renews the vows inscribed on my skin. There is no pain now, for I am beyond this, but the memory of it still clears my mind.{/n}

45c6d96c-d4a6-4e4a-ae55-74218a5de451.Text: {n}I whisper a silent prayer, and a capsule soaked in blessed stimulant slips under my tongue. The fog of enlightenment hides Domin'{rt_name} from my sight.{/n}

223d04ee-bea1-42fc-a922-8b7d51e28e11.Text: {n}The image of Domin'{rt_name} comes into view, and I gaze upon it for an inexcusable length of time. I did not know that the bond between us would be so... strong. The Vizsier did not warn me how important and precious it might become. I give into my weakness, and the confusion in my mind lessens.{/n}

f099f204-588e-4b5e-a38f-f4ccb492e8b1.Text: {n}I should be thinking about the hunt, and yet my thoughts now lie only with the moment when I will stand before Domin'{rt_name} once more and tell {rt_mf|him|her} what I have seen. Will {rt_mf|he|she} be proud of me? Will {rt_mf|he|she} be pleased? This is wrong.{/n}

b79d13cb-f13c-4b31-9478-8f166de9a02f.Text: {n}Three broken bodies lie before me. The crowd tore them apart, squeezed the life out of them, and rendered them useless.{/n}

4be4ef35-f1f3-49a1-9866-8ecd93c924a6.Text: {n}My hand finds the sealed case in which {g|Encyclopedia:ImperialTarotGlossary}His Tarot{/g} cards reside. It is time for a divination in the blood of the dead — it will reveal to me the name of their unholy master.{/n}

1d06a650-27e1-4ae1-bee0-bfcd8b88afea.Text: {n}The Aquila. His holy image watches me from within the card, and my heart grows frigid with the knowledge of what it represents.{/n}

b8a9c480-538e-4627-862a-f9c1653af352.Text: [I know how Whip's thread will end]

106f0402-9bb8-48a4-9a95-032c25b12c04.Text: [Whip, what can your scars reveal to me?]

3498b204-beb2-4778-9307-bd875fcbdfe4.Text: "Nothing is unimportant during the hunt. Tell me what you know, and I will listen."

e16e5f01-c2bf-43e8-8fe9-088ee153ed25.Text: [Let the enforcers converse. I will keep an eye on those around us]

b71fefa8-bdbc-4b44-801f-538ec7d9efe4.Text: [I breathe in essence made from the ashes and blood of the faithful. It enlightens the mind, granting it the grace of reading His signs]

8567a51a-685f-48ec-983c-bbc0a53b89de.Text: {n}Day after day, she watches the serfs labour away, exhausting their last vestiges of strength. And there is no compassion in her eyes. They are simply a resource she is commanded to use and then discard. She hates them because she blames them for her pain, her wounds.{/n}

6b340755-7c3d-45e8-8398-1f4cab97ff3d.Text: "M-Master-at-Arms! Lieutenant Godierda, ready to present a report as you—"

7f5aba39-2ec5-4c6d-9d5a-bf70fe8eb917.Text: {n}An old burn spread across her body in a scarlet blotch. A look of contempt. A heavy baton, covered in blood and symbolising boundless power. Like a fierce leather whip, she lashes with both her hand and her gaze.{/n}

c20c4cb4-4e70-4ad2-853e-92b7a3bf5d9e.Text: "And Motilda, I presume, is that wonderful, not-at-all intimidating baton on your belt? I guess our disguise is working, but I would rather not spend the next few watches in the medbay because of a misunderstanding." {n}His breathing has quickened. Flaming Voice always makes jests when he is nervous... or irritated. Do enforcers infuriate him?{/n}

5b2c0671-b2cd-4bfe-b544-2dc850e5e5fe.Text: "We sealed off the exits and reduced the air supply to the maintenance tunnels to the absolute minimum — now you can't stay in there longer than a few minutes without passing out. There's no way the bastards could have left the plasma chambers. They are definitely in here somewhere." {n}Like snakes, the servants of Nemesite have shed their skin. The red scarf is just a distraction.{/n}

180e3214-2fec-4915-bcf4-c93ccc0438b4.Text: "Keep it down, will you? I understand your desire to curry favour, but do you have to do it so loudly? Mistress Sauerback is already a colourful, attention-grabbing character all by herself."

c33789c2-fdd4-4367-849f-8ed90a232a7c.Text: {n}Some of the people I escorted to the other side looked at me the same way. In the past, I did not understand, but now... Do the laypeople see spinners performing their duty to the Undying One or enforcers performing theirs to the Domin as monsters?{/n}

b8120c93-dc70-4227-9959-1666bd133f2d.Text: "A group of workers wearing red scarves were seen in the compartment just after the attack on the shrine. The foreman stated that they were at work on the freight line. No gunpowder on their clothes, no fresh wounds. Too many of them have started wearing red masks, and it muddles the trail. But we also found some red scarves and bloody rags in one of the shredders only shortly afterward."

2cf07872-f89d-4851-8c09-b4c141b072b3.Text: "Infernus Master? M-Master-at-Arms? Apologies for not recognising you, ma'am!"

6b6e31f8-8409-4e0f-ad98-053b5197b923.Text: {n}The workers hide their eyes. But I can hear the murmurs echoing through the bay. There is an impotent rage in their hearts directed at Whip, for she is the embodiment of the very order they despise. But why do they not realise that the enforcer is a shield as much as a lash?{/n}

da49c0ff-6067-403f-b3cd-904dda52fe66.Text: {n}A portent from Him... The Undying One blesses me to take Whip. The minions of Nemesite fear her. When her soul is delivered to the Undying One, the traitors will feel invulnerable. They will crawl out of their holes and fall into my web.{/n}

444081c9-b050-46a6-a147-34ff28a8dd68.Text: {n}Do I sense... the touch of His will? The Undying Emperor wishes to bestow a revelation upon me in this trying hour. Let His Tarot show me the way.{/n}

e8dfce6c-76ef-492c-b4c8-be9c89ab38b1.Text: {n}A wave of epiphany sweeps my thoughts away, pulling me into a blessed trance. My fingers move of their own accord over the sacred deck and draw a card. It is the Martyr. I see a tear of blood wash over the pale features in the image, and they shift, becoming Whip's face.{/n}

066bce36-6d57-42d1-b6b4-a587b904b53f.Text: {n}The Domin forbade the spinners to cut the threads of {rt_mf|his|her} subjects. I will have to go against the will of my {rt_mf|lord|lady} to protect {rt_mf|him|her} and the ark. And if punishment follows... I am ready to accept it. My duty to the Domin comes before my life.{/n}

af82817c-a071-4178-b3e8-08c7e34a49ec.Text: "What are you looking at, you beggars? You finish your shift, you go to the barracks. You start your shift, you check in with the foreman and get to work before Motilda comes to pat you on the back."

607c9ce9-b589-4d77-843e-92f11f23dd5c.Text: "Don't you dare reprimand my own enforcers in front of me." {n}Steel Mistress clearly agrees with him, but her pride will not let her admit it. She is afraid of appearing weak — of losing control, respect. And by so doing, she may spoil the hunt.{/n}

dbed92c6-da7d-4978-9e25-ea92a0b94965.Text: "Godierda, we are conducting an inquest. Answer the spinner's questions. I hope your report will be useful."

0ab3469c-d688-4ced-b879-418cb4b42803.Text: {n}I cannot sever Whip's thread with a blade, for the serfs would recognise me as one of the spinners and lose all courage. But the spark of the machine spirits in the plasma drive chambers has already claimed the lives of many. I will use this, and thus, the web will be spun.{/n}

f45f4c01-c581-49fe-9e36-51134a444e58.Text: [The thread shakes. The quarry always leaves a trail. We may not see it, but we can feel it]

0263fbb3-c449-4cf3-81c2-90f8fc9a143c.Text: [The web is taut. Know the hunting ground]

fdc910a7-28ae-4e0b-a7f4-09c8b78608e2.Text: [I step silently. Darkness is our ally. Merge with the shadows]

cc68c00d-3918-4544-99d3-9cb6ce53263e.Text: "Instil a false sense of impunity. Convince them that they can and must act now."

b5650d73-fcf1-4a3b-a539-dbb28580d6d7.Text: "Strike out the spark that will ignite the flame."

0713968d-014c-43a9-af42-13870fe3f99e.Text: {n}Stale air. Oppressive noise. The hum and whirr of machinery drown out all thoughts. This place rings with tension... Is it the powerful energy coursing through the cables, or have the wails of the workers merged into a cacophony of indignant whispers and desperate prayers? Lost, mired in petty troubles, unmindful of duty, their voices creak as if covered in rust and their eyes are dimmed by the endless drudgery and lack of light here on the working decks of the Domin's great ark.{/n}

bfe4a021-dc81-4df6-8962-8bcbb4465eb4.Text: {n}I taste the air. The scent of fresh dye with a subtle note of sparks... This is new. Pleasant. The upper decks reek of luxury, but here I feel comfortable. There is something else... This is it. I recognise the smell. Unguent, lho, and burnt meat. Just like inside the shrine. The time has come to spin the scarlet web.{/n}

85509e64-eeef-4f2e-9e92-38107c185d00.Text: "I would not be surprised if the cultist set out on the trail of Nemesite alone. The spinners are arrogant. We are just another soul to them, a gift to offer death." {n}Steel Mistress's voice is hard and cold, like her will. I can see in her eyes that she dislikes me. She is wary. And so she should be, for we serve the Domin, not one another.{/n}

e41a8e95-0c92-4206-a1de-cc5f2ffe78af.Text: "Does this remind you of anyone at all, Jocasta?" {n}This man is enamoured with fire. Even his words sound full of biting flames, and he himself enjoys playing with fire — too much so. They bicker again. Their mutual animosity may disrupt the hunt.{/n}

650df148-21f9-4ef9-93fc-3109cbb8f9d3.Text: {n}To the laypeople, the two are now scarcely distinguishable from the common serfs. In a world where status and privilege are defined by appearance, a single piece of rotten cloth is enough to lower your standing. We will become spectral hounds and follow the trail without drawing attention.{/n}

5c1afa7c-2195-4d67-98c7-33a555375d52.Text: "You can exchange pleasantries later. Lieutenant Godierda is on duty in this compartment. I have ordered her to gather information on all the workers who wear red scarves and who have recently left the bay." {n}This is pointless. The red scarf is not proof of guilt, it is merely a symbol. It could be a trap. I need to find her. I will watch the enforcer and those who are watching her in turn.{/n}

0f33b29e-9e84-43fe-bcae-a9a478c9272d.Text: "Your enforcer knows nothing about life in this compartment. I guarantee it. I have a better source of information, a good friend of mine who knows a lot about delicate matters. It would be easy to get him to talk: he's terrified of pain... and death." {n}Only the faithless fear death. I will not trust him. Let him trust me so that his trust may become a snare for my hunt.{/n}

08c36d6f-751b-4fef-ad3f-24151110301a.Text: {n}I have seen it before. In these murky depths, people become creatures all too ready to devour each other for worldly gains, fleeting pleasures, or imaginary freedom from obligation born from the abyss of spiritual emptiness. The Undying One punishes them through me. Disgusting mutations, abominations, reflections of vice are born in these shadows, and I will be their doom.{/n}

e928f80b-eba1-48ab-93c4-bb2f6370c293.Text: {n}I feel them lurking in the crowd. My enemies. They are cautious. I must find them and let them believe their luck. Then, they will shed their masks, and I will take them down.{/n}

3402265f-ac32-4d75-ad98-da6bcb38ecef.Text: {n}To find the enemy, I must listen. Inhale. Exhale. Inhale. The rhythmic beat of engines and pumps: that is the ship's breathing. That is the ship's heartbeat. Is it strange that I feel at home among the workers of the lower decks, who pass their time like the living dead? {/n}

91b869b8-4383-4bf5-b3c0-6fe5dc976bdc.Text:
{n}The thread shakes.
The web is taut.
I step silently.
May the great hunt begin.{/n}

4f8b1a0e-361b-49a2-997d-f61797ce4995.Text: {n}In the twilight of the chamber, barely illuminated by flickering candlelight, I become like them — the lost, mired servants. They will become unwitting allies in my hunt. Their hopelessness, their desperation, their thirst for survival will become tools for my use.{/n}

451ca1de-4591-4c4e-977a-5800517669aa.Text: {n}I cut them off with a gesture. Their methods of hunting are not mine. But I take the grain of truth from their words and weave it into my plan:{/n} "We need to provoke them into making a move."

06317fc5-da6e-44be-8002-71f8eb7a3588.Text: {n}They look at me in silence. They do not understand yet, but that matters little. I am on the hunt.{/n}

010cdddd-8b1d-41b4-b549-ff134ab86956.Text: {n}This enforcer who answers to Steel Mistress is the symbol of order and obedience in these chambers. She is... standing in the way. When she disappears, my enemies will believe it is safe to strike... and that will be a costly mistake.{/n}

a1775846-3216-43a8-b5b8-c2638f3cba61.Text: {n}Flaming Voice relies on a talker, one who keeps no secrets and fears pain. An unreliable vessel is bad for holding secrets, but good for spilling them. Through him, I will whisper lies to the enemy.{/n}

5d18c78a-0c9a-41f4-a844-828edfb20dc6.Text: "There she is! Welcome to the plasma drive chambers, esteemed holy assassin."

6e179b9a-2a55-46c4-89ec-da15b2fdc1a6.Text: {n}Warmth spreads through my chest. I like to think that it is the connection with which the Undying One bound my and the Domin's fates together. He has blessed us, and we hunt as one.{/n}

29c2381a-3d14-4548-a9d9-dc0782fbcbc6.Text: {n}Footsteps? Two are coming. Toward me. Familiar gaits. Those are the Domin's servants.{/n}

325e469c-81c2-4c5c-9004-3edaf8de837d.Text: {n}They are conspicuous — their clothing attracts the eye. I will use this: let them become a threat that looms over these chambers. Let them stir the souls of the laypeople, in whose hearts the fear of retribution will grow.{/n}

68d80080-a8d5-4461-aeef-ffc2d1a3ae0d.Text: "No matter what being you call to your side, I have the God-Emperor on mine. That means you are doomed."

cf759d13-ea5f-4816-9c6e-eaba1ffd2d7a.Text: "So, we finally meet. At last, I will discover who has been hiding behind the name of Nemesite."

08b21034-c283-471b-b9f6-ec680d235e9e.Text: "I know you. You are the fortune peddler from the freight line who entertained the rabble with games and music."

2dbfe63e-c267-48fa-b2cb-18660c73019c.Text: "You lost. Your battle for the ship's 'freedom' is at an end. Do you have any last words before you die?"

3481b0c8-a154-43c9-9650-f8de4a737b3e.Text: [Smile contemptuously] "Oh, please! You resent that you were born a freak, so now you want to prove that you are just as good as us normal people!"

559e1b43-54a6-49a7-adce-f0ffc5903edf.Text: "Was the man who raised you just as foolish and likely to believe in a fairy story? Did you use him, too?"

9da3a125-76f2-47df-884e-88c5c23922d8.Text: "You sound like a fanatic who simply wishes to die in the name of something greater than himself."

d27b5074-874e-4a2f-b323-218ad2396b05.Text: "You are just another spawn of the aberration cult I eradicated, aren't you?"

01970bdf-dc05-4220-9402-5c2617267424.Text: [Add trepidation to your voice] "I see you will not be intimidated. How about we... make a deal?"

f30a12e5-e3d4-42f6-9446-f598c7e43d56.Text: [Laugh] "I see! You are just another mouthy upstart preying on people's minds."

fb2c86fb-baf3-40f3-ac46-afc34a188dc1.Text: "Vile mutant. You are an insult to the human form."

deb40c23-afd1-41f7-9e91-42e004dbb78f.Text: "There may still be genetic aberrations on board. We celebrated our victory too early."

8b29532b-682c-4524-bf8e-6d9f840a2bce.Text: [Smirk] "Do you even know who I am? Are you aware of my accomplishments? And still you think I can be killed by the likes of you?"

4311d4e9-607c-40e3-b6ed-4e0d45acae6e.Text: [Pretend to wince] "You are right. Everyone knows that I am... unworthy of being in power."

8b608b5e-86ad-427f-a4e3-14242aeec6dd.Text: [Pretend to reach for a second weapon] "Since you are not afraid of dying, I will give you a choice. Do I kill you with my right hand or with my left?"

ba13c456-5ea8-4c94-b46c-ba03ec9cecb9.Text: [Assume the duelling stance of nobility] "You will not be the first braggart that I have put in his place."

0f13a961-8398-4e0e-9c77-f9e3f855a5d2.Text: "This heretic was not just a rabble-rouser. He was a genetic aberration, a mutant!"

45cb58b5-0423-4812-894c-d19e8720d7e4.Text: "I couldn't care less about your drivel."

0652ea4e-b7f8-412f-8840-3328280feb8b.Text: [Raise your voice menacingly] "You lied to people, condemned them to death, and for that, you will be punished. I will speak on behalf of those you have brought to ruin."

f61baec4-448d-4ff1-903e-b17fbc821982.Text: "You are just another mutinous scum — I cannot even begin to recall how many rebels like you I have sentenced to death."

cf986b84-e8e1-4a6d-b83a-5bacae3abf0e.Text: "Surrender, and you will be judged fairly for your transgressions."

78834cb3-f870-4599-ac72-166bebba317e.Text: [Prepare to fight] "You will be the last 'Nemesite' this ship ever sees. I will make sure of it."

4e4ac936-53a4-49d7-81ae-474fc2c485a6.Text: [Nod to Kibellah and act in tandem to deceive the enemy]

2cefdbbe-a59e-4d3b-8e49-a49181b39766.Text: [Dodge the first shot and strike true]

7460a5ac-e7f5-48fc-9e26-ada9276aa8ca.Text: {n}Nemesite is crouching on the ground, clutching at the bleeding wound under his ribs. His tortured body is still strong, and everything in his posture expresses a will to fight on. The red scarf no longer covers his face, and the vigilante grins at you with bloodied teeth.{/n} "Weak. I have yet to be impressed."

efab4aeb-1630-465c-8cc7-c3aa31d996dc.Text: {n}No longer covered by the broken goggles, the hairless skull is bulging with massive growths. However, the mutant nature of your enemy is just as quickly betrayed by an even more unsettling feature: the third arm growing out of his torso. You watch as its fingers deftly empty the drum of a stub revolver and load it with fresh rounds.{/n}

9641ec2d-b4f6-4056-bed3-286c41abadfe.Text: {n}Kibellah emerges nearby like a shadow, blade gleaming menacingly in her hand. She hissed softly, ready to pounce:{/n} "It is your thread that will break today and no other."

4334dddf-f45f-423e-a775-b6acdae71465.Text: {n}Kibellah's gaze is fixed on Nemesite, and she does not notice the look you are giving her. You may outnumber the enemy, but each of you must face the rebel alone.{/n}

cda3ad5c-d3fb-4cff-bdae-ae16478d3c23.Text: {n}The rebel scoffs and spits out a tooth together with blood-streaked saliva.{/n} "You still haven't figured it out, have you? Nemesite is not any one person. It is the vengeance and rage simmering on the lower decks of your usurped ship. It is the servant who cleans your chamber pot, the storage keeper whose family was butchered by enforcers, the train driver who was given half a dozen ration cards in three times as many shifts. It is the name of the one who will kill you, sooner or later. Whoever accomplishes it will be the real Nemesite."

98429f3a-8e7b-4f89-9fca-f542d9d1c234.Text: "Aren't you a little overconfident?" {n}Nemesite casts a glance at the stub revolver in his hand, then back at you.{/n} "You are right in front of me. My gun is loaded. I believe this tune is not quite finished yet." {n}It feels like time has become viscous and is slowing you down. You see the bloody hand of Nemesite raise the weapon, and your body reacts of its own accord...{/n}

9c4228c4-ef37-44d3-bb49-59eebe80f895.Text: {n}Kibellah is watching you out of the corner of her eye. She does not utter a word, but in her posture, in the cold look on her face, in the subtle glint of her blades, you read every movement of the deadly dance she is about to perform. Meanwhile, her slightly shifted gaze tells you that she is reading your tactics just as clearly. Nemesite will stand no chance when you two act as one.{/n}

f553a550-880c-4954-8828-80dc92d8281c.Text: "Save your message for your false god when you meet him, servant of death. I am glad I get to take you both down at once." {n}The second gun is now pointing at Kibellah.{/n} "I vow that your murderous sect will fall along with the Lord Captain."

20616700-66c8-4022-badd-09aa2cfdd899.Text: {n}There is no time to reach for your weapon! You grab a pistol from the holster of the enforcer standing nearby. When you point the barrel at Nemesite, he is already aiming his own at you, a malevolent grin spread over his face. The two black muzzles stare into each other, and the world around you narrows to a thin line.{/n}

53e0fd65-82f1-4d30-aedd-aaa3cf0ce48e.Text: "I... need to reflect on his death, Domin. I need to stand before the Undying One and hear His blessed whisper. We can discuss what happened... after."

6114f78c-7b21-4587-8297-3dc3a8652a8e.Text: "Not only them, as you can see. I also sang glorious songs about the cruelty of the officers, the callousness of the Lord Captain, and the bravery of the selfless Nemesite. Nobody ever notices the pathetic little flute player who always carries a few ration cards for bribing enforcers, do they? Hiding in the shadows of your rotten kingdom was far too easy."

886828a5-782f-4985-a8b3-8411a8139088.Text: {n}Nemesite shrugs, all three of his arms moving with a deadly grace.{/n} "Fate has rewarded me with the ability to kill three of your mutts at once instead of two. I am truly blessed."

ebd49b03-9c36-4667-b712-80d1eca428e7.Text: {n}Something in your voice causes Nemesite's sneer to fade and his gun to shake... but only for a moment.{/n} "I see you have appropriated their names and memories as well. How fitting, to use people even in death."

dd476bb1-ce2a-4f86-a6cc-cc1a06ec61ce.Text: {n}The bright, familiar eyes of the flute player from the lower decks glint with boldness. The humble swindler who used to play tricks on fools with the help of his trained rat now nods at you mockingly.{/n} "I've been waiting for this meeting, Lord Captain."

18152732-0365-45bc-abca-e0b2e6e9fef8.Text: "Nice try." {n}Nemesite grins defiantly.{/n} "But the dead have nothing that the living might want."

c2af7c7e-d2e4-4fc0-88fd-689c583543d4.Text: {n}You lean to the side, and you see the muzzle of Nemesite's stub revolver erupt with fire as the low whirr of a bullet passes over your head. Now, it's your turn!{/n}

3cb3c26b-45be-4e08-a2fb-310bc004f276.Text: {n}Nemesite laughs derisively.{/n} "Freedom? I care nothing for freedom or for the throngs willing to offer their necks to your yoke. I will not die for these wretches, but I will gladly pay for your demise with my life."

18df39c7-4b65-4312-a06c-1c84e6e728d7.Text: {n}Nemesite laughs, his voice full of scorn.{/n} "Then put a bullet through your forehead. That was their ultimate goal, after all!"

3377ef2c-4ccb-41f9-90d9-941dcba02f46.Text: {n}Nemesite hisses in anger, not noticing that his grip on the weapon has shifted slightly.{/n} "Just another? My name is spoken in every bay on this ship. I am more than 'just another upstart.' I am your death sentence!"

138175be-1787-49be-b099-56a905b8a370.Text: "Then you will die at the hand of that same mouthy upstart. What a fitting executioner for such a pathetic victim."

8de1a40b-951c-4e79-8994-c60deb9a79f4.Text: "No, Adalbert believed in what I believe. He was just as willing to sacrifice himself as I am. You disgusted him, and I am proud that he was able to deal such a blow against your paltry authority."

5747f86a-7ef3-41a3-afba-bccf04052e68.Text: "Death is hardly a price. Everyone dies sooner or later. I have given my idea so much more! I have given it my life — every day that I can remember. And that idea is so simple: you and your people must go. Perish in the blood and the filth that you so eagerly spew forth, so that something worthy can take your place. Something that is pleasing to the one true god."

06e58923-93a9-4db1-99f8-722af8f001a8.Text: {n}An angry grimace twists his face.{/n} "Yes, and I will punish you for that blasphemy — for every pure soul you purged, and for desecrating the body of our guide. He blessed me once, and called on me to be a Nemesite and clear a path for the children of the Many-Armed Emperor. You have done the unthinkable. You will pay here and now, because the dead are hungry for vengeance."

634b8fc9-83bf-4bf9-b74f-acca1f7716c8.Text: {n}The haggling tone in your voice brings a complacent smile to Nemesite's face. His trigger finger relaxes slightly.{/n} "You cannot bargain with vengeance, pathetic creature."

eb2d3782-9cc2-4787-a684-4fdf63c63614.Text: "If you knew even a shred of truth about my god, you would already be grovelling on the floor, begging for a swift death!" {n}Absorbed in his zealous rejoinder, Nemesite is no longer holding you firmly in the sights of his weapon.{/n}

e14fbedb-b745-4aee-bd85-937347fc061b.Text: "All it means is that I will kill him someday, too."

9c083bc7-858e-40e2-919f-152098bba747.Text: {n}Nemesite grimaces and snarls,{/n} "If only you knew what you were saying... Yes, my flesh is cursed with imperfection, my blood carries wretchedness, for I could be... But you would not understand, foul-blooded one." {n}The barrel of Nemesite's weapon shakes, but his incensed mind does not notice.{/n}

27f551cd-3c5a-46af-a628-29696616f0d8.Text: "Oh yes, I regret that I was born of foul blood — the same wretched blood that flows in your veins and the veins of your thralls. But such was the divine plan for me, and I am willing to play my part."

a34eba5c-d29c-4d72-8890-a45ed3c893d1.Text: {n}Deafened by the roar of your weapon and the sound of your blood pulsing in your temples, you do not hear Nemesite's own gunshot.{/n}

050c5a90-3871-4d53-b9c5-ae3d930de40b.Text: {n}You and Kibellah move as one, and you manage to confuse Nemesite with a perfectly timed manoeuvre. He is left hesitant to fire... but you are not.{/n}

fbc63e99-2d64-44c8-b5e2-8ac9129c3b01.Text: {n}You sway to the side, see the muzzle of Nemesite's stub revolver erupt with fire, and realise that he will not miss. All that remains for you in this final moment is to attack.{/n}

1ccb90ed-8f8b-4dae-acc5-fe9ea441e728.Text: {n}You pull the trigger, but your enemy is faster. The muzzle of Nemesite's stub revolver erupts with fire.{/n}

fb08a9e7-8701-4650-b5fe-37e9b21f48c1.Text: {n}You and Kibellah move almost as one, but the manoeuvre lacks coordination and precision. You hear a gunshot, and you attack the enemy with a furious cry.{/n}

417ead6b-df5c-49c6-8ccb-9959c5aa02dc.Text: {n}Kibellah takes a deep breath and wipes the blood off her blade. The living legend's head lies severed at her feet.{/n}

1a3085e2-242b-4540-9df3-7ed59433f79b.Text: {n}Once your heartbeat calms down and your breathing evens out, you realise that the bullet that was meant for you... has somehow failed to hit its mark. Kibellah is standing next to you, still breathing heavily as she wipes her blade. A scarlet stain is spreading quickly along her side, blood soaking her clothes and trickling down to the floor. Nemesite's head lies severed at her feet. It is over.{/n}

9e4dadfb-3e76-440e-aeb0-5502c1cd5377.Text: "He did not harm me." {n}Kibellah looks at Nemesite's body with an incomprehensible expression.{/n} "But he tried. Such was his idea, and he remained committed to it until his last breath. His was... a good death."

149098c8-ed64-4d78-825c-bd76f43afe22.Text: "What? I am, but it matters not." {n}Kibellah looks indifferently at the bloody hole in her side.{/n} "This bullet was never meant to cut my thread, for it belongs to you."

2a8ea853-768a-4d65-a3c0-76f3b2ba9d3c.Text: {n}The decapitated body lies motionless on the deck. The cut at the neck stares back at you from the grotesquely distorted ridge of its spine. The power of the folk myth fades into the air like the smoke billowing from the muzzle of his stub revolver.{/n}

c3f099ea-e784-4caf-abbc-38395a6332d6.Text: {n}Kibellah picks up the severed head from the deck and gazes into its extinguished eyes with a strange wistfulness.{/n} "The struggle is not people. The struggle is ideas, and people are merely their vessels — the carriers of the struggle."

55bb48dd-cfac-4275-afd6-e47d5a887d46.Text: "And you do not care if you see it with your own eyes. All you strive to be is a pebble on the road." {n}Kibellah does not ask, she proclaims, as she looks at Nemesite with a strange expression.{/n}

ff1736bc-7763-4aa3-9a7b-eba324cae8d4.Text: "Yes." {n}The caustic mockery vanishes from Nemesite's voice for a brief moment.{/n} "And by becoming a pebble, I will support the feet of all those who walk this road into the future."

2a2050a2-63ee-4a17-840a-8e2cf036fef6.Text: "Both you and your drudges come from the same rotten root. That is why you are so easy to fool. Nemesite and his march against authority are just a fancy story to tell the rabble, a convenient tool for recruiting the wronged and the dispossessed. In truth, all of you must die and make way for those who are truly worthy. More pure, more pious, more courageous than any of you ever were."

a1d40f02-21b1-447c-ad59-8aa2bebffa04.Text: "Then we will find and kill them too. If they are still breathing, they are offending the Undying One. That will be remedied shortly."

914ef0b4-990a-4ab3-a2b8-3605e15cdc98.Text: {n}A tense silence falls, for all the words have been spoken. At last, Nemesite says quietly,{/n} "It's time. Farewell, Lord Captain." {n}The acerbic smile vanishes from his face. Instead, his demeanour turns cold, collected, calm, with the indifferent grimace of a skull.{/n}

d1ba666f-1ad4-49e6-93b1-1da7357f7e29.Text: {n}Time stops for a moment, and then, as if tossed by a blast wave, the events fly forward like murderous shrapnel.{/n}

326b8a2b-e759-4fa8-8561-ed046a59fb5a.Text: {n}The hall prepared for the ceremony is strewn with the signs of battle. The bodies of Nemesite's accomplices lie intermingled with those of the enforcers.{/n}

3fbd4561-2af2-4b1f-b1c9-c73bfe53ec00.Text: {n}You can see it in his eyes: he does know {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_MOT_GreatDeed}you{/d}. He is nervous... but his voice remains as bold as before:{/n} "I know who you are. But you know nothing of me yet."

e34d3d41-086c-409a-9395-ec9901d59fbe.Text: {n}Relishing your {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Shame}self-disparagement{/d}, Nemesite does not notice his finger slowly slipping off the trigger.{/n} "You want to be punished. I can see it. Good, for I am your punishment."

d307ae51-9a8f-435f-a16e-0189da32ea69.Text: {n}Nemesite tensely watches your hand reach for the non-existent backup weapon. Evidently, he is unfamiliar with this {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Criminal}old dirty trick{/d} that has cost so many gullible duellists their lives. As he prepares himself for an underhanded attack, he divides his attention, still smiling brashly.{/n} "You only have two? That is not much of a choice."

93dd3bd0-d8e5-416d-8ff0-f33fee3982a8.Text: {n}Your confidence and unmistakable experience in duelling — which, in turn, serves as a shining example of true {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Nobility}aristocracy{/d} — causes the lowborn freak to squirm anxiously, and you notice his grip on his weapon beginning to slacken.{/n} "I've never killed anyone as highbred as you. I look forward to it!"

f6a68416-3fea-4652-8869-e041e6917f2e.Text: {n}There is no time to deliberate! You draw your weapon and assume a stance, preparing to charge. But Nemesite is already aiming his gun at you, a malevolent grin spread over his face. The black muzzle of the stub revolver stares at you, and the world around you narrows to a thin line.{/n}

4d439e11-e334-4082-88d7-e8a60fca84d5.Text: {n}There is no time to deliberate! You summon your gift, concentrate your psychic power at your fingertips, and raise a hand in Nemesite's direction. The air grows frigid, but the rebel is already aiming his gun at you, a malevolent grin spread over his face. The black muzzle of the stub revolver stares at you, a coating of frost forming along the barrel, and the world around you narrows to a thin line.{/n}

e3b58b8d-c254-420b-b01e-67e43fda19ef.Text: {n}There is no time to deliberate! You draw your weapon and point the barrel at Nemesite, but he is already aiming his own at you, a malevolent grin spread over his face. The two black muzzles stare into each other, and the world around you narrows to a thin line.{/n}

a28f18ba-181b-4106-90b1-b4746a1dfea2.Text: {n}You dash toward Nemesite, trying to move unpredictably. He fires his stub revolver, but the bullet whizzes past your head.{/n}

abb2a786-22a3-42a1-82b2-05925cbc11e2.Text: {n}You dash toward Nemesite, trying to move unpredictably, but the muzzle of his stub revolver adjusts to your erratic patterns. A shot rings out.{/n}

3a951294-558e-483d-bea9-0bf3ea41c147.Text: {n}A cascade of purple sparks erupts from your fingers as your will takes shape and power in this world. Nemesite's eyes fill with rage and fear, and he hastily pulls the trigger, blinded by panic.{/n}

c632bce7-25c4-4545-81c7-df90dfc994fe.Text: {n}A cascade of purple sparks erupts from your fingers as your will takes shape and power in this world. Nemesite's eyes flash with desperate rage, and then a shot rings out.{/n}

172df748-58ac-4ecd-9171-d8223909f20d.Text: "Deviation from true human form mutilates the soul as much as the body. It should not surprise us that the heretic leader was the most malformed of them all."

82d45e7f-3761-4887-93b3-6637f4b42663.Text: {n}The corner of his mouth twitches in displeasure.{/n} "Until your pet Inquisitor started sniffing around who I was and messing up my cards. You surround yourself with useful servants, yes? Well, I am surrounded by comrades — loyal and brave — who risked their lives to conceal me."

fc5f255e-8e80-4eeb-8eee-c836e3769da5.Text: {n}The icy calm in your voice proves more effective than any threat. Standing before an {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Arbitrator}implacable judge{/d}, even this most foolhardy of mutants succumbs to momentary fear, enough to cause the aim of his pistol to veer off slightly.{/n} "I am delivering verdicts today, and yours will be the first!"

4774b834-7337-4d37-bb85-16a4d28b2c52.Text: "And who might you be, madam matriarch?"

eff4643d-aa41-4948-b444-28f0dc3b5ce8.Text: "So, why would Sauerback entrust my safety to someone so... advanced in years?"

49083c59-515e-4daf-bf2f-1135752c048a.Text: "Do you believe Nemesite will fall for our ruse?"

9ad048ae-e98d-4f9a-aeee-636708410bdf.Text: "I am bored. Perhaps you might amuse me with a story."

a4d8ae06-9911-4e51-bc0c-0bf9b052a4aa.Text: "You could have drowned an innocent man in porridge."

1bcdc504-d567-4fca-a47c-5a9af6e5385b.Text: "What a delightful tale! Give me another!"

4c289cad-966e-4200-8aa6-c8de19263390.Text: [Look at the participants in the ceremony]

3565e2f4-8247-478b-90b1-1f335d9df096.Text: "Perhaps you should have climbed into an empty vat."

0a0646ce-a0f0-4d43-9200-0533e978b97f.Text: {n}The rows of disguised enforcers are listening to the confessor's words in silence. All around you are Sauerback's chosen people, each dressed as a member of the officers' families. Close by, a kindly-looking old woman is fumbling with a starched handkercher. Catching your eye, she smiles with a mouth that is missing half its teeth, then whispers,{/n} "Everything is going as planned, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

65ea100d-64da-4d92-bbe0-266604b66bdb.Text: "Oh, the stories I could tell... I remember, in the early days of my time in service, someone started poisoning the food in the kitchen. We couldn't catch the vermin, so I came up with an idea to get into a vat of protein porridge and catch them unawares. I was a small and skinny little thing, so I climbed into the vat and sat there up to my neck in porridge. I waited a long time before someone lifted the lid. It wasn't one of the kitchen servants, but a man twice my size, carrying a bag of foul-smelling stuff!"

a45c5419-8a18-4db4-a25e-e6c52bce0a6a.Text: "Belinda Traufgold, Lord Captain. Transferred from the enforcers with the rank of senior lieutenant to the staff of Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}'s quarters on account of my age and declining health. But, as you can see, there's no such thing as a former enforcer." {n}A friendly smile stretches across her bloodless lips.{/n}

b5660629-3436-4e2f-95f2-7c56dd093c5e.Text: "I guess the Master-at-Arms remembers how Belinda used to be the best shot among the enforcers back in the day, and knows that my eye and hand have not diminished over the years. I spent forty years on duty, and to this day, I can tell if a man is carrying contraband in his pockets just by the way he is walking."

7b3592ed-337b-4030-81e6-68f96fc2095c.Text: "I am grateful to Mistress Sauerback for the honour. I don't want to die in my bed. Let me fall in battle, defending the Lord Captain and crushing traitors." {n}Belinda gives an imperious yet absent-minded nod and dabs her eyes with the handkercher.{/n}

50d47253-c492-434f-ba2e-a1b8bcf5cd17.Text: "Judging by the way that serf in the back row keeps glancing around, our Nemesite has swallowed the bait just like the void rat he is. The porridge will hit the fan any moment now." {n}A most benign smile crosses her face.{/n}

3be6e807-0738-47a4-91e8-deb7853e4eac.Text: "And that was it! I grabbed him by the shoulders and dunked him into the porridge. I held the brute down until he passed out. The Master-at-Arms back then, he lauded my ingenuity and commended me for apprehending the poisoner, but he also took the cost of the porridge out of my wages."

adef85e2-8401-48c4-af3a-7bec623ff695.Text: {n}A loud and menacing voice booms through the hall, cutting short the sacred words:{/n} "But not today."

5b442363-6959-4130-87a4-1fd027e91d63.Text: "What kind of innocent man would skulk about a kitchen where food was being poisoned? If he wasn't a saboteur, he was a thief. Either way, he wasn't there to season the porridge, that's for sure."

b5ac7d41-a0b1-400f-a738-ea25ef9bacbe.Text: "You're not wrong! But I was young and foolish, and thought only of how I might nab the culprit."

385eef2d-b96e-405f-acba-e525607a569e.Text: "Don't be angry with an old woman, Lord Captain. I'm an enforcer: nobody taught me how to speak glibly. My talents are of a different kind."

de4197f3-5558-45a0-b95c-291de63f6835.Text: "I'm afraid we don't have time, Lord Captain. We must be vigilant — the treacherous scum is about to reveal himself."

d39fa5ee-9c76-424c-a516-7bb91ad332a0.Text: "And may fate protect the Great Beacon..."

9a6afa41-089f-4300-a79e-7a3204aa18a0.Text: {n}The ceremony comes to an end. The vows are given and the forehead of every officer is graced with the touch of the confessor. Now comes the moment for the closing prayer.{/n}

4af29945-5e21-4d5e-9a20-fe8dfd673cfa.Text: {n}The facade is holding, with everyone playing their role perfectly. The Master-at-Arms must have instructed them thoroughly and shown them how best to conceal their weapons. All of them are wearing their best, and even you cannot tell where they are hiding their armaments.{/n}

8215ecd2-8337-442f-a343-520c1ef8a04c.Text: "The blood's whisper? Did you perform another divination?"

90f37cbc-7904-4a84-adbe-9e0d63c4bdd1.Text: "See, Jocasta? It seems to me that your enforcers could learn much from these death cultists."

699e1ff2-7cdc-42df-81cb-2d37385aec68.Text: "And you gleaned all of that from a couple of bloodstains? Or did you have a vision?"

c2e3e347-826d-4dca-b30f-aef8d38fab68.Text: "Kibellah is right: it would be prudent to use a disguise."

d551af26-47c5-4970-8edd-c6df22e35f72.Text: "Disguises are overrated. You will do just as well without one."

05c29c4c-5d9b-4845-b898-657b97ecb1be.Text: "So we still have no idea where to find Nemesite."

6ec81f7d-58f3-4602-a4cf-7b77955cf625.Text: "The plasma drive chambers? Are you certain?"

d996d8a3-32a8-4954-97f4-e72f25293678.Text: "Sauerback, gather the enforcers. We will follow Nemesite's trail."

85a1884e-c2d0-4302-aa9a-273069f33e8f.Text: "I do not have time for this right now."

b0698914-27e4-48dd-ad50-0a10d4c5bad8.Text: "So what do you suggest we do, Kibellah?"

7845da3e-d7b4-4e2d-8062-5285bace0df0.Text: "By the power vested in me by the Holy Ecclesiarchy and in the name of the God-Emperor, I hereby sanction a sacred hunt be performed in pursuit of the heretic who calls himself Nemesite!"

5ce78a8b-ffe4-4af0-96fe-5ce54a8bd1f9.Text: "The Cult of the Ravenous Star used the same compartment to assemble and store weapons. This cannot be a simple coincidence."

5dd2a0ce-905e-4f0d-925b-38d355ef035c.Text: "If the attackers have escaped through the maintenance tunnels, we can send in the enforcers after them."

75e03f01-93a8-4aa8-8e22-73f4a81e5a47.Text: {n}Einrich watches the limp body of the Factotum get carried away and chews grimly on the {g|Encyclopedia:Lho}lho{/g}-stick that has appeared between his teeth.{/n} "So, what do we have so far? Master Danrok is on his deathbed, all the attackers are either dead or have absconded along with the sacred relic, and the witnesses all agree on this one thing: Nemesite and his accomplices came out of nowhere and struck suddenly. Only the Throne knows where we can find these bastards now!"

07d2114f-a520-4075-835c-e501ba2be36e.Text: "We will find them." {n}Sauerback's voice is full of terrible fury.{/n} "We will turn this vessel inside out if we must. There is nowhere even a void rat can—"

49db2e67-d0b2-491e-8545-a47d3514f47d.Text: "Yes and no. His Tarot guided me here and told me of the evil that lurked in the shrine. But beyond that... the bloody path carelessly tread by the raiders will reveal the truth."

82948a3e-d3ea-4656-a9f8-03efdac78552.Text: {n}Her steel claws dig into the dead man's arm.{/n} "Your wound holds the answer. You dressed it carefully... Not inside the shrine. Before that. Something struck you, ripped the tissue apart, burned you, turned your hand into a worthless lump. It was not fire, no." {n}Drawing a ragged breath, Kibellah opens her eyes.{/n} "The fury of the conductive charge. It has marked you, heretic. I recognise your wound, for I myself have encountered it on those I take to the other side within the plasma drive chambers."

13d6d6fc-6bc0-48ef-a78b-f2f36f640b40.Text: "I can't say if it's worth drawing conclusions based on a conversation with a corpse, but if it is, then I concur with the esteemed spinner's findings." {n}The Infernus Master spits out the chewed-up lho-stick and immediately produces another.{/n} "All that about burns, the conductive charge, and the smell of cheap lho immediately made me think of the plasma drive technical compartments. Makes sense to me."

8b102e3c-ab3a-4a2b-93e5-113a9258712d.Text: "There is no need for revelations from the Undying Emperor here. For one who has dedicated their life to understanding the Tenets of the Web, death speaks a language clearer than any words. Blood writes the chronicle of the final hour, and it holds all the answers. It speaks to me. It can tell me with what instrument it was spilt. What its owner felt — whether they struggled in terror or were as cold as the steel of a blade. At what moment and how the thread snapped. For a spinner, no two wounds are alike, and each scarlet drop carries a message from the Undying One."

193f4621-e6e4-49d1-bd02-206ddcbedc6d.Text: "I'm glad she's on our side." {n}Einrich scratches the back of his head, smiling wryly.{/n}

b48d2ed8-45d5-4354-ac15-68f661e952a5.Text: "The enforcers will procure regular work clothes for us. We will carry only inconspicuous weapons that we can hide easily in our tool bags. It will help us blend in with the crowd."

ca5adb5f-2b92-4d30-bef7-fd5aa5c3cd5e.Text: "As for this pattern..." {n}Kibellah points to a barely visible chain of scarlet droplets.{/n} "It was made in fury and desperation. The one who left it was wounded, but they did not flee. They fought back while they could, and then they retreated... into the darkness..." {n}Kibellah's eyes close and she falls silent, then she exhales sharply and points a steel claw:{/n} "...into the darkness of the maintenance tunnels hidden within the walls of the shrine."

215105e5-3314-4355-8c78-7b70715267f8.Text: "I'm going too. I have a couple of... good friends in the plasma drive chambers, the nosy kind who know everything about everyone. Convincing them shouldn't be difficult, especially if I pull a few favours. It'll be the three of us, then. What a company!" {n}Einrich's grim laughter echoes inside the shrine.{/n}

e5a4f611-6999-4864-a5de-20d8770c5092.Text: "The rite of blessing for the sacred hunt. With it, the Domin casts their shadow over the path of carnage. Under your benediction, I will strike harder and tread more softly."

951aecff-1017-49b1-9823-c0148bef8a9b.Text: "Before I depart to hunt for Nemesite, I ask the Domin to bless me. I pledged never to leave your side, yet the hunt demands that I do just that. Grant me this permission by performing the ceremony of twining." {n}Kibellah nods toward the altar.{/n} "When your people have taken their leave, under the gaze of the Undying One, we will begin the rite."

0122f455-f155-437d-800e-6bdbcb098c0a.Text: "No, Domin'{name}. You must stay. You are the one that Nemesite has challenged, and those we hunt know you by sight. You will frighten away the prey, and we will lose the trail until the next tragedy occurs." {n}Kibellah's unblinking gaze meets your own.{/n}

150f3652-68ee-49e6-ac90-84c35b47b0f9.Text: "The Undying One has blessed me with the ability to see the truth in death. How can anyone doubt the revelations His blessing bestows?"

b66d720a-e1b6-426e-9fff-cf733f718c59.Text: "Out of the question. An enforcer squad would certainly scare off the vermin, but I am not letting you go alone, servant of death. You and I will go to the chambers together, and together we will bring down all who have dared to insult the Lord Captain."

09cdaae7-0905-454c-b74d-0a79d5433298.Text: "I will go to the plasma drive chambers alone. I will track down the false champion and all who serve him. And I will prepare the grounds for your own hunt."

c9720062-90f6-4e83-9317-ca22fef1ec86.Text: "With your permission, Lord Captain, the Infernus Master and I will take our leave now and set out to prepare for the descent into the chambers."

2626c6a6-825a-4a68-8c3e-54e76ea3d6e3.Text: "Then I will humbly sharpen my blades as I await its arrival."

6ae6639e-8777-4744-a29f-eb0214f70b02.Text: "The technical corridors extend hundreds of meters in different directions. Nemesite and his men must be familiar with the tunnels and possess either a map or a guide.
