Without a clear trail, the enforcers risk getting lost and wasting valuable time, not to mention the fact that those narrow tunnels are perfect for an ambush."

2e1f9f17-e048-4b9b-a35e-8a696e894b44.Text: "The tunnels only answer the question of how he left. Now death will tell us where he was heading."

eab60446-8f53-4180-87f9-5c2e45307830.Text: {n}There is an awkward pause. Kibellah takes a long look at the officers' faces, before finally nodding her assent.{/n} "So be it. But not like this. Much like your faces, your guises are too conspicuous."

a7a7bd80-24c4-4b06-bacf-ce42d1c889f2.Text: "I sure hope so, Lord Captain. The workers are used to seeing me all over the place, but the unexpected arrival of the Master-at-Arms is going to raise a few eyebrows."

5af143d6-2e62-4149-99f5-ed1931c460d9.Text: {n}As if in a trance, Kibellah leans over a body and peers into its eyes.{/n} "He stinks of smoke. The smoke of singed coveralls, vile lho-sticks, burnt sacred unguents... and charred meat." {n}She slides a pale hand along the dead man's skin and snakes it under the sleeve of his coveralls, which she pushes back to reveal a fresh burn, bandaged with a torn scrap of shirt.{/n}

ec3ab3d2-4ef9-4458-8e61-04ca9f51cdc3.Text: "There is no need. The blood's whisper will lead us to Nemesite." {n}Kibellah's words make the two exchange puzzled glances.{/n}

f303d574-3e08-40ad-a8e8-6b89e8f0c74c.Text: "Undoubtedly, Lord Captain." {n}She presses her lips into a thin line.{/n} "Perhaps the servant of death will share her insights, that we might all understand what happened here and what we should do next."

2cf61229-0dc2-49ba-abf3-9fcf4c3712d9.Text: "With all due respect, Spinner, the enforcers have already questioned all the witnesses and compiled an extensive list of evidence, none of which tells us anything about how or where the troublemaker calling himself Nemesite might have escaped to."

414cc274-067d-40e7-8a56-d4e4602ada6a.Text: {n}Kibellah sharply turns to face the crimson splashes on the floor and walls of the shrine. Her pupils dilate, threatening to drown her irises in darkness, her expression turns distant, her voice becoming low and strange:{/n} "This blood is drawn in a pattern of retribution. The one who spilt it appeared later. They moved swiftly and furiously, numb to their own wounds... An enforcer who was drawn to the gunfire and witnessed the sacrilege? Probably."

04d52084-f676-4b1d-811a-16a271ec4b7b.Text: "That mutineer cell and all their secret stockpiles were destroyed. I made sure of it. Nevertheless, you are right, and the same troubling thought has crossed my mind: they could have been connected to Nemesite."

1f6585ab-fba2-440f-a56e-4d26f2a01bba.Text: "We've already wiped out those xenos mutants or whoever they were, so we have one less thing to worry about now. All that's left is to deal with this cutthroat and his henchmen."

96d18850-e7b4-41b7-8f56-808beaa6e0d7.Text: [What are those two talking about? Hammer and Anvil]

36937abc-a431-48a1-bc6b-cbf31b84cc01.Text: [Wait for the right moment and then light the spark]

7fe6f54a-eba2-44c7-bd2e-163dd779e51f.Text: [See if anyone has fallen into my web]

379b5fbf-553a-4c30-aba2-d7f39691270b.Text: [I will come back later. My hunt has just began]

e350d345-84d0-4b22-a001-8dea4ca6275d.Text: [Listen to the rapid beating of hearts]

938cdfbb-94b1-46b8-a699-5932f132f3eb.Text: [The web is spun, but I am not ready to chase my prey into the snare just yet. Later]

03081f7e-6b9e-4e8d-8b31-a8949a2a15f5.Text: [I will come back later. Not all of the snares have been set]

7d8b09e0-eb20-4e26-add3-9a72fc503a2d.Text: {n}The laypeople have huddled together like a herd being chased by predators. Faded gazes, bent backs, the crimson kisses of batons on their bodies. And yet, shadows of smiles touch their dirty, burnt lips as a strange pair, like a hammer and anvil, send sparks into the air with their words.{/n}

3fbf9865-ef11-44ec-a554-fee36bd5397c.Text: "Since you couldn't work, your wife had to pull three shifts. She collapsed at the lathe, and the conductive charge burned out her eyes. None of us deserve that." {n}Tough and unyielding. Every word hurts, but she is forgiven for her sincerity. They listen to her to pull themselves together. To share their common pain.{/n}

56d80e42-0255-4072-bcf5-6048600eb281.Text: "And then the lever smacked you right in the kisser? Hah! Give or take a tooth, this is nothing. Bruises, burns, cuts — that's just life."

5aedbcd9-54eb-4b8d-a5b9-9ed4afdb35ab.Text: "That's called justice — for every broken bone, for every gob of spit in our faces. Good bloody riddance!"

9d577a01-594e-4a18-b11d-6ccefbb16bc7.Text: "Not everyone here is as chipper and thick-skinned as you. A bowl of soup is great, he says. What about having to choose which of your three kids gets it — is that great too? Beatings are nothing, he says. Remember when the enforcers broke your arm?"

889364a3-302a-4123-9c90-ac5e6a344d1f.Text: "Yes... Just as long as they don't pin her death on any of us."

115de8f4-5966-4003-81e2-362659275c30.Text: "You heard the news? The lieutenant got fried on the wires. A brutal end for a brutal woman."

8b81f586-6ec8-4090-bbae-751af1dd8013.Text: "Did you hear what happened? Nemesite didn't stop at that foundry business, he's been roaming the upper decks too! They say he went to the vessel's shrine and shot some nobles."

975aba97-3635-4240-8591-e5eed6ddcf5f.Text: "They tell us this is how it's meant to be! Just because they were born on the upper decks and we down below, in the darkness! Is it really the God-Emperor's will that they grow fat on the fruits of our labours? Revel in luxury while we die without water or medicine?" {n}Hammer's voice rumbles, and the laypeople listen. Their hands clench into fists.{/n}

671a6814-93ea-4567-b2d7-584a58872c0c.Text: {n}I can hear their whispers, insidious and deafening. No longer do they laugh with the others. No longer do they pretend.{/n}

04ae936a-3551-47c5-b376-1751cede1d6d.Text: "Shut your foul mouth, void dog." {n}Flaming Voice? No, it is too soon! I understand your anger, but you must temper it!{/n} "What did you say about the Lord Captain? The one who gives you work, food, and shelter? You insolent deadbeats! I can see why you have gathered here, and I will not let you start another rebellion." {n}Why are you reaching for your {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g}-caster?{/n} "If you do not disperse, I will give the order to vent the plasma chambers. You have five seconds. Four..."

f70195ff-415d-462f-84e2-a8c8bb3632f5.Text: "The tyrant's lackey! If you do this, you'll die with us, you madman!"

dabcc7eb-b25d-457b-8a6e-77ff3eafae29.Text: "To protect the Lord Captain and the crew? I see you've never met an infernus before." {n}Their faces are twisted with fear. Will they retreat? Will they flee? Will the hunt be thwarted? No!{/n}

afc0ead6-3811-444e-81a5-6122b9bee4fa.Text: {n}The laypeople are frightened. Angry. They feel the impunity that sprouted like a weed upon Whip's demise. They feel the threat crushing them from the upper decks, both imminent and inevitable.{/n}

61c314fd-139d-4b80-a985-0023408df76d.Text: "The enforcer is dead, and punishers from the upper decks will soon follow Nemesite's trail."

1bdb4ba4-5395-4db1-a9de-5af9f0efc260.Text: {n}The laypeople are huddled together in a pile of sweltering bodies, filthy and battered by the enforcers' batons, reeking of sweat and disease. Their hearts pump blood faster and faster through bulging veins as two of them send red-hot sparks into the air with their words like a hammer and anvil.{/n}

e8579b7c-6fa5-477d-a290-ed2315a33951.Text: {n}The frightened herd sways, humming with whispers. In their eyes, the fires of anxiety flicker. Careless, suggestible people.{/n}

3dd77c02-bf88-42f3-837a-d5ed1795a307.Text: "Your plan appears to have worked, Spinner. The air itself is charged with something, and it is not the conductive charge. The serfs... they are stirring."

c586c896-63af-4d3b-9da5-bd59a38aebed.Text: "No matter how hard you work, they will wring everything out of you and give you nothing! Who allowed this to happen? The Rogue Trader, {rt_mf|his|her} name be damned! A {g|Encyclopedia:Grox}grox{/g} on the throne! A tyrant throwing our bones into the furnace of {rt_mf|his|her} 'protectorate'—"

ba8c59b2-bfc4-425a-87de-8cfbfb989019.Text: {n}The weariness and fear in the eyes of the laypeople have been replaced with sullen lights. Their faces no longer brighten with pale smiles. Their muscles are as tense as a beast ready to pounce. Their hearts pump blood faster and faster through bulging veins as the fiery words spoken by Hammer and Anvil sizzle in the air.{/n}

d828bb4a-25ab-423a-ba71-0af06622b3e0.Text: "Just remind yourselves how you come home after your shift, having exchanged your ration card for a bowl of soup. How your little ones gulp that bowl down. How they fall asleep, feeling a little better. I say that's worth a hard day's work... and a punch in the face!" {n}He smiles, broad-shouldered, with a rusty beard. He is not afraid to share laughter with others, and so the crimson shades from the beatings never leave his face. His voice is bright, and sonorous, and listened to.{/n}

c853af2c-d539-4e5e-a12f-54973c967214.Text: {n}A small throwing blade flies out of my palm and draws a scarlet line across Anvil's neck. If I had wished it, she would be dead. But she continues to breathe and to bleed. And to scream furiously as she looks for me.{/n} "The Rogue Trader's assassins are here! Look! They wanted to kill me! Find the assassins!" {n}The spark is lit.{/n}

4f402d70-1b7b-4652-bc2a-3d6695894b2c.Text: "And then he fled down into the chambers, so now a punitive squad is on its way. Prepare your backs: this is going to hurt."

a9339d97-4bdc-4538-904a-43765841ca69.Text: "This is our chance. We need to act." {n}This is it. I can sense that the prey is close. They have little fear of giving themselves away anymore. They need a spark to ignite the flames. Something that will convince Nemesite's followers that they are strong, and that the Domin's servants are diminished.{/n}

f0265c24-3b78-4de4-94a9-84103a48dd4c.Text: [One glance is enough for me to see your true self, Stain]

6f3cece9-5a00-4c31-a8df-0546555e0ab8.Text: "Where do things stand in the plasma drive chambers? Speak briefly. Speak sense."

9cb20ce7-26f5-4286-ac4c-ece4dba8ab46.Text: [Set up the snare] "There will be a raid soon. Be careful. I warn you in appreciation for your cooperative nature."

094aa577-6eb1-4fee-b740-ddd48ef87c79.Text: [The quelling stimulant on the needle's tip will loosen Stain's tongue]

3f6717b7-5bcc-415f-9649-59252c3c27d0.Text: "This was done in service to the Domin. You are free to believe me or walk away."

2d116559-6d33-432b-9a93-be4b96bb8bd7.Text: "When the renegades hear of the coming retribution, it will make them nervous. Prone to mistakes. Likely to give themselves away."

357835eb-19d0-4863-80a6-a40fa390d4b4.Text: "Reveal the truth to the enemy, and they will harm themselves with it."

15a0b8be-daf3-4e94-a225-2b7ac5e946fa.Text: [The laypeople fear the grim gaze of the spinners. I will stay silent and wait. His resolve is bound to crumble]

6228879c-81c4-4d13-bfca-0ef6b7781b9a.Text: "I am the herald of the end you fear so much. The Undying One has not whispered your name, so cast away your fear. No one will take your life before it is time."

8799d394-7dae-45a9-b98c-a97c89cfcb84.Text: "Long time no see, Spindle. Tell me, what does silence taste like?" {n}Are they using a secret code? Without Flaming Voice, he would never even speak to me.{/n}

79924519-7633-477f-8c00-e2b87ffeaa0d.Text: "Who's that with you? An enforcer! And a spinner! Do you want me dead? If anyone sees me talking to you, they'll snap my neck! So, off you go." {n}The peddler of words is trembling in fear for his life. I must extract answers from him. But by what means?{/n}

36d3ecce-1422-4db5-830a-97c1e052abf3.Text: "I never said Spindle was 'trusted.' I said he knew what goes on in the plasma chambers."

d10f19cf-0c66-4c80-860a-fd901f574c23.Text: "We just had an enforcer die. I swear she did it to herself! Stepped right on a wire and riled up the machine spirits. You lot be careful now."

6254fd9f-6a96-43fa-80a6-bad38021d416.Text: "R-really? I see... Well, if that's all you wanted, then can I... can I go?"

356b25bc-c994-43a1-981a-379518eb4bee.Text: "There is a bunch of workers in the far corner who now gather between every shift, whispering to each other. They don't invite me — they say I talk too much. Well, if they're scared of my tongue, that means they have something to hide."

f75fabab-6912-4e57-86fa-9c79efa44aa7.Text: "Y-you... What are you looking at? You can't scare me! I know you lot never kill without reason. But we do! So quit staring, and just go... Please..."

44460a3f-ac0c-47a8-b419-0ed6fe2c98ad.Text: "Are we bargaining for information with this lowlife now? It is the duty of every serf to aid the Rogue Trader and {rt_mf|his|her} associates, freely and willingly!"

c1791187-126d-4fa8-8b69-606c76b5a999.Text: "I'm not buying any of that spinner talk! I've known too many good men whose lives were taken, and it sure wasn't their time."

d2df4b91-071a-4358-b081-508ed9bb5db8.Text: "Hey, hey, hey, don't you poke me with that! Over my dead body, you hear?"

0a2078d2-dea9-4243-aad6-07023dd61d63.Text: "Enough! Now listen to me, you void mite. When I snap my fingers, your tongue will miraculously untie, I will be satisfied, and everyone here will stay in one piece. But if it will not..."

22ac895c-6050-4026-bbae-4f8793cc5249.Text: "It is difficult to admit, but I do share the Master-at-Arms's indignation. We came here to get information about the traitors, not to reveal our secrets."

f20d7c79-1638-4593-b61c-fa206f45bae6.Text: "But for them to take the bait, it must be compelling... Yes, I see."

4e1f0bb3-c274-4bcf-8f46-17aacf39da92.Text: "There's no need to be so drastic, is there? We started this together, and we will finish it together."

f46d4a30-6b6e-4ebb-aef1-f89e8d5a7c2f.Text: "I just hope the wisdom of the Bloodspun Web won't cost us."

5fea9559-0542-4ab1-a0a6-fb7ae0bdf81a.Text: "Fine, ask whatever you want. But then leave! My reputation cost me a lot of blood, and I didn't earn it to have it trampled into dust because you people happened to stop by!"

0ef891d1-fbc2-48a0-9b54-20b899fbb6b5.Text: "That's a funny look, Einrich! And you have a funny-looking company. Are you here to sell or to buy? And before you answer, remember the first rule: every word has a price!"

e1bb60b7-8c07-4fd9-8a91-4476713210ff.Text: "This wimp is your trusted source? He is pathetic."

598f60d6-3dc4-4525-b53a-a44b802a11b2.Text: "Everybody knows silence doesn't taste like anything. If you wanna earn rations, you better start dealing in words." {n}He speaks casually, but his voice is slimy and slippery. His eyes are as dirty as an oil-stained garment. The impudence in his gaze and words when he turns them to us... He is unclean, and he knows it. He is unrepentant.{/n}

9f1e96be-a901-452e-953b-5ba10c1f5c6d.Text: "And, of course, everyone's talking about Nemesite. Sure, the foundry and the chapel were big, but he's been helping people all over. A lot of folks are sticking with him now. You can knock my teeth out if I'm lying — don't got many of those left anyhow — but I'll tell you this: even if someone finds him, they won't rat him out."

c9e23c21-5cae-41f9-a460-450a57ae914e.Text: {n}You are a liar and manipulator, peddling other people's secrets and not knowing how to keep your mouth shut. You will become the bait, sowing confusion among the minions of Nemesite who hope to wait out the lockdown. They think they have enough time? I will deprive them of that confidence.{/n}

e8577c4b-0746-4a2a-88c5-506765551b12.Text: "What are you... That information is not meant for his ears!"

a33711b8-a7ea-4d50-8c2d-e9d092a1bb88.Text: "Careful, do not ruin the material. Cut along the sinews."

dd8117c0-a554-448e-bec4-8dd870bad3c1.Text: "This... is definitely going to be my best work! A catharsis of feeling and emotion!"

8462d882-ffe3-4af0-a5ef-7cdc6b245a0e.Text: "I will sculpt a flower of death out of you and gift it to the Undying One! Just hold out a little longer..."

0c997200-2063-46fd-8fcf-6f09c8c5a6c7.Text: "Just look at those young, strong, warm bodies. Fear gives their blood an especially sweet aftertaste."

f2a1abaa-2e2d-4e45-a3f9-d9b9052860ec.Text: "I prefer a fine vintage. With poignant notes of bitterness over the fading of life."

4e1d87be-5340-44a3-b651-edab8f6aaed2.Text: "Mmm... An exquisite flavour... I simply cannot stop."

2997e52e-6222-4766-b1af-5ef642a4044b.Text: "The hues and overtones are amazingly intricate! Upper deck people are fascinating..."

d3ed7ed2-9da0-4d37-af93-f8c79978aec8.Text: "Focus on your feet. Do not think, but feel! Let your body guide you."

be2c3452-a96e-492c-95ab-c8c801bf5bf1.Text: "The blades in your hands are extensions of yourselves, not mere weapons. Merge with the metal. Taste the blood with your blade!"

2d539aab-fa3d-4555-a0ce-c0774a67165a.Text: "And remember: we will all end up in the Undying One's hands. So walk without fear. Strike without regret!"

21d61ff6-4360-4b61-8d85-636af81d5c66.Text: "...And the Undying Emperor whispered, 'I name the exalted spinners heralds of my will in the void between the stars...'"

d0cd7dcd-69fe-4c95-a3ac-4bb76039ef84.Text: "'...And those who have strayed must listen to those who would guide them, and follow them, and be meek and grateful...'"

ff808391-9b48-497d-8c90-2553872fd46e.Text: "'...For your blood is in their hands and their hearts. For your death is in the palms of my hands.'"

1d5fca1a-71c0-429f-ba5e-b49e61cf0ef6.Text: "I saw my sister again today. She was savouring someone's blood as one savours wine. I... want to try it, too."

733849e6-5113-4efb-a941-ffea7d869103.Text: "My sister invited me to the temple of death and left a hundred scars on me. It was... unbearable. But we're bonding."

538a6181-5e2b-4877-b747-1915f517cce5.Text: "Senior Lieutenant Erebis! I've been tasked with serving the exalted spinners on the bridge!"

fed90a27-139c-4347-bc83-1e449b5d7529.Text: "The heir of House Erebis, back on the flagship... I still can't believe it!"

3796fb34-97d1-4d31-9d2b-e6a05ae7cbce.Text: "I saw my sister again today. In the flesh, not in a dream. She... didn't notice me."

d0a102ca-3f52-4023-a0f5-163a310f017f.Text: "Senior Lieutenant Erebis, Lord Captain! Maintaining order on the bridge!"

cc91f40e-3574-4d33-b009-5a92a1594714.Text: "Do you see? The poison has begun to spread through his body. Blood in the eyes is the first sign of death's kiss."

9a5bd03b-98df-480d-bd0b-4a78ba20e6e4.Text: "If you have to sever the thread of life quickly, aim for the neck. If the mark deserves to suffer before they die, open their belly."

60479080-2979-4af1-b930-e1750ed831b4.Text: "...Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship, allow me to introduce the next guests: protectors of Dargonus from the void between the stars..."

04da7550-2299-4d28-980a-941630ee93d7.Text: "...Randor and Xioni of House Erebis, along with their heirs, Mattis, Lorna, Rono, and Lumi Erebis. Glory to the dynasty!"

7278756c-e4ea-449e-a583-5a72e1a69ac1.Text: "Domin'{name}, the Bloodwardens salute you! We are your shield."

e1e765c8-a38d-4a9d-9224-61ff85af82b5.Text: "Second Spinner Kibellah, you have abandoned the Tenets of the Web. And thus I have no choice but to sever your thread."

ba6ed69b-f799-4df5-9a84-f9b19f634f5a.Text: "The Undying One whispers of blood, and we give Him scarlet rivers!"

984c2921-d9bf-4e19-9ad7-df671fdcb4d5.Text: "Glory to the Domin who has allowed us to rise and flourish! Glory to the Vizsier who has given us blood to drink in plenty!"

a22d018b-71fc-4e63-8beb-5d4d6d66167f.Text: "This is a great honour for a house as small as ours. The other guests look down on us."

ae7fa322-b0f9-4962-9e52-c653e830fbd3.Text: "Rono and Lumi spend their every spare moment practising. Diligence truly does run in the family, it seems."

a75477ba-f86b-4933-a392-7620f1f60824.Text: "Let His scourges strike the backs of profaners with the crimson flames of punishment. For the Undying One is duty!"

ae95559a-16a9-4447-a2fd-bf74cf60121b.Text: "And thus, we have risen from ash and darkness to serve as the wardens of the blood that courses through the flagship's veins."

24cb2ae8-4990-4e20-be96-a83b3ab35c64.Text: "Death whispers your name, Vizsier! Death greets you!"

1b69a5f6-d82b-43f1-8c27-66e3f2438734.Text: "May your reign redden the Bloodspun Web, Vizsier!"

5e2afa40-48da-4c90-9e91-1f1acac5381e.Text: "The song of blood is heard ever louder in bay after bay, Domin. Praising you. Saluting the Vizsier. Death keeps watch, for death is Him. For death is me."

5b3ce2a5-9d63-4ae7-a8f2-93a178552690.Text: "Come, Domin. We must descend into the temple of death where I will report on my assignment. And ask the Vizsier a single question. 'Why me?'"

c1d004f6-8864-4376-8ae1-1fd433c17fcf.Text: "Death is in the palms of His hands!"

79ec853f-e7ab-4937-a204-120d4a4b29bb.Text: "Henceforth you are a warrior of the Bloodspun Web. A blade that has drunk of the Undying One's wrath..."

d3912e3b-4dba-47d9-9dfe-bc0e62b59f06.Text: "From now on, you spin the web of blood. Shun worldly things, and the blood from His hands will purify you. And the ritual of releasing the burden will be performed."

913cb273-9599-4878-8f89-f08a49a0b54b.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! I will study hard so I can one day earn the honour of painting your portrait!"

1cb8915f-284a-4030-8cc5-8c4d46815884.Text: "You are dazzling, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! It's... it's like you've just stepped out of a temple painting!"

2e913834-d262-440c-ae9c-f4cc970cf482.Text: "Peace, Kibellah. The Undying One has whispered your name. It is time to put yourself in His gentle hands. For the Undying One is death itself."

a769065a-9bf9-4ac1-9cad-eadb87d0ae06.Text: ...trusted in {mf|his|her} nimbleness and tried to slip past the monster.

f6fea7ac-54db-4682-8f90-31bb1c0d980d.Text: ...banished the monster with a fervent prayer to the Emperor.

e330c740-6c5d-47f2-995b-c25011bd019c.Text: ...pressed onward, pushing the dead away with {mf|his|her} strong arms.

5962dba6-9b0e-462e-98ce-5fa76e0a734f.Text: ...helped the Judge by returning each of his organs to their proper place.

af7bf0cb-5c65-4a97-b26a-03091f6721ec.Text: ...attacked the obstacle of flesh in {mf|his|her} path, tearing it apart and destroying it.

0b44351c-ae9c-49a6-a845-09a6d9823d43.Text: ...studied the tangle of flesh for secret signs that would show {mf|him|her} the way.

da1cafdc-eb83-477d-b1d0-b0e950973325.Text: ...that her duty to the Undying One and the Domin had not yet been fulfilled.

cc0ad85b-3d87-4a61-bf11-85c1d5d3373c.Text: ...that her congregation was suffering without her protection and the Undying One's mercy.

c67754cd-612b-490b-976e-c1710c71ef11.Text: ...nothing. For everything in the world is nothing, and the Undying One Himself is lord of nothing.

52285dd7-3ba7-441d-942f-7c3b0668c95b.Text: ...the life of any calling themselves an enemy of the Undying One.

9f46cc11-0cc2-4c89-a759-86dbb7fdb499.Text: Threatened the Undying Emperor with execution.

eb477f2a-dfe1-4e27-a047-ccddeb6453b9.Text: ...to spare Him from ruthless execution if He surrendered the Domin's shadow at once.

39a2f939-efd6-4f7e-9089-bfb21cbd0520.Text: ...took {mf|his|her} words back and agreed to the bargain.

a2a9a29e-1a24-4ad8-8a8a-dc747bd56ea4.Text: ...that in beholding Death as one of the living, she had received a gift of unparallelled greatness.

e60a3761-cd1e-4689-bc95-7a362df1e664.Text: ...went down on one knee, offering a prayer to Him.

60e33b8e-435b-494c-ab61-70fab43d1249.Text: ...spoke brazenly, demanding that He vacate the throne belonging to the Domin.

d4972777-852f-44ea-aceb-6be7c1607c11.Text: And speak the Domin did, saying that {mf|he|she} had come to find {mf|his|her} shadow and rescue her.

24afbd80-0b14-4460-b98a-8e71387633d1.Text: ...that {mf|he|she} had been waiting for her, had missed her, and had come to claim her and keep her.

9cb35963-e3d8-4ccc-b0cd-c7fdb05aa94c.Text: ...that {mf|he|she} would honour Him with a sacrifice of myriad lives.

419ad329-10b9-4f6b-a89b-d29f9ae512c2.Text: ...struck the first blow, aiming for a weak spot.

78a6c246-ea4e-4e6c-a168-ff9b18129acd.Text: But the shadow known as the Executioner was filled with a great lust for blood. The monster roared fiercely and charged at the Domin, surrounding {mf|him|her} with blades; it was only the sorcery of Veni'Zacchary that drove the monster away. For one who has strayed from their thread is to be feared. He is Death.

b17109fb-3536-4c7f-b82e-edae5537c013.Text:
Sector: Koronus Expanse
Location: Von Valancius flagship
Material: The Book of the Dead, the holy scripture of the Cult of the Bloodspun Web
Author: unknown

a65e9402-3c50-4c62-b1f5-a606e64e85f9.Text: A shackled mind cannot comprehend the wisdom contained herein; therefore repeat: He is Death. Release your breath with each word. Cleanse your thoughts. He is Death. Truth lies in Death. Free your soul from the body's cage. Become nothing. He is Death. Now that your heartbeat is a perfect line and your vision is shrouded in dusk, you have almost reached a state of purity and balance. Heed.

0bd120d4-0473-4113-93f8-55876964c35d.Text: Birth and Death are one. We are snatched from a place of warmth and sent blood-covered into an unfamiliar world: dying is the same. The Domin, too, learned this as {mf|he|she} opened {mf|his|her} eyes and found {mf|himself|herself} on the lower decks, lying in a cold coffin. {mf|He|She} beheld {mf|his|her} ship, drifting through nothingness: an adamantine giant's corpse, a skeleton moaning from the winds of entropy. A tempest of rust was gnawing at its plasteel bones and twisting its vein-like cables, while machine oil oozed down its bulkheads like lymph. Had the Domin been alone, {mf|he|she} would have lost {mf|his|her} way inside the ship's mangled bowels, but a guide reached out a hand to {mf|him|her}.

0f6bd91c-a0fd-4cdb-804e-bf89e129b47f.Text: The blades and the spikes fell, clanging, and turned to rust. For bloodlust weakens a blade, and the Domin had proved as much.

721338c6-6c4a-4a82-941c-64544d5f0ab7.Text: Then the Undying Emperor leant over the Domin and drove a skeletal finger right into {mf|his|her} heart. And He pulled at the scarlet thread of {mf|his|her} soul; and the thread trembled, stretched to the limit. It was then that a revelation came to the Domin: a life must be paid for a life. And a name was revealed to {mf|him|her}: Naaki Erebis. That was the life the Undying One demanded as payment. And the Domin...

fe94ea00-ca17-4720-b407-7ae4fa61a153.Text: The creature wailed and trailed off into the void like a river of rot. For doubt weakens the spirit, and weakness always loses to strength.

793b7145-8077-4f13-8697-2b9b3beac08c.Text: And a card of His Tarot appeared in the Domin's hand: it was the Star. And the second doubt was dispelled. He is Death.

fc20bb06-6fd5-49b5-854f-15ae6c40cfed.Text: But {mf|his|her} sorrow only grew heavier, numbing all feeling, for great was the sadness of the shadow that had spawned it. Then Veni'Zacchary's incantation enveloped the Domin, and it alone was able to save {mf|him|her}. For one who has let doubt lead them astray is to be feared. He is Death.

b8cac1cc-c63e-426a-9478-232a7b930277.Text: And the Domin read the words, and spoke them. And the Judge's body began to rebuild itself to a new design, as beautiful as it was terrifying. For nothing is impossible when a soul has grasped the hidden wisdom.

f786eacf-76c4-4c2b-abfb-f7bc9cf696c2.Text: And the obstacle fell, and the Judge was unbound, no longer prevented from restoring himself. For when order has been defiled and corrupted, break it down and begin anew.

3a9a4670-e227-4d2a-813d-f139c9fa5451.Text: That her woes stemmed from her wavering faith, and that the shadow must return to the thread of the Web in order to do His bidding. He is Death.

1cc079b7-8c59-4694-a889-ce838b81ae32.Text: The flagship's bridge was draped in skulls and webs. And pale souls of the dead flocked to the foot of the throne upon which sat the Undying Emperor, the Protector of Mankind, may His praises be innumerable. Starlight shone coldly in the eyes of His skull, and the galaxy rested in His mighty hand. The Domin approached His throne and...

3056f219-c0a7-4a2b-b66e-06199bda8b6d.Text: And a card of His Tarot appeared in the Domin's hand: it was the Rogue Trader. And the third doubt was dispelled. He is Death.

8ae158f3-aa37-4f12-ba69-3a742a11b03c.Text: But the Judge's flesh only twined tighter around the Domin, for strong were the delusions of the shadow that had spawned him. Then Veni'Zacchary let out a sorcerous cry, and brought down the obstacles. For there are times when only violence can put an end to doubt. He is Death.

e606bba1-9f9f-4240-ab64-e3462bbbef64.Text: The skeletal fingers stirred, and the Domin's shadow loomed out of the darkness beside His throne. She was bound in black chains and asleep. The Undying One was silent: now was the time to offer a payment, as Death would give nothing away without payment in return. And the Domin promised the Undying One...

04dfb566-044a-4265-bac5-1cd13c212e6e.Text: The light in the Undying One's eyes faded out, and He returned to His throne and sat down upon it. For He had nothing to say to one unwilling to repay Death's benevolence. And the Domin...

0a4e54e5-b4fa-42f2-871f-153af24ee512.Text: And the Domin's shadow remained beside the Undying One's throne, and has never been seen since. And so it was that the Domin, having seen Death before {mf|his|her} due time, travelled there and back to bring us these words of wisdom: do not regret what has passed on to Death, for that is the right path. Find value in what the living possess, for one day it will be no more. He is Death.

7b1cd3dc-38a3-47ee-8858-ddb06b09cf21.Text: Lest {mf|he|she} sink into the soft rot of their wails and perish, the Domin...

3b6ceb6b-3185-4b48-b56b-aee23f0c69c4.Text: And the sobbing being was left behind, alone and forgotten. For strength always leaves weakness behind in the darkness of oblivion.

aeec1b49-0818-4eea-b8be-9f5ccfe241f0.Text: And the Lost Child's tears were dried, and with a meek sigh she returned to nothingness. For mercy, too, can be the blade that brings peace.

f6ea93bd-12e6-4e66-9ecf-224a6656005e.Text: And the old Veni led the Domin to the upper decks. And the Domin entered into the officers' chambers. A web of veins adorned the walls, entangling the precious trophies, and statues were bound in intertwining sinews. And high upon a balcony, the dismembered Judge wailed as he attempted to reassemble himself with his pale hands. But his movements merely tightened the tangle of the flesh, turning the chambers into a snare. Such is a blade tangled and trapped in misunderstood teachings. A hapless creature that does not know its place in the world.

532e0b2f-1ad9-4b8b-8231-855278278091.Text: In order to continue on {mf|his|her} journey, the Domin...

f34150a4-9c88-4336-a1f4-1bc9d16f0308.Text: And the Judge became whole again, and regained his comprehension of the world. For one who is wise can make whole what was broken.

861dd276-e5d3-4bc6-9c51-a2ead1ae1d95.Text: Those were true words. For everything is indeed nothing, and the Undying Emperor is lord of nothing. For all things live only to turn to dust in Death. The Domin's wisdom pleased the Undying One.

bea8657d-9dfd-4e5f-8fb7-7408d83f7d28.Text: Those were true words. For He valued His chosen servants, who accomplished incredible feats and brought Him great trophies. The Domin was one of them by nature, and this was known by all.

ca865c47-3020-4d68-94f4-ee359c06e25e.Text: The Undying One laughed, for all His enemies were but dust compared to Him.

8a9add47-7fe6-4f93-a1f1-65974f52ee00.Text: The Undying One listened to the Domin's brazen words without a hint of a smile; for one who taunts Death can do so but once.

41eb7257-3e43-4d0c-8fa9-c25b3d86d80f.Text: An oath of blood was sworn, and the chains fell from the Domin's shadow. Yet she remained silent and motionless, for she saw no sense in leaving the halls of Death. To which the Domin told her...

5ad177b2-80d0-4c4e-a7d1-930bf2b2d629.Text: And there was clarity in the shadow's soul, and her eyes opened. Her doubt was banished, and she glimpsed the truth in her {mf|lord|lady}'s words.

a28869cf-e6cb-4fa9-ba78-707d09a4edf7.Text: That the shadow's encounter with Death had taught her many things about the flow of fate's currents, and thus she was now positioned to decide which thread to sever. Second Spinner Kibellah, Death's Chosen One, may she be glorified! He is Death.

5f3edf42-8e92-42d4-8a42-b51d1c0e29e1.Text: Preserving the defenceless from heinous designs would give her strength; eradicating the ruiners of souls would give her purpose. The shadow would wrap the Bloodspun Web's threads around the ship and thus be redeemed of her flaws. He is Death.

0baea26d-bcbd-49cc-994f-1054f6e401a5.Text: And the eyes of the Domin's shadow opened, and she replied that she had not been waiting, had not missed {mf|him|her}, sought neither duty nor power nor mercy, and had no desire to leave, as the monsters spawned by her mind had not been defeated and were still strong. However, she then rose to her feet and followed the one she had sworn an oath to. For her duty outweighed her mind's torment. He is Death.

fe868691-752c-4c92-8252-1df37f619129.Text: Veni'Zacchary led the Domin out of the hot furnace of the crematorium, and they walked past long columns of the dead. Frayed was their attire; their bones scraped against their augmetics and scratched their decrepit flesh. They were moaning sorrowfully, and the sound made memory fade away. The Domin saw that the dead were carrying an ark, and inside the ark was a Thing. A Lost Child cocooned in silk, shedding crimson tears for the unknown. The unliving carried her as servants would carry their lady, and loudly lamented their fate. Such is a blade mired in broodings over a lost past: a helpless child paralysed by regret.

2d90120c-4250-478d-8074-7de18a2a06e5.Text: The spirit of old Veni'Zacchary had loyally followed the Domin to the other side.

be177428-3eb4-48b9-b8fc-d86550df128c.Text: The Undying One laughed, for the Domin was His to begin with: as it was written in the great treaty between Him and the Domin's line, the treaty every spinner of the Bloodspun Web serves and defends.

caca9304-3413-4a3f-9e38-0d23d6b3d768.Text: The ghost of old Veni'Zacchary, who did not rest in peace, stood by the Domin's side. Deep and painful as his soul's wounds were, he bore the Domin no ill will: for the old Veni had himself sought the punishment the Domin had exacted upon him.

15c9122b-68c6-410e-b290-1a46614acdce.Text: No human will see Death before their time: that is the delusion of the living. Heed. To which we say: a strong spirit can travel there and make the journey back. Heed the tale of the great Domin'{name}, who descended into the kingdom of the dead to retrieve {mf|his|her} shadow.

012fe764-57fb-485e-905e-04ee30a59eb3.Text: In the labyrinth of the hereafter, the piercing gaze of Veni'Zacchary discerned the thorny path to the halls of Death. The loyal servant swore to protect his {mf|lord|lady}.

a825726a-1571-445b-8ce2-398627f685bb.Text: At the great gate of the crematorium, their path was blocked by the Executioner, a sentinel made of metal spikes and coiling blades with roaring flame and pale, bleeding bodies writhing within. Such is a blade that has lost the strength of the Tenets. A murderous monster no longer driven by faith, but by dark desires.

2c328cb5-670e-4cbe-8a01-84fde1ef73ec.Text: Together, the Domin and the Veni made their way up through the malformed frame of the ship. From the cold catacombs of the lower decks, they travelled up into the fires of the ship's crematorium. Tongues of flame licked at them, yet they did not burn. Columns of the dead marched toward them to be turned to ash in the fire, and the Domin and the Veni walked toward the dead in turn.

8faf2255-4892-4d3d-9c64-910927656b97.Text: The Undying One heeded the words spoken to Him and lowered His brow of bone, acknowledging that He had heard the prayer, as He had heard the Domin's other prayers before.

f7acf4cb-80b1-4d76-b2ca-eb2c9119641b.Text: The Undying Emperor grinned a bony grin, and cast a glance at the Domin. And at that moment, something died forever inside the Domin. For the price of arrogant pride in the face of Death is always heavy, but worth its weight.

541fb894-adb9-4721-b092-b3e43c6366fc.Text: The eyes of the Undying One's skull flashed ominously, for He was the Domin of the entire human race, and any and every throne was His throne. But He did not stoop to destroying the brazen Domin, for it was not yet {mf|his|her} time to go.

7faf7ed2-4256-4604-9e11-ebc0f39d42e8.Text: Then the Undying One spoke — and these words are to be preserved in your heart as the greatest of prayers, for they sprang from a source that was and is the holiest of all things: "I know you, Domin. I know your heart."

a0ab3084-0d48-4c73-8aa4-3538accfeb2e.Text: "And the softness that dwells within it. Many who were due to pass on to me remained alive as your heart willed. But I am not angered, for they will pass on to me in the end."

c18d9cd8-28e4-48f6-b93e-e177d5daac71.Text: "And the fervent faith that dwells within it. I know your readiness to serve me, and I accept it. Your spirit has been weighed and found worthy."

840f6760-a041-4a78-8baf-3bfbb0887180.Text: "And the unclean corruption that dwells within it. I know the temptations and shameful longings that gnaw at you. And thus know this: you will face me again when it is your turn, and your spirit will be weighed but found unworthy, and you will rot in sorrow. But that will come to pass later."

25ccea04-eff5-49c4-b946-3c28b53dfdb8.Text: The Domin saw that a fight was inevitable, and...

efc9a408-73df-4ed0-98a8-9f9da8cca18a.Text: The Undying Emperor, may His praises be innumerable, said no more, and it was the Domin's turn to speak.

51517c0a-8331-430c-8578-0010bd5de796.Text: The Undying One laughed, for the Domin had promised Him nothing that did not already belong to Him.

a0103f58-17aa-4729-9a44-2f450cc02bbb.Text: Among them, the Domin saw the card of the Executioner, who carries out sentences and brings a violent end to that which he did not begin.

dc581efe-8f80-4965-b287-e43060df4698.Text: Among them, the Domin saw the card of the Lost Child, who was torn from her roots and her support, but carries within her the still-hidden seeds of a promise to recover them someday.

cd0c8353-a8b8-4f5a-b6b7-355528dad024.Text: Among them, the Domin saw the card of the Judge, who weighs and separates guilt from innocence, and passes his verdict.

2e8279ba-a7cb-437a-948e-141de864ec34.Text: The Domin peered at them but could form no meaning from the Undying One's signs, hearing only the howling of the monsters spawned by {mf|his|her} shadow's mind.

4d58b5e9-c701-4bbd-8ad7-ea1302bfe61e.Text: And a card of His Tarot appeared in the Domin's hand: it was the God-Emperor. And the first doubt was dispelled. He is Death.

b03da14f-32a2-4728-83b7-af4456cb3e56.Text:
And they descended into the lower bays, lay down in a stone coffin, and closed their eyes. And the Domin heard the Undying Emperor's voice promising they would meet again, and soon.
And thereupon their journey ended. And so it was that the Domin, having seen Death before {mf|his|her} due time, travelled there and back to bring us these tidings and wisdom: be free of doubt as you walk along the threads of the Bloodspun Web, for those threads lead to Him, as does all of existence. He is Death.

e21f52da-fe26-4f76-9035-bfdc9eeb34ed.Text: And the eyes of the Domin's shadow opened, and she replied that she, too, had been waiting and had missed {mf|him|her}, and that the Domin should claim her and keep her. He is Death.

695e7ff1-4a87-4d5f-87db-1103d772aaec.Text: The Domin and {mf|his|her} shadow left the bridge of the Undying Emperor, may His praises be innumerable, and their path was strewn with His Tarot cards.

7a86ebf7-85db-4bd6-88b0-900f430c4bc4.Text: Blades whirled around like a hurricane, but the Domin slipped ghost-like between them. For bloodlust blinds the eye, and the Domin proved as much.

46b23a85-3773-4795-9111-3d3dfc011208.Text: The beast prostrated itself and began to tear its own body apart. For words of true faith pacify even the worst of evils with a sense of shame and self-loathing.

51e78c6f-709a-485e-9d25-ae19cdc4c458.Text: The Matriarch Spider's armour has been handed down from one Bloodspun Web Vizsier to another, absorbing all the grief of the gory succession.

776aeafc-2f93-4a34-ab39-2290ec813530.Text: The Matriarch Spider's helmet has heard and remembered the whispers of every Bloodspun Web leader who has worn it.

95ef181a-bd36-4256-95e2-359dd3a8157e.Text: The whistling of this blade laments the deaths of the wicked who have angered the Undying One and so will atone for their deeds with torment.

b8536333-8e95-4e7f-9074-b88adce37da9.Text: This Erebis clan relic served its erstwhile owners faithfully as they boarded voidships. Engraved into it are the words, "May Naaki and Mattis preserve the light of your souls."

a49207a2-e971-41c0-9685-f3f26627e61f.Text: The rustle with which this blade leaves its scabbard whispers the names of those whose deaths would please the Undying One.

50a1c3ae-ba05-410b-83cf-46d6e8680456.Text: "We had a deal. You give me fifteen ration cards, and I don't tell the boss about your scabs. So where's my cards?"

21652b70-ed93-4166-a7a5-c50dd3b5301d.Text: "You're not getting any of my rations! I may be sick, but I do the work of three people. The captain's not gonna hurt me."

7c6ec9ec-40b4-4a34-b7a8-6cd491b4b107.Text: "Besides, he's had buboes break out on his own neck. We'll see how he likes your little clean-freak act."

93f7ddfd-2617-4c40-af3f-bacc8cbe798a.Text: "Look, his head's smashed in and he's still fighting!"

c88887d0-a556-4b05-8350-e2be488d51e2.Text: "I told you to bet on the one with the most sores. For some reason, they last the longest."

dfd0fad7-9b69-49f1-ba3c-701adcff3de4.Text: "Did you rub rust and boiled moss into your scabs like I told you to?"

2c4e241c-b287-4a54-8a3f-663396637e2c.Text: "I did! I've got more scabs now but the itching's gone. Anyway, I'm not here for that. My youngest daughter's eye's festering."

0f90415c-d0b8-4d83-9b1b-3dc082994c87.Text: "Spit in her eyes thrice and repeat this: 'away you go, sickness most unclean and most unwanted.' If that doesn't help, bring your daughter to me."

b86b5e97-ab5d-454a-80e7-3f648e7c6205.Text: "Used items, bargain prices! Wash out the soup stains yourself, that's why they're cheap!"

8c3f3c8d-4a04-4285-9af0-1adedeaf1740.Text: The bodies of those sent to do "kitchen work" are floating in the slurry.

bdaf2680-8be5-4183-a162-1d59cf142012.Text: "Why's everyone bashing mould? It's an all right food."

61002509-cb6e-45d3-8070-2a9e9999b4b0.Text: "You ought to go easy on it, what with all the oozing sores on your mug."

27e174dd-7d37-4126-91c4-4348811226b5.Text: "They don't even hurt. So are you gonna have some mould or not? 'Cause I might as well eat all of it."

b7773378-ff67-4169-9a64-835352487eb0.Text: "They say this preacher came from the pestilence pit. He was dying of void leprosy, but grace came upon him and he started preaching."

e8bad4b7-f2c6-4d28-beb4-553fb89dbce1.Text: "I don't understand half of what he says, but I hear him call the holy fathers monsters. Why haven't the enforcers arrested him yet?"

17e41fa5-4de4-42de-adc5-bfc18ba2d8a6.Text: "He must be saying the right things. And his blessings have made the soup less disgusting, too, so he can stay, as far as I'm concerned."

0b962e20-0c6d-49f5-867d-129b190a8431.Text: "May Grandfather Emperor bless this vat, for all the world is His garden in which all may be nourished and satisfied."

29bfa005-36d8-44e0-be15-1af328ca0c95.Text: "Our god is understanding and caring toward His children, and in His eyes you are all pure. And these white-robed monsters, who scold and shame you, are not worthy of His gifts!"

d5e99d4a-08a9-4c0a-a5cb-679570c30aad.Text: "Pick me, boss! I'll be singing your praises 'til the day I die!"

2a01562a-060b-49c0-806f-b2c80f3e9590.Text: "My wife has a hernia. Can she go to the kitchen?"

b616e234-270e-4be6-ad63-099e60e1590c.Text: "I thought you'd starved to death. What with you going without rations for a week and never checking in with the foreman."

a8e89b20-99e8-4e26-8b4d-e0219409f923.Text: "Yeah, there's not a crumb to eat at home, but for some reason, I'm not hungry. My belly's swelling, though."

04652013-a6d9-4b57-91dd-a9687e29d131.Text: "The swelling's from starvation. Get in the soup queue quickly. They say there's meat in it now."

9e0dd595-fca6-4007-9c43-49be13612a0a.Text: "Listen up, you degenerates. There's kitchen work to be done. Those not fit to work on the freight line will go there."

0d97bcc4-2a92-4ac3-aace-1c55fcc1cffa.Text: "Stop pushing! There's plenty of room for everyone."

cdc5577d-2b45-4f7b-adaa-1eca4144fed3.Text: "You, limper: into the kitchen you go. You're of no use anywhere else anyway."

98cf99d1-0881-46ba-8a2e-6e49b8326fd5.Text: "Who was complaining about the beatings? Off to the kitchen with you as well! I'm feeling generous today, hah!"

2acb7ca8-4cb4-4dc2-a4af-8123767c4f2e.Text: "Your blade has brought death against the Domin's will. You have broken a sacred vow and will be punished accordingly."

95949d55-3949-402f-8c5f-a20ba137e07c.Text: "I have carried out the will of the Undying One, and He alone will judge me."

d5fe5a75-9265-46c6-860d-525bf915161e.Text: "So, you're claiming your neighbour stole a fork to do what with it?"

a2825b33-d889-4246-a846-7ca30e13a996.Text: "To stab someone! A fork's not a spoon, it's practically a knife! Why does he need it when he can eat soup with his mouth and chew nutribars with his teeth?"

03346e32-2681-45e8-aac5-8eaee0765995.Text: "I'm logging the report. For your vigilance, you are entitled to a ration card — place an 'X' here and go to the distribution point. Next!"

c0606a6a-3378-44e2-8bec-53f9e3a77ef9.Text: "I assigned shifts in exchange for bribes, so what? They take away your uniform for that?"

16d50a63-1f7f-4a5a-8b14-85de892a955d.Text: "Now they do. Don't complain, you have a job — you won't starve."

9690a7c1-426f-4510-9d52-52d82251ac8e.Text: "And just be thankful that you don't have to pay anyone to get put on a shift."

ab99e7fb-390b-4e32-ba01-70a970e2e45b.Text: "The compartment needs more enforcers, so consider yourselves drafted. We'll wash you off, drum a bit more discipline into you, and put you to work."

b84f6f40-6abc-4c51-9029-e6538988cfbc.Text: "You'll be giving us batons? And uniforms? We'll be real-life enforcers!"

c0b9f478-20fc-4beb-ab8a-276947f49a9f.Text: "You will when you realise that duty and order always come first. And I'll make sure you do."

708c749e-ad3b-4a38-a4c2-697de0b008ac.Text: "Lord Captain! A clandestine cell has been uncovered. The traitors are dead and their weapons have been confiscated."

1dc22b78-3f51-41cb-a4d6-aec256c850e2.Text: "I'd rather rot peacefully here than overwork myself to death."

fcf6d4b0-8807-41ca-af2e-4d09489ddc07.Text: "It's got scary to even catch an enforcer's eye. They used to beat people up for infractions and now they just grab people and squeeze the life out of them with all the work they make them do."

93925de2-87d5-4a46-bb25-01cbc190b242.Text: "Stolen rations, fuel, weapons, hand it all over now or it's the firing squad for you!"

6aab9990-6032-4026-806b-f59e40ed2669.Text: "We gave up all we had already! Don't kill us! Please!"

a1be6690-9b22-40de-ac0a-ecd9db2ed80c.Text: "I'll talk, I'll talk! There are three rations, a handful of bolts, and half a lho-stick behind the ventilation grid. Take it all. Just don't kill me!"

6e5e9649-63e0-413b-a948-c42b09e19efd.Text: "If you had laboured without sparing your lives and had been steadfast in your faith, your lives would resemble what the Emperor intended for Humanity."

c35a5a94-a8e6-4ed0-b9df-2d9484e30cb0.Text: "You choose to indulge your weaknesses, to steal, lie, and shirk your duty. And what is worse, you do these things knowing that He sees everything."

3571fc31-f14d-40ec-a80f-484323dbaa7a.Text: "So what do you deserve? Only righteous punishment. But the Emperor is merciful and gives you a chance of redemption through blood and hard toil in His name."

c518fcae-0389-4579-a79e-f6e6eca7069e.Text: "You are reprobates whose sloth and depravity have earned you this miserable existence! Do you think there are places like this on Holy Terra? There aren't, for only the purest, most righteous souls tread upon its hallowed surface!"

bc369aae-e496-4621-8b37-3c900989940f.Text: "We are worms unworthy of the Emperor's mercy!"

1641de21-86f6-47f4-8480-674854fa2172.Text: "I repent! I feel so purified, I really do! My soul's already yearning to work five shifts in a row."

041e0449-4641-42e5-b7c4-d50b2aa6e7bf.Text: "I've brought you lunch, dearest, just the way you like it..."

256e396b-ba77-429b-a4d8-3809016dd3a4.Text: "People call me a widow and a servitor's wife, but I know you're still in there, my love. If you would just look at me..."

82807d36-11f9-4647-a139-f2c9a6775052.Text: "Where did that layabout go? Find the parasite and put him to work. Break the flute. The rat goes in the vat."

593e86b4-7700-4762-9cce-d6cdc971814d.Text: "Where are you taking us? And what are the chains for?"

be05868e-0d5b-410f-aed0-8c05b7079833.Text: "Bay SL-M18. And the chains are to make sure that when you get there, you man the machinery and make no attempt to escape. You wanted work, you've got it."

90041852-f2be-41d8-b669-895c2de84143.Text: "What do we even need this... literancy for?"

a8a33c5b-42ea-4620-81a0-7e07cee993dc.Text: "I dunno, I'd rather put letters together than break my back working. Who knows, p'r'aps the Lord Captain will make us officers."

974d8e13-3b72-462e-a179-071259c7734e.Text: "My head's been killing me for two days. Lugging crates was easier than this."

a308727a-74ad-4857-aa8c-bfda761f7752.Text: "What's even going on? They aren't setting fire to our hovels, them 'forcers have been muzzled, and now the rations are a whole card cheaper."

b3166507-a404-4d62-9a4c-a5a6d8fcfe25.Text: "The God-Emperor has heard our prayers and sent us a Lord Captain who cares about us small folk!"

619ce47b-3c1f-41a5-9c39-7f2055dfe02a.Text: "Oh yeah? What kind of fool prayed for us to be taught letters? Should have asked for new shoes or some rations."

619d0c63-2aad-4a43-b5e4-ebd54d1c00f5.Text: "No wonder they shat their pants — {mf|His|Her} Captainship sure did tug on their leash! Won't be waving their clubs about so freely now, will they?"

c5ca80f4-f171-4296-a833-7899146f6489.Text: "I should say a prayer for our Rogue Trader. If {mf|he|she} dies, things will turn real bad for us again real fast."

7d5b8208-943d-4ead-b080-099f71fade35.Text: "Shame about the flute player losing his spot, but I'm more of a food person myself."

d88ac637-3f5c-41f7-a273-f665fa1028a1.Text: "Yeah, can't exactly fill your stomach with music, can you."

d75cce32-17d4-4863-a1bb-d35ce574a074.Text: "Remember the loading dock that used to seize up all the time? We used to have to carry cargo on our backs when we were just labourers."

4e274a64-4844-4016-809d-8ff05faf2f55.Text: "I said a prayer to the Omnissiah yesterday, checked the configuration, oiled the gears, and... it worked!"

4470377e-e466-4414-94fb-2ba7fde9bc7c.Text: "That's why you trained to be a technomat. Light a candle for the Lord Captain's health — it's thanks to {mf|his|her} concern that we've become more useful to the bay."

b29dbf75-d951-4b01-b27a-edc85911f468.Text: "Pick me for studying. I got a huge noggin, see!"

6e38bdca-960d-47bc-81f7-c386e15320d4.Text: "Do they give food? I sure am ready to learn if they do!"

37f5d758-12f1-469c-955e-07bcd26083b0.Text: "Listen here, slackers: the Lord Captain has decreed that some of you should be taught reading and writing."

9a76d11d-74d3-473c-b8d3-5a38310b9e8c.Text: "I can't imagine why you'd need them there letters and numbers, but you'll be studying until the brains come out your ears."

974b3acb-434b-42f0-a2e7-b6f483c13fda.Text: "Praise the Emperor, for your malady is receding. Thank the Lord Captain for sending us here."

cb961df6-e01b-46b1-a8f8-e684415a0427.Text: "Is it really? It's tormented me for so many years... Now I can finally live a life without pain."

0ddef2af-8a27-4f9a-ab8e-b334889d9e57.Text: "Pipe down, you lot. Those not on shift will get a free ration. Thank the Lord Captain for this mercy."

b8cea443-5b37-417e-be6f-51782c2f03cf.Text: "Lord Captain, an urgent report from the vessel's shrine: a group of unknown assailants has invaded His temple and plundered the incorruptible relics of your ancestors, slaughtering devout worshippers as they went. The High Factotum is among the casualties. Had Master Monteg and Mistress Sauerback not arrived in time... Fortunately, Master Danrok survived and remains conscious, albeit in great pain. He implores Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} to come to the temple and hear his confession."

05d5eb9c-7737-46af-9342-8cebbc879b93.Text: "And so it comes to pass," {n}Kibellah's sombre voice fills the broadcast.{/n} "I performed a reading of {g|Encyclopedia:ImperialTarotGlossary}His Tarot{/g} after the morning watch siren, but the visions sent by the Undying One were too indistinct. I saw rivers of blood flowing toward the bones of the dead, and a blurred figure, laughing, treading upon the ashes of the fallen. It is now clear: the Undying One desires me to follow the figure's tracks. Thus, my hunt begins."

7459403f-8e11-4753-8582-a653a2561b06.Text: "Permission to report, Lord Captain." {n}Sauerback's voice is resonant.{/n} "Mistress Kibellah has been apprehended by enforcers at the scene of a crime. Eyewitnesses saw her assault and kill the esteemed Chirurgeon Majoris. She has confessed to the murder."

848aee00-8a58-4714-8576-f7b00c54ac77.Text: "The penalty for murdering a senior officer is death. However, given Mistress Kibellah's honourable service and her... special status, I dare not proceed without your permission. She is incarcerated and awaiting your judgement. Let me know when you are ready to hear her case."

be8aebbb-53d8-44c4-af5c-9ef572c87bb2.Text: Fire a volley at the corpses, consigning them to the cleansing flame.

8fde8946-a822-4df1-9981-27663f77f170.Text: Leave the scene of the carnage.

0c0ced20-a38b-4b50-a098-cef590735bd0.Text: The battle is over. All around there is wreckage and countless corpses. Your guns have burst the transport like a rotten fruit, and myriad bodies float out into the void. Judging by their clothes, they were innocent inhabitants of various worlds captured by the Final Dawn.

6ce93cbb-f5ad-495e-a751-97e09b6b09d8.Text: The crew on the bridge watches the mass burial in the void. May the Emperor embrace these unfortunate souls!

795e726e-d507-465c-92ce-4733642ef909.Text: The blasphemers must have captured the pilgrims' vessel and converted it into their unholy sorcerous flagship. Among the wreckage, you manage to find a vile amulet that exudes the corrupting influence of the warp, and a {g|Encyclopedia:Cybercrypt}data-crypt{/g}.

8fe75c87-e2bb-46cd-8ac0-14ac88155609.Text: Judging from the surviving data, the Final Dawn raided unprotected planets and captured their inhabitants for use in dark rituals. The sorcery helped the heretics move swiftly between worlds and evade punitive strikes. Now the Expanse can breathe a sigh of relief, for you have eliminated a monstrous threat and saved millions of lives.

beb6261b-29b4-43ed-9709-404c76edb66a.Text: Request a report from the Astropathic Chapel.

51289241-6723-409c-98f1-2297a63007b6.Text: Fire all weapons. You will strike first.

a87b7a67-06ec-4004-bc2b-86e958461b24.Text: The heretics will fall. Battle stations!

22db8259-4cd7-4c96-95ec-93a380cf7edd.Text: A huge portal unfolds before you, and a horrifying transport vessel emerges. Its hull is riddled with the unholy markings of the Final Dawn, and behind it stretch corpses on chains, frozen in the icy void. The Astropathic Choir starts wailing in agony. The giant is followed by the blasphemers' smaller ships, like eager dogs hungry for prey. The crew curses the enemies of Humanity and is ready to destroy the heretics.

7339edbe-a24c-4f4d-8bb1-f95433d4731e.Text: The warp is boiling, illuminated by the mad, impossible colours exuded by the ship. Gnashing his teeth in pain, the duty officer reports that an unholy sorcery of immense proportions is taking place aboard the enemy vessel, where thousands of sacrifices are being offered to the {g|Encyclopedia:ChaosGlossary}Dark Gods{/g}, tearing the veil asunder. The abominable portal that spewed out the heretics is ablaze with roiling warp energies.

e0cbf425-0d20-4a2e-b4f6-81be30b91409.Text: There are reports from many compartments of strange whispers creeping into people's minds, causing some to freeze in terror and others to go berserk. The traitors to Humanity have called down witchcraft upon the ship, but the crew remains steadfast and undaunted!

cadef237-79d6-4b95-a7fc-387e5055181c.Text: A transport unfitted for battle should be an easy target, but an impossible shimmering field surrounds the ship and absorbs the explosions. The bridge erupts with cries of righteous anger.

8d22f0af-8f3e-4168-ad4c-c5fa1bb4908d.Text: To enter the warp stirred by sorcery would be madness, but a Navigator as powerful as Lady Cassia can keep a vessel safe even from the fury of the Immaterium.

16f2c88e-98eb-4630-9873-d6817cdaec3b.Text: "Make sure none of the mutants survived."

94ab2640-99ac-4fd7-a4d9-91701acddfb3.Text: "Search every nook and cranny for anything of value and bring it back. The station should be full of caches packed with plunder."

0a5d83a6-4c39-407d-b609-1a0dbd1571e3.Text: "May this station serve the Imperial Navy and become their outpost."

ecf32c26-4983-4558-ae59-d528fc81fefc.Text: "Heriokh's Rim remains a valuable trade hub. We will continue to do business with pirates. From now on, this station is mine."

9e20287d-0547-4585-b2ca-6d48d4cdb6cc.Text: "I want this station converted into an outpost and towed to the Mundus Valancius System. Let it guard my capital."

83641a71-2f0f-4079-b27c-a5c88ed7e3ad.Text: Destroyed a pirate station as a warning to the enemies of the Imperium.

0aadac03-0802-40a2-a697-7b3708ca9072.Text: "Destroy the station. Let the Expanse know what fate awaits mutants, pirates, and heretics."

e9a3849f-2bbc-40a9-9624-6d449baad1d2.Text: "Lord Cap'n, their resistance is broken, and the cleanup parties are landing on Heriokh's Rim. What are your immediate orders?"

04bf93a6-bc5b-4531-84a3-af60ec16e2e1.Text: "The shuttles with trophies are already on their way to the flagship for unloading and inventorisation. But what about the station itself? I daresay it is a more valuable asset than the recovered commodities."

dad50a06-a081-46a0-a23c-fb501e6707e6.Text: "The admirals will appreciate the gift, and the merchants will extol Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} for bringing a new safe route to the Expanse."

1bbdba26-2160-4173-a68e-7afc7d0f866f.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} truly knows how to make friends and maximise profits. I am sure the Fellowship of the Void will be delighted to know that you are the new {mf|master|mistress} of the station."

69f7113d-fed2-447a-a726-f3fddf4ac932.Text: "The decision of a truly prudent ruler who cares for the safety of the heart of {mf|his|her} protectorate."

e37c63bc-51f6-4f8b-bbaa-40248e1b89b6.Text: {n}Heriokh's Rim perishes in the fire of the orbital cannons. A great lesson for all who do lawless deeds in the shadows.{/n}

010dbf11-5215-4bcb-ac45-6cd09284c729.Text: "Lord Captain, the enforcers have turned the station upside down, but found no trace of genetic aberration. They look like normal people, and their guts look just as normal."

9cd07eba-2fce-47ea-80d9-321835ddcb8d.Text: "You were searching the compartments instead of checking out the life support systems. My crew knocked down a suspicious bulkhead and found an entire mutant lair behind it."

cc4e100f-dbb0-468f-9055-d89e9235e106.Text: "Hold your tongue, Monteg. Don't try to pass off a stroke of luck as competence!" {n}The vox relays the stamping of feet and unintelligible swearing. The Master-at-Arms's voice turns pensive.{/n} "There is a lair, after all. But it is... unimpressive somehow. All the symbols of their foul faith are simple, crude. A few sleeping bags, primitive weapons, a decrepit vox-station, and almost no records of future planned actions... I was of the opinion that our previous foe posed a greater threat than this."

d20e4571-4755-4279-9a8e-b9a9457b1150.Text: "The unholy freak lied when he named this place as the source of the corruption." {n}Sauerback's voice burns with hatred.{/n} "I wish that scum could hang again. At least we can take some comfort in knowing that we have destroyed a pirate den, not the Emperor's honest servants. There is now one fewer seedbed of heresy in the Expanse."

2ed2c752-e27f-48b0-91cf-1edf520a9d84.Text: "A mutant, one of you, revealed your hideout's existence to us before he died."

0a637d9f-f60a-4920-89d9-54e14d2867d6.Text: "I wish to upgrade the vessel's weapons."

c6017202-bf95-4daa-a11e-d6d04e16980d.Text: "I will believe you and leave Heriokh's Rim alone. For now."

3e265c93-bbcc-4a72-80e9-07008b67d4bb.Text: "What rumours have been flying around lately?"

27841562-c333-4d18-a4d1-cda39f622d3d.Text: "Heriokh's Rim, this is {name} von Valancius. Surrender without a fight, mutant scum, and I will grant you a swift death."

9116adc0-da6e-40ec-bd2a-45159e38a565.Text: "The mutant stronghold will fall. To arms!"

42f87a05-4051-4af0-bba1-f7b972d766fa.Text: "I will not fall for the heretics' deception. Die."

e1fe27c5-f5a8-4df6-b5f0-d895af77ce0d.Text: "How can you prove the station has not been infested with genetic aberrations?"

4b6b6ae2-9d1e-488f-9cf0-a5855345f331.Text: "Ravor, do you have any tactical recommendations for the assault?"

1edb3b0d-6eba-4677-825d-bd10af0123e5.Text: "I wish to sell weapons to the Fellowship of the Void."

a1c5f5ed-38ae-4789-878e-c8c8274bc61d.Text: "But it did fail to carry its previous owner away from disaster."

eae4b43b-17e9-4337-9120-cdd66281934a.Text: "We welcome Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} to Heriokh's Rim, our humble trading station. I am steward Pontius Lochten, here to offer our highborn guest only the finest wares and special ship modules."

75372492-8ebd-4ac7-9e56-3636b3eaa9e9.Text: "Lord Cap'n, the ship's cannons are fully primed. The station is well fortified and its inhabitants will probably attempt to fight back, but we are stronger. Do you command we attack this hotbed of genetic aberration?"

ccee6b74-b6cd-450b-9cb9-d7cd61b0d8b6.Text: "Of course not! How can one steal from the wielder of such mighty weapons!"

140abd00-1e6a-4176-ad2b-df41c38168e0.Text: "Perhaps you might be interested in macro-cannons? Solid, robust and in very, very good condition. You will crush any enemy with their power at your side!"

42a50d9f-a85f-43ee-84f6-985a3d079c03.Text: "Take a look at this model — it will be a worthy acquisition for your flagship. The spirit of this machine is obstinate but fast!"

27073cfe-3cff-424c-ba21-3f03ff72276f.Text: "Emperor have mercy, what mutants? We are but a bunch of voidsmen, a collective of harmless traders. I urge you to leave station orbit or we will be forced to defend ourselves!"

02efc92d-8806-4395-821d-419509ebea42.Text: "May the new cannons bring you many glorious victories!"

1f2ca180-d1fc-432c-b886-0a4219465d45.Text: "There is a rumour about a lone Adeptus Mechanicus ship, an ancient hulk that is reported to appear in one system or the other, only to vanish the next day. Who knows why it broke away from the {g|Encyclopedia:ExploratorsGlossary}Explorator{/g} Fleet or what secrets it may hold. But this is just a tall tale, unworthy of Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}'s ears."

84a4cb5e-4bf5-42f8-9c9d-6842deda5929.Text: "I will hold on to this component for you in case you change your mind."

2582d8ff-10f1-47bf-a791-90dc5e5e83a2.Text: "May the Emperor bless your good judgement! Let us forget this unpleasant incident and restore mutually beneficial relations."

8d138893-89d7-4b27-b180-a52e7d323b3f.Text: "I knew Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} would come back! How may I assist you? Heriokh's Rim is at your service!"

a9631293-82b4-4c70-9efd-cf76da4308a9.Text: "I cannot imagine why, but this heretic of yours slandered us from head to toe! Whatever possessed Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} to trust the word of a mutant? Their thoughts are as unclean and disgusting as their bodies!"

ae9350e0-2058-4c45-bbd8-7d295f52bc61.Text: "I'd advise a decisive approach strategy. The station is well prepared for a long-range artillery duel — rumour has it they traded with the Explorators for improved macro-cannon boosters and warheads whose spirits can adjust the flight of missiles. In a short-range battle, their guns will be less dangerous."

3e388d68-1cff-411f-8b84-2ed208321518.Text: "According to the overseer, the last deal was particularly successful and made a profit beyond expectation, so the station is sending a shuttle of valuable cargo."

c9f3e9c5-9701-4a35-b67c-e19809380042.Text: "The overseer states that your trade partners will greatly appreciate your good business sense."

fec1e4b5-5a9e-46ae-9fa8-313bd7e5b5bb.Text: "I will hold on to this worthy commodity in case you change your mind."

a8481ab6-0e87-4ab0-919b-b4d6d9fa7938.Text: "I humbly apologise for my impertinence, but the burden of proof lies on the accuser! Whatever crimes may be attributed to us, they do not include aberrant mutations! And I must warn you that we will not go down without a fight!"

7ef3fb90-9d70-4e4b-9bfd-7c0f1ab5e9a0.Text: {n}The helmsman's snort is heard over the internal vox-channel.{/n} "A trading station? Pull the other one. Everyone in the Expanse knows that this is a pirate den where they peddle the stolen plunder. But to be fair, they never touch the customers, which is probably why they are still alive."

909e4006-737c-4211-96b5-da66ae604bb4.Text: "Same old, same old. Rampaging pirates, nefarious smugglers, {g|Encyclopedia:XenosGlossary}xenos{/g} preying on lone ships. The valiant {g|Encyclopedia:ImperialNavyGlossary}Imperial Navy{/g} alone fights them all, and we thank the God-Emperor that we can enjoy its protection!"

3d13c828-7ea7-4648-ab53-1a769845c36e.Text: "Lord Captain, {g|Encyclopedia:ImperialNavyGlossary}Imperial Navy{/g} Fort Heriokh's Rim hails us. The commander thanks you for your cooperation and reports that the station you bestowed has become a stronghold in this system. Pirates and heretics flee from patrols to the delight of law-abiding merchants!"

c5c023c2-4829-477d-bc16-e5f9a0e994ca.Text: "Absolutely not! The previous owner was boarded at the docks— I apologise, I meant to say this merchandise is perfectly legal!"

77780808-4f77-4f50-902c-5e81a4ab284f.Text: "Lord Captain, the new station overseer greets you warmly and reports that under your patronage, trade on the station is going well, as evidenced by the reports sent to the High Factotum. The overseer also reports that the station has secured a lucrative contract to supply weapons to the Fellowship of the Void."

d0081e81-1c8e-4b67-8552-422759922721.Text: "Lord Captain, the fort commander reports that the capital is under attack by xenos! The outpost's forces are insufficient to destroy the enemy, but they are ready to fight to the last drop of blood for Dargonus and the von Valancius dynasty!"

bf587cf9-45d8-467d-8782-6dc280a87778.Text: "Lord Captain! The commander of Heriokh's Rim reports that the outpost is keeping a vigilant eye over the vicinity of the capital world. No enemy ships or unauthorised vessels have been detected."

ff7de0d2-8de6-4bfa-916a-45cc7f450471.Text: Bomb the Necron ship along with the corpses.

af3fac47-b2c3-4808-b911-583c315b8597.Text: Study the contents of the data-slate.

42d5acbc-f3ea-4b36-a9e7-5cc18b6298ad.Text: Bring the remains up to the flagship and give them a proper burial in the crypt.

70679fbc-1904-4a72-8e84-3e119c253fc3.Text: The xenos are defeated, and your men board the enemy ship, cutting their way through the bulkheads to the source of the signal. They find the decayed remains of a von Valancius boarding party. One of the corpses is clutching a vox-caster, sending the voices of the dead out into the void. All of them fell many decades ago.

8d1cc364-1136-45aa-b245-4113117c2a09.Text: You find a single order given by Lady Theodora. The boarding party was commanded to infiltrate the xenos vessel and hold off the enemy until the dynasty flagship withdraws to a safe distance.

1083398b-eb31-451a-86d1-ff2c43adf651.Text: A prayer service for the fallen is broadcast throughout the flagship. In the following days, people line up to honour the martyrs in the ship's chapels.

3bccdbad-acec-43e1-832d-e01128e947c0.Text: The bridge is filled with sombre jubilation. The sight of the huge flaming tomb becomes the final chord of vengeance against the enemies of Humanity.

9a11946d-9f05-46d9-b1b3-12546e2514a0.Text: A data-slate and a weapon that belonged to the commander of the boarding party were recovered from the dead men's belongings. The words "Hope is poison. Kill it, and death becomes easy and desirable" were scratched into the stock.

656b941b-a622-4642-99b5-3c45429de222.Text: Request a report on the enemy.

8b45febd-09bd-4b9e-9ad3-6d857517229f.Text: There is not a moment to lose. To battle!

8a3306f9-fb76-4752-99d5-905e9efbda2c.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:Augur}augurs{/g} reveal two xenos ships hurtling through clouds of cosmic dust. A message is coming from one of the alien vessels on an encrypted vox-frequency used by the von Valancius dynasty. According to the transmission, Lady Theodora's people are aboard the xenos ship!

c70d57c5-1ead-4c62-a50e-fb3c6db77103.Text: The augurs are spotting more and more xenos vessels, but most of them are in a strange state of dormancy. Are they... asleep? Dead? Cautiousness dictates not to test this hypothesis. Thankfully, the nebulae in the system could allow the dynasty flagship to evade danger.

0de95fc5-8f6c-4ff0-8aec-f7c4ab53efd2.Text: The same request for help keeps coming back. "We are alive. We are fighting. We need support."

860e3767-e064-4497-8c22-d606c07ab1b8.Text: "Attack my demesne and I will end you."

7656ad9a-62f1-4e55-a3ed-46af4359528a.Text: "I wish to keep that captive. I would rather not leave her in your hands."

140091a4-f320-4cb1-ad03-da7c809b17df.Text: "Keep a stern eye on your prisoner."

2a5897fb-ec5a-4b65-89e6-daf051a2a392.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! I cannot tell you how grateful I am. Please accept my sincere appreciation and a shuttle with gifts. In addition to the spoils taken from the defeated enemy, the presents include a very special item. The old bastard Saarhol was very proud to possess it. I will send word of your kindness to all corners of the Expanse, and let the Fellowship of the Void know that you are a friend to the free people."

75d9ce73-fea8-4ffb-984d-320ec0977713.Text: "Thank you for your cooperation, Rogue Trader. The boarding party has captured van der Roycen. Perhaps the poor girl has simply fallen under a bad influence, and so I will personally see to her... re-education. The reward for her capture is yours as promised. In addition, I am enclosing a particularly valuable trophy as a token of my sincerest gratitude."

28b79b20-9e54-4c7f-b874-708974f4ff13.Text: "To a place where there are no ranks, no authority, no tyrants, no arranged marriages. I hope our paths will cross again one day, but for now, I bid you farewell!"

5dd56486-3e1d-4dd9-a696-140c1b05380e.Text: "I have seen you in action and I can assure you that black day will never come. I wish to be your ally, not your enemy, and I hope the feeling is mutual. Farewell, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"

515c3063-e864-4291-9b4e-e7275ad0fbfe.Text: "What? No, she is mine!" {n}There is silence for a while, then the vox-caster lets out a heavy sigh.{/n} "You want her? Then go get her. I just threw her out of the airlock. I have already lost too much by chasing her, and I will not fight a Rogue Trader. Good day to you."

15d4c319-a948-4b89-a986-a4a1d04c93b8.Text: "I have no illusions. She is a piece of work, but I promised her parents that I would take care of her. I dare not detain Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} any longer."

6887816d-0300-4171-88ed-07ca2735f33a.Text: "This is not our battle. We are leaving."

8cc52498-88bc-482a-af49-790368b9f67b.Text: "I am hailing the commander... or the gang boss... or whoever is in charge of you void scoundrels."

84ddaf5d-0685-4d87-8f7b-a34a46d25df4.Text: "We attack the Imperial Navy from the rear. Today, I fight for freedom!"

ed3954dc-24e0-4335-b9b3-8cee70f1dc34.Text: "We are engaging. Let us help the Navy crush the pirate scum."

27652b1e-8222-43d9-b9b0-b4852ee28c0e.Text: "Hailing the commander of the Imperial Navy forces. Who are you trying to kill out there?"

c56e4cbf-423a-402f-8fe6-d81598048ba1.Text: "Lord Captain, we have an {g|Encyclopedia:ImperialNavyGlossary}Imperial Navy{/g} squadron preparing to engage a pirate mob. The forces of both flotillas are comparable. Do you wish to intervene?"

888cb9d5-e447-48aa-8929-9995adf50bef.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, this is Princess Lucretia van der Roycen. I beg you, do not remain on the sidelines. That old ruffian, Admiral Saarhol, is willing to kill thousands of people just to get me! He is not a force of justice, he is obsessed with his own personal desires! He has been stalking me for years, he got my father to agree to our wedding, and even now refuses to give up! Please protect me and the handful of freedom fighters like myself! We do not want to be ruled by tyrants like Saarhol!"

c80ecbd2-c634-4328-bdf2-f3b375e505d5.Text: "Greetings, Rogue Trader. We have tracked down a gang of murderers led by the notorious criminal Lucretia van der Roycen. This woman is responsible for many atrocities, including the murder of her own father, the planetary governor of the Imperial world Seleucar. She conspired with void rabble, helped them commit a massacre on her home planet, became their leader, and now she is running amok. I invite you to join me in bringing her to justice!"

53fec4cf-0d0e-4a63-94bb-ef37728bf9b4.Text: "Pirate sympathisers, you have been identified and will be held to Imperial justice!" {n}The vox-caster emits a loud crack as if it had been thrown against a wall.{/n}

88c5907d-40f3-45f3-abbf-526c414fd2f4.Text: "Damn you! All we want is to take charge of our own lives. If that means killing you, so be it!"

6b339987-a0d4-44ac-bed8-db795c53f6d4.Text: Kibellah has lived through impossible torment at the hands of the Haemonculus. She has asked the Lord Captain to speak with her.

cbd9a56f-bcf5-40dc-919f-033a9aa0542e.Text: Kibellah wishes to attend another social function. However, this one is to take place on Dargonus. Janris Danrok will be waiting for the Lord Captain at the palace to commence the event.

1ceb720e-129a-4946-aa54-cf8bb8d088fe.Text: In order to host a truly memorable ceremony, the Lord Captain should discuss the preparations with the High Factotum on the bridge.

4353cf9e-8096-4b69-9245-0027bb42ffcd.Text: Janris Danrok is making arrangements for the event. He will let the Lord Captain know as soon as everything is prepared.

7d76e93c-8fa7-4785-8ec6-f901c00c4de2.Text: Wait for the High Factotum to deliver the news

63b2dad4-1102-4a50-b76b-5668e6d03485.Text: Everything is ready for the gathering on the officers' deck.

ff58fc7a-6ef8-4b78-a32a-bac397fd055d.Text: The Lord Captain attended the social gathering on the officers' deck and introduced Kibellah to the customs of nobility.

b77ef7f3-ccfe-4337-8047-5f25fabe2433.Text: Kibellah has accepted the Lord Captain's invitation to learn more about the ceremonial customs of the ship's upper decks.

462daa68-31e0-4361-9fcd-0300b013e6f9.Text: Kibellah is waiting for the Lord Captain on the bridge. She means to perform a mysterious ritual that will bind the Domin and her together in the eyes of the Undying Emperor.

101f4e5d-4b26-4958-8d0c-c7dba94cc557.Text: "Is the madman gone? I heard screaming. I think he killed someone with his bare hands!"

89ffdd02-263a-40fb-b3ce-a5bf6c21fc76.Text: "Why don't you go have a look? Maybe the killer is already gone and left the dead man's belongings up for grabs."

b4e44b5d-ad0e-4b89-af7b-4398aaade985.Text: "Not a chance! I am not going out there. No loot is worth facing that lunatic a second time."

6df5fd9d-6b61-48dd-aee2-23c1b8e62f76.Text: "We don't know where your beast is! Don't kill me!"

3b3dbc9d-eace-49af-adb3-ddb4933f220f.Text: "Shut up! Can't you see this isn't that brute? So, we live to see another day... I hope."

d6a6ab70-59db-4c1a-a2a3-db66deb89654.Text: "Go on, run! Scream! We haven't had our fill of toying with you yet before the feast is over..."

52153bcf-392c-41d7-b0c2-50b947df7a05.Text: "Ah, someone else has joined us. Let us leave the prey here — make him believe he is out of danger... so that our final visit can reveal the full bouquet of his despair."

ec3ce600-7316-4cee-a007-e73d38635ee8.Text: The guilt is proven. The Weapon of Justice proceeds with {g|f:dffbc4538c8f4571b56ffb0b9c93e5c3}Inevitable Retribution{/g}.

848b5227-5a87-498b-9f70-18eadf3fb93d.Text:
[Accusation: Improper Cyber-Mastiff Exploitation]
You and your cyber-mastiff must deal the same number of instances of damage!

51c40172-ed70-44f6-884b-f1def6608ff0.Text: Whenever Marshal Strachs suffers {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}, adjacent targets suffer damage equal to half the number of his {g|f:85a47da9a853494293b7b2eee8cccc2a}kinesiostatic shield{/g} stacks.

5e234105-a087-45bc-a611-f95fcae0b42d.Text: The enforcer of the law makes an accusation. If the accused person is proven guilty by the end of their {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} through their actions, the Weapon of Justice proceeds with {g|f:dffbc4538c8f4571b56ffb0b9c93e5c3}Inevitable Retribution{/g}.

3eaeb0b2-6e21-42ef-9e32-c29cd4a2c37f.Text: While Prefect Vultur is protected by the glasscrete barrier, she cannot be targeted or {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damaged{/g}. The barrier durability can only be reduced by {g|f:dffbc4538c8f4571b56ffb0b9c93e5c3}Inevitable Retribution{/g}.

84654acc-d0c1-43d0-8a55-5130539c64ba.Text:
This weapon can be activated by Prefect Vultur or the {g|f:2cf8fef6da524c2ea554464b64d4d719}Accusers{/g}.
If the accused person does not fulfil the required actions by the end of their {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, their guilt is considered proven, and this weapon shoots toward them.
If the accused person fulfils the requirement or kills the {g|f:2cf8fef6da524c2ea554464b64d4d719}Accuser{/g} by the end of their turn, this weapon shoots in Prefect Vultur's direction instead.

88f3cdf2-a669-4b23-87d1-e01df87733ac.Text: If the {g|f:2cf8fef6da524c2ea554464b64d4d719}Accuser{/g} dies, the Weapon of Justice unleashes {g|f:dffbc4538c8f4571b56ffb0b9c93e5c3}Inevitable Retribution{/g} upon Prefect Vultur.

c0537577-bfd8-4b61-86af-a1136cd1fdac.Text: The weapon set was changed, and the creatures have gained additional {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}abilities{/g}.

43ab22e1-34a6-4dcb-8d37-a36914f0c59b.Text: A mercifully quick electric shock was not what killed this cultist. His face is contorted in pain as if he was tortured.

4c25e2a3-1606-4971-a046-88dbb74e6489.Text: There are no wounds on the heretic's body, but his face is contorted in terror, and his eyes are bloodshot from ruptured vessels.
