The source of this sound turns out to be the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusAdministratum}Administratum{/g} clerk you saw next to Chaplain. His clothes are neat and impeccably pressed. His face, however, reveals extreme nervousness bordering on fear.{/n} "My good {mf|Master|Mistress} Fidelio! I do hope you're satisfied with the services provided by our establishment?"

a9a4eee9-ef32-4a75-9188-e7dc1eb54a61.Text: "I had just prepared the newest batch of superb, unique implants of the highest quality. But I got careless! I used my first sick leave in four standard years! And it was on that very day that Master Bellardo passed away, and his family was quick to organise a ceremony in our crematorium... I simply didn't have time to prepare. And now my container full of goods — it's in the furnace, and if you don't help me, they're going to burn it any minute!"

51845bf0-f165-4dc4-b1a7-d522fa8b69aa.Text: "Therefore, I am forced — practically forced! — to look for other sources of income that allow me to stay within the walls of this here establishment. I've set up a little, shall we say, enterprise — I replace the {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}implants{/g} of the deceased with identical replicas and sell them to the right people when I have a shipment ready."

bc72ac1e-378f-4e53-8fe8-eb412da661aa.Text: "While there's still time, could you please get to the furnace and pull the container with implants out of there? We'll split the goods fifty-fifty, you can even have first pick! Just please, hurry! They'll soon be putting the coffin with old Bellardo where it belongs, and then... poof! It will be reduced to ash, and my priceless augmetics along with it!"

d7557b7d-a938-425c-b9e9-2287feb761bd.Text: "Such a shame, such a terrible shame... but if you change your mind — just pop into the furnace and get the container out. It's in the far corner, you can't miss it!"

06e2b690-4af1-4db8-9389-f84b00d46aeb.Text: "{g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Throne{/g} preserve you! Make it look like you're just having a look around — it's a lot easier for you to wander into a restricted area without arousing suspicion than it is for me. Find the container — it's in the far corner — get out and come back to me! I'll be waiting!"

bd5b9dab-0d19-49b2-8489-de4495789279.Text: {n}He leans in a little closer and whispers,{/n} "I beg of you... help me! But please keep your voice down, we can't let anyone hear us... It's a matter of life and death!"

448ab626-f078-4fda-893b-b4e0abd33a0b.Text: {n}The clerk wipes the sweat from his brow nervously.{/n} "Please understand, it's very difficult to get by on Footfall with my wages! And Imperial regulation 4030/8L 'On Postmortal Service Workers on Peripheral Worlds' directly prohibits the chief operator of the crematorium from leaving their workplace for any reason other than sleep, food, severe illness, and ministration of sacraments."

7e61ba29-da23-4ae3-8d90-f36003a85ca3.Text: "I've been hiding them there for ten years now, and quite successfully, I might add! Only the richest citizens can afford the services of a crematorium, and, sadly, they don't die all that often. Usually I sell the goods before the next body arrives. But I got unlucky this time. Help me, I beg of you!"

ad8a33dc-2ce7-48b6-8f93-b09776af0157.Text: "Of course... of course, will do! You'll be most pleased with the results! Just help me, for {g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Throne{/g}'s sake..."

b92872ed-c927-4ba3-af1c-32b9397895ab.Text: "There's no one else to turn to!" {n}The clerk exclaims in dismay.{/n} "All the guests here are scoundrels, murderers, or crooks — or all three at once! I was going to send in a {g|Encyclopedia:Servitor}servitor{/g}, but only personal servitors of House Bellardo are allowed into the courtyard today, and I don't have their access codes. You're all I have left! And I can tell you're an upstanding individual... with a most noble countenance, too! The moment I saw you, I knew — {mf|he|she} is the one who will save me!"

54e1e217-28aa-4408-8f82-65883013207f.Text: [Give alms] "I'm feeling kind today. Here, for your help with the fire."

31fd90cb-9fd6-4937-ad14-b3a93705bbfb.Text: "Who are you and what are you doing down here?"

71ebd977-4771-4fbf-9bfe-c310f72048f5.Text: "Do you happen to know who Fidelio is?"

72fd2815-7aeb-4f61-bb40-7a276ff1eee1.Text: "How do I get out of here?"

47ac8bec-845f-46a6-97b9-fada66ea4b91.Text: "They're on fire! On fire! Put them out, put them out, quick!" {n}The voices come to you through streams of something thick and foul — your eyes are covered with whatever your unbidden saviours saw fit to splash over your head.{/n}

94652078-bc57-466a-ab5e-d5458dd2ab33.Text: {n}At last, you can make out the silhouette of a vagrant dressed in rags leaning over you. He throws up his hands.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordiness|Ladyness}, are you all right? Did you hit anything? Any bad burns? You fell right through that there ceiling, and it's mighty high up!"

eb13eccb-a7e6-47ed-8284-4865bab427a8.Text: "The fact that the incompetence of the crematorium's maintenance staff saved our lives does not make their negligence any less egregious. I will register a complaint."

f3fa6a95-38bf-4549-8293-ace9a49516fd.Text: {n}The vagrants' faces brighten, and they accept your handout with a bow.{/n} "Oh, thank you, thank you kindly! Something to buy a bit of food with. 'Cause, well, we used our soup to put you out, you see. And it was only two days old!"

394167be-48f8-493c-a111-a3658d0c5316.Text: "We live here, is all... Your {mf|Lordiness|Ladyness}. You see, these are old tunnels, they dug 'em back in Parsimus Dewain's times, right through the asteroid. It's a little stuffy down here, but it's warmer than up in the big palaces on the surface."

e2fc72ca-5422-4768-bcf4-bba6fe0946b3.Text: "And it sure is warm under the crematorium's furnace! They barely burn anyone up there, but they do fire it up often enough — and that's good for us... sure, sometimes an odd smell makes it through the vents, like they're making roast — makes yer mouth water! But what can you do... that's the cost of comfort for ya!"

c7f3d3f6-0545-472a-bf20-5017271883f9.Text: {n}The vagrants look at each other in surprise.{/n} "I mean, wasn't there that Fid lad, used to live under the Fifth Void? And his hussy kept yellin' all like, 'My Fiiido!'? Fidelio, Fid — same deal, right?"

d451590b-27bc-44be-8026-382fc6f5ad81.Text: "Well, there's no climbing back into the crematorium for ya — look for yourself, it's all burnt and collapsed. But it's no biggie! There's only one way up there, so you won't get lost. First you'll need to pull this big old lever to open the doors. It's by the busted pipe — that's where the lever is. After that, you just walk. Through the corridors, the shaft, the old warehouse. And there you are, on the surface."

3c8945aa-c14a-467a-9bfa-4b26c9616b57.Text: "All the best on your journey and all! May the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} help ya and guide you out!"

7e0b0706-3cc3-45fb-b124-613970fcc0bb.Text: "Honourless, spineless, godless whelps! And you have the gall to call yourselves Imperium subjects? You scoundrels aren't even worthy of a bolt to the head from me — which is a privilege granted to any cowardly weasel on the front lines!"

95a9decd-2db0-42c0-86e7-3870da93028b.Text: "Believe it or not, neither do I."

af89000a-094f-4123-9e9f-213d559fec1e.Text: "And just who are you and what are you doing in here?"

ae86c953-a58c-45d0-9639-034db46e86e2.Text: "Look, all I did was stop by a funeral and introduce myself as Fidelio. Because of this, some people have attempted to burn me alive, others have drenched me in swill, and now thieving utility workers want to murder me. This is starting to feel like a bad joke. How about I just go on my merry way?"

c57efedf-f1af-4468-8170-d97b22146108.Text: [Attack] "You dare threaten one of the von Valancius dynasty. You will pay for this."

fec9ee8f-faa1-4ab1-abe0-c62fab3e4178.Text: "Move it, I said move it! If the inspection gets to the circuit station before we do — I'll have all of you recycled!"

b3231bea-ba32-4f01-aa94-5dd2655bdb06.Text: "Yelling your brains out at {g|Encyclopedia:Servitor}servitors{/g} won't make them work faster."

d775d531-0b1d-4488-aaf8-740ae1a445f7.Text: "You know another way to get the lazy brutes to shift themselves? Well, I'm all ears! If the inspection sees a circuit station without a unit, they'll go to Vladaym with this. And if Vladaym finds out, he won't mince words. He'll give us the old 'Kasballican severance.' As in, kick us out the trash chute without a void suit!"

74c2684b-7a2b-4a9f-af5f-01f3541e0f05.Text: "Simmer down, we'll be fine. Back in my transport days, I'd show the inspection the same protection screen on eight different sites — and I never got busted once. I seriously doubt that Vladaym's inspectors are any more diligent. They'll fall for our one support unit on three circuit stations, they won't notice a thing. Better worry about selling the two units that we borr— who the Throne is that?"

2b72d02f-f9de-4720-b978-f66e89481bd6.Text: {n}Kibellah turns to Pasqal and smiles faintly.{/n} "Now I can take them. Now I hear their names."

d6a6c47e-b1de-4e3b-a0a3-45fee20a2330.Text: "Fidelio? I've no idea who that is..."

48515dc3-639c-4745-8a7a-c3946433b506.Text: {n}The two strangers glance at each other in disbelief and reach for their weapons.{/n}

e4640c38-cc70-4bd7-ae2a-5c485754b3cb.Text: "We're from Footfall Station Services, carrying out scheduled maintenance... but you're not gonna believe that, are you? You heard everything."

cb04fff0-d19c-49da-9f4c-8f358ff33a5e.Text: {n}After glancing briefly at his partner, the man lays a hand on his weapon.{/n} "I promised my wife I could go a month without murder... too bad. I'd rather break my word than get on the Liege's bad side."

c837581f-7772-4795-8886-0c733cc67ecc.Text: {n}The two of them look at each other.{/n} "Hmph. Sure, by all means, go right ahead."

7cb0d399-eac4-48e8-a820-c4a65fdfb022.Text: {n}Then they immediately point their guns at you.{/n} "Just kidding. Ha ha ha! Sorry, but it's the trash chute for you!"

61f39a22-3cfb-4b54-adc3-f128441585f3.Text: "Course you won't — dead men tell no tales."

7895d490-7771-469e-80d1-7d28b7179613.Text: "Von V— bah, whatever! We'll worry about that later!"

b32b6c0e-cb5c-4f8e-91b2-56d57a92dbe1.Text: {n}Pasqal turns to Kibellah and says in a demanding voice,{/n} "They must die. The Undying One has added their names to the catalogue. Eliminate them."

162ae7c3-bd06-4928-9c63-f5b1a41ecab7.Text: "Hey! That... That's not true, I am worthy!"

75081e87-d0b4-4520-9712-487bd9d78476.Text: "This goes beyond a violation of the Rite of Operation. It downright stinks."

67b2daa4-b671-41dd-943e-90f3e2e7d27b.Text: "What are you saying, you moron? Shoot!"

682ab1c7-7252-40d2-b075-08fa990ca06f.Text: {n}Kibellah sighs gravely.{/n} "I... agree with your point, priest. But I am afraid that is not quite how it works."

bfd04749-aed3-4202-8150-1ff223eb6ddc.Text: [Point at the servitor] "Who among you knows this woman? What about the story of the ship named Repentance? I wish to hear it all."

ca7880df-9489-4b1f-9e23-ed7d4fdf4a8e.Text: "I have no use for this wealth. Do with it as you see fit, Chaplain."

f29d3db6-14b0-4ba5-b821-d838e24bde1d.Text: "Again people want to kill me without saying why."

f96c9a14-ba20-4a74-8bb0-63eea5d2f6d7.Text: "I don't quite know how to explain it to you all, but I'm not actually Fidelio."

ba5b9e0e-ef0c-44ff-ba86-1b7ab7ced8de.Text: "I find that Kas Bellardo should inherit the fortune by right of blood."

2f34a5a9-d7e3-416b-96d9-48f9057d80dd.Text: [Attack] "Oh well. Let's get this over with, I suppose."

ae384dfe-f406-4ac2-8606-18f7808977a1.Text: [Attack] "I'll take my chances with the gun!"

538cc361-993e-49c8-88f2-edad209bf06a.Text: [Address Fidelio the Servitor] "Today you will watch your enemies die."

838a6976-7890-46d4-9bbb-99806c0fc863.Text: "Daggen, Denz's mate, deserves to be the heir."

ab3eac76-8728-4750-9a16-ea6cfc374111.Text: "I am Fidelio, and I wish to claim my inheritance."

6914b4bc-d18c-4fe2-a86b-62ca69b29e68.Text: "Kas, get out of my sight. The rest of you — prepare to die. It is time to purge this world of some of its pirate scum."

395ab701-0972-4a09-ad4e-28bf5a61490a.Text: "None among you deserve pity. You will die. All of you."

d1d207c0-e791-4dd6-9bfb-ca3085d529a6.Text: "Treat their wounds. I'm not in a killing mood."

042bd1fa-bc8b-4a6d-ae56-b70cfc5115ed.Text: "I still have a question. Who — in the name of the Golden Throne — is Fidelio?"

d9b8c980-0323-4fab-a733-da636207aa68.Text: "Take care of her, Chaplain. Let her live the rest of her life as peacefully as possible."

f9389654-ae18-4cc7-b887-fbda6f7eff3b.Text: [End her] "Farewell, Fidelio. Both you and the Repentance have been avenged."

74d590e6-d430-476e-825f-a67b78e2fc9d.Text: "I have other business to attend to."

d827982b-738b-436f-a4fe-cbab2f3733a0.Text: "That pirate scum doesn't deserve the honour of my attendance. I'm leaving."

e98f2eea-9052-438f-878f-81089a400f41.Text: "Master or Mistress Fidelio! If you are here now — come forth and lay your claim to the inheritance!"

286e0203-f268-438b-a241-2ad372219e9a.Text: "That takes care of the inheritance. What do we do next?"

6c4dcf1d-151b-4534-8ca4-8066b3612352.Text: "There is still the unresolved matter of Denz's inheritance."

9c08025b-fae0-4433-931a-198b78cfc532.Text: "Then so be it! I am Fidelio, and the inheritance is mine!"

9c752f3d-6430-4fb8-b91d-4df1bdb802e3.Text: Ordered that Denz Bellardo's fortune be given to his granddaughter Adelia.

39b2db5c-0ff7-4d24-bfd8-6272eb226285.Text: "The only one here who truly loved Denz is his granddaughter, Adelia Bellardo. She inherits his fortune."

2e0cef0b-d962-4872-8fd3-7ae7ddadcbfe.Text: "I am the Rogue Trader {name} von Valancius, and as such, I am vested with complete authority on Footfall. I hereby exercise that authority by voiding the will of the pirate Denz Bellardo and confiscating his fortune in its entirety."

9b885e55-bbec-48f8-9504-c6ac9977a457.Text: "A fascinating tale. That is all I have to say."

e1cf16a6-9d6c-4245-be74-8f8f5e384012.Text: "It's all in the past, let us not spill any more blood. Chaplain, take care of this poor soul. May she live out her days in peace."

79497252-0bc8-4341-845c-00d78aee491e.Text: {n}As soon as you appear, a dozen eyes — and guns — shift in your direction. The guests of the ceremony no longer pretend to be peaceful mourners. They are, however, stunned to see you.{/n}

90401ccb-a0b3-4e1b-9472-d64a863b14cf.Text: "I don't believe it... You had the nerve to come back? After your tumble through the flames?"

1b202753-634a-4b03-8543-baaae743834b.Text: "Listen, Daggen. I hate you, you hate me. But maybe we can set aside our differences? For the sake of our mutual... target, so to speak." {n}The man nods at you and narrows his eyes ominously.{/n}

9937d813-fff3-4ff4-8f86-622a864a6183.Text: "Finally, boy, you're showing some signs of being your father's son. Denz would never beat around the bush with rivals. Shoot their head off and be done with it! Anyway, I accept your proposal." {n}He aims his weapon at you.{/n} "We've tried killing you quietly, that didn't work out, so we'll just kill you, plain and simple like. This is Footfall, for Throne's sake! Bye-bye, Fidelio."

35235e5b-99bd-4aec-a15a-48043fb7b3b6.Text: "And so, according to the deceased's will, all of Bellardo's fortune goes... not to his worthless son Kas. Not to his brainless mate Daggen. But to Fidelio — a mysterious new heir. However, I believe a certain party would like to intervene in this process." {n}Chaplain looks straight at you and chuckles.{/n}

5f38fc32-e798-4b09-97fe-642a62079831.Text: "Don't play dumb. Denz, the weasel, left all his money to you — a whole lotta money! I don't know why and I don't want to know, but I think it was very, very wrong of him to forget his old friend. I've got no choice but to fight for justice! So you're going to sit quietly under lock and key while I discuss my share of the inheritance. Isn't that right?"

e1469ed9-8eb4-4630-81a2-182e73374c70.Text: "Anyway, the three of us sat there — me, Denz, and the captain of the Repentance — as the boys brought whoever was left of their crew, one by one — and we popped them. I bet Cockeye over there remembers, he was there too, and so were the Twins." {n}Daggen nods at a few of the guests.{/n}

ab509d45-c68f-4a5e-8cd5-33bd69549cd4.Text: "Anyone would say that looking down the barrels of a dozen guns."

caef1141-86f8-4f5c-9a3b-4017289b0587.Text: {n}Fidelio is standing in a typical servitor pose, eyes staring into space. Only the grips of its metallic appendage are trembling slightly — perhaps caused by a malfunction, or perhaps by suppressed emotions looking for release.{/n}

c25bc35c-3f2f-446d-b264-b26eacb1c931.Text: "Come now, Daggen, let's give the {mf|man|lady} an explanation before {mf|his|her} death. You see, {mf|Master|Mistress} Fidelio, my late father — Denz, daemons take him, Bellardo — has bequeathed his entire fortune to you. Not to me, his only son, not to his first mate — you. So where does that leave us? You must die."

0af7c70e-b241-4ac2-86ce-07665fb9d2f8.Text: {n}Chaplain looks at the carnage around him matter-of-factly.{/n} "Wonderful. This is a funeral Denz would be proud of!"

19639a80-bb48-46f2-b59f-39785913ac45.Text: {n}Kas Bellardo clutches his wounded body.{/n} "The crematorium's going to have its hands full today..."

7d5fda82-fd6f-4e50-8f3a-68e58480bee2.Text: {n}Daggen lifts his bloodied face.{/n} "Agh... It hurts..."

9d09cbd6-82e1-4ba1-8178-75be7c83ce2d.Text: "As it is written in the will. So be it! I will see to all the formalities and make sure you receive all the deeds to the property."

8684b06e-2438-4bbd-bb1f-5f1eea4a2def.Text: "The name on the will is Fidelio, but..." {n}Chaplain pulls a hefty scroll out of his bag and tears it to shreds.{/n} "All his life, Denz spat on laws, I think he'd understand."

64913edf-9796-4b7f-85ac-56fdb3deba37.Text: {n}Chaplain looks at the coffin.{/n} "I would like to say goodbye to my old friend."

6ae11756-e939-41e5-9525-67d4d8f636c2.Text: {n}Chaplain is observing the carnage, unfazed.{/n} "Denz would approve of a funeral like this. Now what? What are we going to do with Fidelio?"

8b58a436-467b-4b3a-ad58-02b8fdcc5a10.Text: "If Fidelio were here, if they were to know about their status as the heir — they would have made themselves known by now. And if it's not you, {mf|sir|ma'am}, then I suppose we'll never know the truth. But we can make our own truth, can't we? We're on Footfall, names and ideas are traded and used here in every way imaginable. And so all that remains is to recognise you as Fidelio."

9215cb14-51df-492a-bce3-e12d50139b3a.Text: "D-dirtbags! This is the last time I deal with nobles!"

2df1ce39-7b36-4b26-acc0-8fa72cd51b54.Text: "The crematorium is a bit wrecked now, heh heh. But who needs a crematorium? Denz loved having his enemies drenched in {g|Encyclopedia:Promethium}promethium{/g} and burned — they didn't call him Jerrycan Denz for nothing! I think it'd be a nice gesture to send him on his way in the same fashion. Thankfully, it's easy enough to procure a jerrycan of promethium on Footfall."

161581f7-9668-4041-a5e3-d25c499d99c6.Text: "I imagine the crematorium has got its furnaces up and running already, but I feel it would be kind of sad to just shove Denz in there like that. He was known as Jerrycan Denz, and he loved having his enemies drenched in {g|Encyclopedia:Promethium}promethium{/g} and burned. I think it'd be a nice gesture to send him on his way in the same fashion. Thankfully, it's easy enough to procure a jerrycan of promethium on Footfall."

b41d9c08-4d58-4d04-a810-6460ceaac74f.Text: {n}Chaplain gives you a sidelong glance.{/n} "Want to stay and watch?"

0fbc5150-2dc8-4404-966d-91c58cfbb177.Text: "I will spare no effort. And now..."

d0006e9c-dab9-422a-b37e-be23966ad7a3.Text: "Emperor, accept Thy servant's soul," {n}Chaplain says in a hollow voice.{/n}

7e8514b9-bd3c-4bb6-b971-04bf00a4c69b.Text: "We should take him up on the offer. I can sense it — we should agree to this kind gentleman's proposal." {n}She gives you a meaningful look.{/n}

2bf737b9-f935-4c34-9b1f-ba5072c34706.Text: "Then, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, maybe we should, uh, discuss the inheritance? Reminiscing is nice and all, but we've got pressing issues to deal with here."

4dca0bdc-44f1-4532-be84-2737bd58ab35.Text: "Ah, that's good, very good. The lads will escort you. And don't worry — no harm will come to you, none at all!"

700f50e4-5caf-47f9-b8a5-58d82c00d98b.Text: {n}Kas Bellardo, the first to guess where this is going, falls to his knees.{/n} "Mercy! I haven't done anything wrong! I'm not a pirate, not a cutthroat, just a harmless drunk! And a single father to boot!"

ad9601f5-f125-4ead-9061-e164dff0df60.Text: {n}Chaplain shrugs.{/n} "The rightful heir can't exactly make use of it, as you can see, and, thanks to your hard work, the other claimants have no more claims to lay. Want to take the fortune for yourself? I think Denz would say you're welcome to it. He liked people like you — people with gumption."

b2865418-ca1b-422b-8a90-c471def4a285.Text: "As Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} wishes." {n}Chaplain winces.{/n} "I will pass all the deeds to Denz's property over to you. Now, if we're done here..."

9cee3549-c9d3-4e14-bfe7-8d8c5cd3c9d9.Text: {n}Chaplain nods. Then he glances at the servitor woman.{/n} "What about her?"

2a82c41b-31a3-4b6d-bbb5-957f15253604.Text: {n}A minute passes, then another. The guests fidget nervously. But your words are met with nothing but silence — the mysterious heir still hasn't revealed themselves.{/n}

e868d9f2-f576-4679-9866-9c9e74802e85.Text: {n}Chaplain winces, looking bored.{/n} "Frankly, I'm beginning to suspect that this 'Fidelio' from the will is just one of Denz's jokes. A stunt like this would be right up his alley. I imagine he'd be ecstatic if everyone at his funeral were at each other's throats."

3975a53d-ffea-4c58-b343-f3cae3890d72.Text: "Still, the decision is yet to be made! We have money, but we have no heir. What is to be done about the inheritance?"

d9216bcf-206b-4391-a1fb-2e85d4466ad8.Text: "Hah, the old man sure as Throne didn't expect this — the money is mine! Don't worry, sweetheart, Daddy will help you put your grandpa's riches to good use."

92ded95b-9f61-46d1-967d-8c02b2ae2f03.Text: {n}Kas smirks sickeningly.{/n} "Bye-bye, Daggen. I'll be sure to remember you fondly when I'm spending all of my father's money."

83eddd0c-b7f8-4052-abe9-405820aa3486.Text: {n}Crying out in fear, the girl runs away.{/n}

37636380-b225-40c0-982d-b3407438e8d7.Text: {n}The servitor woman is standing still. It feels as if her dead eyes are staring at Daggen's corpse... but it could be mere coincidence.{/n}

cba60ad2-1bf1-47b6-9257-ef087701baea.Text: "Kas, have you finally gone deaf from all that drinking? The inheritance is Adelia's, not yours. If you make any attempt to coerce her, I, as Denz's executor, will be forced to take steps." {n}Chaplain puts a hand on the handle of his hammer.{/n}

a926e908-c074-406e-bbdb-15f0835afadc.Text: "Oh, I see. All of you have it in for old Kas, eh? Well, I'm afraid you leave me no choice..."

181b4655-4e65-4f90-bef4-80e602783af4.Text: {n}Sobbing and crying her eyes out, Adelia, smeared with her father's blood, is shaking Kas's lifeless body.{/n} "Dad... Daddy... get up! I'll... I'll give you the inheritance!"

0f4b1c2e-f737-467c-9d13-37b589e3bbaf.Text: {n}The servitor that was once a woman is kneeling, motionless, and showing no signs of life. There are two charred holes where the eyes once were — some malfunction must have burned its brain from the inside. Its face bears a peaceful smile.{/n}

924658e7-2d6a-4cf0-9796-69c5df71572c.Text: "Daemons take you, Kas. Threatening to murder your own daughter at your old man's funeral was a new low for you. You always were a useless waste, even in your final moments."

bdbe4f0b-d745-4f2a-8826-a2fb0ff4cbc4.Text: {n}Chaplain sighs heavily as he looks at the weeping child.{/n} "She's got no one left now. Her mother ran off to the edge of the galaxy, and her father... Well, you saw it yourself." {n}His brow furrows. After a pause, he curses under his breath and nods.{/n} "I'll look after her until she's grown up. I don't think I need to spell it out for you: a little girl with a tremendous fortune... might as well paint a target on her forehead. If I take Adelia in, no one will dare to hurt her, courtesy of the reputation that my turbulent past has earned me. And if they do dare..." {n}He casts a meaningful sidelong glance at Kas's body.{/n}

61d84a91-5c30-4d04-a97b-8356313bab40.Text: "Will do. I would ask the esteemed guests to stay for a moment longer — we still have an important bit of business to take care of!"

09299ab8-b145-43ea-b248-376ff279add0.Text: "I think that's one of Denz's house servitors — Kas brought them with him to the funeral. Could be a malfunction caused by some error during the servitorisation process? Or maybe Denz, knowing his friends and family as the scum that they are, gave it orders to protect his granddaughter. Who could say at this point?"

fba2b22e-8670-402b-a8cc-f60b2eeb1b7a.Text: "I think that's one of Denz's house servitors — Kas brought them with him to the funeral. Didn't it mutter something about 'repentance'? If you're not Fidelio, then maybe this servitor is our mystery heir? Denz's last slap in the face of all the bloodsuckers who are gathered here — sounds like Denz to me! As for why it attacked his half-wit son, that's anyone's guess."

b871fb85-cd98-4cc8-9cb4-3fe3db2e92f6.Text: "Thank you. I was afraid I'd lost all my skill after years of preaching, but it looks like it takes more than a couple of prayers to kill off old habits."

086f11c9-8c52-4453-a9fb-82bb66478f74.Text: "I can tell you're an affluent sort, and I imagine you could always use the services of a robust, reliable supply network. Leave the paperwork and other formalities to me — I'll contact your subordinates myself."

2207f944-92e1-4369-8093-f7c437eba164.Text: "I'll venture a guess and assume you wouldn't say no to a supply network that is robust and loyal to none but House von Valancius. Leave the paperwork and other formalities to me — I'll contact your subordinates myself."

06a6581f-49ab-401f-9c91-0c902e40cda5.Text: "While I'm at it, I'll also help her not to squander her whole fortune — maybe even earn something extra both for herself and you. I think the best investment would be a merchant ship. I'll teach her the basics of voidfaring, find some reliable suppliers, pull a few strings in the Administratum — and just like that, she'll have herself a decent enterprise."

03ed360e-4317-4dc2-8f07-e3ab11dc8cb5.Text: "Yes, thank you! Tough luck, daddy dearest! Thought you'd leave me high and dry? Fat chance! I'll drink myself a bottle or two tonight and hope you blow your stack out there, wherever the damn you are."

b722f58e-728e-4d3c-a734-a5e5bfa8d051.Text: {n}Gritting his teeth, Daggen shoots Kas a sideways glance as if he is deciding where best to stab the newly appointed heir as soon as the funeral is over.{/n}

7e3b5564-af48-4819-99c9-81acc2a5099e.Text: "Much obliged! Good thing there's still decent people in this world, not just useless dregs like Kas here."

e487679f-1d29-4667-b4df-9aef9eeb3bdb.Text: {n}Chaplain shrugs indifferently.{/n} "Are we done with the firing squads? I would like to finally resolve the matter of Denz's inheritance, and after that — give him a proper send-off."

17d7f380-5d8e-420b-be28-bd7f071433de.Text: {n}Kas glares at Daggen in impotent rage.{/n} "You keep gloating, Daggen, because I'm not done yet. I'm not done, you hear me?"

c2faadd1-cd95-4f30-a6b7-13e650a32cca.Text: {n}Kas lets out a sigh of frustration.{/n} "So much for a life without a care in the world. Adelia, get your things — your daddy needs a good drink or five."

586e8e36-10e6-481e-8571-d2d42bd59f83.Text: "I see." {n}Daggen does not say another word, merely gives you a long, furious look.{/n}

f4fb6c3e-614d-42d7-9ce1-dfc0e95006d7.Text: "That's the cleaner {g|Encyclopedia:Servitor}servitor{/g} from our house. What's there to know about her? Her only outstanding quality is that it's hilarious how she wobbles and flaps her grabbers about when you kick her out of the way."

50743f82-0375-44b8-95d4-368257920161.Text: "I would ask the esteemed guests to stay for a moment longer! I was going to announce Denz's last will and testament after he was delivered into the flames, but the circumstances dictated otherwise."

328eefba-cab4-460c-aaa8-a6c6f1434943.Text: "I don't know about the servitor — I've got better things to do in life than look at furniture. And the ship... hmm... I think there was one Cobra by that name or something similar. We were pretty, uh, gentle with it. Boarded it, I mean. Denz was on top of his game that day — after the battle, he dragged their captain to the bridge, all tied up, and sat him at the table with us — we were going through the captain's {g|Encyclopedia:Amasec}amasec{/g}. Hmm... so you're sure you wanna hear everything?"

52eab37e-6356-45fb-9059-ffdaba5cc947.Text: "Planning to leave us after all, {mf|Master|Mistress} Fidelio?" {n}His voice is quiet, but any hint of courtesy is gone. Once more, everyone's eyes focus on you — as their hands reach for their weapons.{/n}

08314f5a-7d37-4ce9-8d85-9a4d0d51b4b1.Text: "Let me tell you how this is gonna go. See my boys over there? See that massive gun they've got? That'll blast you straight to the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} — boom! But I'm not a monster, see?" {n}He gives you a disgusting smirk.{/n} "I gotta offer you a choice at least! If you don't want to go boom — my boys will escort you to a small, cosy room nearby where you'll stay for the next hour or two while I say my goodbyes to my pal Denz... and claim my share of the inheritance, everything I deserve for our years of friendship."

2f2cdab4-21ab-419f-b15e-675719479590.Text: "We three watched. And when the party drew to a close, we threw the captain on top of the pile of his crew's bodies and, as was Denz's way, torched him. Alive. Those were good times... It's a real shame Denz quit. I keep thinking, if he hadn't fallen for this — whatchucallit — 'peaceful life,' maybe he wouldn't have checked out, maybe he would've lived for another twenty years."

08222ac1-3073-45f2-b28a-9bfcacc1cd34.Text: "Kill the ashmags! Aim for the fuel barrels — they go up just beautifully. And then stand well back."

2d9446b7-26eb-43bf-a4ff-a4f061be3866.Text: "Shereen, take cover away from the barrels!"

b16407c5-3102-4b74-bfdb-d5547cbc966e.Text: "See the servitors? They're slow, but they hit hard. Don't let them get too close!"

1a7519ec-ccac-43fe-bb7c-ea5b8439f5ce.Text: "Shereen, I'm here! What a joy it is to see you! Follow me, please!"

04b570ea-8d7d-4ca5-97a4-1c09271e940b.Text: "What a mess! Thank the Throne we didn't come here with just the three of us."

ce80e01c-5b6e-4246-865a-e755e5be7c6c.Text: The container is filled with something heavy — it is difficult to discern what it is exactly.

36cccd6f-9c7a-4753-852f-b708a067ddc4.Text: The container is sealed shut on all sides. You notice the remnants of metallic tags that have been cut.

0f649d05-c73c-48aa-9727-6186e8bba127.Text: The container is airtight. You get the feeling that this was originally a standard box for transporting non-fragile cargo that was then sealed manually.

9c836105-8afc-4532-a759-fcb3a9edf415.Text: "Shut up and get moving, Kor, we need to open the passage into the tunnels and let our guys in. Jae, on your signal."

951f913c-3d2d-471e-871f-10f5bc8dfb9d.Text: "We got lucky with our commander! The Commissar's a fierce fighter and no mistake!"

cba687d7-6e05-475f-bcee-953bffc6c357.Text: "They say he melted an actual Archon with plasma!"

841054cb-3eb2-4723-b430-c3dd061b5d26.Text: "The God-Emperor has shown us leniency in our darkest hour! Praised be He who has arrayed us in the armour of His wrath!"

67f557cf-c183-4192-817f-c9b1b93c09a8.Text: "What if that hunter thing comes? You know, the one that skulks in the shadows?"

ef22c6c2-38a1-4a7a-b71c-d3c438fea7d4.Text: "It will not come. And if it does, we kill it in the Emperor's name!"

13a273ae-3ba1-40ac-96ea-a459ec63fd75.Text: "Enough practising on dummies! Let's take a shot at a living target!"

914a68fa-cba6-426d-9940-02c4c41ae376.Text: "You lazy bastards are the God-Emperor's soldiers now! His saboteur squad!"

616d606b-e647-4bf9-b0f9-61904a0ac74e.Text: "We're what now? Are you high on stimulants, big guy?"

385ac474-e577-4dce-979f-3d3eeca66396.Text: "I said you're soldiers of the God-Emperor! Which one of you has a problem with your ears? Step forward and I'll cut them off!"

2039d532-7e0d-48c4-88bc-057da54289e4.Text: "Hang in there, comrade! You will recover and slay a hundred xenos in the name of the Emperor!"

a5a1fb7a-7ccf-40bb-ab40-6ca5b1e765b0.Text: "Not going to happen... Keep fighting, friends! Do not be afraid, death in the name of a righteous cause is a painless death!"

f133af81-4dc6-4510-b9c1-ce378f0a9b06.Text: "Don't fall asleep! Repeat after me: 'The Emperor protects!'"

664237b8-0305-4a35-89a7-39160dfbde09.Text: "Ooh! What have we got here, then?"

0f043ce9-55da-4aa7-aa2d-846473cf50a9.Text: "It's mine! Bugger off! Or I'll cut you!"

136770d8-0f4e-4b04-9f46-282db0558059.Text: "Have you heard of the Laughing Racer? The one who dies in the arena every time, and then stands up alive and walks away..."

85b3ecf4-1220-461e-8478-738743dea80f.Text: "I have indeed. It's a tall tale. The Laughing Racer, killer of vagabonds! Nonsense!"

51371e2d-e795-4836-bbbe-a640be39f60b.Text: "I'm shaking in my boots! Ha, the Laughing Racer... Now the ur-ghul that's been roaming around here, that is something to be afraid of!"

c21ba46f-4daa-41e6-9096-dc978abe196d.Text: "Should the specimen not have started transforming by now? I think it is just dying in a boring and predictable way."

e1b25a99-b11a-4bd4-a8f5-bec5e07e2c58.Text: "What a dull outcome. But the hypothesis was bold and justified the waste of research material."

314fa6d5-7c6a-4819-b2b4-d2a57f25c5c9.Text: "'The thing must be obedient! The thing must obey orders, and kill only when told!"

38a7549a-4329-4f89-abbf-b1a1e7a50d83.Text: "That's better. Wait until they let you into the arena, and then..."

d3021c15-5398-4dca-ac11-8e291aaaeab7.Text: "Put the weapon down and you will not be hurt. I swear."

a48a0409-3c16-483d-a333-43f88417cbc1.Text: "No! You'll put me under the knife again! You're liars!"

910d4988-cf5f-4ac0-b5e1-40ef5db4ec9e.Text: "Clever specimen. Yes, we are liars, and you are going back under the knife. But if you put the weapon down, I will at least sharpen the blade first."

2ffe88bf-9a1b-4b95-801f-6d0609405ba6.Text: "You scum! I knew you could not be that lucky!"

5e7faac8-afe6-48e2-904d-45419f4fae53.Text: "Let's keep playing, shall we? The fourth player is out, and fortune is smiling upon me."

772b8b33-2f88-4c28-b7b4-0a750e5a6769.Text: "No, put it back! Don't pull anything out of me!"

edd70686-cfac-446e-b2a3-ce53b65a9cee.Text: "Relax, the sawbones knows what he is doing. Right, sawbones?"

28e904fe-4d17-4982-99b3-cf86f1760231.Text: "Aaargh! Enough! You said we were brothers-in-arms now!"

da954737-6291-477b-b0fe-69e01bcf9866.Text: "Shut up! It's your initiation! The Shriekers don't let weaklings in!"

fcbd7880-1851-466d-8db7-f72e69893f2b.Text: "Some initiation... That poor sod is hilarious."

2469cf6f-df67-4fc6-b41b-d70f1d98642a.Text: "Be precise. If you damage the medusae, the next one will be drinking your dreams."

e9d1cdf5-efe2-4122-af26-257429c1f0f9.Text: "I will not miss. The parasite will drink up every moment of this wretch's burning agony."

54900d55-f5c1-4749-87f0-7656c77d575b.Text: "You and I will ascend if the mistress enjoys the taste of this fruit."

63dd278c-3faf-41fe-9a24-0cf0004d94ab.Text: "I like your blade. Give it here."

0d151457-2383-42e3-97f5-03a6cb34c915.Text: "Are you looking for a fight, pathetic maggot? So be it, I have not killed anyone today. Not yet."

c963fe0c-7cf8-45c7-83f7-78c37f9b6ed7.Text: "Consider it a trade. I will take your sword, and you can keep mine."

757d1e5a-e605-451b-8f76-17db686d7293.Text: "The Archon took all the valuable prisoners we captured during the raid. This scum is worthless."

5469688a-1e4c-40c3-b5b4-1d4e135ce835.Text: "Have mercy. If you do not need us, let us go..."

94531bf1-8e59-497a-a553-40e9a68eb330.Text: "In a way, that is exactly what we are going do."

88892d88-4684-451b-b52d-0a1a2e367012.Text: "Much better, mon-keigh. Once more — what are you?"

00c1b55f-ba7d-437b-a1f8-65a560c40cf9.Text: "For your amusement, master, and nothing else."

0d734cc8-c47e-4bcc-badb-6eceafdd58b6.Text: "Have you seen the fresh meat in the arena? There was an exceptional mon-keigh."

2cb99dd8-6178-46f2-a74d-4bcc2ff1cbd9.Text: "Common mon-keigh do not last long. {mf|He|She} may have survived only to be gutted by the Bloodstained Proselytes tomorrow."

e0b0a532-4399-46ca-a8cc-4e6d2f4a6e8d.Text: "Is that {mf|him|her}? The one who butchered the Bloodstained Proselytes?"

36ce5567-e047-468b-b4d7-2b1a07d674fa.Text: "What an affront to the Cult. The Wyches lost face... And soon it may no longer be a figure of speech."

9dd3253a-c1cc-4440-b09d-070486664306.Text: "Stop squirming. One slip of my scalpel — and there go your balls."

27709081-9c31-456a-a69c-67eddd958c44.Text: "No, Chaplain, we can't have that. How would I whack enforcers without them?"

0a8b2003-18a8-45fc-be9d-7489cb69fd7a.Text: "So that's what you were going to whack them with? Relax. Drusus helps the bollockless too."

dbf84919-7639-4cb8-b561-2659b42747bc.Text: "Not so tough without your pals, are you, you filth?"

ea764efa-7223-42a5-ae9d-2263173adffc.Text: "Spare me... I'm an — gah — enforcer... of House—"

55f70e1a-25c8-4883-83c2-5dcdefe3c281.Text: "You're a dead woman, this is what you are! Stab her in the eye! That's a start."

46a713c6-0b6e-4c15-9fab-12fba4a5919d.Text: "May the Emperor have mercy on the souls of these deceased, whether the path they followed was righteous or false."

5c4669fb-adff-4579-a380-819594df95e1.Text: "And the missionary said the soul of whoever's against Chorda will rot after they die."

8f2912ac-5cd0-4264-bc0b-a7b16a895c4e.Text: "Maybe they will. Or maybe our Protector will have mercy upon them. They were, after all, brave people who met their death in battle. Gah, that was some right proper heresy I just uttered."

e5a0edd7-2dd1-4769-942b-1eb23d4b873d.Text: "Look at yourselves, huddled in this den like so many hunted beasts! In vain are you hoping for salvation!"

e4f91d13-ee01-499e-b2b9-50e0a0387d5a.Text: "For you look outward in search for it, while it is inward that you must look. Then you will see the corruption enveloping your souls!"

42932471-3d83-49ad-8a71-b9f5f1799c49.Text: "Only by admitting to your depravity and taking the path of redemption will you drive the darkness out of your soul and let the Emperor's light into it!"

d2d9961f-a7b3-4e4f-aa02-c018bca29b19.Text: "Been a week since my last proper meal. I can barely hold my weapon..."

2ef2703a-398b-4d98-b348-2f6c7bf61407.Text: "Maybe if we hand the Liege over to Her Ladyship we'll be pardoned?"

46385371-64ea-49ca-a6dd-5aa2f7144faa.Text: "Oi! Who goes there? Enforcers? Nah. Never mind."

093e1fb2-9466-4a93-863d-ff2a2bb245f0.Text: "Just let enforcers try to walk in here! Last mistake they'll ever make."

73c65514-91f4-4445-b7bf-a1d4a05bc302.Text: "I'm sure the Vackemo has a plan for kicking Her Slaughtership off the station."

5145ed1a-4d81-472e-babf-b0778b1a4075.Text: "Those monsters burned an entire section of living quarters yesterday. There'll be no mercy for them."

38116390-5c12-48b1-b9b9-9372e03b752b.Text: "H{mf|is Lord|er Lady}ship {name} von Valancius has finally put this place in order! The assorted scum will be singing a different tune now that the Emperor's light has reached our rathole again..."

f1e8ed8c-3fed-47cd-b28d-542368eedc25.Text: "Idleness and slacking breed heresy. I thank the Emperor for blessing me with the gift of hard work, as it keeps me safe from wicked thoughts."

dee4b2b4-3e5b-4c62-b20a-821e109ea8fa.Text: "But what's changed? How's one iron fist different from another? I suppose you might say they don't burn people in the square anymore. Now they put a discreet bullet in the back of your head, or else they give you to the servitors..."

0f022af1-1a9f-482e-8eb9-40f2c506adfc.Text: "They're handing out food for free in the von Valancius poorhouses! My little rascals almost burst into tears of joy when I brought home two whole nutribars..."

326612ce-6c13-4f36-b5b7-6510638fd688.Text: "I've never seen Footfall so peaceful before. Only three people got robbed in our quarter yesterday. And only one got his skull cracked open! Imagine that! The era of prosperity has arrived!"

1f26b8a5-e98a-4190-a060-b02bf7560249.Text: A sizeable queue has formed in front of the spring flowing from the Emperor's statue. A pilgrim looks genuinely blissful as he drinks from his chipped mug amid impatient shouts from the crowd.

fe8fff3f-545d-495f-9968-f227543c4f2c.Text: One of your numerous portraits that grace the station, not unlike the images of the saints. Some commoner is kissing the edge of the portrait's frame, hoping thus to earn the blessing of House von Valancius.

9f8ae0d2-9dbb-4c9e-95db-65505bafbcc3.Text: The commoner lowers his eyes fearfully and looks away.

bf13270d-9e05-4021-852f-00f389bd8e5f.Text: "Take pity on us, my {mf|lord|lady}! We're starving! Get us out of here! Save us!"

e8a1b58c-cfc1-4bcc-8dba-0c9d7ce17ee8.Text: "My faith in the Emperor is very strong! Don't report me to the enforcers!"

bbce2c51-899a-4faa-90c6-4619e2ac5660.Text: "We used to have nothing to eat and now there's plenty of food, what with all the dead people."

fa6bd7e0-13d0-4a5a-9c52-f9aa87e79aaa.Text: "We're gonna squeeze them all. Every pesky little transgressor, every pesky little heretic!"

b236c656-0c42-48ac-a673-accedaa70c3e.Text: The brute-faced enforcer is beaming with satisfaction, like a carnivore that has gorged itself on flesh.

151b8be1-4013-4f84-b44f-99eeb8b127c5.Text: "The Emperor protects! Except for heretics — them He punishes!"

232a56d0-94a5-4be0-83a1-942bb64ffec4.Text: "Have mercy! Our families are starving! We only took a couple of nutribars!"

18be5250-d4f1-4936-8438-d9ea19e3917a.Text: "Lies! I see clearly, with my naked eye, the corruption that has engulfed your nature. Only the cleansing fire can absolve you now. Guilty!"

1da8e9c2-3f78-4ddd-b242-9d567b31a725.Text: "Is this fire cleansing enough for you, you crazy hag?"

c3434dd2-74b4-465d-bab8-02d34ef12eda.Text: "The Emperor protects me. Guilty. Burn him."

a02adb26-bab8-4f3e-af17-3fdaf91bf936.Text: "I repent! I repent! Please, anything but the gallows or the fire!"

fd1106f5-2c8a-4490-97b1-70aae1f6c53f.Text: "She's going to do us all in, one at a time. Just sent a chap to the gallows for spitting at an enforcer's feet. Turns out that's incitement to revolt!"

ce78960f-4d4f-403c-ab27-60a4c6d1f5f4.Text: "Falling asleep during my watch. Hadn't slept in a week. Even the stimulants stopped working anymore. You?"

3b1148d6-f95c-42c3-b5a8-e344e413f7dc.Text: "Knifed a patrol in the docks. Who could've known he'd brought friends along!"

bc04c88c-1ff3-4528-8bd1-f71dd560489d.Text: "Same trial for a slacker as for a killer? What times are we living in?"

df8fa909-5694-47bb-9a41-e6f1542487c4.Text: "Cheer up. Maybe you'll get servitored instead of burned. Although who knows which is worse..."

92f48362-c95b-407c-a0c4-c4b67d6279f1.Text: Someone shoved a flamer down the throat of this Chorda soldier and burned his entrails.

534a8cb9-1c61-4ce7-8fd5-a4380469bc33.Text: The soldier's limbs are twisted at unnatural angles. Someone broke every bone and left him to die.

94080b83-33c3-4385-9762-59db9d79a433.Text: "Bodily suffering is inescapable. Why resist it, then? Cherish your afflictions, for the body's decay is the path to a new existence!"

57c95823-7d31-479f-8068-5247c4da9884.Text: "There is grace in decomposition, for what is rot if not the bustling of new life on the remains of a person of virtue? Who are we to sever the cycle of life? No, we must accept that truth and devote ourselves to it!"

73ffc0a6-c6e0-40da-9807-50a3f3db142f.Text: "You who have been blessed with malady and putrefaction, bring our Truth to your brothers and sisters! Our beliefs must spread everywhere like a disease, rewarding the righteous with gracious abscesses!"

5ae5559b-84c5-4f49-9582-fb5db5373de3.Text: "The Emperor's justice is good and righteous. To resist it is heresy!"

cd04f3da-ae81-4b18-921b-08aed23ff37a.Text: "Penance is born of suffering. A soul that is free from suffering is open to corruption."

e01d3a59-e0f7-44a6-a019-6377d2cae436.Text: "Do not question faith or authority, for doubt begets heresy."

5072ebb8-2a63-4db1-b060-73405afd1e4e.Text: "I used to burn rats in the docks back on the station. Same thing."

6270a68c-dea6-43bd-8743-83e579df45fc.Text: "You think I wouldn't if they begged me? They're vermin. Shut up and burn 'em."

a84ea58c-8b6f-4f39-80d1-8b86fb55f865.Text: "Glory to House von Valancius! You've rid us of the butcher!"

5bed994c-2e3f-4787-be78-bdbf7df6c3b2.Text: "They killed my whole family! I'll have my revenge! We all will!"

45d67bf5-114c-467f-aba5-3beae41c0175.Text: "Now that the enforcers are gone, we can really go to town. We're gonna line our pockets and live it up!"

71a3d9f2-7eb3-4d06-b69c-8294c9c61856.Text: "Believe me when I say, they will be back. And they'll burn us all!"

d64edf6f-086a-4c61-9a17-d6c26f6a216d.Text: "Violating curfew gets you in front of the firing squad. Did you think no one would find out, you nit?"

e7ede484-8984-41ae-9ed1-67d74956c026.Text: "How was I supposed to not violate it, after slaving away for three watches in a row? You could use some extra hands but you've burned them all!"

04e9f970-b8fa-4a36-a198-7c149aa937d0.Text: "So now you're also questioning the fairness of the Imperium's laws? Grab him!"

cde56735-70ce-4e16-b74b-21ed88fb02d9.Text: "Your cargo at the docks has been impounded. Come with us."

54acf759-673b-4ba1-9489-b27f03de2695.Text: "I'm an honest trader! What have I done?"

424e9080-5053-4ff2-a3e8-329e92dabb40.Text: "You are a smuggler and a heretic. Now move, or we'll break your legs."

6f8cca19-69d3-4675-b840-09dc4aa4452f.Text: "On what charges are you detaining me? Where are you taking me?"

92eb4164-e744-44fb-805f-73b94140ba5f.Text: "Shut your trap or I'll consider this resisting arrest."

ca10f050-2d1c-4e88-862c-016689c33ef6.Text: "That's better manners than this scum deserves. On your feet, heretic trash!"

ea9e502a-3e10-499f-bb01-284eaa3a673e.Text: "Guilty of: theft and perjury. Punishment: death."

e0be35bc-388d-4efd-940e-3685cc1c4cc9.Text: "Who was behind the sabotage? Where were the explosives stored? Speak! Now!"

c9301596-169a-4d48-982a-9e9da1dd01f5.Text: "You do know! You know everything! And we'll keep beating you until you start talking!"

356ca253-1b67-4481-a652-411ed1017b3d.Text: The commoner is standing with her back pressed against the wall, muttering something.

b2511466-78fb-42fc-8fab-2d70e8e09642.Text: "Two in the first patrol... Three in the second... You've got to do the three first, they've got shotguns..."

a9feb18c-7ddb-4bb3-89b8-ccd2dd98fe2d.Text: The soldier was killed with a sudden blow at point-blank range, quickly and quietly.

b69e324a-33a8-4ac9-9df4-2e1ed00c1cff.Text: It looks like there was a fire here.

4a7e4078-b337-4c92-8453-f773c4fea71c.Text: A bomb exploded here. Most likely an improvised one.

8d3721c6-6619-46b3-8191-9ab564bbc25d.Text: "They kidnapped my partner! Bastards! Snooping around everywhere like rats, waiting for the right time to strike!"

ef066034-d47a-422a-85ba-ae0cf661d6f2.Text: The sign on the prisoner's neck reads: "INSULTING THE EMPEROR'S LAWS"

12b12018-b4fd-4c0c-9e8e-a8339076957e.Text: The sign on the prisoner's neck reads: "IDLENESS"

e8229813-d99c-492b-bd67-6503a23fe92d.Text: The sign on the prisoner's neck reads: "AIDING AND ABETTING REBELS"

4673b56a-ef48-4e95-a6fb-6b1023c220d0.Text: "You dare extort money from a representative of the Ecclesiarchy? This is blasphemy!"

d32b88ed-3f81-4105-9bcf-8fced5f3604f.Text: "Well, why don't you go and complain to the Emperor about it? There's a piece of him lying over in the square, and it just so happens to be his ear."

a69c5d8b-9783-484d-921e-5e51dfc14d5a.Text: "You— you would not dare! The Emperor protects!"

768aa3a6-1669-4db3-8f41-15726888e146.Text: "Of course he does. And protection costs money. Come on, pay up. Unless you want an extra hole in your head you can pray out of."

a9cb2b2d-f26c-48b4-a6a8-8985c58a3be6.Text: "Know ye that the Emperor is merciful, and that His light will always find a way!"

c5968f01-e76f-4c9d-aa1a-1a3c4b43559d.Text: "He is merciful indeed! May He protect us from heresy in thought and deed."

f124b607-5ebb-4560-bcfa-1854282fe6bf.Text: "Glory to the name of {name} von Valancius, His anointed one who has turned this den of iniquity into the abode of faith its ancient founders always meant it to be!"

f78e16ce-9c40-45e2-b3b0-b901fc32575b.Text: "Glory to {name} von Valancius, benefactor, protector, and champion of His will!"

b049f0c4-bf6c-4fd5-ad84-df6d5c328cc4.Text: "They say {name} von Valancius is a saint. As soon as {mf|he|she} came to power, a spring of the purest water poured forth from the Emperor's statue, and it hasn't run dry to this day! What is that if not a miracle?"

8f654d55-974b-4afa-9567-3bbfbca5896c.Text: "A miracle — or a mishap? Think about it. How do you get a spring of water on a station? It's probably just a burst pipe! Don't you think drinking a bucketful of sewage isn't the best idea?"

d85d2348-2b9d-4b5f-a954-754d377c7ae1.Text: "Why don't you go and take a sip, just one? I've never tasted sweeter water. They say old Rompus's blisters went clean away after just a couple of mugs."

92241902-00a4-45ba-a5c1-92fd869b9bc4.Text: "Right, so the water's got 'powers,' too! Because of course, it does. Well, I'll believe in these 'miraculous healings' when I see one. It sounds way too good to be true..."

77150668-15cb-45b6-a180-829a8338f438.Text: "You... survived the trial? How did you manage that? When they grabbed you on the street, I thought—"

1b1e5b32-0f22-4283-9bca-cb7ac70b96b4.Text: "I was a hair's breadth away from servitorisation, yes. But one of the patrols confirmed that I wasn't at the scene!"

c5bbd7f8-3efe-4de5-8551-9cf785ede4f9.Text: "What about that girl who implicated you? She testified against—"

bfd8bd75-20ec-46d5-891e-8e9ea0eb7941.Text: "Charged with conspiracy against a servant of the Imperium and sentenced to burn. No less than she deserves!"

b5a7a2da-0785-4a0c-910f-e3f73b764bf2.Text: "This is the last shipment of convicts for now. We need another consignment of mechanical parts for the servitorisation process."

b0bab7ec-d555-4f07-8bf4-eb9a6596c17e.Text: "Already at the docks, unloading is underway."

cdc30f09-d50d-4b9f-94ea-3e2d2ed5dbc5.Text: "Hmm... It's amazing to see anything on Footfall running smoothly and on time."

18cdb8ea-f3eb-493f-8e86-1de92360e44b.Text: "Things have certainly tightened up around here since the Rogue Trader arrived, even if the methods used are brutal."

70346120-f588-4887-aee1-c512ad5c04a8.Text: Transaction complete. Glory to the Omnissiah.

9e74cc28-12e1-4b97-bf13-24fcb4938e5e.Text: Function interrupted. Glory to the Omnissiah.

ed2c9a2b-5161-4a85-bd2b-326464c1f49b.Text: Would you like to have a drink to mark our propitious deal?

2deff6b0-d0bb-4529-8f47-25f0e77ed759.Text: It's a pleasure doing business with you.

78b14b3b-d728-43a8-83dd-f025ab0828cc.Text: Just p-please don't tell anyone where you g-got it from...

9cadd6d2-8ef9-46cb-9255-4f68001efcef.Text: A sacred relic is helpful in every situation.

cec376fd-6a22-4e41-858c-b19a7e648cc1.Text: The Emperor protects, but don't forget to stay well-equipped.

8d439953-322b-449f-9f43-1c6ce764b325.Text: Trading interface open. Glory to the Omnissiah.

621fddff-b60f-40b9-8298-80a2e1cdda29.Text: Access granted. Glory to the Omnissiah.

f5aeb73c-0c18-470e-ba23-fea7f1ef4bf1.Text: Would you like to see the merchandise, my {mf|lord|lady}?"

ac5b9366-f0a0-45fb-8917-a5d96eaa3c8c.Text: I hope you like our range of goods.

0d79b718-4f09-4b6b-9817-006cabe5a2dc.Text: Only the b-best wares for you!

dbe15e01-82cd-4330-8e09-5e1884b5a4af.Text: "It's our turn now. We're in charge here."

d8b7aede-cd21-4fde-921f-1d6944c611cd.Text: "So much for Chorda. This is why you don't mess with Vladaym the Vackemo."

cd278fbd-212d-4f8e-8d2d-bfe2fd855823.Text: "Every filthy snitch who ratted their guys out to the enforcers is going to answer for their transgressions. We're the judges now!"

cd72fe9a-8793-4557-bd0f-8397c2e15d1d.Text: Blood mixed with machine oil is barely visible on the dark floor.

16e34f77-85d9-4fc9-9752-784bd2e6ae73.Text: Dark patches can be seen on the floor. They are smudged, as though someone walked through them on the way to the footbridge.

cdc26d89-9cb0-488d-87ab-0217a6a258a5.Text: "Not the best first contact with the world's inhabitants. I hope we will find someone more able to hold a conversation — willingly or not."

87de9287-0f8e-47d3-b4c0-99f90c8b3d72.Text: "There was someone here. It's a good place to hide. Or to set up another ambush."

ed3e3750-96c2-4ed8-8aee-a5b9eae33a0f.Text: "Look at this mark. Someone was dragged... no, someone walked in our direction very recently. But we didn't see anyone..."

ef051913-d770-4185-a795-d561c8277c62.Text: "Rogue Trader, I cannot return to your ship before I have completed my mission on this world. If you insist, I will find another way to fulfil my obligations — without you."

b102d025-f2cf-4010-8df5-60d77e23bf1b.Text: "You are squandering resources. Those body parts could have been used as servitor stock."

b9b98ed7-0028-4240-a325-924ea8b25c12.Text: [Draw your weapon] "We must destroy this machine immediately."

9fceb4a0-d444-4cb3-b57d-eed656e18707.Text: [Cut the power supply] "This spawn of Chaos has no place on my world!"

3b97001f-c603-4e39-9cc2-65ab5de7b72b.Text: "Fine. Let's figure out what's what first."

71b02865-d2a3-4678-9279-fb45fd4f170a.Text: Told Heinrix to stop the heretical cogitator for the sake of the people who were still alive.

aeb49a76-eb39-4079-a4fe-6f4257449502.Text: "We need to stop the cogitator. For the sake of the people still alive down there!"

b67ca28b-ce03-4f29-bd9c-9ffef0fc9a7d.Text: Told Heinrix that the heretical cogitator had to be allowed to complete its work to justify the lives lost.

9caa5797-c09c-45e2-9d47-aee59d685543.Text: "We need to let the cogitator finish its task — otherwise thousands of people will have died for nothing."

cd607cc3-7f69-45f1-a6ed-36afa12519a3.Text: "It predicts the future? How is that even possible?"

0501717e-9ff2-4b06-8d7d-f09ade2410ab.Text: Killed Heinrix to take possession of the heretical cogitator.

63ef8777-4fa4-4dbd-8759-1f344c641d8a.Text: [Attack] "I've heard enough. I think I'd better keep this treasure for myself!"

07262993-d33d-4f16-8f95-9409586814cd.Text: "This decision is on your conscience, Heinrix."

c562618a-0291-46f8-94f5-277c12f571a4.Text: {n}The massive {g|Encyclopedia:Cogitator}cogitator{/g} grows out of the metal bulkheads like a grotesque tumour. A hollow roar sounds from deep within the metal housing — whatever spurred the computer into action, it has enough power to supply a small command centre. As soon as your eyes fall upon the cogitator, you feel a tingling in your temples: every nook, every component of the machine radiates a sense of wrongness — one that is difficult to explain but no less palpable for that. It is as though the construct itself defies the laws of physics and perspective.{/n}

da9f6f71-f4ed-429c-ba51-40a8b5057b08.Text: {n}Heinrix makes a warning gesture. His voice, ringing slightly with tension, is threaded with disquiet.{/n} "Stop, {name}. That is a creation of the {g|Encyclopedia:Chaos}Archenemy{/g}, don't go near it. You have done enough for me and my mission — don't put yourself at risk now."

7a617b06-89f6-49cb-9a13-de26081c5d3a.Text: {n}As soon as Heinrix takes another step toward the cogitator, it emits a deafening shriek like hundreds of metal needles driving into toughened glass, as though sensing the stranger. Wincing, Heinrix approaches the control panel and bends down toward the screens. Despite the heat clogging the room, you feel an ice-cold breeze — Heinrix is clearly using his {g|Encyclopedia:Psyker}psyker{/g} abilities to try to fend off the pernicious effects of the {g|Encyclopedia:Chaos}Chaos{/g} artefact.{/n}

2027dd97-477c-4cb8-863d-1fd858293c19.Text: {n}You study the runes carefully — and suddenly you feel a lancing pain in your eyes, followed by a sharp pang in your chest. You leap away from the cogitator, with your heart pounding and a rushing in your ears.{/n}

7cdae624-4aa3-4eef-8a36-679f8cafbee4.Text: {n}The Tech-Priest raises his uncomprehending gaze to Jae.{/n} "Squeamishness is not a relevant factor. I have conducted the relevant assessments: the risk of spiritual harm is acceptable; the importance of obtaining the information is critical."

661abfd8-506f-4ca9-b39b-7bce845a0df6.Text: "You cannot understand this, xenos. Knowing one's enemy is the path toward destroying them. If, in order to prevent countless future calamities, I must perpetrate one of my own... such is my duty to the Golden Throne."

e4d6d16b-5b96-40dc-825b-820e32441d41.Text: {n}Yrliet remains silent for a while, her head tilted to one side.{/n} "Not only do you not keep watch over your kin, you even sacrifice your own souls to your dead god. It is astounding."

fcf1b153-96e6-4729-abe4-1621cd914928.Text: {n}You take a step backward — and suddenly one of the cogitator screens changes colour, becoming a bright yellow. Your eyes are helplessly drawn to the bilious hue...{/n}

db2b9f35-5080-4a6a-a8ec-d233e5d1c823.Text: {n}The cogitator displays a wall of text on its screens. The string of symbols is a senseless mixture of numbers, formulas, and unfamiliar characters. There seems to be no logic to it — and yet there is no doubt that the cogitator is computing calculations on a prodigious scale.{/n}

ae9f2ae3-5baf-4894-9d5b-efbb91981ebb.Text: {n}One glance is enough to tell you that these are {g|Encyclopedia:Chaos}Chaos{/g} runes, within which lurks a grim threat to mind and soul. You hastily avert your eyes, trying to wipe the foul symbols from your mind.{/n}

b3812d1f-0d85-45b8-844a-112fb6938967.Text: {n}A bundle of cables is coming from the broken side panel of the cogitator — they were clearly added after the machine came off the manufactorum's production line. The wires snake along the floor and disappear inside a maintenance hatch that leads to somewhere down below.{/n}

ce1568e1-9d67-4490-9de0-c1f955be7440.Text: {n}You turn sharply away from the screen — and you can almost feel invisible shackles falling away. The realisation comes a moment later: you were not fighting against your own curiosity, but against someone's malevolent will, which has now lost its hold on you.{/n}

e0343a52-0d0f-447a-a31e-23befaf80ddd.Text: {n}You cannot stop yourself from staring at the yellow square. Ugly symbols gradually begin to appear deep within the screen. Slowly, they come closer to you, until one of them holds out a curved claw... Too late do you realise what is happening, and the sharp talons dig into your heart. Staggering back, you can still feel the touch of that icy hand.{/n}

e28cdb8d-4308-4659-b383-f7222fbc3cab.Text: "Out of the question. Even if we disregard the potential loss of data... It could kill us."

9b56a12a-cf10-4ce8-ae5a-63c833f3e395.Text: {n}A minute passes, then another. You watch Heinrix examine the cogitator: his eyes scan the screens, his hands darting from the reel to the lever, sometimes hovering uncertainly over the next switch — which immediately receives a coating of frost. At some point, you hear his voice, almost a whisper, barely audible above the clanging, roaring machine.{/n}

6dab3f09-9005-4963-b748-78e4bb05d066.Text: "...sacrifices. More and more sacrifices every minute..." {n}Heinrix looks at you, his eyes darker now, appearing almost black in his white face.{/n} "Hecatombe determinans. The womb of this cursed machine is down on the lower levels. The auxiliary enumerator controls the system for delivering molten waste under the manufactorum's main building. This cogitator is fueled by the energy harnessed from thousands of people — who are flowing beneath our feet as slag waste as we speak."

242c4b8c-a9be-48fa-9f2d-ebe92d2dd0b8.Text: {n}He tries to muster a reassuring smile, but it comes out looking more like a grimace.{/n} "I'll be fine."

8b5bba41-69ad-4322-aef7-3c79fd535987.Text: {n}Heinrix vacillates for another second, then shakes his head as though clearing away mental fog.{/n} "I {d|Encyclopedia:CompHeinrix_Humane}almost succumbed{/d} to the Archenemy's old trick... the lure of the unattainable — the primary of all the traps that Chaos sets for unwary souls."

1536adb7-e05e-4c66-931a-0f7b984ddabe.Text: {n}Heinrix casts you a scorn-filled look.{/n} "Their deaths {d|Encyclopedia:CompHeinrix_Humane}do not justify{/d} the murder of even more innocent servants of the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}, Rogue Trader."

7c1b1c11-d1e4-4451-9ac4-f62670864edd.Text: {n}Heinrix's clouded gaze suddenly clears, and he glares at the cogitator.{/n} "No. No, the cult's filthy ravings are {d|Encyclopedia:CompHeinrix_Humane}not worth that{/d}. What we can extract from its storage drives will be enough."

233a7c39-34b2-4295-a706-5eb587e4955d.Text: {n}Heinrix stares stonily at the cogitator screen.{/n} "Yes... Let's allow the machine to finish its calculations. I {d|Encyclopedia:CompHeinrix_Rough}wish to know{/d} what precisely the cult's minions were so desperate to see in the future. Perhaps... if we were to increase the power... it would be finished sooner..."

6b1d7f7b-92f3-41f7-91bc-176e11917969.Text: {n}The cogitator screens flash, and the guttural roar in its depths turns into a frantic shriek that seems to contain the death cries of thousands.{/n}

5f8c2fa4-e849-44f6-a4c1-e41f86e1de2e.Text: {n}Heinrix fails to stop you in time: your blow sends the torn cables whipping out in every direction, scattering sparks and droplets of noxious scarlet slime.{/n}

13bd29f9-1070-4941-8421-99924aa4126e.Text: "But I cannot even imagine the reason for sacrificing all these people... It's inconceivable. Now we know why the Fabricator-Censor prized this monster so highly. The cursed {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priest{/g} and his associates created something that went beyond the limits of the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}'s power. This machine is designed to process myriad possibilities using {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}warp{/g} sorcery. It has almost finished its task. It... it predicts the future, {name}."

8a19a885-7e09-45e1-8db6-12bde10b2ba4.Text: {n}Heinrix vacillates for another moment — and his hands {d|Encyclopedia:CompHeinrix_Rough}come to rest on the cogitator's switches{/d}.{/n} "I will accelerate the process. So that everything is over as soon as possible."

72cc77c3-b97b-46c2-9a65-5dcf7cead10f.Text: "Do not attempt to gain any insight into the essence of the machines corrupted by the Archenemy, at least, not if you value your soul! I have encountered the heretics' mechanical abominations before... to truly fathom their nature is to allow a particle of death into your heart." {n}Heinrix is silent for a few moments.{/n} "But the fruit they bear... no matter how abhorrent their instruments, the fruit they bear could be useful."

8eb99bd7-3f14-4d16-a172-b26394a7f014.Text: {n}Heinrix looks at you, his eyes ice-cold.{/n} "{g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}, in the name of the {g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Golden Throne{/g}, I am requisitioning the population of the lower levels of this manufactorum {d|Encyclopedia:CompHeinrix_Rough}for the purposes of the Inquisition{/d}."

71d9fa5c-f8e1-426f-bc7f-dc64b4fdda2f.Text: {n}Heinrix's movements are exact and purposeful — unlike his earlier operation of the cogitator. One after another, the cogitator screens begin to fade to black, and the roar coming from inside the machine quietens to a barely perceptible howl... in which you imagine you hear notes of dejection.{/n}

4e431875-439f-43d7-978d-f2feb7525e44.Text: {n}Heinrix bends over the keys — and flinches as if from an electric shock. His head snaps back unnaturally, and you see his lips moving... The cogitator lets out a roar that grows louder by the second...{/n}

c91ab505-eaf4-4ae2-b07c-1125ab595b12.Text: {n}Heinrix is too engrossed in his examination of the control panel to stop you. You draw closer to the side section of the cogitator housing, which has several thick cables running from it. With each step toward the flickering screens, your feeling that the cogitator is watching you with rapidly blinking eyes grows stronger and stronger. Up close, you see that besides buttons, switches, and toggles, the cogitator casing is also covered in strange writing.{/n}

94f81f87-efbf-45ee-80b9-ce2af2f8fd36.Text: {n}When you attempt to study the text being displayed on the screens, your head begins to swim. You look away, but the glowing squares continue to dance before your eyes, as though they have been burned into your retinas.{/n}

09e14687-1085-4d21-a451-e516449447c9.Text: "The {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}'s grace has not touched this object. This mechanism was not desecrated but born flawed and unnatural. Iron most profane." {n}Pasqal unhurriedly produces a data-slate.{/n} "Initiating observation log. Let not fear stand in the path of Knowledge."

662f75a0-fa1b-4c03-8b64-29285b1d500f.Text: "You just said this thing is an abomination. Yet you are going to immerse yourself in it in order to study it? Doesn't the thought repel you?"

f2283397-cbd7-49fd-b734-96a26bd0d0b4.Text: {n}Idira suddenly appears by your side and tugs at your sleeve.{/n} "Lord Captain, no. Please don't. Just don't look. The whispers say nothing good will come of it. You really should just step away from that thing..."

c0ed597d-36f2-437e-9df3-810640565919.Text: {n}Idira opens her mouth to speak but then drops her gaze awkwardly.{/n}

124d9a44-44eb-406f-b6e7-db52b5d60592.Text: "You intend to let a creation from beyond the veil do what it was designed to do?" {n}Yrliet stares at Heinrix in astonishment.{/n} "Is it not your calling to protect your kind from the schemes and temptations of Sai'lanthresh?"

62b980db-d309-4ca6-9b76-20e6a4601201.Text: "We'll learn nothing by standing here. Let's go."

7ffbef41-9ac5-43f0-97e1-549740763834.Text: "Remind me, what is your mission on Kiava Gamma?"

9d03c630-c864-42eb-a171-6dda80d777e0.Text: {n}Heinrix frowns as his eyes sweep over the {g|Encyclopedia:Manufactorum}manufactorum{/g}'s dark halls.{/n} "No solemn ceremony, no personal meeting with Magi... I fear we are too late and we won't be dealing with clandestine heretics after all."

c0998c4e-f011-41f8-bf95-ec871497cde7.Text: "You're right, Glaito, something is definitely wrong. And we will know what very soon."

914dd2be-f5a0-4e0f-a60e-172e9051179f.Text: {n}Binharic arias of alarm stream out of Pasqal's {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox-synthesiser{/g}. In their neurotic, broken rhythm, you sense a call to arms and a warning of danger.{/n}

53a42f41-2192-42d7-87d0-825848f17770.Text: {n}The Interrogator nods, continuing to stare into the surrounding gloom.{/n}

a48a5b83-77b9-4317-8eb6-e0cf6730d004.Text: "To start, let's look around and find out why the arrival of the {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} did not elicit the usual fuss. To speak plainly, I would not count on a warm welcome at this rate. Better keep your weapon at the ready."

e693d021-fd7a-4648-84dd-add80466c563.Text: "I assumed I would conduct an investigation and track down traces of the Cult of the Final Dawn. I believe I can discard that plan now: both the incident with the scrap-code and the manner in which we were forced to land on Kiava Gamma indicate that the situation has taken a turn for the worse."

c11d7c02-d643-4430-ac93-d9fe3538b91a.Text: "Nevertheless, I must use this opportunity and try to determine what the cult was doing on an {g|Encyclopedia:IndustrialWorld}industrial world{/g} and what specifically interested them on a planet full of sacred machines and servants of the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}. First, we must find someone who can tell us what's been going on here..." {n}Heinrix pauses, straining to hear something.{/n} "...if, that is, there is anyone left here to speak to."

9b2b46a7-f36e-4b2f-956d-9d890f4b14ed.Text: {n}The cyber-mastiff's visors flicker continuously, as if he is trying to process an overwhelming influx of data. The dog leans forward with a slight growl, but then obediently goes still again at his master's side.{/n}

bc84bd80-3746-4077-b2c8-5b7a66ac28c7.Text: [Look at the cage closest to you]

cc83948b-6147-4eae-b44a-9a74df95a387.Text: "Have you ever seen anything like this before?"

f8897aab-01c1-47f4-93ed-c697c1ae22c0.Text: "Why are they hooked up to cogitators?"

dc68b055-4785-483a-aebb-2607d94268ea.Text: Told Heinrix not to use biomancy on the mutant so as not to prolong their suffering.

91de3166-b829-41de-9135-40cce1cfd7fc.Text: "Heinrix, let this go. You are only prolonging their suffering."

93b2883c-a76d-48e4-a0f7-fe4fab80f212.Text: Told Heinrix to use biomancy on the mutant for the sake of extracting information.

d1421145-0786-452b-83c8-25835ca87500.Text: "If there is something that will make them talk, we must use it."

809dee76-d2e3-47d2-ac41-c814959a50ed.Text: "They're people. Monstrously mutated, but still people."

9a438924-fa0f-42a3-9bfc-e82b35d06243.Text: "The Lexmechanic talked about some kind of slag waste disposal and Chaos symbols on machines... What are the Archenemy's minions doing to the people of the lower levels?"

d7372b26-0d2c-4aad-8c4d-f76d3eb96d0f.Text: "What are you going to achieve by prolonging their suffering? Just release them from this nightmare!"

ff59b45d-2c2c-4934-8e18-16ecbbc42ce6.Text: "I'm not going to argue with you. It seems to me your mind is already made up."

d63ea7b8-9e05-4b68-892b-a90839bd1208.Text: "It seems to me your mind is already made up. These people need deliverance from their suffering."

a60da9ae-8ee7-4d7e-9a55-d0d4ebf8b577.Text: "These people can still serve the Imperium. Anyone would deem their suffering a fair price to pay."

3ee7f158-79dd-4e96-94cb-5c795de1c371.Text: {n}Numerous wires and pipes run to the filthy cages, which are filled with what looks like a conglomeration of human bodies. You cannot make out who is in the cage, but bright blue sparks flash intermittently in the darkness, while the mass of flesh twitches and shudders.{/n}

1b5916cc-3075-46fb-adba-9dc8a5cecb32.Text: {n}Heinrix casts a scrutinising eye over one of the cages, before withdrawing his weapon and approaching to examine what lies inside.{/n}

90345780-9991-425d-b9c1-323bf01f0ae8.Text: {n}The flesh explodes in a fountain of lumps, stinking spray, and bone shards. The gaping wound closes in an instant, and a different face emerges from the fleshy depths in place of the lost head. The mutant's body is pulsing faster, harder, as though the abomination's heart rate has spiked with fear. A many-voiced moan rises up from all the other cages at once — the pain was felt by all who share the mutant's horrific fate.{/n}

dce60464-46f6-4574-bfb6-6e1822fcbfb4.Text: "Negative. What I am currently observing is not my tech-comrades, but merely their biologically functioning remains fashioned into a specimen of an unnatural perversion of Technology. I am under no directives to feel any affinity for such specimens."

f0b71cc2-e2af-4a0c-997a-a577dc1685f8.Text: "Groxseed..." {n}Jae barely breathes the word, not sounding at all like herself.{/n}

c73b0faf-06a6-4067-af7c-6744aaec4c52.Text: {n}Through the metal bars, you see it truly is a pile of human bodies — or something that used to be. The monstrously deformed bodies have fused together in places, while others were severed using saws and knives, leaving wounds seeping pus and slime, wounds that are agglutinating and sprouting tendons. Rods connected to wires that run to a nearby {g|Encyclopedia:Cogitator}cogitator{/g} bristle across the flesh. One of the human heads turns to you.{/n} "Mercy..."

cb318d30-ce49-420c-ac81-d171567cf3aa.Text: "Look at it!" {n}Heinrix gestures toward the cage closest to you.{/n}

6c50961d-0398-4cdc-9861-ef03f9b2a68c.Text: "The effect of warp energy will likely lead to an explosive reaction. I do not know the precise mechanism of this mutation — the result could be even more monstrous than its current state."

5374bf7a-0faf-4d70-81fc-a40e278b9dc8.Text: "I have seen a great deal, Rogue Trader. That includes mutations caused by the sorcery of {g|Encyclopedia:Chaos}Chaos{/g}. But what frightens me most is not their repulsive form, but what is hiding beneath it." {n}Heinrix frowns.{/n} "A human soul in torment. Chaos never forgets to ensure its victims retain the ability to suffer."

e878b7d9-f42a-4d15-8ecd-de845ca57c11.Text: {n}Heinrix carefully studies the screens of the computing machines.{/n} "Lingua-Technis — corrupted by the scrap-code, I'm sure. It's unlikely we will be able to extract anything of value from their data-crypts." {n}Thinking, Heinrix clenches his fist and bites down on a knuckle — and then recoils when the mutant from the nearest cage reaches a hand out to him through the bars.{/n}

dd034b1a-8527-42f1-8d02-6984762a5dbb.Text: {n}You examine the pulsating mass of flesh. The creature in the cage seems to be composed of several bodies joined together. You see no sutures or any other means by which the separate parts could have been connected. Among the layers of meat, you can discern large knots of muscle, various limbs, exposed bones, parts of faces, and entire heads... Only {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}warp{/g} sorcery is capable of creating such an abomination while preserving its ability to live on.{/n}

8b0b77bc-82af-404f-88fe-6fba48194f99.Text: {n}You peer at the pulsating mass of flesh. Beneath the thin film coating the skin of this monstrous creation, you can see the throbbing veins that snake through the flesh and the flowing yellow ichor. The creature looks like a conglomeration of several people, squeezed together by brutal hands into a single whole.{/n}

761c00e1-4790-4cfa-9267-ca423f9b5af9.Text: "You're wrong — this is our chance to find out more. Extracting some good from suffering is the only thing that will justify the torment of these unfortunate people. It is how they can serve the Throne one last time."

8dce67a4-415e-43b8-9be3-865250ffe66e.Text: {n}Heinrix nods.{/n} "Yes. It's possible another person would refuse to make such a choice. But we can use this situation to help the investigation."

1167ce93-843a-4150-b0ca-35f7ded615f2.Text: {n}Heinrix nods.{/n} "I am... inclined to relieve their suffering. Every moment of existence in such a state is pure torture for the people locked in these sheaths..."

83fa8e92-8073-409c-99cf-ba48f5a940c8.Text: "You think so? Tiny fragments of data that could prove worthless and even harmful to us... in exchange for participating in this torture?"

2810aa1a-2c24-486e-9ff2-f7a5fd0e5732.Text: {n}Heinrix nods grimly.{/n} "Yes, this is what warp sorcery has done to them, to be precise. I have seen many mutants whose features have been distorted under the effects of the {g|Encyclopedia:Chaos}Archenemy{/g}... but this is something beyond all imagining."

d306819c-7d70-4ed0-8f68-3eab67caef09.Text: "To know the workings of dark sorcery means allowing corruption into oneself." {n}Heinrix scowls.{/n} "These are warp mutations, no doubt. Perhaps there was some side effect, and that is why they were brought here, to be connected to sensors and cogitators. Even fallen Tech-Priests who have rejected the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g} are driven by a perverted hunger for Knowledge."

a2bcb857-e053-4052-8270-6e351e7bf3c0.Text: {n}Heinrix wavers for another moment, and then leans over the cogitators.{/n} "Each mutant has cables attached. I may not know the nature of these machines, but it isn't too difficult to increase the voltage... Ah, this switch here..."

3230234a-123c-4a26-be41-9c40702a2769.Text: {n}Heinrix hesitates for a moment, then closes his eyes and raises one hand. You are enveloped by an otherworldly chill. The mass of flesh in the cage suddenly rears up: the mutant wrenches open its glued-together lips and begins wailing frantically. The shrieking is echoed by a chorus of howls and tortured moans coming from the neighbouring cages.{/n}

a814a86b-52ae-442c-bbca-46f72bf13f21.Text: "That's that, then. But do you know what bothers me, Rogue Trader? The number of people here — there are too few. The lower levels of similar manufactorums are inhabited by millions — what happened to the rest of them?" {n}Heinrix shakes his head.{/n} "I know I won't like the answer. Let's go. We still haven't done what we came here to do."

b03850a8-da3a-42e8-adce-9dbf5e2a5fa4.Text: {n}Heinrix takes in his surroundings and once again fixes his attention on the contents of the nearest cage.{/n} "I'm beginning to have some idea. The {g|Encyclopedia:Lexmechanic}Lexmechanic{/g} mentioned the inhabitants of the lower levels who had been imprisoned in their homes. He said some of them were brought here. The cultists did something to those poor people... in their own home... and now they are studying the result."

e5cf3aea-06b5-479a-ab9d-f775f359c492.Text: "My psyker abilities allow me to affect the human body. It is one of the most effective tools to use against individuals who resist questioning. But if you're suggesting that I 'want' to use it — I think you are getting a little ahead of yourself."

f88dde42-13ba-40f0-baaa-25da18d19317.Text: "I'll be damned! They can still speak! They remember the people who did this to them!" {n}Heinrix balls his fists in powerless rage. Then he frowns in thought.{/n} "Perhaps a little biomancy will allow us to draw the fragments of knowledge out of them. Or it will trigger further... changes."

5786c614-5d49-47ea-8b6e-5719ff3cf079.Text: {n}The mutant changes before your eyes: the tumours recede like an ebbing tide, revealing an emaciated female face twisted in agony. The woman gasps for air, stretches her now mobile neck, and exclaims,{/n} "LIAR! You promised to kill me! You promised me deliverance! Every one of you, everyone told me to have hope and the pain would go! Accept the Truth, for that is hope! My only hope is to be freed from this pain! Please make it so! MAKE IT S—" {n}A lump of flesh behind her head shudders and sends out smooth, fat tentacles that cover her wailing face and drag it into itself. You feel the pressure in your ears: from the cage you hear a steady, almost imperceptible sound that fills you with despair and horror.{/n}

8f06f14e-fadc-402f-a34f-e2e940635795.Text: {n}With a sigh, Heinrix lowers his hand and looks at what the creature within the cage has become. A wetly gleaming mass of meat and gristle that no longer bears any hint of its human origins, it pulses vigorously.{/n} "And that's it? The lamentations of dying people? No. Not just that. What it said about hope sounds like a lie of Chaos, which it uses to take root in weak minds. I believe the corrupted Tech-Priests repeated this phrase like an echo of what had been instilled in them... Whatever the Cult of the Final Dawn is planning, false hope is a key component of their plan. It's a lead. A small one, but still a lead."
