The only thing that's worked so far is keeping the fires burning and maintaining a constant watch — and even with that, the creatures drag us off in ones and twos the second we drop our guard."

d4cd6ff7-5560-4cce-93c8-1b47248ef429.Text: {n}Heinrix meets your eyes.{/n} "Noticed, have you? Don't jump to any conclusions. It could be a local genetic anomaly... It could be something else. We can't say anything for sure... yet." {n}Heinrix looks past the sentry.{/n}

196e5e8c-270d-404b-b8cf-1ee2838d05fc.Text: "You mean Mistress Lichtenhart, my {mf|lord|lady}? We wouldn't have survived without her. It just so happened that she was here, at a local excavation, when the monsters started appearing. We've been losing contact with the other sites on the planet since then, like candles being snuffed out one after another. The rest of them must have all perished. But we're still here... holding on!"

46365661-9096-4a30-b4ec-e027e0b4a502.Text: "Mistress Lichtenhart is inside, in the pit... You go on. Don't be afraid. She will be there to properly greet you! We'll stand guard... Thanks be to the Emperor for delivering you to us..."

79d9eb5f-a3f3-4fa9-b294-a75ab4e2ba85.Text: "Please, my {mf|lord|lady}..." {n}The sentry is on the verge of tears.{/n} "Do you think we are trained Guardsmen? We're from the expedition convoy — we've lived here for generations and, up to now, the God-Emperor has guarded us from misfortune. But now we have to fight. The survivors have all gathered in the tunnel, we've handed out what weapons we have... but how is that supposed to help us against these butchers when we don't always know how to use our weapons?"

a35c73d3-ff1f-475f-b44b-fe5ac490436e.Text: "Yes. About thirty years back, we were brought here with a load of clever people from some high-up Adeptus of something or other. And we've lived here ever since... I've raised four kids here. Two died at the excavations, one was taken by the monsters, but my youngest is still alive..."

98d67cb1-6cdd-40c4-ba09-4717256f83ff.Text: "Excavations? Hmm. Perhaps the expedition, or rather, its objectives, were what Emelina was interested in. Of course, the easiest option would be to ask her directly..." {n}The Interrogator shoots you a pointed, impatient look.{/n}

7579e13e-2438-4b4e-bed5-7aeb3b73c375.Text: {n}Heinrix furrows his brow.{/n} "Sorcerous creatures from the shadows... Could they be daemons? That would explain the presence of warp anomalies in the system. A local breach..."

1d907db3-7dcd-4e88-9697-334cfa5d9e17.Text: "Well, I know of other 'creatures from the shadows,' Master van Calox. And so do you — for the Exalted One has granted you extensive knowledge of xenos and everything related to them. This poor soul's description sounded to me like the Mandrakes that lurk in the Webway. I don't know why you didn't come to the same conclusion yourself..."

46a3f9b0-8866-4c8d-be6a-930d46e55de3.Text: {n}The sentry bows fearfully.{/n} "Of course, of course... one moment, my {mf|lord|lady}..." {n}She signals to her fellows and two more people hurry over to you.{/n}

1759cb33-14c0-4109-b525-00895243a068.Text: "We are most honoured by your presence. Please, come forward, quickly, out of the darkness." {n}The woman hurriedly checks a nearby lumen, her hands visibly shaking.{/n} "Those creatures come from the dark, you see... but not for much longer, not for much longer! And now you're here, and Mistress Lichtenhart has already found a way to help us..."

e443d96f-4b27-430a-88d4-5eb4f89b2a6a.Text: "I can understand the iceman's thinking. Everything here reeks of the warp — as if it has been pricked full of holes deliberately, just like the system itself. No, sorcery is definitely at work on this planet, we just need to figure out where it came from."

ac66512d-2bfc-40b3-bc99-ef4e2f63abb9.Text: {n}Marazhai lets out a vicious laugh.{/n} "I would not be surprised if this mon-keigh was speaking of Mandrakes. They come from the shadows... as black as Vect's soul... as savage as an enraged ur-ghul... It is strange that your kin are still alive, {name}. The Mandrakes must be prolonging their own pleasure by terrorising the mon-keigh again and again."

d1884536-d23e-4e90-848b-4833a3f05b2c.Text: "Hey, iceman... No need to lie to yourself. You can feel it. There's no way you can't feel it. I can practically taste it in the air — sorcery. First, we had those flares in the system, now this comely lot... Something here has been poking holes in the veil between realspace and the warp. Something or someone."

b77f7203-9b65-4c77-9d78-a89fe4fa7561.Text: {n}The woman lurches backward under your scrutiny. Her eyes are red and swollen, and there are dark circles under them, suggesting a long run of sleepless nights.{/n}

73ee3cc7-1352-4491-852b-3bf4d101a65b.Text: "I... have noted the system's idiosyncrasies, yes. I cannot yet say how it relates to the person who drew us here... if it is related at all." {n}Heinrix plainly refuses to meet Idira's eyes.{/n}

ff69050e-496a-428e-af0f-efda909efe64.Text: "It is called doing your duty, Mistress Heydari. You may not be familiar with the concept, but for most of the Imperium's subjects, it is the honourable mundanity."

79ddea8b-0f2e-484e-8c18-35ee9c0c80fc.Text: Ordered that Emelina's excavation site be destroyed.

4471dc26-8c46-480e-a900-d004eb093f4a.Text: "Destroy the place where we landed. Collapse the mine and wall up the source of tainted knowledge forever."

c27af374-3d97-47c5-bd64-4666a467dfc3.Text: Ordered that Emelina's excavation site be left intact, thereby committing the world to the Archenemy.

a74a3c0e-48ad-497d-899f-a9ee3d129949.Text: "Leave this world to serve the Archenemy."

b731c067-14ff-46f2-bbb1-ec9b998828fb.Text: "Ravor here on the vox-line, Lord Cap'n. Good thing we're getting out of here — we're already getting reports from the lower decks: singing coming through the bulkheads, people going insane, and the like... Just one last thing: what's to be done with the planet?"

85d3a58e-396f-4180-acd6-18a67e00e295.Text: "[[Greeting protocol]] Welcome to the Palace of the Adeptus Administratum, <identifying> Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Please follow me."

c072cd51-c350-4cc1-a5d1-0af2dca742f3.Text: "[[Checking coordinates]] Continue in this direction to reach your destination // Your visit has been logged."

9dd0b434-ad3e-440d-b8eb-ba388b1934ec.Text: "Come closer, brothers and sisters, for I am about to tell you about true faith and humility in the face of adversity."

95ed8265-86bb-4296-b5c4-d868c872b1e7.Text: "One day, they appealed to Saint Justina..."

e09864e9-ffa9-44c4-afcf-4adf7c3ca67e.Text: "I heard they've finished building another dozen levels on the east wing of the palace. When I joined the queue, the plans hadn't even been approved..."

c42eeb1e-908a-4832-aa36-17b9deb6c638.Text: "Lord Emperor, I am so bored! I'd love to pick a fight with someone."

29bd29a3-4ea9-4d73-8989-03ccaf3211b4.Text: "My grandma came here every day and every day she took a new ticket, but she never used any of them. I inherited one of those tickets, God-Emperor watch over her soul!"

efc221f5-90c0-4061-a5c1-2217c1d50882.Text: "Certificate PU-231... Form SH-1208 with an OV-1a seal... Transcript from register ER-856... There's definitely something missing..."

195ff8d1-670a-4fad-b044-af4a0a2335b5.Text: "That's the last time I listen to that idiot! I missed my turn because of him, and now I'm stuck in this queue for another week. I deserve compensation for my lost trading time!"

1dde2c0c-f92c-414d-9e24-035cdad44111.Text: Bundles of wires have been ripped out of the servitor's neck and a yellow fluid is seeping from its damaged joints. How angry would a person have to be to do this?

bc081d7d-ffdf-4d56-b774-167a83604442.Text: Turn after turn, the unceasing stream of petitioners pours through the palace doors. The strong-willed wait patiently, while the weak-willed try everything they can to get ahead of the others.

3749f940-2fa3-4483-a7af-20c417b142f6.Text: "The Palace of the Adeptus Administratum is a bulwark of order in the von Valancius protectorate."

4a84e6de-c63f-4159-a4fa-4c5af8846933.Text: "Not too many petitioners today. Last week they had to put on an extra shift to cope with the crowds."

810f2723-e517-418c-8f98-498ad8e376ea.Text: "I treat every citizen as suspect until they have proved they can be trusted."

1ef88fa0-43dd-4a09-bc6e-4615f8751f38.Text: "In the name of the Holy Inquisition, I order you to let this {mf|lord|lady} through! It is your sacred duty to the Imperium to comply."

a43aaa66-13fe-407b-be07-c2e93423feb0.Text: "Emperor save us, I'd better come back in twenty moons..."

178e3632-a733-4afe-bb5b-a048cf330945.Text: "Right. Let's try something nice and subtle..."

fa3f6736-cc92-480e-819d-c9972ad0d3b8.Text: "Oh, you filthy rat! I knew you were the one who grassed! Thought you could get away with shopping my mother, did you?"

c0b6d9cb-2a04-47f8-ae1c-0e4049e475df.Text: "Mistress Heydari, my patience is not easily exhausted, but you are coming very close. I shall repeat myself again: no, I will be not issuing you any seal. Not in exchange for your honest word, nor for a bribe."

81d1ce2c-02f3-4cea-ab4e-2a784265a3b2.Text: "I can see the family resemblance with Abelard now — you cannot see farther than your own nose, my dear Clementia. It wasn't a bribe, it was a gift! Now about that seal..."

e836b6cb-399d-46e6-a921-e114f8aae9b8.Text: "No, did you hear that? The certification officers will only see petitioners who have a signed number ticket! Thanks be to the Exalted One, I managed to get one in the next queue over!"

838d3d2b-7320-480c-b078-a2179d891482.Text: "I heard these xenos are really rare. The Rogue Trader must have spent a tidy sum on this one."

c2453972-b9d5-4383-84a2-adb99d65558d.Text: "Look, get a load of the freak!"

e80b28d1-589d-4262-b0d2-34438e1f8ab5.Text: Sacred scroll "The 1005 Admonitions of Master of Inventory Avacillus to the Adepts of the Administratum."

058c680b-2911-41b2-a655-20550bd8d43b.Text: Inkwell of Livalia the Impartial, First Master of Seals of the Koronus Expanse.

d5dd3f78-6ba3-47cc-b5f3-548de318d1f7.Text: The towering piles of papers and endless shelves heaving with ledgers evoke special reverence for the laws of the God-Emperor in the hearts of the servants of the Adeptus Administratum.

4b95c486-23f5-47cd-939d-09d95e82c93c.Text: The crowd hums and surges like the sea in foul weather. The smell of unwashed bodies, ancient parchment, and ink assaults your nose — for many petitioners, this is not their first cycle waiting to be seen.

075928f5-a4ee-4fba-82c6-931d4de4a42c.Text: "I've waited five cycles, and I'll wait another five so long as I can keep my head on my shoulders!"

21fe1d23-8fab-4aaa-b97c-cfb4140d2ee7.Text: "Run, run, before {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship} gets angry!"

1b6e53bf-d3fc-430f-9cae-b056f476b804.Text: "Look at them, all dressed up in their finery! Important folk, I suppose. But in this Throne-forsak— ahem, blessed place, all are equal."

87750a62-9739-4df8-8557-fb8603fcfe9d.Text: "Who? Ah, Y-Y-Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! P-p-please, sit down! May the Emperor bless you!"

8de985e3-cc08-4542-8846-d609307e1b54.Text: "Are my eyes and mind failing me? Or did the Rogue Trader's shoulder just brush against me?"

3aba615a-d551-49f0-8f18-bde1d9fba836.Text: The gears grind noisily inside the skull of the former secretary. Several certifying seals with the Adeptus Administratum sigil are built into his hands and are ready for use.

ddf6d680-8493-4193-92a0-bcf5e60e9c57.Text: "Sermon of Adeptus Ferdinand IX the Expositor 56, 18 reads: 'Submit to the letter of the law, for it is the will of the God-Emperor.'"

48859c68-e6ba-4e69-bd57-145c691fadd1.Text: "Application #232-05-68X is awaiting processing by the Master of Seals... // Outcome level C// Petition rejected."

0b6bddd5-0f1d-4557-a3ab-d40d9b1e62d5.Text: "Critical error in service cogitator. [[Auxiliary verification]] Petition cannot be processed."

b25d9bfd-ce02-43b2-b689-6b6b1ab16240.Text: "[[Attention]] Malfunction in waiting hall // [Expected outcome] Replacement of operational servitor."

e9c6bfa6-6015-4998-a976-634cb7a3a346.Text: "Subjects of the Imperium, have your papers ready — on behalf of the Adeptus Arbites, I am initiating an inspection and search."

5cccb833-5233-441d-ab33-5d4848bcdd12.Text: "A cyber-mastiff is being used in the search. Do not move — the servants of the Administratum have better things to do than to wipe your blood off the floor."

76233013-b145-49ff-af86-2c67546df279.Text: "No one told me about any tickets! I've been standing here seven turns already!"

9e577f90-4452-40e7-94ce-80fbd134770a.Text: "Kae-morag, elantach... I will do this. But only because I cannot bear to be surrounded by such a throng of mon-keigh."

7e137836-c79b-4d9b-8438-f40d37da8e2f.Text: "Stop staring at me with your dull little eyes, mon-keigh. I am not a withered leaf, I will not go up in flames."

028b73f1-d6d9-419c-97d7-59222ba49001.Text: "Get to the point! I do not have time to spend all day chatting with you."

7bd5bfe5-a01a-40e2-82c9-b97b99fdfd29.Text: "A truly wonderful gift. I accept it with gratitude."

7afec2a5-0adb-4de5-a58a-f0ec949d3a58.Text: "Yet more xenoheresy? You have some nerve trying to peddle this filth to a true servant of the Emperor!"

7469f7fe-bb79-4338-9385-ea9a2d1ce7a1.Text: "The Adeptus Mechanicus — they are the partners I need now."

92013e06-51c7-44f1-ba81-481f2af43bc6.Text: "You consider these gifts? My lowliest enforcers are equipped with deadlier weapons than this."

4e3ba1dd-3af4-42c4-96cf-9f390e5f5a91.Text: "I do not need your help in such matters."

62828ab0-f33e-4653-a925-be22d84d5f12.Text: "We are not here to exchange pleasantries. What is it you wanted to discuss?"

3cbd82dd-9ace-48df-8922-de1472586021.Text: "I think I follow. You wish to use me?"

76943d02-6716-4c21-a2ff-a27d552d8bb8.Text: "If you were slightly less useful to me, I would have brought you to justice myself."

da35bdc0-381c-433f-b49d-0aac308709d4.Text: "How do I benefit from your gaining official status?"

8497adce-8935-415d-9d52-2371fae0a618.Text: "I would never allow your ilk to lay so much as a finger on true power! You are an ulcer on the body of the Imperium — thank your Exalted One that I have not yet incinerated you in righteous flame!"

23b2892c-53bc-452f-a23d-6dac6f520e82.Text: "That sounds simple enough. I will help you."

268260f9-3f9a-46c6-bfb2-e37a0ab3a949.Text: "Do you really think I care one jot about the travails of Kasballican scum?"

d5a5f5c2-5393-4069-92ee-182cf122235b.Text: "Help me to establish cooperation with the Kasballica."

0d33d12c-b2e1-40d1-8d91-bee42cc9b7ea.Text: "I wish to develop friendly relations with the Drusians."

7c689741-b917-4746-b4ab-01f880e4aebe.Text: "I wouldn't mind having closer ties to the pirates of the Expanse."

aec469ef-f19a-4b67-99be-8d48f8d6add2.Text: {n}The flickering light of dozens of candles plays across Jae's face, making her small smile appear even more mysterious.{/n} "Shereen! The {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Exalted One{/g} Himself brought us together the day you crossed Vladaym's threshold. He led us to the cargo and gave His blessing for its return. Do you know what people on my world say when such a thing happens? 'What's gained is to be shared with your neighbour.'"

85d2841e-2abd-4dd6-8eb7-a75889cec360.Text: {n}A wince flickers across Jae's face.{/n} "I did not mean to anger you, Rogue Trader. I but dreamt of turning our cooperation onto a more profitable track."

6c2ee2d0-9f3f-43e4-82e7-6b9ef6f372d5.Text: "I knew you would appreciate the {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g}' mastery of their craft!" {n}Jae beams at you, curling a lock of black hair around an {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}augmented{/g} finger.{/n}

533e5aef-5c95-45df-9b2c-b278c4523714.Text: "Not a problem, shereen! I will have my people put in a good word for you in the right circles."

01123417-7ee7-4473-94df-9951d815c824.Text: "You are free to do whatever you like with my gifts, shereen. If you so desire, you can have them ejected through an airlock or given away to the needy." {n}Jae strives to affect a nonchalant expression, but your words have clearly wrongfooted her.{/n}

02212dd9-b919-481f-80c7-864c05d0cfe5.Text: "I humbly accept your will and the will of the Exalted One, shereen."

a1887429-7c65-45cd-8710-3d1b6cfc686e.Text: "Straight down to business? Not even any prelude? Oh, shereen, if there were more dealers like you on {g|Encyclopedia:Footfall}Footfall{/g} instead of people who just like to hear themselves speak, I'd get twice as much done!"

26479483-61d3-4ad3-91bc-9ab9e6e06211.Text: {n}After a brief pause, she awkwardly continues,{/n} "So... The matter I wanted to discuss with you is related to my business. You know that I sell xeno-artefacts to interested Imperial subjects, and Imperial trinkets to xenos. Business is going well, my network runs even without my participation. But when it comes to expansion... well, that is where I hit a wall."

7ef5f697-f89f-4859-871f-e67816a49bea.Text: "Rivals, envious of my success!" {n}Jae throws up her hands.{/n} "Falco especially. I am certain the theft of the cargo was his doing. But I can never predict what that ashmag will do next. And while the Imperium's authority may be fragmented in the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Expanse{/g}, it could crack down on people of my... profession at any moment."

0ac0bb4e-6dd4-4dea-b4b5-b8c747db5897.Text: "If the {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} put in a good word for me with the servants of the Adeptus Administratum, I could become an official trade representative of the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}. Just imagine it — a little scrap of paper will offer me and my agents protection against ashmag schemes, far better than any refractor field! And even the Inquisition will have to think twice before they mess with me, because I'll be a representative of the law in my own right."

9f9d17ff-1793-4151-9b38-f551f0e3ecac.Text: "Exalted One forfend, could such a lowly servant of the Emperor use the radiant bearer of the Warrant, like some kind of tool! The other way around, however..."

06eff32d-7166-49a8-b51a-7f0e5391ac45.Text: "But you keep me around because you need my capabilities, shereen. And I can offer you more..."

908b1aef-261e-467b-95ab-20d7aa9d4338.Text: "And the best part of all is that this will cost you precisely nothing, shereen! All you have to do is stop by the Administratum Palace and obtain a certificate from the Master of Seals. My informants tell me that the palace is located on Dargonus, your capital world! You see how everything has aligned so wonderfully? And, of course, I will repay you in kind."

74793ef6-eae9-4a47-af3f-74486b2e86c4.Text: "Besides being in receipt of my eternal gratitude, shereen?" {n}Jae playfully raises a brow.{/n} "Won't it be beneficial to have someone in your retinue with the weight of authority behind them, rather than just another pawn? One slip of paper and I will be able to extend my network to systems far beyond Footfall. My agents will be your eyes and ears throughout the Expanse."

a9fb1f65-f84c-429d-908d-71ea2d48ebcf.Text: {n}Jae lets out a low whistle.{/n} "My, my, shereen! Perhaps I should have softened you up first with a glass of dammassine? No matter, I will not trouble you with any more requests of this nature — unless you have a change of heart, that is."

0a4988ef-cc0f-4cfb-b3fd-d9c097b9bc13.Text: "Perhaps your thoughts will move in the right direction with a little encouragement from me, shereen. You must have some faction in mind that you would like to establish relations with? The severe {g|Encyclopedia:Drusians}Drusians{/g}? The hot-headed pirates of the {g|Encyclopedia:KasballicaMission}Kasballica{/g}? You merely need to use the right words, like a key for a lock, and people will open their hearts to you. Or their wallets. I will arrange everything, you merely have to ask."

5408afce-a758-455b-a4fc-93981b261a42.Text: "Exalted One bless you, shereen! I couldn't find a better business partner in all the Expanse!" {n}Jae ponders for a moment, and then graces you with a dazzling smile.{/n} "Friendship is a gift from the Exalted One, and we must cherish it!"

6149371e-c612-4c13-b5c7-91f1b9b82642.Text: {n}She points at the containers in front of her. One contains a polished {g|Encyclopedia:Aeldari}Aeldari{/g} rifle, a rare model, and the other holds an ornate sword.{/n} "I am sharing what I've gained with you — please accept these humble gifts in honour of our wildly successful, though suddenly struck, friendship."

1167f1f6-5daf-4783-b4d9-77fee322cc5b.Text: "And you will have no complaints about our friendship, shereen! I may not be a trade representative of the Imperium just yet, but I can still help you with whatever you need. You must have some faction in mind that you would like to establish relations with? The severe {g|Encyclopedia:Drusians}Drusians{/g}? The hot-headed pirates of the {g|Encyclopedia:KasballicaMission}Kasballica{/g}? You merely need to use the right words, like a key for a lock, and people will open their hearts to you. Or their wallets. I will arrange everything, you merely have to ask."

c564d588-8344-4f66-8b9b-ee742ce6637f.Text: "I will humbly wait until you steer your vessel toward Dargonus! The Mercatum Tabula Officiale... It sounds almost as majestic as the {g|Encyclopedia:Warrant}Warrant of Trade{/g}!"

bf1da0ed-d718-44da-9e70-98febab95a03.Text: "And if you change your mind about my proposal, you can always find me nearby on the bridge. Just say the word and I'll come, shereen."

98f3a6d0-2b1b-41e3-8fd5-cef4ed827458.Text: {n}Jae smiles bitterly.{/n} "Next time I will try to present you with a worthier gift."

ac32cd41-4ece-4099-8f77-d1d6e01b8f1c.Text: A Mercatum Tabula Officiale. This document requires several signatures and seals to have legal force.

056c15c5-b6c7-47c8-bed7-502d1d01acd9.Text:
The parchment looks grease-marked and old, as though it has passed through many, many pairs of hands.
"Servant of the Imperium Elias Tantanal filed a declaration with the Adeptus Administratum that he is the sole heir of House Tantanal and the legal sovereign of the northern continent of the planet Ergona-Rex. According to the submission, Elias Tantanal cannot exercise his right to this inheritance, as the wider family tree includes an individual who shares his full legal name. According to the petitioner, this individual is his great-grandfather. Given the loss of documents confirming the death of the second claimant to the inheritance, Elias Tantanal is petitioning for confirmation of this relative's death and permission for the enactment of his inheritance rights.
Petition received. Preliminary review period: up to 15 Terran years.
***
Forwarded for review. 23 Terran years, 4 cycles from date of submission.
***
Request for a copy of the death certificate of Elias Tantanal sent to the archive of the Departmento Munitorum. 28 Terran years, 2 cycles from date of submission.
***
Request rejected. 39 Terran years, 11 cycles from date of submission.
***
Second request sent to the archive. 44 Terran years, 4 cycles from date of submission.
***
Request approved. 52 Terran years from date of submission.
***
After 48 repeated petitions from Elias Tantanal, a third request was sent to the archive. 79 Terran years, 7 cycles from date of submission.
***
Copy of death certificate of Elias Tantanal, great-grandfather to the petitioner, received. 84 Terran years, 6 cycles from date of submission.
***
Documents forwarded for formulation of decision granting permission for the enactment of the inheritance rights of Elias Tantanal, sole heir of his house and legal sovereign of the northern continent of the planet Ergona-Rex. 101 Terran years, 5 cycles from date of submission.
***
Death of Elias Tantanal recorded by servants of the Adeptus Administratum. Place of death: Queue 16 (Wills, Legacies, and Inheritances), Waiting Hall, Palace of the Adeptus Administratum, Dargonus. 106 Terran years, 2 cycles from date of submission.
***
Death certificate of Elias Tantanal sent to the archive of the Departmento Munitorum. 114 Terran years, 10 cycles from date of submission.
***
Petition for the enactment of inheritance rights following the death of Elias Tantanal and for the issuance of a copy of the death certificate received from the deceased's daughter, Eliaza Tantanal. 114 Terran years, 11 cycles from date of submission."

781cf81b-ef70-436c-806c-2856c9228a07.Text: A worn golden seal adorned with intricate patterns. Someone has deliberately scraped the coat of arms off the handle.

8cbaf8de-0d6f-4d41-9d4f-10406826c207.Text:
"Elam, I know it hasn't even been a full cycle since I was appointed, but please, cover for me with the Master of Seals, for the Emperor's sake! I completely forgot about one extremely important seal — I'm going to run upstairs to do it. I don't think it will take long. I'll be back within a couple of hours!"
The note is covered in a thick layer of dust, just like the table on which it lies.

0ecb3b6a-1edc-40f3-9842-62ae2a34383c.Text:
"1. Compose an order for the servitorisation of 90% of the population of asteroid mining station VMK-498 for the purposes of increasing productivity.
2. Prepare a set of documents for the reclassification of the world Vheabos VI as a penal colony on the orders of Her Ladyship Theodora von Valancius.
3. Task the newly appointed adepts of the Administratum with conducting a review of all unresolved petitions in the last 5,999 cycles.
4. Make a big mug of recaf."

2ce3dd51-695c-4c36-b065-70086941a3a4.Text: Task List for Current Work Turn

7ae44a9d-f0eb-4f2e-9735-fac4ad10a4e0.Text:
"Auditing and Reissuance of Great Tithe Payment Documentation for GX-75021 and GX-76021.
In the last 2,836 Terran years:
Entries mentioning planet GX-75021: 284,356 found, including copies.
Entries mentioning planet GX-76021: 1 found, including copies.
A full list confirmed by the Adeptus Terra of all planetary objects located within the territory of the illustrious Rogue Trader dynasty of von Valancius was received 164 Terran years ago. After careful reconciliation of the data, it was found that planetary object GX-76021 has not been included in the collection of the Imperial Tithe for the last 2,836 Terran years. In the same period, the planetary object GX-75021 was included in the taxable sites but did not pay its Imperial Tithe, thereby failing to uphold its sacred obligations to the Imperium. Subsequent analysis of archived documentation revealed the absence of documentation confirming the existence of planetary object GX-75021, unlike planetary object GX-76021, which was discovered in files dated more than 2,836 Terran years ago.
Based on an internal inventory investigation, the Adeptus Administratum decrees that:
any mention of planetary object 'GX-75021' must be replaced with 'GX-76021';
the governor of planetary object GX-76021 must pay the tithe for the preceding 2,836 Terran years within a period of no more than 50 Terran years; and
in the event of non-payment of the tithe within the prescribed period, planetary object GX-76021 will be seized for the needs of the Adeptus Administratum, and 95% of the population will be immediately subjected to Servitude Imperpituis for the benefit of the Imperium.
Note: a precise reckoning of the tithe amount required in throne gelts is appended to this report.
Note: an advisory letter has been sent to the Departmento Munitorum recommending that the Departmento conduct its own internal inventory investigation to determine whether planetary object GX-76021 has fulfilled its sacred obligation to provide recruits for the Astra Militarum."

f4cc4100-b2d8-4929-bedb-44d7df5b5d49.Text: A seal featuring the Winterscale coat of arms and the Adeptus Administratum sigil.

821dfdef-3b2d-49a0-8e61-e2b0437012aa.Text:
"—ty regiments of the Astra Militarum sent to the frozen world of Zenegar II, required supplies of warm clothing, footwear, and snowshoes for a successful combat manoeuvre with a further offensive against the enemies of Humanity and the Emperor. Due to a gross error by a low-ranking adept of the Adeptus Administratum, instead of the aforementioned supplies, soldiers received 800 cryobanks, resulting in the death by freezing of the majority of troops before the commencement of the mission of retribution.
For the purposes of improving efficiency, the adept responsible was subjected to Servitude Imperpituis, as a result of which he is now discharging his duties flawlessly."

395730af-cf60-447d-8d79-b69e2460c983.Text: Addendum #32-4 to Addendum #874-BA7 to Document NXC4026-82

194670eb-329c-478c-a8ef-1c3ea3e3c847.Text: "Here, all of the seals, placed by a certification officer."

425bdee3-65b5-462c-b9cd-0426793e47e7.Text: "Tell me about the work of the Adeptus Administratum."

44975e85-91a4-4569-9aac-6feed7ea08aa.Text: "Don't you want to know who I am?"

a0b89276-d357-4cdd-8cbd-169aed1d6aba.Text: "Could you handle the paperwork on my behalf? I will pay."

27727e7c-cf1c-4969-9f05-2b103937b82d.Text: "My companion wishes to obtain a Mercatum Tabula Officiale."

721a1065-22d8-49f2-ad79-7ffa883cf7b7.Text: [Give your written consent on the presented form]

70d56c91-0063-426c-85be-19182aaad1a9.Text: "There is no way of getting around these formalities?"

28a9c99f-eda5-4b56-ac76-5f88b013f955.Text: "It will take a great deal more than what you promised to repay me for this."

9e9e49fe-32f6-4cd5-a6c6-062938dd78b6.Text: "Remind me, what is it you needed me to do?"

a1ec6e8a-90dc-4268-a32b-67235024672a.Text: "Why can the seals not be affixed here in the Administratum Palace?"

193bb286-b0c3-4da6-b6fd-bfa1def2650f.Text: "Find Administratum servitors and have them place two seals of approval. The goal is clear."

ced36441-22dd-4fd3-a819-0a17727be1e8.Text: "Here is your paper, complete with seals."

4933dc28-085f-4980-88e9-ae199e1a31cd.Text: "That is exactly what I am doing at present."

5458caa6-d96a-482f-9a76-ad345a1e9139.Text: "I am the Rogue Trader and sovereign of this world — I do not queue!"

33d5321e-cd42-4889-8748-6c6e0c126f60.Text: "Then I shall return after the official ceremony. And do not even think of obstructing me then!"

fce2521b-ab6f-4c2f-ae67-eb45874dcccf.Text: "Do you really wish to get on my bad side?"

2ef885e2-ce0c-4438-a925-bfacc2753f5f.Text: "If I must queue, then queue I shall."

e358be7e-8f69-4566-b430-fb50b3e786f4.Text: "I am the Rogue Trader, you old hag! Take me to the certification officer!"

af75ede4-eade-4315-b935-25b85296912b.Text: "I did not sign up for this!"

7d8d8559-3aa7-4753-a2e1-a34514e641dc.Text: [Kill the Master of Seals] "As you wish."

8a52a119-81a4-40e6-9c60-bd5fa34c5fa0.Text: [Address Jae] "I am sick of this. Handle your problems yourself, Jae."

2f356ae3-9e3a-4d81-a536-84a6882526b4.Text: "Why am I obliged to handle such a task myself?"

ca1eafd8-c7b9-4172-a66d-9b73554a4ed4.Text: "My name was widely known long before I became a Rogue Trader! People like me do not queue — wherever we go, doors are thrown open wide for us and the red carpet rolled out!"

f45b9f83-66f2-423c-82d6-691477ef3fc5.Text: "R-Rogue Trader! What an honour it is to speak to you in person. The death of the Master of Seals is a terrible and frightening tragedy! But I am sure you had your reasons. I have been sent to report that a new Master of Seals will take up their post within several moons, once the prefect council has convened and selected a worthy candidate. Until then, no new applications will be accepted. But I hasten to assure you — this incident has had no impact on the work of our certification officers! So, please take your place in the queue — and may His will be upon you!"

03d18f54-25f8-46d2-bfbf-2abafd5faa43.Text: {n}An ancient-looking woman in a voluminous robe peers at you critically through her ocular lenses when you descend into the bowels of her bureaucratic domain.{/n} "Another noble bypassing the queue under the pretext of 'Just wanted to ask'? All you highborn ever want is 'just to ask'! But what about protocol? That's what I'm asking! Who is going to follow protocol?"

65e97ac0-efb2-47f8-b715-17af81192bc8.Text: "Very well, don't just stand there, you're here now. Or do you think the Master of Seals has nothing better to do than receive unexpected visitors?" {n}The old woman beckons over a servo-skull floating nearby.{/n} "Begin entry — current hour, current turn, current cycle, 41st millennium." {n}Metal manipulators immediately begin feverishly clacking, taking dictation.{/n}

7da64868-ecdc-4eb3-b351-00ef84ffb0d8.Text: {n}Dumbfounded by your speech and splendour, the petitioners around you freeze, open-mouthed.{/n}

821e2d9d-e202-4a24-b496-8668641f0286.Text: {n}Jae continues in a whisper,{/n} "She's ancient enough herself... Look at her, she's a bona fide living mummy!"

d032cf86-03f4-4a6e-8767-ace01392c909.Text: "{name} von Valancius, sole heir of {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} Theodora von Valancius, may the {g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Throne{/g}'s radiance guide her path on the other side." {n}In a practised move, the Master of Seals twists her magnifying ocular lens and examines the ledger in front of her.{/n} "The sole person to publicly assert their claim, to be precise."

10ad8208-6a86-48a5-a931-329eb25746a4.Text: {n}The Master of Seals nods in approval and stows the scroll into a tube labelled with your name.{/n} "Next is the consent form for the processing and notarisation of the personal data of your most sacred personage."

169c2131-6184-4ebc-ba16-e45cd93cc5ca.Text: {n}The Master of Seals peers over her ocular lenses at Jae in disbelief. Then she looks at you.{/n} "I take it you are her sponsor? In that case, you must submit a written application in conformity with template #404.01. As well as written permission for the processing and notarisation of the personal data of your most sacred personage. Without it, I cannot issue Mistress..."

7b6850c2-5625-4536-9181-b9d25ffbaef4.Text: "...Mistress Heydari the form for collecting the seals required to obtain the Mercatum Tabula Officiale — the certificate of an official trade representative."

0898c226-158f-4782-8b65-24f7f6597e2b.Text: {n}The Master of Seals raises her eyebrows in surprise.{/n} "You are in the very heart of the Palace of the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusAdministratum}Adeptus Administratum{/g}. Day and night, hundreds of thousands of prefects, ordinates, scribes, servants, and {g|Encyclopedia:Servitor}servitors{/g} carry out their duties to Humanity and the von Valancius dynasty here, never setting foot outside its boundaries for decades at a time. But knowledge comes through comparison! There are entire worlds belonging to the Administratum, so this palace is but a humble cog in the blessed machine of the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}."

ad86d98f-fab9-442c-b2f7-f206c7812d7d.Text: {n}The old woman smacks her lips in satisfaction and nods curtly.{/n} "Of course I know who is standing before me. It is my job to know."

9dd348f2-d2a1-45b7-ba01-fa823ee7816e.Text: {n}Cassia stares in puzzlement at the gleaming coin in her hand.{/n} "Ah, I... House Orsellio thanks you for your service, Master of Seals."

33f78f3a-35b4-49c6-936e-8f1bd40e67aa.Text: "Fear the wrath of the Immortal One, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! What would become of your protectorate or even the Imperium itself if every person did what you are proposing? No, Lex Imperialis, Volume 249, Paragraph 18/2, amendment of the twelfth year of the previous millennium clearly states: 'Actions that circumvent the sacred law of the Imperium in pursuit of personal gain are a manifestation of human weakness, which is subject to eradication.'"

8af18c76-be8e-4453-ab8e-7b7c92c120ae.Text: "No. I have received no reports about you."

7105fbe1-9690-42d0-81a6-fcdb842d1268.Text: "Hmph." {n}The old woman is intently writing in her large ledger, not paying you any attention.{/n}

c54bee08-f951-49bd-9aa1-ff3def7f9995.Text: "Come on, esteemed damaar! What's that you were saying about seals?"

a748a397-8ede-42c6-a2b8-05bccd79df1b.Text: {n}The old woman unhurriedly holds out a printed scroll to Jae.{/n} "Here is your document, Mistress Heydari. Unfortunately, it does not yet have legal force — I can certify it as a sacred Mercatum Tabula Officiale once it has received two seals of approval. They are easy to obtain — in the Imperium court Administratum servitors have been handling such tasks for over fifty years. There is one such servitor here on Dargonus in the Rogue Trader's palace. The second is duty-bound to keep the seal in the Telikos Epsilon System."

cfc7a713-f173-44f0-ba9c-6cb1f4dcdc83.Text: "According to Amendment 3-C/8, implemented by Prefectus Estinia II of Dargonus, one of the seals must be kept in the palace of the ruler of the von Valancius protectorate, remaining a symbol of the unbreakable link between the sacred Warrant and the Adeptus Administratum."

4a44b512-d7f9-4dae-b214-d4cc9f15bc5b.Text: {n}The Master of Seals nods with satisfaction.{/n} "Please do return once you have prepared the documents."

f02af5c0-9efc-4c84-abbd-cae3d8d8baf2.Text: {n}Jae smiles obsequiously, trying to hide her disappointment.{/n} "Ah, shereen. If that is your will, who am I to defy it?"

9abc6d72-0cf4-4248-bb3e-e4588cf573c7.Text: "Whatever you want, shereen, whatever it takes to satisfy you!"

9c88c57d-ec1f-423b-9576-e4f69fa4ab80.Text: "You must have two seals of approval affixed to the document with which I furnished you. It is easily done — in the Imperium, Administratum servitors have been performing the duties of certification officers for more than fifty years already. You will find one such servitor here on Dargonus in the {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}'s palace. The second is duty-bound to keep the seal in the Telikos Epsilon System."

7745dcdb-8d12-4e4e-8248-f5ef990ce368.Text: {n}The ocular lenses on the old woman's nose emit a subtle hum as she adjusts the magnification.{/n} "Yes, oh yes, indeed, it is perfect! The seals are authentic, so we may continue with the certification procedure. Follow me, please."

80a2182c-ff7d-4423-adb4-ff5c03b7c0c1.Text: "This is your queue and your ticket number is..." {n}The old woman's ocular lenses hum as she zooms in on the paper in her hand.{/n} "...three hundred and ninety-four! When it is your turn to be seen, the ranking prefect will review your documentation again and sign the official certification for Jae Heydari to possess a Mercatum Tabula Officiale. You will have a bit of a wait, but it will be worth it in the end, yes?"

de52b6c4-c4d0-4839-a921-fe98bcc724de.Text: {n}The Master of Seals peers at you over her ocular lenses.{/n} "Hardly. In accordance with Decree DA-58, Clause 201, citizens of the capital world of the von Valancius protectorate must submit their petitions at one of the assigned windows of the waiting hall. The decree makes no mention of the Rogue Trader being exempt from this rule."

ee19e92c-1900-4a96-bc4d-58447125002c.Text: "Under the {g|Encyclopedia:LexImperialis}Lex Imperialis{/g}, your rights and privileges as Rogue Trader come into effect only after your official accession ceremony. Until then, you are just another humble subject of the von Valancius protectorate."

268eea44-f31c-40ca-a27c-93bac0d4f893.Text: {n}The old woman wrinkles her nose like she has tasted something unpleasant.{/n} "I suppose I could make an exception — but only because Theodora von Valancius never once overlooked the laws of the Imperium or my advice! Here." {n}She holds out a new ticket with the number 301.{/n} "May His blessing be upon you."

1bd6d74b-87ca-4720-a2b8-5d0532b8ea2e.Text: {n}The old woman nods pensively.{/n} "That is your right."

6350fde0-9311-4a4b-9ef8-66ea2b373c01.Text: "The temple of law and order greets you, {name} von Valancius. You have returned with all the necessary paperwork, I presume?"

ca114b70-1f1c-41ec-b007-76c47d1bf88e.Text: "Unfortunately, your previous place in the queue has not been held for you. If you wish to wait your turn, you will have to join the end of the queue."

60ab61f4-21b8-4978-b5ff-c4405bdaca5e.Text: "Then I bid you good day. May the law and the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} keep you."

cee29ca0-9543-41a3-82da-619b25f2cd59.Text: "Shereen, I know the azhi have thwarted our plans, and that unforeseen circumstances have arisen like... like... never mind. So the esteemed damaar wants us to fill in a couple of forms? I will do that with great pleasure!"

c7897e4b-9a4e-47e4-b810-450983c06c35.Text: {n}The colourless eyes of the Master of Seals suddenly fix on Cassia.{/n} "A Lady Navigator of House Orsellio whose name and deeds are unknown to me..." {n}She points her finger at the old ledger.{/n} "It says here that the von Valancius dynasty has owed your House one gold throne for thirty Terran years. Here, take this. And I, at last, will mark the matter closed."

5a8fd7d1-3fc8-4ca6-bf28-ceaae5292169.Text: {n}The Master of Seals looks over Jae's form, which has been rewritten four times already.{/n} "At last, you succeeded in completing the form without any errors. Next, protocol requires consent for the processing and notarisation of the personal data of {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship}."

f7463dd2-17a8-4c2a-a874-c7306f227fa0.Text: "Abelard Werserian," {n}The old woman directs her gaze over your shoulder.{/n} "Seneschal and right hand of the now departed Theodora von Valancius. And of her now extant heir."

911efa2e-bc6b-4709-8d71-9c46328364e3.Text: {n}Jae holds out the scroll, now covered in writing, for you to reinforce the words with the von Valancius coat of arms seal. Only now do you notice that the plebian expression 'chicken scratch writing' describes her gnarled penmanship absurdly accurately.{/n}

d8c55385-37e0-4627-b046-156ac5619443.Text: {n}The scroll is whipped away into another tube by the Master of Seals.{/n} "Protocol executed. Application received. Processed. Approved." {n}The servo-skull scribe taps out each word after its mistress's pronouncement.{/n}

f377697b-024f-4c62-a2c1-3f3cb9e79c20.Text: "Rogue Trader, shereen, we've almost finished! Just two more piddling seals and, Exalted One knows, a full-fledged trade representative will be standing beside you in the darkness of the Expanse like a true comrade!" {n}Jae brings her hands together in a pleading gesture and smiles innocently.{/n}

fbbb262b-859f-4e84-a9ef-392381592a92.Text: "Wonderful. The {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} blessed you with patience greater than that apportioned to ordinary mortals. Allow me to verify the authenticity of your documents — for the final time."

3f265d26-8759-4d4d-8d0e-0d05b95e7a03.Text: "That's not even mentioning the fact that said humble subject is accompanied by a xenos." {n}The gaze of the Master of Seals latches onto Yrliet.{/n} "Given that your official induction has yet to take place, you are, technically speaking, performing an act of heresy here and now, in front of dozens of witnesses."

d2e26a21-64b8-41d5-a5eb-4266a816b4fc.Text: {n}Yrliet gives you a look.{/n} "So you, elantach, have not yet gone through the initiation rite that grants you all your privileges after all? I regret to see that a lie has passed between us."

1d2b277a-3c2d-48ba-9c67-f4207bcd03ea.Text: {n}Abelard lets out a stoic sigh and rolls his eyes. You get the feeling that this is not his first personal interaction with the Administratum bureaucracy, nor is it his second.{/n}

7c24fe77-74ee-4641-b12d-577bd6929b5f.Text: "There was a time during my earlier years of service when I performed the duties of a secretary in charge of logistics reports at a local Administratum office. Your words, Master of Seals, bring back memories of which I am not the least bit fond."

eafb7229-64a5-45c8-9860-9db16bb7199e.Text: {n}Idira stares at Jae in surprise and lets out a whistle.{/n} "Well, that came out of nowhere..."

a4433271-9b25-4824-b52c-1c366c947e72.Text: "Yes, yes, please do. I have three hundred petitioners to see after you today."

ca1a933f-f002-448a-a7d0-d6522e2b07ca.Text: "I am the Master of Seals, the only one in your protectorate, for that matter." {n}The old woman sighs wearily, and then carefully wipes her fogged ocular lenses with a trembling hand.{/n}

18ff9dc0-4a30-41fe-bd53-99d5a1fc21ab.Text: {n}The Master of Seals animatedly draws her cogita-quill across the surface of a {g|Encyclopedia:Dataslate}data-slate{/g}, paying no attention to you.{/n}

17da5bbd-f4ff-406e-ae71-106cb1d0be55.Text: "Oh, shereen, it's just another piece of paper! Say the word and I will take care of it just like the first one."

1cccaddb-c215-4b63-ae86-cba5ab2a6478.Text: {n}The Master of Seals respectfully inclines her head.{/n} "Yes, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. So the law dictates."

c0cd47c4-d8cd-420f-aee9-7cf89bcc6bdc.Text: {n}Heinrix smiles wryly.{/n} "Understandable, though, given the circumstances."

6395a358-e5c1-4539-98bf-d8f368d38c80.Text: "Ahh, {name} von Valancius, you have returned! I hope the sacred document I entrusted to you last time has now successfully passed through the approval procedure?"

8b75c103-33f1-402a-aff3-1e4581d758bc.Text: "Of course, the {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_MOT_Glory}fame{/d} of your deeds has reached the walls of this temple of the Imperium's law and will. And yet the {g|Encyclopedia:LexImperialis}Lex Imperialis{/g}..." {n}The expression on the Master of Seals's face undergoes an indescribable metamorphosis — various moral impulses are warring within her, her lips moving soundlessly. Then she nods several times to herself.{/n}

b561c49e-6474-46e9-8dae-028aec71d4ce.Text: {n}The old woman holds the documents close so that they are almost touching her nose, her mechanical ocular lenses clicking incessantly.{/n} "Yes. Yes. Confirmed. Everything is in order. And this one. Ah, the seal is smudged slightly..."

24ea8d01-1d79-4bde-8473-ea8c00de3902.Text: {n}The perfectly sharpened quill scratches pleasantly on the parchment, but for the first few minutes. The obfuscatory phrasing, footnotes, amendments... You are forced to write out the same details over and over — about you, the protectorate, Theodora von Valancius, Jae... and then also every living person who bears your family name. If you do not know all the required information, you must complete supplementary forms.{/n}

7316eb86-9112-457d-aaea-24b6c1b8ae8f.Text: "Of course, you may have as many as you need." {n}The Master of Seals holds out a clean scroll.{/n} "I advise you not to crumple it, lose it, or ask anyone else to complete it on your behalf. If I find a defect in the next one, you will have to repeat the application procedure from the start."

2c57c9d3-36d8-420f-b81b-d691172aa03f.Text: "The second seal..." {n}The ocular lenses perched on her nose click as she rifles through mouldering scrolls with her wrinkled fingers.{/n} "...is held in the Telikos Epsilon System in accordance with decree OL-008/ZN. Unfortunately, after a fire two hundred years ago, all that remains of the original decree is an addendum certified by an unknown adept with the initials A.A. No instructions repealing this decree were ever received from Holy Terra, therefore the seal remains where it ought to be."

5e26f5d3-e8aa-4d2e-8227-3d16e0985e91.Text: "Decree 424, Clause 79, Amendment 8 of the Law on Certifying a Mercatum Tabula Officiale With Sponsorship of a Bearer of the Warrant of Trade: 'The sponsoring Rogue Trader must be present at the placing and certifying of each seal. If this requirement is not met, the document will be deemed invalid.'"

fb20a714-3d0f-411f-a279-b936d0e1cd74.Text: {n}Jae's smile evaporates, revealing her true emotions.{/n} "Void scorpions scratch out my eyes, now what?"

219879f9-f4a8-4b73-b159-fa083b3a3207.Text: "...Hmm, I suppose I can overlook it, given that the rest has been certified correctly and promptly. Congratulations, Jae Heydari, you are now the holder of a Mercatum Tabula Officiale. Do not forget to repeat the certification process every one hundred Terran years. Uphold the law of the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g} proudly and honourably in the worlds of the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g}."

a3360653-bdd0-48b0-84d9-56200aba3ac9.Text: "And one more thing — loss of the certificate is a grievous transgression, Mistress Heydari. Lose the original document, and you will be unable to regain your status as an official trade representative. Not even with the Rogue Trader's endorsement."

9929a509-7050-403c-8e04-84cbbe896e3f.Text: {n}Kibellah surveys the room and slowly removes her hand from the handle of her weapon.{/n} "There is only one thing that can kill you here, Domin'{name}, and that is old age."

c4a61e4f-303a-46ae-90c6-acc65139a9c5.Text: "Then, I'm afraid, Mistress Heydari will never receive her much-desired certificate. And I will be obliged to levy a fine against your noble name — for wasting the valuable time of the Master of Seals."

b7874df0-3c2f-4859-bdde-f4ea961e8685.Text: "Just one strike. Not in His name, not by His will — merely for myself. Would it be a grave trespass, I wonder? No, I must banish such thoughts."

20e84aee-a000-4eff-90d6-26a2ae0a832a.Text: {n}The Master of Seals tuts in displeasure.{/n} "One would think the protectorate's heir has no care for {mf|his|her} tongue, if {mf|he|she} is so willing to wag it to the point of blistering. However, I, despised servant of the Emperor that I am, do not possess the gift of unallocated time. Let us proceed to the matter of your application."

56cade4f-993b-46fb-80ba-4c616e60e971.Text: {n}At these words, the saccharine smile drops from Jae's face.{/n} "Seals? What seals?"

30fb2b34-0dfb-48e4-b8cb-638944f8b6e1.Text: {n}Jae glances at you and whispers,{/n} "What? So I paid off a few clerks to let us skip the queue, shereen. Your time is more important to me than any little formalities."

2c72a25b-2491-4d20-b655-f9317555228a.Text: "We will discuss that when {name} von Valancius has prepared the primary documentation."

63a49920-8253-4003-996f-f9c8fc7855de.Text: {n}She mutters something waspishly under her breath, ignoring your question entirely.{/n}

f01c57fb-d651-4a03-9227-e2f5dccb1355.Text: {n}Jae shifts, deliberately putting her jewelled {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}augmetic{/g} on display.{/n} "Does that mean that my reputation has preceded me as well, esteemed damaar?"

5ad2d783-5e34-4313-b852-fb2f10e30623.Text: "I am now officially the Rogue Trader of the von Valancius dynasty. Take me to the certification officer."

5bfe5058-1445-49dd-82e7-693b06695770.Text: "I am the law — and I oversee order in this section of the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g}. As well as on worlds of the von Valancius protectorate, in accordance with ancient covenants made with your ancestors. I hold the power to grant petitioners what they seek and to punish criminals for failing to carry out the Imperium's will."

9917aa48-1230-43f9-b279-05aa182464fa.Text: "I require a new document for the certification procedure."

773bbe51-597d-4384-977e-f477b5d98a69.Text: "Yes, yes, esteemed damaar, give me the certificate already, come on!" {n}Jae's eyes dart over the Mercatum Tabula Officiale and shine with delight.{/n} "Praise the Exalted One who saw me through all these trials, shereen! This is something to tell the grandchildren about — how a humble mortal became a trade representative of the Imperium! Let's not bother the damaar any longer, shereen. Why don't we discuss our next steps on the ship?"

779bd0fb-3fd4-4308-beff-f412ec145ae6.Text: {n}The old woman shrugs.{/n} "I am afraid that until the Magnae Accessio rite has been performed, the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusAdministratum}Adeptus Administratum{/g} cannot officially treat you as the Rogue Trader. No one will give you a different answer in this palace, even if there were to be another Master of Seals in my place."

8db3145a-424d-4587-81a7-9a064ab13189.Text: "I trust you will take me to the certification officer directly?"

28a4edd4-a0e0-4cf0-bb2e-ba6672deefe1.Text: "I require a blank form for the Mercatum Tabula Officiale."

c8015899-2cfa-4f50-a52a-71c360efa0f5.Text: {n}The scrawny man pales and leaps to attention at your approach.{/n} "R-R-Rogue Trader! Honoured to be of service! I am the second in line to temporarily carry out the duties of the Master of Seals. How m-may I help you?"

c5a0192f-45a8-4879-abc9-fb0fe0d89153.Text: "O-of course! So the law dictates. Unfortunately, you will have to join the very end of the queue, for there is no route to the certification officer but through humility and acceptance."

2ce24dc7-7547-4eb1-9972-8fde27908ec6.Text: "Certainly, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! It will be my honour!"

91feff6d-30d6-413c-9f7a-af71b7a2caec.Text: {n}The prefect blinks in surprise.{/n} "Oh, you are the eleventh person today who has failed to submit their documents for certification within the validity period. I will pass it up the chain that we need to review our arrangements for managing petitioner flow. Or perhaps add a few extra hours to the certification officers' shifts? Hmm..."

8ff04de9-66e8-4cfe-80c7-151c68b5e177.Text: "May the power of the law and the light of the Throne be upon you!"

4305ea97-d630-4e62-9488-af54514f2a5b.Text: {n}The prefect's knees are knocking together in terror.{/n} "I'm afraid... I'm afraid I cannot do that, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Strictly speaking, you have not officially assumed the title of Rogue Trader after the death of Lady Theodora von Valancius. And within these walls, it is one rule for everyone..." {n}After uttering these last words, the man shrinks back and deliberately avoids looking you in the eye.{/n}

37d74924-bddd-424b-b513-e572002d738a.Text: "Wonderful, wonderful!" {n}The prefect nervously rummages in the drawers and retrieves what must be the gilded quill and red ink of the Master of Seals.{/n} "Aaand... there we are. In the name of the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g}, your application has been approved. Initiation of the new trade representative has been performed. The status is hereby confirmed."

c2b0861b-7ac7-45ab-8412-ebcc81bea243.Text: {n}The prefect catches your look, pales slightly, and hurriedly shakes his head.{/n} "But that is neither here nor there! Here is your new petitioner form."

a1941dd0-cb25-4653-802b-35ebd45f8949.Text: Take your place in the queue

823671dd-e606-4350-b8a3-554a88826bea.Text: "How dare a prefect's property try to make use of its own life! Get away — back to your master!"

dc686424-e168-4d5e-91d6-938a1ee7f40d.Text: "Do not forget — you are the reason we are here."

a514ca09-ee77-416d-adf0-37dc1cd26095.Text: "Your paltry problems are no concern of mine. Begone!"

7de9a310-9937-4f10-9460-051502154272.Text: "I've had it with this bureaucratic nonsense. We're leaving."

165c1722-1df0-4407-b994-75ecb36e028f.Text: "In the name of House von Valancius, I hereby make your fiancée a lady of the court. And release her from any obligations thereto."

91f0fac8-a374-4f7e-b0a2-c217d8017387.Text: "You wish to study alongside your beloved? Very well. I hereby grant you ownership of the Dargonus University of Medicae — you may admit anyone you like."

b0d8ba42-1e23-494d-92ee-2ac69b2a95b3.Text: [Order your servants to prepare a waiting area befitting a Rogue Trader]

1a83350f-b1b3-4640-ad32-a7bee4b25667.Text: "Fine. I shall endure this for the good of the von Valancius protectorate."

f1f84af7-04e9-4c1f-ae73-813df8a21385.Text: "I shall stay, but only because I enjoy hearing your pleas."

a33d9bd8-1467-436e-8d4b-86e893c9714a.Text: "Are you going to make the Rogue Trader repeat {mf|himself|herself}?"

05d9eceb-cbfb-463a-95da-4f6bcd28652d.Text: "I will have my people buy your granddaughter's release and see to your welfare."

976cb4ce-9e22-4bf9-923d-a27574abc417.Text: "You do not have to die, old man. If she has been taken out of service, then the time has come to release her."

d7e588e0-2f3b-49e0-b113-9afd25e66d90.Text: "I will give the order for your granddaughter to be repaired, but if you wish to be with her forever, you will also be subject to Servitude Imperpituis."

8ea85f28-f8f4-4a92-a177-1ac0ef755a58.Text: "This should suffice to cover your expenses."

669d09a8-3826-4484-a686-794dad6647a6.Text: "I suppose you must remarry, then? I shall have my people select the best spouse for you."

850a7b57-99e3-4235-a2b9-8bfd39487c7a.Text: "Frighten the people. These worms should bow down in terror before their {mf|master|mistress} and let us through."

78bfaab7-2945-465a-8e1e-50bf7fd282b2.Text: "We shall solve the problems of the common people."

bfa786e2-e3a3-4ebe-b2bd-606a74cbd5dc.Text: "Heinrix, this is a perfect opportunity to make use of your privileged status. After all, you do not wish to suspend your mission for several cycles, do you?"

8ea808be-c518-40ba-a673-92571184fa59.Text: "Sister Argenta, I believe these people have been gripped by despondency. A sermon from one of His daughters could restore to them their determination."

8b243ff7-f775-467c-844e-dd5271e90fae.Text: "Idira, can you use psykana to persuade the petitioners that they must leave the queue?"

899b16c1-aa4a-468b-bc61-980153fc849e.Text: "Yrliet, I need you to serve as a distraction."

ff8faf91-ceef-44a6-816b-78ac1293c776.Text: [Open fire on the crowd] "Why go to any effort when I can simply shoot everyone here?"

421ec26e-0e23-4d21-ad86-146bba5b47ef.Text: "I am sorry about your daughter, but if you do not let me past, tomorrow fifty Dargonian orphans will die!"

3dce6d94-5736-46c9-add7-926b9628cabc.Text: "I do not think your daughter would mind if you let the Rogue Trader go ahead of you."

b6c44d6b-8ddb-4a7f-9891-68699a011fa2.Text: "Why don't I simply pay you and you give me your place in the queue?"

cf7e6198-6d6e-46d9-be6a-8bc993460ca6.Text: "I see. Well, good luck to you and your daughter."

77052eb5-9641-4a5c-a613-1642715e4250.Text: "I have no interest in your little drama. I will sign the paper if you require a sponsor."

53204a3d-0905-4b49-ae46-a5e31e5fb53d.Text: "The lives of commoners hold no value. When you finish university, you will be qualified to save those who are truly worthy."

bb49292b-0603-47b7-87ec-006ea23a5893.Text: "We need to move forward faster. Use your tricks."

d9f31b80-e444-4094-81ac-717f844c0210.Text: "Your sacrifice will mean nothing to a servitor — you do realise that?"

1248faf8-133e-4679-9cb7-fb0bd6913176.Text: "Solomorne, do you think a wanted criminal could blend into this crowd?"

4f6549b1-569d-4e00-9af2-8305c9c46f5e.Text: [Wait patiently] "Gird your faith, sister. For it is only through patience and humility that true wisdom comes."

0da0194f-9918-4588-bc78-fa60940d66a0.Text: "Perhaps I can rebuild this hat shop of yours?"

9c9095ca-d2b5-41fe-82a6-d2cec976aeea.Text: "And what you want is a life that is meaningless and full of despair? Perhaps it is time you turned to faith, sister?"

67482c80-3c07-46b2-9ee7-8f5784cd09a1.Text: "I shall do everything in my power."

bbefac99-af72-4cea-82be-3aac4fccd217.Text: {n}The queue hums with thousands of voices. Someone has rolled out bedding and is settling down to sleep; someone is playing some bizarre musical instrument; many are praying. Several highborn petitioners are debating who is here on the most important business.{/n}

2f32f117-5896-4d39-9075-2be5d4301923.Text: "Throne take me, what torturous trial have we let ourselves in for?" {n}Jae almost wails in despair.{/n} "So much precious time lost, and we've only moved three places ahead! At this rate, we'll be old and grey before we get out of this queue, shereen."

4dea598f-0e64-4ce9-a02c-72c168ae585d.Text: {n}Only now do you notice the tattoo on his right hand: the symbol of the Adeptus Administratum and several interlocking chains. It seems this old fellow is the property of a prefect of this palace.{/n}

691391a8-e5c4-47d1-8623-544549ee0a33.Text: "Humility, acceptance, meekness... Those are the qualities that I entirely lack, shereen." {n}Jae smiles acidly and leaves you alone with your thoughts.{/n}

fff8edb2-e59c-41f3-a604-2de828b7f7bf.Text: "You wound me, shereen! Jae Heydari always has a better idea. What would you say to making the good folk ahead of us hurry up a little? Just a smidge." {n}Her eyes dart playfully over the faces of the people around you.{/n}

a94d2ff4-ec9e-48c2-ad12-ee391da8a53c.Text: "You have to admit, the magnificent administrative machinery of the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g} isn't without its rough edges..." {n}Jae smiles sheepishly, eying the queue.{/n} "But what a thrilling adventure this is turning out to be, shereen! I've never seen anything like it before... And sometimes it's good to take a break from constant travelling. And to give all the hot-blooded newcomers a chance to cover themselves in glory without us in the way."

6063007b-30f1-4879-aa70-97e2685006fa.Text: "And that was the will of the Exalted One, shereen!" {n}Jae throws up her arms and lowers her head.{/n} "And the Exalted One has granted me insight as to how, with a simple wave of your hand and a few wise words, we can ease our arduous wait."

9190032e-49a5-4681-9456-a40740a45057.Text: "Wasting the Inquisition's time on this foolishness, it's simply unthinkable!" {n}Wearied by the long wait, Heinrix is rereading confidential reports on his data-slate for the tenth time.{/n}

f959deaf-f8b4-404d-88f9-b4d349912613.Text: "Unconstructive expenditure of temporal resources recorded. Recommended resolution: return to initial mission."

496478ba-b999-4083-9975-a3b8f4d1f552.Text: {n}The minutes drag by intolerably slowly. Somewhere in the queue, a child is howling at the top of its lungs, the palace adepts are sedately moving documents from one pile to another, shuffling papers. Several petitioners have gathered in a huddle and are swapping rumours, while someone has laid down for a nap on a nearby bench.{/n}

2ca63e97-ba12-440b-a849-f3fa8993bd48.Text: {n}You have whiled away thirty seconds of your wait. You wonder how long you have left to go.{/n}

b35a2a2e-072a-4def-8d60-5c9876a68dca.Text: {n}The people are constantly moving, coming and going, changing places or simply disappearing from view. On your first attempt, you count two hundred and thirty-eight petitioners. On your second attempt, you count two hundred and forty-four. On your third attempt, the next batch of unlucky souls is ushered into the hall, and you lose count.{/n}

60f2790f-b31f-4e80-bf0b-cfb18e45bc21.Text: {n}The young man in worn work overalls comports himself with unusual grace for a commoner.{/n} "My {mf|lord|lady}, I have been in this queue for two dozen moons already, trying to get a permission slip to wed my fiancée Zazi. Unfortunately, the servants of the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusAdministratum}Administratum{/g} refuse to grant it without the signature of a highborn sponsor..."

36d3fcb3-9b49-47bb-86e4-0af73751e3d5.Text: {n}You feel the envious eyes of the other petitioners upon you, but no one dares to do anything more than stare.{/n}

9664ef06-c0fe-4779-bab4-54efd3394a05.Text: "O shereen, my sponsor, my heaven-sent light of hope, my guiding star! Please, do not abandon our mission when we have almost reached our goal!"

0f13d420-f226-40cd-8516-af3ff8e41414.Text: {n}After allowing you a brief pause, a hunched ragamuffin approaches you. The old man's toothless mouth breathes out a putrefying cloud of air as he speaks only three words:{/n} "Death-th-th... f-f-for life..."

10407e91-61d9-4d80-be90-8c6ee096117c.Text: {n}The young man considers this for a few minutes, and then rips up his piece of paper.{/n} "You are right. There is no honour in dragging back trollops and drunks from the edge of death. Or self-indulgent nobles, for that matter." {n}He looks coldly at his mother.{/n} "I was born to save lives. And there is no better place to do that than in the {g|Encyclopedia:AstraMilitarum}Imperial Guard{/g}."

59392acf-3da4-4d3d-88d8-b1a420b9ee09.Text: {n}The young man spends several seconds opening and closing his mouth in shock.{/n} "T-that means... our marriage will finally be certified? And Zazi will be able to become a chirurgeon now too? I don't know how to thank you, my {mf|lord|lady}! H-here, please, take my place. I will return later, this time with my fiancée."

f6a63cba-db01-458d-bb5c-3a71a3a4d83e.Text: "No, Steffo, that's not what I— stop! Please! Think about this!"

73bbe65f-3952-4454-b317-65e31105aba2.Text: {n}The young man blinks in astonishment.{/n} "W-what? Y-yes, of course! That is just what I'll do! Thank you for your generosity, my {mf|lord|lady}! This... this is a miracle!"

0b3cae3f-d1ab-4910-bf17-e44a3702e077.Text: "Ah, if I had known that before, shereen, I would have offered up my pleas for your delectation every day!"

19b3ebc0-75c6-4ba4-8c42-0d8cbc740f4b.Text: "Definitely not! I'll gather my things and depart with you this instant..."

ce33d283-a3bb-4626-b055-bcfdae1d3034.Text: "For the great dynasty von Valancius!" {n}Jae echoes your words and sighs in relief.{/n}

fed6c4c7-8739-4d6d-8972-4a6a03210d39.Text: {n}Jae surveys the queue sadly.{/n} "Do you think the next time will be better?"

76310618-9acb-474c-aecc-e8518de28795.Text: "Oh, thank you, shereen! And we only have... a short while left to wait."

0a1da006-f40e-4ae8-89e6-6262e5a7d2b4.Text: "Shereen... You're a saint, have I told you that before? You must be, because I don't see any other reason why you would show such fervent but senseless patience. Can't we hurry things along?"

a6aac243-303d-4801-9897-03a6e9d1e171.Text: "The simplest way is to make these lowly subjects bow down before the blinding radiance of our title, shereen. The second option requires a little more... patience. I have already found our first vict— ah, the compassionate citizen who is standing fifty places ahead of us in the queue. Simply offer the right words to unlock his heart and he will gladly swap tickets with you. And also... you have the power to solve the problems of some petitioners, removing their need to visit a coveted window. After all, is there anything an ordinary citizen could want that is beyond the power of the conqueror of the stars to grant?"

2ba543c4-dda1-4606-acad-e6e2e63697aa.Text: {n}The man covers his face with his hands and shakes with soundless sobs.{/n} "Past t-t-time."

ad802c15-5123-4708-ab2b-b83277cc411d.Text: "I'll be honest, shereen, I already tried to convince Heinrix to use his Interrogator's rosette, with sweet words and pretty songs I cajoled and wheedled. But he... remains unmoved, like a rock whipped by the winds. Perhaps he will be more amenable to a request from you?"

72b1d226-f7f7-48d5-aa54-419b02ef3b91.Text: "Sister Argenta, for instance..." {n}Jae's voice becomes noticeably warmer.{/n} "She could engage the people in a prayer or tell a story about some saint or other in exchange for their queue tickets."

f407c807-e9a6-46de-b65d-84a29cbee65e.Text: "You could also ask Idira to use her talent... On second thought, no, that could be more disastrous than a suddenly erupting volcano, shereen. Forget it."

2556dfce-2a83-46f8-85e5-fe96ff8e6527.Text: "The people will be amazed if you show them your tamed xenos! They'll drop everything they're holding — including their tickets — and come to goggle at her, I guarantee it."

8cc852cc-32ef-4d42-a183-15488790bf8e.Text: "I suppose it will... for a while."

22f2f0bf-e576-4cbe-8234-6b17bc2434b5.Text: "No, no, no! Why ever would you— no more husbands or wives! I am too old for all of that. All I want is to enjoy the last years of my life."

1d665cca-2e38-442f-99fd-95fd6b442896.Text: "Well, that was... amusing. I paid off the last few onlookers who were willing to give up their place. It's a pity they aren't all so amenable."

e9cfa978-babf-49b2-aa0f-8f89d9db1934.Text: {n}The woman's beleaguered eyes sparkle to life.{/n} "Why, that's a wonderful idea! Please, take my place in the queue here, I insist. I will leave my details with your retinue and go!"

a017b7c8-2270-45ae-98d6-def2f71cfaba.Text: {n}The woman's eyes go round in surprise.{/n} "Why, I think you're right! What do I want with a tumbledown manor house full of rats? And a depressing view from the window? My whole life I have dreamt of interplanetary travel. A pilgrimage, that's it! I'll sell the house and what's left of the shop, and I'll buy a one-way ticket. And, Emperor willing, I will die happy before my savings run out!"

e40e98d7-64bd-46df-a380-d8d931fa0f42.Text: {n}The man starts in surprise.{/n} "Eh? Yes, yes, light of the {g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Throne{/g} bless you! My name is Menas. Menas de Pyrr. I have been here a month already. I've tried everything I can to get through to that window. Nothing working. My poor, poor Ilena. She's my daughter, my flesh and blood. They detained her on Vheabos VI. Charged her — can you believe it? The charges were false! That's how our Administratum operates." {n}Menas covers his mouth and glances around fearfully.{/n}

c4dc72a2-374e-47be-bab5-5ea66de4b6ee.Text: {n}An excited murmur rises up from the crowd.{/n} "Blessed be {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship} the Rogue Trader and the entire von Valancius line! Of course we lowly subjects will bow our heads in reverence before our great sovereign and will serve {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship} however {mf|he|she} requires. For we find our purpose only through service to {mf|him|her}."

9681225a-35e2-4d92-b936-239672081626.Text: "Who do you think you're kidding? What would {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship} be doing here? What would one of the God-Emperor's anointed need from ordinary mortals, and in a palace of the law to boot? Queue like everybody else, {mf|Master|Mistress} Moneybags, and do not disgrace the Rogue Trader's name again!"

517ee2ae-b5be-44d5-b275-28705017d310.Text: "How ironic... They spend all their lives fearing and revering someone they will never see, and when they do meet {mf|him|her}, they do not recognise {mf|him|her}."

31d81e0f-5abd-4a6f-be3a-15c4e397c29e.Text: "Look at this, shereen!" {n}Jae is waving her hand in the air, clutching a dozen queue tickets.{/n} "It went just as I expected. Well... almost."

f08c075b-7ee0-4b02-8006-6d140b09cff1.Text: "You do not need to tell me twice, shereen. All is fair in love and bureaucracy..."

2fcec584-ae1a-470d-a50b-fb65aefb180e.Text: {n}Menas's fleshy face tenses at your words.{/n} "B-but, well... The time! And I've been... Oh, of course. Of course, it would be an honour for the de Pyrr family. Please, go ahead, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"

320c9105-c8a2-4a14-9583-478661edf7aa.Text: "I doubt the Exalted One will be much help to us if we're going to change tack like that without warning, shereen. We're not going to get any ticket now — at least, not using these methods. I can sniff out an easy mark a mile away — and in this hall there was only one."

749b3d8b-4883-423d-8a8f-254a80f6627f.Text: {n}Jae inspects the tickets she now holds and nods with satisfaction.{/n}

db54c549-48ac-43f6-913c-182a364b969b.Text: "Not as smoothly done as it could have been... But you certainly have a style all your own, shereen! What now?"

40e91d8b-06dc-41f3-a5b5-bfe1179cb31d.Text: "Thank you, thank you! And may the Emperor aid you in your petition as well!"

fb70bcdd-707e-4c24-8ecc-9e09b4e8058c.Text: "You were thinking about it as well?" {n}Argenta's gaze is as clear as the midday sky.{/n} "Words of faith can heal any wound, even those that bleed naught but doubt. I will help these people."

99e00d7a-57c2-4db4-ae45-8ecee2b29725.Text: "A wise decision, shereen! Cold Traders always say: if you can solve a problem with hard cash, then that's just the cost of doing business!"

5a14caff-d240-41ea-a40c-612fdbdc7c28.Text: {n}Jae catches your eye and lays her hand on the shoulder of a weary-looking man.{/n} "May the Emperor illuminate your path, brother! I am Jae, and this is {name}. We've been in the queue so long already, we're all practically family now — won't you tell us what brought you to the palace of order?"

860f6a25-d2c0-464b-aaf8-eb8c5661b5bc.Text: {n}Casting his eyes over the waiting hall, Heinrix heaves a resigned sigh.{/n} "It would be unpardonable to waste so much time here."

6df0edda-007e-4346-968d-08f4adc9a3bf.Text: {n}A cold smile touches the Interrogator's lips.{/n} "If the Rogue Trader wishes to spend {mf|his|her} time helping someone whose every act is a challenge to the Imperium's will in this part of the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Expanse{/g}... I can only conclude that we are not anxious to be anywhere else. And so I have no reason to resort to similar acts, thereby sullying the sacred symbols of the Inquisition."

fb46a080-871e-4535-be8c-b13da205b2f4.Text: "Of course, Lord Captain! Let's go for a poke around in those empty little heads..."

08468ec9-9ff2-4db2-be88-027561cea347.Text: {n}The {g|Encyclopedia:Aeldari}Aeldari{/g}'s clear gaze surveys the crowd.{/n} "Elantach, I will do this, but only because you helped me to leave Janus. If any mon-keigh tries to touch me, I will end them as ruthlessly as one uproots a weed."

578f38b0-e608-4e97-8d42-0f4847526909.Text: "I heard your conversation with the ransacker of the sacred places of my ancestors. My answer is no. I will not help her, not as long as the stars overhead still glitter, and not before the sky above becomes the land underneath my feet."

c49be8ca-d2c8-4d62-9989-1a03e375c9f6.Text: "You have an interesting way of doing business, shereen. I'll keep that in mind." {n}Jae's shrewd eyes are alight with interest as she watches the young petitioner leave.{/n}

e2b718f1-d26e-42d3-8de4-bcb45895985b.Text: {n}The next eight hours pass surprisingly peacefully — nothing unusual happens, all the certification officers are at their windows and are accepting petitioners, and you have even started growing accustomed to the sounds and smells of this place.{/n}

2ee736c1-a786-4ced-aa12-0b2e97d4540a.Text: {n}You greeted the dusk and dawn from your place in the queue, observing the shifting rays of the Mundis Valancius through the windows of the palace. The night passed peacefully — the certification officers left for their beds and servitors took their place. Unfortunately, servitors cannot process all petitioner requests, so at night the queue moved even more slowly.{/n}

e8cd8d68-8947-40ce-a053-4ad6533f3108.Text: "Interesting... So that is how the ruler of worlds and all the stars in the sky acts when {mf|he|she} finds an unfortunate on the edge of {mf|his|her} magnificent orbit." {n}Jae nods pensively and beckons the next petitioner forward.{/n}

e27844be-ef42-4ff1-a1df-0b56732749d8.Text: {n}Today the entire capital is celebrating the birthday of your ancestor — Miltiades Orest Theon von Valancius, who discovered and colonised Kiava Gamma. In every hive on Dargonus, prayer services are being held in his honour, nobles and commoners are attending fairs with amusements, and Governor Drivestem himself is giving his annual speech from the main spire of his palace. Most of the Administratum servants have joined the festivities, so today all of the windows are being served by only one certification officer.{/n}

f5d55b8e-200f-4ec7-ae13-88cd5fbbf466.Text: {n}Jae sighs dejectedly.{/n} "Fiiine. Let's try something else, shall we, shereen?"

2ce02a38-9c84-41f1-bb0f-95076dacfa7b.Text: "I know what you are suggesting. Are you using faith as a shield to hide your lack of restraint? Forgive me, but the Palace of the Adeptus Administratum is a place of quiet contemplation... and submission. And I will not disturb the peace of the servants of the Lex Imperialis."

409ed00d-6275-4475-a6d2-7b67a032a611.Text: "Zazi is a healer too! And she helps the people of the hive a great deal more than any lily-white chirurgeon with a diploma! I do not want to live a life of idleness in the spires of Dargonus like you, not when I know there are thousands of unfortunate people in the lower levels who need my help!"

33aafd95-332e-42cf-9e2e-960e84abe210.Text: "Thank you, my {mf|lord|lady}! I promise I will tell my children and my children's children of your kindness!"

1bd166a9-5982-44bc-beba-92b773c7735c.Text: "As they say on Efreet: 'There is no star more coveted than that which points to the Exalted One!" {n}Jae casts a sidelong glance at the Sister of Battle as the latter holds out several numbered tickets to you.{/n}

aaa4c2a4-871e-40b4-b33c-24e5eee17e57.Text: "Actually..." {n}After catching your eye, Jae purrs surreptitiously as she glances at Kibellah,{/n} "Shereen, if you were to tell your pet assassin to put on a little show in this room right now... I bet the queue would get a lot shorter."

7688ae3f-6baa-4e5b-a963-1a7d27f25f7f.Text: "To defile one of the Bloodspun Web's sacraments by dedicating it to your avarice? Think again, blasphemer."

d27c9784-0402-42b7-bf4a-9bf0d784b645.Text: {n}Solomorne stands impassively like a stone column amidst the throng of lowly petitioners, unmoving except for his eyes, which sweep the perimeter like a guard-visor.{/n}

84680e57-b261-49b7-a316-15b83ac65315.Text: "Hem-ahem. Attention, all! Before you is {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship} {name} von Valancius, Rogue Trader and anointed sovereign of this world! Bow your unworthy heads and give your {mf|master|mistress} {mf|his|her} rightful place in the queue!"

5f2e2346-ad87-405b-b021-3151e217348e.Text: {n}Jae peers over the man's shoulder to read his crumpled form.{/n} "You... are here to request mortification, so that your organs go to your granddaughter as an inheritance? She will hardly want your worn-out body parts, old-timer..."

5adffd2c-7a38-468c-8c83-ce69800311ce.Text: {n}The ragged man shakes his head and covers his face with his wrinkled hands.{/n} "S-s-servitor... Disp-po-posal!"

4e1ea269-950e-4ba6-84ca-9877425af502.Text: {n}Jae looks at the man's form again... and rears back in horror.{/n} "The granddaughter of this poor wretch was turned into a servitor sixteen Dargonus years ago! And after a recent accident, she was listed for disposal. And now this old man is volunteering to be spare parts for a soulless tin can... May the Exalted One keep me from such a fate."

fc14552f-c4ab-4b90-84b8-b14b6f9b833e.Text: "As you wish, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}," {n}Jae says in a deliberately deferential tone and makes her way to the centre of the room.{/n}

aac19445-bc68-48cf-b9d2-c99854ab7987.Text: {n}In the last eight hours, the only thing that has changed in the waiting hall is the warden shift. The petitioners in the queue placidly await the blessed hour when their appeal will be heard by the high-ranking servants of the Imperium. The entire queue perks up at a sudden announcement:{/n} "Number 285, proceed to the available window."

3ead8f05-a852-4037-8729-ddf81748ff50.Text: "I will pray to the Emperor in the hope that you will reconsider, shereen!"

4a3c5fa2-19db-4006-adcd-56b0e7b295eb.Text: "We've got a servant of the Lex Imperialis on our team, and with a formidable dog to boot! Though the Proctor could probably just stare at the queue, and it would move right aside."

b8fe0928-38a1-46c9-9b99-3f9de0673bc6.Text: "Lord Captain, this place is so dull there's not even any knocking on the other side of the door — all the whispers died down when they realised nothing interesting was going to happen! Can't we go back to the ship?"

d6b9b19e-1562-4ab3-8c49-827039916eba.Text: {n}The old man's withered lips curve in the semblance of a smile.{/n} "M-m-may the Emperor k-keep you!"

c205576a-3b41-4a1c-a59b-74e29e62ecf0.Text: {n}A mature woman in a finely made but threadbare dress greets you.{/n} "I heard you were helping those in need. Well, my family... it's devastated! My life's work, oh, my shop selling rare hats, burnt to ashes! I am living out my last years as a widow. Alone, in a cold, deserted manor, without servants, diversions, or delicacies befitting my status." {n}The woman falls silent, her brow raised in expectation of your response.{/n}
