c37f5694-d0c2-4bf8-a88e-e56871d6a400.Text: {n}The old man's toothless mouth opens in pain, seemingly splitting his face in two, and his salty tears well in his time-worn eyes.{/n}

75a21482-84fb-4614-8e6b-0cf41b116249.Text: {n}The old man nods in understanding.{/n} "Yes... I underst-stand... Emperor w-watch over you!"

74904c4e-086e-42dd-9dc6-419a4e982f8e.Text: "Of course, shereen. Our number in the queue is..." {n}Jae checks the ticket.{/n} "O, Exalted One, I wish I hadn't looked. We are definitely not going anywhere soon, shereen. You need to make a decision."

b03455f1-a833-4a81-9b07-d79c0accdf02.Text: "I'd prefer to call it my wisdom learned through many years' experience... But I don't care about the precise wording just now. How do you wish to proceed, shereen?"

cf870255-e434-4e1c-94e3-7bd9e9e39e02.Text: {n}Jae gives you a conspiratorial wink and backs away slightly.{/n} "O Exalted One, could today be my lucky day? No longer will I have to stand in this hall, waiting day and night for my turn to come, for this kind {mf|lord|lady} of House von Valancius is a benefactor of the downtrodden, and {mf|he|she} has solved my problem!"

25f06a22-f316-4e06-8bc4-ec326358f80d.Text: {n}Another eight planetary hours go by. The queue has hardly moved — the adept in the next window was dealing with rebelling {g|Encyclopedia:MachineSpirit}machine spirits{/g} in his {g|Encyclopedia:Cogitator}cogitator{/g}, so the petitioners from that queue were diverted to the middle of yours.{/n}

52a72bba-591b-4740-8137-a6d0837be534.Text: "Well, shereen, maybe this time you will lose patience with being patient and decide to move things along a teensy bit faster?"

9321cdf3-dff2-40a6-b943-4c3ea2234776.Text: "This accursed place again. I stood in this queue when I was planning to marry. I stood in it when every son and every daughter was born, so that their names would be entered in the chronicle of Dargonus. And when my dear wife departed this mortal world, I waited again." {n}Abelard sighs dejectedly.{/n}

bacd1178-e8b0-4615-8913-1bd07b326c89.Text: "The Archenemy is plotting against His servants throughout the Expanse, and we are forced to wait here for a piece of paper to be certified!" {n}Argenta tosses a furious look at Jae.{/n} "And not for the good of the Imperium, no, but to satisfy the whim of a heretic!"

b1ed2e6e-ee31-4816-81ba-81821a206c6e.Text: "Oh, Lord Captain, this place teems with hideous stains of washed-out colours! It makes my head spin..." {n}Cassia covers her eyes with a thick shawl.{/n} "The Palace of the Adeptus Administratum has proved to be just as depressing as the published works of its servants."

a0a6155e-80c3-413c-aac6-a78efe4d7e40.Text: "These were given to me in thanks by the poor souls who decided to abandon their vigil in this palace of the law and return to their worldly matters."

86d76842-9d27-408d-8648-4f38a3f940f3.Text: "Unlikely. In the time we've been standing here, I've assessed every individual in the queue. Then again, one can never be too vigilant — as an Arbitrator, I can perform an unscheduled check of identity documents. At least some good can come out of being stuck here."

2f2b3798-73e6-4660-895f-6afbb01f4cf8.Text: "I've said too much. I do apologise — it's my nerves. My nerves. I just keep thinking about her there on Vheabos, shackled down in the mines. My poor, poor Ilena! As delicate as a flower, she is. She's got weak lungs, you understand? Always coughing. And her now down the mines? All that dust and muck? She won't cope with it, she won't! She was acquitted two years ago. But to get the papers certified, and the seal? So much time has passed... And now here I am, standing, waiting. It doesn't matter. At the rate this queue's moving, it'll be ten cycles or more before our numbers come up."

6dcce34d-86f2-4a73-a1d8-a460f93d9293.Text: {n}Cowering in fear under his shaking arms, the old man rushes out of the hall.{/n}

c43b6def-b5ad-4362-abb3-fefae909b0d5.Text: "We do not need everything, poor wretch. Only your place in the queue."

30f848d2-47c3-498d-a2ed-88bea04876a0.Text: "And here we are again, shereen. I think I saw these same glum faces the last time... No. These are new glum faces." {n}Jae sighs dramatically.{/n}

23f08353-232e-49b7-a010-296fcf6e209b.Text: "This time, I will not allow you to spend one second longer here than absolutely necessary, shereen! No more being patient! No more playing by the rules! Today we are going to make it to that Throne-cursed window and we're going to get the Mercatum Tabula Officiale!" {n}With a pointed smile, Jae glances at you, awaiting your response.{/n}

f51ca732-358d-441e-bf8d-37550ed391d1.Text: "Here, is this what you were so desperate to obtain?" {n}Heinrix holds out three queue tickets dropped by petitioners fleeing the very sight of the Interrogator.{/n} "Do not ask me to resort to such tricks again."{g|Encyclopedia:Inquisition}{/g}

8a2ff5f2-35c3-4d1f-bc4a-cbc65157baec.Text: "Sorry, Lord Captain. Things didn't exactly go to plan..." {n}Idira holds up her hands sheepishly.{/n}

ec8977b7-5270-4eb9-9cd0-ab5f687d1a7d.Text: "Falsely accused, falsely accused! She was slandered! They said she deliberately poisoned a whole room of highborn folk. With cakes! Have you ever heard the like of it? These nobles didn't even make as far as the privy! Panic! Outrage! Scandal! And so what? It was their own fault, that's what! A crate of 'Fine Calixian Wine' was found. Ha! And the smugglers were found too. And what did the smugglers do? They framed someone else. And my daughter was charged!"

8ff425f9-11f4-47af-b139-a3b4772e74f3.Text: "Not at all, light of my soul! You have done exceptionally well as always — the dead do not need tickets, do they?" {n}Jae triumphantly brandishes the newly acquired tickets and winks at the psyker.{/n}

1c6c1412-ac06-473e-bc63-7754de64773f.Text: "You... What?" {n}The man hesitates.{/n} "D-deal! Of course I'll give you my place! My poor, poor Ilena! Delicate little flower! We'll need money. Yeah. For her recuperation."

993debc7-a8b4-4c0d-9994-2ffffc7a42d4.Text: "Such humiliation for a Child of Asuryan, to be nothing but a beast for mon-keigh to gawp at."

3b4c9cd0-0b03-4e09-a88d-cb05c4dca8a6.Text: "Esteemed {mf|lord|lady}, take pity on this poor youth as well! I will give you everything I have, I swear before the Emperor! Only help me solve my problem."

6f63132c-6a8a-406c-9ded-0b201682fb2a.Text: {n}Menas's eyes go wide and despair dawns on his face.{/n} "B-but how? But what about Ilena... And the poor orphans. Just awful, awful! Of course you can go ahead of me. P-please, take my ticket. My Ilena's a fragile girl, but she loves children. She would want me to help!"

811b3865-5336-4c97-a793-ad4c94110783.Text: "Look at it this way, my pointy-eared and elegant xenofriend — you have gained more intimate knowledge of the Imperium's culture. And I have got us a ticket that puts us a few places ahead in the queue. I didn't steal it! I simply... swapped it with ours when no one was looking."

03f3a2bd-660e-4780-9604-a28899a97a89.Text: "Didn't I tell you? One little sob story and we're already one step closer to our goal. Although, there are faster methods of doing that."

6ae128a5-e3bc-4361-83fb-00c8283943b9.Text: "No Lex Imperialis violations detected." {n}Solomorne falls silent and turns to stone again, ready to wait until the end of time.{/n}

e73a8296-7e67-468b-9d27-5d091b83b776.Text: "If these ashmags want to be tricked, I won't stop them." {n}Jae smugly watches the agitated crowd, whispering among themselves and jabbing each other with sheaves of paper.{/n}

91520253-755f-4c31-8350-d4237ee4a916.Text: "I can positively identify one criminal — the one who dragged us here." {n}Solomorne nods toward Jae.{/n} "Your companion would do well to learn the value of order and humility — I will not be violating the sacred regulations of the Administratum for her."

789b7f36-a000-4aa7-a76c-800a18b7b7be.Text: "But I did sniff out a few especially antsy petitioners — all I had to do was drop a vague hint that Master Proctor was here for them and I was immediately showered with thanks for the timely warning!" {n}Jae triumphantly shows off her ill-gotten tickets.{/n}

0f522199-964c-44a0-90a0-f191fd50d3c1.Text: "Sister Argenta, your words cut more deeply than a chainsword!"

5a4a17f1-795f-4f1d-85b9-4d7f30685646.Text: "And here we are again, shereen. I think I saw these same glum faces the last time... No. These are new glum faces." {n}Jae sighs dramatically.{/n}

cda562bb-9b21-49fa-bdb7-5289f26219f6.Text: "Out of my way!" {n}Elbowing aside onlookers left and right, a richly dressed lady with a beauty mark augment above her lip charges toward you.{/n} "Esteemed {mf|lord|lady}, my eighth offspring has lost his mind! He has decided to renounce his family, his noble title, and his talent as a healer, all for the sake of some tattered waif from the middle levels! A union with a commoner will put an end to his studies at the university — but should Dargonus and the Officio Medicae be deprived of a capable chirurgeon because of a passing fancy?"

48cd373f-1e78-4724-9c93-3ee1530fce2e.Text: {n}The old man resembles a dried fruit, mottled and wizened. A worn wooden Aquila on his chest peeks out from under his tattered shirt, and his withered, shaking fingers are constantly checking that his precious paper has not slipped from his grasp.{/n}

5a5aab9b-de3c-4195-8ce2-d634a5d43e73.Text: "Y-yes, of course, I humbly beg your forgiveness, my {mf|lord|lady}."

f14d6000-4cd9-4d0c-8e9f-660a22d3c345.Text: {n}The hum of activity returns to the queue. Petitioners exchange glances, clutching their paperwork. After a few seconds, you realise that the number being called out by the servo-skull for the third time is the one on your ticket.{/n}

a0ed1a79-9258-4ec9-86c9-e834f11013b8.Text: "What are you waiting for, shereen? Let's go. We have another couple of hours with the certification officer to get through."

384e54e5-4e9a-488f-b88c-d3affaa19a88.Text: "O, Exalted One, thank you for granting the Rogue Trader {mf|his|her} sacred Warrant and all its privileges! If we had had to wait a minute longer, heaven be my witness, I would have shot someone!"

60c6d593-c5df-4295-af00-dbd50b97caa7.Text: {n}Jae's eyes are sunken from lack of sleep, amasec, and exhaustion. Her hair is dishevelled, and her fine clothing is so rumpled one would think she had been brawling.{/n} "We've... really made it? I swear on the Throne, patience is the path to madness. I don't know how the saints live through their torments without amasec..."

94412803-c3ce-42ad-82ef-6cc9a28a2680.Text: "Well... That went faster than I expected. We had a little bit of a wait, of course, but at times it was actually fun." {n}Jae smiles wearily.{/n} "One last seal. One more certification and... you will be looking at Official Trade Representative Jae Heydari!"

bf5072dc-7f35-47bc-ae01-faf9931b7e99.Text: "Do you know what gets better with time, shereen? {g|Encyclopedia:Amasec}Amasec{/g} and lovemaking. Remind me of that if I ever ask you to stand in a queue again."

f61d1e3a-3404-45bd-92ef-c5bc34498715.Text: "We've moved forward considerably in the queue, shereen! But you aren't ready to stop there, are you?"

9fd8a5c2-dfb8-4c82-8bd2-9fe2393d8bcf.Text: "The document is hereby certified," {n}says the rasping voice through the metal jaw with its integrated vox.{/n} "Return to the Master of Seals in order to proceed. And may His light and wisdom guard you. Next!"

d53fdeb0-cd04-431d-9e45-55ded78f7489.Text: "Your words are music to my ears, shereen. But which option do you prefer?"

dcfd637e-9e25-4ca3-9a4a-a3d999d4c725.Text: "Certify this damned scrap of paper immediately or lose your head."

c9833c09-2505-4e3b-839f-c8405ae77dba.Text: "Would you be so obliging as to certify this document?"

3ea436bd-0695-4c5b-a41a-a73afd6d90b5.Text: [Throw the paper in the officer's face] "Take care of that."

d62d0c24-e683-4a70-81ac-d70f1b550bd3.Text: [Kill the certification officer and place the seal yourself] "I will kill you, you paper-pushing vermin!"

9267287d-0013-4430-8392-cb4581461427.Text: "If that is what the law of the Imperium requires, then that is what we shall do."

f5eb281a-dd85-410e-80ab-b2543848c0cf.Text: "How much are three hours forty-eight seconds of your life worth, servant?"

675fda35-4efc-46e4-9f54-a94d1bfe76d4.Text: [Write out a letter of payment for ten times the officer's salary]

d6856015-cd3a-4bcc-929b-1b8f348ec590.Text: [Destroy the waiting hall and place the seal yourself] "I've had enough of all of you!"

df34ca1f-88bd-404a-8adf-d0b0e481d0ea.Text: "I stood in that damned queue for nearly three turns, without sleep or amenities. Either you certify this document, or, I swear to the Emperor, I will kill you!"

305397cf-64e6-4c3b-bc54-4f26a2758f5a.Text: {n}Two gleaming ocular lenses peer at you from beneath the shaking counter.{/n} "W-what is it y-you wanted, {mf|master|mistress}?"

becf0d93-f79b-47ff-95ef-60c965cb12b3.Text: "I'm afraid that..." {n}comes the rasping voice from the metal jaws with integrated {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g},{/n} "...the validity period for certifying one of your seals expired three hours and forty-eight seconds ago. You must request a blank form from the Master of Seals and have both seals placed again. After that, you may return here and wait in the queue for your turn to be seen."

6774b261-c209-4df7-b13f-8b0c67f6d4b7.Text: {n}Jae leans over the quivering Administratum officer and nods sympathetically.{/n} "I know, my good man, you have had a lot to deal with today. But here's the thing... My companion, your {mf|master|mistress} in here on business of Imperial importance. As you may have noticed, {mf|he|she} is not the most patient of people. And {mf|he|she} does not want to waste another minute of {mf|his|her} time. So, my esteemed adept, could you please process our petition without delay? And then we will leave you in peace."

01915f6a-edab-4fe7-820e-81d5db376ec9.Text: "Y-yes, I d-do apologise for the inconvenience. It will be done now! J-just don't kill me!"

d02c6388-9fc7-405e-8a6e-5c2d4b6fd2fd.Text: "O-of course..." {n}The officer glances in horror at the bodies behind you.{/n}

a170b9be-03ef-4df7-87fb-6f32b0c94aa3.Text: {n}Without further ado, the certification officer picks up the document and begins feverishly filling in numerous forms. His augmented ocular eyes whirr as the lenses zoom in and out. With quiet scratching sounds, the cogita-quills that serve in place of the adept's fingers make notes on a fine sheet of paper.{/n}

b6db2d61-7d38-4380-b5a7-670fbec91b55.Text: "I'm sorry, but that is impossible. The validity period has—"

49093342-2bb7-4d79-bccf-e6ef2d18c413.Text: "You'll shut up if you know what's good for you, servant of the law. Just shut up."

aee13bce-752d-45ff-a756-9059777dfac4.Text: "But, shereen... He's saying we need to go back to Janus, then back here, then back to..." {n}Jae's shoulders slump.{/n} "Why do I sense that you are going to do something very bad to me as soon as we leave the Administratum Palace?"

fccd3fee-1194-427c-8a69-a8dde3cdae02.Text: {n}The augmented ocular lenses stop moving, and the cogita-fingers sharply cease scratching out gnarled letters.{/n} "Ten times my salary."

38d75576-0d8f-486c-a723-50391064ad18.Text: "In the law, we find His power. In the law, we find His truth. In humility, we find His generosity. And may His wisdom come to those who truly believe."

919f7582-a679-4880-a2d2-27a34114822e.Text: {n}The mechanical ocular lenses hum in pleasure at the sight of the von Valancius seal on the document.{/n}

b7e0e449-c789-4844-aac6-3f76212e272d.Text: "Ah, you again. Come forward." {n}The man makes several notes in the weighty ledger in front of him, then takes your new document and peers at it, adjusting the lenses of his ocular eyes. The cogita-quills, which the officer has instead of fingers, make notes on a fine sheet of paper with a quiet scratching sound.{/n}

80cde214-24b5-4309-bad7-1411df80a536.Text: "H-here, please, t-take it, {mf|master|mistress}. Return to the Master of Seals in order to p-proceed. And may His light and w-wisdom guard you!"

aa43db96-84d9-43b3-a7aa-39b5f60e1ded.Text: {n}Madness glimmers in Jae's eyes as she stares at the bureaucrat and her hand reaches for the knife at her belt.{/n}

e9df8fef-3f61-4e2e-9b63-396fd8863f46.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!" {n}The certification officer makes the sign of the Aquila.{/n} "It is an honour to serve the Rogue Trader. Please, allow me to look at your document."

04f95e82-ef7a-40f3-a6a7-97981b39fc9a.Text: "O, Exalted One, Master of Mankind and Galactic Sovereign, please, be merciful..." {n}Jae grips her Aquila medallion in her hands and whispers her idiosyncratic prayer with surprising sincerity.{/n}

1bebfd4f-4460-4914-84f5-b76e246a90d7.Text: {n}The certification officer leans over the document, his smoothly shaven head gleaming. His {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}augmented{/g} ocular eyes whirr as the lenses zoom in and out. With quiet scratching sounds, the cogita-quills that serve in place of the officer's fingers make notes on a fine sheet of paper.{/n}

1021a6ea-88c6-4ac1-a2ef-da4c41e9ee54.Text: "It's nice to do business with somebody who knows what they want. I'll take the certificate, if you don't mind? And there's something for you too in the room behind you."

9caed22f-a3e1-48d9-a955-d0cb2ec9554b.Text: "Here's your favour, Falco: take this rabble and get out."

0cdd3d24-4cb1-4713-a913-0898acb8a954.Text: "Take your piece of paper, Falco, and never forget what you have promised me."

8a131ab9-0cb5-425f-bfed-2a85fafcb773.Text: "I am not here for underhanded dealings. You will not escape punishment for what you have done."

1569d367-acf1-4296-95fc-8acec48094b3.Text: [Attack] "What makes you think only one Cold Trader will die here today?"

af684f66-c8c6-4db9-994b-806629d30094.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} is full of surprises." {n}Falco can barely contain a smirk as he nods toward Jae's body.{/n} "Let's skip the prelude — your time is too valuable, and I dare not waste it any more than necessary. You know why I am here: the Mercatum. Tabula. Officiale."

8e8db49f-c734-4fe4-b80a-8b8573112b86.Text: "By the Undying Emperor, your papers are more lethal than a thousand blades. Were the spinners to arm themselves with quills, the Expanse would drown in blood."

586c7b05-5213-42b5-bf87-cf89d92becb3.Text: "Never, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. You have my word as a trade representative of the Imperium." {n}With a brief gesture, the former privateer directs his gang to the exit.{/n} "Consider my eternal gratitude already in your pocket."

db18f879-c821-44a2-97eb-0e11e538880f.Text: "I'm afraid I must reject your offer, Rogue Trader. I'll have to deal with this the old-fashioned way."

8fe2c9af-8bfb-4dff-9840-acd8232a2bff.Text: {n}Falco nods in understanding.{/n} "Fair enough. Then this will be our last hurrah, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"

d38913b4-7304-4794-bc38-b91f49c23748.Text: "How much trouble one piece of paper can bring. And how many opportunities. {n}The eyes of the Cold Trader glint greedily.{/n} "Consider it a favour, a whim, or a risky investment — I'm no fool, my life is not worth a throne to you. But I'll give you everything I have now. And if fortune kisses me on the lips... Well. I've been called many things, but an ingrate? Never."

22d41855-f74f-4db5-8638-96771ffda5a8.Text: {n}Falco stares at you for half a minute, then raises his hands in a conciliatory gesture.{/n} "Better to be a living privateer than a dead wannabe trade representative. I thank you for this small mercy, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, and may the stars favour you."

78802ec4-fac5-43cb-a26c-56be764a5ffd.Text: "You have done all the dirty work for me, Falco. There is just one last loose end — kill Jae and we shall part as friends."

eb9d808d-27b6-4933-ae71-39b7aa45978a.Text: "Prepare yourself, Falco. You are going to be punished to the fullest extent of Imperial law."

a6a25954-62dc-469e-a588-a34198150eac.Text: "Well, well, what has fate loosed upon us at this late Footfall hour?" {n}A repulsive face emerges from the gloom, bisected by an old scar and with the left eye screwed up in a permanent squint. His oily hair has been scraped back flat to his head, and the swollen veins at his temples look like pulsating knots of worms.{/n}

b454f38a-fa12-4bae-a58f-8ebb3925efb0.Text: "Fate is for lawmen and drunkards, Falco." {n}Jae spits out in the direction of the twisted face, trying to maintain her composure. But she cannot keep her eyes from straying to the faces of her beaten associates.{/n} "But we've come here under our own steam, and you know why. Take your hands off the rifle and release my people!"

59f11823-11d5-4d8b-a896-e27bc2b07352.Text: {n}The Cold Trader seems deaf to your words of comfort. Her eyes are bereft, and yet at the same time, filled with rage.{/n}

7cbd1d5a-5b3d-4c56-9021-aa577efa870d.Text: {n}Idira shakes her head despondently — she must already know how this scene is going to end.{/n} "Don't look, Jae... Don't look..."

29dfdbaa-fb47-4a07-b41a-4aa99b6ecc29.Text: "Ooh, think you're going to take me alive, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}?" {n}A ragged snarl of a smile splits the Cold Trader's face, and he laughs nastily.{/n} "I'd like to see you try!"

9332f8c8-68ab-403b-b9aa-1f55171d57fd.Text: "What? No! He's going to die here, like the filthy cur that he is! It's what he deserves!" {n}Jae pulls out her weapon and levels it at Falco.{/n}

2a83847e-81bc-4000-af06-375e7f0cf153.Text: "I regret nothing, Your {mf|Lordliness|Ladyness}. My fate was sealed the second you landed on Footfall."

36737de0-9a30-4aed-965a-bdcbeebe4762.Text: {n}Without a moment's hesitation, Falco gives the signal to his associates.{/n}

ae3a90a5-c378-44fc-a886-1176ec314294.Text: {n}The smuggler's face seems to cleave in two as he opens his mouth in a twisted snarl.{/n} "I knew it, even with your pack of whelps on the line, I knew you'd pull something like this, Heydari! You show up here with {mf|him|her}?" {n}Falco points at you.{/n} "We both know how this is going to end now."

54485b70-4f83-4465-b626-e1bb19adc4c1.Text: "Jeh! Geb oubba here! He wonb web you go!" {n}The bruised and bloodied face with swollen eyes is hard to recognise as the once radiant visage of Torra the twin.{/n} "Jeh, puhease..."

4f5574d9-4b88-40b2-ab3e-901a654b7390.Text: "The vileness shows its face at last... It is time we rid Footfall of yet another lump of filth."

e0aa4a08-1f29-40be-a9fc-0fded1b450ec.Text: "Too many times have I watched heretics resort to some low act right before their sentence was delivered. Brace yourself, peddler."

bca89e4d-9bff-4c7f-8b20-f121fa08d86c.Text: "Do what you want, but make it quick. The sewer stench is turning my stomach!"

2d14a91d-1c9f-4bac-a7d6-d33372aecb81.Text: "Let's block off all the entrances to the sewers — let them suffer a slow, painful death down here."

bde5edf3-7110-47ad-9f1a-80a2cd210645.Text: "Let's not descend into anarchy, Jae. You got what you wanted — he'll go to Chorda now."

8490aa92-a465-491b-b2d5-1fc966bf358b.Text: "You acted as a true servant of the Imperium ought. You can be proud of yourself."

fb84c1bf-27d7-4e5a-8cd0-9ccba5428ab2.Text: "What can be right about failing to protect the people who need you?"

8a97ccc7-9528-49bb-80d4-0a92038edb43.Text: "I'm sorry about your gang, but everyone is replaceable."

4a5dfe34-2de1-40b2-adef-5f590b8d3c16.Text: [Pray for the souls of the deceased]

e20e1569-1a3b-4280-816d-f7d93b74ce64.Text: "Very well, I'll wait. It is not as though this place stinks of sewage and other people's retchings."

f3037e0c-98db-4d0d-9a3f-72194cd53847.Text: "Don't torment yourself. You had no choice."

885b689e-77fe-4ba1-b748-e0693b7c559f.Text: "Wake up, Torra! Come on, you bloody kaskha, wake up!" {n}Jae shakes the surviving twin by the shoulders.{/n}

6f728cc7-4b85-413e-84a5-102d91bb4cd8.Text: "By the Exalted One, what's that ashmag done to your poor face, light of my soul?" {n}Jae gently strokes the girl's swollen cheek and then turns to you.{/n} "He will die here, like the scum that he is, shereen. It's what he deserves." {n}She does not seem to be asking you a question.{/n}

ceaceb13-bd02-4cc4-b6dd-465ba5ed15ac.Text: "Waib, holb on a secomb..." {n}Torra leans over Falco and punches him with all her might.{/n} "Fub you! I wab hobing thab the lasb thing heb see woub be my beaten fabe..."

a7054681-9b7a-4e7e-8e23-7417f235ad3f.Text: {n}The rest of the gang are huddled together. Despite their pitiful physical condition, they greet you with satisfied smirks, and they continually shoot delighted glances at you and Jae.{/n}

7e4f7618-3452-45eb-9b5a-31ea520be5ca.Text: "No, shereen, I'm cursing. I'm cursing the one who killed them. The one who failed to stop it. And the ones who didn't care." {n}Her words are interrupted by a smothered sob, and Jae guiltily hangs her head.{/n} "Sorry, shereen. I've never... What is this? Grief? Ha, I'd forgotten..."

9008de99-5927-4b50-b128-145223df8833.Text: {n}Without another word, the Cold Trader draws her weapon and carries out your sentence.{/n}

4de82987-a2ff-4030-8a58-0cbd496c6899.Text: "I'd rather drown him in sewage myself... But your suggestion will do, shereen. A stinking death for a stinking rat!"

401a2368-1db2-4515-84bd-eef3226fe31d.Text: "I wonder what you're thinking of, shereen. Mercy? The Imperium? Or how to make this ashmag suffer most?" {n}Jae smiles like a venomous snake.{/n} "All of them suit me, because everyone on Footfall knows that you'd be better off strung up on a live wire than in an interrogation room with Incendia's hounds."

7076355c-ccc8-4358-a18c-183f1dd20e15.Text: {n}Bowing over the {d|Encyclopedia:JaeQ2_BreakingThrough}pile of bodies{/d}, Jae brings her hands together in a praying gesture and then tightly grips the Aquila, her fingers turning white. A small, unintelligible murmur comes from behind the curtain of her jet-black hair.{/n}

6c103140-4ae4-4499-aaf8-65879c5c3a5b.Text: "'Die'? You would be satisfied with the mundane, swift death of your worst enemy without even adorning it with hours of artfully crafted anguish?"

066e1c04-579f-4e78-bd52-27ba24e7ad1f.Text: "I might like to, but hanging around here any longer than necessary—" {n}Jae shudders and makes the sign of the Aquila.{/n} "Exalted One save me, did I just agree with you?"

0af5eb1a-a9b8-49a9-9690-563a09f2df46.Text: {n}Jae stands over the bodies of her underlings — many of them have been mutilated beyond recognition, as though a troop of expert torturers had worked on them for many station cycles. Jae grips the Mercatum Tabula Officiale in her right hand and the parchment crunches in protest.{/n} "It was the right thing to do... Wasn't it?" {n}You cannot tell if Jae is asking herself or you.{/n}

22301ec1-460e-4cf2-9a26-62aaa0dc3c88.Text: "Well, there's nothing more for us to do here. I suggest we get out of this kingdom of stink and gut-smeared floors and go back to the perfumed chambers of your ship, shereen. And... yes, I'm fine, in case you were wondering. But even if you're not, I still have a lot I need to think about... We will talk about what happened later."

4fab134d-2ffa-475b-986b-3f08904bcfce.Text: {n}Jae doubles over sharply, her face contorted, as if she has been whipped.{/n} "{d|Encyclopedia:JaeQ2_DogmaticReinforcement}Weren't you the one talking about my great responsibility, shereen?{/d} Waxing lyrical about my obligations to the Imperium?" {n}The blade of rage is on the verge of being drawn from the sheath of Jae's good sense, but she manages to stay it.{/n} "Well, if those are the rules in the Exalted One's intimate circles... I'll learn to play by them."

83583a90-e8dd-4f86-b252-844a451a3562.Text: {n}Finally, she sighs wearily, carefully straightens the certificate between her hands and places it in a special container with a code lock.{/n} I would like to reflect on all this in privacy, shereen. Thank you for not leaving me in that situation. If I had been in your place... I don't know if I would have left you."

78c5c69d-a270-4013-b7f4-1d77a34edeff.Text: "I know, shereen. I know... But why then does the taste of victory turn to rot in my mouth and send a chill through my limbs? {d|Encyclopedia:JaeQ2_DogmaticReinforcement}Is this what it means to serve the greater good of the Imperium?{/d}" {n}Jae's gaze is focused on a single point — the disfigured face of Torra, last of the twins, her faithful right hand.{/n}

dc0ac023-6d1e-4084-af76-e55f3a318824.Text: {n}Jae casts one last look at the bodies and adds quietly,{/n} "And just so we're clear... They died because of your pride and unwillingness to act cautiously. I could see why a Rogue Trader wouldn't care about the lives of some wretched smuggler gang... but these smugglers were my family. And their souls won't forgive me if I keep sleeping with the one who condemned them to death. I wouldn't forgive myself either."

d2362ac4-35fe-43f5-88f5-594c8cf5e331.Text: {n}Argenta makes the sign of the Aquila and whispers a quiet prayer without taking her eyes off the dead.{/n}

bf4dba9b-e412-4481-a224-f98655d45994.Text: "I couldn't have put it better myself, Lord Captain. We could all do with some fresh air, away from the stench... and the locals too."

a06a3ffd-85cb-4176-a683-211d40677c89.Text: "Jeh? Jeh, geb oubba here! Ibs a trap! He wohb web you go!" {n}The bruised and bloodied face with swollen eyes is hard to recognise as the once radiant visage of Torra the twin.{/n}

4ea0642a-b605-43a9-b5fa-2bf14b73d89e.Text: "You of all people should know that life is a series of decisions. Some great and some not so great. Simple, everyday decisions... and decisions that {d|Encyclopedia:JaeQ2_DogmaticReinforcement}change people's lives{/d}. Sometimes it might be the life of a single gang, and sometimes the lives of millions." {n}Jae gives a lifeless shrug, even as she attempts a smile.{/n}

4e326227-0d51-4367-ad83-830c800b2c1a.Text: "Well, shereen, from now on Footfall can sleep soundly — the foulest wart on its rusted body has finally been burnt off by none other than Jae Heydari! And her wonderful patron, of course." {n}Jae winks at you and her face breaks into the most genuine smile you have ever seen from her.{/n} "I'll admit, I'm still struggling to wrap my head around what's happened. I need to go over things with my guys, I'm sure I'll have advice and instructions to hand out. As for our little adventure... let's talk about it back on the ship, in a more private setting."

36a4b357-ea04-4de6-8a97-c9f92bd04bd2.Text: "Thabs for my brother, you piece of shib..." {n}A few scant tears trickle from Torra's watery eyes.{/n}

ee525f2f-8249-4f98-bee8-10d8b070593a.Text: "A fibbing death for a piece of shib like you, Falco." {n}Torra spits yet another tooth out of her bloodied mouth straight into the sleeping face of her tormentor.{/n}

87b3aadd-e555-4464-9f2d-14b3fe60ecc5.Text: "An interesting observation, shereen. Does that mean that one day you will {d|Encyclopedia:JaeQ2_DogmaticReinforcement}replace me, like a rusty nail{/d}? Or like a worn-out boot?" {n}Jae's eyes narrow and you do not recognise the shuttered expression that comes over her face.{/n} "No, don't answer! Today I don't want to know the truth. I'd rather stay blind — sometimes it's the wiser path."

a11112e0-d532-4b20-ab0e-6b6020847d70.Text: {n}Deafening silence reigns for several minutes. Jae does not say another word, but her quivering shoulders speak volumes. At last, she straightens.{/n} "The Exalted One has blessed me with an understanding companion, shereen. Sometimes silence says more about us than an ocean of spilt words."

dbddb85d-2111-49b8-b0e0-ce48c9094fb3.Text: "You don't have to subject yourself to this horror, shereen." {n}Jae offers a cheery smile, but her reddened eyes look almost dead.{/n}

1801056d-d46e-41a3-839b-1d9ed8e851f4.Text: "Toliman did not say who sent the message?"

3f06f5ae-0d3c-4693-afbc-9ec84a77a5a1.Text: "When we reach Footfall, I will help your associates."

9a9eb037-0159-45ce-9fa5-a8ebce20461b.Text: "I've had enough of your problems, Jae. Deal with them yourself."

4d4dc009-85ab-48d3-8f41-1fd25cc24234.Text: "Why should I help you? It seems you have reached the limit of your abilities."

3380474c-7fe5-4e4f-8763-ba5bb7c44c1b.Text: "The Exalted One bless the house of von Valancius for your largesse of spirit, shereen! And thank you for deigning to speak with me." {n}Jae turns unusually hesitant, now tentatively choosing the words that only a moment ago rolled off her tongue in an uninterrupted cascade.{/n} "Here's the thing, shereen — my network of 'trade representatives' has been stretched a little too thin recently, like a chiffon dress on a whore. Supplies are all over the place, orders aren't being filled, clients are kicking off — and not without reason — and revenue's plummeting!"

75b0163b-63cd-43d8-b283-c82eda3f9cdc.Text: "Thank you for dispelling the fog of naive expectations that clouded my gaze. I will not presume to disturb you any longer."

e948fd09-bb49-40de-8a50-8c6d019f406b.Text: "And if that wasn't bad enough, my guys running things from Footfall have been incommunicado recently. And an Astropathic message has finally come in to tell me why: some ashmag — or ashmags, Throne smite them — has captured my gang! And they're threatening to kill every last one of those hard-grafting whelps if I don't do what they want..."

080b4416-d365-45c5-9ff2-ada485870647.Text: "And they only want one thing: my Mercatum Tabula Officiale in exchange for my gang's lives." {n}Jae tosses her thick mane of hair and grits her teeth, looking more vicious than you have ever seen her.{/n} "But I'm not giving up my certificate for anything! And nor am I going to leave my guys high and dry. That's why I am begging for your help and protection, shereen. If I have to step into a cage of hyenas, I'd rather do it with a lion at my side."

8801ede1-e27d-46e7-9ec1-98dd0716e285.Text: "I look forward to that day, shereen! And praise be to the Exalted One for bestowing such a miserly portion of haughty indifference upon your heart."

75beebdb-b24a-48bb-99bd-a52c9b2de1a2.Text: "It could, shereen. But I've been missing the familiar stench of the docks, and darling Octy and her bar, and even the stony gaze of the Exalted One that watches over you wherever you are on Footfall. I'm homesick, you see?" {n}The tender smile vanishes from Jae's face, leaving a nakedly bleak expression behind.{/n} "The Exalted One helps those who help themselves, shereen. And I don't want to risk the lives of my people."

20649734-f358-4c66-ae1d-9cd57c1ca803.Text: "Shereen, you know yourself that all this Astropathic chitchat is nothing but a stream of images, thoughts, intentions... nothing concrete! But I don't need the name of the sender — I already know it. I can smell Falco's stench all over this... or else it's Vladaym's doing — this is just that damned ashmag's style, azhi take him!"

a7600ea4-f6f0-43a7-9622-5b553cfa0a22.Text: "If the intoxicating feeling of your own magnanimity isn't enthralling enough, shereen, I will remind you of more mundane but no less significant concerns. My network of Cold Traders is falling apart because someone threw a spanner in my well-oiled machine, and then a few more for good measure. If we do not remove these obstructions, the network will not recover. And all the resources and effort you have invested in my business will have gone down the drain."

a82cbcb9-1c29-477f-9017-1c91d325ba68.Text: "If the galaxy itself bows down before the will of the God-Emperor and the Rogue Trader, though the Rogue Trader be nothing compared to the might of the Master of Mankind..." {n}Jae shrugs her augmented shoulder and smiles thinly.{/n} "...then who is Jae Heydari to gainsay your decisions, shereen?"

0f8310af-2954-413a-b9cd-6a3668520318.Text: Reminded Jae that the rights granted by a Mercatum Tabula Officiale come with obligations.

27fee1dd-c9db-4ff4-8ed1-28b3df36ec76.Text: "Jae Heydari, the certificate did not only grant you limitless opportunities, it also imposed upon you responsibilities to the Imperium. The certificate cannot be allowed to fall into Falco's hands — you know this."

7fbf4cf6-97f5-4ca2-93cf-507e6b51a6c5.Text: "I refuse to creep through tunnels like a rat! We will go in, wipe out Falco's gang, and leave!"

aad08db3-fb5f-44fa-bdbb-261d84702666.Text: "Why are you making this so complicated? I can just go and kill Falco."

1356e744-ba2b-4ecc-86da-f1bd08bd959d.Text: "I am not telling you to abandon your gang. I am merely reminding you that the certificate is more important than the lives of common smugglers."

a41dcf35-ea65-4d1a-8142-8bd4ab49cddd.Text: "Torra and your gang can be replaced. But your certificate can never be."

dad31a7c-bec2-4370-9c9f-4fece6ebf3f9.Text: "We shall work quickly and quietly — I understand."

c586746a-a187-4d01-b937-94b0f46fd548.Text: "Can you go over the plan one more time?"

ec8d5394-b206-42d3-867c-fd2950caccbc.Text: "Where are we going to get a tank of sleeping gas?"

f7dea8b5-bba1-4688-9cb9-efbf07d8ad13.Text: "And how are we going to direct the gas to the right place?"

730191f1-45df-451f-95b2-285b5217baaf.Text: "The plan is more or less clear."

127dd37b-54ac-4a81-ac05-f0ec62f176d4.Text: "How do we get into the tunnels?"

73e465d1-bc86-4c5a-9fd2-6f50171fb5b4.Text: "Come. It is time to enter the sewers."

b0e25aaf-1ad8-441a-828a-13aa71399cb5.Text: "You're right. We must save them at any cost."

c36e5244-d601-4e3d-8224-9380b91ac5fa.Text: "All right, all right, let's just go. We shall improvise as the situation dictates."

0982fb46-213a-474c-8f45-e9f51f58da61.Text: [Approach the thug on patrol] "Hey you, you filthy rats. Run along and tell Falco that the Rogue Trader is coming for his head!"

30d01265-06c7-40ab-938c-65b11e359a26.Text: "You made your choice the moment you accepted the Mercatum Tabula Officiale from the hands of the Administratum servants."

1ebf1f64-283d-4f1b-ae27-93f7f0bc2e24.Text: "Well, shereen, what do we have here? A cowardly ashmag who wants to get his paws on my certificate without even working up a sweat. Considering the... circumstances currently affecting Footfall, the only fitting place this filth could be hiding is in the sewers." {n}Jae's nose wrinkles at the very thought.{/n}

3813deb8-7717-4904-bffa-f8afbf465718.Text: {n}Jae breaks off, her shoulders sagging under the weight of her doubts.{/n} "If it doesn't, my gang are dead, shereen. One wrong move, one wrong word... Gah, Throne damn that ashmag, why is everything so difficult? Perhaps... perhaps I should just give him the Mercatum Tabula Officiale? Falco's not a complete idiot — he won't risk such a valuable payoff. He'll... hold up his end of the deal and give me Torra and the others."

a7de72fd-4e2c-4fc8-825a-604984dae911.Text: "But you'll kill all my loyal mutts along with the jackals, shereen." {n}Jae's lips tremble in agitation.{/n} "They'll meet their deaths at the end of a jagged blade as soon as Falco realises that I haven't come to hand over the certificate. But... all right. Let's do it that way. There is always a chance of salvation, right, Exalted One?" {n}Jae squeezes the already shabby-looking Aquila on her chest, raising her eyes to the vaulted ceiling.{/n}

382949c5-a0f7-468f-b1da-743643c8aca3.Text: "No!" {n}hisses Jae through her teeth, trying not to give herself away.{/n} "Shereen, what are you doing? BACK!"

b115cd13-bc96-4014-820e-009eddee9df5.Text: "A nasty spot, with a powerful whiff about it, that is true. But I swear to you, shereen, you won't come up with a better trap for Falco — I know these tunnels like the back of my hand! And the most delicious part of all is that that ashmag chose to go in there — he'll wish he hadn't. Of course, that's only if the azhi don't mess things up for us and everything goes to plan. And if it doesn't..."

1bde4ee7-c7c7-40d9-b97d-23415f8cd6c5.Text: "The gist is that we need to go down into the sewer tunnels of Footfall, connect a tank of sleeping gas to the old ventilation system, and direct the airflow to Falco's hideout... and, of course, pray to the Exalted One that the ashmag's jackals don't spot us!"

0e79d228-cc31-4326-9a50-0fc9a4c368df.Text: "I would prefer it if we stuck to the plan, shereen. But if you're in a rush, we can go over the details once we're in the sewers. Most of the passages have been sealed off by Chorda's hounds, but there is one they definitely haven't got to." {n}Jae visibly perks up.{/n} "Time to pay a visit to Octy and the Adeptus Amasecus, shereen."

a6ed5f5a-d1a7-470e-a211-50eda2d37e4a.Text: "And may the Exalted Emperor light our path."

9f15727c-3e46-4563-8ee9-b78014f5ea62.Text: {n}Jae interrupts.{/n} "I was actually trying to bring a little levity. I wasn't seriously describing—"

4e576270-0604-4f68-a5cd-fb9ee456fb1d.Text: "Shereen, tell me... why is it that, of all the xenos you could have taken under your wing, you picked the ones who refuse to understand my sarcasm?"

c4bc3988-b02a-4eae-b88a-e1d97000292f.Text: "And doom my associates to death, not even giving them a morsel of hope — as you might give a crumb of bread to the lowliest beggar — that it's not all over yet? If we rush in there, we'll be as good as slitting the throat of every idiot who ever swore their loyalty to me."

ff12092a-96cb-4e3c-8885-6c2449757325.Text: "It's true, shereen... it's going to be a little trickier than it seems. Falco is desperate, so he's bound to have his thugs patrolling the tunnels. If we go crashing around down there, he'll know something is afoot. And when Falco's feeling jumpy..." {n}Jae's nostrils flare with impotent rage.{/n} "...heads roll."

00f21514-e23b-4e75-aa14-be2f9c153569.Text: {n}Jae stares at you, trying to decide if you are joking or being completely serious.{/n} "What do you take me for? I have acquired it already. Don't worry, I have everything covered."

c2181fd2-ace4-4359-92b0-65edbbafc410.Text: "We'll need to turn a few valves there, and another couple here... And start up the ventilation system using an old cogitator, may the Exalted One preserve its machine spirit!"

681442f0-abb2-4848-bfb4-470d94558b3c.Text: "The only thing life has ever taught me, shereen, is that no plan ever goes according to plan." {n}Jae gives you a rakish smile — she is more than ready to dice with death.{/n}

dca46a95-32bc-449e-8977-4fed930f939b.Text: "Most of the passages have been sealed off by Chorda's hounds, but there is one they definitely haven't got to." {n}Jae visibly perks up and winks at you.{/n} "Time to pay a visit to Octy and the Adeptus Amasecus, shereen."

bee149a2-35ec-4bb2-a29f-1a2276d27f95.Text: "To the Amasecus we go, shereen. Or do you have other pressing business to handle on the way there?"

fbdb8ea5-0de2-4257-9b2d-3d92ecd70c76.Text: "I, too, was a 'common smuggler' once, shereen," {n}retorts Jae in an even tone.{/n} "Don't worry. If things go awry down there, keeping the Mercatum Tabula Officiale is my top priority."

93778ffe-3578-44f8-97f2-4e82df24b0a6.Text: "Never..." {n}Jae repeats colourlessly, and her eyes fill with grim determination.{/n} "Ha, azhi devour me, I have no intention of giving up on my goal — the climb up here was too long, too steep — I'm at the summit now, and I'm not going to throw myself off without a second thought!"

695979a4-a5d0-4493-8c6b-a32b149d6ec0.Text: "Let's go — our way in is through a secret passage in the Adeptus Amasecus." {n}Without another word, Jae turns on her heel and strides off toward the Shadow Quarters.{/n}

e3823ef0-53ed-4cef-8b62-bad59331eb7b.Text: "The gang will understand, I'm sure. They would've bashed their own mother's head in for a treasure like the Mercatum Tabula Officiale. But Falco..." {n}Jae's mouth twists in a nasty smile.{/n} "Let's go to the Adeptus Amasecus, shereen. I'll lead you through the secret passage into the sewers. Rest assured, that ashmag hiding down there will sorely rue the day he decided to cross a trade representative of the Imperium."

ea812bd4-3e8c-4032-a2eb-552e554f38a3.Text: {n}Surprise flickers in Jae's eyes.{/n} "Do you... really think so, shereen? In that case... I hope you will still help me release my thoroughbred of a scheme into the wild?"

88b1bc41-4301-4417-bc3f-9b7ac425626a.Text: "As I said before, Falco's jackals are patrolling every nook and cranny of this azhi-cursed place. See those scumbags over there? We need to avoid them and not draw any attention to ourselves, or else we might as well dump a pile of grox shit all over our plan!"

325c1904-a548-4048-bc26-ca8166e2d7ee.Text: "But now we are going to follow the plan. If you will allow me, shereen, I will refresh your memory: avoiding the patrolling scum, we reach the sewer canal and follow it to the east almost until the very end. We connect the gas cylinder to the special intake — ironically enough, it was previously used for cleaning the air — then we need to turn the valves in a few spots so that the gas reaches the correct chamber... I wish I knew exactly where that ashmag was holed up."

6ab5f8a9-694d-4686-bafa-874548f72c7c.Text: {n}Yrliet examines the filthy walls and the mounds of refuse.{/n} "The finest goods on Footfall... Does that make this place... some sort of mon-keigh trading hall? Really?" {n}You cannot tell from Yrliet's tone whether she is speaking in jest or genuinely confused.{/n}

21e9620c-b39b-4188-8f3c-cfef7c010dab.Text: {n}Argenta examines the dark tunnels morosely.{/n} "To skulk in the shadows, to hide from battle... these things are beneath His warriors. But for the sake of saving the innocent, I will dim the flame in my soul that urges me to charge openly at the enemy's ranks."

44653e0a-2753-422b-b57b-941390f502b1.Text: "I would be careful about using the word 'innocent,' given whose colleagues we are talking about."

91cd8be3-ab69-496a-bc5c-eab4153bca4b.Text: "And 'the kingdom of killers' as well? I know that your kind knows nothing about the art of killing, but to found an order in a waste-coated hole like this?" {n}Unlike Yrliet, Marazhai does not even try to hide the venomous sarcasm in his voice.{/n}

c610514d-f2e4-4be5-8730-3639d3bd56cf.Text: "A game of regicide is not won on the final move, but with a strategy planned in advance." {n}You can barely hear Heinrix's disgruntled muttering as he surveys the tunnels.{/n} "This whole operation... is the opposite of that."

96995f5f-a32f-4b4c-9b60-67ab02020f05.Text: {n}Jae falls into a long, heavy silence, weighing every word you just spoke.{/n} "I will not gift him with an easy death, shereen. As an official representative of the Imperium, I am duty-bound to purge the tunnels of Footfall of ashmags like Falco."

5198c4ba-f3dc-479b-85df-bd309e518026.Text: "Welcome to the kingdom of thieves, killers, and smugglers, shereen! All the finest goods on Footfall — every last one of them — have passed through these tunnels." {n}Jae throws up her arms in a theatrical display of reverence.{/n}

b025ac02-fabf-42b2-bded-a08df16c5ff5.Text: "I... do..." {n}Something breaks in Jae's voice. It even sounds to you as if you hear a grinding noise — as if an old screw has come loose and the rusty mechanism is screeching in protest at the assault.{/n} "But Torra and the rest... They're waiting for me, shereen! They're waiting!"

641474c8-d5f9-45f5-bb06-f4c7a988388f.Text: "Aaand... the final move, like all the best regicide players, shereen: we find the service cogitator and send the gas along the pipes! And I'm sure I don't have to remind you that we must do all of this in complete silence? Not even the sewer rats are going to notice us, let alone Falco's lot."

6b1b181a-0930-4e8e-9755-137a2d3d70bc.Text: "How can you be daydreaming in a place like this, shereen?" {n}Jae throws up her hands.{/n} "We avoid the patrols, we reach the sewer canal and follow it east. We connect the gas cylinder to the special intake, then we turn some valves — wherever we need to. And then last of all we find the service cogitator and send the gas along the pipes."

c4d5a8f8-7676-43f9-a36c-1d217f4a24d4.Text: "W-what?" {n}The pock-marked face peers fearfully into the dark of the tunnel.{/n} "Heydari! It's Heydari with the Rogue Trader!"

bcbae15e-c8bb-4df2-9e02-abdbcf4647c8.Text: "Throne curse you, shereen, you just signed my people's death warrant!" {n}You hear the sharp edge of desperation in her shout.{/n}

fcc8eb65-fc7a-4d93-8ffc-ca0c1a3d6bcb.Text: "If Falco touches a hair on their heads — I'll kill him! I'll tear out his spine with my own teeth! Well, what are you waiting for, {name}? You want his head, don't you? Then we need to move now."

557709ce-bb29-4fc3-be45-a0280632a0d5.Text: "You are being addressed by the Rogue Trader and master of this vessel! I command you to compose yourself before the God-Emperor's chosen and beg forgiveness for your crimes."

6aa014de-b967-4c65-8ca2-8e40096e8ced.Text: "Heinrix, use your biomancy to dull his reflexes."

949f0719-b5fc-4d5e-b0a9-04ac507567b5.Text: "Ulfar, would you like to say a few words to your old acquaintance?"

000b656a-91f9-4c6b-a766-62c977a7fcf1.Text: "Marazhai. Can you hear me? Let's talk."

b06d4495-0c3c-42ac-a90d-37a0d04c3b41.Text: "I will try to bring him to his senses."

5f491969-28df-4fa2-8457-c9f44241973e.Text: [Attack Marazhai] "I will not show leniency to the one who butchered my people!"

0c4b5fb1-b0b4-4016-95c2-614cd09ca019.Text: [Push one of the enforcers forward] "Look, Marazhai, I brought you someone!"

739ea668-a9aa-402f-8b9f-4aadb68b4632.Text: "Heinrix, please! I want to avoid spilling even more blood."

1d83c382-4dc6-40fa-8c0c-c635fd4e55b1.Text: [Attack Marazhai] "Sound advice. I think I will follow it!"

31a76b9c-70fa-4046-b9d2-ad7f35d9751d.Text: "I forbid you from moving about the ship unsupervised, and from here on out, you will be kept under lock and key during warp jumps. The alternative is death. The choice is yours."

329bc035-313a-4ebe-9420-d40c40055c5e.Text: Gave a group of enforcers to Marazhai.

22a53613-d817-4cc3-8d9a-64a4c90e2cfa.Text: [Look back at the enforcers] "I need another volunteer."

8a0241f7-f4a1-4987-9b59-5f0bbea31d15.Text: "What about all that talk of the great Aeldari race? If only you could see yourself now, you worthless, quivering beast! A mirage was all it took for you to soil yourself!"

0e6441ec-4576-4eef-aa3a-37a1726834ca.Text: "How many dysjunctions did you survive in Commorragh, Marazhai? The warp is powerless as long as you refuse to let it take hold of you. Master yourself!"

5665a230-36ee-4f7c-b7a5-622bf302770c.Text: "In the name of the Imperium, obey your {mf|master|mistress} and lay down your weapons!"

92dd0f67-2488-4f52-a295-70c8d6274883.Text: "You crave blood and pain? You shall have both. Remember the glorious time we had together in Commorragh. I will give you all of that and more."

5c778cba-ea31-4062-8d2e-b91de4e82410.Text: Allowed the Daemonette to take Marazhai.

8d460061-d8bf-4dd2-a7de-463e01d6ecdd.Text: [Let the Daemonette take Marazhai] "Everyone, step back!"

8bb82ff2-91b8-45ac-b7e0-07f16fa6740a.Text: "Your presence is causing me a great deal of grief, xenos."

423df1b8-64da-48dc-b89a-1c83efc236f4.Text: Killed Marazhai after his bloody rampage.

82cb57b5-798c-428c-a38b-c0804b483719.Text: [Kill Marazhai] "I have had enough of this heresy on my ship."

34fd6f37-8904-47de-aa0e-bd148d4b3894.Text: Allowed Heinrix to kill Marazhai after the xenos's bloody rampage.

bf6d37f0-5b52-4ffc-9c40-4e2212e68ac5.Text: [Let Heinrix dispose of Marazhai] "Esteemed Interrogator, I invite you to do your duty as a servant of the Holy Inquisition."

cb0f4788-ded2-491a-ab9b-0a2437603909.Text: "Marazhai, are you sure you have regained your senses?"

19aefd97-57f1-40b7-8b32-bb61513be3f5.Text: "Pasqal, kindly make good on your offer."

b59ed8f0-ce47-4930-9199-25092f9c8267.Text: "I will change nothing. Marazhai is free to hunt wherever he pleases on my ship."

24309bc2-53bf-466f-8c46-035c82907958.Text: "Let's make a deal. I will supply you with prey of my own choosing. You will be free to roam about the ship until you start going after those you are not supposed to touch."

c7153112-5d54-43b7-a2a6-c5c7faf2f110.Text: "I shall grant you hunting grounds, Marazhai. A bay on the lower decks. You can do whatever your heart desires down there, but you are not to leave its bounds during warp jumps."

377146b8-60b1-4009-8f7a-6329035a1c0e.Text: {n}Marazhai jerks his head up when you appear. His already gaunt face is tightly wrapped in pale grey, parchment-like skin, his teeth are bared feverishly, and his dark eyes have turned into two pitch-black mirrors that could show your reflection clearly if you were to gaze into them. He opens his mouth, but instead of words, an unnatural, rasping hiss comes out. If this creature ever possessed intelligence, there is no sign of it left.{/n}

ce926643-b6f8-4f88-96d6-cc49e16d6dca.Text: "At last..." {n}The resonant voice that has followed you on your journey through the deck sounds like it is coming from every direction, chilling you to the bone.{/n} "At last we meet, my poor child. Look at him, mortal. Look at how he yearns to return to the one whose caress his kind rejects so stubbornly. Come, child. Follow my voice, and my Prince will grant you all the bliss and torment in this universe."

3e0d2976-66a9-4290-bdea-ae4fcf8b5e32.Text: {n}Marazhai staggers to his feet, bleeding from his many wounds. There is awareness in his eyes — and fear.{/n} "They're... dead? Gone, vanished... But I can still hear their whispers. How do mon-keigh bear them for days and days on end?" {n}You hear genuine confusion in his voice.{/n}

31857e10-18d2-46cf-883b-66e3e3e6b4d3.Text: "This ends now." {n}Heinrix draws his weapon, and the air around him grows colder.{/n} "We are putting the rabid beast down for good."

14f7a72a-bc81-4936-a6f1-11437ef341a7.Text: {n}Yrliet exclaims something in the Aeldari language — the Elucidator fails to process her rapid and elaborate speech. Without waiting for Marazhai's response, she turns to you.{/n} "My dark kin has lost himself in the fight against the pull of She Who Thirsts. Allow me, elantach. However great our differences are, however dissolute and depraved the dark ways may be, I cannot blind my eyes and let Sai'lanthresh take him."

cd821153-9f91-4431-857e-91bcafdcec30.Text: {n}Marazhai scoffs.{/n} "An anchor, Asuryani? That is for those who seek to delude themselves with false limitations. As long as I have victims in plentiful supply, I won't let Sai'lanthresh claim me."

fc487be5-dde6-47cf-81cd-2b1d267a7cda.Text: {n}Marazhai looks at Yrliet. There is a barely noticeable shift in his expression.{/n} "The entire time that you have been here..."

5cbec282-5e55-439e-a1f5-1757dc6ddf59.Text: {n}The warp spawn laughs musically.{/n} "Sooner or later, all of his kind will step into my embrace. The Prince is patient. The Prince knows that every Aeldari soul is already his."

7e344680-25ea-4d26-b33a-763b3e2b4943.Text: {n}The Drukhari lowers his head in thought. Then he gives Yrliet a sidelong glance.{/n} "I should have understood. From what you told me..." {n}Marazhai stops himself.{/n} "Well, no matter."

383ac1ca-8651-4646-b381-ec81b69d12d6.Text: "You moron, what is wrong with you? Is it so hard to just say, 'Thanks for saving my sorry hide just now'?" {n}Idira mutters under her breath in exasperation, not daring to raise her voice.{/n}

439317a9-36c4-4d4e-8c7f-2ee4accd73e4.Text: {n}The Wolf's upper lip lifts in a predatory snarl, and ferocious excitement flashes in his eyes. Ulfar's form seems to grow larger and darker as he utters,{/n} "Long have I waited for this, craven minion of derisible masters. And so have my brothers. This is where you meet your death. And your death will be long."

112ffdc1-cf4a-454d-85be-82cca83d3ebd.Text: {n}Marazhai, half-crouched, is teetering slightly, and that is the only movement you can see. His body language shows that he is ready to attack, as do the bloodstained blades he is holding.{/n}

e98f59b5-4844-4f86-9fdc-2acb5fa4fa00.Text: {n}The Drukhari stares at you without blinking, teeth still bared, his frenzied expression frozen like a mask. You hear hissing again — this time lower and angrier than before.{/n}

6dcb1d43-13ac-4d22-afe0-7ecc9d57e796.Text: {n}The Daemonette's voice suddenly forces itself inside your mind.{/n} "But if you let me get close to the lost child... if you lull him into letting his guard down... my Prince will reward you, {name}. The soul of this pathetic xenos is a small price to pay for the blessings that come with my master's favour."

2e5a3336-77e1-4ca5-b28b-af2131853eb4.Text: {n}Marazhai's voice turns into furious hissing.{/n} "Your kind step beyond the veil with nothing but your crude technologies and prayers to a deaf god, and you expect those such as I to rely on such paltry protection from the terrors of She Who Thirsts?"

b85cc6df-60e2-4748-a42f-76ff868e0a0f.Text: {n}The xenos is turning his head back and forth, surveying the room but still watching you. His muscles are no longer cramped stiff in a battle stance, but his face still bears a twisted expression that can either be interpreted as wild frenzy or terror.{/n}

2b5ca082-cf2f-4c9a-832b-bee03cf90062.Text: "I... never..." {n}Marazhai gnashes his teeth.{/n} "I forgot myself for a moment, nothing more."

4b5d1c2f-b88a-4678-b7c1-a6b5ccde9d6f.Text: {n}Your confident voice reverberates through the metal room. The Drukhari blinks. Then blinks again. The mirror-like surface of his eyes seems to ripple, as if something else is beginning to surface apart from the soulless reflection, something vaguely resembling awareness.{/n}

88017eeb-2265-41a6-b753-f6558957d0ba.Text: {n}Marazhai crouches lower. You may be mere moments away from him pouncing on you.{/n}

ac55f086-9981-48ea-b27b-cc07af36565d.Text: {n}Pasqal pulls out a data-slate and touches its screen.{/n} "The Omnissiah castigates."

243b6db8-4d15-4abf-be87-71ccaa8b5793.Text: {n}Heinrix's eyes narrow.{/n} "Why are we wasting time and entertaining the risks of using psyker abilities in the warp? For what? So that you can keep your pet predator? Isn't it about time you rid your menagerie of this exotic menace?"

2b249c39-f0d2-4030-9c13-9f609a874f23.Text: {n}The Interrogator gives you another look, then shakes his head and raises a hand.{/n}

0a6174db-6763-4150-b22c-a83506799014.Text: {n}Heinrix mutters a curse and raises his hand.{/n}

969e580a-cc7f-4fd8-b356-a05b647ac684.Text: {n}The temperature drops considerably. Nothing happens for a few moments, but then Marazhai slowly sinks to his knees. His transfixed eyes close slightly, and an anguished crease appears on his brow, as if the xenos is waking from a nightmare.{/n}

2a723b8f-3a2c-4a57-9ab4-89413bd78b25.Text: {n}Your eyes can barely register the speed with which Marazhai moves. He dashes forward, skewers the screaming enforcer with his blade, and sinks the clawed fingers of his other hand into the victim's face. The scream becomes a howl, then a rattle, then the Drukhari throws the mangled corpse away and steps back. The impenetrable reflective veil over his eyes breaks, and you can almost make out his pupils.{/n}

9d75d077-f24f-43ff-bc07-cf307acdfeb7.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!" {n}The enforcer tries to object but then immediately shrinks when Marazhai looks at him again.{/n}

1e20bccd-9faf-461b-bcd3-74ef0c794265.Text: "{name}." {n}Marazhai runs a finger along the edge of his blade, his eyes trained on the frightened crew.{/n} "The meat... is too loud." {n}Hunger ignites in the Drukhari's eyes.{/n}

9637cbe9-c6a6-44b0-92e6-1c8eb3896d03.Text: {n}Marazhai grimaces and removes his hands from his weapons.{/n} "There is always next time, {name}. I will have my chance yet."

52c926d4-8caa-4cdc-a5e9-7e05936fa06d.Text: {n}Marazhai does not react in time — warp madness must have affected him more than he is letting on. He lets out a short rasp and falls to the floor. His death throes only last a moment, and then the xenos is no more.{/n}

8e94cbe1-ecc7-40ed-abe8-f492990eaac5.Text: {n}The trembling enforcers remain where they are. It would seem that their fear of the mad xenobeast is stronger than their fear of the Rogue Trader's ire.{/n}

fca93cde-d78e-4379-a20a-d977da02df49.Text: {n}Marazhai blinks, and his eyes ignite with a familiar look of fury and wounded pride.{/n} "I will rip out your tongue and make you swallow it piece by piece along with your own teeth!"

85846857-754b-4302-8d3e-df12ea573e60.Text: {n}Your words appear to have reached Marazhai's mind. He shakes his head and closes his eyes, then you watch him take a deep breath and relax his shoulders ever so slightly.{/n}

321e6b09-117b-4e74-88dc-6bd8c3c9eb66.Text: {n}The laughing in your head turns feral.{/n} "Why are you confusing and tricking the lost child? The end is decided. The end is inevitable."

01572678-d88a-4f01-aa71-7588b7265605.Text: {n}Marazhai's head turns sharply as if he just heard a strange and suspicious noise. That is all the reaction you get.{/n}

8a563501-e919-4dae-bba6-ae7f6d97d124.Text: {n}The air behind Marazhai ripples, and you watch as the Daemonette's faintly visible silhouette bleeds out of thin air. The horrible mouth is sneering triumphantly, the large pincer is rising higher and higher...{/n}

c18bdf54-4ff3-42b2-bc0c-1f4b9ca603ee.Text: {n}The Daemonette brings her pincer down on Marazhai's head — and clangs against his raised blade. Marazhai crouches and shoves the shrieking warp entity away from himself.{/n}

39740145-211a-408c-8950-7b7e07ae2ed8.Text: {n}The Daemonette's pincer clamps around Marazhai's throat and forces him onto his knees. He tries to resist, but his blade slashes nothing but air. The Daemonette lets out a hungry howl, leans over Marazhai, and presses her lips against his mouth. A moment later, his body crumples like a broken puppet.{/n}

d04f1789-671e-403e-ae8d-b953f9fd139a.Text: "No!" {n}Yrliet's frantic cry fails to prevent the inevitable.{/n}

cb5dee56-f8f8-478b-9c59-ee9071c1c275.Text: "No! No, you're mine, Marazhai! YOU'RE MINE!"

7e886eda-9325-4f6e-89b0-4776fc4d680d.Text: {n}Marazhai listens to your words. As he does, a different expression surfaces on his previously feral face — a familiar crooked smile.{/n}

aaa9475f-73d7-4993-925d-428dbc479744.Text: "Yes, Dark One. This entire time. With each new passage, I bolstered my spirit further and my meditation became a stronger barrier against the tendrils of She Who Thirsts. I endured it. So will you, if you value your soul."

63857125-aaf4-45c3-944c-0a7f17e35fa7.Text: {n}Heinrix is looking at you intently. You realise that the cold sensation still remains — the Interrogator is ready to strike, waiting for you to say the word.{/n}

fa85bb8b-7c2e-4d74-910b-7c267f062775.Text: {n}The xenos is standing tall and looking at you with faint traces of intelligence in his eyes, which are still hazy. It looks like one last push is required for him to emerge from his death-sowing trance.{/n}

311f1f2c-f04c-4568-b4b8-22bd2a428826.Text: {n}One of the enforcers lets his emotions get the better of him.{/n} "Throne's sakes, Lord Captain, why are you even listening to him? That there xenos is worse than a wild beast! How can a ship that sails in the God-Emperor's light allow one of His enemies to act like he's master here?"

b659c7f5-76a5-4df0-96f4-ded18efb51d7.Text: {n}Marazhai looks at the man hungrily.{/n} "The living meat that serves you talks too much. They would, however, make for perfect playthings." {n}He looks straight at you.{/n} "I need strength in order to suffer through your oafish voyages beyond the veil. If I don't obtain a source of such sustenance, Sai'lanthresh will only keep testing my limits."

7e0b9ca2-4868-4af1-9af8-b5f05975ca5f.Text: "This unit has received a sign from the Omnissiah." {n}Pasqal points at the metal platform beneath Marazhai's feet.{/n} "The transfer-plate upon which the xenos has so short-sightedly made his lair can be reconfigured to send a short discharge of the Motive Force. This unit could use it to impart... a modicum of reason to this crazed creature."

743838d2-799c-49d7-b059-6ecc771cb6fa.Text: "If I begin to run out of sacrifices... I think your servants will be too terrified of becoming my next plaything to perform their duties adequately." {n}Marazhai smirks.{/n} "That well-fed mon-keigh on the ship's bridge... the Factotum? I think he will solve the meat supply problem, if it arises."

6020de89-f82c-4760-bf4e-e57536af9124.Text: {n}The words slam into Marazhai like hammer strikes, and the mad grimace on his face cracks. The sight of the bloodthirsty giant awakens an ancient instinct within him — to survive at any cost! Marazhai responds with a raging battle cry of the Drukhari that carries anticipation of slaughter.{/n}

b100ed74-ba72-4a4b-a4bc-bbd9b1c87762.Text: "Lord Captain, the officer has a point." {n}Abelard glowers at Marazhai.{/n} "If things continue on like this, we might end up with a mutiny on our hands. A massacre during every warp jump... As if we didn't have enough troubles to deal with on days like this." {n}He shakes his head.{/n}

dc89df3f-752e-454e-947a-6fef49434f49.Text: {n}Marazhai closes his eyes for a moment and chuckles in satisfaction.{/n} "As it should be. See to it that I never have a shortage of prey — I tend to run out too quickly for my liking."

8c75ce95-e8c6-44bf-ac89-4100f50f5167.Text: {n}A flash of sparks, a stifled cry — Marazhai jerks, takes a step back, and shakes his head, clearly confused by what happened. For a moment, you see something akin to shocked awareness in his eyes.{/n}

e45fc34d-f49d-469b-b167-b59623223865.Text: {n}Marazhai gives you a long look. The pause starts to drag on when he finally says nonchalantly,{/n} "I will not hold up my end of the bargain if you forget about yours. Should I ever feel a lack of playthings, the corpses of your servants will start piling up."

935f3e98-e95c-42f2-9dab-19cb1bacc000.Text: {n}Marazhai gives you a long look. The pause starts to drag on when he finally says nonchalantly,{/n} "See to it that I am not disappointed with my allotted territory."

b2723a46-5a8d-4253-a60f-2543c705e69f.Text: {n}Marazhai turns to you, looking the same as ever — with the exception that you can see greyish-blue veins through his parchment skin and something resembling terror in his eyes.{/n} "They're gone, {name}. Gone but still lurking at the threshold. Keeping watch. I can hear their whispers. How do mon-keigh bear them for days and days on end?" {n}You hear genuine confusion in his voice.{/n}

ac8c59d3-ab69-430a-811d-bce8167f5022.Text: {n}Yrliet flinches and looks away. She tries to say something, but instead just closes her eyes and shakes her head ruefully.{/n}

3fc2f5c8-d82d-4bfa-946a-c4aec113c52e.Text: {n}Marazhai freezes. You meet his enraged gaze, filled with the promise of torture and agony... but then you almost see something inside him give, forcing him to incline his head slightly.{/n} "Let it be as you say, {name}."

76a48036-b141-40be-86fa-1845bc851bb9.Text: {n}The officer cannot suppress a relieved sigh.{/n} "Well, that's something, at least... Many thanks, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"

bc1a1cd8-157b-4a81-b18b-e57456de74d1.Text: {n}Not a muscle twitches in Marazhai's face. You notice him tighten his grip on the handles of his swords.{/n}

676c50cd-7755-4c16-9997-675bde090d22.Text: "You will hear these whispers every time the void vessel travels beyond the veil. Learn to accept this. Find an anchor for such times. Or lose yourself."

857d9978-97ca-4810-83c5-f1119d7d38c8.Text: "That was profoundly poignant, {name}. But you have picked the wrong audience."

ec1062a0-6794-42db-9350-a813a89bc964.Text: {n}Yrliet starts talking, too quickly for the Elucidator, but not for Marazhai. He turns his head and watches her like a snake watches a bird. Yrliet takes a step. Then another. You hear new inflections in her voice, melodious, almost calming. Her hands are moving in an elaborate dance of gestures as she keeps touching the spirit stone on her chest.{/n}

d6130a16-093f-49cc-ba19-d4b9c528815f.Text: {n}Slowly, very slowly, Yrliet advances toward Marazhai and his bristling blades — and he remains still, seemingly entranced by her words. You carefully follow her.{/n}

16a056d5-cd87-45fb-b4db-a2ad56882bec.Text: {n}Yrliet gives you a slight nod and starts speaking again, her words filled with pain and pleading. She steps forward. Then takes another step. And another. You feel as if this last step was a little too confident...{/n}

81255c58-8033-4539-b650-658197a4641a.Text: {n}Marazhai's expression changes subtly as hungering malice flashes in his eyes. Yrliet notices the alarming signs too late — and only recoils when the blade has already cut through the air. She barely suppresses a cry and clutches her deep wound — but she does not retreat farther than a single step.{/n}

5cc15035-8837-4048-9833-9ce7a2072300.Text: "No more." {n}Yrliet whispers faintly.{/n} "He no longer heeds me."

6b17976d-03fa-4c62-8409-5350ec8d3f3f.Text: "Who were the victims of this massacre?"

91f60cc1-4995-4836-853c-c4b64f5e0ea1.Text: "I have heard enough. I am heading inside."

769221db-8111-4a55-878b-671cdd45c6c0.Text: [Point at the Daemonette] "Can you see her?"

9214f77f-cd05-4e69-8935-3d9f1d204360.Text: "Lord Captain! God-Emperor be with you... and with all of us too." {n}The enforcer can barely suppress the tremors running throughout his body.{/n} "Only you can deal with this... this spawn!"

9380f92b-851a-47ea-8ff3-7b98f99b12db.Text: "I can't see anyone, Lord Captain, but I sure can hear her just fine." {n}Idira's voice is trembling slightly. She is looking at her feet and does not raise her head.{/n} "Must have come for your xenos. Personally. Maybe we shouldn't get in her way? Please?"

0e18bbb6-94f0-4499-acd9-0a0cba7e1e83.Text: "Permission to report, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! It started a few watches after the translation. Well, actually, they say this... associate of yours had been acting strangely even before that. It's as if he started hearing things: he was swivelling back and forth, barking something in his xenos tongue, then he grabbed his blade and sliced his hand open — his own hand! Then he suddenly howled and lunged at the people nearby."

8fbdb91f-8250-41d1-a8f6-9465d84ae56f.Text: "Who? Oh, the xenos! He's holed up in there." {n}He nods at the barricaded gate.{/n} "He corralled a number of crewmen in there like {g|Encyclopedia:Grox}groxes{/g} to a slaughterhouse, all we could hear were screams... Well, we couldn't save them, so we locked him in there so he couldn't crawl back out. Unless he finds a crack to squeeze through..."

147973d1-3b5d-410e-ac37-521f830de590.Text: {n}The officer looks behind him, glances around the deck, then turns to you with an alarmed expression.{/n} "See w-who, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}?"

67e615bf-0a36-472c-9f5e-bf858acd36fd.Text: "Whom are you referring to, Lord Captain?"

7487700c-8608-470e-8c5f-38da985025fc.Text: "Anyone he could get his hands on, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}... Officers, serfs... a technomat... He even attacked a servitor, although that didn't last long, he just tore its head off. The rest of them, though... the xenos scum tortured the life out of them." {n}You can see the colour draining from the officer's face.{/n}

23b3202b-9e2b-412c-a14c-28a4c6aa46da.Text: "We'll unblock it right quick, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}... If only there was a way to flush that fiend out without going in..." {n}He stops and pales even more.{/n} "Throne's mercy... I completely forgot... The late technomat, he... well, he turned on some security systems right before he bled out... We figured, if the xenos thinks about showing his face, those systems will get him..."

dec40f0a-000b-4e8d-aed8-9ea284923db5.Text: "The point is, we should go with Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, with your permission. It just wouldn't be right for the Lord Captain to go in there alone. God-Emperor help us all..." {n}The officer tries his best to speak calmly, but his voice is quivering. The thought of going inside the compartment that has become a death trap fills him with dread bordering on panic.{/n}

de706650-d179-4594-903f-03b91285fbb1.Text: "I cannot see anyone, {name}... but I can certainly sense a warp presence nearby. You're saying you can perceive it? Then the entity itself has decided to reveal its form to you. The real question is... why?"

fb69733e-67bf-4ce3-ad40-a753c8a3ac3f.Text: "Glaito hasn't spotted anyone yet, but I can see his hair is bristling. I don't know what's going on, but we are prepared to attack even an invisible target — just relay its position to us."

b4fe2f9d-1a1c-439d-9968-b778735a19bf.Text: "The prospect of having a rabid xenos crawling inside our bulkheads makes my heart sink... No, we ought to drag him out, then we either put him on a chain or — forgive my bluntness, Lord Captain — we swat him down and forget that he ever existed."

c6fb5fa6-1081-42fb-965d-7dcaac738368.Text: "The voice of She Who Thirsts." {n}Yrliet turns pale.{/n} "He heard the call. Any of our kind who find themselves beyond the veil become tempting prey for Sai'lanthresh... and your technology that protects the ship from her baleful influence cannot drown out the sound of her maddening voice."

11ed6ca8-9d5c-4503-b286-fe0a64b166d6.Text: "Do you still wish to go to the rendezvous point?"

45e22adc-7e4c-4476-9adb-1f49a392b584.Text: {n}Wry laughter sounds in the vox-channel.{/n} "The Black Heart is here. What a surprising turn of events."

13b477aa-c24d-4b42-a766-c77fe79d25c8.Text: "Oh, most certainly!" {n}Marazhai lowers his voice to a bloodthirsty growl.{/n} "We are just getting started, {name}."

de58ab55-639a-4f70-8962-a740c80a9062.Text: "Of course. The blood was spilt long before we set foot on the planet where the meeting will take place. I look forward to sinking my blades into the flesh of my kin... or to seeing them kneel before me." {n}The laughter becomes guttural.{/n} "Oh yes, I am going to enjoy this little adventure. Come, {name}. Let us delay no longer."

f0a0828b-011d-4231-a464-d5bbf6a11cdb.Text: "Marazhai, who let you onto this channel?"

a515a431-476e-4b56-b1ed-37d8ea3033b6.Text: "Do you not think this may be a trap?"

f2683269-5779-40a6-8fea-05311c434d45.Text: "Tell the Drukhari we will hear what they have to say."

47907bf1-3f78-4815-81eb-4bcaaa595977.Text: "I do not hold talks with enemies of Humanity."

83d13312-8dd2-4dbb-a580-09475d644d85.Text: "Fine, have it your way. Ravor, tell the Drukhari that we agree to parley."

dc601468-e728-4d66-a48f-9dd03519b179.Text: "My answer is no. Ravor, destroy the xenos flotilla!"

2416ccf3-70ac-4f43-a840-8992306667c4.Text: "Lord Cap'n, we've got... company." {n}Ravor's voice sounds strained.{/n} "A whole brood of xenos... except they're in no hurry to attack. They sent a vox-transmission, so our eggheads are trying to decipher what they're babbling in their language..."

89ecb4b9-bdcc-47c9-9525-8b028bb4e85f.Text: "Will you just look at these entitled pricks! Lord Cap'n, you're not going to believe this. The enemies of Humanity request — nay, they demand to be admitted aboard so they can have words! But not with you, no. They want to talk to their disgraced kinsman whom you've taken under your wing. How'd they even find us?"

26377dc7-5340-499d-8174-1ef9e1ef900c.Text: {n}The vox-caster clicks — someone else joins this conversation.{/n} "{name}. If the worthless scum wish to see me so badly, I am willing to lend my ear to their pleas and hear what they have to say."

e46e62a0-5512-43f2-96f0-882a5101b5bc.Text: {n}Your question is met with laughter.{/n} "Few dare to refuse when I ask, {name}. Your vox operators are no exception to this rule."

4dd8ee11-1dc2-4527-952f-473658c442c7.Text: "No, but it is likely to be an invitation to walk into one. And even if my kin decided to prey on your ship by boarding it in such a pathetic manner... Are you that afraid of them, {name}?" {n}The last phrase is dripping with scorn.{/n} "You should not be. If nothing else, this will alleviate the boredom on board this mon-keigh rust bucket."

17982d94-b720-4e6e-a2e0-6aa2b843fc7e.Text: "But I do, {name}." {n}Marazhai's voice loses its veneer of unhurried nonchalance — he clearly does not want to miss the chance to talk to his kin.{/n} "They are here for me. And I wish to hear them out. Let them onto your vessel."

46f06cbb-591a-4f7e-b14a-be9e23b3c5d8.Text: {n}The vox-caster relays incomprehensible grumbling.{/n} "It will be done, Lord Cap'n."

840798d6-2d48-49f2-8dff-c127e89e056e.Text: "How did they find us here in the first place?"

89c98ce7-e073-44fb-ac96-ea5ba8b3d037.Text: "I will help, but my assistance does not come free of charge."

5a9bdcc3-745b-4f53-82b6-c9f625e68a9c.Text: "I have had enough of Drukhari scheming and feuding. I want no part in this."

0bbc487a-4ffa-41fe-b96c-8966c844e95c.Text: "It sounds like the Kabal is as good as dead."

aff1e70a-8302-410c-900e-1d1e982bb362.Text: "I trust the destruction of the psy-stifler did not do your fortress any favours."

10f4316f-33b4-432e-bb38-0e47673ab866.Text: "Yes indeed. Just a mark... nothing more."

d4573318-1b2d-43bf-8873-0b3334e91f4c.Text: "Very well, let us talk to your kin."

7b953b31-b9b9-436d-8799-03f7963a320f.Text: "Be careful, Kharael. Marazhai does not like it when others ogle what belongs to him."

a5256319-a358-4b55-8785-a5b73b7f13f9.Text: "I am not going to waste my time on your games or walk headlong into a trap."

1fe36ee2-07a6-4857-a757-e68e6c76e6b5.Text: "This looks too much like a trap."

6a2359f6-c885-462e-b90f-094fc19af72f.Text: "Property? Far from it. Our little games do not make me your property."

b1f82eac-da25-452d-b433-6bcb5585d6b8.Text: "No need to be shy in front of your friend, Marazhai. Tell him the truth — you belong to me."

4bafd804-2ac5-484e-b486-6dfa8e8dfbaf.Text: {n}The xenos in front of you exchange wary glances and curt remarks that your Elucidator cannot capture or comprehend. At last, one of the Drukhari steps forward and takes off his helmet. His hair is bone-white and his face is marked with tattoos not entirely dissimilar to Marazhai's.{/n}

091bc35b-d1bb-4db7-81e1-35cb9b0d1fca.Text: {n}The negotiator bows deeply, not daring to look at your companion.{/n} "Greetings, Marazhai Aezyrraesh, Dracon of the Kabal of the Reaving Tempest, Eviscerator of Illiridos, Blaze of the Barkhag Kingdom, and Slayer of Carrocius the Pale."

058e5433-3bf0-42b8-bfc2-4b697874b7fc.Text: {n}The negotiator bows his head slightly, his eyes not leaving Marazhai's.{/n} "Greetings, Marazhai Aezyrraesh, Dracon of the Kabal of the Reaving Tempest."

04d0fdf9-9ed2-4722-94dd-4c20be5d4c7d.Text: {n}The glares the negotiator casts at the Dracon of the Reaving Tempest can hardly be called respectful, they are practically oozing contempt.{/n} "Marazhai."

5ae1479f-38d1-4609-bf13-777e7fcbcdcb.Text: {n}Your companion responds to the stranger with a wry smile.{/n} "Kharael... But of course. I am not surprised that it was you, my sister's envoy, who managed to survive the death of his mistress. Why are you here?"

b1d7dc90-2316-4884-b31a-7025f177feb9.Text: {n}Your companion nods back at the Drukhari.{/n} "Kharael. My deceased sister's chief envoy. Tell me why you have sought me out."

168778ec-dc5f-452c-bc19-3d0ec9b5e938.Text: {n}A smug smile blossoms on Marazhai's face.{/n} "Kharael... Your sycophantic skills have not dulled since you lost your mistress. They will be of use to you yet. Speak."

4ffdc086-49f4-42f5-b482-70d47b0b0995.Text: "The Reaving Tempest is dying." {n}The Drukhari speaks slowly, carefully choosing his words.{/n} "Since the death of Archon Yremeryss, our territories have been ravaged and our warriors openly attacked, mercenaries have turned their blades against our Kabalites, and the air is rife with rumours that our supreme patrons will soon allow our spire to be consigned to a bloody reaping..."
