b6b9cad2-558a-482a-baa6-8ccadc3f0b14.Text: "Over his many years of service, Governor Drivestem earned Theodora's trust, and he holds his high office for a reason." {n}Sauerback's tone is stern and imperious.{/n} "On behalf of House Sauerback, I support his accusations."

9528f32d-1b81-458b-8baa-707b231d2206.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, Governor Drivestem has always faithfully served the Rogue Traders of House von Valancius and concerned himself with the future of your trade dynasty, and so... House Gaprak thinks his charges against House Werserian to be sound." {n}The augmetics hide Toriana's emotion, but her voice sounds slightly timorous.{/n}

72a13d26-d921-4af0-9e8b-15de0e7733ca.Text: "I humbly ask you to allow me to speak in defence of my family's honour. The evidence provided by the governor is utterly false. I cannot refute it but I can say with confidence that no one from my family has ever tried to forge documents in the Adeptus Administratum, let alone undermine the economy of your capital."

ee362f02-fe95-48cc-92e0-2ce3c33179be.Text: "Kindly allow me to speak as well, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!" {n}Hetka Sauerback offers you an eager bow.{/n} "The opportunity to serve on your ship is a great honour for me and my family. These charges are grievous indeed and thus require the attention of the Rogue Trader. Should you decide to conduct an investigation, I would be happy to assist."

fcdf0570-3fc5-48c1-bd15-4d781e5ab60c.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, allow me to speak as well. I am grateful for the privilege of serving under you. The evidence against House Werserian is quite solid, but I... doubt their culpability. Should you decide to personally resolve this case, then I humbly ask you to speak to me. Perhaps I can be of use to you."

eb5d1771-653c-439e-a4d6-fef0eaa2040c.Text: "My apologies, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, but I wish to speak too..." {n}Regina looks into your eyes with a tender half-smile, then turns her gaze on her husband.{/n} "Of course, I agree with my husband. Governor Drivestem would not press charges against anyone if he were not absolutely certain of the authenticity of the evidence he had unearthed."

d73f6436-e07b-4bd1-ac2d-c7bf57c5d44d.Text: "I think anyone here would agree that anyone who ever doubts the authority of the true Rogue Trader should be prosecuted. I am sure, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, that you will eradicate the scourge of heresy from your domain." {n}Regina bows to you deferentially while maintaining eye contact with you.{/n}

e40e8db3-ffed-4247-a4f8-88ddb86820b8.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! 'Tis an honour!" {n}Governor Urbend Drivestem seems to materialise out of thin air, so suddenly does he emerge from the crowd.{/n} "I regret that such unfortunate circumstances have occasioned the Rogue Trader's visit to the capital."

da49fd33-8a79-4db4-b54a-10364b1f5ac7.Text: "Disruption of logistical lines, bribery of Adeptus Administratum officials, document forgery, and organisation of heretical insurrections. On top of the evidently devastating economic impact this has had on your protectorate, these criminal acts have impeded the delivery of the Imperial Tithe, which, in turn, has drawn the Administratum's attention. Needless to say, the esteemed Adeptus Arbites cannot ignore this situation either, and before their representatives arrive at the palace, we are obligated to identify and punish those responsible."

7bc8a5a3-34ef-4372-9584-af689be33dae.Text: "The Rogue Trader is undoubtedly here to listen to the testimony of each and every one of us — and to punish the traitors." {n}The governor's words, directed at Clementia, are harsh. They are echoed by the scornful sneers and whispers of the assembled nobles.{/n}

f8c2caaa-2ad2-4502-a58d-f245d86122e4.Text: "Allow me to introduce my son, Cornelius." {n}The governor points to the lanky young man standing beside him. He bows curtly but avoids meeting your eye.{/n} "Cornelius holds a prestigious position at the Administratum Palace and it is thanks to him that we managed to identify and trace the entire chain of forged documents. The investigation led us to the perpetrators, who admitted to acting on the orders of members of House Werserian. It was they who were intent on spreading the idea of restoring the title of Rogue Trader to the 'true' heir."

909a7bb1-4928-4e83-a34c-0fdd75f4753b.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I humbly beg your pardon..." {n}Drivestem bows once again, trying to placate you.{/n} "You see, right before your arrival, the palace guard discovered a plot to assassinate you. Fortunately, the malefactors were disposed of before they could cause you any harm."

93ef4c7a-7a80-4590-b88a-a32a89bb7a71.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, House Werserian denies all charges laid against it." {n}Clementia glances at the governor with defiance.{/n} "These last few months have indeed been trying for Dargonus, but we have done our best to remedy the situation. My family's every effort was focused on stabilising the capital's logistics and economy — so much so that we failed to notice the web of intrigue unfolding behind our backs."

95a6c864-5937-4f26-ab54-c76e9e07ab19.Text: "I am already here, which means the Adeptus Arbites has started its official enquiry. You may cool your enthusiasm, Governor — you are already too late to rectify your mistakes."

38af412a-e4d5-4937-bdb7-0b8b1d39f3b9.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! These accusations against my family simply make no sense. I humbly beseech you to speak with Clementia."

b0a28a2b-fbca-41b9-b589-82a467ab4ee8.Text: The cheap and tacky clothes of the assailants are smeared with blood.

04fc7319-602c-478a-a4d6-adae51d0a546.Text: There was a crumpled-up letter in the inside pocket of an assailant's blood-soaked jacket.

cbff9c5e-fd01-4085-ac50-f099b2458f0f.Text: In the shadow behind a bench, a small bottle of wine lies hidden. It exudes an exquisite and oddly familiar scent.

03ecc870-e5f2-4ab1-8007-cf43cced1fd5.Text: "Ladies and gentlemen, please, stand aside! No need to crowd around. Governor Drivestem will take care of everything..."

118ee00a-0f4c-4194-9498-c23aaee13019.Text: "This is ridiculous! Such a thing happening right in the Rogue Trader's palace!"

45d57c36-af00-4cb1-9d96-5ef05ba90481.Text: "Y-Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! You're here. Allow me to explain..."

42754ab8-3fa6-4109-89de-5814d3fc3d69.Text: The bodies bear multiple wounds. It is evident that they died recently.

bc135028-8872-4098-a7ea-6083555d5551.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, are you... leaving already? But everyone is waiting so eagerly for your verdict... I humbly ask you to speak to Governor Drivestem before leaving..."

bec89cf4-a2b1-4d81-8d28-c65a846a276d.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! You can find Governor Drivestem in the throne room."

3d534be9-e68f-4a45-a024-104063441081.Text: "All of Dargonus high society has descended upon the palace today..."

f8b2e9ba-55be-4b3f-861b-de5bc07e9011.Text: "The palace wardens... are standing guard, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! No one will disturb you and your guests from now on."

953d4c8d-8c8d-467d-8fc8-563463a55a39.Text: "All this fuss over the Werserians. They do not deserve so much attention..."

2ef065db-aec6-48c2-b102-4e2ebf70217d.Text: "Hey! Where did all the servants go? I want some wine."

43d3a23e-0bc4-443c-a9ad-371129f37f32.Text: "The Werserians are under guard in the throne room. My gut tells me more blood will be spilt again before long... How exciting!"

cc35d2ee-008b-4540-929d-19a42e56e42c.Text: "My apologies, milord, but you cannot go any further. Governor Drivestem's orders."

7ede3776-579e-4eed-b94b-b2f3d32f5eab.Text: "Move over! Let {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship} the Rogue Trader through!"

8ff00b9b-13c1-4b92-800a-89f88e20ee28.Text: "Let me through! I have an appointment with Chancellor Clementia Werserian!"

41ce1829-e8ab-4a1e-9b10-a0c40b0004b8.Text: The man, swaying slightly, is mumbling a prayer to the Emperor.

87bda7f5-c7c0-451c-9dad-b50a10d1ecab.Text: "I saw Lord Gaprak conversing with someone here, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}..."

92f6c9bf-11d9-48d3-bd38-7418fe72ab47.Text: "It was an honour to assist you..."

f99b19a2-f781-4bd8-b83e-140491be56b9.Text: "The governor holds his high office for a reason. His loyalty and service to the Rogue Trader are beyond doubt."

7fce5ac3-53db-40d9-9622-31f923b54427.Text: "The Werserians have taken things too far. It is lucky that Lord Urbend managed to uncover their grubby plot so quickly."

6691e05d-2a65-4928-b7be-394f0b9a2d9a.Text: "The Werserians are nothing but a bunch of upstarts. What have they ever done to deserve their standing?"

ee43ab64-23db-4622-8bad-cc479c49f8f3.Text: "We are loyal servants of our Rogue Trader, the true heir of Theodora von Valancius..."

f4018950-500b-47a4-98cb-49451112e5aa.Text: "By the order of the Rogue Trader, the members of House Drivestem are sentenced to death for heresy and crimes against the von Valancius trade dynasty!"

b1bdb197-d136-40f9-b177-d79468e03891.Text: "By the order of the Rogue Trader, the members of House Gaprak are sentenced to death for heresy and crimes against the von Valancius trade dynasty!"

f03a38e9-07e6-4761-af30-026f6ad4e8b3.Text: "By order of the Rogue Trader, Regina Sauerback is sentenced to death for heresy and crimes against the von Valancius trade dynasty!"

065eafa2-1d02-44ab-bfad-bc295cc336e6.Text: "By the order of the Rogue Trader, the members of House Sauerback are sentenced to death for heresy and crimes against the von Valancius trade dynasty!"

1fbc7bd5-1733-4ef2-8ee5-181145274026.Text: "By the order of the Rogue Trader, the members of House Werserian are sentenced to death for heresy and crimes against the von Valancius trade dynasty!"

369c3bf9-aedb-4121-97da-b39280ada796.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! House Gaprak thanks you for the honour of serving you!"

37d65462-4b74-44b0-a1f2-36e70ed00903.Text: "Have you seen Halen today? We came together, but I haven't seen him since. He will miss out on all the fun if he doesn't hurry up."

edf09a97-53cc-4a52-8984-bca1f32f848e.Text: "Halen? Yes, I did see him briefly. He looked awfully tense, like he was fit to explode. I think he was headed toward the entrance hall, where the altars are. Do you think he knows something about the Werserians' crimes?"

cebde9b3-5c6d-4a9d-ae05-25748e4d7e57.Text: "Him? As if! He never had any business with those... arrogant parvenus."

b35b6b66-d180-4529-9935-3f28e6c41c8b.Text: "Does Governor Drivestem really have evidence of the Werserians' guilt?"

b4f0dad8-ebf3-4ebb-a79d-0ec804069b19.Text: "How could the Werserians act against {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship}? Unthinkable..."

ed407ecf-fd03-472a-86bb-a8913f076b90.Text: "The heretics deserve to be exposed and executed. Even those among us."

543d356c-fd0f-4a6a-8bf4-c635ddd166e9.Text: "People are saying that Theodora wanted to name someone else as her heir... Nonsense! There is only one true Rogue Trader."

04b9e56d-4ec2-4155-a062-6264c61d33f9.Text: "You claim you knew nothing about the attack, is that right? I'll put that in your file. When you end up on a penal world, the warden will be interested to read it..."

0aebaff1-73c9-4d36-aecc-a10e4cd01520.Text: "The Werserians thought too highly of themselves. Luckily, their brush with power has been brief."

e2bc82b3-0031-4bcf-a08e-9b20c7025386.Text: "As long as Macharius is the head of our house, we have nothing to worry about."

6219c4ee-83e3-4512-a058-b2c1881305cd.Text: "House Sauerback has faithfully served the von Valancius dynasty of Rogue Traders. We have never given anyone cause to doubt our loyalty."

96a36151-6b61-4a97-b516-8c52b5f9cb1b.Text: "{mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship} will make the right decision and punish the culprits — you can be sure of that."

f91f2ca3-165a-4278-8271-839c443a55db.Text: "I recognise this bouquet. House Sauerback usually serves this wine."

ad4065d6-4443-4e8a-b467-0be356c11bf3.Text: "Oh, that scent! Spicy, a bit tart... I am almost sure that I have tasted a wine with this bouquet before... Mon cher, House Sauerback usually serves this wine to their guests."

008d7aac-36f0-47f0-bd79-bffdbbd03487.Text: "Reporting on current actions: data extraction from the memory repository of the servitor will take three standard Terran cycles. Data decoding will take 30 standard Terran cycles."

1c930c1d-e418-4999-a67c-d48da726ad65.Text: "Please, let me go, my lord... I didn't see anything!"

ecf32552-cf0e-4e3e-9f87-29440821aa57.Text: "I am just a servant, milord... I am a loyal subject of the Emperor. I serve only Him and our esteemed Rogue Trader!"

50b8b7c0-475f-4fcb-8d05-28a8ff7d0e21.Text: "Please don't send me to the mines! I'll tell you everything I saw..."

9d4ddb6e-dcc2-4fd3-b2bd-155a36bad240.Text: "All these charges... there cannot possibly be any evidence to corroborate them! We are not involved in any plot."

237872f5-30a3-4eaa-a490-8e6ae160f6a0.Text: "Every Werserian has dedicated their life to serving the von Valancius dynasty. We do not betray our ideals."

2d3bec73-f3b8-45f8-beef-379bfe55dac8.Text: "Lady Clementia... She won't let us be killed, will she?"

a1d767e2-451e-48ab-8595-9d005756278b.Text: "Trumped-up charges are the only reason we are standing here today — nothing more."

85ce03cd-bef4-4339-b626-0449dcc43f7c.Text: "My lady, please, calm down. Did you see what happened here?"

c16b45e9-de37-48d4-b091-1e1c7f8910a3.Text: "It was terrible! They seemed to be ordinary low-ranking aristocrats, what with their tasteless, gaudy clothes, and then... they pulled out weapons! Goodness gracious! Pass me the wine, please."

d1c211e2-b522-40a2-82a9-7752148f7ada.Text: "Thank you, my lady. Do you remember anything else, by any chance?"

f793e915-dbee-4bb2-abe0-4fd18b0fa98c.Text: "I do not remember anything else... Throne have mercy, I am quite overcome! I need to sit down..."

4473e999-c873-464e-8cbe-3960401e74be.Text: "The finest soldiers of House Sauerback, at your service, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"

3499b55e-5e7e-40af-8e26-ee022456abdb.Text: [Try to determine the cause of death]

fdf30ab9-06a6-4def-b4a8-faf373604ce0.Text: {n}A finely dressed man of middle years is kneeling in front of the altar, his palms folded in prayer close to his face. The implant-free parts of his skin are a sickly blue colour. The nobleman does not react to your presence: he does not lift his head, he does not blink, he does not even breathe. Only when you draw closer do you realise that he is dead.{/n}

b464a775-f665-4b8f-93a3-bc8523f940bb.Text: {n}Abelard looks at the man, his eyes grim.{/n} "The colours of House Gaprak. I do not believe he decided to take his own life in such an extravagant way."

cbdc665d-23b8-4aa4-862c-17b48a651bc6.Text: {n}Pasqal's visor emits a series of clicks. He points to the dead man's neck without hesitation.{/n} "I am registering an injection site."

a464cfb7-a057-41f9-8bf9-df7dae19d988.Text: "As far as I know, there is a warden post here, but I do not see any wardens." {n}The Seneschal looks around.{/n} "There is no one to ask about what happened here or with whom this man spoke before he died. I would like to ask Urbend where the palace guard suddenly disappeared to..."

01b1122b-a4a3-4594-a1ff-1cf502dbb2bb.Text: {n}Heinrix leans toward the dead man.{/n} "A familiar sight. There are poisons that rapidly damage the nervous system, causing paralytic spasms throughout the body once injected. The victims usually suffocate slowly and painfully, unable to call for help."

64b603f1-8ed4-4b55-9937-ca87bb5b1029.Text: {n}Death came for him suddenly and ravaged his body with cramping spasms that prevented him from falling to the ground. Some rare poisons have such side effects. The affected victim suffocates slowly without being able to move or call for help.{/n}

d5ea811a-be2c-47e7-8743-b5b05eb7975c.Text: {n}Death found this man in the middle of a holy prayer to the Emperor, but it is impossible to determine the cause of such a quick and eerie death.{/n}

187c2a93-c3b2-43ef-b6a7-b46e7d6f231f.Text: {n}There are no visible wounds on the body, but near the edge of the gold-trimmed collar, you notice a tiny puncture in his blue skin, likely a wound caused by a thin needle.{/n}

6eb226d2-2f85-4196-9197-2c328f05d76f.Text: {n}Yrliet watches you examine the body before pointing to the neck.{/n} "Look closer."

149cee6f-bb81-4016-b959-5a8e745cf05d.Text: {n}You are almost certain that wardens are usually stationed nearby... but their post is empty. Where have they gone? This would be an excellent question to put to Governor Drivestem.{/n}

7d4cf6b9-6f68-44c7-8998-0dee236f9441.Text: {n}You closely examine the body. You cannot identify any wounds or any other obvious causes of death.{/n}

8964c2a0-2899-47ce-9511-e6bae425ba1a.Text: {n}You discover a secret pocket in the lining of the dead man's luxurious jacket. You find a folded piece of paper inside, hiding behind a handkercher embroidered with the initials "H.G."{/n}

a58d8a3d-9f2d-4a5a-8444-f809a9e8702e.Text: {n}Marazhai watches you, then he snorts.{/n} "Blind creatures... {name}, look at the neck."

c300d996-8a05-4c4b-b6ea-1deaf5cdc029.Text: "What a surprise, you are versed in the art of underhanded murder. Have you often resorted to the coward's weapon in your life, rather than fighting fair?"

d52e704a-44ae-477c-bd81-27745c4e1044.Text: "I have. All of my victims were enemies of the Imperium who could not have been reached by any other means. Would you prefer they still be alive, my lord Ulfar?" {n}Heinrix meets the Wolf's menacing gaze with dignity, ignoring the almost palpable wave of threat emanating from the Angel of the Emperor.{/n}

79bc964d-b46f-49e8-b8ed-50239c5c05ae.Text: {n}Kibellah quickly examines the body.{/n} "This man was poisoned. A paralysing toxin. The victim cannot scream, call for help, attract attention... or even breathe. A good tool for silent killing. I have made use of it in the past."

b959e4e6-5ae4-450f-9596-4916f53e0e31.Text: {n}The cyber-mastiff sniffs loudly along the length of the corpse, before coming to a stop at the dead man's neck, whereupon he lets out a low, intermittent growl.{/n}

f95e8651-ab61-409f-a0dd-50b26d43f355.Text: "Glaito has found an injection mark and has also registered traces of poison. Very faint traces — must be a rapidly decaying toxin. But it's nothing a cyber-mastiff's nose can't catch."

034681df-7cbb-4841-8a93-766b9c3fac5b.Text: {n}A shadow falls across Abelard's face. His tone is unwavering, but you hear the soft ring of regret in it.{/n} "The noble dynasty and all its branches have been found guilty of heresy. By the order of the Rogue Trader, the entire house will be executed. The sentence is to be carried out immediately."

7106234e-99a3-4c5e-99db-23faffe1abaf.Text: "Who aided you? There is no way you managed all this on your own."

c7851307-0fab-44aa-93f7-655763b41eb8.Text: "The charges brought by Governor Drivestem were fabricated. House Werserian had nothing to do with the orchestration of the riots or the plot targeting the Rogue Trader. However, the real perpetrators are here in this very room..."

811cdecf-9758-4abb-bb67-0d0e52bf0930.Text: "I wish to hear your reasoning again. What makes you think the Werserians are behind the plot against me?"

4dddeda3-2102-48f7-b2d6-b93bd58b6262.Text: "All of the assailants were high-functioning servitors. Such servitors are only employed by families close to the Adeptus Mechanicus."

398e7ae2-1afd-476b-890a-32d3f2eb28ac.Text: "Tell me more about your son, Drivestem."

e809b9c3-a3bf-47d6-bcd9-e289fc417bee.Text: "...House Drivestem guilty. I shall not forgive your negligence and the false accusations you cast against House Werserian."

3b9754f6-6e8e-46b0-9ba0-098df7ba1e17.Text: "...House Gaprak guilty. You have lost my trust since the incident on Kiava Gamma."

7b3b27a2-7294-4067-8d57-8ca0f29ec204.Text: "Cornelius, what is the true reason for your nervousness?"

f172cd9a-f9d9-4120-a82e-7684dcbef60a.Text: "In the conspiracy against the Rogue Trader, I find..."

622c4218-c5fe-4d1f-93a1-de48ee3fbefb.Text: "I am too busy to deal with this. I find the Werserians guilty."

a9d988e9-ba54-4b57-9382-8e2291aee01a.Text: "Summon everyone. I am ready to pronounce my verdict."

bbb62606-d376-403a-8b40-20dab6c29039.Text: "Urbend Drivestem, you have exhibited inexcusable negligence by failing to question the possible involvement of any other family besides the Werserians. We have discovered that the attempt on my life was orchestrated by a member of House Gaprak."

0317f420-1fdb-45f7-a58a-ef47740b995a.Text: "I know that House Sauerback offered their help to the Gapraks and the late Halen Gaprak seemed to have accepted the offer. I suspect that you are responsible for his death as well."

f02b32d1-4d3a-4c22-887d-4279d9ca6f6e.Text: "Cornelius Drivestem, I hereby sentence you to death. Immediately."

c21a0b3e-a502-4a40-a761-e9095072fe8c.Text: "There was no one near the deceased — the wardens had left their post. Did you order them to do so?"

bfd9cb29-166d-4957-b816-9c52ce01a8e0.Text: "Did you see Halen Gaprak today before I arrived?"

5c5bd671-6639-4097-9521-6f7750dd0135.Text: "I found a dead body in my palace. A member of House Gaprak was slain in front of an altar. Do you know anything about it?"

55137b3e-ff87-452e-95cf-00dbc19ba83d.Text: "What do you make of this letter? I found it on one of the assailants."

b8518f1d-66d4-406a-9cb0-0deb62b790c2.Text: "...House Sauerback guilty. Seneschal, you may take it from here."

170c9b7c-2099-46db-a4d3-8331dbf354dc.Text: "What is this 'friend' that approached you, Cornelius? How did the two of you communicate?"

1ac69c79-8651-4be5-9a54-7861abd9b218.Text: "...House Gaprak guilty. One of your members orchestrated an attack on the Rogue Trader — treason by anyone's reckoning."

36124c10-2206-4370-9c54-2e8fadb91986.Text: "...House Sauerback guilty. The head of your family has never tried to hide his attitude toward me. That is more than enough to convict him."

b41eb681-fc47-4b88-815c-e22e95714cf9.Text: [Place your hand on your weapon] "You are speaking to a Rogue Trader. And my patience is running out."

04d97729-91bd-416d-ad86-90c648790ace.Text: "I see you cannot contain your awe in the face of the grand persona of your {mf|lord|lady}. I will not trouble you with any more questions."

6030b0de-bc80-45a1-9825-65e64929df95.Text: "Urbend Drivestem, you have accused House Werserian of violations that were in truth the result of a grave error committed by your son."

d52c6b8c-7fec-45c7-8e61-7d1651fae9bc.Text: "Toriana Gaprak, a member of your family orchestrated an assassination attempt against me — here, in my own palace. And though he has already been found dead, his act is reason enough to forever brand your house as traitors."

cc4da4cb-2d6f-4327-b180-c1fc7a68d21c.Text: "Macharius Sauerback, your overt contempt toward me is reason enough to implicate you in the conspiracy."

1f9e8f4d-c73e-46da-a9c6-803ed135aa2c.Text: "Are you afraid to talk to me? Perhaps you would be more comfortable speaking to an Interrogator of the Inquisition."

28685fd8-2c66-44ef-9cf8-611ab80d9454.Text: "The poor soul is so frightened... perhaps I should leave and let Marazhai speak in my place. You are familiar with my Drukhari companion, aren't you?"

b7f83ed5-d874-49f4-bffd-935e055faa6d.Text: "Urbend, your son has found the courage to admit his mistake. I will try and find some compassion for him in my heart."

47b97faa-47ba-43bb-a213-eb56d587d3cb.Text: "The entire family. The foul blood will be wiped out."

3a7a28be-0e11-4134-8328-ccc77eadde08.Text: "I will not exterminate an entire noble line that is loyal to me just because of one traitor."

85ce9dbf-1a3b-4633-93b4-aa28b82bff2b.Text: "The charges brought by Governor Drivestem were fabricated. House Werserian had nothing to do with the orchestration of the riots or the plot targeting the Rogue Trader. And yet this matter is far from concluded..."

a79797e0-38e7-4e54-bef4-8fe5b51f894f.Text: "Tell me more about your job, Cornelius. What do you do?"

47b677d6-4a4e-462e-baff-06aa55380570.Text: "How did you manage to find the forged documents in the bureaucratic hell that is the Administratum?"

cac03175-cb41-44ea-b805-4e88c9d84600.Text: "But does House Werserian have access to the Adeptus Administratum? There is no conceivable way they could do all of this in a place where they do not hold any power."

537fa1c4-4ab0-4412-80e5-dab874b82e0a.Text: "Abelard, the sentence has yet to be carried out. Finish this."

d1cff0af-b9f6-4003-9ea7-bd49537b7366.Text: "I thought there could have been something special between us."

b626f5c0-e639-4f14-a931-14a2c5cfb34e.Text: {n}Governor Drivestem is surrounded by his retinue, who are all dressed in expensive gowns and finery. The matching colour scheme of their outfits and the striking physical resemblance among them suggest that they all come from one family.{/n}

85739a66-ffb4-4c5c-9e87-e2ad52026bd2.Text: {n}When you approach them, the conversations die down. The governor bows his head in deference.{/n} "How may I serve you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}? Are you ready to pronounce your verdict yet?"

aaff5091-1a1e-41f3-b401-e8c7b8641a83.Text: "Mother..." {n}Upon realising what has happened, Hetka recoils from his mother.{/n}

be7a7e12-123c-47db-9bc1-8bf0736dd448.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Thank you for giving this case your undivided attention." {n}The governor bows and the rest hasten to follow suit.{/n}

1de9b89f-42a3-4d95-9259-ea0c7f41c7ac.Text: "When compiling reports on last cycle's supply chain, I noticed inaccuracies and discrepancies in the figures. With the help of the other clerks, I managed to find several other documents..." {n}Cornelius stammers and swallows noisily.{/n} "Comprehensive data analysis has shown that the discrepancies were caused by intentional tampering with the data, thus leading to some logistical problems that were practically unsolvable."

ceecfccf-591e-469d-b112-85243b32246b.Text: "It would be my pleasure to speak to the esteemed Cornelius Drivestem. In private, for his father's peace of mind."

0ded0938-fa56-4f8c-a84d-a096e8bf8d64.Text: {n}Marazhai rubs his hands together, producing a repulsive metallic grating sound.{/n} "We will become friends. I promise."

34980843-3578-458b-a5b8-53df3790b80b.Text: {n}The air in the room is frozen with a tense, almost electrified silence. All the nobles — some with fear and others with reverent anticipation — await your verdict...{/n}

1072fcf1-5a37-4fd9-8db1-dc13f6260f92.Text: {n}Urbend Drivestem's face grows paler by the second. A woman's sobs can be heard from behind him, and they soon turn into desperate wails.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}... I accept your decision... with dignity."

d2ae9b6c-3397-4e3d-907c-ffda4083bc84.Text: {n}Many faces are watching you: each and every one awaiting the Rogue Trader's verdict with bated breath.{/n}

9c414fce-f59a-434a-bcca-b23a43381767.Text: {n}Governor Drivestem tensely bows and replies without hesitation,{/n} "Understood, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Allow me to prepare everything..."

c961d712-ff55-41ba-bd45-147fbe777560.Text: "I will not go against your despicable verdict. I will accept it. House Sauerback has never given you any reason to doubt our loyalty and, thus, I will accept death with pride, for there is more honour in that than in serving the likes of you." {n}He raises his chin defiantly, and it seems as if he is suddenly looking down on you from a great height.{/n}

da22f0d8-bf2d-4f45-8375-020c4522a63b.Text: {n}Regina takes a breath to say something, but stops at the last moment. Her beautiful face does not express anything but frosty resignation.{/n}

1718c214-1c83-4451-a48d-2779616e74e9.Text: {n}Abelard steps forward and stares intently at House Sauerback's patriarch.{/n} "Macharius, I must admit I have always admired your bluntness. But just as I once had to say goodbye to a promotion because of my dislike for intrigue, you — and your family — might soon say goodbye to your heads. Tell me now in your blunt fashion: are you loyal to House von Valancius?"

45687bda-861f-47c0-9ab8-a8868460f7ed.Text: {n}Abelard shakes his head.{/n} "And you called my family's honour into question, Urbend. Nevertheless, I harbour no desire to kick a man when he is down. Lord Captain, the confession you have obtained means that House Werserian can now be cleared of all charges."

3c74b805-8c9e-4412-8521-24b043748710.Text: {n}The Seneschal's hard gaze softens. An elusive gesture, visible only to you, conveys the message: "Toriana Gaprak is guilty only of her own poor judgement."{/n}

4ecd55c0-6e2e-42e3-88d7-7572aa8caed3.Text: "Emperor forbid, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!" {n}The governor helplessly throws his hands up in the air as if to signify his powerlessness.{/n}

cb559f2c-6d6e-4f1a-a830-7f38aa65eacc.Text: "Halen? I did not see him myself, but perhaps..." {n}The governor turns around and asks his family,{/n} "Have any of you seen him today?"

9dc248ec-05a8-4e77-bfda-d6d829f050ae.Text: "Indeed." {n}Abelard looks into your face for just a few moments, then turns away.{/n} "As you wish, Lord Captain."

85be8817-144c-439d-8d4e-288438bd5fa4.Text: "Lord Captain, I think we should go to that spot and have a look around. I am not sure what exactly we might find there, but today is a day full of surprises... mostly nasty ones."

19e5c4c5-4c4d-4333-af25-5bbd7c476609.Text: {n}Macharius does not have time to respond — Regina, who is standing beside him, raises her arm as if to slap the elderly Seneschal. Abelard deftly catches her wrist, stopping her hand right in front of his face. Her dainty hand is adorned with a massive augmetic ring topped with a thin spike dripping with venom.{/n}

9f65f38e-0d84-4abb-8b8d-f9dd05c3ff54.Text: "Macharius, your bluntness makes you an open book. When I talked about helping the Gapraks, you had no idea what I was referring to. Your wife, on the other hand... her eyes started shifting like you would not believe. Regina Sauerback, you alone betrayed the Rogue Trader, jeopardising the prosperity of the von Valancius trade dynasty. And you alone are responsible for your unmasking."

c8304d4a-ab1d-4ae2-8e64-7c575d10d5d6.Text: "As soon as the logistical and economic problems gave rise to the initial rumours, we tried to find the person responsible for spreading the calls for Voigtvir's return. The investigation showed that some of the documents inside the Adeptus Administratum were forgeries. We can thank my son, Cornelius, for such astute observations."

06360b06-ecd4-493a-a45d-fb1bc6d3262d.Text: "High-functioning servitors?" {n}Drivestem ponders this, rubbing his chin with his thumb.{/n} "Such servitors are indeed rare and the Gapraks do have them in their service, but this could have been done intentionally with an eye to confusing you. Anyone with the desire and sufficient funds can hire them."

d8d4344c-aed4-49de-97c4-e44d9640466d.Text: "A member of House Gaprak was killed in the palace?" {n}The governor's eyes bulge in surprise.{/n} "And no one noticed? But how... there are wardens posted at every altar..."

e4a375ae-40cf-4c5a-bdd0-ec6c942aee21.Text: "Son, show due respect. Forgive him, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. This is the first time he has had the honour of attracting the attention of the Rogue Trader."

b9b3a005-69f4-4018-8804-500f8f8f4e65.Text: {n}Governor Drivestem peers closely at the blood-stained paper.{/n} "It looks like another piece of evidence incriminating House Werserian. Perhaps they truly did intend to kill you, or at least cause a stir to help them escape custody during the confusion that followed."

e57f6bdf-81f1-4eb1-bbf5-61736ffe4cda.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}..." {n}A slender young man bows to you awkwardly and nervously licks his dry lips.{/n} "I assure you that my humble person is undeserving of your attention..."

e6a967e3-a3b1-4983-a202-ee25a192dfc9.Text: "Cornelius holds a prestigious position at the Administratum Palace and it was he who discovered the errors leading to the disrupted logistics. It is also thanks to him that we found the perpetrators of the forgeries, who admitted to acting on the orders of House Werserian."

1924c336-27dd-48a1-8e7d-1583aeb9ba75.Text: {n}Abelard studies Sauerback, then suddenly nods.{/n} "You are not lying. But someone else is, someone who is poised to destroy both you and your family for her own gain."

b71cf2c6-c22e-4dc6-bf22-9e9fe7a477bc.Text: {n}The young man's pupils suddenly dilate. He stands at attention and replies to you in one breath:{/n} "This is the first time I have spoken face to face with the Rogue Trader... I am afraid of saying something wrong or forgetting something important."

4d284cc6-3447-49e3-9232-099c2bd98613.Text: {n}The governor closely watches his son. His tone changes, now sounding strict and curt:{/n} "Do you wish to tell the Lord Captain anything else?"

034aa7c7-c7bb-4cd8-b695-cac60f3ea3e7.Text: {n}Heinrix narrows his eyes and, glancing at you, shakes his head.{/n}

842735bf-da0b-4365-bb45-b385e8df734a.Text: {n}You see the flash of terror in Cornelius's eyes as he stares at your hand on your weapon. He speaks quietly and confusedly, without raising his head:{/n} "Forgive me, forgive me, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}... I... I... can't do it anymore."

827f48ba-2a9b-4667-976d-6ffb704e4138.Text: {n}Like the spike on her ring, Regina's words are dripping with poison and rage.{/n} "Because Dargonus is serving an impostor. The true heir of the protectorate bears a different name! When Kunrad appeared on Dargonus, he paid me a visit — and opened my eyes to the truth of the situation. Theodora was killed by the one whom she had so unwarily taken under her wing!"

6a396789-edb6-4327-85c4-d1943005bd65.Text: {n}Sauerback shifts his confused gaze from his wife to Abelard, then back again. The stiff arrogance has vanished from his posture.{/n} "Regina... You?"

a8abce16-ec4d-4c01-877b-1b22cab1fcf5.Text: {n}A shiver ripples through Toriana's body and she looks on the verge of fainting but manages to stay on her feet. The augmetics on her face emit an unpleasant click before she starts talking.{/n} "As you wish, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. House Gaprak has been loyal to you in life, and will remain loyal... in death."

eab42a57-a1d7-472e-9985-c87998a16478.Text: " Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}... You have done me a great honour by allowing me to serve you..." {n}Vicent's voice is noticeably quivering but his bearing his upright and unwavering.{/n}

27a4c8eb-0ae0-4e98-a664-e7ec902ba990.Text: {n}Cornelius bows and replies, visibly relieved,{/n} "Thank you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"

46b5e197-1af8-4657-8a8c-f36e5ad59e76.Text: "This lie has gone too far, and I can no longer control it... The truth is... is... that all of the logistical problems were caused by a single error in the numbers... My mistake."

afa362b1-8ce3-46eb-88d2-a20b32d798cf.Text: {n}Urbend curls his hands into fists, the knuckles turning white.{/n} "What have you done... How could you... Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!" {n}He suddenly turns to you, as if trying to shield his son.{/n} "This is my fault! I trusted my son and have failed you in doing so! I beg you, have mercy!"

d2724c0c-a4f7-4dc7-973c-1a495e6f0a6c.Text: {n}Cornelius's voice trembles, but he sounds confident:{/n} "I have nothing else to add, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. If my nervousness upon our meeting is the reason for your anger... I humbly ask your forgiveness."

e8603953-95e2-4882-b0ad-ebf2c2dd1fb0.Text: {n}The governor stares at the lifeless body of his son for some time, barely moving a muscle. With trembling lips, he suddenly speaks in a surprisingly firm voice:{/n} "Thank you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. This is a disgrace to my family. I hope I can atone for it."

f305b31b-9039-4502-b200-2cca27541e70.Text: {n}The crowd of nobles meets the end of House Sauerback with cold sneers and reproaches.{/n}

abc417a7-f8f4-416a-b706-e7c874f35c4a.Text: "Oh, of course I didn't. I have too many helpers to list them all, but rest assured there are plenty of them, just as there are plenty of people who follow Master Voigtvir. My death will not change anything — the true Rogue Trader will come and take his rightful place when the time is right."

0df2f308-e78e-4229-bf87-3e19db3fb02a.Text: "Halen was a good agent, but he was also a coward. He came to me just before our formidable Rogue Trader arrived — he was ready to confess everything. I suggested that he plead for the Emperor's forgiveness first... and He did grant him mercy, did He not?"

f0e00519-23b4-461a-8cff-56d65deff9e2.Text: {n}Regina cocks her head and smiles at you, just as sweetly as before.{/n} "I admit I had my regrets about causing you such difficulties. But what was I to do? Duty calls for us to rein in our most genuine desires. Isn't that right, Rogue Trader?"

ce0a9c63-af8e-4f97-b668-f960845e627c.Text: "But we still do not know who was behind the forgeries, the riots, the plot, and the assassination attempt. Someone is committing their foul deeds and sowing chaos right under your subjects' noses. To leave that stone unturned would be... dangerous."

838d9496-1e03-4307-97ba-483e28107018.Text: "It will be done, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Macharius Sauerback, Regina Sauerback, and Hetka Sauerback, as well as the rest of House Sauerback, have been found guilty of heresy. By the order of the Rogue Trader, the entire house is hereby sentenced to death. The sentence is to be carried out immediately."

f92fac5e-bfb7-42e8-87ea-addcdef43e9a.Text: {n}Sauerback narrows his eyes, grimacing.{/n} "I am loyal, Werserian."

15f107cb-5883-4d70-8740-a5aec1cdc0da.Text: "Thank you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!" {n}The governor bows low, then gives his son a look full of bitterness and frustration.{/n} "And as for your position... I think you will be reassigned to a role requiring less responsibility."

68339743-a11f-4264-a44d-1d5d3d47ba7f.Text: {n}A wave of shocked murmuring sweeps through the gathered nobles, then quickly gives way to oppressive silence. Not so much as a whisper interrupts your speech.{/n}

62546fb6-6d4b-4247-8b8d-0cf160959041.Text: {n}The Seneschal nods to you as if urging you to continue, then shifts his piercing gaze to the crowd before you.{/n}

a25c3be9-c132-4d7a-b1b4-d4206399e9df.Text: {n}The governor closes his eyes, fear and shame getting the better of him. Some faces in the crowd look confused and surprised, but you see more wearing expressions of self-satisfied contempt.{/n}

7df73fcd-d140-4f38-9f83-724fdd10d8e4.Text: {n}Mocking whispers creep through the crowd. Toriana is trembling faintly. She still does not raise her head — perhaps out of fear of meeting her fate face to face.{/n}

c3f5f291-0c5b-4fa0-b77b-0f3f8258cfb8.Text: "Your negligence is stunning, Urbend. An assassination attempt followed by a mysterious death, and yet, here you are, oblivious to everything. The Rogue Trader can justly accuse you of allowing a noble to be killed in the palace and of failing even to notice it."

15066e9f-b236-4599-a847-5dd849d5fb22.Text: {n}The crowd remains silent, with only their tense, anxious gazes darting back and forth between you and Macharius. Sauerback's brows rise higher and you notice his jaw working nervously.{/n}

302b2cc6-344d-4934-a2cc-9ce3d25d7812.Text: "It may be so, but it is for the Rogue Trader to accuse me of negligence, not you." {n}The governor addresses you once more.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, accept my deepest apologies for my imprudence. Nothing matters more to me than my honour. I shall send the servants to deal with all this immediately..."

885bcf88-73f2-43cf-8ff3-79d2335e4ead.Text: {n}The nobles talk quietly among themselves, and then a middle-aged woman with a tall, extravagant hairstyle replies to you,{/n} "I think my sister and I saw him sitting on the bench some distance away from the palace's entrance... We think he was accompanied by a gentleman, but, forgive us, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, we could not make out his face."

4f73c3ad-9a95-446d-86cb-1f5047299d41.Text: {n}Sauerback furrows his brows and slightly cocks his head — he averts his gaze for the first time, as if trying to remember or make sense of something. You notice some restless movements behind him.{/n}

a22e8ad3-37b9-4eb9-bbeb-f08c66c31cc1.Text: "He is afraid... Yes, there is enough fear in this runt to feed a small squad."

6844e3ef-31eb-4c68-a209-d0dbd9ad3b0e.Text: {n}Abelard looks from the governor to you and subtly shakes his head, as if to say, "No, it is not Drivestem pulling the strings here."{/n}

e28cc0cf-bc5e-4d45-adb6-0144f94e6dce.Text: {n}Abelard narrows his eyes and scrutinises Macharius Sauerback and his retinue standing behind him. For a second, his sharp eyes seem to have caught sight of something, only to lose track of it the next moment. A disappointed sigh tells you, "It could be a Sauerback... but is he really the one behind all this?"{/n}

9fb0ee65-89cf-42a2-8678-ee46341c1a08.Text: {n}Abelard narrows his eyes and scrutinises Macharius Sauerback and his retinue standing behind him. His sharp eyes light up when he catches sight of something important and hidden in the crowd. The Seneschal looks at you and nods, as if to say: "The puppeteer has given themselves away. Pronounce the verdict."{/n}

486183c6-0e87-4c5f-a9d2-a9c6ae463de2.Text: "Father and I have managed to single out the Administratum clerks responsible for tampering with the data. Following a... heated interrogation, they confessed that they were following the orders of someone from House Werserian. Everything was supposed to look as though they were the ones suffering losses from the logistical and economic problems..."

402d13e8-095e-41ae-bf86-cca0cedf54c7.Text: "When I discovered my mistake... it was almost impossible to restore the supply lines... then... I was approached... by someone who said they were... a friend. They did not give me their name and I never saw their face. They promised to fix the problem. All I had to do was pretend that the Werserians were responsible for the mistake. And as for the rest of the evidence, they promised to arrange it all. And... and..." {n}Cornelius is suffocating with fear, unable to speak.{/n}

e058bad1-9f22-4a1f-8a97-52c2ae79b06c.Text: "By letter. I received a letter out of the blue one day — it was unsigned, but the person writing already knew about my erroneous calculations. They offered to help me cover up my misdeed... and in return, I would name the Werserians as the ones who had sabotaged the supply lines. All I had to do was gather together some documents and reports that were listed in one of the letters... that, and keep my mouth shut."

54512e01-ce4a-4afe-8f96-7ce9609eb8a8.Text: "No! No, please, not that! I... Yes, I have something to say that I omitted before..."

d95a7faf-bf98-4fe4-8124-9ecd8b686197.Text: "Macharius is too narrow-minded to even consider opposing the Rogue Trader, even an illegitimate one. So I had to wait for the right moment... and the disappearance of the Lord Captain could not have come at a better time. It was quite simple to trigger a chain of events on Dargonus so that the people remembered Master Voigtvir's past service — it seems that many of your subjects do not actually consider you a worthy successor."

b8816d25-a9e7-400c-8db8-95fa8eb27896.Text: "Because when stripped of the Seneschal's protection, this house is the weakest one on all of Dargonus. And they are also particularly disliked by the governor's family. It would have been easy to bury the Werserians under accusations of heresy."

7eabc998-46bb-4f53-bad7-c18eb5efce24.Text: {n}Abelard turns his gaze to you.{/n} "Does the Rogue Trader condemn only the rotten apple, or the entire barrel?"

89dc8a07-f105-4b01-a716-19de357f26b9.Text: "Thank you for your interest, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, but I am not worthy of it..." {n}The governor's son bows and stands still as he nervously stares down at the floor.{/n}

6f40de63-ae3b-4d95-b43f-e7681acc40cc.Text: "In that case, Regina Sauerback shall be subjected to intense interrogation followed by execution."

ed7dc47a-f642-4c4b-ad18-5de742753609.Text: {n}The governor stares at you blankly, trying not to look at his son's lifeless body lying nearby.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

3e1860eb-b832-48f9-b829-8bfb9ebf369d.Text: "I manage the documents and records related to the economy of Dargonus. You probably know how scrupulous the workers of the Adeptus Administratum are. I am afraid that a more detailed explanation of my duties would mirror the administrative processes of the Administratum: too long and overly detailed." {n}Cornelius tries to look you in the eye but it is clearly hard for him to do.{/n}

ec717d81-63a9-4aa0-8eda-06fc5ce78184.Text: {n}Before replying, the governor's son nervously adjusts his expensive frock coat.{/n} "I think... the right amount of money can open any door."

eed90f3b-42bd-4fa5-ae20-3f88c8c7b4a7.Text: "In your opinion, which nobles might have a reason to be party to such a conspiracy?"

b5987967-6447-4fab-b22c-110f48c2b61d.Text: "Vicent, you wished to discuss something with me?"

143506ea-0695-4cb3-b66e-5771b4d74658.Text: "Do you think the accusations against the Werserian family are true?"

091dacaf-f7c8-4148-9101-5fcf13053a0d.Text: "I have examined the bodies of the assailants that were killed today. All of them were high-functioning servitors. Such servitors are only employed by families close to the Adeptus Mechanicus, isn't that so?"

e54a9016-0594-436b-b242-85420578d0d6.Text: "Vicent, I wish to speak to you."

3f679939-579b-4cfa-bc7b-2878ddcbe85c.Text: "I discovered a dead body — a member of your house — right here in my palace. He died kneeling in prayer."

7356f45c-73a1-4f0f-9268-bc2b6aef0bb9.Text: "You tell me this even though your family may face death if found guilty of treason?"

8236ec8a-967a-4220-af91-43b1905a8f15.Text: "Understood. Let us return to the others."

44ce6055-d48e-43de-ae6a-d3457db5ac74.Text: "Halen, was it? Tell me about him, Toriana."

1ad7c7dd-9a06-4fdb-8a48-84e63311c79f.Text: "What made you decide to tell me about this?

a61a990b-404a-4b03-87f5-8e6cae324f10.Text: "Could House Gaprak be responsible for the crimes? After the punitive measures taken against you, you have plenty of reasons to undermine my reign."

16bdd671-55ee-458d-ae1d-35c13ccac26f.Text: "I found this note on the bodies of one of the attackers. What are your thoughts on it?"

19f98e6d-25a9-4085-837a-e40029a245b2.Text: "I think your family is involved in this."

7eec3890-3c3d-484a-8260-244143f4f4f5.Text: "What do you make of the charges against the Werserian family? Could they truly be guilty?"

944eb118-ed42-4eea-bd42-9bfeee5ae379.Text: "I know you care for Astartia Werserian. Are you prepared to watch her die?"

75a475c5-58f2-4c5d-86f4-861474f70ae0.Text: "The dead man had a note on him. It mentions some sort of debt."

3f7e39f9-2d26-4084-b127-66bb3c15b2cd.Text: {n}The lords and ladies sumptuously dressed in the colours of House Gaprak are standing in a half-circle around Toriana and her son Vicent. The bodies and faces of almost every member of this dynasty are covered in large, ornate augmetics.{/n}

ba45bd69-de40-4d66-ac28-d7ed739628df.Text: {n}A wave of greetings and respectful bows to you sweeps through the crowd.{/n}

ad587ff2-f85b-416f-a9bb-b18220c3232d.Text: "My family, Lady Toriana, is yet to be found guilty of anything. That verdict is for the Rogue Trader to reach."

340687e4-67f0-4499-8032-223aeec99ef7.Text: "I am grateful for the opportunity to serve you on board your ship and would like to repay you for such largesse..." {n}Vicent looks back at his family before continuing.{/n} "You see, I harbour special, tender feelings toward Astartia Werserian. I think I know something that can help her escape death, though revealing it may jeopardise my own family."

fc48d203-8553-4737-b214-055995cdab11.Text: "Today, I noticed one of my family members to be in an odd, uncharacteristic mood. Halen Gaprak is my paternal second cousin once removed, may the Emperor save his soul. Usually reserved and self-possessed, today he was frantic and anxious, fidgeting with a small piece of paper and seemingly looking for someone to no avail. When I last saw him, he was headed to the entrance hall, where the altars are. Perhaps you should talk to him."

5c24fecc-b322-4f0b-b6a0-329180d34ad8.Text: "Halen is one of the lower-ranking members of House Gaprak... Despite his advanced age, he never held high office, but he was forever striving to better his position, even beyond his abilities. Many members of my house... struggled to cope with the misfortune that befell Kiava Gamma and our family. Some members could not reconcile themselves to our new position. Halen was one of them."

980657c6-44be-4c7f-a294-91b1f8069cfe.Text: "I do not think I can doubt the validity of the accusations, but..." {n}Vicent's voice trails off and he seems to retreat into himself for a moment. Before continuing, he takes a deep breath.{/n} "I am also not sure that House Werserian had a reason to betray you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I do not know of any instance where their loyalty to you and the Emperor was anything less than unwavering."

8fd8fc51-69e7-4dee-97ea-bf406f368864.Text: "I would not take such a responsibility upon myself and rule on their guilt, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I do think Governor Drivestem's accusations are worthy of consideration, however."

6b879747-e193-4c5b-8d45-732eb3d5d13a.Text: {n}It is impossible to read Toriana's emotions in her heavily augmented face, but her sudden turn toward her family betrays her confusion and surprise. Perplexed whispers bounce from one family member to another: "Impossible!"; "We came here by ourselves, without any servitors..."; "We know nothing about it!"{/n}

cf064c2e-205b-415a-b19d-80b6edd307fd.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}... Thank you for informing us of this. You are absolutely right: my house has indeed been endowed with high-functioning servitors — a blessing for those who revere the Omnissiah. But today... none of our house members were accompanied by them."

fbdbadc9-d09c-4cff-8d7f-41ee193f721a.Text: {n}Vicent inclines his head in a respectful bow.{/n}

83ff3b7b-755a-4658-8d0e-45104dd39134.Text: {n}Toriana covers her open mouth with her hand in surprise and, turning to her family, looks for someone among them.{/n} "Halen... It can't be."

448bf30e-3a5e-4e84-9a3e-9e0dcf21471e.Text: {n}Vicent's jaw augmetic screeches slightly. The young man scrutinises his mother and other family members for a few moments.{/n} "There is something you ought to know, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

b1fb08ef-3828-42cc-a2fd-a1efcd4d9d52.Text: {n}Vicent inclines his head in a respectful bow.{/n}

57b1caac-48b0-4cd6-a497-4181a6d5ebff.Text: "We lost Kiava Gamma — a truly devastating blow to every member of House Gaprak. I lost all hope for the future, and my kin lost their sense of purpose. We needed time to recover and chart a new course for ourselves. We were and still are more than capable of doing that. But I will not deny it — the other houses have offered us their assistance... for their own self-serving ends. Perhaps Halen decided to take them up on one of their offers behind my back."

d6f3a904-06c3-46cc-94a3-d8a5252bfed6.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}... A member of my family appears to have been involved in something sinister and paid the price for it, but he was an oddity among the nobles of House Gaprak. We serve the Omnissiah and you." {n}Toriana humbly bows her head.{/n}

6318142b-651a-4dea-a208-f6456ed5a253.Text: "Let me have a look... Oh, Halen... you fool. Forgive me, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, but I have nothing to say. This is the first I have seen of this letter and I have no idea what kind of debt it might refer to."

f9651422-41fa-4f09-a65c-6337631bdabe.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}..." {n}Vicent stammers awkwardly and briefly looks to his family.{/n} "I would like to talk to you about something in private... if you please, kindly hear me out."

bd6735fb-22ac-493f-aa24-4e134ff5c686.Text: "Yes, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Let us talk in private."

7c6b11db-70dd-41e5-8a0d-b20b7a0df8ed.Text: "I could not bear to live knowing that I failed to disclose information that could have saved the innocent." {n}Vicent looks away, embarrassed.{/n}

5ee64d10-3b0f-432c-bd33-684686e29126.Text: {n}Vicent is silent for some time, then replies with a heavy sigh,{/n} "Yes. Perhaps there is still a glimmer of hope left in me that Halen is not involved in any way and will be able to point you to the perpetrator behind all this... But the truth is that my actions right now come from my heart, not my head."

2fe7132b-c9b4-4ed5-b5d6-b9a5b39a01a0.Text: {n}The Seneschal bows ever so slightly and speaks quietly so that only you can hear him:{/n} "Lord Captain, the Gapraks — all or perhaps only some of them — are definitely involved, but I suspect that they were not behind the plot against you. Halen Gaprak could be nothing more than a puppet in the hands of a deft puppet master. We must expose whoever that is if we are to prevent the pestilence of heresy from spreading any further."

7a7ce1fc-fefe-4bd2-9f5d-c539456b1bf6.Text: "Interrogate the heads of the Drivestem and Sauerback houses. One of them has been pulling the strings here. Once we uncover new evidence, announce that the guilty party will be publicly executed. Before you pronounce the verdict, I suggest focusing on each house in your indictment speech, and I shall observe them."

8ad84859-3f4f-4a93-b521-38aebe43039c.Text: "You already have grounds to suspect House Sauerback of the conspiracy and orchestrating the attempt on your life. Governor Drivestem's decision to unjustly accuse House Werserian also casts doubt on his competence. Tell him that you are ready to pronounce your verdict. But before you do so, I suggest focusing on each house in your indictment speech, and I shall observe them."

398d4c67-0928-4f02-becc-1168562d689b.Text: {n}Toriana's eyes widen.{/n} "No, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! My family failed you — it was because of our own actions that our loyalty was called into question... I admit that there are some in my house who were daunted by this fair punishment and chose to lament their fate instead of working to clear the family name. I am taking steps to ensure that their lamentations remain nothing more than empty whining and that House Gaprak may one day earn back your favour."

33ab01b7-ec05-4b71-ba1b-79a6935100ac.Text: {n}Toriana's mechanical fingers grip the paper.{/n} "Officially, high-functioning servitors are employed by my house and my house alone. If such units were to attack the Rogue Trader, suspicion would instantly fall upon the Gapraks. I assume that this is what the Werserians intended to happen, but they did not expect that the servitors would have this letter on them."

4d3fe16e-6375-4fad-8ad0-28fef452e141.Text: {n}Toriana Gaprak curtsies to you. Her mechanical voice sounds distant and indifferent:{/n} "Greetings, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. May the Omnissiah grant you understanding." {n}With a click, her visor oculars swivel to the Seneschal.{/n} "Abelard. It must be difficult for you to be here under these circumstances, with your house standing accused of such a grave crime."

661fe622-0816-4b63-a4ef-bb0b30b5306e.Text: "I have known those people far longer than you have. I know all their gestures, habits, and behavioural quirks. I am sure that I will be able to determine which of them was responsible for the riots based on their behaviour."

916efe8b-a34e-4059-93cc-4b805078eb9c.Text: {n}She thinks for several moments before replying:{/n} "Pardon my bluntness, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, but I will answer truthfully: it could be anyone. Greed, fear, and ideals can drive even the most loyal subjects to do the unthinkable."

ccbbc8a0-3ac3-4a9e-b0a5-9ba4ee817e0f.Text: "Ready to serve, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. How may I help you?"

799be0fa-8d52-44b1-9337-25c37d18653b.Text: "Toriana, the time to keep silent is long gone. The future of the von Valancius trade dynasty and your house are both at stake now."

a4e64b65-adcc-419b-a374-a47b4308c412.Text: {n}Toriana's visor oculars are fixed on the floor, her fingers restlessly clenching in the fabric of her dress.{/n}

3a230497-8431-4161-9f10-01e619db963f.Text: {n}Abelard frowns.{/n} "As far as I know, House Gaprak has received such servitors from the crimson priesthood as gifts in the past, although this is my first time seeing one myself."

5305b43e-8fd4-425b-b3c8-7388ff3dafea.Text: [Point at the dead bodies] "What is this mess?"

21ef19a1-e2cd-486c-bbb0-93ce697b3f58.Text: "Where is the court chancellor, Clementia Werserian?"

80fbbf8b-c36c-4832-8536-e4da7d6f315a.Text: "Why is the governor not here to greet the Rogue Trader?"

f36127bf-9b07-4bfa-8cd9-b152a4cedcf8.Text: {n}You are confronted by the sight of dead bodies at the entrance to the palace. The corpses have been hauled into a pile — some are dressed in the uniforms of palace wardens, while others are arrayed in the clothing typical of the Dargonus nobility.{/n}

15b22c79-b70d-430c-b884-03f6991702d1.Text: {n}Upon seeing you, the young enforcer stands at attention and swallows noisily. His voice trembles as he says,{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! We are honoured by your presence!"

44865128-308e-4d4b-95dc-074280cab71e.Text: "You see, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}... Those people wanted to attack..." {n}The warden clears his throat.{/n} "Second Lieutenant of the Palace Guard Elam Weit reporting. Shortly before you arrived, we averted an... assassination attempt on the Rogue Trader. The palace soldiers detected intruders and engaged them in combat."

18f9d75a-4692-42a8-9c91-6faecbad90ee.Text: "I think she is with the rest of House Werserian... Detained in the throne room, that is. Governor Drivestem has gathered all of Dargonus's nobility there to pronounce a guilty verdict against House Werserian."

b3843f25-dea5-4b1e-97df-367500f4c0aa.Text: "I do not know, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Perhaps he is..." {n}The guard throws a fearful gaze at Abelard.{/n} "You can probably find him in the throne room, where the governor intends to put House Werserian on trial."

a5aa25cf-b410-40f0-83a6-5800137dbe98.Text: {n}The bodies of the assailants are studded with many augmetics, but upon closer inspection, you realise that they are not merely implants. Their construction makes it clear that the deceased were not humans but in fact rare high-functioning servitors.{/n}

b5588d7b-801f-422b-941a-ef6e7d3f90dc.Text: "Observation. There are rare high-functioning servitor specimens present among the expired units. Such specimens are traditionally bestowed upon the noble houses that are most loyal to the sacred fellowship of the Adeptus Mechanicus."

46f88efc-67ee-496d-92fe-da5356165394.Text: {n}The assailants are dressed in simple but well-made clothes, beneath which strange augmetics can be seen.{/n}

f2a090b7-479f-4919-8daa-a3355125d90a.Text: {n}The augmetics of the deceased do differ from the implants ordinary people wear. Their intricate construction makes it clear that the deceased were not ordinary humans.{/n}

bbf35a1a-9404-4c38-8049-fb3d9c388b1b.Text:
The letter is soaked with blood. Only a portion of the text is readable through the crimson blotches.
"...eful and discreet. Keep away from the lords and ladies. You must look like a noble to the servants and wardens. Do not engage in conversation with anyone. Your task is to avoid exposing yourself ahead of time and let the Werserians get away while the wardens are busy guarding the Rogue Trader."

5996ea44-3e18-4076-ad48-eebfb6095c8a.Text: "Make sure that the Rogue Trader is attacked by someone loyal. It should appear as if it was all staged to let the Werserian family escape. This is the last assignment. Soon your debt will be paid off in full."

b12beeb4-d967-4d20-994f-dd3865b6f921.Text: An exquisite ring augmetic that conceals the tiniest thorn-like blade within. Such an accessory could be a lethal weapon in the right hands.

f0f86459-3a30-4dc1-b032-a6fb383349ba.Text: "What are you going to do now?"

72a2647f-e959-40b3-88c5-f0435f13b60e.Text: "You and your family must be prepared for the next time something like this happens."

67d7e5a9-c5da-4d6a-af07-e5c906be0e79.Text: {n}When the nobles disperse, sated by the bloody performance, Abelard approaches you, his steps firm.{/n} "Lord Captain."

5cfb5d97-d2c5-4693-aae9-b63519bc2ecc.Text: "Urbend and I may not have always seen eye to eye, but his loyalty to Lady Theodora was absolute, and it {d|Encyclopedia:CompAbelard_Q2_KilledGuilty}ended{/d} so... ignominiously."

bc734718-b68e-4f65-8e72-9355aecbbc69.Text: "There is no doubt that the Gapraks were {d|Encyclopedia:CompAbelard_Q2_KilledGuilty}involved{/d} in the plot targeting you... I hope their death will end the spread of pestilential heresy among the nobles in your dominion."

3afab42c-1411-4c1c-ab70-4e07431cfd01.Text: "The Sauerbacks were one of the first families to come to the Expanse. They have served the Emperor for hundreds of years and have never shown any signs of disloyalty — at least, none recorded in any official sources. It is quite regrettable that their noble line has {d|Encyclopedia:CompAbelard_Q2_KilledGuilty}ended{/d}... in such a manner."

883af7ef-9762-4675-a4e8-fa61bcb01200.Text: "I think Macharius let his guard slip and fell victim to his own imprudence. I do not believe he or Hetka were aware of Regina's actions. This is... a sad but just {d|Encyclopedia:CompAbelard_Q2_KilledGuilty}conclusion{/d} to their story."

32c87096-9621-4284-9067-e95aa5a537e1.Text: "I need time to reflect upon what happened and the role I played in it. I think I will be ready to resume this conversation later, when we are back on board the ship." {n}Abelard bows to you deferentially and turns away, lost in thought.{/n}

53da0659-4b24-48d3-b4ea-b5cd4bf5011f.Text: "Thanks to you, Lord Captain, House Werserian is saved, although it came close to being wiped out as a result of scheming without and imprudence within." {n}Abelard pauses for a moment, staring off into the distance.{/n} "Sometimes I think about how much I could teach them. I could ensure that they survive in the future, without me."

9842a270-3196-46f8-9830-3883a2c79999.Text: {n}Abelard nods, deep in thought.{/n} "That is true. They need to be prepared for it, and I want to believe that they will be able to take care of themselves."

db432b8c-5a58-4e56-b951-a3cedaad4037.Text: "You have my thanks. A Rogue Trader should not waste time on the matters that {mf|his|her} servants and trustees can resolve, but in this case, your intervention was necessary. Not just for the sake of my family, but for your trade dynasty as well."

01d6c8ee-ef15-4706-8297-20bdbcce794f.Text: "Regina Sauerback... Evidently, Kunrad's accomplices continue to plot against your protectorate. I fear we have not heard the last of {d|Encyclopedia:CompAbelard_Q2_KilledRegina}such scoundrels{/d}."

d00be781-e913-4cd0-a564-8c6b3f244f50.Text: "Your unveiled hatred for me is so obvious, Sauerback, it is grounds enough to charge you with heresy."

919d1cba-1258-4ca3-b7d3-2401aefde919.Text: "Do you really believe the Werserians are guilty?"

3ac2165d-c6ab-41c6-b3ff-b5ab7b465d06.Text: [Kiss Regina's hand] "I am honoured, Lady Sauerback."

92051ac9-cfcd-482d-8d15-3da2c4e88e10.Text: "Who apart from the Werserians could have a motive to conspire against me?"

1a2509f2-92cd-40db-a6bb-ee0c84c279f4.Text: "Set against the doom and gloom of current events and your husband's dour family, you look especially dazzling today, Regina."

9b7000dd-0b16-41ab-b05f-1e464d94d0d0.Text: "The assailants sent to the palace were rare, high-functioning servitors. Do you think the Gapraks could be behind the attack?"

7a584fb7-488f-40bc-8182-42ef6b8e9a3e.Text: "I discovered a dead body in my palace: a man of House Gaprak was killed while praying to the Emperor. He had this note on him. Do you know anything about it?"

ac97b9b3-2552-45dd-b3ec-71bd9349b424.Text: "Hetka, I wish to have a word with you. In private."

738de07b-a834-4ee0-a703-1572b351f324.Text: {n}The members of House Sauerback, led by Macharius, all bear a striking resemblance to one another, with their slender builds and stern looks. They bow to you almost in unison.{/n}

1a864995-0c50-4cc3-8080-9f4cf48cfbe9.Text: {n}Before bowing, Sauerback scrutinises you with a bitter, judgemental look.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

931929fe-c8d0-4786-a423-3645467af7ff.Text: {n}Hetka Sauerback, looking like a younger copy of his father, stands at a slight distance, close to his mother. An expensive yet understated dress serves to highlight the dazzling beauty of Macharius's wife, Regina Sauerback.{/n}

ca132673-135b-490c-9a2b-6d555b99ad2d.Text: "Certainly," {n}Sauerback replies without hesitation.{/n} "Governor Drivestem possesses proof of their guilt and they have no means by which to refute it. Even if I were to entertain the idea that the Werserians are being framed, how much longer would their house have lasted anyway, if it is so ill-prepared for treachery?" {n}He addresses Abelard with a slightly mocking tone.{/n} "My advice to House Werserian would be not to appeal to the Rogue Trader for help, but instead to simply stop, accept their fate, and not make matters worse for themselves."

a628d2d4-0cb2-4fac-a133-8acfffe45f50.Text: "I cannot remember {name} von Valancius seeking your advice on what House Werserian should do in this situation. Pay attention, Macharius, focus on the Rogue Trader's questions."

39f3f029-a0a8-4572-814e-0cd7110acfc7.Text: {n}Sauerback stares at Yrliet and revulsion flickers across his face.{/n}

fc777e5c-3765-491a-b257-9cb1a397fd4d.Text: {n}Despite Sauerback's attempts to suppress his revulsion, the presence of inhumans in your retinue undoubtedly reflects his fervent desire to eliminate the enemies of Humanity.{/n}

e9b4e2db-d261-4edc-956d-aacb1e79040b.Text: {n}You take in Macharius Sauerback's harsh tone, stiff posture, and hostile gaze. The feeling is decidedly mutual.{/n}

698a3b7e-8934-4b52-a0ba-0c7e64c1f18f.Text: {n}Sauerback's face turns red, his furious gaze trained upon you. Free-flowing rage boils in every word he says:{/n} "The Rogue Trader is the chosen servant of the Emperor and one of Humanity's best. By surrounding yourself with depraved xenos who scorn the very exceptionalism of Humankind, you teeter on the brink of heresy. And no privilege granted by the Emperor can blind others to that fact."

90adf7f1-caf2-446d-ad9a-1f574f9c91c8.Text: {n}Sauerback's face turns red and he grits his teeth in agitation. Echoes of his bridled rage can be heard in the hoarse tone of his voice:{/n} "I am a loyal servant of your dynasty. It is not for me to judge the companions of the Rogue Trader."

06d74e7d-cf47-4b7e-96e2-d8494bea0a8e.Text: {n}The Sauerback patriarch's eyes are trained upon Marazhai. It seems as if the air itself has grown heavy. With visible effort, Sauerback turns his gaze back to you.{/n}

53a170e0-d059-4a3c-9159-09b478d71941.Text: "The thought of existing in the same sector as xenos is revolting, but their presence in your retinue, here, in the capital city of the von Valancius trade dynasty, enrages me. To have xenos sullying the streets of this planet after what we endured — and under the protection of the Rogue Trader, no less!" {n}Sauerback takes a deep breath and exhales noisily. His rage subsides, but his burning gaze remains fixed on you.{/n}

ff9eab61-53c3-467d-9573-d1a701e9653f.Text: "I am hearing this from you, the Emperor's servant who flouts all that is sacred? The person who seems to think the laws of the Imperium are meaningless?"

f857b7a8-8ca9-45a3-a209-c7e871aac604.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I am delighted that you have chosen to grace us with your attention." {n}Regina drops into a curtsy while looking intently into your eyes.{/n}

eccab76e-1218-405f-b5fb-6337bdfe42cd.Text: "House Drivestem, wishing to expand their clout. House Gaprak, who lost their influence after the Kiava Gamma incident." {n}Sauerback looks back at his family, then turns to you again.{/n} "House Sauerback, whose patriarch is too direct in his communication with the Rogue Trader. Anyone could have a reason to conspire against you, and equally, they could have none. It is not a question of motive, but of loyalty: each of your subjects has sworn an oath of loyalty to you, so whose sincerity do you doubt?"

1713a031-5d80-442c-a503-a0bb52a58f87.Text: {n}Noticing your gesture, Regina readily extends her delicate hand, her nails long and manicured.{/n} "Why, how kind of you to say, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"

1b27929a-2126-4163-878b-b5262221088c.Text: {n}Burning eyes fixed on you, Sauerback straightens and leans forward, trying to partially occupy the space between you and his wife.{/n}

21bd7eb9-e6f2-4316-936e-7625838d244d.Text: {n}A flirtatious spark flares in the beautiful lady's eyes.{/n} "Really, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}? I am glad to hear this from the Rogue Trader, especially today..."

494aee3c-4de0-4cbd-9024-f07727b3158f.Text: {n}It seems that Regina did not like your compliment. She takes a step back, smiling politely. Macharius visibly relaxes, but he continues to watch your every move.{/n}

5dd67ee2-47e4-4136-ae51-0b138f22ac43.Text: {n}Macharius almost barks, each word striking like a hammer strikes metal,{/n} "Regina. Step. Away. From. {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship}."

a3276820-6d7e-47c1-be60-16cec33be348.Text: {n}Regina's high voice almost breaks into a shriek: she interrupts her husband, retorting defiantly and disobediently,{/n} "Oh, Throne preserve you, Macharius! Stop being so jealous and making a scene over nothing! Just because a crude blockhead like you lacks the refinement and courtesy of {name} von Valancius!"

166c6b62-ee0d-49fe-bf67-4713fecc1d59.Text: {n}Sauerback looks away briefly and replies to you with a curt laugh,{/n} "I have always thought Toriana too weak to participate in such... risky ventures, but it seems I was wrong about her."

60c53d5d-ef85-40c4-87c1-939fbd169db9.Text: {n}Hetka, standing behind Macharius, spots the note you are holding. Immediately, he balls his fists and jerks his head away. He exhales deeply through his nose in a bid to contain some clearly overwhelming emotion.{/n}

71667e82-5e36-4020-bb7a-8a5b7c454585.Text: {n}Macharius looks at the note without taking it from your hands, and replies without hesitation,{/n} "No, I know nothing about this note."

b7db1379-f434-41af-90f3-1beaa05d97be.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, perhaps you noticed my... momentary weakness. My apologies for my outburst."

76eb63e1-09d8-4579-83c3-6fe8cce3fa23.Text: "That note, you see... I was not fast enough to read the text, but I would recognise the paper anywhere. Those sheets, with the custom gold embossing on the edges, can be found in my father's office." {n}The young man hangs his head, shifting uneasily from foot to foot.{/n}

615a1dcb-b9ce-43f0-af31-400548afe7cd.Text: "I... don't believe my father can be involved in this. He can often be harsh and rude, but a conspiracy against the Rogue Trader is unthinkable. This goes against everything he has taught me ever since I was born. I cannot even imagine the possibility that he... has betrayed himself in such a way."

eec3f994-6902-4608-a36e-0025530c6e55.Text: {n}Macharius pays no attention to his son as he rejoins the group, but the glares of the younger Sauerback family members, bristling with distrust and doubt, almost pin the young man to the floor.{/n}

f198e95d-29e3-40b5-b1c0-95ca7f3293a8.Text: {n}You let go of Regina's hand. Her disappointment and frustration can be clearly seen in her eyes.{/n}

634ddafd-1e08-47cb-b801-f557cc990f74.Text: "Macharius, now is a time when you would do well to stop and not make matters worse for yourself."

5c472771-3ff0-4264-93d5-71564536b082.Text: {n}With a pained and distressed expression, Regina glances at her husband, her hands worrying the ruffles on her dress.{/n}

6a2973df-db0d-44d3-8d7f-66201b51f6a7.Text: {n}Regina's voice drops to a whisper so that only you can hear her.{/n} "His bile poisons the air around him wherever he goes. Once he gets something into his head, he hares off to remove the heads of others just to prove that he is in the right."

f36717f9-e440-4ff9-8b15-979a75ba02db.Text: "The attackers were high-functioning servitors, ones that looked closer to ordinary humans. Do you know anything about them?"

726cd130-6d80-4a40-aded-4cc216b736ba.Text: "I discovered the body of Halen Gaprak here, in this palace. He had this note on him. Do you know anything about it?"

240fbfc1-ec40-4f4d-83ef-be4193842c61.Text: "Are you truly guilty? Be honest — I will not tolerate lies."

2ba358fb-e77d-416c-8324-5a5bce03f255.Text: "The governor claims you forged documents in the Administratum."

a65b903d-6f70-4bf3-994b-a55ec90c90c3.Text: "I found this letter on one of the bodies of the heretics who planned the attack. What can you tell me about it?"

fab59b44-8432-4b9d-acec-396a5bcf25bc.Text: "The governor's son has admitted that it was his mistake that led to the logistics disruption. With the help of an unidentified associate, he accused the Werserians to cover up his mistake."

8473bf95-d8ec-439e-bbb7-1b0f204bb9ab.Text: "If you are not guilty, who is? Who stands to gain from framing you?"

e82537f7-b870-44ba-9f53-ad72c7b68128.Text: "I want to find out what is going on here and who the real mastermind behind all this is. Where should I start?"

45025101-b43e-48fd-85fd-0e4ed2955862.Text: {n}As you draw closer, the wardens step aside, bowing respectfully, allowing you to approach the Werserian family. Clementia, tired and slightly dishevelled, is the first to bow her head to you in deference. Several men and women behind her follow suit.{/n}

8057ba98-a306-4306-9721-03cfa28a9ec2.Text: {n}The Werserian family greets you in subdued voices.{/n}

82d56036-0507-45c5-9bb6-492140ec2866.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}..." {n}The woman stammers, as if lost for words.{/n} "Accept my most humble apologies for failing to greet you properly. And my thanks for agreeing to speak to me before making your final decision."

111103ed-eab4-4ba0-b2d6-fdab6d3ca700.Text: "The charges brought by the governor are severe, but — I can only assure you of this and swear on my own honour — we are not guilty of the crimes that House Werserian is being accused of."

0e9a0da2-a5b3-4486-bd10-d0b893baf87d.Text: "Abelard, it is your family too, you know!" {n}The woman's words burn with defiance.{/n} "My apologies — I should not lose my composure. No member of House Werserian is involved in a conspiracy against {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship}. Honour and loyalty are not something we take lightly, and we know whom we serve."

307b7ca6-391a-41b7-b602-16ce095d5673.Text: "The fleet is the primary remit of House Werserian — it is our responsibility. Logistics and supply routes are another area of our responsibility. We have no direct influence on the inner workings of the Adeptus Administratum. The first large-scale deliveries were cancelled after quantities of food were miscalculated by clerks in the Administratum. Then we were faced with incorrect weather data and a meagre fuel budget. It was clear that the cause of all these problems was the calculations performed in the Administratum, in one way or another, but no matter how many times we asked, we could not ever obtain any clarification on the matter."

7721f0b9-cdd6-4832-8609-12baa3b181c9.Text: {n}While Clementia reads the letter, the Werserians behind her read it over her shoulder.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, let us be frank. It would be foolish of me to try and orchestrate something like this, knowing how many wardens are patrolling your palace. I would not have let myself or anyone in my family get involved in such a scheme."

1b6aa12d-38d7-49ed-8e1d-34b98392f595.Text: "I am afraid I cannot be of much help. Talk to the representatives of other houses, eavesdrop on their retinue... and perhaps you will hear something unusual."

13ba6e93-1057-4d46-8b69-813341427e77.Text: "Anyone, really," {n}Clementia replies with a bitter laugh.{/n} "The other houses consider us unworthy of our position and many would jump at the chance to get rid of us and gain control over what once was our domain — the planet's fleet and logistics, at the very least."

81867215-5021-4221-9d3c-e2c14319d176.Text: "Lady Theodora chose to grant noble status to House Werserian, but the other houses, which have served in the Expanse for millennia, did not welcome the decision. It has led to some difficulties."

cd2ff4f0-00fa-425f-acb6-515b3618f355.Text: {n}Clementia motions sharply for Astartia to stop. Her voice rings with relief:{/n} "This explains a great deal. This is how it all started. The first allegations of forgery were enough for other accusations to be tacked on. It is good to know that the true culprit has been found. Thank you for letting us know, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I am surprised that Urbend allowed this to happen — I doubt he was involved."

ebb8073e-2717-44b1-b60b-e33db5950d7c.Text: "Clementia, if you know that a member of your family is guilty of the crimes you are being accused of—"

bdee5a7f-963e-44e2-9b92-b1873aa7c6bc.Text: {n}Astartia's face turns red, and she can barely contain the enraged cry inside her chest.{/n} "That grox spawn! I wouldn't be surprised if this was no mistake but a deliberate act of sabotage from the off..."

5cabe291-70bf-4b53-94ec-2a7d51e8c456.Text: "Clementia." {n}A hint of sorrow creeps into Abelard's voice, belying his stern facade.{/n} "You were acting head of this family. You were supposed to take care of each and every family member. And now you are being accused of treason and collusion against the Rogue Trader, and the entire family is facing death. How could you let this happen?"

2908fc0f-f3cc-4c3d-8c7c-ccf3826ac919.Text: "Servitors? Is that so..." {n}Clementia crosses her arms and furrows her brow, deep in thought.{/n} "I have encountered servitors that were indistinguishable from normal augmented humans, but only once. They were accompanying several members of House Gaprak."

3001c036-b7bb-4cbe-9fcd-474e9f706c69.Text: {n}The younger members of the Werserian family crowd around to examine the note in Clementia's hands. All present are beset with worry and bewilderment.{/n}

251f6c3d-885d-492d-b741-f659469c7316.Text: "Ha! Finally, I can see the family resemblance!"

44c4e77a-9174-465d-84ca-01dc0649553c.Text: "I am not sure if it is relevant, but perhaps you should know: since the fall of Kiava Gamma, House Gaprak has been faring poorly, to say the least. They have been looking for ways to enhance their influence and to improve their lot, including asking for help from the other noble houses. They have not approached us, of course — it is shameful to seek help from those you consider your inferiors, you understand. But perhaps the Drivestems or the Sauerbacks can tell you more about this matter."

ad13ca6c-8b95-4232-880a-cf10fcbfcdab.Text: {n}Laughing, Ulfar elbows Abelard.{/n} "Your brood, eh? Admit it, were you like that in your youth? As sharp as a harpoon strike to an ice troll's balls?"

0ec7aba8-4bea-40e7-abc2-f0ad85f3d806.Text: {n}Abelard glares at Astartia before responding reluctantly,{/n} "I'm afraid I cannot answer you on that last part. As for your general point, yes, I certainly was. And now I better understand why I was so frequently belted."

320d1723-a487-4552-9b94-f4b414c84613.Text: "We don't have time for talk. Let's keep moving!"

99e470ea-37a0-482d-8b0d-37234edbeba1.Text: "Remind me, what was it that Reverend Hieronymus wanted from us?"

44e3c2a0-a800-4b01-b83d-ae01e6a2ff9e.Text: "If something is troubling you, tell me. Perhaps I can help?"
