e06c8113-d5a3-4664-b2b7-a514fc7be54e.Text: "You do not know? I'm not surprised, Brother Ulfar does not care for the moniker. He has had it since his early years in the Chapter. When Ulfar underwent his trial of the Cup of Wulfen, he took so much longer than the others that the Rune Priests gave him up for lost. Later, he received grievous wounds in raids that sent him into stasis sleep for a long time. Any time we would pay a visit to the Baleful Howl, we would ask, 'Where is Brother Ulfar?' And he was always resting. And recently, he went missing altogether... lost after an attack on xenos." {n}Thorbald grins mockingly, his long fangs glinting.{/n}

20d86471-5228-4764-90c3-ec4accb06cad.Text: "Ha! Of course you do, who would miss the chance to strike up a friendship with the illustrious leader of the equally illustrious Stormbiters? Go on, Halbrandt, recite the saga of my exploits... and make sure to include the landing in the void kraken's mouth. This is Halbrandt the B— the Brave, the most sonorous voice in my pack." {n}Thorbald nods at the tall Wolf, whose seems to radiate the proud vigour of a warrior.{/n}

a5c3c8d1-f563-4292-a3e2-16a0a1a4227a.Text: "I think you meant to say Halbrandt the Braggart, no? For his verses often weave together the truth with his own flights of fancy?" {n}Ulfar smiles vindictively, with a viciousness utterly unbecoming of an Angel of the Emperor. Now it is Halbrandt's turn to blush.{/n}

bf0180bf-12a0-4d46-8b0e-68de8ee91bc5.Text: "I will not test our friendship, Aett-Vater. I know that if I call upon you to go with me in search of my pack, I will be taking you away from important battles and the saving of your home. So I will go alone to seek my brothers. But I will not abandon you in your hour of need — I owe you. When we have defeated your enemies, I will leave you and follow the trail."

0b615402-1378-4b25-9fe6-a72b7f28fba1.Text: "That trail is bloody and has long since gone cold, Brother Ulfar. There is no need to add another body to its tally. As the leader of the Stormbiters, I call you to our pack. Be a brother to us now."

4c47c37a-7b9e-4388-abf8-604a2121b3fe.Text: "When the Baleful Howl was setting off, we exchanged gifts — our pack runes. Every tenth watch, a priest cast the runes and saw what fate they revealed. Fifty watches after the Baleful Howl left, the runes showed Calamity. Sixty watches after they left — Death. Since then, the runes have been voiceless and their patterns hold no meaning."

12c76ce6-8b20-4109-98b8-b94ce449577d.Text: "And that's it? The spirits deceive you — your priest went a little soft in the head and forgot how to read his runes, and for that you give my pack up for dead? Cowards!"

21931c3f-6efb-4251-8346-6851b5282983.Text: "He is our brother. He should not be left to wander the galaxy in the company of ordinary mortals, or alone. Wolves are like sharp knives, we hone ourselves against each other, and without brothers, Ulfar will rust and grow dull. Be with us, Ulfar, we will take you in."

140880ca-f434-4309-adbd-5c979375ed83.Text: "Go to Hel, Thorbald, they'll take you in there."

a7b6572c-19c9-4d09-981f-6ab97cae056c.Text: "And even if you remain deaf to my words, I still will not tell you where your brothers went! Respect your alpha, Ulfar!"

af3bc3c5-eedf-4585-938c-2d2e8c9d55b8.Text: "So you hold this mortal above your brothers? Being without a pack has turned you feral and stupid, Everlost!"

e5317cca-ba95-43d0-bba6-c9aa8cd5a23c.Text: {n}A harsh shout drowns out the two Wolves, who are ready to lunge at one another.{/n} "Quiet! Both of you! Have you forgotten where you are? Holmgang can only take place on solid ground, not on a boat! The void and the warp are treacherous, and unfit to host a duel of the worthy!"

ad6462d2-fe29-4021-b9dc-05cfba760486.Text: {n}Giving you a disgruntled look, Thorbald sternly cuts you off:{/n} "When it concerns Wolf matters, Halbrandt will speak if he wishes. Do not forget that we are the chosen warriors of the Allfather, Rogue Trader. Treat us like servants at your peril..."

0191ce5d-2f03-4472-ad9f-46d0357b9abc.Text: "We'll see about that! I will prove that the Stormbiters will never be a match for the Baleful Howl! Aett-Vater, I must be at your side when you depart for the assault! Promise that you will grant me this honour!"

a1ed2f59-746a-479b-8a2b-2a473521dffe.Text: {n}Ulfar's eyes flash with fury.{/n} "Stop there, Thorbald. This mortal rescued me from captivity and proved {mf|his|her} valour. I will not stand here and allow {mf|him|her} to be disrespected."

91b84165-e664-4b33-b549-9f6147eadbca.Text:
"And forget not to tell
of the dire curse
that of yore was laid
upon the mighty Ulfar;
No good death for him is fated,
Only to one day be lost,
Bereft of glory and honour."
{n}Halbrandt declaims the lines so sonorously and powerfully that the bulkheads begin to vibrate.{/n}

c8ecbac6-d1eb-4776-93ba-fe4fb86f21d1.Text:
"Any who cross his path
let him regale, and gladly,
That proud warrior,
Halbrandt Blatherskite;
Singer of rumours
and fine tattler of tall tales,
For he has glimpsed
no worthy deeds
in his short life."

d966b4fb-31a0-43a8-ad55-4ac5dba88273.Text: "If you prove that your words carry more weight than a battle axe, I will tell you where your brothers went. If you fail, you will submit." {n}Thorbald's lips curve into a superior smirk.{/n}

6f815834-a251-4256-b440-1dcd8d49c5f7.Text: {n}The Wolf leader's tone may be threatening, but you notice a sly glint in his eye. Ulfar, on the other hand, is growling furiously, with no matching twinkle in his gaze.{/n}

84052108-fcd3-4276-bf93-686c9234af8f.Text: {n}Thorbald chuckles.{/n} "Thank you for the correction, Everlost. I reckon we can do without the saga."

2b626c59-2929-4eb4-bc02-b937ce052133.Text: {n}Ulfar gives the peaceably smiling Thorbald a penetrating look, his face darkening and his voice dropping low to a bestial snarl:{/n} "Have you lost your mind, Thorbald?"

e42c9862-6acf-4e0d-87ad-d37d6bc1dacf.Text: "They dissemble so sweetly — they would tear each other apart at the first opportunity."

533977fe-b719-44af-85ab-a7c4e59ae1a2.Text: "Shut up, wretched captive." {n}Halbrandt does not even dignify Marazhai with a contemptuous glance.{/n}

f115f2b2-e4d1-40e1-9eb1-2518863b27c0.Text: "He... ah... he is not a captive. He is the Rogue Trader's huskaerl." {n}Ulfar averts his gaze.{/n}

b829f663-86b9-4fbb-9e5b-4be21b498d0f.Text: "Huskaerl? A fine squad you have found for yourself, Everlost."

0629f0b0-ebcf-4ab6-a191-3635f179b439.Text: "Perhaps it is you who's lost his mind, if you are daring to speak so insolently to Ironhide?" {n}Halbrandt's insinuating tone is dripping with such menace that even the drawing of a sword could not have made his threat any clearer.{/n}

57af2be5-f2c8-457e-9cae-34a2b09530cf.Text: "The runes do not lie, Ulfar, you know this. I am sorry about your brothers, but their fate is clear."

6299d295-25ea-4f81-9040-be60d9d6c26b.Text: "I will need you in the coming battle."

dec523ed-64b2-4454-958a-79c7b8f955e1.Text: "Wolves! You are bickering when you should be fighting!"

0e3778c7-8c3b-4b3d-aa38-d08cbe072ebe.Text: "Now we shall see whose pack is more glorious!"

ae991482-ae60-41ac-90fe-5b9c7ce0732f.Text: [Respectfully observe the Angels of the Emperor]

437a1906-dd11-4d91-8c39-1e3474028b82.Text: "Out of the way, both of you! He is mine!"

aeb2f612-165e-4f64-9cad-be5680f64570.Text: [Cry out proudly] "...the warriors of Russ will never retreat!"

d3e337a0-507f-4dc8-828e-c5ccf8680202.Text: [Whisper grimly] "...for the fallen you will answer to us."

04ac40ad-f3c4-4794-9332-3d0dd058d9df.Text: [Growl bloodthirstily] "...there is a monster far worse to fear."

7157d1ba-30e1-4397-a030-4035d8806d6f.Text: "Are you two serious? Perhaps we can leave the poetry recital until after we've killed him?"

a1e8656e-d6af-4d55-8402-19df14d1babe.Text: [Shout encouragement] "Will old Wolf give young a lesson in battle?"

80ad97e8-74e8-4b92-b388-2fd7df7fefd4.Text: "If you do not stop this foolishness, more of our number will die!"

7a3f12a3-724d-446d-9875-d299f0b5fb00.Text: "Ulfar, stop playing with your prey. Kill it."

8bd8c0b0-93a3-4099-98a7-c43a313107a5.Text:
"...the warriors of Fenris,
that proud litter extolling."

f1626f98-f6fa-4f62-a658-608b7f263854.Text:
"...in memory over graves
of brothers worthy."

324b1b11-0489-4561-b07a-a821108c9177.Text:
"...eternal as our hunt
in darkness unrelenting."

4772369f-eb62-40ce-b02a-5549121cdb63.Text: "What was that contest between you and Halbrandt just now?"

a5aafd26-a9dd-456c-9155-fce53f017a68.Text: "What shall we do with your brother?"

a2626cf8-b025-4656-aeb1-b3a93758432d.Text: {n}Halbrandt looks up from the bodies of his fallen brothers. You can hear the seething rage in his voice:{/n} "I am the wrath of the Allfather, and his wrath is to be dreaded. Traitor of the XVIIth, I will have your head!"

516c66ab-8180-4e4d-b21b-c0c286f5479b.Text: {n}The vox-speakers on the ancient monster's armour emit a blood-curdling screech that turns into the unholy murmurs of countless voices:{/n} "Collect the blood of the false believers in a cup, reap of their pitiful strivings, drink of their sorrow, and the laughter of the True Gods will thunder in your ears."

717bba75-89db-4b2d-8532-a93e711d5da5.Text: {n}The abomination's armour wetly gleams with profane repair scripts daubed in blood. It has been patched with fresh ceramite in several places, evidence of serious damage received in recent battles on the surface, but the monster appears to have fully regained its strength. Its flesh swells hideously as it is flooded with the power of the warp.{/n}

02967a8b-4878-4f4e-b1a0-afa9284851e4.Text: "The last drop of blood will seep from my body before they lay their filthy paws on the sacred armour of Fenris!" {n}Ulfar beats his chest with his plated fist.{/n}

d7cec180-fd16-4590-868c-c852706132ef.Text: "This is important! I will do battle for my pack's honour! Brother Halbrandt will fall back if he does not wish to anger me!"

9f10c4e4-702d-4944-8cea-3181b050cec2.Text: "No, Aett-Vater! The honour of the pack comes before all else, even our friendship!"

05589fee-0eb8-42e6-a250-bd213b9a6805.Text:
{n}Booming drums sound from the vox mounted on Halbrandt's armour.{/n}
"In hour dark,
He bars the doors,
He who fears
guests unbidden,
He who fosters
purpose tainted,
He who dreads
his reckoning..."

b5c12fbb-ffad-4245-8581-bb98ed84d103.Text:
"...Well he knows
that in hour dark and savage
The grey beasts come
to his door prowling;
For blood they come,
For vengeance they come,
The guilty are their prey;
Be you malefic,
Be you monster,
Know that—"
{n}A new burst of furious howling from the Helbrute makes Ulfar falter.{/n}

cd2779bf-bbf9-4d7e-a642-18ae71236120.Text:
{n}With a lusty bark of laughter, Ulfar picks up your words and continues fervently:{/n}
"The warband of Fenris
will never retreat!
The scent will be caught,
and blood will be spilt!"

0031f351-7b6a-4f47-a070-4d871bb1c594.Text:
{n}Ulfar gives you a look that is piercing and full of bitter sorrow, and picks up your words, rasping out,{/n}
"The cosmic gloom
is rife with fears,
But only one true terror—
the Wolves of Russ."

122bdbe6-d40c-4515-950e-262298669cc7.Text: {n}Like two virtuosic musicians, Halbrandt and Ulfar fall into a perfect rhythm of words, breath, and movement. With a fierce howl, they rush to the attack, moving as if they are not two warriors, but one.{/n}

5a820c90-19c6-4925-b21a-57fc58621efe.Text: {n}The wounded monster lets out a scream that resonates with the might of the Ruinous Powers, and retreats. Its armour is riddled with holes, and its vox-speakers are clogged with tangled prayers of despair and joy:{/n} "I fear not the blasphemy of the deluded, for it is promised to me. With my eye of flame I pierce the hearts of the doubting, for it is granted to me. I root out false faith, for I stand on the true path. And I will not be forsaken by the protection of the True Gods!"

3bb77877-f7d9-4af3-ab15-013537961a35.Text:
{n}Ulfar is drenched in the Helbrute's blood, which carries the acrid tang of machine oil. He wipes the blood from his face and bursts into deafening laughter. The ground itself seems to quake at this mighty display of joy.{/n}
"Behold, Allfather,
how fleeting is
a coward's valour,
In stead of brazen hymns
pleas for salvation come!
But my hands are full,
with weapons laden,
Without a finger-span
for mercy
or for grace!"

71b947da-a749-42db-90b4-5cbf9d6fb700.Text:
"But stay the old Wolf's charge
against the foe;
Corruption's mighty beast
he did valiantly ravage,
But the right to sever
its rotten wyrd-thread
will another claim—
a hunter fresh
and battle-bold!"

c87ce56d-26af-4659-9bab-94a4d15cfbbd.Text:
"Indeed with hand
but also heart
the true warrior fights;
With flesh he smites,
and with zealous spirit—"

7b0da274-ee07-4844-a677-2054e3b335a0.Text:
"—How glorious to shatter
a foe's defences
by blow unpitying,
But glory is doubly granted
to he who courage shatters
by verse unrelenting!"

ce70a1da-8db2-4b1c-b691-9f29f03d0647.Text:
{n}Ulfar gives Halbrandt a patronising look.{/n}
"The battle-feast I'll share
with you, young brother,
That you may fully savour
the mjod of my prowess!
Remember this taste well,
for in it lies triumph's sweetness
and the bitterness of loss!"

c6391ce5-a53c-42d4-99c6-9bd9e2d19525.Text:
{n}The Wolf's hair stands on end and his mouth bristles with long, sharp teeth, resembling the maw of a fearsome beast:{/n}
"Hja!
Warmth of hearths unkenning,
My brothers' voices forgetting,
Only whistling ice-wind harking,
Only steam of spilt blood scenting!"

95f93519-fd9a-4884-a304-f08a61262345.Text:
"To my elder bowing,
The right of first-blow yielding,
But last for myself keeping,
The foe shall die
by Halbrandt's hand!"

8a0bb76b-601b-4732-9d4e-d0f77897f826.Text: {n}The heretic, lowering his gruesome weapon in exhaustion but still standing, casts a desperate glance at Ulfar. The vox-speaker crackles:{/n} "In the abode of the True Gods, there is neither time nor prohibition. What is reflected there will endure forever. I was, and therefore I am eternal. Doomscream will resound in your ears..."

d6a1f466-26e6-41bb-a728-ec07ddc10a9f.Text:
"With glorious song
the gnat-buzz we'll drown out!
And with sweetest mjod
your traitor name we'll wash away!
Tell the Blood-Moon Wolf you fell
at noble Halbrandt's hand!
Hjolda!"
{n}Halbrandt shoots a defiant look at Ulfar, who has blocked his path to the defeated monster. The young Wolf raises his weapon, ready to defend his claim to the prey.{/n}

cc2a7543-dc64-4cb8-a616-b57b507cfbc3.Text:
"Many lessons have to you,
Young Wolf, been handed down,
So let this be your last—
Tread not upon
your elders' prey!"
{n}Ferociously declaiming the last line, Ulfar knocks Halbrandt to the ground with a crushing blow to the head, sending him into a deep stupor.{/n}

e1ecb764-1701-4971-a7d6-a4efa5eef239.Text: {n}Judging by his sluggish movements, the young Wolf is alive, but not entirely lucid. A storm cloud of heavy bruising is spreading across his handsome face.{/n}

3a1a7f13-6a55-4e1a-b1dc-aaa70e37a7d6.Text:
"...the warriors of Fenris,
that proud litter extolling."
{n}Ulfar repeats your words thoughtfully, then grins.{/n} "Not bad, {name}. Spoken like a wolf."

1ed4d65c-fb34-4d46-9e31-2b44e105a471.Text:
"...in memory over graves
of brothers worthy."
{n}Ulfar raises his grief-fogged gaze to you.{/n} "Arnoolf and Skyaddi would have liked that ending."

67531ecc-dc13-4d12-9506-6434a9cf664e.Text:
"...eternal as our hunt
in darkness unrelenting." {n}Ulfar echoes your last words with the spiteful, stubborn grin of a doomed man.{/n} "Indeed, an eternal hunt is all that awaits me. Thank you, {name}."

2e438686-113e-477a-8f87-f50dbe34874f.Text: "Fine hunting, Aett-Vater. The prey and the verses have me well pleased!"

8653d827-d9ed-4be5-a26b-0961ae271e92.Text: "We clashed in a dispute over valour and inspiration! Battle fills the true warrior's heart with joy and his mind with piercing clarity, and we on Fenris hold in special honour those who rise above the fray and share their joy with their comrades."

a38ca90a-e5d5-41bc-b583-dc5635949329.Text: {n}Ulfar walks over to the Helbrute, whose limbs are convulsing in vain attempts to raise his weapon. The Wolf draws a knife covered in red runes and smiles at you.{/n} "The name of the Baleful Howl was not tarnished in this battle." {n}Wearing the same blissful smile, Ulfar casually grabs the visor of the heretic's helm and begins to wield the blade with the efficiency of a butcher.{/n}

abb68a3d-8e2a-46b3-91d0-646a4ea06d80.Text: "My heart is raring to fight, Brother Ulfar... But my legs are in no hurry to carry me toward the enemy. I will join the fray when I can stand, if you would be kind enough to leave a few heretics for my blade."

89676c82-f3d4-418a-8039-522a31add0fe.Text: "Noble Halbrandt, it would be unwise for you to come with us, I think. It will be some time before you are well, and I do not want to have to answer to the Allfather should you die — let no one say a worthy warrior met his foolish end because of Ulfar."

6f456f43-ec40-4e70-84e3-d539a4a52419.Text: "Stand aside, young Wolf — the Baleful Howl are here. This prey is ours."

6ef9f79d-abe7-4e57-8334-88a983ca8987.Text: {n}The dying enemy rasps and gurgles, choking on blood, as severed tendons snap and sawed bones crack under the Fenrisian steel. The Helbrute's legs buckle, but he somehow remains upright, as if out of sheer arrogance. The heretic lives long enough to fully partake of the agony, and when Ulfar finishes, he is clutching the bloody horn that protruded from the Chaos worshipper's head. Ulfar swiftly carves a protective rune into it and proudly proclaims,{/n} "A glorious trophy!"

55e3127f-3d23-4942-8dc3-90e9e91332cd.Text: {n}Turning to you, Ulfar jovially calls out,{/n} "You're just in time for the fun, Aett-Vater! Stay close!"

d0328fce-328b-4dfb-a84b-71b3efbe0b77.Text: "Halbrandt, can you defend yourself alone if the Rogue Trader has need of my aid? My hunger is not sated, and I would gladly cleave a few more foul-tongued heads from their heretic bodies."

cea4e939-76ce-44e8-a2b6-97d94c351305.Text: "Go forth to battle, Brother Ulfar. I may be seeing double, but I have never feared a battle against an enemy with superior numbers."

4b4ea3d8-eb14-4650-ad5a-ed252eb931e9.Text: "I have heard you. Let's go back for your quarry."

aab52e53-b26d-4307-b1c2-b108e854ffa2.Text: "I don't have time for such nonsense! There is too much at stake!"

30991a64-41ca-4d21-b101-b7d2618ba0bf.Text: {n}Ulfar's voice is muffled and menacing.{/n} "Aett-Vater... My work in these catacombs is not yet done. I will not leave these halls until I have slain Doomscream. If you wish, go without me. I will return to exact my vengeance."

7210f8d2-b46c-4858-80d4-edc35cf01b22.Text: "Well, {name}. So this is where our roads diverge. Farewell, Rogue Trader."

88cbe6d2-0f0e-4c34-a65e-b73c4051a888.Text: {n}The Space Marine growls contentedly.{/n} "Let's send this heresy straight into Morkai's maw!"

87f976dd-001c-4628-b157-268272870826.Text: The battle with the malevolent spirit on the frozen planet left painful scars. Even healed, the injured area continues to ache as if gripped by a vicious frost.

cb74b0e0-1f8a-4cd6-8274-0800aafa8ccb.Text: Ulfar's hand was mangled in the jaws of the Doppelgrendel. Attaching special significance to this battle trophy, the Space Wolf refuses to replace it with an augmetic.

70498b7a-3700-4587-8e20-eca561b266b6.Text: The shuttles are ready to transport the Lord Captain's squad to the coordinates where Ulfar Thunderlung was found.

247a87c5-d59f-4774-a9bc-3d39d7c0e55e.Text: Arm everyone and have them take up defensive positions.

b828f497-469b-4c9f-9657-5555d9787159.Text: Take the shuttle and leave the planet.

79264cc4-744e-4892-9805-d508333dd404.Text: The Lord Captain will find a convenient firing position to strike the unknown enemy.

c8dfbc89-0481-4f96-9705-122fb40b78b3.Text: Send scouts to survey the area.

147aee0a-7ab2-4eb9-9b9d-afcedcc5f8c7.Text: Take shelter in the ship and set up camp.

14dcf93e-eb8a-434a-a9f8-773dc348df8b.Text: Decide which direction the search will go in next.

f6d968d6-44e5-4c8d-a3fe-01a980c03aa1.Text: Send the party toward the sounds of battle as soon as possible.

879cae81-55c0-4822-b0c3-5cd54ccfb3c7.Text: Carefully lead the group in the direction from which the battle was heard earlier.

967d828e-e37d-4425-a8d8-a0f7ff7ce259.Text: Clamp down on any soldier who does not leap to carry out your command.

82fe8085-9233-4e89-9216-e133de08fda7.Text: Send out scouts to sweep the area.

c79e4f04-207f-46fb-a50f-90b3ab67bcaa.Text: Send the soldiers forward, trusting in their tactical skill and lessons taught to them by the Lord Captain.

140526b6-dd3a-4ac0-831c-3b512f212a00.Text: The Lord Captain will personally rush into battle against the mysterious foe.

ae5f8dd4-467a-4431-8207-04bad3770864.Text: A scouting party led by the Rogue Trader {mf|himself|herself} makes planetfall on the frozen world. The shuttle on which Ulfar Thunderlung departed the ship has been designated the starting point for the search.

ba729173-14ea-4d99-85ee-7c4fd109cc2e.Text: Ulfar is found lying in the blood-soaked snow, his body covered in grievous wounds, but the Wolf continues to cling to life. With great care, he is borne to the shuttles and, wasting no time, brought back to the ship for urgent treatment.

0df7ffec-72e9-4357-a698-0f90f19d7041.Text: With great care, the insensate bodies of Ulfar Thunderlung and the Lord Captain are borne to the shuttles and, wasting no time, brought back to the ship for urgent treatment.

97abb503-7724-4eb4-8a6a-da910057e89d.Text: The path is full of dangers — a treacherous crevasse, hidden under the snow's crust, suddenly opens wide underneath the enforcers' feet.

9f3a6150-7bbd-4bb3-91fd-7523249e55f6.Text: The scouts discover numerous structures — burial grounds and obelisks of the xenorace that once ruled these star systems — all of which are now encased in ice and solemn sepulchral stillness. No signs of activity by potentially hostile xenos have been detected.

73e4f774-2221-45dc-a7de-a34a7928403e.Text: Alas, the enforcers are exhausted by their ordeal, and their morale dwindles. They cannot see the enemy through the engulfing snow, only feel the blood spatter on their faces from their comrades, who were marching ahead of them only moments ago. Thrown into disarray, the warriors retreat.

5420ce58-1155-4404-a53a-d2293ffff47e.Text: The surprised pilots obediently rouse the spirit of the lively shuttle and the reconnaissance expedition leaves the frozen world. As the planet recedes into the distance below, the scouts whisper among themselves: now there is no way for the Angel of the Emperor to return to the ship unless the Lord Captain deigns to extricate him.

c7481874-c39b-4968-b513-09c69742a902.Text: The group bravely ventures onward, into the realm of blinding white and crackling frost. The sky is soon blanketed with snow clouds that block out the star's light. The wind, howling like a pack of hungry spirits, sweeps away all tracks and whips up a furious storm.

c35013e2-8709-40c5-afec-59088c40b512.Text: The machine spirit is in fine form and is ready to ascend from the world's surface. No clues have been found as to Ulfar Thunderlung's intended destination, but a keen-eyed scout sights several disturbed snowdrifts that may indicate the route taken by the Space Wolf.

e76ba5fc-f18b-487f-9246-0cb1f6ed3bfa.Text: The Rogue Trader strides ahead to find a firing position from which {mf|he|she} can view the battle. Suddenly, an eerie shadow leaps out of nowhere straight at the Lord Captain. It is cloaked by the snow and dark, which turn it into a barely discernible silhouette that emanates the promise of death.

ed531a0b-3dc0-4526-8251-8efb4f59be65.Text: The bone-weary soldiers welcome the chance to rest. Watchful sentries stand guard while their more fortunate comrades stuff themselves with the now-frozen rations of the ship's vanished crew.

13b3de98-a0e6-4eaf-aaf2-6453b7b68065.Text: One of the sentries delivers an anxious report to the Lord Captain: he has seen a massive shadow in the darkness... and it was definitely not Ulfar Thunderlung.

c31a2784-22d0-465a-ab70-445ceab64ca7.Text: The enforcers search the area and return without finding anything of interest. Not all of them return, in fact — several seem to have lost their way and fail to make it back to the ship.

0a155656-9f63-40da-95b3-987644fefabb.Text: The ship is identified as the Revelation Granted, the merchant cog commandeered by the Baleful Howl on Footfall. No signs of struggle or other misfortune are found aboard, only some useful cargo in the hold. Contrary to expectations, no crew members are found, dead or alive. The ship has been abandoned, and its fuel systems are non-functional — the promethium has frozen solid and ruptured the tanks and pipes.

b0f985d8-27f2-4c32-a05a-92ad16eb574f.Text: The escalating storm sweeps over the group as if trying to bury them in darkness, snow, and obliterating whirlwinds.

a8c95607-7eb3-4344-a4ac-dedcc7337f98.Text: Fresh tracks in the snow leading to the ship's airlocks indicate that he was here, and recently.

9ca0a54b-50a0-42bf-a2ef-8566141fac7c.Text: In the raging blizzard, it is impossible to determine which way the Space Wolf might have gone. A pair of brave trackers strike out on a long-distance scouting run and still have not returned hours later.

7b2fcb64-086c-4edc-aad4-a633002c6180.Text: Alas, even the most experienced trackers fail to discern from which direction the party came. After two hours of wandering, they return, exhausted, to the wrecked voidship.

750efd5a-9763-4ebc-bd7b-07faf4235b66.Text: The raging storm makes it impossible to establish a vox-link with the Rogue Trader's vessel, leaving the expedition stranded without aid, but probably not for long — the officers on the bridge should have immediately dispatched help as soon as contact with the scouting party was lost.

79f37e2e-6a36-4973-93ea-1d6d3c7d972a.Text: Despite the reinforcements, the sentries cannot conceal their fear. The unknown has robbed them of their courage.

d3cb3f5a-de4d-4c33-b5b8-76efbd63d2b7.Text: The sentries are brought inside and the fire is extinguished. Silence reigns in the ship — the frightened people do not move a muscle, afraid to give themselves away by so much as a whisper.

18b2e714-bf58-4336-b081-12a7658d1437.Text: A squad of the best fighters, led by the Lord Captain, ventures outside the ship and scours the area twice. Unfortunately, the only result of their efforts is several squad members disappearing without a trace.

ebdf69b6-1f26-4a05-87a4-f4a4aa5406bd.Text: Barrels of frozen promethium are dragged outside. The frozen fuel reluctantly succumbs to the heat of the thermal cutters, and fires kindle around the ship. Even this is not enough to dispel the snowy darkness, but the people are buoyed up by the additional light and warmth.

8513bf0a-a6ac-4f32-b135-2460d291c673.Text: A messenger rushes to the Lord Captain to report that one of the sentries is missing. Large tracks have been found near the sentry's post, as well as a few drops of blood.

52486729-aa19-4f11-8ad9-aa9beea728ef.Text: A terrible rumbling cuts through the roar of the storm — the clash and clamour of battle. It is followed by a furious, agonised scream.

9bd5274f-c7ab-44f2-b10b-d48d3c3cfbca.Text: Hours pass before the ferocious storm subsides. Communication with the ship is restored, and anxious bridge officers report that reinforcements from the ship have already landed on the planet and are now searching for the Lord Captain.

c52bd1e3-cc37-495e-a2f1-1960e739b390.Text: The enforcers are bewildered — many suspect it was the blessed Ulfar they heard screaming. The order to abandon the Angel of the Emperor to his peril has dismayed them.

4d907d67-5d40-4188-8a41-d4195660c8bf.Text: Chastened by the Lord Captain's stern dressing-down, the enforcers hasten to the landing site. The expedition members pile onto the shuttles and leave the frozen world — and the memories of the Space Wolf named Ulfar — far behind.

9ce0f5f5-a292-472f-a084-c81c4d51b95d.Text: The soldiers are reassured to learn that the Rogue Trader has no intention of leaving the Angel of the Emperor to his fate.

1ff708a9-bd9b-4b70-8fde-dd7d33480cb4.Text: Tied together with ropes and bolstering each other with battle cries, the enforcers rush toward the battle in human chains. Unable to see anything ahead in the darkness and swirling snow, they blindly stride toward the source of the battle's monstrous thunder.

608466a5-c46c-4f93-9fac-4b26d0baefd7.Text: Eyes darting around cautiously, the expedition's members move forward, and a gruesome discovery is soon revealed to them.

5f60c1c3-0961-4539-9420-ff9ca4dab2c5.Text: The scouts soon return to the ship — this time they have managed to find something worthy of the Lord Captain's attention.

489afd52-0bf2-4bc8-b2db-0e8fb740e164.Text: Ulfar has been found lying in the blood-soaked snow. There are signs of a terrible battle all around, and the Space Wolf's body is covered in grievous wounds. The expedition healer doubts that even an Angel of the Emperor will last long with such injuries.

1e214ffc-d5f9-4de8-aa63-878b11b668ee.Text: The clamour of battle quickly dies down, and the soldiers warily creep forward, where a gruesome discovery is revealed to their eyes.

1479289b-36be-4539-9693-364a4922b56a.Text: With great care, the insensate body of Ulfar Thunderlung is borne to the shuttles and, wasting no time, brought back to the ship for urgent treatment. Despite the healer's prognosis, the Space Wolf's spirit clings on and he drags himself out of Morkai's jaws.

2e75f45f-f853-466e-94ff-23e609b518db.Text: The enemy is concealed by the snow and the darkness, forcing the soldiers to fire in all directions, by some miracle not hitting each other. First one fighter, then another, vanishes with a desperate shriek, dragged off by the unknown enemy into the roiling depths of the storm.

b97d79e8-d736-407f-8c65-9097ed93a2c1.Text: The Lord Captain charges forward, {mf|his|her} soldiers rushing after {mf|him|her}, and an eerie shadow blocks their path. It is cloaked by the snow and the dark, which turn it into a barely discernible silhouette that emanates the promise of death.

e5b61ee7-a1a6-484a-9dfd-49670312c2dc.Text: Clashing with the unknown enemy that cannot even be seen, the Rogue Trader deals several devastating blows, and then the malevolent foe hurriedly retreats into the blizzard.

fee2294a-428b-4d4a-a4c2-3e343669c343.Text: But the enforcers' courage and stubbornness win out — boldly pushing forward, they drive the mysterious enemy from the battlefield and into a retreat.

20114b25-6f31-4af9-a8cf-ad5dd1df374a.Text: Despite the enforcers' excellent training, they are unable to subdue an enemy they cannot see, and instead they die horribly, picked off one by one. After losing many comrades, they retreat in disarray, their foe as mysterious as ever.

d68f3f44-9a9e-477e-af09-b85e0fa88d9c.Text: The scouts indicate the direction, discovered earlier, in which Ulfar Thunderlung was presumed to have been heading.

80f1bfcc-874f-47c0-8dd1-e6d45a36d0e2.Text: However, it seems he decided not to linger — his tracks end outside the ship, the rest covered by the thickly falling snow.

286b22fa-53bc-41c0-bcaf-8390afe55d4e.Text: Said shuttle is found at the landing site, intact and undamaged.

22b86ea1-2e69-427e-b1b4-90d11454167f.Text: Casting food aside and rousing from fitful sleep, every member of the expedition prepares to fight and defend the blessed Rogue Trader.

e59750cb-e1f1-48be-8af3-35cc69196255.Text: It is only the vigilance of the Lord Captain and {mf|his|her} companions, who hear the telltale crack in time, that saves the soldiers from certain death.

8c084e03-dd66-47bb-b2a5-3697d79787ab.Text: But the Rogue Trader's steady hand and keen eye do not betray {mf|him|her} at this crucial moment — {mf|he|she} drives away the malevolent foe with high-precision shots. The von Valancius dynasty has emerged victorious from this skirmish.

65459048-96c7-4620-9dc2-2ad5ae9409e8.Text: A bolt of lightning strikes the Rogue Trader before {mf|he|she} can act to avoid it. The Lord Captain collapses insensate in the snow, and only the intervention of the enforcers, who rush fearlessly to the defence of their {mf|lord|lady}, force the malevolent foe to retreat.

2642f715-a219-42ca-bd45-9a3566bb86f4.Text: The temperature inexorably plummets, but the brave enforcers, following the Lord Captain's example, staunchly endure the trial and do not lose heart.

dfe4862c-aa1b-4dac-bbf3-b7d59529f2bc.Text: A few hours later, the expedition comes to a plateau. Rising up ahead is the dark hull of an Imperial trading vessel that once landed on the world's surface.

d90f8b63-48e0-4750-81e2-e5c96f9360b7.Text: Dozens of brave soldiers vanish into the darkness before they even have a chance to cry out. The rest of the party trek on in mournful silence.

932a75c8-ba02-4d09-bce4-cc425326e3ea.Text: The temperature inexorably plummets. Many members of the expedition suffer from frostbite, while others lose their fortitude and morale.

01e6a090-fb94-45e4-ac3f-7acde5775a4d.Text: However, he was not alone. The scouts find strange dips in the snowdrifts surrounding the ship. It seems that someone was watching the ship, from a position buried in the snow, around the same time that Ulfar Thunderlung was searching it.

f206f936-413d-44ad-8e8c-2c69f042adb1.Text: The magnificent armour is covered in hexagrammic wards, and the helmet's visors are carved with microrunes invoking the beneficence of the spirits of the hunt. Any blood shed by the wearer of this sacred armour will not be in vain — beneath the ceramite shell is an ingenious mechanism that collects every blessed drop of crimson, so that it can later serve as the basis for a Rune Priest's healing balms and sacred potions.

5d1c07af-45f2-45c4-b66f-2e074304a036.Text: "Well, we both knew what we would find."

4852dac4-856f-4ca9-8081-b63febbbb126.Text: "They met their doom with honour, as befits true warriors!"

5345cffd-1e82-4d9c-a9a6-c5d85ebecd80.Text: "I shall bear witness to their final honour."

042049b9-6009-4423-ada9-2f095eae2ce0.Text: "I will not be participating in this ritual."

0de15f4d-8c49-4c2c-a8f2-4a1957f64e40.Text: "It sounds like you are asking me to drink poison."

2de13721-cdb5-49b3-aa25-e6d3e89e2202.Text: [Accept the horn and sip] "Feast well, Wolves."

e8057194-c4b1-498e-9aae-dea9d1016509.Text: "I will definitely not be doing that."

9daaeba0-f1de-40b1-9d8c-57e6220015a6.Text: "What do you think they were looking for here?"

a4304210-9399-4478-87c2-c39743b8b64c.Text: "And what are we going to do with him?"

e5603c3c-d9ff-4421-ba07-65e4db56af19.Text: "Rather than killing your brother, we can just leave him here. Who will he hurt here, after all?"

bce22f53-c1d5-485b-9782-be1008947e03.Text: "Where do you intend to look for him?"

3f2e86e9-263b-4a1e-b3c4-be26ee0dd8a6.Text: "Is he dangerous? Or will you be able to reason with him?"

91301566-702f-4612-ad6a-f9c82a43e210.Text: "Perhaps we should return their bodies to Fenris?"

3e6deb91-4073-4acb-b0e6-9936e055e4c9.Text: "My brothers." {n}Red brows furrowed in anguish, Ulfar bows down over the bodies encased in ceramite and adamantine.{/n} "Once again, fate has barred me from travelling to the hall of the Allfather with my brothers."

9354a29a-099e-4954-a662-78d799b22f2e.Text: {n}The snow-covered battlefield reveals little, but it is clear that the Wolves gave furious battle one last time. The rocks are pitted from bolter strikes, and here and there you see scorch marks left by plasma charges.{/n}

24f85d44-7f98-40f3-9484-854793743447.Text: {n}The Tech-Priest's voice is cold and contemptuous.{/n} "This unit has no intention of assisting a pack of murderous beasts."

8ca03855-7e0d-43b8-afef-7006d55fee1f.Text: "Do not be sorry, Aett-Vater. They died with honour, as the Allfather's warriors should. In the hall of Kjalhalla, their horns will be full to the brim with heady mjod." {n}Ulfar gnashes his teeth in anguish.{/n}

e611fa35-ab99-425c-b952-f9badcabe494.Text: {n}Ulfar huffs a weak laugh.{/n} "True enough. No one would dare say that the Baleful Howl would stare into the eyes of Morkai with anything but joyful awe and fire in their hearts."

1babce4f-5745-43e2-9765-76867569be06.Text: "Yes. My instincts did not fail me, but my heart yearned for hope all the same."

7a814eed-2ae1-470a-91da-c0e763a81f41.Text: {n}Heaving in a breath, Ulfar mutters,{/n} "I sense evil in their deaths. The souls of the Baleful Howl are not at rest, but remain here on the battlefield. They are not with the Allfather. I must escort them to him. Will you bear witness to the last honour given to my brothers?"

cef6ae18-52bc-4d22-8eb7-ca844c03c3fb.Text: "Our sagas have long since become one, and tradition bids that the burial be witnessed by another clan member, not an outsider. I have no one closer than you here."

ecd9ae23-31c3-463d-9789-954ef177d33f.Text: {n}Ulfar nods, unconcerned.{/n} "Then leave me here and go. There will be no burial without a witness, so I will stay here to stand guard over the bodies. When you return to the inhabited sectors of the Expanse, send word to my brothers that I am waiting for them here."

ea34b3ec-53ef-419c-a753-dc3b05009853.Text: "May the Allfather not forsake you in the battles to come." {n}Ulfar's ruminating gaze remains fixed on the bodies of the fallen.{/n}

a27360f0-42f6-4bf1-b087-ee5c47ae0d97.Text:
{n}Ulfar produces a knife inscribed with scarlet runes. Picking up a rock from the ground, he begins to scratch the rock's sharp edge across the blade, etching a name. His powerful voice rumbles:{/n}
"Hear now the saga
of the Baleful Howl pack,
Proud warriors of Fenris,
Vlka Fenryka..."

3943e091-0ed3-4116-9b7d-e78cd473bf5b.Text: "I will sing their sagas so that the world remembers who they were. Then the flames will take their bodies, and we will drink to the memory of my pack to ease their march to Kjalhalla."

89e3a6c6-31c5-449a-94fa-4eccb0119d01.Text: {n}The verses weave together, recounting the deeds of each of Ulfar's dead brothers. With incredible precision in every detail, the Wolf lists the accomplishments of his comrades, the enemies they slew, and the sacrifices they made. The saga continues at length, and the relentless rhythm sends you into a trance. With a grinding screech, the rock is drawn across the knife blade again and again, inscribing one name after another.{/n}

758caf70-5b44-4682-8dc5-0b1a4d0043a1.Text:
"...On the cold world
they gave battle,
The pack's fierce name
never disgracing;
So ends the saga
of the Baleful Howl,
and the void thunders
with echo unending—
Fenrys hjolda."
{n}Ulfar is silent for a long time. The etched knife blade slices across his huge palm, and scarlet drops paint the snow. His weary voice rasps,{/n} "Hear my oath, Allfather. Jelga thu rah, ag jymia." {n}With his bloodied hand, the Wolf removes the rune-covered horn from his belt and, from a flask, pours something dark and sharp-smelling into it.{/n} "Let us drink to my brothers, Aett-Vater, and then we will build the pyre."

0e6d2985-d28f-4293-b9cd-66eb46d5242f.Text: "Usually Wolves are commemorated with mjod, but I'll have to settle for something I made myself — a few poisonous herbs from Janus, some rare toxins traded on Footfall. Maybe this brew will overcome the physical might of an Astartes."

e317bd50-7d6f-4cb9-9104-3a30f4d747ab.Text: "I am not a madman. It is a strong brew, but it will not kill you... It shouldn't, at least. But it may envelop your mind in a haze of dreams. Do not believe everything you see — the visions may have been sent by the Allfather, or by someone less worthy."

66fe0c24-30f5-4d24-b7ad-c97475444226.Text: "You gave your word. Do not dishonour my brothers by breaking tradition." {n}Ulfar's brows are sternly furrowed.{/n}

a05af548-87ec-4bd2-8b7f-62596f2a3938.Text: {n}The astringent liquid burns your throat, and a fog immediately descends over your vision. The sky darkens, and the rising wind whistles in your ears. Through it comes the high-pitched cawing of a bird. Ulfar nods approvingly.{/n} "It is a sign — fate walks beside us. Skal!" {n}Taking back his horn, the Wolf takes a mighty swallow of the stuff.{/n}

99764444-cf46-422b-86d3-c8139560f1a8.Text: "I smell no corruption on their bodies, and I see no traces of xenos weapons. I think they did battle with humans here."

f4d6eba4-157f-4662-9bc6-a4d63225918e.Text: {n}Majestic shadows rise in the snowy haze around you — the figures of warriors clad in indestructible armour, bearing an emblem of two black fangs piercing the yellow of the sun. They are looking at you.{/n}

fca01833-eb7d-480f-840c-60c42a5ac99b.Text: "I do not know what they were seeking, but they certainly found someone here, otherwise this crime would not have been committed."

afc24778-2751-42b7-91ec-ee26939d9f95.Text: "It is the oldest oath on Fenris. It translates as 'I will avenge or I will be forsaken.'"

b3ba065d-11cc-4cd9-9774-f1eddcdebbd3.Text: "The brothers bear witness. Which means it is time for us to meet my last comrade."

c4b1c191-8b0c-4979-8a33-f860ca743422.Text: "There is one missing among the dead, and now I know who I was fighting before. It was Brother Ignilf."

ea7e0fde-0fac-4a4f-a169-003eab33e331.Text: "He went mad with grief over the bodies of his brothers, and the Curse of the Wulfen prevailed over his valiant heart. He became a beast."

d590d26b-8075-4eb8-a186-de018166f729.Text: "Corruption is washed away by blood. We will cleanse his spirit, as there is no hope for his body now. None return from the curse's embrace."

081725c1-527c-4c88-beb8-261c0c12a5f2.Text: "Calcazar once encountered another of my brothers, who had also become a Wulfen. Calcazar captured him and brought him to Fenris — that is the debt we came here to pay. But we have no way of doing what Calcazar did, so we will have to grant Brother Ignilf peace."

56c29e82-7691-488d-947f-980fb1083603.Text: "We cannot. The Curse of the Wulfen is a secret of our Chapter, and secrets must be kept. I cannot leave proof of our vulnerability here, for the enemy may find it and use it."

6a0b2267-41d8-4976-8473-a095f0650c73.Text: {n}A toothy grin is the only response you receive. You see fangs lengthening before your eyes. Is it Ulfar laughing at you, or the feral moon suspended in the sky? The fog clouding your mind grows thicker... {/n} "He will come."

a104818f-cbeb-4910-881b-d27ebca10833.Text: {n}Ulfar lets out a belligerent howl, whipping up snow drifts into frightened whirlwinds.{/n}

52ed1870-0842-4a52-817e-3a5b629a22fe.Text: "It is too late to retreat, Aett-Vater. He caught our scent long ago."

e6619a16-88f3-4c95-a608-443b0aad723d.Text: {n}You hear a terrible cracking sound — someone's feet... no, paws are breaking through the crust of snow on the ground. The Beast now comes, and its cruel howl awakens the fallen warriors of Fenris.{/n}

fbcdb021-7ed9-454e-a5b6-e791af460bd4.Text: "There is no reasoning with one who knows only the black bitterness of hatred. The Curse of the Wulfen is not only our bane but also our shield against temptation. When intolerable thoughts take shelter in a Wolf's mind, the curse comes and drives them out, dousing them with the waters of anger. You cannot reason with a Wulfen, or deceive him, or entice him. That is our bloody talisman against evil."

4e0ba5eb-1c25-4c7d-99b5-083f3edbc3c7.Text: {n}The wolf-moon raises its head and howls. Then it turns its wise, piercing gaze on you, and blood rains down from its snow-white fangs onto the frozen world.{/n}

383384ee-c7d8-416e-9ef9-1a3b49e04a07.Text: "Custom. Back when Leman Russ was still young and did not yet know the Allfather, he found himself in the lost village of the Wave Raiders clan. They had all been slain by monsters and their souls now wandered the ruins of their homes, crying out for vengeance. Leman Russ could not speak to the dead, comfort them, or grant them peace, because he was alive and they were not."

86929cb0-98c7-448d-a60f-b7512e8214bd.Text: "There is no point now. If they had died recently, and if I were a Wolf Priest, I would have armed myself with the Fang of Morkai and extracted their progenoids, the implants containing the memory of the Allfather's blood. On Fenris, they would have been transplanted into young Wolves, and the valour of my brothers would have lived on in them. But their bodies have lain here too long, so they should simply be given to the flames, to protect them against scavengers and unworthy hands."

e2284793-c95c-4bbc-88d2-0df82c7006cb.Text: {n}Ulfar smiles sadly.{/n} "How I wished that my omen would prove a lie, and that my libation would sour without ever being tasted."

280a6517-e1a1-480a-8df2-996d86db38fa.Text: "Then he brewed a mixture of poisoned herbs and drank himself almost to death. The light in his eyes faded, and the figures of the dead appeared before him in the darkness. Russ swore an oath of vengeance before them, and the fire of resentment in their hearts went out. We have been giving our dead the same send-off ever since."

82e5118f-06f2-4caa-a453-d0a653144bed.Text: {n}Turning to Pasqal, Ulfar says in a grave voice,{/n} "I know that you are a man of curiosity, but do not even think about performing the sacrament of harvesting on my brothers' bodies. It is forbidden for you."

67a79dd6-23c8-4887-8266-62291556b0d0.Text: "The Bloodspun Web is glad that its supplies have aided you, Angel." {n}Kibellah bows her head in deference.{/n} "May this stimulant of your making open your soul's eyes."

9d587a4f-356a-4536-bba9-76daf1f14653.Text: "The blood priests from your ship shared many of their poisons with me." {n}Ulfar gives Kibellah a majestic nod.{/n} "Surprising as it is that mere mortals can withstand such substances."

b56fe961-ab98-40df-a3e4-24596ad15cf2.Text: "Your pack seems to have led an entire ship's crew to their deaths."

afca6ecd-ffd0-46b7-b82a-0f05c103f1a4.Text: "Now we can safely say that you are not cursed — you almost met your end in battle."

55a10822-4a76-4b1d-8837-116afc762bd9.Text: "I thank the Emperor that He did not take you from us to join his heavenly host, my lord."

1b2e4d22-d63e-42e2-8002-fbb3209c9ecb.Text: "Tell me, why are there no rhymes in your songs?"

0721c06a-03e9-4b31-9bb5-f3fbe237bfe2.Text: "Do you still believe you will find your brothers?"

7f5afe9b-ba10-4590-b410-f3c9a06af596.Text: "What foe is capable of besting you in combat? Your wounds were truly terrifying."

11523e90-dfc7-4559-8386-5dd3983d2169.Text: [Look around the chamber] "I am pleased that my servants found a fitting shrine for your armour."

8705708b-b515-4631-9a18-710aec464660.Text: "Why did you decide to go to that world alone?"

4bd4bac4-591a-4e6e-ae06-f8e80da9cd66.Text: "We fight together. Do not forget that I am your Aett-Vater."

b4a83b8f-b9c3-479c-a05e-84e9f8c19069.Text: "You did not do all that well on your own."

29ca15e9-b446-4612-bab7-e712b26deeff.Text: "Do not ever steal from me again, or force my soldiers to die saving you."

ec1f8463-615e-4911-b2b5-a90cb570524c.Text: "Did you find any trace of your brothers?"

a25b17b5-87e1-40e3-9062-27b2af9c9617.Text: "I shall consider it. There are other important matters that require my attention."

bca8cc10-f434-4295-a5ee-907b96432f48.Text: "This does not seem like a good idea to me."

1ee5cbde-9e38-4f43-9315-677d753f9288.Text: "You are not your usual self. You seem more sombre."

11c6e523-c861-429d-91e1-97874ac5ba65.Text: "Have you been thinking about your life?"

ee60d96d-ffa4-49c9-89f9-d8bf0171e5e6.Text: "Perhaps something good awaits you in the future."

02fb1ecb-4df8-4980-8a86-3e0effe34ba3.Text: {n}Ulfar's dark figure towers over you. His head is lowered, his hair hanging in a curtain across his face. His fair skin is crosshatched with broad, crimson scars held together by metal staples and covered with black, spiked runes for physical healing. Could an ordinary mortal have survived such injuries? Unlikely.{/n}

313ada2e-bc20-4581-833f-bc2edc6cac66.Text:
"By bitter paths comes wisdom,
In wake of bloody losses
and shattered dreams,
Heavy thoughts weighing
on its broad shoulders,
It enters unbidden
and takes a seat
by your hearth."

d742f958-2109-414c-9ca0-a6b21946b902.Text: {n}The wolf shrugs sadly.{/n} "Do not blame us for what we are. Death always clings to the warriors of the Allfather, and we are fated for no deeds other than those accomplished in the jaws of Morkai."

7275f219-b0b6-4008-8d1d-75560d5781f7.Text: "About the future. Have you ever wondered what it means to be an Astartes? To know no other family but your brothers in battle? To know no other feast but the joy of slaying your enemies and extolling your fallen comrades? To know with certainty that your death will be terrible, brutal, and agonising — for time holds no sway over us, and no warrior of the Allfather has ever breathed his last in a soft bed."

9c154c05-3353-49f2-8943-08d5cf00c43c.Text: "I needed it." {n}Ulfar looks at you with the mild surprise of someone who has rarely had to grapple with the notion of personal property.{/n}

77e83f38-9882-46f9-89b0-c033de693fcd.Text: "My mouth and ears are at your disposal."

2eeec988-cd25-4544-b153-45e3fd076ad8.Text: "The snow covered my eyes and I could only make out a shadow, but it moved fast and it was strong. If the Allfather's gift had not knitted my ribs into a hard carapace, that blow would have been my last." {n}The Wolf says these words with chilling nonchalance.{/n}

b05b62dc-12fa-4303-879d-42f885567a6f.Text: "An Astartes needs very little. A cell and a table where I can perform the purifying rite on my weapon — that is all I require. But to keep the armour bestowed upon me by the Allfather in some shabby cubicle would be sacrilege. This chamber will do well for the vesting ceremony — there is good plasteel beneath the rich decoration and gilding. Yes, I am satisfied."

c6b1e10f-8c14-4344-bd3a-75db0cf0057b.Text: "It is time for me to don my skin again." {n}Ulfar shrugs wearily, his body giving off heat and animal scent. One of the servants opens a casket containing contact unguent — it will be used to anoint each of the black carapace's neural ports marring the Wolf's skin. This sacred augmentation seamlessly fuses Ulfar's body with his armour and every fibre bundle of it.{/n}

7ee295de-29fb-4238-8c4f-1596ddbd0bea.Text: {n}After a few moments of silence, Ulfar says quietly,{/n} "So I did not have to bury your body in the snow, Aett-Vater. It is not out of arrogance that Wolves do not allow mortals into our affairs, but because the burden of those deeds is heavy, and they reek of death. Just consider what kind of threat you could have been facing. In a place where an entire pack of Astartes has disappeared. If I had risked you for the sake of fulfilling my vows — would that have been worthy of me?"

55a8fe61-0954-433c-ab87-ae2c5552ac34.Text: "I... understand. And I will pay you a bloodgeld for the fallen, Rogue Trader. The deaths of your warriors will be paid for with the deaths of your enemies."

cdfb9b05-9a37-43a5-9656-87e20c137bd8.Text: {n}Ulfar heaves a sigh, which seems to hang in the air between you.{/n} "You and I are different. Your way is to rule and build, while mine is to destroy and chase down prey. Such is the Allfather's plan, and in that plan, my death on the battlefield is an expected and joyous event, while your death would be premature, sorrowful, and damaging to many other lives."

f9273d6a-efdb-4572-90eb-4b8225e25230.Text: "And it grieves me. Alas, my enemy, whoever they were, proved too swift, and my thoughts were in turmoil. The air of that world reeks of something foul. Not of corruption... but crime."

bc63b566-62cf-4e45-90c6-f2d5a0373a14.Text: "The vessel I found, the Revelation Granted — that was them. Inside there were signs that Wolf scouts leave for their brothers. The Baleful Howl landed the ship on the surface and left, and the rest of the crew disappeared. I followed my brothers' trail until an unknown foe blocked my path. And battle ensued."

22a46e74-ee4f-4e34-a4d9-25ae1710304a.Text: "I feel flayed without it. Recently I have been trying to remember what it is like to live without a skin... I can't. Too many years have passed."

41925d8d-4acc-41dc-af55-e6474a666182.Text: "I must return. My foe awaits me, and it would be dishonourable to retreat from this battle. But I will need help in the fighting."

151f721e-c5e7-4ee3-a342-e2fc99c00c77.Text: "I can still feel its claws in my chest. Frost shredding flesh... Wounds left by spirits are dangerous. They create a spiritual link between your body and its pernicious mind. The only way to heal such mutilations is to brew a potion from the blood spilt by their incorporeal bodies."

554ebccc-6a18-45ba-b688-b9f589bb9fac.Text: "Then we are both marked. Our bodies will be tormented by its deadly touch until it is defeated. But fear not, Aett-Vater, we will defeat it. I swear it."

7a7b0f88-1afa-4987-a2c6-a1a17d94fc6f.Text: "I understand, Aett-Vater. But my pack's saga must be sung to its end."

beda0c15-c2d0-4a4c-96ae-87a358f421fb.Text: "I am not saying it is a good idea. But it must be done, Aett-Vater."

9d9259ef-3eb2-41d4-ab07-9660de91ed2a.Text: {n}Ulfar nods in agreement, his face grim.{/n}

635a1f93-a925-4c73-8426-1014bdd3e79d.Text: {n}The splendour and monumentality of the chamber befit the solemnity of the sacrament unfolding within. As if performing an intricate dance, the servants of the Omnissiah move in time with the murmuring mechanisms, circling the massive Space Wolf while he stands utterly still. The scent of sacred incense fills the air, giving the sense that one is witnessing a great ritual.{/n}

4c31dd7f-3abb-4cdc-a193-1fbb3a3ecb41.Text: {n}Ulfar nods to the servants, and in low voices they begin a guttural prayer. Shadows leap across the walls, twisting together in a majestic and savage dance. In the flickering candlelight, the sacred rite is performed — the Angel of the Emperor is clothed in the armour of unwavering faith and His wrath.{/n}

74474186-0b0d-4991-81ef-3c8a732b7355.Text: "Rhymes are empty frippery. A saga must be alive. If the words happen to fall into a rhyme, well, that is grand. But to make your whole story fit neatly into such a pattern, you must either twist the truth in the service of beauty, or live your life for the sake of a rhyme. Neither is to a Wolf's liking."

8d30bfbe-809d-4629-8ee2-242fdc56f748.Text: "I will find them." {n}Ulfar clenches his fists.{/n} "Probably not alive. But I will find them."

19f143c8-cd92-4c84-a7c4-6ef76d20028f.Text: {n}With a twitch of his fingers, Ulfar bids the two servants in attendance to step away so as not to intrude on your conversation. They silently retreat.{/n} "Aett-Vater, I must thank you for saving me. I had a difficult battle."

3ad512f7-142f-4ef2-bd2d-741524be2e85.Text: "An evil spirit. It attacked me from behind and wounded me instantly." {n}Ulfar points to a particularly gruesome scar on his chest, the strike clearly intended for one of the Space Wolf's two hearts. The wound gives off a strong medicinal smell, but it is not one you recognise — probably a Fenrisian balm brewed by Ulfar himself. Your healers would faint after one whiff of such a potion.{/n}

8eb9eff2-0c0a-45b9-ae5f-bc610b23b8c1.Text: "But it eluded me once again. And there would have been no glory in such a death — I could not even tell what I was fighting against, and I had not found my brothers."

e2a96685-d4f1-4c6d-8c62-87713cfbf2d9.Text: "Our sagas are voices sounding through eternity. When we hear them, we do not hear stories — we hear the tellers, speaking their words to us now."

0ac328a3-d18b-4645-908e-aa8a09bb71b9.Text: "Death holds no fear for us, Aett-Vater. We have been eating at the same table since day one."

c02fcabd-e79d-4539-bb31-ae2d55935266.Text: "As for which me emerged victorious, that was hidden from my sight. But that is not what frightened me... The black wolf's gaze was fearsome, full of more pain than he could ever inflict himself. It drove him mad, turning him into a monster. And, as dark as he appears, I... recognise myself in him. After all, I was made for destruction, torment, annihilation. I am the more agile monster. Does that mean that, by the Allfather's design, I must drink this cup of pain to the bottom in order to fulfil his plan? I do not know." {n}Ulfar looks at you, his expression inscrutable.{/n}

a7f1f882-d4ce-49a3-93af-0ee233be4920.Text: "Listen, Aett-Vater. When the Wolf Priests tested me, I went to the Gate of Morkai, a dark place where realspace and the thoughts of the Great Wolves intertwine like the tentacles of a kraken. Everyone who appears before the Gate is granted a vision, and mine was... a dark omen. I saw myself, in two guises — one as white as the moon, the other as black as the lowering sky. And the two were locked in combat."

2165d822-d85a-4ab9-b3f2-bbd020a654a9.Text:
"...Stepped back,
to {mf|his|her} ally granting
breadth to strike."

05e20686-f882-4b95-9e8f-1184bb49d07f.Text:
"The Allfather's call two summoned
to battle against the beast."

4297e9ee-cc8c-4e18-b065-c05aed70e933.Text:
'Fight boldly on,
my brave brother, Ulfar,
You will taste this victory alone!'

a4d8f0da-e239-4845-ab70-f858b05ad169.Text: "Terror and awe the beast's form roused..."

33b62bbf-af71-40ab-9c6d-44a647e4dd6f.Text:
"...Against the second went
von Valancius the {mf|Brave|Furious}."

1259646c-dd40-43fe-95ff-4a71ad71d2db.Text:
"...The second went whirling
with von Valancius the fleet-footed,
unable to smite the foe."

761d79fa-c89f-47c5-af4e-f0896e4fed01.Text:
"...With the second he clashed,
the Aett-Vater as his shield."

08567922-5c03-44e1-b1a3-152fab29e33a.Text:
"{mf|His|Her} retinue to {mf|his|her} aid
the Rogue Trader called..."

463ed84a-fe46-4f91-a2f3-f7332988e67a.Text:
"...And turn the two Wolves away
from the empty shedding of blood."

7357686d-157c-439d-838d-c225973340d1.Text:
"...And {mf|his|her} words were formidable
and filled with wrath!"

4e76ffdf-b0af-455d-b52c-d43b281c7c41.Text:
"...A direct blow struck
to the beast's broad back."

1bf0497e-727c-415f-85f0-b44636e15073.Text:
"...With a keen shot struck
the enemy from afar."

bc79d1a5-df0c-4221-a7b3-730d2ed8a845.Text:
"...A sliver of weakness sighted
in the foe's armour."

41c0c788-3612-4d26-bb45-0c83bab3ea29.Text:
"Upon the Aett-Vater fell
the wolf's fiery gaze."

73b152af-13fb-4e7c-bfd6-c53343b79805.Text:
"'The sweet mjod
my mind has fogged'
—said the Aett-Vater..."

306e8852-57d1-4a60-a515-3e7454181b99.Text:
"From the Aett-Vater's lips
a daring song burst forth,
death on the battlefield extolling!"

1757e262-7dae-4715-85b1-f1a13ee498ea.Text:
"{mf|His|Her} teeth gritting,
the Aett-Vater stared down the foe..."

aeb03638-c0ba-4509-8130-e95ac7eedb4e.Text:
"Glory to brave hearts
that fear not death!"

7d38de2b-a8e3-4322-bf01-70a35448faf5.Text:
"Said the spirit,
and then it fell silent forever,
the noble Wolf's body fleeing,
and peace to it bestowing."

0ea9ec4d-722f-4276-9101-eb6e4743a4fa.Text:
'Who killed your brothers?
From this day forth,
who is our foe?'

489225c8-190e-446c-94e7-40cefe05e747.Text: 'What now will become of you, my lord?'

74ed90b9-95e9-4f05-acf0-a2eebe7d4a64.Text:
'The honour of Fenris
you have defended,
Ulfar Thunderlung.'

7fedc8b9-c42c-4e1c-9df6-2d3dca8652d7.Text:
'Now the last of the pack remains:
Ulfar the Avenger.'

90af5555-2de5-4f71-a6de-6148ca446ca3.Text:
'A shame it is
that you came not in time
to save your brothers, Ulfar,
who is called Everlost.'

5ac41e70-2a6e-4b07-a4fe-f1d3ecbc0bd5.Text:
"Glory to the fierce Wolf,
son of Fenris!"

c06a1091-9205-4313-95ff-29f3ec4013d5.Text: "Was there room in Ulfar's heart for sorrow?"

7061bd70-4cb9-44a8-b057-be17496d15c8.Text: "Did he think to return to Thorbald's pack?"

e4106c36-bf0e-4c31-9b44-daccb5715bbe.Text: "What fate awaited Ulfar in the future?"

ebade829-f995-4a2b-892a-089850e3329f.Text:
"Woe to the warrior,
the curse's burden is heavy!"

5e9ec64c-3de7-4f11-b01d-48ad27727c1a.Text:
"Ulfar held no fear
that his strike broadly sweeping
his ally would catch
in a glancing blow.
He fought mercilessly,
his heavy swings scribing
scarlet runes upon the snow.

b382c7a6-7e2a-4951-b31c-93c733a5df34.Text:
"My verses you will hear,
Glorious brothers,
Of how the paths of Ulfar,
called Thunderlung from the first,
and the Last Wolf of the Baleful Howl,
were intertwined.
Over his brothers' cold bodies standing,
Ulfar the hard-armed proclaimed
to the sky their glorious sagas,
and his last homage paid
to those warriors proud,
as his witness taking
his companion of the line von Valancius.
The blizzard was raging
and the wind furiously howling,
As under that terrible clawed paw,
the snow crunched,
and in the dead light of a moon
strange to human eyes,
a beast,
long fur bristling,
of death reeking,
into the circle stepped."

7bc570d7-896b-443e-a35b-29775f074e94.Text:
"The power of words spewed
from the beast's mouth grinning,
The cry of the wild hunt,
and the embittered souls hearkened!
Out of snow and wind
wolf bodies were woven
for the warriors who died
an unclean death,
the unavenged,
evil never forgetting!
Their ice-fangs gnashing,
they approached,
into the roiling sky howling.
The first brother
by Ulfar was vanquished..."

2d5bef74-0db9-45df-90ff-f9ceb4c508d6.Text:
"His gory breath to vapour turning,
with guile and fierce malice
his eyes glowing,
the whirling eddies
like a snow-cloak
upon his shoulders lying,
waiting
for the beast to feed them
with hot blood.
Even the moon stood patron to him,
his face hiding
with the shadows of her deceitful dance.
His howl the old tune echoing
of the Fenrisian sagas
of mindless rampaging
and mortal carnage."

0713939c-0c9a-4697-bfb5-b4a85ff301c3.Text:
"One on one
the spirit and Ulfar warred,
The flame of the mortal soul
and the chill of the grave.
But little by little
the hot hearth began to dwindle,
to Ulfar battle-strength granting.

d73e4203-99af-43c7-891d-1f2216ddff98.Text:
"...But the cry was drowned out
by the harsh elements roaring.
Magic, with snow whirling
in a dance intertwining,
for the beast left
a bloody reaping
of only two."

906f8da9-6d94-4427-bc9b-9b00436fbe0d.Text:
"The ghostly wolf was struck down
with a fearsome blow.
In outrage howling,
away into the storm he melted
till no trace was left.

17446934-8417-4b14-a7b5-d97b448e15a3.Text:
"Fearsome was the blow,
but the heat of mortals
did not defeat
that son of Helwinter's frost
and craver of vengeance!

e4fdff16-bcba-43d2-9321-bed8da4f1e26.Text:
"Among the winds they whirled
in a dance of death,
The cunning Aett-Vater evading,
those front-fangs.
By the hunt spellbound,
the ghostly wolf darted to and fro,
Till Ulfar's firm hand
sent him scattering
across the snow.

b4386351-08de-44da-ac0d-ed8f38448139.Text:
"Twice the ghostly wolf came lunging,
and when a third time he leapt,
it was the promise of his death.

26406a0e-799c-4f88-90ad-ac1a0ac26c92.Text:
"Then with laugh booming
the heavens were split
by the formidable Ulfar,
his battle-friends guarding.
With a mighty wrench
the wolf's jaws he tore,
opening them wide,
the evil charms banishing.

bb117994-6e67-4c2e-a26e-bd4e1b089a0b.Text:
"Like stout armour
in trouble's path standing,
Ulfar boldly accepted
the hail of blows.
Numb to his wounds,
the cruel foes he slew,
his ally's looming death forestalling."

d40e267d-890d-4e71-b0dd-e0add3d16849.Text:
"'You did not fear to meet me,
Perfidious spirit,
who the name Doppelgrendel claims.
I see you have naught learned
from the last battle,
though you paid for it
with gouged eye!'
—so spoke Ulfar Thunderlung.
And the beast replied—
'Of your spoils you boasted
to the priests in vain,
Ulfar Everlost.
My body alone you wounded,
but I your spirit maimed
and your wyrd crippled.'
Then came the turn of the Aett-Vater to speak..."

a845f83d-285b-41f2-a17a-e8cbb647a064.Text:
"But it is not given to us
to change fate's weaving.
The children of Fenris hungered
for mortal combat."

bad5437b-8022-4c64-8c8d-3ea7e60318dd.Text:
"The grin was merry
and full of bloody joy.
'For your insolence you will pay
with tears and blood.'
—so answered the dread spirit,
and to that harsh oath served
the hurricane itself
as witness incorruptible."

caa2e522-54e1-40cc-a8fa-2cdbb20f30c0.Text:
Fiercely roaring, forward stepped
Brother Ulfar to meet him,
taking the blow
intended for the Aett-Vater.
With a terrible blow he replied,
and by the maelstrom
the wolf was laid low,
struck down and shamed."

8fe0cee1-aa65-47df-a304-fae5df12b751.Text:
"...But the beast was not yet vanquished.
Roaring, his body he threw
into the fray
like a mighty spear-thrust,
Howling, his claws cut through the adamantine,
The warriors fought,
a river of blood spilling.
Ulfar Thunderlung,
his battle song singing,
The black curse
his vicious rival echoing.
The warriors were clashing
when the cunning Aett-Vater..."

79957e6b-f084-45e8-ba24-6dd3c9935568.Text:
"Like scarlet runes
upon the snow
the blood lay.
But the dark Wolf's grip
did not slacken.

8506115d-3ad1-4687-9a45-bf7a794d9f54.Text:
"The dark Wolf howled
in rage and agony,
His eyes blazing
with lust for vengeance.

d5b0e497-5355-405d-a3a7-cb4c88ce7c26.Text:
"A weakness spying
in the strong armour's joins,
The Aett-Vater to Ulfar {mf|cried out|a sign gave}
that a ruthless blow
he should strike.
His knife drawing,
and a harsh cry unleashing,
Thunderlung plunged the blade
into the insidious spirit's foul flesh.

9951e606-6b8d-4968-b4dc-801bdbd11676.Text:
"No matter how the Aett-Vater tried,
no weakness could {mf|he|she} spy
in the evil spirit's stout armour.

2dd93903-c123-4631-abd7-b226e244ec12.Text:
Each the other's throat seizing,
the warriors fought to the death.
Both were flagging,
but of cunning
the beast had enough
yet in store."

96c71c40-cda9-42d5-b7c9-a079c1c0d3ad.Text:
"'By the power of icy Fenris,
I do curse you!
If you look into the past,
you shall see only deceit,
If you look into the future,
you shall see only treachery!
The false friend's dagger
shall open your breast,
the arrows of deceits wrought
shall pierce your back!'
—so spoke the spirit,
born in sorrow,
the Aett-Vater cursing.
And then the bloody wound the Aett-Vater spied.
{mf|His|Her} breast was cut,
{mf|His|Her} heart was quiet,
the Aett-Vater's death
had caught {mf|him|her} unawares."

d730c634-c46d-4d09-9168-d145f875dcc9.Text:
With dignity was met
each brutal strike,
and with savagery was slain
each deadly foe!"

e48e75c5-2b6c-46f3-ab91-106286da744c.Text:
To his knees the beast fell,
and suddenly about his grey lips,
a smile played
of guile and fear."

4f777544-2bb9-4747-a11b-47cf55575b12.Text:
"...And like a veil that clouds the gaze
the vision slipped away."

f5b5a952-136c-4eef-a0f1-cb7f21ce4d4f.Text:
"...But the evil spirit's mirage
proved too strong.

a04171cb-d692-4e16-8d34-61e2d028901a.Text:
"The knife in the moonlight gleamed,
across the wolf's face cutting,
In a blink,
the dark gloom receded,
the spell dissipated."

e05f5a0e-4214-4426-af31-cd689f51df82.Text:
"But no strength was left
in the cold, battered body.

061376c3-7049-450a-b2cc-5a8a87000fdb.Text:
"The heat of these words
the Aett-Vater's heart inflamed,
the spirit's fatal vision banishing!"

afcf2f34-ae5b-4354-89ff-94d13473baeb.Text:
"But the bold words turned to stone,
The cold of the grave chaining
them in the weakened throat.

deefe372-173b-448f-a868-78f2c30a5053.Text:
"'Together, Aett-Vater,
our horns at the feast we'll raise!
My eyes are wearied by the sight
of my companions perishing in battle!'
—so came Ulfar Thunderlung's reply,
the spirit's iron grip breaking.
In agony, the malign son of Fenris cried out
and the fog fled
from the Aett-Vater's mind."

b40ca695-fec9-4162-b4c9-849476d1da9c.Text:
"So the dark beast lay
in the snow,
His chosen name—
the Doppelgrendel,
and over his body standing,
Ulfar said—'Before you die,
answer me, evil spirit.
Who killed my brothers,
the Baleful Howl?'

14ad14df-ca50-4fdf-9681-c02c7a98ae71.Text:
"Ulfar was grievously wounded,
but the mighty beast he slew,
and asked it with menace,
his mangled hand
the beast's throat gripping—
'Who is to blame
for the deaths of my brothers?
Answer me, fell spirit!'"

637b98e8-2183-4953-b00e-6acce34a1499.Text:
"The pair stood together
over the prostrate body,
The body not of a beast,
but of a brave fallen brother.
The fearsome Ulfar declared
an oath of vengeance,
and the mighty Wolves
to Kjalhalla went charging!
They went knowing
that from their betrayers
three times the blood price
would be exacted.

e5841179-9d31-46fc-be33-5e5e5fb1493b.Text:
In its death rasp,
the Doppelgrendel answered—
'Brother, we were doomed
not by the Archenemy's followers,
nor by the despicable inhumans,
who did not touch our armour,
nor with dark sorcery
did the malefics defeat us.
No, it was the humans,
who oaths of friendship swore,
that plunged the blade into our back,
their treacherous plot
in malice hatched.'"

e972ed82-c4ba-47df-a85f-babff0759a8c.Text: And the Aett-Vater also {mf|his|her} piece spoke:"

8937afd3-c8a3-4067-b581-9e6211241140.Text:
'The traitor's name for now
remains unknown,
but in the darkness
I will find him
and have my vengeance'
—so answered Thunderlung.

a86d81bf-2955-46b8-bd46-a322020f23c4.Text:
From the mangled hand dripped
blood hot and thick,
spilt for the just cause.
The fingers now bereft
of their former furious strength,
but it lived on
in the wolf's cruel heart.

c57306d5-1f41-4804-92a0-04734b8c4d43.Text:
'My brothers,
the Allfather's hall entering,
will boldly tell that in death
they have not been forgotten.
With a joyous roar
these words they will answer,
for they surely mean
that fierce Fenris still stands.'

e381e94a-a5af-4880-b96d-b384effe91a6.Text:
"'For the cursed Wolf,
there is no other path
but to be the hand
that punishment metes out
to his brothers' slayers,
The fires of their hearts by death
are generously doused,
but I, cooled forever, always endure.'

8af717a4-4c88-46b0-b1d2-338f5dce7d97.Text:
'In this world
there is no curse more terrible
than that which the evil spirit,
the Doppelgrendel,
has upon me cast.
'Tis sweeter to lie a cold corpse
under a banner of glory
than to bury my brothers,
and always survive.'

c4b106ac-2e73-42fc-98a1-efc377133c56.Text:
"And so ended
the saga of the Baleful Howl,
May the Blackmane guide them
to Kjalhalla!
Only one was not claimed
by Morkai the dark-hearted—
Ulfar Thunderlung stood stalwart
upon the ground.
Too stubborn for death
was this rebellious wolf,
Too hot to be seized
by the chill of the grave.
His brothers praising,
he raised his deadly axe—
'Fenris stands,
so there will many yet to slay.'"

f60c18d8-3f43-4a7c-a77d-2984d3d9fd2a.Text:
"'Know, my brothers,
that my heart will have no peace
until I see you in Kjalhalla.
I hear your laughter
and your proud war cries,
I will carry them into the darkness,
for the Baleful Howl.
Many foes I will smite
to glorify your deed,
Many I will put to death
to honour your memory.
When to the ground I fall,
mortally wounded,
You will meet the Lone Wolf
in Kjalhalla.'"

3e6fb29d-42dc-4b07-863d-c379d30009ec.Text:
"'The Baleful Howl is no longer.
All are dead,'—said he.
'And I call myself a dead man.
My path lies not to Kjalhalla,
but to a hollow end.
My memory no longer holds
the stories of my brothers.
The seed of bitter losses
and bloody hardships,
As a weed, has sprouted
and destroyed its firm ground.
I remember now only
blood in the arena,
steaming wounds and dead comrades,
empty oaths and oblivion...
I remember how
the spirit Doppelgrendel
placed a curse upon me.
And this curse I dutifully accept!'"

9f7923d8-dac7-4465-acc6-03b1d38f942d.Text:
"Let us remember, brothers,
the Baleful Howl—
daring hunters, fierce fighters,
and trouble-makers without equal!
Let us glorify their exploits
and glorify their fall,
with honour have these Wolves
gone to Kjalhalla!
Let us remember
the mighty brother Ulfar,
who did not abandon his pack
in the snowy wastes!
Let us remember
the Trader of the von Valancius line,
{mf|He|She} whose name is known
and honoured on Fenris.
Let us raise our cups
and cry into the face of Helwinter's gale—
'Father, we live still!'"

44c03100-f712-4696-8436-4742bed82b15.Text:
"...So it was!
But anguish does not plague
the warrior's soul.
He knew one day
his brothers he would meet again,
once the curse was broken
and his honourable death
he claimed in battle!"

2dfa1433-dc39-41d8-9ef9-e1d53edd5708.Text:
"...No, for he would betray
his brothers' memory.
The name of the Baleful Howl
would not be forgotten,
while the last had not yet fallen."

b3a151dd-5329-4992-a2a3-567821f2a0cb.Text:
"...Before, ones such as he
to the Moritat would go,
that black purge,
warband sworn to death,
in battle doom seeking and finding.
But the years had passed,
and the old brotherhood
was no more.
Only exile awaited
the weary Wolf.
There, far from his brothers and mortals,
could he surrender
to the poisoned curse
that had cleaved his heart."

09460494-7449-410d-98d7-6587444e56ab.Text:
Region: -classified-
Location: -classified-
Material: Oral retelling of "On Ulfar and His Brothers, the Baleful Howl" (saga) and "On the Last Wolf" (verse)
Recorded by: Archronicler Olkert Memistat

ba5a3891-8ada-4b7f-9da2-f2ab5f413caa.Text:
"Having spoken thus,
upon the snow the Aett-Vater fell.

15b5f2e4-1cef-42bd-9ff3-8500617d689e.Text:
The old spinners weave
the wyrd-thread cruelly,
no enquiries or entreaties accepting.
Ulfar Thunderlung cast his gaze
and clearly he beheld..."

69af647a-2708-44bb-b67d-d75fc54576ae.Text:
So Ulfar's mighty word was spoken.
A proud funeral dirge was sung,
His brother's weary body,
cursed by grief,
from his carapace was freed
and laid upon the pyre.

290de3c3-0cff-4832-b94b-62690ce47eaa.Text:
'My steps are dogged by doom,
the worthy perishing,
and I surviving!'
—roared Ulfar Thunderlung,
despairing,
his brow darkened
with blackest grief.
In Ulfar's heart
there was no trembling
when his hand he thrust
into the beast's maw.
His scheming tongue firmly gripping,
Ulfar began to wrench,
heeding not the roar!
The teeth snapped closed,
the warrior's hand disfiguring,
but the tormenting fog relented,
the Aett-Vater releasing."

ff3ac464-bafd-415d-8279-bc1d11c3441d.Text: "This game board is chained in crimson and black shackles. The colours are so rich... But how is this possible? Normally, an object only exudes distant echoes of its owner's colours."

84ee187a-43d4-4338-9af1-24c2210efbed.Text: "This place is enveloped in a fog of dirty scarlet. I can barely see past my own outstretched hand. And dark shadows are lying in wait around every corner... Sometimes my ability to see the essence of things seems more of a curse than a gift."

26a6daeb-5cbe-4df8-87ba-990aaffff726.Text: Judging by the marks on its body, this unfortunate xenos was sewn together from several individuals of the same species and then ripped three modified Aeldari hearts out of its own chest.

6b32b494-f344-4a01-a535-5400c7df4486.Text: Frozen in elegant poses on the intricate game board are figurines of Drukhari and Asuryani, carved with great skill from onyx and wraithbone.

f1cb3b5a-9809-4daa-b4f2-449dd74acb45.Text: The Farseer's body is covered in fresh wounds. Their edges are turning blue and rotting: the effect of an unknown toxin.

ffcf3e50-13d1-4d3b-b4ed-4eeb4485d5dd.Text: "The Haemonculus has activated the mechanisms inside this room. Hurry and save me, and I will repay you in kind."

e4694ec6-bdf9-46be-bb3a-d4e0b06724bb.Text: "Wait, mon-keigh! Extend a helping hand and I will show you the way home."

ece487e8-5e41-4297-a379-b5fe1ed2c5c4.Text: "There is fairly strong psychic activity coming from those pieces. I would not recommend touching them. There is no telling what manner of trap may have been set here by someone as insane as a Drukhari Haemonculus."

6629828e-6962-42f3-8482-4c1d03a5df74.Text: "The energy of a thousand tortured souls permeates this spire. I can feel their fury and thirst for vengeance. And their helplessness."

e3d616d9-0488-407c-8182-2f6d88ece00b.Text: "Hoo... Those creepy game pieces give me the shivers. Hey, can you hear that? They're even talking! They— it— gah, this thing's alive! Get out! Get out of my head!"

5185f32e-de80-49be-adb2-9c0b24b8b57f.Text: "The little whisperers in my head are going crazy with excitement. Lots of knocking on the door. All the visitors from the other side who can't wait to share the last visions they had before they died. Oi, form an orderly queue, idiots! There's a load of you and only one of me!"

d4684fc9-46a3-415e-b847-82dda6c233b5.Text: "You are here too, elantach! Quick, help me. We must save him before the guards return. There should be a switch somewhere in this room. Look carefully."

c1d44966-d5a6-477c-ab99-3c10348b234b.Text: "I have rarely given a thought to the price our dark kin pay to save their souls from the clutches of She Who Thirsts. But now I see the price their victims pay. The price my kin have paid."

08f87788-2f01-4f4f-b843-8ee8b063f3f1.Text: "I know you are there, Artreus, Cassarthruin, Maedryl, Dharianne! Answer my call and the call of your sister!"

0736cdd4-c1fe-42c4-88e5-c51ea6f98719.Text: Wounded the monster stitched together from Aeldari Farseers.

185595ee-4d3b-4c7b-a669-2330bde3064b.Text: [Wound the monster] "You're a sight! Let's see how you like this."

2062d525-cbd7-4dab-85d7-36102eaa8753.Text: [Kill the Farseers] "You should look away. I will put them out of their misery myself."

56326b6d-9686-44bf-b1ff-4f0640e9ec5a.Text: Told Yrliet to end the suffering of the monster stitched together from Aeldari Farseers.

7501585d-0b6e-41fd-9d5d-17b4460a8aef.Text: "Nothing of your kin is left in this creature. End their suffering, Yrliet."

a1eccf6d-876c-4442-b6fa-d13af0a3c31a.Text: "I am not afraid of the consequences."

1b4d75c5-e8c4-4029-9406-f36e41cdf7ca.Text: "You are right. Let's not risk it."

5aad2ae6-6c9c-478c-8daa-33ad2ddd7070.Text: [Use psyker powers to revive the Farseers]

626aac0c-02e9-417d-9e83-913ef608d981.Text: "You have been asked for mercy. Grant it."

55c55112-33e0-496a-97fc-200b4999a311.Text: "Whoever you are, we have come for answers. Help us make sense of what happened to your world."

5898924d-60d0-4aa0-a6d7-29090ab1a517.Text: "Your presence on Crudarach would hardly have changed anything. You would most likely be dead now."

acd6e55c-b5dd-4fda-9c9b-ae372b938eae.Text: "These are your kin. You should decide what happens to them."

bdadd7f9-5095-4285-bea7-51770ebe6a88.Text: "You should have stayed on your homeworld and defended it to the end."

cc94afc8-3113-4d27-bb14-9de5c5127552.Text: "Caetan... Caetaaan, my son..." {n}The Aeldari Farseer's tortured body is barely moving. You have seen abject creatures like this before: stitched together from several bodies, their miserable existence serves but to satisfy their Haemonculus master's morbid interest in perversions of the flesh. And yet... this one is not like the others. A twin face stitched together from parts of several male and female {g|Encyclopedia:Aeldari}Aeldari{/g} turns its unseeing gaze toward you. Its eyes have been crudely sewn shut.{/n}

743e4d5c-24c0-42a4-823d-247e78ee4da5.Text: "I doubt they can hear you. The Haemonculus's experiments... have twisted more than their bodies. Their minds and souls have been remoulded into something... wrong. All of this is wrong. It must not be!" {n}The Aeldari's usually calm voice is trembling, either with anger or with fear.{/n}

8389b612-fc91-4d27-82bf-10a8c1ca1a5f.Text: "That... is not so. The accursed Haemonculus has merged not just the Farseers' bodies, but their souls as well. They are still inside... in agony. Torn to pieces by memories, their own and others'. But I can sense the shadow of She Who Thirsts creeping ever closer, to devour them and erase them from this world forever. I cannot let that happen."
