c259557d-8b86-43bb-9d5f-544e1803d057.Text: "Any object you call your 'favourite toy' cannot possibly be anything good."

4d4d33e9-33f4-450b-ad61-722fb1f5b79b.Text: "Whatever it is, I will not permit you to take it with you."

fcc44f47-5826-4da6-913d-05a9b7e28fce.Text: "Humanity has similar tools. For livestock and peasants."

a2aeffec-3148-430a-8f36-00399b18e8c8.Text: [Snap the agoniser in Marazhai's hand] "While you are in my retinue, you can forget about such abominations."

6537fa86-febb-411b-9af1-3f048fc2702b.Text: "Why is this thing so important to you?"

43083f59-6f8c-4dfb-b2eb-e8ad7990f876.Text: {n}Marazhai spends several minutes rifling through the items on the tables until he stops, having noticed something. With a satisfied growl, he draws a long, pliable, spiked whip from the pile. You hear a click, and an icy blue glow ripples out across the whip's smooth surface with a slight crackling sound.{/n}

63a580fe-1dd1-487a-bdca-5ae998090cd9.Text: "Why? It is a priceless artefact that belongs to me, and I have reclaimed it before my kin managed to steal it. It is property of the Reaving Tempest that must not be allowed to fall into the hands of the other Kabals — and when we dispose of Yremeryss, the spire will certainly come under attack. And lastly... I can indulge in a little sentimentality, can't I?"

42e3bafa-4da5-4560-b035-449e2951cb95.Text: {n}The Drukhari chokes in outrage, genuinely shocked by your decisiveness. Gripping the broken agoniser in his hand, he glares at you, almost shaking with rage... and yet he does not lose control. With deliberate nonchalance, he tosses the pieces aside.{/n}

42dff602-3758-4ce3-a5ed-b0f298254fd6.Text: "Tsk. I doubt your kind is capable of such a sophisticated creation — most likely it is a crude copy."

8569eb53-988e-41cd-925c-fbc888fa3276.Text: {n}Marazhai shakes his head.{/n} "On the contrary. I have exceptional taste."

7d24c400-f305-4361-9db1-d776be9021bb.Text: "An agoniser. An electrical disintegrator that acts upon the nerve impulses. This particular one is too fine a piece to be used in combat, but in a torture chamber..." {n}The Drukhari hefts the whip, clearly familiar with the feel and weight in his hand.{/n} "An exquisite instrument of pain. Total impulse control. It can deliver sensations as subtle as a whisper... or incinerate synapses."

6b57d926-8072-46bc-8695-2f2bc529dd64.Text: {n}Marazhai's eyes narrow.{/n} "You would deny me such a trifle without even knowing what it is? Are you so afraid of the unfamiliar? How tragic."

9161ec9c-2fce-4728-94a8-04545529a5ae.Text: {n}Marazhai's voice drops to a whispered growl.{/n} "You wanted to know my world, {name}. Where is that desire now?"

b26b9d5c-2fb3-46d1-8f98-5f9f9b569da2.Text: {n}Marazhai hums low in his throat.{/n} "I ought to express my gratitude for my escape from the arena, after all. What better way than to share with you that which truly excites me?"

bf863d0a-be09-4c82-bedd-b7307431012c.Text: {n}Marazhai swings his arm without hesitation, and the agoniser's flexible tail wraps around your wrist. At first, you feel nothing... and then a fiery flower of agony blooms in your heart, sending poisonous roots along your veins and into every corner of your body. Your vision darkens, you gasp for air, your knees threaten to buckle beneath you — and then the pain recedes like a tide, leaving behind the crazed pounding of your heart and aftershocks dancing in your nerve endings.{/n}

9c58b619-007f-48b2-a780-91be8a168f7f.Text: {n}The Drukhari's eyes glitter with delight and mockery.{/n} "That was minimal power. Barely any at all, I would say. Did you really think I would be in such a hurry to break... my new toy?"

e7c29c08-afc8-4535-b70e-65da6bc95187.Text: {n}Marazhai half-closes his eyes, and with a flick of his wrist, he twists the agoniser's flexible tail around his arm. A moment later, a wave passes through the Drukhari's body, sending his eyes rolling into the back of his skull and making him arch his spine and throw his head back. Spasm after spasm courses through his body, until finally a stifled gasp claws its way out of his throat. The agoniser's tail slips from Marazhai's wrist, and he looks at you with unfocused eyes.{/n}

c61073ad-58ec-449c-9dab-c3bac4e7486e.Text: "I... am accustomed to pain. Unlike you, {name}." {n}You detect a glimmer of interest in the Drukhari's gaze.{/n} "I would like to see you... endure something like this. But not now. Another time."

8c9244da-ee85-42cd-b058-e4c11c61e100.Text: "Let us go. I no longer have any desire to wander the spire."

9d832c2f-d9db-40cc-a546-78953fa8a89b.Text: {n}Marazhai tuts in disappointment, but he nevertheless coils up the agoniser and clips it to his belt.{/n}

96ca0f60-79f2-4426-8c53-2cf74f6e3de9.Text: "I did not find my shadow field generator, and my toxin kit is gone too... but at least I have found my favourite toy." {n}The Drukhari shows you his find.{/n} "Do you know what this is, {name}?"

d02a089e-a763-40a3-946a-5eacf68256b2.Text: {n}Marazhai weighs the whip in his hand once more and gives you an appraising look. At last, he says softly,{/n} "Do you want to try it out, {name}? A little... demonstration?" {n}His eyes dart to your arm.{/n}

ea805eaa-c0d6-4d8e-8bfb-36d1e6a450d6.Text: [Make your echo touch Yrliet's echo's hand]

8a061953-3043-48e5-a1ca-fab5ba4ddf0a.Text: "Will I be able to see your world?"

6074f864-9809-479d-b1cc-0bd876d6ef37.Text: "Thank you for showing me this part of myself."

559562ff-7265-4f65-8ee8-12e47563c8de.Text: "Wow. I feel as if I have been reborn."

5245ea5d-5e34-4eb0-a189-9b660d6841f6.Text: "It's not litter, it's my inner world!"

448d17cb-b45d-4b09-b9e6-19729163dc20.Text: "Will you help me with meditation again?"

5795a916-9603-4e1d-93d5-1d215257df7c.Text: "When we were meditating, you did not seem surprised by my... relationships with our mutual acquaintances."

1631cdf2-0d05-43da-b90d-24a98dfee7ba.Text: "Why are you so surprised by these particular echoes of my world?"

9d5d5ba9-e17a-4554-b76b-f28c380163c9.Text: "When you strive to know someone, they inevitably become a part of you."

ce4cd4e1-76e1-4fa4-b8a0-9d8b48bb9590.Text: {n}Yrliet's face tenses in surprise, her features becoming even sharper as she stares in confusion at the ghostly figures. She says nothing, stealing glances at you, then at the figures again, as if she is waiting for something.{/n}

dd058384-979d-4b7c-96f0-3c2fd6ea7b0c.Text: "Of course, your world is not as beautiful and serene as mine, but I was glad to see it."

bb7713f8-d184-4a66-b36f-320fb321b6cc.Text: {n}When your soul's echo touches the ghostly skin of the Aeldari, the real Yrliet recoils in horror.{/n} "So these are the dormant desires lurking in the depths of your soul, mon-keigh! I promised not to judge you, but this... this is not something I can tolerate. Enough."

1c033cd1-a3f2-48dd-97e6-c07fd197d3c5.Text: {n}You and Yrliet stand together in complete silence for a while — tense and awkward at first, then soft and enveloping. You feel Yrliet sigh ever so slightly, and you hear the sadness hidden in her voice. But she remains silent until the ghostly figures around you start to disappear.{/n}

0909318b-f54a-4f98-89be-b69d55239690.Text: {n}When your soul's echo touches the ghostly hand of the Aeldari, the real Yrliet flinches in fear and involuntarily pulls her own hand back.{/n} "Please, elantach! This may be your world, but I... Do not do that again."

acc70299-c063-42f7-a786-7cae1492ee92.Text: "{name}, you are awake." {n}Yrliet starts at her own words, realising that this is the first time she has ever called you by your name.{/n} "Your soul shines too radiantly for a human, despite all the litter that had accumulated in your soul. You can get rid of litter, but the light... Try to preserve it, {name}. It draws the eye like bright stars in the night sky."

27243124-0a32-4f2c-9f53-bbefabbb3710.Text: {n}You awaken from your meditation with a sense of vigour and unusual calm. As if you have just taken a shower under a freezing waterfall. Or delivered a speech in front of thousands of subjects and your heart swells from the crowd's adulation.{/n}

b69853a8-7a7a-43e7-9c24-6419ff9bf963.Text: {n}Yrliet just shakes her head.{/n} "I do not think so, elantach. It is impossible to know everything in this world, no matter how much we would like to. And still, my heart sings, for I have helped you find peace. Even if only for a short while."

35cf5c46-4673-401e-b1c1-83bac93ae508.Text: "My heart sings, for I have helped you find peace. Even if only for a short while."

654e3ad0-6bde-475e-90f0-0d234f8f793e.Text: {n}Yrliet averts her uncertain gaze.{/n} "I did not think there would be a place for me inside a human's soul. And the memory itself... Clean. Not distorted. This is something I must reflect upon. And ponder in solitude."

9414923e-8136-43ed-9b3c-fcaf40d26dfa.Text: "I did not mean to hurt you with my words, elantach. You saw how much heaviness had amassed in your heart. Try to take care of it."

b3d9a95f-8abb-4c0e-be2c-01ae6addfbfb.Text: {n}Yrliet gives you a strange look.{/n} "Your words trouble me with their sincerity, elantach. Your mind is... much cleaner and loftier than I imagined. To become a part of someone..." {n}For a second, Yrliet lapses into thought.{/n}

73436aa2-a463-42a8-a51a-f33cefb9cb83.Text: "I do not know. Perhaps. Someday?" {n}she replies vaguely.{/n}

d3df6727-dd49-41af-891e-a08d7fc3688a.Text: {n}Yrliet's words echo across your world and the ghostly figures begin to disappear. The world around you starts to stretch endlessly.{/n} "It is time to return, elantach. Your soul is not yet strong enough to endure prolonged immersion. Take a deep breath and..."

f257cb7f-8527-43cc-b4d5-6e0a71af60b9.Text: {n}Your head is spinning from the sudden awakening, and you feel nausea creeping up your throat. But all of that is overshadowed by the angry emerald eyes staring at you.{/n} "Mon-keigh."

7b10f4a0-5800-4533-b57a-6bd9572bad9f.Text: "Until we meet again, elantach. May the stars guide us along the safe roads."

e42014d3-356e-4499-89e3-46f2e0b66fe2.Text: {n}A strange feeling envelops your body — you feel yourself become lighter than air, and inside your mind your thoughts are racing at an incredible speed. You are not yet aware that you are looking through the eyes of your ghostly echo and are observing from afar — all at the same time. The inner world changes under the force of your will, and you can now control your own echo. You can now do something that you would not dare to do in the real world.{/n}

f8c67024-5317-4ad6-9302-5919dd1c2f33.Text: "What is this, mon-keigh?" {n}The voice of the incorporeal echo that has made your soul its home seems to sound only in your own head.{/n}

4864b136-4607-48ca-8cef-606c2b890aef.Text: {n}Yrliet's words are akin to the lashes of an enraged whip.{/n} "After all the warnings and conversations we had, you decide to show your lowly nature. And at the exact moment when I was helping to ease the burden on your soul." {n}She shakes her head in disappointment.{/n} "Sometimes I wonder — can we ever come to fully understand each other? But your actions in the depths of your soul have shown how different we are. Enough, elantach. Do not try to reach inside my soul ever again — its doors are tightly closed to you from now on."

d698c1a8-ca37-4b05-8326-6b2dd8a8b983.Text: "It is time to return, elantach. Your soul is not yet strong enough to endure prolonged immersion. Take a deep breath and..."

62f05051-75a7-4f2c-8939-d3e69c4cc1ef.Text: "This is the cleansing of your soul, elantach. I hope that now you understand the importance of keeping it free from unnecessary litter."

4176dffe-c02c-4b65-8054-2ff442c5ed2d.Text: {n}Yrliet shrugs indifferently.{/n} "You long for that which human nature desires — for intimacy with your own kind. I can understand that."

4246f485-29ba-4805-8b37-bf97219e6564.Text: "Your kin? You have never referred to the Drukhari as such before."

9ec47aae-a7c3-4edb-9976-c175ce26cb7d.Text: "Why are you apologising? It is not your fault."

d3251f5b-4dc5-4866-88cb-b12441929994.Text: "I should not have underestimated my enemies. I will not make the same mistake again."

5227d553-c038-4956-883e-f08ed0eabaf9.Text: "What's wrong? Is there something on my face?"

3b4c4e63-7ff0-4d35-a094-c6c230f03180.Text: "What do you mean? I feel perfectly well!"

a7591d59-d3a5-4d59-90c3-f44743c99f9b.Text: "The burden of my responsibilities has indeed weighed heavily upon me of late."

b66c7186-23c2-4cd2-80fb-ac34a084f67f.Text: "How exactly are you going to help me?"

beb7db8f-ae1f-4c80-adbc-76c9665bc17a.Text: "I do not need to be cared for — by you or anyone else."

54b805c1-563e-4a9f-92ad-8c0f0a89557f.Text: "Delving into one's inner world — is it painful?"

a153916c-eed0-4003-9ec5-9790cecf998c.Text: "Is this the same meditation you were using before to immerse yourself?"

dc872c9d-df4a-4c29-bb47-a4718ed50f75.Text: "And you are a little curious to see what is inside my head, aren't you?"

292b79ce-f9a7-46ca-b770-66b7b9e1fe23.Text: "Very well. Yrliet, show me my inner world."

23dffd0b-24c7-4cb9-a8d0-96378f838ea4.Text: "Just admit it. There is nothing wrong with wanting to know a human's soul."

8acc6cf1-8157-47f4-8226-4331b528760d.Text: "Is that all? Or did you want to tell me something else?"

f3ae01b5-098f-4dbb-9e17-88cc487d957d.Text: "Your apologies will not bring back what has been lost."

b1bbea72-4de6-44a2-8abe-bffbf5fb129c.Text: "Elantach, I finally found you in this dwelling." {n}Yrliet comes closer and smoothly makes an unfamiliar gesture with her hands.{/n} "This symbol has many meanings — humility, grief, loss, shame, regret. I hope you will accept them all. Because I am sorry for what happened to your world, to your subjects, to your palace... and for what my kin did to them."

2cc8a80b-f30c-4177-96c5-51ed6932ca05.Text: {n}Yrliet falls silent, and her deep, piercing gaze seems to reach down into the very depths of your soul.{/n}

29757a5c-2deb-4e02-a586-0868a1bf1f77.Text: {n}Yrliet shudders, so slightly that you almost miss it. She opens her mouth, then turns away, searching for the right words.{/n} "My words will not heal the wounds nor bring back the fallen. And they will not restore your protectorate. However..."

59ff164d-c872-4b76-a6aa-34eff5140be8.Text: "Look, elantach. The gaze of a Child of Asuryan can penetrate deeper than a mon-keigh's. And I can see all the heaviness that has accumulated in your soul during our travels. I... see it. In your gestures. In the tilt of your head. In the change in your scent. If you will allow me..." {n}This is the first time you have heard Yrliet sound so indecisive and... guilty.{/n} "I will help you to cast off this burden and cleanse your soul and mind of worry."

1dd5aa54-0414-49ad-ab36-0bc50b5bb6ae.Text: "Nothing will help. Only time can erase the pain from memory, leaving healed scars on body and mind. But you have gained some invaluable experience, elantach. You have resisted the Drukhari and emerged victorious. This is a more than worthy outcome."

2f18f400-8bfb-4c3b-8ea2-9239efea9d67.Text: "Perhaps that is the song your body sings to you, but the exhaustion of mind and soul is much more subtle and easily missed."

580495f3-4df7-4cac-a23e-6cb8db847e2a.Text: {n}Yrliet nods in understanding.{/n} "Together, we can try to ease that burden."

f193cfd8-04be-43d6-8365-bffff6218e07.Text: "It is difficult to describe, elantach. But your soul shines bright and your mind is strong enough for you to be able to immerse yourself in your own mind and cleanse it of unnecessary cares. I am still not sure that your species is capable of such a thing... But it is worth a try. If nothing comes out of it, then the only thing you will lose is a small fraction of your time."

5f57d7fd-fe89-42ff-b488-6f9243e937a6.Text: {n}Yrliet frowns and averts her gaze, confused by your refusal.{/n} "Of course, elantach. Help is not something that should be forced. I hope you can rid yourself of the thorns that twine around your weary soul. Even if you do not realise your own exhaustion." {n}She nods curtly before leaving.{/n}

0d9b57e6-7c88-4798-a42c-c4df2f589353.Text: "No, elantach. There is no physical pain, but you will be able to see your inner pain if it is bleeding in your soul."

7c0a7fc9-814d-4ccb-ad39-562bf3e2c36d.Text: {n}An affirmative nod serves as her silent answer.{/n}

cf40184a-11a8-401f-bd43-c7e2015c73d5.Text: {n}Yrliet, looking offended, crosses her fingers in a new gesture.{/n} "Meditation is not a tool for achieving lowly goals — it is a healing spring for the soul."

058d399b-39a6-47d0-8e4e-1be1cae98578.Text: "And I will be your guide on this journey. I will help you to enter the meditative state, to get to know yourself... Of course, that is if you let me. Immersing yourself in your soul is a deeply intimate process, but you will not be able to do it without me." {n}Yrliet thoughtfully brushes a strand of red hair away from her face.{/n} "And I promise you, elantach, that I will not judge you — you, your world, or anything that takes place inside it. We will see only what you want to see."

51537db8-655e-4c0f-8402-d75e3fb786b1.Text: {n}Yrliet awaits your answer patiently. Her pose, a tad stiff, betrays her anxiety, but that is to be expected — she has decided to conduct a sacred Aeldari rite in order to help a human.{/n}

8cff49b6-4016-40e2-992d-708df6a7f037.Text: "And that is your right, elantach. A soul that is not ready for change will never open up to its full potential. And thus I will no longer lead you down the spiritual path that I myself follow."

1fdf8b65-77cf-4a9e-9181-27ce35302097.Text: {n}Yrliet nods slowly — she is clearly surprised by your compliance.{/n} "Then we need to find a suitable place. Somewhere quiet and serene."

8eb3a0e4-97a6-4eff-a5e2-224111f4cd6b.Text: "You are tired of fighting the raging waters of your life, and so I am holding out my hand to you. The choice to grab it or to fight alone is yours to make. So make it."

0b5829e9-01e9-4b65-9d04-fcbe197abd91.Text: "You are like a snake coiling around my body, twisting tighter with every word, elantach. It is hard to breathe when I am near you." {n}Yrliet furrows her brow and crosses her arms.{/n}

8c13eb09-b49f-484e-8209-93672c6d6177.Text: {n}Embers of genuine curiosity glimmer in her emerald gaze. To know a human soul is a unique opportunity for an Aeldari. And Yrliet's uncharacteristic caution and uncertainty imply that she is also discomfited by her own keen interest.{/n}

57ab044c-b4a4-4508-9446-8c6660a2b7c5.Text: {n}For a few seconds, Yrliet is silent.{/n} "We come from the same source, elantach. We share the same blood... even though the Drukhari's blood is distorted and their souls empty. It is a fact that cannot simply be brushed aside."

fecb3e28-e362-418e-a778-98599d054ba3.Text: "The Drukhari masterfully spin their webs of deceit and manipulation. Do not castigate yourself too harshly — even the most esteemed Children of Asuryan cannot always escape their clutches. But you, elantach, resisted my cousins more ably than many."

a30c1f5a-35ec-4513-9b17-7ad266a8db2b.Text: "I seem to have lost my right to vote today."

f907779c-c0ec-43f9-a42f-3ada39043e2e.Text: "Wait, you can do it without a spirit stone?"

dc7ff8c6-9192-4459-b7ab-e4ae03cf52f5.Text: "I do not think we are close enough to enter each other's souls again."

ba8a3632-e65a-4306-b1fb-37e8d3998b1f.Text: "I wasn't too thrilled with you either."

911c0aea-3c92-4697-8e70-a27db2aa5d94.Text: "I think there's something you're not telling me."

742a4834-ae7f-4ef4-867a-e683fd0c6a37.Text: "I have never heard so many compliments from you at once."

96a296ef-1f21-47ee-9dd3-9f2df7433957.Text: "I would be happy to share my life path with you."

98b5547c-372e-4e92-b6fa-c330f8be1356.Text: "I do not think we are close enough to live together until death parts us."

2da7e993-26a1-43b6-8308-55328d884179.Text: "This place looked a little different the last time I was here."

c0b0b124-464c-41cc-a6df-89b9fd21a99c.Text: "I am happy to see you now, and I will be happy to see you on my deathbed."

1397ce15-9643-40ec-b428-58a2d4d7f5e1.Text: "I will live much longer than you have foreseen. You might even get bored of me."

faf2e874-5604-4e4a-aad8-23676875cd0c.Text: "If you are ready to open them to me."

e184bfab-f936-4fed-b15e-67a2fababfa2.Text: "{name}, we need to talk!" {n}Yrliet rushes into your study like an invigorating gust of wind. Her face is beaming with a mixture of agitation and happiness.{/n} "I have just realised something very important, and only you will be able to understand me!"

e164e989-c38e-4076-88e5-fd362f9e25bc.Text: {n}Yrliet presses her hand to her chest and looks at you with irrepressible joy in her gaze.{/n}

f5e2550f-9c5a-4fda-b09c-1079fd9ed28d.Text: {n}Yrliet tilts her head to the side a little, and, overcoming her awkwardness, says,{/n} "I wanted to share this joy with you, {name}. What do you say? My true inner world, my real soul... Do you want to see them?"

0cd80327-ae60-406a-a8df-190f1d8f2a6b.Text: "Yes, oh yes, {name}. I was afraid that my world would wither during this time. That it would turn into a desert or become overgrown with weeds. But what I saw left me truly delighted."

379ecc1a-730d-435d-9f53-2fad7f2754d3.Text: "The spirit stone is the sacred protection of the Children of Asuryan. A talisman to ward off the evil gaze and control of She Who Thirsts. But it is replaceable. And, of course, it is not my actual soul."

7dafeaf7-450c-45b2-b661-4080a11d6d3f.Text: "My world resembles an endless road, piercing the galaxy itself. I can see no beginning or end to it..." {n}Yrliet pauses and looks at you attentively.{/n} "But I can see where the road ends for you, {name}. It ends much sooner than mine — like a fleeting flash, the glimmer of a fallen star. A short, beautiful moment... And this road, this moment, I wish to spend with you. Not as a human and a Child of Asuryan, but as equals. {name} and Yrliet. Yrliet and {name}. What do you say?"

ac04dd81-3a6b-4673-97ed-10f20aa2c543.Text: {n}Yrliet musters her courage and draws herself up straight like the string of a delicate, exquisite lyre. Her hand still reaches for her shattered spirit stone out of habit.{/n} "At first I thought that meeting you would bring my soul only pain and malediction..."

8c509ba5-8cb4-4fe3-a18c-86e4ec28a83f.Text: "You must be wondering why I am saying all this to you. The human habit of talking endlessly must have rubbed off on me." {n}Yrliet chuckles quietly, but her gaze suddenly turns serious and piercing.{/n} "I am here to tell you, {name}... I have no regrets. Not about meeting you, not about what happened to my spirit stone. The stars alone know how much richer and deeper my soul has become since meeting you."

40110c1c-0a28-4fac-9113-b13eb99f0336.Text: "I learned to pick out the sarcastic notes in human speech long ago, {name}. But you are right — you really do not have a choice."

5799ef7b-1ad4-4565-b58e-7ef8610ab76b.Text: {n}Yrliet laughs softly.{/n} "Probably. This is all because I have realised something really important — it was the souls of my Alaitoc ancestors that accidentally shattered my spirit stone. They meant me no harm — they were just trying to protect a child who walked the Path of the Outcast. And they... truly did help me, {name}. I can meditate and immerse myself in my world again!"

443067ce-4b56-488e-8052-8a1d5c7a1891.Text: "You are rejecting me? Now?" {n}Yrliet goes still, an indefinable expression appearing on her delicate face.{/n} "Well, it seems that I am still terrible at understanding humans. But I respect your wishes, just as you have tried to respect mine all this time."

3adfe222-79f1-45e5-a85a-254923ed5425.Text: {n}A loud sigh, a wave of her fiery ponytail — and Yrliet leaves your room without saying another word.{/n}

850f32b0-4325-4839-992f-46526f30245e.Text: {n}Yrliet smiles warmly and beckons you closer than usual, but she still does not touch your skin.{/n} "Then close your eyes, {name}. And listen to my voice..."

71fc69f8-0ed1-43e9-97d3-8efe8d56957b.Text: {n}You close your eyes and dive into infinity... And when you open them again — a wondrous road with no end in sight appears before you.{/n}

2ba9fd4a-5c57-454c-b1a3-63b6e593e7f4.Text: {n}Yrliet nods knowingly and extends her hand to you.{/n} "Then I would love to see the glow of your world once again, {name}. Human emotions are... different. Like faraway stars. And they are just as mesmerising."

5628022c-3f27-4f05-9309-82af185cca66.Text: {n}Yrliet's laugh is soft and tender, as if the burden of her fate has melted in the rays of a nearby star.{/n} "I was afraid that my world would have withered during this time. That it would have turned into a desert or become overgrown with weeds... But it changed. For the better, I think."

0017dd2f-987b-4d96-9096-b17111ab8c8a.Text: {n}Yrliet looks straight ahead, where there is no edge of the road, no limit. Then she turns her gaze to you — it is warm and full of gratitude and excitement. She holds out her hand to you and says, barely audibly,{/n} "It is time for us to go, {name}."

6e8c086a-3bf4-4392-a3bd-869830700dc3.Text: "Now you have seen what is inside my soul. And you know my true thoughts and desires. What will be your response to them, {name}? Will you let me walk this lifelong road with you?"

690bb767-1f2b-483c-abd3-87aa5c2b562c.Text: {n}Yrliet gives you a smile.{/n} "Your answer warms my heart like the rays of a rising star, {name}. From now on, if you ever wish to practise meditating again — call upon me at any time."

b7d1b4fe-4418-445e-8597-bab42e9cda17.Text: "But soon, after getting to know you better, I changed my mind. Not about mon-k— not about your kind. But about you, {name}. Everything that happened to Crudarach, to my kin, and what transpired in Commorragh... I was able to endure it all only because Asuryan brought our Paths together."

a8e84de0-735d-48a7-bb48-e7ffec18b9be.Text: "It goes where your soul leads, {name}. This is my Path, but it runs side by side with yours — and that means that you will choose where to steer your own aspirations and dreams."

87a1ae30-e2e6-4900-b95e-86baec513da8.Text: {n}The bridge is thrumming with the sound of endless officer reports, the hum of ancient mechanisms, and the buzz of servo-engines. Among the usual servants bustling to and fro, the Lord Captain notices a flash of flame-red hair.{/n}

6681c6ae-c7b5-4897-bce7-0941c9385620.Text: "Lord Captain, the xenos Yrliet has been enquiring about you. She is seeking an audience and, most likely, will shortly arrive at your study."

17a391fa-149e-4ca0-8af2-3731f256cd96.Text: {n}The Lord Captain retreats to {mf|his|her} study to reflect on recent events. But {mf|his|her} train of thought is interrupted by the muffled creak of the door and the sound of soft footsteps.{/n}

62cb9e5a-281d-40bd-8bff-99283acd4757.Text: "My apologies, Lord Captain. The enforcers report that your pet Aeldari is in a foul mood and is moving toward the captain's bridge. We didn't dare to stop her, but I expect that you have a difficult conversation ahead of you."

a1381069-6ac6-495d-aca7-52c8ec477282.Text: "Wait... Heinrix took the shuttle? Where is he now?"

c210e27c-cc91-47e0-b052-f68cf677c848.Text: "I'll personally shoot that scum when I catch up with him!"

6f0b709d-9e22-4433-9b7e-db548db0f10d.Text: "One shuttle is a small price to pay to get rid of that spy."

f678ddad-8670-442c-9a39-640a39b2fe1e.Text: {n}Ravor's voice trembles — the Master Helmsman can barely restrain his rage.{/n} "Lord Captain! Warp take that son of a— we have been robbed! The voidship has lost one shuttle, and know who we have to thank for it? As the Vox Master reported, the lander has been... 'requisitioned' by the servant of the Inquisition to conduct an investigation in the interests of the Golden Throne!"

12fb273b-5d20-429a-a982-3e7e036bb2a8.Text: {n}Vigdis, who has taken over the vox-channel from Ravor, coughs lightly at the sound of your words — or was it a laugh?{/n} "I'm glad the current situation hasn't affected your composure."

58844e8f-0aff-4a7a-986a-23991f2d2210.Text: {n}There is an audible click as Vigdis takes over the vox-channel from Ravor.{/n} "The message about the incident came in too late, and we did not dare open fire on the shuttle without your direct instructions. Perhaps if you had left orders to that effect..." {n}Vigdis sounds uncertain.{/n}

7356dd24-5128-4127-94a7-aa12211c9f42.Text: {n}There is an audible click as Vigdis takes over the vox-channel from Ravor.{/n} "The shuttle undocked and headed toward the manufactorum of Kiava Gamma. I do not know if the flyer made it to the surface of the planet — the augurs lost track of it. We also failed to establish a vox-connection with van Calox. I believe the Interrogator has decided that what is happening on the planet is more important than providing escort to the Rogue Trader."

f05f0e0c-9fea-49e9-a5c7-83f135f31a62.Text: "We could linger in orbit and make some effort to find the Interrogator or shuttle, but, given the circumstances on the planet and the ability of the Interrogator to go undetected when he wants to... I'm not sure you can count on quick success. I am afraid Heinrix van Calox has left your retinue for good.'

3c8b07e4-6da8-408e-901c-e6c7e6671139.Text: "Lord Captain. I intend to pay you a visit in your office. Do spare a few minutes of your time."

629948e1-220c-436b-9742-318183f2bc8e.Text: "Let us see who would display such impudence to a Rogue Trader."

e7210eb0-b17d-4806-938c-2bafab67fed0.Text: "Void dogs snapping at the Rogue Trader? Accept the vox-transmission. This should be interesting."

d5d8fdd9-5eab-4c87-a5f2-8df10a478b00.Text: "Load the artillery and allow the ships to draw closer. Then connect me."

d9c56bb0-69d6-4d86-a15f-5126df327cdf.Text: "Order the voidborn to bring the package aboard."

5396988e-021d-4d82-a1ba-b4190c52e1b1.Text: "I sense a trap. I am not prepared to risk any lives."

6ded37df-c4ad-4256-93b0-4f0ecc8e4a57.Text: "I wish to contact the pursuers' flagship."

683eae7d-0740-4f1c-81c9-ae0df11f3cee.Text: "A few warning shots should help this meeting along. Fire!"

7794b875-87f5-4dd6-b344-3648064b1f76.Text: "Now let's hear what they want from us."

ab29f61f-557f-40bd-8da9-cc46cb1feae7.Text: "Ignore them. And if they approach again, fire first."

193bf128-fc7b-4be6-ac0c-c68c4464f3cd.Text: "We do not parley with aggressors. Load the artillery — we attack first!"

1fb2e9bf-3fd3-4cef-8db4-8cd0de28cd93.Text: "That's a rather pathetic moniker. Couldn't come up with anything better?"

29292ca4-16d2-4511-bdca-cdb6abf1e5c3.Text: "Get to the point, filth. You are only alive because you briefly alleviated my boredom."

4df8a42d-ef29-4403-9f52-d715a6e40c2d.Text: "Who you are makes no difference to me. Why were you pursuing my vessel?"

bf35996a-f0ef-4e21-b6e1-c460821d0a07.Text: "So you admit you were threatening a Rogue Trader, and yet you're not the least bit afraid?"

5d14565b-cd98-435c-b25a-3f6503e3b865.Text: "That's enough of your bilge, void mutt. Speak plainly and get to the point."

2b688535-5fa0-46dd-ad22-6bf660a29beb.Text: "In the Emperor's name, state your business or get off my vox-channel!"

e24cb5f1-8bf5-4cd0-b371-d15d4b31e9fe.Text: "Threaten my retinue and you threaten me."

bd2188ab-05ed-4e3a-a2a9-129ff7c734b2.Text: "Why not? I shall give you Jae."

7327f1bb-958a-4cf6-b6c1-2692eb8b2cb7.Text: "Let's do it this way: I will give you whatever I have in my hold, and you will leave and never inflict your presence on me again."

6306d206-8bb5-4333-aae7-372df1fb0fd6.Text: "That's it? How terribly dull. Toliman, alert all stations: prepare to engage."

a27b7a9b-6e62-4375-8c81-16a451fdd323.Text: "It appears I have just found myself a new partner. Goodbye, Jae."

d05a3ed0-fafb-4405-ab4b-8e65090022ef.Text: "You may have a point. Very well, you may stay."

8ec53538-a1bf-409c-9f03-43a78b90eb39.Text: "I have made my decision. Enforcers! Take her away."

592b13db-c1d1-4cd2-b333-7d4fa8a086b6.Text: "In the name of the Emperor, you and your boss will pay for your insolence!"

29a6ff65-07be-4314-a70e-3433bff0b731.Text: "Your 'gift' — what do you mean by it?"

8a28bd61-fc29-40a3-89d2-111755982b19.Text: "Lord Captain, emergency report! The augurs have detected several voidships slowly encircling us. Our requests for this pursuit to cease have been completely ignored, but an unmanned vessel has been dispatched in our direction, broadcasting only two words: 'Gift' and 'Heydari.'"

aa7a3f09-015f-42a2-89dd-f7c8dd33d00e.Text: "Ahem. Lord Captain, the returning voidborn report that the package for Jae Heydari was the head of a young man..." {n}Vigdis types swiftly at the cogitator keys.{/n} "According to our archives, he was a member of her 'trade network' on Footfall. The deceased is... Trickster Kor, one of the Trickster Twins who engage in suspect commercial activity on the station's asteroids with Mistress Heydari."

b1a86ace-89d0-45e6-abf3-48be2e4b9922.Text: "Exalted One incinerate these void jackals! What does it mean?" {n}Jae's agitated voice comes on the vox-channel.{/n} "Shereen, this whole thing stinks worse than a dead {g|Encyclopedia:Grox}grox{/g}... and it's also eerily similar to how Kasballican agents operate. With your permission, I would like to see what kind of 'gift' those tight-lipped ashmags have sent me."

7289f294-6dbb-4866-b376-787b8371f8d2.Text: "A frigate and four raiders, Lord Captain. No identifying marks, so they're probably pirates. Although, the Augur Master reports that they are well coordinated, more so than your typical void rabble."

592f2b70-11b7-4f19-a981-806df9966d8f.Text: {n}A minute later, the vox-line crackles with static, followed by a rough, drunken voice:{/n} "Well, I'll be. It's {mf|His Lordliness|Her Ladyness} Rogue Trader von — Throne-damned — Valancius! I humbly tug m'forelock to you, {mf|m'lud|m'lady}. We mean no offence — our convoy is but a mark of respect for your holy self. You wouldn't have stopped to talk to us, would you, if we hadn't given your officers a good scare, eh?"

27fdef64-4888-4732-9111-1f90d0cc626c.Text: "Apologies, Lord Captain. Our attempted calls to the unknown pursuers' ships are being automatically relayed to the beacon on the pilotless vessel."

3d431a4f-ae16-426e-8de1-0697e58d5624.Text: "Fire!" {n}The Vox Master relays the order over the vox-system to the artillery compartment, and several minutes later reports:{/n} "The unidentified vessels have halted their approach, but they are continuing to trail us at a distance. The lead ship is again requesting permission for a vox-transmission."

9921dfad-dc6a-4b50-9c80-f34231c89f27.Text: {n}Several tense hours go by. All the while, Jae Heydari paces back and forth across the captain's bridge, but at the first shriek of the sirens announcing the shuttle's return, she rushes down to the lower decks.{/n}

8cde2f8a-a48f-40ee-9841-7f585fc0c963.Text: "The not knowing is tearing me apart, shereen, but I do respect your decision. I would think twice — and think again — in your shoes before I sent my own guys off to only the Exalted One knows where."

2eff1c2e-699d-4dcc-90c8-ede9a1e5332b.Text: "It seems the unidentified parties are not the patient kind, Lord Captain. The vox-signal has stopped. Prepare for battle."

7b6e8876-3709-4c3a-892a-fd1c4aae6f2c.Text: "Oh, where are my manners? I forgot to introduce myself — Toto the Vulture, at your most noble service."

cde74042-1a8d-4b21-91a3-b27fba589864.Text: {n}He grunts in outrage.{/n} "Now see here, Your {mf|Lordliness|Ladyness}! That's the name my mother gave me, and I'll carry it my whole life long! And they call me the Vulture because— ack, to the void with that! I'm here with a special mission for you!"

a058b783-6ea6-469a-8614-ec3894010c83.Text: "Yes, yes, the Emperor protects, Your {mf|Lordliness|Ladyness}. I won't keep you long. The thing is, I got a special mission for you!"

70ab052a-9748-4e52-9d3b-51f1f6d71d66.Text: "Escorting, Your von Valanciusness, we were escorting you! I'm an envoy, you see! I come to you with a special mission!"

98576cdd-78ef-4ce8-809e-3b4d536853d9.Text: "Right enough, I am a scoundrel, Your {mf|Lordliness|Ladyness}. But I'm also an envoy! I've come to you with a special mission, so I wouldn't kill me if I was you."

cb775c7c-7b97-42f3-a1a2-2558c7bf9644.Text: "Throne take me, could a lowly commoner like me pose any threat to Your Rogue Traderness? Not in a million years. I'm a cowardly lad, I swear on my mother's life. It's just my boss is a pretty important man in the Expanse, and I'm his... his envoy, if you like! And they say that honest folk don't go around killing envoys."

3159d7ab-613e-40f5-863c-14ce458a7fa1.Text: "Bit of a hothead, are we, Your {mf|Lordliness|Ladyness}? Calm those nerves of yours and you'll live longer." {n}The Vulture spits on the floor with relish, not bothering to mute his vox.{/n} "I'm an envoy. Of an important man in the Expanse, among other places."

db099562-7550-4df1-93ec-c98d7856bf37.Text: "A little bird told my boss that you've got rats on your ship. Well, we're the best ratcatchers this side of the Maw, Your Tradership. And we're ready to take that problem right off your hands. All you have to do is put Jae Heydari on a pod and send her straight to the coordinates we'll give you. My boss has been after her a while, and he's generous to those who help him."

068af140-f003-47e6-a177-e25a4ee17728.Text: "You're no vulture, Toto, you're the worst kind of ashmag!" {n}A voice just as rough as Toto the Vulture's bursts onto the vox-channel.{/n} "Tell me, you son of a {g|Encyclopedia:Grox}grox{/g} and a void jackal, who sent you?"

ecfa6380-a5d4-422c-a885-85c316eadedc.Text: "And the critter runs right into the trap." {n}The Vulture chuckles hoarsely.{/n} "I'm afraid I can't reveal his name."

4c516182-6693-4c1a-a32a-7e88905865b7.Text: "The best weapons? Supplies of rare artefacts? Trading sites across the Expanse? Gratitude? Take your pick."

08cd1c46-840f-4dc7-b48a-47eb292ec111.Text: "I'll send over a cargo shuttle, Your {mf|Lordliness|Ladyness}. I never saw you, you never saw us. And the rats can keep scampering all over your decks, since you like the little beasts. I don't care."

1c6fcdc6-d4ca-4e60-9fbe-5710b2d08ca3.Text: "Ehhh, I don't think so, Your von Valanciusness. My boss would rip my head off for that kind of stunt. And I like my head — it makes it easier to knock back the amasec."

80192273-f622-49df-8003-23ff7aa3e2cd.Text: {n}Jae switches to a private vox-channel.{/n} "Shereen, what are you saying? Are we not partners? Hand me over to these ashmags and you'll be shooting yourself in the foot! No one in the Expanse can offer you the lucrative deals I can. I'm begging you... Please reconsider!" {n}Jae's voice trembles traitorously, as if she is fighting to suppress true terror.{/n}

6b920678-ea7b-433b-a61c-80fcd5cc5f82.Text: "You'll regret this, {name}! Even if I go to my ancestors, the Exalted One be a witness to my curse — I will get back even from beyond the veil!"

1d34f933-afb8-46b1-ad2b-52afee5b34bc.Text: "Y-yes, shereen. I will prove my usefulness yet."

d3fc3a32-9436-4a28-8042-49c5f7101d09.Text: "So... the answer's no, then? Ah, that's probably for the best, Your {mf|Lordliness|Ladyness}. I make a bad negotiator, but a damn fine pirate." {n}Before the vox-transmission cuts off, you hear a rasping shout:{/n} "Falco says hello, Jae Heydari! And screw you!"

61d7fa2b-7307-4ce1-927e-b9dc1484a39e.Text: "It will be done, Lord Captain. A shuttle carrying a retrieval team and bomb disposal specialists is already en route."

51270d91-6985-49c2-ad59-ed387707a10a.Text: {n}Static comes over the line, the siren blares again, and the Vox Master turns to you:{/n} "We have finally been alerted to an incoming vox-transmission! My officers are standing by to connect you to the unidentified parties."

950872d1-ce1a-4384-b6ca-a4fea4516030.Text: "Kor! No!" {n}Jae's outburst blares from the comm-bead, momentarily deafening you and a third of the officers on the bridge listening on the vox-channel.{/n} "No, no, no! Why would the Exalted One doom so kind-hearted a person to such a fate? What void beast has done this to you?" {n}The vox-caster picks up a quiet sob, the whining screech of an augment on the bulkhead panels, the crunching of metal fingers... and Jae cuts the vox-connection.{/n}

b05f1dff-0fa1-4737-963a-668b3753412a.Text: "You see, a little bird told my boss that the rat I'm after is on your ship. And we're the best ratcatchers this side of the Maw, Your Tradership! So we're ready to take that problem right off your hands. All you have to do is put Jae Heydari on a pod and send her straight to the coordinates we'll give you. My boss has been after her a while, and he's generous to those who help him."

1a687076-6e3c-4eba-8bdf-fd26379356ff.Text: "Oh yes, Your von Valanciusness, now that's how a Rogue Trader does business! I see the shuttle with Heydari on it is already speeding its way toward our coordinates. Good." {n}Toto the Vulture smacks his lips in satisfaction.{/n} "My boss sends his deepest thanks, Your Holiness. And he promises to back up his thanks with expensive gifts every Terran year."

b0a17e6a-162e-4627-bb30-c2cdeb62c584.Text: {n}The Vox Master patiently awaits your instructions, flipping switches and occasionally emitting crackling static from her integrated vox-system.{/n}

0d794297-02f4-490c-998d-e260c82bc595.Text: "Oh, that..." {n}Toto the Vulture laughs, and it sounds like the giggling of an innocent little boy. A little boy with a frog in his throat.{/n} "Just a little joke to raise a smile, Your {mf|Lordliness|Ladyness}. And a warning for one slippery little rat."

bd7a9355-e7ab-496b-b0c1-e945b3939e2b.Text: "And why is it that Astropathic messages on my vessel bypass me?"

734a926c-a37d-45a8-9ad7-6f4e80d727c3.Text: "We will have another opportunity to discuss this."

b6964ce4-f02b-4309-a67e-bea36c426dad.Text: "Of course, I will hear you out."

182ecd14-68d7-4834-8734-b3b098e8bd6e.Text: "I do not care for your Footfall mythos."

dd89b88e-f4fa-4cd8-984b-55c0c86d7894.Text: "Addressed to you? What nonsense! Who would send you a message?"

0de27c38-9d35-47ea-af15-93c84d4f1e4a.Text: "Shereen, do you copy?" {n}Jae's velvet voice trembles with anxiety, trickling out of the comm-bead in your ear.{/n} "Vigdis has just... delivered an Astropathic message to me from Footfall. You heard that right, an Astropathic message addressed PERSONALLY to Jae Heydari, the holder of Mercatum Tabula Officiale."

12bc80d4-47d4-4109-81c6-e893ea75c8ba.Text: "So, nobody... reported it to you?" {n}A quick burst of surprise is followed by a pregnant pause.{/n} "Oh, shereen, please do not be angry with Vigdis! She merely related a personal message to the person it was intended for. And I immediately came to you."

1bd33b70-5ddb-4136-8cf4-077d906b4eea.Text: "Ah, shereen, the Exalted One did bless you with the precious gift of overabundance of time!" {n}The comm-bead delivers a disappointed chuckle.{/n} "Very well, I will be in the usual place. With the usual bottle of amasec. Patiently waiting for your lenience, shereen. I am begging you not to forget about your partner."

2bea420a-1ee7-45a9-8525-3e41521e82f7.Text: "Private conversations are my most fa-a-avourite, shereen." {n}Jae noticeably cheers up, her tone become once again purring and becoming warm.{/n}

ce0fd911-e8c3-487b-bf6f-934853f2147f.Text: "Of course not. How dare I look at the sun without squinting my eyes?" {n}The comm-bead delivers a bitter chuckle.{/n} "But should you change your mind, shereen, you know where to find me."

472b9f2b-1ca9-4029-bce5-257e17f10b6b.Text: "We need to discuss it. This is urgent." {n}Jae is unexpectedly serious, her speech is devoid of the usual honeyed words.{/n} "Uhm... I was curious if would you spare a few moments of your precious time for your loyal partner? Shereen."

50eba027-61a9-458f-b6e5-670035c04117.Text: "Oh, shereen, I would gladly give up every pearl from every ocean and the light of every star in the sky to be anyone but myself at this moment. But alas." {n}Jae is trying to perk herself up, but it's not working out too well.{/n}

52013da6-e31c-433c-b056-65f919e9460c.Text: "You're right, it's time to rescue your gang."

6579eafe-5cbf-45e2-ab54-4facc4c5473b.Text: "Forget about them, Jae. We have more pressing business to attend to."

e406f39c-bb9c-4f88-9a90-62b423c355f4.Text: "Sher— Rogue Trader. We've been through a lot of shit together, so forgive the impertinence of what I'm about to say." {n}Jae's voice is calm and quiet, like the sea before an impending storm.{/n} "I've been as loyal to you as I am to my own self. And I've been grateful for every favour you've bestowed upon me."

52615d79-b6d7-4a1d-8bfb-4a3cc3758ddf.Text: "Words worth more than any jewels and gifts, shereen! Let's go."

ff03f5e6-7f40-491b-adad-8f69627ac1fb.Text: "Then good luck with your business, shereen." {n}Jae's tone tastes acrid in the air.{/n} "But I'm off to handle mine. If the Exalted One wills it, maybe we'll meet again."

62119506-d0f7-4e05-9218-bdb3ca12a39e.Text: "Even so... They may be a bunch of ashmags and kaskhas, but they're my ashmags and kaskhas. They are loyal to me like void dogs, and they've dragged me back from the brink of death more than once. If I don't help them today — now — I will never forgive myself. Will you come with me, shereen? Will you help save them?"

a388fc95-090a-45b0-ad1f-df548ed094aa.Text: "Lord Captain, permission to report. Jae Heydari... is gone. It is difficult to say when and how she left the ship, but only a few items are missing — her personal weapons, her certificate, and a small box containing securities. I believe she has returned to Footfall. According to vox-officer reports, she was always telling the crew that she would do the 'last decent thing in her life' there."

b132cd36-2ce8-49f4-8862-fa37358d2975.Text: {n}Some time after the signal, you receive a message from Jae over a secure vox-channel. Her voice cracks uncharacteristically on every word she says.{/n}

19442b9a-cd56-41d0-b45f-91643c388c36.Text: "Shereen, I would never have bothered you again if not for that Astropathic message from Footfall. In the name of all the stars from the Segmentum Solar to the accursed fringes of the Expanse, I ask you to hear me out! I will be waiting for you at the usual spot."

83855f55-7c08-434c-bbc4-22960f4a7ae6.Text: "If you do not grace me with your favour soon, shereen, well... I will just have to solve my problems the old-fashioned way. On my own."

2856a470-a5a5-445f-886b-f91fdc8bbbbb.Text: "Shereen, the plan was to go to Footfall and help my gang, but time is slipping through our fingers like sand! It may not mean much to you, but people die. And if I don't even try to rescue them from the jaws of those void jackals... the name Jae Heydari may as well be smeared with groxshit!"

9e16b8ce-4ca6-4d1e-befa-73d5c161f170.Text: "I apologise for distracting Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} from matters of the protectorate, but there is information of crucial importance that I am compelled to report to you as expediently as possible."

3fb3a187-c1fb-4349-bfd0-87787f123438.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I humbly ask that you grace me with an audience. I simply must inform you of a series of outrageous breaches of discipline that threaten to dissipate the dynasty's coffers!"

74da4178-3fa9-465c-8459-533862366083.Text: "I am going to the officers' deck immediately."

2aa3b7c5-d329-493a-b973-c963fb355783.Text: "Can no one here do anything right without me?"

cb2a9330-3f92-456b-a0eb-c29f41f0b224.Text: "Vent the officers' deck compartment into space."

4ed1ef37-28c3-4ca2-8cc6-7fcb3b2693b0.Text: "Who cares! Rid me of the xenos however you can!"

a0390e40-f7f1-464a-bba2-9d8a96c0f7ec.Text: "I got it, Vigdis. I will have to personally go to the officers' deck."

35261c33-df5b-43c0-ae40-5837841e2b93.Text: "Lord Captain, there is an... an emergency at the officers' deck." {n}Vigdis's voice is quaking slightly.{/n} "Numerous victims, loss of communication... The voidsmen report warp-voices filling the compartments... but this is not a warp breach. This is... the xenos you took aboard at Janus. He has gone mad and went on a rampage."

e2c0c3f1-6df7-40e3-b576-ae40de03ea54.Text: "I have two fairly reliable witness accounts. According to one, the xenos suddenly assaulted the crew members, gutting them seemingly at random. The other claims that there are survivors who barricaded themselves in the adjacent compartments. The enforcers managed to isolate the raving xenos in a dead end... But they have been unable to pacify him so far. What will your orders be?"

4816c51e-3ba9-4dc3-a4b3-a1e4c1f7ad71.Text: "The ways of Asuryan keep us safe from her claws, but the Dark Ones... The Dark Ones never sought to restrain their desires for excess and pleasure in order to acquire at least some protection against our eternal enemy. When the voices of She Who Thirsts called out to me, I found refuge in meditation. I think... I think Marazhai started feeding his withering soul instead, using the only method he knew."

6d555a7b-cd2f-4c0e-a1c7-af3176272566.Text: "Such are the consequences of ill-considered actions born out of the lack of faith in the God-Emperor's laws! I am ready to stop the accursed xenos's rampage personally and repay every life he has taken!"

44a6bfc9-4b41-4acf-8a08-d8b58850cc3e.Text: "Why am I not surprised?" {n}Heinrix's voice is oozing with poison.{/n} "Rogue Trader, we cannot bring back your subjects, but I will gladly aid you in disposing of the rabid creature before it mauls even more people."

ed1419cd-f6a0-4cf8-a26c-d3ecb755a540.Text: {n}The vox-channel relays a thin sigh, full of realisation... and fright?{/n} "Elantach... I know what the reason behind Marazhai's madness is. Please, I must accompany you to the compartment. I will help you deal with the Dark One."

dd5a925d-3ed3-453a-aec8-a425f4dfa0ee.Text: "The squad of enforcers who had blocked the xenos in the dead-end corridor is waiting at the deck. I beg you to be careful, Lord Captain... And may the God-Emperor watch over you."

45509de9-5ed7-4660-89b5-0e22f34e7bc0.Text: "Lord Captain, I repeat: there are dozens of officers in the adjacent rooms that are not hermetically sealed. If we open the airlocks... They are going to die along with the xenos."

6e3364f4-c775-4144-8a82-4b290c1f5f96.Text: {n}Vigdis sighs.{/n} "Lord Captain... a pair of voidsmen managed to relay to us before dying that their comrades are disappearing into a bloody fog only to emerge in pieces... Your enforcers are trained to suppress human riots, not to restrain deadly xenos."

7146fa84-92e2-46b5-a66e-f4f19d56052c.Text: "Do you remember what happened during my very first voyage aboard your ship? When I found myself beyond the veil, the servants of She Who Thirsts descended upon the fragile shell that is protecting your vessel from the outside horrors and managed to break through. The soul of an Aeldari shines like a beacon in the night, drawing the gaze of Sai'lanthresh and stoking her thirst."

6ebc6167-3b6d-4808-acf2-f250e8d69a44.Text: "I am not interested in the problems of the Lady Navigator. If that is all, we are done here."

72ab7d9b-c337-4fef-8e3b-825862ce30e3.Text: "Cassia is an honoured guest on this voidship, and the voidsmen must come to terms with all her oddities and caprices. And for those who cannot — lashes to every one of them!"

21b59e1e-3063-45d9-9b5a-038da1cc46db.Text: "Measures to pacify the crew have been taken, and I have no intention of troubling the Lady Navigator with this matter. That will be all."

b59168ad-f6fa-4062-90de-1d7feeb429e9.Text: "Lord Captain, I hasten to report the disturbing news brought to me by the machine spirits of the ship. The matter is extremely delicate and concerns Lady Cassia. You see, since her first day aboard, her presence has been a disturbance to the crew's way of life. If you'll allow, I have prepared a detailed report."

a69b60ba-8eb0-43ed-b66d-a2c4c0e85a57.Text: "If I may, Lord Captain — the Lady Navigator's state of mind worries me. She is self-contained and does not mesh with the crew at all, which is why everyone avoids her — even senior officers can be superstitious. I fear that only you are in a position to talk to her on an equal footing and improve the situation. For the sake of the crew's safety — and that of Lady Cassia herself."

320e9da6-6670-4bbf-bf8c-e4508a77a4e6.Text: "Of course, Lord Captain. I will tell the officers not to respond to such reports again."

5cc2e49b-33dc-4225-a93e-690f48e04b16.Text: "As the Lord Captain sees fit." {n}Vigdis is silent for a while, but the crackle of the vox reveals she is still connected:{/n} "Concerning the report..."

9387df5c-1654-4fd4-9387-82ce68f40ece.Text: "Things are even worse with Jae Heydari — I intercepted a vox-cast in which she promised she would, and I quote, 'end that kaskha' if she ever saw her again."

d2633239-240a-4ba4-9372-10c667c572de.Text: "Of course, Lord Captain. I deeply apologise for the inconvenience."

3ef1defc-ed6c-4584-974d-334fd9ce2ab3.Text: "After that, officers living near the Lady Navigator's quarters began to express extreme emotions — hysteria, apathy, euphoria, rage. This is quite detrimental to crew morale and performance. The last incident was recorded on Footfall. Around a hundred living birds were delivered on board during our stay on Footfall. Each bird cost a hefty sum, but I have failed to discover their purpose and subsequent fate."

2c6afaeb-6467-4519-89f1-8c50989e57af.Text: "The first incident occurred immediately after our departure from Eurac V: the Lady Navigator chastised one of the ship's runners, after which he went to his living quarters, killed his family, and then shot himself. The second incident was noted while traversing the warp: the Lady Navigator gave the pilots the wrong instructions and the voidship was thrown off course — for a matter of minutes, but this was enough for the forces of the Immaterium to anger the machine spirits enough for them to start a fire in the service bay."

69758c62-06d4-4311-b692-c7afbeaf362e.Text: "I was also told about a conflict between the Lady Navigator and the Seneschal. Alas, with no details. If you like, you can ask Master Werserian directly."

b00cee3f-5ae9-4387-89b9-93dd91358f5b.Text: "How did House Orsellio even learn that I have Cassia?"

47f97236-76c9-41e4-9226-1470cd7dca96.Text: "Order the Astropaths to send the following: Cassia Orsellio perished at the hands of the rebel Navigators of her own House."

dc5e66fe-9a18-4ea2-9518-c79535e803c1.Text: "Tell House Orsellio that Cassia is safe and that the Rogue Trader would be honoured to meet in person."

4bc1736e-8d6f-47dc-99ed-4f3c25cc4f4a.Text: "Tell Regent Aaronto that the Rogue Trader does not know anyone named Cassia."

d3a99b4a-3a62-4c4f-941d-99d01422c457.Text: "Ignore it. I have no obligation to answer anyone's requests."

4ed3078f-ccd1-4c47-b55d-4543c5de2669.Text: "Lord Captain, urgent report — we have received an Astropathic message from Regent Aaronto Orsellio. The Navigators are concerned about the fate of Cassia, who disappeared from Eurac V. The regent is requesting an update on her current status and he has also enquired about the possibility of a personal meeting to negotiate and to arrange the return of the Lady Navigator to her House."

f62782d3-d57a-4a16-b7b9-e7e118871304.Text: "I'll see to it, Lord Captain. The Astropaths will transmit your consent — representatives of House Orsellio will be waiting for you on the capital world Dargonus. Receiving members of the Navis Nobilite is always a delicate matter. Please make sure to discuss the details of this meeting with your chancellor upon arrival."

f711409b-a3e8-4712-ba90-26ab946b2195.Text: "The psycho-emotional coding of the received message betrays acute concern, but it also contains something that the Astropaths have failed to put into words. If you'll excuse my forthrightness, I feel it is necessary to tell House Orsellio the truth. Otherwise, a conflict with the Navis Nobilite is possible, which, given the current state of the Koronus Expanse, will only play into the hands of the enemies of the Imperium."

758c371e-0cad-4770-8c04-621a3b8733ca.Text: "I wish I knew, Lord Captain. It is troubling indeed. Perhaps we have a spy on board... or Regent Aaronto is bluffing. In either case, I believe we should respond. Navigators are extremely powerful and useful allies to have."

039965b0-245f-4ea0-85a8-7787de09197a.Text: "Display the message on the screen, right now!"

47083693-1e59-465f-b8a5-4db3794c4ae9.Text: "This will not end well, destroy the data-slate!"

cebecca5-077f-4298-8879-db91801d73a9.Text: "I am no longer interested in the affairs of House Orsellio. Tell the Tech-Priests not to waste their time."

6ae421a8-85fe-4840-9b5f-097d21075ce3.Text: "Lord Captain, an urgent report from the servants of the Omnissiah! They managed to locate a second message on the House Orsellio data-slate, hidden in the shadow of the first one. As soon as it happened, the machine spirit rebelled and started devouring the decrypted data. The acolytes of the Cult Mechanicus are performing the rites to appease it and slow down the process of annihilation. What should we do?"

7451be0d-7092-40e6-8163-8cd2d2cc6ddf.Text: "Rogue Trader, you hardly know me, but I am well-informed of your {d|Encyclopedia:CassiaQ1_ElinaExecuted}deeds{/d}." {n}A well-built young man adjusts his silk headband embellished with the symbol of the Navis Nobilite.{/n} "My name is irrelevant, for as long as the cursed Child continues to live and breathe, no one in House Orsellio is safe."

d932f143-db5f-4ff0-93cb-d5074a5e1689.Text: "Rogue Trader?" {n}Lady Navigator Elina, the one who staged an attempt to assassinate Cassia right in your palace, politely smiles at you from the vid-screen.{/n} "I had no doubt that your servants would find my trace. They are far cleverer than the ones employed by the Great Regent of House Orsellio." {n}She does not bother to hide the venomous disdain in her last few words.{/n}

c7e4fe84-7f07-4db2-b70a-fb6944ef3cec.Text: "I know what Master Felek and Lady Elina-Hatteria had to do at Eurac V and in your palace. I understand your anger. House Orsellio deeply apologises for these incidents." {n}The Navigator tiredly closes his eyes.{/n} "I presume you already know that House Orsellio will be holding a Grand Council in the depths of that accursed Atlas very soon. And we cannot ignore the call, for we are bound to it against our will."

e1b6e65d-a022-452c-bcd2-626e7e778260.Text: "I feel extremely awkward that our first encounter took place under such... unfortunate circumstances? Truth be told, I saw a worthy person behind the lofty title only after fate put me on the death's precipice. You {d|Encyclopedia:CassiaQ1_ElinaAlive}hesitated to end my life{/d} despite holding it in your hands. Your noble deed... gave me enough food for thought. Despite everything that transpired, I still believe we may become loyal allies to one another."

1c6b6271-4385-46a4-82c3-ce9f831bc33b.Text: {n}The comm-bead echoes with the furious clicking of Vigdis's augmented fingers. A few moments later the vid-screen of your cogitator shows the recording through a wall of static.{/n}

144d7abc-931b-4a22-bfaa-f0d91dce8932.Text: "I am also aware that you enjoy a great influence over the cursed Child. Convince her to reject the Atlas. Break the centuries-old shackles binding our House. Crush Tisiphone's tyranny under her foot... Or simply kill her, I do not care. I am not going to lie, we are unlikely to become good friends, but House Orsellio values true allies like no other. The true House Orsellio, that is, and not these lunatic zealots of the regent."

aa912a75-a2a3-4868-8862-59ad9f0c4a58.Text: "Of course, Lord Captain. I will relay your order immediately."

7f6cd2a3-d2d1-465e-bae1-d9240d146042.Text: "I presume you already know that House Orsellio will be holding a Grand Council in the depths of that accursed Atlas very soon. And we cannot ignore the call, for we are bound to it against our will. But if you convinced this bi... Lady Cassia to reject the Atlas and break the centuries-old shackles binding our House... We could turn over a new page. Having said that, I will accept a different outcome. Should the Child die, I am not going to shed any tears."

703e2036-a51f-4f59-a741-d8051beec72b.Text: "I will accept any choice, Rogue Trader. My people have nothing else to lose. But you could benefit from our friendship." {n}There are mysterious shadows dancing in Lady Elina's eyes.{/n} "There lies an emerald in the rays of Martianus, my gift to you for sparing my life. Head through the stor-r-ms and tor-r-rents. Le... t, ri... t, and ...wice fo... d, then..."

59d11d88-dbe2-4505-b6a4-c98baa3286ab.Text: {n}The vid-recording cuts short and you hear the Vox Master's voice in your comm-bead.{/n} "I am very sorry, Lord Captain. The servants of the Omnissiah could no longer restrain the machine spirit's hunger. I hope you were able to see the vid-message through to the end."

854a2448-aaf1-41cb-b68c-65c0bd18b02e.Text: "To assure you of my sincerity, I shall be the first to extend my hand in a gesture of goodwill. A gratuitous gift to the von Valancius dynasty. You will find it in the rays of Martianus, an emer-rald clutched in the stor-rm's embr-race. Head le... t, ri... t, and ...wice fo... d, then..."

c58ed7ed-0524-4221-a859-1cf2edc75974.Text: "Decode the encryption hidden in the data-slate."

da9f69b8-85cb-41d1-b1f7-f9c65dd4090d.Text: "I have grown tired of House Orsellio. Throw the data-slate in the plasma reactor."

95b0657e-1793-4eaf-b85c-a5efc51709fe.Text: "A hidden encryption? This is suspicious. Get rid of it immediately."

60c6bc3d-1f43-4af4-a73d-19c30bfb866a.Text: "Lord Captain, reporting. Shortly before our departure from Footfall a group of messengers in luxurious garbs delivered a strongbox and several chests bearing the insignia of House Orsellio to the ship. I suppose the use of gold-clad servants instead of servitors... was an extravagant attempt by the Navigators to draw the attention of the Rogue Trader."

408f308b-fabe-4bd9-af60-2ef4c7db7539.Text: "Greetings, Rogue Trader." {n}A cold female voice comes from the cogitator's vox-system, and you see a voluptuous woman whose face is completely hidden behind a veil of deep purple.{/n} "My name is Ciretta-Melina Orsellio. After {d|Encyclopedia:CassiaQ1_RegenExecuted}Aaronto Orsellio's untimely demise{/d} during his visit to your capital world I was offered the honour of taking the seat of the Great Regent of House Orsellio. My advisors spoke against contacting you, but disregarding a Rogue Trader who is keeping our sacred Child by {mf|his|her} side is simply not possible." {n}The Navigator's voice is dripping with obvious animosity.{/n}

a909c312-71f4-4a43-b689-770940817778.Text: "Rogue Trader." {n}A familiar piercing voice comes from the cogitator's vox-system, and you see a bloated face with sagging skin and a gaping hole where the nose should be.{/n} "We, Great Regent Aaronto Orsellio, {d|Encyclopedia:CassiaQ1_RegenAlive}send greetings and hope this message finds you in good health{/d}."

072be9a8-6eff-413d-a320-5da3c3aa4b2b.Text: "It will be done, Lord Captain. Sorry to have disturbed you."

6f9c32e5-87a3-4f96-9d6d-8b2238858879.Text: "Considering the incident on the capital world, the enforcer officers checked the Navis Nobilite gifts thrice. I am pleased to report that none of them threaten your, Lady Cassia's, or the crew's well-being. Having said that, a closer examination of the strongbox by the Tech-Adepts revealed a data-slate with a vid-message addressed personally to you alongside some kind of encrypted data. We dared not touch them without your instructions."

d58f3ce7-3fc3-4210-90e0-44a7f5f46cfe.Text: "As you command, Lord Captain." {n}Vigdis issues several orders, and the vid-screen of your personal cogitator springs to life, the machine innards rumbling unhappily.{/n}

1101f122-1120-433b-bf80-dc8b4a98f1da.Text: "Yes, Lord Captain." {n}Vigdis falls silent, and the vox-transmission fills with scratchings of a cogita-quill and rustling of papers.{/n} "A messenger servo-skull has been sent to the Omnissiah's servants' compartment. Once the data has been decrypted, I will notify you immediately."

18da0819-e0aa-41ed-82fc-e84b0dd90a8c.Text: "Of course." {n}Vigdis falls silent, and the vox-transmissions fills with the binharic trill of a Tech-Priest and the measured clicking of mechadendrites.{/n} "It is done, Lord Captain."

9ed90114-7ff9-45a6-a0ed-9eff462e10f6.Text: {n}The vid-screen shuts down and the Vox Master breaks the silence,{/n} "I am told the message has been relayed to your cogitator, Lord Captain. I hope the data did not get corrupted during playback or delivery."

0c075c71-0c66-4078-aeec-ed087bfadff9.Text: "House Orsellio will soon hold a Grand Council within the palace of Atlas, the holy relic that connects all Navigators of our House. This meeting will take place not in the physical world but in the world of thoughts, dreams, and visions. It is the only way to avoid bloodshed and decide the fate of the sacred Child at last."

267e4f41-7ad7-4d57-b4f3-9332c8eab6a8.Text: "Thanks to the Atlas we feel that the soul of the Child is full of dismay. And yet the Rogue Trader's words bear a lot of weight with the Child, so {mf|he|she} may soothe its anxiety and lead the Child down the right path. The path of accepting its duty before the House and ascending the Novator's throne. I hope you consider my offer, {name} von Valancius, for it is in your power to not only strengthen the bond between our dynasties, but multiply your riches at the same time. The gifts accompanying this message are but an insignificant part of the Great Regent's gratitude. May the God-Emperor protect us all."

b44b0563-1a13-412a-a8ef-6a49be802678.Text: "Pasqal, why are you being summoned to that ship?"

9f05cf8f-1370-45e6-a6fc-e719634431d1.Text: "Chart the course to the transmitted coordinates!"

d9e18b19-5af5-43a1-a478-a06145166958.Text: "I am sorry, Pasqal. The Expanse is ablaze, there is no time to look for missing mentors."

925fc758-996e-40ad-a9ec-5f3d2ed99790.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, the Choirmaster is reporting that the Astropaths have received a signal. It states the following: 'Ark Mechanicus Hermetico is calling the unit Pasqal Haneumann. Directive: visit. Priority: ahead of the queue. Purpose: Discontinuing the Cycle.' It is followed by a set of coordinates."

c4d743ce-0a9d-4bb4-bc54-393c1ea94478.Text: "According to my data, the lost sacred vessel Hermetico is the flagship, headquarters, and last confirmed location of Archmagos Amarnat. I hereby request permission to immediately embark on an expedition."

1cb90f0c-85b1-4e09-8007-63ed2cf2d411.Text: "The answer has been recorded. The unit's access level prevents it from vetoing this decision. I am registering the protest in the ship's archive."

f4920ee3-d62f-475e-9409-d8af11985f41.Text: "No data are available. No hypotheses... are available. The justification is irrelevant. If the blessed Amarnat summons me, I must comply with the directive."

05bf4cdd-ef24-4087-bcfd-81fabbbe0573.Text: "The Cognisance Fleet is of no interest to us. Let those who wish to follow the new Messiah join our cause. The unbelievers will be consigned to oblivion."

c4536e22-9fd7-4371-9b09-57c3e9f5d916.Text: "Tell them the statement is true. The heresy has been exterminated and there is no more reason for bloodshed."

90ec74f1-9a77-4caa-8c51-2f13bb889fbb.Text: "Tell them the statement is true. Pasqal, the True Messiah, has arrived to correct the mistakes of his predecessor, mend the schism and lead the Cognisance Fleet into the future."

6e0c658c-a99a-4d02-abaf-c9a8a30355d9.Text: "Tell them the statement is true. Amarnat has returned to reign and unite his flock."

6a9e58d1-8f7c-4c90-a7a2-938c9964aed1.Text: "Blessed Amarnat calls upon those who remained loyal to him to put an end to the unbelievers and thus mend the schism."

9eb99f53-01bd-4a94-bb94-4d84d7f06094.Text: "It is time to end the schism. Let them hunt down every last renegade who follows the teachings of Amarnat and cleanse the fleet!"

85411546-e591-4c75-bc47-a7264c899ae9.Text: "The ship is identified as a von Valancius dynasty vessel. You are being hailed by a representative of the Explorator Cognisance Fleet."

27246338-eeaa-4376-b0d8-558f7429c612.Text: "Query. Is the statement that a new Messiah has been created true? Is the statement that the Amarnat unit no longer exists but the Cycle will be discontinued true?"

b36395c4-a16d-4e4e-b62c-01e14663c291.Text: "Query. Is the statement that the Messiah considered fallen has come back true? Is the statement that the Cycle will be discontinued true?"

a2180f56-ea53-4716-b42f-bbe451855d35.Text: "Query. Is the statement that the Messiah is dead true? Is the statement that the schism has been ended true?"

fd74b48c-4a7d-41f2-8f35-1b99c4bc1bcb.Text: "The Cognisance Fleet praises the new Messiah. May the mistakes of the schism not be repeated, may the nonconformity be purged. The Omnissiah knows all, comprehends all."

c690f413-795d-4a62-9385-bd5570337f94.Text: "The Cognisance Fleet praises the new Messiah. The mistakes will be corrected, the unbelief will be replaced with faith. Let the Cycle be discontinued!"

aa3fb96d-aa50-49ae-b2b8-c546bd5c3c64.Text: "The Cognisance Fleet praises the end of the schism. The nonconformity will be overcome, the purity of the Ritual shall be restored. The Omnissiah knows all, comprehends all."

d051d460-9a25-455d-a280-151186b24c72.Text: "The Cognisance Fleet praises the end of the schism. The heresy is purged, the purity of the Ritual is restored. The Omnissiah knows all, comprehends all."

b8ce7cb8-d203-4061-abeb-4d5bf2cfd566.Text: "We are picking up an active vox-exchange on encrypted frequencies between the Explorator ships... Incoming message."

d4b65e44-bee8-47a5-98df-6db785489188.Text: "The units who are no longer a part of the Explorator Cognisance Fleet welcome the new Messiah and are standing by for new mission protocols."

c96f8e8d-9be3-4565-91f5-5041b8ca5d53.Text: "We are picking up an active vox-exchange on encrypted frequencies between the Explorator ships... They are opening fire! They are shooting one another! But a good part of the ships from the same squadron seem to have joined their opponents! This... This is a slaughter. They have no chance."

d7cbea3e-0ff9-491c-9a5b-1d75df76da6c.Text: "The Cognisance Fleet praises the returned Messiah. The hierarchy of command has been restored. Let the Cycle be discontinued!"

b1e70b17-dcf6-494b-a8da-937e616feb77.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, we are observing a large squadron of Adeptus Mechanicus forces. Many of the ships are badly damaged. Judging by the position of the servants of the Omnissiah, they are divided into two groups. I daresay they were fighting not long ago... I am picking up a signal from one of the ships."

e9e7e1e6-d6f4-41d2-af52-025505b23c2b.Text: "They wish to know if their fratricidal battle should continue. What do you think I should answer, {name}?"

95f7fd5b-d83b-40d4-ade4-9d958172aa40.Text: "They wish to know whether their fratricidal struggle shall continue. Tell me, {name}, what answer should I give them?"

274967a1-6db8-40be-b770-750133116926.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, the Cognisance Fleet asks whether their schism still stands. How am I to reply?"

7a574a6e-0004-44ce-b6c2-0297adab6aed.Text: "Is there anything unusual about these ships?"

4785123c-6ccb-4e84-9cf9-4ea96a105e44.Text: "Pasqal, it looks like a gathering of believers in Discontinuing the Cycle."

ad043f1b-e732-43c7-b2e6-72b5f158d74c.Text: "We are the Cognisance Fleet. We praise the Messiah of Discontinuing. We remain in prayer. We remain on standby. Let the Cycle be discontinued. The Omnissiah knows all, comprehends all. We are the Cognisance Fleet. We praise the Messiah of Discontinuing..."

fae7ebc5-466e-4d59-8027-223dd5b8f159.Text: "It will be done, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}... Request denied. We are receiving only the message voiced earlier."

39e8be0b-3df8-42e5-8f17-35a129729732.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, hailing the ships surrounding the Hermetico's wreck led to receiving the following transmission."

5c508acc-4742-4d5b-9e4a-21a672e4f91b.Text: "Yes, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. We are picking up traces of recent combat on many of the vessels. Numerous traces."

95ce679e-fd5c-48fc-9d47-49f4f5891d30.Text: "Based on the initial radiation background assessment, it appears that... an Adeptus Mechanicus weapon has been used against them."

4f74fa64-2fe5-4b7a-8ade-457bb06eb33b.Text: "We cannot say for sure whom they ran into. But with the current situation in the Expanse, it is not surprising."

70f1e4da-2781-4ed4-a0d9-b8adbad3e462.Text: "Confirmed. The number of adherents of Discontinuing the Cycle does not correspond with the earlier prognosis. The willingness to declare one's commitment to the teachings of blessed Amarnat is anomalous. This unit is intrigued."

8e56259e-8bf0-4f66-bd3c-d3df6408a65e.Text: "We have received a standard denial of request message, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. What outrageous impudence!"

829045dc-c50a-4158-a46e-d39ddfc18380.Text: "I hypothesise that the schism within the Cognisance Fleet has reached a climax. My tech-comrades raised arms against one another. It is with sorrow that I register this information in the archive."

39af2905-019a-4a14-8d53-f556e7954587.Text: "Dispatch a trophy crew to the ship. We could use that pile of metal."

de91742e-213b-450a-b67f-a6598dd35cca.Text: "Let us give Pasqal a dignified burial. Main gun deck, open fire on the Hermetico."

8ff99d19-38dc-4098-8be6-13cd9537f128.Text: "Leave her be. May she remain as the memorial to Pasqal."

bf37d783-42ca-4dbb-92da-5fc5127c42e6.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, the senior officers mourn the tragic loss of the Enginseer Prime during the expedition. What will be the subsequent orders regarding the Hermetico?"

1de7c8f0-64eb-4825-9d26-7bbb236fc2e4.Text: "It will be done. The native clans of the lower decks will be trained in the craft of basic dismantling and transported to the Hermetico.

ae78165b-d57d-4d08-8ef7-6ee58b6f8e5b.Text: "Main deck to Lord Captain, the order will be carried out."

fdae02b5-0513-46ae-afcb-a50b6915b837.Text: "Main gun deck. I order you to open fire on the Hermetico."

e0bc2c2c-2224-43e1-8937-f3855ef05371.Text: "The schism of Discontinuing the Cycle is henceforth suppressed. Requesting a fiery burial of the remains of the sacred ship Hermetico... And what little remains of Archmagos Amarnat."

51ebd1a1-e3f5-49f4-80c2-7c671d2c6fb9.Text: "Request denied. Eschatos is the doctrine of discontinuing. Activating said doctrine, target — the Hermetico."

041e423f-702e-46be-b649-a7ba2e106518.Text: "What do we know about the ship?"

065285dc-5a4e-4984-946b-a13ffb9bba1b.Text: "Permission granted. May the Messiah of Discontinuing reveal the way to a safe docking gate."

b4db7880-17b6-4c21-935e-d99933789f34.Text: "Requesting the right to participate in the first boarding party. Evaluating shuttle docking options."

da1a41c3-0519-4126-aa8c-0f4f070df201.Text: {n}The raspy voice of the person who recorded the message is vaguely familiar to you, but you cannot put your finger on it.{/n}

a41efabc-951c-498d-8b13-9eae450c33da.Text: "Response accepted. I am filing a protest and a request to reconsider. The mission is of the highest priority."

10b70075-a71e-49e8-862c-62c63ebcb7cd.Text: "I hypothesise that the proper vacuum lock may be opened using my personal access code. Justification: a message from the Ark Mechanicus."

373c97ee-d2c0-4e7b-a11e-23e3803dbc32.Text: "In any case, she is a ruin of her former glory. We observe numerous traces of internal decompression, but not a single sign of aggression carried out from the outside. For what it's worth, some of the decks look intact... At least, from the outside."

660deab6-19f7-430f-af8f-ab5f4ebe0e53.Text: "We are also picking up strange radiation emanating from the hull. We believe the ship has been in the Processional of the Damned for a long time."

8a427620-9410-4a9d-9fc3-c48bcaf858d8.Text: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, according to the ship's registry, we're looking at the Ark Mechanicus Hermetico. We picked up a vox-signal coming from her."

92908062-c17b-4932-a341-7feef6c076e1.Text: "Each Ark is a sanctuary for the Adeptus Mechanicus. Every such ship is a relic. They are incredibly ancient and were made to search for the sacred Standard Template Construct patterns. Legends tell of entire forge worlds that were literally disassembled for parts to make such vessels."

32b54882-5f4e-4b19-a523-883b06cf01d0.Text: "Not at the moment, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. The damage to the hull makes observations difficult, and the surviving vacuum locks are sealed shut."

8c2a936e-29ba-461c-a394-ca4c795aef90.Text: "He stole a shuttle? How did this happen?"

d08a4182-3aad-4717-b8dd-e9c07bfb2675.Text: "Why have I not been notified of his actions right away?"

e89d792a-b2f6-466b-b327-5fcaf2cecea4.Text: "Will all members of my entourage be stealing shuttles now?"

684e9a55-f094-4f5c-9daf-689c57d024c0.Text: "Execute the sentries who were guarding the shuttles."

64d340e8-0488-4e5d-a4d0-2558fc3227d3.Text: "Lord Captain, there was an incident on the flight deck. The planet we discovered is located at the coordinates of interest to the honourable Ulfar, Angel of the Emperor. The moment he learned about this, he... chose to abandon ship."

f9c03b80-1129-4a07-85e4-a0cf74856cd1.Text: "He ordered a shuttle to be provided to him and directed it to the world before us. We do not know where exactly he wishes to go, but the augurs have tracked the shuttle to its landing site."

99ee7de1-bf81-49c8-bc5e-1ba46a1d2f13.Text: "Lord Ulfar simply showed up at the deck, drove the enforcers away and demanded he be granted clearance for take-off. Your servants became frightened and dared not disobey his orders."

4af74404-da2a-411f-bacd-75163a840784.Text: "He... forbade it. And the enforcers did not dare to defy an Angel of the Emperor. I am very sorry."

dd5e38d8-c9b3-48f8-81d1-6003a90d05a1.Text: "I fully share your indignation, Lord Captain. Such blatant abuse of the ship's resources is unacceptable!"

1ca70f97-83df-497c-88bc-da48118ddf6a.Text: "Your order will be carried out with the utmost diligence, Lord Captain."

125ab6e9-0bb5-4029-a6b5-3d1d129c967e.Text: "I apologise for having to bring you this troubling news, Lord Captain."

92398e4d-cebb-4e16-bea4-62446b8e6364.Text: "Send a shuttle with scouts to investigate the xenos ship."

c0e8586f-7216-446a-87b1-1f0bbeffed36.Text: "Have the acolytes of the Machine Cult identify the remains of the third vessel."

7b6465ab-1241-4007-8322-7a03fc6d867e.Text: "Dispatch a rescue team if there are any survivors at the frigate."

1058d250-6c43-4e05-99ff-ed9512b413a9.Text: "We have done everything we could. We are leaving."

a0cc0185-bc42-4184-b0b8-2783803b1ba3.Text: "Lord Cap'n, there is evidence of a recent scuffle straight ahead of us... Throne take me, this is not a frigate, this is just a gutted piece of metal!" {n}The helmsman falls silent for a moment.{/n} "Blimey, the culprits are here too, it is the Aeldari freaks! I recognise their shiny asses even from this distance. Except... the xenos are acting suspiciously, they are hovering in place and not even trying to run. Should we approach or open fire from a distance?"

cd75135d-87a8-4c99-ab6a-68252fbedb1e.Text: "Call off your people, elantach! Something is wrong. The Children of Asuryan are dismayed, but doing something like this to a mon-keigh vessel... No, we are not animals. I appeal to your prudence and the promise you made, do not destroy my kin for the deeds they did not commit."
