Can only be used once per combat.

543b30be-05a9-42e5-9991-5b9d0727439e.Text: "Behold the generosity of the new Rogue Trader! Everyone gets three rations and a fuel resource!"

0b41600b-c1d4-4f9a-a7eb-56a8d06736ba.Text: "Glory to the von Valancius dynasty! Our benefactor!"

f3128fdc-f497-4b56-bc02-76cfe1a18343.Text: "Our {mf|lord|lady} has granted us the purgation of all traitors and thieves."

459d63f2-e6c9-4df0-80df-df7d6a35ad5c.Text: "Give me death, good folk! I am guilty! I robbed and I lied, so execute me!"

9c115ab4-5c2c-47c2-8fd4-352384826544.Text: "With the new Rogue Trader, our lives will be pure!"

ae1aca5b-b42d-41b8-b247-37c98b77f1c1.Text: "Execute the traitor! For the glory of the von Valancius dynasty!"

fab54991-c41b-4bba-9edf-4cf7c3cd5d12.Text: "I bet two thrones on that wimp! Damn!"

281663db-98fd-4403-b696-1c0992fadf80.Text: "May the good {name} live for a thousand years! They never put on a show like this under Theodora!"

8bb0a858-7d9a-4d19-ab66-d678164cd2a4.Text: "We bring you good tidings — the Emperor protects!"

0e18c4c6-cb41-473c-9388-02f7371115da.Text: "In this hour of dark portents, He shields us from the vileness of xenos and heresy most profane!"

3f567607-22ad-4482-825c-03f7b55bf64b.Text: "Glory to the Emperor! Protect us, Father!"

138f886e-a694-4bf7-8af7-756461c81bd8.Text: "Bow before the heir of the von Valancius dynasty, commoners!"

3d665c92-8b5f-44bc-8936-72e94c0263ac.Text: "Look at all that fat sizzlin'! I guess those sods were livin' it up under Her Butchership."

c1890a70-7583-491c-a866-e72e88f1eddb.Text: "Yeah, strolling 'round the station burning rabble is a cosy old job. A far sight better than breaking your back at the docks for a quarter of a ration."

f93ade03-186d-498a-822b-8ae91ed468a5.Text: "But the fat mugs forgot that all flesh burns the same. Turn up the heat, we've a good three dozen left to get through."

418c4ae8-8070-42ac-a2ec-9a7dcf7b4f70.Text: "For God-Emperor's sakes, careful! I want to lay him in an open casket!"

586b35a5-7417-4abd-8c3d-6eaafad83e51.Text: "I'm tryin', Ma! But those brutes did a number on him. Might as well rip the boards off!"

309ac8f2-a8cf-48c8-9b79-1995c553c171.Text: "Joyke, I still don't understand how they make corb starch? What is corb?"

a9550bf1-fb64-453e-af37-9c78436ea3f4.Text: "I'm afraid I don't quite understand you, Master Fitzger."

24a6a495-18d8-4520-b578-b8110edb5587.Text: "The protein bars we used to sell, and now we have to eat. They're made from corb starch."

ec99fe63-80e7-4e0b-acb2-1b4c15124608.Text: "Ah, I get it! The corpses of what? Groxes?"

4cfd40af-1988-48cc-b7f4-3b976694d09d.Text: "I'm sorry, Master Fitzger, but I have some bad news for you..."

14f84e44-76dd-4030-87a4-afb6b945c8eb.Text: "They say Lukra's been poisoned by sewer water again."

7445bdd1-79f0-4a14-b3dc-02e50a25335f.Text: "The fool! How many times do I have to tell her? You drink the condensate from the capacitors, not that sludge!"

c9d8e3b6-0e69-4d67-a4ea-315dc236d8da.Text: "I can hear the beating of his heart... the roaring blood in his veins... the pulsating fear in his black soul..."

56330232-bc0a-4d6e-8eb3-659ae1be0b04.Text: "When the time comes for me to step into this world, he will be waiting for me."

0e5067cc-b178-4be0-8e30-317077d135ab.Text: "I have come because the Prince wills it. The souls of all his progenitors belong to him alone. None will escape his embrace."

de180c13-8575-46d7-b1eb-93fb71f32ee1.Text: "Go to him... Pave my path to he who is meant to fall..."

55a374b5-705d-472e-8c44-cfec0f3fc592.Text: "Who is this? Is it the ruler of this vessel and the {mf|master|mistress} of the lost child? Come closer, let me get a good look at you."

2ba24b64-b4e9-4618-bb4f-f38cc4319d81.Text: The body is covered in hundreds of cuts, none of which look deep enough to have ended the victim's suffering in a single blow.

471f7d30-a5bd-4dfc-891c-990b7888f6e8.Text: The maimed, bloodied body looks like a broken marionette lying in an unnatural position.

05c52cdb-88e4-448d-b7b4-6ba76b2aed97.Text: The corpse is missing its eyes, and its face is horribly mutilated.

df11b977-1303-46d4-ac52-e72de24a5482.Text: "No rest for the forgotten, no glory for the disgraced."

ecd58d71-aca1-498f-9e68-3e35d8b0e2f0.Text: Scratched into the rock is the Eye of Repulsion, a sign used by Fenrisian scouts to indicate danger.

d87d54b6-3cd1-4b17-b8ce-a5abc5a141de.Text: Metal particles — the fragments of a power blade — glitter in the snow.

306a2ac7-4c98-456d-bdc5-cad0d0049797.Text: The rock is pitted all over — a bolter shell exploded nearby.

e222991d-154e-4a11-a443-4cfc1a8fbf93.Text: Stubber shell casings lie scattered in the snow.

311ec002-ec4d-459c-8c9a-21c2949a87a6.Text: The scouts discovered Ulfar's lifeless body here.

02c21844-d2bc-4fb1-9a43-1fda3ff95501.Text: The tracks of the mysterious enemy that defeated the Space Wolf have almost been hidden by the snow.

7520ffa4-7903-4bb2-a9f9-d7d58cc36c47.Text: "The symbolic gestures of the nobility remain a mystery to me, but there is one thing I know for certain: I want to grow closer to you."

8b09d302-f558-45b8-b58c-967d6278a784.Text: "Before I met you, I had never thought that I would find myself engaged in something of this sort. Will you permit me... to touch your hand?"

64306c57-023a-4285-a8a0-054444271ad9.Text: "When I am with you, Lady Cassia, I become heedless, ready to take on any rituals or trials. Will you... accept my feelings?"

ad237b16-8b9a-48af-abb8-250ab29de826.Text: "It was amusing, but no more than that. I have had enough of these games."

da19eb5a-4cfe-4db7-96a1-51791a763576.Text: {n}Cassia hesitates for a while, as if wondering if it would be more proper to say nothing. Eventually, however, she braces herself and firmly takes a half-step back.{/n} "Lord Captain, your attention... is making my life insufferable. You pretend to understand me. Pretend to have truly taken an interest in me."

514092ee-12a1-445d-8b99-39fe3f16d9eb.Text: "And yet nothing could be further from the absurd truth. Your words and actions wound my dignity. This is not the relationship I have dreamt of. A lady deserves better. I ask that you accept my words with grace: we were not meant to grow close, and thus you no longer have my permission to express sentiments that breach the bounds of propriety." {n}Cassia jerks her chin up and looks at you intently.{/n}

9bac2fc2-49ee-40d2-a721-f16f2238c298.Text: "I understand, Cassia. It pains me to hear that I have upset you."

3be64751-3b37-482e-bd82-ba9313c7b348.Text: {n}Timid doubt flashes in her eyes, but she just nods curtly.{/n} "I... do not loathe you, Lord Captain. We can still become good companions. Friends, even. But for now... let us enjoy a moment of respite from each other."

d885cc62-481b-4d8c-ab1e-cd34f5507bd3.Text: "But, Cassia, we can still make this right!"

0e3547ba-c29e-4570-8db2-02e81fe7f7c7.Text: "Out of the question." {n}Her sharp gesture erects an impenetrable wall between you.{/n} "I do not wish to continue this conversation any longer."

33ca7b54-a6af-43cd-942a-ceead95262fb.Text: "Ungrateful girl! After all I have done for you!"

dc8b2260-3012-405f-930e-4cd490fbe286.Text: "From the moment we met, you have always put your own welfare first, Lord Captain. I express my gratitude by faithfully serving this ship and carrying out my duties as her Navigator. Feelings, however... cannot be compelled."

65f60117-4532-4d53-a135-d967602593e1.Text: {n}Her ruby eyes demurely hide behind her lowered lashes.{/n} "I was not certain if engaging in this long-forgotten noble ritual was prudent of me. And yet you did everything in accordance with the customs of etiquette. I must admit I rather enjoyed this game. I hope... you did too."

73907cd4-7a94-4a8b-9147-237479fb958a.Text: {n}Cassia turns around at the sound of your footsteps, and a scattering of iridescent colours refracted through the prism of the gemstone in her hands illuminates her features.{/n} "Oh! {name}, you... you came after all. I must say I did not expect to receive such a generous gift in return. These stones, their hues enchant me! Now I can see the vivid colours of the world even when I am alone. Thank you."

193d3a13-3ada-439b-ba1e-a634ea30c716.Text: {n}The Lady Navigator's chambers are suffused with the fragrance of wildflowers, the sweetness of honey, a zesty touch of recaf and Calixian spices, all intermingled with fresh hints of sea waves. As Cassia pulls out yet another bottle of perfume from the elegant box, her gaze meets yours.{/n} "{name}, your gift... it is positively wonderful! A single drop of perfume is all it takes to make me feel like I am standing at the ocean shore or in a blooming garden. I never imagined that smells could brighten my world as vividly as colours. Thank you."

922c877c-20ac-4d01-b113-cb15e0c0d36a.Text: {n}Cassia is completely absorbed in admiring the shelves of her new personal library, which are all but buckling under the weight of gilded and leather bound tomes. Upon noticing you, she smiles, barely able to stop herself from rushing to meet you.{/n} "{name}! How... How did you procure all these works? By the Throne, even your personal collection doesn't have them — I would have remembered! So many unexplored worlds and stories, dozens of unstudied essays. You... I am utterly astounded. Thank you. I could not have dreamt of a better gift."

2d79f297-de9e-4dcb-b107-efcc687c0d11.Text: {n}Cassia is tentatively examining the large embroidery machine already loaded with the finest silk and gold thread. As you approach, she jerks her hand away in fright, and her sharp claws slice the translucent fabric.{/n} "Ah, {name}, you are here already. I... wanted to thank you for this unexpected gift. Embroidery... I have never engaged in anything of this sort before. It looks... most curious."

ebe3d7e7-1b6d-4b0e-b377-9bbfac0814a4.Text: {n}Awkwardly averting her eyes, Cassia hides her blushing face behind a curtain of silver hair.{/n} "I..."

1ad99f18-4a0a-4214-b708-b1b2596529e2.Text: {n}When Cassia's cold hand warms in yours, she awkwardly retracts it, trying not to prick you with her sharp claws.{/n} "I..."

696ab4da-7341-4339-af46-70d27ca7689d.Text: "In that case, Lord Captain... What I mean to say is... um... Your servants have done marvellously in their efforts to adapt these chambers to my needs and tastes!" {n}A meek smile touches her pale lips.{/n} "If I may, I would like to retire after an arduous day. And you... we... we shall see each other tomorrow."

492c0608-d734-4614-81a3-303d5df73998.Text: {n}The Lady Navigator's valet greets you with a deep bow and humbly delivers a tasteful scroll inviting you to a private meeting.{/n}

5bc48967-e845-4d0e-8673-e6346dcf7198.Text: [Examine the dome with the plant inside]

2fcff58b-1095-43af-a740-4bef669034ff.Text: {n}However, the Lady Navigator's intentions are still not entirely clear. High Factotum Janris Danrok should be able to assist you with his expertise in gestures of such kind. Alternatively, the Vox Master could uncover something useful by listening in on the personal communication channels of the ship's officers.{/n}

c7448004-292c-4c01-af3d-021ca4513927.Text: {n}As for the plant itself, a term from the ancient etiquette of the nobility, all but forgotten in this day and age, comes to your mind — "immortalium," or "eternal flower." A living plant capable of enduring in the void for centuries. An extremely rare sight in the Koronus Expanse — and an unmistakable token of the giver's special favour.{/n}

063aa737-860a-48a1-959d-84e48d3abd3c.Text: {n}Before you is a fragile branch of Lavandulum Quaddis — a most rare specimen native to the world of Quaddis in the Calixis Sector. Covered in tiny blooms the colour of a purple sky, the plant has been carefully sealed inside a dome along with mineral fertiliser modified by the Magos Biologis, which will sustain it for many years.{/n}

f63572c7-9069-4581-b1be-3328150b85de.Text: {n}Before you is a fragile branch of an unknown plant covered in tiny blooms the colour of a purple sky. Sealed inside a dome with some viscous bluish liquid, the flower somehow carries on with its solitary existence behind the thin layer of glass without any soil, roots, or most of its leaves.{/n}

b102f224-7d1e-439a-9ac6-b51e792d9719.Text: {n}You have already met the servant who delivered this gift — he is Lady Cassia's personal valet. At least you know the identity of the sender.{/n}

6366e3f1-7c79-4f15-b491-c8a319d2488e.Text: {n}What the sender of such an unusual gift meant to achieve with it remains unclear. High Factotum Janris Danrok should be able to assist you with his expertise in articles of such rarity. In the meantime, the Vox Master could look into the sender's intentions by listening in on the personal communication channels of the ship's officers.{/n}

607c64f2-778d-4b2c-a741-1a16545451f0.Text: {n}The appearance of an immortalium in the life of two aristocrats is a unique ritual, the purpose of which is to demonstrate their true intentions without words. Every gesture, glance, or phrase in this ritual is imbued with deep symbolic meaning. You are expected to take the next step, which is either to reject the gift by pointedly ignoring its existence, or to accept it on your own terms. The recipient's acceptance can be expressed through words of gratitude in private conversation or by sending a gift in return. High Factotum Janris Danrok can always assist you with the latter.{/n}

c9d377f2-e056-4f2c-a789-937a060700cb.Text: {n}The young servant in fine livery quickly bows to you and places a peculiar object on your desk — a transparent dome with a living flower inside.{/n}

99990748-c5b3-4679-8c4c-36b9cb0c878f.Text: {n}He gestures at the crystal dome, then at you, then makes several more gestures and stands at attention, staring at the tips of his boots.{/n}

c17f6a01-483e-4659-b168-b6b7533a78e1.Text: {n}The servant gestures at the flower, and the vox-caster built into his respiratory system lets out a crackle of static.{/n} "I was instructed to deliver this gift to the Lord Captain only."

3da749e7-6951-444d-aff8-1fb18ff4619c.Text: {n}The servant starts, then shrugs, then offers several deep bows and swiftly departs.{/n}

f7f9beec-9c12-491d-a4a7-a9dedae4c9c7.Text: {n}A strained sigh comes out of the vox.{/n} "P-please stay your anger, Your Lordship, but this servant knows nothing. He was instructed to deliver this without asking or answering any questions on pain of losing his tongue... again. S-so... h-here we are... I'm afraid I can't help you..." {n}The servant shrugs nervously, then offers you several deep bows and swiftly departs.{/n}
